english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Ne èdze nusiwo nèƒã ɖe agble me la ŋeŋe gɔme la, naɖu ŋkekenyuie, eye ne eƒo wò agblemenuwo nu ƒu ɖe ava me le ƒe la ƒe nuwuwu me la, ekema nagaɖu ŋkekenyuie.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutsuwo katã nava wò Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋku me zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: Zi etɔ̃ naɖu ŋkekenyuie nam le ƒe ɖeka me.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku abolo maʋamaʋã ŋkeke la dzi; ŋkeke adre sɔŋ naɖu abolo maʋamaʋã le nuŋeɣleti ƒe ŋkeke, si woɖo la dzi, abe alesi mede se na wò ene; elabena eya dzi nèʋu tso Egipte. Ke womava ŋkunye me asi gbolo o.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò agblemenu gbãtɔ, siwo ʋã la, va Yehowa, wò Mawu la, ƒe me. Megaɖa gbɔ̃vi le dada ƒe notsi me o. Le Kanaanitɔwo nyanyã kple yayra ŋugbedodo na Israel ŋuti.

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, medɔ nye dɔla ɖo ɖe ŋgɔwò, bena wòakpɔ dziwò le mɔ ta, eye woakplɔ wò ava teƒe, si medzra ɖo ɖi na wò la.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nyuie le eŋu, eye naɖo to eƒe gbe; megasẽ tame ɖe eŋu o, elabena matsɔ miaƒe vodadawo ake mi o, elabena nye megbea wònye.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: Ne eɖo to eƒe gbe, eye nèwɔ nu, siwo katã magblɔ na wò la, ekema malé lu wò ketɔwo, eye maɖe to ɖe amesiwo xaxa wò ɖo.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Ne nye ɖɔla dze ŋgɔwò, eye wòkplɔ wò va Amoritɔwo, Xititɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Kanaanitɔwo, Xiwitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo gbɔ, eye metsrɔ̃ wo la,

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: ekema megade ta agu na woƒe mawuwo alo asubɔ wo o, eye megawɔ nusiwo wowɔna la o; ke boŋ nagblẽ wo, eye nagbã woƒe legbawo.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Ne miesubɔ Yehowa, miaƒe Mawu la, ekema ayra ɖe wò nuɖuɖu kple wò nunono dzi, eye maxe mɔ na dɔléle, be mava mia dome o.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: Madɔ vɔvɔ̃, si le ŋunye la, ɖe ŋgɔwò, eye dukɔ, siwo katã dome nava la, alulu, eye wò futɔwo katã asi le ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Madɔ téamekplɔɖoewo ɖe ŋgɔwò, bena wòanya Xiwitɔwo, Kanaanitɔwo kple Xititɔwo le ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Gake nyemanyẽ wo katã le dowòme le ƒe ɖeka me o, bena anyigba la magato gbe, eye lã wɔadãwo nadzi ɖe dzi anɔ fu ɖem na wò o.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: Manɔ wo nyãm le mia ŋu ʋeʋeʋe, vaseɖe esime míadzi ɖe dzi eye anyigba la natu mia nu.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Eye mana wò liƒowo natso Avaƒu la nu vaseɖe Filistitɔwo ƒe ƒu la nu, tso gbedzi vaseɖe tɔsisi la nu; elabena matsɔ anyigbadzitɔwo ade asi na wò, eye nanyã wo le dowòme.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Migabia nu kpli wo alo naxɔ woƒe mawuwo o.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Womeganɔ wò anyigba dzi o, ne womagava ble wò nawɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye o. Elabena ne èsubɔ woƒe mawuwo la, atrɔ zu mɔ̃ aɖe wò.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na Mose bena: Lia toa va Yehowa gbɔ, wò ŋutɔ kple Aron, Nadab kple Abihu kpakple Israel-me tsitsiawo dome ame blaadre, eye míado gbe ɖa le adzɔge.

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: Eye Mose ɖeɖe nate ɖe Yehowa ŋu, ke woawo megate vo o, eye dukɔ la hã megana to la kplii o.

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Eye Mose yi ɖagblɔ Yehowa ƒe nyawo katã kple ɖoɖoawo katã na dukɔ la. Tete dukɔ la katã ɖo ŋu yoo gblɔ bena: Nya, siwo katã Yehowa gblɔ la, míawɔe!

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye Mose ŋlɔ Yehowa ƒe nyawo katã, eye wòtso ŋdi kanya ɖaɖi vɔsamlekpui, eye wòɖo dzesikpe wuieve ɖe Israel ƒe to wuieveawo nu ɖe to la te.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye Mose dɔ Israel-viwo dome ɖekakpuiwo ɖa, eye wotsɔ nyitsuwo mè numevɔsawo, eye wosa akpedavɔwo na Yehowa.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Eye Mose ku ʋu la ƒe afã ɖe ze me, eye wõhlẽ ʋu la ƒe afã ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ agbalẽ, si me nubablanyawo le, hexlẽ sesĩe ɖe dukɔ la ƒe to me. Tete wogblɔ bena: Nya, siwo katã Yehowa gblɔ la, miawɔe, eye míalé eme ɖe asi!

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Eyome Mose, tsɔ du la wu ɖe dukɔ la dome gblɔ bena: Esia enye nusi Yehowa bia kpli mi, ɖe nya siawo katã dzi la, ƒe ʋu. Nunɔlawo kple amegã blaadre wo kpɔ Mawu ɖa.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Esia megbe Mose kple Aron, Nadab kple Abihu kpakple Israel-me tsitsiawo dome ame blaadre la wolia to la,

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: eye wokpɔ Israel ƒe Mawu la, eƒe afɔgbɔ le abe gbloti, alo abe alesi alilime kɔna keŋkeŋ ene.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Ke mewɔ naneke Israel-viwo ƒe ame ŋkutawo o, eye woɖe ŋku ɖe Mawu ŋu, emegbe woɖu nu, eye wono nu. Mose galia yi to la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Va gbɔnye le to la dzi, eye natsi anyi, ne matsɔ kpe, siwo dzi meŋlɔ ɖoɖoawo kple seawo ɖo, bena nafia wo la, na wo!

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Tete Mose tso, eye eƒe subɔla Yosua kpe ɖe eŋu, eye Mose lia Mawu ƒe to la.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na ame tsitsiawo bena: Mina afisia, vaseɖe esime míagatrɔ ava mia gbɔ. Kpɔ ɖa, Aron kple Xur le mia gbã, ne ʋɔnunyaa ɖe le amea ɖe si la, wòatsɔe ayi wo gbɔe.

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Esi Mose yi toa dzi la, tete alilikpo va tsyɔ to la.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe va nɔ Sinai-to la dzi, eye alilikpo tsyɔ to la ŋkeke ade sɔŋ Le ŋkeke adreagbe la eyɔ Mose tso alilikpo la me.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple aɖabɛ dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dze, ɖeti ɣi kple gbɔ̃fuwo,

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo bena, woadzɔ nu nam. Midzɔ nu nam le amesiame, si lɔ̃ tso dzime faa la si.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Nusiwo miadzɔ le wo si la wonye: Sika, klosalo kple akɔbli,

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: agbogbalẽ, si wode ama dzi, nyogbalẽ kple xé.

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: Ami ɖe akaɖiniedede ŋu kple ami ʋeʋẽe hena sisi kple numeme ʋeʋẽe.

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: Soham-kpe kple kpe xɔasiwo, bena woatsɔ aɖo kɔmewu kple akɔtaɖonu la ŋu.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Eye woawɔ nɔƒe kɔkɔe nam, bena manɔ wo dome.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Eye nafa sika nyuitɔ ɖe eŋu; nafae ɖe eme kple ekɔgo, eye natsɔ sika ado atsiã ɖe eto akpe ɖo.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Emegbe nakɔ sikasigɛ ene, eye naklã wo ɖe eƒe dzogoe eneawo ŋu; asigɛ eve nanɔ axa ɖeka, eye asigɛ eve hã nanɔ axa evelia.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Eyome natsɔ xé akpa kpowo, eye nafa sika ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ kpoawo aƒo ɖe asigɛ, siwo le aɖaka la ƒe axawo dzi la me, bena woatsɔ wo akɔ aɖaka lae.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Kpoawo natsi asigɛawo me le aɖaka la ŋu, eye womaɖe wo le eme o.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Wɔ Kerubi ɖeka ɖe go si dzi, eye Kerubi evelia ɖe go keme dzi; ale Kerubiawo kple eve nanɔ go eveawo dzi.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ nutsyɔnu la aɖo aɖaka la tame, ke natsɔ se, siwo mana wò la, ade aɖaka la me.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Kerubi eve, siwo le nubablaɖaka tame la domee maɖe ɖokuinye afia wò le, eye magblɔ nya, siwo katã made asi na Israel-viwo la na wò tso afima. Sikakplɔ̃.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Eye naɖo to nɛ akpe ɖo, esi akeke asi ɖeka, eye natsɔ sika ado atsiã de to la ŋu akpe ɖo.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Tsɔ sika wɔ asigɛ ene, eye naklã asigɛawo ɖe eƒe afɔ eneawo ƒe axa eneawo dzi.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Tsɔ xé kpa kpewo, eye nata sika ɖe wo ŋu; woawoe woatsɔ akɔ kplɔ̃ lae.

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: Eyome natsɔ sika nyuitɔ awɔ akaɖitii; woatu akaɖitia, eƒe afɔ kple ati la, eye woawɔ kawo, seƒoƒowo kple woƒe tamekukuwo ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: and four on the stem.
translation_verse: Eye seƒoƒo ene kple woƒe tamekukuwo nanɔ atia ŋutɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Kɔawo kple alɔavvo nawɔ ɖeka ɖe ati la ŋu; sika nyuitɔ woatso atu akaɖiti lae blibo.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Eye natso sika nyuitɔ awɔ ɖovulãnuwo kple ganu suewoe.

english_verse: The lampstand and its equipment will require
translation_verse: Woatso sika nyuitɔ talento ɖeka awɔ akaɖiti la kple eŋu nuawo katãe.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Kpɔ dzi, be nawɔe ɖe nɔnɔme, si wotia wò le toa dzi la nu pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Eye avɔlɔ̃lawo natsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dze kple ɖeti ɣi dada alɔ̃ avɔ, bena woatsɔ atu agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Kuntru ɖeka ƒe didime nanye abɔklugui blaetɔ̃, eye eƒe kekeme nanye abɔklugui ene. Dzidzeme ɖeka nanɔe na kuntru wuiɖekɛawo katã.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Tsɔ kuntru ewo wɔ nɔƒe la; eye aɖaŋuvɔlɔ̃lawo natsɔ ɖetí ɣi dada, aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka kpakple ka dze alɔ̃e, eye woalɔ̃ Kerubiwo ɖe eme.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Woatɔ kuntruawo akpe ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu atɔ̃atɔ̃.

english_verse: The panel of goat hair will be a meter longer than the tent itself, so fold
translation_verse: Eye kuntru, siwo tsi edzi le agbadɔ la ƒe didime go eveawo dzi la, nadzo de anyigba abɔklugui ɖeka, bena woaxe agbadɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Natɔ Kuntru atɔ̃ akpe vovo, eye natɔ kuntru ade hã akpe vovo, eye naŋe kuntru adelia, si le agbadɔ la ƒe ŋgɔdze la me ɖe eve.

english_verse: and fasten the two panels at the loops with
translation_verse: Eyome natu akɔbliganuvi blaatɔ̃, eye natsɔ ganuviawo aku kaawo, bena agbadɔ la nakpe azu ɖeka.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Emegbe natso agbogbalẽ, si wode ama dzi la, agba agbadɔ la, eye nagatsɔ nyogbalẽ agba edzi. Agbadɔ la ƒe nuƒowo.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ nutsyɔnu la ada ɖe nubablaɖaka la dzi le kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la me.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Esia yome natsɔ xè adze ʋuƒo, siwo woatu na agbadɔ la.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ klosalo awɔ afɔ blane ɖe wo gome, afɔ eve nano ʋuƒo ɖesiaɖe gɔme.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Eye nadze ʋuƒo ade hena agbadɔ la ƒe axa, si le ɣedzeƒe gome.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Eye woakpe wo gome kple wo tame ɖe ʋuƒoawo ŋu, bena asigɛ ɖeka nano wo ŋu. Alea woawo wo kple eve lae, eye woanɔ dzogoeawo kple eve dzi.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Wo katã le ʋuƒo enyi, siwo gome woawo klosalofɔ wuiade ɖo, afɔ eve nanɔ ʋuƒo ɖesiaɖe gɔme. Gametiawo.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Eye gameti dometɔ nato ʋuƒoawo titina, tso agbadɔ la ƒe go ɖeka me vaseɖe go keme me.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Fa sika ɖe ʋuƒoawo ŋu, eye natsɔ sika atu wo ŋuti sigɛ, siwo me woaƒo gametiawo ɖo, eye nafa sika ɖe gametiwo hã ŋu.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Tu agbadɔ la ɖe nɔnɔme, si wofia wo le toa dzi la nu pɛpɛpɛ. Xɔmetsovɔ eveawo.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Tsa kplɔ̃ la da ɖe xɔmetsovɔa ŋgɔ le anyiehe gome, eye natsɔ akaɖiti la ada ɖe agbadɔ la ƒe dziehe gome le kplɔ̃ la kasa.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ku xɔmetsovɔ la ɖe kuntru gbãtɔwo ƒe kpeƒe, eye natso nubablaɖaka la ada ɖe xɔmetsovɔ la godo, eye xɔmetsovɔ la natsɔ kɔkɔeƒe la kple kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la me na mi.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Emegbe natsɔ xé akpa sɔti atɔ̃ hena avɔ la; fa sika ɖe wo ŋu, eye natsɔ sika awɔ wo ŋuti gatagbadzɛawo, eye natsɔ akɔbli akɔ afɔwo ɖe wo gɔme.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Eye woatsɔ kpoawo aƒo ɖe asigɛawo me, eye kpoawo nanɔ vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axawo kple eve dzi, bena woatsɔ wo akɔe.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Eye nawɔ afilɔnuwo, sofiwo, zewo, gaflowo kple dzoɖesonuwo ɖe eŋu, eye natsɔ akɔbli awɔ eŋuti nuawo katãe.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ʋuƒo natsɔ awɔe, eye to nanɔ me. Alesi wolia wò le Noa dzi la, nenema nawɔe. Kpɔ la.

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: De se na Israel-viwo, ne woatsɔ dzomi nyuitɔ vɛ na wò hena akaɖiawo, bena woate ŋu atsɔ akaɖigbɛawo aɖo ati dzi ɖaa

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Wɔ kpɔti blave, eye natsɔ akɔbli atu afɔ blave ɖe wo gɔme; ke natsɔ klosalo awɔ kpɔtiawo ŋuti gatagbadzɛwo kple heletiwoe.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Esia megbe avɔlɔ̃lawo natsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ, ka dze kple ɖeti ɣi dada alɔ avɔ, si adidi abɔklugui blave hena agbo la nu, eye kpɔti ene, siwo gɔme afɔ ene le la, nakpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Nusiwo katã ŋu dɔ woawɔ le kpɔa me, nanye akɔbli; agbadɔ la ŋu tsyotiwo kple kpɔ la ŋu tsyotiwo katã nanye akɔbli. Dzomi nyui la.

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, le xɔmetsovɔ, si xe nubablaɖaka ŋku me la ŋgɔ, eye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo nadzrae ɖo, bena wòanɔ bibim le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me tso fiẽ vaseɖe ŋdi. Esia anye ɖoɖo na Israel-viwo kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo tegbee.

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Eye naɖe nɔviwò Aron kple viaŋutsuwo le Israel-viwo dome ava gbɔwòe, bena woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm; Aron ŋutɔ kple viaŋutsuwo: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar kple Itamar.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Eye gblɔ na amesiwo katã mede nunya tagbɔ na, eye wònya adaŋu la bena, woatɔ Aron ƒe awuawo, ne woaɖoe nunɔla, be wòasubɔm. Nunɔlawo ƒe awuwo.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Nusiwo woatɔ wonye: akɔtaɖonu, kɔmewu, dziwui, awutewui ʋlaya, si wotsɔ deti ɣi lɔ̃e, tablanu kple alidziblanu; eye woatɔ awu kɔkɔewo na nɔviwò Aron kple viaŋutsuwo, be woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye woawɔ sika, aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple deti ɣi ŋu dɔ. Nunɔlawo ƒe kɔmewu.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ ka, si wotsɔ sika nyuitɔ gbee la, awɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ eve, eye natɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔawo ɖe gboawo ŋu. Akɔtaɖonu la.

english_verse: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Kpeawo nanɔ wuieve ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ŋkɔwo nu, eye ŋkɔɖelawo nata to wuieveawo ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: Eye aɖaŋuvɔlɔ̃lawo natsɔ sika, aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dze kple ɖeti ɣi dada alɔ kɔmewu ƒe avɔ tɔgbe hena akɔtaɖonu, si enye nyametsonu la.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ kpe xɔasiwo aɖo eŋu ɖe agbaka ene me. Agbaka gbãtɔ nanye karneol, topas kple smaragd;

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: agbaka evelia nanye rubin, safir kple oniks,

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: agbaka etɔ̃lia nanye ligurio, axat kple ametist,

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: eye agbaka enelia nanye krisolit, soham kple yaspis. Eye woatsɔ sika aƒo fefeka ɖe wo ŋu akpe ɖo.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Eyome nade kɔsɔkɔsɔ eveawo ƒe nu eveawo gbo eveawo ŋu, eye natɔ gboawo ɖe kɔmewu la ƒe abɔtawo, le ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Eye woagbe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka asa ɖe asigɛ, siwo le akɔtaɖonu la ŋuti la ŋu ahade asigɛ, siwo le kɔmewua ŋuti la me, ale be akɔtaɖonu manɔ ʋaʋãm o, eye woanɔ akɔgbanu la dzi.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: Emegbe natsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka ɖeɖe alɔ̃ dziwui, si dzi woaɖo kɔmewu la ɖo.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Eye woaɖe kɔme nɛ ɖe titina, afisi woaƒo ta ɖo, eye avɔlɔ̃la naƒo kɔ la me to akpe, bena magadze o.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Sikanyawowoe ɖeka yevuboɖa ɖeka, sikanyawowoe ɖeka yevuboɖa ɖeka; alea woanɔ dziwui la to godoo ava kpee.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Eye woanɔ Aron ŋu, ne ele subɔsubɔm, eye woanɔ ɖiɖim wòase, ne eyi kɔkɔeƒe le Yehowa ŋku me alo wòɖo go, bena nagaku o. Ŋgoblanu.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ sika nyuitɔ awɔ ŋgoblanu, eye ŋkɔɖelawo nata nu ɖe dzi bena: „Kɔkɔea na Yehowa.“

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Eye natsii ɖe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka ŋuti le tablanu la ŋu le ŋgɔ.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Eye wòanɔ Aron ƒe ŋgonu; ale Aron naxa vodada, siwo le Israel-viwo ƒe nunanawo katã ŋu la, aƒu akɔ; eye wòanɔ eƒe ŋgonu ɖaa, bena woƒe nunanawo nadze Yehowa ŋu. Awutewui ʋlaya, tablanu, alidzinublanu kple agbotɛ.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: Eyome nalɔ̃ awutewui ʋlaya, alidziblanu kple tablanu na Aron viŋutsuwo, bena woade bubu wo ŋu, eye woaɖo atsyɔ̃ na wo.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Ɖo atsyɔ̃ na nɔviwò Aron kple viaŋutsuwo, eye nasi ami na wo, aɖo wo, eye nawɔ wo kɔkɔe, bena woanye nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Eye natɔ agbotɛ ɣiwo na wo, woadidi ava se ali me, bena woado ɖe woƒe ama.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Eye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo nadoe, ne woyina ɖe agbadɔ, si me Yehowa ɖea eɖokui fiana le la me, alo wote ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, be woasubɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la, ne maganye vodada na wo, eye woaku o. Esia nanye ɖoɖo na eya ŋuta kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo tegbee.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Gbesiagbe nawu nyitsu ɖeka hena nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsa, abe avulenu ene. Eye naɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le vɔsamlekpui la ŋu to avulénuwo meme le edzi me, eye nasi ami ne awɔe kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: eye natsɔ wɔ memee aƒo abolo maʋamaʋà kple aboŋgo maʋamaʋã, eye natɔ tatali maʋamaʋã akɔ ami ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wo de kusi me, eye woatsɔ woa kple kusi la vɛ, eye nakplɔ nyitsu la kple agbo eveawo vɛ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Eye na bena, Aron kple viaŋutsuawo nate va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye nale tsi na wo.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Fɔ awua wo vɛ, eye nado awutewui ʋlaya la kple dziwui la kpakple kɔmewu la na Aron; gba wo dzi nɛ kple akɔgbanu, eye natsɔ akɔtaɖonu la aɖo eŋu.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Tso ami ko ɖe eƒe tame, eye nasi ami ne.

english_verse: caps, and sashes, then ordain them, because they and their descendants will always be priests.
translation_verse: Bla ali dzi na wo, Aron ŋutɔ kple viaŋutsuawo, eye nabla tablanu la na wo, bena nunɔladɔ nazu wo to tegbee. Ale naɖo Aron kple viaŋutsuawo enye si;

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: He nyitsu la va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋgɔ, eye Aron kple viaŋutsuawo natsɔ woƒe asiwo aɖe nyitsua ƒe tame.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Eye nawu nyitsu la le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Eye nade asibide nyitsu la ƒe ʋu me asisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, ke natsɔ ʋu mamlea katã akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Ke natɔ dzo nyitsu la ƒe lã, eƒe agbalẽ kple dɔmemiwo le asaɖa la godo; elabena nuvɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsae.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Emegbe nahe agbo ɖeka vɛ, eye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo natsɔ woƒe asiwò ada ɖe agbo la ƒe tame,

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: eye nawu agbo la atsɔ eƒe ʋu awu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Eyome nafli agbo la ɖe eƒe ƒunuɖeƒeewo, eye nakpala eƒe dɔmenuwo kple eƒe afɔwo, eye natsɔ wo ada ɖe eƒe akpa mamleawo kple la dzi.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Eye natɔ dzo agbo blibo la ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi; elabena numevɔsa wònye na Yehowa, ʋeʋẽ lilili kple Yehowa ƒe dzo wònye.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Emegbe nahe agbo evelia vɛ, eye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo natsɔ woƒe asiwò ada ɖe agbo la ƒe tame.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eye nawu agbo la atsɔ eƒe ʋu asisi ɖe Aron kple viaŋutsuawo ƒe nuɖusi togboewo, nuɖusi-degblefetsuwo kple nuɖusifɔ-degblefetsuwo ŋu, eye natsɔ ʋu mamlea awu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ ʋu, si le vɔsamlekpui dzi, kple ami awu ɖe Aron ŋutɔ kple eƒe awuawo kpakple viaŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuawo ŋu, bena eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe awuwo, viaŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuawo ŋuti nakɔ.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: Eyome naɖe ami, siwo le agboa ŋu; ɖe asike la kple eŋu miwo, ami, siwo le dɔmenuawo ŋu, aklã ŋu miwo, ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu miwo kpakple nuɖusita; elabena ameɖoɖo ƒe agboe.

english_verse: Take one loaf of each kind of bread from the basket,
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ abolo bɔbɔ ɖeka, aboŋgo ɖeka kple tatali ɖeka, siwo nye nu maʋamaʋãwo le Yehowa ŋku me la, le kusia me,

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: eye natsɔ nuawo katã ade asiƒome na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo, eye nanyè nuawo le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Emegbe naxɔ nuawo le wo si ada ɖe vɔsalã la dzi le vɔsamlekpuia dzi, eye natɔ dzo wo, bena woaʋẽ lilili de Yehowa. Yehowa ƒe dzo wònye.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ɖe agbo, si wowu hena Aron ɖoɖo la ƒe akɔ, eye nanyee le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, emegbe woazu towò.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Viaŋutsuwo dometɔ, si azu nunɔla ɖe eteƒe, amesi ayi Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, bena wòasubɔ le kɔkɔeƒea la, nadoe ŋkeke adre sɔŋ.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: Ke naɖa agbo, si wowu hena ameɖoɖo la, ƒe lã le teƒe kɔkɔe la

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Eye Aron kple viaŋutsuawo naɖu agbolã la kple abolo, siwo le kusia me la, le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Ale woaɖu nusi wotsɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa hafi ɖo wo, eye wowɔ wo kɔkɔe la; ke ame bubua ɖeke mekpɔ mɔ aɖui o, elabena nu kɔkɔe ye.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Ne ameɖovɔsalã la kple abolo la ƒe ɖe tsi anyi ŋu ke ɖe edzi la, ekema woatɔ dzoe; womaɖui o, elabena nu kɔkɔe ye.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: Wɔ na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo pɛpɛpɛ, abe alesi mede se na wò ene: ŋkeke adre sɔŋ naɖo wo.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adre sɔŋ name avulénuwo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye nawɔe kɔkɔe, bena vɔsamlekpui la nazu nu kɔkɔetɔ. Nusianu, si aka vɔsamlekpui ŋu la, azu kɔkɔe. Gbesiagbe numeme.

english_verse: Each day you must sacrifice two lambs a year old,
translation_verse: Eye nusiwo namè le vɔsamlekpuia dzi, wonye esi. Gbesiagbe name alẽvi eve, siwo xɔ ƒe ɖekaɖeka.

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Me alẽvi ɖeka le ŋdi, eye alẽvi evelia le fiẽ.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Mè alẽvi evelia le fiẽ me: eye nawɔ nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa, siwo kpe ɖe eŋu la, abe ŋdi tɔ ene: esia enye dzo, si aʋẽ lilili ɖe Yehowa.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Makɔ agbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpuia ŋu, eye makɔ Aron kple viaŋutsuawo ŋuti, bena woanye nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Mana Israel-viwo dome, eye manye woƒe Mawu.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Eye wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa, woƒe Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, bena manɔ wo dome, nye Yehowa!

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Migawɔ dzudzɔdonu, si nawɔ la, tɔgbea ɖeke o, ke boŋ miabui kɔkɔe na Yehowa.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: numevɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu nuwo kpakple tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: Tso xe wo vɔsamlekpui, si dzi wòado dzudzɔ ɖo.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Eye nawɔ sikasigɛ eveve ɖe eƒe axawo kple eve dzi le atsiãdodo la te, bena woate ŋu aƒo kpo ɖe wo me akɔe.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Tsɔ xe kpa kpoawo, eye nafa sika ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔe ada ɖe nubablaɖaka, si dzi nutsyɔnu la le, afisi maɖe ɖokuinye afia wò le la, kasa le xɔmetsovɔ la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Migatsɔ dzudzɔdonu bubua ɖeke va edzi migatsɔ numevɔsa alo nuɖuvɔsa va edzi o, eye migakɔ nunovɔsa hã ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Eye Aron natsɔ nuvɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsalã, si enye avulénu la, ƒe ʋu aɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eƒe dzowo ŋu zi ɖeka le ƒe ɖeka me. Zi ɖeka woaɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eŋu le ƒe ɖeka me, eye wòanye ɖoɖo na miaƒe dzidzimeviwo; elabena nu kɔkɔetɔ wònye na Yehowa. Gadzɔdzɔ ɖe agbadɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena;

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: Ne ètia Israel-viwo xlẽ la, ekema amesiwo netia la, naxe fe ɖe woƒe agbe ta, bena dɔ vɔ̃ɖia ɖeke magaɖo wo dome, le esi woxlẽ wo la ta o.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Eye Aron kple viaŋutsuawo naklɔ woƒe asiwo kple afɔwo le eme.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye nagblẽ ga, si Israel-viwo na ɖe woƒe agbe ta la, ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu, bena wòanye ŋkuɖodzinu kple avulénu na Israel-viwo le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me. Akɔblitsileze.

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wɔ etɔgbe, be yeaʋẽ ase la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena:

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Wɔ wo kɔkɔe, bena woanye nu kɔkɔetɔwo, nusianu, si aka wo ŋuti la, azu kɔkɔe.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena:

english_verse: for dedicating the tent and chest,
translation_verse: Eye nasii ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple nubablaɖaka la,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: kplɔ̃ la kple eŋu nuwo, akaɖiti la kple eŋu nuwo, kple dzudzɔdovɔsamlekpui la,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Eye nasi ami na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo awɔ wo kɔkɔe, bena woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Womasii na ame bubua ɖeke o, eye womawɔ etɔgbe hã o, elabena nu kɔkɔe wònye, eye nu kɔkɔe wòanye na mi.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wɔ etɔgbe alo wòna eƒe ɖe ame bubua ɖe la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome. Dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe donu.

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ wo awɔ dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe donui; natɔtɔ wo, abe alesi atike ʋeʋẽe wɔlawo wɔne ene; nade dze eme, eme nadza, eye woabui kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Eye natu eƒe ɖe memee ada ɖe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, afisi maɖe ɖokuinye afia wò le; nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wòanye na mi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena:

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metia Bezaleel, Uri viŋutsu, si enye Xur ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi tso Yuda-to la me,

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ Oholiab, Axisamak viŋutsu tso Dan-to la me, kpe ɖe eŋuti, eye metsɔ nunya de amesiwo katã ƒe dzime nunya le la, ƒe tame, bena woawɔ nusiwo katã ƒe se meɖe na wò la:

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo bena: Miɖo ŋku ne dzudzɔgbeawo dzi! Elabena dzesi wònye le mia kpli mi kpakple miaƒe dzidzimeviwo dome, ne mianyae bena, nye Yehowa enye amesi wɔ mi kɔkɔe.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Dzesi wonye le mia kple Israel-viwo dome tegbee; elabena ŋkeke ade Yehowa wɔ dzi kple anyigba, ke edzudzɔ eɖokui le ŋkeke adreagbe, eye wògbɔ ɖe eme. Kpe, si dzi woŋlɔ se ɖo.

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòƒo nu kple Mose le Sinai-toa dzi vɔ la, etsɔ kpe eveawo, siwo dzi sea le la ne, kpe, siwo dzi Mawu ŋutɔ tsɔ eƒe asibide ŋlɔ nui ɖo.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Mekpɔ bena, dukɔ sia la dukɔ kɔ lialiatɔ wònye.

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Esi wòtɔ ŋdi la, wome numevɔsawo, eye wotsɔ akpedavɔsawo ve, eye dukɔ la bɔbɔ nɔ anyi, ɖu nu, eye wono nu. Emegbe wotsi tre de asi fefe me.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ bena: Mitsɔ vɔsanu vɛ na Yehowa, bena yayra nava mia dzi egbea; elabena ŋutsu sia ŋutsu tsi tre ɖe viaŋutsu kple nɔvia ŋu. Mose ɖe kuku ɖe dukɔ la ta.

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Esi dukɔ la kpɔ bena: Mose mele gbɔgbɔm tso toa dzi o la, dukɔ la ƒo ƒu ɖe Aron ŋu, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Netsɔ, wɔ mawu na mí, si azɔ mía ŋgɔ; elabena Mose, ŋutsu ma, si kplɔ mí tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, mienyã nusi gɔ̃ wɔe o.

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Aron gblɔ na wo bena: Miɖe sikatɔgɛ, siwo le mia srɔ̃wo, mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo ƒe towo, eye mitsɔ wo vɛ nam.

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Eye wòxɔ wo le wo si, eye wotsɔ pɛ wɔ nyivi ƒe nɔnɔme, eye wòkɔe. Tete wogblɔ bena: Israel, esia nye wò mawu, si kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Esi Aron kpɔe la, eɖi vɔsamlekpui ɖe eŋgɔ. Eye Aron do kpo bena: Etsɔ enye ŋkekenyuie na Yehowa!

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Tso, ɖi yi; elabena wo dukɔ, si nekplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, wɔ nu gbegblẽ.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Wote ɖa enumake le mɔ, si meɖo na wo la dzi, wokɔ nyivi na wo ɖokui, eye wode ta agu nɛ hesa vɔ nɛ gblɔ bena: Israel, esia enye wò mawu, si kplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba la dzi.

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Eyata na nye dɔmedzoe nabi ɖe wò ŋu, be matsrɔ̃ wo, eye mawɔ wò natrɔ zu dukɔ gãa ɖe.

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ke Mose ƒo koko na Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la, gblɔ bena. Yehowa, nukaŋuti wò dɔmedzoe abi ɖe wò dukɔ, si nẽkplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi kple ŋusẽ gã kpakple asi sesẽ la ŋuti mana?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti Egiptetɔwo agblɔ bena: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e didi na wo ta wòkplɔ woyii ɖo, bena wòa wu wo le towo domee, eye woatsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le anyigba ŋku me? Na wò dome nata, eye naɖe asi le vɔ̃, si neɖo ɖe wò dukɔ ŋuti la ŋu.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò dɔla Abraham, Isak kple Israel dzi, amesiwo neka atam na, eye nègblɔ na wo bena: Mana miaƒe dzidzimeviwo nasɔ gbɔ abe dziƒoɣletiviwo ene, eye matsɔ anyigba blibo sia, si ŋugbe meɖo ta, ana miaƒe dzidzimeviwo, bena wòanye wo tɔ tegbee.

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖe asi le vɔ, si wòɖo ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋuti la ŋu.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Esi Yosua se dukɔ la ƒe ɣli la, egblɔ na Mose bena: Aʋaɣli le ɖiɖim le asaɖa la me!

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena: Menye dziɖuɖuseye kple aʋasiɣli sem mele o, ke boŋ hadzidzi sem mele. Mose do dɔmedzoe ɖe dukɔ la ƒe nyivi subɔsubɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Esi wote tu asaɖa la, eye wòkpɔ nyivi la kple alesi wole ɣe ɖumee la, ɖɔme ve Mose, eye woxlã kpe, siwo le esi la, ɖe anyi, eye wogbã ɖe to la te.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Eye; wòxɔ nyivi, si wowɔ la, eye wofiãe. Kple dzo hetui memee, emegbe woɖee tsi me, eye wòna Israel-viwo noe.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ; na Aron bena: Nuka dukɔ sia wɔ wò, bena nèhe vɔ gã sia va wo dzi ale?

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Aron do ŋu bena: Nye aƒetɔ, megado dɔmedzoe o; wò ŋutɔ enye dukɔ sia bena, ame gbegblẽwo wonye.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nam bena: Wɔ mawu na mi, si azɔ mia ŋgɔ; elabena Mose, ŋutsu ma, si kplɔ m, tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, mienya nuka gɔ wɔe o.

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Megblɔ na wo bena: Amesi ke si sika le la, netsɔe vɛ nam. Tete wotsɔe vɛ nam, eye medee dzo me ko wòtrɔ zu nyivi.

english_verse: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.
translation_verse: Esi Mose kpɔ bena, dukɔ la wɔ yakanu, elabena Aron ye do lã wo, be woƒe futɔwo naɖu fewu le wo ŋu la,

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Mose tsi tre ɖe asaɖa la ƒe agbo nu gblɔ bena: Amesi ke le Yehowa dzi, neva gbɔnye afi! Tete Lewi-viwo katã ƒo ƒu va egbɔ.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ale Yehowa Israel ƒe Mawu la gblɔ esi: Ŋutsu sia ŋutsu nesa eƒe yi ɖe ali; mige ɖe asaɖa la me, tso afi yi afi, tso agbo nu yi agbo nu, eye amesiame nawu nɔviaŋutsu, xɔlɔ̃via kple eƒe ƒometɔwo.

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Eye Lewi-viwo wɔe ɖe Mose ƒe nya la nu, eye anɔ ŋutsu akpe etɔ ku le dukɔ la dome gbemagbe.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, Mose gblɔ na dukɔ la bena: Miewɔ nuvɔ̃ gã ŋutɔ, eyata malia to la ayi Yehowa gbɔ, ɖewo mate ŋu alé avu ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta mahĩ.

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gatrɔ yi Yehowa gbɔ, eye wògblɔ bena: Ao, taflatse, dukɔ sia wɔ nuvɔ̃ gã ŋutɔ, elabena wotsɔ sika wɔ mawui na wo ɖokui.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Meɖe kuku, tso woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke wo, ne menye nenem o la, ekema ɖeko natutu nye hã nye ŋkɔ ɖa le agbalẽ, si nèŋlɔ la me.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖo ŋu na Mose bena: Amesi wɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye la, eya ƒe ŋkɔ matutu ɖa le nye agbalẽ me.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Heyi ko, eye nakplɔ dukɔ la ayi teƒe, si megblɔ na wò la, eye nye dɔla adze ŋgɔwò. Gake ne nye toheɣi ɖo la, maxe woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋuti fe na wo.

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ho to na dukɔ la, elabena wona Aron wɔ nyivi na wo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Heyi, eye mia kple dukɔ, si nekplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, miadzo le afisia ayi anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo na Abraham, Isak kple Yakob gblɔ bena: woƒe dzidzimeviwo màtsɔe ana la dzi!

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: akplɔ mi ayi anyigba, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la dzi. Nyemanɔ mia dome ayi kpli mi o, elabena dukɔ kɔ lialiatɔwo mienye, ne nyemagatsrɔ̃ mi le mɔ dzi o.

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Dukɔ kɔ lialiatɔwo mienye, ne manɔ mia dome ayi kpli mi aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka pɛ hã la, matsrɔ̃ mi. Eyata miɖe miaƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo ɖi, eya ko hafi manya, nusi mawɔ na mi.

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Tete Israel-viwo ɖe woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo ɖi tso Xoreb-to la gbɔ.

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Eye Mose tsɔ agbadɔ la tu de asaɖa la godo le adzɔge, eye wòyɔe be Mawu ƒe agbadɔ. Amesiame, si di be, yeabia nu Yehowa la, doa go va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ, si le asaɖa godo la gbɔ.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Eye ne Mose yina ɖe agbadɔ la gbɔ la, dukɔ blibo la tsia tre, eye amesiame nɔa eƒe agbadɔ nu henɔa Mose yome kpɔm ɖa, vaseɖe esime woɖoa agbadɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒɔ nu kple Mose ŋku me kple ŋku me, abe alesi ame kple xɔlɔ̃a ƒoa nui ene; emegbe egatrɔna yia asaɖa la me. Ke eƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ Yosua. Nun vi, amesi nye eƒe subɔla la, medzona le agbadɔ la me o.

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ na Yehowa bena Kpɔ ɖa, woe gblɔ nam bena: kplɔ dukɔ sia, gake mena, menya, amesi nedo kpe ɖe ŋunye o, wò, ye egblɔ bena menya wò kple wò ŋkɔ, eye meve nuwò hafi.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Ne evɔ nunye vavã la, ekema na manya wo mɔwo, eye madze si wò be eve nunye. Kpɔ ɖa, amena siawo mewo dukɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena: Nye ŋutɔ manɔ, me akplɔ mi ayi afisi miagbɔ ɖe eme le la.

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Exɔ dzi nɛ bena: Ne wò ŋutɔ manɔ me o la, ekema megakplɔ mí tso afisia yii o.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Eye nuka gɔ woatsɔ adze sii bena, eve mia kple wo dukɔ la nu, ne meyi kpli mí, bena wòadze sii be, wòe tia mia kple wò dukɔ la le anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã dome oa?

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖo ŋu na Mose bena: Mawɔ nya, si negblɔ la hã dzi, elabena meve nuwò, eye menya wò kple wò ŋkɔ. Mose ɖi bena, yeakpɔ Yehowa te ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena Meɖe kuku, na makpɔ wo ŋutikɔkɔe la!

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Exɔ dzi bena: Mana nye atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo blibo la nato ŋkuwò me ayi, eye maɖe gbe ƒã Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ le, ŋgɔwò. Amesi nu medi be, mave la, eya nu mave, eye amesi ke meɖi be, makpɔ nublanui na la, eya makpɔ nublanui na.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Eye wògagblɔ bena: Mate ŋu akpɔ nye ŋku me o, elabena amea ɖeke makpɔm aganɔ agbe o.

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, teƒea ɖe le gbɔnye, va tsi tre ɖe agakpe la dzi.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: Ne nye ŋutikɔkɔe tso me yina la, ekema maɣla wò ɖe agakpe la to me, eye matsɔ nye asi abu dziwò, vaseɖe esime matso me ayi.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Ne meɖe nye asi le dziwò la, ekema akpɔ yonyeme da, gake nye ŋku me la, amea ɖeke makpɔe akpɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena: Kpɔ ɖa, mebia nu kpli wò le wò dukɔ blibo la ŋku me, eye mawɔ nukunu, siwo womewɔ le anyigba blibo la dzi kple dukɔwo katã dome kpɔ o la: eye dukɔ blibo, si dome nèle la, akpɔ Yehowa ƒe nukunuwo, elabena nusi mawɔ kpli wò la, adzi ŋɔ.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Dzra ɖo vaseɖe etsɔ, eye etsɔ ŋdi la nalia Sinai-to la, eye nanɔ dzɔyem le to la tame.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke malia to la kpli wò o, eye womakpɔ amea ɖeke le to blibo la dzi o; alẽwo kple nyiwo hã maɖu gbe le to sia gbɔ o.

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Eye Mose kpɔ kpe ete nyuie abe gbãtɔwo ene, eye wòfɔ ŋdi kanya helia Sinai-to la, abe alesi Yehowa de se ne ene, eye wotsɔ kpe eveawo ɖe asi. Yehowa vi to Mose ŋuti yi.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa va to eŋuti yi heɖe gbe ƒã bena: Yehowa, Yehowa, nublanuikpɔla kple amenuve Mawu, amesi gbɔa dzi blewu, eye eƒe amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ sɔ gbɔ,

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete Mese wɔ kaba tsyɔ mo anyi, eye wodo gbe ɖa

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, ne eve nunye la, ekema meɖe kuku be, Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ nanɔ mia dome ayi, elabena dukɔ kɔ lialiatɔ wònye, eyata tsɔ miaƒe vodadawo kple nuvɔ̃wo ke mi, eye naxa mí awɔ tɔwòe. Yehowa na se ewo Israel-dukɔ.

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutsuwo katã nava Aƒetɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ŋku me zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: Megade ta agu na mawu bubuwo o, elabena Yehowa enye ŋuʋãla, eƒe ŋkɔe nye Mawu ŋuʋãla.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si aʋu dɔnu na dada la, tanyee; lãwo ƒe ŋgɔgbevi, siwo nye atsu, eɖanye nyi alo alẽ o, tanyee.

english_verse: Your men will even marry their women and be influenced to worship their gods.
translation_verse: eye naɖe woƒe vinyɔnuwo na viwòŋutsuwo; eye ne woƒe vinyɔnuwo le woƒe mawunuwo wɔm la, ekema woana be, viwòŋutsuwo hã nasubɔ woƒe mawuwo.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: Megake mawu na ɖokuiwò o!

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Dzra se, siwo maɖe na wò egbe la ɖo. Kpɔ ɖa, manyã Amoritɔwo, Kanaanitɔwo, Xititɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Xiwitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo le ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nyuie, bena magabla nu kple anyigbadzitɔ, siwo gbɔ nava la o, be womaganɔ mia dome atrɔ zu mɔ na mi o.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ mímu woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, migbã woƒe legbawo, eye milã woƒe Aseratiwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Megabla nu kple anyigbadzitɔwo gbeɖegbeɖe o; elabena ne wole woƒe mawunuwo wɔm, eye wosa vo na woƒe mawuwo la, ekema woayɔ wò, be nava du woƒe vɔsanuawo,

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku abolo-maʋamaʋã-ŋkekenyuie la dzi. Ŋkeke adre sɔŋ naɖu abolo maʋamaʋã le nuŋeɣleti ƒe ŋkeke, si woɖo la dzi, abe alesi mede se na wò ene; elabena nuŋeɣleti la dzi nèʋu tso Egipte.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Ke natsɔ alẽ èɖuɖɔ tedzi ƒe ŋgɔgbevii, ne mèɖudɔe o la, naŋe kɔ nɛ. Ɖuɖɔ wò ŋgɔgbeviŋutsuwo katã ta. Womava ŋkunye me asi gbɔlo o.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ade nawɔ da, ke nadzudzɔ le ŋkeke adreagbe; eɖanye agbleŋlɔɣi alo nuŋeɣi o, dzudzɔ ɖokuiwò.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Ɖu kwasiɖawo ƒe ŋkekenyuie, si enye lu gbãtɔwo ŋeŋe ƒe ŋkekenyuie la; emegbe naɖu avaɖoɖoŋkekenyuie le ƒe la ƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Manyã dukɔwo le ŋgɔwò, eye makeke wò liƒowo ɖe nu; ke ne èyi Yehowa wò Mawu ƒe ŋku me zi etɔ le ƒe ɖeka me la, wò anyigba madzro amea ɖeke o.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: Megatsɔ nye vɔsalã ƒe ʋu sa vɔe le afisi amɔwɔ ʋaʋã le o, eye megagblẽ ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie ƒe vɔsalã ɖi ŋu nake ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: Wò agblemenu gbãfa, siwo nèƒã la, natso ava Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe me. Megaɖa gbɔ̃vi le dada ƒe notsi me o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Ŋlɔ nya siawo ɖi; elabena nya siawo dzi mebia nu kpli wò kpakple Israel-viwo ɖo.

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Esi Mose di tso Sinai-toa dzi la, kpe eveawo, siwo dzi sea le la, le esi. Esi Mose ɖi tso toa dzi la, menyae bena, esi wòƒo nu kple ye la, yeƒe mo de asi keklẽ me o.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Eye esi Aron kple Israel-viwo katã kpo bena, Mose ƒe mo le keklẽm la, wole vɔvɔ̃m na tete ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Tete Mese ya wo ɖa, eye Aron kple ameha la fe amegãwo katã gatrɔ va agbo, eye Mose ƒo nu kple wo.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Emegbe Israel-viwo katã te va, eye wòde se, siwo katã Yehowa gblɔ nɛ le Sinai-toa dzi la, na wo.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Esi Mose ƒo nu kpli wo vo la, etso nu tsyo ŋku me.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Eye ne Mose yi Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, be wòaƒo nu kplii la, eɖea nu la le ŋku me, vaseɖe esime wòdoa go; eye ne edo go la, egblɔa se, siwo wode nɛ la, na Israel-viwo.

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke ne Israel-viwo kpɔ Mose ƒe mo wòle keklẽm la, Mose gatsyɔa nu ŋku me, vaseɖe esime wòagayi nu ƒo ge kplii.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ade miawɔ dɔ, ke miaɖu ŋkeke adrelia kɔkɔe, dzudzɔgbee wònye na Yehowa, amesiame, si awɔ dɔ le edzi la, woawui.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Migado dzo ɖe miaƒe aƒea ɖeke me le dzudzɔgbe la dzi o. Nudzɔdzɔ faa hena agbadɔ la tutu.

english_verse: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu, siwo nya ɖetitetre, tsɔ asi tre aɖabe blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ɖeti dze kple ɖeti ɣi hetsɔ ve.

english_verse: onyx stones or other gems for the sacred vest and breastpiece.
translation_verse: soham-kpe kple kpe xɔasiwo, bena woatsɔ aɖo kɔmewu kple akɔtaɖonu la ŋu.

english_verse: And he has given them all kinds of artistic skills, including the ability to design and embroider with blue, purple, and red wool and to weave fine linen.
translation_verse: Etsɔ aɖaŋu de woƒe tame fũ, bena woate ŋu abu tame awɔ ɖɔ ƒomevi vovovowoe, woanya alesi woakpa aɖaŋunu vovovowoe, alesi woalɔ̃ aɖaŋuvɔe, eye woanya alesi woatso aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple ɖeti ɣi alɔ avɔ ƒomevi vovovowoe.

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:
translation_verse: Eye mia dometɔ, siwo ƒe tagbɔ aɖaŋu le la, nava awɔ nusiwo katã Yehowa ɖi la.

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons. Gifts for the Lord
translation_verse: atsyɔ̃ɖowuawo, bena woatsɔ asubɔ le kɔkɔeƒe, kple nunɔla Aron ƒe awu kɔkɔe susɔeawo kpakple viaŋutsuwo ƒe awuawo, bena woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔna Israel-viwo ƒe ha blibo la bena: Ale Yehowa de se gblɔ enye si:

english_verse: I will welcome an offering from anyone who wants to give something. You may bring gold, silver, or bronze;
translation_verse: Midzɔ nusiwo le mia si la na Yehowa Amesiame, si lɔ tso dzime faa la, nadza nu na Yehowa: sika, klosalo kple akɔbli;

english_verse: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dze, ɖeti ɣi kple gbɔ̃fuwo;

english_verse: tanned ram skin or fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: agbogbalẽ, si wode ama dzi, nyogbalẽ kple xé;

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;
translation_verse: aɖaka la kple eŋu kpoawo, nutsyɔnu la kple xɔmetsovɔ la;

english_verse: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: kplɔ̃ la kple eŋu kpoawo kpakple eŋu nuwo katã kple ŋkumeɖobolo la;

english_verse: the lamp with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: akaɖiti la, eŋu nuwo kple akaɖigbɛawo kpakple ami hena akaɖi la;

english_verse: the incense altar with its carrying poles and sweet-smelling incense; the ordination oil; the curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent;
translation_verse: dzudzɔdovɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu kpoawo, ami sisi la kple dzudzɔdotike ʋeʋẽe kpakple agbadɔnuvɔ;

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: numevɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu dzrala, si wotsɔ akɔbli wɔe, eŋu kpoawo kple eŋu nuwo katã, tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ;

english_verse: the curtains with the posts and stands that go around the courtyard and the curtain at the entrance;
translation_verse: kpɔ ŋuti vɔwo, kpɔtiawo kple woƒe afɔwo, kple agbonuvɔ,

english_verse: the pegs and ropes for the tent and the courtyard;
translation_verse: agbadɔ ŋu tsyotiwo kple kpɔ ŋu tsyotiwo kpakple woƒe atagbiawo;

english_verse: Moses finished speaking, and everyone left.
translation_verse: Emegbe Israel-viwo ƒe ha blibo la dzo le Mose gbɔ.

english_verse: Then those who wanted to bring gifts to the Lord, brought them to be used for the sacred tent, the worship services, and the priestly clothes.
translation_verse: Eye amesiame, si wòdzɔ dzi na, eye wòlɔ̃ kple dzi faa la, va dzɔ nu na Yehowa, bena woatsɔ awɔ Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple eŋu dowo katã kpakple awu kɔkɔeawoe.

english_verse: Men and women came willingly and gave all kinds of gold jewelry such as pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces.
translation_verse: Ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa, amesiame, si lɔ̃ tso dzime faa la, tsɔ alɔnugawo, togɛwo, asigɛwo, sikakɔdzonuwo kple sikatsyɔ̃nu vovovowo vɛ. Eye amesiame tsɔ sika wɔ adzɔgbeɖenui na Yehowa.

english_verse: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.
translation_verse: Amesiame tsɔ nusi le esi la ve; aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ, ɖeti ɣi, gbɔ̃fuwo, agbogbalẽ, si wode ama dzie kple nyogbalẽ.

english_verse: Anyone who had silver or bronze or acacia wood brought it as a gift to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si di be, yeana klosalo kple akɔbli la, dzɔ wo na Yehowa, eye amesiame, si si xé le la, tsɔe vɛ hena ɖɔ vovovoawo wɔwɔ.

english_verse: And the women who knew how to make cloth from goat hair were glad to do so.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu, siwo katã aɖaŋu le tagbɔ na la, tre gbɔ̃fuwo.

english_verse: The leaders brought different kinds of jewels to be sewn on the special clothes and the breastpiece for the high priest.
translation_verse: Amegãwo tsɔ soham-kpe kple kpe xɔasiwo vɛ, bena woatsɔ aɖo kɔmewu kple akɔtaɖonu la ŋu;

english_verse: Moses had told the people what the Lord wanted them to do, and many of them decided to bring their gifts. Bezalel and Oholiab (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye Israel-viwo, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa, amesiwo lɔ kple dzi faa la, tsɔ nunanawo vɛ na Yehowa, bena woatsɔ awɔ dɔ, si Yehowa de se na Mose, be wòawɔ la. Aɖanuwɔlawo yɔyɔ.

english_verse: Moses said to the people of Israel: The Lord has chosen Bezalel of the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Eye Mese gblɔ na Israel-viwo bena: Mikpɔ ɖa. Yehowa tia Bezaleel, Uri viŋutsu, si enye Xur ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi tso Yuda-to la me,

english_verse: The Lord is urging him and Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to teach others.
translation_verse: Eye wòde nunya tame na eya kpakple Oholiab, Axisamak ƒe viŋutsu tso Dan-to la me, bena woate ŋu afia nu.

english_verse: and he gave them the gifts that the people of Israel had donated for building the place of worship. In fact, so much was being given each morning,
translation_verse: Eye wòxɔ nudzɔdzɔ, siwo katã Israel-viwo na, bena woatsɔ awɔ kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu dɔwoe la, le Mose si. Ke woganɔa nunanawo tsɔm vɛ nɛ le wo ɖokui si ŋdi sia ŋdi.

english_verse: and said, “Moses, there is already more than we need for what the Lord has assigned us to do.”
translation_verse: eye wogblɔna Mose bena: Dukɔ la na nu geɖe wu alesi ɖɔ, si Yehowa gblɔ be, woawɔ la, bia.

english_verse: But there was already more than enough to do what needed to be done. The Curtains and Coverings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Elabena nuawo sɔ gbɔ na dɔ blibo la wɔwɔ: wode gbɔ dzi gɔ̃ hã. Agbadɔ la ƒe kɔkɔeƒe tutu.

english_verse: and they were sewn together to make two curtains with five panels each.
translation_verse: Ekpe kuntru atɔ̃ ɖe wo nɔewo nu, eye wògakpe kuntru atɔ̃ hã ɖe wo nɔewo nu.

english_verse: These eleven sections were joined to make two panels, one with five and the other with six sections.
translation_verse: Ekpe kuntru atɔ̃ vovo, eye wokpe kuntru ade hã vovo.

english_verse: Fifty loops were put along one of the wider sides of each panel,
translation_verse: Eye wòtɔ ka kpukpui blaatɔ̃ ɖe kuntru kpekpea ƒe to ɖeka, eye wogatɔ ka kpukpui blaatɔ̃ ɖe kuntru kpekpe evelia ƒe to ɖeka.

english_verse: and the two panels were fastened at the loops with
translation_verse: Etsɔ akɔbli tu ganuvi blaatɔ̃ hetsɔ kpe agbadɔkuntruawo wozu ɖeka.

english_verse: Two other coverings were made—one with fine leather and the other with ram skins dyed red. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ewɔ agbogbalẽ, si woɖe ama dzi la hã hegba edzi, emegbe wòtsɔ nyogbalẽ gba edzi.

english_verse: Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.
translation_verse: Wo katã le ʋuƒo enyi, siwo gɔme klosalofɔ wuiade le, afɔ eveve le ʋuƒo ɖeka gɔme.

english_verse: Six frames were used for the back wall along the west side
translation_verse: Eye wodze ʋuƒo ade hena nɔƒe la ƒe akpa, si le ɣetoɖoƒe gome.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. These corner frames were joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Eye wo gɔme kple wo tame kpe ɖe ʋuƒoawo ŋu, bena asigɛ ɖeka nanɔ wo ŋu. Alea wòwɔ wo ame eve la ɖe dzogoe eveawo dzi.

english_verse: Five crossbars were made for each of the wooden frames, with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ gameti dometɔ wòto ʋuƒoawo titina, tso go ɖeka me vaseɖe go keme me.

english_verse: The frames and crossbars were covered with gold, and gold rings were attached to the frames to run the crossbars through. The Inside Curtain for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Eta sika ɖe ʋuƒoawo ŋu, eye wotsɔ sika lu wo ŋu sigɛ, siwo me woaƒo gametiawo ɖo; eye wòta sika ɖe gametiawo ŋu.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Eye wòna avɔlɔ̃lawo tsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzẽtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple ɖeti ɣi dada lɔ avɔ, bena woatsɔ atu agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: They made the inside curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Ena aɖaŋuvɔlɔ̃lawo tsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple ɖeti ɣi dada lɔ xɔmetsovɔ la, eye wowɔ Kerubiwo ɖe eme.

english_verse: They also made four acacia wood posts and covered them with gold. Then gold rings were fastened to the posts, which were set on silver stands.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ xé kpa sɔti ene ɖe eŋu, eye wòfa sika ɖe wo ŋu: wo ŋu gatagbadzɛawo nye sika, eye wòkɔ klosalofɔ ene ɖe wo gɔme.
