english_verse: They made five posts, covered them completely with gold, and set each of them on a gold-covered bronze stand. Finally, they attached hooks for the curtain.
translation_verse: Ewɔ sɔti atɔ̃ kple wo ŋu gatagbadzɛawo ɖe eŋu, eye wòfa sika ɖe wo tame kple woƒe heletiwo ŋu, eye wòtsɔ akɔbli wɔ afɔ atɔ̃ ɖe wo gɔme.

english_verse: He covered it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the top.
translation_verse: Eta sika nyuitɔ ɖe eme kple ekɔgo, eye wotsɔ sika do atsiã ɖe eŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Eye wòkɔ sikasigɛ ene hena eƒe dzogoe eneawo; asigɛ eve le axa ɖeka, eye asigɛ eve hã le axa evelia.

english_verse: Then he made two poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold,
translation_verse: Emegbe wotso xé kpa kpowo, eye wòfa sika ɖe wo, ŋu,

english_verse: The entire lid of the chest, which was made of pure gold, was the place of mercy.
translation_verse: Eyome wotsɔ sika nyuitɔ, wɔ nutsyɔnu la, eɖiɖi abɔklugui eve kple afã, eye wokeke abɔklugui ɖeka kple afã.

english_verse: On each of the two ends of the chest he made a winged creature of hammered gold. They faced each other, and their wings covered the place of mercy. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Kerubiawo klẽ aʋala ɖo ta dzi, eye woƒe aʋalawo bi ɖe nutsyɔnu la dzi; wodze ŋgɔ wo nɔewo, eye wode mo to ɖe nutsyɔnu la dzi.

english_verse: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Eɖo to ne kpe ɖo, si kɔ asi ɖeka, eye wotsɔ sika do atsiã ɖe to la ŋu kpe ɖo.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Eye wotso sika kɔ asigɛ ene, eye wòklẽ asigɛawo ɖe eƒe afa eneawo ƒe axa eneawo dzi.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table were placed through these rings
translation_verse: Asigɛawo te ɖe to la ŋu, bena woaƒo kpo ɖe wo me akɔ kplɔ̃ lae.

english_verse: and were made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsɔ xe kpa kpoawo, eye wòfa sika ɖe wo ŋu, bena woatsɔ wo akɔ kplɔ̃ lae.

english_verse: Everything that was to be set on the table was made of pure gold—the bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings. The Lampstand (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye wotsa sika nyuitɔ wɔ nusiwo kpe ɖe kplɔ̃ la ŋu, siwo nye: agbawo, nutɔgbawo, trewo kple goewo, siwo woatso aƒo nunovɔsa ɖi.

english_verse: Bezalel made a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered gold,
translation_verse: Eyome wòtso sika nyuitɔ wo akaɖiti la; etu akaɖiti la, eƒe afa kple ati la, eye wòwɔ kɔwo, seƒoƒowo kple wo tamekukuwo ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: and four on the stem.
translation_verse: Seƒoƒo ene kple wo tamekukuwo le atia ŋutɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: There was also a blossom where each pair of branches came out from the stem.
translation_verse: Alɔ ade le ati la ŋu, eye ka ɖeka le alɔ eveve ƒe kpeƒe.

english_verse: The lamp and its equipment, including the tongs and trays, were made of about
translation_verse: Sika nyuitɔ talento ɖeka wòtsɔ wɔe kple eŋu nuwo katã.

english_verse: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Efa sika nyuitɔ ɖe eŋu, etame kple ekɔgo godoo va kpe kpakple eƒe dzowo ŋu, eye wotsɔ sika do atsiã ɖe eŋu ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides he attached two gold rings through which he put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ sikasigɛ eve ɖe eƒe atsiãdodo la te, le eƒe axa eveawo ƒe dzogoe eveawo dzi, bena woaƒo kpo ɖe wo me akɔe.

english_verse: These poles were also made of acacia wood and covered with gold. The Oil for Dedication and the Incense (Exodus
translation_verse: Etsɔ xé kpa kpoawo, eye wòfa sika ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Bezalel mixed the sacred oil for dedication and the pure spices for the sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Eyome wòwɔ ami sisi kɔkɔe la, eye wòtsɔ atike ʋeʋẽewo wɔ dzudzɔdonu, si me dza; ewɔe, abe alesi ami ʋeʋẽe wɔlawo wɔne ene.

english_verse: Bezalel made a large bowl and a stand out of bronze from the mirrors of the women who helped at the entrance to the sacred tent. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Etsɔ akɔbli wɔ tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ; nyɔnu, siwo subɔna le Mawu ƒe agbadɔa nu la, ƒe ahuhɔ̃ewo wòtsɔ wɔe.

english_verse: and the silver that was collected when the people were counted came to
translation_verse: Eye klosalo, siwo ame xexlẽawo na la, le talento alafa ɖeka kple sekel kɔkɔe akpe ɖeka alafa adre blaadre vɔ atɔ̃.

english_verse: Then he attached a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners to put the poles through.
translation_verse: Eye wòkɔ asigɛ ene ɖe akɔblidzrala la ƒe dzogoe eneawo dzi, bena woate ŋu aƒo kpo ɖe wo me.

english_verse: put them through the rings for carrying the altar, which was shaped like an open box. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye wòtsɔ kpoawo ƒo ɖe asigɛawo me le vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axawo dzi, bena woate ŋu atsɔ wo akɔe. Ʋuƒo wotsɔ wɔe, eye to le eme.

english_verse: And it was used to make the stands for the entrance to the tent, the altar and its grating, the equipment for the altar,
translation_verse: Woawo wotsɔ wɔ Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu ʋɔtrutiwo ƒe afɔwo kple akɔblivɔsamlekpui la, eŋu dzralawo kpakple vɔsamlekpui la ŋu nuwo katã;

english_verse: For the entrance to the courtyard, Bezalel made a curtain nine meters long, which he hung on four bronze posts that were set on bronze stands. This curtain was
translation_verse: Ekpa kpɔti ene, siwo gɔme akɔblifɔ ene le la, ɖe eŋu; wo ŋu gatagbadzɛawo nye klosalo, efa klosalo ɖe wo tame, eye wo ŋu heletiawo nye klosalo.

english_verse: Bezalel had worked closely with Oholiab, who was an expert at designing and engraving, and at embroidering blue, purple, and red wool. The two of them completed the work that the Lord had commanded to be done. Moses put Aaron's son Ithamar in charge of the Levites who kept record of the metals used for the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Eye Oholiab, Axisamak viŋutsu tso Dan-to la me kpe ɖe eŋu, amesi nye aɖaŋunuwo kpala, eye wotsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple ɖeti ɣi lɔ aɖaŋuvɔ ƒomevi vovovowo.

english_verse: Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given.
translation_verse: Akɔbli, siwo wodzɔ la, le talento blaadre kple sekel akpe eve alafa ene

english_verse: the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.
translation_verse: kpɔ la ƒe afɔwo godoo va kpe kple agbo la ƒe afɔwo, nɔƒe la ƒe tsyotiwo katã kple kpɔ la ƒe tsyotiwo katã godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka kple ka dzẽ lɔ atsyɔ̃ɖowuawo, bena woatsɔ awɔ subɔsubɔdɔe le kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wolã awu kɔkɔewo na Aron, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene.

english_verse: and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Kpeawo le wuieve ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ŋkɔwo nu, eye ŋkɔɖelawo ta to wuieveawo ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest.
translation_verse: Woƒo sika la gbabɛ, eye wodzee lelele, bena aɖaŋuvɔlɔ̃lawo nate ŋu atsɔe atɔtɔ kple aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple ɖeti ɣi dada alɔ.

english_verse: Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ sika ƒo fefeka ɖe soham-kpe eve ŋu, eye ŋkɔɖelawo ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ wo ɖo kɔmewu la ƒe abɔtawo hena ŋkuɖoɖo Israel-viwo dzi, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The words “Dedicated to the Lord” were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold,
translation_verse: Emegbe wotsɔ sika nyuitɔ wɔ ŋgoblanu kɔkɔe la, eye ŋkɔɖelawo ta nu ɖe dzi bena: „Yehowa ƒe kɔkɔetɔ!“

english_verse: The breastpiece was made with the same materials and designs as the priestly vest.
translation_verse: Eyome wòna aɖaŋuvɔlɔ̃lawo tsɔ sika, aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple ɖeti ɣi dada lɔ kɔmewu ƒe avɔ tɔgbe hena akɔtaɖonu la.

english_verse: a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row;
translation_verse: agbaka evelia nye rubin, safir kple omks;

english_verse: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;
translation_verse: agbaka etɔ̃lia nye, ligurio, axat kple ametist;

english_verse: and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting,
translation_verse: agbaka enelia nye: krisolit, soham kple yaspis: eye wotsɔ sika ƒo fefeka ɖe wo ŋu ƒo xlã wo.

english_verse: Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Eyome wode kɔsɔkɔsɔ eveawo ƒe nu eveawo gbo eveawo ŋu, eye wòtɔ gboawo ɖe kɔmewu la ƒe abɔtawo le ŋgɔ.

english_verse: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.
translation_verse: Emegbe wogawɔ sikasigɛ eve, eye wòtɔ wo ɖe kɔmewu la ƒe abɔtawo kple eve to le ŋgɔ, afisi woɖe kɔme nɛ ɖo, le akɔblanu la ƒe dziƒo gome.

english_verse: To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Clothes for the Priests (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye wogbe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka sa ɖe asigɛ, siwo le akɔtaɖonua ŋu la ŋuti hetsi ɖe asigɛ, siwo le kɔmewua ŋu la ŋuti, ale be akɔtaɖonu la li ɖe akɔblanu la dzi, eye mele ʋaʋãm o, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Work Is Completed (Exodus
translation_verse: Eye wotsi aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka ɖe eŋu, bena woate ŋu asae ɖe tablanu la ŋu, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene. Mose yra dɔ, si nu wowu la.

english_verse: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_verse: Eye Mose kpɔ dɔ blibo la; kpɔ ɖa, wowɔe, abe alesi Yehowa de se be, woawɔe la ene. Eye Mose yra wo.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Woɖe kɔme nɛ ɖe titina, eye woƒo kɔme la to va kpe, bena magadze o.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
translation_verse: nyawowoe ɖeka yevuboɖa ɖeka, nyawowoe ɖeka yevuboɖa ɖeka; alea wole dziwui la to godoo va kpe, hena subɔsubɔ ƒe dzesi, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
translation_verse: Eye avɔlɔ̃lawo tsɔ ɖeti ɣi dada, aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka kpakple ka dze lɔ alidziblanu la ŋɔŋɔe, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: nubablaɖaka la, eŋu kpoawo kple nutsyɔnu la,

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Ble wowu nɔƒe, si enye Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la, ŋu dɔwo katã nu, eye Israel-viwo wɔe pɛpɛpɛ, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose be, woawɔe ene.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Eye wofɔ nɔƒe la va Mose gbɔ; agbadɔ la kple eŋu nuwo katã; ganuviawo, ʋuƒoawo, gametiawo, sɔtiawo, afɔawo,

english_verse: the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain;
translation_verse: agbogbalẽ, si wode ama dzi kple nyogbalẽawo kpakple xɔmetsovɔ la,

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: kplɔ̃ la kple eŋu nuwo katã kple ŋkumeɖobolo la,

english_verse: the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: sikakaɖiti la kple eŋu kaɖigbɛawo, siwo wodo ɖe agbaka nu, eŋu nuwo katã kple akaɖimemi,

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: sikavɔsamlekpui la, ami sisi la kple dzudzɔdonu, si wotsɔ atike ʋeʋẽewo wɔe kpakple agbadɔnuvɔ la,

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: akɔblivɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu kɔblidzrala la, eŋu kpoawo kple eŋu nuwo katã, tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ,

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: kpɔ la ŋu vɔwo, kpɔtiawo, afɔawo kple agbonuvɔ la, agbadɔ ŋu kawo kple tsyotiawo kpakple nusiwo katã ŋu dɔ woawɔ le nɔƒe, si enye Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me;

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons.
translation_verse: atsyɔ̃ɖowu, siwo woaɖo awɔ subɔsubɔdɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la, nunɔla Aron ƒe awu kɔkɔe mamleawo kple viaŋutsuwo ƒe awuawo, bena woanye nunɔlawo asubɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena:

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: Le ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi natu nɔƒe, si enye Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Tsɔ nubablaɖaka la da ɖe eme, eye natsɔ xɔmetsovɔ la axe aɖaka la ŋku me.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Tsɔ kplɔ la da ɖe eme, eye natsɔ ŋkumeɖobolo la ada ɖe edzi; emegbe nakɔ akaɖiti la ava eme, eye natɔ akaɖigbɛawo aɖo edzi.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ sikavɔsamlekpui, si dzi woado dzudzɔ ɖo, ada ɖe nubablaɖaka la ƒe ŋgɔdze, eye natsɔ avɔ atu agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ numevɔsamlekpui la ada ɖe nɔƒe la, si enye Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la, ŋu ʋɔtrua ƒe ŋgɔdze.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Tsɔ tsileze la da ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpui la dome, eye naku tsi de eme.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Eye natɔ kpɔ ɖe eŋu godoo ava kpe, eye natsɔ avɔ atu agbo la nu.

english_verse: Use the sacred olive oil to dedicate to me the tent and everything in it.
translation_verse: Tsɔ ami sisi la si na nɔƒe la kple nusiwo katã le eme, eye nakɔ eya ŋutɔ kple eŋu nuwo katã ŋu, bena woazu kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Si ami na numevɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu nuwo katã, eye nakɔ vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, bena vɔsamlekpui la nazu nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe.

english_verse: and with the bowl and its stand.
translation_verse: Eye nasi ami na tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ, eye nakɔ eŋu.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Emegbe nana Aron kple viaŋutsuwo nate va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye nale tsi na wo.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Eye na Aron nado awu kɔkɔeawo, eye nasi ami nɛ àwɔe kɔkɔe, bena wòazu nunɔla asubɔm.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Eyome nana viaŋutsuwo nate va, eye woado awutewui ʋlayawo,

english_verse: and ordain them in the same way, so they and their descendants will always be my priests.
translation_verse: eye nasi ami na wo, abe alesi nèsii na wo fofo ene, bena woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm. Ami sisi sia nanye dzesi na wo kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo bena, nunɔladɔ la zu wo tɔ tegbee.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Le ƒe evelia ƒe ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi wotu nɔƒe la.

english_verse: then the two layers of coverings were hung over them.
translation_verse: Eye wòkeke kuntruawo ɖe nɔƒe la dzi, emegbe wògbã wo dzi, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Etsɔ se la de aɖaka la me, eye wòde kpoawo aɖaka la ŋu; eyome wòkɔ nutsyɔnu la da de aɖaka la tame.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Eye wokɔ aɖa ka la da ɖe nɔƒe la, eye wotsɔ xɔmetsovɔ la xe nubablaɖaka la ŋku me, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ kplɔ la da ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, le nɔƒe la ƒe anyiehekpa dzi, le xɔmetsovɔ la ŋgɔ,

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: eye wòfɔ akaɖigbɛawo do edzi le Yehowa ŋku me, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: Eye wòtsɔ sikavɔsamlekpui la da de Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, le xɔmetsovɔ la ŋgɔ,

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: eye wotsɔ atike ʋeʋẽewo do dzudzɔ de edzi, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Emegbe wòtsɔ avɔ tu agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsɔ numevɔsamlekpui la da ɖe nɔƒe, si enye Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋgɔ, eye wome numevɔsa kple nuɖuvɔsa le edzi, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ tsileze la da de Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpui la dome, eye wòku tsi, si woale la, de eme.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Eya me Mose kple Aron kple viaŋutsuwo klɔa woƒe asiwo kple afɔwo ɖo.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ne wole Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me yi ge, alo wole tete ge ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu la, woléa tsi, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Eye wòtɔ kpɔ ƒo xlã nɔƒe la kple vɔsamlekpui la godoo va kpe, eye wòtsɔ avɔ la tu agbo la nu. Ale Mose wu dɔ blibo la nu. Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ agbadɔ la taŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete alilikpo tsyɔ Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la dzi, eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ nɔƒe la taŋ.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Eye ne alilikpo la ho tso nɔƒe la dzi la, Israel-viwo hã hona, alea wowɔ le woƒe mɔzɔzɔ la katã me.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Ne alilikpo la meho o la, womehona o, vaseɖe gbesigbe woaho hafi.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Le woƒe mɔzɔzɔwo katã me la Mawu ƒe alilikpo la nɔ nɔƒe la dzi le ŋkeke me, ke edzena na Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la le zã me abe dzo ene.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Eye woatso eƒe asi aɖo numevɔsalã la ƒe tame, ekema ana wòadze eŋu, eye wòalé avui.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eye wòawu nyivi la le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, eye Aron viŋutsu, siwo nye nunɔlawo la, natsɔ ʋu la ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui, si le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ nu la ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Ekema wòako numevɔsalã la, eye wòaflii ɖe eƒe ƒunuɖeƒeewo.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Emegbe Aron viŋutsu, siwo nye nunɔlawo, nado dzo ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye woafɔ nake ado dzo la dzi.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ke woatso tsi akpala eƒe domenuwo kple eƒe afɔwo, eye nunɔla Aron nata dzo wo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, elabena numevɔsae dzovɔsa, si ʋẽna lilili ɖe Yehowa wònye.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Nenye alẽ alo gbɔ̃ wòbe, yeatsɔ amè numevɔsae la, ekema woatso atsu, si so blibo, asa vɔ lae.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eye woawui ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe anyiehekpa dzi le Yehowa ŋku me. Eye Aron viŋutsu, siwo nye nunɔlawo, natsɔ eƒe ʋu ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Eye woatso tsi akpala eƒe dɔmenuwo kple eƒe afɔwo, eye nunɔla natsɔ wo katã asa vɔe, eye woata dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi; elabena numevɔsae, dzovɔsa si nena lilili de Yehowa wònye.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Ke nenye xewo wòbe, yeatsɔ asa vɔ na Yehowa la, ekema wòatsɔ akpakpa alo ahɔnevi asa vɔ lae.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla natsɔe ava vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ, eye wòatro kɔ le enu; eyome woatɔ dzo ta la le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye wòadudu eƒe ʋu de vɔsamlekpui la ŋu.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Emegbe woade eƒe avɔ eye wòanya fu le eŋu, atsɔ wo aƒu gbeɖe dzowɔteƒe le vɔsamlekpui la ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Eyome wòafe eƒe aʋalawo, gake womaɖe le enu o, eye nunɔla nata dzoe le nake, siwo te wodo dzo ɖo le vɔsamlekpuia dzi la dzi, elabena numevɔsae, dzovɔsa, si ʋẽna lilili ɖe Yehowa wònye.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: Ne amea de be, yeasa nuɖuvɔ na Yehowa la, ekema wòatsɔ wɔ memee asa vɔ lae, eye wòakɔ ami de dzi, atsɔ dzudzɔdonu akpe de eŋu.

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Eye woatsɔe ava Aron viŋutsu, siwo nye nunɔlawo la gbɔ, eye nunɔla naku eƒe wɔ memee, si dzi ami le la, asiƒlo ɖeka, eye woatɔ dzoe kpakple dzudzɔdonu la katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, hena ŋkuɖoɖo dzi; dzovɔsa, si ʋẽna lilili de Yehowa wònye.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ke nuɖuvɔsa mamlea nye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo tɔ, nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye tso Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsa la me.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Ne èbe, yeatsɔ nusi woƒona de kpo me asa nuɖuvɔe la, ekema natsɔ wɔ memee aƒo aboŋgo maʋamaʋã kple akaklã, si dzi nakɔ ami ɖo.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Ne èbe, yeatsɔ nusi wotɔna le agba me asa nuɖuvɔe la, ekema wòanye wɔ memee, si wode amũ; nu maʋamaʋã wòanye.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Flii kakɛkakɛ, eye nakɔ ami ɖe edzi, elabena nuɖuvɔsae.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Ne èbe, yeatsɔ nusi woɖana le ze me asa nuɖuvɔe la, ekema natsɔ wɔ memee, si wode amii, aɖae.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ nuɖuvɔsa, si woɖa alea la, avae na Yehowa. Tsɔe yi na nunɔla, eye eya natsɔe ava vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla naɖe ɖe le nuɖuvɔsa la ŋu hena ŋkuɖoɖo dzi, eye woatɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi; dzovɔsa, si ʋẽna lilili ɖe Yehowa wònye.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ke nuɖuvɔsa mamlea nye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo tɔ, nu kɔkɔewo fe nu kɔkɔe wònye tso Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsa la me.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Migatsɔ amɔwɔ ʋaʋã wɔ nuɖuvɔ, si miasa na Yehowa la, dometɔa ɖeke o, elabena womatɔ dzo amɔwɔ ʋaʋã alo anyitsinua ɖeke na Yehowa o.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Woate ŋu anɔ miaƒe nu gbãtɔwo me, miatsɔ ava na Yehowa; ke womate dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe ʋeʋẽ lilili ene o.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: De dze wò nuɖuvɔsawo katã me, eye wò Mawu ƒe nu, si wòbia kpli wò la, ƒe dze mato le wò nuɖuvɔsawo me o; dze nakpe ɖe wò vɔsawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Ne èbe, yeatsɔ wò agblemenu gbãtɔwo asa nuɖuvɔe na Yehowa la, ekema namè blitimuawo, eye nagbã wo hafi atsɔ asa wò nuɖuvɔ lae.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Kɔ ami ɖe edzi, eye natsɔ dzudzɔdonu akpe ɖe eŋu, elabena nuɖuvɔsae.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla nato dzo bli gbagbã, si dzi ami le la, ƒe ɖe kple dzudzɔdonu la katã hena ŋkuɖoɖo dzi, elabena dzovɔsae wònye na Yehowa.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Ne ebe, yeatsɔ nyi asa akpedavɔe la, ekema wòatsɔ esi sɔ blibo, eɖanye atsu alo nɔ o, asa vɔ lae na Yehowa.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔ eƒe asi aɖo eƒe vɔsalã la ƒe tame, eye woawui le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu; emegbe Aron viŋutsu, siwo nye nunɔlawo, natsɔ ʋu la ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu mi, siwo ku ɖe ali la ŋu kpakple aklã ŋu miawo; ayikuawo ŋu wòaɖe wo le.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Eye Aron viŋutsuwo nato dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi kpakple numevɔsa, si le nake, siwo te wodo dzo ɖo la dzi, dzovɔsa, si ʋẽna lilili ɖe Yehowa wònye.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Nenye alẽ wòbe, yeatsɔ asa akpedavɔ na Yehowa la, ekema wòatsɔ esi sɔ blibo, eɖanye atsu alo nɔ o, asa vɔ lae.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Nenye alẽvi wotsɔ be, yeasa vɔ lae la, ekema wòakplɔe ava Yehowa ŋku me,

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ eƒe asi aɖo eƒe vɔsalã la ƒe tame, eye wòawui le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu; emegbe Aron viŋutsuwo natsɔ ʋu la ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu mi, siwo ku ɖe ali la ŋu kpakple aklã ŋu miawo; ayikuawo ŋu wòaɖe wo le.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla natɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, dzovɔsanuɖuɖu wònye na Yehowa.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: Nenye gbɔ wòbe, yeatsɔ asa vɔ lae la, ekema wòakplɔe ava Yehowa ŋku me,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ eƒe asi aɖo eƒe tame, eye woawui le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋgɔ; emegbe Aron viŋutsuwo natsɔ eƒe ʋu ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu mi, siwo ku ɖe ali la nu kpakple aklã ŋu miawo; ayikuawo ŋu wòaɖe wo le.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla natɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, dzovɔsanuɖuɖu, si ʋẽna lilili wònye. Amiawo katã Yehowa tɔe.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na miaƒe dzidzimeviwo le mia nɔƒewo katã. Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu lã ƒe ami alo ʋua ɖeke o.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la nade eƒe asi ʋu la me ahlẽ zi adre ɖe avɔ, si tso kɔkɔeƒea me la gbã le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔ eƒe asi aɖo gbɔ̃tsu la ƒe tame, eye woawui ɖe afisi wowua numevɔsalã le le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, elabena nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsae.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Emegbe nunɔla la natsɔ eƒe asi asisi eƒe nu la ƒe ɖe ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, ke wòatsɔ ʋu mamlea katã akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo be: Ne amea ɖe ɖe ŋu ɖi ɖa Yehowa ƒe seawo dometɔ ɖeka dzi, eye wòwɔ nusi ŋu se le na wo la.

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla, si wòsi ami na, da vo hehe vɔ̃ va dukɔ la dzi la, ekema woatsɔ nyitsu ɖagbea ɖe, si so blibo asa nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔ na Yehowa ɖe nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la ta.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Eye wòakplɔ nyitsu la ava Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu le Yehowa ŋku me, atsɔ eƒe asi aɖo nyitsu la ƒe tame, eye woawu nyitsu la le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Eyome nunɔla si wòsi ami na la, naku nyitsu la ƒe nu ƒe ɖe ayi Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Emegbe nunɔla la natsɔ ʋu la asisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui, si le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, si dzi wotsɔa atike ʋeʋẽewo doa dzudzɔe ɖo la, fe dzowo ŋuti le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me ke wòatsɔ nyitsu la ƒe ʋu mamlea akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui, si le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ nu la te.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: gɔ̃ nyitsu blibo la ayi teƒe kɔkɔe, afisi woƒua afi gbe ɖo, le asaɖa la godo, eye woatɔ dzoe le nake dzi; afisi woƒua afi gbe ɖoe, wòatɔ dzoe ale.

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: Ne Israel-ha blibo la da ƒu, eye dukɔ la ƒe ŋku dzo le Yehowa ƒe seawo dometɔ ɖeka dzi, eye wowɔ nusi ŋu se le na wo,

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: emegbe wodze si nuvɔ̃, si wowɔ la, ekema ha la natsɔ nyitsu ɖagbea ɖe asa nuvɔ̃vɔe, eye woakplɔe ava Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Ha la me ame tsitsiwo natsɔ woƒe asiwò aɖo nyitsu la ƒe tame le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, eye woawu nyitsu la le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Eyome nunɔla, si wòsi ami na la, naku nyitsu la ƒe nu ƒe ɖe ayi Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la nade eƒe asi ʋu la me, ahlẽ zi adre ɖe xɔmetsovɔ la gbɔ le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Emegbe woatsɔ ʋu la asisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui, si le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me la, ƒe dzowo ŋu; ke wòatsɔ ʋu mamlea katã akɔ ɖe numevɔsamlekpui, si le Mawu ƒe agbadɔa nu la te.

english_verse: Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty.
translation_verse: Ne amegãa ɖe ɖe ŋu ɖi da Yehowa, eƒe Mawu, ƒe seawo dometɔ ɖeka dzi, eye wòdi fɔ,

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: emegbe wòdze si nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la, ekema wòatsɔ gbɔ̃tsu, si sɔ blibo, asa vɔe.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Emegbe nunɔla natsɔ eƒe asi asisi nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã ƒe ʋu la ƒe ɖe ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, ke woatsɔ ʋu mamlea akɔ ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye woatɔ dzo lã la ƒe amiawo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe akpedavɔsalã ƒe ami ene. Ale nunɔla la alé avu nɛ le eƒe nuvɔ̃ la ta, eye woatsɔe akee.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: Ne dukɔ la dometɔa ɖe ɖe ŋu ɖi da Yehowa ƒe seawo dometɔ ɖeka dzi, eye woɖi fɔ,

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: emegbe wòdze si nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la, ekema wòatsɔ gbɔ, si sɔ blibo, asa vɔe ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la ta.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔ eƒe asi aɖo nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã la ƒe tame, eye wòawu nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã la ɖe afisi wowua numevɔsa ɖo.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Eye wòaɖe eƒe amiwo katã, abe alesi wòɖe akpedavɔsalã ƒe amiwo ene, eye nunɔla natɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, bena wòaʋẽ lilili ɖe Yehowa. Ale nunɔla alé avu nɛ, eye woatsɔe akee.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Nenye alẽvi wòbe, yeatsɔ asa nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔe la, ekema wòanye nɔe, si sɔ blibo,

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ eƒe asi aɖo nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã la ƒe tame, eye woawui wòanye nuvɔ̃vɔsa, ɖe afisi wowua numevɔsalã le.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Emegbe nunɔla la natsɔ eƒe asi asisi nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã ƒe ʋu la ƒe ɖe ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋuti, ke wòatsɔ ʋu mamlea katã akɔ ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Eye wòaɖe eƒe amiwo katã le eŋu, abe alesi wòɖea ami le akpedavɔsalã ŋu ene, eye nunɔla natsɔ wo aɖa ɖe Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsalã la dzi ato dzo wo. Ale nunɔla alé avu nɛ le eƒe nuvɔ̃, si wowɔ la ta, eye woatsɔe akee.

english_verse: You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
translation_verse: Alo ne amea ɖe de asi nu makɔmakɔa ɖe ŋu, eɖanye gbemelã, aƒemelã alo nutata makɔmakɔa ɖe ƒe kuku ŋu o, eye menyae o la, ekema egblẽ ko ɖo, eye wòɖi fɔ.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Ne ede asi amea ɖe ƒe nu makɔmakɔa; ɖe, si na be, ame la gblẽ kɔ ɖo ŋu, eye menyae o, emegbe wòdzesii la, ekema eɖi fɔ.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Alo ne atam ge le amea ɖe nu, eɖanye vɔ̃ alo nyui dzi wòka atam la ɖo be, yeawɔ o, eye menyae o, emegbe wòdze sii la, ekema eɖi nu siawo dometɔ ɖeka ƒe fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Eya dzɔ, ne amea ɖe ɖi fɔ le nusiawo dometɔ ɖeka me la, ekema wòaʋu vo, si wòda la me,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ alẽnɔ alo gbɔ̃nɔ asa nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔe na Yehowa ɖe eƒe vo, si wòda heɖi fa la ta, eye nunɔla nale avu ne le eƒe nuvɔ̃ la ta.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔ wo ava nunɔla gbɔ, eye eya natsɔ esi wole nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔ sa gee la gbã atro ko le enu ɖe kɔʋume, ke ta la maɖe le enu o.

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Emegbe wòahlẽ nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã la ƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, ke wòaɖuɖu ʋu mamlea ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te, elabena nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsae.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Ne mate ŋu ana akpakpa eve alo ahɔnevi eve hã o la, ekema wòatsɔ wo memee eta ɖeka ƒe ewoliawo ɖeka asa vɔe ɖe eƒe vo, si wòda la ta; makɔ ami ɖe edzi o, eye makpe dzudzɔdonu hã ɖe eŋu o, elabena nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsae.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔe ava nunɔla la gbɔe, eye nunɔla la naku eƒe asiʋlo ɖeka aku ɖe Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsa la dzi atɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi hena ŋkuɖoɖo dzi, elabena nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsae.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ale nunɔla alé vu nɛ le eƒe vo, si wòda le nusiawo dometɔ ɖeka me la ta, eye woatsɔe akee. Ke nu mamlea nye nunɔla la tɔ abe nuɖuɖuvɔsa tɔ ene. Fɔɖivɔsawo ŋu se.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe meɖi anukware o, eye wòɖe ŋu ɖi ɖa vo le Yehowa ƒe nu kɔkɔeawo me la, ekema wòatsɔ agbo, si sɔ blibo, eye nèbu be, anɔ klosalo sekel kɔkɔe eve la, asa fɔɖiŋuvɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Womatsɔ amɔwɔ ʋaʋã aƒoe o, elabena nye dzovɔsa me meɖee le na wo, nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye abe nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsa kple fɔɖiŋutivɔsa ene.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: Nunɔla nado eƒe awu ʋlaya viawo, eye wòado agbotɛ ɣiawo ɖe eƒe ama; emegbe wòala afi, siwo numevɔsa ƒe dzo nyẽ la le vɔsamlekpui la dzi akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la xa.

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: Amesiame, si aka asi eƒe lã ŋu la, azu kɔkɔe, eye ne eƒe ʋu hlẽ ɖe amea ɖe ƒe awu ŋu la, ekema wòanya afisi wòhlẽ ɖo la, le teƒe kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Aron viŋutsuwo katã kpɔ mɔ aɖui. Ɖoɖo mavɔ wònye le Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsa la ŋu hena miaƒe dzidzimeviwo. Amesiame, si aka asi eŋu la, azu kɔkɔe.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Esia enye vɔ, si Aron kple viaŋutsuwo asa na Yehowa le gbesigbe wòsi ami nɛ: Wɔ memee eta ƒe mamã ewoliawo ɖeka woatsɔ asa nuɖuvɔe gbesiagbe; woatsɔ wɔ la ƒe afã asa vɔe le ŋdi, eye afã le fiẽ.

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Tsɔ ami blui, eye natɔe le agba me, emegbe naflii, hafi atsɔ asa nuɖuvɔ lae, bena wòaʋẽ lilili ɖe Yehowa.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Aron kple viaŋutsuwo be: Esia enye nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsa ŋu se: Woawu nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã ɖe afisi wowua numevɔsalã ɖo, le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me; elabena nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ne woɖae le ze me la, ekema woagbã ze la, ke nenye gaze me woɖae le la, ekema woaklɔe, eye woakpalae kple tsi.

english_verse: Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten! Sacrifices for Sin (Leviticus
translation_verse: Gake womekpɔ mɔ aɖu nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsalã, si ƒe ʋu wotsɔ yi Mawu ƒe agbadɔ me, be woatsɔ alé avui le kɔkɔeƒea me la, ƒe lã o, boŋ woatɔ dzoe.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla natɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, elabena dzovɔsa wònye na Yehowa; fɔɖivɔsae.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Eye wòadzɔ eƒe nunanawo tatata na Yehowa; esia nanye nunɔla, si hlẽa akpedavɔsalã ƒe ʋu la tɔ.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Ne lã la ƒe ɖe ka nu makɔmakɔa ɖe ŋu la, womaɖui o, boŋ woatɔ dzoe. Amesiame, si ŋu kɔ la, kpɔ mɔ aɖu lã la.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: Esia nye fɔɖivɔsa ŋu se: Nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Woawu fɔɖivɔsalã ɖe afisi wowua numevɔsalã ɖo, eye woatsɔ eƒe nu ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Eye woatsɔ eƒe amiwo katã asa vɔe: Asike la kple eŋu miwo kpakple ami, si tsyɔ dɔmenuawo dzi,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu mi, siwo ku ɖe ali la ŋu, kpakple aklã ŋu miawo; ayikuawo ŋu wòaɖe wo le.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu sia ŋutsu, si nye nunɔla la, kpɔ mɔ aɖui le teƒe kɔkɔe la, elabena nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsa kple fɔɖivɔsa wòsɔ, se ɖeka le wo ŋu; nunɔla, si tsɔe lé avui la, tɔ wònye.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla sa numevɔ na amea ɖe la, ekema numevɔsalã la ƒe agbalẽ enye nunɔla tɔ.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Nuɖuvɔsa, siwo katã woƒona ɖe kpo me, woɖana le ze me alo wotɔna le agba me la, nanye nunɔla, si tsɔe sa vɔe la tɔ.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye nuɖuvɔsa, siwo katã woɖe amii alo wole ɣeɣe la, nye Aron viŋutsuwo dome ɖesiaɖe tɔ.

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Esia nye akpedavɔ, si amea ɖe asa na Yehowa la ŋu se;

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Nenye kafukafu tae wòbe, yeasa vɔ ɖo la, ekema wòatsɔ aboŋgo maʋamaʋã, akaklã, si dzi wokɔ ami ɖo, kpakple wɔ memee, si wodzaba kple ami hetsɔ tɔ tatali la, akpe ɖe eƒe kafukafuvɔsalã la ŋu.

english_verse: You must also make some bread with yeast.
translation_verse: Ke wòatsɔ abolo ʋaʋã akpe ɖe eƒe kafukafu-kple akpedavɔsalã la ŋu.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Woaɖu eƒe kafukafu-kple akpedavɔsalã la le gbesigbe wosa vɔ la, eye womagblẽ ɖeke ɖi ŋu nake ɖe eɖzi o.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe ɖe adzɔgbe alo dzi dzɔe wòsa vɔ la, ekema woaɖu vɔsalã la le gbesigbe wosa vɔ la, eye ne ŋu ke ɖe dzi hã, wokpɔ mɔ aɖu mamlea.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe aɖu eƒe akpedavɔsalã le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la, womagaxɔe nɛ o, eye womabui na amesi sa vɔ la o; lã makɔmakɔ wòanye, eye amesi aɖu eƒe ɖe la, fɔɖiɖi la anɔ edzi.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe de asi nu makɔmakɔa ɖe ŋu, eɖanye amea ɖe ƒe nu makɔmakɔ, lã makɔmakɔ alo ŋunyɔnu makɔmakɔa ɖe ŋu o, eye woɖu akpedavɔsa, si nye Yehowa tɔ ƒe ɖe la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena.

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu nyi, ale alo gbɔ ƒe amia ɖeke o.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Ke miate ŋu awɔ lã kukuwo kple lã, siwo nu lé la, ƒe ami ŋu ɖɔ, gake miaɖui o.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si aɖu lã, si wotsɔ sa dzovɔ na Yehowa, ƒe ami la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu xe alo lãfɔneewo ƒe mũ le mia nɔƒewo katã o.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si aɖe nu ʋua ɖe ŋu la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose gblɔ bena:

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Nunɔla natɔ dzo ami la le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, ke akɔ la nye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo tɔ.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aron viŋutsuwo dometɔ, si tsɔ akpedavɔsalã ƒe ʋu kple ami sa vɔe la, tɔ enye ɖusita la.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Elabena meɖe akɔ, si wonye kple ata, si nye adzɔ la, le Israel-viwo ƒe akpedavɔsawo me na nunɔla Aron kple viaŋutsuawo. Esia anye ɖoɖo na Israel-viwo tegbee.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: se, siwo Yehowa de na Mose le Sinai-to la dzi, le gbesigbe wòde se na Israel-viwo le Sinai-gbedzi, be woasa va na Yehowa.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Eyome Mose tsa ameɖogbo la ƒe akɔ, eye wònyèe le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, eye wòzu Mose to, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Kplɔ nɔviwò Aron kple viaŋutsuwo, eye natsɔ awuawo, ami sisi la, nuvɔ̃vɔsa-nyitsu la, agbo eveawo kpakple kusi, si me nu maʋamaʋãwo le,

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: eye na ameha blibo la naƒo ƒu ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ƒe ʋɔtru nu.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Tete Mose gblɔ na, ameha la bena: Ale Yehowa de se be woawo enye si.

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Eye Mose na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo te va, eye wòle tsi na wo.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Edo awutewui ʋlaya la nɛ, eye wotso alidziblanu bia edzi; emegbe wòdo dziwui la nɛ, eve wòdo kɔmewu la ɖe dzi; eyome wòtsɔ akɔblanu, si le kɔmewua ŋu la, bia akɔ nɛ,

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: etsɔ akɔtaɖonu la ɖo eŋu, eye wotsɔ Urim kple Tumim ɖe akɔtaɖonu la me;

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: emegbe wòtsɔ tablanu la bla ta nɛ, eye wòtsi sikaŋgoblanu kɔkɔe la ɖe tablanu la ŋu le ŋgɔgbe, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Eyome Mose tso ami sisi la, eye wòsii na nɔƒe la kple eme nuawo katã, eye wòwɔ wo kɔkɔe.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ewu ami la ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu zi adre, eye wòsi ami na vɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu nuawo katã, tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ, be wòawɔ wo kɔkɔe.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye wòkɔ ami sisi la ƒe ɖe ɖe Aron ƒe tame hesi ami ne, be wòako eŋu.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Eye Mose na Aron viŋutsuwo te va, wodo awutewui ʋlayawo, eye wòtsɔ alidziblanu bia wo dzi na wo, emegbe wòbia ta na wo, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Eye wòna wohe nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsu la ve, eye Aron kple viaŋutsuawo tsa woƒe asiwò ɖo nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsua ƒe tame.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Emegbe Mose wui, eye wotso eƒe asibide sisi ʋu la ƒe ɖe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu godoo va kpe, eye wòɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le vɔsamlekpui la ŋu; ke ekɔ ʋu mamlea ɖe anyigba le vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ. Ale wòwɔe kɔkɔe, esi wòwɔ avulénuwo le eŋu.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖe ami, siwo katã le dɔmenuawo ŋu, aklã ŋu miawo kpakple ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu miawo. Eye Mose to dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ke etɔ dzo nyitsu la, eƒe agbalẽ, eƒe lã kple dɔmemiwo le asaɖa la godo, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Eyome wòhe numevɔsagbo la vɛ, eye Aron kple viaŋutsuwo tso woƒe asi ɖo agbo la ƒe tame.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eye Mose wui, eye wotsa ʋu la hlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ke etsɔ tsi kpala dɔmenuawo kple afɔawo, eye Mose tɔ dzo agbo blibo la le vɔsamlekpui dzi. Numevɔsa, si nena lilili la wònye, dzovɔsa wònye na Yehowa, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Emegbe wòhe agbo evelia, si nye ameɖogbo la vɛ, eye Aron kple viaŋutsuawo tsɔ woƒe asi ɖo agbo la ƒe tame.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Eye Mose wui hetsɔ ʋu la ƒe ɖe sisi ɖe Aron ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kpakple ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eyome Mose na Aron viŋutsuawo le va, eye wotsɔ ʋu la ƒe ɖe sisi ɖe woƒe ɖusitogboewo, ɖusidegblefetsuwo kpakple ɖusifɔdegblefetsuwo ŋu. Eye Mose tsɔ ʋu mamlea hlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖe eŋu miwo: Asike la kple eŋu miwo, ami, siwo katã le dɔmenuawo ŋu, aklã ŋu miwo, ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu miwo kpakple ɖusita la.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Emegbe wotsɔ akaklã ɖeka, aboŋgo ɖeka kple tatali ɖeka le kusi, si me nu maʋamaʋãwo le le Yehowa ŋku me la me, heda ɖe amiawo kple ɖusita la dzi,

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ nu siawo katã de asi me na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo henyè wo le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Eye Mose xɔ nuawo le wo si ɖa ɖe numevɔsalã la dzi heto dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Ameɖovɔsa, si ʋẽna lilili la wònye, dzovɔsa wònye na Yehowa.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye Mose tsɔ ami sisi la kple nu, si le vɔsamlekpuia dzi la, ƒe ɖe wu ɖe Aron kple eƒe awuwo kpakple viaŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuwo ŋu; ale wòkɔ Aron kple eƒe awuwo kpakple viaŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuwo ŋu.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo bena: Miɖa lã la le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye miaɖu le afima kple abolo, siwo le ameɖokusi la me, abe alesi wode se nam be, Aron kple viaŋutsuawo naɖui ene.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Migadzo le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu ŋkeke adre sɔŋ o, vaseɖe gbesigbe mia ɖoɖo ŋkeke la nawu nu, elabena ŋkeke adree wole mia ɖo ge.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Alesi wowɔ egbea la, nenema Yehowa de se be, woawo ayi dzi, be woalé avu na mi.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Minɔ Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu ŋkeke adre sɔŋ zã kple keli, eye ŋkeke adre mialé ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖoawo ŋu, ne miagaku o, elabena nenema wòde se gblɔ.

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Eye Aron kple viaŋutsuawo wo nusianu, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyiagbe Mose ya Aron kple Israel-ame tsitsiwo,

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na Aron bena: Lé nyitsuvi woawo nuvɔ̃vɔsae kple agbo woawɔ numevɔsa; woa kple eve la nasɔ blibo, eye nakplɔ wo ava Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: nyi kple agbo ɖeka woawɔ akpedavɔsae; eye miawu wo le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, eye miatsɔ nuɖuvɔsa, si wode amii vɛ, elabena egbea Yehowa aɖe eɖokui afia mi.

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Tete wotsɔ nusiwo Mose bia la, va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye ameha blibo la ƒo ƒu hetsi tre ɖe Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ bena: Ale Yehowa de se be, miawɔ; miwɔe, be Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe naɖe eɖokui afia mi!

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Emegbe Mose gblɔ na Aron bena: Te ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, eye nasa wò nuvɔ̃vɔ kple wò numevɔ, bena nalé avu na ɖokuiwò kple dukɔ la; eyome nasa vɔ ɖe dukɔ la ta, be nalé avu na wo, abe alesi Yehowa de se ene.

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Tete Aron te ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, eye wowu nyitsuvi la, wòanye eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃vɔsa.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Eye Aron viŋutsuawo tso ʋu la vɛ ne, eye wotso eƒe asibide de ʋu la me hesisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, ke etso ʋu mamlea ka ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Eye wòto dzo nuvɔ̃vɔsalã ƒe amiawo, ayikuawo kple aklã ŋu miawo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ke eta dzo lã la ŋutɔ kple agbalẽa le asaɖa la godo.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eyome wòwu numevɔsalã la, eye Aron viŋutsuawo tsɔ ʋu la nɛ, eye wòhlẽe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ numevɔsalã la ƒe akpawo kpakple ta la nɛ, eye wòto dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Eye wòkpala dɔmenuawo kple afɔawo da ɖe numevɔsalã la dzi heto dzo wo.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Emegbe wòsa vɔ na dukɔ la. Elé nuvɔ̃vɔsagbɔ̃tsu, si nye dukɔa to la, eye wòwui hetsɔ sa nuvɔ̃vɔe, abe alesi wòwɔe gbã ene.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Eyome wòhe numevɔsalã la vɛ, eye wòsa va la ɖe ɖoɖo la nu.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Eye wotso nuɖuvɔsa la vɛ: eku asiʋlo ɖeka le eŋu hetɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi kpe ɖe ŋdinumevɔsa la ŋu.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eye wòwu nyi kple agbo la hena dukɔ la ƒe akpedavɔsasa. Aron viŋutsuawo tsa ʋu la nɛ, eye wòhlẽe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Wotsɔ nyi la ƒe amiawo, agbo la ƒe asike kple eŋu miawo, ami, si tsyɔ dɔmenuawo dzi, ayikuawo kple aklã ŋu miawo

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Emegbe Aron wu eƒe asiwò dzi ɖe dukɔ la dzi, eye wòyra wo; eye esi wòsa nuvɔ̃vɔ, numevɔ kple akpedavɔ vɔ la, eɖi ɖe anyi.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Eye Mose kple Aron woyi ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me; eye esi wodo go la, woyra dukɔ la. Tete Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖe eɖokui fia dukɔ blibo la.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye dzo tso Yehowa gbɔ fiã numevɔsalã kple amiawo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Dukɔ blibo la kpɔe, eye wotso aseye hetsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Eye Aron viŋutsuawo Nadab kple Abihu, tsɔ woƒe dzudzɔdosonuwo ɖe dzo ɖe me, eye woda dzudzɔdonu ɖe wo dzi, eye wotsɔ dzo bubu, si ŋu meɖe mɔ le na wo o la, va Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Tete dzo tso Yehowa gbɔ va fiã wo, eye woku ɖe Yehowa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ na Aron bena: Ke esia gblɔm Yehowa le enye sia bena: Maɖe ɖokuinye afia amesi te ɖe ŋunye la, abe kɔkɔetɔ ene, eye maɖe nye ŋutikɔkɔe afia le dukɔ blibo la ŋku me. Tete Aron zi kpi.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Eye Mose yɔ Misael kple Elzafan, Aron tɔdia Usiel ƒe viŋutsuwo, gblɔ na wo bena Miva, ne miakɔ mia nɔviawo aɖo goe le kɔkɔeƒe la me ayi ɖe asaɖa la godo.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo Eleazar kple Itamar bena: Migakaka miaƒe ɖawo ɖe ta o, eye migadze miaƒe awuwo o, ne miagaku, eye wòado dɔmedzoe ɖe ha blibo la ŋu o. Ke mia nɔviwo, Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la, nafa dzo, si Yehowa tɔ nu la.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Migadzo le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, bena miaku o, elabena Yehowa ƒe ami le mia ŋu. Eye wowɔ, abe alesi Mose gblɔ ene.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Aron bena:

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ne mia kple viwòŋutsuawo miele Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me yi ge la, migano wein alo aha muamea ɖeke o, bena miagaku o. Ɖoɖo mava wòanye na miaƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Miade vovo nu kɔkɔewo kple nu makɔmakɔwo, nu madzɔmadzɔwo kple nu dzadzɛwo dome.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Eye miafia ɖoɖo, siwo katã Yehowa ɖo to Mose dzi la, Israel-viwo.

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ na Aron kple Eleazar kpakple Itamar, viaŋutsu, siwo susɔ ɖi bena: Mitso nuɖuvɔsa, si susɔ tso Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsa me la, eye miaɖui maʋamaʋãe le vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ, elabena nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wonye.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Teƒe kokoe la miaɖui le; wò ŋutɔ kple viwòŋutsuawo ƒe gome wònye tso Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsa la me; elabena nenema wode se nam.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ ala, si nye adzɔ, kple akɔ, si wonye la, akpe ɖe amiawo, siwo nye dzovɔsa la ŋu, eye nanye wo le Yehowa ƒe ŋku me, bena woanye wò ŋutɔ kple viwòŋutsuawo to. Miaƒe gome wòanye tegbee, abe alesi Yehowa de se ene.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wometsɔ eƒe ʋu yi kɔkɔeƒe la mee o, eyata ɖe miaɖui le teƒe kɔkɔe la, abe alesi mede se ene hafi.

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Eye Aron ƒo nu kple Mose bena: Kpɔ ɖa, wosa nuvɔ̃vɔ kple numevɔ na Yehowa egbea. Esi wònye dzinyee nya la dzɔ ɖo la, ne meɖu nuvɔ̃vɔsalã egbea la, adze Yehowa ŋua?

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Esi Mose see la, edze eŋu.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu lãtɔne, siwo katã ƒe afɔkli me fe, eye wodzɔa nu gaɖuna.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose kple Aron gblɔ na wo bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: Migblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Lã, siwo miaɖu le lãfɔnewo dome le anyigba dzi la, wonye si.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ke nu dzodzoe bubu, siwo katã gɔme afɔ ene le la, ŋunyɔnu woanye na mi.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: atɔ, ana, xɔmenyatri, ve kple agama.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Esiawo nye lã makɔmakɔwo na mi le lã suewo katã dome; amesi ade asi woƒe kukua ŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If something made of wood, cloth, or leather touches one of their dead bodies, it must be washed, but it is still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si dzi woƒe kukua ge dze la, ŋu mekɔ o, eɖanye atinuwo, avɔ, lãgbalẽ, kotoku alo nusianu, si ŋu dɔ wowɔna o, ele be, woade wo tsi me, eye wo ŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ; emegbe hafi wo ŋu agakɔ.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ne woge dze anyinua ɖe me la, ekema nusianu, si le eme la, ŋu mekɔ o, eye ele be, miagbã nu la.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu sia nuɖuɖu, si dzi wokɔ tsi ma ɖo la, ŋu mekɔ o, eye nunono sia nunono, si le nu mawo ƒe ɖe me la, ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si dzi woƒe kukua dze la, ŋu mekɔ o, eɖanye abolokpo alo mlekpui o, ele be, woagbãe; nu makɔmakɔwo wonye, eye ŋunyɔnu woanye na mi.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ke tsi dzidziwo, vudowo kple tawo ŋu kɔ, gake amesi ke de asi woƒe kukua ŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Ne woƒe kukua dze nukua ɖe, si ƒã ge wòala dzi la, eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Ke ne wode nuku la tsi, eye woƒe kukua dze edzi la, ekema eŋu mekɔ na mi o.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne lã, siwo mieɖuna la, dometɔa ɖe ku, eye amea ɖe de asi kukua ŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖu kukua la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ; amesi tsɔ kukua la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.
translation_verse: Lã sue, siwo katã zɔna le anyigba dzi, esiwo tana le ƒodo dzi kpakple esiwo gɔme afɔ ene alo afɔ geɖe le la, miaɖu wo o, elabena ŋunyɔnuwo wonye.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
