translation_verse: Migatsɔ lã suewo do ŋunyɔ mia ɖokui o, eye migatsɔ wo gblẽ kɔ ɖo ahaƒo ɖi mia ɖokui o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Elabena nyee nye Yehowa, miaƒe Mawu. Eyata miwɔ mia ɖokui kɔkɔe, eye mianɔ kɔkɔe, elabena kɔkɔetɔ menye; migatsɔ anyigbadzilã suewo gblẽ kɔ ɖo na mia ɖokui o.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, si kplɔ mi tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, bena manye miaƒe Mawu. Eyata minɔ kɔkɔe, elabena kɔkɔetɔ menye.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: bena woade vovo nu makɔmakɔ kple nu kokoe dome, eye woade vovo lã, si woaɖu kple esi womaɖu o la dome.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Ne nyɔnua ɖe fo fu, eye wòdzi ŋutsuvi la, ekema eŋu mekɔ o ŋkeke adre, abe ŋkeke alesi wokpɔa dzinui ene.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke enyiagbe la woatso eƒe aʋanuyi ɖa.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Ke ne edzi nyɔnuvi la, ekema eŋu mekɔ o kwasiɖa eve, abe alesi wòkpɔa dzinui ene; emegbe wòatsi xɔ me ŋkeke blaade vo ade le ʋu, si le eŋu la ta.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Nenye ŋutsuvi alo nyɔnuvie, eye ŋkekeawo de eŋu ko la, ekema wòalé alẽvi, si xɔ ƒe ɖeka, woawo numevɔsae, kple ahɔnevi alo akpakpa woawɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsae, avae na nunɔla le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Eya natsɔe asa wɔe le Yehowa ŋku me, bena wòalé avu nɛ, ekema eŋu ko tso ʋu, si do le eŋu la me. Esia nye se na nyɔnu, si dzi ŋutsuvi alo nyɔnuvi.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ke ne mate ŋu ana alé o la, ekema wòatsɔ akpakpa alo ahɔnevi eve vɛ; ɖeka woawo numevɔsae, eye ɖeka woawo nuvɔ̃vɔsae, eye nunɔla nalé avu nɛ, ekema eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose kpakple Aron bena:

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ƒe ŋutigbalẽ dze haƒla, aklabi alo dzi, eye wòbe, yeatrɔ zu anyi la, ekema woakplɔ ame la ava nunɔla Aron alo viaŋutsu, siwo nye nunɔlawo la, dometɔ ɖeka gbee.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla kpo nusi le eƒe ŋutigbalẽ ŋu, eye fu, siwo le eteƒe, fu ɣie, eye nu la teƒe nye ɖe me wu ŋutigbalẽ bubuawo la, ekema anyie; eye ne nunɔla la kpɔe la, woabui ame makɔmakɔe.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ke ne eƒe ŋutigbalẽ ɖe bo ɣie ko, eye eteƒe menyẽ ɖe me wu ŋutigbalẽ bubuawo o, eye fuawo hã mefu ɣie o la, ekema nunɔla la natu ame la ɖe xɔ me ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Eye ne nunɔla la kpɔe le ŋkeke adreagbe, eye wòdze sii be, nua gale nenema ko, eye mekaka ɖe eƒe ŋutigbalẽ me o la, ekema nunɔla la nagatui ɖe xɔ me zi evelia ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla la gakpɔe ɖa le ŋkeke adreagbe, eye nu la teƒe lé akpa, eye mekaka ɖe eƒe ŋutigbalẽ me o la, ekema nunɔla nabui amesi ŋu ko; elabena dzi ko wònye, eye ame la nanyã eƒe avɔwo, ekema eŋu ko.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, dzi la kaka ɖe eƒe ŋutigbalẽ me la, ekema nunɔla la nabui ame makɔmakɔe, anyie wònye.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Ne anyi ƒo ɖe amea ɖe ŋu la, ekema wòakplɔe ava nunɔla gbɔe.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Eye ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, eŋu ɖo loholoho ɣie, eye fuawo trɔ zu ɣie, alo adzu ɖo loholoho la me la,

english_verse: he will say, “This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.”
translation_verse: ekema anyi xoxo wònye le eŋu, eye nunɔla la nabui ame makɔmakɔe; matui ɖe xɔ me o, elabena eŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: eye ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, anyi la xɔ eŋu katã, eye eŋu fu ɣie keŋ la, ekema woabui amesi ŋu kɔe.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: eye ne nunɔla la kpɔ adzua la, ekema woabui ame makɔmakɔe; elabena adzu la nu vɔe, anyie wònye.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Eye ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, nu la fu ɣie la, ekema nunɔla la nabui be, eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: emegbe nuƒoƒo la teƒe lolo alo dze dzi, si le ɣie heɖe dze wɔ ge la, ekema wòatsɔ eɖokui afia nunɔla.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, nu la teƒe nye ɖe me wu ŋutigbalẽ bubuawo, eye fuawo lu ɣie la, ekema nunɔla la nabui ame makɔmakɔe; anyie wònye ƒo ɖe nuƒoƒo la teƒe.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ke ne nunɔla kpɔ bena, fu ɣiwo mele eɖzi o, eye eteƒe menyẽ ɖe me o, ke wòlé akpɔ la, ekema nunɔla la natui ɖe xɔ me ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Eye, ne ekaka ɖe eƒe ŋutigbalẽ me la, ekema nunɔla nabui ame makɔmakɔe; anyie wònye.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Ke ne nu la teƒe gale nenema ko, eye mekeke ɖe nu o la, ekema nu kuku teƒee, eye nunɔla nabui amesi ŋu kɔe.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Ne dzo fiã amea ɖe, eye dzobi la teƒe le ɣie de dzẽ wɔ ge alo le ɣie keŋ,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: eye ne nunɔla kpɔ bena fu, siwo le eteƒe, fu ɣie, eye eteƒe nyẽ ɖe me la, ekema anyie wònye ƒo ɖe dzobi la teƒe, eye nunɔla la nabui ame makɔmakɔe; anyie wònye.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ke ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, fu ɣiwo mele eteƒe o, eteƒe menyẽ ɖe eme o, eye melé akpɔ hã o la, ekema nunɔla natui ɖe xɔ me ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla kpɔe ɖa le ŋkeke adreagbe, eye wòkeke ɖe nu la, ekema nunɔla nabui ame makɔmakɔe; anyie wònye.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Ke ne teƒe ɣi la tsi nenema, mekeke ɖe nu o, eye wòlé akpɔ la, ekema dzobi kuku teƒe wònye.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Ne aklabi ƒo ɖe ŋutsu alo nyɔnua ɖe ƒe ta me alo ge me,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: eye ne nunɔla kpɔ aklabi la, eteƒe nye ɖe me, eye dawo zu hẽ hele belibeli la, ekema nunɔla nabui ame makɔmakɔe; aklabi vɔ̃ɖie, anyie wònye ƒo ɖe ta me alo ge me ne.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ke ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, aklabi la teƒe menyẽ ɖe me o, eye ɖa, siwo le edzi, menya o la, ekema nunɔla la natu ame la ɖe xɔ me ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Eye ne nunɔla la kpɔe ɖa le ŋkeke adreagbe, eye aklabi la melolo ɖe dzi o, ɖa, siwo le eteƒe, mezu hẽ o, eye aklabi la teƒe menyẽ ɖe me o la,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ekema wòako ta, gake woatso aklabi la teƒe ɖi, eye nunɔla la nagatu ame la ɖe xɔ me zi evelia ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Eye ne nunɔla la kpɔ ame la le ŋkeke adreagbe, aklabi la melolo ɖe dzi o, eye eteƒe menyẽ ɖe me hã o la, ekema nunɔla la nabui amesi ŋu kɔe, eye wòanya eƒe avɔwo, ekema eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: eye ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, aklabi la nya lolo ɖe dzi ko la, ekema nunɔla la megabia ɖa hẽ ta se o, ame makɔmakɔ wònye.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Ne aklabi ƒo ɖe ŋutsu alo nyɔnua ɖe ŋu,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: eye nunɔla kpɔ bena, eƒe ŋutigbalẽ lé akpɔ la, ekema menye aklabi vɔ̃ɖie ƒo ɖe eŋu o; eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Eye ne ɖa be le ŋgonu nɛ la, ekema tabebetɔ wònye; eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Eye ne nunɔla la kpɔ bena, nusi ƒo ɖe eƒe dzodome alo ŋgonu la, le ɣie de dzẽ wɔ ge, abe alesi anyi ƒona ɖe ame ŋutii ene la,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Ɖovu nanɔ anyidzela ŋu, wòagblẽ eƒe ta ɖi wòato, eye wòabla glã anɔ ɣli ɖom bena: Busue! busue!

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke alesi anyia le eŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o, eya ɖeka nanɔ aga, asaɖa la godo nanye enɔƒe. Alesi woakpɔ anyi adze sii le awuwo me.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Eye woatɔ dzo awu, avɔ alo nusi wotsɔ lãfu alo ɖeti lɔ̃e alo nusianu, si wotsɔ lãgbalẽ wɔe, si ŋu nu la le; anyi vɔ̃ɖie, eyata woatɔ dzo nu la.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ekema nunɔla la nade se be, wòanya nusi ŋu wòle, emegbe woatsɔe ade xɔ zi evelia ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Ne wonyã nu la, eye nunɔla la kpɔ bena, egale nenema ko, eye mekeke ɖe nu hã o la, ekema nu makɔmakɔ wònye; ele be, woatɔ dzoe, anyie wònye lé ɖe nu la megbe alo ŋku me.

english_verse: But if the spot has faded after being washed, he will tear away the spot.
translation_verse: Ke ne wonyã nu la, eye nunɔla la kpɔ bena, megale nenema o la, ekema wòala teƒe la ɖa le awu alo lãgbalẽ, avɔ alo nu lɔlɔ̃ la me.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Ke ne egaɖo awu alo avɔ, nu hlɔ̃ alo nusi wotsɔ lãgbalẽ wɔe me la, ekema anyie, ele be, woatɔ dzo nusi ŋu wòle.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Ne ènyã awu alo ava, nu lɔlɔ̃ alo nusi wotsɔ lãgbalẽ wɔe, eye nu la do le me la, ekema naganyãe zi evelia, emegbe la eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Esia nye se le anyi, si ɖo awu, si nye kuntru alo aklala, avɔ alo nu lɔlɔ̃ alo nusianu, si wotso lãgbalẽ wòe me la ŋuti, alesi woabui be, eŋu ko, alo eŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena;

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: ekema nunɔla nade se bena, woana xevi gbagbe eve, siwo dza kple sederti, ka dze kpakple isop ɖe amesi ŋu kɔm wole la ta.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla nade se bena, woatso xevi ɖeka ɖe tɔsisi me tsi ŋgɔ le ze me.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔ xevi gbagbe la kple sederti, ka dzẽ kpakple isop la ato xeviʋu, si wotso ɖe tɔsisi me tsi ŋgɔ la me,

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: awu ɖe anyidzela, si ŋu kɔm wole la ŋu, eye wòakɔ eŋu; ke wòaɖe asi le xevi gbagbe la ŋu aɖo ɖe gbe me.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ŋu kɔm wole la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo, alũ eƒe dawo keŋ, eye wòale tsi, ekema eŋu kɔ. Emegbe ekpɔ mo ayi asaɖa la me, gake woatsi eƒe agbadɔ nu ŋkeke adre sɔŋ.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adreagbe la wòalũ eƒe ɖawo keŋ; alũ ta, ge kple adzugo, gɔglɔ̃gɔ wòalũ afisiafi, si fu nya le ko, anyẽ eƒe avawo, eye wòale tsi, ekema eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyiagbe woatso alẽvi eve, siwo so blibo, kple alẽnɔ, si xɔ ƒe ɖeka, eye wosa blibo la, akpe ɖe wɔ memee tre etɔ̃, si wodzaba kple ami ŋu awɔ nuɖuvɔsae, hekpe ɖe ami trevi ɖeka ŋu.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla, si le nua wɔm la, nakplɔ amesi ŋu kɔm wole la, akpe ɖe nuawo ŋu aɖo Yehowa ŋku me le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla nalé alẽvi ɖeka akpe ɖe ami trevi ɖeka la ŋu asa fɔɖivɔe, eye wòanyè wo le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Emegbe woawu alẽvi la ɖe teƒe kɔkɔe, si wowua nuvɔ̃vɔsalã kple numevɔsalã ɖo; elabena fɔɖivɔsalã hã nye nunɔla tɔ, abe nuvɔ̃vɔsalã ke ene; nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la natsɔ fɔɖivɔsalã ƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe asisi ɖe amesi ŋu kɔm wole la ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la nakɔ ami trevi ɖeka la ƒe ɖe ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe miãsi me.

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la natsɔ eƒe ɖusisibide ade ami, si le eƒe miãsi me la me, eye wòatsɔ eƒe asibide ahlẽ ami la zi adre le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la natsɔ ami, si susɔ ɖe esi la, ƒe ɖe asisi fɔɖivɔsalã ƒe ʋu dzi, le amesi ŋu kɔm wole la ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: If you are poor and cannot afford to offer this much, you may offer a ram as a sacrifice to make things right, together with
translation_verse: Ke ne eda ahe, eye mate ŋu ana nusiawo o la, ekema wòana alẽvi ɖeka, si woanyè awɔ fɔɖivɔsae, bena woatsɔ alé avu nɛ, kple wɔ memee tre ɖeka, si wodzaba kple ami awɔ nuɖuvɔsa, ami trevi ɖeka

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: kpakple akpakpa eve alo ahɔnevi eve, esi ke woate ŋu anya na ko; woatsɔ ɖeka asa fɔɖivɔe, eye woatsɔ evelia asa numevɔe.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: Ne wobui be, eŋu kɔ ŋkeke enyi megbe la, ekema wòatsɔ nuawo avae na nunɔla le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Eye woawu alẽvi, si wole fɔɖivɔ sa gee la, eye nunɔla natsɔ fɔɖivɔsalã ƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe asisi ɖe amesi ŋu kɔm wole la ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la nakɔ ami la ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe miasi me.

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la natsɔ eƒe asibide ahlẽ ami, si le eƒe miãsi me la, ƒe ɖe zi adre le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la natsɔ ami, si le esi la, ƒe ɖe asisi ɖe fɔɖivɔsalã ƒe ʋu dzi le amesi ŋu kɔm wole la ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Esia nye se na amesi dze anyi, eye nu mesɔ gbɔ le esi, be woatsɔ akɔ eŋui o. Alesi woaɖe anyi ɖa le xɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose kpakple Aron bena;

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: Ne miava Kanaan-nyigba, si matsɔ na mi wòanye mia tɔ la dzi, eye mana anyi nado ɖe xɔa ɖe ŋu le anyigba, si nye mia tɔ dzi la,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: ekema xɔtɔ nava gblɔ na nunɔla bena: Nane ɖo ɖe nye xɔ ŋu abe anyi ene.

english_verse: The priest will reply, “Empty the house before I inspect it, or else everything in it will be unclean.”
translation_verse: Nunɔla la nade se bena, woatɔ nuwo le xɔa me, hafi nunɔla la nava kpɔ nua ɖa, bena nusiwo katã le xɔa me la, magazu nu makɔmakɔwo o. Emegbe hafi nunɔla nayi akpɔ xɔ la ɖa.

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Ne ekpɔ nu la teƒe, eye wòdze sii bena, nusi le xɔ la ƒe gli ŋu ɖe amamatsi alo ɖe dze wɔ ge, eye wònye ɖe me wu gli la ƒe afi bubuwo la,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: ekema nunɔla la naɖo le xɔa me ɖe xɔa nu, eye woatu nɔa ŋkeke adre.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla la va le ŋkeke adreagbe, eye wòkpɔ bena, nu la keke ɖe nu le xɔ la ƒe gli ŋu la,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Emegbe woadza xɔ la ƒe gli ŋu afisiafi le eme, eye wòalɔ anyi, si wòdza la, akɔ ɖe du la godo le teƒe makɔmakɔa ɖe.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Eyome woatsɔ kpe bubuwo aɖo kpe kemeawo teƒe, eye woatsɔ anyi bubu atre xɔ lae.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: eye nunɔla la va kpɔ nu la, eye wòdze sii bena, ekeke ɖe xɔa ŋu la, ekema anyi vɔ̃ɖie wònye le xɔa me; eŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Woagbã xɔ la aƒu anyi, eye woalɔ xɔ la ƒe kpewo, atiwo kple anyiglãgowo aƒu gbe ɖe du la godo le teƒe makɔmakɔa ɖe.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke alesi xɔ la gale tutu ko, hafi amea ɖe ge ɖe eme la, eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖo xɔa me la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye amesi ɖu nu le xɔa me la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Ke ne wogbugbɔ xɔ la tre, eye nunɔla la va, eye wòkpɔ bena, nu la mekeke ɖe nu le xɔa me o la, ekema nunɔla la nabu xɔ la be, eŋu kɔ, elabena nu la vɔ.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Wòatso xevi ɖeka ɖe tɔsisi me tsi ŋgɔ le ze me,

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Ale wòatsɔ xevi la ƒe ʋu, tɔsisi me tsi, xevi gbagbe, sederti, isop kpakple ka dzẽ la aɖe vɔ̃ ɖa le xɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Eye wòaɖe asi le xevi gbagbe la ŋu aɖo ɖe du la godo le gbe me; eye ale wòaɖe vɔ ɖa le xɔ la ŋu, ekema eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: bena wòanya nusi ŋu mekɔ o kple nusi ŋu ko. Esia nye se le anyi ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose kpakple Aron bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: Miƒo nu kple Israel-viwo, eye miagblɔ na wo bena: Ne ŋutsua ɖe le afu ɖɔm la, ekema eŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: whether it is stopped up or keeps dripping.
translation_verse: Ne tsi le dodom le eƒe ŋutsu me alo enu xe la, ekema eŋu meka o.

english_verse: Anything that he rests on or sits on is also unclean,
translation_verse: Aba sia aba, si dzi afuɖɔla mia la, eŋu mekɔ o, eye nusianu, si dzi wònɔ la, ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: eye amesi de asi afuɖɔla ŋu la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne afuɖɔla ɖe ta ɖe amea ɖe, si ŋu ko ŋu la, ekema ame la nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe de asi nusianu, si dzi wono ŋu la, eŋu meka o vaseɖe fiẽ, eye amesi atsɔ nua la, nanyã eƒe avawo, eye wòale tsi, eye eŋu meka o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne afuɖɔla meklɔ asi hafi de asi amea ɖe ŋu o la, ekema ame la nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Ne afuɖɔla de asi anyinua ɖe ŋu la, ekema woagbãe; ke nenye atinue la, ekema woaklɔe kple tsi.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Ne afu la vo na amea, eye eŋu ko la, ekema wòaxlẽ ŋkeke adre; emegbe woanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi le tɔsisi me, ekema eŋu ko.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyiagbe la woatso akpakpa eve alo ahɔnevi eve ava Yehowa ŋku me le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye woatso wo na nunɔla,

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: eye nunɔla la nawɔ wo ŋu dɔ; wòatsɔ ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔe, eye wòatsɔ evelia asa numevɔe. Ale nunɔla la alé avu nɛ le Yehowa ŋku me le eƒe afu la ta.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe nyẽ tsi la, ekema wòale tsi, eye eŋu meka o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Eye wòanyã avɔ sia avɔ kple lãgbalẽ sia lãgbalẽ, si dzi wònyẽ tsi la ɖo, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua mlɔ nyɔnua ɖe gbã, hafi nyẽ tsia la, ekema woa kple eve la nale tsi, eye wo ŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne nyɔnua ɖe kpɔ dzinu, eye ʋu le dodom le eƒe nyɔnu me la, ekema eŋu mekɔ o ŋkeke adre, eye amesiame, si ka asi eŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne nane le eƒe aba alo nunɔdzi dzi, eye amea ɖe de asi eŋu la, ekema ame la ŋu meka o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe mlɔ egbɔ, eye ʋu la ɖe ɖe eŋu la, ekema eŋu meka o ŋkeke adre, aba sia aba, si dzi ŋutsua mlɔ la, ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Ne nyɔnua ɖe mekpɔ dzinu, hafi ʋu le dodom le eŋu o, alo eƒe dzinukpɔŋkekewo de, hafi ʋua gale dodom ko la, ekema ŋkeke alesi ʋu le dodom le eŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke alesi ʋu le dodom le eŋu, eye wòmlɔ abaa ɖe dzi la, ekema aba la le abe eƒe dzinukpɔtɔ ene, eye nusianu, si dzi wònɔ la, ŋu mekɔ o, eye wòle abe eƒe dzinukpɔtɔ ke ene.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si ɖe asi nusiawo ŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o, wòanya eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Ne ʋu la nu tso la, ekema wòaxlẽ ŋkeke adre, emegbe eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyiagbe la wòatsɔ akpakpa eve alo ahɔnevi eve avae na nunɔla le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu?

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la natsɔ ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔe, eye wòatsɔ evelia asa numevɔe. Ale nunɔla la alé avu ne le Yehowa ŋku me, le eƒe ʋu makɔmakɔ la ta.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Ale miaxlɔ̃ nu Israel-viwo le nu makɔmakɔwo ŋu, bena ne wo ŋu mekɔ o la, woagagblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye nɔƒe, si le wo dome la, eye woaku o.

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Gblɔ na nɔviwò Aron be, megayi ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la me le xɔmetsovɔ la godo le nutsyɔnu, si le aɖaka la dzi la ŋgɔ ɣesiaɣi, be wòagava ku o; elabena meɖea ɖokuinye fiana le alilikpo me le nutsyɔnu la dzi.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Nusiwo Aron natsɔ ava kɔkɔeƒe la, wonye: Nyitsu ɖagbee ɖeka woawɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsae kple agbo ɖeka woawɔ numevɔsae.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: Wòado awutewui ʋlaya la, eye wòado agbotɛ ɣi ɖe eƒe ama, abla alidziblanu yi la, eye wòatsɔ tablanu ɣi la abla tae. Awu kɔkɔewo wonye, wòale tsi hafi ado wo.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Emegbe Aron natsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsu la alé avu na eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe aƒe.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Eyome wòatsɔ gbɔ̃tsu eveawo aɖo Yehowa ƒe ŋku me le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Eye Aron nadzidze nu ɖe gbɔ̃tsu eveawo dzi, dzidze ɖeka nadze Yehowa dzi, eye dzidze ɖeka nadze Asasel dzi.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Eye Aron natsɔ gbɔ̃tsu, si dzi Yehowa ƒe dzidze dze la, asa nuvɔ̃vɔe.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ke wòatsɔ gbɔ̃tsu, si dzi Asasel ƒe dzidze dze la, ado Yehowa ŋku me agbagbe, eye wòaɖe nuvɔ̃ atrɔ ɖe edzi anyae aɖo ɖe Asasel gbɔ le gbedzi.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Emegbe Aron nahe eƒe nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsu la vɛ, eye wòalé avu na eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe aƒe, eye woawu eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsu la,

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ sonu aɖe dzoka xɔxɔ le vɔsamlekpui la dzi le Yehowa ŋku me, eye woaku dzudzɔdonu, si wotsɔ atike ʋeʋẽe wɔe, eye wotoe memee la, asiʋlo eve ava xɔmetsovɔ la godo.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Eye wòako dzudzɔdonua ɖe dzo la dzi le Yehowa ŋku me, eye ne dzudzɔdonu la ƒe dzudzɔ bia nutsyɔnu, si le nubablaɖakaa dzi la, ekema maku o.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Wòatso eƒe asibide ahlẽ nyitsu la ƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe ɖe nutsyɔnu la dzi, eye woatso eƒe asibide ahlẽ ʋu la ƒe ɖe ɖe nutsyɔnu la ŋgɔ zi adre.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Eyome wòawu dukɔ la ƒe nuvɔ̃vɔsagbɔ̃tsu la, atsɔ eƒe ʋu ava xɔmetsovɔ la godo, eye wòawo eƒe ʋu, abe alesi wòwɔ nyitsu la ƒe ʋu ene; wòahlẽe ɖe nutsyɔnu la dzi kple nutsyɔnu la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Eye wòaɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu le Israel-viwo ƒe nu makɔmakɔ wɔwɔwo kple vo, siwo woda hewɔ nuvɔ̃ la ta; eye alea wòawɔ Mawu ƒe agbadɔ, si le wo gbɔ le woƒe nu makɔmakɔ wɔwɔwo dome la hãe.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Ne edo go la, wòate ɖe vɔsamlekpui, si le Yehowa ŋku me la ŋu, eye wòaɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eŋu. Wòaku nyitsu la ƒe ʋua ƒe ɖe kpakple gbɔ̃tsu la ƒe ʋua ƒe ɖe asisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔ eƒe asibide ahlẽ ʋua ƒe ɖe ɖe edzi zi adre, eye wòako eŋu tso Israel-viwo ƒe nu makɔmakɔwo me awɔe kɔkɔe.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ne eɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le kɔkɔeƒe la, Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpui la ŋu va la, ekema wòana woahe gbɔ̃tsu gbagbe la vɛ.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Eye Aron natsɔ eƒe asiwo kple eve aɖo gbɔ̃tsu gbagbe la ƒe tame, eye wòaʋu Israel-viwo ƒe vodadawo, dzidadawo kple woƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã me akɔ ɖe gbɔ̃tsu la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòana ŋutsu, si le klalo la, nakplɔe aɖo ɖe gbedzi.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Ekem woƒe vodadawo katã yi ɖe gbɔ̃tsu la dzi wotsa yi gbedadaƒoe, eye wòaɖe asi le gbɔ̃tsu la ŋu le gbedzi.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Eye wòale tsi le teƒe kɔkɔe la, aɖo eƒe awuwo, eye wòado go amè eya ŋutɔ ƒe numevɔsa kple dukɔ la ƒe numevɔsa, eye wòalé avu na eya ŋutɔ kple dukɔ la.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Eye wòatɔ dzo nuvɔ̃vɔsalã ƒe amiwo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Amesi kplɔ gbɔ̃tsu la ɖo ɖe Asasel gbɔ la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi, emegbe hafi wòkpɔ mɔ ava asaɖa la me.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Eye woatsɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsu la kple nuvɔ̃vɔsagbɔ̃tsu, siwo ƒe ʋu wotsɔ yi kɔkɔeƒe la me helé avui la, ayi asaɖa la godo, eye woatɔ dzo woƒe agbalẽ, woƒe lã kple woƒe dɔmemiwo.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Amesi tɔ dzo wo la, nanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi, emegbe hafi wòkpɔ mɔ ava asaɖa la me.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Esia nanye ɖoɖo mavɔ na mi. Le ɣleti adrelia ƒe ŋkeke ewolia dzi la míatsi nu ado, eye miawo doa ɖeke o, eɖanye duametɔ alo amedzrovi, si le mia dome o.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Elabena gbemagbe wolé avu na mi, bena woakɔ mia ŋu; azɔ nuvɔ̃wo katã kɔ le mia ŋu le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Dzudzɔgbe gã wòanye na mi, eye míatsi nu ado; ɖoɖo mavɔ wònye na mi.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Amesi alé avua la, nanye nunɔla, si wòsi ami na, eye woɖoe, bena wòanye nunɔla ɖe fofoa teƒe asubɔ; eyae ado awu kɔkɔe ɣiawo,

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: eye wòaɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le kɔkɔeƒewo katã ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la, Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, eye wòalé avu na nunɔlawo kple dukɔ la ƒe ha blibo la.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Esia nye ɖoɖo mavɔ na mi. Zi ɖeka ƒe ɖeka woalé avu na Israel-viwo katã le woƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ta. Eye wòwɔ, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: eye metsɔe va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, bena wòasa vɔ na Yehowa le Yehowa ƒe nɔƒe la nu o la, ekema ame la do hlɔ̃; ekɔ ʋu ɖi, eye woatsrɔ̃ ame la ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Eyata Israel-viwo natsɔ woƒe vɔsalã, siwo wonɔa wuwum le gbedzi la, avae na nunɔla le Yehowa ŋku me le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye woasa akpedavɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla nawu ʋu la ɖe Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye woatɔ dzo amiawo, bena woaʋẽ lilili ɖe Yehowa.

english_verse: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Womegatsɔ woƒe lãwo sa vɔ na azizã, siwo wosubɔna la o. Ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na wo kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo bena: Ne Israel ƒe aƒemetɔa ɖe alo amedzrovi, si le wo dome la, wu numevɔsalã alo akpedavɔsalã,

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: eye mietsɔe va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, bena wòasa vɔ na Yehowa o la, woatsrɔ̃ ame la ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome. Wotsri ʋu kple nu kuku ɖuɖu.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Ne Israel ƒe aƒemetɔa ɖe alo amedzrovi, si le wo dome, ɖu lãʋua ɖe la, maɖe ŋku atɔ amesi ɖu ʋua la, eye matsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Elabena agbe le ʋu la me, eye metsɔe na mi, bena woatsɔ alé avui, elabena agbe le eme.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Ne Israel-viwo dometɔa ɖe alo amedzrovi, si le wo dome, da ade wu gbemelã alo xevia ɖe, si woɖuna la, ekema wòaɖuɖu eƒe ʋu ɖe anyigba, eye wòaxe ke ɖe dzi.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Lãwo katã ƒe agbe le woƒe ʋu me, eyata megblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Migaɖu lãa ɖeke ƒe nu o, elabena lãwo ƒe nu enye woƒe agbe. Amesiame, si aɖui la, woatsɔe ɖa.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne duamevi alo amedzrovia ɖe ɖu lã kuku alo lã, si nu lé la, ekema wòanyã eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi, eye eŋu mekɔ o vaseɖe fiẽ; emegbe eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Ke ne menya wo o, eye mele tsi hã o la, ekema eya ŋutɔ ƒe fɔɖiɖi le edzi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Migawɔ Egipte-nyigba, si dzi mienɔ la, dzinɔlawo ƒe nuwɔnawo o, eye migawɔ Kanaan-nyigba, si dzi mekplɔ mi yinae la, dzitɔwo ƒe nuwɔnawo o, eye migawɔ woƒe ɖoɖowo dzi hã o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nye sewo dzi, eye milé ŋku ɖe nye ɖoɖowo ŋu, ne miawo wo dzi. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke megamlɔ eƒe ƒometɔ kekeake gbɔ ade asi eŋu o. Nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father.
translation_verse: Megaɖe ama fofowò o, eye megade asi dawo ŋu o; dawò wònye, eyata megade asi eŋu o.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Megade asi fofowò srɔ̃ ŋu o, elabena eƒe ama nye fofowò tɔ.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Megaɖe asi nɔviwònyɔnu, fofowò vinyɔnu alo dawò vinyɔnu, si wodzi ɖe aƒe alo ɖe afi bubu la ŋu o.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Megaɖe asi viwòŋutsu ƒe vinyɔnu alo viwònyɔnu ƒe vinyɔnu ŋu o, elabena wò ŋutɔ wò ama wònye.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Megade asi dawò nɔvinyɔnu ŋu o, elabena eya kple dawòe dzɔ tso ɖɔ ɖeka me.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Megaɖe ama fofowò nɔviŋutsu o, eye megamlɔ srɔ̃ gbɔ hã o, elabena dawòɖiae.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Megaɖe asi nyɔnua ɖeke kple vianyɔnu siaa ŋu o, eye megaɖe asi viaŋutsu ƒe vinyɔnu kple vianyɔnu ƒe vinyɔnu ŋu o, elabena ƒometɔ kekeakewo wonye; ŋukpenanu wònye.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Ne srɔ̃wò le agbe la, megaɖe nɔvianyɔnu kpe ɖe eŋu o, eye megaɖe asi eŋu hã o, bena nagadɔ atsusidzre o.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Ne nyɔnua ɖe kpɔ dzinu la, megamlɔ egbɔ ade asi eŋu o.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Megaɖe asi hawòvi srɔ̃ ŋu, bena nado ŋunyɔ ɖokuiwò o.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Megatsɔ viwò sa vɔe na Molex o, bena nagaƒo ɖi Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ o. Nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Megadɔ ŋutsu gbɔ abe nyɔnu gbɔ ene o, ŋunyɔnu wònye.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Migawɔ nusiawo atsɔ ado ŋunyɔ mia ɖokui o, elabena trɔ̃subɔla, siwo nyã ge mala le mia ŋgɔ la, wɔ nusiawo heɖo ŋunyɔ wo ɖokui,

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: eye woƒe anyigba gblẽ; eyata maɖo woƒe vodadawo teƒe na wo, eye anyigba la atu edzinɔlawo aƒu gbe.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: elabena anyigbadzitɔ, siwo nɔ mia ŋgɔ la, wɔ ŋunyɔnu siawo katã, eye anyigba la gblẽ;

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: ne anyigba la nagatu miawo hã aƒu gbe, le esi miegblẽe ta, abe alesi wòtu dukɔ, si nɔ mia ŋgɔ la, ƒu gbe ene o.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Eyata milé ŋku ɖe nye ɖoɖoawo ŋu, bena miagawɔ kɔnu gbegblẽ, siwo wowɔ le mia ŋgɔ la, ahado ŋunyɔ mia ɖokui o Nyee Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel ƒe ha blibo la, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ame kɔkɔewo mianye, elabena nye Yehowa, mia Mawu la, mele kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Migayi legbawo gbɔ o, eye migakɔ mawuwo na mia ɖokui o. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Ne miesa akpedavɔ na Yehowa la, miwɔe ale be, miadze eŋu.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Miaɖui le gbesigbe miewui kple ŋkeke, si dze eyome dzi; ke woatɔ dzo esi tsi anyi vaseɖe ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Ke ne woɖui le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la, ezu ŋunyɔnu, eye womaxɔe o.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖui la, eƒe vodada le edzi, elabena egblẽ kɔ ɖo na Yehowa ƒe nu kɔkɔe la, eye woatsrɔ̃ ame la ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Ne mieŋe nukuwo le miaƒe agble me la, ekema megaŋe wo vaseɖe boto ke o, eye megafɔ nusiwo dudu la o.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Megaxa wò weingblemenuwo ƒiaƒiaƒia o, eye megafɔ tsetse, siwo dudu ɖe anyi hã o: ke boŋ gblẽ wo ɖi na ame dahewo kple amedzrowo. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Migafi fi o, migasẽ nu o, eye amea ɖeke megable nɔvia o.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Migaka aʋatso yɔ nye ŋkɔ ta nui o, bena nagaƒo ɖi wò Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ o. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Megate hawòvi ɖe anyi o, eye megada adzoe o. Megana agbatedɔwɔla ƒe fetu natsi gbɔwò ŋu nake ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Megaɖe alɔme le mumuitɔ ŋu o, eye megada nu ɖe ŋkuagbãtɔ ŋgɔ, be wòakli o, ke boŋ vɔ̃ wò Mawu la. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Migawɔ apasa le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me o. Mígade ame dahe dzi o, eye migakpɔ amegãwo ŋku me o; ke boŋ mídrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mia nɔewo ɖe teƒe.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Meganye sakplitɔ nɔ yiyim le wò dukɔ me viwo dome o; eye megaka ɖe dzi, be woatso kufia na hawòvi o. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Megalé nɔviwò ɖe do me o, ke boŋ gbe nya nɛ, ne magana nahe nuvɔ̃ ava ɖokuiwò dzi o.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Megawɔ wɔɖenui o, eye megalé dɔmedzoe, si wò dukɔ me viwo do na wò la, ɖi o; ke boŋ nalɔ̃ hawòvi abe ɖokuiwò ene. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Milé ŋku ɖe nye ɖoɖoawo ŋu. Megana wò lã ƒomevi vovovowo natsaka ayɔ asi wo nɔewo o; megaƒã nuku ƒomevi vovovowo ɖe wò agble me o, eye megata avɔ, si wotsɔ lãfu kple ɖeti tsaka lɔ̃e la o.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe mlɔ nyɔnua ɖe gbɔ, eye wòɖe asi eŋu, eye nyɔnu la nye kosi, si womexɔ kple ga o, eye womèna ablɔɖee hã o, gake wotsɔe na ŋutsua ɖe la, ekema tohehe dze nya la me; gake womawu wo o, elabena womèna ablɔɖee o.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla natsɔ fɔɖivɔsagbo lã alé avu nɛ le Yehowa ŋku me, le eƒe nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la ta; ekema woatsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la, akee.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Ne mieva anyigba la dzi, eye mieɖo ati vovovowo, siwo ƒe tsetse woɖuna la, ekema mibu woƒe tsetse abe bolobolotɔwo ene. Ƒe atɔ̃ sɔŋ miabu wo abe bolobolotɔwo ene, eye miaɖu wo o.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Le ƒe enelia me la woƒe tsetsewo katã ŋu ko, bena woatso akafu Yehowa.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ke le ƒe atɔ̃lia me miekpɔ mɔ aɖu woƒe tsetsewo, bena woatse ɖe dzi na mi geɖe. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Migaɖu nusi me ʋu le o. Migaka afã o, eye migasa dzo o.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Ne ame ku la, migasi blini ɖe ŋuti o, eye migatá nu ɖe ŋuti hã o. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: Megagblẽ viwònyɔnu, eye naɖoe ɖe ahasigbe o, bena anyigba la nagazu gbolonyigba, eye ŋukpenanuwo nanɔ edzi o.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nye dzudzɔgbewo dzi, eye vɔvɔ̃ nanɔ nye kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu na mi. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Migayi ŋɔliyɔlawo gbɔ o, eye migabia nu le bokɔnɔwo gbɔ o, bena miagaƒo ɖi o. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Amegã ta ɣi ŋku me nanɔ tsitre ɖo, eye bu amegã ɖeɖi la, eye navɔ̃ wò Mawu la. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Ne amedzroa ɖe dze gbɔwò le wò anyigba dzi la, migatee ɖe anyi o.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Amedzro nanɔ mia gbɔ abe duamevi ene, eye nalɔ̃e abe ɖokuiwò ene; elabena miawo hã míenye amedzrowo kpɔ le Egipte-nyigba dzi. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Nudanu nyui kple nudakpe nyuiwo, efa blibo kple hin blibo nanɔ mia si. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu, si kplɔ mi tso Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Ne Israel-viwo dometɔa ɖe alo amedzro, si le Israel la, tsɔ via na Molex la, woawui, anyigbadzitɔwo naƒu kpee woaku.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Maɖe ŋku atɔ ame la, eye matsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la dome, elabena etsɔ via na Molex, bena wòado ŋunyɔ nye kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wòaƒo ɖi nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Ke ne anyigbadzitɔwo miã ŋku ɖe amesi tsɔ via na Molex la dzi, eye womewui o la,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: ekema nye ŋku anɔ ame la kple eƒomeawo ŋu, eye matsrɔ̃ ame la kple amesiwo katã dze eyome hesubɔ Molex la, le woƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe yi ŋɔliyɔlawo kple bokɔnɔwo gbɔ, eye wòdze wo yome la, maɖe ŋku atɔ ame la, eye matsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Eyata miwɔ mia ɖokui kɔkɔe, eye mianɔ kɔkɔe, elabena nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Milé ŋku ɖe nye ɖoɖoawo ŋu, eye miawo wo dzi, elabena nyee nye Yehowa, si ko mia ŋu.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ƒo fi de fofoa alo dada la, woawui, elabena fofoa alo dadae wòƒo fi de; eya ŋutɔe ɖe hlɔ̃fe.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wo ahasi kple ŋutsua ɖe srɔ̃ la, ekema ewo ahasi kple ehavi srɔ̃, eye ele be, woawu ŋutsu la kple nyɔnu la siaa.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe do fofoa srɔ̃ gbɔ la, ekema eɖe fofoa ƒe ama ɖe go; ele be, woawu wo kple eve la, woa ŋutɔwoe ɖe hlɔ̃fe.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe dɔ viaŋutsu srɔ̃ gbɔ la, woawu wo kple eve la; elabena ŋukpenanu vɔ̃ɖi wowɔ, eye woa ŋutɔwoe ɖe hlɔ̃fe.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe do ŋutsu gbɔ, abe alesi wodɔa nyɔnu gbɔe ene la, ekema woa kple eve wowɔ ŋunyɔnu; ele be, woawu wo, woa ŋutɔwoe ɖe hlɔ̃fe.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe ɖe nyɔnua ɖe kple dada siaa la, ŋukpenanu wònye, ele be, woatɔ dzo ŋutsu la kple nyɔnuawo, bena ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ maganɔ mia dome o.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Eye ne nyɔnua ɖe na lãa ɖe yɔ asii la, ekema woaƒo nyɔnu la kple lã la woaku; ele be, woawu wo, elabena woa ŋutɔwoe ɖe hlɔ̃fe

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖe nɔvianyɔnu, si nye fofo via alo dada via, eye wòkpɔ eƒe ama, eye nyɔnu la hã kpɔ eƒe ama la, ekema ŋukpenanu wònye, eye woatsrɔ̃ wo le woƒe dukɔ me viwo dome, elabena eɖe nɔvianyɔnu ƒe ama ɖe go, eye fɔɖiɖi la le edzi.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe dɔ nyɔnua ɖe, si kpɔ dzinu gbɔ, eye wòɖe eƒe ama, si me ʋu le dodom le, ɖe go la, ekema woatsrɔ̃ woa kple eve la ɖa le woƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖe asi dada nɔvinyɔnu alo fofoa nɔvinyɔnu ŋu la, eɖe eƒe ƒometɔ kekeake ƒe ama ɖe go, eye fɔɖiɖi la le wo dzi.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe do fofoa nɔviŋutsu srɔ̃ gbɔ la, ekema ede fofoa nɔviŋutsu ƒe ama de go; woƒe nuvɔ̃ la le wo dzi, eye woatsi ko vaseɖe woƒe ku me.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖe nɔviaŋutsu srɔ̃ la, ŋunyɔnu wònye; eya ŋuta nɔviaŋutsu ƒe ama wòɖe ɖe go, eye woatsi ko.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Eyata milé ŋku ɖe nye ɖoɖoawo katã kple nye seawo katã ŋu, bena anyigba, si dzi mekplɔ mi yinae, be miana edzi la, nagatu mi aƒu gbe o.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Migawɔ dukɔ, si nyã ge mala le mia ŋgɔ la, ƒe kɔnuwo o; elabena nusiawo katã wowɔ, eyata wonyã ŋu nam.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ na mi bena: Mixɔ woƒe anyigba la wòanye mia tɔ, eye matsɔ anyigba, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la, ana mi wòazu mia tɔ. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu, si tia mi tso dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Eyata miɖe vovo lã, siwo ŋu kɔ, kple esiwo ŋu mekɔ o, xe, siwo ŋu mekɔ o, kple esiwo ŋu kɔ la dome, eye migawɔ lãwo kple xewo kpakple anyigba dzi nu gbagbewo, siwo megblɔ be, wo ŋu mekɔ o la, ŋu dɔ ahado ŋunyɔ mia ɖokui o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Mínye ame kɔkɔewo nam, elabena nye Yehowa la kɔkɔetɔ menye, eye metia mi tso dukɔwo dome, bena mianye tɔnye.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu alo nyɔnua ɖe nye ŋɔliyɔla alo bokɔnɔ la, ekema woawu wo; woaƒu kpewo woaku, elabena woa ŋutɔwoe de hlɔ̃fe.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Gblɔ na Aron viŋutsu, siwo nye nunɔlawo la bena: Nunɔlaa ɖeke megagblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui ɖe ame kuku ŋu le eƒe dukɔ la dome o;

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: kpakple nɔvianyɔnu, si nye ɖetugbi, eye wògogoe, eye ŋutsua ɖeke meɖee haɖe o la ene

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Ke megagblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui ɖe ame kukua ɖeke ŋu le eƒe dukɔ la dome, bena woaƒo ɖi eɖokui o.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Womegalũ dzodome kokoe o, womegafɔ woƒe ge dzi o, eye womegasi blini ɖe ŋuti o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Woanɔ kɔkɔe na woƒe Mawu, eye womaƒo ɖi woƒe Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ o, elabena woawoe sa Yehowa ƒe dzovɔ, si nye woƒe Mawu ƒe nuɖuɖu, eyata woanɔ kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Womekpɔ mɔ aɖe gbolo, nyɔnu, si gblẽ, alo nyɔnu, si srɔ̃ gbe o; elabena ame kɔkɔewo wonye na woƒe Mawu.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Bu nunɔlawo kɔkɔe, elabena woawoe tsɔa wò Mawu ƒe nuɖuɖu sa vɔe. Ame kɔkɔewo woanye na wò, elabena nye Yehowa, si kɔ mia ŋu la, mele kɔkɔe.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔlaa ɖe ƒe vinyɔnu gblẽ le ahasi wɔm la, ekema eƒo ɖi fofoa; ele be, woatɔ dzoe. Nuwɔametɔ maganɔ nunɔlawo dome o.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Ke amesi nye nunɔlagã le nɔviawo dome, amesi ƒe tame wokɔ ami sisi la ɖo, eye woɖoe, bena woaɖo awuawo la, mekpɔ mɔ akaka ɖa ɖe ta o, eye madze eƒe awuwo hã o.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: Eya mekpɔ mɔ ava ame kukua ɖeke gbɔ o, eye magblẽ kɔ ɖo ɖe fofoa alo ɖada ŋu gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Mado go le kɔkɔeƒe la o, bena magagblẽ kɔ ɖo na eƒe Mawu ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la o, elabena eƒe Mawu ƒe ami sisi kɔkɔe le eŋu Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔ aɖe ahosi alo nyɔnu, si gbe atsu, nyɔnu, si gblẽ, alo gbolo o: ke boŋ ɖetugbi wòaɖe tso eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome;

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: bena viawo nagaɖi gbɔ le eƒe dukɔ me viwo dome o. Nyee nye Yehowa, si kɔ eŋu!

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Nuwɔametɔa ɖeke megate va o, eɖanye ŋkuagbãtɔ alo xɔdrɔ̃ o, eɖanye ŋɔtiagbãtɔ alo amesi ƒe ŋutinua ɖe le blaya o,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: eɖanye ataŋeŋetɔ alo abɔŋeŋetɔ o,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: eɖanye kponɔ alo amesi ɖi ku glaŋ o, eɖanye amesi atɔsi le ŋku dzi na alo amesi dze akpa o, eɖanye amesi dze haƒla alo amesi ɖo vo o.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Ɖeko mekpɔ mɔ ava xɔmetsovɔ la gbɔ o, eye mekpɔ mɔ ate ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu o, elabena nuwɔametɔ wònye, bena magaƒo ɖi nye teƒe kɔkɔeawo o; elabena nye Yehowa ŋutɔe kɔ wo ŋu.

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye Mose ƒo nu kple Aron kple viaŋutsuwo kpakple Israel-viwo katã.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eve Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Aron kple viaŋutsuawo bena, woakpɔ nyuie le Israel-viwo ƒe nu kɔkɔe, siwo ŋu wokɔ nam la ŋu, bena womaga ƒo ɖi nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la o. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo bena: Ne mia viwo alo miaƒe dzidzimeviwo dometɔa ɖe ŋu mekɔ o, eye wote ɖe nunana kɔkɔe, siwo ŋu Israel-viwo kɔ na Yehowa ŋuti la, ekema woatsrɔ̃ ame la ɖa le nye ŋku ta. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Ne Aron viwo dometɔa ɖe dze anyi alo le atu ɖɔm la, mekpɔ mɔ aɖu nunana kɔkɔe la ɖeke o, vaseɖe esime eŋu nakɔ hafi. Ne amea ɖe ka asi amesi gblẽ kɔ ɖo ɖe ame kuku ŋu, alo amesi nyẽ tsi ŋuti,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: alo amea ɖe ka asi nu gbagbea ɖe, si ŋu mekɔ o la ŋuti, alo ka asi amea ɖe, si ŋu mekɔ o, alo nu makɔmakɔ bubua ɖe ŋuti la,

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ɣe ɖo to la, ekema eŋu kɔ, emegbe ekpɔ mɔ aɖu nunana kɔkɔe la, elabena eƒe nuɖuɖu wònye.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔ aɖu lã kuku alo lã, si nu lé o, ava gblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Woalé ŋku ɖe nye ɖoɖoawo ŋu bena womagagblẽ kɔ ɖo, eye nuvɔ̃ nanɔ wo dzi woaku o. Nyee nye Yehowa, si kɔ wo ŋu!

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: Amedzroa ɖeke mekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu kɔkɔe la o, eye amedzro, si le agbatedɔ wɔm na nunɔla la, mekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu kɔkɔe la o.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla ƒle amea ɖe kple ga la, ekema ame la kpɔ mɔ aɖu nu kɔkɔe la, eye amesi wodzi ɖe eƒe me hã kpɔ mɔ aɖu eƒe nuɖuɖu la.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla ƒe vinyɔnu ɖe to bubu me tɔa ɖe la, mekpɔ ma aɖu nunana kɔkɔe, si nye adzo la o.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Ke ne nunɔla ƒe vinyɔnu zu ahosi, alo wogbee, eye vi mele esi o, eye wòtrɔ va le fofoa ƒe me, abe alesi wònɔe le eƒe ɖetugbime ene la, ekpa mo aɖu fofoa ƒe nuɖuɖu la, ɖeko to bubu me toa ɖeke mekpɔ mɔ aɖui o.

english_verse: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖe ŋu ɖu nu kɔkɔea la, ekema woaɖo nu kɔkɔe la teƒe na nunɔla, eye wòatsɔ nu la ƒe mamã atɔ̃lia akpe ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Migatso lã, si nu wo la, sa vɔe o; elabena mana miaƒe nu nadze eŋu o.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye womegagblẽ kɔ ɖo na Israel-viwo ƒe nunana kɔkɔe, si wodzo na Yehowa la o.

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: Eye womegana woaɖu woƒe nunana kokoe la, aɖa vo, eye woƒe fɔɖiɖi la nanɔ wo dzi o. Nyee nye Yehowa, si ko wo ŋu! Vodada maganɔ vɔsawo ŋu o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Aron kple viaŋutsuwo kpakple Israel-viwo katã, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ne Israeltɔa ɖe alo amedzro, si le Israel be, yeasa numevɔ, eɖanye adzɔgbe wòɖe hafi, alo eɖokui si wòna nu Yehowa le o la,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖe adzɔgbe, alo le eɖokui si wòbe, yeasa akpedavɔ na Yehowa la, ekema wòatsɔ nyi alo alẽ, si so blibo, eye nu mewɔ afia ɖeke nɛ o, bena ame la ƒe nu nadze eŋu.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖokuiwò si nèbe, yeana nu le la, ekema èkpɔ mɔ ana nyi alo alẽ, si ŋutinua ɖe didi gbɔ me alo to ɖe me; ke nenye adzɔgbee neɖe la, womaxɔe o.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Migaƒle wo le amedzrowo si o, eye miekpɔ mo atso wo tɔgbe awɔ nuɖuɖu na miaƒe Mawu o, elabena nu wo wo, eye wo ŋuti mesɔ o; womaxɔ wo na mi o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: Ne wodzi nyi, alẽ alo gbɔ̃via ɖe la, wòanɔ ɖada gbɔ ŋkeke adre; ke ne exɔ ŋkeke enyi alo wu nenema, eye wotsɔe sa dzovɔ na Yehowa la, woaxɔe.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mo awu nyi alo alẽ kple via siaa gbe ɖeka o.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Ne miesa kafukafuvɔ na Yehowa la, miwɔe ale be, wòadze eŋu.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Gbemagbe ke woaɖui, eye migasusɔ ɖeke ɖi ŋu nake ɖe edzi o. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Eyata milé ŋku ɖe nye seawo ŋu, eye miawo wo dzi. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ade miawo ɖo, ke ŋkeke adrelia enye dzudzɔgbe blibo kple takpegbe kɔkɔe; miawɔ dɔa ɖeke o, elabena dzudzɔgbe wònye na Yehowa le mia nɔƒewo katã. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Miawɔ dɔa ɖeke le ŋkeke sia dzi o, elabena avulégbee, bena woalé avu na mi le Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋku me.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adre sɔŋ miasa dzovɔ na Yehowa, eye ŋkeke adreagbe enye takpegbe kokoe, miawɔ asinudɔa ɖeke o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ne mieva anyigba, si matso na mi dzi, eye mieŋe nu le edzi la, ekema miatsɔ lubabla gbãtɔwo avae na nunɔla.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Miatsɔ wɔ memee eta ƒe mamã ewoliawo eve, si wodzaba kple ami awɔ nuɖuvɔsa, si woatɔ dzoe na Yehowa, be wòaʋẽ lilili, hekpe de nunovɔsa wein hin ƒe mamã eneliawo ɖeka ŋu.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Ke miekpɔ mɔ aɖu abolo, bli tɔtɔe alo blitimu o, vaseɖe gbesigbe miasa vɔ na mia Mawu. Ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na mi kple miaƒe dzidzimeviwo le mia nɔƒewo katã. Pentekoste.

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Miawɔ dɔa ɖeke o, ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na miaƒe dzidzimeviwo le mia nɔƒewo katã.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Emegbe miabu kwasiɖa dedie adre tso ŋkeke, si dze dzudzɔgbe yome la dzi, gbesigbe mienyã lubablawo;

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ wɔ memee efa ƒe mamã ewoliawo eve ƒe abolo ʋaʋã eve atsɔ tso mia nɔƒewo katã vɛ, woanye nu gbãtɔwo na Yehowa, be woanyèe.
