english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Eye miatsɔ alẽvi adre, siwo naneke mewo afia ɖeke na o, eye woxɔ ƒe ɖekaɖeka, nyitsuvi ɖeka kple agbo eve asa numevɔe na Yehowa, eye miatsɔ nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa akpe ɖe wo ŋu awɔ dzovɔsa, si nena lilili ɖe Yehowa.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Eyome miatsɔ gbɔ̃tsu ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔe, eye miatsɔ alẽvi eve, siwo xɔ ƒe ɖekaɖeka, asa akpedavɔe.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla nanyè nu gbãtɔwo ƒe aboloawo akpe ɖe alẽvi eveawo ŋu le Yehowa ŋku me; nu kɔkɔewo wonye na Yehowa hena nunɔla.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ma dzi miaɖe gbe ƒã bena, takpegbe kɔkɔe wònye na mi, miekpɔ mɔ awɔ asinudɔa ɖeke o. Ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na miaƒe dzidzimeviwo le mia nɔƒewo katã.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Ne mieŋe nu le miaƒe anyigba dzi la, migaŋe nukuawo vaseɖe boto ke o, eye migafɔ nusiwo dudu de anyi o; ke boŋ migblẽ wo di na ame dahewo kple amedzrowo. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu! Ƒe yeye.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: Ɣleti adrelia sia ƒe ŋkeke ewolia enye avulégbe, takpegbe kɔkɔe wònye na mi, míatsi nu adɔ, eye miasa dzovɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Dzudzɔgbe blibo wòanye na mi, eye míatsi nu adɔ. Tso fiẽ vaseɖe fiẽ miaɖu dzudzɔgbe sia, tso ɣleti la ƒe ŋkeke asiekelia ƒe fiẽ. Agbadɔxɔwo me nanɔ.

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi miatsɔ atikutsetse nyuitɔwo, eye mialã ɖeʋayawo, ati, siwo ƒe aŋgbawo ɖo, ƒe alɔwo kple amuti ƒe alɔwo, eye miakpɔ dzidzɔ le Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋku me ŋkeke adre sɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Tso ɣleti adrelia sia ƒe ŋkeke wuiatɔ̃lia dzi miaɖu agbadɔŋkekenyuie ŋkeke adre sɔŋ na Yehowa.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adre miasa dzovɔ na Yehowa. Ŋkeke enyilia nanye takpegbe kɔkɔe na mi, eye miasa dzovɔ na Yehowa; takpegbe wònye, miawɔ asinudɔa ɖeke o.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: Esiawo nye Yehowa ƒe ŋkekenyuie, siwo miade gbe ƒãe be takpegbe kɔkɔewo, eye miasa dzovɔ na Yehowa, numevɔ, nuɖuvɔ, akpedavɔ kple nunovɔ; ŋkeke sia ŋkeke kple etɔ,

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: hekpe de Yehowa ƒe dzudzɔgbewo, miaƒe nunanawo, miaƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖewo katã kple nusiwo katã miana le mia dokui si hena Yehowa la ŋuti.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Ne mieƒo anyigba dzi nu ʋaʋãwo nu ƒu la, ekema miaɖu Yehowa ƒe ŋkekenyuie la, le ɣleti adrelia ƒe ŋkeke wuiatɔ̃lia dzi, ŋkeke adre sɔŋ; ŋkeke gbãtɔ nanye dzudzɔgbe, eye ŋkeke enyilia hã nanye dzudzɔgbe.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Eye miaɖui wòanye ŋkekenyuie na Yehowa ŋkeke adre sɔŋ le ƒe ɖeka me. Ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na miaƒe dzidzimeviwo, ɣleti adrelia me miaɖui.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Mianɔ agbadɔwo me ŋkeke adre sɔŋ, Israeltɔwo katã nana agbadɔwo me,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: bena miaƒe dzidzimeviwo nanyae bena, esi mekplɔ Israel-viwo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, mena wono agbadɔwo me, nye Yehowa, mia Mawu.

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkekenyuieawo na Israel-viwo.

english_verse: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth.
translation_verse: nuveviwɔame ɖe nuveviwɔame teƒe, ŋku ɖe ŋku teƒe, aɖu ɖe aɖu teƒe; alesi wòwɔ nu vevi amea ɖee la, nenema ke woawɔ eya hãe.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒo lã wòku la, woaɖo eteƒe; ke amesi ƒo ame woku la, woawu eya hã.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: De se na Israel-viwo be, woatsɔ dzomi nyuitɔ vɛ, bena woate ŋu atso akaɖigbɛawo aɖo ati dzi ɖaa.

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ wɔ memee aƒo abolo wuieve; wɔ efa ƒe mamã ewoliawo eve naƒo abolo ɖeka,

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: eye naɖo wo ɖe agbaka eve me ɖe sikakplɔ̃ la dzi le Yehowa ŋku me; agbaka ɖeka nanye wo ame aɖe.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Eye nada dzudzɔ donu ɖe agbakawo dzi, eya nanye nu ʋeʋẽe anɔ abolo la ŋu, woawo Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsae.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Wòa ɖoe Yehowa ŋku me ɖaa dzudzɔ gbe sia dzudzɔgbe; ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na Israel-viwo.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Woanye Aron kple viaŋutsuawo to, eye woaɖui le teƒe kɔkɔe la, elabena nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye nɛ tso Yehowa ƒe vɔsa la me; ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye. Woƒu kpe busunyagblɔta.

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Eye Israel-nyɔnu la ƒe viŋutsu la ƒo ti de ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la, eye wòdo ɖiŋu nɛ; tete wokplɔe va Mose gbɔe. Dada ŋkɔ nye Selomit, amesi nye Dibri vinyɔnu, tso Dan-to la me.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Eye wolée da ɖi, vaseɖe esime woadi nyaa ɖe ato na wo, alesi Yehowa agblɔ.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena:

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: Kplɔ ɖiŋudola la yi asaɖa la godo, eye amesiwo katã se nyaa, natsɔ woƒe asi aɖo eƒe tame, eye ha blibo la naƒu kpee woaku.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ƒo fi de Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ la, woawui; ha blibo la naƒu kpee wòaku, eɖanye amedzro alo duamevi o, ele be, woaku, elabena eƒo fi de ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la. Amewuwu kple abidede ame ŋu tohehe.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ƒo ame wòku la, woawui;

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: eye ne amea ɖe ƒo lã woku la, wòaɖo eteƒe, lã ɖe lã teƒe.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wo nu vevi nɔvia la, ekema woawɔ eya hã, abe alesi wòwɔe ke ene;

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Se ɖeka nanɔ mia si na amedzro kple duamevi siaa; elabena nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu.

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo; tete wokplɔ ɖiŋudola la do goe ɖe asaɖa godo, eye woƒu kpee woku. Eye Israel-viwo wɔ, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Aseyetsoƒe la ŋu naƒle nu le nɔviwò si ɖo, eye ƒe alesi nu naŋe nu la, ŋu wòadzrae na wò ɖo.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose le Sinai-to la dzi bena:

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Ƒe blaatɔ̃lia nanye aseyetsoƒe na mi, miaƒã nu o, eye míaŋe nusiwo mie ɖe flu me o, eye miaxa weintsetse le weinka, siwo ŋu mieɖe o la dzi o.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ne mieva anyigba, si matsɔ na mi dzi la, ekema anyigba la nagbɔ ɖe me na Yehowa.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Ke le ƒe adrelia me la anyigba la nagbɔ ɖe me na Yehowa, ma ƒã nu ɖe wò agble me o, eye màɖe wò weinkawo ŋu hã o.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Maŋe nusiwo mie ɖe flu me o, eye màxa weintsetse le weinka, siwo ŋu meɖe o la dzi o; ke boŋ anyigba la nagbɔ ɖe me le ƒe la me.

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: Etɔɖia alo etɔɖia ƒe viŋutsu alo eƒe ƒometɔ kekeake kpɔ mɔ axɔe, alo ne eya ŋutɔ kpɔ nu la, ate ŋu axɔ eɖokui.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Le ɣleti adrelia ƒe ŋkeke ewolia dzi woaku kpẽ atsae; le avulégbe la dzi woaku kpẽ atsa le miaƒe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Miakɔ ƒe blaatɔ̃lia ŋu, eye miaɖe gbe ƒã ablɔɖe le anyigba la dzi na anyigbadzitɔwo katã; aseyetsoƒe wòanye na mi, eye amesiame nagaxɔ eƒe nuwo, eye amesiame nagagbugbɔ ayi eƒe ƒometɔwo gbe.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Aseyetsoƒe wònye, eye eŋu nakɔ na mi; ke miekpɔ mɔ aɖu agblemenuawo.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: Le aseyetsoƒe sia me amesiame nagaxɔ eƒe nuwo.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Ƒe geɖe kple eƒe asi gã, eye ƒe ʋee kple eƒe asi bɔbɔe, elabena nuŋeɣiwo nu wòadzrae na wò ɖo.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Migatafa mia nɔewo o, ke boŋ navɔ̃ wò Mawu la; elabena nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: anyigba la awɔ nu, eye miakpɔ nu geɖe aɖu, eye mianɔ edzi dedie.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Ke ne miagblɔ be: Nuka ɖu ge míala le ƒe adrelia me, elabena miele nu ƒã ge o, eye miele miaƒe agblemenuwo hã ƒo ge ƒu o la,

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: mayra ɖe mia dzi le ƒe adelia me ale gbegbe be, miaƒe agblemenuwo nade ƒe etɔ̃ nu.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Ne míeƒã nu le ƒe enyilia me la, ekema mianɔ agblemenu xoxoawo ɖum ahade asi na ƒe asiekelia; nu xoxoawo miana ɖu-ɖum hafi agaŋe nu.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Womadzra anyigba wòatsi ame si ɖaa o, elabena tanyee nye anyigba la, eye miawo míenye amedzrowo kple gbɔnye mewo. Alesi woagbugbɔ ƒle nu dzadzrawo.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Eyata woagagbugbɔ anyigba axɔ le miaƒe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Ne nɔviwò ɖo ko, eye wòtsɔ eƒe nu dzra, eye eƒe ƒometɔ va, be wòagaxɔ nua la, ekema wòagaxɔ nusi nɔvia tso dzra la.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Ke ne exɔla mele ame la si o, gake eya ŋuta kpo nu wòsɔ gbɔ, ale bena woate ŋu axa eƒe nua la,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: ekema wòabu ƒe alesi nu wòdzra nu la, eye wòaxe fe kpɔtɔe na amesi wòdzra nu la na, eye wòagaxɔ eƒe nu la.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Gake ne mekpɔ nu wòde, alesi wòana nu o la, ekema nua natsi eƒlela gbɔ, vaseɖe esime aseyetsoƒe naɖo. Le aseyetsoƒea dzi la nu la ŋu vo, eye wòagaxɔ eƒe nu.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe dzra aƒea ɖe le ɖu, si ŋu woɖo gli ɖo me la, ekema ekpɔ mɔ agaxɔe vaseɖe ƒe, si me wòdzrae la, ƒe nuwuwu; ƒe ma me ko woate ŋu agaxɔe.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ke ne ƒe ɖeka la de, eye womexɔe o la, ekema aƒe, si le du, si ŋu woɖo gli ɖo me la, nazu eƒlela tɔ ɖikaa hena eƒe dzidzimeviwo, eye womaɖe asi le eŋu le aseyetsoƒe la dzi o.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ne womeɖo gli ɖe kɔƒea ɖe ŋu o la, ekema wòabu aƒe kple agbledenyigba katã ɖekae. Woate ŋu agaxɔe, eye woaɖe asi le eŋu le aseyetsoƒe la dzi.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Ke Lewitɔwo kpɔ mɔ axɔ aƒe, siwo le woƒe duwo me, le woƒe anyigba dzi la, ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke ne Lewitɔa ɖeke mexɔe o la, ekema woaɖe asi le aƒe, si wodzra le woawo ŋutɔ ƒe du me la, ŋuti le aseyetsoƒe la dzi; elabena Lewitɔwo ƒe duwo nye woawo ŋutɔ tɔ le Israel-viwo dome.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ke womadzra gbeɖuƒe, siwo le woƒe duwo ŋu la o; elabena woawo ŋutɔ tɔ wonye ɖikaa. Wogbe kasaɖiɖi kple anyrawɔwɔ le dɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Ne nu vɔ le nɔviwò si, eye wòdo ko la, ekema kpe ɖe eŋu, eye naxɔe abe amedzro alo gbɔwò me ene, bena wòanɔ agbe le gbɔwò.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Megado ga ne ɖe deme dzi o, eye: ne etsɔ nuɖuɖu ne la, megabia xɔɖedzi o.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu, si kplɔ mi tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, bena matsɔ Kanaan-nyigba na mi, eye manye miaƒe Mawu.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Ne nɔviwò ɖo ko, eye wòtsɔ eɖokui dzra na wò la, ekema megaɖe kluvidɔ asi ne o.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Nenɔ gbɔwò abe agbatedɔwɔla kple gbɔwò me ene, eye wòasubɔ wò vaseɖe aseyetsoƒe la dzi.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Emegbe woadzo le gbɔwò, eya ŋutɔ kple viawo siaa, eye wòagagbugbɔ va eƒe ƒometɔwo gbɔ, eye woaxɔ fofoawo ƒe domenyinu wo.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Nye dɔlawo wonye, amesiwo mekplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi; womadzra wo, abe alesi wodzra kluviwo ene o.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Megaɖu edzi kple sesẽ o, ke boŋ nayɔ wò Mawu la.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mo aƒle amedzro, siwo le mia dome la ƒe viwo kple woƒe dzidzimevi, siwo wodzi ɖe miaƒe anyigba dzi, eye wole mia dome la; woawo azu mia to.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Woawo anye miaƒe ame, eye mia viwo atso wo anyi domee, miekpɔ mɔ ade kluvidɔ asi na wo ɣesiaɣi. Ke migaɖu mia ŋutɔwo mia nɔvi Israel-viwo dzi kple sesẽ o.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Ne nu ɖo amedzro alo gbɔwò mea ɖe si, eye nɔviwò ɖo ko hetsɔ eɖokui dzra na amedzro alo gbɔwò me la alo woƒe dzidzimevia ɖe la,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: ne edzra eɖokui la, ekema se li, be woagaxɔe; nɔviawo dometɔ ɖeka kpɔ mɔ agaxɔe.

english_verse: by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Eya kple eƒlela nabu ƒe tso ƒe, si me wòdzra eɖokui nɛ la dzi vaseɖe aseyetsoƒe la dzi, eye eƒlefe la nanɔ ɖe ƒeawo ŋu; wòanɔ egbɔ abe agbatedɔwɔla ene.

english_verse: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.
translation_verse: Ke nenye ƒe ʋea ɖe koe susɔ, ne aseyetsoƒe naɖo la, ekema woabui nɛ; ƒeawo nu exɔfe la nanɔ ɖo.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Wòanɔ egbɔ ƒe sia ƒe abe agbatedɔwɔla ene, eye megazi kpi kpɔe be, woaɖu edzi kple sesẽ o.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ke ne womexɔe alea o la, ekema woaɖe asi le eya ŋutɔ kple viawo ŋu le aseyetsoƒe la dzi.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Elabena nye dɔlawo nye Israel-viwo, amesiwo mekplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi. Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu!

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nye dzudzɔgbewo dzi, eye vɔvɔ̃ nanɔ nye kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu na mi. Nyee nye Yehowa!

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: ekema mana tsi nadza na mi le edzaɣi, anyigba awɔ nu, eye agblemetiwo atse ku.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Mana anyigba dzi nata, miadɔ alɔ, eye amea ɖeke maɖo voɖi na mi o; manye lã wɔadãwo ɖa le miaƒe anyigba dzi, eye yi mato miaƒe anyigba dzi ayi o.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Mianya miaƒe futɔwo, eye woatsi miaƒe yi nu.

english_verse: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.
translation_verse: Mianɔ agblemenu xoxoawo ɖum, eye ne yeyea ɖo aƒe la, ekema ɖeko miaɖe xoxoawo ɖa.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Matrɔ ɖe mia ŋu, eye mana míadzi asɔ gbɔ, eye mawɔ nu, si mebia kpli mi la dzi.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Maɖo nye nɔƒe ɖe mia dome, eye nyemanyɔ ŋu mi o.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Mazɔ mia dome, eye manye miaƒe Mawu, eye miawo mianye nye dukɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu, si kplɔ mi tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, bena miaganye kluviwo na wo o; meŋe kɔkuti ɖa le kɔ dzi na mi, eye mievo le yiyim. Fiƒode gbɔgblɔɖi.

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: ne mieɖe nye ɖoɖoawo ɖa, mieɖo vlo nye seawo, eye miewɔ nye seawo katã dzi o, eye mietu nye nubabla la,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: ekema nye hã mawo nu siawo mi, eye vovɔ̃ alé mi: Kpetri kple asrã ana miaƒe ŋkutome anyẽ ɖe me, eye miagbɔdzɔ: yakatsyɔ miaƒã nukuwo, elabena miaƒe futɔwo ava ha wo.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Maɖe ŋku ata mi, miaƒe futɔwo asi mí, eye miaƒe adikãtɔwo aɖu mia dzi, eye ne amea ɖeke mele mia nyãm o hã, miade afa du me.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Ne nusiawo va tso, hafi miegaɖo tom o la, ekema mahe to na mi ɖe dzi zi adre le miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Maŋe miaƒe dada vivivo la nu, eye mana dziƒo nana na mi ate ga ene, eye miaƒe anyigba nana abe akɔbli ene.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Yakatsyɔ miawo do, ŋusẽ nava le mia ŋu, elabena anyigba mawɔ nu o, eye agblemetiwo matse ku o.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: Gake ne miaƒe nuwɔwɔwo gatsi tre ɖe ŋunye ko, eye miegbe toɖoɖom la, ekema magaɖe fu na mi de dzi zi adre le miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Maɖo lã wɔadãwo ɖe mia dome; eye woaɖe viwo le mia ŋu, eye woatsrɔ̃ miaƒe aƒemelãwo; miaƒe xexlẽme azu sue, eye miaƒe mowo ato gbe.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Maɖo yi de mia dome, bena woabia hiã de nubabla la ta, eye ne miesi aʋa yi de miaƒe duwo me la, ekema maɖo dɔvɔ̃ ɖe mia dome, eye matsɔ mi ade asi na miaƒe futɔwo.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Magblẽ abolo, si nye miaƒe agbe la dome, eye nyɔnu ewo aƒo abolo de kpo ɖeka me, eye woaxlẽ abolo de do nu na mi, eye miaɖui maɖi ƒo na mi o.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Eye miaɖu mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo ƒe lã.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Magbã miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, eye matutu miaƒe ɣelegbawo aƒu anyi, malɔ miaƒe ame kukuwo atrɔ ɖe miaƒe legba gbagbãwo dzi, eye miazu ŋunyɔnu nam.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Magbã miaƒe duwo woazu glikpo, eye mana miaƒe teƒe kɔkɔewo nazu aƒedo, eye miaƒe numemewo magaʋẽ ɖem lilili o.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Mana anyigba la nazu gbegbe, eye miaƒe futɔ, siwo le edzi la, ƒe mo awɔ yaa.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Maka mi ahlẽ ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye maɖi yi anɔ mia yomee, miaƒe anyigba azu gbegbe, eye miaƒe duwo azu glikpo.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Agba ɖe me le ɣeyiɣi, siwo katã me wònye gbegbe, elabena tso esime miele edzi la, megbɔ de me le miaƒe dzudzɔɣiwo me alea kpo o.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Mialɔ mia nɔewo aƒu anyi, abe alesi wotsia yi nu ene, wònye amea ɖeke mele mia nyãm o hafi, eye mianɔ te ɖe miaƒe futɔwo nu o.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Miatsrɔ̃ ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye miaƒe futɔwo ƒe anyigba ami mi.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye mia dometɔ kpɔtɔeawo atsrɔ̃ ɖe woƒe vodadawo me, le woƒe futɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi, eye woatsrɔ̃ le wo fofowo ƒe vodadawo ta abe woawo ke ene. Ne Israel-viwo trɔ dzim, la, woagaxɔ wo.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: eye nye hã metsi tre ɖe wo ŋu hekplɔ wo va woƒe futɔwo ƒe anyigba dzii la, me la, ne woƒe dzi masenuwo bɔbɔ, eye wokpɔ woƒe vodadawo tɔnua la,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: ekema mado ŋku nu, si mebia kple Yakob, Isak kple Abraham la dzi, eye maɖo ŋku anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Elabena esi wogblẽ anyigba la ɖi wòzu gbegbe la, ekpa gbɔdzɔe. Woakpɔ woƒe vodadawo tɔnua, elabena wogbe nye sewo, eye wodo vlo nye ɖoɖowo.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Ke ne wole woƒe futɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi la, nyemagbe wo o, eye nyemanyɔ ŋu wo o, nyematsrɔ̃ wo keŋ o, eye nyematu nye nubabla le mia kpli wo dome o, elabena nyee nye Yehowa, woƒe Mawu.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Le woƒe nyui didi ta maɖo ŋku nu, si mebia kple wo tɔgbuiwo, amesiwo mekplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi le dukɔwo ŋku me, bena manye woƒe Mawu la dzi; nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Esiawo nye ɖoɖowo, sewo kple mɔnufiamewo, siwo Yehowa ɖo eya ŋuta kple Israel-viwo dome, eye wòde asi na Mose le Sinai-to la dzi.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ne amea ɖe tsɔ ame ɖe adzɔgbee na Yehowa la, ekema nado asi ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Ne ame la xɔ ƒe blaade kple vɔ la, ekema ŋutsu ƒe asi nanye sekel wuiatɔ̃, eye nyɔnu to nanye sekel ewo.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Anyigba dzi nuwo katã ƒe mamã ewoliawo ɖeka nye Yehowa to, eɖanye agblemenuwo alo kutsetsewo o, nu kɔkɔewo wonye na Yehowa.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔ aɖo lii alo atsɔ lã nyui aɖuɖɔ manyomanyoa alo atsɔ manyomanyoa aɖo li nyuia o; ke ne eɖuɖɔe la, ekema esi wotsɔ ɖuɖɔe kple esi wòɖuɖɔ la, wole kɔkɔe.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame la da ahe, eye mate ŋu ana ho la o la, ekema nakplɔe ayi nunɔla gbɔ, eye nunɔla nado asi nɛ ɖe nusi le esi la nu.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: Nenye lã, siwo wotsɔna saa vɔ na Yehowa la, dometɔa ɖe wònye la, ekema ɖesiaɖe, si wotsɔ na Yehowa la, nanɔ kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Ke nenye lã makɔmakɔ, siwo wometsɔna saa va na Yehowa o la, dometɔa ɖee wònye la, ekema woakplɔ lã la ava nunɔla gbɔe.

english_verse: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Ke ne ebe, yeagaxɔe kple ga la, ekema wòatsɔ asi, si nedo ɖe eŋu la, ƒe mamã atɔ̃liawo ɖeka aƒu dzi.

english_verse: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe kɔ eƒe xɔ ŋu na Yehowa la, ekema nunɔla nado asi ɖe eƒe nyonyome alo manyomanyome ŋu, eye alesi nunɔla do asi lae la, nenema wòaxe.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ko eƒe agble, si wotsɔ nyi domee la, ƒe akpaa ɖe ŋu na Yehowa la, ekema nado asi ɖe ŋu le nuku, si woaƒã ɖe eme la nu; ne woaƒã lu gomer ɖeka ɖe eme la, ekema asi la nye klosalo sekel blaatɔ̃.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Ne ekɔ eƒe agble ŋu tso aseyetsoƒe dzi la, ekema alesi nado asi lae la, nenema wòaxe.

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ke ne aseyetsoƒe va yi, hafi wòkɔ eƒe agble ŋu la, ekema nunɔla nabu fe la nɛ ɖe ƒe, siwo susɔ, hafi aseyetsoƒe nagaɖo la ŋu, eye naɖe asi, si nèdo la dzi.

english_verse: If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional
translation_verse: Ke ne amesi kɔ eŋu be, yeagaxɔ agble la kple ga la, ekema wòatsɔ asi, si nedo ɖe eŋu la, ƒe mamã atɔ̃liawo ɖeka aƒu dzi, emegbe ezu etɔ.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: ke ne agble la ŋu vo le aseyetsoƒe dzi la, ekem tɔ megale enu o, eŋu kɔ na Yehowa, eye woazu nunɔla ƒe domenyinu.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe kɔ agble, si wòƒle, ŋu na Yehowa, eye menye eƒe domenyinu wònye o la,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: ekema nunɔla nabu asi la nɛ vaseɖe aseyetsoƒe dzi, eye wòaxe fe la gbemagbe, eye ga la ŋu kɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Ke amesi ƒe domenyinu wònye, amesi si wòƒlee le la, nagagbugbɔ agble la axɔ le aseyetsoƒe la dzi.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nado asiawo katã ɖe sekel kɔkɔe la ŋu, gera blave nanye sekel ɖeka.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖeke mekpɔ mɔ akɔ lãwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo ŋu na Yehowa o, eɖanye nyi alo alẽ o, Yehowa tɔ wònye.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe ko eƒe nua ɖe ŋu hetsɔ ɖe adzɔgbe na Yehowa ɖikaa, eɖanye ame, lã alo agble, si wotso nyi domee o la, womadzrae o, eye womaxɔe kple ga hã o, elabena nusianu, si wotsɔ ɖe adzɔgbe ɖikaa la, nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye na Yehowa.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ne wodo busu amea ɖe la, womaxɔe kple ga o, boŋ woawui.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe be, yeaxe fe ɖe eƒe nuwo ƒe mamã ewoliawo ɖeka ta la, ekema woatso home la ƒe mamã atɔ̃liawo ɖeka aƒu edzi.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Lã, siwo katã lãkplɔvi xlẽna kple eƒe ati la, dometɔ ewoliawo ŋu ko na Yehowa, eɖanye nyi alo ale o.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Womadzro eme be, lã la nyo loo alo menyo o, eye womada lu hã o Ke ne woɖo lii la, ekema esi wotso ɖo lii kple esi woɖo lii la, wole kɔkɔe, eye womaxɔ wo kple ga o.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Esiawo nye se, siwo Yehowa gblɔ na Mose le Sinai-to la dzi, be woade na Israel-viwo.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Esi woʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ƒe eve megbe la, Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose le ɣleti evelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, le Sinai-gbedzi bena:

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: Mia kple Aron mina Israeltɔ, siwo xɔ ƒe blave kple va, eye woate ŋu ade aʋa la, xlẽ hamehame.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron tia ŋutsu, siwo ŋkɔ woyɔ,

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: eye woƒo ha blibo la nu ƒu le ɣleti evelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi, eye wode amesiwo xɔ ƒe blave kple vo la, ƒe ŋkɔwo dzidzimegbalẽ me ɖekaɖeka le woƒe ƒomewo kple wo fofowo ƒe aƒewo nu,

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-viwo wɔ, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: ke Lewitɔwo naƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe nɔƒe, si me se la le, ŋuti godoo ava kpe, bena dɔmedzoe magabi ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ha la ŋu o. Eyata Lewitɔwo nalé ŋku ɖe nɔƒe, si me sea le la, ŋuti ɖoɖoawo ŋu.

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Ke womexlẽ Lewitɔwo fofo ƒe to kpe ɖe wo ŋu o. Woaɖe Lewitɔwo ɖe vovo.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Megatia amewo xlẽ le Lewi-to la me o, eye megatsɔ woƒe xexlẽme kpe ɖe Israel-vi bubuawo tɔ ŋu o;

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Israel-vi bubuawo naƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe woƒe teƒewo le woƒe aflagawo gbɔ hamehame;

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose kple Aron bena:

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: Israel-viwo naƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe woƒe aflaga, si nye wo fofowo ƒe to ƒe dzesi la gbɔ; woaƒu asaɖa anyi aƒo xlã Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la godoo va kpe.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blaatɔ̃ vɔ ene alafa ene.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe, aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blaatɔ̃ vo adre alafa ene.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blaatɔ̃ vɔ asieke alafa etɔ̃.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blane vɔ atɔ̃ alafa ade blaatɔ̃.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Emegbe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple Lewitɔwo ƒe asaɖa, si le asaɖa bubuawo titina la, naho. Alesi woƒu asaɖa anyii la, nenema ŋu woaho ɖo; amesiame nanɔ eteƒe le eƒe aflaga gbɔ.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blaetɔ̃ vɔ eve alafa eve.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Esiawo nye amesiwo wotia xlẽ le Israel-viwo dome le wo fofowo ƒe aƒewo nu Aʋawɔla, siwo katã le asaɖa me hamehame la, le ame akpe alafa ade kple etɔ alafa atɔ blaatɔ̃.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blaetɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃ alafa ene.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blane vɔ ɖeke alafa atɔ̃

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aʋawɔlawo le ame akpe blaatɔ̃ vɔ etɔ̃ alafa ene.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ke wometia Lewitɔwo xlẽ kpe ɖe Israel-vi bubua wo ŋu o, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-viwo wɔ, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene. Alesi woƒo asaɖa anyi la, nenema ŋu woho ɖo, amesiame kple eƒe ƒome le wo fofowo ƒe aƒewo nu?

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Aron viŋutsuwo ƒe ŋkɔwo nye si: Eƒe ŋgɔgbevi Nadab, eyome Abihu, Eleazar kple Itamar.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Ke Nadab kple Abihu ku le Yehowa ŋku me, esime wotsɔ dzo bubu va Yehowa ŋku me le Sinai-gbedzi; ke viŋutsu mele wo si o, eye Eleazar kple Itamar zu nunɔlawo kpe ɖe wo fofo Aron ŋu. Lewitɔwo ƒe dɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: They are assigned to help Aaron and his sons,
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ Lewitɔwo ade asi na Aron kple viaŋutsuwo, etɔ woanye blibo le Israel-viwo dome.

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Eye naɖo Aron kple viaŋutsuwo, be woawɔ nunɔladɔ; ke ne ame tutɔa ɖe le va la, woawui.

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose le Sinai-gbedzi bena:

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: Tia Lewitɔwo xlẽ le wo fofowo ƒe aƒewo kple woƒe ƒomeawo nu; ŋutsuvi, siwo katã xɔ dzinu ɖeka alo wu nenema la, natia axlẽ.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Lewi-viwo ƒe ŋkɔwo nye si: Gerson, Kehat kple Merari.

english_verse: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gerson-viwo ƒe ŋkɔwo nye si le woƒe ƒomewo nu: Libni kple Simei.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kehat-viwo nye si le woƒe ƒomewo nu: Amram, Yizhar, Xebron kple Uziel.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Eye Merari viwo nye si le woƒe ƒomewo nu: Maxeli kple Musi. Esiawo nye Lewitɔwo ƒe ƒome le wo fofowo ƒe aƒewo nu.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gerson-hawo nye: Libni-viwo ƒe ƒome kple Simei-viwo ƒe ƒome. Woawo nye Gerson ƒomeawo.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Dɔ, siwo le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu na Gerson-viwo wonye: Woakpɔ nɔƒe la, etamevɔ kple edzigbanuwo kpakple Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu vɔ,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: kpɔ, si ƒo xlã nɔƒe la kple vɔsamlekpui la godoo va kpe, eŋuti vɔwo, agbadɔ ŋu kawo kple eŋu nu bubuawo kpakple kpɔnuvɔ la dzi.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kehat-hawo nye. Amram-viwo ƒe ƒome, Yizhar-viwo ƒe ƒome, Xebron-viwo ƒe ƒome kple Uziel-viwo ƒe ƒome. Woawo nye Kehat ƒomeawo.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Woƒe dɔe nye be, woakpɔ aɖaka la kple kplɔ la, akaɖiti la, vɔsamlekpuiwo kple kɔkɔeƒe la me nuwo kpakple xɔmetsovɔ la kple nu bubuawo dzi.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Lewitɔwo ƒe amegã ƒe tatɔ enye Eleazar, nunɔla Aron ƒe vi, eƒe dɔe nye be, wòakpɔ amesiwo le dɔ wɔm le nu kɔkɔeawo ŋu la dzi.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Merari-hawo nye: Maxeli-viwo ƒe ƒome kple Musi-viwo ƒe ƒome. Woawo nye Merari ƒomeawo.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Merari ƒome la ƒe amegã nye Zuriel, Abixail vi; woawo naƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe nɔƒe la ƒe axa dzi le anyiehe gome.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Eye Mose kple Aron kpakple viaŋutsuwo ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe nɔƒe, si nye Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋgɔ le ɣedzeƒe gome. Woƒe dɔe nye be, woawɔ dɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la na Israel-viwo; ke ne ame tutɔa ɖe te va la, woawui.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: Ŋutsu, siwo katã xɔ dzinu ɖeka alo wu nenema le Lewitɔwo dome, amesiwo Mose kple Aron tia xlẽ, abe alesi Yehowa de se ene la, le ame akpe blave vɔ eve. Alesi woaɖuɖɔ ŋgɔgbedzidziawo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Tia Israel-viwo ƒe ŋutsu ŋgɔgbeawo katã, amesiwo xɔ dzinu ɖeka alo wu nenema la xlẽ, eye naŋlɔ woƒe ŋkɔwo ƒe xexlẽme di.

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: Tia Lewitɔwo na Yehowa ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo katã teƒe; eye natia Lewitɔwo ƒe lãwo ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe lã ŋgɔgbeawo katã teƒe.

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Eye Mose tia Israel-viwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo katã xlẽ, abe alesi Yehowa de se ne ene.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: Tia Lewitɔwo nam ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo katã teƒe, eye tia Lewitɔwo ƒe lãwo ɖe woƒe lãwo teƒe, bena Lewitɔwo nanye Yehowa tɔ.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Ke woaxe fe ɖe ame alafa eve blaadre vɔ etɔ̃, siwo Israel-viwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo tsɔ sɔ gbɔ wu Lewitɔwo la ta;

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: naxa sekel kokoe atɔ̃ ɖe ame ɖeka ta; gera blave nanye sekel ɖeka.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ wo dometɔ, siwo tsi dzi, ƒe ga la ana Aron kple viaŋutsuwo.

english_verse: Moses collected the silver from the extra
translation_verse: Eye Mose xɔ sekel kɔkɔe akpe ɖeka alafa etɔ̃ blaade vɔ atɔ̃

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Eye Mose tsa ga la na Aron kple viaŋutsuwo, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ hede se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose kpakple Aron bena:

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kehat viwo ƒe dɔ enye be, woakpɔ nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔeawo dzi le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Ne ameha la le hoho ge la, ekema Aron kple viaŋutsuwo nayi ɖe eme, eye woaɖe xɔmetsovɔ la atsyɔ na aɖaka, si me se la le,

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: eye woatsɔ nyogbalẽ atsyɔ edzi, emegbe woatsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ akeke ɖe dzi, eye woade kpoawo eŋu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Eye woakeke aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ɖe ŋkumeɖobolokplɔ̃ la dzi, emegbe woafɔ agbawo, nutɔgbawo, trewo kple goe, siwo me wokua nunovɔsa ɖo kpakple gbesiagbe boloawo ada ɖe edzi.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Eyome woabia akaɖiti la kple eŋu kaɖigbɛawo, ɖovulãnuawo kple ganuviawo kpakple amigoe, siwo kpe ɖe eŋu la, ɖe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ me;

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: emegbe woabia nyogbalẽ ɖe eŋu, eye woatsɔe aɖo agbati dzi.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Woakeke aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ɖe sikavɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye woatsɔ nyogbalẽ abu dzi, eye woade kpoawo eŋu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Emegbe woabia nusi wo katã ŋu dɔ wowɔna le kɔkɔeƒe la, ɖe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ me, eye woaxatsa nyogbalẽ ɖe wo ŋu, eye woatsɔ wo aɖo agbati dzi.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Emegbe woalɔ afi le vɔsamlekpui la me, eye woakeke aɖabɛ dzĩtɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Eyome woafɔ eŋu nu, siwo ŋu dɔ wowɔna la, aɖa ɖe dzi, afilɔnuawo, gafloawo, sofiawo, zeawo kple vɔsamlekpui la ŋu nuwo katã, eye woatsɔ nyogbalẽ abu wo dzi, eye woade kpoawo eŋu.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Ne Aron kple viaŋutsuwo bia nu ɖe nu kɔkɔeawo kple wo ŋu nuawo katã ŋu va, eye ameha la le hoho ge la, eya ko hafi Kehat viwo nava atsɔ wo, bena womagaka asi nu kɔkɔeawo ŋu ahaku o. Esiawo nye Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu nusiwo Kehat-viwo natsɔ.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Eleazar, nunɔla Aron viŋutsu, ƒe dɔ enye be, wòakpɔ ami, si woade akaɖigbɛawo me, dzudzɔʋeʋẽedonu, gbesiagbe nuɖuvɔsa, ami sisi la, nɔƒe blibo la kple eme nu kɔkɔeawo katã kpakple wo ŋu nuwo dzi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: The Gershonites will be responsible
translation_verse: Gerson viwo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ kple woƒe nutsɔwo nye si:

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: Woawoe atsɔ nɔƒe la ƒe kuntruawo kple Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la tamekuntruawo kple nyogbalẽ, siwo wotsɔ gba wo dzii, kpakple Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu vɔ,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: kpɔ, si ƒo xlã nɔƒe la kple vɔsamlekpui la godoo va kpe la ŋu vɔwo kple agbonuvɔ la, agbadɔ ŋu kawo kple eŋu nu bubuawo: woawɔ eŋu dɔwo katã.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Esia enye Gerson viwo ƒe ƒome la ƒe dowo le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu, eye Itamar, nunɔla Aron viŋutsu, nakpɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Dɔ, si le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu na wo, enye be, woatsɔ nɔƒe la ƒe ʋuƒoawo kple gametiawo, sɔtiawo kple woƒe afɔawo,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: kpɔtiawo katã kple woƒe afɔawo, wo ŋu tsyoliwo kple wo ŋu kawo kpakple wo ŋu nuwo ka lã, eye woa wɔ wo ŋu dɔwo katã; miaha amesiame ƒe agba, si wòatsɔ lae ɖekaɖeka.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Esia nye Merari viwo ƒe ƒome la ƒe dɔwo le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu, eye Itamar, nunɔla Aron viŋutsu, nakpɔ wo dzi. Lewitɔwo xexlẽ.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Mose na wòfiã amesiame ƒe dɔ kple agba, si wòatsɔ lae, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se ene: eye wotia wo xlẽ, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se na Mose ene.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Woaɖo wo ɖe asaɖa la godo, eɖanye ŋutsu alo nyɔnu o, bena womagagblẽ kɔ ɖo na woƒe asaɖa, si me mele le wo dome la o.

english_verse: The Israelites obeyed the Lord's instructions. The Penalty for Committing a Crime (Leviticus
translation_verse: Israel-viwo wɔ nenema, eye woɖo wo ɖe asaɖa la godo; alesi Yehowa gblɔ na Mose la, nenema Israel-viwo wɔ. Vodada ʋu vɔsasa.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israel-viwo be: Ne ŋutsu alo nyɔnua ɖe da vo ɖe amea ɖe ŋu, eye meɖi anukware na Yehowa o la, ekema ame la ɖi fɔ.

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: Eye wòaʋu eƒe vo, si wòda la me, eye wòaxe fe dedie ɖe nusi me wòɖi fɔ le la ta; emegbe wòatsɔ ho la ƒe mamã atɔ̃liawo ɖeka aƒu edzi ahatsɔ na amesi ŋu wòɖi fɔ ɖo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ke ne ƒometɔ kekeake mele ame la si, amesi wòaxe fe la na o la, ekema fe, si wòxe la, zu Yehowa tɔ hena nunɔla, hekpe ɖe agbo, si woatsɔ alé avu nɛ la ŋuti.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe na nunana kɔkɔe la, enye nunɔla tɔ, eye ne amea ɖe na nu nunɔla la, ekema enye etɔ. Ŋunãvɔsa kple fiƒodetsi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: eye ŋuʋaʋã ɖo ŋutsu la me, wòde asi anukluiwɔwɔ me le srɔ̃ ŋu, eye nyɔnua gblẽ kɔ ɖo vava la, alo ŋuʋaʋã ɖo ŋutsu la me, eye wòɖe asi anukluiwɔwɔ me le srɔ̃ ŋu, wònye megblẽ kɔ ɖo hafi o la,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: ekema ŋutsu la nakplɔ srɔ̃a ava nunɔla gbɔ, eye woatsɔ luwɔ efa ewoliawo ɖeka awɔ vɔsanu akpe ɖe eŋu, makɔ ami ɖe edzi o, eye mada dzudzɔdonu hã ɖe edzi o; elabena anukluiwɔwɔ-nuɖuvɔsa kple nuɖuvɔsa, si ɖoa ŋku vodada dzi wònye.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la nana nyɔnua nate va, eye wòakplɔe aɖo Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla la naku tsi kɔkɔe la ɖe agba me, eye wòalɔ ke le nɔƒe la akɔ ɖe tsi la me.

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Emegbe nunɔla naŋlɔ fiƒodenya siawo ɖe agbalẽ dzi, eye woakpalae ɖe tsi, si hea fuwɔame va ame dzi la me.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla naxɔ anukluiwɔwɔ-nuɖuvɔsa la le nyɔnu si, eye wòanyè nuɖuvɔsa la le Yehowa ŋku me, emegbe wòatsɔe ayi vɔsamlekpui la gbɔe.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la naku nuɖuvɔsa la asiʋlo ɖeka, eye wòatɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi; emegbe hafi wòana nyɔnua nano tsi la.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Ne eno tsi lã, wònye egblẽ kɔ ɖo, eye meɖi anukware na srɔ̃ o hafi la, ekema tsi, si hea fiƒode kple fuwɔame va ame dzi la, aɖo lãme nɛ; ƒodo adzi ɖe nu, eƒe ali aklẽ, eye nyɔnu la atrɔ zu ɖiŋudonu le eƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Ke ne nyɔnu la megblẽ kɔ ɖo o, eye eƒe nya dzɔ la, ekema naneke mawɔe o, eye wòagate ŋu afɔ fu.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: alo ŋuʋaʋã ɖo ŋutsua ɖe me, eye wòɖe asi anukluiwɔwɔ me le srɔ̃a ŋu la, ekema wòakplɔ nyɔnu la ava Yehowa ŋku me, eye nunɔla nawɔ nɛ alea de se sia nu.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Eye fɔɖiɖi manɔ ŋutsu la dzi o, ke boŋ fɔɖiɖi la atsi nyɔnua ŋutɔ dzi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ne ŋutsu alo nyɔnua ɖe ɖe adzɔgbe hekɔ eɖokui ŋu na Yehowa koŋ la,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: ekema mano wein alo nu muamea ɖeke o, eye mano wein alo nu muame, si wotsɔ ɖo ƒãe la o, mano weintsetse me tsi o, manyi weintsetse o, eye maɖu weintsetse ƒuƒu hã o.

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: Talũhɛ made eƒe ta le ŋkeke, siwo me wòɖe adzɔgbe heka eɖokui ŋu la o, vaseɖe esime ŋkeke, siwo wòkɔ eɖokui ŋu na Yehowa, nade hafi; ame kɔkɔe wònye, eyata wòagblẽ eƒe taɖa ɖi wòato ʋluya.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Made ame kuku gbɔ le ŋkeke, siwo katã me wòkɔ eɖokui ŋu na Yehowa la me o.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe ku ku kpata ɖe egbɔ, eye wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na eƒe la, si ŋu ko la, ekema wòalũ ta le gbesigbe woka eŋu; le ŋkeke adreagbe wòalũ ta

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke enyiagbe la wòatsɔ akpakpa eve alo ahɔnevi eve avae na nunɔla le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la natsɔ ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔe, eye wòatsɔ evelia asa numevɔe, eye wòalé avu nɛ, le esi wògblẽ kɔ ɖo ɖe ame kuku ŋu la ta, eye wòagakɔ eƒe ta ŋu nɛ gbemagbe.

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Emegbe wòagagbugbɔ adzɔgbe aɖe na Yehowa, eye wòana alẽvi, si xɔ ƒe ɖeka wòawɔ fɔɖivɔsae; ke ŋkeke, siwo va yi la, mele eme o, elabena egblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: Esia nye se na amesi ɖe adzɔgbe hekɔ eɖokui ŋu. Ne ŋkeke, siwo wòkɔ eɖokui ŋu de la, ekema woakplɔe ava Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Eye wòatsɔ nusiawo asa vɔe na Yehowa, alẽvi, si xɔ ƒe ɖeka, eye naneke mewɔ afia ɖeke nɛ o, woawɔ numevɔsae, alẽnɔ, si xɔ ƒe ɖeka, eye naneke mewɔ afia ɖeke nɛ o, woawɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsae, kple agbo, si naneke mewɔ aba ɖeke nɛ o, woawɔ akpedavɔsae

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: kpakple kusi, si me nu maʋamaʋãwo le: aboŋgo, si wotsɔ wɔ memee ƒoe, kple akaklã, si dzi wokɔ ami ɖo; emegbe wòatsɔ nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa akpe ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla natsɔ wo ava Yehowa ŋku me, eye wòasa nuvɔ̃vɔ kple numevɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Then he will sacrifice the ram and offer the wine, grain, and bread.
translation_verse: Ke wòatsɔ agbo la kple kusi, si me nu maʋamaʋãwo le la, asa akpedavɔe na Yehowa, eyome nunɔla la nasa nuɖuvɔ kple nunovɔ nɛ.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ɖe adzɔgbe hekɔ eɖokui ŋu la, nalũ eƒe ta, si ŋu ko la, le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu, eye wòatsɔ eƒe taɖa, si ŋu ka la, ade dzo, si le akpedavɔsa te la me.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Ne amesi ɖe adzɔgbe hekɔ eɖokui ŋu, lu eƒe ta, si ŋu ka la, ekema nunɔla la natsɔ agbo la ƒe abɔ, si woɖa, kple aboŋgo maʋamaʋã ɖeka kpakple akaklã ɖeka le kusi la me ade asi me nɛ.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla nanyè wo le Yehowa ŋku me, nu kɔkɔewo wonye hena nunɔla la kpe ɖe akɔ, si wonye kple ata, si nye adzɔ la ŋu. Emegbe amesi ɖe adzɔgbe hekɔ eɖokui ŋu la, kpɔ mo ano wein.

english_verse: These are the requirements for Nazirites. However, if you can afford to offer more, you must do so. The Blessing for the People
translation_verse: Esia nye se le amesi ɖe adzɔgbe hekɔ eɖokui ŋu la, ƒe nusi wòana Yehowa ɖe eƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe ta la ŋuti, hekpe ɖe nusi eya ŋutɔ atsɔ kpee la ŋuti. Alesi wòɖe adzɔgbe lae la, nenema ŋu wòana nuawo ɖo. Nunɔla gã ƒe yayra.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo be: Ale miayra Israel-viwo agblɔ na wo enye si:

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: Yehowa ayra wò, eye wòakpɔ dziwò!

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Yehowa akɔ ŋku me ɖe wò, eye wòave nuwo!

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Yehowa atrɔ mo ɖe gbɔwò, eye wòana ŋutifafa wò!

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: Ale woayɔ nye ŋkɔ atɔ ɖe Israel-viwo ŋu, eye mayra wo.

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Esi Mose wu nɔƒe la tutu nu vɔ, eye wòsi ami ne kple eŋu nuawo katã hekɔ wo ŋu la, esi wòsi ami na vɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu nuawo katã, eye wòkɔ wo ŋu la,

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Israel-amegã, siwo nye tatɔwo le wo fofowo ƒe aƒewo nu, amesiwo nye toawo ƒe amegãwo kple amesiwo wotia xlẽ la dzikpɔlawo la, dzɔ nu.

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: Woƒe nunana, siwo wotsɔ va Yehowa ŋku me la, woawo nye: tasiaɖam ade, siwo dzi wogba, kpakple nyi wuieve: amegã eve na tasiaɖam ɖeka, eye wo dome ɖesiaɖe na nyi ɖekaɖeka, eye wotsɔ wo va nɔƒe la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena:

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: Xɔ wo le wo si hena Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu dɔwo wowɔ, eye namã wo na Lewitɔwo, ɖe alesi woƒe dɔwo le la nu.

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Tete Mose xɔ tasiaɖamawo kple nyiawo, eye wotsɔ wo na Lewitɔwo.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ tasiaɖam ene kple nyi enyi na Merari viwo, le alesi woƒe dɔ le la nu, wo dzikpɔla nye Itamar, nunɔla Aron viŋutsu.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Ke metsɔ ɖeke na Kehai viwo o, elabena woƒe dɔe nye be, woatsɔ nu kɔkɔeawo ɖe abɔta.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Esime wole ami sim na vɔsamlekpuia la, amegãwo dzɔ nu, bena woatsɔ akɔ eŋui, eye wotsɔ nunanawo va vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Woatsɔ woƒe nunanawo vɛ ɖekaɖeka, be woatsɔ akɔ vɔsamlekpui la ŋui, ŋkeke ɖeka amegã ɖeka.

english_verse: And so when the altar was dedicated to the Lord, these twelve leaders brought the following gifts:
translation_verse: Lã, siwo wotsɔ sa akpedavɔe, wole nyi blave vɔ ene, agbo blaade, gbɔ̃tsu blaade kple alẽvi blaade, siwo xɔ ƒe ɖekaɖeka. Ale wokɔ vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, le esime wosi ami nɛ la, enye si.

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: gbɔ̃tsu ɖeka woawɔ nuvɔvɔsae,

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Abidan, Gideoni vi, amesi nye Benyamin-viwo ƒe amegã la, na nu le ŋkeke asiekeagbe.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ne Mose yi ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, bena yeaƒo nu kplii la, ekema esea gbea ɖe tso Kerubi eveawo dome le nutsyɔnu, si le nubablaɖakaa tame la dzi: afisiae wòƒoa nu kplii le.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Aron, eye nagblɔ nɛ bena: Ne èɖo akaɖigbɛawo ati dzi la, ekema akaɖigbɛ adreawo nabi aɖo ta ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Aaron obeyed and placed the lamps as he was told.
translation_verse: Aron wo nenema, eye wòɖo akaɖigbɛawo atia dzi le ŋgɔgbe gome, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene:

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Sika wotsɔ tu akaɖiti blibo lae; ɖe wotu ati la kple eŋu seƒoƒoawo. Alesi Yehowa fia Mose la, nenema ŋu wowɔ akaɖiti la ɖo. Lewitɔwo ŋuti kɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Ale nawɔ na wo ákɔ wo ŋu enye si: Wu tsi, si ɖea nuvɔ̃ ɖa la, ɖe wo ŋuti, eye wòalũ fu le wo ŋuti katã, emegbe woanyã woƒe avɔwo, eye woakɔ wo ɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Woana nyitsuvi ɖeka, eye woatsɔ wɔ memee, si wodzaba kple ami, ne woawɔ nuɖuvɔsae akpe ɖe eŋu, eye natsɔ nyitsuvi bubu asa nuvɔ̃vɔe.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Emegbe nana Lewitɔwo nate va Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋgɔ, eye naƒo Israel-viwo ƒe ha blibo la nu ƒu.

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: Eyome nana Lewitɔwo nate va Yehowa ŋku me, eye Israel-viwo natsɔ woƒe asiwò ada ɖe Lewitɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Eye Aron nanyè Lewitɔwo le Yehowa ŋku me abe Israel-viwo ƒe nunana ene, bena woawɔ Yehowa ƒe da la.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Lewitɔwo natsɔ woƒe asiwò aɖo nyitsuawo ƒe tame, eye natsɔ ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔe, eye natsɔ evelia asa numevɔ na Yehowa, bena nalé avu na Lewitɔwo.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Kplɔ Lewitɔwo ɖo Aron kple viaŋutsuawo ŋku me, eye nanyè wo na Yehowa.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Emegbe Lewitɔwo nava, bena woawɔ dɔ le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me. Ale naka wo ŋu anyẽ wo enye si.

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: Elabena tɔnye wonye blibo le Israel-viwo dome. Nye ŋutɔe xɔ wo ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ŋgɔgbevi, siwo ʋu dɔ nu na wo dadawo la teƒe?

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Israel-viwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo katã kple lãwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo nye tɔnye; elabena esi mewu ŋgɔgbeviwo katã le Egipte-nyigba dzi la, eyae meka wo ŋu na ɖokuinye.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Eye mexɔ Lewitɔwo ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo katã teƒe.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Meɖe Lewitɔwo le Israel-viwo dome na Aron kple viaŋutsuawo, bena woawɔ subɔsubɔdɔ ɖe Israel-viwo nu le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me; eye woalé avu na Israel-viwo, bena Israel-viwo magate ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu, eye do vɔ̃ɖi naɖo wo dome o.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Eye Mose kple Aron kpakple Israel-viwo ƒe ha blibo la wɔ nenema: alesi Yehowa de se na; Mose le Lewitɔwo ŋu ta, nenema Israel-viwo wɔ na wo.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Lewitɔwo ɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le wo ɖokui ŋu, wonyã woƒe avɔwo, eye Aron; nye wo le Yehowa ŋku me, eye wòlé avu na wo, be wo ŋu nakɔ.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Emegbe Lewitɔwo yi, bena woawo dɔ le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me le Aron kple viaŋutsuawo ŋku me. Alesi Yehowa de se na Mose le Lewitɔwo ŋu la, nenema wòwɔ na wo. Lewitɔwo ƒe subɔsubɔdɔwɔɣi.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Gake ate ŋu akpe asi ɖe nɔviawo ŋu, ne wole dɔ wɔm le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me, ke magawɔ dɔ bubua ɖeke o. Ale nana Lewitɔwo nawɔ woƒe ɖoe enye si.

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Esi woʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi le ƒe evelia ƒe ɣleti gbãtɔ dzi la, Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose le Sinai-gbedzi bena:

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Israel-viwo naɖu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la ɖe eƒe ɣeyiɣi dzi.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Miaɖui ɖe eƒe ɣeyiɣi dzi le ɣleti sia ƒe ŋkeke wuienelia dzi le fiẽ ɖe ɖoɖo kple se, siwo katã le eŋu la nu.
