english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Sitsoƒedu, siwo miana la, nanye du ade.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Mose bena:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: Ƒo nu kple Israel-viwo, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ne mietso Yordan va Kanaan-nyigba dzi la,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: ekema mitia duwo, ne woanye sitsoƒe na mi, afisi amesi mebuawu ame o la, nasi ayi.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Duawo nanye sitsoƒe na mi le hiãtɔ ta, ne womagawu amewula la hafi ava eƒe ʋɔnu le ameha la ŋku me o.

english_verse: three on each side of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Du etɔ nanɔ Yordan ƒe go si dzi, eye du etɔ̃ nanɔ Kanaan-nyigba dzi; sitsoƒeduwɔ woanye.

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Du ade siawo nanye sitsoƒe na Israel-viwo kple amedzrowo kpakple wo gbɔ mewo, bena ne amea ɖe mebua wu ame o la, ne wòasi ayi afima.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Eye ne etsɔ kpo, si adze ame wòaku, ƒoe wòku la, ekema edo hlɔ̃; eye ele be, woawu hlɔ̃dola la.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: alo wòlé fui heƒoe kple kɔ wòku la, ekema woawu ame la, elabena edo hlɔ̃; ne hiãtɔ do go hlɔ̃dola la, ekema wòawui.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: ekema ameha la nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le amewula kple hlɔ̃tɔ dome ɖe ɖoɖo siawo nu.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Eye ha la naɖe amewula tso hlɔ̃tɔ si me, eye ha la nana woakplɔe agbugbɔ ayi sitsoƒedu, si me wòsi yi ɖo la me, eye wòatsi afima, vaseɖe esime nunɔlagã, amesi wosi ami kɔkɔe na, naku hafi.

english_verse: But if you ever leave the Safe Town
translation_verse: Ke ne hlɔ̃dola la gbɔ sitsoƒedu, si me wòsi yi ɖo la, ƒe liƒo dzi,

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: eye hlɔ̃tɔ do goe le sitsoƒedu la ƒe liƒo godo, eye hlɔ̃tɔ wu hlɔ̃dola la, ekema meɖe hlɔ̃fea ɖeke o,

english_verse: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.
translation_verse: elabena ɖe wobe, wòanɔ sitsoƒedu la me, vaseɖe esime nunɔlagã naku. Ke le nunɔlagã ƒe ku megbe la amewula kpɔ mɔ agbugbɔ ava eya ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.
translation_verse: Esia nanye ɖoɖo na miaƒe dzidzimeviwo le mia nɔƒewo katã.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wu ame, eye ɖasefowo ɖi ɖase le eŋu la, eya ko hafi woawui, gake ɖasefo ɖeka ɖeɖe maɖi ɖase, eye woawui o.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: Miaxɔ fe ɖe hlɔ̃dola, si wotso kufia na la ta o, ele be, woawui kokoko.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Eye miekpɔ mɔ ana woaxe fe ɖe amea ɖe ta, bena magayi sitsoƒedu la me o, eye bena wòanɔ anyigba ƒe afia ɖe, vaseɖe esime nunɔla naku o.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Eye Gilead, Maxir vi, amesi nye Manase vi tso Yosef-ƒome la, ƒe viwo ƒe amegãwo va, eye woƒo nu le Mose kple Israel-viwo ƒe toawo ƒe amegãwo ŋku me

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Yehowa de se na nye aƒetɔ be, wòadzidze nu amã anyigba la na Israel-viwo; eye Yehowa gagblɔ na nye aƒetɔ be, wòatsɔ mia nɔvi Zelofxad ƒe anyigba na vianyɔnuwo.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne woaɖe Israel-viwo ƒe toawo me ŋutsua ɖe la, ekema woaka woƒe anyigba le mía fofowo ƒe anyigba ŋu atsɔ kpee na to, si me woɖe srɔ̃ le la, ke míaƒe to la tɔ azu sue.

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: Eye ne aseyetsoƒe ɖo na Israel-viwo la, ekema woatsɔ woƒe anyigba akpe to, si me woɖe srɔ̃ le la tɔ, eye woaka woƒe anyigba le mía fofowo ƒe to la ƒe anyigba ŋu.

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Tete Mose gblɔ na Israel-viwo, abe alesi Yehowa de se ene bena: Yosef-viwo ƒe ƒome la gblɔe ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa de se le Zelofxad vinyɔnuwo ŋu enye si: Amesi ke ŋu wodze la, kpɔ mɔ aɖe wo; gake ele be, woaɖe srɔ̃ ɖe wo fofo ƒe to la me,

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: bena ne Israel-viwo ƒe anyigba magatso to ɖeka si ayi ɖe to bubu si me o, boŋ Israel-viwo dome ɖesiaɖe nalé fofoa ƒe to la ƒe anyigba ɖe asi.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: Eye anyigba matso to ɖeka si ayi ɖe to bubu si me o, boŋ Israel-viwo ƒe toawo dome ɖesiaɖe nalé eƒe anyigba ɖe asi.

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: Eye Zelofxad vinyɔnu, siwo nye: Maxla, Tirza. Xogla, Milka kple Noa la, ɖe wo fofo nɔviŋutsuwo ƒe viwo.

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: Woɖe srɔ̃ le Yosef vi Manase ƒe ƒomeawo me. Ale woƒe anyigba tsi wo fofo ƒe ƒome la si.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Esia nye se kple ɖoɖo, siwo Yehowa na Mose gblɔ na Israel-viwo le Moab-tagba le Yordan nu le Yerixo kasa.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Ke miawo mitrɔ, eye míaho aɖo ta gbedzi ato Avaƒu la gbɔ mɔ!

english_verse: People of Israel, when we were in our camp at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God told us: You have stayed here long enough.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía Mawu, gblɔ na mí le Xoreb bena: Mienɔ to sia gbɔ wòdidi;

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: mitrɔ miaho, eye miayi Amoritɔwo ƒe towo gbɔ, miayi woƒe aƒelika, siwo le tagba, towo dzi kple gbadzaƒe, dzíehe kpakple ƒu ŋu la Kanaanitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi la gbɔ, eye miaɖo ta Libanon gbɔ ava se Frat tɔsisi gã la nu.

english_verse: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land. Leaders Were Appointed (Exodus
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ anyigba, si le mia ŋku me la na mi, miyi, ne miaxɔ anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na mia fofowo Abraham, Isak kple Yakob be, yeatsɔe na woa kple wo megbe-viwo.

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Ale mede se na mi ɣemaɣi le nusiwo katã miawɔ la ŋu enye si.

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: Eye mieli liʋĩliʋĩ le miaƒe agbadɔwo me gblɔ bena: De Yehowa lé fu mí, eyata wòkplɔ mí tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, bena wòatsɔ mí ade asi na Amoritɔwo, ne woatsrɔ̃ mí.

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ na mi ɣemaɣi bena: Nye ɖeka nyemate ŋu atsɔ, mi o.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mia fofowo ƒe Mawu, ana miasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi zi akpe, eye wòayra mi, abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe na mi ene.

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Aleke nye ɖeka mate ŋu atso miaƒe fuɖenamewo, miaƒe agba kple miaƒe dzrewɔwɔwo?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Eye metsɔ miaƒe toawo ƒe amegãwo, ŋutsu, siwo tagbɔ li na, eye ŋkɔ le wo ŋu la, ɖo amegãwo ɖe mia nu, ɖe ame akpe kple ame alafa, ɖe ame blaatɔ̃ kple ame ewo nu, eye wonɔ miaƒe toawo nu.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Eye mede se na miaƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo ɣemaɣi bena: Mibia nya ta mia nɔviwo se, eye midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na amesiame kple nɔvia kpakple amedzro nyuie.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Migakpɔ ame ŋku me le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe o, ke boŋ milé to ɖe ame gblɔewo kple ame gãwo ƒe nyawo ŋu, eye migasi amea ɖeke ŋku me o, elabena Yehowa tɔ enye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃; ke ne nyaa ɖe sesẽ na mi akpa la, ekema mitsɔe va gbɔnye, ne mase.

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: amesi zɔ mia ŋgɔ le mo dzi, be yeafia afisi miaƒu asaɖa anyi ɖo la mi, amesi zɔ dzo me le zã me, be yeafia mɔ, si miato la mi, eye wòzɔ alilikpo me le ŋkeke me.

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Tete míeho tso Xoreb heto gbegbe gã dziŋɔ ma, si mia ŋutɔwo miekpɔ la, heɖo ta Amoritɔwo ƒe towo gbɔ, abe alesi Yehowa, mia Mawu, de se na mí ene: eye mieva ɖo Kades-Barnea.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsɔ anyigba, si le ŋkuwò me la, na wò, yi naxɔe wòanye tɔwò, abe alesi Yehowa, fofowòwo ƒe Mawu, do ŋugbee na wò ene; megavɔ̃ o, eye ŋɔ megadzi wò o!

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ke mi katã mieva gbɔnye gblɔ bena: Na miadɔ ŋutsuwo ɖe mía ŋgɔ, bena woatsa le anyigba da dzi, eye woagbɔ ava gblɔe na mí, mɔ, si míato ayi, kple ɖu, siwo me míayi.

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Eye esi nya la dze ŋunye la, meɖe ŋutsu wuieve le mia dome, to ɖeka ame ɖeka;

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: amesiwo dze mɔ yi toawo dzi heva Eskol-bali la me, eye wotsa le edzi.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Wogbe anyigba dzi kutsetsewo ɖe asi va mía gbɔ, eye wogbugbɔ va gblɔ na mí bena: Anyigba, si Yehowa, mía Mawu, le mía na ge la nyo.

english_verse: Then you came back to the place of worship at Kadesh-Barnea and wept, but the Lord would not listen to your prayers. Israel Spent Years in the Desert Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Eye miegbugbɔ va fa avi le Yehowa ŋku me, ke Yehowa mese miaƒe gbe o, eye melé to ɖe mia ŋu o.

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ke miawo miegbe be, yewomayi edzi o, eye miesẽ to ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu, ƒe nya la ŋu.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Afika gɔ̃ yi ge míala? Mía nɔviwo ɖe dzi le mía ƒo gblɔ bena: Dukɔ la sɔ gbɔ, eye wodzo atsu wu mi, duawo lolo, eye woɖo gli ɖe wo ŋu ɖatɔ dziƒo, eye míekpɔ Enak-viwo hã le afima.

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mia Mawu, dze mia ŋgɔ, eye awɔ aʋa na mi, abe alesi wòwɔ na mi le Egipte miekpɔ ene,

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: kple alesi wòwɔ le gbedzi, afisi nèkpɔ le bena, Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsɔ wò kpa le mɔ blibo, si nèzɔ vaseɖe afisia la dzi abe alesi ŋutsu kpa viae ene.

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Ke miebui o, eye miegbe ŋuɖoɖo ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋu

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: Eye esi Yehowa se miaƒe nyawo la, dome vee, eye wòka atam gblɔ bena:

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ƒome vɔ̃ɖi sia dome ŋutsua ɖeke makpɔ anyigba nyui, si ŋu meka atam ɖo be, matsɔ na wo fofowo la o;

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: negbe Kaleb, Yefune vi, koe akpɔe, eye matso anyigba, si dzi wòde la, ana eya ŋutɔ kple viawo, elabena edze Yehowa yome blibo.

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe nye hã ŋunye le mia ta gblɔ bena: Wò hã made afima o.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Ke Yosua, Nun vi, amesi le gbɔwò la, ade afima; de dzi ƒo nɛ, elabena eyae amã anyigba la na Israel.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Eye miaƒe vidzie, siwo ŋu miegblɔ le be, woazu aboyonu, kple mia viŋutsu, siwo mele nyui alo vɔ̃ nyam egbe siawo o la, ade afima, eye matsɔe na wo wòanye wo to.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Tete mieɖo ŋu gblɔ nam bena: Miewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa ŋu, miayi aɖawɔ aʋa, abe alesi Yehowa, mía Mawu, de se na mí ene. Eye mia dome amesiame kpla aʋawɔnu, eye miesẽ tame ɖi be, yewoayi toawo dzi.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Gblɔ na wo bena: Miekpɔ mɔ ayi aɖawɔ aʋa o, elabena nyemele mia dome o, ne miaƒe futɔwo magasi mi o.

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Eye meƒo nu kpli mi, ke mieɖo to o; miesẽ to ɖe Yehowa ƒe nya la ŋu, eye miesẽ tame helia to la.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Tete Amoritɔ, siwo nɔ toawo dzi la, va kpe mi, eye wonyã mi, abe alesi anyiwo wɔna ene, eye woka mi hlẽ tso Seir vaseɖe Xorma.

english_verse: We spent many years wandering around outside the hill country of Seir,
translation_verse: Tete mietrɔ, eye miehe ɖo ta gbedzi heto Avaƒu gbɔ mɔ, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ nam ene, eye mietrɔ Seir-to la ta eteƒe didi.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena:

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: Mietrɔ to sia ta eteƒe didi, mitrɔ ɖo ta anyiehe!

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Eye de se na dukɔ la bena: Miele mia nɔvi Esau-viwo, amesiwo le Seir la, ƒe anyigba dzi to ge, eye wole mia vɔ̃ ge, ke mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie,

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: ne miagawɔ aʋa kpli wo o, elabena nyemele woƒe anyigba ƒe afɔ ɖeka hã na ge mi o, elabena ɖe metsɔ Seir-to la na Esau, be wòanye etɔ.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ atsɔ ga aƒle nuɖuɖu le wo si aɖu, eye miekpɔ mɔ atsɔ ga adze tsi le wo si ano.

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Eye míedzo tso mía nɔvi Esau-viwo, amesiwo nɔ Seir la gbɔ hetrɔ tso Elat kple Ezeon-Geber-tagbamɔ dzi ɖo ta Moab-tagba.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Megadze Moabitɔwo dzi o, eye megawɔ aʋa kpli wo o, elabena nyematsɔ woƒe anyigbaa ɖeke na wò wòanye tɔwo o, elabena ɖe metsɔ Ar na Lot-viwo, be wòanye wo tɔ.

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: Tsã la Emitɔwo nɔ afima, amesiwo nye dukɔ gã, wòsɔ gbɔ, eye wodzɔ atsu abe Enakitɔwo ene.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Wobu woawo hã ɖe ame dzɔtsuwo me abe Enakitɔwo ene, eye Moabitɔwo yɔ wo be Emitɔwo.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Tsã la Xoritɔwo nɔ Seir, ke Esau-viwo nyã wo, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo le wo ɖokui ŋgɔ hena wo teƒe abe alesi Israel wo anyigba, si Yehowa nae wònye eta la ene.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Esi aʋawɔlawo katã ku le dukɔa dome vɔ la,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒo nu kplim bena:

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: Egbe nèle Ar to ge le Moab ƒe liƒo dzi,

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: eye nèle tete ge ɖe Amon-viwo ŋu, megadze wo dzi o, eye megawɔ aʋa kpli wo o, elabena nyematsɔ Amon-viwo ƒe anyigbaa ɖeke na wò wòanye tɔwo o, elabena ɖe metsɔe na Lot-viwo, ne wòanye wo tɔ.

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: Wobua eya hã abe ame dzɔtsuwo ƒe anyigba ene, elabena ame dzɔtsuwo nɔ edzi tsã, eye Amonitɔwo yɔ wo bena Samsumitɔwo;

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: abe alesi Yehowa wɔ na Esau-viwo, amesiwo nɔ Seir la ene: etsrɔ̃ Xoritɔwo le wo ŋgɔ, eye wonyã wo hena wo teƒe va do egbee.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Eye Kaftoritɔwo tso Kaftor heva tsrɔ̃ Awitɔwo, amesiwo nɔ kɔƒekɔƒewo me vaseɖe Gaza, eye wònɔ wo teƒe.

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Mitso míaho atso Arnon-tɔʋu la; kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ Amoritɔwo ƒe fia Sixon, amesi te Xesbon, kple eƒe anyigba de asi na wò! Dze anyigba xɔxɔ gɔme, eye nawɔ aʋa kplii!

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Madze egɔme egbea ana ŋɔdzi kple vɔvɔ̃ nalé dukɔ, siwo katã le dziƒoa te le ŋuwò, ale be, ne wose: ŋkɔwo la, ŋɔ adzi wo, eye woadzo nyanyanya le ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: Na mato wò anyigba dzi ayi, mɔ dzi ko mazɔ, eye nyemele dzedze ge ɖe ɖusi alo mia me o.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: abe alesi Esau-vi, siwo le Seir, kple Moabitɔ, siwo nɔ Ar la, wɔm ene, — vaseɖe esime matso Yordan ava anyigba, si Yehowa, mia Mawu, le mía na ge la dzi.

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena; Kpɔ ɖa, medze Sixon kple eƒe anyigba ɖeɖe asi gɔme le ŋkuwò me; dze eƒe anyigba xɔxɔ gɔme, ne wòanye tɔwo!

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Eye Sixon kple eƒe dukɔ blibo la ho aʋa va kpe mí le Yaza.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa, mía Mawu, tsɔe de asi na mi, ale be míewu eya ŋutɔ kple viaŋutsuwo kpakple eƒe dukɔ blibo la.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Negbe lãwo koe mieha na mía ɖokui, eye míeɖe aboyo nuwo le du, siwo miexɔ la me.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Du, siwo tso Aroer le Arnon-tɔʋu la nu, kple du, si le bali me gbɔ vaseɖe Gilead la, dometɔa ɖeke mesesẽ na mí o; Yehowa, mía Mawu, tsɔ wo katã de asi na mí.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Negbe Amon-viwo ƒe anyigba, si le Yabok-tɔʋu ƒe go ɖeka, kple du, siwo le towo dzi, kpakple nusiwo katã ŋu Yehowa, mia Mawu, ɖe se le la ŋu ko mele ɖo o.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Megavɔ̃e o, elabena matsɔ eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe dukɔ blibo la kpakple eƒe anyigba ade asi na wò, eye nawɔe, abe alesi nèwɔ Amoritɔwo ƒe fia Sixon, si nɔ Xesbon la ene.

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Eye mietsrɔ̃ du sia ɖu, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo kpakple vidziewo, abe alesi mietsrɔ̃ fia Sixon, si nɔ Xesbon la ene.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Ke mieha lãwo katã kple aboyonuwo le duawo me na mía ɖokui.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Ale míexɔ anyigba le Amoritɔwo ƒe fia eveawo si ɣemaɣi le Yordan ƒe go keme dzi, tso Arnon-tɔʋu la nu vaseɖe Xermon-to la gbɔ, —

english_verse: Mount Hermon is called Mount Sirion by the people of Sidon, and it is called Mount Senir by the Amorites.
translation_verse: Sidonitɔwo yɔ Xermon bena Siryon, ke Amoritɔwo yɔe bena Senir —

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: du, siwo katã le tagba kple Gilead blibo la kpakple Basan blibo la vaseɖe Salxa kple Edrei; du siawo nɔ Og, Basan-fia, ƒe fiaɖuƒe me.

english_verse: King Og was the last of the Rephaim, and his coffin is in the town of Rabbah in Ammon. It is made of hard black rock and is four meters long and almost two meters wide. The Land East of the Jordan River Is Divided (Numbers
translation_verse: Og, Basan-fia, enye ame dzɔtsu mlɔetɔ, si kpɔtɔ ɖi; eƒe gabati, si le Amon-viwo ƒe du Rabat me la, didi ŋutsu ƒe abɔklugui asieke, eye wòkeke abɔklugui ene. Wòmã anyigba, si le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe la me.

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime Yehowa nana gbɔdzɔe mia nɔviwo abe miawo ke ene, eye woaxɔ anyigba, si Yehowa, mia Mawu, le wo na ge le Yordan ƒe go keme dzi, hafi mia dome amesiame nagbugbɔ ava anyigba, si mena mi la dzi.

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Tete meƒo koko na Yehowa ɣemaɣi bena:

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: Oo, Aƒetɔ, Yehowa, wò ŋutɔ ede asi wò gãnyenye kple wò abɔ sesẽ fiafia me wò dɔla, elabena Mawu kae le dziƒo alo anyigba dzi ate ŋu awɔ wò dɔwɔwɔwo kple ŋusẽ-nuwɔwɔwo tɔgbe?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Na mayi dzro, bena maɖakpɔ anyigba nyui la le Yordan godo kple to nyui siawo kpakple Libanon!

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye le mia ta, eye meɖo tom o; ke boŋ Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Esɔ gbɔ, megaƒo nu kplim le nya sia ŋuti azɔ o.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: De Pisga-to tame, eye natɔ kɔ dzi atsɔ wò ŋkuwo akpɔ ɣetoɖoƒe kple anyiehe, dziehe kple ɣedzeƒe gome ɖa; elabena mele Yordan sia tso ge o.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: De gbe asi na Yosua, ɖe dzi ƒo nɛ, eye nado ŋusẽe, elabena eyae adze dukɔ sia ŋgɔ ayi, eye wòamã anyigba, si kpɔm nèle la, na wo.

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Eye míetsi bali la me le Bet-Peor kasa.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Azɔ Israel, se dodo kple se, siwo mele mia fia ge la, ne miawɔ wo dzi anɔ agbe, bena miade afima, eye miaxɔ anyigba, si Yehowa, mia fofowo ƒe Mawu, le mia na ge la.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Migatsɔ nyaa ɖeke kpe se, siwo ɖe ge mala na mi la o, eye migaɖe ɖeke le edzi o; ke boŋ miwɔ Yehowa, mia Mawu ƒe se, siwo de ge mala na mi la dzi.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: ke mi, amesiwo ku ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋu la, mietsi agbe va do egbee.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Ke kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi nyuie, eye nakpɔ wò agbe ta, bena magaŋlɔ nusiwo nèkpɔ kple wò ŋku la be o, eye womagaɖo le wò dzi me le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me o, ke boŋ naxlẽ wo afia viwòwo kple viwòwo ƒe viwo.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Eye megaŋlɔ gbesigbe netsi tre ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu, ŋku me le Xoreb gbɔ la be o, esime Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Ƒo dukɔ la nu ƒu nam, bena wòase nye nyawo, ne wòanya, alesi woavɔ̃m, ŋkeke alesi wole agbe le anyigba dzi, eye woafia wo wo viwo.

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Tete miete va, eye mietsi tre ɖe to la te, eye dzo de dzi le to la ŋu ɖase dziƒo ke, alilikpo do, eye viviti tsyɔ.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kpli mi tso dzo la me, miese gbeɖiɖi, gake miekpɔ nɔnɔmea ɖeke o, negbe gbe ko miese.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Eka eƒe nubabla la ta na mi, si enye se ewo, siwo wòde, be miawɔ la, eye woŋlɔ wo ɖe kpe eve dzi.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa de se nam ɣemaɣi bena, mafia ɖoɖoawo kple seawo mi, ne miawɔ wo dzi le anyigba, si dzi yim miele, be miaxɔe wòanye mia tɔ la dzi.

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: Eyata mikpɔ miaƒe agbe ta nyuie, elabena miekpɔ nɔnɔmea ɖeke le gbesigbe Yehowa ƒo nu kpli mi tso dzo me le Xoreb gbɔ la o;

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: ne miagawɔ vɔ ayi legba wɔ ge na mia ɖokui o, eɖanye ŋutsu alo nyɔnu ƒe nɔnɔmea ɖeke o;

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: eye megawu wò mo dzi akpɔ ɣe, ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo kpakple dziƒonuwo, eye naɖu ɖokuiwò ade ta agu na wo ahayi wo subɔ ge o, elabena ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsɔ wona dukɔ, siwo katã le dziƒoa te la.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa ɖe miawo tso aŋɔɖakpo me le Egipte, bena mianye eya ŋutɔ ƒe dukɔ, abe alesi wòzu egbe siawo ene.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖo dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye ka atam bena, nyematso Yordan ayi anyigba nyui, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge, wòanye wò domenyinu la dzi o;

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: ke boŋ maku le anyigba sia dzi, eye nyemagatso Yordan o; ke miawo mitsoe, eye miaxɔ anyigba nyui sia wòanye mia tɔ.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Eyata mikpɔ nyuie, ne miagaŋlɔ nusi Yehowa, mia Mawu bia kpli mi la be o, eye migawɔ legba alo nusiwo Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsri na mi la, ƒe nɔnɔmea ɖeke na mia ɖokui o.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu la, dzo binu kple Mawu ʋãŋu wònye.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa akaka mi ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye mianɔ ʋee le dukɔ, siwo dome Yehowa nyã mi ɖo la dome.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Eye miasubɔ mawuwo le afima, esiwo amegbetɔwo tsɔ ati kple kpe wɔe, womekpɔa nu o, eye womesea nu o, womeɖua nu o, eye womeʋẽa nu sena o la.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Ne nu siawo katã va dziwò le ɣeyiɣi, siwo gbɔna me, eye nèɖo xaxa me la, ekema atrɔ ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu ŋu, eye aɖo to eƒe gbe;

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu la, Mawu nublanuikpɔla wònye, maɖe asi le ŋuwò alo agblẽ wò o, eye maŋlɔ nubabla, si ŋu wòka atam ɖo na fofowòwo la be o.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ena nèse eƒe gbe tso dziƒo, bena wòafia nu wò, eye wòna nèkpɔ eƒe dzo gã la le anyigba dzi, eye nèse eƒe gbe tso dzo la me.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Elabena elɔ̃ fofowòwo, eyata wotia wo megbeviwo, eye eya ŋutɔ kpamkpam tsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ gã kplɔ wò tso Egipte,

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: eye wonyã dukɔ gã, siwo sesẽ wu wò la, le ŋgɔwò, bena yeakplɔ wò ayii, atsɔ woƒe anyigba na wò wòanye wò domenyinu, abe alesi wòzu egbe siawo ene.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Eyata nyae egbea, eye wòaɖe dzi gbɔ na wò bena, Yehowa enye Mawu le dziƒo afime kple anyigba dzi afi, eye bubua ɖeke meli kpe ɖe eŋu o;

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: eye nawɔ ɖoɖo kple se, siwo meɖe na wò egbea la dzi, bena wòanyo na wò kple megbewòviwo, eye nanɔ agbe didie le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge la dzi tegbee. Woɖo sitsoƒedu etɔ̃ le Yordan godo.

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: le Yordan ƒe go keme dzi, le tagba le Bet-Peor kasa, le Amoritɔwo ƒe fia Sixon, si nɔ Xesbon la, ƒe anyigba dzi, amesi Mose kple Israel-viwo si, le esime woʋu tso Egipte.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Eye woxɔ eya kple Og, Basan-fia, siwo nye Amoritɔwo ƒe fia eveawo, ƒe anyigba le Yordan godo, le ɣedzeƒe gome, wòzu wo tɔ;

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: tso Aroer le Arnon-tɔʋu la nu vaseɖe Sion, si nye Xermon-to la gbɔ,

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: kpakple tagba blibo, si le Yordan ƒe go keme dzi, le ɣedzeƒe gome vaseɖe tagbaƒu la gbɔ, le Pisga ƒe aganu.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Eye Mose yɔ Israel blibo la gblɔ na wo bena: Israel, se ɖoɖo kple se, siwo gblɔ ge mala ɖe to me na mi egbea, misrɔ̃ wo, milé wo me ɖe asi, eye miwɔ wo dzi!

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía Mawu, bia nu kpli mí le Xoreb gbɔ.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Menye mía fofowoe Yehowa bia nu sia kpli o, ke boŋ mí, amesiwo katã le agbe le afisia egbe lae.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒo nu kpli mi ŋku me kple ŋku me le to la gbɔ tso dzo me,

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: eye menɔ mia kple Yehowa dome ɣemaɣi, bena magblɔ Yehowa ƒe nyawo na mi, elabena miele dzo lã vɔ̃m, eye mieha to la o. Eye wògblɔ bena:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, wò Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso kluvinyenyeƒe me le Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Mawu bubua ɖeke megana asiwò kpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Megawɔ legbaa ɖeke na ɖokuiwò ɖe nusiwo le dziƒo afime kple anyigba dzi afi kpakple tsiwo me le anyigba dzi la, ƒe nɔnɔme ŋu o.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Megade ta agu na wo o, eye megasubɔ wo o, elabena nye Yehowa, wò Mawu la, Mawu ʋãŋu menye, amesi ɖoa fofowo ƒe vodada teƒe na vi, siwo léa fum la, vaseɖe dzidzime etɔ̃lia kple enelia dzi;

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: ke mevea ame akpe nane, siwo lɔ̃am, eye wòwɔa nye sewo dzi la nu.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Megayɔ Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe ŋkɔ yakatsyɔ o, elabena Yehowa magbe tohehe na amesi yɔ eƒe ŋkɔ yakatsyɔ la o.

english_verse: Show respect for the Sabbath Day—it belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku dzudzɔgbe la dzi, ne nawɔe kɔkɔe, abe alesi Yehowa, wo Mawu, de se na wò ene.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adee nawɔ do, eye nawɔ ŋuwò dɔwo katã;

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: ke ŋkeke adrelia enye dzudzɔgbe na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, megawɔ dɔa ɖeke le edzi o, eɖanye wò ŋutɔ, viwòŋutsu alo viwònyɔnu o, eɖanye wò dɔlaŋutsu alo wò dɔlanyɔnu o, eɖanye wò nyitsu, wò tedzi, wò lãwo katã alo amedzro, si dze wò du me la o, bena wò dɔlaŋutsu kple wò dɔlanyɔnu nagbɔ ɖe me abe wò ŋuta ke ene.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi be, ènye kluvi le Egipte-nyigba dzi kpɔ, eye Yehowa, wò Mawu, tso asi sesẽ kple abɔ, si wodo ɖe dzi, kplɔ wò tso afima; eyata Yehowa, wò Mawu, de se na wò be, nadzra dzudzɔgbe la ɖo.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: Bu fofowò kple dawo, abe alesi Yehowa, wò Mawu, ɖe se na wò ene, bena nanɔ agbe didie, eye wòanyo na wò le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge la dzi.

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Elabena ameka le ŋutilãwo katã dome, si se Mawu gbagbe la ƒe gbe tso dzo me kpɔ abe miawo ene gatsi agbe?

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: Te yi, ne nase nya, siwo katã Yehowa, mia Mawu, le gbɔgblɔge na mí la, eye nagblɔ nya, siwo katã Yehowa, mía Mawu, gblɔ na wò la, na mí; ekema míasee, eye miawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa se nya, siwo miegblɔ nam la, eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Mese nya, siwo katã dukɔ sia gblɔ na wò la, wogblɔ wo katã ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe dzi sia tɔgbe anɔ wo si, ne woavɔ̃m, eye wòalé nye seawo katã me ɖe asi ɣesiaɣi, bena wòanye na wo kple wo viwo!

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Ke wò la tsi gbɔnye afisia, ne magblɔ seawo katã kple ɖoɖoawo kpakple kɔnuawo, esiwo nafia wo la, na wò, bena woawɔ wo dzi le anyigba, si matsɔ na wo wòanye wo tɔ la dzi.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Milé wo me ɖe asi, eye miwɔ wo dzi, abe alesi Yehowa, mia Mawu, de se na mi ene, eye migadze ɖe ɖusi alo mia me o;

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: Esia nye se kple ɖoɖo kpakple kɔnu, siwo Yehowa, mia Mawu gblɔ, bena woafia mi, ne miawɔ wo dzi le anyigba, si dzi yim miele, bena míaxɔe wòanye mia tɔ la dzi,

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: ne miavo Yehowa, mia Mawu la, eye mia kple viwòwo kple wò tɔgbuiyɔviwo miawɔ ɖoɖo kple se, siwo megblɔ na mi la dzi, le miaƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me, bena mianɔ agbe didie.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Eyata Israel see, lé wo me ɖe asi, eye nawɔ wo dzi, ne wòanyo na wò, eye nadzi ɖe dzi le anyigba, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la dzi, abe alesi Yehowa, fofowòwo ƒe Mawu la, do ŋugbe na wò ene.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Israel, see, Yehowa, mía Mawu la, Yehowa ɖeka koe!

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Eyata tsɔ wò dzi blibo kple wò luʋɔ blibo kpakple wò ŋusẽ katã lɔ̃ Yehowa, wo Mawu la.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Ku wo ɖe to me na viwòwo, eye naƒo nu le wo ŋu, ne èbɔbɔ nɔ aƒewò me, alo nèle mo dzi, ne èmlɔ anyi, alo nèfɔ.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Bla wo ɖe wò asi ŋu abe dzesi ene, eye bla wo ɖe ŋgonu le ŋudome;

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, kple wò va anyigba, si ŋu wòka atam ɖo na fofowòwo Abraham, Isak kple Yakob bena, yeatsɔe na wò dzi, afisi du gã nyui, siwo menye wòe tso wo o la le,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: eye xɔwo yɔ fũ kple nu nyui, siwo menye wòe de wo me o, afisi vudo, siwo menye wòe ɖe wo o, kple weingble kpakple amitibɔ, siwo menye wòe tso wo o la le, eye nèɖu nu ɖi ƒo la,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: ekema kpo nyuie, bena mãgaŋlɔ Yehowa, si kplɔ wò tso kluvinyenyeƒe me, le Egipte-nyigba dzi la be o.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ Yehowa, wò Mawu la, eye nasubɔe, eye natsɔ eƒe ŋkɔ aka atame.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Migadze dukɔ, siwo ƒo xlã mi la, ƒe mawuwo yome o.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu la, ŋuʋã Mawu wònye le dowòme, bena Yehowa magaɖo dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋuwò, eye woatsrɔ̃ wò ɖa le anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Migate Yehowa, mia Mawu la kpo, abe alesi mietee kpɔ le Masa la ene o;

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: ke boŋ miwo Yehowa, mia Mawu, ƒe sewo, eƒe ɖaseɖiɖiwo kple ɖoɖowo, siwo wògblɔ na mi la dzi.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Ne viwò ava bia wò gbaɖegbe bena: Nukata Yehowa, mía Mawu, gblɔ ɖaseɖiɖi, ɖoɖo kple se siawo na mi hã la,

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: ekema gblɔ na viwò bena: Míenye kluviwo na Farao le Egipte kpɔ, eye Yehowa tsɔ asi sesẽ kplɔ mi tso Egipte,

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: eye Yehowa wɔ dzesi kple nukunu gã dziŋɔwo le Egipte, ɖe Farao kple eƒe aƒe blibo la ŋu miekpɔ;

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: ke èkplɔ miawo va tso afima, bena wòakplɔ mi ayii, ne wòatsɔ anyigba, si ŋu wòka atam ɖo na mía fofowo la na mí.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Ne mielé se siawo katã me ɖe asi, eye miewɔ wo dzi, abe alesi wòɖe se na mi ene la, woabui dzɔdzɔenyenye na mi.

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Eyata lé se kple ɖoɖo kpakple kɔnu, siwo megblɔ na wò egbe la me ɖe asi, eye nawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Atsrɔ̃ dukɔ, siwo katã Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsɔ de asi na wò la; megakpɔ wo ta o, eye megasubɔ woƒe mawuwo o, elabena woava nye mɔ̃ aɖe wò.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: eye Yehowa, wò Mawu, tso wo de asi na wò nèɖu wo dzi la, ekema, natsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi, megabla nu kpli wo o, eye megave wo nu o.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: elabena woana viwòŋutsu natrɔ le yonyeme, eye wòasubɔ mawu bubuwo, ale bena Yehowa nado dɔmedzoe ɖe mia ŋu, eye woatsrɔ̃ mi amloamlo.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ale miawɔ wo enye si; Mimũ woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, eye migbã woƒe legbawo, milé woƒe Asera-tiwo ƒu anyi, eye mitɔ dzo woƒe aklama kpakpɛwo.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔ kɔkɔe nènye na Yehowa, wò Mawu la; Yehowa, wò Mawu, tia wò tso dukɔwo katã dome le anyigba dzi, bena nanye eya ŋutɔ ƒe dukɔ.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: ke boŋ esi Yehowa lɔ̃ mi, eye wòwɔ eƒe atam, si wòka na mia fofowo dzi ta Yehowa tsɔ asi sesẽ kplɔ mi tso kluvinyenyeƒe me, eye wòɖe mi tso Farao, Egipte-fia si me.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Eyata nyae bena, Yehowa, wò Mawu la, Mawu vavã kple Mawu anukwaretɔ wònye, amesi wɔa eƒe nubabla kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ dzi na amesiwo lɔ̃nɛ, eye wowɔa eƒe se dzi la, vaseɖe dzidzime akpe dzi;

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: eɖoa teƒe na eƒe fufuwo ŋutɔwo, eye wòtsrɔ̃a wo, eye mehena ɖe megbe le eƒe futɔwo tsɔtsrɔ̃ me o.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Woayra wò aƒo dukɔwo katã ta: mia dometɔa ɖeke magbe vidzidzi o, eye miaƒe lãwo matsi ko o.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Megado ŋunyɔnua ɖeke va aƒewò me o, ne busu nava dziwò abe woawo ke ene o; ke boŋ woanyɔ ŋu na wò aganyɔ ŋu na wò ɖe dzi, elabena busunu wonye.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: eye wòalɔ̃ wò, ayra wò, eye wòana nadzi ɖe dzi, ayra wò dɔmevi kple wò anyigba dzi nukuwo, wò bli, wò wein kple wò ami, wò nyinɔ kple wò alẽnɔ, le anyigba, si ŋu wòka atam ɖo na fofowòwo be, yeatsɔe na wò la dzi.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ne miese se siawo, mielé wo me ɖe asi, eye miewɔ wo dzi la, ekema Yehowa, mia Mawu, awɔ nubabla kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ, si ŋu wòka atam ɖo na mia fofowo la dzi,

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa axe mɔ na dɔlélewo tsyo ƒomevi le ŋuwò, eye makplɔ Egiptedɔvɔ̃, siwo katã nenya la, aƒu wò o, ke boŋ akplɔ wo aƒu wò ketɔwo.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Ne abu le wò dzi me be: dukɔ siawo sɔ gbɔ wum, aleke mate ŋu anyã wo hã la,

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: megavɔ̃ wo o, boŋ ɖo ŋku nusi Yehowa, wo Mawu, wo Farao kple Egipte blibo la dzi,

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: eye ɖo ŋku ŋusẽnuwɔwɔ, siwo nèkpɔ kple ŋku, dzesiwo kple nukunuwo, asi sesẽ kple alɔ, si wodo ɖe dzi, siwo Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsɔ kplɔ wò la dzi. Alea ke Yehowa, wò Mawu, awɔ dukɔ, siwo katã vɔ̃m nele lae.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò Mawu, aɖo teamekplɔɖoewo hã ɖe wodome, vaseɖe esime ame mlɔeawo kple amesiwo si yia la, naku avɔ le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Womegadzi ŋɔ na wò o, elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu, si nye Mawu gã, si ŋu vɔvɔ̃ le la, le dowòme.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò Mawu, anyã dukɔ siawo ɖa le ŋgɔwò ʋeʋeʋe; matsrɔ̃ wo zi ɖeka o, ne lã wɔadãwo magadzi ɖe dzi ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: atsɔ woƒe fiawo aɖe asi na wò, eye natsrɔ̃ woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le dziƒoa te. Wo dometɔa ɖeke manɔ te ɖe nuwo o, vaseɖe esime natsrɔ̃ wo avɔ.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Mitɔ dzo woƒe aklama kpakpɛwo, eye wo ŋu sika kple klosalo megabiã ŋu na mi, ne miatsɔ wo na mia ɖokui ahaɖo mɔ̃ me o, elabena ŋunyɔnu wonye na Yehowa, mia Mawu la.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Milé se, siwo katã meɖe na mi egbea la me ɖe asi, eye miwo wo dzi, bena miano agbe, míadzi ɖe dzi, eye miayi aɖaxɔ anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na mia fofowo la wòanye mia to.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Eye wòbɔbɔ wò ɖe anyi hena dɔ wu wò, eye wonyre wò kple mana, si wò ŋutɔ kple fofowòwo mienyã o, bena wòana nadze sii be, amegbetɔ mele abolo ƒe agbe ko o, ke boŋ amegbetɔ le agbe le nya, siwo katã do tso Yehowa nu la ta.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Eyata nyae le wò dzi me bena, ɖe Yehowa le nu fiãm wò, abe alesi ŋutsu fia nunya via ene.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Wo Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe seawo dzi, ne nato eƒe mɔ, eye navɔ̃e.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu, le kplɔ wò ge ava anyigba nyui, si dzi tɔʋuwo, vudowo kple tawo, siwo dzɔ tso towo dzi kple baliwo me le la dzi,

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Ne èɖu nu ɖi ƒo la, ekema kafu Yehowa, wò Mawu, le anyigba nyui, si wòna wò la ta.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Ke kpo nyuie, bena màgaŋlɔ Yehowa, wò Mawu be, eye nagbe eƒe sewo, kɔnuwo kple ɖoɖowo, siwo megblɔ na wò egbe la dziwɔwɔ o;

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: eye naɖu nu aɖi ƒo, atu xɔ nyuiwo ano me,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: wò nyiwo kple alẽwo nadzi ɖe dzi, klosalo kple sika nasɔ gbɔ ɖe asiwò, eye wò nuwo katã nadzi ɖe dzi avɔ tso,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: hafi nado ɖokuiwò ɖe dzi, eye naŋlɔ Yehowa, wò Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso kluvinyenyeƒe me le Egipte-nyigba dzi la be o;

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: eye naŋlɔ amesi kplɔ wò to gbe gã dziŋɔ ma dzi, afisi da vɔ̃wo kple dziɖegbewo le, afisi tsi vena le, eye wòna tsi ɖo tso agakpe sesẽ la me,

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: amesi tso mana, si mia kple fofowòwo mienyã o la, nyro wò le gbeadzi, ne woabɔbɔ wò ɖe anyi, eye wòado wò akpɔ, be wòava wo nu nyui na wò emegbe la be o.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Eye megabu le ɖokuiwò me be: Nye ŋutɔ nye ŋusẽ kple nye asi sesẽe metsɔ kpɔ kesinɔnu siawoe o;

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: ke boŋ ɖo ŋku Yehowa, wò Mawu la dzi, elabena eyae na ŋusẽ wò, be nakpɔ kesinɔnuwo, ne wòawɔ nusi wòbia kple fofowòwo la dzi, abe alesi wòzu egbe siawo ene.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: miatsrɔ̃ abe dukɔ, siwo Yehowa be, yeatsrɔ̃ ɖa le mia ŋgɔ la ene, le esi mieɖo to Yehowa, mia Mawu, ƒe gbe o la ta!

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Israel, see, èle Yordan tso ge egbea, ne nayi aɖanyã dukɔ, siwo sɔ gbɔ, eye wosesẽ wu wò, eye naxɔ woƒe du, siwo lolo, eye wo ŋu gliwo kɔ ɖatɔ dziƒo la,

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: dukɔ, siwo nye Enak-viwo, wosɔ gbɔ, eye wodzɔ atsu, amesiwo wò ŋutɔ nènya kple amesiwo ŋu nèse nya le bena: Ameka ate ŋu ano te ɖe Enak-viwo nu?

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Eyata nyae egbea bena, Yehowa, wò Mawu, si nye dzo binu la, dze ŋgɔwò yi toa godo, eya ŋuta atsrɔ̃ wo, eye woaɖu wo dzi le ŋgɔwò, be nanyã wo, eye natsrɔ̃ wo amloamlo, abe alesi Yehowa do ŋugbe na wò ene.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi, eye megaŋlɔ alesi nèɖo dɔmedzoe na Yehowa, wò Mawu, le gbedzi la be o! Miesẽ to ɖe Yehowa ŋu, tso gbesigbe ke mieʋu tso Egipte, vaseɖe esime mieva teƒe sia.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Mieɖo dziku na Yehowa le Xoreb gbɔ, eye Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe mia ŋu be, yeatsrɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena; Netsɔ naɖi ayi, elabena wò dukɔ, si nèkplɔ tso Egipte la, wɔ nu gbegblẽ, wote ɖa le mɔ, si meɖo na wo la dzi enumake, eye wokɔ legba na wo ɖokui.

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Mekpɔ dukɔ sia bena, dukɔ kɔlialiatɔ wònye.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ɖe asi le ŋunye, ne matsrɔ̃ wo, eye matutu woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le dziƒoa te, eye mawɔ wò nazu dukɔ, si asẽ ŋu, eye wòasɔ gbɔ awu wo.

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Tete metrɔ heɖi tso to la dzi, le esime dzo le dzi ɖem le to la nu, eye melé nubabla ƒe kpe eveawo ɖe nye asiawo kple eve.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ bena, miewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu la ŋu, miekɔ nyivi na mia ɖokui, eye miete ɖa le mɔ, si Yehowa ɖo na mi la dzi enumake.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Tete mekɔ kpe eve, siwo le nye asiawo kple eve la dzi hexlã ɖe anyi, eye megbã wo le mia ŋku me.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ŋutɔ ɖe Aron hã ŋu be, yeatsrɔ̃e; ke meɖe kuku ɖe Aron hã ta ɣemaɣi.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Eye mexɔ nyivi, si miewɔ nuvɔ̃ hewɔ la, ɖe dzo me, eye metui memee wòtrɔ zu ʋuʋudedi, eye melɔ ʋuʋudedi la kɔ ɖe tɔʋu, si si tso toa dzi la me.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Eye mìedo dɔmedzoe na Yehowa le Tabera, Masa kple nudzrolawo ɖiƒe.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Esi Yehowa dɔ mi le Kades-Barnea gblɔ bena: miyi, ne miaxɔ anyigba, si mena mi, ne wòanye mia tɔ ta, miesẽ to ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu, ƒe nya ŋu, mieɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu o, eye miese eƒe gbe o.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Tso esime menya mi la, to kokoko sẽm miele ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Ale mede ta agu na Yehowa, eye metsi nenema ŋkeke blane kple zã blane, le esi Yehowa gblɔ be, yeatsrɔ̃ mi ta.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Eye medo gbe ɖa na Yehowa gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ Yehowa, megagblẽ wò dukɔ, si nye wò ŋutɔ tɔ la o, dukɔ, si neɖe kple wò ŋusẽ gã, eye nètsɔ wò asi sesẽ kplɔe tso Egipte.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò dɔlawo Abraham, Isak kple Yakob dzi, eye megaɖo ŋku dukɔ sia ƒe tamesesẽ, nuvlowɔwɔ kple nuvɔ̃ dzi o;

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: ne anyigba, si dzi nè-kplɔ mí tsoe la, magagblɔ be: Esi Yehowa mekpe be, wòakplɔ wo ayi anyigba, si ŋugbe wòdo na wo la dzi o, eye esi wòlé fu wo ta wòkplɔ wo ɖo, be wòawu wo le gbedzi;

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: evɔ wònye dukɔ, si nye wò ŋutɔ tɔ wònye, eye nètsɔ wò ŋusẽ gã kple wò abɔ, si nedo ɖe dzi kplɔ wo hafi.

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam ɣemaɣi bena: Kpa kpe eve abe gbãtɔwo ene, eye nava gbɔnye le to la dzi, eye natsɔ ʋuƒo akpa aɖaka,

english_verse: When I had taken the second set of stones up the mountain, I spent
translation_verse: Ke metsi to la dzi ŋkeke blane kple zã blane abe tsã ene; eye Yehowa se nye gbe ɣemaɣi hã, eye Yehowa be, yemagatsrɔ̃ wò o.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: ne maŋlɔ nya, siwo nɔ kpe gbãtɔ, siwo nègbã dzi la, ɖe wo dzi, eye natsɔ wo ade aɖaka la me.

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Tete metsɔ xé kpa aɖaka la, eye mekpa kpe eve abe gbãtɔwo ene, eye metsɔ kpe eveawo ɖe asi helia to la.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ nya ewoawo, siwo Yehowa gblɔ na mi tso to la dzi le dzo me le takpegbe la, ɖe kpeawo dzi abe tsã ene, eye Yehowa tsɔ wo de asi nam.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Tete megbugbɔ heɖi tso to la dzi, eye metsɔ kpeawo ɖe aɖaka, si mewo la me, eye wotsi afima, abe alesi Yehowa ɖe se nam ene.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ Yehowa, wò Mawu la, eye nasubɔe, ku ɖe eŋu, eye eƒe ŋkɔ dzi naka atam ɖo.

english_verse: When your ancestors went to live in Egypt, there were only
translation_verse: Fofowòwo le ame blaadre hafi va Egipte, ke azɔ la Yehowa, wò Mawu, na mèsɔ gbɔ abe dziƒoɣletiviwo ene.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-viwo ho tso Beerot-Bene-Yaakan heva Mosera, afisi Aron ku ɖo, eye woɖii ɖe afima, eye via Eleazar zu nunɔla ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Woho tso afima heva Hagudgod, eye woho tso Hagudgod heva Yotba, anyigba, si dzi tɔʋuwo le.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖa Lewi-to la ɣemaɣi, bena woatsɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la, woawɔ subɔsubɔdɔ le Yehowa ŋku me, eye woayra ame ɖe eƒe ŋkɔ dzi, va do egbe.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Tso, nayi àdze dukɔ la ŋgɔ, bena woahe ayi aɖaxɔ anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo na wo fofowo bena, matsɔe na wo wòanye wo tɔ la. Nuka Aƒetɔ bia le Israel si.

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Eyata Israel, Yehowa, wò Mawu la, mele naneke dim tso asiwò o, negbe esia ko be, nava Yehowa, wò Mawu la, eye nazɔ eƒe mɔwo katã dzi, nalɔ̃e, eye nasubɔ Yehowa, wò Mawu la, tso wò dzi blibo kple wò luʋɔ blibo me;

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: eye nawɔ Yehowa ƒe se kple ɖoɖo, siwo megblɔ na wò egbe la dzi, bena wòanyo na wò.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, dziƒo kple dziƒowo ƒe dziƒo kple anyigba kpakple nusiwo katã le edzi, wonye Yehowa, wò Mawu la to;

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: hafi Yehowa tia mia fofowo ɖeɖeko, eye wòlɔ̃ wo hetia mi, amesiwo nye wo megbeviwo, tso dukɔwo katã dome, abe alesi wòzu egbe siawo ene. Mitso aʋa na miaƒe dziwo!

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Eyata mitso aʋa na miaƒe dziwo, eye migalia ʋume azɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, mia Mawu la, enye mawuwo dzi Mawu kple aƒetɔwo dzi Aƒetɔ, Mawu gã, si ŋu ŋusẽ kple ŋɔdzi le, amesi medea ame dzi o, eye mexɔa zãnua ɖeke o;

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: amesi tsoa afia na tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo, eye wolɔa amedzro hena abolo kple avɔtatae.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Eyata milɔ̃ amedzro, elabena miawo hã míenye amedzrowo le Egipte-nyigba dzi kpo.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Eya nye wò kafukafu kple wò Mawu, si wo nu gã dziŋɔwo, esiwo nèkpɔ kple ŋku la na wò.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Eyata lɔ̃ Yehowa, wò Mawu la, eye nawɔ eƒe nufiamewo kple ɖoɖowo, kɔnuwo kple sewo dzi ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Eye midze si Yehowa, mia Mawu, ƒe amehehe kple eƒe gãnyenye, eƒe asi sesẽ kple eƒe abɔ, si wòɖo ɖe dzi egbe — menye mia vi, siwo menyae o, eye womekpɔ eteƒe o lae mele egblɔm na o —

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: kple eƒe dzesiwo kpakple nutsuwɔwɔ, siwo wowu le Egipte, ɖe Egipte-fia Farao kple eƒe anyigba blibo la ŋu;

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: midze si nusi wowɔ Egipte-ʋakɔwo, woƒe sɔwo kple tasiaɖamwo, esi wòna Avaƒu la ŋe ɖe wo dzi, esime woti mia yome, eye Yehowa tsrɔ̃ wo va do egbee;

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: kple nusi wò wo na mi le gbedzi, vaseɖe esime mieɖo afisia,

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: kpakple nusi wòwɔ Ruben-vi, Eliab ƒe viŋutsuwo Datan kple Abiram, amesiwo anyigba ke nu mi hekpe ɖe wo xɔwo, wo agbadɔwo kple nu gbagbe, siwo katã le wo si la ŋuti, tso Israel blibo la dome.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Elabena mia ŋutɔwo miekpɔ nu gã, siwo Yehowa wo la, kple ŋku. Toɖoɖo ŋu yayra, tomaɖomaɖo ŋu fiƒode.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Eyata miwo se, siwo katã mede na mi egbe la dzi, bena ŋusẽ nana mia ŋu, eye miayi aɖaxɔ anyigba, si dzi yim miele, be miaxɔ la wòanye mia to,

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: eye mianɔ agbe didie le anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na mia fofowo be, yeatsɔ na woa kple wo viwo la dzi, anyigba, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Elabena anyigba, sidzi yim nèle, be naxɔe wòanye towo la, mele abe Egipte-nyigba, si dzi nèʋu tso, afisi, ne éƒã nuku la, netsɔa afɔ troa mɔ̃ hedea sii abe amagbebɔ ene la ene o;

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: ke boŋ towo kple gbadzaƒewo le anyigba, si dzi yim nèle, be naxɔe wòanye towo la dzi, eye wonoa tsi, si dza tso dziƒo;

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, léa be na, eye Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe ŋku le eŋu tso ƒe la ƒe gɔmedzedze vaseɖe nuwuwu.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Ne mielé to ɖe se, siwo mede na mi egbe ŋu pɛpɛpɛ, eye mielɔ̃ Yehowa, mia Mawu la, eye míesubɔe tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me la,

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie, ne miagana miaƒe dzi naɖu mi, eye miatrɔ asubɔ mawu bubuwo, eye miade ta agu na wo o;

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: ne Yehowa magado dɔmedzoe ɖe mia ŋu, eye woatu dziƒo nu, bena tsi magadza, eye anyigbadzĩnuwo nagbe wɔwɔ o, eye miatsrɔ̃ ava le anyigba, si Yehowa le mia na ge la dzi amloamlo o.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Eyata mina nye nya siawo nage ɖe miaƒe dzi kple miaƒe luʋɔ me, mibla wo ɖe asi ŋu abe dzesi ene, eye mibla woɖe ŋgonu le ŋudome.
