english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Mifia wo mia viwo, eye miƒo nu le wo ŋu, ne miebɔbɔ no miaƒe aƒewo me, alo miele mɔ dzi, ne miemlɔ anyi, alo miefɔ,

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: eye ŋlɔ wo ɖe wò xa ƒe ʋɔtrutiwo kple wò agbowo ŋu,

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: ne mia kple mia viwo miano agbe didie le anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na mia fofowo be, yeatsɔe na wo la dzi, abe alesi dziƒo anɔ anyigba tame eteƒe nadidii ene.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Elabena ne miewɔ se, siwo katã meɖe na mi egbe, be miawɔ la dzi pɛpɛpɛ, mielɔ̃ Yehowa, mia Mawu la, miezɔ eƒe mɔwo katã dzi, eye mieku ɖe eŋu la,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: ekema Yehowa anyã dukɔ siawo katã ɖa le mia ŋgɔ, eye miaxɔ dukɔ, siwo lolo, eye wosesẽ wu mi la, ƒe anyigba.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Afisiafi, si mieɖo afɔe la, azu mia to, eye miaƒe liƒo atso gbedzi kple Libanon gbɔ kpakple Frat nu vaseɖe ɣetoɖoƒe gome le ƒu la nu.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke manɔ te ɖe mia nu o, eye Yehowa, mia Mawu, ana ŋɔdzi kple vovɔ̃, si le mia ŋu la, naɖo anyigba blibo, si dzi va ge míala la, abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe na mi ene.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metso yayra kple fiƒode ɖo mia ŋku me egbea.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Ne mieɖo to Yehowa, mia Mawu ƒe se, siwo mede na mi egbe la, anye yayra na mi.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Ke ne mieɖo to Yehowa, mia Mawu ƒe seawo o, eye miete ɖa le mo, si meɖo na mi egbe dzi hesubɔ mawu bubu, siwo mienyã o la, anye fiƒode na mi.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, kplɔ wò va anyigba, si dzi yim nèle, be naxɔe wòanye tɔwò dzi la, ekema natsɔ Gerizĩm awɔ yayrato, eye natsɔ Ebal awɔ fiƒodetoe.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Wole Yordan ƒe go keme dzi le mɔ, si le ɣetoɖoƒe gome la dzi, le Kanaanitɔ, siwo le gbadzaƒe la, ƒe anyigba dzi le Gilgal kasa hete ɖe More ƒe ati gãwo gbɔ.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Ne mietso Yordan va anyigba, si Yehowa, mia Mawu, le mia na ge wòanye mia to la dzi, eye miexɔe wònye mia lɔ miele edzi la,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: ekema milé se kple ɖoɖo, siwo medo mia ŋku me egbe la me ɖe asi, eye miwɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Esiawo nye ɖoɖo kple se, siwo me míalé ɖe asi, eye miawo wo dzi ŋkeke alesi miele anyigba, si Yehowa, mia fofowo ƒe Mawu, na mi, be wòanye mia to la dzi.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Migblẽ teƒe, siwo katã dukɔ, siwo mienyã la, subɔa woƒe mawuwo le, le to kɔkɔwo kple togbɛwo dzi kpakple ati damawo te.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Migbã woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, eye mimu woƒe aƒeliwo, mitɔ dzo woƒe Asera-tiwo, eye migbã woƒe legbawo, eye mitsrɔ̃ woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le teƒe ma. Afisi kple alesi woasubɔ Mawu bliboe.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Migawɔ alea na Yehowa, mia Mawu o,

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Ne teƒe, si Yehowa, wò Mawu tia, be yeƒe ŋkɔ nanɔ, didi na wò akpa la, ekema wu wò nyi alo alẽ, si Yehowa na wò la, abe alesi mede se na wò ene, eye naɖui le wò du me, abe alesi nèdi ene.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Ke woaɖui, abe alesi woɖua sẽ alo zi ene; amesi ŋu mekɔ o, kple amesi ŋu kɔ la siaa kpɔ mɔ aɖui.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Megaɖui o, bena wòanyo na mia kple megbewòviwo, le esi nèwɔ nusi dze Yehowa ŋu la ta.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: eye nawɔ wò numevɔsawo ƒe lã kple ʋu siaa ŋu da le Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, ke nakɔ wò akpedavɔsa ƒe ʋu ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye natsɔ lã la aɖu.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Lé nya, siwo katã megblɔ na wò la me ɖe asi, eye naɖo to wo, bena wòanyo na mia kple megbewòviwo tegbee, le esi nèwɔ nusi nyo, eye wòdza le Yehowa, wò Mawu, ŋku me ta.

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: Ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, atsrɔ̃ dukɔ, siwo gbɔ nèyina, be nanyã wo la ɖa le ŋgɔwò, eye nènyã wo hetso aƒe ɖe woƒe anyigba dzi la,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: ekema kpo nyuie, bena nagadze wo yome aɖo mɔ̃ me o; eye ne wotsrɔ̃ wo le ŋgɔwò megbe la, megabia woƒe mawuwo ta se agblɔ be: alesi dukɔ siawo le woƒe mawuwo subɔme la, nenema nye hã mawo o.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Megawɔ alea na Yehowa, wò Mawu la o, elabena ŋunyɔnu, siwo katã Yehowa lé fui la, eya wowɔna na woƒe mawuwo; wotɔa dzo wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo gɔ̃ hã na woƒe mawuwo.

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: eye dzesi alo nukunu, si wògblɔ la, va me, emegbe wògblɔ be, mina miadze mawu bubu, siwo mienyã o yome, eye miasubɔ wo la,

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: ekema migaɖo to nyagblɔɖila alo drɔ̃ekula ma ƒe nyawo o, elabena ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu la, Me mia dom kpɔ, ne yeadze sii be, mielɔ̃ Yehowa, mia Mawu la, tso miaƒe dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me hã?

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Midze Yehowa, mia Mawu yome, eye nuvɔ̃e, milé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi, eye miɖo to eƒe gbe, misubɔe, eye miku ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Ele be, naƒu kpee woaku, elabena edi be, yeana natrɔ le Yehowa, wò Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso kluvinyenyeƒe me le Egipte-nyigba dzi la yome;

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: eye Israel blibo la nasee, eye woavɔ̃, ne womagawɔ nu vɔ̃ɖisia tɔgbe le mia dome azɔ o.

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: Ne èse le du, siwo Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge nanɔ me la, dometɔ ɖeka ŋu be,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: ŋutsu yakamea ɖewo tso mia dome, eye woble duametɔwo gblɔ bena: mina miayi aɖasubɔ mawu bubu, siwo mienyã o la,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: ekema di nya la gɔme, eye nabia eta tsitotsito. Eye nenye nyateƒee be, wowɔ nua, eye wowɔ ŋunyɔnu sia le mia dome la,

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye mialɔ aboyonuawo katã ava kɔ ɖe ablɔ me, eye miatɔ dzo du la kple aboyonuawo katã abe vɔsa blibo ene na Yehowa, mia Mawu la, ale be wòatrɔ zu aƒedo ɖikaɖika, eye womagagbugbɔe atso akpɔ o.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Megana busunuawo dometɔa ɖeke nalé ɖe wò asi ŋu o, bena Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe nu nata, eye wòave nuwo ahana nadzi ɖe dzi, abe alesi wòka atam na fofowòwo ene;

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: elabena dukɔ kɔkɔe nènye na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, eye Yehowa tia wò tso dukɔwo katã dome le anyigba dzi, ne nanye eya ŋutɔ ƒe dukɔ. Nuɖuɖu tsitsriwo kple nuɖuɖu matsrimatsriwo.

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu xe, siwo katã ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: Megaɖu ŋunyɔnua ɖeke o.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu lãfɔne, siwo katã ƒe afɔkli me fe, eye wodzɔa nu ɖuna.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Esiwo dzɔa nu ɖuna, kple esiwo ƒe afɔkli me fe dometɔ, siwo miekpɔ mɔ aɖu o la, wonye: kposɔ, fɔmizi kple xɔfie, elabena wodzɔa nu ɖuna, gake woƒe afɔkli me mefe o; ŋunyɔnu wonye na mi,

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: kpakple ha, elabena eƒe afɔkli me fe, gake medzɔa nu ɖuna o; ŋunyɔnu wònye na mi. Migaɖu woƒe lã o, eye migaɖe asi woƒe kukua ŋu o.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Tɔmelã, siwo katã miekpɔ mɔ aɖu, wonye esiwo ŋu adza kple tsro le;

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: ke esiwo katã ŋu adza kple tsro mele o la, miekpɔ mɔ aɖu wo o; ŋunyɔnu wonye na mi.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Nu dzodzoewo katã nye ŋunyɔnu na mi; miekpɔ mɔ aɖu wo o.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Ke miekpɔ mɔ aɖu xe, siwo katã ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Migaɖu lã kukua ɖeke o, gake miekpɔ mɔ atsɔe na amedzro, si le wò du me la wòaɖu, alo nadzrae na du bubu me tɔwo; elabena dukɔ kɔkɔe nènye na Yehowa, wò Mawu la. Megaɖa gbɔ̃vi le dada ƒe notsi me o. Ewolia nana.

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Na wò agblemenuwo ƒe ewolia ƒe sia ƒe pɛpɛpɛ,

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: eye nano wò wein ƒe ewolia, eye naɖu wò bli kple wò ami ƒe ewolia kpakple wò nyi kple alẽwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo le teƒe, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, atia be, yeƒe ŋkɔ nanɔ la, ne nanya alesi nava Yehowa, wò Mawu lae ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Ke ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, yra wò, eye mɔ didi na wò akpa, be màte ŋu atsɔ wo ayii o, elabena teƒe, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, atia be, yeƒe ŋkɔ nano la gbɔ metsɔ na wò o la,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ ga la aƒle nusianu, si dze ŋuwò, eɖanye nyi alo alẽ, wein alo aha sesẽa de alo nusianu, si nèdi la o, eye mia kple aƒewò me tɔwo miaɖu nu akpɔ dzidzɔ le afima le Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Megagblẽ Lewitɔ, si le wò du me la ɖi o, elabena mexɔ gome alo domenyinua ɖeke kpe ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Fe etɔ̃ sia ƒe etɔ̃ megbe la naɖe wò agblemenu, siwo nèxa le ƒe ma me la, ƒe ewolia agblẽ ɖe wò du me,

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: hena Lewitɔwo — elabena womexɔ gome alo domenyinua ɖeke kpe ɖe ŋuwò o — kple amedzro, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo, amesiwo le wò du me la, nakpɔ nu aɖu aɖi ƒo, ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, nayra wò le wò asinudɔ, siwo katã nèwɔna la me.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Ne nɔviwòwo dometɔa ɖe da ahe le wò dua ɖe me le wò anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge dzi la, ekema megasẽ wò dzime, eye namiã asi ɖe noviwò dahe la o;

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Ale woatsɔ fe ake enye si: Ne amea ɖe ɖo nu na nɔvia la, wòatsɔ fe la ake, mekpɔ mɔ ali fe ehavi alo nɔvia o, elabena Yehowa na be, woaɖe gbe ƒã be, woatso fe ake.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ mɔ ali fe du bubu me tɔwo, gake megali nusi nèdo na noviwò la ƒe fee o.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu, ayra wò, abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe na wò ene, ale be nado agbana na dukɔ geɖewo, ke wò ŋutɔ màdo nugbana o, aɖu amegã ɖe dukɔ geɖewo dzi, ke woawo maɖu amegã ɖe dziwò o.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: ke boŋ naʋu wò asi nɛ, eye naɖo nugbana nɛ, abe alesi hiãe ene.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nyuie, bena tamesusu dzodzroa ɖeke magava wò dzime, eye nagblɔ bena: ƒe adrelia tu aƒe, eye wole fe tsa ge ake, eye natre ŋku ɖe noviwò dahe la agbe nunanae o; ne wòagayɔ Yehowa ɖe dziwò, eye wòatro zu nuvɔ̃ na wò o;

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: ke boŋ nae faa, eye megave wò, bena nènae o, elabena esia ta Yehowa, wò Mawu, yra wò le wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã kple nusiwo nèwɔ dɔ kpɔ la me.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ke ne nu wòe, eƒe afia ɖe ŋe, eƒe ŋku gbã, alo nu manyatanua ɖe wòe la, ekema megatsɔe sa vo na Yehowa, wò Mawu la o.

english_verse: If any of you buy Israelites as slaves, you must set them free after six years.
translation_verse: Ne noviwò, Hebri-ŋutsu alo Hebri-nyɔnu, tsa eɖokui dzra na wò la, ekema wòasubɔ wò ƒe ade, ke le ƒe adrelia me la, naɖe asi le eŋu woadzo le gbɔwò.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Eye ne èɖe asi le eŋu wodzo le gbɔwò la, megana wòayi asi gbɔlo o;

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: ke boŋ natsɔ wò alé, wò bli kple wò wein, siwo me Yehowa wò Mawu yra wò le la, ado agba, nɛ.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Ke ne egblɔ na wò bena, yemadzo le gbɔwò o, metɔwo miaɖu wo le Yehowa, wò tɔwo, eye gbɔwò nanɔ dze ye ŋu la,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: ekema natsɔ nuŋɔnui aŋɔ to nɛ amimi ɖe ʋɔtru ŋu, ne woatsi gbɔwò ɖika. Alea nawɔ na wò kosiwo hã.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Kɔ wò nyi kple alẽwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo, siwo nye atsu la ŋu na Yehowa, wò Mawu la; megana wò nyitsu, siwo nye ŋgɔgbéawo la, nawɔ dɔ na wò o, eye megako fu le wò alẽwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo ŋu o;

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: ke boŋ mia kple aƒewò me tɔwo miaɖu wo le Yehowa, wò Mawu ŋku me ƒe sia ƒe le teƒe, si Yehowa atia.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Ekpa mo aɖui le wò duwo me, eye amesi ŋu meka o kple amesi ŋu kɔ siaa kpɔ mɔ aɖui, abe alesi woɖua sẽ kple zi ene;

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: negbe eƒe ʋu ko mèkpɔ mo aɖu o, ke boŋ naɖuɖui ɖe anyigba abe tsi ene.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Wò ŋku nena nuŋeɣleti la ŋu, eye naɖu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, elabena nuŋeɣleti la dzi Yehowa, wò Mawu, kplɔ wò tso Egipte de zã me.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nya dzɔdzɔe yome kokoko nadi, ne nanɔ agbe, eye naxɔ anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge la wòanye tɔwò.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ade sɔŋ naɖu nu maʋamaʋã, ke ŋkeke adrelia enye takpegbe na Yehowa, wò Mawu la; megawɔ dɔa ɖeke le edzi o.

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Eye nawu alẽwo kple nyiwo le ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la dzi na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, le teƒe, si Yehowa atia be, yeƒe ŋkɔ nanɔ.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Mèkpɔ mɔ awu lã hena ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la le wò du sia du, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, ana wò la me o;

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: ke boŋ nawui le teƒe, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, atia be, yeƒe ŋkɔ nana; afima naɖu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la le, le fiẽ, ne ɣe ɖo to, ɣeyiɣi, si dzi neʋu tso Egipte.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Eye naɖae aɖu le teƒe, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, atia la; ke ne ŋu ke la, nagbugbɔ ayi wò xa nu.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Eye megaɖi aƒelia ɖeke, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, lé fui la o.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Megado Asera-tia ɖeke ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe vɔsamlekpui, si nadi la gbɔ o.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: Xlẽ kwasiɖa adre; ne wode asi nukuwo xaxa me la, nadze wo xexlẽ gome

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Eye mia kple viwòŋutsu kple viwònyɔnu, wò dɔlaŋutsu kple wò dɔlanyɔnu kpakple Lewitɔ, si le wò du me, kple amedzro, tsyɔ̃evi kple ahosi, siwo le dowòme la, miakpɔ dzidzɔ le Yehowa, wò Mawu, ŋku me le teƒe, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, atia be, yeƒe ŋkɔ nano la.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amesiame nana nusi su esi, abe alesi Yehowa, wò Mawu, yrae ene. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kple dumegãwo ŋu nya.

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutsuwo katã nava Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe ŋku mezi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me le teƒe, si wòatia, le nu maʋamaʋã ŋkekenyuie, kwasiɖawo ƒe ŋkekenyuie kple agbadɔŋkekenyuie la dzi, eye womava Yehowa ŋku me asi gbɔlo o.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Megatsɔ nyitsu alo alé, si nane wɔe alo vloƒea ɖe le eŋu la, sa vɔ na Yehowa, wò Mawu la o, elabena ŋunyɔnu wònye na Yehowa, wò Mawu la.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔe na wò nèse la, ekema ɖi nya la gɔme tsitotsito, eye nenye nyateƒee wowɔ nua, eye wowɔ ŋunyɔnu sia le Israel la,

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: bena Israel blibo la nasee, eye wòavɔ̃, ne womagasẽ to azɔ o. Fia ŋu se.

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Ne eva anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge la dzi, eye nèxɔe wònye tɔwo nètso aƒe ɖe edzi, emegbe dagblɔ bena: Maɖo fia ɖe ɖokuinye nu abe dukɔ, siwo katã ƒo xlãm ene la,

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: ekema naɖo fia, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, atia la, ɖe ɖokuiwò nu; natsɔ nɔviwòwo dometɔ ɖeka aɖo fia ɖe ɖokuiwò nu; mèkpɔ mɔ aɖo du bubu me tɔ, si menye nɔviwò o la, ɖe ɖokuiwò nu o.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Ɖeko sɔ geɖe meganɔ esi o, eye megaɖo dukɔ la ɖe Egipte, be wòaƒle sɔwo o, elabena Yehowa gblɔna mi bena: Migagbugbɔ to mɔ sia dzi o.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Fia nagaɖe srɔ̃ geɖe o, ne eƒe dzi nagatre mɔ o, eye klosalo kple sika geɖe akpa hã meganɔ esi o.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Eye ne eva fiazi dzi la, wòana Lewitɔwo, siwo nye nunɔlawo la, nagbugbɔ se sia aŋlɔ nɛ ɖe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Eye wòanɔ esi wòaxlẽ le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me, ne wòanya alesi wòavɔ̃ Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la, eye wòalé se kple ɖoɖo siawo katã me nyawo me ɖe asi, eye wòawɔ wo dzi,

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: ne megado eɖokui ɖe dzi ɖe nɔviawo ŋu, eye wòadze le se la ŋu ɖe ɖusi alo mia me o, ne eya kple viaŋutsuwo nanɔ zi la dzi eteƒe nadidi le Israel dome.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Mele nyagblɔɖila ɖe ɖo ge na wo tso wo nɔviwo dome abe wò ene, eye wòagblɔ gbe, siwo katã meɖe asi nɛ la, na wo.

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Lewi-to blibo la, si nye nunɔlawo la, maxɔ gome alo domenyinua ɖeke akpe ɖe Israel ŋu o, ke boŋ woatsɔ Yehowa ƒe dzovɔsa, si nye woƒe domenyinu la, anyro wo ɖokui.

english_verse: because he has promised to provide for them in this way.
translation_verse: Womaxɔ domenyinua ɖeke ɖe wo nɔviwo dome o, elabena Yehowa ŋutɔe nye woƒe domenyinu, abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe na wo ene.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo ƒe adzɔ enye si: Ne dukɔ la tsɔ nyi alo alẽ sa akpedavɔ la, ekema woatsɔ abɔ kple glã kpakple dɔgbo na nunɔlawo.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu, da wo tso wò toawo katã me, bena woawo kple wo viwo nasubɔ le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Ne Lewitɔa ɖe tso Israel blibo la ƒe dua ɖe me, afisi wònye amedzro le, va la, ekpɔ mɔ ayi teƒe, si Yehowa atia la faa, abe alesi wòdi ene,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: eye wòasubɔ le Yehowa, eƒe Mawu, ƒe ŋkɔ me abe nɔvia Lewitɔ bubuawo katã, amesiwo le Yehowa ŋku me afima la ene.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Ne èyi anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge dzi la, ekema megasrɔ̃ dukɔ mawo ƒe ŋunyɔnuwo nawɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si le nusia wɔm la, ŋunyɔnu wònye na Yehowa, elabena ŋunyɔnu siawo la Yehowa, wò Mawu, le wo nyã ge le ŋgɔwò ɖo.

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔ, siwo nyã ge nala la, ɖoa to goloɖolawo kple bokɔnɔwo, ke wo la, Yehowa, wò Mawu, meɖe esia ƒe mɔ nɔ wò o. Nyagblɔɖila vavã la ava.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò Mawu, le nyagblɔɖila ɖe ɖo ge na wò tso nɔviwòwo dome abe nye ene, ame sia miaɖe toe!

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Esi neɖe kuku na Yehowa, wò Mawu, le Xoreb gbɔ le takpegbe la gblɔ bena; nyemate ŋu agase Yehowa, nye Mawu, ƒe gbe o, eye nyemate ŋu agakpɔ dzo gã sia, ne maku o la.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ nam be. Wògblɔe ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Amesi ke meɖo to nya, siwo wòagblɔ le nye ŋkɔ dzi o la, mabia tso ame la si.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ke ne nyagblɔɖilaa ɖe ɖo eɖokui ɖe dzi, eye wògblɔ nya, siwo nyemegblɔ nɛ o la, le nye ŋkɔ dzi, alo wògblɔ nya le mawu bubuwo ƒe ŋkɔ dzi la, woawu nyagblɔɖila ma.

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Ne abu le wò dzi me bena: Aleke miate ŋu adze si nya, si Yehowa megblɔ o la?

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne nyagblɔɖilaa ɖe gblɔ nya le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ dzi, gake nya la meva me o, eye medze edzi o la, ekema menye Yehowae gblɔ nya la o, ke boŋ nyagblɔɖila la ŋutɔe do eɖokui ɖe dzi hegblɔe; eyata megavɔ̃e o.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: ke esi nèle se blibo, si mede na wò egbe la, me ɖe asi, eye nèwɔ edzi, èlɔ̃ Yehowa, wò Mawu la, eye nezɔ eƒe mɔwo dzi ɣesiaɣi ta la, ekema natsɔ du etɔ̃ akpe ɖe wo ame etɔ̃ siawo ŋu,

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsrɔ̃ dukɔ, siwo ƒe anyigba Yehowa, wò Mawu be, yeatsɔ na wò, eye nènyã wo hele woƒe duwo kple xɔwo me la,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: alo ne amea ɖe kple nɔvia woyi ave me nake fɔ ge, eye wòkɔ fia dzi, be yealã nake, kasia fia tu le atia me hedze nɔvia woku la, ekema wòasi ayi du siawo dometɔ ɖeka me, bena woatsi agbe,

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Eyata mede se na wò be, natia du etɔ̃ na ɖokuiwò.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe lé fu nɔvia, eye wòde xa ɖi nɛ heƒo vevieƒe nɛ woku, emegbe wòsi yi du siawo dometɔ ɖeka me la,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: ekema wo de dumegãwo nadɔ ame woaɖakplɔe tso afima vɛ, eye woatsɔe ade asi na hiãtɔ, ne woawu.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Megakpɔ eta o, ke natutu ame maɖifɔ ƒe ʋu ɖa le Israel dome, bena wòanyo na wò. Megaɖɔ li liƒo o!

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Megage nɔviwò ƒe liƒo, si tɔgbuiwòwo ɖe ɖe wò anyigba dzi, be wòanye wò domenyinu le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge wòanye tɔwo la dzi, ɖe eme o. Aʋatsoɖaseɖilawo ƒe tohehe.

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Ame ɖeka mekpɔ mɔ aɖi ɖase le amesi ke da vo alo wɔ nuvɔ̃ bubu ƒomevia ɖe la ŋu o, ke boŋ ne ame eve alo ame etɔ̃ ɖi ɖase la, hafi woaxɔ nya la.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Ne aʋatsoɖasefoa ɖe ɖi ɖase le amea ɖe ŋu heli sedzidanyaa ɖe ɖe edzi la,

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Ne èho aʋa ɖe wò futowo ŋu, eye nekpɔ sɔwo, tasiaɖamwo kple aʋakɔ, si sɔ gbɔ wu wò la, megavɔ̃ wo o, elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, li kpli wò.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Hafi miava ho aʋa la, nunɔla natsi tre, eye wòaƒo nu kple aʋakɔ la

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: agblɔ na wo bena: Israel see, egbe miele aʋa ho ge ɖe miaƒe futowo ŋu, dzi megaɖe le mia ƒo o, eye migavɔ̃ o, dzidzi megaƒo mi o, eye womegadzi ŋɔ na mi o! Amesi avo tso, aʋawɔwɔ me.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, mia Mawu, ayi kpli mi, be wòawɔ aʋa kple miaƒe futɔwo na mi, eye wòaxɔ na mi.

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Eye dzikpɔlawo nagblɔ na aʋakɔ la bena: Ne ŋutsua ɖe tu xɔ yeye, eye meʋu ɖe eme haɖe o la, ekema wòagbugbɔ ayi aƒe, bena magaku ɖe aʋa me, eye ŋutsu bubu naʋu ɖe eme o.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe de weingble, eye mede nu eme nua ɖeke ŋu haɖe o la, ekema wòagbugbɔ ayi aƒe, bena magaku ɖe aʋa me, eye ŋutsu bubu nawɔ eŋu ɖɔ o.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe bia nyɔnu ta, eye mekpɔ ɖee haɖe o la, ekema wòagbugbɔ ayi aƒe, bena magaku ɖe aʋa me, eye ŋutsu bubu naɖee o.

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: Eye dzikpɔlawo naƒo nu kple aʋakɔ la ayi dzi agblɔ bena: Ne ŋutsua ɖe le vɔvɔ̃m, eye dzi mele eƒo o la, ekema wòagbugbɔ ayi aƒe, bena magade vovɔ̃ lãme na nɔviawo abe eya ŋuta ene o.

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Eye ne dzikpɔlawo ƒo nu kple aʋakɔ la vɔ la, ekema woaɖo aʋafiawo aʋakɔ la nu. Alesi woawɔ le duxɔxɔ me.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Ke mèkpɔ mɔ ana amea ɖeke natsi agbe le dukɔ siawo ƒe du, siwo Yehowa, wò Mawu, ana wò wòanye wò domenyinu lãme o;

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: ke boŋ natsrɔ̃ Xititɔwo, Amoritɔwo, Kanaanitɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Xiwitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo gbidigbidi, abe alesi Yehowa, wò Mawu, de se na wò ene,

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: ne womagava fia ŋunyɔnu, siwo katã wowɔna na woƒe mawuwo la, wɔwɔ mi, eye miawo nuvɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋu o.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Ne èbe, yeawɔ aʋa kple dua ɖe axɔe, eye nèɖe to ɖee eteƒe didi la, ekema megatsɔ̃ fia gblẽ woƒe atiwo o, ke boŋ èkpɔ mɔ aɖu woƒe tsetse, eye megalã wo o, elabena agblemeti menye ame wònye nèva to ɖe ge ɖee o.

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Negbe ati, siwo nènya be, womeɖua woƒe tsetse o la, ko nagblẽ, eye nalã wo atsɔ tɔ kpɔ ɖe du, si le aʋa wɔm kpli wò la ŋu, vaseɖe esime naɖu edzi.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Ne wofa ame kukua de le gbe me le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge wòanye towo la dzi, eye womenya amesi wui o la,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: ekema wò ame tsitsiwo kple wò ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo nado ayi, eye woadzidze ame kuku la kple du, siwo ƒo xlãe la dome.

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: Eye du, si tsɔ ɖe ame kukua gbɔ la me ame tsitsiwo nana nyinɔvi ɖeka, si mewo ɖɔ kpɔ o, eye womede kɔkuti kɔ nɛ kpɔ o la.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: Eye du, si tsɔ ɖe ame kukua gbɔ la me ame tsitsiwo katã naklɔ asi ɖe nyinɔ, si nu wòŋe kɔ le, le baba me la dzi

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: ahagblɔ bena: Menye míaƒe asie kɔ ʋu sia ɖi o, eye míaƒe ŋku mekpɔ eteƒe o.

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Ne eho aʋa de wò futɔwo ŋu, eye Yehowa, wò Mawu, tsɔ wo ɖe asi na wò, eye neɖe aboyo wo dometɔa ɖewo,

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ke ne eƒe nu meganyo ŋuwò o la, ekema naɖe asi le eŋu wòanɔ eɖokui si; ɖeko megatsɔe dzra xɔ ga o, eye megasẽ ŋuta le eŋu o, elabena edɔ egbɔ xoxo. Vi ka anyi fofoa dome?

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsuvi dzeaglã, sẽtoa ɖe le amea ɖe si, eye meɖoa to fofoa kple dada ƒe gbe o, eye wohe to nɛ, gake mesee o la,

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: ekema fofoa kple dada nalée ayi du me ame tsitsiawo gbɔ, eye woakplɔe ayi du la ƒe ʋɔnu.

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: Eye woagblɔ na du me ame tsitsiawo bena: Mia viŋutsu sia enye ame dzeaglã kple tosẽla, meɖoa to miaƒe gbe o, eye wònye ame baɖa kple ahamũla.

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Emegbe dua me ŋutsuwo katã naƒu kpee wòaku. Ale naɖe vɔ̃ la ɖa le dowòme, eye Israel blibo la nasee, eye woavɔ̃. Ame dekavewo ŋu nya.

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe wo nua ɖe, si dze ku, eye wowui, eye nède kae ɖe ati ŋu la,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: ekema megagblẽ eƒe kukua ɖi ŋu nake ɖe edzi o, ke boŋ naɖu gbemagbe ke, elabena Mawu ƒo fi ɖe amesi wode kae ɖe ati ŋu la, eye megagblẽ ko ɖo na anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge wòanye wò domenyinu la o.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Ne èkpɔ nɔviwò ƒe nyi alo alẽ tre mɔ la, megato eŋu yi o, ke boŋ gakplɔe yi na nɔviwò.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Ke ne nɔviwò mele kpuiƒe o, eye menyae hã o la, ekema kplɔe va aƒewò me, eye wòatsi gbɔwò, vaseɖe esime noviwò la nabia eta; emegbe nagbugbɔe nɛ.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Alea nawɔ eƒe tedzi kple eƒe avɔ kpakple nusianu, si nɔviwò bu nèfɔ lae; megato wo ŋu yi o.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nyɔnua ɖeke megado ŋutsuwu o, eye ŋutsua ɖeke megado nyɔnuwu o; elabena amesi wɔ nusia la, enye ŋunyɔnu na Yehowa, wò Mawu la.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne ètu xɔ yeye la, ekema to kpɔ ɖe xɔ la ta, bena amea ɖeke magage le edzi, eye nana wò aƒe naɖe hlɔ̃fe o.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Megaƒã nuku eve ƒomevi ɖe wò weingble me o, bena nuku, si nèƒã kple weintsetseawo siaa nagazu adzɔ na kɔkɔe la o.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Megana nyitsu kple tedzi natsaka aŋlɔ agble na wò o.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: De gbo wò avɔ, si nẽtsyɔna la, ƒe dzogoe eneawo ŋu. Ahasiwɔwɔ ŋu sewo.

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖe srɔ̃, eye wòdo egbɔ, emegbe wòlé fui,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ ŋukpenanyawo ɖe eŋu hegblẽ eƒe ŋkɔ gblɔ bena: Esi meɖe nyɔnu sia, eye medɔ egbɔ, nyemekpɔe aƒe o la,

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: ekema nyɔnuvia fofo kple ɖada natsɔ avɔ la ava dumegãwo ŋku me le ʋɔnu.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnuvia fofo nagblɔ na ame tsitsiawo bena: Metsɔ vinyenyɔnu na ŋutsu sia wòɖe, ke eva lé fui,

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ ŋukpenanyawo ɖe eŋu gblɔ bena: Nyemekpɔ viwònyɔnu la aƒe o; evɔ wònye vinyenyɔnu ƒe avɔ enye si hafi. Eye woakeke avɔ la ɖe dumegãwo ŋku me.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Ekema dumegãwo nalé ŋutsu la aƒo.

english_verse: because he accused his bride of not being a virgin. He will have to pay her father
translation_verse: Eyome wòaxe klosalo alafa ɖeka na nyɔnuvia fofo, le esi wogblẽ Israel-ɖetugbi ŋkɔ ta; emegbe woatsɔe nɛ wòanye srɔ̃, eye maɖe asi le eŋu le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me o.

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Ke nenye nyateƒee be, womekpɔ nyɔnuvi la aƒe o la,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: ekema woakplɔ nyɔnuvi la ayi fofoa ƒe xɔ nu, eye dua me ŋutsuwo naƒu kpee woaku, elabena ewɔ ŋukpenanu le Israel, eye wòwɔ ahasi le fofoa ƒe me. Ale naɖe vɔ la ɖa le dowòme.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Ne wòlé ŋutsu, si de asi nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔa ɖe ŋu la, ekema woawu ŋutsu, si de asi nyɔnua ŋu kpakple nyɔnu la siaa. Ale naɖe vɔ̃ la ɖa le Israel!

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ke nenye gbe mee ŋutsua lé amea ɖe ƒe ŋugbetɔ le sesẽ de asi eŋu la, ekema woawu ŋutsu, si de asi eŋu ta, ɖeɖeko.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Migawɔ naneke nyɔnuvi la o, elabena mewɔ naneke, si dze ku o; ke boŋ nya la nanɔ, abe alesi amea ɖe adze nɔvia dzi awui la, ƒe nya ene.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Elabena gbe mee wòlée le, eye ne ŋugbetɔ la ɖo ɣli hã la, amea ɖeke meli axɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe lé nyɔnuvi, si ta womebia o, hede asi eŋu, eye wòlé wo la,

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke megaɖe fofoa srɔ̃, eye wòaklo fofoa ƒe avɔ o.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Amesi wòto voku na, alo wolã kakalikɛ nɛ la, mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Yehowa ƒe ha la me o.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ahasivia ɖeke mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Yehowa ƒe ha la me o; kekeke eƒe dzidzime ewolia ke hã mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Yehowa ƒe ha la me o.

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Amonitɔ kple Moabitɔa ɖeke mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Yehowa ƒe ha la me o, kekeke woƒe dzidzime ewolia ke hã mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Yehowa ƒe ha la me gbeɖe o;

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: elabena wometsɔ abolo kple tsi va kpe mi le mɔ dzi, esime mieʋu tso Egipte la o, eye woda Bileam, Beor vi, tso Petor le Mesopotamia ɖe mia ŋu, be wòaƒo fi ade mi.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Megadi nyuie alo dzɔgbenyuie na wo le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me gbeɖe o.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Meganyɔ ŋu Edomitɔ o, elabena nɔviwò wònye, eye meganyɔ ŋu Egiptetɔ o, elabena ènye amedzro kpɔ le eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzidzimevi etɔ̃lia kpɔ mɔ anɔ Yehowa ƒe ha la me. Se vovovowo

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Ŋe eho aʋa ɖe wò futɔwo ŋu, eye nèƒu asaɖa anyi la, ekema kpo nyuie le vɔ̃wo katã ŋu.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe le dowòme, amesi nyẽ tsi le zã me, eye eŋu meka o la, ekema wòado le asaɖa la me, eye mekpɔ mo ava asaɖa la me o.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: Le ɣetrɔ me la wòalé tsi, eye ne ɣe ɖo to la, ekpɔ mɔ ava asaɖa la me.

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu, le yiyim le wò asaɖa la me, bena woaxɔ na wò, eye wòatsɔ wò futɔwo aɖe asi na wò. Eyata wò asaɖa nanɔ kɔkɔe, ne magakpɔ fenua ɖeke, eye wòatrɔ adzo le gbɔwò o.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Ne kluvia ɖe, si le eƒe aƒetɔ gbɔ, va si wò tso la, megakplɔe de asi na eƒe aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ woatsi gbɔwò le wò duwo dometɔ ɖeka, si dze eŋu wotia la me, eye megatee ɖe anyi o.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Megaɖe adzɔgbe atsɔ nyɔnu alo ŋutsu ƒe ahasihoa ɖeke ava Yehowa, wò Mawu la, ƒe me o, elabena ŋunyɔnu woa kple eve la siaa nye na Yehowa, wò Mawu la.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Megaxɔ deme le nɔviwò si o, eɖanye ɖe ga alo nuɖuɖu alo nusianu, si woaɖo woaxɔ deme ɖe dzi la dzi o.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ mɔ axɔ deme le du bubu me tɔwo si, ke megaxɔ deme le nɔviwò si o, bena Yehowa, wò Mawu, nayra wò le nusiwo katã netsɔ wò asi wɔ dɔ kpɔ la me, le anyigba, si dzi yim nèle, be naxɔe wòanye tɔwò la dzi.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Ne èɖe adzɔgbe na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, ekema megahe edziwɔwɔ ɖe megbe o, elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu, abiae tso asiwò kokoko, ne megaɖi fɔ o.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Lé nya, si do le nuwo la me ɖe asi, eye nawɔ nya, si nègblɔ heɖe adzɔgbe le ɖokuiwò si na Yehowa, wò Mawu la dzi.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Ne èva hawòvi ƒe weingble me la, ekema ɖu tsetseawo alesi dze ŋuwò, vaseɖe esime naɖi ƒo; ɖeko megatsɔ ɖeke ɖe wò nuwo me o

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖe nyɔnu wòzu srɔ̃, emegbe eƒe nu meganyo eŋu o, le esi wòwɔ ŋukpenanu ta, eye woŋlɔ kaklãgbalẽ de esi henyãe tso eƒe me;

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: eye wòʋu le eƒe me ɖade ŋutsu bubu,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ekema ŋutsu gbãtɔ, si nyae la, mekpɔ mɔ agaɖee woazu srɔ̃ o, elabena wodo ŋunyɔe. Ŋunyɔnu wònye le Yehowa ŋku me, eyata megahe vɔ̃ va anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge wòanye wò domenyinu la dzi o.

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖe srɔ̃ eteƒe medidi o la, ekema megayi aʋa o, eye womaɖe dɔa ɖeke asi nɛ o, ke boŋ wòanɔ eɖokui si le eƒe me ƒe ɖeka, eye wòado dzidzɔ na srɔ̃, si wòɖe la. Se vevovowu, vevitɔ ama dahewo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple amedzrowo ŋu sewo.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne wole amea ɖe, si fi nɔvia Israel-viwo dometɔa ɖe, eye wòsẽ ŋuta le eŋu hetsɔe dzra la, ekema woawu hafi la Ale naɖe vɔ̃ la ɖa le dowòme.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku nusi Yehowa, wò Mawu, wɔ Miryam le mɔ ta, le esime mieʋu tso Egipte la dzi.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: ke boŋ nɔ xexe, eye amesi do nugbana le asiwò la, natsɔ nu ava ɖo awɔba na wò.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Ke boŋ, ne ɣe ɖo to la, nagbugbɔ awɔbanu la nɛ, bena woate ŋu akpɔ avɔ atsyɔ amlɔ anyii, eye Woayra wò, eye wòatrɔ zu dzɔdzɔenyenye na wò le Yehowa, wò Mawu, ŋku me.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: Megate fetu ame dahe kple hiãtɔwo o, eɖanye nɔviwò alo amedzro, si le wò anyigba dzi duwo me la dometɔa ɖe o.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Gbemagbe ke naxe fe nɛ, eye ɣe megaɖo to ɖee o, elabena ame dahe wònye, eye eya ŋu eƒe ŋku le, ne magayɔ Yehowa ɖe dziwò, eye wòatrɔ zu fɔɖiɖi na wò o.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Megawu fofowo kpe ɖe viwo ŋu o, eye megawu viwo kpe ɖe fofowo ŋu o, ke boŋ amesiame naku ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃ ta.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi bena, ènye kluvi kpɔ le Egipte, eye Yehowa, wò Mawu, xɔ wò ƒle tso afima, eyata mede se na wò be, nawɔ alea ɖo.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ne eŋe nu le wò agble me, eye neŋlɔ bablaa ɖe be ɖe agblea me la, ekema megagbugbɔ yi, be natsɔe o, ke boŋ amedzro, tsyɔ̃evi kple ahosiwo tɔ wònye, ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, nayra wò le wò asinudɔwo katã me?

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Ne ègbe kutsetsewo le wò amiti dzi la, megava tsa le eme ƒiaƒiaƒia o, ke boŋ amedzro, tsyɔ̃evi kple ahosiwo tɔ wònye.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Ne èxa nu le wò weingble me la, megava tsa le eme ƒiaƒiaƒia o, ke boŋ amedzro, tsyɔ̃evi kple ahosiwo tɔ wònye.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Do ŋku edzi be, enye kluvi kpɔ le Egipte-nyigba dzi, eyata mede se na wò be, nawɔ alea ɖo.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Zi blane dedie woaƒoe, eye womaƒoe wòagbɔ edzi, alo woaƒoe woatso me o, ne womagaɖi gbɔ nɔviwò le wò ŋku me o.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne nyitsu le mɔli tugum la, megabla nu nɛ o. Nɔvi naɖe nɔvi kukua arɔ̃.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Ke ne medze ŋutsu la ŋu be, wòaɖe nɔvia srɔ̃ o la, ekema nyɔnu la nayi ame tsitsiwo gbɔ le ʋɔnu agblɔ bena: Srɔ̃nye nɔvi gbe be, yemalé ye nɔvi ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe te le Israel o; egbe be, yemaɖem o.

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Emegbe dumegãwo nana woayɔ ŋutsu la vɛ, eye woaƒo nu kplii; ke ne ele dzi gblɔ be, eɖeɖe mele ye dzrom o la,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: ekema nɔvia srɔ̃ nate ɖe eŋu le ame tsitsiawo ŋku me, eye wòaɖe afɔkpa le afɔ ne, aɖe ta ɖe mo nɛ ahagblɔ bena: Ale woawɔ ŋutsu, si be, yemalé ye nɔvi ƒe aƒe ɖe te o la, enye si.

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsuwo le avu wɔm kple wo nɔewo, eye wo dometɔ ɖeka srɔ̃ va, be yeaxɔ srɔ̃ le amesi le eƒom si, eye wòdo asi ɖa lé ŋutsu nɛ la,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ekema lã eƒe asi, eye megakpɔ eta o. Womagaho ame le nudzidze kple nudada me o.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Nudakpe blibo nyui nanɔ asiwò, ne nanɔ agbe didie le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge la dzi.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame, si wɔ nusia, eye wòwɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ la, ŋunyɔnu wònye na Yehowa, wò Mawu la. Woatsrɔ̃ Amalektɔwo.

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku nusi Amalek wo wò le mɔ̃ ta, esime mieʋu tso Egipte la dzi,

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: mesi Mawu da o, eye esi ɖeɖi te ŋuwò negbɔdzɔ la, wòva kpe wò le mɔ dzi, eye wòtsrɔ̃ wò ame kudɔe, siwo tsi megbe la.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ne Yehowa, wò Mawu, na nèkpɔ gbɔdzɔe tso wò futɔ, siwo katã ƒo xlã wò si me le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge wòanye wò domenyinu dzi la, ekema tsrɔ̃ Amalek ŋkɔ da le dziƒoa te. Megaŋlɔe be o!

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: Ne eva anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge wòanye wò domenyinu dzi, eye nèxɔe hetso aƒe ɖe edzi la,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: ekema tso wò agblemenu ɖesiaɖe ƒe ŋgɔgbea, si nèkpɔ le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge dzi la, ade kusi me, atso yi teƒe, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le tiatia ge, be yeƒe ŋkɔ nana,

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: eye nayi nunɔla, si le ɣemaɣi la gbɔ agblɔ nɛ bena Mele eme ʋum na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, egbea be: Meva anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na mia fofowo be, yeatsɔe na mí la dzi.

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Emegbe nunɔla naxɔ kusi la le asiwò atsɔ ɖa ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ le Yehowa, wò Mawu ŋku me bena: Fofonye enye Aramtɔa ɖe, si de tsɔtsrɔ ge, eye wòʋu va Egipte; ame ʋeea ɖewo ko wonye henye amedzrowo le afima, ke wodzi ɖe dzi, eye wotrɔ zu dukɔ gã sẽŋua ɖe.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Ke Egiptetɔwo sẽ ŋuta le mía ŋu, wote mí ɖe anyi, eye wode do sesẽwo asi na mi.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Eye esi míedo ɣli yɔ Yehowa, mia fofowo ƒe Mawu la, Yehowa ɖo to míaƒe gbe, eye wòkpɔ miaƒe hiã, agbagbadzedze kple fukpekpewo me na mí,

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: eye Yehowa tsa asi sesẽ kple abɔ, si wodo de dzi, nu dzɔtsuwo, dzesiwo kple nukunuwo kplɔ mi tso Egipte,

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: eye wòkplɔ mí va afisia hetsɔ anyigba sia, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la, na mí.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Azɔ kpɔ ɖa, agblemenu, siwo nenam la, ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo nye esi metsɔ vɛ na wò, Yehowa. Eye natsɔ wo aɖa ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu la ŋku me ahade ta agu ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu la ŋku me.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Eye mia kple Lewito kpakple amedzro, si le gbɔwò la, míakpɔ dzidzɔ le nu nyui, siwo katã Yehowa, wò Mawu, na wò kple aƒewò me towo la ŋuti.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Ne èƒo wò nuwo katã ƒe ewolia nu ƒu le ƒe etɔ̃lia me vo, eye nètso wo na Lewitɔwo, amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo, be woaɖu nu aɖi ƒo le wò duwo me la,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: ekema nagblɔ le Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe ŋku me bena: Meɖe nu kokoe ɖa le aƒenye me, eye metsɔe na Lewitɔwo, amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo, abe alesi nede se nam pɛpɛpɛ ene, eye nyemeda wò seawo dzi alo ŋlɔ wo be o.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Esi mele fu nyim la, nyemeɖu ɖeke o, ŋunye kɔ hafi meɖee na, eye nyemetsɔ ɖeke na ame kukuwo o; meɖo to Yehowa, nye Mawu ƒe gbe, eye mewɔ, abe alesi nède se nam pɛpɛpɛ ene.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kpɔ nu tso wò nɔƒe kɔkɔe la le dziƒo, eye nayra wò dukɔ Israel kple anyigba, si nètsɔ na mi, afisi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la, abe alesi nèka atam na mia fofowo ene. Toɖoɖo Mawu.

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Egbe sia Yehowa, wò Mawu, le se dem na wò be, nawɔ ɖoɖo kple se siawo dzi: eyata lé wo me ɖe asi, eye nawɔ wo dzi tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Eka de dzi na Yehowa egbea bena, eya nye yeƒe Mawu, eye yeazɔ eƒe mowo dzi, yealé eƒe ɖoɖowo, sewo kple kɔnuwo me de asi, eye yeado to eƒe gbe.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ka de dzi na wò egbea bena, anye eya ŋuta ƒe dukɔ, abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe na wò ene, eye nalé eƒe sewo katã me de asi,

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: yeatsɔ wò ado gã de dukɔ, siwo katã wòwɔ la nu hena eƒe kafukafu, bubu kple atsyɔɖoɖo, eye nanye dukɔ kɔkɔe na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe ene.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Eye Mose kple Israel-ame tsitsiwo de se na dukɔ la bena: Lé se, siwo katã mede na wò egbea la me de asi.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ kpe aɖi vɔsamlekpui na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, ɖe afima, ke megatsɔ gakpee fui o.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Kpe blibo natsɔ aɖi vɔsamlekpui na Yehowa, wò Mawu la, eye namè numevɔsawo le edzi na Yehowa, wò Mawu la,

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: eye nasa akpedavɔ aɖu nu le afima, eye nakpɔ dzidzɔ le Yehowa, wò Mawu ŋku me.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Eye Mose kple nunɔlawo, amesiwo nye Lewitɔwo la, gblɔ na Israel blibo la bena: Israel, ɖo to nasee! Egbe nètrɔ zu Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe dukɔ;

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: eyata ɖo to Yehowa, wò Mawu la ƒe gbe, eye nawɔ se kple ɖoɖo, siwo megblɔ na wò egbe la dzi! Fiƒode tso Ebal-to dzi.

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Eye Mose de se na dukɔ la gbemagbe bena:

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Woayra wò le ɖu me, eye Woayra wò le agble me.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Woayra wò dɔmevi, wò agblemenukuwo, wò lãwo ƒe viwo, kpakple wò nyinɔwo kple wò alẽnɔwo.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Woayra wò kusi kple wò amɔwɔze.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Ne eva aƒe la, Woayra wò, eye ne edo go la, woayra wò.

english_verse: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò Mawu, asiwò futɔ, siwo ho aʋa ɖe ŋuwò la, le ŋgɔwò; mɔ ɖeka dzi woato aho ɖe ŋuwò, ke mɔ adre dzi woato asi le nuwo.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Yehowa ana yayra nanɔ wò ava kple nusiwo katã netsɔ asi wɔ ɖɔ kpɔ la dzi, eye woayra wò le anyigba, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, le na wò ge la dzi.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ne èlé Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye nèzɔ eƒe mɔwo dzi la, ekema Yehowa aɖo wò nanye eƒe dukɔ kɔkɔe, abe alesi wòka atam na wò ene.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Eye anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã akpɔe bena, Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ le ŋuwò, eye woayɔ wò.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ana wò kesinɔnuwo kple wò dɔmevi, wò lãwo ƒe viwo kple wò agblemenukuwo nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi le anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na fofowòwo be, yeatsɔe na wò la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Yehowa aƒo eƒe nu nyuiwo nu ƒu na wò, aʋu dziƒo nu, be tsi nadza ɖe wò anyigba dzi le edzaɣi, eye woayra wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã, ale be nado nu na dukɔ geɖewo, ke wò ŋutɔ mado nugbana o.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Yehowa atsɔ wò awɔ tae, eye menye asike o, wòado wò ɖe dzi ɖaa, eye mava anyi o, elabena èse Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe se, siwo mede na wò egbe, eye nele wo me ɖe asi hewɔ wo dzi,

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Wò ame kukuwo anye nuɖuɖu na dziƒoxe dzodzoewo katã kple anyigba dzi lãwo, eye amea ɖeke manyã wo ɖa o.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: eye dzesiwo kple nukunuwo adze le mia kple wò dzidzimeviwo ŋu tegbee.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Ke ne mèɖo to Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe gbe o, eye melé se kple ɖoɖo, siwo katã megblɔ na wò egbe la me ɖe asi hewɔ wo dzi o la, ekema fiƒode siawo katã ava dziwò, eye woaɖi ŋuwò.

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: Aɖi ŋuwò le du me, eye aɖi ŋuwò le agble me.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Aɖi wò kusi kple wò amɔwɔze ŋu.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Aɖi wò dɔmevi kple wò agblemenukuwo kpakple wò nyinɔwo kple wò alẽnɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ne èva aƒe la, aɖi ŋuwò, eye ne edo go la, aɖi ŋuwò.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Yehowa ana fiƒode, ʋunyaʋunya kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e nava wò nusiwo katã netsɔ wò asi wɔ dɔ kpɔ la dzi, vaseɖe esime naku atsrɔ̃ avɔ xoxoxo, le nu vɔ̃ɖi, siwo nèwɔ, eye negblẽm ɖi la ta.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Yehowa ana kekui kple ʋuʋudedi nadza tso dziƒo ɖe tsi, si dzana ɖe wò anyigba dzi la teƒe.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: Yehowa ana wò futɔwo nasi wò, mɔ ɖeka dzi nato aho aʋa ɖe wo ŋu, ke mɔ adre dzi nato asi le wo nu, ale bena natrɔ zu bibi na anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo katã.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
