translation_verse: Eye Yehowa akplɔ tamedada, ŋkuagbã kple tsukuku aƒu wò,

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: eye atsa asi le ŋdɔ, abe alesi ŋkuagbãtɔ tsaa asi le viviti me ene; wò mɔwo madze edzi na wo o, ke boŋ woasẽ ŋuta le ŋuwò ɣesiaɣi, eye woada adzo wò, ke xɔnametɔa ɖeke manɔe na wò o.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Woawu wò nyitsu le ŋkuwo me, ke makpɔ ɖeke aɖu o, wòalé wo tedzi le ŋkuwò me, eye maganɔ va na wo o; woatsɔ wò alẽwo ana wò tutɔwo, ke xɔnametɔa ɖeke manɔe na wò o.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ viwòŋutsuwo kple viwònyɔnuwo na dukɔ bubuwo, wò ŋkuwo akpɔe, eye woano dzrowòm ŋkeke blibo la katã, gake womelé wò ŋusẽ te o.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Dukɔ, si menya o la, aɖu wò agblemenuwo kple nusiwo katã nèwɔ dɔ kpɔ, wòase ŋuta le ŋuwò ɣesiaɣi, eye woate wò ɖe anyi.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Eye nusiwo katã teƒe nakpɔ la, ana wò tame aɖa.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Yehowa ana nuƒoƒo vɔ̃ɖia ɖe naƒo klo kple sobo na wò, tso afɔƒome vaseɖe ta me, eye màhaya akpɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Yehowa akplɔ wò kple fia, si nava ɖo na ɖokuiwò la, ayi dukɔ, si mia kple fofowòwo mienyã o la dome, eye nasubɔ mawu bubuwo, siwo nye ati kple kpe.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ, siwo katã dome Yehowa anyẽ wò aɖo ɖo la, aɖe ao ɖe ŋuwò, woatsɔ wò awɔ lodonya kple alɔmeɖenui.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Àƒã nuku geɖe ɖe agble me, ke ʋeea ɖe ko naŋe, elabena ʋetsuviwo aɖui avɔ.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Àde weingble, eye awɔ dɔ le eŋu, ke makpɔ wein ano o, eye màgbe kutsetsea ɖeke hã o, elabena ŋɔwo aɖui.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Amitiwo anɔ wò anyigba blibo la dzi, ke makpɔ ami asi o, elabena wò amititsetsewo adudu.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Adzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo, ke womanye tɔwò o, elabena woaɖe aboyo wo.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Adogowo aɖu wò atiwo kple wò agblemenuwo.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Amedzro, si le dowòme la ŋkɔ ade dzi, ke wò la àyi to gbidigbidi.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Ado nu na wò, ke wò la màdo nugbana nɛ o; atrɔ zu ta, ke wò la azu asike.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Fiƒode siawo katã ava dziwò, woanɔ ŋuwò, eye woaɖi ŋuwò, vaseɖe esime natsrɔ̃ avɔ, elabena mèɖo to Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe gbe o, eye mèlé se kple ɖoɖo, siwo wògblɔ na wò la me ɖe asi o;

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: Esi nu do sɔ gbɔ ɖe asiwò, eye mèkɔ mo hesubɔ Yehowa, wò Mawu la faa tso dzi me o la,

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: eyata dɔ kple tsikɔ awu wò, atsi amama, eye hiã atu wò le nu geɖewo me, gake hafi nagasubɔ wò futɔ, siwo Yehowa dɔ ɖe ŋuwò la, eye woade gakɔkuti kɔ na wò, vaseɖe esime woatsrɔ̃ wò avɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Yehowa akplɔ dukɔ, si ƒe gbe mèsena o la, tso didiƒe le anyigba seƒe ke, abe alesi hɔ̃ dzona ene, ava de wò;

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: dukɔ, si ƒe mo kplala, menya nusi nye amegã ɖeɖi o, eye mevea ɖekakpui nu hã o.

english_verse: They will take your cattle, sheep, goats, grain, wine, and olive oil, then leave you to starve.
translation_verse: Aɖu wò lãwo kple wò agblemenuwo, vaseɖe esi natsrɔ̃ avɔ, eye bli, wein kple ami kpakple wò nyinɔ kple wò alẽnɔa ɖeke masusɔ na wò vaseɖe esime natsrɔ̃ avɔ o.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Woaxaxa wò ɖo ɖe wò duwo katã me, vaseɖe esime wò gli kɔkɔ sesẽ, siwo ŋu nèle ŋu ɖom ɖo la, namũ adze anyi le wò anyigba blibo la dzi. Woaxaxa wò ɖo ɖe wò ɖu, siwo katã Yehowa, wò Mawu, na wò la me.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Ne wò futɔwo ɖe to ɖe wò, eye woxaxa wò ɖo la, ekema aɖu wò ŋutɔ wò dɔmevi, viwòŋutsu kple viwònyɔnu, siwo Yehowa, wò Mawu, na wò la ƒe lã.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: eye mana via, siwo ƒe lã ɖum wòle la, wo dometɔa ɖeke o; elabena wò futɔ, siwo aɖe to ɖe wò, eye woaxaxa wò ɖo ɖe wò duawo katã me la, magblẽ naneke ɖi nɛ o.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ɖe amenɔ, si le eƒe atawo domee, kpakple via, siwo wòdzi la ŋu, eye woaɖu wo le adza me le hiã, si tui le nuwo katã me la la, elabena wò futɔwo aɖe to ɖe wò, eye woaxaxa wò ɖo ɖe wò duwo katã me.

english_verse: like those you were so afraid of in Egypt.
translation_verse: eye wòakplɔ Egipte-dɔvɔ̃, siwo katã dzi ŋɔ na wò tsã la, aƒu wò.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa akplɔ dɔlélewo tsyo ƒomevi kple fuwɔamewo tsyo ƒomevi, siwo womeŋlɔ ɖe se sia ƒe agbalẽa me o la, aƒu wò, vaseɖe esime natsrɔ̃ avɔ.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Eye miatrɔ zu ʋee, ɖe esi miasa gbɔ abe dziƒoɣletiviwo ene la teƒe, elabena meɖo to Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe gbe o.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Abe alesi Yehowa kpɔ dzidzɔ le mia ŋu be, wòawɔ nyui na mi, eye wòana míadzi ɖe dzi ene la, nenema ke Yehowa akpɔ dzidzɔ le mia ŋu be, wòawu mi, eye wòatsrɔ̃ mi; eye wòaɖe mi ɖa le anyigba, si dzi yim miele, be míaxɔe la dzi.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Yehowa aka wò ahlẽ ɖe dukɔwo katã dome, tso anyigba ƒe go ɖeka vaseɖe go keme, eye àsubɔ mawu bubu, siwo nye ati kple kpe, eye mia kple fofowòwo mienyã o la, le afima.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Ŋdi la agblɔ be: Ao, zã maɖo dzroa! Eye fiẽ la agblɔ be: Ao, ŋu make dzroa! Elabena wò dzi le dzodzom nyanyanya le nu, siwo teƒe wò ŋkuwo le kpɔkpɔm la ta.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Yehowa akplɔ mi ade ʋu agbugbɔ aɖo ɖe Egipte ato mɔ, si megblɔ na mi be, migato o la dzi, eye woadzra mi le afima na miaƒe futɔwo mianye kluviwo kple kosiviwo, eye womakpɔ mia ƒlelawo gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Eye Mose yɔ Israel blibo la gblɔ na wo bena: Miekpɔ nusi Yehowa wo le mia ŋku me ɖe Farao kple eƒe dɔlawo kpakple eƒe dukɔ blibo la ŋu le Egipte-nyigba dzi,

english_verse: Moses called the nation of Israel together and told them: When you were in Egypt, you saw the Lord perform great miracles that caused trouble for the king, his officials, and everyone else in the country.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa mena dzi mi, be miase nu gɔmee, mena ŋku mi, be míakpɔ nui, eye mena to mi, be miase nui vaseɖe egbe o.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: eye miexɔ woƒe anyigba hetsɔ na Ruben-viwo, Gad-viwo kple Manase-viwo ƒe to afã, bena wòanye woƒe domenyinu.

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: Eyata milé nubabla sia ƒe nyawo me ɖe asi, eye miwo wo dzi, bena nusianu, si miawɔ la, nadze dzi na mi.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Mi katã miele tsitre ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋku me egbe, miaƒe towo ƒe amegãwo, miaƒe ame tsitsiwo, mia dzikpɔlawo kple Israel ƒe ŋutsuwo katã,

english_verse: Today everyone in our nation is standing here in the Lord's presence, including leaders and officials, parents and children, and even those foreigners who cut wood and carry water for us. We are at this place of worship to promise that we will keep our part of the agreement with the Lord our God.
translation_verse: ne wòaɖo wò egbe nanye eƒe dukɔ, eye eya nanye wò Mawu, abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe na wò kple alesi wòka atam na fofowò Abraham, Isak kple Yakob la ene.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ɖeko ŋutsu alo nyɔnu, ƒome alo toa ɖeke meganɔ mia dome, si ƒe dzi atrɔ le Yehowa, mía Mawu la yome egbea o, eye miaƒe kèa ɖeke meganɔ anyi anye aɖi kple atsa o;

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: amesi ase fiƒodenya siawo avɔ tso, ade dzi ƒo na eɖokui agblɔ le eƒe dzi me bena; ne mese dzime le yiyim hã, ŋunye afa o, bena ne womagatsrɔ̃ amesi ɖi ko kple amesi tsikɔ le wuwum la siaa o.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Yehowa matsɔe akee o, ke boŋ Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe abi ɖe ame ma ŋu, eye wòaʋã ŋui; fiƒode, siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la, ava edzi, eye Yehowa atsrɔ̃ eƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le dziƒoa te.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Eye ne miaƒe dzidzimevi, siwo ava le mia megbe, kple ɖu bubu me tɔwo, siwo tso anyigba ɖiɖiwo dzi, kpɔ anyigba sia ƒe fuwɔamewo kple dɔléle, siwo Yehowa he va edzi,

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Tete woaɖo ŋu be: Esi wotu Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu ƒe nu, si wòbia kpli wo, le esime wòkplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi,

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: eye woyi ɖasubɔ mawu bubuwo hede ta agu na mawu, siwo womenya o, eye metsɔ wo na wo o ŋuti la,

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: eyata Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe anyigba ma ŋu, eye wòhe fiƒode, siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la, va wo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Nusi ɣla enye Yehowa, mía Mawu tɔ, ke nusi le gaglãgbe enye mía kple mia viwo to tegbee, be miawo se sia ƒe nyawo katã dzi.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: Ne nya siawo katã ava dzo ɖe dziwò, yayra kple fiƒode, tsiwo metsɔ ɖo ŋkuwò me, eye wode dzigbɔ na wò le dukɔ, siwo katã dome Yehowa, wò Mawu, nyã wò ɖo ɖo,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: eye metrɔ ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu la ŋu, eye mia kple viwòwo mieɖo to eƒe gbe tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me, abe alesi mede se na mi ene la,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Ne miekaka ɖase dziƒo seƒe ke hã, Yehowa aƒo mia nu ƒu tso afima, eye wòakplɔ mi tso afima.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò Mawu, akplɔ wò va anyigba, si fofowòwo xɔ la dzi, eye naxɔe wòanye tɔwo; awɔ nyuie na wò, eye wòana nadzi ɖe dzi wu fofowòwo.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa, wò Mawua atso aʋa na mia kple wò dzidzimeviwo ƒe dziwo, bena mialɔ̃ Yehowa, mia Mawu la, tso miaƒe dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me, ne miano agbe.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò Mawu, ana fiƒode siawo katã nava wò futɔ kple wò ketɔ, siwo le yowòme tim la dzi.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ke wò la gaɖo to Yehowa, wò Mawu la ƒe gbe, eye nawɔ se, siwo katã mede na wo egbe la dzi.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa, wò Mawu, ana nusiwo katã newɔna, wò dɔmeviwo, wò lãwo ƒe viwo kple wò agblemenuwo kpakple wò kesinɔnuwo nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi; eye Yehowa agakpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋuwò, eye wòawɔ nyuie na wò, abe alesi wòkpɔ dzidzɔ le fofowòwo ŋu ene.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Elabena èɖo to Yehowa, wò Mawu la ƒe gbe, eye nèle se kple ɖoɖo, siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la me ɖe asi, eye nètrɔ ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu la ŋu tso wò dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Elabena se, si mede na wò egbe la, menye nya masegɔmea wònye o, eye mele didiƒe tso gbɔwò o.

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Eye mele ƒu godo, ne woagblɔ be: ameka atso ƒu ayi atsɔe vɛ na mi, be míase, ne miawo edzi o.

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Ke boŋ nya la tso ɖe gbɔwò kpuie, ele wò nu me kple wò dzi me, be nawɔ edzi.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ agbe kple dzɔgbenyuie, ku kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖo ŋkuwò me egbe.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Meta dziƒo kple anyigba na mi be: Metsɔ agbe kple ku, yayra kple fiƒode le mia ŋku me ɖom. Eyata mitia agbe, be mia kple wò dzidzimeviwo mianɔ agbe,

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: eye nalɔ̃ Yehowa, wò Mawu la, ɖo to eƒe gbe, eye naku ɖe eŋu, elabena eya nye wò agbe, bena nanɔ agbe didie le anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo be, yeatsɔ na fofowòwo Abraham, Isak kple Yakob la dzi.

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Tete Mose yi ɖagblɔ nya siawo na Israel blibo la,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Milé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye misẽ ŋu, migavɔ̃ o, eye womegadzi ŋɔ na mi o, elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu ŋutɔ le yiyim le mia dome, maɖe asi le ŋuwò o, eye magblẽ wò ɖi o

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Eye Mose yɔ Yosua hegblɔ nɛ le Israel blibo la ŋku me bena: Lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye sẽ ŋu, elabena wòe le dukɔ sia kplɔ ge ayi anyigba, si ŋu Yehowa ka atam ɖo na wo fofowo be, yeatsɔ na wo la dzi, eye wòe le emã ge na wo.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Yehowa ŋutɔ adze ŋgɔ-wò, eye wòanɔ anyi kpli wò, maɖe asi le ŋuwò o, eye magblẽ wò ɖi o; megavɔ̃ o, eye ŋɔ megadzi wò o.

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye Mose ŋlɔ se sia ƒe nyawo, eye wòtsɔe ɖe asi na nunɔlawo, siwo nye Lewi-viwo, amesiwo le Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la tsɔm, kpakple Israel-ame tsitsiwo katã.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: ne Israel blibo la va, be wòado ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu ŋku me le teƒe, si wòatia la, ekema naxlẽ se sia ɖe Israel blibo la ƒe to me.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Eye wo vi, siwo mele naneke nyam haɖe o la, nasee, ne wòanya, alesi woavɔ̃ Yehowa, mia Mawu la, ŋkeke alesi miele agbe le anyigba, si dzi mietsɔ Yordan le yiyim, be míaxɔe wòanye mia tɔ la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Kpɔ ɖa, wò kuɣi le aƒe tum; yɔ Yosua, eye mia kplii míatsi tre ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la gbɔ, ne maɖe se nɛ. Eye Mose kple Yosua woyi ɖatsi tre ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ɖe eɖokui fia le agbadɔ la me le alilikpo dodoa ɖe me, eye alilikpo dodo la nɔ agbadɔ la ƒe ʋɔtru tame.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena: Kpɔ ɖa, ne èmlɔ tɔgbuiwòwo gbɔ la, ekema dukɔ sia atso adze anyigba, si dzi yim wole la, ƒe mawuwo yome, woagblẽm ɖi, eye woatu nu, si mebia kpli wo la.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Eye mado dɔmedzoe ɖewo ŋu ɣemaɣi, magblẽ wo ɖi, eye maɣla nye ŋku me ɖe wo, be woatsrɔ̃ wo, dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple hiã geɖe ava wo dzi; tete woagblɔ le ɣemaɣi bena: Menye esi Yehowa mele mia dome o la, vɔ̃ sia va mia dzi ɖo oa?

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ke maɣla nye ŋku me ɣemaɣi le vɔ, siwo katã wowɔ hedze mawu bubuwo yome la ta.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Elabena makplɔ wo ayi anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo na wo fofowo la dzi, afisi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo, eye woaɖu nu aɖi ƒo, akpɔ lãme, emegbe wòadze mawu bubuwo yome asubɔ wo, ke nye la wòado vlom, eye woatu nye nubabla la.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Eye ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple hiã geɖe va wo dzi la, ekema ha sia anye ɖase anɔ woƒe ŋku me, elabena mage le woƒe dzidzimeviwo nu o. Elabena menya tame, si li na wo fifia, hafi mele wo kplɔm le anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo la dzi yimi.

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Eye Mose ŋlɔ ha sia gbemagbe, eye wòfiae Israel-viwo.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Eye wòde se na Yosua, Nun vi, gblɔ bena: Lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye sẽ ŋu, elabena wòe akplɔ Israel-viwo ayi anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo na wo la dzi, eye nye ŋutɔ manɔ anyi kpli wò. Lewitɔwo xɔ segbalẽ la.

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Esi Mose ŋlɔ se sia ƒe nyawo ɖe agbalẽ me vɔ keŋ la,

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Mose de se na Lewitɔwo, amesiwo nye Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖakatsɔlawo bena:

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Elabena menya miaƒe tosesẽ kple kɔlialia. Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke alesi menɔ mia gbɔ la, miesẽ to ɖe Yehowa ŋu vaseɖe fifi; evɔ, ne meku ɖe?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Miƒo miaƒe towo ƒe ame tsitsiwo katã kple mia dzikpɔlawo nu ƒu ɖe gbɔnye, ne magblɔ nya siawo ɖe woƒe to me, eye mata dziƒo kple anyigba na wo.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Elabena menyae bena, miele gbegblẽ ge ɖe dzi le nye ku megbe, eye miate ɖa le mɔ, si metia mi la dzi, eye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava mia dzi emegbe, le esi miewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye mietsɔ miaƒe asiwo wɔ nu hedo dziku nɛ ta.

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Eye Mose gblɔ ha sia ƒe nyawo ɖe mii keŋkeŋ ɖe Israel-ha blibo la ƒe to me bena:

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Miɖo to, mi dziƒowo, mele nu ƒo ge, eye anyigba, se nye numenyawo!

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Nye nufiafiawo le ɖuɖu ge abe tsidzadza ene, eye nye nyawo le dzadza ge abe zãmu ene; wole abe tsie nyɔ ɖe gbe dzi ene, eye wole abe tsie tso ka ɖe amagbe dzi ene.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Elabena mele Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ kafu ge, mide bubu Yehowa, mia Mawu la ŋu!

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: Agakpe wònye, eƒe nuwɔwɔ de blibo; elabena eƒe mɔwo katã dzo. Mawu nyateƒetɔ wònye, eye alakpa mele eme o, nuteƒewɔla kple dzɔdzɔetɔ wònye.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Wowɔ nu tovo ɖe eŋu ŋukpenanu wonye, eye womenye viawo o; dzidzime baɖa kple ame gbegblẽwo wonye!

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Dukɔ dzɔlã kple bometsila, ale nèle akpe da mi na Yehowa? Alo menye eya nye fofowò, si wɔ wò oa? Eya ŋutɔe wɔ wò, eye wòɖo wò te.

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku gbaɖegbe dzi, eye nabu lãme le blematɔwo ŋu; bia fofowò, ne wòato nya na wò, eye bia wò amegã ɖeɖiwo, ne woagblɔe na wò!

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Esi dziƒoʋitɔ ma anyigba na dukɔwo, eye wòkaka ame gbetɔviwo me la, eɖo liƒo na dukɔwo, ɖe alesi Israel-viwo sɔ gbɔe nu.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa tɔ enye eƒe dukɔ, eye Yakob enye domenyinu, si wòmã nɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: Ebe le gbedzi kple gbedadaƒo, afisi gbemelãwo le xɔxlɔ̃m le. Ekpla asi kɔ nɛ, eye wòkpɔ edzi helé be nɛ abe eƒe ŋkuvi ene.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Alesi hɔ̃ dea dzo viawo me ɖe dzodzo ŋu, eye wosa agba ɖe viawo dzi, ekekea eƒe aʋalawo hekɔ wo, eye wotsɔ wo ɖe eƒe aʋalawo dzi la,

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: nenema Yehowa ɖeɖe kplɔe, eye mawu bubua ɖeke mekpe ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: Ekplɔe, wonyã avuzi le anyigbawo dzi, eye wòna woɖu gbemekutsetsewo. Ena anyitsii tso agakpe la me wono kple amii tso kpekui sesẽwo me.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Ena nyinotsi kpekẽ kple alẽnotsii hekpe ɖe alẽviwo kple agbowo, Basan-nyitsuwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe amiwo ŋu. Ena bli dokuwoe, eye wòna wein nyuitɔe wòno.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: Yesurun ɖa ami, eye wòda afɔkli. Eye esi nèda ami klã, eye nèkpɔ lãme la, egblẽ Mawu, si wɔ wò la ɖi, eye nedo vlo agakpe, si nye wò xɔxɔ.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ mawu bubuwo ɖe ŋuʋaʋã me, eye wotsɔ ŋunyɔnuwo do dɔmedzoe nɛ.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Wosa vɔ na trɔ, siwo menye mawuwo o, kple mawu, siwo womenya o, kpakple nu yeye, siwo meli tsã o, nusiwo ŋu mia fofowo medzi ŋɔ le o.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Eɖe ŋu ɖi le agakpe, si dzi wò la ŋu, eye nèŋlɔ Mawu, si ƒe dɔme nèdzɔ tso la be.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: Esi Yehowa kpɔ esia la, edo dɔmedzoe, eye wogbe viaŋutsuwo kple vianyɔnuwo

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: hegblɔ bena: Maɣla nye ŋku me ɖe wo, ne makpɔ nusi ava dzɔ ɖewo dzi. Elabena dzidzime tovo kple vi maɖianukwarewo wonye.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ mũ maɖimawuwo ɖe ŋuʋaʋã menye, eye wotsɔ woƒe legbawo do dziku nam. Eyata nye hã matsɔ ame maɖidukɔwo ade ŋuʋaʋã wo me, eye matsɔ dukɔ baɖawo ado dziku na wo.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Elabena nye ŋɔti me lé dzo, eye wòle bibi ge aɖe tsiẽƒe ke, afiã anyigba kple nusiwo wɔna le edzi, eye wòafiã towo ƒe gɔmegɔmea.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Mala dzagbevɔ̃ewo katã ali kɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye mada nye aŋutrɔwo katã ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Dɔ awu wo aɖi tsi de wo ŋu, eye asrã kple dɔvɔ̃ atsrɔ̃ wo; madɔ lãwo ƒe aɖu kple nutata, siwo tana le ké me la, ƒe aɖi ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Yi aɖu nu le gota, eye ŋɔdzi alé ame le xɔ me, ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo, vidzĩewo kple amegã taɣìwo siaa.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Megblɔ be: Maɖo ƒuƒu ɖe wo, eye matutu woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le amegbetɔwo dome hafi,

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: ɖe menye ɖe mele vɔvɔ̃m be, futɔwo ado dziku nam o, eye woƒe ketɔwo aƒo adegbe agblɔ bena: miaƒe abe de dzi, eye menye Yehowae wɔ nu siawo katã o!

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔ, si dome adaŋudede mele o, eye nyasãa ɖeke mele wo me o la wonye.

english_verse: If you did, you could see where you are headed.
translation_verse: Ɖe wònye nunyalawo wonye la, ne wodze si nusia, eye ne wobu nusi ava dzɔ de wo dzi la ŋu.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Aleke ame ɖeka ate ŋu anyẽ ame akpe, eye ame eve ale ŋu aɖe ame akpe ewo ɖe nu, ne menye woƒe agakpee tsɔ wo dzra, eye ne menye Yehowae tso wo de asi o?

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Elabena woƒe agakpe mede miaƒe agakpe nu o, miaƒe futowo ŋutɔ nyenyametsolawo.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Woƒe weinkawo nye Sodom-weinkawo, eye Gomora-gblewo me wotso. Woƒe weintsetsewo nye aɖi, eye wo me tsi vena.

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: Woƒe wein enye da ƒe aɖi kple ƒli ƒe veve.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: Alo womedzra nusia ɖo ɖe gbɔnye oa, eye woɖo ŋkɔ edzi le nye nuwo dome oa?

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Tanye enye hlɔ̃biabia kple teƒeɖoɖo le gbesigbe woƒe afa ada; elabena woƒe gbegblẽɣi le aƒe tum, eye nusi woɖo ɖe wo ŋu la, le edzi ɖo ge kaba.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Elabena, ne ekpa be, ŋusẽ vo le wo ŋu, eye ame tsitsiwo kple ɖeviwo megali o la, adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eƒe dukɔ, eye wòave eƒe dɔlawo nu

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Eye woabia bena: Afika woƒe mawuwo le, eye afika agakpe, si ŋu wole ŋu ɖom ɖo la le?

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: Miaƒe vɔsa ƒe amiɖulawo kple miaƒe nunovɔsa ƒe weinnolawo netsi tre, ne woaxɔ na mi, eye woakpɔ mia ta!

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: Miele ekpɔm azɔ be, nye ɖeɖe koe ti, eye mawua ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye oa? Mewua ame, eye megbɔa agbee, meƒoa ame, eye meyɔa ɖoe, eye womate ŋu aɖe amea ɖeke tso asinye o.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Elabena meɖo nye asi ɖe dziƒo gblɔ bena: Mele agbe tegbee!

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: Ne menyre nye yi dadzo la, eye meɖe asi ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me la, ekema mabia hiã nye futowo, eye maɖo teƒe na nye ketɔwo.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Mana nye aŋutrɔwo nano ʋu amũ, eye nye yi naɖu lã; ame tsiaʋawo kple aboyomewo ƒe nue, futɔwo kplɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo ƒe lae!

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo mitso aseye ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋu, elabena ebia hlɔ̃ ɖe eƒe dolawo ƒe ʋu nu; ebia hlɔ̃ eƒe futowo, eye wòlé avu na eƒe anyigba kple eƒe dukɔ!

english_verse: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished,
translation_verse: Esi Mose gblɔ nya siawo katã na Israel blibo la vɔ la,

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: egblɔ na wo bena: Mina nya siawo katã, siwo meku ɖe to me na mi egbea la, naɖe dzigbɔ na mi, eye midee asi na mia viwo, ne wòalé se sia ƒe nyawo katã me ɖe asi, eye woawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Elabena menye nya gbɔlo wonye na mi o, ke boŋ miaƒe agbee; eye nya sia ana mianɔ agbe didie le anyigba, si dzi mietsɔ Yordan le yiyim, be míaxɔe wòanye mia tɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Mose gbemagbe bena:

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: De Abarim-towo dzi, eye nalia Nebo-to, si le Moab-nyigba dzi le Yerixo kasa, eye nakpɔ Kanaan-nyigba, si tso ge mala na Israel-viwo wòanye wo tɔ la ɖa.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Eye naku te to, si dzi nede la dzi, eye nayi tɔgbuiwòwo gbɔ, abe alesi nɔviwò Aron ku le Xor-to la dzi heyi tɔgbuiawo gbɔ ene.

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: Elabena miedi anukware nam le Israel-viwo dome le dzrewɔtsi la gbɔ le Kades le Zin-gbedzi o, eye miekɔ ŋunye le Israel-viwo dome o.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Anɔ adzɔge akpɔ anyigba la ɖa, ke maɖe anyigba, si mele Israel-viwo na ge la dzi o.

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Esia nye yayra, si Mose, Mawu ƒe ame la, tsɔ yra Israel-viwo hafi ku.

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Yehowa tso Sinai va, edze na wo tso Seir, eye wòdo tso Paran-to la gbɔ. Ame kɔkɔe akpe nanewo kpe ɖe eŋu, eye dzo le eƒe nuɖusi na wo.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Elɔ̃ dukɔwo, eye eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã le esi me. Wodze wò afɔ yome, eye netsɔ wò nya kplɔ wòe.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: See Mose ɖe na mi, si nye Yakob-ha la ƒe domenyinu.

english_verse: Then you and your leaders made the Lord your king.
translation_verse: Eyae nye fia le Yesurun, le esime dukɔ la ƒe tatɔwo ƒo ƒu kpe ɖe Israel-toawo ŋu.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Ruben anɔ agbe, maku o, eye eƒe amewo manya xlẽ o.

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Yuda ƒe yayra enye si. Eye wògblɔ bena: Yehowa, se Yuda ƒe gbe, eye gakplɔe va eƒe dukɔ gbɔ! Tsɔ wò asi wɔ aʋa ɖe eta, eye naxɔe tso eƒe futɔwo si!

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Lewi ŋu bena: Wò Tumim kple Urim enye wò ame kɔkɔe la tɔ. Amesi nete kpɔ le Masa, eye nèwɔ dzre kplii le dzrewɔtsia gbɔ.

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ le wo fofo kple wo dada ŋu be, yewo mele wo kpɔm o; womedze si wo nɔviŋutsuwo o, eye womenya woƒe viŋutsuwo o; ke boŋ woɖo to wò nyawo, eye wolé wò nubabla me ɖe asi.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Woawoe fiaa wò ɖoɖowo Yakob kple wò se la Israel; woawoe tsɔa dzudzɔdonu ɖoa wò ŋɔti nu, eye wotsɔa vɔsa blibo ɖoa wò vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa, yra eƒe ŋusẽ, eye na eƒe asinudɔwo nadze dzi nɛ! Gbã ali na eƒe futɔwo kple eƒe ketɔwo yaʋayaʋa, ne womagatsi tre o!

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Benyamin ŋu bena: Yehowa ƒe lɔlɔ̃tɔe, anɔ egbɔ dedie, eya akpɔ edzi ɣesiaɣi, eye wòanɔ eƒe abɔta.

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Yosef ŋu bena: Yehowa ayra eƒe anyigba kple dziƒonu xɔasiwo kple zãmu kpakple anyigbatu me tsiwo.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: Ayrae kple kutsetse xɔasi, siwo ɣe na woɖina, kple kutsetse xɔasi, siwo ɣleti na wowɔna.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Ayrae kple nusiwo tso blema-towo dzi kple nu vevi, siwo wɔna le blema-togbɛwo dzi,

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: kpakple anyigba dzi nu xɔasiwo woasɔ gbɔ! Eye amesi le ŋuvekɔe me la ƒe amenuveve ava Yosef ƒe ta dzi kple nɔviawo ƒe amegã ƒe dzodome.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Edze ɖeka abe eƒe nyitsu ŋgɔgbea ene, eye eƒe dzowo le abe to ƒe dzowo ene. Woawo wòtsɔ tu dukɔwo ƒu anyi vaseɖe anyigba seƒewo ke. Esiawo nye Efrayim ƒe ame akpe nanewo kple Manase ƒe ame akpeawo.

english_verse: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Zebulon ŋu bena: Zebulon, wò mɔzɔzɔ nedzɔ dzi na wò, eye wò Isaxar, kpɔ dzidzɔ le wò aƒenɔnɔ ŋu!

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Wokpe dukɔwo va to la gbɔ, afisi wosa vɔ vavãtɔwo le, elabena wole ƒu me kesinɔnuwo kple ketu me nu veviwo ɖe ge.

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Gad ŋu bena: Woakafu amesi na nɔƒe keke Gad! Etsyɔ akɔ anyi abe dzatanɔ ene, eye wòvuvu abɔ kple ta.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ anyigba nyuitɔ da ɖi, si wodzra ɖo ɖi na aʋakplɔla. Enɔ dukɔ la nu yi kpli wo, be wòawɔ nusi dze Yehowa ŋu, eye eya kple Israel wowɔ eƒe ɖoɖowo dzi.

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Dan ŋu bena: Dan enye dzatavi, si ti kpo tso Basan.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Naftali ŋu bena: Nu nyuiwo asɔ gbɔ ɖe Naftali si, Yehowa ƒe yayra anɔ edzi fũ, eye axɔ ɣetoɖoƒe kple dziehenyigba wòanye etɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le Aser ŋu bena: Woayra Aser le viŋutsuwo dome! Eƒe nu anyo nɔviawo ŋu, eye wòatsɔ eƒe afɔ ade ami me!

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Wò gametiwo nye gayibɔ kple akɔbli, eye akpɔ dzudzɔ le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖeke mele abe Yesurun ƒe Mawu la ene o, amesi le yiyim le dziƒo, be yeaxɔ na wò, amesi ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le alilikpowo me.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Blema-Mawu la enye sitsoƒe, kple abɔ mavɔwo le anyigba afi. Enyã futɔwo le ŋgɔwò, eye wògblɔ be: Mitsrɔ̃ wo!

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Israel, si nye Yakob ƒe vudo la, anɔ aga dedie le anyigba, si dzi bli kple wein le, afisi zãmu dzana tso dziƒo ɖo.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Woayra wò Israel! Ameka ɖe nuwo? Dukɔ, si Yehowa ɖe, amesi nye wò akpoxɔnu kple xɔwòla, kpakple wò dziɖuɖu ƒe yi! Wò futɔwo avivi nu me na wò, ke wò la ànyã avuzi le wo dzi.

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Esi Mose lia Nebo-to la hede Pisga tame le Moab-tagba le Yerixo kasa la, Yehowa na wòkpɔ anyigba blibo la tso Gilead vaseɖe Dan,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Naftali blibo la, Efrayim kple Manase ƒe anyigba, kpakple Yuda ƒe anyigba blibo la vaseɖe ƒu nu,

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nɛ bena: Esia nye anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo hedo ŋugbe na Abraham, Isak kple Yakob bena, matsɔe na woƒe dzidzimeviwo. Mena nèkpɔe kple wò ŋkuwo, ke made afima akpɔ o.

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Eye Mose, Yehowa ƒe dɔla, ku ɖe afima le Moab-nyigba dzi, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ ene.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖii ɖe bali la me le Moab-nyigba dzi le Bet-Peor kasa; ke amea ɖeke menya eɖiƒe vaseɖe egbe o.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Eye Israel-viwo fa na Mose ŋkeke blaetɔ̃ sɔŋ le Moab-tagba. Emegbe wowu avifafa-ŋkekeawo kple funyinyi na Mose nu.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Eye nunyagbɔgbɔ yɔ Yosua, Nun vi fũ, elabena Mose da asi ɖe edzi. Eye Israel-viwo ɖo toe, eye wowɔ, abe alesi Yehowa de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Ke nyagblɔɖila ɖeke megana Israel kpɔ abe Mose, Yehowa nya ŋku me kple ŋku me ene o;

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: amesi Yehowa ɖɔ ɖe Egipte-nyigba dzi, be wòawɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo ɖe Farao kple eƒe dɔlawo katã kpakple eƒe anyigba blibo la ŋu;

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: hekpe ɖe ŋusẽnu kple nu tsu dziŋɔ, siwo katã Mose wɔ le Israel blibo la ŋku me ŋuti.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Le Yehowa ƒe dɔla Mose ƒe ku megbe la Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua, Nun vi, si nye Mose ƒe subɔla bena:

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: Nye dɔla Mose ku, eyata tsi tre, eye mia kple dukɔ blibo la miatso Yordan sia ayi anyigba, si mebe, mana Israel-viwo la dzi.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: Teƒe sia teƒe, si miaƒe afɔƒome aɖo la, matsɔe na mi, abe alesi megblɔ na Mose ene.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Miaƒe anyigba atso gbedzi kple Libanon sia gbɔ vaseɖe Frat-tɔsisi gã la nu, Xititɔwo ƒe anyigba blibo la vaseɖe ƒu gã la nu le ɣetoɖoƒe gome.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke manɔ te ɖe nuwò le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me o; alesi menɔ kple Mose la, nenema manɔ kple wò hã; nyemaɖe asi le ŋuwò o, eye nyemagblẽ wò ɖi o.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Megaɖe nu le segbalẽ sia ŋu o, eye nabu eŋu zã kple keli, ne nalé nusiwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe eme la me ɖe asi, eye nawɔ wo dzi; elabena eya ko hafi dzɔgbenyuie anɔ mɔ dzi na wò, eye nusianu adze dzi na wò.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Menye ɖe meɖe se na wò be, lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye nasẽ ŋu, ŋɔ megadzi wò o, eye dzidzi megaƒo wò oa? Elabena Yehowa, wò Mawu la, li kpli wò le afisiafi, si nayi ɖo. Dukɔ la be, yeado to Yosua.

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Tete Yosua ɖe se na dukɔ la dzikpɔlawo bena:

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: Mitsa le asaɖa lãme, ne miade se na dukɔ la bena: Midzra mɔ dzi nuɖuɖu ɖo, elabena ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la miele Yordan sia tso ge ayi aɖaxɔ anyigba, si Yehowa, mia Mawu be, yeatsɔ na mi wòanye mia tɔ la.

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Eye Yosua gblɔ na Ruben-viwo, Gad-viwo kple Manase-viwo ƒe to afã bena:

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime Yehowa ana mia nɔviwo hã nakpɔ gbɔdzɔe abe miawo ke ene; eye ne Yehowa, mia Mawu, tsɔ anyigba, si wòle wo na ge, na wo la, ekema miagbugbɔ ayi aɖaxɔ anyigba, si Yehowa ƒe ɖɔla Mose na mi le Yordan godo le ɣedzeƒe gome.

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Tete woɖo ŋu na Yosua bena: Míawɔ se, siwo katã nède na mí la dzi, eye afisiafi, si nèdɔ mí ɖo la, míayi!

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Woawu amesiame, si asẽ to ɖe wò sededewo ŋu, eye maɖo to wò nya, siwo katã negblɔ na mi o la. Lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye nasẽ ŋu ko!

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Eye Yosua, Nun vi, ɖɔ ŋutsu eve le adza me tso Sitim, be woaɖatsa ŋku, gblɔ bena: Miyi ɖakpɔ anyigba la kple Yerixo ɖa! Tete woyi, eye wova dze gboloa ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Raxab la ƒe me, eye wotsi afima dɔ.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ na Yerixo-fia bena: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsuwo tso Israel-viwo dome va afisia egbe zã, be woatsa ŋku le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Hafi ŋutsuawo nadɔ alɔ la, nyɔnu la yi wo gbɔ le xɔta

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: gblɔ na wo bena: Menyae bena, Yehowa le anyigba la tsɔ ge na mi, ŋɔdzi, si le mia ŋu la, va lé mí, eye anyigbadzitɔwo katã de asi nua vɔvɔ̃ me.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Elabena míese, alesi Yehowa na Avaƒu la mie le mia ŋgɔ, esime mieʋu tso Egipte, kpakple nusi miewɔ Amoritɔwo ƒe fia eveawo, siwo nye Sixon kple Og le Yordan godo, amesiwo mietsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Esi míesee la, dzi ɖe le mia ƒo, eye kalẽ megale amea ɖeke me ɖe mia ŋu o, elabena Yehowa, mia Mawu, enye Mawu le dziƒo afime kple anyigba dzi afi.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ mita Yehowa nam, eye alesi meve mía nui la,; nenema ke miawo hã miave nye ƒome nui, eye mina dzesim ɖe dzi,

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: be miana fofonye kple danye, nɔvinyeŋutsuwo kple nɔvinyenyɔnuwo kpakple woƒe ƒometɔwo katã natsi agbe, eye miaxɔ mí ɖe agbe.

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsuawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Ne miegblɔ nya sia wose o, eye Yehowa tsɔ anyigba la na mí, gake míeve nuwo o, eye míeɖi anukware na wò o la, ekema míaku ɖe mia teƒe!

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Tete wòtsɔ atagbi ɖiɖi wo to eƒe xɔ, si le dua ƒe gli ŋu la, ƒe fesre nu ɖe anyi; elabena eƒe aƒe le glia dzi.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miɖo ta toawo dzi, ne mia yometilawo magaɖo go mi o, eye miɣla mia ɖokui ɖe afima ŋkeke etɔ̃, vaseɖe esime mia yometilawo atrɔ, emegbe hafi mialé miaƒe mɔ.

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo ŋu na wo bena: Neva me, abe alesi miegblɔ ene! Eye wòɖe asi le wo ŋu woyi. Eyome wòtsi ka dzẽ dada ɖe fesre la nu.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Eye woyi dzi ɖatsi afima ŋkeke etɔ̃ sɔŋ, vaseɖe esime wo yometilawo trɔ gbɔ. Eye wo yometilawo ɖi wo le mɔ blibo la katã dzi, gake womekpɔ wo o.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsu eveawo gbugbɔ tso toawo dzi, eye wotso tɔ la va Yosua, Nun vi la gbɔ hexlẽ nusiwo katã dzɔ ɖe wo dzi la nɛ.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ na Yosua bena: Nyateƒee, Yehowa tsɔ anyigba blibo la de asi na mí, elabena anyigbadzitɔwo hã le mía vɔ̃m.

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Tete Yosua kple Israel-viwo katã fɔ ŋdi kanya, eye woho tso Sitim heva Yordan nu, eye wotsi afima dɔ, hafi woava tso tɔ la.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke etɔ megbe la dzikpɔlawo tsa le asaɖa la me,

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: Ke mina mia kplii dome nadidi abɔklugui akpe eve, eye migate de eŋu wu o, ne mianya mɔ, si to ge miala, elabena mieto mɔ sia dzi kpɔ o.

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Eye Yosua gblɔ na dukɔ la bena: Mikɔ mia dokui ŋu, elabena etsɔ la Yehowa le nukunu wɔ ge le mia dome.

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Eye Yosua gblɔ na nunɔlawo bena: Mikɔ nubablaɖaka la dze dukɔ la ŋgɔ! Tete wokɔ nubablaɖaka la dze dukɔ la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua bena: Madze gɔme egbe ade asi gãɖoɖo me wò le Israel blibo la ŋku me, ne wòadze sii be, alesi mena kple Mose la, nenema ke mana kpli wò hã.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: De se na nunɔla, siwo le nubablaɖaka tsam la bena: Ne mieva ɖo Yordan-tɔa nu la, ekema mitɔ ɖe afima!

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Tete Yosua gblɔ na Israel-viwo bena: Mite va ali, ne miase Yehowa, mia Mawu ƒe nya!

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Eye Yosua gblɔ bena: Esia miatsɔ adze sii bena, Mawu gbagbe le mia dome, eye wòle Kanaanitɔwo, Xititɔwo, Xiwitɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Girgasitɔwo, Amoritɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo nyã ge da le mia ŋgɔ vavã.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla, siwo tsɔ anyigba blibo la ƒe Aƒetɔ, Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka, ƒe afɔƒome ka Yordan me tsia me la, ekema Yordan me tsi la nu atso, eye dzigbe gome tsi la amii kɔ de afi ɖeka.

english_verse: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front,
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ la do tso woƒe agbadɔwo me, eye woho, be yewoatso Yordan, eye nunɔlawo tsɔ nubablaɖaka la dze dukɔa ŋgɔ.

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Esi aɖakatsɔlawo va Yordan nu, eye nunɔla, siwo tsɔ aɖaka la, ƒe afɔwo ka tsia me la, ke Yordan ɖɔ gbagba go le nuŋeɣi blibo la katã me —

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla, siwo tsɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la, tɔ ɖe tsitre sesĩe le ƒuƒuiƒe le Yordan titina, vaseɖe esime dukɔ blibo la va Yordan godo.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Esi dukɔ blibo la ɖi go ɖe Yordan godo vɔ la, Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua bena:

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: eye miɖe se na wo bena: Miyi ɖaɖe kpe wuieve le Yordan me le teƒe, si nunɔlawo ƒe afɔ tsi tre ɖo la, eye mitsɔ wo va teƒe, si miedro ɖo, afisi miele tsitsi ge adɔ la.

english_verse: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together
translation_verse: Tete Yosua yɔ ŋutsu wuieve, siwo wotia ɖi la, le Israel-viwo dome, to ɖeka ame ɖeka.

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: Eye Yosua gblɔ na wo bena: Miyi Yordan titina le Yehowa, mia Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ, eye mia dome amesiame natsɔ kpe ɖeka ɖe abɔta, ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu;

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: ekema migblɔ na wo bena: Elabena Yordan me tsia nu tso le Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ; esi wole Yordan tso ge la, tete Yordan me tsi la nu tso, eyata kpe siawo nye ŋkuɖodzinu na Israel-viwo tegbee do.

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-viwo wɔ, abe alesi Yosua de se na wo ene; wode kpe wuieve le Yordan titina ɖe Israel-viwo ƒe toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua ene, eye wotsɔ wo va ɖa ɖe afisi wodro ɖo.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Ke Yosua tu kpe wuieve ɖe Yordan titina hã, ɖe afisi nunɔla, siwo tsɔ nubablaɖaka, ƒe afɔwo tsi tre ɖo, eye wotsi afima vaseɖe egbe.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Dukɔ la ɖi go ɖe Yordan godo le ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke ewolia dzi, eye woƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Gilgal le Yerixo ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Eye Yosua tsɔ kpe wuieve ma, siwo woɖe le Yordan me la, lu ɖe Gilgal.

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na Israel-viwo bena: Ne mia viwo ava bia wo fofowo gbaɖegbe bena, kpe siawo gɔme ɖe hã la,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: elabena Yehowa, mia Mawu, na Yordan me tsi la mie le mia ŋgɔ, eye mieto eme yi, abe alesi Yehowa, mia Mawu, na Avaƒu la mie le mía ŋgɔ, eye mieto eme yi ene;

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: ne anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã nadze si Yehowa ƒe asi sesẽ la, eye miawo miavo Yehowa, mia Mawu la ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Esi Amoritɔwo ƒe fiawo katã, amesiwo le Yordan godo le ɣedzeƒe gome, kple Kanaanitɔwo ƒe fiawo katã, amesiwo le ƒu ŋu, se bena, Yehowa na Yordan me tsi la mie le Israel-viwo ŋgɔ, eye wòto me ɖi go la, tete dzi ɖe le wo ƒo, eye kalẽ megale amea ɖeke me ɖe Israel-viwo ŋu o. Aʋatsotso le Kanaan-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua bena: Tsɔ kpe wo hɛ, eye natso aʋa na Israel-viwo zi evelia!

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Tete Yosua tso kpe wo hɛwo hetso aʋa na Israel-viwo le Aralot-togbɛ la gbɔ.

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ wo viwo ɖo wo teƒe; woawoe Yosua tso aʋa na, elabena bolobolotɔwo wonye, eye wometso aʋa na wo le mɔ ta o.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Esi wotso aʋa na wo katã vɔ la, wotsi afima le woƒe asaɖa me, vaseɖe esime abia ku na wo.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua bena: Meɖe Egipte-ŋukpe ɖa le mia ŋu egbe; eyata wona ŋkɔ teƒe ta bena Gilgal vaseɖe egbe. Ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie. Mana la nu tso.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Esi Israel-viwo ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Gilgal la, woɖu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la le ɣleti la ƒe ŋkeke wuienelia dzi le fiẽ le Yerixo-tagba,

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Eye esi woɖu anyigba dzi agblemenuwo ŋu ke la, mana la nu tso, eye mana ɖeke megali na Israel-viwo o, ke boŋ woɖu Kanaan-nyigba dzi agblemenuwo le ƒe ma me. Mawudɔla ɖe eɖokui na Yosua.

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Esi Yosua le Yerixo gbɔ, eye wòfɔ ko dzi la, ekpɔ ŋutsua ɖe ɖi yi ɖe asi, le tsitre ɖe eŋgɔ. Tete Yosua zɔ ɖe edzi biae bena: Mía dzi nèle loo, alo míaƒe futɔwo dzi nèlea?

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu be: Gbeɖe, ke boŋ Yehowa ƒe aʋafia menye; azu medo enye si! Tete Yosua tsyo mo anyi hede ta agu, eye wòbiae bena: Nya ka le nye aƒetɔ si na eƒe dɔla?

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe aʋafia la gblɔ na Yosua bena: Ɖe wò atokota le afɔ, elabena teƒe, si nèle tsitre ɖo la, teƒe kɔkɔe! Tete Yosua wo nenema.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: Ke wodo Yerixo ƒe agbowo hexe mɔ na Israel-viwo, eye amea ɖeke mete ŋu do alo va me o.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla adre natsɔ akɔfɛ adre adze aɖaka la ŋgɔ. Ke le ŋkeke adreagbe la woazɔ aƒo xlã du la akpe ɖo zi adre, eye nunɔlawo naku akɔfɛawo.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Ne wonyã ku lãdzoawo tsiã ɖe nu miese ko la, dukɔ blibo la natso aseye hoo, ekema du la ƒe gliwo aŋe adze eme, eye dukɔ la nakpɔ ŋgɔ tẽ age ɖe me.

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Tete Yosua, Nun vi, yɔ nunɔlawo gblɔ na wo bena: Mitsɔ nubablaɖaka la, eye nunɔla adre natsɔ akɔfɛ adre adze Yehowa ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe aɖaka la ƒo xlã du la va kpe zi ɖeka, emegbe wogbugbɔ vɔ asaɖa la me hetsi afima ɖɔ.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Ke wòfɔ le ŋkeke adreagbe kaba, esime dzite tso, eye wozɔ ƒo xlã du la alea zi adre; le ŋkeke adrelia dzi ko woƒo xlã du la zi adre.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Zi adrelia la nunɔlawo ku akɔfɛawo, eye Yosua gblɔ na dukɔ la bena: Mitso aseye, elabena Yehowa tsɔ du la de asi na mi!

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Mitsrɔ̃ du la kple nusiwo katã le eme gbidigbidi na Yehowa; negbe Raxab, gbolo la, kple amesiwo katã le eƒe me ko miaxɔ de agbe, elabena eyae tsɔ amesiwo míedɔ la ɣla.

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ la tso aseye, eye woku akɔfɛawo. Esi dukɔ la se akɔfɛawo ƒe ɖiɖi la, wotso aseye hoo, tete ɖu la ƒe gliwo mu ɖo baba, eye dukɔ la ge ɖe dua me, amesiame kpɔ ŋgɔ tẽ, eye woxɔ du la.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi Yosua ka atam bena: Ŋutsu, si atso, be yeagbugbɔ Yerixo-du sia atso la, aɖi eŋu le Yehowa ŋku me. Via ŋgɔgbea ƒe ku wòatsɔ aɖo egɔme anyi, eye eƒe dɔmlɔea ƒe ku wòatsɔ aɖe agbo enu!

english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa nɔ kple Yosua, ale be eƒe ŋkɔ kaka ɖe anyigba la katã dzi.

english_verse: The Lord had said that everything in Jericho belonged to him. But Achan from the Judah tribe took some of the things from Jericho for himself. And so the Lord was angry with the Israelites, because one of them had disobeyed him.
translation_verse: Ke Israel-viwo meɖi anukware le busunuawo me o, elabena Axan, Karmi vi, amesi nye Sabdi vi, amesi nye Zerax vi tso Yuda-toa me la, tsɔ busunuawo ƒe ɖe. Tete Yehowa ɖo dɔmedzoe ɖe Israel-viwo ŋu.

english_verse: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.
translation_verse: Tete Yosua dze eƒe awuwo, eye eya kple Israel ame tsitsiwo tsyɔ mo anyi ɖe Yehowa ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ vaseɖe fiẽ, eye wolɔ ke kɔ ɖe ta me.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Eye Yosua gblɔ bena: Oo, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, nukaŋuti nèkplɔ dukɔ sia tso Yordan, be natsɔ mi ade asi na Amoritɔwo, ne woatsrɔ̃ mi? Oo, ɖe míetsi Yordan godo la, ne nyo wu!

english_verse: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.
translation_verse: Taflatse Aƒetɔ, esi Israel trɔ megbe ɖe eƒe futɔwo la, aleke gblɔ ge mala?

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.
translation_verse: Eye ne Kanaanitɔwo kple anyigbadzitɔwo katã see la, ekema woava kpe ta ɖe mía ŋu, eye woatsrɔ̃ míaƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le anyigba dzi; emegbe ɖe, aleke nawɔ ɖe wò ŋkɔ gã la ta?

english_verse: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ na Yosua bena: Tsi tre! Nukaŋuti gɔ̃ nètsyɔ mo anyi?

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Nuvɔ̃e Israel wɔ, eye wotu nye nu, si mebia kpli wo la, wotsɔ busunuawo ƒe ɖe, eye wofi fi, wowɔ alakpanu, eye wotsɔe ɣla ɖe woƒe nuwo dome.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Israel-viwo magate ŋu anɔ te ɖe woƒe futɔwo nu akpɔ o, megbe kokoko woatrɔ ade woƒe futɔwo, elabena busu le wo dzi. Nyemaganɔ anyi kpli mi o, negbe ɖeko miaɖe busu la ɖa le mia dome hafi.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.
translation_verse: Tsi tre, nakɔ dukɔ la ŋu, eye gblɔ na wo bena: Mikɔ mia dokui ŋu hena etsɔ! Elabena ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Israel, busu le mia dome, eyata miate ŋu anɔ te de miaƒe futɔwo nu akpɔ o, vaseɖe esime miaɖe busu la ɖa le mia dome hafi.

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Eye woatɔ dzo amesi gbɔ wokpɔ busunua le, kpakple nusiwo katã le esi, elabena etu Yehowa ƒe nubabla, eye wòwɔ ŋukpenanu le Israel.

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Eye Yosua tso ŋdi kanya, eye wòna Israel-toawo te va, tete wòlé Yuda-to la.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòna eƒe aƒe te va ŋutsu ɖekaɖeka la, asi tu Axan, Karmi vi, amesi nye Zabdi vi, amesi nye Zerax vi tso Yuda-to la me.
