translation_verse: Tete Dawid ɖi vɔsamlekpui na Yehowa ɖe afima, eye wosa numevɔ kple akpedavɔ. Eye Yehowa se gbe, si wòdo ɖa ɖe anyigba la ta, eye dɔvɔ̃ la nu tso le Israel.

english_verse: King David was now an old man, and he always felt cold, even under a lot of blankets.
translation_verse: Esi fia Dawid ku amegã xɔ ƒe geɖe la, wotsyɔa avɔwo ne, gake dzo meɖoa eƒe lã me o.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we will look for a young woman to take care of you. She can lie down beside you and keep you warm.”
translation_verse: Tete eƒe dolawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Woadi ɖetugbi atiatia ɖe na miaƒe aƒetɔ fia la, ne woatsi tre ɖe fia la ŋku me akpɔ edzi, eye wòamlɔ wò akɔ nu alé dzo ɖe miaƒe aƒetɔ fia la ŋu.

english_verse: Adonijah was the son of David and Haggith. He was Absalom's younger brother and was very handsome. One day, Adonijah started bragging, “I'm going to make myself king!” So he got some chariots and horses, and he hired
translation_verse: Le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo me la fofoa mehe nya ɖe eŋu kpɔ be: nukaŋuti nèwɔ esi kple esi hã o. Edze ɖeka hã ŋutɔ, eye eya wòdzi ɖe Absalom yome.

english_verse: Adonijah met with Joab the son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest and asked them if they would help him become king. Both of them agreed to help.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo gbe ɖi kple Yoab, Zeruya vi, kpakple nunɔla Abyatar, eye wokpe ɖe Adoniya ŋu.

english_verse: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David's bodyguards all refused.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔla Zadok, Benaya, Yehoyada vi, nyagblɔɖila Natan. Simei kple Rei kpakple Dawid ƒe kalẽtɔwo mele Adoniya ƒe nya me o.

english_verse: Adonijah invited his brothers and David's officials from Judah to go with him to Crawling Rock near Rogel Spring, where he sacrificed some sheep, cattle, and fat calves.
translation_verse: Eye Adoniya wu alẽwo, nyiwo kple nyivi damiwo le Soxelet-kpe la gbɔ le Rogel-vudo la xa, eye wokpe nɔviaŋutsuwo katã, siwo nye fiaviwo kple Yuda-ŋutsuwo katã, siwo nye fia ƒe dɔlawo

english_verse: But he did not invite Nathan, Benaiah, David's bodyguards, or his own brother Solomon.
translation_verse: ke mekpe nyagblɔɖila Natan Benaya kple kalẽtɔwo kple nɔvia Salomo o.

english_verse: When Nathan heard what had happened, he asked Bathsheba, Solomon's mother: Have you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has made himself king? But David doesn't know a thing about it.
translation_verse: Eye Natan gblɔ na Salomo dada Bat-Seba bena: Mese be, Adoniya, Xagit vi, zu fia, eye miaƒe aƒetɔ, fia Dawid, menyae oa?

english_verse: You and your son Solomon will be killed, unless you do what I tell you.
translation_verse: Eyata va maɖo adaŋu na wò, ne naɖe wò ŋutɔ kple viwò Salomo ƒe agbe.

english_verse: Go say to David, “You promised me that Solomon would be the next king. So why is Adonijah now king?”
translation_verse: Tso, nayi fia Dawid gbɔ, eye nagblɔ ne bena: Nye aƒetɔ fia, menye ɖe nèka atam na wò dɔlanyɔnu gblɔ bena: Viwò Salomo azu fia ɖe yonyeme, eye wòanɔ nye fiazikpui dzi oa? Nukaŋuti Adoniya zu fia?

english_verse: While you are still talking to David, I'll come in and tell him that everything you said is true.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ne ègale nu ƒom kple fia la le afima la, madze yowòme ava ɖo kpe wò nyawo dzi.

english_verse: Meanwhile, David was in his bedroom where Abishag was taking care of him because he was so old. Bathsheba went in
translation_verse: Tete Bat-Seba yi fia la gbɔ le xɔgã me. Fia lã tsi ŋutɔ, eye Abisag, Sunamitɔ la, la fia la subɔm.

english_verse: and bowed down. “What can I do for you?” David asked.
translation_verse: Eye Bat-Seba bɔbɔ hede la agu ɖe fia la ŋku me, eye fia la gblɔ nɛ bena: Nuka le wɔwòm?

english_verse: Bathsheba answered: Your Majesty, you promised me in the name of the Lord your God that my son Solomon would be the next king.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Nye aƒetɔ, eta Yehowa, wò Mawu, na wò dɔlanyɔnu bena: Viwò Salomo azu fia ɖe yonyeme, eye wòanɔ nye fiazikpui dzi!

english_verse: But Adonijah has already been made king, and you didn't know anything about it.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, kpɔ ɖa, Adoniya zu fia, eye wò, nye aƒetɔ fia, menyae o.

english_verse: He sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. And he invited Abiathar the priest, Joab your army commander, and all your sons to be there, except Solomon, your loyal servant.
translation_verse: Ewu nyitsuwo, nyi damiwo kple alẽwo kpaŋkpaŋ, eye wokpe na viŋutsuwo katã kple nunɔla Abyatar kpakple aʋafia Yoab; ke mekpe wò dɔla Salomo ya o.

english_verse: Your Majesty, everyone in Israel is waiting for you to announce who will be the next king.
translation_verse: Nye aƒetɔ fia, Israel blibo la le nuwò kpɔm, be nagblɔ amesi le nye aƒetɔ fia ƒe fiazikpui dzi nɔ ge ɖe yowome la, na wo

english_verse: If you don't, they will say that Solomon and I have rebelled. They will treat us like criminals and kill us as soon as you die.
translation_verse: Elabena ava me be, ne nye aƒetɔ fia mia fofoawo gbɔ la, ekema woakpɔ mia kple vinye Salomo abe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ene.

english_verse: Someone told David that he was there, and Nathan came in. He bowed with his face to the ground
translation_verse: Tete woyi ɖa gblɔe na fia la bena: Kpɔ ɖa, nyagblɔɖila Natan enye si. Eye wòva fia la gbɔ hede la agu ɖe fia la ŋku me.

english_verse: and said: Your Majesty, did you say that Adonijah would be king?
translation_verse: Eye Natan gblɔ bena: Nye aƒetɔ fia, wòe gblɔ be, Adoniya nezu fia ɖe ye yome, eye wòanɔ yeƒe fiazikpui dzia?

english_verse: Earlier today, he sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. He invited the army commanders, Abiathar, and all your sons to be there. They are already eating and drinking and shouting, “Long live King Adonijah!”
translation_verse: Elabena egbe la eyi ɖa wu nyitsuwo, nyi damiwo kple alẽwo kpaŋkpaŋ, eye wokpe fia viŋutsuwo katã, aʋakɔ la ƒe tatɔwo kpakple nunɔla Abyatar; kpɔ ɖa, woɖu nu, eye wono nu le egbɔ, eye wodo ɣli bena: Fia Adoniya nenɔ agbe!

english_verse: But he didn't invite me or Zadok the priest or Benaiah or Solomon.
translation_verse: Ke mekpe nye, wò dɔla, kple nunɔla Zadok, Benaya, Yehoyada vi, kpakple wò dɔla Salomo o.

english_verse: Did you say they could do this without telling the rest of us who would be the next king? Solomon Becomes King
translation_verse: Nye aƒetɔ fia gbɔe nya sia tso, hafi megblɔ amesi anɔ nye aƒetɔ fia ƒe fiazikpui dzi ɖe eyome la na wò dɔla oa?

english_verse: David said, “Tell Bathsheba to come here.” She came and stood in front of him.
translation_verse: Tete fia Dawid xɔ edzi gblɔ bena; Miyɔ Bat-Seba ɖem! Eye wòva fia la gbɔ le eme hetsi tre ɖe fia la ŋku me.

english_verse: Then he said, “The living Lord God of Israel has kept me safe. And so today, I will keep the promise I made to you in his name: Solomon will be the next king!”
translation_verse: Alesi meta Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, na wò gblɔ bena: Viwò Salomo azu fia ɖe yonyeme, eye wòano nye fiazikpui dzi ɖe tenyeƒe la, nenema mawɔ egbe sia!

english_verse: Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground and said, “Your Majesty, I pray that you will live a long time!”
translation_verse: Tete Bat-Seba bɔbɔ ɖe fia la ŋku me hede ta agu gblɔ bena: Nye aƒetɔ fia nanɔ agbe tegbee. Wosi ami na Salomo heɖo fiae.

english_verse: Then David said, “Tell Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah to come here.” When they arrived,
translation_verse: Eye fia Dawid gblɔ bena: Miyɔ nunɔla Zadok kple nyagblɔɖila Natan kpakple Benaya, Yehoyada vi ɖem. Esi wova fia la ŋku me la,

english_verse: he told them: Take along some of my officials and let Solomon ride my own mule to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: fia la gblɔ na wo bena: Miɖe miaƒe aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlawo kpe ɖe mia ɖokui ŋu, eye mina vinye Salomo nado nye tedzisɔ, ne miakplɔe yi Gixon.

english_verse: When you get there, Zadok and Nathan will pour olive oil over Solomon's head to show that he is the new king of Israel. Then order someone to blow a trumpet and tell everyone to shout, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla Zadok kple nyagblɔɖila Natan nasi ami ne le afima ahaɖoe fia ɖe Israel nu; miku kpẽ, eye míado ɣli bena: Fia Salomo nenɔ agbe!

english_verse: Bring him back here, and he will take my place as king. He is the one I have chosen to rule Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Emegbe mikplɔe do, eye wòava bɔbɔ nɔ nye fiazikpui dzi ahazu fia ɖe tenyeƒe; elabena eya meɖo, be wòaɖu amegã ɖe Israel kple Yuda dzi.

english_verse: Benaiah answered, “We will do it, Your Majesty. I pray that the Lord your God will let it happen.
translation_verse: Tete Benaya, Yehoyada vi, xɔ edzi gblɔ na fia la bena: Neva me! Alea Yehowa, nye aƒetɔ fia la ƒe Mawu, agblɔ aƒu edzi.

english_verse: The Lord has always watched over you, and I pray that he will now watch over Solomon. May the Lord help Solomon to be an even greater king than you.”
translation_verse: Alesi Yehowa nɔ kple nye aƒetɔ fia la, nenema wòanɔ kple Salomo, eye wòana eƒe fiazikpui naƒo nye aƒetɔ fia Dawid ƒe fiazikpui ta

english_verse: Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah left and took along the two groups of David's special bodyguards. Solomon rode on David's mule as they led him to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: Tete nunɔla Zadok, nyagblɔɖila Natan kple Benaya, Yehoyada vi, kpakple Kretitɔwo kple Pletitɔwo woyi, eye wona Salomo do fia Dawid ƒe tedzisɔ, eye wokplɔe yi Gixon.

english_verse: Zadok the priest brought some olive oil from the sacred tent and poured it on Solomon's head to show that he was now king. A trumpet was blown and everyone shouted, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla Zadok tsɔ lãdzo, si me ami le la, tso agbadɔ la me hesi ami na Salomo, eye woku kpẽ; tete dukɔ blibo la do ɣli bena. Fia Salomo nenɔ agbe!

english_verse: Then they played flutes and celebrated as they followed Solomon back to Jerusalem. They made so much noise that the ground shook.
translation_verse: Emegbe dukɔ blibo la kplɔe ɖo, eye dukɔ la ku dzewo hekpɔ dzidzɔ eteƒe mekɔ o, eye woƒe ɣli na be, anyigba ʋuʋu.

english_verse: Adonijah and his guests had almost finished eating when they heard the noise. Joab also heard the trumpet and asked, “What's all that noise about in the city?”
translation_verse: Esi Adoniya kple amesiwo katã wokpe ɖe egbɔ la, ɖu nua vɔ tete la, wosee. Ke esi Yoab se kpẽawo ƒe ɖiɖi la, egblɔ bena: Howɔwɔ ka enye si le ɖiɖim le dua me?

english_verse: Just then, Jonathan son of Abiathar came running up. “Come in,” Adonijah said. “An important man like you must have some good news.”
translation_verse: Esi wogale nuƒoƒo dzi la, Yonatan, nunɔla Abyatar vi do, eye Adoniya gblɔ bena: Va, elabena ame zãzɛ nènye, eye gbe nyuia ɖe nèhe ve.

english_verse: Jonathan answered: No, I don't! David has just announced that Solomon will be king.
translation_verse: Yonatan ɖo ŋu gblɔ na Adoniya bena: Ele eme! Míaƒe aƒetɔ fia Dawid tsɔ Salomo ɖo fiae.

english_verse: Solomon rode David's own mule to Gihon Spring, and Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and David's special bodyguards went with him. When they got there, Zadok and Nathan made Solomon king. Then everyone celebrated all the way back to Jerusalem. That's the noise you hear in the city.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla Zadok kple nyagblɔɖila Natan wosi ami nɛ heɖoe fia le Gixon, eye wole dzidzɔ kpɔm tso afima gbɔe, eye du la ʋuʋu; esia nye ɣli, si sem miele.

english_verse: Solomon is now king.
translation_verse: Salomo bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi;

english_verse: And listen to this! David's officials told him, “We pray that your God will help Solomon to be an even greater king!” David was in his bed at the time, but he bowed
translation_verse: eye fia la ƒe dɔlawo hã yi, be yewoayra míaƒe aƒetɔ fia Dawid gblɔ bena: Wò Mawu ana Salomo ƒe ŋkɔ nade du wu wò ŋkɔ, eye eƒe fiazikpui naƒo wò fiazikpui ta! Tete fia la bɔbɔ ɖe aba dzi.

english_verse: and prayed, “I praise you, Lord God of Israel. You have made my son Solomon king and have let me live to see it.”
translation_verse: Eye fia la hã gblɔ be: Woakafu Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, si na amesi ano nye fiazikpui dzi la egbea, eye nye ŋkuwo kpɔe!

english_verse: Adonijah's guests shook with fear when they heard this news, and they left as fast as they could.
translation_verse: Tete dzika tso amesiwo katã Adoniya kpe la ƒo, eye wotsi tre, eye amesiame lé eƒe mɔ.

english_verse: Someone told Solomon, “Adonijah is afraid of you and is holding onto the corners of the altar. He wants you to promise that you won't kill him.”
translation_verse: Eye wova gblɔ na Salomo bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Adoniya le fia Salomo vɔ̃m, eye wòɖalé vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo gblɔ bena: Fia Salomo neka atam nam egbe be, mawu eƒe dɔla kple yi o.

english_verse: Solomon answered, “If Adonijah doesn't cause any trouble, I won't hurt him. But if he does, I'll have him killed.”
translation_verse: Eye Salomo gblɔ bena: Ne enye nuteƒewɔla la, ekema eƒe taɖaa ɖeke mage ɖe anyigba o: ke ne woakpɔ vɔ̃a ɖe le eŋu la, ekema aku.

english_verse: Then he sent someone to the altar to get Adonijah. After Adonijah came and bowed down, Solomon said, “Adonijah, go home.”
translation_verse: Eye fia Salomo dɔ woɖakplɔe tso vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ ve, eye wòva de ta agu ɖe fia Salomo ŋku me, eye Salomo gblɔ ne bena: Yi aƒewò me!

english_verse: Not long before David died, he told Solomon:
translation_verse: Esi Dawid ƒe kuɣi le aƒe tum la, ede se na via Salomo gblɔ bena:

english_verse: My son, I will soon die, as everyone must. But I want you to be strong and brave.
translation_verse: Mele demagbɔnugbe yim, eyata sẽ ŋu, eye wɔ ŋutsu.

english_verse: Do what the Lord your God commands and follow his teachings. Obey everything written in the Law of Moses. Then you will be a success, no matter what you do or where you go.
translation_verse: Lé ŋku ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu, ƒe nudidiwo ŋu, eye nazɔ eƒe mɔwo dzi, ne nalé eƒe ɖoɖowo, sewo, kɔnuwo kple ɖaseɖiɖiwo me ɖe asi, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖe Mose ƒe se la me ene, ne nusiwo katã nawɔ kple afisiafi, si nayi la, nadze edzi na wò;

english_verse: You and your descendants must always faithfully obey the Lord. If you do, he will keep the solemn promise he made to me that someone from our family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: ne Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ ɖe ŋunye la, nava me be: Ne viwòŋutsuwo lé ŋku ɖe woƒe mɔwo ŋu, eye wozɔ anukwaretɔe le ŋkunye me kple woƒe dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo la, ekema wò amesiwo anɔ Israel-fiazikpuia dzi la, nu matso akpɔ o.

english_verse: Solomon, don't forget what Joab did to me by killing Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, the two commanders of Israel's army. He killed them as if they were his enemies in a war, but he did it when there was no war. He is guilty, and now it's up to you to punish him
translation_verse: Enya nusi Yoab, Zeruya vi la wɔm, nusi wòwɔ Israel ƒe aʋafia eveawo Abner, Ner vi, kple Amasa, Yeter vi la, amesiwo wowu, eye wòbia hlɔ̃ ɖe ʋu, si wokɔ ɖe anyi le aʋa me la nu le ŋutifafaɣi, eye wòna aʋaʋu ƒo eƒe alidziblanu, si le eƒe ali, kple afɔkpa, si le eƒe afɔ.

english_verse: in the way you think best. Whatever you do, don't let him die peacefully in his old age.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɖe wò nunya la nu, be eƒe ta ɣi magayi tsie le ŋutifafa me o.

english_verse: Be sure to do something about Shimei son of Gera from Bahurim in the territory of Benjamin. He cursed and insulted me the day I went to Mahanaim. But later, when he came to meet me at the Jordan River, I promised that I wouldn't kill him.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Benyamintɔ Simei tso Baxurim le gbɔwò; eyae ɖi gbɔm vevie le gbesigbe meyina ɖe Maxanayim, ke eva kpem le Yordan nu, eye mefa Yehowa nɛ gblɔ bena: Nyemawu wò kple yi o.

english_verse: Now you must punish him. He's an old man, but you're wise enough to know that you must have him killed. David Dies
translation_verse: Eyata megagbe tohehe ne o, elabena ame nyanu nènye, eye ànya nusi nawɔe, be eƒe ta ɣi nayi tsie kple ʋu.

english_verse: he saddled his donkey and went after them. He found them and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tete Simei tso, bia akpa na eƒe tedzi, eye wòyi Axis gbɔ le Gat, be yeadi yeƒe dɔlawo. Eye Simei yi ɖakplɔ eƒe dɔlawo tso Gat gbɔe.

english_verse: Joab's family will always suffer because of what he did, but the Lord will always bless David's family and his kingdom with peace.
translation_verse: Eye woƒe ʋu agbugbɔ ava Yoab kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe ta dzi tegbee; ke ŋutifafa atso Yehowa gbɔ ava Dawid kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo kple eƒe aƒe kpakple eƒe fiazikpui la dzi tegbee.

english_verse: His son Solomon became king and took control of David's kingdom. Adonijah Is Killed
translation_verse: Eye Salomo bɔbɔ nɔ fofoa Dawid ƒe fiazikpui la dzi, eye eƒe fiaɖuƒe la li ke ŋutɔ.

english_verse: One day, Adonijah went to see Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, and she asked, “Is this a friendly visit?” “Yes.
translation_verse: Eye Adoniya. Xagit vi la, yi Salomo dada Bat-Seba gbɔ. Ebiae bena: Ŋutifafa me nèva lea? Eɖo ŋu bena: Ŋutifafa mee!

english_verse: I just want to talk with you.” “All right,” she told him, “go ahead.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Nyaa ɖe le asinye, be magblɔ na wò. Eɖo ŋu be: Ƒo nu!

english_verse: “You know that I was king for a little while,” Adonijah replied. “And everyone in Israel accepted me as their ruler. But the Lord wanted my brother to be king, so now things have changed.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ be: Wò ŋutɔ ènyae be, fiaɖuƒe la nye tɔnye, eye Israel blibo la ƒe ŋku le ŋunye, be nyee le fia nye ge; ke fiaɖuƒe la trɔ yi ɖe nɔvinye si, elabena Yehowae ɖoe nɛ.

english_verse: Would you do me a favor?” “What do you want?” Bathsheba asked.
translation_verse: Azɔ mabia nu ɖeka tso asiwò, eye megatem o. Eɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Ƒo nu!

english_verse: “Please ask Solomon to let me marry Abishag. He won't say no to you.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Taflatse, ƒo nu kple fia Salomo, elabena magbe wò gbe o, ne wòatsɔ Sunami-nyɔnu Abisag nam maɖe.

english_verse: “All right,” she said. “I'll ask him.”
translation_verse: Bat-Seba ɖo ŋu be: Enyo, maɖaƒo nu kple fia la ɖe tawo.

english_verse: When Bathsheba went to see Solomon, he stood up to meet her, then bowed low. He sat back down and had another throne brought in, so his mother could sit at his right side.
translation_verse: Eye Bat-Seba va fia Salomo gbɔ, be yeaƒo nu kplii le Adoniya ta; tete fia la tsi tre yi ɖakpee, eye wòbɔbɔ ɖe eŋku me; ebɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui la dzi, eye wòna nunɔdzi fia la dada wòbɔbɔ nɔ eƒe nuɖusi me.

english_verse: Bathsheba sat down and then asked, “Would you do me a small favor?” Solomon replied, “Mother, just tell me what you want, and I will do it.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Mabia nu via ɖe tso asiwò, eye megatem o. Fia la ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Danye bia, elabena nyemele tewò ge o.

english_verse: “Allow your brother Adonijah to marry Abishag,” she answered.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Woatsɔ Abisag, Sunami-nyɔnu, na nɔviwò Adoniya, ne wòaɖe.

english_verse: Solomon said: What? Let my older brother marry Abishag? You may as well ask me to let him rule the kingdom! And why don't you ask such favors for Abiathar and Joab?
translation_verse: Tete fia Salomo ɖo ŋu gblɔ na dadaa bena: Nukaŋuti nele Abisag, Sunami-nyɔnu la, ko biam na Adoniya? Bia fiaɖuƒe la hã na eya kple nunɔla Abyatar kpakple Yoab, Zeruya vi la, elabena tonye wonye.

english_verse: I swear in the name of the Lord that Adonijah will die because he asked for this! If he doesn't, I pray that God will severely punish me.
translation_verse: Eye fia Salomo ta Yehowa bena: Mawu nafiam agadiam ɖe dzi, ne menye Adoniya ɖe wògblɔ nya sia ɖe eƒe agbe ŋuti o ti!

english_verse: The Lord made me king in my father's place and promised that the kings of Israel would come from my family. Yes, I swear by the living Lord that Adonijah will die today.
translation_verse: Eyata meta Yehowa ƒe agbe, amesi li kem, eye wona mebɔbɔ no fofonye Dawid ƒo fiazikpui dzi, eye wòtso aƒe nam, abe alesi wògblɔ ene la be: Adoniya aku egbea!

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “go kill Adonijah.” So Adonijah died. Abiathar Is Sent Back Home
translation_verse: Eye fia Salomo dɔ Benaya, Yehoyada vi ɖa woɖada nui ƒu anyi woku.

english_verse: Solomon sent for Abiathar the priest and said: Abiathar, go back home to Anathoth! You ought to be killed too, but I won't do it now. When my father David was king, you were in charge of the sacred chest, and you went through a lot of hard times with my father.
translation_verse: Eye ha la gblɔ na nunɔla Abyatar bena: Yi wò agble le Anatot, elabena edze ku Ke nyemele wuwo ge egbe sia o, elabena wòe tso Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe aɖaka la nɔ fofonye Dawid ŋgɔ, eye nèkpe tu dzẽa fu yia, si fofonye kpe.

english_verse: But I won't let you be a priest of the Lord anymore. And so the promise that the Lord had made at Shiloh about the family of Eli came true. Joab Is Killed
translation_verse: Ale Salomo nyã Abyatar, be maganye Yehowa ƒe nunɔla azɔ o, ne Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ ɖe Eli ƒe aƒe ŋu le Silo la, nava me.

english_verse: Joab had not helped Absalom try to become king, but he had helped Adonijah. So when Joab learned that Adonijah had been killed, he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Eye nya la ɖi Yoab se, elabena Yoab ku ɖe Adoniya ŋu, ke meku ɖe Absalom ŋu o; tete Yoab si yi Yehowa ƒe agbadɔ la me ɖalé vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo.

english_verse: When Solomon heard about this, he sent someone to ask Joab, “Why did you run to the altar?” Joab sent back his answer, “I was afraid of you, and I ran to the Lord for protection.” Then Solomon shouted, “Benaiah, go kill Joab!”
translation_verse: Eye wova gblɔ na Ha Salomo bena, Yoab si yi Yehowa ƒe agbadɔ la me, eye kpɔ ɖa, ele vɔsamlekpui la xa. Tete Salomo do Benaya, Yehoyada vi la ɖa bena: Yi ɖada nui ƒu anyi!

english_verse: Benaiah went to the sacred tent and yelled, “Joab, the king orders you to come out!” “No!” Joab answered. “Kill me right here.” Benaiah went back and told Solomon what Joab had said.
translation_verse: Eye Benaya yi Yehowa ƒe agbadɔ la me hegblɔ nɛ bena: Ale fia la gblɔ esi: Do go! Eɖo ŋu bena: Gbeɖe, ke boŋ afisia maku ɖo. Tete Benaya he gbe la vɛ na fia la gblɔ bena: Ale Yoab gblɔ, eye ale wòɖo ŋu nam enye si.

english_verse: Solomon replied: Do what Joab said. Kill him and bury him! Then my family and I won't be responsible for what he did to Abner the commander of Israel's army and to Amasa the commander of Judah's army. He killed those innocent men without my father knowing about it. Both of them were better men than Joab. Now the Lord will make him pay for those murders.
translation_verse: Yehowa agbugbɔ eƒe nu ava eƒe ta dzi, elabena eda nu ŋutsu eve, siwo nye ame dzɔdzɔewo, eye wonyo wui, amesiwo nye Israel ƒe aʋafia Abner, Ner vi, kple Yuda ƒe aʋafia Amasa, Yeter vi, eye wowu wo kple yi fofonye Dawid ƒe manyamanyae.

english_verse: Benaiah went back and killed Joab. His body was taken away and buried near his home in the desert.
translation_verse: Tete Benaya, Yehoyada vi la, yi ɖada nui ƒu anyi hewui, eye wòɖu ɖe eƒe xɔ me le gbedzi.

english_verse: Solomon put Benaiah in Joab's place as army commander, and he put Zadok in Abiathar's place as priest. Shimei Is Killed
translation_verse: Eye fia la tso Benaya, Yehoyada vi, ɖo aʋakɔ la nu ɖe eteƒe; eye fia la tsɔ nunɔla Zadok ɖo Abyatar teƒe.

english_verse: Solomon sent for Shimei and said, “Build a house here in Jerusalem and live in it. But whatever you do, don't leave the city!
translation_verse: Eye fia la do ame ɖo da, be woayɔ Simei vɛ, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Tu xɔ na ɖokuiwò ɖe Yerusalem nanɔ afima, ke megado tso afima yi afi alo afime o.

english_verse: If you ever cross Kidron Valley and leave Jerusalem, you will be killed. And it will be your own fault.”
translation_verse: Gbesigbe nado atso Kidron-toʋua la nyae be, àku; wò ʋu ava wò ta dzi

english_verse: “That's fair, Your Majesty,” Shimei answered. “I'll do that.” So Shimei lived in Jerusalem from then on.
translation_verse: Simei ɖo ŋu na fia la bena: Enyo, alesi nye aƒetɔ fia la gblɔ la, nenema eƒe ɖɔla awɔ. Eye Simei nɔ Yerusalem eteƒe didi

english_verse: About three years later, two of Shimei's servants ran off to King Achish in Gath. When Shimei found out where they were,
translation_verse: Ke eva me le ƒe elɔ̃ megbe bena, dɔlaŋutsu eve si le Simei gbɔ yi Gat-fia Axis, Maaxa vi gbɔ. Eye wova gblɔ na Simei bena: Kpɔ ɖa, wò dɔlawo le Gat.

english_verse: Someone told Solomon that Shimei had gone to Gath and was back.
translation_verse: Eye wova gblɔ na Salomo bena: Simei dzo tso Yerusalem yi Gat, eye wògatrɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: Solomon sent for him and said: Shimei, you promised in the name of the Lord that you would never leave Jerusalem. I warned you that you would die if you did. You agreed that this was fair, didn't you?
translation_verse: Tete fia la dɔ woɖayɔ Simei ve, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Ɖe nyemena wota Yehowa na wò, eye mexlɔ̃ nu wò gblɔ bena, gbesigbe nado ayi afi alo afime la, nyae be, àku, eye nèɖo ŋu nam be, enyo yesee oa?

english_verse: You have disobeyed me and have broken the promise you made to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti mèwɔ Yehowa ƒe atam kple se, si mede na wò la dzi oa?

english_verse: I know you remember all the cruel things you did to my father David. Now the Lord is going to punish you for what you did.
translation_verse: Eye fia la gblɔ na Simei be: Wò ŋutɔ ènya vɔ, siwo katã nèwɔ ɖe fofonye Dawid ŋu, eye wò dzi nyae. Yehowa agbugbɔ wò vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi la ava wò ta dzi.

english_verse: But the Lord will bless me and make my father's kingdom strong forever.
translation_verse: Ke woayra Salomo va, eye Dawid ƒe fiazikpui la ali ke le Yehowa ŋku me tegbee.

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “kill Shimei.” So Shimei died. Solomon was now in complete control of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Tete fia la de se na Benaya, Yehoyada vi la, wòɖada nui ƒu anyi woku.

english_verse: At that time, there was no temple for worshiping the Lord, and everyone offered sacrifices at the local shrines.
translation_verse: Ke dukɔ la gasa vɔ le nuxeƒewo, elabena wometu xɔa ɖeke na Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ vaseɖe ɣemaɣi o.

english_verse: I'll also give you what you didn't ask for. You'll be rich and respected as long as you live, and you'll be greater than any other king.
translation_verse: Eye nusi mèbia o hã la, metsɔe na wò, kesinɔnu kple bubu siaa, ale be tɔwò tɔgbea ɖeke manɔ fiawo dome le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me o.

english_verse: Solomon loved the Lord and followed his father David's instructions, but Solomon also offered sacrifices and burned incense at the shrines.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo lɔ Yehowa hezɔ le fofoa Dawid ƒe ɖoɖowo nu; ke esa vɔ, eye wòdo dzudzɔ le nuxeƒewo.

english_verse: One night while Solomon was in Gibeon, the Lord God appeared to him in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ɖe eɖokui fia Salomo le drɔ̃eƒe le zã me le Gibeon, eye Mawu gblɔ nɛ bena: Bia nusi mana wò.

english_verse: Solomon answered: My father David, your servant, was honest and did what you commanded. You were always loyal to him, and you gave him a son who is now king.
translation_verse: Salomo ɖo ŋu bena: Eve wò dɔla, fofonye Dawid nu ŋutɔ, elabena ezɔ le ŋkuwò me le nyateƒe kple dzɔdzɔenyenye kpakple dzi dzadzɛ me, eye nèdzra amenuveve gã sia ɖo nɛ, be nèna viŋutsu, amesi le eƒe fiazikpui la dzi, abe alesi wòle egbe siawo ene.

english_verse: Lord God, I'm your servant, and you've made me king in my father's place. But I'm very young and know so little about being a leader.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yehowa, nye Mawu, etsɔ wò dɔla ɖo fiae ɖe fofonye Dawid teƒe, ke ɖevi sue menye, eye nyemenya alesi madoe alo gbɔe o!

english_verse: And now I must rule your chosen people, even though there are too many of them to count.
translation_verse: Eye wò dɔla le dukɔ, si nètia la dome, dukɔ, si keke ta, eye wòsɔ gbɔ, ale be womate ŋu abui alo axlẽe o.

english_verse: Please make me wise and teach me the difference between right and wrong. Then I will know how to rule your people. If you don't, there is no way I could rule this great nation of yours.
translation_verse: Eyata na dzi nyanu wò dɔla, ne wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo dukɔ, eye wòaɖe vovo nyui kple vɔ̃ dome, elabena ameka ale ŋu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò dukɔ gã sia?

english_verse: God said: Solomon, I'm pleased that you asked for this. You could have asked to live a long time or to be rich. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom to make right decisions.
translation_verse: Eye Mawu gblɔ nɛ bena: Esi nèbia nusia, eye mebia be, nanɔ agbe didie o, mebia kesinɔnu o, eye mèbia wò futɔwo ƒe ku o, ke boŋ nèbia nunya, be naŋɔ ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me la,

english_verse: If you obey me and follow my commands, as your father David did, I'll let you live a long time.
translation_verse: Ne èzɔ nye mowo dzi helé nye ɖoɖowo kple sewo me ɖe asi, abe alesi fofowò Dawid zɔe ene la, ekema mana wò agbeŋkekewo nadidi.

english_verse: Solomon woke up and realized that God had spoken to him in the dream. He went back to Jerusalem and stood in front of the sacred chest, where he offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. Then Solomon gave a feast for his officials. Solomon Makes a Difficult Decision
translation_verse: Ke esi Salomo nyo la, ekpa bena, drɔ̃e wònye. Tete wòyi Yerusalem ɖatsi tre ɖe Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ, eye wòsa numevɔ kple akpedavɔ, eye wòɖo kplɔ̃ na eƒe dɔlawo katã. Salomo ƒe afiatsotso.

english_verse: One day two women came to King Solomon,
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la gbolo eve wova fia la gbɔ, eye wotsi tre ɖe eŋku me.

english_verse: and one of them said: Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. Not long ago my baby was born at home,
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu ɖeka gblɔ bena: Taflatse aƒetɔ, mia kple nyɔnu sia miele xɔ ɖeka me, eye medzi vi ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la, medzi vi le egbɔ le xɔa me.

english_verse: and three days later her baby was born. Nobody else was there with us.
translation_verse: Esi nyɔnu sia hã dzi vi, eye miele mía nɔewo gbɔ; amedzroa ɖeke mele mía gbɔ le xɔa me o, negbe mí ame evea koe le xɔa me.

english_verse: One night while we were all asleep, she rolled over on her baby, and he died.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu sia ƒe vi ku le zã me, elabena emlɔ edzi.

english_verse: Then while I was still asleep, she got up and took my son out of my bed. She put him in her bed, then she put her dead baby next to me.
translation_verse: Tete wòfɔ le zã titina kɔ vinye le axanye, esime wò dɔlanyɔnu le alɔ dɔm, eye wòtsɔe mlɔ eƒe akɔnu hetsɔ kukua mlɔ nye akɔnu.

english_verse: In the morning when I got up to feed my son, I saw that he was dead. But when I looked at him in the light, I knew he wasn't my son.
translation_verse: Esi metɔ ŋdi, be mana no vinye la, kpɔ ɖa, eku; ke esi meɖe ŋku ɖee le ŋdi la, kpɔ ɖa, menye vinye, si medzi lae o.

english_verse: “No!” the other woman shouted. “He was your son. My baby is alive!” “The dead baby is yours,” the first woman yelled. “Mine is alive!” They argued back and forth in front of Solomon,
translation_verse: Nyɔnu evelia ɖo ŋu be: Kpao, vinyee nye agbagbea, eye viwoe nye kukua! Nyɔnu gbãtɔ gblɔ be: Kpao, viwoe nye kukua, eye vinyee nye agbagbea! Alea woƒo nui le fia la ŋku me.

english_verse: Someone bring me a sword.” A sword was brought, and Solomon ordered,
translation_verse: Eye fia la gblɔ be, mitsɔ yi vɛ nam! Tete wotsɔ yi va fia la ŋku me.

english_verse: “Cut the baby in half! That way each of you can have part of him.”
translation_verse: Eye fia la gblɔ be: Mife ɖevi gbagbe la me ɖe eve, eye mitsɔ akpa afã na ame ɖeka, eye mitsɔ akpa afã na ame evelia.

english_verse: “Please don't kill my son,” the baby's mother screamed. “Your Majesty, I love him very much, but give him to her. Just don't kill him.” The other woman shouted, “Go ahead and cut him in half. Then neither of us will have the baby.”
translation_verse: Tete nyɔnu, si ƒe vi nye agbagbea, gblɔ na fia la bena: Taflatse aƒetɔ, mitsɔ ɖevi gbagbe la nɛ, eye migaxawui o! Elabena eƒe dɔ me trɔ ɖe via ŋu. Ke ekemea gblɔ bena: Menye tɔnye o, eye maganye eya hã tɔ o, mife eme ko!

english_verse: Solomon said, “Don't kill the baby.” Then he pointed to the first woman, “She is his real mother. Give the baby to her.”
translation_verse: Tete fia la xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Mitsɔ ɖevi gbagbe la nɛ, eye migaxawui o, eyae nye dada.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel was amazed when they heard how Solomon had made his decision. They realized that God had given him wisdom to judge fairly.
translation_verse: Esi Israel blibo la se ʋɔnu, si fia la drɔ̃ la, wode asi fia la vɔvɔ̃ me; elabena wokpɔ be, Mawu ƒe nunya le eme hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: Solomon chose twelve regional officers, who took turns bringing food for him and his household. Each officer provided food from his region for one month of the year.
translation_verse: Eye dzikpɔla wuieve le Salomo si ɖe Israel blibo la nu, amesiwo kpɔa fia kple eƒe aƒe la dzi le nuɖuɖu gome, ɖesiaɖe kpɔa wo dzi dzinu ɖeka le ƒe ɖeka me.

english_verse: The son of Deker was in charge of the towns of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.
translation_verse: Ben-Deker le Makaz, Saalbim, Bet-Semes, Elon kple Bet-Xanan nu;

english_verse: The son of Abinadab was in charge of Naphath-Dor and was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath.
translation_verse: Ben-Abinadab tɔ enye Xor-nyigba blibo la; eya ɖe Salomo ƒe vinyɔnu Tatat;

english_verse: The son of Geber was in charge of the town of Ramoth in Gilead and the villages in Gilead belonging to the family of Jair, a descendant of Manasseh. He was also in charge of the region of Argob in Bashan, which had
translation_verse: Ben-Geber le Ramot-Gilead nu, etɔ enye Manase vi Yair ƒe kɔƒewo, siwo le Gilead, etɔ enye Argob-nutowo me le Basan, ɖu gã blaade, siwo ŋu gli le, eye akɔbligameti le wo ŋu,

english_verse: Ahinadab son of Iddo was in charge of the territory of Mahanaim.

translation_verse: Yehowa wo eƒe nya, si wògblɔ la dzi, eye medo xɔ fofonye Dawid teƒe hebɔbɔ nɔ Israel-fiazikpui la dzi, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ ene, eye metu xɔ na Yehowa, Israel Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple,
translation_verse: elabena woase wò ŋkɔ gã kple wò asi sesẽ kpakple wò alo, si nado ɖe dzi la ŋkɔ — eye wòva do gbe ɖa le aƒe sia me la,

english_verse: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, mawua ɖeke mele abe wò ene le dziƒo afime kple anyigba dzi afi o; èdzra nubabla kple amenuveve ɖo na wò dɔla, siwo zɔna le ŋkuwò me kple woƒe dzi blibo.

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Wò amesi dzra nya, si nègblɔ na wò dɔla fofonye Dawid la do; ègblɔe kple wò nu, eye nètsɔ wò asi wo edzi, abe alesi wòle egbe siawo ene.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you promised my father that someone from his family would always be king of Israel, if they do their best to obey you, just as he did.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, dzra nya, si nègblɔ na fofonye Dawid la ɖo, esi negblɔ bena: Ne viwòŋutsuwo nya lé ŋku ɖe woƒe mɔwo ŋu, eye wozɔ le ŋkunye me, abe alesi nèzɔ le ŋkunye me ene ko la, ekema wò amesiwo anɔ Israel-fiazikpuia dzi la nu matso o.

english_verse: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.
translation_verse: Eyata, Israel ƒe Mawu, taflatse wo nya, si negblɔ na wò dɔla fofonye Dawid la dzi.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: Ke nyateƒee, Mawu anɔ anyigba dzia? Kpɔ ɖa, dziƒo kple dziƒo ƒe dziƒowo melolo na wò o, ʋuu keke xɔ sia, si metu o.

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: Ne wò ŋkuwo nanɔ te ɖe xɔ sia ŋu zã kple keli, ɖe teƒe, si ŋu nègblɔ le be: nye ŋkɔ anɔ afima la ŋu; eye nase gbe, si wò dɔla ado ɖa le teƒe sia.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.
translation_verse: Eye ɖo to koko, si wò dɔla kple wò dukɔ Israel aƒo le teƒe sia, eye nasee le nɔwòƒe le dziƒo; ne èsee la, ekema tsoe ke.

english_verse: Suppose someone accuses a person of a crime, and the accused has to stand in front of the altar in your temple and say, “I swear I am innocent!”
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ehavi ŋu, eye wobia atam tso esi, be wòaka, eye wohe atam la va wò vɔsamlekpui ŋgɔ le aƒewò me la,

english_verse: Listen from heaven and decide who is right. Then punish the guilty person and let the innocent one go free.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le dziƒo, eye nadrɔ̃e na wò dɔlawo ahabu fɔ vodala, eye nana eƒe nuwɔwɔ nava eƒe la dzi, ke natso afia na nya dzɔdzɔe tɔ, eye nawɔ ne le eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye nu.

english_verse: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness,
translation_verse: Ne wò dukɔ Israel ƒe futɔwo si wo, le esi wowɔ nuvɔ̃ de ŋuwò ta, eye wotrɔ ɖe ŋuwò heʋu wò ŋkɔ me, wodo gbe ɖa heƒo koko na wò le aƒe sia me la,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le dziƒo, eye natsɔ wò dukɔ Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake wo, eye nagakplɔ wo ava anyigba, si nètsɔ na wo fofowo la dzi.

english_verse: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they turn toward this temple and pray in your name and stop sinning,
translation_verse: Ne dziƒo nu xe, eye tsi megale dzadzam o, le esi wowɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò ta, eye wodo gbe ɖa le teƒe sia heʋu wò ŋkɔ me, eye woɖe asi le woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋu, le esi nèbɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi ta la,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And please send rain on the land you gave them to be theirs forever.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le dziƒo, eye natsɔ wò dɔlawo kple wò dukɔ Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake wo, elabena èfia mɔ nyui, si dzi woazɔ la wo, eye nana tsi nadza ɖe wò anyigba, si netsɔ na wò dukɔ abe domenyinu ene la dzi.

english_verse: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ne dɔwuame va anyigba dzi, eɖanye dɔvɔ̃ alo bliwo dze heteku o, nukuwo hlɔ̃ alo ʋetsuviwo kple ŋɔwo va o, woƒe futɔwo xaxa wo ɖo ɖe woƒe duwo me le anyigba dzi, fuɖenamea ɖe alo dɔlélea ɖe o;

english_verse: Listen when anyone in Israel truly feels sorry and sincerely prays with arms lifted toward your temple.
translation_verse: eye amea ɖe alo wò dukɔ Israel blibo la dze si fuɖename, si le eƒe dzi me, eye wòdo gbe ɖa heƒo koko, eye wòke eƒe abɔwo me do ɖe xɔ sia dzi la,

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to the way they live and what is in their hearts.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le nɔwòƒe le dziƒo, eye natsɔe ake, wɔ edzi, eye nawɔ na amesiame le eƒe zɔzɔwo katã nu, abe alesi nènya eƒe dzi mee ene, elabena wò ɖeka koe nya amegbetɔviwo katã ƒe dzi me;

english_verse: Then your people will worship and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: ne woavɔ̃ wò ŋkeke, siwo katã wole agbe le anyigba, si nètsɔ na mia fofowo la dzi.

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and answer their prayers. Then everyone on earth will worship you, just like your people Israel, and they will know that I have built this temple to honor you.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le nɔwòƒe le dziƒo, eye nawɔ nusiwo katã ŋuti du bubu me to la le yɔwòm ɖo; ne anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã nadze si wò ŋkɔ, eye woavɔ̃ wò abe wò dukɔ Israel ene, eye wòadze sii bena, wò ŋkɔ woyɔ ɖe xɔ sia, si metu na wò la ŋu.

english_verse: Our Lord, sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: Ne wò dukɔ ho aʋa ɖe woƒe futɔwo ŋu le mɔ, si dzi nèdɔ wo ɖo, eye woaɖo gbe ɖa na Yehowa aɖo ɖe du, si nètia kple xɔ, si metu na wò ŋkɔ dzi la,

english_verse: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.
translation_verse: ekema nase woƒe gbedodoɖa kple woƒe kokoƒoƒo la le dziƒo, eye natso na wo.

english_verse: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.
translation_verse: Ne wowɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò, — elabena amegbetɔa ɖeke megbea nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ o — eye nèɖo dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu hetsɔ wo de asi na woƒe futɔwo, eye woɖe aboyo wo yi woƒe futɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi, eɖanye didiƒe alo kpuiƒe o,

english_verse: Forgive your people no matter how much they have sinned against you. Make the enemies who defeated them be kind to them.
translation_verse: Eye tsɔ nuvɔ̃, si wò dukɔ la wɔ ɖe ŋuwò kple vo, siwo katã woda ɖe ŋuwò la ke wo, eye na amesiwo ɖe aboyo wo, nakpɔ woƒe nublanui, eye woa ve wo nu;

english_verse: Remember, they are the people you chose and rescued from Egypt that was like a blazing fire to them.
translation_verse: elabena wò dukɔ kple wò domenyinu wonye, amesiwo nèkplɔ tso gakpo me le Egipte;

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So listen when any of us pray and cry out for your help.
translation_verse: ne wò ŋku nanɔ te ɖe wò dɔla ƒe kokoƒoƒo kple wò dukɔ Israel ƒe kokoƒoƒo ŋu, eye naɖo to wo le nusianu, si ŋuti wole yɔwòm ɖo la me.

english_verse: When you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, you told your servant Moses to say to them, “From all people on earth, the Lord God has chosen you to be his very own.” Solomon Blesses the People
translation_verse: Elabena wò ŋutɔe ɖe wo tso anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã dome, bena woanye wò domenyinu, abe alesi negblɔ to wò dɔla Mose dzi, esime nèkplɔ mía fofowo tso Egipte ene, Aƒetɔ Yehowa!

english_verse: When Solomon finished his prayer at the altar, he was kneeling with his arms lifted toward heaven. He stood up,
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime Salomo wu gbedodoɖa kple kokoƒoƒo siawo katã nu na Yehowa vɔ la, etsi tre tso Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ, afisi wòdze klo ɖo ɖeke eƒe abɔwo do ɖe dziƒo la.

english_verse: turned toward the people, blessed them, and said loudly:
translation_verse: Eye wote yi ŋgɔ heyra Israel ƒe ameha blibo la kple gbe sesĩ gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He has kept his promise and given us peace. Every good thing he promised to his servant Moses has happened.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, amesi na gbɔɖeme eƒe dukɔ Israel pɛpɛpɛ, abe alesi wògblɔ ene; naneke meto le nya nyui, siwo katã wògblɔ to eƒe dɔla Mose dzi la me o.

english_verse: The Lord our God was with our ancestors to help them, and I pray that he will be with us and never abandon us.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía Mawu, nenɔ kpli mí, abe alesi wònɔ kple mia fofowo ene, megagblẽ mí ɖi o, eye megagbe mí o;

english_verse: May the Lord help us obey him and follow all the laws and teachings he gave our ancestors.
translation_verse: ne wòatrɔ míaƒe dziwo ɖe eɖokui ŋu, be miazɔ eƒe mɔwo katã dzi, eye míalé eƒe sewo, dodowo kple kɔnuwo, siwo wògblɔ na mía fofowo la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord our God will remember my prayer day and night. May he help everyone in Israel each day, in whatever way we need it.
translation_verse: Eye nye nya, siwo metsɔ ƒo koko le Yehowa ŋku me la, nanɔ Yehowa, mía Mawu la ŋku me keli kple zã, ne wòatso na eƒe dɔla kple eƒe dukɔ Israel ɣeawokatãɣi, abe alesi wòhiã ene;

english_verse: Then every nation will know that the Lord is the only true God.
translation_verse: bene anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã nadze sii bena, Yehowae nye Mawu, bubua ɖeke megali o.

english_verse: Obey the Lord our God and follow his commands with all your heart, just as you are doing today. Solomon Dedicates the Temple (
translation_verse: Miaƒe dzi naku ɖe Yehowa, mía Mawu la ŋu blibo, eye miazɔ le eƒe ɖoɖowo nu ahalé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi, abe alesi wòle egbea ene.

english_verse: On that day, Solomon dedicated the courtyard in front of the temple and made it acceptable for worship. He offered the sacrifices there because the bronze altar in front of the temple was too small.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe Salomo kɔ xɔxɔnu emetɔ, si le Yehowa ƒe xɔ la ŋgɔ la ŋu, elabena esa numevɔ kple nuɖuvɔ, eye wotso akpedavɔsalã ƒe amiwo sa vɔe le afima, le esi akɔblivɔsamlekpui, si le Yehowa ŋku me la, le sue akpa, eye mede numevɔsa, nuɖuvɔsa kple akpedavɔsa ƒe amiwo nu o ta.

english_verse: Solomon and the huge crowd celebrated the Festival of Shelters at the temple for seven days. There were people from as far away as the Egyptian Gorge in the south and Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo kple Israel blibo, si le eŋu la, ɖu ŋkekenyuie la ɣemaɣi; ameha gãa ɖe tso Xamat-nutowo me, vaseɖe Egipte-tɔʋu la gbɔ, va Yehowa, mía Mawu la ŋku me, ŋkeke adre kple ŋkeke adre, ele ŋkeke wuiene.

english_verse: Then on the eighth day, he sent everyone home. They said goodbye and left, very happy, because of all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyiagbe la edo mɔ dukɔ la, woyra fia la, eye woyi woƒe agbadɔwo me kple dzidzɔ, eye woƒe dzi dze eme le nu nyui, siwo katã Yehowa wo na eƒe dɔla Dawid kple eƒe dukɔ Israel la ŋuti.

english_verse: I will no longer let my people Israel live in this land I gave them. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped. Then people everywhere will think this nation is only a joke and will make fun of it.
translation_verse: ekema matsrɔ̃ Israel ɖa le anyigba, si mena wo la dzi, eye mate xɔ sia, si ŋu mekɔ hena nye ŋkɔ la ɖa le ŋkunye me, eye Israel azu hamelo kple alɔmeɖenu le dukɔwo katã dome.

english_verse: Solomon did not force the Israelites to do his work. They were his soldiers, officials, leaders, commanders, chariot captains, and chariot drivers. But he did make slaves of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were living in Israel. These were the descendants of those foreigners the Israelites could not destroy, and they remained Israel's slaves.
translation_verse: Ke Salomo metsɔ amea ɖeke wɔ kluvi le Israel-viwo dome o, ke boŋ woawo nye aʋawɔlawo, eƒe dɔlawo, eƒe amegãwo kple tatɔwo kple aʋafiawo le eƒe tasiaɖamwo kple sɔdolawo nu.

english_verse: The Lord said: I heard your prayer and what you asked me to do. This temple you have built is where I will be worshiped forever. It belongs to me, and I will never stop watching over it.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nɛ bena: Mese wò gbedodoɖa kple wò koko, si neƒo le ŋkunye me la; meka xɔ sia, si nètu, be matsɔ nye ŋkɔ aɖo afima tegbee la ŋu, eye nye ŋku kple nye dzi anɔ afima ŋkekeawo katã.

english_verse: and I will keep my promise to David that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: ekema mana wò fiaɖuƒe ƒe fiazikpui nali ke ɖe Israel dzi tegbee, abe alesi megblɔ na fofowò Dawid ene bena: Wò amesiwo anɔ Israel-fiazikpuia dzi la, nu matso akpɔ o.

english_verse: Then they will answer, “We know why the Lord did this. The people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.” Other Things Solomon Did (
translation_verse: Eye woaɖo eŋu bena: Esi wogblẽ Yehowa, woƒe Mawu, si kplɔ wo fofowo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ɖi, eye woku ɖe mawu bubuwo ŋu, ɖe ta agu na wo hesubɔ wo la, eyata Yehowa he dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo katã va wo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: Baalath, and Tamar in the desert of Judah.
translation_verse: Baalat kple Tadmor, si le gbedzi le anyigba la dzi,

english_verse: When Hiram went to see the towns, he did not like them.
translation_verse: Eye Xiram tso Tiro be, yeaɖakpɔ du, siwo Salomo tsa nɛ la ɖa, ke womadze eŋu o.

english_verse: He said, “Solomon, my friend, are these the kind of towns you want to give me?” So Hiram called the region Cabul because he thought it was worthless.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Nɔvinye, du ka ƒomeviwo nye esi nènam? Eye wòna ŋkɔ wo be Kabul-nyigba vaseɖe egbe.

english_verse: After Solomon's workers had finished the temple and the palace, he ordered them to fill in the land on the east side of Jerusalem, to build a wall around the city, and to rebuild the towns of Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
translation_verse: Ale yakadɔwɔla, si wo fia Salomo ɖe, be woatu Yehowa ƒe xɔ, eya ŋutɔ ƒe xɔ kple Milo, eye woaɖo gli ɖe Yerusalem, Xazor, Megido kple Gezer ŋu la, ƒe nya la enye si:

english_verse: Earlier, the king of Egypt had captured the town of Gezer; he burned it to the ground and killed the Canaanite people living there. Then he gave it to his daughter as a wedding present when she married Solomon.
translation_verse: Egipte-fia Farao ho va xɔ Gezer, eye wòtɔ dzoe hewu Kanaanitɔ, siwo le eme, eye wòtsɔe wɔ atsuƒeyinu na vianyɔnu, si nye Salomo srɔ̃.

english_verse: So Solomon had the town rebuilt. Solomon ordered his workers to rebuild Lower Beth-Horon,
translation_verse: Eye Salomo tso Gezer kple anyigbe Bet-Xoron,

english_verse: They also built towns where he could keep his supplies and his chariots and horses. Solomon ordered them to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere in his kingdom.
translation_verse: kple nudzraɖoƒexɔwo ƒe du, siwo katã le Salomo si, tasiaɖamwo ƒe du kple sɔdolawo ƒe du hekpe ɖe xɔ, siwo Salomo ɖi be, yeatu ɖe Yerusalem kple Libanon kpakple eƒe dziɖuƒe ƒe anyigba blibo la dzi la ŋuti.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the older part of Jerusalem to her new palace. Then Solomon had the land on the east side of Jerusalem filled in.
translation_verse: Ke esi Farao vinyɔnu ʋu tso Dawid ƒe du la me yi eƒe xɔ, si wòtu nu me la, Salomo tu Milo.

english_verse: Three times a year, Solomon burned incense and offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built. Solomon had now finished building the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo sa numevɔ kple akpedavɔ le vɔsamlekpui, si wòɖi na Yehowa la dzi zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me, eye wòdo dzudzɔ le edzi le Yehowa ŋku me. Ale wowu xɔ la nu.

english_verse: He also had a lot of ships at Ezion-Geber, a town in Edom near Eloth on the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Fia Salomo kpa ʋuwo hã ɖe Ezeon-Geber, si le Elon gbɔ le Avaƒu la nu le Edom-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: King Hiram let some of his experienced sailors go to the country of Ophir with Solomon's own sailors, and they brought back about
translation_verse: Eye wova Ofir hetsɔ, sika talento alafa ene kple blave tso afima gbɔe vɛ na fia Salomo.

english_verse: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.
translation_verse: Eve Salomo ɖo eƒe biabiawo katã ŋu ne, biabiaa ɖeke meli, si Salomo do kpo eŋu ɖoɖo nɛ o.

english_verse: The Queen was amazed at Solomon's wisdom. She was breathless when she saw his palace, the food on his table, his officials, his servants in their uniforms, the people who served his food, and the sacrifices he offered at the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: nuɖuɖu, si le eƒe kplɔ dzi, eƒe dɔlawo ƒe nɔƒewo, eŋu mewo ƒe subɔsubɔ kple woƒe awuwo kple eƒe ahakulawo kpakple numevɔ, si wosana le Yehowa ƒe me la, gbɔgblɔ bu ɖee.

english_verse: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na fia la bena: Nyateƒee nye nya, si mese le nye anyigba dzi le wò nuwɔna kple wò nunya ŋuti.

english_verse: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are wiser and richer than I was told.
translation_verse: Nyemexɔ nyawo dzi se o, vaseɖe esime nye ŋutɔ meva, eye mekpɔe kple ŋku, kpɔ ɖa, womegblɔ woƒe afã gɔ̃ hã nam o; eƒo nya, si wogblɔ le wò nunya kple wò kesinɔnu ŋuti mese la ta.

english_verse: Your wives and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.
translation_verse: Woayra wò amewo, woayra wò dɔla, siwo le tsitre ɖe ŋkuwò me ɖaa, eye wosea wò nunya.

english_verse: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, many jewels, and more spices than anyone had ever brought into Israel.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ sika talento alafa ɖeka kple blave kple atike ʋeʋẽe geɖe ŋutɔ kpakple kpe xɔasiwo na fia la; womegatsɔ atike ʋeʋẽe vɛ wòsɔ gbɔ de esi Saba-fianyɔnu la na fia Salomo la nu kpɔ o.

english_verse: He was the richest and wisest king in the world.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo ɖo kpo ɖe anyigba dzi fiawo katã dzi le kesinɔnu kple nunya gome.

english_verse: The merchants and traders, as well as the kings of Arabia and rulers from Israel, also gave him gold.
translation_verse: ke womebu esiwo woxɔ le nudzralawo, asitsalawo kple Arabia-fiawo katã kpakple anyigbadzikpɔlawo si la, ɖe eme o.

english_verse: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.
translation_verse: Fia la tsɔ nyiɖu wɔ fiazikpui gãa ɖe hã, eye wòfa sika nyuitɔ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Since silver was almost worthless in those days, everything was made of gold, even the cups and dishes used in Forest Hall.
translation_verse: Fia Salomo ƒe nunonuwo katã nye sika, eye sika nyuitɔ wotsɔ wɔ Libanon-avexɔ ƒe nuwo katãe, klosaloa ɖeke mele eme o, elabena le Salomo ŋɔli la womebu eya ɖe nemi me hã o.

english_verse: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.
translation_verse: Elabena ʋu, siwo dea Tarsis, le fia la si hekpe ɖe Xiram ƒe ʋuwo ŋu; ʋuawo gbɔna tso Tarsis ƒe etɔ̃ zi ɖeka, eye wohea sika kple klosalo, nyiɖu, kese kple atsaxewo vanɛ.

english_verse: People from every nation wanted to hear the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Eye xexeame katã ɖi Salomo ƒe ŋku me, be yeakpɔ, eye yease eƒe nunya, si Mawu de dzi me nɛ la.

english_verse: Year after year people came and brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, or mules.
translation_verse: Wo dome amesiame hea nunanawo vɛ ƒeawo tsyo ƒe, siwo nye klosalonuwo, sikanuwo, awuwo, aʋawɔnuwo, atike ʋeʋẽe, sɔwo kple tedzisɔwo.

english_verse: While he was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: Eye fia la na klosalo sɔ gbɔ abe kpewo ene le Yerusalem, eye sedertiwo sɔ gbɔ abe gboti, siwo le bali me la ene.

english_verse: Solomon also worshiped Astarte the goddess of Sidon, and Milcom the disgusting god of Ammon.
translation_verse: Salomo dze Zidontɔwo ƒe mawu Astarte kple Milkom, si nye Amonitɔwo ƒe ŋunyɔnu la yome.

english_verse: Solomon's father had obeyed the Lord with all his heart, but Solomon disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Salomo wɔ nusi nye vɔ̃ le Yehowa ŋku me, eye medze Yehowa yome blibo abe fofoa Dawid ene o.

english_verse: Solomon built shrines on a hill east of Jerusalem to worship Chemosh the disgusting god of Moab, and Molech the disgusting god of Ammon.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi Salomo tu nuxeƒe na Kemos, si nye Moabtɔwo ƒe ŋunyɔnu kple Molex, si nye Amon-viwo ƒe ŋunyɔnu, ɖe to dzi le Yerusalem ŋgɔ.

english_verse: In fact, he built a shrine for each of his foreign wives, so all of them could burn incense and offer sacrifices to their own gods.
translation_verse: Alea wòwɔe na srɔ̃a, siwo katã tso anyigba bubuwo dzi, amesiwo do dzudzɔ, eye wosa vɔ na woƒe mawuwo.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel had appeared to Solomon two times and warned him not to worship foreign gods. But Solomon disobeyed and did it anyway. This made the Lord very angry,
translation_verse: eye wòde se nɛ le nusia ŋu be, megadze mawu bubuwo yome o; ke mewo se, si Yehowa de la dzi o.

english_verse: and he said to Solomon: You did what you wanted and not what I told you to do. Now I'm going to take your kingdom from you and give it to one of your officials.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ na Salomo bena: Esi nusia tɔgbe le ta me na wò, eye mèlé nye nubabla kple nye ɖoɖo, siwo megblɔ na wò la me ɖe asi o la, eyata maɖu fiaɖuƒe la le asiwò ahatsɔ na wò ɖɔla.

english_verse: But because David was your father, you will remain king as long as you live. I will wait until your son becomes king, then I will take the kingdom from him.
translation_verse: Ɖeko nyemele ewɔ ge le wò agbenɔɣi o, le fofowò Dawid ta, ke boŋ maɖui le viwò si.

english_verse: When I do, I will still let him rule one tribe, because I have not forgotten that David was my servant and Jerusalem is my chosen city. Hadad Becomes an Enemy of Solomon
translation_verse: Ke nyemele fiaɖuƒe blibo la du ge o, hafi boŋ matsɔ to ɖeka na viwò le nye dɔla Dawid kple Yerusalem, si metia la ta. Salomo ƒe futɔwo kple eƒe ku.

english_verse: Hadad was from the royal family of Edom, and here is how the Lord made him Solomon's enemy:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖo futɔ na Salomo, si nye Edomtɔ Hadad, amesi tso fiaƒome le Edom.

english_verse: Hadad and his wife had a son named Genubath, and the queen let the boy grow up in the palace with her own children.
translation_verse: Taxpenes nɔvinyɔnu dzi ŋutsuvi Genubat nɛ, eye Taxpenes nyii le Farao ƒe me.

english_verse: When Hadad heard that David and Joab were dead, he said to the king, “Your Majesty, please let me go back to my own country.”
translation_verse: Esi Hadad se le Egipte bena, Dawid mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye aʋafia Yoab ku la, tete Hadad gblɔ na Farao bena: Ɖe mɔ nam, ne mayi nye anyigba dzi.

english_verse: “Why?” asked the king. “Do you want something I haven't given you?” “No, I just want to go home.” Rezon Becomes an Enemy of Solomon
translation_verse: Farao gblɔ nɛ bena: Esi nèle gbɔnye la, nukae hiã wò, hafi nèle didim be, yeayi mia de? Eɖo ŋu bena: Naneke mehiãm o: gake ɖe mɔ nam ko.

english_verse: Here is how God made Rezon son of Eliada an enemy of Solomon: Rezon had run away from his master, King Hadadezer of Zobah.
translation_verse: Eye Mawu gaɖo futɔ bubu ne, si nye Rezon, Elyada vi, amesi si tso eƒe aƒetɔ Zoba-fia Hadadezer gbɔ,

english_verse: Jeroboam was from the town of Zeredah in Ephraim. His father Nebat had died, but his mother Zeruah was still alive. Jeroboam was one of Solomon's officials, but even he rebelled against Solomon.
translation_verse: Yerobeam, Efraitɔ, Nebat vi tso Zereda, enye Salomo ƒe dɔla; dadaa nye ahosi, eye eŋkɔ nye Zerua. Eya hã do eƒe asi ɖe dzi de fia la ŋu.

english_verse: Here is how it happened: While Solomon's workers were filling in the land on the east side of Jerusalem and repairing the city walls,
translation_verse: Nusi ta wòdo eƒe asi ɖe dzi ɖe fia la ŋu enye si: Salomo tu Milo, eye wòxe fofoa Dawid ƒe du la ƒe ʋe.

english_verse: Solomon noticed that Jeroboam was a hard worker. So he put Jeroboam in charge of the work force from Manasseh and Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu Yerobeam enye aʋawɔla kalẽtɔ, eye esi Salomo kpɔ be ɖekakpui la nye dɔwɔla vevi la, etsɔe ɖo Yosef ƒe aƒe la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ blibo la nu.

english_verse: But Solomon will still rule one tribe, since he is the son of David my servant, and Jerusalem is my chosen city.
translation_verse: To ɖeka akpɔtɔ nɛ le nye dɔla Dawid kple Yerusalem du, si metia le Israel-toawo katã me la ta.

english_verse: “Solomon and the Israelites are not like their ancestor David. They will not listen to me, obey me, or do what is right. They have turned from me to worship Astarte the goddess of Sidon, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of Ammon.
translation_verse: Elabena wogblẽm ɖi, eye wode ta agu na Zidontɔwo ƒe mawu Astarte kple Moabtɔwo ƒe mawu Kemos kpakple Amontɔwo ƒe mawu Milkom, womezɔ nye mɔ dzi, be woawɔ nusi nyo le ŋkunye me, eye woawɔ nye ɖoɖowo kple kɔnuwo dzi abe fofoa Dawid ene o.

english_verse: “Solomon is David's son, and David was my chosen leader, who did what I commanded. So I will let Solomon be king until he dies.
translation_verse: Ke nyemaxɔ fiaduƒe blibo la le esi o, ke boŋ mana wòaɖu fia le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me le nye dɔla Dawid, amesi metia, eye wòwɔ nye sewo kple dodowo dzi la ta.

english_verse: Then I will give you ten tribes to rule,
translation_verse: Gake la maxɔ fiaɖuƒe la le via si, eye matsɔ to ewo na wò.

english_verse: but Solomon's son will still rule one tribe. This way, my servant David will always have a descendant ruling in Jerusalem, the city where I have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Matsɔ to ɖeka ana via, be akaɖi nakpɔtɔ na Dawid le ŋkunye me ŋkekeawo katã le Yerusalem du, si metia na ɖokuinye, be matsɔ nye ŋkɔ aɖo eme la ta.

english_verse: “You will be king of Israel and will rule every nation you want.
translation_verse: Eyata meɖo wò, be naɖu fia ɖe nusianu, si dze ŋuwò la dzi, eye naɖu fia de Israel dzi.

english_verse: I'll help you if you obey me. And if you do what I say, as my servant David did, I will always let someone from your family rule in Israel, just as someone from David's family will always rule in Judah. The nation of Israel will be yours.
translation_verse: Nenye be, nèɖo to se, siwo katã mede na wò, eye nèzɔ nye mɔ dzi hewɔ nusi nyo te ŋkunye me, be nèle nye ɖoɖowo kple nye sewo me ɖe asi, abe alesi nye dɔla Dawid wɔ ene la, ekema manɔ kpli wò, eye maɖo wò aƒe ɖe dzi, abe alesi mewɔe na Dawid ene, eye matsɔ Israel na wò.

english_verse: “I will punish the descendants of David, but not forever.”
translation_verse: Eye mabɔbɔ Dawid ƒe dzidzimeviwo ɖe anyi le esia ta; ke manye tegbee o.

english_verse: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the book about him and his wisdom.
translation_verse: Salomo ŋutinya susɔea, eƒe nunya kple nusiwo katã wòwɔ la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Salomo ƒe ŋutinyagbalẽ me.

english_verse: he died and was buried there in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe fofoa Dawid ƒe du la me; eve via Rexabeam ɖu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: But the people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said,
translation_verse: wodɔ ame ɖo ɖee heyɔe gbɔe — tete Yerobeam kple Israel ƒe ameha blibo la va, eye woƒo nu kple Rexabeam bena:

english_verse: “Give me three days to think about it,” Rehoboam replied, “then come back for my answer.” So the people left.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu na wo bena: Miyi, ŋkeke etɔ megbe miagava gbɔnye. Eye dukɔ la dzo.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, “What should I tell these people?”
translation_verse: Tete fia Rexabeam de adaŋu kple ame tsitsi, siwo nɔ fia Salomo ŋu le eƒe agbenɔɣi la, gblɔ bena: Adaŋu ka miade, be woaɖo nya la ŋu na dukɔ sia?

english_verse: They answered, “If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should do what they ask today. Tell them you will make their work easier.”
translation_verse: Woɖo ŋu gblɔ ne bena: Ne èzu dɔla na dukɔ sia egbea, èsubɔ wo, eye nèɖo to wo, eye nè ƒo nu kpli wo nyuie la, ekema woasubɔ wò ɖaa.

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Ke egbe adaŋu, si ame tsitsiawo de nɛ la, eye wòde adaŋu kple ɖekakpui, siwo nye eƒe hatiwo, eye wonɔa eŋu la.

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Adaŋu ka miade, ne míaɖo ŋu na dukɔ sia, si va gblɔ nam bena: ka kɔkuti, si fofowò ɖo mia dzi la, dzi ɖe na mí?

english_verse: He spoke bluntly and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: Eye wòƒo nu kpli wo le ɖekakpuiawo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nu bena: Fofonye na miaƒe kɔkuti kpe, ke nye la mana miaƒe kɔkuti la nakpe ɖe edzi; fofonye ƒo mi kple atam, ke nye la maƒo mi kple dziɖegbe.

english_verse: When the Israelites heard that Jeroboam was back, they called everyone together. Then they sent for Jeroboam and made him king of Israel. Only the people from the tribe of Judah remained loyal to David's family. Shemaiah Warns Rehoboam (
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esi Israel blibo la se bena, Yerobeam trɔ gbɔ la, wodɔ ame woyi ɖayɔe va ameha la gbɔe, eye wotsɔe ɖo fia ɖe Israel blibo la dzi; wo dometɔa ɖeke meku ɖe Dawid ƒe aƒe la ŋu o, negbe Yuda-to la ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and take control of the whole country. So he called together
translation_verse: Esi Rexabeam va Yerusalem la, eƒo Yuda ƒe aƒe blibo la kple Benyamin-to la nu ƒu, wole aʋawɔla tiatia akpe alafa ɖeka kple blanyi, be woaɖawɔ aʋa kple Israel ƒe aƒe la, ne wòagbugbɔ fiaɖuƒe la na Salomo vi Rexabeam.

english_verse: Meanwhile, God told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Tete Mawu ƒe gbe va Semaya, Mawu ƒe ame la gbɔ bena:

english_verse: to give Rehoboam and everyone from Judah and Benjamin this warning:
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Yuda-fia Rexabeam, Salomo vi, kple Yuda ƒe aƒe blibo la kple Benyamin kpakple dukɔ la ƒe kpɔtɔeawo bena:

english_verse: “Don't go to war against the people from Israel—they are your relatives. Go home! I am the Lord, and I made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord and went home. Jeroboam Makes Religious Changes
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Migaho yidawɔ aʋa kple mia nɔvi Israel-viwo o, mia dome amesiame negbugbɔ yi eƒe me, elabena gbɔnyea nya sia tso. Tete wose Yehowa ƒe gbe, eye wòtrɔ dzo le Yehowa ƒe nya la nu. Israel-fiaɖuƒe. Yerobeam wɔ nyivi eve.

english_verse: Jeroboam rebuilt Shechem in Ephraim and made it a stronger town, then he moved there. He also fortified the town of Penuel.
translation_verse: Emegbe Yerobeam gbugbɔ Sixem tso de Efrayim-to la dzi hena eme; eyome woʋu tso afima ɖagbugbɔ Penuel tso.

english_verse: One day, Jeroboam started thinking, “Everyone in Israel still goes to the temple in Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord. What if they become loyal to David's family again? They will kill me and accept Rehoboam as their king.”
translation_verse: Ne dukɔ sia le Yerusalem yim, be woaɖasa vɔ le Yehowa ƒe me la, ekema dukɔ sia ƒe dzi atrɔ ɖe eƒe aƒetɔ Yuda-fia Rexabeam ŋu, eye woawum ahatrɔ ayi Yuda-fia Rexabeam gbɔ.

english_verse: Jeroboam asked for advice and then made two gold statues of calves. He showed them to the people and said, “Listen everyone! You won't have to go to Jerusalem to worship anymore. Here are your gods who rescued you from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Tete fia la de adaŋu hewɔ sikanyivi eve, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miede Yerusalem wòsɔ gbɔ azɔ! Israel, kpɔ ɖa, wò mawu, siwo kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, wonye si.

english_verse: The people sinned because they started going to these places to worship.
translation_verse: Eye nusia zu nuvɔ̃; eye dukɔ la yia ɖeka gbɔ le keke Dan ke.

english_verse: Jeroboam built small places of worship at the shrines and appointed men who were not from the tribe of Levi to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Etu nuxeƒexɔwo, eye wòtsɔ dukɔ la ƒe amesiame ƒomevi, si metso Lewi-viwo dome o la, ɖo nunɔlae.

english_verse: He also decided to start a new festival for the Israelites on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, just like the one in Judah. On that day, Jeroboam went to Bethel and offered sacrifices on the altar to the gold calf he had put there. Then he assigned the priests their duties.
translation_verse: Eye wosa vo le vɔsamlekpui, si woɖi ɖe Betel la dzi le dzinu enyilia ƒe ŋkeke wuiatɔ̃lia dzi, dzinu, si me eya ŋutɔ bu ta me heɖo ŋkekenyuie na Israel-viwo, eve wòde vɔsamlekpui la dzi, be yeado dzudzɔ.

english_verse: One day, Jeroboam was standing at the altar in Bethel, ready to make an offering. Suddenly one of God's prophets arrived from Judah and shouted: The Lord sent me with a message about this altar. A child named Josiah will be born into David's family. He will sacrifice on this altar the priests who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on it.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo ɣli ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ta le Yehowa ƒe nya nu gblɔ bena: Vɔsamlekpui, vɔsamlekpui! Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, wole ŋutsuvia ɖe dzi ge na Dawid ƒe aƒe la, si ŋkɔ anye Yosiya, eya awu nuxeƒe ƒe nunɔlawo ɖe dziwò, amesiwo doa dzudzɔ le dziwò, eye wòatɔ dzo ameƒuwo ɖe dziwò.

english_verse: You will know that the Lord has said these things when the altar splits in half, and the ashes on it fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ dzesi di gbemagbe bena: Dzesi, si Yehowa gblɔ enye si: Kpɔ ɖa, vɔsamlekpui la afe, eye afi, si le edzi la, aɖuɖu ɖe anyi.

english_verse: The altar split in half, and the ashes fell to the ground, just as the prophet had warned.
translation_verse: Vɔsamlekpui la fe, eye afi la dudu tso vɔsamlekpui la dzi le Mawu ƒe ame ƒe dzesi, si wògblɔ ɖi la nu ɖe Yehowa ƒe nya la nu.

english_verse: “Come home with me and eat something,” Jeroboam said. “I want to give you a gift for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Eye fia la gblɔ na Mawu ƒe ame la bena: Va miyi aƒenye me, eye nade nane nu me, ne madi nane ana wò.

english_verse: “No, I wouldn't go with you, even if you offered me half of your kingdom. I won't eat or drink here either.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe ame la ɖo ŋu na fia la bena: Ne etsɔ aƒewò me nuwo ƒe afã nam hã la, nyemayi kpli wò aɖu abolo, eye nyemano tsi le teƒe sia o.

english_verse: The Lord said I can't eat or drink anything and that I can't go home the same way I came.”
translation_verse: Elabena alea wode se nam le Yehowa ƒe nya nu gblɔ bena: Megaɖu abolo o, megano tsi o, eye megagbugbɔ to mɔ, si neto yi o.

english_verse: Then he started home down a different road. An Old Prophet from Bethel
translation_verse: Eye wòto mɔ bubu, eye megbugbɔ to mɔ, si wòto va Betel la o.

english_verse: At that time an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons told him what the prophet from Judah had said and done.
translation_verse: Ke nyagblɔɖila tsitsia ɖe le Betel, eye viaŋutsuwo va to nusiwo katã Mawu ƒe ame la wo gbemagbe le Betel la nɛ, eye woto nya, siwo wògblɔ na fia la, na wo fofo.

english_verse: “Show me which way he went,” the old prophet said, and his sons pointed out the road.
translation_verse: Wo fofo bia wo bena: Mo ka wòto? Ke viaŋutsuawo kpɔ mɔ, si Mawu ƒe ame, si tso Yuda va la to.

english_verse: “Put a saddle on my donkey,” he told them. After they did, he got on the donkey
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na viawo bena: Mibla akpa na tedzi nam! Tete wòbia akpa na tedzi nɛ wòdo.

english_verse: and rode off to look for the prophet from Judah. The old prophet found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, “Are you the prophet from Judah?” “Yes, I am.”
translation_verse: Eye wòdze Mawu ƒe ame la yome heva kpoe wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe logotia ɖe te. Tete wòbiae bena: Wòe nye Mawu ƒe ame, si tso Yuda va la? Eɖo ŋu be: Nyee!

english_verse: “Come home with me,” the old prophet said, “and have something to eat.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Va miyi aƒe me, ne naɖu abolo.

english_verse: “I can't go back with you,” the prophet replied, “and I can't eat or drink anything with you.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena: Nyemate ŋu agbugbɔ ayi kpli wò o, eye nyemaɖu abolo, eye nyemano tsi kpli wò le teƒe sia o.

english_verse: The Lord warned me not to eat or drink or to go home the same way I came.”
translation_verse: Elabena wogblɔ nam le Yehowa ƒe nya nu be: Megaɖu abolo o, megano tsi le afima o, eye megagbugbɔ to mɔ, si neto yi o.

english_verse: The old prophet said, “I'm a prophet too. One of the Lord's angels told me to take you to my house and give you something to eat and drink.” The prophet from Judah did not know that the old prophet was lying,
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Nye hã nyagblɔɖila menye abe wò ke ene, eye mawudɔla ƒo nu kplim le Yehowa ƒe nya nu gblɔ bena: Yi ɖagbugbɔe, eye mia kplii miayi aƒewò me, ne wòaɖu abolo, eye wòano tsi! Ke alakpae wòda nɛ.

english_verse: so he went home with him and ate and drank.
translation_verse: Tete wògbugbɔ kplii, eye woɖu abolo, eye wono tsi le eƒe me.

english_verse: During the meal the Lord gave the old prophet
translation_verse: Esime wole kplɔ̃ ŋu la, Yehowa ƒe gbe va nyagblɔɖila, si ɖatrɔe vɛ la gbɔ,

english_verse: a message for the prophet from Judah: Listen to the Lord's message. You have disobeyed the Lord your God.
translation_verse: eye wòdo ɣli gblɔ na Mawu ƒe ame, si tso Yuda va la bena: Esi negbe toɖoɖo Yehowa ƒe gbe, eye melé se, si Yehowa, wò Mawu, de na wò me ɖe asi o,

english_verse: He told you not to eat or drink anything here, but you came home and ate with me. And so, when you die, your body won't be buried in your family tomb.
translation_verse: ke boŋ netrɔ, eye nèɖu abolo heno tsi le teƒe, si ŋuti wogblɔ le na wò be, megaɖu abolo, eye megano tsi o la, eyata wò kukua made fofowòwo ƒe yɔdo me o.

english_verse: After the meal the old prophet got a donkey ready,
translation_verse: Esime woɖu abolo heno nu vɔ la, ebla akpa na tedzi la na nyagblɔɖila, si wòɖatrɔ gbɔe la.

english_verse: and the prophet from Judah left. Along the way, a lion attacked and killed him, and the donkey and the lion stood there beside his dead body.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòdze mɔ la, dzataa ɖe va do goe le mo dzi, eye wòwui; eƒe kukua dze mo dzi, eye tedzi la tsi tre ɖe egbɔ, eye dzata la hã la tsitre ɖe ame kuku la gbɔ.

english_verse: Some people walked by and saw the body with the lion standing there. They ran into Bethel, telling everyone what they had seen.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, esi ŋutsuwo va yina la, wokpɔ ame kuku la le mɔ dzi, eye dzata le tsitre ɖe ame kuku la gbɔ; tete woɖagblɔe le du, si me nyagblɔɖila tsitsia le la me

english_verse: When the old prophet heard the news, he said, “That must be the prophet from Judah. The Lord warned him, but he disobeyed. So the Lord sent a lion to kill him.”
translation_verse: Eye esi nyagblɔɖila, si ɖagbugbɔe tso mɔ ta gbɔe la, see la, egblɔ bena: Eya nye Mawu ƒe ame, si gbe toɖoɖo Yehowa ƒe gbe, eyata Yehowa tsɔe ɖe asi na dzata, eye wòvuvui hewui le Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ nɛ la nu.

english_verse: The old prophet told his sons to saddle his donkey, and when it was ready,
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na viaŋutsuwo bena: Mibla akpa na tedzi nam! Eye woblae.

english_verse: he left. He found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and lion standing there. The lion had not eaten the body or attacked the donkey.
translation_verse: Esi wòyi la, ekpɔ eƒe kukua le mɔ dzi, eye tedzia kple dzata la tsi tre ɖe ame kuku la gbɔ; dzata la meɖu ame kuku la o, eye mevuvu tedzi la hã o.

english_verse: The old prophet picked up the body, put it on his own donkey, and took it back to Bethel, so he could bury it and mourn for the prophet from Judah.
translation_verse: Eye nyagblɔɖila la kɔ Mawu ƒe ame la ƒe kukua da ɖe tedzi dzi hetsɔe va nyagblɔɖila tsitsi la ƒe du me, be wòa fa nɛ, eye wòaɖii.

english_verse: He buried the body in his own family tomb and cried for the prophet.
translation_verse: Etsɔ ame kuku la ɖa ɖe eƒe yɔdo me, eye wòfa nɛ bena: Ao, nɔvinye!

english_verse: I'm sure that everything he said about the altar in Bethel and the shrines in Samaria will happen.”
translation_verse: Elabena nya, si wògblɔ le Yehowa ƒe nya nu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋuti le Betel kple nuxeƒexɔwo katã, siwo le Samaria-duwo me ŋuti la, ava me.

english_verse: But Jeroboam kept on doing evil things. He appointed men to be priests at the local shrines, even if they were not Levites. In fact, anyone who wanted to be a priest could be one.
translation_verse: Le nya siawo megbe la Yerobeam metrɔ tso eƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo dzi o, ke boŋ eɖo dukɔ la ƒe; amesiame ƒomevi nuxeƒenunɔlae; eye amesi nya lɔ ko la, eɖonɛ wòzua nuxeƒenunɔla.

english_verse: This sinful thing led to the downfall of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Nusia zu nuvɔ̃ na Yerobeam ƒe aƒe la, esi na be, wògblɔe, eye wotsɔe ɖa le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: About the same time, Abijah son of Jeroboam got sick.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la Yerobeam vi Abiya dze dɔ.

english_verse: She got ready and left for Ahijah's house in Shiloh. Ahijah was now old and blind,
translation_verse: Tete Yerobeam srɔ̃ wɔ nenema, eye wotso heyi Silo, eye wòva Axiya ƒe me. Ke Axiya megate ŋu le nu kpɔm o, elabena etsi akpa, eye eƒe ŋkuwo tsi.

english_verse: But when Ahijah heard her walking up to the door, he said: Come in! I know you're Jeroboam's wife—why are you pretending to be someone else? I have some bad news for you.
translation_verse: Esime Axiya se eƒe afɔzi le ʋɔtrua nu wògbɔna la, egblɔ bena: Ge ɖe me, Yerobeam srɔ̃! Nukaŋuti nèwɔ ɖokuiwò ame natɔe? Ke nye la, gbe sesẽ wode asinye na wò.

english_verse: Give your husband this message from the Lord God of Israel: “Jeroboam, you know that I, the Lord, chose you over anyone else to be the leader of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Yi ɖagblɔ na Yerobeam bena: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Esi medo wò ɖe dzi le dukɔ la dome, metsɔ wò ɖo fia ɖe nye dukɔ Israel dzi,

english_verse: I even took David's kingdom away from his family and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed me and did what was right.
translation_verse: eye medu fiaɖuƒe la le Dawid ƒe aƒe la si hetsɔ na wò; ke wòa mèle abe nye dɔla Dawid, amesi lé nye seawo me ɖe asi, eye wòdze yonyeme kple eƒe dzi blibo hewɔ nusi ɖeɖe ko nyo le ŋkunye me ene o;

english_verse: “You have made me very angry by rejecting me and making idols out of gold. Jeroboam, you have done more evil things than any king before you.
translation_verse: èwɔ nu gbegblẽ wu amesiwo katã nɔ ŋgɔ na wò, eye nèɖawɔ mawu bubuwo, eye nèkɔ legbawo, be natsɔ aɖo dɔmedzoe nam, ke netsɔ nye nya ƒu gbe ɖe megbewò la,

english_verse: “Because of this, I will destroy your family by killing every man and boy in it, whether slave or free. I will wipe out your family, just as fire burns up trash.
translation_verse: eyata kpɔ ɖa, mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava Yerobeam ƒe aƒe la dzi, eye matsrɔ̃ Yerobeam ƒe ŋutsuwo, ɖeviwo kple ame tsitsiwo siaa le Israel, eye makplɔ Yerobeam ƒe aƒe la ƒiaƒiaƒia, abe alesi wokplɔa aɖuɖɔ ene.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel will mourn at his funeral. But he will be the last one from Jeroboam's family to receive a proper burial, because he's the only one the Lord God of Israel is pleased with.
translation_verse: Eye Israel blibo la afa nɛ, eye woaɖii, elabena eya ɖeɖe koe anye Yerobeam ƒe ame, si woaɖi ɖe yɔdo me, elabena eya ko ŋu wokpɔ nane, si dze Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu le Yerobeam ƒe me la le.

english_verse: The Lord will soon choose a new king of Israel, who will destroy Jeroboam's family. And I mean very soon.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa aɖo fiãa ɖe na Israel, amesi atsrɔ̃ Yerobeam ƒe aƒe la le egbe ŋkeke siawo me, nusi va me egbeawo xoxo.

english_verse: The people of Israel have made the Lord angry by setting up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. So the Lord will punish them until they shake like grass in a stream.
