translation_verse: Midian viwo nye: Eta, Efer, Xanox, Abida kple Eldaa. Amesiawo katã nye Ketura ƒe viwo.

english_verse: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
translation_verse: Eye Abraham dzi Isak. Isak viwo nye: Esau kple Israel. Esau viwo kpakple Edom-fiawo.

english_verse: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation_verse: Esau viwo nye: Elifaz, Reguel, Yehus, Yaelam kple Korax.

english_verse: Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah.
translation_verse: Amesiwo ɖu fia le Edom-nyigba dzi, hafi fia va nɔ Israel nu la, wonye: Bela, Beor vi; eƒe du enye Dinhaba.

english_verse: Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
translation_verse: Seir viwo nye: Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dison, Ezer kple Disan.

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Lotan viwo nye: Xori kple Homam, eye Lotan nɔvinyɔnu nye Timna.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Sobal viwo nye: Alyan, Manaxat, Ebal, Sefi kple Onam. Zibeon viwo nye: Aya kple Ana.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Ana vi nye: Dison. Dison viwo nye: Xamran, Esban, Yitran kple Xeran.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Ezer viwo nye: Bilhan, Zaawan kple Yaakan. Disan viwo nye: Uz kple Aran.

english_verse: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.
translation_verse: Esi Bela ku la, Yobab, Zerax vi tso Bozra, zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Esi Yobab ku la, Xusam tso Temanitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi zu fia ɖe eteƒe

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Esi Xusam ku la, Hadad, Bedad vi, zu fia ɖe eteƒe; eya si Midiantɔwo le Moab-tagba; eƒe du enye Awit.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Esi Hadad ku la, Samla tso Masreka zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Esi Samla ku la, Saul tso Rexobot le tɔsisi la nu zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Esi Saul ku la, Baal-Xanan, Axbor vi, zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Esi Baal-Xanan ku la, Hadad zu fia ɖe eteƒe; eƒe du enye Pagi, eye srɔ̃a Mehetabeel enye Matred, si nye Mesaxab ƒe vinyɔnu la ƒe vi.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Esi Hadad ku la, Edom-amegãwo nye: Amegã Timna, amegã Alwa, amegã Yetet,

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: amegã Oholibama, amegã Ela, amegã Pinon,

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: amegã Kenaz, amegã Teman, amegã Mibzar,

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Yuda viwo nye: Ger, Onan kple Sela; wo ame etɔ la Sua vinyɔnu, Kanaan-nyɔnu la, dzi nɛ. Ke esi Yuda ƒe ŋgɔgbevi Ger ƒe nu medze Yehowa ŋu o la, ewui.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Eye lɔ̃xoa Tamar dzi Perez kple Zerax nɛ. Yuda viwo katã le wo ame atɔ̃.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Perez viwo nye: Xezron kple Xamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Zerax viwo nye: Zimri, Etan, Heman, Xalkol kple Dara; wole ame atɔ̃.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Karmi vi nye: Axan, amesi he dzɔgbevɔ̃e va Israel dzi, le esi wòtsɔ busunuawo ƒe ɖe ta.

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Xezron ƒe vi, siwo wodzi nɛ, wonye: Yeraxmeel, Ram kple Kelubai.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Ram dzi Aminadab, eye Aminadab dzi Naxeson, amesi nye Yuda-viwo ƒe amegã

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: Naxeson dzi Salma, Salma dzi Boas,

english_verse: Obed, and Jesse.
translation_verse: Boas dzi Obed, Obed dzi Isai.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Wo nɔvinyɔnuwo nye Zeruya kple Abigail, eye Zeruya viwo nye Abisai, Yoab kple Asahel; wole wo ame etɔ̃.

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Kaleb, Xezron vi, kple srɔ̃a Azuba kple Yeriot wodzi viwo: wo viawo nye esi: Yeser, Sobab kple Ardon.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Esi Azuba ku la, Kaleb ɖe Efrat, eya dzi Xur nɛ.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Xur dzi Uri, eye Uri dzi Bezaleel.

english_verse: was the father of Jair, who ruled
translation_verse: Segub dzi Yair, amesi si du blave vɔ etɔ̃ no le Gilead-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Le Xezron ƒe ku megbe la Kaleb va Efrat. Xezron srɔ̃ ŋkɔ nye Abiya, eya dzi Asxur nɛ, amesi nye Tekoa fofo.

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Eye Xezron ƒe ŋgɔgbevi Yeraxmeel viwo nye: Ram, eƒe ŋgɔgbevi, Buna, Oren, Ozem kple Axiya.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Eye srɔ̃ bubu ganɔ Yeraxmeel si, si ŋkɔ nye Atara; eya nye Onam dada.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Yeraxmeel ŋgɔgbevi Ram ƒe viwo nye: Maaz, Yamin kple Eker.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam viwo nye Samai kple Yada. Samai viwo nye: Nadab kple Abisur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Abisur srɔ̃ ŋkɔ nye Abixail, eya dzi Axban kple Molid nɛ.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadab viwo nye: Seled kple Apayim; ke Seled medzi via ɖeke hafi ku o.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apayim viwo nye: Yisi, eye Yisi vi nye Sesan, Sesan vi nye: Axelai.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Semai nɔvi, Yada ƒe viwo nye Yeter kple Yonatan; ke Yeter medzi via ɖeke hafi ku o.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Yonatan viwo nye Pelet kple Zaza. Amesiawo nye Yeraxmeel ƒe viwo.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Eye Sesan tso vianyɔnu na eƒe kluvi Yarxa wòɖe; eya dzi Atai nɛ.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Atai dzi Natan, eye Natan dzi Zabad

english_verse: Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron,
translation_verse: Yeraxmeel nɔvi Kaleb ƒe viwo nye: eƒe ŋgɔgbea nye Mesa, eya nye Zif toto, kple Maresa, si nye Xebron lolo ƒe viwo.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Xebron viwo nye Korax, Tapuax, Rekem kple Sema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Sema dzi Raxam, si nye Yorkeam fofo, eye Rekem dzi Samai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Samai ƒe viŋutsu enye Maon, eye Maon enye Bet-Zur fofo.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Eye Kaleb ƒe ahiã Efa dzi Xaran, Moza kple Gazez; ke Xaran ye dzi Gazez.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Yadai viwo nye: Regem, Yotam, Gesan, Pelet, Efa kple Saaf.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kaleb ƒe ahiã Maaxa dzi Seber kple Tirxana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Eya kee dzi Saaf hã, amesi nye Madmana fofo, Sewa, si nye Maxbena kple Gibea fofo; eye Kaleb ƒe vinyɔnu enye Axsa.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Eye Kiryat-Yearim fofo Sobal ƒe viwo nye: Haroe kple Menuxottɔwo ƒe afã.

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: Kiryat-Yearim ƒe ƒomewo nye: Yitritɔwo, Putitɔwo, Sumatitɔwo kple Misraitɔwo. Woawo me Zoreatitɔwo kple Estaolitɔwo dzo tso.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salma viwo nye: Betlexem, Netofatitɔwo, Atarot, Bet-Yoab kple Manatitɔwo ƒe afã, eya nye Zoreatitɔwo,

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: agbalẽŋlɔlawo ƒe ƒome, si le Yabez, Tiratitɔwo, Simatitɔwo kple Suxatitɔwo, amesiawo nye Kinitɔwo, amesiwo dzɔ tso Xamat, amesi nye Rexab ƒe aƒekɔ ƒe fofo la me.

english_verse: more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
translation_verse: eya ƒe vi nye Axaz, eya ƒe vi nye Xizkiya, eya ƒe vi nye Manase,

english_verse: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Elisama, Elyada kple Elifelet ŋu wole wo ame asieke.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye Dawid ƒe viŋutsuwo, ke eƒe ahiãwo ƒe viŋutsuwo mele eme o. Wo nɔvinyɔnu enye Tamar.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Yoyakim viwo nye: Yexonya, eya ƒe vi nye Zedekiya.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Yexonya, amesi nye aboyome la ƒe viwo nye: Sealtiel,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: Malxiram, Pedaya, Senazar, Yekamya, Hosama kple Nedabya.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pedaya ƒe viwo nye: Zerubabel kple Simei. Zerubabel ƒe viwo nye: Mesulam kple Xananya; wo nɔvinyɔnu enye Selomit;

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: emegbe Xasuba, Ohel, Berexya, Xasadya kple Yusab-Xesed, wole wo ame atɔ̃.

english_verse: Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah,
translation_verse: Xananya viwo nye: Pelatya kple Yesaya, Refaya viwo, Arnan viwo, Obadya viwo, Sexanya viwo.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Sexanya vi nye: Semaya, eye Semaya viwo nye: Xatus, Yigeal, Bariax, Nearya, Safat; wote wo ame ade.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nearya viwo nye: Elyoenai, Xizkiya, Azrikam; wole wo ame elɔ̃.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elyoenai viwo nye: Hodaya, Elyasib, Pelaya, Akub, Yoxanan, Delaya kple Anani; wole wo ame adre.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Yuda viwo nye: Perez, Xezron, Kelubai, Xur kple Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Sobal vi Reaya dzi Yaxat, eye Yaxat dzi Axumai kple Lahad. Esia nye Zoreatitɔwo ƒe ƒomeawo.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Tekoa fofo Asxur ɖe srɔ̃ eve, siwo nye: Xelea kple Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Naara dzi Axuzam, Xefer, Temni kple Axastaritɔwo nɛ. Amesiawo nye Naara viwo.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Eye Xelea viwo nye; Zeret, Yizxar, Etnan kple Koz.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Koz dzi Anub, Hazobeba kple Harum vi Axarxel ƒe ƒomeawo.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Bubu nɔ Yabez ŋu wu nɔviawo, eye dadaa na ŋkɔe be Yabez, le esi wose veve hafi dzii ta.

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Eye Yabez yɔ Israel ƒe Mawu la gblɔ bena: Ne èyram, eye nèkeke nye anyigba ɖe enu, wò asi nɔ kplim, eye neɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃ewo ɖa, ale be vevea ɖeke medzɔ ɖe dzinye o la, — tete Mawu na nusi wòbia la, va me.

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Suxa nɔvi Kelub dzi Mexir, eya nye Eston fofo.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Eston dzi Bet-Rafa, Paseax kple Texina, si nye Naxas-du la fofo; amesiawo nye Rexa ƒe ŋutsuwo.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenaz viwo nye: Otniel kple Seraya; eye Otniel vi nye Xatat.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Meonotai dzi Ofra, eye Seraya dzi Yoab, si nye atikpala, bali me nɔlawo fofo, elabena atikpalawo wonye.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Yefune vi Kaleb ƒe viwo nye: Iru, Ela kple Naam, hekpe ɖe Ela kple Kenaz ƒe viwo ŋu.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodiya srɔ̃, si nye Naxam nɔvinyɔnu ƒe viwo nye: Garmitɔ, Kegila fofo, kple Maaxatitɔ Estemoa.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Simon viwo nye Amnon, Rina, Ben-Xanan kple Tilon. Yisei viwo nye: Zoxet kple Ben-Zoxet.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Wonye zermlawo, eye wono Netaim kple Gedera, fia ƒe do me wono le afima. Simeon ƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon viwo nye: Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Serax kple Saul;

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: eya ƒe vi nye Salum, eya ƒe vi nye Mibsam, eya ƒe vi nye Misma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Misma viwo nye: Xamuel, eya ƒe vi nye Zakur, eya ƒe vi nye Simei.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Woƒe kɔƒe, siwo kpe ɖe eŋu, wonye: Etam, Ayin, Rimon, Toxen kple Asan, wole du atɔ̃,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: kpakple woƒe kɔƒe, siwo katã ƒo xlã du siawo vaseɖe Baal. Esiawo nye woƒe nɔƒewo, eye ƒomegbalẽ tɔxɛ le wo si.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Amesiwo ŋkɔ woxlẽ la, wonye amegãwo le woƒe ƒomeawo me, eye woƒe aƒekɔwo keke ta ŋutɔ.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Eye woho ɖo ta Gedor vaseɖe bali la ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, be woadi lãnyiƒe na woƒe lãhawo.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Eye wokpɔ lãnyiƒe dama nyuia ɖe; anyigba la keke le goawo katã me, eye eŋu fa bɔkɔɔ; elabena Xam-viwo nɔ afima tsã.

english_verse: but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
translation_verse: Tete amesiwo ŋkɔ woŋlɔ ɖi la, va gbã woƒe agbadɔwo, eye wowu Meunitɔ, siwo nɔ afima le Yuda-fia Xizkiya ŋɔli: wotsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi vaseɖe egbe henɔ wo teƒe, elabena lãnyiƒe le afima na woƒe lãwo.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Eye wowu Amalekitɔ, siwo tsi anyi la ƒe susɔeawo henɔ afima vaseɖe egbe.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Israel ŋgɔgbevi Ruben ƒe viwo; elabena eya nye ŋgɔgbea, ke esi wògblẽ kɔ ɖo na fofoa ƒe aba la, wotsɔ eƒe ŋgɔgbevinyenye na Israel vi Yosef ƒe viwo, ke ɖeko womeŋlɔ woƒe ŋkɔ ɖi abe ŋgɔgbeawo ene o.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Israel ŋgɔgbevi Ruben ƒe viwo nye: Henox. Palu, Xezron kple Karmi.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: eya ƒe vi nye Beera, amesi Asur-fia Tiglat-Pileser de aboyoe; eya nye Ruben-viwo ƒe amegã.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: enɔ ɣedzeƒe gome ɖo ta gbe dzi tso Frat-tɔsisi la nu, elabena woƒe lãwo dzi ɖe dzi le Gilead-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Le Saul ŋɔli la wowɔ aʋa kple Hagritɔwo; eye esi wotsi wo si me la, woxɔ woƒe agbadɔwo no me le Gilead ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome katã. Gad ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Aʋawɔwɔ kple Hagritɔwo.

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Yoel, si nye tatɔ, Safam, si nye evelia, Yanai kple Safat le Basan.

english_verse: Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
translation_verse: Wo nɔviwò nye esi le woƒe aƒekɔwo nu: Mixael, Mesulam, Seba, Yorai, Yakan, Zia kple Eber; wole adadre.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye Abixail ƒe viwo, amesi nye Xuri vi, amesi nye Yaroax vi, amesi nye Gilead vi, amesi nye Mixael vi, amesi nye Yesisai vi, amesi nye Yaxdo vi, amesi nye Buz vi.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Guni vi Abdiel ƒe vi Axi enye woƒe aƒekɔ la ƒe tatɔ.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Wonɔ Gilead, Basan kple wo ŋu duwo me kpakple Saron ƒe nutowo katã me vaseɖe eƒe mlɔenu.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ amesiawo katã ɖi le Yuda-fia Yotam kple Israel-fia Yerobeam ŋɔli.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: hewɔ aʋa kple Hagritɔwo, Yetur, Nafis kple Nodab.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Mawu kpe ɖe wo ŋu, ale be Hagritɔwo kple amesiwo katã kpe ɖe wo ŋu la, ge ɖewo si me; elabena wodo ɣli yɔ Mawu le aʋa la me, eye wòɖo to wo, le esi woɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu ta.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Elabena woda nu ame geɖewo woku, elabena aʋa la tso Mawu gbɔ̃; eye wono wo, teƒe vaseɖe aboyoɖeŋɔli. Manase to afã.

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Eye Manase-to afã la ƒe viwo nɔ Basan-nyigba dzi vaseɖe Baal-Xermon kple Senir kpakple Xermon-to la ŋu; wosɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Woƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo nye esi: Efer, Yisei, Eliel, Azriel, Yirmeya, Hodaya kple Yaxdiel; wonye ŋutsuwɔlawo, ame ŋkɔŋuwo kple woƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo.

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ke womeɖi anukware na wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la o, eye wodze anyigba dzi dukɔ, siwo Mawu tsrɔ̃ le wo ŋgɔ la ƒe mawuwo yome.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Tete Israel ƒe Mawu la nyɔ Asur-fia Pul ƒe gbɔgbɔ kple Asur-fia Tiglat-Pileser ƒe gbɔgbɔ de wo, eye wokplɔ Ruben-viwo, Gad-viwo kple Manase ƒe to afã la dzo yi Xalax, Xabor kple Hara kpakple Gozan-tɔsisi la nu vaseɖe egbe. Lewi ƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Gerson viwo ƒe ŋkɔwo nye esi: Libni kple Simei.

english_verse: Eleazar's descendants included Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Ahimaaz, Azariah, Johanan, Azariah the priest who served in the temple built by King Solomon, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Shallum, Hilkiah, Azariah, Seraiah, and Jehozadak.
translation_verse: Merari viwo nye: Maxeli, eya ƒe vi nye Libni, eya ƒe vi nye Simei, eya ƒe vi nye Uza,

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: eya ƒe vi nye Simea, eya ƒe vi nye Xagiya, eya ƒe vi nye Asaya.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: amesi nye Elkana vi, amesi nye Yeroxam vi, amesi nye Eliel vi, amesi nye Toax vi,

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Nɔvia Asat tsi tre ɖe eƒe ɖusi me Asaf enye Berexya vi, amesi nye Simea vi,

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: amesi nye Mixael vi, amesi nye Baaseya vi, amesi nye Malkiya vi,

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: amesi nye Etan vi, amesi nye Zima vi, amesi nye Simei vi,

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: amesi nye Yaxat vi, amesi nye. Gerson vi, amesi nye Lewi vi.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: amesi nye Xasabya vi, amesi nye Amazya vi, amesi nye Xilkiya vi,

english_verse: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
translation_verse: amesi nye Maxeli vi, amesi nye Musi vi, amesi nye Merari vi, amesi nye Lewi vi.

english_verse: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
translation_verse: Wona du wuietɔ̃ Gerson viwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu ɖe Isaxar-to, Aser-to, Naftali-to kple Manase-to me le Basan.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Eye wodzidze nu tso du wuieve na Merari viwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu ɖe Ruben-to, Gad-to kple Zebulon-to la me.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ Aner kple eŋu lãnyiƒe kpakple Bileam kple eŋu lãnyiƒe na Kehat viwo ƒe ƒome susɔeawo ɖe Manase ƒe to afã la me.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ Golan le Basan kple eŋu lãnyiƒe kpakple Astarot kple eŋu lãnyiƒe na Gerson viwo ɖe Manase ƒome ƒe to afã la me.

english_verse: So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh.
translation_verse: Esiwo le Aser-to la me, wonye: Masal kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Abdon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Eye esiwo le Naftali-to lãme, wonye: Kedes le Galilea kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Xamon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe kpakple Kiryatayim kple eŋu lãnyiƒe.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Esiwo wotso na Merari vi susɔeawo ɖe Zebulon-to la me, wonye: Rimono kple eŋu lãnyiƒe kpakple Tabor kple eŋu lãnyiƒe.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Esiwo le Ruben-to la me le Yordan ƒe go keme le Yerixo gbɔ le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, wonye: Bezer le gbe dzi kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Yaza kple eŋu lãnyiƒe,

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Kedemot kple eŋu lãnyiƒe kpakple Mefaat kple eŋu lãnyiƒe.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Esiwo le Gad-to la me, wonye: Ramot le Gilead kple eŋu lãnyiƒe, Maxanayim kple eŋu lãnyiƒe.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Xesbon kple eŋu lãnyiƒe kpakple Yazer kple eŋu lãnyiƒe.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Isaxar viwo nye: Tola, Pua, Yasub kple Simron, wole wo ame ene.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola viwo nye: Uzi, Refaya, Yeriel, Yaxmai, Yibsam kple Samuel; woawo nye Tola ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo, eye wonye ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo me. Woƒe xexlẽme de akpe blave vo eve kple alafa ade le Dawid ŋɔli.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Tete wo fofo Efrayim fa na wo eteƒe didi, eye nɔviawo va, be woafa akɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Uzi vi nye Yizraxya, eye Yizraxya viwo nye: Mixael, Obadya, Yoel kple Yisiya; wole wo ame atɔ̃; wo katã wonye tatɔwo.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofax viwo nye: Suax, Xarnefer, Sual, Beri kple Yimra,

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: Wo nɔvi, siwo tso Isaxar ƒe ƒomeawo katã me la, nye ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo; ame akpe blanyi va adre le woƒe dzidzimegbalẽ la me.

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Benyamin viwo nye: Bela, Bexer kple Yediael, wole wo ame etɔ̃.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bela viwo nye: Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Yerimot kple Iri; woawo nye aʋakɔwo ƒe tatɔ atɔ̃awo kple ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo; eye ame akpe blave vɔ eve kple blaetɔ̃ vɔ ene le woƒe dzidzimegbalẽ la me.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bexer viwo nye: Zemira, Yoas, Eliezer, Elyoenai. Omri, Yeremot, Abiya, Anatot kple Alemet; wo katã nye Bexer viwo.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efrayim vi nye: Sutelax; eya ƒe vi nye Bered eya ƒe vi nye Taxat, eya ƒe vi nye Eleada, eya ƒe vi nye Taxat,

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Yediael vi nye: Bilhan, eye Bilhan viwo nye: Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Zetan, Tarsis kple Axisaxar.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ulam vi nye Bedan. Amesiawo nye Manase vi Maxir ƒe vi Gilead ƒe viwo.

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Naftali viwo nye: Yaxziel. Guni, Yezer kple Salum, amesiwo nye Bilha ƒe viwo.

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manase viwo nye: Asriel, si eƒe ahiã, Aram-nyɔnu la dzi, eyae dzi Maxir, si nye Gilead fofo.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Eye Maxir ɖe srɔ̃, si nye Xupim kple Supim nɔvinyɔnu, amesi ŋkɔ nye Maaxa. Evelia ŋkɔ nye Zelofxad, eye Zelofxad dzi nyɔnuviwo

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Eye Maxir srɔ̃ Maaxa dzi ŋutsuvi hena ŋkɔe be Peres, eye nɔvia ŋkɔ nye Seres; eya ƒe viwo nye Ulam kple Rekem.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Nɔvianyɔnu Hamolexet dzi Ishod, Abiezer kple Maxla.

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: eya ƒe vi nye Zabad, eya ƒe vi nye Sutelax hekpe ɖe Ezer kple Elead ŋuti. Ke Gat-ŋutsuwo, siwo nye anyigbadzitɔwo, wu wo, elabena wova, be woalé woƒe lãwo.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Eye wòdɔ srɔ̃ gbɔ wòfɔ fu hedzi ŋutsuvi, eye wòna ŋkɔe be Beria, elabena dzɔgbevɔ̃e va eƒe aƒe dzi.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Vianyɔnu enye Seera, eyae tso Anyigbe-Bet-Xoron kple Dzigbe-Bel-Xoron kpakple Uzen-Seera.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Viaŋutsu nye Refax, eya ƒe viwo nye Resef kple Telax, eya ƒe vi nye Taxan,

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Woƒe anyigba kple wo nɔƒewo nye: Betel kple eŋu duwo ɖo ta Naaran le ɣedzeƒe kple Gezer le ɣetoɖoƒe kple wo ŋu duwo, Sexem kple eŋu duwo vaseɖe Aya kple eŋu duwo gbɔ.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Manase viwo tɔ, si le akpa sia dzi, wonye Bet-Sean kple eŋu duwo; du siawo me Israel vi Yosef ƒe viwo nɔ.

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Aser viwo nye: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi, Bena kple wo nɔvinyɔnu Serax.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Bena viwo nye: Xeber kple Malxiel, eya nye Birzayit fofo.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Xeber dzi Yaflet, Somer, Xotam kple wo nɔvinyɔnu Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Yaflet viwo nye: Pasax, Bimhal kple Aswat; amesiawo nye Yaflet viwo.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Somer viwo nye: Axi, Roga, Xuba kple Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Nɔvia Helem viwo nye: Zofax, Yimna, Seles kple Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Bezer, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Yitran kple Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Yeter viwo nye: Yefune, Pispa kple Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Ula viwo nye: Arax, Xaniel kple Rizya.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Amesiawo katã nye Aser viwo, aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo, ŋutsu kalẽtɔ tiatia, siwo nye amegãwo ƒe tatɔwo, eye woŋlɔ woƒe ŋkɔwo ɖi hena aʋawɔwɔ, woƒe xexlẽme le ame akpe blave vɔ ade.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Eye Benyamin dzi Bela, si nye eƒe ŋgɔgbea, evelia nye Asbel, etɔ̃lia nye Axrax,

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bela viwo nye: Adar, Gera, Abihud,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: Abisua, Naaman, Axoax,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: Gera, Sefufan kple Xuram.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Elpaal viwo nye Eber, Misam kple Semer; eya tso Ono kple Lod kpakple wo ŋu duwo.

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Beria kple Sema wonye Ayalontɔwo ƒe aƒedowo ƒe tatɔwo; woawo nyã Gattɔwo wòsi;

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: Mixael, Yispa kple Yoxa; amesiawo nye Beria viwo.

english_verse: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: Yismerai, Yizia kple Yobab; amesiawo nye Elpaal viwo.

english_verse: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
translation_verse: Adaya, Beraya kple Simrat; woawo nye Simei viwo.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: Yaaresya, Eliya kple Zixri; woawo nye Yeroxam viwo.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye woƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu, eye wonɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Gibeon fofo nɔ Gibeon, eye srɔ̃a ŋkɔ nye Maaxa.

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: Gedor, Axyo kple Zexer.

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: Miklot dzi Simea; woawo kple wo nɔviwo hã nɔ wo nɔviwo kasa le Yerusalem.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner dzi Kis, eye Kis dzi Saul. Saul dzi Yonatan, Malxisua, Abinadab kple Esbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Yonatan vi enye Merib-Baal, eye Merib-Baal dzi Mixa.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mixa viwo nye: Piton, Melex, Taxrea kple Axaz.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Axaz dzi Yoada, eye Yoada dzi Alemet, Azmawet kple Zimri. Zimri dzi Moza,

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Eye Azel dzi vi aɖe, woƒe ŋkɔwo nye: Azrikam, Boxru, Ismael, Searya, Obadya kple Xanan; amesiawo katã nye Azel viwo.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Nɔvia Esek ƒe viwo nye: Ulam, si nye eƒe ŋgɔgbea, evelia nye Yeus, etɔ̃lia nye Elifelet.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam viwo nye ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo kple aŋutrɔdalawo, eye ŋutsuvi geɖe kple tɔgbuiyɔviwo nɔ wo si; wole ame alafa ɖeka kple blaatɔ̃. Amesiawo katã tso Benyamin viwo dome.

english_verse: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.
translation_verse: Amesiwo no woƒe anyigba dzi le woƒe duwo me gbã, wonye: Israel nunɔlawo, Lewi viwo kple gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye amewo tso Yuda-viwo, Benyamin-viwo, Efrayim-viwo kple Manase-viwo dome no Yerusalem.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Adaya, Yeroxam vi, amesi nye Pasxur vi, amesi nye Malxiya vi; Maesai, Adiel vi, amesi nye Yaxzera vi, amesi nye Mesulam vi, amesi nye Mesilemit vi, amesi nye Imer vi,

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawo nye: Salum, Akub, Talmon, Aximan kple wo nɔviwò. Salum enye tatɔ.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Ele fia ƒe agbo nu le ɣedzeƒe gome vaseɖe fifi. Amesiawo nye Lewi-viwo ƒe asaɖa ƒe agbonudzɔlawo.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Salum, Kore vi, amesi nye Ebyasaf vi, amesi nye Korax vi, kple nɔvia, siwo tso eƒe aƒekɔ la me; wotsɔ do la de asi na Korax viwo, be woadzo agbadɔ la ƒe kpui nu, abe alesi wo fofowo nye mɔnudzɔlawo le Yehowa ƒe asaɖa la me ene.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Tsã la Pinexas, Eleazar vi, nye amegã ɖe wo nu, eye Yehowa na kplii?

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Zaxarya, Meselemya vi, enye agbonudzɔla le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawo le akpa eneawo dzi, le ɣedzeƒe, ɣetoɖoƒe, anyiehe kple dziehe.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Eye wo nɔviwo tsoa woƒe kɔƒewo me vana ŋkeke adreadre, ne woakpe asi ɖe eŋu na wo ti;

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: elabena agbonudzɔlawo ƒe amegã eneawo ɖo dɔ la me ɖikaa; wonye Lewi-viwo, eye wokpɔa Mawu ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔwo kple nudzraɖoƒeawo dzi.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Wotsia Mawu ƒe aƒe la nu dona, elabena woawoe nye dzɔlawo, eye woƒe dɔ enye agboawo ʋuʋu ŋdi sia ŋdi.

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ dɔwɔnuawo de wo dometɔa ɖewo si, be woatsɔ wo ava emee dedie, eye woatsɔ wo ado goe dedie.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo ƒe viwo dometɔa ɖewo tsɔa atike ʋeʋẽe ɖaa ami sisi la.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ nusiwo wotɔna le agba me la, de Matitya si ɖikaa, etso Lewi-viwo dome, eye wònye Korax vi Salum ƒe ŋgɔgbevi.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ Kehat viwo, siwo tso wo nɔviwo dome la, ɖo ŋkumeɖobolo la nu, ne woadzrae ɖo le dzudzɔgbe sia dzudzɔgbe dzi.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye hadzilawo, siwo nye Lewi-viwo ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo, amesiwo mewɔa da bubua ɖeke le woƒe aƒewo me o, elabena do le wo si ŋkeke kple zã.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye Lewi-viwo ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo le woƒe ƒomewo nu; woawo nye amesiwo nɔ Yerusalem. Gibeon nɔlawo kple Saul ƒe aƒe.

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Miklot dzi Simeam, eye eya kple nɔviawo hã nɔ wo nɔviwò kasa le Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Amesiwo nɔ Gibeon, wonye: Gibeon fofo Yeuel; srɔ̃a ŋkɔ nye Maaxa;

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: eƒe vi ŋgɔgbea nye Abdon, Zur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: Gedor, Axyo, Zaxarya kple Miklot.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner dzi Kis, eye Kis dzi Saul. Saul dzi Yonatan, Malxisua, Abinadab kple Esbaal.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azel dzi vi ade, woƒe ŋkɔwo nye: Azrikam, si nye eƒe ŋgɔgbea, Ismael, Searya, Obadya kple Xanan; amesiawo nye Azel viwo.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Filistitowo wɔ aʋa kple Israel; tete Israel-ŋutsuwo si le Filistitɔwo nu, eye wotsi aʋa le Gilboa-toa dzi.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Ale Saul ku le eƒe vodada de Yehowa ŋu kple Yehowa ƒe nya, si me mele ɖe asi o la ta. Ede ŋɔliyɔlawo hã gbɔ ɖabia gbe wo se,

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Filistitowo ɖe Saul kple viawo ɖe nu, eye Filistitɔwo wu Saul viwo, siwo nye: Yonatan, Abinadab kple Malxisua.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Ke esi aʋa la nu sẽ ɖe Saul dzi, eye aŋutrɔdalawo va tui la, dzidzi ƒoe le aŋutrɔdalawo ŋuti.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Tete Saul gblɔ na eƒe adekplɔvi bena: Di wò yi naƒo ɖem, ne bolotɔ siawo magava awɔ funyafunyam o! Ke eƒe adekplɔvi la meli o, elabena evɔ̃ ŋutɔ. Tete Saul tso eƒe yi hedze enu.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Esi eƒe adekplɔvi la kpɔ be, Saul ku la, eya hã dze yi nu, eye woku.

english_verse: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.
translation_verse: Ale Saul kple via etɔ̃awo kpakple eƒe aƒe blibo la woku zi ɖeka.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Esi Israel-ŋutsu, siwo katã nɔ bali la me, kpɔ be, wòsi, eye Saul kple viawo ku la, wogblẽ woƒe duwo ɖi hesi, eye Filistitowo va nɔ wo me.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke, eye Filistitɔwo va nu ɖe ge le ame tsiaʋawo ŋu la, wokpɔ Saul kple viawo woku ɖe Gilboa-to la dzi,

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: eye woɖe nu le eŋu hetsɔ eƒe ta kple eƒe aʋawɔnuwo ɖo ɖe Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi godoo, ne woaɖe gbe ƒã dzidzɔ sia na woƒe mawuwo kple dukɔ la.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ eƒe aʋawɔnuwo da ɖe woƒe mawu ƒe me, eye wotsɔ eƒe takoloe ku Dagon ƒe xɔ me.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Esi Yabes-Gileadtɔwo katã se nusiwo keŋ Filistitɔwo wɔ Saul la,

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: ŋutsu aʋawɔlawo katã ho, eye wova tsɔ Saul kple viawo ƒe kukuawo yi Yabes; woɖi woƒe ƒuwo de baniti la te le Yabes, eye wotsi nu dɔ ŋkeke adre sɔŋ.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: ke mebia gbe Yehowa ya se o; eyata wòwui, eye wòna fiaɖuƒe la yi ɖe Dawid, Isai vi la si me.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: Ke Yebusnɔlawo gblɔ na Dawid bena: Màte ŋu ava afisia o! Gake Dawid xɔ Zion ƒe mɔ̃ la, eya nye Dawid ƒe du la.

english_verse: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives,
translation_verse: Tete Israel blibo la va kpe ta de Dawid gbɔ le Xebron gblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, wò ƒu kple wò ŋutilã míenye.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Tete Israel-ame tsitsiwo va fia la gbɔ le Xebron, eye Dawid bla nu kpli wo le Yehowa ŋku me le Xebron, eye wòsi ami na Dawid heɖo fiae de Israel dzi le Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ to Samuel dzi la nu.

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: Tete Dawid gblɔ bena: Amesi ke tre Yebusitɔwo sisi la, eya anye tatɔ kple kplɔla. Tete Yoab, Zeruya vi, tre yiyi, eye wòzu tatɔ.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe kalẽtɔwo ƒe tatɔwo nye esi; woawo kple Israel blibo la ku ɖe eŋu tsehee le eƒe fiaɖuɖu la me, eye wotsɔe ɖo fiae le Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ ɖe Israel ŋu la nu.

english_verse: Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town.
translation_verse: Eye Dawid kple Israel blibo la ho yi Yerusalem, si nye Yebus, elabena Yebusitɔwo nyẽ anyigba dzi nɔlawo le afima.

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: Dawid nɔ mɔ̃ la me, eyata woyɔnɛ be Dawid du.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Ale Dawid le akɔ trim ɖe dzi ɖaa, eye Yehowa Zebaot nɔ kplii. Dawid ƒe kalẽtɔwo,

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Eya wu Egipte-ŋutsu kako, si didi abɔklugui atɔ̃ la. Akplɔ le Egiptetɔ la si le abe abaladoti ene; ke eya yi egbe kple atizɔti, eye wòxɔ akplɔ la le Egiptetɔ la si hetsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe akplɔ wui.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Eye nu de asi Dawid dzodzro me wògblɔ bena: Ameka aɖaku tsi le vudo, si le agbo me le Betlexem la me ve nam mano?

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe kalẽtɔwo ƒe xexlẽme enye si: Yasobeam, Xaxmoni vi, amesi nye ame blaetɔ̃awo ƒe tatɔ, eya ɖa eƒe akplɔ to ame tsiaʋa alafa etɔ̃awo dzi zi ɖeka.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Eyometɔ nye Eleazar, Axoxitɔ, Dodo ƒe vi, amesi le kalẽtɔ etɔ̃awo dome;

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: Tete wotsi tre ɖe agble la titina, eye woxɔe, wowu Filistitɔwo, eye Yehowa na woɖu dzi gãa ɖe.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Tatɔwo dometɔ etɔ̃ va Dawid gbɔ le agakpe la dzi le Adulam-mɔ̃ la me, esime Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Refaim-bali la me.

english_verse: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress,
translation_verse: Dawid le mɔ̃ la me ɣemaɣi, eye Filistitɔwo ɖe aʋakɔ ɖo Betlexem ɣemaɣi.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: hegblɔ bena: Nye Mawu nena esia wowɔ naɖe megbe xaa tso gbɔnye! Ɖe mano ŋutsu siawo ƒe ʋu, si nye woƒe agbea? Elabena wotsɔ woƒe agbe ke hafi kui vɛ! Eye wogbe be, yemanoe o. Kalẽtɔ etɔ̃awoe wɔ nusia.

english_verse: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed
translation_verse: Abisai, Yoab nɔvi, enye ame blaetɔ̃awo ƒe tatɔ, eya ɖa eƒe akplɔ to ame tsiaʋa alafa etɔ̃awo dzi, eye wòxɔ ŋkɔ le ame blaetɔ̃awo dome.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Wode bubu eŋu kpe ɖe ame blaetɔ̃awo dometɔ eveawo ŋu, eye eya nye woƒe tatɔ, ke ɖeko mede ame etɔ̃awo nu o.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Benaya, Yehoyada vi, enye ŋutsu kalẽtɔa ɖe, si wɔ nu tsuwo la ƒe vi tso Kabzeel. Eya wu Moabitɔwo ƒe kalẽtɔ eveawo, eye wòyi ɖawu dzata le vudo la me le gbesigbe sno dza.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Nusia Benaya, Yehoyada vi la wɔ, eye wòxɔ ŋkɔ le kalẽtɔ blaetɔ̃awo dome.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Wode bubu eŋu le kalẽtɔ blaetɔ̃awo dome, ke ɖeko mede ame etɔ̃awo nu o, eye Dawid tsɔe ɖo eƒe fia ŋu asrafowo nu.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: wonye aŋutrɔdalawo, amesiwo nya ɖusiwɔwɔ kple miawɔwɔ le kpedada kple aŋutrɔdada me; wotso Benyamin-viwo, siwo nye Saul nɔviwò dome.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Amesiwo ɖe wo ɖokui le Gad-viwo dome va Dawid gbɔ le mɔ̃ me le gbe dzi la, wonye ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo kple aʋamewo, amesiwo kplaa akpoxɔnu kple akplɔ, woƒe mo le abe dzata ƒe mo ene, eye woɖea abla le towo dzi abe ziwo ene:

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Amesiawo tso Gad-viwo dome, eye wonye aʋakɔ la ƒe tatɔwo, ame ɖagbitɔ ate ŋu akpe kple ame alafa, eye ame lolotɔ ate ŋu akpe kple ame akpe.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Woawoe tso Yordan le dzinu gbãtɔ me, esime wògbagba eƒe goawo katã, eye wonyã bali me nɔla, siwo le ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, wòsi.

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Eye esi amewo tso Benyamin-viwo kple Yuda-viwo dome va Dawid gbɔ̃ le mɔ̃ me la,

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Dawid do yi wo gbɔ, eye wòxɔ edzi gblɔ na wo bena: Nenye ŋutifafa me mieva gbɔnye le, be miaxɔ nam la, ekema mawɔ ɖeka kpli mi tso dzi me, ke nenye ɖe miehe, yewoaɖe agɔnyeme ɖe go na nye ketɔwo, evɔ wònye vɔ̃a ɖeke mele asinye me o la, ekema mía fofowo ƒe Mawu akpɔ me, eye woatso me!

english_verse: Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖewo tso Manase va Dawid gbɔ, esime eya kple Filistitɔwo ho aʋa ɖe Saul ŋu; ke mekpe ɖe wo ŋu o, elabena Filistitɔwo ƒe amegãwo bu lãme, eye woɖe asi le eŋu, elabena wobu be: ne edzo ɖade eƒe aƒetɔ dzi la, ekema míaƒe ta enye ekem tsi asi!

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Amesiawo xɔ na Dawid tso aʋakɔwo si me, elabena wo katã wonye ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo, eye wòzu aʋakɔ la ƒe amegãwo.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo tsɔ ɖe wo gbɔ kpuie va ke ɖe Isaxar, Zebulon kple Naftali la, wotsɔ abolowo ɖo tedziwo, kposɔwo, tedzisɔwo kple nyiwo dzi vɛ, wohe nuɖuɖu, siwo wotsɔ wɔ ɖae, gbotitsetsebolo kple weintsetsebolo, wein kple ami, nyiwo kple alẽwo vɛ kpaŋkpaŋ, elabena dzidzɔ nɔ Israel.

english_verse: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.
translation_verse: Aʋawɔla siawo katã, amesiwo dzea aʋa la, va Xebron kple dzi ɖeka, be woatsɔ Dawid aɖo fiae ɖe Israel blibo la nu, eye dzi ɖeka li na Israel-vi susɔeawo katã hã, be woatsɔ Dawid aɖo fiae.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Wonɔ Dawid gbɔ le afima ŋkeke etɔ̃ sɔŋ, eye woɖu nu no nu, elabena wo nɔviwo ɖa nu na wo.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: Tete Dawid kple Israel blibo la ho yi Baala, eya nye Kiryat-Yearim, si nye Yuda lɔ, ne woatsɔ Mawu Yehowa, amesi le Kerubiwo ta me, afisi woyɔa eƒe ŋkɔ le la ƒe aɖaka tso afima vɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, David talked with his army commanders,
translation_verse: Eye esi Dawid de adaŋu kple ame akpewo kple ame alafa wo ƒe tatɔwo kpakple amegãwo katã la,

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: Eye Dawid vɔ̃ Mawu gbemagbe hegblɔ bena: Aleke matsɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ava gbɔnyee?

english_verse: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
translation_verse: Tete ameha blibo la gblɔ be, yewoawɔ nenema, elabena nya la dze dukɔ blibo la ŋu.

english_verse: David gathered everyone from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Eye Dawid yɔ Israel blibo la tso Egiptetɔwo ƒe Sixor vaseɖe Xamat, ne woaɖakɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la tso Kiryat-Yearim vɛ.

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: Ke wotsɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ɖo tasiaɖam yeye dzi tso Abinadab ƒe me, eye Uza kple Axyo wole tasiaɖam la kplɔm.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: Tete Dawid kple Israel blibo la le ɣe ɖum le Mawu ŋku me kple ŋusẽ katã ɖe hadzidzi, saŋku kple kasaŋku, asiʋui kple gakogoe kpakple kpẽwo ŋu.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Esi wova Kidon ƒe lugbɔƒe la, Uza do asi ɖa, be yealé aɖaka la, elabena nyiawo dze ɖe aga.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ɖo dɔmedzoe ɖe Uza ŋu, eye wòƒoe, le esi wòdo eƒe asi ɖa lé aɖaka la ta, eye woku le afima le Mawu ŋku me.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Eye wòve Dawid be, Yehowa ɖe Uza ɖa, eye wòna ŋkɔ teƒe ma be Perez-Usa, vaseɖe egbe.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Eyata Dawid metsɔ aɖaka la va eɖokui gbɔ le Dawid ƒe du la me o, ke boŋ ena woɖadroe ɖe Gat vi Obed-Edom ƒe me.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu ƒe aɖaka la tsi Obed-Edom gbɔ le eƒe me dzinu etɔ̃, eye Yehowa yra Obed-Edom ƒe aƒe la kple eƒe nuwo katã.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Woho yi Baal-Perazim, eye Dawid si wo le afima. Tete Dawid gblɔ be: Mawu dze nye futɔwo to nye asi dzi, abe alesi tɔ ŋɔa goe ene! Eyata wòna ŋkɔ teƒe ma be Baal-Perazim.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: Dawid wɔ, abe alesi Mawu de se nɛ ene, eye wòsi Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ la tso Gibeon vaseɖe Gezer.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Tete Tiro-fia Xiram ɖo amewo, sedertiwo, gliɖolawo kple atikpalawo ɖe Dawid, ne woatu xɔ nɛ.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Ke Dawid gaɖe srɔ̃ ɖe dzi le Yerusalem, eye wògadzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo.

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: Eye Dawid ƒe ŋkɔ nyo le anyigbawo katã dzi, eye Yehowa de vɔvɔ̃ eŋu na dukɔwo katã.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Esi Filistitɔwo se be, wòsi ami na Dawid heɖo fia ɖe Israel blibo la dzi la, Filistitɔwo katã ho, be yewoadi Dawid. Eye esi Dawid see la, eho yi wo kpe ge.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Ke Filistitɔwo va kaka ɖe Refaim-bali la me.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: Tete Dawid bia nu Mawu be: Maho ɖe Filistitɔwo ŋua, eye atsɔ wo aɖe asi nama? Yehowa ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Ho yi, eye matso wo ade asi na wò!

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Ke wogblẽ woƒe mawuwo ɖe afima, eye Dawid de se wotɔ dzo wo.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: Tete Dawid gabia nu Mawu, eye Mawu ɖo ŋu nɛ be: Megaho dze wo yome o, ke boŋ trɔ ɖa le wo ŋu, eye nava tu wo le klẽtiawo kasa.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Eye ne enya se zi to klẽtiawo dome va yi ko la, ekema ho yi aʋa la nu, elabena Mawu ho dze ŋgɔwò, be wòasi Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ la.

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: Eye wòtu xɔwo na eɖokui ɖevi Dawid ƒe du la me, eye wòwɔ nɔƒe na Mawu ƒe aɖaka la, eye wòtu agbadɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: Tete Dawid yɔ Israel blibo la va Yerusalem, ne woaɖatsɔ Yehowa ƒe aɖaka la ava nɔƒe, si wòwɔ nɛ la.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: Eye Dawid ƒo Aron-viwo kple Lewi-viwo nu ƒu.

english_verse: Uriel, the leader of the Kohath clan, and
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Kehat viwo dome, wonye amegã Uriel kple nɔviawo, wole ame alafa ɖeka blave;

english_verse: Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and
translation_verse: amesiwo tso Gerson viwo dome, wonye amegã Yoel kple nɔviawo, wole ame alafa ɖeka blaetɔ̃;

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: amesiwo tso Elizafan-viwo dome, wonye amegã Semaya kple nɔviawo, wole ame alafa eve;

english_verse: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and
translation_verse: amesiwo tso Xebron-viwo dome, wonye amegã Eliel kple nɔviawo, wole ame blanyi;

english_verse: Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with
translation_verse: amesiwo tso Uziel viwo dome, wonye amegã Aminadab kple nɔviawo, wole ame alafa ɖeka kple wuieve.

english_verse: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.
translation_verse: Eye Dawid na woyɔ Zadok kple Abyatar, siwo nye nunɔlawo, kple Lewi-viwo Uriel, Asaya, Yoel, Semaya, Eliel kple Aminadab,

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: Elabena esi mieno eteƒe gbemagbe o la, eyata Yehowa, mía Mawu, ɖe ame le mía dome, elabena míebia gbee se, abe alesi dze ene o.

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Tete nunɔla kple Lewi-viwo ko wo ɖokui ŋu, ne woaɖakɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe aɖaka la.

english_verse: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
translation_verse: Eye Lewi-viwo tsɔ kpoawo kɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ɖe woƒe abɔta, abe alesi Mose de se le Yehowa ƒe nya nu ene.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: Eye Dawid gblɔ na Lewi-viwo ƒe amegãwo be, woaɖe wo nɔvi, siwo nye hadzilawo, ne woatsɔ hadzinuawo, siwo nye: saŋkuwo, kasaŋkuwo kple gakogoewo, eye woana dzidzɔha nade dzi.

english_verse: Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah. Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer. The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Sebanya, Yosafat, Netaneel, Amasai, Zaxarya, Benaya kple Eliezer wonye nunɔlawo, amesiwo kua kpẽ le Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ, eye Obed-Edom kple Yexiya wonye agbonudzɔlawo le aɖaka la gbɔ.

english_verse: David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Tete Dawid kple Israel-ame tsitsiwo kpakple ame akpewo ƒe tatɔwo woyi, be woaɖakɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la kple dzidzɔ tso Obed-Edom ƒe me.

english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: Eye esi Mawu kpe ɖe Lewi-vi, siwo tsɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka ŋuti la, wotsɔ nyitsu adre kple agbo adre sa vɔe.

english_verse: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.
translation_verse: Dawid kple Lewi-vi, siwo tsɔ aɖaka la, hadzilawo kpakple agbatsɔlawo kple hadzilawo ƒe tatɔ Kenanya wodo aklaladziwui, eye Dawid ɖo aklalakɔmewu.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Israel blibo la le aseye tsom, le kpẽ kple dze kum, le gakogoe ƒom, eye wole saŋku kple kasaŋku ƒom sesĩe hetso Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la yii.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Esi Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la ɖo Dawid ƒe dua me la, Mixal, Saul vinyɔnu, do ko ɖe fesre nu kpo alesi fia Dawid le kpo tim le ɣe ɖumee; tete woɖu fewu le eŋu le eƒe dzi me.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: Esi Dawid sa numevɔ kple akpedavɔ vo la, eyra dukɔ la le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me,

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: eye wòmã abolobɔbɔ, lãkɔ kple weintsetsebolo ɖekaɖeka na Israel-viwo dome amesiame, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye Dawid ɖe amewo tso Lewi-viwo dome, ne woasubɔ le Yehowa ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ, woaɖo ŋku Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la dzi, woada akpe nɛ, eye woakafui

english_verse: Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals,
translation_verse: kple woƒe hadzinuwo, siwo nye saŋkuwo kple kasaŋkuwo; woawo nye Asaf, si nye tatɔ, eyometɔ nye Zaxarya, Yeiel, Semiramot Yexiel, Matitya, Eliab, Benaya, Obed-Edom kple Yeiel. Asaf ƒoa gakogoe sesĩe,

english_verse: and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest. David's Song of Praise (Psalms
translation_verse: eye nunɔla Benaya kple Yexaziel wotsɔa kpẽwo nɔa Mawu ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ ɖaa.

english_verse: We must never forget his agreement and his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋu eƒe nubabla, nya, si wògblɔ hena dzidzime akpewo la tegbee;

english_verse: You belong to the family of Israel, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: mi eƒe dɔla Israel ƒe dzidzimeviwo, Yakob-viwo kple mi eƒe ame tiatiawo!

english_verse: That same day, David instructed Asaph and his relatives for the first time to sing these praises to the Lord:
translation_verse: Gbemagbe enye zi gbãtɔ, esi Dawid tsɔ akpedaha, si wòadzi na Yehowa la, de asi na Asaf kple nɔviawo:

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, miyɔ eƒe ŋkɔ! Miɖe gbe ƒã eƒe nutsuwɔwɔwo le dukɔwo dome!

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Midzi ha ne, miƒo saŋku nɛ, eye miƒo nu le eƒe nukunuwo katã ŋuti!

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ƒo adegbee, amesiwo dia Yehowa la ƒe dzi nekpɔ dzidzɔ!

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power. Worship him always.
translation_verse: Mibia Yehowa kple eƒe ŋusẽ ta se, eye midi eƒe ŋku me ɖaa!

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋu eƒe nukunuwo, dzesiwo kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃, si tso eƒe nu me,

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Eya, Yehowa, enye mía Mawu; eyae drɔ̃e ʋɔnu xexeame katã.

english_verse: God made an eternal promise
translation_verse: nusi wòbla kple Abraham kple atam, si wòka na Isak,

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: hegblɔ bena: Wòe matsɔ Kanaan-nyigba ana wòanye miaƒe domenyinu, si wodzidze;

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: afisi miele ʋee le, eye miaƒe xexlẽme mede naneke nu o, kple afisi míenye amedzroe le.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Eye esi wotsa tso dukɔ gbɔ yi dukɔ gbɔ, tso fiaɖuƒe gbɔ yi dukɔ bubu gbɔ la,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: mena amea ɖeke te wò ɖe anyi o, eye woawo ta wòhe to na fiawo ɖo.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Migaka asi nye amesiaminawo ŋu o, eye migawɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke nye nyagblɔɖilawo o!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Anyigbawo katã, midzi ha na Yehowa; miɖe gbe ƒã eƒe xɔxɔ la gbawotsyogbe!

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Miƒo nu le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ŋu le dukɔwo dome kple eƒe nukunuwo ŋu le anyigbadzitɔwo katã dome.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa lolo, edze kafukafu ŋutɔ, eye vɔvɔ̃ le eŋu wu mawuwo katã.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo katã nye legbawo, ke Yehowa wo dziƒo.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Keklẽ kple atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo le egbɔ, eye ŋusẽ kple dzidzɔ le enɔƒe.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo ƒomeawo, mitsɔ bubu kple ŋusẽ na Yehowa. Yehowa ye miatsɔe na!

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple. Worship the Lord, majestic and holy.
translation_verse: Mide bubu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu, mitso nunanawo va eŋku mee, eye miɖo atsyɔ̃ kɔkɔe ade ta agu na Yehowa!

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble!” The world stands firm, never to be shaken.
translation_verse: Anyigba blibo la ƒo kpakpakpa le eŋku me; ena anyigba li ɖi sesĩe, be megaʋã o.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! And announce to the nations, “The Lord is King!”
translation_verse: Dziƒo nekpɔ dzidzɔ, anyigba netso aseye, eye woagblɔ le dukɔwo dome be: Yehowa ye nye fia!

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all of its creatures and the fields to rejoice with all of their crops.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu kple eme nuwo neɖe gbe, eye agble kple eme nuwo katã nekpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth.
translation_verse: Ekema avemetiwo atso aseye le Yehowa ŋku me, elabena egbɔna ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge anyigba!

english_verse: Praise the Lord because he is good to us, and his love never fails.
