english_verse: Then the priests and the Levites picked up the sacred chest, the sacred tent, and the objects used for worship, and they carried them to the temple.
translation_verse: eye wotsɔ aɖaka la, Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple nu kɔkɔe, siwo katã le agbadɔa me la vɛ; nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwoe tsɔ wo vɛ.

english_verse: Solomon and a crowd of people stood in front of the chest and sacrificed more sheep and cattle than could be counted.
translation_verse: Eye fia Salomo kple Israel ƒe ameha blibo, si kpe ta ɖe egbɔ la, tsi tre ɖe aɖaka la ŋgɔ, eye wotsɔ alẽwo kple nyiwo, siwo womete ŋu xlẽ alo bu wo o la, sa vɔe.

english_verse: The priests carried the chest into the most holy place and put it under the winged creatures,
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo kɔ Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka la ɖada ɖe eteƒe le Kerubiwo ƒe aʋalawo te le xɔ la ƒe megbexɔ, si nye kɔkɔeawo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la me.

english_verse: The poles were so long that they could be seen from just outside the most holy place, but not from anywhere else. And they stayed there from then on.
translation_verse: Kpoawo didi, ale be wokpɔa kpoawo nu le megbexɔ la nu tso kɔkɔeƒe la, ke womekpɔa wo tso gota o, eye wotsi afima vaseɖe egbe.

english_verse: The only things kept in the chest were the two flat stones Moses had put there when the Lord made his agreement with the people of Israel at Mount Sinai, after bringing them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Naneke mele aɖaka la me o, negbe kpe eve, siwo Mose tsɔ de eme le Xoreb-to la gbɔ, esime Yehowa bla nu kple Israel-viwo, le esime woʋu tso Egipte la koe.

english_verse: The Lord's glory was in that cloud, and the light from it was so bright that the priests could not stay inside to do their work.
translation_verse: eye nunɔlawo mete ŋu nɔ te, be woasusɔ o, le alilikpoawo ta, elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ Mawu ƒe xɔ la.

english_verse: Now I've built a glorious temple where you can live forever.” Solomon Speaks to the People (
translation_verse: ke metu xɔ na wò, be nanɔ eme kple teƒe, si nanɔ tegbee.

english_verse: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, mawua ɖeke mede nuwò le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi o, èléa nubabla kple amenuveve me ɖe asi na wò dɔla, siwo zɔna le ŋkuwò me kple dzi blibo.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you, and so whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.
translation_verse: Eye ɖo to koko, si wò dɔla kple wò dukɔ Israel aƒo le teƒe sia, eye nasee le nowòƒe le dziƒo; ne èsee la, ekema tsɔe ke!

english_verse: Solomon turned toward the people standing there. Then he blessed them
translation_verse: Tete fia la trɔ kɔ heyra Israel ƒe ameha blibo la, esime wole tsitrenu.

english_verse: When my father wanted to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Eye fofonye Dawid ɖoe ɖe ta me be, yeatu xa na Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: But you're not the one to do it. Your son will build the temple to honor me.”
translation_verse: Gake wòa matu xɔ la o, ke boŋ viwò, si ado tso wò ali me la, eya atu xɔ na nye ŋkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has done what he promised. I am now the king of Israel, and I've built a temple for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔ eƒe nya, si wògblɔ la dzi, eye medo ɖe fofonye Dawid teƒe hebɔbɔ nɔ Israel-fiazikpui la dzi, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ ene, eye metu xɔ na Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ,

english_verse: Suppose someone accuses a person of a crime, and the accused has to stand in front of the altar in your temple and say, “I swear I am innocent!”
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖeehavi ŋu, eye wòbia atam tso esi, be wòaka, eye wòva ka atam la le wò vɔsamlekpui ŋgɔ le aƒewò me la,

english_verse: Earlier, Solomon had a bronze platform made that was about two meters square and over a meter high, and he put it in the center of the outer courtyard near the altar. Solomon stood on the platform facing the altar with everyone standing behind him. Then he lifted his arms toward heaven; he knelt down
translation_verse: Elabena Salomo tsɔ akɔbli wɔ kɔkɔƒea ɖee heda ɖe xɔxɔnu la titina; edidi abɔklugui atɔ̃, keke abɔklugui atɔ̃, eye wòkɔ abɔklugui atɔ̃; eya dzi wòtsi tre ɖo hedze klo le Israel-ha blibo la ŋku me, eye wòke eƒe abɔwo ɖo ɖe dziƒo

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Wò amesi lé nya, si negblɔ na fofonye Dawid la me ɖe asi; ègblɔe kple wò nu, eye netsɔ wò asi wɔ edzi, abe alesi wòle egbe siawo ene.

english_verse: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, nɔ nya, si nègblɔ na wò dɔla Dawid la dzi.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: Elabena nyateƒee Mawu anɔ amegbetɔwo gbɔ le anyigba dzia? Kpɔ ɖa, dziƒowo kple dziƒowo ƒe dziƒowo melolo na wò o, ʋuu keke xɔ sia, si metu o!

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: Ne wò ŋkuwo nana ʋuʋu ɖe xɔ sia ŋu zã kple keli ɖe teƒe, si ŋu nègblɔ le be, yeatsɔ yeƒe ŋkɔ aɖo la ŋu, eye nase gbe, si wò dɔla ado ɖa le teƒe sia.

english_verse: Listen from heaven and decide who is right. Then punish the guilty person and let the innocent one go free.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le dziƒo, eye nadrɔ̃e na wò dɔlawo ahabu fɔ vodala, eye nana eƒe nuwɔwɔ nava eƒe ta dzi; ke natso afia na nya dzɔdzɔe tɔ, eye nawɔ nɛ le eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye nu!

english_verse: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness,
translation_verse: Ne futɔwo si wò dukɔ Israel, le esi wowɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò ta, eye wòtrɔ ɖe ŋuwò heʋu wò ŋkɔ me, wodo gbe ɖa heƒo koko na wò le aƒe sia me la,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le dziƒo, eye natsɔ wò dukɔ Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake wo, eye nagakplɔ wo ava anyigba, si nètsɔ na wo kple wo fofowo la dzi!

english_verse: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they stop sinning and turn toward this temple to pray in your name,
translation_verse: Ne dziƒo nu xe, eye tsi megale dzadzam o, le esi wowɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò ta, eye wodo gbe ɖa le teƒe sia heʋu wo ŋkɔ me, eye woɖe asi te woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋu, le esi nebɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi ta la,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And send rain on the land you promised them forever.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le dziƒo, eye natsɔ wò dɔlawo kple wò dukɔ Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake wo, eye nafia mɔ nyui, si dzi woazɔ la wo, eye nana tsi nadza ɖe wo anyigba, si nètsɔ na wo dukɔ wònye woƒe domenyinu la dzi!

english_verse: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ne dɔwuame va anyigba dzi, eɖanye dɔvɔ̃ alo bliwo dze heteku o, nukuwo hlɔ̃ alo ʋetsuviwo kple ŋɔwo va o, ne woƒe futɔwo xaxa wo ɖe woƒe duwo me le anyigba dzi, eɖanye luɖenamea ɖe alo dɔlélea ɖe o,

english_verse: Please listen when anyone in Israel truly feels sorry and sincerely prays with arms lifted toward your temple.
translation_verse: eye amea ɖe alo Israel-dukɔ blibo la dze si eƒe fuɖename kple veve la, eye wòke eƒe abɔwo me ɖo ɖe xɔ sia dzi la,

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to what they do and what is in their hearts.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le nɔwòƒe le dziƒo, eye natsɔe ake, eye naɖo eteƒe na amesiame le eƒe zɔzɔmewo katã nu, abe alesi nènya eƒe dzii ene, elabena wò ɖeka koe nya amegbetɔviwo ƒe dzi,

english_verse: Then your people will worship you and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: ne woavɔ̃ wò, eye woazɔ wò mɔwo dzi ŋkeke, siwo katã wole agbe le anyigba, si nètsɔ na mía fofowo la dzi.

english_verse: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple,
translation_verse: Ne du bubu me ta hã, amesi metso wò dukɔ Israel dome o, ke boŋ anyigba didia ɖe dzi wòtso va le wò ŋkɔ gã, wò asi sesẽ kple wò abɔ, si nedo de dzi ta, eye wòva do gbe ɖa le aƒe sia me la,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and answer their prayers. Then everyone on earth will worship you, just as your own people Israel do, and they will know that I have built this temple in your honor.
translation_verse: ekema nasee le nɔwòƒe le dziƒo, eye nawɔ nusiwo katã ŋuti du bubu me to la le yɔwòm ɖo la, ne anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã nadze si wò ŋkɔ, eye woavɔ̃ wò abe wò dukɔ Israel ene, eye wòadze sii bena, wò ŋkɔ woyɔ ɖe xɔ sia, si metu la ŋu!

english_verse: Sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: Ne wò dukɔ ho aʋa de woƒe futɔwo ŋu le mɔ, si dzi nèdɔ wo ɖo, eye woado gbe ɖa na wò aɖo ɖe du sia, si nètia, kple xɔ, si metu na wò ŋkɔ dzi la,

english_verse: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.
translation_verse: ekema nase woƒe gbedodoɖa kple kokoƒoƒo le dziƒo, eye natso na wo.

english_verse: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.
translation_verse: Ne wowɔ nuvɔ̃ de ŋuwò, — elabena amegbetɔa ɖeke megbea nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ o — eye nedo dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu hetsɔ wo de asi na lu towo, eye woɖe aboyo wo yi woƒe anyigba dzi, eɖanye kpuiƒe alo didiƒe o,

english_verse: Come to your new home, where we have already placed the sacred chest, which is the symbol of your strength. I pray that when the priests announce your power to save people, those who are faithful to you will celebrate what you've done for them.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa Mawu, mia kple wò ŋusẽ ƒe aɖaka la mitso, ne miayi ɖe wò gbɔɖemeƒe la! Yehowa Mawu, wò nunɔlawo nado xɔxɔ, eye wò ame dzɔdzɔewo nakpɔ dzidzɔ le nu nyuiwo ŋu!

english_verse: Always remember the love you had for your servant David, so that you will not reject your chosen kings.
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu, megagbe wò amesiamina la ƒe ŋku me o, eye nado ŋku wò dɔla Dawid ƒe amenuveve la dzi!

english_verse: When the crowd of people saw the fire and the Lord's glory, they knelt down and worshiped the Lord. They prayed: “The Lord is good, and his love never ends.”
translation_verse: Israel-viwo katã kpɔ, alesi dzo la ɖi ɖe anyi kple Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le xɔ la dzi, tete wobɔbɔ hede ta agu de kpenyigba la dzi, eye wodo gbe ɖa heda akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Then they will answer, “It was because the people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.”
translation_verse: Eye woaɖo ŋu be: Esi wogblẽ Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu, si kplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ɖi, eye woku ɖe mawu bubuwo ŋu, wode ta agu na wo, eye wosubɔ wo la, eyata wòhe dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo katã va wo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: Everybody stood up during the ceremony. The priests were in their assigned places, blowing their trumpets. And the Levites faced them, playing the musical instruments that David had made for them to use when they praised the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo tsi tre ɖe wo nɔƒe, eye Lewi-viwo lé Yehowa ƒe hadzinu, siwo fia Dawid na wowɔ la, ɖe asi, ne woatsɔ Dawid ƒe kafukafuha ada akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee; nunɔlawo tsi tre ɖe wo kasa le kpẽwo kum, eye Israel blibo la le tsitrenu.

english_verse: If my own people will humbly pray and turn back to me and stop sinning, then I will answer them from heaven. I will forgive them and make their land fertile once again.
translation_verse: eye nye dukɔ, si ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo la, bɔbɔ eɖokui, wodo gbe ɖa, eye wodi nye ŋku me, eye woɖe asi le woƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo ŋu la, ekema masee le dziƒo, eye matsɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake wo, eye mayɔ dɔ woƒe anyigba la.

english_verse: Then on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon sent everyone home. They left very happy because of all the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon, and for his people Israel. The Lord Appears to Solomon Again (
translation_verse: Le dzinu adrelia ƒe ŋkeke blave vɔ etɔ̃lia dzi la edo mɔ dukɔ la woyi woƒe agbadɔwo me kple dzidzɔ, eye woƒe dzi dze eme le nu nyui, si Yehowa wo na Dawid kple Salomo kpakple eƒe dukɔ Israel la ŋuti. Mawu ɖe eɖokui fia zi evelia.

english_verse: The Lord's temple and Solomon's palace were now finished. In fact, everything Solomon had planned to do was completed.
translation_verse: Esi Salomo wu Yehowa ƒe xɔ kple fia ƒe xɔ nu vɔ la, — nusianu, si Salomo ɖo ɖe ta me le Yehowa ƒe aƒe kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe ŋu la, ewɔe dedie —

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream and said: I heard your prayer, and I have chosen this temple as the place where sacrifices will be offered to me.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe eɖokui fia Salomo le zã me gblɔ nɛ bena: Mese wò gbedodoɖa, eye metia teƒe sia wo nye vosaƒe.

english_verse: Suppose I hold back the rain or send locusts to eat the crops or make my people suffer with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ne mexe dziƒo nu, eye tsi megale dzadzam o, ne medo ʋetsuviwo ɖa, be woaɖu anyigba la, ne meɖo dɔvɔ̃ ɖe nye dukɔ la dome,

english_verse: because it belongs to me, and this is where I will be worshiped forever. I will never stop watching over it.
translation_verse: Azɔ metia xɔ sia, eye mekɔ eŋu be, nye ŋkɔ nanɔ afima tegbee, eye nye ŋku kple nye dzi nanɔ afima ɣeawokatãɣi.

english_verse: Your father David obeyed me, and now, Solomon, you must do the same. Obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Ne èzɔ le ŋkunye me, abe alesi fofowò Dawid zɔ ene, eye nèwɔ nusiwo katã ŋuti mede se na wò le la dzi, eye nèlé nye ɖoɖowo kple nye kɔnuwo me ɖe asi la,

english_verse: and I will keep my solemn promise to him that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: ekema mana wò fiaɖuɖu ƒe fiazikpui nali ke, abe alesi medo ŋugbe na fofowò Dawid gblɔ ene be: Wò amesiwo aɖu fia ɖe Israel dzi la nu matso o!

english_verse: But if you or any of the people of Israel disobey my laws or start worshiping foreign gods,
translation_verse: Ke ne mietrɔ, eye mieɖe asi le nye ɖoɖo kple nye se, siwo mede asi na mi la ŋu, eye mieyi ɖasubɔ mawu bubuwo hede ta agu na wo la,

english_verse: I will pull you out of this land I gave you. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped, so that people everywhere will think it is only a joke and will make fun of it.
translation_verse: ekema mate wo ɖa le nye anyigba, si metsɔ na wo la dzi, eye maɖe xɔ sia, si ŋu mekɔ hena nye ŋkɔ la ɖa le ŋkunye me, eye mawɔe wòanye hamelo kple alɔmeɖenu le dukɔwo katã dome.

english_verse: This temple is now magnificent. But when these things happen, everyone who walks by it will be shocked and will ask, “Why did the Lord do such a terrible thing to his people and to this temple?”
translation_verse: Eye ne amesiame va to xɔ sia, si ŋkɔ nyɔ tsã la ŋuti yina la, eƒe nu aku, eye woabia bena: Nukata Yehowa wo anyigba sia kple xɔ sia ɖo alea?

english_verse: After that, Solomon had his workers rebuild the towns that Hiram had given him. Then Solomon sent Israelites to live in those towns.
translation_verse: Salomo gbugbɔ du, siwo Xuram tsɔ nɛ la tso, eye wòna Israel-viwo nɔ afima.

english_verse: Solomon attacked and captured the town of Hamath-Zobah.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo ho yi ɖaxɔ Xamat-Zoba.

english_verse: He ordered his workers to build the town of Tadmor in the desert and some towns in Hamath where he could keep his supplies.
translation_verse: Eye wòtso Tadmor le gbe dzi kple nudzraɖoƒedu, siwo katã wòtso ɖe Xamat.

english_verse: He strengthened Upper Beth-Horon and Lower Beth-Horon by adding walls and gates that could be locked.
translation_verse: Etso Dzigbe-Bet-Xoron kple Anyigbe-Bet-Xo-ron wonye du sesẽwo, siwo ŋu woɖo gli ɖo, eye agbo kple gameti le wo nu.

english_verse: He did the same thing to the town of Baalath and to the cities where he kept supplies, chariots, and horses. Solomon ordered his workers to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere else in his kingdom.
translation_verse: Etso Baalat kple nudzraɖoƒedu, siwo katã Salomo tso, kpakple tasiaɖamwo kple sɔdolawo ƒe duwo katã hekpe ɖe xɔ, siwo katã Salomo ɖi be, yeatu ɖe Yerusalem, Libanon kple eƒe fiaɖuƒe ƒe anyigba bliboa dzi la ŋuti.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the part of Jerusalem called David's City to her new palace that Solomon had built. The sacred chest had been kept in David's City, which made his palace sacred, and so Solomon's wife could no longer live there.
translation_verse: Ke Salomo kplɔ Farao vinyɔnu la tso Dawid ƒe du la me yi xɔ, si wòtu nɛ la me, elabena egblɔ be: Srɔ̃nyea ɖeke manɔ Israel-fia Dawid ƒe me o, elabena kɔkɔeƒe wònye, le esi Yehowa ƒe aɖaka la va afima ta. Ɖoɖo henɔ mawusubɔsubɔ.

english_verse: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi Salomo sa numevɔ na Yehowa le Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui, si woɖi ɖe akpala la ŋgɔ la dzi,

english_verse: He followed the requirements that Moses had given for sacrifices offered on the Sabbath, on the first day of each month, the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: eye wosa vɔ le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke ƒe kɔa nu, le dzudzɔgbewo, dzinu yeyewo kple ŋkekenyuiewo dzi, zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me, le abolo maʋamaʋã ŋkekenyuiewo, le kwasiɖawo ŋkekenyuiewo kple agbadɔŋkekenyuiewo dzi le Mose ƒe se la nu.

english_verse: Solomon then assigned the priests and the Levites their duties at the temple, and he followed the instructions that his father, the man of God, had given him. Some of the Levites were to lead music and help the priests in their duties, and others were to guard the temple gates
translation_verse: Eɖo nunɔlawo ƒe hawo woƒe subɔsubɔdɔwo nu, le fofoa Dawid ƒe ɖoɖo la nu kple Lewi-viwo woƒe dɔwo nu, ne woakafu, eye woasubɔ le nunɔlawo gbɔ, le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke ƒe kɔa nu, kple agbonudzɔlawo ƒe hawo ɖe agbo sia agbo nu, elabena alea Mawu ƒe ame Dawid de se gblɔ.

english_verse: Everything Solomon had planned to do was now finished—from the laying of the temple's foundation to its completion.
translation_verse: Ale wowɔ Salomo ƒe dɔ blibo lae tso gbesigbe woɖo Yehowa ƒe xɔ la gɔme anyi, vaseɖe esime wowu enu; wowɔ Yehowa ƒe xɔ la ɖe mii keŋkeŋ. Ʋuɖoɖo.

english_verse: Solomon went to Ezion-Geber and Eloth, two Edomite towns on the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi Salomo ho yi Ezyon-Geber kple Elot, le ƒu nu le Edom-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Hiram sent him ships and some of his experienced sailors. They went with Solomon's own sailors to the country of Ophir and brought back more than
translation_verse: Eye Xuram tsɔ ʋuwo ɖe eƒe dɔlawo si ɖo ɖee hekpe ɖe ƒu ŋu dɔwɔlawo ŋu, eye woawo kple Salomo ƒe dɔlawo yi Ofir ɖatsɔ sika talento alafa ene blaatɔ̃ tso afima vɛ na fia Salomo.

english_verse: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo ɖo eƒe biabiawo katã ŋu nɛ, biabiaa ɖeke meli, si Salomo do kpo eŋuɖoɖo nɛ o.

english_verse: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na fia la bena: Nyateƒee nye nya, si mese le nye anyigba dzi le wò nuwo kple wò nunya ŋuti;

english_verse: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are greater than I was told.
translation_verse: ke nyemexɔ woƒe nyawo dzi se o, vaseɖe esime meva kpɔe kple nye ŋkuwo, eye kpɔ ɖa, womegblɔ wò nunya gã la ƒe afã gɔ̃ hã nam o; èƒo nya, siwo mese la ta.

english_verse: Your people and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.
translation_verse: Woayra wò amewo, woayra wò dɔla, siwo nɔa tsitre ɖe ŋkuwò me ɖaa, eye wosea wò nunya la.

english_verse: I praise the Lord your God. He is pleased with you and has made you king of Israel. God loves the people of this country and will never desert them, so he has given them a king who will rule fairly and honestly.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, wò Mawu, amesi ŋu wò nu nyo, be wotsɔ wò ɖo eƒe fiazikpui dzi nènye fia na Yehowa, wò Mawu la. Esi Mawu lɔ̃ Israel, eye wòna nɔƒee tegbee la, eyata wòtsɔ wò ɖo fiae ɖe wo nu, ne nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu, eye nawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, a large amount of jewels, and the best spices anyone had ever seen.
translation_verse: Eye wòna sika talento alafa ɖeka blave kple atike ʋeʋẽe geɖe ŋutɔ kpakple kpe xɔasi wo fia la; womegatsɔ atike ʋeʋẽe vɛ wòɖe esi Seba-fianyɔnu la na fia Salomo la nu kpɔ o.

english_verse: not counting what the merchants and traders brought him. The kings of Arabia and the leaders of Israel also gave him gold and silver.
translation_verse: ke womebu esiwo nudzralawo kple asitsalawo hena vɛ la, de eme o. Arabia-fiawo katã kple anyigba dzikpɔlawo hã hea sika kple klosalo vanɛ na Salomo.

english_verse: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the records of Nathan the prophet, Ahijah the prophet from Shiloh, and Iddo the prophet who wrote about Jeroboam son of Nebat.
translation_verse: Salomo ŋutinya susɔeawo, tsãtɔwo kple megbetɔwo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe nyagblɔɖila Natan ŋutinya kple Silotɔ Axiya ƒe nyagblɔɖiwo kpakple nukpɔla Yedo ƒe nya, siwo wògblɔ ɖe Yerobeam, Nebat vi ŋu la me.

english_verse: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.
translation_verse: Fia la tsɔ nyiɖu wɔ fiazikpui gãa ɖe hã, eye wòfa sika nyuitɔ ɖo eŋu.

english_verse: It had a gold footstool attached to it and armrests on each side. There was a statue of a lion on each side of the throne,
translation_verse: Atrakpuifɔflɔ ade le fiazikpui la ŋu, eye wòtsɔ sika wɔ afɔdodzimagoevi ɖe fiazikpui la ŋu; alɔ eve le anyinɔƒe la ƒe axawo kple eve dzi, eye dzata eve le tsitre ɖe alɔawo ƒe axawo dzi.

english_verse: and there were two lion statues on each of the six steps leading up to the throne. No other throne in the world was like Solomon's.
translation_verse: Dzata wuieve le tsitre ɖe atrakpuifɔflɔ adeawo ƒe axawo kple eve dzi le afi kple afi; womewɔ esia tɔgbe le fiaɖuƒea ɖeke me kpɔ o.

english_verse: Solomon's cups and dishes in Forest Hall were made of pure gold, because silver was almost worthless in those days.
translation_verse: Fia Salomo ƒe nunonuwo katã nye sika, eye Libanon-avexɔ ƒe nuwo katã nye sika nyuitɔ. Le Salomo ŋɔli la womebu klosalo ɖe nemi me hã o.

english_verse: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.
translation_verse: Elabena ʋu, siwo dea Tarsis, siwo me Xuram ƒe dɔlawo le la, le fia la si. Ʋuawo gbɔna tso Tarsis ƒe etɔ zi ɖeka, eye wohea klosalo kple sika, nyiɖu, kesewo kple atsaxewo vanɛ.

english_verse: Solomon was the richest and wisest king in the world.
translation_verse: Ale fia Salomo ɖo kpo ɖe anyigba dzi fiawo katã dzi le kesinɔnu kple nunya gome.

english_verse: Year after year, other kings came to hear the wisdom God had given him. And they brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
translation_verse: Wo dome ɖesiaɖe hea nunanawo vanɛ nɛ ƒeawo tsyo ƒe, siwo nye klosalonuwo kple sikanuwo, awuwo kple aʋawɔnuwo, atike ʋeʋẽe, sɔwo kple tedzisɔwo.

english_verse: He ruled all the nations from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of Philistia in the south, as far as the border of Egypt.
translation_verse: Eɖu fia ɖe fiawo katã dzi tso tɔsisi la nu vaseɖe Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi kple Egipte-liƒowo ŋu.

english_verse: While Solomon was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as the sycamore trees in the western foothills.
translation_verse: Eye fia la na klosalo sɔ gbɔ abe kpewo ene le Yerusalem, eye sedertiwo sɔ gbɔ abe gboti, siwo le tagba ene.

english_verse: Solomon's horses were brought in from other countries, including Musri. Solomon Dies (
translation_verse: Eye woɖakplɔa sɔwo tsoa Egipte kple anyigbawo katã dzi vanɛ na Salomo. Salomo ku

english_verse: he died and was buried in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.
translation_verse: Eye Salomo mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe fofoa Dawid ƒe du la me, eye via Rexabeam zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to Shechem where everyone was waiting to crown him king.
translation_verse: Eye Rexabeam yi Sixem, elabena Israel blibo la va Sixem, be woatsɔe aɖo fiae.

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard what was happening, and he returned from Egypt, where he had gone to hide from Solomon.
translation_verse: Esime Yerobeam, Nebat vi la, see la, — elabena ele Egipte, afisi wòsi le fia Salomo nu yi — Yerobeam trɔ gbɔ tso Egipte.

english_verse: The people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said,
translation_verse: Eye wodɔ ame wòɖayɔe vɛ. Tete Yerobeam kple Israel blibo la va, eye woƒo nu kple Rexabeam bena:

english_verse: “Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard. But if you make our work easier, we will serve you and do whatever you ask.”
translation_verse: Fofowò na míaƒe kɔkuti la kpe, eyata ka fofowò ƒe dɔ sesẽ kple eƒe kɔkuti kpekpe, si wòɖo mía dzi la, dzi ɖe na mi, ekema miasubɔ wò.

english_verse: Rehoboam replied, “Come back in three days for my answer.” So the people left.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu na wo bena: Miva gbɔnye le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe! Eye dukɔ la dzo.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, “What should I tell these people?”
translation_verse: Tete fía Rexabeam de adaŋu kple ame tsitsi, siwo nɔ fofoa Salomo ŋu le eƒe agbenɔɣi, gblɔ bena: Adaŋu ka miaɖo, be woatsɔ aɖo ŋu na dukɔ sia?

english_verse: They answered, “If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should be kind and promise to make their work easier.”
translation_verse: Woɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Ne ekɔ dɔme ɖe dukɔ sia ŋu egbea, nèwɔ wo nyuie, eye neƒo nu kpli wo nyuie la, ekema woasubɔ wò ɖaa.

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Ke egbe ame tsitsiawo ƒe adaŋu, si woɖo nɛ la, eye wòɖade adaŋu kple ɖekakpui, siwo nye ehatiwo, eye wonɔa eŋu la,

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: gblɔ na wo bena: Aɖaŋu ka miaɖo, ne miatsɔ aɖo ŋu na dukɔ, si va gblɔ nam bena: Ka kɔkuti, si fofowò ɖo mía dzi la dzi ɖe na mi?

english_verse: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: Fofonye tsɔ kɔkuti kpekpe ɖo mia dzi, ke nye la mana miaƒe kɔkuti la nakpe ɖe edzi na mi: fofonye ƒo mi kple atam, ke nye la maƒo mi kple dziɖegbe!

english_verse: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors. He spoke bluntly
translation_verse: Eye fia la he nya sesẽ kpli wo. Fia Rexabeam gbe ame tsitsiawo ƒe aɖaŋu,

english_verse: and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested. He said: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: eye wòƒo nu kpli wo le ɖekakpuiawo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nu bena: Fofonye na miaƒe kɔkuti kpe, ke nye la mana woakpe ɖe edzi na mi; fofonye ƒo mi kple atam, ke nye la maƒo mi kple dziɖegbe!

english_verse: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and regain control of the whole country. So he called together
translation_verse: Esi Rexabeam va Yerusalem la, eƒo Yuda kple Benyamin ƒe aƒe la nu ƒu, wole aʋawɔla tiatia akpe alafa ɖeka kple blanyi, ne woaɖawo aʋa kple Israel, eye woagbugbɔ fiaɖuƒe la na Rexabeam.

english_verse: as well as with shields and spears. He used these fortified cities to keep control of Judah and Benjamin. The Priests and the Levites Support Rehoboam
translation_verse: eda akpoxɔnuwo kple akplɔwo ɖe du sia du me, eye wòna wòzu du sesẽ ŋutɔwo. Yuda kple Benyamin nye etɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Lord had told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va Mawu ƒe ame Semaya gbɔ bena:

english_verse: to tell Rehoboam and everyone from Judah and Benjamin,
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Yuda-fia Rexabeam, Salomo vi, kple Israel blibo, si nye Yuda kple Benyamin bena:

english_verse: “The Lord warns you not to go to war against the people from the northern tribes—they are your relatives. Go home! The Lord is the one who made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord's message and did not attack Jeroboam and his troops. Rehoboam Fortifies Cities in Judah
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Migaho yi ɖawɔ aʋa kple mia nɔviwò o, mia dome amesiame negbugbɔ yi eƒe me, elabena gbɔnye nya sia tso! Tete woɖo to Yehowa ƒe gbe hegbugbɔ, eye wodzudzɔ aʋahoho ɖe Yerobeam ŋu. Rexabeam le mɔ̃wo.

english_verse: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
translation_verse: Etso Betlexem, Etam, Tekoa,

english_verse: Beth-Zur, Soco, Adullam,
translation_verse: Bet-Zur, Soxo, Adulam,

english_verse: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
translation_verse: Gat, Maresa, Zif,

english_verse: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
translation_verse: Adorayim, Laxis, Azeka,

english_verse: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. After he had fortified these cities in the territories of Judah and Benjamin,
translation_verse: Zora, Ayalon kple Xebron, siwo le Yuda kple Benyamin, wòzu du sesẽwo.

english_verse: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine,
translation_verse: Ewɔ mɔ siawo sesĩe, eɖe aʋafiawo ɖo wo me, eye wòdzra nuɖuɖu, ami kple wein ɖo ɖe wo me;

english_verse: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo, siwo le Israel bliboa la, tso woƒe anyigbawo katã dzi va egbɔ;

english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: elabena Lewi-viwo gblẽ woƒe duwo kple woƒe anyigbawo ɖi heʋu va Yuda kple Yerusalem, elabena Yerobeam kple viawo nyã wo, be womaganye nunɔlawo na Yehowa o.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo ƒe dzi le Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, dim la, tso Israel-toawo katã me dze wo yome va Yerusalem, ne woasa vo na Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Woawoe ti ke Yuda-fiaɖuƒe la, eye wodo ŋusẽ Rexabeam, Salomo vi la, ƒe etɔ̃; elabena woto Dawid kple Salomo ƒe ʋe me ƒe etɔ̃. Rexabeam srɔ̃wo kpakple viwo.

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: eya dzi ŋutsuviwo nɛ, siwo nye: Yeus, Semarya kple Zaham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: Eyome wòde Absalom vinyɔnu Maaxa; eya dzi Abiya, Atai, Ziza kple Selomit nɛ.

english_verse: so he chose their oldest son Abijah to be the next king.
translation_verse: Eye Rexabeam tsɔ Abiya, Maaxa vi, ɖo tame le nɔviawo dome, elabena edi be, yeatsɔe aɖo fiae.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: Eye wòdze aɖaŋu hemã viawo katã ɖe du sesẽawo katã me le Yuda kple Benyamin ƒe anyigbawo katã dzi, ena nuɖuɖu wo kpaŋkpaŋ, eye, wòɖe srɔ̃ geɖe na wo.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ nusi nye vɔ̃, elabena metsɔ eƒe dzi ɖo Yehowa didi ŋu o.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me le fia Rexabeam ƒe ƒe atɔ̃lia me be, Egipte-fia Sisak ho ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, le esi womeɖi anukware na Yehowa o ta;

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Eye nyagblɔɖila Semaya va Rexabeam kple Yuda-amegã, siwo si le Sisak nu va Yerusalem la gbɔ gblɔ na wo bena; Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi miegblẽm ɖi la, eyata nye hã metsɔ mi de asi na Sisak.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Tete Israel-amegãwo kple fia la wobɔbɔ wo ɖokui gblɔ bena: Yehowa tɔ dzo!

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Eye esi Yehowa kpɔ be, wobɔbɔ wo ɖokui la, Yehowa ƒe gbe va Semaya gbɔ gblɔ bena: Wobɔbɔ wo ɖokui, eyata nyemagblẽ wo o, ke boŋ maxɔ na wo vie, eye nye dɔmedzoe mato Sisak dzi ava Yerusalem dzi o;

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: gake woasubɔe, ne wòadze si, alesi nye subɔsubɔ kple anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo ƒe subɔsubɔ le.

english_verse: Shishak attacked Jerusalem and took all the valuable things from the temple and from the palace, including Solomon's gold shields.
translation_verse: Tete Egipte-fia Sisak ho ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eye wòlɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe me, kesinɔnuwo kple fia ƒe aƒe me kesinɔnuwo; nuawo katã wòlɔ hekpe ɖe sikakpoxɔnu, siwo Salomo wɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Eye fia Rexabeam wɔ akɔblikpoxɔnuwo ɖe wo teƒe, eye wòtsɔ wode fia ŋu asrafo, siwo dzɔa fia ƒe aƒe mɔnu la ƒe amegãwo si.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Ne fia la yina ɖe Yehowa ƒe me godoo la, fia ŋu asrafoawo tsoa wo, eye wogagbugbɔa wo va dana ɖe fia ŋu asrafoawo ƒe xa me.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Esi wòbɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi la, eyata Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe nu fa ɖe eŋu, eye metsrɔ̃e keŋkeŋ o. Nyuiwɔwɔ nu metso le Yuda keŋ o.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Rexabeam ŋutinyawo, tsãtɔwo kple megbetɔwo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe nyagblɔɖila Semaya kple nukpɔla Ido ŋutinyawo me. Eye aʋa nɔ Rexabeam kple Yerobeam dome ŋkekeawo katã.

english_verse: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.
translation_verse: Eye Rexabeam mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe Dawid ƒe du la me, eye via Abiya zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Abiya zu fia ɖe Yuda dzi le Yerobeam ƒe ƒe wuienyilia me.

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: eye Yuda-ŋutsuwo le aʋaɣli dom. Esi Yuda-ŋutsuwo le aʋaɣli dom; la, Mawu si Yerobeam kple Israel blibo la le Abiya kple Yuda ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: Azɔ miele susum be, yewoate ŋu anɔ te ɖe Yehowa ƒe fiaɖuƒe, si le Dawid viwo si me la nu, le esi miesɔ gbɔ fũ, eye sikanyivi, siwo Yerobeam tsa wo mawuwo na mi la, le mia gbɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: Eɖu fia le Yerusalem ƒe etɔ̃, eye dadaa ŋkɔ nye Mixaya, Uriel vinyɔnu, tso Gibea. Eye aʋa na Abiya kple Yerobeam dome.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Eye Abiya tsi tre ɖe Zemarayim-to dzi le Efrayim-towo dome gblɔ bena: Yerobeam kple Israel blibo la, miɖo tom!

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae bena, Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, tso Israel-fiaɖuƒe la na Dawid kple viawo, ne wòanye dzenubabla tegbee oa?

english_verse: But Jeroboam, you were King Solomon's official, and you rebelled.
translation_verse: Ke Yerobeam, Nebat vi, amesi nye Dawid vi, Salomo ƒe dɔla tso, eye wòdze aglã ɖe eƒe aƒetɔ ŋu,

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: eye yakamewo kple ame ɖigbɔwo ƒo ta kplii ɖe eŋu, eye wodo dzi tsi tre ɖe Salomo vi Rexabeam ŋuti: elabena Rexabeam nye ɖevi, eye dzi mele eƒo, ne wòana te ɖe wo nu o.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye miawoe nyã Yehowa ƒe nunɔlawo, siwo nye Aron viwo kple Lewi-viwo, eye mieɖo nunɔlawo na mia ɖokui abe anyigba dzi dukɔwo ene oa? Ne amesiame nya tso nyitsuvi ɖeka kple agbo adre vɛ, be woaɖo ye la, ekema wotsɔnɛ ɖoa mawu maɖimawuwo ƒe nunɔlae.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, Yehowa enye mia Mawu, eye miegblẽe ɖi o; Aron viwo nye nunɔlawo, amesiwo subɔa Yehowa, eye Lewi-viwo le woƒe dɔwo nu;

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: woawoe tɔa dzo numevɔsa na Yehowa ŋdi sia ŋdi kple fiẽ sia fiẽ, wotsɔa atike ʋeʋẽe doa dzudzɔe, wodaa abolo ɖe kplɔ̃; dzadzɛ la dzi, eye wosia sikakaɖitiawo ƒe akaɖigbɛawo fiẽ sia fiẽ, elabena mielé Yehowa, mía Mawu ƒe ɖoɖowo meɖe asi; ke miawo miegblẽe ɖi.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu kple eƒe nunɔlawo le mía nu, eye aseyetsokpẽawo li, be woaku ɖe mia ŋu Israel-viwo, migawɔ aʋa kple Yehowa, mia fofowo ƒe Mawu la o, elabena madze edzi na mi o!

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Ke Yerobeam na xadelawo trɔ, ne woaɖadze wo dzi le megbe gome; woawo dze ŋgɔ Yuda, eye xadelawo le megbe nɛ.

english_verse: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ale wobɔbɔ Israel-viwo ɖe anyi ɣemaɣi, ke Yuda kpɔ ŋusẽ, elabena woziɔ ɖe wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la ŋu.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Abiya ti Yerobeam yome, eye wòxɔ eƒe duwo, siwo nye Betel kple eŋu duwo, Yesana kple eŋu duwo kpakple Efron kple eŋu duwo.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Eye ŋusẽa ɖeke menɔ Yerobeam; ŋu le Abiya ƒe agbenɔɣi o; eye Yehowa ƒoe woku.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Abiya ŋutinya susɔeawo, eƒe zɔzɔme kple eƒe nuƒoƒowo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe nyagblɔɖila Ido ƒe ŋutinyagbalẽ me.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Eɖe vɔsamlekpui tutowo kple nuxeƒewo ɖa, egbã aƒeliwo, eye wòlã Aserawo

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: hede se na Yuda bena, woadi Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la, eye woawo eƒe nufiamewo kple eƒe sewo dzi.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Eɖe nuxeƒewo kple ɣelegbawo ɖa le Yuda-duwo katã me, eye fiaɖuƒe la kpɔ gbɔdzɔe le ele.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Eye aʋakɔ nɔ Asa si. Amesiwo tso Yuda, eye wokpla akpoxɔnu kple akplɔ la, wole ame akpe alafa etɔ̃, eye amesiwo tso Benyamin, wokpla akpoxɔnu, eye wodaa da la, wole ame akpe alafa eve kple blanyi; amesiawo katã wonye kalẽtɔwo. Via ɖu ame yibɔwo dzi.

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: Wòsi du, siwo katã le Gerar ŋu godoo; elabena Yehowa ƒe vɔvɔ̃ dze wo dzi; eye woha duawo katã, elabena nu geɖe le wo me.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Eye Mawu ƒe gbugbɔ va Azarya, Obed vi dzi;

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: eye wòyi ɖakpe Asa gblɔ nɛ bena: Asa kple Yuda blibo la kpakple Benyamin, miɖo tom! Yehowa nɔ kpli mi, elabena miena eŋu. Ne mieɖii la, ana be, míakpɔe; ke ne miegblẽe ɖi la, eya hã agblẽ mi ɖi.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke nanewo va yi, le esiwo me Mawu vava la kple nunɔlawo, siwo nye nufialawo, kpakple sea ɖeke mena Israel si o.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Ke esi woɖo xaxa me la, wòtrɔ ɖe Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu, eye esi woɖii la, ena wokpɔe.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la ŋutifafaa ɖeke menɔ anyi na amesiwo doa go kple amesiwo gbɔna la o, elabena ŋɔdzi gãa ɖe va anyigba dzi nɔlawo katã dzi.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Dukɔ kple dukɔ kpe, eye ɖu kple du kpe, elabena Mawu tsɔ hiã vovovowo do ŋɔdzi na wo.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Ke esi Asa se nyagblɔɖila Obed ƒe nya siawo kple eƒe nyagblɔɖiawo la, dzi ɖo eƒo, eye wò ɖe ŋunyɔnuwo ɖa tso Yuda-nyigba blibo la dzi kple Benyamin kpakple du, siwo woxɔ ɖe Efrayim-to dzi la me, eɖɔ Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui, si le Yehowa ƒe akpata nu la ɖo,

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: eye wòƒo Yuda blibo la kple Benyamin kpakple amesiwo tso Efrayim, Manase kple Simeon va dze egbɔ la nu ƒu, elabena ame geɖewo tso Israel va de edzi, esime wokpɔ be, Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la, li kplii.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye wova kpe ta ɖe Yerusalem le Asa ƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe ƒe wuiatɔ̃lia me le dzinu etɔ̃lia dzi.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Eye woge ɖe nubabla me, be yewoadi Yehowa, yewo fofowo ƒe Mawu la, tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli sesĩe, eye wotso aseye, eye woku kpẽwo kple lãdzowo heka atam na Yehowa.

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: Yuda blibo la kpɔ dzidzɔ le atamkaka la ŋu, elabena wokae tso dzi blibo me. Wodii kple woƒe lɔlɔ̃nu blibo, eye wòna wokpɔe, eye Yehowa na gbɔdzɔe wo godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Eye fia Asa ɖe dadaa Maaxa hã ɖa, be magaɖu dzi o, elabena ewɔ legba na Asera. Asa mũ legba la, eye wògbãe ɖatɔ dzoe ɖe Kidron-bali la me

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: Ke womede nuxeƒewo ɖa le Israel o; gake Asa ƒe dzi nɔ blibo le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ fofoa ƒe nu kɔkɔewo kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe nu kɔkɔewo, siwo nye klosalo kple sika kpakple ŋudɔwɔnuawo, yi Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.
translation_verse: Eye aʋaa ɖeke medzɔ kpɔ o, vaseɖe Asa ƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe ƒe blaetɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃lia me.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Tete Asa tsɔ klosalo kple sika le Yehowa ƒe aƒe kple fia ƒe aƒe ƒe nudzraɖoƒe ɖo ɖe Aram-fia Ben-Hadad, amesi le Damasko bena:

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: Nubabla le mia kpli wò, fofonye kple fofowò dome: kpɔ ɖa, mele klosalo kple sika ɖom ɖe wò, be natu nubabla, si le mia kple Israel-fia Baesa dome la, ne woadzo le gbɔnye.

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Tete Ben-Hadad se fia Asa ƒe gbe, eye wòdɔ eƒe aʋafiawo ɖo ɖe Israel-duwo me, eye wòsi Yion, Dan kple Abel-Mayim kpakple Naftali ƒe nudzraɖoƒeduwo katã.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Eye esi Baesa see la, edzudzɔ Rama tsotso, eye wòtasi eƒe dɔ la.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Eye fía Asa kplɔ Yuda blibo la woɖafɔ kpe kple ati, siwo Baesa tsɔ le Rama tsomi la, eye wotsɔ wo tso Geba kple Mizpa.

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Tete nukpɔla Xanani va Yuda-fia Asa gbɔ ɣemaɣi gblɔ nɛ bena: Esi nède me Aram-fia, eye mède me Yehowa, wò Mawu o la, eyata Aram-fia ƒe aʋakɔ ge le asiwò me.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe Kusitɔwo kple Lubitɔwo menye aʋakɔ gãa ɖe hekpe ɖe tasiaɖamwo kple sɔdolawo ŋu kpaŋkpaŋ oa? Ke esi nède me Yehowa la, ɖe nyemetsɔ wo de asi na wò oa?

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋku kpɔa anyigba blibo la dzi, eye woɖoa ŋusẽ amesiwo ku ɖe eŋu kple woƒe dzi blibo. Ewɔ bometsinu; eyata tso fifi la aʋa ano dowòme.

english_verse: When Asa heard this, he was so angry that he put Hanani in prison. Asa was also cruel to some of his people. Asa Dies (
translation_verse: Tete dzi ku Asa ɖe nukpɔla la ŋu, eye wòtsɔe de gaxɔ me, elabena dɔme vee ɖe eŋu te nya la ta. Eye Asa sẽ ŋuta le dukɔ la dometɔa ɖewo ŋu ɣemaɣi. Asa ku.

english_verse: Everything Asa did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Asa ŋutinya susɔeawo, tsãtɔwo kple megbetɔwo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Yuda-fiawo kple lsrael-fiawo ƒe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Eye Asa dze da ɖe afɔ le eƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe ƒe blaetɔ̃ va asiekelia me, eye ɖɔ la do gã ɖe edzi; ke mebia gbe Yehowa se le eƒe dɔléle la me o, negbe atikewɔlawo ko.

english_verse: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.
translation_verse: Eye woɖii ɖe eƒe yɔdo, si wòɖe ɖe Dawid ƒe dua me la me; wotsɔe mlɔ aba, si dzi wotsɔ atike ʋeʋẽe vovovo, siwo atikeɖala veviwo tɔtɔ, da ɖo la dzi, eye wodo dzo gãa ɖe nɛ eteƒe mekɔ o.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king and strengthened his defenses against Israel.
translation_verse: Eye via Yosafat zu fia ɖe eteƒe, eye wòglã eɖokui ɖe Israel ŋu.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translation_verse: Eɖe asrafowo ɖo Yuda-du sesẽwo katã me, eye wòɖe amewo ɖo Yuda-nyigba dzi kple Efrayim-du, siwo fofoa Asa xɔ la me.

english_verse: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected,
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa li ke fiaɖuƒe la ɖe esi me, eye Yuda blibo la tsɔ nunanawo na Yosafat, ale be kesinɔnu kple bubu siaa su esi.

english_verse: he remained completely faithful to the Lord. He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.
translation_verse: Eye esi dzi ɖo eƒo le Yehowa ƒe mɔwo dzi la, eɖe nuxeƒewo kple Aserawo ɖa le Yuda.

english_verse: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.
translation_verse: eye Semaya, Netanya, Zebadya, Asahel, Semiramot, Yonatan, Adoniya, Tobiya kple Tob-Adoniya, amesiwo nye Lewi-viwo kpakple nunɔla Elisama kple Yoram kpe ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: They carried with them a copy of the Lord's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.
translation_verse: Wotso Yehowa ƒe segbalẽ la ɖe asi, eye wofia nu le Yuda, wotsa le Yuda-duwo katã me, eye wofia nu dukɔ la.

english_verse: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe ŋɔdzi dze anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒe, siwo katã ƒo xlã Yuda godoo la dzi, ale be womewɔ aʋaa ɖeke kple Yosafat o.

english_verse: Philistines brought him silver and other gifts to keep peace. Some of the Arab people brought him
translation_verse: Filistitɔwo dometɔa ɖewo tso nunanawo kple klosalo geɖe vɛ na Yosafat, eye Arabiatɔwo hã tsɔ agbo akpe adre kple alafa adre kpakple gbɔ̃tsu akpe adre kple alafa adre vɛ ne.

english_verse: As Jehoshaphat became more powerful, he built fortresses and cities
translation_verse: Eye Yosafat le gã zum ɖe dzi ɖaa ŋutɔ, etu mɔwo, eye wòtso nudzraɖoƒeduwo ɖe Yuda.

english_verse: where he stored supplies. He also kept in Jerusalem some experienced soldiers
translation_verse: Edzra nuɖuɖu geɖe ɖo ɖe Yuda-duwo me, eye ŋutsu aʋawɔla kalẽtɔwo le esi le Yerusalem.

english_verse: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had
translation_verse: Woƒe amesiwo wotia xlẽ la, wonye esi le woƒe aƒekɔwo nu: Ame akpewo ƒe tatɔ, siwo tso Yuda, wonye: Amegã Adna, ŋutsu kalẽtɔ akpe alafa etɔ̃ te eŋu;

english_verse: Amasiah son of Zichri, who had volunteered to serve the Lord, was third in command, with
translation_verse: eye amesi kpe ɖe eŋu, enye Amasya, Zixri vi, amesi tso eɖokui na Yehowa faa, ŋutsu kalẽto akpe alafa eve le eŋu.

english_verse: Eliada was a brave warrior who commanded the troops from Benjamin. He had
translation_verse: Esiwo tso Benyamin, wonye: Ŋutsu kalẽtɔ Elyada, ame akpe alafa eve le eŋu, amesiwo kplaa dati kple akpoxɔnu;

english_verse: These were the troops who protected the king in Jerusalem, not counting those he had assigned to the fortified cities throughout the country.
translation_verse: Amesiawoe subɔa fia la hekpe ɖe amesiwo fia la ɖo du sesẽwo me le Yuda blibo la ŋuti.

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Tete Israel-fia kple Yuda-fia Yosafat woho yi Ramot-Gilead.

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: Le ƒea ɖewo megbe la eyi Axab gbɔ le Samaria, eye Axab wu alẽwo kple nyiwo fũ na eya kple amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋu; eye woble enu yi Ramot-Gilead.

english_verse: and finally asked, “Jehoshaphat, would you go with me to attack Ramoth?” “Yes,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army is at your command.
translation_verse: Israel-fia Axab gblɔ na Yuda-fia Yosafat bena; Ayi Ramot-Gilead kplima? Eɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Mele abe wò ene, eye wò dukɔ le abe nye dukɔ ene, mayi aʋa la kpli wò!

english_verse: But first let's ask the Lord what to do.”
translation_verse: Ke Yosafat gblɔ na Israel-fia bena: Bia gbe Yehowa se gbɔ!

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Tete Yosafat gblɔ bena: De Yehowa ƒe nyagblɔɖilaa ɖeke mele afisia, ne míabia nu le egbɔ oa?

english_verse: “We could ask Micaiah son of Imlah,” Ahab said. “But I hate Micaiah. He always has bad news for me.” “Don't say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
translation_verse: Israel-fia ɖo ŋu na Yosafat bena: Ame ɖeka li, si gbɔ wobiaa gbe Yehowa le; ke melé fui, elabena metoa nya nyuia ɖeke nam le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me o, negbe vɔ̃a ko; eya nye Mixa, Yimla vi. Yosafat gblɔ bena: Fia la megana nu ƒom alea o.

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Tete Israel-fia yɔ aƒedzikpɔla ɖeka gblɔ bena: Yi ɖayɔ Mixa, Yimla vi vɛ fififi!

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-fia kple Yuda-fia Yosafat wo dome ɖesiaɖe do fiawu bɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi, eye wobɔbɔ no lugbɔƒe le Samaria-gbo nu, eye nyagblɔɖilawo katã le nya gblɔm ɖi le wo ŋku me.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Zedekya, Kenaana vi, tsɔ ga wɔ lãdzowo gblɔ bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esiawo natsɔ atu Aramtɔwo, vaseɖe esime natsrɔ̃ wo avɔ.

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Eye nyagblɔɖilawo katã gblɔ nya ɖi alea gblɔ bena: Ho yi Ramot-Gilead, eye adze edzi na wò; elabena Yehowa atsɔe ade asi na fia la.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Eye dɔla, si yi Mixa yɔ ge la, gblɔ ne bena: Kpɔ ɖa, nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe gbe sɔ, eye wogblɔ nya nyui na fia la; eyata wò nya nena abe wo dome ɖesiaɖe ta ene, eye ƒo nu nyuie!

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Tete Mixa gblɔ bena: Meta Yehowa ƒe agbe: Ne menye nya, si nye Mawu ato nam la, magblɔ o fi! Mixa gblɔ tete ɖe anyi ɖi.

english_verse: Then Micaiah went up to Ahab, who asked, “Micaiah, should we attack Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you capture the city.”
translation_verse: Esi wòva fia la gbɔ la, fia la gblɔ nɛ bena: Mixa, mího aʋa yi Ramot-Gilead loo, alo migayi oa? Eɖo ŋu be: Miho yi, adze edzi nami, eye woatsɔ wo ade asi na mi!

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Tete fia la gblɔ nɛ bena: Zi nenie maka atam na wò be, nato nyateƒe sɔŋ ko nam le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ mea?

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, ‘These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu be: Mekpe Israel blibo la woka xlẽ ɖe towo dzi abe alé, siwo kplɔlaa ɖeke mele wo nu o ene; eye Yehowa gblɔ be; Aƒetɔa ɖeke mele amesiawo nu o, wo dome amesiame negbugbɔ yi eƒe me faa!

english_verse: Ahab turned to Jehoshaphat and said, “I told you he would bring me bad news!”
translation_verse: Tete Israel-fia gblɔ na Yosafat bena: Nyemegblɔe na wò be, metoa nya nyuia ɖeke nam o, negbe vɔ̃a ko oa?

english_verse: Micaiah replied: I then saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ be: Azɔ se Yehowa ƒe gbe: Mekpɔ Yehowa wòbɔbɔ no eƒe fiazikpui dzi, eye dziƒoʋakɔ blibo la le tsitre le eƒe ɖusi kple mia me.

english_verse: The Lord asked, “Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed?” They talked about it for a while,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ bena: Ameka ayi aɖaflu Israel-fia Axab, ne wòaɖatsi aʋa le Ramot-Gilead a? Amesi be ale, ame keme be ale.

english_verse: then finally a spirit came forward and said to the Lord, “I can trick Ahab.” “How?” the Lord asked.
translation_verse: Tete gbɔgbɔa ɖe do ɖe Yehowa ŋku me gblɔ bena: Mayi aɖaflui! Yehowa gblɔ nɛ bena: Aleke nawɔe?

english_verse: “I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him.” “Good!” the Lord replied. “Now go and do it. You will be successful.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena: Mayi aɖanye aʋatsogbɔgbɔ anɔ eƒe nyagblɔɖilawo katã, ƒe nu me. Eye wògblɔ bena: Ate ŋu aflui vavã. Heyi ɖawɔ alea!

english_verse: Zedekiah walked over and slapped Micaiah on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Tete Zedekya, Kenaana vi, te va ƒo to me na Mixa gblɔ bena: Afika Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ dzo le gbɔnye yi hafi va ƒo nu kpli wò?

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “You'll find out on the day you have to hide in the back room of some house.”
translation_verse: Mixa ɖo ŋu bena: Kpɔ ɖa, àkpɔe le gbesigbe nasi atso xa me ayi xɔ me, be naɣla ɖokuiwò!

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.
translation_verse: Tete Israel-fia gblɔ bena: Milé Mixa, ne miakplɔe agbugbɔ ayi dumegã Amon kple fiavi Yoas gbɔ,

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: eye migblɔ bena: Ale fia la gblɔ esi: Mitsɔ amesia de gaxɔ me, eye mina abolo via ɖe koe wòaɖu kple tsi via ɖe koe, vaseɖe esime matrɔ agbɔ le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: Micaiah said, “If you do come back, I was wrong about what the Lord wanted me to say.” Then he told the crowd, “Don't forget what I said!” Ahab Dies at Ramoth (
translation_verse: Mixa ɖo ŋu bena: Ne ètrɔ gbɔ le ŋutifafa me la, ekema menye Yehowa ye ƒo nu to dzinye o. Eye wògblɔ bena: Mi dukɔwo katã, miele esema? Axab ƒe ku.

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-fia gblɔ na Yosafat bena: Maɖo li nye awuwo, eye mayi aʋa la nu, ke wò la wò awuwo nenɔ ŋuwò! Eye Israel-fia ɖɔ li eƒe awuwo heyi aʋa la nu.

english_verse: The king of Syria had ordered his chariot commanders to attack only Ahab.
translation_verse: Ke Aram-fia de se na eƒe tasiaɖam-amegãwo gblɔ bena: Migakpe kple ame tsɛ loo alo amegãa ɖeke o, ke boŋ mikpe kple Israel-na ɖeɖeko!

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But Jehoshaphat prayed, and the Lord made the Syrian soldiers stop.
translation_verse: Esi tasiaɖam-amegãwo kpo Yosafat la, woɖe to ɖee, be woakpe kplii, elabena wobu be, eya nye Israel-fia la. Tete Yosafat de asi aƒadodo me; eye Yehowa xɔ nɛ, eye Mawu ble wo dzoe le eŋu.

english_verse: And when they realized he wasn't Ahab, they left him alone.
translation_verse: Esi tasiaɖam-amegãwo kpɔ be, menye Israel-fia lae o la, wotrɔ dzo le eŋu.

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab between two pieces of his armor. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsua ɖe vu eƒe da me heda ɖe ya me, eye wote Israel-fia le gawua kpeƒe. Tete wògblɔ na eƒe tasiaɖamkplɔla bena: Trɔ, ne nakplɔm dzo le aʋa la nu, elabena mexɔ abi!

english_verse: The fighting lasted all day, with Ahab propped up in his chariot so he could see the Syrian troops. He stayed there until evening, and by sundown he was dead.
translation_verse: Aʋa la nu sẽ gbemagbe, eye Israel-fia tsi tre ɖe tasiaɖam la me le Aramtɔwo kasa vaseɖe fiẽ, eve woku, esime ɣe ɖo to.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke Yuda-fia Yosafat gbugbɔ yi eƒe me le Yerusalem le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: But the prophet Jehu son of Hanani met him and said: By helping that wicked Ahab, you have made friends with someone who hates the Lord. Now the Lord God is angry with you!
translation_verse: Tete nukpɔla Yehu, Xanani vi, yi ɖakpee, eye wogblɔ na fia Yosafat bena: Ame vlo ŋu nèyi ɖakpe ɖoa, eye nèlɔ amesi lé fu Yehowa a? Le esia ta Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe va dziwò ɖo.

english_verse: But not everything about you is bad. You destroyed the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah—that shows you have tried to obey the Lord. Jehoshaphat Appoints Judges To Settle Cases
translation_verse: Ke wokpɔ nyuiwɔwɔa ɖewo le ŋuwò, elabena eɖe Asera wo ɖale anyigba la dzi, eye nètso wò dzi di Mawu.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Eye Yosafat no Yerusalem; emegbe egatsa le dukɔ la dome tso Beer-Seba vaseɖe Efrayim-to dzi, eye wòtrɔ wo ɖe Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la ŋu.

english_verse: He assigned judges to each of the fortified cities in Judah
translation_verse: Eɖo ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo Yuda-du sesẽwo katã me le anyigba la dzi, du sia du kple etɔ.

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo bena: Miɖo ŋku anyi le nusi ke miewɔna la me, elabena menye amegbetɔwo miedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu na o, ke boŋ Yehowa ye, eye ele mia gbɔ le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe la.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa ƒe ŋɔdzi nelé mi, eye mikpɔ nyuie le miaƒe nuwɔwɔwo me, elabena le Yehowa, mia Mawu gbɔ la, nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔa ɖeke, amedzidedea ɖeke alo zãnuxɔxɔa ɖeke meli o!

english_verse: Jehoshaphat also chose some Levites, some priests, and some of the family leaders, and he appointed them to serve as judges in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye Yosafat ɖo Lewi-viwo kple nunɔlawo kpakple Israel ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo dometɔa ɖewo Yerusalem hã ɖe Yehowa ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo kple dzrenyawo ŋu. Esi wògbɔ va Yerusalem la,

english_verse: The people of Judah will bring you legal cases that involve every type of crime, including murder. You must settle these cases and warn the people to stop sinning against the Lord, so that he won't get angry and punish Judah. Remember, if you follow these instructions, you won't be held responsible for anything that happens.
translation_verse: Ne mia nɔvi, siwo le woƒe duwo me, he nyaa ɖe vɛ na mi, hlɔ̃nya alo nufiamewo, sewo, ɖoɖowo kple kɔnuwo ŋu nya la, ekema mixlɔ̃ nu wo, ne womagaɖi fɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye dɔmedzoe nava mia kple mia nɔviwo dzi o; alea miawɔ, ne miagaɖi fɔ o.

english_verse: Amariah the high priest will have the final say in any religious case. And Zebadiah, the leader of the Judah tribe, will have the final say in all other cases. The rest of the Levites will serve as your assistants. Be brave, and I pray that the Lord will help you do right.
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, nunɔlagã Amarya le mia nu de Yehowa ƒe nyawo katã ŋu, eye Yuda ƒe aƒe ƒe amegã Zebadya, Ismael vi, li de fia ƒe nyawo katã ŋu, eye Lewi-viwo nye dɔnunɔlawo le mia si. Misẽ ŋu le miaƒe nuwo wɔwɔ me, eye Yehowa anɔ kple ame nyui la!

english_verse: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, “A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.”
translation_verse: Eye wova gblɔna Yosafat bena: Kpɔ ɖa, ameha gãa ɖe ho ɖe ŋuwò tso Aram, tso ƒu la ƒe go keme dzi, eye kpɔ ɖa, wole Xazezon-Tamar, si nye En-Gedi.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Tete Yosafat vɔ̃, eye wotsɔ eƒe ŋku ɖo Yehowa didi ŋu, eye wòna woɖe gbe ƒã le Yuda blibo la, be woatsi nu aɖɔ.

english_verse: They immediately left for Jerusalem to ask for the Lord's help.
translation_verse: Eye Yuda va kpe ta, be woaƒo koko na Yehowa; Yuda-duwo katã me wotso, be woadi Yehowa.

english_verse: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard
translation_verse: Tete Yosafat va Yuda kple Yerusalem ƒe takpekpe la me le Yehowa ƒe me le kpɔ yeye la ŋgɔ

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Yehowa, mía fofowo ƒe Mawu, de menye wòe nye Mawu le dziƒo kple dziɖula ɖe dukɔwo ƒe fiaɖuƒewo katã dzi oa? Asiwò me ŋusẽ kple kamesesẽ le, eye amea ɖeke mate ŋu ana te ɖe nuwò o.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye wò, mía Mawue, nyã anyigba sia dzi nɔlawo ɖa le wò dukɔ Israel ŋgɔ, eye nètsɔe na xɔ̃wò Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwo tegbee oa?

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: Wotso aƒe de edzi, eye wotu kɔkɔeƒe ɖe edzi na wò ŋkɔ la gblɔ bena:

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: Ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e, yi, tohehe, dɔvɔ̃ kple dɔwuame va mia dzi, eye mieva xɔ sia ŋgɔ kple ŋkuwò me, elabena wò ŋkɔ le xɔ sia me, eye mieɖo ɣli na wò le míaƒe xaxa me la, ekema nasée, eye naɖe mí!

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: Azɔ kpɔ ɖa, Amon-viwo kple Moab-viwo kpakple amesiwo le Seir-towo dzi, amesiwo dome mèɖe mɔ na Israel, be woato, esime wotso Egipte o, ke boŋ wode axa na wo, eye wometsi wo o la,

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: Mia Mawu, madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo oa? Elabena ŋusẽa ɖeke mele mía ŋu ɖe ameha gbogbo sia, si ho ɖe mía ŋu la ŋuti o. Mienya nuka wɔ ge míala o, negbe ŋuwò ko míaƒe ŋku le.

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Eye Yuda blibo la tsi tre ɖe Yehowa ŋku me, keke woƒe vidzĩewo, wo srɔ̃wo kple woƒe viŋutsuwo ke hã le eme.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ bena: Miƒu to anyi, mi Yuda blibo la kple Yerusalem-nɔlawo kpakple wò fia Yosafat! Ale Yehowa le gbɔgblɔm na mi enye si: Migavɔ̃ o, eye ameha gã sia megadzi ŋɔ na mi o, elabena aʋa la menye miaƒe nya o, ke boŋ Mawu tɔe.

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Etsɔ la miho ɖe wo ŋu, kpɔ ɖa, woava Haziz-to dzi mɔ dzi, eye miaƒo go wo le bali la nu le Yeruel-gbegbe ŋgɔ.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Miele asi ɖe ge aʋa la me o, ke boŋ mitsi tre ɖi, ne míakpɔ, alesi Yehowa le xɔxɔ ge na mi! Yuda kple Yerusalem, migavɔ̃ o, eye dzika megatso mia ƒo o! Etsɔ la miho ɖe wo ŋu. Yehowa li kpli mi!

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye Lewi-viwo, siwo tso Kehat viwo kple Korax viwo dome la, tsi tre, eye wodo ɣli sesĩe kafu Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la hoo.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Eye wòfɔ ŋdi kanya heho ɖo ta Tekoa-gbedzi. Esi woho la, Yosafat tsi tre ɖi gblɔ bena: Miɖo tom, mi Yuda kple Yerusalemtɔwo! Ne miexɔ Yehowa, mia Mawu dzi se la, ekema mianɔ te, eye ne miexɔ eƒe nyagblɔɖilawo dzi se la, ekema adze edzi na mi!

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Tete wòɖo aɖaŋu kple dukɔ la be, ne woho la, yeaɖo Yehowa ƒe hadzilawo, siwo ɖoa atsyɔ kɔkɔe hedzia kafukafuha la, akpablalawo ŋgɔ, eye woanɔ ha dzim be: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Tete Amon-viwo kple Moab-viwo tso ɖe amesiwo tso Seir-towo dzi la ŋuti, wòdza wo ƒu anyi, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo. Eye esi wotsrɔ̃ Seir-to dzi nɔlawo vɔ la, wotsrɔ̃ wo nɔewo.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Esi Yuda va toa ta me le gbea dzi, eye wòtrɔ ɖe ameha la ŋu la, kpɔ ɖa, ame kukuwo ɖo baba ɖe anyigba, eye amea ɖeke mekpɔtɔ o.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke eneagbe la wokpe ta ɖe kafukafubali la me, elabena afima wokafu Yehowa le; eyata wona ŋkɔ teƒe ma be: kafukafubalime vaseɖe egbe.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Eye Mawu ƒe ŋɔdzi lé anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo katã, esime wose be, Yehowa wɔ aʋa kple Israel ƒe futɔwo.

english_verse: to invade Judah. The Lord let Jehoshaphat's kingdom be at peace. Jehoshaphat Dies (
translation_verse: Ale Yosafat ƒe fiaɖuƒe la ŋu fa, elabena Mawu na wokpɔ gbɔdzɔe godoo va kpe. Yosafat bla nu kple Axazya.

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la Yuda-fia Yosafat bla nu kple Israel-fia Axazya, amesi nye nu vlo wɔla.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat obeyed the Lord, just as his father Asa had done,
translation_verse: Eto fofoa Asa ƒe ʋe me, eye megbe nusi dze Yehowa ŋu la wɔwɔ o.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ke womeɖe nuxeƒewo ɖa o, eye dukɔ la metsɔ woƒe dzi ɖo wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la ŋu haɖe o.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Yosafat ŋutinya susɔeawo, tsãtɔwo kple megbetɔwo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Yehu, Xanani vi fe ŋutinya, si wotsɔ de Israel-fiawo ƒe agbalẽ me la me.

english_verse: They agreed to build several seagoing ships at Ezion-Geber.
translation_verse: Ebia nu kplu be, yeatu ʋuwo, ne wòayi Tarsis, eye wotu ʋuawo le Ezyon-Geber.

english_verse: But the prophet Eliezer warned Jehoshaphat, “The Lord will destroy these ships because you have supported Ahaziah.” The ships were wrecked and never sailed.
translation_verse: Ke Eliezer, Dodawa vi, tso Maresa gblɔ nya ɖi na Yosafat bena: Esi nebla nu kple Axazya la, eyata Yehowa gblẽ wò dɔwɔwɔ me na wo Tete ʋuawo gbã, eye womete ŋu de Tarsis o.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Eye Yosafat mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖu ɖe fofoawo gbɔ le Dawid ƒe du la me, eye via Yoram zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: King Jehoshaphat had seven sons: Jehoram, Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah.
translation_verse: Nɔviaŋutsu, siwo nye Yosafat viwo, wonye Azarya, Yexiel, Zaxarya, Azarya, Mixael kple Sefatya. Amesiawo katã nye Yuda-fia Yosafat ƒe viwo.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Le eŋɔli Edom dze aglã ɖe Yuda le dziɖuɖu ŋu, eye woɖo fia na wo ɖokui.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa dɔ Filistitɔwo kple Arabiatɔwo, amesiwo le Kusiviwo xa la ƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖe Yoram ŋu.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Wo fofo na nu geɖe wo, klosalo kple sika kple nu xɔasiwo hekpe ɖe Yuda-du sesẽwo ŋu, ke etsɔ fiaɖuƒe la na Yoram, elabena eya nye ŋgɔgbea.

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Eye esi Yoram va ɖo fofoa ƒe fiaɖuƒe la nu, eye woli ke eɖokui la, etsɔ yi wu nɔviawo katã kple Israel-amegãwo dometɔa ɖewo.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Eye wòto Israel-fiawo ƒe ʋe me, abe alesi Axab ƒe aƒe la wɔ ene, elabena eɖe Axab ƒe vinyɔnu, eye wòwɔ nusi nye vɔ̃ le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
