translation_verse: Ke Yehowa mebe, yeagblẽ Dawid ƒe aƒe la o le nusi wòbia kple Dawid kple alesi wòdo ŋugbe be, yeana akaɖia ɖe eya kple viawo ɖaa la ta. Edomtɔwo ƒe megbedede.

english_verse: Jehoram, his officers, and his cavalry marched to Edom, where the Edomite army surrounded them. He escaped during the night,
translation_verse: Tete Yoram kple amegãwo ho yi, eye tasiaɖamwo katã kpe ɖe wo ŋu. Eye wòva me be, eya kple eƒe amegãwo tso le zã me ɖasi Edomtɔ, siwo ɖe to ɖee.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ke Edom dze aglã ɖe Yuda ƒe dziduɖu ŋu vaseɖe egbe. Eye Libna hã dze aglã ɖe eƒe dziɖuɖu ŋu le ɣemaɣi, le esi wògblẽ Yehowa fofoawo ƒe Mawu ɖi la ta.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nuxeƒewo hã ɖe Yuda-towo dzi, eye wòna Yerusalemtɔwo subɔ trɔ̃wo, eye woble Yuda. Eliya ƒe agbalẽ.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Tete nyagblɔɖila Eliya ɖo agbalẽ ɖee bena: Ale Yehowa, fofowò Dawid ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Esi meto fofowo Yosafat ƒe ʋe me o,

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: ke boŋ neto Israel-fiawo ƒe ʋe me, eye nena Yuda kple Yerusalemtɔwo subɔ trɔ̃wo abe Axab ƒe aƒe ene, eye nèwu nɔviwòwo hã, amesiwo tso fofowò ƒe me, eye wonyo wu wò la,

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: eyata kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ahe fuwɔame ava wò dukɔ la, viwòwo kple srɔ̃wòwo kpakple wò kesinɔnuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: Ke wò ŋutɔ la adze dɔ ɖe wò dɔkawo ŋu, eye dɔlele la ana be, nanye wò dɔkawo agbadre. Yoram ku.

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: Eye woho va dze Yuda dzi heta kesinɔnu, siwo katã wokpɔ le fia ƒe me la dzoe; wokplɔ viawo kple srɔ̃wo hã dzoe, eye viŋutsua ɖeke mekpɔtɔ nɛ o, negbe viawo ƒe dɔmlɔea Yoaxaz ko.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Eye le nusiawo katã megbe la Yehowa ɖe fu nɛ, eye wòdze dɔ vɔ̃ɖia ɖe ɖe eƒe dɔkawo ŋu.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me le ɣeyiɣia ɖewo megbe, esime ƒe eve va yi la, dɔléle la na wònyè eƒe dɔkawo, eye wòse veve geɖe heku; ke eƒe dukɔ la medo dzoa ɖeke nɛ, abe alesi wodo dzo na fofoawo ene o.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime Yehu le to hem na Axab ƒe aƒea la, ekpa Yuda-amegãwo kple Axazya nɔviwò ƒe viwo, amesiwo subɔa Axazya la, — eye wowu wo.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: Edi Axazya, eye wolée, esime wòɣla ɖe Samaria. Eye wokpɔe va Yehu gbɔ, eye wòna wowui hetso ɖi; elabena wogblɔ be, eya nye Yosafat, amesi tso eƒe dzi blibo di Yehowa la ƒe vi. Azɔ amea ɖeke megale Axazya ƒe me, amesi ate ŋu aɖu fia o. Atalya wu ame.

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ nusi nye vɔ̃ le Yehowa ŋku me abe Axab ƒe aƒe la ene, elabena woawòe nye eƒe aɖaŋuɖolawo le fofoa ƒe ku megbe hena eƒe gbegblẽ.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Eɖo to woƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo, eye woho aʋa kple Israel-fia Yoram, Axab vi, yi Ramot-Gilead ɖe Aram-fia Xazael ŋu; ke Aramtɔwo si Yoram

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Ke Mawue toto ta me na Axazya, be wòayi Yoram gbɔ. Esi wòva la, eya kple Yoram woho ɖe Yehu, Nimsi vi, amesi Yehowa si ami na, be yeatsrɔ̃ Axab ƒe aƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Tete fia ƒe vinyɔnu Yoseba fi Yoas, Axazya vi, le fiavi, siwo wu ge woala la dome, eye wòkplɔ eya kple eƒe nonala yi abaxɔ me. Ale fia Yoram ƒe vinyɔnu Yoseba, amesi nye nunɔla Yoyada srɔ̃ la, ɣlae ɖe Atalya, eye mete ŋu wui o, elabena eya nye Axazya nɔvinyɔnu.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Eye esi Axazya dada kpo be, ye vi ku la, etso, eye wowu Yuda ƒe aƒe ƒe fiaƒome blibo la.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Eye wòɣla ɖe wo gbɔ le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me ƒe ade, eye Atalya ɖu anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Eye wotsa le Yuda godoo heƒo Lewi-viwo nu ƒu tso Yuda-duwo katã me kple Israel ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo nu ƒu, eye wova Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jehoiada and his sons brought Joash outside, where they placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of the instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, and the crowd cheered and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Tete wokplɔ fiavi la ɖoe, woɖɔ fiakuku la nɛ, eye wotsɔ se la de asi nɛ: woɖo fiae, eye nunɔla Yoyada kple viawo si ami nɛ, eye wodo ɣli bena: Fia nenɔ agbe! Atalya wuwu.

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Ale miawo enye si: Nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo, amesiwo le da me ɖo ge le dzudzɔgbe dzi la ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia nadzɔ agbo la nu;

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Eye anyigba dzi dukɔ blibo la kpɔ dzidzɔ, eye du la me fa. Ke wowu Atalya kple yi.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Ke le ƒe adrelia me la Yoyada do dzi hebla nu kple ame alafawo ƒe tatɔwo, woawo nye: Azarya, Yeroxam vi, Ismael, Yoxanan vi, Azarya, Obed vi, Maaseya, Adaya vi, kple Elisafat, Zixri vi.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: Eye ameha blibo la bla nu kple fia la le mawuƒe me; eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Kpɔ ɖa, fiavie aɖu fia, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Dawid viwo ŋu ene.

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka nanɔ fia ƒe me, eye akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka nanɔ Yesod-gbo la nu, eye dukɔ blibo la nanɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnuwo.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke megava Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me o, negbe nunɔlawo kple Lewi-vi, siwo le dɔ wɔm la ko; woawo ko nava, elabena ame kɔkɔewo wonye. Eye dukɔ blibo la nalé Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Lewi-viwo dome amesiame nalé eƒe aʋawɔnu ɖe asi, eye woaɖe to ɖe fia la, ne amea ɖe va aƒea me la, woawui; eye minɔ fia la ŋu, ne eva me alo wòdo.

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Eye Lewi-viwo kple Yuda blibo la wɔ, abe alesi nunɔla Yoyada de se pɛpɛpɛ ene, eye amesiame kplɔ eƒe amewo, amesiwo ɖo dɔ me le dzudzɔgbe dzi kple amesiwo do le dɔ me le dzudzɔgbe dzi siaa, elabena nunɔla Yoyada meɖe asi le amehawo ŋu o.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla Yoyada tsɔ fia Dawid ƒe akplɔwo, akpoxɔnu kple aʋawɔnu, siwo le mawuƒe la me la, na ame alafawo ƒe amegãwo.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo dukɔ blibo la tso xɔ la ƒe ɖusi me kpa dzi vaseɖe xɔ la ƒe mia me kpa dzi heƒo xlã vɔsamlekpui la kple xɔ la, eye woɖe to ɖe fia la.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Esi Atalya se dukɔ, si nyã aƒa va le fia la kafum ƒe ɣli la, eyi ɖe dukɔ la gbɔ le Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòkpɔ bena, fia la tsi tre ɖe kɔkɔƒe le mɔ nu, eye amegãwo kple kpẽkulawo le fia la gbɔ, dukɔ hahoo la katã le dzidzɔ kpɔm, eye wole kpẽ kum, eye hadzilawo tsɔ hadzinuwo le kafukafuha dzim la, Atalya dze eƒe awuwo, eye wòdo ɣli bena: Nugbeɖoɖoe! Nugbeɖoɖoe!

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Tete nunɔla Yoyada ɖe se na ame alafawo ƒe amegãwo, amesiwo nye aʋakɔ la kplɔlawo, gblɔ na wo bena: Mikplɔe to ameawo domee, eye ne amea ɖe dze eyome la, miwui kple yi; elabena nunɔla la gblɔ be, womawui ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me o.

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.
translation_verse: Esi wòlée va ɖo afisi sɔwo tona via fiaƒe me la, wowui ɖe afima. Baal subɔsubɔ gbegblẽ.

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Eye Yoyada bla nu kple dukɔ blibo la kpakple fia la be, yewoanye Yehowa ƒe dukɔ.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ blibo la ge ɖe Baal-ƒe me, wòmũ eƒe vɔsamlekpui ƒu anyi, wogbã eƒe legbawo, eye wowu Baal ƒe nunɔla Matan ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Eye Yoyada tsa Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me dowo de asi na nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo, amesiwo me Dawid mã hena Yehowa fe aƒe la, be wòasa Yehowa ƒe numevɔ kple dzidzɔ kpakple hadzidzi le Dawid ƒe ɖoɖo la nu, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖe Mose ƒe se la me ene.

english_verse: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.
translation_verse: Eɖo agbonudzɔlawo Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe agbowo nu, be ame makɔmakɔa ɖeke magage ɖe eme o

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: Tete wòɖe ame alafawo ƒe amegãwo, dukɔ la ƒe ame ŋkutawo kple aƒekɔwo kpakple dukɔ hahoo la katã, eye wokplɔ fia la tso Yehowa-ƒe me heto dzigbegbo la nu yi fiaƒe me, eye wotsɔ fia la ɖo fiazikpui la dzi.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Eye Yoas wɔ nusi dze Yehowa ŋu le nunɔla Yoyada ƒe agbenɔɣi katã.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Eye fia la kple Yoyada wotsɔ wo na Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe dɔnunɔlawo, eye woɖatsɔ kpefulawo kple atikpalawo, ne woaɖɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ɖo hekpe ɖe gayibɔ- kple akɔblidɔwɔlawo ŋu, ne woaɖɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la do.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Eye woɖii ɖe Dawid ƒe du la me ɖe fiawo gbɔ, elabena ewɔ nyui na Israel kple Mawu kpakple eƒe aƒe la. Yoas subɔ trɔ̃.

english_verse: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.”
translation_verse: Elabena Atalya baɖa ma ƒe viwo gbã Mawu ƒe aƒe la, eye wotsɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe nunana kɔkɔewo katã wɔ Baal tɔe.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Eye Yoyada ɖe srɔ̃ eve ne, eye wòdzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Le nusiawo megbe la Yoas ɖo ɖe ta me be, yeaɖɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ɖo.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: Eye wòƒo nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo nu ƒu gblɔ na wo bena: Miyi Yuda-duwo me, eye midzɔ ga le Israel blibo la si ƒe sia ƒe, ne miatsɔ aɖo mia Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖo. Mitsɔ dzo ɖe nusiawɔwɔ ŋu! Ke Lewi-viwo metsɔ dzo ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Tete fia la yɔ Yoyada, si nye tatɔ la, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Nukaŋuti meɖi tso Lewi-viwo si be, woaɖaxɔ Yehowa ƒe dɔla Mose ƒe adzɔ, si wòɖo na Israel ƒe ameha la ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋu la, tso Yuda kple Yerusalem si oa?

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Tete fia la de se be, woawɔ aɖakaa ɖe, eye wotsɔe ɖa ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe agbo nu le egodo.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Eye wòna woɖe gbe ƒã le Yuda kple Yerusalem be, woatsɔ Mawu ƒe dɔla Mose ƒe adzo, si wòɖo na Israel le gbe dzi la, vɛ na Yehowa.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Tete amegãwo katã kple dukɔ blibo la kpo dzidzɔ, eye wotsɔe va ko ɖe aɖaka la me, vaseɖe esime wòyɔ.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Ne wokpɔ be, ga la sɔ gbɔ la, ekema Lewi-viwo tsɔa aɖaka la yia amesi fia la ɖo la gbɔ, eye fia ƒe agbalẽŋlɔla kple nunɔlagã ƒe dɔwɔla vana, eye wotrɔnɛ le aɖaka la me gatsɔnɛ ɖadana ɖe eteƒe. Alea wowɔe gbesiagbe, eye woƒo ga geɖe nu ƒu.

english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.
translation_verse: Esi dɔnunɔlawo lé dɔa me la, dɔ la de ŋgɔ to wo si me, eye wogaɖɔ Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖo wòɖo eƒe nɔnɔme, eye wowɔe asi te eŋu.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: Ke esi wowɔe vo la, wotsɔ ga susɔea na fia la kple Yoyaɖa, eye wotsɔe wo Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me nuwo, subɔsubɔdɔwɔnuwo kple vɔsanuwo, trewo, sikanuwo kple klosalonuwo. Ale wosa numevɔ le Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me ɖaa le Yoyada ƒe agbenɔɣi katã.

english_verse: He died at the ripe old age of
translation_verse: Yoyada tsi, eye agbe tii, eye woku; exɔ ƒe alafa ɖeka kple blaetɔ̃ hafi ku.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Le Yoyada ƒe ku megbe la Yuda-amegãwo va de ta agu na ha la, eye fia la ɖo to woƒe gbe.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Wogblẽ Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖi, eye wosubɔ Aserawo kple legbawo Tete dɔmedzoe va Yuda kple Yerusalem dzi le woƒe fɔɖiɖi sia ta.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo nyagblɔɖilawo ɖe wo gbɔ, be woatrɔ wo ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye woxlɔ̃ nu wo, ke womeɖo to o.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Eye Mawu ƒe gbagba dze nunɔla Yoyada ƒe vi Zaxarya dzi, eye wòtsi tre ɖe dukɔ la ŋku me gblɔ na wo bena: Ale Mawu gblɔ esi: Nukaŋuti míeɖa Yehowa ƒe se dzi, ne dzɔgbenyuiea ɖeke maganɔ mia ŋu o? Esi miegblẽ Yehowa ɖi la, eyata eya hã gblẽ mi ɖi.

english_verse: King Joash forgot that Zechariah's father had always been a loyal friend. So when the people of Judah plotted to kill Zechariah, Joash joined them and gave orders for them to stone him to death in the courtyard of the temple. As Zechariah was dying, he said, “I pray that the Lord will see this and punish all of you.” Joash Is Killed
translation_verse: Ke fia Yoas meɖo ŋku alesi fofoa Yoyada ve enu la dzi o, eye wowu via. Eye esi wòle kukum la, egblɔ be: Yehowa kpɔe, eye abia eta. Tohehe na Yoas kple ku.

english_verse: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.
translation_verse: Le ƒe ɖeka megbe la Aramtɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ho ɖe eŋu, eye wova Yuda kple Yerusalem, wowu dukɔ la ƒe amegãwo katã le dukɔ la dome, eye woɖo woƒe aboyonuwo katã ɖe Damasko-fia.

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.
translation_verse: Aramtɔwo va kple aʋakɔ suea ɖe ko hafi, ke Yehowa tsɔ aʋakɔ gã ŋutɔ na wo, le esi wogblẽ Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la ɖi la. Eye wohe to na Yoas.

english_verse: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.
translation_verse: Viaŋutsuwo kple nya gbogbo, siwo wogblɔ ɖe eŋu kpakple alesi wògbugbɔ Mawu ƒe aƒe la gɔme ɖo anyi la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe ŋutinya, siwo le fiawo ƒe agbalẽ me la me. Eye via Amazya zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: One of God's prophets said, “Your Majesty, don't let these Israelite soldiers march into battle with you. The Lord has refused to help anyone from the northern kingdom of Israel,
translation_verse: Eye Mawu ƒe amea ɖe va egbɔ gblɔ bena: Oo fia, Israel ƒe aʋakɔ la megayi kpli wò o, elabena Yehowa meli kple Efrayim-viwo katã, amesiwo nye Israel o,

english_verse: Amaziah replied, “What am I supposed to do about all the silver I paid those troops?” “The Lord will give you back even more than you paid,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Amazya gblɔ na Mawu ƒe ame la bena: Evɔ talento alafa ɖeka, si metsɔ na Israel ƒe amehaawo ɖe? Mawu ƒe ame la ɖo ŋu bena: Yehowa ana nu geɖe wò wu esia.

english_verse: After Amaziah got his courage back, he led his troops to Salt Valley, where he killed
translation_verse: Ke Amazya lé dzi ɖe ƒo he kplɔ eƒe aʋakɔ la; woho va dzeƒe la me, eye wowu Seir-viwo ame akpe ewo.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Israelite troops that Amaziah had sent home, raided the towns in Judah between Samaria and Beth-Horon. They killed
translation_verse: Ke ameha, siwo Amazya gbugbɔ ɖo ɖa, be womagayi aʋa la kplii o la, yi ɖakaka ɖe Yuda-duwo me tso Samaria vaseɖe Bet-Xoron; wowu ame akpe etɔ̃ le wo dome, eye woha aboyonu geɖe.

english_verse: But before the prophet finished speaking, Amaziah interrupted and said, “You're not one of my advisors! Don't say another word, or I'll have you killed.” The prophet stopped. But then he added, “First you sinned and now you've ignored my warning. It's clear that God has decided to punish you!” Israel Defeats Judah (
translation_verse: Eye esi wòƒo nu kplii la, egblɔ nɛ bena: Wòe mietsɔ ɖo fia ƒe aɖaŋuɖolaea? Dzudzɔ, ne menye nenem o la, woaƒo wò. Eye nyagblɔɖila la dzudzɔ hegblɔ bena: Menyae be, Mawu ɖo gbegblẽ ɖe ŋuwò, le esi nèwɔ nusia, eye mèɖo to nye aɖaŋuɖoɖo o ta.

english_verse: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his officials, then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Eye Yuda-fia Amazya de aɖaŋu heɖo ame ɖe Israel-fia Yoas, amesi nye Yehu vi Yoaxaz ƒe vi, be woagblɔ ne bena: Va, ne míakpe akɔ kple mía nɔewo kpɔ!

english_verse: Jehoash sent back a reply that said: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon arranged the marriage between his son and the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Tete Israel-fia Yoas ɖo ame ɖe Yuda-fia Amazya gblɔ bena: Ŋuvegoe, si le Libanon dzi la, dɔ ame ɖo ɖe sederti, si le Libanon dzi, gblɔ bena: Tsɔ viwònyɔnu na vinyeŋutsu, ne wòaɖe. Tete gbemelã, siwo le Libanon dzi la, va nyã avuzi le ŋuvegoe la dzi.

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. But stay at home and do your celebrating. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ele bubum be: kpɔ ɖa, mesi Edomtɔwo; eyata dzi ɖo ƒowò, nèle ɖokuiwò dom ɖe dzi. Tsi aƒe, nukaŋuti nèbe, yeade ɖokuiwò dzɔgbevɔ̃e me, eye mia kple Yuda siaa míatsi?

english_verse: so Jehoash led his army to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Tete Israel-fia Yoas ho, eye eya kple Yuda-fia Amazya wokpe akɔ le Bet-Semes, si nye Yuda tɔ la.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Ke Israel si Yuda, eye wo dome amesiame si yi eƒe agbadɔ me.

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash took Amaziah with him when he went to attack Jerusalem. Jehoash broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: Eye Israel-fia Yoas lé Yuda-fia Amazya, amesi nye Axaz vi Yoas ƒe vi la, le Bet-Semes, eye wòkplɔe va Yerusalem; eye wògbã Yerusalem ƒe gli tso Efrayim-gbo la nu vaseɖe dzogoedzigbo la gbɔ, ele abɔklugui alafa ene.

english_verse: He carried away the gold, the silver, and all the valuable furnishings from God's temple where the descendants of Obed-Edom stood guard. He robbed the king's treasury, took hostages, then returned to Samaria. Amaziah Is Killed (
translation_verse: Eye wòlɔ sika kple klosalowo katã kpakple ŋudɔwɔnuawo katã, siwo le Obed-Edom si me le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me, kple fia ƒe aƒe me kesinɔnuwo hekpe ɖe awɔbamewo ŋuti yi Samaria.

english_verse: Everything else Amaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Amazya ŋutinya susɔeawo, tsãtɔwo kple megbetɔwo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Yuda-fiawo kple Israel-fiawo ƒe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah started disobeying the Lord, some people in Jerusalem plotted against Amaziah. He was able to escape to the town of Lachish, but another group of people caught him and killed him there.
translation_verse: Tso esime Amazya trɔ le Yehowa yome la, woɖo nugbe ɖe eŋu le Yerusalem. Tete wòsi yi Laxis; ke wodo ame ɖe eyome ɖe Laxis, eye wowui le afima.

english_verse: His body was taken to Jerusalem on horseback and buried beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye wokɔe ɖo sɔ dzi va ɖi ɖe fofoawo gbɔ le Yuda-du la me.

english_verse: Uzziah supplied his army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and stones used for slinging.
translation_verse: Uziya wo akpoxɔnuwo, akplɔwo, gakukuwo, gawuwo, dawo kple akafomekpewo na aʋakɔ blibo la.

english_verse: Uzziah had leprosy the rest of his life. He was no longer allowed in the temple or in his own palace. That's why his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Ale fia Uziya dze anyi vaseɖe eƒe kugbe, eye wònɔ aga le xɔa ɖe me abe anyidzelawo ene, elabena wotsri Yehowa ƒe aƒe la nɛ, eye via Yotam nɔ fia ƒe aƒe la nu hedrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔ hahoo la.

english_verse: Everything else Uzziah did while he was king is in the records written by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
translation_verse: Uziya ŋutinya susɔeawo, tsãtɔwo kple megbetɔwo la, nyagblɔɖila Yesaya, Amoz vi la, ŋlɔ wo.

english_verse: Some of his skilled workers invented machines that could shoot arrows and sling large stones. Uzziah set these up in Jerusalem at his defense towers and at the corners of the city wall. God helped Uzziah become more and more powerful, and he was famous all over the world. Uzziah Becomes Too Proud
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ mɔ̃a ɖe, si aɖaŋutɔa ɖe to vɛ la, le Yerusalem, si wotsɔ, da ɖe xɔ tsralawo kple xɔwo ta me, ne woatsɔ ada aŋutrɔwo kple kpe gãwoe. Eƒe ŋkɔ de du, elabena woxɔ nɛ nukutɔe, vaseɖe esime ŋusẽ ɖo eŋu. Uziya do eɖokui ɖe dzi, eye Mawu tsɔ anyi he, to nɛ le eya ŋutɔ ƒe numeme ŋuti.

english_verse: God helped him defeat the Philistines, the Arabs living in Gur-Baal, and the Meunites.
translation_verse: Eye Mawu de edzi de Filistitɔwo kple Arabiatɔwo, amesiwo nɔ Gur-Baal la, kple Meunitɔwo ŋuti.

english_verse: After the death of King Amaziah, the people of Judah crowned his son Uzziah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Uziya xɔ ƒe wuiade, esime wòzu fia, eye woɖu fia ƒe blaatɔ̃ vɔ eve le Yerusalem.

english_verse: Uzziah became proud of his power, and this led to his downfall. One day, Uzziah disobeyed the Lord his God by going into the temple and burning incense as an offering to him.
translation_verse: Ke esi ŋusẽ ɖo eŋu la, ede asi dada me, vaseɖe esime eƒe nuwɔwɔ gblẽ; meɖi anukware na Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la o, eye wòge ɖe Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la me hedo dzudzɔ le dzudzɔdovɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: He obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Ewo nusi dze Yehowa ŋu, abe alesi fofoa Amazya wo pɛpɛpɛ ene.

english_verse: Zechariah was Uzziah's advisor and taught him to obey God. And so, as long as Zechariah was alive, Uzziah was faithful to God, and God made him successful.
translation_verse: Edi Mawu le Zaxarya, amesi fia Mawu vɔvɔ̃e la ƒe agbenɔɣi katã, eye Mawu na wòdze edzi nɛ le ŋkeke, siwo katã me wòdi Yehowa.

english_verse: While Uzziah was king, he started a war against the Philistines. He smashed the walls of the cities of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod, then rebuilt towns around Ashdod and in other parts of Philistia.
translation_verse: Eye wòho dawo aʋa kple Filistitɔwo, eye wògbã Gat ƒe gliwo, Yabne ƒe gliwo kple Asdod ƒe gliwo, eye wòtso duwo ɖe Asdod kple Filistitɔwo dome.

english_verse: Even the Ammonites paid taxes to Uzziah. He became very powerful, and people who lived as far away as Egypt heard about him.
translation_verse: Amonitɔwo dzo nu na Uziya, eye eƒe ŋkɔ de Egipte ke, elabena ekpa ŋusẽ tso me.

english_verse: In Jerusalem, Uzziah built fortified towers at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the place where the city wall turned inward.
translation_verse: Uziya tu xɔ tsralawo ɖe Yerusalem, ɖe dzogoedzigbo la, bali me agbo la kple dzogoe la dzi, eye wòwɔ wo sesĩe.

english_verse: He also built defense towers out in the desert. He owned such a large herd of livestock in the western foothills and in the flatlands, that he had cisterns dug there to catch the rainwater. He loved farming, so he had crops and vineyards planted in the hill country wherever there was fertile soil, and he hired farmers to take care of them.
translation_verse: Etu xɔ tsralawo ɖe gbe dzi, eye wòɖe vudo geɖewo, elabena lãho geɖe le esi le bali me kple tagba, eye agbledelawo kple weingbledelawo le esi le towo dzi kple Karmel, elabena elɔ̃a agbledede.

english_verse: Uzziah's army was always ready for battle. Jeiel and Maaseiah were the officers who kept track of the number of soldiers, and these two men were under the command of Hananiah, one of Uzziah's officials.
translation_verse: Aʋawɔla kalẽtɔ, siwo hona dea aʋa hamehame la, le Uziya si, agbalẽŋlɔla Yeiel kple dɔdzikpɔla Maaseya tia wo xlẽ le Xananya, amesi tso fia ƒe amegãwo dome ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te.

english_verse: and said, “Your Majesty, this isn't right! You are not allowed to burn incense to the Lord. That must be done only by priests who are descendants of Aaron. You will have to leave! You have sinned against the Lord, and so he will no longer bless you.”
translation_verse: Eye wotsi tre ɖe fia Uziya ŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Uziya, medze wò be, nado dzudzɔ na Yehowa o, negbe nunɔlawo, siwo nye Aron viwo, amesiwo ŋu wokɔ hena dzudzɔdodo la ko. Do go le kɔkɔeƒe la, elabena èwɔ nu tovo, eye Yehowa made bubua ɖeke ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Uzziah, who was standing next to the incense altar at the time, was holding the incense burner, ready to offer incense to the Lord. He became very angry when he heard Azariah's warning, and leprosy suddenly appeared on his forehead!
translation_verse: Tete Uziya ɖo dɔmedzoe, eye wòlé dzudzɔdogba ɖe asi be, wòado dzudzɔ. Ke esi wòdo dɔmedzoe ɖe nunɔlawo ŋu la, anyi ƒo ɖe eƒe ŋgonu le nunɔlawo ŋku me le Yehowa ƒe xɔ la me le dzudzɔdovɔsamlekpui la xa.

english_verse: Azariah and the other priests saw it and immediately told him to leave the temple. Uzziah realized that the Lord had punished him, so he hurried to get outside.
translation_verse: Eye esi nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔ Azarya kple nunɔlawo katã trɔ kɔ ɖe eŋu la, kpɔ ɖa, edze anyi ɖe ŋgonu, eye wonyae afɔ tsɔtsɔe tso afima. Eya ŋutɔ hã wɔ kabakaba hedo, le esi Yehowa ƒoe la ta.

english_verse: Since Uzziah had leprosy, he could not be buried in the royal tombs. Instead, he was buried in a nearby cemetery that the kings owned. His son Jotham then became king.
translation_verse: Eye Uziya mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe agble me le fofoawo gbɔ lɔƒo le fiawo ɖiƒe, elabena wogblɔ be: Anyie wòdze. Eye via Yotam zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Jotham obeyed the Lord and did right. He followed the example of his father Uzziah, except he never burned incense in the temple as his father had done. But the people of Judah kept sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nusi dze Yehowa ŋu, abe alesi fofoa Uziya wɔ pɛpɛpɛ ene, negbe ɖeko eya mege ɖe Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la me o. Ke dukɔ la gale nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ dzi ɖaa ko.

english_verse: During his rule he attacked and defeated the Ammonites. Then every year for the next three years, he forced them to pay
translation_verse: Ewɔ aʋa kple Amon-viwo ƒe fia hã, eye woɖu wo dzi, eye Amon-viwo tsɔ klosalo talento alafa ɖeka, lu kor akpe ewo kple ƒo kor akpe ewo nɛ le ƒe ma mè. Nusiawo Amon-viwo tsɔ nɛ le ƒe evelia kple ƒe etɔ̃lia hã me.

english_verse: Jotham remained faithful to the Lord his God and became a very powerful king.
translation_verse: Ale Yotam kpɔ ŋusẽ, elabena ezɔ le Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la ŋku me.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king, including the wars he fought, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Yotam ŋutinya susɔeawo, eƒe aʋawɔwɔwo katã kple eƒe nuwɔwɔwo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Israel-fiawo kple Yuda-fiawo ƒe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: He was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Eye Yotam mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe Dawid ƒe ɖu la me, eye via Axaz zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees. Syria and Israel Attack Judah (
translation_verse: Esa vɔ, eye wòdo dzudzɔ le nuxeƒewo, togbɛwo dzi kple ati damawo katã te.

english_verse: So Tiglath Pileser came to Judah, but instead of helping, he made things worse.
translation_verse: Asur-fia Tiglat-Pileser va ƒoe ɖe anyi, ke mekpe asi ɖe asi ŋu nɛ o, hafi boŋ exaxae ɖo,

english_verse: and he offered sacrifices in Hinnom Valley. Worst of all, Ahaz sacrificed his own sons, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: Edo dzudzɔ le Ben-Hinom-bali la me, eye wòna viawo to dzo me le dukɔ, siwo Yehowa nyã le Israel-viwo ŋgɔ la ƒe ŋunyɔnuwo nu.

english_verse: Ahaz and the people of Judah sinned and turned away from the Lord, the God their ancestors had worshiped. So the Lord punished them by letting their enemies defeat them. The king of Syria attacked Judah and took many of its people to Damascus as prisoners. King Pekah of Israel later defeated Judah and killed
translation_verse: Eye Pekax, Remalya vi, wu ame akpe alafa ɖeka blave, siwo nye kalẽtɔwo sɔŋ, le Yuda le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi, elabena wogblẽ Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la ɖi.

english_verse: If you make slaves of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, you will be as guilty as they are of sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Azɔ miele bubum be, miazi Yuda-viwo kple Yerusalem-viwo dzi, ne woanye dɔlaŋutsuwo kple dɔlanyɔnuwo na mia? Ɖe menye fa ɖeɖe sɔŋ ko miawo hã míeɖi ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋu oa?

english_verse: Send these prisoners back home—they are your own relatives. If you don't, the Lord will punish you in his anger.
translation_verse: Eyata miɖo tom, eye nugbugbɔ aboyome, siwo mieɖakplɔ tso mia nɔviwo gbɔ la na, elabena Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe le mia ŋu.

english_verse: About the same time, four of Israel's leaders arrived. They were Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai. They agreed with Oded that the Israelite troops were wrong,
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsuwo tso Efrayim-viwo ƒe tatɔwo dome, woawo nye; Azarya, Yoxanan vi, Berexya, Mesilemot vi, Yexizkiya, Salum vi, kple Amasa, Xadlai vi, eye wotsi tre ɖe amesiwo gbɔ tso aʋa la ŋu,

english_verse: and they said: If you bring these prisoners into Samaria, that will be one more thing we've done to sin against the Lord. And he is already angry enough with us.
translation_verse: gblɔ na wo bena: Migakplɔ aboyomeawo va afisia o, elabena fa ko wòanye míaɖi ɖe Yehowa ŋu! Ɖe, miebe, yewoadzi miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple miaƒe fɔɖiɖiwo ɖe dzia? Elabena míaƒe fɔɖiɖiwo sɔ gbɔ, eye dɔmedzoe le Israel dzi.

english_verse: So in front of the leaders and the crowd, the troops handed over their prisoners and the property they had taken from Judah.
translation_verse: Tete akpablalawo he aboyomeawo kple aboyonuawo va amegãwo kple takpekpe la ŋku me.

english_verse: The four leaders took some of the stolen clothes and gave them to the prisoners who needed something to wear. They later gave them all a new change of clothes and shoes, then fixed them something to eat and drink, and cleaned their wounds with olive oil. They gave donkeys to those who were too weak to walk, and led all of them back to Jericho, the city known for its palm trees. The leaders then returned to Samaria. Ahaz Asks the King of Assyria for Help (
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsu, siwo ŋkɔ woyɔ la, tsi tre xa aboyomeawo, wotsɔ awu tso aboyonuawo dome do na amesiwo katã le amama, wotsɔ awuwo kple; afɔkpawo, nuɖuɖu kple nunono na wo, wosi ami na wo, eye wotsɔ amesi wo katã gbɔdzɔ la, ɖo tedziwo dzi hekplɔ wo va wo nɔviwo gbɔ le devedu Yerixo me, eye wògagbugbɔ yi Samaria. Mawu ƒe tohehe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ Axaz.

english_verse: But God was punishing Judah with these disasters, because Ahaz had disobeyed him and refused to stop Judah from sinning.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa baba Yuda ɖe anyi le Yuda fia Axaz ta, elabena ena Yuda dze ha, eye meɖi anukware na Yehowa o.

english_verse: Ahaz gave him gifts from the Lord's temple and the king's palace, as well as from the homes of Israel's other leaders. The Assyrian king still refused to help Ahaz. The Final Sin of Ahaz and His Death
translation_verse: evɔ wònye Axaz ha Yehowa ƒe aƒe kpakple fia kple amegãwo ƒe aƒe hetsɔ na Asur-fia la hafi, ke egbe kpekpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Even after all these terrible things happened to Ahaz, he sinned against the Lord even worse than before.
translation_verse: Ke Axaz sia gãwo nu tovo ɖe dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu le ɣeyiɣi, si me woxaxae ɖo.

english_verse: He said to himself, “The Syrian gods must have helped their kings defeat me. Maybe if I offer sacrifices to those gods, they will help me.” That was the sin that finally led to the downfall of Ahaz, as well as to the destruction of Judah.
translation_verse: Esa vo na Damaskotɔ, siwo sii la ƒe mawuwo gblɔ bena: Esi Aram-fiawo ƒe mawuwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la, eyata nye hã masa vɔ na wo, ne woakpe ɖe nye hã ŋunye! Ke wòtrɔ zu mɔ̃ na eya kple Israel blibo la.

english_verse: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye fia la ƒo Mawu ƒe aƒe ŋu dɔwɔnuwo nu ƒu, eye wògbã Mawu ƒe aƒe ŋu dɔwɔnuwo, etu Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe ʋɔtruwo, eye wòɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo ɖe dzogoewo katã dzi le Yerusalem.

english_verse: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.
translation_verse: Ewo nuxeƒewo ɖe Yuda-duwo katã me, ne woaɖo dzudzɔ na du bubu me tɔwo ƒe mawuwo, eye wòdo dziku na Yehowa, fofoawo ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Eŋutinya susɔeawo kple eƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã, tsãtɔwo kple megbetɔwo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Yuda-fiawo kple Israel-fiawo ƒe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah then became king.
translation_verse: Eye Axaz mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖu ɖe ɖu la me le Yerusalem, elabena wometsɔe yi Israel-fiawo ƒe ɖiƒe o; eye via Xizkiya zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done. The Temple Is Purified
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ nusi dze Yehowa ŋu, abe alesi fofoa Dawid wo pɛpɛpɛ ene.

english_verse: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo yi fia Xizkiya gbɔ gblɔ bena: Míekɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe blibo la kple numevɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu nuwo katã kpakple ŋkumeɖobolokplɔ̃ la kple eŋu nuwo katã ŋuti.

english_verse: Next, Hezekiah assigned the Levites to their places in the temple. He gave them cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments, according to the instructions that the Lord had given King David and the two prophets, Gad and Nathan.
translation_verse: Eɖo Lewi-viwo Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me, eye wòlé gakogoewo, saŋkuwo kple kasaŋkuwo ɖe asi le Dawid kple fia ƒe nukpɔla Gad kpakple nyagblɔɖila Natan ƒe sedede nu, elabena Yehowa ye de se la to eƒe nyagblɔɖilawo dzi.

english_verse: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Esi wowu numevɔsa la nu la, fia la kple eƒe amesiwo katã le eŋu la, dze klo, eye wodo gbe ɖa.

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: Ena nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo va, eye wokpe ta ɖe teƒe la le ɣedzeƒe gome,

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mi Lewi-viwo, miɖo tom! Mikɔ mia ɖokui ŋu, eye mikɔ Yehowa, mia tofowo ƒe Mawu ƒe aƒe la ŋu, eye miɖe nu makɔmakɔwo ɖa le kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: Elabena mía fofowo da vo, eye wowɔ nusi nye vɔ le Yehowa, mia Mawu ŋku me; wogblẽe ɖi, eye woɖe ŋku ɖa le Yehowa, si wotrɔ megbe dee la ƒe nɔƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Wodo akpatala ƒe ʋɔtruwo hã, eye wotsi akaɖiawo, wometsɔ dzudzɔdonu la do dzudzɔe o, eye womesa vɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la na Israel ƒe Mawu la o.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe va Yuda kple Yerusalem dzi, eye wòwɔ wo wòzu bibidonu, ŋɔdzinu kple alɔmeɖenu, abe alesi miele ekpɔmi kple miaƒe ŋkuwo ene.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mía fofowo tsi yi nu, eye woɖe aboyo míaƒe ŋutsuviwo kple míaƒe nyɔnuviwo kpakple mía srɔ̃wo le esia ta?

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: Azɔ meɖo ɖe ta me be, mabla nu kple Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ne eƒe dɔmedzoe nu nala ɖe mía ŋu.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, migawɔ ƒome o, elabena míawoe Yehowa fia, be mianɔ tsitre ɖe eŋku me, miawɔ eƒe dɔwo, eye mianye eƒe subɔlawo kple dzudzɔdolawo.

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Woƒo wo nɔviwo nu ƒu, eye wokɔ wo dokui ŋu, eye wova le fia ƒe sedede kple Yehowa ƒe nya nu, be yewoakɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo ge ɖe Yehowa ƒe xɔ la me, be yewoakɔ eŋu, eye woɖe nu makɔmakɔ, siwo katã wokpɔ le Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ me la, do goe va Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnu, eye Lewi-viwo xɔ wo hetsɔ yi Kidron-tɔʋu la nu.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Wodze eŋu kɔkɔ gɔme le dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi, eye wova ɖo Yehowa ƒe akpata la me le dzinu la ƒe ŋkeke enyiliagbe hekɔ Yehowa ƒe xɔ la ŋu ŋkeke enyi sɔŋ, eye wowu enu le dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke wuiadelia dzi.

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: Eye míegaɖɔ nusiwo katã fia Axaz do ŋunyɔe le eƒe fiaɖuɖu me, esime wòda vo la ɖo, eye miekɔ wo ŋu; kpɔ ɖa, wole Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Tete fia Xizkiya fɔ ŋdi kanya, eye wòƒo dumegãwo nu ƒu heyi Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: Eye wokplɔ nyitsu adre, agbo adre, alẽvi adre kple gbɔ̃tsu adre vɛ, be woanye nuvɔ̃vɔsa ɖe fiaɖuƒe la kple kɔkɔeƒe la kpakple Yuda ta. Eye wòde se na Aron viwo, amesiwo nye nunɔlawo, be woasa vɔ le Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.
translation_verse: Eye wokplɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsa ƒe gbɔ̃tsuawo va fia la kple takpekpe la ŋku me, eye wotsɔ woƒe asiwò da ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Tete nunɔlawo wu wo hetsɔ woƒe ʋu kɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, ne wòanye nuvɔ̃vɔsa, ne woatsɔ alé avu na Israel blibo lae, elabena fia la de se be, numevɔsa la kple nuvɔ̃vɔsa la wonye Israel blibo la tɔ.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Lewi-viwo le tsitrenu kple Dawid ƒe hadzinuawo, eye nunɔlawo lé kpẽawo ɖe asi.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya de se be, woasa numevɔ le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Azɔ esi wode asi numevɔ sasa me la, Yehowa ƒe ha kple kpẽawo kpakple Israel-fia Dawid ƒe hadzinuawo de asi ɖiɖi me.

english_verse: and everyone worshiped the Lord. This continued until the last animal was sacrificed.
translation_verse: Eye ameha blibo la do gbe ɖa, eye hawo kple kpẽawo ɖi, vaseɖe esime wowu numevɔsa la nu.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete fia Xizkiya kple amegãwo ɖo na Lewi-viwo be, woatsɔ Dawid kple nukpɔla Asaf ƒe nyawo adzi kafukafuhawo na Yehowa. Wodzi kafukafuhawo kple dzidzɔ, eye wode ta agu hedo gbe ɖa.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Emegbe Xizkiya xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Azɔ miekɔ mia ɖokui ŋu na Yehowa Mite va, ne miasa akpedavɔ kple kafukafuvɔ le Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me! Eye ameha blibo la sa akpedavɔ kple kafukafuvɔ, eye amesiame, si lɔ̃ le eɖokui si lã, sa numevɔ.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlawo mesɔ gbɔ, be woako numevɔsalãwo katã o; eyata wo nɔvi Lewi-viwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu, vaseɖe esime dɔ blibo la wu nu. Eye nunɔlawo kɔ wo ɖokui ŋu, elabena Lewi-viwo ƒe dzime kɔ wu nunɔlawo tɔ ɖe wo ɖokui ŋutikɔkɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Numevɔsa la sɔ gbɔ hekpe ɖe akpedavɔsa ƒe amiwo kple numevɔsa ƒe nunovɔsawo ŋuti. Ale wogaɖo Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me subɔsubɔ te dzi.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya kple dukɔ blibo la kpɔ dzidzɔ le nusi Mawu wɔ na dukɔ la ŋuti, elabena ɖeko wòva dzɔ zi ɖeka kpoyi.

english_verse: Everyone from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north was invited. This was the largest crowd of people that had ever celebrated Passover, according to the official records.
translation_verse: Eye woɖo kpe nya la dzi be, woaɖe gbe ƒã le Israel blibo la tso Beer-Seba vaseɖe Dan, ne woava ɖu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie na Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, le Yerusalem, elabena eteƒe didi womegaɖu kpɔ, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖi ene o.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Eye duxɔlawo xɔ agbalẽawo le ha la kple eƒe amegãwo si ɖatsa le Israel blibo la kple Yuda, eye wogblɔ le fia ƒe sedede nu bena Israel-viwo, mitrɔ ɖe Yehowa, Abraham, Isak kple Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu, ne wòatrɔ ɖe miaƒe ame mamleawo, siwo gatso Asur-fia si me la ŋu!

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: Migasẽ ta me abe mia fofowo ene o, ke boŋ mina asi Yehowa, eye miva eƒe kɔkɔeƒe, si ŋu wòkɔ tegbee la, eye misubɔ Yehowa, mia Mawu, ne eƒe dɔmedzoe nu nata ɖe mia ŋu.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mietrɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu la, ekema futɔwo akpɔ mia nɔviwo kple mia viwo ƒe nublanui, eye woagatrɔ ava anyigba sia dzi, elabena amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla enye Yehowa, mia Mawu la, eye ne mietrɔ ɖe eŋu la, maɖe kɔ ɖa le mia ŋu o.

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: negbe amea ɖewo koe bɔbɔ wo ɖokui ɖe anyi le Aser, Manase kple Zebulon, eye wova Yerusalem.

english_verse: God also made everyone in Judah eager to do what Hezekiah and his officials had commanded. Passover Is Celebrated
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe asi va Yuda hã dzi, eye wòna dzi ɖeka ŋugbee wo, be woawɔ fia kple amegãwo ƒe se la dzi le Yehowa ƒe nya nu.

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Tete ameha gãa ɖe va kpe ta ɖe Yerusalem, be woaɖu abolo maʋamaʋã ŋkekenyuie la le dzinu evelia me, ameha la sa gbɔ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Eye wotsi tre fɔ vɔsamlekpui, siwo le Yerusalem, kple dzudzɔdovɔsamlekpuiwo katã ɖaƒu gbe ɖe Kidron-tɔʋu la me.

english_verse: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa se Xizkiya ƒe gbe, eye wòyɔ dɔ dukɔ la.

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Ale Israel-vi, siwo le Yerusalem la, ɖu abolo maʋamaʋã ŋkekenyuie la ŋkeke adre kple dzidzɔ gãa ɖe, eye Lewi-viwo kple nunɔlawo tsɔ Yehowa ƒe hadzinuwo kafu Yehowa gbesiagbe sesĩe.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya ƒo nu kple Lewi-vi, siwo katã nya mɔnu le Yehowa ƒe subɔsubɔ ŋu la, xɔlɔ̃tɔe, eye woɖu ŋkekenyuie-vɔsalã la ŋkeke adre, wosa akpedavɔ, eye woʋu go wo ɖokui na Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Everyone was so excited that they agreed to celebrate seven more days.
translation_verse: Eye ameha blibo la ɖo be, yewoagaɖui ŋkeke adre, eye woɖui ŋkeke adre sɔŋ kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Everyone was very happy, including those from Judah and Israel, the priests and Levites, and the foreigners living in Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Tete Yuda ƒe ameha blibo la, nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo, ameha blibo, si tso Israel, kpakple amedzro, siwo tso Israel-nyigba dzi, kple esiwo le Yuda la, kpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.
translation_verse: Dzidzɔ gãa ɖe no Yerusalem, elabena tso Israel-fia Salomo, Dawid vi la ŋɔli la esia tɔgbe medzɔ le Yerusalem kpɔ o.

english_verse: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo tsi tre heyra dukɔ la, eye wose woƒe gbe, eye woƒe gbedodoɖa de eƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la le dziƒo.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya ɖo nusiawo kple Lewi-viwo ƒe hawo. Nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo ƒe hawo dome ɖesiaɖe le eƒe da nu ɖe numevɔsa kple akpedavɔsa ŋu, eye woasubɔ, woada akpe, eye woakafu le Yehowa ƒe asaɖa la ƒe agbowo nu.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: hekpe ɖe amesiwo ŋkɔ woŋlɔ la, kple woƒe vidzĩewo katã, wo srɔ̃wo kple wo ŋutsuviwo kpakple wo nyɔnuviwo, siwo tso ameha blibo la me ŋuti, elabena wowɔ nu kɔkɔeawo ŋu do le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: Eye wòde se na ameha, si nye Yerusalemtɔwo, bena woana nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo ƒe gome wo, ne woalé ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe se la ŋu koŋ.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Esi wowu nusiawo katã nu vɔ la, Israel blibo, si va la, ho yi Yuda-duwo me, eye wogbã aƒeliwo, wòmũ Aserawo, eye wogbã nuxeƒewo kple vɔsamlekpuiwo le Yuda blibo la. Benyamin, Efrayim kple Manase, vaseɖe esime wogblẽ wo keŋkeŋ. Emegbe Israel-viwo katã dome amesiame gbugbɔ yi eƒe du me le eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye fia la tso eƒe kesinɔnuwo ƒe akpa ɖeka naɖe numevɔsa ŋu: numevɔsa le ŋdi kple fiẽ kple numevɔsa le dzudzɔgbe kple dzinu yeye kpakple ŋkekenyuiewo dzi, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖe Yehowa ƒe se la me ene.

english_verse: As soon as the people heard what the king wanted, they brought a tenth of everything they owned, including their best grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other crops.
translation_verse: Esi nya sia ɖi wose la, Israel-viwo na bli, wein, ami kple anyitsi kpakple agblemenuwo katã ƒe ŋgɔgbetɔwo, wona nuwo katã ƒe ewoliawo taŋtaŋ.

english_verse: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-vi kple Yuda-vi, siwo le Yuda-duwo me la, hã na nyiwo kple alẽwo ƒe ewoliawo kpakple nunana kɔkɔe, siwo ŋu wokɔ na Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la fũ.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Wodze nuawo ƒoƒoƒu gome le dzinu etɔ̃lia dzi, eye wowu enu He dzinu adrelia dzi.

english_verse: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.
translation_verse: Esi Xizkiya kple amegãwo kpo nu ƒoƒuawola, wokafu Yehowa kple eƒe dukɔ Israel.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya bia nu ƒoƒuawo ta se le nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo gbɔ.

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: Tete nunɔlagã Azarya tso Zadok-ƒe me ɖo ŋu nɛ gblɔ bena: Tso esime wode asi nudzɔdzɔ tsɔtsɔ me va Yehowa-ƒe me la, mieɖu nu ɖi ƒo, eye wòkpɔtɔ taŋtaŋ, elabena Yehowa yra eƒe dukɔ la, eyata nu gbogbo siawo kpɔtɔ.

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya de se be, woawɔ xɔwo ɖe Yehowa ƒe xɔ ta ŋu, eye wowɔ wo.

english_verse: all the extra offerings were taken there. Hezekiah and Azariah then appointed Conaniah the Levite to be in charge of these storerooms. His brother Shimei was his assistant, and the following Levites worked with them: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah.
translation_verse: Yexiel, Azazya, Naxat, Asahel, Yerimot, Yozabad, Eliel, Yismaxya, Maxat kple Benaya, wonye dzikpɔlawo le Xananya kple nɔvia Simei te, le fia Xizkiya kple Mawu ƒe aƒe me amegã Azarya ƒe ɖoɖo nu.

english_verse: Kore son of Imnah was assigned to guard the East Gate, and he was put in charge of receiving the offerings voluntarily given to God and of dividing them among the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ Kore, Yimna vi, si nye Lewi-vi, eye wònye agbonudzɔla le ɣedzeƒekpa dzi la, ɖo nusiwo wona faa la nu, ne woatsɔ Yehowa ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo kple nu kɔkɔeawo nɛ.

english_verse: He had six assistants who were responsible for seeing that all the priests in the other towns of Judah also got their share of these offerings. They were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah. Every priest and every Levite over
translation_verse: negbe ŋutsuvi, siwo ŋkɔ woŋlɔ ɖe dzidzimegbalẽ la me, amesiwo xɔ ƒe etɔ̃ kpakple amesiwo xɔ wu nenema, amesiwo katã va Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me, be yewoawɔ woƒe subɔsubɔdɔwo le woƒe ɖoɖowo nu, abe alesi wohiã gbesiagbe ene la, koe mele eme o;

english_verse: Hezekiah also appointed other men to take food and supplies to the priests and Levites whose homes were in the pastureland around the towns of Judah. But the priests had to be descendants of Aaron, and the Levites had to be listed in the official records.
translation_verse: Eye woɖe ŋutsu, siwo ŋkɔ woyɔ la, na Aron viwo, siwo nye nunɔlawo le woƒe lãnyiƒewo ƒe duwo me, ne woana nu nunɔlawo dome ŋutsu sia ŋutsu kpakple Lewi-vi, siwo katã ŋkɔ woŋlɔ ɖi.

english_verse: Everything Hezekiah did while he was king of Judah, including what he did for the temple in Jerusalem, was right and good. He was a successful king, because he obeyed the Lord God with all his heart.
translation_verse: Eye nusiwo katã gome wòdze le Mawu ƒe a ƒe ŋu dɔwo me le nufiafia kple se la nu, be wòatsɔ aɖi eƒe Mawui la, ewɔe kple eƒe dzi blibo, eye wòdze edzi nɛ.

english_verse: The officials said all these things in Hebrew, so that everyone listening from the city wall would understand and be terrified and surrender.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli sesĩe le Yuda-gbe me ɖo ɖe Yerusalemtɔ, siwo le glia dzi, ne woade vɔvɔ̃ kple ŋɔdzi na wo, eye woaxɔ du la;

english_verse: You've heard what my ancestors and I have done to other nations. Were the gods of those nations able to defend their land against us?
translation_verse: Mienya nusi mia kple fofonyewo míewɔ anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã oa? Ɖe anyigba dzi dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo te ŋu de woƒe anyigbawo tso asinye me kpɔa?

english_verse: The Lord rescued Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from Sennacherib and also protected them from other enemies.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa xɔ na Xizkiya kple Yerusalemtɔwo tso Asur-fia Sanxerib kple amewo katã si me, eye wòna gbɔdzɔe wo godoo va kpe.

english_verse: he and his officials worked out a plan to cut off the supply of water outside the city, so that the Assyrians would have no water when they came to attack. The officials got together a large work force that stopped up the springs and streams near Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eƒo ameha gãa ɖe nu ƒu, eye woxe vudowo katã kple lɔʋu, si si to anyigba la titina hegblɔ bena, ne Asur-fiawo va la, ne womagakpɔ tsia ɖeke o.

english_verse: Hezekiah's workers also repaired the broken sections of the city wall. Then they built defense towers and an outer wall to help protect the one already there. The landfill on the east side of David's City was also strengthened. He gave orders to make a large supply of weapons and shields,
translation_verse: Egla eɖokui, eye wòdɔ gli la ƒe gbagbãƒewo katã do, etu xɔ tsralawo de wo dzi, eye wòɖo gli bubuwo ɖe egodo, eɖo gli ɖe Dawid-du la ƒe Milo ŋu, eye wòwɔ aʋawɔnuwo kple akpoxɔnuwo kpaŋkpaŋ;

english_verse: and he appointed army commanders over the troops. Then he gathered the troops together in the open area in front of the city gate and said to them:
translation_verse: eɖo aʋafiawo aʋakɔ la nu, eye wòƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe eɖokui ŋu le ablɔ me le ɖugbo la nu, eye wòƒo nu kpli wo xɔlɔ̃tɔe gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Be brave and confident! There's no reason to be afraid of King Sennacherib and his powerful army. We are much more powerful,
translation_verse: Mile dzi ɖe ƒo, mise ŋu, eye migavɔ̃ o, Asur-fia kple ame gbogbo, siwo katã le eŋu la, megadzi ŋɔ na mi o, elabena amesi le mia dzi la, ƒo amesi le edzi la ta.

english_verse: When Sennacherib and his troops were camped at the town of Lachish, he sent a message to Hezekiah and the people in Jerusalem. It said:
translation_verse: Le nusiawo megbe la Asur-lia Sanxerib dɔ eƒe dɔlawo ɖo ɖe Yerusalem ɖe Yuda-fia Xizkiya kple Yuda blibo, si le Yerusalem la gbɔ, be woagblɔ bena: — ke eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe amewo katã le Laxis kasa —

english_verse: I am King Sennacherib of Assyria, and I have Jerusalem surrounded. Do you think you can survive my attack?
translation_verse: Ale Asur-fia Sanxerib gblɔ esi Nuka ŋu miele dzi ɖom ɖo be, míetsi tò me le Yerusalem?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah! No god of any nation has ever been able to stand up to Assyria. Believe me, your God cannot keep you safe!
translation_verse: Eyata Xizkiya megable mi, eye wòaganɔ mia flum alea o, eye migaxɔ edzi se o, elabena dukɔ kple fiaɖuƒea ɖeke ƒe mawua ɖeke mete ŋu ɖe eƒe dukɔ tso mía kple fofonyewo si me o, ʋuu keke ne miaƒe mawuwo nahayi mia ɖe ge tso asinye me o.

english_verse: The Assyrian officials said terrible things about the Lord God and his servant Hezekiah.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe dɔlawo gagblɔ nya geɖewo ɖe Mawu Yehowa kple eƒe dɔla Xizkiya ŋu.

english_verse: Sennacherib's letter even made fun of the Lord. It said, “The gods of other nations could not save their people from Assyria's army, and neither will the God that Hezekiah worships.”
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ agbalẽ hetsɔ ɖe alɔme le Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu, gblɔ ɖe eŋu bena: Abe alesi anyigba dzi dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo meɖe woƒe dukɔwo tso asinye me o ene la, nenema ke Xizkiya ƒe Mawu hã maɖe eƒe dukɔ atso asinye me o.

english_verse: People brought offerings to Jerusalem for the Lord and expensive gifts for Hezekiah, and from that day on, every nation on earth respected Hezekiah. Hezekiah Gets Sick and Almost Dies (
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo he nunanawo va Yerusalem na Yehowa kple nu xɔasiwo na Yuda-fia Xizkiya. Tso ekema dzi la eƒe ŋkɔ ɖe du le dukɔwo katã dome. Xizkiya ƒe dɔléle, ŋukeklẽ kple ku.

english_verse: About this same time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. He prayed, and the Lord gave him a sign that he would recover.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke mawo me la Xizkiya lé dɔ de kuku ge. Eye esi wòdo gbe ɖa na Yehowa la, eƒo nu kplii, eye wòna nukunudzesii.

english_verse: But Hezekiah was so proud that he refused to thank the Lord for everything he had done for him. This made the Lord angry, and he punished Hezekiah and the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke Xizkiya mezɔ ɖe dɔmenyo, si wòwɔ nɛ la nu o, ke boŋ ede asi dada me, eyata dɔmedzoe va eya kple Yuda kpakple Yerusalem dzi.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people later felt sorry and asked the Lord to forgive them. So the Lord did not punish them as long as Hezekiah was king. Hezekiah's Wealth (
translation_verse: Tete Xizkiya kple Yerusalemtɔwo bɔbɔ wo dokui le eƒe dada la ta, eye Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe meva wo dzi le Xizkiya ƒe agbenɔɣi o.

english_verse: Hezekiah was very rich, and everyone respected him. He built special rooms to store the silver, the gold, the precious stones and spices, the shields, and the other valuable possessions.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu kple bubu geɖe ŋutɔ su Xizkiya si, eye wòwɔ nudzraɖoƒewo ɖe klosalo kple sika, kpe xɔasiwo kple atike ʋeʋẽewo, akpoxɔnuwo kple nu xɔasi vovovowo ŋu.

english_verse: Storehouses were also built for his supply of grain, wine, and olive oil; barns were built for his cattle, and pens were put up for his sheep.
translation_verse: Etu nudzraɖoƒewo ɖe bli, wein kple ami ŋu, etu lãxɔ na lã vovovowo, eye wòtɔ kpɔ na lãhawo.

english_verse: God made Hezekiah extremely rich, so he bought even more sheep, goats, and cattle. And he built towns where he could keep all these animals.
translation_verse: Etso duwo na eɖokui, eye alẽha kple nyiha gãwo le esi, elabena Mawu na kesinɔnu geɖe ŋutɔe.

english_verse: It was Hezekiah who built a tunnel that carried the water from Gihon Spring into the city of Jerusalem. In fact, everything he did was successful!
translation_verse: Eyae nye Xizkiya, si xe Gixon-tɔ la ƒe nugbɔ, eye wòɖe tɔʋu nɛ to Dawid ƒe ɖu la ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome. Nusianu, si Xizkiya wɔ la, dze edzi ne.

english_verse: Even when the leaders of Babylonia sent messengers to ask Hezekiah about the sign God had given him, God let Hezekiah give his own answer to test him and to see if he would remain faithful. Hezekiah Dies (
translation_verse: Negbe esi wodɔ Babel-amegãwo ƒe ame dɔdɔwo do ɖee, be woabia nukunu, siwo dzɔ le anyigba la dzi ta se la, ko Mawu gblẽe ɖi, be yeadoe akpɔ, ne yeanya nusiwo katã le eƒe dzi me.

english_verse: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including how faithful he was to the Lord, is included in the records kept by Isaiah the prophet. These are written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Xizkiya ŋutinya susɔeawo kple eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔwo la, kpɔ ɖa, woŋlɔ wo ɖe nyagblɔɖila Yesaya, Amoz vi ƒe ŋutegakpɔkpɔwo me ɖe Yuda-fiawo kple Israel-fiawo ƒe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: When Hezekiah died, he was buried in the section of the royal tombs that was reserved for the most respected kings, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem honored him. His son Manasseh then became king.
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe to dzi mɔ, si yi Dawid viwo ƒe yɔdowo gbɔ la to. Yuda blibo la kple Yerusalemtɔwo ɖe bubu eŋu le eƒe ku me, eye via Manase zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: But the people of Judah and Jerusalem listened to Manasseh and did even more sinful things than the nations the Lord had wiped out.
translation_verse: Ke Manase ble Yuda kple Yerusalem wowɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi wu dukɔ, siwo Yehowa tsrɔ̃ ɖa le Israel-viwo ŋgɔ.

english_verse: The people obeyed Manasseh, but they worshiped the Lord at their own shrines.
translation_verse: Negbe ɖeko dukɔ la gasa vɔ le nuxeƒewo, gake Yehowa ye wosanɛ na.

english_verse: Everything else Manasseh did while he was king, including his prayer to the Lord God and the warnings from his prophets, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Manase ŋutinya susɔeawo, eƒe gbedodoɖa na eƒe Mawu kple nukpɔlawo ƒe nya, siwo wogblɔ nɛ le Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ me la, kpɔ ɖa, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Israel-fiawo ŋutinya me.

english_verse: While Manasseh was held captive there, he asked the Lord God to forgive him and to help him.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòɖo xaxa me la, eƒo, koko le Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la ŋku me, eye wòbɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi vevie le fofoawo ƒe Mawu la ŋku me.

english_verse: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. And he continued to worship the stars.
translation_verse: Egagbugbɔ nuxeƒe, siwo fofoa Xizkiya gbã la tu, eye wòɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo na Baalwo, ewɔ Aserawo, eye wòde ta agu na dziƒonuwo katã hesubɔ wo.

english_verse: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods
translation_verse: Eɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe, si ŋu Yehowa gblɔ le be, yeƒe ŋkɔ anɔ le Yerusalem tegbee la me.

english_verse: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courtyards of the temple
translation_verse: Eɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnuawo kple eve.

english_verse: and even set up a stone image of a foreign god. Manasseh practiced magic and witchcraft; he asked fortunetellers for advice and sacrificed his own sons in Hinnom Valley. He did many other sinful things and made the Lord very angry. Years ago, God had told David and Solomon: Jerusalem is the place I prefer above all others in Israel. It belongs to me, and there in the temple I will be worshiped forever.
translation_verse: Etso legba, si wòwɔ la, ɖo mawuxɔ me, xɔ, si ŋu Mawu gblɔ le na Dawid kple via Salomo bena: Matsɔ nye ŋkɔ aɖo xɔ sia me tegbee kple Yerusalem, si metia le Israel-towo katã me la.

english_verse: If my people will faithfully obey all the laws and teaching I gave to my servant Moses, I will never again force them to leave the land I gave to their ancestors.
translation_verse: Nyemena Israel ƒe afɔ nate ɖa le anyigba, si mena wo fofowo la dzi azɔ o, nenye be, wòlé nye sewo, ɖoɖowo kple kɔnuwo, siwo katã mena wo to Mose dzi la me ɖe, asi, eye wowɔ wo dzi ko.

english_verse: The Lord tried to warn Manasseh and the people about their sins, but they ignored the warning.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒo nu kple Manase kple eƒe dukɔ la, ke womeɖo toe o. Manase ƒe ga me nanɔ, dzimetɔtrɔ kple gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: So he let Assyrian army commanders invade Judah and capture Manasseh. They put a hook in his nose and tied him up in chains, and they took him to Babylon.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa na Asur-fia; ƒe aʋafiawo va ƒo ɖe wo dzi: wode ga Manase heɖe aboyoe, eye woɖe kɔsɔkɔsɔe hekplɔe yi Babel.

english_verse: The Lord listened to Manasseh's prayer and saw how sorry he was, and so he let him go back to Jerusalem and rule as king. Manasseh knew from then on that the Lord was God.
translation_verse: Edo gbe ɖa nɛ, eye wosee nɛ, eɖo to eƒe kokoƒoƒo, eye wògakplɔe va Yerusalem le eƒe fiaɖuƒe la me. Tete Manase dze sii be, Yehowa ye nye Mawu.

english_verse: Later, Manasseh rebuilt the eastern section of Jerusalem's outer wall and made it taller. This section went from Gihon Valley north to Fish Gate and around the part of the city called Mount Ophel. He also assigned army officers to each of the fortified cities in Judah.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la eɖo gli kɔtoeto ɖe Dawid ƒe du la ŋu le ɣetoɖoƒe gome to Gixon ŋu le bali la me ɖo ta tɔmelãgbo la nu heƒo xlã Ofel; eye wòɖo wo woka ŋutɔ. Eye woɖo aʋalawo Yuda-du sesẽwo katã me.

english_verse: Manasseh also removed the idols and the stone image of the foreign god from the temple, and he gathered the altars he had built near the temple and in other parts of Jerusalem. He threw all these things outside the city.
translation_verse: Eɖe mawu; tutɔwo kple legba la ɖa le Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me hekpe ɖe vɔsamlekpui, siwo katã wòɖi ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe to dzi kple Yerusalem la ŋuti, eye wotsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe dua godo.

english_verse: Then he repaired the Lord's altar and offered sacrifices to thank him and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He gave orders that everyone in Judah must worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Eɖi Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la, eye wosa akpedavɔ kple kafukafuvɔ le edzi, eye wòde se na Yuda be, woasubɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Manasseh died and was buried near the palace, and his son Amon became king. King Amon of Judah (
translation_verse: Eye Manase mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe eƒe xɔ me, eye via Amon zu fia ɖe eteƒe. Wowu fia Amon, si subɔ trɔ̃.

english_verse: Amon disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done, and he worshiped and offered sacrifices to the idols his father had made.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nusi nye vɔ̃ le Yehowa ŋku me, abe alesi fofoa Manase wɔ ene, eye Amon sa vɔ na legba, siwo katã fofoa Manase wɔ, eye wòsubɔ wo.

english_verse: Manasseh had turned back to the Lord, but Amon refused to do that. Instead, he sinned even more than his father.
translation_verse: Ke mebɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi le Yehowa ŋku me, abe alesi fofoa Manase va bɔbɔ eɖokui ene o; ke boŋ Amon sia na vodada la sɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Some of Amon's officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe dɔlawo ɖo nugbe ɖe eŋu hewui le eƒe me.

english_verse: But the people of Judah killed the murderers of Amon and made his son Josiah king.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ hahoo la tsɔ via Yosiya ɖo fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Hilkiah and the four other men left at once and went to talk with Huldah the prophet. Her husband was Shallum, who was in charge of the king's clothes. Huldah lived in the northern part of Jerusalem, and when they met in her home,

english_verse: In the eighteenth year of Josiah's rule in Judah, after he had removed all the sinful things from the land and from the Lord's temple, he sent three of his officials to repair the temple.
