translation_verse: Le eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒe wuienyilia me, esime wòklɔ anyigba kple aƒea ŋu la, edɔ Safan, Azalya vi, kple dumegã Maaseya kpakple Yoax, Yoaxaz vi, amesi nye fia ƒe tsiami la ɖa, be woaɖɔ Yehowa, ete Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖo.

english_verse: After Josiah had finished reading, he stood in the place reserved for the king. He promised in the Lord's name to faithfully obey the Lord and to follow his laws and teachings that were written in the book.
translation_verse: Eye fia la tsi tre ɖe enɔƒe, eye wòbia nu kple Yehowa be, yeadze Yehowa yome, eye yealé eƒe sewo, ɖaseɖiɖiwo kple ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me, eye yeawɔ nubabla ƒe nyawo, esiwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la dzi.

english_verse: He watched as the altars for the worship of the god Baal were torn down, and as the nearby incense altars were smashed. The Asherah poles, the idols, and the stone images were also smashed, and the pieces were scattered over the graves of their worshipers.
translation_verse: Wogbã Baal ƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo kple ɣelegba, siwo le wo dzi la, le eƒe ŋku me, wòmũ Aserawo, eye wogbã aklama kpakpɛwo kple legba kɔkɔwo, eye wotu wo helɔ kɔ ɖe amesiwo sa vɔ na wo la ƒe yɔdowo dzi.

english_verse: At once he called together Hilkiah, Shaphan, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, and his own servant Asaiah. He said,
translation_verse: Eye fia la de se na Xilkiya kple Axikam, Safan vi, Abdon, Mixa vi, kple agbalẽŋlɔla Safan kpakple fía ƒe subɔla Asaya bena:

english_verse: Shaphan took the book to Josiah and reported, “Your officials are doing everything you wanted.
translation_verse: Safan tsɔ agbalẽ la vɛ na fia la, eye wòhe gbe vɛ na fia la gblɔ bena: Nusiwo katã wò dɔlawo ɖo la, wowɔ wo.

english_verse: Josiah then had the bones of the pagan priests burned on the altars. And so Josiah got rid of the worship of foreign gods in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Etɔ dzo nunɔlawo ƒe ƒuwo le woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo dzi, eye wòklɔ Yuda kple Yerusalem ŋu.

english_verse: He did the same things in the towns and ruined villages in the territories of West Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as the border of Naphtali.
translation_verse: Ewɔe le Manase, Efrayim kple Simeon ƒe duwo, le woƒe aƒedowo me godoo va kpe vaseɖe Naftali.

english_verse: Everywhere in the northern kingdom of Israel, Josiah tore down pagan altars and Asherah poles; he crushed idols to dust and smashed incense altars. Then Josiah went back to Jerusalem. Hilkiah Finds The Book of God's Law (

english_verse: These three men went to Hilkiah the high priest. They gave him the money that the Levite guards had collected from the people of West Manasseh, Ephraim, and the rest of Israel, as well as those living in Judah, Benjamin, and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye woyi nunɔlagã Xilkiya gbɔ hetsɔ ga, siwo wohe vu Mawu ƒe aƒe me la na, ga, si Lewi-vi, siwo nye kpuinudzɔlawo, dzɔ le Manase kple Efrayim kpakple Israel ƒe ame kpɔtɔeawo katã, Yuda blibo la kple Benyamin kpakple Yerusalemtɔwo si.

english_verse: Then the money was turned over to the men who supervised the repairs to the temple. They used some of it to pay the workers,
translation_verse: Wotsɔ wo na dɔnunɔlawo, siwo wotsɔ ɖo Yehowa ƒe aƒe la nu, ne woaɖɔ aƒe la ƒe gbagbãƒewo ɖo.

english_verse: and they gave the rest of it to the carpenters and builders, who used it to buy the stone and wood they needed to repair the other buildings that Judah's kings had not taken care of.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ wo na atikpalawo kple gliɖolawo, ne woaƒle kpe fufuwo kple daɖedzitiwo, ne woawɔ daɖedziwo na xɔ, siwo Yuda-fiawo gblẽ la.

english_verse: The workers were honest, and their supervisors were Jahath and Obadiah from the Levite clan of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam from the Levite clan of Kohath. Other Levites, who were all skilled musicians,
translation_verse: Ŋutsuawo wɔ dɔla le anukware me. Eye wotsɔ Yaxat kple Obadya, amesiwo nye Lewi-viwo tso Merari viwo dome, kple Zaxarya kpakple Mesulam, amesiwo tso Kehat viwo dome, do wo nu; eye wotsɔ Lewi-vi, siwo katã nya saŋkuƒoƒo la,

translation_verse: Esime fia la se se la me nyawo la, edze eƒe awuwo.

english_verse: “Josiah, I am the Lord! And I intend to punish this country and everyone in it, just as this book says.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple liƒode, siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ, si woxlẽ na Yuda-fia me la, ava teƒe sia kple eme nɔlawo dzi;

english_verse: The people of Judah and Israel have rejected me. They have offered sacrifices to foreign gods and have worshiped their own idols. I can't stand it any longer. I am furious.
translation_verse: elabena wogblẽm ɖi, eye wodo dzudzɔ na mawu tutɔwo, ne woatsɔ woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã ado dziku nam; eyata nye dɔmedzoe va nɔƒe sia dzi, eye enu matso o.

english_verse: Then he asked the people of Jerusalem and Benjamin to make that same promise and to obey the God their ancestors had worshiped.

english_verse: Josiah destroyed all the idols in the territories of Israel, and he commanded everyone in Israel to worship only the Lord God. The people did not turn away from the Lord God of their ancestors for the rest of Josiah's rule as king.
translation_verse: Yosiya ɖe, ŋunyɔnuwo katã le Israel-nyigba-wo katã dzi, eye wozi amesiwo katã le Israel la dzɔ be, woasubɔ Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la. Eye womete ɖa le Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la ŋu le eƒe agbenɔɣi katã o.

english_verse: During the battle an Egyptian soldier shot Josiah with an arrow. Josiah told his servants, “Get me out of here! I've been hit.”

english_verse: Neco sent the following message to Josiah: I'm not attacking you, king of Judah! We're not even at war. But God has told me to quickly attack my enemy. God is on my side, so if you try to stop me, he will punish you.
translation_verse: Tete wòdo amewo ɖo ɖee, ne woagblɔ nɛ bena: Yuda-fia, nya ka le mia kpli wò dome? Menye ŋuwòe meho ɖo egbea o, ke boŋ ɖe aƒe, si mía kplii míele aʋa dzi la ŋu, eye Mawu be, mawo kaba. Eyata ɖe asi le Mawu, si li kplim la ŋu, ne magagblẽ wò o!

english_verse: Josiah commanded that Passover be celebrated in Jerusalem to honor the Lord. So, on the fourteenth day of the first month, the lambs were killed for the Passover celebration.

english_verse: Get ready to do the work that David and Solomon assigned to you, according to your clans.

english_verse: When the people bring you their Passover lamb, you must kill it and prepare it to be sacrificed to the Lord. Make sure the people celebrate according to the instructions that the Lord gave Moses, and don't do anything to make yourselves unclean and unacceptable.
translation_verse: Miwu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie ƒe lã la, eye mikɔ mia ɖokui ŋu, ne miadzrae ɖo na mia nɔviwo, ne woawɔ nu ɖe Mawu ƒe nya, si wògblɔ to Mose dzi la nu.

translation_verse: Eye eƒe amegãwo na nu dukɔ la, nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo faa. Xilkiya kple Zaxarya kpakple Yexiel, amesiwo nye Mawu ƒe aƒe la ƒe amegãwo la, tsɔ alẽvi kple gbɔ̃vi akpe eve kple alafa ade kple nyi alafa etɔ̃ na nunɔlawo ɖe ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie ƒe vɔsa la ŋu.

english_verse: When everything was ready to celebrate Passover, the priests and the Levites stood where Josiah had told them.

english_verse: Then the Levites killed and skinned the Passover lambs, and they handed some of the blood to the priests, who splattered it on the altar.
translation_verse: Wowu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie ƒe lãwo, eye nunɔlawo hlẽ ʋu la tso wo si me, eye Lewi-viwo ko agbalẽ le wo ŋu.

english_verse: The Levites set aside the parts of the animal that the worshipers needed for their sacrifices to please the Lord, just as the Law of Moses required. They also did the same thing with the bulls.
translation_verse: Woɖe numevɔsawo hetsɔ na dukɔ hahoo la ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe hawo, ne woatsɔ wo asa vɔe na Yehowa, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖe Mose ƒe agbalẽ me ene. Alea wowɔ nyiawo hãe.

english_verse: They sacrificed the Passover animals on the altar and boiled the meat for the other offerings in pots, kettles, and pans. Then they quickly handed the meat to the people so they could eat it.
translation_verse: Womè ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie ƒe lã la le dzo me le ɖoɖo la nu, ko woɖa nunana kɔkɔeawo le gaze, ze kple agbawo me hetsɔ yi na dukɔ hahoo la katã.

english_verse: All day long, the priests were busy offering sacrifices and burning the animals' fat on the altar. And when everyone had finished, the Levites prepared Passover animals for themselves and for the priests.
translation_verse: Emegbe wowɔe na woawo ŋutɔ ɖokui kple nunɔlawo; elabena nunɔlawo, siwo nye Aron viwo, le dzo tom numevɔsa kple amiawo, vaseɖe esime zã do. Eyata Lewi-viwo wɔe na woawo ŋutɔ ɖokui kple nunɔlawo, siwo nye Aron vi wo hã

english_verse: So on that day, Passover was celebrated to honor the Lord, and sacrifices were offered on the altar to him, just as Josiah had commanded.

english_verse: Some time later, King Neco of Egypt led his army to the city of Carchemish on the Euphrates River. And Josiah led his troops north to meet the Egyptians in battle.

english_verse: But Josiah ignored Neco's warning, even though it came from God! Instead, he disguised himself and marched into battle against Neco in the valley near Megiddo.

english_verse: They carried Josiah out of his chariot, then put him in the other chariot he had there and took him back to Jerusalem, where he soon died. He was buried beside his ancestors, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem mourned his death.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe dɔlawo ɖee le tasiaɖam la me hetsɔ de eƒe tasiaɖam evelia me, eye wokplɔe va Yerusalem. Eye wòku, eye woɖii ɖe fofoawo ɖiƒe, eye Yuda blibo la kple Yerusalem fia na Yosiya.

english_verse: Jeremiah the prophet wrote a funeral song in honor of Josiah. And since then, anyone in Judah who mourns the death of Josiah sings that song. It is included in the collection of funeral songs.

english_verse: The message said: I am King Cyrus of Persia. The Lord God of heaven has made me the ruler of every nation on earth. He has also chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over any of his people who want to go back to Judah.
translation_verse: Persia-fia Kores ƒe gbe enye si: Yehowa, dziƒo Mawu la, tsɔ anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo katã nam, eye wòde se nam be, matu xɔ na ye ɖe Yerusalem le Yuda. Eyata mi eƒe dukɔ la dome amesiame neyi, eye Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la, anɔ kplii!

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar also carried off many of the valuable things in the Lord's temple, and he put them in his palace in Babylon.
translation_verse: Eye Nebukadnezar fɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ŋu dɔwɔnua ɖewo yi Babel, eye wòtsɔ wo da ɖe eƒe fiasã me le Babel.

english_verse: The Lord sent King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to attack Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar killed the young men who were in the temple, and he showed no mercy to anyone, whether man or woman, young or old. God let him kill everyone in the city.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔ Kaldeatɔwo ƒe fia va ƒu wo, amesi wu woƒe ɖekakpuiwo kple yi ɖe woƒe kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe aƒe me, eye meve ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo, ame tsitsiwo kple amegã ɖeɖiwo nu o; etsɔ wo katã de asi nɛ.

translation_verse: Eye wòlɔ Mawu ƒe aƒe ŋu dɔwɔnuwo katã, gãwo kple sueawo, kple Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me kesinɔnuwo kpakple fia kple amegãwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo; etsɔ wo katã yi Babel.

english_verse: In the spring of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had Jehoiachin arrested and taken to Babylon, along with more of the valuable items in the temple. Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Zedekiah king of Judah. King Zedekiah of Judah (
translation_verse: Esi ƒe trɔ la, fia Nebukadnezar do woɖakplɔe va Babel, eye wofɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe me ŋu dɔwɔnu veviwo kpe ɖe eŋu, eye wòtsɔ nɔvia Zedekiya ɖo fia ɖe Yuda kple Yerusalem nu. Zedekiya. Babilonia boyo me nɔnɔ.

translation_verse: Ekplɔ amesiwo metsi yi nu o la, yi Babel, eye wòzu eya kple viawo ƒe dɔlawo, vaseɖe esime Persiatɔwo ƒe dziɖuɣi ɖo,

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord his God and refused to change his ways, even after a warning from Jeremiah, the Lord's prophet.
translation_verse: Ewo nusi nye vɔ̃ le Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la ŋku me, eye mebɔbɔ eɖokui na nyagblɔɖila Yeremya, amesi do Yehowa ƒe numegbe la o.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had forced Zedekiah to promise in God's name that he would be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn and refused to turn back to the Lord God of Israel, so he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Edze aglã ɖe fia Nebukadnezar, amesi na wòta Mawu nɛ la hã ŋu, esẽ ʋu me, eye wosẽ eƒe ta me, ale be metrɔ ɖe Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la ŋu o.

english_verse: The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord's holy temple unfit for worship.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo ƒe amegãwo katã hã kple dukɔ la wɔ nu tovo geɖe le dukɔwo ƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã nu, eye wodo gu Yehowa ƒe aƒe, si ŋu wòka le Yerusalem.

english_verse: But the Lord God felt sorry for his people, and instead of destroying the temple, he sent prophets who warned the people over and over about their sins.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa, wo fofowo ƒe Mawu la, ɖo eƒe dɔlawo ɖe wo enuenu, elabena Yehowa kpɔ eƒe dukɔ kple eƒe nɔƒe la ta.

english_verse: But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem. Jerusalem Is Destroyed (

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall.

english_verse: The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.
translation_verse: Eye wo gbɔ nɔlawo katã tsɔ klosalonuwo kple sika, kesinɔnuwo kple lãwo kpakple nu xɔasiwo do alɔ na wo hekpe de nusiwo katã wona laa la ŋuti.

english_verse: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.
translation_verse: Eye fia Kores tsɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe ma nusiwo Nebukadnezar ɖafɔ tso Yerusalem heva da de eƒe mawuwo ƒe me la na.

english_verse: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.

english_verse: When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.

english_verse: Everyone returned to the towns from which their families had come, including the priests, the Levites, the musicians, the temple guards, and the workers.
translation_verse: Ale nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo kple amesiwo tso dukɔ la dome, hadzilawo, agbonudzɔlawo kple gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo nɔ woƒe duwo me, eye Israel blibo la nɔ woƒe duwo me.

english_verse: During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Esi Israel-viwo le woƒe duwo me, eye dzinu adrelia ɖo la, dukɔ la va kpe ta de Yerusalem sɔsɔe.

english_verse: The priest Joshua son of Jozadak, together with the other priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his relatives rebuilt the altar of Israel's God. Then they were able to offer sacrifices there by following the instructions God had given to Moses, the man of God.
translation_verse: Tete Yesua, Yozadak vi, kple nɔvia, siwo nye nunɔlawo, kpakple Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple nɔviawo wotso, eye wodi Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe vɔsemlekpui la, ne woasa numevɔ le edzi, abe alesi woŋlɔe de Mawu ƒe eme Mose ƒe se la me ene.

english_verse: And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Woɖi vɔsamlekpui la ɖe eteƒe, elabena ŋɔdzi ɖo wo ɖe anyigba dzi dukɔwo ŋu, eye wosa numevɔ le edzi ne Yehowa ŋdi kple fiẽ.

english_verse: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.
translation_verse: Woɖu agbadɔŋkekenyuie la, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖi ene, eye wosa numevɔ gbesiagbe ɖe xexlẽme le nu, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖi, eye woɖo na gbesiagbe ene.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: Emegbe wosa gbesiagbe-numevɔ, dzinu yeye kple Yehowa ƒe ŋkekenyule kɔkɔewo katã kpakple emesiwo sa vɔ le wo ɖokui si la ƒe numevɔwo.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Tso dzinu adrelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi wodze numevɔsasa gɔme na Yehowa, esi womekpɔ ɖo Yehowa ƒe gbeɖoxɔ la gɔme anyi haɖe o.

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ ga na kpefulawo kple atikpalawo, eye wotsɔ nuɖuɖu kple nunono kpakple ami na Sidontɔ vo kple Tirolɔwo, ne woatsɔ sedertiwo atso Libanon dzi ato ƒu dzi ava Yafo, abe alesi Persia-fia Kores ɖe gbe na woa ene. Gbedoxɔ gɔmeɖoɖo anyi.

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Esi wogbɔ va Mawu ƒe aƒe la gbɔ le Yerusalem la, Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple Yesua, Yozadak vi, kpakple wo nɔvi susɔeawo, nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo kpakple amesiwo katã gbɔ tso abe yo me va Yerusalem la, wodze egɔme le ƒe eve megbe le dzinu evelia me. Woɖo Lewi-vi, siwo xɔ ƒe blave, kpakple edzivɔwo la, ne woana Yehowa ƒe aƒe la ƒe dɔ nu.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Eye Yesua kple viawo kpakple nɔviawo. Kadmiel kple viawo, siwo nye Hodaya viwo, do va sɔsɔe, be yewoanɔ amesiwo le dɔ wɔm le Mawu ƒe aƒea ŋu la nu, nenema ke nye Xenadad viwo kple wo viwo kpakple wo nɔviwo, siwo nye Lewi-viwo.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Esi xɔtulawo ɖo gbedoxɔ la gɔme anyi la, nunɔlawo le woƒe awuwo me tsi tre ɖi, eye wotsɔ kpẽwo ɖe asi, eye Lewi-vi, siwo nye Asaf viwo la, tsɔ gakogoewo ɖe asi, ne woakafu Yehowa, abe alesi Israel-fia Dawid ɖo ene.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Wodzi kafukafuha kple akpedaha na Yehowa be. Eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee ɖe Israel dzi Eye ɖukɔ blibo la tso aseye sesie, esime wole Yehowa kɔfum, le esi woɖo Yehowa ƒe xɔ la gɔme anyi ŋuti.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo kpakple eƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo dometɔ geɖewo, amegã ɖeɖi, siwo kpɔ xɔ gbãtɔ la, esi woɖo xɔ sia gɔme anyi le wo ŋku me la, wofa avi kple ɣli, ke ame geɖewo le aseye tsom hele dzidzɔ kpɔm, eye aƒa ɖe dzi hoo,

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: ele be dukɔ la mete ŋu de vovo ameha la ƒe dzidzɔseye kple avifagbe dome o; elabena dukɔ la tso dzidzɔseye sesĩ, eye wose ɣli la le didiƒe ke.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yuɖa kple Benyamin ƒe ketɔwo se be, aboyoviwo le gbedoxɔ tum na Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la,

english_verse: So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
translation_verse: wova Zerubabel kple aƒekɔwo ƒe lalɔwo gbɔ gblɔ na wo bena; Míawo hã míatui kpli mi, elabena míele mía Mawu la dim abe míawo ke ene, eye eya míele vɔ sam na tso gbesigbe Asur-fia Asar-Xadon kple mi va afisiae la.

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Tem Zerubabel kple Yesua kpakple Israel ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔ mamleawo ɖo ŋu na wo bena: Medze be, mía kpli miawo míatu xɔ na mia Mawu la o, ke boŋ míawo ɖeɖe míatui na Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, abe alesi Persia-fia Kores de se na mi ene.

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Eye anyigba dzi dukɔ la do alogblɔdɔ Yuda-dukɔ la, eye wodo ŋɔdzi na wo le xɔ la tutu me.

english_verse: During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work. Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
translation_verse: Wode aɖaŋuɖolawo ɖewo ŋu, be woagblẽ woƒe tameɖoɖo la me, tso Persia-fia Kores ƒe agbenɔɣi katã vaseɖe Persia-fia Dario ƒe fiaɖuɖu me.

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Esi Axasweros le fia ɖum la, woŋlɔ agbalẽ tso Yudatɔwo kple Yerusalemtɔwo nu le eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe gɔmedzedzea me.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Le Artaxsasta ŋɔli la Bislam, Mitredal, Tabeel kple wo nɔvi mamleawo ŋlɔ agbalẽ ɖo ɖe Persia-fia Artaxsasta. Woŋlɔ agbalẽ la ɖe Aramgbe me eye woɖe egɔme ɖe Persia-gbe me.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe fia Artaxsasta la me nya enye si: Wò dɔlawo, ŋutsu, siwo le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi, kple nya bubuwo.

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: Fia la nanyae be, Yudatɔ, siwo tso gbɔwò va mia gbɔ le Yerusalem la, gale du dzeaglã vɔ̃ɖi la tsom, wole gliawo nu flɔm, eye wole woƒe anyinɔwo ɖɔm ɖo.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Azɔ fia la nanyae be, ne wotso du sia, eye woflɔ gliawo nu la, ekema woagbe nudzɔdzɔ, adzɔ kple mɔtaho nana, eye mlɔe ke la woade fiawɔ bla me.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Eyata esi wonye míawoe ɖua fiasã me dze, eye medze be, míanɔ fia ƒe ŋukpe kpɔm o la, eyaŋuti míele ame ɖom ɖa, ne míana fia la nanyae;

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: elabena ne wodzro fofowòwo ƒe nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ me la, ekema akpɔe le nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ la me, adze sii be, du sia nye aglãdzedu, si be gbegblẽva fiawo kple anyigbawo dzi, eye wodzea aglã le eme tso gbaɖegbe ke; eyatae wogblẽ du sia ɖo.

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Eyata míele nanam fia la nanyae be, ne woagatso du sia, eye woflɔ gliawo nu la, ekema esia awɔ be, gomea ɖeke megana asiwò le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi o.

english_verse: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: Tete fia la ɖo du ɖe adaŋumegã Rexum kple agbalẽŋlɔla Simsai kpakple wo nɔvi bubu, siwo le Samaria kple anyigba bubuwo dzi le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi la bena: Ŋutifafa na mi! kple nya bubuwo.

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: Agbalẽ, si míeɖo ɖe mí la, woxlẽe nam dedie.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: Eye meɖe se be, woadzro eme, eye wokpɔ be, du sia tsia tre ɖe fiawo ŋu tso gbaɖegbe ke, wowɔa ʋunyaʋunya, eye wodzea aglã le eme.

english_verse: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
translation_verse: Fia sẽŋuwo nɔ Yerusalem, wokpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe anyigba siwo katã le tɔsisi la ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe gome la dzi, eye wona nudzɔdzɔ kple adzɔ kple mɔtaho wo.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Eyata mide se, ne woaxe mɔ na ŋutsuawo, be womagatso du sia o, vaseɖe esime made se hafi.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Eyata mikpɔ nyuie, ne miagawɔ ƒome le nusia me, be gbegblẽ la nadzi de dzi, eye wòazu hlã na fiawo o.

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Esi wonya xlẽ Artaxsasta ƒe agbalẽa me nya na Rexum kple agbalẽŋlɔla Simsai kpakple wo nɔviwo la, wowɔ kplakplakpla yi Yudatɔwo gbɔ le Yerusalem, eye wotsɔ sesẽ xe mɔ na wo.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Yemaɣi wodzudzɔ Mawu ƒe xɔdɔ la le Yerusalem, eye wòtsi anyi vaseɖe Persia-fia Dario ƒe fieɖuɖu ƒe ƒe evelia me.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: Eye nyagblɔɖila Xagai kple Zaxarya, Ido vi, gblɔ nya ɖi na Yuɖatɔ, siwo le Yuda kple Yerusalem, le Israel ƒe Mawu, si le wo nu la ƒe ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi Zeruhabel, Sealtiel vi, kple Yesua, Yozadak vi, wotso hede asi Mawu ƒe xɔ la tutu me le Yerusalem, eye Mawu ƒe nyagblɔɖilawo le wo ŋu hedo alɔ na wo.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Le ɣemayi la Tatnai, amesi nye anyigba, si le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi la ƒe dzikpɔla, kple Setar-Boznai kpakple wo nɔviwo va wo gbɔ gblɔ na wo bena: Ameka ɖe gbe na mi be, miatu xɔ sia, eye miaflɔ gliawo nu?

english_verse: Give us the names of the workers!”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ hã bena: Ŋutsu, siwo le xɔ sia tum la ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe?

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Ke woƒe Mawu ƒe ŋku le Yudatɔwo ƒe ame tsitsiawo dzi, ale be womexe mɔ na wo o, vaseɖe esime nya la naɖo Dario gbɔ, eye agbalẽ nava na wo le nya la ŋuti. Agbalẽŋɔŋlɔ na fia Dario.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: Woɖo du ɖee, eye ale wogblɔ enye si. Ŋutifafawo katã na fia Dario!

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: Fia nenyae be, miede Mawu ga la ƒe xɔ gbɔ le Yuda-nyigba dzi, wotsɔ kpe gãwo le etumi, eye wode atiwo gliawo me, wole dɔ sia dzi kple mo vevi, eye wole ŋgɔ dem le wo si me.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: Tete míebia ame tsitsi mawo, eye miegblɔ na wo bena: Ameka de gbe na mi be miatu xɔ sia, eye miaflɔ gli siawo nu?

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Míebia woƒe ŋkɔwo hã la se, eye míeŋlɔ ŋutsu siwo nye woƒe tatɔwo le wo nu la ƒe ŋkɔwo, ne mlína nanya wo.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Ale wokpɔ ɖo eŋu na mi enye si. Dziƒo kple anyigba ƒe Mawu la ƒe dɔiawo míenye, eye míele xɔ, si Israel-fia gãa ɖe tu gbaɖegbe ke ƒe nanewo nye esi va yi la tum.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Esi mia fofowo do dziku na dziƒo Mawu la, etsɔ wo de asi na Kaldeatɔ Nebukadnezar, Babel-fia; eya gbã xɔ sia, eye wòɖe aboyo dukɔ la yi Babel.

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Tete Sesbazar sia va ɖo mawuxɔ la ge me anyi le Yerusalem, eye wole etutu dzi tso ɣemaɣi vaseɖe fifi, womekpɔ wu enu o.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: Eyata ne edze fia ŋu la, ekema nana woadzro me le fia ƒe nudzradoƒe le Babel le afima be, ele me bena, fia Kores de se be, woata mawuxɔ sia le Yerusalem mahã? Eye alesi fia la kpɔ le eŋu la, woagblɔe ado ɖe mí.

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Emegbe la fia Dario ɖe se be, woadzro me le agbalẽxɔ, si me wodzraa nuwo ɖo le Babel la me.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Tete wokpɔ agbalẽa ɖe le Axmeta-mɔ̃, si le Media-nyigba dzi la me, eye ŋkuɖodzinya, si woŋlɔ ɖe eme la, enye si.

english_verse: that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built
translation_verse: Le fia Kores ƒe ƒe gbãtɔ me la fia Kores ɖe se be, woatu mawuxɔ ɖe Yerusalem wòanye teƒe, si woasa vɔ le; woaɖo egɔme anyi, eve wòakɔ abɔklugui blaade, akeke abɔklugui blaade.

english_verse: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ kpe gãwo ãɖo amli etɔ̃, eye amli ɖeka nanye ati; ga, si woɔgblẽ ɖe ete la, natso fiaƒe me.

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Woagatsɔ mawuxɔ me nuawo, sikatɔwo kple klosalotɔwo, siwo Nebukadnezar ɖafɔ tso gbedoxɔ me le Yerusalem va Babel la, ana woakɔ ayi gbedoxɔ me le Yerusalem le wo teƒe, eye woada wo ɖe mawuxɔ la me.

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: Eyata Tatnai, anyigba dzikpɔla le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi, kple Setar-Boznai kpakple wo nɔvi, siwo tso Afarsax le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi, mite ɖa tso afima!

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Mina woawɔ Mawu ƒe xɔɖɔ la! Yudatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzikpɔla kple Yudatɔwo ƒe ame tsitsiwo netu mawuxɔ sia ɖe eleƒe!

english_verse: Starting at once, I am ordering you to help the leaders by paying their expenses from the tax money collected in Western Province.
translation_verse: Eye mene wole se ɖeni le nusi miawɔ na Yudatɔwo ƒe ame tsitsiwo, be woatu mawuxɔ sia la ŋuti. Woatsɔ fia ƒe nudzɔdzɔ le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi ƒe gawo ana ŋutsu siawo dedie, eye womagaxe mɔ na wo o.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Eye ne nane le hiahiãm, eɖanye nyitsuvi, agbo alo alẽvi ɖe numevɔsa na dziƒo Mawu la ŋu; lu, dze wein kple ami la, ekema woatsɔ wo na wo gbesiagbe, abe alesi nunɔla gblɔ le Yerusalem ene, eye womahe ɖe megbe o;

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: ne woado dzodzo ʋeʋẽe na dziƒo Mawu la, eye woado gbe ɖa de fia la kple viawo ƒe agbe ta.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Eye mene wole se dem be, ne amea ɖe trɔ nya sia la, woaɖe ati le eƒe xɔ me aklãe ɖe eŋuti, eye eƒe ate atrɔ zu aɖukpo le nya sia la.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Eye Mawu, si na be, yeƒe ŋkɔ nana afima la, atsrɔ̃ fia sia fia kple dukɔ, si ado eƒe asi ɖa, be yeatsrɔ̃e, eye yeagblẽ mawuxɔ sia le Yerusalem la! Nye Dario ye ɖe sea, ele be, woawoe pɛpɛpɛ!

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Eye Yudatɔwo ƒe ame tsitsiwo tui wòdze edzi na wo le nyagblɔɖila Xagai kple Zaxarya, Ido vi ƒe nyagblɔɖi la nu, eye wotui hewu enu le Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe sedede kple Kores, Dario kpakple Persia-fia Artaxsasta ƒe sedede nu.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Wowu xɔ sia nu vaseɖe dzinu Adar ƒe ŋkeke etɔ̃lia dzi le fia Dario ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒe adelia me.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-viwo, nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo kpakple aboyome mamleawo kɔ mawuxɔ sia ŋu kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ nyitsu alafa ɖeka, agbo alafa eve kple alẽvi alafa ene sa vɔe le mawuxɔ la ŋutikɔkɔ me, eye wotsɔ gbɔ̃tsu wuieve ɖe Israel toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu sa nuvɔ̃vɔe ɖe Israel blibo la ta.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Eye wo ɖo nunɔlawo le woƒe ɖoɖowo nu kple Lewi-viwo le woƒe hawo nu ɖe mawusubɔsubɔ nu le Yerusalem, ahe alesi woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe agbalẽa me ene.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Eye aboyomeawo ɖu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la le dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke wuienelia dzi.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Elabena nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo kɔ wo ɖokui ŋu hahoo; wo katã ŋu kɔ, eye wowu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuielã la ɖe aboyomeawo katã kple nunɔlawo kpakple wo ɖokui la.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-vi, siwo gbɔ tso aboyo me la, woɖui hekpe ɖe amesiame, si ɖe eɖokui ɖa tso anyigba dzi dukɔwo ƒe nu makɔmakɔwo me heva wo gbɔ, be yewoadi Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋuti.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Eye woɖu abolo maʋãmaʋã ŋkekenyuie la ŋkeke adre kple dzidzɔ, elabena Yehowa do dzidzɔ na wo, eye wòtrɔ Asur-fia ƒe dzi ɖe wo ŋu be, wòdo ŋusẽ woƒe alɔwo ɖe Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe xɔ la ŋu dɔwɔwɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Eye amewo tso Israel-viwo, nunɔlawo Lewi-viwo, hadzilawo, agbonudzɔlawo kple gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo dome va Yerusalem kplii le fia la ƒe ƒe adrelia me.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ enye mɔdzegbe tso Babel, eye wòɖo Yerusalem le dzinu atɔ̃lia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔi dzi, elabena eƒe Mawu ƒe asi nyui le edzi.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Agbalẽ, si na Artaxsasta tsɔ na nunɔla Ezra, amesi nye agbalẽfiala kple Yehowa ƒe se la ƒe nyawo kpakple eƒe ɖoɖowo na Israel ƒe nufiala la me nya enye si.

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: Artaxsasta, fiawo ƒe fia, ŋlɔe na nunɔla Ezra, amesi nye dziƒo Mawu ƒe seawo fiala kple nya bubuwo.

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Elabena na la kple eƒe adaŋumegã adreawoe ɖo wò ɖa be, natsɔ wò Mawu ƒe se, si le asiwo la adzro Yuda kple Yerusalem me akpɔ,

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: eye natsɔ klosalo kple sika, siwo fia la kple eƒe adaŋumegãwo na Israel ƒe Mawu, si ƒe nɔƒe le Yerusalem la, faa le ayii,

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: akpe ɖe klosalo kple sika, siwo katã nakpɔ le Babel-nyigba blibo la dzi kple nusiwo dukɔ la kple nunɔlawo ana le wo ɖokui si ɖe Mawu ƒe xɔ, si le Yerusalem ŋu faa la ŋuti.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eyata tsɔ ga siawo ƒle nyitsuwo, agbowo kple alẽviwo kpakple wo ŋu uuɖuvɔsawo kple nunovɔsawo pɛgɛpɛ, eye natsɔ wo asa vɔe le mia Mawu ƒe aƒe ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi le Yerusalem.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si dze mia kple nɔviwo ŋu míebe, yewoawɔ klosalo kple sika susɔeawo la, miwɔe le mía Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu nu!

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Eye nusiwo wotsɔ na wò ɖe subɔsubɔ le wò Mawu ƒe xɔ me ŋu la, tsɔ wo na dedie le wò Mawu ŋku me le Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Eye ne nane hiã le wò Mawu ƒe xɔ la ŋu nèbe, yea ƒle la, ekema na woana wò tso fia ƒe kesinɔnu dzraɖoƒe.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: Nye, fia Artaxsasta, mana woade se na kesinɔnu dzikpɔlawo katã le tɔsisi le ƒe go keme dzi be, nusianu, si nunɔla Ezra, amesi nye dziƒo Mawu ƒe sefiala la, abia tso mia si la, mianae pɛpɛpɛ,

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Woava nusianu, si nye dziƒo Mawu ƒe se la, pɛpɛpɛ ɖe dziƒo Mawu ƒe xɔ la ŋu, elabena nukaŋuti dɔmedzoe ava fia kple viawo ƒe fiaɖuƒe dzi ɖo?

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Eye míele nanam mianyae be, amea ɖeke mekpɔ ŋusẽ be, wòaɖo nudzɔdzɔ, adzɔ kple mɔtaho na nunɔlawo, Lewi-viwo, hadzilawo, agbonudzɔlawo, gbedɔxɔ me dɔwɔlawo kple mawuxɔ la ŋu dɔlawo katã o.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: Eye wò Ezra ɖo ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kple dzikpɔlawo le wò Mawu ƒe nya, si le asiwò la nu, ne woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔ, si katã le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi, amesiwo katã nya wò Mawu ƒe seawo, eye amesi ke menya wo o la, mifia woe.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe mewɔ Mawu ƒe se kple fia ƒe se dzi o la, woabu fɔe ɖe eteƒe, eɖanye wòaku alo woaɖee le ha me o, eɖanye wòaxe fe alo woadee gaxɔ o.

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, mia fofowo ƒe Mawu, si ɖe nusia dzi me na fia la, be wòaɖo atsyɔ̃ na Yehowa ƒe xɔ le Yerusalem,

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: eye wòna fia la kple eƒe adaŋumegãwo kple fia la ƒe amegã ŋusẽtɔwo katã ve nunye! Eye dzi do ƒonye meƒo tatɔwo nu ƒu tso Israel, ne woayi kplim, elabena Yehowa, nye Mawu ƒe asi le dzinye.

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo kple woƒe ƒome, siwo tso Babel yi kplim le fia Artaxsasta ƒe fiaɖudu me la ƒe ŋkɔwo nye esi.

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Bigewai viwo dome, wonye; Utai kple Zabud, eye ŋutsu blaadre kpe de wo ŋu.

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ na wo be: Míele kɔkɔe na Yehowa, eye nuawo le kɔkɔe, klosalo kple sikawo nye nusiwo wona Yehowa, mía fofowo ƒe Mawu la faa la,

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Tete meƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe tɔsisi, si si ɖo ta Axawa la nu, eye míeƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe afima ŋkeke etɔ̃; eye esi melé ŋku ɖe dukɔ la kple nunɔlawo dome la, nyemekpɔ Lewi-via ɖeke le afima o.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Tete medɔ Eliezer, Ariel, Semaya, Elnatan, Yarib, Elnatan, Natan, Zaxarya kple Mesulam, amesiwo nye nufialawo.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Medɔ wo ɖe Iɖo, amesi nye tatɔ le Kasifya, eye mede gbe asi na wo, ne woagblɔ na Ido kple nɔvia, siwo nye gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo le Kasifya, be woakplɔ subɔlawo vɛ na mí ɖe mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Eye esi wònye mía Mawu ƒe asi nyui le mía dzi ta la, wokplɔ Isexei, si tso Maxli, amesi nye Lewi vi, amesi nye Israel vi ƒe viwo dome, kple Serabya kple viawo kpakple nɔviawo vɛ na mí, wole ame wuienyi.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Xasabya kple Yesaya, amesi tso Merari viwo dome, kpe ɖe eŋu; nɔviawo kple wo viwo le ame blave.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Tete mede gbe ƒã le Ahawatɔsisi la nu be, woatsi nu adɔ, ne míabɔbɔ mía ɖokui ɖe anyi le mía Mawu ŋku me, eye míabia afɔ nyui tsɔtsɔ tso esi na mía ŋutɔwo, mía viwo kple míaƒe kesinɔnuwo katã.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Ale míetsi nu dɔ, eye míeƒo koko na mía Mawu la le esia ta, eye wowɔ edzi na mi.

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Míetia nunɔlawo ƒe amegã wuieve, Serebya kple Xasabya hekpe ɖe wo nɔviwo dometɔ ewo ŋu,

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Midzɔ eŋu, eye midzrae ɖo, vaseɖe esime miada wo le Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔwo me le nunɔlawo ƒe amegãwo, Lewi-viwo kple Israel ƒe aʋakɔwo ƒe amegãwo ŋku me le Yerusalem.

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Tete nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo xɔ klosalo kple sika kpakple ŋudɔwɔnu, siwo woda la, be woatsɔ wo ayi mía Mawu ƒe me le Yerusalem. Yerusalem dede.

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Tete míedze mɔ tso Ahawatɔsisi la nu le dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke wuievelia dzi, be míayi Yerusalem. Eye mía Mawu ƒe asi le mía dzi wòɖe mi tso futɔwo kple mɔ dzi xadelawo si me.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Eye m eya Yerusalem henɔ afima ŋkeke etɔ̃.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke eneagbe la woda klosalo kple sika kpakple ŋudɔwɔnuawo le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me de asi na nunɔla Meremot, Uriya vi; Eleazar, Pinexas vi, kpe ɖe eŋu, eye Yozabad, Yesua vi, kple Noadya, Binui vi, amesiwo nye Lewi-viwo, kpe ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Those who had returned from exile offered sacrifices on the altar to the God of Israel. Twelve bulls were offered for all Israel. Ninety-six rams and
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo gbɔ tso aboyo me, siwo nye aboyomewo la, sa numevɔ na Israel ƒe Mawu la, nyitsu wuieve ɖe Israel blibo la nu, agbo blaasieke vɔ ade, alẽvi blaadre vɔ adre kple gbɔ̃tsu wuieve woawɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsae, wo katã wotsɔ sa numevɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Amesi tso Azgad viwo dome, enye Yoxanan, Hakatan vi; eye ŋutsu alafa ɖeka kple ewo kpe de eŋu.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ fia ƒe seawo de asi na fia la ƒe dziɖulawo kple anyigba dzikpɔlawo le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme dzi, eye wokpe ɖe dukɔ la kple mawuxɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Eye esi wowu nusiawo nu vɔ la, amegãwo va gbɔnye gblɔ bena: Israel-dukɔ la, nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo meɖe wo ɖokui ɖa tso anyigba dzi dukɔ, siwo nye Kanaanitɔwo, Xititɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Yebusitɔwo, Amonitɔwo. Moabitɔwo, Egiptetɔwo kple Amoritɔwo ƒe ŋunyɔnuwo me o;

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: elabena woawo ŋutɔwo kple wo viŋutsuwo ɖe srɔ̃ tso woƒe nyɔnuviwo dome, ale be ƒome kɔkɔe la tsaka kple anyigba dzi dukɔawo, eye amegãwo kple dzikpɔlawo ƒe asiwo do ŋgɔ le nu tovo sia wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Esi mese nya siawo la, medze nye awuwo kple nye awu ʋlaya, mekaka nye taɖa kple nye ge, eye mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi de kɔ to.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo katã vɔvɔ̃ ɖo le Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe nya, siwo wògblɔ ɖe aboyomeawo ƒe nu tovo wɔwɔ ŋu la, kpe ta ɖe gbɔnye, eye mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi de kɔ to, vaseɖe esime fiẽnuɖuvɔsaɣi ɖo.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Eye esi wole fiẽnuɖuvɔ sam la, metsi tre tso nye nuxaxa me, eye nye awu kple nye awu ʋlaya la dzedze, eye medze klo heke nye abɔwo me na Yehowa, nye Mawu la,

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Nye Mawu, ŋu le kpeyem ŋutɔ, be mawu mo dzi na wo, nye Mawu: elabena míaƒe vodadawo gbɔ mía ta, eye míaƒe fɔɖiɖiwo kɔ yi ɖatɔ keke dziƒo ke.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Tso mía fofowo ŋɔli ke míeda vo geɖe vaseɖe egbe, eye le míaƒe fɔɖiɖi ta wotsɔ mía kple míaƒe fiawo kple míaƒe nunɔlawo de asi na anyigba dzi fiawo, na yi kple aboyoɖeɖe, na haha kple ŋukpedodo, abe alesi wògale egbe siawo ko ene.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yehowa, mía Mawu, ve mía nu vie, ekpɔtɔ ame susɔea ɖewo ɖi na mi, eye wona agbadɔtsyoti mi le eƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la, ne mía Mawu nana míaƒe ŋku dzi nakɔ, eye wòakpe ɖe mía ŋu míanɔ agbe vie le miaƒe kluvinyenye me.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Elahena kluviwo míenye, ke mía Mawu megblẽ mí ɖi ɖe míaƒe kluvinyenye la me o, ke boŋ eve mía nu le Persia-fiawo ŋku me, ne woana agbe naɖo mía me, ne míatu mía Mawu le xɔ la, eye míaɖɔ eƒe gli gbagbãwo ɖo, eye gli nano mia si le Yuda kple Yerusalem.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: Azɔ mía Mawu, aleke gblɔ ge míala le nusiawo megbe? Elabena míegblẽ wò seawo ɖi,

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: se, siwo neɖe to wò dɔla nyagblɔɖilawo dzi gblɔ bena: Anyigba, si dzi mieva, be miaxɔe woanye mia tɔ la, anyigba makɔmakɔ wònye to anyigba dzi dukɔwo ƒe nu makɔmakɔ wɔwɔ me, elabena wotsɔ woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo kple woƒe nu makɔmakɔwo na wòyɔ tso go ɖeka yaseɖe go keme

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Eyata migatsɔ mia vinyɔnuwo na woƒe viŋutsuwo o, eye migaɖe woƒe vinyɔnuwo na mia viŋutsuwo o; migadi woƒe ŋutifafa kple woƒe nyui tegbee o, ne ŋusẽ naɖo mia ŋu, eye miaɖu anyigba dzi nu nyuitɔwo, eye miagblẽe ɖi na mia viŋutsuwo wòanye wo tɔ tegbee.

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Le nusiwo katã va mia dzi le míaƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo kple miaƒe fɔɖiɖi gã ta la megbe la, elabena to míaƒe dzidadawo gbɔ hã la èkpɔtɔ ame ʋeea ɖewo ɖi na mí…

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: ɖe míagada wò seawo dzi, eye míado ƒome kple dukɔ nyɔŋuwoa? Ɖe màdo dɔmedzoe ɖe mía ŋu, vaseɖe esime miatsrɔ̃ avɔ, eye amea ɖeke makpɔtɔ alo asi oa?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, enye dzɔdzɔetɔ, elabena míawoe nye ame susɔeawo, siwo kpɔtɔ ɖi, abe alesi wòle egbe siawo ene. Kpo ɖa, míele míaƒe fɔɖiɖiwo me le ŋkuwò me, elabena míate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwò le esia ta o.

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Esi Ezra do gbeɖa, eye wòʋu eɖokui me, efa avi, eye wòmlɔ mawuxɔ ŋgɔ la, ameha gãa ɖe ŋutɔ tso Israel va kpe ta ɖe egbe ŋutsuwo, nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo; elabena dukɔ la fa avi vevie.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Tete Yexiel vi Sexanya, amesi tso Elam viwo dome la, xɔ edzi gblɔ na Ezra bena; Mieto vo ɖe mia Mawu la ŋu, be míeɖe nyɔnu tutɔwo tso anyigba dzi dukɔwo dome, ke mɔkpɔkpɔ gale Israel ŋu le esia ta.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Eyata mina míabla nu kple mía Mawu la, ne míaɖe nyɔnuawo katã kple vi, siwo wodzi la ɖa, le nye aƒetɔ kple amesiwo vɔvɔ̃ ɖo le mía Mawu ƒe sea ŋu la ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nu, eye woawɔe le se la nu!

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Tso, elabena nya la le asiwò me, eye míeli kpli wò; le dzi de ƒo, eye nawɔe!

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Tete Ezra tsi tre, eye wona, amegã, siwo tso nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo kpakple dukɔ blibo la: dome la, woka atam be, yewoawɔ ɖe nya siawo nu. Eye woka atam la.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Tete Ezra fɔ tso mawuxɔ la ŋgɔ heyi Yoxanan, Elyasib vi ƒe xɔ me. Eye esi wòva afima la, meɖu abolo o, eye meno tsi o. Elabena exa nu le aboyomeawo ƒe nu tovo wɔwɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe meva le ŋkeke etɔ̃ me o la, woagblẽ eƒe kesinɔnuwo kalã gbidigbidi, eye woaɖe eya ŋulɔ le aboyomewo ƒe ha la me, abe alesi amegãwo kple ame tsitsiwo ɖo ene.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Tete Yuda-ŋutsuwo kple Benyamin-ŋutsuwo va kpe ta ɖe Yerusalem le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe le dzinu asiekelia ƒe ŋkeke blavelia dzi, eye dukɔ blibo la haha nɔ anyi ɖe dogba dzi le Mawu ƒe xɔ la ŋgɔ, eye wole dzodzom nyanyanya le nya la kple tsidzadza ta.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla Ezra tsi tre gblɔ na wo bena Miewɔ nu tovo be, mieɖe nyɔnu tutɔwo, ne miana Israel ƒe fɔɖiɖi nadzi ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Eyata miʋu mia ɖokui me na. Yehowa, mía Mawu la, eye miwɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye miklã mia ɖokui ɖa tso anyigba dzi dukɔwo kple nyɔnu tutɔwo ŋu!

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ blibo la do ɣli sesĩe ɖo ŋu bena: Alesi nègblɔ la, nenema míawɔ!

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Ke dukɔ la sɔ gbɔ, eye wonye tsidzaɣi, be womate ŋu anɔ tsitre ɖe xexe o, eye dɔ la menye ŋkeke ɖeka alo ŋkeke eve tɔ wònye o, elabena míaƒe dzidadawo sɔ gbɔ le nya sia me.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Woaɖo míaƒe amegãwo na ameha blibo la, eye amesiame, si le míaƒe duwo me, ɖe nyɔnu tutɔwo la, nava le ɣeyiɣi tɔxɛ dzi, eve du la ƒe ame tsitsiwo kpe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo nakpe de wo ŋu, vaseɖe esime míana mía Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe nu nafa de mía ŋu le nya sia ta.

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Negbe Yonatan, Asahel vi, kple Yaxzeya, Tikwa vi, koe tsi tre de nya la ŋu, eye Mesulam kple Sabetai, amesiwo nye Lewi-viwo la, de wo dzi.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Ke aboyomeawo wɔ nenema, eye wotia nunɔla Ezra kple ŋutsu, siwo nye aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo le woƒe aƒekɔwo nu, amesiame kple eƒe ŋkɔ; eye wodi ʋɔnu le dzinu ewolia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi be, woadzro nya la me.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Eye wowu nya la nu na ŋutsu, siwo katã de nyɔnu tutɔwo, vaseɖe dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi.

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;
translation_verse: eye woɖo be, yewoaɖe asi le yewo siawo bu, eye yewoana agbo ɖeka woawɔ fɔɖivɔsa de yewoƒe fɔɖiɖi la ta.

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Imer viwo dome la, wonye Xanani kple Zebadya.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Xarim viwo dome la, wonye Maaseya, Eliya. Semaya, Yexiel kple Uziya.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Pasxur viwo dome la, wonye Elyoenai, Maaseya, Ismael, Netaneel, Yozabad kple Eleasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Lewi-viwo dome la, wonye Yozabad, Simei, Kelaya, eya enye Kelita, Petaxya, Yuda kple Eliezer.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Amesi tso hadzilawo dome la, enye Elyasib. Amesiwo tso agbonudzɔlawo dome la, wonye Salum, Telem kple Uri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Esiwo tso Israel, wonye esi. Amesiwo tso Pareos viwo dome la, wonye Ramya, Yiziya, Malkiya. Miyamin, Eleazar, Malkiya kple Benaya.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Elam viwo dome la, wonye Matanya, Zaxarya, Yexiel, Abdi, Yeremot kple Eliya.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Zatu viwo dome la, wonye Elyoenai, Elyasib, Matanya, Yeremot, Zabad kple Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Bebai viwo dome la, wonye Yoxanan, Xananya, Zabai kple Atlai.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Bani viwo dome la, wonye Mesulam, Malux, Adaya, Yasub, Seal kple Yeremot.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Paxat-Moab viwo dome la, wonye Adna, Xelal, Benaya, Maaseya, Matanya, Bezaleel, Binui kple Manase.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Xasum viwo dome la, wonye Matenai, Matata, Zabad, Elifelet, Yeremai, Manase kple Simei.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Nebo viwo la, wonye Yeiel, Matitya, Zabad, Zebina, Yadai, Yoel kple Benaya.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Amesiawo katã ɖe nyɔnu tutɔwo, eye nyɔnuawo dometɔa ɖewo dzi viwo.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Nexemya, Haxalya vi ƒe ŋutinyawo nye esi: Le dzinu Kisiew dzi le ƒe blavelia me, esime mele Susa-mɔ̃ me la.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Xanani, amesi tso nɔvinyewo dome la, kple ŋutsua ɖewo tso Yuda va, eye mebia nya wo se le Yudatɔ, siwo nye ame mamle, siwo susɔ tso aboyo me kple Yerusalem la ŋuti.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Tete woɖo ŋu nam bena: Ame mamle siwo susɔ tso aboyo me le anyigba dzi afima la, wole dzɔgbevɔ̃e gã kple ŋukpe me; wogbã Yerusalem ƒe gliwo, eye wotɔ dzo eƒe agbowo.

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Esi mese nya siawo la, mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi hefa avi, eye mexa nu, ŋkeke geɖe, metsi nu da, eye medo gbe ɖa le dziƒo Mawu la ŋku me

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Ao, Yehowa, dziƒo Mawu, wò Mawu gã, si ŋu ŋɔdzi le, amesi lea nubabla kple amenuveve me de asi na amesiwo lɔ̃nɛ, eye woléa eƒe seawo me ɖe asi la,

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: ke wò to, eye naʋu wò ŋkuwo, ne nase wò dɔla ƒe gbe, si, mele dodom ɖa egbe le ŋkuwò me zã kple keli ɖe wò dɔla Israel-viwo ta, eye meʋu Israel-viwo ƒe nuvɔ̃, siwo miewɔ de ŋuwò la me; mía kple fofonye ƒe aƒe hã míewɔ nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Míewɔ nu gbegblẽ de ŋuwò, eye míewɔ se, ɖoɖo kple kɔnu, siwo nede asi na wò dɔla Mose la dzi o.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu nya, si nègblɔ na wò dɔla Mose bena: Ne míewɔ nu tovo la, ekema maka mi ahlẽ ɖe dukɔwo dome;

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: ke ne mietrɔ de ŋunye, eye mielé nye sewo me ɖe esi hewɔ wo dzi la, nenyo be, miaƒe amesiwo woɖe aboyoe la, de wòle keke dziƒo ƒe mlɔenu ke hã la, maƒo mia nu ƒu tso afima akplɔ ava teƒe, si metia be, nye ŋkɔ nana afima.

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutɔ wò dɔlawo wonye kple wò dukɔ, si nède kple wò ŋusẽ ga kpakple wò alɔ sesẽ.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: Oo Aƒetɔ, ke wò to de wò dɔla ƒe gbedodoɖa kple wò dɔla, siwo wò ŋkɔ vɔvɔ dzrona la ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu, na wòadze edzi na wò dɔla egbea dzro, eye nana ŋutsu sia nave enu! Fia ƒe ahakula menye.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me le dzinu Nisan li me le fia Artaxsasta ƒe ƒe blavelia me, esime wein le egbɔ le metso wein la de esi na fia la; — ke nyemeɖo adã le eŋku me kpɔ o.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: Tete fia la gblɔ nam be: Nukaŋuti neɖo adã, evɔ mele dɔ lém hafi o? Menye nu bubua ɖekee o, ke boŋ nu xam nele le dzi me. Eyata vɔvɔ̃ ɖom ŋutɔ,

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: eye meɖo ŋu na fia la bena: Fia nenɔ agbe tegbee! Nukaŋuti nyemaɖo adã o, esi du, si nye fofonyewo, ɖiƒe la, zu aƒedo, eye dzo fiã eƒe agbowo la?

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Fia la gblɔ nam be: Nuka biam nèle? Tete mede gbe ɖa na dziƒo Mawu la,

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: eye meɖo ŋu na fia la bena: Ne edze fia ŋu, eye wò dɔla ƒe nu nyo ŋuwò la, ekema ɖom ɖe fofonyewo ƒe ɖiƒedu la me le Yuda, na magatsoe.

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Tem fia la kple fiasrɔ̃, si bɔbɔ nɔ exa la, gblɔ nam bena: Ŋkeke nenie nèle ma zɔ ge, eye gbekagbe natrɔ agbɔ? Esi wòdze fia la ŋu be, wòaɖom ɖa la, meɖo ŋkeke nɛ

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: gblɔ na fia la bena: Ne edze fia ŋu la, ekema woana agbalẽm matsɔ ana anyigba dzikpɔlawo le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme, be woana matso me ayi, vaseɖe esime made Yuda,

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: kple agbalẽ matsɔ na fia ƒe ave dzikpɔla Asaf, be wòatsɔ atiwo nam, ne matsɔ akpa mɔ̃ la ƒe agbowo, siwo le gbedoxɔ kple du la ƒe gliwo kpakple aƒe, si me yi ge mala la ŋu. Tete fia la lɔ̃ edzi nam, elabena nye Mawu ƒe asi nyui le dzinye.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Fia la kpe aʋafiawo kple sɔdolawo ɖe ŋunye, eye meva anyigba dzikpɔlawo gbo le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme hetsɔ fia ƒe agbalẽawo na wo.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke esi Xoronitɔ Sanebalat kple Amonitɔwo ƒe ɖɔla Tobiya wosee la, dzi ku wo vevie ŋutɔ be, amea ɖe va nyui di ge na Israel-viwo.

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Esi meva Yerusalem, eye meno afima ŋkeke etɔ̃ la,

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: mia kple ŋutsu ʋeea ɖewo mietso le zã; ke nyemegblɔ nusi nye Mawu de dzi me nam, be mawo na Yerusalem la, na amea ɖeke o; eye laa ɖeke meno ŋunye o, negbe lã, si mede la koe.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Meto balimegbo la nu le zã me heva ke ɖe lovudo la kple akɔligbo la gbɔ, eye meɖe ŋku ɖe Yerusalem ƒe gli gbagbãwo kple alesi dzo fiã eƒe agbowoe.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Emegbe meyi ŋgɔ heva vudogbo la kple fia ƒe la la gbɔ; ke teƒea ɖeke meli na lã, si le tenye la, be wòato ayi ŋgɔ o.

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: Eye mete bali la me le zã hede ŋku ɖe gli la, emegbe metrɔ va to balimegbo la nu hegbɔ va aƒe me.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Ke amegãwo menya afisi mede kple nusi meɖawɔ o; eye nyemeka eta na Yudatɔwo nunɔlawo, bubumewo, amegãwo kple dɔwɔla bubuawo o.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ na wo bena: Miele dzɔgbevɔ̃e, si me míele la kpɔm, be Yerusalem zu aƒeɖo, eye eƒe agbowo fiã oa? Eyata mina míaɖo Yerusalem ƒe gliawo, be womagaɖe alɔme le mía ŋu azɔ o!

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Megblɔ nye Mawu ƒe asi nyui, si le dzinye la na wo, eye meto fiaƒe nya, siwo wògblɔ nam la hã na wo. Tete wogblɔ bena: Míatso, eye míaɖo wo! Ale wodo ŋusẽ woƒe asiwo ɖe dɔ nyui la wɔwɔ ŋu.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Ke esi Xoronitɔ Sanebalat kple Amonitɔwo ƒe dɔla Tobiya kpakple Arabiatɔ Gesem wosee la, woɖu fewu heɖe alɔme le mia bu gblɔ bena: Nuka nye esi wɔm míele, ɖe miebe, yewoadze aglã ɖe fia ŋua?

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Tete meɖo ŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Dziƒo Mawu la ana wòadze edzi na mi, eye mi, eƒe dɔlawo, míatso aɖo wo; ke miawo la gome kple nya kpakple ŋkɔa ɖeke mele mía si le Yerusalem o.

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Tete nunɔlagã Elyasib kple si nɔviawo, siwo nye nunɔlawo la, wotso, eye woɖe alẽgbo la, wokɔ eŋu, eye woɖe ʋɔtruwo enu; wokɔ eŋu vaseɖe xɔ tsrala Hamea kple xɔ tsrala Xananel gbɔ.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Yerixo-ŋutsuwo kpe ɖe eŋu le gliaɖoɖo me, eye Sakur, Imri vi, hã kpe ɖe eŋu le glia ɖoɖo me.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Sena viwo ɖe tɔmelãgbo la wokpae, eye wode ʋɔtruwo, ʋɔtru ŋu gawo kple ʋɔmedetiwo wo nu:

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Meremot, Hakoz vi Uriya ƒe vi, kpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me, Mesulam, Mesezabeel vi Berexya ƒe vi, kpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me, eye Zadok, Baana vi, kpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Eye Tekoatɔwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me, ke woƒe bubumewo meɖe la woƒe Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔ la te o.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Yoyada, Peseax vi, kple Mesulam, Besodya vi, wode agbo xoxo la woli kpae, eye wode ʋɔtruwo, ʋɔtru ŋu gawo kple ʋɔmedetiwo wo nu.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Eye Gibeontɔ Melatya kple Melonotitɔ Yadon kpakple Gibeon-ŋutsuwo kple Mizpa-ŋutsuwo, amesiwo dea anyigba dzikpɔla, si le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme ƒe zikpui ŋgɔ la, kpe de wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Uziel, Xarhaya vi, amesi tso sikanutulawo dome la, kpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me, eye Xananya, amesi tso ami ʋeʋẽe ɖalawo dome la, kpe de eŋu glia ɖoɖo me; eye wodra Yerusalem ɖe enu vaseɖe gli keke la gbɔ.
