english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Eye Refaya, Xur vi, amesi nye Yerusalem-nutowo me ƒe afa ƒe amegã la, kpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Yedeya, Xarumaf vi, kpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me tso eƒe aƒe kasa, eye Xatus, Xasbneya vi, kpe ɖe eŋu le glia ɖoɖo me.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Milkiya, Xarim vi, kple Xasub, Paxat-Moab vi, woɖo gli la ƒe akpa evelia, eye wotu kpoxɔ tsrala la.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Salum, Xaloxes vi, si nye Yerusalem-nutowo me ƒe afã ƒe amegã la, kpakple vianyɔnuwo wokpe ɖe wo ŋu le glia ɖoɖo me.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Xanun kple Zanoaxtɔwo ɖɔ balimegbo la do; wowu enu, eye woɖe ʋɔtruwo, ʋɔtru ŋu gawo kple ʋɔmedetiwo enu; eye woɖo glia vaseɖe akɔligbo la gbɔ wole abɔklugui akpe ɖeka.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Malkiya, Rexab vi, si nye amegã le weingblenutowo me la, ɖɔ akɔligbo la ɖo; ewu enu, eye wode agbo, ʋɔtru ŋu gawo kple ʋɔmedetiwo enu.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Salum, Kol-Xoze vi, amesi nye amegã le Mizpa-nutowo me la, ɖɔ vudogbo la ɖo; ewu enu, eye wògbã eta me hede agbo kple ʋɔtru ŋugawo kpakple ʋɔmedetiwo enu; edo Selax-ta la ƒe gli, si le fia ƒe abɔ ŋu vaseɖe atrakpui, si ɖiɖi de Dawid ƒe dua me la gbɔ.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Eyome Nexemya, Azbuk vi, amesi nye amegã le Bet-Zur-nutowo ƒe afã me la, ɖɔe ɖo vaseɖe Dawid ƒe yɔdowo kasa kple ta, si woɖe, kpakple kalẽtɔwo ƒe xɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Eya yome Lewi-viwo ɖɔe ɖo: Rexum, Bami vi, ɖɔe ɖo; amesi kpe ɖe eŋu le eɖɔɖɔɖo me hena eƒe nutowo me la, enye Xosabye, amesi nye amegã le Kegila-nutowo ƒe afa me.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Eya yome wo nɔviwo ɖɔe ɖo: Bawai, Xenadad vi, amesi nye amegã le Kegila-nutowo ƒe afa me.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Eser, Yesua vi, amesi nye amegã le Mizpa la, kpe ɖe eŋu ɖɔ akpa evelia, si le to dzi mɔ kasa la ɖo vaseɖe aʋawɔnuxɔ, si le dzogoe dzi la gbɔ.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Eya yome Barux, Zabai vi, do vevie ɖɔ akpa evelia ɖo tso dzogoea dzi vaseɖe nunɔla ga Elyasib ƒe aƒe ƒe ʋɔtru nu.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Eya yome Meremot, Xakoz vi Uriya ƒe vi, ɖɔe ɖo yi dzi tso Elyasib ƒe aƒe ƒe ʋɔtru nu vaseɖe Elyasib ƒe aƒe ƒe mlɔenu.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Emegbe Benyamin kple Xasub woɖɔe ɖo le woƒe eƒe kasa; eyome Ananya vi Maaseya ƒe vi Azarya ɖɔe ɖo le eƒe aƒe ŋu.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Eyome Binui, Xenadad vi, ɖɔ akpa evelia ɖo tso Azarya ƒe aƒe gbɔ vaseɖe afisi glia ƒe tɔtrɔƒe, eye vaseɖe dzogoe dzi.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Palal, Uzai vi, ɖɔe ɖo le tɔtrɔƒe la kple xɔ tsrala dzigbetɔ, si le fiasã ŋu le gãxɔ ƒe xɔxɔnu la kasa; eye Pedaya, Paros vi, dze eyome.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Emegbe Zadok, Imer vi, ɖɔe ɖo le eƒe aƒe kasa; eya yome Semaya, Sexanya vi, si nye ɣedzeƒegbo la nudzɔla ɖɔe ɖo.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Emegbe Xananya, Selemya vi, kple Xanun, amesi nye Zalaf ƒe vi adelia la, ɖɔ akpa evelia ɖo; eyome Mesulam, Berexya vi, ɖɔe ɖo le eƒe aƒe kasa.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Eya yome sikanutula vi Malkiya ɖɔe ɖo vaseɖe gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo kple nudzralawo ƒe aƒe gbɔ, tso Mifkadgbo la kasa vaseɖe dziƒoxɔ dzogoedzitɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Ke esi Sanebalat kple Tobiya, Arabiatɔwo kple Amonitɔwo kpakple Asdodtɔwo se be, woɖɔ Yerusalem ŋu gliwo ɖo, eye gbagbãƒeawo ɖe asi xexe me la, dzi ku wo ŋutɔ,

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Ke míawo míedo gbe ɖa na mía Mawu la, eye míeɖe dzɔlawo ɖo wo ŋu keli kple zã le wo ta.

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Tete Yuda gblɔ bena: Ŋusẽ vɔ le agbatsɔlawo ŋu, eye anyiglãgoawo sɔ gbɔ akpa, eye míate ŋu aɖo gli la o.

english_verse: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yudatɔ, siwo tso teƒewo katã le wo gbɔ la, va gblɔ na mi zi ewo be, mítrɔ va yewo gbɔ la,

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: tete mede amewo do anyigbe gome le glia godo le gbagbagbe; meɖo dukɔ la le woƒe ƒomeawo nu, eye wole woƒe yiwo, akplɔwo kple dawo ɖe asi.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Esime míaƒe futɔwo se be, míenyae, nye Mawu gblẽ woƒe tameɖoɖo me la, tete mí katã míetrɔ va gli la gbɔ, eye amesiame yi eƒe dɔ dzi.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Tso gbemagbe nye ɖekakpuiawo ƒe afa woa dɔ, eye afa evelia léa akplɔ, akpoxɔnu kple da ɖe asi, eye wodo gawu, eye amegãwo tsi tre ɖe Yuda ƒe aƒe blibo la megbe.

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Amesiwo le gli ɖom kple agbatsɔlawo siaa tso asi ɖeka le dɔ wɔmi, eye wotsɔ asi ɖeka lé aʋawɔnuwo ɖe asi.

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Amesiwo le glia ɖom hã, ta yi ɖe ali hafi le glia ɖom, eye kpẽkula tsi tre ɖe axanye.

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ na bubumeawo kple amegãwo kpakple ame mamleawo bena: Dɔ la sɔ gbɔ, eye wòkeke ta, míekaka ɖe gli dzi, eye amesiame le adzɔge tso nɔvia gbɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: Alea míewɔ dɔ lae; woƒe afa léa akplɔ de asi tso agudzedze me, vaseɖe esime ɣletiviwo tona.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: Megbiɔ na dukɔ la ɣemaɣi hã bena: Amesiame kple eƒe ɖekakpui natsi Yerusalem ɖɔ, ne woa-nye dzɔlawo na mi le zã me, eye woawɔ ɖɔ le ŋkeke me,

english_verse: who were rebuilding the wall. Everyone who hauled building materials kept one hand free to carry a weapon.
translation_verse: Mia kple nɔvinyewo kple nye ɖekakpuiwo kpakple ŋutsu, siwo nye dzɔlawo le yonyeme la, míeɖe míaƒe awuwo ɖi kpɔ o, eye amesiame ƒe aʋawɔnu le exa.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ la kple wo srɔ̃wo ƒe ɣli ɖi hoo de wo nɔvi Yudatɔwo ŋuti,

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Amea ɖewo gblɔ be: Mía viŋuisuwo kple mía vinyɔnuwo sɔ gbɔ, ele na mi be, míaƒle bli aɖu, ne míatsi agbe!

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Amea ɖewo gblɔ be: Míatsɔ míaƒe agblewo, míaƒe weingblewo kple míaƒe xɔwo aɖo awɔba aƒle blii le ɖɔŋɔli la.

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Eye ame bubuwo gblɔ bena: Míetsɔ míaƒe agblewo kple míaƒe weingblewo ɖo awɔba, bena míate ŋu adzɔ nu na fia la.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Azɔ mía nɔviwo ƒe ŋutilã le abe míaƒe ŋutilã ene, eye wo viwo le abe mía viwo ene; kpɔ ɖa, ele na mí be, míatsɔ mía viŋutsuwo kple mía vinyɔnuwo awɔ kluviwoe, gɔglɔ̃gɔ la mía vinyɔnuwo dometɔa ɖewo zui xoxo, eye ŋusẽa ɖeke mele mía si o, elabena míaƒe agblewo kple míaƒe weingblewo zu eme bubuwo tɔ!

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Esi mese woƒe ɣli kple nye siawo la, dɔme vem ŋutɔ.

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: Tete mede ŋugble, eye mehe nye ɖe bubumeawo kple amegãwo ŋu gblɔ nu wo bena: Miele mía nɔviwo tafam! Eye meɖi ʋɔnu gãa ɖe ɖe wo ŋu

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: gblɔ na wo bena: Míawo míexɔ mía nɔvi Yudatɔ, siwo wotsɔ dzra na dukɔwo la ƒle, alesi míete ŋui ko la, eye azɔ miawo mietsɔ mia nɔviwo le dzadzram, eye wole wo dzram na mía? Ke wozi kpi, eye womekpɔ nyaa ɖeke ɖo eŋu o.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ bena: Nusi wɔm miele la, menye o, Esi dukɔ, siwo nye míaƒe futɔwo, le alɔme ɖem le mía ŋu la, ɖe míagbe zɔzɔ le mía Mawu la vɔvɔ̃ mea?

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Mía kple nɔvinyewo kple nye ɖekakpuiawo hã míedo ge kple bli gbana na wo; mina míatsɔ fe la ake wo dzro!

english_verse: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.”
translation_verse: Migbugbɔ woƒe agblewo, weingblewo kple amitigblewo kple woƒe xɔwo kpakple ga kple bli, wein kple ami ƒe alafaliawo ɖeka, siwo mieɖo na wo la, na wo egbea!

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ bena Miagbugbɔ wo ana, eye míabia naneke tso wo si o; miawɔ, abe alesi nègblɔ ene! Meyɔ nunɔlawo vɛ, eye mene woka atam be, woawɔ nya sia dzi.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: Meʋuʋu nye akɔnu gblɔ bena: Ale Mawu aʋuʋu amesiame, si mewɔ nya sia dzi o la, tso ele me kple eƒe nuwo gbɔe, eye alea wòaʋuʋui wòaɖi gbɔlo! Tete ameka blibo la do ŋu bena: Neva me! Eye wokafu Yehowa. Eye dukɔ la wɔ nya sia dzi. Nexemya zu dufia; gake menye viɖenu ta o.

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Tso gbemagbe, esi wode se nam be, mazu anyigba dzikpɔla le Yuda-nyigba dzi la, mia kple nɔvinyewo míeɖu anyigba dzikpɔnu o ƒe wuieve sɔŋ, tso fia Artaxsasta ƒe ƒe blavelia dzi vaseɖe ƒe blaetɔ̃ vɔ evelia dzi.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Anyigba dzi kpɔla tsãtó, siwo nɔ ŋgɔnye la, do agba na dukɔ la, eye woxɔa abolo kple wein wòwu klosalo sekel blane le wo si gbesiagbe, eye woƒe ɖekakpuiwo hã se ŋuta le dukɔ la ŋu; ke nye la nyemewɔ alea o, le vɔvɔ̃ na Mawu ta.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Nye hã mekpe asi ɖe gliɖodɔ sia ŋu eye míeƒle agblea ɖeke o, eye nye ɖekakpuiwo katã kpe ta ɖe ɖɔ la ŋu le afima.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Nusiwo woɖana gbesiagbe la, wonye: nyitsu ɖeka, alẽ tiatia aɖe kple xewo; nusiawo woɖana ɖe nye ŋutɔ nye akɔta dzi; hekpe ɖe wein vovovowo ŋu fu ɖe ŋkeke ewo nu; to egbɔ hã nyemebia anyigba dzikpɔnu o, elabena ɖɔ la nu se na dukɔ la.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, edo ŋku nusiwo katã mewɔ na dukɔ la dzi nam hena nye nyui.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime Sanebalat, Tobiya kple Arabiatɔ Gesem kpakple míaƒe tutɔ mamleawo se be, mede gliawo, eye gbagbãƒea ɖeke megale eŋu o la, — vaseɖe ɣemaɣi la, nyiemekpɔ de agbo mɔnuwo nu haɖe o —

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: tete Sanebalat kple Gesem woɖo ame ɖem, be woagblɔ nam bena: Va, ne míakpe le kɔƒeawo me le Onobali la me! Ke ɖe woɖo ɖe ta me be, yewoawɔ vɔ̃m.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Eye medɔ ame ɖo ɖe wo, be woagblɔ na wo bena: Dɔ gã dzi mele, eyata nyemate ŋu ava o. Nukaŋuti dɔ la atsi akpo dzi, eye magblẽe ɖi adzo va mia gbɔa?

english_verse: They invited me four times, but each time I refused to go.
translation_verse: Woɖo ame ɖem alea zi ene, eye meɖo ŋu na wo alea.

english_verse: Finally, Sanballat sent an official to me with an unsealed letter,
translation_verse: Tete Sanebalat ɖo eƒe ɖekakpui ɖem zi atɔ̃lia, eye wòlé agbalẽ, si nu wometre o la, ɖe asi.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Ale woŋlɔ ɖe eme enye si: Eɖi le dukɔwo dome wose, eye Gasmu be, mia kple Yudatɔwo mieɖo be, yewoadze aglã, eyata nele glia ɖom, eye nele didim be, yeanye woƒe fia; kple nya bubuwo.

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: Edo nyagblɔdilawo hã, ne woaɖe gbe ƒã le ŋuwò le Yerusalem be: Fia le Yuda si! Azɔ nya sia le fia la gbɔ de ge. Eyata va, ne míade adaŋu kple mía nɔewo.

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Tete medɔ ame ɖee, ne woagblɔ nɛ bena: Nya, siwo nése la, mele eme o, boŋ wò ŋutɔe kpa wo tso wò la me.

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Elabena wo katã le didim be, yewoado ŋɔdzi na mí hele susum be, woƒe asiwo ado agblɔ de dɔ la ŋu, eye womawu nu o. Eyata do ŋusẽ nye asiwo!

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Eye meyi Semaya, Mehetabeel vi Delaya ƒe vi, amesi do ʋɔ ɖe eɖokui nu la ƒe me, eye wògblɔ bena. Mina míayi gbedoxɔ gãtɔ me le mawuƒe la me, eye míado gbedoxɔ la ƒe ʋɔtruwo; elabena wogbɔna wu wò ge; zã mee wogbɔna wu wò ge.

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Tete meɖo ŋu bena: Ame abe nyee ene nana? Nyemayi gbedoxɔ me, be matsi agbea? Nyemele eme yi ge o.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Medze sii be, menye Mawue dɔe o; elabena ɖeko wògblɔ nya ɖi ɖe ŋunye, le esi Tobiya kple Sanebalat wodae ŋunye la ta.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Eyata wodae ɖo, be mavɔ̃, eye mawɔ alea ahawɔ nuvɔ̃, ne nya vɔ̃ naɖi woase ahatsɔ aɖe alɔmee le ŋunye.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku Tobiya kple Sanebalat dzi le woƒe nuwɔwɔ siawo nu hekpe ɖe nyɔnunyagblɔɖila Noadia kple nyagblɔɖila susɔeawo, siwo be, yewoado ŋɔdzi nam la ŋuti.

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Gli la wu nu le ŋkeke blaatɔ̃ va eve megbe le dzinu Elul ƒe ŋkeke blave vɔ atɔ̃lia dzi.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Esime míate futɔwo katã see la, vɔvɔ̃ ɖo dukɔ, siwo katã ƒo xlã mi godoo va kpe la, eye dzi ɖe le wo ƒo, eye wodze sii bena, mía Mawu gbɔ ɖɔ sia tso wowɔ.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la Yuda bubumewo ŋlɔ agbalẽ ɖo ɖe Tobiya edziedzi, eye Tobiya hã ɖoe ɖe wo.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Elabena dzoɖuxɔlɔ̃ geɖewo le esi le Yuda, elabena eya nye Sexanya, Arax vi ƒe to, eye via ɖe Berexya vi Mesulam ƒe vinyɔnu.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Woƒo nu nyuie hã le eŋu nam, eye woɖo nye nyawo ɖe egbɔ. Ale Tobiya ɖo agbalẽ ɖa, be yeatsɔ ado ŋɔdzi nam enye si.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Du la nyadri, eye wòlolo, ke amesiwo le eme la, mesɔ gbɔ o, eye womekpɔ tu xɔwo o. Dukɔ la xexlẽ.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from each family group:
translation_verse: Gibeon viwo le ame blaasieke vɔ atɔ̃;

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Senaa viwo le ame akpe etɔ̃ alafa asieke kple blaetɔ̃.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from the families of Levites:
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawo: Salum viwo, Ater viwo, Talmon viwo, Akub viwo Xatita viwo kple Sobai viwo, wole ame alafa ɖeka kple blaetɔ̃ vɔ enyi.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until he lets us know if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Eye anyigbanua dzikpɔla gblɔ na wo bena, womekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu kɔkɔe-tɔwo ƒe ɖeke o, vaseɖe esime nunɔla natsɔ Urim kple Tumim adoe hafi.

english_verse: Many people gave gifts to help pay for the materials to rebuild the temple. The governor himself gave
translation_verse: Nusiwo dukɔ mamlea na la, wonye: sika dariko akpe blave, klosalo mine akpe eve kple nunɔlawo ƒe dziwui blaade vɔ adre.

english_verse: bowls to be used in the temple, and
translation_verse: Reaya viwo, Rezin viwo, Nekoda viwo,

english_verse: And so, by the seventh month, priests, Levites, temple guards, musicians, workers, and many of the ordinary people had settled in the towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo, agbonudzɔlawo kple hadzilawo kple amesiwo tso dukɔ la me, gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo kple Israel blibo la nɔ woƒe duwo me.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: Agbalẽfiala Ezra tsi tre ɖe kɔkɔƒe, si wotsɔ ʋuƒo wɔe ɖe nusiawo tɔgbe ŋu, eye Matitya, Sema, Anaya, Uriya, Xilkiya kple Maaseya wotsi tre ɖe exa le ɖusi me, eye Pedaya, Misael, Malkiya, Xasum, Xasbadana, Zaxarya kple Mesulam wole eƒe mia me.

english_verse: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfiala Ezra ʋu agbalẽ la le dukɔ blibo la ŋku me, elabena ekɔ de dzi wu dukɔ blibo la; eye esi wòʋui la, dukɔ blibo la tsi tre.

english_verse: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ezra kafu Yehowa, Mawu gã la, eye dukɔ blibo la wu asi dzi heɖo ŋu bena: Neva me! Neva me! Wobɔbɔ hede ta agu de Yehowa ŋku me, eye wotsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: Woxlẽ Mawu ƒe segbalẽ la eme kɔ, eye woɖe eme, ale be wose nusi woxlẽ la gɔme.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Tete anyigba dzikpɔla Nexemya kple nunɔla Ezra, amesi nye agbalẽfiala, kpakple Lewi-vi, siwo le eme ɖem na dukɔa la, gblɔ na dukɔ blibo la bena: Ŋkeke sia ŋu kɔ na Yehowa, mia Mawu la, migaxa nu o, eye migafa avi o! Elabena dukɔ blibo le avi fam, esime wose se la me nyawo.

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miyi, ne miaɖu aminu, eye miano aha vivi, eye miɖo ɖe de amesiwo si ɖeke mele o la, elabena ŋkeke sia ŋu kɔ na mia Aƒetɔ la, migaxa nu o; elabena dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu enye miaƒe mɔ̃ sesẽ.

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Eye Lewi-viwo la akɔ na dukɔ blibo la gblɔ bena: Mizi ɖoɖoe, elabena ŋkeke sia ŋu kɔ; eye migaxa nu o!

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ blibo la yi be, yewoaɖaɖu nu ano nu, eye woana nu amewo, eye woatu aglo gã; elabena wose nya, si wogblɔ na wo la gɔme. Agbadɔ me nɔŋkekenyuie ɖuɖu.

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke eveagbe la dukɔ blibo la, nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe amegãwo va kpe la de agbalẽfiala Ezra gbɔ, be yewoase se la me nyawo gɔme.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Eye yvokpɔ woŋlɔ ɖe se, si Yehowa de to Mose dzi la me be, Israel-viwo nana agbadɔ me le ŋkekenyuie la dzi le dzinu adrelia me;

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
translation_verse: eye woado kpo aɖe gbeƒã le woƒe duwo katã me kple Yerusalem be; Mido yi towo dze eye mitso amiti ŋutɔ ƒe alɔwo, gbemiti ƒe alɔwo, mirte ƒe alɔwo, deʋayawo kple afi dɔdɔewo ƒe alɔwo, ne miatsɔ awɔ agbadɔe, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene!

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ la yi ɖatsɔ wo, eye amesiame wɔ, agbadɔ de eƒe xɔta, woƒe xɔxɔnuwo, mawuƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnuwo kple tsigbo la ƒe ablɔ me kpakple Efrayim-gbo la ƒe ahiɔ me.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
translation_verse: Eye ameha blibo si gbɔ tso aboyo me la, wɔ agbadɔwo, eye wonɔ agbadɔwo me, elabena tso Yosua, Nun vi la ŋɔli la Israel-viwo mewɔ alea kpɔ o vaseɖe ŋkeke ma dzi, eye wònye dzidzɔ ga ŋutɔ.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Exlẽ Mawu ƒe segbalẽ la gbesiagbe tso ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi vaseɖe ŋkeke mlɔetɔ̃ dzi. Woɖu ŋkekenyuie la ŋkeke adre sɔŋ, eye ŋkeke enyilia nye takpegbe, abe alesi wònye kɔnui ene.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Le dzinu sia ƒe ŋkeke blave vɔ enelia dzi la Israel-viwo va kpe la, wotsi nu dɔ, wota akpanya, eye ke le ta me na wo.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-ƒome la ɖe eɖokui ɖa tso amedzroviwo katã dome, eye wote va heʋu woƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple wo fofowo ƒe vodadawo me.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Wotsi tre ɖe wo teƒe, eye wotsɔ ŋkeke la ƒe akpa enelia xlẽ Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la ƒe segbalẽ lae, eye wotsɔ akpa enelia ʋu wo ɖokui mea, eye wode ta agu ɖe Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la ŋku me.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Tete Yesua, Bani, Kadmiel, Sebanya, Euni, Serebya, Bani kple Kenani wotsi tre ɖe Lewi-viwo ƒe kɔkɔƒe la, eye wodo ɣli kple gbe sesi na Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said: “Stand and shout praises to your Lord, the eternal God! Praise his wonderful name, though he is greater than words can express.” The People Pray
translation_verse: Eye Lewi-viwo, siwo nye Yesua, Kadmiel Bani, Xasabneya, Serebya, Hodiya, Sebanya kple Petanya, wogblɔ bena: Mitso, ne miakafu Yehowa mia Mawu la, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe, si ƒo kafukafu kple ŋkɔxɔxɔwo katã ta.

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: Wò ɖeka koe nye Yehowa, wòe wɔ dziƒowo kple dziƒowo ƒe dziƒowo kpakple wo ŋu nuwo katã kple anyigba kple nusiwo katã le edzi, kpakple atsiaƒuwo kple nusiwo katã le wo me la; wòe na agbe wo katã, eye dziƒonuwo le ta dem agu na wò.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: Wòe nye Yehowa Mawu, amesi tia Abram, eye nẽkplɔe tso Ur-Kaldea hetsɔ ŋkɔ ne be Abraham.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: Eye esi nèkpɔ be, eƒe dzi ɖi anukware le ŋkuwò me la, èbla nu kplii, be yeatsɔ Kanaanitɔwo, Xititɔwo, Amoritɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Yebusitɔwo kple Girgasitɔwo ƒe anyigba ana eƒe dzidzimeviwo, eye nèwɔ wò nya dzi, elabena dzɔdzɔetɔ nènye.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ mía fofowoƒe hiã le Egipte, eye nèse woƒe ɣli le Avaƒu la nu.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: Ewɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo ɖe Farao kple eƒe dɔlawo katã kpakple eƒe anyigba dzi dukɔ blibo la ŋu; elabena enya be, dadam wole ɖe wo ŋu, eye nède ŋkɔ ɖokuiwò ŋu, abe alesi wògale egbe siawo ko ene.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: Emã ƒu la me le wo ŋgɔ, eye woto ƒuƒuiƒe le ƒu la titina; ke èxlã wo yometilawo ɖe tɔ me, abe alesi kpe dzea tɔ sesẽwo me ene.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo le ŋkeke me kple alilikpo dodo, eye le zã me kple dzo babla, ne nana mɔ, si woto la dzi nakɔ na wo.

english_verse: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.
translation_verse: Eɖi va Sinai-to la dzi, eye nẽƒo nu kpli wo tso dziƒo; èna kɔnu dzɔdzɔewo, nufiame, siwo le eteƒe, kpakple ɖoɖo kple se nyuiwo wo.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: Ena wonya wò dzudzɔgbe kɔkɔe la, eye nègblɔ sewo, ɖoɖowo kple nufiamewo na wo towò dɔla Mose dzi.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Esi dɔ wu wo la, èna abolo wo tso dziƒo, eye esi tsikɔ wu wo la, èna tsi do tso agakpe me na wo, eye nègblɔ na wo be, woade anyigba, si nèdɔ wò alɔ de dzi be, yeatsɔ na wo la dzi axɔe woanye wo tɔ.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Esi wokɔ nyivi na wo ɖokui hegblɔ bena: esia nye wò Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso Egipte, eye wobɔ ahɔhlɔ̃ ga hã la,

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: mègblẽ wo ɖe gbea dzi o le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ ga la la; alilikpo dodo la medzo le wo gbɔ le ŋkeke me o, be wòakplɔ wo ato mɔ dzii, eye dzo babla la megbe keklẽ na wo le zã me le mɔ, si woto la dzi o.

english_verse: Your gentle Spirit instructed them, and you gave them manna to eat and water to drink.
translation_verse: Ena wò gbɔgbɔ nyui la wo, ne wòafia nu wo; mète wò mana le woƒe nu o, eye esi tsikɔ wu wo la, èna tsi wo.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: Ƒe blane sɔŋ nènyi wo le gbea dzi, eye naneke mebia wo o; woƒe avɔwo medo xoxo o, eye woƒe afɔwo mete o.

english_verse: You let them conquer kings and take their land, including King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan.
translation_verse: Etsɔ fiaduƒewo kple dukɔwo, siwo nèkaka ɖe afisiafi la, de asi na wo; eye woxɔ Sixon ƒe anyigba, Xesbon-fia ƒe anyigba kple Basan-fia Og ƒe anyigba wonye wo ta.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Ena wo viwo sɔ gbɔ abe dziƒo ɣletiviwo ene, eye nèkplɔ wo va anyigba, si ŋu nègblɔ le na wo fofowo be, woayi adaxɔe wòanye wo lɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Then their descendants conquered the land. You helped them defeat the kings and nations and treat their enemies however they wished.
translation_verse: Ɖeviawo yi ɖaxɔ anyigba la wònye wo tɔ, eye nèbɔbɔ anyigbadzitɔ, siwo nye Kanaanitɔwo, de anyi le wo ŋku me; ètsɔ woƒe fiawo kple anyigba dzi dukɔwio siaa de asi na wo, ne woawɔ wo, alesi dze wo ŋu.

english_verse: They captured strong cities and rich farmland; they took furnished houses, as well as cisterns, vineyards, olive orchards, and numerous fruit trees. They ate till they were satisfied, and they celebrated your abundant blessings.
translation_verse: Woxɔ nu sesẽwo kple anyigba wɔnuwo, eye woxɔ aƒe, siwo me kesinɔnu geɖewo le fũ, kple vudo ɖeɖewo, weingblewo kple amitiwo kpakple ati tseku ɖuɖuawo taŋtaŋ; woɖu nu ɖi ƒo ɖa ami, eye wonɔ agbe vivi le wò kesinɔnu geɖeawo me.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: Tete wosẽ to, eye wodze aglã ɖe ŋuwò, wotsɔ wò se la ƒu gbe ɖe megbe, eye wowu wò nyagblɔɖila, siwo xlɔ̃ nu wo, be wioatrɔ wo ɖe ŋuwò la, eye wobɔ ahɔhlɔ ga.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Eyata nètsɔ wo de asi na woƒe ketɔwo, eye woxaxa wo ɖo; woɖo ɣli na wò le woƒe xaxaɣi la me, eye nèsee le dziƒo heɖo xanametɔwo na wo le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã la nu, amesiwo ɖe wo tso woƒe ketɔwo si me.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Ke esi wonya kpɔ gbɔdzɔe ko la, wogawɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi le ŋkuwò me; tete nètsɔ wo de asi na woƒe futɔwo, eye wonyã avuzi le wo dzi; emegbe wogado ɣli na wò, eye nèsee le dziƒo heɖe wo le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã la nu zi geɖewo.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Ezi kpi kpɔ wo ƒe geɖe, eye nètsɔ wò gbɔgbɔ xlɔ̃ nu wo to wò nyagblɔɖilawo dzi, gake womeɖo toe o, eyata nètsɔ wo ɖe asi na anyigba dzi dukɔwo.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke mètsrɔ̃ wo ɖikaa o, eye mègblẽ wo ɖi o le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã la nu elabena Mawu amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla nènye.

english_verse: Our God, you are powerful, fearsome, and faithful, always true to your word. So please keep in mind the terrible sufferings of our people, kings, leaders, priests, and prophets, from the time Assyria ruled until this very day.
translation_verse: Eyata, mía Mawu, wò Mawu gã ŋusẽtɔ, si ŋu ŋɔdzi le, wò amesi lé nubabla kple amenuveve me ɖe asi la, fu, siwo katã dzɔ ɖe mía kple míaƒe fiawo, amegãwo, nunɔlawo, nyagblɔɖila wokple mía fofowo kpakple wò dukɔ blibo la dzi tso Asur-fiawo ŋɔli vaseɖe egbe la, megaɖi nu tsɛ le ŋkuwò me o!

english_verse: You have always been fair when you punished us for our sins.
translation_verse: Tɔwò dzɔ le nusiwo katã va mía dzi la me, elabena èwɔe ɖe eteƒe, ke míawo míewɔ nu tovo.

english_verse: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.
translation_verse: Míaƒe fiawo, amegãwo, nunɔlawo kple mía fofowo mewɔ wò nufiamewo dzi o, eye womelé ŋku ɖe wò sewo kple wò nuxlɔ̃amenya, siwo nètsɔ xlɔ̃ nu wo la ŋu o.

english_verse: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.
translation_verse: Eye esi wole woƒe fiaɖuƒe me kple wò kesinɔnu gbogbo, siwo nètsɔ na wo dome, eye wole anyigba nyadri wɔnu, si nètsɔ na wo dzi hã la, womesubɔ wò o, eye wometrɔ tso woƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiawo me o.

english_verse: Now we are slaves in this fruitful land you gave to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, míezu ɖɔlawo egbe siawo; anyigba, si nètsɔ na mía fofowo, be woaɖu edzi kutsetsewo kple edzi nu nyuiwo la dzie míezu dɔlawo le.

english_verse: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock. The People Make an Agreement
translation_verse: Edzi agblemenu wo le dzidzim ɖe dzi na fia, siwo nètsɔ ɖo mía nu le míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta la, woɖu míaƒe ŋutilã kple míaƒe lãwo dzi, alesi dze wo ŋu, eye míeɖo xaxa gã me.

english_verse: As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests:
translation_verse: Le nusiawo katã megbe la míebla nu ɖikaa, eye míeŋlɔe ɖi na míaƒe amegãwo, míaƒe Lewi-viwo kple míaƒe nunɔlawo, eye míeɖo ŋkɔ ete.

english_verse: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Mixa, Rexob, Xasabya,

english_verse: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation_verse: Zakur, Serebya, Sebanya,

english_verse: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation_verse: Buni, Azgad, Bebai,

english_verse: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation_verse: Adoniya, Bigewai, Adin,

english_verse: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation_verse: Ater, Xizkiya, Azur,

english_verse: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
translation_verse: Xodiya, Xasum. Bezai,

english_verse: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
translation_verse: Xarif, Anatot, Nebai,

english_verse: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
translation_verse: Magpias, Mesulam, Xezir,

english_verse: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
translation_verse: Mesezabeel, Zadok, Yadua,

english_verse: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
translation_verse: Pelatya, Xanan, Anaya,

english_verse: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
translation_verse: Hosea, Xananya, Xasub,

english_verse: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
translation_verse: Xaloxes, Pilxa, Sobek,

english_verse: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
translation_verse: Rexum, Xasabna, Maaseya,

english_verse: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Agreement
translation_verse: Axiya, Xanan, Anan,

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ la ƒe susɔea, nunɔlawo, Lewi-viwo, agbonudzɔlawo, hadzilawo kple gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo kpakple amesiame, si ɖe eɖokui ɖa tso anyigba dzi dukɔwo dome hetrɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe se la ŋu la, wo srɔ̃wo, wo ŋutsuviwo kple wo nyɔnuviwo, amesiame, si ate ŋu ase egɔme ko la,

english_verse: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
translation_verse: Eya enye bena, míatsɔ mía nyɔnuviwo na anyigba dzi dukɔwo o, eye míaɖe wo nyɔnuviwo na mia viŋutsuwo o.

english_verse: We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
translation_verse: de ŋkumeɖobolo, gbesiagbe nuduvɔsa kple gbesiagbe numevɔsa, dzudzɔgbevɔsawo kple dzinu yeye vɔsawo kple ŋkekenyuie vɔsawo, akpedavɔsawo kple nuvɔ̃vɔsawo ŋu, be woalé avu na Israel kple mía Mawu ƒe ale ŋu ɖɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ agblemenu gbãlɔwo kple ati vovovowo ƒe tsetse ɖesiaɖe ava Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me le sia ƒe.

english_verse: To the priests in the temple of our God, we will bring the bread dough from the first harvest, together with our best fruit, and an offering of new wine and olive oil. We will bring ten percent of our grain harvest to those Levites who are responsible for collecting it in our towns.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ mía viŋutsuwo kple míaƒe lãwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo kpakple míaƒe nyiwo kple alẽwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo ava mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me na nunɔla, siwo le subɔsubɔdɔ wɔm le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖe se la me ene.

english_verse: A priest from the family of Aaron must be there when we give this to the Levites. Then the Levites will put one tenth of this part in the temple storeroom,
translation_verse: Míatsɔ míaƒe amɔwɔ kple míaƒe nudzɔdzɔ, kutsetse vovovowo, wein kple ami ƒe gbãlɔwo avae na nunɔlawo le xɔwo me le mia Mawu le aƒe la me, eye míatsɔ míaƒe agblemenuwo ƒe ewolia na Lewi-viwo, ne Lewi-viwo nava dza nuwo ƒe ewolia le míaƒe agblededuwo katã me.

english_verse: which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers. Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room. We will not neglect the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Eye ne Lewi-viwo le nuawo ƒe ewolia dzɔm la, nunɔla, si nye Aron vi la, nanɔ Lewi-viawo gbɔ, eye Lewi-viawo natsɔ nuawo ƒe ewolia ƒe ewolia ayi nudzradoƒexɔwo me le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: The nation's leaders and their families settled in Jerusalem. But there was room for only one out of every ten of the remaining families, and so they asked God to show them who would live there.
translation_verse: Dukɔ la ƒe amegãwo nɔ Yerusalem; ke dukɔ susɔea dzidze nu be, ame ɖekaɖeka natso ame ewoewo dome ava nɔ du kɔkɔe Yerusalem me, ke ame asieke asieke bubuawo nanɔ duwo me

english_verse: Then everyone else asked God to bless those who were willing to live in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ la yra ŋutsu, siwo katã lɔ̃ faa be, yewoanɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families. The Judah Tribe
translation_verse: Anyigba dzikpɔla, siwo nɔ Yerusalem la, wonye si: ke Israel, nunɔlawo Lewi-viwo, gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo kpakple Salomo ƒe dɔlawo ƒe viwo nɔ Yuda-duwo me, amesiame nɔ eƒe anyigba dzi le eƒe du me —

english_verse: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command. Priests
translation_verse: Yoel, Zixri vi, le wo nu, eye Yuda, Hasenua vi, nye ame evelia le dua nu.

english_verse: Four priests settled in Jerusalem. The first was Jedaiah; he was the son of Joiarib and the uncle of Jachin.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso nunɔiawo dome la, wonye: Yedaya, Yoyarib vi, Yaxin,

english_verse: The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest.
translation_verse: Seraya, Xilkiya vi, amesi nye Mesulam vi, amesi nye Zadok vi, amesi nye Merayot vi, amesi nye Axitub vi, eya nye amegã le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tso Lewi-viwo dome la, wonye Semaya, Xasub vi, amesi nye Azrikam vi, amesi nye Xasabya vi, amesi nye Buni vi.

english_verse: Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.
translation_verse: Zabetai kple Yozabad, amesiwo tso Lewi-viwo ƒe tatɔwo dome, eye wole gotadɔwo nu le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me

english_verse: Then there was Mattaniah son of Mica. His ancestors were Zabdi and Asaph. Mattaniah led the temple choir in the prayer of praise. Bakbukiah, who also settled in Jerusalem, was his assistant. Finally, there was Abda son of Shammua; his grandfather was Galal, and his great-grandfather was Jeduthun.
translation_verse: Matanya, Mixa vi, amesi nye Zabdi vi, amesi nye Asaf vi, eya nye kafukafuha ƒe henɔ, amesi doa „Mida akpe“ ɖa ɖe gbedodoɖa, kple Bakbukya, amesi nye evelia tso nɔvlawo dome, kpakple Abda, Samua vi, amesi nye Galal vi, amesi nye Yedutun vi.

english_verse: One hundred seventy-two temple guards settled in Jerusalem; their leaders were Akkub and Talmon.
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawo nye Akub, Talmon kple wo nɔviwo, amesiwo dzɔ agboawo nu, wole ame alafa ɖeka kple blaadre vɔ eve.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Ke Israel kple nunɔlawo kpakple Lewi-viwo ƒe ame susɔeawo nɔ Yuda-duwo katã me, amesiame nɔ eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.
translation_verse: Gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo nɔ Ofel dzi, eye Zixa kple Gispa wole gbedoxɔ me ɖɔwɔlawo nu.

english_verse: Uzzi son of Bani was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem. His grandfather was Hashabiah, his great-grandfather was Mattaniah, and his great-great-grandfather was Mica. He belonged to the Asaph clan that was in charge of the music for the temple services,
translation_verse: Amesi le Lewi-viwo nu le Yerusalem ɖe Mawu ƒe aƒe la ƒe ɖɔwo ŋu la, enye Uzi, Bani vi, amesi nye Xasabya vi, amesi nye Matanya vi, amesi nye Mixa vi tso Asaf vi, siwo nye hadzilawo dome.

english_verse: though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.
translation_verse: Elabena fia la de se na wo, eye wodo kpe gbesiagbe fetu dzi na hadzilawo.

english_verse: The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe. The People in the Other Towns and Villages
translation_verse: Petaxya, Mesezabeel vi, amesi tso Yuda vi Zerax ƒe viwo la, nye fia ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ le dukɔ la ƒe nyawo gome.

english_verse: Some of the people of Judah lived in the following towns near their farms: Kiriath-Arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel,
translation_verse: Yuda-vi, siwo nɔ kɔƒewo me le woƒe agblewo me la, dometɔa ɖewo nɔ Kiryat-Arba kple eƒe kɔƒewo me, Dibon kple eƒe kɔƒewo me, Yekabzeel kple eƒe agbletawo,

english_verse: Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-Pelet,
translation_verse: Yesua, Molada kple Bet-Pelet,

english_verse: Enrimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,
translation_verse: En-Rimon, Zora kple Yarmut,

english_verse: Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.
translation_verse: Zanoax, Adulam kple eƒe agbletawo, Laxis kple eƒe agblewo me, Azeka kple eƒe kɔƒewo me. Eye womlo ɖe nu tso Beer-Seba vaseɖe Hinom-bali la me.

english_verse: The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages,
translation_verse: Benyamin-viwo dze yome tso Geba le Mixmas, Aya, Betel kple eƒe kɔƒewo

english_verse: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
translation_verse: Anatot, Nob, Ananya,

english_verse: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
translation_verse: Xazor, Rama. Gitayim,

english_verse: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
translation_verse: Xadid, Zeboyim, Nebalat,

english_verse: Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley.
translation_verse: Lod kple Ono le atikpalawo ƒe bali la me.

english_verse: Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Eye Lewi-viwo ƒe ha, siwo nɔ Yuda la domelɔa ɖewo nɔ Benyamin.

english_verse: Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo kple Lewi-vi, siwo gbɔ kple Zerubabel. Sealtiel vi, kpakple Yesua, wo ye Seraya, Yeremya, Ezra,

english_verse: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
translation_verse: Amarya, Malux, Xatus,

english_verse: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
translation_verse: Sexanya, Rexum, Meremot,

english_verse: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
translation_verse: Ido, Ginetoi, Abiya.

english_verse: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
translation_verse: Miyamin, Maadya, Bilga,

english_verse: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
translation_verse: Semaya, Yoyarib, Yedaya,

english_verse: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and another Jedaiah. These were the leading priests and their assistants during the time of Joshua.
translation_verse: Salu, Amok, Xilkiya kple Yedaya. Amesiawo nye nunɔlawo kple wo nɔviwo ƒe tatɔwo le Yesua ŋɔli.

english_verse: The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise,
translation_verse: Lewi-viwo nye Yesua, Binui, Kadmiel, Serebya, Yuda kple Matanya; eya kple nɔviawo le kafukafuhadzihawo nu,

english_verse: while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses. Descendants of Joshua the High Priest
translation_verse: Bakbukya kple Uni kpakple nɔviawo tsi tre ɖe wo kasa le woƒe hawo nu.

english_verse: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada.
translation_verse: Yesua dzi Yoyakim, Yoyakim dzi Elyasib, eye Elyasib dzi Yoyada,

english_verse: When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Nunɔla, siwo nye tatɔwo na aƒekɔwo le Yoyakim ŋɔli la, wonye: Meraya na Seraya; Xananya na Yeremya;

english_verse: Meshullam of Ezra, Jehohanan of Amariah,
translation_verse: Mesulam na Ezra; Yoxanan na Amarya;

english_verse: Jonathan of Malluchi, Joseph of Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Yonatan na Meluxi; Yosef na Sebanya;

english_verse: Adna of Harim, Helkai of Meraioth,
translation_verse: Adna na Xarim; Xelkai na Merayot;

english_verse: Zechariah of Iddo, Meshullam of Ginnethon,
translation_verse: Zaxarya na Ido; Mesulam na Gineton;

english_verse: Zichri of Abijah, Piltai of Moadiah,
translation_verse: Sixri na Abiya, Piltai na Minyamin-Moadya;

english_verse: Shammua of Bilgah, Jehonathan of Shemaiah,
translation_verse: Samua na Bilga; Yonatan na Semaya;

english_verse: Mattenai of Joiarib, Uzzi of Jedaiah,
translation_verse: Matenai na Yoyarib; Uzi na Yedaya;

english_verse: Kallai of Sallai, Eber of Amok,
translation_verse: Kalai na Salai; Eber na Amok;

english_verse: Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah. The Priestly and Levite Families
translation_verse: Xasabya na Xilkiya; Netaneel na Yedaya.

english_verse: During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families.
translation_verse: Le Elyasib, Yoyada, Yoxanan kple Yadua ŋɔli la woŋlɔ Lewi-viwo ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo kple nunɔlawo ɖi le Persiatɔ Dario ƒe fiaɖuɖu me.

english_verse: However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔ, siwo nye Lewi-viwo, ɖe nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ la me vaseɖe Yoxanan, Elyasib vi ŋɔli.

english_verse: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.
translation_verse: Lewi-viwo ƒe aƒekɔwo nye; Xasabya, Serebya kple Yesua, Kadmiel vi; eye wo nɔyiwo tsi tre ɖe wo kasa, be woakafu, eye woada akpe le Mawu ƒe ame Dawid ƒe sedede nu, ameha ɖe ameha yome.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.
translation_verse: Matanya, Bakbukya kple Obadya, Mesulam, Talmon kple Akub wonye agbonudzɔlawo, siwo dzɔa nudzraɖoƒexɔ, siwo le agboawo nu la ŋu.

english_verse: All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest. Nehemiah Dedicates the City Wall
translation_verse: Amesiawo nɔ agbe le Yoyakim, Yesua vi, amesi nye Yozadak vi ŋɔli kple anyigba dzikpɔla Nexemya kpakple nunɔla Ezra, amesi nye agbalẽfiala la ŋɔli. Yerusalem glia ŋu kɔkɔ.

english_verse: When the city wall was dedicated, Levites from everywhere in Judah were invited to join in the celebration with songs of praise and with the music of cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Esi wole Yerusalem ŋu gliawo ŋu kɔ ge la, woɖadi Lewi-viwo tso wo nɔƒewo katã vɛ, ne woatsɔ akpedahawo, hadzidziwo, gakogoewo, saŋkuwo kple kasaŋkuwo aɖu glia ŋu kɔkɔ ŋkekenyuie kple dzidzɔ ŋkekenyuie lae.

english_verse: The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.
translation_verse: kple Bet-Gilgal kple Geba-gblewo me kpakple Azmawet; elabena hadzilawo tso agbletawo na wo ɖokui ɖe Yerusalem ŋu goɖoo.

english_verse: I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate.
translation_verse: Mene Yuda-amegãwo de gli la dzi, eye meɖo kafukafuhadziha gã eve, ha ɖeka to glia dzi ɖo ta akoligbo la gbɔ le ɖusi me gome,

english_verse: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them.
translation_verse: wo yomedzelawo nye Hosaya kple Yuda-amegãwo ƒe afa,

english_verse: Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
translation_verse: Azarya, Ezra kple Mesulam,

english_verse: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Yuda Benyamin. Semaya kple Yeremya.

english_verse: and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played musical instruments like those that had been played by David, the man of God. And they marched behind Ezra, the teacher of the Law.
translation_verse: Nɔvia, siwo nye. Semaya, Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netaneel, Yuda kple Xanani la wole Mawu ƒe ame Dawid ƒe hadzinuwo ɖe asi, eye agbalẽfiala Ezra dze wo ŋgɔ.

english_verse: When they reached Fountain Gate, they climbed the steps to David's City and went past his palace, before stopping at the Water Gate near the eastern wall of the city.
translation_verse: Woɖo ta vudogbo la gbɔ, eye wole ŋgɔmɔ tẽ heto atrakpuiawo dzi va Dawid ƒe du la gbɔ; wolia gli la to Dawid ƒe xɔ gbɔ vaseɖe tsigbo la gbɔ le ɣe dzeƒe gome.

english_verse: The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall,
translation_verse: Kafukafuhadziha evelia, si yome mia kple dukɔ la ƒe afã míedze le, to glia dzi le mía me gome ɖo ta kpoxɔ tsrala la gbɔ vaseɖe gli keke la gbɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim Gate, Old Gate, Fish Gate, Hananel Tower, Hundred Tower, and on to Sheep Gate. Finally, we stopped at Gate of the Guard,
translation_verse: Wole Efrayim-gbo, ɖu xoxo la ƒe egbe kple tɔmelãgbo le la me va to xɔ tsrala Xananeel kple xɔ tsrala Mea ŋu vaseɖe alẽgbo la gbɔ, eye wotɔ ɖe gaxɔgbo la gbɔ.

english_verse: where we stood in front of the temple with the other group, praising God. In the group with me were half of the leaders,
translation_verse: Tete kafukafuhadziha eveawo ɖo ɖe Mawu ƒe aƒe la me hekpe ɖe mía kple amegãwo ƒe afã, si le ŋunye la ŋuti.

english_verse: as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets.
translation_verse: Elyakim, Maaseya, Minyamin, Mixaya, Elyoenai, Zaxarya kple Xananya, amesiwo nye nunɔlawo la, wolé kpẽwo ɖe asi,

english_verse: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer also stood there, as Jezrahiah led the singers.
translation_verse: eye Maaseya, Semaya, Eleazar, Uzi, Yoxanan, Malkiya, Elam kple Ezer, amesiwo nye hadzilawo la, dzi ha, eye Yizraxiya le wo nu.

english_verse: God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem. Preparation for Worship
translation_verse: Wosa vɔ geɖe gbemagbe, eye wokpɔ dzidzɔ, elabena Mawu do dzidzɔ gã na wo; nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo hã kpɔ dzidzɔ, eye wose Yerusalem ƒe dzidzɔ la ŋkɔ le didiƒe ke. Gbedoxɔ ŋu nudzɔdzɔwo dzikpɔlawo.

english_verse: On that same day, some leaders were appointed to be responsible for the safekeeping of gifts for the temple and to be in charge of receiving the first part of the harvest and the ten percent of the crops and livestock that was offered to God. These same leaders also collected the part of crops that the Law of Moses taught was to be given to the Levites. Everyone was pleased with the work of the priests and Levites,
translation_verse: Gbemagbe wodo ŋutsuwo nudzraɖoƒexɔ, siwo me nudzɔdzɔ, nu gbãtɔwo kple nuwo ƒe ewolia le la nu, be woadzɔ nu tso agblededuwo me ade wo me na nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo, abe alesi wode see ene; elabena Yuda kpɔ dzidzɔ le nunɔla kple Lewi-vi, siwo tsi tre ɖi,

english_verse: when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon.
translation_verse: eye woƒe Mawu ƒe dɔ kple ŋutikɔklɔdɔ le wo si me la ŋuti; eye hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo tsi tre ɖi le Dawid kple via Salomo ƒe se la nu.

english_verse: In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship.
translation_verse: Elabena tso gbaɖegbe ke le Dawid kple Asaf ŋɔli amegãwo le hadzilawo kple Mawu ƒe kafukafuhawo kpakple akpedahawo nu.

english_verse: During the time that Zerubbabel and I were in charge, everyone in Israel gave what they were supposed to give for the daily needs of the singers and temple guards from the Levi tribe. Then the Levites would give the priests their share from what they had received.
translation_verse: Le Zerubabel ŋɔli kple Nexemya ŋɔli la Israel blibo la na nu hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo, alesi nu hiã gbesiagbe; wotsɔ nunana kɔkɔeawo na Lewi-viwo, eye Lewi-viwo tsa nunana kɔkɔeawo na Aron viwo.

english_verse: On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe woxlẽ Mose ƒe segbalẽ la ɖe dukɔ la ƒe to me, eye wokpɔ woŋlɔ ɖe eme be, Amonitɔ kple Moabitɔa ɖeke megava Mawu ƒe ha la me gbeɖegbeɖe o;

english_verse: This was because they had refused to give food and water to Israel and had hired Balaam to call down a curse on them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: elabena wometsɔ abolo kple tsi va kpe Israel-viwo o, eye woda Bileam ɖe wo ŋu, be wòaƒo li aɖe wo, ke mía Mawu trɔ fiƒoɖe la wòzu yayra.

english_verse: The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms.
translation_verse: Do ŋgɔ na esia la, nunɔla Elyasib, amesi wotsɔ ɖo mía Mawu ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔwo nu, eye wòɖo ƒome kple Tobiya la, dzra xɔ loloe ɖeka me do nɛ,

english_verse: This happened in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes ruled Babylonia. I was away from Jerusalem at the time, because I was visiting him. Later I received permission from the king
translation_verse: Ke nyemenɔ Yerusalem, esime nusiawo katã dzɔ o; elabena le Babel-fia Artaxsasta ƒe ƒe blaetɔ̃ vɔ evelia me la meyi ɖe fia la gbɔ. Le ɣeyiɣia ɖewo megbe la, mebia gbe fia la.

english_verse: to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi metrɔ va Yerusalem la, medze si nu gbegblẽ, si Elyasib wɔ le esime be, wòɖɔ xɔ ɖeka me do na Tobiya le Mawu ƒe eƒe ƒe xɔxɔnuwo.

english_verse: It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture.
translation_verse: Tete dzi kum ŋutɔ, eye mefɔ Tobiya ƒe xɔmenuwo katã ƒu gbe tso xɔ le me.

english_verse: Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.
translation_verse: Emegbe megblɔ be, woakɔ xɔ la ŋu, eye megafɔ Mawu ƒe eƒe ŋu dɔwɔnuawo, nuɖuvɔsa kple atike ʋeʋẽeawo va mee.

english_verse: I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest.
translation_verse: Eye mese be, womena Lewi-viwo ƒe gome wo o, eyata Lewi-viwo kple hadzilawo, emesiwo woa subɔsubɔdɔ la, do me amesiame yi eƒe agble me.

english_verse: I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, “Why is the temple neglected?” Then I told them to start doing their jobs.
translation_verse: Tete meka mo na amegãwo gblɔ bena: Nukaŋuti wogblẽ Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖi? Eye megaƒo wo nu ƒu hetsɔ wo ɖo wo teƒe.

english_verse: After this, everyone in Judah brought a tenth of their grain, wine, and olive oil to the temple storeroom.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yuda blibo la tso bli, wein kple ami ƒe ewoliawo ya nudzraɖoƒexɔawo me;

english_verse: Finally, I appointed three men with good reputations to be in charge of what was brought there and to distribute it to the others. They were Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the teacher of the Law, and Pedaiah the Levite. Their assistant was Hanan, the son of Zaccur and the grandson of Mattaniah.
translation_verse: eye metsɔ nunɔla Selemya kple agbalẽŋlɔla Zadok kpakple Pedaya tso Lewi-viwo dome do nudzraɖo ƒexɔwo dzikpɔlawoe, eye Matanya vi Zakur ƒe vi Xanan kpe de wo ŋu; elabena wobu wo anukwaretɔwoe, eye wonye woƒe dɔ be, woamã nu na wo nɔviwo.

english_verse: I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there. The Sabbath
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, ɖo ŋui nam, eye megana nye lɔlɔ̃dɔ, si mewɔ ɖe nye Mawu ƒe aƒe kple eƒe subɔsubɔhawo ŋu la nu natsi o!

english_verse: I also noticed what the people of Judah were doing on the Sabbath. Not only were they trampling grapes to make wine, but they were harvesting their grain, grapes, figs, and other crops, and then loading these on donkeys to sell in Jerusalem. So I warned them not to sell food on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi mekpɔ be, amea ɖewo fiã wein le dzudzɔgbe le, wotsɔ lubablawo va aƒee, eye wotsɔ wein, weintsetse kple gbotitsetse kpakple agba vovovowo do agbae na tedziwo hetsɔ va Yerusalem le dzudzɔgbe la. Tete mexlɔ̃ nu wo le gbesigbe wole nuɖuɖuawo dzram.

english_verse: People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Tirotɔ, siwo le dua me hã, tsɔ tɔmelãwo kple adzɔnu vovovo vɛ, eye wodzra wo na Yuda-viwo le Yerusalem le dzudzɔgbe la.

english_verse: I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, “This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath!
translation_verse: Tete meka mo na Yuda-bubumewo gblɔ na wo bena: Nu gbegblẽ ka nye esi wɔm miele hele kɔ gblẽm do na dzudzɔgbe la?

english_verse: Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath!”
translation_verse: De menye alea mía fofowo wɔ, eye Mawu he dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo katã va mía kple nu sia dzi oa? Azɔ míegale dɔmedzoe dzim ɖe dzi hena Israel, eye míele kɔ gblẽm ɖo na dzudzɔgbe laa?

english_verse: I ordered the gates of Jerusalem to be closed on the eve of the Sabbath and not to be opened until after the Sabbath had ended. Then I put some of my own men in charge of the gates to make certain that nothing was brought in on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Hafi dzudzɔgbe la naɖo la, mede se be, ne vɔvɔli nye ɖo Yerusalem-gbowo nu ko la, woaɖo agboawo, eye megblɔ be, womegaʋu wo o, vaseɖe esime dzudzɔgbe la nu nayi hafi. Eye meɖe amewo tso nye ɖekakpuiwo dome ɖo agboawo nu, be womagatsɔ agboa ɖeke vɛ le dzudzɔgbe la o.

english_verse: Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods.
translation_verse: Ke asitsalawo kple adzɔnu vovovowo dzralawo tsi Yerusalem godo dɔ zi ɖeka kple zi eve.

english_verse: But I warned them, “If you do this again, I'll have you arrested.” From then on, they did not come on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Tete mexlɔ̃ nu wo gblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti míetsi glia godo ɖɔ? Ne miegawɔe le ekema malé mi! Tso ɣemaɣi dzi la womegava le dzudzɔgbe dzi kpɔ o.

english_verse: I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy. God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this. Mixed Marriages
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ na Lewi-viwo be, woakɔ wu ɖokui ŋu, eye woava dzɔ agboawo nu, ne woawo dzudzɔgbe la kɔkɔe. Nye Mawu, ɖo ŋu esia hã nam, eye nakpɔ tanye le wò amenuveve gã la nu!

english_verse: I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ le ɣemaɣi hã be, Yudatɔwo ɖe nyɔnuwo tso Asdod, Amon kple Moab.

english_verse: About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language.
translation_verse: Eye wo viwo ƒe afa doa Asdod-gbe, alo dukɔ si kple dukɔ keme ƒe gbe, ke womenya Yuda-gbedodo o.

english_verse: So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise: In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Tete meka mo na wo, meƒo fi de wo, meƒo wo dome ŋutsua ɖewo, eye menya ɖa na wo, eye meta Mawu na wo bena: Migatsɔ míaƒe nyɔnuviwo na woƒe ŋutsuviwo o, eye migaɖe woƒe nyɔnuviwo na míaƒe ŋutsuviwo kple mía ŋutɔwo ɖokui o!

english_verse: God dearly loved King Solomon of Israel and made him the greatest king on earth, but Solomon's foreign wives led him into sin.
translation_verse: Ɖe Israel-fia Salomo mewɔ nuvɔ̃ le esia ta oa? To egbɔ be, fiaa ɖeke mede enu le dukɔ geɖewo dome o, eye wonye ete Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃tɔ, eye Mawu tsoe ɖo fia ɖe Israel blibo la nu hã la, dutanyɔnuwo blee de nuvɔ̃ me.

english_verse: So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.
translation_verse: Azɔ woase esia le mía ŋu be, miewɔ nu gbegblẽ gã sia heto vo de mía Mawu la ŋu be, míede dutanyɔnuwoa?

english_verse: Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã Elyasib vi Yoyada viwo dometɔ ɖeka nye Xoronitɔ Sanebalat ƒe to, eye menyãe ɖa le ŋunye.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku, alesi woɖi gbe nunɔlanyenye kpakple nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo ƒe nubabla lae la dzi na wo!

english_verse: Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Ale mede du bubu me tɔwo katã da le wo dome, eye medo ɖoɖowo hena nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwo, amesiame le eƒe dɔ nu,

english_verse: I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple. I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.
translation_verse: kple ɖoɖowo ɖe nakenana ɖe ɣeyiɣi dzi ŋu kpakple ɖe nu gbãtɔwo. Nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku edzi nam hena nye nyui.

english_verse: King Xerxes of Persia lived in his capital city of Susa and ruled
translation_verse: le ɣemaɣi, esime Axasweros bɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi le Susa-mɔ̃ me la,

english_verse: During the third year of his rule, Xerxes gave a big dinner for all his officials and officers. The governors and leaders of the provinces were also invited, and even the commanders of the Persian and Median armies came.
translation_verse: etu aglo na eƒe amegãwo katã kple eƒe dɔlawo le eƒe ftaɖuɖu ƒe ƒe etɔ̃lia me, eye Persia-ʋakɔwo kple Media-ʋakɔwo, bubumewo kple anyigbawo ɖzikpɔlawo le eŋku me;

english_verse: At the end of this time, King Xerxes gave another dinner and invited everyone in the city of Susa, no matter who they were. The eating and drinking lasted seven days in the beautiful palace gardens.
translation_verse: Esi ŋkekeawo de vɔ la, fia la tu aglo na dukɔ blibo, si va Susa-mɔ̃ la me, tso tsitsiwo dzi vaseɖe ɖeviwo dzi ɖe fiasã la ƒe abɔ nu ŋkeke adre sɔŋ.

english_verse: The area was decorated with blue and white cotton curtains tied back with purple linen cords that ran through silver rings fastened to marble columns. Couches of gold and silver rested on pavement that had all kinds of designs made from costly bright-colored stones and marble and mother-of-pearl.
translation_verse: Wotsi avɔ ɣito, dzĩtɔ kple blɔtɔ, siwo ŋu wosa aklala kple aɖabɛ dzĩtɔ ƒe ka ɖo la, ɖe klosalosigɛwo ŋu le kpe xɔasi sɔtiawo ŋu. Wotsɔ sika kple klosalo lɔ̃ kuntrunuwo, ɖo ɖe anyigba, si wotsɔ kpe xɔasi dama, ɣito, hẽtɔ kple yibɔtɔ ɖo la.

english_verse: The guests drank from gold cups, and each cup had a different design. The king was generous
translation_verse: Woku aha ɖe sikakpluwo me, eye kplu ɖesiaɖe le vovo, eye fia ƒe wein so gbɔ taŋ, abe alesi dze fia ene.

english_verse: and said to them, “Drink all you want!” Then he told his servants, “Keep their cups full.”
translation_verse: Wono aha la le ɖoɖo la nu dzizizi manɔme, elabena fia la ɖo na eƒe me amegãwo katã be, amesiame nawɔ, alesi dze eŋu.

english_verse: While the men were enjoying themselves, Queen Vashti gave the women a big dinner inside the royal palace.
translation_verse: Eye fiasrɔ̃ Wasti hã tu aglo na nyɔnuwo ɖe fiasã, si nye fia Axasweros tɔ la me.

english_verse: By the seventh day, King Xerxes was feeling happy because of so much wine. And he asked his seven personal servants, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas,
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adreliagbe, esime wein na fia la, ƒe dzi gbɔ ɖe me la, ede se na aƒe dzikpɔla aɖreawo, siwo nye Mehuman, Bizta, Xarbona, Bigta, Abagta, Zetar kple Xarkas, amesiwo subɔna le fia Axasweros ŋku me la be,

english_verse: to bring Queen Vashti to him. The king wanted her to wear her crown and let his people and his officials see how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: woaɖakplɔ fiasrɔ̃ Wasti va fia ŋku me, eye fiakuku nanɔ eta, ne wòafia eƒe tugbedzedze dukɔwo kple fiawo, elabena edze tugbe.

english_verse: The king's servants told Queen Vashti what he had said, but she refused to go to him, and this made him terribly angry.
translation_verse: Ke fiasrɔ̃ Wasti gbe fia ƒe nya, si wòde aƒe dzikpɔlawo si la, eye meva o. Tete fia la nyrã ŋutɔ, eye dzi bi ɖe dɔ me nɛ.

english_verse: The king called in the seven highest officials of Persia and Media. They were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan. These men were very wise and understood all the laws and customs of the country, and the king always asked them what they thought about such matters.
translation_verse: Amesiwo te ɖe ŋu la, wonye Karsena, Zetar, Admata, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena kple Memuxan; woawoe nye amegã adreawo le Persia kple Media, amesiwo kpɔa fia la ŋku me, eye wonɔa nɔƒe gbãtɔ le fiaɖuƒe la me —

english_verse: The king said to them, “Queen Vashti refused to come to me when I sent my servants for her. What does the law say I should do about that?”
translation_verse: Nuka woawɔ fiasrɔ̃ Wasti le se la nu? Elabena mewo fia Axasweros ƒe nya, si wòde aƒe dzikpɔlawo si la dzi o.

english_verse: Then Memucan told the king and the officials: Your Majesty, Queen Vashti has not only embarrassed you, but she has insulted your officials and everyone else in all the provinces.
translation_verse: Tete Memuxan ɖo ŋu le fia kple amegãwo ŋku me bena. Menye fia la ɖeɖeko ŋu fiasrɔ̃ Wasti da vo ɖo o, ke boŋ ɖe amegãwo katã kple dukɔ, siwo katã le fia Axasweros ƒe anyigbawo katã dzi la hã ŋutie.

english_verse: The women in the kingdom will hear about this, and they will refuse to respect their husbands. They will say, “If Queen Vashti doesn't obey her husband, why should we?”
translation_verse: Elabena fiasrɔ̃ ƒe nuwɔwɔ la aɖo nyɔnuwo katã dome, eye woava wo srɔ̃wo kpɔ ge ɖe ƒomevi ahanɔ gbɔgblɔm be: Fia Axasweros be, woakplɔ fiasrɔ̃ Wasti va egbɔe, ke meyi o!

english_verse: Before this day is over, the wives of the officials of Persia and Media will find out what Queen Vashti has done, and they will refuse to obey their husbands. They won't respect their husbands, and their husbands will be angry with them.
translation_verse: Eye egbe sia ke Persia-amegãwo kple Meɖia-amegãwo ƒe srɔ̃wo hã agblɔ alea ɖe fia ƒe amegãwo katã ŋu, ne wose fiasrɔ̃ ƒe nuwɔwɔ la, eye woahe vlododo kple dziku geɖe vɛ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, if you agree, you should write for the Medes and Persians a law that can never be changed. This law would keep Queen Vashti from ever seeing you again. Then you could let someone who respects you be queen in her place.
translation_verse: Ne edze fia ŋu la, ekema woade fia ƒe se, eye woaŋlɔe ɖe Persiatɔwo kple Mediatɔwo ƒe se la me, eye womada edzi o be: Wasti mekpɔ mɔ agava fia Axasweros ŋku me o, eye fia la natsɔ eƒe fianyenye ana nyɔnu bubu, si nyo wui.

english_verse: When the women in your great kingdom hear about this new law, they will respect their husbands, no matter if they are rich or poor.
translation_verse: Ne wose fia ƒe se, si wòde le eƒe fiaɖuƒe blibo, si nyadri la me la, ekema nyɔnuwo katã abu wo srɔ̃wo tso tsitsiawo dzi vaseɖe ɖeviawo dzi,

english_verse: King Xerxes and his officials liked what Memucan had said,
translation_verse: Tete nya la dze fia kple amegãwo ŋu, eye fia la wo Memuxan ƒe nya la dzi,

english_verse: and he sent letters to all of his provinces. Each letter was written in the language of the province to which it was sent, and it said that husbands should be in charge of their wives and children.
translation_verse: eye wòɖo agbalẽ ɖe fia ƒe anyigbawo katã dzi le anyigba sia anyigba kple eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ kple dukɔ sia dukɔ kple eƒe gbegbɔgblɔ nu be: Ŋutsu sia ŋutsu enye aƒetɔ ɖe eƒe me eye eƒemetɔwo nabui.

english_verse: After a while, King Xerxes got over being angry. But he kept thinking about what Vashti had done and the law that he had written because of her.
translation_verse: Le nya siawo megbe, esi fia Axasweros ƒe dziku nu fa la, eɖo ŋku Wasti kple nusi wòwɔ kpakple tame, si wòɖo ɖe eŋu la dzi.

english_verse: Then the king's personal servants said: Your Majesty, a search must be made to find you some beautiful young women.
translation_verse: Tete fia la ƒe ɖekakpuiwo amesiwo subɔnɛ la, gblɔ bena: Ne wodi ɖetugbi dzetugbewo na fia la,

english_verse: You can select officers in every province to bring them to the place where you keep your wives in the capital city of Susa. Put your servant Hegai in charge of them since that is his job. He can see to it that they are given the proper beauty treatments.
