english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Eye ne mefɔe ɖe dzi le, ekema àyɔm ɖe nu abe dzata ene, eye àgawɔ nukunuwo ɖe ŋunye atraɖii.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Aɖo ɖasefo bubuwo ɖe ŋunye ɖaa, àdzi wò dziku ɖe dzi ɖe ŋunye, eye aʋakɔwo anɔ li ɖɔm wo nɔewo atraɖii ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèna medo tso danye ƒe dɔ me ɖo? Ɖe wònye ɖe metso me la, anye ne ŋkua ɖeke mekpɔm o;

english_verse: and been carried to the grave without ever breathing.
translation_verse: anye ne nyemeli o, eye anye ne wotsɔm tso danye ƒe dɔme hede yɔ me.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: Ɖe nye ŋkekewo mele ʋee ko oa? Nedzudzɔ, eye wòate ɖa le ŋunye, ne magbɔ ɖe eme vie,

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Tete Naamatɔ Zofar xɔ dzi gblɔ bena:

english_verse: So much foolish talk cannot go unanswered.
translation_verse: Ɖe woagbe eŋuɖoɖo na nyawɔlaa? Eye ɖe aɖe gãtɔ tɔ anye dzɔdzɔea?

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Wò nyawɔwɔ de ga nu na amewo, ale be nèle fewu ɖum, eye amea ɖeke mede ŋukpe mo na wò o;

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: eyata nèle gbɔgblɔm be: Nye nufiafia me ko, eye medze le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: But I wish God would speak
translation_verse: Oo, ne Mawu ahaƒo nu, eye wòake eƒe nuyiwo de ŋuwò,

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: eye wòaɖe eƒe nunya ɣaɣlawo afia, be wo gɔme goglo nukutɔe la, ekema adze sii be, Mawu ƒe ŋku dzo le wò vodadaa ɖewo dzi.

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Eka abe dziƒo ene, nuka woa nawɔ? Egoglo wu tsiẽƒe, nuka wòa nunya?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: Eƒe dzidzeme didi wu anyigba, eye wòkeke wu atsiaƒu.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: Ne eva tso me yi, ele ame, eye wòɖi ʋɔnu la, ameka axe mɔ nɛ?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Elabena enya alakpatɔwo, eye wòkpɔa nu menyo wɔwɔ, evɔ menyanɛ ɖi hafi o.

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Ale gegeme hã adze nunya, eye woadzi gbetedzivi wòazu ame.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: Azɔ ne èdzra wò dzi do, eye nèke wò alɔwo me nɛ,

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: ne èɖe nu manyomanyo, si le asiwò me la ɖa, eye nu madzɔmadzɔa ɖeke mele wò agbadɔ me o la,

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: ekema awu wò mo dzi mokaka manɔmee, eye àli ke, eye màvɔ̃ o;

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: ekema àŋlɔ wò hiãkame be, eye wòanɔ ŋku dzi na wò abe tsi, si si va yi la ene.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: Wò agbenɔnɔ me akɔ wu ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ, eye ne edo viviti hã la, akɔ ahe ŋdi ene.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: Wò dzi adze eme, elabena mɔkpɔkpɔ li, atsa ŋu afisiafi, eye àmlɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: Amlɔ anyi, eye amea ɖeke maɖo vodi na wò o, eye ame geɖewo akɔ mo ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Nu ati kɔ na ame vlowo ƒe ŋkuwo, sitsoƒewo katã abu ɖe wo, eye woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ la luʋɔ ƒe ƒuƒue.

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Eye Hiob ɖo du gblɔ bena:

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee! Miawo koe nye amewo, eye ne mieku la, ekema nunya ku.

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Nye hã nunya le asinye ahe miawo ke ene, eye mia kpli miawo miele kpo ɖeka dzi. Amekae menye nusiawo tɔgbe oa?

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: Ame ŋutɔ xɔlɔ̃wo ƒe alɔmeɖenu menye tsã, nye amesi yɔa Mawu, eye wòɖoa toe, nye ame dzɔdzɔe kple mawuvɔ̃la anye alɔmeɖenu!

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Amesi le dedie buna be, yeado vlo dzɔgbevɔ̃e, eye yeatu nu amesi ƒe afɔ mele te dzi o la.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Adzoblasuwo ƒe agbadɔwo le ŋutifafa me, eye amesiwo le dedie do dziku na Mawu, eye woƒe kɔŋɔŋlɔ nye mawu na wo.

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: Ke bia lãwo se, eye woafia nu wò, kple dziƒoxewo: eye woagblɔe na wo,

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Amekae medze sii le nusiawo katã ŋu be, Yehowa ƒe asie wɔ nusiawo oa?

english_verse: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi si me nu gbagbewo katã ƒe luʋɔ kple amegbelɔwo katã ƒe ŋutilã ƒe gbɔgbɔ le!

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Ɖe to medoa nya kpɔna, abe alesi veme ɖɔa nuɖuɖu kpɔna ene oa?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Ɖe nunya le amegã ɖeɖiwo si, eye tagbɔ kɔkɔ li na ame tsitsiwoa?

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: Eya si ko nunya kple ŋusẽ, aɖaŋuɖoɖo kple tagbɔ kɔkɔ le.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ne egbã nane la, amea ɖeke megatunɛ o, eye ne ede ame xɔ la, amea ɖeke meʋunɛ o.

english_verse: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, ne exa mɔ na tɔwo la, womiena; ne eɖe asi le wo ŋu la, wowuwlua anyigba.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Eya si me ŋusẽ kple nunya vavãtɔ le, eye etɔ enye mɔtrelawo kple amesiwo kplɔa amewo tre mɔe.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Eɖea aboyo adaŋumegãwo amamae, eye wòdoa tsu ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Eɖea aboyo nunɔlawo amamae, eye wòlãa amesiwo ƒo kè ɖe to la, ƒu anyi.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Etrɔa vlododo kɔna ɖe amegãwo dzi, eye wodoe agblɔ ŋusẽtɔwo ƒe alidziblanu me.

english_verse: he makes nations strong, then shatters their strength.
translation_verse: Enana duwo dzina ɖe dzi, eye wòtsrɔa wo; enana dukɔwo kekea ta, eye wògakplɔa wo dzonɛ.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Egblẽa tagbɔ na anyigba dzi dukɔwo ƒe tatɔwo, eye wònana wotsaa tsa glãla le gbegbe, si mɔa ɖeke mele o.

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ɖa, nusiawo katã mekpɔ kple nye ŋkuwo, nye to see, eye wòdzrae ɖo.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Nu alesi nu mienya la, nye hã menyae; míe kple miawo la kpo ɖeka dzi míele.

english_verse: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—
translation_verse: Ke medi be, maƒo nu kple ŋusẽkatãtɔ, eye wòle dzroyem be, mía kple Mawu míahe nya akpa.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, ami ɖem miele ɖe aʋatso, eye gbedala dzodzrowo mienye.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Oo, ne miazi ɖoɖoe dzro de; ekema woabu esia nunyae na mi.

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Ɖe miebe, yewoade edzia? Alo ɖe miebe, yewoawɔ dzre ɖe Mawu nua?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Ne edzro mia me kpɔ la, ɖe eteƒe akɔa? Alo ɖe miebe, yewoaflui, abe alesi woflua amegbetɔ enea?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Ahe to na mi kokoko, ne miele ame dzi dem le adze me.

english_verse: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
translation_verse: Ɖe eƒe gãnyenye mado ŋɔdzi na mi, eye eƒe vɔvɔ̃ malé mi oa?

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Miaƒe nye tsitsiwo nye tofloko, eye miaƒe aʋakpoƒuƒuwo nye anyi ɖeɖe.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: Miɖe nu ɖa le ŋunye, ne maƒo nu, eye nusi be, yeava dzinye la, neva!

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Malé nye ŋutilã ɖe aɖu nu, eye matsɔ nye luʋɔ aɖo nye asi me.

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ele wu ye ge tsã, eya ko sinu kpɔm mele; ke ɖeko mebe, maʋu go nye zɔzɔme ɖe ŋku me nɛ,

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: eye esia nye nye dziɖuɖu xoxo, elabena ame vloa ɖeke medona ɖe eŋku me o.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, medzra ɖo ɖe dzrenya la ŋu, eye menyae be, tɔnyee le dzɔdzɔ ge.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Ameka ate ŋu akpe kplim? Eya ko hafi mazi ɖoɖoe, eye maku.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: Negbe nu eve ko megawɔm o, ekema nyemaɣla ɖokuinye ɖe ŋkuwò me o:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Ekema yɔm, eye matɔ, alo nyea maƒo nu, eye nado eŋu nam!

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Vodada kple nuvɔ̃ nenie le ŋunye? Na manya nye dzidadawo kple nye nuvɔ̃wo!

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèɣla wò ŋku me dem, eye nèle buyem wò futɔe?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Ɖe nèbe yeado vodi na aŋgba, si nu ya, alo nayɔ ahɔ̃liti ƒuƒu ɖe nua?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Hafi nètsɔ vevesesewo ɖo dzinye, eye nèna mele nye ɖevime vodadawo ƒe dome nyim;

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: ède ga nye afɔwo ɖe atiboli ŋu, èle ŋudzɔ hã na nye mɔwo katã, eye nèɖo liƒo na nye afɔƒome;

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: evɔ wònye menyunyɔ abe nu ŋɔɖua kple avɔ, si agbagblaʋui du la, ene hafi.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ nyanu tɔ dzidzia, eƒe agbe le kpuie, eye fuɖeɖe ti kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.
translation_verse: Edona abe seƒoƒo ene, eye wòyrɔna; esina abe vɔvɔli ene, eye metɔna ɖi o.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Esia tɔgbe ŋu nèke ŋku ɖo, eye nèkplɔm va wò ʋɔnuia?

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Ɖe ame dzadzɛ ate ŋu atso ame madzamadza mea? Ɖeka pɛ hã o!

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Ne woɖo eƒe ŋkekewo, eƒe dzinuwo ƒe xexlẽme le gbɔwò, eye nèdo liƒo nɛ, si dzi magbɔ o la,

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: ekema ɖe kɔ ɖa le eŋu, ne wòagbɔ ɖe eme, eye wòakpɔ dzidzɔ, abe alesi agbatedɔwɔla kpɔa dzidzɔ le eƒe ŋkeke ŋu ene!

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: Elabena mɔkpɔkpɔ li na ati; ne wolãe la, ekema egadzena yeye, eye eƒe alɔwo nu metsina o.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: tsi ƒe ʋeʋẽ nana be, wògadzena, eye wòtoa alɔ abe atilɔ mumu, si woɖo ene.

english_verse: Humans are different— we die, and that's the end.
translation_verse: Ke ne ŋutsu ku la, emlɔa anyi drana ɖi, eye ne amegbetɔ mia nu la, afika wògale?

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Tsi nona le ta me, tɔsisi miena, eye eme ƒuna;

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: ke ne amegbetɔ mlɔ anyi la, megafɔna o, ŋkeke alesi dziƒowo li la, menyɔna o, eye womenyɔnɛ tsoa eƒe alɔ̃dɔdɔa me o.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: Oo, ne naxaɣlam ɖe tsiẽƒe, eye nadzram ɖo, vaseɖe esime wò dɔmedzoe nu nafa; naɖo ɣeyiɣi nam, eye naɖo ŋku dzinye emegbe ɖe!

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu ku la, ɖe wògagbɔa agbea? Le nye aʋamenɔɣiwo katã la manɔ asiɖeɖe le ŋunye lalam.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Àyɔm, eye matɔ na wò, ne wò asinudɔwɔwɔ ƒe nu le dzrowòm.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la èle nye afɔɖeɖewo xlẽm, eye mèto nye nuvɔ̃ ŋu yi o.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Wodzi nye dzidada ɖa nu me goŋgoŋ hetre enu, eye nègale nye voɖadawo ɖitsim.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: Ke ne to ŋe dze eme la, etua wɔ, eye agakpe tena ɖa le eteƒe.

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: Tsi nyia kpewo, eye tsidzadza kplɔa anyigbakewo dzonae, ale nègblẽa amegbetɔ ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ mee.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Edzea edzi kple ŋusẽ ɖaa, eye enu va yina, ètrɔa eƒe mo bubui henyãnɛ ɖona ɖa.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Ne bubu le viawo ŋu la, menyanɛ o, eye ne woɖi gbɔ la, medzea sii o.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Negbe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã ƒe veve ko wòsena, eye eya ŋutɔ ƒe luʋɔ koe xaa nu.

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Tete Elifaz, Temanitɔ la, ɖo eŋu gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Job, if you had any sense,
translation_verse: Ɖe nunyala atsɔ nya tofloko aɖo eŋu, eye ɣedzeƒeya ayɔ eƒe ɖɔmea?

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Atsɔ nuƒoƒo, si mele ɖeke me o, kple nya, siwo maɖe ame o la, anɔ eɖokui ta ʋlimia?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Edzudzɔ mawuvɔvɔ̃, eye nèɖi gbɔ tamesusuwo le Mawu ŋku me.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Elabena wò vodada le nu fiam wò nu, eye nètia ayetɔwo ƒe aɖe.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Wò nue le fɔ, bum wò, menye nyee o, eye wò nuyiwoe nye ɖasefowo ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: Wòe nye ame gbãtɔ wodzi loo? Wòe tredzɔdzɔ na togbɛwoa?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Ɖe nèse Mawu ƒe adaŋudede kple to, eye nèfi nunya na ɖokuiwòa?

english_verse: Do you know and understand something we don't?
translation_verse: Nuka nènya, eye míawo míenyae o? Nuka gɔme nèse, eye míawo míedze sii o?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Ta ɣi tɔwo kple amegã ɖeɖiwo le míawo hã dome, amesiwo ƒe ŋkeke sɔ gbɔ wu fofowò tɔ.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu ƒe akɔfanamewo kple nya bɔbɔe, si gblɔm wole na wò la, nye nu tsɛ na wòa?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Afika wò dzi le fluwòm yinae, eye nukaŋuti wò ŋku le totrom,

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: be nètrɔ wò dziku ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye wò nu le nyawo dudum le ƒoƒom ɖi?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meɖoa dzi ɖe eƒe ame kɔkɔewo ŋu o, eye dziƒo medza le eŋku me o,

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: ʋuu eke, ne wòahayi ame nyɔŋu, ame gbegblẽ, amesi noa nu vlo wɔwɔ abe tsi ene la, nye ge?

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: Mele nya to ge na wò, lé to ɖe ŋunye! Eye nusi mekpe la, eya gblɔ ge mala:

english_verse: wisdom known by others since ancient times.
translation_verse: nusi nunyalawo xlẽ fia le wo fofowo ŋu, eye womeɣlae o,

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: wo, amesiwo ɖeɖe wotsɔ anyigba la na, eye amedzroa ɖeke meto wo dome o.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi léa ame vlo le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me, eye ƒe geɖe siawo wotu ɖo na ŋutasẽla.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzigbe ɖi le eƒe to me be: Adzoblasu le ƒoƒo ge ɖe edzi le ŋutifafaɣi me.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Ele tsa glãla tsam le abolo ta be, afika ɖe le? Enyae be, vivitidogbe le klalo ɖe ye xa.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi kple hiã do dzikatsoƒoe na, wodze edzi abe fia, si dzra ɖo ɖe tadede aʋa me ŋu ene.

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Elabena eɖo eƒe asi ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye wòdze aglã ɖe ŋusẽkatãtɔ ŋu;

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: eƒu ɖu ɖe edzi kple kɔ dzeti kpakple akpoxɔnu ƒe kpo titri la.

english_verse: They may be rich and fat,
translation_verse: Eklã ɖe mo gbɔ, eye eƒe alime ɖa ami,

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: Ena du gbagbãwo kple xɔdowo me, siwo woɖo ɖi de anyiglãgozuzu ŋu.

english_verse: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.
translation_verse: Eyata makpɔ ho o, eƒe kesinɔnu mali ke o, eye mabi alɔ wòatɔ anyi o.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Masi le viviti nu o, dzoƒaɖe ana eƒe alɔwo naƒu, eye Mawu ƒe nu me ƒuƒu aɖee ɖa.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Megana ŋu ɖom ɖe yakanuwɔwɔ ŋu o, eɖokui flum wòle; elabena axɔ yakanu ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: like a date palm tree without a leaf.
translation_verse: Ava me hafi eƒe ɣeyiɣi naɖo dzi, eye eƒe deʋala made ama o.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Adudu, abe alesi weintsetse gboewo luluna le weinka ŋu ene, eye woadudu abe amiti ƒe seƒoƒo ene.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Elabena ame vlowo ƒe ha medzina ɖe dzi o, eye dzo afiã zãnuxɔlawo ƒe agbadɔ.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Wofɔ agbagbadzedze ƒe fu hetsɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzi, eye alakpa tsi ɖe dɔ me na wo.

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: Mese nusiawo tɔgbe wòsɔ gbɔ azɔ; mi katã la akɔfala ƒuƒluwo mienye.

english_verse: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?
translation_verse: Nya toflokoawo va azɔa? Nukae ɖu lãme na wò, be nèɖo eŋu?

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Nye hã mate ŋu aƒo nu abe miawo ene; ɖe wònye miawoe xa ɖe tenyeƒe la, anye ne matrɔ nyawo aƒo ɖe anyi ɖe mia ŋu, eye maʋuʋu ta ɖe mia ŋu;

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: Ne meƒo nu la, nye veveawo dzi maka aɖe o, eye ne medzudzɔ hã la, ɖe woavɔ nama?

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la egbã lãme nam, eye nètsrɔ̃ nye aƒemetɔwo.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: Elém, esia nye ɖase; eye nye ƒuɖiɖi tsi tre ɖe ŋunye hele ɖase ɖim ɖe mo nam kaŋ.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Eƒe dɔmedzoe vuvum, eye wòwɔ avu kplim; feɖu aɖukli ɖe ŋunye, eye wòklẽ ŋku ɖe ŋunye abe nye futɔ ene.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Woke woƒe nu ɖe ŋunye baa, woɖu fewu heƒo tome nam, eye wotso ha ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Mawu gblẽm ɖe ɖevi vloewo si me, eye wòtsɔm ɖe asi na ame vlowo.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Meli bɔkɔɔ, tete wògbãm nyanyanya; elé kɔgbɔ nam, eye wòʋuʋum, eye wòtsɔm ɖo nudzidzea na eɖokui.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: Eƒe aŋutrɔwo blam kɔtɔɔ, ete nye ayikuwo nublanui makpɔe, eye wòtrɔ nye vevegoe kɔ ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Metɔ akpanya ɖe nye ŋutigbalẽ ŋu, eye metsɔ nye dzo ɖe ke me.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Mefa avi, nye mo ɖo ʋusrã, eye ku ƒe vɔvɔli le nye aɖabawo dzi,

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: evɔ wònye nu madzɔmadzɔa ɖeke mele nye asiwo me o, eye alakpa mele nye gbedodoɖa me o hafi.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Anyigba, megatsyɔ nye nu dzi o, eye nye aʋadodo megakpɔ nɔƒea ɖeke o!

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye ɖasefo le dziƒo fifia hã, eye tanyeʋlila le dzi!

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Xɔ̃nyewo le fewu ɖum le ŋunye, eye nye ŋku le aɖatsi fam na Mawu,

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: be wòatso na ŋutsu la le eya kple Mawu dome, kple amegbetɔvi la le eya kple xɔlɔ̃a dome.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Elabena nye ƒe ʋeeawo le dedem, eye mayi demagbɔnugbe.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Nu ti kɔ na nye gbɔgbɔ, nye ŋkekewo nu tsi, eye yɔdo enye tanye.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, fewuɖuɖu ɖe to ɖem, eye nye ŋku le woƒe dzrehehewo teƒe kpɔm.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Wò ŋutɔ xɔ nya ɖe nunye le gbɔwò! Ameka gɔ̃e gali ana asim?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Elabena èɣla nunya ɖe woƒe dzi, eyata mana woƒe alɔ naɖe dzi o.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Amesi tsɔ xɔlɔ̃wo ɖe awɔba me la, viawo ƒe ŋkuwo atsi.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Etsɔm wɔ hameloe na dukɔwo, eye ame, ne woaɖe la ɖe mo na ko manye tsã.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Nye ŋku tsi vi le nuxaxa ta, eye nye ŋutilã ŋu nuwo katã le abe vɔvɔli ene.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nu ku le esia ta, eye dzi ku ame maɖifɔ ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi la ŋu.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Ke ame dzɔdzɔe alé eƒe mɔ ɖe asi sesĩe, eye asi dzadzɛ tɔ akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: Ke mi kalã mitrɔ va ko; nyemele nunyalaa ɖeke kpɔ ge le mia dome o.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkekewo nu yi; nye tameɖoɖo, siwo xɔ nye dzi me la, me gblẽ.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Wobe, yewoatsɔ zã awɔ ŋkekee, kekeli natsɔ de gbɔnye kpuie wu viviti.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Ne mele ŋu ɖom ɖe tsiẽƒe ŋu abe nye aƒe ene, eye meɖo nye aba de viviti me,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: ne meyɔ yɔdo be fofonye, eye nyẽwo be danye kple nɔvinyenyɔnu la,

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: afika gɔ̃e nye mɔkpɔkpɔ la le? Amekae le nye mɔkpɔkpɔ la kpɔm?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Nenye be, mía kplii míegbɔ de me le ke me la, ekema ayi tsiẽƒe ƒe gametiwo gbɔ.

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Tete Suaxtɔ Bildad ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena:

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣi miawɔ nyaʋa ase ɖo? Midze nunya gbã, emegbe hafi miaƒo nu!

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti wobu mí lãwoe, eye míenye bometsilawo le mía ŋku me?

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Tsiã, wò amesi vuvu wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò le wò dɔmedzoe me, wò tae anyigba azu aƒeɖo, eye woate agakpe ɖa le eteƒea?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: Ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe akaɖi tsina, eye eƒe dzoƒaɖe meklẽna o.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Eƒe afɔ legbe ɖeɖe tona ɖe eme, eye eya ŋutɔ ƒe adaŋudede ƒunɛ anyi.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Adoboli miãna ɖe afɔkpo dzi nɛ, eye mɔ̃ka ɖenɛ.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzidodowo doa dzikatsoƒoe nɛ, eye woyɔnɛ de nu kplikplikpli.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Eƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e tsia dɔmeɣee de eŋu, eye gbegblẽ nɔa klalo de exa.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋutilã ŋu nuwo duduna, eye ku ƒe ŋgɔgbevi ɖua eƒe ŋutilã ŋu nuwo.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Woaɖee ɖa le eƒe agbadɔ, si ŋu wòle ŋu ɖom ɖo la me, eye nu akplɔe aƒu fia dziŋɔla.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Nusi menye etɔ o la, nɔa eƒe agbadɔ me, eye wokɔa aŋɔ ɖe enɔƒe.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Eƒe kewo kuna ɖe to me, eye eƒe alɔwo yrɔna ɖe dzi me.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Wotua asii tsoa kekeli me dona ɖe viviti me, eye wonyãnɛ ɖa le xexeame.

english_verse: Everyone, from east to west, is overwhelmed with horror.
translation_verse: Ɣetoɖoƒetɔwo ƒe nu aku le eƒe ŋkeke la ŋu, eye ɣedzeƒetɔwo ƒe tame able fu.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Alea nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔla ƒe nɔƒewo nɔna, eye alea amesi ŋlɔ Mawu be la, ƒe teƒe nɔna.

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣi mianɔ nuxaxa dom na nyee luʋɔ, eye miatsɔ nyawo agbãm nyanyanya ase ɖo?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Zi ewo sɔŋ enye si mieɖo vlom, eye ŋu mele mia kpem, be míele funyafunya wɔmem o!

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Eye nenye vavãe metra la, ekema nye tatra la le nye ɖeka dzinye.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Nenyo vavãe míebe, yewoawɔ mia ɖokui ga ɖe ŋunye, eye miafia nye ŋukpem la,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ekema minyae be, Mawu wɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye wòda ɖɔ ɖe ŋunye godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meyɔ ame le ŋutasesẽ ta, gake wometɔ nam o; meɖo ɣli le xɔname ŋuti, ke wometso nam o.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Etɔ kpɔ ɖe nye mɔ dzi, efɔflɔ meli o, eye wòlɔ viviti ƒo ɖe nye afɔtoƒewo.

english_verse: God rips me apart, uproots my hopes,
translation_verse: Egbãm keŋkeŋ, eye nyemegali o, eye wòho nye mɔkpɔkpɔ abe ati ene.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Ena eƒe dɔmedzoe bi ɖe ŋunye, eye wòbum abe eƒe futɔwo ene.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Tete eƒe adzohawo ɖo, woɖe mɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye woƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe nye agbaɖɔ ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: Eɖe nɔvinyeŋutsuwo ɖa le ŋunye, eye xɔ̃nyewo trɔ bubui ɖem keŋ.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Nye aƒemetɔwo kple nye dɔlanyɔnuwo le buyem amedzroe, eye mezu ame tutɔ le woƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Meyɔ nye dɔlaŋutsu, metɔ o, eye ele nam be, matsɔ nye nu aƒo koko nɛ.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Nye nume le ʋeʋẽm ɖe srɔ̃nye, eye mele ya ɖem ɖe nye alimeviwo.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Ɖeviwo ke ha le vlo domem, eye ne mebe, metso la, wonɔa nu ƒom le ŋunye.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Xɔ̃nye veviwo le ŋunyɔmem, eye amesiwo melɔ̃na la, tso ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutigbalẽ kple nye ŋutilã le ɖe nye ƒu ŋu, negbe nye nye koe kpɔtɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Mive nunye, xɔ̃nyewo, mive nunye! Elabena Mawu ƒe asi ƒoni.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti miele yonyeme tim abe Mawu ene, eye nye ŋutilã meɖi ƒo na mi kpɔ oa?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe woaŋlɔ nye nyawo ɖi, eye woade wo agbalẽ me,

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ke nyea menyae be, nye xɔnametɔ le agbe, eye mlɔe ke la ado ɖe anyigba me.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Eye ne nye ŋutilã vuvu yaʋayaʋa, eye nye ŋutilã megali o la, makpɔ Mawu.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Makpɔe na ɖokuinye, nye ŋutɔ nye ŋkuwo akpɔe, eye menye ame bubu o. Ele nye ayikuwo dzrom le dɔ me.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Ne miegblɔ be, aleke míawɔ ati eyome? eye be: nya la ƒe agunu le gbɔnye la,

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: ekema yi netso dzika ƒo na mi; elabena yi wotsɔna hea to na vodada sia tɔgbe; ne mianyae be, ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ li.

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Tete Naamalɔ Zofar do ŋu gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: Esi metsi dzi le ɖokuinye me la, eyata nye susuwo ɖo eŋu nam.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Manɔ nya heɖeameŋu, si nye nye dzu la sem, eye wòatsɔ nya toflokowo anɔ eŋu ɖom nam.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: Ɖe menya nusi li tso tititi ke, esime woɖo amegbetɔwo anyigba dzi la o be:

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: Ame vlowo ƒe aseyetsotso nu mesena yina o, eye ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe dzidzɔ nɔa anyi aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka koa?

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ne eƒe gãnyenye de dziƒo, eye eƒe ta ɖatɔ alilikpo la,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: aɖo agu ɖikaa abe eƒe mi ene; eye amesiwo kpee la, abia be: Afika eyama le?

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Ŋku, si kpɔe la, magakpɔe akpɔ o; eye enɔƒe hã magakpɔe o.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Viawo anyo dɔme na ame dahewo, eye woƒe asi agbugbɔ eƒe kesinɔnuwo ana.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ dzodzo nɔ eƒe ƒuwo ŋu, ke woa kplii womlɔ ke me.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: Ne nu vɔ̃ɖi vivi le nu me nɛ, eye wòɣlae ɖe eƒe aɖe te,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: ekema eƒe nuɖuɖu atrɔ le eƒe dɔkaviwo me azu da kpui ƒe veve ɖe dɔme nɛ.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Emi kesinɔnu, eye ele nɛ be, wòadzɔe; Mawu aɖee atso eƒe ɖɔ me.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Eno da kpui ƒe aɖi, eye ƒli ƒe aɖi wui,

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Makpɔ dzidzɔ le tɔʋuwo kple tɔsisiwo, esiwo me anyitsi kple notsi kpekẽ le sisim la la ŋu o.

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: Elabena ete ame dahe ɖe anyi, eye wògblẽe ɖi; exɔ xɔ, si metu o la sesẽe.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Elabena atsi dzodzodzoe le eɖokui me, ke matsɔ eƒe nu veviwo aɖe eɖokuii o.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Naneke mekpɔtɔ o le eƒe nutsuɖuɖu la, eyata eƒe dzɔgbenyuie matɔ ɖi o.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Ne nu bɔ ɖe esi kpaŋ la, ŋɔdzi alée be, hiãtɔwo ƒe asiwo katã le ye dzi va ge.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ne esi le ga yibɔ lãnu nu la, ekema akɔblida aƒo ɖee.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Ehoe wòdo le eƒe lã me, eye esi ga dadzo la ɖo tso eƒe vevegoe me la, ŋɔdzi lée.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Wodzra vivitiwo katã ɖo ɖi ɖe eƒe kesinɔnuwo ŋu; dzo, si womeƒlɔ ɖo o la, fiãe, eye wòɖuɖɔ nusi kpɔtɔ ɖe eƒe agbaɖɔ me la ƒiaƒiaƒia!

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Dziƒo aklo nu le eƒe vodada dzi, eye anyigba atso ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Wòalɔ eƒe me gblemenuwo adzoe, eye wòado dzodzo yayaya le Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Esia nye ame vlo ƒe gome tso Mawu gbɔ kpakple domenyinu, si woɖo ɖi nɛ tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: Oo, misee, mise nye nuƒoƒo dzro, eye esia anye miaƒe akɔfaname.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Migbɔ dzi ɖi nam, ne maƒo nu vɔ, hafi miaɖe alɔme le ŋunye.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: Amewo ŋue mele konyi fam ɖo loo, eye nukaŋuti magbɔ dzi ɖi ɖo?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Mitrɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye miaƒe nu neku, eye mitsɔ asi ɖo nu!

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Hm, ne meɖo ŋku edzi la, vɔvɔ̃a ɖoam, eye nye lãme blea fu.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tsia agbe, wokua amegã, eye woƒe ŋusẽ dzina ɖe edzi?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Wo viwo lia ke le wo gbɔ kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo le wo ŋku me.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Woƒe aƒewo nɔa ŋutifafa me, ŋɔ medzia wo o, eye Mawu ƒe atam mevaa wo dzi o.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Eƒe nyitsu yɔa asi, eye menyea dzodzro o; eƒe nyinɔ dzia vi, eye fu megena le eƒo o.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Woɖea woƒe ŋutsuviwo doa goe abe lãha ene, eye wo viwo nɔa adzrɔ ɖim.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Wonɔa ha dzim ɖe gakogoe kple gakasaŋku ŋu, eye wonɔa dzidzɔ kpɔm ɖe dze ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Woɖua woƒe ŋkekewo le dzidzɔ me, eye le adahaƒoƒo ɖeka me woɖoa agu yia tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Ke wogblóna na Mawu be: Te ɖa le mía gbɔ, míele naneke dim, be míanya le wò mɔwo ŋu o.

english_verse: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
translation_verse: Ameka nye ŋusẽkatãtɔ, ne míasubɔe, eye viɖe ka wònye na mí, ne míaɖe kuku nɛ?

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Kpa ɖa, woƒe dzɔgbenyuie mele wo si me o; eyata ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe adaŋudede nede megbe xaa tso gbɔnye!

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: Zi nenie ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe akaɖi mehetsina, eye woƒe gbegblẽ mehevaa wo dzi o? Emãa woƒe gome na wo le eƒe dɔmedzoe me,

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: be woanɔ abe gbe ƒuƒu le ya nu ene, abe tsro, si ahom kplɔna dzonae ene.

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖo nuxi dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖi na viawo. Aɖo eteƒe nɛ, be wòa ʋẽe ase!

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkuwo akpɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe gbegblẽ, eye wòano ŋusẽkatãtɔ ƒe dziku heliheli la.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Elabena eƒe aƒe me nya ka tsɔ egbɔ le emegbe, nenye be, wotsi eƒe dzinuwo ƒe xexlẽme nu?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Ɖe wobe, yewoafia nunya Mawu, eya amesi drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dziƒotɔwoa?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ke ame bubu ku, esime eƒe luʋɔ le nu xam, eye mede nu nu nyui ŋu kpɔ o.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Wo kple eve la womlɔ wo nɔewo gbɔ le ke me, eye nyẽwo ɖi ba ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, menya miaƒe susuwo kple tame vɔ̃, siwo ɖom miele ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Ne miele gbɔgblɔm be, afika ŋutasẽla ƒe aƒe le, eye afika agbadɔ, si me ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nɔ la, le hã la,

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: wokpɔa ame vɔ̃ɖi ta le gbegblẽɣi, eye wotsonɛ ɖi le dɔmedzoedogbe oa?

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Ameka agblɔ eƒe zɔzɔme ɖe ŋku me nɛ kaŋ, eye ne eƒo nu la, ameka aɖo eteƒe nɛ?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Emegbe wokplɔnɛ ɖo yia yɔdo gbɔe, eye woganɔa eƒe yɔɖo ŋu dzɔm.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: Aleke mianɔ akɔ fam nam ɖe ya me? Miaƒe ŋuɖoɖowo la, alakpa ɖeɖe ko wonye.

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Eye Temanitɔ Elifaz ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena:

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋutsu enye viɖenu na Mawua? Kpao, boŋ nunyala enye viɖenu na eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ko.

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ne ènye ame dzɔdzɔe la, ɖe ŋusẽkatãtɔ tsɔ ɖe le emea? Eye ne fɔɖiɖi mele wò zɔzɔme ŋu o la, viɖe ka wònye nɛ?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ mekeke ta, eye seƒeɖo meli na wò vodadawo oa?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Elabena èxɔ awɔbanu le nɔviwòwo si yakatsyɔ, eye nèɖe avɔ le avɔkoewɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Mèna tsi amesiwo gbafa ƒo la wono o, eye nète abolo dɔwuitɔwo.

english_verse: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu alɔkpa sesẽ tɔ tɔ enye anyigba la, eye ame ŋkutatɔ anɔ edzi.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Eɖo ahosiwo ɖa asi gbɔlo, eye wogbã alɔ na tsyɔeviwo.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Eyata adoboliwo kpe ta ɖe ŋuwò godoo, eye vɔvɔ ɖo dzikatsoƒoe na wò zi ɖeka.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Mèle viviti kple tsiɖɔɖɔ, si nyè tsyɔ dziwò la, kpɔm oa?

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu mekɔ abe dziƒo ene oa? Eye kpɔ alesi ɣletivi kɔkɔtɔwo gbɔ metsɔe o ɖa!

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Eye wòa nele gbɔgblɔm be: Nuka Mawu nya? De wòate ŋu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu to alilikpo dodo mea?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Alilikpowo xe eŋku me, ale be mele nu kpɔm o, eye wòle tsatsam le dziƒo ƒe goawo dzi.

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Ɖe nèbe, yealé blemamɔ, si ame gbegblẽwo zɔ la, me ɖe asia?

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Amesiwo gblɔ na Mawu be: Te ɖa le mía gbɔ, nuka ŋusẽkatãtɔ awɔ mí hã?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Evɔ wonye etsɔ kesinɔnuwo yɔ xɔ na wo taŋ hafi. Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe adaŋudede nede megbe xaa tso gbɔnye!

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo akpɔ eteƒe; eye dzi adzɔ wo, eye ame maɖifɔ aɖu fewu le wo ŋu be:

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Wotsrɔ̃ míaƒe adikãtɔwo vavã, eye dzo fiã woƒe nuwo!

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: Dze xɔlɔ̃ kplii, eye ŋuwò afa, elabena to esia me dzɔgbenyuie ava dziwò.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Xɔ nufiafia tso eƒe nu me, eye eƒe nuƒoƒo nede dzigbɔ na wò!

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Ne ètrɔ de ŋusẽkatãtɔ ŋu, eye nèbɔbɔ ɖokuiwò ɖe anyi la, ne èɖe nu manyomanyo ɖa le wò agbadɔ me,

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: eye nètsɔ to me sika kɔ ɖe ke me kple Ofir-sika kɔ ɖe tɔʋu ƒe kpekuiwo me la,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ekema ŋusẽkatãtɔ anye sika kple klosalo na wò gleglegle.

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: E, ekema àkpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋusẽkatãtɔ ŋu, eye àwu wò mo dzi na Mawu.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Ne edo gbe ɖa nɛ la, aɖo to wò, eye àwɔ wò adzɔgbeɖeɖe dzi.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Ne èɖo nane ɖe tame la, adze edzi na wò, eye kekeli aklẽ ɖe wò mawo dzi.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Ne wole to yim la, ekema ãgblɔ be: Míva dzi! Exɔna na amesi bɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Aɖe ame ɖifɔ hã; eye woaɖee le wò asiwo ƒe dzadzɛnyenye ta.

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: Wobu nye konyifafa aglãdzedzee egbea hã, eye eƒe asi nu se ɖe nye hũɖeɖe dzi.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Oo, ne mahanya, afisi matu eyama le, eye made kekeke enɔƒe de!

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: ne menya, alesi wòaɖo eŋu nam, eye madze si nya, si wòagblɔ nam.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Ɖe wòatsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la awɔ aʋa kplima? Kpao ke boŋ akpɔ dzinye!

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Eye ame dzɔdzɔe ahe nya kplii, eye tɔnye adzɔ, madza le nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la gbɔ ɖikaa.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, mete ɣedzeƒe gome, mele afima o; mete ɣetodoƒe gome, nyemekpɔe o.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Ne ele nu wɔm le anyiehe la, nyemekpɔnɛ o; eye ne etrɔ ɖo ta dziehe la, nye ŋku metunɛ o.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Elabena edze si nye mɔ nyanyɛ la, eye ne adom akpɔ la, matsi anyi abe sika ene.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Nye afa mede eƒe afɔɖeɖewo ƒu o, melé ŋku ɖe eƒe mɔ ŋu, eye nyemedze o.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Ke eya la metrɔna o, ameka axe mɔ na? Ne nane dzroe la, ewɔnɛ!

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Aƒo nye nya la ade goe, eye esia tɔgbe geɖe le tame nɛ:

english_verse: makes me tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖe dzi le ƒonye, eye ŋusẽkatãtɔ ɖo dzikatsoƒoe nam.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Elabena menye viviti la ta wòtsrɔm ɖo o, eye menye nye ŋutɔ tae blukɔ tsyɔm ɖo o.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti ŋusẽkatãtɔ meɖo nuxi ɣeyiɣiatvo o, eye xɔlɔ̃awo mekpɔa eƒe ŋkekewo o?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Wotrɔa liƒowo, eye woɖaa adzo lãhawo kple lãkplɔlawo.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Wokplɔa tsyɔ̃evi ƒe tedzi dzonɛ, eye wotsɔa ahosi ƒe nya ɖoa awɔbae;

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: wotua asi ame dahewo ɖa le mɔ dzi, eye anyigba dzi hiãtɔwo sina ɣlana.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, woyia woƒe dɔ dzi abe gbetedzi le gbedzi ene; wofɔna ŋdi kanya ɖe nuhaha ŋu, eye gbegbe naa nuɖuɖu wo hena wo viwo.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Woŋea nu le agble me le zã, eye wofɔa nu dzɔdzɔe le ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe weingble me.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Womlɔa anyi amama le zã avɔ makpɔm eye nutsyɔtsyɔ mele wo si le vuvɔ me o.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Tsi gãwo ƒoa wo le towo dzi tea wo ŋu; wodoa akɔ na agakpewo, elabena bebeƒe meli na wo o.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Woɖaa adzo tsyɔ̃evi le dada ƒe akɔ, eye woxɔa awɔbanu le ame dahe si.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Wole yiyim amama, avɔ mele wo ŋu o, eye wole lu bablawo tsam domeɣeɣee.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Wole ami ɖam le woƒe gliwo domee, eye wole wein fiãm, gake tsikɔ le wo wum.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Kudɔƒolawo le ŋeŋem le duwo me, eye amesiwo woɖa nui la, le ɣli dom, gake Mawu melé ŋku ɖe nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ la ŋu o.

english_verse: Some rebel and refuse to follow the light.
translation_verse: Woawoe nye kekeli ƒe futɔwo, womedzea si eƒe mawo o, eye wometoa etoƒe o.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Ne ŋu le ɖeɖem le eme la, hlɔ̃ɖola tsona heƒoa ame dahe kple hiãtɔ ƒua anyi, eye le zã me la ewɔa nu abe fiafitɔ ene.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ahasitɔ ƒe ŋku le zãɖoɖo ŋu wòle gbɔgblɔm be, ŋkua ɖeke mele ye kpɔ ge o, eye wòtsɔ nu tsyɔ ma.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Wodzea zã ɖe aƒewo ŋu; wodoã ʋɔ ɖe wo ɖokui nu le ŋkeke me, eye womenyaa keli o.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Elabena viviti tsiɖitsiɖi le na wo katã abe agudzedze ene, eye wodzea xɔlɔ̃ zãblukɔ ƒe ŋɔdzi.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Eɖia du le tɔ dzi, eye woaƒo fi ade eƒe domenyinu le anyigba dzi, be magato weingblemɔ o.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe kplɔa nuvɔwɔlawo dzonɛ, abe alesi kuɖiɖi kple ŋdɔ heliheli kplɔa sno yina ene.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Dadaa ƒe akɔ aŋlɔe be, avivi nyẽwo nu, eye womagaɖo ŋku edzi o; woaŋe ame vlo abe ati ene,

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: eya amesi ha konɔ, siwo medzi via ɖeke o, eye mewɔ dɔmenyo na ahosiwo o.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Etsɔa eƒe ŋusẽ léa ŋutasẽla ɖe asi didie, eye amesi megaɖo ŋu ɖe agbenɔnɔ ŋu o la, gafɔna ɖe tsitrenu.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Enana wònɔa dedie, eziɔna ɖe eŋu, eye eƒe ŋkuwo nɔa eƒe mawo ŋu.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Wodoa wo ɖe dzi, eteƒe didina vie ko wo nu va yina; woɖoa agu hekuna abe ame bubuwo ene, eye wolãa wo abe ahɔ̃liti ƒe tagbɔ ene,

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: Ne mele alea o la, amekae aɖe aʋatso nam, eye wòagblẽ nye nuƒoƒo me?

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Tete Suaxtɔ Bildad ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena:

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: Dziɖuɖu le esi, eye ŋɔdzi le eŋu; enaa ŋutifafa le dzi me ʋi.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Ameka ate ŋu axlẽ eƒe aʋakɔwo, eye ameka tame eƒe kekeli mele oa?

english_verse: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Aleke amegbetɔ ƒe nya adzɔ le Mawu gbɔ, eye nyɔnu tɔ dzidzia adze?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ɣleti ke hã meɖina, eye ɣletiviwo me mekɔna le eƒe ŋku me o,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: ʋuu kekeke woahayi amegbetɔ, si nye nyẽ, kpakple ame, si nye ŋɔ la, nye ge!

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: Ame kudɔe ŋue nye esia nèkpe ɖoa, eye alɔ beli enye esia nèxɔ naa?

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Aɖaŋu pɛ nye esia nèɖo na ame manyanu, eye nètrɔ nunya ƒo ɖi dududua?

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Ameka ƒe nyawo nèva gblɔ, eye ameka ƒe gbɔgbɔe do tso mewò?

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔliwo le ʋuʋum nyanyanya le tsiwo kple wo me nuwo te.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe tsi go le eŋku me, eye woklo nu le ketu me dzi,

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: eya, amesi keke anyiehe ɖe ya me, eye meku anyigba ɖe naneke ŋu o;

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: amesi blaa tsiwo ɖe alilikpowo me, eye alilikpoawo medzena le wo ŋu o;

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: amesi xea eƒe fiazikpui ŋku me hekekea alilikpo ɖe edzi.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Eɖe liƒo ɖe tɔwo dzi godoo, vaseɖe afisi kekeli ke ɖe viviti ŋu le.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Dziƒosɔtiwo le dzodzom kpekpekpe, eye dziku tso wo ƒo le eƒe ŋɔdzidoname la,

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋusẽ nana ƒu dzea agbo, eye wògbãa ƒu me lãtsu gudugudu le eƒe nunya nu.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Eƒe ƒuƒu na dziŋgɔli me kɔ, eye eƒe asi ƒo nu ɖe ʋɔ dranyi, si le sisim la.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, esiawo nye eƒe mɔwo to ko, eye nusi sem miele la, enye dalidodo. Ke ameka ate ŋu abe eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe gbeɖeɖe gɔme?

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: Meta Mawu, amesi gbe afiatsotso nam la, ƒe agbe, kple ŋusẽkatãtɔ, amesi do nuxaxa na nye luʋɔ la;

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: ne nye nuyi ahagblɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ, eye nye aɖe agblɔ alakpanya fĩ!

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Nede megbe xaa tso gbɔnye, be matso na mi; nyemasẽ nu le nye fɔmaɖimaɖi ŋu, vaseɖe esime mamia nu o.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: Nye futɔ anɔ abe ame vɔ̃ɖi ene, eye nye adikãtɔ abe ame madzɔmadzɔ ene.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Elabena nuka nye ame vlo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ, ne Mawu lã eƒe luʋɔ, eye wòhoe ɖaa?

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu ase eƒe ɣli, ne xaxa va edzia?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe wòakpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋusẽkatãtɔ ŋu, eye wòayɔ Mawu ɣesiaɣia?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: Mafia nu mi le Mawu ƒe asi ŋu, eye nyemaɣla nusi ŋusẽkatãtɔ ɖo la o.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mi katã miekpɔe. Nukaŋuti miege ɖe susu dzodzro siawo me?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Esia nye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe gome tso Mawu gbɔ kple ŋutasẽlawo ƒe ɖomenyinu, si woxɔna tsoa ŋusẽkatãtɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Ne viawo dzi ɖe dzi la, ekema yi tae wonye, eye abolo maɖi ƒo na eƒe dzidzimeviwo o.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Dɔvɔ̃ atsɔ̃ amesiwo kpɔtɔ nɛ la, aɖe yɔ me, eye eƒe ahosiwo mafa avi o.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Ne eli kɔ klosalo abe ke ene, eye wotu avɔ ɖo abe anyi ene la,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: ekema ɖeko wòtu wo ɖo dzro; ame dzɔdzɔe atsɔ wo ata, eye ame maɖifɔ ama klosaloawo.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Etu eƒe xɔ ahe agbagblaʋui ene, eye wòɖi agbaɖɔ, si dzɔla tu.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔe wònye mlɔ anyi, ke magamlɔe zi evelia o; enu eƒe ŋkuwo, eye enu yi.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi ɖi kpee abe tɔɖɔɖɔ ene, eye ya ʋuɖuʋuɖu lɔe ɖe nu le zã me.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Ɣedzeƒeya de asi ete hekɔe yii, eye wòkplɔe dzoe le eteƒe.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Eyru aŋutrɔ ɖe edzi, eye meve enu o, eye wòsi le eƒe asi nu afɔ tsɔtsɔe.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Woƒu akpe ɖe ete, eye wòɖu tse ɖe eŋu wòdzo le enɔƒe.

english_verse: Gold and silver are mined, then purified;
translation_verse: Elabena klosalofɔƒe li, eye sika, si wolólona la, teƒe li.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Wokua ga yibɔ tso to me, eye kpe wolólona wòzua akɔbli.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Woɖo seƒe na viviti, eye wodi kpe, si le viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me la, le goawo katã me keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu tsoa anyigba me, ke wowlua ete, abe alesi dzo wlua; nui ene.

english_verse: that have jewels or gold.
translation_verse: Safir le eƒe kpewo me, eye afima wokpɔa sikawo le;

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: woawo nye mɔ, si hɔ̃ medze sii, eye aʋako ƒe ŋku mekpe kpɔ o;

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: mɔ, si dzi gbemelã ɖaɖadzrawo mele, eye dzata mezɔ kpɔ o.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Edo asi kpa sesẽwo dzi, eye wòwlu towo gome.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Eɖe toƒewo ɖe agakpewo me, eye eƒe ŋku kpɔ nu xɔasi vovovowo.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Exe mɔ na tsiwo, be womagaɖuɖu o, eye wòhe nusi ɣla le va kekeli nui.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Agume gblɔ be: Mele menye o! Eye atsiaƒu be: Mele gbɔnye o!

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Womenaa sika nyuitɔ ɖe eta o, eye womedaa klosalo ɖe eƒe home nu o.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Womabu sika kple ahuhɔ̃e ɖe eŋu o, eye womatsɔ sikanuwo aɖɔ lii o.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Womayi sui kple gbloti ŋkɔ yɔ ge ɖe eŋu o, eye nunya ƒe emesinɔnɔ nyo wu adzagba.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Kus ƒe Topas-kpe meɖe enu o, eye womadae akpe ɖe sika dzɔdzɛtɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Eɣla ɖe agbagbeawo katã ƒe ŋkuwo, eye wòbe ɖe dziƒoxewo.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Aʋlime kple ku le gbɔgblɔm be: Miele hũhũhũ sem le eŋu kple míaƒe towo.

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Mawu nya egbɔ mɔ, eye wòdze si enɔƒe.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: ne wòana yia ƒe kpekpemee, eye wòado dzidzeme na tsi.

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: Esi wòɖo seƒe na tsidzadza, eye wòɖo toƒe na dziɖegbe ƒe dzokeke la;

english_verse: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
translation_verse: ekpɔe, eye wòɖee fia, eɖoe te, eye wòdzro eme kpɔ hã,

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: hegblɔ na amegbetɔwo be: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la vɔvɔ̃ enye nunya, eye vɔ̃tsitsri enye gɔmesese.

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe wòanɔ num ehe dzinu tsãtɔwo kple ŋkeke, siwo me Mawu kpɔ tanye la ene:

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: esime eƒe akaɖi klẽ ɖe tanye me, eye meno eƒe kekeli me hezu to viviti me la:

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: esime menɔ nye edameŋkekewo me, eye Mawu ha ha kplim le nye agbadɔ me;

english_verse: and all of my children were nearby.
translation_verse: esime ŋusẽkatãtɔ gale gbɔnye, eye vinyewo ɖe to ɖem godoo;

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: esime notsi kpekẽ ƒo nye afa bliba, eye ami ɖo le agakpe me le axanye la!

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: Ne medo to agbo nu heyi ɖua me, eye meɖo nye zikpui ablɔ me gli,

english_verse: the young leaders stepped aside, *
translation_verse: eye ɖekakpuiwo kpɔm la, ekema wobena, eye ame tsitsiwo tsona henɔa tsitrenu,

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: amegãwo tɔna kɔ̃ le nuƒoƒo me hetsɔa asi ɖoa nu,

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: gbɔgblɔ buna ɖe bubumewo, eye woƒe aɖe léna ɖe aŋɔme na wo.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Elabena mexɔna na ame ɖahe, si le ɣli dom la, kple tsyɔ̃evi, si xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli na o la.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Ame tsiasi ƒe yayra vaa dzinye, eye mewɔa ahosi ƒe dzi wòtsoa aseye.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Menye ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔ, eye menye afɔ na bunɔ.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Fofoe menye na ame dahewo, eye media ame manyamanya ƒe ʋɔnunyagɔme.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Mefea glã na nu madzamadzɔ wɔla, eye meɖea adzonu le eƒe aɖu dzi.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: Mebu be, mía kple nye atɔ koe atsrɔ̃, eye nye ŋkekewo asɔ gbɔ abe ke ene,

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: nye kèwo ake nu de tsi ŋu, eye zãmu atsi nye alɔwo me;

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: Amewo léa to de ŋunye henɔa nye asinu dzɔm, eye wozina vi ɖe nye adaŋudede ŋu.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Ne meƒo nu la, amea ɖeke megaƒonɛ o, eye nye nyawo nyɔna ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Wole lalayem abe tsidzadza ene, eye woƒe veme ƒu abe ɖe keletsi ŋu ene.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ne melé mɔ yi wo dome la, ekema mebɔbɔ noa anyi abe woƒe tatɔ ene, eye menɔa anyi gli abe fia le aʋakɔwo dome kple amesi le akɔ fam na konyifalawo ene.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Azɔ nye tsɛwo, amesiwo fofowo medzem be, mana woade ha kple nye lãkplɔvũwo gɔ̃ hã o la, le koyem.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Nuka woƒe alɔkpa sesẽ nye nam? Tsitsinyenye bu ɖe wo.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Hiã kple dɔwuame na wolé ayi, eye wokuko gbegbe, si nye gbedzi ƒeƒle la.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Amesiwo ke aŋɔto le avekɔewo te, eye dɔli ƒe ke enye woƒe nuɖuɖu.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Wonyã wo le ha me, eye wole ɣli dom ɖe wo ta abe fiafitɔwo ene.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Wonɔa ne dziŋɔwo, dowo kple agadowo me.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Wole xɔxlɔ̃m le avekɔewo dome, eye woƒo ta kpli de aŋɔkawo te.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Bometsilawo kple ame ɖigbɔwo ƒe viwo wonye, amesiwo wotsɔ atam nya ɖa le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Azɔ metrɔ zu lodonu na wo, eye mezu alɔmeɖenu na wo.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Wole ŋu nyɔmem, wodea megbe le ŋunye, eye womegbea taɖeɖe ɖe mo nam o.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Elabena atso nye daka, eye wòbɔbɔm ɖe anyi, eye wòna woɖaa ɖadzra le ŋkunye me.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Ɖevi vloewo tsia tre ɖe ŋunye le ɖusi me, wotutua nye afɔ ɖa, eye wotaa mɔ ɖe ŋunye, be yewoagblẽm.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Wogblẽa nye toƒe, eye wo, amesiwo xɔnamelɔa ɖeke meli na o la, kpea asi ɖe nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ŋu.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzidodo trɔna ɖe ŋunye; woyɔa nye bubu ɖe nu abe ya ene, eye nye dzɔgbenyuie nu yina ahe alilikpo ene.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Azɔ nye luʋɔ lólo gbanaa ɖe dɔme nam, eye hiãŋkekewo lém.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Kuɖiɖi na nye awu gblɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye wole ŋunye abe nye awutewui ƒe kɔme ene.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Wotsɔm ƒu gbe ɖe ba me, eye mele abe ke kple afi ene.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: Medoa ɣli yɔa wò, ke mètɔna nam o; metsia tre ɖi, eye mèléa ŋku de ŋunye o.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Ekɔam ɖe dzi mezɔa ya me, eye nènana menyina de ahom me keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Elabena menyae be, àkplɔm ade asi na ku, eye mayi xɔ, si me agbãgbeawo katã ƒoa ta kpli do la me.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Elabena mekpɔ mɔ na nyui, ke vɔ̃ va; mekpɔ kekeli sinu, ke viviti do.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Nye dɔkaviwo le tòtom klɔklɔklɔ atraɖii, eye hiãŋkekewo ƒo ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Menyɔ tsiɖitsiɖi le yiyim, evɔ menye ɣee fiãm o; metso le takpekpe me hele boboe dom.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Mezu agbotoewo nɔvi kple hati na golowo.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutigbalẽ nyɔ tsiɖitsiɖi heflo le ŋunye, eye dzoxɔxɔ na nye ƒuwo fiã.

english_verse: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.
translation_verse: Nye gakasaŋku do konyifagbe, eye nye dze ƒe ɖiɖi zu avigbe.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: Mebla nu kple nye ŋku, eye aleke lawɔ malé ŋku ɖe ɖetugbi ŋu?

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Ɖe gbegblẽ mevaa ame vɔ̃ɖi dzi, eye dzɔgbevɔ̃e vaa nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo dzi oa?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Ɖe mele nye mɔwo kpɔm, eye wòxlẽa nye afɔɖeɖewo katã oa?

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: ekema nedam le nudanu nyuitɔ dzi, eye Mawu nadze si nye fɔmaɖimaɖi.

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: ekema maƒã nu, eye ame bubu naɖui, eye woaho nye nu miemiewo kple ke.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: Ne woflu nye dzi ɖe nyɔnu ŋu, eye mede xa ɖe hanyevi ƒe ʋɔtru nu la,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: ekema srɔ̃nye netu wɔ na ame bubu, eye ame tutɔ nedɔ egbɔ.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Elabena ŋukpenanu enye esia, eye se me dzedze wònye le ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo ŋku me.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: E, dzo wònye, si abi nu vaseɖe tsiẽƒe ke, eye wòafiã nye agblemenuwo katã kple ke.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: Ne nye dɔlaŋutsu kple nye dɔlanyɔnu do nya me kplim, eye megbe woƒe nya dzɔdzɔe la,

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: nuka mawɔ, nenye be, Mawu tso? Eye ne edzro eme kpɔ la, aleke made eŋu nɛ?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ɖe menye amesi mem ɖe vidzidɔ me la, me eya hã, eye ame ɖekae wɔ mí ɖe dɔme oa?

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: Ɖe mete ame dahewo ƒe nudidi wo, eye mene nu ti kɔ na ahosiwo ƒe ŋkuwoa?

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Ɖe nye ɖeɖe meɖu nu, eye nyemena tsyɔ̃evi ɖul kplim oa?

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Kpao, ke boŋ enɔ gbɔnye tsi tso nye ɖevime abe fofoa gbɔ ene, eye tso keke danye ƒe dome ke mefia mɔnui.

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: ɖe eƒe alime meyram, eye nye alẽwo ƒe tu de dzo lãme nɛ oa?

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Ne menye nye asi de tsyɔ̃evi ŋu, le esi xɔnamelɔ le asinye le dua me ta la,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: ekema nye abɔta nege le abɔgba ŋu, eye nye abɔ netu ɖa le ekpeƒe!

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Elabena gbegblẽ, si tso Mawu gbɔ la, do ŋɔdzi nam, eye nyemate ŋu anɔ te de eƒe gãnyenye nu o.

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: ne mekpɔ dzidzɔ be, nye kesinɔnuwo sɔ gbɔ, eye nye alɔ wɔ dɔ kpɔ nu geɖe;

english_verse: Such horrible sins would have deserved punishment from God.
translation_verse: ekema esia hã anye se me dzedze le ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo ŋku me; elabena meda alakpa na Mawu le dzi.

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: Ɖe mekpɔ dzidzɔ le nye ketɔ ƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ŋu, eye meti kpo, esime vɔ dzɔ ɖe edzia?

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Kpao, nyemena nye nu wɔ nuvɔ̃ o, eye nyemedi eƒe ku to ɖiŋudodo nɛ me o.

english_verse: No one ever went hungry at my house,
translation_verse: Ɖe aƒenye me tɔwo menɔa gbɔgblɔm bena: Amekae meɖu eƒe lã ɖi ƒo oa?

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Ɖe metsyɔ nu nye dzidadawo dzi abe amegbetɔ ene, eye meɣla nye fɔɖiɖi ɖe akɔnua?

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Ɖe menɔa ame geɖewo vɔ̃m, eye ƒomewo ƒe vlododo nɔa ŋɔ dzim nam, eyata ɖoɖoe zina le ŋunye, eye nyemedona ɖe ʋɔtru nu oa?

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe amea ɖe naɖo tom! Kpɔ ɖa, nye nuŋɔŋlɔ enye si, ŋusẽkatãtɔ neɖo eŋu nam! Nye adikãtɔ ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ ɖe?

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Vavã, malée ɖe abe, eye maxatsae ɖe ta abe atsyɔ̃ɖonu ene.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Mato nye afɔɖeɖewo ƒe xexlẽme nɛ, eye mate ɖe eŋu abe amegã ene.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: Ne nye agble nɔa ɣli dom ɖe ŋunye, eye eƒe boliƒowo kalã nɔa avi fam,

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: ne meɖu eme nu femaxemaxe, eye mene gbɔgbɔ ɖo le agbletɔ me la,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: ekema ŋu nemie ɖe lu teƒe, eye gbe vɔe nemie ɖe ƒo teƒe! Hiob gblɔ eƒe nya vɔ.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsu etɔ̃awo dzudzɔ nya ŋuɖoɖo na Hiob, elabena edo eɖokui ame dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Tete dzi ku Elihu, Buzitɔ Baraxel ƒe vi, amesi tso Ram-ƒome la me la; Hiob ŋue dzi kui ɖo, elabena ebu eɖokui dzɔdzɔetɔe wu Mawu;

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: eye exɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo ŋue dzi kui do, elabena womekpɔ nyaa ɖeke aɖo ŋu atsa abu fɔ Hiob o.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Ke Elihu tsɔ nyawo le Hiob dzɔmi, elabena ame kemeawo nye xoxo nɛ.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Eye esi Elihu kpɔ be, nya ŋuɖoɖo vɔ le ŋutsu etɔ̃awo nu la, dzi kui.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
