translation_verse: Eye Buzitɔ Elihu, Baraxel vi la, xɔ dzi gblɔ bena: Ɖevi menye, ke miawo mietsi ƒo wɔ, eya ta dzi mele ƒonye o, eye mele vɔvɔ̃m be, maɖe nye nunyanya afia mi.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Mebu be: Tsitsi neƒo nu, eye ƒe geɖe nede nunya fia!

english_verse: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.
translation_verse: Ke gbɔgbɔ la le amegbetɔwo me, eye ŋusẽkatãtɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ fia nunya wo.

english_verse: Age is no guarantee of wisdom and understanding.
translation_verse: Nunya mele tsitsi me o, eye menye amegã ɖeɖiwo koe nyaa nusi le teƒe la o.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Eyata mebe, mido tom, nye hã made nye nunyanya afia!

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Ɖeko migagblɔ bena: Míedo go nunya, Mawu koe akpe ɖe dzi, menye amegbetɔ o.

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Ke medo nyaa ɖeke ɖe gbɔnye o; eye menye miaƒe nyawo tsɔ ge mala aɖo eŋu nɛ o.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Dzi ɖe le wo ƒo, womagate ŋu aɖo eŋu o, eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe wo.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Eye ɖe nyea manɔ lalam, esi womele nu ƒom o, wozi ɖoɖoe, eye nya ŋuɖoɖo megale wo ŋu o laa?

english_verse: No! I will give my opinion,
translation_verse: Nye hã maɖo tɔnye nua ŋu, eye maɖe nye nunya afia!

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Elabena nya yɔm banaa, eye helehele tsi akɔta nam.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Nyemade ame dzi o, eye nyemavivi nume na amea ɖeke o.

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: Elabena nyemenya alesi wovivia numee o; anye, ne nye wɔla aɖem ɖa bɔbɔe.

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: Azɔ, Hiob, se nye nyawo, eye naƒu to anyi ɖe nye nuƒoƒowo katã ŋu!

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔe wɔm, eye ŋusẽkatãtɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔe gbɔ agbem.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: Ne ele ŋuwò la, ɖo ŋu nam; bla akpa de ŋunye, eye nadze avu ɖi!

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, Mawu tae menye abe wò ke ene, eye tsue woka me nye hãe.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, megana madzi ŋɔ na wò o, eye nye asi megale ɖe dziwò o!

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: „Medza, dzidada mele ŋunye o, ŋunye kɔ, eye vodada mele ŋunyie o:

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: kpɔ ɖa, ekpɔ nane le ŋunye, eye wòbum abe eƒe futɔ ene,

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: de ga nye afɔ ɖe atiboli ŋu, eye wolé ŋku de nye mɔwo katã ŋu.“

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mele eŋu ɖdom na wò be: Tɔwò medzɔ le esia me o, elabena Mawu kpe wu amegbetɔ.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nele dzra wɔm kplii, le esi medo wò nyawo katã ŋu na wò o taa?

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒoa nu le mɔ si kple mɔ keme dzi, ke womedzea sii o.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: ne woate amegbetɔ da le eƒe nuwɔwɔ ŋu, eye wòaɖe dàdaa le ŋutsu la me,

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: ne wòaxɔ eƒe luʋɔ tso yɔdo si me, eye eƒe agbe magatsi aŋutrɔ nu o.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Wotsɔa vevesese hã hea to nɛ le eƒe aba dzi, eye eƒe ƒuwo nɔa eɖum ƒuƒuƒu.

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu nyɔa ŋu nɛ, eye eƒe luʋɔ nyɔa ŋu eƒe nuɖuɖu lɔlɔ̃a.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: ale be eƒe luʋɔ gogo yɔdo, eye eƒe agbe gogo saɖagatsi.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Ke ne dɔla ɖeka, si nye nyaxɔlaɖakɔtɔ, tso akpewo dome la va, be yeaɖe nusi nye amegbetɔ ƒe dɔ la afiae,

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: eye wòve enu hegblɔ bena: Ɖee, ne magayi yɔdo me o, elabena wolé avum la,

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: ekema dzo aɖo eƒe lãme abe ɖekakpui ene, eye wòagaɖo eƒe ɖekakpuiŋkekewo me.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Edo gbe ɖa na Mawu, eye wòve enu hekpɔ eƒe ŋku me dzidzɔtɔe, eye wòɖo amegbetɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Adzi ha na amewo agblɔ bena: Mewɔ nuvɔ̃, eye metrɔ gbo nu dzɔdzɔe la, ke womeɖo eteƒe nam o.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: Eɖe nye luʋɔ, ale be meyi yɔ me o, eye nye agbe kpɔ dzidzɔ le kekeli ŋu.

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nusiawo katã Mawu wɔna na ame zi eve kple zi etɔ̃,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: ne yeaxɔ eƒe luʋɔ tso yɔdo si, eye agbe ƒe kekeli naklẽ nɛ.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Ne nya le asiwò la, ekema ɖo ŋu; ƒo nu, eye matso na wò kpoo:

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: Mi nunyalawo, mise nye nyawo, eye mi nugɔmeselawo, milé to ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: Elabena to doa nya kpɔna, abe alesi veme ɖɔa nuɖuɖu kpɔna ene.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Mina míahe nya dzɔdzɔe atu anyi, ne míadze si nusi nyo la le mía dome.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Elabena Hiob be: „Tɔnye dzɔ, gake Mawu gbe afiatsotso nam;

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: wobum aʋatsokalae, evɔ wònye tɔnye dzɔ hafi: gbedala meli na nye aŋutrɔbi o, evɔ wònye nyemeda vo o hafi.“

english_verse: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
translation_verse: Afika amea de le abe Hiob ene, amesi le ɖiŋudoname nom abe tsi ene,

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Elabena egblɔ be: „Menye viɖe na amegbetɔ, ne edze xɔlɔ̃ kple Mawu o.“

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Eyata, mi ŋutsu nunyalawo, milé to ɖe ŋunye! Nede megbe xaa be, Mawu nawɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi, eye ŋusẽkatãtɔ nawɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ;

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Ameka tsa anyigba ɖe asi nɛ, eye ameka ɖo xexeme godoo la gɔme anyi?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Ne edia eɖokui tɔ ko, eye wògbugbɔ eƒe gbɔgbɔ kple eƒe agbe gagbɔ ɖe eɖokui me la:

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: ekema ŋutilãwo katã nu ayi, eye amegbetɔ agazu ke.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Ɖe amesi lé fu nya dzɔdzɔe la, ale ŋu aɖu dzia? Eye ɖe nébe, yeabu fɔ dzɔdzɔetɔ, si nye ŋusẽtɔ la?

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Ɖe wokpɔ mɔ agblɔ na fia be: yakame, eye na amegã be: ame vɔ̃ɖia?

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi medea amegãwo dzi o, eye meɖia kesinɔtɔwo ƒe nya wua ame dahewo tɔ o, elabena wo katã la eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ wonye.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Woku ɖe aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me, dukɔwo ƒe mo tsyɔ zi le zãtiƒe, eye wo nu vi: woɖe ŋusẽtɔwo ɖa, ke menye to amegbetɔwo ƒe asi dzi o.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Viviti kple blukɔa ɖeke meli, si me nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔla abe ɖo o.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Elabena meɖoa ŋkeke na amegbetɔ, be wòava ʋɔnu le Mawu ŋku me o.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Egbãa ŋusẽtɔwo gudugudu, eye wòtsɔa bubuwo ɖoa wo teƒe.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Esi wònya woƒe nuwɔnawo la, eyata wòtua asi wo ƒua anyi le zã me, eye woagbã gudugudu.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Eƒoa wo abe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ene le dutoƒo;

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: eye womehe ame dahewo ƒe ɣlidodo va eŋku me, ne wòase hiãtɔwo ƒe ɣlidodo o.

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: be ame vlowo magaɖu dzi, eye woanye mɔ̃ka na dukɔ la o.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Ɖe amea ɖe gblɔ na Mawu kpɔ be: Mekpe fu, evɔ wònye nyemewɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke o hafia?

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Nusi kpɔm nyemele o la, fiaem, eye ne mewɔ nu madzɔmadzɔa ɖe la, nyemagawɔe azɔ oa?

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Ɖe wòaɖo eteƒe le wò susu nua? Wò ŋue nu mele dzedzem o, eyata kpɔ eme natsɔ, menye nye o. Eye ne ènya nane la, gblɔe!

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: Nugɔmeselawo kple nunyala, siwo le to ɖomem la agblɔ nam be:

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: „Nunya mele Hiob ƒe nuƒoƒo me o, eye tamebubua ɖeke mele eƒe nyawo me o.

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe woate Hiob akpɔ atraɖii le ŋuɖoɖo, si wòna abe eme vlowo ene la ta!

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Elabena etsɔ vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ kpe ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋu, ele alɔme ɖem le mía dome, eye wòle nu geɖe ƒom ɖe Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Nya nyui enye sia gblɔm nèle be: „Tɔnye dzɔ wu Mawu tɔa?“

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Maɖo eŋu na mia kple xɔ̃wòwo!

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Ne ènye ame dzɔdzɔe la, nuka tsɔm nèle nɛ? Alo nuka wòaxɔ le asiwò?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: Ame abe wò ene, wò vɔɖiwɔwɔ ava dziwò ke; eye wò amegbetɔvi, wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ava dziwò!

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Wodoa ɣli le ameteɖeanyi geɖewo ta, eye wodoa boboe le ŋusẽtɔ ƒe alɔkpa ta;

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: ke womegblɔna be: Afika Mawu, nye wɔla, amesi na kafukafuhawo le zã me,

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe dadaa ta, ke meɖo eŋu o.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Yakanyawo koe Mawu mesena o, eye ŋusẽkatãtɔ la meléa ŋku ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
translation_verse: Azɔ nèle gbɔgblɔm hã be, yemele ekpɔm o. Nya la le eŋku me, dzɔ esi nu ko!

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ, esi eƒe dɔmedzoe mehe to na ame, eye metsɔ ɖeke le vodada geɖewo ƒe nya me o la,

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: eyata Hiob ƒo nu yakatsyɔ, eye wòlɔ nyawo ƒo ɖi, nunyaa ɖeke mele wo me o.

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: Kpɔ asinyenu vie, eye mafia nu wò, elabena nya gali woagblɔ ɖe Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Mahe nye nunya tso adzɔge vɛ, eye matso na nye wɔla.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Elabena nytateƒee, alakpa mele nye nyawo me o, eye nunyala kpamkpam enye si le gbɔwò.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu lolo, eƒe nunya ƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ, ke medoa vlo amea ɖeke o,

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Menana ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nɔa agbe o, eye wòtsona na hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Meɖea eƒe ŋku ɖa le ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu o, eye wònana wobɔbɔ nɔa fiawo gbɔ le fiazikpuiwo dzi ɖaa, ne woatsi kɔkɔƒe.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Ne wode kɔsɔkɔsɔ wo, eye wole hiã ƒe ka me la,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: eɖea woƒe nuwɔwɔ kple woƒe dzidadawo fiaa wo, le esi wodo wo ɖokui ɖe dzi ta:

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: eʋua to na wo ɖe tohehe la ŋu hegblɔna be, woatrɔ tso woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo me.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Ne woɖo to, eye wosubɔe la, ekema woawu woƒe ŋkekewo nu le dzɔgbenyuie me kple woƒe ƒewo nu le dzidzɔ me.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Ke ne womeɖo to o la, ekema woatsi aŋutrɔ nu, eye wo nu ayi le numanyamanya me.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoe le dzi ta na eme vlowo, eye ne ede ga wo la, womeƒoa koko o,

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Ke etsɔa hiã ɖea hiãtɔwoe, eye wòtsɔa xaxa nua to na woe.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Aɖe wò hã tso xaxa ƒe ve me ayi teƒe keke, afisi mexaxa o, eye nusiwo ava wò kplɔ̃ dzi la, ada ami nyanyanya.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Ke ne ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe afiatsotso yɔ mewò fũ la, ekema afiatsotso kple tohehe adze dziwò.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Elabena dɔmedzoe megaflu wò nayi fewu ɖu ge o, eye tawòƒlega gbogboawo megakplɔ wò trae o.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Ɖe wò ɣli, si nèɖo le hiã me kple wò kutrikukuwo katã ate ŋu ade nane nua?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Zã si kplɔ dukɔwo ɖa le wo teƒe ƒiaƒiaƒia la, meganɔ dzrowòm o.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi nyuie! Megatrɔ ɖe yakanu ŋu o, elabena èlɔ̃a eya wu hiã.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu tsɔa eƒe ŋusẽ wɔa nu tsuwo; eye ameka nye nufiala abe eya ene?

english_verse: to guide or correct him. Others Have Praised God
translation_verse: Ameka ɖo eƒe mɔwo nɛ, eye ameka kpɔ mɔ agblɔ nɛ be: Ewɔ nu manyomanyo?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ɖo eƒe nuwɔwɔ, siwo ŋu amegbetɔwo dzia ha le la, ɖe dzi!

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Amegbetɔwo katã kpɔa dzidzɔ le eŋu, eye kodzogbea kpɔnɛ tsoa adzɔge.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu tri akɔ, mele nyanya me na mí o, eye eƒe ƒewo gɔmedidi meli o.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: Elabena ehea tsi toŋtoŋwo yia dzii, eye eƒe afuwo dzaa tsi,

english_verse: and supplies us with rain.
translation_verse: woɖuɖuna tsoa alilikpowo me, eye wonyɔna ɖe ame geɖewo dzi.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Ɖe amegbelɔa ɖe nya, alesi wokekea alilikpowo me, kple alesi eƒe agbaɖɔ dzena kprrr… laea?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ekeke kekeli ɖe eɖokui dzi, eye wòtsɔ afu, si ɖo tso atsiaƒu me la, tsyɔ eɖokui dzi.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Elabena eya wòtsɔna hea to na dukɔwo, eye wònaa nuɖuɖu wo kpaekpaŋ.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Eɣla dzikedzo ɖe eƒe asiawo kple eve me, eye wòdɔe ɖa ɖe eƒe ketɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Eƒe gbeɖeɖe le boblo domi, eye eƒe dɔmedzoe le ŋu ʋãm ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu.

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: Ẽ, esia na nye dzi lã kpokpokpo, eye wòbu ɖe dɔ me nam.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Oo, mise eƒe gbeɖeɖe hoo kple bublu, si dona tsoa eƒe nu me la ɖa!

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Eɖea asi eŋu ɖona ɖe dziƒo blibo la te, eye eƒe dzikedzo dea anyigba ƒe mlɔeanu.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖea gbe nukutɔe, ewɔa nu gã, si mele nyanya me o.

english_verse: make us stop and think about God's power,
translation_verse: Enana amewo katã dea asi asitɛ me, ne amegbetɔwo katã nadze si eƒe nuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Gbemelã yia bebeƒe, eye wògbɔna ɖe eme le emlɔƒe.

english_verse: The windstorms of winter strike,
translation_verse: Ahom tsoa dziehe, eye vuvɔ tsoa anyiehe.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe ƒuƒu nana tsi blana, eye tɔ kekewo ƒoa ƒu ɖeka.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Etsɔa tsi ɖoa agba na alilikpowo, eye eƒe dzikedzo kakaa alilikpowo me,

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: Enana wòvana, ne wòatsɔe ahe to na anyigba dzi nɔlawo loo, alo ne wòawɔ dɔmenyo na woe.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Hiob, lé to de esia ŋu, zi ɖoɖoe, eye nalé ŋku de Mawu ƒe nukunuwo ŋu!

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Enya alesi Mawu dɔa dɔwoe, eye wònana kekeli dona tsoa eƒe alilikpowo mea?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Ɖe enya alesi alilikpowo nɔa agba sami, nusi nye nunyala ŋutɔŋutɔ ƒe nukunuwɔwɔa?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Wo, amesi ƒe awuwo xɔa dzo, nenye be, dzieheya na anyigba ɖo ho anyi la,

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: mi kpakpliie xa dziŋgɔli, si le abe ahuhɔ̃e, si wokɔ ene la gobaa?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: To nusi míaɖagblɔ nɛ la, na mi! Elabena míate ŋu ahe nyaa ɖeke ayi eŋku mee o le míaƒe viviti la ta.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Ɖe woaɖagblɔ nɛ be, mele nu ƒo gea? Alo ɖe amea ɖe bi be, woatsrɔ̃ea?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ womele kekeli, si le keklẽm le alilikpowo me la, kpɔm o; ke ne ya ƒo to edzi la, eŋu kɔna.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Sika tsoa anyiehe, eye atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo, si dzia ŋɔ la, le Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, amea ɖeke matui o, eƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ, ke metea se kple dzɔdzɔenyenye blibo ɖe to o.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Eyata amegbetɔ navɔ̃e. Meléa ŋku ɖe amesiwo katã bua wo ɖokui nunyalawoe la ŋu o.

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖo ŋu na Hiob le dziya me gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: Amekae tsɔ nuƒoƒo, si nunyaa ɖeke mele eme o la, blu aɖaŋuɖoɖo mee?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Tso, nasa avɔ ɖe ali abe ŋutsu ene; mabia nya wò, eye nafia num!

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Afika nènɔ, esime meɖo anyigba gɔme anyi? Ne nunya le tagbɔ na wò la, ekema gblɔe!

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Ameka ɖo eƒe dzidzeme? Enyae tso! Alo ameka da dzidzeka nɛ?

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Nuka dzi wodo egɔme anyi do, eye ameka ɖo eƒe dzogoedzikpe,

english_verse: while morning stars sang, and angels rejoiced?
translation_verse: esime ŋukeɣletiviwo katã le aseye tsom, eye Mawu ƒe viwo katã gli kple dzidzɔa?

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: Ameka tso ʋɔtruwo xe mɔ na atsiaƒu, esime wòdo tso vidzidɔ me?

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: Esime metsyɔ alilikpo nɛ, eye medzii goŋgoŋ ɖe blukɔ me;

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: meɖo liƒo nɛ, eye mede gameti kple agbo enu

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: hegblɔ bena: Afii nava se ɖo, eye mayi ŋgɔ o; eye afii wò tsotsoe kpakawo aƒo ɖoa?

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Le wò agbe me ŋkekewo me la, ɖe nèɖe se na ŋɖi kpɔ, eye néfia agudzedze ƒe nɔƒee,

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: ne wòalé anyigbatoga aʋuʋu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖa le eŋua?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Etrɔna abe tsu, si wonyã ene, eye nɔnɔmewo tsia anyi abe avɔ ene.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Woaxɔ kekeli le ame vɔ̃ɖi si, eye woaŋe abɔ, si woɖo ɖe dzi la.

english_verse: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?
translation_verse: Ɖe nede atsiaƒu dzɔƒe, eye nèzɔ egɔme kpɔa?

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: De woʋu ku ƒe agbo na wò, eye nekpɔ blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi ƒe agbo kpɔa?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Ekpɔ anyigba ƒe kekemea? Ne enya nusiawo katã la, gblɔe!

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Kekeli gbɔ mɔ ɖe, eye afika nye viviti ƒe nɔƒe,

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Enyae tso, elabena ɣemaɣi wodzi wò, eye wò ŋkekewo ƒe xexlẽme sɔ gbɔ!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Ɖe nède afisi wodzra sno ɖo, eye nèkpɔ afisi woƒo dzikpewo nu ƒu do,

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: esiwo metu do ɖe xaxaɣi, avuwɔgbe kple aʋakpegbe ŋua?

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: Mɔ ka kekeli mãna tona, eye afika ɣedzeƒeya tona kakana ɖe anyigba dzi?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Ameka ɖo toƒe na tsidzadza gãwo kple mɔ na dziɖegbe kple dzikedzo,

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: ne woana tagba kple gbegbe naɖi kɔ, eye gbe mumu namie?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Ɖe fofo li na tsidzadza, eye zãmũ ƒe tagegewo la, ameka dzi wo?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Ameka ƒe dɔ mee tsi babla tso, eye ameka dzi dziƒo ƒe miãtsi bablawo?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Tsiwo lía abe kpe ene, eye tɔwo ŋgɔ bla ɖekae.

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: Wòe saa atifieŋuwo ƒe ka, alo wòe ɖea ka avũ kple avũtɔa?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Wòe kplɔa ŋukeɣletivi doa goe, eye wòe kplɔa koklovinɔ kple viawoa?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Enya dziƒo ƒe sewoa, alo wòe ɖoa eƒe dziɖuɖu ɖe anyigba dzia?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: A le ŋu aɖe gbe na alilikpo be, tsi geɖe nanyẽ atsyɔ dziwòa?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Ate ŋu ada dzikedzowo, eye woayi ava gblɔ na wò be: Míawoe nye esia?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Ameka tsɔ nunya ɖo alilikpo tsiɖitsiɖi me, eye ameka na gɔmesese yamenuwo?

english_verse: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
translation_verse: Ameka tsɔ nunya xlẽ alilikpowoe, eye ameka trɔ dziƒotsigoewo ƒo ɖe anyi,

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: Wòe kaa ade na dzatanɔ, eye nèfaa dɔwuame nu na dzataviwo,

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: ne wotsyɔ akɔ anyi ɖe dowo me, eye wode xa ɖe avedodoewo mea?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Ameka ɖaa nuɖuɖu na akpaviã, ne viawo le ɣli dom na Mawu, eye wole tsa glãla tsam nuɖuɖu makpɔmakpɔe?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: Ènya agamegbɔ̃ewo ƒe vidziɣia? eye ɖe nèdze si ɣeyiɣi, si fu ɖua zinɔwoa?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ ɖoa wo viawo ŋu, eye wotsina le gbe me, wodzona, eye womegagbɔna vaa wo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Who set wild donkeys free?
translation_verse: Ameka na ablɔɖe gbetedzi? Eye ameka tu ka gbetedzi,

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: si metsɔ gbegbe wɔ aƒe na, eye metsɔ dzeƒe wɔ eƒe nɔƒee?

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Du me howɔwɔ le kokoe ɖim nɛ, eye mele kplɔla ƒe ɣlidodo sem o.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Ele ŋu tsam na gbeɖuƒe le towo dzi, eye wòle gbe mumu ɖesiaɖe yome mɔ dim.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Ɖe tò alɔ̃ asubɔ wò kpoo, eye wòatsi wò lãto gbɔ adɔa?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Ɖe àte ŋu ade ka tò ɖe agbleŋlɔnu ŋu, alo wòagudu bali me le yowòmea?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Ɖe naɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu, le esi ŋusẽ kako le esi ta, eye natsɔ wò dɔ agblẽ ɖe esi mea?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Ɖe naɖo dzi ɖe eŋu be, atsɔ wò agblemenuwo ava aƒee, eye wòaƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe wò ava mea?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Golonɔ ƒoa aʋala kpakpakpa, ke damixe ƒe aʋala kple fu ye wònyea?

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Kpao, hafi boŋ eɖaa eƒe azi ɖe anyigba, eye wònana ke dzodzoe ƒoa wo;

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: ke eŋlɔnɛ be, be woaɖo afɔ edzi, eye gbemelãwo agbãe.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Esẽa ŋuta le viawo ŋu, abe menye eto wonye o ene; eye ne eƒe agbagbadzedze zu dzodzro ha la, ŋɔ medzinɛ o.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu na nunya bu ɖee, eye mena gɔmesesea ɖekee o.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Wòe na ŋusẽ sɔa, eye wòe tsa kɔdza tsyɔ kɔ ŋu nɛa?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Wòe na wòdzoa kpo abe ʋetsuvi enea? Eƒe gbagba fuxefuxe enye ŋɔdzi.

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Ele anyigba kam, ekpɔa dzidzɔ le eƒe ŋusẽ ŋu, eye wòyina ɖakpea akpablalawo.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ ɖoa nukokoe ne, ŋɔ medzinɛ o, eye metrɔa megbe dea yi o.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Daku, akplɔ kple tunuhlo le zi dom ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Enyrã, eye wòdze agbo heka anyigba le dadam, eye ne kpẽ di hã la, metɔna o.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Ne kpẽ ɖi la, exlɔ̃na be: Eɖo dzi loo! Aʋa kple aʋafia ƒe gbedeɖe kpakple aʋaɣli ƒe ya le edzi dzem tso adzɔge ke!

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Wò nunya nue aʋako dzona, eye wòkekea eƒe aʋala ɖoa ta dziehe lena?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Afima wòtsaa ŋu nuɖuɖu tsona, eye eƒe ŋku kpɔa keke didiƒe ke.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Viawo noa ʋu, eye afisi ame tsiaʋawo le la, afima wònɔna.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖo ŋu na Hiob gblɔ bena:

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyaheɖeameŋula ahe nya kple ŋusẽkatãtɔa? Amesi fia nyanyɛ Mawu la, neɖo eŋu!

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Tete Hiob ɖo ŋu na Yehowa gblɔ bena:

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: Meƒo nu zi ɖeka, eye meɖe nu le eme; meƒo evevea, eye nyemagawɔe azɔ o.

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ɖo ŋu na Hiob le dziya me gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: Sa ava ɖe ali abe ŋutsu ene, mabia nya wò, eye nafia num!

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Ɖe nagblẽ nye afiatsotso me, eye nabu fɔm be, tɔwòe nye dzɔdzɔea?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Ɖe abɔ le asiwò abe Mawu ene, eye nate ŋu aɖe gbe abe eya enea?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Ekema tsɔ bubu kple gãnyenye ɖo atsyɔ̃e, eye naɖo fianyenye kple ŋutikɔkɔe!

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Ɖi wo katã ɖe ke me, eye nam nu ɖe woƒe mo nu ɖe blukɔ me!

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Ekema nye hã makatu wò be, wò nuɖusi xɔ na wò.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Kpɔ tɔmenyi, si mewɔ kpe ɖe ŋuwò ɖa! Eɖua gbe abe nyi ene.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eƒe ŋusẽ le eƒe ali me, eye eƒe ŋusẽ le eƒe ƒodokawo me.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Eli eƒe asike ɖe dzi abe sederti ene, eye eƒe atagbo me kawo ɖo wo nɔewo me kunyakunya.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Eƒe ƒuwo le abe akɔbliyetiwo ene, eye eƒe ƒuwo le abe gakpɔti ene.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Eya nye Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe gbãtɔ, eye ewɔla tsɔ yi de asi nɛ.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Elabena nuɖuɖu miena ɖe towo dzi ne eye gbemelãwo katã ɖia adzrɔ le afima.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Egbɔna ɖe eme le tɔŋgɔtrefe le, eye wòɣlana ɖe aƒlawo me le si me.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Aguŋgbawo ɖo vɔvɔli ɖe edzi, eye amutiwo ɖe to ɖee.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ne tɔsisi ɖe ati ʋɔ me la, dzika metsoa eƒo o, eye ne Yordan le ƒoƒom ɖe nuti ŋu nɛ hã, enɔa anyi bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: De amea ɖe ate ŋu alée le ŋgɔdze, eye wòaƒo ka ɖe ŋɔti me nɛa?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ azu dzodzro: ne ekpɔe tete ko la, aɖo baba ɖe anyi.

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke meɖoa nu tamee, be wòaʋuʋui o; eye ameka ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nunya?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Nyemazi ɖoɖoe le eƒe ŋutinuwo, eƒe ŋusẽ gbogboawo kple eƒe nɔnɔme dzeani la ŋu o.

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Ameka aklo ava le eŋu, eye ameka aɖo eƒe aɖuwo domee?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Ameka aʋu eƒe ŋku me ʋɔtruwo? Ŋɔdzi ƒo xlã eƒe aɖuwo.

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Eƒe akpoxɔnu trikpawo nye adegbeƒonu, eye wolè ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu kpaɖikpãɖi.

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Womimi ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu, ale be ya metoa wo domee o.

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Ɖesiaɖe ku ɖe nɔvia ŋu, eye wode alɔ wo nɔewo me, ale be womate ŋu amã o.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Eƒe nyenyẽ kea dzo, eye eƒe ŋkuwo le abe agudzedze ƒe aɖabawo ene.

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Kakati bibiwo dona tsoa eƒe nu me, eye dzoxiwo hlẽna ŋeŋeŋe.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Ne egbɔ la, akawo léa dzo, eye dzoƒaɖewo dona tsoa eƒe nu me.

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le eƒe kɔ me, eye ŋɔdzi le ɣe ɖum le eŋgɔ.

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Eƒe dɔyi medzɔ gblɔyi o, ke boŋ edo akpa ɖe eŋu kpaɖikpaɖi.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Ne etso la, dzidzi ƒoa ŋusẽtɔwo, eye ŋɔdzi nana woluluna.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Ne wotsɔ lãnu ɖe eŋu, eɖanye yi alo akplɔ o, eɖanye fiavi alo aŋutrɔ o la, exɔa akpo.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Ebua ga yibɔ abe gbe ƒuƒu ene kple akɔbli abe ati nyunyɔ ene.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Aŋutrɔ menyãnɛ o, eye akafokpewo nɔna nɛ ahe ahɔ̃liti ene.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Ebua kpoviakpoe abe ahɔ̃liti ene, eye ne akplɔ le ʋɔ lũm la, eɖia kokoe nɛ.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Eƒe dɔmegbɔ nye sonugaglɛ ɖaɖɛwo, eye wòɖena ɖe ba me abe luƒotasiaɖam ene.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Enana tɔ gɔme fiẽna wlɔwlɔwlɔ abe nuɖaze me ene, eye wòblua atsiaƒu abe amiɖaze me ene.

english_verse: and its heart is stone.
translation_verse: Eyome dea mumutsi, eye tɔa dzi funa tii.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Etɔgbea ɖeke mele anyigba dzi o; nuwɔwɔ, si ŋɔ medzina o la, wònye.

english_verse: No sword or spear can harm it,
translation_verse: Eklẽa ŋku ɖe nu gãwo katã; eya nye fia ɖe lã ɖaɖadzratvo katã dzi.

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: Azɔ menyae be, ate ŋu awɔ nuwo katã, eye nusi nèdo la, mesesẽna na wò o.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Ameka tsoa numanyamanya tsyɔa adaŋudede dzia? Eyata megblɔ nya, siwo gɔme nyemese o, kple nusiwo kɔ wum, eye nyemedze si wo o la.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: Ɖo to, ne maƒo nu; mabia nya wò, eye nafia num!

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nya le ŋuwò mese; ke azɔ la nye ŋkuwo kpɔ wò.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esi Yehowa ƒo nusiawo kple Hiob vɔ megbe la, Yehowa gblɔ na Temanitɔ Elifaz bena: Nye dɔmedzoe bi ɖe mia kple xɔ̃wò eveawo ŋu, elabena mieƒo nu nyuia ɖeke le nunya abe nye ɖɔla Hiob ene o.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Eyata milé nyitsu adre kple agbo adre, eye miyi nye dɔla Hiob gbɔ, ne wòasa numevɔ na mi, eye nye dɔla Hiob naɖe kuku ɖe mia ta; elabena eya ke ƒe ŋku me makpɔ, hafi nyiemaɖo bometsitsi la teƒe na mi o; elabena mieƒo nu nyuia ɖeke le ŋunye abe nye dɔla Hiob ene o.

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Tete Temanitɔ Elifaz, Suaxtɔ Bildad kple Naamatɔ Zofar woyi ɖawɔ, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ na wo ene; eye Yehowa kpɔ Hiob ŋku me. Mawu yra Hiob wu tsã.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gaɖo Hiob tè, le esi wòde kuku ɖe xɔlɔ̃awo ta la ŋuti; eye Yehowa dzi nusiwo katã nɔ Hiob si tsã la, ɖe dzi zi gbɔ zi eve.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Eye nɔviaŋutsuwo kple nɔvianyɔnuwo katã kpakple eƒe ame nyanyɛ tsãtɔwo katã va egbɔ; woɖu nu kplii le eƒe me, eye wodo baba nɛ hefa akɔ nɛ le dzɔgbevɔ̃e, siwo katã Yehowa he va edzi la ta, eye wo dome amesiame tsɔ kesita ɖekaɖeka kple sikasigɛ ɖekaɖeka nɛ.

english_verse: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.
translation_verse: Ena ŋkɔ nyɔnuvi gbãtɔ be Yemima, evelia be Kezia, eye etɔ̃lia be Keren-Hapux.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Ŋutsuvi adre kple nyɔnuvi etɔ̃ nɔ esi.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Womekpɔ nyɔnu dzetugbea ɖeke le anyigba blibo la dzi ahe Hiob vinyɔnuwo ene o; eye wo fofo na anyigba wo ɖe wo nɔviŋutsuwo dome.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Hiob tsi, eye agbenɔnɔ tii, hafi wòku.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Woayra amesi mezɔna ɖe ame vɔɖiwo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nu o, amesi metsia tsitre ɖe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo fe mɔ dzi o, eye menɔa anyi ɖe fewuɖulawo ƒe ha me o;

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: ke boŋ fekpɔa dzidzɔ le Yehowa ƒe se la ŋu, eye wòdea ŋugble le eƒe se la ŋu zã kple kelí.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Eyama ɖi ati, si woɖo ɖe tɔʋuwo to, si tsena le etseɣi, eye eƒe aŋgbawo melũa xe o; eye nusianu, si wówɔna la, ewɔnɛ wua nu nyuie!

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Ame vɔɖiwo ya mele alea o, ke boŋ wole abe tsro, si ya lɔna ɖe nu ene.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Eyata ame vɔ̃ɖiwo manɔ te le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me o, eye nuvɔ̃wɔlawo mana te ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe ha me o.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa nya ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe mɔ, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ buna gbidi.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti dukɔwo le nyanyrãm, eye anyigba dzi dukɔwo le tame bum dzodzro?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Anyigba dzi fiawo tso, eye amegãwo ƒo takpli ɖe aɖaŋu me ɖe Yehowa kple eƒe amesiamina ŋu.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Mina míatso woƒe kawo, eye míaɖe woƒe gawo aƒu gbe le mía ŋu!

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Amesi bɔbɔ nɔ dziƒo la, le nu kom, eye Aƒetɔ la le alɔme ɖem le wo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Emegbe aƒo nu kpli wo le eƒe dɔmedzoe me, eye wòado ŋɔdzi na wo le eƒe dziku me.

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: Ke nye la meɖo fianye le Zion, nye to kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Mele tameɖoɖo la gblɔ ge afia: Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Vinye nènye, egbea medzi wò.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Biam, eye matsɔ dukɔwo awɔ wò domenyinu kple anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo awɔ tɔwòe!

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Àtsɔ gatikplɔ ato wo nyanyanya, eye agbã wo ahe zemela ƒe ze ene!

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Eyata mi fiawo, mídze nunya, eye mina woaxlɔ̃ nu mi, mi anyigba dzi ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo!

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Misubɔ Yehowa kple vɔvɔ̃, eye mitso aseye kple dzodzo nyanyanya!

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Migbugbɔ nu na via, be megado dɔmedzoe, eye miatsrɔ̃ le mɔ ta o! Elabena esusɔ ʋee, eƒe dɔmedzoe nafla. Woayra amesiwo katã sii tso la!

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha, esime wòsi le via Absalom nu.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Yehowa, aleke nye ketɔwo sɔ gbɔ ale! Ame geɖewo tso ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo le gbɔgblɔm le ŋunye be: Xɔnamea ɖeke mele Mawu gbɔ nɛ o! Sela.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Yehowa, enye nye akpoxɔnu kple nye bubu, eye wòe fɔ nye ta ɖe dzi.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Metso gbenye yɔ Yehowa, eye wòtɔ nam tso eƒe to kɔkɔe ta dze. Sela.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Memlɔ anyi, eye meɖɔ alɔ; meganyɔ, elabena Yehowa lém ɖe asi.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Ame akpe nane, siwo ho ɖe to ɖem goɖoo la, mele ŋɔ dzim nam o.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Ne meyɔ wò la, tɔ nam, nye dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe Mawu, wò amesi na alɔmeɖeƒem le xaxa me; ve nunye, eye nase nye gbedodoɖa!

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Mi ŋutsu ƒe viwo, zi nenie miaɖi gbɔ nye bubu, yakanu nanɔ mía ŋu nyom, eye míanɔ aʋatso yome dim? Sela.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Ke mínyae be, Yehowa tia mawumeme na eɖokui! Yehowa senɛ, ne meyɔe.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo le gbɔgblɔm be: Ameka ana míakpɔ nu nyui kple ŋku? Oo, Yehowa, na wò ŋku me kekeli naklẽ ɖe mía dzi!

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ede dzidzɔ nye dzi me wu wo le ɣeyiɣi, si me bli kple wein bɔ ɖe wo si.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Dawiɖ ƒe ha na dzekulawo ƒe henɔ.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye nyawo nede tome na wò, se nye hũɖeɖe,

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: eye nalé to de nye ɣlidodo ŋu, fianye kple Mawunye, elabena wòe mele gbe dom ɖa na.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, se gbenye le ŋdi, medzra ɖo ɖe ŋuwò le ŋdi hele asiwo nu kpɔm.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu, si nu tovo wɔwɔ medzea eŋu o la, nènye, nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔla menɔa gbɔwò o.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Adegbeƒolawo menɔa te ɖe ŋkuwò me o; èléa fu nu vlo wɔlawo katã.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ke nyea mage ɖe aƒewò me le wò amenuveve geɖe la nu, eye mavɔ̃ wò ahade ta agu ɖe wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe ta nu.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Yehowa, kplɔm le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la nu le nye ketɔwo ta; ta wò mɔ ɖe ŋgɔnye!

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Elabena nya vavãa ɖeke mele woƒe nu me o, gbegblẽ le woƒe dzi me, woƒe veme enye yɔdo nuvo, eye wovivia nu me kple woƒe aɖe.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Mawu, bu fɔ wo! Woƒe adaŋudedewo netsɔ wo ƒu anyi, tu asi wo ƒu anyi le woƒe dzidada gbogboawo ta, elabena wodze aglã ɖe ŋuwò!

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã ɖoa ŋu ɖe ŋuwò la, nakpɔ dzidzɔ, woatso aseye tegbee, elabena èkpɔ wo ta; amesiwo katã lɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ la, nado ɖe ŋuwò hoo!

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na gbe gã kasaŋkutɔtvo ƒe henɔ.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, megaka mo nam le wò dɔmedzoe me o, eye megahe to nam le wò dziku me o!

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Yehowa, ve nunya, elabena nu te ŋunye belibeli; da gbe le ŋunye, elabena ŋɔdzi lé nye ƒuwo!

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Dzidzi ƒo nye luʋɔ ŋutɔ! Eye wò Yehowa, vaseɖe ɣekaɣie?

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, trɔ kɔ, ne naɖe nye luʋɔ, xɔ nam le wò amenuveve la ta!

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋkuɖoɖo dziwò meli le ku me o, eye ameka akafu wò le tsiẽƒe!

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Meɖea hũ ʋuu ɖeɖi tea ŋunye, meƒoa aɖatsi nye aba bekee zã sia zã, eye aɖatsi ƒoa nye dɔƒe.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Nuxaxa na nye ŋkuwo le ayi, nu te wo ŋu le nye ketɔwo katã ta.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Mi nu vlo wɔlawo katã, mite da le gbɔnye, elabena Yehowa se nye avigbe la.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Yehowa se nye kokoƒoƒo. Yehowa xɔa nye gbedodoɖa alɔ eve.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe konyifaha, si wodzi na Yehowa, le Benyamintɔ Kus ƒe nyawo ta.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye Mawu, mesi wò tso, xam tso yonyemetilawo katã si me, eye naɖem,

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye Mawu, ne mewɔ nusia, nu tovo le ɖe asi ŋu nam,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: eye mewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe xɔ̃nye ŋu la, — eva wonye meɖe amesi lé fum yakatsyɔ la hafi —

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: ekema futɔ neti yonyeme, eye wòatum, nefanyam ɖe anyigba, eye wòate nye bubu ɖe ke me! Sela.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Tsi tre, Yehowa, le wò dɔmedzoe me; tso ɖe nye ketɔwoƒe agbodzedze ŋu, eye nadzɔ ŋunye, wò amesi ɖo ʋɔnudɔdrɔ anyi la!

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe amehawo ɖe to ɖe wò, to wo dzi nagbugbɔ ayi dziƒo!

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye dukɔwo ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lã. Drɔ̃ ʋɔnum, Yehowa, de nye dzɔdzɔenyenye kple fɔmaɖimaɖi, si le ŋunye la nu!

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ nu natso, eye nali ke ame dzɔdzɔe la; elabena wò, Mawu dzɔdzɔe la, édzroa dziwo kple ayikuwo me kpɔna.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Nye akpoxɔnu le Mawu si, eya xɔna na amesiwo ƒe dzi toa mɔ ɖeka la.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Mawu enye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la dzɔdzɔe kple Mawu, si dzi kuna daa.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe fu le eɖum; efɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e ƒe fu, eye wòava dzi alakpa.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Eɖe ʋe, eye wòwlu eme, ke ege dze do, si wòɖe la me.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e trɔ va eƒe ta dzi, eye eƒe ŋutasesẽ gbugbɔ va dze eƒe dzodome.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe Gatitɔwo tɔ nu.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía Aƒetɔ, wò amesi na wò ŋutikɔkɔe gbagba gbɔ dziƒo ta, ale gbegbe wò ŋkɔ dzeani le anyigba blibo la dzii!

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Deviwo kple vi nonowo ƒe nu me neli ŋusẽ anyi ɖo le wò ketɔwo ta, ne nana ketɔwo kple hlɔ̃bialawo ƒe nu natɔ kpe.

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: Ne mekpɔ wò dziƒowo, siwo nye wò asinudɔwɔwɔ, ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo, siwo, newɔ la,

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: nuka nye amegbetɔ, be néɖoa ŋku edzi, kple amegbetɔvi, be néléa ŋku ɖe eŋu?

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Esusɔ vie, nena wòsɔ kple Mawu kloe, eye netsɔ bubu kple ŋutikɔkɔe ɖɔ nɛ.

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: Etsɔe ɖo wo asinudɔwɔwɔwo nu, eye netsɔ nuwo katã ɖe eƒe ato te:

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: alẽwo kple nyiwo siaa hekpe ɖe gbemelãwo hã ŋu,

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: dziƒoxeviwo kple ƒumelãwo kpakple nusianu, si zɔa atsiaƒu me.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe „Ŋutsuvi la ƒe ku“ ƒe gbeɖiɖi nu.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Makafu Yehowa tso dzi blibo me, eye maxlẽ wò nukunuwɔwɔwo katã afia.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Makpa dzidzɔ, dzi adzɔm de ŋuwò, eye manya wo ŋkɔ, wò dziƒoʋitɔ,

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: le esi nye tutɔwote gbugbɔ ɖe megbee, wodze anyi, eye wotsrɔ̃ le ŋkuwò me ta.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Elabena woe tso nye nya kple nye kodzoɖoɖo la wode go; ebɔbɔ nɔ fiazi dzi, wò ʋɔnudrɔ̃la dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ehe nya de dukɔwo ŋu, ètsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye nètutu woƒe ŋkɔ da ɖikaɖika.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Wotsrɔ̃ futɔwo, wogbã woƒe duwo wozu aƒedo ɖikaa, eye ŋkuɖoɖo wo dzi megali o.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa li tegbee, eye wodo eƒe fiazikpui anyi gli de ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexeame godoo ɖe eteƒe, eye wòatso afia dzɔdzɔe na anyigba dzi dukɔwo.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye mɔ̃ sesẽ na hiãtɔwo, enye mɔ̃ sesẽ le xaxaɣiwo me.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Amesiwo dze si wò ŋkɔ la, ɖoa ŋu ɖe ŋuwò; elabena wò, Yehowa, megblẽa amesiwo dia yowòme mɔ la ɖi o.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Midzi katukafuha na Yehowa, amesi le Zion, miɖe gbe ƒã ele nutsuwɔwɔwo le dukɔwo dome!

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Elabena ebia hlɔ̃ hlɔ̃dolawo, eɖoa ŋku wo dzi, eye meŋlɔa hiãlɔwo ƒe ɣlidodo be o.

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Ve nunye, Yehowa! Wò amesi ɖe asi tenye tso ku ƒe agbowo me la, kpa alesi mele fu kpemi le nye adikãtɔwo si me la ɖa:

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: na maxlẽ nya afia le wò ŋkɔxɔxɔwo katã ŋu le Zion-vinyɔnu ƒe duwo me, eye matso aseye le xɔname ŋuti.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ge dze ɖo, si woawo ŋutɔ woɖe la me, eye ɖɔ, si woɖo di la, ɖe woƒe afɔ.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Yehowa de eɖokui fia, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu; ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ ɖe eya ŋutɔ. Miyro saŋkuawo! Sela.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple dukɔ, siwo katã ŋlɔ Mawu be la, negbugbɔ yi tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Elabena womaŋlɔ ame dahe be ɖikaa o, eye hiãlɔwo ƒe mɔkpɔkpo mabu tegbee o.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Tso, Yehowa, megana amegbetɔ ƒe alɔ naɖe dzi o! Na woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo le ŋkuwò me!

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Yehowa, nukaŋuti nètsi tre ɖe adzɔge boo, eye nèɣla le xaxaɣiwo me?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe dada doa dzikatsoƒoe na hiãtɔwo; woatsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aye, si woɖo la, ale woe.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖi tsoa eƒe dzimedidiwo ƒoa adegbee, eye ŋubiala ɖea Yehowa ɖe aga heɖea alɔme le eŋu.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi buna le eƒe dada me be: Mabia eta ase o, Mawua ɖeke meli o. Eƒe tamesusu katã nye esi.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Eƒe nuwɔwɔ dzea dzi nɛ ɣesiaɣi; wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le dziƒo ʋi tso egbɔ, eye wòɖoa ƒuƒu de eƒe ketɔwo katã yome.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Egblɔna le eƒe dzi me bena: Ke maɖe le tenye akpɔ o, eye amesi maɖo dzɔgbevɔ̃e me ɣeaɖekeɣi akpɔ gbeɖegbeɖe o la, menye.

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ɖiŋudodo, alakpa kple ŋutasẽnya yɔ nu me nɛ taŋ, eye gbegblẽ kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e le eƒe ade te.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Enɔa xa me ɖe agblekɔƒewo xa, ebena wua ame maɖifɔ, eye wònɔa ŋu tsam na ame kudɔewo.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Edea xa ɖe ɣaɣlɛƒe abe dzata le eve dodoe me ene, edea xa ɖi, be yealé hiãtɔ la, eye wòléa hiãtɔ la henɔa ehem kple eƒe ɖɔ.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Eƒonɛ ƒua anyi, eye wòmiminɛ ɖe anyigba: eƒe ŋusẽ nana ame kudɔewo dzea anyi.

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Yehowa, tso! Mawu, kɔ wò asi dzi, eye megaŋlɔ hiãtɔ be o!

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti ame vɔ̃ɖi le alɔme ɖem le Mawu ŋu le gbɔgblɔm le eƒe dzi me be, mabia eta ase oa?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Ekpɔe, elabena wò ŋku le hiã kple nuxaxa ŋu, esiwò me wole; hiãtɔwo tsɔe de esi na wò; xɔnametɔ nènye ne tsyɔ̃eviwo.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Ŋe abɔ na eme vɔ̃ɖi kple nuvɔ̃wɔla; ɖe àdi eƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ, eye mãkpɔe oa?

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye fia tegbetegbe, dukɔwo tsrɔ̃ ɖa le eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Wò Yehowa, èɖo to hiãtɔwo ƒe didi, èli ke woƒe dzi, eye nèƒu wò to anyi,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: ne natso afia na tsyɔ̃eviwo kple hiãtɔwo, be amegbetɔ magaɖa ɖadzra le anyigba dzi azɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ na henɔ la. Yehowae mesi tso. Aleke miele gbɔgblɔm nam be: Misi yi miaƒe towo dzi abe xevi ene?

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖiwo vu da me, wotsɔ woƒe aŋutrɔwo ɖo daka dzi, be yewoate amesiwo ƒe dzi toa mɔ ɖeka la, le blukɔ me.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Elabena wogbã gɔmeɖoɖoanyiwo ke hã, nuka ame dzɔdzɔe ate ŋu wɔ ma?

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Yehowa le eƒe gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me, Yehowa, amesi ƒe fiazikpui le dziƒo la, ƒe ŋkuwo le ekpɔm, eƒe aɖabawo doa amegbetɔviwo kpɔna.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Yehowa doa ame dzɔdzɔe kpɔna, ke eƒe luʋɔ léa fu ame vɔ̃ɖi kple amesi lɔ̃a ŋutasẽnuwɔwɔ la.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ana dzoka nadza ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi, eye dzo, aŋɔ kple ya xɔdzo anye woƒe kplu me nu.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa enye nuteƒewɔla, eye wòlɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ; dzime dzɔdzɔe tɔwo akpɔ eƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woaƒo ɖe gbe gã me.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Yehowa, xɔ na ame, elabena mawumemewo nu tso, eye anukwaretɔwo bu le amegbetɔviwo dome!

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Amesiame vivia nume henɔa aʋatso kam na nɔvia, eye wogblɔa aɖevee.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: Yehowa netsrɔ nume ŋanɛ tɔwo kple aɖe, siwo gblɔa nya gãwo,

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: amesiwo gblɔna be: Míaƒe aɖewo doa ŋusẽ mí, míaƒe nuyiwo li kpli mí, ameka nye aƒetɔ de mía nu?

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Metso azɔ le ŋutasesẽ le hiãtɔwo ŋu kple ame dahewo ƒe hũɖeɖe ta, eye mahe xɔname vɛ na amesi le eyome dim la.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nyawo dza abe klosalo, si wolólona le kpo me wotstana ɖe anyigba, eye woklɔe zi gbɔ zi adre la ene.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Oo, Yehowa, dzra mí ɖo, eye nakpɔ mía ta le dzidzime sia ŋuti tegbee!

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Yehowa, vaseɖe ɣekaɣi naŋlɔm be ɖikaɖika, eye vaseɖe ɣekaɣi naɣla wò ŋku me ɖem?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Yaseɖe ɣekaɣi mana ŋugble dem le ɖokuinye me, eye nuxaxã anɔ nye dzi me gbesiagbe? Vaseɖe ɣekaɣi nye futɔ akɔ eɖokui ɖe dzi ɖe ŋunye?

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Kpɔm ɖa, Yehowa, nye Mawu, eye nam nam; na nye ŋku dzi nakɔ, ne magatso me le alɔ̃ me o!

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Ne nye futɔ magagblɔ be: „Mede enu“ o, eye nye ketɔ matso aseye, le esi ke ɖe le tenye ta o!

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Ke nyea mele ŋu ɖom ɖe wò amenuveve ŋu; nye dzi le aseye tsom le wò xɔname ŋuti. Madzi ha na Yehowa, elabena ewo dɔmenyo nam.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ na henɔ la. Abunetɔwo gblɔna le woƒe dzi me be: Mawua ɖeke meli o. Wowɔa nu gbegblẽwo kple nu nyɔŋuwo. Amea ɖeke meli, si woa nu nyui o.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe ŋku ɖe amegbetɔviwo tso dziƒo, ne yeakpɔ be, amea ɖe dze nunya, eye wòblaa Mawu ta sena hã?

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ɖe nu vlo wɔlawo katã, amesiwo le nye dukɔ ɖum, abe alesi woɖua aboloe ene, eye womeyɔa Yehowa o la, medze si esia oa?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Dzidzi ƒo wo ŋutɔ le afima, elabena Mawu le dzidzime dzɔdzɔe la dome.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Minɔ ŋukpe dom hiãtɔ ƒe adãŋudede la ko, ke Yehowa nye sitsoƒe nɛ.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe xɔname atso Zion ava na Israel! Ne Yehowa gaɖo eƒe dukɔ te le Yakob atso aseye, eye dzi ladzɔ Israel!

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Yehowa, ameka adze wò gbadɔ me, eye ameka anɔ wò to kɔkɔe la dzi ma?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Amesi fɔɖiɖi mele eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o, ewɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòtoa nyateƒe le eƒe dzi me;

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: amesi metsɔa eƒe ade zɔa eme gɔmee o, mewɔa vɔ̃ ɖe ehavi ŋu o, eye medea ŋukpe mo na xɔlɔ̃via o;

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: amesi ƒe ŋku me ame vɔ̃ɖi meɖia naneke le o, ke ebua amesiwo vɔ̃a Yehowa la; amesi ka atam, si me eya ŋutɔ ƒe gbegblẽ tsona, ke megatrɔnɛ o;

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: amesi menaa eƒe ga ɖe deme dzi o, eye mexɔa zãnu ɖe ame maɖifɔ ŋu o. Amesi wɔa nusiawo la, ke maɖe le ete gbeɖegbeɖe o.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha ɖe futamee la. Mawu dzram ɖo, elabena wòe mesi tso!

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Megblɔ na Yehowa be: Aƒetɔnyee nènye, nu nyuia ɖeke mele asinye kpe ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Ame kɔkɔe, siwo le anyigba dzi, kple ame ŋkulawo ƒe nu nyea ŋunye ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Vevesesewo dzina ɖe dzi na amesiwo tsɔa Mawu ɖɔa li mawu bubuwoe; nyemaƒo woƒe vɔsaʋu ɖe anyi o, eye woƒe ŋkɔ mava nye nu me o.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye nye domenyinu kple nye kplu me nu; ele nye dzidzenu de asi.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Dzidzenu la dze nyuiaƒe nam; domenyinu la dze ŋunye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Makafu Yehowa, amesi doa aɖaŋu nam; le zã me hã nye ayikuwo xlɔ̃ã num,

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Metsɔa Yehowa ɖoa ŋkunye me ɖaa; ne ele nye nuɖusi me la, ke maɖe le tenye o.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Eyata nye dzi le dzidzɔ kpɔm, eye nye bubu le aseye tsom, nye ŋutilã hã anɔ anyi dedie.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Elabena màgblẽ nye luʋɔ ɖe tsiẽƒe si me o, eye màlɔ be, wò mawumeme la nakpɔ yɔdo o.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Àna menya agbemɔ la, dzidzɔ bɔ ɖe ŋkuwò me, eye vivisese le wò nuɖusi me tegbee.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe gbedodoɖa. Yehowa, se nye dzɔdzɔe, ɖo to nye ɣlidodo, eye nalé to ɖe nye gbedodoɖa si metso alakpanuyiwo me o la ŋuti!

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Ŋkuwò me nye afiatsotso tsona; wòŋkuwo kpɔa nu tututu.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Eɖo nye dzi kpɔ, eye nèɖe ŋku dem le zã me; èlólom, eye mèkpɔ naneke le ŋunye o; eye susu vɔ̃ɖiwo medona le nunye o.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Le emegbelɔwo ƒe nuwɔwɔwo me le metsɔ wò numenyawo kpɔ ɖokuinye dzi ɖe ŋutasẽlawo ƒe mɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mawu, mele yɔwòm, elabena àtɔ nam; lé to ɖe ŋunye, eye nase nye nuƒoƒo!

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò amenuveve fia nukutɔe, wò amesi nye xɔnametɔ na amesiwo sina le aglãdzelewo nu bena ɖe wò nuɖusi me la.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Dzram ɖo abe gadaglamakui le ŋkuvi me ene; ɣlam ɖe wò aʋala ƒe vɔvɔli te

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: tso ame vɔ̃ɖi, siwo dze dzinye, kple nye futɔ, siwo nyrã de to ɖem la, si me.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Ami nye tsyɔ woƒe dzi, eye wotsɔa woƒe nu gblɔa dadanyawo.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Woɖe to ɖe mí le míaƒe afɔɖeɖewo katã me, eye woƒe ŋku le mía ŋu, be woaxlã mi ɖe anyi.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Woɖi dzata, si di be, yeavuvu nu, kple dzatavi, si be ɖi la.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Yehowa, tso, naɖakpe wo, ƒu wo anyi, eye ɖe nye agbe tso ame vɔ̃ɖi la si me kple wò yi,

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: tso amegbetɔwo si me kple wò asi, Yehowa, tso ame kodzogbeawo si me, amesiwo kpa woƒe gome le agbe me, eye nètsɔ wò kesinɔnuwo te ɖe ko me na wo; viwo bɔ ɖe wo si kpaŋ, eye wogblẽ woƒe nu susɔeawo ɖi na wo viwo.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Ke nye la makpɔ wò mo le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye ne menyɔ la, wò nɔnɔme aɖi ƒo nam.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye agakpe, nye ma kple nye xɔnametɔ; Mawu, nye aga, si mesi tso, nye akpoxɔnu, nye xɔname ƒe dzo kple nye bebeƒe!

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Meyɔ Yehowa, amesi dze kafukafu, eye wòɖem tso nye futɔwo si me.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Ku ƒe kawo ɖe to ɖem, eye gbegblẽ ƒe tɔʋuwo do dzikatsoƒoe nam.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe ƒe kawo ƒo xlãm, eye ku ƒe adoboliwo va di kpem.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Esi meɖo xaxa me la, meyɔ Yehowa, eye medo ɣli na nye Mawu. Ese nye gbe le eƒe gbedoxɔ me, eye nye ɣlidodo de egbɔ ge ɖe eƒe to me.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Tete anyigba ʋanya, eye wòʋuna, towo ƒe anyinɔwo ʋuʋu, eye wodzo kpekpekpe, elabena dzi kui.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Dzudzɔ de dzi tso eƒe ŋɔti me, dzo binu tso eƒe nu me, eye dzoka tso egbɔ hehẽhe.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Eviã dziƒo heɖi ɖe anyi, eye alilikpo dodo le eƒe afɔwo te.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Enɔ Kerubiwo dzi hedze, eye wosa agba le ya ƒe aʋalawo dzi.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Eɣla eɖokui ɖe blukɔ me, eye tsiɖoɖo kple alilikpo dodo nye eƒe agbaɖɔ ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Alilikpowo, dzikpe kple dzokawo ɖo dzo keklẽ me le eŋku me.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe gbe le dziƒo, eye dziƒoʋitɔ la na wose eƒe gbe.
