english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Eɖo ete aŋutrɔwo ɖa wokaka wo me, kple dzikedzo geɖe ɖa wotɔtɔ wo.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Tɔwo gɔme dze, nye xexeme ƒe agunu tsi go le wo bublu la nu, Yehowa, kple wò dɔmedzoe ƒe ŋɔti me gbɔgbɔ fuxefuxe la nu.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Edo abɔ ɖa tso dzi lém, eye wòhem tso tsi gãwo me.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Eɖem tso nye futɔ kako la si me, kple nye ketɔwo si me, elabena wotri akɔ wum.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Wodze dzinye le nye dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe, ke Yehowa nye nye ziɔɖeŋutɔ.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Ekplɔm yi dogba dzi, eye wòɖem ɖo goe, elabena nye nu nyo eŋu.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔ nyuie nam ɖe nye dzɔdzɔenyenye nu, eye wòɖo eteƒe nam, le esi nye asime dza ŋuti.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Elabena mele ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe mɔwo ŋu, eye nyemewɔ nu tovo ɖe nye Mawu ŋu o.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Wò sewo katã le ŋkunye me, eye nyemeɖe wò ɖoɖowo ɖa le gbɔnye o.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Fɔɖiɖia ɖeke mele ŋunye le eŋku me o, eye mekpɔ ɖokuinye dzi ɖe nuvɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa ɖo eteƒe nam le nye dzɔdzɔenyenye kple nye asi dzadzɛ, siwo le eŋku me la ta.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Wò dɔme nyo ɖe dɔmenyotɔ la ŋu, eye fɔɖiɖi mele ŋuwò ɖe ame maɖifɔ la ŋu o.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Ŋuwò dza de ame dzadzɛ la ŋu, eye nèfia ɖokuiwò ayetɔe ɖe ayetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Elabena wòe nye xɔnametɔ na dukɔ ɖihiãwo, eye nèbɔbɔa ŋku kɔkɔwo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
translation_verse: Ena nye akaɖi klẽ; Yehowa, nye Mawu, na nye viviti me kɔ.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Elabena wòe li kplim meƒua du ɖe aʋakɔwo dzi; nye Mawu li kplim metia kpo flɔa gli!

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Fɔɖiɖi mele Mawu ƒe mɔ ŋu o, Yehowa ƒe nya me kɔ, akpoxɔnu wònye na amesiwo katã sii tso la.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Mawu tsa ŋusẽ bla ali dzi nam, eye wona be, fɔɖiɖia ɖeke mele nye mɔ ŋuti o.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Ewo nye afa abe zinɔwo tɔ ene, eye wòtsɔm ɖo nye kɔkɔƒe.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wò xɔname ƒe akpoxɔnu nam, meziɔ ɖe wò ɖusi ŋu, eye wò tufafa ɖo gãm.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Ena nye afɔɖeɖe me keke le tenye, eye nye afɔkɔewo mebotso o.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Meli nye futɔwo yome ɖatu wo, eye nyemetrɔ o, vaseɖe esime metsrɔ̃ wo vɔ.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Megbã wo nyanyanya, womagate ŋu afɔ o, eye wodze anyi ɖe nye afɔ te.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Etsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzi nam ɖe aʋawɔwɔ ŋu, eye nẽbɔbɔ nye adikãtɔwo ɖe tenye.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ena nye futɔwo trɔ ʋume ɖem, eye metsrɔ̃ nye ketɔwo.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Woɖo ɣli, ke xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli o; wodo ɣli na Yehowa, ke metɔ na wo o.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Mem wo gudugudu abe ʋuʋudedi le ya nu ene, eye metsɔ wo ƒu gbe abe ablɔ me gbeɖuɖɔ ene.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Nya ko wose le ŋunye, gake woɖo tom; du bubu me viwo vivi nume nam.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Nu te du bubu me viwo ŋu, eye wodzo nyanyanya hedo le wote mawo me.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Yehowa le agbe, woakafu nye agakpe, eye woado nye xɔxɔ ƒe Mawu la ɖe dzi.

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Mawu, amesi bia hlɔ̃ nam, eye wo nya dukɔwo de tenye;

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: amesi ɖem le nye futɔwo si me, eye wòkɔm ɖo nye ketɔwo nu hã; eɖem le ŋutasẽla si me.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa, makafu wò le dukɔwo dome, eye madzi ha na wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Dziƒowo le Mawu ƒe bubu xlẽm fia, eye dziŋgɔli le gbe ƒã ɖem eƒe asinuɖɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke dea gbe asi na ŋkeke, eye zã toa nya na zã.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzidzeka de anyigba blibo la dzi, eye woƒe nuƒoƒo de xexeame ƒe mlɔenu ke; etsɔ wo wɔ agbadɔ na ɣe.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Ɣe doa go tsoa eƒe xɔ me abe ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ene, ekpɔa dzidzɔ abe kalẽtɔ ene, be yealé eƒe mɔ.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Edzena ɖe dziƒo ƒe mlɔenu, eye wòtrɔna va eƒe mlɔenu, naneke meɣlana ɖe eƒe dzoxɔxɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe se de blibo, enana luʋɔ gbɔna ɖe eme; Yehowa ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi le eteƒe, enana bometsilawo dzaa nunya.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖowo dzɔ, wodoa dzidzɔ na dzi; Yehowa ƒe sewo dza, wonana ŋku dzi kɔna.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Yehowa vɔvɔ̃ dza, eye wònɔa anyi daa; Yehowa ƒe afiatsotsowo le eteƒe, wo katã wodzɔ.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Wovena wu sika kple sika nyuitɔ geɖe, eye wovivina wu anyitsi kple anyiɖaɖa.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Woawo wotsɔ fia mɔnu wò dɔla hã; fetu gã le wo me lelé ɖe asi me.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Dzra wò dɔla ɖo tso dadalawo si me, ne womagaɖu aƒetɔ ɖe nanye o! Ekema fɔɖiɖi mana ŋunye o, eye madza tso vodada gãwo me.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Yehowa aɖo to wò le xaxagbe, Yakob ƒe Mawu la akpɔ tawò.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Aɖo xɔname ɖe wò tso kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wòado alɔ na wò tso Zion.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Aɖo ŋku wò nuɖuvɔsawo katã dzi, eye wò numevɔsa ada ami le eŋku me. Sela.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Awɔ na wò le wò dzimedidi nu, eye wòawɔ wò tameɖoɖowo katã dzi na wò.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Míatso aseye ɖe wò xɔname ŋu, eye míado aflaga ɖe dzi le mía Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ me. Yehowa nawɔ wò biabiawo katã dzi na wò.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Azɔ menyae be, Yehowa xɔna na eƒe amesiamina la, eye wòtsɔa eƒe nuɖusi ƒe nutsuwɔwɔ, siwo xɔna na ame la, tɔna nɛ tso eƒe dziƒo kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Ame meawo ɖoa ŋu ɖe tasiaɖam kple sɔwo ŋu, ke míawo míeyɔa Yehowa, mía Mawu la, ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Ame meawo bɔbɔna dea la agu, ke míawo míetsia tre dzena kã.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Yehowa, fia la kpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ŋusẽ ŋu, eye aleke gbegbe mehele aseye tsom ɖe wò xɔname ŋui o!

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Ewɔ eƒe dzimedidiwo dzi nɛ, eye mète nusi eƒe dzi di lae o. Sela.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Etsɔ yayra, siwo nye nu nyuiwo, va kpee, eye néɖɔ sikafiakuku ɖe la nɛ.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Ebia agbe tso asiwò, eye néna agbe didii ɖaa tegbee.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Wò xɔname na eƒe ŋkɔxɔxɔ ɖe dzi; bubu kple atsyɔ̃ nètsɔ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Elabena éɖoe wonye yayra tegbee, eye nètsɔ dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ na eƒe dzeme kɔ la ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Elabena fia la ɖo ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye ŋusẽkatãtɔ ƒe amenuveve ana be, ke maɖe le ete o.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Wò asi axe wò futɔwo katã, eye wò nuɖusi atu wò ketɔwo.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Ne èdo la, àwɔ wo abe kpodzo ene; Yehowa ami wo le eƒe dɔmedzoe me, eye dzo afiã wo.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Àtsrɔ̃ wo viwo da le anyigba dzi kple woƒè dzidzimeviwo le amegbetɔviwo dome.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Elabena wobe, yewoahe gbegblẽ ava dziwò; woɖo tame vɔ̃, gake womete ŋu wɔe o.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Elabena ana woatrɔ ʋume; àtsɔ wò da adzidze woƒe ŋku mee.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe „Agudzedzezinɔ“ ƒe gbe ŋu.

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, nye Mawu, nukaŋuti nègblẽm ɖi? Nye hũɖeɖe ƒe nyawo metsɔ ɖe nye xɔname gbɔ o.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, meyɔ wò le ŋkeke me, ke mètɔ nam o, eye le zã me, ke nyemekpɔ gbɔdzɔe o.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ele kɔkɔe, eye nèbɔbɔ nɔ Israel ƒe kafukafuwo dome gli.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Ŋuwò mía fofowo ɖo ŋu ɖo, ŋuwò woɖo ŋu ɖo, eye nèxɔ na wo.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Wòe wodo ɣli na, eye woɖe wo; ŋuwò woɖo ŋu ɖo, eye ŋu mekpe wo o.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Ke nye la ŋɔ menye, menye amegbetɔ o; amewo ƒe alɔmeɖenu menye, eye dukɔ la ɖo vlom.

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã kpɔm la, ɖu fewu le ŋunye, woke woƒe nuyiwo, eye woʋuʋu ta gblɔ be:

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Nefae na Yehowa, axɔ nɛ, eye wòaɖee, elabena eƒe nu nyo eŋu.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Elabena wòe hem tso dɔ me, eye nèna menɔ ɖanye ƒe no nu bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Wotsɔm gblẽ ɖe dziwò tso dɔ me ke, eye nye Mawu nenye tso danye ƒe dɔ me.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Meganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o, elabena xaxa tu aƒe; elabena xɔnametɔa ɖeke mele afi o.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Nyitsu geɖewo de to ɖem, Basan ƒe nyitsuwo ƒo xlãm.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Woke woƒe nu ɖe ŋunye abe dzata, si le xɔxlɔ̃m hele nu vuvum ene.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Woƒom ɖe anyi abe tsi ene, nye ƒuwo katã dudu; nye dzi zu abe anyigba ene helólo ɖe dɔ me nam.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Ami ƒu le ƒuto me nam abe sonugaglɛ ene, nye aɖe le ɖe nye veme, eye nètsɔm ɖo ku ƒe ʋuʋudedi me.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Elabena avũwo ƒo xlãm, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ha ɖe to ɖem, eye woku nye asiwo kple afɔwo.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Mate ŋu axlẽ nye ƒuwo katã. Ke woawo kpɔe, eye wofɔ ŋku ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Womã nye avɔwo ɖe wo nɔewo dome, eye wodzidze nu ɖe nye awu dzi.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Yehowa, meganɔ adzɔge o; nye ŋusẽ, afɔ netsɔ naxɔ nam!

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: De nye luʋɔ tso yi nu, nye tenu ɖeka la tso avũwo si me.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Xɔm tso dzata ƒe nu me, eye naɖem tso tò ƒe dzowo nu.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Matsɔ wò ŋkɔ ade gbe ƒae na nɔvinyewo, eye makafu wò le amehawo dome be:

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo vɔ̃a Yehowa la, mikafui! Mi Yakob-ƒomeawo katã, mibui! Mi Israel-ƒomeawo katã, misi eƒe ŋku me!

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Elabena medo vlo, eye menya ŋu hiãtɔ ƒe hiã o, meɣla ŋku me ɖee o, eye esi wodo ɣli nɛ la, eɖo to.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Gbɔwòe nye kafukafuha tso le ameha gãwo dome. Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe le amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la ŋku me.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Hiãtɔwo aɖu nu aɖi ƒo; amesiwo biaa Yehowa ta sena la, nekafui! Agbe neɖo miaƒe dzi ŋu tegbee!

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Dzidzimeviwo asubɔe, eye megbeviwo axlẽ nya afia le Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Yehowa enye kplɔlanye, naneke mehlãam o.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Lãnyiƒe damawo wona metsyɔ akɔ ɖo; gbɔɖemeƒe tɔwo nu wòkplɔm yii.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: Ena nye luʋɔ gbɔ de eme, ekplɔm to toƒe dzɔdzɔewo le eƒe ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Ne mezɔ bali doblukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me hã, nyemavɔ̃ dzɔgbevɔ̃ea ɖeke o, elabena wòe le gbɔnye; wò atikplɔ kple wò atizɔti faa akɔ nam.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Eɖo kplɔ̃ ɖe akɔnye me le nye ketɔwo ŋku me; èsi ami ɖe ta nam, nye kplu yɔ gba go.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: E, dzɔgbenyuie kple amenuveve adze yonyeme le nye agbe me ŋkekewo katã me, eye mana Yehowa ƒe me ɖaa.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Yehowa tɔe nye anyigba kple nusiwo yɔ edzi, xexeame kple eme nɔlawo.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Elabena eɖo egɔme anyi ɖe atsiaƒu dzi, eye wòlii anyi ɖe tɔsisiwo dzi zã.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Ameka alia Yehowa ƒe to, eye ameka atsi tre ɖe eƒe teƒe kɔkɔe la?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒe asi me dza, eye eƒe dzi me kɔ, amesi ƒe luʋɔ media aʋatso yome mɔ o, eye meda alakpa heka atam o ta,

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: eya axɔ yayra tso Yehowa gbɔ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye tso eƒe xɔname ƒe Mawu la gbɔ.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mi agbowo, mikɔ ta dzi, mi blemaʋɔtruwo, mitɔ dzi, ne bubufia la nage ɖe eme!

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Amekae henye bubufia la ma? Yehowa ŋusẽtɔ kple kalẽtɔ lae, Yehowa aʋakalẽtɔ lae!

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mi agbowo, mikɔ ta dzi, mi blemaʋɔtruwo, mifɔ dzi, ne bubufia la nage ɖe eme!

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Ameka goe henye bubufia la? Yehowa Zebaot ye, eyae nye bubufia la! Sela.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Yehowa, wòe mewu nye luʋɔ ɖe dzi na.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, wò ŋu mele ŋu dom ɖo; megana ŋu nakpem, ne nye futɔwo natso aseye ɖe ŋunye o!

english_verse: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã kpɔa mɔ na wò hã, ŋu makpe wo o; ke ŋu akpe amesiwo trɔ le yowòme yakatsyɔ.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖe wò mɔwo fiam, eye nafia wò toƒewom!

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Na mazɔ le wò nyateƒe me, eye nafia num; elabena wòe nye nye xɔname Mawu, wòe mele mɔ kpɔm na ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖo ŋu wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple wò amenuveve, elabena woli tso tititi ke!

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Megaɖo ŋu nye ɖevimenuvɔ̃wo kple nye dzidadawo o, ke boŋ ɖo ŋku dzinye le wò amenuveve kple wò dɔmenyo ta, Yehowa!

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔme nyo, eye wòwɔa nuteƒe, elabena afiaa mɔ nuvɔ̃wɔlawo.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Enaa hiãtɔwo zɔa dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye wòfiaa eƒe mɔ hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe toƒewo katã nye amenuveve kple nyateƒe na amesiame léa eƒe nubabla kple seawo me de asi.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Le wò ŋkɔ la ta, Yehowa, tsa nye vodada kam, elabena esa gbɔ!

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu kae vaa Yehowa? Eya wòafia mɔ, si wòatsɔ lae.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Eƒe luʋɔ anɔ dzɔgbenyuie me, eye anyigba la anɔ viawo si me.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Yehowa bɔa ha kple amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la, eye wònana wonyaa eƒe nubabla.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo li de Yehowa dzi daa, elabena eya aɖe nye afɔ le ɖɔ me.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Trɔ kɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye nave nunye, elabena metsi akogo, eye mele hiã ɖim.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Nye dzimexãxàwo do gã de dzi, dem tso nye hiãwo me!

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye nuxaxa kple nye hiã ɖa, eye natsɔ nye nuvɔ̃wo katã kem!

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye futɔwo ɖa, elabena wode ha, eye wolé fum ŋutasẽtɔe.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Dzra nye luʋɔ ɖo, eye naɖem, ŋu makpem o, elabena wòe mesi tso.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Fɔmaɖimaɖi kple dzadzɛnyenye nakpɔ tanye, elabena mele mɔ kpɔm na wò.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖe Israel tso eƒe xaxawo katã me!

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Tso afia nam, Yehowa, elabena fɔɖiɖi mele nye zɔzɔme ŋu o, eye meɖo ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu, nyemeʋã o!

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Yehowa, dom kpɔ, eye nadzro menye kpɔ, lólo nye ayikuwo kple nye dzi!

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Elabena wò amenuveve le ŋkunye me, eye mezɔ le wò nyateƒe me.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Nyemebɔbɔ nɔ ame tovowo gbɔ o, eye nyemede afɔ gbedegblemimewo ƒe ha me o.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Meklɔ nye asi fɔmaɖitɔe, eye maƒo xlã wò vɔsamlekpui, Yehowa,

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: ahana kafukafuha naɖi, eye maxlẽ wò nukunuwo katã afia.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Yehowa, melɔ̃ wò aƒe nɔƒe kple teƒe, si wò bubu le.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Megade nye luʋɔ ɖa kpe ɖe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ŋu o, kple nye agbe ɖa kpeɖe hlɔ̃mewo ŋu o;

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: amesiwo ŋukpenanuwo le asi ŋu na, eye zãnunana yɔ ɖusi na.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ke nyea mazɔ fɔmaɖitɔe; ɖem, eye nave nunye!

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nye afɔ tsi tre ɖe teƒe gbadzaa. Makafu Yehowa le takpekpewo me.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Yehowa enye nye kekeli kple nye xɔname, ameka mavɔ̃? Yehowa enye mɔ̃ na nye agbe, ameka adzi ŋɔ nam?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Ne ame vlowo, nye ketɔwo kple nye futɔwo lũ ɖe dzinye, be yewoaɖu nye lã la, woakli nu adze anyi.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Ne aʋakɔ ƒu asaɖa ɖe ŋunye ha la, dzika matso ƒonye o. Ne aʋa ho ɖe ŋunye ale keke hã, nyea maɖe dzi ɖi.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Nu ɖeka mebia Yehowa, esi le dzroyem, be manɔ Yehowa ƒe me le nye agbe me ŋkekewo katã me, eye makpa Yehowa ƒe vivisesewo katã kple ŋku, eye mayi tame le eƒe gbeɖoxɔ me.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Elabena etsyɔ nu dzinye ɖe eƒe agbadɔ me le dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe, eye wòɣlam ɖe eƒe agbadɔ ƒe bebeƒe; ekɔm ɖo agakpe dzi.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Azɔ nye ta kɔ dzi ɖe nye futɔ, siwo ƒo xlãm godoo la ŋuti mase aseyetsovɔ le eƒe agbadɔ me, madzi ha, eye maƒo saŋku na Yehowa.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mele yɔwòm kple ɣli, see, ve nunye, eye natɔ nam!

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Nye dzi tsa wò nya gaɖo ŋkuwò me be: „Midi ŋkunye me!“ Yehowa, ŋkuwò me madi.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Megaɣla wò ŋku me ɖem o! Megatutu wò dɔla ɖa le dɔmedzoe me o! Wòe nye nye xɔname, megatsɔm ƒu gbe o, eye megagblẽm ɖi o, nye xɔname ƒe Mawu!

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Elabena fofonye kple danye wogblẽm ɖi, ke Yehowa xɔm.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa, fia wò mɔm, eye nakplɔm to toƒe sɔsɔe le nye futɔwo ta!

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Megatsɔm de asi na nye ketɔwo ƒe nyanyrã o, elabena aʋatsoɖasefowo kple amesiwo le ŋutasesẽ gbɔm fuxefuxe la, tso ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Ne nyemehexɔe se be, mãkpɔ Yehowa ƒe nu nyuiwo le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi o fi!

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpɔ mɔ na Yehowa, se ŋu, eye nalé dzi ɖe ƒo! E, kpo mɔ na Yehowa!

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Yehowa, wò yɔm mele. Nye aga, megado tokum o, be ne èdo tokum la, ne manɔ abe amesiwo yi aʋli me la ene o!

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Se nye kokoƒogbe, ne meɖo ɣli na wò, eye mewu nye asiwo dzi ɖo ɖe wò kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la!

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Megakplɔm kpe ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi kple nu vlo wɔlawo ŋu o, amesiwo ƒoa nu kple wo xɔlɔ̃viwo fafɛ, ke vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi le woƒe dzi me la o!

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Elabena womelé ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe nuwɔwɔwo kple eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo ŋu o. Agbã wo, eye womagatu wo o.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, elabena esa nye kokoƒogbe!

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye nye ŋusẽ kple nye akpoxɔnu, eya ŋu nye dzi le ŋu ɖom ɖo, eye wòxɔ nam; eyata nye dzi le aseye tsom, eye matsɔ nye ha akafui.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye ŋusẽ na eƒe dukɔ; eya nye mɔ̃ kple xɔname na eƒe amesiamina.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Xɔ na wò dukɔ, eye nayra wò domenyinu la, nyi wo, eye na tsa wo kpa ɖaseɖe mavɔ me!

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Mi mawuviwo, mitsɔbubu kple ŋusẽ na Yehowa, Yehowa ye míatsɔe na!

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu bubu nɛ; mide ta agu na Yehowa le atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kɔkɔe me

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe di ɖe tsiwo dzi; bubu ƒe Mawu la ɖe gbe, Yehowa ɖe gbe ɖe tsi gãwo dzi.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe ɖi kple ŋusẽ, Yehowa ƒe gbe ɖi le ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe ŋe seɖertiwo, ẽ, Yehowa ŋe Libanon ƒe sedertiwo.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ena woti kpo abe nyivi ene, Libanon kple Sirion abe tòvi ene.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe ke dzo mia.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe na gbedzi ʋuʋu, Yehowa na Kades-gbedzi ʋuʋu.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe na fu ɖu zinɔwo, eye wòkɔ avemetiwo ta; eye nusianu le gbɔgblɔm le eƒe gbeɖoxɔ me be: Bubu!

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Yehowa bɔbɔ nɔ anyi gli ɖe tɔɖɔɖɔ dzi; Yehowa bɔbɔ nɔ anyi gli abe fia ene tegbee.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Yehowa atsɔ ŋusẽ na eƒe dukɔ; Yehowa atsɔ ŋutifafa ayra eƒe dukɔ!

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Mado wò ɖe dzi, Yehowa, elabena wòe hem ɖo goe, eye mèna be, nye futɔwo kpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye Mawu, wòe medo ɣli na, eye neda gbe le ŋu nye.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wòe he nye luʋɔ tso tsiẽƒe, eye nègbɔ agbem tso amesiwo yi aʋli me la dome.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Midzi kafukafuha na Yehowa, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, eye mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la!

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Nyea megblɔ le nye dziɖeɖi me bena: Ke maɖe le tenye akpɔ gbeɖe o!

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Yehowa, ètsɔ wò amenuveve li ke nye to zã. Esi nẽɣla wò ŋku me la, dzidzi ƒom.

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Yehowa, see, eye nave nanye; Yehowa, nanye nye xɔnametɔ!

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: Ena nye nuxaxa zu ɣeɖuɖu nam; èɖe akpanya le ŋunye hetsɔ dzidzɔ bla ali dzi nam,

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wòe mesi tso, megana ŋu nakpem akpɔ gbeɖe o! Tsɔ wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la ɖem!

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Ƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye, ɖem asi tsɔtsɔe; zu agakpe, si nye sitsoƒe nam, kple mɔ̃ sesẽ, ne naxɔ nam!

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Àɖem le ɖɔ, si woɖo nam la me, elabena wòe nye nye sitsoƒe!

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye gbɔgbɔ le asiwò me dem; Yehowa, eɖem, wò Mawu nuteƒetɔ.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Melé fu amesiwo ku ɖe nu maɖinuwo ŋu la; ke nyea meɖo ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Matso aseye, eye dzi adzɔm le wò amenuveve ŋuti, le esi nèkpɔ nye hiã, eye nèlé ŋku ɖe nye luʋɔ ƒe xaxa ŋu ta;

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: mètsɔm ɖe asi na futɔ la o, eye nèɖo nye afɔ teƒe keke.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Ve nunye, Yehowa, elabena meɖo xaxa me, nuxaxa na nye ŋku, luʋɔ kple ŋutilã lé ayi.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Elabena nye agbe nu yi le konyifafa me kple nye ƒewo le hũɖeɖe me; nye vodada na nye ŋusẽ nu tsi, eye nye ƒuwo nyunyɔ.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Mezu alɔmeɖenu na nye ketɔwo katã kple nye aƒelikawo vevie ŋutɔ; mezu bibi na nye ame nyanyɛwo, eye amesiwo kpɔam le kpɔdomee la, sina le nunye.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔm be le dzi me abe ame kuku ene, eye medi ze gbagbã.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Elabena mese ame geɖewo ƒe dalidodo be: „Ŋɔdzi nede to ɖee!“ Wode adaŋu kple wo nɔewo de ŋunye be, yewoaɖe nye agbe ɖa.

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, ŋuwò meɖo ŋu ɖo, Yehowa; megblɔ be, nye Mawu nènye.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Asiwò me nye agbe me nyawo le, ɖem tso nye futɔwo kple yonyemetilawo si me!

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Na wò ŋku me naklẽ ɖe wò dɔla dzi, eye natsɔ wò amenuveve axɔ nam!

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Yehowa, megana ŋu nakpem o, elabena mele yɔwòm; ŋu nekpe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye woƒe nu netɔ kpe le tsiẽƒe!

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Woade ga nu na aʋatsoka-nuyiwo, amesiwo gblɔa nya vlo ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe la ŋu le ɖaɖa kple vloɖoɖo me.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Wò dɔmenyo, si nètu ɖo na amesiwo vɔ̃a wo la, esi nèɖe fia amesiwo si wò tso le amegbetɔviwo ŋku me la, sɔ gbɔ loo!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Eɣla wo ɖe wò ŋku me ƒe ɣaɣlɛƒe tso amewo ƒe aglãdzedzewo nu, eye nèɣla wo ɖe agbadɔ me tso aɖeʋawɔwɔ nu.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, elabena eɖe eƒe amenuveve fiam nukutɔe le ɖu sesẽ me.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Esi dzi ɖe le ƒonye la, nyea megblɔ be: Woɖem ɖa le wò ŋku ta: ke èse nye kokoƒogbe, esi medo ɣli na wò.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Milɔ̃ Yehowa, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã; Yehowa kpɔa anukwaretɔwo ta, ke eɖoa teƒe na dadalawo wòsɔa gbɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe nufiameha. Woayra amesi wotsɔ eƒe dzidadawo kee, amesi ƒe nuvɔ̃wo dzi wotsyó nui.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Woayra amesi Yehowa mehe vodada na o, eye eƒe gbɔgbɔ me la alakpaa ɖeke meli o.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Elabena esi mezi ɖoɖoe la, nye ŋeŋe atraɖi na nye ƒuwo nyonyo.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Elabena wò asi sẽ ɖe dzinye keli kple zã, ŋdɔ heliheli na nye ƒuto me mi no. Sela.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Mede nye nuvɔ̃wo fia wò, eye nyemetso nu tsyɔ nye vodadawo dzi o; megblɔ be, maʋu nye dzidadawo me na Yehowa; tete nètsɔ nye nuvɔ̃ ƒe vodadawo kem. Sela.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Eyata mawumemewo ado gbe ɖa na wò le kpɔwòɣi, ẽ, ne tɔ gawo ɖɔ hã la, womade wo gbɔ o.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Bebeƒe nenye nam; èkpɔ tanye le xaxa me, eye nètsɔ ɖeɖe ƒe aseyetsotso ƒo xlãm. Sela.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Mafia nu wò, eye mafia mɔ, si nam la wò; made aɖaŋu na wò, eye nye ŋku anɔ ŋuwò.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Miganɔ abe sɔ kple tedzisɔ, siwo nunya mele tagbɔ na o la ene o; woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonu enye ka kple numega, si wotsɔna mlã woe, hafi woate ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi kpɔa vevesese geɖe; ke amesi ɖoa ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu la, atsɔ amenuveve aƒo xlãe.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Migli kple dzidzɔ, mi ame dzɔdzɔewo, de Yehowa ŋu; kafukafuha dze nuteƒewɔlawo!

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa kple kasaŋkuwo, eye miƒo saŋku ka ewo tɔ nɛ!

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Midzi ne yeye na; mitɔ asi kaawo nu kple ŋusẽ!

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe nya toa mɔ ɖeka, eye eƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã le eteƒe.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Elɔ̃a dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃; Yehowa ƒe amenuveve yɔ anyigba dzi taŋ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nye wotsɔ wɔ dziƒowoe, eye eƒe nu me gbɔgbɔ wotsɔ wɔ wo ŋu nuwo katàe.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: Eƒoa atsiaƒutsiwo nu ƒu abe ɖe goe me ene, eye wòdzraa tɔɖɔɖɔ ɖo ɖe nudzraɖoƒe.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Anyigba blibo le nevɔ̃ Yehowa; xexemetɔwo katã nesi eƒe ŋku me!

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Elabena eƒo nu, eye wòva me; ede se, eye wòɖo di.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa tɔtɔ dukɔwo ƒe adaŋudede me, eye wògblẽ anyigba dzi dukɔwo ƒe tameɖoɖo me.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe adaŋudede li tegbee, eye eƒe dzimesusuwo tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Woɔyra dukɔ, si ƒe Mawu Yehowa nye; dukɔ, si wòtia wɔ domenyinu na eɖokui.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa nu tso dziƒo ke, ekpɔa amegbetɔviwo katã.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ele enɔƒe ɖe ŋku ɖe anyigba dzi tɔwo katã,

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: eya, amesi wɔ woƒe dziwo katã tim, eye wòlé ŋku ɖe woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dziɖuɖu mele aʋakɔ kpaŋkpaŋ me o, eye ŋusẽ geɖe meɖea kalẽtɔ o.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Ne eɖó dziɖuɖu teƒe la, sɔ mele ɖeke me o, eye eƒe ŋusẽ la hã meɖea ame o.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ Yehowa ƒe ŋku le amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ ŋu, amesiwo le eƒe amenuveve sinu kpɔm,

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Míaƒe luʋɔ le mɔ kpɔm na Yehowa, míaƒe xɔname kple akpoxɔnu wònye.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Elabena míaƒe dzi le dzidzɔ kpɔm le eŋu, eye míele ŋu ɖom ɖe eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò amenuveve nenɔ mía dzi, abe alesi míele mɔ kpɔm na wòe ene!

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Makafu Yehowa ɣeawokatãɣi, eye eƒe kafukafu ano nunya me ɖaa.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ atsɔ Yehowa aƒo aɖegbee, hiãtɔwo asee, eye woakpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Mido kɔkɔ Yehowa ɖem ti, eye mina miaƒo kpli ado eƒe ŋkɔ ɖe dzi!

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Medi Yehowa, etɔ nam, eye wòdem tso nye ŋɔdziwo katã me.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tsɔ ŋku ɖo eŋu la, dzidzɔ ɖo mo na wo, eye woƒe mo metsi ɖã o.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Esi hiãtɔ sia yɔe la, Yehowa ɖo toe, eye wòɖee tso eƒe hiãwo katã me.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ɖɔla ƒua asaɖa anyi ɖe amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la ŋu, eye wòhea wo doa goe.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Miɖɔe kpɔ, eye miakpɔ be, Yehowa ƒe dɔme nyo; woayra ŋutsu, si sii tso.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Mivɔ̃ Yehowa, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, elabena amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la, hiã metua wo o.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Hiã tua dzataviwo, eye dɔ wua wo, ke amesiwo dia Yehowa la, kesinɔnua ɖeke mehiãa wo o.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Viwo, miva, milé to ɖe ŋunye, ne mafia Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ mi!

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Amekae le agbe dim, amesi lɔ̃a ŋkeke geɖe, be yeakpɔ dzɔ gbenyuie?

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Kpɔ wò aɖe dzi ɖe vɔ̃ ŋu kple wò nuyiwo dzi, ne womagagblɔ alakpanya o!

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Te ɖa le vɔ̃ ŋu, eye nawɔ nu nyui: di ŋutifafa, eye nati eyome.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋkuwo le ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu, eye eƒe towo le woƒe ɣlidodo ŋu.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Yehowa klẽ ŋku ɖe amesiwo le vɔ̃ wɔm la, ne yeatsrɔ̃ woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli, Yehowa see, eye wòɖe wo tso woƒe xaxawo katã me.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsɔ ɖe amesiwo ƒe dzi gbã gudugudu le gbɔ, eye wòxɔna na amesiwo ƒe gbɔgbɔ woƒo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe fukpekpewo sɔ gbɔ, ke Yehowa ɖenɛ tsoa wo katã me.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Ekpɔa eƒe ƒuwo katã ta, womaŋe wo dometɔa ɖeke o.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e wua eme vɔ̃ɖi le eye amesiwo lé fu ame dzɔdzɔe la la, woakpɔ woƒe dzidada tɔ nua.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò akpoxɔnu ɖagbitɔ kple lolotɔ, eye tso, naxɔ nam!

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Di wò akplɔ̃, naxe mɔ na yonyemetilawo; gblɔ na nye luʋɔ be: Xɔname menye na wò!

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe kple vlododo ava amesiwo le nye luʋɔ dim la dzi, eye amesiwo le nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e bum ɖe tame la, agbugbɔ ɖe megbe, eye woƒe mo atsi dã.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Woana abe tsro le ya nu ene, eye Yehowa ƒe dɔla atutu wo ɖa.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Woƒe mɔ dzi nedo viviti, edzi neɖiɖi, eye Yehowa ƒe dɔla neti wo yome!

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Elabena yakatsyɔ woɖo dɔ de ŋunye, eye yakatsyɔ woɖe ʋe na nya luʋɔ.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Gbegblẽ nedo ɖe edzi kpoyi; eƒe ɖɔ, si wòɖo la, neɖe eye ŋutɔ, eye nege dze gbegblẽ la me!

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Ke nye luʋɔ atso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye wòakpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe xɔname ŋu.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Nye ƒuwo katã agblɔ bena: Yehowa, amekae ɖe nuwò? Wò amesi ɖe hiãtɔ tso amesi tri akɔ wui la si me, kpakple hiãtɔ kple ame dahe tso amesi ɖa adzoe la si me.

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo ŋutasẽlawo tsi tre, eye wole nusi nyemenya o la biamem.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ vɔ̃ ɖo nyui teƒe nam, eye wodo tsyɔ̃evim.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Ke ne wole dɔ lém la, nyea metaa akpanya, metsɔa nutsitsidɔ wɔa funyafunya nye luʋɔ, eye nye gbedodoɖa ɖoa ta nye akɔme,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: abe xɔ̃nye kple nɔvinyeŋutsu wonye ene; meƒo ɖi ɖo dɔgɔ̃e le yiyim, abe amesi le fu nyim na dada ene.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Ke esi memu dze enyi la, wokpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woƒo takpli, ame ɖigbɔ, siwo nyemenya o la, kpe ta ɖe ŋunye, eye wole alɔme ɖem numaɖemee.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Apayɔlawo le alɔme ɖem, eye wole aɖukli ɖum ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɣekaɣi nanɔ ekpɔm kple ŋku ava se ɖo? Ɖe nye luʋɔ tso woƒe gbegblẽ me, kple nye tenu la tso dzatavi si me!

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Ekema manyɔ wò ŋkɔ le ameha gãwo me, eye makafu wò le eme geɖewo dome.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Megana nye ketɔ aʋatsotɔwo nakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋunye o, eye amesiwo lé fum yakatsyɔ la, nate ŋku ɖem o!

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Elabena womegblɔa ŋutifafanya o, eye woɖo alakpadanya ɖe anyigba dzi ame fafawo ŋu.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Woke woƒe nu baa ɖe ŋunye le gbɔgblɔm be: Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃, míaƒe ŋkuwo kpɔe!

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Yehowa, èkpɔe, megazi kpi o; Aƒetɔ, meganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o!

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye Mawu, ɖrɔ̃ ʋɔnum ɖe wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la nu, ne womagakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋunye o!

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Megana woegblɔ le woƒe dzi me be: Ehɛ̃, alea dim míele o! Megana woagblɔ be: Míemii o!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Ŋu nekpe amesiwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm le nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ŋu la, eye woƒe mo netsi dã: vlododo kple ŋukpe nenyẽ tsyɔ amesiwo le asi ƒum akɔ ɖe ŋunye la!

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Amesiwo ŋu nye dzɔdzɔenyenye dze la, atso aseye, eye woakpɔ dzidzɔ ahanɔ gbɔgblɔm ɖaa be: Yehowa, amesi ŋu eƒe dɔla ƒe ŋutifafa dze la, lolo!

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Nye aɖe aƒo nu le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋu, eye wòakafu wò gbesiagbe.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔla Dawid tɔ na henɔ la.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe dzidada ƒe gbe le nye dzi me be: Mawu ƒe vɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke metso ga ɖe ŋku me na o.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Elabena evivi nume nɛ le eŋku me, ne wòakpɔ mɔnu le eƒe dzidada ŋu, eye wòalé fui.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Eƒe nu me nya enye vovlo kple alakpa: edzudzɔ nuwɔwɔ ɖe nunya me kple nu nyui wɔwɔ.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Enɔa nu vlo ŋu bum le eƒe aba dzi, etsɔa eɖokui ɖoa mɔ, si menyo o la dzi, eye metsria nu vɔ̃ɖi o.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò amenuveve ɖatɔ dziƒo ke, eye wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖaseɖe alilikpowo ŋu.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Wò dzɔdzɔenyenye le abe Mawu ƒe towo ene, wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ enye tɔ goglo; èxɔna na amegbelɔwo kple lãwo, wò Yehowa.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Mawu, wò amenuveve xɔ asi loo! Amegbetɔviwo be ɖe wò aʋala ƒe vɔvɔli te.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Woɖi ƒo kple aƒewò me nu gbogboawo, eye nèkpe wò vivisese ƒe tɔsisi na wo wono ɖi kɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Elabena gbɔwò agbedzɔƒe le, eye wò kekeli me míele kekeli kpɔm le.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Gblẽ wò amenuveve ɖe amesiwo nya wò la dzi kple wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖe amesiwo ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka la dzi!

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Dadalawo megate afɔ ɖe dzinye o, eye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi meganyãm de gbe o!

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Ɖzi megaku wò le nu vlo wɔlawo ŋu o, eye megaʋã ŋu ɖe amesiwo wɔ nu tovo la ŋu o!

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: Elabena woasi wo xoxoxo abe gbe ene, eye woayrɔ abe aŋgba ene.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye nawɔ nyuie! Nɔ anyigba dzi, eye naɖi anukware!

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nu nenyo ŋuwò, eye wòana nusi wò dzi di la wò.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò mɔwo gblẽ ɖe Yehowa dzi, eye naɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu, ekema awɔe ade goe.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Ahe wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖe go abe kekeli ene, kple wò nya dzɔdzɔe ɖe go abe ŋɖɔkutsu ene.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Zi kpi na Yehowa kpoo, eye nakpɔ esinu! Dzi megaku wò ɖe amesi ƒe mɔwo dzea dzi nɛ, kple ŋutsu, si nye ayetɔ la ŋu o!

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Wò dɔmedzoe nu nefa, eye nadzudzɔ dzikudodo; dzi megaku wò o, elabena nu vɔ̃ɖi ko nayi wɔwɔ ge!

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Elabena woatsrɔ̃ ame vlowo, ke amesiwo kpɔa mɔ na Yehowa la, woanyi anyigba la dome.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Ke eme ɖihiãwo enyi anyigba la dome, eye dzi adzɔ wo ɖe ŋutifafa gbogbo la ŋuti.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖoa vɔ̃ ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe la ŋu, eye wòɖua aɖukli ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la le ekom, elabena ekpɔ be, eƒe ŋkeke li gbɔna.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo di yi, eye wova woƒe da me, ne woaxlã hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo ɖe anyi, eye woawu amesiwo ƒe zɔzɔme to mɔ ɖeka la.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Ke woƒe yi aƒo ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzi, eye woƒe da aŋe.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Nu ʋee, si le ame dzɔdzɔewo si la, nyo wu ame vɔ̃ɖi geɖewo ƒe nu gbogboawo.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe alɔ aŋe, ke Yehowa léa ame dzɔdzɔewo ɖe le.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa nya ame maɖifɔwo ƒe ŋkeke, eye woƒe domenyinu anɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Ŋu makpa wo le ŋkeke vɔ̃wo dzi o, eye woaɖi ƒo le dɔŋɔli.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖiwo atsrɔ̃, eye Yehowa ƒe ketɔwo nu ayi abe lãnyiƒe ƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo ene; wo nu ayi abe dzudzɔ ene.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi la doa nugbana, eye mexenɛ o; ke ame dzɔdzɔe la vea ame nu, eye wonae nu ame.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo wòyra la, woanyi anyigba la dome, ke woatsrɔ̃ amesiwo wòƒo fi de la.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Yehowa lia ke ŋutsu ƒe afɔɖeɖe, nenye be, eƒe mɔwo dze eŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Ne edze anyi la, made baba ɖe anyi o, elabena Yehowa léa eƒe asi ɖe te.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Meno ɖevime tsã, eye azɔ metsi, ke nyemekpɔ be, wogblẽ eme dzɔdzɔe ɖi, eye viawo ɖo abologbe kpɔ o.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Evea ame nu ɣesiaɣi, eye wòdoa nugbana, eye viawo zua yayra.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Tsri vɔ̃, eye nawɔ nyui, ekema ànɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa laa nya dzɔdzɔe, eye megblẽa eƒe mawumemewo ɖi o; akpɔ wo ta tegbee, ke woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe viwo.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo anyi anyigba la dome, eye woanɔ edzi tegbee.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Nunya le ame dzɔdzɔe la nu, eye eƒe aɖe gblɔa nya dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Eƒe Mawu ƒe se la le eƒe dzi me, eye eƒe afɔɖeɖe meʋãna o.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖe xa di na ame dzɔdzɔe la, eye wòdi be, yeawui.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa megblẽe ɖe esi me o, eye ne wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnui la, mebua fɔe o.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Kpɔ mɔ na Yehowa, eye nalé ŋku ɖe eƒe mɔwo ŋu, ekema ado wò ɖe dzi, ne nanyi anyigba la dome, eye ne woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo la, àkpɔ eteƒe.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ ame vɔ̃ɖia ɖe le ɖadzra ɖam, eye wòvu eɖokui ɖranyi abe ati dodo, si vu ke la ene.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Mete eŋu yi, eye kpɔ ɖa, megali o; medii, eye nyemekpɔe o.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Lé ŋku ɖe eme maɖifɔ la ŋu, eye nakpɔ ame dzɔdzɔe la ɖa, elabena dzidzimeviwo le ŋutifafame la si.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Woatsrɔ̃ dzidalawo katã, eye woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ke dzɔdzɔewo ƒe xɔname tso Yehowa gbɔ, eya nye sitsoƒe na wo le hiãɣi me.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Yehowa dea wo dzi, eye wòɖea wo, eɖea wo tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me, eye wòxɔna na wo, elabena wosinɛ tsona.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Yehowa, megaka mo nam le wò dɔmedzoe me o, eye megahe to nam le wò dziku me o!

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Elabena wò aŋutrɔwo ɖo agu ɖe menye, eye wò asi te ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Elabena nye vodadawo gbɔ tanye, eye wole kpeyem ŋutɔ abe agba kpekpe ene.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Nye abiwo le ʋeʋẽm le tsi kplɔm yoo le nye bometsitsi ta.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Mexa gobaa, eye mebi ŋutɔ, meƒo ɖi le yiyim ŋkekeawo katã.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Elabena nye alime ʋu dzo hẽ, eye agbagbeƒea ɖeke mele nye lãme o.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Megbɔdzɔ, eye nye lãme gbã gudugudu, mele ɣli dom wu alesi dzata ɖea gbee.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ŋkuwò me nye didiwo katã le, eye nye hũɖeɖewo meɣla ɖe wò o.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le totrom, nye ŋusẽ gblẽm ɖi, eye nye ŋkuwo ƒe kekeli hã megale gbɔnye o.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Nye ame lɔlɔ̃wo kple xɔ̃nyewo ƒo asa nam le nye fuwɔame la ta, eye nye ƒometɔwo tsi tre ɖe adzɔge.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Mele abe tokunɔ ene, nyemesea nu o, eye mele abe aɖetututɔ, si mekea eƒe nu o la ene.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Mele abe ŋutsu, si mesea nu o, eye nyakpenyaa ɖeke mele eƒe nu me o la ene.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Elabena wò Yehowa, sinu kpɔm mele, àtɔ nam, Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu!

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Nye anyidzedze gbɔ megɔdidi o, eye nye vevesesewo le ŋkunye me ɖaa.

english_verse: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
translation_verse: Elabena meɖe nye vodadawo fia, eye metsi dzi le nye nuvɔ̃wo ta.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Ke nye futɔwo le agbe, eye ŋusẽ le wo ŋu; amesiwo lé fum yakatsyɔ la, sɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tsɔ vɔ̃ ɖo nyuie teƒe nam la, lém ɖe ke me, le esi meti nyuie yome ta.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Yehowa, megagblẽm ɖi o, nye Mawu, meganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o!

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Mebe: Malé ŋku ɖe nye zɔzɔme ŋu, ne nyemagawɔ nuvɔ̃ kple nye aɖe o; made ga nye nu, ŋkeke alesi ame vɔ̃ɖi la gale ŋkunye me ko.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Doɖoe zi le ŋunye klenee, eye mezi ɖoɖoe le dzɔgbenyuiewo ŋu, ke nye vevesesewo do gã ɖe dzi.

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: Nye dzi xɔ dzo ɖe dɔme nam; ne mele tame susum la, dzo la flana. Metsɔ nye aɖe le nu ƒom be:

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Yehowa, na manya nye nuwuwu kple alesi nye ŋkekewo ƒe dzidzeme le; na madze si ɣesiɣi nunye ava yi!

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, èwɔ nye ŋkekewo wonye asi ƒe kekeme, eye nye agbenɔɣi menye naneke le ŋkuwò me o. Nyateƒe, ne amegbetɔ li ke ʋuu hã la, ƒuƒu ko wònye. Sela.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Azɔ, Aƒetɔ, nuka sinu makpɔ? Wò ɖeɖe koe mele mɔ kpɔm na.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso nye dzidadawo katã me; megatsɔm wɔ alɔmeɖenu na bometsilawo o!

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Ɖoɖoe zi le ŋunye, nyemeke nye nu o, elabena wòe wɔe.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò hiãkame ɖa le ŋunye, wò asi ƒe avuwɔwɔ kplim na metsrɔ̃.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ne ètsɔ tohehe ka mo na amegbetɔa ɖe le eƒe vodada ta la, ekema eƒe nyonyo dome agblẽ, abe agbagblaʋui ye ɖui ene. Vavãe, ƒuƒu ko amegbetɔwo katã nye! Sela.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Yehowa, se nye gbedodoɖa, nye ɣlidodo nede to me na wò, eye megazi kpi kpɔ nye aɖatsiwo o, elabena amedzro menye le gbɔwò, eye amegbɔme menye abe fofonyewo katã ene.

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Mele mɔ kpɔm na Yehowa kakaka, eziɔ to ɖe ŋunye, eye wòsa nye ɣlidodo.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ehem tso gbegblẽ ƒe do la me, eye wòɖem le ba finyafinya me, etsɔ nye afɔ ɖo agakpe dzi, eye wòli ke nye afɔɖeɖewo,

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: ede ha yeye nunye kple kafukafuha na mía Mawu la. Ame geɖewo akpɔe, eye vɔvɔ̃ aɖo wo, eye woaɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: Woayra ŋutsu, si tsɔ eƒe ŋuɖoɖo ɖo Yehowa dzi, eye metrɔ eɖokui ɖe ɖadzraɖalawo kple amesiwo ku ɖe aʋatsokaka ŋu la, ŋuti o.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye Mawu, wò nukunu kple wò tamesusu, siwo nèɖe fia ɖe mía ŋu la, sɔ gbɔ. Naneke mede nuwò o! Mebe, matsɔ wo aɖe gbe ƒãe, eye maƒo nu le wo ŋu, ke womele xexlẽ me o.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Akpedavɔsa kple numevɔsa medzea ŋuwò o; eʋu to nam; mèdia numevɔsa kple nuvɔ̃vɔsa o.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna, agbalẽ me woŋlɔ nya ɖo le ŋunye.

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, wò lɔlɔ̃nu wɔwɔ enye nye dzidzɔ, eye wò se la le nye dzi me.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Meɖe gbe ƒã wò dzɔdzɔenyenye le ameha gãwo me; kpɔ ɖa, nyememia nu o, Yehowa, ènyae.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Nyemeɣla wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖe nye dzi me o; mekɔ nu le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ kple wò xɔname dzi, eye nyemeɣla wò amenuveve kple wò nyateƒe de ameha gãwo o.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Yehowa, mate wo nublanuikpɔkpɔ da le gbɔnye o; wò amenuveve kple wò nyateƒe akpɔ tanye ɖaa.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Elabena fukpekpewo ɖe to ɖem taŋtaŋ, nye vodadawo lém, womele kpɔkpɔ me nam o; wosa gbɔ wu nye taɖa; eye nye dzi gblẽm ɖi.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Dzidzi neƒo amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm ɖe ŋunye be: Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃! la, le woƒe ŋukpe la ta!

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã dia wò la, ƒe dzeme nekɔ, eye woakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋuwò! Amesiwo dia wò xɔname la, nenɔ gbɔgblɔm ɖaa be: Yehowa lolo!

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Yehowa akpɔ eta, eye wòaxɔe ɖe agbe, ne woanyo nɛ le anyigba dzi; matsɔe ade asi na eƒe futɔwo ƒe adãwɔwɔ o!

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Yehowa akpe ɖe eŋu le dɔba dzi; ne ele dɔ lém la, atrɔ eƒe aha dzi nɔnɔ bubui.

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Nyea mele gbɔgblɔm be: Yehowa, ve nunye, da gbe le nye luʋɔ ŋu, elabena mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò!

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo le nu vɔ̃ ƒom ɖe ŋunye be: Ɣekaɣi ga wòaku, eye eƒe ŋkɔ nabu?

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo katã le nu dem tenye, eye wole nusi nye nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e la susum ɖe ŋunye be:

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Wolɔ gbegblẽ trɔ ɖe edzi, emlɔ anyi, eye magafɔ akpɔ o!

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Xɔ̃nye kekeake, amesi ŋu meɖoa ŋu ɖo, eye wòɖua nye abolo la, kɔ afɔkpodzi dzi ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Ke wò Yehowa, ve nunye, eye nafɔm ɖe te, ekema maɖo eteƒe na wò!

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Esia me menyae le be, nye nu nyea ŋuwò, ne nye futɔ magatso aseye ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ke èlé nyea ɖe asi le nye fɔmaɖimaɖi ta, eye nètsɔm ɖo ŋkuwò me tegbee.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Alesi zinɔ ƒe veme ƒuna ɖe tɔʋu ŋu la, nenema nye luʋɔ ƒe veme ƒu ɖe ŋuwò, Mawu!

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Tsikɔ le nye luʋɔ wum ɖe Mawu ŋu, ɖe Mawu gbagbe la ŋu; gbekagbe made ahado ɖe Mawu ŋku me?

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Nye aɖatsiwo zu nuɖuɖu nam zã kple keli, esi wole gbɔgblɔm nam edziedzi be: Afika gɔ̃ wò Mawu la le?

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Ne meɖo ŋu, alesi menɔa amehawo dome, eye mía kpli wo míeyia Mawu ƒe aƒe la me kple aseyetsotso kple kafukafuhadzidzi le ŋkekenyuieɖulawo ƒe ha me la, nye dzi lólona gbanaa.

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ, nukaŋuti nèle nu xam, eye nètsi dzodzodzoe le menye? Kpɔ mɔ na Mawu, elabena magakafui, eya, amesi nye nye xɔnametɔ kple nye Mawu la!

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Mawunye! Nye luʋɔ le nu xam le menye, eyata mele ŋku ɖom dziwò le Yordan-nyigba, Hermon-to kple to sue la dzi.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Le wò tsiwo ƒe kɔkɔɖanyi bababa me la tɔɖɔɖɔ yɔ tɔɖɔɖɔ; wò tsi kpakawo kple tsitsotsoewo ŋe ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ŋkeke me la Yehowa ɖɔ eƒe amenuveve ɖa, le zã me la eƒe ha le nunye, eye medo gbe ɖa na nye agbe ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Magblɔ na Mawu, nye agakpe, be: Nukaŋuti nèŋlɔm be, eye nukaŋuti maƒo ɖi anɔ yiyim le nye futɔ ƒe teteɖanyi te?

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Ne nye ketɔwo le alɔme ɖem le gbɔgblɔm nam edziedzi be: Afika gɔ̃ wò Mawu le hã la, enɔna abe ŋɔ ɖunue le nye ƒuwo me ene.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Tso afia nam, Mawu, eye nawɔ nye dzre kple dukɔ malɔ̃ame la nam; ɖem tso alakpatɔ kple ame vlo la si me!

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Elabena wòe nye nye Mawu, amesi nye nye sitsoƒe; nukaŋuti nètu asim ɖa, eye nukaŋuti maƒo ɖi anɔ yiyim le futɔ la ƒe teteɖanyi te?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Ɖo wò kekeli kple wò nyateƒe ɖa, ne woakplɔm ayi wò to kɔkɔe la kple wò nɔƒe la gbɔe,

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: ne maɖe Mawu ƒe vɔsamlekpui la kple nye dzidzɔseye ƒe Mawu la gbɔ, eye matsɔ saŋku akafu wò, Mawu, nye Mawu la!

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ, nukaŋuti nèle nu xam, eye nètsi dzodzodzoe le menye? Kpɔ mɔ na Mawu, elabena magakafui eya, amesi nye nye xɔnametɔ kple nye Mawu la!

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Mawu, míesee kple míaƒe to, mía fofowo ɖa xo na mí, le nusiwo nèwɔ le wo ŋɔli le blema la ŋuti.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wò asi nyã dukɔwo, ke woawo la èƒo woƒe aganu ɖe to; ègblẽ anyigbadzitɔwo, ke èna woawo keke la.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
