translation_verse: Mawu, nye fia nènye, ɖo xɔnume ɖe Yakob!

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Wòe míatsɔ aƒu míaƒe futɔwo anyii, eye wò ŋkɔ míatsɔ anyã avuzi le míaƒe ketɔwo dzii.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemele ŋu ɖom ɖe nye dati ŋu o, eye menye yie axɔ num o;

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wòe xɔ mí tso míaƒe futɔwo si me, eye nèna ŋukpe lé míaƒe ketɔwo.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Míetsɔ Mawu le adegbe ƒomi ɖaa, eye míekafu wò ŋkɔ tegbee. Sela.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Ke ètsɔ mí ƒu gbe, ède ŋukpe mo na mí, eye mèho yi kple míaƒe aʋakɔwo o.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Ena míede megbe le míaƒe futɔwo nu, eye míaƒe ketɔwo ha nu.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Etsɔ mí na, ne woaɖu abe alẽwo ene, eye nèkaka mí ɖe dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wò dukɔ dzra ho kpɔtsɔe, eye medo asi loloe ɖe wo ŋu o.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Etsɔ mí wɔ hameloe le dukɔwo dome kple ame, ne woɔʋuʋu ta ɖe eŋua le anyigbɔdzitɔwo dome.

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: Nye vlododo le ŋkunye me ŋkekeawo katã, eye ŋukpe, si le ŋunye le, nyẽ tsyɔm,

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: be manɔ vlodoamela kple fewuɖula ŋkɔ sem, eye manɔ futɔ kple hlɔ̃biala kpɔm kple ŋku.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Nusiawo katã va mía dzi, ke míeŋlɔ wò be o, eye míezu alakpatɔwo le wò nubabla la me o.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Míaƒe dzi mefe ɖa o, eye míaƒe afɔɖede mete ɖa le wò mɔ dzi o.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Elabena èto mí nyanyanya le amegãxiwo nɔƒe, eye nètsɔ blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi tsyɔ mía dzi.

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: Ɖe wònye ɖe míeŋlɔ mía Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ be, eye míeke míaƒe asiwo na mawu tutɔwo la,

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: enye ne mía Mawu madi egɔme oa? Elabena enya dzi me gogloeaƒe ke.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Elabena tawò wole mía wum atraɖi ɖaa, eye wobua mí abe alẽ, siwo wu ge woala la ene.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Nyɔ, Aƒetɔ! Nukaŋuti nèle alɔ̃ dɔm? Fɔ, eye megatsɔ mí ƒu gbe ɖika o!

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèɣla wò ŋku me, eye nèŋlɔ míaƒe hiã kple míaƒe xaxa be?

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Elabena míaƒe luʋɔ bɔbɔ vaseɖe ke me ke, eye míaƒe ƒodo lé ɖe anyigba ŋu.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Korax-viwo ƒe nufiameha, si nye lɔlɔ̃ha na henɔ la, ne woatsɔ „Dzogbenya“ ƒe gbeɖiɖi adzii.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Nya nyuiwo le fiefiẽm le nye dzi me wlɔwlɔwlɔ. Mebe: Nye hawo nye fia la tɔ; nye aɖe enye amesi bi ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔ me la, ƒe nuŋlɔti.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Ta wò yi, wò bubu kple wò atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo ɖe ali, wò kalẽtɔ!

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Nɔ wò atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo me, naho, eye yi le nyateƒenya la kple nya dzɔdzɔe, si wote ɖe to la ta, eye wò nuɖusi afia nu dziŋɔwo wɔwɔ wò!

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Wò aŋutrɔ ɖaɖɛwo ƒo ɖe fia ƒe futɔwo ƒe dzi me, dukɔwo dze anyi ɖe tewò.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Mawu, wò fiazikpui li ɖaa tegbee; wò fiaɖuƒe ƒe fiatikplɔ enye fiatikplɔ dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Elɔ̃a dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye nèléa fu nu vɔ̃ɖi, eyata Mawu, wò Mawu le si dzidzɔmi na wò ƒo hawòviwo ta.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Wò avɔwo katã nye lifi, sikɔni kple kotoklobo; saŋkuƒoƒo le dzidzɔ dom na wò le nyiɖufiasã me.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Fianyɔnuwo le wò ame veviwo dome; fiasrɔ̃ le Ofir-sikanuwo me tsi tre ɖe wò nuɖusi me.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Nyɔnuvi, see, kpɔ nu, eye naƒu to anyi, wò ŋku nedzo le wò dukɔ kple fofowò ƒe aƒe dzi,

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: eye na fia la nadi wò tugbedzedze yome, elabena wò aƒetɔ wònye, eye nade ta agu nɛ!

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Tiro-vinyɔnu atsɔ nunana vɛ, eye dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔtɔwo aɖo mo ŋanɛ na wò.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Fiavinyɔnu, si le eme la, enye atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo ɖeɖe sɔŋ; sika wotsɔ lɔ̃ eƒe avɔe.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Ele avɔ ŋɔŋɔe me wokplɔ yi na fia la, detugbi, siwo nye exɔlɔ̃wo le eyome, wokplɔ vɛ na wò.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ dzidzɔ kple aseyetsotso kplɔ wo yii, eye woge ɖe fia ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Viwòŋutsuwo anɔ fofowòwo teƒe, eye atsɔ wo aɖo amegãwoe ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Korax-viwo ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe ɖetugbiwo ƒe gbe nu.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye sitsoƒe kple ŋusẽ na mí, xɔnametɔ ŋutɔ wònye le xaxawo me.

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: Eyata míavɔ̃ o, nenye be, anyigba gli le enu, eye towo ʋã le atsiaƒu titina,

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: ne eƒe tɔwo dze agbo, eye wotso futukpɔ, eye towo ʋuʋu le eƒe nyanyrã me hã. Sela.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Tɔsisi la ƒe alɔdzewo doa dzidzɔ na Mawu ƒe du, si nye dziƒoʋitɔ ƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Mawu le eme, maʋã o, Mawu xɔna nɛ, ne agu dze.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo dze agbo, ke de le fiaɖuƒewo te; enu eƒe gbe di, tete anyigba lólo.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot li kpli mi Yakob ƒe Mawu la nye mɔ̃ sesẽ na mi! Sela.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: amesi tsia aʋawɔwɔwo nu vaseɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke, eflia dati, eŋea akplɔ, eye wòtɔa dzo tasiaɖamwo!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Midzudzɔ, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Mawu; meɖo kpo ɖe dukɔwo dzi, meɖo kpo ɖe anyigba dzi!

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Korax viwo ƒe ha na henɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, miƒu akpe, eye mitsɔ aƒadodo tso aseye ɖe Mawu ŋu!

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Elabena ŋɔdzi le Yehowa dziƒoʋitɔ la ŋu, fia gã wonye ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Etsɔ dukɔwo ɖe mía te kple sesẽ, eye wòɖe anyigbadzitɔwo míaƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Etia míaƒe domenyinu na mí, si nye Yakob, amesi wòlɔ̃na la, ƒe adegbeƒonu. Sela.

english_verse: Sing praises to God our King,
translation_verse: Mawu yi dzi kple aseyetsotso, Yehowa kple kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Midzi kafukafuha na Mawu, midzi kafukafuha hee! Midzi kafukafuha na mía fia la, midzi kafukafuha!

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawue nye fia ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi, midzi nufiameha!

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Mawu ɖu fia ɖe dukɔwo dzi, Mawu bɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Yehowa lolo, eye wòdze kafukafu le mía Mawu ƒe du la me kple eƒe to kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Zion-to, si nye fia gã la ƒe nu, kɔ eɖokui ɖe dzi nyuie le anyiehe kekeake, eye wònye dzidzɔdonu na anyigba blibo la.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Mawu fia eɖokui le eƒe fiasãwo me abe sitsoƒe ene.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, fiawo ƒo ƒu, eye wa katã wova ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Esi wokpɔe la, woƒe nu ku, dzidzi ƒo wo, eye wosi.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Wodzo nyanyanya le afima, eye ŋɔdzi lé wo abe nyɔnu, si le ku lém ene.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Míekpɔe le Yehowa Zebaot ƒe ɖu kple mía Mawu ƒe du la me, abe alesi míesee ene. Mawu ali kee tegbee. Sela.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Mawu, míele ŋku dom wò amenuveve dzi le wò gbedoxɔ titina.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Mawu, wò kafukafu de anyigba ƒe mlɔenu abe wò ŋkɔ ke ene. Wò nuɖusi yɔ fũ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Zion-to nekpɔ dzidzɔ, eye Yuda-nyɔnuviwo netso aseye le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ta!

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: Mizɔ Zion ŋu godoo, miƒo xlãe va kpe, eye mixlẽ eƒe xɔ tsralawo!

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: Milé ŋku de eƒe agbogbowo ŋu, eye mito eƒe fiasãwo me, ne miaxlẽe afia megbeviwo!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Korax-viwo ƒe ha na henɔ la.

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, mise esia, mi xexeametɔwo katã, miƒu to anyi,

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: mi hahooawo kple amegãviwo, mi kesinɔtɔwo kple ame dahewo siaa!

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Nye nu agblɔ nunya, eye gɔmesese enye nye dzimesusuwo.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Maƒu to anyi ɖe abebubu ŋu, eye mato nye adzo ɖe saŋkuƒoƒo ŋu.

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti mavɔ̃ le dzɔgbevɔ̃eɣiwo me, ne nye adikãtɔwo ƒe vodada ɖe to ɖem?

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Amesiwo le dzi ɖom ɖe woƒe nuwo ŋu, eye wotsɔ woƒe kesinɔnu gbogboawo le adegbe ƒomi.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mate ŋu axɔ nɔvia akpɔ o, eye mate ŋu axe etafe na Mawu,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: — elabena woƒe agbe ƒeƒle xɔ asi ŋutɔ, eye aɖo kpoe tegbee, —

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Kpao, ke boŋ akpɔe be, nunyalawo kuna, bometsilawo kple abunetɔwo nu yina, eye wogblẽa woƒe nuwo ɖi na ame bubuwo.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Ke amegbetɔ, si le agbe le atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo me la, mali ke o; esɔ kple lã, eye nuƒoƒo abu ɖee.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Esia nye amesiwo ɖoa ŋu ɖe wo ɖokui ŋu la, ƒe zɔzɔme, eye woƒe nya dzea wo yometɔwo ŋu. Sela.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ade nye luʋɔ atso tsiẽƒe si me, elabena axɔm de eɖokui gbɔ. Sela.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe zu kesinɔtɔ, eye eƒe aƒe ƒe bubu dzi ɖe dzi la, megava o!

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Elabena ne eku la, matsɔ nusiawo katã dometɔa ɖeke aɖo asi o, eye eƒe bubu makplɔe ɖo o.

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Nenye be, eyra eɖokui le eƒe agbenɔɣi, eye wokafui be, ewɔ nyuie na eɖokui hã la,

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: ayi fofoawo ƒe ƒome, si megakpɔ kekeli kpɔ o la gbɔ.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe ha. Mawu, Yehowa, ŋusẽkatãtɔ la le nu ƒom, eye wòle xexeame yɔm tso ɣe ƒe dzedze me vaseɖe eƒe loɖoɖo me.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Zion, si nye nyonyowo ƒe ta la, Mawu klẽ tso.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Mía Mawu gbɔna, ɖoɖoe mazi le eŋu o, dzo le nu bim le eŋgɔ, eye ahom sesẽ ɖe to ɖee.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Ele dzi me yɔ dziƒo kple anyigba ɖa, ne wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eƒe dukɔ.

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: Miƒo nye mawumeme, siwo bla nu kplim ɖe akpedavɔsa dzi la, nu ƒu nam!

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Dziƒowo ɖe gbe ƒã eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye, elabena Mawu enye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, see, mele nu ƒo ge; Israel, maɖi ɖase na wò be: Mawu, wò Mawu, menye!

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Nyemalé nyitsu le aƒewò me alo gbɔ̃tsu le wò lãkpɔ me o.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Elabena tɔnyee nye avemelãwo katã kple lã akpe nane, siwo le towo dzi.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Menya xevi, siwo katã le towo dzi, eye nusiwo katã ʋãa wo ɖokui le gbe me la, mele manyamanya ɖem o.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Ɖe nye dɔe le wuyem la, ne nyematoe na wò o, elabena tɔnyee nye xexeame godoo kple eme nu gbogboawo.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe meɖua nyitsuwo ƒe lã, eye menoa gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe ʋua?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Tsɔ akpedada sa vɔ na Mawu, eye naxe wò adzɔgbeɖefe na dziƒoʋitɔ la!

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Yɔm le xaxagbe la, ekema maɖe wò, eye nade bubu ŋunye!

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Ke Mawu gblɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi be: Nye ɖoɖowo xexlẽfia kae tsa gbɔwò? Eye nukaŋuti nèlé nye nubabla ɖe nu?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Wòa èlé tu hehe, eye nètsɔ nye nyawo ƒu gbe ɖe megbewò tso!

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Ne èkpɔ hafi la, ekema èkplɔe ɖo, eye nèɖea ha kple ahasitɔwo.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Eɖe ga wò nu ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi ŋu, eye wò aɖe ɖa alakpa.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi le nu ƒom le nɔviwò ŋu, eye nèle aɖeɖi ƒom dawòvi.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Nusiawo wɔm nèle, eye mezi kpi; eyata nèle bubum be, ɖe mele abe wò ene. Maka mo na wò, eye matsɔe aɖo ŋkuwò me!

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Mi, amesiwo ŋlɔ Mawu be, midze si esia dzro, ne nyemagavuvu nu, eye ɖelaa ɖeke manɔ anyi o!

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Amesi tso akpedada sa vɔe la, ede bubu ŋunye; eye amesi lé ŋku ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu la, mana wòakpɔ Mawu ƒe xɔname!

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: esime wode Batseba gbɔ, eye nyagblɔɖila Natan va egbɔ.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Mawu, ve nunye le wò dɔmenyo la nu, eye le wò nublanui-kpɔkpɔ sɔgbɔ la nu tutu nye dzidadawo ɖa!

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Le tsi nam keŋkeŋ tso nye vodada me, eye naklɔ ŋunye tso nye nuvɔ̃ me!

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Elabena nye dzidadawo la, medze si wo, eye nye nuvɔ̃ le ŋkunye me daa?

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, voɖaɖa me wodzim ɖo, eye nuvɔ̃ me danye fɔ nye fu ɖo!

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nyateƒe, si le dzi me la, nèdina, eyata ɖe nunya fiam le adzame!

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Tsɔ akutsa klɔ nye nuvɔ̃ ɖa, ne ŋunye naɖi; le tsi nam, ne matu tititi wu ɖetifu!

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Na mase dzidzɔ kple aseyetsotso, ne nye ƒu, siwo nèŋe la, nagli kple dzidzɔ!

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Ɣla wò mo ɖe nuvɔ̃nyewo, eye tutu nye vodadawo katã ɖa!

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Mawu, wɔ dzi dzadzɛa ɖe nam, eye nade gbɔgbɔ yeye, si li ke la, menye!

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Megatsɔm ƒu gbe le ŋkuwò me o, eye megaxɔ wò gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la le asinye o!

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Gatsɔ wò xɔname do dzidzɔ nam, eye natsɔ gbɔgbɔ, si me lɔlɔ̃nu le le, lém ɖe asi!

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mafia wò mɔ dzidalawo, eye nuvɔwɔlawo atrɔ tame ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ke nye nuyiwo, eye nye nu aɖe gbe ƒa wò kafukafu!

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Elabena mèdia akpedavɔsa o, anye ne mana wò; numevɔsa hã medzea ŋuwò o!

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Vɔsewo na Mawu wonye gbɔgbɔ, si wote de anyi; Mawu, màdo vlo dzi gbagbã, si tugu la o.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: le esime Edomtɔ Doeg va to na Saul bena, Dawid le Abimelex ƒe me.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Kalẽtɔ, nukaŋuti nètsɔ vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi le adegbe ƒomi? Mawu ƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Wò aɖe le gbegblẽ ŋu susum abe talũhɛ ɖaɖɛ ene, wò alakpadala.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Elɔ̃ vɔ̃ wu nyui, eye nèlɔ̃ aʋatso wu nya dzɔdzɔe gbɔgblɔ. Sela.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Wò alakpaɖe, nu gbegblẽ nyawo sɔŋ nyoa ŋuwò.

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: Eyata Mawu hã agbã wò aƒu anyi ɖikaa, alé wò, eye wòahe wò aƒu gbe tso agbadɔ me, eye wòaho wò kple ke tso agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi. Sela.

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo lakpɔe, eye dzika atso wo ƒo, eye woakoe be:

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu, si metsɔ Mawu wɔ eƒe mɔ̃ sesẽe o, ke boŋ wòɖo dzi ɖe eƒe kesinɔnu sɔgbɔawo ŋu, eye wòtɔ asi kɔ ɖe eƒe nuwo ŋu la enye si!

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Ahunetɔwo gblɔna le woƒe dzi me bena: Mawua ɖeke meli o! Wowɔa nu gbegblẽwo kple nu nyɔŋuwo le nu tovo wɔwɔwo me. Amea ɖeke meli, si wɔa nu nyui o.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖe ŋku ɖe amegbetɔviwo tso dziƒo, ne yeakpɔ be, amea ɖe dze nunya, eye wòbiaa Mawu ta sena hã?

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Wo keŋ wote ɖe aga, wo katã tim wogblẽ. Ame ɖeka hã meli, si wɔa nu nyui o, ɖeka hɔ̃ hã meli o!

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Ɖe nu vlo wɔlawo, amesiwo le nye dukɔ ɖum, abe alesi woɖua aboloe ene, eye womeyɔa Mawu o la, medze si esia oa?

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Tete vɔvɔ̃ ɖo dzikatsoƒoe na wo le afisi ŋɔdzia ɖeke mele o; elabena Mawu kaka amesi ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe ŋuwò la, ƒe ƒuwo. Ena ŋukpe lé wo, elabena Mawu gbe wo.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe nufiameha na kasaŋkuwo ƒe henɔ,

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: le esime Ziftɔwo va gblɔ na Saul bena: Menye Dawid ye nye esi ɣla ɖe mia gbɔ oa?

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Mawu, tsɔ wò ŋkɔ xɔ nam, eye natsɔ wò ŋusẽ tso afia nam!

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Mawu, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye nalé to ɖe nye nu me nyawo ŋu!

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Elabena ame tovowo tso ɖe ŋunye, eye ŋutasẽlawo le nye ku dim. Wometsɔ Mawu ɖo ŋku me o. Sela.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa. Mawua nye xɔnametɔ, Aƒetɔ la lé nye luʋɔ ɖe asi.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ la agbugbɔ ayi nye ketɔwo dzi; tsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le wò nyateƒe la nu!

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe nufiameha na kasaŋkuwo ƒe henɔ.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Mawu, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye megaɣla dokuiwò ɖe nye kokoƒoƒo o!

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: Lé to ɖe ŋunye, eye natɔ nam; mele tsa glalã tsam le konyifafa me, eye mele hũ ɖem

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ kple dzodzo nyanyanya lém, eye nye lãme ble tu.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: Mebe: Ao, ɖe wonye aʋalae le asinye abe ahɔ̃ne ene la, anye ne madzo aɖatsi afia ɖe!

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, didiƒe ʋi mebe, masi ayi, eye matsi gbedzi adɔ. Sela.

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Mawɔ kaba asi le ya ʋuduʋudu kple ahom nu.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Tsrɔ̃ wo, Aƒetɔ, eye nate woƒe aɖe me ɖe eve, elabena mekpɔ ŋutasesẽ kple dzrewɔwɔ le dua me.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Woɖe to ɖee te woƒe gliwo dzi zã kple keli, eye gbegblẽ kple hiãkame le eme.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Gbegblẽ le eme, eye ŋutasesẽ kple amebaba mete ɖa le eƒe abla me o.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ amegbetɔ, si mía kplii míele tasɔsɔ ɖeka me lae, xɔ̃nye kple nye ame nyanyɛ,

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: mí amesiwo dome nya viviwo le, eye míenɔa amehawo dome yia mawuƒe me lae.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Saɖagatsi nedze wodzi, woayi tsiẽ agbagbe, elabena vɔɖinyenye le wo nɔƒe, le woƒe dzi me.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Ke nyea meyɔ Mawu, eye Yehowa xɔ nam.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Mefa konyi, eye meɖe hũ le fiẽ, ŋdi kple ŋdɔ, eye wòɖo to nye gbe.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Eɖe nye luʋɔ tso amesiwo le tetem ɖe ŋunye la si me, eye wòna ŋunye fe; elabena amesiwo tso ɖe ŋunye la, sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Edo asi ɖa ɖe amesiwo le ŋutifafa me kplii la ŋuti, eye wògblẽ kɔ ɖo na eƒe nubabla.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Eƒe nu me nya zrɔ̃ drẽdrẽdrẽ abe notsi kpekẽ ene; aʋawɔwɔ le eƒe dzi me, eƒe nuƒoƒowo le bɔlɔbɔlɔ abe ami ene, ke yi, si wodi, wonye.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò nyawo dro ɖe Yehowa dzi, eyae akpɔtawò; emana ke naɖe le ame dzɔdzɔe te akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Nye ketɔwo lɔ gbɔgbɔtsixe ɖe ƒo ɖaa; eye amesiwo tsɔ dada le aʋa wóm kplim la, sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Ne vɔvɔ̃ ɖom la, meɖoa ŋu ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Mawu ana be, makafu yeƒe nyia la; Mawu ŋu maɖo ŋu ɖo, nyemavɔ̃ o, nuka ŋutilã awɔm ma?

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Wole nya trɔm nam gbesiagbe; eye woƒe susuwo katã nye be, woawo vɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Wokpe ta, wode xa, eye wole ŋku ɖem ɖe nye afɔkpodzi, abe alesi wole nye luʋɔ yome dimee ene.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Ɖe woasi le woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ la ta? Mawu, xlã dukɔwo ɖe anyi le dɔmedzoe me!

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Wòe xlẽ nye sisiƒewo, eɖe nye aɖatsiwo wò goe me! Ɖe mèŋlɔ wo ɖe wò agbalẽ me oa?

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Mawu ana be, makafu nya la, Yehowa ana be, makafu nya la.

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Mawu ŋu mele ŋu ɖom ɖo, nyemavɔ̃ o; nuka amegbetɔ awɔm ma?

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Megagblẽ nu o! Dawid ƒe ha ɖe futamee na henɔ la, le esime wòsi le Saul nu yi agado la me.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Adɔ ɖa tso dziƒo, ne wòaxɔ nam; ne amesi lɔ gbɔgbɔtsixe ɖe ƒo ɖe ŋunye la, le vlo ɖom hã, Sela; Mawu aɖo eƒe amenuveve kple nyateƒe ɖa.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ le dzatawo dome, memlɔ amegbetɔvi, siwo nye adzowɔlawo la dome, amesiwo ƒe aɖuwo nye akplɔ kple aŋutrɔ, eye woƒe aɖe nye yi ɖaɖɛ.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Oo, Mawu, kɔ ɖokuiwò ɖe dzi gbɔ dziƒo ŋu, eye wò ŋutikɔkɔe nagbɔ anyigba blibo la ta!

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Woɖo ɖɔ ɖi na nye afɔwo, eye wote nye luʋɔ ɖe anyi; woɖe ʋe ɖe ŋkunye me; woawo ŋutɔ kee adze eme. Sela.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Nye dzi dze eme, Mawu, nye dzi dze eme; madzi ha, eye maƒo saŋku.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, makafu wò le dukɔwo dome, madzi ha na wò, eye maƒo saŋku na wò le anyigbadzitɔwo dome.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Elabena wò amenuveve kɔ ɖatɔ dziƒo, eye wò nyateƒe de alilikpowo gbɔ.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Megagblẽ nu o! Dawid ƒe ha ɖe futamee na henɔ la.

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Mi ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo, ɖe mietsoa afia ɖe nyateƒe mea? Ɖe míedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu amegbetɔwo, alesi dzea?

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Nu tovo boŋ miewɔna le miaƒe dziwo me, eye miedaa miaƒe asiwo ƒe ŋutasẽnuwɔwɔ le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo te ɖe aga tso ƒoɖo me ke eye amesiwo koa aʋatso la, tra mɔ tso ɖɔ me ke.

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: Aɖi te wo si abe ɖa ƒe aɖi ene, abe ƒli toku, si xe nu tome,

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: eye mesea dzom kple gbesala, si bi ɖe gbesasa me le ƒe gbe o la ene.

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Mawu, ŋe aɖu le nu me na wo, Yehowa, ho tsyo na dzataviwo!

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Wo nu ayi abe tsi sisi ene; eye ne eda eƒe aŋutrɔwo la, woanɔ abe ɖe wo nu tsi kpo ene.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Wole abe abɔbɔ, si le azɔli dzi le nyinyim ene, eye wodi nyɔnu ƒe fu gege, si mekpɔ ɣe kpɔ o.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Hafi aŋɔkadzo nabi ɖe miaƒe zewo ŋu la, aɖe wo ɖa le dɔmedzoe me, esime wogale mumu.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe akpɔ dzidzɔ, elabena ele hlɔ̃biabia kpɔm, eye aklɔ eƒe afɔwo ɖe eme vɔ̃ɖi ƒe ʋu me.

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, ɖem tso nye futɔwo nu, eye nakpɔ tanye tso amesiwo tso ɖe ŋunye ta si me!

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso nu vlo wɔlawo si me, eye naxɔm tso hlɔmewo si me!

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: Elabena wode xa de nye luʋɔ ŋu; ame sesẽwo kpe ta ɖe ŋunye, menye le nye dzidada kple nye nuvɔ̃wo ta o. Yehowa!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Menye vodada ŋuti wole du dzi, eye wodzra ɖo ɖi ɖo o. Nyɔ, nava kpem, eye kpɔ nya la me!

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Wogbɔ le fiẽ le gbe tem abe avũwo ene, eye wole tsa glãla tsam le ɖua me.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Yehowa, èle wo kom, eye nele alɔme ɖem le dukɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Nye ŋusẽ, asiwò nu kpɔm mele, elabena Mawu enye nye sitsoƒe.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu ava kpem kple eƒe amenuveve, Mawu ana nye ŋku atsa le nye ketɔwo dzi.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Megawu wo o, ne nye dukɔ ƒe ŋku nanɔ edzi! Tsɔ wò ŋusẽ nyã wo de gbe, eye natsɔ wo aƒu anyi, wò Aƒetɔ, mía akpexɔnu!

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Woƒe nu me nuvɔ̃ enye woƒe nuyiwo ƒe i ya, eyata woalé wo le woƒe dada la me le fiƒode kple alakpa, si dona tsoa wo nu la ta.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Wotrɔna gbɔna le fiẽ nɔa gbe tem abe avũwo ene, henɔa tsatsam le dua me.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Wonɔa tsa glãla tsam le nuɖuɖu ta; eye ne womeɖi ƒo o la, wotsina dɔna.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha ɖe futamee na henɔ la, ne woafia, eye woadzi ɖe „Dzogbenya ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi“ ƒe gbe nu;

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: le esime wòwɔ aʋa kple Aramtɔwo le Mesopotamia kple Aramtɔwo le Zoba, eye Yoab trɔ hewu Edomtɔ akpe wuieve le dzeʋe la me.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Mawu, ègbe mí, èkaka mí hlẽ èdo dɔmedzoe; gatrɔ mí gbɔe!

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Eʋuʋu anyigba, eye nèfee; gatre eƒe fefeƒeawo, elabena ele ʋaʋãm!

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Ena nu sesẽ kpe wò dukɔ la, eye néna wein mí míeno mu.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Ena aflaga amesiwo vɔ̃a wò, ne woafɔ wo ɖokui de tsitre le nyateƒe la ta. Sela.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Ne woaxɔ na wò ame lɔlɔ̃wo, tsɔ wò nuɖusi ɖe mi, eye naɖo to mi!

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Mawu ƒo nu le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la be: Makpɔ dzidzɔ, mamã Sixem, eye madzidze Sukot-hali me la.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Gilead enya tɔnye, eye tɔnyee nye Manase; Efrayim enye nye taxenu, eye Yuda enye nye fiatikplɔ;

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: nye tsileze enye Moab, mada nye atokota ɖe Edom dzi, eye matso aseye ɖe Filistitɔwo ŋu!

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Amekae akplɔm ayi du sesẽ la mee, eye amekae akplɔm vaseɖe Edom?

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖe menye wòe gbe mi oa, Mawu, eye mèho kple míaƒe aʋakɔwo oa?

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ na kasaŋkuwo ƒe henɔ.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Mawu, se nye ɣli, eye nalé to ɖe nye gbedodoɖa ŋu!

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke mele yɔwòm tsoe, esime nu te nye dzi ŋu; tsɔm ɖo agakpe, si kɔ nam akpa la dzi!

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Elabena ènye sitsoƒe nam kple xɔ tsrala sesẽ le futɔ la ŋku me.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Medi be, mana wò agbadɔ me tegbee, eye mabe ɖe wò aʋala te. Sela.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Elabena wò Mawu èɖo to nye adzɔgbeɖeɖewo, eye nẽtsɔ domenyinu na amesiwo vɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ la.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Tsɔ ŋkekewo kpe fia la ƒe ŋkekewo, eye eƒe ƒewo netso dzidzime yi dzidzime!

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Neɖu fia le Mawu ŋku me tegbee; ɖo amenuveve kple nyateƒe, ne woakpɔ eta!

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ Yedutun.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, doɖoe zi le nye luʋɔ ŋu kpoo na Mawu, eya gbɔ nye xɔname tso.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Eya koe nye nye aga, nye xɔname kple nye mɔ̃ sesẽ, eyata nyemaʋã akpe o.

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Zi nenie mi katã mialũ ɖe ame ɖeka dzi, be yewoaƒui anyi abe gli treazã kple gli gbagbã ene?

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ, zi ɖoɖoe na Mawu kpoo ko, elabena eya gbɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ tso.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Eya koe nye nye aga, nye xɔname kple nye mɔ̃ sesẽ, eyata nyemaʋã o!

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Nya xɔname, nye bubu kple nye ŋusẽ ƒe aga le Mawu gbɔ, eye Mawu me nye sitsoƒe le.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔ la, miɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu ɣeawokatãɣi, mitrɔ miaƒe dzi ƒo le eŋku me; Mawu enye míaƒe sitsoƒe! Sela.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Vavã, tofloko enye amegbetɔviwo, eye alakpa enye ameviwo; wole wodzoo le nudanu me, elabena wo katã la tofloko wonye.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒo nu zi ɖeka, eye nu eve mese le eme; Mawu tɔe nye ŋusẽ,

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Ale metsa ŋu na wò le kɔkɔeƒe la, be makpɔ wò ŋusẽ kple wò ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Elabena wò amenuveve nyo wu agbe; nye nuyiwo akafu wò.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Ekema makafu wò le nye agbe me katã, eye mawu nye asiwo dzi le wò ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ aɖi ƒo, abe alesi woɖua ami kple lãmi ene, eye nye nu atsɔ aseyetsonuyiwo akafu wò.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ne medo ŋku dziwo le nye aba dzi, ne menya le zã, eye mebu ŋuwò le,

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: — elabena wòe nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ, eye wò aʋala ƒe vɔvɔli te mele aseye tsom le —

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: ekema nye luʋɔ kuna ɖe ŋuwò; wò nuɖusi vaam goŋgoŋ.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Ke woawo, amesiwo le nye luʋɔ dim, be yewoɔgblẽe la, woayi keke anyigba te ʋi ke.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ wo ade yi nu, eye woazu aboyonu na amegãxiwo.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Mawu, se nye gbe le nye konyifafa me, eye nakpɔ nye agbe ta tso futɔ la ƒe ŋɔdzidodo me!

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Ɣlam tso eme vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe takpekpe kple ame vlowo ƒe howɔwɔ me!

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: ne woaɖa ame maɖitɔ la le vivi me; zi ɖeka kasia wodae, eye dzika metso wo ƒo o.

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Woɖe dzi ƒo na wo ɖokui ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu, eye woɖo be, yewoatre mɔ̃ ɖe vivime hele gbɔgblɔm be: Amekae le ekpɔ ge?

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Tete Mawu te wo kple da, eye woxɔ abi enumake.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aɖe atsɔ wa aƒu anyi, eye amesiwo katã kpɔ wo la, woaʋuʋu ta.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Tete vɔvɔ̃ aɖo amewo katã, woaɖe gbe ƒã Mɔwu ƒe nuwɔwɔ, eye woadze si eƒe nuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Ha na henɔ la.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Mawu, kafukafuha edze wò le Zion, eye wòe woaxe adzɔgbeɖefe na.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Eɖoa to gbedodoɖa, gbɔwòe ŋutilãwo katã woayi.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Míaƒe vodadawo ɖo kpo ɖe mía dzi: ke ètsɔ míaƒe dzidadawo ke.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Woayra amesi nètia, eye nèna be, wòava nɔ wò xɔxɔnuwo! Míaɖu wò ate me nu nyuiwo aɖi ƒo le wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: amesi li kè towo zã le wò ŋusẽ me, eye nètsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzi,

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: amesi tsi ƒu me gbeɖeɖe, ƒutsotsoewo ƒe howɔwɔ kple dukɔwo ƒe dzidodo nu,

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋku anyigba dzi, eye nède tsu wòwu ko nɛ, tsi yɔ Mawu ƒe tɔʋu taŋ. Ena blii, eye ale nèwɔ anyigba lae enye si.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Ede tsi woƒe boliƒoivo, ègbã woƒe agble me nylglãwo hetsɔ tsidzadza bɔbɔwoe; èyra woƒe numiemiewo.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Lãnyiƒewo le gbegbe hã le ami tsyɔm, eye togbɛwo tsɔ aseyetsotso bla ali dzii.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Ha na henɔ la. Mí anyigbawo katã, mitso aseye na Mawu!

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe bubu, eye mido kɔkɔe eƒe kafukafu la!

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Migblɔ na Mawu be: Ŋɔdzi le wò dɔwɔwɔ ŋu loo! Le wò ŋusẽ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ta wò futɔwo avivi nu me na wò.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Anyigbawo katã ade ta agu na wò, eye woadzi kafukafuha na wò, woadzi kafukafuha na wò ŋkɔ. Sela.

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Miva, ne miakpɔ Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ; eya, amesi wɔ nu dziŋɔwo ɖe amegbetɔviwo ŋu!

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Etrɔ atsiaƒu wòzu ƒuƒuiƒe; afɔ wotsɔ tso tɔsisi lae; gama míekpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe eŋu le!

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Ele fia ɖum le eƒe ŋusẽ me tegbee, eƒe ŋku le tsatsam le dukɔwo dzi. Tosẽlawo megafɔ wo ɖokui ɖe dzi o! Sela.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo, mikafu mía Mawu la, eye mina eƒe kafukafu naɖi woase!

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi le míaƒe luʋɔ de agbe, eye meɖe ke le míaƒe afɔ te o.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Oo, Mawu, elabena èdo mí kpɔ, eye nèlòlo mí, abe alesi wolóloa klosalo ene.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Etsɔ mí de ɖɔ me, eye nèdro agba ɖe ali dzi na mí.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Ena amegbetɔwo nɔ míaƒe ta me; míedze dzo kple tɔ me, ke nèɖe mí do go heyi ablɔɖe mee.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Matsɔ numevɔsa ava aƒewò mee, ne maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe,

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Matsɔ alẽ damiwo asa numevɔ na wò akpe ɖe agbowo ƒe dzudzɔ lilili ŋu, matsɔ nyiwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo asa vɔ na wò. Sela.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Mi mawuvɔ̃lawo katã, miva, ne maxlẽ nusi wòwɔ na nye luʋɔ la, afia miase!

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Eya metsɔ nye nu do ɣli na, eye kafukafu le nye aɖe te na.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Ɖe wònye ɖe meɖo nu vɔ̃ɖi ɖe nye dzi me la, anye ne Aƒetɔ la gbe toɖoɖom.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu see, eye wòɖo to nye gbedodoɖa ƒe gbe.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu, amesi megbe nye gbedodoɖa o, eye mete eƒe amenuvevem o!

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: Mawu, ve mía nu, eye nayra mí, na wò mo naklẽ na mí, Sela,

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: ne woadze si wò mɔ le anyigba dzi kple wò xɔname le dukɔwo katã dome!

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Mawu, dukɔwo akafu wò, wòe dukɔwo katã woakafu.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzitɔwo akpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woatso aseye, elabena wòe drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dukɔwo ɖe eteƒe, eye wòe kplɔa anyigbadzitɔwo. Sela.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Mawu, dukɔwo akafu wò, wòe dukɔwo katã akafu.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Anyigba mie eƒe nukuwo. Mawu, mía Mawu la, ayra mí.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Ha na henɔ la, Dawid tɔ.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Mawu tso, eƒe futɔwo ka hlẽ, eye eƒe ketɔwo si le eŋku me.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Ke ame dzɔdzɔewo le dzidzɔ kpɔm, wole aseye tsom le Mawu ŋku me, eye wogli kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Mawu, midzi kafukafuha na eƒe ŋkɔ! Mita mɔ na amesi tso gbedzi gbɔna; Yehowae nye eŋkɔ, eye mitso aseye le eŋku me!

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Tsyuẽviwo fofo kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃la na ahosiwo nye Mawu le eƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Mawu, amesi kplɔa ame tsigbewo va aƒee, eye wòkplɔa gatɔwo yia dzɔgbenyuie mee; ke tosẽlawo atsi kuɖinyigba dzi.

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Mawu, esi nèho dze wò dukɔ ŋgɔ, eye nètsa le gbegbe la, Sela,

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: anyigba ʋuʋu, Sinai sia hã, le Mawu ŋku me, eye dziŋgɔ ge la le Mawu, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ŋku me.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Mawu, èna tsi geɖe wu de wò domenyinu la dzi, èdo ŋusẽe, esime ɖeɖi te eŋu belibeli.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Wò amehawo nɔ edzi afima, Mawu, wò dɔmenyo nètsɔ wɔe na hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ƒo nu, eye wòna nyɔnu du nyui xɔlawo de ha kpaŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Esi ŋusẽkatãtɔ la kaka fiawo me le afima la, sno dza ɖe Zalmon dzi.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe to enye Basan-towo, to tame tsutsuẽwo nye Basan-towo.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Mi to tame tsutsuẽwo, nukaŋuti miele to, si Mawu di be, yeatsɔ awɔ ye nɔƒee la, kpɔm ɖe ƒomevii? E, Yehowa anɔ afima tegbee!

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe tasiaɖamwo le akpe nane teƒe akpe. Aƒetɔ la le wo dome. Sinai ye le kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Edzo yi dzi me ʋi, èɖe amewo aboyoe, eye nèxɔ nunana le amegbetɔwo dome. Tosẽlawo hã anɔ Mawu Yehowa gbɔ.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ la gbeawotsyogbe! Eya, míaƒe xɔname ƒe Mawu la, le mía tsam. Sela.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Mawu enye míaƒe xɔname ƒe Mawu, eye Yehowa, Aƒetɔ la, nya mɔnu le bu ŋu.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Vavãe, Mawu agbã la na eƒe tutɔwo kple dzodome na amesiwo le yiyim le woƒe fɔɖiɖi me.

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be: Makplɔ wo atso Basan, eye makplɔ wo atso atsiaƒu gɔme,

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: ne woaklɔ woƒe afɔ ɖe ʋu me, eye woƒe avũwo ƒe aɖewo nakpɔ wo tɔ gome te woƒe futɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Mawu, wole wò azɔlime kpɔm, nye Mawu, nye fia, wole wò azɔlime kpɔm la kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Hadzilawo do ŋgɔ, saŋkuƒolawo xe megbe, eye ɖetugbi gakogoeƒolawo tsɔ wo ɖe dome.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Mikafu Mawu. Aƒetɔ la, le takpekpewo me, mi Israel ƒe agunuviwo!

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Benyamin, si nye dɔmlɔea, nye woƒe dziɖula, Yuda-amegãwo kple woƒe ame gbogboawo, Zebulon-amegãwo kple Naftali-amegãwo.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖo wò ŋusẽ te! Oo, Mawu, li ke nusi nèwɔ na mí la!

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Amegãwo atso Egipte ava, eye Kus aɖe abla aɖo asi ɖe dzi na Mawu.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Mi anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo, midzi ha na Mawu, midzi katukafuha na Aƒetɔ la! Sela.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi le yiyim le blemadziƒowo ƒe dziƒowo; kpɔ ɖa, ana eƒe gbe, si nye gbe sesẽ la, naɖi woase,

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Mitsɔ ŋusẽ na Mawu, eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le Israel dzi, eye eƒe ŋusẽ le alilikpowo me.

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe „Dzogbenya“ ƒe gbe nu.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: De ƒe agbi mim, afɔɖoƒe meli o, mege ɖe tɔ ƒe gogloƒe, eye tsi ɖɔ va to dzinye.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Meɖo ɣli nu ti kɔ nam, eye nye gbe me xe, mele mɔ kpɔm na nye Mawu ʋuu wòti nye ŋkuwo.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.
translation_verse: Mawu, enya nye bometsitsi, eye nye fɔɖiɖiwo meɣla ɖe wò o.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ. Yehowa Zebaot, ŋu megakpe amesiwo le mɔ kpɔm na wò la, le tanye o! Israel ƒe Mawu, amesiwo dia wò la, ƒe mo megatsi dã o!

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Elabena tawò mele vlododo tsom, eye ŋukpe tsyo nye mo ɖo.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋuʋaʋã ɖe wò aƒe ŋu mim, eye amesiwo le vlo dom wò la, ƒe vlodoame va dzinye.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Mefa avi, eye metsi nu dɔ, ke ŋukpe ko wozu nam.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Metsɔ akpanya wɔ nye avɔe, eye mezu hamelo na wo.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Amesiwo bɔbɔ nɔ agbo nu la, le nu ƒom le ŋunye, eye ahamulawo le ha dzim deyem.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Ke nyea medo gbe ɖa na wò, Yehowa, le amenuveɣi la; Mawu, tsɔ wò xɔname nyateƒetɔ la ɖo tom le wò amenuveve sɔgbɔ la nu!

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso agbi me, ne nyemagayi to o, ne mado tso nye ketɔwo si me kple tɔ goglowo me;

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: ne tsi magaɖɔ ato tanye o, ne gogloƒe magamim o, eye vudo magaxe eƒe nu ɖe nunye o!

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ɖo tom, Yehowa, elabena wò amenuveve la nyo; le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔgbɔ la nu trɔ ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Megaɣla wò mo ɖe wò dɔla o, elabena ŋɔdzi lém, netsɔ naɖo tom!

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Te ɖe nye luʋɔ ŋu, eye naxɔe; le nye futɔwo ta dem!

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Enya nye vlododo, ŋukpe kple dzo; ŋkuwò me nye ketɔwo katã le.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Vlododo gba nye dzi, eye wode dɔlã me nam; mekpɔ mɔ na babadoname, ke dzodzroa, eye na akɔfalawo, gake nyemekpɔ ɖeke o.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ veve nam be, maɖu, eye esi tsikɔ wum la, wokpe aha tsitsi nam.

english_verse: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
translation_verse: Woƒe kplɔ̃ netrɔ zu ɖɔ na wo, eye wòanye mɔ̃ na amesiwo ɖe dzi ɖi!

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Woƒe mo netsyɔ zi, ne womagakpɔ nu o, eye na woƒe ali nanɔ ʋaʋãm tegbee!

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dɔmedzoe kɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye wò dziku heliheli nelé wo!

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Woƒe agbletawo nezu aƒedo, eye amea ɖeke meganɔ woƒe agbadɔwo me o!

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Tsɔ fɔɖiɖi ƒu fɔɖiɖi dzi na wo, eye megana woade wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la gbɔ o.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Woatutu wo ɖa le agbalẽ la me, eye womegaŋlɔ wo kpe de ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu o!

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Ke nyea mele nublanui me, eye veve ɖi tsi de ŋunye, gake Mawu, wò xɔname akɔm ɖe dzi.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Matsɔ hadzidzi akafu Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ, eye matsɔ akpedada ado bubui.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Eya adze Yehowa ŋu wu nyitsu, si dzo le eta, eye eƒe afɔkli me fe.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Hiãtɔwo akpɔe, eye woɔkpɔ dzidzɔ. Mi amesiwo le Mawu dim la, miaƒe dzi negbɔ agbe!

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ɖoa to ame dahewo, eye medoa vlo eƒe gatɔwo o.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Dziƒo kple anyigba, atsiaƒu kpakple nusiwo katã ʋãna le eme, mikafui!

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu axɔ na Zion, eye wòatso Yuda-duwo, ne woana afima, eye woanye wo tɔ.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Dawid lɔ na henɔ la hena ŋkuɖoɖodzi.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm be: Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃! la, woatrɔ le woƒe ŋukpe la ta.

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã dia wò la, ƒe dzeme nekɔ, eye woakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋuwò; eye amesiwo lɔ̃a wò xɔname le, nenɔ gbɔgblɔm ɖaa be: Mawu lolo!

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Dawid lɔ na henɔ la hena ŋkuɖoɖodzi.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm be: Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃! la, woatrɔ le woƒe ŋukpe la ta.

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã dia wò la, ƒe dzeme nekɔ, eye woakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋuwò; eye amesiwo lɔ̃a wò xɔname le, nenɔ gbɔgblɔm ɖaa be: Mawu lolo!

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wòe mesi tso, megana ŋu nakpem akpɔ gbeɖe o!

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖem, eye na mado le eme; ƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye, eye naxɔ nam!

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Na woanye agakpeto nam, afisi masi ayi ɖaa; wò, amesi ɖo be, yeaxɔ nam; elabena nye agakpe kple nyee mɔ sesẽ nènye.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖi la si me, eye naɖem tso ame vlo la kple ŋutasẽla ƒe fego me!

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Elabena wòe nye nye mɔkpɔkpɔ, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, nye nusi ŋu meɖoa ŋu ɖo tso nye ɖevime ke!

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Ŋuwò meziɔ ɖo tso danye ƒe dɔ me ke, eye danye ƒe dɔ me nèɖem tsoe, nye kafukafu enye tɔwò ɖaa.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Nuku menye na ame geɖewo, ke wòe nye nye sitsoƒe sesẽ.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Nye nu me yɔ fũ kple wò kafukafu, nye ŋkekewo kple wò dodoɖedzi.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Megagbem le amegãkuɣi o, eye ne nye ŋusẽ nu yi la, megagblẽm ɖi o!

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm be: Mawu gblẽe ɖi, miti eyome, eye milée, elabena xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli o!

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mawu, meganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o, nye Mawu, netsɔ naxɔ nam!

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ŋu nekpe amesiwo lé fu nye luʋɔ la, eye wo nu neyi; vlododo kple ŋukpe nenyẽ tsyɔ amesiwo le nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e dim la!

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Ke nyea manɔ mɔkpɔkpɔ dzi daa, eye madzi wò kafukafu ɖe dzi.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Nye nu axlẽ wò dzɔdzɔenyenye afia, kple wò xɔname hã ɣesiaɣi; elabena womele xexlẽ me nam o.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Mado kple Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe nutsuwɔwɔwo, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖeɖeko mekafu.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Mawu, èfia num tso nye ɖevime ke, eye meɖe gbe ƒã wò nukunuwo vaseɖe fifi.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Eyata, Mawu, megagblẽm ɖi o vaseɖe nye amegãkuku kple nye wɔƒoƒo me, vaseɖe esime meɖe gbe ƒã wò alɔ na dzidzimeviwo kple wò ŋusẽ na megbeviwo katã!

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Mawu, wò dzɔdzɔenyenye kɔ de dziƒo ke; wò amesi wɔ nu gãwo, Mawu, amekae ɖe nuwò ma?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Wò amesi na míekpɔ hiã kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e geɖe la, wò kee agbɔ agbe mí, eye nahe mí tso anyigbatu me ke ava dzii.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Adzi nye gãnyenye ɖe dzi, eye agafa akɔ nam.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Ekema nye hã matsɔ saŋku akafu wò le wò nyateƒe la ta, nye Mawu; maƒo gakasaŋku na wò, wò Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Nye nuyiwo kple nye luʋɔ, si nèɖe la, atso aseye, ne mele saŋku ƒom na wò.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Nye aɖe hã aƒo nu le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋu daa; elabena ŋukpe le amesiwo di nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e la, eye woƒe mo tsi dã.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Salomo tɔ. Mawu, tsɔ wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ na fia la kple wò dzɔdzɔenyenye na flavi la!

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò dukɔ ɖe eteƒe kple wò hiãtɔwo alesi dze.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Towo kple togbɛwo netsɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye he ŋutifafa vɛ na dukɔ la!

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Atso afia na dukɔ la ƒe hiãtɔwo, axɔ na ame daheviwo, eye wòato ŋutasẽla nyanyanya.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Ekema woavɔ̃ wò, ŋkeke alesi ɣe kple ɣleti li, tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Aɖi ɖe anyi ahe tsidzadza ɖe gbe talãlàe dzi ene, abe tsi gãe ƒo anyigba ene.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Ekema ame dzɔdzɔe la amie le eƒe ŋkekewo me, eye ŋutifafa axɔ aƒe, vaseɖe esime dzinu maganɔ anyi o.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Aɖu fia tso atsiaƒu nu yi atsiaƒu nu, tso tɔsisi la nu ɖaseɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo ke.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Gbegbe nɔlawo adze klo ɖe eŋku me, eye eƒe futɔwo atu mo ke me.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarsis-fiawo kple ƒukpowo dzi fiawo atsa nunanawo vɛ, Saba-fiawo kple Seba-fiawo axe nudzɔdzɔ.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Fiawo katã aɖe ta agu nɛ, eye dukɔwo katã asubɔe.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Elabena aɖe ame dahe, si le ɣli dom, kple hiãtɔ, si xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli na o la.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Ave hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo nu, eye woade ame dahewo ƒe luʋɔ.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Aɖe woƒe luʋɔ tso teteɖeanyi kple ŋutasesẽ me, eye woƒe ʋu axɔ asi le eŋku me.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Anɔ agbe, eye woana Seba-sikae, woado gbe ɖa ɖe eta ɖaa, eye woakafui ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Bli aɖo kpekpekpe le anyigba dzi kple towo tame, eƒe agblemenuwo ado zi abe Libanon ene, eye woaƒo se le duwo me abe gbe le anyigba dzi ene.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkɔ anɔ anyi tegbetegbe; ŋkeke alesi ɣe li la, eƒe ŋkɔ amie, eye amewo atsɔe ayra wo nɔewoe; dukɔwo katã akafui.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa Mawu, Israel ƒe Mawu la, amesi ɖeɖe ko wɔ nukunuwo!

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Woakafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la tegbee! Eƒe bubu ayɔ anyigba blibo la dzi fũ! Nenɔ alea, ẽ, nenɔ alea!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Dawid, Isai vi la, ƒe gbedodoɖa wu nu.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe ha. Nyateƒee, Mawu ƒe dɔme nyo ɖe Israel ŋu, de amesiwo ƒe dzi dza la ŋu.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Elabena meʋã ŋu adegbeƒola, esi mekpɔ be, enyona na ame vɔ̃ɖi la.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Womesea vevea ɖeke vaseɖe ku me o, eye woƒe ƒodo da ami.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Eyata dada enye woƒe kɔdzonu, eye wotsyɔ ŋutasesẽ abe avɔ ene.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Woƒe ŋku do le ami me hɔ̃, eye woƒe dzimesusuwo do lululu.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Wole alɔme ɖem le nu ƒom le nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋuti, wole kɔkɔƒe le nu ƒom le tetedeanyi ŋuti do ɖa.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Wodoa woƒe nu de dziƒo, eye woƒe aɖe le tsatsam le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Eyata amewo kplɔa wo ɖo bibibi, eye wokplɔa tsi geɖe hlohlohlo.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Eye wole gbɔgblɔm be: Ɖe Mawu nyae, eye ɖe nunya le dziƒoʋitɔ la sia?

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, alea ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le, eye wolia kɔ kesinɔnuwo ɖi daa fuɖeɖea ɖeke makpɔmakpɔe.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, yakatsyɔe mene nye dzi ŋn dza, eye meklɔ nye asi ɖe fɔmaɖimaɖi me.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: E, mekpea tu gbesiagbe, eye nye tohehe li ŋdi sia ŋdi.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Ɖe nye hã megblɔ be, maƒo nu abe woawo ke ene la, anye ne meto vo ɖe viwòwo ƒe dzidzime ŋu.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Mebu tame, be madze si esia, hiãkame wònye le ŋkunye me,

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime mege de Mawu ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la, eye melé ŋku ɖe woƒe nuwuwu ŋu.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, ètsɔ wo ɖo ɖiɖiƒe, eye nèxlã wo ɖe anyi wozu anyiglãgo.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ale ŋɔdzi na wotsrɔ̃ le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me, wobu, eye wo nu yi!

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ne ènyɔ la, àdo vlo woƒe nɔnɔme abe drɔ̃ekuku le nyɔnyɔ megbe ene.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Esi dzi kum, eye nye ayikuwo ɖum la,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: mele abe bometsila ene, nunya mele tagbɔ nam o, eye meɖi lã le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Ke mele gbɔwò ɖaa, eye nèlé nye nuɖusi ɖe asi.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Akplɔm le wò adaŋudede la nu, eye emegbe àxɔm ɖe gbɔwò kple bubu.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Amekae le dziƒo nam? Nyemele naneke dim le anyigba dzi kpe ɖe ŋuwò o.
