english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Ne nye ŋutilã kple nye dzi nu yi hã, Mawue nye nye dzi ƒe sitsoƒe kple nye gome tegbee.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo te ɖe aga le ŋuwò la, woegblẽ; àtsrɔ̃ amesiwo katã trɔ ʋu le yowòme la.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, Mawu ƒe gbɔnyenɔnɔ enye nye dzidzɔ; meɖo ŋu ke Aƒetɔ Yehowa ŋu, ne maxlẽ eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã afia.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe nufiameha. Mawu, nukaŋuti nègbe mí ɖikaa, eye wò dɔmedzoe le adzudzɔ tum ɖe wò lãnyiƒe ƒe lãhɔwo ŋu?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò ameha, si nèxɔ ƒle le blema, eye nèɖe, be natsɔ awɔ domenyinu na ɖokuiwò, kple Zion-to, si dzi nèle la dzi!

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: De wò afɔ yi gli gbagbã ɖikaɖikawo gbɔ! Futɔ la gblẽ nuwo katã le kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Wò ketɔwo le xɔxlɔ̃m le wò takpeƒewo titina, eye woɖo woƒe dzesiwo, ne woanye dzesiwo.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Ele abe amea ɖe, si kɔ fia dzi le ave dodo me,

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ fia kple zu gbã eƒe ati, siwo katã ŋu wowɔ aɖaŋu do la ene.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Wotɔ dzo wò kɔkɔeƒe la, wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na wò ŋkɔ ƒe nɔƒe la vaseɖe anyigba ke,

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: hele gbɔgblɔm le woƒe dzi me be: Mina míate wo katã ɖe anyi! Wotɔ dzo takpeƒe kɔkɔewo katã.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Míele míaƒe dzesiwo kpɔm o; nyagblɔɖilaa ɖeke megali o, eye amea ɖeke mele mía dome anya ɣesiɣi wòava ase ɖo o.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Mawu, ɣekaɣi ketɔ la anɔ vlo dom, eye futɔ la anɔ alɔme ɖem le wò ŋkɔ ŋu ɖikaa ase do?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèhe wò asi kple wò nuɖusi de megbe? Doe ɖa tso wò akɔnu nagblẽ nu!

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Ke Mawue nye fianye tso blema ke, amesi wɔ xɔnamedɔwo le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wò ŋusẽ mã atsiaƒu me ɖe eve, eye nègbã bosowo ƒe ta le tɔwo dzi.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Egbã lo ƒe ta, eye nètsɔe wɔ nuɖuɖu na gbegbenɔlawo ƒe amehawo.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Wòe na tsidzɔƒewo kple lɔʋuwo si, eye nèna tɔsisi gãwo mie.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Tɔwòe nye ŋkeke, eye tɔwòe nye zã, wòe ɖo kekeli kple ɣe.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Wòe de anyigba ƒe liƒowo katã, eye wòe wɔ dzomeŋɔli kple vuvɔŋɔli.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, do ŋui be, wòe futɔ la do vloe, eye wò ŋkɔ ŋu dukɔ bometsila la ɖe alɔme le!

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Megatsɔ wò akpakpa ƒe luʋɔ de asi na gbemelãwo o, eye megaŋlɔ wò hiãtɔwo ƒe agbe be ɖikaa o!

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku nubabla la dzi! Elabena ŋutasesẽ ƒe nɔƒewo yɔ anyigba ƒe ɣaɣlɛƒewo fũ.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Megana amesi wote de anyi la, natrɔ kple ŋukpe o! Hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo akafu wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Mawu, tso, nawɔ wò aʋa! Ɖo ŋu alɔme, si bometsilawo le ɖeɖem le ŋuwò atraɖi la!

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Megagblẽ nu o! Hadzidzi, Asaf ƒe ha na henɔ la.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Elabena ne ɣeyiɣi, si meɖo, de la, madrɔ̃ nɔnu ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Ne anyigba kple edzi nɔlawo katã lolo hã, nyee li ke eƒe sɔtiwo. Sela.

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Megblɔ na adegbeƒolawo be: Miganɔ adegbe ƒom o! eye na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo be: Migakɔ miaƒe dzo dzi o!

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Migaka míaƒe dzo ɖe dzi o, eye migalia kɔ anɔ nya baɖa gblɔm o!

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Elabena menye ɣedzeƒe alo ɣetoɖoƒe alo gbedzie dodoɖedzi tsona o,

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Elabena kplu le Yehowa si, wein le fu tem le eme, eye aha tɔtɔ yɔe banaa; eku aha tso me, anyigba dzi ame vɔ̃ɖiwo akplɔ keke ahaƒã ke hã, eye woanoe ƒiaƒiaƒia.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Ke nye la matsɔe aɖe gbe ƒãe tegbee, eye madzi kafukafuha na Yakob ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Hadzidzi. Asaf ƒe ha na kasaŋkuwo ƒe henɔ.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Wonya Mawu le Yuda, eƒe ŋkɔ lolo le Israel;

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: eƒe agbadɔ le Salem, eye eƒe nɔƒe le Zion.

english_verse: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.
translation_verse: Gama wòŋe aŋutrɔ, akpoxɔnu kple yi, eye wòna aʋawɔwɔ nu tsi le. Sela.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Woha nu le kalẽtɔ dziƒowo ŋu, eye woyi alɔ̃ me ʋi; ŋutsuwɔlawo kalã meganya afika woƒe alɔ le o.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe Mawu, le wò bublu la nu luʋɔ dzo le aʋawɔtasiaɖamwo kple sɔwo siaa ta.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Wò la, ŋɔdzi le ŋuwò, eye ameka anɔ te de nuwò, ne dzi ku wòa?

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: Ena wose wò afiatsogbe tso dziƒo; dzika tso anyigba ƒo, eye ɖoɖoe zi le eŋu;

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: esime Mawu tso ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu, ne wòaxɔ na anyigba dzi hiãtɔwo katã. Sela.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔwo ƒe dɔmedzoe anye kafukafu na wò, eye dɔmedzoe ƒe susɔea natsɔ abla ati dzii.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Miɖe adzɔgbe, eye miwɔ edzi na Yehowa, mia Mawu la! Mi amesiwo le eŋu godoo la, mitsɔ nunanawo vɛ na amesi ŋu ŋɔdzi le!

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe ha na henɔ Yedutun.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Mekɔ gbe dzi na Mawu, eye mele ɣli dom; Mawue mekɔ gbe dzi na, ɖo tom!

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Mele ŋu ɖom Mawu hele hũ ɖem; mele ŋugble dem, eye nu ti kɔ na nye gbɔgbɔ. Sela.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Eke nye ŋkuyiwo ɖe te, metsi dzodzodzoe, eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖem.

english_verse: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:
translation_verse: Mele blema ŋkekewo kple gbaɖegbe ƒewo ŋu bum.

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Ɖe Aƒetɔ la agbe ame tegbee, eye magave ame nu oa?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Ɖe eƒe amenuveve nu yi ɖikaa, eye ɖe eƒe ŋugbedodo nu tsi na dzidzimewo katã?

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋku dzo le edzi be, wòave ame nua? eye ɖe wòdo ʋɔ ɖe eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ nu le dziku mea? Sela.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Mebe: Nye kokoƒoƒo enye be, dziƒoʋitɔ la ƒe nuɖusi netrɔ!

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nuwɔwɔwo anɔ ŋku dzi nam, ẽ, maɖo ŋkuwò blemanukunuwo dzi.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Mabu tame le wò nuwɔwɔwo katã ŋu, eye made ŋugble le wò dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Mawu, wò mɔ le kɔkɔe, Mawu kae lolo abe wò Mawu ene?

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Wòe nye Mawu, amesi wɔ nukunuwo, èɖe wò ŋusẽ fia le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Etsɔ abɔ sesẽ ɖe wò dukɔ la, Yakob-viwo kple Yosef-viwo. Sela.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Mawu, tsiwo kpɔ wò; esi tsiawo kpɔ wò la, ŋɔdzi lé wo, eye tɔwo gɔme dzo kpekpekpe.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Alilikpo ɖuɖu tsi, dziŋgɔ ɖe gbe, eye wò aŋutrɔwo va yi.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Wò gbeɖeɖe ɖi le yali me, dzikedzo ke dzo ɖe xexeame; anyigba ʋuʋu, eye wòdzo nyanyanya.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Wò mɔ le atsiaƒuwo me, wò toƒe le tɔ geɖewo me eye womedze si wò afɔʋeewo o.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe nufiameha. Nye dukɔ, mise nye nufiame; miƒu le anyi ɖe nye nu me nyawo ŋu!

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Make nye nu kple lododowo, eye mate blemadzowo.

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: Nusi miese, míenya, eye mía fofowo tsɔ da xo na mi la,

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: míaɣlae de wo viwo o, eye míaxlẽ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔxɔxɔ kple eƒe ŋusẽ kpakple nukunu, siwo wòwɔ la, afia megbeviwo.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Etu se anyi ɖe Yakob, eye wòɖo nufiame anyi de Israel, siwo ŋu wòde se na mía fofowo le be, woafia wo wo viwo,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: ne woƒe ƒome megbetɔwo, ɖevi, siwo dzi ge woala la, nanyae, eye woatso ɖe tsitre axlẽe afia wo viwo,

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: ne woaɖo ŋu de Mawu ŋu, eye womaŋlɔ Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo be o, ke boŋ woalé eƒe sewo me de asi,

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: ne womaganɔ abe wo fofowo, ƒome sẽto dzeaglã, ƒome, si ƒe dzi meli ke o, eye eƒe gbɔgbɔ meku ɖe Mawu ŋu le nyateƒe me o la ene o.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Efrayim-viwo, aŋutrɔdala, siwo bla akpa la, de megbe le aʋawɔgbe;

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: womelé Mawu ƒe nubabla la me de asi o, eye wogbe zɔzɔ de eƒe seawo nu,

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: eye woƒe ŋku dzo le eƒe nuwɔwɔwo kple eƒe nukunu, siwo wòna wokpɔ la dzi.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nukunuwo le wo fofowo ŋku me le Egipte-nyigba dzi, le Zoan-tagba.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Emã atsiaƒu me ɖe eve, eye wòna woto eme, ena tsiwo dzɔ kã abe gli ene,

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke me la etsɔ alilikpo kplɔ woe, eye le zã blibo la me la etsɔ dzo keklẽ.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Efe agakpe me le gbedzi, eye wòna tsi wo kpaŋkpaŋ wono.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ena tsi, si tso agakpewo me, eye tsi do bababa abe tɔsisi gãwo ene.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ke woyi dzi gawɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe eŋu, eye wodze aglã ɖe dziƒoʋitɔ la ŋu le kuɖinyigba dzi.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Wote Mawu kpɔ le woƒe dziwo me hebia nuɖuɖu na woƒe nudzodzro,

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: eye woƒo nu ɖe Mawu ŋu gblɔ bena: Ɖe Mawu ate ŋu aɖo kplɔ̃ de gbedzi loo?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eƒo agakpe, tsi do, eye tɔʋuwo si bababa; ɖe wòate ŋu ana abolo alo lã hã eƒe dukɔ loo?

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eyata esi Yehowa see la, dzi kui, dzo bi de Yakob ŋu, eye dɔmedzoe de dzi ɖe Israel ŋu.

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: Elabena womexɔ Mawu dzi se o, eye womeɖo dzi ɖe eƒe xɔname ŋu o.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Eye wòde se na alilikpowo le dzi me, enu dziƒo nu,

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: eye mana dza, ne woaɖu; ẽ, dziƒobli wòna wo,

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: mawudɔlawo ƒe abolo amegbetɔ ɖu, eye wòna nuɖudu woɖu ɖi ƒo.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ena ɣedzeƒeya ƒo le dziƒo ŋu, eye wòtsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ kplɔ dzieheya vɛ.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ena lã dza ɖe wo dzi abe ʋuʋudedi ene kple xewo abe ƒutake ene.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Ena woge dze woƒe asaɖa titina ƒo xlã woƒe nɔƒewo.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Ale wuɖui ɖi ƒo taŋ, eye wòwɔ woƒe dzodzro dzi na wo.

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: tete Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe de dzi ɖe wo ŋu, ewu amewo le woƒe amidalawo dome, eye wòƒo Israel-ɖekakpuiwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Ke to nusiawo katã gbɔ hã wogawɔ nuvɔ̃ yi dzi, eye womexɔ eƒe nukunuwo dzi se o.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Eyata wòna woƒe ŋkekewo bu ɖe gbahlaya me kple woƒe ƒewo ɖe ŋɔdzi me.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Ne ewu wo la, wobiaa ete sena, eye wotrɔna hedia Mawu;

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: woɖoa ŋku edzi be, Mawue nye yewoƒe agakpe, eye Mawu, dziƒoʋitɔ la, enye yewoƒe xɔnametɔ.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Wovivi nume nɛ kple woƒe nu, eye wotsɔ woƒe aɖe da alakpa nɛ;

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Ke eya la nublanuikpɔla wònye, etsɔa vodada kena, eye metsrɔ̃a ame o; eɖoa asi eƒe dɔmedzoe dzi zi geɖe, eye meɖea esi le eƒe dziku katã ŋu o.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Eɖoa ŋku edzi be, ŋutilã wonye, ƒuƒu, si yina, eye megatrɔna gbɔna o la, wonye.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Zi nenie womehedze aglã ɖe eŋu le gbeadzi, eye womedo dziku nɛ le gbedadaƒo o!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Wole Mawu tetekpɔ dzi ɖaa, eye wodo dziku na Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Womeɖo ŋku eƒe asi dzi le gbesigbe wòɖe wo tso ketɔ la si me,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: esime wòwɔ eƒe dzesiwo le Egipte kple eƒe nukunuwo le Zoan-tagba la o.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ene woƒe tɔsisiwo trɔ zu ʋu, eye womete ŋu nowoƒe tɔʋuwo o.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Eɖo togbatowo ɖe wo dome woɖu wo, kple ekpɔkplɔwo wogblẽ wo.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Etsɔ woƒe numiemiewo na ʋetrawo kple woƒe agblemenuwo na ʋetsuviwo.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Eto woƒe weinkawo nyanyanya kple dzikpe, eye woƒe gbotiwo kple ketsi.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Etsɔ woƒe lãwo na dzikpe kple woƒe lãhawo na dzikedzo.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe dɔmedzoe heliheli, nyanyrã, dziku kple xaxa ɖe wo, siwo nye dɔla vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ha.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Eɖe mɔ na eƒe dɔmedzoe, meɖe woƒe luʋɔ tso ku nu o, eye wòtsɔ woƒe agbe de asi na ɖɔvɔ̃.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: Eye wòwu woƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo katã le Egipte, woƒe ŋuse ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo le Xam ƒe agbadɔwo me.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Ena eƒe dukɔ ho abe alẽwo ene, eye wòkplɔ wo le gbedzi abe lãhawo ene.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo dedie, be womevɔ̃ o; ke woƒe tutɔwo la atsiaƒu nyẽ tsyɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔ wo va eƒe anyigba kɔkɔe la dzi, va to, si eƒe nuɖusi xɔ la gbɔe.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Enyã dukɔwo le wo ŋgɔ, eye wòdzidze nu ɖe edzi na wo, ne wòanye wo tɔ, eye Israel-toawo nɔ woƒe agbadɔwo me.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ke wote Mawu, dziƒoʋitɔ la kpɔ, wodze aglã, eye womelé eƒe seawo me ɖe esi o.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Wote ɖe megbe, eye womeɖi anukware o abe wo fofowo ke ene, woƒo asa abe dati doagblɔ ene.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe nuxeƒewo do dziku nɛ, eye woƒe legbawo wotsɔ do adãe.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Mawu see, dzi kui, egbe Israel keŋkeŋ,

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: eye wògblẽ nɔƒe, si le Silo, agbadɔ, si wòtu ɖe amegbetɔwo dome la ɖi.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ de aboyo me, eye wòtsɔ eƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo de asi na ketɔ te

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Etsɔ ete dukɔ de asi na yi, eye dzi kui ɖe eƒe ɖomenyinu ŋu.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Dzo fiã eƒe ɖekakpuiwo, eye womedzi srɔ̃ɖeha na eƒe ɖetugbiwo o.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Eƒe nunɔlawo tsi yi nu, eye avi bu ɖe eƒe ahosiwo.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ la nyɔ abe alɔ̃dɔla ene, abe kɔlẽtɔ, si wein na wòle aseye tsom ene,

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: eye wònyã eƒe futɔwo ɖe megbe; ŋukpe mavɔe wòdo wo.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ke edo vlo Yosef ƒe agbadɔ, eye metia Efrayim-to la o,

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: ke boŋ etia Yuda-to la, Zion-to, si wòlɔ̃na.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Eye wotu eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la abe dziŋgɔli ene, abe anyigba, si gɔme wóɖo anyi tegbee ene.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Etia eƒe dɔla Dawid, eye wòkplɔe mo alẽkpɔwo gbɔe;

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: eɖee le alẽ vinɔwo yome, ne wòakplɔ ele dukɔ Yakob kple eƒe domenyinu Israel.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ wo dzi le eƒe dzi dzɔdzoe nu, eye wòtsɔ asi dzeaɖaŋu kplɔ woe.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Asaƒ ƒe ha. Mawu, dukɔwo nye zi de wò domenyinu dzi, wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la, eye wotsɔ Yerusalem wɔ anyiglãgoe.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ wò dɔlawo ƒe kukuawo na dziƒoxewo, ne woaɖu, kple wò ame kɔkɔewo ƒe lã na gbemelãwo.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Wokɔ woƒe nu ɖe Yerusalem ŋu goɖoo abe tsi ene, eye amea ɖeke meli aɖi wo o.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Míezu ŋukpe na míaƒe aƒelikawo kple alɔmeɖenu kpakple vlododo na amesiwo ƒo xlã mi?

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɣekaɣi nado dziku ɖaa ase ɖo, eye wò ŋuʋaʋã nabi abe dzo ene?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dziku heliheli la kɔ ɖe dukɔ, siwo menya wò o, kpakple fiaɖuƒe, siwo meyɔ wò ŋkɔ o la dzi!

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Elabena womi Yakob, eye wodo aƒedo enɔƒewo.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Megaɖi tsãtɔwo ƒe vodadawo na mí o! Netsɔ, nakpɔ nublanui na mí, elabena míegbɔdzɔ ŋutɔ!

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Mía xɔname ƒe Mawu, xɔ na mi le wò ŋkɔ ƒe bubu la ta; ɖe mí, eye natsɔ mía nuvɔ̃wo ke mí le wò ŋkɔ la ta!

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti dukɔwo anɔ gbɔgblɔm be: Afika woƒe Mawu la le? Wò dɔlawo ƒe ʋu, si wokɔ ɖe anyi, ƒe hlɔ̃biabia nedze le mía ŋku me ɖe dukɔwo ŋu!

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Gatɔwo ƒe ŋeŋe nede gbɔwò! Le wò alɔ ƒe sesẽ la nu na kuviwo nakpɔtɔ ɖi!

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Oo, Aƒetɔ, ɖo míaƒe aƒelikawo ƒe vlo, si wodo wò la, teƒe ɖe akɔnu na wo zi adre!

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Ke mí, wò dukɔ kple wò lãnyiƒe ƒe alẽwo, míada akpe na wò tegbee, eye míaxlẽ wò ŋkɔxɔxɔ afia le dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe „dzogbenya ƒe ɖasediɖi“ ƒe gbe nu.

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Wò, Israel kplɔla, see! Wò, amesi kpɔ Yosef dzi abe alẽ ene, eye nèbɔbɔ nɔ kerubiwo dzi gli la, do!

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Na wò ŋusẽ nana azɔli dzi le Efrayim, Benyamin kple Manase ŋgɔ, eye ya xɔ na mí!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Mawu, gaɖo mí te, na wò ŋku me naklẽ, ne míakpɔ xɔname!

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot, ɣeka ɣi nado dziku ɖe wò dukɔ ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu ase ɖo?

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Ena aɖatsibolo wo woɖu, eye nèna aɖatsi wo taŋtaŋ wono.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Etsɔ mí ɖo dzrenui na míaƒe aƒelikawo, eye míaƒe futɔwo le alɔme ɖem.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Mawu Zebaot, gaɖo mí te, na wò ŋku me naklẽ, ne míakpɔ xɔname!

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Eho weinka tso Egipte, eye nènyã dukɔwo ɖa hetsɔe do.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Edzra eŋu ɖo, eye wòɖe ke hexɔ anyigba.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Eƒe vɔvɔli do ɖe towo dzi, eye wòɖe alɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe sedertiwo ŋu.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Eɖe alɔ do keke atsiaƒu nu ke, eye eƒe ɖɔ de tɔsisi la nu.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèvuvu kpɔ le eŋu, be amesiwo katã to mɔ dzi yina la, nanɔ ekem?

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Mawu Zebaot, trɔ dzro, do kɔ ɖa tso dziƒo, kpɔ nu, eye galé ŋku ɖe weinka sia,

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: kple alɔ, si wò nuɖusi tsɔ ɖo, kpakple dzedze, si dzi nèkpɔ wòtsi la ŋu!

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Dzo fiã wo, wolã wo, eye wò ŋku me ŋɔdzidodo na wotsrɔ̃.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Wò asi nenɔ wò nuɖusi ƒe ame kple amegbetɔvi, si dzi nèkpɔ wòtsi la ŋu,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: ekema míate ɖa le ŋuwò o! Gbɔ agbe mí, eye míayɔ wò ŋkɔ!

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Asaf tɔ na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe Gat-viwo tɔ nu.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Migli kple dzidzɔ ɖe Mawu, si nye míaƒe ŋusẽ la ŋu, eye mitso aseye ɖe Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋu!

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Mixe ha, mina axatsɛwo, gakasaŋku kple saŋku viviwo naɖi!

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Miku kpẽ le dzinu yeye dzi, eye ne dzinu sɔ tegblẽ le míaƒe ŋkekenyuieɖugbe!

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: Esime wòho de Egipte-nyigba ŋu la, etsɔe wɔ see na Yosef. Gbe, si nyemenya o la, di mese be:

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Meɖe agba ɖa le eƒe abɔta, eye eƒe asi ɖe ɖa le tsikpo ŋu.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Eyɔm le xaxa me, eye mexɔ na wò, meɖo to wò le dziɖegbelilikpo me, eye medo wò kpɔ le dzrewɔtsi la gbɔ. Sela.

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, see; Israel, maxlɔ̃ nu wò, be aɖo tom loo!

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Mawu tutɔa ɖeke meganɔ asiwo o, eye megado gbe ɖa na mawu bubuwo o!

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, wò Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi. Ke wò nu baa, ne made nu eme na wò taŋ!

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Ke nye dukɔ meɖo to nye gbe o, eye Israel melɔ̃ edzi nam o.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Eyata meɖe asi le wo ŋu ɖe woƒe dzimesesẽ la me, ne woazɔ ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo la nu.

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe wònye ɖe nye dukɔ ɖo tom, eye Israel zɔ nye mɔwo dzi la,

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: anye ne asusɔ vie ko mabɔbɔ woƒe futɔwo ɖe anyi, eye matrɔ nye asi ɖe wote ketɔwo ŋu;

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: anye ne Yehowa ƒe adikãtɔwo avivi nu me na wo, eye woƒe ɣeyiɣi anɔ anyi tegbee;

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe ha. Mawu tsi tre ɖe Mawu ƒe ha la me, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le mawuwo dome.

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: Ɣekayi miadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu madzɔmadzɔ ase do, eye miade ame vɔ̃ɖi la dzi? Sela.

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame tsɛwo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo ɖe eteƒe, eye mitso na hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo!

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Mixɔ na ame tsɛwo kple ame dahawo, eye midu wo le ame vɔ̃ɖi la si!

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Womedze sii o, eye womenyae o, wole zɔzɔm le viviti me, eye anyigba ƒe agunuwo katã le ʋaʋãm.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Nyee gblɔ be: Mawuwo mienye, eye dziƒoʋitɔ la ƒe viwo mi katã mienye!

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Ke miaku abe amegbetɔwo ene, eye miatsi aʋa abe amegãwo dometɔ ɖeka ene.

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Mawu, tso, nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu anyigba, elabena wòe nye dukɔwo katã ƒe domenyila!

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖoɖoe megazi le ŋuwò o, Mawu, megazi kpi o, eye megaɖo ho to o!

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, wò futɔwo nyrã, eye wò ketɔwo kɔ ta dzi.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Wole tame ɖom le aye me de wò dukɔ ŋu, eye wole adaŋu dem ɖe wò amesiwo nèɣla la ŋu.

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm be: Miva, míatsrɔ wo, ne womaganye dukɔ o, eye ne womagaɖo ŋku Israel ƒe ŋkɔ dzi azɔ o!

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Wode adaŋu nu ɖekɛ, ŋuwò wobla nu ɖo:

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Edom ƒe agbadɔwo kple Ismaeltɔwo, Moabtɔwo kple Hagaritɔwo,

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Gebal, Amon, Amalek, Filistitɔwo kple Tirotɔwo.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Asur hã ɖe wo dzi, woawoe nye Lot-viwo ƒe alɔ. Sela.

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: Wɔ wo abe Midiantɔwo kple Sisera ene, abe Yabin le Kison-tɔʋu la nu ene!

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Wotsrɔ̃ le Endor, eye wozu aɖu na anyigba.

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: Wɔ woƒe amegãwo abe Oreb kple Zeeb ene, eye woƒe aʋafiawo katã ahe Zebax kple Zalmuna ene;

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: wo, amesiwo gblɔ be: Miaxɔ Mawu ƒe nɔƒewo na mía ɖokui!

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, wɔ wo abe yali ene, eye abe gbe ƒuƒu le ya nu ene!

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: Alesi dzo bia ave, eye dzo ƒe ade tɔa dzo towoe la,

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: nenema natsɔ wò ya ʋuduʋudu ati wo yomee, eye nado dzikatsoƒoe na wo kple wò ahom!

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: De ŋukpe mo na wo fũ, ne woadi wò ŋkɔ, Yehowa!

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Ŋu akpe wo, eye ŋɔ adzi wo tegbee, woƒe mo atsi dã, eye woatsrɔ̃,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Korax-viwo ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe Gat-viwo tɔ nu.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe xɔxɔnuwo le nye luʋɔ dzrom yi ɖe menye ke; nye dzi kple nye ŋutilã le aseye tsom de Mawu gbagbe la ŋu.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Xevi kpɔ aƒe, eye sagbadre kpɔ atɔ na eɖokui, afisi wòatsɔ viawo aɖoe, eye nye wò vɔsamlekpuiwo, Yehowa Zebaot, nanye kple Mawunye.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo le aƒewò me la; woakafu wò ɖaa. Sela.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Woayra amegbetɔ, siwo ƒe ŋusẽ le mewò, amesiwo ƒe dziwo le Zion mɔtatawo ŋu.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Ne woto aɖatsibali me la, wowɔnɛ wòzua tsidzɔƒe; eye aɖatsi tsɔa yayra ɖoa atsyɔ̃ na.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Wole azɔli dzi, woƒe ŋusẽ le gã dom ɖe dzi, wova do ɖe Mawu ŋku me le Zion.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot, ɖo to nye gbedodoɖa, Yakob ƒe Mawu, see! Sela.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Mawu, mía akpoxɔnu, kpɔ nu, eye nalé ŋku ɖe wò amesiamina la ƒe mo!

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋkeke akpe mede wò xɔxɔnu nɔnɔ ŋkeke ɖeka nu o, melɔ̃ be, matsi tre ɖe kpui nu le nye Mawu ƒe me, wu esi manɔ eme vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe agbaɖɔ me.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Yehowa, eve wò anyigba nu, eye nègaɖo Yakob te,

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: ètsɔ wò dukɔ la ƒe vodada ke wo, eye nètsyɔ nu woƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã dzi; Sela,

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: èdzudzɔ wò dzikudodowo katã, eye nèɖe asi le wò dziku heliheli la ŋu.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Gatrɔ ɖe mía ŋu, mía xɔname Mawu, eye nadzudzɔ wò adãwɔwɔ ɖe mía ŋu!

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Ɖe ànɔ dɔmedzoe dom ɖe mía ŋu ɖikaa, eye nanɔ wò dziku didim ɖe nu tso dzidzime yi dzidzimea?

english_verse: Show us your love and save us!
translation_verse: Ɖe màgagbɔ agbe mí, ne wò dukɔ nakpɔ dzidzɔ de ŋuwò oa?

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Yehowa, na míakpɔ wò amenuveve, eye na wò xɔname mi!

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Mase nusi gblɔ ge Mawu Yehowa ala; elabena agblɔŋutifafa na eƒe dukɔ kple eƒe mawumemewo, eye malɔ̃ be, woagatrɔ ɖe bometsitsi ŋu o.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, eƒe xɔname tsɔ ɖe amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la gbɔ, ne bubu nanɔ míaƒe anyigba ŋu.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple nyateƒe ado go wo nɔewo; dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ŋutifafa agbugbɔ nu na wo nɔewo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe amie tso anyigba me, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye ado mo ɖa tso dziƒo.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Yehowa ana nu nyui hã, eye míaƒe anyigba ame eƒe ku.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe gbedodoɖa. Yehowa, ƒu to anyi, eye naɖo tom, elabena hiã tum, eye mede ahe.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye luʋɔ ta, elabena ame kɔkɔe menye; nye Mawu, xɔ na wò dɔla, si ɖoa dzi ɖe ŋuwò la!

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ve nunye, elabena wò yɔm mele gbawotsyogbe.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Do dzidzɔ na wò dɔla ƒe luʋɔ, elabena Aƒeto, wòe mekɔ nye luʋɔ dzi na!

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Elabena Aƒetɔ, wò dɔme nyo, eye nèlɔ̃a tsɔtsɔke; amenuveve bɔ ɖe asiwò na amesiwo katã yɔa wò la.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Yehowa, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye nalé to ɖe nye kokoƒogbe ŋu!

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Mayɔ wò le nye xaxagbe, elabena àɖo tom.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mede nuwo le mawuwo dome o, eye naneke mede wò dɔwɔwɔwo nu o.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, dukɔ, siwo katã nèwɔ la, ava de ta agu na wò, eye woade bubu wò ŋkɔ ŋu.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Elabena èlolo, eye nèwɔa nukunuwo; wò ɖeɖe koe nye Mawu.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Yehowa, fia wò mɔm, ne mazɔ le wò nyateƒe la me; tsa nye dzi ɖo nu ɖeka kolia ŋu, ne mava wò ŋkɔ!

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Makafu wò Aƒetɔ Mawu tso dzi blibo me, eye made bubu wò ŋkɔ ŋu ɖaa.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Elabena wò amenuveve sɔ gbɔ ɖe dzinye, eye nèɖe nye luʋɔ tso keke tsiẽƒe ʋi ke.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Mawu, dadalawo tso de ŋunye, eye ŋutasẽlawo ƒe ha le nye agbe yome tim, eye womele buwòm ɖa o.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Aƒetɔ la, Mawu nublanuikpɔla kple amenuvela nènye, ègbɔa dzi blewu, eye amenuveve kple nyateƒe bɔ ɖe asiwò.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye nave nunye, na wò ŋusẽ wò dɔla, eye naxɔ na wò dɔlanyɔnu vi!

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Wɔ dzesi le ŋunye hena nyui, ne nye ketɔwo nakpɔe, ŋu nakpe wo, elabena wò Yehowae kpe ɖe ŋunye, eye nèfa akɔ nam.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Hadzidzi; Korax-viwo ƒe ha. Eƒe agunu le to kɔkɔewo dzi.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɔ̃a Zion ƒe agbowo wu nɔƒewo katã le Yakob.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe du, nya nyui wogblɔ de ŋuwò. Sela.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Meyɔ Raxab kple Babel be, wonye amesiwo nyam; kpɔ ɖa, Filistitɔwo, Tiro kple Kus la, afima wodzi wo ɖo.

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Ke woagblɔ le Zion ŋu be: Eya me wodzi amesiame ɖo, eye eya dziƒoʋitɔ la li kee.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Ne Yehowa le dukɔwo ɖem agbalẽ me la, axlẽ wo be, afima wodzi wo ɖo. Sela.

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Hadzilawo kple ɣeɖulawo agblɔ be: „Nye susuwo katã le dziwò.“

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Hadzidzi. Korax-viwo ƒe ha na henɔ la, ne woadzi ɖe „Dɔléle“ ƒe gbe nu. Heman tso Ezrax-viwo dome ƒe nufiameha.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Nye gbedodoɖa neva ŋkuwò me, eye naƒu to anyi de nye kokoƒoƒo ŋu!

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Elabena fukpekpe ɖi ƒo na nyee luʋɔ, eye nye agbe te ɖe tsiẽƒe ŋu.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Wobum ɖe amesiwo yi aʋli me le dome, eye mele abe ŋutsu gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ ene.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Etsɔm ɖe aʋli me ƒe do kple viviti me kpakple atsiaƒu ƒe gogloƒe.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Wò dziku le dzinye, eye wò ƒutsotsoewo tem de to. Sela.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ede nye ame nyanyɛwo ɖa le ŋunye, eye nètsɔm ɖo ŋunyɔnui na wo, èdo ʋɔ ɖe nunye, dodo meli nam o.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Hiã ti kɔ na nye ŋku; meyɔ wò, Yehowa, gbawotsyogbe ye meke nye abɔ na wò.

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ɖe àwɔ nukunu ɖe ame kukuwo ŋua? Alo ɖe ŋɔliwo afɔ akafu wòa? Sela.

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: De woaxlẽ wò amenuveve afia le yɔdo me kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le tsiẽƒea?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Ke nyea medo ɣii na wò, eye ŋdi la nye gbedodoɖa va ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nukaŋuti nètu asi nye luʋɔ ɖa, eye néɣla wò ŋku me ɖem?

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Hiãtɔ menye, eye mele kukum tso ɖevime ke: wò ŋɔdzidodowo le kpeyem, eye melulu.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Wò dɔmedzoe heliheli va to dzinye, wò ŋɔdzidonamewo tsrɔ̃m.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Woɖe to ɖem atraɖi abe tsi ene, wo katã tim ɖe to ɖem.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Madzi ha le Mawu ƒe amenuveve ŋu ɖaa, matsɔ nye nu eɖe gbe ƒã eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ le dzidzimewo kalã me.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Elabena megblɔ be: Woatu amenuveve la ɖe dziƒo tegbee, eye àli ke wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖe afima.

english_verse: David, one of your descendants will always be king.”
translation_verse: „Mebia nu kple nye ame tiatia, eye meke atam na nye dɔla Dawid be:

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Mali ke wò ƒome tegbee, eye maɖo wò fiazikpui anyi na dzidzimewo katã!“ Sela.

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, dziƒowo le wò nukunuwo kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ kafum le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe takpekpe me.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Elabena ameka le dziŋgɔli me de Yehowa nu, eye ameka sɔ kple Yehowa le mawuwo ƒe viwo dome?

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi le Mawu ŋu ŋufɔ le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe adaŋu me, eye vɔvɔ̃ le eŋu na amesiwo katã ƒo xlãe la.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Yehowa. Mawu Zebaot, ameka sesẽ abe wò, Yehowa, ene? Eye wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖe to ɖe wò.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖu fia ɖe atsiaƒu ƒe agbodzedze dzi; ne eƒe tsotsoewo le mimlim la, wòe tsia wo nu.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Egbã Raxab gudugudu, abe amesi woda nui ene, eye nèka wò futɔwo hlẽ.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Tɔwòe nye dziƒo, tɔwòe nye anyigba hã, xexeame kple eme nuwo, wòe ɖo wo gɔme anyi.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Tɔwòe nye ãlɔ sesẽ, ŋusẽ le wò esi ŋu, eye wò nuɖusi ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nye wò fiazikpui ƒe anyinɔ; amenuveve kple nyateƒe le tsitre ɖe wò mo.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Woayra dukɔ, si nya aseyetsotso! Yehowa, woazɔ le wò ŋku me kekeli me.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Woatso aseye le wò ŋkɔ me gbawotsyogbe, eve woado wò ɖe dzi le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Elabena weƒe ŋusẽ ƒe atsyɔ̃ nènye, eye míaƒe dzo kɔ de dzi to wò amenuveve me.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa tɔe nye míaƒe akpoxɔnu, eye míaƒe fia enye Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la tɔ.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ nye dɔla Dawid, eye mesi nye ami kɔkɔe nɛ.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Nye asi anɔ eŋu sesie, eye nye alɔ ado ŋusẽe.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Futɔ maxaxae ɖo o, eye eme vlo matee ɖe anyi o.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Magbã eƒe adikãtɔwo le eŋgɔ nyanyanya, eye maxlã nu ɖe eƒe ketɔwo.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Nye nuteƒewɔwɔ kple amenuveve anɔ anyi kplii, eye eƒe dzo akɔ ɖe dzi to nye ŋkɔ ene.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Matsɔ eƒe alɔ aɖo atsiaƒu dzi, eye eƒe nuɖusi aɖo tɔsisiwo dzi.

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Ayɔm be: Fofonye nènye, nye Mawu kple nye xɔname ƒe aga.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Matsɔe aɖo ŋgɔgbevi kple tatɔe ɖe anyigba dzi fiawo nu.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Madzra nye amenuveve do nɛ tegbee, eye nye nubabla ali di nɛ.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Mana eƒe ƒome nana anyi tegbetegbe kple eƒe fiazikpui abe dziƒo ƒe ŋkekewo ene.

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: Ne viawo gblẽ nye nufiame ɖi, eye womezɔ de nye kɔnuwo nu o,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: ne wogblẽ kɔ do na nye ɖoɖowo, eye womewɔ nye sewo dzi o la,

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: ekema matsɔ ameƒoti ava kpɔ woƒe dzidada ɖae, kple fuɖename ava kpɔ woƒe vodada ɖae.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Ke nyemana nye amenuveve nadzo le egbɔ o, eye nyemada alakpa le nye nuteƒewɔwɔ me o.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Nyemagblẽ kɔ do na nye nubabla o, eye nyematrɔ nusi do tso nye nuyiwo me la o.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Meta nye kɔkɔenyenye zi ɖeka, nyemada alakpe na Dawid o;

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Ali ke abe ɣleti ene tegbee. Ɖasefo, si le dziŋgɔli me la, enye nyateƒetɔ. Sela.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ke ègbe ame, eye nèdo vlo ame; edo dziku ɖe wò amesiamina ŋu.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Eɖi gbɔ wò dɔla ƒe nubabla, ègblẽ kɔ ɖo na eƒe fiakuku hetsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Egbã eƒe gliwo katã, eye nèmu ele mɔ̃ sesẽwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã to mɔ dzi yina la, wohae, eye wòzu alɔmeɖenu na eƒe aƒelikawo.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Ena eƒe adikãtɔwo ƒe nuɖusi ɖe dzi, eye nèdo dzidzɔ na eƒe futɔwo katã.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ena eƒe yi nu ƒo asa, eye mèna wònɔ te le ana me o.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Etsi eƒe dzadzɛnyenye nu, eye nètsɔ eƒe fiazikpui xlã ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Eto eƒe ɖekakpui me ŋkekewo ɖe eme eye nètsɔ ŋukpe tsyɔe. Sela.

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɣekaɣi naɣla ɖokuiwò ɖikaa ase ɖo, eye wò dɔmedzoe heliheli nano bibim abe dzo ene?

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋu, alesi nye agbe le kpuie kple alesi nèwɔ amegbetɔviwo katã dzodzroe!

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Ŋutsu kae le agbe, mekuna o, eye wòɖe eƒe luʋɔ tso tsiẽƒe si me? Sela.

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, afika wò amenu veve tsãtɔ, siwo dzi nèta wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖo na Dawid la le?

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋu wò dɔla ƒe vlodoame, siwo katã metsɔ ɖe akɔnu tso dukɔ geɖewo gbɔ,

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Mose, Mawu ƒe ame, ƒe gbedodoɖa. Aƒetɔ, sitsoƒe nènye na mí tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Hafi towo nava do, eye anyigba kple xexeme nadzɔ la, wòe nye Mawu tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Wòe nana amegbetɔwo gatrɔna zua kewɔ, eye nègblɔna bena: Mitrɔ gbɔ, mi amegbetɔviwo!

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Elabena ƒe akpe le ŋkuwò me ahe etsɔ ŋkeke, si nu va yi, kple ŋudzɔɣi le zã me ene.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo yii, alɔ̃dɔdɔ ko wonye; ŋdi la wodze abe gbe ene.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Ŋdi la eƒo se, eye wòdze, fiẽ la woyae, eye wòƒu.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Etsɔ míaƒe vodadawo ɖo wò ŋku me, kple míaƒe nu ɣaɣlawo ɖo wò mo ƒe kekeli nu.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Elabena miaƒe ŋkekewo katã nu yi le wò dziku la nu, míaƒe ƒewo vɔ ɖe mi abe ame ƒe ŋeŋe ene.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Míaƒe agbenɔƒewo nye ƒe blaadre, ne ede ƒã la, ƒe blanyi, eye fuɖename kple hlã nye wo aɖegbeƒonu; elabena wova yi kabakaba, eye míedze.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Amekae dze si wò dɔmedzoe ƒe ŋusẽ kple wò dziku de alesi woavɔ̃ wò nui?

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Fia alesi míaxlẽ míaƒe ŋkekewoe la mí, ne dzi nyanu nado mía si!

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: Yehowa, trɔ kɔ dzro! Vaseɖe ɣekaɣie? Eye na wò dɔme natrɔ de wò dɔlawo ŋu!

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò amenuveve ɖi ƒo na mí le ŋdi, ekema míatso aseye, eye míakpɔ dzidzɔ le míaƒe ŋkekewo katã me!

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Do dzidzɔ na mí ɖe ɣeyiɣi, si nète mí ɖe anyi, kple ƒe, siwo me dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖi kpe mí la nu!

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Na wo dɔwɔwɔ nadze na wò dɔlawo, eye wò atsyɔ̃ nanɔ viwòwo ŋu!

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu, ƒe ɖɔmenyo nanɔ mía dzi, eye wòana míaƒe asinudɔwo nali ke zã na mi, ẽ, míaƒe asinudɔwo wòana woayi dzi nyuie!

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Amesi bɔbɔ nɔ dziƒoʋitɔ la ƒe bebeƒe, eye wòle ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe vɔvɔli te la,

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: eya gblɔna na Yehowa be: Nye sitsoƒe kple nye mɔ̃ sesẽ nenye, nye Mawu, si ŋu meɖoa ŋu ɖo.

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Elabena aɖe wò tso xevimɔ̃trela ƒe adoboli me, tso dɔvɔ̃, si gblẽa nu me.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Atso eƒe fu atsyɔ dziwò eye eƒe aʋala fe nabe ɖo; akpoxɔnu gã kple ɖagbitɔ enye eƒe nyateƒe la.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Mava zã me ŋɔdzi kple aŋutrɔ, si le ʋɔ lũm le ŋkeke me,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: ɖɔvɔ̃, si le zɔzɔm le blukɔ me, kple dɔ xɔleameŋua, si le nu gblẽm le ŋdɔ la o.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Akpe nenɔ anyi dzem ɖe axawò, eye akpe ewo ɖe wò nuɖusi me, ke wò la, mate ɖe ŋuwò o!

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Vava, àkpɔe kple wò ŋkuwo, eye àkpɔ alesi woaɖo eteƒe na ame vɔ̃diwoe.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa enye wò si tsoƒe, eye dziƒoʋitɔ la nètsɔ wɔ nɔwòƒee.

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e maƒo go wò o, eye hiãkame mate ɖe wò agbaɖɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Elabena adɔ eƒe dɔlawo ɖe ŋuwò, ne woakpɔ tawò le wò mawo katã dzi.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Asi me woakɔ wò ɖo, ne màgatsɔ wò afa axlã ɖe kpea ɖeke o.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Azɔ dzata kple ƒli dzi, eye enya avuzi le dzatavi kple ʋɔ driba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Maɖee, elabena eku ɖe ŋunye; makɔe aɖo kɔkɔƒe, elabena enya nye ŋkɔ.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Ayɔm, eye matɔ nɛ, meli kplii le hiã me; maɖee le eme, eye mahaɖe bubu eŋu.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Matsɔ agbe didi aɖi ƒo nɛ, eye mana wòakpɔ nye xɔname.

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Enyo be, woade akpe na Yehowa, eye woadzi kafukafuha na wò ŋkɔ, wò dziƒoʋitɔ la,

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: woade gbe ƒã wò amenuveve le ŋdi kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le zãwo me,

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: de kasaŋku ka ewo tɔ, saŋku kple gakasaŋku ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Elabena wò, Yehowa, ètsɔ wò dɔwɔwɔwo do dzidzɔ nam, wò asinudɔwo ta mele aseye tsom ɖo.

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò nuwɔwɔwo lolo loo, wò susuwo me goglo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: Gegeme menya esia o, eye bometsila medze sii o.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke wò la èɖo kpo tegbee, Yehowa.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ da, wò futɔwo, kpɔ ɖa, wò futɔwo atsrɔ̃, eye nu vlo wɔlawo katã aka ahlẽ!

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Ke ãkɔ nyea nye dzo ɖe dzi abe akpãgba tɔ ene, eye woakɔ ami yeye ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Nye ŋku atsa le nye ketɔwo dzi bɔkɔɔ, eye nye to ase nya le ame vlo, siwo tso ɖe ŋunye la ŋu.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe la atu hlo abe deti ene, eye wòade dzi abe sederti le Libanon dzi ene.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Wodo wo ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me, eye woƒo se ɖe mía Mawu ƒe xɔxɔnuwo.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Woatse ku le tsitsime ke hã, tsi anɔ wo me gugugu, eye woade ama

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye fia! Eta ganyenye, Yehowa ye me, etsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzi, eyae li ke xexeame, mana o.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Wò fiazikpui li ke tso gbaɖegbe ke, eye nèli tso mavɔ me ke.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Tɔsisiwo, Yehowa, tɔsisiwo dze agbo; tɔsisiwo le gbe ɖem.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Yehowa kako le dziƒo wu, tɔ gãwo ƒe howɔwɔ kple atsiaƒu ƒe agbodzedze sesẽ.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Wò sewo le eme tututu; Yehowa, ŋutikɔkɔe dze wò aƒe la ɣeawiokatãɣ.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Wò anyigba ƒe ʋɔnuɖrɔ̃la, kɔ ɖokuiwò dzi, eye naɖo dadalawo ƒe nuwɔwɔ teƒe na wo!

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣie, Yehowa, ɣekaɣi ame vɔ̃diwo atso aseye ase ɖo?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Wole nuƒoƒo yrom hele nya tovowo gblɔm; ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã le ɖadzra ɖam.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wogbã wò dukɔ la nyanyanya, eye wole wò domenyinu la ɖe anyi,

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: wowu ahosiwo kple amedzrowo, eye woɖo hlɔ̃ ɖe tsyɔeviwo ŋu

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: hele gbɔgblɔm be: Yehowa mele ekpɔm o, Yakob ƒe Mawu la medze sii o!

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Mi gegeme, siwo le dukɔ la dome, midze sii, eye mi bometsilawo, ɣekaɣi miadze nunya?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Eya, amesi wɔ to, ɖe mase nu oa? Eya, amesi wɔ ŋku, ɖe makpa nu oa?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Eya, amesi hea to na dukɔwo, ɖe mahe to oa? Eya, amesi fia nunya amegbetɔwoa?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Yehowa nya amegbetɔwo ƒe susuwo be, dzodzro wonye.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Yehowa, woayra ŋutsu, si nèhe to na, eye nètsɔ wò se le fia nui,

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: ne nana gbɔdzɔe le dzɔgbevɔ̃eɣi, si me woɖea yɔɖo na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ya.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa magbe eƒe dukɔ la o, eye magblẽ eƒe domenyinu la di o,

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Elabena ʋɔnuɖɔɖrɔ̃ agatrɔ ɖe dzɔdzɔenyenye nu, eye amesiwo katã ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka la, aku ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Ameka atso ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu nam, eye ameka ado ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ŋu ɖe nunye?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye Yehowa ye xɔ nam o la, anya ne eteƒe makpɔ adidi hafi ɖoɖoe nazi le nye luʋɔ ŋu le tsiẽƒe o.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Ne mele gbɔgblɔm be, nye afɔ le ʋaʋãm la, Yehowa, wò amenuveve léam ɖe asi.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Mele ŋugble geɖe dem le nye dzi me, ke wò akɔfaname doa dzidzɔ na nye luʋɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa enye nye mɔ sesẽ, eye nye Mawu enye nye sitsoƒe ƒe aga.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Ana woƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e natrɔ va wo dzi, eye wòatsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ atsrɔ̃ woe; Yehowa, mía Mawu la, atsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Mitso! Mina míatso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye míagli kple dzidzɔ ɖe míaƒe xɔname ƒe agakpe la ŋu!

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Mina míatsɔ akpedada ado ɖe eƒe ŋku me, eye míatsɔ kafukafuhawo atso aseye ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu gã enye Yehowa kple fia ga de mawuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Eya si me anyigba ƒe globoƒewo le, eye etɔe nye towo ƒe tsutsuẽƒe;

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: etɔe nye atsiaƒu, si wòwɔ, kple ƒuƒuiƒe, si eƒe asi wɔ.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Miva, mina míabɔbɔ ade ta agu adze klo de Yehowa, mía wɔla, ŋku me!

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Elabena eya nye mía Mawu, eye míawo míenye dukɔ le eƒe lãnyiƒe kple eƒe si me lẽwo. Egbegbe, ne miese eƒe gbe la,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: migasẽ miaƒe dzime ahe le Meriba kple gbemagbe le Masa le gbeadzi ene o!

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Afisi mia fofo wo tem kpɔ, eye wodom kpɔ le, evɔ wonye wokpɔ nye nuwɔwɔwo hafi.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Ƒe blane sɔŋ ƒome sia nyɔ ŋu nam, eye megblɔ be: Dukɔ, si ƒe dzi tre mɔ, wonye eye womenya nye mɔwo o;

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: ale be meke atam le nye dziku me be: Ne woahade nye gbɔdemeƒe la fi!

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye na Yehowa, mi anyigbawo katã, midzi ha na Yehowa!

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Yehowa, mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ, eye miɖe gbe ƒã eƒe xɔname gbawotsyogbe!

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Mixlẽ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe fia le dukɔwo dome kple eƒe nukunuwo le anyigba dzi tɔwo katã dome!

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa lolo, eye wòdze kafukafu ŋutɔ, ŋɔdzi le eŋu ƒo mawuwo kalã ta.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo katã nye nu dzodzrowo; ke Yehowa ye wɔ dziƒo.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Gãnyenye kple ŋutikɔkɔe le eŋku me, ŋusẽ kple atsyɔ̃ le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo ƒe ƒomeawo mitsɔ bubu kple ŋusẽ na Yehowa, mitsɔe na Yehowa!

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ ƒe bubu nɛ, miɖo vɔsanuwo asi va eƒe xɔxɔnuwoe!

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Mina atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kɔkɔe me de ta agu de Yehowa ŋku me; anyigba wo katã, midzo nyanyanya!

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Migblɔ le dukɔwo dome be: Yehowa ye nye fia! Xexeame li ke, maʋã o. Àdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo ne eteƒe.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Dziƒo akpɔ dzidzɔ, anyigba atso aseye, eye atsiaƒu kple eme nuwo aɖe gbe;

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: agble kple nusiwo katã le eme la, akpɔ dzidzɔ, emegbe avemetiwo katã atso aseye

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: le Yehowa ŋku me: elabena egbɔna, egbɔna ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge anyigba; adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexeame ɖe dzɔdzɔenyenye nu kple dukɔwo ɖe eƒe nyateƒe nu.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Yehowa nye fia, anyigba netso aseye, ƒukpo geɖeawo nekpɔ dzidzɔ!

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Alilikpo kple tsizi ƒo xlãe, dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nye eƒe fiazikpui ƒe anyinɔ.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Dzo le yiyim le eŋgɔ, eye wòfiã eƒe futɔwo godoo va kpe.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzikedzowo klẽ ɖe xexea me; anyigba kpɔe, eye wòlulu.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Towo lólo abe anyigba ene le Yehowa ŋku me, le anyigba blibo la ƒe Aƒetɔ ŋku me.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Dziƒowo de gbe ƒã eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye dukɔwo katã kpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋu nekpe aklama kpakpɛ subɔlawo katã, amesiwo tsɔa legbawo ƒoa adegbee, mawuwo katã mede ta agu nɛ!

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Zion see, eye dzi dzɔe, Yuda-nyɔnuvi tso aseye le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ta, Yehowa.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Elabena wò Yehowa, ènye tatɔ le anyigba blibo la dzi, edo kpo ŋutɔ ɖe mawuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo lɔ̃a Yehowa la, milè fu vɔ̃! Ekpɔa eƒe mawumemewo ƒe luʋɔ ta, eye wòɖea wo tsoa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Kekeli dona na ame dzɔdzɔewo kple dzidzɔ na amesiwo ƒe dzi toa mɔ ɖeka la.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Mi ame dzɔdzɔewo, mikpɔ dzidzɔ de Yehowa ŋu, eye mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la!

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Hadzidzi. Midzi ha yeye na Yehowa, elabena ewɔ nukunuwo! Eƒe nuɖusi kple eƒe alɔ kɔkɔe la xɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe eƒe xɔname fia, eklo nu le eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye dzi le dukɔwo ŋku me.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu eƒe amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe la Anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo katã kpɔ mía Mawu, ƒe xɔname.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi anyigbawo katã, mitso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu, aseyetsotso neɖi le mia nu, eye midzi kafukafuha!

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Midzi kafukafuha na Yehowa ɖe kasaŋku ŋu, ɖe kasaŋku kple ha ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu,

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: ɖe dze kple kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu! Mitso aseye le Yehowa, fia la ŋku me!

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu kple eme nuwo neɖe gbe kpe ɖe xexeame kple eme nɔlawo ŋu!
