english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Tɔsisiwo neƒu akpe, towo katã netso aseye

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: le Yehowa ŋku me, elabena egbɔna ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge anyigba! Aɖrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexeame ɖe dzɔdzɔenyenye nu kple dukɔwo ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye fia, dukɔwo dzo nyanyanya; ebɔbɔ nɔ Kerubiwo dzi, anyigba ʋanya.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa lolo le Zion, eye wòɖo kpo de dukɔwo katã dzi.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Woakafu wò ŋkɔ, elolo, ŋɔdzi le eŋu, eye wòle kɔkɔe.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Eli ŋusẽ anyi na fia, si lɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔe la, eye nedo nusi dzɔ la te; ena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye dzi le Yakob.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Mido Yehowa, mía Mawu la, de dzi, eye mide ta agu ɖe eƒe afɔɖodzinu ŋgɔ! Eyama le kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron le eƒe nunɔlawo dome eye Samuel le amesiwo yɔa eƒe ŋkɔ la dome. Woyɔ Yehowa, eye wòɖo to wo.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Enɔ alilikpo dodo me ƒo nu kpli wo, wolé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi, eye wòde ɖoɖo asi na wo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía Mawu, èɖo to wo; Mawu, si tsɔna kena, nènye na wo, eye nèbiaa hlɔ̃ ɖe woƒe nu masɔmasɔ wɔwɔwo la.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Mido Yehowa, mía Mawu la, ɖe dzi, eye mide ta agu ɖe eƒe to kɔkɔe la ŋgɔ, elabena Yehowa, mía Mawu la, le kɔkɔe!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Akpedada. Anyigbawo katã, mitso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Misuhɔ Yehowa kple dzidzɔ, eye mitsɔ aseyetsotso do ɖe eŋku me!

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Midze sii be, Yehowa ye nye Mawu! Eyae wɔ mí, eye etɔ míenye, eƒe dukɔ kple alẽwo le eƒe lãnyiƒe míenye.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ akpedada ge ɖe eƒe agbowo me kple kafukafuha ge ɖe eƒe xɔxɔnuwo, mida akpe nɛ, eye mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ!

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe dɔme nyo, eƒe amenuveve li tegbee kple eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Madzi ha le amenuveve kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu, wò Yehowa ye madzi kafukafuha na.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Malé ŋku ɖe maɖifɔmɔ ŋu. Ɣekaɣi nèle gbɔnye va ge? Mazɔ le nye dzi ƒe fɔmaɖimaɖi me le aƒenye me.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Nyemetsɔ nu tovo aɖo ŋku me o, melé fu dzidanuwɔwɔ, malé ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Amesi lia ehavi ŋu le adza me la, matsrɔ̃e ɖa; amesi dadaŋku le ta nɛ, eye eƒe dzi vu gbloto la, mia kplii ƒe ŋɔlime meƒo go o.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye ŋku ɖo anyigba dzi nuteƒewɔlawo ŋu, be woana gbɔnye; amesi zɔa maɖifɔmɔ dzi la, eya asubɔm.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Amesi daa alakpa le, manɔ aƒenye me o, eye amesi kaa aʋatso la, mali de ŋkunye me o.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Magblẽ anyigba dzi ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã ŋdi sia ŋdi, ne matsrɔ̃ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo katã ɖa le Yehowa ƒe du la me.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Megaɣla wò mo ɖem le nye xaxagbe o, ƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye! Netsɔ, naɖo tom le gbesigbe meyɔ wò!

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Elabena nye ŋkekewo nu va yi abe adzudzɔ ene, eye nye ƒuwo biã hẽ abe dzo ene.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Nye dzi yrɔ, eye wòƒu abe gbe ene; elabena meŋlɔ aboloɖuɖu be.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Nye ŋutilã miã ɖe nye ƒu ŋu le nye ŋeŋe sesĩ la ta.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Meɖi aluge le gbedzi kple favieʋuto, si le aƒedo me.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Alɔ̃dɔdɔ zu dɔ, eye mele abe xevi tsi akogo le xɔta ene.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo le alɔme ɖem le ŋunye atraɖi, eye amesiwo nyrã ɖe ŋunye la, tsɔm wɔ ɖiŋuɖonui.

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: Elabena mele dzowɔ ɖum abe abolo ene, eye nye nunono tɔtɔ kple aɖatsi

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: le wò dɔmedzoe kple wò dziku la ta, elabena ède asi tanye xlã ɖe anyi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkekewo le abe vɔvɔli, si ɖo to la ene, eye meƒu abe gbe ene.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Ke wò Yehowa la, èli tegbee, eye wò ŋkɔ le dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Atso àkpɔ nublanui na Zion, elabena enuveɣi ɖo, eye azãgbe la de.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Elabena wò dɔlawo melɔ̃a nu le eƒe kpewo gbɔ o, eye eƒe anyiglãwo ƒe nu vea wo.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Dukɔwo avɔ̃ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, eye anyigbawo dzi fiawo avɔ̃ wò ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Yehowa agbugbɔ Zion atso, eye wòado le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me,

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: atrɔ ɖe ame ɖeƒeƒlewo ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu, eye mado vlo woƒe kukuɖeɖe o.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Woaŋlɔ esia ɖi na megbeviwo, eye dukɔ, si woava mè la, akafu Yehowa.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: Elabena ekpɔ nu tso eƒe kɔkɔƒe kɔkɔe la, Yehowa do mo ɖe anyigba dzi tso dziƒo,

english_verse: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
translation_verse: ne wòase gatɔwo ƒe ŋeŋe, eye wòaɖe ga kuviwo,

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: ne woaxlẽ nya afia le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu le Zion kple eƒe kafukafu ŋu le Yerusalem,

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: nenye be, dukɔwo katã kple fiaɖuƒewo kpe ta, be woasubɔ Yehowa.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Ebɔbɔ nye ŋusẽ de anyi le mɔ ta, eye wòto nye ŋkekewo ɖe eme.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Mele gbɔgblɔm be: Nye Mawu, megana nunye nayi le nye ŋkekewo ƒe domedomee o! Wo ƒewo anɔ anyi tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Gbaɖegbe ke nèdo anyigba gome anyi, eye wò asinudɔwɔwɔ enye dziƒowo.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Woawo nu ayi, ke wò la ànɔ anyi; wo katã anyunyɔ abe ava ene, eye àɖɔ li wo woaɖɔ abe awu ene.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Ke wò la nenema ko nèle, eye wò ƒewu nu metsona o.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Luʋɔnye, kafu Yehowa, eye nusianu, si le menye la, mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, kafu Yehowa, eye megaŋlɔ eƒe nyuiwɔwɔwo katã be o!

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Amesi tsɔa wò vodadawo katã kea wò, eye wòdaa gbe le wò dɔlélewo katã ŋu,

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: amesi ɖea wò agbe tso gbegblẽ me, eye wòtsɔa amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ɖɔna na wò,

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: amesi tsɔa nu nyui ɖia ƒo na wò amegãkuku, ale be wò ɖekakpuinyenye gaɖoa yeye me abe hɔ̃ tɔ ene.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu na amesiwo katã wote ɖe anyi la.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ena Mose nya eƒe mɔwo, eye wòna Israel-viwo nya eƒe nuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Nublanuikpɔla kple amenuvela enye Yehowa, egbɔa dzi ɖi blewu, eye amenuveve bɔ ɖe esi.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Menɔa dzre dzi ɖaa o, eye meléa dziku ɖe dɔme tegbee o.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Elabena alesi dziƒo kɔ tso anyigba gbɔe la, nenema eƒe amenuveve nu se de amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la dzii.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Alesi ɣedzeƒe didi tso ɣetodoƒe gbɔe la, nenema wòte mía dzidadawo da boo tso mía gbɔe.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Alesi fofo ƒe dɔme trɔna ɖe mawo ŋui la, nenema Yehowa ƒe dɔme trɔna ɖe amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la ŋui.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Elabena enya míaƒe wɔwɔme, eɖoa ŋui be, akewɔ míenye.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe agbe la gbe wònye, eƒoa se abe seƒoƒo le gbe me ene.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Elabena ne ya ƒo to edzi la, meganɔa anyi o, eye eteƒe megadzea sii o.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa ƒe amenuveve li tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me na amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye li na viwo ƒe viwo,

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Yehowa li eƒe fiazikpui de dziƒo, eye eƒe fiaɖuƒe ɖua nuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, mi eƒe dɔlawo, mi kalẽtɔ sesẽ, siwo wɔa eƒe nya dzi hesea eƒe nya ƒe gbe!

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, mi eƒe aʋakɔwo katã, mi eƒe subɔla, siwo wɔa nusi dzea eŋu!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, mi eƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã le eƒe dziɖuƒewo katã me! Luʋɔnye, kafu Yehowa!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, kafu Yehowa! Yehowa, nye Mawu, èlolo ŋutɔ, ètaa gãnyenye kple atsyɔ̃ ɖoɖo.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Etsyɔa kekeli abe avɔ ene, eye wòkekea dziƒo abe agbadɔvɔ ene.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: Etsɔa tsiwo sãa eƒe dziƒoxɔ dzi, etsɔa alilikpowo wɔa eƒe tasiaɖam, eye wòzɔa ya ƒe aʋalawo dzi.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Etsɔa ya wɔa eƒe dɔlawoe kple dzo flafla wɔa eƒe subɔlawoe.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Edo anyigba gɔme anyi ɖe eƒe anyinɔwo dzi, ne magaʋã gbeɖe akpɔ o.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Etsɔ tsi gbana tsyɔ edzi abe avɔ ene; tsi kɔ gbɔ towo ta.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Wosi le wò bublu nu, eye wode afɔ du me le wò gbeɖeɖe nu.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Towo kɔ dzi, baliwo nyẽ ɖe eme le teƒe, si nèɖo enyi na wo.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Eɖo liƒo na wo, womagbɔ edzi o, eye womagbugbɔ atsyɔ anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ena tsi dzɔ tso baliwo me, wosi to towo domee:

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: wonaa tsi gbemelãwo katã wonona, gbetedzi faa eƒe tsikɔwuame nu.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Dziƒoxewo nɔa wo to, eye wonana wosea wo ŋkɔ le atilɔwo me.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Enana towo ƒoa tsi beke tso eƒe dziƒoxɔ me, eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kutsetse ɖia ƒo na anyigba.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Enana gbe miena na lãwo kple agblemenuwo na amegbetɔwo ƒe ŋudɔwɔwɔ, ne woaɖe nuɖuɖu atso anyigba me.

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: Wein doa dzidzɔ na amagbetɔ ƒe dzi, eye wònana eƒe mo zrɔ̃na lãlãlã wu ami; ke abolo doa ŋusẽ amegbetɔ ƒe dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe atiwo ɖia ƒo, Libanon ƒe sederti, siwo wòdo.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Afima xewo wɔa ato ɖo, eye damixe tsɔa kpomitiwo me wɔ eƒe aƒee.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: To kɔkɔwo li na agamegbɔ̃wo, eye agawo nye sitsoƒe na hotoklolowo.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Ewɔ ɣleti, ne wòade vovo ɣeyiɣi me: ɣe nya eƒe toɖoƒe.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Eɖoa viviti anyi, eye zã dona, eya me ave me lãwo katã ʋãa wo ɖokui lena.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Dzataviwo le xɔxlɔ̃m ɖe nuléle ŋu, eye wobiaa woƒe nuɖuɖu tso Mawu si me.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Ne ɣe dze la, woƒoa wo ɖokui nu ƒu, eye wotsyɔa akɔ anyi ɖe wo nɔƒe.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ dona yia eƒe nuwɔƒe kple eƒe dɔwɔwɔ dzi vasena ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò dɔwɔwɔwo sɔ gbɔ loo! Ewɔ wo katã le nunya me: anyigba yɔ fũ kple wò nuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu enye si, elolo, eye wòkeke le goawo kple eve me: afima lã suewo kple gãwo siaa, siwo mele xexlẽ me o la, ʋãa wo ɖokui lena;

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: ʋuwo zɔa edzi yina; afima boso, si nèwɔ, be wòafe le eme la le.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Wo katã wole asiwò nu kpɔm, be nana nuɖuɖu yewo le enaɣi.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Ena wo, eye wofɔe, èʋu wò asi me, eye wodi ƒo kple wò nu nyui.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Ne èɣla wò ŋku me la, woluluna; ne èɖe woƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖa la, wokuna, eye wogbugbɔna yia woƒe ke me.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Ne èɖo wò gbɔgbɔ ɖa la, wodzɔna, eye nègawɔa anyigba ƒe ŋku me yeye.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe li tegbee! Yehowa kpɔa dzidzɔ le eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu!

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi doa mo de anyigba dzi, tete wòdzena nyanyanya, ekaa asi towo ŋu, eye wotua adzudzɔ.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Madzi ha na Yehowa, ŋkeke alesi mele agbe; maƒo saŋku na nye Mawu, ŋkeke alesi meli.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Nye susuwo avivi enu; nye la, Yehowa ŋu ko makpɔ dzidzɔ ɖo.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Nuvɔ̃wɔlawo atsrɔ̃ le anyigba dzi, eye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo maganɔ anyi o! Luʋɔnye, kafu Yehowa! Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, miɖe gbe ƒã eƒe ŋkɔ, eye miɖe eƒe nuwɔwɔwo fia le dukɔwo dome!

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Midzi ha nɛ, miƒo saŋku nɛ, eye miƒo nu le eƒe nukunuwo katã ŋu!

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Miƒo adegbe le eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu; amesiwo katã dia Yehowa la, ƒe dzi nekpɔ dzidzɔ!

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Mibia Yehowa kple eƒe ŋusẽ la se, eye midi eƒe ŋku me ɖaa!

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋu eƒe nukunu, siwo wòwɔ, eƒe dzesiwo kple eƒe nu me fiatsotsowo!

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Mi eƒe dɔlawo, Abraham-ƒomeawo, mi eƒe ame tiatiawo, Yakob-viwo,

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: eya nye Yehowa, mía Mawu la, eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le anyigbawo kalã dzi.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Aɖo ŋu eƒe nubabla, nya, si wòɖo hena dzidzime akpewo la tegbee,

english_verse: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
translation_verse: etsɔe wɔ ɖoɖoe na Yakob kple nubablae na Israel tegbee,

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: hegblɔ bena: Wòe matsɔ Kanaan-nyigba na, ne wòanye miaƒe domenyinu ƒe gome!

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Esime womede ha o, wole ʋee, eye wonye amedzro le edzi ko,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: eye woho tso dukɔ gbɔ yi dukɔ gbɔ, tso fiaɖuƒe gbɔ yi dukɔ bubu gbɔ la,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: mana amea ɖeke te wo ɖe anyi o, eye wòhe to na fiawo le wo ta.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Migaka asi nye amesiaminawo ŋu o, eye migawɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke nye nyagblɔdilawo o!

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Eyɔ dɔwuame va anyigba dzi, eye wòŋe abolo ƒe ziɔɖeŋutiwo katã.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: Edɔ ŋutsua ɖe ɖe wo ŋgɔ; wotsɔ Yosef dzra kluvii.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Womimi eƒe afɔ ɖe atiboli ŋu, eye woɖee kunyowu me,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: vaseɖe ɣeyiɣi, si eƒe nya va me, eye Yehowa ƒe nuƒoƒo lóloe wòdza.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Tete fia la ɖɔ woɖaɖee, dukɔwo dziɖula na woɖe gae.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Etsɔe ɖo aƒetɔ ɖe eƒe aƒe nu kple eƒe nuwo katã dzikpɔlae,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: ne wòabla eƒe amegãwo, alesi dze eŋu, eye wòafia nunya eƒe ame tsitsiwo.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Eye Israel va Egipte, eye Yakob nye amedzro le Xam-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Eye wòna eƒe dukɔ dzi ŋutɔ, eye wokpɔ ŋusẽ wu woƒe kelɔwo.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Etrɔ woƒe dzi, be woalé fu yeƒe dukɔ, eye woado aye ɖe yeƒe dɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Edɔ eƒe dɔla Mose kple Aron, si wòtia la ɖa.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Ewɔ eƒe dzesiwo le wo dome kple nukunuwo le Xam-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Eɖo viviti ɖa, eye blukɔ do, ke womebu eƒe nyawo o.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ena woƒe towo zu ʋu, eye wowu woƒe tɔmelãwo.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Woƒe anyigba dzi gblẽ kple akpɔkplɔwo, keke woƒe fiawo ƒe xɔwo me ke hã.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu, tete togbatowo kple mũwo va woƒe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ena tsikpewo wu ɖe tsidzadza teƒe kple dzoƒaɖewo ɖe woƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Eƒo woƒe weinkawo kple gbotiwo ƒu anyi, eye wòŋe woƒe anyigba dzi tiwo.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu, eye ʋetsuviwo kple ʋetrawo ɖo bibibi,

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: eve woɖu numiemiewo katã le woƒe anyigba dzi, eye woɖu woƒe agble me nukuwo.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ewo ŋgɔgbeviwo katã lewoƒe anyigba dzi, woƒe ŋusẽwo katã ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo dzoe kple klosalo kple sika, eye ame kudɔea ɖeke meno woƒe toawo me o.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Dzi dzɔ Egipte le woƒe ʋuʋu la ta, elabena woƒe ŋɔdzi le wo,

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ekeke alilikpo tsyɔ wo dzi, eye wòna dzo na zã me kɔ.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Wobia nu, eye wòhe tegliwo va; dziƒobolo wòtsɔ di ƒo na woe.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Enu agakpe nu, eye tsi ɖuɖu hesi le gbegbe abe tɔsisi ene.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Elabena eɖo ŋku eƒe nya kɔkɔe, si wògblɔ na eƒe dɔla Abraham la dzi.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔ eƒe dukɔ la le dzidzɔ me kple eƒe ame dadawo le aseyetsotso me.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Etsɔ dukɔwo ƒe anyigbawo na wo, ne woaxe nusi dukɔwo dagba kpɔ la, woanye wo tɔ;

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ne woalé ŋku ɖe eƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu, eye woalé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Miɖa akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Amekae ate ŋu agblɔ Yehowa ƒe nutsuwɔwɔwo ade goe, eye wòaɖe gbe ƒã eƒe ŋkɔxɔxɔwo katã?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Woayrã amesiwo léa se la me ɖe asi, eye wowɔa nu dzɔdzɔe ɣeawo katã ɣli.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖo ŋku dzinye le wò amenuveve, si nèɖe fi wò dukɔ la nu; tsa wò xɔname va kpɔm ɖa,

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: ne makpɔ wò ame tiatiawo ƒe dzɔgbenyuie, dzi nadzɔm ɖe wò dukɔ ƒe dzidzɔ ŋu, eye maƒo adegbe akpe ɖe wò domenyinu ŋu!

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Míewɔ nuvɔ̃ kpe ɖe mía fofowo ŋu, míeɖa vo, eye míewɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Mía fofowo melé ŋku ɖe wò nukunuwo ŋule Egipte o, womeɖo ŋu wò amenuveve geɖeawo o, eye wosẽ to le ƒu la nu, le Avaƒu la nu.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Ke exɔ na wo le eƒe ŋkɔ la ta, ne yeaɖe eƒe ŋusẽ afia.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Eblu ɖe Avaƒu la ta wòmle, eye wòkplɔ wo to tɔ gɔme abe tagba ene.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Tsi nye tsyo woƒe adikãtɔwo dzi, wo dometɔ ɖeka hɔ̃ hã mekpɔtɔ o,

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: eye woxɔ eƒe nyawo dzi se hedzi ha le eƒe kafukafu ŋu.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo be kaba, eye womekpɔ eƒe tameɖoɖo sinu o.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Wodzro nu le gbedzi, eye wote Mawu kpɔ le gbedadaƒo.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Ewɔ woƒe didi dzi na wo, eye wòdɔ ƒuɖiɖi glaŋglaŋ ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Eye woʋã ŋu Mose le asaɖa me kple Yehowa ƒe ame kɔkɔe Aron.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Anyigba ke nu hemi Datan, eye wòtsyɔ Abiram ƒe amehawo dzi.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Dzo bi woƒe amehawo, eye dzoƒaɖe fiã ame vɔ̃ɖiawo.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Wowɔ nyivi le Xoreb gbɔ, eye wode ta agu na legba kɔkɔ la.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ woƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖɔ li nyitsu, si ɖua gbe, ƒe nɔnɔme.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Woƒe ŋku dzo le Mawu, woƒe xɔnametɔ ta dzi, amesi wɔ nu gãwo le Egipte,

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: amesi wɔ nukunuwo le Xam-nyigba dzi kple nu dziŋɔwo le Avaƒu la nu.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Tete wòbe, yeatsrɔ̃ wo, ɖe menye eƒe ame tiatia Mose ye tsi tre ɖe gbagbãƒe le eŋku me, ne wòafa eƒe dziku nu, be magagblẽ nu o la!

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Wodo vlo anyigba nyo la, eye womexɔ eƒe nyawo dzi se o,

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: woli liʋiliʋi le woƒe agbadɔwo me, eye womeɖo to Yehowa ƒe gbe o.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Tete wòkɔ eƒe asi dzi ɖe wo ŋu, be yeaxlã wo ɖe anyi le gbea dzi,

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: yeakaka wo viwo ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye yeahlẽ wo de anyigbawo dzi.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Woku ɖe Baal-Peor ŋu, eye woɖu eme kukuwo ƒe vɔsa,

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: wotsɔ woƒe nuwɔwɔwo ɖo dziku nɛ, eye fuwɔame ɖo wo dome.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Tete Pinexas tso hetso nyo la me, eye fuwɔame la nu tso.

english_verse: Now he will always be highly honored.
translation_verse: Eye wobui dzɔdzɔenyenye na eya kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo katã tegbee.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Wodo dziku nɛ le dzrewɔtsi la gbɔ, eye le woawo la eme menyo na Mose o ɖo.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Wodo dziku na eƒe gbɔgbɔ, eye nya ge le enu.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Wometsrɔ̃ dukɔwo, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔe na wo ene o,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wotsaka kple dukɔwo, eye wosrɔ̃ woƒe nuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wosubɔ woƒe legbawo, eye wotre zu mɔ na wo,

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple woƒe nyɔnuviwo sa vɔ na gbetsiwo.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Wokɔ nu maɖifɔ ɖi, si nye woƒe ŋutsuvi kple woƒe nyɔnuvi, siwo wotsɔ sa vɔ na Kanaan-legbawo la, ƒe ʋu, ale be wotsɔ hlɔ̃dodo gblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba la.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ƒo di wo ɖokui, eye wozu ame dzegowo to woƒe nuwɔwɔwo me.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe bi ɖe eƒe dukɔ la ŋu, eye wònyɔ ŋu eƒe ɖomeuyinu la.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wo de asi na dukɔwo, be woƒe ketɔwo naɖu fia ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Woƒe futɔwo xaxa wo ɖo, ale be wobɔbɔ ɖe woƒe ŋusẽ te.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Exɔ na wo zi geɖe; ke woawo se to le woƒe aɖaŋudedewo nu, eye woyi to le woƒe vodadawo me.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ woƒe hiã la ɖa, eye wòse woƒe ɣli.

english_verse: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu eƒe nubabla le wo ta, eye wòvee le eƒe amenuveve geɖe la nu.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Eye wòna amesiwo katã ɖe aboyo wo la, kpɔ nublanui na wo.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía Mawu, xɔ na mí, eye naƒo mía nu ƒu tso dukɔwo dome, ne míakafu wò ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la, eye míatsɔ wò kafukafu aƒo adegbee!

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu, fa, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me, eye dukɔ blibo la negblɔ be: Nenɔ alea, mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Amesiwo Yehowa de la, negblɔ alea, amesiwo wòɖe le xaxa me,

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: eye wòƒo wo nu ƒu tso anyigbawo dzi, tso ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, tso anyiehe kple dziehe la!

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Wotre mɔ le gbedzi kple gbedadaƒo, afisi mɔ mele o; eye womekpɔ du, si me woanɔ o.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Dɔ kple tsikɔ wu wo, nu te woƒe luʋɔ ŋu le wo me.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe hiã me; eɖe wo tso woƒe xaxa me

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: hekplɔ wo to mɔtata dzi, ne woayi du, si me woanɔ la me.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woawo neda akpe na Yehowa le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukunu, siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔviwo la ta!

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Elabena ena luʋɔ tsikɔwuwo ɖi kɔ, eye wòtsɔ nu nyui di ƒo na luʋɔ dɔwuiwo.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Wobɔbɔ nɔ viviti kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me, eye wobɔ pã wo ɖe hiã kple ga me.

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: Elabena wosẽ to ɖe Mawu ƒe nyawo ŋu, eye wodo vlo dziƒoʋitɔ la ƒe adaŋudede,

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: ale be wòtsɔ hiãkame bɔbɔ woƒe dzi ɖe anyi, womu ya, ke xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli ti.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete woɖo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe hiã me, eye wòɖe wo tso woƒe xaxa me.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Eɖe wo tso viviti kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me, eye wòtso woƒe gawo.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woawo neda akpe na Yehowa le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukunu, siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔviwo la ta!

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Elabena egbã akɔbligbowo, eye wòfli ga yibɔ gametiwo.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Bometsilawo wonye, amesiwo kpe fu le woƒe dzidadawo kple woƒe vodadawo ta.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖuwo katã nyɔ ŋu na woƒe luʋɔ, ale be woɖo ku ƒe agbo nu.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe hiã me, eye wòɖe wo tso woƒe xaxa me.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Edo eƒe nya da wòyɔ dɔ wo, eye wòhe wo tso woƒe ʋe la me.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woawo neda akpe na Yehowa le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukunu, siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔviwo la ta;

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: woawo nesa akpedavɔ, eye woatsɔ aseyetsotso axlẽ eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo afia!

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Wole ʋuwo me zɔ atsiaƒu dzi, eye wotsa asi le tɔ gãwo dzi.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Wokpɔ Yehowa ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo kple eƒe nukunuwo le tɔ gɔme.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu, eye ahomya tso hemli eƒe tsotsoewo.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Woyi dzi hoo hedze abu me; woƒe luʋɔ lolo gbanaa le xaxa me.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe hiã me, eye wòɖe wo tso woƒe xaxawo me.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Ena ahom la dze anyi kpoo, eye eƒe tsitsotsoeawo ɖo ho to.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Dzi dzɔ wo be, ɖoɖoe zi le wo nu, eye wòkplɔ wo ɖe ʋutɔkɔ ɖe woƒe didi nu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woada akpe na Yehowa le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukunu, siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔvlwo la ta;

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: woadoe ɖe dzi le dukɔ la ƒe takpekpe me, eye woakafui le ame tsitsiwo ƒe adaŋu me!

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Ewɔ tɔsisiwo wòzu gbegbe kple tsidzɔƒewo wozu kuɖinyigba,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: anyigba wɔnu zu dzeƒee le edzinɔlawo ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Etrɔ gbegbe wòzu tsi ta kple kuɖinyigba wòzu tsidzɔƒe.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Etsɔ dɔwuitɔwo ɖo afima, ne woatso du, si me woanɔ;

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: woaƒã nu ɖe agble me, woade weingblewo, eye woaŋe agble me nukuwo.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Eyra wo, eye wodzi ɖe dzi ŋutɔ, eye meke woƒe lãwo dzi ɖe o.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Wozu ʋee, eye dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple nuxaxa ƒe agba te wo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Etrɔ vlododo kɔ ɖe ame ŋkutɔwo dzi, eye wòna wotra mɔ le gbegbe, afisi mɔa ɖeke mele o.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Ke ekɔ ame dahe ɖe dzi tso hiã me, eye wòwɔ eƒe ƒome abe lãha ene.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Dzime dzɔdzɔe tɔwo kpɔe, eye dzi dzɔ wo, eye vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔwo katã miã nu.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Amesi nye nunyala la, nelé ŋku ɖe esia ŋu, eye wòadze si Yehowa ƒe amenuveve!

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Mawu, nye dzi dze eme, madzi ha, eye mate saŋku; nye kafukafu hã awɔe.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Yehowa, makafu wò le dukɔwo dome, eye madzi kafukafuha ne wò le anyigbadzilɔwo dome.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Elabena wò amenuveve kɔ gbɔ dziƒo ta, eye wò nyateƒe datɔ alilikpowo.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Oo Mawu, kɔ dokuiwò dzi gbɔ dziƒo ŋu, eye wò ŋutikɔkɔe nagbɔ anyigba blibo la ta!

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Ne woaxe na wò ame lɔlɔ̃wo; tsɔ wò nuɖusi ɖe mí, eye naɖo tom!

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒo nu le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la be: Makpa dzidzɔ, mamã Sixem, eye madzidze Sukot-bali me la.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Gilead enye tɔnye, eye tɔnyee nye Manase; Efrayim enye nye taxenu, eye Yuda anye nye fiatikplɔ;

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: nye tsileze enye Moab, mada nye atokota ɖe Edom dzi, eye metso aseye ɖe Filistitɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Amekae akplɔm ayi du sesẽ la mee, eye ameka akplɔm vaseɖe Edom?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖe menye wòe gbe mi oa, Mawu, eye mèho kple míaƒe aʋakɔwo oa?

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Kpe ɖe mía ŋu ɖe míaƒe ketɔwo ŋuti, elabena amegbetɔ ƒe xɔname mele ɖeke me o!

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la. Wò, nye kafukafu ƒe Mawu, megazi kpi o!

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple alakpadalawo ƒe nu ke ɖe ŋunye, eye wotsɔ alakpaɖewo ƒo nu kplim.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ fuléamenyawo ɖe to ɖem, eye wowɔ avu kplim yakatsyɔ.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Wolém ɖe ke me ɖe nye lɔlɔ̃ teƒe; gbedodoɖa sɔŋ ko nyama mezu.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ vɔ̃ ɖo nyui teƒe nam kple fuléle ɖo nye lɔlɔ̃ teƒe.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Da ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖe eŋu, eye Satana netsi tre ɖe eƒe nuɖusi me!

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Nenye ame ɖifɔ le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me, eye eƒe gbedodoɖa nezu nuvɔ̃!

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkekewo nezu ʋee, eye ame bubu nexɔ eƒe dɔ!

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Viawo nezu tsyɔ̃eviwo, eye srɔ̃a nezu ahosi!

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Viawo nenɔ tsa glãla tsam anɔ nu biam, eye woadi nu le adzɔge tso woƒe aƒedowo gbɔ!

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Fetɔ nehe eƒe nuwo katã ɖe akɔme, eye ame tutɔwo neha nusiwo wòwɔ ɖɔ kpɔ la!

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke meganɔ anyi nɛ, si ave enu o, eye amea ɖeke megakpɔ nublanui na eƒe tsyɔ̃eviwo o!

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Woatsrɔ̃ eƒe dzidzimeviwo, eye woƒe ŋkɔ netutu ɖa le ƒome, si adze eyome la me!

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Woaɖo ŋu fofoawo ƒe vodada le Yehowa gbɔ, eye womegatutu dada ƒe nuvɔwo ɖa o;

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: ke boŋ woana Yehowa ŋku me ɖaa, eye netsrɔ̃ woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le anyigba dzi!

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Elabena meɖo ŋku dɔmenyowɔwɔ dzi o, ke boŋ eli hiãtɔ kple ame dahe kpakple amesi ƒe dzi le nu xam la yome be, yeawui.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Elɔ̃ fiƒode, eyata neva edzi; yayra ƒe nu menyo eŋu o, eyata nenɔ adzɔge nɛ!

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Eta fiƒode abe avɔ ene, eyata neɖo lãme nɛ abe tsi ene kple eƒe ƒuwo me abe ami ene!

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Nenye eƒe avɔ, si wòtana, kple alidziblanu si wòblaa ali dzi ɖaae!

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Esia nenye nye ketɔwo kple amesiwo le nye gblɔm ɖe ŋunye la, ƒe fetu tso Yehowa gbɔ!

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, wɔ nam le wò ŋkɔ la ta; esiwò amenuveve nyo ŋuti la ɖem!

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Elabena hiãkpela kple ame dahe menye, eye nye dzi xɔ abi ɖe dɔme nam.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Nenye yi abe vɔvɔli, si le to ɖom la ene, eye woʋuʋum abe ʋetsuvi ene.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Nye klo zu hehe le nutsitsidɔ ta, eye ami no le lã me nam.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Nyea mezu alɔmeɖenu na wo, wokpɔm, eye woʋuʋu ta.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Kpe ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa, nye Mawu, xɔ nam le wò amenuveve la nu!

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Ekema woadze sii be, wò asie nye esia, eye wò Yehowa ye wɔe.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Woaƒo fi ade faa, ke wò la, ayra tsã; ne wotso ɖe ŋunye hã, woaɖu ŋukpe; ke wò dɔla ya akpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Nye ketɔwo ata vlododo, eye woado ŋukpe abe awu ʋlaya ene.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye nu ada akpe na Yehowa vevie, eye makafui le ame geɖewo dome.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Elabena ele tsitre ɖe ame dahe la ƒe nuɖusi me, ne yeaxɔe tso amesiwo le fɔ bumee la si me.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Yehowa gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ be: Bɔbɔ nɔ nye nuɖusi me, vaseɖe esime matsɔ wò fulɔwo awɔ wò afɔɖodzinu!

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa ado wò ŋusẽ ƒe fiatikplɔ da tso Zion be: Ɖu fia le wo futɔwo titina!

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Wò dukɔ atsɔ eɖokui ake wò le wò aʋakpegbe, eye wò ɖekakpuiwo anɔ atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kɔkɔe me ado na wò abe zãmu tso agudzedze ƒe dɔ me ene.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Yehowa ka atam, eye mavee akpɔ o be: Wòe nye nunɔla tegbee le Melxizedek ƒe kɔa nu.

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la le wò nuɖusi me, agbã fiawo le dɔmedzoe me nyanyanya.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le dukɔwo dome; atsɔ ame kukuwo ayɔ teƒe kekewoe, eye wòagbã ametawo ɖi.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Tɔʋu, si le mɔ to la me, wòano tsi le; eyata awu ta dzi:

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Makafu Yehowa tso dzi blibo me le dzime dzɔdzɔe tɔwo ƒe adaŋu me kple amehawo dome.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ lolo, amesiwo katã dzrom wole la, dia eyome.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Gãnyenye kple atsyɔ̃ nye eƒe nuwɔwɔ, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye li tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Edo ŋkuɖodzinu eƒe nukunuwo ŋu, amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla enye Yehowa.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Ena nuɖuɖu amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la; eɖoa ŋku eƒe nubabla dzi tegbee.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Ede eƒe nuwɔwɔ ƒe ŋusẽ fia eƒe dukɔ la, esime wòtsɔ dukɔwo ƒe domenyinu na wo.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo nye nyateƒe kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃, eye eƒe sewo katã le eteƒe;

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: elia ke wo ɖaa tegbee, eye wòwɔ wo le nyateƒe kple nuteƒewɔwɔ me.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Eɖo ɖeɖe ɖe eƒe dukɔ, eye wòɖo eƒe nubabla anyi tegbee; eƒe ŋkɔ le kɔkɔe, eye ŋɔdzi le eŋu.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Yehowa vɔvɔ̃ enye nunya ƒe gɔmetoto; amesiwo katã léa eme la, gɔmesese nyui sua wo si; eƒe kafukafu li tegbee.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Woayra ŋutsu, si vɔ̃a Yehowa, eye wòkpɔa dzidzɔ le eƒe seawo ŋu vevie.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ anɔ viawo ŋu le anyigba dzi, eye woayra dzime dzɔdzɔe tɔwo ƒe ƒome.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Nu geɖe kple kesinɔnu le eƒe me, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye li tegbee.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Eme anye na ŋutsu, si naa nu ame, eye wòdoa nu na ame; eya ƒe nya aɖu dzi le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nu.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Elabena ke maɖe le ete akpɔ o tegbee; ame dzɔdzɔe anɔ anyi hena ŋkuɖoɖodzi tegbee.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Nya vɔ̃ sesea ɖeke madzi ŋɔ nɛ o, eƒe dzi dzea eme, eye wòɖoa dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Dzi le eƒo mavɔ̃ o, vaseɖe esime wòakpɔ eƒe ketɔwo ta ɖa.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Enaa nu ame dahewo fũ, eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye li tegbee, eye eƒe dzo ade dzi le bubu me.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi kpɔe, eye dzi kui, eɖu aɖukli, eye wòabu ɖa. Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe didi nu ayi.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Mi Yehowa ƒe dɔlãwo, mikafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, mikafui!

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ tso fifia vaseɖe mava me!

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ tso ɣedzeƒe vaseɖe eƒe toɖoƒe!

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖo kpo ɖe dukɔwo katã dzi, eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖo kpo ɖe dziƒo dzi.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Amekae ɖe Yehowa, mía Mawu la, amesi bɔbɔ nɔ dzi me,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: amesi le ame bɔbɔɖeanyiwo kpɔm ɖa le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi la nu?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Eya, amesi fɔ ame tsa la tso ʋuʋudedi me kple ame dahe la tso ba me;

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: ne wòatsɔe aɖo bubumewo gbɔ, aɖo eƒe dukɔ la ƒe bubumewo gbɔ;

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: amesi na konɔ la nɔa aƒe me, ne wòakpɔ dzidzɔ ahe vidada ene. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Esime Israel nu tso Egipte, Yakob ƒe aƒe la tso fiafialawo dome la,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda nye eƒe kɔkɔeƒe, eye Israel nye eƒe fiaɖuƒe.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu kpɔe, eye wosi, Yordan gbugbɔ ɖe megbe;

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: towo ti kpo abe agbowo ene, togbɛwo abe alẽviwo ene.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu, nya kae dzɔ, be nèsi, wò, Yordan, be nègbugbɔ ɖe megbe?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Mi towo, be miele kpo tim abe agbowo ene, eye mi togbɛwo abe alẽviwo ene?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Anyigba, dzidzi neƒo wò le Aƒetɔ la ŋku me, le Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋku me;

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: amesi na agakpe zu tsíta, eye ahliha zu tsidzɔƒe!

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Menye míawo o, Yehowa, menye míawo ŋu nade bubui o, ke boŋ wò ŋkɔ la ŋue le wò amenuveve kple wò nyateƒe la ta!

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti dukɔwo anɔ gbɔgblɔm be: Atike ga woƒe Mawu la le?

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Mía Mawu le dziƒo, nusianu, si dze eŋu la, wòwɔna.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Woƒe legbawo nye klosalo kple sika, amegbetɔ ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo wonye.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Nu li na wowomeƒoa nu o; ŋku li na wo, womekpɔa nu o;

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: to li na wo, womesea nu o; ŋɔti li na wo, womeʋẽa nu sena o;

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: asi li na wo, wometea nu kpɔna o; afɔ li na wo, womezɔa azɔli o, eye womeƒoa nu toa ve me o.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Amesiwo wɔa wo kple amesiwo katã ɖoa dzi ɖe wo ŋu la, sɔ kpli wo.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Israel ɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu; woƒe xɔname kple akpoxɔnu wònye!

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Aron ƒe aƒe, miɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu; woƒe xɔname kple akpoxɔnu wònye!

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo vɔ̃a Yehowa, miɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu; woƒe xɔname kple akpoxɔnu wònye!

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖo ŋku mía dzi; ayra Israel ƒe aƒe la, ayrae; ayra Aron ƒe aƒe la;

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: ayra amesiwo vaa Yehowa, ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo siaa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Yehowa adzi mia kple mia viwo de dzi.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Yehowa, dzikple anyigbawɔla, ƒe ame yayrawo mienye.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Dziƒo enye dziƒo na Yehowa, ke etsɔ anyigba na amegbetɔviwo.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Menye ame kukuwoe akafu Yehowa o, alo amesiwo katã yi aʋli me la o;

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: boŋ míawoe akafu Yehowa tso fifia vaseɖe mavɔ me. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Melɔ̃ Yehowa, elabena eɖo to nye gbe kple nye kokoƒoƒo.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Elabena eƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye, eyata mayɔe le nye agbe me ŋkekewo me.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Ku ƒe kawo ɖe to ɖem, tsiẽƒe ƒe ŋɔdzi lém, eye mekpe hiã kple nuxaxa.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Tete meyɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ be: Oo Yehowa, ɖe nye luʋɔ!

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Amenuvela kple dzɔdzɔetɔ enye Yehowa, nublanuikpɔla enye Mawu.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa amesiwo ŋu wɔna mele o la ta; megbɔdzɔ, ke exɔ nam.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ, gagbɔ ɖe me, elabena Yehowa wɔ nyui na wò!

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Elabena eɖe nye luʋɔ tso ku me, nye ŋku tso aɖatsi me kple nye afɔ tso anyidzedze me.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Mazɔ le Yehowa ŋku me le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Mexɔna sena, eyata meƒoa nu; ke wokaa hiãm ŋutɔ.

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Esime dzi ɖe le ƒonye la, megblɔ be: Amegbetɔwo katã nye alakpadalawo

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Aleke maɖo dɔmenyo, siwo katã Yehowa wɔ nam la, teƒe nɛ?

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe na Yehowa le eƒe dukɔ blibo la ŋku me.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Eƒe ame kɔkɔewo ƒe ku nye nu xɔasi le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, wò dɔla menye, wò dɔla, si nye wò dɔlanyɔnu ƒe vi la, menye; wòe tu nye bablawo.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Wòe mase ekpedavɔ na, eye mayɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe na Yehowa le eƒe dukɔ blibo la ŋku me,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: le Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnuwo, le mewò, Yerusalem. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, mikafu Yehowa, midoe ɖe dzi, mi anyigbadzitɔwo katã;

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: elabena amenuveve sɔ gbɔ ɖe mía dzi, eye Yehowa ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ li tegbee. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Israel negblɔ be: Eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Aron ƒe aƒe negblɔ be: Eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Amesiwo vɔ̃a Yehowa la, negblɔ be: Eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Meyɔ Yehowa le xaxa me, Yehowa tɔ nam hetsɔm ɖo teƒe keke.

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa li kplim, enye xɔnametɔ nam, eye makpa nye ketɔwo ɖa kple ŋku.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Enyo be, woasi Yehowa atso, wu esi woaɖo dzi ɖe amegbetɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo katã ƒo kɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ dzi metsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Woƒo kɔ ɖe ŋunye, ẽ, woƒo kɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ dzi matsrɔ̃ wo da le.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Woƒo kɔ ɖe ŋunye abe anyiwo ene, eye wotsi ahe aŋɔkadzo ene, Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ dzi matsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Enya tu asim, be madze anyi, ke Yehowa xɔ nam.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Nye ŋusẽ kple nye ha enye Yehowa, eye wònye nye xɔname.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Aseye kple dzidzɔɣli le didim le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe agbadɔwo me be: Yehowa ƒe nuɖusi wɔa kalẽ!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nuɖusi ɖea dzi, Yehowa ƒe nuɖusi wɔa kalẽ!

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Nyemaku o, ke boŋ mana agbe axlẽ Yehowa ƒe ɖówɔwɔwo afia.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Yehowa he to nam, gake medem asi na ku o.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Miʋu dzɔdzɔenyenyegbowo nam, ne mage ɖe eme ada akpe na Yehowa.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe agboe nye esia, ame dzɔdzɔewoe age ɖe eme.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na wò, be nèɖo tom, eye nènye xɔnametɔ nam.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Kpe, si xɔtulawo gbe la, eyae trɔ zu dzogoedzikpe.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbɔ esia tso, enye nukunu le míaƒe ŋkuwo me.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Esia nye ŋkeke, si Yehowa wɔ, mina míatso aseye, eye míakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe eŋu!

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Oo Yehowa, xɔ na mí, Yehowa, na wòadze edzi dzro!

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Woayra amesi gbɔna le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ dzi! Míeyra mi tso Yehowa ƒe me.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye Mawu, eye wòklẽ na mí. Mibla ŋkekenyuie vɔsalãwo kple ka de vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu!

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu nenye, mada akpe na wò; nye Mawu, mado wò ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo fɔɖiɖi mele woƒe azɔlime ŋu o, amesiwo zɔna le Yehowa ƒe se la me.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo wɔa eƒe ɖaseɖiɖiwo dzi, amesiwo dinɛ tso dzi blibo me;

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: womewɔa nu vɔ̃ɖia ɖeke hã o, eye wozɔa eƒe mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Ekema ŋu makpem o, nenye be, meɖe ŋku ɖe wò seawo katã.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Matsɔ dzi, si toa mɔ ɖeka la, ada akpe na wò, ne mesrɔ̃ wò ɖoɖo dzɔdzɔeawo,

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Malé ŋku ɖe wò ɖoɖowo ŋu, megagblẽm di keŋkeŋ o!

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Aleke ɖekakpui alẽ eƒe mɔ atsɔ fɔɖiɖi manɔmee? Ne elé ŋku ɖe eɖokui ŋu ɖe wò nya la nu.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Medi wò tso dzi blibo me, megana matra tso wò seawo gbɔ o!

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Meɣla wò nyawo ɖe nye dzi me, ne nyemagawɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Yehowa, woakafu wò, fia wò ɖoɖowom!

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye nuyiwo axlẽ wò nu me ɖoɖowo katã afia.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Mekpe dzidzɔ ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe mɔwo ŋu abe ɖe kesinɔnu vovovowo ŋu ene.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Maɖe ŋugble le wò sededewo ŋu, eye maɖe ŋku ɖe wò mɔwo.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Nye dzeme akɔ ɖewò ɖoɖowo ŋu, nyemaŋlɔ wo be o.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyuie na wò dɔla, ne mana agbe ale ŋku ɖe wò nya la ŋu.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Klo nu ɖa le nye ŋku dzi, ne makpa nukunuwo le wò se la me!

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Amedzroe menye le anyigba dzi; megaɣla wò se la ɖem o!

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Wò ɖoɖowo yome didi ɣesiaɣi na nye luʋɔ gbã gudugudu.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Eblu ɖe dadala, siwo woƒo fi de la ta, amesiwo tra tso wò se la gbɔ.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Mli ŋukpe kple vlodoame da le ŋunye, elabena meléa ŋku ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu!

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Ne amegãwo kpe ta, eye wole nu ƒom le ŋunye hã, wò dɔla dea ŋugble le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo nye nye dzidzɔ kple adaŋudelawo nam.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ le ɖe anyigba ŋu, gbɔ agbem le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mexlẽ nya fia le nye zɔzɔme ŋu, eye nèɖo tom. Fia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Na mase wò sededewo ƒe mɔwo gɔme, eye mayi tame le wò nukunuwo ŋu.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ fa aɖatsi le nuxaxa ta; fam ɖe tsitrenu le wò nya la nu!

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Te aʋatsomɔ ɖe aga tso gbɔnye, eye natsɔ wò se la ve nunye!

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Metia nyateƒemɔ, eye metsɔ wò ɖoɖowo tu enyi ɖe ŋkunye me.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Yehowa, meku ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu, megana ŋu nakpem o.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Maƒu du le wò sewo ƒe mɔ dzi, elabena èvu nye dzi gbloto.

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Yehowa, fia wò ɖoɖo ƒe mɔm, eye malé ŋku ɖe eŋu vaseɖe nuwuwu!

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Na gɔmesesem, ne malé ŋku ɖe wò se la ŋu, eye malé eme ɖe asi tso dzi blibo me.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Na mato wò se la ƒe mɔ dzi, elabena eƒe nu nyo ŋunye.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Bi nye dzi de wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu, eye menye de ŋubiabia ŋu o.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Ɖe nye ŋku ɖa le nu dzodzrowo kpɔkpɔ ŋu. Gbo agbem le wò mɔ dzi!

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Wɔ wò ŋugbe, si nèdo na amesiwo vɔ̃a wò la, dzi na wò dɔla.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Na nye ŋukpe, si vɔ̃m mele la, nu nayi; elabena wò ɖoɖowo nyo.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wò sewo le dzroyem; tsɔ wò dzɔdzɔenyenye gbɔ agbem.

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò amenuveve kple wò xɔname neva dzinye le wò ŋugbedodo la nu,

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: ne maɖo nye ŋu na amesi le alɔme ɖem le ŋunye la; elabena meɖo ŋu ɖe wò nya ŋu.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Megaɖe nyateƒenya la ɖa le nunye keŋkeŋ o, elabena mele wò ɖoɖowo sinu dzɔm.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Malé ŋku ɖe wò se la ŋu ɣesiaɣi ɖaa tegbee,

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: eye mazɔ le teƒe keke, elabena medi wò se la yome.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Maƒo nu le wò ɖaseɖiɖi la ŋu le fiawo ŋku me, eye ŋu makpem o.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Nye dzeme akɔ ɖe wò se, siwo melɔ̃na la ŋu.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mawu nye alɔ dzi ɖe wò se, siwo melɔ̃na la ŋu, eye made ŋugble le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu.

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Wɔ wò nya dzi na wò dɔla, le esi nèna mele mɔ kpɔm ta.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Esia nye akɔfafa nam le nye hiã me be, wò nye la gbɔ agbem.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Dadalawo le fewu ɖum le ŋunye vevie ŋutɔ, ke nyemete ɖe aga le wò se la ŋu o.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Yehowa, meɖo ŋu wò se le tso mavɔ me ke, eye mete akɔ ne ɖokuinye.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Dzi kum heliheli ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi, siwo gblẽ wò see ɖi la ŋuti.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Wò ɖoɖoanyiwo nye hadzidzi nam le aƒe, si me menye amedzro le.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Yehowa, meɖoa ŋu wò ŋkɔ le zã me, eye meléa ŋku ɖe wò se la ŋu.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Esia su asinye, elabena medzra wò sededewo ɖo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye nye gome, megblɔ be, malé ŋku ɖe wò nyawo ŋu.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Meƒo koko na wò tso dzi blibo me, ve nenye le wò ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Mebu tame le nye zɔzɔme ŋu, eye metrɔ nye afɔ ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mewɔ kaba, be malé ŋku ɖe wò seawo ŋn, eye nyemalala o.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe kawo ɖe to ɖem, ke nye ŋku medzo le wò se la dzi o.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Mefɔ le zãtiƒe, be mada akpe na wò le wò ɖoɖo dzɔdzɔeawo ta?

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ̃ menye na amesiwo katã vɔ̃a wò kple amesiwo léa ŋku de wò sededewo ŋu.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò amenuveve yɔ anyigba dzi fũ; fia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Yehowa, èwɔ nyuie na wò dɔla le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Fia gɔmesese nyui kple nunyam; elabena mexɔ wò nya dzi se.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
