translation_verse: Hafi woava bɔbɔm ɖe anyi la, metra mɔ, ke azɔ le melé ŋku ɖe wò nya ŋu.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wò dɔme nyo, eye nèwɔa nu nyui, fia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Dadalawo da alakpa ɖe asinye; ke nyea melé wò seawo me ɖe asi tso dzi blibo me.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzi ku ami ahe ami ene, ke nyea mekpɔ dzidzɔ le wò seawo ŋu.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Enyo nam ŋutɔ be, wobɔbɔm ɖe anyi, ne masrɔ̃ wò ɖoɖowo.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Wò nu me sewo nyo nam wu sika kple klosalo akpe nanewo.

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Wò asiwo wɔm, eye woɖɔm ɖo; fia nunyam, ne masrɔ̃ wò seawo!

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Amesiwo vɔ̃a wò la, woakpɔm ahakpɔ dzidzɔ, elabena mele wò nya la sinu kpɔm.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Yehowa, menyae be, wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo le eteƒe, eye nèbɔbɔm ɖe anyi le nyateƒe la me.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Wò amenuveve nenye akɔfafa nam le wò ŋugbedodo na wò dɔla la nu.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ neva dzinye, ne mana agbe, elabena wò se la enye nye dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Ŋu nekpe dadalawo, elabena wotem ɖe anyi yakatsyɔ; ke nyea wò seawo ŋu medea ŋugble lena.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Amesiwo vaa wò kple amesiwo nya wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo, netrɔ ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Fɔɖiɖi meganɔ nye dzi ŋu le wò ɖoɖowo me, ne ŋu nakpem o.

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Nu le nye luʋɔ ŋu le wò xɔnɔme didi me wò nye sinu kpɔm mele.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Nu te nye ŋkuwo ŋu le wò ŋugbedodo didi me be: Ɣe kaɣi nafa akɔ nam?

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mele abe lãgbɔlẽgolo, si le dzokɔ ene hã, nyemɔŋlɔ wò ɖoɖowo be o.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Wò dɔla ƒe ŋkekewo la, nenie wole? Gbekagbe nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu yonyemetilawo?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Dadalawo ɖe ne num, wo amesiwo mewɔa nu ɖe wò se la nu o.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Wò seawo katã nye nyateƒe; wole yonyeme tim yakatsyɔ, xɔ nam!

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Ekpɔtɔ vie wotsrɔ̃m ɖa le anyigba dzi kloe, ke nyemegblẽ wò seawo ɖi o.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Gbɔ agbem le wò amenuveve la nu, eye malé ŋku ɖe wò nu me ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò nya la li ke ɖe dziƒo tegbee.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Wò nuteƒewɔwɔ li tso dzidzime yina dzidzime, èɖo anyigba anyi, eye wòtɔ ɖe tsitrenu.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Woli vaseɖe egbe, elabena wo katã wole suhɔwòm.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye wò see nye nye dzidzɔ o la, anye ne metsrɔ̃ ɖe nye hiã me.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Nyemaŋlɔ wò sewo be tegbee o, elabena woawo nétsɔ gbɔ agbem.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Tɔwò menye, xɔ nam, elabena mebiaa wò seawo ta sena.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo de xa ɖe ŋunye, be yewoatsrɔ̃m, ke nye la meléa ŋku ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: Nothing is completely perfect, except your teachings.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ nuwo katã ƒe nuwuwu, ke seƒeɖo meli na wò se la o.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Aleke gbegbe nyemehelɔ̃a wò se lae o! Nye ŋugbledede wonye ɖaa.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wò se la wɔm nunyalae wu nye futɔwo, elabena tɔnyee wonye tegbee.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Medze nunya wu nye nufialawo katã, elabena wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo nye nye ŋugbledede.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Mese nu gɔme wu ame tsitsiwo, elabena melé wò seawo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Mete nye afɔ ɖe megbe tso toƒe vɔ̃ɖiwo katã gbɔ, ne malé ŋku de wò nya ŋu.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Nyemete ɖa le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu o, elabena wòe fia num.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Wo nyawo vivi na nye veme wu anyitsi le nye nu me.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Wò sewo na medze nunya, eyata melé fu aʋatsomɔwo katã.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Wò nya enye akaɖi na nye afɔ kple kekeli na nye toƒe.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Meka atam, eye nyemagbe edziwɔwɔ o be: Malé ŋku de wò ɖoɖo dzɔdzɔeawo ŋu.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Wobɔbɔm ɖe anyi ŋutɔ, Yehowa, gbɔ agbem le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Yehowa, na nye nu ƒe vɔsa faawo nadze ŋuwò, eye fia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Melé nye agbe ɖe asiƒome ɖaa, ke nyemeŋlɔ wò se la be o.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tre mɔ nam, ke nyemetra ɖa tso wò seawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo nye nye domenyinu tegbee, elabena woawoe nye nye dzi ƒe dzidzɔ.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔ̃ be, yeawɔ wò ɖoɖowo dzi tegbee vaseɖe nuwuwu.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Melé fu adzɔveeɖulawo, ke melɔ̃a wò se la.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Ɣaɣlaƒe kple akpoxɔnu nènye nam; wò nya la sinu dzem mele.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Mi nu vlo wɔlawo, mite ɖa le ŋunye, ne malé nye Mawu ƒe seawo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Lém ɖe asi le wò ŋugbedodo la nu, ne manɔ agbe, megana ŋu nakpem le nye mɔkpɔkpɔ me o.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Do ŋusẽm, ne woaxɔ nam, eye makpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu tegbee.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Egbe amesiwo katã tra tso wò ɖoɖowo gbɔ, elabena woƒe alakpadada mele ɖeke me o.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Eɖe anyigba dzi ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã ɖe aga abe aŋuka ene, eyata melɔ̃a wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Nye lãme lulu le wò ŋɔdzi ta, eye wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ tso dzika ƒo nam.

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Mewɔa nusi le eteƒe kple nusi edzɔ; megagblẽm ɖe amesiwo tem ɖe anyi la si me o.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Xɔ nya ɖe wò dɔla nu hena eƒe nyui, ne dadalawo nagatem ɖe anyi o.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Nu te nye ŋkuwo ŋu le wò xɔname kple wò ŋugbedodo dzɔdzɔe la ŋuti.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wɔ na wò dɔla le wò amenuveve la nu, eye nafia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Wò dɔla menye, fia nunyam, ne madze si wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo!

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nuwɔɣi do edzi, elabena wotu wò se la.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Eyatae melɔ̃a wò seawo wu sika kple sika nyuitɔ ɖo.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Eyata mebua wò seawo katã be, wole eteƒe; melé fu aʋatsomɔwo katã.

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo nye nukunu, eyata nye luʋɔ léa wo me de asi.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ne woʋu go wò nya la, eklẽna, eye wòfiaa nunya amesiwo ŋu wɔna mele o.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Meke nu de te, eye nye veme ƒu, elabena wò seawo le dzroyem.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye nave nunye, abe alesi wòdze amesiwo lɔ̃a wò ŋkɔe la ene.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò nya la li ke nye afɔɖeɖe, eye megana nu vɔ̃ɖia ɖeke naɖu fia de dzinye o!

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso amegbetɔwo ƒe tetedeanyi me, ekema malé ŋku de wò seawo ŋu.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Na wò ŋku me naklẽ ɖe wò dɔla dzi, eye nafia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Yehowa, dzɔdzɔetɔ nenye, eye wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo le eteƒe.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Ede wò sewo le dzɔdzɔenyenye kple nuteƒewɔwɔ me ŋutɔ.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Ŋuʋaʋa le wu ye ge, elabena nye ketɔwo ŋlɔ wò nya la be?

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Wò nya me kɔ ŋutɔ, eye wò dɔla melɔ̃a nu le egbɔ o.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Nyemele ɖeke me o, eye wodo vlom, ke nyemeŋlɔ wò sewo be o.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Wò dzɔdzɔenyenye le dzɔdzɔe tegbee, eye wò se la nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Hiã kple xaxa dzɔ de dzinye, ke wò seawo nye nye dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo le dzɔdzɔe tegbee; fia nunyam, ne manɔ agbe.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Meyɔ wò tso dzi blibo me, Yehowa, ɖo tom; malé wò ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Meyɔ wò, xɔ nam, ne malé ŋku ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Meɖo ɣli, hafi ŋu nava ɖe le eme; wò nya la sinu dzɔm mele.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo le te hafi zãdzɔɣiwo ɖo, bene made ŋugble le wò nyawo ŋu.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Ɖo to nye gbe le wò amenuveve la nu; Yehowa, gbɔ agbem le wò ɖoɖoawo nu.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Amesiwo le ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ yome tim la, gogo, wole adzɔge tso wò se la gbɔ.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ètsɔ kpuiƒe, eye wò seawo katã nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Xoxoxo ke menya le wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu be, èɖo wo anyi tegbee.

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye hiã ɖa, eye naɖem, elabena nyemeŋlɔ wò se la be o.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Wɔ nye dzre, eye naɖem; gbɔ agbem le wò ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Xɔname le aga tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo gbɔ, elabena womebiaa wò ɖoɖowo ta sena o.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔ gbɔ, Yehowa, gbɔ agbem te wò ɖoɖoawo nu.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Yonyemetilawo kple nye ketɔwo de ha; ke nyemete ɖe aga tso wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ ame mawɔnuteƒewo, eye wòvem be, womeléa ŋku ɖe wò nyawo ŋu o.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Kpɔe ɖa dzro, melɔ̃a wò seawo; Yehowa, gbɔ agbem le wò amenuveve la nu.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Wò nya ƒe taƒoƒo enye nyateƒe, eye wò ɖoɖo dzɔdzɔeawo li tegbee.

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Amegãwo ti yonyeme yakatsyɔ, eye nye dzi dzo nyanyanya le wò nya la ta.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Dzi le dzɔyem ɖe wò ŋugbedodo la ŋu, abe amesi kpɔ aboyonu geɖe ene.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mele tu aʋatso, eye menyɔ ŋui; ke melɔ̃a wò se yia.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Mekafua wò zi adre le ŋkeke me, le wò ɖoɖo dzɔdzɔeawo ta.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa gã le amesiwo lɔ̃a wò sea la si, eye nukiklia ɖeke meli na wo o.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mele mɔ kpɔm na wò xɔname, eye mewɔa wò seawo dzi.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ léa ŋku ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu, eye melɔ̃a wo vevie ŋutɔ.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Meléa ŋku ɖe wò seawo kple ɖaseɖiɖiawo ŋu, elabena nye mɔwo katã le ŋknwò me.

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye ɣli netu wò; fia nunyam le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Nye kokoƒoƒo nede ŋkuwò me, ɖem le wò ŋugbedodo la nu!

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Nye nuyiwo adudu kafukafu aƒo ɖi, elabena èfia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Nye aɖe adzi ha le wò nya la ŋu, elabena wò seawo katã le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Na wò asi nakpe ɖe ŋunye, elabena metia wò seawo.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò xɔname le dzroyem, eye wò se la enye nye dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ nenɔ agbe, ne wòakafu wò, eye wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo nekpe ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Metra abe alẽ bubu ene; di wò dɔla, elabena nye ŋku medzo le wò seawo dzi o.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Meyɔ Yehowa le nye xexe me, eye wòɖo tom.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Yehowa, de nye luʋɔ tso aʋatsonuyi kple alakpaɖe si me!

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Nuka alakpaɖe ana wò, eye nuka wòatsɔ akpee na wò?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Ele abe aʋawɔlawo ƒe aŋutrɔ, siwo wonyrẽ; eye abe yɔkuti ƒe dzokawo.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Baba nam be, medze Mesex gbɔ, eye mele Kedar ƒe agbadɔwo gbɔ!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ le ŋutifafa ƒe ketɔwo gbɔ eteƒe didi ŋutɔ.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Nye la ŋutifafa ɖeɖe menye, ke ne meƒo nu ko la, woawo dzea aʋa gɔme.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Mewu mo dzi ɖe toawo ŋu, afika xɔname atso ava nama?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nye xɔname atso Yehowa, dzikple anyigbawɔla gbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Mana ke naɖe le wò afɔ te o; ŋuwòdzɔla medɔa akɔlɔ̃e o.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Israel-ŋudzɔla medɔa akɔlɔ̃e, eye medɔa alɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye ŋuwòdzɔla, Yehowa enye wò vɔvɔli le wò nuɖusi me.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Ɣe maɖu wò le ŋkeke me o, eye ɣleti hã le zã me o.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Yehowa adzɔ ŋuwò tso vɔ̃wo katã me, adzɔ wò luʋɔ ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Yehowa adzɔ wò dodo kple wò gbɔgbɔ ŋu tso fifia ɖaseɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe mɔzɔha. Dzi dzɔm, esime wogblɔ nam be: Mina míayi Yehowa ƒe me.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Míaƒe afɔwo le tsitre ɖe wò agbowo me, Yerusalem!

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Wò Yerusalem, si wogbugbɔ tso, eye nèlé abe du, si wotsiã ɖe wo nɔewo nu ene.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Gama ƒomeawo, Yehowa ƒe ƒomeawo yina, ne woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, nusi nye se na Israel.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Elabena gama woɖo zikpui anyi ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu, Dawid ƒe aƒe la ƒe zikpui.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Mibia ŋutifafa na Yerusalem! Amesiwo lɔ̃a wò la, woanɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa nenɔ wò gliwo me, eye gbɔdzɔe nenɔ wò fiasãwo me! Le nɔvinyewo kple xɔ̃nyewo fa madi ŋutifafa na wò.

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Le Yehowa, mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ta madi wò nyui.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Wò amesi bɔbɔ nɔ dziƒo, wòe mefu mo dzi ne

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Ve mía nu, Yehowa, ve mía nu, elabena vlododo ɖi ƒo na mí ŋutɔ.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Amesiwo li bɔkɔɔ ƒe alɔmeɖeɖe kple dadalawo ƒe vlododo ɖi ƒo na míaƒe luʋɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe mɔzɔha. Israel negblɔ be: Ɖe menye Yehowa ye le mía dzi o,

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: esime amegbetɔwo tso ɖe mía ŋu, ɖe menye Yehowa ye le mía dzi o la,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: anye ne womi mi agbagbe, esime woƒe dɔmedzoe bi ɖe mía ŋu;

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: anye ne tɔ ɖe mí, eye tɔsisi si to míaƒe luʋɔ dzi;

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: anye ne tɔ dzeagbowo si to míaƒe luʋɔ dzi.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, be metsɔ mí wɔ adelã na woƒe aɖuwo o.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Míaƒe luʋɔ le abe xevi, si le mɔtrela ƒe mɔ̃ka me la ene; mɔ̃ka la lã, eye míawo míesi.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Míaƒe xɔname le Yehowa, dzikple anyigbawɔla, ƒe ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Amesiwo ɖoa dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu la, le abe Zion-to, si meʋana o, eye wòli tegbee la ene.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Towo ƒo xlã Yerusalem va kpe, eye Yehowa ƒo xlã eƒe dukɔ va kpe tso fifia ɖaseɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe fiatikplɔ manɔ ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe dzidzenu dzi o, ne ame dzɔdzɔewo magado asi ɖe nu madzɔmadzɔ gbɔ o.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wɔ nyuie na ame nyuiwo kple dzime dzɔdzɔe tɔwo.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo dze yi woƒe mɔ gɔglɔ̃wo dzi la, Yehowa akplɔ wo akpe ɖe nu vlo wɔlawo ŋu ayii. Ŋutifafa nenɔ Israel dzi!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Esime Yehowa gaɖo Zion le la, míezu abe drɔ̃ekulawo ene.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Tete nukoko yɔ míaƒe nume fũ, míaƒe aɖe tso aseye, eye wogblɔ le dukɔwo dome be: Yehowa wɔ nu gã na woamawo.

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Nu gãe Yehowa wɔ na mí vavã, eyata dzi dzɔ mí ɖo!

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Amesiwo ƒã nu kple aɖatsiwo la, woaŋe nu kple aseyetsotso.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Azɔli dzi wole le avi fam hele nuku ƒaƒãwo tsɔm, ke wotsɔ lu bablawo gbɔ va aƒee kple dzadzɔ.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Salomo ƒe mɔzɔha. Ne Yehowa metu xɔ o la, dzodzroa etulawo le agbagba dzem le eŋu; ne Yehowa medzɔ dua ŋu o la, dzodzroe dzɔla le ŋudzɔ.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Dzodzroe míefɔa fɔŋli, eye míelalana ʋuu kekeke hafi bɔbɔ nɔa anyi, be miaɖu míaƒe hiãbolo; alea kee wònaa nu eƒe eme vevi la le alɔ̃ mee.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsuviwo nye domenyinu tso Yehowa gbɔ, eye fufɔfɔ enye fetu.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Woayra ŋutsu, si wole daku me na taŋ. Ŋu makpe wo o, ne woa kple futɔwo kpe nya le agboa nu.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Woayra amesi vɔ̃a Yehowa, eye wòzɔa eƒe mɔwo dzi la.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Aɖu wò ŋutɔ asiwò me nu; woayra wo, tɔwò me nyo.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃wò le abe weinka, si tsena ene le wò xɔ ƒe xɔgã me, eye viwòwo le abe amiti fẽwo ene le wò kplɔ̃ ŋu godoo.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, alea woayra ŋutsu, si vɔ̃a Yehowa enye si.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Yehowa ayra wò tso Zion, eye àkpɔ Yerusalem ƒe dzɔghenyuie le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Eye àkpɔ viwòwo ƒe viwo. Ŋutifafa nenɔ Israel dzi!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Israel negblɔ be: Woxaxam ɖo zi geɖe tso nye ɖekakpui me,

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: zi geɖe woxaxam ɖo tso nye ɖekakpui me, ke womede nunye o.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Agbleŋlɔlawo ŋlɔ nye mẽdome, eye wodze boliƒo lebe.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa nya dzɔdzɔetɔ, elã ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe kawo.

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Ŋu akpe amesiwo le fu Zion, eye woagbugbɔ ɖe megbe.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Woana abe xɔtagbe, si yrɔna hafi woava yi eho ge ene,

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: si meyɔa nuŋela ƒe asiƒome alo nublala ƒe abɔdome o!

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo tso eme va yina la, magblɔ be: „Yehowa ƒe yayra nenɔ mía dzi, míeyra mi le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me“ o.

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Yehowa, globoƒe mete yɔwòm tso!

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo to nye gbe, eye nalé to ɖe nye kokoƒogbe ŋu.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ne èbe, yealé vodadawo ɖi la, Aƒetɔ, ameka anɔ te ma?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Elabena gbɔwò tsɔtsɔke le, ne woavɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Mele mɔ kpɔm na Yehowa, nye luʋɔ le mɔ kpɔm, eƒe nya sinu dzɔm mele.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ le mɔ kpɔm na Aƒetɔ la wu zãdzɔla na ŋdi, wu zãdzɔla gɔ̃ na ŋdi.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israel, kpɔ mɔ na Yehowa, elabena amenuveve geɖe le Yehowa si, eye ɖeɖe bɔ ɖe esi!

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Eye wòaɖe Israel atso eƒe vodadawo katã me.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe mɔzɔha. Yehowa, nye dzi mele dadam o, ŋku tusã mele tanye o, eye nyemezɔna le nu gã, siwo nye nuku nam la me o.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Israel, kpɔ mɔ na Yehowa tso fifia vaseɖe mavɔ me!

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Yehowa, ɖo ŋu Dawid ƒe dagbadagbawo katã;

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: eya, amesi ka atam na Yehowa, eye wòɖe adzɔgbe na Yakob ƒe ŋusẽtɔ la be:

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: „Nyemage ɖe nye aƒe ƒe agbadɔ me o, eye nyemade dɔnyeƒe ƒe abati dzi o,

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime makpɔ teƒe na Yehowa kple nɔƒe na Yakob ƒe ŋusẽtɔ la.

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, míese eŋkɔ le Efrata, eye míekpɔe le Yaar-gbegbe.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Mina míayi enɔƒe, eye míaɖe ta agu ɖe eƒe afɔɖodzinu ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía kple wò ŋusẽ ƒe aɖaka la mitso yi wò gbɔɖemeƒe la!

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Wò nunɔlawo neta dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye wò mawumemewo netso aseye.

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Le wò dɔla Dawid ta megagbe wò amesiamina la ƒe mo o.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Yehowa ka nyateƒetam na Dawid, eye matrɔe o be: Wò alimevi matsɔ aɖo wò fiazikpui dzi.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Ne viwòwo le nye nubabla kple ɖaseɖiɖi, si mefia wo la, me de esi le ekema wo viwo hã anɔ fiazikpui dzi na wò tegbee.

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa fia Zion, eye wòdi be, wòanye nɔƒe na ye.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: Nye gbɔɖemeƒe enye esia tegbee, afii manɔ, elabena eye medi.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Mayra woƒe nuɖuɖu, eye matsɔ abolo aɖi ƒo na woƒe ame dahewo.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mata xɔname na woƒe nunɔlawo, eye woƒe mawumemewo atso aseye sesĩe.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Gama mana dzo nato ɖo na Dawid, eye matsɔ akaɖi bibi aɖo anyi na nye amesiamina la.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Mata ŋukpe na eƒe futɔwo, ke eƒe fiakuku aklẽ le ta nɛ.

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe mɔzɔha. Kpɔ ɖa, aleke mehenyo, eye wòvivinae, ne nɔviwo le afi ɖeka!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ele abe ami: vevi le tame hetsyɔ ɖe ge me, tsyɔ ɖe Aron ƒe ge, si dze eƒe awu to la, me ene!

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ele abe Xermon-zãmu, si le tsyɔtsyɔm ɖe Zion-towo dzi la ene; elabena gama Yehowa ɖo yayra kple agbee tegbee.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Mɔzɔha. Mikafu Yehowa, mi Yehowa ƒe dɔlawo katã, mi amesiwo tsia tre ɖe Yehowa ƒe me le zãwo me!

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Miwu miaƒe asiwo dzi ɖo ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la gbɔ, eye mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Mikafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, mi Yehowa ƒe dɔlawo, mikafui;

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: mi amesiwo tsia tre ɖe Yehowa ƒe me, le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnuwo!

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, elabena Yehowa ƒe dɔme nyo; midzi kafukafuha na eƒe ŋkɔ, elabena vivi le eŋu.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa tia Yakob na eɖokui, eye wòtsɔ Israel wɔ eɖokui tɔe.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Elabena menyae be, Yehowa lolo, eye mía Aƒetɔ ƒo mawuwo katã ta.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si dze Yehowa ŋu la, ewɔnɛ le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi, le atsiaƒuwo me kple gogloƒewo katã.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi nana alilikpo hona yia dzi tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu, ewɔa dzikedzo, ne dzi le wuwum, eye wòkplɔa ya donɛ tso eƒe nudzraɖoƒe;

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: eya, amesi wu Egipte-ŋgɔgbeviwo tso amewo tɔ dzi vaseɖe lãwo tɔ dzi;

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: eɖo dzesiwo kple nukunuwo de dowòme, Egipte, ɖe Farao kple eƒe dɔlawo katã ŋu;

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: eya, amesi si dukɔ geɖewo, eye wowu fia sesẽwo;

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ woƒe anyigba wɔ domenyinui, domenyinu na eƒe dukɔ Israel.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò ŋkɔ anɔ anyi tegbee, Yehowa, woaɖo ŋku dziwò tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa atso na eƒe dukɔ, eye eƒe dɔme atrɔ ɖe eƒe dɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe legbawo nye klosalo kple sika, amegbetɔwo ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo wonye.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Nu li na wo, womeƒoa nu o; ŋku li na wo, womekpɔa nu o;

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: to li na wo, womesea nu o; eye gbɔgbɔa ɖeke hã mele woƒe nu me o.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Amesiwo wɔ wo kple amesiwo katã ɖoa dzi ɖe wo ŋu la, di woamawo.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, mikafu Yehowa; Aron ƒe aƒe, mikafu Yehowa;

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Lewi ƒe aƒe, mikafu Yehowa; mi amesiwo vɔ̃a Yehowa, mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa tso Zion, eye amesi le Yerusalem! Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na mawuwoƒe Mawu la, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na aƒetɔwo dzi Aƒetɔ la, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi ɖeɖeko wɔa nukunuwo, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi wɔ dziƒo de nunya me, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi keke anyigba de tsiwo dzi, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi wɔ nu keklẽ gãwo, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ɣe naɖu ŋkeke dzi, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo naɖu zã dzi, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi wu Egiptetɔwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòkplɔ Israel tso wo domee, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: kple asi sesẽ kpakple abɔ, si wodo ɖe dzi, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi mã Avaƒu ɖe eve, elabena eƒe amenuveve li legbee;

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòna Israel to wo domee yi, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòʋuʋu Farao kple eƒe aʋakɔ de Avaƒua me, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi na eƒe dukɔ la to gbedzi, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi si fia gãwo, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wowu fia xɔŋkɔwo, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Amoritɔwo ƒe fia Sixon, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Og, Basan-fia, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ woƒe anyigba wɔ domenyinui, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: domenyinu na eƒe dɔla Israel, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi ɖo ŋku mía dzi, esime wòbɔbɔ mí ɖe anyi, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòɖe mí tso míaƒe ketɔwo si me, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi na nuɖuɖu ŋutilãwo katã, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na dziƒo Mawu la, elabena eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babel-tɔsisiwo nu, gama míebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖo hele avi fam, esime míaƒe ŋku ɖo Zion dzi.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Amuti, siwo le afima la, ŋu míeku míaƒe kasaŋkuwo ɖo.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Elabena afima amesiwo ɖe aboyo mí la, di ha tso mía nu, eye amesiwo ha mí la, di dzidzɔ tso mía si le hegblɔ be: Midzi Zion-ha na mí!

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Aleke míadzi Yehowa ƒe ha le anyigba tutɔ dzi? Yerusalem, ne meŋlɔ wò be la, ekema nye nuɖusi netu!

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Nye aɖe nalé ɖe aŋɔme, nenye be, nyemeɖo ŋku dziwò o, nenye be, Yerusalem meƒo nye dzidzɔwo ta o!

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Yehowa, do ŋku Edom-viwo kple Yerusalem ƒe ŋkeke la dzi, amesiwo gblɔ be: Migbãe, migbãe vaseɖe gɔmegɔmea ke!

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Babel-nyɔnuvi, wò aƒedo, woayra amesi aɖo nusi nèwɔ mí la, teƒe na wò!

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Woayra amesi alé wò vidziewo axlã ɖe agakpe!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Makafu wò tso dzi blibo me, eye madzi kafukafuha na wò le mawuwo ŋku me.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Made ta agu ɖe wò gbeɖoxɔ kɔkɔe la ŋgɔ, eye makafu wò ŋkɔ le wò amenuveve kple wò nyateƒe la ta, elabena èna wò ŋugbedodo kɔ gbɔ wò ŋkɔwo katã ta.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Gbesigbe meyɔ wò la, ètɔ nam, ède dzi ƒo nam, eye nèɖo ŋusẽ nye luʋɔ.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, anyigba dzi fiawo katã akafu wò, nenye be, wose wò numenya;

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: eye woadzi ha le Yehowa ƒe mɔwo ŋu be, Yehowa ƒe bubu nye gã.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa lolo, ekpɔa ame bɔbɔɖokui, eye wòdzea si dadala tso adzɔgba.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ne mele zɔzɔm le xaxa me la, àgbɔ agbem; àdo wò asi ɖa ɖe nye futɔwo ƒe dɔmedzoe ŋu, eye wò nuɖusi axɔ nam.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Yehowa awɔe aɖe goe nam. Yehowa, wò amenuveve li tegbee; megagblẽ wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo ɖi o.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha na henɔ la. Yehowa, èdzro menye, eye nèdze sim.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Enya nye anyinɔnɔ kple nye tsitretsitsi, eye nèdze si nye susuwo tso adzɔgedzɔgee ke.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Edo nye azɔlizɔzɔ kple nye anyimɔmlɔ kpɔ, eye nye mɔwo katã le nyanya na wò.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Elabena nyaa ɖeke mele nye aɖe dzi o, kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa, ènya wo keŋ.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Etsɔm ɖe to me le megbe kple ŋgɔ, eye nèɖo wò asi dzinye.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Nunya sia nye nuku nam akpa, ekɔ, nyemate ŋn anya ta le enu o.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Afika madzo le wò gbɔgbɔ la gbɔ ayi, eye afika masi atso wò ŋku me ayi?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Ne melia yi dziƒo la, èle afima, eye ne metsɔ tsiẽƒe wɔ mlɔnyeƒee ta, èle gama;

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: ne metsɔ agudzedze ƒe aʋalawo dzoe, eye meɖanɔ atsiaƒu ƒe mlɔenu la,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: kpɔ ɖa, wò asi aɖakplɔm tso gama hã, eye wò nuɖusi além.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Ne mebe, viviti netsyɔm hã la, ekema zã azu kekeli anɔ ŋunye;

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: viviti ke hã meɖo tsizi le ŋkuwò me o, eye zã me kɔ abe ŋkeke ene; viviti kple kekeli la ɖeka wole.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Elabena wòe wɔ nye ayikuwo, eye nèkpɔ tanye le danye ƒe dɔme.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na wò le alesi wowɔm nukutɔe la ta; wò dɔwɔwɔwo nye nukunu, eye nye luʋɔ dze si esia keŋ.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Nye ƒuwo meɣla ɖe wò, esime wowɔm le ɣaɣlaƒe, eye wolɔ̃m ɖe wo nɔewo me le anyigba ƒe gogloƒe o.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Esi menye ʋukɔe la, wò ŋkuwo kpɔm, eye woŋlɔ ŋkeke, siwo katã ava emegbe, siwo dometɔa ɖeke meli haɖe o la, ɖe wò agbalẽ me.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, Mawu, wò susuwo xɔ asi nam ŋutɔ! Aleke woƒe xexlẽme mehesɔ gbɔe o!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Ne mebe, maxlẽ wo la, wosɔ gbɔ wu ke! Ne menyo la, megale gbɔwò ko.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Oo Mawu, ne nahawu ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖe! Mi ŋutsu hlɔ̃dolawo, mite ɖa le gbɔnye!

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖe nyemalé fu amesiwo léa fu wò, eye nyemanyɔ ŋu amesiwo tsona ɖe ŋuwò la oa?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Mele fu wo gbidigbidi, futɔwo wozu nam.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Mawu, dzro menye, eye nadze si nye dzi, dom kpɔ, eye nadze si nye susuwo!

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Eye ne èkpɔ be, fukpekpemɔ le ŋkunye me la, kplɔm to mɔ tegbeetɔ la dzi!

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Amesiwo le nu vɔ̃ɖi susum ɖe dzi me, eye wole aʋawɔwɔ dim gbesiagbe;

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: wole woƒe aɖewo nyrem abe da fɔ ene; ƒli ƒe aɖi le woƒe nuyiwo te. Sela.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Yehowa, kpɔ tanye tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me, eye nadzram ɖo tso ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo si me, amesiwo ɖo ɖe tame be, yewoaɖe afɔ le tenye aƒu anyi.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Dadalawo ɖo adoboli kple ka nam, woɖo ɖɔ ɖe mɔ to, eye wotre kpa nam. Sela.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Megblɔ na Yehowa be: Nye Mawu nenye, Yehowa; se nye kokoƒogbe.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Aƒetɔ la, enye nye xɔname sesẽ, ètsyɔ nu ta nam le aʋakpegbe.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Yehowa, megawɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi la ƒe didi dzi o; megaxɔ de eƒe tameɖoɖo dzi, ne wòado eɖokui ɖe dzi o. Sela.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Ne woke ta dzi ɖe to ɖem la, ekema woƒe nuyiwo ƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e nenyẽ tsyɔ wo!

english_verse: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.
translation_verse: Nena dzoka nadza ɖe wo dzi, netsɔ wo ƒu dzo kple ʋe me, be womegafɔ akpɔ o.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu aɖe vɔ̃e tɔ megali ɖe anyigba dzi o; ŋutsu ŋutasẽla la dzɔgbevɔ̃e neyɔe ɖe nu kplikplikpli.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Menyae be, Yehowa adrɔ̃ nya na hiãtɔwo, eye wòatso na ame dahewo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Yehowa, mele yɔwòm, afɔ netsɔ ɖe ŋunye; se nye gbe, ne mele yɔwòm.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Nye gbedodoɖa nenɔ ŋkuwò me abe dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe ene, eye nye asiwo wuwu dzi nenɔ abe fiẽnuɖuvɔsa ene.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖo dzɔla na nye nu, eye nabu nye nuyiwo ƒe mɔnu ŋu!

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Megana nye dzi natrɔ ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi ŋu, ne mawɔ nu tovo akpe ɖe ŋutsu, siwo nye nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo la ŋu o, eye megana maɖɔ woƒe nuɖuɖu ŋanɛ akpɔ o!

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Ne ame dzɔdzɔe ƒom la, lɔlɔ̃e; ne ehe to nam la, tamemi wònye, nye ta magbee o, nenye be, ele ewɔm atraɖi hã. Meɖoa gbe ɖa ɖe woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Ne wotutu woƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo tso agakpe dzi ƒu abu me le ekema woase nye nyawo be, wovivina.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Alesi woŋlɔa anyigba, eye wokanɛ la, nenema wokaka míaƒe ƒuwo hlẽ na tsiẽƒe ƒe nu me.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Elabena wò Yehowa, Aƒetɔ la, wò dzi ko metsɔ ŋku ɖoe, gbɔwò mebe ɖo, megaƒo nye agbe ɖe anyi o!

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Kpɔ tanye tso adoboli, si woɖo nam, kpakple nu vlo wɔlawo ƒe mɔ̃wo me.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã nadze woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ɖɔ me, eye nye ya mate eŋu ayi!

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe nufiameha, esime wònɔ agado me; gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye gbe do ɣli na Yehowa, nye gbe metsɔ ƒo koko na Yehowa.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Metrɔa nye nuxaxa kɔna ɖe eŋku me, eye meɖea nye hiãwo fiana le eŋku me.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Ne nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu la, ènyaa tonyeƒe. Woɖo adoboli ɖe mɔ, si dzi metona la dzi nam.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋku ɖe ɖusi me, eye nakpɔ nu, nye ame nyanyɛa ɖeke meli o, eye sitsoƒe bu dem; amea ɖeke meli, si biaa tanye sena o.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Le to ɖe nye nuxaxa ŋu, elabena nu ti kɔ nam ŋutɔ; ɖem tso yonyemetilawo si me, elabena wotri akɔ wum.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe ha. Yehowa, se nye gbedodoɖa, lé to ɖe nye kokoƒoƒo ŋu, eye naɖo tom le wò nyateƒe kple dzɔdzɔenyenye nu!

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Eye megaɖrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò dɔla o, elabena ŋkuwò me la agbagbea ɖeke menye dzɔdzɔetɔ o.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Elabena futɔ la ti yonyeme, exlã nye agbe ɖe anyi, eye wòdem viviti me abe amesiwo ku xoxoxo ene.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu, eye nye dzi lulu ɖe menye.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Meɖo ŋu blemaŋkekewo, mede ŋugble le wò nuwɔwɔwo kalã ŋu, eye mesusu wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Meke nye alɔwo me na wò; nye luʋɔ ƒe veme ƒu ɖe ŋuwò kplakplakpla abe anyigba ene. Sela.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Yehowa, netsɔ naɖo tom, nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu, megaɣla wo ŋku me ɖem, ne maɖi amesiwo yi aʋli me la o.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Na mese wò amenuveve le ŋdi, elabena ŋuwò mele ŋu ɖom ɖo; ɖe mɔ, si mato la fiam, elabena wòe mewu nye luʋɔ dzi na.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖem tso nye futɔwo si me, elabena gbɔwò mebe ɖo.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Fia wò lɔlɔ̃num mawɔ, elabena nye Mawu nènye; wò gbɔgbɔ nyui la nekplɔm to anyigba sɔsɔe dzi!

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Yehowa, gbɔ agbem le wò ŋkɔ la ta; ɖe nye luʋɔ tso xaxa me le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la ta!

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Le wò amenuveve la ta gblẽ nye futɔwo, eye natsrɔ̃ amesiwo katã lé fu nye luʋɔ, elabena wò dɔla menye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Dawid tɔ. Woakafu Yehowa, nye agakpe, amesi fia avuwɔwɔ nye asiwo kple aʋawɔwɔ nye asibidewo;

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: nye amenuveve kple nye mɔ̃ sesẽ, nye sitsoƒe kple ɖelanye kpakple nye akpoxɔnu, si gbɔ mebe ɖo, amesi tsɔ nye dukɔ la ɖe tenye.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Yehowa, nuka nye amegbetɔ be, nèdze sii, kple amegbetɔvi be, nèlé ŋku ɖe eŋu?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ le abe ƒuƒu ene, eye eƒe ŋkekewo le abe vɔvɔli, si va yina ene.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Yehowa, viã wò dziƒo, eye naɖi ɖe anyi; ka asi towo ŋu, ne woatu adzudzɔ.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Da wò dzikedzo, eye naka wo ahlẽ, ɖo wò aŋutrɔ ɖa, eye natɔtɔ wo.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Do wò asi ɖa tso dzi, eye nahem ado goe, ɖem tso tɔ gãwo me kple amedzroviwo si me,

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: amesiwo ƒe nu daa alakpa, eye woƒe nuɖusi nye aʋatsoka nuɖusi!

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mawu, madzi ha yeye na wò, eye maƒo ha na wò le kasaŋku ka ewo tɔ dzi;

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: wò, amesi na dziɖuɖu fiawo, eye nèɖe wò dɔla Dawid tso yi gblẽnu la nu.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Hem do goe, eye naɖem tso amedzroviwo si me, amesiwo ƒe nu daa alakpa, eye woƒe nuɖusi nye aʋatsoka nuɖusi;

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: ne mía viŋutsuwo natsi le woƒe ɖevime abe numiemiewo ene, eye mía vinyɔnuwo nanɔ abe dzogbesɔti, siwo ŋu woŋlɔ le fiasãwo me ene;

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: ne míaƒe nudzraɖoƒewo nayɔ kpaŋ ahaɖe nuwo tsyo ƒomevi anɔ nanam; míaƒe alẽwo nadzi akpe, eye woadzi ɖe dzi akpe nane le míaƒe lãnyiƒewo;

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: ne míaƒe nyiwo natsɔ agba, ne gli gbagbã kple aboyoɖeɖe meganɔ anyi o, ne nuxaxa magaɖi le míaƒe ablɔwo me o.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Woayra dukɔ, si wòanɔ na alea! Woayra dukɔ, si ƒe Mawu Yehowa nye!

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe kafukafuha. Nye Mawu, medo wò de dzi, wò fia, eye makafu wo ŋkɔ daa tegbee.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Makafu wò gbesiagbe, eye mado wò ŋkɔ ɖe dzi ɖaa tegbee.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Yehowa lolo, eye wòdze kafukafu ŋutɔ, eƒe gãnyenye me dzodzro meli o.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Woakafu wò dɔwawɔwo tso dzidzime yi dzidzime, eye woaɖe gbe ƒã wò nutsuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Made ŋugble le wò gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo nyoawo kple wò nukunuwɔwɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Wò nuwɔwɔ dziŋɔwo ƒe ŋusẽ ŋu woaƒo nu le; maxlẽ nya afia le wò nutsuwɔwɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Woaɖe wò nyuiwɔwɔ gãwo ƒe ŋkuɖoɖodzi afia, eye woatso aseye le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋuti.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla enye Yehowa, medoa dziku kabakaba o, eye eƒe amenuveve sɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye dɔmenyotɔ na amewo katã, eye eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ gbagba ɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã dzi.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã ada akpe na wò, eye wò mawumemewo akafu wò.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Woagblɔ nya le wò fiaɖuƒe ƒe bubu ŋu, eye woaƒo nu le wò ŋusẽ ŋu,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: ne woaɖe eƒe nutsuwɔwɔwo kple eƒe fiaɖuƒe ƒe atsyɔ̃ nyo la afia amegbetɔviwo.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Wò fiaɖuƒe enye fiaɖuƒe mavɔ, eye wò fiaɖuɖu anɔ dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Yehowa tso amesiwo katã dze anyi la xɔ, eye wòfɔ amesiwo katã wobɔbɔ ɖe anyi la, ɖe tsitrenu.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Ŋkuwo katã le asiwo nu kpɔm, eye nèna nuɖuɖu wo ɖe enaɣi;

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: èʋu wò asi me, eye nètsɔ nu gbagbewo katã ƒe nudidi ɖi ƒo na woe.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Yehowa enye dzɔdzɔetɔ le eƒe mɔwo katã me, kple amenuvetɔ le eƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã me.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsɔ ɖe amesiwo katã yɔnɛ, amesiwo katã yɔnɛ le nyateƒe me la gbɔ.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ewɔa amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ la, ƒe didi dzi na wo, esea woƒe ɣli, eye wòxɔna na wo.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa amesiwo katã lɔ̃nɛ la ta, ke etsrɔ̃a ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Nye nu negblɔ Yehowa ƒe kafukafu, eye ŋutilãwo katã nekafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ɖaa tegbee.

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Makafu Yehowa, ŋkeke alesi mele agbe; madzi kafukafuha na nye Mawu, ŋkeke alesi meli.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Migaɖo ŋu ɖe amegãwo, amegbetɔvi, siwo mate ŋu axɔ na ame o la ŋu o!

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Ne eƒe gbɔgbɔ nu tso la, egbugbɔna yia eƒe anyi gbɔ; gbemagbe eƒe tameɖoɖowo nu yina.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Woayra amesi Yakob ƒe Mawu la nye xɔname na, amesi ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ le Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la dzi;

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: eya, amesi wɔ dzi kple anyi, atsiaƒu kple nusiwo katã le eme, eya, amesi léa nuteƒewɔwɔ me ɖe asi tegbee;

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: eya, amesi tsona na amesiwo wote ɖe anyi, eye wònaa abolo dɔwuitɔwo. Ye howa ɖea ga gatɔwo.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Yehowa naa ŋkuagbãtɔwo kpɔa nu, Yehowa fɔa amesiwo wobɔbɔ ɖe anyi la, ɖe tsitrenu, Yehowa lɔ̃a ame dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa amedzrowo ta, eléa tsyɔeviwo kple ahosiwo ɖe asi, eya wòglɔ̃a ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yehowa enye fia tegbee, Zion, wò Mawu le dzidzimewo katã me! Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, elabena kafukafuhadzidzi na mía Mawu la enye, eye wòvivina; kafukafu edzee.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsoa Yerusalem, eƒoa Israel ƒe amesiwo woka hlẽ la, nu ƒu;

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: eya, amesi ɖaa gbe le amesiwo ƒe dzi gbã la ŋu, eye woblaa woƒe abiwo.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi ɖo xexlẽme na dzinuviwo, eye wòyɔa wo katã ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ la lolo, eƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ, eye goléƒe mele eƒe nunya ŋu o.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yehowa léa hiãtɔwo ɖe asi, ke ebɔbɔa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo vaseɖe anyigba ke.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Mixe akpedaha hena Yehowa, mitsɔ kasaŋkuwo ƒo ha na mía Mawu la;

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: eya, amesi tsa alilikpowo xea dziŋgɔli ŋku me, ewɔa tsidzadza hena anyigba, eye wònana gbe miena ɖe towo dzi.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi na nuɖuɖu lãwo kple akpaviãvi, siwo le xɔxlɔ̃m.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Mekpɔa dzidzɔ le sɔ ƒe ŋusẽ ŋu o, eye ŋutsu ƒe ate medzea eŋu o.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Amesiwo vɔ̃a Yehowa la, ƒe nu dzea eŋu, amesiwo le eƒe amenuveve lalam.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Yerusalem, kafu Yehowa; Zion, ɖo wò Mawu ɖe dzi.

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Elabena ewɔ wò agbo ƒe gametiwo sesĩe, eye wòyra viwòwo le mewò;

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: eya, amesi na wò liƒowo ŋu fa, eye wòtsɔ lu ʋaʋã ɖi ƒoe na wò.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi ɖo eƒe nya ɖe anyigba dzi, eye eƒe sedede ɖi ɖu;

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: eya, amesi naa sno abe ɖetifu ene, eye wòwua míãtsi babla abe dzowo ene;

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: eya, amesi tsɔa eƒe tsi babla dana kɔkɔkɔe; ameka anɔ te ɖe eƒe vuvɔ nu?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe nya ɖa, eye wòna wolólo, ena eƒe ya ƒo, eye tsia sina lalala.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Eɖe eƒe nya fia Yakob, eƒe ɖoɖowo kple kɔnuwo fia Israel.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Emewɔ alea na dukɔa ɖeke o, eye womenya eƒe kɔnuwo o. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Mikafu Yehowa tso dziƒo; midoe ɖe dzi le kɔkɔƒewo!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Mikafui, mi eƒe dɔlawo katã, mi eƒe aʋakɔwo katã, mikafui!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Ɣe kple ɣleti, mikafui; mikafui, mi dzinuvi keklẽwo katã!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Mikafui, mí dziƒo ƒe dziƒowo kple mi dziƒotametsiwo!

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, elabena ede se, eye wodzɔ,

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: etsɔ wo ɖo anyi ɖaa tegbee; ena ɖoɖowo, eye emagatrɔ wo o.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa tso anyigba dzi, mi bosowo kple tɔ goglowo katã,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: mi dzo kple dzikpe, sno kple adzudzɔ kpakple ahom, si wɔa eƒe gbe dzi;

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: mi towo kple togbɛwo katã afi tsekuwo kple sedertiwo katã;

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: mi gbemelãwo kple aƒemelãwo kalã kpakple xevi dzogoewo;

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: mi anyigba dzi fiawo kple dukɔwo katã, amegãwo kple anyigba dzi ʋɔnuɖrɔ̃lawo katã,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo siaa, amegã ɖeɖiwo kple ɖeviwo!

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, elabena eƒe ŋkɔ ɖeɖekoe ɖo kpo, eye eƒe gãnyenye xɔ anyigba dzi kple dziƒo.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ewu eƒe dukɔ ƒe dzo ɖe dzi, eyata kafukafu neɖi le eƒe mawumemewo katã, Israel-viwo, dukɔ, si tsɔ ɖe egbɔ la nu! Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Midzi ha yeye na Yehowa, eƒe bubu neɖi le mawumemewo ƒe ha me!

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Israel nekpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ewɔla ŋu; Zion-viwo netso aseye ɖe woƒe ena ŋu!

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ ɣeɖuɖu akafu eƒe ŋkɔ, eye woafsɔ asiʋui kple kasaŋku aƒo ha nɛ!

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe dukɔ ƒe nu nyo eŋu, etsɔa xɔname ɖoa atsyɔ̃ na hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Mawumemewo nekpɔ dzidzɔ le bubu me, eye woagli le wo ɖɔƒewo.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe dodoɖedzi le woƒe nu me, eye yi nuvee le wo si,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: ne woade kɔsɔkɔsɔ woƒe fiawo kple kunyowu woƒe ame ŋkutawo;

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ne woawɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃, si woŋlɔ di la, dzi ɖe wo ŋu. Atsyɔ̃ nye esia na eƒe mawumemewo katã. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa! Mikafu Mawu le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la me; mikafui le eƒe alili sesẽ la me!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Mikafui le eƒe nutsuwɔwɔwo fa; mikafui ɖe eƒe gãnyenye gbogbo la nu!

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ kpẽɖiɖi kafui; mikafui kple saŋku kple kasaŋku!

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ asiʋui kple ɣeɖuɖu kafui, mikafui kple kasaŋkuƒoƒo kpakple dze!

english_verse: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ gakogoe, siwo ƒe gbeme kɔ la, kafui: mikafui kple gakogoe, siwo ɖina sesĩe!

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nusianu, si me gbɔgbɔ le la, nekafu Yehowa! Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Israel-fia Salomo, Dawid vi la, ƒe lododowo nye esia

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: ne woadze nunya kple amehehe, eye woase nuƒoƒo nunyatɔwo gome,

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: ne woaxɔ amehehe, si fiaa gɔmesese ame, dzɔdzɔenyenye, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ na ame ɖokui;

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: ne gegemewo nadze aɖaŋu, eye ɖekakpulwo nadze si nu, eye woabu tame;

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: ne nunyala nasee, eye wòadzi eƒe nunya ɖe dzi, eye mɔ sɔsɔe nasu nugɔmesela si;

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: ne woase lododowo, abebubuwo, nunyalawo ƒe nyawo kple adzowo gɔme.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ enye sidzedze ƒe gɔmetoto; ke bometsilawo doa vlo nunya kple amehehe.

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Vinye, se fofowò ƒe amehehe, eye megagblẽ ɖawò ƒe nufiame ɖi o;

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: elabena seƒoƒotsihe nyui wonye na wò la kple kɔgɛ na wò kɔ. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le ameblelawo ŋuti.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Vinye, ne nuvɔ̃wɔlawo le nuwò blem la, megalɔ̃ edzi o!

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Ne wogblɔ be: Yi kpli mi, míade xa ɖe ʋukɔkɔɖi ŋu, eye míanɔ adeklo dzi ɖe ame maɖifɔ ŋu naneke mawɔmawɔe,

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: míaƒe asi asu nu vevi vovovowo dzi, eye míatsɔ aboyonu ayɔ míaƒe xɔwoe,

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: nana tasɔsɔ ɖeka me kpli mi, eye akplo ɖeka nana mí katã mía si la,

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: ekema vinye, megazɔ ma ɖeka dzi kpli wo o, eye nahe wo afɔ ɖe megbe tso wo toƒe wo.

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Elabena woƒe afɔwo le tsɔtsɔm ɖe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ŋu, eye wole abla ɖem, be woakɔ ʋu ɖi.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Elabena dzodzroe woɖoa mɔ̃ ɖi le xewo katã ŋku me.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Woawo la woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ʋu ŋue wole xa ɖem ɖo, eye woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbe ŋue wole adeklo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Alea wòanɔ na amesiwo katã le viɖe madzɔmadzɔ yome tim lae; aɖe ekpɔlawo ƒe agbe ɖa. Tomaɖomaɖo fe tohehe.

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nunya le ɣli dom le kpɔdomee, eye wòkɔ eƒe gbe dzi le ablɔwo me,

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
