translation_verse: ele ɣli dom le kpɔdomeewo ƒe dzogoe, siwo dzi zi le, kple agbowo nu, du blibo la katã me wòle eƒe nyawo gblɔm le be:

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣi mi gegemewo míalɔ̃ bometsitsi, mi fewuɖulawo miakpɔ dzidzɔ le fewuɖuɖu ŋu, eye mi bometsilawo mialé fu sidzedze ase do?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Mitrɔ kɔ ɖe nye mokaname ŋuti. Kpa ɖa, mana nye gbɔgbɔ nado bɔbɔbɔ, eye mana miadze si nye nyawo.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: míedo toku nye aɖaŋuɖoɖowo katã, eye miegbe nye mokaname la,

english_verse: “So when you are struck by some terrible disaster,
translation_verse: eyata nye hã mako nu le miaƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ŋu, eye maɖe alɔme, ne ŋɔdzi xa aƒe na mi,

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: ne ŋɔdzi xa aƒe na mi abe dziya ene, eye miaƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e do abe ahom ene; ne hiã kple xaxa va mia dzi.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: Ekema woayɔm, eya nyematɔ o; woadim, ke womakpɔm o.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Le esi wolé fu sidzedze, eye womedo Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ o,

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: le esi womelɔ̃ ɖe nye aɖaŋuɖoɖo dzi o, eye woɖo vlo nye mokanamewo katã ŋuti la,

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: eyata woaɖu woƒe zɔzɔme ƒe kutsetsewo, eye woƒe aɖaŋuɖeɖewo neɖi ƒo na wo.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Elabena gegemewo ƒe godzedze wua woawo ŋutɔwo, eye bometsilawo ƒe anyinɔnɔ bɔkɔɔ tsrɔ̃a wo.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ke amesi ɖoa tom la, anɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ, eye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ƒe ŋɔdzidoname maɖe dzi le eƒo o.

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne èxɔ nye nuƒoƒo wɔ tɔwòe, eye nèdzra nye sewo ɖo ɖe ɖokuiwò gbɔ,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: be nèƒu wò to anyi ɖe nunya ŋu, eye nèbi wò dzi ɖe gɔmesese ŋuti,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: ẽ, ne èyɔ nunya, eye nèkɔ wò gbe dzi ɖe gɔmesese ŋu la,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: ne édii abe klosalo ene, eye nèdi eyome mɔ abe kesinɔnu, si le to me ene la,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ekema ãse Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ gɔme, eye wò asi atu sidzedze Mawu.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa naa nunya, eƒe nu me sidzedze kple gɔmesese dzɔ tso;

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: edzraa dzɔgbenyuie vavã ɖo ɖi na nuteƒewɔlawo, akpoxɔnu wonye na amesiwo ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o,

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: ne wòakpɔ nu dzɔdzɔe ƒe toƒe ta, eye wòadzɔ eƒe mawumememe ƒemɔ ŋuyi.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ekema ase dzɔdzɔenyenye, nu dzɔdzɔe kple nuteƒewɔwɔ gɔme; mɔ nyuiwo katã gɔme nase;

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: ekema nunya age ɖe wò dzi me, eye sidzedze avivi wò luʋɔ nu.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Tamebubu akpa dziwò, eye gɔmesese adzɔ ŋuwò,

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: ne woade wò tso mɔ va dzi, le amesiwo gbiɔa godzenya la ŋu,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: amesiwo gblẽ mɔ dzɔdzɔe la ɖi, be woazɔ blukɔ ƒe mɔ dzi,

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: amesiwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm ɖe vɔ̃wɔwɔ ŋu, eye wole aseye tsom ɖe godzedze vɔ̃ɖi ŋu,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: amesiwo loƒe le gɔdɔ̃gɔdɔ̃, eye wodze tso woƒe mɔwo dzi;

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: ne wòaɖe wò tso ame tutɔ srɔ̃ si me, tso dutanyɔnu, si ɖea ami de eƒe nyawo la, si me,

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: amesi gblẽ eƒe ɖetugbi me srɔ̃ ɖi, eye wòŋlɔ woƒe Mawu ƒe nubabla be;

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: elabena eƒe aƒe ɖo agu yi ku gbɔ, eye eƒe mɔwo yi tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã yia egbɔ la, womegatrɔna gbɔna o, eye womegava tsoa agbemɔ me o.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Ne nato ame nyuiwo ƒe mɔ dzi, eye nalé ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe toƒe ɖe asi.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Elabena nuteƒewɔlawo anɔ anyigba la dzi, eye ame madifɔwo asusɔ de edzi;

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: ke woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖa le anyigba dzi, eye woaho ame maɖianukwarewo ɖa le edzi.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Vinye, megaŋlɔ nye nufiame be ti, eye wò dzi nedzra nye sededewo ɖo;

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: elabena woade agbenɔnɔ didi, ƒe nyuiwo kple ŋutifafa va na wò kpaŋkpaŋ.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple nyateƒe megate ɖa le ŋuwò o; tsɔ wo de kɔ, ŋlɔ wo ɖe wò dzi ƒe kpe dzi;

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: ekema amenuveve kple gɔmesese nyui asu asiwo le Mawu kple amegbetɔwo ŋku me.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu tso dzi blibo me, ke megaɖo dzi ɖe wò gɔmesese ŋu o.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Le ŋku ɖe eŋu le wò mɔwo katã dzi, ekema ata mɔ na wò.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Meganye nunyala le ɖokuiwò ŋku me o, vɔ̃ Yehowa, eye natsri va;

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: ekema esia ada gbe le wò ƒodo ŋu, eye woana wò ƒuwo me nafa miaa.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò kesinɔnuwo kple wò agblemenuwo katã ƒe gbãlɔwo du bubu Yehowa ŋu,

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: ekema nu ayɔ wò ava taŋtaŋ, eye wein agbagba ɖe wò ahafiãƒe.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Vinye, megagbe Yehowa ƒe amehehe o, eƒe mokaname megaɖu dzi na wò o!

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Elabena amesi Yehowa lɔ̃na la, eya wòhea to na abe vi, si gbɔ fofoa melɔ̃a nu le o ene.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Woayra amesi tu nunya kple amesi ƒe asi su gɔmesese dzi.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Elabena eƒeƒle nyo wu klosaloƒeƒle, eye eƒe viɖe ƒo sika ta.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Exɔ asi wu adzagba, eye wò nuveviwo katã mede enu o.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Agbenɔnɔ didie le eƒe ɖusi me, eye kesinɔnu kple bubu le eƒe mia me.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Eƒe mɔwo nye mɔ vivi, eye eƒe toƒewo katã nye ŋutifafa.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Agbeti wònye na amesiwo lee ɖe asi, eye woayra amesi vãe goŋgoŋ la.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nunyae Yehowa ŋutɔ tsa ɖo anyigba gome anyii, eye gɔmesese wòtsɔ li ke dziƒoe.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Eƒe sidzedze na towo gɔme ŋɔ, eye alilikpowo dza zãmu.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Vinye, megana woate da le ŋkuwò me o; le nunya vavã kple tamebubu me ɖe asi sesie;

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: ekema woanye agbe na wò kple atsyɔ̃ɖonu na wò kɔ.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Ekema ale wò mɔ atsɔ dedie, eye wò afɔ makli naneke o.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Ne èmlɔ anyi la, màɖi vo o, ke boŋ alɔ̃ avivi na wò.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Ne ŋɔdzi ƒo ɖi kpoyi, eye gbegblẽ va ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi la, dzika metso ƒowò o.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ye nye wò ŋuɖoɖeŋutɔ, eye wòakpɔ wò afɔ dzi tso mɔ̃ me.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Megãte nu nyui hiãtɔ, nenye be ŋutete le ŋuwò na ewɔwɔ o.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Ne ele asiwò la, megagblɔ na hawòvi be: „Heyi, ne nagava, etsɔ hã mana wò“ o!

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Megabu vɔ̃ ɖe hawòvi ŋu, esime wòɖe dzi ɖi le gbɔwò o.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Megawɔ dzre kple amea ɖeke yakatsyɔ, ne mewɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke wò o.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Megaʋã ŋu sesẽnuɖula o, eye eƒe mɔã ɖeke megadze ŋuwo o.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Elabena godzela enye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa, ke tsi metoa eya kple dzime dzɔdzɔe tɔ domee o.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe fiƒode le ame vɔ̃ɖi la ƒe me, ke eyraa ame dzɔdzɔe la nɔƒe.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Eɖua fewu le fewuɖulawo ŋu, ke evea ame bɔbɔɖeanyiwo ya nu.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Mi viwo, mise fofowo ƒe amehehe, mido ŋku anyi, ne miadze si gɔmesese.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Nufiafia nyui mele tsɔtsɔm na mi, migagblẽ nye nufiame ɖi o.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Elabena esi menye ɖevi na fofonye, vi fe kple tenuvi na danye la,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: efia num gblɔ nam bena: Wò dzi neku ɖe nye nyawo ŋu, dzra nye sededewo ɖo, ekema anɔ agbe.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Ele nunya, ƒle gɔmesese! Megaŋlɔe be o, eye megate ɖe aga tso nye nu me nyawo ŋu o.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Megaɖe asi le eŋu o, ekema adzra wò ɖo; lɔ̃e, ekema akpa tawò.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nunya ƒe gɔmeloto enye be, woaƒle nunya, eye natsɔ wo kesinɔnuwo katã aƒle gɔmesesee.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Kɔe ɖe dzi, ne wòakɔ wò ɖe dzi, akplɔ bubu aƒu wò, ne ekpla asi kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Aɖɔ seƒoƒotsihe nyui ɖe la na wò, eye woana fiakuku dzeani wò.

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Vinye, see, eye naxɔ nye nyawo awɔ tɔwòe, ekema agbenɔƒe geɖe anɔ asiwò.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Nunyamɔ fiam mele wò, eye mekplɔ wò to toƒe dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Ne ele yiyim la, wò atame maxaxa o, eye ne èle ɖu dzi la, màkli nu o.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Le amehehe ɖe asi sesĩe, megage le asiwò o, dza eŋu, elabena wò agbee wonye.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Megage ɖe ame vɔɖiwo toƒe o, eye megazɔ ame vlowo ƒe mɔ dzi o.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Ɖe kɔ ɖa le eŋu, eye megato edzi o; dze le eŋu, eye nato eŋu ayi

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Elabena woawo la, ne womewó vɔ o kpea, wometea ŋu ɖɔa alo o, eye ne womeƒu ame anyi o la, alɔ̃dɔdɔ buna ɖe wo.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Elabena woɖua nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe abolo, eye wonoa sesẽnuwɔwɔ ƒe wein.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe toƒe le abe agudzedze ƒe kekeli, si nua kɔkɔm ɖe dzi, vaseɖe esime ŋu kena keŋ ene.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe mɔ le abe blukɔ ene; womenya afika wole nu kli ge le o.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Vinye, lé to ɖe nye nyawo ŋu, eye naƒu to anyi ɖe nye nuƒoƒo ŋu.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Womegate ɖa le ŋkuwò me o, dzra wo ɖo ɖe wò dzi ƒe gogloeaƒe.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Elabena agbe wonye na amesiwo katã ƒe asi su wo dzi la, eye woyɔa ɖɔ woƒe ŋutilã blibo la.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Dza wò dzi ŋu wu nuwo katã, elabena eya me agbe tsona.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Ɖe alakpanu da le ɖokuiwò ŋu, eye nam aʋatsonuyi ɖa le ɖokuiwò gbɔ.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Wò ŋkuwo nekpɔ ŋgɔ te, eye wò aɖabawo nelé mɔ ɖeka tso le ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Ɖe toƒe dzɔdzɔe na wò afɔwo, eye wò mɔwo katã nesɔ ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Megadze ɖe ɖusi alo mia me o, te wò afa ɖe aga tso vɔ̃ gbɔ.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Vinye, lé to ɖe nye nunya ŋu, ƒu to anyi ɖe nye gɔmesese ŋu,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: ne nadzra tamebubu ɖo, eye wò nuyiwo nalé sidzedze ɖe asi.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Elabena nyɔnu tutɔ ƒe nuyi le anyĩtsi tsyɔm, eye eƒe veme zrɔ̃ drẽdrẽdrẽ wu ami;

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: ke mlɔe ke la evena wu atsa, eye wòɖana wua yi nuevee.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Eƒe afa ɖi abu yina ku gbɔ, eye tsiẽƒe ku ɖe eƒe abi ŋu goŋgoŋ.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Eƒe toƒewo le ʋuʋum, ke medze sii o, ne megalé agbemɔ la atsa o.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Eyata mi viwo, miɖo tom, eye migate ɖe aga le nye numenyawo ŋu o.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Na wò mɔ naƒo asa nɛ, eye megagogo eƒe aƒe ƒe ʋɔtru o,

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: ne magatsɔ wò atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo na ame tutɔwo kple wò ƒewo na ŋutasẽla o;

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: ne ame bubu magatsɔ wò kesinɔnuwo aɖi ƒoe, eye nusi nèwɔ dɔ kpɔ la, nayi ame tutɔ ƒe me o;

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: eye ne eɖo mlɔeanu na wò, eye wɔna le vɔvɔm le wò ŋutilã kple wò lãkusi ŋu la, màganɔ hũ ɖem

english_verse: and shout, “I hated advice and correction!
translation_verse: anɔ gbɔgblɔm be: Ao, nukaŋuti mehelé fu amehehe, eye nye dzi do vlo mokaname,

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Ekpɔtɔ vie mege ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃ewo tsyo ƒomevi me te takpekpewo kple amehawo dome kloe!

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: No tsi tso wò tsido me, tsidzidzi tso wu vudo me!

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò tsi adzi agba go, eye wò tɔʋuwo asi ɖa gbagbagbea?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Wò ɖeka dɔwò ke woanye, eye ame bubu mekpe ɖe ŋuwò o!

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Wò vudo anye yayra, eye àkpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ɖekakpui me srɔ ŋu,

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: eya, si nye zinɔ dzeameŋu kple sãde nyo la, eƒe no nemu wò, eye eƒe lɔlɔ nena nanɔ ya mum ɖaa.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Ke vinye, nukaŋuti nyɔnu tutɔ ana nana ya mum, eye nakpla asi kɔ na dutanyɔnu?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame ƒe mɔ le nuvo le Yehowa ŋku me, eye eyae ɖea woƒe toƒewo katã.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ame vɔɖi ŋutɔ ƒe vodadawo lénɛ, eye eƒe nuvɔ̃ ƒe ka ɖenɛ.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Eku, elabena eɖo ko le amehehe me, eye eƒe bometsitsi gbogboawo na wòle nagbanagba kum.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne èƒu asi akɔ ɖe hãwòvi nu, eye nèlé fe nu na ame tutɔ,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: wò numenya ɖe nyagbatee dowòme, eye wò numenya lé wò la,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ekema, vinye, wɔ ale, ne naɖe ɖokuiwò — ège ɖe hawòvi si me ɖe — Yi naxlã ɖokuiwò ɖe eƒe afɔ nu, eye naƒoe ɖe hawòvi nu.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Megana alɔ̃ nava wò ŋku dzi o, eye akɔlɔ̃e megaɖo wò aɖaba me o.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Ɖe ɖokuiwò le esi abe sãde ene, eye abe xevi tso mɔ̃trela si me ene. Nyagbegbe na ame le kuviawɔwɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Wo kuviatɔ, yi anyidi gbɔ, kpɔ eƒe nuwɔna ɖa, eye nadze nunya!

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: eƒoa eƒe abolo le dzomeŋɔli, eye wòtua eƒe nuɖuɖu ɖo le nuŋeɣi.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ, ɣekaɣi nanɔ aba dzi ase do? Ɣekaɣi nenyo tso wò alɔ̃dɔdɔ me?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Gadɔ alɔ̃ vie, gadɔ akɔlɔ̃e vie, de asi asitɛ me nagbɔ ɖe eme vie!

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: Ekema wò ahedada aɖi kpe wo ahe mazɔla ene, eye wò hiã ahe ŋutsu, si bla akpa ene. Nuxɔxlɔ le vɔ̃ɖinyenye ŋuti.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: eya, amesi ƒe dzi me ayedzedze le, edoa va de tame ɣesiaɣi, eye wòdea dzra aƒe.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Eyata eƒe gbegblẽ aƒo ɖe edzi kpoyi, agbã zi ɖeka, eye hayahaya manɔ eŋu o.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Nu ade Yehowa lé fui, eye adadrelia nye ŋunyɔ na eƒe luʋɔ:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: dadaŋkuwo, aʋatsoɖe kple asi, siwo kɔa nu maɖifɔ ɖi,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: dzi, si ɖoa tame gbegblẽ, afɔ, siwo tsɔna ɖe vɔ̃ ŋu,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: amesi ɖua aʋatsoɖasefo hedaa alakpa, kpakple amesi dea dzre nɔviwo dome. Le ahasiwɔwɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Blae ɖe wò dzi ŋu dam eye naxatsae ɖewò kɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Ne èle azɔli dzi la, akplɔ wò, ne èmlɔ anyi la, adzɔ ŋuwò, eye ne ènyɔ la, aɖo dze kpli wò.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Elabena akaɖie nye se la, kekelie nye nufiame la, eye agbemɔ enye mokaname, siwo fiaa mɔnu ame la.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Ne nadzra ɖokuiwo do tso nyɔnu vɔ̃ɖi la si me kpakple dutanyɔnu ade zɔzrɔ̃etɔ la si me.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Eƒe tugbedzedze megadzro wò le dzi me o, eye megatsɔ eƒe aɖaba le wò o.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Elabena gbolo ɖe wòɖia gbɔ ame vaseɖe abolo dzi, eye nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ le agbe xɔasi la minyam.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Ɖe amea ɖe ate ŋu aɖe dzo de akɔnu, eye eƒe avɔ nagbe fiafiã?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe amea de azɔ dzoka xɔxɔ dzi, eye eƒe afɔ nagbe fiafiã?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Alea ke wòanɔ na amesi de ehavisrɔ̃ gbɔe; amesiame, si de asi eŋu la, metsi to mahemahe o.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Womedoa vlo fiafitɔ, ne efi fi, be wòatsɔ atsi eƒe dɔwuame nu, esime ƒomenui le ewɔm o;

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: ke ne asi tui la, ado eteƒe zi adre, eye wòatsɔ eƒe me nuwo katã ana.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Gake amesi wɔ ahasi kple nyɔnua ɖe la, tagbɔ gbegblẽtɔ wonye; amesi le didim be, yeatsrɔ̃ yeƒe agbe la, eyae wɔa ale nusia tɔgbe.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Ƒoƒo kple dzu atso eme nɛ, eye eƒe ŋukpe nu matsi o.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋutsu ƒe dziku ɖe wòʋãa ŋu, eye mekpɔa nublanui le hlɔ̃biagbe o.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Avulénua ɖeke malé enuo, eye ne ena nu geɖe hã la, mãlɔ̃ o.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Vinye, dzra nye nuƒoƒo ɖo, eye naɣla nye sededewo ɖe gbɔwò.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Dzra nye sededewo ɖo, ne nana agbe, kple nye nufiamewo ɖo abe wò gadaglamakui ene.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Bla wo ɖe wò asibidewo ŋu, eye naŋlɔ wo ɖe wò dzi ƒe kpe dzi.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na nunya be: nɔvinye nènye, eye nayɔ xɔlɔ̃ na gɔmesese;

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: ne woadzra wò ɖo tso nyanu tutɔ si me, tso dutanyɔnu, si ɖea ami ɖe eƒe nyawo la si me.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Mele nye xa ƒe fesre nu kpa nu to adzrala nu.

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: Eya le tsatsam le kpɔdomee le eƒe dzogoe kasa, eye wòle zɔzɔm ɖo ta eƒe aƒe gbɔ

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: le fiẽ, esime anyigba le tsyɔtsyɔm, le zã kple blukɔ me.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, nyɔnua ɖe le gbolovɔ me va do goe, eye ayedzedze le tame nɛ.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Eƒe mo nyrã, eye wòɖe ku eɖokui, eye eƒe afɔwo gbe be, yewomatɔ ɖe eƒe me o.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Eyae le kpɔdomee fifi, kasiaa eye nye ekem nyo ɖe ablɔ me, eye wòde xa ɖe dzogoe ɖesiaɖe dzi.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Elée hegbugbɔ nu nɛ, eye wòɖo ŋku me kplalaa gblɔ nɛ be:

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: Egbea metso akpedavɔsa xe nye adzɔgbedete ɖe ɖokuinye nu.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Eyata medo be, mado go wò, eye madi wò, eye azɔ la mekpɔ wò.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Meɖo kuntruwo ɖe nye aba dzi, avɔ ŋɔŋɔe, siwo wotsɔ Egipte-ka lɔ̃e.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mewu sikɔni, anowɔtre kple adrike ɖe nye aba dzi.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Eyata na mieno lɔlɔ̃ amu vaseɖe ŋɖi, eye míaƒe dzeme nakɔ ɖe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ me.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Elabena srɔ̃nye mele aƒe o, eyi nugbe didia ɖe;

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: etsɔ gakotoku la ɖo asi yii, gbesigbe dzinu sɔ tegblẽ la ko wòagbɔ va aƒe.

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe nuƒoƒo geɖegeɖeawo blee, eye wòtsɔ eƒe nuyi zɔzrɔ̃e la lẽe.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Ekplɔe ɖo kɔ̃ enumake abe nyitsu, si yina de ewuƒe ene, abe sẽ, si yina gege ge de mɔ̃ me ene,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime aŋutrɔ naƒo ɖe eƒe aklã; eye abe xevi, si zɔ ɖe mɔ̃ dzi, eye menyae be, yeƒe ku wonye o la ene.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Eyata, mi viwo, miɖo tom, eye milé to ɖe nye numenyawo ŋu.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Megana wò dzi nadze ayi eƒe mawo dzi o, eye megatra yi etoƒewo o.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo tsi esi me heɖo baba ɖi la, sɔ gbɔ, eye amesiwo wowu la, ɖe ha.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Eƒe aƒe enye tsiẽƒe ƒe mɔ geɖe, siwo ɖo la ku ƒe xɔgãwo me.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Ɖe nunya mele ɣli dom, eye gɔmesese ƒe gbe mele ɖiɖim oa?

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Etsi tre ɖe togbɛwo tame le mɔ to, kple mɔ ɖogoewo nu.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Ele ɣli ɖom le agboawo xa, le dua ƒe mɔ nu kple ʋɔtruawo nu bena:

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: Ŋutsuwo, míawoe mele ɣli dom na, eye amegbetɔviwoe nye gbe le ɖiɖim na.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Mi bebewuwo, mixɔ ayedzedze na mia ɖokui, eye mi bometsilawo, míxɔ gɔmesese na mía ɖokui!

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Mísee, elabena nya xɔasi gblɔm mele, eye nusi le eteƒe pɛpɛpɛ la, nye nu agblɔ.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Elabena nyateƒe gblɔm nye nu le, eye na vɔ̃ɖi enye ŋunyɔ na nye nuyiwo.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Nye numenyawo katã le eteƒe, eye kple alakpa mele wo me o.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Wo katã me kɔ ne amesiwo dze nunya eye wosɔ na amesiwo ƒe esi tu sidzedze la.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Mixɔ nye amehehe wu klosalo kple sidzedze wu sika nyuitɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Elabena nunya nyo wu adzagba, eye nu veviwo katã mede enu o.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Nye, nunya, gbɔe ayedzedze te, eye asinye mee tamebubu vavã ƒe sidzedze le.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Yehowa-yɔvɔ̃ enye fuléle vɔ̃; melé tu dada, ɖokuidodoɖedzi, mɔ vɔ̃ɖi kple alakpanu.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Tɔnyee nye aɖaŋudede kple edzisusu; nyee nye gɔmesese, eye tɔnyee nye ŋusẽ.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Dzinyee fiawo tonu ɖua fia eye amegãwo ɖea se dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Dzinyee tatɔwo tona ɖua amegã, eye anyigba dzi ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo katã nyea ame ŋkutawo.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Melɔ̃a amesiwo lɔ̃m, eye amesiwo diam la, kpɔam.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu kple bubu, nu xoxowo kple dzɔdzɔenyenye le asinye.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Nye kutsetse xɔ asi wu sika kple sika nyuitɔ, eye nye nukpɔkpɔ nyo wu klosalo nyuitɔ.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ dzi zɔm mele kple nu dzɔdzɔe ƒe toƒe,

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: ne mana kesinɔnu amesiwo lɔ̃am, eye made nu nudzraɖoƒe na wo fũ.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔm menye eƒe mɔ ƒe gɔmetoto, eƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe gbãtɔ tso blema ke.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Tso tititi woɖom, tso gɔmedzedzea me ke, esime anyigba dzo kelekele.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Wodzim, hafi to goglowo navaɖo anyi, hafi ne tsidzɔƒe, siwo me tsi le taŋtaŋ la, neva do anyi.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Wodzim, hafi ne woava ɖi towo ɖe agu me; meɖo ŋgɔ na togbɛwo,

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: hafi ne woava wɔ anyigba kple gbegbe kpakple anyigba goɖoo ƒe anyikɔ gbãlɔwo.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Mele eteƒe, hafi wòwɔ dziƒo, esime wòdzidze dziŋgɔli ɖe tɔ gogloawo dzi;

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: esime wosa alilikpowo ɖe dzi me, eye tɔ goglowo dzi tsi bɔbɔbɔ.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: Esime wòɖo seƒe na atsiaƒu, ne magagbɔ eƒe sedede dzi eyi o, eye wòdo anyigba ƒe zɔ anyi la,

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: menye dɔnunɔla le egbɔ, nye dzeme kɔ gbesiagbe, eye mewɔ dɔ abe fefe ene le eŋku me ɣeawiokatãɣi;

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: mele le eƒe anyigba dzi godoo, eye mekpɔ dzidzɔ le amegbelɔviwo ŋu.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: Eyata, mi viwo, miɖo tom. Woayra amesiwo dzra nye mawo ɖo.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Miɖo to amehehe, ne miadze nunya, eye migagbee o.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Woayra amesi ɖoa tom hedzɔa nye ʋɔtru nu gbesiagbe, eye wòkpɔa nye agbo ƒe agbalinu dzi.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ƒe asi tum la, eƒe asi tu agbe, eye wòkpɔa amenuveve tso Yehowa gbɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo dam ƒu la, wowɔ nu vevi wo ɖokui; amesiwo katã lé dim la, ku lɔ̃m wole.

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nunya tu xɔ, eye wòkpa eƒe sɔti adreawo,

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: ewu eƒe lãwo, edzro eƒe wein, eye wòɖo kplɔ̃ hã;

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: edɔ eƒe dɔlanyɔnuwo ɖa, ne woaɖo ɣli le dua ƒe kɔkɔƒewo be:

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: „Mi bebewuwo, miva dze afii!“ Ele gbɔgblɔm na nunyalawo be:

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: „Miva, ne miaɖu nye abolo, eye miano nye wein, si metɔtɔ la!

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Miɖe asi le bometsitsi ŋu, ne mianɔ agbe, eye milé gɔmesese ƒe mɔ tsa tẽ!

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Amesi le mɔnu fiam fewuɖula la, kplɔa ŋukpe ƒua eɖokui, eye amesi le mo kam na ame vɔ̃ɖi la, dzu wònyena nɛ.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Megaka mo na fewuɖula, ne wòalé fu wò o, ka mo na nunyala boŋ, eye alo wò.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Na nu nunyala, eye wòaganya nu ɖe dzi; fia nu ame dzɔdzɔe, eye wòadzi eƒe nunyanya ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ enye nunya ƒe gɔmetoto, eye sidzedze kɔkɔetɔ la enye gɔmesese.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Elabena wò ŋkekewo asɔ gbɔ to dzinye, eye agbenɔƒewo adzi ɖe edzi na wò.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Ne èdze nunya la, enye viɖe na wò ŋutɔ; ke ne ènye fewuɖula la, wò ɖeɖe akpee.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Ebɔbɔ nɔ zikpui dzi le eƒe aƒe ƒe agbalinu le dua ƒe kɔkɔƒe,

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: ne yeayɔ amesiwo to mɔ dzi yina, amesiwo le woƒe, mɔ tsɔ tẽ be;

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: „Amesi nye gegeme la, neva dze afi!“ Eye wole gbɔgblɔm na nunyalawo be:

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: Tsi, si wofi, eyae vivina, eye vivimebolo le ŋanɛ.“

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Ke menyae be, ŋɔliwo le afima, eye be amesiwo wokpe la, tsiẽƒe ƒe aʋli me wole o.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Salomo ƒe lododowo. Ɖevi nyanu doa dzidzɔ na fofoa; ke ɖevi tsibome enye nuxaxa na dada.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu madzɔmadzɔ menye viɖea ɖeke o; ke dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖea ame tsoa ku; me.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Yehowa megbea ame dzadzɔewo ƒe dɔwuamenutsitsi o; ke etutua ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe didi ɖa.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Amesi wɔa alɔgblɔlɔ le dɔ ŋu la, ado ko, ke veviedolawo ƒe asi hea kesinɔnu vɛ.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒoa nu ƒu le dzomeŋɔli la, vi nyanue, amesi dɔa alɔ̃ le nuŋeɣi la, vi wɔŋukpenanue.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Yayra ava ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ta dzi, ke ŋutasesẽ ɣla de ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu me.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ŋkuɖoɖo ame dzɔdzɔe la dzi zua yayra, ke ame vɔ̃ɖi la ƒe ŋkɔ nyunyɔna.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Amesi nunya le tagbɔ na la, xɔa sedede na eɖokui: ke bometsila si glãgbɔ li na la, ɖea eɖokui gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒe azɔlime ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o la, azɔ dedie; amesi glɔ̃ eƒe mɔ la, asi atui.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Amesi miãa ŋku ɖe ame la, hea dziku ve; bometsila, si glãgbɔ li na la, ɖea eɖokui gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Agbevudo enye ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nu, ke ŋutasesẽ yɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu me.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Fuléle dea dzre aƒe, ke lɔlɔ̃ tsyɔa dzidadawo katã dzi.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Nugɔmeselawo ƒe nuyiwo dzi wokpɔa nunya lena, ke ame manyanuwo ƒe mẽdome tɔ enye ali.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo dzraa sidzedze ɖo; ke bometsila ƒe nu te ɖe gbegblẽ ŋu.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Hotɔ ƒe kesinɔnuwo nye du sesẽ nɛ, ke hiãtɔ ƒe gbegblẽ enye eƒe ahedada.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe wɔa eƒe dɔwɔfetu ŋu dɔ hena agbenɔnɔ, tame vɔ̃ɖi la wɔa eƒe viɖe ŋu dɔ hena nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Amesi dzraa amehehe ɖo le ele agbemɔ dzi; ke amesi mebua mokaname o la, etra mɔ.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Amesi léa fu ame le adzame la, alakpanue; eye amesi ha ame gɔme la, bometsilae.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Dadaƒu megbea nuƒoƒo vivivo me o, ke amesi kpɔa eƒe nuyiwo dzi la, nunyalae.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Klosalo nyuitɔ enye ame dzɔdzɔe le aɖe, ke eme vɔ̃ɖi ƒe dzi mele ɖeke me o.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nuyi kplɔa ame geɖewo; ke numenya wua bometsilawo.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe yayra wɔa ame kesinɔtɔ agbagba madzemadzee.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Alesi nu vlo wɔwɔ nye fefenui na bometsila la, nenema nunya le na nugɔmesela.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Nusi sim ame vɔ̃ɖi le la, eyae dzɔna ɖe edzi; ke ame nzɔdzɔewo ƒe didi vaa eme na wo.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ne ahomya ƒo la, ekema ame vɔ̃ɖi la nu ayi; ke ame dzɔdzɔe la ali ke tegbee.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Alesi aha tsitsi le na aɖuwo kple dzudzɔ na ŋkuwo la, nenema kuviatɔ le na amesi dɔ dɔe.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Yehowa-vɔvɔ dzia agbe me ŋkekewo ɖo edzi; ke ame vɔɖiwo ƒe ƒewo ato ɖe eme?

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe lala zua dzidzɔ, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ zua ya

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe mɔ enye mɔ̃ sesẽ na fɔmaɖila, ke enye gbegblẽ na nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe maʋã akpɔ o tegbee, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo matsi anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nunya míena tsoa ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nu me, ke alakpaɖe atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nuyi nyaa nya dzeto gbɔgblɔ, ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu enye alakpago.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Nuɖanu amebatɔ enye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa; ke nudanu blibo dzea eŋu.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Afisi dàda le la, afima ŋukpe hã le; ke amesiwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui ɖe anyigba la, si me nunya le?

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu menye viɖea ɖeke le dzikudogbe o; ke dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖea ame tsoa ku me.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Ame maɖifɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye taa mɔ na; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe vɔ̃wɔwɔ tsɔnɛ ƒua anyi.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖea wo; ke ame mawɔnuteƒewo ŋutɔ ƒe dzodzro wotsɔna léa woa.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖi la ku la, ekema eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ nu yi, eye ame vlowo ƒe lala zu ya.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Woɖea ame dzɔdzɔe tsoa hiã me, eye ame vɔ̃ɖi xɔna ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Yakamewo ƒe nuƒoƒo tsrɔ̃a wo haviwo; ke nunya wotsɔna ɖea ame dzɔdzɔewoe.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Ne enyo na ame dzɔdzɔewo la, ɖu kpɔa dzidzɔ; eye ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tsrɔ̃ la, aseye ɖina.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe yayra nana ɖu ƒe ŋkɔ ɖea dzi; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu nana wogbãnɛ ƒua anyi.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ame manyanu doa vlo ehavi; ke ame nyanu zia kpi.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Amegɔmezɔla nua go nya ɣaɣla, ke nyateƒetɔ ɣlaa nya.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Ne kplɔla meli o la, dukɔ yia to, ke ɖeɖe toa adaŋudela geɖewo dzi.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Amesi ƒu asi akɔ de ame bubu nu la, eme menyo nɛ o; ke amesi gbe fenuléle la, anɔ dedie.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu nyodɔme ƒe asi sua bubu dzi; ke ŋutasẽlawo ƒe asi sua kesinɔnu ko dzi.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Dɔmenyotɔ woa nyuie na eya ŋutɔ ɖokui; ke ŋutasẽla wɔa nu vevee eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi kpɔa viɖe ƒuƒlu; ke amesi ƒãa dzɔdzɔenyenye la, akpɔ fetu vavã.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye vavã hea agbe ve; ke vɔ̃ɖiyometiti hea ku vɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Amesiwo si alakpadzi le la, ŋunyɔ wònye na Yehowa; ke amesiwo fɔɖiɖi mele woƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o la, ƒe nu nyea eŋu.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Mina míatso gbe, ne woahagbe tohehe na ame vɔ̃ɖi fi! Ke woade ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ƒome ya.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Nyanu dzetugbee, si nye avɔ la, le abe aƒeha, si sikagɛ le ŋɔti me na ene.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe didi enye dzɔgbenyuie ɖeɖe sɔŋ; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ enye dziku.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Amea ɖewo na nu geɖe, ke wokpɔa ho ɖe edzi; amea ɖewo vea nu le nusi dze be, woawɔ la gbɔ, ke ahe ko wodana.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Woaɖi ƒo na luʋɔ dɔmenyotɔ la taŋ, eye woana tsi amesi na tsi wono.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Amesi mia asi ɖe bli dzi la, amewo aɖo ɖiŋu nɛ, ke yayra ava blidzrala ƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Ani esi ti nyuie yome la, eƒe nu adze ame ŋu; ke amesi di vɔ̃ la, ado goe.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖo ŋu ɖe eƒe kesinɔnu ŋu la, adze anyi; ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ade ama abe aŋgba ene.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Amesi gblẽ eƒe aƒe la, aɖu aya; eye bometsila azu dɔla na nunyala.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe kutsetse enye agbeti, eye nunyala xɔa dziwo na eɖokui.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, woɖoa eteƒe na ame dzɔdzɔe ke hã le anyigba dzi, ʋuu keke wòayi ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo nye gea?

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Amesi lɔ̃a amehehe la, elɔ̃a sidzedze; ke amesi léa fu mokaname la, gbemelãe.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Ame nyui ƒe nu nyoa Yehowa ŋu, ke ebua fɔ ayeme la.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ mana amegbetɔ nali ɖi o; ke ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ke maʋã o.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu zãzɛ enye fiakuku na srɔ̃a; ke nyɔnu ŋukpenanuwɔla enye ŋuɖui le eƒe ƒuwo me.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe tamesusuwo le eteƒe; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe adaŋudedewo nye alakpa.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nya ɖea xa ɖe ameʋu ŋu; ke dzi me dzɔdzɔetɔwo ƒe nu ɖea wo.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Woatutu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo aƒu anyi, eye womaganɔ anyi o; ke ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe aƒe atsi anyi.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nunya nue wokafunɛ ɖo, ke wodoa vlo amesi ƒe nya medzea to o.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ame tsa, si si subɔla le la, nyo wu amesi le asi tɔm akɔ, gake abolokoe le ewɔm.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe sea veve na eƒe lãwo ti; ke dzi kplala li na ame vɔ̃diwo.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Amesi de eƒe agble la, akpa abolo fu; ke amesi le nu ƒuƒluwo yome dim la, tagbɔ meli nɛ o.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Nu vlo wɔlawo ƒe aboyonu le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzrom; ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe ke adze.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Nuyiwo ƒe ɖaɖaƒu enye mɔ̃ na vɔ̃ɖitɔ la; ke ame dzɔdzɔe sina le hiã nu.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe nu ƒe kutsetse hea nyui vana nɛ taŋtaŋ, eye nusi ame ƒe asi wɔ la, eya gbugbɔna vana nɛ

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe mɔ dzɔna le eya ŋutɔ ŋku me; ke nunyala doa to aɖaŋuɖoɖo.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Bometsila mesea dzikudodo o; ke amesi ɣlaa eƒe dzu la, nunyalae.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Amesi nu nyateƒe donu le la, gblɔa nusi le eteƒe; ke aʋatsoɖasefo daa alakpa.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Amea, ɖewo ƒe nuƒoƒo le abe yitɔame ene; ke nunyalawo ƒe aɖe daa gbe le ame ŋu.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Nyateƒenuyi anɔ anyi tegbee; ke alakpaɖe anɔ anyi aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka ko.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Alakpa le dzi me na amesiwo ɖo vɔ̃wɔwɔ; ke amesiwo ɖea adaŋu le ŋutifafa ŋu la, hea dzidzɔ vɛ.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃a ɖeke mekpe ame dzɔdzɔe o; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo la, dzɔgbevɔ̃ego wonye.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Alakpanuyiwo nye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa; ke amesiwo wɔa nuteƒe ƒe nu nyoa eŋu

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Nunyala mekɔa nu le eƒe sidzedze dzi o; ke bometsila ƒe dzi doa boblo eƒe bometsitsi.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Veviedola ƒe asi aɖu fia; ke kuviatɔ adzɔ nu.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Nuxaxa le dzi me tea ame ɖe anyi; ke xɔlɔ̃nya doa dzidzɔ na ame.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe tsaa ŋu na eƒe lãnyiƒe; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ kplɔa wo tranae.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ memea eƒe adelã o; ke veviedodo la nu xɔasi wònye na amegbetɔ.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Agbe le dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ dzi; ke mɔ dzeɖexɛ kplɔa ame yia ku mee.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Yi nyanu sea fofoa ƒe amehehe; ke mokaname metsɔa fu ɖe fewuɖula ŋu o.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nu ƒe kutsetse wotsɔna ɖua nu nyui; ke ame mawɔnuteƒewo ƒe dzodzro enye ŋutasesẽ.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Amesi kpɔa eƒe nu dzi la, dzraa eƒe luʋɔ ɖo; ke amesi ke eƒe nuyiwo la, gbegblẽ aɖi kpee.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe la léa fu alakpanya; ke ame vɔ̃ɖe la dea dzu kple ŋukpe eɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye kpɔa amesiwo fɔɖiɖi mele woƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o la ta; ke nu tovo wɔwɔ ƒua nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo anyi.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Amea ɖewo ɖoa kesinɔtɔ wo ɖokui, ke agaga hã mele wo si o; amea ɖewo ɖoa ame dahe wo ɖokui, ke nu hɔ ɖe wo si.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu ame tsɔna ɖea eƒe agbee; ke ame dahe mesea ŋɔdzidonyaa ɖeke o.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe kekeli klẽna nyuie; ke eme vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe akaɖi tsina.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Dadala dzre sɔŋ ko wòhena vɛ; ke nunya le emesiwo nana woɖoa aɖaŋu na wo la dome.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu, si wotso hosuhosudodo kpɔe le azu ʋee, ke nusi woƒo ƒu ʋeʋeʋe la, adzi ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Lala vivivo ɖe wòdoa veve na dzi; ke didi, si va me la, agbeti wonye.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Amesi doa vlo nya la, atsrɔ; ke amesi sedede dzia ŋɔ na la, woaɖo eleƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe nu fia me la, agbevudo wònye, ne woaƒo asa na ku ƒe mɔ̃.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Gɔmesese nyui hea ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ vɛ; ke ame mawɔnuteƒewo ƒe mɔ kplɔa wo dea gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Nugɔmeselɛ wɔa nu ɖe nunya me; ke bometsila tsɔa bometsitsi doa bobloe.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Duxɔla vɔ̃ɖi gena ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e me; ke duxɔla nyateƒetɔ daa gbe le ame ŋu.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Ahedada kple ŋukpe ava amesi gbe amehehe la dzi; ke amesi bu mokaname la, woade bubu eŋu.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Ne ame ƒe didi va me la, evivia luʋɔ nu; ke vɔ̃tsitsri enye ŋunyɔ na bometsilawo.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Ne èzɔ kple nunyalawo la, àdze nunya; ke ne ède ha kple bometsilawo la, azu emegbegblẽ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔe tia nuvɔwɔlawo yome; ke etsɔa nyui tua fe na eme dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Viwo ƒe viwo nyia dɔmenyotɔ ƒe dome; ke wodzraa nuvɔ̃wɔla ƒe nuwo ɖo ne ame dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Agble yeye me nu naa nuɖuɖu eme dahewo fu; ke amea ɖewo tsrɔ̃na to woƒe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Amesi vea nu le eƒe ameƒoti gbɔ la, léa fu via; ke amesi lɔ̃nɛ la, tsona ɖe tohehe ŋu bla.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Nu le ame dzɔdzɔe si wòaɖu aɖi ƒo; ke dɔkoe le ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe ƒodo wɔm.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Nyɔnuwo ƒe nunya tua woƒe xɔ; ke bometsitsi tsɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe asi gbãnɛ ƒua anyi.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Amesi vɔ̃a Yehowa la, toa mɔ dzɔdzɔe dzi; ke amesi toa mɔ gɔglɔ̃ dzi la, doa vloe.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe nu enye ameƒoti hena eƒe dàda; ke nunyalawo ƒe nuyi kpoa wo dzi.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Ne nyiwo meli o la, lãto me ɖia ƒuƒlu; ke nyitsu ƒe ŋusẽ wotsɔna kpɔa agblemenu geɖe.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo nyateƒetɔ mekaa aʋatso o; ke aʋatsoɖasefo daa alakpa.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula le nunya dim ʋuu do kpoa; ke sidzedze le bɔbɔe na nugɔmeselawo.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Te ɖa le bometsila gbɔ, elabena mèdzea si gɔmesese ƒe nuyiwo o.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe ayedzedze enye be, woalé ŋku ɖe woƒe zɔzɔme ŋu; ke bometsilawo ƒe bometsitsi enye alakpa.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Avulévɔsa le alɔme ɖem le bometsilawo ŋu; ke ŋudzedze kpɔkpɔ le nuteƒewɔlawo dome.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Dzi nya eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuxaxa, eye ame tutɔ mate ŋu akpɔ dzidzɔ ɖee ti o.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aƒe agblẽ, ke nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe agbadɔ ade ama.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Amea ɖewo ƒe mɔ dzɔ le wo ŋku me; ke eƒe nuwuwu enye ku ƒe mɔ.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Veve le dzi me wotoa egbɔ koa nu; ke dzidzɔ sia ƒe nuwuwu nyea nuxaxa.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Tosẽla ƒe zɔzɔme ɖia ƒo nɛ, nenema enye ame nyui ƒe nuwɔwɔ hã.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Amebebewu xɔa nya sia nya dzi sena; ke nunyala léa ŋku ɖè eƒe afɔɖeɖe ŋu.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Nunyala vɔ̃na, eye wòtsria vɔ̃; ke bometsila nyrãna, eye wòɖoa dzi ɖe eɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoetɔ wɔa bometsinu; woalé fu amesi ɖoa aye ɖe tame

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Amebebewuwo tae nye bometsitsi, ke nunyalawo vaa sidzedze goŋgoŋ.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖilɔwo abɔbɔ na ame nyuiwo, eye nuvɔ̃wɔlawo anɔ ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe agbo nu.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ƒe hatiwo ke hã léa fui; ke xɔlɔ̃ bɔ ɖe kesinɔtɔ si.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Amesi doa vlo ehavi la, ewɔ nuvɔ̃; ke amesi vea hiãtɔ nu la, woayrae!

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Ɖe amesiwo ɖoa vɔ̃ ɖe tame la, metrana oa? Ke amenuveve kple nyateƒe vana na amesiwo ɖoa nyuie ɖe tame.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Agbagbadzedze hea viɖe ve; ke nu kpoloe ƒoƒo hea hiã vɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe kesinɔnu enye fiakuku; ke bometsilawo ƒe bometsitsi la, bometsitsi ko wònye.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo nyateƒetɔ enye amexɔla ɖe agbe; ke aʋatsoɖasefo enye alakpatɔ!

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Dzideƒo vevi le Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ me, eye sitsoƒe wònye na viawo.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Yehowa-vɔvɔ enye agbevudo, ne woaƒo asa na ku ƒe mɔ̃.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe atsyɔ̃ le dukɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ me; ke ne amewo zu ʋee la, ekema amegãɖuɖu yi to.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Dzigbɔɖitɔ la, nunya geɖe le esi; ke dɔmedzoetɔ ɖoa boblo bometsitsi.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Dzi nyodɔme enye agbe le lã me; ke ŋuʋaʋã enye ŋuɖui le ƒuwo me.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Amesi te ame tsa ɖe anyi la, ɖea alɔme le ewɔla ŋu; ke amesi vea ame dahe nu la, ɖea bubu eŋu.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe vɔ̃wɔwɔ atutui aƒu anyi; ke ame dzɔdzɔe la akpɔ sitsoƒe le eƒe ku me.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Nunya le nugɔmeselawo ƒe dzi me, eye wòɖea eɖokui fiana le bometsilawo dome.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖoa dukɔ ɖe dzi; ke nuvɔ̃ enye anyigbadzitɔwo ƒe ahɔhlɔ̃bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Dɔla nyanu ƒe nu anye fia ŋu; ke ado dziku ɖe esi wɔa ŋukpenanu la ŋu.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Nyaŋuɖoɖo fafɛ tsia dziku nu; ke gbe da ɖe ame gbɔ nana dɔmedzoe flana.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe aɖe hea sidzedze vɛ; ke bometsitsi doa go tso bometsila nu gbẽgbẽgbẽ.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋku le vɔ̃ kple nyui ŋu le afiawo katã.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Aɖe fafɛ enye agbeti; ke ne alakpa le eŋu la, enye abidede dzi ŋu.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Bometsila doa vlo fofoa ƒe amehehe; ke amesi bua mokaname la, adze nunya.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu bɔ ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe la ƒe me: ke gbegblẽ le ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe nuyiwo le dzodzo dom sidzedze; ke bometsilawo ƒe dzi metoa mɔ ɖeka o.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe vɔsa enye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa: ke nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe gbedodoɖa dzea eŋu.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe zɔzɔme enye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa: ke elɔ̃a amesi tia dzɔdzɔenyenye yome?

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Tohehe vɔ̃ɖi enye amesi gblẽ mɔ dzɔdzɔe ɖi la tɔ; amesi lé fu mokaname la, aku.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe kple aʋlime le nuvo le Yehowa ŋku me, ʋuu keke wòahayi amegbetɔtowo ƒe dzi nye ge!

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula melɔ̃na be, woagbe nya na ye o, eye meyia nunyalawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Nugɔmesela ƒe dzi dia sidzedze; ke bometsilawo ƒe nu meɖena le bometsitsi ŋu o.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Hiãtɔ ƒe ŋkekewo katã nye vɔ̃; ke dzi kpɔdzidzɔ enye aglotutu atraɖi.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Nu vi nɔamesi, si ŋu Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ kpe ɖo la, nyo wu kesinɔnu geɖe, si me dzimaɖeɖi le.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Ama agba ɖeka, si ŋu lɔlɔ̃ kpe ɖo la, nyo wu nyitsu dami, si ŋu fuléle kpe ɖo.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoetɔ ɖɔa avu, ke tufala tsia dzre nu.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ ƒe mɔ enye ŋukpɔ; ke nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe toƒe enye mɔ tata.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Vi nyanu doa dzidzɔ na fofoa; ke bometsila doa vlo dada.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Bometsitsi enye ame manyanuwo ƒe dzidzɔ; be nugɔmesela toa mɔ dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Afisi adaŋudede mele o la, tameɖoɖowo tsia akpe dzi; ke afisi adaŋudela geɖewo le la, edzea edzi.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nu ƒe nya ŋuɖoɖo doa dzidzɔ nɛ; eye aleke nya, si wogblɔ de egblɔɣi la, mehevivinae oa?

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe agbemɔ do ta dzi, ne woaƒo asa na tsiẽƒe le anyi me.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbãa dadalawo ƒe aƒe da, ke edoa liƒo na ahosiwo.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Tameɖoɖo vɔ̃ɖi enye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa; ke nya dzeto dzana le eŋku me.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Amesi le zãnuxɔxɔ yome dim la, eƒe aƒe agblẽ; ke amesi lé fu adzɔxɔxɔ la, anɔ agbe.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe dzi bua tame, ne wòaɖo nya ŋu; ke vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ le dodom le ame vɔ̃ɖi nu gbẽgbẽgbẽ.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Yehowa le adzɔge tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo gbɔ, ke esea ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Mokɔkɔ doa dzidzɔ na dzi; nya nyui xɔxɔ dea amí ƒuto me.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: To, si sea mokaname agbetɔ la, nɔa nunyalawo dome.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Amesi gbea amehehe la, edoa vlo eya ŋutɔ ɖokui; ke amesi sea mokaname la, adze nunya.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ enye amehehe, si kplɔa ame dea nunya me; ɖokuibɔbɔ nye xoxo na bubu.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ tɔ enye dzi ƒe tãmeɖoɖowo; ke Yehowa gbɔ aɖe ƒe ŋuɖoɖo tsona.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe zɔzɔmewo katã dzana le eya ŋutɔ ŋku me; ke Yehowa ye daa gbɔgbɔwo kpɔna.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò dɔwo de asi na Yehowa; ekema wò tameɖoɖowo adze dzi.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si Yehowa wɔ la, kple etɔe li, eya ame vɔɖiwo hã hena dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Dadalawo katã nye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa. Mine mítso gbe; ne woahagbe tohehe na wo fi!

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ kple nyateƒe wotsɔna léa avu vodada, eye Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ wotsɔna tsria vɔ̃e.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ƒe zɔzɔme dze Yehowa ŋu la, enana be, eƒe futɔwo ke hã nɔa ŋutifafa me kplii.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Nu ʋee, si ŋu dzɔdzɔenyenye kpe ɖo, nyo wu nukpɔkpɔ geɖe, si ŋu nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ kpe ɖo.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe dzi susua eƒe mɔ ŋu; ke Yehowa ye fiaa mɔ eƒe afɔɖeɖe.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Afiatsotso le fia ƒe nuyiwo me; eƒe nu mada le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ me o.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Nudanu nyui kple nudada nyui tso Yehowa gbɔ, eƒe nuwɔwɔ enye nudakpewo le akplo me?

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Nu vɔɖi wɔwɔ enye ŋunyɔ na fiawo; elabena dzɔdzɔenyenye nana fiazikpui lia ke.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dziku enye ku ƒe dɔla; ke nunyala faa dzi nɛ.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Ne fia ƒe mo kɔ la, agbee wònye, eye eƒe ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ le abe adametsiɖoɖo ene.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Aleke gbegbe nunyakpɔkpɔ mehenyo wu sikae, ete gɔmesesekpɔkpɔ meheƒo klosalo tae o!

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃tsitsri enye nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe mɔtata; amesi léa ŋku de eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu la, kpɔa eƒe agbe ta.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Dada doa ŋgɔ na gbegblẽ, eye ɖokuidodoɖedzi na anyidzedze.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ɖokuibɔbɔɖeanyi la hiãtɔwo dome nyo wu ne woamã aboyonu kple dadalawo.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Amesi léa to de nya ŋu la, eƒe esi sua nyui dzi; amesi ɖoa dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu la, woayrae!

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Amesi si dzi nyanu le la, woyɔna be nugɔmesela; nya vivi dzia nufiame ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Gɔmesese enye agbevudo na amesi si wòle; ke bometsitsi enye tohenu na bometsilawo.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Nugɔmesela ƒe dzi nana eƒe nù dzea nunya, eye eƒe nuyiwo dzia nufiame ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Nya dzeto la anyitsi wonye, evivina na luʋɔ, eye wòyɔa dɔ ƒuwo.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Amea ɖewo ƒe mɔ dzɔna le wo ŋku me; ke eƒe nuwuwu nyea ku ƒe mɔ.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Dɔwɔla ƒe ɖɔwuamee wɔa ɖɔ nɛ; elabena eƒe nùe le ɖu ƒom ɖe ete.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Yakame tia dzɔgbevɔ̃e yome, eye dzo binu le eƒe nuyiwo me.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Alakpatɔ dea dzre aƒe, eye sakplitɔ mãa xɔlɔ̃wo dome.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
