translation_verse: Ŋutasẽla blea ehavi nu, eye wòkplɔnɛ ma mɔ manyomanyo dzi.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Amesi ŋku la, eɖo vɔ̃ ɖe ta me, amesi va nuyi ɖe nu me goŋgoŋ la, ewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe goe xoxo.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Atsyɔ̃fiakuku enye ta ƒowɔ, dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ dzi wokpɔnɛ lena.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Dzi gbɔɖitɔ nyo wu kalẽtɔ, eye amesi ɖua eɖokui dzi la, nyo wu duwo xɔla.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Woda dzidzenu ɖe akɔme, ke Yehowa me nye emetsotso katã.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Abolo ƒuƒlu ɖuɖu, si me dzidzeme le, nyo wu aƒe, si me yɔ fũ kple akpedavɔsa, eye dzre kpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Kluvi nyanu aɖu amegã ɖe aƒevi ŋukpenanuwɔla dzi, eye eya kple nɔviawo anyi dome.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Sonu li de klosalo ŋu, eye kpo li ɖe sika ŋu; ke Yehowa doa dziwo kpɔna.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ɖitɔ léa to ɖe alakpanuyiwo ŋu, eye aʋatsokala ƒua to anyi ɖe gbegblẽ ƒe aɖe ŋu.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖea alɔme le ahetɔ ŋu la, edoa vlo ewɔla; amesi kpoa dzidzɔ le dzɔgbevɔ̃e ŋu la, womagbe tohehe nɛ o.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Amegã ɖeɖi ƒe fiakuku enye viawo ƒe viwo, eye viwo ƒe atsyɔ̃ enye wo fofowo.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Nyagãgbɔgbɔ medze bometsila o, ʋuu keke aʋatsokaka nahayi bubume dze ge o.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Zãnuxɔla bu be, kpe xɔasi wonye yexɔ; afisiafi, si wòtrɔ ɖo la, edzea aye.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖia dziɖaɖa ɖe to me la, ele lɔlɔ̃ dim, ke amesi hea nya xoxo ɖe go la, klãa xɔlɔ̃wo dome.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Nyaheɖeameŋu dea tame na nugɔmeselawo wu na woƒe bometsilawo zi alafa.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Aglãdzela dia vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ yome; nyala woaɖɔ dɔla sɔ̃ŋuta ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Gododo sisiblisinɔ, si ŋu woɖe viwo le la, nyo wu gododo bometsila le eƒe bometsitsi me.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Amesi tsa vɔ̃ ɖo nyui teƒe la, dzɔgbevɔ̃e mate ɖa le eƒe me o.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Dzregɔmetoto le, abe alesi woŋɔa tɔe ene; eyata dzudzɔ, hafi ne wòava do gã.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Amesi tso afia nyui na ame vɔ̃ɖi kple amesi bu fɔ ame dzɔdzɔe la, ŋunyɔ woa kple eve la siaa wonye na Yehowa.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Nukata bometsila lé ga ɖe asi be, yeaƒle nunyae, evɔ tagbɔ mele esi o ɖe!

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ lɔ̃a ame ɣesiaɣi, eye wòtrɔna dzɔa ame nɔvi le hiã me.

english_verse: It's stupid to guarantee someone else's loan.
translation_verse: Amesi Iéa fe nu, eye wòƒua asi akɔ ɖe ehavi nu la, ame manyanue.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Amesi laa dzidada la, ele dzre lɔ̃m; amesi ɖea eƒe agbo wòkɔna tsrala la, ele gbegblẽ dim.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Amesi si alakpadzi le la, makpɔ nu nyuia ɖeke o, eye amesi ƒe aɖe medoa mɔ ɖeka o la, age ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e me.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Amesi dzi bometsila la, akpa nuxaxa, eye bometsila toto makpa dzidzɔ o.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Dzi kpɔdzidzɔ nana lãme hayana, ke gbɔgbɔ xanu nana ƒuwo ƒuna kplakplakpla.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi xɔa zãnu tsoa akɔnu, ne yeaglɔ̃ nya dzɔdzɔe ƒe mɔ.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Nunya le nugɔmesela ŋku me; ke bometsila ƒe ŋku le anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Vi tsibome enye dziku na fofoa kple nuxaxa na dada.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Tohehe na ame dzɔdzɔewo menyo o, ʋuu keke wòahayi bubume, siwo wɔa nuteƒe la, ƒoƒo nye ge o.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Amesi mekea nu kplakplakpla o la, sidzedze le esi, eye ame ɖɔŋuɖo enye nugɔmesela.

english_verse: Even fools seem smart when they are quiet.
translation_verse: Ne bometsila zi kpi la, wohunɛ nunyalae, ne emiã eƒe nuyiwo la, wohunɛ nugɔmeselae.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖe eɖokui ɖe aga le eya ŋutɔ ƒe dzodzro yome dim la, etsia tre ɖe nunyanyawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Gɔmesese medzea bometsila ŋu o, ke boŋ be, wòaɖe eƒe tamesusu ɖe go.

english_verse: Wrongdoing leads to shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Afisi ame vɔ̃ɖi va la, vlododo, alɔmeɖeɖe kpakple ŋukpe vana.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ƒe numenya enye tɔ goglo, eye tɔʋu, si le tsotsom kpakakpaka la, enye nunya ƒe vudo.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi dziɖeɖe, ne woate ame dzɔdzɔe ɖe anyi le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me la, menyo o.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe nuyiwo dea dzre aƒe, eye eƒe nu yɔa ameƒoƒo ɖa.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe nu enye eƒe gbegblẽ, eye eƒe nuyiwo nye mɔ na eya ŋulɔ ƒe agbe.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Sakplitɔ ƒe nyawo le ahe nuɖuɖu ŋanɛ ene, woɖea ɖɔme ke.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Amesi wɔa alɔgblɔlɔ le ɖɔ ŋu la, nugblẽla nɔvl wonye.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ enye mɔ sesẽ; afima ame dzɔdzɔe la sina yina, eye wònɔa dedie.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔ ƒe nuwo nye eƒe du sesẽ, eye wobuna be, gli kɔkɔwo wonye.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Hafi ame nadze anyi la, eƒe dzi dana gbã; ɖokuibɔbɔ doa ŋgɔ na bubu.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Ne amea de mekpe se nya, hafi do eŋu o la, bometsitsi kple ŋukpe wonye nɛ.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ƒe dzidodo tsɔa eƒe fukpekpewo, ke ne wɔna vɔ le dzidodo ŋu la, ameka atsɔ eya?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Nugɔmesela ƒe dzi kpɔa sidzedze, eye nunyala ƒe to dia sidzedze yome.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe nunana naa alɔmeɖeƒee, eye wòkplɔnɛ yia ame ŋkutawo ŋku mee.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Ame gbãtɔ dzena ahe dzɔdzɔetɔ ene le dzrenya me; ke evelia va ɖea egɔme ɖe go.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Nudzidze tsia dzre nu, eye wòtsoa nya me na ŋusẽtɔwo.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Nɔvi, si ŋu woda vo ɖo la, tri akɔ wu du sesẽ, eye dzrewɔwɔ le abe fiasã ƒe gametiwo ene.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ƒe nu ƒe kutsetse aɖi ƒo na eƒe ƒoɖo, eye eƒe nuyiwo ƒe nukpɔkpɔ aɖi ƒo nɛ.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Ku kple agbe le aɖe si me, amesi dze xɔlɔ̃e, aɖu eƒe kutsetsewo.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Amesi si nyɔnu su la, eƒe asi tu nu nyui, eye eƒe nu anyo Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ƒoa koko, ke kesinɔtɔ ɖoa ŋu kple mo kplala.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ̃ geɖe dzedze aʋlie; ke xɔlɔ̃a ɖewo kuna ɖe ame ŋu wu ame nɔvi gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ame dahe, si fɔɖiɖi mele eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o la, nyo wu amesi alakpa le eƒe nuƒoƒo me, eye wonye bometsila.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Nudzodzro tamebubu manɔmee menyo o, eye amesi do du eƒe afɔ la, ada aƒu.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe bometsitsie nana eƒe mɔ glɔ̃na; ke eƒe dzi nyrãna ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu dzea xɔlɔ̃ geɖe ame, ke xɔlɔ̃wo kana le kotɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
translation_verse: Aʋatsoɖasefo metsi tomahe o, eye amesi nu alakpa ɖona le la, masi o.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo wɔa ŋkumenui na bubume, eye amesi naa nu la, amewo katã dzea xɔlɔe.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ame ɖahe nɔvlwo léa fui, ɖe eƒe xɔlɔwoya agbe kaka le eŋua? Amesi ti nya yome la, mezu naneke nɛ o.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒle nunya la, laa eƒe agbe, amesi dzra gɔmesese do la, eƒe asi tu nu nyui.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Aʋatsoɖasefo metsi tomahe o, eye amesi nu alakpa doa le le atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Agbe vivi nɔnɔ medze bometsila o, ʋuu keke kluvi nahayi aƒetɔ ɖu ge ɖe amegãwo dzi o.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Amesi gbee dzi blewu la, nunyalae, eye bubu wonye nɛ, nenye be, eɖe kɔ ɖa le dzidada ŋu.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe nyanyrã le abe dzatavi ƒe gbetete ene; ke eƒe ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ le abe zãmu le gbe dzi ene.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Vi tsibome enye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ne fofoa, eye nyɔnu nyawɔla enye betrɔ, si le ɖuɖum ɖaa.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒe kple kesinɔnuwo nye ɖomenyinu tso eme fofowo gbɔ; ke nyɔnu nyanu la, Yehowa gbɔ wòtsona.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Kuviawɔwɔ ɖe wòɖɔa alɔ̃ eme, eye eme wɔƒome ɖɔe wunɛ.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Amesi dzraa sedede ɖo la dzraa eƒe agbe ɖo; amesi meléa ŋku ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o la, aku?

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Amesi ve ame dahe nu la, edo nugbana na Yehowa, eye wòaɖo eƒe nuwɔwɔ teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: He to na viwò, elabena mɔkpɔkpɔ gali; ke megaɖo ɖe tame be, yeawui o.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Amesi dzi kumi heliheli la, axe tohefe; elabena ne èbe, yeaxɔ nɛ la, ɖeko nagaɖo gãe ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Se aɖaŋuɖoɖo, eye naxɔ amehehe na ɖokuiwò, ne nadze nunya le ɣeyiɣi, siwo gbɔna me.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Tameɖoɖo geɖewo le amegbetɔ ƒe dzi me; ke Yehowa ƒe aɖaŋudede nɔa anyi.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Dɔmenyo enye amegbetɔ ƒe atsyɔ̃, ahedada nyo wu alakpadada.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Yehowa-vɔvɔ̃ hea agbe vɛ, ame aɖi ƒo ana anyi, eye dzɔgbevɔ̃ea ɖeke mava edzi o.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Ne kuviatɔ de asi agba me la, megagbugbɔnɛ yia eƒe nu me tete hã o.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Ne èƒo fewuɖula la, ekema eme bebewu adze nunya; ne woke mo na nugɔmesela la, ekema adze si nu.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Amesi se ŋuta le fofoa ŋu, eye wònyã dada la, vi vloe ŋukpenanuwɔla wònye.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne àse nyagbename vɔ, hafi ava te ɖa le sidzedze ƒe nyawo ŋu la, ekema dzudzɔe dzro.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo vlo ɖea alɔme le nya dzɔdzɔe ŋu, eye ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu mia nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Tohehe le dzadzraɖo ɖi ɖe fewuɖulawo ŋu kple ƒoƒo ɖe bometsilawo ƒe mẽɖome ŋu.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula enye wein, eye zidola enye aha muame, amesi wòmu la, madze nunya o.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi, si le fia ŋu la, le abe dzata ƒe gbetete ene, amesi do adãe la, eto vo ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe agbe ŋu.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Bubu wònye na ame, ne wòƒo asa na dzre, ke amesiwo katã dea dzre aƒe la, bometsilawo wonye.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ be, yemade agble le kele me o, eyata wòdia nu le nuŋeɣi doa kpoe.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ƒe tameɖoɖo ɖe dzi me le abe tɔ goglo ene, ke nugɔmesela ɖunɛ.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo doa go amesi kɔa mo ɖe wo; ke amesi ŋu woaɖo dzi ɖo la, afika woakpɔe le?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe, si ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o la, eme anyo na viawo le emegbe.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Fia, si bɔbɔ nɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui dzi la, ƒe ŋku dea vovo vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔwo katã me.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Amekae ate ŋu agblɔ be: Melólo nye dzi wòkɔ, eye medza tso nye nuvɔ̃wo me?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Nudakpe eve ƒomevl kple nudotree eve ƒomevi la, ŋunyɔ woa kple eve la siaa wonye bia Yehowa.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Ŋutsuvi ƒe nɔnɔme wotsɔna dzea sii be, eƒe nuwɔwɔ adza, eye wòato mɔ ɖeka loo.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: To senu kple ŋku kpɔnu la, Yehowa ye wɔ woa kple eve la siaa.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Megaɖikpi lɔ̃ alɔ̃dɔdɔ akpa, ne nada ahe o; wò ŋku netsi te, ekema abolo abɔ ɖe asiwò.

english_verse: Everyone likes to brag about getting a bargain.
translation_verse: Nuƒlela be: „nua menyo o, menyo o;“ yi ke ne edzo la, ekafua eɖokui.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Sika kple adzagba geɖewo li; ke sidzedze ƒe nuyiwo la, nu veviwo wonye.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Ɖe avɔ le eŋu, elabena eƒu asi akɔ ɖe ame bubu nu, eye natsɔe aɖo awɔba ɖe ame tutɔ ta!

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Alakpabolo vivi na ŋutsu la, ke emegbe kpekui anɔ nu me nɛ.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Tameɖoɖowo vaa eme, ne adaŋudede kpe ɖe eŋu; eyata tsa tamebubuwɔ aʋae.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Amesi ado ɖiŋu na fofoa kple dada la, eƒe akaɖi atsi le blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Domenyinu, si ŋu wotsi hohoho ɖo la, yayra manɔ me o.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Megegblɔ ha „maɖo vɔ teƒe“ o; dzɔ Yehowa sinu, eye wòakpe ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Nudakpe eve ƒomevi enye ŋunyɔ na Yehowa: nuɖanu amehatɔ menyo o.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ƒe afɔɖeɖe tso Yehowa gbɔ, eye ɖe amegbetɔ se eƒe mɔ gɔmea?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Mɔ̃ wònye na amegbetɔ, ne nya ge le enu be: „nua ŋu kɔ!“ emegbe hafi wòayi tame bu ge le adzɔgbeɖeɖe la ŋu.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Fia nyanu ɖea vovo ame vɔ̃ɖiwo me, emegbe wònana wona luƒotasiaɖam toa wo dzii.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe akaɖi enye amegbetɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ, edzroa dɔme ƒe gogloaƒewo.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ kple nyateƒe kpɔa fia ta, eye lɔlɔ̃ lẽa eƒe fiazikpui ɖe te.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Ɖekakpuiwo ƒe atsyɔ̃ enye woƒe ŋusẽ, eye ta ɣi enye amegã ɖeɖiwo ƒe bubu.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Ameƒoka ƒe abidede eme ŋu nyãa vɔ̃ ɖa, nenema enye ƒoƒo, si dea la me ke na ame hã.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dzi le abe tɔʋu ene le Yehowa si me; afisi wòlɔ̃ la, eya wòkplɔnɛ yinae.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu be mɔwo katã dzɔ le eŋku me; ke Yehowa ye daa dziwo kpɔna.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Nusi dzɔ, eye wòle eteƒe la, wɔwɔ nyo Yehowa ŋu wu vɔsa.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Ame vɔɖiwo ƒe akaɖi enye nuvɔ̃, dadaŋkuwo kple dzi, si vu gblotoo.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Veviedola ƒe tameɖoɖo hea viɖe vɛ; ke amesi tsi klokloklo la, dea hiã aƒe.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Alakpaɖe tsɔtsɔ kpɔ kesinɔnui enye ƒuƒu, si nu yina, ku ƒe mɔ̃ wònye.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe sesẽnuwɔwɔ tsrɔ̃a wo; elabena wogbea nusi dzɔ la wɔwɔ.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu fɔɖila ƒe mɔ gɔdɔ; ke ame dzadzɛ la ƒe nuwɔwɔ toe mɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Enyo, ne woanɔ dzogoe dzi le xɔta wu nyɔnu nyawɔla nana aƒe me kple ame.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe luʋɔ le vɔ̃ yome dim, ehavi ƒe nu mewɔa nublanui nɛ o.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Ne wohe to na fewuɖula la, ekema amebebewu dzea nunya; ke ne wofia nu nunyala la, edzea si nu.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔetɔ la ɖea ŋku ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aƒe ŋu, eye wòkplɔa gbegblẽ ƒua ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Amesi xe nu to me ɖe ame dahewo ƒe ɣlidodo la, eya hã ado ɣli, eye womesea o.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Adzamenunana faa dɔmedzoe nu, eye zãnunana, si wohe ɖe akɔnu vɛ la, laa adãwɔwɔ nu.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ enye dzidzɔ na ame dzɔdzɔe; ke enye ŋɔdzi na nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Amesi tra tso gɔmesese ƒe mɔ dzi la, agbɔ ɖe eme le ŋɔliwo ƒe takpeƒe.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Amesi lɔ̃a dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ la, azu hiãtɔ; eye amesi lɔ̃a wein kple ami ʋeʋẽe la, makpa ho o.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi enye avulénu ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe nu, eye ame mawɔnuteƒewo xɔna de nuteƒewɔla teƒe.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Gbedadaƒonɔnɔ nyo wu nyɔnu nyawɔla kple dzikutɔ gbɔ nɔnɔ.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Nu xɔasiwo kple ami le nunya ƒe me, ke bometsila tsɔa wo doa dzodzoe.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Amesi ti dzɔdzɔenywnye kple lɔlɔ̃ yome la, eƒe asi atu agbe, dzɔdzɔenyenye kple bubu.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Nunyala ha kalẽtɔwo ƒe du, eye wòmũa woƒe kpoƒuƒu, si ŋu wole dzi ɖom do la, ƒua anyi.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Amesi dzraa eƒe nu kple aɖe ɖo la, dzraa eƒe agbe ɖo tso hiã me.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Dadala kple adegbeƒola, si wɔa nu tovo vivivo la, woyɔna be fewuɖula.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ ƒe nudzodzro wunɛ, elabena eƒe asi gbe dɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: But people who obey God are always generous.
translation_verse: Wole nu dim gbawotsyogbe; ke ame dzɔdzɔe la naa nu, eye metea ame o.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Ŋunyɔ enye ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe vɔsa, aleke wòahanɔ, nenye ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ ta wohee vɛ ɖo?

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Aʋatsoɖasefo atsrɔ̃; ke amesi se nya kple to la, aƒo nu ɣesiaɣi.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖoa mo vloe; ke nuteƒewɔla léa ŋku ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nunya kple gɔmesese kpakple aɖaŋuɖoɖoa ɖeke meli ɖe Yehowa ŋu o.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Woblaa akpa na sɔ ɖe aʋawɔgbe ŋu, ke Yehowa si mee dziɖuɖu le.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Mia ɖevi ɖe mɔ, si wòato la ŋu, ne eve tsi la, mate ɖa le edzi o.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔ ɖua fia ɖe ame dahe dzi; amesi doa nugbana la, dɔla wònye na agbanatɔ.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒãa nu madzɔmadzɔ la, axa dzɔgbevɔ̃e; eye eƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe toheti atsrɔ̃ eya ŋutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Woayra dɔmenyolɔ, elabena eɖe eƒe abolo hena ame dahe.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Ne ènyã vlodola ɖa la, ekema dzrewɔwɔ hã dzo, eye nyawɔwɔ kple dzu nu yi.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Amesi laa dzi dzadza, eye eƒe nuyiwo nyo la, eya xɔlɔ̃e nye fia.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋkuwo dzɔa sidzedze ŋu; eye wòtrɔa gbo ame dzegowo ƒe nyawo.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Kuvlatɔ be, dzata le xexe ava wu ye le kpɔdome.

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Gboloƒe nu laʋe goglo wònye; amesi Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe xe hã la, eyae gena ɖe eme.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Ne bometsitsi bla ɖe ŋutsuvi ƒe dzi ŋu la, ameƒoti afee ɖa le afima.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Ne wote ame dahe ɖe anyi la, eƒe nuwo ko wobe, nedzi ɖe edzi; ke ne wona nu kesinɔtɔ la, ahedada wònye wokplɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Ƒu to anyi, eye nase nunyalawo ƒe nyawo, eye wò dzi netrɔ ɖe nye nufiame ŋuti.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: Elabena enye, nenye be, nèdzra wo ɖo ɖe wò dzi me, eye wo katã woli ɖe nuyi ŋu na wò.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Be naɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu ta, mele nu fiam wò egbea ɖo he!

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyemeŋlɔ nya vevi, siwo me aɖaŋuɖoɖo kple sidzedze le la, na wò,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: ne mafia wò be, nyateƒenyawo le eteƒe, eye nahe nya vavãwo ayi na amesiwo ɖɔ wò la oa?

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Megaɖa adzo ahetɔ le esi wòda ahe ta o, eye megate hiãtɔ de anyi kple afɔ le ʋɔnu o;

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: elabena Yehowa awɔ woƒe dzre na wo, eye wòada adzo amesiwo da adzo wo la ƒe agbe.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Megade ha kple dɔmedzoetɔ o, eye mia kple dzikutɔ migado ka o;

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: ne eƒe toƒe namã wò, eye nahe gbegblẽ vɛ na wò luʋɔ o.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: elabena ne mate ŋu axe fea o la, ɖe woagbe aha ɖeɖe le tewòa?

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Megatrɔ liƒo xoxo, siwo fofowòwo ɖo la o!

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Kpa amesi zã le eƒe ɖɔwɔwɔ me la ɖa, fiawoe wòasubɔ, eye menye ame tsɛwo wòasuhɔ o.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Megaɖu damevevetɔ ƒe abolo o, eye eƒe nuduɖu vivi megadzro wò o!

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Ne mia kple dziɖulaa ɖe miebɔbɔ nɔ anyi, be yewoaɖu nu la, ekema ɖe ŋku ɖe amesi le ŋkuwò me la vevie;

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: nenye nudzrola nenye la, ekema naɖo hɛ wò vehlo dzi!

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Eƒe nuɖuɖu viviawo megadzro wò o, elabena alakpanuɖuɖu wònye.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wò be, „Ɖu nu, nano nu!“ ke eƒe dzi mele ŋuwò o, elabena alesi wòbu de dzi me la, nenema eyama le.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Meganɔ kutri kum, be nakpɔ ho o; dzudzɔ wò tameɖoɖo sia!

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Ne èkpɔe ɖa la, maganɔ anyi o, elabena eto aʋala hedzo yi dzi abe hɔ̃ ene.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Nusi nèdu la, ele na wò be, nadzɔe, eye ètsɔ wò nya viviwo hã de aka.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Megaƒo nu ɖe bometsila ƒe le me o, elabena ɖeko wòado vlo wò nunya ƒe nyawo.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Megatrɔ liƒo xoxowo o, eye megage ɖe tsyɔ̃eviwo ƒe agble me o;

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Vinye, see, eye nadze nunya, eye naɖo wò dzi mɔ dzɔdzɔe dzi.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Meganɔ weintsunolawo kple lãtsuɖulawo dome o.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Elabena ahatsunola kple nutsuɖula ɖe wodaa ahe, eye alɔ̃tsudɔla ɖe wònɔa ɖuvu me.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Ɖo to folowò, si dzi wò, eye megado vlo dawo, ne eku nyagã o!

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Ƒle nyateƒe, nunya, amehehe kple gɔmesese, eye megatsɔ wo dzra o!

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe fofo tsoa aseye, eye ne amea ɖe dzi vi nyanu la, ekpɔa dzidzɔ le eŋu.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Fofowò kple dawò akpɔ dzidzɔ, eye dawò atso aseye.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Vinye, tsɔ wò dzi nam, eye nye mɔwo nedze wò ŋkuwo ŋu.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Elabena nyɔnu ahasitɔ la, ʋe globo wònye, eye vudo xaxɛ nye gbolo.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: E, ede xa ɖi abe adzodala ene, eye wole ame dzegowo dzim ɖe dzi le amegbetɔwo dome.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Amekae ɖea hũ? amekae sea veve? amekae xaa nu? amekae xɔa abi yakatsyɔ? ameka ƒe ŋku dzie wona dɔ̃?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Amesiwo tsia wein te dedie la tɔe; amesiwo yina, be woade nu aha, si wotɔtɔ me akpɔ la tɔe.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Megade ŋku de wein, alesi wòbiã kple alesi wòle dzo sim le kplu me kpakple alesi wominɛ wóli la o.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Ke emegbe la eɖua ame abe da ene, eye wònyɔa aɖi abe ƒli ene.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Wò ŋkuwo akpɔ nu tutɔwo, eye wò dzi anɔ nya baɖawo gblɔm.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Anɔ abe amesi le atsiaƒu gɔme kple amesi le abalati la me ene.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: „Woƒom, ke mevem o; wotu kɔm, nyemesee o. Ɣekaɣi gɔ manyɔ, ne magaɖi eyome mɔ?“

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Dzi megaku wò ɖe eme vlowo ŋu o, eye megaʋã ŋu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo o,

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Megaʋã ŋu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo o, eye megadzro wò, be naɖe ha kpli wo o;

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: elabena wole gbegblẽ bum le dzi me, eye woƒe nuyiwo gblɔa dzɔgbevɔ̃e.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: elabena ŋu nyui kegbe meli na ame vlowo o, eye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe akaɖi atsi.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Nunya wotsɔna tua xɔe, gɔmesese wotsɔna lia kee,

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: eye sidzedze wotɔna dea kesinɔnu nyui vovovowo woƒe xɔwo me taŋtaŋ.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Vinye, vɔ Yehowa kple fia la, eye megado ka kple godzelawo o;

english_verse: Wisdom brings strength, and knowledge gives power.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu nyanu sesẽna, eye ŋutsu nugɔmesela ɖea ŋusẽ fiana.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Elabena tamebubu natsɔ awɔ aʋae, eye adaŋudela geɖewo hea dziɖuɖu vanɛ.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: elabena woƒe gbegblẽ aƒo ɖi kpo yi, eye ameka nya woa kple eve la ƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e?

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Nunya enye gbloti xɔasi na bometsila, eyata mekea nu le ʋɔnu o.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Nya siawo hã tso nunyalawo gbɔ. Ame dzi dede le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me menyo o.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖoa vɔ̃ be, yeawɔ la, eya woyɔna be ame vɔ.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe tameɖoɖo enye nuvɔ̃, eye fewuɖula enye ŋunyɔ na amegbetɔwo.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Amesi gblɔna na fɔɖila be: „Tɔwò dzɔ“ la, dukɔwo aƒo fi adee, eye anyigbadzitɔwo ado ɖiŋu nɛ.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Ne ègbɔdzɔ le xaxaɣi la, ekema ŋusẽ boo mele ŋuwò o.

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo hea to la, yayra ava wo dzi fu.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Xɔ na amesiwo wokplɔ yina wuwu ge, eye ɖe amesiwo woyina nu ɖa gee la.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Ne ègblɔ be: „Míenyae o“ la, kpɔ ɖa, amesi da dziwo kpɔna la, adze sii, eye amesi ɖea ŋku ɖe wò luʋɔ la, anyae, eye wòaɖo eteƒe na amegbetɔ le eƒe nuwɔwɔ nu.

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Amesi doa nya ŋu tututu la ƒe nuyi wiogbugbɔna.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Vinye, no anyitsi, elabena enye, eye anyixe avivi le wò ve me.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Nenema ke srɔ̃ nunya na wò luʋɔ, eye ne wò asi tui la, ekema ŋkeke li gbɔna na wò, eye wò mɔkpɔkpɔ mazu dzodzro o.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Wɔ wò dɔwo le xexe, eye nade wò agble, emegbe hafi natu xɔ.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Wò ame vɔ̃ɖi, megade xa ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nɔƒe ŋu o; megagblẽ eɖɔƒe o.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Elabena ame dzɔdzɔe dzea enyi zi adre, eye wògafɔna; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzea dzɔgbevɔ̃e me.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Meganye ɖasefo de nɔviwò ŋu dzodzro o, eye megatsɔ wò nuyiwo da alakpae o.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Ne wò futɔ dze enyi la, dzi megadzɔ wò o, eye ne ekli nu la, wò dzi megatso aseye o,

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: bena ne Yehowa nakpɔe, medze eŋu o, eye wòaklo eƒe dɔmedzoe ɖa le eŋu o.

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Megagblɔ be; „Alesi wòwɔm la, nenema mawɔe, eye made eteƒe na ame le eƒe nuwɔwɔ nu“ o!

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Mele kuviatɔ ƒe agble kple ame manyanu ƒe weingble ŋu yi.

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa aŋɔka yɔ eme taŋ, gbe to ɖe eme, eye eƒe kpegliwo mũ.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Tete meɖe ŋku ɖee, eye wòde dzi gbɔ nam, mekpɔe, eye wòzu nuxaxlɔ̃ nam:

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: „Madɔ alɔ̃ vie, madɔ akɔlɔ̃e vie, made asi asitɛ me, ne magbɔ ɖe eme“ la,

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Lododo siawo hã nye Salomo tɔ, eye Yuda-fia Xiskiya ƒe ŋutsuwoe ƒo wo nu ƒu.

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe bubue wònye be, wòaɣla nya, eye fiawo ƒe bubu wònye be, woadzro nye me.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Alesi dziƒo kɔ, eye anyigba gogloe la, nenema fiawo ƒe dzimedzodzro meli o.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Ne woɖe aŋuka ɖa le klosalo ŋu le ekema edzana keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Ne woɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖa le fia ŋku me la, ekema dzɔdzɔenyenye ali ke eƒe fiazikpui.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Megadi bubu na ɖokuiwò le fia ŋku me o, eye megatsi tre ɖe ame ŋkutawo nɔƒe o;

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: elabena ne wogblɔ na wò be: „Te va dzi gome!“ enye wu esi woabɔbɔ wò de anyi le bubume, si nékpɔ hafi la ŋku me.

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: Megatsi klokloklo dzi de dzrewɔwɔ ŋu o, elabena nuka nawɔ emegbe, ne hawòvi do ŋukpe wòa?

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Wɔ wò ŋutɔ wò dzre kple hawòvi; ke megaʋu go ame tutɔ ƒe enya ɣaɣla,

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: ne amesi see la, nana dzuwòm, eye ŋkɔ vɔ̃e natsi ŋuwò o.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Nya, si wogblɔ de egblɔɣi la, sikatɔtɔŋuti wònye le klosalogba me.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Nuxlɔ̃la nyanu enye sikasigɛ kple kɔgɛ, si wotsɔ sika nyuitɔ tui la, na to senu.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Alesi sno fa le nuŋeɣi la, nenema dɔla nuteƒewɔla le na amesi dɔe, eye wòfaa dzi na eƒe aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Amesi doa nunana ŋugbe ƒuƒlu la, le abe tsie ɖo ya le ƒoƒom, gake tsi gbe dzadza ene.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Dzigbɔɖie xɔa nu le fia si, eye aɖe tafɛ gbãa ƒuwo.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Meganɔ afɔ ƒom hawòvi ƒe me, ne wò nu nagati kɔ nɛ, eye wòalé fu wò o.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖia aʋatsoɖase le ehavi ŋu la, zũ kple yi kpakple aŋutrɔ ɖaɖɛ wònye.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Dziɖoɖo ɖe ame mawɔnuteƒe ŋu le hiãɣi le abe aɖu nyonyo kple afɔ, si te ke mele o ene.

english_verse: Singing to someone in deep sorrow is like pouring vinegar in an open cut.
translation_verse: Amesi le ha dzim na dzi xanu la, le abe amesi ɖe avɔ ɖi le vuvɔŋɔli, eye abe ahaƒãe wokɔ ɖe adzalẽɖaɖi dzi ene.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Ne dɔ le wò ketɔ wum la, na aboloe wòaɖu, eye ne tsikɔ le ewum la, na tsii wòano;

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: elabena dzoka ƒom nèle ƒu ɖe eƒe ta me, eye Yehowa aɖo eteƒe na wò.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Anyieheya hea tsidzadza vɛ, nenemae ame ŋu liɖe nana mo vena heliheli.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Enyo, ne woana dzogoe dzi le xɔta, wu ne nyɔnu nyawɔla nanɔ aƒe me kple ame.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Nya nyui xɔxɔ tso duta le abe tsi fafɛ na amesi ƒe ve me ƒu la ene.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe, si ke ɖe le ete le ame vɔ̃ɖi ŋku me la, le abe tsidzidzi bublu kple vuɖo kpɔtɔ̃ ene.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Anyitsi geɖe nono menyo o; ke nya sesẽwo me dzodzro enye bubu.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Amesi mate ŋu aɖu eƒe gbɔgbɔ dzi o la, le abe du, si wogbã gli le eŋu, wòtsi nuvo ene.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Bubu medze bometsila o, abe sno le dzomeŋɔli kple tsidzadza le nuŋeɣi ene.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Alesi atsutsure dzena, eye sagbadre saa agbae la, nenema nye tiƒoƒo de ame naneke mawɔmawɔ.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Sɔƒoka li na sɔ, numega li na tedzi, bometsila ƒe medome tae nye ati.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Megado nya ŋu na bometsila ɖe eƒe bometsitsi nu, ne wò hã nasɔ kplii o.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Ɖo eŋu na bometsila ɖe eƒe bometsitsi nu, ne magabu eɖokui nunyalae o.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Amesi dea du asi na bometsila la, lãa eya ŋutɔ ƒe afɔ, eye wògblẽa eɖokui ɖome.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Alesi ata tu ɖe xɔɖrɔ̃ ŋu ɣleɖee la, nenema nunyagbe nɔa nu me na bometsilae.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Ne woɖe bubu bometsila ŋu la, ele abe kpe wobla ɖe akafo me ene.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Alesi ŋu nɔa ahamula si mee la, nenema nunyagbe nɔa nu me na bometsila.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Nu geɖe wotsɔna kpɔa nui fũ, ke bometsila ƒe fetu kple fetuanala ŋutɔ woatsrɔ̃.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Alesi avũ trɔna ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe xeɖeɖe ŋui la, nenema bometsila gbugbɔa eƒe bometsinu wɔnae.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Ele ŋutsu, si le eɖokui bum nunyalae la kpɔma? Mɔkpɔkpɔ le bometsila ŋu wu eyama.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ be: Gbeɖela le xexe, dzata le kpɔdome.

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Alesi ʋɔtru trona le eƒe megbega me la, nenema nye kuvlatɔ le aba dzi.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Ne kuviatɔ de asi agba me la, edede nu me nyea dɔ nɛ.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ bua eɖokui nunyalae wu ame adre, siwo ɖoa nya ŋu ɖe nunya me.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Amesi dzre metsɔ egbɔ nya o, hafi wòku dzi nɛ la, ele to na avũ, si tso me yina.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Alesi ŋɔdzo me nuwɔla daa akakati bibi kple aŋutrɔ hewua nui la,

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: nenema nye ŋutsu, si blea ehavi, eye wògblɔna be: Fefem nye mele!

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Ne nake vɔ la, dzo tsina; eye ne sakplitɔ meli o la, ɖoɖoe zina le dzrewɔwɔ nu.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Aka nyia dzo, eye nake doa dzo, nenema ŋutsu dzretɔ traa dzre ɖoe.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Sakplitɔ ƒe nyawo le abe nuɖuɖu vivi ene, eye wodea keke dɔ me ke.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Nugbugbɔ xɔdzo, si ŋu dzi vɔ̃ɖi kpe ɖo la, le abe senu gaglɛ, si ŋu wofa klosaloŋuka ɖo ene.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Ketɔ la tsɔ eƒe nuyiwo trɔa eɖokui bubui, ke alakpa le eƒe dzi me.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Ne eƒe gbe vivina ha la, megaɖo dzi ɖe eŋu o, elabena ŋunyɔnu adre le eƒe dzi me.

english_verse: Everyone will see through those evil plans.
translation_verse: Ne fuléle ɣla ɖe beble me ha la, aɖi go le dutoƒo.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖe ʋe la, eya ŋutɔ adze eme, eye kpe age adze emlila dzi.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Alakpaɖe léa fu amesiwo dome wògblẽ keŋkeŋ la, eye nu zɔzrɔ̃e hea gbegblẽ vɛ.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Megaƒo adegbe ɖe etsɔ, si gbɔna ŋu o, elabena mènya nuka dzi ge etsɔ ala o.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Kpe la, nu kpekpee, eye ke la, agbae; ke bometsila ƒe dziku kpena wu wo ame eve la.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Dziku la, nu nyayrãe, eye dɔmedzoe dzea agbo; ke ameka ale ŋu anɔ te ɖe ŋuʋaʋã nu?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Mokaka ɖe mo na ame kaŋ enyo wu amelɔlɔ̃ le adza me.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ̃ ƒe abidede ame ŋu medze vɔ̃ o; ke ketɔwo ƒe nugbugbɔ sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ!

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Ƒoɖilae zɔa anyitsi me, ke dɔwuitɔ la nu vevewo katã vivia enu.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu, si si tso wo de la, le abe xevi, si si tso eƒe atɔ me ene.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Ami kple dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe donu doa dzidzɔ na dzi; xɔlɔ̃ ƒe nya vivi nyo wu ame ŋutɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Megagblẽ xɔ̃wò kple fofowò xɔlɔ̃ ɖi o; gbesigbe hiã tu wò la, megade nɔviwò ƒe me o; aƒelika, si te ɖe ame ŋu, nyo wu ame nɔvi le adzɔge.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Vinye, dze nunya, be nado dzidzɔ na nye dzi, ne mate ŋu aɖo nya ŋu na amesiwo le alɔme ɖem le ŋunye.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Ne nunyala kpɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e la, eɣlaa eɖokui; ke ame bebewuwo dea ta eme, eye wòle na wo be, woakpɔ wo tɔnua.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Ɖe avɔ le eŋu, elabena eƒu asi akɔ ɖe ame bubu nu, eye natsɔe aɖo awɔba le ame tutɔ ta.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Amesi yra ehavi ŋdi kanya asi madetsimee kple ɣli la, woabui fiƒoɖe nɛ.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Betrɔ, si nɔa ɖuɖu dzi ɖaa, ne tsi ga le dzadzam la, kple nyɔnu nyawɔla wosɔ;

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: amesi be, yeatsi enu la, ya nu wòbe, yeatsi, eye ɖe wòbe, yeatsɔ yeƒe nuɖusi aku amii.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Alesi wotsɔa ga nyrea gae la, nenema ame nyrea nɔviae.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Amesi kpɔa eƒe gboti dzi la, aɖu eƒe kutsetse; nenema ke amesi dzɔa eƒe aƒetɔ ŋu la, woade bubu eŋu.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Alesi ŋku me ɖla ŋku me le tsi mee la, nenema amegbetɔ ƒe dzi sɔna ɖe amegbetɔ tɔ ŋui.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Tsieƒe kple aʋli me maɖi ƒo akpɔ o; nenema amegbetɔ ƒe ŋku hã maɖi ƒoe o.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Sonu ɖe klosalo ŋu, eye kpo ɖe sika ŋu, nenema ŋutsu le ɖe eƒe ŋkɔxɔxɔ ŋui.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Ne èɖe bometsila kple bli to me hetsɔ tati toe la, eƒe bometsitsi mado le eŋu akpɔ o ɖe!

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Wò alẽwo ƒe nɔnɔme nenɔ nyanya na wò, eye lé ŋku ɖe wò lãhawo ŋu;

english_verse: because wealth and honor don't last forever.
translation_verse: elabena kesinɔnu menɔa anyi ɖaa o, alo ɖe fiakuku noa anyi na dzidzimeawo katãa?

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Ne gbe megali o, eye gbe fewo to, eye woƒo gbe nu ƒu le towo dzi la,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: ekema alẽviwo nye avɔ na wò, eye gbɔ̃tsuwo nye ho natsɔ aƒle agblee;

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: gbɔ̃notsi sɔ gbɔ na wò nuɖuɖu kple aƒewòmetɔwo ƒe nuɖuɖu kpakple wo dɔlanyɔnuwo ƒe nunyiame.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke menyãa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe nu, hafi wosina o; ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ɖea dzi ɖi abe dzatavi ene.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzitɔwo ƒe vodadawo nana emegãwo sɔ gbɔna, eye to nugɔmesela nyanu ɖeka dzi nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nɔa anyi dedie.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Amegã, si te ame dahewo de anyi la, le ahe tsidzadza, si de anyigba, eye mehe nuɖuɖu vɛ o ene.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo mesea nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ gɔme o, ke amesiwo dia Yehowa la, sea nuwo katã gɔme.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ame dahe, si fɔɖiɖi mele eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o la, nyo wu kesinɔtɔ, si zɔa mɔ gɔglɔ̃ dzi.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Amesi dzraa se ɖo la, vi nyanue; ke amesi tsoa nutsuɖuɖu ɖoa dɔe la, dea ŋukpe fofoa ŋu.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Amesi lsɔa demexɔxɔ kple kasaɖiɖi dzia eƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖe edzii la, ele nu tum ɖo na amesi vea eme dahewo nu.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖe to ɖa, be yemase se o la, eƒe gbedodoɖa ke hã nye ŋunyɔ.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Amesi ble nuteƒewɔlawo yi mɔ vɔ̃ɖi dzi la, eya ŋutɔ age adze eƒe ɖo me; ke fɔmaɖilawo anyi nu nyui ƒe dome.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔ bua eɖokui nunyalae; ke ame dahe nugɔmesela le egɔme kpɔm.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Ne ame dzɔdzɔewo le aseye tsom la, atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo teƒe mekɔna o; ke ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe alɔ de dzi la, amewo kpɔkpɔ nyea dɔ.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Amesi tsɔ nu tsyɔ eƒe vodada dzi la, madze edzi nɛ o; ke amesi ʋu eme, eye wòdzudzɔe la, woave enu.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Woayra ŋutsu, si le vɔvɔ̃ dzi daa, ke amesi sẽ eƒe dzi me goŋgoŋ la, adze dzɔgbevɔ̃e me.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi si le dukɔ dahe dzi ɖum la, le abe dzata ɖegbe kple sisiblisi dɔwui ene.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Amegã, si ɖo ko le gɔmesese me la, ameteteɖeanyi bɔ ɖe esi; amesi lé fu amebaba la, anɔ agbe didie.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Amesi dzi hlɔ̃fe le, ne esi vaseɖe aʋli me ke hã, amea ɖeke megalée o!

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Amesi fɔɖiɖi mele eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o la, woakpe ɖe eŋu; ke amesi toa mɔ gɔglɔ̃ dzi la, adze anyi zi ɖeka

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖe eƒe agble la, nuɖuɖu abɔ ɖe esi; ke amesi ti yakanuwo yome la, ahedada ado gã ɖe edzi.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Woayra nuteƒewɔla geɖe; ke amesi tsi klokloklo ɖe hokpɔkpɔ ŋu la, womagbe tohehe nɛ o.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Amedzidede menyo o, abolo kakɛ pɛ hã ana ame dada vo.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Ŋubiala le yɔyɔm ɖe kesinɔnu ŋu; ke menyae be, hiã le ye dzi va ge o.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Amesi da adzo fofoa kple ɖaɖaa hegblɔ be: Menye nuvɔ̃a ɖeke o la! nugblẽlawo ƒe hati wònye.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋubiala ɖɔa dzre, ke amesi ɖoa dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu la, woaɖi ƒo nɛ taŋ.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖoa dzi ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe gɔmesese ŋu la, bometsilae; ke amesi zɔna le nunya me la, woaɖee.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Amesi naa nu ame dahe la, hiã matui akpɔ o, ke amesi trɔa mo ɖe aga la, woaɖo ɖiŋu geɖe nɛ.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe alɔ ɖe dzi la, amewo ɣlaa wo ɖokui; ke ne wotsrɔ̃ la, ame dzɔdzɔewo dzina ɖe dzi.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Amesi lɔ̃a nyateƒe la, doa dzidzɔ na fofoa, ke amesi doa ka kple gbolowo la, gblẽa kesinɔnuwo dome.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Dza dzɔenyenye fia tsɔna lia ke anyigba; ke adzɔxɔla gblẽnɛ.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Amesi vivia nu me na ehavi la, eɖoa ɖɔ na eƒe afɔ.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Mɔ̃tetre le vodada me na nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo; ke ame dzɔdzɔe atso aseye, eye wòakpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe nyaa ame dahèwo ƒe nya me na wo, ke ame vɔ̃ɖi masea sidzedze gome o.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Fewuɖulawo ƒlɔa dzo ɖe ɖu ŋu, ke nunyala faa dɔmedzoe nu.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Ne bometsila kple nunyala woɖo nya me la, eɖoa dɔmedzoe nɔa nu kom, eye mekpɔa gbɔdzɔe o.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Hlɔ̃dola léa fu ame maɖifɔwo, eye wòdia nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe agbe yome.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Bometsila dudua eƒe dɔmedzoe katã kɔna ɖi; ke nunyala la enu emegbe.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Dziɖula, si ɖoa to alakpanya la, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nye eƒe dɔlawo katã.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Ame dahe kple ameteɖeanyila wodoa go wo nɔewo; amesi nana woa kple eve la ƒe ŋku dzi kɔna la, enye Yehowa.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Fia, si drɔ̃a ʋɔnu na ame dahewo le nyateƒe me la, eƒe fiazikpui ali ka tegbee.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Ati kple mokaname dzea nunya ame, ke ɖevi tsibodome dea ŋukpe mo na dadaa.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi ɖe dzi la, vodada dzina ɖe edzi; ke ame dzɔdzɔewo akpɔ woƒe anyidzedze ɖa.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: He to na viwò, ekema ana gbɔɖeme wò, eye wòado vivi na wò luʋɔ.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Ne nyagblɔɖi meli o la, dukɔ tsia bodome; ke ne edzra sea ɖo la, woayrae.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Wometsɔa nya hea to na kluvi o, elabena esenɛ hafi gbea toɖoɖo.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Ele ŋutsu, si tsi klokloklo dzi le nuƒoƒo me la, kpɔma? Mɔkpɔkpɔ le bometsila ŋu wu eyama.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe wɔ vinugbee ne eƒe kluvi tso ɖevime ta, ava ɖu aƒetɔ emegbe.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoetɔ dea dzre aƒe, eye dzikutɔ ɖaa vo geɖe.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe dãda abɔbɔe ɖe anyi, ke amesi bɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi la ƒe asi asu bubu dzi.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Amesi woa kple fiafitɔ womã nu, eye wòse ɖiŋudodo, gake metoe o la, ele fu eya ŋutɔ ƒe agbe.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔvɔvɔ̃ mɔ̃e wònye ɖea eme; ke amesi doa dzi de Yehowa ŋu la, woakpɔ eta.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo wɔa nu, be woadze amegã ŋu; ke Yehowa gbɔe ame ƒe afiatsotso tsona.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Agur, Yake vi ƒe nyawo. Ŋutsu la ƒe gbe enye si. Meku kutri, Mawu, meku kutri, eye nunye yi.

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: Elabena medzɔ la wu amesiame, eye amegbetɔ ƒe gɔmesese mele asinye o,

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: eye nyemesrɔ̃ nunya, be madze si kɔkɔetɔ la o.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Ameka lia yi dziƒo gaɖi va anyi? Ameka lɔ ya ɖe asiʋlo me? Ameka bla tsi ɖe avɔ me? Ameka ɖo anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo katã tsitrenu? Eŋkɔ ɖe, eye aleke woyɔna na via? Enyaea?

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nuƒoƒowo katã me dza; akpoxɔnu wònye na amesiwo sii tso la.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Megatsɔ nyaa ɖeke kpe eƒe nyawo, ne wòade ga nu na wò, eye nanye aʋatsotɔ atsi anyi ɖi o. Agur le kukeɖeɖe.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Nu eve biam mele wò, megatem, hafi maka o.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Alakpa kple aʋatsokaka neƒo asa nam! Megana ahedada kple hotsuim o; na maɖu nye nusi nyee tɔnye,

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: ne nyemagaɖi ƒo akpa ahasẽ nu agblɔ bena: „Amekae nye Yehowa hã“ o; eye ne nyemagaɖo ko ayi fi fi ge ahaɖa aƒu ɖe nye Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Megali dɔla ŋu le eƒe aƒetɔ gbɔ, ne woado ɖiŋu na wò, eye fɔɖiɖi nanɔ dziwò o.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Dzidzime, si doa ɖiŋu na fofoa, eye meyraa dadaa o la,

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: nenema nye dzidzime, si buna be, yedza, gake mele eƒe ɖiƒoƒo kpɔm o;

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: nenema nye dzidzime, si ta ŋku kɔkɔ le, eye eƒe aɖahawo ɖe dzi;

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: Nyɔnuvi eve le axɔ̃ si: Tsɔe vɛ, tsɔe vɛ! Nu etɔ̃e meɖia ƒo gbeɖe o, eye enelia megblɔna be, esɔ gbɔ o:

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe, nyɔnu ƒe dɔ tsiko, kple anyigba, si tsi meɖia kɔ na o, kpakple dzo, si megblɔna be: esɔ gbɔ gbɔ o.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Ŋku, si ɖea alɔme le fofoa ŋu, eye mebua dada ɖe naneke me o la, akpaviãwo ahoe le to me le tɔʋu to, eye hɔ̃viwo aɖui.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Nu etɔ̃e nye nuku nam, eye enelia la nyemenya ta le enu o:

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Hɔ̃ toƒe le dziƒo, ɖa toƒe le agakpe dzi, ʋu loƒe le atsiaƒu titina kpakple ŋutsu toƒe le nyɔnuvi ŋu.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Alea nye gbolɔ toƒe hã; eɖua nu tutua nu xalixali gblɔna be: Nyemewɔ nu baɖaa ɖeke o.

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Nu etɔ̃e nana anyigba dzona kpekpekpe, eye enelia mele tsɔtsɔ me nɛ o.

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Ne kluvi zu fia, ne nuɖuɖu bɔ ɖe bometsila si,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: ne nyɔnu tsi tre heva ɖe srɔ̃ emegbe kple ne dɔlanyɔnu ɖo alɔgo eƒe aƒenɔ do ɖa.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Nu enee nye suetɔwo le anyigba dzi, ke wodze nunya eteƒe mekɔ o:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Anyidiwo menye dukɔ sesẽa ɖeke o hafi, gake wodia woƒe nuɖuɖu le dzomeŋɔli;

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: hotoklolowo menye dukɔ sẽŋua ɖeke o, gake wowɔa woƒe nɔƒe ɖe agakpewo me;

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: fiaa ɖeke mele ʋetsuviwo nu o, ke woƒe ha blibo la yina le ɖoɖo me,

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: woate ŋu alé xɔ ŋu nyatri kple asi, gake enaa fiasãwo me.

english_verse: Three or four creatures really strut around:
translation_verse: Nu etɔ̃e zɔa atsyɔ̃zɔli, eye enelia zɔa fiazɔli:

english_verse: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle,
translation_verse: dzata, si nye kalẽtɔ le lãwo dome, eye metrɔa megbe dea naneke o,

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: aʋawɔsɔ kple gbɔ̃tsu kpakple fia, si nu womate ŋu anɔ te ɖo o.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Ne ètsi bome le ɖokuiɖoɖoɖedzi me la, ekema ɖo asi nu, nenye be, nèdze nunya.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Elabena, ne woƒo notsi le eye ami dona, ne wofiã ŋɔti sesie la, eye ʋu dona, eye ne wofiã dɔmedzoe sesie la, eye dzre dzɔna.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Fia Lemuel ƒe nyawo nye esi, nya, siwo dadaa ku ɖe to me nɛ:

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Oo vinye, oo nye dɔmevi, oo nye adzɔgbeɖeɖe ƒe vi!

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Megatsɔ wò ŋusẽ na nyɔnuwo o kple wò zɔzɔme na nyɔnu fiagblèlawo o!

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Lemuel, menye fiawo ƒe dɔ o, wein nono menye fiawo ƒe dɔ o, eye aha muame menye amegãwo ƒe dɔ o!

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: Ne magano aha aŋlɔ se la be, eye wòatrɔ gbo nya na hiãtɔwo katã o!

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ mitsɔ aha muame na amesiwo do tsɔtsrɔ̃ ƒe etua nu kple wein na nuxala,

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: ne wòanoe, eye wòaŋlɔ eƒe ahedada be, eye eƒe ŋku nadzo le hiãkame dzi!

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Ke wò nu de aɖetututɔwo nu kple ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃etɔwo katã ƒe nye nu!

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Ke wò nu natso efia ɖe eteƒe, eye nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo! Nyɔnu nu dzeame wɔla ƒe kafukafu.

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Amekae akpɔ nyɔnu zazɛ̃? Eƒe asime sẽ wu adzagba tɔ.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃a ɖoa dzi ɖe eŋu, eye nuwo kpɔkpɔ mavee o.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Ewɔa nyuie nɛ, eye menye vɔ̃ o, le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Edia ɖetifu kple anazi, eye eƒe asiwo wɔa ɖɔ kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Ele abe esiʋu ene, eye wòhea nuɖuɖu tso didiƒe vɛ.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Ne ŋu mekpɔ ke haɖe o la, efɔna, eye wònaa nuɖuɖu eƒemetɔwo kple eƒe dɔlanyɔnuwo tɔ gome wo.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Ebua la me le agble ŋu, eye wòƒlenɛ ka; eƒe asi ƒe kutsetse wòtsɔna ɖea weingblee.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: Etsɔa ŋusẽ blaa ali dzii, eye wòdoa ŋusẽ eƒe alɔwo.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Edzea sii be, yeƒe asitsatsa nyo; eƒe akaɖi metsina le zã mee.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Edoa eƒe asi ɖe hiãtɔwo, eye wòkea eƒe abɔ me na ame dahewo.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Mevɔna ɖe eƒe aƒe nu le vuvɔ ta o, elabena wotsyɔ kuntru dzi na eƒe aƒemetɔwo.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Elɔ̃a kuntruwo na eɖokui, aklala kple aɖahɛ nye eƒe avɔtata.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Wonyaa srɔ̃a, ne eya kple anyigba dzi ame tsitsiwo wole ʋɔnuɖrɔ̃ƒe.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Etɔa awutewui hedzrana, eye asitsalawo xɔa alidziblanuwo tsoa egbɔe.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ kple atsyɔ̃ nye eƒe ava, eye ŋkeke ɖia kokoe nɛ.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Ekea eƒe nu kple nunya, eye nufiame fafɛwo le eƒe aɖe dzi.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Eléa ŋku de nuwɔwɔwo ŋu le eƒe me, eye meɖua kuviabolo o.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Viaŋutsuwo tsona heyranɛ; srɔ̃a kafunɛ be:

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: „Nyɔnu zazɛ̃ geɖewo li; ke wòa èƒo wo katã ta!“

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Nyonyo le alakpae, eye tugbedzedze la, yae; nyɔnu, si vɔ̃a Yehowa le, ele be, woakafui.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ eƒe esi ƒe kutsetse nɛ, eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo akafui le dua me!

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla, amesi nye Dawid vi, fia le Yerusalem la ƒe nyawo nye esi:

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla be: Toflokowo ƒe tofloko, toflokowo ƒe toflokoe; nusianu enye tofloko!

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Viɖe ka emegbelɔ kpɔna tsoe eƒe agbagba, siwo katã wòdzena le ɣea te la mea?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Dzidzime nu yina, eye bubu vana; ke anyigba ya li tegbee.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Ɣe dzena, eya ɣe ɖoa to, eye wòɖea abla yia enɔƒe, afisi wòdzena tsona.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Ya ɖoa ta: dziehe, etrɔna yia anyiehe, eye wògatrɔna vaa afisi wotso.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Towo katã sina yia atsiaƒu me, ke etsiaƒu meyɔna gbeɖe o; afisi towo sina yina la, afima woyina ɖaa.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
