english_verse: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
translation_verse: Miaƒe anyigba zu gbegbe; dzo fiã miaƒe duwo, eye du bubu me tɔwo ɖu miaƒe agble le mia ŋku me, eye wòzu gbegbe, abe alesi wogblẽ Sodom ene.

english_verse: Enemies surround Jerusalem, alone like a hut in a vineyard or in a cucumber field.
translation_verse: Eye Zion-nyɔnuvi tsi anyi abe agbadɔ le weingble me, abe miaƒe le adzamatregble me kple du, si woɖe to ɖo la ene.

english_verse: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
translation_verse: Ɖe menye Yehowa Zebaot ye kpɔtɔ ame ʋeea ɖewo ɖi na mí o la, anye ne esuso vie ko miele abe Sodom ene, eye míeɖi Gomora! Biabia tso Israel bena, wòatrɔ dzi me, eye megasubɔ Mawu le gota ɖeɖeko o.

english_verse: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
translation_verse: Mi Sodom-amegãwo, mise Yehowa ƒe nya, mi Gomora-dukɔ, miƒu to anyi ɖe mía Mawu ƒe nufiame ŋu!

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: Yehowa be, Nuka miaƒe akpedavɔsa gbogboawo awɔ nam? Agbowo ƒe numevɔsa kple nyivi damiwo ƒe ami ti kɔ nam, eye nyiwo, alẽviwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe ʋu medzea ŋunye o.

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Ne mieva, be yewoado ɖe ŋkunye me la, amekae bia esia tso mia si be, mianɔ afɔ ƒom nye xɔxɔnuwo?

english_verse: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
translation_verse: Migasa nuɖuvɔ alakpatɔ azɔ o, dzudzɔdonu nyɔŋu wònye nam. Dzinu yeyewo, dzudzɔgbewo kple gbeƒẽɖeɖe takpegbewo la, nyemate ŋu ado dzi atsɔ alakpa kple takpekpewo o!

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: Melé fu miaƒe dzinu yeyewo kple miaƒe ŋkekenyuiewo, wòzu agba nam, eye wo tsɔtsɔ glom.

english_verse: Wash yourselves clean! I hate your filthy deeds. Stop doing wrong
translation_verse: Mile tsi, miklɔ mia ɖokui ŋu! Miɖe miaƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖa le ŋkunye me, eye midzudzɔ vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ!

english_verse: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
translation_verse: Misrɔ̃ nu nyui wɔwɔ, miti nya dzɔdzɔe yome, mixɔ na amesi wote ɖe anyi, midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na tsyɔ̃eviwo, eye mihe nya na ahosiwo! Ŋugbedodo kple ŋɔdzidodo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Miva mídrɔ̃ nɔ nu! Ne miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo le abe nyagadzĩ ene la, woafu abe sno ene, eye ne wòbiã abe aɖabɛ ene la, woazu abe alẽfu ene.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ne mielɔ̃, eye mieɖo to la, ekema miaɖu anyigba ƒe nu nyuitɔ.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke ne miegbe, eye miesẽ to la, yi aɖu mi, elabena Yehowa ƒe nue gblɔe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Aleke du wɔnuteƒe, si me nya dzɔdzɔe no tu la, zu gbolo? Afisi dzɔdzɔenyenye na tsã la, hlɔ̃dolawo li fifia!

english_verse: Your silver is fake, and your wine is watered down.
translation_verse: Wò klosalo zu aŋuka, eye wotso tsi dzro wò wein!

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Wò amegãwo zu aglãdzelawo kple fiafiwo xɔlɔ̃; wo dome amesiame lɔ̃a zãnunana, eye wotia fetu yome; womedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu na tsyɔ̃eviwo o, eye ahosiwo ƒe nya medea wo gbe o.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Eyata Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe ŋusẽtɔ la ƒe gbe enye si: Alele, mele akɔ fa ge na ɖokuinye ɖe nye ketɔwo ŋu, eye mele hlɔ̃ bia ge ɖe nye futɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Matrɔ nye asi ɖe ŋuwò, eye malólo wò aŋukawo abe adzalẽɖaɖi wotso wòe ene, eye maɖe wò tsumiwo katã ɖa.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Magaɖo ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo na wò abe tsã ene, kple adaŋudelawo na wò abe le gɔmedzedzea me ene. Esia megbe woayɔ wò be dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe du, du wɔnuteƒe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Woatso ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ aɖe Zion, eye woatsɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye aɖe eƒe amesiwo trɔ ta me la.

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Woagbã godzelawo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo siaa nyanyanya, eye amesiwo trɔ le Yehowa yome la nu ayi.

english_verse: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋu akpe mi le logoti, siwo ŋu miekpɔa dzidzɔ le la ŋu, eye miaƒe mo atsi dã le aba, siwo mielɔ̃na la ŋu.

english_verse: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
translation_verse: Elabena mia ŋutɔwo mianɔ abe logoti, siwo ƒe aŋgba yrɔ, kple abɔ, si tsia ɖeke meli na o la ene.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: Ame sesẽ la azu ɖetifu, eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔ azu dzoxi; wo kple eve la siaa woabi, eye amea ɖeke mate ŋu atsi wo o.

english_verse: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Nya, si Yesaya, Amoz vi la, kpo le Yuda kple Yerusalem ŋu la enye si:

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Ava me le ŋkeke mlɔeawo me be, Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe to la akɔ ta agbɔ towo ŋu, eye wòaƒo togbɛwo ta, eye anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã aƒo zi ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ geɖewo atso agblɔ bena: Mina míayi Yehowa ƒe to la, Yakob ƒe Mawu ƒe aƒe la gbɔ, ne wòafia nu mí le eƒe mawo ŋu, eye míazɔ eƒe toƒewo. Elabena nufiame atso Zion, eye Yehowa ƒe nya atso Yerusalem.

english_verse: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na anyigba dzi dukɔwo, eye woatso nya me na dukɔ geɖewo; woatso woƒe yiwo atu kodziwoe, eye woatso woƒe akplɔwo atu hɛ gobɛwoe; dukɔ magatso yi ɖe dukɔ ŋu azɔ o, eye womagasrɔ̃ aʋa wowu hã azɔ o.

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe aƒe, mitso, ne míazɔ le Yehowa ƒe kekeli me!

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: Etso wò dukɔ, Yakob ƒe aƒe la, ƒu gbe, elabena ɣedzeƒetɔwo ƒe afakaka yɔ wo fũ, wosa dzo abe Filistitowo ene, eye wona asi du bubu me viwo.

english_verse: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.
translation_verse: Klosalo kple sika yɔ eƒe anyigba dzi fũ, eye eƒe kesinɔnuwo teƒe mekɔ o; sɔwo yɔ eƒe anyigba dzi fũ, eye eƒe tasiaɖamwo teƒe mekɔ o.

english_verse: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
translation_verse: Legbawo yɔ eƒe anyigba dzi fũ; wode ta agu na woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo, nusiwo woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe asibide wɔ.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Ale amegbetɔ de ta agu, eye ŋutsu bɔbɔ eɖokui; màtsɔe ake wo o!

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Yi ɖe agato me, eye naɣla ɖokuiwò ɖe ke me tso Yehowa ƒe ŋɔdzi kple eƒe gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ la nu!

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Woabɔbɔ amegbetɔwo ƒe ŋku kɔkɔwo ɖe anyi, eye woate ŋutsuwo ƒe dàda ɖe to, ale be Yehowa ɖeɖeko lanye gã le ŋkeke ma dzi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋkeke li na Yehowa Zebaot ɖe dadalawo katã kple ame kɔkɔwo, ɖe nusiwo katã kɔa ta dzi la ŋu, ne woabɔbɔ ɖe anyi;

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: ɖe Libanon ƒe sedertiwo katã, siwo ko, eye woƒo ta la ŋu, ɖe Basan ƒe logotiwo katã ŋu;

english_verse: all high mountains and hills,
translation_verse: ɖe to kɔkɔwo katã kple togbɛ kɔkɔwo katã ŋu;

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: ɖe Tarsis-ʋuwo katã kple nukpɔkpɔ veviwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Woabɔbɔ amegbetɔwo ƒe adegbeƒoƒo ɖe anyi, eye woate ŋutsuwo ƒe dàda ɖe to, ne Yehowa ɖeɖeko nanye gã le ŋkeke ma dzi.

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: Eye legbawo nu ayi keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Eye wòayi kpetowo kple anyigba dzi dowo me tso Yehowa ƒe ŋɔdzi kple eƒe gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ nu, ne etso, be yeado ŋɔdzi na anyigba.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe la amegbetɔ atsɔ eƒe klosalolegba kple eƒe sikalegba, siwo wòwɔ, be yeade ta agu na la, aƒu gbe na alegeliwo kple agutɔwo,

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: ne wòayi agadowo kple kpetowo me tso Yehowa ƒe ŋɔdzi kple eƒe gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ la nu, ne etso, be yeado ŋɔdzi na anyigba.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Eyata miɖe asi le amegbetɔ, si ƒe ŋɔti me gbɔgbɔ le la ƒe nya me, elabena nukata gɔ̃ woabui ɖo?

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, aɖe atizɔti kple ziɔɖeŋu ɖa le Yerusalem kple Yuda, abolo ƒe xɔnamewo katã kple tsi ƒe xɔnamewo katã,

english_verse: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
translation_verse: kalẽtɔwo kple aʋawɔlawo, ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo, afakalawo kple ame tsitsiwo,

english_verse: officials and advisors, fortunetellers and others who tell the future.
translation_verse: ame blaatɔ̃wo ƒe amegãwo, ame ŋkutawo, adaŋudelavvo, aɖaŋuawo ƒe amegãwo kple dzotɔwo.

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: Matso ɖeviwo aɖo woƒe amegãwoe, eye ɖevinuwɔlawo aɖu fia ɖe wo dzi;

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: amewo asẽ ŋuta le wo nɔewo ŋu, eye amesiame le ehavi ŋu, ɖeviwo adze agbo ɖe amegã ɖeɖiwo ŋu, eye yakamewo ɖe bubumewo ŋu.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe alé nɔvia le fofoa ƒe me bena: „Avɔ le asiwò, eyata nanye míaƒe amegã, eye aƒe gbagbã sia nanɔ asiwò me“ la,

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: axɔ edzi agblɔ gbemagbe bena: „Nyemele abiwɔlaa ɖeke nye ge o, elabena abolo kple avɔa ɖeke mele aƒenye me o; migatsɔm ɖo dukɔ ƒe amegãe o!“

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Elabena Yerusalem amũ, eye Yuda adze anyi, le esi woƒe aɖewo kple woƒe nuwɔwɔwo tso ɖe Yehowa ŋu, ne woaɖo dziku na eƒe kɔkɔenyenye ƒe ŋkuwo ta.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Woƒe moɖoɖo le ɖase ɖim le wo ŋu, eye woɖe woƒe nuvɔ̃wo fia faa abe Sodom ene, womeɣlae o; baba na wo, elabena woawo ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋu wole vɔ̃ wɔm ɖo.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Woayra ame dzɔdzɔewo, wo tɔ me nyo na wo, elabena woaɖu woƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe kutsetse.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Baba na ame vɔ̃ɖi, etɔ me vɔ̃e nɛ, elabena nusi eƒe asi wɔ la, eya woatsɔ awɔe.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ ƒe ŋutasẽlawo nye ɖeviwo, eye nyɔnuwo ɖu fia ɖe wo dzi. Nye dukɔ, kplɔwòlawo nye ameflula wo, eye wobaɖa wò toƒe ƒe mɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa tso, be yeahe nya, etsi tre ɖi va, be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: Yehowa kple eƒe dukɔ ƒe ame tsitsiwo kpakple eƒe amegãwo ɖi ʋɔnu be: Miawo miegblẽ nye weingble, eye mieha ame dahewo ƒe nuwo ɖe miaƒe xɔwo me.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot ƒe gbe enye si be: Nukaŋuti mienyã avuzi le nye dukɔ dzi, eye mieto hiãtɔwo ƒe mo nyanyanya?

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Esi Zion-nyɔnuviwo dana, eye wolia kɔ ganɛ nɔa yiyim, woɖoa mo ŋanɛ, wonɔa ble nyẽm xatsɛxatsɛ nɔa yiyim, eye woƒe afɔgawo nɔa ɖiɖim gleŋgleŋ la,

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: eyata Aƒetɔ la abebe ta na Zion-nyɔnuviwo, eye Yehowa aɖe ama wo.

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Ʋeʋẽ kũ axɔ ɖe ʋeʋẽ lilili teƒe, ka axɔ ɖe alidziblanu teƒe, tabebe axɔ ɖe ɖaƒoƒo teƒe, akpanyatata axɔ ɖe awu ʋlaya nyui teƒe, eye dzobi axɔ ɖe nyonyo teƒe.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutsuwo atsi yi nu, eye wò kalẽtɔwo atsi aʋa me.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Woƒe agbowo axa nu, woata konyi, eye woaɖi ƒuƒlu abɔbɔ nɔ anyigba.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Nyɔnu adre alé ŋutsu ɖeka gbemagbe agblɔ bena: Míaɖu mía ŋutɔwo ƒe abolo, eye míata mía ŋutɔwo ƒe avɔ; na woayɔ wò ŋkɔ de mía ŋu ko; ɖe míaƒe ŋukpe ɖa le mía ŋu.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe la Yehowa ƒe atidzedze anye atsyɔ̃ kple bubu, eye anyigba ƒe kutsetse anye adegbeƒoƒo, ɖekadzenu na Israel ƒe ame susɔeawo.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: nenye be, Aƒetɔ la tsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe ya kple dzo ƒe ya klɔ Zion-nyɔnuwo ƒe ɖiƒoƒo, eye wòkpala Yerusalem ƒe ʋu ɖa le wo dome.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa aɖo alilikpo kple dzudzɔ ɖe Zion-to ƒe nɔƒewo katã kple eƒe takpeƒewo le ŋkeke me kpakple dzo keklẽ le zã me; elabena wòa tsyɔ nu atsyɔɖoɖowo katã dzi,

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: eye agbadɔ anɔ anyi anye vɔvɔli dodo le ŋkeke me le dzoxɔxɔ ta, eye wòanye sitsoƒe kple bebeƒe le dziya kple tsidzadza ta.

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: Mele ha dzi ge le xɔ̃nye ŋu, mele xɔ̃nye ƒe ha dzi ge le eƒe weingble ŋu. Weingblea ɖe le xɔ̃nye si le totame wɔnua ɖe.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: Edzobo eme, eɖe kpewo le eme, eye wòdo weinka nyuitɔwo ɖe eme, etu xɔ tsrala ɖe etitina, ekpa weinfiãnu hã da ɖe eme hele mɔ kpɔm be, atse weintsetsewo; ke etse ʋukatsetsewo.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: Eyata mi Yerusalemtɔwo kple mi Yuda-ŋutsuwo, midrɔ̃ nya le mía kple nye weingble la dome!

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Nukae woawɔ na nye weingble la, eye nyemewɔe nɛ o? Nukaŋuti mele mɔ kpɔm be, atse weintsetsewo, eye wòtse ʋukatsetsewo?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Azɔ mana mianya nusi wɔ ge mala nye weingble la: Makaka kpo le eŋu, ne lãwo naɖui, magbã gli le eŋu, ne woazɔ edzi.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: Mawɔe woazu afutime; womaɖe eŋu o, eye womaga eme o, ke boŋ aŋɔkawo kple ŋuwò amie ɖe eme; eye made se na alilikpowo be, womagadza tsi ɖe edzi azɔ o.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Elabena Israel ƒe aƒe lae nye Yehowa Zebaot ƒe weingble, eye Yuda ŋutsuwo nye eƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ƒe nudodowo: ekpɔ mɔ na afiatsotso, ke ʋukɔkɔɖie li; ekpɔ mɔ na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, ke konyifafae li. Wotsɔ Mawu ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ alo futɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi dzedze do ŋɔdzi na dukɔ la.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo le xɔ tsiãm ɖe xɔ nu, eye wole agble didim ɖe agble nu, vaseɖe esime teƒea ɖeke maganɔ anyi o, ne woawo ɖeɖe nanɔ anyigba dzi!

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ ɖe to me nam bena: Ne xɔ gbogboawo matrɔ zu gbegbe, eye xɔ gã nyuiawo mazu xɔdowo o fĩ!

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Ɖeɖi mate amea ɖeke ŋu o, eye ame kudɔea ɖeke manɔ wo dome o; womada alɔ̃ o, eye womada akɔlɔ̃e o, alidziblanu matu le woƒe ali o, eye woƒe atokotaka matso o;

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo tsɔa alakpaka dea vodada nɔa hehem, eye wotsɔa tasiaɖamka hea nuvɔ̃e!

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo tɔa fɔŋli hetia aha muame yome, eye wotsia anyi vaseɖe zãtiƒe, ne wein nade dzo lã me na wo!

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Kasaŋkuwo, saŋkuwo, asiʋuiwo kple dzewo kpakple wein kpena ɖe woƒe aglotutu la ŋu; ke womeɖea ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ o, eye womekpɔa eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ o.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Eyata woaɖe aboyo nye dukɔ le manyamanya me, woƒe ame ŋkutawo azu dɔwuitɔwo, eye tsikɔ awu woƒe amehawo ate wo ŋu.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Eyata tsieƒe ke eƒe ve me, eye wòke eƒe nu baa, eye Yerusalem ƒe atsyɔ̃, eƒe amehawo, eƒe howɔwɔ kple amesiwo kpɔa dzidzɔ le eme la, age ɖe eme.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Ekema amegbetɔ atsyɔ akɔ anyi, woabɔbɔ ŋutsu ɖe anyi, eye woate dàda ŋkuwò ɖe to;

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot anye gã le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me, eye Mawu kɔkɔe la akɔ eɖokui ŋu le dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Alẽviwo aɖu gbe le afima, abe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe gbeɖuƒee wònye ene, eye lã tutɔwo aɖu nu le amidalawo ƒe aƒedowo me.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Amesiwo noa gbɔgblɔm bena: Newɔ kabakaba, neƒo du ɖe eƒe dɔ nu, ne míakpɔe; eye Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe adaŋudede nete va, ne miadze sii.

english_verse: You are headed for trouble! You say wrong is right, darkness is light, and bitter is sweet.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo yɔa vɔ̃ be nyui kple nyui be vɔ̃, amesiwo tsɔa viviti wɔa kekelii, eye wotso kekeli wo vivitii, amesiwo tsoa veve wɔa vivii, eye wotsɔa vivi wo vevee!

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo nye kalẽawo le weinnono me kple ŋutsuwɔlawo le aha muame toto me.

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Amesiwo xɔa zãnu hetsona na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye wodaa adzo nya dzɔdzɔe le ame dzɔdzɔewo si.

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Eyata woƒe ke azu nu nyunyɔ abe ahɔ̃liti takpoe, si dzo ƒe aɖe fiã, kple gbe ƒuƒu, si nye afi ɖe dzo me la ene, eye woƒe seƒoƒo ami ya abe ʋuʋudedi ene, elabena wogbe Yehowa Zebaot ƒe nufiame, eye woɖe alɔme le Israel ƒe kɔkɔeto la ƒe nyawo ŋu.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe bi ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋu, eye wòdo eƒe alo ɖe dzi heƒo wo, ale be towo dzo kpekpekpe, eye woƒe kukuawo tsi kpɔdome abe gbeɖuɖɔ ene. Ke to esiawo katã gbɔ hã la eƒe dɔmedzoe nu mefa o, eye eƒe alɔ gale dzi ko.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Akɔ aflaga dzi na dukɔa ɖe le didiƒe, eye wòala aku ayɔe tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu, eye kpɔ ɖa, anɔ du dzi ava kaba.

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: wonyre woƒe aŋutrɔwo, eye wovu woƒe dawo katã me; woƒe so wo ƒe afɔwo le abe kpe ene, eye woƒe tasiaɖamfɔwo ɖi ahom.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Wole gbe ɖem abe dzatanɔ ene, eye wole xaxlɔ̃m abe dzataviwo ene; wole gbe tem helé nu tso dzoe, eye amea ɖeke mate ŋu axɔe o.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Eye wòaɖe gbe ɖe eɖzi gbemagbe abe atsiaƒu ƒe gbeɖeɖe ene, eye ne woɖe ŋku ɖe anyigba dzi la, hiã ƒe blukɔ koe li, eye woƒe alilikpo na kekeli do viviti.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Le ƒe, si me fia Uziya ku la, mekpɔ Aƒetɔ la bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui kɔkɔ gãa ɖe dzi, eye eƒe awutoga yɔ gbedoxɔ la taŋ.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Serafiwo le eta me, wo dome ɖesiaɖe to aʋala adeade, wotsɔ wo ame eve tsyɔ ŋku me, wotsɔ eve tsyɔ afɔ, eye wotsɔ wo ame eve le dzodzomee.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
translation_verse: Eye wodo ɣli ɖo ɖe wo nɔewo gblɔ bena: Kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe enye Yehowa Zebaot! Eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ anyigba blibo la dzi!

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: Ɣlidola la ƒe gbe na kpuiawo ƒe agunu ʋuʋu, eye dzudzɔ yɔ xɔ la taŋ.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: Alele, evɔ nam! Elabena ame miyi makɔmakɔtɔ menye, eye mele dukɔ, si ƒe nuyi mekɔ o la dome, elabena nye ŋkuwo kpɔ fia Yehowa Zebaot.

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Tete Serafiwo dometɔ ɖeka dzo va gbɔnye, eye wòlé kpe xɔdzo hẽ, si wotsɔ abe ɖe le vɔsamlekpuia me la, ɖe asi;

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔe lili nu nam gblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, esia ka nuyi ŋu na wo, wò vodadawo ɖe ɖa, eye wòlé avu wò nuvɔ̃wo.

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Tete mese Aƒetɔ la ƒe gbe wògblɔ bena: Ameka madɔ, eye ameka ayi na mí? Tete megblɔ bena: Nyee nye esi, dɔm!

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Yi naɖagblɔ na dukɔ sia bena: Minɔ nusese dzi ko, ke mígase nu gɔme o; minɔ nukpɔkpɔ dzi, ke migadze si nu o.

english_verse: “Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.”
translation_verse: Na dukɔ sia ƒe dzi naku atri, tsi to nɛ, eye natre eƒe ŋkuwo, ne magakpɔ nu kple eƒe ŋkuwo, wòase nu kple eƒe towo, eye wòase nu gɔme kple eƒe dzi, ne wòatrɔ la me, eye eƒe lãme nahaya o.

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, vaseɖe ɣekaɣie? Eɖo ŋu bena: Vaseɖe esime duwo nagbã, eye woazu aƒedo, xɔwo nazu xɔdo, eye anyigba nazu gbegbe,

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime Yehowa nakplɔ amewo adzoe, eye gbegbewo nasɔ gbɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Eye ne akpa ewolia susɔ la, woagatsrɔ̃ eya hã ɖa; ke abe alesi ne wolã sesewu kple logoti, eye takpoea kpɔtɔna la, nenema ƒome kɔkɔe la anye takpoea.

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Eye wova gblɔ na Dawid ƒe aƒe la bena: Aram ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Efrayim. Tete eya kple eƒe dukɔ ƒe dzi ʋuʋu nyanyanya, abe alesi avemetiwo ʋuʋuna le ya nu ene.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ na Yesaya bena: Mia kple viwò Sear-Yasub mido yi ɖakpe Axaz le dzigbeta la ƒe tɔʋu ƒe mlɔenu le avɔnyãla ƒe agblemɔ to,

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: eye nagblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖokui wò dzi, eye nanɔ anyi kpoo! Megavɔ̃ o, eye dzi megaɖe le ƒowò le dzoti takpoe eve, siwo le dzudzɔ tum, le Rezin kple Aram kpakple Remalya vi ƒe dɔmedzoe la ta o.

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: mina míaho ɖe Yuda ŋu, míado ŋɔdzi nɛ, eye míaxɔe na mía ɖokui atsɔ Tabeal vi aɖo fiae ɖe eɖzi la,

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Maɖze edzi o, eye mava me o!

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe ta enye Samaria, eye Samaria ƒe ta enye Remalya vi. Ne miexɔe se o la, ekema mianɔ te hã o! Imanuel ŋugbedodo

english_verse: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gaƒo nu kple Axaz gblɔ bena:

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: Bia dzesi tso Yehowa, wò Mawu la si, eɖanye tso tsieƒe ke alo tso dziƒo ʋĩ o.

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Tete Axaz gblɔ bena: Nyema-biae o, ne nyemahayi Yehowa te ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Dawid ƒe aƒe la, misee: Nu tsɛ wònye na mi be, miana nu nati ko na amegbetɔ, hafi miehe, yewoana nu nati ko na nye Mawua ke hã?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: Eyata Aƒetɔ la ŋuta ana dzesi mi: Kpɔ ɖa, ɖetugbi afɔ fu, eye wòadzi ŋutsuvi ana ŋkɔe be „Mawu li kpli mí“.

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Elabena hafi ɖevi la nava nya vɔ̃tsitsri kple nyuitiatia la, anyigba, si ƒe fia wo kple eve le ŋɔ dzim na wò la, lazu gbegbe! Tohehe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ to Asiriatɔwo dzi.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa akplɔ Asur-fia aƒu mia kple wò dukɔ kpakple fofowò ƒe aƒe, ŋkeke, siwo meva kpo tso esime Efrayim klã ɖa le Yuda ŋu o!

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: Eye woava me le ŋkeke ma dzi be, Yehowa ala aku ayɔ togbato, siwo le Egipte-tsiwo ƒe mlɔenu, kple anyi, siwo le Asur-nyigba dzi,

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: eye wo katã woava aƒo ɖe bali globowo kple kpetowo kple ŋuvegoewo katã kpakple lãnyiƒewo katã.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe la Aƒetɔ la aɣe talũhɛ, si nye Asur-fia tso tɔsisi la ƒe go keme, alũ ta kple aŋɔ me fu nɛ, eye wòaƒlɔ ge nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: Eye woava me le ɣemaɣi be, ame ɖeka anyi nyinɔvi ɖeka kple alẽvi eve.

english_verse: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
translation_verse: Eye le esi notsi bɔ ta la, woano notsi kpekẽ, elabena amesiwo kpɔtɔ ɖe anyigba dzi la dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ano notsi kpekẽ kple anyitsi.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Aŋutrɔ kple da woatso yi afimae, elabena aŋɔka kple ŋuwò axɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Eye womagate ŋu aɖe to, siwo katã wotso agblenu ŋlɔ tsã la dzi o le aŋɔka kple ŋuwò vovɔ̃ ta, eye woazu nyikplɔƒe kple alẽwo toƒe.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Tso nuŋlɔkpe gãa ɖe, eye naŋlɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ hahootɔ ɖe edzi bena: Aboyonu, afɔ netsɔ, nuhaha, va kaba!

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: De ɖasefo wɔnuteƒe wo nam: nunɔla Uriya kple Zaxarya, Yeberexya vi.

english_verse: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
translation_verse: Eye mete de nyɔnu nyagblɔɖila ŋu wòto fu, eye wòdzi ŋutsuvi. Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Yɔ eƒe ŋkɔ be „Aboyonu, afɔ netsɔ, nuhaha, va kaba!“

english_verse: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
translation_verse: Elabena hafi ɖevi la nade asi fofo kple dada yɔyɔ me la, woatso Damasko ƒe kesinɔnuwo kple Samaria ƒe aboyonuwo adze Asur-fia ŋgɔe.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gaƒo nu kplim gblɔ bena:

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: Esi dukɔ sia do vlo Siloa-tsi, si sina blewu la, eye wòkpɔ dzidzɔ kple Rezin kpakple Remalya vi la,

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: eyata Aƒetɔ la akplɔ tɔsisi la ƒe tsi gã sẽŋuwo ava ƒo ɖe wo dzi, si nye Asur-fia kple eƒe ŋusẽ blibo; ayɔ eƒe baliwo katã me, eye wòagbagba eƒe tɔgowo katã,

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: asi ato Yuda, eye aɖo agbagba vaseɖe ve ke, eye eƒe aʋala, siwo ke la, asa wò anyigba ƒe kekeme. Mawu ti kpli mí!

english_verse: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.
translation_verse: Ne miede adaŋu la, woagblẽ eme, ne mieɖo gbe ɖi la, mava me o; elabena Mawu li kpli mí! Nuxɔxlɔ̃ bena, woaxɔ Mawu gbagbe la dzi ase.

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa ƒo nu kplim, eye eƒe asi nu sẽ ɖe dzinye wogbe nya nam be, nyemagazɔ dukɔ sia ƒe mo dzi o hegblɔ bena:

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: Migayɔ nusiwo katã dukɔ sia yɔna be nugbeɖoɖo la, be nugbeɖoɖo o, migavɔ̃ nusi wovɔ̃na la o, eye megadzi ŋɔ na mi o.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Mibu Yehowa Zebaot kokoe, eye eya nenye vovɔ̃ kple ŋɔdzi na nu.

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Bia ɖaseɖiɖi la, eye natre nufiame la nu ɖe nye nusrɔ̃viwo me.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Eyata mele Yehowa, amesi tsyo nu eƒe ŋku me ɖe Yakob ƒe aƒea la sinu dzɔm, eye mele mɔ kpɔm nɛ.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mía kple vi, siwo Yehowa tsɔ nam la, míenye dzesi kple kpɔɖeŋu le Israel tso Yehowa Zebaot, amesi le Zionto dzi la gbɔ.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Ne wogblɔ na mi be, mibia nu ŋɔliyɔlawo kple afakalawo se, amesiwo nɔa ŋɔti me gbee dom, eye wonɔa gbe tem la, ɖe dukɔ mabia nu eƒe Mawu ase oa? De woabia nu kukuawo na agbagbeawoa?

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Mitrɔ ɖe nufiame kple ɖaseɖiɖi la ŋu! Ne womegblɔ alea o la, ekema agu medze na wo o.

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Woanɔ tsa glãla tsam, woate wo ɖe anyi, eye do awu wo, eye ne do le wo wum la, wòado dziku ahaƒo fi ade woƒe fia kple woƒe Mawu. Eye ne wofa ko dzi

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: alo wode ko to la, kpo ɖa, xaxa kple viviti li; xaxa ƒe tsizi kple blukɔ me woatutu wo ade.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: Dukɔ, si le viviti me zɔm la, kpɔ kekeli gãa ɖe, amesiwo le blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi ƒe anyigba dzi la, kekeli klẽ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Edzi dukɔ la ɖe edzi, eye nena dzidzɔ do gã; wokpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋkuwò me, abe alesi wokpɔa dzidzɔ le nuŋeɣi ene, abe alesi wotsoa aseye, ne wòmã aboyonu ene.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Elabena èŋe woƒe agba ƒe kɔkuti, ati, si le woƒe kɔʋu me, kple wo kplɔlawo ƒe ati, abe Midian ŋɔli ene.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Elabena wòtɔ dzo amesiwo ƒo aʋazi la ƒe afɔkpawo katã kple awu, siwo wobliba ɖe ʋu me la, eye dzo afiã wo.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Elabena wodzi vi na mí, eye wona ŋutsuvi mí, dziɖuɖu le abɔta nɛ, eye wotso ŋkɔ nɛ be; Nukunu, adaŋudela, Mawu kalẽtɔ, fofo mava, ŋutifafafia,

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: ne eƒe dziɖuɖu nakeke ta, eye seƒeɖo manɔe na ŋutifafa le Dawid ƒe fiazikpui dzi kple eƒe fiaɖuƒe la me o, ne wòafɔe ɖe te, eye wòatsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe ali kee tso fifia ɖaseɖe mavɔ me. Yehowa Zebaot ƒe ŋuʋaʋã awɔ esia ade goe. Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ Israel.

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: „Anyikpewoe mũ dze anyi, ke miatsɔ gãwo atui, gbotiwoe wolã, ke míado sedertiwo ɖe wo teƒe.“

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa do Rezin ƒe ketɔwo ɖe dzi ɖe eŋu, eye wòde akiti lã me na eƒe futɔwo:

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ la metrɔ ɖe amesi ƒoe la ŋu o, eye womedi Yehowa Zebaot yome mí o.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa tsrɔ̃ la kple asike, deʋaya kple keti ɖa tso Israel le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Ame tsitsiwo kple ame ŋkutawo nye ta la, eye nyagblɔɖila, siwo baa atakpadada la, wonye asike la.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Dukɔ sia kplɔlawo nye ameblelawo, eye amesiwo woble la, wobu.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Elabena vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ le bibim abe dzo ene, efiã aŋɔkawo kple ŋuwò, eye wòtɔ dzo ave dodowo, ale be dzudzɔ de dzi kɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot ƒe dziku na dzo ƒo anyigba, eye dukɔ la le abe dzo ƒe nuɖuɖu ene; amea ɖeke mekpɔ nɔvia ta o.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Wole tsyo dam nu le ɖusi me, ke dɔwuame nu mefa o, wole nu ɖum le mia me, ke womeɖi ƒo o, amesiame ɖu eya ŋutɔ ƒe abɔ ƒe lã;

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Manase ɖu Efrayim, eye Efrayim ɖu Manase; woa kple eve la siaa wotso ɖe Yuda ŋu. Ke to esiawo katã gbɔ ha eƒe dɔmedzoe nu mefa o, eye eƒe alɔ gale dzi ko.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo tsɔ ɖoɖo gbegblẽwo wɔ see, kple agbalẽŋlɔla, siwo le ameteteɖanyi ŋlɔm ɖi,

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Nuka miawɔ le gbesigbe wotu eŋu fe, eye gbegblẽ tso adzɔge va? Ameka miasi atso, eye afika miagblẽ miaƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖo?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ame labɔbɔ ɖe gatɔwo dome, eye wòadze anyi ɖe ame tsiaʋawo dome. Ke to esiawo katã gbɔ hã la eƒe dɔmedzoe nu mefa o, eye eƒe alɔ gale dzi ko! Asur ƒe dàda kple bɔbɔɖanyi.

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: Baba na Asur, nye dɔmedzoe ƒe ameƒoti wònye, eye nye dziku ƒe ati le esi me.

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Medɔe ɖe dukɔ vɔ̃ɖi la ŋu, eye meɖe gbe nɛ ɖe nye dɔmedzoe ƒe dukɔ la ŋu, ne wòaɖe aboyo, wòaha nu, eye wòafanyae abe ba le kpɔdome ene.

english_verse: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
translation_verse: Ke eya mesusu alea o, eye mebu ɖe dzi me alea o, ke boŋ eɖo ɖe ta be, yeagblẽ nu, eye yeatsrɔ̃ dukɔ geɖewo.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: Elabena egblɔ be: Ɖe nye amegãwo katã menye fiawo oa?

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: Ɖe meva me na Kalno abe Karkemis ene, Xamat abe Arpad ene, Samaria abe Damasko ene oa?

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Eye ava me, ne Aƒetɔ la awu eƒe dɔwo katã nu ɖe Zion-to la kple Yerusalem ŋu vɔ la, atu Asur-fia ƒe dada ƒe kutsetse kpakple eƒe dadaŋku ƒe adegbeƒoƒo ŋu fe nɛ.

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Elabena egblɔ be: Nye asi ƒe ŋusẽ kple nye nunya metsɔ wɔe, elabena mese nu gɔme, meɖe dukɔwo ƒe liƒowo ɖa, eye metutu fiazikpui dzi nɔlawo ƒu anyi abe ŋusẽtɔ ene;

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: nye asi tu dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo abe xevitɔ ene, abe alesi wolɔa azi, siwo dzi xeviwo dzo le lae la, nenema mele anyigba blibo lae, eye amea ɖeke meƒo aʋala alo ke dɔ heyi xɔxlɔ̃ ge o.

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: Ɖe fía aƒo adegbe ɖe amesi tsɔe le nu lãmee la ŋua? Alo ɖe laxalaxa atɔ asi akɔ ɖe amesi le ehem la ŋua? Ɖe ati anye amesi fɔe ɖe dzi la ɖa? Eye ɖe atizɔti akɔ nusi menye ati o la dzia?

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Eyata Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, aɖo kpexlẽ ɖe eƒe ame damiwo dome, eye eƒe aʋakɔ abi, abe alesi dzo binae ene.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe kekeli azu dzo, eye eƒe kɔkɔetɔ la azu dzoƒaɖe ahabi eƒe aŋɔkawo kple ŋuwo le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi, eye wòafiã wo;

english_verse: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
translation_verse: agblẽ eƒe ave kple atibɔwo tso tu me vaseɖe tsrokpa dzi, eye wo nu ayi abe dɔnɔ ene;

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: woate ŋu axlẽ eƒe avemeti susɔeawo, eye ɖevi ɖeka ade wo agbalẽ me. Israeltɔ susɔeawo ƒe dzimetɔtrɔ.

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Eye wòava me le ɣemaɣi be, Israel ƒe ame susɔeawo kple Yakob ƒe aƒe ƒe ame sisiwo magaɖo dzi ɖe amesi ƒo wo la ŋu azɔ o, ke boŋ woaɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa, Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Elabena Israel, ne wò dukɔ le abe ƒutake ene hã la, ame mamleawo koe atrɔ ta me. Woɖo gbegblẽ, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye gbagba ɖi!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Elabena Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, ahe tsɔtsrɔ̃, si wòɖo kplikpaa la, ava anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, gblɔ esi: Nye dukɔ, si le Zion, megavɔ̃ Asur, si tso ati, be yeaƒo woe, eye, wòka atizɔti dzi ɖe ŋuwò abe Egipte ene la o!

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Elabena ekpɔtɔ vie ko dziku la nu natso, eye nye dɔmedzoe natrɔ ɖe wo ŋu, ne woatsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot aɖe atam ɖe wo dzi, abe alesi wòƒo Midian le Oreb-kpe la gbɔ ene, eye eƒe atìkplɔ anɔ atsiaƒu dzi, abe alesi wòdoe ɖe dzi ɖe Egipte ŋu ene.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Eye ava me le ɣemaɣi be, eƒe agba aɖe le wò abɔta kple eƒe kɔkuti le wò ko, eye kɔkuti la aŋe le amidada ta.

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Eva dze Ayat dzi, eto Migron, eye wòva gblẽ eƒe nuwo ɖe Mixmas.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Woto to dome mo, eye wotsi Geba dɔ. Rama dzo nyanyanya, Saul ƒe Gibea de afɔ du me!

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Galim-nyɔnuvi ɖo boboe; Laisa ƒu to anyi; nublanuitɔ enye Anatot!

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Madmena si, Gebim-tɔwo ɖe ato du me!

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Egbea ke wòadze aʋa ɖe Nob, eye wòanye eƒe asi ɖe Zion-nyɔnuvi ƒe to, Yerusalem ƒe togbe la ŋu.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Kpo ɖa, Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, atsɔ ŋɔdzidodo alã atilɔwo, atso esiwo de dzi bobobo, eye kɔkɔtɔwo amũ;

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: woatso lãnu aƒo ave dodowo, eye ŋusẽtɔ la amũ Libanon aƒu anyi.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Eye atilɔ amie tso Isai ƒe atitakpo me, eye dzedze atso eƒe ke me atse ku.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ, si nye nunya kple gɔmesese ƒe gbɔgbɔ, adaŋu dede kple ŋusẽ ƒe gbɔgbɔ, sidzedze kple Yehowa vovo ƒe gbɔgbɔ la, anɔ edzi.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Yehowa vɔvɔ̃ ƒe nu anyo eŋu, madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe nusi eƒe ŋku le kpɔkpɔm la nu o, eye matso afia ɖe nusi eƒe to le sesem la nu o.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na ame dahewo le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye woatso afia na anyigba dzi hiãtɔwo ɖe eteƒe; atsɔ eƒe nu me likplɔ aƒo ŋutasẽla la, eye woatso eƒe nu me gbɔgbɔ awu ame vɔ̃ɖi lae.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye anye alidziblanu le eƒe ali, eye nyateƒe anye alidziblanu le eƒe aklito.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Amegãxi ana alẽvi gbɔ, lãkle atsyɔ akɔ ɖe gbɔ̃vi gbɔ, nyivi, dzata kple nyi dami woana wo nɔewo gbɔ, eye ŋutsuvi suea ɖe akplɔ wo.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Nyinɔ kple sisiblisinɔ woaɖu gbe, eye wo viwo atsyɔ akɔ ɖe afi ɖeka. Dzata aɖu gbe abe nyi ene.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Ɖevi nono ate le ƒli ƒe do nu, eye ɖevi, si ɖi no la, aƒo asi ɖe dakpui ƒe do me.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Womawɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke o, eye womahe gbegblẽ ava nye tonyigba kɔkɔe blibo la dzi o, elabena sidzedze Yehowa xa anyigba la dzi, abe alesi tsi yɔ atsiaƒu me ene. Dukɔ kaka ta ƒe ɖeɖe.

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Eye woava me le ɣemaɣi be, dukɔwo adi Isai ƒe ke, si nye aflaga li na anyigba dzi dukɔwo la yome, eye eƒe gbɔɖemeƒe anye atsyɔ̃.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Eye woava me le ɣemaɣi be, Aƒetɔ la ado eƒe asi ɖa zi evelia, ne wòaxɔ eƒe dukɔ mamlea, si kpɔtɔ ɖi la, aƒle tso Asur, Egipte, Patros, Kus, Elam, Sinear, Xamat kple atsiaƒu me ƒukpowo dzi.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Akɔ aflaga dzi na dukɔwo, eye wòaƒo Israel ƒe amesiwo woava de gbe kple Yuda-nyɔnu, siwo wokaka hlẽ la nu ƒu tso anyigba ƒe go eneawo dzi.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe ŋuʋaʋã nu atso, eye woatsrɔ̃ Yuda ƒe ketɔwo. Efrayim mana ŋu Yuda o, eye Yuda maxaxa Efrayim ɖo o.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Woadzo ɖe abɔta na Filistitowo le ƒu gome, eye woaƒo ƒu aɖaha ɣedzeƒeviwo, woake asi ɖe Edom kple Moab ŋu, eye Amon-viwo aɖo to wo.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Yehowa ana Egipte-ƒu la ƒe ado namie, eye anyẽ eƒe asi ɖe tɔsisi la dzi le eƒe ya sesẽ me, eye wòamãe ɖe tonu adre me, ale be woano atokota me atsoe.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Eye wòanye ma tata na eƒe dukɔ ƒe ame mamlea, siwo akpɔtɔ tso Asur, abe alesi wònɔ na Israel, esime wòʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ene.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la àgblɔ bena: Mekafu wò, Yehowa, elabena edo dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye, ke wò dɔmedzoe nu fa, eye nève nunye.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu enye nye xɔname, dzi le ƒonye, nyemavɔ̃ o; elabena nye ŋusẽ kple nye hadzidzi enye Yehowa, ẽ, Yehowa, eye eya zu nye xɔname!

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Eye miadu tsi le xɔname ƒe vudowo me kple dzidzɔ

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: ahagblɔ le ɣemaɣi be: Mikafu Yehowa, miyɔ eƒe ŋkɔ, miɖe eƒe nuwɔwɔwo fia le dukɔwo dome, miɖe gbe ƒãe be, eƒe ŋkɔ de dzi.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Yehowa, elabena ewɔ nu klitsuwo; woanya esia le anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Zion-nɔla, kpɔ dzidzɔ, eye natso aseye, elabena Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la tri akɔ le dowò me.

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Nya, si Yesaya, Amoz vi la, kpɔ ɖe Babel ŋu enye si:

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Mitu aflaga ɖe to ƒeƒle la ta me, mido ɣli yɔ wo, mimiã asi wo, ne woage ɖe amegãwo ƒe du la me!

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Medɔ nye ame kɔkɔewo, meyɔ nye kalẽtɔwo, nye aseyetsolawo kple adegbeƒolawo ɖe nye dɔmedzoe la ŋu.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Miƒu to anyi, zi le ɖiɖim le towo dzi abe dukɔ geɖewo tɔ ene; fiaɖuƒewo kple anyigba dzi dukɔ, siwo kpe ta la ƒe howɔwɔ le ɖiɖim. Yehowa Zebaot le aʋakɔwo xlẽm!

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Wotso anyigba didi dzi, tso dziƒo ƒe mlɔenu, Yehowa kple eƒe dziku ƒe dɔwɔnuwo, ne woagblẽ anyigba blibo la.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Mifa avi, elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe, egbɔna abe ŋusẽkatãtɔ ƒe nugbegblẽ ene.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Eyata asiwò katã ado agblɔ, eye amegbetɔwo ƒe dziwo katã alólo gbanaa.

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: Dzidzi ƒo wo, nutsoame kple veve lé wo, eye wole ku lém abe nyɔnu dzivi ene; wofa ŋku ɖe wo nɔewo dzi gã, eve woƒe mo le vem hẽ!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke dziŋɔ la gbɔna, dziku kple dɔmedzoe heliheli, ne wòado gbegbe anyigba la, eye woatsrɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ɖa le edzi.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Elabena dziƒoɣletiviwo kple woƒe avũ kple avũtɔwo mana woƒe kekeli naklẽ o, ne ɣe dze la, ado viviti, eye ɣleti mana eƒe kekeli naɖi o.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Matu xexeame ƒe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe vodada ŋu fe na wo, mana dadalawo ƒe dada nu natso, eye mate ŋutasẽlawo ƒe adegbeƒoƒo ɖe to.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Mana amegbetɔ nave abe sika nyuitɔ ene, eye ame kodzogbea abe Ofir-sika ene.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Eyata matsɔ Yehowa Zebaot ƒe dzikudodo kple eƒe dɔmedzoedogbe ana dziƒo nadzo kpekpekpe, eye anyigba naʋuʋu le enɔƒe.

english_verse: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
translation_verse: Ava me na wo abe sãde, si wonyã ɖe nu, kple alẽ, siwo amea ɖeke mele wo nu o la ene; amesiame atu ta eƒe dukɔ gbɔ, eye amesiame asi ayi eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Woada nu amesi ke woakpɔ, eye amesi ke asi tu la, atsi yi nu;

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: woaxlã wo viwo ɖe nu le wo ŋku me, woaha woƒe aƒewo, eye woade asi wo srɔ̃wo ŋu.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, made adã Mediatɔwo ƒe ta me ɖe wo ŋu, amesiwo mebua klosalo o, eye sika medzroa wo o;

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: woƒe dawo tea ɖekakpuiwo, womekpɔa nublanui na fu nɔdɔmee o, eye woƒe ŋkuwò mevea ɖeviwo nu o.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Ale woava me na Babel, si nye fiaɖuƒewo ƒe nu vevi kple Kaldea-tɔwo ƒe adegbeƒoƒo kple atsyɔ la, abe alesi Mawu trɔ Sodom kple Gomora bu anyi ene.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Womatso aƒe ɖe afima akpɔ o tegbee, eye wòatsi anyi aƒedoe tso dzidzime yi dzidzime, Arabiatɔwo matu agbadɔ ɖe afima o, eye lãkplɔviwo mana lãwo natsyɔ akɔ ɖe afima o;

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: gbemelãwo atsyɔ akɔ ɖe afima, eye favieʋuto ayɔ woƒe xɔwo me, golowo atso aƒe ɖe afima, eye azizãwo aɖi adzra le afima.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Gbevũwo axlã le woƒe dziƒoxɔwo me kple amegãxiwo le woƒe agbeɖuɖu ƒe fiasãwo me. Woƒe ɣeyiɣi tu aƒe, eye woƒe ŋkeke mahe ɖe megbe o.

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ave Yakob nu, eye wòagatia Israel ahakplɔ wo aɖo woƒe anyigba dzi, du bubu me tɔwo akpe ɖe wo ŋu, eye woaku ɖe Yakob ƒe aƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Woakplɔ dukɔwo ayi wo teƒee, eye woazu Israel ƒe aƒe la tɔ anye dɔlaŋutsuwo kple dɔlanyɔnuwo le Yehowa ƒe anyigba la dzi; ale woalé amesiwo ɖe aboyo wo la, eye woaɖu amegã ɖe woƒe ŋutasẽlawo dzi.

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Eye ava me le gbesigbe Yehowa ana gbɔdzɔe wò tso wò fuɖeɖewo kple hiãkakawo kpakple dɔ sesẽ, siwo wotsɔ do kluvi wò me la,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: be ado hamelo sia ɖa ɖe Babel-fia ŋu agblɔ bena: Funyafunyawɔwɔ nu tso, eye ŋutasesẽ wu enu!

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Yehowa ŋe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ati, dziɖulawo ƒe atikplɔ,

english_verse: who were furious and never stopped abusing the people of other nations.
translation_verse: si ƒo dukɔwo le dziku me atraɖi, si te anyigba dzi dukɔwo ɖe anyi le dɔmedzoe me heti wo yome madzudzɔmadzudzɔe la.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Anyigba blibo la gbɔ ɖe eme bɔkɔɔ, wode asi aseyetsotso me.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Sesewuwo kple Libanon ƒe sedertiwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm ɖe ŋuwò be. Esime nèmlɔ anyi kpaa la, mia lãlawo megaho ɖe mia ŋu kpɔ o.

english_verse: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
translation_verse: Tsieƒe le to me ʋi dzo nyanyanya le ŋkuwò me, le esi neva do goe la ta; enyɔ ŋɔli, siwo nye anyigba dzi ŋusẽtɔwo katã le ŋkuwò me, ena dukɔwo ƒe fiawo katã tso le woƒe fiazikpuiwo dzi.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Wo katã wòxɔ dzi gblɔ na wò bena: „Wò ha egbɔdzɔ abe míawo ke ene, ezu abe miawo ene.

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Wò atsyɔ̃ kple wò saŋkuwo ƒe ɖiɖi yi tsieƒe, wotsɔ nyẽwo ɖo aba na wò, eye ŋɔwo tsyɔ dziwò.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: Wò ŋukeɣletivi, agudzevi, ale nège tso dziƒo enye si! Wò, amesi te dukɔwo ɖe anyi, woƒo wò ƒu anyigba!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le wò dzi me be: Malia dziƒo, mali nye fiazikpui ɖe Mawu ƒe ɣletiviwo ta me, eye mabɔbɔ nɔ takpeto la dzi le anyiehe kekeake;

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: malia alilikpowo ta me, eye mia kple dziƒoʋĩtɔ la mianɔ tasɔsɔ me.

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ke woatutu wò aƒu tsieƒe, ɖe aʋli doblukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi la me.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Amesiwo kpɔ wò la, aɖe ŋku ɖe wò, agaɖe ŋku ɖe wò ʋuu agblɔ bena: Ŋutsu, si na anyigba dzo nyanyanya, eye wòʋuʋu fiaɖuƒewo la, nye esia?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Amesi wɔ xexeame wòzu gbegbe, gbã eƒe duwo ƒu anyi, eye mede asi le eƒe aboyomewo ŋu ɖo de aƒe o la, nye esia?

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: Ke wotsɔ wò ya ƒu gbe tso wò yɔdo gbɔ, abe atilɔ, si wotsɔ ƒu gbe, kple lã kuku, si wofanya kple afɔ la ene, eye ame tsiaʋa, siwo woda yii, eye woyi agu me kpewo gbɔ la, tsyɔ dziwò.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Masɔ kple woamawo le yɔ me o; elabena ègblẽ wò anyigba, eye nèwu wò dukɔ. Womayɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe viwo ŋkɔ akpɔ o tegbee.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Midzra wuƒe ɖo hena viawo le wo fofowo ƒe vodada ta. Womegatso, ne woaxɔ anyigba la, eye woatsɔ anyiglãgowo ayɔ xexeame o.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa Zebaot be: Matso ɖe wo ŋu, Yehowa Zebaot be: Matsrɔ̃ ŋkɔ kple ame susɔeawo, viwo kple dzidzimeviwo ɖa le Babel ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot be: Matsɔe awɔ hlɔ̃madewo nɔƒe kple simee, eye matsɔ tsɔtsrɔ̃ ƒe abaya akplɔe. Filistitɔwo kple Asiriatɔwo ƒe gbegblẽ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot ka atam be: Alesi mebu ɖe ta me la, nenema wòanɔ, eye alesi meɖo la, nenema woava mee

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: Magbã Asur le nye anyigba dzi, eye mafanyae kple afɔ ɖe nye towo dzi, eƒe kɔkuti aɖe ɖa le wo ŋu, eye eƒe agba adzo ɖa le woƒe kɔʋu me.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Esia nye ta me, si woɖo ɖe anyigba blibo la ŋu, eye esia nye alɔ, si wodo ɖe dzi ɖe dukɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Elabena ne Yehowa Zebaot ɖo nu ɖe ta me la, ameka agble eme, eye ne edo eƒe alɔ ɖe dzi la, ameka agbugbɔe?

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Gbe, siwo va le ƒe, si me fia Axaz ku la, wonye esi:

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Filisti-nyigba blibo la, meganɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm le esi ati, si ƒo wò la ŋe ta o! Elabena ƒli ado tso da ƒe ke me, eye eƒe kutsetse anye da toaʋala.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Ame dahewo ƒe ame dahewo aɖu nu, eye hiãtɔwo anɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ, ke matsɔ dɔwuame awu wò ke, eye matsrɔ̃ wò ame susɔeawo.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: Agbo, fa avi; du, do ɣli: Filisti-nyigba blibo la, lolo gbanaa! Elabena dzudzɔ tso anyiehe gbɔna, eye amea ɖeke metsi megbe le eƒe aʋawɔlawo dome o.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Eye aleke woahaɖo eŋu na dukɔwo ƒe ame dɔdɔwo ma? Yehowa tso Zion, eye eyae eƒe dukɔ ƒe hiãtɔwo asi atso.

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Nya ɖe Moab ŋu. Vavãe, woaha Ar-Moab le zã, eye woatsrɔe! Vavãe, woaha Kir-Moab le zã, eye woatsrɔe!

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibon-nyɔnuvi yi nuxe ƒe avi fa ge, Moab le konyi fam le Neho kple Medeba ta me, wo katã wolũ ta kokoe, eye wolũ gewo katã.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Wosa akpanya ɖe ali le eƒe kpɔdomewo, amesiame le konyi fam le eƒe xɔtawo kple ablɔwo me, eye aɖatsi le dodom yoyoyo.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Xesbon kple Eleale le boboe dom, eye wose woƒe ɣli le Yahaz ke. Eyata Moab ƒe aʋawɔlawo ɖo ɣli, eye eƒe luʋɔ dzo kpekpekpe.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le nu xam ɖe Moab ŋu, eya, si ƒe amewo si de Zoar kple Eglat etɔ̃lia ke; elabena wole avi fam le Luxit-to dzi mɔ la dzi; elabena konyifaɣli le ɖiɖim le wo ŋu le Xoronayim-mɔta.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Elabena Nimrim ƒe tsiwo azu tagba, gbe aƒu, gbe fe aku, eye aŋgba manɔ anyi o.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Eyata woatso woƒe kesinɔnu, siwo woƒo ƒu, kple nusiwo wodzra ɖo la, ato amutitɔʋu la dzi ayi.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Elabena konyifaɣli kpe Moab ƒe liƒo ɖo, eƒe avifafa de Eglayim ke, eƒe avifafa de Beer-Elim ke!

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Elabena ʋu yɔ Dimon ƒe towo me fũ; elabena magahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava Dimon dzi, eye makplɔ dzata ade Moab ƒe ame sisiwo kple amesiwo kpɔtɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Miɖo anyigbadziɖula ƒe alẽviwo ɖa tso Sela to gbegbe ɖe Zion-nyɔnuvi ƒe to la gbɔ!

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Moab-nyɔnuviwo anɔ abe xevi, si wonyã le atɔ me wòsi ene le Arnon ƒe tɔtsoƒe.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: De adaŋu, drɔ̃ ʋɔnu, na wò vɔvɔli nanɔ abe zã ene le ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ! Yia amesiwo wonyã de gbe, eye megaɖe ame sisiwo gɔme ɖe go o!

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Na Moab ƒe amesiwo wonyã de gbe la, nanɔ gbɔwò, eye nanye sitsoƒe na wo tso nugblẽla si me, vaseɖe esime ŋutasesẽ nu natso, tsɔtsrɔ̃ nawu enu, eye amefanyala nate ɖa le anyigba dzi!

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Eye woatsɔ amenuveve ali ke fiazikpuia ɖe, eye ʋɔnudrɔ̃laa ɖe anɔ edzi le Dawid ƒe agbadɔ me ɖikaa, amesi dia nya dzɔdzɔe yome, eye wòsea dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
translation_verse: Míese Moab ƒe dàda, alesi wòle asi tɔm akɔe vevie, eƒe dàda, eƒe dziku kple eƒe nu kpoloe ƒoƒo ɖe ya me.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Eyata Moab afa avi ɖe Moab ŋu, eye wo katã woawu avi; miafa konyi ɖe Kir-Xareset ƒe weintsetse ŋu, eye nu ate mia ŋu.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Elabena Xesbon-gblewo yrɔ, Sibma ƒe weinka, si ƒe tsetse nyuitɔwo ƒo dukɔwo ƒe amegãwo ƒu anyi, eye wode Yaezer ke heva bu ɖe gbegbe, eƒe alɔwo vu gbɔ atsiaƒu la!

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Eyata mala avi, abe alesi Yaezer le avi fam ɖe Sibma ƒe weinka ŋu ene, Xesbon kple Eleale, mafa nye adatsi ɖe mía dzi, le esi aʋaɣli dze miaƒe kutsetsegbeɣi kple nuŋeɣi me la ŋuti.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Dzidzɔ kple vivisese nu tso le abɔwo me, eye womegale aseye tsom le dzidzɔ kpɔm le weingblewo me o; womegafiãa wein le weinfiãnu me o, eye metsi dzidzɔɣli nu.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Eyata nye dɔkavi le gbe ɖem ɖe Moab ŋu abe ka-saŋku ene kple nye dɔme ɖe Kir-Xeres ŋu.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Eye wòava me, ne Moab do ɖe nuxeƒe hele dagbadagbam, eye wòva eƒe kɔkɔeƒe, ne wòado gbe ɖa la, mate ŋui o.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Esia nye nya, si Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Moab ŋu tsã.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Azɔ ta Yehowa gblɔ be: Le ƒe etɔ̃ me tu-tutu abe agbatedɔwɔla ƒe ƒe ene la, maɖi gbɔ Moab ƒe ŋusẽ hekpe ɖe eƒe ameha gbogboawo ŋu, eye susɔea anɔ ʋee, manɔ nemi me hã o.
