english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Nya ɖe Damasko ŋu: Kpɔ ɖa, woaɖe Damasko ɖa maganye du azɔ o, eye wòatrɔ zu anyiglãgo.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Woagblẽ Aroer ƒe duwo ɖi woazu lãhawo to, woatsyɔ akɔ anyi ɖe afima, eye amea ɖeke maɖo voɖi na wo o.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe mɔ̃ kple Damasko ƒe fiaɖuƒe nu ayi, eye Aram ƒe ame susɔeawo ƒe ŋusẽ anɔ abe Israel-viwo tɔ ene, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Ava me le ɣemaɣi be, Yakob ƒe ŋusẽ ado agblɔ, eye ami ano le eƒe lã me.

english_verse: Israel will be like wheat fields in Rephaim Valley picked clean of grain.
translation_verse: Anɔ abe alesi nuŋela léa ahɔ̃liti, eye eƒe asi ŋea bliwo ene, eye anɔ abe alesi wofaa bli dzɔdzɔe le Refaim-bali me ene.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Kutsetse akpɔtɔ ɖe edzi hena nu dzɔdzɔe fɔlawo, abe alesi wogbea amitii ene, kutsetse eve alo etɔ̃ tsia eƒe ɖɔ mee, wo ame ene alo atɔ̃ nɔa ati tseku la ƒe alɔwo me, Yehowa Israel ƒe Mawu la gblɔe.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la amegbetɔ atrɔ kɔ ɖe ewɔla ŋu, eye eƒe ŋkuwò akpɔ Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la dzi ɖa;

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: eye matrɔ kɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui, siwo nye eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo la ŋu o, eye maɖe ŋku ɖe Asera kple ɣelegba, siwo eya ŋutɔ ƒe asi wo la o.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la woƒe du sesẽwo azu gbegbe, abe Xiwitɔwo kple Amoritɔwo ƒe aƒedo, siwo wogblẽ ɖi hesi le Israel-viwo nu la ene.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Elabena èŋlɔ wò xɔxɔ ƒe Mawu la be, eye meɖo ŋu wò sitsoƒe ƒe agakpe la o; eyata nede agble nyowo, eye nèdo du bubu me tɔwo ƒe weinka ɖe wo me.

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: Gbesigbe nedoe la, ètɔ kpɔ ɖe eŋu, eye esi ŋu ke la, èna wò nukuawo ƒo se, ke nuŋeɣi la ʋu ya le takpegbe kple veve heliheli segbe. Nyagblɔɖi le Israel ŋuti.

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo le ho wɔm abe tsi geɖewo ƒe howɔwɔ ene, ke eblu ɖe wo ta, eye wòsi yi adzogedzogee, woɖe wo ɖe nu abe gbe ƒuƒu le ya nu le towo dzi kple yali le ahom nu ene.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi li le fiẽnyi, eye hafi ŋu nava ke la, womegali o. Esia nye amesiwo da adzo mi la ƒe gome kple mia halawo ƒe dzidzenu.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Baba na anyigba, si le aʋala ƒom kpakpakpa le Kus ƒe tɔsisiwo ƒe go keme,

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: anyigba, si dɔ amewo ɖo ɖe atsiaƒu dzi, eye wole aƒlaʋuwo me to tɔwo dzi! Mi dɔla ɖablɛwo, miyi dukɔ, si dzɔ atsu ƒlalu, eye eŋu zrɔ̃ dredredre la gbɔ, dukɔ, si wovɔ̃na dea didiƒe ke, dukɔ, si klitsu, eye wònyãa avuzi le ame dzi, dukɔ, si ƒe anyigba me tɔsisiwo to yi.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Mi xexea me nɔlawo katã kple anyigbadzitɔwo, ne wotu aflaga ɖe towo dzi la, miakpɔe, eye ne woku kpẽ la, miasee!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ nam enye si: Manɔ nɔnyeƒe kpoo anɔ ekpɔm, ne ŋdɔkutsu le vevem heliheli, ne alilikpowo le zãmu dzam le nuŋeɣi ƒe dzoxɔxɔ me.

english_verse: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
translation_verse: Elabena hafi nuŋeɣi naɖo, ne seƒoƒowo nu yi, eye weintsetse gbogbowo zu ɖiɖiawo la, atsɔ hɛ gobɛ alã kaawo, aɖi aba wo ɖa, eye woaŋe wo.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Woagblẽ wo katã ɖi na to dzi xe ƒonuwo kple anyigba dzi lãwo; xe ƒonuwo anɔ wo dzi le dzomeŋɔli, eye anyigba dzi lãwo katã anɔ wo dzi le vuvɔŋɔli.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la dukɔ, si dza atsu ƒlalu, eye eŋu zrɔ̃ dredredre, dukɔ, si wovɔ̃na le dea didiƒe ke, dukɔ, si klitsu, eye wònyãa avuzi le ame dzi, dukɔ, si ƒe anyigba me tɔsisiwo to yi la, ahe nunanawo vɛ na Yehowa Zebaot, ayi Yehowa Zebaot ƒe ŋkɔ ƒe nɔƒe, ayi Zion-to la gbɔ.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Nya ɖe Egipte ŋu. Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa do alilikpo ɖidu gbɔna ɖe Egipte: Egipte legbawo dzo nyanyanya le eŋku me, eye dzi lolo ɖe dɔ me na Egipte

english_verse: “I will punish Egypt with civil war— neighbors, cities, and kingdoms will fight each other.
translation_verse: Eye mado avu na Egipte kple Egipte, nɔvi kple nɔvi, havi kple havi, du kple du, fiaɖuƒe kple fiaɖuƒe, ne woawo ana kple wo nɔewo.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Maɖe gbɔgbɔ le Egipte me keŋkeŋ, eye magblẽ eƒe tameɖoɖo me, eye woabia nu legbawo, dzotɔwo, ŋɔliyɔlawo kple afakalawo.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Matsɔ Egipte ade asi na amegã sesẽa ɖe, eye fia sẽŋuta aɖu wo dzi, Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Tsi ano le atsiaƒu me, eye tɔsisi la amie aƒu kplakplakpla.

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Tɔsisiwo aʋẽ kũ, Egipte tɔʋuwo nu atso ahamĩe, eye aƒla kple ava ayrɔ.

english_verse: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
translation_verse: Gbeteƒe, siwo le Nil to, le Nil ƒe azizã nu kple nudodowo katã aƒu kplakplakpla, woaɖo ƒuƒu ɖe wo, eye wòmaganɔ anyi o.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe lé amesiwo trea anazi kple amesiwo lɔ̃a aklala.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Wogbã eƒe agunusɔtiwo, eye agbatedɔwɔlawo katã le nu xam.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Bometsilawo ɖeɖe sɔŋ nye Zoan-amegãwo, Farao ƒe adaŋudela nyanuwo; wodo lã woƒe adaŋudede. Aleke miagblɔ na Farao be: Nunyalawo ƒe vi menye, blemafiawo ƒe vi menye?

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Afika wò nunyalawo le, ne woatoe na wò, eye wòadze si nusi Yehowa Zebaot ɖo ɖe Egipte ŋu?

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zoan-amegãwo zu bometsilawo, Nof-amegãwo flu wo ɖokui, amesiwo nye woƒe ƒomeawo ƒe dzogoekpewo na Egipte le nagbanagba kum.

english_verse: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
translation_verse: Yehowa de ŋuzitsɔame ƒe gbɔgbɔ wo me, ne woaflu Egipte le eƒe nuwɔwowo katã me, abe alesi ahamula nɔa ya mum le eƒe xeɖeɖe me ene.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la Egiptetɔwo anɔ abe nyɔnuwo ene, ŋɔ adzi wo, eye woadzo nyanyanya le Yehowa Zebaot ƒe asi, si wònyẽ ɖe wo ŋu la ŋuti.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Yuda-nyigba azu ŋɔdzi na Egipte, eye ne woyɔ eŋkɔ le egbɔ la, adzo nyanyanya le Yehowa ƒe ta me, si wòɖo ɖe eŋu la ta.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la du atɔ̃ anɔ Egipte-nyigba dzi, siwo agblɔ Kanaan-gbe, woaka atam na Yehowa Zebaot, eye woayɔ wo dometɔ ɖeka be dzɔdzɔenyenyedu.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la vɔsamlekpui anɔ Egipte-nyigba titina na Yehowa, eye dzesikpe anɔ eƒe liƒo dzi na Yehowa,

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: si anye dzesi kple ɖaseɖiɖi na Yehowa Zebaot le Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye ne wodo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe ketɔ, wo ta la, aɖo xɔnametɔ ɖe wo, amesi awɔ aʋa aɖe wo.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Yehowa aɖe eɖokui afia Egiptetɔwo, eye Egiptetɔwo adze si Yehowa ɣemaɣi, woatsɔ akpedavɔsa kple nuɖuvɔsa asubɔe, woaɖe adzɔgbe na Yehowa, eye woawɔ edzi.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Yehowa aƒo Egiptetɔwo, eye wòagahaya wo; elabena ne wòtrɔ ɖe eŋu la, ase woƒe kukuɖeɖe, eye wòahaya wo.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la mɔ tata atso Egipte ayi Asur; Asur ava Egipte, eye Egipte ayi Asur, eye Egipte kple Asur siaa woasubɔe.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la Israel anye etɔ̃lia akpe ɖe Egipte kple Asur ŋu ahanye yayra anɔ anyigba titina,

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: eye Yehowa Zebaot ayrae agblɔ bena: Woayra wò, nye dukɔ Egipte kple nye asinudɔwɔwɔ Asur kpakple nye do menyinu Israel!

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Le ƒe, si me Tartan va Asdod, esime Asur-fia Sargon dɔe ɖa, eye wòwɔ aʋa kple Asdod hexɔe la,

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: ɣemaɣi Yehowa ƒo nu to Yesaya, Amoz vi la dzi bena: Yi natu akpanya le ali, eye naɖe atokotawo le wò afɔ. Tete wòwɔ nenema, eye wòɖe ama le afɔ ƒuƒlu le yiyim.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ bena: Alesi nye dɔla Yesaya ɖe ama le afɔ ƒuƒlu le yiyim ƒe etɔ̃ sɔŋ la, dzesi kple kpɔɖeŋu wònye na Egipte kple Kus,

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: nenema Asur-fia akplɔ Egipte ƒe aboyomewo kple Kus ƒe amesiwo wonyã de gbe la ayii, ɖekakpuiwo kple amegã ɖeɖiwo, woaɖe ama, anɔ afɔ ƒuƒlu, eye woƒe agɔnu atsi ƒeƒle; ŋukpe wònye na Egipte.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Eye dzika atso wo ƒo, eye ŋu akpe wo ɖe Kus, si ŋu wole ŋu ɖom ɖo kple Egipte, si ta wole adegbe ƒom ɖo la ŋuti.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Eye ƒuta sia nɔlawo agblɔ le ɣemaɣi bena: Kpo ɖa, ale wòzu na amesiwo ŋu miele ŋu ɖom ɖo la enye si, amesiwo míesi yi ɖaɖo, be woaɖe mí tso Asur-fia si me. Aleke miawo míawɔ asi?

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Nya ɖe atsiaƒutagba ŋu: Egbɔna tso anyigba dziŋɔ dzi abe ahom le dziehe, si le tutum tso gbe dzi ene.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Ŋutega sesẽa ɖe woɖe fiãm be: Amegɔmezɔla, zɔ ame gɔme; adzoblasu, ha nu! Elam, ho va; Media, ɖe to ɖe ŋu! Matsi eƒe hũɖeɖewo katã nu.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Eyata nye ali tsom, eye veve ƒo ɖe dzinye abe nyɔnu dzivi ƒe vevesese ene. Nye ta me tɔtɔ, ale be nyemele nu sem o, eye dzi-dzi ƒom, ale be nyemele nu kpɔm o.

english_verse: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le ya mum sagãsagã, dzidziƒoame ble fu lã me nam, wona fiẽ, si ŋu mele ŋu ɖom ɖo la, zu ŋɔdzi nam.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Miɖo kplɔ̃, eye mikeke kuntruwo, miɖu nu, mino nu! Mi amegãwo, mitso, ne miasi ami na akpoxɔnu!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nam enye si: Yi naɖo gbetakpɔ la, ne wòato nusi wòkpɔ.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Eye ne ekpɔ sɔɖolawo ƒe ha le eveve, tedzi-dolawo kple kposɔdolawo la, wòaƒu to anyi vevie,

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: ahade gbe abe dzata ene be: Aƒetɔ, metsi tre ɖe nye dzɔƒe la ɖaa le ŋkeke me, eye metsi dzɔƒe la le zã blibo la me,

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: tete ŋutsu sɔdolawo gbɔna hele gbɔgblɔm be: Babel mũ, emũ, eye wogbã eƒe legbawo katã ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: Nye amesiwo wogbã gudugudu, nye lugboƒeviwo, nya, si mese tso Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la gbɔ la, meto na mi. Nyagblɔɖi ɖe Edom ŋuti.

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Nya ɖe Duma ŋu: Woyom tso Seir be. Dzola, zã gbɔ tsɔa? Dzola, zã gbɔ tsoa?

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Dzola be: Ŋkeke kple zã sia gbɔna ne miehe, yewoabia la, migava ne miabia! Nyagblɔɖi ɖe Arabia nu.

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Nya ɖe Arabia ŋu: Mi Dedantɔwo ƒe asihawo, mitsi ave me da le Arabia!

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: Mi Tema-nyigbadzitɔwo, mitso tsi yi ɖakpe ame tsikɔwuwo, mitso nuɖuɖu ɖakpe ame sisiwoe!

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Elabena yi nu wòsi le; yi, si wodi, kple ɖa, si me wovu, kpakple aʋa ƒe nyanyrã nu wòsi le.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nam enye si; Le ƒe ɖeka me tututu abe agbatedɔwɔla ƒe ƒe ene la Kedar ƒe ŋusẽwo katã nu ayi,

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: eye Kedar-viwo ƒe aʋawolawo ƒe dati susɔeawo ƒe xexlẽme azu ʋee; elabena Yehowa. Israel ƒe Mawu la, ye gblɔe!

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Nya ɖe ŋutegabalime la ŋu: Nya ka dzo, be mi katã miede xɔta?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Wò, howɔwɔ kple ʋunyaʋunya ƒe ɖu; wò, mɔ̃ tsoaseye! Wò ame kukuwo la, menye yi woda wo o, eye menye aʋa me wotsi o;

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: wò tatɔwo katã si, wobla wo ɖa matsɔmatsɔe, wode ga wò amewo katã, esi wòsi yi didiƒe ke hã

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Eyata mebe: Miɖe ko ɖa le ŋunye, ne mafa avi vevie, migaƒo ɖu ɖe nunye, be yewoafa akɔ nam le nye dukɔ ƒe vinyɔnu tsɔtsrɔ̃ la ŋuti o.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Elabena Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot he ʋunyaʋunya, tsɔtsrɔ̃ kple toto ƒe ŋkeke va ŋutegabali la me; wowlu gliwo te, eye ɣlikpɛ ɖi ɖo ɖe to la gbɔ.

english_verse: The people of Elam and Kir attacked with chariots and carried shields.
translation_verse: Elam kpla daku, eye tasiaɖam, siwo ame ya, kple sodolawo kpe ɖe eŋu; Kir klo nu le akpoxɔnu ŋu.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Ale tasiaɖamwo yɔ wò bali nyuitɔwo me, eye sodolawo dze aʋa ɖe wò agbowo ŋu.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Eklo avɔ le Yuda dzi, eye nètsa ŋu na avexɔ ƒe aʋawɔnuwo gbemagbe.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: Miekpo be, Dawid ƒe du la ƒe gbagbãƒewo so gbɔ, eye mieƒo anyigbeta ƒe tsiwo nu ƒu;

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Eye miede tsiʋe ɖe gli eveawo dome na ta xoxo la me tsiwo; ke mietrɔ kɔ ɖe amesi wɔe la ŋu o, eye mielé ŋku ɖe amesi wɔe tso gbaɖegbe ke la ŋu o.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, yɔ ame hena avifafa, konyifafa, talulũ kple akpanyatata;

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: ke agbeɖuɖu kple dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ li: wole nyi wum, wole ale tsom, wole lã ɖum, eye wole wein nom! Mina míaɖu nu, eye míano nu, elabena etsɔ miele kuku ge!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ ɖe to me nam be: Womatsɔ vodada sia ake mi akpɔ o, vaseɖe esime miaku! Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, ye gblɔe! Woagblẽ Sebna.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, gblɔ esi: Tso, nayi nuwo dzikpɔla Sebna, amesi lé aƒea nu la gbɔ.

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: Nukae le asiwò le afi, eye amekae li na wò le afi, hafi nèɖe yɔdo na ɖokuiwò ɖe afi, eɖe yɔdo ɖe kɔkɔƒe, eye nèwɔ nɔƒe na ɖo-kuiwò ɖe agakpe me?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ada wò ɖa, abe alesi ŋutsu ɖaa nu ɖae ene, eye wòavà wò goŋgoŋ,

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: eye woaŋlɔ wò kotikoti abe nu mligoe ene aɖo ɖe anyigba, si keke le goawo kple eve me la dzi. Afima naku ɖo, eye afima wò tasiaɖam nyuiawo atsi, wò, amesi nye wò aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe ƒe ŋukpe la!

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Maɖe wò le wò do nu, eye matutu wò ɖa le nowòƒe. Woado Elyakim ɖe dzi.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: maɖo wò awu nɛ, eye matsɔ wò alidziblanu abla ali dzi nɛ, matso wò dziɖuɖu ade asi ne, eye wòanye fofo na Yerusalem-tɔwo kple Yuda ƒe aƒe la.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Matsɔ Dawid ƒe aƒe la ƒe safui aɖo abɔta nɛ, aʋui, eye amea ɖeke madoe o; adoe, eye amea ɖeke maʋui o!

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Maƒoe ɖe teƒe sesẽ abe tsyoti ene, eye wòazu bubufiazikpui na fofoa ƒe aƒe.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: Eye fofoa ƒe aƒe hahoo blibo la aku ɖe eŋu, viwo kple tɔgbuiyɔviwo kple nu kpotoekpotoewo katã, tso agbanuwo dzi vaseɖe goenuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot be: Le ɣemaɣi la tsyoti, si woƒo ɖe teƒe sesẽ la, agli, aŋe, age adze anyi, eye agba, si le eŋu la, akaka gbẽ; elabena Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Nya ɖe Tiro ŋu: Mi Tarsis-ʋukulawo, mifa avi, elabena etsrɔ̃, aƒea ɖeke megali o, eye tɔtrɔgbɔ megali o! Wosee le Kititɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Mi ƒutatɔwo, Zidon-sitsalawo, amesiwo toa atsiaƒu dzi, eye woyɔa dua me taŋ la, miaƒe nu netsi te!

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: Wotso Sixor ƒe nukuwo kple Nil ƒe agblemenuwo va me, eye wòzu dukɔwo ƒe asiɖiƒe.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Zidon, ŋu nekpe wò, elabena atsiaƒu, atsiaƒu ƒe mɔ̃ sesẽ gblɔ be: Fu meɖum o, nyemedzi vi o, eye nyemenyi ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo wotsi o.

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Ne nya la de Egipte la, woadzo nyanyanya le Tiro ƒe nya la ta.

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Miaƒe dzidzɔdu, si dzɔ tso blema ke la, nye esia? Woƒe afɔwo kɔe yi didiƒe, ne wòadanye amedzro le afima.

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Amekae ɖo esia ɖe Tiro, si ɖaa fiakuku na ame la ŋu? Eƒe asitsalawo nye amegãwo, eye eƒe nudzralawo nye ame ŋkutawo le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot ɖoe ɖe ta me be, yeaɖi gbɔ atsyɔ̃ɖoɖowo katã ƒe dàda, eye yeaklo bubu le ame ŋkutawo ŋu le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Gbagba ɖe wò anyigba dzi abe Nil ene, wò Tarsis-nyɔnuvi, alidziblanua ɖeke megali o!

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Edo eƒe alo ɖe atsiaƒu ŋu, eʋuʋu fiaɖuƒewo, Yehowa de se ɖe Kanaan ŋu, ne wòatsrɔ̃ eƒe mɔ̃ sesẽwo,

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ bena: Màgatso aseye o, wò Zidon-ɖetugbi, si wogblẽ; tso, nayi Kititɔwo gbɔ, màkpɔ gbɔdzɔe le gama hã o.

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Kpo ɖa, Asur tso Kaldeatɔ, siwo meganye dukɔ o la ƒe anyigba na gbedzilãwo; wotu xɔ tsralawo, eye wogbã woƒe fiasãwo wozu glikpo.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Mi Tarsis-ʋukulawo, mifa avi, elabena wogblẽ miaƒe mɔ̃ sesẽ la.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Wò gbolo, si woŋlɔ be, tso kasaŋku natsa le dua me godoo; ƒo saŋku nyuie, dzi ha geɖe, ne woagaɖo ŋku dziwò!

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke eƒe viɖe kple gboloho ŋu akɔ na Yehowa; womali koe o, eye womafi ɖo gleglegle o, ke boŋ eƒe adzododo anye amesiwo le Yehowa ŋku me la tɔ, ne woaɖu nu aɖi ƒo, eye woata ava nyuiwo.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa aɖi gbɔlo anyigba, eye wòagblẽe, atrɔ eƒe ŋku me abu anyi, eye woaka edzi nɔlawo ahlẽ.

english_verse: including ordinary people and priests, slaves and slave owners, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, the rich and the poor.
translation_verse: Eye woava me na dukɔ abe nunɔla ene, dɔlaŋutsu abe eƒe aƒetɔ ene, dɔlanyɔnu abe eƒe aƒenɔ ene, nuƒlela abe nudzrala ene, agbanatɔ abe agbanadola ene, eye fenyila abe fetɔ ene.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Woaɖi gbɔlo anyigba ƒiaƒiaƒia, eye woahae keŋkeŋ, elabena Yehowa gblɔ nya sia.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba to edzi nɔlawo dzi, elabena woda seawo dzi, wòto vo ɖe ɖoɖoawo ŋu, eye wotu nubabla mavɔ la.

english_verse: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
translation_verse: Eyata fiƒode le anyigba ɖum, eye edzi nɔlawo akpɔe ɖe enu. Eyata anyigbadzitɔwo afia kolikoli, eye amegbetɔ ʋeea ɖewo kɔe asusɔ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Wein yeye ano ƒiaƒiaƒia, weinka ayra, eye amesiwo katã ƒe dzi kpɔa dzidzɔ la, aɖu tse.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Asíʋuiwo ƒe vivisese nu tso, dzidzɔkpɔlawo ƒe howɔwɔ se ɖo, eye kasaŋkuwo ƒe vivisese nu tso.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Womaga-dzi ha ɖe wein-nono ŋu o, eye aha muame ave heliheli na enolawo.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Wogbã du ɖiƒeƒle la, wotu xɔwo katã ƒe ʋɔwo, eye wo me yiyi meli o.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Wole konyi fam ɖe wein ŋu le ablɔwo me, dzidzɔwo katã nu yi, vivisesewo bu le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Du la zu aƒedo, eye wogbã agbo la wòzu glikpo.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Elabena alea wòanɔ le anyigba dzi le dukɔwo dome, abe alesi wogbea amititsetse kple alesi woxaa nu mlɔea, ne weinxaxa nu va yi ene.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame kemeawo kɔ woƒe gbe dzi le aseye tsom le ƒu gome le Yehowa ƒe gãnyenye ta be:

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Eyata mikafu Yehowa le ɣedzeƒe kple Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ le ƒukpowo dzi!

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Míese hadzidzi tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu be: Woakafu ame dzɔdzɔewo! Ke nyea megblɔ be: Nye nublanuitɔ, baba nam! Adzodalawo le nu ham, nuhaha dzi adzodalawo le!

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: Mi anyigbadzitɔwo, ŋɔdzi, ʋe kple mɔ̃ka le mia dzi va ge!

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Eye amesi ase ŋɔdzi ŋkɔ asi la, age adze ʋe me, eye amesi ado le ʋe me la, mɔ̃ka aɖee. Elabena woʋu dzimefesrewo, eye anyigba ƒe agunu le dzodzom kpekpekpe.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Anyigba fe kpla, anyigba wó kpla, anyigba le ʋuʋum keɖekeɖe;

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: anyigba le ya mum abe ahamula ene, eye wòle nyenyem ʋakaʋaka abe ahamaka ene, elabena eƒe dzidadawo do agba ɖe edzi; adze anyi, eye magafɔ o. Mawu aɖe eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖe ko le Zion.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Eye woava me le ɣemaɣi be, Yehowa ahe to na dziƒoʋakɔwo le dzi me kple anyigba dzi fiawo le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Woaƒo wo nu ƒu abe gatɔwo ene ɖe do me, eye woatu gaxɔ ɖe wo nu, eye le ɣeyiɣi geɖe megbe hafi woaɖo ŋku wo dzi.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Du akpe ɣleti, eye ɣe ƒe mo atsi dã, elabena Yehowa Zebaot ɖu fia le Zion-to la dzi kple Yerusalem, eye atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo le eƒe ame tsitsiwo ŋku me.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye Mawu nènye, mado wò ɖe dzi, eye makafu wò ŋkɔ! Elabena èwɔ nukunuwo, wò gbaɖegbe tameɖoɖowo nye nyateƒe, eye wometrɔna o!

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Elabena èna du la zu anyiglãgo, eye mɔ̃ sesẽ la zu glikpo, du bubu me towo ƒe fiasã maganye du o, eye womagatui akpɔ gbeɖegbeɖe o.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: Eyata dukɔ nyanyrãwo ade bubu ŋuwò, eye dukɔ sesẽwo ƒe duwo avɔ wò.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Elabena mo sesẽ nènye na ame beliwo, mɔ̃ sesẽ nènye na ame dahewo le woƒe hiã me; sitsoƒe nènye tso dziya nu kple vɔvɔli tso ŋdɔkutsu nu; elabena ŋutasẽlawo ƒe gbɔgbɔ fuxefuxe le abe dziyae le ƒoƒom ɖe gli ŋu ene.

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: Ete du bubu me towo ƒe nyanyrã ɖe to abe ŋdɔkutsu le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi ene; etsi ŋutasẽlawo ƒe aseyetsoha nu, abe alesi alilikpowo ƒe vɔvɔli tsia ŋdɔkutsu nu ene. Mawu aɖo dzidzɔkplɔ̃ na dukɔwo le Zion.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa Zebaot atsɔ nuɖuɖu damiwo kple wein, siwo ɖo ƒã la, atu aglo na dukɔwo katã ɖe to sia dzi; nuɖuɖuawo da ami, eye ƒuto me mi le wo me, weinawo ɖo ƒã, eye wo me dza.

english_verse: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
translation_verse: Eye woade avɔ, si tsyɔ dukɔwo katã dzi, kple nutsyɔnu, si tsyɔ anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã dzi la ɖa le to sia dzi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Ami ku saɖagatsi tegbee, eye Aƒetɔ Yehowa atutu aɖatsi ɖa le ŋkuwò katã me, eye woaɖe eƒe dɔlawo ƒe ŋukpe ɖa tso anyigba blibo la dzi. Elabena Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi woagblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, mía Mawu, amesi ŋu míedo ŋu ɖo be, aɖe mi la, enye si; Yehowa, amesi ŋu míeɖo ŋu ɖo la, enye si! Mina miatso aseye, eye míakpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe xɔname ŋu!

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe asi aɖiɖi ɖe to sia dzi, eye wòafanya Moab ɖe enɔƒe, abe alesi wofanyaa gbe ɖe agboti me ene;

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: akeke abɔ me le eme, abe alesi tsiƒula kekea abɔ, be yeaƒu tsi ene; ke ate eƒe dàda kple eƒe ayedzesiwo ɖe to.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Eye woagbã wò gli kɔkɔ sesẽwo aƒu anyi, abɔbɔ wò ɖe anyi, eye wòate wò ɖe ke me.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi woadzi ha sia le Yuda-nyigba dzi be: Du sesẽ le mía si, etsɔ eƒe xɔname wɔ gli kple ʋewo na mí.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Miʋu agboawo, ne dukɔ dzɔdzɔe, si dzraa nyateƒe ɖo la, nage ɖe eme.

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Etsɔ ŋutifafa dzra amesi ƒe susu li ke la ɖo, elabena eɖo dzi ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Miɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu ɖaa, elabena Yehowa, ẽ, Yehowa enye agakpe tegbee.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Elabena eƒu kɔkɔƒenɔlawo anyi, ebɔbɔ ɖu kɔkɔ la ɖe anyi, ebɔbɔe vaseɖe anyigba ke, eye wòtee ɖe ke me.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Afa fanya wo, ame dahewo ƒe afa kple hiãtɔwo ƒe afɔɖeɖe.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe toƒe to mo ɖeka, eta ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe mo wòdzɔ.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Yehowa, míekpɔ ma na wò le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo ƒe mo dzi ke hã; wò ŋkɔ kple wò kafukafu dzro luʋɔwo.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Ele nye luʋɔ dzrom le zã me, nye gbɔgbɔ hã le diwòm le menye; elabena ne wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo va anyigba dzi la, xexeametɔwo srɔ̃a dzɔdzɔenyenye.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ne wòve ame vɔ̃ɖi nu la, mesrɔ̃a dzɔdzɔenyenye o, ke boŋ ewɔa nu vɔ̃ɖi le anyigba dzɔdzɔe dzi, eye meléa ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe gãnyenye ŋu o.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò alo le dzi, ke womelé ekpɔm o; woakpɔ ŋuʋaʋã ɖe dukɔ la ŋu, eye ŋu akpe wo, eye dzo afiã wò ketɔwo.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ana ŋuti fafa mí, elabena èwɔ míaƒe do wo katã de goe na mí.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, mía Mawu, ame geɖewo ɖu aƒetɔ ɖe mia dzi hekpe ɖe ŋuwò; wò ɖeɖe kple wò ŋkɔ ko míakafu!

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Ame kukuwo me gagbɔa agbe o, eye ŋɔliwo megafɔna o; eyata nèhe to na wo hetsrɔ̃ wo, eye nètsi woƒe ŋkɔwo katã nu.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Ena dukɔ la dzi ɖe dzi, Yehowa, èna dukɔ la dzi de dzi, ède bubu ɖokuiwò ŋu, eye nèkeke anyigba ƒe liƒowo katã ɖe nu.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wodi wò le hiã me, eye esi wò tohename va wo dzi la, wotrɔ woƒe dzi me nya wo ƒo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Alesi ne funɔ ƒe vidzidzi tu aƒe wonoa togotogoe ƒom nɔa ɣli dom le veve sese ta la, Yehowa, nenema míenɔ le ŋkuwò mee.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Míefɔ fu, eye míelé ku, ke tofloko ko míedzi: xoname meva na anyigba la o, eye amewo medzɔ ɖe xexea me o.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Wò ame kukuwo agbɔ agbe, eye nye ame kukuwo afɔ ɖe tsitre! Minyɔ, mi ketu me tɔwo, eye mitso aseye, elabena miaƒe zãmu enye kekeli ƒe zãmu, eye anyigba aɖe ŋɔliwo ana.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, yi ɖe wò xɔgã me, eye nado ʋɔ ɖe ɖokuiwò nu, ɣla ɖokuiwò vie, vaseɖe esime dziku la nu nava yi.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ado tso enɔƒe, ne wòaxe anyigbadzitɔwo ƒe vodada ŋu fe na wo, anyigba aklo nu le eƒe ʋu dzi, eye magatsyɔ nu amesiwo wowu ɖe edzi la dzi o.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la Yehowa atsɔ eƒe yi kpekpe gã sesẽ la ahe to na ʋɔ driba, si nye ɖa, si le sisim, kple ʋɔ driba, si nye da xatsaxatsa la, eye woawu boso le atsiaƒu me.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la midzi ha le weingble nyo la ŋu be.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: Nye Yehowa manye eŋu dzɔla, eye made tsii ɣesiaɣi, be naneke magawɔe o; madzɔ eŋu zã kple keli.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Dzi mele kuyem o; ne makpɔ aŋɔkawo kple ŋuwò la, maho aʋa ɖe wo ŋu atɔ dzo wo katã;

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: negbe ɖeko woava sim atso, eye woawɔ ŋutifafa kplim hafi, ŋutifafa ko woawɔ kplim hafi!

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke, siwo gbɔna me la, Yakob ato ke, Israel adze, eye wòaƒo se, eye eƒe kutsetse ayɔ xexeame taŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɖe wòƒo Israel, abe alesi wòƒo eƒolawo enea? Alo ɖe wòwui, abe alesi wowu ewulawo enea?

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Esi nènyã wo ɖa la, mèhe to na wo wòtso eme o; etsɔ wò ya ʋuɖuʋudu kplɔ wo ɖae le gbesigbe ɣedzeƒeya ƒo.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Eyata alea ko woawɔ hafi atsɔ Yakob ƒe vodadawo akee, eye esia katã anye eƒe nuvowo ɖeɖeɖa ƒe kutsetse: be wòƒo vɔsamlekpui ƒe kpewo katã abe akalokpe gbagbã ene, eye Asera kple ɣelegbawo maganɔ anyi o.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Elabena du sesẽ la tsi akogo, amenɔƒe ɖi aƒedo, eye wogblẽe ɖi abe gbegbe ene. Nyiviwo aɖu gbe le afima, woa-tsyo akɔ anyi ɖe afima, eye woaɖu eƒe alɔwo.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Ne woƒe alɔwo ƒu la, woaŋe wo, nyɔnuwo ava ade dzo wo me; elabena dukɔ manyanu wonye. Eyata wo wɔla makpɔ nublanui na wo o, eye wo mèla mave wo nu o.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Eye ava me le ɣemaɣi be, Yehowa atsa ali aƒo luwo tso tɔsisi la nu vaseɖe Egipte-tɔʋu la nu, eye woata mi ɖekaɖeka, mi Israel-viwo.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye woava me be, woaku kpẽ gã la, eye amesiwo bu ɖe Asur-nyigba dzi kple amesiwo wonyã de gbe ɖe Egipte-nyigba dzi la, ava ado gbe ɖa le Yehowa ŋku me le to kokoe la dzi le Yerusalem.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Baba na Efrayim-hamulawo ƒe dàdafiakuku kple eƒe atsyɔ̃ ƒe seƒoƒo dzeani yɔyrɔ, si le weinmulawo ƒe bali wɔnu ta me!

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nu sesẽ kako atso Aƒetɔ ta gbɔ ava abe dzikpe ƒe dzadza kple ahom gblẽnu ene; aƒoe aƒu anyi kple ŋusẽ, abe tsiɖɔɖɔ sesẽ ƒe gbagba ɖe anyi ene.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: eye woava me na eƒe atsyɔ̃ ƒe seƒoƒo dzeani yɔyrɔ, si le bali wɔnu ta me la, abe gbotsetse, si ɖi, hafi dzomeŋɔli ɖo, esi, ne amea ɖe kpɔe la, mekpɔa ɖoa asi me hafi wòminɛ o la ene.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la Yehowa Zebaot anye atsyɔ̃kuku kple ŋgoblanu dzeani na eƒe dukɔ susɔea;

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: anye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃gbɔgbɔ na amesi le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nu kple ŋusẽ na amesiwo gbugbɔ aʋa ɖo ɖe agbo nu.

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Elabena xeɖeɖe ya kplɔ̃wo katã dzi fũ, ale be teƒea ɖeke megali o.

english_verse: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord's message?
translation_verse: Ameka wòafia sidzedzee, eye ameka wòaɖe nya gome na? Ɖevi, si dzudzɔ notsi, kple ɖevi, si ɖi le noea?

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: Se ɖe se dzi, se ɖe se dzi, ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖo dzi, ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖo dzi, afi ʋee, game ʋee.

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Eyata atsa miyi, si kɔkɔna, kple aɖe tutɔ aƒo nu kple dukɔ sia!

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: Dzudzɔ enye si, mina dzudzɔ amesiwo ŋu ɖeɖi te, eye gbɔɖeme enye si! Ke wogbe toɖoɖo.

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa ƒe nya ava me ɖe wo ŋu be. Se ɖe se dzi, se ɖe se dzi, ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖo dzi, ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖo dzi, afi ʋee, game ʋee, ne woazɔ ahate gbugbɔɖemegbee adze anyi, eye woagbã gudugudu, mɔ̃ aɖe wo, eye asi atu wo.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Eyata mi fewuɖulawo, dukɔ sia, si le Yerusalem la ƒe dziɖulawo, mise Yehowa ƒe gbe:

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Elabena miegblɔ be: Míebla nu kple ku, eye mie ɖu dzo kple tsieƒe. Atam, si le nyènyem le yiyim la, mava mía gbɔ o, elabena míetsɔ aʋatso wɔ míaƒe sitsoƒee, eye míebe de alakpa gbɔ. Dzogoedzikpe xɔasi la.

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, meɖo kpea ɖe anyi ɖe Zion, kpe, si wodo kpɔ, dzògoekpe xɔasi, si li ke zã. Amesi xɔe se la, masi o.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: Matsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ awɔ dzidzekae, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye anye nudanu; dzikpe atsrɔ̃ aʋatsositsoƒe la, eye tsi akplɔ bebeƒe la adzoe;

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: woagblẽ mia kple ku ƒe nubabla la me, eye mía kple tsieƒe ƒe dzoɖuɖu la mali ke o. Atam, si le nyenyem le yiyim la, agba mi gudugudu.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Ne eva le yiyim la, eƒe asi axe mi kã, elabena ava yi ŋdi sia ŋdi, le ŋkeke kple zã me, eye ŋɔdzi ɖeɖe sɔŋ aɖe nya gome na mi.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa akɔ eɖokui ɖe dzi abe le Perazim-to la gbɔ ene, eye wòanyrã abe le Gibeon-bali me ene, ne woawo eƒe do, do tutɔ enye eƒe do la, ne woawo eƒe nuwɔwɔ, nuku enye eƒe nuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Eyata miganɔ fewu ɖum, ne miaƒe babla nadzi goŋgoŋ o; elabena wotsrɔ̃ kple tameɖoɖo kplikpaa mese tso Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot gbɔ ɖe anyigba blibo la ŋu. Mawu ƒe nuku ɖaŋu la.

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Miƒu to anyi, ne miase nye gbe, miɖo ŋku anyi, ne miase nye nuƒoƒo.

english_verse: Farmers don't just plow and break up the ground.
translation_verse: Ɖe agbleŋlɔla nɔa nuŋɔŋlɔ dzi atraɖi, ne wòaƒã nua? De wòdzraa anyigba ɖo hedzobonɛ atraɖia?

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Alo ne edzobo eme la, ɖe mewua sikɔni kple adrike ɖi, eƒãa lu ɖe agbaka nu kple ƒo ɖe enɔƒe kpakple bli ɖe boliƒo dzi oa?

english_verse: They learn this from their God.
translation_verse: Eƒe Mawu fia mɔnui ɖe kɔnu la nu, eye wòfiã nui.

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Elabena menye luƒotasiaɖam wotsɔna ƒoa sikɔni o, eye womemlia tasiaɖamfɔ toa adrike dzi o, ke boŋ kpo wotsɔna ƒoa sikɔni, eye ati wotsɔna ƒoa adrike.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Ɖe wogbãa lu, si woƒoa aboloe la nyanyanyaa? Womeƒonɛ atraɖi o, wohea tasiaɖamfɔ kple sɔwo toa edzii, ke womegbãnɛ nyanyanya o.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Esia hã tso Yehowa Zebaot gbɔ. Eƒe adaŋudede enye nuku, eye eƒe nunya lolo.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Baba na Ariel, Ariel-du, si me Dawid ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖo! Ne míekpe ƒe ɖe ƒe ŋu, eye ŋkeke nyui wo tre va kpe la,

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: ekema maxaxa Ariel ɖo, konyifafa kple nuxaxa ayɔe, eye woazu Ariel vavã nam.

english_verse: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
translation_verse: Maƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe ŋuwò godoo, mana aʋakɔwo namimi wò ɖo, eye maɖe ne ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Aƒo nu tso anyigba tu me ke, eye wò nuƒoƒo aɖi tso ke me; wò gbe anɔ abe ŋɔli to ene tso anyigba me, eye wò nuƒoƒo aɖi huhuhu tso ke me.

english_verse: Then your cruel enemies will suddenly be swept away like dust in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Ke wo ketɔ gbogboawo azu abe kewɔ memee ene, eye ŋutasẽla geɖegeɖeawo azu abe tsro, si ʋu ya ene; ava me zi ɖeka kpoyi.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot atsɔ dziɖegbe kple anyigbaʋuʋu, gbeɖiɖi sesi, ya kple ahom kpakple dzoƒaɖe binu ahe to na wò.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔwo ƒe amehawo katã, siwo ho aʋa ɖe Ariel ŋu, kple amesiwo katã tso ɖe eya kple eƒe mɔ̃ sesẽ la ŋu, eye woxaxae ɖo la, anɔ abe drɔ̃ekuku kple zã me ŋutega ene.

english_verse: Those nations that attack Mount Zion will suffer from hunger and thirst. They will dream of food and drink but wake up weary and hungry and thirsty as ever. Prophets Who Fool Themselves
translation_verse: Alesi dɔwuitɔ kua drɔ̃e be, yele nu ɖum, ke ne enyɔ la, dɔa nu melana ne o, eye alesi tsikɔwuitɔ kua drɔ̃e be, yele tsi nom, ke ne enyo la, nu tea eŋu, eye eƒe veme ƒuna la, nenemae dukɔ, siwo katã ho aʋa ɖe Zion-toa ŋu la ƒe amehawo anɔ. Woagbã ŋku na dukɔ la.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Miɖo asi nu, eye miaƒe nu Hetsi te, mitre ŋku, eye mizu ŋkuagbãtɔwo! Womu aha, ke menye wein ye wɔe o, wole ya mum, ke menye aha muame ye wɔe o.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa trɔ alɔ̃dɔdɔ sesẽ ƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔ ɖe mia dzi, etre miaƒe ŋkuwò, siwo nye nyagblɔɖilawo, eye wotsyɔ nu miaƒe tawo, siwo nye nunɔlawo.

english_verse: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, “We can't read it, because it's sealed.”
translation_verse: Ale ŋutegawo katã anɔ na mi, abe agbalẽ, si nu wotre la me nya ene, esi ne wotsɔe na agbalẽnyala gblɔ be: Xlẽe la, aɖo ŋu be: Nyemate ŋui o, elabena wotre enu

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Eye ne wotsɔ agbalẽ la na ame manyagbalẽ gblɔ be: Xlẽe la, aɖo ŋu be: Nyemenya agbalẽ o.

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ la gblɔ esi: Esi dukɔ sia te va kple woƒe nu, eye wotsɔ woƒe nuyiwo de bubu ŋunye, ke woƒe dzi le adzɔge tso gbɔnye, eye woƒe vɔvɔ̃ nam nye amegbetɔwo ƒe ɖoɖo, siwo wosrɔ̃ ko la,

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: eyata kpɔ ɖa, megaɖe nukunu afia ɖe dzi ɖe dukɔ sia ŋu, nukunuwo ƒe nukunu wòanye, nunya abu ɖe woƒe nunyalawo, eye gɔmesese asi abe ɖe woƒe nugɔmeselawo.

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo nɔa bebem le Yehowa ŋku me, woɣlaa woƒe adaŋudede, eye wowɔa woƒe nu le vivi me henɔa gbɔgblɔm be: Ameka le mía kpɔm, eye ameka dze si mí?

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Oo, mieflu mia ɖokui! Ɖe tsu le abe zemela ene, ne nuwɔwɔ nagblɔ na ewɔla be: Menye wòe wɔm o, eye numeme nagblɔ na emela be: Mele ɖeke nyɔm oa? Nuku tɔtrɔ la.

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: De mekpɔtɔ vie ko, ne Libanon nazu atibɔ, eye woabu atibɔ de avewo me oa?

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la tokunɔwo ase agbalẽ sia me nyawo, eye ŋkuagbãtɔwo ƒe, ŋkuwo akpɔ nu tso blukɔ kple viviti me.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Hiãtɔwo akpɔ dzidzɔ de Yehowa ŋu agakpɔe ɖe dzi, eye ame dahewo le amegbetɔwo dome atso aseye de Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Elabena ŋutasẽlawo nu tso, fewuɖulawo nu yi, eye wotsrɔ̃ amesiwo katã bua nu madzɔmadzɔ ŋuti,

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: amesiwo tsɔa nya blea amewo dea nuvɔ̃ me le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me, wotrea mɔ̃ na nyadrɔ̃la le ʋɔnu, eye wotsɔa alakpadada ƒua ame dzɔdzɔe anyi.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa, amesi ɖe Abraham la, gblɔ na Yakob ƒe aƒe la enye si. Ŋu magakpe Yakob azɔ o, eye eƒe mo magatsi dã azɔ o.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ne viawo kpɔ nye asinudɔwɔwɔwo le wo dome la, woakɔ nye ŋkɔ ŋu, woakɔ Yakob ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu, eye woava Israel ƒe Mawu la;

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: tamedadatɔwo ase nu gɔme, eye tosẽlawo asrɔ̃ nunya.

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Yehowa be, baba na vi sẽtowo, amesiwo de adaŋu nye manɔmee, eye wobla nu nye gbɔgbɔ manɔmee, ne woali kɔ nuvɔ̃ de nuvɔ̃ dzi!

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Amesiwo mebia nye nu me gbe se, hafi yi Egipte, be wòasi Farao ƒe ŋusẽ atso, eye woabe ɖe Egipte ƒe vɔvɔli te o.

english_verse: “You will be disappointed, completely disgraced for trusting Egypt.
translation_verse: Farao ƒe ŋusẽ azu ŋukpe na wo, eye bebe ɖe Egipte ƒe vɔvɔli te azu dzu na wo.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Elabena ne eƒe amegãwo va Zoan, eye eƒe ame dɔdɔwo ɖe keke Xanes ke hã,

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Nya ɖe dziehe-nyigba ƒe lãwo ŋu. Le hiã kple xaxa ƒe anyigba dzi, afisi dzatanɔ kple dzatatsu dona tsona, afisi ƒli kple da toaʋala le la, afima wotsɔa woƒe nuwo ɖoa tedziwo ƒe mẽdome kple woƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖoa kposɔwo ƒe kpo dzi tsonɛ yia dukɔ, si mele viɖea ɖeke me o la gbɔ.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Egipte ƒe xɔname mele nemi me hã o, eyata meyɔe be, enye numeɖila, si ŋu nanekewɔwɔ mele o.

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Eyata yi naŋlɔe ɖe nuŋlɔkpe dzi le wo gbɔ, eye naŋlɔe ɖe agbalẽ me, ne wòanɔ anyi anye ɖase tegbee le ŋkeke, siwo gbɔna la me.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔ sẽto, vi dalakpa, vi, siwo gbe Yehowa ƒe nufiamewo sese la, wonye;

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: amesiwo gblɔ na nukpɔlawo be: Migakpɔ nu o, eye wogblɔ na nyagblɔɖilawo be: Migagblɔ nya, si le eteƒe la, ɖi na mí o, ke boŋ migblɔ nya ŋɔnɔewo na mi, eye migblɔ alakpanyawo ɖi!

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Mite ɖa le mɔ la dzi midze le toƒe la, eye mina Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la nabu le mía ŋku me!

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la gblɔ esi: Esi miedo vlo nya sia, eye mieɖo ŋu ɖe ŋutasesẽ kple ayedzedze ŋu heziɔ ɖe eŋu la,

english_verse: This sin is like a crack that makes a high wall quickly crumble
translation_verse: miaƒe vodada sia azu abe gli dzeabi, si le mumũm hetre azã le gli kɔkɔa ɖe ŋu la ene, esi ƒe mũɣi aɖo zi ɖeka kpoyi.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Eye woagbã wo, abe alesi zemela ƒe ze gbãna gudugudu, ale be sonu gaglɛa ɖeke menɔa gbagbã la me, si woatsɔ aɖe dzo le adokpo me, alo woatsɔ aɖu tsii le vudo me o la ene.

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la, gblɔ esi: Tametɔtrɔ kple anyinɔnɔ kpoo woatsɔ axɔ na mi, eye miaƒe ŋusẽ le ɖoɖoezizi kple ŋuɖoɖo ɖe eŋu me, ke mielɔ̃ o

english_verse: said, “No! We will safely escape on speedy horses.” But those who chase you will be even faster.
translation_verse: hegblɔ bena: Kpao, ke boŋ míanɔ sɔwo dzi asi, eye míado sɔ ɖiduwo. Eyata miasi, eye mia yometilawo ado sɔ ɖiduwo.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Mia dometɔ akpe ɖeka asi le ame ɖeka kolia ƒe bublu nu, eye mi katã miasi le ame atɔ ƒe bublu nu, vaseɖe esime miasusɔ abe aflagati le to ta me kple aflaga le togbɛ dzi ene. Woayra amesiwo ɖo ŋu ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa le lalam, be yeave mia nu, eyata wotso, be yeakpɔ nublanui na mi; elabena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe Mawu enye Yehowa. Woayra amesiwo katã kpɔa esinu!

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Zion-dukɔ, si le Yerusalem, meganɔ avifafa dzi o, elabena ave nuwò vavã le wò aƒadodo ta; ne enya see ko la, atɔ na wò.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ana abolo mi le hiã me kple tsi mi le xaxa me, eye miaƒe nufialawo magabe azɔ o, ke boŋ míakpɔ miaƒe nufialawo kple ŋku,

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: eye miaƒe to ase nya sia le mia megbe bena: Mɔ la enye si, mito edzi! nenye ɖusi me alo mia me miebe, yewoato.

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Miado gu klosalo, siwo wofa ɖe miaƒe aklama kpakpawo ŋu, kple sika, si le miaƒe legbawo ŋu; miaɖe wo ɖa abe ŋunyɔnu ene ahagblɔ ɖe wo ŋu bena Mido!

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Ana tsi nadza ɖe nuku, siwo nèƒã ɖe agble me la dzi, nuɖuɖu, tsi tso wò agble me nukuwo me la, avivi, eye woada ami; le ɣemaɣi la wò lãwo aɖu gbe le lãnyiƒe kekewo;

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: eye nyitsuwo kple tedzi, siwo ŋlɔa agble la, aɖu bli tsakatsaka, si me dze le, eye wotsɔ sofi kple gaflo gã dzoboe.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Eye wòava me le amewugbe gã, si xɔ tsralawo amũ la be, toʋuwo anɔ tsi tsam le to kɔkɔwo katã kple togbɛ kɔkɔwo katã ta me.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Gbesigbe Yehowa bia eƒe dukɔ ƒe kakaƒe, eye wòda gbe ƒe eƒe abi, si wòxɔ ŋu la, ɣleti ƒe keklẽ anɔ abe ɣe tɔ ene, eye ɣe ƒe keklẽ adzi ɖe dzi zi gbɔ zi adre abe keklẽ le ŋkeke adre me ene.

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ tso adzɔge gbɔna, eƒe dɔmedzoe le bibim, eye wòde dzi kɔtɔɔ; eƒe nuyiwo dzi yɔ fũ kple dziku, eƒe aɖe le abe dzo binu ene;

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: eye eƒe gbɔgbɔ le abe tɔɖɔɖɔ, si me woase ve le ene, ne wòanyè dukɔwo, vaseɖe esime woatsrɔ̃ avɔ, eye woade numega dukɔwo ƒe nu me, si akplɔ wo atrae.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Miadzi ha abe le ŋkekenyuieɖuɣi ƒe zã me ene, eye miaƒe dzi akpa dzidzɔ abe amesiwo le dze kum le mɔ zɔm heyina ɖe Yehowa ƒe to la, ɖe Israel ƒe agakpe la gbɔ ene.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ana woase eƒe gãnyenye ƒe gbe, eye woakpɔ eƒe alɔ ƒe ɖiɖiɖeanyi le ɖɔmedzoe ƒe bublu, dzo binu ƒe aɖe, ahom, tsidzadza gãwo kple dzikpewo me.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe gbe aɖe dzi le Asur ƒo, nenye be, etsɔ ati ƒoe.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Zi geɖe alesi eƒe toheti, si wòɖo ɖe eŋu la, dze edzii la, zi geɖe ma ke asiʋuiwo kple kasaŋkuwo anɔ ɖiɖimi, eye woawo aʋa kplii anɔ alɔnyènye dzi ɖaa.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Elabena wodzra dzotɔƒe ɖo ɖi xoxo, fiawo hãe wodzrae ɖo ɖi na, eye wògoglo hekeke; dzo kple nake li kpaŋkpaŋ hekpe ɖe eƒe nakekɔwo ŋu; Yehowa ƒe gbagba enye aŋɔtoʋu, si ato dzoe.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo yi Egipte, be woaxɔ na yewo, woɖo dzi ɖe sɔwo ŋu, eye woɖo ŋu ɖe tasiaɖam sɔgbɔwo kple sɔdola geɖewo ŋu; ke womelé ŋku ɖe Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu o, eye wo mebia Yehowa ta se o!

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke nunyala eya hã nye, eye wòahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ve, magbe eƒe nya o, ke boŋ atso ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aƒe kple nu tovo wɔlawo ƒe xɔname ŋu.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Ke Egiptetɔwo la, amegbetɔwo wonye, menye Mawu o; woƒe sɔwo la, ŋutilã wonye, menye gbɔgbɔ o; eye ne Yehowa do eƒe asi ɖa la, ke aɖe le xɔnametɔ la te, eye amesi wòle xɔxɔm na la, adze anyi, eye woa kple eve la siaa nu ayi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ nam enye si: Alesi dzata kple dzatavi nɔa gbe tem ɖe nuléle ŋu, eye ne woyɔ lãkplɔviwo ɖe eŋu kpaŋkpaŋ hã, woƒe ɣli meɖea dzi le eƒo o, eye meɖoa to woƒe howɔwɔ o la, nenema Yehowa Zebaot aɖi ɖe anyi, ne woawo aʋa le Zion-to la kple eƒe togbɛ la dzi.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Alesi xevi ɖoa agbae la, nenema Yehowa adzɔ Yerusalem ŋu, adzo eŋu, eye wòaxɔ nɛ, akpa eta, eye wòaɖee.

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi Israel-viwo, migatrɔ ɖe amesi yome mietrɔ le la ŋu!

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Elabena le ɣemaɣi la wo dome amesiame anyɔ ŋu eƒe klosalolegba kple sikalegba, siwo eƒe asiwò wo na eɖokui hena nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ la.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: Asur atsi yi nu, ke menye ŋutsu ƒe yi nu o, eye yi aɖui, ke menye amegbetɔ ƒe yi o; asi le yi nu, eye eƒe ɖekakpuiwo azu yakadɔwɔlawo;

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: eƒe agakpe ate ɖa le vɔvɔ̃ ta, eye aflaga ana dzidzi naƒo eƒe amegãwo; Yehowa, amesi ƒe dzo le Zion, eye eƒe mlekpui le Yerusalem lae gblɔe.

english_verse: A king and his leaders will rule with justice.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, fia aɖu fia ɖe dzɔdzɔenyenye nu, eye amegãwo aɖu dzi ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nu.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Amesiame anɔ abe sitsoƒe tso ya nu, bebeƒe tso tsidzadza nu, tɔʋu le gbegbe kple agakpe gã nyadri ƒe vɔvɔli le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi ene.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Nukpɔlawo ƒe ŋku maganyẽ atre o, eye nuselawo aƒu to anyi.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Ame mabutamewo ƒe dzi adze si nunya, eye kɔkɔlawo ƒe aɖe aƒo nu eme nakɔ.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Womagayo bometsilawo be bubumewo azɔ o, eye womagayɔ ayetɔwo be ŋkutatɔwo o.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Elabena bometsila gblɔa bometsinya, eƒe dzi hea dzɔgbevɔ̃e va aƒee, ne wòawɔ nu tovo ahagblɔ nya trama ɖe Yehowa ŋu, wòana dɔwuitɔwo natsi domeɣi, eye nunono nahiã tsikɔwuitɔwo.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Ayetɔ ɖoa ta me vɔ̃ɖi, edea adaŋu vɔ̃ be, yeatsɔ alakpanya agblẽ hiãtɔwoe, nenye be, ame dahe la to nya dzɔdzɔe hã.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke tamesusu vavãwo li na bubumewo, eye nu vavãwo dzi wolina ɖo.

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Mi nyɔnu, siwo li bɔkɔɔ, mitso, ne miase nye gbe! Mi nyɔnuvi, siwo le ablɔɖe me, miƒu to anyi ɖe nye nyawo ŋu.

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Ne ƒe kple edzi ŋkekewo va yi la, mi ablɔɖewo miadzo nyanyanya, elabena weintsetsexaɣi nu yi, eye kutsetsegbeɣi megbɔna o.

english_verse: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo li bɔkɔɔ, dzidzi neƒo mi; mi ablɔɖewo, midzo nyanyanya! Miɖe ava ɖi, miɖe amama, eye misa akpanya ɖe ali!

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Woƒo akɔta le agble nyowo kple weinka tsekuwo ta.

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: Aŋɔkawo kple ŋuwo mie ɖe nye dukɔ la ƒe anyigba dzi kple du sevivi la ƒe dzidzɔxɔwo katã me.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Elabena fiasãwo zu xɔdo, eye du, si me zi na la, zu gbegbe, togbɛ kple gbetakpɔxɔ zu agado, wòzu gbetedziwo ƒe adzrɔɖiƒe kple gbeɖuƒe na lãhawo,

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime woatrɔ gbɔgbɔ akɔ ɖe mia dzi tso dzi me, eye gbegbe nazu atibɔ, eye wòabu atibɔwo ɖe avewo dome.

english_verse: Honesty and justice will prosper there,
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ anɔ gbegbe, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye anɔ atibɔwo me;

english_verse: and justice will produce lasting peace and security.
translation_verse: dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe dɔwɔwɔ anye ŋutifafa, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe viɖe anye gbɔdzɔe kple dziɖeɖi tegbee.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Eye nye dukɔ anɔ ŋutifafa teƒe kple dziɖeɖi teƒewo kpakple ablɔɖe gbɔɖemeƒewo.

english_verse: even if hailstones flatten forests and cities.
translation_verse: Ke ne dzikpewo dza la, ave la amũ, eye du la aɖo agu.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: Woayra mi, amesiwo ƒã nu ɖe tɔwo to sɔŋ, mi amesiwo ɖe ka nyiwo kple tedziwo wole yiyim.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Baba na wò nugblẽla, si womegblẽna o, wò adzoblasu, si womedaa adzoe o! Ne èwu nugbegblẽ nu la, woagblẽ wò hã, eye ne eda adzo vɔ la, woada adzo wò hã!

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ve mía nu, asiwònu kpɔm míele! Nye míaƒe alɔ ŋdi sia ŋdi kple míaƒe xɔname le hiãɣi!

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo si le gbeɖeɖe nu, eye anyigba dzi dukɔwo ka hlẽ le wò tsitretsitsi nu.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Eye woaƒo miaƒe nuhahawo nu ƒu, abe alesi woƒoa ʋetsuviwo nu ƒu ene, eye woaƒu du ɖe wo ŋu, abe alesi abɔ fia kpoe ene.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖo kpo, elabena ele dzi me, eye wotsɔ: nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye yɔ Zion taŋ;

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, kalẽtɔwo le avi fam le xexe, eye du nyui xɔlawo le avi fam hehehe.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Ametoƒe zu gbegbe, amea ɖeke megale mɔ dzi tom o. Etu nubabla la, eɖi gbɔ duwo, eye amegbetɔ menye naneke le eŋku me o.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Anyigba le nu xam wòte eŋu, ŋu kpe Libanon, eƒe lãme gbã, Saron zu abe gbegbe ene, eye Basan kple Karmel lu xe.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Azɔ matso, azɔ matsi tre, azɔ matso ɖe afa dzi.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
