translation_verse: Miefɔ gbe ƒuƒu ƒe fu, eye ahɔ̃liti takpoe miadzi; miaƒe gbɔgbɔ enye dzo, si afia mi.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Woamè dukɔwo abe akalo ene, eye woatɔ dzo wo abe aŋɔka ene.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Mi didiƒewo, mise nusi mewɔ, mi kpuiƒewo, midze si nye kalẽwɔwɔ!

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Dzidzi ƒo nuvɔ̃wɔlawo le Zion, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe lãme ble fu: Mía dometɔ ka anɔ dzo binu gbɔ, eye mia dometɔ ka anɔ dzoxɔxɔ mava gbɔ?

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒe zɔzɔme to mɔ ɖeka, eye eƒe nuƒoƒo le eme, amesi tsri ŋutasesẽ tsɔtsɔ kpɔ viɖee, amesi ʋuʋu eƒe asi, be magaxɔ zãnunana o, amesi xe eƒe towo, be magase hlɔ̃dodo o, amesi mia eƒe ŋkuwò, be womagakpɔ vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ o la,

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: eyae anɔ kɔkɔƒewo, mɔ̃ sesẽ, siwo le agakpewo dzi la, anye eƒe bebeƒe, woana aboloe, eye eƒe tsi mamie o.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Wò ŋkuwò akpa fia la le eƒe atsyɔ̃ me, akpɔ anyigba keke la,

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: eye wò dzi abu ŋɔdziɣi la ŋu bena: Afika agbalẽŋlɔla le, afika nudala le, eye afika amesi xlẽ xɔ tsralawo la le?

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Magakpɔ dukɔ nyanyrã azɔ o, dukɔ, si ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ sesẽ, eye womate ŋu ase eme o, woƒe aɖe kɔkɔna, eye gɔmesesea ɖeke mele eŋu o.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Kpɔ Zion, du, si nye miaƒe takpeƒe la ɖa! Wò ŋkuwò akpɔ Yerusalem, nɔƒe dedie la, agbadɔ, si womakaka o, eƒe tsyotiwo maho o, eye eƒe kawo katã matso akpɔ o.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Ke boŋ Yehowa enye ŋusẽ na mí le afima, abe tɔsisi gã keke le goawo kple eve me ene, esi dzi atablukulawo mato o, eye ʋu gãwo mazɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa enye míaƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, Yehowa enye míaƒe aʋafia, Yehowa enye míaƒe fia, eya aɖe mí.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Wò atagbiwo me do agblɔ, womedzi abalati la goŋgoŋ o, eye womehe abala me o. Emegbe woamã aboyonu kple nuhaha; xɔdrɔ̃wo ke hã aha nu.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Duametɔa ɖeke nagblɔ be, yele dɔ lém o; wotsɔ vodada ke amesiwo le eme.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!
translation_verse: Mite va, mi dukɔwo, ne miase nu, mi anyigba dzi dukɔwo, miƒu to anyi! Anyigba kple edzi nuwo, xexeame kple edzi numienuewo katã nesee!

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe dukɔwo katã ŋu kple dziku ɖe woƒe aʋakawo katã ŋu; edo busu wo, eye wòtsɔ wo de asi, be woawu;

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: wotsɔ woƒe ame tsiaʋawo xlã ɖe anyi, woƒe ame kukuwo ƒe ʋeʋẽ de dzi, eye woƒe ʋu na towo lolo gbanaa.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Dziƒo ŋu nuwo katã nu ayi, woaŋlɔ dziƒowo, abe alesi woŋlɔa agbalẽe ene, eye eŋu nuwo katã alé akpɔ̃, abe alesi aŋgba yrɔna le weinka ŋu kple alesi gboti ƒe aŋgba yrɔnae ene.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Elabena nye yi mũ aha le dziƒo, eye woge dze Edom, dukɔ, si medo busui la dzi hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Ʋu ƒo Yehowa ƒe yi, ami ɖoe, alẽviwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe ʋue, agbowo ƒe ayikuwo ŋu mie; elabena Yehowa le vɔsa ŋkekenyuie ɖum le Bozra kple lãwu ŋkekenyuie gã le Edom-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Woawo kple tòwo siaa woamũ adze anyi hekpe ɖe nyitsuwo kple nyiwo ŋu, woƒe anyigba ano woƒe ʋu, eye ami adzaba woƒe ke.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Elabena hlɔ̃biagbe, teƒeɖoɖo ƒe ƒe wònye tso Yehowa gbɔ, ne woawo avu na Zion.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Eƒe toʋuwo atrɔ zu aŋe, eƒe kewɔ azu aŋɔ, eye eƒe anyigba azu age bidzo,

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Matsi o zã kple keli, eye eƒe dzudzɔ ade dzi tegbee, atsi anyi gbegbee tso dzidzime yi dzidzime, eye amea ɖeke mato edzi akpɔ o tegbee.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Aluge kple hlɔ̃made anɔ edzi, eye adzexe kple akpaviã atso aƒe ɖe edzi; ada dzidzeka ɖe edzi, be woazu gbegbe kple nudakpe ɖe edzi, be wòazu aƒedo.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Eƒe bubumewo maganɔ afima atso fiaɖuƒe la anɔ boblo dome o, eye eƒe amegãwo katã nu atso.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Aŋɔka amie ɖe eƒe fiasãwo me kple dzawo kpakple ŋuwo ɖe eƒe mɔ̃ sesẽwo me, eye wòazu aƒe na amegãxiwo kple kpɔtɔtɔ na goloviwo.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Gbedzilãwo kple amegãxiwo ado go le afima, azizãwo ayɔ wo nɔewo le afima, eye gbetsiwo adzudzɔ le afima, agbɔ ɖe eme bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Dakpui awɔ atɔ ɖe afima, aɖa azi ahaƒo wo, eye wòaƒo viawo nu ƒu ɖe eƒe vɔvɔli te; akagãwo sɔŋ aƒo ta kpli ɖe afima.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Midzro Yehowa ƒe agbalẽ me, eye miaxlẽe: Wo dɔmetɔa ɖeke makpɔtɔ o, eye womabu ɖe wo nɔewo o. Elabena nye nue de se, eye nye gbɔgbɔe ƒo wo nu ƒu.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Eyae dzidze nu na wo, eye eƒe asie tso dzidzeka mãe na wo, anye wo to tegbee, eye woanɔ edzi tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Gbegbe kple gbedadaƒo akpɔ dzidzɔ, tagba atso aseye, eye wòaƒo se abe dzogbenya ene.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Woaƒo se ake, eye woatso dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple aseyetsotso ase vivii. Woatso Libanon ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe, Karmel kple Saron ƒe atsyɔ̃ nɛ. Woakpɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple mia Mawu ƒe atsyɔ̃.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Mido ŋusẽ alɔ gblɔdɔwo, eye mide agbe klo beliwo me.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Migblɔ na amesiwo ƒo dzi ɖe le la be. Milé dzi ɖe ƒo, migavɔ̃ o! Kpɔ ɖa, mia Mawu enye si! Hlɔ̃biabia gbɔna, Mawu ƒe teƒeɖoɖo; eya ŋutɔ gbɔna, ne woaxɔ na mi.

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Ekema ŋkuagbãtɔwo ƒe ŋku aʋu, eye tokunɔwo ƒe to aʋu;

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: ekema xɔdrɔ̃wo ali kpo abe zi ene, eye aɖetututɔwo ƒe aɖe atso aseye; elabena tɔ ŋɔ tso gbegbe, eye tɔʋu tso tagba.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Bleziblezi azu tà, eye kuɖiɖinyigba azu tsidzɔƒe; amegãxiwo nɔƒe, afisi wotsyɔa akɔ ɖo la, azu aƒla kple avawo teƒe.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Ametoƒe kple mɔ tata anɔ afima, si woayɔ be „mo tata kɔkɔe.“ Ame makɔmakɔa ɖeke mato edzi o; woawo ɖeɖeko tɔ wòanye. Amesi ke to edzi la, matra mo o, keke gegemewo ke hã.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Dzataa ɖeke manɔ afima o, lã wɔadãa ɖeke manɔ edzi loo, alo woakpɔe le afima o, eye ale amesiwo woɖe la, woato edzi,

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe amesiwo wòxɔ ƒle la, atrɔ agbɔ, eye woava Zion kple aseyetsotso, eye dzidzɔ mavɔ anɔ woƒe ta me; vivisese kple dzidzɔ asu wo si, eye nuxaxa kple hũɖeɖe abu ɖe wo.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Migana Xizkiya nano mia blem anɔ gbɔgblɔm be: Yehowa aɖe mi o! De dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo dometɔa ɖe te ŋu ɖe eƒe anyigba tso Asur-fia si mea?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Tete Rabsake te va ɖo ɣli sesĩe le Yuda-gbe me gblɔ bena: Mise fia gã, Asur-fia ƒe nya!

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Afika Xamat kple Arpad ƒe mawuwo le? Afika Sefarwayim ƒe mawuwo le? Ɖe wote ŋu ɖe Samaria tso asinye mea?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Ale fia la gblɔ esi: Migana Xizkiya nanɔ mia flum o, elabena mate ŋu aɖe mi o!

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Eye Rabsake gblɔ na wo bena: Miɖagblɔ na Xizkiya be: Ale fia gã Asur-fia gblɔ esi: Nuka ŋu gɔglɔ̃gɔe nele dzi ɖom ɖo?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Ɖe nèle bubum be, nu me nya ƒuƒlu enye aɖaŋuɖoɖo kple ŋusẽ hena aʋawɔwɔa? Ameka ŋu gɔ̃e nèle ŋu ɖom ɖo, be nèdze aglã ɖe ŋunye?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Azã èle dzi ɖom ɖe aƒla ŋeŋe sia, si nye Egipte la ŋu, esi ne amea ɖe ziɔ ɖe eŋu la, wòŋɔa asi nɛ flo la; alea Egipte-fia Farao le na amesiwo katã le dzi ɖom ɖe eŋu la!

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Ke ne agblɔ nam be: Yehowa, mía Mawu la ŋue míele dzi ɖom ɖo la, ɖe menye eya ƒe nuxeƒewo kple vɔsamlekpuiwo Xizkiya ɖe ɖa hegblɔ na Yuda kple Yerusalem bena: Mido gbe ɖa le vɔsamlekpui sia ŋgɔ oa?

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: Azɔ mia kple nye aƒetɔ Asur-fia mitso gbe, eye matsɔ so akpe eve na wò, be ate ŋu akpɔ sɔɖolawo ado wo dzi hã?

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Màte ŋu asi aʋafia ɖeka, si nye nye aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlawo dometɔ suetɔ hã o, hafi nèle dzi dom ɖe Egipte ŋu le tasiaɖamwo kple sɔɖolawo taa?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Azɔ ɖe Yehowa megbee meto ho ɖe anyigba sia ŋu, be magblẽe loo? Yehowa ye gblɔ nam be: Ho ɖe anyigba sia ŋu nagblẽe!

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Tete Elyakim, Sebna kple Yoax wogblɔ na Rabsake bena: Ƒo nu kple wò dɔlawo ɖe Aram-gbe me, elabena míesenɛ; ke megaƒo nu kpli mí le Yuda-gbe me ɖe dukɔ, si le glia dzi la ƒe to me o.

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Rabsake ɖo ŋu bena: Mia kple wò aƒetɔ gbɔe nye aƒetɔ dɔm ɖo, be magblɔ nya siawoa? Ɖe menye ŋutsu, siwo bɔbɔ no glia dzi, be woaɖu woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe mi, eye woano woƒe aɖuɖɔ kpli mi la gbɔe oa?

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Migana Xizkiya natsɔ Yehowa anɔ dzi ɖem ƒo na mi ahanɔ gbɔgblɔm be: Yehowa aɖe mí vavã, eye womatsɔ du sia ade asi na Asur-fia o.

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Miganɔ to ɖom Xizkiya o; elabena ale Asur-fia gblɔ esi: Mibla nu kplim, eye miɖo va gbɔnye, eye mia dome amesiame naɖu eƒe weintsetse, amesiame naɖu eƒe gbotitsetse, eye amesiame nano eƒe vudo me tsi,

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime mava akplɔ mi ayi anyigba, si le abe mia to ene la dzi, anyigba, si dzi bli kple wein le, anyigba, si dzi abolo kple atibɔwo te.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Anyigba siawo ƒe mawuwo katã dometɔ kae ɖe eƒe anyigba tso asinye me, ne Yehowa naɖe Yerusalem atso asinye me?

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Tete aƒenunɔla Elyakim, Xilkiya vi, kple agbalẽŋlɔla Sebna kpakple Yoax, Asaf vi, fia ƒe tsiami, wole awu vuvuwo me va Xizkiya gbɔ, eye wogblɔ Rabsake ƒe nyaawo nɛ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esi fia Xizkiya see la, edze eƒe awuwo, eye wòta akpanya heyi Yehowa ƒe me.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Afika Xamat-fia, Arpad-fia kple du Sefarwayim, Hena kple Iwa ƒe fia le?

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: wogblɔ nɛ bena Ale Xizkiya gblɔ esi Egbe enye xaxa-, tohehe- kple vlodogbe. Elabena viwo ɖo dzidzɔ me, ke ŋusẽ meli woadzi wo o.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ Yehowa, wò Mawu la, se Rabsake ƒe nya, siwo eƒe aƒetɔ Asur-fia de esi ɖo ɖa, be wòatsɔ aɖe alɔme le Mawu gbagbe la ŋui, eye Yehowa, wò Mawu la, ahe to nɛ le nya, si wose la ta; eyata do gbe ɖa ɖe ame mamlea, siwo li la ta.

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Tete fia Xizkiya ƒe dɔlawo va Yesaya gbɔ.

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Eye Yesaya gblɔ na wo bena: Ale miaɖagblɔ na miaƒe aƒetɔ enye si: Yehowa ƒe gbe enye si: Migavɔ̃ nya, siwo Asur-fia ƒe ɖekakpuiwo tsɔ ɖe alɔme le ŋunye nèse la o.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖe gbɔgbɔa ɖe eme, eye mana wòase nyaa ɖe ahagbugbɔ ayi eƒe anyigba dzi, eye mana wòatsi yi nu le eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Esi Rabsake gbugbɔ la, ekpɔ Asur-fia wòle aʋa wɔm kple Libna, elabena ese be, eho tso Laxis.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Eye esi wose le Kus-fia Tirhaka ŋu be, eho, be yeawɔ aʋa kplii la, egadɔ ame ɖo ɖe Xizkiya, ne woagblɔ nɛ bena:

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: Ale miagblɔ na Yuda-fia Xizkiya enye si: Megana wò Mawu, si ŋu nèle dzi ɖom ɖo la, nanɔ fluwòm, eye nanɔ gbɔgblɔm be, womatsɔ Yerusalem aɖe asi na Asur-fia o.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wò ŋutɔ èse nusi Asur-fiawo wɔ anyigbawo katã, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi, eye woaɖe wò ya?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: De dukɔ, siwo fofonyewo tsrɔ̃: Gozan, Xaran, Rezef kple Eden-viwo, siwo le Telasar la ƒe mawuwo ɖe woa?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Esi Xizkiya xɔ agbalẽa le dɔlawo si, eye woxlẽe la, eyi Yehowa ƒe me, eye Xizkiya kekee ɖe Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu, wò amesi nɔa Kerubiwo dzi, wò ɖeka koe nye Mawu ɖe anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo katã dzi, wòe wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Yehowa, Asur-fiawo tsrɔ̃ dukɔwo kple woƒe anyigbawo vava,

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Agbugbɔ ato mɔ, si dzi wòto va, eye mava ɖu sia me o; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Eɖe alɔme le Aƒetɔ la ŋu to wò dɔlawo dzi gblɔ bena. Metsɔ nye tasiaɖam geɖeawo va towo ta me, vaseɖe Libanon ƒe tsutsuẽƒe ke, eye melã eƒe sederti kɔkɔwo kple eƒe sesewu nyuitɔwo, eye mede eƒe kɔkɔƒe kekeake kple eƒe abɔ me ti dodowo gbɔ.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Meɖe vudo heno tsia, eye metsɔ nye afɔƒome na Egipte-tɔsisiwo katã mie.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Mèsee kpɔ be, tso tititi ke mewɔe, eye meɖoe tso gbaɖegbe ke oa? Azɔ mena wòva me be, nagblẽ du sesẽwo woazu anyiglãgo;

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: wo me nɔlawo ƒe lãme natu, dzi naɖe le wo ƒo, eye ŋu nakpe wo woanɔ abe agble me ma, gbe mumu, xɔtagbe kple bli, si tsi to nu ta ene.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: Menya wò anyinɔnɔ, wò yiyi kple wò gbɔgbɔ kple wò agbodzedze ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Esi nèdze agbo ɖe ŋunye, eye wò dàda va nye to me ŋuti la, eyata matsɔ nye ga aɖe ŋɔti na wò, eye made nye numega nu na wò ahakplɔ wò agbugbɔ ato mɔ, si dzi neto va la.

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Esia anye dzesi na wò: Le ƒe sia me la miaɖu nusiwo mie dzro le wo ɖokui si, le ƒe evelia me la miaɖu flumenu, eye le ƒe etɔ̃lia me la mia ƒã nu aŋe nu, eye miade weingblewo aɖu wo me kutsetsewo.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Yuda ƒe aƒe la ƒe ame mamlea, siwo woɖe la, aɖe ke aɖo ta to me, eye woatse ku ɖe dzi me.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Elabena ame susɔeawo ado tso Yerusalem, eye amesiwo woɖe la, atso Zion-to la dzi; Yehowa Zebaot ƒe ŋuʋaʋã la le esia wɔ ge.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Asur-fia ŋu enye si: Mava du sia me o, eye mada aŋutrɔ ɖe eme o, matsɔ akpoxɔnu ate ɖe eŋu o, eye maƒu kpo ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Tete Asur-fia Sanxerib ho gbugbɔ dzo yi aƒe, eye wòɖanɔ Ninive.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Eye wova me, esime wòle gbe dom ɖa le eƒe mawu Nisrox ƒe me la, via Adramelex kple Sarezer wowui kple yi hesi yi Ararat-nyigba dzi; eye via Esar-Xadon zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Tete Xizkiya trɔ mo ɖe gli ŋu hedo gbe ɖa na Yehowa

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Yehowa le xoxo ge nam, eyata mina miaƒe saŋkuwo naɖi le Yehowa ƒe me le míaƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke mawo me la Xizkiya lé kudɔ. Eye nyagblɔɖila Yesaya, Amoz vi la, va egbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ɖɔ wò aƒe ɖo, elabena èle kuku ge, eye mele agbe no ge o.

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Megblɔ be: Nyemagakpɔ Yehowa, Yehowa le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi o, eye nyemagakpɔ amegbetɔ le tsieƒenɔlawo dome o.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Oo Yehowa, ɖo ŋu, alesi metsɔ nyateƒe kple ɖzi blibo zɔ le ŋkuwò me, eye mewɔ nu nyui le ŋkuwò me. Eye Xizkiya fa avi kple ɣli.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va Yesaya gbɔ bena:

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: Yi naɖagblɔ na Xizkiya be: Ale Yehowa, fofowò Dawid ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Mese wò kokoƒoƒo, eye mekpɔ wò aɖatsiwo; kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ ƒe wuiatɔ̃ akpe ɖe wò ŋkekewo ŋu.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Nya ka magblɔ, esi nèdo ŋugbe nam, eye nèwɔ edzi? Mazɔ kpookpookpoo le nye ƒewo katã me, le nye luʋɔ ƒe nuxaxa megbe.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Maɖe mia kple du sia tso Asur-fia si me, eye makpɔ du sia ta.

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Eye esia anye dzesi na wò tso Yehowa gbɔ be, Yehowa le nya, si wògblɔ la, dzi wo ge:

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mana vɔvɔli nagbugbɔ ɖe megbe ɖoƒe ewo tso Axab ƒe ɣega ƒe ɖoƒe, si wòle la dzi; tete ɣe gbugbɔ ɖe megbe tso ɖoƒe, si wòle la, ɖoƒe ewo.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Yuda-fia Xizkiya ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ enye si, esime wòlé do, eye dɔ la vo nɛ:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Megblɔ be, mage ɖe tsieƒe ƒe agbowo me le nye ŋkekewo ƒe gbɔɖemeɣi; woda adzo nye ƒe susɔea le asinye!

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Wogbã nye nɔƒe, eye wòte ɖa le gbɔnye abe lãkplɔviwo ƒe agbadɔ ene. Meŋlɔ nye agbe, abe alesi avɔlɔ̃la wɔna ene; ètsom le avɔtsitsi ŋu, eye nèna wòvɔ nam le ŋkeke me, hafi zã va do.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Medo boboe vaseɖe ŋdi; ègbã nye ƒuwo katã abe dzata ene, eye nèna wòvɔ nam le ŋkeke me, hafi zã va do.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Mele fafàm abe sagbadre kple tsãlɛ ene, eye mele xɔxlɔ̃m abe ahɔne ene; nye ŋkuwò le dzi kpam nu te wo ŋu; Yehowa, meɖo xaxa me, xɔ nya ɖe nunye!

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, esia nu ame nɔa agbe ɖo, eye esia nu nye gbɔgbɔ le agbe ɖo blibo; eyata da gbe le ŋunye, eye na manɔ agbe!

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, veve zu xɔname nam, ètsɔ lɔlɔ̃ he nye luʋɔ tso gbegblẽ ƒe do me, elabena ètsɔ nye nuvɔ̃wo katã ƒu gbe ɖe megbewò.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Elabena tsieƒe mada akpe na wò o, ku saɖagatsi makafu wò o, eye amesiwo yi aʋli me la, makpɔ mɔ na wò nyateƒe o.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Agbagbea, agbagbea koe akafu wò, abe alesi mele wɔwɔm egbe sia ene; fofo ɖea wò nyateƒe fiãa viwo.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Eye Yesaya be, woatso gbotitsetsebolo ava ɖo ƒoƒoeawo dzi, ne wòahaya.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya gblɔ be: Nuka nye dzesi be, mayi Yehowa ƒe me?

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Eye Xizkiya kpɔ dzidzɔ le nusiawo ŋuti, eye wòfiã eƒe kesinɔnu dzraɖoƒe, klosalo kple sika, atike ʋeʋẽe kple ami xɔasi kple eƒe aʋawɔnuxɔ blibo la kpakple nusiwo katã le eƒe kesinɔnu dzraɖoƒe la wo; naneke meli, si Xizkiya metsɔ fia wo le eƒe me kple fiaɖuƒe blibo la me o.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi Babel-fia Merodax-Baladan, Baladan vi, ɖo agbalẽ kple nunanawo ɖe Xizkiya, esime wose be, elé dɔ wòvɔ nɛ.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Tete nyagblɔɖila Yesaya va fia Xizkiya gbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: Nya ka ŋutsu siawo gblɔ, eye afika wotso va gbɔwò? Xizkiya ɖo ŋu bena: Didiƒe wotso va gbɔnye, tso keke Babel ke.

english_verse: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Nuka wokpɔ le aƒewò me? Xizkiya ɖo ŋu bena: Wokpɔ nusiwo katã le aƒenye me, naneke mele nye kesinɔnu dzraɖoƒe la, si nyemetsɔ fia wo o.

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Eye Yesaya gblɔ na Xizkiya bena: Se Yehowa Zebaot ƒe nya:

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkekewo li gbɔna, esiwo me woatɔ nusiwo katã le aƒewò me kple nusiwo katã fofowòwo tu ɖo vaseɖe egbe la, ayi Babel, naneke makpɔtɔ o, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Eye woakplɔ viwòŋutsu, siwo ado tso wò ali me, esiwo dzi ge nata la dometɔa ɖewo woaɖanye nudzikpɔlawo le Babel-fia ƒe me.

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Xizkiya do ŋu na Yesaya be: Yehowa ƒe gbe, si nèƒo la, enyo. Eye wògagblɔ bena: Ne ŋutifafa kple nyateƒe le nye ŋkekewo me ko!

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Mifa akɔ, mifa akɔ na nye dukɔ, mía Mawu la gblɔe!

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Mide dzi ƒo na Yerusalem be, eƒe aʋawɔdɔ la wu enu, eye woxe eƒe vodada ŋu fe, elabena exɔ teƒeɖoɖo eve nu tso Yehowa gbɔ ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ta.

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Miƒu to anyi, gbeƒãɖelaa ɖe ƒe gbe enye si. Mita mɔ ɖe gbe dzi na Yehowa, eye miwɔ mɔwo dzɔdzɔe ɖe gbegbe na mía Mawu la!

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Balimewo katã akɔ kpo, eye to kple togbɛwo katã anyẽ ɖe eme, kpoƒeewo azu zɔzrɔ̃e, eye kɔwo asɔ kple anyigba,

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: ne Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe naɖe eɖokui afia, eye ŋutilãwo katã nakpɔe; elabena Yehowa ƒe nue gblɔe.

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Miƒu to anyi, amea ɖe le gbɔgblɔm be: De gbe ƒã! Tete megblɔ be: Nya ka tsɔ ge mala aɖe gbe ƒã lae? Ŋutilãwo katã le abe gbe ene, eye woƒe atsyɔ̃ le abe seƒoƒo le gbe me ene.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Gbe ƒuna, eye seƒoƒo yrɔna, elabena Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ gbɔ ɖee. Nyateƒe, gbe enye dukɔ la!

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Gbe ƒuna, eye seƒoƒo yrɔna, ke mía Mawu ƒe nya anɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Zion, wò du nyui xɔla, lia to kɔkɔ la; wò Yerusalem, du nyui xɔla, kɔ wò gbe dzi sesĩe; kɔe dzi megavɔ̃ o, eye gblɔ na Yuda-duwo bena: Kpɔ ɖa, mia Mawu enye si!

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ Yehowa gbɔna kple ŋusẽ, eye eƒe alo aɖu fia ɖe enu. Kpɔ ɖa, eƒe fetu kpe ɖe eŋu, eye eƒe teƒeɖoɖo le eŋgɔ.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Anyi eƒe alẽhawo abe alẽkplɔvi ene, alé alẽviawo ɖe abɔ dome, eye wòakɔ wo ɖe akɔnu, eye wòakplɔ vinɔwo ɖɔɖɔɖɔ.

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Ameka tsɔ asiʋlo dzidze tsii, eye wodzidze asi ɖe dziƒo ŋu? Ameka tsɔ nudonui do anyigba dzi kee, etso nudanu da to, eye wòda togbɛwo le nudagbɛ me?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Ameka nya ta le Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ nu, eye ameka nye eƒe adaŋudela, si fia nui?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Ameka wòde adaŋu kplii, be woafia nunyae, eye wòafia nui le nu dzɔdzɔe ƒe mɔ ŋu, wòafia sidzedzee, eye wòaɖe gɔmesese ƒe mɔ afiae?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, dukɔwo le abe tsi toŋtoŋ le ze ŋu ene, wobu wo abe ʋuʋudedi le nudanu ŋu ene; kpɔ ɖa, edo ƒukpowo abe kekui ko ene!

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Libanon ƒe atiwo mesɔ gbɔ hena dzododo o, eye edzi lãwo mesɔ gbɔ hena numevɔsa o.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo katã mele ɖeke me le eŋku me o, ebu wo abe nu maɖinui kple tofloko ene.

english_verse: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
translation_verse: Amekae miehe, yewoabu ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye nɔnɔme ka míebe, yewoatsɔ asɔ kplii?

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Aɖaŋua kɔa legba, nutula faa sika ɖe eŋu, eye wòdea klosalo kɔsɔkɔsɔwo eŋu.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Amesi ɖo ko, be mate ŋu ana nu o la, tiaa ati, si manyunyɔ o la, na eɖokui, eye wòdia àɖaŋutɔ nyanua ɖe, amesi aɖo legba la anyi maʋuʋu o.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Miele nu nyam na? Miele nu sem oa? Ɖe wometoe na mi tso gɔmedzedzea ke oa? Ɖe mielé ŋku ɖe anyigba ƒe agunu ŋu oa?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi le xexeame godoo ta me, eye eme nɔlawo le dzedzem abe ʋetsuviwo ene; eya, amesi he dziƒo me abe avɔ beli ene, eye wòkekee abe agbadɔ ene, be yeanɔ eme;

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: eya, amesi na amegãwo zu nu maɖinui, eye anyigba dzi ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo zu tofloko.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Womekpɔ do wo o, womekpɔ ƒã wo o, woƒe ali mekpɔ ƒo ke ɖe to o, tete wògbɔ ɖe wo, woƒu, eye ahom lɔ wo ɖe nu abe gbe ƒuƒu ene.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Kɔkɔetɔ la be: Ameka ŋu miebe, yewòatsɔm aɖoe, ne masɔ kplii?

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Mifɔ mo dzi, ne míakpɔ nu! Ameka wɔ nusiawo, eye wòkplɔa eŋu nuwo ɖoa goe dedie? Eyɔa wo katã ŋkɔ, eye wo dometɔa ɖeke mesusɔna o le eƒe ŋusẽ geɖe kple alɔkame sesẽ la I nu.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Yakob, nukaŋuti nèle nu ƒom, Israel, nèle gbɔgblɔm be: Nye mo ɣla ɖe Yehowa, eye nye nya dzɔdzɔe to nye Mawu ŋu yi?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Menyae, eye mèsee kpɔ be, Mawu mavɔ enye Yehowa, amesi wɔ anyigba ƒe mlɔeanuwo oa? Nu metia kɔ nɛ o, ɖeɖi metea eŋu o, eye eƒe nunya ƒe ta metsɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Eyae naa lãmesesẽ amesiwo ŋu ɖeɖi te, eye wònaa ŋusẽ geɖe ame beliwo.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Nu tia kɔ na ɖekakpuiwo, eye ɖeɖi tea wo ŋu, eye ŋutsuwo dzea anyi;

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: ke ŋusẽ yeye ɖoa amesiwo kpɔa mɔ na Yehowa ya ŋu, woɖoa li fu abe hɔ̃ ene, woƒua ɖu metia wo o, wòzɔa azɔli ɖeɖi metea wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Mi ƒukpowo, mimiã nu le ŋkunye me, ŋusẽ yeye neɖo dukɔwo ŋu; woate va, hafi woaƒo nu; titina míaƒo ta kpli ayi ʋɔnu.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Ameka nyɔ amesi yome xɔname le kplikplikpli la, tso ɣedzeƒe? Ameka tsɔ dukɔwo de asi le eŋku me, eye wòna wonyã avuzi le fiawo dzi? Ameka na woƒe yi zu abe ke ene, eye woƒe datiwo le abe tsro, si nu ya ene?

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: Eti wo yome, eto mɔ, si dzi eƒe afɔ meto kpɔ o, ke naneke mewɔe o.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Ameka wɔe heƒoe wòde go? Eya, amesi yɔ ƒomewo tso gomedzedzea me ke lae. Nye Yehowa enye gbãtɔ, eye alea ke mele na ame mlɔeawo!

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Ƒukpowo kpɔe, eye dzidzi ƒo wo, anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo dzo nyanyanya; woƒo ta kpli heva.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Wokpe ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu, eye amesiame gblɔ na nɔvia be: Lé dzi ɖe ƒo!

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Aɖaŋua de dzi ƒo na sikanutula, amesi ƒoa ga gbabɛ la, de dzi ƒo na zũdala hegblɔ be: Wotsiãe nyuie. Tete woƒo gatagbadzɛ ɖee, be magaʋã o.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Ke wò, nye dɔla Israel, Yakob, amesi metia, xɔ̃nye Abraham ƒe ƒome,

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: wò, amesi melé tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo, eye meyɔ wò tso eƒe dzogoewo dzi hegblɔ na wò be: Nye dɔla nènye, metia wò, eye nyemegbe wò o;

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: megavɔ̃ o, elabena meli kpli wò; ŋɔ megadzi wò o, elabena nyee nye wò Mawu, mali ke wo, makpe ɖe ŋuwò, eye matsɔ nye xoname ƒe nuɖusi alé wò.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋukpe kple vlododo ava amesiwo katã do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋuwò la dzi, wò ketɔwo atsrɔ̃, eye wo nu ayi.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Àdi amesiwo le dzre wɔm kpli wò la, ke mãkpɔ wo o, amesiwo le aʋa wɔm kpli wò la, azu tofloko agazui ɖe dzi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Elabena nye Yehowa, wò Mawu, amesi le gbɔgblɔm na wò be, megavɔ̃ o, makpe ɖe ŋuwò lae lé wò nuɖusi ɖe asi.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Wò, nyẽvi Yakob, wò, ha sue Israel, megavɔ̃ o! Makpe ɖe ŋuwò, Yehowa ye gblɔe; wò xɔnametɔ enye Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ wò awɔ luƒotasiaɖam yeye ɖaɖɛ, si nu dɔ geɖe le. Àfanya towo, agba wo gudugudu, eye, àwɔ togbɛwo abe tsro ene.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Agbo wo, ya alo wo ɖe nu, eye ahom aka wo ahlẽ; ke wò la atso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye aƒo adegbe ɖe Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo, siwo le tsi dim, ke ɖeke meli o, eye woƒe aɖe ƒu le tsikɔwuame ta la, nye Yehowa makpe ɖe wo ŋu, nye Israel ƒe Mawu, nyemagblẽ wo ɖi o.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Maʋu go tɔsisiwo le to ƒeƒlewo ta me, eye tsidzɔƒe anɔ balimewo; mana gbegbe nazu tà, eye tsi nado bababa le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Mado sederti, xe, gbemiti kple amiti ŋutɔ ɖe gbe dzi, eye mado sesewu, fɔfɔli kple kpomi siaa ɖe gbegbe;

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: ne woakpɔe, eye wòadze sii, wòade dzigbɔ na wò, eye woanyae be, Yehowa ƒe asie wo esia, Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ lae wɔe.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Yehowa be, mihe miaƒe dzrenyawo vɛ, Yakob ƒe fia la be, mihe miaƒe ɖokuitaʋlinyawo vɛ.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Woate va, ne woagblɔ nusi gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la, na mí. Kawoe nye tsãtɔwo? Migblɔe, ne míalé ŋku ɖe woawo kple woƒe nuwuwu ŋu, alo mina míase nusi le dzɔdzɔ ge la.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Migblɔ nusi gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la, ne miadze sii be, mawuwo míenye; miwɔ nyuie alo vɔ̃a ɖe, ekema míaƒe nu aku, eye mí katã míakpɔe kple ŋku.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, miele ɖeke me o, eye tofloko enye miaƒe dɔwɔwɔ; amesi tia mi la, ŋunyɔ wònye!

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: Menya amea ɖe tso anyiehe wòva, amesi aɖe gbe ƒã nye ŋkɔ la, tso ɣedzeƒe; azɔ anyigba-nunɔlawo dzi abe anyi me ene, eye abe alesi zemela nyãa tsui ene.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Ameka gblɔe tso gɔmedzedzea me, ne míadze sii, eye ameka gblɔe tso gbaɖegbe, ne míagblɔ be, etɔ dzɔ? Amea ɖeke megblɔe o, amea ɖeke mena wosee o, eye amea ɖeke mese miaƒe nyawo o.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Nyee nye ame gbãtɔ gblɔ na Zion be: Kpɔ ɖa, woawoe nye esi! Eye meɖo du nyui xɔlawo ɖe Yerusalem.

english_verse: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.
translation_verse: Metsa ŋu, ke amea ɖeke meli o; aɖaŋuɖolaa ɖeke mele wo dome, ne mabia nyae wòaɖo eŋu o.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wo katã mele ɖeke me o, nu dzodzroa enye woƒe dɔwɔwɔ, ya kple tofloko enye woƒe legbawo.

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔla enye si, malée ɖe te, nye ame tiatia, si ƒe nu nyo ŋunye! Meda nye gbɔgbɔ ɖe edzi, ne woahe nye ɖoɖowo ayi na dukɔwo.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Mado ɣli alo aɖo boboe o, eye mana woase eƒe gbe le kpɔdome o.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Maɖe aƒla ŋeŋe la le enu o, eye matsi ɖovu bibi fiɖifiɖi la o. Ahe ɖoɖo la ayii le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Ɖeɖi mate eŋu o, eye eƒe lãme matu o, vaseɖe esime wòaɖo ɖoɖo la anyigba dzi, ƒukpowo le mɔ kpɔm na eƒe nufiame.

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu Yehowa, amesi wɔ dziƒowo, eye wòhe wo me, amesi keke anyigba kple eƒe numiemiewo ɖe nu, amesi na agbe dukɔ, si le eɖzi, kple gbɔgbɔ amesiwo zɔa edzi la, gblɔ esi:

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: Nye Yehowa ye yɔ wò le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, melé wò alɔnu, eye mekpɔ tawò, eye metsɔ wò wɔ nubabla na dukɔ la kple kekeli na anyigba dzi dukɔwo,

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: ne naʋu ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔwo, eye naɖe amesiwo wode gae la, tso ga me, kple amesiwo bɔbɔ no viviti me la, tso gaxɔ me.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, ŋkɔnyee, nyematsɔ nye bubu na ame tutɔ kple nye kafukafu na legbawo o.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, gbaɖegbe nyawo va me, magblɔ yeyewo, eye mana miasee, hafi woava dzɔ.

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo toa atsiaƒu dzi, kple atsiaƒu me nuwo, mi ƒukpowo kple wo dzi nɔlawo, midzi ha yeye na Yehowa, miɖe gbe ƒã eƒe kafukafu tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu!

english_verse: Tell the tribes of the desert and everyone in the mountains to celebrate and sing.
translation_verse: Gbegbewo kple woƒe duwo kpakple kɔƒe, siwo me Kedar le la, negli! Agakpe dzi nɔlawo nètso aseye, wòado ɣli tso towo ƒe tsutsuẽƒe ke!

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Yehowa ho abe kalẽtɔ ene, eɖe dzo ŋuʋaʋã me abe aʋawɔla ene, edo ɣli, eye wòtso ayiboopɛɛ, eɖe ŋusẽ fia ɖe eƒe futɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Mezi ɖoɖoe eteƒe didi, memiã nu kpoo, eye mezi ɖokuinye dzi: azɔ mado ɣli abe nyɔnu léku ene, eye mala gbɔgbɔtsixe ɖe ƒo anɔ gbɔgbɔm fuxefuxe.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Magblẽ towo kple togbɛwo, eye mana woƒe gbe mumuwo katã naƒu, mana tɔsisiwo nado kpo, eye mana táwo namie.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Mana ŋkuagbãtɔwo nazɔ mɔ, si Womenya o la dzi, eye makplɔ wo ato toƒe manyamanyae, mana viviti nazu kekeli le wo ŋgɔ, eye kpoƒeewo nazu zɔzrɔ̃e. Nusiawo wo ge mala, eye nyemadzudzɔe o.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Amesiwo ɖoa dzi ɖe aklama kpakpɛwo ŋu, eye wogblɔna na legbawo be: Miawoe nye míaƒe mawuwo la, woate gbugbɔ ɖe megbee, eye ŋu akpe wo vevie.

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Mi tokunɔwo, mise nu, mi ŋkuagbãtɔwo, mifɔ ko dzi miakpɔ nu!

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ nu geɖe, ke mèlé wo ɖe ta me o; èke to, ke mèse nu o.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Edze Yehowa ŋu be, wòaɖe gãnyenye kple ŋutikɔkɔe se la ŋu lé eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ta;

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: ke dukɔ, si woha, eye woda adzoe la wonye, mɔ̃ ɖe wo katã le do me, eye woɣla ɖe gaxɔ me; woɖe aboyo wo, ke amea ɖeke mexɔ wo o, woha wo, ke amea ɖeke megblɔ be: Migbugbɔ wo vɛ o.

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Amekae de Yakob asi, be woaha, eye wòde Israel asi na adzodalawo? Ɖe menye Yehowa, amesi ŋu míewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖo, miegbe eƒe mɔwo dzi zɔzɔ, eye míese eƒe nufiame o lae oa?

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Etrɔ eƒe dziku ƒe dɔmedzoe kple aʋa ƒe ŋusẽ kɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye wòlé dzo bi ƒo xlã wo, ke womedze sii o, efiã wo, ke mede dzi gbɔ na wo o.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Azɔ ale Yehowa, amesi wo wò Yakob, eye wòme wò Israel la, gblɔ esi: Megavɔ̃ o, elabena meɖe wò, metsɔ wò ŋkɔ yɔ wò be: Tɔnye nènye.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Ne èto to me la, meli kpli wò, eye ne èto tɔsisiwo me la, womalé wò o. Ne èto dzo me, mamè wò o, eye dzo ƒe adewo mafiã wò o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Elabena nye Yehowa enye wò Mawu, nye Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la enye wò xɔnametɔ. Matso Egipte aƒle tawo, eye Kus kple Seba axɔ de tewòƒe.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Esi nèxɔ asi le ŋkunye me, bubu le ŋuwò, eye melɔ̃ wò ta la, matso amegbetɔwo ana ɖe tewòƒe kple dukɔwo de wò agbe ta,

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Megavɔ̃ o, elabena meli kpli wò; makplɔ viwòwo tso ɣedzeƒe vɛ, eye maƒo nuwo ƒu tso ɣetoɖoƒe!

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: Magblɔ na anyiehe be; Tsɔe ve! eye na dziehe be: Megasika ame di o! Kplɔ vinyeŋutsuwo tso didiƒe vɛ kple vinyenyɔnuwo tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu,

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: amesiwo katã ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ do, amesiwo mewɔ hena nye bubu, memè wo, eye mewo wo.

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Kplɔ dukɔ, si ta ŋku le, hafi wònye ŋkunɔ, to le eta, hafi wònye tokunɔ la doe!

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo katã neƒo ƒu, anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã neƒo ta kpli: Ameka le wo dome agblɔ esia, alo ana míase nya, siwo dzɔ va yi? Woƒe ɖasefowo neva, ne woatso na wo, eye woasee ahagblɔ bena: Ele eme.

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Miawoe nye nye ɖasetɔwo kple nye dɔla, si metia, ne mianyae, miaxɔ dzinye ase, eye miadze sii be, nyee. Womewɔ mawua ɖeke do ŋgɔ nam o, eye ɖeke mado megbe nam o.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, eye xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Medo ŋugbe, eye mexɔ na ame; mena miesee, eye mawu tutɔa ɖeke mena mia dome o; Yehowa be, míawoe nye nye ɖasefowo, eye nyee nye Mawu.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Nyee li tso tititi ke, eye amea ɖeke maxɔ ame le asinye o; ne mewo nu la, ameka atrɔe?

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, miaƒe xɔnametɔ, Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la, gblɔ esi: Le mia tae medɔ ame ɖo ɖe Babel, eye mena wonyã amewo ɖe nu, eye wonyã Kaldeatɔwo ɖo ɖe woƒe ʋu, siwo me wokpɔ dzidzɔ le tsã la me.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Nye Yehowa enye miaƒe kɔkɔetɔ, nye Israel ƒe wɔla enye miaƒe fia.

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, amesi ta mo ɖe atsiaƒu me, eye wòɖe toƒe ɖe to sesẽwo me la, gblɔ esi:

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: eya, amesi na tasiaɖamwo, sɔwo, aʋakɔwo kple kalẽtɔwo siaa ho; woɖo baba ɖe anyigba, eye womegafɔ o, wo nu tsi, abe alesi akaɖi me ɖovu tsina ene:

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: Migaɖu ŋu gbaɖegbe nuwo o, eye migalé ŋku ɖe nusiwo dza va yi la ŋu o.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mele nu yeye wo ge; ele nu dom ɖa xoxo, miedze sii oa? Mana mo tata naɖo gbe dzi, eye tɔsisiwo nado gbegbe.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Gbemelãwo, amegãxiwo kple golowo akafum, elabena mena tsi ɖo gbe dzi, eye tɔsisiwo ɖo gbegbe, ne mana tsi nye dukɔ, nye ame tiatiawo, ne woano.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Dukɔ, si mewɔ na ɖokuinye la, axlẽ nya afia le nye kafukafu ŋu.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Yakob, menye wòe yɔm o, eye Israel, mèdze agbagba le ŋunye o.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Mètsɔ wò alẽviwo sa numevɔ nam o, eye mètsɔ wò akpedavɔsawo de bubu ŋunye o. Nyemetsɔ wò nuɖuvɔsawo do agba na wò o, alo tsa dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe dodo ɖe fu na wò o.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Mètsɔ ga ƒle gbekee nam o, eye metsɔ wò akpedavɔsawo ƒe ami ɖi ƒoe nam o; ke boŋ etso wò nuvɔ̃wo ɖo agba nam, eye nèɖe fu nam kple wò vodadawo.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Nyee, nyee atutu wò dzidadawo ɖa le nye ŋutɔ ɖokuinye ta, eye nyemaɖo ŋu wò nuvɔ̃wo o.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Do ŋku edzi nam, na míahe nya kple mia nɔewo; to wò nyawo, ne towo nadzɔ.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Fofowò gbãtɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃, eye amesiwo nɔ nuwò la, to vo ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Eyata medo gu amegã kɔkɔeawo, metsɔ Yakob de asi na tsɔtsrɔ̃ gbidigbidi, eye Israel na fewuɖuɖu.

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: Azɔ nye dɔla Yakob kple nye ame tiatia Israel, see!

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, wɔwòla kple mèwòla tso dɔ me ke, amesi li kpli wò la, gblɔ esi: Nye dɔla Yakob kple nye ame tiatia Yesurun, megavɔ̃ o!

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Elabena maƒo tsi ɖe kuɖinyigba dzi kple tɔʋu wo ɖe anyigba ƒuƒu dzi. Matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ akɔ ɖe viwòwo dzi kple nye yayra ɖe wò dzidzimeviwo dzi,

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: ne woamie abe gbe ene, abe amuti le tɔ to ene.

english_verse: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.
translation_verse: Amesi agblɔ be, Yehowa tɔ ye nye, ame keme atsɔ Yakob ƒe ŋkɔ na eɖokui, eye ame bubu aŋlɔ Yehowa ɖe eƒe asi ŋu, eye wòaƒo Israel ŋkɔ ɖo na eɖokui. Trɔ̃subɔsubɔ ƒe bometsinuwo.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe fia kple eƒe xɔnametɔ, Yehowa Zebaot,: gblɔ esi: Nyee nye gbãtɔ, eye nyee nye mlɔetɔ; mawua ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ameka agblɔ nya abe nye, amesi ɖo dukɔwo gɔme anyi tso blema ke la ene, ne wòaɖee afia, eye wòatoe nam? Woagblɔ nusi le eme va ge kple nusi le dzɔdzɔ ge la na wo!

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ŋɔ megadzi mi o, eye migadzo nyanyanya o! Ɖe nyemena miesee tso gbaɖegbe ke, eye nyemetoe na mi oa? Miawoe nye nye ɖasefowo. Ɖe mawua ɖe li kpe ɖe ŋunyea? Agakpea ɖeke meli o, nyemenya ɖeke o.

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Legba mèlawo katã la toflokowo wonye, eye woƒe nu lɔlɔ̃awo mele ɖeke me o; woawo ŋutɔwoe nye woƒe ɖasefowo be, womele nu kpɔm o, eye womedzea si nu o, eyata ŋukpe alé wo.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Amekae wɔ mawua ɖe, eye amekae kɔ legbaa ɖe, si mele ɖeke me o?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋu akpe wo hatiwo katã; aɖaŋuawo la, amegbetɔwo wonye, wo katã naƒo ta kpli, eye woado: ke woadzo nyanyanya, eye ŋukpe alé wo katã.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Gbeɖe tsɔa gayibɔ tua fiae, ewɔa eŋu ɖɔ le dzoka xɔxɔ me, etsɔa zu tunɛ, eye wòtsɔa eƒe alɔkpa sesẽ wɔa ɖɔ le eŋu; ne dɔ va wui la, ekema ŋusẽ vɔna le eŋu, ne meno tsi o la, ekema eƒe lãme tuna.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Atikpala daa dzidzeka, etsɔa ɣe tanɛ, eye wòtsɔa fi kpanɛ, etsɔa nudzidzega tanɛ, eye wòwɔnɛ ɖe ŋutsu ƒe nɔnɔme me, ɖe amegbetɔ ƒe ɖekadzedze me, ne wòanɔ xɔ me.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Amea ɖe lã sedertiwo, etsɔ fɔfɔli kple logoti, eye wotia avemetiwo na eɖokui. Eɖo sesewu wo, eye tsidzadza na wotsi.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Wonye dzodonu na amegbetɔ; etsɔ ɖe do dzoe heƒu, eye wòtsɔe do dzo ƒo aboloe; etsɔ ɖe wɔ mawui hede ta agu nɛ, eye wòtsɔ ɖe wɔ aklama kpakpɛe heɖo gbe ɖa nɛ.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Etsɔ mamlea wɔ mawui, etsɔe wɔ eƒe legbae, eye wòdze klo ɖe ta agu nɛ hedo gbe ɖa nɛ gblɔ bena: Ɖem, elabena wòe nye nye mawu!

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mebua ta me, eye wòkpɔ sidzedze kple gɔmesese o, ne wòagblɔ be: Metsɔ afã do dzoe, meƒo abolo ɖe eƒe akawo dzi, eye metɔ lã ɖu tso; ɖe matsɔ mamlea awɔ ŋunyɔnui, eye ɖe maɖo gbe na atikpoa?

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Amesi le dzofi yome la, dzi bleamee flui, maɖe eƒe agbe o, eye magblɔ na eɖokui o be: Ɖe menye aʋatsoe melé ɖe nuɖusi oa? Israel nuveve kple eɖeɖe.

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: Yakob kple Israel, ɖo ŋui, elabena nye dɔla nènye; nyee wɔ wò nènye nye dɔla; Israel, megaŋlɔm be o!

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Mena wò dzidadawo bu abe atu ene kple wò nuvɔ̃wo abe alilikpo ene; trɔ va gbɔnye, elabena meɖe wò.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Mi dziƒowo, mitso aseye, elabena Yehowa wɔe wòde go! Mi anyigba ƒe agunuwo, mido aƒa! Mi towo, avewo kple wo me nuwo katã, mitso aseye hoo, elabena Yehowa ɖe Yakob, eye wòdo kɔkɔe eɖokui ɖe Israel ŋu.

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, ɖewòla, amesi mè wò tso dɔ me ke la, gblɔ esi: Nyee nye Yehowa, amesi wɔ nusiawo katã, nye ɖeka koliae he dziƒo me, eye mekeke anyigba me, amea ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Eya, amesi gblẽa nu kpoloe ƒolawo ƒe dzesi me, eye wòdoa bometsila afakalawo; eya, amesi nana nunyalawo gbugbɔna, eye wòdoa lã woƒe nunya;

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: eya, amesi nana eƒe dolawo ƒe nya vaa me, eye wòwɔa eƒe ame dɔdɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo dzi; eya, amesi gblɔ na Yerusalem be, woaganɔ eme, eye wogblɔ na Yuda-duwo be, woatso wo, eye yeafɔ eƒe glikpowo ɖe tsitrenu;

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: eya, amesi gblɔ na to gome be, mie, eye mana wò tɔsisiwo naƒu kplakplakpla;

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: eya, amesi gblɔ na Kores be: Nye lãkplɔvi nenye! Eyae awɔ nye ɖiɖiwo katã ade goe, eye wòagblɔ na Yerusalem be, woatsoe, eye na gbedoxɔ be, woaɖo egɔme anyi!

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ na Kores, eƒe amesiamina la, amesi ƒe nuɖusi melé, ne mafanya dukɔwo le eŋgɔ, eye matu ali dzi na fiawo, maʋu ʋɔwo le eŋku me, eye agbowo matsi dodo o la, ènye si:

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: Madze ŋgɔwò, eye mana kpoƒewo nasɔ, magbã akɔbligbowo, eye maŋe gametiwo,

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: eye matsɔ kesinɔnu, si le blukɔ me, kple nu xɔasi, siwo woɣla la, ana wò, ne nadze sii be, nye Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, enye amesi tsɔ ŋkɔ yɔ wòe,

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: le nye dɔla Yakob kple nye ame tiatia Israel ta; metsɔ wò ŋkɔ yɔ wò, eye metsɔ bubuŋkɔ na wò, esi mèkpɔ dze sim haɖe o.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, ɖeke megali o; mawua ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o; mebia ali dzi na wò, esi mekpɔ dze sim haɖe o,

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: ne wòadze sii tso ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe be, amea ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o. Nyee nye Yehowa, ɖeke megali o,

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: nye amesi ɖo kekeli, eye mewɔ viviti, nye amesi wɔ dzɔgbenyuie, eye mehe dzɔgbevɔ̃e vɛ. Nye Yehowa ye wɔ nusiawo katã!

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mi dziƒowo, nuɖuɖu tso dzi me, eye alilikpowo nadza dzɔdzɔenyenye; anyigba neke nu, ne xɔname nado, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye hã namie Nye Yehowa ye wɔe.

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Baba na amesi le dzre hem kple emèla, sonu gaglɛ wònye le anyisonu gaglɛwo dome! Ɖe tsu agblɔ na emela be: Nuka wɔm nèle? alo eƒe dɔwɔwɔ nagblɔ be: Mèto asi oa?

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Baba na amesi gblɔna fofoa be: Nuka la nedzim? eye na nyɔnu be: Nuka ta nèle ku ɖo?

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ kple emèla, gblɔ esi: Mibia nusiwo gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la ta se, ke mina makpɔ vinyewo kple nye asinudɔwɔwɔwo ƒe nya gbɔ.

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Nyee wo anyigba, eye mewo ame ɖe edzi. Nye asie he dziƒo me, eye meɖo eŋu nuwo katã.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Menyae le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye mala eƒe mɔwo katã. Eyae atso nye du la, eye wòaɖe asi le nye aboyomewo ŋu, menye le ga alo nunana ta o; Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Egipte ƒe adzɔnuwo, Kus kple Sebatɔ ƒlalaawo ƒe viɖe age ɖe asiwò me ahazu tɔwò; woano ga me adze yowòme, eye woade ta agu na wò ahaƒo koko na wò be: Wò ɖeɖe ko gbɔe Mawu le, ɖeke megali o, mawu bubua ɖeke megali o.

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Vavãe, wò Israel ƒe Mawu, xɔnametɔ la, Mawu ɣaɣla nenye!

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe lé wo katã, eye woƒe mo tsi dã; legbamèlawo katã le yiyim le vlododo me.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Yehowa atso xɔname mavɔ aɖe Israel; ŋukpe kple vlododo malé mi tegbetegbe akpɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa, dziƒowɔla, eya amesi nye Mawu, eya amesi mè anyigba, eye wòwɔe; eya amesi ɖoe anyi, menye ɖe wòwɔe, be woatsi ƒuƒlu o, ke boŋ ɖe wòmee, be woanɔ edzi la, gblɔ esi: Nyee nye Mawu, ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Nyemeƒo nu le vivi me le anyigba ƒe teƒe, si do blukɔ o; nyemegblɔ na Yakob ƒe ƒome la be: „Midim yakatsyɔ“ o. Nye Yehowa megblɔ nusi le eme, eye meto nyateƒe.

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo ƒe ame sisiwo, miƒo ta kpli, eye miva, mi katã milé va! Ame manyanuwo wonye, amesiwo lé woƒe aklama kpakpɛ tikpowo ɖe la, eye wole gbe dom ɖa na mawu, siwo meɖea ame o.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Migblɔe, eye mihee vɛ, woade adaŋu kple wo nɔewo. Ameka na wose nusiawo gbaɖegbe ke, eye wògblɔe tso blema ke? Nye Yehowa ye, eye mawua ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o!

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Mi anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo katã, mitrɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye mina woaxɔ na mi; elabena nyee nye Mawu, ɖeke megali o.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Meta ɖokuinye, nya vava do tso nye nu me, eye matrɔ o be: Klowo katã ata anyi nam, eye aɖewo katã aka atam nam

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: ahagblɔ bena: Míaƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ŋusẽ le Yehowa gbɔ; amesiwo katã do dziku ɖe eŋu la, ava egbɔ, eye ŋu akpe wo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Yehowa ye woatsɔ atso afia na Israel ƒe ƒomeawo katã, eye woaƒo adegbe.

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Bel mũ, eye Nebo do dɔgɔe; wotsɔ miaƒe legba, siwo mieléna ɖe ta la, de asi na agbatsɔlãwo, wotsɔ wo do agbae ɖe lã, si ŋu ɖeɖi te la dzi.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Wo katã wodo dɔgɔe, eye womũ, womate ŋu axɔ agba la o, eye woawo ŋutɔ wozɔ yi aboyo me.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe aƒe la kple Israel ƒe aƒe me ame mamleawo, miɖo tom, mi amesiwo metsɔ do agba ɖe ɖokuinye dzi tso dɔ me ke, eye metsɔ mi tso vidzidɔ me ke.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ame ma ke manye, vaseɖe esime miaku amegã; matsɔ mi ado agbae ɖe ɖokuinye dzi, eye maɖe mi.

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Wo, amesiwo dudua sika tsoa kotoku me ɖe anyi, eye wodaa klosalo le nudanu me, woɖatsɔa gbeɖe, ne woatsɔe awɔ mawu, si woadze klo ade ta agu na.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Wokɔe ɖo abɔta, eye wode ta ete ɖadro ɖe enɔƒe; etsia tre ɖi meʋãna tsoa eteƒe o. Ne amea ɖe do ɣli nɛ hã, mesenɛ o, eye meɖenɛ tsoa eƒe hiã la me o.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋu esia, eye mili ɖe nu ɖeka dzi; mi godzelawo, mina wòade dzi gbɔ na mi.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Mido ŋu nusiwo dzɔ va yi tso blema la be, nyee nye Mawu, ɖeke megali o, nyee nye Mawu, amea ɖeke mesɔ kplim o;

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
