translation_verse: nye amesi ɖe nuwuwu fia le gɔmedzedzea me ke kple nusi gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la fia le blema ke gblɔ bena: Nye tame-ɖoɖo ava me, eye mawɔ nye didiwo katã dzi;

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: nye amesi yɔ hɔ̃ tso ɣedzeƒe kple ŋutsu, si nye nye tameɖoɖotsɔla la, tso anyigba matsɔmatsɔ dzi; megblɔ nya, eye mana woava eme hã, meɖo nu, eye mawɔe hã.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Miɖo tom, mi tamesẽlawo, mi amesiwo le adzɔge na dzɔdzɔenyenye.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mehe nye dzɔdzɔenyenye va kpuiƒee, mele adzɔge o, eye nye xɔname mahe de megbe o; mana xɔname Zion kple nye atsyɔ̃ Israel.

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wò ɖetugbi, Babel nyɔnuvi, ɖi ɖe anyi, eye nabɔbɔ nɔ ke me! Bɔbɔ nɔ anyigba fiazikpui makpɔmakpɔe, wò Kaldea-nyɔnuvi! Elabena womagayɔ wò azɔ be fewunuwɔla kple atsyɔ̃nuwɔla vivivo o.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Ɖo teƒo natu wɔ, ɖe moxevɔ ɖa, ɖe taɖedzi ɖa, ɖe ata ƒuƒlu, ne natso tɔ!

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Wò ama adze go, eye woakpɔ wò ŋukpeƒe. Mabia hlɔ̃, eye amea ɖeke matso mía dome o.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Míaƒe xɔnametɔ la ŋkɔ enye Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ!

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Kaldea-nyɔnuvi, zi ɖoɖoe klenee nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi, eye nayi ɖe blukɔ me! Elabena womagayɔ wò azɔ be fiaɖuƒewo ƒe aƒenɔ o.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Medo dɔmedzoe ɖe nye dukɔ ŋu, medo gu nye domenyinu, eye metsɔ wo de asi na wò; ke mèkpɔ nublanui na wo o, eye nètsɔ wò kɔkuti kpekpe do amegã ɖeɖiwo dzi.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Egblɔ be, yeanye aƒenɔ daa tegbee; esia mede dzigbɔ na wò o, eye meɖo ŋu alesi woava nɔ emegbe o.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Azɔ see, wò agbe vivi ɖula, si li bɔkɔɔ, eye nèle gbɔgblɔm le wò dzi me be; Nye koe, ɖeke megali o, nyemazu ahosi o, eye womaɖe vi le ŋunye o.

english_verse: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
translation_verse: Eyata nusiawo kple eve adzɔ ɖe dziwò gbe ɖeka kpoyi, woaɖe vi le ŋuwò, eye nazu ahosi; to wò dzosasa geɖeawo kple wò gbesa gbogboawo gbɔ hã woaƒo ɖe dziwò bibibi.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu ɖe wò vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi ŋu gblɔ bena: Amea ɖeke mele kpɔyem o. Wò nunya kple wò ayedzedze flu wò, nègblɔ le wò dzi me bena: Nye koe, ɖeke megali o!

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Do kple wò gbesawo kpakple wò dzo gbogbo, siwo ŋu nèku kutri le tso wò ɖevime ke; ɖewohĩ ate ŋu awɔ nane, ɖewohĩ ate ŋu ado ŋɔdzi na amea ɖe.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Ede aɖaŋu geɖe wòti ko na wò; na dziŋgɔli me nyalawo, amesiwo ɖea ŋku ɖe dzinuviwo, eye wodzea si nusi gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe dziwò le dzinu me la, natso axɔ na wò.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, gbe ƒuƒu wonye, dzo afiã wo, womaɖe woƒe agbe tso dzoƒaɖe ƒe ŋusẽ nu o, elabena menye dzoka xɔxɔ wònye, ne wòa ƒu o, eye menye mlekpui me dzo wònye, ne woabɔbɔ nɔ enu o.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Alea amesiwo ŋu nèku kutri ɖo, eye mia kpli wo mietsa asi tso wò ɖevime ke la, woazu na wò, amesiame lé eƒe mɔ, eye ɖeke mexɔ na wò o.

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Misee, Yakob ƒe aƒe, mi amesiwo tso Israel ƒe ŋkɔ, eye miedzɔ tso Yuda ƒe tsidzɔƒewo, mi amesiwo taa Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, eye miekafua Israel ƒe Mawu la, ke menye le nya teƒe kple dzɔdzɔenyenye me o.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Elabena woyɔa du kɔkɔe la ɖe wo ɖokui ŋu, eye woɖoa dzi ɖe Israel ƒe Mawu, si ŋkɔ nye Yehowa Zebaot la ŋu.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: Meɖe blemanyawo fia gbaɖegbe ke; nye nu me wodo tso, eye mena wosee, mewɔe zi ɖeka kpoyi, eye wova dzɔ.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: eyata meɖee fia wò gbaɖegbe ke, eye mena nèsee, hafi woava dza, ne màgagblɔ be: Nye legbawoe wɔe, nye aklama kpakpɛwo kple nye legba kɔkɔwoe ɖoe o.

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Esee, eye nèɖe ŋku ɖe wo katã; ke miawo, ɖe miagbe boblododoea? Maɖe nu yeyewo afia wò tso azɔ kple nu ɣaɣla siwo menya o.

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Fifia wowɔe, eye menye tso blema o, eye mèse eŋu nya kpɔ vaseɖe fifi o, ne nagagblɔ be, yenyae tsã o.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Mèsee kpo alo nyae o, eye wò to meke ɖe eŋu tsã o, elabena menyae be, ame mawɔnuteƒe nènye, eye godzela woyɔna na wò tso dɔ me ke.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Metsi nye dɔmedzoe nu le nye ŋkɔ ta, eye le tawò meɖo asi ɖokuinye dzi le nye kafukafu ŋuti, be magatsrɔ̃ wò o;

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: kpo ɖa, melólo wò, ke menye abe klosalo ene o, eye medo wò kpo le hiã ƒe aŋoɖakpo me.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Le tanye, le tanye mawɔe, elabena aleke womehegblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye ŋkɔe o! Nyematsɔ nye bubu na ame tutɔa ɖeke o.

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Yakob kple wò Israel, si meyɔ, miɖo tom! Nyee, nyee nye gbãtɔ, eye nyee nye mlɔetɔ hã.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Nye asie ɖo anyigba gome anyi, eye nye nuɖusie he dziƒo me; esi meyɔ wo la, wo katã wova tsi tre ɖi.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Mi katã mikpe ta, ne miasee! Wo dometɔ kae gblɔ esia? Amesi Yehowa lɔ̃na la, aɖe eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu afia ɖe Babel kple eƒe alɔkpa afia ɖe Kaldea-tɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Nyee, nyee ƒo nu, meyɔe, eye mena wòva, eye eƒe mo adze edzi nɛ.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Mite ɖe ŋunye, ne miasee; tso gɔmedzedzea me ke nyemeƒo nu le adza me o; mele eteƒe tso gbaɖegbe ke, esime wòva me. Azɔ Aƒetɔ Yehowa kple eƒe gbogbo la ɖom ɖa.

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, wò xɔnametɔ, Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la, gblɔ esi: Nye Yehowa, wò Mawu, enye amesi fia nusi nyo na wò la wò, nyee akplɔ wò to ma, si dzi nato la.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Ɖe wònye ɖe neɖo to nye seawo la, anye ne wò ŋutifafa ana abe tɔsisi ene, eye wò dzɔdzɔenyenye anɔ abe ƒutsotsoewo ene;

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: anye ne wò ƒome ano abe ke ene, eye wò dɔmeviwo abe kekui ene; eye womatsrɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ alo atutui ɖa le ŋkunye me o.

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Mitso aseyetsotso ʋu tso Babel, eye nusi tso Kaldea-nyigba dzi! Migblɔ nusia, eye miɖe gbe ƒãe, mihee yi anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke, migblɔ be: Yehowa ɖe eƒe dɔla Yakob!

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Tsikɔ mewu wo, esi wòkplɔ wo to gbegbe o; ena tsi do tso agakpe me na wo, eye wòle agakpe wòɖudu tsi.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ŋutifafaa ɖeke meli na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo o.

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Mi ƒukpowo, miɖo tom, mi adzɔge dukɔwo, miƒu to anyi! Yehowa yɔm tso dɔ me ke, eye wòyɔ ŋkɔnye tso danye ƒe do me ke.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Ewo nye nu abe yi ɖaɖɛ ene, eɣlam ɖe eƒe asi ƒe vɔvɔli te, eye wòtsɔm wo aŋutrɔ biɖoe hetsɔm ƒo ɖe eƒe daku me.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam be: Israel, nye dɔla nènye, amesi ŋu mawo ɖokuinye kɔkɔe ɖo.

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Ke megblɔ be: Medze agbagba yakatsyɔ, eye megblẽ nye ŋusẽ ɖe ya me dzodzro; ke Yehowa si me nye nya le, eye nye fetu le nye Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Azɔ ale Yehowa, amesi mèm tso dɔ me ke hewɔ eƒe dɔlae, ne wòakplɔ Yakob agbɔe, eye wòaƒo Israel nu ƒu la gblɔ nam esi; elabena bubu le ŋunye le Yehowa ŋku me, eye nye Mawu enye nye ŋusẽ.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Egblɔ bena: Nu tsɛ wònye be, nènye nye dɔla, ne nafɔ Yakob ƒe toawo ɖe tsitrenu, eye nakplɔ Israel ƒe amesiwo woɖe la agbɔe; metsɔ wò ɖo kekeli na dukɔwo hã, ne nanye nye xɔname vaseɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke.

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe xɔnametɔ kple eƒe kɔkɔetɔ la gblɔ na amesi wodo vloe, amesi dukɔ la nyɔ ŋui, amesi nye dziɖulawo ƒe kluvi la, enye si; Fiawo akpɔe ahatso ɖe tsitrenu, eye amegãwo aɖe ta agu le Yehowa, amesi metrɔa ta me o la ta, le Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ, amesi tia wò la ta.

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mase wò gbe le amenuveɣi, eye maxɔ na wò te xɔnamegbe, makpɔ tawo, eye matsɔ wò aɖo nubabla na dukɔ la, ne naɖo anyigba la te, eye namã domenyinu, si zu gbegbe la;

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: ne nagblɔ na gatɔwo be: Mido! eye na amesiwo le viviti me la be: Miva kekeli nu! Woaɖu gbe le mɔ to, eye woƒe gbeɖuƒe anɔ togbɛ ƒeƒlewo katã ta me.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Dɔ kple tsikɔ mawu wo o, eye ŋdɔ kple ɣe maɖu wo o, elabena wo nuvela le wo kplɔm, eye woakplɔ wo ato tsidzidziwo ŋu.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye towo katã awɔ mɔe, eye wòado nye mɔ tatawo.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, amesiwo atso adzɔge ava, ame kemewo atso anyiehe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, eye ame bubuwo atso Sinitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Mi dziƒowo, mitso aseye, anyigba, kpo dzidzɔ, eye mi towo, mido aƒa; elabena Yehowa fa akɔ na eƒe dukɔ, eye wòkpɔ nublanui na eƒe hiãtɔwo. Zion ƒe akɔ nata le dɔmetɔtrɔ de eŋu ta.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Ke Zion be: Yehowa gblẽm ɖi, Aƒetɔ la ŋlɔm be.

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyɔnu aŋlɔ eƒe vidzie be, eye eƒe dɔme agbe tɔtrɔ ɖe eƒe dɔmevi ŋua? Ne woawo ŋlɔe be hã, nyea nyemaŋlɔ wò be o!

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meŋlɔ wò ɖe nye asi ŋu, wò gliwo le ŋkunye me ɖaa.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Viwòwo gbɔna afa tsɔtsɔe, tsrɔ̃wòlawo kple gblẽwòlawo atu le mewo adzo.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Fɔ ka dzi nakpɔ nu godoo: Wo katã woƒo takpli gbɔna va gbɔwò! Yehowa be: Meta ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ado wo katã abe lekewɔnu ene, eye atso wo abla ali dzi abe ŋugbetɔ ene.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Azɔ wò aƒedo, wò gbegbe kple wò anyigba, si wogblẽ la, axaxa ŋuta na edzinɔlawo, eye gblẽwòlawo anɔ adzɔgedzɔgee na wò.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Azɔ vi, siwo woɖe le ŋuwò la, agblɔ ɖe to me na wò be: Nɔƒe la xaxa nam, te ɖa tso gbɔnye, ne manɔ anyi!

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Eye àgblɔ le wò dzi me be: Woɖe vi le ŋunye, eye metsi ko, wode aboyom, eye wonyãm de gbe tso, ameka dzi esiawo nam? Ameka nyi wo wotsi? Kpɔ ɖa, nye ɖeka ko wogblẽ ɖi, afika woawo ya no?

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpo ɖa, mamiã asi dukɔwo, eye mado aflaga ɖe dzi na anyigba dzi dukɔwo, ne woatsɔ wò ŋutsuviwo ɖe akɔnu vɛ, eye woakɔ wò nyɔnuviwo ɖe abɔta ve.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Fiawo anye vinyilawo na wò, eye wo srɔ̃wo anye nonala na wò; woade ta agu atsyɔ mo anyi ɖe ŋkuwò me, eye wòaɖuɖɔ wò afɔ ŋu ke, eye adze si be, nyee nye Yehowa, eye nyemenana ŋu kpea amesiwo ɖoa ŋu ɖe ŋunye la o.

english_verse: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?
translation_verse: Ɖe woaxɔ nuhaha le kalẽtɔ sia? eye ɖe aboyomewo age le ŋutasẽla sia?

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Woxɔa aboyomewo le kalẽtɔ si, eye nuhaha gena le ŋutasẽla si; mawo avu kple amesiwo le avu wɔm kpli wò, eye maɖe viwòwo;

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: mana amesiwo te wò ɖe anyi la, naɖu woawo ŋuta ƒe lã, eye woamu woƒe ʋu abe wein ene. Eye ŋutilãwo katã nadze sii be, nye Yehowa enye wò xɔnametɔ, eye Yakob ƒe ŋusẽtɔ enye wò ɖela.

english_verse: The Lord says, “Children, I didn't divorce your mother or sell you to pay debts; I divorced her and sold you because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Afika mía dada ƒe asigbegbalẽ, si metsɔ gbee la le? alo ameka nye nye fetɔ, si metsɔ mi dzra na? Kpɔ ɖa, mia vodadawo ta wotsɔ mi dzra, eye le mia dzidadawo ta wogbe mia dada ɖo.

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti meva, eye amea ɖeke meli o, meyɔ ame, eye amea ɖeke metɔ o? Ɖe nye alɔ le kpuie, be wòagbe xɔxɔ na amea? eye ɖe ŋusẽ mele ŋunye, be maɖe ame oa? Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ nye nyanyrã ana atsiaƒu namie, eye mana tɔsisiwo nazu tagba, wo me lãwo aƒaƒã, elabena tsi megale wo ŋu o, eye tsikɔ awu wo woaku.

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa tsɔ nusrɔ̃viwo ƒe aɖe nam, ne manya alesi matsɔ nuƒoƒo akpe ɖe amesiwo ŋu ɖeɖi te la ŋui. Enyɔam ŋdi sia ŋdi, eʋua to nam, ne mase nu abe nusrɔ̃vi ene.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa ʋu to nam, nyemesẽ to o, eye nyemede megbe o.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Mesia nye mẽdome ɖi na ameƒolawo, eye meɖo nye tome anyi na amesiwo nyɔa ɖa; nyemetsyɔ nu ŋku me le vlododo kple taɖeɖe ŋuti o.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ Yehowa kpe ɖe ŋunye, eyata ŋukpe malém o; eyata nye mo sẽ abe ahliha ene, eye menyae be, ŋu mele kpe ye ge o.

english_verse: My protector is nearby; no one can stand here to accuse me of wrong.
translation_verse: Amesi le afia tso ge nam la, tsɔ gbɔnye; ameka be, yeahe nya kplim? Mina míava kpe ta! Amesi si nya le ɖe ŋunye la, nete ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa. Aƒetɔ Yehowa axɔ nam; amekae abu fɔm ma? Kpɔ ɖa, wo katã anyunyɔ abe avɔ ene, eye agbagblaʋui aɖu wo.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mia dometɔ, si vɔ̃a Yehowa la, neɖo to eƒe dɔla ƒe gbe; amesi le viviti me zɔm, eye kekelia ɖeke meklẽna nɛ o lã, neɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu, eye wòaziɔ ɖe eƒe Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mi amesiwo katã tɔa dzo nu, eye mietsɔa dzoƒaɖe bia akpae la, mige ɖe miaƒe dzobibi la kple dzoti, si miekpe la me. Asinye me esia tso na mi, eye miamlɔ vevesese me.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo tia dzɔdzɔenyenye yome, mi amesiwo dia Yehowa la, miɖo tom! Miɖe ŋku ɖe agakpe, si wotsɔ wɔ mi, kple vudoʋe, si me woɖe mi tsoe.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Miɖe ŋku ɖe mia fofo Abraham kple Sara, si dzi mi; elabena eya ɖeka meyɔ, eye meyrae wòdzi ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa afa akɔ na Zion, afa akɔ na woƒe aƒedowo katã, awɔ woƒe gbegbe abe Eden ene kple woƒe tagba abe Yehowa ƒe aba ene; vivisese kple dzidzɔ, kafukafuha kple saŋkuƒoƒo anɔ anyi.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, miƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye, nye ameha, milé to ɖe ŋunye! Elabena nufiame ado tso asinye me, eye maɖo nye ɖoɖo anyi, wòanye kekeli na dukɔwo.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Nye dzɔdzɔenyenye tu aƒe, nye xɔname ado, eye nye alɔwo adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo; ƒukpowo le mɔ kpɔm nam, eye wole nye alɔ si nu dzɔm.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Mifɔ mo dzi ɖe dziƒo eye mide mo to ɖe anyigba; elabena dziƒo abu abe dzudzɔ ene, anyigba anyunyɔ abe avɔ ene, eye edzinɔlawo aku abe tagbatsuwo ene; ke nye xɔname anɔ anyi tegbee, eye nye dzɔdzɔenyenye nu matsi o.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo nyaa dzɔdzɔenyenye, dukɔ, si ƒe dzi me nye se la le, miɖo tom! Migavɔ̃ amegbetɔwo ƒe fewuɖuɖu o, eye woƒe vlodoame megaɖe dzi le mia ƒo o!

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Elabena agbagblaʋui aɖu wo abe avɔ ene, eye tsiƒomee aɖu wo abe kuntru ene; ke nye dzɔdzɔenyenye anɔ anyi tegbee, eye nye xɔname anɔ dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Nyɔ, Yehowa ƒe alɔ, nyɔ, eye nata ŋusẽ! Nyɔ abe le tsã ŋkekewo me ene, abe le blema ƒomeawo ŋɔli ene. Ɖe menye wòe fũ Raxab, eye nèƒo nu ɖe boso la oa?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Ɖe menye wòe na atsiaƒu, tɔgo glo la me tsiwo mie, eye nèta mɔ ɖe atsiaƒu gɔme, be amesiwo woɖe la, to edzi yi oa?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe amesiwo wòxɔ ƒle la, atrɔ gbɔ, woava Zion kple aseyetsotso, eye dzidzɔ mavɔ anɔ woƒe ta me; vivisese kple dzidzɔ asu wo si, eye nuxaxa kple hũɖeɖe abu ɖe wo.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Nyee, nyee nye amesi afa akɔ na mi. Ameka nènye, be nèle amegbetɔ, si nye nu kukua, kple amegbetɔvi, si wowɔna abe gbe ene la vɔ̃m?

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: eye nèŋlɔ Yehowa, wɔwòla, amesi he dziƒo me, eye wòɖo anyigba gɔme anyi la be, eye nèle dzodzom nyanyanya gbawotsyogbe ɖaa le ameteɖeanyigba ƒe dziku ta, ne eɖo be, yeagblẽ wo? Afika ameteɖeanyila ƒe dziku le azɔ?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Woaɖe ga amesi do dɔgɔ̃e ɖi la kaba, maku ɖe gaxɔ me o, eye abolokoe mawɔe o.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, wò Mawu, amesi de adã ta me na atsiaƒu, ale be eƒe tsotsoewo dze agbo; eƒe ŋkɔ nye Yehowa Zebaot.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye nya ɖe nuwo, eye meɣla wò ɖe nye asi ƒe vɔvɔli te, ne magbugbɔ dziƒo me ahe, maɖo anyigba gome anyi, eye magblɔ na Zion be: Nye dukɔ nènye.

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Fɔ, fɔ, Yerusalem, tso, wò, si no dɔmedzoekplu tso Yehowa si me, èno kplu muame la kpɔ egɔme ƒiaƒiaƒia.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Vi, siwo katã wòdzi la dometɔa ɖeke mekpɔe o, eye vi, siwo katã wònyi wotsi la dometɔa ɖeke melé eƒe alɔnu o.

english_verse: You have been destroyed by war and by famine; I cannot comfort you.
translation_verse: Nu evee dzɔ ɖe dziwò, amekae afa na wò? Gbegblẽ kple, tsɔtsrɔ̃, dɔwuame kple yi, amekae afa akɔ na wò?

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Nu te viwòwo ŋu, wòmlɔ kpɔdomewo katã ƒe dzogoewo dzi abe sẽ, si mɔ̃ ɖe ene, eye Yehowa ƒe dziku kple wò Mawu ƒe nyanyrã ɖi ƒo na wò.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Eyata, wò hiãtɔ, yamula, si meno wein hafi o la, se esia!

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Ale wò Aƒetɔ Yehowa kple wò Mawu, amesi wòa avu ɖe eƒe dukɔ nu la, gblɔ esi: Maxɔ kplu muame, nye dɔmedzoekplu la, le asiwò me, eye màganoe azɔ o;

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: matsɔe ade asi na amesiwo wo funyafunya wò, amesiwo gblɔ na wò be: Bɔbɔ, ne míato dziwò ayi, wo wò mẽdome wòasɔ kple anyigba, eye wòanɔ, abe alesi mo le na edzitolawo ene.

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Nyɔ, Zion, nyɔ nata wò ŋusẽ! Yerusalem, wò du kɔkɔe la, ta wò atsyɔ̃vɔwo! Elabena bolotɔwo kple ame makɔmakɔwo magava mewò azɔ o.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Ʋuʋu ke le ŋuwò, Yerusalem, tso nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi! Zion-nyɔnuvi, si woɖe aboyoe, ɖe ga le wò kɔ!

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Wotso mi dzra yaka, eye menye ga tsɔ ge woala axɔ mi o.

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Tsã la nye dukɔ yi Egipte, be wòanɔ afima, eye Asur tee ɖe anyi yakatsyɔ.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Azɔ dɔ ka le ŋunye le afi, esi wokplɔ nye dukɔ dzoe yakatsyɔ? Yehowa be, wo dziɖulawo le aseye tsom, eye wole alɔme ɖem le nye ŋkɔ ŋu gbeawotsyogbe ɖaa.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Eyata nye dukɔ adze si nye ŋkɔ gbemagbe be, nyee nye amesi le gbɔgblɔm be: Nyee nye si!

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Du nyui xɔla ƒe afɔwo nyo le towo dzi loo! Eya, amesi ɖea gbe ƒã ŋutifafa, eye wòtoa gbe nyui, eɖea gbe ƒã xoname, eye wòle gbɔgblɔm na Zion be: Wò Mawu enye fia!

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Lé to ɖe wò dzɔlawo ŋu! Wo katã ƒe gbe de dzi, eye wotso aseye; elabena woƒe ŋkuwò kpɔ eteƒe, esime Yehowa trɔ gbɔ va Zion.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Mi Yerusalem ƒe aƒedowo, mido aƒa, mitso aseye yoo; elabena Yehowa fa akɔ na eƒe dukɔ, eye wòɖe Yerusalem!

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Yehowa klo nu le eƒe alɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu le dukɔwo katã ŋku me, eye anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo katã akpɔ mía Mawu ƒe xɔname.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Midzo, midzo, miʋu tso afima! Migaka asi nu makɔmakɔa ɖeke ŋu o! Miʋu tso wo dome; mi Yehowa ƒe nutsɔlawo, mikɔ mia ɖokui ŋu!

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Elabena menye kplakplakpla dzi miano aʋu o, eye miasi adzo o; elabena Yehowa adze ŋgɔ na mi, eye Israel ƒe Mawu la axe megbe na mi.

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔla awɔ nu ɖe nunya me, woadoe ɖe dzi, axɔ ŋkɔ, eye wòaɖo kpo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Alesi ame geɖewo ƒe nu ku ɖe ŋuwò, alesi eƒe nɔnɔme vlo wu amegbetɔwo tɔ, eye eƒe kpɔkpɔme vlo wu amegbetɔviwo tɔ la,

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: nenema wòana dukɔ geɖewo ƒe nu naku, eye fiawo ƒe nu ade ga le eta, elabena nusi womegblɔ na wo kpɔ o la, wokpɔ, eye nusi womese kpɔ o la, wodze sii.

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Amekae xɔ nya, siwo wogblɔ na mí la dzi se, eye ameka ŋue Yehowa ƒe alɔ ɖe eɖokui fia ɖo?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Edze abe atilɔ fẽ ene le eŋku me, eye abe ke ƒe dzedzè tso anyigba ƒuƒu me ene. Nɔnɔme kple ɖekadzedze mele eŋu, ne míaɖe ŋku ɖee o, eye kpɔkpɔme mele eŋu, ne eƒe nu nadzro mí o.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Amegbetɔwo do vloe, eye wogbee, ŋutsu kpehiã kple amesi dzi dɔléle le la wònye, wodo vloe abe amesi ta wotsyɔ nu ŋku me ɖo la ene, eye míebui ɖe naneke me o.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Ke eyae tsɔ míaƒe dɔlélewo, eye wòɖe ta miaƒe vevesesewo te; evɔ wònye míawo míebui abe amesi wohe to na, amesi Mawu ƒo, eye wòwɔ funyafunyae ene hafi.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Ke wode abi eŋu le míaƒe dzidadawo ta, eye wogbãe gudugudu le míaƒe vodadawo ta. Miaƒe ŋutifafa ƒe tohehe le edzi, eye eƒe kabiwo wotsɔ yɔ dɔ mí.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Mí katã míetra mɔ abe alẽwo ene, eye amesiame lé eƒe mɔ tsɔ; ke Yehowa na míaƒe vodadawo katã va eyama dzi.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Wowɔ fui, ke ebɔbɔ eɖokui eye meke nu o; abe alẽ, si wokplɔ yina wuwu ge, kple alẽvi, si li kpoo le eƒe fukolawo ŋku me ene la, nenema eya hã meke nui o.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Woɖee le xaxa kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me, eye eŋɔlimeviwo dometɔ kae bu eŋuti kpɔ be, woɖee ɖa le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi, eye wowɔ fui le nye dukɔ ƒe dzidadawo ta?

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Woɖe yɔdo nɛ ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dome, eye esi wòku la, enɔ vodalawo dome, evɔ wònye mesẽ ŋuta o, eye alakpa menɔ eƒe nu me kpɔ o hafi.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa ɖi be, yeatsɔ dɔléle agbãe gudugudu; ne etso eɖokui wo fɔɖivɔsae la, akpɔ dzidzimeviwo, anɔ agbe didie, eye Yehowa ƒe tameɖoɖo adze edzi to eƒe asi dzi.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Akpa nu kple ŋku, wòaɖi ƒo nɛ le eƒe luʋɔ ƒe agbagbadzedze ta. Nye dɔla dzɔdzɔe la atsa nunya atso afia na ame geɖewo, eye wòade ta woƒe vodadawo te.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Eyata mana gomee ɖe ame geɖewo dome, eye eya kple kalẽtɔwo amã aboyonu, elabena etso eƒe agbe de ku me, eye wòna wobui kpe ɖe vodalawo ŋu, evɔ wònye ede ta ame geɖewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo te, eye wòɖe kuku ɖe vodalawo ta hafi.

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Wò konɔ, si medzi vi o, tso aseye; kpɔ dzidzɔ, eye nado aƒa, wò amesi melé ku kpɔ o! Yehowa be: Amesi tsi akogo la ƒe viwo sɔ gbɔ wu srɔ̃tɔ ƒe viwo.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Elabena àkeke ɖe ɖusi kple mia me, viwòwo axɔ dukɔwo ƒe anyigba, eye woanɔ ɖu zu aƒedowo me.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Megavɔ̃ o, elabena ŋu makpe wò o; wò mo megatsi da o, elabena ŋukpe malé wò o. Elabena àŋlɔ wò ɖetugbime ŋukpe be, eye màɖo ŋu wò ahosinyenye me vlododo o.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Elabena wɔwòla enye srɔ̃wò, eŋkɔ nye Yehowa Zebaot, eye wò ɖela enye Israel ƒe kɔkɔeto la, eŋkɔ nye xexeame blibo ƒe Mawu.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ya wò abe nyɔnu, si wogblẽ ɖi wòle nu xam ene, eye abe ɖekakpuime srɔ̃, si wogbe ene, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: Megblẽ wò di vie ko, ke matsɔ nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã aƒo wò ƒu.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Le dɔmedzoedodo ƒe nyanyrã me meɣla nye ŋku me de wò ʋee: ke matsɔ amenuveve mavɔ akpɔ nublanui na wò, Yehowa, wò ɖelae gblɔe!

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: Elabena esia le nam abe Noa ƒe tsiɖɔɖɔ ene; alesi mekɔ atam be, Noa ƒe tsiɖɔɖɔ magaɖe anyigba akpɔ o la, nenema ke meka atam be, nyemagado dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋuwò, eye nyemagaka mo na wò azɔ o.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Elabena ne towo te ɖa, eye togbɛwo ʋã hã la, nye amenuveve mate ɖa le ŋuwò o, eye nye ŋutifafa nubabla maʋã o, Yehowa, wò nublanuikpɔlae gblɔe!

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Wò hiãtɔ, si ahom lɔ ɖe nu, eye womefa akɔ na wò o, kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ kpe ŋɔŋɔewo aɖo gɔwòme anyi, eye matsɔ adzagba aɖo wò agunu anyi.

english_verse: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
translation_verse: Mana wò xɔta tsutsuẽwo nanye gbloti, wò agbowo nanye soe, eye wò kpɔtɔtɔ blibo la nanye kpe xɔasiwo.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Viwòwo katã anye Yehowa ƒe nusrɔ̃viwo, eye viwòwo ƒe ŋutifafa asa gbɔ.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye woatsɔ ali ke wò; anɔ adzɔge na ŋutasesẽ, elabena mavɔ̃ o, eye anɔ adzɔge na ŋɔdzi, elabena mate ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ne amea ɖe wɔ avu la, menye nyee dɔe o; amesi wɔ avu kpli wò la, atsi asiwò me.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nyee wɔ gbede, amesi ƒlɔa dzo ɖo, eye wòtua lãnu le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ nu; eye nyee wɔ nugblẽla hã, be wòagblẽ nu.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Lãnu sia lãnu, si wotu ɖe ŋuwò la, madze edzi o, eye abu tɔ aɖe, siwo katã tso ɖe ŋuwò le ʋɔnu. Esia nye Yehowa ƒe dɔlawo ƒe domenyinu, eye woƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye tso gbɔnye, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Kuwui! Mi ame tsikɔwuwo katã, miva tsi gbɔ! Mi amesiwo si ga mele o, miva ƒle nu, ne miaɖu! Miva, ne miadze wein kple notsi, menye kple ga alo le asixɔxɔ nu o!

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Nuka ta miebe, yewoaxlẽ ga ɖe nusi menye abolo o la ta, eye miawɔ dɔ ɖe nusi meɖia ƒo o la ta? Miɖo tom ko, ekema miaɖu nu nyui, eye miaƒe luʋɔ ƒe dzeme akɔ ɖe ami ŋu.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: Miƒu to anyi, eye miva gbɔnye! Mise nu, ekema miaƒe luʋɔ anɔ agbe! Mabia nu mavɔ kpli mi, mana Dawid ƒe amenuveve, si li ke la mi.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔe ɖo ɖasefo na dukɔwo, eye metsɔe ɖo dukɔwo ƒe amegã kple dziɖula.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ayɔ dukɔ, si menya o la vɛ, eye dukɔ, si menya wò o la, aƒu du ava gbɔwò le Yehowa, wò Mawu, kple Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la ta, elabena ede bubu ŋuwò.

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Midi Yehowa, ŋkeke alesi wòle gaglãgbe, miyɔe, esime wotsɔ kpui ƒe.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi neɖe asi le eƒe mɔ ŋu, eye nu vlo wɔla neɖe asi le eƒe susuwo ŋu, ne wòatrɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu, ekema akpɔ nublanui nɛ, eye wòatrɔ ɖe mía Mawu ŋu, elabena etsɔa nuvɔ̃ kena geɖe. Mawu ƒe nya ƒe dɔwɔwɔ vodada manɔŋui.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa be: Nye susuwo menye miaƒe susuwo o, eye miaƒe mɔwo menye nye mɔwo o;

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: ke boŋ alesi dziƒo kɔ boo wu anyigbae la, nenema nye mɔwo kɔ wu miaƒe mawo kple nye susuwo wu miaƒe susuwòe.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi tsidzadza kple sno dzana tso dziƒo, eye megagbugbɔna yina o, ke boŋ wòdea tsi anyigba wònana wòmiea nu heʋãa nu, eye wònaa nuku nuƒãla kple abolo, ne woaɖu la,

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: nenema ke nye nya, si do tso nye nu me la anɔ: Magbugbɔ va gbɔnye ƒuƒlu o, negbe ɖeko wòawɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu, eye wòawɔ nusi gbe meɖoe ɖo la hafi.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Elabena miaʋu adzo kple dzidzɔ, eye woaɖo mi ɖa le ŋutifafa me. Towo kple togbɛwo atso aseye le mia ŋgɔ, eye gbemetiwo katã aƒu akpe.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Sesewuwo amie ɖe ŋuvewo teƒe, eye gbe ʋeʋẽewo amie ɖe dzawo teƒe, eye wòazu kafukafu na Yehowa kple ŋkuɖodzinu mavɔ, si nu mayi o.

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi. Midzra ɖoɖo la ɖo, eye miwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe. Elabena nye xɔname tu aƒe, ne wòava, kple nye dzɔdzɔenyenye, ne wòaɖe eɖokui afia.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Amedzrovi, si ku ɖe Yehowa ŋu la, megagblɔ be, Yehowa le ye ɖe ge ɖa atso eƒe dukɔ ŋu o; eye ame tata megagblɔ be, kpɔ ɖa, ye la, ati ƒuƒu ko ye nye o.

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ na ame tata, siwo dzraa nye dzudzɔgbewo ɖo, wotiaa nusi dzea ŋunye, eye wokuna ɖe nye nubabla ŋu tsehee la, enye si:

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: Mana ŋkuɖodzinu kple ŋkɔ, siwo nyo wu ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo la wo ɖe aƒenye me kple nye gliwo me; ŋkɔ mava, si metsrɔ̃na o la, mana amesiawo tɔgbe.

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Eye amedzrovi, siwo ku ɖe Yehowa ŋu, be yewoasubɔe, yewoalɔ̃ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, eye yewoanye dɔlawo ne, wo amesiwo katã dzraa dzudzɔgbe la ɖo, be yewomagagblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ o, eye wokuna ɖe nye nubabla ŋu la,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: mana woade nye to kɔkɔe la gbɔ, eye mado dzidzɔ na wo le nye gbedoxɔ me. Woƒe numevɔsawo kple woƒe akpedavɔsawo adze ŋunye le nye vɔsamlekpui dzi; elabena woayɔ nye aƒe be: Dukɔwo katã ƒe gbedoxɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa, amesi ƒo Israel ƒe ame kahlẽwo nu ƒu la be: Magaƒo amewo nu ƒu akpe ɖe ame ƒoƒuawo ŋu. Tohehe na dukɔ la kplɔla vɔ̃ɖiawo.

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Mi gbemelãwo katã, miva ɖu nu, mi avemelãwo katã!

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzɔlawo katã nye ŋkuagbãtɔwo, womele si dzem naneke o; avũ aɖetututɔ, siwo mate ŋu aɖe gbe o la, wo katã wonye, womlɔ anyi le drɔ̃e kum, eye alɔ̃ le wo nu vivim.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Do le avũawo wum vevie, eye womenya ƒoɖiɖi o, lãkplɔvi, siwo mele ɖeke nyam o la, wonye; wo katã wòlé woƒe mɔ, eye wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe le eƒe viɖe yome dim le goawo katã me.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Miva, ne maɖaku wein ve, eye míano aha muame; etso hã nanɔ abe egbe ene, eye eteƒe makɔ o.

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe kuna, eye medea dzigbɔ na amea ɖeke o, woɖea mawumemewo ɖa, ke amea ɖeke medzea sii be, vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ nu woɖea ame dzɔdzɔe ɖa le o.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Amesiwo ƒe zɔzɔme to mo ɖeka la, wòayi ɖe ŋutifafa me, eye woagbɔ ɖe eme le wo mlɔƒewo.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Mi nyɔnu dzosala ƒe viwo, mi ŋutsu ahasitɔ kple gbolo ƒe dzidzimeviwo, mite va!

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Ameka ŋu miele fefem le, ameka ŋu mieke nu ɖo baa, eye miedo aɖe ɖe go biɖaa ɖo? Ɖe menye godzelawo ƒe dzidzimeviwo kple alakpaviwo mienye,

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: amesiwo ƒe lãme le fiefiẽm ɖe legbawo ŋu le ati damawo katã te, mi amesiwo wu mia viwo ɖe balimewo le agakpetowo te la oa?

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Etia bali me kpe zɔzrɔ̃ewo na ɖokuiwo, woawoe nye wò gome; èƒo tsi ɖe anyi na wo, eye nèɖe dza na wo, ɖe mazi kpi akpa nusiawoa?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Etu mlowòƒe ɖe to, si ko bobobo la dzi, eye nèyi edzi, be nawu vɔsalã.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Etso wò ŋkuɖodzinu ɖo wò ʋɔtruwo kple ʋɔtrutiwo godo, elabena ètrɔ ʋu le yonyeme, èklɔ nu le wò aba ŋu, ede edzi, eye nèkekee de nu, eye mia kple wo miebla asi; wo mlɔƒe dze ŋuwò, eye nèɖe ŋku ɖe ama.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Etsɔ ami yi fia gbɔe, eye nèɖo atike ʋeʋẽe asi fũ; èɖo wò amewo ɖe didiƒe ke, eye nèbɔbɔ ta wòɖatɔ tsieƒe ke.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Ne wò ma didi la te ɖeɖi ŋuwò hã la, mègblɔna be, yeadzudzɔ o; agbe gale ŋuwò, eyata nu mete ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Amekae le ŋɔ dzim na wò, eye ameka vɔ̃m nèle, be nèzu alakpatɔ, meɖo ŋku dzinye o, eye nya mede dzigbɔ na wò o? Esi mezi kpi eteƒe didi la, menye eyatae negbem vɔvɔ̃ ɖo oa?

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Maɖe wò dzɔdzɔenyenye afia; ke wò dɔwɔwɔwo maxɔ na wo o.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Eɖo ɣli be, wò legba gbogboawo naxɔ na wò, ke ya lɔ wo katã ɖe nu, eye ƒuƒu kplɔ wo dzoe. Ke amesi sim tso la, anyi anyigba ƒe dome, eye wòaxɔ nye to kɔkɔe la wòanye etɔ.

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ be: Mita mɔ, mita mɔ, mikplɔ mɔwo dzi; miɖe nukikliwo katã ɖa le mɔ me na nye dukɔ!

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Elabena ale ame gã, si ɖo kpo, eli tegbee, eye eƒe ŋkɔ nye kɔkɔe la, gblɔ esi: Mele dzi kple kɔkɔeƒe la, mele amesi wogbã gudugudu, kple amesi ƒe gbɔgbɔ wobɔbɔ de anyi la gbɔ, ne magbɔ agbe amesiwo wobɔbɔ ɖe anyi la ƒe gbɔgbɔ, eye magbɔ agbe amesiwo wogbã gudugudu la ƒe dzi.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemanɔ dzre hem godogodo o, eye nyemanɔ dɔmedzoe dom ɖaa o; elabena nu ava te gbɔgbɔ ŋu le ŋkunye me kple luʋɔ, siwo mewɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Le eƒe ŋubiabia ƒe vodada ta medo dɔmedzoe, eye meƒoe ɖo, medo dɔmedzoe, eye meɣla ɖokuinye, tete wòdze go helé eƒe tamesusu ƒe mɔ tso.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: Mekpɔ eƒe mɔwo, mayɔ dɔe, makplɔe, eye mafa akɔ na eya kple eƒe nuxalawo.

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Yehowa, amesi wo nuyiwo ƒe kutsetse la, gblɔ be: Ŋutifafa, ŋutifafa mana didiƒe nɔlawo kple kpuiƒe nɔlawo, eve mayɔ do wo.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu be; Ŋutifafaa ɖeke meli na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo o.

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: He vekati nado ɣli, megadzudzɔ o! Wò gbe nede dzi abe kpẽ ene, eye nagblɔ nye dukɔ ƒe vodada nɛ kple Yakob ƒe aƒe ƒe nuvɔ̃wo nɛ!

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Wole diyem gbeawotsyogbe, eye wole didim be, yewoanya nye mɔwo; wole ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe dim tso gbɔnye abe dukɔ, si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye megblẽa eƒe Mawu ƒe ɖoɖowo ɖi o la ene; wole didim be, Mawu natsɔ ɖe yewo gbɔ!

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: „Nukaŋuti míetsi nu dɔ, eye mèlé ŋku ɖe eŋu o, míeka hiã mía ɖokui, eye mèdze sii o?“ Kpɔ ɖa, miewɔ ɖɔ le miaƒe nutsidɔgbe, eye mieƒo du ɖe miaƒe dɔwɔlawo nu.

english_verse: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, dzrewɔwɔ kple avuwɔwɔ ta mietsi nu le dɔdɔm ɖo, eye be miada kɔ madzɔmadzɔ. Menye ɖe mietsi nu dɔ le ŋkeke mawo me, be woase miaƒe gbe le dzi o.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: De nutsitsiɖɔ, si melɔ̃na, kple ŋkeke, si dzi amegbetɔ naka hiã eɖokui la, enye esia? Ne wobi ta ɖe anyi abe keti ene, eye womlɔ akpanya kple afi dzi la, eya yɔm nèle be nutsitsidɔ kple ŋkeke, si adze Yehowa ŋua? Mawusubɔsubɔ vavãtɔ yayra.

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: Ɖe menye esia nye nutsitsidɔ, si melɔ̃na la oa be, woaɖe ga madzɔmadzɔwo, woatu kɔkuti ƒe kawo, woana ablɔɖe amesiwo wote ɖe anyi, eye míaŋe kɔkutiwo katã,

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: naka wò abolo na dɔwuitɔ, eye nakplɔ ame dahe, siwo le tsaglãla tsam la, ayi aƒewò mee, ne èkpɔ amea ɖe amama la, nata avɔ ne, eye màgaɣla ɖokuiwò ɖe wò ŋutɔ wò ŋutilã o.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Ekema wò kekeli adze abe agudzedze ene, eye wò hayahaya ado kaba, wò dzɔdzɔenyenye adze ŋgɔwò, eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ahe megbe na wò.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Ekema àyɔ Yehowa, eye woatɔ na wò; àdo ɣli, eye wòagblɔ be: Nyee nye si! Ne èɖe ameteteɖeanyi, asifiafia me kple nu vɔ̃ɖi ƒoƒo le dowòme,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: ne ètsɔ wò abolo na dɔwuitɔ, eye nèɖi ƒo na amesi wole ɖe anyi la, ekema wò kekeli aklẽ le viviti me, eye wò tsizi anɔ abe ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ ene,

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: ekema Yehowa akplɔ wò ɖaa, eye wòaɖi ƒo na wò le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi, aɖe agbe wò ƒuwo me, eye ànɔ abe abɔ, si wode tsii, kple tsidzɔƒe, si ƒe tsiwo memiena o la ene.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Viwòwo atso blemaƒedowo, eye afɔ gbaɖegbetɔwo ƒe glikpowo ɖe tsitrenu, eye woayɔ wò be „gli gbagbãwo ɖɔɖola, mɔwo dzradola, ne woatso aƒe ɖi.“

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: ekema akpɔ dzidzɔ le Yehowa ŋu, mana naɖe anyigba ƒe kɔkɔƒewo, eye mana naɖu fofowò Yakob ƒe domenyinu; elabena Yehowa ƒe nue gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ƒe alɔ meto ɖe eme, be maxɔ na ame o, eye eƒe to metsi, be mase nu o;

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: ke boŋ miaƒe vodadawoe klã mia kple miaƒe Mawu dome, eye miaƒe nuvɔ̃woe na be, wòɣla ŋku me ɖe mi, be magaɖo to mi o.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Elabena ʋu ƒo asi na mi, eye vodada le míaƒe asibidewo ŋu, miaƒe nuyiwo daa alakpa, eye miaƒe aɖewo gblɔa nya tovo.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke meli, si biaa dzɔdzɔenyenye ta sena o, eye ame ɖeke medrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe o, woɖoa ŋu ɖe nu dzodzroa ŋu, eye wodaa alakpa, wofɔa hiãkame ƒe fu hetsɔa dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzina.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Woƒoa dakpui ƒe azi, eye wolɔ̃a yiyiɖɔ; amesi ɖua woƒe azi la, aku, eye ne wogbãe kple afɔ la, ƒli ado atso me.

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: Woƒe kawo mazu avɔ akpɔ o, eye womatsyɔ woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo o; woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nye dɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye ŋutasesẽ le woƒe asiwò me.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Woƒe afɔwo le du dzi ɖe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ŋu, eye wole abla ɖem, be wòakɔ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi. Woƒe susuwo nye susu vɔ̃ɖiwo, gbegblẽ kple tsɔtsrɔ̃ le wo toƒewo.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Womenyaa ŋutifafa mɔ la o, eye nu dzɔdzɔea ɖeke menɔa wo toƒe o, woglɔ̃a woƒe mɔ, eye amesi toa eɖzi la, menyaa ŋutifafaa ɖeke o.

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Eyata ɖoɖo la le adzɔge na mí, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye gbe mía gbɔ vava; míele mɔ kpɔm na kekeli, kpɔ ɖa, viviti li, míele mɔ kpɔm na xexeme ƒe kɔkɔ, ke míele zɔzɔm le blukɔ me.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Miele asi tsam le gli ŋu abe ŋkuagbãtɔwo ene, eye míele asi tsam abe ŋkunɔwo ene. Míekli nu le ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ abe le zã me ene, eye miele ame damiwo dome abe ame kukuwo ene!

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Mi katã miele gbe tem abe sisiblisiwo ene, eye miele xɔxlɔ̃m abe ahɔnewo ene; miele mɔ kpɔm na ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃, ke meva o, miele mɔ kpɔm na xɔname, ke etsi adzɔge na mi.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: Elabena míaƒe dzidadawo sɔ gbɔ le ŋkuwò me, eye míaƒe nuvɔwo le ɖase ɖim le mía ŋu. Elabena míedze si miaƒe dzidadawo, eye miaƒe vodadawo la, míenya wo.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Míeda vo, eye miegbe Yehowa, miede megbe tso mia Mawu la gbɔ, eye míeƒo ŋutasesẽ kple godzedze ƒe nu, míefa alakpanya ƒe tu, eye míedzii tso dzi me.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Ɖoɖo la gbugbɔ ɖe megbe, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye tsi adzɔge. Elabena nyateƒe le nu klim le kpɔdome, eye nuteƒewɔwɔ mate ŋu age ɖe eme o.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Ale nyateƒe bu ɖe ame, eye amesi ƒo asa na vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ la, wohae. Eye Yehowa kpɔ be, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔa ɖeke meli o, eye medze eŋu o. Ɖelaa ɖe ŋugbedodo.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Eye wòkpɔ be, amea ɖeke meli o, eye wòwɔ mo yaa nɛ be, avulélaa ɖeke meli o. Tete wotso eƒe alo xɔ na eɖokui, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye kpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
translation_verse: Edo dzɔdzɔenyenye abe ga wu ene, eye wòɖɔ xɔname ƒe gakuku ɖe la; eta hlɔ̃biabia abe ava ene, eye wòda ŋuʋaʋã ɖe abɔ abe taɖedzi ene.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Aɖo eteƒe ɖe nuwɔwɔwo nu: eƒe ketɔwo to enye dziku, teƒeɖoɖo enye eƒe futɔwo tɔ, eye wòaɖo ƒukpowo ƒe nuwɔwɔwo teƒe na wo.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Ɣetoɖoƒetɔwo avɔ̃ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, eye ɣedzeƒetɔwo avɔ̃ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe, elabena ele vava ge abe tɔsisi, si xaxa, eye Yehowa ƒe ahom lɔ ɖe nu la ene.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Anye ɖela ava na Zion, eye na amesiwo trɔ tso woƒe dzidadawo me le Yakob; Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nusi mebia kpli wò la, enye si: Nye gbɔgbɔ, si le dziwò, kple nye nya, si metsɔ de nuwo la, mate ɖa le nuwo me alo le viwòwo kple viwo wo ƒe viwo nu me o, tso fifia ɖaseɖe mava me, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Tso naklẽ, elabena wò kekeli gbɔna, eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe adze ɖe dziwò!

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Elabena viviti xɔ anyigba dzi, eye blukɔ tsyo dukɔwo, ke wò la, Yehowa adze ɖe dziwò, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ado ɖe dziwò.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Anyigba dzi dukɔwo azɔ le wò kekeli nu kple fiawo le wò keklẽ ƒe dzedze nu.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Fɔ kɔ dzi nakpɔ nu godoo va kpe, wo katã woƒo ta kpli gbɔna gbɔwò! Wo ŋutsuviwo atso didiƒe ava, eye woakpa wo nyɔnuviwo ɖe axada me.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Ekema akpɔe, eye àko atsemenu, wò dzi adzo kpo, eye wòavu eɖokui; elabena atsiaƒu me nu xɔasiwo do agbogbo ɖe dziwò, eye dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo va na wò.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Kposɔwo anyẽ atsyɔ wò bibibi kple kposɔviwo tso Midian kple Efa; wo katã woatso sika kple dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽedonu atso Seba vɛ, eye woaɖe gbe ƒã Yehowa ƒe kafukafu.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Kedar ƒe lãhawo katã aƒo ƒu ɖe ŋuwò, eye Nebayot ƒe agbowo asubɔ wò; woava nye vɔsamlekpui dzi, ne woadze ŋunye, eye mawɔ leke na nye atsyɔ̃xɔ la.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Amekawoe nye esiawo, siwo le ya ʋum abe alilikpo ene, eye abe ahɔnee yina ɖe eƒe xɔ gbɔ ene?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nyee ƒukpowo le mɔ kpɔm na, eye Tarsis-ƒukpowo ɖo ŋgɔ, be woakplɔ viwòwo tso didiƒe vɛ; wohe woƒe klosalo kple sika ɖe asi hena Yehowa, wò Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ, hena Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la, elabena eɖo atsyɔ̃ na wò.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Amedzroviwo aɖo wò gliwo, eye woƒe fiawo asubɔ wò; elabena le nye dɔmedzoe me meƒo wò, eye makpɔ nublanui na wò le nye amenuveve me.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Wo agbowo anɔ nuvo ɖaa, eye womado wo o zã Kple keli, ne woahe dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo ve na wò, eye woƒe fiawo nanɔ wo nu.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Dukɔ kple fiaɖuƒe, siwo be, yewomade ta tewò o la nu ayi, eye woatsrɔ̃ anyigba dzi dukɔ mawo gbidigbidi.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Woahe Libanon ƒe atsyɔ̃, sesewu, fɔfɔli kple kpomi siaa vɛ na wò, ne natsɔ aɖo atsyɔ̃ na nye kɔkɔeƒe ƒe nɔƒe, eye nade bubu nye afɔ nɔƒe ŋu.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo se ŋuta le ŋuwò la ƒe viwo ado dɔgɔ̃e ava gbɔwò, amesiwo katã ɖe alɔme le ŋuwò la, ade ta agu ɖe wò afɔ nu ahayɔ wò be: „Yehowa ƒe ɖu.“ „Israel ƒe kɔkɔetɔ ƒe Zion“.

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: Esi wogblɔ wò ɖi, wogbe wò nya, eye amea ɖeke meto ŋuwò yi o ta la, matsɔ wò awɔ atsyɔ̃e tegbee kple dzidzɔ na ƒomeawo katã.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Àno dukɔwo ƒe notsi, eye àno fiawo ƒe no, ne nadze sii be, nye Yehowa enye wò xɔnametɔ, Yakob ƒe ŋusẽtɔ enye wò ɖela.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Mahe sika vɛ ɖe akɔbli teƒe kple klosalo ɖe gayibɔ teƒe, akɔbli ɖe ati teƒe, eye gayibɔ ɖe kpewo teƒe, matso ŋutifafa aɖo tatɔe na wò kple dzɔdzɔenyenye aɖo wò dɔnunɔlae.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Womase ŋutasesẽ ŋkɔ le wò anyigba dzi azɔ o kple tsɔtsrɔ̃ kpakple gbegblẽ ŋkɔ le wò liƒowo dzi o, eye àyɔ wò gliwo be „xɔname“ kple wò agbowo be „kafukafu“. Mawu si nye kekeli na eƒe dukɔ la.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: Ɣe maganye kekeli na wò le ŋkeke me azɔ o, eye dzinu magaɖi na wò, be xexeme nakɔ o; ke boŋ Yehowa anye wò kekeli tegbee, eye wò Mawu anye wò atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Wò ɣe magaɖo to azɔ o, eye wò dzinu magaɖo xɔ o, elabena Yehowa lanye wò kekeli tegbee, eye wò nuxaɣi nu va yi.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Wò dukɔ anye ame dzɔdzɔewo sɔŋ, eye anyigba anye wo tɔ tegbee, nye atibɔmeti fẽ kple nye asinudɔwɔwɔ, si ade bubu ŋunye la, wonye.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Ame suewo azu akpe, eye ame ʋeewo azu dukɔ sesẽ. Nye Yehowa, nye asi matsɔ awɔe le ewɔɣi.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ le dzinye, elabena Yehowa si ami nam, be mahe du nyui la ayi na amesiwo wole ɖe anyi; eɖom ɖa, be mada gbe le amesiwo ƒe dzi gbã la ŋu, maɖe gbe ƒã ablɔɖe na gatɔwo, ne woaɖe ga amesiwo wode gãe;

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: maɖe gbe ƒã Yehowa ƒe amenuveƒe kple mía Mawu ƒe hlɔ̃biaŋkeke la, ne mafa akɔ na konyifalawo katã;

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: ne mata avɔ na Zion ƒe konyifalawo, mana atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo wo ɖe dzowɔ teƒe, dzidzɔmi ɖe konyifafa teƒe, atsyɔ̃vɔ ɖe gbɔgbɔ, si nu ti kɔ na teƒe, eye woayɔ wo be „dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe logotiwo“, „Yehowa ƒe atibɔ“, si wòbe, yeatsɔ ade bubu eɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Woatso blemaƒedowo, woafɔ gbaɖegbe glikpowo ɖe tsitrenu, eye woagbugbɔ du gbagbãwo kple tsãtɔwo ƒe glikpowo atso.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Du bubu me tɔwo atsi tre ɖi anyi miaƒe lãhawo, eye amedzro viwo anye miaƒe agbledelawo kple miaƒe weingbledelawo.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, woatsɔ ŋkɔ na mi be: „Yehowa ƒe nunɔlawo“, eye woayɔ mi be „mía Mawu ƒe subɔlawo“; miaɖu dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo, eye woƒe atsyɔ̃ atu mia nu.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Le woƒe ŋukpe eve ƒokpli kple woƒe vlododo, si nye woƒe gome ta la woaxɔ teƒeɖoɖo eve nu le woƒe anyigba dzi, eye woakpɔ dzidzɔ tegbee.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Elabena nye Yehowa melɔ̃a nya dzɔdzɔe, eye meléa tu nuhaha vɔ̃ɖi; matu woƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋu fe na wo pɛpɛpɛ, eye mabia mũ mava kpli wo.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Woanya wo viwo le dukɔwo dome kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo le anyigba dzi dukɔwo dome. Amesiwo katã kpɔ wo la, adze si wo be, ƒome, si Yehowa yra la wonye.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Mele dzidzɔ kpɔm ɖe Yehowa ŋu, nye luʋɔ le aseye tsom ɖe nye Mawu ŋu; elabena eta xɔname ƒe avɔ nam, eye wòdo dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe awu ʋlaya nam, abe alesi ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ blaa atsyɔ̃tae kple alesi ŋugbetɔ doa nui la ene.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi anyigba nana nuwo miena, eye abɔ nana nukuwo dzenae la, nenema Aƒetɔ Yehowa ana dzɔdzɔenyenye kple kafukafu namie le dukɔwo katã ŋku mee.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Nyemazi ɖoɖoe o le Zion ta, eye le Yerusalem ta nyemagbɔ ɖe eme o, vaseɖe esime eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye nado abe kekeli ene, eye eƒe xɔname nabi abe akakati ene.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo akpɔ wò dzɔdzɔenyenye, fiawo katã akpɔ wò ŋutikɔkɔe, eye woayɔ ŋkɔ yeye, si Yehowa ƒe nu agblɔ la, na wò.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Anye atsyɔ̃ fiakuku le Yehowa si me kple fiaƒe tablanu le wò Mawu si me.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Womagayɔ wò azɔ be: „amesi wogbe“ o, eye womagayɔ wò anyigba be: „aƒedo“ o; ke boŋ woayɔ wò be: „mekpɔ dzidzɔ le eŋu“, eye woayɔ wò anyigba be „srɔ̃nyɔnu“; elabena Yehowa akpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋuwò, eye wòaɖe wò anyigba woazu srɔ̃a.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Alesi ɖekakpui ɖea ɖetugbii la, nenema dziwòviwo aɖe wòe; alesi ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ kpɔa dzidzɔ le ŋugbetɔ ŋui la, nenema wò Mawu akpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋuwòe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Yerusalem, meɖo dzɔlawo wò gliwo dzi, amesiwo mazi ɖoɖoe ŋkeke blibo kple zã blibo o. Mi amesiwo ɖoa ŋku nu dzi na Yehowa, migagbɔ ɖe eme o!

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: Miɖee toe, vaseɖe esime wòaɖo Yerusalem te, eye wòatsɔe awɔ kafukafu le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Yehowa ta eƒe nuɖusi kple eƒe alɔ sesẽ. Nyemagatsɔ wò bli na wò futɔwo woaɖu azɔ o, eye du bubu me tɔwo magano wò wein, si ŋu neku kutri ɖo la, azɔ o,

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: ke boŋ amesiwo xa nuku la, woawoe aɖui, eye woakafu Yehowa, eye amesiwo; xa nu la, woawoe anoe le nye xɔxɔnu kɔkɔewo.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Mito agboawo me yi, mito wo me yi! Midzra mɔ dzi ɖo na dukɔ la; mido mɔ, miɖo mɔ, miɖe kpewo ɖa, mikɔ aflaga dzi na dukɔwo!

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa na wosee le anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke: Migblɔ na Zion-nyɔnuvi be: Kpɔ ɖa, wò xɔname gbɔna, kpɔ ɖa, eƒe fetu kpe ɖe eŋu, eye eƒe dɔ dze eŋgɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Woayɔ wo be: „dukɔ kɔkɔe“, „Yehowa ƒe amesiwo woɖe“, ke wò la, woayɔ wò be „du, si ƒe nya wodina“, „du, si womagblẽ ɖi o.“

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Amekae nye esi tso Edom gbɔna, eye wole awu dziwo me tso Bozra, amesi tsɔ eƒe awuwo ɖo atsyɔ̃e, eye wòle yiyim le eƒe ŋusẽ geɖe la me? Nyee nye amesi ƒoa nu ɖe eteƒe, eye xɔname bɔ ɖe asinye.

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
