translation_verse: Nukaŋuti wò awuwo biã, eye wò avɔwo le abe weinfiãla tɔ ene?

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: Nye ɖeɖee fanya wein kple afɔ, eye dukɔwo dometɔa ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o. Ale menyã avuzi le wo dzi le nye dɔmedzoe me, eye mefanya wo le nye dziku me, eye woƒe ʋu hlẽ ɖe nye awuwo ŋu, eye nye avɔwo katã me gblẽ.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Elabena meɖo nye hlɔ̃biagbe ɖe ta me, eye nye xɔname ƒe ƒe la ɖo?

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Eye metsa ŋku, ke amea ɖeke mexɔ nam o, eye nye mo wɔ yaa be, xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli o; tete nye abɔ xɔ nam, eye nye dziku kpe ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Mefanya dukɔwo le nye dɔmedzoe me, meto wo nyanyanya le nye dziku me, eye mena woƒe ʋu ɖuɖu de anyigba.

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Makafu Yehowa ƒe amenuveve kple Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔxɔxɔ le nusiwo katã Yehowa wɔ na mí la nu kpakple eƒe dɔmenyo gbogbo, siwo wòwɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe la le eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple eƒe amenuveve geɖe la nu.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: Vavã, nye dukɔ wonye, vi, siwo madaa alakpa o la wonye, eye wòzu xɔnametɔ na wo.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Esi woxaxa woɖo hã la, hiãa ɖeke menɔ anyi o, elabena dɔla, si me woɖea eɖokui fiana lena la, xɔ na wo; eɖe wo le eƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple eƒe tufafa ta, eye wòkɔ wo hetsɔ wo le blema ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Ke woawo dze aglã ɖe eŋu, eye wodo dziku na eƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la, tete wòtrɔ zu futɔ na wo, eye eya ŋutɔ wɔ avu kpli wo.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Tete eƒe dukɔ la ɖo ŋku Mose dzi le blema ŋkekewo me be: Afika amesi kplɔ wo tso atsiaƒu hekpe ɖe eƒe lãha ƒe kplɔla ŋu la le? Afika amesi na eƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe nɔ wo dome la le?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Amesi na eƒe atsyɔ̃dabɔ to Mose ƒe nuɖusi dzi, eye wòmã tsi la me ɖe eve le wo ŋgɔ, be wòaɖe ŋkɔ mava eɖokui ŋu?

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: Eya amesi na wòto tɔ gɔme womekli nu o, abe alesi sɔa toa gbegbee ene?

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ kplɔ wo yi gbɔɖemeƒe, abe alesi lã yia bali me ene. Ale nèkplɔ wò dukɔ la, be nade ŋkɔ gã ɖokuiwò ŋu. Gbedodoɖa hena ɖeɖe.

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Do ŋku ɖa tso dziƒo, eye nakpɔ nu tso wò nɔƒe kɔkɔe nyo la me! Afika wò ŋuʋaʋã kple wò nutsuwɔwɔwo le? Wò dɔmetɔtrɔ kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ de megbe le ŋunye.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Wòe nye mía fofo, elabena Abraham menya mí o, eye Israel medze si mí o. Wò Yehowa enye mía fofo, eye ŋkɔwòe nye „mía ɖela“ tso gbaɖegbe ke.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nukaŋuti nena míele tatram tso wò mowo dzi, eye nèse miaƒe ta me, be mievɔ̃ wò o? Gatrɔ va le wò dɔla kple wò domenyinyi ƒe toawo ta!

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi ʋeea ɖe ko wò to kɔkɔe la nɔ si me, tete miaƒe futɔwo nyã avuzi le wò kɔkɔeƒe la dzi.

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: esime ne wo nu dziŋɔ, siwo míekpɔ mo na o, èɖi ɖe anyi, eye towo dzo kpekpekpe le ŋkuwò me!

english_verse: You are the only God ever seen or heard of who works miracles for his followers.
translation_verse: Edo go amesi wòa nu dzɔdzɔe kple dzidzɔ, kpakple amesiwo ɖoa ŋku dziwò le wò mɔwo dzi. Kpɔ ɖa, eɖo dɔmedzoe, eye míezu nuvɔ̃wɔlawo; miele eme eteƒe didi, ɖe woagaɖe mía?

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Mí katã miele abe ame makɔmakɔwo ene, eye miaƒe dzɔdzɔenyenyewo katã le abe avɔ, si ƒo ʋu ene; mí katã míeyrɔ abe aŋgba ene, eye míaƒe vodadawo lɔ mí ɖe nu abe ya ene.

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke meli, si yɔa wò ŋkɔ, eye wòtsona be, yeaku ɖe ŋuwò o; elabena èɣla wò ŋku me ɖe mí, eye nèna nu ti kɔ na mí ɖe miaƒe vodadawo me.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yehowa, mía fofo nènye: mía wo la, tsu míenye, eye wòe nye mía mèla, wò asinudɔwɔwɔ mí katã míenye.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Yehowa, megado dɔmedzoe akpa o, eye megaɖo ŋu vodada ɖaa o! Kpɔ ɖa, trɔ kɔ ɖe afi, wò dukɔ mí katã míenye!

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Wò du kɔkɔewo zu gbegbe, Zion zu gbegbe, eye Yerusalem tsi anyi aƒeɖoe.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dzo fiã míaƒe aƒe kɔkɔe nyo, si me mia fofowo kafu wò le, eye míaƒe nu veviwo katã gblẽ.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖe àlé ɖokuiwò le nusiawo katã me, àzi kpi, eye nate mí ɖe anyi woatso mea?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: Mele nyanya na amesiwo wu media nye mɔ o, eye mele kpɔkpɔ na amesiwo mediam o; megblɔ na dukɔ, si meyɔa nye ŋkɔ o la be: Nyee nye esi, nyee nye esi!

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Meke nye abɔ me ŋkeke blibo la ɖo ɖe dukɔ sẽto, si le mɔ baɖa dzi hedze eya ŋutɔ ƒe susuwo yome la.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Amesiwo le dziku dom nam le ŋkunye me ɖaa, wosaa vɔ le abɔwo me, eye wodoa dzudzɔ le anyikpewo dzi

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: amesiwo bɔbɔ nɔa yɔdowo me eye wotsia teƒe ɣaɣlɛwo dɔna, amesiwo ɖua halã, eye detsi nyɔ ŋu le woƒe ku lu wo me;

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm be: Nɔ adzɔge, megaka asi ŋunye o, mava wɔ wò kɔkɔe la, amesiawoe nye dzudzɔ le nye ŋɔti me kple dzo, si abi nu ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meŋlɔe ɖi ɖe ŋkunye me, nyemazi kpi o, negbe ɖeko maɖo eteƒe hafi, maɖo eteƒe ɖe woƒe akɔ me;

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Madzidze miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖe akɔ me na mi gbã, miaƒe vodadawo kple mia fofowo ƒe vodadawo siaa, amesiwo do dzudzɔ le towo dzi, eye woɖe alɔme le ŋunye le togbɛwo dzi.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Alesi ne wokpɔ tsi le weintsetse me wogblɔna be: Migagblẽe o, elabena yayra le eme la, nenemae mawɔ, eye nyemagblẽ wo katã o, le nye dɔlawo ta;

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: eye mana ƒome nado tso Yakob me, eye nye towo ƒe domenyila natso Yuda me; nye ame tiatiawo anyi edome, eye nye dɔlawo anɔ afima.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Saron azu alẽwo ƒe gbeɖuƒe, eye Axorbalime la azu nyiwo ƒe akɔtsyɔƒe hena nye dukɔ, si biaa tanye sena la. Tohehe na dukɔ dzeanyi la.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: Ke miawo, esi miegblẽ Yehowa ɖi, eye mieŋlɔ nye to kɔkɔe la be, mieɖo kplɔ̃ na aklama, eye mieku aha tre banaa na dzɔgbe la,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: eyata maɖo yi ɖa ɖe mia ŋu, eye mi katã miado dɔgɔ̃e woawu, elabena meyɔ mi, mieta o, meƒo nu, miesee o, miewɔ nusi nye vɔ̃ le ŋkunye me, eye mietia nusi medze ŋunye o la.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo aɖu nu, ke miawo la, dɔ awu mi; kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo ano nu, ke miawo la, tsikɔ awu mi; kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo akpɔ dzidzɔ, ke miawo la, ŋu akpe mi.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo atso aseye le dzi ƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ta, ke miawo la, miado ɣli le dzi ƒe vevesese ta, eye miafa avi le gbɔgbɔ ƒe teteɖeanyi ta.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Eye miagblẽ miaƒe ŋkɔ ɖi na nye ame tiatiawo woatsɔ ado ɖiŋui be: „Alea Yehowa nawu wòe!“ Ke ayɔ ŋkɔ yeye na eƒe dɔlawo ya,

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: ale be amesi ayra eɖokui le anyigba dzi la, atsɔ Mawu nyateƒetɔ la ayra eɖokui, eye amesi ata nu le anyigba dzi la, ata Mawu nyateƒetɔ la, elabena ŋku dzo le gbaɖegbe xaxawo dzi, elabena woɣla ɖe nye ŋkuwò. Dziƒo kple anyigba yeye.

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Elabena kpo ɖa, mawo dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye, eye womagaɖo ŋku tsãtɔwo dzi, alo woava ame ƒe ta me o;

english_verse: Celebrate and be glad forever! I am creating a Jerusalem, full of happy people.
translation_verse: ke boŋ miakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye miatso aseye ɖaa le nusi mawo la ŋuti, elabena kpo ɖa, mawo Yerusalem hena aseyetsotso, eye eƒe dukɔ la hena dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Matso aseye ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eye makpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe nye dukɔ ŋu, eye womagase avifagbe kple konyifagbe le eme azɔ o.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Ɖevi, si xa ŋkeke ʋee alo amegã ɖeɖi, si ƒe ŋkekewo mede keŋ o la, magano afima o; elabena amesi xɔ ƒe alafa hafi ku la, ɖevie, eye nuvɔ̃wɔla, si xa ƒe alafa la, fiƒode ava edzi.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Woatu xɔ anɔ eme, eye woaɖe weingble aɖu eme kutsetse.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Womãtu xɔ ame bubu nanɔ eme o, eye womaƒã nu ame bubu naɖu o; elabena nye dukɔ atsi, abe alesi ati tsinae ene, eye nye ame tiatiawo aɖu woawo ŋutɔ ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Womadze agbagba dzodzro o, eye womadzi dzikudziku o; elabena Yehowa ƒe ame yayrawo ƒe ƒome wonye, eye wo viwo le wo ŋu.

english_verse: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
translation_verse: Eye woava me be, matɔ, hafi woava yɔm, eye ne wogale nuƒoƒo dzi la, masee.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Amegãxi kple alẽvi woaɖu gbe le wo nɔewo gbɔ, dzata aɖu gbe abe nyi ene, eye da ƒe nuɖuɖu anye kewɔ. Womawɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke o, eye womahe gbegblẽ ava nye to kɔkɔe blibo la dzi o, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Dziƒo enye nye fiazikpui, eye anyigba enye nye afɔɖodzinu. Xɔ ka ƒomevie miehe, yewoatu nam, eye teƒe ka anye nye gbɔɖemeƒe?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nye asie wɔ nusiawo katã, ale be nusiawo katã li. Ke melé ŋku ɖe amesiwo ŋu: ɖe hiãtɔwo kple amesiwo ƒe gbɔgbɔ wote ɖe anyi, eye wovɔ̃a nye nyawo la ŋu.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: Amesi wu nyitsu la, sɔ kple amesi wu ame, amesi tsɔ alẽvi sa vɔe la, sɔ kple amesi tro kɔ le avũ nu, amesi sa nuɖuvɔ la, sɔ kple amesi tsɔ haʋu sa vɔe, amesi do dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe la, sɔ kple amesi kafua trɔwo. Alesi amesiawo ɖaa woawo ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ, eye woƒe luʋɔ kpɔa dzidzɔ le woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo ŋu la,

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: nenema nye hã makpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋutasesẽ le wo ŋu ŋuti, eye mahe nusi dzia ŋɔ na wo la, ava wo dzi, elabena meyɔ ame, ke amea ɖeke metɔ o, meƒo nu, ke womesee o, wowɔ nusi nye vɔ̃ le ŋkunye me, eye wotia nusi medze ŋunye o. Yerusalem yeye ƒe xɔxɔ kple alesi wòakaka ɖe trɔ̃subɔlawo katã dome.

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo vɔ̃a Yehowa ƒe nya la, mise eƒe nya la! Mia nɔvi, siwo lé fu mi, eye wonyã mi ɖa le nye ŋkɔ ta hele gbɔgblɔm be: „Yehowa nede bubu eɖokui ŋu, ne míakpɔ miaƒe dzidzɔ“ la, ŋukpe alé wo.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Howɔwɔ ƒe ɖiɖi tso dua me, gbe tso gbedoxɔ me, Yehowa, amesi aɖo eteƒe na eƒe futɔwo la ƒe gbe ye!

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: Woadzi vi, hafi woava lé ku, woadzi ŋutsuvi, hafi fu nava ɖu wo.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Ameka se esia tɔgbe kpɔ, eye ameka kpɔ esia tɔgbe kpɔ? Ɖe anyigbae ɖe adzɔ gbe ɖeka, eye ɖe woadzi dukɔa ɖe zi ɖeka? Hafi Zion ya lé ku, eye wodzi viawo zi ɖeka.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nye amesi ʋua vidzidɔ nu, ɖe mana be, womadzi vi oa? Wò Mawu be: Nye amesi na wodzia vi, ɖe maxe mɔa?“

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ dzidzɔ kple Yerusalem, eye mitso aseye ɖe eŋu, mi amesiwo katã lɔ̃a eƒe nya! Mitso aseye kplii le dzidzɔ me, mi amesiwo katã xaa nu le eŋu!

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Ne miano eƒe akɔfafa ƒe no, woadi kɔ na mi, eye míakplɔ eƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo ƒe nu gbogboawo hlohlohlo, miaƒe; dzi nagbɔ ɖe eme.

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matrɔ ŋutifafa ɖe eŋu abe tɔsisi ene kple dukɔwo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖe eŋu abe tɔʋu, si gba go ene, be miano no, woatsɔ mi ɖe axada me, eye woalé mi ɖe akɔ dzaa.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Alesi ŋutsua ɖe dada fa akɔ ne la, nenema mafa akɔ na mii, eye miaƒe akɔ afa le Yerusalem ŋu.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Miakpɔe, miaƒe dzi akpɔ dzidzɔ, eye miaƒe ƒuwo amie abe gbe ene, Yehowa ƒe asi aɖe eɖokui afia ɖe eƒe dɔlawo ŋu, eye wòado dziku ɖe eƒe futɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa gbɔna le dzo me, eye eƒe tasiaɖamwo le abe ahom ene, ne woaɖo eteƒe le eƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe dziku me, eye wòablu le dzoƒaɖe me.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Elabena dzo kple yi Yehowa atsɔ adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ŋutilãwo katãe, eye Yehowa ƒe ame wuwuwo asɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: Yehowa be. Amesiwo wɔa wo ɖokui kɔkɔe, eye wokɔa wo ɖokui ŋu hena trɔ̃kpɔwo, eye wokplɔa ame ɖeka ɖo le dome, amesiwo ɖua halã, nu nyɔŋuwo kple afiwo la, wo katã nu ayi.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: Ke nye la, menya woƒe nuwɔwɔwo kple tameɖoɖowo. Azã su, be woaƒo dukɔwo katã kple aɖe wo nu ƒu, eye woava akpɔ nye ŋutikɔkɔe la.

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: Mawɔ dzesi ɖe wo ŋu, eye maɖo ame sisiwo ɖa tso wo dome ɖe dukɔwo, ɖe Tarsis, Pul kple Lud, amesiwo nye aŋutrɔdalawo, ɖe Tubal kple Yawan kpakple ɖe didiƒe ƒukpowo, amesiwo mese ŋkɔnye o, eye womekpɔ nye ŋutikɔkɔe o la gbɔ, eye woaɖe gbe ƒã nye ŋutikɔkɔe le dukɔwo dome;

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: ne woakplɔ mia nɔviwo katã tso dukɔwo katã dome aɖo sɔwo dzi kple tasiaɖam kple apakawo me kple tedzisɔwo kple kposɔwo dzi abe nuɖuvɔsa ene na Yehowa ahava Yerusalem le nye to kɔkɔe la dzi, abe alesi Israel-viwo tsɔa nuɖuvɔsa dea nu dzadzɛwo me vaa Yehowa ƒe mee ene, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Matsɔ wo dometɔa ɖewo hã awɔ nunɔlawo kple Lewi-viwoe!

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Alesi dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye, si wɔ ge mala la, anɔ anyi le ŋkunye mee la, nenema ke miaƒe ƒome kple miaƒe ŋkɔ anɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eye woava me, ne dzinu yeye sia dzinu yeye kple dzudzɔgbe sia dzudzɔgbe ɖo la, ŋutilãwo katã ava ado gbe ɖa le ŋkunye me, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Eye woaɖo ayi, be woakpɔ amesiwo dze go ɖem la ƒe kukuwo; elabena woƒe nyẽwo maku o, woƒe dzo ma tsi o, eye woanye ŋunyɔ na ŋutilãwo katã.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: eya gbɔ Yehowa ƒe gbe va le Yuda-fia Yosiya, Amon vi ŋɔli le eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒe wuietɔ̃lia me;

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: Hafi mava mè wò ɖe ɖɔ me la, menya wò, mekɔ ŋuwò, hafi nèdo tso dɔ me, eye metsɔ wò ɖo nyagblɔɖilae na dukɔwo.

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ bena: Oo, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, kpɔ ɖa, nyemate ŋu aƒo nu o, elabena nyemetsi o.

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Meganɔ gbɔgblɔm be, yemetsi o, ke boŋ afisiafi, si maɖo wò ɖo la, nayi, eye gbe, siwo katã made asiwò la, nagblɔe.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Megavɔ̃ wo o, elabena meli kpli wò, be maɖe wò, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa do eƒe asi ɖa hetɔ nu nam, eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ nye nyawo le nuwo ɖem.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ wò ɖo dukɔwo kple fiaɖuƒewo nu, nalã nu, eye nagbã nu, natsrɔ̃ nu, eye nagblẽ nu, natso aƒe, eye naƒã nu!

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va gbɔnye bena Yeremya, nuka kpɔm nèle? Meɖo ŋu bena: Aɖatsigoti kpɔm mele

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Ekpɔe ɖe eteƒe; elabena manɔ ŋute ɖe nye nya ŋu, ne mawɔe ade goe.

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va gbɔnye zi evelia bena: Nuka kpɔm nele? Meɖo ŋu bena: Mele ze, si le fiefiẽm la kpɔm, wòtrɔ ŋgɔ dze anyiehe.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e atso anyiehe gome aƒo ɖe anyigba la dzinɔlawo katã dzi.

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, mayɔ fiaɖuƒewo ƒe ƒomeawo katã tso anyiehe, ne wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe nava ali zikpui anyi ɖe Yerusalem-gbowo nu, ɖe eƒe gliwo katã ŋu kple ɖe Yuda-duwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu kpli wo le woƒe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔwo katã ta, le esi wogblẽna ɖi eye wodo dzudzɔ na mawu tutɔwo, eye wode ta agu na woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo ŋuti.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, bia ali dzi, eye tso naɖagblɔ nya, siwo katã made asiwò la, na wo. Womegadzi ŋɔ na wo o, ne màgana ŋɔ nadzi wò le wo ŋku me o.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nyea matsɔ wò awɔ ɖu sesẽ, gasɔti kple akɔbligli egbea ɖe anyigba blibo la nu, ɖe Yuda-fiawo, eƒe amegãwo, eƒe nunɔlawo kple dukɔ hahoo la ŋuti.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Woawɔ avu kpli wò, ke woaɖo kpoe, elabena meli kpli wò, be maɖe wò, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va gbɔnye bena:

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: Yi ɖaɖe gbe ƒã ɖe Yerusalem ƒe to me bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Meɖo ŋu wò ɖetugbime dɔmenyo kple wò ŋugbetɔnyenye ƒe lɔlɔ̃ na wò, esime nekplɔm ɖo to gbedadaƒo, to anyigba, si dzi womeƒãa nu ɖo o.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Israel le kɔkɔe na Yehowa, eƒe agblemenu gbãtɔwo wonye; amesiwo katã ɖui la, kpɔe ɖe enu; dzɔgbevɔ̃e va wo dzi!

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Nu manyo ka mia fofowo kpɔ le ŋunye, be wode megbe le ŋunye, eye wodze ya nuwo yome hezu tofloko?

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Eye womegblɔ be: Afika Yehowa, amesi kplɔ mí tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la le hã o; eya amesi kplɔ mí to gbe dzi, to kuɖiɖinyigba kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi ƒe anyigba dzi, to anyigba, si dzi amea ɖeke metona o, afisi amegbetɔa ɖeke mele o la dzi.

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Eye mekplɔ mi va anyigba wɔnu dzi, be miaɖu eƒe kutsetsewo kple eƒe nu nyuiwo; ke miawo mieva hedo gu nye anyigba la, eye mietsɔ nye domenyinu la wɔ ŋunyɔnui.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo megblɔ be. Afika Yehowa le hã o. Amesiwo si me se la le la, menyam o, eye lãkplɔviwo dze aglã ɖe ŋunye, nyagblɔɖilawo gblɔ nya ɖi le Baal ƒe ŋkɔ me, eye wodze nusiwo mele ɖeke me o la yome.

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Eyata magawɔ dzre kpli mi, eye mawɔ dzre kple mia viwo ƒe viwo.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: Miyi Kititɔwo ƒe ƒukpowo dzi, eye mikpɔ nu; miɖo ame ɖe Kedar, eye mido ŋku anyi nyuie, ne miakpɔ be, esia tɔgbe dzɔ kpɔ mahã?

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Ɖe dukɔa ɖe ɖɔ ti eƒe mawuwoa? Evɔ wònye menye Mawu wonye o hafi. Ke nye dukɔ ya tsɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖɔ li nusi mele ɖeke me o lae.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Elabena nye dukɔ wɔ vɔ̃ ƒomevi eve: wogblẽ nye, amesi nye tsi gbagbe vudo la ɖi, be woaɖe tsido na woawo ŋutɔ ɖokui, tsido, siwo gɔme ŋɔ, tsi mate ŋu anɔ wo me o.

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: Kluvie nye Israel loo alo aƒeviea? Nukaŋuti wòtrɔ zu aboyome?

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Dzatawo xlɔ̃ ɖe eŋu, eye woɖe gbe; wowɔ eƒe anyigba wòzu gbegbe, wogbã eƒe du wòzu aƒedo.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Nof-viwo kple Taxpanes-viwo hã woaɖu gbe le wò dzodome.

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Ɖe esia medza de dziwò, le esi nègblẽ Yehowa, wò Mawu ɖi le ɣeyiɣi, si me wònye kplɔwòla le mɔta la ŋuti oa?

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wò vɔɖinyenye aka mo na wo, eye wò godzedze ahe to na wò, ne nadze sii, eye nakpɔ, alesi wòvɔ̃ɖii, eye wòvenae be, nègblẽ Yehowa, wò Mawu la ɖi, eye vɔvɔ̃a ɖeke mele ŋunye na wò o, Aƒetɔ Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Elabena tso gbaɖegbe ke nèŋe wò kɔkuti, eye nètso wò kawo gblɔ bena, yemasubɔ o. Elabena ènye ahasitɔ mlɔ togbɛ kɔkɔwo katã dzi kple ati damawo katã gɔme.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Weinka nyuitɔ tso ka vavãtɔwo dome nenye metsɔ do, ke aleke wɔ nètrɔ zu nuka ƒe abɔwo nam?

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Ne èle aɖitsi lem, eye nèle adzalẽ geɖe ŋu dɔ wɔm hã, wò vodadawo nye ɖiƒoƒo le ŋkunye me

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: Aleke nagblɔ be, yemegblẽ ye ɖokui ŋu o, yemedze Baal yome o? Lé ŋku ɖe wò azɔlime ŋu le bali la me, eye nadze si nusi nèwɔ la, kposɔnɔ ɖidu, si le tsa glãla tsam le eƒe mɔ dzi la, nènye.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ wò afɔ dzi, be magatsi ƒeƒle o, kple wò ve me dzi, be tsikɔ magawui o! Ke wò la, ele gbɔgblɔm be: Dzodzroe, kpao! Elabena melɔ̃ amedzrowo, eye woawo yome madze.

english_verse: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
translation_verse: Alesi ne asi lu fiafi ŋu kpenɛ la, nenema ŋu akpe Israel ƒe aƒe la hekpe ɖe woƒe fiawo, amegãwo, nunɔlawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo ŋu,

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm na ati be: Wòe nye mía fofo, eye na kpe be: Wòe dzi mí. Elabena wòtrɔ ʋume dem, eye menye ŋku me o; ke wole gbɔgblɔm le woƒe hiãɣi be: Tso naɖe mí!

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Ke afika wò mawu, siwo nèwɔna ɖokuiwò la le? Woawo nètso kpɔ, be woate ŋu aɖe wò le wò hiãɣi la hã? Yuda, elabena alesi wò duwo sɔ gbɔe la, nenema wò mawuwo sɔ gbɔe!

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nukaŋuti miele dzre wɔm kplim? Mi katã mieto vo ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Yakatsyɔ meƒo mia viwo, wodo toku tohehe la. Miaƒe yi ɖu miaƒe nyagblɔɖilawo abe dzata vuvunu ene.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: Oo, dzidzime ka miehenye! Milé ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe nya ŋu. Gbegbe menye na Israel loo, alo anyigba doblukɔ tsiɖitsiɖia? Nukaŋuti nye dukɔ le gbɔgblɔm be: Miele tsa glãla tsam, eye míagava gbɔwò o?

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Ɖe ɖetugbi aŋlɔ eƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo be, eye ŋugbetɔ aŋlɔ eƒe alidziblanu bea? Ke nye dukɔ ŋlɔm be, ŋkekeawo mele xexlẽ me o.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Aleke nèle ami ɖem ɖe wò zɔzɔme ŋu, be nati ahasiwɔwɔ yome? Eyata wò zɔzɔme ma wò ɖe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ŋu.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Ame maɖifɔ dahewo ƒe ʋu hã le wò avɔ toga. Menye fifiƒe mekpɔ wò le o, ke boŋ le teƒe siawo katã.

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: Ke wò la egblɔ be, yemeɖi tɔ o, eƒe dɔmedzoe fa ɖe ye ŋu vava! Kpɔ ɖa, mía kpli wò miaɖi ʋɔnu, le esi negblɔ be, yemewɔ nuvɔ̃ o la ta.

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèwɔ kaba, be natrɔ wò azɔlime? Ŋu akpe wò ɖe Egipte hã ŋu, abe alesi ŋu kpe wò ɖe Asur ŋui ene.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Adzo tso alima, eye nakpla asi ta. Elabena Yehowa gbe amesiwo ŋu nele dzi ɖom ɖo la, eye madze edzi na mia kpli wo o.

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Ne ŋutsua ɖe gbe srɔ̃a, eye wòyi ɖaɖe ŋutsu bubu la, ɖe wòagagbugbɔ ayi nyɔnu la gbɔa? Ɖe magblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba ma oa? Yehowa be: Ke wò la èwɔ amatre kple ahasitɔwo tso, hafi nèbe, yeatrɔ ɖe ŋunyea?

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: Fɔ kɔ dzi ɖe to ƒeƒlewo ŋu, eye nakpɔ nu! Afikae womehede asi ŋuwò le o? Ede xa ɖe mɔ to na wo abe Arabiatɔwo le gbe dzi ene, eye nètsɔ wò ahasiwɔwɔ kple vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ do gu anyigba la.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Woklo tsidzadza, eye keletsi hã medza o. Ke wò la, gbolo ƒe mo li na wò, eye ŋu gbe wò kpekpe.

english_verse: You call me your father or your long-lost friend;
translation_verse: Azɔ ɖe mède asim yɔyɔ me be, ye fofo kple yeƒe ɖekakpuime xɔlɔ̃e menye oa?

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: De wòado dziku ɖaa, eye wòalé ame ɖe dɔ me tegbeea? Kpɔ ɖa, alea nègblɔ, ke medo kpo vɔ̃wɔwɔ o.

english_verse: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam le fia Yosiya ŋɔli bena: Ekpɔ nusi Israel dzeaglã la wɔa? Eyi to kɔkɔwo katã dzi kple ati damawo gɔme, eye wòwɔ ahasi le afima.

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ be, megbe Israel dzeaglã la le eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ta, eye mena srɔgbegbalẽe hã la, nɔvianyɔnu Yuda dzego la mevɔ̃ o, ke boŋ eya hã yi ɖawɔ ahasi.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me be, wotsɔ woƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe howɔwɔ gblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba la, eye wowɔ ahasi kple kpe kpakple ati.

english_verse: Even the people of Israel were honest enough not to pretend.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Israel dzeaglã la tɔ dzɔ wu Yuda dzego la tɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Yi naɖaɖe gbe ƒã nya siawo do ɖe anyiehe gome bena: Israel dzeaglã, ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gatrɔ, nyemaɖo adã ɖe mia ŋu o, elabena amelɔ̃la menye, eye nyemalè nya ɖe dɔ me tegbee o, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Mi vi dzeaglãwo, migatrɔ va, elabena nyee nye mia srɔ̃, eye maɖe ame ɖeka tso du me kple ame eve tso ƒome me ahakplɔ mi ava Zion;

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: eye mana kplɔlawo mi ɖe nye dzi nu, ne woatsɔ nunya kple gɔmesese akplɔ mi.

english_verse: You will increase in numbers, and there will be no need to remember the sacred chest or to make a new one.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ava me be, ne miekeke ta, eye miedzi ɖe amũ gbã dzi le ŋkeke mawo me la, womagagblɔ azɔ be: „Yehowa ƒe nubablaɖaka“ o, magava ame ƒe ta me o, eye womagaɖo ŋui o, womagabia eta ase o, eye womagakpɔe o.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la woayɔ Yerusalem be: „Yehowa ƒe fiazikpui“, eye dukɔwo katã aƒo takpli ɖe afima te Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, si le Yerusalem la ta, eye womagazɔ le woƒe dzi vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe tamesesẽ nu o.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la Yuda ƒe aƒe ayi Israel ƒe aƒe gbã, eye woaƒo takpli tso anyiehe-nyigba dzi ayi anyigba, si metsɔ na mia fofowo, ne wòanye domenyinu la dzi.

english_verse: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
translation_verse: Megblɔ be: Matso wò aɖo viŋutsu teƒe, eye mana anyigba nyo la wò, si nye domenyinu vevietɔ le dukɔwo dome! Mehe. Yɔm be ye fofo, eye megatrɔ le yonyeme o.

english_verse: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, Yehowa be: Alesi nyɔnu dzea go tsoa srɔ̃a gbɔ la, nenema miedze go tso gbɔnyee!

english_verse: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.
translation_verse: Wose ɣli le to ƒeƒle wo ta me, Israel-viwo ƒe avifafa kple kokoƒoƒo, elabena woto mɔ gɔglɔ̃ dzi, eye woŋlɔ Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la be.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Mi vi dzeaglãwo, migatrɔ va, eye mahaya mi tso miaƒe tatrawo me! Kpɔ ɖa, míeva gbɔwò, elabena wòenye Yehowa, mía Mawu!

english_verse: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.
translation_verse: Vava, alakpae nye togbɛwo kple howɔwɔ le towo dzi; vava, Israel ƒe xɔname le Yehowa, mía Mawu la gbɔ.

english_verse: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Ŋukpenamawuwo ɖu mía fofowo ƒe kesinɔnuwo tso míaƒe ɖevime ke: woƒe alẽwo kple nyiwo, woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple nyonuviwo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Israel, Yehowa be: Ne èbe, yeatrɔ la, ekema trɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye ne èɖe wò ŋunyɔnuwo ɖa le ŋkunye me la, ekema màgatsa tsa glãla o!

english_verse: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.
translation_verse: Eye ne èta Yehowa ƒe agbe le nyateƒe kple dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye ɖe eteƒe la, ekema dukɔwo atso wò ayra wo ɖokui, eye woatso wò aƒo adegbee!

english_verse: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ na Yuda-ŋutsuwo kple Yerusalem enye si: Mide agble yeye, eye migaƒã nu ɖe aŋɔkawo me o.

english_verse: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *
translation_verse: Mi Yuda-ŋutsuwo kple Yerusalem-tɔwo, mina woatso aʋa na mi na Yehowa, eye miɖe miaƒe dzi ƒe boloyiwo ɖa, ne nye dziku magalé dzo ge abe dzo ene, ahabi le miaƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiawo ta, eye amea ɖeke mate ŋu atsii o. Nyagblɔɖi le Yuda-nyigba gbegblẽ ŋuti.

english_verse: Head for Jerusalem or another walled town!’ “Jeremiah, tell them I'm sending disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Mikɔ aflaga dzi do ɖe Zion! Misi, migatɔ o! Elabena mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple tsɔtsrɔ gã tso anyiehe vɛ.

english_verse: An army will come out, like a lion from its den. It will destroy nations and leave your towns empty and in ruins.”
translation_verse: Dzata do tso avegoe me, dukɔwo gblẽla tso, eye woho tso enɔƒe, be woatso wò anyigba awɔ gbegbee, eye wòagblẽ wò duwo woazu aƒedo.

english_verse: Then I told the people of Israel, “Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, ‘The Lord is still angry with us.’ ”
translation_verse: Le esia ta mita akpanya, mifa konyi, eye mifa avi, elabena Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe heliheli la nu mefa ɖe mía ŋu o.

english_verse: The Lord said, “When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.”
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ava me le ɣemaɣi be, dzi aɖe le fia kple amegãwo ƒo, nunɔlawo alulu, eye nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe mo awɔ yaa.

english_verse: I said, “You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats?” The Coming Disaster
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: Alele, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, vavãe nèflu dukɔ sia kple Yerusalem, esime negblɔ be: „Míakpɔ ŋutifafa“, evɔ wònye yi de keke luʋɔ gbɔ hafi!

english_verse: Look! The enemy army swoops down like an eagle; their cavalry and chariots race faster than storm clouds blown by the wind.” Then you will answer, “We are doomed!”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eho gbɔna abe alilikpo ene, eƒe tasiaɖamwo le abe ahom ene, eye eƒe sɔwo ɖia ɖu wu hɔ̃; baba na mí, elabena míetsrɔ̃.

english_verse: But Jerusalem, there is still time for you to be saved. Wash the evil from your hearts and stop making sinful plans,
translation_verse: Yerusalem, klɔ vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ɖa le wò dzi ŋu, ne woaxɔ na wò. Ɣekaɣi tamesusu vɔ̃ɖiwo nanɔ wò dzi me ase ɖo?

english_verse: before a message of disaster arrives from the hills of Ephraim and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Elabena wole gbe ƒã ɖemee tso Dan, eye wona wose dzɔgbevɔ̃e nya tso Efrayim-towo dzi.

english_verse: “People of Judah, your hearts will be in pain, but it's your own fault that you will be punished.” Jeremiah's Vision of the Coming Punishment
translation_verse: Wò zɔzɔme kple wò nuwɔnawoe wɔ esia wò, wò vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔe wɔ esia, eve kaɖikaɖi, eye ade dzigbɔ ke na wò. Nyagblɔɖila ƒe konyifafa.

english_verse: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.
translation_verse: Nye dɔkaviwo, nye dɔkaviwo! Mele togotogoe ƒom le vevesese ta, nye dzixɔ, nye dzi dze agbo le menye, nyemate ŋu azi ɖoɖoe o, elabena nye luʋɔ le kpẽwo ƒe ɖiɖi kple aʋaɣli sem!

english_verse: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
translation_verse: Gligbagbã tsia ɖe wo nɔewo nu, elabena wogblẽ anyigba blibo la; woagblẽ nye xɔwo enumake kple nye agbadɔwo le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me.

english_verse: How long will I see enemy flags and hear their trumpets?
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣi manɔ aflaga kpɔm, eye manɔ kpẽwo ƒe ɖiɖi sem ase ɖo?

english_verse: I heard the Lord say, “My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.”
translation_verse: Elabena nye dukɔ dzɔ lã, womedze sim o; vi tsibomewo wonye, eye Womenya nu o; nunyalawo wonye le vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ me, ke nyuiwɔwɔ la, womedzea si eya o.

english_verse: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
translation_verse: Meɖe ŋku ɖe anyigba, nɔnɔme meli nɛ o, ele ƒuƒlu; meɖe ŋku ɖe dziƒo, kekelía ɖeke meli o.

english_verse: no people could be seen, and all the birds had flown away.
translation_verse: Meɖo ŋku anyi, kpɔ ɖa, amegbetɔa ɖeke megali o, eye dziƒoxewo katã dzo yi.

english_verse: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Meɖo ŋku anyi, kpɔ ɖa, anyigba wɔnu zu gbegbe, wogbã eƒe duwo katã le Yehowa ŋgɔ le eƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe bibi ta.

english_verse: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.
translation_verse: Eyata anyigba nefa konyi, eye dziƒo nenɔ ahovɔ me, elabena meƒo nu, eye mavem o, meɖo ta me, eye nyematrɔe o.

english_verse: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.
translation_verse: Du blibo la si le sɔdolawo kple aŋutrɔdalawo ƒe howɔwɔ nu, woyi ave dodowo me, eye wolia agakpewo; wogblẽ du blibo la ɖi amea ɖeke megale eme o.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
translation_verse: Ke wò, amesi wotsrɔ̃, nuka nahawɔ ma? Ne eta aɖabɛ, nedo sikanuwo, eye neɖo tu ɖe ŋku hã la, dzodzroe nèwɔ leke; wò lɔlɔ̃tɔwo ado vlo wò, eye woadi wò ku.

english_verse: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
translation_verse: Elabena mese ɣli abe nyɔnu, si le ku lém la tɔ ene, abe nyɔnu, si le vi ŋgɔgbea dzim la ƒe ŋɔdziɣli ene, mese Zion-nyɔnuvi, si le ŋeŋem hewu asi dzi la ƒe gbe be; Baba nam, elabena nye luʋɔ tsi amewulawo si!

english_verse: “Search Jerusalem for honest people who try to be faithful. If you can find even one, I'll forgive the whole city.
translation_verse: Miyi ɖatsa le Yerusalem ƒe kpɔdomeewo, mikpɔ nu, eye midze si nu, midi nu gɔme se le eƒe ablɔwo me, be míakpɔ amea ɖe loo, alo amea ɖe li, si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòbiaa nyateƒe ta sena hã, ekema màtsɔe akee.

english_verse: I answered, “I know that you look for truth. You punished your people for their lies, but in spite of the pain, they became more stubborn and refused to turn back to you.”
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɖe wò ŋkuwo mele nyateƒe ŋu oa? Eƒo wo, gake meɖe lã me na wo o; ètsrɔ̃ wo ɖa, ke wogbe toɖoɖo tohehe, wosẽ woƒe ŋku me wu agakpe, eye wogbe tametɔtrɔ.

english_verse: Then I thought to myself, “These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.
translation_verse: Nyea mebu be: Amesiawo, ame dahewoe, wodzɔ lã, elabena Womenya Yehowa ƒe mɔ kple woƒe Mawu ƒe se la o.

english_verse: So I'll go and talk to the leaders. They know what God demands.” But even they had decided not to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Eyata mayi ame ŋkutawo gbɔ, eye maƒo nu kpli wo; elabena woawoe nya Yehowa ƒe mɔ kple woƒe Mawu ƒe se la me. Ke wo katã wòŋe kɔkuti la, eye wotso kaawo!

english_verse: The people have rebelled and rejected the Lord too many times. So enemies will attack like lions from the forest or wolves from the desert. Those enemies will watch the towns of Judah, and like leopards they will tear to pieces whoever goes outside. Enemies Will Punish Judah The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eyata dzata ado tso ave me agbã wo, amegãxi, si le gbegbe, atsrɔ̃ wo, lãkle ade xa ɖe woƒe duwo ŋu, eye wòavuvu amesiame, si do tso wo me. Elabena woƒe vodadawo sɔ gbɔ, eye woƒe godzedzewo do agbogbo.

english_verse: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Wole asi yɔm le yiyimee abe sɔtsu ɖami ene, eye amesiame le gbe tem ɖe ehavi srɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: I will tell their enemies, “Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.”
translation_verse: Miɖe woƒe gliwo dzi, ne miagblẽ nu; ke menye gbidigbidi o! Miho woƒe weinkawo, elabena menye Yehowa tɔ wonye o.

english_verse: In every way, Judah and Israel have been unfaithful to me. *
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Israel ƒe aƒe kple Yuda ƒe aƒe dze go ɖem.

english_verse: Their prophets lie and say, “The Lord won't punish us. We will have peace and plenty of food.”
translation_verse: Wosẽ nu le Yehowa ŋu gblɔ bena: „Menye eyae o; dzɔgbevɔ̃e mava mía dzi o, eye míakpɔ yi kple dɔwuame kple ŋku o;

english_verse: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
translation_verse: nyagblɔɖilawo azu ya, elabena menye eyae ƒo nu to wo dzi o; woawo ŋutɔwo ŋu ke woaɖi.“

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot gblɔ esi: Esi miele nu ƒom alea la, eyata kpɔ ɖa, mana nye nya, si le nuwo la, nanye dzo, eye dukɔ sia nanye nake, ne wòafiã wo.

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Israel ƒe aƒe, eyata makplɔ dukɔa ɖe tso didiƒe ava ƒo ɖe mia dzi, dukɔ sẽnu wònye, blema dukɔ wònye, dukɔ, si ƒe gbe mènya o, eye mèsea eƒe nuƒoƒo me hã o.

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
translation_verse: Eƒe daku le abe yɔdo nuvo ene; kalẽtɔwo sɔŋ wonye.

english_verse: This nation will eat your crops and livestock; they will leave no fruit on your vines or fig trees. And although you feel safe behind thick walls, your towns will be destroyed and your children killed. Israel Refused To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: Aɖu wò agblemenu kple wò abolo, aɖu wò ŋutsuviwo kple wò nyɔnuviwo, aɖu wò alẽwo kple wò nyiwo, aɖu wò weinka kple wò gbotiwo, eye atsɔ yi agba wò du sesẽ, siwo ŋu nèle dzi ɖem ɖo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.
translation_verse: Ke ɣemaɣi hã nyematsrɔ̃ mi gbidigbidi o, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Eye wòava me, ne wogblɔ be: Nukata Yehowa wɔ nusiawo katã mí ɖo hã la, ekema naɖo ŋu na wo be: Alesi miegblẽm ɖi hesubɔ mawu tutɔwo le mia ŋutɔwo miaƒe anyigba dzii la, nenema ke miasubɔ du bubu me tɔwo le anyigba, si menye mia tɔ o la dzii.

english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɖe gbe ƒã nya sia le Yakob ƒe aƒe la me, eye na woasee le Yuda be:

english_verse: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
translation_verse: Dukɔ tsibome manyanu, mise esia, amesiwo ŋku li na, hafi womekpɔa nu o, to li na wo, ke womesea nu o!

english_verse: that you should worship me with fear and trembling? I'm the one who made the shore to hold back the ocean. Waves may crash on the beach, but they can come no farther.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ɖe miagbem vɔvɔ̃, eye miadzo nyanyanya le ŋkunye me oa? Nye amesi tsɔ ke do liƒo na atsiaƒu wònye kpododo mavɔ, si dzi magbɔ o, ne edze agbo hã, mate ŋui o, eye ne eƒe tsotsoewo le gbe ɖem hã, magbɔ edzi ayi o.

english_verse: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
translation_verse: Ke dzi dzeaglã sẽto li na dukɔ sia, wote ɖe aga helé woƒe mɔ tsɔ;

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: eye womegblɔ le woƒe dzi me be: mina míavɔ̃ Yehowa, mía Mawu, amesi na tsi dzana, adametsi kple keletsi ɖe wo dzaɣi la o, eya amesi wɔ nuŋeɣi ƒe kwasiɖawo dzi na mí pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: That's why I cannot bless you! *
translation_verse: Miaƒe vodadawoe gblẽ nusia me, eye miaƒe nuvɔ̃woe te nu nyui mi.

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le nye dukɔ la dome, woɖe xa ɖi, eye wodo dɔgɔ̃e abe xevimɔ̃trela ene; wotre mɔ̃ heɖe amegbetɔwo!

english_verse: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
translation_verse: Alesi xevi yɔa xadzae taŋ la, nenema alakpadada yɔa woƒe xɔwo fũ, eyata wòzu amegãwo kple kesinɔtɔwo ɖo.

english_verse: and prosperous, but you refuse to help the poor get the justice they deserve.
translation_verse: Woda ami lalala, eye vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ yɔ wo gbagba; womedrɔ̃a nya o, womedrɔ̃a tsyɔ̃eviwo ƒe nya, be wòadze edzi na wo o, eye womedrɔ̃a nya na ame dahewo o.

english_verse: You need to be punished, and so I will take revenge.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ɖe nyemahe to le esia ta, eye ɖe nye luʋɔ mabia hlɔ̃ dukɔ sia tɔgbe oa?

english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzinu kple ŋunyɔnue dzɔ le anyigba dzi:

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: Nyagblɔɖilawo gblɔa alakpanya ɖi, eye nunɔlawo le aƒetɔ ɖum, alesi wofia woe, eye wòdze nye dukɔ ŋu alea! Ke nuka miawɔ, ne eƒe nuwuwu la va ɖo?

english_verse: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Mi Benyamin-viwo, misi tso Yerusalem! Miku kpẽ le Tekoa, eye mitu aflaga ɖo Bet-Hakerem; elabena dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple gbegblẽ gã tso anyiehe gbɔna.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a lovely pasture,
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ wò Zion-nyɔnuvi dzetugbee ɖuvii la.

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: Lãkplɔviwo kple woƒe lãhawo vaa egbɔ, wotua woƒe agbadɔwo ɖe eŋu godoo, eye amesiame nyia lã le eƒe akpa dzi.

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: „Mikɔ aʋawɔwɔ ŋu ɖe eŋu! Mitso, ne míaho le ŋdɔ! Baba na mi, be anyinu le wɔwɔm, eye ɣetrɔ ƒe vɔvɔli le kekem ɖe nu!

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: Mitso, ne míaho le zã me, eye miagblẽ eƒe fiasãwo!“

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Milã eƒe atiwo, eye miƒu kpo ɖe Yerusalem ŋu; eyae nye du, si woahe to na, eye ŋutasesẽ yɔe fũ.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Alesi vudo dzia tsii la, nenema eƒe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ le dzidzimee; wose nu vlo wɔwɔ kple ŋutasesẽ ŋkɔ le eme; abideameŋu kple dodro le ŋkunye me ɖaa.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, na woaka mo na wò, ne nye luʋɔ magadzo le gbɔwò, eye matso wò awɔ gbegbe kple anyigba zu aƒedoe o.

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Woaxa Israel ƒe ame susɔewo, abe alesi woxaa weintsetse mlɔeawoe ene; gado wò asi ɖa abe weingbledela ɖe kawo ŋu ene.

english_verse: I have told the people that you, Lord, will punish them, but they just laugh and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ameka maƒo nu na, eye maɖi ɖase na, be woasee? Kpɔ ɖa, woƒe to meŋɔ, ne woalé to ɖe nya ŋu o. Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ƒe nya zu alɔmeɖenu na wo, eƒe nu medze wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe yɔm fũ, eye eléle ɖe dɔ me tim. Trɔe kɔ ɖe ɖeviwo dzi le ablɔ me kple ɖekakpuiwo ƒe ha siaa dzi; elabena woalé ŋutsu kple nyɔnu, ame tsi-tsi kple amegã ɖeɖi siaa!

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Woƒe aƒewo anye ame bubuwo tɔ hekpe ɖe woƒe agblewo kple wo srɔ̃wo ŋu; elabena mado nye asi ɖe anyigba dzinɔlawo ŋu, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Elabena wo katã wonye amebalawo tso ɖeviwo dzi vaseɖe tsitsiawo dzi; wo katã wonye alakpatɔwo tso nyagblɔɖilawo dzi vaseɖe nunɔlawo dzi.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Wotre nye dukɔ ƒe gbagbãƒe betsebetse hele gbɔgblɔm be: Ŋutifafa, ŋutifafa! evɔ ŋutifafa meli o hafi.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Ne ŋukpe lé wo, le esi wowɔ ŋunyɔnu ta hã la, woƒe mo metsia dã o, eye womenyaa nukae nye ŋukpe o. Eyata woatsi ame tsiaʋawo dome, eye wòadze anyi le ɣeyiɣi, si mahe to na wo, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Miyi mowo dzi, miɖo ŋku anyi, eye mibia blema mɔwo ta se be, mɔ kae nye nyuia hã, eye mizɔ edzi, ne miakpɔ gbɔdzɔe na miaƒe luʋɔwo. Ke woawo ɖo ŋu be: Miele edzi to ge o.

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Meɖo dzɔlawo wo ŋu wole gbɔgblɔm be: Milé to ɖe kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu! Ke woɖo ŋu be: Miele to lé ge ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Eyata mi dukɔwo, misee, eye mi amehawo, midze si nusi le dzɔdzɔ ge le wo dome!

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Anyigba, see! Kpɔ ɖa, mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava dukɔ sia dzi wòanye woƒe tamesusuwo ƒe kutsetse, elabena womeɖo to nye nyawo o, eye wodo vlo nye se la.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Nuka dzudzɔʋeʋẽedonu tso Saba kple gbekee xɔasi tso didiƒenyigba dzinye nam? Miaƒe numevɔsawo medzea ŋunye o, eye miaƒe akpedavɔsawo mevivina nam o.

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖo nukikli na dukɔ sia, fofowo kple viwo siaa, aƒelika kple xɔlɔ̃a woaklii, eye woatsrɔ̃.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, dukɔa ɖe tso anyiehe-nyigba dzi gbɔna, eye anyigba dzi dukɔ gãa ɖe nyo tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Da kple akplɔ le wo si; ŋutasẽlawo wonye, eye womekpɔa nublanui o; woƒe ʋunyaʋunyawɔwɔ le abe atsiaƒu ƒe gbeɖeɖe ene, wodo sɔwo, eye wobla akpa abe ŋutsu ene, be woawɔ aʋa kpli wò, Zion-nyɔnuvi.

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: „Míese eŋu nya, míaƒe asiwò do agble, ŋɔdzi lé mí, eye míele ƒoƒom tititi abe nyɔnu léku ene.“

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Migado yi agble me o, eye migato mo dzi o, elabena yi le futɔ si, eye ŋɔdzi li godoo va kpe.

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ ƒe nyɔnuvi, ta akpanya, eye na ƒo togotogoe le dzowɔ me; xa nu le tenuvi la ŋu, eye nata konyi vevie; elabena nugblẽla le ƒoƒo ge ɖe mía dzi kpoyi.

english_verse: Jeremiah, test my people as though they were metal.
translation_verse: Metsɔ wò ɖo galólolae le nye dukɔ dome, be nadze si woƒe zɔzɔme, eye nadoe akpɔ.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Aglãdzelawo ƒe aglãdzelawo, ame gɔmezɔlawo, akɔbli kple gayibɔe wo katã wonye, nugblẽlawo nye wo katã tim.

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: ke womeɖo tom o, eye womeƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye o, ke boŋ wosẽ ʋume, eye wogblẽ wu wo fofowo.

english_verse: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: miete amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo ɖe anyi o, miekɔ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi ɖe teƒe sia o, eye miedze mawu tutɔwo yome hena miaƒe gbegblẽ o la,

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Migaɖo dzi ɖe akpanya, si wole gbɔgblɔm be: „Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ, Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ, Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔe nye esia la ŋu o!

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ne mieɖɔ miaƒe zɔzɔme kple nuwɔnawo ɖo, ne miedrɔ̃ nya na amesiame kple ehavi,

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ekema mana mianɔ teƒe sia le anyigba, si metsɔ na mia fofowo tegbee la dzi.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, miele dzi ɖom ɖe alakpanya, si mele ɖeke me o la ŋuti.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Nuka? Miele fifim, le ame wum, le ahasi wɔm, le atam dzodzro kam, eye miedo dzudzɔ na mawu tutɔ, siwo mienya o tso,

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: hafi mievana hetsia tre ɖe ŋkunye me le aƒe sia, si ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo la me henɔa gbɔgblɔm be: „Mía ŋu vo“, ne miawɔ ŋunyɔnu siawo katã?

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Ɖe aƒe sia, si ŋu woyɔa nye ŋkɔ ɖo la, zu adzodalawo ƒe do le mia ŋku mea? Yehowa be: Nye hã mekpɔe!

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Elabena miyi nɔnyeƒe le Silo, afisi mena nye ŋkɔ nɔ tsã la, eye mikpɔ nusi mewɔe le nye dukɔ Israel ƒe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ta la ɖa.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Azɔ esi miewɔ nusiawo katã, eye mele nuƒoƒo kpli mi dzi ɖaa, ke miesee o, meyɔ mi, eye mietɔ o la,

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: eyata mawɔ aƒe, si ŋu woyɔa nye ŋkɔ ɖo, esi ŋu miele dzi ɖom ɖo, kple teƒe, si metsɔ na mia kple mia fofowo la, abe alesi mewɔ Silo ene,

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: eye matsɔ mi aƒu gbe atso nye ŋku ta, abe alesi metsɔ mia nɔviwo katã, siwo nye Efrayim ƒe ƒome blibo la ƒu gbee ene.

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Ɖe mèle nusi wɔm wole le Yuda-duwo me kple Yerusalem-kpɔdomeewo la kpɔm oa?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Viwo le nake fɔm, fofowo le dzo dom, eye nyɔnuwo le amɔwɔ blum, ne woatsɔ tɔ tatali na dziƒofianyɔnu, eye woƒo tsi ɖe anyi na mawu tutɔwo, ne woatsɔ do dziku nam.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nyee wole dziku dom na loo? Woawo ŋutɔwo boŋ ƒe moe wole ŋukpe demi.

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi. Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔmedzoe kple nye dziku atrɔ akɔ ɖe teƒe sia, amegbetɔwo kple lãwo, gbemetiwo kple anyigba dzi kutsetsewo dzi, eye woabi, womatsii o.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemeƒo nu kple mia fofowo alo de se na wo le numevɔsa kple akpedavɔsa ŋu le gbesigbe mekplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi o.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Ke boŋ nya siae metsɔ de se na wo be: Mise nye gbe, ne manye miaƒe Mawu, eve miawo mianye nye dukɔ, eye mizɔ nye mɔ, si meɖo na mi la dzi, be eme nanyo na mi.

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Ke wogbe esese, eye womeƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye o; wozɔ le adaŋu, si wode le woƒe dzi vɔ̃ɖi ƒe tamesesẽ me la nu, eye wotrɔ megbe ɖem, menye ŋku me o.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Meɖo nye dɔlawo katã, siwo nye nyagblɔɖilawo la, ɖe mi tso gbesigbe mia fofowo ʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi vaseɖe egbe, mele wo ɖoɖoɖa dzi gbesiagbe ɖaa;

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ na wo be: Esia nye dukɔ, si mesea Yehowa, eƒe Mawu ƒe gbe o, eye meɖoa to amehehe o. Nyateƒetoto nu yi, eye wotsrɔ̃ ɖa le woƒe nu me.

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Lũ wò taɖa natsɔ aƒu gbe, eye yi naɖato konyifaha le to ƒeƒlewo ta me, elabena Yehowa gbe ƒome, si le dɔmedzoe dom nɛ la, eye wònyã wo.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Elabena Yuda-viwo wɔ nu gbegblẽ le ŋkunye me, eye woli ŋunyɔnu ɖe aƒe, si ŋu woyɔa nye ŋkɔ ɖo la me, ne woagblẽ ko ɖo nɛ,

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: wowɔ Tofet-nuxeƒe ɖe Ben-Hinom-bali me la, ne woatɔ dzo woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple woƒe nyonuviwo, nusi ŋu nyemede se na wo le loo, alo wòayi nye la me va ge o.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Eyata ŋkeke li gbɔna, eye womagayɔe be „Tofet“ kple „Ben-Hinom-balime“ azɔ o, ke boŋ be „Amewu-balime“, eye woadi ame ɖe Tofet, le esi teƒe meli o ta.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Dukɔ sia ƒe kukuawo azu nuɖuɖu na dziƒoxewo kple anyigba dzi lãwo, eye womanyã wo o.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Eye mana aseyetsogbe kple dzidzɔgbe, ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ƒe gbe kple ŋugbetɔ ƒe gbe nu natso le Yuda-duwo kple Yerusalem ƒe kpɔdomeewo; elabena anyigba la azu gbegbe.

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Le ɣemaɣila woaho Yuda-fiawo ƒe ƒuwo kple woƒe amegãwo ƒe ƒuwo, woƒe nunɔlawo ƒe ƒuwo, woƒe nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe ƒuwo kpakple Yerusalem-tɔwo ƒe ƒuwo tso woƒe yɔdowo me,

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: ahasia ɖe ɣe kple ɣleti kpakple dziƒo ŋu nuwo nu, nusiwo ƒe nya wolɔ̃, eye wosubɔ, wodze wo yome, wobia nu wo se, eye wode ta agu na wo; womafɔ wo o, eye womatsɔ wo aɖi o, eye woazu gbeɖuɖɔ le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot be: Ƒome vɔ̃ɖi sia ƒe ame mamlea, siwo katã susɔ ɖe teƒe, siwo katã menyã wo ɖo ɖo la, alɔ̃ ku wu agbe.

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Eyata ale nagblɔ na wo enye si: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ɖe wòto anyi womegafɔna oa, alo ɖe wotrɔa megbe womegatrɔa kɔ oa?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti dukɔ sia, si nye Yerusalem, dze go ɖikaa? Woku ɖe alakpadada ŋu, eye wogbe tɔtrɔ.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: Meƒu to anyi, eye mese be, womelé nu ƒom ɖe eteƒe o; amea ɖeke meli, si eƒe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ venɛ wògblɔna be: Nuka nye esi mehewɔ hã o! Amesiame lé eƒe ma abe so, si lu ɖe aʋa me ene.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Damixe le dziƒo te hã nya eƒe azã, eye akpakpa, sagbadre kple tsalɛ dzea si woƒe gbɔgbɔɣi; ke nye dukɔ menya Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖowo o.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Aleke miate ŋu ano gbɔgblɔm be, nunyalawo yewonye, eye Yehowa ƒe se la le yewo si me? Kpɔ ɖa, vavãe agbalẽnyalawo ƒe nuŋlɔnu trae wo aʋatsoe.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Ŋu akpe nunyalawo, dzi aɖe le wo ƒo, eye asi atu wo; kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ƒe nya wogbe, nunya kae hele wo si azɔ ma?

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Eyata matso wo srɔ̃wo na ame tutɔwo kple woƒe agblewo na wo nyãlawo, elabena ŋuklẽlawo sɔŋ wonye tso ɖeviawo dzi vaseɖe tsitsiawo dzi, alakpadalawo sɔŋ wonye tso nyagblɔɖilawo dzi vaseɖe nunɔlawo dzi.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Wotre nye dukɔ ƒe gbagbãƒe betsebetse hele gbɔgblɔm be: Ŋutifafa, ŋutifafa; evɔ wònye ŋutifafaa ɖeke meli o hafi.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ne ŋukpe lé wo, le esi wowɔ nu nyɔŋu ta hã la, woƒe mo metsia dã o, eye womenyaa nukae nye ŋukpe o. Eyata woatsi ame tsiaʋawo dome, eye wòadze anyi le ɣeyiɣi, si mahe to na wo, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Maɖe wo ɖa keŋkeŋ, ale be weintsetsea ɖeke manɔ weinka ŋu o, gbotsetsea ɖeke manɔ gboti dzi o, eye aŋgba ayra, eye madɔ amesiwo ava ƒo ɖe wo dzi la, ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti míegale anyinɔƒe ko? Miƒo takpli, míayi du sesẽwo me, ne míatsrɔ̃ ɖe afima; elabena Yehowa, mía Mawu la, le míaƒe tsɔtsrɔ dim; ekpe aɖitsi na mí mieno, le esi miewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa ŋu ta.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Miele mɔ kpɔm na ŋutifafa, ke nu nyuia ɖeke meva o; míele mɔ kpɔm na hayahaya, ke ŋɔdzi li.
