english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Wose eƒe sɔwo ƒe gbɔgbɔ fuxefuxe tso Dan, eye eƒe sɔtsuwo ƒe xɔxlɔ̃ ƒe ɖiɖi na anyigba blibo la ʋuʋu; wogbɔna, ne woaɖu anyigba kple edzi nuwo, du la kple eme nɔlawo.

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Mado dawo kple ƒliwo ɖe mia ŋu, siwo ŋu gbesa meɖina o, eve woaɖu mi.

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Oo, nukae ana nye dzeme nato le nye nuxaxa me! Nu te nye dzi ŋu le menye!

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dukɔ ƒe ɣlikpe ɖi tso didiƒenyigba dzi be: „Ɖe Yehowa megale Zion oa, eye ɖe eƒe fia megale eme oa?“ Nukaŋuti wotsɔ woƒe aklama kpakpɛwo kple du bubu me towo ƒe yakanuwo do dziku nam?

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Nuŋeɣi va yi, eye kutsetsegbegbe nu tso, ke miawo la, womexɔ na mi o!

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ ƒe ƒoƒo na megbã gudugudu, mele nu xam, eye nye lãme ble fu.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Ɖe atikea ɖeke megale Gilead o, eye gbedalaa ɖeke mele afima oa? Nukaŋuti nye dukɔ mehaya o?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe wònye dzeƒee le asinye le gbegbe la, anye ne magblẽ nye dukɔ ɖi, eye míaʋu tso wo gbɔ! Elabena ahasiwɔla kple ame tovowo ƒe ha wo katã wonye.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Wotsɔa alakpa vua woƒe aɖekawo mee abe dati ene, eye menye nyateƒetotoe nana wokpɔa ŋusẽ le anyigba dzi o. Elabena wohona tsoa vodada gbɔyia vodada gbɔ, ke nye la, womedzea sim o.

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Amesiame nekpɔ eɖokui dzi nyuie le ehavi ŋu, eye megaɖo ŋu ɖe nɔvia ɖeke ŋu o; elabena nɔvi sia nɔvi enye ayetɔ, eye xɔlɔ̃ sia xɔlɔ̃ enye ame gɔmezɔla.

english_verse: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.
translation_verse: Amesiame flua ehavi, eye wometoa nyateƒe o; wona alakpadada ma woƒe aɖe, eye wokua kutri le nu tovo wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Alakpadada le dowòme, eye wogbe sidzedzem le alakpadada ta.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, malólo wo, eye mado wo akpɔ; elabena aleke mawɔ le nye dukɔ ƒe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ta?

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: Aŋutrɔ wuame enye woƒe aɖe, eye wodaa alakpa; wotsoa woƒe aɖe gblɔa nya fafɛ na wo havi, ke aye le woƒe dzi me.

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ɖe nyemahe to na wo le esia ta oa, eye ɖe nye luʋɔ mabia hlɔ̃ dukɔ sia tɔgbe oa?

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Maɖafa avi le towo dzi, maxa nu, eye mato konyifaha le gbegbe ƒe lãnyiƒe, elabena wogblẽ ale be amegbetɔa ɖeke megato wo dzi yi o, eye womegase lãhawo ƒe xɔxlɔ̃ o; dziƒoxewo kple lãwo ʋu dzo.

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Amesi nye ŋutsu nyanu la, nèse esia gɔme, eye amesi Yehowa ƒe nu toa nya na la, eya negblɔ nusi ta wotsrɔ̃ anyigba la, eye wogblẽe wòzu gbegbe, ale be amea ɖeke megatoa edzi yina o la ɖo.

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Esi wogblẽ nye se, si metsɔ ɖo wo ŋku me la ɖi, womeɖo to nye gbe o, eye womezɔ ɖe enu o,

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wodze woƒe dziwo ƒe tamesesẽ kple Baalwo yome, abe alesi wo fofowo fia wo ene la,

english_verse: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: eyata ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, mana atsa dukɔ sia wòaɖu, eye makpe aɖitsi nɛ wòano,

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: eye makaka wo ahlẽ ɖe dukɔ, siwo woawo kple wo fofowo menya o la dome, eye maɖo yi ɖe wo yome, vaseɖe esime matsrɔ̃ wo ava.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Mitsa ŋu, eye miyɔ nyɔnu yɔƒewɔlawo, ne woava, eye miɖo ame ɖe nyɔnu nyanuwo, ne woava,

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: ne woato konyifaha ɖe mía ŋu kaba, be míaƒe ŋkuwo nafa aɖatsi yoyoyo, eye míaƒe aɖabawo naɖuɖu tsi.

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Elabena wose konyifagbe tso Zion be: Aleke wotsrɔ̃ mí, eye ŋu kpe mí vevie ale? Elabena èle na mí be, míadzo le anyigba dzi, eye wogbã mía nɔƒewo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Mi nyɔnuwo, mise Yehowa ƒe nya, eye eƒe nu me nya nege ɖe miaƒe towo me; mifia nuxaxa mia vinyɔnuwo, eye nyɔnu sia nyɔnu nefia konyifaha ehavi.

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Elabena ku to míaƒe fesre nu ge ɖe eme, ege ɖe miaƒe fiasãwo me, ne woatsrɔ̃ ɖeviwo le kpɔdomee kple ɖekakpuiwo le abla me.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Ƒo nu: Yehowa ƒe gbe enye si: Amegbetɔwo ƒe kukuwo ana anyi abe gbeɖuɖɔ le agble me ene, eye abe lubabla le nuŋelawo megbe, siwo amea ɖeke meli aƒo wo nu ƒu o la ene.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi; Nunyala megaƒo adegbe le eƒe nunya ŋu o, ŋusẽtɔ megaƒo adegbe le eƒe ŋusẽ ŋu o, eye kesinɔtɔ megaƒo adegbe le eƒe kesinɔnu ŋu o;

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Dukɔwo ƒe mɔ megamã mi o, eye dziƒo ŋu dzesiwo megadzi ŋɔ na mi o, nenye be, wonɔa ŋɔ dzim na dukɔwo hã.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔwo ƒe ɖoɖowo la, nu dzodzroe. Ati wònye wotso le ave me, eye aɖaŋua tsɔ fiavi wɔ eŋu dɔe.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Wotso klosalo kple sika ɖo atsyɔ̃ ne, eye wotso zu ƒo gatagbadzɛ ɖee, be magamũ o.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Woɖi xenyãnu le adzamatregble me, eye womate ŋu aƒo nu o; ele be, woatso wo, elabena womezɔa azɔli o. Migavɔ̃ wo o, elabena womewɔa vɔ̃a ɖeke o, eye nyuiwɔwɔ hã mele wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Our Lord, great and powerful, you alone are God.
translation_verse: Yehowa, amea ɖeke mede nuwo o, èlolo, eye wò ŋusẽ na wò ŋkɔ lolo.

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe fia, amekae mavɔ̃ wò o ma? Elabena wòe wòdze; elabena amea ɖeke mele dukɔwo ƒe nunyalawo katã kple woƒe fiaɖuƒewo katã dome, si le abe wò ene o.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Wo katã wodzɔ lã, eye wòzu bometsilawo; wohe to na legbawo, ati wonye.

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ klosalo, si woƒo gbabɛ la, tso Tarsis vɛ, kple sika tso Ofir; aɖaŋua ƒe dɔwɔwɔ wònye kple sikanutula ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ, woƒe avɔtata nye aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ; aɖaŋua ƒe dɔwɔwɔ wo katã wonye!

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa enye Mawu vava; eyae nye Mawu gbagbe kple fia mavɔ; anyigba ʋuʋu le eƒe dɔmedzoe nu, eye eƒe dziku menya le tsɔtsɔm na dukɔwo o.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Ale miagblɔ na wo enye si: Mawu, siwo mewo dziƒoa kple anyigba o la, wo nu ayi tso anyigba dzi kple dziƒo te.

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Eyae nye amesi tsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ wɔ anyigba, etsɔ eƒe nunya ɖo xexeame te, eye wotsɔ eƒe sidzedze keke dziƒo me.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Eƒe gbeɖeɖe nana tsiwo ɖina hoo le dziƒo, eye wònana alũ hona yia dzi le anyigba ƒe mlɔenu: ewɔa dzikedzo kpena ɖe tsidzadza ŋu, eye wòɖea ya donae tsoa eƒe nudzraɖoƒe.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔwo katã dzɔa lã le woƒe nunyanya me, eye ŋukpe léa legbakɔlawo katã, elabena alakpa enye nusi wokɔna, eye gbɔgbɔa ɖeke menɔa eme o.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nu dzodzroawo wonye, dɔwɔwɔ, si ŋu woaɖe alɔme le la, wonye, woatsrɔ̃ le woƒe tohegbe.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Ke Yakob ƒe gome mele abe woamawo ene o, elabena eya nye nuwo katã wɔla, eye Israel enye eya ŋutɔ ƒe ƒome; Yehowa Zebaot enye eƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Wò amesi woɖe to ɖo, kɔ wò agba dzoe le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ anyigba dzinɔlawo aƒu gbe, eye mana woaɖe to ɖe wo, be asi natu wo.

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Baba nam le nye gbegblẽ la ta, nye abi le veyem! Ke mebe; Fukpekpe la tɔnyee, mado dzi atsɔe.

english_verse: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
translation_verse: Wogblẽ nye agbadɔ, eye wotso nye atagbiwo katã. Vinyewo dzo le gbɔnye, eye womegali o. Amea ɖeke meli, si agatu nye agbadɔ nam, eye woatsi nye agbadɔvɔwo o.

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Lãkplɔviwo katã dzɔ lã, eye womedi Yehowa yome mɔ o; eyata medze edzi na wo o, eye woƒe lãhawo katã ka hlẽ.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Fu to anyi, nane le ɖiɖim gbɔna, eye howɔwɔ gã tso anyiehe-nyigba dzi, ne wòado gbegbe Yuda-duwo, ne woazu amegãxiwo nɔƒe!

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: Yehowa, menyae be, amegbetɔ ƒe mo kple ŋutsu ƒe zɔzɔme la menye eya ŋuta si me wòle, ne eƒe azɔlime nato ma ɖeka o.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Yehowa, he to nam, ke megagbɔ me o, eye menye le wò dɔmedzoe me, be natsrɔ̃m ɖa o.“

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dɔmedzoe kɔ ɖe dukɔ, siwo medze si wò o, kple ƒome, siwo meyɔ wò ŋkɔ o la dzi, elabena woɖu Yakob, ẽ, woɖui petepete, eye wogblẽ eƒe nɔƒewo.

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Woaƒo fi ade amesi meɖo to nubabla sia ƒe nyawo o,

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: nya, siwo mede asi na mia fofowo le gbesigbe mekplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, tso gakpo me, gblɔ bena: Ne míese nye gbe, eye miewɔ, abe alesi mede se na mi ene la, ekema mianye nye dukɔ, eye manye miaƒe Mawu,

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: ne mawɔ atam, si meka na mia fofowo be, matsɔ anyigba, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la, na wo la dzi, abe alesi wòzu egbeawo ene. Eye meɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Yehowa, neva me!

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Ɖe gbe ƒã nya siawo katã le Yuda-duwo kple Yerusalem ƒe kpɔdomeewo bena: Mise nubabla sia ƒe nyawo, eye miwɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Elabena mexlɔ̃ nu mia fofowo tso gbesigbe mekplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi vaseɖe egbe, eye megale nu xlɔ̃m wo vevie ɖaa be: Miɖo to nye gbe!

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Ke womeɖo to o, eye womeƒu to anyi o, ke boŋ wò katã wozɔ le woƒe dzimesesẽ vɔ̃ɖi me; tete mehe nubabla sia ƒe nyawo katã va wo dzi, nya, siwo ŋu mede se na wo le, hafi womewɔ wo dzi o la. Dukɔ la ƒe anukware maɖimaɖi.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Gbeɖoɖoɖi le Yuda-ŋutsuwo kple Yerusalemtɔwo dome.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Wotrɔ ɖe wo fofo, siwo gbe be, yewomaɖo to nye nyawo o la ƒe vodada tsãtɔwo ŋu; wodze mawu tutɔwo hã yome, ne woasubɔ wo; Israel ƒe aƒe kple Yuda ƒe aƒe la tu nye nu, si mebia kple wo fofowo la.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava wo dzi, esi me womaɖe le o, eye woaɖo ɣli nam, ke nyemaɖo towo o.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Elabena Yuda, alesi wò duwo sɔ gbɔe la, nenema nu wò mawuwo le ɖo, eye míeɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo ɖe Yerusalem-blɔwo ƒe xexlẽme nu na ŋukpenamawuwo, ne míado dzudzɔ le vasamlekpulawo dzi na Baal.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Ke wò la megaɖe kuku ɖe dukɔ sia ta o, megaƒo koko, eye megado gbe ɖa ɖe wo ta o, elabena ne wodo ɣli yɔm le woƒe hiã me la, nyemaɖo to wo o.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Nuka xɔ̃nye veviwo be, yewoawɔ le aƒenye me? Ɖe wobe, yewoawɔ yewoƒe aye tameɖoɖowo dzia? Ne gbedodoɖa kple vɔsalã kɔkɔewo ɖe wò nu vɔ̃ɖi wowɔ ɖa la, ekema akpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Yehowa yɔ wò be „amiti dama, si ƒe tsetse nyo, eye wònya kpɔna“. Le howɔwɔ gã ƒe ɖiɖi me la ado dzo ɖe eŋu, eye eƒe alɔwo aŋe.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot, amesi ɖe wò aganu to la, ɖo vɔ ɖe ŋuwò le Israel ƒe aƒe kple Yuda ƒe aƒe ƒe vɔ̃ɖi, si wowɔ hedo dzudzɔ na Baal, ne woatsɔ ado dziku nam la ta. Jeremya nɔ xaxa me.

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Yehowa na menyae, eye medze sii; tete nèɖe woƒe nuwɔwɔwo fiãm ɣemaɣi.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Ke nye la mele abe alẽvi mamlã, si wokplɔ yina wuwu ge ene, nyemenyae be, woɖo la me ɖe ŋunye o be: Mina míawu ati la kple eƒe tsetsewo, eye míatsrɔ̃e ɖa le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi, ne womagaɖo ŋu eƒe ŋkɔ azɔ o.

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Ke wò Yehowa Zebaot, amesi drɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe, eye nèdoa ayikuwo kple dziwo kpɔna la, na makpɔ wò hlɔ̃biabiawo ɖe wo ŋu, elabena asiwò me metsɔ nye nya ɖee.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Anatot-ŋutsu, siwo le wò ku dim le gbɔgblɔm be: Megagblɔ nya ɖi le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me, ne míaƒe asi magawu wò o la, enye si.

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, mahe to na wo: Ɖekakpuiwo aku ɖe yi nu, eye woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo aku ɖe dɔwuame si me;

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: woƒe amea ɖeke makpɔtɔ o, elabena mahe dzagbevɔ̃e ava Anatot-ŋutsuwo dzi le ƒe, si me mahe to na wo.

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Yehowa, ne meɖe, mahe nya kpli wò la, towo dzɔna, gake maɖi ʋɔnu kpli wò. Nukata ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ dzea edzi na wo, eye eme nyona na ame tovowo katã ɖo?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Ede woƒe agunu to, eye wòto ke, wotsi, eye wotsea ku hã. Etsɔ de woƒe nu gbɔ, ke èle adzɔgedzɔgee na woƒe dzi.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: Ke wò, Yehowa, edze sim, èkpɔm, eye nedo nye dzi kpɔ le ɖokuiwò gbɔ. He wo ɖawu abe alẽwo ene, eye naɖo wo ɖi hena wuwugbe.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣi anyigba naxa nu ase ɖo, eye gbe naƒu le anyigba blibo la dzi le edzi nɔlawo ƒe vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ta, lãwo kple xewo natsrɔ̃, le esi wole gbɔgblɔm be, makpɔ míaƒe nuwuwu o la ta?

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Mia kple afɔzɔlawo miaƒu du, eye ɖeɖi te ŋuwò, aleke nahayi duɖime ke ge kple sɔwo? Eli bɔkɔɔ le gbɔɖeme nyigba dzi, aleke nahawɔ le Yordan ƒe aƒlatsuwo me?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Elabena nɔviwòwo kple tofowò ƒemetɔwo hã trɔ le yowòme, woawo hã le ɣli dom ɖe yowòme sesĩe, megaɖo dzi ɖewo ŋu o, nenye be, wole nya ŋɔŋɔe gblɔm na wò hã.

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Megblẽ nye aƒe ɖi, megbe nye domenyinu, eye metsɔ nusi gbɔ nye luʋɔ melɔ̃a nu le o la, de asi na eƒe futɔwo.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: Nye domenyinu zu nam abe dzata le ave me ene, ele gbe tem ɖe ŋunye, eyata melé fui.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye xe ƒonu ŋɔŋɔe enye nye domenyinu nam oa? Ɖe xe ƒonuwo meƒo xlãe godoo oa? Miɖaƒo gbemelãwo katã nu ƒu, ne woava ɖu nu!

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Lãkplɔvi geɖewo gblẽ nye weingble, wonyã avuzi le nye agble me, eye wowɔ nye dzidzɔkpɔgble wòzu gbegbe ɖeɖe sɔŋ.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Nugblẽlawo va to ƒeƒlewo katã ta me te gbe dzi; elabena Yehowa ƒe yi le nu ɖum tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ɖaseɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenu; ŋutifafaa ɖeke meli na ŋutilãwo katã o.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Woƒã lu, ke ŋu woaxa, woku kutri, ke viɖe manɔ eme na wo o; ale ŋu akpe mi ɖe miaƒe agblemenuwo ŋu le Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe heliheli la ta. Nyagblɔɖi le dukɔ bubuwo ŋuti.

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe nye aƒelika vɔ̃ɖiawo katã, siwo de asi nusi metsɔ na nye dukɔ Israel, be wòanye etɔ la ŋu la ŋuti enye si: Kpɔ ɖa, maho wo ɖa tso woƒe anyigba dzi, eye maho Yuda ƒe aƒe la ɖa le wo dome.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Ke ne meho wo ɖa megbe la, magakpɔ nublanui na wo, eye mana amesiame nagbugbɔ ayi eƒe domenyinu gbɔ, eye amesiame nayi eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Eye ne wosrɔ̃ nye dukɔ ƒe mɔwo, be woaka atam le nye ŋkɔ me, abe alesi wòfiã nye dukɔ be, woata Baal ene be: „Meta Yehowa ƒe agbe“ la, ekema woaɖo wo gɔme anyi ɖe nye dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ke ne womeɖo to o la, ekema maho dukɔ sia ɖa, eye matsrɔ̃e gbidigbidi, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Ble Yehowa gblɔ nam enye si: Yi naɖaƒle aklala lidziblanu, eye natsɔe abla ali dzii, ke megana woade tsi me o.

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Tete meƒle alidziblanu la le Yehowa ƒe nya la nu hetsɔ bia ali dzii.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: Tsɔ alidziblanu, si nèƒle wòle ali na wò la, eye natso ayi Frat nu aɖaɣlae ɖe kpeto me le afima.

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke geɖe megbe la Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Tso nayi Frat nu naɖatsɔ alidziblanu, si megblɔ na wò be, naɣla ɖe afima la.

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Tete meyi Frat nu, eye meku alidziblanu la le teƒe, si meɣlae ɖo; kpo ɖa, alidziblanu la nyunyɔ, wɔnaa ɖeke megale eŋu o.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va gbɔnye bena:

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Alea ke magblẽ Yuda ƒe dàda kple Yerusalem ƒe dàda gã lae.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Dukɔ vɔ̃ɖi sia, si gbe nye nyawo sese, wole zɔzɔm le woƒe dzimesesẽ nu, wodze mawu tutɔwo yome, eye wosubɔ wo hede ta agu na wo la, anɔ abe alidziblanu sia, si ŋu wɔnaa ɖeke megale o la ene.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Alesi alidziblanu noa ali na ŋutsui la, nenema memiã Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la kple Yuda ƒe aƒe blibo la ɖe ɖokuinye ŋui, ne wòanye dukɔ, ŋkɔ, kafukafu kple atsyɔ̃ nam, ke womeɖo to o.

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ nya sia na wo bena: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Woaku wein ɖe goewo katã me banaa. Ke ne woɖo ŋu na wò be: Ɖe míenyae be, wokua wein ɖe goe sia goe me banaa o hã la,

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: ekema nagblɔ na wo bena, ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ ahamumu ayɔ anyigba sia dzinɔlawo katã kple fia, siwo le Dawid ƒe zi dzi, nunɔlawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo kpakple Yerusalemtɔwo katã fũ.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Maxlã wo ɖe wo nɔewo, fofowo kple viwo siaa; nyemave wo nu o, nyemakpɔ wo ta o, eye nyemakpɔ nublanui agbe wo tsɔtsrɔ̃ o. Woakplɔ dukɔ la adzoe.

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Misee, eye miƒu to anyi; miganɔ dadam o, elabena Yehowa le nu ƒom.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Miɖe bubu Yehowa, mia Mawu la ŋu, hafi ne blukɔ nava do, hafi miaƒe afɔ nava kli blukɔ ƒe towo, eye mianɔ mo kpɔm na kekeli, gake wòana woazu tsizi, eye wòana viviti nado.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ke ne miegbe toɖoɖo la, ekema nye luʋɔ afa avi le adza me le dàda la ŋuti, eye nye ŋkuwo afa aɖatsi yoyoyo, le esi wokplɔ Yehowa ƒe lãhawo dzoe ta.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na fia kple fia srɔ̃ bena: Mibɔbɔ nɔ anyi me, elabena miaƒe atsyɔ̃fiakuku ge le mia ta!

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Wotu dziehe-duwo ƒe agbowo, eye amea ɖeke meʋu wo o; woɖe aboyo Yuda katã, woɖe aboyo wo petepete.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Fɔ kɔ dzi nakpɔ amesiwo tso anyiehe gbɔna la ɖa! Afika wò lãha, siwo wotsɔ na wò, wò alẽha nyoawo le?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Aleke nagblɔ, nenye be etsɔ xɔ̃wò, siwo ƒe nu ma wò la, ɖo tatɔwo ɖe nuwo? Ɖe màlé ku abe nyɔnu, si le vi dzim la ene oa?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ne ègblɔ le wò dzi me be: Nukata nusia dzɔ ɖe ye dzi hã la, le wò vodada gbogboawo tae woklo taɖedzi le ŋuwò, eye woɖe ƒuƒlu wò afɔkpodzi ɖo.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Ne ame yibɔ ate ŋu atrɔ eƒe ŋutigbalẽ, eye lãkle atrɔ eƒe agbalẽ ŋɔtaŋɔta la, ekema mi, amesiwo nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ mã la hã, miate ŋu awɔ nu nyui.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Eyata makaka wo ahlẽ abe gbe ƒuƒu le tagbaya nu ene.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Esia nye wò dzidzenu kple tɔwò gome, si nudzidze na wò, elabena èŋlɔm be, eye neɖo dzi ɖe alakpadada ŋu.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Eyata nye hã meklo taɖedzi le ŋgɔgbe na wò, ne woakpɔ wò ŋukpe ƒe.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: Mekpe wò ahasiwɔwɔ, wò gbetete, wò amatrewɔwɔ vivivo kple wò ŋunyɔnuwɔwɔwo le togbɛwo dzi le gbegbe. Yerusalem, baba na wò! Ɣekaɣi gɔ̃ hafi ŋuwò nakɔ?

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe gbe, si va na Yeremya le kuɖiɖi ta:

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Bubumewo dɔa wo teviwo ɖona ɖe tsiduƒe, wovaa vudowo gbɔ, ke womekpɔa tsia ɖeke o, eye wotrɔna gbɔna ƒuƒlu kple woƒe zeawo; ŋukpe léa wo, eye woƒe mo tsia dã, eye wotsyɔa nu ta.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe léa agbledelawo, eye wotsyɔa nu ta, elabena agbleawo gblẽ, le esi tsi megadza ɖe anyigba dzi o la.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Zinɔ le gbe mè ke hã dzia vi gblẽna ɖi, elabena gbe mumua ɖeke megali o.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Gbetedziwo tsia tre ɖe to ƒeƒlewo ta me nɔa ya nom abe amegãxiwo ene; nu tea woƒe ŋkuwo ŋu, elabena gbea ɖeke megali o.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ne miaƒe vodadawo le ɖase ɖim le mia ŋu la, ekema wo nu le wò ŋkɔ la ta; elabena miaƒe tosesẽwo do so gbɔ, ŋuwóe míewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖo.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: Wò Israel ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ, wò eƒe xɔnametɔ le hiãɣi, nukaŋuti nèbe, yeanɔ anyigba la dzi abe amedzro ene, eye abe mɔzɔla, si tu eƒe agbadɔ, be woatsi adɔ la ene?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèbe, yeanɔ abe ŋutsu, si ƒo dzi ɖe le kple kalẽtɔ, si mate ŋu axɔ na ame o la ene? Yehowa, èle mía dome, eye woyɔa wò ŋkɔ de mía ŋu, màgagblẽ mí di o!

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ na dukɔ sia enye si: Tsa glãla tsatsa nyo wo ŋu, eye womexe mɔ na woƒe afɔwo o, eyata woƒe nu menyo Yehowa ŋu o ɖo; azɔ aɖo ŋu woƒe vodadawo, eye wòahe to le woƒe nuvowo ta.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena; Megaɖe kuku ɖe dukɔ sia ƒe nyui ta o.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Ne wotsi nu dɔ la, nyemase woƒe konyifafa o, eye ne wosa numevɔ kple nuɖuvɔ la, madze ŋunye o; boŋ matsɔ yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ atsrɔ̃ wòe.

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ bena: Oo, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, kpo ɖa, nyagblɔɖilawo le gbɔgblɔm na wo be: Miele yi alo dɔwuame kpɔ ge o, ke boŋ ŋutifafa mavɔ mana mi le afisia.

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Alakpanya gblɔm nyagblɔɖilawo le ɖi le nye ŋkɔ me, nyemedɔ wo o, nyemede se na wo o, eye nyemeƒo nu kpli wo o; alakpaŋutega, afakaka, trɔ̃subɔsubɔ kple woƒe dziwo ƒe amebeble gblɔm wole na mi.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe nyagblɔɖila, siwo nyemedɔ o, hafi wole nya gblɔm ɖi le nye ŋkɔ me be: Yi kple dɔwuame manɔ anyigba sia dzi o la ŋu enye si: Yi kple dɔwuame awu nyagblɔɖila mawo.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Eye dɔwuame kple yi atsɔ amesiwo wole nya gblɔm ɖi na la aƒu Yerusalem-kpɔdomeewo, eye womaɖi wo o, woawo kple wo srɔ̃wo, woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo siaa, eye matrɔ woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ akɔ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Eye wò la gblɔ nya sia na wo bena: Nye ŋku le aɖatsi fam zã kple keli, eye madzudzɔ o, elabena wogbã nye dukɔ ƒe nyɔnuvi, ɖetugbi, wote eŋu, eye wòxɔ abi vevie!

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Ne meyi gbe me la, amesiwo tsi yi nu li, eye ne meva du me la, kpɔ ɖa, amesiwo dɔ te wo ŋu li; elabena nyagblɔɖilawo kple nunɔlawo siaa yina ɖe anyigba, si womenya o la dzi.

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Ɖe nègbe Yuda godooa, eye ɖe Zion ƒe nu ti kɔ na wò luʋɔa? Nukaŋuti nèƒo mí, ale be hayahaya megale mía ŋu o? Miele futɔ kpɔm na ŋutifafa, ke nu nyuia ɖeke meva o, miele mɔ kpɔm na hayahayaɣi, ke ŋɔdzi li!

english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, míedze si miaƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo kple mía fofowo ƒe vodadawo be, miewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Megagbe mí o, le wò ŋkɔ la ta, megaɖi gbɔ wò ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe fiazikpui la o; ɖo ŋui, eye megatu wò nu, si nèbla kpli mi la o.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ɖe tsinala le dukɔwo ƒe trɔ wo domea, eye ɖe dziƒo ate ŋu ana tsi nadza? De menye wò Yehowa ye nye mía Mawu oa? Asiwò nu kpɔm miele, elabena wòe wɔ nusiawo katã!

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Ne Mose kple Samuel wotsi tre ɖe ŋkunye me hã la, nye dzi matrɔ ɖe dukɔ sia ŋu o. Nyã wo ɖa le ŋkunye me, ne woadzo.

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Eye ne wogblɔ na wò be, afika yi ge yewoala hã la, ekema ɖo ŋu na wo be: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Amesi woɖo ɖi na ku la, neyi ku gbɔ, amesi woɖo ɖi na yi la, neyi yi gbɔ, amesi woɖo ɖi na dɔwuame la, neyi dɔwuame gbɔ, eye amesi woɖo ɖi na aboyo la, neyi aboyome.

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Maɖo nu ene ƒomevi ɖe wo ŋu: Yi, ne wòawu wo, avũ wo, ne woahe wo dranyidranyi, dziƒoxewo kple gbemelãwo, ne woaɖu wo, eye woatsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Eye mana woanye bibi na anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo katã le Yuda-fia Xizkiya vi Manase ta, le nusi wòwɔ le Yerusalem la ŋuti.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Elabena Yerusalem, ameka akpɔ nublanui na wò, ameka ado baba na wò, eye ameka ava gbɔwò abia wò lãme ta ase?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Egbem, eye nède megbe, eyata mado nye asi ɖa ɖe ŋuwò, eye matsrɔ̃ wò, nublanuikpɔkpɔ tim.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Eyata matsɔ lugbɔnu agbɔ wò le anyigba la ƒe agbowo nu, maɖe vi lé nye dukɔ, si gbe tɔtrɔ tso eƒe mɔwo dzi la ŋu, eye matsrɔ̃e.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Woƒe ahosiwo asɔ gbɔ wu ƒutake; makplɔ nugblẽla aƒu ɖekakpuiwo dada le ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ, mana vɔvɔ̃ kple ŋɔdzi nava wo dzi kpoyi.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Nu te vi adre nɔ ŋu, eye eƒe luʋɔ dzo le eme; eƒe ɣe ɖo to le keli me, ŋukpe lée, eye eƒe mo tsi dã; matsɔ eƒe ame susɔeawo ade asi na yi le eƒe futɔwo nu, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Danye, baba nam be, nèdzi nye, amesi ŋu xexeame blibo la le avu kple dzre wɔm ɖo! Nyemedo nugbana o, eye amea ɖeke medo agbana nam o tso, hafi wo katã wole ɖiŋu dom nam.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Vava, mali ke wò hena nyuie, vava, mana ketɔ la naƒo koko na wò le dzɔgbevɔ̃eɣi kple hiãɣi.

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: Matsɔ wò kesinɔnuwo kple wò nu xɔasiwo ana woaha, eye womaxe fe ɖe wo ta o, le wò nuvɔ̃, siwo katã nèwɔ le wò anyigbawo katã dzi la ta,

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: eye mana nasubɔ wò futɔwo le anyigba, si mènya o la dzi. Elabena dzo le bibim le nye dɔmedzoe me, miawo ŋue wòle bibim ɖo. Akɔfafa na Yeremya.

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Yehowa, ènyae, ɖo ŋku dzinye, eye naɖe ŋku ɖe ŋunye, netsɔ nabia hlɔ̃ yonyemetilawo nam; megawɔ nu ɖewo dzigbɔgbɔ blewu la nu o; tso nam, eye nanyae be, tawòe ŋukpe le dzinye ɖo.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Esi wò nyawo ɖo gbɔnye la, memi wo, eye wò nyawo nye vivisese kple dzidzɔ na nye dzi, elabena wo ŋkɔe woyɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Nyemebɔbɔ nɔ nukolawo dome le dzidzɔ kpɔm o, ke boŋ nye ɖeka mebɔbɔ no aga le wò alɔ ta, elabena ètsɔ dziku yɔ menye fũ.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nye vevesesewo anɔ anyi ɖaa, eye nye abiwo anye abi vɔ̃e agbe kuku? Ezu nam abe tɔʋu, si blea ame, kple tsi, si metɔna ɖi o la ene.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ne ètrɔ ɖe ŋunye la, matrɔ ɖe ŋuwò, eye atsi tre ɖe ŋkunye me. Eye ne eɖe nu nyuiwo ɖe go, menye gbegblẽawo o la, ekema anye nye nu; woawo atrɔ ɖe ŋuwò, ke wòa matrɔ ɖe wo ŋu o.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Matsɔ wò awɔ, akɔbligli sesẽ na dukɔ sia, eye ne wowɔ aʋa kpli wò la, womakpe dziwò o, elabena meli kpli wò, ne maxɔ na wò, eye maɖe wò;

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: maɖe wò le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me, eye maxɔ wò le ŋutasẽlawo ƒe fego me.

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: Megaɖe srɔ̃ o, ne màgadzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo ɖe teƒe sia o.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Dɔvɔ̃ awu wo, womafa na wo o, womaɖi wo o, eye woanye gbeɖuɖɔ ɖe anyigba dzi; yi kple dɔwuame atsrɔ̃ wo, eye woƒe kukuawo anye nuɖuɖu na dziƒoxewo kple gbemelãwo.

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Megayi ahoxɔ me o, megayi kuteƒe o, eye megado baba na wo o; elabena meɖe nye ŋutifafa, amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ɖa le dukɔ sia ŋu, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Tsitsiawo kple ɖeviawo aku le anyigba sia dzi, womaɖi wo o, eye womafa na wo o, womasi blinui o, eye womalũ ta kokoe le wo ta o.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Womaɖu yɔƒenu ahatsɔ afa akɔ na ame ɖokui le ame kuku ta o, eye womano yɔƒeha le ame fofo kple ame dada ta o.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: Megayi aglotuƒe, ne nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi aɖu nu, ano nu kpli wo o.

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsi aseyetsotso ƒe ɖiɖi, dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ƒe ɖiɖi, ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ƒe gbe kple ŋugbetɔ ƒe gbe nu le teƒe sia le mia ŋku me le mia ŋɔli.

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: Eye ne èto nya siawo katã na dukɔ sia, eye wogblɔ na wò be: Nukaŋuti Yehowa ɖo dzɔgbevɔ̃e gã siawo katã ɖe mia ŋu, vo ka míeda, eye nuvɔ̃ ka míewɔ ɖe Yehowa, mía Mawu la ŋu hã la,

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: ekema naɖo ŋu na wo bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Elabena mia fofowo gblẽm ɖi, eye wodze mawu tutɔwo yome, wosubɔ wo, eye wode ta agu na wo, ke wogblẽ nye ya ɖi, eye womelé nye seawo me ɖe asi o.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Ke miawo miewɔ nu gbegblẽ wu mia fofowo, mia dome amesiame dze eƒe dzimesesẽ vɔ̃ɖi yome, eye miegbe toɖoɖom.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Eyata matsɔ mi aƒu gbe tso anyigba sia dzi ɖe anyigba, si mia kple mia fofowo mienya o la dzi, gama miasubɔ mawu tutɔwo le zã kple keli, elabena nyemele mia nu ve ge o. Woagakplɔ Israel tso Babel.

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Eyata, kpo ɖa, ŋkekewo li gbɔna, esi womagagblɔ azɔ be, yewotà Yehowa, amesi kplɔ Israel-viwo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ƒe agbe o;

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ke boŋ yewotà Yehowa, amesi kplɔ Israel-viwo tso anyiehe-nyigba kple anyigba, siwo katã dzi wònyã wo ɖo ɖo dzi la ƒe agbe. Magakplɔ wo agbo va woƒe anyigba, si metsɔ na wo fofowo la dzi.

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, mado ɖɔkplɔla geɖewo ɖa, ne woaɖe wo; emegbe madɔ adela geɖewo ɖa, ne woayɔ wo ɖe nu tso towo katã kple togbɛwo katã dzi kpakple agatowo me.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Elabena nye ŋku le woƒe mɔwo katã ŋu, womeɣla ɖem o, eye woƒe vodadawo mebe ɖe nye ŋkuwo o.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Gbagbiãgba la maxe woƒe vodadawo kple woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋu fe na wo zigbɔ zi eve, elabena wotso woƒe nu makɔmakɔwo ƒe kukuwo gblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye anyigba, eye wotso woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo yɔ nye domenyinu la dzi fũ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: Yehowa, wòe nye míaƒe ŋusẽ, míaƒe mɔ̃ sesẽ kple míaƒe sitsoƒe le hiãɣi! Dukɔwo atso anyigba ƒe mlɔeanuwo ava gbɔwò agble bena: Alakpa ɖeɖe sɔŋ mía fofowo tso nyi domee, toflokowo wonye, eye womele ɖeke me o.

english_verse: worthless idols made by human hands.”
translation_verse: Ɖe amegbetɔ awɔ mawuwo na eɖokui, siwo menye Mawu wonye oa?

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Eyata mana wòadze si nye alɔ kple nye ŋusẽ, mana wòadze sii, eye woanyae be, ŋkɔnyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Wotsɔ ganuŋlɔnu kple lotamekpe tsutsuẽ ŋlɔ Yuda ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖe woƒe dzi ƒe nuŋlɔkpe dzi kple woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo ƒe dzowo ŋu.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo kple woƒe Aserawo, siwo le ati damawo te kple togbɛ kɔkɔwo ta me la, le ŋku dzi na wo abe wo viwo ene.

english_verse: So I'll take everything you own, including your altars, and give it all to your enemies.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye to le agble me, wò kesinɔnuwo kple wò nu xɔasiwo katã kpakple wò nuxeƒewo ana woaha, le nuvɔ̃, siwo nèwɔ le wò anyigbawo katã dzi la ŋuti.

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Eye aɖe asi le wò domenyinu, si metsɔ na wò la ŋu, eye mana nasubɔ wò futɔwo le anyigba, si menya o la dzi, elabena miede dzo nye dɔmedzoe la me, eye wòabi tegbee.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Aɖi ŋutsu, si ƒe dzi te ɖa le Yehowa ŋu, eye wòle dzi ɖom ɖe amegbetɔ ŋu hetsɔ ŋutilã wɔ eƒe alɔe la ŋuti kpekpekpe!

english_verse: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.
translation_verse: Anɔ abe fekplɔ le gbegbe ene, eye ne dzɔgbenyuie va la, makpɔe o, anɔ kuɖiɖinyigba dzi kple dzeƒee le tagba, afisi menye ame nɔƒe o.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Woayra ŋutsu, si ɖoa dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu, ame ƒe nu ɖoŋuɖeŋua enye Yehowa!

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Eyama le abe ati, si wodo ɖe tɔ to, eye wòɖe ke ɖe tɔʋu ŋu la ene; ne ŋdɔ le vevem la, mevɔ̃na o, eye eƒe aŋgbawo dea ama; ne ku ɖi hã, metsia dzimaɖi o, eye wonɔa tsetse dzi ɖaa.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe dzi la, alakpatɔ wònye wu nuwo katã, nu gbegblẽ wònye, ameka ahadze sii ma?

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Nye Yehowa ye dzroa dziwo me, eye meɖoa ayikuwo me kpɔna; maɖo eteƒe na amesiame ɖe eƒe zɔzɔ kple eƒe nuwɔnawo ƒe kutsetse nu.

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Amesi ƒo kesinɔnu nu ƒu, ke menye to dzɔdzɔenyenye mɔ dzi o la, ele abe tegli, si ƒo vi, gake menye eya ŋutɔe ɖa azi la o la ene; agblẽe ɖi le eƒe agbenɔnɔ titina, eye le nuwuwu me la azu bometsila.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe fiazikpui, si ɖo kpo tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la, enye míaƒe kɔkɔeƒe la nɔƒe.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: Wò Yehowa, Israel ƒe nukpɔkpɔ, amesiwo katã gblẽ wò ɖi la ŋu akpe wo! Woaŋlɔ amesiwo ɖe megbe le ŋuwò la ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe kewɔ me; elabena wogblẽ Yehowa, tsi gbagbe vudo la ɖi!

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa, yɔ dɔm, ne mahaya, xɔ nam, ne woaɖem, elabena wòe nye nye kafukafu.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ame kemeawo le gbɔgblɔm nam be: Afika Yehowa ƒe nya tsi? Neva dzro!

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Nyemegbe be, maganye lãkplɔvi le yowome o, eye ŋkeke vɔ̃e la medzrom o, wò ŋutɔ ènyae; nya, si do tso nye nuyi me la, nɔ nyanya na wò.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Meganye ŋɔdzi nam o dzro, wò, nye sitsoƒe le dzɔgbevɔ̃eɣi.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Ŋu nekpe yonyemetilawo, ke nye la, ŋu megakpem o, dzi neɖe le wo ƒo, ke dzi megaɖe le nye ya ƒo o. He dzɔgbevɔ̃eɣi va wo dzi, eye nagbã wo gudugudu agagbã wo ɖe dzi! Miwɔ Sabat kɔkɔe.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: eye nagblɔ na wo bena; Mi Yuda-fiawo kple Yuda blibo la kpakple mi Yerusalemtɔwo katã, mi amesiwo gena ɖe agbo siawo me la, mise Yehowa ƒe nya!

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nenye be, mieɖo tom, mietsɔ agba ge ɖe ɖu sia ƒe agbowo me le dzudzɔgbe la dzi o, eye miekɔ dzudzɔgbe la ŋu, miewɔ dɔa ɖeke le edzi o la,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: ekema fiawo kple amegãwo, amesiwo abɔbɔ nɔ Dawid ƒe fiazikpui dzi la, aɖo tasiaɖamwo, eye woaɖo sewo age ɖe du sia ƒe agbowo me, woawo kple woƒe amegãwo. Yuda-ŋutsuwo kple Yerusalemtɔwo siaa, eye woanɔ du sia me tegbee.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Eye amewo atso Yuda-duwo kple Yerusalem-nutowo me, tso Benyamin-nyigba dzi, tso balimewo kple towo dzi kpakple tso dziehe, eye woahe numevɔsa, akpedavɔsa, nuɖuvɔsa kple dzudzɔʋeʋẽedonu vɛ, eye woatsɔ kafukafuvɔsa ava Yehowa ƒe me.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Ke ne miegbe toɖoɖom, miekɔ dzudzɔgbe la ŋu o, eye mietsɔ agba ge ɖe Yerusalem ƒe agbowo me le dzudzɔgbe dzi la, ekema mado dzo ɖe eƒe agbowo nu, be wòafiã Yerusalem ƒe fiasãwo, eye matsi o.

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: Tso, nayi zemela ƒe me, afima mana nase nye nyawo le.

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Tete meyi zemela ƒe me, eye kpɔ ɖa, ele dɔ wɔm le zemenu dzi.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Eye ne ze, si mena wòle la gblẽ, abe alesi tsu dia wɔwɔ le zemela si me godoo ene la, ekema zemela la tsɔnɛ woa ze bubui, alesi dze eŋu wòbe, yeawɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va gbɔnye bena:

english_verse: People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Israel ƒe aƒe, ɖe nyemate ŋu awɔ mi, abe alesi zemela sia wona ene oa? Israel ƒe aƒe, kpo ɖa, alesi tsu le zemela si mee la, nenema miele asinye mee!

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Fifia meƒo nu kple dukɔ kple fiaɖuƒea ɖe, be mahoe ɖa, magbãe, eye matsrɔ̃e;

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: ke ne ewo nusi nye vɔ̃ le ŋkunye me, eye meɖo to nye gbe o la, ekema nyuie, si megblɔ be, mawo nɛ la, avem.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Azɔ gblɔ na Yuda-ŋutsuwo kple Yerusalemtɔwo bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, meɖo dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖe mia ŋu, eye meɖo ta me ɖe mia ŋu. Mia dome amesiame netrɔ tso eƒe mo vɔ̃wo dzi, eye miɖo miaƒe zɔzɔme kple miaƒe nuwɔnawo ɖo.

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Ke wogblɔ bena: Dzodzroe! Elabena míazɔ ɖe míaƒe susuwo nu, eye mía dome amesiame awu nu ɖe eƒe dzimesesẽ vɔ̃ɖi nu.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Mibia se le dukɔwo dome be, ameka se esia tɔgbe kpo hã? Nu gbegblẽ ŋutɔŋutɔ Israel-ɖetugbi wɔ.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: De Libanon ƒe sno dzona ɖa le towo ƒe agakpewo dzia, eye ɖe to gã fafɛ, siwo le sisim la miena?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Elabena nye dukɔ la ŋlɔm be, eye wódoa dzudzɔ na nu dzodzroawo, siwo kplɔa wo ɖa tsoa woƒe mo, si nye toƒe mava la dzi, ne woazɔ mɔ kple toƒe xexewo;

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: ne woana woƒe anyigba nazu gbegbe kple alɔmeɖenu tegbee, ne amea ɖe to eŋu yina la, eƒe nu aku, eye woaʋuʋu ta.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Makaka wo ahlẽ le woƒe futɔwo nu abe ɣedzeƒeya ene, matrɔ ʋume ade wo le woƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃gbe, eye menye ŋku me o. Yeremya ƒe konyifafa kple gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ bena: Mina míaɖo nugbe ɖe Yeremya ŋu; elabena nufiame mabu ɖe nunɔlawo o, adaŋudede mabu ɖe nunyalawo loo, alo nya nabu ɖe nyagblɔɖilawo o. Eyata mina míatsɔ aɖe aƒo Yeremya, eye míagalé to ɖe eƒe nyawo katã ŋu o.

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: Yehowa, lé to ɖe ŋunye, eye nase nye ketɔwo ƒe gbe.

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Ɖe wotsɔa vɔ̃ ɖoa nyuie teƒe, hafi woawo ɖe ʋe na nye luʋɔa? Ɖo ŋu, alesi metsi tre ɖe ŋkuwò me, be magblɔ nya nyui ɖe wo ŋu, ne wò dziku nu nafa ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Eyata tso woƒe ŋutsuviwo de asi na dɔwuame, eye naxlã wo ɖe yi nu, na woaɖe vi le wo srɔ̃wo ŋu, eye woazu ahosi, ku natsrɔ̃ woƒe ŋutsuwo ɖa, eye yi ne wu woƒe ɖekakpuiwo le aʋa me.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Wòase ɣlikpɛ le woƒe aƒewo me, ne èkplɔ adzohawo va ƒo ɖe wo dzi kpoyi; elabena woɖe ʋe, be yewoatsɔ aɖem, eye woɖo mɔ̃ na nye afɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi; Yi naɖaƒle ze le zemela si, eye naɖe dukɔ la ƒe ame tsitsiwo kple nunɔlawo ƒe ame tsitsiwo akpe ɖe ɖokuiwò ŋu

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: nayi Ben-Hinom-bali me, si le zemegboa ŋgɔdze la me, eye naɖe gbe ƒã nya, siwo gblɔ ge mala na wò la le afima.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Mi Yuda-fiawo kple mi Yerusalemtɔwo, mise Yehowa ƒe nya! Ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, mele dzɔgbevɔ̃e he ge ava teƒe sia dzi, eye amesiwo katã see la ƒe tome laɖi yeŋ;

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: wodi nuxeƒewo na Baal, ne woata dzo wo viwo abe numevɔsa ene na Baal, nusi nyemeɖo na wo o, nyemegblɔe na wo, alo wòahayi nye ta me va ge gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkekewo li gbɔna, esi womagayɔ teƒe sia be Tofet kple Ben-Hinom-bali me o, ke boŋ be amewubalime.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Magblẽ Yuda kple Yerusalem ƒe adaŋudede me le teƒe sia, eye mana woatsi woƒe futɔwo ƒe yi nu kple amesiwo le woƒe ku dim la si me, eye matso woƒe kukuawo ana dziƒoxewo kple gbemelãwo woaɖu.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Mana du sia nazu gbegbe kple alɔmeɖenu; amesiame, si to eŋu yina la ƒe nu aku le eƒe fuɖenamewo katã ŋu, eye wòaɖe alɔme le eŋu.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Mana woaɖu woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple woƒe nyɔnuviwo ƒe lã, eye amesiame naɖu ehavi ƒe lã le toɖeɖe kple xaxa, siwo woƒe futɔwo kple amesiwo le woƒe ku dim la, kplɔ ƒu wo la me.

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: Eye nagbã ze la le ŋutsu, siwo yi kpli wò la ŋku me,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: ahagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi; Alea magbã dukɔ sia kple du siae, abe alesi wogbãa zemela ƒe ze eye womegatea ŋu trenɛ o la ene, eye woaɖi ame ɖe Tofet, le esi ameɖiƒe le vevem ta.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Eye mado gu Yerusalem-xɔwo kple Yuda-fiawo ƒe xɔwo abe teƒe Tofet ene, xɔ, siwo katã ta me wodo dzudzɔ le na dziƒo ŋu nuwo katã, eye woƒo tsi ɖe anyi na mawu tutɔwo le.

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Eye Yeremya gbɔ tso Tofet, afisi Yehowa ɖoe ɖo, be wòaɖagblɔ nya ɖi le la, etsi tre ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnu hegblɔ na dukɔ blibo la bena:

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e, siwo katã megblɔ ɖe wo ŋu la, ava du sia kple eƒe duwo katã dzi; elabena wolia ʋume goŋgoŋ hegbe nye nyawo sese.

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Esi nunɔla Pasxur, Imer vi, amesi nye dzikpɔlawo ƒe amegã le Yehowa ƒe me la, se Yeremya le nya siawo gblɔm ɖi la,

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Pasxur ƒo nyagblɔɖila Yeremya, eye wòbɔ pãe ɖe Benyamin-gbo dzigbeta, si le Yehowa ƒe aƒe ŋu la nu.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Eye esi ŋu ke ɖa, Pasxur na woɖaɖe Yeremya le pã me. Tete Yeremya gblɔ nɛ bena: Yehowa megayɔ wò be Pasxur azɔ o, ke boŋ „ŋɔdzi li godoo“.

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ wò awɔ ŋɔdzi na wò ŋutɔ kple xɔ̃wòwo katã, woatsi woƒe tutɔwo ƒe yi nu, eye àkpɔ eteƒe. Matsɔ Yuda blibo la ade asi na Babel-fia, aɖe aboyo wo ayi Babel, eye wòawu wo kple yi.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ke woaɖe aboyo wò Pasxur kple aƒewò me tɔwo katã, eye mia kple xɔwo, siwo katã nèka aʋatso gblɔ nya di na la, míayi Babel aku woaɖi ɖe afima. Yeremya fa konyi bena, yezu nyagblɔɖila.

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: Yehowa, eƒo nya ɖe nunye, eye melɔ̃ neƒoe ɖe nunye, èlèm sesẽ, eye nèkpe le dzinye; mezu alɔmeɖenu ŋkeke blibo la, eye wo katã wole koyem.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mebe, maƒo nu ɣesiaɣi la, ele be, manɔ ɣli dom, eye manɔ boblo dom nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ kple ŋutasesẽ; elabena Yehowa ƒe nya zu dzu kple vlododo nam ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Eye ne mebe, maɖe ŋku ɖa le edzi, eye magaƒo nu le eƒe ŋkɔ me o la, enɔa nye dzi me abe dzobibi nue wotu nu ɖo ɖe nye ƒuwo me ene, etsɔtsɔ tia ko nam, eye wògloam.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Mese ame geɖewo ƒe ameŋulili kple ŋɔdzi godoo be: „Miɖe egɔme ɖe go, ne miaɖe egɔme ɖe go“! Amesiwo katã nye xɔ̃nyewo la, le xa me ɖe nye anyidzedze ŋu be: Ɖewohĩ ana woblee, eye míaɖi ba ɖe edzi ahabia míaƒe hlɔ̃e.

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa, nye kalẽtɔ sesẽ, li kplim, eyata yonyemetilawo adze anyi, eye woƒe alɔ made dzi o, ŋu akpe wo, elabena womedze aye o, ŋukpe mavɔ, si womaŋlɔ be akpɔ o la, wòanye

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Wò Yehowa Zebaot, amesi doa ame dzɔdzɔe la kpɔna, eye nèɖea ŋku de ayiku kple dzi la, na makpɔ wò hlɔ̃biabia ɖe wo ŋu, elabena asiwò me metsɔ nye nya de?

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Yehowa, mikafu Yehowa, elabena eɖe hiãtɔ ƒe agbe tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me!

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Aɖi ŋkeke, si dzi wodzim la ŋu kpekpekpe; womayra gbesigbe danye dzim o!

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Aɖi ŋutsu, si he dzidzɔnya vɛ na fofonye be, wodzi ŋutsuvi ne, eye wòdo dzidzɔ nɛ ŋutɔ la ŋu kpekpekpe!

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ma nenɔ abe du, siwo Yehowa trɔ bu anyi, eye mevee o la ene! Nese aƒadodo le ŋdi kple aʋaɣli le ŋdɔ!

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: Elabena mewum ɖe dɔ me, ne danye nanye yɔdo nam, eye tu natsi eƒo tegbee o! Nukata medo tso danye ƒe dɔ me ɖo, ne manɔ fukpekpe kple nuxaxa kpɔm, eye nye ŋkekewo nayi le ŋukpe me?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe, si va na Yeremya, enye si, esime fia Zedekiya dɔ Pasxur, Malxiya vi, kple nunɔla Zefanya, Maaseya vi, ɖo ɖe egbɔ, ne woagblɔ bena:

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: Bia gbe Yehowa na mi, elabena Babel-fia Nebukaɖnezar le aʋa wɔm kpli mí; ɖewohĩ Yehowa awɔ na mí ɖe eƒe nukunuwo katã nu, eye wòaho adzo tso mia ŋu.

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Eye gblɔ na dukɔ sia be: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ da, metsɔ agbemɔ kple kumɔ le mia ŋku me ɖom:

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Amesi tsi du sia me la, aku de yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ si me; ke amesi do yi Kaldeatɔ, siwo de to ɖe mi gbã la, atsi agbe, eye eƒe agbe anye aboyonu nɛ.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Yehowa be; Metrɔ nye ŋku me ɖe du sia ŋu ɖe vɔ̃wɔwɔ ŋu, menye ɖe nyuiwɔwɔ ŋu o; woatsɔe ade asi na Babel-fia, ne woatɔ dzoe.

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: Eye gblɔ na Yuda-fia, Dawid ƒe aƒe la bena: Mise Yehowa ƒe nya:

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Dawid ƒe aƒe, ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe ŋdi sia ŋdi, eye mixɔ amesiwo woda adzoe la, tso ŋutasẽla si me, ne nye dziku magalé abe dzo ene, eye wòabi woade tsitsi ge ado kpoe le miaƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo ta o!

english_verse: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, maƒo ɖe dziwò, wò balime nɔla, wò gbadzaƒe ƒe agakpe, mi amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm be: Ameka aɖi abu ɖe mía dzi, eye ameka ava mia nɔƒe?

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Mahe to na mi ɖe miaƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe kutsetse nu, eye mado dzo ɖe woƒe ave me, ne wòabi woƒe nutowo katã me.

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Elabena ne miewɔ nu ɖe nya siawo nu la, ekema fia, siwo abɔbɔ nɔ Dawid ƒe zikpui dzi la, aɖo tasiaɖam, eye woaɖo sɔ age ɖe aƒe sia ƒe agbowo me, woawo kple woƒe dɔlawo kple woƒe dukɔ siaa.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ke ne mieɖo to nya siawo o la, ekema metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne aƒe sia mazu aƒedo o fĩ!

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Yuda-fia ƒe aƒe ŋu enye si: Gilead kple Libanon-ta me nènye nam, ke mawɔ wò nazu gbegbe kple du ɖiaƒedo.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Eye maɖo nugblẽlawo ɖe ŋuwò, eye wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe atsɔ eƒe lãnu alã Libanon ƒe sederti nyuitɔwo ahatsɔ de dzo me.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ geɖewo ava to du sia ŋu ayi, eye woagblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Nukata Yehowa wɔ du gã sia alea ɖo?
