english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye woaɖo ŋu bena: Elabena wogblẽ Yehowa, woƒe Mawu ƒe nubabla ɖi, eye wode ta agu na mawu tutɔwo hesubɔ wo.

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Megafa avi ɖe ame kuku ŋu o, eye megafa nɛ o, ke boŋ fa avi ɖe amesi ʋu dzo la ŋu, elabena megale tɔtrɔ ge agbɔ o, eye megale wo denyigba kpɔ ge o.

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: eya amesi gblɔna be: Matu xɔ gãwo kple dziƒoxɔ kekewo, made fesrewo wo nu, maklã sederʋuƒowo ɖe wo me, eve masi aŋɔ dze na wo!

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: Ne ele aɖika dom le sedertiwo me la, ɖe nèbuna be, eyae nye fianyenyea? Fofowò hã ɖu nu, eye wono nu, ke edrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe, eye wòwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe, eye eme nyo nɛ.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Etso na hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo, eyata eme nyo nɛ. Yehowa be: Ɖe menye esia woyɔna be sidzedzem oa?

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Elabena wò ŋku kple wò dzi le viɖe kple ame maɖifɔ ƒe ʋu kɔkɔɖeanyi kple ŋutasesẽ kpakple fuwɔame ko ŋu.

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Yuda-fia Yoyakim, Yosiya vi la ŋu enye si: Womafa nɛ be: „Ao, nɔvinyeŋutsu, ao, nɔvinyenyɔnu“ o! Eye womafa nɛ be: „Ao, nye aƒetɔ, ao, eƒe atsyɔ̃“ o!

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: De Libanon dzi nado ɣli, eye na wò gbe naɖi le Basan; do ɣli tso Abarim dzi, elabena wogbã wò ahiãviwo katã nyanyanya!

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Esi nèli bɔkɔɔ la, meƒo nu kpli wò, ke ègblɔ be, yemasee o; esia nye wò nɔnɔme tso wò ɖevime ke, be nègbe toɖoɖo nye gbe.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ya akplɔ wò lãkplɔviwo katã, eye wò ahiãviwo ayi aboyo me; ŋu akpe wò, eye wò mo atsi dã le wò nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: Wò amesi tso aƒe ɖe Libanon dzi, eye nèwɔ ato ɖe sedertiwo me, ne vevesese ƒo ɖe dziwo, eye nèlé ku abe nyɔnu, si le vi dzim ene la, aleke màhaɖe hũi o!

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Mefa ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ɖe wònye ŋkosigɛ nye Yuda-fia Xonya, Yoyakim vi la, le nye ɖusi la, anye ne maɖee aƒu gbe tso gama,

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: ahatsɔ wò ade asi na amesiwo le wò ku dim, kple amesiwo le ŋɔ dzim na wò, eye matsɔ wò ade asi na Babel-fia Nebukadnezar kple Kaldeatɔwo.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Matsɔ mia kple dawo, si dzi wò la, aƒu gbe ɖe anyigba tutɔ dzi, afisi womedzi mi ɖo o, eye miaku ɖe gama;

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ɖe ze gbagbã, si ɖi gbɔ, enye Xonya sia loo, alo ze, si ƒe nu menyoa amea ɖeke ŋu o la, wònyea? Nukata wonyã eya kple viawo de gbe, eye wotsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba, si womenya o la dzi?

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Anyigba, anyigba, anyigba, se Yehowa ƒe nya!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Miŋlɔ ŋutsu sia ɖi be, medzi vi o, enye ŋutsu, si naneke medze dzi na le eƒe agbe me o; elabena madze dzi na viawo dometɔa ɖeke, be wòabɔbɔ nɔ Dawid ƒe fiazikpui dzi ahaɖu le Yuda akpa o.

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Baba na lãkplɔvi, siwo tsrɔ̃ nye lãnyiƒe ƒe alẽwo, eye woka wo hlẽ la!

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ ɖe lãkplɔvi, siwo le nye dukɔa kplɔm la ŋu enye si: Miekaka nye alẽwo, mienyã wo ɖe gbe, eye miedi wo yome mɔ o, eyata mahe to na mi le miaƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiawo ta; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Maƒo nye alẽ mamleawo nu ƒu atso anyigba, siwo katã dzi menya wo ɖo ɖa la dzi, eye magakplɔ wo ava woƒe gbeɖuƒe, eye wòadzi akeke ta.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Eye maɖo lãkplɔviwo wo nu, amesiwo anyi wo; womagavɔ̃ azɔ o, dzi magaɖe le wo ƒo o, eye wo dometɔa ɖeke mabu o, Yehowa ye gblɔe.“

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkekewo li gbɔna, eye dzidzimevi dzɔdzɔea ɖe ado na Dawid, aɖu dzi abe fia ene, eye woawo nu ɖe nunya me, adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe, eye wòawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Le eŋɔli woaɖe Yuda, eye Israel ana anyi bɔkɔɔ. Eye ŋkɔ, si woava nɛ la, enye: „Yehowa, míaƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye“.

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Eyata kpɔ ɖa, ŋkekewo li gbɔna, esi womagagblɔ azɔ be, yewota Yehowa, amesi kple Israel-viwo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ƒe agbe o,

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: ke boŋ yewota Yehowa, amesi kplɔ Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe viwo tso anyiehe-nyigba kple anyigba, siwo katã dzi wònyã wo ɖo ɖa la dzi vɛ, ne woanɔ woƒe anyigba dzi la ƒe agbe. Le nyagblɔɖilawo ŋuti.

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyagblɔɖilawo ŋu: Nye dzi fli ɖe do me nam, eye nye ƒuwo katã zu behebehe; mezu abe ahamula kple ŋutsu, si wein wu ko na la ene le Yehowa kple eƒe nya kɔkɔeawo ta.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Elabena ahasitɔwo yɔ anyigba la dzi fũ, fiƒode na nu ti ka na anyigba la, eye gbegbe ƒe lãnyiƒewo ƒu, elabena woƒe zɔzɔme enye vɔ̃, eye woƒe kalẽwɔwɔ mele eteƒe o.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nyagblɔɖilawo kple nunɔlawo siaa nye ame tovowo, eye mekpɔ woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le aƒenye me ke hã.

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Elabena woƒe mɔ dzi aɖiɖi dredredre na wo le blukɔ me, eye woakli nu adze anyi le edzi; elabena mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava wo dzi le ƒe, si me mahe to na wo la, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ bometsinuwɔwɔ le nyagblɔɖila, siwo le Samaria la hã ŋu: Wogblɔ nya ɖi to Baal dzi, eye wokplɔ nye dukɔ Israel trae.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Ke mekpɔ ŋunyɔnuwɔwɔ le nyagblɔɖila, siwo le Yerusalem la ŋu: Wole amatre wɔm, wole alakpadada dzi, eye wodo ŋusẽ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ƒe asi, ale be wometrɔ tso woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo me o; wo katã le nam abe Sodom ene, eye emenɔlawo le abe Gomora ene.

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ ɖe nyagblɔɖilawo ŋu enye si: Kpɔ ɖa, mana atsa wo woaɖu, eye makpe aɖitsi na wo woano; elabena nyagblɔɖila, siwo le Yerusalem, gbɔ nu tovo wɔwɔ yi ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Migaɖo to nyagblɔɖila, siwo le nya gblɔm ɖi na mi la o; mia flum wole, eye woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzi ƒe ŋutega tom wole, menye Yehowa ƒe nu me wòtso o,

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm na amesiwo le vlo domem la be: „Eme anyo na mi“, eye wole gbɔgblɔm na amesiwo katã le zɔzɔm ɖe woƒe dzimesesẽ nu la be: „Dzɔgbevɔ̃ea ɖeke mava mia dzi o“.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi nɔ Yehowa ƒe aɖaŋu me, amesi kpɔ nu, eye wose eƒe nya, amesi léa to ɖe nye nya ŋu la, eya natsɔe aɖe gbe ƒãe!

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, Yehowa ƒe ahom kple eƒe dziku tso, eye yali abla ta na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe matrɔ kɔ o, negbe ɖeko wòawɔ eƒe dzimesusu dzi ade goe hafi; le ŋkekeawo ƒe nuwuwu la miadze sii.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Menye nyee dɔ nyagblɔɖilawo, hafi wole du ƒum o, eye menye nyee ƒo nu kpli wo, hafi wole nya gblɔm ɖi o.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Ɖe wònye ɖe wònɔ nye adaŋu me la, anye ne woɖe gbe ƒã nye nyawo na nye dukɔ, eye wòtrɔ wo tso woƒe mɔ vɔwo dzi kple woƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo me.

english_verse: I am everywhere— both near and far,
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpuiƒe ƒe Mawu ko menye, eye nyemenye adzɔge ƒe Mawu oa?

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ɖe ame aɣla ɖe ɣaɣlɛƒe, eye magbe ekpɔkpɔa? Yehowa be: Ɖe menye nyee yɔ dziƒo kple anyigba dzi taŋ oa?

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Mese nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nuƒoƒo, amesiwo le alakpanya gblɔm ɖi le nye ŋkɔ me be: Meku drɔ̃e, meku drɔ̃e!

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣi hafi nyagblɔɖila, siwo gblɔa alakpanya ɖi, amesiwo nye nyagblɔɖilawo le woƒe dzi ƒe alakpadada nu la, atrɔ ta me?

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Wo amesiwo di be, yewoatsɔ yewoƒe drɔ̃ekuku, siwo wo dome amesiame li na ehavi la, ana nye dukɔ naŋlɔ nye ŋkɔ be, abe alesi wo fofowo ŋlɔ nye ŋkɔ be le Baal ŋuti ene.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Nyagblɔɖila, si ku drɔ̃e la, nelĩ drɔ̃e, eye amesi si nye nya le la, negblɔ nye nya le nyateƒe me; tsro gbɔ nya kae tsɔ lu gbɔ nya?

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ɖe nye nya mele abe dzo ene, eye abe zũ, si agba agakpe gudugudu la ene oa?

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mado ɖe amesiwo tsɔ alakpa drɔ̃ewo gblɔa nya ɖi, eye wolia wo la dzi, amesiwo tsɔa woƒe alakpadadawo kple adegbeƒoƒowo kplɔa nye dukɔ tranae, evɔ wònye nyemedɔ wo o, eye nyemeɖo wo ɖa o hafi; womenye viɖea ɖeke na nye dukɔ o, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Eye ne dukɔ sia, nyagblɔɖila alo nunɔlaa ɖe bia wò be, nuka nye Yehowa ƒe agba hã la, ekema ɖo ŋu na wo be: Yehowa be: Miawoe nye agba la, eye matsɔ mi aƒu anyi.

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Eye ne nyagblɔɖila, nunɔla kple dukɔ la gblɔ be „Yehowa ƒe agba“ la, mahe to na ŋutsu ma kple eƒe aƒe siaa.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Ale mia dome amesiame nagblɔ na ehavi kple nɔvia enye si: Aleke Yehowa ɖo eŋui, eye nya ka Yehowa gblɔ?

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ke migakɔ nu le „Yehowa ƒe agba“ dzi azɔ o; elabena amesiame ƒe nya azu agba nɛ, le esi mietrɔ gbo Mawu gbagbe, Yehowa Zebaot, mía Mawu la ƒe nyawo ta.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ na nyagblɔɖila be: Aleke Yehowa ɖo eŋui, eye nya ka Yehowa gblɔ?

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: eyata kpɔ ɖa, makɔ mi ɖe dzi, eye matsɔ mia kple du, si metsɔ na mia kple mia fofowo la, aƒu gbe tso ŋkunye me,

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: eye mahe ŋukpe mavɔ kple vlododo mavɔ, si womaŋlɔ be akpɔ o la, ava mia dzi.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Esi Babel-fia Nebukaɖnezar ɖe aboyo Yuda-fia Yexonya, Yoyakim vi, kple Yuda-amegãwo, atikpalawo kple gbeɖewo tso Yerusalem yi Babel megbe la. Yehowa na mekpɔ gbotsetse kusi eve, si wotsɔ da ɖe Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ nu.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Gbotsetse nyui, siwo le abe gbotsetse ŋgɔgbeawo ene la, le kusi ɖeka me, eye gbotsetse gbegblẽwo le kusi evelia me, esiwo gblẽ, ale be womelé ɖuɖu me o.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam be: Yeremya, nuka kpɔm nèle? Meɖo ŋu be. Gbotsetsewoe; gbotsetse nyuitɔwo nyo ŋutɔ, eye gbegblẽawo gblẽ vevie, ale be ɖuɖu mele wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia,
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Mekpɔ nyuie ɖe Yuda ƒe aboyome, siwo menya tso teƒe sia ɖo ɖe Kaldea-nyigba dzi la ŋu, abe gbotsetse nyui siawo ene.

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye ŋku aɖo wo ŋu hena nyuiwɔwɔ, eye mana woatrɔ agba va anyigba sia dzi, matu wo, eye nyemagbã wo o, mado wo, eye nyemaho wo o.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Mana dzi wo, ne woatsɔ adze sim be, nyee nye Yehowa; woanye dukɔ nam, eye manye Mawu na wo, nenye be wotrɔ ɖe ŋunye tso woƒe dzi blibo me.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Alé Yehowa gblɔ esi: Alesi gbotsetse gbegblẽawo gblẽ, ale be ɖuɖu mele wo ŋu o la, nenema mawo Yuda-fia Zedekiya kple eƒe amegãwo, amesiwo kpɔtɔ ɖe Yerusalem, kple amesiwo susɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi, kpakple amesiwo le Egipte-nyigba dzi lae.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Matsɔ wo awɔ bibi kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e na anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo katã, woanye alɔmeɖenu, lodonu, ahamasinu kple ɖiŋudonu le teƒe, siwo katã manyã wo aɖo ɖo.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Maɖo yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ ɖe wo, vaseɖe esime woatsrɔ̃ avɔ le anyigba, si metsɔ na woawo kple wo fofowo la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖo eƒe dɔlawo katã, siwo nye nyagblɔɖilawo ɖe mi, eɖo wo ɖe mi ɖaa atraɖi: ke mieɖo to o, eye mieƒu to anyi, be miase nu o.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Egblɔ bena. Amesiame netrɔ tso eƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo dzi kple eƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo me, ne miano anyigba, si Yehowa tsa na mia kple mia fofowo tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me la dzi.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Migadze mawu fufuwo yome, ne miasubɔ wo ahade ta agu na wo o, eye migatsɔ miaƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo do dziku nam o, ekema nyemawɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke mi o.

english_verse: You refused to listen to me,
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Esi miegbe toɖoɖo nye nyawo la,

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: eyata, kpɔ ɖa, makplɔ anyiehe ƒomeawo katã kple nye dɔla Babel-fia Nebukaɖnezar vɛ, eye mana woava ƒo ɖe anyigba sia kple edzinɔlawo kple dukɔ sia katã dzi godoo, matsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi, eye matsɔ wo awɔ bibi, alɔmeɖenu kple aƒedoe tegbee; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Eye matsi aseyetsotso ƒe ɖiɖi kple dzidzɔ ƒe ɖiɖi, ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ƒe gbe kple ŋugbetɔ ƒe gbe, tetutu ƒe ɖiɖi kple akaɖi ƒe keklẽ nu le wo dome.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Anyigba sia azu aƒedo kple gbegbe, eye dukɔ sia asubɔ Babel-fia ƒe blaadre sɔŋ. Babel ƒe gbegblẽ.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ne ƒe blaadre la de vɔ la, ekema mahe to na Babel-fia kple dukɔ ma kpakple Kaldea-nyigba le woƒe vodada ta, eye matsɔe awɔ gbegbee ɖikaa.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Eye mana nye nya, siwo katã megblɔ ɖe anyigba ma ŋu la, nava edzi; nya, siwo katã Yeremya gblɔ ɖi ɖe dukɔwo katã ŋu woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Elabena woawo hã asubɔ dukɔ geɖewo kple fia gãwo, eye maɖo eteƒe na wo le woƒe nu wona kple woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo nu. Dɔmedzoe kplu la enye dukɔwo katã tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ nam enye si: Xɔ dɔmedzoe ƒe weinkplu sia le asinye, eye natsɔe na dukɔ, siwo katã gbɔ maɖo wò ɖo la, woano.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Eye ne wonoe la, woanɔ mumũm sagãsagã, eye wòadze aɖaʋa le yi, si maɖo ɖe wo dome la ta.

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Tete mexɔ kplu la le Yehowa si, eye mekpee na dukɔ, siwo katã gbɔ Yehowa ɖom ɖo;

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: na Yerusalem kple Yuda-duwo, woƒe fiawo kple woƒe amegãwo, ne mawɔ wo woazu aƒedo, bibi, alɔmeɖenu kple ɖiŋudonu, abe alesi wòle egbe sia wo ene;

english_verse: and all the foreigners who lived in the country. Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod.
translation_verse: na dukɔ tsakatsaka blibo la, Uz-nyigba dzi fiawo katã, Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi fiawo katã, Askalon, Gaza, Ekron kple Asdod ƒe ame mamleawo;

english_verse: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon,
translation_verse: na Edom, Moab kple Amon-viwo;

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: na Tiro-fiawo katã, Zidon-fiawo katã kple ƒukpowo dzi fia, siwo le atsiaƒu ƒe go keme;

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: na Arabia-fiawo katã kple dukɔ tsakatsaka, siwo le gbegbe ƒe fiawo katã;

english_verse: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
translation_verse: na anyiehe fiawo katã, esiwo le kpuiƒe kple adzɔge tso wo nɔewo gbɔ, kple xexeme fiaɖuƒe, siwo katã le anyigba dzi; eye Sesax-fia anoe ɖe wo yome.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Mino aha miamu, eye miɖe xe, midze anyi, eye migafɔ o, le yi, si maɖo ɖe mia dome la ta.

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Eye ne wogbe be, yewomaxɔ kplu la le asiwò o la, ekema gblɔ na wo be: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Mianoe kokoko!

english_verse: Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.”
translation_verse: Elabena keke ɖu, si ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo ke hã ŋue medze vɔ̃wɔwɔ gɔme ɖo, eye miawo miato le emea? Womagbe tohehe na mi o! Elabena meyɔ yi ɖe anyigbadzitɔwo katã ŋu, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: From my sacred temple I will roar like thunder, while I trample my people and everyone else as though they were grapes.
translation_verse: Eye wò la nagblɔ nya siawo katã ɖi ɖe wo ŋu agblɔ na wo bena: Yehowa le gbe ɖem tso dzi me, eye wòna eƒe gbe ɖi tso eƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la me; ele gbe ɖem ɖe eƒe lãnyiƒe ŋu, eye wòtso ayiboopɛɛ abe weinfiãlawo ene ɖe anyigbadzitɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: Howɔwɔ de anyigba ƒe mlɔenu; elabena Yehowa le avu wɔm kple dukɔwo, ele ʋɔnu drɔ̃m ŋutilãwo katã, eye wòatsɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ade asi na yi, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, dzɔgbevɔ̃e tso dukɔ gbɔ yi dukɔ gbɔ, eye wode zi ahom gã me le anyigba ƒe mlɔenu.

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe amesiwo wowu le ŋkeke ma me la, woanɔ anyi tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ɖaseɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenu; womafa na wo o, womaƒo wo nu ƒu o, eye womaɖi wo o, eye woazu aɖuɖɔ le agble me.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Mifa avi, mi lãkplɔviwo, mido aƒa, eye miƒo togotogoe, mi lãha ƒe bubumewo, elabena miaƒe azã de, ne woawu mi, eye makaka mi ahlẽ, ne mianɔ abe agba xɔasi, si ge dze anyi ene!

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Sitsoƒe abu ɖe lãkplɔviwo, eye sisi abu ɖe lãha ƒe bubumewo.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: eye gbeɖuƒe, si wovona ɖo la nu yi le Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe nu.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: Egblẽ eƒe avegoe ɖi abe dzata ene; elabena woƒe anyigba zu gbegbe le yi gblẽnu kple eƒe dɔmedzoe heliheli nu.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo kpakple dukɔ blibo la wosee Yeremya le nya siawo gblɔm le Yehowa ƒe me.

english_verse: Soon after Jehoiakim became king of Judah, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Le Yuda-fia Yoyakim, Yosiya vi ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe gɔmedzedzea me la, gbe sia tso Yehowa gbɔ bena:

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke ne miewum la, ekema minyae be, miehe ʋu maɖifɔ va mia ɖokui kple du sia kpakple emenɔlawo dzi; elabena nyateƒe Yehowa dom ɖe mi, be magblɔ nya siawo katã ɖe miaƒe towo me.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Yi ɖatsi tre ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnu, eye nagblɔ nya, siwo katã meto na wò be, nagblɔ na wo la, na Yuda-du, siwo katã va gbe do ge ɖa le Yehowa ƒe me; megana nyaa ɖeke nato le eme o.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ woasee, eye amesiame atrɔ tso eƒe mɔ vɔ̃ dzi; ekema vɔ̃, si meɖo be, mawɔ wo le woƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo ta la, avem.

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ne mieɖo tom, be miazɔ ɖe nye se, siwo mede na mi nu o,

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: mieɖo to nye dɔla nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nya, siwo meɖo ɖe mi ɖaa atraɖi la o, eye miegbe wo sese la,

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: ekema mawɔ aƒe sia abe Silo ene, eye matsɔ du sia awɔ ɖiŋudonu na anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã.

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nègblɔ nya ɖi le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me be, aƒe sia ano abe Silo ene, eye du sia agba azu aƒedo? Tete dukɔ blibo la ƒo takpli de Yeremya ŋu le Yehowa ƒe me.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Esi Yuda-amegãwo se nya siawo la, wotso fia ƒe me va Yehowa ƒe me, eye wobɔbɔ nɔ Yehowa ƒe agbo yeye la nu.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Tete nunɔlawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo gblɔ na amegãwo kple dukɔ blibo la bena: Ŋutsu sia dze ku; elabena egblɔ nya ɖi ɖe du sia ŋu, abe alesi mia ŋutɔwo miesee kple miaƒe to ene.

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Azɔ miɖo miaƒe zɔzɔme kple nuwɔnawo ɖo, eye mise Yehowa, mia Mawu ƒe gbe; ekema vɔ̃, si Yehowa gblɔ ɖe mia ŋu la, avee.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Ke nye la mele mia si me, miwɔm abe alesi dze, eye wònyo mia ŋu ene.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Tete amegãwo kple dukɔ blibo la gblɔ na nunɔlawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo bena: Ŋutsu sia medze ku o, elabena eƒo nu na mí le Yehowa, mía Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsuwo tsi tre tso anyigba la ƒe ame tsitsiwo dome gblɔ na dukɔ la ƒe takpekpe blibo la bena:

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: Mixa, Morasitɔ la, gblɔ, nya ɖi le Yuda-fia Xizkiya ŋɔli, eye wògblɔ na Yuda-dukɔ blibo lã bena: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Woade Zion abe agble ene, Yerusalem azu anyiglãgo, eye gbedoxɔ ƒe togbɛ la azu togbɛ toave.

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɖe Yuda-fia Xizkiya kple Yuda blibo la wuia? Ɖe mevɔ̃ Yehowa boŋ, eye wòƒo koko na Yehowa, ale be vɔ̃, si Yehowa gblɔ ɖe wo ŋu la, vee oa? Eye ɖe miawo míahe vɔ̃ gã sia ava mia ɖokui dzia?

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ nam enye si: Gbe ka, eye nawɔ kɔkuti atsa ku wò kɔ.

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔe de dɔla, siwo va Yuda-fia Zedekiya gbɔ le Yerusalem la si aɖo ɖe Edom-fia, Moab-fia, Amon-viwo ƒe fia, Tiro-fia kple Sidon-fia.

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Eye nade gbe wo si aɖo ɖe woƒe aƒetɔwo bena: Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: Ale miagblɔ na miaƒe aƒetɔwo enye si:

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: Nyee tso nye ŋusẽ gã kple nye alo, si le dzi la, wo anyigba, amegbetɔwo kple lãwo, siwo le anyigba dzi, eye amesi dze ŋunye la, metsɔnɛ na.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: Eye ne dukɔ kple fiaɖuƒea ɖe be, yemasubɔ Babel-fia Nebukadnezar o, eye yemade kɔ Babel-fia ƒe kɔkuti me o la, matsɔ yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ ahe to na dukɔ ma, vaseɖe esime mato eƒe asi dzi atsrɔ̃e keŋkeŋ, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la migaɖo to miaƒe nyagblɔɖilawo, bokɔnɔwo, drɔ̃ekulawo, gbesalawo kple dzotɔwo, amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm na mi be, miasubɔ Babel-fia o la o.

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: Elabena alakpanya gblɔm wole ɖi na mi, be woaɖe mi ɖa le miaƒe anyigba dzi, ne manyã mi, eye miatsrɔ̃.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ke dukɔ, si tsɔ eƒe kɔ de Babel-fia ƒe kɔkutĩ me, eye wòsubɔe la, mana wòano anyigba dzi aɖe dzi ɖi, ade agble ɖe edzi, eye wòana edzi.

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Meƒo nu kple Yuda-fia Zedekiya ɖe nya siawo nu pɛpɛpɛ gblɔ bena: Mitsɔ miaƒe kɔ de Babel-fia ƒe kɔkuti me, eye misubɔ eya kple eƒe dukɔ, ekema mianɔ agbe.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti mia kple wò dukɔ miebe, yewoaku ɖe yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ si me, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ ɖe dukɔ, si gbe be, yemasubɔ Babel-fia o la ŋu ene?

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Eye migaɖo to nyagblɔɖila, siwo le gbɔgblɔm na mi be, migasubɔ Babel-fia o la ƒe nyawo o; elabena alakpanya gblɔm wole ɖi na mi.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Menye nyee do wo o, alakpanya gblɔm wole ɖi le nye ŋkɔ me, ne manyã mi ɖa, eye mia kple nyagblɔɖila, siwo le nya gblɔm ɖi na mi la, miatsrɔ̃.

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Eye ale megblɔ na nunɔlawo kple dukɔ blibo sia enye si: Yehowa be: Migaɖo to miaƒe nyagblɔɖila, siwo le nya gblɔm ɖi na mi be: Kpɔ ɖa, woahe Yehowa ƒe aƒe me nuwo agbɔe tso Babel kaba la ƒe nya o; elabena alakpanya gblɔm wole ɖi na mi.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Migaɖo to wo o, ke boŋ misubɔ Babel-fia, ekema mianɔ agbe. Nukaŋuti du sia nazu aƒedo ɖo?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye nenye nyagblɔɖilawo wonye, eye Yehowa ƒe gbe le wo si la, ekema woaƒo koko na Yehowa Zebaot, ne womagatsɔ nusiwo susɔ ɖe Yehowa ƒe me, ɖe Yuda-fia ƒe me kple ɖe Yerusalem la, ayi Babel o.

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Woatsɔ wo ayi Babel, eye woatsi afima, vaseɖe gbesigbe mava kpɔ wo ɖa, eye makplɔ wo agbɔe va teƒe sia.

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Eye wòva me le ƒe ma me le Yuda-fia Zedekiya ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe gɔmedzedzea me le ƒe enelia ƒe dzinu atɔ̃lia me be, nyagblɔɖila Xananya, Asur vi tso Gibeon, gblɔ nam le Yehowa ƒe me le nunɔlawo kple dukɔ blibo la ŋku me bena:

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Le ƒe eve megbe la matsɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe me nusiwo katã Babel-fia Nebukadnezar tsɔ tso teƒe sia yi Babel la, agbɔ va teƒe sia.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Makplɔ Yuda-fia Yexonya, Yoyakim vi, kple Yuda ƒe aboyome, siwo katã yi Babel la, agbɔ va teƒe sia; elabena maŋe Babel-fia ƒe kɔkuti.

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Neva me, Yehowa newɔ alea! Yehowa newɔ wò nya, si negblɔ ɖi la dzi, eye woahe Yehowa ƒe aƒe me miawo kple aboyomeawo katã tso Babel agbɔ va teƒe sia.

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Nyagblɔɖila, siwo do ŋgɔ na mía kple wò tsã la, wogblɔ aʋawɔwɔ, dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple dɔvɔ̃ ƒe nya ɖi ɖe anyigba geɖewo kple fiaɖuƒe gãwo ŋu.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ne nyagblɔɖila ɖe gblɔ ŋutifafanya ɖi, eye eƒe nya va me la, ekema wòadze sii be, Yehowa ye dɔ nyagblɔɖila sia ɖa vavã.

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Tete nyagblɔɖila Xananya ɖe kɔkuti la le nyagblɔɖila Yeremya ƒe kɔ, eye wòŋee.

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: Eye Xananya gblɔ le dukɔ blibo la ŋku me bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Alea maŋe Babel-fia Nebukadnezar ƒe kɔkuti ɖa le dukɔwo katã ƒe kɔ le ɖe eve megbe. Eye Yeremya lé eƒe mɔ dzo.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Gakɔkuti metsɔ de kɔ na dukɔ siawo katã, ne woanye Babel-fia Nebukadnezar te viwo, eye woasubɔe; gbemelãwo hãe metsɔ de asi nɛ.

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖe wò ɖa le anyigba dzi; àku le ƒe sia me, elabena ègblɔ aglãdzenya ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: etsɔe de Eleasa, Safan vi, kple Gemarya, Xilkiya vi, amesiwo Yuda-fia Zedekiya dɔ ɖo ɖe Babel-fia Nebukadnezar gbɔ le Babel la si.

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ na aboyomeawo katã, amesiwo mena wokplɔ tso Yerusalem yi Babel la enye si;

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: Mitso aƒe mianɔ eme; mitɔ abɔ, eye miaɖu eme kutsetse.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Miɖe srɔ̃, eye midzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo; miɖe nyɔnu na mia viŋutsuwo, eye miɖe ŋutsu na mia vinyɔnuwo, ne wòadzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo; midzi ɖe dzi le afima, eye migazu ʋee o.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: Midi du, si me mena woɖe aboyo mi yi la fe nyuie, eye mido gbe ɖa na Yehowa ɖe eta; elabena ne eme nyo nɛ la, eme anyo na miawo hã.

english_verse: I will bless you with a future filled with hope—a future of success, not of suffering.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Elabena menya tame, si meɖo ɖe mia ŋu la, ŋutifafa ƒe tamee, eye menye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ƒe tame o, ne mana nuwuwu, si miele mo kpɔm na la mi.

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Miayɔm, miaɖado gbe ɖa nam, eye maɖo to mi.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Miadim, eye miakpɔm, nenye be miebia tanye se tso miaƒe dzi blibo me ko.

english_verse: and accept your worship. Then I will gather you from all the nations where I scattered you, and you will return to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye mana miakpɔm, Yehowa ye gblɔe. Magaɖo mi te, eye maƒo mia nu ƒu tso dukɔwo katã dome kple teƒe, siwo katã menya mi ɖo ɖo, eye makplɔ mi agbo va teƒe, si mena woɖe aboyo mi le, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ke miawo miele gbɔgblɔm be, Yehowa ye ɖo nyagblɔɖilawo na yewo le Babel.

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: Ke mi aboyomewo katã, amesiwo mena wokplɔ tso Yerusalem yi Babel la, mise Yehowa ƒe nya!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Eŋlɔ agbalẽ le wò ŋkɔ me ɖo ɖe dukɔ blibo, si le Yerusalem kple nunɔla Zefanya, Maaseya vi, kpakple nunɔla wo katã bena:

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsɔ wò ɖo nunɔla ɖe nunɔla Yoyada teƒe, ne nanye dzikpɔla le Yehowa ƒe aƒe la me ɖe amesiame, si ƒe tagbɔ gblẽ, wòle nya gblɔm ɖi la nu, eye nadee kunyowu kple ga me.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti mèxe ma na Yeremya, Anatotitɔ, amesi le nya gblɔm ɖi na mi la oa?

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: Elabena eɖo agbalẽ ɖe mi le Babel be: „Eteƒe adidi; eyata mitso aƒe mianɔ eme; mitɔ abɔ miaɖu eme kutsetse.“

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla Zefanya xlẽ agbalẽ sia ɖe nyagblɔɖila Yeremya ƒe to me.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Yeremya bena;

english_verse: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord, have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.
translation_verse: Ɖo ame ɖa, ne woagblɔ na aboyomeawo katã bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Semaya, Nexelamitɔ ŋu enye si: Esi Semaya gblɔ nya ɖi na mi, evɔ wònye nyemedɔe o hafi, eye wòna miele dzi ɖom ɖe alakpanya ŋu la,

english_verse: He has even talked you into disobeying me. So I will punish Shemaiah. He and his descendants won't live to see the good things I will do for my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, mahe to na Semaya, Nexelamitɔ la, kple eƒe ƒome; amea ɖeke makpɔtɔ nɛ, si anɔ dukɔ sia dome o, eye makpɔ nyuie, si mawɔ na nye dukɔ la o, Yehowa ye gblɔe; elabena egblɔ aglãdzenya ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Ŋlɔ nya, siwo katã megblɔ na wò la, ɖe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: Someday I will let my people from both Israel and Judah return to the land I gave their ancestors.”
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke li gbɔna, eye maɖo nye dukɔ Israel kple Yuda te, mana woagbɔ va anyigba, si metsɔ na wo fofowo la dzi, eye woaxɔe wòanye wo tɔ, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Míese ŋɔdziɣli, vɔvɔ̃ ɖeɖe sɔŋ, eye ŋutifafaa ɖeke meli o.

english_verse: Can men give birth? Then why do I see them looking so pale and clutching their stomachs like women in labor?
translation_verse: Mibia se, eye miɖo ŋku anyi be, ɖe ŋutsu dzia vi loo? Nukaŋuti mele ŋutsu sia ŋutsu kpɔm wotsɔ asi ɖo ali abe nyɔnu léku ene, eye woƒe ŋku me wo katã fu tititi?

english_verse: My people, soon you will suffer worse than ever before, but I will save you.
translation_verse: Alele, ŋkeke ma enye ŋkeke gã, eye eteƒe mekɔ o; xaxaɣi li na Yakob, ke woaɖee le eme.

english_verse: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zebaot be: Ava me le ŋkeke ma dzi be, maŋe eƒe kɔkuti ɖa le wò kɔ, eye matso wò kawo, eye màgasubɔ ame tutɔwo azɔ o;

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: ke boŋ woasubɔ Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la, kple woƒe fia Dawid, amesi ɖo ge mala na wo.

english_verse: Israel, you belong to me, so don't be afraid. You deserved to be punished; that's why I scattered you in distant nations. But I am with you, and someday I will destroy those nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Eyata nye ɖɔla Yakob, megavɔ̃ o, Israel, dzi megaɖe le ƒowò o; elabena maɖe wò tso didiƒe kple wò ƒome tso anyigba, si dzi woɖe aboyoe yi la dzi; Yakob agatrɔ agbɔ, eye wòagbɔ ɖe eme bɔkɔɔ, amea ɖeke mado voɖi nɛ o.

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Meli kpli wò, ne maɖe wò; matsrɔ̃ dukɔ, siwo katã dome mekaka wò ɖo la, ke nyematsrɔ̃ wò ya o; nyemagblẽ wò ɖi tomahemahee o, ke boŋ mahe to na wò ɖe ɖoɖo nu.

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Woƒo wò vevie ŋutɔ, eye abi vɔ̃e le ŋuwò.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Wò nya meɖi amea ɖeke o, hayahaya mele wò abiawo ŋu o, eye atikea ɖeke meli na wò o.

english_verse: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.
translation_verse: Wò ahiãviwo katã ŋlɔ wò be, eye womebia ta wò se o; elabena metsɔ tohehe, si teƒe mekɔ o la, ƒo wòe abe futɔ ƒe ameƒoƒo ene le wò vodada gbogboawo kple wò nuvɔ̃ geɖeawo ta.

english_verse: But if your enemies try to rob or destroy you, I will rob and destroy them, and they will be led as captives to foreign lands.
translation_verse: Eyata woaɖu amesiwo katã ɖu wò, eye wò ketɔwo katã ayi aboyo me; woaha amesiwo ha wò, eye woada adzo amesiwo katã da adzo wò.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Mahaya wò, eye mayɔ dɔ wò ahiãwo; elabena wole yɔwòm be „amenyãdegbea“, Zion, „si ta womebiana sena o.“

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖo Yakob ƒe agbadɔ te, eye makpɔ nublanui na eƒe nɔƒewo, woagatso du la ɖe eƒe togbɛ dzi, eye fiasã anɔ eteƒe xoxoa.

english_verse: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.
translation_verse: Kafukafuha kple dzidzɔkpɔlawo ƒe gbe aɖi le wo dome; mana woadzi ɖe dzi, eye womazu ʋee o, made bubu wo ŋu, eye womaɖi gbɔ o.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: Viawo anɔ abe tsã ene, eƒe amehawo ali ke le ŋkunye me, eye mahe to na amesiwo katã te wo ɖe anyi la.

english_verse: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.
translation_verse: Woƒe amegã ado tso wo dome, eye wo dziɖula ado tso wo titina; mana woate va agogom, elabena amekae ado dzi, be yeate ɖe ŋunye ma? Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You will be my people, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mianya dukɔ nam, eye ma nye Mawu na mi.

english_verse: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ƒe ahom le tutum le dɔmedzoe me, eye ya ʋuduʋudu le ƒoƒom ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe nu mafa o, vaseɖe esime woawo eƒe dzimesusuwo dzi ade goe hafi; miava dze sii le ŋkeke mlɔeawo me xoxo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Le ɣemaɣi la manye Mawu na Israel ƒe ƒomeawo katã, eye woawo anye dukɔ nam.

english_verse: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Rebuild Israel
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Dukɔ, si susɔ tso yi nu la, kpɔ amenuveve le gbea dzi. Tso nakplɔ Israel ayi gbɔɖemeƒee!

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe eɖokui fiãm le didiƒe. Metsɔ lɔlɔ̃ mava lɔ̃ wò, eyata meɖo amenuveve ɖi na wò didie alea.

english_verse: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.
translation_verse: Ɖetugbi Israel, magatso wò, eye natsi tsotso; àgakpla wò asiʋuiwo, eye aɖo dzidzɔkpɔlawo ƒe to me;

english_verse: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria and enjoy the grapes.
translation_verse: woagade weingble ɖe Samaria-towo dzi; amesi wo de wo la, woaɖu wo me kutsetse.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Elabena ŋkeke li gbɔna, eye dzɔlawo ado ɣli le Efrayim-towo dzi bena: Mitso, ne míayi Yehowa, mía Mawu la gbɔ le Zion.

english_verse: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, “Come and rescue your people, Lord! Save what's left of Israel.”
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mido dzidzɔɣli ɖe Yakob ŋu, eye mitso aseye ɖe dukɔwo ƒe ta ŋu! Mina kafukafuha naɖi, eye migblɔ be: Yehowa, xɔ na wò dukɔ, na Israel mamlea!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, makplɔ wo tso anyiehe-nyigba dzi, eye maƒo wo nu ƒu tso anyigba ƒe dzogoewo dzi, ŋkunɔwo, xɔdrɔ̃wo, funɔwo kple vinɔwo siaa anɔ wo dome, woanɔ ha gãwo me agbɔ va afisia.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Woanɔ avi dzi ava, eye woanɔ koko ƒom makplɔ wo vɛ; makplɔ wo alo ma dzɔdzɔe, si dzi womakli nu le o la dzi ayi toʋuwo toe; elabena fofo menye na Israel, eye Efrayim la, vinye ŋgɔgbea ye.

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo, mise Yehowa ƒe nya, mitoe le ƒukpowo dzi le didiƒe gblɔ bena: Eya, amesi kaka Israel hlẽ la, agaƒo enu ƒu, eye wòanyii, abe alesi lãkplɔvi nyia lãhae ene.

english_verse: I will rescue them from enemies who could overpower them.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa xa Yakob ƒle, eye wòɖee tso ŋusẽtɔ si me.

english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: Woava atso aseye le Zion ƒe togbɛ dzi, eye woanye zi ɖe Yehowa ƒe nu nyuiwo dzi, ɖe lu, wein kple ami, alẽviwo kple nyiwo dzi, woƒe luʋɔ anɔ abe abɔ, si wode tsii ene, eye nu magati kɔ na wo azɔ o.

english_verse: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.
translation_verse: Emegbe la ɖetugbiwo, ɖekakpuiwo kple ame tsitsiwo siaa aɖu ɣe akpɔ dzidzɔ; matrɔ woƒe nuxaxa wòazu dzidzɔ, mafa akɔ na wo, eye mado dzidzɔ na wo le woƒe konyifafa megbe;

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: matsɔ ami aɖi ƒo na nunɔlawo, eye maɖi ƒo na nye dukɔ la kple nye nu nyuiwo, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Wose konyifagbe le Rama kple avifafa vevie, Raxel le fafam na viawo, eye wogbe be, womegafa akɔ na ye le ye viwo ŋuti o, le esi womegali o la ta.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Tsri avifafa na wò gbe kple aɖatsi na wò ŋkuwo; elabena fetu li na wò dɔwɔwɔ, eye woagatrɔ agbɔ tso futɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: So don't lose hope. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Mɔkpɔkpɔ le wò ŋkeke, siwo gbɔna la ŋu, eye ɖeviawo agatrɔ va woƒe anyigba dzi,

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: Mese Efrayim le nu xam xoxo be: „Ehe to nam, eye mena nèhe to nam abe nyivi, si womemlã o la ene; gakplɔm gbɔe, ekema matrɔ la me; elabena wòe nye Yehowa, nye Mawu.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Elabena esi metrɔ ta me la, evem, eye esi medze si nu la, meƒo aklito; ŋu kpem, eye nye mo tsi dã, elabena nye ɖevime ŋukpe le ŋunye.“

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Efrayim la, vi vevi kple vi malɔ̃nugbɔa wònye nama? Elabena ne menya ƒo nu le eŋu ko la, nye ŋku nɔa eyama dzi ɖaa; eyata nye dɔme le tɔtrɔm ɖe eŋu, makpɔ nublanui nɛ kokoko, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋkuɖodzikpewo, tu dzesidonuwo, tsɔ wò tame ɖo mɔ, si nèto la ŋu. Trɔ gbɔ, ɖetugbi Israel, trɔ gbɔ, va wò du siawo me!

english_verse: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man. The Lord Will Bring Judah Home
translation_verse: Ɣekaɣi nanɔ tsa glãla tsam ase ɖo, wò nyɔnu dzego? Elabena Yehowa le nu yeye wɔ ge le anyigba dzi: Nyɔnu aɖe to ɖe ŋutsu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Ne megaɖo wò te la, ekema woagblɔ nya sia le Yuda-nyigba dzi kple eƒe duwo me bena: Yehowa ayra wò, wò dzɔdzɔenyenye nɔƒe, wò to kɔkɔe!

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Eye Yuda kple eƒe duwo katã anɔ edzi hekpe ɖe agbledelawo kpakple amesiwo hona kple lãhawo la ŋu.

english_verse: Those who feel tired and worn out will find new life and energy,
translation_verse: Elabena mafa dzi na luʋɔ, siwo ŋu nu te, eye maɖi ƒo na luʋɔ, siwo nu ti kɔ na.

english_verse: and when they sleep, they will wake up refreshed.
translation_verse: Esia ta menvɔ ɖo, eye mekpɔ be, nye alɔ̃ la vivi nam.

english_verse: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke li gbɔna, eye maƒã amegbetɔwo kple lãwo ƒe nuku ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe kple Yuda ƒe aƒe lã me.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Eye alesi menɔ ŋute ɖe wo ŋu, be mala wo, maho wo, magbã wo, magblẽ wo, eye matsrɔ̃ wo la, nenema manɔ ŋudzɔ ɖe wo ŋu, be matso wo, eye made woƒe agunu to, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke mawo me la womagagblɔ azɔ be: „Fofowo ɖu weintsetse hɔhlɔ̃e, eye aɖu nyɔ viwo“ o;

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: ke boŋ amesiame aku ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe vodada ta, eye amesi ɖu weintsetse hɔhlɔ̃e la, eyae aɖu anyɔ. Nyagblɔɖi le nubabla yeyea ŋuti.

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke li gbɔna, eye mabia nu yeye kple Israel ƒe aƒe kpakple Yuda ƒe aƒe.

english_verse: It will be different from the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt. Although I was their God, they broke that agreement.
translation_verse: Manɔ abe nusi mebia kple wo fofowo le gbesigbe melé woƒe alɔnu, be makplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, nubabla, si wotu, eye nye hã megbe wo la ene o, Yehowa ye gblɔe;

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: ke boŋ nusi mele babla ge kple Israel ƒe aƒe la le ŋkeke siawo megbe la, enye esi: Matsɔ nye se la ade woƒe dɔ me, eye maŋlɔe ɖe woƒe dzi ŋu, manye Mawu na wo, eye woawo nanye nye dukɔ, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke magafia nu xɔlɔ̃via kple nɔvia agblɔ be: „Dze si Yehowa“ o, elabena wo katã wòadze sim tso ɖeviwo dzi vaseɖe tsitsiawo dzi, Yehowa ye gblɔe; elabena matsɔ woƒe vodadawo ake wo, eye nyemagaɖo ŋu woƒe nuvɔ̃wo azɔ o.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi; eya amesi wɔ ɣe, ne wòaklẽ le ŋkeke me, eye wòɖo na ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo be, woaklẽ le zã me, eya amesi de adã ta me na atsiaƒu, be eƒe tsotsoewo nadze agbo la, eŋkɔ enye Yehowa Zebaot:

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ne ɖoɖo siawo te ɖa le ŋkunye me la, ekema Israel-ƒome la hã nu atsi, maganye dukɔ le ŋkunye me akpɔ gbeɖe o. Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Ne woate ŋu adzidze dziƒowo le dzi me, eye woate ŋu adzro anyigba ƒe agunu me akpɔ le anyi me la, ekema nye hã matsɔ Israel ƒe ƒome blibo la aƒu gbe le nusiwo katã wowɔ la ta, Yehowa ye gblɔe,

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke li gbɔna, eye woatso du la na Yehowa tso Xananeel ƒe xɔ tsrala gbɔ vaseɖe dzogoe gbo la nu.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Eye dzidzeka agato Gareb ƒe togbɛ dzi tẽ ahanyẽ kpo aɖo ta Goa.

english_verse: Even that disgusting Hinnom Valley will be sacred to me, and so will the eastern slopes that go down from Horse Gate into Kidron Valley. Jerusalem will never again be destroyed.
translation_verse: Eye ame kuku balime, dzowɔ balime blibo la kpakple agblewo katã ɖake ɖe Kidron-tɔʋu la nu vaseɖe sɔgbo la ƒe dzogoe dzi anɔ kɔkɔe na Yehowa; womagagblẽe azɔ o, eye womagagbãe aƒu anyi akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe, si va na Yeremya le Yuda-fia Zedekiya ƒe ƒe ewolia, si nye Nebukadnezar ƒe ƒe wuienyilia me la, enye si:

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi Babel-fia ƒe aʋakɔ ɖe to ɖe Yerusalem, eye wode nyagblɔɖila Yeremya gaxɔ ɖe dzɔlawo ƒe xɔxɔnu, si le Yuda-fia ƒe me.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Elabena Yuda-fia Zedekiya ye dee gaxɔ me gblɔ bena: Nukaŋuti nègblɔ nya ɖi be: „Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ du sia ade asi na Babel-fia, eye wòaxɔe;

english_verse: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.
translation_verse: Yuda-fia Zedekiya mage le Kaldeatɔwo si me o, ke boŋ woatsɔe ade asi na Babel-fia kokoko, eye wo kpakplii woaƒo nu kple wo nɔewo, eye woakpɔ wo nɔewo ŋku me;

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: akplɔ Zedekiya ayi Babel, eye wòatsi afima, vaseɖe esime maɖo ŋku edzi, Yehowa ye gblɔe; ne miewɔ aʋa kple Kaldeatɔwo la, madze edzi na mi o.“

english_verse: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye Yeremya gblɔ be: Yehowa ƒe gbe va gbɔnye bena:

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, tɔwòɖia Salum vi Xanameel le gbɔwò va ge agblɔ na wò bena: Xɔ nye agble, si le Anatot la ƒle, elabena wò nya wònye, be naxɔe aƒle.

english_verse: Hanamel came, just as the Lord had promised. And he said, “Please buy my field near Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. You have the right to buy it, and if you do, it will stay in our family.” The Lord had told me to buy it
translation_verse: Tete tɔnyeɖia vi Xanameel va gbɔnye le dzɔlawo ƒe xɔxɔnu, abe alesi Yehowa gblɔ ene, eye wògblɔ nam bena: Xɔ nye agble, si le Anatot le Benyamin-nyigba dzi la ƒle, elabena tɔwòe nye domenyinyi la, eye exɔxɔ la, wò nya wònye; xɔe ƒle. Eye medze sii bena, Yehowa ƒe nya wònye.

english_verse: from Hanamel, and so I did. The price was
translation_verse: Ale meƒle agble, si le Anatot la le tɔnyeɖia vi Xanameel si, eye meda klosalo sekel wuiadre nɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: Oo, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, ètsɔ wò ŋusẽ gã kple wò alɔ, si le dzi la, wo dziƒo kple anyigba, naneke mekpe na wò akpa o,

english_verse: And while he, the witnesses, and all the other Jews sitting in the courtyard were still watching, I gave both copies to Baruch son of Neriah.
translation_verse: de asi na Maxseya vi Neriya ƒe vi Barux le nye tɔɖia-yɔvi Xanameel kple ɖasefoawo, amesiwo ŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe asinyigbalẽa te la ŋku me kpakple le Yudatɔ, siwo katã le dzɔlawo ƒe xɔxɔnua la ŋku me,

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Tsɔ agbalẽ siawo, asinyigbalẽ, si nu wotre kple esi le ʋuʋu la siaa de ze me, ne woanɔ anyi eteƒe nadidi.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Woagaƒle xɔwo, agblewo kple weingblewo le anyigbã sia dzi. Yeremya do gbe ɖa, eye Mawu nado ŋugbe ne le Israel ƒe ɖeɖe ŋuti.

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: wò amesi ve ame akpe nanewo nu, eye neɖo fofowo ƒe yodadawo teƒe ɖe akɔ me na wo viwo le wo megbe, wò Mawu gã ŋusẽtɔ, si ŋkɔ nye Yehowa Zebaot;

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: amesi ƒe aɖaŋudede kpe, eye eƒe nuwɔwɔ sɔ gbɔ, wò amesi ƒe ŋkuwo le te ɖe amegbetɔviwo ƒe mɔwo katã ŋu, ne nawɔ na amesiame le eƒe mɔwo kple eƒe nuwɔnawo ƒe kutsetse nu;

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: wò amesi wɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo le Egipte-nyigba dzi ɖe Israel kple amegbetɔwo siaa nu vaseɖe egbe, eye nède ŋkɔ ɖokuiwò ŋu, abe alesi wòle egbe siawo ene,

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: etso dzesiwo kple nukunuwo, asi sesẽ kple alɔ, si le dzi, kpakple ŋɔdzi gã kplɔ wò dukɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi,

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: eye nètsɔ anyigba sia na wo, si ŋu nèka atam ɖo na wo fofowo be, yeatsɔ anyigba, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi ba ɖo la, na wo.

english_verse: But when our ancestors took over the land, they did not obey you. And now you have punished Israel with disaster.
translation_verse: Eye wova hexɔe wònye wo tɔ, ke wogbe toɖoɖo wò gbe, womezɔ ɖe wò seawo nu o, eye womewɔ nusiwo katã ŋu nèɖe se le na wo la o; eyata nèna dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo katã va wo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, kpoƒuƒu va keke dua ŋu ke, ne woaxɔe, eye woatsɔ du la ade asi na Kaldeatɔ, siwo le aʋa wum kplii, le yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ ta; nya, si nègblɔ la, va me, eye nèle ekpɔm tso,

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: hafi wò, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, nègagblɔ nam be: Tsɔ klosalo naƒle agblee, eye naɖo ɖasefowo eŋu, evɔ wònye wole du la tsɔ ge ade asi na Keldeatɔwo hafi!

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nyee nye Yehowa, ŋutilãwo katã ƒe Mawu; ɖe mado kpo nanea?

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ du sia ade asi na Kaldeatɔwo kple Babel-fia Nebukadnezar, ne wòaxɔe.

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: Eye Kaldeatɔ, siwo le aʋa wɔm kple du sia la, age ɖe eme, woatɔ dzo du sia, eye eya kple xɔ, siwo ta me wodo dzudzɔ na Baal, eye woƒo tsi ɖe anyi na mawu tutɔwo le, ne woatsɔ ado dzikui nam la, afiã.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo ɖo aƒe, si ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo la me, ne woagblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ.

english_verse: And they led Judah into sin by building places to worship Baal in Hinnom Valley, where they also sacrificed their sons and daughters to the god Molech. I have never even imagined they would commit such disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Wowɔ nuxeƒewo na Baal ɖe Ben-Hinom-bali la me, ne wòakɔ woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple woƒe nyɔnuviwo ŋu na Molox, nusi nyemeɖo na wo alo wòayi nye ta me va ge, be woawo ŋunyɔnu sia ahatsɔ ble Yuda ade nuvɔ̃ me o.

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ ɖe ɖu, si ŋu miawo miele gbɔgblɔm le be, woatsɔe ade asi na Babel-fia to yi dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ dzi la ŋuti enye si:

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, maƒo wo nu ƒu atso anyigbawo katã dzi, afisi menyã wo ɖo ɖo le nye dɔmedzoe kple nye dziku kpakple nye nyanyrã gã me, magakplɔ wo ava teƒe sia, eye woanɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ,

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: woanye dukɔ nam, eye manye Mawu na wo.

english_verse: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Alesi mehe dzɔgbevɔ̃e gã siawo katã va dukɔ sia dzii la, nenema ke mahe nyui, siwo katã ŋu meƒo nu le la, ava wo dzii.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
translation_verse: Eye woagaƒle agble le anyigba sia, si ŋu miawo miele gbɔgblɔm le be, ezu gbegbe, elabena amegbetɔ kple lãwo megali o, eye wotsɔe de asi na Kaldeatɔwo la dzi.

english_verse: But someday, people will again spend their silver to buy fields everywhere—in the territory of Benjamin, the region around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and in the hill country, the foothills to the west, and the Southern Desert. Buyers and sellers and witnesses will sign and seal the bills of sale for the fields. It will happen, because I will give this land back to my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Woagatsɔ ga aƒle agblewoe le Benyamin-nyigba dzi kple Yerusalem-nutowo me le Yuda-duwo kple to dzi duwo me, le bali me duwo kple dzieheduwo me, woade wo agbalẽ me, eye woatre enu ahaɖo ɖasefowo wo ŋu; elabena magaɖo wo te, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord, and I created the whole world.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, amesi wɔa nu, Yehowa, amesi ɖoa tame, eye wòwɔnɛ ɖea goe, eya amesi ŋkɔ nye Yehowa la, gblɔ esi:

english_verse: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.
translation_verse: Yɔm, ekema matɔ na wò, eye maɖe nu gã kako, siwo mènya o la, afia wò.

english_verse: Many of the houses in Jerusalem and some of the buildings at the royal palace have been torn down to be used in repairing the walls to keep out the Babylonian attackers. Now there are empty spaces where the buildings once stood. But I am furious, and these spaces will be filled with the bodies of the people I kill. The people of Jerusalem will cry out to me for help, but they are evil, and I will ignore their prayers.
translation_verse: Elabena wova, be woawɔ aʋa kple Kaldeatɔwo, ne woatsɔ amegbetɔ, siwo mewu le nye dɔmedzoe kple nye dziku me la ƒe kukuawo ayɔ wo me fũ, le esi meɣla nye ŋku me ɖe du sia le woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo katã ta la ŋuti:

english_verse: Then someday, I will heal this place and my people as well, and let them enjoy unending peace.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mayɔ dɔ wo, eye mahaya wo, eye mana ŋutifafa kple nyateƒe wo fũ,

english_verse: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.
translation_verse: mana Yuda kple Israel ƒe aboyomewo nagatrɔ agbɔ, eye maɖo wo te abe tsã ene,

english_verse: When that happens, all nations on earth will see the good things I have done for Jerusalem, and how I have given it complete peace. The nations will celebrate and praise and honor me, but they will also tremble with fear because of the powerful things I have done.
