translation_verse: Tsikɔ na vidzĩewo ƒe aɖe lé de aŋɔƒome na wo, ɖeviwo bia abolo, ke amea ɖeke mekae na wo o.

english_verse: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
translation_verse: Amesiwo du nu vivivo tsã la, nu te wo ŋu le kpɔdomeewo, amesiwo ta aɖabɛ tsã la, le gbeɖuɖɔ me.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ ƒe nyɔnuvi ƒe vodadawo só gbɔ wu Sodom, si wotrɔ bu anyi le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me, eye amea ɖeke mekpe asi ɖe eŋu o la ƒe nuvɔ̃wo.

english_verse: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
translation_verse: Woƒe amegãwo da dzo wu sno, eye wotu wu notsi, woƒe mo blã wu soe, eye woƒe nɔnɔme nɔ abe gbloti ene.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la woƒe dzedzeme nya wu zemabi, eye amea ɖeke medzea si wo le kpɔdomee o. Woƒe agbalẽ lé ɖe woƒe ƒuwo ŋu kpaɖii, eye wòƒu abe nake ene.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu, siwo ame ƒe nu wɔa nublanui na la ƒe asi ɖa woawu ŋutɔ ƒe viwo, eye wonye nuɖuɖu na wo le nye dukɔ ƒe nyɔnuvi la gblẽɣi.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Yehowa wu eƒe dziku nu, eye wòtrɔ eƒe dɔmedzoe ƒo ɖe anyi, eɖo dzo ɖe Zion, eye wòfiã eƒe agunusɔtiwo.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Anyigba dzi fiawo kple xexeametɔwo katã mexɔe se be, ketɔ kple futɔ la age ɖe Yerusalem ƒe agbowo me hafi o.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Eva me le woƒe nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple woƒe nunɔlawo ƒe vodadawo la, amesiwo kɔ ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe ʋu ɖe anyi le eme.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: Wole tsa glãla tsam le kpɔɖotnee abe ŋkunuwo ene, eye woƒo ʋu, ale be amea ɖeke mete ŋu ɖe asi woƒe avɔwo ŋu o.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Wole ɣli dom ɖe wo ŋu be: Midzo, mi ame makɔmakɔwo, midzo, midzo, migaka asi naneke ŋu o! Eye esi wosi hele tsa glãla tsam la, wogblɔ le dukɔwo dome be: Womele anyi nɔ ge ɖiɖie o!

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe adãmo kako wo hlẽ, magaɖe ŋku ɖe wo ŋu azɔ o. Womebu nunɔiawo o, eye womeve amegã ɖeɖiwo nu o.

english_verse: Our eyes became weary, hopelessly looking for help from a nation that could not save us.
translation_verse: Míaƒe ŋkuwo le xɔname dzodzroa ŋu, wòti kɔ na wo; eye esi míele mɔ kpɔm la, míetsa ŋku ɖo dukɔ, si mate ŋu axɔ na ame o la ŋu.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Wole ŋku ɖem ɖe míaƒe afɔɖeɖe ŋu hã, ale be míaƒe mawo dzi toto zu dɔ; míaƒe nuwuwu tu aƒe, miaƒe ŋkekewo de, elabena míaƒe nuwuwu ɖo.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Mía yometilawo ɖi du wu hɔ̃ le dziƒo ŋu; woyɔ mi ɖe nu le towo dzi, eye woɖe xa ɖe gbe dzi na mi.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Míaƒe agbegbɔgbɔ, si nye Yehowa ƒe amesiamina la, ge ɖe woƒe ʋe me; eya amesi ŋu míegblɔ le be: Míanɔ agbe le eƒe vɔvɔli te le dukɔwo dome la.

english_verse: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
translation_verse: Eɖom-nyɔnuvi, wò Uz-nyigba dzi nyɔnu, tso aseye, nakpɔ dzidzɔ; kplu la le vava ge na wò hã, eye namu aha aɖe ama.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Zion-nyɔnuvi, wò vodada se ɖo, eye maganyã wò ade gbe azɔ o. Edom-nyɔnuvi, ahe to na wò vodada, eye aklo nu le wò nuvɔ̃wo dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: Yehowa, do ŋu nusi dzo ɖe mía dzi la; ɖo ŋku anyi nakpɔ míaƒe ŋukpe ɖa!

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Míaƒe domenyinu ge ɖe amedzrowo si me, eye míaƒe aƒewo ge ɖe ɖu bubu me tɔwo si me.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: Tsyɔ̃eviwo míenye, tɔ mele mía si o, eye mía nɔwo zu ahosiwo.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Gae míetsɔna hafi noa míaƒe tsi, eye ɖe míeƒlea míaƒe nakewo.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Woti mía yome kplikplikpli, ɖeɖi te mía ŋu, ke womena míegbɔ ɖe eme o.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Míena ta Egipte kple Asur, ne míakpɔ abolo aɖu aɖi ƒo.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Mia fofowo wɔ nuvɔ̃, eye womegali o, ke míawo míele woƒe vodadawo tsɔm.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Kluviwo le amegã ɖum ɖe mía nu, ke amea ɖeke mele mía ɖem le wo si me o.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Míaƒe agbe míetsɔ ɖaɖi aboloe, le yi, si le gbe dzi ta.

english_verse: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
translation_verse: Dɔwuame heliheli na míaƒe ŋutigbalẽ ʋu dzo hẽ abe kpo ene.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Wogblẽ nyɔnuwo le Zion kple ɖetugbiwo le Yuda-duwo me.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Wode ke ve na amegãwo, eye womesi amegã ɖeɖiwo ŋku me o.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Ɖekakpuiwo le te ɖe te, eye ɖeviwo dze anyi ɖe nake te.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Ame tsitsiwo vɔ le ʋɔnu, eye ɖekakpuiwo megale saŋku ƒom o.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Míaƒe dzidzɔ nu tso, míaƒe ɣeɖuɖu zu nuxaxa.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Míaƒe fiakuku ge le mía ta. Baba na mí be, míewɔ nuvɔ̃!

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Eyata míaƒe dzi le nu xam, eye míaƒe ŋkuwo zu vi

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: ɖe Zion-to la ŋu, elabena ezu gbegbe, eye abeiwo le edzi tom.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Ke wò Yehowa, èlí tegbee, eye wò fiazikpui nɔa dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: Why have you forgotten us for so long?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèŋlɔ mí be ɖikaa, eye negblẽ mí ɖi eteƒe didi ale?

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: Yehowa, trɔ mí ɖe ŋuwò, ne míatrɔ; wɔ míaƒe ŋkekewo yeye abe tsa ene.

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe negbe nu keŋ, eye nèɖo dɔmedzoe ɖe mia ŋu vevie ŋutɔŋutɔa?

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Meɖo ŋku anyi, eye kpɔ ɖa, ahom tu tso anyiehe, alilikpo gãa ɖe bia kɔtɔɔ, keklẽ ƒo xlã alilikpo gãa ɖe, eye dzobabla kɔtɔɔ le eme; nane le dzedzem le dzo la titina abe sika, si me kɔ keŋkeŋ ene;

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: nu gbagbe ene do tso eme, eye woƒe nɔnɔme enye si: Woɖi amegbetɔ,

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: ɖesiaɖe to mo ene, eye aʋala ene li na wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe,

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: woƒe atatiwo dze ti, woƒe afɔƒome le abe nyivi tɔ ene, eye wole dzo dam kaŋkaŋ abe ayawa ene.

english_verse: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe asi li na wo le woƒe aʋalawo te le go eneawo dzi; mowo kple aʋalawo li na wo ame eneawo;

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: woƒe aʋalawo kpe wo nɔewo, eye ne wole azɔli dzi la, wometrɔa kɔ o; wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe léa eƒe mɔ te.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Woƒe mo ɖi amegbetɔ ƒe mo le ŋgɔ, wo ame enea to dzata ƒe mo ɖe ɖusi me, wo ame enea to nyitsu ƒe mo ɖe mia me, eye wo ame enea to hɔ̃ ƒe mo ɖe megbe,

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: esia nye woƒe mowo. Woklẽ woƒe aʋala wo ɖo ta dzi me, ɖesiaɖe tsɔ eve ƒo go nɔvia, eye wotsɔ eve tsyɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Ne wole yiyim la, wo dome ɖesiaɖe kpɔa eŋgɔ tẽ; afisi gbɔgbɔ la ɖo wo ɖo la, afima woyina, eye ne wole azɔli dzi la, wometrɔa kɔ o.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Eye nane le nu gbagbeawo domee le abe dzoka ene hele bibim abe akakati ene, dzo la le faflam le nu gbagbeawo domee, eye eme kɔ keŋkeŋ, eye dzikedzo do tso dzoa me.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Eye nu gbagbeawo le du dzi tso afi yi afi abe dzikedzo ene.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Esi meɖe ŋku ɖe nu gbagbeawo la, kpɔ ɖa, tasiaɖamfɔ le nu gbagbeawo xa le anyigba le woƒe ŋgɔdze eneawo katã.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Tasiaɖamfɔawo ƒe dzedzeme le abe adzagba wotsɔ wɔ wòe ene, eye wo ame eneawo katã ɖi wo nɔewo, woƒe dzedzeme kple woƒe wɔwɔme sɔ abe ɖe tasiaɖamfɔ ɖeka le nɔvia me ene.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning.
translation_verse: Wozɔna ɖe woƒe go eneawo me, eye ne wole yiyim la, wometrɔna o.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Wo meɖotiwo la, gãnyenye kple ŋɔdzi wonye, eye ŋku le wo ame eneawo katã meɖotiwo ŋu godoo.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Ne woɖe zɔ la, tasiaɖamfɔawo hã ɖea zɔ, ne wòtɔ la, wotɔna, eye ne wokɔ wo ɖokui tso anyigba la, woawo hã kɔa wo ɖokui dzi; elabena nu gbagbeawo ƒe gbɔgbɔ le tasiaɖamfɔawo me.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Eye esi wole yiyim la, mese woƒe aʋalawo me le ɖiɖim abe tɔ gãwo ƒe hoowɔwɔ, abe ŋusẽkatãtɔ ƒe gbeɖeɖe kple aʋakɔwo ƒe ɣlidodo ene, eye ne wòtɔ la, woɖiɖia woƒe aʋalawo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Eye gbea ɖe ɖi le dziŋgɔli, si le wo ta me la dzi; ne wòtɔ la, woɖiɖia woƒe aʋalawo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Nane ɖi fiazikpui le dziŋgɔli, si le wo ta me la dzi le abe gbloti ene, eye nɔnɔmea ɖe, si ɖi amegbetɔ lã, bɔbɔ nɔ nusi ɖi fiazikpuia la dzi.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Meɖe ŋku ɖe eƒe ali ŋu ɖo ta dziƒo gome, wòle abe sika, si me kɔ keŋkeŋ la ene, eye nane le dzedzem le eme godoo abe dzo ene; eye meɖe ŋku ɖe eƒe ali ŋu ɖo ta anyi me gome, wòle abe dzo ene, eye keklẽ ɖe to ɖee.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Keklẽ, si ɖe to ɖee la, le abe alesi anyieʋɔ ɖina ɖe alilikpo ŋu le tsidzadza megbe ene. Esia nye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe nɔnɔme. Eye esi mekpɔe la, metsyɔ mo anyi, eye amea ɖe le nu ƒom mese.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, tsi tre ɖe wò afɔ dzi, ne maƒo nu kpli wò.

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Esi wòƒo nu kplim la, gbɔgbɔ la ɖo menye, eye wòfɔm ɖe te ɖe nye afɔwo dzi, eye melé to ɖe amesi le nu ƒom kplim la ŋu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, madɔ wò ɖe Israel-viwo, dukɔ dzeaglã, si dze aglã ɖe ŋunye la gbɔ, woawo kple wo fofowo trɔ ʋu le yonyeme va do egbenɔwo tsɛ.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Vi, siwo gbɔ mele dɔwòm ɖo la, mo kplala li na wo, eye woƒe tame sẽ goŋgoŋ. Gblɔ na wo bena: „Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi!“

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Ke wosee o, womeɖasee o, woanyae be, nyagblɔɖila ɖe nɔ yewo dome kpɔ; elabena ƒome sẽto wonye.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: Ke wò amevi, nenye be, nèle dza kple aŋɔkawo gbɔ, eye nètso aƒe ɖe dziɖegbewo gbɔ hã la, megavɔ̃ wo o, eye megavɔ̃ woƒe nyawo o! Megavɔ̃ woƒe nyawo o, eye woƒe mo megatso dzika ƒo na wò o, elabena ƒome sẽto wonye;

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: ke boŋ gblɔ nye nyawo na wo, wosee o, womeɖasee o; elabena ƒome sẽto wonye.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: Ke wò amevi, se nya, si gblɔ ge mala na wò, eye megasẽ to abe ƒome sẽto la ene o! Ke wò nu naɖu nusi tso ge mala na wò la!

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ wodo asia ɖe ɖe gbɔnye, si me agbalẽ le.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Eye wòkekee ɖe ŋkunye me, woŋlɔ nu ɖe eme kple ekɔgo, eye woŋlɔ konyifahawo, hũɖeɖewo kple vevesesewo ɖe eme.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: hegblɔ nam bena: Amevi, tso agbalẽ, si metsɔ na wò la, ɖi ƒoe, eye natsɔe ayɔ wò dɔgboe! Eye meɖui, wòviví le nu me nam abe anyitsi ene.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, yi Israel ƒe aƒe la gbɔ nagblɔ nye nyawo na wo.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: eye menye dukɔ geɖe, siwo nye fiafialawo kple kɔkɔlawo, amesiwo ƒe gbe mèsena o la gbɔe mele dɔwòm ɖo o; eye ɖe wònye woawo gbɔe medɔ wò ɖo la, anye ne woaɖo to wò.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Ke Israel ƒe aƒe la mele to ɖo ge wò o, le esi wogbe toɖoɖom ta; elabena ŋgonu kplala kple dzi kuatri li na Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Yi aboyome, siwo nye mia ɖeviwo la gbɔ, eye naƒo nu kpli wo agblɔ na wo bena: „Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi“; wosee o, womeɖasee o! Gbɔgbɔ la ko Xezekiel dzoe.

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Tete gbɔgbɔ la kɔnu eye mese hoowɔwɔ abe anyigbaʋuʋu gãa ɖe ene le megbenye, esime Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ho le eteƒe,

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: kple nu gbagbeawo ƒe aʋala, siwo le wo nɔewo kam ƒe ɖiɖi hekpe ɖe tasiaɖamfɔawo ƒe ɖiɖi kpakple anyigbaʋuʋu gãa ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Tete gbɔgbɔ la kɔm dzoe, eye melé nye mɔ tsɔ, dzi kum vevie, eye Yehowa ƒe asi nu sẽ ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Eye meva Tel-Abib le aboyome, siwo le Kebar-tɔsisi nu la gbɔ, eye menɔ wo dome le afima ŋkeke adre nu maƒomaƒoe. Woɖo Xezekiel Israel ƒe aƒe ŋudzɔlae.

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke adre megbe la Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: Amevi, metsɔ wò ɖo dzɔla na Israel ƒe aƒe la be, ne èse nyaa ɖe tso nunye me la, naxlɔ̃ nu wo nam.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Ne megblɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi be: „Ele kuku ge,“ eye mexlɔ̃ nui heƒo nu kplii be, ame vɔ̃ɖi la nakpɔ eɖokui dzi ɖe eƒe mo vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu, ne woatsi agbe o la, ekema ame vɔ̃ɖi la aku le eƒe vodadawo ta; ke asiwò me mabia eƒe ʋu le.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Ke ne èxlɔ̃ nu ame vɔ̃ɖi, la, eye wogbe asiɖeɖe le eƒe vɔ̃ɖinyenye kple eƒe mɔ vɔwo ŋu la, ekema aku le eƒe vodadawo ta; ke wò la eɖe wò agbe.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Ne ame dzɔdzɔe ɖe asi le eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ŋu hewɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi la, ekema maɖo nu nɛ, wòakli aku. Elabena esi mèxlɔ̃ nui o la, eyata woku le eƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta ɖo, eye womagaɖo ŋu eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe, siwo wòwɔ la o; ke asiwò me mabia eƒe ʋu le.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Ke ne èxlɔ̃ nu ame dzɔdzɔe la be, megawɔ nuvɔ̃ o, eye ame dzɔdzɔe la mewo nuvɔ̃ o, ke boŋ wòna woxlɔ̃ nui la, ekema atsi agbe; eye wò la eɖe wò agbe. Nyagblɔɖila la gakpɔ Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe asi va dzinye le afima wògblɔ nam bena: Tso nayi bali la me, ne maƒo nu kpli wò le afima!

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Tete metso heyi bali la me, eye kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le tsitre ɖe afima abe ŋutikɔkɔe, si mekpɔ le Kebar-tɔsisi la nu ene, eye metsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Eye gbagba la ɖo menye hefɔm ɖe te ɖe nye afɔwo dzi, eye wòƒo nu kplim gblɔ nam bena: Yi naɖatu ʋɔ ɖe ɖokuiwò nu le aƒewò me.

english_verse: You will be tied up to keep you inside,
translation_verse: Wò amevi, kpo ɖa, wole ka tsa ge aɖo ŋuwò ahabla wò, be magaɖo ayi wo dome o.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Eye mana wò aɖe nalé ɖe aŋɔ me na wò kaɖii, ne wò aɖe natu, be magagblɔ tohenya na wo o; elabena ƒome sẽto wonye.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ke ne maƒo nu kpli wò la, maʋu nu na wò, eye nagblɔ na wo bena: „Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi.“ Amesi see la, nesee; amesi gbe la, negbe; elabena ƒome sẽto wonye.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Wò amevi, tsɔ anyikpe ɖo ŋkuwò me, eye nata Yerusalem-du la ɖe edzi;

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke wò la tsa gagba nawɔ gagli atso mia kple ɖu la dome, trɔ mo de du la, woaɖe to ɖee, eye naxaxae ɖo; dzesi enye esia na Israel ƒe aƒe la.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Trɔ ŋku me de Yerusalem, si woɖe to ɖo la, eye naɖe abɔ ƒuƒlu agblɔ nya ɖe anyi ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mede ka wò, be magatrɔ ɖe axa bubu dzi, hafi ne wò toɖeɖe ƒe ŋkekeawo nava de o.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: Ke wò la tso bli, lu, gbagbayi, ayi, ƒo kple meli de ze me, eye natsɔ wo aƒo aboloe na ɖokuiwò, ne naɖu le ŋkeke alafa etɔ̃ kple blaasieke, siwo nemlɔ wò axa dzi la me.

english_verse: Eat only a small loaf of bread each day
translation_verse: Wò gbe sia gbe nuɖuɖu ƒe dadame nanye sekel blave, eya naɖu tso ɣeyiɣi dzi ɖaseɖe bubu dzi.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Ƒoe abe lubolo ene naɖu, eye namèe le amemĩ dzi le wo ŋku me.

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ bena: Alea Israel-viwo aɖu abolo makɔmakɔ le dukɔwo domee, afisi menya wo aɖo ɖo.

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ bena: Ao, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, kpɔ ɖa, nyemegblẽ ko ɖo na ɖokuinye kpɔ o, nyemeɖu lã kuku alo lã, si nu vuvu la, tso nye ɖevime vaseɖe egbe o, eye lã ƒaƒã mede nye nu me kpo o!

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Kpɔ ɖa, meɖe gbe na wò bena, namè wò abolo la le nyimĩ dzi ɖe amemĩ teƒe.

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam be: Amevi, kpo ɖa, maŋe abolo ƒe ziɔɖeŋu le Yerusalem, eye woatso vovɔ̃ aɖu abolo ɖe dada nu, eye woatsɔ ŋɔdzi ano tsi ɖe dzidze nu;

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: ne abolo kple tsi nahiã wo, eye ame ƒe nu naku ɖe nɔvia ŋu, eye woatsrɔ̃ ɖe woƒe vodada me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: Wò amegbetɔvi, tso yi ɖaɖɛ wo talũhɛ, ne natsɔ alũ wò ta kple wò ge, eye natsɔ nudanu amã ɖawo mee.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Tɔ dzo akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka ɖe dua me, nenye be, toɖeɖe ƒe ŋkekeawo wu enu; tsɔ yi fũ akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka ƒo xlãe godoo, eye natsɔ akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka ahlẽ ɖe ya nu, eye maɖi yi anɔ wo yome.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Ɖe suea ɖe le eŋu nasa ɖe wò avɔ nu,

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: eye gaɖe ʋeea ɖe le esia ŋu de dzo me, ne wòafiã ɖe dzo me; esia me dzo atso ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la ŋu.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Nyee tsɔ Yerusalem sia ɖo dukɔwo dome, eye anyigbawo ɖe to ɖee godoo.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Wosẽ to ɖe nye sewo ŋu vloe wu dukɔwo, eye ɖe nye ɖoɖowo ŋu wu anyigba, siwo ɖe to ɖe wo godoo; elabena wogbe nye seawo, eye womezɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu o.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi miesẽ to wu dukɔ, siwo ƒo xlã mi godoo, miezɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu o, eye miewɔ nu ɖe nye sewo nu, ʋuu kekeke miahayi nu wɔ ge ɖe dukɔ, siwo ƒo xlã mi godoo ƒe sewo nu o la,

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, nye hã maƒo ɖe dziwò, eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le mewò le dukɔwo ŋku me,

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: eye mawɔ nu mawɔkpɔa ɖe ŋuwò le wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã ta, nusi tɔgbe nyemegale wɔwɔ ge o.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Eyata fofowo aɖu wo viwo le mewo, eye viwo aɖu wo fofowo; madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò, eye makaka wò ame mamleawo katã ahlẽ ɖe yawo nu.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe, esi netsɔ wò legbawo katã kple wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã gblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye kɔkɔeƒe ta la, ne magbe wò gbagbã gudugudu, nye ŋku akpɔ nublanui na wò, eye makpɔ tawo fi!

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Wò akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka aku ɖe dɔvɔ̃ nu, eye dɔwuame atsrɔ̃ wo ɖe mewò; akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka atsi yi nu aƒo xlã wò godoo ava kpe, eye makaka akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka ahlẽ ɖe yawo katã nu, eye maɖi yi anɔ wo yome.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: Eye nye dɔmedzoe abi ade eseƒe ke, nye dziku nu afa ɖe wo ŋu, eye mafa dzi na ɖokuinye, ne wòadze sii be, nye Yehowa ye ƒo nu le nye ŋuʋaʋã me, nenye be, metrɔ nye dziku blibo la ƒo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Eye azu alɔmeɖenu kple vlodonu, nuxlɔ̃amenu kple ŋɔdzinu na dukɔ, siwo ƒo xlã wò godoo, nenye be, medrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò le dɔmedzoe kple dziku me, eye mehe to na wò kple dziku; nye Yehowa ye gblɔe;

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: ne meda dɔwuame ƒe aŋutrɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe wo dome, ne woazu amewula, eye meda wo, be woagblẽ mi, eye meli kɔ dɔwuame ɖi na mi gleglegle, eye meŋe abolo ƒe ziɔɖeŋu na mi.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mahe dɔwuame kple lã wɔadãwo ava mia dzi, ne woaɖe vi le ŋuwò, dɔvɔ̃ kple ʋukɔkɔɖeanyi ava ƒo ɖe dziwò, eye mana yi nava dziwò; nye Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: Amevi, trɔ mo de Israel-towo, eye nagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe wo ŋu

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Mi Israel-towo, mise Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe nya! Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ ɖe towo kple togbɛwo, agatowo kple balimewo ŋu enye si: Kpɔ ɖa, mahe yi ava mia dzi, eye magblẽ miaƒe nuxeƒewo.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo agblẽ, miaƒe ɣelegbawo agba, eye matsɔ miaƒe ame tsiaʋawo aƒu gbe ɖe miaƒe legbawo ŋku me;

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: matsɔ Israel-viwo ƒe kukuawo aɖo woƒe legbawo ŋku me, eye makaka miaƒe ƒuwo aƒo xlã miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Míaƒe duwo azu aƒedo le mia nɔƒewo katã, eye miaƒe nuxeƒewo agblẽ: elabena woagbã miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, eye woatsrɔ̃ wo; woagbã miaƒe legbawo, eye woaɖe wo ɖa, woa mũ miaƒe ɣelegbawo, eye woatsrɔ̃ miaƒe dɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Eye ame tsiaʋawo atsi mia dome, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: Ke ne miekaka ɖe anyigbawo dzi la, mana amesiwo si le yi nu la, nakpɔtɔ na mi ɖe dukɔwo dome!

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: Miaƒe ame sisiwo aɖo ŋku dzinye le dukɔwo dome, afisi woɖe aboyo wo yii, nenye be, megbã woƒe ahasiwɔdzi, si trɔ le yonyeme, kple woƒe ŋku, siwo dze legbawo yome la; eye woanyɔ ŋu na woawo ŋutɔwo ɖokui le woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi, siwo wotso woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã wo la ta;

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: eye wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa; menye dzodzroe megblɔ be, mele vɔ̃ sia wɔ ge wo o.

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ƒu akpe, tu afa anyi, eye nado aléle ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe ƒe ŋunyɔnu vɔ̃ɖiawo katã ŋu, elabena wole yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ si me tsi ge.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Amesi le didiƒe la, dɔvɔ̃ awui, amesi le kpuiƒe la, atsi yi nu, eye amesi kpɔtɔ ɖi woɖe lã, aku ɖe dɔwuame si me, eye matrɔ nye dziku aƒo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye miadze sii bena, nyee nye Yehowa, ne miaƒe ame tsiaʋawo tsi miaƒe legbawo dome ƒo xlã miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo le togbɛ kɔkɔwo katã dzi, le towo katã ta me, le ati damawo katã kple logoti dodowo katã gome, teƒe, siwo wodo dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe na woƒe legbawo katã le.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Mado nye asi ɖa ɖe wo ŋu, eye mado gbegbe kple aƒedo anyigba la tso gbe dzi vaseɖe Ribla le wo nɔƒewo katã, ne wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: Amevi, ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Israel-nyigba ŋu enye si: Nuwuwu gbɔna, nuwuwu gbɔna na anyigba la ƒe go eneawo!

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: nye ŋku makpɔ nublanui na wò o, eye nyemakpɔ tawò o; ke boŋ mahe wò zɔzɔme ava dziwò, eye wò ŋunyɔnuwo anɔ dowòme, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, dzɔgbevɔ̃e kplɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖo gbɔna!

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Nuwuwu gbɔna, nuwuwu gbɔna, efɔ ɖe ŋuwò, kpo ɖa, egbɔna!

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzinɔla, nuwɔame gbɔna ɖe dziwò! Ɣeyiɣi la gbɔna, nuxagbe tu aƒe, eye menye aseyetsotso le towo dzi o!

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Azɔ ekpɔtɔ vie matrɔ nye dziku aƒo ɖe dziwò, eye nye dɔmedzoe katã nu nafa ɖe ŋuwò, madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò ɖe wò zɔzɔme nu, eye mahe wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã ava dziwò:

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Nye ŋku makpɔ nublanui na wò o, eye nyemakpɔ tawò o, mahe wò zɔzɔmewo ava dziwò, eye wò ŋunyɔnuwo anɔ dowòme, ne miadze sii be, nye Yehowa ye ƒo ame.

english_verse: Disaster is near! Injustice and arrogance are everywhere,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna, ŋkeke la gbɔna! Nuwɔame do, ameƒoti ƒo se, eye dada de ama!

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Ŋutasesẽ tsi zu vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ ƒe ameƒoti; wo dometɔa ɖeke megali o, woƒe ame gbogboawo dometɔa ɖeke megali o, woƒe nu gbogboawo dometɔa ɖeke megali o, eye woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo nu yi!

english_verse: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
translation_verse: Azã la ɖo, ŋkeke la ɖe, nuƒlela makpɔ dzidzɔ o, eye nudzrala maxa nu o; elabena dɔmedzoe va woƒe amehawo katã dzi

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Ne nudzrala tsi agbe hã la, matrɔ yi eƒe nudzadzrawo gbɔ o, elabena wokpɔ ŋutega ɖe woƒe amehawo katã ŋu, eye dzi aɖe le amesiame ƒo le eƒe vodadawo ta.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Woku kpẽ, eye wo katã wobla akpa, ke amea ɖeke meho yi aʋa o, elabena nye dɔmedzoe va woƒe amehawo katã dzi.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Yi le xexe, dɔvɔ̃ kple dɔwuame le aƒe me; amesi le gbe me la, yi awui, eye amesi le du me la, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ aɖui.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Miaƒe sisilawo asi, eye woano towo dzi abe akpakpawo le agato me ene, eye wo katã woanɔ xɔxlɔ̃m le woƒe vodadawo la.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Alɔwo katã ado agblɔ, eye klowo katã alólo azu tsi;

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ woƒe klosalo aƒu gbe ɖe kpɔdomee, eye wòabu woƒe sika ŋunyɔnui; woƒe klosalo kple sika maɖe wo le Yehowa ƒe dzikudogbe o; womate atsi woƒe dɔwuame nu o, eye womatsɔe aɖi ƒoe o; elabena eyae ble wo de vodada me.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe atsyɔ̃nu, siwo nye woƒe adegbeƒonuwo, wɔ legba, siwo nye woƒe ŋunyɔnuwoe, eyata mena wozu ŋunyɔnu na wo do;

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Maɖe ko ɖa le wo ŋu, ne woagblẽ ko ɖo na nye nu vevi la, eye mana adzoblasuwo nage ɖe eme ahagblẽ ko ɖo ne.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: Mitu kɔsɔkɔsɔ, elabena hlɔ̃ɖoɖo yɔ anyigba dzi, eye ŋutasesẽ ya dua me.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Mana dukɔwo ƒe vɔ̃ɖitɔwo nava xɔ woƒe aƒewo, matsi ŋusẽtɔwo ƒe dàda nu, eye woagblẽ ko ɖo na woƒe kɔkɔeƒewo.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzinu gbɔna, eye woaɖi ŋutifafa, ke mana anyi o.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e akplɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖo, eye ŋɔdzinya ava ɖe ŋɔdzinya yome; woadi ŋutega tso nyagblɔɖilawo si, nufiame abu ɖe nunɔlawo, eye adaŋudede de ame tsitsiwo.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Fia axa nu, dzidzi aƒo amegã, eye dukɔ hahoo la ƒe asi adzo nyanyanya, mawo wo ɖe woƒe zɔzɔme nu, eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo de woƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nu, ne wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime mebɔbɔ nɔ aƒenye me le ƒe adelia me, le dzinu adelia ƒe ŋkeke atɔ̃lia dzi, eye Yuda ame tsitsiwo bɔbɔ nɔ ŋkunye me la, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe asi va dzinye le afima.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: Eye medo ŋku anyi, kpɔ ɖa, nane le abe ame ene; eƒe ali ƒe anyi me gome le abe dzo ene, eye eƒe ali ƒe dzi me gome ɖi kekeli hele abe sika, si me kɔ keŋkeŋ la ene.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: Tete wòdo nane da abe asi ene helé nye taɖa, eye gbagba la kɔm ɖe anyigba kple dziƒo domee hekplɔm le Mawu ƒe ŋutega me va ɖo Yerusalem le agbo metɔ, si ɖo ta anyiehe gome la nu, afisi legbaa ɖe, si dea ŋuʋaʋã Yehowa me la le.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Eye Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le afima abe nɔnɔme, si mekpɔ le bali la me ene.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, fa ko dzi ɖe anyiehe gome! Tete mefɔ kɔ dzi, eye kpɔ ɖa, ŋuʋaʋã ƒe legba sia le vɔsamlekpui la ƒe agbo la nu le anyiehe gome.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, èle nusi wɔm wole la kpɔma? Ŋunyɔnu gã Israel ƒe aƒe la le wɔwɔm le afisia, ne wòatsɔ anyãm ɖa le nye kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu; ke ègale ŋunyɔnu gãwo kpɔ ge.

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔm yi xɔxɔnu la ƒe mo nu, eye meɖo ŋku anyi, kpɔ ɖa, do le glia me.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, ŋɔ gli la! Eye esi meŋɔ glia la, kpo ɖa, ʋotrua ɖe li.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena. Yi ɖe eme, ne nakpe ŋunyɔnu vɔ̃ɖi, siwo wɔm wole le afisia la ɖa!

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Esi mege ɖe eme la, kpɔ ɖa, wota nutatawo kple lãfɔnewo, siwo nye ŋunyɔnuwo la ƒe nɔnɔme vovovowo, kple Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe legbawo katã ɖe glia ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Eye Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe ame tsitsiwo dometɔ blaadre, amesiwo nu Yaazanya, Safan vi, le la tsi tre de wo ŋgɔ, amesiame lé sonu ɖe asi, eye dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe de dzi kɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be: Amevi, ele nusi Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe ame tsitsiwo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe le wɔwɔm le vivi me le eƒe xɔvi, si me nɔnɔmetatawo le me la kpɔma? Wole gbɔgblɔm be: Yehowa mele mía kpɔm o, Yehowa gblẽ anyigba la ɖi!

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Emegbe wògblɔ nam bena: Egale ŋunyɔnu gã, siwo wɔm wole la, kpɔ ge.

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔm va Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe agbo, si le anyiehe gome la nu, kpɔ ɖa, nyɔnuwo bɔbɔ nɔ afima le fafam na Tamus.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, èkpɔea? Egale ŋunyɔnu gãwo kpɔ ge wu esia.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam be: Amevi, èkpɔea? Ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe ŋunyɔnu, siwo wɔm wòle le afisia, mesɔ gbɔ nɛ o, hafi wotsɔ ŋutasesẽ le anyigba dzi yɔm, eye wole dziku dom nam de edzia? Kpɔ ɖa, wotso hahlayɛ le dodom ɖe woƒe ŋɔti nu.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Eyata nye hã mawo nu le dziku me, nye ŋku makpɔ nublanui o, eye nyemakpɔ wo ta o; eye me wodo ɣli ɖe to me nam sesĩe hã la, nyemasee na wo o.

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Emegbe wòdo ɣli ɖe to me nam sesĩe gblɔ bena: Mihe du la ƒe tohehe vɛ, eye amesiame nele eƒe amewunu de asi!

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsu ade to dzigbegbo, si ɖo ta anyiehe la ƒe mɔ va, wo dome amesiame lé ametsrɔ̃nu ɖe asi, eye ŋutsua ɖe le dome na wo, amesi ta aklala, eye agbalẽŋlɔnu le aklito nɛ. Eye wova he tsi tre ɖe akɔblivɔsamlekpui la xa.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Eye Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la ho tso Kerubiawo ta me, afisi wònɔ tsã la, heyi ɖe xɔ la ƒe kpui nu. Tete wòyɔ ŋutsu, si ta aklala, eye agbalẽŋlɔnu le aklito nɛ la.

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ ne bena: Yi naɖatsa le Yerusalem dua me, eye made dzesi ŋgonu na amesiwo le hũ ɖem, eye wole nu xam ɖe ŋunyɔnu, siwo katã wole wɔwɔm le eme ŋuti la.

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Miwu amegã ɖeɖiwo, ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo, ɖeviwo kple nyɔnuwo, ne miatsrɔ̃ wo; ke migade asi amesiwo katã ŋu dzesi le la ŋuti o, eye midze egɔme tso nye kɔkɔeƒe la gbɔ! Tete wodze egɔme ɖe ame tsitsi, siwo le aƒea ŋgɔ la ŋu

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Migblẽ kɔ ɖo na aƒe la, eye mitso ame kukuwo yɔ xɔxɔnu la taŋ! Miho yi! Tete woyi ɖawu amewo le dua me.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime wowu wo, eye nye ɖeka mekpɔtɔ la, metsyɔ mo anyi hedo ɣli gblɔ bena: Ao, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe ame susɔeawo katãe nèbe, yeatsrɔ̃, esi nètrɔ̃ wò dziku ƒo ɖe Yerusalem dzia?

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Tete wòɖo ŋu nam bena: Israel ƒe aƒe kple Yuda ƒe vodada sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ, hlɔ̃dodo yɔ anyigba dzi, eye nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ le dua me fũ; elabena wole gbɔgblɔm be: Yehowa gblẽ anyigba la ɖi, Yehowa mele mía kpɔm o.

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Eyata nye hã nye ŋku makpɔ nublanui o, eye nyemakpɔ wo la o, ke boŋ mahe woƒe zɔzɔme ava woƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu, si ta aklala, eye agbalẽŋlɔnu le aklito nɛ la, trɔ gbɔ gblɔ bena: Mewo, abe alesi nède se nam ene.

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: Eye meɖo ŋku anyi, kpɔ ɖa, nane ɖi fiazikpui do ɖe dziŋgɔli, si le Kerubiawo ta me la dzi le dzedzem abe gbloti ene.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na ŋutsu, si ta aklala bena: Yi ɖe tasiaɖam, siwo le Kerubiawo gome la domee, eye naku dzo asiʋlo ɖeka le Kerubiawo domee akɔ ɖe dua dzi! Eye wòyi mekpɔ.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Kerubiawo le tsitre ɖe xɔ la ƒe ɖusi me gome, esime ŋutsu la yi, eye alilikpo yɔ xɔxɔnu metɔ fũ.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ho dzo le Kerubiawo dzi yi xɔ la ƒe kpui nu, eye alilikpo yɔ xɔ la taŋ, eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe keklẽ yɔ xɔxɔnu la fũ.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Eye wose Kerubiawo ƒe aʋala ƒe ɖiɖi le xɔxɔnu kɔtoetɔ ke abe Mawu ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe gbe, ne ele nu ƒom ene.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Tete Kerubia ɖo asi ɖe Kerubiawo domee heɖe dzo, si le Kerubiawo dome la, de asi na ŋutsu, si ta aklala la, eye wòxɔe hedzo.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Nane dze le Kerubiawo ŋu abe amegbetɔ ƒe asi ene le woƒe aʋalawo te.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Eye meɖo ŋku anyi, kpo ɖa, tasiaɖamfɔ ene le Kerubiawo xa, tasiaɖamfɔ ɖeka le Kerubi ɖeka xa, eye tasiaɖamfɔ ɖeka le Kerubi bubu xa; tasiaɖamfɔawo le dzedzem abe adzagba ene.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Nɔnɔme ɖeka li na wo ame eneawo katã, eye wòle abe ɖe tasiaɖamfɔ ɖeka le bubu me ene.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Ne wole yiyim la, wozɔna ɖe woƒe axa eneawo dzi, eye wometrɔna, ne wole azɔli dzi o, elabena afisi ŋgɔgbetɔ ɖo tae la, afima wokplɔnɛ ɖo yina, eye wometrɔna, ne wole azɔli dzi o.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Ŋkuwo yɔ woƒe ƒodo blibo la kple woƒe megbe, woƒe asiwo kple woƒe aʋalawo kpakple woƒe tasiaɖamfɔ eneawo katã ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Mo ene li na wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe; mo gbãtɔ nye Kerubi ƒe mo, mo evelia nye amegbetɔ ƒe mo, etɔ̃lia nye dzata ƒe mo, eye enelia nye hɔ̃ ƒe mo.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: ne wotɔ la, woawo hã tɔna, eye ne wokɔ wo ɖokui dzi la, woawo hã kɔa wo ɖokui dzi, elabena nu gbagbeawo ƒe gbɔgbɔ le wo me.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe dzo le xɔ la ƒe kpui nu yi ɖanɔ Kerubiawo ta me.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Tete Kerubiawo ƒo aʋala hekɔ wo ɖokui dzi tso anyigba le ŋkunye me; esi woho la, tasiaɖamfɔawo hã kpe ɖe wo ŋu, eye wova tɔ ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe agbo nu le ɣedzeƒe gome, eye Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la le wo ta me.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Woawo nye nu gbagbe, siwo mekpɔ le Israel ƒe Mawu la gɔme le Kebar-tɔsisi la nu; azɔ medze sii be, Kerubiwo wonye.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Woƒe mowo ƒe nɔnɔme enye mo, siwo mekpɔ le Kebar-tɔsisi la nu; wo dome ɖesiaɖe ɖoa ta eŋgɔ tẽ.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ Yehowa ƒe nya, siwo katã wòɖe fiãm la, na aboyomeawo.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, ŋutsu siawo nye amesiwo le tame gbegblẽ ɖom, eye wole adaŋu vɔ̃ɖi ɖem le du sia me,

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ va dzinye, eye wògblɔ nam bena: Gblɔ be: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Israel ƒe aƒe, ale mieƒo nu enye si, eye nusi do tso dzi me na mi la, menyae.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Miedzi miaƒe ame kukuwo ɖe dzi le du sia me, eye mietsɔ ame kukuwo yɔ eƒe kpɔdomee taŋ.

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Miaƒe ame kuku, siwo mietsɔ da ɖe dua me la, woawoe nye lã, eye eyamae nye kutu; ke miawo la, woakplɔ mi adzoe le eme.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: Yi vɔ̃m miele, ke yie mahe va mia dzi, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: Makplɔ mi adzoe le eme, matsɔ mi ade asi na ame tutɔwo, eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Míatsi yi nu, eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi le Israel ƒe liƒo dzi, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Dua manye kutu na mi, eye miawo mianye lã anɔ eme o, ke boŋ madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi le Israel ƒe liƒo dzi,

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa; elabena miezɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu o, eye miewɔ nu ɖe nye sewo nu o, ke boŋ miewɔ nu ɖe dukɔ, siwo ƒo xlã mi godoo la ƒe sewo nu.

english_verse: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esi mele nya gblɔm ɖi la, kasia Pelatya, Benaya vi la ku; tete matsyɔ mo anyi hedo ɣli sesĩe gblɔ bena: Alele, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, Israel ƒe ame mamleawo nèbe, yeatsrɔ̃a?

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: Amevi, nɔviwòwo, nɔviwò aboyomeawo kple Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la, wonye amesiwo ŋu Yerusalemtɔwo le gbɔgblɔm le be: Woamawo le adzɔge tso Yehowa gbɔ, míawoe wotsɔ anyigba la na, be wòanye mía tɔ.

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ be: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Meɖo mi ɖe dukɔwo dome ʋĩ, eye mekaka mi ɖe anyigbawo dzi, eye menye kɔkɔeƒe na mi vie le anyigba, siwo dzi mieyi.

english_verse: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ be: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Maƒo mia nu ƒu tso dukɔwo dome, eye maƒo mia nu ƒu tso anyigba, siwo dzi miekaka ɖo la dzi ahatsɔ Israel-nyigba na mi.

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Woayi afima, eye woaɖe eƒe legbawo katã kple eƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã ɖa le edzi.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Mana dzi bubu wo, eye maɖe gbɔgbɔ yeye wo me, maɖe kpedzi le dɔ me na wo, eye mana lãkusidzi wo,

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: ne woazɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu, eye woalé nye sewo me ɖe asi ahawɔ wo dzi, woanye dukɔ nam, eye manye Mawu na wo.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo ƒe dzi dze woƒe legbawo kple woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo yome la, mahe woƒe zɔzɔme ava woƒe ta dzi, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Tete Kerubiawo ƒo aʋala, eye tasiaɖamfɔawo kpe ɖe wo ŋu, eye Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le wo ta me.

english_verse: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kɔ eɖokui dzi tso dua me heva no to, si le dua ƒe ɣedzeƒe la dzi.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Eye gbɔgbɔ la kɔm le ŋutega me ɖada ɖe aboyomeawo gbɔ le Kaldea-nyigba dzi to Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la me, eye ŋutega, si mekpɔ la, dzo le gbɔnye.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Amevi, ƒome sẽto me nele, amesiwo ŋku li na, ne woatsɔ akpɔ nui, ke womekpɔa nu o, eye to li na wo, ne woatsɔ ase nui, ke womesea nu o, elabena ƒome sẽto wonye.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: Wò amevi, do mɔzɔgba, eye nadze mɔ le ŋkeke me le wo ŋku me, dze mɔ tso nɔwòƒe yi teƒe bubu le wo ŋku me, ɖewohĩ woakpɔe bena, ƒome sẽto yewonye.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò agba la do goe le ŋkeke me abe mɔzɔgba ene, ne woakpɔ, eye nadze mɔ le wo ŋku me le fiẽ, abe alesi aboyomewo dzea mɔe ene.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ gli le wo ŋku me, eye nato eme ado ɖe egodo.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kɔe ɖo abɔta le wo ŋku me, eye ne blukɔ do la, natsɔe adzoe; tsyɔ nu ŋku me, be magakpɔ anyigba la o; elabena ɖe metsɔ wò ɖo dzesi na Israel ƒe aƒe la.

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Eye mewɔ, abe alesi wode se nam ene: Metsɔ nye agba la do goe le ŋkeke me abe mɔzɔgba ene, eye metsɔ asi ŋɔ gli la le fiẽ; esi blukɔ do la, metsɔe dzoe, eye mekɔe ɖo abɔta le wo ŋku me.

english_verse: The next morning, the Lord
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: Amevi, ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe, ƒome sẽto la, megblɔ na wò be: Nuka wɔm nele hã oa?

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Amegã, si le Yerusalem, kple Israel ƒe aƒe blibo, si le eme la tɔe nye nya sia.

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Gblɔ bena: Dzesi menye na mi, alesi mewɔ la, nenema ava me na woe: Woakplɔ woamawo adzoe, eye woayi aboyo me.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Amegã, si le wo dome la, alé agba ɖe abɔta adzo le blukɔ me, woaŋɔ gli, ne wòato eme adzo, eye atsyɔ nu ŋku me, le esi wòbe, yemele anyigba la kpɔ ge kple ŋku o ta.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Maɖo ɖɔ nɛ, eye nye mɔ̃ aɖee, makplɔe ayi Babel le Kaldeatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi, ke makpɔe o, eye afima wòaku ɖo.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Eye makaka eƒe xɔnametɔ, siwo katã ƒo xlãe godoo, kple eƒe aʋakɔwo katã ahlẽ ɖe yawo katã nu, eye maɖi yi anɔ wo yome.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: Eye ne mekaka wo ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye mehlẽ wo ɖe anyigbawo dzi la, wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Ke makpɔtɔ woƒe ame ʋeea ɖewo ɖi tso yi, dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃ si me, ne woaxlẽ woƒe ŋunyɔnuwɔwɔwo katã afia le dukɔwo dome, afisi woayi, ne woawo nadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: Amevi, nɔ ƒoƒom kpakpakpa naɖu wò abolo, eye nano wò tsi le dzodzo nyanyanya kple ŋɔdzi me.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ na dukɔ hahoo la bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Yerusalemtɔ, siwo le Israel-nyigba dzi la ŋu enye si: Woaɖu woƒe abolo kple vɔvɔ̃, eye woano woƒe tsi le ŋɔdzi me, elabena woƒe anyigba azu gbegbe, eye woaɖe edzi nuwo katã ɖa le edzinɔlawo katã ƒe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Du, siwo me ame le la, azu aƒedo, eye anyigba la azu gbegbe, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: Amevi, nya ka ƒomevi enye ekem gblɔm miele le Israel-nyigba dzi be, ɣeyiɣiawo gbɔ metsɔ o, eye ŋutegawo katã nu tso?

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ na wo be: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Matsi nya siawo tɔgbe nu, eye womagagblɔe le Israel azɔ o, ke boŋ gblɔ na wo bena: ɣeyiɣi la kple ŋutegawo katã ƒe nyawo tu aƒe.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋutega dzodzroa ɖeke kple alakpanyagblɔɖi maganɔ Israel ƒe aƒe la me azɔ o.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa menye, nya, si gblɔm mele la, ava me, eye manɔ anyi eteƒe nadidi o; mi ƒome sẽto, mia ŋɔlie mawɔ nya, si mele gbɔgblɔm la dzi, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: Amevi, kpɔ ɖa, Israel ƒe aƒe la le gbɔgblɔm be: Ŋkeke nanewo ŋue wòle ŋutega kpɔm ɖo, eye gbaɖegbe ŋue wòle nya gblɔm ɖi ɖo.

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Nye nyawo katã maganɔ anyi eteƒe nadidi o. Nya, si megblɔ la, ava me, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: Amevi, gblɔ nya ɖi ɖe Israel ƒe nyagblɔɖilawo, amesiwo le nya gblɔm ɖi la ŋu, eye nagblɔ na amesiwo le nya gblɔm ɖi tso woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzi me la bena: Mise Yehowa ƒe nya!

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Baba na nyagblɔɖila tsibomewo, amesiwo dze woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzi kple nusi womekpɔ o la yome!

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israel, wò nyagblɔɖilawo zu abe abeiwo le glikpowo me ene.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: Miexe gbagbãƒewo o, eye mieɖo gli ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe la ŋu, ne wòanɔ te ɖe aʋa nu le Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la dzi o.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Nu dzodzroa kpɔm wole, eye alakpanya gblɔm wole ɖi; wo, amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm be: „Yehowa ƒe gbe enye si,“ evɔ wònye Yehowa medɔ wo o hafi, eye wole mɔ kpɔm be, nya la ava me.

english_verse: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
translation_verse: Ɖe menye ŋutega dzodzroa míekpɔ, eye miegblɔ alakpanya ɖi le gbɔgblɔm be; „Yehowa ƒe gbe enye si,“ evɔ wònye nyemeƒo nu hafi o oa?

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi mieƒo nu dzodzroa, eye miekpɔ alakpanu la, eyata maƒo ɖe mia dzi, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Nye asi ava nyagblɔɖila, siwo kpɔa nu dzodzroa, eye wogblɔa alakpanya ɖi la dzi: womanɔ nye dukɔ ƒe ha me o, womaŋlɔ wo ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe agbalẽ me o, eye womade Israel-nyigba dzi o, ne wòadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ Yehowa.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: Elabena wokplɔ nye dukɔ la trae hele gbɔgblɔm be „ŋutifafa“, evɔ wònye ŋutifafaa ɖeke meli o hafi. Dukɔ la ɖo gli, eye woawo si akalo nɛ.

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na akalosilaawo be: Tsidzadza gbɔna hahaha, tsikpewo adza, eye ahom atu,

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: eye gli la amũ! Ɖe womegblɔ na mi emegbe be: Afika akalo, si miesi la, le hã oa?

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mana ahom natu le nye dziku me, tsi nadza bababa le nye dɔmedzoe me, eye tsikpewo nadza le nye dziku me, ne woagblẽ nu.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Mamũ gli, si miesi akalo na la, eye matutui aƒu anyi, ale be eƒe agunu natsi go; amũ, eye miawo miaku ɖe ete, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: Matrɔ nye dziku blibo la aƒo ɖe gli la kple amesiwo si akalo nɛ la dzi ahagblɔ na mi be: Glia nu yi, eye amesiwo si akalo nɛ la nu yi,

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: woawo nye Israel ƒe nyagblɔɖilawo, amesiwo gblɔ nya ɖi ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eye wokpɔ ŋutifafa ŋutega nɛ, evɔ wònye ŋutifafa meli o hafi, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: Wò amevi, trɔ ŋgɔ dze wò dukɔ ƒe nyɔnuvi, siwo le nya gblɔm ɖi tso woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzi me, eye nagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe wo ŋu,

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Baba na amesiwo saa dzoka ɖe alɔnuwo katã, eye wowɔa tatsyɔnu ɖe tawo katã, ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo tɔ ŋu, ne woatsɔ alé luʋɔwoe; wòlé nye dukɔ ƒe luʋɔ, be woawo ŋutɔ ƒe luʋɔ natsi agbe.

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Mieɖo gum le nye dukɔ la ŋku me le lu asiʋlo ɖeka kple abolo alɔgomedede ɖeka ta, be miawu luʋɔ, siwo medze ku o, eye miaxɔ luʋɔ, siwo dze ku la, ɖe agbe, esime mieka aʋatso na nye dukɔ, si lɔ̃a aʋatsonya sese la.

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matso miaƒe dzoka, siwo mietsɔna ɖea luʋɔwoe abe xevi ene la, le miaƒe alɔnuwo, eye maxɔ luʋɔ, siwo mieɖe abe xevi ene la.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mavuvu miaƒe tatsyɔnuawo, eye maɖe nye dukɔ le mia si me, be maganye nuléle anɔ mia si me azɔ o, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: Esi mietsɔ alakpa do nuxaxa na ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe dzi, evɔ wònye nyemebe, mado nuxaxa nɛ hafi o, eye mieɖo ŋusẽ ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe asi, be magatrɔ tso eƒe mɔ vɔ̃wo dzi, ne woatsi agbe o la,

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: eyata miagakpɔ nu dzodzroa azɔ o, eye miagagblɔ alakpanya ɖi azɔ o, eye maɖe nye dukɔ le mia si me, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsuwo tso Israel ƒe ame tsitsiwo dome va gbɔnye, eye wobɔbɔ nɔ ŋkunye me.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: Amevi, ŋutsu siawo lé woƒe legbawo ɖe dzi me, eye wotsɔ woƒe vodadawo ƒe nukikliwo ɖo ŋku me, ɖe mana woabia gbema?

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Eyata ƒo nu kpli wo nagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ne Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe ŋutsua ɖe lé eƒe legba ɖe dzi me, eye wòtsɔ eƒe vodada ƒe nukikli ɖo ŋku me heva nyagblɔɖila gbɔ la, nye Yehowa ŋutɔ maɖo eŋu ne, evɔ wònye eƒe legbawo sɔ gbɔ hafi;

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: ne nye asi natu Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe dzi, wo amesiwo tso woƒe legbawo katã trɔ le yonyeme.

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe la bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mitrɔ, mitrɔ tso miaƒe legbawo yome, eye miɖe kɔ ɖa le miaƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã ŋu!

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: Elabena ne Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe amea ɖe, alo amedzro, siwo le Israel la dometɔa ɖe trɔ le yonyeme, elé eƒe legbawo ɖe dzi me, eye wotsɔ eƒe vodada ƒe nukikli ɖo ŋku me heva nyagblɔɖila gbɔ, ne woabia gbem nɛ la, nye Yehowa ŋutɔ maɖo ŋu nɛ.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye ŋku aɖo ŋutsu ma ŋu, eye matsɔe awɔ dzesi kple hamelo, eye matsrɔ̃e ɖa le nye dukɔ la dome, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: Ke ne woflu nyagblɔɖila ɖe wòƒo nu la, nye Yehowa ye flu nyagblɔɖila ma, eye mado nye asi ɖa ɖe eŋu ahatsrɔ̃e ɖa le nye dukɔ Israel dome.
