english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Eye woatsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe vodada: alesi gbebiala ƒe vodada le la, nenema nyagblɔɖila hã ƒe vodada anɔ;

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: ne Israel ƒe aƒe la magatra le ŋunye, eye woatsɔ woƒe dzidadawo katã agblẽ kɔ ɖo na wo ɖokui azɔ o, ke boŋ woanye nye dukɔ, eye manye woƒe Mawu, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe. Womagahe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ Yerusalem ɖe megbe le mawuvɔ̃lawo ƒe kukuɖeɖe ɖe eta trɔ hã ŋuti o.

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: Amevi, ne anyigbae ete wo nuvɔ̃ ele ŋunye hetrɔ ʋu le yonyeme, eye medo nye asi ɖa ɖe eŋu heŋe abolo ƒe ziɔdeŋu, eye meɖo dɔwuame ɖe afima, be matsrɔ̃ amegbetɔwo kple lãwo le edzi,

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: eye ŋutsu etɔ siawo: Noa, Daniel kple Hiob le edzi la, woaɖe woƒe agbe le woƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ta, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: Ne meɖo lã wɔadãwo ɖe anyigba dzi, be woaɖe ame le edzi, eye woazu gbegbe, be amea ɖeke magato edzi ayi o le lãwo ta,

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: eye ŋutsu etɔ̃ siawo le edzi la, Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Womaɖe ŋutsuvi alo nyɔnuvi o, negbe woawo ɖeɖe ko woaɖe, eye anyigba la azu gbegbe.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Alo ne meɖo yi ɖe anyigba ma dzi hegblɔ be: Vi, to anyigba dzi yi, eye mebe, matsrɔ̃ amegbetɔwo kple lãwo le edzi,

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: eye ŋutsu etɔ̃ siawo le edzi la, Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Womaɖe ŋutsuvi alo nyɔnuvi o, negbe woawo ɖeɖe ko woaɖe.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: Alo ne meɖo dɔvɔ̃ ɖe anyigba ma dzi, eye nye dziku zu ʋu metrɔ kɔ ɖe edzi, be matsrɔ̃ amegbetɔwo kple lãwo le edzi,

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.
translation_verse: eye Noa, Daniel kple Hiob le edzi la. Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Womaɖe ŋutsuvi alo nyɔnuvia ɖeke o, negbe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbe ko woaɖe le woƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ta.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ke ne meɖo yi, dɔwuame, lã wɔadã kple dɔvɔ̃, siwo nye nye tohenu vɔ̃ɖi eneawo ɖa ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, be matsrɔ̃ amegbetɔwo kple lãwo le eme la,

english_verse: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo, siwo tsi agbe la, akpɔtɔ ɖe eme, eye woakplɔ wo adzoe; woava mia gbɔ, eye ne miekpɔ woƒe zɔzɔme kple woƒe nuwɔna la, miafa akɔ na mia ɖokui le dzɔgbevɔ̃e, si mehe va Yerusalem dzi, kple nusiwo katã mena wova edzi la ŋuti.

english_verse: You will be convinced that I, the Lord God, was right in doing what I did.
translation_verse: Eye woata akɔ na mi, nenye be, miekpɔ woƒe zɔzɔme kple woƒe nuwɔnawo, eye miadze sii be, menye dzodzroe mewɔ nusiawo katã ɖe eŋu ɖo o, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, what happens to the wood of a grapevine after the grapes have been picked? It isn't like other trees in the forest,
translation_verse: Amevi, nukae nye weinka ƒe nake le nake bubuwo katã dome, eye nukae nye weinka le avemetiwo dome?

english_verse: because the wood of a grapevine can't be used to make anything, not even a small peg to hang things on.
translation_verse: Ɖe woatsɔ eƒe ati awɔ naneea, eye ɖe woatsɔe awɔ tsyoti aku nu ɖe eŋua?

english_verse: It can only be used as firewood. But after its ends are burnt and its middle is charred, it can't be used for anything.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wotsɔe na dzo, be wòafiã. Ne dzo fiã eƒe goawo kple eve, eye dzo ƒo domedomee nɛ la, ɖe wògale nane wowɔ mea?

english_verse: The wood is useless before it is burned, and afterwards, it is completely worthless.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, esi wògale blibo la, mele naneke wɔwɔ me o, azɔ esi dzo fiãe, eye wòƒo dzo la, ɖe wòayi nane wɔwɔ me nɔ gea?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise that just as the wood of a grapevine is burned as firewood,
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Alesi metsɔ weinka ƒe nake de asi na dzo, be wòafiã le avemetiwo dome la, nenema ke mawɔ Yerusalemtɔwoe.

english_verse: I will punish the people of Jerusalem with fire. Some of them have escaped one destruction, but soon they will be completely burned. And when that happens, you, Ezekiel, will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Matrɔ nye mo ɖe wo ŋu: dzo nu wòsi le, dzo ke afiã wo, eye miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa, nenye be, metrɔ nye mo ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: I will make their country an empty wasteland, because they have not been loyal to me. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eye mado gbegbe woƒe anyigba, le esi wotrɔ ʋu le yonyeme ta, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, remind the people of Jerusalem of their disgusting sins
translation_verse: Amevi, ɖe Yerusalem ƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã fiae.

english_verse: and tell them that I, the Lord God, am saying: Jerusalem, you were born in the country where Canaanites lived. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: Eye gblɔ bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ na Yerusalem enye si: Wò dzɔƒe kple dziwòƒe enye Kanaan-nyigba; Amoritɔe nye fofowò, eye Xititɔe nye dawo.

english_verse: When you were born, no one cut you loose from your mother or washed your body. No one rubbed your skin with salt and olive oil, and wrapped you in warm blankets.
translation_verse: Gbesigbe wodzi wò la, wometso ƒoƒolika na wò o, eye womele tsi na wò, be ŋuwò nadza o, womesi dze na wò o, eye wometsɔ wò mlɔ tsihe dzi o.

english_verse: Not one person loved you enough to do any of these things, and no one even felt sorry for you. You were despised, thrown into a field, and forgotten.
translation_verse: Ŋkua ɖeke mekpɔ nublanui na wò, ne woawɔ nusiawo dometɔa ɖeke na wò ahakpɔ tawò o, ke boŋ wotsɔ wò ƒu gbe ɖe gbe me, eye wonyɔ ŋu wò agbe le gbesigbe wodzi wò.

english_verse: I took care of you, like someone caring for a tender, young plant. You grew up to be a beautiful young woman with mature breasts and hair, but you were still naked.
translation_verse: Eye mana nasɔ gbɔ abe gbe le gbe me ene! Etsi heka ta, eye neɖo ɖetugbi atiati me; ète no, eye wò ɖa to; ke ènɔ amama heno ƒeƒle.

english_verse: When I saw you again, you were old enough to have sex. So I covered your naked body with my own robe. Then I solemnly promised that you would belong to me and that I, the Lord God, would take care of you.
translation_verse: Tete meva to ŋuwò yi, eye mekpɔ be, wò srɔ̃ɖeɣi ɖo; mekeke nye aʋala ɖe dziwò, eye metsyɔ nu wò ama, meka atam na wò, eye mebia nu kpli wò nèzu tɔnye; Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I washed the blood off you and rubbed your skin with olive oil.
translation_verse: Mele tsi na wò, meklɔ nu le ŋuwò, eye mesi ami na wò;

english_verse: I gave you the finest clothes and the most expensive robes, as well as sandals made from the best leather.
translation_verse: meta avɔ ŋɔŋɔe na wò, eye meɖo lãgbalẽ nyuitɔ ƒe atokota na wò, metsɔ aklala bla ta na wò, eye metsɔ seda wɔ taɖedzi na wò;

english_verse: a ring for your nose, some earrings, and a beautiful crown.
translation_verse: mede ŋɔtigɛ ŋɔti na wò, kple togɛ to na wò, eye metsɔ sikatsyɔnu nyui ɖɔ ɖe ta na wò.

english_verse: Your jewelry was gold and silver, and your clothes were made of only the finest material and embroidered linen. Your bread was baked from fine flour, and you ate honey and olive oil. You were as beautiful as a queen,
translation_verse: Edo sika kple klosalo, wò avɔtata nye aklala, seda kple avɔ ŋɔŋɔe, eye wò nuɖuɖu nye wɔ memee, anyitsi kple ami; ale nèdze tugbe eteƒe mekɔ o, eye fiaɖuƒe su asiwò.

english_verse: and everyone on earth knew it. I, the Lord God, had helped you become a lovely young woman.
translation_verse: Eye wò ŋkɔ nyɔ le dukɔwo dome le wò tugbedzedze ta, elabena nye atsyɔ̃, si meɖo na wò la, gbɔgblɔ mele eŋu o, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You learned that you were attractive enough to have any man you wanted, so you offered yourself to every passerby.
translation_verse: Ke eɖo dzi ɖe wò tugbedzedze ŋu, eye esi wò ŋkɔ nya ŋuti la, ètsɔ wò gbolowɔwɔ do dzodzoe ɖe amesiame, si va tso me yi la ŋu wòzu etɔ.

english_verse: You made shrines for yourself and decorated them with some of your clothes. That's where you took your visitors to have sex with them. These things should never have happened!
translation_verse: Etsɔ wò avɔwo dometɔa ɖewo wɔ nuxeƒe ŋɔŋɔewoe, eye nèwɔ gbolo le afima, nusi tɔgbe meva eme kpɔ o, eye mele eme va ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: You made idols out of the gold and silver jewelry I gave you, then you sinned by worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: Etsɔ nye sika kple nye klosalo ƒe atsyɔ̃nu, siwo metsɔ na wò la, wɔ ŋutsu ƒe nɔnɔmewo, eye nèwɔ gbolo kple wo.

english_verse: You dressed them in the clothes you got from me, and you offered them the olive oil and incense I gave you.
translation_verse: Etsɔ nye avɔ ŋɔŋɔewo tsyɔ na wo, eye nètsɔ nye ami kple nye dzudzɔʋeʋẽedonu ɖo wo kɔme.

english_verse: I supplied you with fine flour, olive oil, and honey, but you sacrificed it all as offerings to please those idols. I, the Lord God, watched this happen.
translation_verse: Eye nusi metsɔ na wò, be naɖu, wɔ memee, ami kple anyitsi la, woawo netsɔ ɖo wo kɔme, ne wòaʋẽ ɖe wo lilili; alea nèwɔ, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: But you did something even worse than that—you sacrificed your own children to those idols!
translation_verse: Elé wò ŋutsuvi kple wò nyɔnuvi, siwo nèdzi nam la, hewu na wo, be woaɖu. De wò gbolowɔwɔ mesɔ gbɔ o,

english_verse: You were so busy sinning and being a prostitute that you refused to think about the days when you were young and were rolling around naked in your own blood.
translation_verse: Le wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã kple wò gbolowɔwɔwo me la mèɖo ŋu wò ɖevimenɔɣi, esime nèɖe ama le ƒeƒle hele afɔti dam le wò ʋu me la o.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord God, say you are doomed! Not only did you do these evil things,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Baba na wò, baba na wò! Le wò nu vɔ̃ɖiwo katã wɔwɔ megbe la

english_verse: but you also built places on every street corner
translation_verse: ètu trɔ̃xɔwo na ɖokuiwò, eye nèwɔ nuxeƒewo ɖe kpɔdomeewo katã;

english_verse: where you disgraced yourself by having sex with anyone who walked by. And you did that more and more every day!
translation_verse: èwɔ nuxeƒewo ɖe kpɔdomeewo ƒe dzogoewo katã dzi, eye nedo ŋunyɔ wò tugbedzedze; èke ata na amesiwo katã va yina, eye nena wò gbolowɔwɔ sɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: To make me angry, you even offered yourself to Egyptians, who were always ready to sleep with you.
translation_verse: Ewo gbolo kple wò aƒelika Egipte-viwo, amesiwo ŋutsu lekpẽ li na, eye nena wò gbolowɔwɔ sɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi, ne natsɔ ado dziku nam.

english_verse: So I punished you by letting those greedy Philistine enemies take over some of your territory. But even they were offended by your repulsive behavior.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mado nye asi ɖa ɖe ŋuwò, eye maka ɖe le wò gome ŋu, eye matso wò ade asi na wò futɔwo, Filistitɔwo ƒe nyɔnuviwo ƒe nyanyrã, amesiwo wò ŋukpenanuwɔwɔwo le ŋu kpem na.

english_verse: You couldn't get enough sex, so you chased after Assyrians and slept with them. You still weren't satisfied,
translation_verse: Ewo gbolo kple Asur-viwo, le esi nu metia ko na wò o ta; ewo gbolo kpli wo, ke nu meti ko na wò o.

english_verse: so you went after Babylonians. But those merchants could not satisfy you either.
translation_verse: Eye nègawɔ gbolo ɖe dzi kple Kaldea, si nye asitsalawo ƒe anyigba; ke eya hã meli ko na wò o.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say that you were so disgusting that you would have done anything to get what you wanted.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Nu te wò dzi ŋu, esi nèwɔ nusiawo katã, abe alesi gbolo ŋukpenanuwɔla wona ene;

english_verse: You had sex on every street corner, and when you finished, you refused to accept money. That's worse than being a prostitute!
translation_verse: esi nètu trɔ̃xɔwo ɖe kpɔdomeewo ƒe dzogoewo katã dzi, eye nèwɔ nuxeƒewo ɖe ablowo katã me. Ke wòa mèle abe gbolo bubuwo ene, ne nahayi vlo ɖo ge gbolohoa ɖeke o.

english_verse: You are nothing but an unfaithful wife who would rather have sex with strangers than with your own husband.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu ahasitɔ, si ɖe ŋutsu bubu ɖe srɔ̃a te, nènye!

english_verse: Prostitutes accept money for having sex, but you bribe men from everywhere to have sex with you.
translation_verse: Gbolo bubuwo katã la, ɖe wonaa nu wo, ke wòa èna nu wò ahiãviwo katã; ɖe nèna nu wo, be woatso goawo katã me avawo amatre kpli wò.

english_verse: You're not like other prostitutes. Men don't ask you for sex—you offer to pay them! Jerusalem Must Be Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Towo to vovo le wò gbolowɔwɔ me tso nyɔnu bubuwo tɔ gbɔ, womedi ahiã wò o, eye wòa nèxe fe ɖe eta, evɔ wònye wòe woaxe fe na hafi; ale tɔwò to vovo sã.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you prostitute, listen to me.
translation_verse: Eyata, wò gbolo, se Yehowa ƒe nya!

english_verse: You chased after lovers, then took off your clothes and had sex. You even worshiped disgusting idols and sacrificed your own children as offerings to them.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi nètso wò gbolowɔwɔ kple wò ahiãviwo kpakple wò legba nyɔŋuawo katã, siwo nètso viwòwo ƒe ʋu na la, hewɔ be, wò ŋukpe gbagba ƒo ɖi, eye wò ama dze la,

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will gather every one of your lovers, those you liked and those you hated. They will stand around you, and I will rip off your clothes and let all of those lovers stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: eyata maƒo wò ahiãviwo katã nu ƒu, esiwo ƒe nu dze ŋuwò kple esiwo katã nèlɔ̃na kpakple esiwo katã nèlé fui, maƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe ŋuwò tso goawo katã me, eye maɖe ama wò, ne woakpɔ wò ama blibo la.

english_verse: I will find you guilty of being an unfaithful wife and a murderer, and in my fierce anger I will sentence you to a violent death!
translation_verse: Madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò ɖe gbolowo kple nyɔnu hlɔ̃dolawo ƒe se nu, eye mahe dziku kple ŋuʋaʋã ƒe ʋu ava dziwò.

english_verse: Then I will hand you over to your lovers, who will tear down the places where you had sex. They will take your clothes and jewelry, leaving you naked and empty-handed.
translation_verse: Matso wò ade asi na wo, eye woagbã wò trɔ̃xɔwo ahamũ wò nuxeƒewo aƒu anyi, woaɖe ava le ŋuwò, eye woaxɔ wò atsyɔ̃nuawo ahagblẽ wò ɖi natsi ama anɔ ƒeƒle.

english_verse: Your lovers and an angry mob will stone you to death; they will cut your dead body into pieces
translation_verse: Woayɔ amehawo ɖe ŋuwò, eye woaxlã kpe ɖe wò ahadza wò kple woƒe yiwo.

english_verse: and burn down your houses. Other women will watch these terrible things happen to you. I promise to stop you from being a prostitute and paying your lovers for sex.
translation_verse: Woata dzo wò xɔwo, eye woahe to na wò le nyɔnu geɖewo ŋku me; matsi wò gbolowɔwɔ nu, eye magaxe gboloho azɔ o.

english_verse: Only then will I calm down and stop being angry and jealous.
translation_verse: Mana nye dziku nu nafa ɖe ŋuwò, be nye ŋuʋaʋã nadzo le ŋuwò, eye magbɔ ɖe eme, nyemagado dɔmedzoe azɔ o.

english_verse: You made me furious by doing all these disgusting things and by forgetting how I took care of you when you were young. Then you made things worse by acting like a prostitute. You must be punished! I, the Lord God, have spoken. Jerusalem's Two Sisters The Lord said:
translation_verse: Esi meɖo ŋu wò ɖevimenɔɣi o, ke boŋ nètsɔ nusiawo katã do dziku nam ŋuti la, eyata kpɔ ɖa, mahe wò zɔzɔme ava wò ta dzi, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe: Ɖe mèhewɔ ŋukpenanu sia kpe ɖe wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã ŋu o ɖe!

english_verse: People will use this saying about you, Jerusalem: “If the mother is bad, so is her daughter.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ne amesiame be, yeado hamelo la, adoe ɖe ŋuwò bena: „Alesi dada le la, nenema vianyɔnu nɔna.“

english_verse: You are just like your mother, who hated her husband and her own children. You are also like your sisters, who hated their husbands and children. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: Dawò vinyɔnu kpamkpam nenye, eya amesi gbe srɔ̃a kple viawo; eye nɔvinyɔnu kpamkpam nènye na nɔviwònyɔnuwo, amesiwo gbe wo srɔ̃wo kple wo viwo; Xititɔe nye mia dada, eye Amoritɔe nye mia fofo.

english_verse: Your older sister was Samaria, that city to your north with her nearby villages. Your younger sister was Sodom, that city to your south with her nearby villages.
translation_verse: Dawòe nye Samaria hekpe ɖe vianyɔnu, siwo le wò mia me la ŋu, eye wò tsɛ nye Sodom hekpe ɖe vianyɔnu, siwo le wò ɖusi me la ŋu.

english_verse: You followed their way of life and their wicked customs, and soon you were more repulsive than they were.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe ko mèzɔ woƒe mowo dzi o, eye mewɔ nu ɖe woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo nu o; tete nèwɔ nu le wò mowo katã dzi wòvloe wu wo to.

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, the people of Sodom and its nearby villages were never as sinful as you.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Meta ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne nɔviwònyɔnu Sodom kple vianyɔnuwo hewɔ, abe alesi mia kple viwònyɔnuwo miewɔ ene fi!

english_verse: They were arrogant and spoiled; they had everything they needed and still refused to help the poor and needy.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nɔviwònyɔnu Sodom ƒe vodada enye: Dàda kple nuɖuɖu fũ, eye eya kple nɔvianyɔnuwo nɔ agbe vivi bɔkɔɔ; ke mekpe ɖe ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo ŋu o.

english_verse: They thought they were better than everyone else, and they did things I hate. And so I destroyed them.
translation_verse: Woda, eye wowɔ ŋunyɔnu le ŋkunye me, eye esi mekpɔe ko la, meɖe wo ɖa.

english_verse: You people of Jerusalem have sinned twice as much as the people of Samaria. In fact, your evil ways have made both Sodom and Samaria look innocent.
translation_verse: Samaria mewɔ wò nuvɔ̃wo ƒe afã o, eye ewo ŋunyɔnu wui; ale nètsɔ wò ŋunyɔnu, siwo katã nèwɔ la, tso afia na nɔviwònyɔnuwo.

english_verse: So their punishment will seem light compared to yours. You will be disgraced and put to shame because of your disgusting sins. Jerusalem Will Be Ashamed The Lord said to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Eyata wò hã ŋukpe nenɔ dziwò, le esi nexɔ nya ɖe nɔviwònyɔnuwo ta ŋuti, etso wò nuvɔ̃ nyɔŋu, siwo newɔ wu wo la, na be, wo to dzo wu towo. Eyata ŋu nekpe wò, eye wò ŋukpe nenɔ dziwò, le esi nètso afia na nɔviwònyɔnuwo ta.

english_verse: Someday I will bless Sodom and Samaria and their nearby villages. I will also bless you, Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Magaɖo wo te, maɖo Sodom kple vianyɔnuwo te kple Samaria kpakple vianyɔnuwo te, eye maɖo wò hã te le wo dome,

english_verse: Then you will be ashamed of how you've acted, and Sodom and Samaria will be relieved that they weren't as sinful as you.
translation_verse: ne wò ŋukpe nanɔ dziwò, eye ŋu nakpe wò le nusiwo katã nèwɔ hetsɔ fa akɔ na wo la ta.

english_verse: When that day comes, you and Sodom and Samaria will once again be well-off, and all nearby villages will be restored.
translation_verse: Nɔviwònyɔnu Sodom kple vianyɔnuwo agaɖo woƒe nɔnɔme tsãtɔ me, Samaria kple vianyɔnuwo agaɖo woƒe nɔnɔme tsãtɔ me, eye mia kple viwònyɔnuwo miagaɖo miaƒe nɔnɔme tsãtɔ me.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so arrogant that you sneered at Sodom.
translation_verse: Ɖe nɔviwònyɔnu Sodom ƒe ŋɔdzinya menɔ nuwò me le wò dadaɣi,

english_verse: But now everyone has learned how wicked you really are. The countries of Syria and Philistia, as well as your other neighbors, hate you and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: hafi ne woava klo nu le wò vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ dzi, abe alesi nezu vlodonu na Aram-nyɔnuviwo kple Filistitowo ƒe nyɔnuviwo, amesiwo ƒo xlã wò godoo, eye wole alɔme ɖem le ŋuwò le goawo katã me la ene oa?

english_verse: Jerusalem, you deserve to be punished, because you broke your promises and ignored our agreement.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi nèdo vlo atam la, eye netu nubabla la, eye mewɔ na wò, abe alesi nèwɔ ene hã la,

english_verse: But I remember the agreement I made with you when you were young, and so I will make you a promise that will last forever.
translation_verse: maɖo ŋu nye nu, si mebia kpli wò le wò ɖevimenɔɣi, eye mabia nu mavɔ kpli wò.

english_verse: When you think about how you acted, you will be ashamed, especially when I return your sisters to you as daughters, even though this was not part of our agreement.
translation_verse: Nenye be, ekplɔ nɔviwònyɔnuwo, esiwo nye xoxo na wò kple esiwo nye ɖevi na wò, eye metsɔ wo wɔ viwònyɔnuwoe, ke menye le wò nubabla la ta o la, ekema àɖo ŋu wò zɔzɔme, eye ŋu akpe wò.

english_verse: I will keep this solemn promise, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mabia nu kpli wò, ne nadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa;

english_verse: I will forgive you, but you will think about your sins and be too ashamed to say a word. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: ne naɖo ŋui, ŋukpe nalé wò, eye wò nu nade ga le ŋukpe ta, nenye be, metsɔ nusiwo katã nèwɔ la, ke wò, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel the following story,
translation_verse: Amevi, to adzo, eye nado lo na Israel ƒe aƒe la

english_verse: so they will understand what I am saying to them: A large eagle with strong wings and beautiful feathers once flew to Lebanon. It broke the top branch off a cedar tree,
translation_verse: gblɔ bena Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Hɔ̃ gãa ɖe, si ƒe aʋalawo lolo, eƒe aʋalafuwo didi, eye wòto fu ŋɔŋɔe kpoyoo la, va Libanon dzi, eye wòŋe sederti ƒe domee dzoe.

english_verse: then carried it to a nation of merchants and left it in one of their cities.
translation_verse: Èŋe woƒe alɔwo ƒe tametɔ hetsɔ yi nudzralawo ƒe anyigba dzi, eye wòtsɔe do ɖe asitsalawo ƒe du me.

english_verse: The eagle also took a seed from Israel and planted it in a fertile field with plenty of water, like a willow tree beside a stream.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ anyigba dzi nukuwo dometɔ ɖeka ɖaƒã de agble me, eƒãe ɖe tɔ gãwo to abe amuti ene.

english_verse: The seed sprouted and grew into a grapevine that spread over the ground. It had lots of leaves and strong, deep roots, and its branches grew upward toward the eagle.
translation_verse: Tete wòdze hezu weinka, si vu dranyi, eƒe zekpẽ mekɔ o, ne eƒe alɔwo nadzɔ ɖe eyama ŋu, eye eƒe kewo natsi ete. Ale wòzu weinka, eye wòɖe ka hevu alɔ.

english_verse: There was another eagle with strong wings and thick feathers. The roots and branches of the grapevine soon turned toward this eagle, hoping it would bring water for the soil.
translation_verse: Eye hɔ̃ gã bubua ɖe li, eƒe aʋalawo lolo, eye wòto fu kpoyoo; eye kpɔ ɖa, weinka ma bi eƒe kewo ɖe eŋu, eye wòdidi eƒe alɔwo ɖe egbɔ tso kpo, si dzi wodoe ɖo la dzi, ne wòana tsii wòano,

english_verse: But the vine was already growing in fertile soil, where there was plenty of water to produce healthy leaves and large grapes.
translation_verse: evɔ wònye agblewɔnu mee wodoe ɖo le tɔ gãwo to, be wòaɖe alɔ, atse ku, eye wòazu weinka nyui hafi.

english_verse: Now tell me, Ezekiel, do you think this grapevine will live? Or will the first eagle pull it up by its roots and pluck off the grapes and let its new leaves die? The eagle could easily kill it without the help of a large and powerful army.
translation_verse: Gblɔ be: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ɖe wòadze edzia? De mava aho eƒe kewo, ne woaku, eƒe alɔ fẽwo naƒu, eye woatso eƒe tsetsewo oa? Menye ŋusẽ gã kple dukɔ geɖe wòle tsɔtsɔ ge ava ahoe kple ke o.

english_verse: The grapevine is strong and healthy, but as soon as the scorching desert wind blows, it will quickly wither. The Lord Explains the Story
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wodoe, ke de wòadze edzia? Ne ɣedzeƒeya be ɖe eme la, ɖe maku oa? Kpo, si dzi wòmie do la dzie wòaku ɖo.

english_verse: Ezekiel, ask the rebellious people of Israel if they know what this story means. Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem, then he captured the king of Judah and his officials, and took them back to Babylon as prisoners.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na ƒome sẽto la bena: Miese nusia gɔmea? Gblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Babel-fia va Yerusalem, eye wòkplɔ eƒe fia kple eƒe amegãwo yi eɖokui gbɔ le Babel.

english_verse: He chose someone from the family of Judah's king and signed a treaty with him, then made him swear to be loyal. He also led away other important citizens,
translation_verse: Eɖe ame ɖeka le fiaƒome la me, eye wòbia nu kplii heka atam nɛ, ke ekplɔ anyigba dzi bubumewo dzoe;

english_verse: so that the rest of the people of Judah would obey only him and never gain control of their own country again.
translation_verse: ne fiaɖuƒe la natsi to, eye magafɔ eɖokui ɖe dzi o, be wòawɔ eƒe nubabla dzi, eye wòali ke.

english_verse: But this new king of Judah later rebelled against Babylonia and sent officials to Egypt to get horses and troops. Will this king be successful in breaking the treaty with Babylonia? Or will he be punished for what he's done?
translation_verse: Ke edze aglã ɖe eŋu, eye wòɖo ame ɖe Egipte, ne woana sɔ kple ame geɖewoe. Ɖe wòadze edzi nɛa, eye ɖe amesi wo alea la, asia? Eye esi wònye nubabla wòtu la, ɖe wòasia?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I swear that the king of Judah will die in Babylon, because he broke the treaty with the king of Babylonia, who appointed him king.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Meta ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne menye ɖe woaku ɖe fia, si tsɔe ɖo fia, amesi ƒe atam wòdo vloe, eye wòtu eƒe nubabla la de le Babel o fi!

english_verse: Even the king of Egypt and his powerful army will be useless to Judah when the Babylonians attack and build towers and dirt ramps to destroy the cities of Judah and its people.
translation_verse: Eye ne woƒu kpo ɖe eŋu, eye wotu dzɔlawo ƒe xɔ tsralawo, be woatsrɔ̃ ame geɖewo la, Farao matsɔ aʋakɔ gã kple ameha geɖe akpe ɖe eŋu le aʋa me o.

english_verse: The king of Judah broke his own promises and ignored the treaty with Babylonia. And so he will be punished!
translation_verse: Esi wòdo vlo atam la hetu nubabla la, evɔ wònye ena asi ame tso hafi wɔ nusiawo katã la, eyata masi o.

english_verse: He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne nyemahe nye atam, si wòdo vlo, kple nye nubabla, si wòtu la, ava eƒe ta dzi o fi!

english_verse: I will spread out a net to trap him. Then I will drag him to Babylon and see that he is punished for his unfaithfulness to me.
translation_verse: Maɖo nye ɖo nɛ, eye nye mɔ̃ aɖee, makplɔe ayi Babel, eye mahe nya kplii le afima le ʋu, si wòtrɔ le yonyeme la ta.

english_verse: His best troops will be killed in battle, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eƒe aʋawɔla tiatiawo katã, siwo le eƒe aʋalɔgowo katã me la, atsi yi nu, eye ame mamleawo akaka ɖe yawo katã nu, ne miadze sii be, nye Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Someday, I, the Lord, will cut a tender twig from the top of a cedar tree, then plant it on the peak of Israel's tallest mountain,
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Nyea matsɔ sederti kɔkɔ ƒe ɖɔmee aɖado; wo tametɔwo ƒe alɔ fẽa ɖe maŋe aɖado ɖe to kɔkɔ gãa ɖe dzi.

english_verse: where it will grow strong branches and produce large fruit. All kinds of birds will find shelter under the tree, and they will rest in the shade of its branches.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe to kɔkɔ dzi madoe ɖo, adze alɔ, atse ku, eye woazu sederti nyuia ɖe, eye xevi ƒomevi vovovowo katã anɔ ete, eƒe alɔwo ƒe vɔvɔli te woanɔ.

english_verse: Every tree in the forest will know that I, the Lord, can bring down tall trees and help short ones grow. I dry up green trees and make dry ones green. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will keep my word.
translation_verse: Eye gbemetiwo katã adze sii be, nye Yehowa ye bɔbɔ ati kɔkɔ la ɖe anyi, eye mekɔ ati tehee la ɖe dzi; nyee na ati mumu la ku, eye ati kuku la dze, nye Yehowa ye ƒo nu, eye mewɔe hã.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I hear the people of Israel using the old saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti miele lo sia dom le Israel-nyigba dzi bena: „Fofowo ɖu weintsetse hɔhlɔ̃e, eye aɖu nyɔ viwo?

english_verse: Now tell them that I am the Lord God, and as surely as I live, that saying will no longer be used in Israel.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne miagado lo sia lé Israel fi!

english_verse: The lives of all people belong to me—parents as well as children. However, only those who sin will be put to death.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, luʋɔwo katã, tɔnye wonye, fofo kple vi ƒe luʋɔ siaa, tɔnye wonye; luʋɔ, si wɔ nuvɔ̃ la, eyae aku.

english_verse: Suppose there is a truly good man who always does what is fair and right.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe nye ame dzɔdzɔe, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe kple nusi le eteƒe,

english_verse: He refuses to eat meat sacrificed to foreign gods at local shrines or to worship Israel's idols. He doesn't have sex with someone else's wife or with a woman having her monthly period.
translation_verse: meɖua nu le towo dzi o, eye mefɔa mo te ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe legbawo ŋu o, megblẽa kɔ ɖo na ehavi srɔ̃ o, eye metena ɖe nyɔnu ŋuti le eƒe dzinukpɔɣi o,

english_verse: He never cheats or robs anyone and always returns anything taken as security for a loan; he gives food and clothes to the poor
translation_verse: mebaa ame o, egbugbɔa awɔbanu, si wòxɔ ɖe eƒe fe nu la nana, eye meɖua sesẽnu o, enaa eƒe abolo dɔwuitɔwo, eye wòtaa avɔ na amesiwo tsi ƒeƒle,

english_verse: and doesn't charge interest when lending money. He refuses to do anything evil; he is fair to everyone
translation_verse: meɖia kasa le agbanadodo me o, eye mexɔa deme o, eɖea eƒe asi ɖa tso nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ me, eye wòtsoa afia na ame kple ehavi ɖe eteƒe,

english_verse: and faithfully obeys my laws and teachings. This man is good, and I promise he will live.
translation_verse: ezɔna ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu, eye wòléa nye sewo me ɖe asi hewɔa nuteƒe la, eya nye ame dzɔdzɔe, anɔ agbe kokoko, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: But suppose this good man has an evil son who is violent and commits sins
translation_verse: Eye ne edzi vi sẽŋuta, si kɔa ʋu ɖi, amesi wɔa nusiawo dometɔa ɖe,

english_verse: his father never did. He eats meat at local shrines, has sex with someone else's wife,
translation_verse: evɔ wònye fofoa mewɔa nusiawo dometɔa ɖeke o hafi; eyama ɖua nu le towo dzi, eye wògblẽa kɔ ɖo na ehavi srɔ̃,

english_verse: cheats the poor, and robs people. He keeps what is given to him as security for a loan. He worships idols, does disgusting things,
translation_verse: esẽa ŋuta le ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo ŋu, eɖua sesẽnu, eye megbugbɔa awɔbanu nana o, efɔa mo te ɖe legbawo ŋu, eye wòwɔa ŋunyɔnu,

english_verse: and charges high interest when lending money. An evil man like that will certainly not live. He is the one who has done these horrible sins, so it's his own fault that he will be put to death.
translation_verse: eɖia kasa le agbanadodo me, eye wòxɔa deme la, ɖe wòanɔ agbea? Manɔ agbe o, ke boŋ esi wòwɔa ŋunyɔnu siawo katã ŋuti la, eyata aku, eye eƒe ʋu ava edzi.

english_verse: But suppose this evil man has a son who sees his father do these things and refuses to act like him.
translation_verse: Eye ne edzi vi, eye wòkpɔ nuvɔ̃, siwo katã fofoa wɔna, ke evɔ, eye mewɔa emawo tɔgbe o:

english_verse: He doesn't eat meat at local shrines or worship Israel's idols, and he doesn't have sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Meɖua nu le towo dzi o, mefɔa kɔ te ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe legbawo ŋu o, eye megblẽa kɔ ɖo na ehavi srɔ̃ o,

english_verse: He never cheats or robs anyone and doesn't even demand security for a loan. He gives food and clothes to the poor
translation_verse: mesẽa ŋuta le amea ɖeke ŋu o, mexɔa awɔbanu o, eye meɖua sesẽnu o, enaa eƒe abolo dɔwuitɔwo, eye wòtaa avɔ na amesiwo tsi ƒeƒle,

english_verse: and refuses to do anything evil or to charge interest. And he obeys all my laws and teachings. Such a man will live. His own father sinned, but this good man will not be put to death for the sins of his father.
translation_verse: eɖea eƒe asi ɖa tso nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ me, meɖia kasa o, eye mexɔa deme o, ewɔa nye sewo dzi, eye wòzɔna ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu la, eya maku le fofoa ƒe vodadawo ta o, ke boŋ anɔ agbe.

english_verse: It is his father who will die for cheating and robbing and doing evil.
translation_verse: Ke esi fofoa sea ŋuta le ame ŋu, exɔa sesẽnu le nɔvia si, eye wòwɔa nu manyomanyo le wo ɖeviwo dome la, eyata aku le eƒe vodadawo la.

english_verse: You may wonder why a son isn't punished for the sins of his father. It is because the son does what is right and obeys my laws.
translation_verse: Miawo miele gbɔgblɔm be: Nukaŋuti fofo ƒe vodada manɔ via dzi ɖo o hã? Ne via wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe kple nusi le eteƒe, eye wòléa nye ɖoɖowo katã me ɖe asi hewɔa wo dzi la, anɔ agbe.

english_verse: Only those who sin will be put to death. Children won't suffer for the sins of their parents, and parents won't suffer for the sins of their children. Good people will be rewarded for what they do, and evil people will be punished for what they do.
translation_verse: Amesi wɔa nuvɔ̃ la, eyae aku; fofo ƒe vodada manɔ via dzi o, eye vi ƒe vodada manɔ fofo dzi o; ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ava eya ŋutɔ dzi, eye ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wowɔ ava eya ŋutɔ dzi. Mawu kpɔa ŋudzedze le vɔ̃wɔla ƒe dzimetɔtrɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Suppose wicked people stop sinning and start obeying my laws and doing right. They won't be put to death.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖi trɔ tso eƒe nuvɔ̃, siwo katã wòwɔna la me, eye wòlé nye ɖoɖowo katã me ɖe asi hewoa nu dzodzoe kple nusi le eteƒe la, ana agbe, maku o.

english_verse: All their sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they did right.
translation_verse: Womagaɖo ŋu eƒe dzi, siwo katã wòda la o, ke boŋ ana agbe le eƒe nu dzodzoe, siwo wòwɔna la ta.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't like to see wicked people die. I had much rather see them turn back from their sins and live.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe ku vivia nunyea? negbe ne etrɔ tso eƒe mɔwo dzi, be wòanɔ agbe la koe!

english_verse: But when good people start sinning and doing disgusting things, will they live? No! All their good deeds will be forgotten, and they will be put to death because of their sins.
translation_verse: Eye ne ame dzɔdzɔe ɖe asi le eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋu hewɔa nu gbegblẽ, eye wòwɔa ŋunyɔnu, siwo katã ame vɔ̃ɖi wɔna la, ɖe wòanɔ agbea? Womagaɖo ŋu nu dzɔdzɔe, siwo katã wòwɔ la o, le eƒe go, si wòdze, kple eƒe nuvɔ̃, siwo wòwɔ la ta; woawo ta wòaku ɖo.

english_verse: You people of Israel accuse me of being unfair! But listen—I'm not unfair; you are!
translation_verse: Ke miele gbɔgblɔm be: „Aƒetɔ la ƒe nuwɔna mele eteƒe o.“ Israel ƒe aƒe, misee: Nye nuwɔnae mele eteƒe oa? Ɖe menye miawo boŋ ƒe nuwɔnae mele eteƒe oa?

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they must be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Ne ame dzɔdzɔe ɖe asi le eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋu, eye wòwɔa nu gbegblẽ la, aku ɖe esia ta; eƒe nu gbegblẽ, si wòwɔna la tae wòaku ɖo.

english_verse: And if wicked people start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Eye ne ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖe asi le eƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi, si wòwɔ ŋu hewɔa nu dzɔdzɔe kple nusi le eteƒe la, axɔ eƒe luʋɔ ɖe agbe.

english_verse: They will think about what they've done and stop sinning, and so they won't be put to death.
translation_verse: Eye ne edze sii, eye wòɖe asi le eƒe dzi, siwo katã wòda ŋu la, anɔ agbe, maku o.

english_verse: But you still say that I am unfair. You are the ones who have done wrong and are unfair!
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe la le gbɔgblɔm be: „Aƒetɔ la ƒe nuwɔna mele eteƒe o.“ Israel ƒe aƒe, nye nuwɔnae mele eteƒe oa? De menye miawo boŋ ƒe nuwɔnae mele eteƒe oa?

english_verse: I will judge each of you for what you've done. So stop sinning, or else you will certainly be punished.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Israel ƒe aƒe, madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mia dome amesiame ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme nu. Miɖe asi le miaƒe dzidadawo katã ŋu, miɖe asi le wo ŋu, ne vodadawo maganye mɔ̃ na mi o!

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and start thinking pure thoughts. And be faithful to me! Do you really want to be put to death for your sins?
translation_verse: Miɖe miaƒe dzi, siwo katã mieda ɖe ŋunye la ɖa, eye miwɔ dzi yeye kple gbɔgbɔ yeye na mia ɖokui. Israel ƒe aƒe, nukaŋuti miehe, yewoaku?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, don't want to see that happen to anyone. So stop sinning and live!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Elabena ame ƒe ku mevivia nunye o. Eyata mitrɔ ta me, ne mianɔ agbe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, sing a funeral song for two of Israel's leaders:
translation_verse: Ke wò la to konyifaha ɖe Israel ƒe amegã ŋu

english_verse: Your mother was a brave lioness who raised her cubs among lions.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Ameka nye dawo? Dzatanɔ wònye tsyɔ akɔ ɖe dzatawo dome, eye wònyi viawo wotsi le dzataviwo dome

english_verse: She taught one of them to hunt, and he learned to eat people.
translation_verse: Enyi viawo dometɔ ɖeka wòtsi, eye wòzu dzatavi; esrɔ̃ nuléle, eye wòɖua amelã.

english_verse: When the nations heard of him, they trapped him in a pit, then they used hooks to drag him to Egypt.
translation_verse: Ke esi dukɔwo se eŋkɔ la, woɖo asɔʋe nɛ heɖee, eye wode ŋɔtigae hekplɔ yi Egipte-nyigba dzii.

english_verse: His mother waited for him to return. But soon she lost all hope and raised another cub, who also became fierce.
translation_verse: Eye esi dada kpɔ be, yelala dzodzro, eye yeƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ nu tsi la, etsɔ viawo dometɔ ɖeka heɖo dzatae.

english_verse: He hunted with other lions and learned to eat people.
translation_verse: Enɔ dzatawo dome, eye wòzu dzatavi; esrɔ̃ nuléle, eye woɖu amelã.

english_verse: He destroyed fortresses and ruined towns; his mighty roar terrified everyone.
translation_verse: Egbã woƒe fiasãwo, eɖo aƒedo woƒe duwo, eye eƒe gbeɖeɖe ƒe ɖiɖi na ŋɔdzi lé anyigba kple edzinɔlawo.

english_verse: Nations plotted to kill him, and people came from all over to spread out a net and catch him in a trap.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔwo tso ɖe eŋu godoo tso anyigbawo dzi, woɖo ɖɔ ne, eye woɖee le woƒe asɔʋe me.

english_verse: They put him in a cage and took him to Babylonia. The lion was locked away, so that his mighty roar would never again be heard on Israel's hills.
translation_verse: Woɖe ŋɔtigae, eye wotsɔe de kpẽ me hekplɔe yi na Babel-fia; wotsɔe de mɔ̃ sesẽ me, ne womagase eƒe gbe le Israel-towo dzi azɔ o.

english_verse: Your mother was a vine like you, growing near a stream. There was plenty of water, so she was filled with branches and with lots of fruit.
translation_verse: Dawò nye weinka wodo ɖe to to abe wò ene, etse fũ, eye wòto aŋgba mlamlamla le tsi geɖe ta.

english_verse: Her strong branches became symbols of authority, and she was taller than all other trees— everyone could see how strong and healthy she was.
translation_verse: Eƒe alo ɖeka lolo hezu dziɖula ƒe fiatikplɔ, eye wòkɔ alɔ gbɔ alɔ dodoawo ta. Esi wokpɔ be, akɔ alea, eye wòto geɖe la,

english_verse: But in anger, I pulled her up by the roots and threw her to the ground, where the scorching desert wind dried out her fruit. Her strong branches wilted and burned up.
translation_verse: wohoe ƒu anyi le dziku me, eye ɣedzeƒeya no tsi le eƒe tsetsewo me; woŋe eƒe alo gã la, eye wòƒu wotɔ dzoe.

english_verse: Then she was planted in a hot, dry desert,
translation_verse: Azɔ wotsɔe do ɖe gbegbe le kuɖinyigba kple anyigba ƒuƒu dzi.

english_verse: where her stem caught fire, and flames burned her branches and fruit. Not one strong branch is left; she is stripped bare. This funeral song must be sung with sorrow.
translation_verse: Eye dzo do tso eƒe alɔwo ƒe zekpẽ me hefiã eƒe tsetsewo, eye alɔ gãa ɖeke megale eŋu ahanye dziɖula ƒe fiatikplɔ o. Konyifaha wònye, eye wòzu konyifaha.

english_verse: Seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, some of Israel's leaders came to me on the tenth day of the fifth month. They sat down and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me le ƒe adrelia me le dzinu atɔ̃lia ƒe ŋkeke ewolia dzi be, ŋutsuwo tso Israel ame tsitsiwo dome va gbe bia ge Yehowa se, eye wobɔbɔ nɔ ŋkunye me.

english_verse: Just then, the Lord God said:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these leaders have come to find out what I want them to do. As surely as I live, I will not give them an answer of any kind.
translation_verse: Amevi, ƒo nu kple Israel ame tsitsiwo nagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Nyee miava gbe bia geea? Mefa ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne mana miabia gbem ase akpɔ fi! Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Are you willing to warn them, Ezekiel? Then remind them of the disgusting sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Màdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo oa, amevi, màdrɔ ʋɔnu wo oa? Ɖe wo fofowo ƒe ŋunyɔnuwo fia wo!

english_verse: Tell them that long ago I, the Lord God, chose Israel to be my own. I appeared to their ancestors in Egypt and made a solemn promise that I would be their God and the God of their descendants.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gbesigbe metia Israel, eye mekɔ nye asi dzi na Yakob ƒe aƒe ƒe ƒomea, mede ɖokuinye fía wo le Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye mekɔ nye asi dzi na wo hegblɔ bena: Nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu la,

english_verse: I swore that I would rescue them from Egypt and lead them to a land I had already chosen. This land was rich with milk and honey and was the most splendid land of all.
translation_verse: gbemagbe mekɔ nye asi dzi na wo, ne makplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ayi anyigba, si medi da di na wo la dzi, afisi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo; anyigba nyuitɔ wònye le anyigbawo katã dome.

english_verse: I told them to get rid of their disgusting idols and not to sin by worshiping the gods of Egypt. I reminded them that I was the Lord their God,
translation_verse: Mía dome amesiame neɖe ŋunyɔnu ɖa le ŋku ta, eye migatsɔ Egipte-legbawo gblẽ kɔ ɖo na mia ɖokui o; nye Yehowa ye nye mia Mawu.

english_verse: but they still rebelled against me. They refused to listen and kept on worshiping their idols and foreign gods. In my anger, I decided to punish the Israelites in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ke wosẽ to ɖe ŋunye, eye wogbe toɖoɖom; wo dometɔa ɖeke meɖe ŋunyɔnuawo ɖa le ŋku ta o, eye womeɖe asi le Egipte-legbawo ŋu o. Tete meɖo be, matrɔ nye dziku aƒo ɖe wo dzi, eye nye dɔmedzoe nabi avɔ ɖe wo ŋu le Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: But that would have made me look like a liar, because I had already promised in front of everyone that I would lead them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ke nyemewɔe o le nye ŋkɔ la, ne magaɖo gui le dukɔ, siwo dome wole la ŋku me o, amesiwo ŋku me meɖe ɖokuinye fia wo le, ne makplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: So I brought them out and led them into the desert.
translation_verse: Ale mekplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi heva gbe dzi.

english_verse: I gave them my laws and teachings, so they would know how to live right.
translation_verse: Mena nye ɖoɖowo wo, eye meɖe nye se, siwo, ne ame wɔ wo dzi la, woana wòanɔ agbe la, fia wo.

english_verse: And I commanded them to respect the Sabbath as a way of showing that they were holy and belonged to me.
translation_verse: Eye metsɔ nye dzudzɔgbewo hã na wo, ne woanye dzesi anɔ mía kple wo dome, eye woadze sii be, nye Yehowa ye kɔ wo ŋu.

english_verse: But the Israelites rebelled against me in the desert. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath like any other day. Then in my anger, I decided to destroy the Israelites in the desert once and for all.
translation_verse: Ke Israel ƒe aƒe la sẽ to de ŋunye le gbea dzi; womezɔ de nye ɖoɖowo nu o, wodo vlo nye se, siwo, ne ame wɔ wo dzi la, woana wòanɔ agbe la, eye wogblẽ kɔ do na nye dzudzɔgbewo vevie ŋutɔ. Tete meɖo be, matrɔ nye dziku aƒo de wo dzi le gbea dzi, eye matsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: But that would have disgraced me, because many other nations had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ke nyemewɔe o le nye ŋkɔ ta, ne megado gui le dukɔwo ŋku me, amesiwo ŋku me mekplɔ wo dzoe le la o.

english_verse: Instead, I told them in the desert that I would not lead them into the beautiful, fertile land I had promised.
translation_verse: Gake hã mekɔ nye asi dzi ɖe wo ŋu le gbea dzi, be nyemakplɔ wo ayi anyigba, si metsɔ na wo, afisi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo, eye wònye anyigba nyuitɔ le anyigbawo katã dome la dzi o;

english_verse: I said this because they had not only ignored my laws and teachings, but had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped idols.
translation_verse: le esi wodo vlo nye seawo, womezɔ de nye dodowo nu o, eye wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye dzudzɔgbewo ta; elabena woƒe dzi dze woƒe legbawo yome.

english_verse: Yet, I felt sorry for them and could not let them die in the desert.
translation_verse: Ke nye ŋku kpɔ nublanui na wo, be nyemagblẽ wo o, eye nyematsrɔ̃ wo le gbea dzi o.

english_verse: So I warned the children not to act like their parents or follow their evil ways or worship their idols.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ na wo viwo le gbea dzi bena: Migazɔ de mia fofowo ƒe ɖoɖowo nu o, migalé woƒe sewo me ɖe asi o, eye migatsɔ woƒe legbawo gblẽ kɔ ɖo na mia ɖokui o!

english_verse: I reminded them that I was the Lord their God and that they should obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Nye Yehowa, ye nye mia Mawu, mizɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu, eye milé nye sewo me ɖe asi, ne miawɔ wo dzi;

english_verse: I told them to respect my Sabbath to show that they were my people and that I was the Lord their God.
translation_verse: mikɔ nye dzudzɔgbewo ŋu, ne woanye dzesi anɔ mía kpli mi dome, eye wòadze sii be, nye Yehowa yenye mia Mawu.

english_verse: But the children also rebelled against me. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath as any other day. I became angry and decided to punish them in the desert.
translation_verse: Ke wo viwo sẽ to ɖe ŋunye, womezɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu o, womelé nye sewo me ɖe asi, ne woawɔ wo dzi o, evɔ wònye ne ame wɔ wo dzi la, woana wòanɔ agbe hafi, eye wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye dzudzɔgbewo. Tete meɖo be, matrɔ nye dziku aƒo ɖe wo dzi, eye nye dɔmedzoe nabi avɔ de wo ŋu le gbea dzi.

english_verse: But I did not. That would have disgraced me in front of the nations that had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ke megagbugbɔ nye asi ɖe megbe, eye nyemewɔe o le nye ŋkɔ ta, ne magado gui le dukɔwo ŋku me, amesiwo ŋku me mekplɔ wo dzoe le la o.

english_verse: So I solemnly swore that I would scatter the people of Israel across the nations,
translation_verse: Gake hã mekɔ nye asi dzi ɖe wo ŋu le gbea dzi, ne makaka wo ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye mahlẽ wo ɖe anyigbawo dzi;

english_verse: because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made.
translation_verse: le esi womewɔ nye sewo dzi o, eye woɖo vlo nye ɖoɖowo, wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye dzudzɔgbewo, eye woƒe ŋkuwo le wo fofowo ƒe legbawo yome la.

english_verse: I gave them laws that bring punishment instead of life,
translation_verse: Eyata metsɔ ɖoɖo gbegblẽwo kple se, siwo mana woanɔ agbe o la, na wo.

english_verse: and I let them offer me unacceptable sacrifices, including their first-born sons. I did this to horrify them and to let them know that I, the Lord, was punishing them.
translation_verse: Eye mena wotsɔ woƒe vɔsanuwo gblẽ kɔ ɖo na wo ɖokui, esime wotsɔ woƒe vi ŋgɔgbeawo katã to dzo mee, ne magblẽ wo, eye ne woadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: by offering sacrifices, incense, and wine to gods on every hill and under every large tree. I was very angry, because they did these things in the land I had given them!
translation_verse: Esi mekplɔ wo va anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo be, matsɔ na wo la dzi, eye wokpɔ togbɛ kɔkɔ sia togbɛ kɔkɔ kple ati dodo sia ati dodo la, wosa woƒe akpedavɔwo le afima, eye wohe woƒe vɔsanu kudzinamewo va afima, wodo dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe le afima, eye woƒo tsi ɖe anyi ɖe afima.

english_verse: I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, “At the local shrines.” And those places of worship are still called shrines.
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ na wo bena: Nuxeƒe ka nye esi mieva? Eyata woyɔa togbɛ be nuxeƒe vaseɖe egbe. Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple ŋugbedodo.

english_verse: by worshiping idols and by sacrificing their own children as offerings. They commit these sins and still think they can ask me for a message. As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will give them no answer.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, mietsɔ miaƒe legbawo katã gblẽ kɔ ɖo na mia ɖokui, eye mietsɔ miaƒe vɔsanuwo sa vɔe, esime mietsɔ mia viwo to dzo mee vaseɖe egbe tso, hafi nyea mana miabia gbem asea? Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Nyemana miabia gbem ase akpɔ o, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: They may think they can be like other nations and get away with worshiping idols made of wood and stone. But that will never happen! The Lord Promises To Restore Israel The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Nusi ɖo ta me na mi lã, mava me akpɔ o, esime miele gbɔgblɔm bena: Míanɔ abe dukɔwo kple anyigbawo ƒe ƒomeawo ene, ne míasubɔ ati kple kpe.

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe be: Ne nyematsɔ asi sesẽ kple alɔ, si le dzi, kpakple dziku, si wotrɔ ƒo ɖe anyi la, aɖu fia ɖe mia dzi o fi!

english_verse: and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you
translation_verse: eye makplɔ mi ayi dukɔwo ƒe gbe dzi, eye gama mahe nya kpli mi le ŋku me kple ŋku me.

english_verse: and punish you, just as I punished your ancestors in the desert near Egypt.
translation_verse: Alesi mehe nya kple mia fofowo le Egipte-nyigba ƒe gbe dzi la, nenema mahe nya kple miawo hãe, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: Mana miato atikplɔ te ayi, eye makplɔ mi ayi nubabla la ƒe ga mee;

english_verse: I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: eye matia aglãdzelawo kple amesiwo trɔ ʋu le yonyeme la, le mia dome; makplɔ wo adzoe tso anyigba, si dzi wonye amedzro le la dzi, ke womade Israel-nyigba dzi o, eye miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me!
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mia dome amesiame neyi, ne wòaɖasubɔ eƒe legbawo ko; ke emegbe la miava ɖo tom xoxo, eye miagatsɔ miaƒe vɔsanuwo kple miaƒe legbawo agblẽ ka ɖo na nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la azɔ o.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone in Israel will worship me on Mount Zion, my holy mountain in Jerusalem. I will once again call you my own, and I will accept your sacred offerings and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la, amesiwo katã le anyigba dzi la, asubɔm le nye to kɔkɔe la, Israel ƒe to kɔkɔ la dzi; gama maxɔ wo le atuu, eye madi woƒe adzɔwo, woƒe vɔsanuwo ƒe gbãtɔwo kpakple woƒe nusiwo katã ŋu woka la le.

english_verse: When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy,
translation_verse: Ne mekplɔ mi tso dukɔwo dome la, maxɔ mi atuu abe dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe ene, maƒo mia nu ƒu tso anyigba, siwo dzi miekaka ɖo la dzi, eye makɔ ɖokuinye ŋu ɖe mia ŋuti le dukɔwo ŋku me.

english_verse: and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Eye miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa, nenye be, mekplɔ mi va Israel-nyigba, anyigba, si ŋu meka atam ɖo be, matsɔ na mia fofowo la dzi.

english_verse: Then you will remember your wicked sins, and you will hate yourselves for doing such horrible things. They have made you unacceptable to me,
translation_verse: Míado ŋu miaƒe zɔzɔme kple miaƒe nuwɔnawo katã, siwo mietsɔ gblẽ ko ɖo na mia ɖokui la, le afima, eye miava ŋu nyo ge na mia ɖokui le nu vɔ̃ɖi, siwo katã miewɔ la ta.

english_verse: so you deserve to be punished. But I will treat you in a way that will bring honor to my name, and you will know that I am the Lord God. Fire from the South
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa, nenye be, mewo na mi le nye ŋkɔ ta, eye menye ɖe miaƒe zɔzɔme vɔ̃ɖiwo kple miaƒe nuwɔna gbegblẽwo nu o, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the places in Jerusalem where people worship. Warn everyone in Israel
translation_verse: Amevi, trɔ ŋgɔ dze dziehe gome, dudu nya ƒo ɖe dziehe, eye nagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe ave, si le gbegbe le dziehe la ŋuti.

english_verse: that I am about to punish them. I will pull out my sword and have it ready to kill everyone, whether good or evil.
translation_verse: Eye nagblɔ na dzieheve la bena: Se Yehowa ƒe gbe, ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mado dzo ɖe mewo, ne wòafiã ati mumuwo katã kple ati ƒuƒuwo katã; womatsi dzo ƒe aɖeawo o, eye ŋkuwo katã me atɔ aka tso dziehe vaseɖe anyiehe;

english_verse: knowing that my sword will never be put away.
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: Ao, Aƒetɔ Yehowa, wole gbɔgblɔm le ŋunye be: Eyama lo sɔŋ ko wònɔa dodom!

english_verse: Ezekiel, groan in sorrow and despair so that everyone can hear you.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem: I have sharpened my sword to slaughter you; it is shiny and will flash like lightning! Don't celebrate— punishment is coming, because everyone has ignored my warnings.
translation_verse: Eye ŋutilãwo katã adze sii be, nye Yehowa ye di nye yi tso aku me; magatrɔ agbɔ o.

english_verse: Ezekiel, warn my people, then celebrate my victory by clapping your hands. My vicious sword will attack again and again, killing my people with every stroke.
translation_verse: Amevi, gblɔ nya ɖi bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gblɔ be: Yi, yi! Wonyree, eye wosiae.

english_verse: They will lose all courage and stumble with fear. My slaughtering sword is waiting at every gate, flashing and ready to kill.
translation_verse: Wonyree ɖe amewuwu ŋu, eye ɖe wosiae, be wòanɔ dzo dam kaŋkaŋ. Ɖe míakpɔ dzidzɔa? Vinye ƒe ameƒoti le vlo dom atiwo katã.

english_verse: It will slash right and left, wherever the blade is pointed.
translation_verse: Etsɔe na, be woasia, ne woalée kple asi; wonyre yi la, eye wosiae, be woatsɔ ade asi na amewula.

english_verse: Then I will stop being angry, and I will clap my hands in victory. I, the Lord, have spoken. The King of Babylonia and His Sword
translation_verse: Amevi, do ɣli, eye nafa avi, elabena egbɔna ɖe nye dukɔ dzi, egbɔna de Israel ƒe amegãwo katã dzi; woawo kple nye dukɔ siaa la, yi lɔ wonye; eyata ƒo aklito!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mark two roads for the king of Babylonia to follow when he comes with his sword. The roads will begin at the same place, but be sure to put up a signpost where the two roads separate and go in different directions.
translation_verse: Ke wò amevi, gblɔ nya ɖi, eye naƒo asi kpoloe, elabena yi la adzi ɖe edzi zi eve kple zi etɔ̃; amewuyie, amewuyi gã lae aɖe to ɖe wo.

english_verse: Clearly mark where the two roads lead. One goes to Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and the other goes to Jerusalem, the fortified capital of Judah.
translation_verse: Mena yi le dzo dam le miaƒe agbowo katã nu, ne dzi nalólo gbanaa, eye ame tsiaʋawo nasɔ gbɔ; ɖe wowɔe, be woada dzo, eye de wonyree de amewuwu ŋu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, tell the people of Jerusalem and their ruler that I, the Lord God, am saying: Everything you do is wicked and shows how sinful you are. You are guilty and will be taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Amevi, da mɔ eve na ɖokuiwò, siwo dzi Babel-fia ƒe yi ato ava, anyigba ɖeka dzie woa kple eve la woatso, eye naɖo mɔfianu mɔ sia mɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze ɖo ta du sia du me,

english_verse: And now, you evil and wicked ruler of Israel, your day of final punishment is almost here.
translation_verse: ne yi nate ŋu ava Amon-viwo ƒe Raba kple Yerusalem, si ŋu woɖo gli ɖo le Yuda.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, command you to take off your royal turban and your crown, because everything will be different. Those who had no power will be put in charge, and those who now rule will become nobodies.
translation_verse: Elabena Babel-fia ava tɔ de mɔdzevee nu le mɔawo kple eve ƒe godoƒe, be wòaka afã, adzobo aŋutrɔwo, abla gbe aklama kpakpɛwo ase, eye wòaɖe ŋku de lãklã ŋu.

english_verse: I will leave Jerusalem in complete ruins like no one has ever seen until my chosen one comes to punish this city. Judgment against Ammon
translation_verse: Yerusalem ƒe dzidzenu dze ɖusi me nɛ, ne woatu gligbãnu, woake nu ado ɣli, eye woatso ayiboopɛ sesĩe, woatu gligbãnu ɖe eƒe agbowo ŋu, woaƒu kpo, eye woatu dzɔlawo ƒe xɔ tsralawo.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying: A sword is drawn, ready to slaughter; it is polished and prepared to kill as fast as lightning.
translation_verse: Eye wòle na wo abe ɖe afã meɖi o ene, elabena eteƒe didi kwasiɖa geɖewo; ke eya aɖo ŋu woƒe vodadawo, ne asi natu wo.

english_verse: You wicked Ammonites see false visions and believe untrue messages. But your day of punishment is coming soon, and my sword will slaughter you!
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi mieɖo ŋu miaƒe vodadawo, eye miaƒe tosesẽwo dze go, be wokpɔ miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo le miaƒe nuwɔnawo me, esi woɖo ŋku mia dzi la, eyata asi atu mi.

english_verse: Your days to punish others are over, so put your swords away. You will be punished in the land of your birth.
translation_verse: Wò Israel ƒe amegã, wò ame vɔ̃ɖi, si wodo gui, wò amesi ƒe ŋkeke de le vodadawo ƒe nuwuwu,

english_verse: My furious anger will scorch you like fire, and I will hand you over to cruel men who are experts in killing.
translation_verse: ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Woaɖe tablanu da, eye woade fiakuku ɖi. Maganɔ alea o, ke boŋ woado ame tsɛ ɖe dzi, eye woabɔbɔ amegã ɖe anyi.

english_verse: You will be burned and will die in your own land. Then you will be forgotten forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Anyiglãgo, anyiglãgowo ƒe anyiglãgo mawɔ wòe; esia maganɔ anyi o, vaseɖe esime amesi tɔ wònye la, nava, eye màtsɔe nɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, are you ready to condemn Jerusalem? That city is filled with murderers, so remind the people of their sins
translation_verse: Amevi, ɖe nebe, yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu, yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu hlɔ̃dodu laa? Ekema ɖe eƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã fiae

english_verse: and tell them I am saying: Jerusalem, you have murdered many of your own people and have worshiped idols. You will soon be punished!
translation_verse: gblɔ bena; Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Wò du, si ko ʋu ɖe eɖokui me, ne wò ɣeyiɣi naɖe, eye nèwɔ legbawo, ne natsɔ agblẽ ko ɖo na ɖokuiwò.

english_verse: Those crimes have made you guilty, and the idols have made you unacceptable to me. So your final punishment is near. Other nations will laugh at you and make insulting remarks,
translation_verse: Eda vo to wò ʋu, si nèkɔ ɖe anyi la me, eye nètso wò legba, siwo newɔ la, gblẽ kɔ ɖo na ɖokuiwò, ehe wò ŋkeke va aƒegbɔe, eye nèɖo wo ƒewo ƒe nuwuwu; eyata matsɔ wò awɔ vlodonu na dukɔwo kple alɔmeɖenu na anyigbawo katã.

english_verse: and people far and near will make fun of your misery.
translation_verse: Amesiwo le kpuiƒe kple didiƒe la, aɖu fewu le ŋuwò be, wò ŋkɔ gblẽ, eye ʋunyaʋunya bɔ ɖe mewò.

english_verse: None of you honor your parents, and you cheat foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Wodoa vlo fofo kple dada le mewo, wotea amedzro ɖe anyi le mewo, eye wosẽa ŋuta le tsyɔ̃evi kple ahosi ŋu le mewo.

english_verse: You show no respect for my sacred places and treat the Sabbath just like any other day.
translation_verse: Eɖoa vlo nye kɔkɔeƒe la, eye negblẽa ko ɖo na nye dzudzɔgbewo.

english_verse: Some of your own people tell lies, so that others will be put to death. Some of you eat meat sacrificed to idols at local shrines, and others never stop doing vulgar things.
translation_verse: Ame gɔmezɔlawo le mewò, ne woakɔ ʋu ɖi, woɖua nu le towo dzi le mewo, eye wowɔa ŋukpenanu le mewo.

english_verse: Men have sex with their father's wife or with women who are having their monthly period
translation_verse: Woɖea ama fofo le mewo, eye woɖea asi nyɔnu, si kpo dzinu la ŋu le mewò.

english_verse: or with someone else's wife. Some men even sleep with their own daughter-in-law or half sister.
translation_verse: Amesiame wɔa ŋunyɔnu ɖe ehavi srɔ̃ ŋu, amesiame wɔa ŋukpenanu kple eƒe tɔyɔvinyɔnu hedoa gu eɖokui, eye amesiame dea asi nɔvianyɔnu, si nye fofoa ƒe vinyɔnu la ŋu.

english_verse: Others of you accept money to murder someone. Your own people charge high interest when making a loan to other Israelites, and they get rich by cheating. Worst of all, you have forgotten me, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Woxɔa zãnu le mewo, ne wòakɔ ʋu ɖi, eɖia kasa, eye nexɔa deme, ẽɖua sesẽnu le nɔviwò si, eye wò ŋku dzona le dzinye. Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I will shake my fist in anger at your violent crimes.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, masi akpe ɖe viɖe, siwo nekpɔ, kple hlɔ̃, si wodo le mewo la ŋu.

english_verse: When I'm finished with you, your courage will disappear, and you will be so weak that you won't be able to lift your hands. I, the Lord, have spoken and will not change my mind.
translation_verse: Ɖe dzi anɔ ƒowò, eye ŋusẽ anɔ wò asi ŋu le ŋkeke, siwo me mawɔ nu kpli wòa? Nye Yehowa ye ƒo nu, eye mawɔe hã.

english_verse: I will scatter you throughout every nation on earth and put a stop to your sinful ways.
translation_verse: Makaka wò ɖe dukɔwo dome, mahlẽ wò ɖe anyigbawo dzi, eye mana wò ɖiƒoƒo nu natso le ŋuwò,

english_verse: You will be humiliated in the eyes of other nations. Then you will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. Jerusalem Must Be Purified
translation_verse: eye azu busu me le dukɔwo ŋku me, ne nadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I consider the people of Israel as worthless as the leftover metal in a furnace after silver has been purified.
translation_verse: Amevi, Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la zu aŋuka nam; akɔbli, gaɣi, gayibɔ kple tsumi wonye le kpo me, klosaloŋuka wozu.

english_verse: So I am going to bring them together in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi mi katã miezu aŋuka la, eyata mala mi akɔ ɖe Yerusalem.

english_verse: like silver in a furnace. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them in my anger. Everyone in Jerusalem Is Guilty
translation_verse: Alesi wolóloa klosalo le kpo mee la, nenema woalólo mi le emee, eye miadze sii be, nye Yehowa ye trɔ nye dziku ƒo ɖe mia dzi.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that their country is full of sin, and that I, the Lord, am furious!
translation_verse: Amevi, gblɔ nɛ bena: Wòe nye anyigba, si dzi tsi madza ɖo o, eye tsi maƒoe le dzikudoɣi o.

english_verse: Their leaders are like roaring lions, tearing apart their victims. They put people to death, then steal everything of value. Husbands are killed, and many women are left as widows.
translation_verse: Eƒe nyagblɔɖilawo ɖoa gbe ɖi le eme, wole abe dzata, si le gbe tem hele nu vuvum ene, woɖua amewo, wolɔa kesinɔnuwo kple nu veviwo dzonɛ, eye wonana ahosiwo sɔgbɔna le eme.

english_verse: The priests of Israel ignore my Law! Not only do they refuse to respect any of my sacred things, but they don't even teach the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary or between what is clean and what is unclean. They treat my Sabbath like any other day, and so my own people no longer honor me.
translation_verse: Eƒe nunɔlawo toa vo ɖe nye se la ŋu, eye wogblẽa kɔ ɖo na nye kɔkɔeƒe la; womedea vovo nu kɔkɔe kple nu makɔmakɔ dome o, eye womefiaa vovototo, si le nu dzadzɛ kple nu madzamadza dome o, wotsyɔa nu ŋku me ɖe nye dzudzɔgbewo, eye wogblẽa kɔ ɖo nam le wo dome.

english_verse: Israel's officials are like ferocious wolves, ripping their victims apart. They make a dishonest living by injuring and killing people.
translation_verse: Eƒe amegãwo le abe amegãxi lénuwo ene le eme, ne wòakɔ ʋu ɖe anyi, woatsrɔ̃ amewo, eye woakpɔ viɖe.

english_verse: And then the prophets in Israel cover up these sins by giving false visions. I have never spoken to them, but they lie and say they have a message from me.
translation_verse: Woƒe nyagblɔɖilawo sia akalo ɖe nu ŋu na wo, wokpɔa aʋatso-ŋutega, eye wogblɔ alakpanya ɖi na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi; evɔ wònye Yehowa meƒo nu o hafi.

english_verse: The people themselves cheat and rob; they abuse the poor and take advantage of foreigners.
translation_verse: Dukɔ hahoo la ɖua sesẽnu, eye wodaa adzo, esẽa ŋuta le ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo ŋu, eɖua sesẽnu le amedzrowo si hedaa se la dzi.

english_verse: I looked for someone to defend the city and to protect it from my anger, as well as to stop me from destroying it. But I found no one.
translation_verse: Medi ame le wo dome, si aɖo gli, eye wòatsi tre ɖe gbagbãƒe le ŋkunye me ɖe anyigba la nu, ne magagblẽe o, ke nyemekpɔ ɖeke o.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish the Israelites for what they have done, and they will know that I am furious. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eyata metrɔ nye dɔmedzoe ƒo ɖe wo dzi, metso nye dzinu ƒe dzo tsrɔ̃ wòe, eye mehe woƒe zɔzɔme va woƒe ta dzi, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, listen to this story about two sisters.
translation_verse: Amevi, nyɔnu eve nɔ anyi, wonye dada ɖeka viwo.

english_verse: While they were young and living in Egypt, they became prostitutes.
translation_verse: Wowɔ gbolo le Egipte, woƒe ɖetugbimee wowɔ gbolo le; afima wolé no na wo le, eye afima wofanya akɔnu na wo le.

english_verse: The older one was named Oholah, which stands for Samaria; the younger one was Oholibah, which stands for Jerusalem. They became my wives and gave birth to my children.
translation_verse: Woƒe ŋkɔwo nye: xoxoetɔ nye Ohola, eye nɔvianyɔnu nye Oholiba, wozu tɔnye, eye wodzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo. Woyɔ Ohola be Samaria, eye Oholiba be Yerusalem.

english_verse: Even though Oholah was my wife, she continued to be a prostitute and chased after Assyrian lovers.
translation_verse: Ohola wɔ ahasi le megbe nye, eye wòle kukum ɖe eƒe ahiã viwo dzi, woawo nye Asurtɔ siwo ƒe ŋkɔ nya;

english_verse: She offered herself to soldiers in purple uniforms: handsome, high-ranking officers and cavalry troops.
translation_verse: anyigbanunɔlawo kple amegãwo, siwo le aɖabɛ blɔtɔ me, ɖekakpuivi dzeɖekɛwo sɔŋ wonye, eye wole sɔ dzi.

english_verse: She had sex with all the important Assyrian officials and even worshiped their disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ewɔ gbolo kple Asur-viwo ƒe ame tiatĩawo katã, eye wotsɔ woa kple amesiwo wɔ ahasi la ƒe legbawo katã gblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui.

english_verse: Once she started doing these things in Egypt, she never stopped. Men slept with her, and she was always ready for sex.
translation_verse: Ke meɖe asi le eƒe gbolowɔwɔ tso Egipte ŋu o, elabena woawoe de asi eŋu le eƒe ɖetugbime, wofanya eƒe akɔnu, eye wolɔ woƒe amatrewɔwɔwo trɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: So I gave Oholah to the Assyrian lovers she wanted so badly.
translation_verse: Eyata metsɔe ɖe asi na eƒe ahiãvi, siwo nye Asur-viwo, amesiwo dzi wòle kukum ɖo.

english_verse: They ripped off her clothes, then captured her children and killed her. Women everywhere talked about what had happened to Oholah.
translation_verse: Woɖe amae, wokplɔ viaŋutsuwo kple vianyɔnuwo dzoe, eye wowu eya ŋutɔ kple yi, ale be wòzu kpɔdzidze na nyɔnuwo, eye wohe to nɛ.

english_verse: Oholibah saw all this, but she was more sinful and wanted sex more than her sister Oholah ever did.
translation_verse: Nɔvianyɔnu Oholiba kpɔe, ke le wɔ gbolo wòvloe wui, eye wòwɔ ahasi wu nɔvianyɔnu.

english_verse: Oholibah also chased after good-looking Assyrian officers, uniformed soldiers, and cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Eku ɖe Asur-viwo dzi, anyigbanunɔlawo kple amegãwo, amesiwo ŋkɔ nya, eye woɖo atsyɔ̃, wole sɔ dzi, eye wonye ɖekakpuivi dzeɖekɛwo sɔŋ.

english_verse: Just like her sister, she did vulgar things.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ be, egblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui, mɔ ɖeka dzi woa kple eve la wòto.

english_verse: But Oholibah behaved worse than her sister. Oholibah saw images of Babylonian men carved into walls and painted red.
translation_verse: Ke egawɔ gbolo ɖe edzi, ekpɔ ŋutsu, siwo wòta ɖe gli ŋu, Kaldeatɔwo ƒe nɔnɔme, si wotsɔ de tae,

english_verse: They had belts around their waists and large turbans on their heads, and they reminded her of Babylonian cavalry officers.
translation_verse: alidziblanu le ali na wo, eye tablanu le ta na wo hedzɔ ɖe anyi, wo katã ƒe nɔnɔme le abe aʋafiawo ene, eye woɖi Babel-viwo, amesiwo de nye Kaldea.

english_verse: As soon as she looked at them, she wanted to have sex with them. And so, she sent messengers to bring them to her.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ woƒe ŋku me la, wo nu le dzi nɛ, eye wòdo ame ɖo ɖe wo le Kaldea.

english_verse: Men from Babylonia came and had sex with her so many times that she got disgusted with them.
translation_verse: Tete Babel-viwo va egbɔ le edo ƒe, eye wotsɔ woƒe amatrewɔwɔwo gblẽ ko ɖo nɛ, eye wòtsɔ wo do gu eɖokui; emegbe la woƒe nu gblẽ le eƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: She let everyone see her naked body and didn't care if they knew she was a prostitute. That's why I turned my back on her, just as I had done with her older sister.
translation_verse: Eye esi eƒe gbolowɔwɔ dze go, eye eƒe ama dze la, eƒe nu ti kɔ nam, abe alesi nɔvianyɔnu ƒe nu ti kɔ nam ene.

english_verse: Oholibah didn't stop there, but became even more immoral and acted as she had back in Egypt.
translation_verse: Egawɔ gbolo ɖe edzi, eye wòɖo ŋu eƒe ɖetugbimenɔɣi, esime wòwɔ gbolo le Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: She eagerly wanted to go to bed with Egyptian men, who were famous for their sexual powers.
translation_verse: Eye wole kukum ɖe eƒe ahiãviwo dzi, amesiwo ƒe ŋutsu le abe tedzi tɔ ene, eye woƒe tsi le abe sɔtsu tɔ ene.

english_verse: And she longed for the days when she was a young prostitute, when men enjoyed caressing her body. The Lord Will Punish Oholibah
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋku wò ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ le wò ɖetugbime dzi, esime Egiptetɔwo fanya wò akɔnu, eye wòlé wò ɖetugbimeno. Tohehe le anukwatre maɖimaɖi ŋuti.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Oholibah, though you no longer want to be around your lovers, they will surround you like enemies, when I turn them against you.
translation_verse: Eyata Oholiba, ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, made adã ta me na wò ahiãviwo, amesiwo ƒe nu gblẽ le ŋkuwò me la, ɖe ŋuwò, eye mana woatso goawo katã me ava ƒo ɖe dziwò.

english_verse: I will gather all the handsome young officials and the high-ranking cavalry officers from Babylonia and Assyria, as well as from the Chaldean tribes of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa.
translation_verse: Babel-viwo, Kaldeatɔwo katã, Pekod, Soa kple Koa kpakple Asur-viwo katã kpe ɖe wo ŋu, ɖekakpuivi dzeɖekɛwo, anyigbanunɔlawo kple amegãwo sɔŋ kple aʋafiawo wonye, woƒe ŋkɔ nyɔ, eye wo katã wole sɔ dzi.

english_verse: Their large armies will come from the north with chariots and wagons carrying weapons. They will wear shields and helmets and will surround you, and I will let them judge and sentence you according to their own laws.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ tasiaɖam kple tasiaɖamfɔ geɖewo ava ƒo ɖe dziwò, woatsɔ akpoxɔnu gã kple via kpakple gakuku adze aʋa ɖe ŋuwò godoo, eye matsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ade asi na wo, ne woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò ɖe woƒe se nu.

english_verse: I am angry with you, so I will let them be very cruel. They will cut off your nose and ears; they will kill your children and burn alive anyone in your family who survives.
translation_verse: Mahe nye ŋuʋaʋã ava dziwò, eye woawɔ nu kpli wò le dziku me: Woakpa ŋɔti kple to na wo, eye viwòwo atsi yi nu; woakplɔ wò ŋutsuviwo kple wò nyɔnuviwo adzoe, eye dzo afiã wò nu susɔeawo.

english_verse: Your clothes and jewelry will be torn off.
translation_verse: Woaɖe avɔ le ŋuwò, eye woalɔ wò atsyɔ̃nuwo adzoe.

english_verse: I will stop your wickedness and the prostitution you started back in Egypt. You will never want to think about those days again.
translation_verse: Matsi wò ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ kple wò gbolowɔwɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi nu, magafɔ mo te ɖe wo ŋu azɔ o, eye wò ŋku magadze Egipte dzi azɔ o.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, am ready to hand you over to those hateful enemies that you find so disgusting.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ wò ade asi na amesiwo nèle fui, eye matsɔ wò ade asi na amesiwo ƒe nu gblẽ le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: They will cruelly take away everything you have worked for and strip you naked. Then everyone will see you for the prostitute you really are. Your own vulgar sins
translation_verse: Woawɔ nu kpli wò abe ketɔ ene, eye woalɔ wò nuwo katã adzoe ahagblẽ wò ɖi natsi ama kple ƒeƒle, ale be wò ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe ama, wò ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ kple wò gbolowɔwɔ natsi go.

english_verse: have led to this. You were the one determined to have sex with men from other nations and to worship their idols.
translation_verse: Nusiawo ava dziwò, le esi nèwɔ gbolo kple dukɔwo, eye nètsɔ woƒe legbawo gblẽ kɔ ɖo na ɖokuiwò ta.

english_verse: You have turned out no better than your older sister, and now you must drink from the cup filled with my anger.
translation_verse: Nɔviwònyɔnu ƒe afɔ nètsɔ, eyata matsɔ eƒe kplu ade asi na wò.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, gave your sister a large, deep cup filled with my anger. And when you drink from that cup, you will be mocked and insulted.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ano nɔviwònyɔnu ƒe kplu, si ko helolo, eye woɖi nu, ne nazu nu ɖikokoea kple alɔmeɖenu;

english_verse: You will end up drunk and devastated, because that cup is filled with horror and ruin.
translation_verse: ahamuame kple nuxaxa ayɔ mewo fũ, elabena nɔviwònyɔnu Samaria ƒe kplu enye ŋɔdzi kple mo yaa wɔwɔ ƒe kplu!

english_verse: But you must drink every drop! Then smash the cup and chew on its broken pieces. Use them to cut your breasts in sorrow. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ànoe ƒiaƒiaƒia ahaɖuɖɔ eƒe gbagbana biɖabiɖa, eye ade abi wò no ŋu; Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Nyee gblɔe!

english_verse: You have completely rejected me, and so I promise that you will be punished for the disgusting things you did as a prostitute. The Two Sisters Are Condemned
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi neŋlɔm be, eye netsɔm ƒu gbe ɖe megbewò la, eyata wò ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ kple wò gbolowɔwɔ anɔ dziwò.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, it's time for you to tell Oholah and Oholibah that they are guilty. Remind them of their evil ways!
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Amevi, ɖe nèbe, yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu Ohola kple Oholiba? Ekema ɖe woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo fia wo.

english_verse: They have been unfaithful by worshiping idols, and they have committed murder by sacrificing my own children as offerings to idols.
translation_verse: Elabena wowɔ ahasi, eye ʋu le asi ŋu na wo, wotsɔ woƒe legbawo wɔ ahasii, eye wotsɔ wo vi, siwo wodzi nam la, to dzo me, ne woanye nuɖuɖu na wo.

english_verse: They came into my temple that same day, and that made it unfit as a place to worship me. They have even stopped respecting the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ne wowu wo viwo na legbawo la, wovaa nye kɔkɔeƒe la gbemagbe ke, ne woagblẽ ko ɖo nɛ; alea wowɔ le nye xɔ me.

english_verse: They sent messengers to attract men from far away. When those men arrived, the two sisters bathed themselves and put on eye shadow and jewelry.
translation_verse: Woɖo ame ɖe ŋutsuwo le didiƒe, be woava, eye esi wodɔ ame ɖe wo wova la, èle tsi, eɖo tù ɖe ŋku, eye newɔ leke,

english_verse: They sat on a fancy couch, and in front of them was a table for the olive oil and incense that had belonged to me.
translation_verse: èbɔbɔ nɔ ada nyuia ɖe dzi, si ŋgɔ woɖo kplɔ̃ ɖo, eye nètso nye dzudzɔdonu kple nye ami da ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Their room was always filled with a noisy crowd of drunkards brought in from the desert. These men gave the women bracelets and beautiful crowns,
translation_verse: Wole ɣli dom hoo le afima, eye woyɔ Salbatɔwo tso gbe dzi kpe ɖe ame gbogboawo ŋu, amesiwo tso alɔnuga de alɔnu na wo, eye woɖo fiakuku nyui ɖe la na wo.

english_verse: and I noticed that the men were eager to have sex with these women, though they were exhausted from being prostitutes.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ be: Ɖe nyɔnu léayi aganɔ gbolo wɔma? Ɖe woaganɔ ahasi wɔm kpliia?

english_verse: In fact, the men had sex over and over with Oholah and Oholibah, the two sinful sisters.
translation_verse: Wova egbɔ, abe alesi wovaa gbolo gbɔe ene; alea wova Ohola kple Oholiba, siwo nye nyɔnu wo ŋukpenanuwo la gbɔe.

english_verse: But honest judges will someday accuse those two of murder and of being unfaithful, because they are certainly guilty.
