translation_verse: Gbemeti atse ku, anyigba awu nu, eye woano woƒe anyigba dzi aɖe dzi ɖi, ne wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa, ne meŋe woƒe kɔkuti, eye meɖe wo tso amesiwo wonye kluvi na la si me.

english_verse: Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Womaganye nuhaha na dukɔwo azɔ o, gbemelã magaɖu wo o, eye woanɔ anyi aɖe dzi ɖi, amea ɖeke maɖo voɖi na wo o.

english_verse: I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners.
translation_verse: Ma na nudodo namie na wo ade ŋkɔ wo ŋu, ne dɔwuame magatsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le anyigba dzi azɔ o, eye dukɔwo magado ŋukpe wo azɔ o.

english_verse: Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Eye wòadze sii be, nye Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la, meli kpli wo, eye woawo, Israel ƒe aƒe la, wonye nye dukɔ, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.
translation_verse: Ke miawoe nye nye alẽwo, mi amegbetɔwoe nye nye lãnyiƒe ƒe alẽwo la, eye nyee nye mia Mawu; Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Edom
translation_verse: Amevi, trɔ mo de Seir-to la, eye nagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe eŋu

english_verse: and say to them: I, the Lord God, am now your enemy! And I will turn your nation into an empty wasteland,
translation_verse: gblɔ nɛ bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Seir-to, mele ƒoƒo ge ɖe dziwò, mado nye asi ɖa ɖe ŋuwo, eye matsɔ wò awɔ gbegbe kple aƒedoe.

english_verse: leaving your towns in ruins. Your land will be a desert, and then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mado aƒe do wò duwo, eye wò ŋutɔ azu gbegbe, ne nadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: People of Edom, not only have you been Israel's longtime enemy, you simply watched when disaster wiped out its people as punishment for their sins.
translation_verse: Esi nèlé fu ame ɖikaɖika, eye nètsɔ Israel-viwo de asi na yi ie dzɔgbevɔ̃eɣi kple vodadawo ƒe nuwuwu la,

english_verse: And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death.
translation_verse: eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Meta ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne nyematsɔ wò awɔ ʋui, eye ʋu nati yowòme o fi! Ʋuhlɔ̃e nèdo, eyata ʋu ati yowòme!

english_verse: I will destroy your nation and kill anyone who travels through it.
translation_verse: Matsɔ Seir-to la awɔ aƒedo kple gbegbee, eye matsrɔ̃ amesiwo vana kple amesiwo dzona la ɖa le edzi.

english_verse: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Matsɔ wò awɔ gbegbee ɖikaa, eye wò duwo atsi anyi aƒedoe, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God,
translation_verse: Esi nèle gbɔgblɔm be, dukɔ eve mawo kple anyigba eve mawo anye ye tɔ, eye yewoe axɔe wòanye yewo tɔ, evɔ wònye Yehowa nɔ afima kpɔ hafi la,

english_verse: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you!
translation_verse: eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Mawɔ nu kpli wò ɖe wò dɔmedzoe kple wò ŋuʋaʋã nu, abe alesi nele fu wo wɔ ene, eye maɖe ɖokuinye afia le wo dome, ne medrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò.

english_verse: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.
translation_verse: Eye nadze sii be, nye Yehowa mese wò ɖiŋudonya, siwo katã negblɔ ɖe Israel ƒe towo ŋu bena: „Wòzu gbegbe, miawoe wotsɔe na, be miaɖu.“

english_verse: You even insulted me, but I heard it all.
translation_verse: Mietsɔ miaƒe nuwo ƒo adegbe ɖe ŋunye, eye miedudu nya ƒo ɖi bababa ɖe ŋunye mese.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate when I destroy you,
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Matsɔ wò awɔ gbegbee, ne dzi nadzo anyigba blibo la.

english_verse: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Alesi nekpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe anyigba ŋu be, ezu gbegbe la, nenema ke mawo wòe; Seir-to kple Edom blibo la azu gbegbe, ne wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the mountains of Israel
translation_verse: Wò amevi, gblɔ nya ɖi ɖe Israel-towo ŋu gblɔ bena: Mi Israel-towo, mise Yehowa ƒe nya!

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, am saying: Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi futɔ la le ehẽ dom ɖe mia ŋu be, blematowo zu yewo tɔ la,

english_verse: So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you.
translation_verse: eyata mi Israel-towo, mise Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe nya! Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ ɖe towo kple togbɛwo, balimewo kple gbadzaƒewo, glikpo gbagbãwo kple du ƒuƒluwo, siwo zu nuhaha kple alɔmeɖenu na dukɔwo ƒe mamleawo godoo la ŋu enye si:

english_verse: But in my fierce anger, I will turn against those nations, and especially the Edomites, because they laughed at you the loudest and took over your pasturelands.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Matsɔ nye ŋuʋaʋã ƒe dzobibi aƒo nu kple dukɔwo ƒe susɔea kpakple Edom blibo la, amesiwo tsɔ nye anyigba wɔ wo ɖokui tɔe, woƒe dzi le nu kom nyrenyrenyre, eye wole alɔme ɖem, le esi wotsɔe na wòzu nuhaha la ta.

english_verse: so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mekɔ nye asi dzi heka atam be: Dukɔ, siwo ɖe to ɖe mi godoo la, atsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ŋukpe!

english_verse: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.
translation_verse: Ke mi Israel-towo, miɖe ama, eye mitse ku na nye dukɔ Israel, elabena woƒe gbɔgbɔɣi tu aƒe.

english_verse: I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, mele mia gbɔ, eye matrɔ ɖe mia ŋu, woade agble ɖe mia dzi, eye woaƒã nu ɖe mia dzi!

english_verse: The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them.
translation_verse: Mana Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la ƒe amewo nasɔ gbɔ ɖe mia dzi, amewo anɔ duwo me, eye woaɖo gli gbagbãwo.

english_verse: Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mana amegbetɔwo kple lãwo nasɔ gbɔ ɖe mia dzi, woakeke ta, eye wòadzi; mana ame nanɔ mia dzi abe tsã ene, eye mawɔ nyui na mi wu tsã, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve.
translation_verse: Mana amegbetɔwo, nye dukɔ Israel, nazɔ mia dzi, woaxɔ wò, eye nazu woƒe domenyinu, eye magaɖe vi le wo ŋu azɔ o.

english_verse: It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Esi wole gbɔgblɔm na mi be, amelãɖula nenye, eye nèɖe vi le wò ŋutɔ wò dukɔ ŋu la,

english_verse: But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord Will Be Honored
translation_verse: Nyemena nagase dukɔwo ƒe vlodoame azɔ o, màgatso dukɔwo ƒe ŋukpedoame azɔ o, eye màgaɖe vi le wò dukɔ ŋu azɔ o, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe. Dzi yeye ŋugbedodo.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean.
translation_verse: Amevi, esi Israel ƒe aƒe la nɔ woƒe anyigba dzi la, wotsɔ woƒe zɔzɔme kple woƒe nuwɔnawo do gui; woƒe zɔzɔ le ŋkunye me abe nyɔnu kpɔdzinu ƒe ʋu ene.

english_verse: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people
translation_verse: Eyata metrɔ nye dziku ƒo ɖe wo dzi le ʋu, si wokɔ ɖe anyigba dzi, kple woƒe legba, siwo wotsɔ gblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ la ta.

english_verse: Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
translation_verse: Eye esi wova dukɔwo dome la, wodo gu nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la, le afisiafi, si woyi, ale be wole gbɔgblɔm le wo ŋu bena: „Yehowa ƒe dukɔe nye esia, eye eƒe anyigba dzi woɖu tso“

english_verse: so tell the Israelites that I am saying: You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe la bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Israel ƒe aƒe, menye mia ta mele ewɔm ɖo o, ke boŋ nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe, si mieɖo gui le dukɔwo dome, afisi míeyi la lae.

english_verse: and to show foreign nations that I am holy. Then they will know that I am the Lord God. I have spoken.
translation_verse: Eye makɔ nye ŋkɔ gã, si wodo gui le dukɔwo dome, esi miawo miedo gui le wo dome la ŋuti, eye dukɔwo adze sii bena, nyee nye Yehowa, ne mekɔ ɖokuinye ŋu le wo ŋku me ɖe mia ŋuti, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home.
translation_verse: Makplɔ mi atso dukɔwo dome, eye maƒo mia nu ƒu atso anyigbawo katã dzi ahakplɔ mi ava miaƒe anyigba dzii.

english_verse: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Mahlẽ tsi dzadzɛ ɖe mia ŋu, ne miaƒe nu makɔmakɔwo katã naɖi le mia ŋu, eye maklɔ miaƒe legbawo katã da le mia ŋu.

english_verse: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts,
translation_verse: Mana dzi yeye mi, eye maɖe gbɔgbɔ yeye mia me, maɖe kpedzi la le miaƒe dɔ me, eye mana lãkusidzi mi.

english_verse: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Maɖe nye gbɔgbɔ mia me, eye mana be, miazɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo kple nye sewo nu, ne mialé wo me ɖe asi ahawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Eye mianɔ anyigba, si metsɔ na mia fofowo la dzi, mianye dukɔ nam, eye manye mia Mawu.

english_verse: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.
translation_verse: Maɖe mi atso miaƒe nu makɔmakɔwo katã me; mayɔ bli vɛ, mana wòasɔ gbɔ, eye nyemahe dɔwuame ava mia dzi o.

english_verse: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.
translation_verse: Mana atikutsetsewo kple agble me nukuwo nasɔ gbɔ, ne miagahe dukɔwo ƒe vlodoame ava mia ɖokui dzi le dɔwuame ta azɔ oa

english_verse: You will remember your evil ways and hate yourselves for what you've done.
translation_verse: Miaɖo ŋu miaƒe zɔzɔme vɔ̃ɖiawo kple miaƒe nuwɔna manyomanyoawo, eye miava ŋu nya ge na mia ŋutɔwo mia ɖokui le miaƒe vodadawo kple miaƒe ŋunyɔnuwo ta.

english_verse: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Menye mia tae mele ewɔm ɖo o, minyae loo! Israel ƒe aƒe, ŋu nekpe mi, eye miaƒe mo netsi dã le miaƒe zɔzɔme ta! Anyigba nyui la ŋugbedodo.

english_verse: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gbesigbe makɔ mia ŋu tso miaƒe vodadawo katã me la, mana ame nanɔ duawo me, eye woagaɖo gli gbagbãwo.

english_verse: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.
translation_verse: Woade anyigba, si nye gbegbe la, ɖe esi wònye gbegbe le amesiwo katã va tsoa eme yina ŋku me la teƒe;

english_verse: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.
translation_verse: eye woagblɔ bena: „Anyigba, si nye gbegbe tsã la, zu abe Eden-bɔ ene, ame le ɖu, siwo nye aƒedo kple gbegbe, eye wogbã wo ƒu anyi tsã la me, eye wozu du sesẽwo.“

english_verse: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ mamlea, siwo ƒo xlã mi godoo la, adze sii bena, nye Yehowa ye tso du, siwo wogbã ƒu anyi, eye mede anyigba, si nye gbegbe la; nye Yehowa ye ƒo nu, eye mawo edzi hã.

english_verse: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mana Israel ƒe aƒe la naɖe kuku nam ɖe esia hã ta, eye mawɔe na wo: Mana woƒe amewo nasɔ gbɔ abe alẽwo ene.

english_verse: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Alesi ale, siwo ŋu wokɔ, kple alesi alẽ nɔa Yerusalem le ŋkekenyuieɖuɣii la, nenema amehawo ayɔ du ɖi aƒedo la mee, eye wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe asi va dzinye, eye wòtsɔ Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ kplɔm yi ɖada ɖe tagba, si yɔ fũ kple ameƒuwo.

english_verse: The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out.
translation_verse: Ekplɔm towo ŋui godoo, kpɔ ɖa, wosɔ gbɔ le tagba la fũ, eye woƒu kplakplakpla.

english_verse: He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?” I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be: Amevi, ɖe ƒu siawo agagbɔ agbea? Meɖo ŋu bena: Aƒetɔ Yehowa, wò ŋutɔ ènyae!

english_verse: He then told me to say: Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you,
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Gblɔ nya ɖi ɖe ƒu siawo ŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Mi ƒu ƒuƒuwo, mise Yehowa ƒe nya!

english_verse: “I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ na ƒu siawo enye si: Made gbɔgbɔ mia me, ne miagbɔ agbe.

english_verse: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Made lãmeka mia ŋu, eye mana lã naɖo mia ŋu; mafa agbalẽ ɖe mia ŋu, eye made gbɔgbɔ mia me, be miagbɔ agbe, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ nya ɖi, abe alesi wode se nam ene. Esi megblɔ nya ɖi la, hoowɔwɔ le ɖiɖim, ƒuawo le kpekpem ɖe wo nɔewo nu, eye wo dome ɖesiaɖe va nɔvia gbɔ.

english_verse: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
translation_verse: Eye meɖo ŋku anyi hekpɔ bena, lãmeka dowo ŋu, lã ɖo wo ŋu, eye agbalẽ fa ɖe edzi, ke gbɔgbɔ mekpɔ ɖo wo me haɖe o.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam bena: Gblɔ nya ɖi do ɖe gbɔgbɔ, amevi, gblɔ nya ɖi, eye nagblɔ na gbɔgbɔ bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gbɔgbɔ tso ya eneawo gbɔ nava, agbɔ ɖe ame kuku siawo me, ne woagbã agbe!

english_verse: As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ nya ɖi, abe alesi wode se nam la ene. Tete gbɔgbɔ va ɖo wo me, eye wogbɔ agbe hetso ɖe woƒe afɔwo dzi, aʋakɔ gã nyadria ɖe wonye.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Ƒu siawo nye Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la! Kpɔ ɖa, wole gbɔgblɔm be: „Tsi no le míaƒe ƒuwo me, miaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ nu yi, eye miebu!“

english_verse: So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel,
translation_verse: Eyata gblɔ nya ɖi nagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Nye dukɔ, kpɔ ɖa, mele miaƒe yɔdowo ʋu ge, mana miado atso miaƒe yɔdowo me, eye makplɔ mi ayi miaƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa, ne meʋu miaƒe yɔdowo, eye mena mieɖo tso miaƒe yɔdowo me.

english_verse: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.” Judah and Israel Together Again
translation_verse: Made nye gbɔgbɔ mia me, ne miagbɔ agbe, eye makplɔ mi aɖo miaƒe anyigba dzi, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa. Yehowa be: Nyee gblɔe, eye mawɔe hã. Israel dzadzraɖo.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.”
translation_verse: Amevi, tsɔ ati naŋlɔ nu ɖe edzi be: „Yuda kple Israel-vi, siwo wɔ ɖeka kplii la tɔe.“ Eye gatsɔ ati bubu naŋlɔ nu ɖe edzi bena: „Yosef, si nye Efrayim ƒe ali, kple Israel ƒe aƒe blibo, si wɔ ɖeka kplii la tɔe.“

english_verse: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.
translation_verse: Eye natsiã wo ɖe wo nɔewo nu, ne woanye ati ɖeka anɔ asiwò me.

english_verse: And when your people ask you what this means,
translation_verse: Eye ne mia ɖeviwo gblɔ na wò bena: Gblɔ gɔme, si le eme na wò na yewo la,

english_verse: tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
translation_verse: ekema gblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ Yosef ƒe ati, si le Efrayim si, kple Israel-to, siwo wo ɖeka kplii la, atsiã ɖe Yuda ƒe ati nu, eye matsɔ wo awɔ ɖekae, ne woanye ati ɖeka anɔ asinye me.

english_verse: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone
translation_verse: Lé ati, siwo dzi neŋlɔ nu ɖo la, ɖe asi le wo ŋku me,

english_verse: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.
translation_verse: eye nagblɔ na wo bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖakplɔ Israel-viwo atso dukɔwo dome, afisi woʋu yi, eye maƒo wo nu ƒu atso goawo katã me ava woƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.
translation_verse: Matsɔ wo awɔ dukɔ ɖekae ɖe anyigba dzi le Israel-towo dzi, eye fia ɖeka anye wo katã ƒe fia, womaganye dukɔ eve azɔ o, eye womagamã ɖe fiaɖu ƒe eve me azɔ o.

english_verse: They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Womagatsɔ woƒe legbawo kple woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo kpakple woƒe dzidadawo katã agblẽ kɔ ɖo na wo ɖokui azɔ o, maɖe wo tso woƒe dzidada, siwo katã wotsɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃e la me, eve makɔ wo ŋu, ne woanye nye dukɔ, eye manye Mawu na wo.

english_verse: Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Woanɔ anyigba, si dzi wo fofowo no, eye metsɔ na nye dɔla Yakob la dzi, woawo kple wo viwo kpakple wo viwo ƒe viwo ana edzi tegbee, eye nye dɔla Dawid anye amegã ɖe wò nu tegbee.

english_verse: I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time,
translation_verse: Mabia ŋutifafa ƒe nu kpli wo, nubabla mavɔ wòanye na wo, malé wo ɖe te, madzi wo ɖe dzi, eye mali nye kɔkɔeƒe la ɖe wo dome tegbee.

english_verse: and I will live among my people and be their God.
translation_verse: Nye nɔƒe anɔ wo dome, manye woƒe Mawu, eye woawo anye nye dukɔ.

english_verse: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔwo adze sii be, nye Yehowa ye ko Israel ŋu, ne nye kɔkɔeƒe la le wo dome tegbee.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
translation_verse: Amevi, trɔ mo ɖe Gog ŋu le Magog-nyigba dzi, amesi nye amegã le Ros, Mesex kple Tubal, eye nagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe eŋu

english_verse: and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords.
translation_verse: Mable nuwo, eye made ga alɔgo na wò ahakplɔ mia kple wò aʋakɔ blibo la, sɔwo kple sɔdolawo, adzoe, wo katã woɖo atsyɔ̃, ameha gã, si kpla akpoxɔnu gã kple via, eye wo katã wòlé yi ɖe asi.

english_verse: Your army includes soldiers from Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya,
translation_verse: Persia, Kus kple Put kpe ɖe wo ŋu, akpoxɔnu kple gakuku le wo katã si,

english_verse: as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!
translation_verse: hekpe ɖe Gomer kple eƒe aʋakɔ blibo la, Togarma ƒe aƒe, si le anyiehe kekeake kple eƒe aʋakɔ blibo la ŋu; du geɖe kpe ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land.
translation_verse: Le ɣeyiɣi geɖe megbe la woade se na wò! Le ƒewo ƒe nuwuwu la ayi anyigba, si vo tso yi si me la dzi, dukɔ, si woƒo ƒu tso dukɔ geɖewo dome wole Israel-to, siwo nye gbegbe eteƒe didi la dzi, dukɔ, si wokplɔ tso dukɔwo dome, eye wo katã woli ɖe dzi ɖi.

english_verse: But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
translation_verse: Aho ava abe ahom ene, eye ava abe alilikpo ene, anyẽ atsyɔ anyigba la, mia kple wò aʋakɔ blibo la, eye dukɔ geɖewo akpe ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gbemagbe la nu aɖo dzi me na wò, eye aɖo tame vɔ̃ɖi

english_verse: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.
translation_verse: agblɔ bena: Maho ɖe anyigba, si le nuvo la ŋu eye maƒo ɖe amesiwo li bɔkɔɔ, eye woɖe dzi ɖi la dzi, amesiwo li, eye gli, gameti kple agbo mele wo si o,

english_verse: You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property.
translation_verse: ne naha nu, naɖe aboyo nu, eye nanye wò asi ɖe aƒedo, si me ame le, kple dukɔ, si woƒo ƒu tso dukɔwo dome la dzi, amesiwo si lãwo kple kesinɔnuwo le, eye wole anyigba ƒe ƒoƒoli nu.

english_verse: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
translation_verse: Seba, Dedan kple Tarsis ƒe asitsalawo kpakple woƒe dzatawo katã agblɔ na wò be: Ɖe nèva, be naha nu, eye ɖe neƒo wò amehawo nu ƒu, be naɖe aboyo nu, nalɔ klosalo kple sika ahatsɔ lãwo kple kesinɔnuwo adzoe, eye naxa nu geɖewoa?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, know that when you see my people Israel living in peace,
translation_verse: Eyata amevi, gblɔ nya ɖi, eye nagblɔ na Gog bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ne nye dukɔ Israel li heɖe dzi ɖi la, àho ɣemaɣi,

english_verse: you will lead your powerful cavalry from your kingdom in the north.
translation_verse: àtso nɔwòƒe le anyiehe kekeake ava, eye dukɔ geɖe akpe ɖe ŋuwò, wo katã woanɔ sɔ dzi, ameha gã kple aʋakɔ dranyi wòanye;

english_verse: You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy. Judgment on Gog
translation_verse: eye àho ɖe nye dukɔ Israel ŋu, anyẽ atsyɔ anyigba la abe alilikpo ene; ŋkekeawo ƒe nuwuwu wòava me; Gog, makplɔ wò aƒu nye anyigba, ne dukɔwo nadze sim, ne mekɔ ɖokuinye ŋu ɖe ŋutiwò le wo ŋku me!

english_verse: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi; Wòe nye amesi ŋu meƒo nu le le blema-ŋkekewo me to nye ɖɔla Israel ƒe nyagblɔɖilawo dzi, amesiwo gblɔ nya ɖi ɣemaɣi ƒe geɖe be, wòe wole kpɔkplɔ ge ava ƒu woa?

english_verse: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.
translation_verse: Nye ŋuʋaʋã kple nye dziku ƒe dzo mee meƒo nu le be, ɣemaɣi la anyigbaʋuʋu gãa ɖe le Israel-nyigba dzi nɔ ge.

english_verse: Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse.
translation_verse: Ƒumelãwo kple dziƒoxewo, gbemelãwo kple nutata, siwo katã tana le anyigba dzi, kpakple amegbetɔ, siwo katã le anyigba dzi la, adzo kpekpekpe le ŋkunye me, towo aŋe adze eme, agakpewo amũ, eye gliwo katã amũ adze anyi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Mayɔ yi ɖe eŋu le nye towo katã dzi, eye amesiame atsɔ yi ɖe ehavi ŋu.

english_verse: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Matsɔ dɔvɔ̃ kple ʋu, tsidzadza gãwo kple tsikpewo adrɔ̃ ʋɔnui, eye mana dzo kple aŋɔ nadza ɖe eya kple eƒe aʋakɔ kpakple dukɔ geɖe, siwo kpe ɖe eŋu la dzi.

english_verse: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_verse: Mado gã ɖokuinye, makɔ ɖokuinye ŋu, eye maɖe ɖokuinye afia le dukɔ geɖewo ŋku me, ne woadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Amevi, gblɔ nya ɖi ɖe Gog vivi, nu, nagblɔ bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gog, kpɔ ɖa, mele ƒoƒo ge ɖe dziwò, wò amesi nye amegã le Ros, Mesex kple Tubal!

english_verse: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.
translation_verse: Mable nuwo, eye malé wò alɔnu akplɔ wò atso anyiehe kekeake ava Israel-towo dzi.

english_verse: I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand,
translation_verse: Maƒo dati da le mia na wò, eye wò aŋutrɔwo age le ɖusi na wò.

english_verse: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh
translation_verse: Mia kple wò aʋakɔ blibo la kple dukɔ, siwo katã kpe ɖe ŋuwò la, miatsi Israel-towo dzi; eye matsɔ wò ana xe ƒonuwo, lã, siwo katã to aʋala, kple gbemelãwo, ne woaɖu.

english_verse: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Dogba dzi natsi, elabena nyee gblɔe.

english_verse: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Maɖo dzo ɖe Magog kple amesiwo le ƒukpowo dzi bɔkɔɔ la dome, ne wòadze sii be, nyee nye Yehowa.

english_verse: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Maɖe nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la afia le nye dukɔ Israel dome, eye nyemana woagado gu nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la azɔ o, ne dukɔwo nadze sii be, nye Yehowa ye nye kɔkɔetɔ le Israel.

english_verse: The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa be: Kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna, eye wòle eme va ge; esia nye ŋkeke, si ŋu meƒo nu le.

english_verse: When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years.
translation_verse: Eye Israel-duwo me towo ado ayi aɖado dzo, eye woatso aʋawɔnuwo, akpoxɔnu gã kple via, datiwo kple aŋutrɔwo, kpowo kple akplowo ade dzo; woatsɔ wo ado dzoe ƒe adre sɔŋ.

english_verse: They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Burial of Gog The Lord said:
translation_verse: Womatsɔ nake atso gbe me vɛ o, eye womafɔe le avewo me hã o, ke boŋ aʋawɔnuwo woatso ado dzoe; woada adzo amesiwo da adzo wo, eye woaha wo halawo, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.”
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la mana teƒea ɖe Gog ɖe Israel-nyigba dzi, si nye Abarim-bali me la le atsiaƒu ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome; woaxe Abarim-bali la ƒe mo, eye afima woadi Gog kple eƒe amehawo katã ɖo, eye woayɔe be „Gog ƒe amehawo ƒe balime“.

english_verse: The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe la aɖi wo dzinu adre sɔŋ, ne woakɔ anyigba la ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen.
translation_verse: Dukɔ hahoo la aɖi wo, eye woaxɔ ŋkɔ le gbesigbe mede bubu ɖokuinye ŋu, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean.
translation_verse: Woaɖe amewo, ne woano tsatsam le anyigba dzi ɖaa, ne woaɖi amesiwo gakpɔtɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi, be woakɔ eŋu; le dzinu adre megbe la woagadzro eme akpɔ.

english_verse: Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army”
translation_verse: Eye ne amesiwo le tsatsam le anyigba dzi la dometɔ ɖeka kpɔ ameƒua ɖe la, ade dzesi egbɔ, vaseɖe esime ameɖilawo natsɔe aɖi ɖe Gog ƒe amehawo ƒe balime.

english_verse: near the town of “Gog's Army.” After that, the land will be pure again.
translation_verse: Afima woaɖi amehawo ɖo, eye woakɔ anyigba la ŋu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to hold a feast on Israel's mountains and offer sacrifices there. So invite all the birds and wild animals to come from every direction and eat the meat of sacrifices and drink the blood. The birds and animals
translation_verse: Amevi, ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Gblɔ na xe ƒomevi vovovowo katã kpakple gbemelãwo katã bena: Miƒo ta kpli, eye miƒo mia ɖokui nu ƒu tso goawo katã me, ne miava nye vɔsa ŋkekenyuie, si ɖu ge mala na mi la ɖu ƒe, aglotutu gã wònye le Israel-towo dzi, eye miaɖu lã ano ʋu.

english_verse: will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls.
translation_verse: Miaɖu kalẽtɔwo ƒe lã, eye miano anyigba dzi amegãwo ƒe ʋu hekpe ɖe agbowo, alẽviwo, gbɔ̃tsuwo kple nyitsuwo ŋu, wo katã lã damiwo wonye tso Basan,

english_verse: I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk.
translation_verse: eye miaɖu nye vɔsalã, si mewu na mi la ƒe ami woaɖi ƒo na mi, eye miano eƒe ʋu wòamu mi.

english_verse: They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Israel Will Be Restored The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye miaɖu sɔwo kple sɔdolawo, kalẽtɔwo kple aʋawɔla ƒomevi vovovowo aɖi ƒo le nye kplɔ̃ ŋu, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: When I punish the nations of the earth, they will see the brightness of my glory.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye ŋutikɔkɔe aɖo dukɔwo dome, eye dukɔwo katã akpɔ nye ʋɔnu, si medrɔ̃, kple nye asi, si metsɔ do wo dzi.

english_verse: The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe la adze sii bena, nye Yehowa ye nye woƒe Mawu tso gbemagbe heyii.

english_verse: Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔwo nadze si be, Israel ƒe aƒe la ƒe vodadawo ta wonyã wo de gbe ɖo; le esi wòtrɔ ʋu le yonyeme ŋuti la, eyata meɣla nye ŋku me ɖe wo, eye metsɔ wo ɖe asi na woƒe ketɔwo, be wo katã wotsi yi nu.

english_verse: Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Azɔ maɖo Yakob te, makpɔ nublanui na Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la, eye maʋã ŋu ɖe nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la nu.

english_verse: They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me.
translation_verse: Eye woaŋlɔ woƒe ŋukpewo katã kple go, siwo katã wodze ɖe ŋunye la be, nenye be, wogale woƒe anyigba dzi bɔkɔɔ, eye amea ɖeke medoa voɖi na wo o.

english_verse: Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: Ne mekplɔ wo gbɔe tso dukɔwo dome, eye meƒo wo nu ƒu tso woƒe fufuwo ƒe anyigba dzi la, maka ɖokuinye ŋu ɖe wo ŋuti le dukɔ geɖewo ŋku me.

english_verse: My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land.
translation_verse: Eye woadze sii be, nye Yehowa ye nye woƒe Mawu, esi mena woɖe aboyo wo yi dukɔwo dome, eye megaƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe woƒe anyigba dzi, eye nyemegblẽ wo dometɔa ɖeke ɖe afima o ŋuti.

english_verse: Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eye nyemagaɣla nye ŋku me ɖe wo azɔ o, le esi metrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ kɔ ɖe Israel ƒe aƒe la dzi ta, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and
translation_verse: Ekɔm le Mawu ƒe ŋutega me va dro ɖe to kɔkɔ booa ɖe dzi le Israel-nyigba dzi, eye wòle abe dua ɖee wotso ɖe edzi le dziehe gome ene.

english_verse: He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide.
translation_verse: Ewɔ akpata la wòle abɔklugui blave, eye xɔxɔnu la va tɔ agbo la ƒe akpata le goawo katã me.

english_verse: In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other.
translation_verse: Esi wòkplɔm va afimae la, kpo ɖa, ŋutsua ɖe le tsi tre ɖe agbo nu, eƒe nɔnɔme le abe akɔbli ene, eye wòlé anazika gbegbe kple dzidzeti ɖe asi.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.” The East Gate
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsu la gblɔ nam bena: Amevi, kpɔ nu kple ŋku, se nu kple to, eye nalé ŋku ɖe nusiwo katã mele fiawo ge la ŋu; elabena ɖe wokplɔ wò va afisiae, be woafia nu wò. Gblɔ nusiwo katã kpɔ ge nala la, na Israel ƒe aƒe la.

english_verse: at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter.
translation_verse: Edzidze agbo la ƒe akpata wòle abɔklugui enyi, eye eƒe domegliwo le abɔklugui eve; agbo la ƒe akpata le eme go dzi.

english_verse: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
translation_verse: Xɔvi etɔ̃ le agbo, si dze ŋgɔ ɣedzeƒe gome la ƒe akpa ɖeka, eye wo ame etɔ̃ le akpa keme; dzidze ɖeka li na wo ame etɔ̃awo katã, eye dzidze ɖeka li na woƒe domegliawo le go si kple go keme me.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide.
translation_verse: Edzidze agbo la ƒe mɔnu wòkeke abɔklugui ewo, eye agbo la me keke abɔklugui wuietɔ̃.

english_verse: The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters.
translation_verse: Eye wodzidze agbo la ƒe kekeme tso xɔvi ɖeka megbe vaseɖe evelia megbe wòle abɔklugui blave vɔ atɔ̃; mɔnu dze ŋgɔ mɔnu.

english_verse: Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was
translation_verse: Tso agbo gotatɔ nu vaseɖe akpata ƒe agbo metɔ nu le abɔklugui blaatɔ̃.

english_verse: The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. The Outer Courtyard
translation_verse: Fesre, siwo ƒe nugbɔ keke ɖo ta eme lɔƒo ɖe xɔviawo kple woƒe domegliwo gbɔ la, le agbo la ŋu godoo va kpe, alea fesrewo ƒo xlã akpata la hãe, eye wòta detiwo ɖe domegliawo ŋu.

english_verse: The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔm yi xɔxɔnu egodotɔ, kpɔ ɖa, xɔviwo le xɔxɔnu la, eye wotsɔ kpe srã anyigbae godoo va kpe; xɔviawo le blaetɔ̃, eye wotsɔ kpe srã wo nui.

english_verse: This was known as the lower sidewalk, and it was
translation_verse: Kpenyigba le agbo la ƒe axawo dzi ɖe agbo la ƒe didime nu; esia nye kpenyigba anyigbe gometɔ.

english_verse: I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was
translation_verse: Eye wodzidze kekeme, si tso anyigbe-gbo la nu, le eme gome vaseɖe xɔxɔnu metɔ nu wòle abɔklugui alafa ɖeka, alea wòle le ɣedzeƒe kple anyiehe hã.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Eye wodzidze agbo, si le anyiehe gome le xɔxɔnu kɔloetɔ ŋu la ƒe didime kple kekeme.

english_verse: This gate also had three guardrooms on each side of a passageway. The measurements of these rooms, the walls between them, and the entrance room at the far end of the passageway were exactly the same as those of the east gate. The north gate was also
translation_verse: Xɔvi etɔ̃ le eƒe axa ɖeka, eye wo ame etɔ̃ le axa evelia, eƒe domegliwo kple akpata la ƒe dzidzeme sɔ kple agbo gbãtɔ tɔ; edidi abɔklugui blaatɔ̃, eye wòkeke abɔklugui blave vɔ atɔ̃.

english_verse: and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it.
translation_verse: Eƒe fesrewo, eƒe akpata kple eƒe detiwo i ƒe dzidzeme sɔ kple agbo, si le ɣedzeƒe gome la tɔ, atrakpuifɔflɔ adre woliana vaa edzi, eye eƒe akpata le eme lɔƒo.

english_verse: Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was
translation_verse: Xɔxɔnu metɔ ƒe agbo dze ŋgɔ agbo, siwo le anyiehe kple ɣedzeƒe; eye wòdzidzee tso agbo ɖeka nuyi evelia nu wòle abɔklugui alafa ɖeka.

english_verse: The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates.
translation_verse: Tete wòkplɔm yi dziehe gome, eye kpɔ ɖa, agboa ɖe dze ŋgɔ dziehe gome; eye wodzidze eƒe domegliwo kple eƒe akpata wòle abe dzidzeme kemeawo ene.

english_verse: Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway.
translation_verse: Atrakpuifɔflɔ adre woliana yia edzi, eƒe akpata le eme gome, eye detiwo le eƒe domegliwo ŋu le go si kple go keme me.

english_verse: And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also
translation_verse: Agbo le xɔxɔnu meta ŋu ɖo ta dziehe gome, eye wòdzidzee tso agbo ɖeka nuyi evelia nu le dziehe gome wòle abɔklugui alafa ɖeka.

english_verse: The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Eƒe akpata ɖo ta xɔxɔnu kɔtoetɔ gbɔ, detiwo le eƒe sɔtiwo ŋu, eye atrakpuifɔflɔ enyi woliana yia edzi.

english_verse: Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔm yi xɔxɔnu metɔ le ɣedzeƒe gome, eye wodzidze agbo la abe dzidzeme kemeawo ene.

english_verse: The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was
translation_verse: Eƒe xɔviwo, domegliwo kple eƒe akpata le abe dzidzeme kemeawo ene, fesrewo le eya kple eƒe akpata ŋu godoo va kpe; edidi abɔklugui blaatɔ̃, eye wòkeke abɔklugui blave vɔ atɔ̃.

english_verse: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Eƒe akpata ɖo ta xɔxɔnu kɔtoetɔ gbɔ, detiwo le eƒe domegliwo ŋu le go si kple go keme me, eye atrakpuifɔflɔ enyi woliana yia edzi.

english_verse: including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, and the entrance room. There were also windows in this gate. It was
translation_verse: eƒe xɔviwo, domegliwo kple eƒe akpata wòle abe dzidzeme kemeawo ene, eye fesrewo le eŋu godoo va kpe; edidi abɔklugui blaatɔ̃, eye wòkeke abɔklugui blave vɔ atɔ̃.

english_verse: and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate. The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
translation_verse: Eƒe akpata ɖo ta xɔxɔnu kɔtoetɔ gbɔ, detiwo le eƒe domegliwo ŋu le go si kple go keme me, eye atrakpuifɔflɔ enyi woliana yia edzi.

english_verse: Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room.
translation_verse: Ne wòto agbo la nu va la, kplɔ eve le glia godo de anyiehe gome, eye kplɔ̃ eve le agbo la ƒe akpata ƒe gli evelia godo.

english_verse: So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed,
translation_verse: Kplɔ ene le agbo la ƒe gli ƒe go si me, eye kplɔ̃ ene le go keme me, wole kplɔ enyi, siwo dzi wowua lã le.

english_verse: and where the meat was placed until it was sacrificed on the altar. Next to the tables in the entrance room were four stone tables
translation_verse: Woɖo to na kplɔ̃awo godoo va kpe wòkɔ asi ƒe kekeme ɖeka, eye woawo dzi wodaa vɔsalãwo ɖo.

english_verse: The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔm yi agbo metɔ me, kpɔ ɖa, xɔvi eve le xɔxɔnu metɔ la, ɖeka le anyiehegbo ƒe axa dzi hetrɔ ŋgɔ dze dziehe gome, eye evelia le dziehe-gbo ƒe axa dzi hetrɔ ŋgɔ dze anyiehe gome.

english_verse: He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple,
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Xɔvi, si trɔ ŋgɔ dze dziehe gome la, enye nunɔla, siwo le dɔ wɔm le aƒea me la tɔ;

english_verse: and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.” The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
translation_verse: eye xɔvi, si trɔ ŋgɔ dze anyiehe gome la, enye nunɔla, siwo le dɔ wɔm le vɔsamlekpuia ŋu la tɔ; woawo nye Zadok-viwo tso Lewi-viwo dome, amesiwo kpɔ mɔ ate ɖe Yehowa ŋu asubɔe.

english_verse: We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters.
translation_verse: Emegbe wòkplɔm yi xɔ la ƒe akpata me, eye wòdzidze akpata la ƒe domegliwo, go si metɔ le abɔklugui atɔ̃, eye go keme metɔ le abɔklugui atɔ̃, agbo la ƒe kekeme le abɔklugui wuiene, eye agbo la ƒe axa dzi gli le abɔklugui etɔ̃ le go si me, eye wòle abɔklugui etɔ̃ le go keme me.

english_verse: The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_verse: Akpata la didi abɔklugui blave, eye wòkeke abɔklugui ewo; atrakpuifɔflɔ ewo woliana yia edzi, eye sɔtiwo le domegliawo ŋu, ɖeka le go si me, eye evelia le go keme me.

english_verse: Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was
translation_verse: Tete wòkplɔm yi gbedoxɔ me, eye wòdzidze eƒe domegliwo, go si metɔ keke abɔklugui ade, eye go keme metɔ keke abɔklugui ade.

english_verse: and the nearest buildings ten meters away.
translation_verse: kple akpatawo dome ƒo xlã xɔ la godoo va kpe la, keke abɔklugui blave.

english_verse: Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide,
translation_verse: Eye wòdzidze eƒe didime ɖo ta gbedoxɔ la gbɔ wòle abɔklugui blave, eye kekeme le abɔklugui blave. Eye wògblɔ nam be: Esia nye kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe.

english_verse: The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
translation_verse: Xɔŋuxɔeawo le kekem ɖe dzi ɖo ta dzi me, elabena xɔviawo de dzi ƒo xlã xɔ la, eyata xɔ la ƒe kekeme lɔ le dzi me gome. Xɔvi tetɔ me wotona yia titinatɔ kple etametɔ me.

english_verse: The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ kpoƒuƒu le xɔ la ŋu godoo va kpe, si nye xɔŋuxɔeawo ƒe gomeɖoɖo, ele dzidzeti ɖeka, si nye abɔklugui ade.

english_verse: The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls
translation_verse: Xɔŋuxɔeawo ƒe gli, si le gota gome la, keke abɔklugui atɔ̃. Eye teƒe, si tsi xɔŋuxɔe, siwo le xɔa ŋu

english_verse: One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms. The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
translation_verse: Xɔŋuxɔeawo ƒe ʋɔtru ɖo ta teƒe, si wotso di la gbɔ, ʋɔtru ɖeka ɖo ta anyiehe gome, eye ʋɔtru evelia ɖo ta dziehe gome, teƒe, si wotso ɖi la ƒe kekeme le abɔklugui atɔ̃ le goawo katã me.

english_verse: The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also
translation_verse: Eye gbedoxɔ la ƒe ŋgɔdze le ɣedzeƒe gome kple teƒe, si ŋu wòtɔ kpɔ ɖo la, keke abɔklugui alafa ɖeka.

english_verse: were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood.
translation_verse: agbalinu kple fesre, siwo ƒe nugbɔ lɔ ɖe eme lɔƒo kpakple gbedoxɔ la ƒe akpa etɔ̃awo ƒe gliwo ŋu le agbali la ŋgɔdze tso anyigba vaseɖe fesreawo gbɔ; ke wotu fesreawo.

english_verse: The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle. The Wooden Altar In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like
translation_verse: Gbedoxɔ la ƒe ʋɔtrutiwo le dzogoe ene me, eye nane le kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la ŋgɔ abe

english_verse: a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.” The Doors in the Temple
translation_verse: vɔsamlekpui, si wotso ati wòe la ene, ekɔ abɔklugui etɔ̃, eye wòdidi abɔklugui eve, dzogoewo li ne, afɔ le egɔme, eye eƒe axawo dzi nye ʋuƒo. Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Esia nye kplɔ̃, si le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors,
translation_verse: Ʋɔtru agavee le kɔkɔeƒe la kple kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la nu;

english_verse: and each door had two sections that could fold open.
translation_verse: ʋɔtruawo dze eve, eye wotrona, wo ame eve le mɔnu ɖeka, eye wo ame eve le mɔnu keme.

english_verse: The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors.
translation_verse: Eye wowɔ Kerubiwo kple detiwo ɖe wo ŋu, abe alesi wowɔe ɖe gliawo ŋu ene. Eye wotsɔ ʋuƒo wɔ agbali ɖe akpata la nu le gota gome.

english_verse: The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_verse: Fesreawo ƒe nugbɔ lɔ ɖe eme lɔƒo, eye detiwo le akpata la ƒe axawo kple eve kpakple xɔŋuxɔeawo ƒe gli ŋu.

english_verse: and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms. There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building.
translation_verse: le xɔxɔnu ƒe gliawo ƒe gɔmedzedze. Xɔviwo le dziehe gome hã le teƒe, si ŋu watɔ kpɔ ɖo la ŋgɔdze kple gli la ŋgɔdze.

english_verse: with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and
translation_verse: Toƒea ɖe le xɔviawo nu ɖo ta xɔxɔnu metɔ, ekeke abɔklugui ewo, eye wòdidi abɔklugui alafa ɖeka; woƒe ʋɔtruwo ɖo ta anyiehe gome.

english_verse: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level.
translation_verse: Xɔvi tametɔwo mekeke abe etetɔwo kple dometɔwo ene o, elabena sɔtiwo ƒe akpata la xɔ teƒe le wo si.

english_verse: The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard.
translation_verse: Dzisasrã etɔ me wole; ke sɔti mele wo ŋu abe le xɔxɔnuawo ŋu ene o, eyata xɔvi tametɔwo mekeke abe etetɔwo kple dometɔwo ene o.

english_verse: These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them.
translation_verse: Toƒe le wo ŋgɔ, abe esi le xɔvi, siwo le anyiehe gome la ŋgɔ ene, wodidi, eye wokeke abe ekemeawo ene, eye wowɔ woƒe mɔnu wo katã wòsɔ kple ekemeawo.

english_verse: The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.
translation_verse: Woƒe ʋɔtruwo le abe xɔvi, siwo le dziehe gome la ƒe ʋɔtruwo ene, eye mɔnu ɖeka le glia ƒe gɔmedzedze, ne wotso ɣedzeƒe gome va.

english_verse: The man then said to me: These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam be: Xɔvi, siwo le anyiehe gome, kple xɔvi, siwo le dziehe gome le teƒe, si ŋu wòtɔ kpɔ ɖo la ŋgɔdze la, xɔvi kɔkɔewo wonye, afisi nunɔla, siwo kpɔ mɔ ate ɖe Yehowa ŋu la, aɖu nu kɔkɔetɔwo le; afima woatsɔ nu kɔkɔetɔ, siwo nye nuɖuvɔsa, nuvɔ̃vɔsa kple fɔɖivɔsa ada ɖo, elabena teƒe kɔkɔe ye.

english_verse: When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people. The Size of the Temple Area
translation_verse: Ne nunɔlawo ge ɖe kɔkɔeƒea me la, womado ayi xɔxɔnu kɔtoetɔ o, ke boŋ woaɖe woƒe awu, siwo wodo subɔ la, ɖe afima, elabena nu kɔkɔewo wonye, eye woaɖo awu bubuwo hafi ayi teƒe, si woɖo ɖi na dukɔ la.

english_verse: After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdzidze xɔ metɔ vɔ la, ekplɔm to agbo, si le ɣedzeƒe gome la nu, eye wòdzidze wo katã godoo va kpe.

english_verse: He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was
translation_verse: Etsɔ dzidzeti dzidze ɣedzeƒekpa wòle abɔklugui alafa atɔ̃;

english_verse: and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.
translation_verse: Edzidzee le go eneawo me, eye gli ƒo xlãe godoo va kpe didi abɔklugui alafa atɔ, eye wòkeke abɔklugui alafa atɔ, ne wòatso nu kɔkɔewo kple nu makɔmakɔwo dome.

english_verse: The man took me back to the east gate of the temple,
translation_verse: Emegbe wòkplɔm yi agbo, si dze ŋgɔ ɣedzeƒe gome la nu.

english_verse: meters high, was the place where sacrifices were burned, and the four corners of the top section looked like the horns of a bull. The steps leading up to the altar were on the east side. The Dedication of the Altar
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe tso ɣedzeƒe gome va, eye eƒe zinyenyẽ le abe tɔ gãwo ƒe hoowɔwɔ ene, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe na anyigba le keklẽm.

english_verse: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River. I immediately bowed with my face to the ground,
translation_verse: Eye nusi mekpɔ la, le abe esi mekpɔ, esime meva dua gblẽ ge la ene, eye nɔnɔmeawo le abe esiwo mekpɔ le Kebar-tɔsisi la nu ene. Tete metsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: and the Lord's glory came through the east gate and into the temple.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe to agbo, si dze ŋgɔ ɣedzeƒe gome la nu ge ɖe xɔ la me.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord's glory had filled the temple.
translation_verse: Tete gbɔgbɔ la kɔm ɖaɖa ɖe xɔxɔnu metɔ, eye kpɔ da, Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ xɔ la taŋ.

english_verse: But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.
translation_verse: Azɔ woate woƒe gbolowɔwɔ kple woƒe fiawo ƒe kukuawo ɖa le gbɔnye, eye manɔ wo dome tegbee.

english_verse: The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it,
translation_verse: Amevi, fia gbedoxɔ la Israel ƒe aƒe la, ne woƒe vodadawo nakpe ŋu na wo; eye na woadzidze eƒe nɔnɔme.

english_verse: then if they are truly sorry, describe for them the design and shape of the temple, the gates, the measurements, and how the buildings are arranged. Explain the regulations about worshiping there, then write down these things, so they can study and obey them.
translation_verse: Eye ne woƒe nuwɔnawo katã kpe ŋu na wo la, ekema ɖe xɔ la ƒe nɔnɔme kple etutume, eƒe mɔnuwo kple ʋɔtruwo, eƒe nɔnɔmewo katã, eƒe ɖoɖowo katã kple sewo katã fia wo, eye naŋlɔ wo le wo ŋku me, ne woadzra eƒe nɔnɔmewo katã kple eƒe ɖoɖowo katã ɖo, eye woawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple. The Altar
translation_verse: Se, si le aƒea ŋu la, enye si: Eya kple eŋu katã godoo le kɔkɔe le toa ta me. Esia nye se, si le aƒea ŋu. Vɔsamlekpui la kple eƒe dzidze.

english_verse: According to the official standards, the altar in the temple had the following measurements: Around the bottom of the altar was a gutter
translation_verse: Vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzidze enye si le abɔklugui nu; abɔklugui ɖeka tsɔ asi ƒe kekeme wu abɔklugui hahoo tɔ: Eƒe zɔ kɔ abɔklugui ɖeka, eye wòkeke abɔklugui ɖeka; woɖo to nɛ ƒo xlãe wòkeke asi ɖeka. Vɔsamlekpui la ƒe kɔkɔme enye si:

english_verse: Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adre sɔŋ natsɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsa ƒe gbɔ̃tsu, nyitsuvi kple agbo tso alẽwo dome asa vɔe; nu megawɔ wo hafi woatsɔ asa vɔ lae o.

english_verse: The altar rested on a base and had three sections, each one of them square. The bottom section was
translation_verse: Kɔawo didi abɔklugui wuiene, eye wokeke abɔklugui wuiene le woƒe go eneawo; to, si woɖo nɛ ƒo xlãe la, le abɔklugui afã, eye eƒe zɔ la le abɔklugui ɖeka godoo va kpe. Eƒe atrakpuifɔflɔwo dze ŋgɔ ɣetodoƒe gome.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amevi, ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Vɔsamlekpui la ƒe ɖoɖowo nye esi: Ne wowɔe vɔ, be woasa numevɔ le edzi, eye woawu ʋu ɖe edzi la,

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: ekema natsɔ nyitsuvi ɖeka na nunɔla, siwo nye Lewi-viwo, amesiwo tso Zadok-viwo dome, eye wokpɔ mɔ ate ɖe ŋunye, ne woasubɔm la, be woatsɔ asa nuvɔ̃vɔe; Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Tsɔ eƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe sisi ɖe eƒe dzo eneawo kple eƒe kawo ƒe dzogoe eneawo kpakple to, si woɖo nɛ godoo va kpe la ŋu, eye nade nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eŋu alé avui.

english_verse: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.
translation_verse: Eye natsɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsu la aɖatɔ dzoe ɖe aƒe la ƒe teƒe, si woɖo ɖi le kɔkɔeƒe la godo la.

english_verse: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke eveagbe la natsɔ gbɔ̃tsu, si sɔ blibo la, asa nuvɔ̃vɔe, eye woatsɔe aɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le vɔsamlekpui la ŋuti, abe alesi wotsɔ nyitsu ɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eŋui ene.

english_verse: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them,
translation_verse: Ne èɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eŋu vɔ la, naɖe nyitsu, si sɔ blibo, kple agbo, si sɔ blibo, le alẽwo dome asa vɔe.

english_verse: and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: He wo va Yehowa ŋku me, eye nunɔlawo nawu dze ɖe edzi ahatsɔe asa numevɔe na Yehowa.

english_verse: The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adre sɔŋ woalé avu vɔsamlekpui la, woaklɔ eŋu, eye woakɔ eŋu.

english_verse: From then on, the priests will use this altar to offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices to ask my blessing. Then I will be pleased with the people of Israel. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eye ne wowu ŋkeke siawo nu vɔ la, ekema nunɔlawo nasa miaƒe numevɔwo kple miaƒe akpedavɔwo tso ŋkeke enyilia dzi heyii, eye miaƒe nu adze ŋunye. Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The man took me back to the outer courtyard, near the east gate of the temple area. I saw that the doors to this gate were closed.
translation_verse: Tete wògbugbɔm va kɔkɔeƒe ƒe agbo kɔtoetɔ, si dze ŋgɔ ɣedzeƒe gome la nu; ke ele dodo.

english_verse: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Agbo sia netsi dodo, womaʋui o, eye amea ɖeke mato enu age ɖe eme o; esi wònye Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, to enu ge ɖe eme la, eyata netsi dodo.

english_verse: The ruler of Israel may come here to eat a sacrificial meal that has been offered to me, but he must use only the entrance room of this gate. People Who Are Not Allowed in the Temple
translation_verse: Ke amegã la nebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe eme, ne wòaɖu nu le Yehowa ŋku me. Agbo la ƒe akpata ƒe axa dzi wòato ava eme, eye afima ke wòato ado go.

english_verse: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I saw that the brightness of the Lord's glory had filled the temple, and I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Emegbe wòkplɔm to anyiehegbo la nu yi gbedoxɔ la nu, eye mekpɔ be, Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ya Yehowa ƒe xɔ la taŋ; tete metsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to give you the laws for my temple. So pay attention and listen carefully to what kind of people are allowed to come in the temple, and what kind are not.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Amevi, ɖo ŋku anyi nakpɔ nu kple ŋku, eye nase nya, siwo katã gblɔ ge mala na wò le Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe ɖoɖowo katã kple sewo katã ŋu la, kple wò to; lé ŋku ɖe afisi woato age ɖe aƒe la me kple kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe afisiwo katã woato ado la ŋu.

english_verse: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!
translation_verse: Eye gblɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe sẽto la bena: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Israel ƒe aƒe, míaƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã do ɖoɖo,

english_verse: My temple has been disgraced, because you have let godless, stubborn foreigners come here when sacrifices are being offered to me. You have sinned and have broken our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: elabena miekplɔ amedzro, siwo nye bolotɔwo, eye wometso dziʋa hã na wo o la vɛ, be woanɔ nye kɔkɔeƒe la, eye woagblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye aƒe la; eye mietu nye nubabla la hekpe ɖe miaƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã ŋu, le esime mietsɔ nye nuɖuɖu, ami kple ʋu sa vɔe,

english_verse: Instead of following the proper ways to worship me, you have put foreigners in charge of worship at my temple.
translation_verse: eye miewɔ nye kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe dowo o, ke boŋ mieɖo woawo, be woasubɔ le nye kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: And so I, the Lord God, say that no godless foreigner who disobeys me will be allowed in my temple. This includes any foreigner living in Israel. The Levites Are Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Amedzro, siwo nye bolotɔwo, wometso dziʋa hã na wo o, amedzro, siwo katã le Israel-viwo dome la dometɔa ɖeke megava nye kɔkɔeƒe la o;

english_verse: Some of the Levites turned their backs on me and joined the other people of Israel in worshiping idols. So these Levites must be punished!
translation_verse: ke boŋ Lewi-vi, siwo trɔ le yonyeme, esime Israel tra mɔ, eye wòdzo le gbɔnye hedze legbawo yome la ƒe vodadawo anɔ wo dzi;

english_verse: They will still be allowed to serve me as temple workers by guarding the gates and by killing the animals to be sacrificed and by helping the worshipers.
translation_verse: eye woanye aƒe la ƒe agbonudzɔlawo le nye kɔkɔeƒe la, eye woasubɔ le aƒe la me; Woawu numevɔsalã kple akpedavɔsalã na dukɔ la, eye woatsi tre ɖe wo gbɔ asubɔ wo.

english_verse: But because these Levites served the people of Israel when they worshiped idols, I, the Lord God, promise that the Levites will be punished. They did not stop the Israelites from sinning,
translation_verse: Esi wosubɔ wo le woƒe legbawo ŋku me, eye wokplɔ Israel ƒe aƒe la de vodada me la, eyata mekɔ nye asi dzi ɖe wo ŋu, ka atam bena: Ne womatsɔ woƒe vodadawo o fi! Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: and now I will no longer let the Levites serve as my priests or come near anything sacred to me. They must suffer shame and disgrace for their disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Womate ɖe ŋunye anye nunɔlawo asubɔm o, eye womate ɖe nye nu kɔkɔewo katã, siwo nye nu kɔkɔetɔwo la ŋu o, ke boŋ woatso woƒe ŋukpe kple ŋunyɔnu, siwo wowɔ la.

english_verse: They will be responsible for all the hard work that must be done in the temple. Rules for Priests The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye matsɔ wo aɖo aƒe la ƒe subɔlawo hena eƒe subɔsubɔdɔwo katã kple dɔ, siwo katã wowɔna le eme.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe who are descendants of Zadok the priest were faithful to me, even when the rest of the Israelites turned away. And so, these priests will continue to serve as my priests and to offer the fat and the blood of sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔla, siwo nye Lewi-viwo, amesiwo tso Zadok-viwo dome, eye wosubɔ le nye kɔkɔeƒe la me, esime Israel-viwo trɔ le yonyeme la, woawo nete ɖe ŋunye, ne woasubɔm, eye woatsi tre ɖe ŋkunye me, ne woatsɔ ami kple ʋu asa vɔ̃e nam, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: They will come into my temple, where they will offer sacrifices at my altar and lead others in worship.
translation_verse: Woawo neyi nye kɔkɔeƒe la, eye woate de nye kplɔ ŋu, ne woasubɔm, eye woawɔ nye subɔsubɔdɔwo.

english_verse: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.
translation_verse: Ne wobe, yewoage ɖe xɔxɔnu metɔ ƒe agbo me la, woaɖo aklalawuwo; lãfuvɔa ɖeke megana wo ŋu, ne wole subɔsubɔm le xɔxɔnu metɔ ƒe agbowo me kple xɔ la me o.

english_verse: Even their turbans and underwear must be made of linen to keep my priests from sweating when they work.
translation_verse: Aklalatablanu nenɔ la na wo, eye woaɖo aklalagbotɛ ɖe ali; womegatsɔ nusi woa fifia ame la, bia ali dzi o.

english_verse: And before they leave to join the other people in the outer courtyard, they must take off their priestly clothes, then place them in the sacred rooms and put on their regular clothes. That way, no one will touch their sacred clothes and be harmed.
translation_verse: Ne wole dodo ge ayi dukɔ la gbɔ le xɔxɔnu kɔtoetɔ la, woaɖe woƒe awu, siwo wodo subɔ la, ɖe xɔvi kɔkɔeawo me, eye woado awu bubuwo, ne womagatsɔ woƒe awuwo ana dukɔ la ŋu nakɔ o.

english_verse: Priests must never shave their heads when they are mourning. But they must keep their hair properly trimmed and not let it grow too long.
translation_verse: Womegalũ ta kokoe o, ke womegana woƒe taɖa nato ʋuya o, ke boŋ woako ta wòasɔ.

english_verse: They must not drink wine before going to the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa ɖeke megano wein, ne ele xɔxɔnu metɔ yi ge o.

english_verse: A priest must not marry a divorced woman; he can marry only a virgin from Israel or the widow of another priest.
translation_verse: Womaɖe ahosi alo nyɔnu, si wogbe la o, ke boŋ woaɖe ɖetugbi tso Israel ƒe aƒe ƒe ƒome la me; ke wokpɔ mɔ aɖe nunɔlawo ƒe ahosi.

english_verse: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.
translation_verse: Woafia vovo, si le nu kɔkɔe kple nu makɔmakɔ dome, kpakple vovo, si le nu madzamadza kple nu dzadzɛ dome la, nye dukɔ.

english_verse: They will make decisions in difficult legal cases, according to my own laws. They must also observe the religious festivals my Law requires and must always respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Woabɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe dzrenyawo ŋu, eye woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu; woalé ŋku ɖe nye sewo, nye ɖoɖowo kple nye ŋkekenyuiewo katã ŋu, eye woakɔ nye dzudzɔgbe la ŋuti.

english_verse: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.
translation_verse: Womegayi ame kuku gbɔ, ne woagblẽ kɔ ɖo na wo ɖokui o; negbe wo fofo kple wo dada, wo viŋutsu kple wo vinyɔnu, wo nɔviŋutsu kple wo nɔvinyɔnu, si meɖe srɔ̃ o la ŋu ko wokpɔ mo agblẽ kɔ ɖo le.

english_verse: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: eye gbesigbe wòyi xɔxɔnu metɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la, be yeasubɔ le kɔkɔeƒea la, nesa nuvɔ̃vɔ, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.
translation_verse: Woƒe domenyinu enye si. Nye ŋutɔe nye woƒe domenyinu; migana gomea ɖeke wo le Israel o, nye ŋutɔe nye woƒe gome.

english_verse: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.
translation_verse: Lã kukuwo katã kple lã, siwo nu lé, eɖanye xe alo lãfɔnee o la, nunɔlawo mekpɔ mo aɖui o.

english_verse: So from now on, you must use honest weights and measures.
translation_verse: Nudanu sɔsɔe, efa kple bat sɔsɔe nenɔ mia si.

english_verse: kilometers wide. This will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem. Land for Israel's Ruler The Lord said:
translation_verse: Teƒe sia, si didi abɔklugui akpe blave vo atɔ̃, eye wòkeke abɔklugui akpe ewo la dzi kɔkɔeƒe, si nye kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la, nanɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: You leaders of Israel have cheated and abused my people long enough! I want you to stop sinning and start doing what is right and fair. You must never again force my people off their own land. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Israel-amegãwo, esɔ gbɔ na mi azɔ! Miɖe asi te ameteteɖeanyi kple ŋutasesẽ ŋu; miwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe kple nusi le eteƒe, eye midzudzɔ adzodada nye dukɔ; Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The ephah will be the standard dry measure, and the bath will be the standard liquid measure. Their size will be based on the homer, which will equal ten ephahs or ten baths.
translation_verse: Efa kple bat nesɔ kple wo nɔewo, ale be xomer ewoliawo ɖeka nanye bat ɖeka, eye efa ɖeka nanye xomer ewolia ɖeka; xomer nu nudonuiwo nanɔ ɖo.

english_verse: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.
translation_verse: Alea nawɔ le dzinu adrelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi ɖe amesiwo ɖe ŋu ɖi alo wɔ nu le manyamanya me la ta, ne mialé avu na aƒe la.

english_verse: Leaders of Israel, the people must bring you one sixtieth of their grain harvests as offerings to me.
translation_verse: Adzɔ, si miana, enye si; Woaɖe lu efa ƒe adeliawo ɖeka le xomer ɖeka ŋu, eye woaɖe ƒo eta ƒe adeliawo ɖeka le xomer ɖeka ŋu.

english_verse: They will also bring one percent of their olive oil. These things will be measured according to the bath, and ten baths is the same as one homer or one cor.
translation_verse: Ami, si miana la, enye si: Woaɖe bat ewolia ɖeka le kor ɖeka ŋu; kor enye bat ewo, eye wòsɔ kple xomer ɖeka; elabena bat ewo enye xomer ɖeka.

english_verse: The people of Israel will bring you these offerings.
translation_verse: Dukɔ hahoo la katã natsɔ adzɔ siawo vɛ na Israel-amegã la.

english_verse: But during New Moon Festivals, Sabbath celebrations, and other religious feasts, you leaders will be responsible for providing animals for the sacrifices, as well as the grain and wine. All these will be used for the sacrifices for sin, the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices to please me, and those to ask my blessing. I will be pleased and will forgive the sins of my people. The Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Amegã la si me numevɔsa, nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa le ŋkekenyuiewo dzi, le dzinu yeyewo kple dzudzɔgbewo dzi, kpakple le Israel ƒe takpegbewo katã nanɔ, eya ana woasa nuvɔ̃vɔ, nuɖuvɔ, numevɔ kple akpedavɔ, ne woalé avu na Israel ƒe aƒe la. Numeme ŋu se.

english_verse: Each day of the festival he is to bring seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifices to please me, and he must bring a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Le ŋkekenyuie la ƒe ŋkeke adreawo me la wòana woatsɔ nyitsu adre kple agbo adre, siwo so blibo la, asa numevɔe na Yehowa gbesiagbe, eye woatso gbɔ̃tsu ɖekaɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔe gbesiagbe.

english_verse: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la nate nyitsuvi, si sɔ blibo la, eye natsɔ aɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le kɔkɔeƒe lã ŋu.

english_verse: The priest will take some blood from this sacrifice and smear it on the doorposts of the temple, as well as on the four corners of the altar and on the doorposts of the gates that lead into the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla natsɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsalã ƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe asisi ɖe xɔ la ƒe ʋɔtrutiwo kple vɔsamlekpui la ƒe kawo ƒe dzogoe eneawo kple xɔxɔnu metɔ ƒe ʋɔtrutiwo ŋu.

english_verse: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Le dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke wuienelia dzi la miaɖu ŋutitoto-ŋkekenyuie; miaɖui ŋkeke adre sɔŋ, eye woaɖu abolo maʋãmaʋã.

english_verse: On the first day, the ruler will bring a bull to offer as a sacrifice for his sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe amegã la nana woatsɔ nyitsu ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔ ɖe eya ŋutɔ kple dukɔ hahoo la ta.

english_verse: He will also provide nine kilograms of grain and three liters of olive oil to be offered with each bull and each ram.
translation_verse: Eye woatso nuɖuvɔsa efa ɖeka akpe ɖe nyitsu ɖeka ŋu, eye efa ɖeka nakpe ɖe agbo ɖeka ŋu, eye ami hin ɖeka nanɔ efa ɖeka ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord said: The east gate of the inner courtyard must remain closed during the six working days of each week. But on the Sabbath and on the first day of the month, this gate will be opened.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Xɔxɔnu metɔ ƒe agbo, si dze ŋgɔ ɣedzeƒe la, nano dodo le gbedzrogbe-ŋkeke adeawo dzi, ke woaʋui le dzudzɔgbe kple dzinu yeye dzi.

english_verse: Israel's ruler will go from the outer courtyard into the entrance room of this gate and stand in the doorway while the priest offers sacrifices to ask my blessing and sacrifices to please me. The ruler will bow with his face to the ground to show that he has worshiped me. Then he will leave, and the gate will remain open until evening.
translation_verse: Amegã la nato agba la ƒe akpata nu le gota gome age ɖe eme ahatsi tre ɖe agbo la ƒe ʋɔtruti ŋu, eye ne nunɔlawo le eƒe numevɔ kple akpedavɔ sam la, wòano gbe dom ɖa le agbo la ƒe agbali nu, emegbe wòadzo; ke womegado agbo la vaseɖe fiẽ o.

english_verse: Each Sabbath and on the first day of each month, the people of Israel must also come to the east gate and worship me.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ hahoo la nanɔ gbe dom ɖe le agbo ma nu le Yehowa ŋku me le dzudzɔgbewo kple dzinu yeyewo dzi.

english_verse: On the Sabbath, the ruler will bring six lambs and one ram to be offered as sacrifices to please me. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Numevɔ, si amegã la nasa na Yehowa le dzudzɔgbe enye: Alẽvi ade, siwo so blibo, kple agbo ɖeka, si sɔ blibo;

english_verse: With the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: nuɖuvɔsa efa ɖeka nakpe ɖe agbo la ŋu, eye nuɖuvɔsa, si wòate ŋu ana, nakpe ɖe alẽviawo ŋu, eye ami hin ɖeka nanɔ efa ɖeka ŋu.

english_verse: The ruler is to bring six lambs, a bull, and a ram to be offered as sacrifices at the New Moon Festival. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Dzinu yeye la tɔ nanye nyitsuvi ɖeka, si sɔ blibo, kple alẽvi ade kpakple agbo ɖeka, siwo sɔ blibo.

english_verse: With the bull and the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Wòatsɔ nuɖuvɔsa efa ɖeka akpe ɖe nyitsu la ŋu kple efa ɖeka akpe ɖe agbo la ŋu, ke wòakpe alesi nu woate ŋu ana la, ɖe alẽviawo ŋu, eye ami hin ɖeka nanɔ efa ɖeka ŋu.

english_verse: The ruler must come through the entrance room of the east gate and leave the same way.
translation_verse: Ne amegã la be, yeage ɖe eme la, neto agbo la ƒe akpata nu yi eme, eye wòato mɔ ma ke ado.

english_verse: When my people come to worship me during any festival, they must always leave by the opposite gate from which they came: Those who come in the north gate must leave by the south gate, and those who come in the south gate must leave by the north gate.
translation_verse: Eye ne dukɔ hahoo la va Yehowa ŋku me le ŋkekenyuiewo dzi la, ekema amesi to anyiehe-gbo nu ge ɖe eme be yeado gbe ɖa la, neto dziehe-gbo nu do, eye amesi to dziehe-gbo nu ge ɖe eme la, neto anyiehe-gbo nu ɖo; amea ɖeke megagbugbɔ to agbo, si nu wòto ge ɖe eme la o, ke boŋ neɖo la ŋgɔ tẽ, ne wòado go.

english_verse: Their ruler will come in at the same time they do and leave at the same time they leave.
translation_verse: Amegã la nenɔ wo dome, ne wova eme, eye ne wode la, wòado kpli wo.

english_verse: At all other festivals and celebrations, nine kilograms of grain will be offered with a bull, and nine kilograms will be offered with a ram.
