english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: Eye mede gbe ɖa na Yehowa, nye Mawu, heʋu nuvɔ̃ me gblɔ bena; Ao, Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ga dziŋɔ, amesi dzraa nubabla kple amenuveve ɖo na amesiwo lɔ̃nɛ, eye woléa eƒe sewo me ɖe asi!

english_verse: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Míewɔ nuvɔ̃, míeda ƒu, eye míewɔ nu tovo, miese to, eye míeƒo asa na wò sewo kple wò ɖoɖowo.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Míegbe toɖoɖo wò dɔla nyagblɔɖilawo, amesiwo ƒo nu le wò ŋkɔ me na míaƒe fiawo, míaƒe amegãwo, mía fofowo kple dukɔ hahoo la katã.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: Ke nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple tsɔtsɔke le Aƒelɔ, mía Mawu la si; elabena míese to ɖe eŋu,

english_verse: and rejected your teachings that came to us from your servants the prophets.
translation_verse: míese Yehowa, mía Mawu la ƒe gbe, ne míazɔ de eƒe nufiame, siwo wode asi na mí to eƒe dɔla nyagblɔɖilawo dzi la nu o.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel has stubbornly refused to obey your laws, and so those curses written by your servant Moses have fallen upon us.
translation_verse: Israel blibo la da wò nufiamewo dzi, eye wòle de aga hegbe wò gbesese, eyata fiƒode kple atam, siwo woŋlɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe dɔla Mose ƒe sea me la, va mía dzi, elabena míewɔ nuvɔ̃ de eŋu.

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ eƒe nya, si wògblɔ ɖe mía kple míaƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, siwo drɔ̃ ʋɔnu mí ŋu la dzi, be yeahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e, si meva me le dziƒo blibo la te kpɔ o la, ava mia dzii, abe alesi wodzɔ ɖe Yerusalem dzii ene.

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo katã va mía dzi, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖe Mose ƒe sea me ene; ke míeƒo koko na Yehowa, mía Mawu la, ne míaɖe asi le míaƒe vodadawo ŋu, eye míalé ŋku ɖe eƒe nyateƒe ŋu o.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe ŋku nɔ te ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e la ŋu, eye wòhee va mía dzi, elabena Yehowa, mía Mawu tɔ dzɔ le nusiwo katã wòwɔ la me; ke míawo míegbe toɖoɖo eƒe gbe.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Azɔ Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu, wò amesi tsɔ alɔ sesẽ kplɔ wò dukɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye nède ŋkɔ ɖokuiwò ŋu, abe alesi wòle egbe siawo ene, míewɔ nuvɔ̃, eye míewɔ nu tovo.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò dɔmedzoe kple wò dziku nedzo ɖa le wò ɖu Yerusalem, wò to kɔkɔe la ŋu le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye blibo la ta; elabena miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple mía fofowo ƒe vodadawo ta Yerusalem kple wò dukɔ la zu alɔmeɖenu na amesiwo katã ƒo xlã mí la ɖo.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Eyata, mía Mawu, se wò dɔla ƒe gbedodoɖa kple eƒe kokoƒoƒo la, eye nana wò ŋku me naklẽ de wò kɔkɔeƒe, si zu aƒedo la dzi; elabena wòe nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, see! Aƒetɔ, tsɔe ke! Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋku anyi nawɔ nu, eye megahe ɖe megbe o, le wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ta, nye Mawu! Elabena wò ŋkɔe woyɔ ɖe wò du la kple wò dukɔ la ŋu. Mawu ƒe ɖeɖefia le kwasiɖa blaadrea wo ŋuti.

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: Esi megale nuƒoƒo dzi, mele gbe dom ɖa, mele nye nuvɔ̃wo kple nye dukɔ Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃wo me ʋum, eye mebɔbɔ ɖokuinye ɖe anyi le koko ƒom na Yehowa, nye Mawu la, ɖe nye Mawu ƒe to kɔkɔe la ta,

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: esi megale gbe dom ɖa la, ŋutsu Gabriel, si mekpɔ le ŋutega me tsã la, dzo va gbɔnye le flẽvɔsaɣi.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: Efia num gblɔ bena: Daniel, ɖe meva be, mafia nu wò.

english_verse: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
translation_verse: Esi nèdze kokoƒoƒo gɔme la, nyaa de tso Mawu gbɔ, eye meva, be magblɔe na wò, elabena wolɔ̃ wò; eyata lé to ɖe nya la ŋu, eye nalé to ɖe ŋutega la hã ŋu.

english_verse: You need to realize that from the command to rebuild Jerusalem until the coming of the Chosen Leader, it will be
translation_verse: Azɔ nyae, eye naƒu to anyi: Tso ɣeyiɣi, si woɖe se be, woagatso Yerusalem vaseɖe amegã, si wosi ami na dzi la, le kwasiɖa aɖre; eye woatsɔ kwiasiɖa blaade vɔ eve atso ablɔwo kple kpɔɖomeewo le xaxaɣi.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Abla nu sesẽ kple ame geɖewo kwasiɖa ɖeka, eye le kwasiɖa afã me la atsi akpeɖavɔsa kple nuɖuvɔsa nu, eye ŋunyɔ, si mele gbɔgblɔ me o la, axɔ ɖe wo teƒe vaseɖe nuwuwu, si woɖo; emegbe woatrɔ gbegblẽ aƒo ɖe nugblẽla dzi.

english_verse: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
translation_verse: Le Persia-fia Kores ƒe ƒe etɔ̃lia me la woɖe nyaa ɖe fia Daniel, amesi ŋkɔ nye Beltsazar; nya la nye nyateƒe kple nuxaxa gã; elé nya la ɖe ta me, eye wole ŋku ɖe ŋutega la ŋu.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi nye Daniel mexa nu kwasiɖa eta sɔŋ.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: Nyemeɖu nu vivia ɖeke o, la kple wein mede nu me nam o, eye nyemesi ami hã o, vaseɖe esime kwasiɖa etɔ̃awo ɖe.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Le dzinu gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke blave vɔ enelia dzi la menɔ Xidekel tɔsisi gã la te

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: Eye esi mefɔ kɔ dzi ɖo ŋku anyi la, kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsua ɖe le awu ɣi me, eye sika nyuliɔ ƒe alidziblanu le ali nɛ.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: Eŋuti ɖi adzagba, eƒe mo le abe dzikedzo ene, eye eƒe ŋkutvo ɖi akakati, eƒe abɔwo kple afɔwo le abe ayawa, si le dzo dam ene, eye eƒe nuƒoƒo ƒe ɖiɖi le abe amehawo ƒe hoowɔwɔ ene.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: Nye Daniel ɖeɖekoe kpɔ ŋutega sia, ŋutsu, siwo le ŋunye la, mekpɔ ŋutega lã o, ke boŋ ŋɔdzi gãa ɖe lé wo, eye wosi, be woaɣla wo ɖokui.

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: Tete mese eƒe nuƒoƒo ƒe ɖiɖi; eye esi mese eƒe nuƒoƒo ƒe ɖiɖi la, ŋuzi tsɔm me tsyɔ mo anyi hetsɔ ŋku me bu anyigba.

english_verse: He raised me to my hands and knees
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, asia ɖe va ka ŋunye, eye wòfɔm ɖe nye klo kple asi dzi.

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Wò Daniel, ame malɔ̃nugbɔa, lé to ɖe nya, si gblɔ ge, mala na wò la ŋu, eye natsi tre: ɖe tewòƒe, elabena azɔ wodɔm ɖe gbɔwò! Eye esi wògblɔ nya sia nam le metsi tre ɖi hele dzodzom nyanyanya.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Daniel, megavɔ̃ o, elabena tso gbesigbe nẽdi tso dzi me be, yease nya gɔme, eye nètsi nu ɖɔ le wò Mawu ŋku me la, wose wò nyawo, eye wò nyawo, dzi mezɔ do va.

english_verse: I will tell you what is written in The Book of Truth. But first, you must realize that no one except Michael, the guardian angel of Israel, is on my side.
translation_verse: Ke magblɔ nusi woŋlɔ ɖe nyateƒe-gbalẽ me la, na wò; amea ɖeke made dzinye ɖe wo ŋu o, negbe mlaƒe amegã Mixael ko.

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: Eye meva, be magblɔ nusi gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe wò dukɔ dzi emegbe la afia wò, elabena gbaɖegbe ŋu ŋutega la le ɖo.

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: Eye esi wògblɔ nya siawo nam la, meɖe kɔ to, eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖem.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Eye nɔnɔmea ɖe, si ɖi amegbetɔvi la, ka asi nye nuyi ŋu, tete nye nu nu meƒo nu gblɔ na amesi tsi tre ɖe ŋgɔnye la bena: Nye Aƒetɔ, ŋutega la na dzidzi ƒom, eye ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: Aleke nye aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla ate ŋu aƒo nu kple ame abe wo, nye aƒetɔ, ene? Elabena azɔ ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye, eye gbɔgbɔa ɖeke megale menye o.

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: hegblɔ bena: Ame malɔ̃nugbɔa, megavɔ̃ o, ŋuwò nefa, sẽ ŋu, eye nalé dzi de ƒo! Eye esi wòƒo nu kplim, la, agbe do ŋunye, megblɔ bena: Nye aƒetɔ neƒo nu, elabena èdo ŋusẽm!

english_verse: Then the angel said: Now do you understand why I have come? Soon I must leave to fight against the guardian angel of Persia. Then after I have defeated him, the guardian angel of Greece will attack me.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ bena: Enye nusi ta meva gbɔwò doa? Azɔ magbugbɔ aɖawɔ ana kple Persia-amegã, eye ne medze la, ekema Hela-amegã le vava ge.

english_verse: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
translation_verse: Elabena makpe ɖe eŋu, ne manye xɔnamelɔ kple sitsoƒe nɛ le Mediatɔ Dario ƒe ƒe gbãtɔ me.

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ mato nyateƒe la na wò. Kpɔ ɖa, fia etɔ̃ le dzɔdzɔ ge le Persia, eye enelia akpa ho ŋutɔ wu bubuawo katã; ne ŋusẽ ɖo eŋu la, atsɔ kesinɔnu ado adã bubuawo katã ɖe Hela-fiaɖuƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: Eye fia sẽŋua ɖe ado ahatsɔ ŋusẽ gã aɖu dzii, eye wòawo nusi dze eŋu.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ne enya do ko la, woagbã eƒe fiaɖuƒe la, eye woamãe ɖe dziƒo ƒe ya eneawo dzi, menye na eƒe dzidzimeviwo o, eye menye ɖe ŋusẽ, si wòtsɔ ɖu dzii la nu o; ke hoŋ woagbã eƒe fiaɖuƒe la atsɔ na ame bubuwo, eye menye na woawo o.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ aɖo dziehefia ŋu, eye eƒe aʋafiawo dometɔ ɖeka akpɔ ŋusẽ wu eyama, aɖu fia, eye eƒe fiaɖuƒe alolo.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Le ƒea ɖewo megbe la woaɖu dzo kple wo nɔewo, eye dziehefia ƒe vinyɔnu ayi anyiebefia gbɔ, ne wòaɖe ŋutifafa aƒe; ke ŋusẽ manɔ eƒe alɔ ŋu o, eye eya kple eƒe alɔ mali ke o, ke boŋ woatsɔ eya kple amesiwo kplɔe ɖo, kple edzila kpakple eƒe dzoɖuxɔlɔ̃ aɖe asi le ɣemaɣi.

english_verse: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
translation_verse: Ke alɔ adze atso eƒe ke me ɖe eteƒe; aho aʋa ahage ɖe anyiehefia ƒe mɔ̃ sesẽwo me, awɔ nu kple wo, eye wòaɖu dzi.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: Aɖe aboyo woƒe mawuwo kple legba kɔkɔwo kpakple nu vevi, siwo wotsɔ klosalo kple sika wɔe la, ayi Egipte, eye wòadzudzɔ nuwɔwɔ kple anyiehefia ƒea ɖewo.

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: Aƒo ɖe dziehefia ƒe fiaɖuƒe dzi, ke agagbugbɔ ayi eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: Viawo adze aʋa gɔme, eye woaƒo aoakɔ gãa ɖe nu ƒu fu, woava aƒo ɖe anyi ahagbagba ɖi, eye woagawɔ aʋa kplii vaseɖe eƒe mɔ sesẽwo gbɔ.

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: Dziehefia anyrã, eye wòaho ãɖawɔ aʋa kple anyiehefia, atsɔ aʋakɔ gãa ɖe adze aʋa ɖe eŋu, eye woatsɔ aʋakɔawo aɖe asi nɛ.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Ne aʋakɔawo ho la, eƒe dzi ado eɖokui de dzi, atsrɔ̃ ame akpe nanewo, ke maɖu dzi o.

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: Elabena anyiehefia agaƒo aʋakɔ nu ƒu wòalolo wu gbãlɔ, eye le ƒea ɖewo megbe la ava kple aʋakɔ gã kple aʋawɔnu gede.

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la ame geɖewo atso de dziehefia ŋu, eye mia devi sẽŋutawo atso, be woano ŋutega la nava me, ke woadze anyi.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Anyiehefia ava aƒu kpo, eye wòaxɔ du sesẽ la; dzieheʋakɔ manɔ te o, eye eƒe ame tiatiawo mate ŋu ana te o.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Amesi ho ɖe eŋu la, awɔ nu alesi dze eŋu, eye amea ɖeke manɔ te ɖe enu o; ava tɔ ɖe anyigba nyo la dzi, eye eƒe asi agblẽ nu.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: Ado ta me be, yeatsɔ yeƒe fiaɖuƒe blibo la ƒe aʋakɔwo vɛ; eye wòaɖu dzo kplii ahatsɔ vianyɔnu nɛ wòaɖe, ne wòagblẽ anyigba la; ke mava me o, eye medze edzi nɛ o.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Atrɔ ɖe ƒukpewo ŋu, eye wòaxɔ geɖewo; ke aʋafiaa ɖe atsi eƒe vloɖoame la nu, eye magado vloe azɔ o.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Atrɔ ɖe eƒe anyigba ƒe mɔ̃ sesẽwo ŋu, ke aɖe goglomi adze anyi, eye womagakpɔe azɔ o.

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: Emegbe amea ɖe axɔ ɖe ete ƒe, eye wòana nudzɔdzɔxɔlawo natsa le fiaɖuƒe nyo la me; ke woawui le ŋkekea ɖewo megbe, menye le ɖɔmedzoe kple aʋa me o.

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: Ame ɖigbɔa ɖe axɔ ɖe efeƒe, amesi ŋu womeɖo fiaɖuƒe la ƒe atsyɔ̃ ɖo o, ke aƒo ɖe anyi le vo me, eye wòatsa numevivinyawo axɔ fiaɖuɖu lae.

english_verse: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.
translation_verse: Akplɔ̃ aʋakɔ, siwo gbagba ɖi bibibi la, adzoe abe tɔsisi ene, eye wòatsrɔ̃ wo hekpe ɖe nubabla la ƒe amegã hã ŋu.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: Ne woɖu dzo kplii hã la, awɔ nu ɖe alakpa me, eye wòaho atsɔ ame ʋeea ɖewo aɖu dzii,

english_verse: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
translation_verse: Aƒo ɖe anyigba la ƒe teƒe wɔnuwo le vo me, eye wòawɔ nusi fofoawo; kple tɔgbulawo mewɔ o, ama aboyonu, nuhaha kple kesinɔnu na wo, eye wòaɖo la me ɖe mɔ̃ sesẽwo ŋu ɣeyiɣia ɖewo.

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: Atso, aʋakɔ ga ado adã eƒe ŋusẽ kple dzi eteƒe nadidi ʋee, eye dziehefia atsɔ aʋakɔ gã, si teƒe mekɔ o la, aho aʋa de eŋu, ke manɔ te o, elabena woɖo nugbe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Amesiwo ɖua nu le eƒe agba nu la, awui, woakplɔ eƒe aʋakɔ adzoe abe tɔsisi ene, eye ame geɖewo atsi aʋa.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Fia eveawo aɖo ta me ɖe gbegblẽ ŋu, eye woagblɔ alakpanya le kplɔ̃ ɖeka ŋu, ke madze edzi na wo o, elabena ɣeyiɣi woɖo na nuwuwu la.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Atsɔ kesinɔnu geɖe atrɔ yi eƒe anyigba dzi; atsɔ eƒe tame edo nubabla kɔkɔe la ŋu, eye ne ewɔe vɔ la, alrɔ yi eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: Le ɣeyiɣi, si woɖo dzi la, agava ƒo ɖe dziehe-nyigba dzi, ke zi evelia manɔ abe zi gbãtɔ ene o.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Elabena Kititɔwo ƒe ʋuwo aho ɖe eŋu, dzi aɖe le eƒo, eye wòatrɔ ahado dziku ɖe nubabla kɔkɔe la ŋu, eye wòawɔe aɖe goe; eye ne etrɔ yi aƒe la, atsɔ ŋku aɖo amesiwo gblẽ nubabla kɔkɔea ɖi la ŋuti.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Aɖo aʋakɔ ɖa, wòava gblẽ kɔ ɖo na mɔ̃ sesẽ kɔkɔe la, woatsi gbesiagbe vɔsa nu, eye woaɖo ŋunyɔnu, si teƒe mekɔ o la anyi.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Atsɔ numevivi able amesiwo to vo ɖe nubablaa ŋu la nui; ke amesiwo dze si woƒe Mawu la, alé dzi ɖe ƒo awɔ nu ade goe.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Dukɔ la ƒe ame nyanuwo afia nunya ame geɖewo; eye woatsi yi, dzo, gaxɔ kple nuxaxa si me eteƒe nadidi ʋee.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Le woƒe alɔ ƒe toyiyi me la woaxɔ na wo vie, eye ame geɖewo atsɔ numevivi aku ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo dometɔa ɖewo atsi aʋa ne woado wo akpɔ kple dzo, woakɔ wo ŋuti, ne wo me nadza vaseɖe nuwuɣi, si wodo ɖi la.

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: Fia la awɔ nusi dze eŋu, ado eɖokui ɖe dzi, eye wòatɔ asi akɔ ɖe mawu sia mawu ŋu, agblɔ ɖiŋudonyawo ɖe mawuwo dzi Mawu la ŋu, eye wòadze edzi nɛ, vaseɖe esime dziku la nu natso, elabena wole nusi woɖo la wó ge.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Malé ŋku de fofoawo ƒe mawuwo ŋu o, eye malé ŋku de nyɔnuwo ƒe nu malɔ̃nugbɔa kple mawu sia mawu ŋu o, ke boŋ atɔ asi akɔ ɖe nusianu ŋu.

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: Asuhɔ mawu, si le mɔ sesẽwo me la, ɖe wo teƒe, eye wòatsɔ sika kple klosalo, kpe xɔesiwo kple nu veviwo asubɔ mawu, si fofoawo menya o.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: Atsɔ mawu tutɔ ƒe dukɔ ade ma sesẽwo me; ade bubu gã amesiwo xɔ ɖe edzi la ŋu, atsɔ wo aɖo amegã ɖe ame geɖewo nu, eye wòamã anyigba woanye fetu na wo.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: Le nuwuɣi la dziehefia akpe kplii; anyiehefia atsɔ tasiaɖamwo sɔɖolawo kple ʋu geɖewo aho ɖe eŋu, eye woava aƒo ɖe anyigbawo dzi bibibi.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: Ava anyigba nyo la dzi, eye ame nanewo atsi aʋa; ke Edom, Moab kple Amon-viwo ƒe ame ŋkutawo asi le enu.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: Ado eƒe asi ɖa ɖe anyigbawo ŋu, eye womaɖe Egipte-nyigba o.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Egipte ƒe sikanuwo kple klosalonuwo kpakple nu veviwo katã anɔ esi me, eye Libitɔwo kple Kusitɔwo anɔ eye me.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Ase nya tso ɣedzeƒe kple anyiehe wòado ŋɔdzi nɛ, eye wòaho kple dziku gã, be wòagblẽ ame geɖewo atsrɔ wo.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: Atu eƒe fiasã ƒe agbadɔ ɖe atsyaƒu kple to kɔkɔe nyo la ɖome; ke eƒe nuwuwu aɖo, eye amea ɖeke maxɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Amesiwo le alo dɔm le anyigba ƒe ke mala dometɔ geɖewo anyɔ: woƒe ɖewo bena agbenɔnɔ mavɔmavɔ, eye bubuwo bena ŋukpe kple ŋunyɔ mavɔmavɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo aklẽ abe dziŋgɔli ƒe keklẽ ene, eye amesiwo fia dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ nu ame geɖewo la, abe dzinuviwo ene ɖaa tegbee.

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Ke wò Daniel, dzra nya siawo ɖo, eye natre agbalẽ la bu vaseɖe nuwuɣi; ame geɖewo adzro eme, eye sidzedze adzi ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: Eye nye Daniel mekpɔ ame bubu eve wole tsitre ɖi, ɖeka le tɔsisi la ƒe go si me, eye evelia le tɔsisi la ƒe go keme.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Eye wo ɖometɔ ɖeka gblɔ na ŋutsu, si le aklalawu me tsi tre ɖe tɔsisi la ƒe dzigbe gome bena; Ɣeka ɣie nu manyatanuwo ƒe nuwuwu la ase ɖo?

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: Tete mese amesi le aklalawu me tsi tre ɖe tɔsisia ƒe dzigbe gome la, kɔ ɖusi kple mia dzi hetà amesi le agbe tegbee la bena: Le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka, ɣeyiɣi eve kple ɣeyiɣi afã megbe, ne dukɔ kɔkɔe la ƒe akpa ɖeka kaka vɔ la, ekema nusiwo katã ava me.

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: Mesee, ke nyemese egɔme o, eye megblɔ bena; Nye aƒetɔ, nusiawo ƒe nuwuwu ɖe?

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena Daniel, heyi, elabena nya siawo le ɣaɣla, eye wotre wo nu vaseɖe nuwuɣi.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Woatia ame geɖewo, woakɔ wo ŋuti, eye woado wo akpɔ kple dzo; eme vɔ̃ɖiwo awɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi, eye eme vɔ̃ɖiwo katã mase egɔme o, ke nunyalawo ase egɔme.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who patiently waits until
translation_verse: Woayra amesi ɖo dzi, eye ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eta blaetɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃ ɖo ɖee la.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: Ke wò la heyi, vaseɖe esime nuwuwu naɖo, gbɔ ɖe eme, eye nafɔ le ŋkekeawo ƒe nuwuwu naxɔ wò gome.

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe gbe, si va na Hosea, Beeri vi, le Yuɖafiawo Uziya, Yotam, Axaz kple Xizkiya ŋɔli kpakple Israel-fia Yerobeam, Yoas vi ŋɔli.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.”
translation_verse: Esi Yehowa dze nuƒoƒo gome kple Hosea la, Yehowa gblɔ na Hosea bena: Yi naɖe gbolo, ne wòadzi ahasiviwo na wò; elabena anyigba la wɔ gbolo, eye wòtrɔ le Yehowa yome!

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Tete wòyi ɖaɖe Gomer, Diblayim ƒe vinyɔnu, eye wòfɔ tu dzi ŋutsuvi nɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nɛ bena: Tsa ŋkɔ nɛ be Yezreel; elabena ekpɔtɔ vie mahe to na Yezreel ƒe hlɔ̃dodo ɖe Yehu ƒe aƒe la ŋu, eye matsi Israel ƒe aƒe ƒe fiaɖuƒe la nu.

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la maŋe Israel ƒe dati le Yezreel-bali me la.

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: Eye wògafɔ fu dzi nyɔnuvi. Tete wógblɔ nɛ bena: Tsa ŋkɔ na be „Amemalɔ̃e,“ elabena nyemagakpɔ nublanui na Israel ƒe aƒe la atsɔe anɔ wo kem ɖaa o.

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Ke makpɔ nublanu: na Yuda ƒe aƒe la, eye maxa na wo to Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la dzi, menye dati, yi kple aʋawɔwɔ, sɔwo kple sɔdolawo matsɔ axa na wo o.

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Esi Amemalɔ̃e ɖi no nu la, egafɔ fu dzi ŋutsuvi.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Tsɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be „Manyenyedukɔe“, elabena menye nye dukɔ mienye o, eye nye hã nyemanye mia lɔ o.

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Israel-viwo ƒe xexlẽme anɔ abe ƒulake, sĩ mele dzidze kple xexlẽ me o la ene. Eye woava me be, woayɔ wo be „Mawu gbagbe viwo“, ɖe esi wogblɔ na wo he, Manyenyedukɔe mienye la teƒe.

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: Yuda-viwo kple Israel-viwo aƒo takpli, eye woaɖo tatɔ ɖeka na wo ɖokui aho aʋa atso anyigba la dzi; elabena Yezreel ƒe ŋkeke la teƒe mekɔ o.

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: ne magaɖe amae ana wòanɔ abe gbesigbe wòdzii ene, mana wòasɔ kple gbegbe, wòaɖi kuɖinyigba, eye mana tsikɔ nawui wòaku o.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Nyemakpɔ nublanui na viawo o, elabena ahasiviwo wonye.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: Elabena wo dada wɔ ahasi, eye wo nɔ wɔ ŋukpenanu; elabena egblɔhe: Madze nye ahiãviwo yome, woawoe tsɔa abolo kple tsi, ɖetifu kple anazi, ami kple nunono nam.

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Eyata metso ŋu atɔ kpɔ ɖe eƒe mɔ dzi, eye maɖo gli ɖe edzi, ale be magakpɔ etoƒe o.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Ati eƒe ahiãviwo yome, ke eƒe asi matu wo o; adi wo, ke makpɔ wo o; eye wòagblɔ be: Matso agbugbɔ yi srɔ̃nye tsãtɔ gbɔ, elabena eme nyo nam tsã wu fifia.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: Medze sii be, nyee na bli, wein kple ami, klosalo kple sika geɖe, siwo ŋu dɔ wòwɔ na Baal lae o.

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: Eyata ne azã ɖo edzi la, maɖe bli kple wein ɖa, eye maxɔ nye ɖeti kple nye anazi, si wòtsɔna xea eƒe amae la.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Maklo nu le eƒe ŋukpeƒe dzi le eƒe ahiãviwo ŋku me, eye amea ɖeke maxɔe le asinye me o.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: Magblẽ eƒe weinkawo kple aƒe gbotiwo, siwo ŋu wògblɔ le be, nunana wonye na ye, yeƒe ahlãvlwoe na ye la, eye mana woazu ave, ne gbemelãwo naɖu wo!

english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Mahe to nɛ ɖe ŋkeke, siwo wòɖo dzudzɔ na Baalwo, wòɖe woƒe ga ŋɔti kple woƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔ kɔ, eye wodze eƒe ahiãviwo yome heŋlɔ nyea be la ta.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Eyata, kpɔ ɖa, mable enu akplɔe ayi gbegbe, eye maƒo nu wòade dzi me nɛ.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Matse eƒe weingble nɛ de afima, eye nuxaxabali me la atrɔ zu mɔkpɔkpɔ ƒe agbo! Adzi ha le afima abe le eƒe ɖetugbimenɔɣi kple ɣeyiɣi, si wòʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ene.

english_verse: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le ɣemaɣi la ãyɔm he „srɔ̃nye“, nye mãgayɔm be „nye Baal“ azɔ la.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Made Baalwo ƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le eƒe nu me, eye woƒe ŋkɔ magava ame ƒe ta me azɔ o.

english_verse: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
translation_verse: Ànye nye ŋugbetɔ tegbee, eye matsɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ana nenye nye ŋugbetɔ:

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: ànye nye ŋugbetɔ le nyateƒe me, ne nadze si Yehowa.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le ɣemaɣi la mase dziƒo ƒe gbe, eye dziƒo ase anyigba ƒe gbe;

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Gayi nalɔ̃ nyɔnu, si ame bubu le lɔlɔ̃m, eye wònye gbolo la, abe alesi Yehowa lɔ̃ Israel-viwo, ke woawo trɔ ɖe mawu tutɔwo ŋu, eye wole weintsetsebolo lɔ̃m la ene.“

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ nɛ bena: Nɔ gbɔnye kpoo eteƒe nadidi, megawɔ gbolo o, eye megaɖe ŋutsu bubua ɖeke o, eye alea nye hã mana na wò.

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Elabena Israel-viwo anɔ anyi eteƒe nadidi, eye fia kple amegã, akpedavɔsa kple legba, kɔmewu kple aklama kpakpɛa ɖeke mana wo si o.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Emegbe Israel-viwo atrɔ adi Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la, kple woƒe fia Dawid; eye woanɔ dzodzom nyanyanya ava Yehowa kple eƒe dɔmenyo gbɔ le ŋkekeawo ƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Israel-viwo, mise Yehowa ƒe nya, Yehowa le dzre hem kple, anyigbadzitɔwo, elabena nuteƒewɔwɔ, lɔlɔ̃ kple sidzedze Mawu mele anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Eyata anyigba axa nu, eye nu ati kɔ na edzinɔlawo katã, eye woatsrɔ̃ gbemelãwo, dziƒoxewo kple keke atsiaƒumelãwo ke hã.

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Ɖeko amea ɖeke megawɔ dzre, eye wòaku mo na ame o, elabena wo dukɔ la le abe amesiwo nɔa dzre wɔm; kple nunɔlawo la ene.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Eyata àdze anyi le ŋkeke me, nunɔla hã adze enyi akpe ɖe ŋuwò le zã me, eye matsrɔ̃ dawò.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: Woatsrɔ̃ nye dukɔ, le esi sidzedze mele esi o ta; elabena èɖo vlo sidzedze, eyata nye hã mado vlo wo be, maganye nunɔla nam o; èŋlɔ wo Mawu ƒe se la he, eyata nye hã maŋlɔ viwòwo be.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: Alesi wosɔ gbɔ ɖe edzii la, nenemae wowɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋunyee; eyata matrɔ woƒe bubu wòazu ŋukpe.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃wo nye nuɖuɖu na wo, eye dɔ le wo wum ɖe woƒe vodada ŋu.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Ava me na nunɔla abe dukɔ la ene; mahe to nɛ le eƒe zɔzɔme ta, eye maɖo eƒe nuwɔnawo teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled
translation_verse: Ne woɖu nu la, maɖi ƒo na wo o, eye ne wowɔ ahasi la, womadzi ɖe edzi o, elabena wodzudzɔ ŋkuléle ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ le gbe biam eƒe atiwo, eye eƒe atizɔti tea nya nɛ. Elabena ahasiwɔgbɔgbɔ kplɔ wo trae, wowɔ ahasi, eye wotrɔ le woƒe Mawu yome.

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: Wosa vɔ le towo la me, eye wodo dzudzɔ le togbɛwo dzi, le fɔfɔliwo, sesewuwo kple logowo le, le esi woƒe vɔvɔli nyo ta; eyata miaƒe nyɔnuviwo awɔ gbolo, eye miaƒe tovɔvinyɔnuwo awɔ ahasi.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Nyemahe to na miaƒe nyɔnuviwo le esi wole gbolo wɔm ta o, eye nyemahe to na miaƒe toyɔvinyɔnuwo le esi wole ahasi wɔm ta o; elabena woawo ŋutɔwo kplɔ ahasitɔwo de kpɔe, eye wosa vɔ kple gbolowo, ale be dukɔ manyanu la dze anyi. Woxlɔ̃ nu Yuda bena, eva hã nagawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: Israel, ne éwɔ gbolo la, Yuda megaɖi fɔ o dzro! Eyata migava Gilgal o, migayi Bet-Awen o, eye migaka atam gblɔ bena: „Miele Yehowa ƒe agbe“ o!

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Elabena Israel dze aglã abe nyinɔ dzeagbo ene; azɔ Yehowa anyii abe alẽvi ene le leƒe gbaoo.

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Efrayim dze xɔlɔ̃ kple legbawo, miɖe kɔ le eŋu!

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Ne wono aha tsu vɔ la, wowɔa ahasi; woƒe amegawo lɔ̃a ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Ya bla wo kɔtɔɔ, eye ŋukpe lé wo de woƒe vɔsawo ŋu.

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: Mi nunɔlawo, misee, Israel ƒe aƒe, ɖo ŋku anyi, eye mi fiaƒemetɔwe miƒu to anyi, elabena mia tɔe nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la! Elabena miawoe nye mɔ̃ na Mizpa, eye miawoe nye ɖɔ woɖo ɖe Tabor dzi

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: kpla ʋe goglo le Sitim; ke mahe to na ml katã!

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Menya Efrayim, eye Israel meɣla ɖem o; Efrayim, azɔ èwɔ ahasi, eye Israel, ègblẽ kɔ ɖo na ɖokuiwò.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Woƒe nuwɔnawo xe mɔ na wo, be womagatrɔ ɖe woƒe Mawu ŋu o, elabena ahasiwɔgbɔgbɔ le wo me, eye womedze si Yehowa o.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe dàda aɖi ɖase ɖe mo nɛ kem Israel kple Efrayim adze anyi le woƒe vodadawo la, eye Yuda hã adze anyi akpe ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ woƒe alẽwo kple nyiwo ayi Yehowa di gee, ke womakpɔe o, elabena eɖe eɖokui ɖa tso wo gbɔ.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Yehowa yomee wotrɔ nu le, elabena wodzi vi tutɔwo; azɔ dzinu yeye aɖu woawo kple woƒe anyigbawo.

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Miku lãdzo le Gibea, eye miku kpẽ le Rama! Mido aƒa le Bet-Awen be: Benyamin, kpɔ megbewò!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Efrayim azu gbegbe le tohegbe; nusi megblɔ ɖe Israel ƒe toawo ŋu la, le eteƒe.

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Yuda-amegãwo zu abe amesiwo ŋea liƒo ɖe eme la ene, matrɔ nye dziku akɔ ɖe wo dzi abe tɔɖɔɖɔ ene.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Wote Efrayim de anyi, eye wotso tohehe bɔbɔe de anyi, le esi wòlɔ̃ dze mawuwo ƒe sewo yome le ta.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Ke agbagblaʋuie menye na Efrayim, eye ŋɔ ɖunue menye na Yuda ƒe aƒe la.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: Efrayim kpɔ dɔléle, si le eŋu, eye Yuda kpɔ eƒe abiwo; tete Efrayim yii Asur, eye wòdɔ ame do ɖe fia Yareb; ke mate ŋu ada gbe te mia ŋu o, eye mayɔ dɔ miaƒe abiwo o.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Elabena dzata menye na Efrayim, eye dzatavi menye na Yuda ƒe aƒe; mavuvu nu ahadzo, malé nu adzoe amea ɖeke maxɔe o.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Magagbugbɔ ayi nɔnyieƒe, vaseɖe esime woafufu ŋku ahadi nye ŋku me; ne wodo xaxa me la, woadi yonyeme mɔ.

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Eyata mina míagatrɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu; elabena eyae vuvu mí, eye agada gbe le mía ŋu, eyae de abi mía ŋu, eye agablae ne mí.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Agbɔ agbe mí le ŋkeke eve megbe, eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la afɔ mí ɖe tsitrenu, ne míanɔ agbe le eŋku me.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ele dodo ge kokoko abe agudzedze ene, eye ele vava ge na mí abe tsidzadza ene, abe keletsi, si ƒoa anyigba ene.

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Efrayim, nuka mawu wò, eye Yuda, nuka mawɔ wò? Elabena míaƒe lɔlɔ̃ le abe ŋdililikpo kple zãmu, si nu yina le ŋdi ene.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Eyata meƒo wo to nyagblɔɖilawo dzi, metso nyee numenyawo wu woe, eye nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ adze abe kekeli ene.

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Elabena lɔlɔ ƒe nu dze ŋunyie vu akpeɖavɔsa, eye sidzedze Mawu dze ŋunye wu numevɔsa.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: Ke woawo tu nyee nubabla la abe Adam ene, eye wotrɔ ʋu le yonyeme le afima.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Gilead enye nu tovo wɔlawo ƒe du, eye nu ƒoe.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo ƒe ha le abe adzoblasu, siwo de xa ɖi la ene, wowu ame le Sixem-mɔ dzi, eye wowɔ ŋukpenanu.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ nusi mele gbɔgblɔ me o la, le Israel ƒe aƒe le me; Efrayim tsɔ ahasiwɔwɔ do dɔe le afima, eye Israel do gu eɖokui.

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: Ne mebe, mada gbe le Israel ŋu la, Efrayim ƒe vodadawo kple Samaria ƒe nu vɔ̃di wɔwɔwo dee ta ɖa. Elabena wodaa alakpa, fiafitɔwo dzea kpɔ, eye adzohawo nɔa nu ham le mɔ dzi.

english_verse: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
translation_verse: Womegblɔ le woƒe dzi me kpɔ be, yewoƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo kala le ŋku dzi nam o.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Azɔ woƒe nuwɔwɔwo ɖe to ɖe wo, eye wotsɔ woƒe alakpadada do dzidzɔ na amegãwo

english_verse: Everyone burns with desire— they are like coals in an oven, ready to burst into flames.
translation_verse: Ahasitɔwowo katã wonye, wole abe kpo, si me aboloƒola do dzo ɖo ene; ne eblu amɔwɔ la, edzadzɔa dzoa tutu ɖo, vaseɖe esime wòaʋã.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Le míaƒe fia ƒe ŋkekenyuie dzi la amegãwo tsɔã wein ƒe dzoʋuʋu dea dɔ lã me na wo ɖokui; ebɔa ha kple fewuɖulawo.

english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Elabena woƒe dzi le bibim abe kpo ene le woƒe ayedzedze me; woƒe aboloƒola dɔ alɔ̃ le zã blibo la me, eye wòbi le ŋdi flaflafla.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Wo kalã le bibim abe kpo ene, eye woflã woƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo, woƒe fiawo katã dze anyi, eye wo dometɔa ɖeke meyɔm o. Gbeƒãɖeɖe tohehe la.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Efrayim tsaka kple dukɔwo: Efrayim le abe abolo, si woƒo de afi dzi, eye wometrɔe o la ene.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Du bubu me tɔwo xɔ ŋusẽ le esi, ke medze sii o; eƒe ta ƒo wɔ, ke menyae o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel ƒe dãda le ɖase dim ɖe mo nɛ kaŋ; ke wometrɔ ɖe Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la ŋu o, eye womedi eyome mɔ le nusiawo katã me o.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: Efrayim le abe ahɔne tsibome, si nunya mele tagba na o la ene: wole Egipte yɔm, eye woyi Asur.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Ne wonya yi ko la, mada asabu de wo dzi, maɖidi wo ɖe anyi abe dziƒoxewo ene, eye mahe to na wo, abe alesi wotoe na woƒe amehawo ene.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Baba na wo, elabena wodzo le gbɔnye! Gbegblẽ neva wo dzi, elabena wotrɔ ʋu le yonyeme! Mebe, maɖe wo, ke woawo da alakpa ɖe asinye.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Womedo ɣli nam le woƒe dzi me o, ke boŋ wofa avi le woƒe abawo dzi; wova kpe ta le bli kple aha yeye ta, eye wotrɔ nu le yonyeme.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Nyee fia nu wo, eye mede ŋusẽ woƒe alɔwo, ke woɖo ta me vɔ ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Wotrɔ, ke menye ɖo ta dziƒo o, eye wole abe dati doagblɔ ene; woƒe amegãwo atsi yi nu le woƒe aɖe ƒe nyanyrã la; esia woatsɔ aɖe alɔmee le wo ŋu le Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: Tsɔ kpẽ ɖo nu! Egbɔna Yehowa ƒe aƒe la dzi abe hɔ̃ ene! Elabena wotu nye nubabla la, eye wosẽ to de nye seawo ŋu.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Wole ɣli dom nam be: Nye Mawu, mi Israel-viwo míedze si wò!

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Israel do vlo nu nyui; futɔ neti eyome!

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: Woɖo fiawo, ke metso gbɔnye o; woɖo amegãwo, nyemenye naneke le eŋu o. Wotsɔ woƒe klosalo kple sika wɔ legbawoe, ne woatsrɔ̃.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Samaria, wò nyivi le ŋu nyɔm, nye dɔmedzoe bi ɖe wo ŋu; ɣekaɣi hafi woate ŋu ana wo ɖokui ŋu nadza?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Elabena Israel wòdzɔ tso, gbede ye wɔe, eye menye Mawu wònye o; eyata Samaria ƒe nyivi la afli kakɛkakɛ.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Elabena yae woƒã, eye ahom woaxa, vvoƒe nukuwo mamie o; ahɔ̃liti matse ku o, ne eme hã la, ame tutɔwo aɖui.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Woami Israel; azɔ woanɔ dukɔwo ɖome abe ze ɖigbɔ ene.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Elabena woyi Asur; gbetedzi la, eya ɖeka koliae nɔa anyi, ke Efrayim ya na nu eƒe ahiãviwe.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Ne wogana ahiãnu le ɖukɔwo dome hã la, maƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe wo ŋu, eye woavo vie tso amegãwo ƒe fia ƒe adzɔnana si me.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Elabena Efrayim ɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo kpaŋkpaŋ, ne wòatsɔ awɔ nutala, eye vɔsamlekpuiawo zu nuvo nɛ.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Ne meŋlɔ nye se akpe nane nɛ hã la, ebunɛ abe ame tutɔ tɔe wonye ene.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Wowu nye vɔsalãwo, ne woaɖu lã; woƒe nu medze Yehowa ŋu o Azɔ aɖo ŋu woƒe voɖaɖawo, ahe to na wo le woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta, eye woagagbugbɔ ayi Egipte.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Israel ŋlɔ ewɔla he; etu fiasãwo, eye Yuda tso du sesẽwo kpaŋkpaŋ; maɖo dzo ɖe eƒe duwo me, ne wòafiã woƒe fiasãwo.

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Israel, megakpɔ dzidzɔ o, megatso aseye abe ɖukɔwo ene o! Elabena èwɔ gbolo, ètrɔ ʋu le wò Mawu yome, eye nelɔ̃ gbolonunana le lugbɔƒewo katã.

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Lugbɔƒe kple ahafiãƒe manyi wo o, eye aha yeye aflu wo.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Womatsi Yehowa ƒe anyigba dzi o, ke boŋ Efrayim agbugbɔ ayi Egipte, eye woaɖu nu makɔmakɔ le Asur.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Womaƒo wein ɖe anyi na Yehowa o, eye woƒe akpedavɔsawo maɖo dzidzɔ nɛ o; kuteƒenuɖuɖu wònye na wo; amesiwo katã ɖui la, agblẽ kɔ ɖo na wo ɖokui; elabena woƒe nuɖuɖu la, woƒe ɖɔ nu koe wòle ɖo, wometsɔe va Yehowa ƒe mee o.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nuka miawo le takpegbe kple Yehowa ƒe ŋkekenyuie la dzi?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Elabena ne wosi le gbegblẽ nu la, Egipte aƒo wo nu ƒu, eye Mof aɖi wo. Dza ato ɖe woƒe klosalonu veviwo dzi, eye aŋɔka amie ɖe woƒe agbaɖɔwo me.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Tohegbe ɖo, eye teƒeɖogbe ɖɔ, Israel adze sii! Nyagblɔɖila tsi bome, eye amesi si gbɔgbɔ le la, zu tsukunɔ le wò vodada gbogboawo kple fuléle geɖeawo ta.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Gbetakpɔ la enye Efrayim de nye Mawu ŋu; mɔ̃ka enye nyagblɔɖila le eƒe toƒewo katã, eye fuléle le eƒe Mawu ƒe aƒe me!

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Wogbẽ wòtso me abe le Gibea ŋɔli ene; ado ŋu woƒe vodadawo, eye wòahe to le woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta.

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Mefɔ Israel le gbegbe abe weintsetse ene, eye mekpɔ mia fofowo abe gbotsetse ŋgɔgbea ene; ke esi wova Baal-Peor la, wotsɔ wo ɖokui na ŋukpenamawu la, eye wozu ŋunyɔnu, abe nusi ŋu woku ɖo la ke ene.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe adzo abe xevi ene, vidzidzi kple fulɔfɔa ɖeke manɔ anyi o.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Ne wobe, yewoanyi wo viwo woatsi la, made vi lewo ŋu, be amegbetɔa ɖeke maganɔ anyi o; elabena baba na woawo ŋutɔ hã, nenye be, medze le wo gba.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Eye meɖo ŋku anyi kpɔ Efrayim vaseɖe Tiro be: wodoe ɖe lãnyiƒe, ke Efrayim akplɔ viawo ayi na amewula.

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Yehowa, nuka nana wo ma? Na dɔ tsikɔ kple no ƒuƒu kplalɛ wo.

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Wowɔ woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖiwo katã le Gilgal; afima melé fu wo le le woƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo ta; manyã wo atso aƒenye me, eye nyemagalɔ̃ wo azɔ o; woƒe amegãwo katã nye aglãdzelawo.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Ati ŋɔɖua enye Efrayim, woƒe kewo ayrɔ, eye womatse ku o; ne wobe, yewoadzi vi hã la, mawu woƒe dɔmevi, siwo gbɔ womelɔ̃a nu le o.

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu agbe wo, elabena womeɖo toe o, eye woanɔ tsa glãla tsam le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Weinka, si vu dranyi, eye wòtse la, enye Israel; alesi wòtsee la, nenema nu wòɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo ɖo; alesi eƒe anyigba nã nui la, nenema nu wòwɔ legbawo ɖo.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzi dze eve, eyata woakpɔe ɖe enu; agbã woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, eye wòagblẽ woƒe legbawo.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Ekema woagblɔ bena: Fiaa ɖeke mele mía si o; míegbe Yehowa vɔvɔ̃, nukae fia awɔ na mí ma?

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Aɖe gã le nu me na wo, wokaa atam dzodzro, eye woblaa nu kple wo nɔewo, ale be ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ amie abe aɖigbe le boliƒo dzi le agble me ene.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi ɖo Samariatɔwo le Bet-Awen ƒe nyivi la ŋuti; elabena esubɔlawo le nu xam le eta, eye eƒe trɔ̃nuawo le dzodzom nyanyanya, le esi eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe dzo le egbɔ ta.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Woakplɔ nyivi la ayi Asur atsɔ awɔ nunanae na fia Yareb; ŋukpe alé Efrayim, eye Israel ƒe mo atsi dã ɖe eƒe tameɖoɖo la ŋu.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samaria ƒe fia abu abe futukpɔ le tɔ ŋgɔ ene.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Woatsrɔ̃ nuxeƒe, siwo Israel tsa wɔ nuvɔ̃e la ɖa le Awen, ŋuwo kple aŋɔkawo alo ɖe woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo dzi, eye woagblɔ na towo bena; Mitsyɔ mía dzi! eye na togbɛwo be: Mimũ dze mía dzi!

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Israel, èwɔ nuvɔ̃ tso Gibea ŋɔli ke. Eya dzi wogale; ɖe ana matu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le Gibea oa?

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Mahe to na wo ɖe nye didi nu, eye dukɔwo aƒo wo ɖokui nu ƒu ɖe wo ŋu, ne mebe, mahe lo na wo le woƒe vodada eveawo ta.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Efrayim enye nyivi mamlã, si nu luƒoƒo vivina: Mekpɔ eƒe kɔ nyui la ta vaseɖe fifi, ke azɔ matsi Efrayim ɖe tasiaɖam ŋu, Yuda aŋlɔ agble, eye Yakob adzobo anyigba.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Miƒã dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye mixa nu kple lɔlɔ̃; mide agble yeye, elabena azã ɖo be, míadi Yehowa, vaseɖe esime wòava, eye wòana dzɔdzɔenyenye nadza ɖe mía dzi.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Miede nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe agble, miexa nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ, eye mieɖu alakpakutsetse; elabena èle dzi ɖom ɖe wò tasiaɖamwo kple wò aʋawɔla gbogboawo ŋu.

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: Aʋaɣli aɖi le wò dukɔ la dome, eye woagbã wò mɔ̃ sesẽwo katã, abe alesi Salman gbã Bet-Arbel, eye wòxlã dadawo kple viwo ɖe nu la ene.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Betel, alea wòle mia wɔ gee le miaƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ vivivo la ta; le ŋɖi kanya asimaɖetsimee la Israel-fia nu ayi.

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Esi Israel nɔ ɖevime la, melɔe, eye meyɔ vinye la tso Egipte vɛ.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Wova wo, ke wotrɔ ʋume ɖe ame: Wosa vɔ na Baalwo, eye wodo dzudzɔ na legbawo.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Evɔ wònye nyee fia azɔli Efrayim, eye melée ɖe alɔ to hafi; ke womedze sii be, nyee da gbe le wo ŋu o.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Mede amegbetɔwo ƒe atagbi, si nyee lɔlɔ̃ka la wo he, mena na wo abe amesiwo ɖea kɔkuti le kɔ la ene, eye mena nuɖuɖu wo.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Womagagbugbɔ ayi Egipte-nyigba dzi o, ke boŋ Asur nenye woƒe fia, elabena wogbe tametɔtrɔ.

english_verse: War will visit their cities, and their plans will fail.
translation_verse: Yi ava woƒe duwo dzi, aŋe woƒe gametiwo, eye wòaɖu nu le woƒe tameɖoɖowo ta.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Aglãdzedze de ŋunye vivia nye dukɔ nu, eye ne woyɔ wo ɖo ta dzi hã la, wo ɖometɔa ɖeke mefɔa eɖokui dzi o.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Efrayim, aleke matsɔ wo ana, eye matsa wò Israel ade asi? Aleke mawɔ wò abe Adma ene, eye mawɔ wò abe Zeboim ene? Nye dzi trɔ le menye, eye nye nublanuikpɔkpɔ le fiefiẽm wlɔwlɔwlɔ!

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Nyemawɔ nu le nye dɔmedzoe heliheli me o, eye nyemagagblẽ Efrayim azɔ o, elabena Mawu menye, eye menye amegbetɔ o, kɔkɔelɔ menye le dowòme, eye nyemava le dziku me o.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Woakplɔ Yehowa ɖo, ne eɖe gbe be dzata ene; elabena ele gbe ɖe ge, eye ɣetoɖoƒeviwo aɖe abla ava.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Woadzo tso Egipte abe xeviwo ene, eye abe ahɔnewo ene tso Asur-nyigba dzi, eye mana woanɔ woƒe aƒewo me; Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Efrayim tsɔ alakpadada ɖe to ɖem, eye Israel ƒe aƒe la tsa amefuflu ɖe to ɖem, ke Yuda gale eɖokui trɔm ɖe tsiƒo agbaƒo na eƒe Mawu, na kɔkɔetɔ nyateƒetɔ la ko.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Efrayim melɔ̃a nu le ya gbɔ o, eye wòtia ɣedzeƒeya yome; ele alakpadada kple ŋutasesẽ dzim de dzi gbesiagbe, eɖua dzo kple Asur, eye wòɖoa ami ɖe Egipte.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Yehowa le nya he ge kple Yuda, ahe to na Yakob le eƒe zɔzɔme nu, eye wòaɖo eƒe nuwɔnawo teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Elé nɔvia ƒe afɔkpodzi le dɔ me, eye esi wòɖo ŋutsu me la, ete keme kple Mawu.

english_verse: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye Mawu Zebaot, Yehowa enye eŋkɔ.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Eye Efrayim gblɔ be: Mekpɔ ho, eye kesinɔnu su asinye, womekpɔ vodadaa ɖeke le nye dɔwɔwɔwo katã ŋu, si nye nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, wò Mawui, tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ke, magana nanɔ agbadɔ me abe le ŋkekenyuieduɣi ene.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Meƒo nu kple nyagblɔɖilawo, mede ŋutega gedewo fia, eye mede lowo to nyagblɔdilawo dzi.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Yakob si yi Aram-nyigba dzi; nyɔnu me Israel subɔ ɖo, eye nyɔnu tae wònyi lã ɖo.

english_verse: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa kplɔ Israel tso Egipte to nyagblɔɖilaa ɖe dzi, eye wòna nyagblɔɖilaa ɖe kpe wo dzi.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Ne Efrayim ƒo nu la, ŋɔdzi ɖoa ame; eyae nye tatɔ nɔ Israel; ke eɖi fɔ to Baal dzi, eye wòku.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Ke wogale nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ dzi; wotsɔ woƒe klosalowo kɔ nɔnɔmewoe, eye wotsɔ woƒe aɖaŋu wɔ legbawoe; gbede ƒe dɔwɔwɔ wo katã wonye; woawoe woƒoa nu na, eye vɔsalawo gbugbɔa nu na nyiviwo!

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Eyata woanɔ abe ŋdililikpo kple zãmu, si nu yina le ŋdi ene, abe tsro, si ya kplɔna dzonɛ le lugbɔƒe, kple dzudzɔ, si toa fesre nu ene.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Ke nyee nyee Yehowa, wò Mawu, tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ke, menye mawua ɖeke kpe ɖe ŋunye o, eye xɔnametɔa ɖeke meli abe nye ene o.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Melé ŋku ɖe ŋuwò la gbegbe, le kuɖinyigba dzi.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Esi wokpɔ gbeɖuƒe la, woɖu nu ɖi ƒo; eye esi woɖi ƒo la, woƒe dzi de esi dada me, eye woŋlɔm be.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Eyata mezu dzata na wo, eye mede xa de mɔ to abe lãkle ene.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Medze wo dzi abe sisiblisinɔ, si ŋu woɖe vi le la ene, maflo tsrokpa da le woƒe dzi ŋu, maɖu wo abe dzatanɔ ene, eye gbemelãwo avuvu wo.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: Israel, wò gbegblẽ wònye, be nètso de nye, wò xɔnametɔ ŋu.

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Afika wò fia le azɔ, ne wòaxɔ na wò le wò duwo katã me, eye afika wò ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo le, amesiwo ŋu nègblɔ le be: „Na fia kple amegãwom?“

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mena fia wò le nye dɔmedzoe me, eye magaxɔe le nye dziku me.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: Wodzi Efrayim ƒe vodadawo goŋgoŋ, eye wotu nu ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃ nu sesĩe.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: Alé ku abe nyɔnu, si le vi dzim ene; vi manyanu wònye, elabena ne azã de la, metoa vidzimɔ nu o.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Mava aɖe wo le tsieƒe si me, eye mava axɔ wo aƒle le ku si me! Ku, wò dɔvɔ ɖe? Tsieƒe, wò veve ɖe? Nublanuikpɔkpɔ ɣla ɖe mo nam!

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Elabena ne enye ati tseku le naviawo dome hã la, ɣedzeƒeya aƒo, Yehowa ƒe ahom atu tso gbegbe, ale be eƒe vudowo amie, eye eƒe tsidzɔƒewo aƒu, eye woaha eƒe kesinɔnu veviwo katã.

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Esi Samaria sẽ to ɖe eƒe Mawu ŋu la, eyata akpɔe ɖe enu; woatsi yi nu, woaxlã woƒe vidzĩewo ɖe nu, eye woadze ƒo le woƒe funɔwo nu.

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Israel, gatrɔ ɖe Yehowa, wò Mawu la ŋu, elabena wò vodadawoe tsɔ wò ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Mihe nya ɖe asi, eye mitrɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu! Migblɔ nɛ he; „Tsɔ vodadawo katã ke, eye wò dɔme neganyo, ekema míana nyitsu, siwo ŋugbe míedo, kple míaƒe nuyiwo la!

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Asur mate ŋu axɔ na mí o, míagado sɔwo o, eye míagayɔ míaƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ be mía Mawu azɔ o, elabena gbɔwò nublanuikpɔkpɔ le na tsyɔ̃eviwe.“

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Mayɔ dɔ woƒe godzedze, eye malɔ̃ wo tso dzi me, elabena nye dɔmedzoe nu fa de wo ŋu.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Mana na Israel abe zãmu ene, aƒo se abe dzogbenya ene, eye wòato ke abe Libanon ene.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Eƒe alɔwo ava dranyi, adze ani abe amiti ene, eye wòaʋẽ lilili abe Libanon ene.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Amewo aganu eƒe vɔvɔli te, eye woaƒã bli; woaƒo se abe weinka ene, eye woaxɔ ŋkɔ abe Libanon ƒe wein ene.

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Efrayim, legbawo ƒe nya kae tsɔ gbɔnye? Mede toe, eye melé ŋku de eŋu. Sesewu dama menye, dzinye nakpɔ wò kutsetsewo le.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe gbe, si va na Yoel, Petuel vi.

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Mi amegã ɖeɖiwo, mise nya sia, eye mi anyigbadzitɔwo katã, miƒu to anyi! Ɖe esia tɔgbe dzɔ le mia ŋɔli alo le mia fofowo ŋɔli kpɔa?

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Mixlẽe fia mia viwo, mia viwo naxlẽe afia wo viwo, eye wo viwo naxlẽe afia wo megbeviwo!

english_verse: Swarm after swarm of locusts has attacked our crops, eating everything in sight.
translation_verse: Nusi ŋɔwo kpɔtɔ ɖi la, ʋetsuviwo ɖui; nusi ʋetsuviwo kpɔtɔ ɖi la, ʋetrawo ɖui, eye nusi ʋetrawo kpɔtɔ ɖi la, abɔwo ɖui.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Mi ahamulawo, minyɔ, eye mifa avi! Mi weintsunolawo katã, mixa nu ɖe aha yeye ŋu, elabena woɖee le nu me na mi.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔa ɖe ho va nye anyigba dzi, ŋusẽ le eŋu, eye wòsɔ gbɔ kpaŋ, eƒe aɖuwo le abe dzatatsu ƒe aɖu ene, eye eƒe tsyo le abe dzatanɔ tɔ ene.

english_verse: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
translation_verse: Egblẽ nye weinkawo, eye wòŋe nye gbɔtiwo, eflo tsro le wo ŋu hetsɔ wo ƒu anyi, eye woƒe kawo fu ɣie.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Xa nu abe ɖetugbi, si ta akpanya ɖe eƒe ɖetugbimesrɔ̃ ŋu la ene!

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa nu tso le Yehowa ƒe me; nunɔla, siwo subɔa Yehowa la, le konyi fam.

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Agble zu gbegbe, eye anyigba le nu xam, elabena bli gblẽ, aha yeye no ƒiaƒiaƒia, eye ami ƒu kplakplakpla.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe lé agbledelawo, eye weingbledelawo le nu xam le lu kple ƒo ta, elabena nuŋeŋe nu tso le agble me.
