english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Weinka ku, eye gboti yrɔ, yevuboɖatiwo ƒu, keke detiwo kple atɔtɔŋutitiwo kpakple agblemetiwo katã ke hã; dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ nu tso, le amegbetɔviwo dome. Konyifafa kple kukuɖeɖe.

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Mi nunɔlawo, mibla ali dzi, ne miafa konyi! Mi vɔsamlekpui la subɔlawo, mifa avi! Miva miatsi akpanya me adɔ, mi, nye Mawu subɔlawo; elabena nuɖuvɔsa kple nunovɔsa nu tso le mia Mawu ƒe me.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Miɖo nutsitsidɔ kɔkɔe, eye miɖe gbe ƒã takpegbe! Miƒo ame tsitsiwo kple anyigbadzitɔwo katã nu ƒu ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu la ƒe me, eye mido ɣli na Yehowa!

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Aleke, ŋkeke la! Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe, eye gbegblẽ wònye tso ŋusẽkatãtɔ la gbɔ gbɔna.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Ɖe wometsi nuɖuɖu nu le mía ŋku me, eye dzidzɔ kple aseyetsotso nu le mía Mawu ƒe me oa?

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Blikuwo lé akpɔ̃ ɖe to me, avawo ɖi ƒuƒlu, eye nuɖzraɖoƒewo mũ; elabena bliwo tsi tonu.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Lãwo le xɔxlɔ̃m, eye nyihawo le tsa glãla tsam, elabena gbeɖuƒea ɖeke meli na wo o; nu ti kɔ na alẽhawo hã.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò yɔm mele; elabena dzo bi lãnyiƒewo ƒe gbewo, eye dzoƒaɖe fia agblemetiwo katã.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Gbemelãwo hã le xɔxlɔ̃m na wò, elabena toʋuwo mie, eye dzo bi lãnyiƒewo ƒe gbewo.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Miku kpẽ le Zion, mido aƒa le nye to kɔkɔe la dzi! Anyigbadzitɔwo katã nedzo nyanyanya, elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la gbɔna, etu aƒe!

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Viviti kple blukɔdogbe, alilikpo kple tsizidogbe wònye! Alesi agudzedze gbagbana ɖe towo, dzi la, nenema dukɔ gã sẽŋua ɖe avae, si tɔgbe menɔ anyi kpɔ gbeɖe, eye mele anyi nɔ ge le emegbe vaseɖe ƒome, siwo gbɔna la ŋɔli o.

english_verse: Fiery flames surround them; no one escapes. Before they invaded, the land was like Eden; now only a desert remains.
translation_verse: Dzo le nu ɖum le eŋgɔ, eye dzoƒaɖe le nu fiãm le emegbe; anyigba la le eŋgɔ abe Eɖen-bɔ ene, eye emegbe nye gbegbe ɖeɖe sɔŋ; amea ɖeke masi le enu o.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Woƒe mo le abe sɔwo ƒe mo ene, eye wole du dzi abe sɔɖolawo ene.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Wole kpo dim le towo ta me abe tasiaɖamwo ƒe hoowɔwɔ ene; wole zi nyẽm, abe alesi dzo fiãa gbe ƒuƒui ene, eye wodze aʋa abe aʋakɔ gãa ɖe ene.

english_verse: The very sight of them is frightening.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo dzo nyanyanya le eŋgɔ, eye mowo katã fu tititi.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Wole du dzi abe kalẽtɔwo ene, eye wole gli liam abe aʋamewo ene, wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe lé eƒe mɔ tsɔ, eye womeɖɔa li woƒe toƒewo o.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔa ɖeke memimi nɔvia ɖo o, amesiame lé eƒe mɔ tsɔ; wode ta aŋutrɔwo me, ke womexɔ abi o.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Wole tsa glãla tsam le dua me, eye wole du ƒum le gli dzi, woge ɖe xɔwo me, eye wòto fesrenu ge ɖe eme abe fiafitɔ ene.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Anyigba dzo kpekpekpe le enu, eye dziƒo ʋuʋu; ɣe kple ɣleti do viviti, eye ɣletiviwo ƒe keklẽ nu tsi.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Yehowa le gbe ɖem le eƒe aʋakɔ ŋgɔ, eƒe aʋakɔ lolo ŋutɔ, eye ame sesẽe nye eƒe gbe dzi wɔla; elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la tri akɔ, eye ŋɔdzi le eŋu ŋutɔ, amekae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe enu? Nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena dzimetɔtrɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Azɔ hã la, mitsɔ miaƒe dzi blibo kple nutsitsidɔ, avifafa kple konyifafa trɔ ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Midze miaƒe dziwo, menye miaƒe awuwo o, eye migatrɔ ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu la ŋu! Elabena amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla wònye, egbɔa dzi ɖi blewu, amenuveve bɔ ɖe esi, eye vɔ̃wɔwɔ venɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Amea ɖe menya nu o, avee, eye wòatrɔ adzo ahagblẽ yayra ɖe megbe, ne woatsɔ asa nuɖuvɔ kple nunovɔ na Yehowa, mia Mawu la.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Miku kpẽ le Zion, miɖo nutsitsiɖɔ kɔkɔe, eye miɖe gbe ƒã takpegbe!

english_verse: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
translation_verse: Miƒo dukɔ la nu ƒu, eye mikɔ ameha la ŋu, miyɔ amegã ɖeɖiwo vɛ, eye miƒo ɖeviwo kple vi nonowo nu ƒu; ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ neɖo tso eƒe xɔ me, eye ŋugbetɔ nedo tso ŋugbetɔxɔ me.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo, amesiwo subɔa Yehowa la, nefa avi le akpata kple vɔsamlekpui la domee agblɔ be: Yehowa, kpɔ nublanui na wò dukɔ, eye megahe ŋukpe va wò domenyinu la dzi, ne dukɔwo nanɔ ahama sim ɖe wo ŋu o. Nukaŋuti woanɔ gbɔgblɔm le dukɔwo dome be: Afika woƒe Mawu le hã? Yayra yeye ŋugbedodo.

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ʋã ŋu ɖe eƒe anyigba la nu, eye wòkpɔ nublanui na eƒe dukɔ la.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ɖo ŋu gblɔ na eƒe dukɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖo bli, aha yeye kple ami ɖe mi, ne miaɖu aɖi ƒo, eye nyemagana ŋu nakpe mi le dukɔwo dome azɔ o.

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: Maɖe anyiehetɔ la ɖa le mia ŋu, ahanyãe aɖo ɖe kuɖinyigba dzi kple gbegbe, atrɔ ta ade ɣedzeƒeƒu, eye wòatrɔ agɔmegbɔ ade ɣetoɖoƒeƒu, eye wòaƒaƒã anɔ ʋeʋẽm, elabena ewo nu eteƒe mekɔ o.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: Anyigba, megavɔ̃ o, tso aseye, eye nakpɔ dzidzɔ, elabena Yehowa le nu gã wo ge.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Mi gbemelãwo, migavɔ̃ o, elabena lãnyiƒe ƒe gbewo ade ama; elabena atiwo atse, eye kutsetsewo ado agba ɖe gboti kple weinka dzi.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Mi Zion-viwo, mitso aseye, ne miakpo dzidzɔ ɖe Yehowa, mia Mawu la ŋu; elabena atso tsidzadza ayra mi, ana adatsi kple keletsi nadza ɖe mia dzi abe tsa ene.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Lu ayɔ lugbɔƒe fũ, eye aha yeye kple ami ado agbogbo ɖe ahafiãƒe.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Eye ma ɖo ƒe, siwo ʋetsuviwo kple ʋetrawo, abɔwo kple ŋɔwo ɖu nu la teƒe na mi, woawoe nye nye aʋakɔ gã, si medɔ ɖe mia ŋu.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Miaɖu nu aɖi ƒo, eye miakafu Yehowa, mia Mawu, amesi wo nukunu ɖe mia ŋu la ƒe ŋkɔ, eye ŋu magakpe nye dukɔ akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eye miadze si be, mele Israel dome, nyee nye Yehowa, mia Mawu la, ɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o; eye ŋu magakpe nye dukɔ akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Eye mana nukunuwo nado ɖe dziƒo ŋu kple anyigba dzi: Ʋu, dzo kple dzudzɔbabla kɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: Ye ado viviti, eye ɣleti azu ʋu, hafi. Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke gã dziŋɔ la nava ɖo.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Eye woava me be, woaɖe amesiame, si ayɔ Yehowa ŋkɔ la; elabena xɔname anɔ Zion-to la dzi kple Yerusalem kpakple ame mamlea, siwo Yehowa ayɔ la dome, abe alesi Yehowa do eŋugbee ene.

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Esia nye Amos, amesi tso alẽnyilawo dome le Tekoa la ƒe nya, si wòkpɔ ɖe Israel ŋu ƒe eve ɖo ŋgɔ na anyigbaʋuʋu le Yuda-fia Uziya ŋɔli kple Israel-fia Yerobeam, Yoas-vi ŋɔli la.

english_verse: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena. Yehowa le gbe ɖem tso Zion, eye wòna eƒe gbe le ɖiɖim tso Yerusalem, tete lãkplɔviwo ƒe lãnyiƒe yrɔ, eye Karmel tame; ƒu.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le Damasko ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wowɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta la, nyematsɔe akee o; elabena emli galuƒotasiaɖam to Gilead dzi.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Eyata mada dzo ɖe Xazael ƒe me, eye wòafia Ben-Hadad ƒe fiasãwo.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Maŋe Damasko ƒe gametiwo, eye amesiwo le nuvɔ̃bali me la kple amesi; lé fiatikplɔ ɖe asi le dzidzɔkpɔxɔwo me la, atsrɔ̃, eye woaɖe aboyo Aram-dukɔ la ayi Kir; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le Gaza ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta, nyematsɔe akee o; elabena woɖe amewo keŋkeŋ, be woakplɔ wo ayi aɖade asi na Edom.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Eyata mada dzo ɖe Gaza ƒe gliwo dzi, ne wòafiã woƒe fiasãwo.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Eye matsrɔ̃ Asdodtɔwo kple amesi lé fiatikplɔ ɖe asi le Askalon, matrɔ nye asi ɖe Ekron ŋu, eye Filistitɔwo ƒe susɔea nu ayi; Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le Tiro ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi, wɔwɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo la, nyematsɔe akee o; elabena woɖe aboyo amewo keŋkeŋ ɖade asi na Edom, eye womeɖo ŋu nɔviwo ƒe nubabla la o.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Eyata mada dzo ɖe Tiro ƒe gliwo dzi, ne wòafiã woƒe fiasãwo.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi. Le Edom ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta, nyematsɔe akee o; elabena etsɔ yi ti nɔvia yome, eye wòmia ŋku ɖe nublanuikpɔkpɔ dzi na eɖokui, ele nu vuvum ɖaa le dɔmedzoe me, eye wòlé dziku ɖe dɔ me ɖikaa.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Eyata mada dzo ɖe Teman, ne wòafiã Bozra ƒe fiasãwo.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi. Le Amon-viwo ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta, nyematsɔe; ake wo o; elabena wodze ƒo le Gilead ƒe funɔwo nu, ne woakeke woƒe anyigba ɖe enu.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Eyata mado dzo ɖe Raba ƒe gliwo ŋu, ne wòafiã woƒe fiasãwo, ne ɣli ɖi le aʋakpegbe, eye ya tso ʋuɖuʋudu le ahomtugbe.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Eye Woƒe fia kple eƒe amegãwo siaa wòayi aboyo me; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le Moab ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta, nyematsɔe akee o, elabena etsɔ Edom-fia ƒe ƒuwo me akaloe.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Eyata mada dzo ɖe Moab, ne wòafiã Keriyot ƒe fiasãwo, eye Moab naku le ʋunyarunyawɔwɔ me, ne ɣli ɖi, eye kpẽwo ɖi.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ ʋɔnudrɔ̃la lé wo dome, eye mawu eƒe amegãwo katã akpe ɖe eŋu; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le Yuda ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta, nyematsɔe akee o; elabena wogbe Yehowa ƒe se, eye womelé eƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi o, ke boŋ wona woƒe alakpalegba, siwo yome wo fofowo dze la, kplɔ wo trae.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Eyata mada dzo ɖe Yuda, ne wòafia Yerusalem ƒe fiasãwo!

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le Israel ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ etɔ̃ kple eneawo ta, nyematsɔe akee o; elabena etsɔ ame dzɔdzɔe dzra ɖe ga nu kple hiãtɔ ɖe atokota dodo ɖeka nu.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Wo amesiwo ƒe ve me le fiefiẽm ɖe kekui, si le ame dahe ƒe ta me la ŋu, woglɔ̃a mɔ na hiãtɔwo, eye vi kple fofoa woyia gbolo ɖeka gbɔ, ne woaɖo gu nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Wodraa afɔ ɖe awɔbavɔ dzi le vɔsamlekpuiwo katã gbɔ, eye wonoa nyadrɔ̃ha le woƒe mawuwo ƒe me.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Evɔ wònye metsrɔ̃ Amoritɔwo le wo ŋgɔ, amesiwo dzo atsu, abe alesi sederti kɔe ene, eye wosesẽ abe sesewu ene hafi; metsrɔ̃ woƒe tsetsea dzi me kple woƒe ke le to me.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Mekplɔ mi tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye mena miezɔ gbe dzi ƒe blane, ne miaxɔ Amoritɔwo ƒe anyigba.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Eye meɖo nyagblɔɖilawo tso miaƒe ŋutsuviwo dome kple Mawu ƒe kluwo tso miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo dome Israel-viwo, Yehowa be, ɖe mele alea oa?

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Ke miena wein Mawu ƒe kluwo wono, eye miede se na nyagblɔɖilawo gblɔ be: Migagblɔ nya ɖi o!

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mate mi ɖe to me, abe alesi tasiaɖam, si wode lubablae taŋ la, nyẽna ɖe to mee ene

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Sitsoƒe abu ɖe ame ɖablɛ, ŋusẽtɔ mate ŋu awɔ eƒe ŋusẽ ŋu da o, eye kalẽtɔ maɖe eƒe agbe o;

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: aŋutrɔdala manɔ te o, afɔ tsɔtsɔe tɔ masi o, eye sɔdola maɖe eƒe agbe o;

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: eye amesi nye dzideƒotɔ te kalẽtɔwo dome la, asi amama gbemagbe; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Mise Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ ɖe mi Israel-viwo, mi ƒome blibo, si wòkplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ŋu:

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: Miawo koe menya le anyigba dzi ƒomeawo katã dome; eyata mahe to na mi le miaƒe vodadawo katã ta.

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: Ne ame eve be, yewoazɔ ma la, ɖe womeɖoa gbe ɖi hafi oa?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Ne nuléle mesu dzata si o la, ɖe wòxlɔ̃na le ave mea? Ɖe dzatavi ɖea gbe le emlɔƒe, ne mekpɔ lé nu haɖe oa?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: De xevi dzona ɖe mɔ̃ dzi lé anyigba, ne mɔ̃a ɖeke meli nɛ oa? Eye ɖe mɔ̃ fena, ne naneke meɖo eme oa?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Ɖe wokua kpẽ le du me, eye vɔvɔ̃ gbea amewo ɖoɖoa? De dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔna le du me, eye menye Yehowa ye wɔe oa?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa mewɔa naneke, ne meɖe eƒe tameɖoɖo fia eƒe ɖɔla, nyagblɔɖilawo hafi o.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Ne dzata ɖe gbe la, amekae agbe vɔvɔ̃? Ne Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒo nu la, amekae agbe nyagbɔgblɔ ɖi?

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Miɖo kpo ɖe fiasãwo ta le Asdod kple ɖe fiasãwo ta le Egipte-nyigba dzi gblɔ bena: Miƒo takpli ɖe Samaria-towo dzi, eye mikpɔ ʋunyaʋunyawɔwɔ geɖe kple ame teteɖeanyi, si le eme la ɖa.

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Womenya nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ o, eye woli kɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ kple ŋutasesẽ ɖe woƒe fiasãwo me gleglegle.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Futɔ ɖe to ɖe wò anyigba godoo, atu ŋusẽ le ŋuwò, eye woaha wò fiasãwo.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Alesi lãkpɔvi ɖea lã ƒe ata eve kple to kakɛ tsoa dzata ƒe nu mee la, nenema ke woaɖe Israel-vi, siwo bɔbɔ nɔ Samaria le aba ƒe dzogoe dzi kple aba ƒe kuntru dzi lae.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot, be: Misee, eye mitsɔe ɖi ɖase na Israel ƒe aƒe la be:

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: Gbesigbe mahe to na Israel ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ la, mahe to na Betel ƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo hã, eye woaŋe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo woage adze anyi.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Magbã vuvɔŋɔlixɔ akpe ɖe ɖzomeŋɔlixɔ ŋu, nyiɖuxɔwo atsrɔ̃, eye xɔ gbogboawo nu ayi; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Mise nya sia, mi Basan-nyinɔ, siwo le Samaria-to dzi! Mi amesiwo te ame dahewo ɖe anyi, miegbã hiãtɔwo gudugudu, eye miegblɔ na miaƒe atsuwo bena: Miku aha vɛ míano!

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa tà eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye be: Kpo ɖa, ŋkeke li gbɔna na mi, woaɖe mi kple ƒu, eye woatsɔ ʋã atɔ mia viwo.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Miato gli ƒe gbagbãƒe, amesiame akpɔ eŋgɔ te, eye miatsɔ miaƒe legbawo axlã ɖe anyi; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: Miyi Betel, ne miaɖawɔ nu tovo; miyi Gilgal, ne miaɖawɔ nu tovo ɖe edzi! Misa miaƒe vɔwo ŋdi sia ŋdi, eye mitsɔ miaƒe nuwo ƒe ewoliawo ɖeka sa vɔe ŋkeke etɔ̃etɔ̃.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Mina dzudzɔ nade dzi ɖe abolo ʋaʋã ŋu, ne wòanye akpedavɔsa; miɖe gbe ƒã be, woana nu faa, midee sesĩe, elabena alea vivia mi Israel-viwo nu, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: Medo kuvia miaƒe aɖuwo le miaƒe duwo katã me, eye mena abolokoe wɔ nu le mia nɔƒewo katã; ke miegbe tɔtrɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: Esi dzinu etɔ̃ susɔ, ne nuŋeɣi naɖo la, mete tsidzadza mi; mena tsi dza, ɖe du ɖeka me, ke nyemena wòdza ɖe evelia me o; tsi dza ɖe agble ɖeka me; ke agble, si me tsi medza ɖo o la me ƒu kplakplakpla.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Du eve kple du etɔ̃ wole ya mum sagãsagã yi du ɖeka me, be yewoano tsi, ke womeɖi kɔ o; gake miegbe tɔtrɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mena miaƒe bliwo dze heteku, eye wohlɔ̃: ʋetsuviwo ɖu miaƒe abɔwo kple weingblewo, gbotiwo kple amitiwo; ke miegbe tɔtrɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mehe dɔvɔ̃ va mia dzi abe Egipte tɔa ene; mewu miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo kple yi, woha miaƒe sɔwo, eye miaƒe, asaɖa me ʋẽ kũ ɖo ŋɔti me na mi; ke miegbe tɔtrɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Metrɔ mi bu anyi, abe alesi Mawu trɔ Sodom kple Gomora bu anyi ene, eye miele abe ati, si woɖe tso dzo me la ene; ke miegbe tɔtrɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: Eyata Israel, ale mele wɔ wò ge enye si: Esi mele esia wɔ ge wò la, eyata Israel, dzra ɖo naɖakpe kple wò Mawu!

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Elabena eya amesi mè towo, eye wòwɔ ya, etoa amegbetɔ ƒe tamesusuwo nɛ, enana agudzedze zua viviti, eye wòzɔa anyigba ƒe kɔkɔƒewo la ŋkɔ enye Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot!

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, mise nya sia, elabena mele konyifaha to ge ɖe mia ŋu!

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: Israel-ɖetugbi dze anyi, megale fɔfɔ ge o; eɖo baba ɖe eƒe anyigba dzi, amea ɖeke mele efɔ ge ɖe tsitrenu o!

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ne dua ɖe ho kple ame akpe le Israel ƒe aƒe la me la, ame alafa akpɔtɔ, eye ne eho kple ame alafa la, ame ewo akpɔtɔ.

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa gblɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe la enye si: Midim, ne mianɔ agbe!

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: Ke migabia Betel ta se o, migava Gilgal o, eye migayi Beer-Seba o; elabena Gilgal ayi aboyo me, eye Betel atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Midi Yehowa, be mianɔ agbe, ne magadze Yosef ƒe aƒe la dzi, abe dzo ene ahafiãe, eye dzotsilaa ɖeke manɔ anyi na Betel o;

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: mi amesiwo trɔ nya dzɔdzɔe wòzu atsa, eye miete dzoe dzɔenyenye ɖe to!

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Eya amesi wo atifieŋu kpakple avũ kple avũtɔ, eye wotsɔ blukɔ wɔ ŋdii, ena ŋkeke do viviti abe zã ene, eye wòyɔ atsiaƒu me tsiwo vɛ hetrɔ wo ƒo ɖe anyigba dzi la ŋkɔ enye Yehowa;

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: eya amesi de gbegblẽ ame sesẽ la dome, eye wòhe gbegblẽ va du sesẽ la dzi.

english_verse: You people hate judges and honest witnesses;
translation_verse: Wole fu amesi xlɔ̃a nu ame le ʋɔnu, eye wonyɔ ŋu nyateƒetola.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Esi miefanya ame dahewo kple afɔ, eye miexɔ blidzɔ le wo si la, eyata miatsɔ kpe fufuwo atu xɔe, gake mianɔ wo me o; miade weingble nyowo, gake miano woƒe wein o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: Elabena menyae be, miaƒe dzidadawo sɔ gbɔ, eye miaƒe nuvowo teƒe mekɔ o, mielé ame dzodzɔewo ɖe ke me, miexɔ zãnu, eye miete ame dahewo ɖe anyi le ʋɔnu!

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Eyata nunyala ƒe nu nede gã le ɣemaɣi, elabena ɣeyiɣi vɔe wònye.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Midi nyui, eye menye vɔ̃ o, ne mianɔ agbe, eye Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot, nanɔ anyi kpli mi, abe alesi miele gbɔgblɔm ene.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Milé fu vɔ̃, milɔ̃ nyui, eye mifɔ nya dzɔdzɔe ɖe tsitrenu le ʋɔnu, amea ɖe menya nu o Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot, ave Yosef ƒe ame mamleawo nu.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot, Aƒetɔ la, gblɔ esi: Konyifafa anɔ ablɔwo katã me, eye woana alele dom le kpɔdomeewo katã, woayɔ agbledela ɖe nuxaxa ŋu, eye kuteƒehadzilawo ɖe konyifafa ŋu;

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: eye konyifafa anɔ weingblewo katã me, ne meva to dowòme yi, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo dzrom Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la le! Viɖe ka Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la nye na mi? Viviti wònye, menye kekeli o.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Ele abe ŋutsua ɖe, si si le dzata nu, eye sisiblist va do goe, eye esi wògbɔ va aƒe hetsɔ asi ziɔ ɖe gli ŋu la, da ɖui la ene.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: De menye vivitie nye Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la, eye menye kekeli oa, ɖe menye blukɔ wònye, eye eme mekɔ oa? Gota mawusubɔsubɔ ɖeɖe menye naneke o.

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: Melé fu miaƒe ŋkekenyuiewo, eye metsri wo, eye nyemaʋẽ miaƒe takpegbewo ase o.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings or animal sacrifices— not even your very best.
translation_verse: Elabena ne miesa numevɔ kple nuɖuvɔ nam hã la, womadze ŋunye o, eye nyemanyẽ: kɔ akpɔ miaƒe nyivi damiwo ƒe akpedavɔsawo o.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Te wò hawo ƒe ɖiɖi ɖe megbe tso gbɔnye, wò saŋkuƒoƒowo le to me vem nam!

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Nya dzɔdzɔe nesi abe tsi ene, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye abe tɔʋu, si memiena o la ene boŋ!

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, ɖe miesa akpedavɔ kple nuɖuvɔ nam le gbe dzi le ƒe blaneawo mea?

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Eyata miatsɔ miaƒe legbawo: Miaƒe fia Sakut kple miaƒe mawu Kewan ƒe dzinuvi, si miewɔ na mia ɖokui la;

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: eye mana woaɖe aboyo mi agbɔ Damasko ŋu ʋĩ ayii, Yehowa, amesi ŋkɔ nye Mawu Zebaot lae gblɔe!

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Baba na mi amesiwo ɖe dzi ɖe anyi le Zion, kple mi amesiwo le Samaria-towo dzi bɔkɔɔ, mi dukɔwo ƒe ame veviwo dome ŋkutatɔwo, amesiwo gbɔ Israel ƒe aƒe la vana!

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Miyi Kalne, eye milé ŋku ɖe anyi, mitɔ edzi tso afima yi Xamat-gã, eye mihoe ɖe dzi yi Filistitɔwo ƒe Gat be, ɖe eme nyo na wo wu fiaɖuƒe siawo tɔ loo, alo woƒe anyigba lolo wu mia tɔa?

english_verse: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo ɖi be, dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe la nate ɖa, eye miele ŋutasesẽ ƒe fiazikpui hem vɛ;

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: mi amesiwo mlɔ nyiɖubatiwo dzi, eye miedra ɖe mia mlɔƒewo, mieɖu alẽviwo le lãhawo dome kple nyiviwo le lãkpɔ me;

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: mi amesiwo nɔa saŋku ƒom kɔ kple avu, eye mienɔa hã kpam abe Dawid ene;

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: mi amesiwo noa wein le vɔsatrewo me, eye miesa ami veviwo, eye Yosef ƒe abixɔxɔ metsɔa fu lã me na mi o!

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Eyata mianɔ ŋgɔ na aboyomewo ayi aboyo me, eye amesiwo dra ɖe aba dzi la ƒe nukoko hahaha nu atso!

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa ta eƒe agbe be: Ale Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot, gblɔ esi: Yakob ƒe dàda le ŋu nyɔm nam, melé fu eƒe fiasãwo, eye matsɔ du la kple eme nuwo ade asi.

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Eye woava me be, ne ŋutsu ewo kpɔtɔ ɖe aƒe ɖeka me la, woaku;

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: eye ne woƒe ƒometɔ, amesi be, yeatɔ dzo wo la, va, be yeafɔ ame kukuawo tso aƒea me, eye wòbia amesi kpɔtɔ ɖe xogã me be: Amea ɖe gale gbɔwò hã, eye wòɖo ŋu be: Ɖeke megali o la, agblɔ be. Mia nu, ne womagaɖo ŋku Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ dzi o.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ, ɖa, Yehowa le se de ge, tete woagbã xɔ gãwo, eye xɔ suewo agba gudugudu

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Ɖe sɔwo ate ŋu aƒu du le agakpe dzia, eye ɖe woatsɔ nyiwo aŋlɔ agble ɖe atsiaƒu dzia? Elabena miawo mietrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe wòzu aɖi, kple dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse wòzu atsa

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm le nu maɖinuiwo ŋu, eye miele gbɔgblɔm be: De menye sesẽ mietsɔ to dzo ɖe ta oa?

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, ale Yehowa, Mawu Zebaot gblɔ esi: Maɖo dukɔa ɖe ɖa ɖe mia ŋu, ne woaxaxa mi ɖo tso Xamat-nutowo me vaseɖe tɔʋu, si le gbegbe la nu.

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ Yehowa na mekpɔ ŋutega, kpɔ ɖa, ewo ʋetsuviwo, esime kelegbewo de asi miemie me; elabena kelegbewo miena, ne wova gbe na fia megbe.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Eye esi woɖu anyigba dzi gbewo vo keŋkeŋ la, megblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ Yehowa, tsɔe ke dzro! Aleke Yakob ate ŋu anɔ te, esi mele ɖeke me o?

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Tete wòve Yehowa, eye Yehowa gblɔ bena. Mava me o.

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ Yehowa na mekpɔ ŋutega, kpo ɖa, Aƒetɔ Yehowa yɔ dzo vɛ, be wòatsɔ ahe toe, eye wòfiã to gãwo helé agblewo.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ be: Aƒetɔ Yehowa, dzudzɔ dzro! Aleke Yakob ate ŋu anɔ te, esi mele ɖeke me o?

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Tete wòve Yehowa, eye Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ be: Esia hã mava me o.

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Eye wòna mekpɔ ŋutega, kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la tsi tre ɖe gli, si dzɔ kã la dzi, eye wòlé tsumikpe ɖe asi.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Amos, nuka kpɔm nele? Meɖo ŋu bena. Tsumikpee Eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ bena: Kpo ɖa, mada tsumikpe ɖe Israel-duko la dome, eye nyemagatsɔe akee azɔ o.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Isak ƒe nuxeƒewo azu gbegbe, Israel ƒe kɔkɔefewo azu aƒedo, eye matso yi atso ɖe Yerobeam ƒe aƒe la ŋu. Amazya tso Amos nu, ke Amos ɖe gbe ƒã tohehe, si ava edzi la nɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Tete Amazya, amesi nye nunɔla le Betel la, dɔ ame ɖo ɖe Israel-fia Yerobeam, ne woagblɔ nɛ bena: Amos ɖo gbe ɖi ɖe ŋuwò le Israel ƒe aƒe la dome; anyigba la magaɖo dzi atso eƒe nyawo katã o.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Elabena ale Amos gblɔ esi: Yerobeam aku ɖe yi nu, eye woaɖe aboyo Israel atso eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Eye Amazya gblɔ na Amos, bena: Nukpɔla si yi Yuda-nyigba dzi, gblɔ nya ɖi le gama, ne nakpɔ abolo aɖu le afima.

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: Ke megagblɔ nya ɖi le Betel azɔ o; elabena fia ƒe kɔkɔeƒe kple fiaɖuƒe ƒe gbedoxɔ wònye.

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Tete Amos ɖo ŋu gblɔ na Amazya bena: Nyemenye nyagblɔɖila alo nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe vi o, ke boŋ lãkplɔvi kple gbotidola menye.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa ɖem le lãhawo yome, eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Yi ɖagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe nye dukɔ Israel ŋu.

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Srɔ̃wò awɔ gbolo le dua me, wò ŋutsuviwo kple wò nyonuviwo atsi yi nu, eye woatsɔ dzidzeka amã wò anyigbae, wò ŋutɔ àku ɖe anyigba makɔmakɔ dzi, eye woaɖe aboyo Israel atso eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ Yehowa na mekpɔ ŋutega, kpo ɖa, kutsetse ɖiɖiwo yɔ kusia ɖe fũ.

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amos, nuka kpɔm nèle? Meɖo ŋu be: Kutsetse ɖiɖi kusi taŋ. Tete Yehowa gblɔ nam bena: Nye dukɔ Israel ɖiɣi ɖo, nyemagatsɔe akee azɔ o.

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Nyɔnu, siwo dzia ha le fiasãwo me la, afa avi gbemagbe, ame kukuwo asɔ gbɔ, eye woazi ɖoɖoe atso wo, aƒu gbe ɖe teƒewo katã.

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Misee, mi amesiwo ƒe ve me le fiefiẽm ɖe ame dahewo ŋu, eye mietsrɔ̃ hiãtɔwo;

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: mi amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm be: Gbekagbe gɔ̃ dzinu yeye nu le yiyi ge, ne míadzra bli, eye dzudzɔgbe nu le yiyi ge, ne míaʋu avawo nu ahakpa nudotree sue, míadzi asi ɖe edzi, eye míaŋe nudanu ɖe eme aha amee;

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: míaƒle ame dahewo ɖe gã nu kple hiãtɔwo ɖe atokota ɖoɖo ɖeka nu, eye míadzra bli toto ɖe bli ŋutɔ teƒe?

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: Yehowa ta nu ɖe Yakob ƒe dada ŋu be: Nyematsɔ woƒe nuwɔnawo katã ake wo akpa gbeɖe o!

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: De anyigba maʋuʋu, eye edzinɔlawo katã naxa nu le esia ta oa? Akɔ dzi glodzoo abe Nil, eye wòadze agbo agadze anyi abe Egipte-tɔsisi la ene.

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le ŋkeke ma me la mana ɣe naɖo to le ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ, eye viviti nado ɖe anyigba dzi le ŋkeke me.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Matrɔ miaƒe ŋkekenyuiewo woazu nuxaxa kple miaƒe hawokatã woazu konyifaha, made akpanya aliwo katã, eye tawo katã nazu ta kokoe, mana wòanɔ, abe alesi wofaa konyi na tenuvi ene, eye eƒe nuwuwu anɔ abe ŋkeke vɔ̃e ene.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkekewo li gbɔna, eye maɖo dɔwuame ɖe anyigba dzi, ke, menye abolodɔ alo tsikɔwuame ɖe tsi ŋu o, ke boŋ ɖe Yehowa ƒe nyawo sese ŋu.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Woanɔ ya mum tso atsiaƒu nu yi atsiaƒu nu, eye woanɔ tsatsam tso anyiehe yi ɣedzeƒe, ne woadi Yehowa ƒe nya, ke womakpɔe o

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la tsikɔ awu ɖetugbi dzetugbeewo kple ɖekakpuiwo, eye gbafa aƒo wo;

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: wo amesiwo tà Samaria ƒe dzidada, eye wogblɔna bena: „Dan, míetà wò mawu ƒe agbe, eye míetà Beer-Seba-ma!“ Woadze anyi, eye womagafɔ o.

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ Aƒetɔ la wòtsi tre ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi gblɔ bena: Ŋe kɔ le sɔtiawo nu, ne kpuiawo nadzo kpekpekpe, eye nagbã wo ɖe wo katã ƒe ta dzi! Matsɔ yi awu wo viwoe, wo dometɔa ɖeke masi o, eye amea ɖeke makpɔtɔ o.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Ne woyi tsieƒe ke hã la, nye asi ahe wo tso afima, eye ne wolia dziƒo la, maɖiɖi wo ɖe anyi tso afima.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Ne wobe ɖe Karmel ta me la, maɖi wo le afima ahe wo agbɔe, eye ne wosia ɖem ɖe atsiaƒu gɔme la, madɔ da woaɖu wo le afima.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Eye ne wodze woƒe futɔwo ŋgɔ yi aboyo me la, madɔ yi woawu wo le afima; matso nye ŋku aɖo wo ŋu ɖe vɔ̃ me, eye menye ɖe nyui me o.

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Yehowa Zebaot, amesi ka asi anyigba ŋu wòlólo gbanaa, eye edzinɔlawo katã xa nu, ede dzi glodzoo abe Nil ene, eye wòdze eme abe Egipte-tɔsisi ene;

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: eya amesi tu eƒe dziƒoxɔ ɖe dzi me, eye wòɖo eƒe xɔ goba gɔme anyi ɖe anyigba dzi, eya amesi yɔ atsiaƒu me tsiwo hetsɔ ƒo ɖe anyigba dzi la ŋkɔ enye Yehowa!

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: De mi Israel-viwo, miele nam abe Kusiviwo ene oa? De nyemekplɔ Israel tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, Filistitowo tso Kaftor, eye Aramtɔwo tso Kir oa?

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Kpo ɖa, Aƒetɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋku le fiaduƒe wonuvɔ̃ sia ŋu, eye matsrɔ̃e ɖa tso anyigba dzi; ke ɖeko nyematsrɔ̃ Yakob ƒe aƒe la keŋkeŋ o, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: Elabena made se, eye woaʋuʋu Israel ƒe aƒe la le dukɔwo katã dome, abe alesi woʋuʋua asɔe, eye blikua ɖeke megena ɖe anyigba o ene.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo katã aku ɖe yi nu, wo amesiwo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e la matu mí o, eye maɖi kpe mí o. Ɣeyiɣi nyuia ɖe ŋugbedodo na Israel.

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la mafɔ Dawid ƒe agbadɔ gbagbã la de tsitrenu, eye matre eƒe gbagbãƒewo, mafɔ eƒe glikpowo ɖe tsitrenu, eye matui abe tsã ene;

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: ne woaxɔ Edom ƒe ame mamleawo kple dukɔ, siwo katã ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo la, woanye wo tɔ; Yehowa, amesi le nusiawo wɔ ge lae gblɔe.

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke li gbɔna, eye woanɔ agbleŋɔŋlɔ dzi ahade asi na nuŋeɣi, woanɔ weinfiafiã dzi ahade asi na nuƒãɣi, towo atsyɔ aha yeye, eye togbɛwo katã aƒo beke.

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Magaɖo nye dukɔ Israel te, eye woatso du zuaƒedowo anɔ wo me, woade weingblewo anɔ wo me wein, eye woatɔ abɔwo aɖu wo me kutsetsewo.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Made woƒe agunu to ɖe woƒe anyigba dzi, eye womagaho wo tso woƒe anyigba, si mena wo la dzi o, Yehowa, wò Mawue gblɔe!

english_verse: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: “I, the Lord, have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.”
translation_verse: Obadya ƒe ŋutega. Ale Aƒetɔ Yehowa gblɔ ɖe Edom ŋu enye si: Míese nya tso Yehowa gbɔ, eye woɖo du ɖe dukɔwo dome be: Mitso, ne míaho aʋa ɖe wo ŋu!

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mawɔ wò sue le dukɔwo dome, eye maɖi gbɔ wò vevie.

english_verse: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
translation_verse: Wò dzi ƒe dàda ble wò, wò amesi le agatowo me, eye nètso aƒe ɖe kɔkɔƒewo, wò amesi le gbɔgblɔm le wò dzi me be: Ameka atutum aƒu anyi?

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ne èyi dzi ʋĩ abe hɔ̃ ene, eye nèwɔ ato ɖe dzinuviwo dome hã la, matutu wò aƒu anyi tso afima, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: Nenye fiawo kple adzodalawoe ƒo ɖe dziwò le zã la, ɖe womafi nu alesi ko asu wo nu oa? Ke aleke wòa nèhetsrɔ̃e! Nenye weinxalawoe ƒo ɖe dziwò la, ɖe womakpɔtɔ ɖe ɖi oa?

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: Aleke womehedzro Esau me, eye wotsa le eƒe kesinɔnuwo mee o!

english_verse: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
translation_verse: Wò dzoɖuxɔlɔ̃wo katã nyã wò vaseɖe liƒo dzi ke, xɔ̃wòwo ble wò, eye wokpe dziwò; wò aboloɖulawo ɖo mɔ̃ ɖe tewò, ke mèdze sii o.

english_verse: Edom, when this happens, I, the Lord, will destroy all your marvelous wisdom.
translation_verse: Yehowa be: De nyematsrɔ̃ nunyalawo ɖa le Edom kple gɔmesese ɖa le Esau ƒe towo dzi gbemagbe oa?

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Teman, dzi aɖe le wò kalẽtɔwo ƒo, ne woatsɔ amewuwu atsrɔ̃ amesiame ɖa le Esau ƒe towo dzi.

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: Le ŋuta, si nesẽ le noviwò Yakob ŋu ŋuti la, ŋukpe anyẽ atsyɔ wò, eye woatsrɔ̃ wò ɖa tegbee.

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe èle eteƒe; esi amedzrowo ɖe aboyo eƒe aʋakɔwo ɖzoe gbemagbe, du bubu me towo ge ɖe eƒe agbowo me, eye wodzidze nu ɖe Yerusalem dzi la, wò hã ènye wo dometɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
translation_verse: Ke megafɔ ŋku ɖe nɔviwò dzi le eƒe ŋkeke la dzi, le eƒe dzogbevɔ̃egbe o, megakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Yuda-viwo ŋu le woƒe tsotsrɔ̃gbe o, eye megake wò nu baa le xaxagbe o.

english_verse: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
translation_verse: Megage ɖe nye ɖukɔ ƒe agbo me le, eƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe o, megafɔ ŋku ɖe eƒe gbegblẽ dzi le eƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe o, eye megado wò asi ɖa ɖe eƒe kesinɔnuwo ŋu le eƒe dzogbevɔ̃egbe o.

english_verse: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
translation_verse: Megatsi tre ɖe mɔ dzevee nu natsrɔ̃ eƒe ame sisiwo o, eye megaɖe aboyo eƒe ame mamleawo le xaxagbe o!

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe na dukɔwo katã; alesi nèwɔ la, nenema woawo wò, eye wò nuwɔwɔwo ava wò ta dzi.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Alesi mieno aha le nye to kɔkɔe dzii la, nenema dukɔwo katã anɔ enono dzii ɖaa; woanoe aɖuɖɔ egɔme ƒiaƒiaƒia, eye woanɔ abe amesiwo medzo kpɔ o la ene.

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: Ke xɔname anɔ Zion-to dzi, anye kɔkɔeƒe, eye Yakob ƒe aƒe la axɔ woƒe domenyinu.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: Dziehetɔwo axɔ Esau ƒe towo, eye bali me nɔlawo ado Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba, woaxɔ Efrayim-tagba kple Samaria-tagba, eye Benyamin axɔ Gilead;

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: eye Israel-viwo ƒe aʋakɔ, siwo woɖe aboyoe la, ado Kanaanitɔwo ƒe anyigba vaseɖe Zarpat, eye Yerusalem ƒe aboyome, siwo le Sefarad la, ado dzieheduwo.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Xɔnametɔwo ava Zionto la dzi, ne woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu Esau ƒe towo, eye fiaɖuƒe la anye Yehowa to.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Yona, Amitai vi, bena:

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: Tso, nayi Niniwe, du gã la me, eye nagblɔ nya ɖi ɖe eŋu; elabena woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ va ŋkunye me.

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Ke Yona tso, be yeasi le Yehowa ŋku me ayi Tarsis. Eye esi wòva Yafo, eye wòkpɔ ʋua ɖe, si le Tarsis yi ge la, exe fe, eye wòɖoe, be yeasi atso Yehowa ŋku me ayi Tarsis kpli wo.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa lɔ ya gãa ɖe trɔ ɖe atsiaƒu la dzi, eye ahom sesẽa ɖe tu ɖe atsiaƒu dzi, ale be ʋu la ɖi be, yeagbã.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Tete ʋukulawo vɔ̃, eye wo dome amesiame do ɣli yɔ eƒe mawu, eye wotsɔ ʋua me nuwo ƒu gbe ɖe ƒu me, ne woazu wodzoe, ke Yona ya yi ɖe ʋua gɔme, eye wòmia anyi do alɔ̃ yi me ʋĩ.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Tete ʋumefia te ɖe eŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Alɔ̃ dɔm wòa nèlea? Fɔ nayɔ wò Mawu! Amea ɖe menya nu o Mawu aɖo ŋku mía dzi, be míagatsrɔ̃ o hĩ.

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Mina míadzidze nu, ne míakpɔ amesi ta dzɔgbevɔ̃e sia dza de mía dzi ɖo la! Tete wodzidze nu, eye nudzidze la dze Yona dzi.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Gblɔ nusi ta dzɔgbevɔ̃e sia dzo ɖe mía dzi ɖo la na mí! Do ka wɔla nènye, eye afika nètso? Mia de ɖe, eye dukɔ ka me nètso?

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu na wo bena: Hebritɔ menye, eye mevɔ̃a Yehowa, dziƒo Mawu la, amesi wɔ atsiaƒu kple anyigba ƒuƒui.

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsuawo vɔ̃ ŋutɔ, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Nukae nèhewɔ ma? Elabena wonyae be, Yehowa nu wòsi le; elabena etoe na wo tsã.

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena; Nuka míawɔ wò, be atsiaƒu la nadze kɔ anyi le mía ŋu godoo? Elabena ƒu la ƒe nyanyrã nu le sesẽm ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu na wo be: Mikɔm ƒu gbe ɖe ƒua me, ekema ƒua adze anyi le mia ŋu godoo; elabena menyae be, tanyee ahom gã sia va mia dzi ɖo.

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsuawo ku ʋua, be woatrɔ ayi gota, ke womete ŋui o, elabena atsiaƒu da nyrã ɖe edzi hekpe wo.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Eye woyɔ Yehowa gblɔ bena: Ao, Yehowa, megana míatsrɔ̃ le ŋutsu sia ƒe agbe ta o, eye megatsɔ̃ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖo mía dzi o; elabena Yehowa nènye, eye nusi dze ŋuwò la, nèwɔna.

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Eye wokɔ Yona ƒu gbe ɖe ƒua me; tete ƒu la dzudzɔ agbodzedze.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsuawo vɔ̃ Yehowa ŋutɔ, wosa vɔ na Yehowa, eye woɖe adzɔgbe.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa dɔ ƒumelã gãa ɖe, be wòaɖami Yona; eye Yona nɔ lã la ƒe dɔ me ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple zã etɔ̃.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena, Meyɔ Yehowa le nye xaxa me, eye wòtɔ nam; medo ɣli tso tsieƒe ƒe ƒodo me, eye nèse nye gbe.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: Etsɔm ƒu gbe ɖe to gɔme, le atsiaƒu titina, tsi sisiwo ɖe to ɖem, eye wò tsi kpakpawo katã kple wò tsi tsotsoewo to tanye yi.

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Megblɔ be, wonyãm ɖa le ŋkuwò me, ɖe magakpɔ wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la akpɔa?

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: Tsiwo ɖe to ɖem de keke nye luʋɔ gbɔ; tɔ gɔme le ŋunye godoo, eye avawo xatsa ɖe ta nam.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: Mede towo ƒe agunu ke, eye anyigba do gameti ɖe nunye ɖikaa, ke èhe nye agbe tso do me, Yehowa, nye Mawu!

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Esi nu te nye luʋɔ ŋu le menye la, meɖo ŋku Yehowa dzi, eye nye gbedoɖoɖa ɖo gbɔwò le wò gbedoxɔ kokoe la me.

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Ke nye la matsɔ akpedagbe asa vɔ na wò, eye mawɔ adzɔgbe, si meɖe la dzi. Xɔname enye Yehowa tɔ!

english_verse: Once again the Lord told Jonah
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Yona zi evelia bena:

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: Tso, nayi Niniwe, ɖu gã la me, eye naɖe gbe ƒã nya, si gblɔ ge mala na wò la nɛ.

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Tete Yona tso yi Niniwe ɖe Yehowa ƒe nya la nu. Niniwe enye du gãa ɖe le Mawu ŋku me, eye eƒe didime enye ŋkeke etɔ̃ ƒe mɔzɔzɔ.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Eye Yona zɔ ŋkeke ɖeka ƒe mɔ le dua me heɖe gbe ƒã gblɔ bena: Esusɔ ŋkeke blane, ne Niniwe natsrɔ̃!

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Tete Nimwetɔwo xɔ Mawu dzi se, wodo kpo, be woatsi nu adɔ, eye woata akpanya, tso tsitsiawo dzi vaseɖe ɖeviawo dzi.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Esi nya la ɖe Niniwe-fia gbɔ la, etso le eƒe fiazikpui dzi, eɖe eƒe awu ʋlaya ɖi, eye wòta akpanya hebɔbɔ nɔ dzowɔ me.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Eye esi Mawu kpɔ, alesi wowɔ, be woɖe asi le woƒe mɔ vɔwo ŋu la, vɔ̃, si Mawu gblɔ be, yeawɔ wo la vee, eye mewɔe o.

english_verse: Jonah was really upset and angry.
translation_verse: Ke esia medze Yona ŋu o, eye dzi kui vevie.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo gbe ɖa na Yehowa gblɔ bena: Oo, Yehowa, esia ŋu pɛ mebu, esime mele mía de; eyata medo ŋgɔ be, masi ayi Tarsis; elabena menyae be, Mawu amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla nenye, egbɔa dzi ɖi blewu, dɔmenyo bɔ ɖe asiwò, eye vɔ̃wɔwɔ vea wò.

english_verse: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
translation_verse: Eyata Yehowa, xɔ nye agbe le asinye! Elabena enyo nam be, maku wu esi manɔ, agbe.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ be: Ɖe nèle dɔmedzoe dom ɖe eteƒea?

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Tete Yona do le dua me ɖabɔbɔ nɔ dua ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, eye wòtu agbadɔ ɖe afima hebɔbɔ no eƒe vɔvɔli te, ne yeakpɔ nusi le dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe dua dzi.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa Mawu dɔ treklɔnu wòva mie ɖe Yona ta me, ne wòado vɔvɔli ɖe edzi ahafa eƒe dzikudodo nu nɛ; tete Yona kpo dzidzɔ le treklɔnu la ŋu ŋutɔ.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Ke esi agu dze le ŋkeke evelia dzi la, Mawu do ŋɔ wòva du treklɔnu la woku.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Esi ɣe dze la, Mawu do ɣedzeƒeya xɔdzo ɖa, eye ɣe ɖu Yona ƒe ta, ale be nu te eŋu belibeli. Tete wodi ku na eɖokui gblɔ bena: Ne meku la, enyo wu esi manɔ agbe.

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Eye Mawu gblɔ na Yona bena: Ɖe nèle dziku dom ɖe eteƒe le treklɔnu la taa? Eɖo ŋu bena: Tɔnye dzɔ be, mado dziku, vaseɖe esime maku.

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ be: Treklɔnu, Si ŋu medze agbagba le o, mekpɔ edzi wòtsi o, emie le zã ɖeka me, eye woku le zã ɖeka me la ƒe nu le vewòm, —

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe nya, si va na Mixa, Moresitɔ la, eye wò-kpɔ ɖe Samaria kple Yerusalem ŋu le Yuda-fia Yotam, Axaz kple Xizkiya ŋɔli.

english_verse: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, misee, anyigba kple edzl nuwo, miƒu to anyi! Aƒetɔ Yehowa nye ɖasefo ɖe mia ŋu, Aƒetɔ la tso eƒe gbedoxɔ kɔ: kɔe la me!

english_verse: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa atso le enɔƒe ahaɖi ɖe anyi, eye wòatsa le anyigba ƒe gkɔkɔƒewo.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Towo alólo le ete abe anyĩgba le dzo nu ene, eye gbadzaƒewo aɖe dzoglo, abe alesi tsi sina tsoa aganu wònɔna ene.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe dzidadawo kple Israel ƒe aƒe ƒe nuvɔ̃wo tae nusiawo katã dzɔ ɖo. Yakob ƒe dzidada ɖe? Ɖe menye eya nye Samaria oa? Yuda ƒe nuxeƒe ɖe? Ɖe menye eyae nye Yerusalem oa?

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: Eyata matsɔ Samaria awɔ anyiglãgoe ɖe gbe me kple weingbledeƒee, malɔ eƒe kpewo aƒu gbe ɖe abu me, eye maɖi ƒeƒle eƒe agunu.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: Woagbãwoƒe aklama kpakpɛwo katã, woatɔ dzo woƒe gbolonunanawo katã, eye matsrɔ̃ woƒe legbawo katã; elabena gboloho wotsɔ ƒo wo nu ƒui, eye gboloho woagazu.

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: Eyata mafa konyi, mafa avi, eye maɖe ƒeƒle anɔ yiyim; mafa konyi abe amegãxiwo ene, eye maxa nu abe golowo ene.

english_verse: The nation is fatally wounded. Judah is doomed. Jerusalem will fall.
translation_verse: Elabena gbedada mele eƒe ƒoƒowo ŋu o; elabena eva Yuda ke, eye wòde nye dukɔ ƒe agbo nu vaseɖe Yerusalem ke.

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
translation_verse: Migado bobloe le Gat o; migafa avi le Ako o, eye mlgaƒo togotogoe le ke me le Bet-Leafra o!

english_verse: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.
translation_verse: Mi Safirtɔwo, miɖe ama miaʋu adzo; Zaanantɔwo mele dzodzo ge o; mifa konyi le Bet-Haezel, elabena mia gbɔe wòdze aʋa ɖo!

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dzidzi aƒo Ma-rotfɔwo le woƒe dzɔgbenyuie ta, elabena dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖi tso Yehowa ghɔ ɖe Yerusalem ƒe agbowo dzi.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Laxistɔwo, mitsi sɔwo ɖe tasiaɖamwo ŋu! Elabena wòe nye Zion-nyɔnuvl ƒe nuvɔ̃ gãtɔ, eye gbɔwòe wokpɔ Israel ƒe dzidadawo le.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Mi Maresatɔwo, magakplɔ nugblẽla aƒu mi, eye Israel ƒe bubumewo aɖe Adulam ke.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Lũ ta kokoe le viwò, siwo ghɔ mèlɔ̃a nu le o la ta; wò ta nebebe tegblẽ abe akagã tɔ ene, elabena wokplɔ wo dzoe le gbɔwò.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Baba na amesiwo ɖoa dzɔ-gbevɔ̃e ɖe ta me, eye wobua nu vɔ̃ɖl wɔwɔ ŋu le woƒe abawo dzi! Ne agu dze la, wowɔnɛ, elabena ŋusẽ le wo si,

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: Ne agble dzro wo la, woxɔnɛ; ne xɔ dzro wo la, wodaa adzoe, eye woɖua sesẽnu le aƒe kple aƒetɔ si, le ŋu-tsu kple eƒe domenyinu si.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Meɖo tame vɔ̃ ɖe ƒome sia ŋu, miaɖe ta le eme o, eye miadzɔ kã anɔ yiyim o, elabena ɣeyiɣi vɔ̃ɖi wònye.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la woado lo ɖe mia ŋu, eye woadzi konyifaha agblɔ bena: Wogblẽ ml keŋkeŋ, wodzidze nye ɖukɔ ƒe anyigba, eye wome-gagbughɔe na ml o; womã míaƒe agblewo na amesiwo ɖe aboyo ml.

english_verse: And so you will never again own property among the Lord's people.
translation_verse: „Eyata wò amea ɖeke mada dzidzeka ɖe eƒe anyigba ŋu le Yehowa ƒe amehawo dome o.“

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm be: Migagblɔ nya o, migagblɔ nya siawo tɔgbe o, vlodoame nu metso o,

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Nya kae nye esia gblɔm Yakob ƒe aƒe la le be: „Ɖe Yehowa mesea dziku dona o, eye esia nye eƒe nuwɔna?“ Ɖe nye nyawo mefa na ame dzɔdzɔewo oa?

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Ke gbaɖegbe ke nye ɖukɔ dze aglã hezu ketɔ: Mieɖe awu ʋlaya le amesiwo ɖe dzi ɖi bɔkɔɔ va tso me yina la ƒe awuwo dzi, abe aʋae miegbɔ tso ene.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mienyã nye ɖukɔ ƒe nyɔnuwo ɖa le woƒe xɔ, siwo gbɔ womelɔ̃a nu le o la me, eye miexɔ atsyɔ̃ le wo viwo si ɖikaa.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Mitso miadzo! Elabena afi menye mia nɔƒe o; le nu makɔmakɔ wɔwó ta woatsɔ gbegblẽ, si teƒe mekɔ o la, agblẽ mi.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe le ya yome lelele, eye wòɖa alakpa be: „Magblɔ nya na mi le wein kple aha muame ŋu“ la, eya anye nyagblɔla asɔe na dukɔ sia.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: Maƒo Yakob nu ƒu blibo, eye makplɔ Israel ƒe ame mamleawo ɖe du; maƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe lãkpɔ me abe alẽwo ene, abe lãha le lãnyiƒe titina ene; eye afima agblẽ kple amegbetɔwo.

english_verse: I will break down the gate and lead them out— then I will be their king.
translation_verse: Gligbãla aho adze wo ŋgɔ, woagbãe ato agbo nu age ɖe eme, eye woagado, woƒe fia adze wo ŋgɔ, eye Yehowa anɔ wo nu.

english_verse: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel! You know right from wrong,
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ bena: Mi Yakob ƒe tatɔwo kple Israel ƒe aƒe me amegãwo, ɖe menye mlaƒe dɔ wònye be, miadze si se la oa?

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo léa fu nyui, eye mielɔ̃a vɔ̃, mievuvua agbalẽ lewo ŋu kple lã le woƒe ƒuwo ŋu.

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Emegbe woado ɣli ayɔ Yehowa, ke matɔ na wo o, eye wòaɣla ŋku me ɖe wo ɣemaɣl le woƒe nuwɔua vɔ̃ɖlwo ta.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ ɖe nyagblɔɖilawo ŋu, wo amesiwo kplɔa nye ɖukɔ tranae, eye ne woƒe aɖu kpɔ nu le ɖuɖum la, woɖoa boblo ŋutl-fafa, ke wotsɔa aʋa ɖe amesi mena nu wo, be woaɖu o ŋu la, enye si:

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: Eyata zã ghɔna ɖoɖo ge na ml, miakpɔ ŋutega o; blukɔ le dodo ge na mi, miaka afã o; ɣe aɖo to ɖe nyagblɔɖilawo, eye ŋke-ke anyɔ tsiɖitsiɖi ɖe wo.

english_verse: You prophets and fortunetellers will all be disgraced, with no message from me.”
translation_verse: Ŋu-kpe alé nukpɔlawo, bokɔnɔwo ƒe mo atsi ɖã, eye wo katã woabla nu ɖe ge, elabena Mawu megale nya ŋu ɖom azɔ o.

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, ŋusẽ kple Yehowa ƒe gbɔgbɔ, dzɔdzɔenyenye kple dzideƒo yɔm fũ, ne magblɔ Yakob ƒe dzidadawo kple Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃wo nɛ. Yerusalem gbegblẽ gbɔgblɔdi.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Misee, mi Yakob ƒe aƒe ƒe ta-tɔwo kple mi Israel ƒe aƒe ƒe amegãwo, mi amesiwo nyɔa ŋu se la, eye mieglɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔewo katã;

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
