translation_verse: mi amesiwo tsɔa fʋu tsoa Zion kple nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ tsoa Yerusalem.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Woƒe tatɔwo drɔ̃a ʋɔnu le zãnunana ta, woƒe nunɔ-lawo fiaa nu ame le fetu ta, eye woƒe nyagblɔɖilawo gblɔa nya ɖl le ga ta; woziɔna ɖe Yehowa ŋu nɔa gbɔgblɔm be: Ɖe Yehowa mele mia dome oa? Dzɔgbevɔ̃ea ɖeke mele mia, dzi va ge o.

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: Eyata le mia ta woade Zion abe agble ene, Yerusalem azu glikpo, eye gbedoxɔ ƒe to azu togbɛ toave.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Eye wòava me le ŋkeke mlɔeawo me be, Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe to la akɔ ta aghɔ towo ŋu, eye wòaƒo togbɛwo ta, eye anyigba dzi dukɔwo aƒo zi ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Eye ɖukɔ geɖewo atso agblɔ bena: „Mina míayi Yehowaƒe to la kple Yakob ƒe Mawu ƒe aƒe la gbɔ, ne wòafia eƒe mɔwo mí, eye míazɔ eƒe toƒewo!“ Elabena nufiame atso Zion, eye Yehowa ƒe nya atso Yerusalem.

english_verse: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na ɖukɔ geɖewo, eye wòatso nya me na anyigba dzi ɖukɔ geɖewo vaseɖe didiƒe ke. Woatsɔ woƒe yiwo atu agblenuwoe, eye woatsɔ woƒe akplɔwo atu hɛ gohɛwoe; dukɔ magatsɔ yi ɖe dukɔ ŋu azɔ o, eye womagasrɔ̃ aʋawɔwɔ azɔ o.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Eye wo dome amesiame abɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe eƒe weinka kple eƒe gboti te bɔkɔɔ; elabena Yehowa Zehaotƒe nue gblɔe,

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Elabena ne ɖukɔ-wo katã dometɔ ɖesiaɖe le zɔzɔm le eƒe mawu ƒe ŋkɔ me hã la, míawo ya míazɔ le Yehowa, mía Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ me ɖaa tegbee. Woagaƒo Israel nu ƒu, eye woaɖee le tohehe nɛ megbe.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Le ɣemaɣi la maƒo abutɔlawo nu ƒu, eye makplɔ amesiwo kaka hlẽ, kple amesiwo dzi mehe gbegblẽ vɛ la, ɖe du.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Mana abutɔlawo nazu ame susɔeawo, eye amesiwo wonyã yi didiƒee, nazu dukɔ sesẽ, eye Yehowa aɖu fia ɖe wo nu le Zion-to la dzi tso fifia ɖaseɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: Mount Zion in Jerusalem, guardian of my people, you will rule again.
translation_verse: Ke wò lãhawo ƒe xɔ tsrala, wò Zion-nyɔnuvi ƒe toghɛ, dziɖuɖu tsãtɔ asu asiwò, Yerusalem-nyɔnuvl ƒe fiaɖuƒe asu asiwò.

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Azɔ nukaŋutl nẽle aƒa ɖom ale? Ɖe fiaa ɖeke megale me-wò o, eye adaŋudela bu ɖe wò, ale be nẽle ku lém abe nyɔnu, si le vi ɖzim la enea?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Zion-nyɔnuvi; ƒo togotogoe nalé ku abe uyɔnu, si le vi ɖzim la ene! Elabena ele na wò be, naʋu le ɖua me aɖanɔ gbedadaƒo, eye naɖe Babel ke; afima woaɖe wò le, eye afima Yehowa axɔ wò le wò fu-tɔwo si me le.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Ekema ɖukɔ geɖewo aƒo takpli ɖe ŋuwò agblɔ bena: „Wogblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ, eye míaƒe ŋkuwo aɖl ƒo ɖe Zion ŋu!“

english_verse: But they don't know that I, the Lord, have gathered them here to grind them like grain.
translation_verse: Ke womenyaa Yehowa ƒe: susuwo o, eye womedzea si eƒe tameɖoɖowo be, eli kɔ wo abe lubabla ɖe lugbɔƒe ene o.

english_verse: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
translation_verse: Zion-nyɔnuvi, tso nafanya nu! Elabena mana wò dzo nanye gayibɔ, eye wò afɔkli nanye akɔbli, ne nagbã dukɔ geɖewo gudugudu, eye nakɔ aboyonuwo ŋu na Yehowa kple woƒe kesinɔnuwo ŋu na anyigba blibo la dzi Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
translation_verse: Ke wò Betlexem Efrata, esi nènye suetɔ le Yuda ƒe ƒomeawo dome hã la, mewò Israel ƒe dziɖula le dzɔdzɔ ge atso nam, amesi dzɔɣi tso tititi le gbaɖegbe ʋĩ ke.

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Eyata atsɔ wo aɖe asi vaseɖe ɣeyiɣi, si funɔa ɖe nadzi vi; emegbe nɔviawo ƒe mamlea atrɔ agbɔ akpe ɖe Israel-viwo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will abandon Israel only until this ruler is born, and the rest of his family returns to Israel.
translation_verse: Ado ahatsɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋusẽ kple eƒe Mawu, Yehowa ŋkɔ ƒe gãnye-nye anyi woe, eye woanɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ, elabena alolo azɔ vaseɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenu.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Eyama anye gŋutifafa. Eye ne Asur va míaƒe anyigba ɖzi, eye wòbe, yeaɖo afɔ mlaƒe fiasãwo me la, míadɔ lã-kplɔvi adre kple amegã enyi ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: Woatsɔ yi agblẽ Asur ƒe anyigba la, eye woadi yi agblẽ Nimrod ƒe anyigba la; woaɖe mi tso Asur si me, ne eva míaƒe anyigba dzi, eye wòbe, yeaɖo afɔ míaƒe llƒowo dzi la.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe ame mamleawo anɔ ɖukɔ geɖewo dome, abe Yehowa ƒe zãmu kple tsiɖzadza ɖe gbe dzi, si mekpɔa amea ɖeke sinu o, eye melalaa amegbelɔvia ɖeke o la ene.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Eye Yakob ƒe ame mamleawo anɔ anyigba ɖzi dukɔwo me le ɖukɔ geɖewo dome abe dzata le gbemelãwo dome ene, abe dzatavi le alẽhawo dome, si, ne eto wo dome la, enyãa avuzi le nu dzi, eye wòvuvua nu, ke xɔnametɔa ɖeke menɔa anyi o la ene.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ɣemaɣi la matsrɔ̃ wò sɔwo ɖa le dowòme, eye magblẽ wò tasiaɖamwo.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ wò anyigba ɖzl duwo, eye magbã wò mɔ̃ sesẽwo katã aƒu anyi.

english_verse: as well as your cities and your fortresses.
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ dzokawo le asiwò, eye gbesalawo maganɔ asiwò azɔ o.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ wò aklama kpakpɛwo kple aƒeliwo ɖa le ɖo-wòme, eye magaɖe ta agu na wò aslnudɔwɔwɔwo azɔ o.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Maho wò Aserawo ɖa le dowòme, eye magblẽ wò duwo.

english_verse: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.
translation_verse: Eye mabia hlɔ̃ ɖukɔ, siwo gbe toɖoɖo la, le dɔmedzoe kple dziku me.

english_verse: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
translation_verse: Mise nya, si gblɔm Yehowa le: Tso nahe nya kple towo, eye togbɛwo nase wò gbe!

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: Mi towo kple anyigba ƒe agunu sesẽwo, mise Yehowa ƒe dzrenya! Elabena dzre le Yehowa kple eƒe ɖukɔ la dome, eye wòle ʋɔnu yi ge kple Israel.

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, nukae mewɔ wò, eye fu kae meɖe na wò ma? Ɖo ŋu nam!

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Nyee kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, mexɔ wò ƒle tso kluvinyenyeƒe me, eye medɔ Mose, Aron: kple Miryam woɖze ŋgɔwò ɖe!

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: Nye ɖukɔ, ɖo ŋu tame, si Moab-fia Balak ɖo, kple alesi Bileam, Beor vi la, ɖo eŋu nɛ; ɖo ŋu nya, siwo dzɔ tso Sitim vaseɖe Gilgal, ne nadze si Yehowa ƒe dɔmenyo! Numeme, si dzea Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Nukae matsɔ ɖe asi ado ɖe Yehowa ŋku me, eye made ta agu ɖe Mawu ɖziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋku me? Ɖe matsɔ enumevɔsa kple nyivi, siwo xɔ ƒe ɖeka la, ɖe asi ado ɖe eŋku mea?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: Ɖe agbo akpewo kple amitɔʋu akpe nanewo adze Yehowa ŋua? Ɖe matsɔ vinye ŋgɔgbea ana ɖe nye dzidadawo ta kple nye dɔmevi ana ɖe nye luʋɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃wo taa?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ, egblɔ nusi nyo la na wò; nusi ko dim Yehowa le tso asiwò la, enye be, nawɔ nusi le eteƒe, nalɔ̃ dɔmenyowɔwɔ, eye uabɔbɔ ɖokuiwò ɖe anyi ahazɔ le wò Mawu ŋku me.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Yehowa le du la yɔm; amesi vɔ̃a wò ŋkɔ la, nunyalae; milé to ɖe ameƒoti kple amesi ɖoe ɖa la ŋu! Nuku manyomanyoa ɖe ŋeɣi.

english_verse: You store up stolen treasures and use dishonest scales.
translation_verse: Ɖe kesinɔnu madzɔmadzɔ kple nudotree nyaŋui, si ŋu fi-ƒode le la, gale ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe me koa?

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Ɖe matso afia na ame, ne nuɖanu madzɔmaɖzɔ li, eye nudakpe amebatɔ le akplo mea?

english_verse: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.
translation_verse: Elabena woƒe kesinɔtɔwo yɔ fũ kple ŋulasesẽ, duametɔwo ka aʋatso, eye alakpaɖe le nu me na wo.

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Eyata nye hã maƒo wò vevie, eye magblẽ dowòme le wò nuvɔ̃wo la.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Àɖu nu, ke màɖi ƒo o, eye ɖɔ anɔ wuwòm ɖaa; ne èdzra nu ɖo la, ɖeke makpɔtɔ o, eye ne ɖe susɔ la, matsɔe ade asi na yi.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Àƒã nu, ke màŋe nu o; ãɖa ami, ke mãkpɔ ami asi o; àfiã aha, ke mãkpɔ wein ano o.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: Miewɔ nu ɖe Omri ƒe ɖoɖowo kple Axab ƒe aƒe ƒe nuwɔnawo katã ŋu, eye miezɔ ɖe woƒe adaŋudedewo nu, ne matsɔ wò awɔ gbegbee, duametɔwo nazu tsiãdonu, eye nye dukɔ ƒe ɖzu uauɔ mia dzi.

english_verse: I feel so empty inside— like someone starving for grapes or figs, after the vines and trees have all been picked clean.
translation_verse: Baba nam! Elabena ezu nam, abe alesi kutsetsegbeɣi kple weiuxaɣl nu yinae ene: weintsetsea ɖeke meli, ne woaɖu o, eye nye ve me le fiefiẽm ɖe kutsetse ŋgɔgbea ŋu.

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔlawo nu yi le anyigba ɖzi, eye ame dzɔdzɔea ɖeke megale amegbetɔwo dome o; wo kalã wode xa ɖe ʋu ŋu, eye woɖo ɖɔ na wo nɔewo.

english_verse: People cooperate to commit crime. Judges and leaders demand bribes, and rulers cheat in court.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ sɔ alɔ me na wo; amegã dia nu, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la drɔ̃a ʋɔuu le fetu ta, eye dumegãwo gblɔa nusi le wo dzrom; ale woblua afɔ na nya.

english_verse: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.
translation_verse: Ame nyuitɔ le wo dome le abe ŋu ene, eye nuteƒewɔla vɔ̃ɖi wu aŋɔka. Le wò gbetakpɔlawo ƒe ŋkekea dzi la tohehe ava na wò; azɔ tɔtɔ aɖo wo dome.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Migaxɔ miaƒe zɔhɛ ɖzl se o, eye migaɖo dzi ɖe mia xɔlɔ̃ kutsimea ŋu o; kpɔ wò aɖe dzi le nyɔnu, si le akɔwònu la ghɔ.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Ŋutsuvi aɖe alɔme le fofoa ŋu, eye nyɔnuvi atso ɖe dada ŋu; lɔ̃xoyɔvinyɔnu atso ɖe lɔ̃xoa ŋu, eye ŋutsu ƒe aƒemetɔwo anye eƒe futɔwo. Mawu ƒe amenuveve ŋugbedodo le tohehe megbẽ.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Ke nye la matsa ŋu na Yehowa, eye makpɔ Mawu, nye xɔnametɔ sinu; nye Mawu ase nye gbe.

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: Nye futɔ, meganɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm ɖe ŋunye, o; elabena ne medze anyi la, magafɔ, eye ne mebɔbɔ nɔ viviti me la, Yehowa ye nye nye kekeli.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Mado dzi atsɔ Yehowa ƒe dziku, elabena mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe eŋu, vaseɖe esime wòadrɔ̃ nye nya ahatso nam; akplɔm aɖo ɖe kekeli nu, eye makpɔ eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ŋku.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Nye ketɔ, amesi le gbɔgblɔm nam be: Afika Yehowa, wò Mawu, le hã la, akpɔe, eye ŋukpe alée. Nye ŋku aɖi ƒo ɖe eŋu, emegbe woafanyae abe ba le kpɔdomee ene.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke la ghɔna, be woaɖo wò gliwo, eye wò liƒowo ate ayi adzɔge ʋĩ gbemagbe.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Ke anyigba anye gbegbe le edzinɔlawo ŋuti le woƒe nuwɔnawo ƒe kutsetse ta.

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò atikplɔ kplɔ wò dukɔ, wò ŋutɔ wò lãha, siwo ɖe ɖe aga le ave me le Karmel dzi; woaɖu gbe le Basan kple Gilead abe blema ene.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Mana wòakpɔ nukunuwo abe gbesigbe nèʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ene.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Dukɔwo akpɔe, eye woƒe ŋusẽwo katã akpe ŋu na wo, woatsɔ asi aɖo nu, eye woƒe towo me atsi.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Woaɖuɖɔ kewɔ abe dawo kple anyigba dzi nutatawo ene, eye woadzo nyanyanya aɖo atso woƒe mɔ̃wome; dzidzi aƒo wo woava Yehowa, mía Mawu la gbɔ, eye woavɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Mawu kae ɖe nuwò? Wò amesi tsɔa vodada kena, eye mèléa ŋku ɖe wò domenyinu mamlea ƒe dzidada ŋu o; meléa dɔmedzoe ɖe ɖɔ me ɖikaa o, eye amenuveve ƒe nu dzea ŋuwò.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Agakpɔ nublanui na mi, àxɔ aɖi le miaƒe vodadawo si, eye wòatsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã aƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu ƒe gogloƒe.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Àwɔ nuteƒe na Yakob, eye àve Abraham nu, abe alesi nèka atam na mía fofowo tso blema ŋɔli ke ene.

english_verse: The Lord God demands loyalty. In his anger, he takes revenge on his enemies.
translation_verse: Mawu: ŋuʋãla kple hlɔ̃biala enye Yehowa; Yehowa biaa hlɔ̃, eye dzl kunɛ vevie; Yehowa biaa hlɔ̃ eƒe ketɔwo, eye wòléa nya ɖe dɔ me na eƒe futɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbɔa dzi ɖi blewu, eye ŋusẽ gã le esi, ke megbea tohehe o. Yehowa ƒe mo to ahom kple ya ʋuduʋudu me, eye alilikpowo nye eƒe afɔ ƒe ʋuʋudedi.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: Eblu ɖe atsiaƒu: ta wòmie, eye wòna tɔsisiwo katã ƒu kplakplakpla; Basan kple Karmel woyrɔ, eye Libanon ƒe numiemiewo yrɔ.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Towo ʋuʋu le eŋgɔ, togbɛwo lólo gbanaa, eye anyigba kple xexeame kpakple emenɔlawo katã dzo kpekpekpe le eŋku me.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Ameka ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe eƒe dziku nu, eye ameka ato ɖe eƒe dɔmedzoe heliheli nu? Etrɔ eƒe dziku ƒo ɖi abe dzo ene, eye agakpewo le wowom le eŋgɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔme nyo, enye sitsoƒe le xaxagbe, eye wònya amesiwo ɖoa dzi ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Ke ana tsi naƒo ɖi bababa, eye wòatsrɔ̃ eƒe nɔƒe, eye wòalsɔ viviti ayɔ eƒe fulɔwo ɖe nu.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Tame ka miebe, yewoaɖo ɖe Yehowa ŋu? Ele nu tsrɔ̃ ge, eye xaxa maɖo ta ɖa zi evelia o.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: Elabena ne woɖo wo nɔewo me nyamanyama abe aŋɔka ene, eye woƒo tsi abe woƒe nunonowo ene la, woabi keŋkeŋ abe gbe ƒuƒu ene.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Gbɔwòe amesi ɖo tame vɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye wòɖe adaŋu vlo la tso.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa ghlɔ esi; Ne ŋusẽ le wo ŋu, eye wosɔ ghɔ kpaŋ hã la, woasẽ wo ɖa, eye wo nu ayi; mehɔhɔ wo ɖe anyi, ke nyemagabɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi azɔ o.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Azɔ maŋe eƒe kɔkutl ɖa le dziwò, eye matso eƒe kawo.

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ke ŋuwò la, ale Yehowa ɖo ɖi enye si: Womagatsɔ wò ŋkɔ aƒã azɔ o; matsrɔ aklama kpakpɛwo kple legba kɔkɔwo ɖa le wò mawuwo ƒe me; maɖe yɔɖo na wò, elabena èle wodzoe akpa.

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ɖu nyui xɔla ƒe afɔwo ɖo towo dzi, eye wòle gbe ƒã ɖem ŋutlfafa be: Yuɖa, ɖu wò ŋkekenyuiewo, eye nawɔwò adzɔgbeɖeɖewo dzi; elabena ame vlo la magaƒo ɖe, dzlwò azɔ o, wo-tsrɔ̃e keŋkeŋ!

english_verse: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
translation_verse: Nughlẽla le ƒoƒo ge ɖe dziwò: Kpɔ mɔ̃ sesẽwo ta, eye natsa ŋu te mɔ dzl, bla ali dzi, eye nade dzo la me vevie!

english_verse: Nineveh, on this day of attack, your enemies' shields are red; their uniforms are crimson.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa agaghughɔ Yakob ƒe gãnyenye vɛ abe Israel ƒe gãnyenye ene. Elabena nuhalawo hae keŋkeŋ, eye woghlẽ eƒe weinkawo.

english_verse: Their horses prance, and their armored chariots dart around like lightning or flaming torches.
translation_verse: Eƒe kalẽtɔwo ƒe akpoxɔnuwo biã hẽ, eye aʋawɔlawo le abe aɖabɛ dzitɔ ene, tasiaɖam ŋu gawo le dzo kem le akpablagbe, eye wole akplɔwo nyẽm.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Tasiaɖamwo le zi nyẽm le kpɔdomeewo; eye wole du dzi le ablɔwo me; wole abe kakatiwo ene, eye wole zɔzɔm abe dzikedzo ene.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Woaɖe ama fiasrɔ̃ akplɔ adzoe,: eƒe nyɔmidɔlawo anɔ fafam abe akpakpa ene, eye woanɔ akɔta ƒom.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Tso gbaɖegbe ke Niniwe le abe ta, si tsi yɔ fũ ene; ke woasi, eye ne wobe, „mitɔ, mitɔ“ la, amea ɖeke menye kɔ o.

english_verse: Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed! Her people tremble with fear; their faces turn pale.
translation_verse: Miha klosalo, miha sika! Aƒemenuwo teƒe mekɔ o, eye nu vevi vovovowo sɔ gbɔ kpaŋkpaŋ!

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Woaɖi gbɔloe ƒiaƒiaƒia, eye woahae! Dziwo alólo gbanaa eye klowo anɔ ƒoƒom kpakpakpa, aliwo katã adzo nyanyanya, eye ŋkumewo katã afu tititi.

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Afika dzatawo nɔƒe le azɔ, eye afika dzataviwo ƒe nuɖuƒe le, afisi dzatatsu kple dzatanɔ kpakple dzataviwo tsana le, eye amea ɖeke medoa vodi na wo o?

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Dzata lé nu alesi atu viawo nu, eye wòwu nu na dzatanɔwo; etsɔ adzonu yɔ eƒe ɖowo fũ kple nuléle yɔ enɔƒewoe.

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Baba na hlɔ̃dodu, si me alakpadada hɔ ɖo, ŋutasesẽ yɔe fũ, eye wòghe aslɖeɖe le adzodada ŋu!

english_verse: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;
translation_verse: Fu to anyi, sɔƒokawo le ɖiɖim, eye tasiaɖamfɔwo le zi nyẽm, sɔwo le du dzl, eye tasiaɖamwo le hoo wɔm!

english_verse: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
translation_verse: Le gbolo ƒe ahaslwɔwó vivivo kple dzotɔ dzetugbee nyo la, amesi tso eƒe gholowɔwɔ ƒle dukɔwoe, eye wòtsɔ eƒe dzosasa ƒle ƒomewoe ta la,

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: kpɔ ɖa, ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Maƒo ɖe dziwò, eye maɖe wò taɖedzi lewo ŋutɔ ŋkuwò me, mana dukɔwo nakpɔ wò ama, eye fiaɖuƒewo nakpɔ wò ŋukpeƒe.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nu nyɔŋuwo axlã ɖe wò, maɖi gbɔ wò, eye matsɔ wò aɖo kpɔdzidzee.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Eye wòava me be, ne amea ɖe to ŋuwò yina la, asi le nuwo agblɔ bena; Wogblẽ Niniwe, ameka afa nɛ, eye afika maɖadi akɔfala le na wò?

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: Ɖe nènye wu No-Amon, si hɔhɔ nɔ Nil-tɔsisi to, tsi ɖe to ɖee goɖoo, atsiaƒu nye kpo nɔ eŋu, eye tsi nye gli nɔ eŋu laa?

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Kusitɔ kple Egiptetɔ gbogboawo nye eƒe ŋusẽ, Putitɔwo kple Lubitɔwo nye wò xɔnametɔwo.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Ke wonyã eya hã ɖe gbe wòyi aboyo me, eye woxlã viawo ɖe kpɔdomeewo ƒe dzogoewo katã, wodzidze nu ɖe eƒe bubumewo dzl, eye wode kɔsɔkɔsɔ eƒe amegãwo katã.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Wò hã àmu aha, wò mo atsyɔ zi, eye nadi sltsoƒe le futɔ la nu.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Wò mɔ̃ sesẽwo katã le abe gboti, siwo dzi kutsetse ɖiɖiwo le la ene; ne woʋuʋu wo la, woade adze nu me na wo ɖula.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wò amewo le abe nyɔnuwo ene le dowòme; wò anyigba ƒe agbowo aʋu wo ɖokul na wò futɔwo siaa, eye dzo afiã wò gametiwo.

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: Du tsi na ɖokuiwò, elabena wole to ɖe ge ɖe wò, eye ƒu kpo ɖe dzi, ɖo agbi me nanyã anyi, eye namè anyikpewo!

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Afima dzo aɖu wò le, aɖu wò abe ʋefra ene, eye yi atsrɔ̃ wò, ne éde ha abe ʋetrawo ene, eye nèsɔ gbɔ kpaŋkpaŋ abe ʋetsuviwo ene hã.

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Wo asitsalawo sɔ gbɔ wu dziƒoɣletiviwo, ke ʋetrawo aɖɔ li aʋala ahadzo adzo.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Wo amegãwo le abe ʋetrawo ene, eye wò aʋaflawo le abe ʋe-tsuviwo ƒe ha ene, wodzona ɖe gliwo ŋu le gbesigbe vuvɔ le wɔwɔm, ke ne ɣe dze la, wotuna dzona, eye womegadzea siwo teƒe o.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Asur-fia, wò lãkplɔviwo le alɔ̃ ɖɔm, eye wò bubumewo le gbɔgbɔm ɖe eme, wò amewo kaka ɖe towo dzi; eye amea ɖeke meƒo wo nu ƒu o.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Wò ghe-ghlẽ nu mafa o, eye hayahaya manɔe na wò ahlxɔxɔ o. Amesiwo katã se nya le ŋuwò la, aƒu akpe ɖe ŋuwò; elabena ameka dzie wò vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ meheva atraɖii o ma?

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: Yehowa, ɣekaɣi mana yɔwòm sesĩe, eye nagbe esese ase ɖo? Mado ɣli na wò le ŋutasesẽ ta, ke màxɔ na ame o?

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèna mele nu vlo wɔwɔ teƒe kpɔm, eye nèle hiãkame kpɔm kple ŋku, gbegblẽ kple ŋutasesẽ le ŋkunye me, avuwɔwɔ li, eye dzre dzɔ?

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Eyata se la ŋutl nufiafia me gbɔdzɔ, eye nuteƒewɔwɔ megadona ɖe gota o. Elabena ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖe to ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe, eyata nuteƒewɔwɔ trɔ tagbo hafi do.

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: Miɖe ŋku de dukɔwo dome, mikpɔ nu, eye miaƒe nu neku! Elabena mele nane wɔ ge le mia ŋɔli, eye ne wotoe na mi la, miele exɔ ge ase o.

english_verse: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, manyɔ Kaldeatɔwo, dukɔ nyanyrã, si ƒe afɔ tsɔna; woatu anyigba ƒe ke-keme, ne woaxɔ nɔƒe, siwo menye wo tɔ o la.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi kple vɔvɔ̃ anɔ eŋu, ade se, eye wòaɖu gã ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe akɔta.

english_verse: Their cavalry troops are faster than leopards, more ferocious than wolves hunting at sunset, and swifter than hungry eagles suddenly swooping down.
translation_verse: Eƒe sɔ wo ɖi ɖu wu lãkle, eye woƒe afɔ, wo tsɔ wu famegãxi le zã me, eƒe sɔdolawo le zi nyẽm, didiƒe ke eƒe sɔdolawo tso, eye wole dzodzom abe hɔ̃, si le abla ɖem ɖe nuɖuɖu ŋu la ene.

english_verse: They are eager to destroy, and they gather captives like handfuls of sand.
translation_verse: Wo katã wova ɖe ŋutasesẽ ŋu, wotso woƒe ŋkume tu ŋgɔ tẽ, eye weƒo aboyo mewo nu ƒu abe ke ene

english_verse: They make fun of rulers and laugh at fortresses, while building dirt mounds so they can capture cities.
translation_verse: Woaɖe alɔme le fiawo ŋu, eye woaku amegãwo, mɔ̃ sesẽwo anye fefenu na wo, eye woatsɔ anyi aƒu kpoe ahaxɔ wo.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Emegbe aho adzo abe ahom ene, eye enu ayi; ke amesi tsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ wɔ mawui la: to vo ɖe eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
translation_verse: Yehowa, nye Mawu, nye kɔkɔetɔ, ɖe menye wòe li tso blema ke oa? Míele kuku ge o. Yehowa, wòe ɖoe na ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃, wò agakpe, wòe ɖoe na tohehe.

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Wò amesi ƒe ŋkuwo dza, be màte ŋu akpɔ nu yɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ o, eye màte ŋu alé ŋku ɖe hiãkame ŋu o, nu kaŋuti nèle ame tovo kpɔm kpleŋku, eye nèzi kpi, ne ame vɔ̃ɖi mi amesi nye ame dzɔdzɔe wui la?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Ewɔ amegbetɔ abe ƒumelã ene, abe nutata, siwo nu aƒetɔa ɖeke mele o la ene.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Etsɔ ƒu he wo katã ɖe go, eɖe wo kple eƒe ɖɔ, eye wòlɔ wo trɔ ɖe eƒe aguɖɔe me. Eyata wòle dzidze kpɔm le aseye tsom ɖo.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Eyata wòsavɔ na eƒe ɖɔ, eye wòɖo dzudzɔ na eƒe aguɖɔe; elabena woawoe na eƒe gome ɖa ami, eye eƒe nuɖuɖu sɔ gbɔ fũ.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Ɖe wòanɔ eƒe ɖɔ kam, eye wòanɔ dukɔwo wuwu dzi ɖaa nublanui makpɔmakpɔea?

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Mayi nye dzɔƒe, eye matsi tre ɖe xɔta, ne matsa ŋu akpɔ nya, si wòle gbɔgblɔ ge nam, kple nya, si tsɔ ge wòala aɖo nye nyahehe ŋu nam

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ɖo ŋu nam gblɔ bena: Ŋlɔ ŋutega la ɖi, eye naɖee ɖe kpe dzi, be wòanya xlẽ bɔbɔe.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Elabena azãgbe li na ŋutega la, eƒe nuwuwu le aƒe tum, eye maflu ame o; ke ne etsi megbe la, kpɔ esinu; elabena ele vava ge kokoko, eye mahe ɖe megbe o.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eƒe luʋɔ vu gblotoo, eye meto mɔ ɖeka le eme o; ke ame dzɔdzɔe ya anɔ agbe to eƒe xɔse me. Nyagblɔɖi le dadalawo ƒe gbegblɛ̃ ŋuti. Kaldeatɔwo ƒe nuwo.

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Wein la, ameflulae, ŋutsu adegbeƒola manɔ anyi aɖe dzi ɖi akpɔ o, eyama keeƒé nu abe tsieƒe ene, eye nu meɖia ƒo na o abe sãɖagatsi ene, eƒo dukɔwo katã nu ƒu ɖe eɖokui gbɔ, eye wòlɔ anyigba ɖzi dukɔwo katã li kɔe ɖe eɖokui gbɔ.

english_verse: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
translation_verse: Ɖe amesiawo katã mado hamelo ɖe eŋu, woasi ahama, eye woado lo ɖe eŋu agblɔ hena: „Baba na amesi ƒo nu geɖe ƒu, hafi menye etɔ o, eye wòtsɔ awɔbanu do agba na eɖokui la“ oa? Ɣekaɣi wòanɔ anyi ase ɖo?

english_verse: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò fetɔwo matso kpoyi, amesiwo axaxa wò ɖo la, nanyɔ, eye woahe wò oa?

english_verse: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.
translation_verse: Elabena esi nèha dukɔ geɖewo la, eyata dukɔwo ƒe susɔeawo katã aha wò le ameʋu, si nèka ɖe anyi, kple ŋuta, si nèsẽ le anyigba kple ɖu la kpakple emenɔlawo katã ŋu la ta.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Baba na amesi tafaa ame na eƒe aƒe, ne wòawɔ atɔ ɖe dziƒo ʋĩ, be wòasi le dzɔgbevɔ̃e nu la!

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋukpe ɖe ta me ɖe wò aƒe ŋu, esi nèbe, yeatsrɔ̃ dukɔ geɖewo, eye nègblẽ wò agbe dome.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Elabena kpewo axlɔ̃ le gli me, eye daɖedziwo aɖo ŋu na wo le xɔtiwo me.

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: Baba na amesi tsɔ ʋu tso dui, eye wòtsɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ tu mɔ̃e!

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ɖe menye Yehowa Zebaot gbɔ wòtso be, dukɔwo nadze agbagba bena dzo, eye anyigba dzi dukɔwo naku kutri yakatsyɔ oa?

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Elabena sidzedze Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ayɔ anyigba dzi taŋ, abe alesi tsi yɔ atsiaƒui ene.

english_verse: You're doomed! You get your friends drunk, just to see them naked.
translation_verse: Baba na amesi na nu ehavi wòno, eye wòku dziku nɛ wono mu, be yeakpɔ eƒe ama!

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe aɖi ƒo na wò, eye menye bubu o; wò hã noe, ne naɖe ama, Yehowa ƒe nuɖusi lé kplu la wòva ɖo gbɔwò, eye, wò bubu aɖi gbɔ.

english_verse: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
translation_verse: Elabena ŋuta, si wosẽ le Libanon ŋu la, ava ddiwò, eye lã, siwo wotsrɔ̃ la, aɖo ŋɔdzi na wò le ameʋu, si nekɔ ɖe anyi, kple ŋuta, si nèsẽ le anyigba kple du la kpakple emenɔlawo katã ŋu la ta.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Viɖe ka nye aklama kpakpɛ be, ekpala kpae, eye viɖe ka nye legba kɔkɔ kple alakpanufiala be, legbamela le dzi ɖom ɖe eƒe legba ŋu, esi wòwɔ legba maƒonuwo?

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Baba na amesi lé gbɔgblɔm na ati be: Nyɔ! eye na kpe maƒonu be: Fɔ! Ɖe wòate ŋu afia nu amea? Kpɔ ɖa, sika kple klosalo wotsɔ fa ɖe eŋu, eye gbɔgbɔ ku ɖeka hã mele eme o.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa le eƒe gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me; anyigba blibo la nezi ɖoɖoe le eŋku me.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: Yehowa, esi mese nya le ŋuwò la, vɔvɔ̃ ɖom! Yehowa, gbɔ agbe wò dɔwɔwɔ le ƒewo ƒe domedomee, ɖee fia Ie ƒewo ƒe domedomee; ɖo ŋku nublanuikpɔkpɔ dzi le dɔmedzoedodo me!

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu tso Teman, eye kɔkɔetɔ la tso Paran-towo dzi. Sela. Eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nyẽ tsyɔ dziƒo, eye eƒe kafukafu yɔ anyigba dzi taŋ.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Keklẽ ɖo abe ɣe tɔ ene, keklẽ le eƒe axa dzi, eya mee eƒe ŋusẽ be ɖo.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Dɔvɔ̃ dze eŋgɔ, eye dzoxɔxɔ kplɔe ɖo.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Etɔ, eye anyigba ʋuʋu; eɖo ŋku anyi kpɔ nu, eye dzidzi ƒo dukɔwo, blema towo fe kpla, gbaɖegbe togbɛwo ŋe dze eme, eye wòzɔ blema mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ Kusan ƒe agbadɔ wòle hlã me, agbadɔvɔwo le dzodzom nyanyanya le Midian-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, were you angry with the monsters of the deep? You attacked in your chariot and wiped them out.
translation_verse: Yehowa, tɔsisiwo ŋue dzi le kuwòm ɖoa, tɔsisiwo ŋue nèle dɔmedzoe dom ɖo loo, alo atsiaƒu ŋue dzi le kuwòm ɖo, be nèdo wò sɔwo, eye neɖo wò tasiaɖamwoa?

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Wò dati ɖi ƒeƒle, eye aŋutrɔwo yɔ wò daku fũ. Sela. Emã tɔsisiwo me wòzu anyigba ƒuƒui.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Towo kpɔ wò, eye wodzo kpekpekpe, eye tɔwo gbagba ɖe anyi bababa; agumetsiwo na wose wo ŋkɔ, eye wodo alo ɖe dzi.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: Ɣe kple ɣleti tɔ ɖe wo teƒe, bene wò aŋutrɔ, siwo le yiyim la, nanye kekeli, eyewò akplɔ, siwo le dzo kem la, nanye keklẽ.

english_verse: In your furious anger, you trampled on nations
translation_verse: Eto anyigba dzi le dziku me, eye nè fanya dukɔwo ledɔmedzoe me.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Eho, be naxɔ na wò dukɔ, naxɔ na wò amesiamina la; egbã ta le ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aƒe nu, eye wòɖi ƒeƒle tso afɔ gɔme vaseɖe kɔ gbɔ. Sela.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe akplɔ ƒo ɖe ta na eƒe amegãwo, wonyẽ zi va, be woakam ahlẽ; wole aseye tsom abe ɖe wohe, yewoaɖu ame dahe le bebe me ene.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Etsɔ wò sɔwo to atsiaƒu kple tɔ gã nyanyrãwo dzi.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Mesee, eye nye dɔme ʋuʋu, nye nuyiwo le ƒoƒom kokóko, eye ŋuɖui ɖo ƒuwo me nam; ne metsi tre ɖi la, menɔa dzodzom nyanyanya, elabena mele anyi nɔ ge kpoo akpɔ hiãɣi, si le dukɔ, si xaxa mí ɖo la dzi va ge.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Gboti magaƒo se o, eye weinka matse o; amiti agbe aminana, eye agblewo mana, nuɖuɖu o; woatsrɔ̃ alẽwo le lãkpɔwo me, eye nyiwo maganɔ lãxɔwo me o.

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: Ke nyea matso aseye, eye makpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Mawu, nye xɔnametɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yehowa enye nye ŋusẽ, awɔ nye afa abe zinɔ tɔ ene, eye wòana mazɔ: kɔkɔƒewo. Na kasaŋkuwo ƒe henɔ.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe gbe, si va na Zefanya, Kus, amesi nye Xizkiya vi Amarya ƒe vi Gedalya ƒe vi la, le Yuda-fia Yosiya, Amon vi la ŋɔli.

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Matsrɔ̃ nusianu ɖa le anyigba dzi petepete.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ amegbetɔwo kple lãwo, dziƒoxewo kple ƒumelãwo, matsrɔ̃ nuɖianuwo kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖa, eye matsrɔ̃ amegbetɔwo ɖa le anyigba dzi, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: Mado nye asi ɖa ɖe Yuda kple Yerusalemtɔwo katã ŋu, eye ma-tsrɔ̃ Baal ƒe susɔea ɖa le teƒe sia akpe ɖe trɔ̃nuawo kple nunɔlawo ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu;

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: matsrɔ̃ amesiwo dea ta agu na dziƒo ŋu nuwo la, akpe ɖe amesiwo dea ta agu na Yehowa, gake wogakaa atam na Milkom la siaa ŋu;

english_verse: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.
translation_verse: eye matsrɔ̃ amesiwo trɔ le Yehowa yome, kple amesiwo medi Yehowa alo bia eta se kpɔ o la siaa.

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Mizi ɖoɖoe le Aƒetɔ Yehowa ŋku me, elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe, elabena Yehowa do vɔsagbe la ɖi, eye wòkɔ amesiwo wòkpe la ŋu!

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Eye wòava me le Yehowa ƒe vɔsagbe be, mahe to na amegãwo kple fiaviwo kpakple amesiwo katã taa dutatɔwo ƒe avɔwo la.

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
translation_verse: Mahe to na amesiwo katã tia kpo flɔa kpuiwo, eye wotsɔa ŋu-tasese kple alakpadada yɔa wo-ƒe aƒetɔ ƒe xɔwo taŋ la, gbemagbe.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: Gbemagbe la asiƒunu aɖl tso tɔmelãgbo la nu, avifafa atso du la ƒe to evelia, eye hoo-wɔwɔ gã atso togbɛwo dzl, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Mi ʋe me nɔ-lawo, mifa avi, elabena woatsrɔ̃ asitsalawo katã kple amesiwo do klosalogba ɖe ta.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la matsɔ akaɖi atsa le Yerusalem, eye mahe to na amesiwo katã ɖo ƒã ɖi hele gbɔgblɔm le woƒe dzl me be: Yehowa mele nyui alo vɔ̃ wɔ ge o.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Woaha woƒe ke-sinɔnuwo, eye woƒe aƒewo azu aƒedo; woatu xɔ, ke womanɔ eme o, eye woade weingble, ke womano eƒe wein o.

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke gã la tu aƒe, etu aƒe, eye wòle du dzi ŋutɔ. Yehowa ƒe ŋkeke la ŋkɔ le ɖiɖim, eye kãletɔ le aʋaɣii dom sesĩe.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoedogbe, hiãgbe kple xaxagbe, aƒedoɖigbe kple nu-gblẽgbee, blukɔ- kple vivitidogbee, alilikpo kple tsizidogbee;

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: lãdzo- kple kpẽkugbe wòanye ava du sesẽwo kple xɔta kɔkɔwo dzi.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Mahe xaxa ava amegbetɔwo dzi, ne woanɔ yiyim abe ŋkunɔwo ene, elabena wowɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe Yehowa ŋu; woakɔ woƒe ʋu ɖe anyi abe ke ene, eye woƒe dɔmenuwo adudu ɖe anyi abe mi ene.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Woƒe klosalo kple sika hã mate ŋu aɖe wo le Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoedogbe o, eye eƒe ŋuʋa-ʋã ƒe dzo afiã anyigba blibo la; elabena ele anyigbadzitɔwo katã tsrɔ̃ ge zi ɖeka.

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: hafi ne tameɖoɖo la ƒe vidziɣi naɖo, eye ɣeyiɣi la nu nayi, abe alesi gbe ƒuƒu ʋua yae ene, hafi ne Yehowa ƒe dɔmedzoe heliheli nava mia dzi, eye hafi ne Yehowa ƒe dzikudogbe nava mia dzi!

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Midi Yehowa, mi amesiwo katã bɔbɔ mia ɖokul ɖe anyi le anyigba dzi, midi dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye midi ɖokuibɔbɔ yome mɔ, amea ɖe menye nu o woatsɔ mi aɣia le Yehowa ƒe dzikudogbe la hĩ!

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Elabena Gaza azu du gbɔlo, eye Askalon azu aƒedo; woanyã Asdoɖ le ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ, eye woaho Ekron kple ke.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Baba na mi Krefa-ɖukɔ, mi amesiwo le atsiaƒu nu! Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba Kanaan, mia ŋue Yehowa ƒe gbe va ɖo, eye matsrɔ̃ wò, ale be ame navɔ le dziwò.

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Kreta azu lãnyiƒe na lãkplɔvlwo kple lãkpɔ na alẽwo.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Anyigba, si le atsiaƒu nu la, azu Yuɖa ƒe aƒe la ƒe ame mamleawo tɔ, eye woaɖu gbe le edzi; woatsyɔ akɔ ɖe Askalon ƒe aƒewo me le fiẽ, ne Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la, va kpɔ wo ɖa, eye wògaɖo wo te.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: Mese Moab ƒe alɔmeɖeɖe kple Amon-viwo ƒe vloɖoɖo, wo amesiwo ɖe alɔme le nye ɖukɔ ŋu, eye woka ɖe eƒe anyigba ŋu.

english_verse: And so, I swear by my very life that Moab and Ammon will end up like Sodom and Gomorrah— covered with thornbushes and salt pits forever. Then my people who survive will take their land.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa Zebaot, Israel ƒe Mawu la, gblɔ esi: Metà ɖokuinye ƒe agbe: Ne Moab mazu abe Soɖom ene, eye Amon-viwo abe Gomora ene o fĩ! Woazu ŋuve, dzeʋe kple gbegbe tegbee; nye ɖukɔ ƒe susɔea aha wo, eye nye dukɔ ƒe mamlea atsɔ wo anyi domee.

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Esia adzɔ ɖe wo dzi le woƒe ɖãɖa ta, elabena woɖe alɔme eye woka ɖe Yehowa Zebaot ƒe ɖukɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Yehowa anye ame dziŋɔ anɔ wo nu, elabena ana legbawo katã nu nayi le anyigba dzi, eye dukɔwo ƒe ƒukpowo katã aɖo gbe ɖa na, amesiame le enɔƒe.

english_verse: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ado eƒe asi ɖa ɖe anyiehe ŋu, eye wòatsrɔ̃ Asur, ana Niniwe nazu gbegbe, eye wòaƒu kplakplakpla abe tagba ene.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Lãhawo kple gbemelã vovovowo atsyɔ akɔ ɖe eme, eye aluge kple hlɔmaɖe atsi woƒe sɔtiwo ƒe ko te aɖɔ. Ha anɔ ɖiɖim le fesre nu, eye anyiglãgo anɔ kpui nu, elabena seɖerʋuƒowo atsi go.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Ɖe ɖu, si nɔa aseye tsom, eye wòli bɔkɔɔ henɔa gbɔgblɔm le eƒe dzi me be: Míawoe nye gɔglɔ̃mitɔgɔ̃wo la, nye esia? Ke azɔ la ezu gbegbe kple gbemelãwo mlɔƒe, eye amesiame, si ato eŋu ayi la, ado tsiã, eye wòaʋuʋu asi.

english_verse: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!
translation_verse: Baba na ɖu sẽto, si ƒo ɖi, eye wòsẽa ŋuta!

english_verse: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
translation_verse: Egbe toɖoɖo, eye mena wohe to nɛ o; meɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu o, eye mete ɖe eƒe Mawu ŋu o.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Eƒe amegawo le eme abe dzata ɖegbe ene, eye eƒe ʋɔnuɖrɔ̃lawo le abe amegãxi, siwo le zã me, eye womekpɔtɔa naneke ɖi na ŋdi o la ene.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Eƒe nyagblɔɖilawonye toflokowo kple alakpatɔwo; eƒe nunɔlawo ɖo gu nu kɔkɔe la, eye woto vo ɖe se la ŋu.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa enye dzɔdzɔetɔ le wo ɖome, eye mewɔa nu gbegblẽa ɖeke o; eɖea eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ doa goe ŋdi sia ŋɖl, eye medzudzɔnɛ o; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi menya nuka nye ŋukpe o.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: Metsrɔ̃ ɖukɔwo, eye woƒe mɔ̃wo gbã; meɖo gbegbe woƒe ablɔwo, eye ame megatoa wo me yina, o; woƒe ɖuwo gbã zu aƒeɖo, eye ame vɔ le wo me.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: Megblɔ be; Ne evɔ̃m, eye wòna wobe to nɛ la, ekema nyemagblẽ eƒe nɔƒe o, eye nusiwo katã meɖo ɖe eŋu la, mava edzi o; ke wole nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ dzi ɖaa atraɖi.

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Mikpɔ asinyenu, vaseɖe gbesigbe manye ɖasefo atso; elabena nye ɖoɖo wònye be, maƒo dukɔwo nu ƒu, eye mana fiaɖuƒewo nakpe ta, ne matrɔ nye dziku kple nye dɔmedzoe heliheli katã akɔ ɖe wo dzi. Elabena nye ŋuʋaʋã ƒe dzo afiã anyigba blibo la. Mesia ƒe vavaɣi ŋugbedodo.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Emegbe makɔ nuyi ŋu na dukɔwo, ne wo katã nayɔ Yehowa ŋkɔ, eye woatsɔ nusɔsɔ asubɔe.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Nye ameka, siwo ka hlẽ, amesiwo ɖoa gbe ɖa nam la, atso tɔsisi la ƒe go keme le Kus, eye woahe vɔsanuwo vɛ nam.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la ŋu magakpe wò le wò nuwɔna, siwo katã nètsɔ to vo ɖe ŋunye la ŋu o; elabena maɖe amesiwo nɔa aseye tsom nɔa ɖa-dam la ɖa le dowòme, eye màgado ɖokuiwò ɖe dzi le nye to kɔkɔe la dzi azɔ o.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Eye makpɔtɔ dukɔ ɖagbi, si bɔbɔ eɖoku ɖe anyi la, ɖe mewò, eye woaɣia wo ɖokul ɖe Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Israel ƒe ame mamleawo mawɔ nu gbegblẽ o, womaka aʋatso o, eye alakpaɖe manɔ nu me na wo o; ke hoŋ woaɖu nu, eye woatsyɔ akɔ anyi ɖl, amea ɖeke maɖo voɖl na wo o.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
translation_verse: Zion-nyɔnuvi, tso aseye, Israel, ɖo ɣli; Yerusalem-nyɔnuvi, kpɔ dzidzɔ, natso aseye tso dzi blibo me!

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ɖa, eye wòkplɔ wò futɔ dzoe; Yehowa, Israel ƒe fia la, le dowòme, nu vɔ̃ɖia ɖeke madzi ŋɔ na wò azɔ o.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la woagblɔ na Yerusalem be: Megavɔ̃ o; Zion, wò asi megaɖo agblɔ o!

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò Mawu la, le dowòme, kalẽtɔ, si ate ŋu axɔ na ame la wònye. Akpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋuwò vevie, azi ɖoɖoe le lɔlɔ̃ me, eye wòakpɔ dzldzɔ atso aseye ɖe ŋuwò!

english_verse: The Lord has promised: Your sorrow has ended, and you can celebrate.
translation_verse: Maƒo amesiwo le nu xam, eye wole adzɔge tso takpekpe gbɔ la nu ƒu; mia deviwo wonye, eye ŋukpe le wo dzi.

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mawɔ nu kple amesiwo katã te mi ɖe anyi la ɣemaɣi, makpe ɖe ata ŋeŋee tɔwo ŋu, maƒo: amesiwo kaka hlẽ la nu ƒu, eye matso wo awɔ kafukafu kple bubu le anyigba, siwo katã dzi wodo ŋukpe wo le la dzi.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ma-kplɔ mi agbɔe ɣemaɣi, eye maƒo mia nu ƒu ɣemaɣi; elabena ne meɖo mi te miekpɔ kple ŋku la, matso mi awɔ bubu kple kafukafu le anyigba dzi ɖukɔwo katã ɖome; Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Le fia Dario ƒe ƒe evelia me? le dzinu adelia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Yuda ƒe anyigbanunɔla Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple nunɔlagã Yosua, Yozadak vi, to nyagblɔɖila Xagai dzi bena:

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: Mieƒã nu taŋtaŋ, gake nu ʋeea ɖe ko mieŋe; miedu nu, meɖi ƒo na mi o; mieno nu, meɖi kɔ na mi o; mieta avɔ, mede dzo lã me na mi o; miewɔ dɔ xɔ fetu, eye mietsɔe de kotoku ŋɔŋɔ me.

english_verse: Think about what I have said!
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Milé ŋku ɖe mia ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu!

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Miyi towo dzi miatsɔ atiwo vɛ, be miatu xɔ lae, ne wòadze ŋunye, eye bubu nanɔ ŋunye, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: Miele nu geɖe sinu kpɔm, gake mesɔ gbɔ o; miehe nu va aƒee, ke meɖo ƒuƒu ɖee. Yehowa be: Nuka tae ma? Le esi nye xɔ nye glikpo li, ke miawo mia dome amesiame le duɖime kem le eƒe xɔtutu me la tae!

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Eyata ɖziƒo te zãmu mi, eye anyigba, te agblemenu mi ɖo;

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: eyata meyɔ kuɖiɖi ɖe anyigba kple towo ŋu, ɖe bli, aha yeye kple ami ŋu, ɖe nusiwo miena tsoa anyigba me la ŋu, ɖe amegbetɔwo kple lãwo kpakple dɔ, siwo katã wotsɔa asi wɔne la ŋu.

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple nunɔlagã Yosua, Yozadak vi, kpakple dukɔ la ƒe susɔeawo katã wose Yehowa, woƒe Mawu ƒe gbe kple nyagblɔɖila Xagai ƒe nya, siwo Yehowa, woƒe Mawu la, de asi nɛ ɖo ɖe wo; eye dukɔ la vɔ̃ Yehowa.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Eye Xagai, Yehowa ƒe ame dɔdɔ la, to Yehowa ƒe gbe na dukɔ la bena: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Meli kpli mi.

english_verse: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
translation_verse: le fia Dario ƒe ƒe evelia me le dzinu adelia ƒe ŋkeke blave vɔ enelia dzi.

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Yuda ƒe anyigbanunɔla Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, kple nunɔlagã Yosua, Yozadak vi, kpakple dukɔ la ƒe susɔea bena:

english_verse: Does anyone remember how glorious this temple used to be? Now it looks like nothing.
translation_verse: Mia dometɔ susɔea, siwo kpɔ xɔ tsãtɔ ƒe atsyɔ̃ la, aleke miele esia kpɔmi? Esia meɖi naneke le mia ŋku me o ɖe!

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: abe alesi meɖo gbe ɖi kpli mi, esime mieʋu tso Egipte la ene; eye nye gbɔgbɔ anɔ mia dome. Migavɔ̃ o!

english_verse: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Esusɔ vie ko maʋuʋu dziƒo kple anyigba, atsiaƒu kple ƒuƒuiƒe;

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: maʋuʋu dukɔwo katã, eye woahe dukɔwo katã ƒe nu vevitɔ vɛ, eye matso ŋutikɔkɔe ayɔ xɔ sia taŋ, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: All silver and gold belong to me,
translation_verse: Tɔnyee nye klosalo, eye tɔnyee nye sika, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Xɔ megbetɔ ƒe atsyɔ asu gbɔ wu gbãtɔ tɔ, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe! Eye made ŋutifafa teƒe sia, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Mibia nunɔlawo, ne woafia nu mi be:

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsua ɖe lɔ lã kɔkɔe ɖe avɔ nu; eye avɔ la toga ka abolo alo nuɖaɖa, wein, ami alo nuɖuɖua ɖe ŋu la, ɖe nusiawo ŋu akɔa? Nunɔlawo ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Kpao.

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Eye Xagai gblɔ bena: Ne amea ɖe gblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui ɖe ame kuku ŋu, eye wòka, asi nusiawo katã ŋu la, ɖe woawo hã azu nu makɔmakɔa? Nunɔlawo ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Woazu nu makɔmakɔ.

english_verse: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
translation_verse: Tete Xagai ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Yehowa be: Alea dukɔ sia kple anyigba dzi dukɔ sia le; alea woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã kple vɔ, siwo wosana la le; wo ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,
translation_verse: Azɔ minyẽ kɔ kpɔ megbe tso egbe dzi, esi womekpɔ tsɔ kpe ɖo kpe dzi le Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ la tutu me haɖe o:

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Xagai zi evelia, le dzinu la ƒe ŋkeke blave vɔ enelia dzi bena:

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Mehe to na mi ɖe miaƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã ŋu, ale be miaƒe bliwo hlɔ̃, eye wodze heteku, eye dzikpewo dza; gake miegbe tɔtrɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Today you have completed the foundation for my temple, so listen to what your future will be like.
translation_verse: Minyẽ kɔ kpɔ megbe tso egbe, dzinu asiekelia ƒe ŋkeke blave vɔ enelia dzi vaseɖe gbesigbe woɖo Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ gɔme anyi la dzi; milé ŋku ɖe eŋu:

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: De nukuwo tsi ava mea, eye ɖe wein kple gboti, yevuboɖati kple amiti wogbe tsetsea? Made yayra aƒe tso ŋkeke ma dzi.

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Yuda ƒe anyigbanunɔla Zerubabel bena: Mele dziƒo kple anyigba ʋuʋu ge,

english_verse: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.
translation_verse: mamũ fiaɖuƒewo ƒe fiazikpuiwo aƒu anyi, eye miatsrɔ̃ dukɔwo ƒe fiaɖuƒe sesẽwo, mamũ tasiaɖamwo kple wo me nɔlawo aƒu anyi, sɔwo kple wo dolawo adze anyi, eye amesiame atsi ehavi ƒe yi nu.

english_verse: But tell my servant Zerubbabel that I, the Lord All-Powerful, have chosen him, and he will rule in my name.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Ɣemaɣi la matsɔ wò, nye ɖɔla Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi, awɔ ŋkɔsigee; elabena wòe metia, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Le Dario ƒe ƒe evelia me, le dzinu enyilia dzi la Yehowa ƒe gbe va na nyagblɔɖila Zaxarya, Iɖo vi Berexya ƒe vi, bena:

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: Eyata ale nagblɔ na wo enye si: Yehowa Zebaot be: Mitrɔ ɖe ŋunye, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe, ekema nye ha matrɔ ɖe mia ŋu, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Miganɔ abe mia fofowo ene o; wo amesiwo nyagblɔɖila tsãtɔwo gblɔ na bena: Yehowa Zebaot be: Miɖe asi le miaƒe zɔzɔme vɔ̃ɖiwo kple nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu! Ke wogbe toɖoɖo, eye womelé ŋku ɖe ŋunye o, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
translation_verse: Afika mia fofowo le azɔ, eye ɖe nyagblɔɖila-wo ami agbe tegbetegbea?

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Ke nye gbe kple nye fameɖoɖo, siwo meɖe asi na nye dɔla nyagblɔɖilawo la, ɖe womeva mia fofowo dzi, ale be woyi ta me hegblɔ bena: Alesi Yehowa Zebaot ɖo be, yeawɔ mi ɖe miaƒe zɔzɔme kple míaƒe nuwɔnawo nu la, nenema wòwɔ mi oa? Sɔdola la le amitive me.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: Le za me la mekpɔ ŋutega, eye kpɔ ɖa, ŋu-tsua ɖe do sɔ dzĩa ɖe, eye wòtɔ ɖe gbemiti, siwo le bali me la domee, eye sɔ, siwo le dzie, hẽ kple ɣle la, le emegbe.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Tete me-gblɔ bena; Nye aƒetɔ, amekawoe nye esiawo? Eye mawudɔla, si ƒo nu kplim la, gblɔ nam bena: Magblɔ amesiwo wonye la, afia wo.

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Tete ŋutsu, si tɔ ɖe gbemitiawo domee la, xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Woawo nye amesiwo Yehowa ɖɔ, be woaɖatsa le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Eye woɖo ŋu na Yehowa ƒe dɔla, si tɔ ɖe gbemitiawo domee la, gblɔ bena: Míeyi ɖatsa le anyigba dzi, eye kpɔ ɖa, ɖo-ɖoe zi le anyigba blibo la ŋu klenee.

english_verse: The Lord's answer was kind and comforting.
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nya nyui kple akɔfanyawo na mawudɔla, si ƒo nu kplim, la,

english_verse: So the angel told me to announce: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am very protective of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla, si ƒo nu kplim le gblɔ nam bena: Ɖe gbe ƒã be: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Maʋã ŋu ɖe Yerusalem kple Zion nu vevie,

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: eye dzi akum vevie ɖe dukɔ dadalawo ŋu; elabena esi dɔ me nya vem vie ko la, woawo kpe asi ɖe eŋu hetrɔ gbegblẽ la ɖo.

english_verse: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.
translation_verse: Eyata ale Yehowa gblɔ esi. Makpɔ nublanui na Yerusalem agatrɔ ɖe eŋu, woatu nye xɔ ɖe eme, eye woada dzidzeka ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Gaɖe gbe ƒã bena: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi; Nu nyui agagbagba ɖe nye ɖuwo me, Yehowa agave Zion nu, eye wòagatia Yerusalem.

english_verse: This time I saw someone holding a measuring line,
translation_verse: Tete mefɔ ko dzi heɖo ŋku anyi, eye mekpɔ lãdzo ene,

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ na mawudɔla, si ƒo nu kplim bena; Nusiawo gɔme ɖe?. Eɖo ŋu nam bena; Woawoe nye lãdzo, siwo kaka Yuda, Israel kple Yerusalem hlẽ la.

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be; Nuka wɔ ge amesiawo va? Eɖo ŋu bena; Esiawo nye lãdzo, siwo kaka Yuda hlẽ, ale be amea ɖeke megafɔ ta dzi o la; eyata wova, be yewoaɖo ŋɔdzi na wo, eye yewoatutu dukɔ, siwo kɔ dzo dzi ɖe Yuda-nyigba ŋu, be woakakae ahlẽ la ƒe dzowo aƒu anyi. Ŋutsu la kple nudzidzeka la.

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ bena: Afika nèyina? Eɖo ŋu nam bena; Yerusalem dzidze ge meyina, ne niakpɔ alesi wòkeke kple alesi wòdidii.

english_verse: Leave Babylonia and hurry back to Zion.”
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla, si ƒo nu kplim la ɖo, eye mawu-dɔla bubu do va kpee.

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nɛ bena: Ɖe abla naɖagblɔ na ɖekakpuivi ma bena: Yerusalem anɔ nuvo le ame kple lã geɖe, siwo anɔ eme la ta.

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: Hee! hee! Misi tso anyiehenyigba dzi, Yehowa ye gblɔe; elabena mekaka mi hlẽ ɖe dziƒo ƒe ya eneawo dzi, Yehowa ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Elabena ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi. Bubu ta wòdɔm ɖe dukɔ; siwo ha mi la gbɔ ɖo; elabena amesi ka asi mia ŋu la, eka asi eƒe ŋkuvi ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, manyẽ nya asi ɖe wo ŋu, ne woazu aboyonu na woƒe kluviwo, eye miadze sii be, Yehowa Zebaot ye ɖɔm ɖa.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Eye wòna mekpɔ nunɔlagã Yosua tsi tre ɖe Yehowa ƒe dɔla ŋku me, eye Satana tsi tre ɖe eƒe ɖusi me, be wòatso enu.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ nu Satana bena: Yehowa blu ɖe tawò, Satana, Yehowa, amesi fia Yerusalem la, blu ɖe tawò! Ɖe menye eyae nye ati takpoe woɖe tso dzo me oa?

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Tete wòxɔ edzi gblɔ na amesiwo tsi tre ɖe eŋku me la bena; Miɖe awu ƒoɖlawo le eŋu! Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, meɖe wò voɖaɖawo ɖa le ŋuwò, eye maɖo atsyɔ̃wuwo na wò.

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ bena: Woatsɔ tablanu dzadzɛ abla ta nɛ! Tete wotsɔ tablanu dzadzɛ bla ta nɛ, eye wodo awuwo nɛ, esime Yehowa ƒe dɔla gali ko.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe dɔla xlɔ̃ nu Yosua gblɔ bena:

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Ne ézɔ nye mɔwo dzi, eye nèlé ŋku ɖe nye ɖoɖowo ŋu, énɔ nye aƒe nu, eye nèlé ŋku ɖe nye xɔxɔnuwo ŋu la, ekema maɖe mɔ na wò nazɔ amesiwo tsi tre ɖi la dome.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: Wò nunɔlagã Yosua kple xɔ̃wò, siwo bɔbɔ nɔ gbɔwò la, misee; elabena ŋutsu, slwò nye kpɔdzidze la wonye. Elabena mele nana ge nye dɔla Zemax nava.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Elabena woafɔ ŋku adre ɖe kpe, si metsɔ ɖo Yosua ŋku me la dzi; kpɔ ɖa, ma-ŋlɔ nu ɖe edzi, eye maɖe anyigba sia ƒe voɖaɖa ɖa le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣl la mia ɖome amesiame akpe nɔvla ayi weinka kple gbotiwo te, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Tete mawudɔla, si ƒo nu kplim la, trɔ gbɔ va nyɔm, abe alesi wonyɔa ame tsoa alɔ̃ me ene.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Nuka kpɔm nèlé? Meɖo ŋu bena: Mele akaɖitia ɖe, si wolsɔ sika ɖeɖe wɔe la kpɔm; aminu le eta me, eye akaɖlgbɛ adre le eŋu, eye alɔ adre, siwo me to le la, le aka-ɖlgbɛawo ŋu.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Amiti eve le exa, ɖeka le aminu la ƒe ɖusi me, eye evelia le eƒe mia me.

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Tete wòɖo ŋu gblɔ nam bena: Yehowa ƒe gbe na Zerubabel enye si: Mava me to aʋa-kɔ alo ŋusẽ me o, ke hoŋ to nye gbɔgbɔ dzi, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe!

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: Wò to gã, nenye nuka ke nènye hã, azu gbadzaƒe le Zerubabel ŋku me. Eyama aɖe etamakpe adoe, eye woanɔ ɣli dom be: Eme nenye, eme nenye nɛ!

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Zerubabel ƒe asie ɖo xɔ sia gɔme anyi, eye eƒe asi kee awu enu, ne nadze sii be, Yehowa Zebaot ye ɖom ɖe mia gbɔ.
