english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Elabena amekae ado vlo gɔmedzedze nyaŋui? Weakpɔ tsumikpe, si le Zerubabel si la, kple dzidzɔ, wo ame aɖre siawo nye Yehowa ƒe ŋku, siwo le tsatsam le anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Tete meɖo ŋu gblɔ nɛ hena: Amiti eve, siwo le akaɖiti la ƒe ɖusi me kple mia me la gɔme ɖe?

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Eye megaxɔ edzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Amitiɖɔmee eve, siwo Ie si-kalɔ, siwo me to le, eye sikami sina tea wo me la xa la gɔme ɖe?

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam bena: Mènya nusiawo gɔme oa? Meɖo ŋu bena: O, nye aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Woawo nye amivi eveawo, siwo tsi tre ɖe anyigba blibo la ƒe Aƒetɔ ŋku me.

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Eye megafɔ kɔ dzi heɖo ŋku anyi, eye mekpɔ agbalẽ toaʋa-laa ɖe.

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam bena: Nuka kpɔm nèle? Meɖo ŋu bena: Mele agbalẽ toaʋalaa ɖe kpɔm wòdidi abɔklugui blave, eye wòkeke ahɔklugul ewo.

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam hena: Esia nye fiƒode, si le anyigba blibo la dzi yim; elabena fiafitɔwo katã tsi tomahemahe, eye atam dzodzro kalawo katã tsi tomahemahe.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Nyee ɖoe ɖa, be wòayi fiafitɔ kple atam dzodzro kala ƒe me le nye ŋkɔ me, eye wòatsi eƒe xɔ me afiã eƒe xɔtlwo kple kpewo.

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Eye mawuɖɔla, si ƒo nu kplim la, ɖo va gblɔ nam bena: Fɔ kɔ dzi nakpɔ nusi do gbɔna la ɖa!

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: Nuka enye esia? Eɖo ŋu hena: Esia enye nudotree, si ɖo gbɔna. Eye wògblɔ bena: Eyae nye woƒe vodada le anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, tsumigbaa ɖe kɔ eɖokui dzi eye nyɔnua ɖe bɔbɔ nɔ nudotree la me.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Esia enye nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ. Tete wòtigii ɖe nudotree la me, eye wòtsɔ tsumigba tu enu.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Eye esi mefɔ kɔ dzi la, mekpɔ nyɔnu eve wodo va, eye ya ɖo aʋala me na wo, woto aʋala abe ɖamixe ƒe aʋala ene, eye woka nuɖotree la ɖe dziƒo kple anyigba domee.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Eye mebla mawudɔla, si ƒo nu kplim la bena: Afika wokɔ nuɖotree la yinae?

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu nam bena: Ɖe wobe, yewoatu xɔ nɛ ɖe Sinear-nyigba dzi, eye ne wotui vɔ la, woatsɔe adre ɖe enɔƒe le afima.

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Eye megafɔ ke dzi heɖo ŋku anyi, eye mekpɔ taslaɖam ene woto to eve domee; toawo nye akɔbli towo.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Sɔ dzĩwo le tasiaɖam gbãtɔ ŋu, eye sɔ ylhɔwo le tasiaɖam evelia ŋu,

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: sɔ ɣiwo le tasiaɖam etɔ̃lia ŋu, eye sɔ ŋɔŋɔe hẽwo le taslaɖam enelia ŋu.

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Tete mexɔ edzi gblɔ na mawu-dɔla, si ƒo nu kplim la bena: Nye aƒetɔ, nusiawo gɔme ɖe?

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla la ɖo ŋu gblɔ nam bena: Woawoe nye dziƒo ƒe ya eneawo, siwo tso, esime wotsi tre ɖe anyigba blibo la ƒe Aƒetɔ ŋku me megbe.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Tasiaɖam, siwo ŋu sɔ yibɔwo le la, ho ɖo ta anyiehe, eye ɣiawo kplɔ wo ɖo; ke ŋɔŋɔeawo ho ɖo ta dziehe.

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Eye dzĩawo ho, be yewoayi aɖatsa le anyigba dzi. Eye wògblɔ bena; Miyi miaɖatsa le anyigba la dzi! Tete woɖatsa le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Eye wòyɔm gblɔ nam bena: Kpɔ ɖa, esiwo ho ɖo ta anyiehe-nyigba dzi la, woawoe le nye dɔmedzoe nu fa ge le anyiehe-nyigba dzi. Fiakuku ɖɔɖɔ na nunɔlagã Yosua.

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Eyama atu Yehowa ƒe gbeɖoxɔ la, eye atsyɔ̃ anɔ eŋu, abɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi aɖu fia, anye nunɔla anɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi, eye ŋutlfafa anɔ woa kple eve la dome.

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Ke fiakuku la nenɔ Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ me, ne woafsɔ aɖo ŋku Xeldai, Tobiya kple Yedaya kpakple Zefanya vi la ƒe dɔmenyowɔwɔ dzi

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Amewo atso dldiƒe ava tu Yehowa ƒe gbedoxɔ, eye miadze sii be, Yehowa Zebaot ye dɔm ɖe mi. Esia ava me, nenye be, miese Yehowa, mia Mawu la ƒe gbe.

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Le fia Dario ƒe ƒe enelia me la Yehowa ƒe gbe va na Zaxarya, le dzinu asiekelia Kislew ƒe ŋkeke enelia dzi.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: eye woabia nunɔlawo kple nyagblɔɖilawo, siwo le Yehowa Zebaot ƒe me la, agblɔ bena: Ɖe mafa avi atsi nu aɖɔ le dzinu atɔ̃lia me, abe alesi mewɔ ƒe geɖe xoxo enea?

english_verse: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For
translation_verse: Gblɔ na dukɔ hahoo la katã kple nunɔlawo bena: Esi mietsi nu ɖɔ, eye miexa nu le dzinu atɔ̃lia kple adrelia me ƒe blaadre sɔŋ nye esi la, nyee mietsi nu dɔ na loo?

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Eye ne mieɖu nu no nu la, ɖe menye mia ŋutɔwoe nye nuaɖulawo kple nuanolawo oa?

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye esia nye nya, si Yehowa tsɔ ɖe gbe ƒãe to nyagblɔɖila tsãtɔwo dzi, esime Yerusalem kple eƒe ɖu, siwo ƒo xlãe goɖoo la, li bɔkɔɔ, eye ame le wo me, eye ame le dziehe kple gbadzaƒe la oa?

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Miɖrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe, eye mia dome amesiame nelɔ̃ ehavi, eye wòakpɔ nublanui nɛ!

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Migate ahosiwo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo, amedzrowo kple ame dahewo ɖe anyi o, eye migaɖo nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ɖe ta me ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu o!

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe dzi wɔ lotamekpee, be yewomagase se la kple Yehowa Zebaot ƒe nya, siwo wòɖo ɖa to eƒe gbɔgbɔ kple nyagblɔɖlla lsã tɔwo dzi la o; eyata dɔmedzoe ga tso Yehowa Zebaot gbɔ va ɖo.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Eyata alesi meyɔ wo wogbe esese la, nenema woayɔm, ke nyemasee o, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: Makaka wo ahlẽ ɖe dukɔ, siwo katã womenya o la ɖome, eye anyigba la atsi anyi aƒeɖoe le wo megbe, ale be amea ɖeke magato edzi ayi o; eye ale woatsɔ anyigba vevi la awɔ gbegbee.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa Zebaot ƒe gbe va bena:

english_verse: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Meʋã ŋu ɖe Zion nu vevie, eye meɖo dziku vevie be ʋã ŋu ɖe enu.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Magatrɔ ɖe Zion ŋu, eye manɔ Yerusalem. Woayɔ Yerusalem be, „nyateƒeɖu“, eye Yehowa Zebaot ƒe to la be „to kɔkɔe“.

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: Ŋutsuvlwo kple nyɔnuvlwo ayɔ ɖua ƒe ahlɔwo me laŋ, eye woanɔ fefem le eƒe ahlɔwo me.

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔesl: Ne enye nukunu na dukɔ sia ƒe susɔea le ɣemaɣi la, ɖe wòanye nukunu na nye ha loo? Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖe nye dukɔ tso ɣedzeƒe-nyigba kple ɣeloɖoƒe-nyigba dzi,

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: eye makplɔ wo vɛ, ne woanɔ Yerusalem, woanye nye dukɔ, eye manye Mawu na wo le nyateƒe kple dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi. Agbe neɖo miaƒe asiwo me mi amesiwo se nya siawo tso nyagblɔɖilawo nu le ŋkeke siawo me, nya, siwo wogblɔ na mi le gbe sigbe woɖo Yehowa Zebaot ƒe xɔ la gɔme anyi, be woagatu gbeɖoxɔ la.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Hafi ŋkeke siawo naɖo la, fetu menɔ anyi na amegbetɔwo kple lãwo o; amesi do alo va eme la ŋu mefa o, le futɔ ta, eye meɖe adã ta me na amegbetɔwo katã ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la nyemele na dukɔ sia ƒe susɔea abe tsã ene o, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe;

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: ke boŋ nuku ŋu afa, eye weinka atse, anyigba aʋã nu, eye dziƒo adza zãmu, eye mana nusiawo katã nazu dukɔ sia ƒe susɔea tɔ.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Yuda ƒe aƒe kple Israel ƒe aƒe, alesi mienye fiƒoɖe le dukɔwo ɖomee la, nenema maxɔ na mi, be miazu yayra; migavɔ̃ o, agbe neɖo miaƒe asiwo me!

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Alesi meɖo ta me be, mawɔ vɔ̃ mi, eye mevem o, le esi mia fofowo ɖo dziku nam ta la, Yehowa ye gblɔe,

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: nenemae me-gaɖo ta me le ŋkeke siawo me be, mawɔ nyuie na Yerusalem kple Yuda ƒe aƒe la; migavɔ̃ o!

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Nusiwo miawɔ la, wonye esi: Amesiame neto nyateƒe na ehavi, midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe eleƒe le ŋutifafa me le miaƒe ablɔwo me!

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Migaɖo vɔ̃ ɖe dzi me ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu o, eye alakpatamkaka megavivi mia nu o, elabena melé fu nusiawo kafã, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Eya Yehowa Zebaot ƒe gbe va nam bena:

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ asi: Nutsitsidɔ le dzinu enelia kple etɔ̃lia dzi, le dzinu adrelia kple ewolia dzi azu dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple aseyatsotso kpakple ŋkekenyuie na Yuda ƒe ale la; ke milɔ̃ nyateƒe kple ŋutifafa!

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Dukɔwo kple ɖu geɖewo me nɔlawo agava.

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: Eye du si me nɔlawo atso aɖagblɔ na ekeme me nɔlawo bena: Mitso, ne míayi aɖaƒo koko le Yehowa ŋku me, eye miaɖl Yehowa Zebaot. Nye hã mayi!

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ geɖewo kple anyigba dzi dukɔ gawo ava ɖl Yehowa Zebaot la Yerusalem, eye woaƒo koko le Yehowa ŋku me.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Ɣemaɣi la ŋutsu awu atso dukɔwo ƒe gbegbɔgblɔwo kalã me alé Yuda-ŋutsu ɖeka ƒe awu toga agblɔ bena: Miayi kpli mi, elabena míese be, Mawu li kpli mi.

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ ɖe Xadrax-nyigba ŋu, kple eƒe nya, si va nɔ Damasko — elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋku le amegbetɔwo kple Israel ƒe toawo katã ŋu —

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: hekpe ɖe Xamat, si ɖo liƒo nɛ, kple Tiro kpakple Zidon ŋuti, le, esi nunya le wo si ŋutɔ ta.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tiro tu mɔ̃ sesẽ na eɖokui, eli kɔ klosalo gleglegle abe ke ene kple sika abe gbeɖuɖɔ le kpɔdomee ene.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la ana woaxɔe, eye atsiaƒu agble eƒe ŋusẽ dome, ke dzo afiã eya ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Askalon akpɔe, eye vɔvɔ̃ aɖoe; dzidzi aƒo Gaza akpe ɖe Ekron ŋu, elabena eƒe sitsoƒe azu ŋukpe. Fia atsrɔ̃ ɖa le Gaza, eye Askalon azu aƒeɖo.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Ame tsakatsakawo anɔ Asdod, eye matsi Filistitɔwo ƒe ɖaɖa nu.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Maɖe ʋu ɖa le eƒe nu me kple ŋunyɔnu ɖa le eƒe aɖuwo dzi, eya ha asusɔ na mia Mawu, eye wòanɔ abe Yuda ƒe amegãwo ene, eye Ekron anɔ abe Yebusitɔwo ene

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Manye dzɔla aƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe nye aƒeŋu le amesiwo vana gadzonu la ta, eye ŋutasẽla magaƒo ɖe wo dzi azɔ o, elabena nye ŋutɔ mekpɔe kple nye ŋkuwo. Mesia, si anye fia ŋutifafatɔ kple ŋusẽtɔ ŋugbededo.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Zion-nyɔnuvi, kpɔ dzidzɔ vevie; Yerusalem-nyɔnuvi, tso aseye! Kpo ɖa, wo fia gbɔna gbɔwò; dzɔdzɔetɔ kple xónametɔ wonye, eye wodo tedzi kple tedzivi, si nye tedzinɔ ƒe vi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ tasiaɖam ɖa le Efrayim kple sɔwo ɖa le Yerusalem, aʋadatiwo atsrɔ̃, eye wòaɖe gbe ƒã ŋutifafa le dukɔwo dome; eƒe fiaɖuƒe atso atsiaƒu nu ayi atsiaƒu nu, eye tso tɔsisi la nu vaseɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo ke.

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Maɖe esi le wo gatɔwo bã ŋu tso ɖo ƒuƒiu la me, le nu, si metsɔ bla nu kpli wo la ta.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Mi gatɔ siwo le mɔ kpɔm, mitrɔ gbɔ va mɔ̃ sesẽ la me! Mele gbe ƒã ɖem egbea be: Maɖo eteƒe na wò zi gbɔ zi eve.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Elabena mehe Yuda me abe ɖatl ene, eye metsɔ Efrayim wɔ aŋutrɔe heɖo edzi: Zion, maɖe aɖã ta me na viwòwo ɖe Helaviwo ŋu, eye matsɔ wo awɔ kalẽtɔ ƒe yii.

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Yehowa ado ɖe wo ta me, eye ele aŋutrɔ alũ ʋɔ abe dzikedzo ene. Aƒetɔ Yehowa aku kpẽ, eye wòanɔ dziehe ƒe ahom me ave yi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Yehowa Zehaot akpa wo ta, be woaɖu wo, eye woanyã avuzi le akafokpewo dzi, woano nu anɔ ɣli dom abe weinmulawo ene, eye woayɔ banaa abe vɔsalre kple vɔsamiekpul ƒe dzogoewo ene.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Yehowa, woƒe Mawu, axɔ na eƒe dukɔ ɣemaɣi abe lãha ene; elabena woanɔ dzo sim le eƒe anyigba dzi abe kpe xɔasi le fiakuku ŋu ene.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Elabena aleke wòhenyo, eye wòdze ani ale? Bli nana ɖekakpuiwo tsina, eye aha yeye nana ɖetugbiwo tsina.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Mibia tsidzadza Yehowa; Yehowa ye nana tsi dzana ɖe edza ɣi le kele me, enana dzi ɖona, eye tsi dzana na gbe me numiemiewo kalã

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Elabena aklama kpakpɛwo gblɔa nya maɖinyawo, eye hokɔnɔwo kpɔa alakpaŋutegawo, wolĩa drɔ̃e, siwo mele ɖeke me o, eye woƒe akɔfaname la toflokoe; eyata woanɔ tsa glãla tsam abe alẽwo ene, eye fu awɔ wo, elabena lãkplɔvla ɖeke meli o.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: Nye dɔmedzoe bi ɖe lãkplɔviwo ŋu, eye mahe to na gbɔ̃tsuwo elabena Yehowa Zebaot ava kpɔ Yuda ƒe aƒe, si nye eƒe lãha la ɖa, eye wòatsɔ wo awɔ eƒe sɔ, si woɖo atsyɔ̃ na le aʋa me.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Eya me dzogoekpe kple gatagbadzɛwo, eya me aʋadatiwo kple dzi-ɖulawo katã ado atso.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Woanɔ abe kalètɔwo ene ahafanya gbeɖuɖɔ le kpɔdomeewo le aʋa me; woawɔ aʋa, elabena Yehowa li kpli wo, eye sɔdolawo aɖu ŋukpe.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: Made agbe Yuda ƒe ale la ŋu, made Yosef ƒe aƒe, eye mana woatrɔ agbɔ; elabena mave wo nu, eye woanɔ abe ɖe nyemenyã wo de gbe o ene; elabena nye Yehowa enye woƒe Mawu, eye mase woƒe gbe.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Efrayim azu abe kalẽtɔ ene, eye woƒe dzi akpɔ dzidzɔ abe wein-nolawo ene; wo viwo akpɔe ahakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woƒe dzi atso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: Mala aku aƒo wo nu ƒu, elabena mexɔ wo ƒle, eye woasɔ gbɔ abe tsã ene.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: Mekaka wo hlẽ ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye woaɖo ŋku dzinye le didi ƒe ke, woawo kple wo viwo atsi agbe, eye woatrɔ agbɔ va aƒe.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Mana woagbɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, maƒo wo nu ƒu tso Asur, eye makplɔ wo ayi Gilead-nyigba kple Libanon dzi, eye teƒe matu wo nu gɔ̃ ha o.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Xaxa ava atsiaƒu dzi, eye aŋe atslaƒu ƒe tsotsoewo nu, ale be Nil-tɔsisi ƒe gogloƒewo katã namie; Asur ƒe dàda ava anyi me, eye fiatikplɔ adzo le Egipte si me.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Matsɔ Yehowa ade agbe wo ŋu, eye woazɔ le eƒe ŋkɔ me, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Libanon, ʋu wò agbowo, ne dzo nafiã wò sedertiwo.

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Mi logotiwo, mifa avi, elabena sedertiwo mũ, elabena ati nyuitɔwo gblẽ! Mi Basan ƒe sesewuwo, mifa avi, elabena woƒo ave nyadri la!

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Lãkplɔviwo ƒe avi le ɖidim, elabena woƒe atsyɔ̃ gblẽ; dzataviwo le xɔxlɔ̃m, elabena wogblẽ Yordan ƒe avegoe la!

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa, nye Mawu la, gblɔ esi; Nyi alẽ, siwo woɖo ɖi na wuwu la!

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Wo ƒlelawo wu wo, womeɖi fɔ o, eye wo dzralewo gblɔ be: Woakafu Yehowa, be mezu hotɔ! Eye wo kplɔlawo ha mekpɔ wo ta o.

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi; Nyemagakpɔ anyigbadzitɔwo ta azɔ o, eye matsɔ amesiame ade asi na ehavi kple eƒe fia, woagbã anyigba gudugudu, eye nyemaxɔ ame le wo si me o.

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Menyi alẽ, siwo woɖo ɖi na wuwu, eye woɖi hiã ŋutɔ le alẽwo dome la. Metsɔ atikplɔ eve; meyɔ ɖeka be, „dɔmefafa“, eye meyɔ evelia be, „ɖekawɔwɔ“, eye menyi alẽawo.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Metsrɔ̃ lãkplɔvi etɔ̃ ɖa le dzinu ɖeka me; woƒe nu ti kɔ nam, eye nye nu ti kɔ na woawo hã.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: Nyemele mia nyi ge o; amesi be, yeaku la, neku, amesi be, yeabu la, nebu, eye mamleawo neɖu wo nɔewo ƒe lã.

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Tete metsɔ nye atikplɔ, „dɔmefafã“, eye meŋee, ne matu nye nu, si mebla kple dukɔwo katã la.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtu gbemagbe la, alẽ ɖihiã, siwo lé ŋku ɖe ŋunye la, dze sii bena, Yehowa ƒe nya wònye.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gblɔ nam bena; Tsɔ fetu gbogbo ma, si wohe, ye-wotsɔ de bubu ŋunye la, ƒu gbe ɖe nudzraɖeƒe la me. Tete metsɔ klosalo sekel blaetɔ̃ la ƒu gbe ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe nudzraɖoƒe me.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Emegbe meŋe nye atikplɔ evelia, „ɖekawɔwɔ“, ne ma gblẽ Yuda kple Israel ƒe nɔviwɔwɔ dome.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa gagblɔ nam bena: Tsɔ lãkplɔvi mawɔnuteƒe ƒe lãkplɔnuwo.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, maɖo lãkplɔvla ɖe anyigba la dzi, mabia esiwo bu la ta se o, eye madi esiwo ka hlẽ la o, mada gbe le esiwo xɔ abi la ŋu o, eye malé fɔ ɖe sesẽawo ŋu o, ke aɖu ɖamiawo ƒe lã, eye wòavuvu woƒe afɔkliwo.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Baba na lãkplɔvi dzodzro, si gblẽ lãha la ɖe ya me! Yi neva eƒe alɔ kple eƒe ɖusi ŋku dzi! Eƒe alɔ aƒu kplakplakpla, eye eƒe ɖusl ŋku agbã.

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ ɖe Israel ŋu; Ale Yehowa, amesi keke dziƒo me, amesi ɖo anyigba gɔme anyi, eye wòwɔ gbɔgbɔ de amegbetɔ me la, gblɔ esi;

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: Yerusalem anye ahamuametre na dukɔwo katã godoo; eye ne woɖe to ɖe Yerusalem la, Yuda hã anɔ eme.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la matsɔ Yerusalem awɔ kpegbae na dukɔwo katã; amesiwo katã be, yewoakɔe la, woade abi wo ɖokui ŋu, eye anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã aƒo takpli de eŋu.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Ate Yehowa gblɔ esi; Ɣemaɣi la mado vɔvɔ̃ na sɔwo katã eye sɔdolawo adze aɖaʋa; nye ŋku anɔ te de Yuda ƒe aƒe la ŋu, ke mana dukɔwo ƒe sɔwo katã ƒe ŋku nagbã.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Eye Yuda-amegãwo agblɔ le woƒe dzi me bena: Yerusalem-tɔwo la, Yehowa Zebaot, woƒe Mawu la, enye ŋusẽ na wo.

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la matsɔ Yuda-amegãwo awɔ dzoɖesonu ɖe nake titina, woanɔ abe akakati bibi le gbe ƒuƒu me ene, eye woafiã dukɔwo katã godoo Ie ɖusl me kple mia me; ke Yerusalem aganɔ eteƒe.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: Yehowa axɔ na Yuda ƒe agbaɖɔ gbã, ne Ɖa-wlɖ ƒe aƒe kple Yerusalemtɔwo magaƒo aɖegbe ɖe Yuda ŋu akpa o.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣl la Yehowa akpɔ Yerusalemtɔwo ta, woƒe ame beliwo anɔ ɣemaɣi abe Dawid ene, eye Dawid ƒe aƒe la anɔ abe Mawu ene, abe Yehowa ƒe dɔla ene adze wo ŋgɔ.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la madi be, matsrɔ̃ dukɔ, siwo katã ho ɖe Yerusalem ŋu la. Gbɔgbɔ la ŋugbedodo. Dukɔ la fa konyi le amesi wotɔ nui la ŋuti.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: Matrɔ amenuveve kple kokoƒoƒo ƒe gbɔgbɔ akɔ ɖe Ɖawlɖ ƒe aƒe kple Yerusalemtɔwo dzi, eye woafɔ ŋku ɖe amesi woƒo nu ɖo la dzi, woafa konyi nɛ, abe alesi wofaa: konyi na tenuvi ene, eye woafa avi nɛ vevie, abe alesi wofaa avi na vi ŋgɔgbea ene.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣl la konyifafa leƒe makɔ le Yerusalem o, abe alesi wówɔ kuteƒe na Hadad-Rimon le Megiɖo-tagba ene.

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: Anyigba la afa konyi, ƒome sia ƒome etɔxɛ; Dawid ƒe aƒe ƒe ƒome la afa konyi wo tɔxɛ, eye wo srɔ̃wo wo tɔxɛ; Natan ƒe aƒe ƒe ƒome la wo tɔxɛ, eye wo srɔ̃wo wo tɔxɛ;

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣl la vuɖo aʋu na Dawid ƒe aƒe la kple Yerusalemtɔwo ɖe nuvɔ̃ kple makɔmakɔnyenye ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Le ɣemaɣi la matsrɔ̃ legbawo ƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le anyigba dzi, eye womagava ŋku dzi na ame azɔ o; eye mana nyagblɔɖilawo kple gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo hã nu natso le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe gale nya gblɔm ɖi la, ekema eƒe dzilawo, fofoa kple dadaa woagblɔ nɛ bena: Mãtsi agbe o, elabena ègblɔ alakpanya le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me; eye eƒe dzilawo, fofoa kple ɖaɖaa, woaɖa nui, ne egblɔ nya ɖi.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la ŋu akpe nyagblɔɖilawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ɖe eƒe ŋutega ŋu, ne egblɔ nya ɖi, eye womaɖo lãfuwu, be woaflu ame o.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Wo ɖo-metɔ ɖesiaɖe agblɔ bena: Nyemenye nyagblɔɖila o, agbledela menye, eye agbleɖeɖe enye nye ɖɔ tso ɖevime ke.

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Eye ne wogblɔ nɛ be: Abi kawoe nye esi le asi ŋu na wò hã la, aɖo ŋu be: Ɖe woƒom le xɔ̃nyewo ƒe me. Kplɔla gã la ku, eƒe alẽha la ka; gake wogaƒo enu ƒu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Yi, nyɔ ɖe nye lãkplɔvi kple ŋutsu, si mia kplii míebɔa ha la ŋu, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe. Dza lãkplɔvi, ne lãha nakaka ahlẽ! Ke matrɔ nye asi ɖe ame tsewo ŋu.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Woetsrɔ̃ akpa etɔ̃liawo eve le anyigba blibo la dzi, eye woaku, eye akpa efɔ̃llawo ɖeka asusɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Matso akpa etɔ̃liawo ɖeka aɖe dzo me ahalóloe, abe alesi wolóloa klosalo ene, eye madoe akpa, abe alesi wodoa sika kpɔna ene Woayɔ nye ŋkɔ, eye matɔ na wo; magblɔ be: Nye dukɔ nye esi, eye woawo agblɔ be: Yehowa enye nye Mawu!

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Maƒo dukɔwo katã nu ƒu ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, ne woawɔ aʋa kplii, woaxɔ ɖua, eye woaha xɔwo, woagblẽ nyɔnuwo, eye ɖu la ƒe afã ayi aboyo me, ke womatsrɔ̃ dukɔ la ƒe susɔe le ɖua me o.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Eye Yehowa aho awɔ aʋa kple dukɔ siawo abe gbesigbe wòwɔ aʋa le aʋakpegbe ene.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Eƒe afɔ anɔ amito, si le Yerusalem ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome la dzi, eye amito la afe de titina kpla aɖo ta ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe; lo la ƒe afã ado ta anyiehe, eye afã aɖo ta dziehe; bali la me akeke ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Eye miasi ayi nye to la ƒe bali me, elabena to la ƒe balime aɖe Azal ke; miasi, abe alesi miesi le anyigbaʋuʋu nu le Yuda-fia Uriya ŋɔli ene; Yehowa, nye Mawu la, ava eye ame kɔkɔeawo katã akpe ɖeeŋu!

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Ɣemaɣi la kekeli maganɔ anyi o, ke hoŋ vuvɔ kple tsi babla ko.

english_verse: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ɖeka kolia anɔ anyi, si le nyanya na Yehowa; ŋkeke kple zã manɔ anyi o, eye kekeli anɔ anyi le flẽwɔɣl. Mawu ƒe ameɖede.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la tsi gbagbe asi atso Yerusalem, eƒe afãaɖotaɣe-dzeƒeƒu la me, eye afã ado fa ɣe-foɖoƒeƒu la me le dzomeŋɔli kple vuvɔŋɔli siaa.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa anye fia ɖe anyigba blibo la nu; ɣemaɣi la Yehowa ɖeka ko anɔ anyi, eye ŋkɔ ɖeka ko anɔ eŋu.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Eye hiãkame, si Yehowa le hehe ge ava dukɔ, siwo katã ho aʋa ɖe Yerusalem ŋu dzi la, enye si: La aƒaƒã ɖe ŋuti na amesiame, esime wogale tsitrenu ko, ŋku aƒaƒã ɖe to me na wo, eye aɖe aƒaƒã ɖe nu me na wo.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi la Yehowa ade ʋunyaʋunya gã wo dome, ale be amesiame alé ehavi ƒe alɔnu, eye amesiame akɔ asi dzi ɖe ehavi ŋu.

english_verse: until even the people of Judah turn against those in Jerusalem. This same terrible disaster will also strike every animal nearby, including horses, mules, camels, and donkeys. Finally, everything of value in the surrounding nations will be collected and brought to Jerusalem—gold, silver, and piles of clothing.
translation_verse: Eye hiãkame ava sɔwo kple tedzisɔwo, kposɔwo kple tedziwo kpakple lã, siwo katã le asaɖa me la dzi abe hiãkame kemeawo ene. Mawufiaɖuƒe la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple kaka.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Eye ava me be; ɖukɔ siwo kalã ho ana ɖe Yerusalem ŋu ƒe susɔeawo katã ava ƒe sia ƒe, be yewoaɖe la agu na fia Yehowa Zebaot, eye yewoaɖu agbaɖɔŋke-kenyule la.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ke anyigba dzi ƒomeawo ɖometɔ; si meyi Yerusalem, be yeaɖe ta agu na fia Yehowa Zebaot o la, tsi madza nɛ o.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Esia enye tohehe na Egipte kple dukɔ, slwo katã mava, be yewoaɖu agbaɖɔŋkekenyuie la o. Woakɔ nusianu ŋu na Mawu.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Esia nye Yehowa ƒe nya, si wògblɔ na Israel to Maleaxi dzi.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Melɔ̃ mi. Eye ne miebe: Nuka nètsɔ lɔ̃ mí hã la, ale Yehowa gblɔ esi: Ɖe menye Yakob nɔvie nye Esau oa? Melɔ̃ Yakob,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: ke melé fu Esau ya; metsɔ eƒe towo wo gbegbee, eye eƒe ɖomenyinu zu gbedada ƒo na amegãxiwo.

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Ne Edom gblɔ be; Wogbã mí, ke míagatso aƒeɖoawo, ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Ne wotsoe hã la, magbãe aƒu anye eye woayɔ wo be, „nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe anyigba“ kple „dukɔ, si ŋu Yehowa do dziku ɖo ɖikaa“.

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Eye miakpɔe kple miaƒe ŋkuwo agblɔ hena; Yehowa tri akɔ gbɔ Israel ƒe anyigba ta! Tohehe na nunɔlawo kple dukɔ la le nu manyomanyo meme ŋuti.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Vi ɖea bubu fofoa ŋu, eye kluvi dea bubu eƒe aƒetɔ ŋu mi nunɔla, siwo ɖoa vlo nye ŋkɔ la, ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ na mi enye si: Nenye Fofo menye la, afika nye bubu le, eye nenye Aƒetɔ menye la, afika vɔvɔ̃, si le ŋunye la le? Eye ne miegblɔ be: Nuka mietsɔ do vlo wò ŋkɔe ha la?

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: mietsɔ nuɖuɖu makɔmakɔwo va nye vɔsamiekpui dzi hafi le gbɔgblɔm be. Nuka míetsɔ do gu wo hã? Eye miele gbɔgblɔm be: Yehowa ƒe kplɔ̃ ɖi gbe.

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Ne mietsɔ: lã ŋkuagbã va sa vɔe la, miegblɔna be, medze vɔ̃ o; eye ne mietsɔ lã ɖixɔdrɔ̃wo kple lã lédɔwo vɛ la, miegblɔna be, medze vɔ̃ o. Tsɔe yi na wò anyigbanunɔla kpɔ be, wò nu adze eŋu, eye wòalɔ wò nya hã? Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Eyata miƒo koko na Mawu, ne wòave mia nu. Miawoe wɔnusla, ɖe miebuna be, agalɔ̃ miaƒe nyaa? Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Esi mia dometɔ ɖeka nahatu agboawo, be miaganɔ dzo dom ɖe nye vɔsamiekpui dzi ɖe yakatsyɔ teƒe o ɖe! Miaƒe nu medze ŋunye o, eye nyemele vɔsanua ɖeke dim tso; mia si o, Yehowa. Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Elabena nye ŋkɔ lolo le dukɔwo dome tso ɣedzeƒe va-seɖe ɣetoɖoƒe, eye woado dzudzɔ ahasa vɔ dzadzɛ na nye ŋkɔ le teƒewo katã; elabena nye ŋkɔ lolo, le dukɔwo dome, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ke miawo miedo gui hele gbɔgblɔm be; Yehowa ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋu mekɔ o, eye edzi nuɖndu le ŋu nyɔm.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Miele gbɔgblɔm be, eɖuɖu la, fuɖename wònye; eye mietsɔ adzonuwo, lã ɖixɔdrɔ̃wo kple lã lédɔwo va sa vɔe. Ɖe mele esia dim tso mia si mea? Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Aɖl ameflula la ŋu kpekpekpe, nenye be, lãtsu le eƒe lãha me, eye wode adzɔgbe hetsɔ la nuwɔe wu na Aƒetɔ la! Elabena ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Fia gã menye, eye ŋɔdzi le nye ŋkɔ ŋu le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: Mi nunɔlawo, mia tɔe nye se siawo:

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa Zebaot gblɔ esi: Ne miegbe toɖoɖo, eye nya mede dzi gbɔ na mi o la, ekema maɖo fiƒode ɖa ɖe mia ŋu, eye matrɔ miaƒe yayra wòazu fiƒode; meƒo fi dee xoxo, elabena nya mede dzi gbɔ na mi o.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, malã alɔ na mi, mahlẽ miaƒe ŋkekenyuiewo ƒe mĩwo ɖe mo na mi, eye woakɔ mi ayi wo gbɔe.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Eye miadze sii be, nyee ɖo se siawo ɖe mi, ne wòanye nu, si mebla kple Lewi, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: Nye nu, si mebla kplii la, enye agbetɔ kple ŋutifafatɔ, eye metsɔ vɔvɔ̃ ɖe asi nɛ, evɔ̃m, eye nye ŋkɔ ɖo ŋɔdzi nɛ.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Nufiame dzɔdzɔe nɔ eƒe nu me, eye womekpɔ alakpa le eƒe nuyiwo dzi o. Ezɔ kplim le ŋutifafa kple nyateƒe me, eye wòɖe ame geɖe-wo ɖa tso vodada me.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Elabena nunɔla ƒe nuyiwo nedzra sidzedze ɖo, eye woadi nufiame le eƒe nu me; elabena Yehowa Zebaot ƒe ame dɔdɔ wònye.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ke miawo miele ɖa le mo dzi, mietsɔ nufiame na ame geɖewo dze anyi, eye miegblẽ Lewi ƒe nubabla la ɖome. Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Eyata nye hã meɖl gbɔ mi, eye mehɔhɔ mi ɖe dzi le dukɔ blibo la ŋku me; elabena mielẽ ŋku ɖe nye mɔwo ŋu o, eye miede ame dzi le nufiafia me.

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Ɖe menye fofo eɖekae li na mi katã oa, eye ɖe menye Mawu fɖekae me mi oa? Nukaŋuti mia dome amesiame awɔ nu tovo ɖe ehavi ŋu, ne míagblẽ kɔ ɖo na mia fofowo ƒe nubabla la?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Yuda wɔ nu tovo, eye wowɔ ŋunyɔnu le Israel kple Yerusalem. Elabena Yuɖa gblẽ kɔ ɖo na Yehowa ƒe kɔkɔeƒe, si gbɔ melɔ̃a nu le o, eye wode mawu tutɔ ƒe nyɔnuvi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Yehowa atsrɔ̃ ŋutsu, si wɔa nusia la ɖa le Yakob ƒe agbaɖɔwo me akpe ɖe vi kple fɔgbulyɔvi kpakple amesi saa vɔ na Yehowa Zebaot la ŋuti.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Eye nusi miagawɔ evevea la, enye si: Miatsɔ aɖatsi, avifafa kple hũɖeɖe anyẽ atsyɔ Yehowa ƒe vɔsamlekpui la, elabena megatrɔna ɖe mia ŋu o, eye mexɔa nusi dzea eŋu la, tso mia si me o.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Eye ne miegblɔ be, nuka me hã la, le esi Yehowa nye ɖasefo na mia kple wò ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃, si ŋu nèto vo ɖo la tae, evɔ wònye wò zɔhɛ kple nyɔnu, si nẽhla nu kplii la, wònye hafi.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye ame ɖekae wɔ mi, eye wole míaƒe agbe ɖe le oa? Nuka dim ame ɖeka la le? Mawu ƒe ƒome dim wole. Eyata mikpɔ miaƒe gbɔgbɔ dzi, eye megawɔ nu tovo ɖe wò ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃ ŋu o.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Elabena mele fu srɔ̃gbegbe, Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la gblɔe, kple amesi tsɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ tsyɔ eƒe avɔ dzi la, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe; eyata mikpɔ miaƒe gbɔgbɔ dzi, eye migawɔ nu tovo o!

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Mietsɔ miaƒe nyawo do dziku na Yehowa. Eye ne miegblɔ be: Nukae míetsɔ do dziku nɛ hã la ɖe miele gbɔgblɔm be: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã nyo le Yehowa ŋku me, eye woƒe nu dze eŋu, alo afika Mawu, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la la le mahã oa?

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mele nye dɔla dɔ ge ɖa, ne wòata mɔ le ŋgɔnye, eye Aƒetɔ, si ta biam miele la, ava eƒe gbedoxɔ me zi ɖeka kpoyi, kpɔ ɖa, nubabla ƒe dɔla, si ɖim miele la, le vava ge, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Amekae ado dzi anɔ anyi le eƒe vavagbe, eye amekae anɔ te ɖe eƒe dodo nu? Elabena ele abe galólola ƒe dzo ene; eye wole abe avɔnyãla ƒe adzalẽtsi ene.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: Abɔbɔ nɔ anyi alolo klosalo, eye wòadza eŋu, akɔ Lewi-viwo ŋu, eye wòadza wo ŋu abe sika kple klosalo ene, eye woasa vɔ na Yehowa le dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Eye Yuda kple Yerusalem ƒe vɔsawo avivi Yehowa nu abe le tsã ŋkekewo kple gbaɖegbe ƒewo me ene.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Maɖi ʋɔnu ɖe mia ŋu, eye manye ɖasefo zãzɛ ɖe dzotɔwo kple ahasitɔwo, atam dzodzro kalawo kple amesiwo ŋea fetu ɖe eme na dɔwɔlawo, ɖe amesiwo tea ahosiwo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple amedzrowo ɖe anyi, eye wogbem vɔvɔ̃ la ŋufi; Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Elabena nye Yehowa nyemetrɔ o, eye mi Yakob hã miedzudzɔ o.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Tso mia fofowo ŋɔli ke mieƒo asa na nye ɖoɖowo, eye miewɔ wo dzl o. Mitrɔ ɖe ŋunye, ekema nye ha matrɔ ɖe mia ŋu, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe! Eye ne miebe: Aleke míatrɔe hã la,

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: ɖe amegbetɔ aflu Mawu, hafi miawo miele fluyema? Eye ne miebe: Nuka míetsɔ flu wòe hã la, ɖe menye nuwo ƒe ewolia kple adzɔwoe oa?

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Woƒo fi ɖe mi tso, hafi mi kafã miele fluyem.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Mihe nuwo ƒe ewoliawo katã yi nudzraɖoƒe la, ne woanye nuɖuɖu le aƒenye me; mitsɔ esia dom kpɔ abe nyemaʋu dziƒo nu, eye nyemadudu yayra aƒo ɖe mia dzi wòagbɔ eme o ha? Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Mablu ɖe ʋetsuviwo ta na mi, be womagagblẽ miaƒe anyigba dzi nukuwo o, eye weinka magbe tsetse na mi le agble me o; Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Eye dukɔwo katã akafu mi, elabena mianye anyigba dzeani, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Yehowa be: Miegblɔa nya sesẽ ɖe ŋunye! Eye ne miebe; Nya ka miegblɔna ɖe ŋuwò hã la,

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: ɖe miegblɔna be: „Mawusubɔsubɔ la, dzodzroe, viɖe ka wonye be, míeléa eƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi, eye mienɔa ahovɔ me nɔa yiyim le Yehowa Zebaot ŋku me hã oa?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la yewole dadalawo kafum; nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo li ke, eye esi wote Mawu kpɔ la, wosi le enu oa?“

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Ale Yehowa-vɔ̃lawo gblɔ le wo nɔeawo dome enye si; Yehowa ɖo to see, eye wòŋlɔ ŋkuɖodzigbalẽ le eŋku me na Yehowa-vɔ̃lawo kple amesiwo léa ŋku ɖe eƒe ŋkɔ ŋu la.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Woawoe azu tɔnye le ŋkeke, si wɔ ge mala la dzi, Yehowa Zebaot ye gblɔe, eye makpɔ wo ta, abe alesi ŋutsu kpɔa via, si subɔnɛ ta ene. Le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe ŋuti.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Emegbe miagakpɔ vovo, si le ame dzɔdzɔe kple ame vɔ̃ɖi dome, kple vovo, si le mawusubɔla kple amesi mesubɔnɛ o la dome.

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: „Kpo da, ɖetugbi, si menya ŋutsu o la, le fu fɔ ge, eye wòadzi ŋutsuvi, eye woayɔ eƒe ŋkɔ be Imanuel, si gome ènye: Mawu li kpli mi.“

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Azur dzi Zadok, Zadok dzi Yaxin, eye Yaxin dzi Elihud;

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu Kristo ƒe dzidzi le ale: Esime wodo dadaa Maria ŋugbe na Yosef, eye hafi wova kpe la, wokpɔ bena, efɔ fu tso Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Ke srɔ̃a Yosef, si nye ame dzɔdzɔe, eye mele didim be, yeado ŋukpee o la, do tame bena, yeagblẽe ɖi le aɖaŋu me.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòle nu siawo ŋuti bum la, kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla ɖe eɖokui fiae le drɔ̃eƒe gblɔ nɛ bena: Yosef, Dawid vi, megavɔ̃ srɔ̃wò Maria kpɔkplɔ va gbɔwò o, elabena fu, si ke wòfɔ la, Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la mee wòtso.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: Adzi ŋutsuvi, eye nayɔ eƒe ŋkɔ be Yesu; elabena eyae laɖe eƒe dukɔ la tso woƒe nuvɔ̃wo me.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Ke esia katã va me, bene woawu nya, si Aƒetɔ la gblɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖila dzi la nu bena:

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yosef nyɔ tso alɔ̃ me la, ewo alesi Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla la gblɔ nɛ, eye wòkplɔ srɔ̃a va eɖokui gbɔe;

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: eye menyae o ʋuu keke vaseɖe esime wòdzi eƒe ŋutsuvi ŋgɔgbetɔ la, eye wòyɔ eƒe ŋkɔ be Yesu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke esi wodzi Yesu le Betlexem le Yudea, le fia Herodes ŋɔli la, kpɔ ɖa, nunyalawo tso ɣedzeƒe va Yerusalem va bia bena:

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: Afika Yudalawo ƒe fia, si wodzi la le? Elabena miekpɔ eƒe ɣletivi le ɣedzeƒe, eye mieva ta de ge agu na eyama esi.

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke esi fia Herodes se esia la, dzika tso eya kple Yerusalem katã ƒo.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòƒo dukɔ la ƒe nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo katã nu ƒu la, edzro me bia wo afisi wodzi Kristo la le.

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ be: Le Betlexem le Yudea, elabena nenema woŋlɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖila dzi bena:

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: „Eye wò Betlexem le Yuda-nyigba dzi, menye suetɔ nènye le Yuda ƒe fiaduwo dome kura o; elabena wò me fia, si le nye dukɔ Israel nyi ge la, ado atso.“

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Tete la Herodes yɔ nunyalawo yi ɖe adzame, eye wòbia ɣeyiɣi, si dzi ɣletivi la do la wo tsitotsito.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdɔ wo ɖo ɖe Betlexem la, egblɔ bena: Miheyi ɖadi ɖevi la vevie; eye ne miekpɔe la, migava ka eta nam bena, nye hã mayi aɖade ta agu nɛ.

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Ke woawo la, esi wose fia ƒe nya la, woto edzi heyi; eye kpɔ ɖa, ɣletivi, si wokpɔ le ɣedzeƒe la, zɔ wo ŋgɔ laa keke va tɔ ɖe aƒe, si me ɖevi la le la ƒe tame.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Ke esi wokpɔ ɣletivia la, dzi dzɔ wo geɖe ŋutɔ.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Eye esi woyi ɖe aƒea me la, wokpɔ ɖevi la kple dadaa Maria; tete wodze klo de ta agu nɛ, eye woʋu woƒe nuwo nu hetsɔ nunanawo, sika, kotoklobo kple lili nɛ.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Eye esi Mawu gbe nya na wo le drɔ̃eƒe be, womagagbugbɔ ayi Herodes gbɔ o la, woto mɔ bubu gbugbɔ yi wo de. Sisi kple Kristo yi Egipte.

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Ke esi wodzo yi la, kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla ɖe eɖokui fia Yosef le drɔ̃eƒe gblɔ bena: „Fɔ, natsɔ ɖevi la kple dadaa, eye nasi ayi Egipte, eye nanɔ afima, vaseɖe esime magblɔe na wò: elabena Herodes le ɖevi la dim be, yeawu.

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Tete wòfɔ, eye wòkplɔ ɖevi la kple dadaa le zã me hedzo yi Egipte;

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: eye wònɔ afima vaseɖe Herodes ƒe ku megbe, bena nya, si Aƒetɔ la gblɔ ɖe anyi to nyagblɔɖila dzi la, nava ve me bena: „Keke Egipte ke meyɔ vinye la tsoe.“ Herodes wu ɖeviwo.

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Esi Herodes kpɔ bena, nunyalawo flu ye la, edze agbo ɖo dɔmedzoe ŋutɔ, eye wòdɔ woɖawu ŋutsuvi, siwo katã le Betlexem kple eƒe nutowo katã me, esiwo xɔ ƒe eve kple esiwo mexɔ nenema haɖe o, ɖe alesi wòbia ɣeyiɣi la tsitotsito tso nunyalawo gbɔe la nu.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Ale wowu nya, si wogblɔ ɖe anyi to nyagblɔɖila Yeremya dzi la nu bena:

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: „Wose ɣlidodo le Rama, avifafa kple nublanuiɣli geɖe; Raxel le fafam na viawo, eye mele lɔlɔ̃m bena, woafa akɔ na ye o, elabena womegali o.“ Yesu ƒe dzilawo trɔ tso Egipte gbɔ, eye wova nɔ Nazaret.

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ke esi Herodes ku la, kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla ɖe eɖokui fia Yosef le drɔ̃eƒe le Egipte

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Fɔ, nakplɔ ɖevi la kple dadaa ayi ɖe Israel-nyigba dzi, elabena amesiwo le ɖevi la ƒe ku dim la, woku.

english_verse: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.
translation_verse: Tete wòfɔ hekplɔ ɖevi la kple dadaa va Israel-nyigba dzii.

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Ke esi wose bena, Arxelao ɖu fia le Yudea ɖe fofoa Herodes teƒe la, evɔ̃ afimayiyi; ke esi wònyè Mawue gblɔe nɛ le drɔ̃eƒe ta la, edzo heyi Galilea-nutowo me:

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: eye wòva nɔ du, si woyɔna be Nazaret la me, bene woawu nya, si wogblɔ ɖe anyi to nyagblɔɖilawo dzi la nu bena: Woayɔe be Nazaretetɔ.

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Azɔ mitse ku, si dze dzimetɔtrɔ,

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm bena: Mitrɔ le miaƒe dzi me: elabena dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ɖo vɔ.

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Ke Yohanes la ŋutɔ la, kposɔfuwu le eŋu, eye lãgbalẽlidziblanu le eƒe ali dzi; eye eƒe nuɖuɖu enye ʋetsuviwo kple gbemenyitsi.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Tete wotso Yerusalem kple Yudea blibo la katã kple Yordan-nutowo katã me godoo va egbɔ.

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: Eye wona wòde mawutsi ta na wo ɖe Yordan-tɔsisi la me, le esime woʋu woƒe nuvɔ̃wo me nɛ.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ farisitɔ kple zadukitɔ geɖewo va eƒe mawutsidedetaname gbɔ la, egblɔ na wo bena: Dawo ƒe dzidzimewo! Amekae gblɔe fia mi bena, miasi atso dɔmedzoe, si gbɔna la nu mahã?

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la wotsɔ fia ɖo atiwo ƒe ke dzi gã hã xoxo. Ati sia ati, si metsea ku nyui o la, wolãnɛ, eye wotsɔnɛ dea dzo me.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: amesi si lugbɔnu le, eye wòakplɔ eƒe lugbɔƒe keŋkeŋ, eye wòaƒo eƒe lu nu ƒu ala ɖe ava me, ke tsroa la, wòatsɔ dzo matsimatsi atɔe. Yohanes de mawutsi ta na Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi me Yesu tso Galilea va Yohanes gbɔ le Yordantɔsisi la to, bena woade mawutsi ta na ye.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Ke Yohanes xe mɔ nɛ gblɔ bena: Nye boŋ wòhiã bena, wò nade mawutsi ta na, eye wòa nèva gbɔnyea?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Na mɔ azɔ, elabena nenema koe dze mí bena, míawu nu dzɔdzɔewo katã nu. Tete wòɖe mo nɛ.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Ke esi wode mawutsi ta na Yesu vɔ la, edo go tso taa me enumake; eye kpɔ ɖa, dziƒowo ʋu nɛ, eye wokpe Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la le ɖiɖim abe akpakpa ene va edzi:

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: eye kpɔ ɖa, gbe tso dziƒowo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Amesia enye vinye, si gbɔ nyemelɔ̃a nu lena o la, si dzea ŋunye!

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu se bena, wotso Yohanes de asi la, edzo heyi ɖe Galilea.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Eye esi woʋu le Nazaret la, eva nɔ Kapernaum, si le ƒua nu le Zebulon kple Naftali-nutowo me,

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Eye tela te ɖe eŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Nenye Mawuvi nènye la, ekema gblɔ na kpe siawo be, wòatro zu abolo.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ ne bena: Wogaŋlɔ ɖi hã bena: „Megate Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, kpɔ o!“

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Abosam gakplɔe heyi ɖe to kɔkɔ ŋutɔa ɖe dzi, eye wòde xexeame fiaɖuƒewo katã kple woƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la fiae,

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Matsɔ nu siawo katã ana wò, ne èdze klo ɖe la agu nam.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ ”
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ ne bena: Te ɖa le gbɔnye, Satana! Elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, nade ta agu na, eye eya ɖeka ko nasubɔ.“

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,
translation_verse: bena woawu nya, si wogblɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖila Yesaya dzi la nu bena:

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: Enumake wogblẽ asabuawo ɖi, eye wodze eyome.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòle tsa ɖim le Galilea-ƒua nu la, ekpɔ nɔviŋutsu eve, Simon, si woyɔna be Petro, kple nɔvia Andrea, wole asabu dam ɖe ƒua me: elabena tɔƒodelawo wonye.

english_verse: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòdzo le afima te yi ŋgɔ la, ekpɔ nɔviŋutsu bubu eve, Yakobo, si nye Zebedeo vi, kple nɔvia Yohanes, wole ʋu me kple wo fofo Zebedeo hele woƒe aɣliwo sam, eye wòyɔ wo.

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: Enumake wogblẽ ʋu la kple wo fofo ɖi, eye wodze eyome. Yesu yɔ dɔ dɔléla vovovowo.

english_verse: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu yi ɖatsa le Galilea katã, le nu fiãm amewo le woƒe ƒuƒoƒewo, eye wòle gbe ƒã ɖem fiaɖuƒe la ƒe nyanyuie, eye wòle dɔlélewo katã kple lãmegbegblẽwo katã ƒomevi ɖem ɖa le dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe ŋkɔ ɖi hoo le Siria blibo la katã; eye wotsɔ amesiwo katã ƒe lãme gblẽ, kple amesiwo le dɔ bubu ƒomeviwo lém, kple amesiwo le fu kpem, kple amesiwo me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo le la, kple kpeŋuikulawo kple lãmetututɔwo katã va egbɔ, eye wòda gbe le wo ŋu.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Eye ameha geɖewo dze eyome tso Galilea kple Dekapoli kple Yerusalem, Yudea kpakple Yordan godo.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on the side of a mountain and sat down. Blessings (Luke
translation_verse: Ke esi wòkpɔ ameha geɖe wo la, elia to la; eye esi wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi la, eƒe nusrɔlawo te va egbɔ,

english_verse: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven. Anger
translation_verse: Elabena mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ne miaƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye la maƒo agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo tɔ ta sa o la, ekema miele yiyi ge ɖe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me akpɔ o.

english_verse: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you,
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti ne etsɔ wò nunana va da ɖe vɔsamlekpuia dzi, eye nèɖo ŋui le afima bena, nyaa ɖe le nɔviwò ƒe dzi me ɖe ŋutiwò la,

english_verse: and he taught them:
translation_verse: eye wòke nu, fia nu wo gblɔ bena:

english_verse: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo da ahe le gbɔgbɔ me la; elabena woawo tɔe nye dziƒofiaɖuƒe la.

english_verse: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo le konyi fam la; elabena woawoe woafa akɔ na.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo nye ame fafawo la; elabena woawoe anyi anyigba la ƒe dome.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo le nublanui kpam na amewo la: elabena woawoe woakpɔ nublanui na.

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: Woayra amesiwo dza le woƒe dzi me la: elabena woawoe akpɔ Mawu.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: Miawoe nye xexeame ƒe kekeli Du, si le to dzi la, womate ŋu aɣlae o.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Ke nye la mele egblɔm na mi bena: Migata nu kura o, eɖanye dziƒo o, elabena Mawu ƒe zikpui wònye;

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: eɖanye anyigba o, elabena eƒe afɔɖodzinue; eɖanye Yerusalem o, elabena ɖia gã la ƒe ɖue.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: Miawoe nye anyigba ƒe dze; ke ne dze bu eƒe vivi la, nuka tsɔ ge wòala ado vivi ne mahã? Tso esia dzi la meganyo na naneke o; ke boŋ woatsɔe aƒu gbe, bena amewo naɖo afɔ edzi.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Eye womesia akaɖi hã dana ɖe afianu te o, ke ɖe akaɖiti dzi boŋ, eye wòaklẽ na amesiwo katã le aƒea me.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: Migabu xa bena, meva se la alo nyagblɔlawo tu ge o. Nyemeva wo tu ge o, ke boŋ wo nu wu ge meva.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: Miese wogblɔ na blematɔwo bena: Megawu ame o; ke amesi ke awu ame la, adze ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Ke nye la mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesiame, si le dɔmedzoe dom ɖe nɔvia ŋuti la, adze ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃; eye amesi ke agblɔ na nɔvia bena takukutɔ la, adze daŋudede gã, eye amesi ke agblɔ bena lã la, adze dzomavɔʋemeyiyi.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
