translation_verse: gblẽ wò nunana la ɖe afima le vɔsamlekpuia ŋgɔ, eye nayi aɖadzra mia kple nɔviwò dome do gbãgbiagbã, hafi nava tsɔ wò nunana la vae.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke alesi nègale mɔ dzi kple wò ketɔ la, wɔ ɖeka kplii kaba bena, ne wò ketɔ nagava tsɔ wò ade asi na ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, eye vɔnudrɔ̃la nagatsɔ wò ade asi na atikplɔtɔ la, eye woade wò gaxɔ me o.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Vava mele egblɔm na wò bena: Màdo go le afima gbeɖe o, vaseɖe esime naxe agaga mlɔetɔ hafi.

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ hã bena: Amesi aɖe asi le srɔ̃a ŋu la, nena kaklãgbalẽe;

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: Miegase wogblɔ na blematɔwo bena: Megaka atam dzodzro o, ke nawɔ wò atamkaka dzi na Aƒetɔ la.

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Ke boŋ miaƒe nya nanye: Ẽ, ẽ; o, o; eye nusi ke wu esiawo la, etso vɔ̃ɖito la me.

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: Míese wogblɔ bena: Ŋku ɖe ŋku teƒe, eye aɖu ɖe aɖu teƒe;

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: ke nye la mele egblɔm na mi bena: Migatsi tre ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi la ŋuti o; ke boŋ amesi ke ƒo wò nuɖusi tome la, nyẽ ekeme hã nɛ;

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: eye amesi le didim be, yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu kpli wò, bene yeaxɔ wò awu le asiwò la, na ne wòaxɔ avɔ hã le asiwò;

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: eye amesi ke azi dzi wò be, nazɔ kplii gaƒoƒo ɖeka la, zɔ eve kplii.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Na nu amesi le nu biawòm, eye amesi le didim be, yeaɣe nu le asiwò la, megatrɔ dzo le egbe o.

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: Míese wogblɔ bena: Lɔ̃ hawòvi, eye nalé lu wò ketɔ:

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: bena ne miazu mia Fofo, si le dziƒo la, ƒe viwo; elabena eyae nana eƒe ɣe dzena na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple ame nyuiwo, eye wònana tsi dzana na ame dzɔdzɔewo kple ame madzɔmadzɔwo.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mielɔ̃a amesiwo lɔ̃a mi la, fetu ka kpɔm miele mahã? Alo menye nudzɔlawo hã wɔa nenema ke o ɖe?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Eye ne miedoa gbe na mia nɔviwo ɖeɖe ko la, wɔwui ka wɔm miele? Alo menye xexemeviwo hã wɔa nenema ke o ɖe?

english_verse: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti miawo hã mizu blibo, sigbe alesi mia Fofo, si le dziƒo la, le blibo ene.

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie, ne miagawɔ miaƒe dzɔdzɔenyenyenu le amewo ƒe ŋku me, be woakpɔ o; ne menye nenem o la, fetua ɖeke meli na mi le mia Fofo, si le dziƒowo la, gbɔ o.

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ne èle nu nam ame la, megana wò miasi nanya nusi wò nuɖusi wɔna o,

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: Eye ne miele gbe dom ɖa la, migano abe alakpatɔwo ene o; elabena wolɔ̃a gbedodoɖa le tsitrenu le ƒuƒoƒewo kple ablɔwo ƒe dzogoewo dzi, bena amewo nakpɔ yewo. Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Woxɔ woƒe fetu yi xoxo.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ne èle gbe do ge ɖa la, yi ɖe wò xogã me, eye esi nètu ʋɔa la, nado gbe ɖa na Fofowò le ɣaɣlaƒe, eye Fofowò, si le nu kpɔm le ɣaɣlaƒe la, laɖo teƒe na wò.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: Ke ne miele gbe dom ɖa la, migagblɔ nyatsinyatsi abe trɔ̃subɔlawo ene o; elabena wobu xa bena, le yewoƒe nya geɖe gbɔgblɔ ŋuti la woaɖo to yewo.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti migaɖi woawo o; elabena mia Fofo nya nusiwo hiãa mi, hafi miebianɛ.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Eyata miawo mido gbe ɖa ale: Mía Fofo, si le dziƒowo! Wò ŋkɔ ŋuti nakɔ!

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: Wò fiaɖuƒe nava! Woawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu le anyigba dzi, sigbe alesi wowɔna le dziƒo ene!

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mietsɔ amewo ƒe vodadawo ke wo la, ekema mia Fofo, si le dziƒo la, atsɔe ake miawo hã.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Ke ne mietsɔ ke amewo o la, mia Fofo hã matsɔ miaƒe vodadawo ake mi o.

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: bena amewo nagadze si wò nutsitsidɔ o; negbe Fofowò, si le ɣaɣlaƒe la ko, eye Fofowò, si le nu kpɔm le ɣaɣlaƒe la, laɖo teƒe na wò. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le anyigba dzi nuwo ŋuti.

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Midi mawufiaɖuƒe la kple eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye gbãgbiagbã, eye woatsɔ nusiawo katã akpe ɖe eŋuti na mi.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti migatsi dzimaɖi le etso si gbɔna la, ƒe nuwo ŋuti o; elabena etso si gbɔna la, adze agbagba le eya ŋuta ƒe nuwo ŋuti. Ŋkeke ƒe vɔ̃ la sɔ gbɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Migadzra nu nyuiwo ɖo na mia ɖokui le anyigba dzi, afisi agbagblaʋui kple nusiwo ɖua nu la, gblẽa nu le, eye fiafitɔwo dzea kpɔ va fia, nu le la o;

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: ke boŋ midzra nu nyuiwo ɖo na mia ɖokui le dziƒo, afisi agbagblaʋui kple nusiwo dua nu la, megblẽa nu le o, eye fiafitɔ medzea kpo va fia nu le o:

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: elabena afisi wò nu nyui le la, afima wò dzi hã lanɔ.

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: Ke ne ŋku vɔ̃ li na wò la, wò ame blibo la katã me lado viviti. Azɔ ne kekeli, si le mewo la, zu viviti la, aleke viviti ŋutɔ lahasɔ gbɔe!

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mate ŋu asubɔ aƒetɔ eve o; elabena ɖewo alé fu ame ɖeka, eye woalɔ̃ evelia, alo aku ɖe ame ɖeka ŋuti, eye wòado vlo evelia. Miate ŋu asubɔ Mawu kple anyigba dzi nuwo o.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti migaɖe fu na mia ɖokui agblɔ bena: Nuka míaɖu, nuka miano, alo nuka míatsɔ ata mahã o.

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: Eyakeŋuti mele egblɔm na mi bena: Migatsi dzimaɖi le miaƒe agbe ŋuti, nusi miaɖu kple nusi miano o, alo le miaƒe ame blibo la ŋuti, nusi miata o. Alo agbe mewu nuɖuɖu o ɖe, eye ame blibo la mewu avɔtata o ɖe?

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ dziƒoxeviwo ɖa, womeƒãa nu o, womeŋea nu hã o, eye womeƒoa nuwo ƒu ɖe avawo me hã o, ke mia Fofo, si le dziƒo la, nyia wo. Alo ɖe mia tɔ mevena wua woawo to o mahã?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: Eye nukaŋuti miele fu ɖem na mia ɖokui le avɔtata ŋuti mahã? Mibu dzogbenyã, si le gbedzi la, ŋuti kpɔ, alesi wòwɔnae; mewɔa dɔ o, metrea ɖeti hã o;

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: ke mele egblɔm na mi bena: Salomo le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe katã me la meɖo atsyɔ̃ kpɔ abe esiawo dometɔ ɖeka ene o.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Eye ne Mawu ɖo atsyɔ̃ na gbe, si le gbedzi egbe, eye etso kasia woatsɔe aƒu gbe ɖe kpodzo me la, ɖe mawɔ na miawo geɖe awu o mahã? Mí xɔseʋeetɔwo!

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Elabena nenem nusiawo katã tɔgbe trɔ̃subɔlawo dina; ke mia Fofo, si le dziƒo la, nyae bena, nenem nusiawo katã hiãa mi.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: Migadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu, ne woagadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi o.

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Elabena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃, si miedrɔ̃ la, eya ke woatso adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi; eye dzidzenu, si mietsɔ dzidze la, eya ke woatsɔ adzidze na miawo hã.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Ke nuka wo nèkpɔa ati fefee, si ɖo nɔviwò ƒe ŋku me la, eye atikpo, si le wò ŋuta wò ŋku dzi la, medzea si eya o mahã?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Alo aleke lawɔ nagblɔ na nɔviwò bena: Na mɔm, ne maɖe ali fefee la le wò ŋku me, eye kpɔ ɖa, atikpo le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi mahã?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Alakpatɔ, ɖe atikpo la le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi gbã, hafi nakpɔ nyuie, alesi nawɔ aɖe ati fefee la le nɔviwò ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne mi, amesiwo nye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo la, mienya alesi miana nunana nyuiwo mia viwo la, ɖe mia Fofo, si le dziƒo la, mana nu nyuiwo amesiwo bianɛ la, awu mi o mahã?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Alo ameka le mia dome, ne via abia aboloe la, wòatsɔ kpe anae mahã?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Mibia, eye woana mi; midi, eye miakpɔ; miƒo ʋɔa, eye woaʋui na mi;

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: elabena amesiame, si biaa nu la, exɔa nu, eye amesi dia nu la, ekpɔa nu, eye amesi ƒoa ʋɔ la, woʋunɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Alo ne abia tɔmelãe la, wòatsɔ da anae mahã?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti nusianu, si mielɔ̃na bena, amewo nawɔ na mi la, miawo hã miwɔ nenema ke na wo; elabena esia enye se la kple nyagblɔɖilawo. Le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu dzi wɔwɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti amesiame, si se nye nya siawo, eye wòwɔ wo dzi la, matsɔe aɖo ŋutsu nyanu, si tu eƒe xɔ ɖe kpe gbadza dzi la ŋuti;

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Elabena agbo la le biie, eye mo la hã xaxa, si kplɔa amewo yina ɖe agbe la me, eye ame ʋeewo nye amesiwo kpɔnɛ.

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le aʋatsonyagblɔɖilawo ŋuti, amesiwo vaa mia gbɔ le alẽgbalẽwo me, eva le wo me la wonye amegãxi nyanyrãwo.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Mitso woƒe tsetsewo dze si wo. Ɖe wogbea weinkpo le aŋɔkawo dzi loo, alo wogbea gbowo le srẽwo dzi mahã?

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ati nyui sia ati nyui tsea ku nyui; eye ale manyomanyo tsea ku manyomanyo.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Ati nyui mate ŋu atse ku manyomanyo o, eye ati manyomanyo hã mate ŋu atse ku nyui o.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Ati sia ati, si metsea ku nyui o la, wolãnɛ, eye wotsɔnɛ dea dzo me.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mitsɔ woƒe tsetseawo dze si wòe!

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Eye amesiame, si sea nye nya siawo, eye mewɔa wo dzi o la, woatsɔe aɖo ŋutsu manyanu, si tu eƒe xɔ ɖe ke dzi la ŋuti;

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: eye tsi dzana, eye tɔwo ɖɔna, eye yawo ƒona, eye wova nyẽa zi le nenem xa ma te, eye wòmu, eye eƒe anyidzedze ɖi gbloo.

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: Menye amesiame, si le gbɔgblɔm nam bena: Aƒetɔ! Aƒetɔ! ayi ɖe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me o, negbe amesi le Fofonye, si le dziƒowo la, ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu wɔm la koe.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo lagblɔ nam le ŋkeke ma dzi bena: Aƒetɔ! Aƒetɔ! Alo menye wò ŋkɔ dzi míegblɔ nya ɖe anyi le o ɖe, eye wò ŋkɔ dzi mienyã gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do goe de o ɖe, eye wò ŋkɔ dzi miewɔ ŋusẽdɔ geɖewo le o ɖe?

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Ekema nye hã maʋu me na wo bena: Nyemenya mi kpɔ o, mi nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo; mite ɖa le gbɔnye!

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: eye tsi dzana, eye tɔwo ɖɔna, eye yawo ƒona, eye wova nyea zi le nenem xɔ ma te, eye memuna o; elabena woɖo egɔme anyi ɖe kpe gbadza dzi.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime Yesu wu nenem nya siawo nu va la, kuvia ɖo amehawo le eƒe nufiafia la ŋuti;

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: elabena ele nu fiãm wo abe amesi si ŋusẽ le ene, eye menye abe woƒe agbalẽfialawo ene o.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”
translation_verse: hafi fiaɖuƒe la ƒe viwo la, woatso wo aƒu gbe ɖe viviti, si le egodo la me; afima avifafa kple aɖukliɖuɖu lanɔ.

english_verse: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Ke esi fiẽsi ɖo la, wotsɔ ame geɖe, siwo gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo le wo me la, va egbɔ; eye wògblɔ nya henyã gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃awo do goe, eye wòda gbe le amesiwo katã ƒe lãme gblẽ la ŋuti,

english_verse: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, “Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, anyidzelaa ɖe va dze klo ne gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, ne èlɔ̃ ko la, ate ŋu ana ŋutinye nakɔ.

english_verse: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, “I want to! Now you are well.” At once the man's leprosy disappeared.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu do abɔ da, eye wòde asi eŋu gblɔ bena: Meli, ŋutiwò nekɔ! Eye enumake eƒe anyi la kɔ ɖa.

english_verse: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nɛ bena: Nye la megbɔna be, mada gbe le eŋu.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu see la, eƒe mo wo yaa, eye wògblɔ na amesiwo le eyome la bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Le Israel me hã la nyemekpɔ nenem dzixɔse sia tɔgbe kpɔ o.

english_verse: “Lord, my servant is at home in such terrible pain that he can't even move.”
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm bena: Aƒetɔ, nye dɔtsɔla mlɔ anyi le aƒe me le lãmetutudɔ lém, eye wòle fu kpem ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Many people will come from everywhere to enjoy the feast in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ame geɖewo latso ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe ava, eye woanɔ kplɔ̃ ŋuti akpe ɖe Abraham, Isak kple Yakob ŋuti le dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me;

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the officer, “You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen.” Right then his servant was healed. Jesus Heals Many People (Mark
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na aʋafia la bena: Heyi, eye alesi nèxɔe se la, woawɔ na wò nenema ke! Eye eƒe dɔtsɔla ƒe lãme sẽ le gaƒoƒo ma ke dzi. Yesu da gbe le Petro lɔ̃xo kple dɔlẽla bubu geɖewo ŋuti.

english_verse: Suddenly they shouted, “Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time?”
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, wodo ɣli gblɔ bena: Nya ka le mía kpli wò dome, wò Mawuvi? Ɖe nèva afisia funyafunya wɔ ge mi, hafi ɣeyiɣi la nade mahã?

english_verse: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Eye kpo ɖa, du blibo la katã do go yi Yesu kpe ge; eye esi wokpɔe la, woɖe kuku nɛ bena, woadzo le yewoƒe nutoawo me ayi.

english_verse: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu va Petro ƒe me la, ekpɔ lɔ̃xoa le anyimlɔƒe, le ŋudza lém.

english_verse: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.
translation_verse: Eye wòde asi eƒe asi ŋuti, tete ŋudza la dzo le edzi; eye wòtsi tre hesubɔe.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “He healed our diseases and made us well.” Some Who Wanted To Go with Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: bena woawu nya, si wogblɔ ɖi to Yesaya, nyagblɔɖila dzi la nu bena: „Eya ŋutɔ tsɔ míaƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo kple dɔlélewo ɖo eɖokui dzi.“ Yesu gbe nya na nusrɔ̃la eve.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowd, he went across Lake Galilee.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu kpɔ ameha geɖewo le eŋuti la, eɖo bena, yewoatso ƒu la ayi egodo.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, “Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you!”
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfialaa ɖe va gblɔ nɛ bena: Nufiala, afisi ke nayi ɖo la, manɔ yowòme.

english_verse: Another disciple said to Jesus, “Lord, let me wait till I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Eye eƒe nusrɔlawo dome ame bubu gblɔ ne bena: Aƒetɔ, ɖe mɔ nam, ne mayi aɖaɖi fofonye gbɔ.

english_verse: so the disciples went over to him and woke him up. They said, “Lord, wake up! Save us before we drown!”
translation_verse: Eye wova egbɔ, nyae gblɔ bena; Aƒetɔ, ɖe mi, miele tsɔtsrɔm!

english_verse: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples,
translation_verse: Eye esi wòɖo ʋua la, eƒe nusrɔlawo kplɔe ɖo.

english_verse: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep,
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, ya sesẽa ɖe va ƒo ɖe ƒua dzi, eye ƒutsotsoewo le ŋeŋem ɖe nua me; ke eya ŋutɔ dɔ alɔ̃.

english_verse: The men in the boat were amazed and said, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.” Two Men with Demons in Them (Mark
translation_verse: Eye ameawo ƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye wogblɔ bena: Ameka ƒomevi enye sia be, yawo kple ƒu hã ɖoa toe? Yesu da gbe le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ tɔ eve ŋu.

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva egodo le Gadaratɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi la, ame eve, siwo me gbɔgbɔ vɔwo le, eye adã le mo na wo ŋutɔ, ale bena amea ɖeke metea ŋu toa afimamɔ o la, do go tso yɔdowo me va kpee.

english_verse: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Ke aƒehawo ƒe ha gãa ɖe le adzɔge le gbe ɖum.

english_verse: So the demons begged Jesus, “If you force us out, please send us into those pigs!”
translation_verse: Eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃awo ɖe kuku nɛ gblɔ bena: Ne ènyã mi do go la, dɔ mí ɖe hawo me.

english_verse: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miheyi! Eye esi wodo go la, woyi ɖe haawo me; kasia kpɔ ɖa, wo katã wòsi du kplikplikpli tso to la kɔgo ge ɖe ƒu la me, eye woku ɖe tsiawo me.

english_verse: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.
translation_verse: Tete wo kplɔviwo si, eye esi wova dua me la, woka nyaawo katã kple amesiwo me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do go le la, hã ƒe nya ta na wo.

english_verse: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòɖo ʋu la, etso ƒu la va ye ŋutɔ ƒe dua me.

english_verse: Jesus heard them and answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu see la, egblɔ na wo bena: Menye lãmesesẽtɔwoe hiã gbedala o, negbe dɔlélawo ko.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Mark
translation_verse: Wometsɔa aha yeye hã dea lãgbalẽgolo xoxowo me o; ke ne menye nenem o la, lãgbalẽgolowo awo, eye aha la aƒu gbe, eye lãgbalẽgolowo agblẽ; ke wotsɔa aha yeye ɖea lãgbalẽgolo yeyewo me, eye wo kpakple eve la siaa wonɔna dedie. Yairo vinyɔnuvi kple nyɔnu, si le nusisidɔ.

english_verse: News about this spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
translation_verse: Nenem eƒe ŋkɔ nyo kaka ɖe afima-nyigba katã dzi! Ŋkuagbãtɔ eve kple aɖetututɔ la.

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses said to themselves, “Jesus must think he is God!”
translation_verse: Eye kpo ɖa, agbalẽfialawo dometɔa ɖewo gblɔ le wo ɖokui me bena: Amesia le busunya gblɔm.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their minds, and he said, “Why are you thinking such evil things?
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu kpo wote tamebubuwo la, egblɔ bena: Nukaŋuti miele nu vɔ̃ɖiwo bum le miaƒe dzi me ale mahã?

english_verse: But I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Ke ne mianyae bena, ŋusẽ le Amegbetɔvi la si be, wòatsɔ nuvɔ̃wo ake le anyigba dzi; tete wògblɔ na lãmetututɔ la bena: Tsi tre, kɔ, wò aba dzi, eye nayi aƒewò me!

english_verse: The man got up and went home.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsi tre heyi ɖe eƒe me.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving that place, two blind men began following him and shouting, “Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu dzo le afima yina la, ŋkuagbãtɔ eve dze eyome, le ɣli dom gblɔ bena: Dawid vi la, kpɔ mía nublanui!

english_verse: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.
translation_verse: Eye esi woawo do go la, kpɔ ɖa, wotsɔ aɖetututɔ, si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le la, va egbɔ.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu to afima yina la, ekpa ŋutsua ɖe, si woyɔna be Mateo, si no anyi le nudzɔƒe, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Dze yonyeme! Eye wòtsi tre dze eyome.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime wòle kplɔ̃ ŋuti le aƒea me la, kpɔ ɖa, nudzɔla kple nuvɔ̃wɔla geɖewo va, eye wobɔbɔ nɔ anyi kple Yesu kpakple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus' disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Ke esi farisitɔwo kpɔe la, wogblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Nukaŋuti miaƒe nufiala ɖua nu kple nudzɔlawo kpakple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo mahã?

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Esi wòle nusiawo gblɔm na wo la, kpɔ ɖa, amegãa ɖe va dze klo nɛ gblɔ bena: Ye nyɔnuvi ku fifi laa; gake la va natsɔ wò asi ada ɖe edzi, eye woagbɔ agbe.

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòtrɔ kpɔe la, egblɔ nɛ bena: Vinyɔnuvi, na wò dzi nadze me! Wò xɔse la ɖe wò. Eye nyɔnu la ƒe lãme sẽ le gaƒoƒo ma ke dzi.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wonyã gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la do goe la, aɖetututɔ la ƒo nu. Eye amehawo ƒe mo wɔ yaa, wogblɔ bena: Womekpɔ nusia tɔgbee le Israel kpɔ o.

english_verse: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Tete Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ gblɔ bena: Nukaŋuti miawo kple farisitɔwo mietsia nu dɔna atraɖii, ke wò nusrɔ̃lawo metsia nu dɔna o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Alo ɖe ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ƒe xɔlɔ̃wo ate ŋu afa konyi, ŋkeke alesi ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la li kpli wo mahã? Ke ŋkekewo gbɔna, esime woatsɔ ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ayii le wo gbɔ la, ekema woatsi nu adɔ.

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke metsɔa avɔ matakpɔ ƒe nuɖeɖi hekaa avɔ xoxo o, elabena nuɖeɖi, si wotso kae la, aho avɔ la ɖe eɖokui ŋu, eye eƒe vuvu la awu tsãtɔ.

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: elabena egblɔ le eɖokui me bena: Ne mede asi eƒe awu la ŋu ko la, mahaya.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu tsi tre la, eya kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dze eyome.

english_verse: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, nyɔnua ɖe, si ŋu ʋu le dodom le ƒe wuieve sɔŋ la, to emegbe va te ɖe eŋu, eye wòde asi eƒe awuto ŋu;

english_verse: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners,
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu va amegã la ƒe me, eye wòkpɔ dzekulawo kple ameha, siwo le ʋunyaʋunya wɔm la,

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: egblɔ na wo bena: Mite yi megbe! Elabena nyɔnuvia meku o; ke alɔ̃e wòdo. Eye wokoe.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Eye esi wonyã ameha la do go la, eyi ɖe eme, eye wòlé eƒe asi, eye nyɔnuvi la to ɖe tsi tre.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòyi ɖe aƒea me la, ŋkuagbãtɔwo va egbɔ, eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Miexɔe se bena, mate ŋu awɔ esia mahã? Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ẽ, Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: Tete Yesu de asi woƒe ŋkuwo ŋu gblɔ bena: Ava me na mi le miaƒe xɔse la nu.

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Eye woƒe ŋkuwo ʋu. Eye Yesu gbe nya na wo vevie gblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, migana amea ɖeke nanyae o.

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk
translation_verse: Ke woawo la, esi wodo go ko la, wona eƒe ŋkɔ ɖi hoo le afima-nyigba blibo la katã dzi.

english_verse: But the Pharisees said, “The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.” Jesus Has Pity on People
translation_verse: Ke farisitɔwo gblɔ bena: Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe fia la dzie wòto nyã gbɔgbɔ vɔwo do goe. Yesu fia nu, eye wòyɔ dɔ amewo. Nuŋelawo mede ha o.

english_verse: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu yi ɖato duawo kple kɔƒeawo katã me, hele nu fiãm le woƒe ƒuƒoƒewo, eye wòle fiaɖuƒe la ŋutinya nyui la gblɔm hele dɔlélewo kple lãmegbegblẽwo katã ƒomevi ɖem ɖa le dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòkpɔ amehawo la, eƒe dɔme trɔ ɖe wo ŋuti; elabena woƒe lãme gbɔdzɔ, eye woka hlẽ abe alẽ, siwo kplɔla meli na o la ene.

english_verse: He said to his disciples, “A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Nuŋeŋe la sa gbɔ; ke nuŋelawo mede ha o.

english_verse: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti miɖe kuku na nuŋeŋe ƒe Aƒetɔ la bena, wòadɔ dɔwɔlawo aɖo ɖe eƒe nuŋeŋe la me.

english_verse: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.
translation_verse: Filipo kple Bartolomeo: Toma kple Mateo, nudzɔla; Yakobo, si nye Alfeo vi, kple Lebeo, si woyɔna hã be Tadeo;

english_verse: But when someone arrests you, don't worry about what you will say or how you will say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.
translation_verse: Eye ne wode mi asi la, migaɖe fu na mia ɖokui be, aleke alo nuka gblɔ ge míala o; elabena le nenem gaƒoƒo ma me la woana nusi ke gblɔ ge míala la mi.

english_verse: Go only to the people of Israel, because they are like a flock of lost sheep.
translation_verse: ke miyi ɖe Israel ƒe me alẽ, siwo bu la, gbɔ boŋ.

english_verse: I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves. So be as wise as snakes and as innocent as doves.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye la mele mia dɔm abe alẽwo ene ɖe amegãxiwo dome; eyaŋuti midze adaŋu abe dawo ene, eye midza abe ahɔ̃nɛwo ene.

english_verse: The others were Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Instructions for the Twelve Apostles (Mark
translation_verse: Simon Kanatɔ kple Yuda Iskariot, si fia eyome mɔ la hã.

english_verse: Jesus sent out the twelve apostles with these instructions: Stay away from the Gentiles and don't go to any Samaritan town.
translation_verse: Nenem me wuieve siawo Yesu dɔ hede se na wo gblɔ bena: Migayi ɖato trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe mɔ dzi o, eye migayi ɖe Samariatɔwo ƒe dua ɖeke me hã o;

english_verse: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
translation_verse: nagatsɔ mɔzɔkotoku alo awu eve, atokotawo alo atizɔti o; elabena dɔwɔla dze eƒe nuɖuɖu.

english_verse: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.
translation_verse: Ke ne miayi ɖe ɖu alo kɔƒea ɖe me la, midi amesi dze le eme la vevie; eye minɔ afima, vaseɖe esime miadzo.

english_verse: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town. Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Mele sesẽ ge na Sodom- kple Gomora-nyigba la le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la, abe nenem du ma ene o.

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: Nɔvi lade nɔvi ku me, eye fofo lade vi asi, ɖeviwo latsi tre ɖe dzilawo ŋuti, eve woatsɔ wo ana woawu

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le amewo ŋuti; elabena woade mi asi na ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo, eye woaƒo mi kple atam le woƒe ƒuƒoƒewo;

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: eye woakplɔ mi ayi ɖe mɔ̃mefiawo kple fiawo ƒe ŋku me le tanye, ne wòanye ɖaseɖiɖi na woa kple trɔ̃subɔlawo.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Elabena menye miawoe nye amesiwo le nu ƒom o; ke boŋ mia Fofo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ lae nye amesi le nu ƒom le mia me?

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Eye wo katã woalé mi ɖe ke me le nye ŋkɔ la ŋuti; ke amesi ke ado dzi vevie vaseɖe nuwuwu la, eya lakpɔ ɖeɖe.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Ne woti mia yome le du sia me la, nusi yi ɖe bubua ɖe me; elabena vava mele egblɔm na mi bena: Miele Israel-duawo nu wu ge, hafi amegbetɔvi la nava o.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la mewua nufiala o, eye subɔla hã mewua eƒe aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Esɔ gbɔ na nusrɔ̃la, ne woazu abe eƒe nufiala ene, kple subɔla abe eƒe aƒetɔ ene. Ne woyi aƒetɔ la be Beelzebul la, aleke woahayɔ eƒe aƒemetɔwo a wui?

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Eye migavɔ̃ amesiwo le ŋutilã wum, eye womate ŋu awu luʋɔ o la o, ke boŋ mivɔ̃ amesi ate ŋu atsrɔ̃ luʋɔ kple ŋutilã siaa le dzomavɔʋe me.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Alo wometsɔa atsutsurɔe eve ƒlena xɔa hotsui ewo oa? Eye ne menye mia Fofo ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu o la, wo dometɔa ɖeke mele dzedze ge ɖe anyigba o;

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: ke miaƒe taɖawo katã hã woxlẽe!

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti migavɔ̃ o! Mia tɔ vena wu atsutsurɔe geɖewo tɔ.

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: Azɔ amesiame, si aʋu menye le amewo ƒe ŋku me la, nye hã maʋu eyama me le Fofonye, si le dziƒowo la, ƒe ŋku me;

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: ke amesi ke lagbe nu le gbɔnye le amewo ƒe ŋku me la, nye hã magbe nu le eyama gbɔ le Fofonye, si le dziƒowo la, ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: Migaɖu xa bena, meva tomefafa na ge le anyigba dzi o, nyemeva tomefafa na ge o, negbe yi boŋ.

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: Elabena meva ame kple fofoa, vinyɔnuvi kple dadaa, ŋutsuvi srɔ̃ kple lɔ̃xoa dome mã ge;

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: eye ame ƒe ketɔwo anye ye ŋutɔ ƒemetɔwo.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke metsɔ eƒe atitsoga ɖo eɖokui dzi dze yonyeme o la, eya medzem o.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Amesi ke ɖe eƒe agbe la, eya labui; eye amesi ke bu eƒe agbe le tanye la, eya lakpɔe.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Amesi ke xɔa nyagblɔɖila le nyagblɔɖila ƒe ŋkɔ dzi la, eya laxɔ nyagblɔɖila ƒe fetu; eye amesi ke xɔa ame dzɔdzɔe le ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ŋkɔ dzi la, eya laxɔ ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe fetu.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Amesi ke xɔa mi la, nyee wòxɔ, eye amesi ke xɔam la, exɔ amesi dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke tsɔ tsi fafa kplu na ame tsɛ siawo dometɔ ɖeka le nusrɔ̃la ɖeɖe ƒe ŋkɔ dzi ko la, vava mele egblɔm na mí bena: Eƒe fetu la mele eŋu tsi ge o.

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Ke esi woawo trɔ yina la, Yesu de asi nyagbɔgblɔ me na amehawo le Yohanes ŋuti bena: Nuka kpɔ ge miedo go yi le gbedzi mahã? Alo ayeti, si ya le ʋuʋum mahã?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Elabena Yohanes va, meɖua nu o, menoa nu hã o, eye wogblɔ bena: Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le eme.

english_verse: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he left and began teaching and preaching in the towns.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esi Yesu de se na eƒe nusrɔ̃la wuieveawo vɔ la, edzo le afima, be yeayi aɖafia nu, eye yeagblɔ nya lé woƒe duawo me.

english_verse: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers
translation_verse: Ke esi Yohanes le gaxɔ me se Kristo ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo la, edɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be, woaɖagblɔ ne bena:

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: Alo wòe nye amesi gbɔna loo, alo ame bubua ɖee míakpɔ mɔ na mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have heard and seen.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Miyi ɖato nusi miese kple nusi miekpɔ la, na Yohanes:

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Ŋkunɔwo le nu kpɔm, eye tekunɔwo le azɔli zɔm, anyidzelawo ŋuti le kɔkɔm, eye tokunɔwo le nu sem, ame kukuwo le tsi tre tsim, eye wole nyanyuie la gblɔm fia ame dahewo.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Eye Woayra amesi ke mekpɔ nuɖiaɖia le ŋutinye o.

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Alo nuka kpɔ ge miedo go yii? Alo amesi do awu bɔbɔewoa? Kpɔ ɖa, amesiwo do awu bɔbɔewo la, woawoe le fiawo ƒe aƒewo me.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Ekema nukaŋuti gɔ̃e mieɖo go ɖo? Alo nyagblɔɖila kpɔ gea? Ẽ, mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ewu nyagblɔɖila hã.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: Vava, mele egblɔm na mi bena: Le amesiwo nyɔnuwo dzi dome la, amea ɖeke metsi tre kpɔ, si wu Yohanes mawutsidetanamela o; gake amesi nye suetɔ le dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me la, wu eyama.

english_verse: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.
translation_verse: Eye tso Yohanes mawutsidetanamela ƒe ŋkekeawo dzi vaseɖe egbegbe dzi la woƒo zi ɖe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ŋuti, eye amesiwo ƒo zi ɖe eŋuti la, woawoe le eham.

english_verse: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.
translation_verse: Eye ne mielɔ̃ be, yewoaxɔe la, esia nye Eliya, si ke le vava ge la.

english_verse: You people are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other,
translation_verse: Ke ameka gɔ̃ ŋuti matso egbevi siawo aɖoe mahã? Woɖi ɖevi, siwo bɔbɔ nɔ asi me, eye wole wo towo yɔm

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm bena: Mieku dze na mi, eye mieɖu ɣe o; míedzi konyifaha na mi, eye mieƒo akɔta o.

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Amegbetɔvi la va, ɖua nu, noa nu hã, eye wogblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, amesia enye nutsuɖula kple ahatsunola, nudzɔlawo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ƒe xɔlɔ̃. Eye nunya la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ tso afia nɛ. Vɔ̃dodo na du, siwo metrɔ dzi me o.

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Tete la wòde asi nyahehe me ɖe du, siwo me wòwɔ eƒe ŋusẽdɔ geɖewo wu le la ŋuti, elabena wometrɔ le woƒe dzi me o.

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Eye wò, Kapernaum, alo menye ɖe wokɔ wo ɖe dzi yi ɖatɔ dziŋgɔli me oa? Woate wò ɖe to vaseɖe tsiẽƒe ke; elabena ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔ, siwo wowɔ le mewò la, ɖe wowɔ wo le Sodom la, ne etsi anyi vaseɖe egbegbe.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: Gake megale egblɔm na mi bena: Mele sesẽ ge na Sodom-nyigba le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbeŋkeke la dzi abe wò ene o. Yesu kafu Fofoa.

english_verse: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi me la Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Fofo, dziƒo kple anyigba dzi Aƒetɔ, mekafu wò, elabena ètsɔ nusiawo ɣla ɖe nunyalawo kple nugɔmeselawo, eye nèɖe woawo fia vidzĩewo;

english_verse: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: ẽ, Fofo, elabena nenema enyo ŋuwò.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: Fofonye tso nuwo katã de asi nam; eye amea ɖeke menya Vi la kpɔ o, negbe Fofo la ko; eye amea ɖeke menya Fofo la hã kpɔ o, negbe Vi la ko, kple amesi ke Vi la lɔ̃ bena, yeaɖee afiae. Agbagbadzelawo kpekpe.

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: Mite va gbɔnye, mi amesiwo katã le agbagba dzem, eye agba le mia wum la, eye nye la mana dzudzɔ mi.

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nye kɔkuti la ɖo mia ɖokui dzi, eye miasrɔ̃ nu tso gbɔnye, elabena nye dɔme fa, eye mebɔbɔ ɖokuinye ɖe anyi le dzi me, eye míakpɔ dzudzɔ na miaƒe luʋɔwo.

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: Elabena ye kɔkuti la le bɔbɔe, eye nye agba la le wodzoe.

english_verse: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this!”
translation_verse: Ke esi farisitɔwo kpɔe la, wogblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, wò nusrɔ̃lawo wɔ nusi mele sekɔa nu o la, le Sabat dzi.

english_verse: The crowds were so amazed they asked, “Could Jesus be the Son of David?”
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo ameha la katã, eye wogblɔ bena: Alo nenem me sia la menye Dawid vie o ɖe?

english_verse: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.
translation_verse: Ke ne nye la menyãa gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo doa go to Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dzi la, ekema Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la do ɖe mia dzi.

english_verse: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Alo miexlẽ le se la me kpɔ bena, nunɔlawo gblẽa Sabat-kɔ ɖo le mawuxɔa me, eye nuvɔ̃ mele wo ŋu o oa?

english_verse: He went into the house of God, and then they ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are supposed to eat.
translation_verse: Alesi wòyi ɖe mawuƒe la me, eye woɖu ŋkumeɖobolo, si womeɖe mɔ le eŋuti ne bena, eya kple amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋuti naɖu o, negbe nunɔlawo ko la oa?

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Ke ɖe mienya nusia bena: „Nublanuikpɔkpɔ dim mele, eye menye numeme o“ gɔme la, anye ne miedo ɖe amesiwo ŋu nuvɔ̃ mele o la, ta o.

english_verse: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues,
translation_verse: Esi wòdzo le afima la, eyi ɖe woƒe ƒuƒoƒe;

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “Hold out your hand.” The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na ame la bena: Mlo wò asi! Eye wòmloe, eye wògaɖɔ ɖo zu blibo abe ekeme ene.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu dze si esia la, ete eɖokui ɖa tso afima, eye ameha geɖewo dze eyome, eye wòda gbe le wo katã ŋu,

english_verse: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: eye wogbe nya na wo bena, woagana wòanya ye o;

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as Isaiah the prophet had said,
translation_verse: ne woawu nya, si wogblɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖila Yesaya dzi la nu bena:

english_verse: “Here is my chosen servant! I love him, and he pleases me. I will give him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: „Kpɔ ɖa, ye dɔla, si metia; ye blɔtɔ, amesi dzea ye luʋɔ ŋu la; matsɔ ye Gbɔgbɔ la ada ɖe eyama dzi, eye wòaka ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ta na dukɔawo.

english_verse: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.
translation_verse: Amesi ke mele kplim o la, eya to vo ɖe ŋutinye; eye amesi ke meƒoa ƒu kplim o la, eya kana hlẽna.

english_verse: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.
translation_verse: Tete wotsɔ amea ɖe, si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le, eye wònye ŋkuagbãtɔ kple aɖetututɔ la, va egbɔe. Eye wòda gbe le eŋu ale bena, aɖetututɔ la ƒo nu, eye wòkpɔ nu.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu nya woƒe tamebubuwo la, egblɔ na wo bena: Fiaɖuƒe sia fiaɖuƒe, si mã ɖe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti la, ezua aƒedo, eye du sia ɖu alo aƒe sia aƒe, si mã ɖe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti la, mele anyi nɔ ge o;

english_verse: If I use the power of Beelzebul to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? Your followers are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Ne nye la menya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do go to Beelzebul dzi la, ekema miaƒe ŋutsuviwo la, ameka dzi woto nyã wo do goe mahã? Eyakeŋuti la woawo azu miaƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when the demon doesn't find a place,
translation_verse: Ke esi gbɔgbɔ bliba la do go tso ame la me la, eyi ɖato ƒuƒuiƒewo le dzudzɔ dim, eye mekpɔe o.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and the person ends up in worse shape than before. That's how it will be with you evil people of today. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Mark
translation_verse: Tete la Wòtɔ edzi heyi ɖatsɔ gbɔgbɔ bubu adadre, siwo vɔ̃ɖi wu ye ŋutɔ la, hekpe ɖe eɖokui ŋuti, eye esi woyi ɖe eme la, wonɔ afima; eye nenem me sia ƒe anyinɔnɔ megbetɔ va vɔ̃ɖi wu gbãtɔ; nenema ke wòanɔ na nenem dzidzime vɔ̃ɖi sia hã. Yesu fia asi amesiwo nye eƒe ƒometɔ vavãwo.

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit. You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces.
translation_verse: Alo mido ati nyui la, eye eƒe kutsetse lanyo; alo mido ati manyomanyo la, eye eƒe kutsetse la manye o; elabena ati ƒe tsetse wotsɔna dzea sii.

english_verse: You are a bunch of evil snakes, so how can you say anything good? Your words show what is in your hearts.
translation_verse: Dawo ƒe dzidzimewo! Aleke lawɔ mi, amesiwo vɔ̃ɖi la, miate ŋu agblɔ nya nyuiwo mahã? Elabena nya, si ke wu dzi la, eya nu gblɔna.

english_verse: I promise you on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.
translation_verse: Eye mele egblɔm na mi bena; Nya dzodzro sia nya dzodzro, si amegbetɔwo lagblɔ la, wòabu akɔnta le eŋuti le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbeŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: On that day they will be told they are either innocent or guilty because of the things they have said. A Sign from Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Elabena wò nyawo woatsɔ atso afia na wò, eye wò nyawo woatsɔ abu fɔ wò.

english_verse: Some Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses said, “Teacher, we want you to show us a sign from heaven.”
translation_verse: Tete agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo dome tɔa ɖewo ɖo eŋu gblɔ bena: Nufiala, miedi be, míakpɔ dzesi tso gbɔwò.

english_verse: But Jesus replied: You want a sign because you are evil and won't believe! But the only sign you will get is the sign of the prophet Jonah.
translation_verse: Eye wòxɔ edzi gblɔ na wo bena: Dzidzime vɔ̃ɖi wɔahasi le dzesi biam, eye womele dzesi na gee o, negbe nyagblɔɖila Yona ƒe dzesi la ko;

english_verse: He was in the stomach of a big fish for three days and nights, just as the Son of Man will be deep in the earth for three days and nights.
translation_verse: elabena abe alesi Yona nɔ ƒumelãtsu ƒe ɖɔ me xɔ ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple zã hã etɔ̃ la, nenema ke amegbetɔvi la anɔ anyigba ƒe tu me ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple zã hã etɔ̃.

translation_verse: Eye amea ɖe va gblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, dawò kple nɔviwòwo le tsitre le xexe le didim be, yewoaƒo nu kpli wò.

translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke le Fofonye, si le dzi ƒowò, ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu wɔm la, eyae nye nɔvinyeŋutsu, enye nɔvinyenyɔnu, ganye danye hã.

english_verse: Such large crowds gathered around him that he had to sit in a boat, while the people stood on the shore.
translation_verse: Eye ameha geɖewo ƒo ƒu ɖe eŋu ale bena, wòyi ɖe ʋu me ɖabɔbɔ nɔ anyi, eye ameha blibo la katã le tsitre ɖe ƒua nu.

english_verse: Then he taught them many things by using stories. He said: A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked the plants.
translation_verse: Bubuwo ge ɖe ŋuwo me, eye ŋuawo mie vu tsyɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, “Why do you use stories to speak to the people?”
translation_verse: Tete nusrɔlawo va egbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: Nukaŋuti nèle nu ƒom na wo le lododowo me?

translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke nu le esi la, eya woana nui, eye woagbã go ne: ke amesi ke nu mele esi o la, nusi ke le esi la, woaxɔ eya hã le esi.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “These people will listen and listen, but never understand. They will look and look, but never see.

english_verse: Many prophets and good people were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear. Jesus Explains the Story about the Farmer (Mark
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nyagblɔɖilawo kple ame dzɔdzɔe geɖewo di be, yewoakpɔ nusiwo kpɔm miele, eye womekpɔe o; eye be, yewoase nusiwo sem miele la, eye womesee o.

translation_verse: Amesiame, si le fiaɖuƒe la ŋutinya sem, eye mesea egɔme o la, vɔ̃ɖitɔ la lava aha nusi wowu ɖe eƒe dzi me. Esia enye amesi gbɔ wowui ɖe mɔto le la.

english_verse: The seeds that fell among the thornbushes are also people who hear the message. But they start worrying about the needs of this life and are fooled by the desire to get rich. So the message gets choked out, and they never produce anything.
translation_verse: Ke nusi wowu ɖe ŋuwo me la, eya nye amesi le nya la sem, eye tete xexeame ƒe agbagbadzedze kple kesinɔnuwo ƒe beble vu tsyo nya la dzi, eye wòtsi matsematse la.

translation_verse: Ke nusi wowu ɖe anyigba nyui la dzi la, eya nye amesi le nya la sem, eye wòsea egɔme, amesi tsena, ɖewo alafa, ɖewo blaade, ɖewo blaetɔ̃ la.

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a farmer scattered good seed in a field.
translation_verse: Lo bubu wògado na wo bena: Dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ɖi amesi le nuku nyui wum ɖe eƒe abɔ me;

english_verse: When the plants came up and began to mature, the farmer's servants could see the weeds.
translation_verse: Ke esi lu la tsi, eye wòtse ku la, gbe wuwluiawo hã do.

english_verse: The servants came and asked, “Sir, didn't you scatter good seed in your field? Where did these weeds come from?”
translation_verse: Eye aƒeatɔ ƒe dɔlawo va egbɔ gblɔna bena: Aƒetɔ, alo ɖe menye nuku nyui nèwu ɖe wò abɔ me oa? Afika gbe wuwlui la tso?

english_verse: “An enemy did this,” he replied. His servants then asked, “Do you want us to go out and pull up the weeds?”
translation_verse: Eya gblɔ na wo bena: Futɔ lae wo esia. Dɔlawo gblɔ ne bena: Ekema elɔ̃? be, míayi aɖagae mahã?

english_verse: “No!” he answered. “You might also pull up the wheat.

english_verse: Jesus told them another story: The kingdom of heaven is like what happens when a farmer plants a mustard seed in a field.

english_verse: Jesus answered: The one who scattered the good seed is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo eŋu na wo bena: Amesi le nuku nyuia wum la, eya nye amegbetɔvi la;

english_verse: The field is the world, and the good seeds are the people who belong to the kingdom. The weeds are those who belong to the evil one,
translation_verse: ke abɔ la enye xexe la me, eye nuku nyui la enye fiaɖuƒe la ƒe viwo; ke gbe wuwluiawo nye vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe viwo;

english_verse: At once, Jesus said to them, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Enumake Yesu ƒo nu na wo gblɔ bena: Miaƒe dzi nèdze me, nye enye esi; migavɔ̃ o hee!

translation_verse: eye wova ɖe kuku nɛ bena, yewoade asi teƒe awuto ko ŋuti; eye ame geɖe alesi nu de asi eŋu la, ƒe lãme sẽ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.
translation_verse: Eye wòxɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Ati sia ati, si Fofonye, si le dziƒo la, medo o la, woahoe.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti wò nusrɔ̃lawo daa blematɔwo ƒe kɔawo dzi mahã? Elabena womeƒoa asi hafi ɖua abolo o.

english_verse: Jesus answered: Why do you disobey God and follow your own teaching?
translation_verse: Ke exɔ edzi gblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti miawo hã miedaa Mawu ƒe se la dzi le miaƒe kɔawo ŋuti mahã?

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la miegblɔ bena: Amesi ke lagblɔ na fofoa alo dadaa bena: Nusi ke nate ŋu akpɔ tso gbɔnye la, nanye nunana na Mawu la, eya magabu fofoa alo dadaa o!

english_verse: Is this any way to show respect to your parents? You ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching.
translation_verse: Eye miegabua Mawu ƒe se la o le miaƒe koa ŋuti.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.” What Really Makes People Unclean (Mark
translation_verse: Eye dzodzro wole subɔyem hele nufiafia, siwo nye amewo ƒe sededewo la fiam.“

english_verse: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.”
translation_verse: Miɖe asi le wo ŋu! Mɔfiala ŋkuagbãtɔwo wonye na ŋkuagbãtɔwo. Ke ne ŋkuagbãtɔ le mo fiam ŋkuagbãtɔ la, wo kpakple eve la katã woayi aɖadze do me.

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Ke meɖo nyaa ɖeke ŋu ne o. Eye esi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ la, woɖe kuku nɛ gblɔ bena: Do mɔe, ne wòayi; elabena ele ɣli ɖom le mia yome.

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Menye nusi ke yia nu me la, gblẽa kɔ ɖo na ame o; ke nusi ke doa go tsoa nu me la, eya koe gblẽa ko ɖo na ame.

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Tete nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: Enyae bena, esi farisitɔwo se nyaa la, eɖia wo nu mahã?

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Eye Petro xɔ edzi gblɔ ne bena: Ɖe lo sia gome na mi.

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Alo miawo hã ame masenugɔmewo mieganye mahã?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Alo miedze sii kpɔ bena, nusianu, si yia nu me la, eyina ɖe do me, eye wotsɔnɛ ƒua gbe ɖe kpɔxa o mahã?

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Ke nusiwo doa go tsoa nu me la, woawo doa go tso dzi me, eye nenem nu mawo ƒoa ɖi ame.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Elabena dzi mee nu vɔ̃ɖi susuwo, amewuwuwo, ahasiwowowo, matrewɔwɔwo, fififiwo, aʋatsoɖaseɖiɖiwo kple ɖiŋudodowo doa go tsona.

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Woawoe nye nusiwo ƒoa ɖi ame; ke ne woɖu nu asi maklɔmaklɔe la, eya meƒoa ɖi ame o. Kanaan-nyɔnu la.

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Ke eya ɖo eŋu gblɔ bena: Womedɔm o, negbe ɖe Israel-ƒe me alẽ bubuwo gbɔ ko.

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Eye ameha geɖewo va egbɔ; eye wokplɔ tekunɔwo, ŋkuagbãtɔwo, aɖetututɔwo, ame glɔmɔ̃wo kple dɔléla bubu ƒomevi geɖewo ɖe asi ve, eye wotso wo da ɖe eƒe afɔ nu; eye wòda gbe le wo ŋu.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu do go tso afima la, eva Tiro- kple Sidon-nutoawo me.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Eye kpo ɖa, Kanaan-nyɔnua ɖe ɖo go tso afima nutoawo me, eye wòɖo ɣli gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, Dawid vi la, kpɔ ye nublanui! Vinyenyɔnuvi le fu kpem ŋɔdzitɔe tso gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ si me.

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnua va dze klo ne gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, xɔ nam!

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo eŋu gblɔ bena: Womeɖe mɔ bena, woatsɔ ɖeviwo ƒe abolo aƒu gbe na avũviwo o.

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Ke eya gblɔ bena: Yoo, Aƒetɔ! Gake avũviwo hã ɖua abolo wuwlui, siwo duduna tsoa woƒe aƒetɔ ƒe kplɔ dzi.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Tete Yesu xɔ edzi gblɔ nɛ bena: O, nyɔnu, wò xɔse la lolo! Neva mè na wò, abe alesi nèdi ene. Eye eƒe nyɔnuvi la ƒe lãme sẽ le nenem gaƒoƒo ma dzi. Yesu yɔ dɔ dɔlélawo.

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu dzo le afima te yi ŋgɔ va Galilea-ƒua nu, eye wolia to la hebɔbɔ no anyi ɖe afima.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Esi ameha la kpɔ bena, aɖetututɔwo le nu ƒom, ame glɔmɔ̃wo le dzɔdzɔm, tekunɔwo le azɔli zɔm, eye ŋkuagbãtɔwo le nu kpɔm la, woƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye wokafu Israel ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu yɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ƒo ƒu ɖe egbɔ gblɔ bena: Nye dɔme trɔ ɖe ameha la ŋuti; elabena egbe enye ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe wole ŋutinye, eye naneke mele wo si woaɖu o; ke nyemelɔ̃ bena, mado mɔ wo dɔme ɣeɣi o, ɖewohĩ aƒetrɔ latsɔ wo le mɔ dzi.

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Afika míakpɔ abolo geɖe alea gbegbe atsoe le gbe sia dzi, bena ameha gã sia naɖu aɖi ƒo mahã?

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Abolo nenie le mia sii? Eye wogblɔ bena: Wo ame adre kple lãvi ʋeea ɖewo.

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo bena, ameha la nabɔbɔ nɔ anyigba;

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: eye wotsɔ abolo adre lã kple lãwo, eye esi wòda akpe ɖe wo dzi la, eŋe wo me hetsɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo, eye nusrɔ̃lawo tsɔ wo na ameha la.

english_verse: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.
translation_verse: Eye wo katã woɖu nu, eye woɖi ƒo, eye wolɔ abolo kakɛ, siwo susɔ la, ɖe kevi adre me fũ.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Aleke wɔ miedze sii kpo bena, menye abolo ŋuti meƒo nu le na mi o bena: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le farisitɔwo kple zadukitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔ ʋaʋã la ŋuti o mahã?

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu va Kaisarea Filipi-nutoawo me la, ebia eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Ameka amewo gblɔna bena, Amegbetɔvi la nye mahã?

english_verse: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Who Is Jesus? (Mark
translation_verse: Tete wodze sii bena, menye ɖe wògblɔ bena, yewoakpɔ yewo ɖokui dzi nyuie le farisitɔwo kple zadukitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔ ʋaʋã la ŋuti o, negbe le farisitɔwo kple zadukitɔwo ƒe nufiafia la ŋuti boŋ. Petro ʋu Yesu me.

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.
translation_verse: Ke exɔ edzi gblɔ na wo bena: Fiẽsi la miegblɔna bena: Xexeme le kɔkɔ ge; elabena dziƒo bia.

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Eye ŋdi la miegblɔna bena: Egbe la tsi le dzadza ge; elabena dziƒo biã, eye woxe lilii. Alakpatɔwo, miedzea si dziƒo ƒe nɔnɔme, aleke wɔ miate ŋu adze si ɣeyiɣiwo ƒe dzesiwo o mahã?

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: Eye woawo gblɔ bena: Ɖewo bena, Yohanes mawutsidetanamelae, ke bubuwo bena, Elia ye, eye amea ɖewo hã gblɔ bena, Yeremya, alo nyagblɔɖilawo dometɔ ɖekae.

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Tso ekema dzi la Yesu de asi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo fiafia me, alesi, wòle nɛ godoo bena, wòayi Yerusalem, eye woakpe fu geɖe atso amegãwo kple nunɔlagãwo kpakple agbalẽfialawo si me, eye woawui, eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe wòafɔe ɖe tsitre.

english_verse: Jesus then warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Mikpɔ nyuie, eye milé be na mia ɖokui le farisitɔwo kple zadukitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔ ʋaʋã la ŋuti.

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Eye woawo ke ɖi le wo nɔewo dome gblɔ bena, le esi yewometsɔ abolo ɖe asi o la ŋutie.

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Elabena Amegbetɔvi la le vava ge le Fofoa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me kple eƒe dɔlawo; eye ekema aɖo eteƒe na amesiame le eƒe nuwɔwɔwo nu.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Eye nye hã mele egblɔm na wò bena: Wòe nye Petro, eye nenem kpe gbadza sia dzi matu ye ha la ɖo, eye tsiẽƒe ƒe agbowo hã mele edzi ɖu ge o.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo bena: Ke miawo la, amekae miegblɔna bena, menye mahã?

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Eye Simon Petro xa edzi gblɔ bena: Wòe nye Kristo, Mawu gbagbe la ƒe vi!

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Woayra wò, Simon, Bar-Yona! Elabena ŋutilã kple ʋu meɖe esia fia wò o, negbe Fofonye, si le dziƒowo la ko.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Matsɔ dziƒofiaɖuƒe ƒe safuiawo ana wò, eye nusi ke nabia le anyigba dzi la, anɔ babla le dziƒowo, eye nusi ke natu le anyigba dzi la, anɔ tutu le dziƒowo.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Tete wòde se na nusrɔ̃lawo bena, woagagblɔe na amea ɖeke bena, yee nye Kristo la o. Yesu gblɔ eƒe fukpekpe ɖi zi gbãtɔ, eye wòfo nu le eyomedzedze ŋuti.

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Eye Petro ɖe kpoe, eye wòde asi nyagbegbe me nɛ gblɔ bena: Mawu nèhe esia ɖa xaa tso gbɔwò, Aƒetɔ; esia nagava dziwò gbeɖe o!

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Ke etrɔ gblɔ na Petro bena: Te ɖa yi megbenye, Satana! Nuɖiaɖia nènye nam, elabena menye Mawu tɔ nesusu o, negbe nusi nye amegbetɔwo tɔ ko.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Ne amea ɖe lɔ̃ bena, yeanɔ yonyeme la, negbe nu le eya ŋutɔ dokui gbɔ, ne woatsɔ eƒe atitsoga la, eye wòadze yonyeme.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke be, yeaɖe yeƒe agbe la, atsrɔ̃e; ke amesi ke atsrɔ̃ eƒe agbe le tanye la, akpɔe.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Ela bena viɖe ka wòanye na ame, ne xexeme blibo la katã zu etɔ, ke wòabu eƒe luʋɔ mahã? Alo nuka amegbetɔ atso ana agaxɔ eƒe luʋɔ mahã?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena, amea ɖewo le amesiwo le tsi tre ɖe afisia la dome, siwo mele ku ɖo ge akpɔ o, vaseɖe esime woakpɔ Amegbetɔvi la le eƒe fiaɖuƒe la me gbɔna.

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe nɔnɔme trɔ le woƒe ŋku me, eye eƒe mo klẽ sigbe ɣe ene, eye eƒe awuwo fu tititi abe kekeli ene?

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Tete nusrɔ̃lawo dze sii bena, Yohanes mawutsidetanamela ŋutie wògblɔe le na wo. Yesu da gbe le kpeŋutitɔa ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke ade megbe la Yesu tsa Petro kple Yakobo kple nɔvia Yohanes kpe ɖe eɖokui ŋuti, eye wòkplɔ wo yi to kɔkɔe ɖe dzi, woawo ɖeɖe.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, Mose kple Eliya woɖe wo ɖokui fia wo hele dzẽ ɖom kplii.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Ke Petro ɖo eŋu gblɔ na Yesu bena: Aƒetɔ, enyo na mí bena, miano afisia. Ne èlɔ̃ la, mawɔ agbadɔ etɔ̃ ɖe afisia; tɔwò ɖeka, Mose ta ɖeka, eye Eliya to ɖeka.

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Esi wogale nuƒoƒo la dzi la, kpo ɖa, alilikpo, si klẽ la, do vɔvɔli ɖe wo dzi; eye kpɔ ɖa, goe tso alilikpo la me gblɔ bena: Amesia enye vinye, si nyemelɔ̃a nu egbɔ o, si dzea ŋunye; miɖo to eyama!

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Eye esi nusrɔ̃lawo see la, wotsyɔ mo anyi, eye wovɔ̃ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu va wo gbɔ, eye wòde asi wo ŋu gblɔ bena: Mitsi tre, eye migavɔ̃ o!

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke esi wowu mo dzi la, womekpɔ amea ɖeke o, negbe Yesu ɖeka ko.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃lawo biae bena: Nukaŋuti gɔ̃ agbalẽfialawo gblɔ bena: Ele nɔ Eliya be, wòava gbãgbiagbã mahã?

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Ke eɖo eŋu gblɔ bena: Ele me bena: Eliya nava gbãgbiagbã, eye wòaɖo nuwo katã ɖo.

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi bena: Eliya va xoxo, eye womedze sii o: ke boŋ wowɔ nusianu, si wolɔ̃ la, ɖe eŋu. Nenema ke Amegbetɔvi la hã le fu kpe ge atso wo si mee.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Eve esi wova ameha la gbɔ la, amea de va egbɔ, eye wòdze klo nɛ

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm bena: Aƒetɔ, kpɔ nye ŋutsuvi ƒe nublanui! Elabena ele kpeŋui kum, eye wòle fu kpem ŋɔdzitɔe; elabena enuenu la edzea dzo me, eye enuenu la edzea tɔ me.

english_verse: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.”
translation_verse: Eye mekplɔe va wò nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ, eye womete ŋu da gbe le eŋu o.

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: O, dzidzime maxɔse kple dzidzime, si tro kpaɖikpaɖi; ɣekaɣie manɔ anyi kpli mi ase ɖo? Eye ɣekaɣie mado dzi ahe mi ase ɖo mahã? Mikplɔe va gbɔnye afii!

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu wo ɖe eta, eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la do go tso eme, eye ɖevi la ƒe lãme sẽ le nenem gaƒoƒo ma dzi.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Tete nusrɔ̃lawo ɖeɖe va Yesu gbɔ gblɔ bena: Nukaŋuti miawo miete ŋu nyae do go o mahã?

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Ke esi woƒo wo ɖokui nu ƒu le Galilea la, Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Wole Amegbetɔvi la ɖe ge asi na amewo

english_verse: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.” All of this made the disciples very sad. Paying the Temple Tax
translation_verse: eye woawui, eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la wòafɔ. Eye woxa nu ŋutɔ. Mawuxɔ me nudzɔdzɔ nana.

english_verse: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”
translation_verse: Esi wova Kapernaum la, amesiwo dzaa ga la, va Petro gbɔ, eye wogblɔ bena: Alo miaƒe nuxala ya menaa mawuxɔ me nudzɔdzɔ o mahã?
