english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Eye wòbena: Enana! Eye esi wòva aƒe me la, Yesu tre ebiabia gblɔ bena: Simon, nuka nèsusuna? Anyigba dzi fiawo la, ameka si woxɔa adzɔ alo nudzɔdzɔ lena mahã? Le woa ŋutɔwo ƒe viwo si loo, alo le amedzrowo si mahã?

english_verse: Peter answered, “From foreigners.” Jesus replied, “Then their own people don't have to pay.
translation_verse: Egblɔ bena: Le amedzrowo si. Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Ekema viwo le wo ɖokui si.

english_verse: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.”
translation_verse: Ke ne míagaɖia wo nu o la, yi ƒuta nada ƒu, eye lã, si ke naɖe gbã la, lée, eye ne èke eƒe nu la, akpɔ ga; eyae natsɔ ana wo ɖe mía kpli wò ta.

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, poke it out and get rid of it. You would be better off to go into life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fires of hell. The Lost Sheep (Luke
translation_verse: Eye ne wò ŋku ɖia nuwò la, hoe le eme, eye natsɔe aƒu gbe le ŋutiwò; enyo na wò bena, nayi ɖe agbe la me kple ŋku ɖeka, wui esi ŋku eve nana asiwò, eye woatso wò aƒu gbe ɖe dzomavɔʋe la me.

english_verse: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you?”
translation_verse: alo mele na wò bena, wò hã nakpɔ wò hadɔtsɔla ƒe nublanui, abe alesi nye hã mekpɔ wò nublanui ene o mahã?

english_verse: But if you are as humble as this child, you are the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti amesi ke bɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi abe nenem ɖevi sia ene la, eyae ƒo ta le dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me.

english_verse: And when you welcome one of these children because of me, you welcome me. Temptations To Sin (Mark
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke laxɔ nenem ɖevi sia tɔgbe ɖeka le nye ŋkɔa dzi la, nyee wòxɔ;

english_verse: If the follower refuses to listen to them, report the matter to the church. Anyone who refuses to listen to the church must be treated like an unbeliever or a tax collector. Allowing and Not Allowing
translation_verse: Ke ne meɖo to woawo hã o la, yi ɖagblɔe na hame la, eye ne meɖo to hame la hã o la, na ne wòano na wò abe trɔ̃subɔla kple nudzɔla ene.

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!
translation_verse: ke amesi ke laɖia nenem ɖevi sue, siwo xɔa dzinye sena, dometɔ ɖeka nu la, enyo nɛ bena, woatsɔ té atsi ɖe ko nɛ, eye woatsɔe aɖa ɖe ƒu ƒe gogloƒe, be wòano tsi aku.

english_verse: If your hand or foot causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Ke ne wò asi alo wò afɔ ɖia nuwò la, lae ɖa, eye natsɔe aƒu gbe le ŋutiwò; enyo na wò bena, nayi ɖe agbe la me kple afɔkpo alo abɔkpo wu esi aba eve alo afɔ eve anɔ asiwò, eye woatsɔ wò aƒu gbe ɖe dzo mavɔ la me.

english_verse: If one of my followers sins against you, go and point out what was wrong. But do it in private, just between the two of you. If that person listens, you have won back a follower.
translation_verse: Ke ne nɔviwò wo nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋutiwò la, yi ɖaɖee fiae le mia kple eya ɖeka ko dome; ne eɖo to wò la, ekema eɖe nɔviwò.

english_verse: That's how it is with your Father in heaven. He doesn't want any of these little ones to be lost. When Someone Sins (Luke
translation_verse: Nenema ke menye mia Fofo, si le dziƒowo la, ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu bena, nenem ɖevi sue siawo dometɔ ɖeka nabu o. Ŋusẽ si le nusrɔ̃lawo si.

english_verse: But if that one refuses to listen, take along one or two others. The Scriptures teach that every complaint must be proven true by two or more witnesses.
translation_verse: Ke ne meɖo to wò o la, yi ɖatsɔ ame ɖeka alo eve kpe ɖe ɖokuiwò ŋu, bena le ɖaseɖila eve alo etɔ̃ nu la woaɖo kpe nya sia nya dzi.

english_verse: I promise you God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth, but God will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nusianu, si ke míabia le anyigba dzi la, anɔ babla le dziƒo, eye nusianu, si ke miatu le anyigba dzi la, anɔ tutu le dziƒo.

english_verse: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
translation_verse: Megale egblɔm na mi hã bena: Ne mia dome ame eve woawɔ ɖeka le anyigba dzi le nusianu me, eye woaɖe kuku la, ava ve me na wo tso Fofonye, si le dziƒowo la gbɔ.

english_verse: Whenever two or three of you come together in my name, I am there with you. An Official Who Refused To Forgive
translation_verse: Elabena afisi ame eve alo ame etɔ̃ wokpe ta ɖo te nye ŋkɔa dzi la, afima mele wo titina. Lododo le fenyila gã la ŋu.

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Tete Petro va egbɔ gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, zi nenie nɔvinye awɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋutinye, eye matsɔe akee mahã? Halase zi adre loo?

english_verse: This story will show you what the kingdom of heaven is like: One day a king decided to call in his officials and ask them to give an account of what they owed him.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti wotso dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ɖo fiãa ɖe, si le didim be, yeabu akɔnta kple eƒe dɔlawo la ŋu.

english_verse: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him
translation_verse: Ke esi wòde asi ebubu me la, wokplɔ fenyila ɖeka, si talento akpe ewo le eŋu la, va egbɔ.

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Eye esi naneke mele esi wòatsɔ axee o la, eƒe aƒetɔ la de se bena, woatsɔ eya kple srɔ̃a kple viawo kple nusiwo katã le esi la aƒle, ne woatsɔ aɖo eteƒe.

english_verse: The official got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe!”
translation_verse: Tete dɔla ma dze klo ƒo koko nɛ gblɔ bena: Gbɔ dzi blewu, eye maɖo wo katã teƒe na wò.

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Eye aƒetɔ la kpɔ dɔla ma ƒe nublanui, eye wòɖe asi le eŋu hetsɔ fe la kee.

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: Tete eƒe hadɔtsɔla la dze klo ɖe kuku nɛ gblɔ bena:

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: Fa tu blewu, eye maɖo eteƒe na wò. Gake melɔ̃ o; ke boŋ eyi ɖatsɔe de gaxɔ me, vaseɖe esime wòaɖo nusi wònyi la teƒe.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Ke esi wo tɔwo kpɔ nusi va yi la, eve wo ŋutɔ, eye woyi ɖagblɔ nusiwo katã va ve me la, fia woƒe aƒetɔ eteƒeteƒe.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: Tete eƒe aƒetɔ la yɔe va egbɔ, gblɔ nɛ bena: Dɔla vɔ̃ɖi! Esi nèɖe kuku nam, metsɔ nenem fe ma katã ke wò la;

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe aƒetɔ la do dɔmedzoe, ɖee asi na ŋutasẽlawo, halase esime wòaxe fe, siwo katã wònyi la.

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: Nenema ke Fofonye, si le dziƒo la, hã lawɔ mi, ne mia dome amesiame metsɔ ke nɔvia tso eƒe dzi me o.

english_verse: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime Yesu wu nenem nya siawo nu la, edzo le Galilea, eye wòva Yudea-nutowo me le Yordan godo.

english_verse: Some people are unable to marry because of birth defects or because of what someone has done to their bodies. Others stay single in order to serve God better. Anyone who can accept this teaching should do so.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Mark
translation_verse: Elabena ame tataa ɖewo li, siwo wodzi wo nenema tso keke wo dada ƒe dɔ me ke; eye ame tataa ɖewo li, siwo amewo la wo; eye ame tataa ɖewo li, siwo ta wo ɖokui le dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ŋuti. Amesi ke ate ŋu ase eme la, nesee. Yesu yra ɖeviwo.

english_verse: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.
translation_verse: Eye ameha geɖewo dze eyome, eye wòda gbe le wo ŋu le afima.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, “Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?”
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo va egbɔ, eye wotee kpɔ gblɔ bena: Alo woɖe mɔ na ame bena, wòaɖe asi le srɔ̃a ŋu le nya sia nya ŋuti mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?
translation_verse: Ke eɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Alo miexlẽe kpɔ bena, amesi wɔ ame le gɔmedzedzea me ke la, atsu kple asi wòwɔ wòe o mahã?

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.
translation_verse: Eye wòbe. Le esia ta ame agblẽ fofoa kple dadaa ɖi, eye wòalé ɖe srɔ̃a ŋuti, eye wo kpakple eve la woanye ŋutilã ɖeka,

english_verse: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.”
translation_verse: nenem bena tso esia dzi yina la womeganye ame eve o, negbe ŋutilã ɖeka ko. Azɔ nusi ke Mawu bla la, ame nagamã eme o.

english_verse: The Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away?”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ ne bena: Azɔ nukaŋuti Mose de se bena, woana gbegbegbalẽe, eye woaɖe asi le eŋuti mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo bena: Le miaƒe dzimesesẽ ŋutie Mose na mɔ mi bena, miaɖe asi le mia srɔ̃wo ŋuti ɖo; gake tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la mele nenema o.

english_verse: I say if your wife has not committed some terrible sexual sin, you must not divorce her to marry someone else. If you do, you are unfaithful.”
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesi ke laɖe asi le srɔ̃a ŋuti, ne menye le ahasiwɔwɔ ŋuti o, eye wòaɖe bubua ɖe la, eyae wɔ ahasi.

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Only those people who have been given the gift of staying single can accept this teaching.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Menye amewo katãe ase nya sia me o, negbe amesiwo wona la ko.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus, so he could place his hands on them and pray for them. His disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Tete wotsɔ ɖevi suewo va egbɔ, bena woada asi ɖe wo dzi, eye ne wòado gbe ɖa; ke nusrɔ̃lawo blu ɖe wo ta.

english_verse: A man came to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, amea ɖe va egbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: Nufiala, nu nyui ka mawɔ, ne makpɔ agbe mavɔ mahã?

english_verse: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “Do not murder. Be faithful in marriage. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: Eye wòbena: Kawoe? Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Megawu ame o. Megawɔ ahasi o. Megafi fi o; Megaɖi aʋatsoɖase o.

english_verse: After Jesus had placed his hands on the children, he left. A Rich Young Man (Mark
translation_verse: Eye wòda asi ɖe wo dzi, eye wòdzo le afima. Ɖekakpui kesinɔtɔ la.

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, you must obey his commandments.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Nuka nèle biayem le nyuie ŋuti mahã? Amea ɖeke mele nyuie o negbe Mawu ɖeka ko; ke ne èle didim bena, yeayi ɖe agbe la me la, lé seawo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Let the children come to me, and don't try to stop them! People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Mina ɖeviwo nava gbɔnye, eye migaxe mɔ na wo o; elabena nenem mewo tɔe nye dziƒofiaɖuƒe la.

english_verse: But many who are now first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
translation_verse: Ke ame geɖe, siwo nye mlɔetɔwo, lazu gbãtɔwo, eye gbãtɔwo lazu mlɔetɔwo.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother. And love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Bu fofowò kple dawò, eye nalɔ̃ hawòvi abe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene.

english_verse: The young man said, “I have obeyed all of these. What else must I do?”
translation_verse: Ɖekakpui la gblɔ nɛ bena: Mewɔ nusiawo katã dzi tso nye ɖevime ke; nuka gasusɔ nama?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If you want to be perfect, go sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Ne èle didim be, yeazu blibo la, heyi ɖadzra nusiwo le asiwò la, ne natsɔ wo ana ame dahewo, ekema kesinɔnu anɔ dziƒo na wò, eye nava anɔ yonyeme.

english_verse: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Ke esi ɖekakpui la see la, edzo yi kple nuxaxa: elabena nu geɖe le esi.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you, it's terribly hard for rich people to get into the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena, esẽ na kesinɔtɔ bena, wòayi ɖe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Eye megale egblɔm na mi hã bena: Ele bɔbɔe na kposɔ be, wòato abi ƒe vo me wu alesi kesinɔtɔ nayi de dziƒofiaɖuƒe la mee.

english_verse: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly surprised and asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Ke esi nusrɔ̃lawo see la, kuvia do wo ŋutɔ, eye wogblɔ bena: Ekema ameka gɔ̃e ate ŋu akpɔ ɖeɖe mahã?

english_verse: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “There are some things people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu le wo kpɔm du gblɔ na wo bena: Amegbetɔwo gbɔ la womate ŋu awɔ esia o; ke Mawu gbɔ la woate ŋu awɔ nusianu.

english_verse: Peter replied, “Remember, we have left everything to be your followers! What will we get?”
translation_verse: Tete Petro xɔ edzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, miawo miegblẽ nuwo katã ɖi, eye miedze yowòme: nuka gɔ̃e lanye mía to mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered: Yes, all of you have become my followers. And so in the future world, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, I promise you will sit on twelve thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena, mi amesiwo dze yonyeme la, le nuwo ƒe gbugbɔgadzi me la, gbesigbe ke Amegbetɔvi la abɔbɔ na eƒe ŋutikɔkɔezikpui la dzi la, miawo hã miabɔbɔ nɔ zikpui wuieve dzi, eye míadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu Israel ƒome wuieveawo.

english_verse: All who have given up home or brothers and sisters or father and mother or children or land for me will be given
translation_verse: Eye amesiame, si ke gblẽ nɔviŋutsuwo alo nɔvinyɔnuwo alo fofo alo dada alo srɔ̃ alo viwo alo abɔwo alo xɔwo ɖi le nye ŋkɔ ŋuti la, elaxɔ teƒeɖoɖo geɖe, eye anyi agbe mavɔ dome.

english_verse: As Jesus was telling what the kingdom of heaven would be like, he said: Early one morning a man went out to hire some workers for his vineyard.
translation_verse: Elabena dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ɖi aƒetɔa ɖe, si do go ŋdikanya, be yeadɔ dɔwɔlawo de yeƒe weinbɔ me.

english_verse: After he had agreed to pay them the usual amount for a day's work, he sent them off to his vineyard.
translation_verse: Ke esi eya kple dɔwɔlawo nyi denario ɖeka ƒe asi ɖe ŋkeke ɖeka dzi la, edo wo de eƒe weinbɔ la me.

english_verse: About nine that morning, the man saw some other people standing in the market with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdo go le gaƒoƒo etɔ̃lia me la, ekpa ame bubuwo le tsitre le asi me le kuvia me;

english_verse: He promised to pay them what was fair, if they would work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miawo hã miheyi ɖe weinbɔ la me, eye nusi ke anyo la, mana mi. Eye woyi.

english_verse: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, “Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòdo go le gaƒoƒo wuiɖekelia me la, ekpɔ ame bubuwo le tsitre, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti míetsi tre le kuvia me ɖe afisia ŋkeke blibo la katã mahã?

english_verse: “Because no one has hired us,” they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ bena: Elabena amea ɖeke medɔ mi o. Egblɔ na wo bena: Miawo hã miheyi ɖe weinbɔ la me.

english_verse: That evening the owner of the vineyard told the man in charge of the workers to call them in and give them their money. He also told the man to begin with the ones who were hired last.
translation_verse: Ke esi fiẽsi ɖo la, weinbɔtɔ la gblɔ na eƒe xɔnuvi bena: Yɔ dɔwɔlawo vɛ, eye nana fetu wo, eye nadze egɔme atso mlɔetɔwo dzi vaseɖe gbãtɔwo dzi.

english_verse: When the workers arrived, the ones who had been hired at five in the afternoon were given a full day's pay.
translation_verse: Eye esi gaƒoƒo wuiɖekelia me tɔwo va la, wo katã woxɔ denario ɖekaɖeka.

english_verse: they began complaining to the owner of the vineyard.
translation_verse: Eye esi woxɔe la, woli liʋiliʋi le aƒetɔ la ŋuti

english_verse: They said, “The ones who were hired last worked for only one hour. But you paid them the same that you did us. And we worked in the hot sun all day long!”
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Ame mlɔetɔ siawo wo do gaƒoƒo ɖeka ko, eye nèwɔ wo wosɔ kpli mi, amesiwo kpe hiã ŋkeke blibo la katã, eye ŋɖɔkutsu ɖu mi la.

english_verse: The owner answered one of them, “Friend, I didn't cheat you. I paid you exactly what we agreed on.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo dometɔ ɖeka bena: Xɔ̃nye, nyemewɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ ɖe ŋuwò o, alo mia kpli wò la menye denario dzi mienyi asi ɖo o mahã?

english_verse: Take your money now and go! What business is it of yours if I want to pay them the same that I paid you?
translation_verse: Tsɔ tawò nayi; gake melɔ̃ bena, mana mlɔetɔ sia, abe alesi mena wò ene.

english_verse: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Why should you be jealous, if I want to be generous?”
translation_verse: Alo ɖe ma mele asinye bena, mawɔ nusi nye tɔnye la ŋuti do, alesi melɔ̃ o mahã? Alo nye ɖɔmenyonyo ŋutie nèle ŋku biam ɖe ŋutinye ɖo mahã?

english_verse: Jesus then said, “So it is. Everyone who is now last will be first, and everyone who is first will be last.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Nenem eye mlɔetɔwo lazu gbãtɔwo, eye gbãtɔwo lazu mlɔetɔwo; elabena ame geɖewo nye amesiwo woyɔ, eye ame ʋeewo nye amesiwo wotia. Fukpekpe gbɔgblɔɖi etɔ̃lia.

english_verse: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu to ɖe tsitre, eye wòyɔ wo ve gblɔ bena: Nuka dim miele, bena mawɔ na mi mahã?

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. At once they could see, and they became his followers.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ƒe dɔme trɔ ɖe wo ŋu, eye wòde asi woƒe ŋkuwo ŋu, eye enumake wokpɔ nu, eye wodze eyome.

english_verse: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Eye ameha la blu ɖe wo ta, bena woazi ɖoɖoe. Ke woawo gado ɣli ɖe edzi gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, Dawid vi la, kpɔ mia nublanui!

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he took his twelve disciples aside and told them in private:
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu yina Yerusalem la, ena nusrɔ̃la wuieve la ɖeɖe va egbɔ, eye le mɔ dzi la egblɔ na wo bena:

english_verse: and then they will hand him over to foreigners who will make fun of him. They will beat him and nail him to a cross. But on the third day he will rise from death. A Mother's Request (Mark
translation_verse: eye woatsɔe ade asi na trɔ̃subɔlawo, bena woaɖu fewu le eŋuti, eye woaƒoe kple atam, eye woahee ɖe ati ŋuti; eye ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la wòatsi tre? Zebedeo vi eveawo. Ameka enye gãtɔ?

english_verse: The mother of James and John came to Jesus with her two sons. She knelt down and started begging him to do something for her.
translation_verse: Tete Zebedeo viwo dada va egbɔ kple eƒe ŋutsuvi eve, eye wòdze klo nɛ le nane biamii.

english_verse: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, “When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ ne bena; Nuka dim nèle? Egblɔ nɛ bena: Na bena, nye ŋutsuvi eve siawo nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi, ɖeka nanɔ wò nuɖusi me, eye ɖeka nanɔ wò mia me le wò fiaɖuƒe la me.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from?” James and John said, “Yes, we are!”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Mienya nusi biam miele o. Alo miate ŋu ano kplu, si no ge malaa? Eye mawutsi, si woade ta nam la, wòadee ta na miawo hã mahã? Wogblɔ nɛ bena: Miate ŋui.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from my cup! But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for my Father to say.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo bena: Ele me bena, miano nye kplu la, eye mawutsi, si woade ta nam la, woadee ta na miawo hã; ke anyinɔnɔ ɖe nye nuɖusi me kple mia me la, eya menye tonye be, mana o, negbe amesiwo Fofonye dzrae ɖo ɖi na la ko.

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.
translation_verse: Ke esi ame ewo la see la, eve dɔme na wo ɖe nɔvi eveawo ŋuti.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ya wo va egbɔ gblɔ bena: Mienya bena, dukɔwo ƒe dziɖulawo nye aƒetɔwo ɖe wo dzi, eye amegãwo kpo ŋusẽ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.
translation_verse: Neganɔ nenema le mia dome o; ke amesi ke di bena, yeazu amegã le mia dome la, nanye miaƒe subɔla;

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.
translation_verse: eye amesi ke di bena, yeanye gbãtɔ le mia dome la, nanye miaƒe dɔla;

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men (Mark
translation_verse: abe alesi Amegbetɔvi la meva bena, woasubɔ ye o, ke boŋ bena yeasubɔ, eye yeatsɔ eƒe agbe la ana ɖe ame geɖewo ƒe xoxo ta la ene. Ŋkuagbãtɔ eve le Yerixo gbɔ.

english_verse: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.
translation_verse: Eye esi wodo go tso Yerixo-dua me yina la, ameha geɖewo dze eyome.

english_verse: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Eve kpo ɖa, ŋkuagbãtɔ eve bɔbɔ nɔ mɔ to; esi wose bena, Yesu le wo ŋuti tom yina la, wodo ɣli gblɔ bena: Dawid vi la, kpɔ mia nublanui!

english_verse: They answered, “Lord, we want to see!”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, bena miaƒe ŋkuwo naʋu.

english_verse: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, “Go work in the vineyard today!”
translation_verse: Ke nuka miesusuna? Vi eve le amea ɖe si, eye wòva gbãtɔ gbɔ gblɔ bena: Vinye, heyi nawɔ da le weinbɔ la me egbe.

english_verse: But when they saw the man's son, they said, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ke esi agbledelawo kpɔ via la, wogblɔ le wo nɔewo dome bena: Domenyila enye esi; miva, ne miawui, ne míaxɔ eƒe domenyinyi.

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will at once let you have the donkeys.”
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe agblɔ nane na mi la, migblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ la le wo hiãm, eye enumake adɔ wo ɖa.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Ke nusia va me, bena woawu nya, si wogblɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖila dzi la nu bena:

english_verse: “Announce to the people of Jerusalem: ‘Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey.’ ”
translation_verse: „Migblɔ na Zion vinyɔnuvi la bena: Kpɔ ɖa, wò fia gbɔna gbɔwò; eƒe dɔm…, eye wòdo tedzi kple dɔwɔlã, si nye tedzivi.

english_verse: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.
translation_verse: Ke esi nusrɔ̃lawo yi la, wowɔ abe alesi Yesu ɖo na wo la ene;

english_verse: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.
translation_verse: eye wokplɔ tedzinɔ kple via ve, eye watsɔ woƒe avɔwo ɖo wo dzi, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: When Jesus came to Jerusalem, everyone in the city was excited and asked, “Who can this be?”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva Yerusalem la, du blibo la katã ƒo zi gblɔ bena: Ameka nye esia?

english_verse: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.
translation_verse: Eye esi nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo kpɔ nukudɔ, siwo wòwɔ, kple ɖevi, siwo le ɣli dom le mawuƒe la me bena: Hosana na Dawid vi la! la, eve dome na wo.

english_verse: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew Jesus was talking about them.
translation_verse: Ke esi nunɔlagãwo kple farisitɔwo se eƒe lododoawo la, wodze sii bena, yewo ŋuti wòdo wo ɖo.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be called a place of worship.’ But you have turned it into a place where robbers hide.”
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Nye aƒe la, woayɔe be gbedoxɔ; ke miawo mietsɔe wo adzodalawo ƒe ɖoe.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray, you will be given whatever you ask for.” A Question about Jesus' Authority (Mark
translation_verse: Eye nusianu, si ke míabia le gbedodoɖa me kple xɔse la, miaxɔe. Yesu ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ le gbedoxɔ me.

english_verse: The men said to Jesus, “Don't you hear what those children are saying?” “Yes, I do!” Jesus answered. “Don't you know that the Scriptures say, ‘Children and infants will sing praises’?”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ese nusi ame siawo le gbɔgblɔm mahã? Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Ẽ! Alo miexlẽe kpɔ bena: „Ɖeviwo kple vi nonowo ƒe nu me nèdzra kafukafu ɖo o mahã?

english_verse: Then Jesus left the city and went out to the village of Bethany, where he spent the night. Jesus Puts a Curse on a Fig Tree (Mark
translation_verse: Eye wògblẽ wo ɖi do go tso dua me yi ɖe Betania, eye wòtsi afima dɔ. Gboti matseku la.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I have just one question to ask you. If you answer it, I will tell you where I got the right to do these things.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye hã mabia nya ɖeka mi, eye ne miegblɔe nam la, ekema nye hã magblɔ ŋusẽ, si metsɔ wɔ esiawo la, na mi:

english_verse: When Jesus got up the next morning, he was hungry. He started out for the city,
translation_verse: Ke esi wògayina ɖe ɖua me le ŋdi me la, do wui.

english_verse: But Jesus said to them, “If you have faith and don't doubt, I promise you can do what I did to this tree. And you will be able to do even more. You can tell this mountain to get up and jump into the sea, and it will.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ne xɔse le mia si, eye mieke ɖi o la, ekema menye nusi wɔ gboti la ɖeɖeko miawɔ o; ke boŋ ne miagblɔ na to sia hã bena: Ho, ne nayi aɖadze ƒu me la, ava ve me.

english_verse: So they told Jesus, “We don't know.” Jesus said, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.” A Story about Two Sons
translation_verse: Eye woɖo eŋu na Yesu bena: Míenye o. Eya hã gblɔ na wo bena: Ekema nye hã nyemagblɔ ŋusẽ, si metso wo esiawòe la, na mi o.

english_verse: Jesus told the chief priests and leaders to listen to this story: A land owner once planted a vineyard. He built a wall around it and dug a pit to crush the grapes in. He also built a lookout tower. Then he rented out his vineyard and left the country.
translation_verse: Mise lo bubu: Aƒetɔa ɖe de weingble, eye wòtɔ kpɔ ɖe eŋu godoo, eye wòwɔ weinfiãnu ɖe eme, eye wòtu mɔ̃ ɖe eme, eye wòtsɔe ɖe asi na weingbledelawo, eye wòyi nugbe.

english_verse: Jesus had gone into the temple and was teaching when the chief priests and the leaders of the people came up to him. They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòva mawuƒe me, eye wòle nu fiãm amewo la, nunɔlagãwo kple dumegãwo va egbɔ gblɔ bena: Ŋusẽ ka nètsɔ wɔ esiawoe, eye amekae tsɔ nenem ŋusẽ sia na wò mahã?

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?” They thought it over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Yohanes ƒe mawutsidedetaname la ɖe, afika wòtso? Tso dziƒo loo, alo tso amewo gbɔ mahã? Ke woawo ke ɖi le wo nɔewo dome bena:

english_verse: On the other hand, these people think John was a prophet, and we are afraid of what they might do to us. That's why we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Ne miegblɔ bena, dziƒo wòtso la, agblɔ na mí bena: Ekema nukaŋuti miexɔ edzi se o? Ke ne miegblɔ bena, amewo gbɔ wòtso la, ekema mievɔ̃ ameha la; elabena wo katã wobu Yohanes abe nyagblɔɖila ene.

english_verse: His son told him he would not do it, but later he changed his mind and went.
translation_verse: Ke eɖo eŋu gblɔ bena: Megbe! Ke emegbe la evee, eye wòyi.

english_verse: The man then told his younger son to go work in the vineyard. The boy said he would, but he didn't go.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva evelia gbɔ la, egagblɔe nɛ nenema ke. Eya ɖo eŋu gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, mayi! Ke meyi o.

english_verse: Which one of the sons obeyed his father? “The older one,” the chief priests and leaders answered. Then Jesus told them: You can be sure tax collectors and prostitutes will get into the kingdom of God before you ever will!
translation_verse: Ame eve siawo dometɔ kae wo fofoa ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu mahã? Wogblɔ bena: Gbãtɔ lae. Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nudzɔlawo kple ahasiwɔlawo tre mawufiaɖuƒe la me yiyi na mi.

english_verse: When John the Baptist showed you how to do right, you would not believe him. But these evil people did believe. And even when you saw what they did, you still would not change your minds and believe. Renters of a Vineyard (Mark
translation_verse: Elabena Yohanes va mia gbɔ le dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ dzi, eye miexɔ eyama dzi se o; ke nudzɔlawo kple ahasiwɔlawo xɔ edzi se; gake miawo la, esi miekpɔe la, mietrɔ miaƒe tame emegbe bena, miaxɔ edzi ase o. Lododo le weinbɔ gbledelawo ŋuti.

english_verse: When it was harvest time, the owner sent some servants to get his share of the grapes.
translation_verse: Eye esi kutseɣi ɖo la, edo eƒe dɔlawo ɖo ɖe agbledelawo gbã, bena woaxɔ eƒe kutsetsewo vɛ.

english_verse: But the renters grabbed those servants. They beat up one, killed one, and stoned one of them to death.
translation_verse: Ke agbledelawo lé eƒe dolawo, woƒo ame ɖeka, wowu ame ɖeka, eye woƒu kpe ame ɖeka.

english_verse: He then sent more servants than he did the first time. But the renters treated them in the same way.
translation_verse: Egadɔ dɔla bubu geɖewo sɔ gbɔ wu gbãtɔwo, eye wowɔ woawo hã nenema ke.

english_verse: Finally, the owner sent his own son to the renters, because he thought they would respect him.
translation_verse: Ke emegbe la edɔ via ɖo ɖe wo gbɔ gblɔ bena: Woasi vinye ƒe ŋku me mahi.

english_verse: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
translation_verse: Tete wòlée hetu asi ʋume nɛ do go tso weingble la me, eye wowui.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “When the owner of that vineyard comes, what do you suppose he will do to those renters?”
translation_verse: Azɔ ne weingbleatɔ ava la, nuka wòawɔ agbledela mawo mahã?

english_verse: The chief priests and leaders answered, “He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ ne bena: Atsrɔ̃ ame vlo siawo ŋɔdzitɔe, eye wòatsɔ weingble la ade asi na agbledela bubu, siwo atsɔ kutsetsewo nɛ ɖe woƒe ɣeyiɣi nyuiwo dzi.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You surely know that the Scriptures say, ‘The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Alo miexlẽ le ŋɔŋlɔawo me kpɔ bena: „Kpe, si xɔtulawo gbe la, eya ke trɔ zu dzogoekpe; Aƒetɔ la gbɔ esia tso, eye wònye nukunu le míaƒe ŋkuwo me“ o mahã?

english_verse: I tell you God's kingdom will be taken from you and given to people who will do what he demands.
translation_verse: Eyakeŋuti mele egblɔm na mi bena: Woaxɔ mawufiaɖuƒe la le mia si, eye woatsɔe ana dukɔ, si atse ku la.

english_verse: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will be crushed, and anyone it falls on will be smashed to pieces.”
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke ladze kpe sia dzi la, aŋe gudugudu; eye amesi ke dzi wòadze la, atui memie.

english_verse: So they looked for a way to arrest Jesus. But they were afraid to, because the people thought he was a prophet.
translation_verse: Eye wole didim be, yewoalée, ke woyɔ̃ ameha la, elabena wobunɛ abe nyagblɔɖila ene.

english_verse: Many are invited, but only a few are chosen. Paying Taxes (Mark
translation_verse: Elabena ame geɖewo nye amesiwo woyɔ; ke ame ʋeewo nye amesiwo wotia. Nudzɔdzɔ na kaisaro.

english_verse: The Pharisees got together and planned how they could trick Jesus into saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Tete farisitɔwo yi, eye wode adaŋu alesi woawɔ, ne woatsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ atre mɔ̃ nɛ alée.

english_verse: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: Nufiala, Mose gblɔ bena, ne amea ɖe ku, eye viwo mele esi o la, nɔvia naɖe srɔ̃a, ne wòado ƒome ɖi na nɔvia.

english_verse: Once again Jesus used stories to teach the people:
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ɖo ŋu, eye wògaƒo nu na wo lelododowo me gblɔ bena:

english_verse: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a king gave a wedding banquet for his son.
translation_verse: Dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ɖi fiãa ɖe, si wɔ srɔ̃ɖeŋkekenyuie na via,

english_verse: The king sent some servants to tell the invited guests to come to the banquet, but the guests refused.
translation_verse: eye wòdɔ eƒe dɔlawo, bena wòayi aɖayɔ amesiwo wokpe la, ava srɔɖeŋkekenyuieɖuƒee; ke womelɔ̃ bena, yewoava o.

english_verse: He sent other servants to say to the guests, “The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet!”
translation_verse: Egadɔ dɔla bubuwo gblɔ bena: Migblɔ na amesiwo wokpe la bena: Kpɔ ɖa, medzra nye nuɖuɖu ɖo; wowu nye nyitsuwo kple lã damiwo, eye nuwo katã sɔ gbe; miva srɔ̃ɖeŋkekenyuieɖuƒe.

english_verse: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.
translation_verse: Ke womebui nɛ o, eye wodzo heyi, ame ɖeka yi eƒe abɔ me, eye ame bubu yi eƒe adzɔ do ge.

english_verse: Others grabbed the servants, then beat them up and killed them.
translation_verse: Eye mamleawo lé eƒe dɔlawo, wodo vlo wo, eye wowu wo.

english_verse: This made the king so furious that he sent an army to kill those murderers and burn down their city.
translation_verse: Ke fia la do dɔmedzoe, eye wòdɔ eƒe aʋakɔwo, eye woyi ɖagblẽ nenem hlɔ̃dola mawo, eye wòtɔ dzo woƒe du.

english_verse: Then he said to the servants, “It is time for the wedding banquet, and the invited guests don't deserve to come.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na eƒe dɔlawo bena: Srɔ̃ɖenuawo sɔ gbe; gake amesiwo wokpe lã, womedze o.

english_verse: Go out to the street corners and tell everyone you meet to come to the banquet.”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti miyi mɔ dzeveewo dzi, eye amesiame, si ke míakpɔ la, miyɔe va srɔ̃ɖeŋkekenyuieɖuƒe.

english_verse: When the king went in to meet the guests, he found that one of them wasn't wearing the right kind of clothes for the wedding.
translation_verse: Ke esi fia la va kplɔ̃ŋutinɔlawo kpɔ ge ɖa la, ekpɔ amea ɖe le afima, si medo srɔɖewu o;

english_verse: Tell us what you think! Should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not?”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti gblɔe na mi, nuka nèsusuna mahã? Woɖe mɔ bena, woadzɔ nu na kaisaro loo, womeɖe mɔ o mahã?

english_verse: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers and finally to all seven of them.
translation_verse: nenema ke evelia kple etɔ̃lia hã wowɔ, vaseɖe adrelia dzi.

english_verse: They sent some of their followers and some of Herod's followers to say to him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Eye wodɔ woƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple Herodiahawo ɖo ɖe legba gblɔ bena: Nufiala, míenye bena, nyateƒetɔ nènye, eye nèle Mawu ƒe mɔ fiãm le nyateƒe me, eye amea ɖeke ƒe nya meɖia wò o: elabena mèkpɔa amewo ƒe ŋku me o.

english_verse: Let me see one of the coins used for paying taxes.” They brought him a silver coin,
translation_verse: Mifia nudzɔsika lam. Eye wotsɔ denario la va fiae.

english_verse: “The Emperor's,” they answered. Then Jesus told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.”
translation_verse: Wodo ŋu nɛ bena: Kaisaro tɔe. Tete wògblɔ na wo bena: Ekema mitsɔ nusi enye kaisaro tɔ la, na kaisaro, eye nusi enye Mawu tɔ la, na Mawu.

english_verse: His answer surprised them so much that they walked away. Life in the Future World (Mark
translation_verse: Eye esi wosee la, wotsiyaa, eye wogblẽe ɖi hedzo. Ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi.

english_verse: At last the woman died.
translation_verse: Wo katã megbe la nyɔnu la hã ku.

english_verse: All the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets are based on these two commandments. About David's Son (Mark
translation_verse: Se blibo la katã kple nyagblɔɖilawo ku ɖe nenem se eve siawo ŋuti. Kristo enye Dawid vi kple eƒe aƒetɔ.

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe people would rise to life after death. So that same day some of the Sadducees came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke ma dzi la zadukitɔ, siwo gblɔna bena, tsitretsitsi meli o la, va egbɔ, eye wobiae bena:

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Mieda ƒu, elabena mienya ŋɔŋlɔawo kple Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ la o.

english_verse: When God raises people to life, they won't marry. They will be like the angels in heaven.
translation_verse: Elabena le tsitretsitsi la me la womeɖea srɔ̃ o, eye womenana woɖea wo hã o; ke boŋ wole abe mawudɔlawo le dziƒo ene.

english_verse: And as for people being raised to life, God was speaking to you when he said,
translation_verse: Ke le ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi gome la, ɖe miexlẽ nya, si Mawu gblɔ ɖi na mi bena:

english_verse: “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living.
translation_verse: „Nye enye Abraham ƒe Mawu, Isak ƒe Mawu kple Yakob ƒe Mawu“ la o mahã? Menye ame kukuwo ƒe Mawu wònye o, ke boŋ ame gbegbewo toe.

english_verse: The crowds were surprised to hear what Jesus was teaching. The Most Important Commandment (Mark
translation_verse: Eye esi amehaawo see la, kuvia ɖo wo le eƒe nufiafia la ŋuti. Se lolotɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus had made the Sadducees look foolish, the Pharisees heard about it and got together.
translation_verse: Ke esi farisitɔwo se bena, ede ga nu na zadukitɔwo la, woƒo wo ɖokui nu ƒu ɖe afi ɖeka.

english_verse: “Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law?”
translation_verse: Nufiala, se ka nye vevito le sea me mahã?

english_verse: This is the first and most important commandment.
translation_verse: Esia enye se gbãtɔ, si le vevie.

english_verse: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Eye evelia, si ɖii la, enye bena: „Lɔ̃ hawòvi abe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene.“

english_verse: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them,
translation_verse: Ke esi farisitɔwo ƒo ƒu la, Yesu bia wo bena:

english_verse: ‘The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: „Aƒetɔ la gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ bena: Bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe nye nuɖusi me, vaseɖe esime matsɔ wò ketɔwo aɖe wò afɔ te.“

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: Aleke miebuna le Kristo la ŋutii? Ameka vi wònyea? Woɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Dawid vie.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “How then could the Spirit lead David to call the Messiah his Lord? David said,
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo bena: Aleke gɔ̃ wo Dawid yɔe le gbɔgbɔ me be Aƒetɔ, esi wògblɔ bena:

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: Azɔ ne Dawid yɔe be Aƒetɔ la, aleke wɔ wònye via mahã?

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke mete ŋu ɖo nyaa ɖeke ŋu nɛ, alo do dzi gabia nyaa ɖee tso ŋkeke ma dzi heyina o.

english_verse: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke lado eɖokui ɖe dzi la, woabɔbɔe ɖe anyi, eye amesi ke labɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi la, woadoe ɖe dzi.

english_verse: And now your temple will be deserted.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, woagblẽ miaƒe aƒe ɖi na mi aƒedoe.

english_verse: Whoever is the greatest should be the servant of the others.
translation_verse: Ke amesi nye gãtɔ le mia dome la, nanye miaƒe subɔla.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, Yerusalem, si wu nyagblɔɖilawo, eye wòfɔ kpe ƒu amesiwo wodɔ ɖo ɖe egbɔ! Zi nenie meɖi bena, maƒo viwòwo nu ƒu, abe alesi koklonɔ ƒoa viawo nu ƒu ɖe eƒe aʋala te ene, gake mielɔ̃ o!

english_verse: Anyone who swears by the altar also swears by everything on it.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti amesi ke atà vɔsamlekpui la, eya ta eya kple nusianu, si le edzi.

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Tete Yesu ƒo nu na amehawo kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ bena:

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo bɔbɔ nɔ Mose ƒe zikpui dzi;

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: eyaŋuti nusianu, si wogblɔ na mi la, miwɔe, eye milé eme ɖe asi; gake la migawɔ nu ɖe woƒe nuwɔnawo nu o, elabena wogblɔnɛ, ke womewɔnɛ o.

english_verse: They pile heavy burdens on people's shoulders and won't lift a finger to help.
translation_verse: Ke wodoa agba kpekpe, siwo wu tsɔtsɔ la, hetsɔna ɖoa amewo ƒe abɔta; gake woawo ŋutɔ melɔ̃na be, woƒe asibide ɖeka naka wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Eye wowɔa woƒe nuwo katã, bena amewo nakpɔ wo; elabena wowɔa woƒe ŋkuɖodzinuwo wokekena, eye wowɔa woƒe awutogbowo wololona;

english_verse: They love the best seats at banquets and the front seats in the synagogues.
translation_verse: eye wolɔ̃a kplɔ̃tanɔnɔ le nuɖuƒewo kple nɔƒe gbãtɔwo nɔnɔ le woƒe ƒuƒoƒewo

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: kpakple gbedoname le ablɔawo me, eye bena, amewo nayɔ wo be Rabi.

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la migana woayɔ mi be Rabi o, elabena ame ɖeka koe nye miaƒe nufiala, eye mi katã la nɔviwò mienye.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Eye migayɔ amea ɖeke be mia fofo le anyigba dzi o; elabena ame ɖekae nye mia fofo, eyae le dziƒo.

english_verse: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.
translation_verse: Eye womegayɔ mi be kplɔlawo o; elabena ame ɖekae nye miaƒe kplɔla, eyae nye Kristo.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo, alakpatɔwo, elabena miemia ahosiwo ƒe aƒewo, eye miedaa alakpa nɔa gbe didiwo dom ɖa.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo, alakpatɔwo, elabena mietsana le ƒu kple anyigba dzi bena miawo trɔ̃subɔla ɖeka wòazu Yudatɔ, eye ne ezui la, ekema miewɔe dzomavɔʋe ƒe vi, si wu mia ŋutɔwo zi eve.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: Baba na mi mɔfiala ŋkuagbãtɔ, siwo gblɔna bena: Amesi ke ata mawuƒe la, eya menye naneke o; ke amesi ke ata mawuƒe me sika la, eyae nyi fe.

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Movitɔwo kple ŋkuagbãtɔwo, kae lolo wu, sika loo alo mawuƒe, si na sika la ŋuti kɔna, mahã?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke atà vɔsamlekpui la, eya menye naneke o, ke amesi ke atà nunana, si le edzi la, eyae nyi fe.

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Ŋkuagbãtɔwo, kae lolo wu, nunana loo alo vɔsamlekpui, si na nunana la ŋuti kɔna, mahã?

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke atà mawuƒe la, eya tà eya kple amesi nɔa eme.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke atà dziƒo la, eya tà Mawu ƒe zikpui kple amesi nɔa edzi.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo, alakpatɔwo, elabena miena ahame, sikɔni kple tsyo ƒe memamã ewolia, eye miegblẽ nusiwo le kpekpem wu le sedede la me: ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple xɔse la ɖi; ke esiawo le bena, miawɔ, eye miagagblẽ ekemeawo ɖi mawɔmawɔ o.

english_verse: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.
translation_verse: Mɔfiala ŋkuagbãtɔwo, miele tagbatsu tsyɔm, ke kposɔ miemina.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo, alakpatɔwo, elabena mieklɔa kplu kple agba ŋuti, ke wo me yɔ fũ kple adzodada kple aɖifuɖiɖuɖu.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: Wò farisitɔ, ŋkuagbãtɔ, klɔ kplu me gbãgbiagbã, bena eŋuti hã naɖi.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo, alakpatɔwo; elabena mieɖi yɔdo, siwo ŋuti wòsi akalo ɖo, eye wole dzedzem nyuie la, ke wo me yɔ fũ kple ame kukuwo ƒe ƒuwo kpakple ɖiƒoƒo katã.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Nenema ke miawo hã miedzena ame dzɔdzɔewo le gota le amewo ƒe ŋku me; ke mia me yɔ taŋ kple alakpadada kpakple madzɔmadzɔnyenye.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo, alakpatɔwo, elabena mieɖɔa nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe yɔdowo ɖo, eye miewɔa leke na ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe ɖiƒewo

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: hegblɔna bena: Ɖe mieli le mia fofowo ŋɔli la, ne miewɔ ɖeka kpli wo le nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nu la me o.

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Alea mieɖia ɖase le mia ɖokui ŋuti bena, míenye amesiwo wu nyagblɔɖilawo la ƒe viwo.

english_verse: So keep on doing everything they did.
translation_verse: Miawo hã miyɔ mia fofowo ƒe dzidzenu la nu!

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: Dawo, ƒliwo ƒe dzidzimewo! Aleke miawɔ asi atso dzomavɔʋe ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la nu mahã?

english_verse: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things! Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Luke
translation_verse: Vava mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nenem nusiawo katã ava dzidzime sia dzi.

english_verse: You won't see me again until you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Elabena mele egblɔm na mi bena: Tso esia dzi yina la miegale kpɔ ye ge o, vaseɖe esime miagblɔ bena: Woayra amesi gbɔna le Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkɔ la dzi.

english_verse: After Jesus left the temple, his disciples came over and said, “Look at all these buildings!”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu do go la, egblẽ mawuƒe la ɖi dzo yina, eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ, bena woafia mawuxɔ ƒe tutumewoe.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Ke eɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Ɖe miele nusiawo katã kpɔma? Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Womele kpe gblẽ ge ɖe kpea ɖeke dzi le abi, si womatu asii aƒu anyi o.

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
translation_verse: Elabena ame geɖewo ava le nye ŋkɔa dzi agblɔ bena: Nye enye Kristo; eye woaɖu ame geɖewo.

english_verse: You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Eye miasa aʋa kple aʋaŋutiɣliwo; kpɔ ɖa, migaɖi vo o, elabena esiawo ava me tsã; gake nuwuwu la meɖo haɖe o.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Amitoa dzi la, nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ wo tɔxe gblɔ bena: Gblɔe na mi, ɣekaɣie nusiawo ava? Eye ka enye wò vava la kple xexeame ƒe nuwuwu la ƒe dzesii?

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔ latsi tre ɖe dukɔ ŋuti, eye fiaɖuƒe ɖe fiaɖuƒe ŋuti, dɔwuame kple dɔléame kple anyigbaʋuʋu ava teƒeteƒewo.

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Ke baba na amesiwo fu le wo ƒo kple amesiwo le notsi nam le ŋkeke mawo me.

english_verse: But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Ke nenem nusiawo katã wonye fuɖuame ƒe gɔmedzedze.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke ma me woaɖe mi asi na fukpekpe, eye woawu mi, eye dukɔwo katã woalé fu mi le nye ŋkɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Many will give up and will betray and hate each other.
translation_verse: Ekema woaɖia ame geɖewo nu, eye woade wo nɔewo asi, eye wòalé fu wo nɔewo.

english_verse: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.
translation_verse: Eye aʋatsonyagblɔɖila geɖewo atsi tre ahaflu ame geɖewo.

english_verse: Someone may say, “Here is the Messiah!” or “There he is!” But don't believe it.
translation_verse: Ekema ne amea ɖe agblɔ na mi bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Kristo la le afii, alo ele afii la, migaxɔe se o.

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ke miɖo gbe ɖa bena, miaƒe sisigbe nagadze vuvɔŋɔli alo Sabat-ŋkeke dzi o.

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!
translation_verse: Azɔ ne míakpɔ aƒedo ƒe ŋunyɔnu, si wogblɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖila Daniel dzi la, anɔ tsitre le kɔkɔeƒea la ,

english_verse: If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: ekema amesiwo le Yudea la, nasi ayi towo dzi;

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: eye amesi le abɔ me la, megagbugbɔ va tsɔ eƒe avɔ yii o.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Eye ne womeɖe ŋkeke mawo dzi o la, ekema ŋutilãa ɖeke makpɔ ɖeɖe o; ke le ame tiatiawo ta woaɖe ŋkeke mawo dzi.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: nenema ke miawo hã, ne miekpɔ nusiawo katã la, midze sii bena, egogo agbo la nu.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Eye sigbe alesi Noa ƒe ŋkekewo no la, nenema ke lanye Amegbetɔvi la ƒe vava.

english_verse: No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: Ke le ŋkeke ma kple gaƒoƒo ma ŋuti la, amea ɖeke menyae o; mawudɔla, siwo le dziƒowo, kple Vi la hã menyae o, negbe Fofonye ɖeka ko.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi wowɔ le ŋkeke, si dze ŋgɔ na tɔɖɔɖɔ me, wole nu ɖum, eye wole nu nom, wole srɔ̃ ɖem, eye wole wo tsɔm na, bena woaɖe, vaseɖe ŋkeke, si dzi Noa yi ɖe aɖakaʋua me,

english_verse: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: eye womedze sii o, vaseɖe, esime tɔɖɔɖɔ va, eye wòkplɔ wo katã yii ta, nenema ke lanye Amegbetɔvi la ƒe vava.

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Ekema ame eve woano aba me; woaxɔ ɖeka, eye woagblẽ ɖeka ɖi;

english_verse: Two women will be together grinding grain, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: nyɔnu eve woanɔ teƒo; woaxɔ ɖeka, eye woagblẽ ɖeka ɖi.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti minɔ ŋudzɔ, elabena mienya ŋkeke ka dzi mia Aƒetɔ la ava o.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.
translation_verse: Ke minya esia bena, ɖe wònye aƒeatɔ anya zã ƒe ŋudzɔɣi, si me fiafitɔ ava la, anye ne anɔ ŋudzɔ, eye mana mɔe bena, wòadze kpɔ age ɖe eƒe aƒe me o.

english_verse: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come. Faithful and Unfaithful Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti miawo hã misu te; elabena Amegbetɔvi la ava le gaƒoƒo, si ŋuti miebu o la me.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.
translation_verse: Ke ne dɔla vɔ̃ɖi la agblɔ le eƒe dzi me bena: Nye aƒetɔ la tsi anyi,

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Azɔ amekae nye dɔla nuteƒewɔla kple aɖaŋudzela, si eƒe aƒetɔ la ɖo eƒe aƒemetɔwo nu, ne wòana nuɖuɖu wo le ɣeyiɣi nyui dzi mahã?

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Woayra dɔla ma, si, ne eƒe aƒetɔ ava la, akpɔe be, ewo nenema.

english_verse: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena, aɖoe eƒe nuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.
translation_verse: eye woade asi eƒe hadɔtsɔlawo ƒoƒo me, eye wòaɖu nu, ano nu kple ahamulawo,

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.
translation_verse: dɔla ma ƒe aƒetɔ ava te ŋkeke, si dzi mele mɔ kpɔm nɛ o kple gaƒoƒo, si menya o la dzi,

english_verse: This servant will then be punished and thrown out with the ones who only pretended to serve their master. There they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.
translation_verse: eye wòafe eyama ɖe eve, eye wòana eƒe gomee akpe ɖe alakpatɔwo ŋu: afima avifafa kple aɖukliɖuɖu lanɔ.

english_verse: The foolish ones took their lamps, but no extra oil.
translation_verse: Elabena abunetɔwo la wotsɔ woƒe akaɖiwo, ke wometsɔ ami kpe ɖe wo ŋuti o;

english_verse: The ones who were wise took along extra oil for their lamps.
translation_verse: ke aɖaŋudzelawo ya tsɔ ami de woƒe guiwo me kpe ɖe woƒe akaɖiawo ŋuti.

english_verse: Then in the middle of the night someone shouted, “Here's the groom! Come to meet him!”
translation_verse: Ke le zãtitina lã ɣli ɖi bena: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la gbɔna! Miɖo go yi ɖakpee!

english_verse: When the women got up and started getting their lamps ready,
translation_verse: Tete ɖetugbi kemawo katã fɔ, eye wodzra woƒe akaɖiwo ɖo.

english_verse: the foolish ones said to the others, “Let us have some of your oil! Our lamps are going out.”
translation_verse: Eye abunetɔwo gblɔ na aɖaŋudzelawo bena: Mina miaƒe ami la ɖe mí, elabena miaƒe akaɖiwo le tsitsim.

english_verse: Those who were wise answered, “There's not enough oil for all of us! Go and buy some for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Ke aɖaŋudzelawo xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: O, ɖewohĩ made mía kpli miawo nu o, miyi amesiwo le edzram la gbɔ boŋ, ne miadzee na mia ɖokui.

english_verse: But the groom replied, “I don't even know you!”
translation_verse: Ke exɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nyemenya mí o.

english_verse: So, my disciples, always be ready! You don't know the day or the time when all this will happen. A Story about Three Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti minɔ ŋudzɔ, elabena mienyã ŋkeke la alo gaƒoƒo la o. Amea ɖe ƒe talento mamã na eƒe dɔlawo.

english_verse: Some time later the master of those servants returned. He called them in and asked what they had done with his money.
translation_verse: Ke le ŋkeke geɖe megbe la dɔla mawo ƒe aƒetɔ la va, eye wobu akɔnta kple wo.

english_verse: You could have at least put my money in the bank, so I could have earned interest on it.”
translation_verse: Ekema ele na wò bena, natsɔ nye klosalo la ayi aɖana gasitsalawo, eye le nye vava me la maxɔ ye nu la kple deme.

english_verse: The kingdom is also like what happened when a man went away and put his three servants in charge of all he owned.
translation_verse: Elabena ele abe amea ɖe, si yi nugbe la ene, amesi yɔ eƒe dɔlawo, eye wotsɔ eƒe nuwo de asi na wo la.

english_verse: As soon as the man had gone, the servant with the
translation_verse: Enumake amesi xɔ talento atɔ̃ la, yi ɖatrɔ le wo dzi, eye wòɖe vi talento atɔ̃ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: “Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
translation_verse: Eƒe aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ bena: Ehe, dɔla nyui kple nuteƒewɔla! Ewɔ nuteƒe le nu ʋeewo me, matsɔ wò aɖo nu geɖewo nu: yi ɖe wò aƒetɔ ƒe dzidzɔ la me!

english_verse: “Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
translation_verse: Eƒe aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ bena: Ehẽ, dɔla nyui kple nuteƒewɔla! Ewɔ nuteƒe le nu ʋeewo me, matsɔ wò aɖo nu geɖewo nu; yi ɖe wò aƒetɔ ƒe dzidzɔ la me!

english_verse: I was frightened and went out and hid your money in the ground. Here is every single coin!”
translation_verse: eye esi mele vɔvɔ̃m la, medzo yi ɖaɖi wò talento la ɖe do me; kpɔ ɖa, xɔ wò nu.

english_verse: The master of the servant told him, “You are lazy and good-for-nothing! You know I harvest what I don't plant and gather crops where I haven't scattered seed.
translation_verse: Eƒe aƒetɔ la xɔ edzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Dɔla vɔ̃ɖi kple kuviatɔ! Ɖe nènyae bena, meŋea nu le afisi nyemeƒã nu ɖo o, eye meƒoa nu ƒu le afisi nyemewu nu ɖo o mahã?

english_verse: Then the master said, “Now your money will be taken away and given to the servant with
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mixɔ talento la le esi, eye mitsɔe na amesi si talento ewo le la.

english_verse: Everyone who has something will be given more, and they will have more than enough. But everything will be taken from those who don't have anything.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame, si nu le esi la, woana nui, woagbã go nɛ: ke amesi si nu mele o la, nusi le esi la, woaxɔ eya hã le esi.

english_verse: You are a worthless servant, and you will be thrown out into the dark where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.” The Final Judgment
translation_verse: Eye dɔla, si menyo na naneke o la, mitsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe viviti tsiɖitsiɖi la me, afima avifafa kple aɖukliɖuɖu lanɔ. Nuwuwu ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all his angels, he will sit on his royal throne.
translation_verse: Ke ne Amegbetɔvi la ava le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me, eye dɔlawo katã akpe ɖe eŋuti la, ekema abebe no eƒe ŋutikɔkɔezikpui la dzi;

english_verse: The people of all nations will be brought before him, and he will separate them, as shepherds separate their sheep from their goats.
translation_verse: eye woaƒo dukɔwo katã nu ƒu ɖe eƒe ŋku me, eye wòamã wo me atso wo nɔewo gbɔ, abe alesi alẽkplɔla mãa alẽwo kple gbɔ̃wo mee ene;

english_verse: He will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ alẽwo aɖo eƒe nuɖusi me, ke atsa gbɔ̃wo aɖo eƒe mia me.

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his right, “My father has blessed you! Come and receive the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Tete fia la agblɔ na amesiwo le eƒe nuɖusi me la bena: Miva, mi Fofonye ƒe ame yayrawo, minyi fiaɖuƒe, si wodzra ɖo ɖi na mi tso xexeme ƒe gɔmeɖoɖoanyi me la, ƒe dome!

english_verse: When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me,
translation_verse: Elabena dɔ wum, eye miena nuɖuɖum; tsikɔ wum, eye miena tsim; amedzro menye, eye miexɔm medze mia gbɔ.

english_verse: and when I was naked, you gave me clothes to wear. When I was sick, you took care of me, and when I was in jail, you visited me.”
translation_verse: Mele amama, eye miedo awu nam; nye lãme gblẽ, eye mieva kpam ɖa, mele gaxɔ me, eye mieva gbɔnye.

english_verse: Then the ones who pleased the Lord will ask, “When did we give you something to eat or drink?
translation_verse: Tete ame dzɔdzɔeawo axɔ edzi ne agblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, gbekagbee míekpɔ bena, da le wuwòm, eye míenyi wò, alo tsikɔ le wuwòm, eye miena tsi wò mahã?

english_verse: When did we welcome you as a stranger or give you clothes to wear
translation_verse: Gbekagbe míekpɔ wò nènye amedzro, eye míexɔ wò nèdze mía gbɔ, alo amama, eye míedo awu na wò mahã?

english_verse: or visit you while you were sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Alo gbekagbe míekpɔ bena, wò lãme gblẽ, alo nèle gaxɔ me, eye míeva kpɔ wò ɖa mahã?

english_verse: The king will answer, “Whenever you did it for any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you did it for me.”
translation_verse: Eye fia la aɖo eŋu agblɔ na wo bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nusianu, si miewɔ na nenem nɔvinye sue siawo dometɔ ɖeka la, nyee miewɔe na.

english_verse: Then the king will say to those on his left, “Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels!
translation_verse: Tete wòagblɔ na amesiwo le mia me la hã bena: Mite ɖa tso gbɔnye, mi amesiwo woƒo fi de; miyi ɖe dzo mavɔ, si wodzra ɖo ɖi na Abosam kple eƒe dɔlawo la me!

english_verse: I was hungry, but you did not give me anything to eat, and I was thirsty, but you did not give me anything to drink.
translation_verse: Elabena da wum, eye miena nuɖuɖum o; tsikɔ wum, eya miena tsim o;

english_verse: I was a stranger, but you did not welcome me, and I was naked, but you did not give me any clothes to wear. I was sick and in jail, but you did not take care of me.”
translation_verse: amedzro menye, eye miexɔm medze mia gbɔ o; menɔ amama, eye mieɖo awu nam o; nye lãme gblẽ, menɔ gaxɔ me, eye mieva kpɔm ɖa o.

english_verse: Then the people will ask, “Lord, when did we fail to help you when you were hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in jail?”
translation_verse: Tete woawo hã woaxɔ edzi nɛ agblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, gbekagbe míekpɔ wò bena, da le wuwòm, alo tsikɔ le wuwòm, alo nènye amedzro, alo nèle amama, alo wò lãme gblẽ, alo nèle gaxɔ me, eye míesubɔ wò o mahã?

english_verse: The king will say to them, “Whenever you failed to help any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you failed to do it for me.”
translation_verse: Tete wòaɖo ŋu na wo agblɔ bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mí bena: Nusianu, si miewɔ na nenem me sue siawo dometɔ ɖeka o la, miewɔe na nye hã o.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Eye woawo la wòayi ɖe fukpekpe mavɔ la me, ke ame dzɔdzɔewo la wòayi ɖe agbe mavɔ la me.

english_verse: “You know two days from now will be Passover. This is when the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies and nailed to a cross.”
translation_verse: Minyae bena, ŋkeke eve megbe la ŋutitoto la aɖo, eye woade Amegbetɔvi la asi, be woaklẽe ɖe ati ŋuti.

english_verse: Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.
translation_verse: Tete wòva nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miyi alɔ̃dɔdɔ dzi azɔ, eye migbɔ ɖe eme; mikpɔ ɖa, gaƒoƒo la ɖo vɔ, eye woade Amegbetɔvi la asi na nuvɔ̃wɔlawo.

english_verse: They planned how they could sneak around and have Jesus arrested and put to death.
translation_verse: eye wode adaŋu bena, yewoalé Yesu le adaŋu me, eye yewoawui.

english_verse: But they said, “We must not do it during Passover, because the people will riot.” At Bethany (Mark
translation_verse: Ke wogblɔ bena: Menye le ŋkekenyuie la dzi o, bena zi nagatɔ le dukɔ la dome o. Amisisi na Yesu le Betania.

english_verse: We could have sold this perfume for a lot of money and given it to the poor.”
translation_verse: Elabena woate ŋu adzra ami sia ho gãe, eye woatsɔe ana ame dahewo.

english_verse: But when his disciples saw this, they became angry and complained, “Why such a waste?
translation_verse: Ke esi nusrɔ̃lawo kpɔe la, eve dome na wo, eye wogblɔ bena: Nugbegblẽ sia gome ɖe?

english_verse: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives. Peter's Promise (Mark
translation_verse: Eye le akpedahadzidzi vɔ megbe la wodo go yi ɖe Amito la ŋu.

english_verse: and from then on he started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus. Jesus Eats the Passover Meal with His Disciples (Mark
translation_verse: Eye tso ekema dzi la ele asinu dim, bena yeadee asi. Nuɖuɖu kɔkɔe ɖoɖoanyi.

english_verse: When Jesus was eating with his twelve disciples that evening, he said, “One of you will surely hand me over to my enemies.”
translation_verse: eye esi wole nu ɖum la, egblɔ bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Mia dometɔ ɖeka adem asi.

english_verse: On the first day of the Festival of Thin Bread, Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, “Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal?”
translation_verse: Eye le abolo maʋamaʋã ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la nusrɔ̃lawo va Yesu gbɔ gblɔ bena: Afika dim nèle bena, míadzra ɖo na wò, ne naɖu ŋutitotolẽvi la le mahã?

english_verse: During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, “Take this and eat it. This is my body.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wole nua ɖum la, Yesu tsɔ abolo ɖe asi, eye esi wògblɔ akpedanya la, eŋe eme hetsɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ bena: Mixɔe ɖu! Esia nye nye ŋutilã!

english_verse: This is my blood, and with it God makes his agreement with you. It will be poured out, so that many people will have their sins forgiven.
translation_verse: elabena esiae nye nye ʋu, si nye nubabla yeye la ta, si wokɔ ɖe anyi le ame geɖewo ŋuti hena nuvɔ̃keke la.

english_verse: From now on I am not going to drink any wine, until I drink new wine with you in my Father's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mí bena: Tso esia dzi la nyemegale weinkutsetse sia me tsi no ge, vaseɖe ŋkeke ma dzi, esi mía kpli mi miano yeye le Fofonye ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me o.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “During this very night, all of you will reject me, as the Scriptures say, ‘I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Mi katã miele nuɖiaɖia kpɔ ge le ŋutinye le zã sia me; elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Mele alẽkplɔla ƒo ge, eye alẽha blibo la katã laka ahlẽ.“

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise you before a rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu to ne bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na wò bena: Zã sia me ke, hafi koklo naku atɔ la, agbe nu le gbɔnye zi etɔ̃.

english_verse: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. When they got there, he told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
translation_verse: Tete woa kple Yesu wova teƒea ɖe, si woyɔna be Getsemane, eye wògblɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Mibɔbɔ nɔ afisia, vaseɖe esime mayi aɖado gbe ɖa le afime.

english_verse: and he said to them, “I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na wo bena: Nye luʋɔ le nu xam kakaka vaseɖe ku me; minɔ afisia, eye minɔ ŋudzɔ kpakplim.

english_verse: Peter spoke up, “Even if all the others reject you, I never will!”
translation_verse: Ke Petro xɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Ne wo katã woakpɔ nuɖiaɖia le ŋutiwò la, nye la nyemele ekpɔ ge gbeɖe o.

english_verse: But Peter said, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you.” All the others said the same thing. Jesus Prays (Mark
translation_verse: Petro gblɔ nɛ bena: Ne anɔ nam bena, maku kpli wò hã la, nyemele nu gbe ge le gbɔwò akpɔ o. Nenema ke nusiawo katã wogblɔ. Ʋiʋli le Getsemane.

english_verse: Again Jesus went to pray and said, “My Father, if there is no other way, and I must suffer, I will still do what you want.”
translation_verse: Egayi zi evelia, eye wòdo gbe ɖa gblɔ bena: Fofonye, ne esia nu mate ŋu ayi o, wònye ɖeko manoe la, woawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu.

english_verse: Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wote yi ŋgɔ ʋee la, edze klo tsyɔ mo anyi hedo gbe ɖa gblɔ bena: Fofonye, ne ate ŋui la, na be, kplu sia nato ŋutinye ayi; gake la menye alesi nye ŋutɔ medi o, negbe alesi wòa nèdi ko.

english_verse: Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.” Jesus Is Arrested (Mark
translation_verse: Mitsi tre, mina midze! Kpɔ ɖa, amesi le yonyeme mɔ fiãm la gogo. Yuda fia Yesu yome mɔ.

english_verse: Jesus took along Peter and the two brothers, James and John. He was very sad and troubled,
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ Petro kple Zebedeo ƒe ŋutsuvi eveawo kpe ɖe eɖokui ŋuti, eye wòde asi nuxaxa me kple dzodzo me nyanyanya.

english_verse: He came back and found his disciples sleeping. So he said to Peter, “Can't any of you stay awake with me for just one hour?
translation_verse: Eye wova nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ, eye wòkpɔ wo le alɔ me, eye wògblɔ na Petro bena: Ɖe miate ŋu anɔ ŋudzɔ kplim gaƒoƒo ɖeka oa?

english_verse: Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.”
translation_verse: Minɔ ŋudzɔ, eye mido gbe ɖa, ne miagadze telekpɔ me o; gbɔgbɔ la le lɔlɔ̃m, gake ŋutilã la gbɔdzɔ.

english_verse: He left them and prayed the same prayer once more.
translation_verse: Eye wògagblẽ wo ɖi hedzo yi be, yeado gbe ɖa zi etɔ̃lia, eye wògagblɔ nenem nya mawo ke.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “My friend, do what you came for.” The men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Xɔ̃, nukaŋuti neva ɖo? Tete wote ɖe: eŋuti, eye wotsɔ woƒe asiwo do Yesu dzi, eye wòlée kpli.

english_verse: Jesus was still speaking, when Judas the betrayer came up. He was one of the twelve disciples, and a large mob armed with swords and clubs was with him. They had been sent by the chief priests and the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòbe, yeaɖe nu le eme kasia la, kpɔ ɖa, Yuda, ame wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka la, va; do, eye ameha gãa ɖe le eyome kple yiwo kple kpowo tso nunɔlagã kple ɖumegãwo gbɔ.

english_verse: Judas had told them ahead of time, “Arrest the man I greet with a kiss.”
translation_verse: Eye yomemɔfiala la ɖo dzesi ɖi na wo gblɔ bena: Amesi ƒe nu gbugbɔ ge mala la, eyae, ne mialée kpli.

english_verse: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Hello, teacher.” Then Judas kissed him.
translation_verse: Eye enumake wote ɖe Yesu, ŋu, eye wògblɔ bena. Rabi, fiẽ na wò loo! Eye wògbugbɔ nu nɛ.

english_verse: One of Jesus' followers pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, amesiwo li kple Yesu la, wo dometɔ ɖeka do eƒe asi ɖa, ɖi yi heda nunɔlagã ƒe dɔla, eye wòkpa to nɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus told him, “Put your sword away. Anyone who lives by fighting will die by fighting.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Gbugbɔ wò yi la ɖo eteƒe; elabena amesiwo katã dia yi la, yi kee woatsɔ awu wòe.

english_verse: The high priest then tore his robe and said, “This man claims to be God! We don't need any more witnesses! You have heard what he said.
translation_verse: Tete nunɔlagã la dze eƒe awuwo gblɔ bena: Egblɔ busunya! Ɖaseɖila kawo gahiã mí? Kpɔ ɖa, azɔ miese busunya la;

english_verse: But Jesus did not answer. So the high priest said, “With the living God looking on, you must tell the truth. Are you the Messiah, the Son of God?”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu zi kpi. Eye nunɔlagã la xɔ edzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Meta Mawu gbagbe la na wò, be nagblɔe na mí nenye wòe nye Kristo, Mawuvi la!

english_verse: When Peter had gone out to the gate, another servant girl saw him and said to some people there, “This man was with Jesus from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòto agboa nu do go la, nyɔnudɔla bubu hã kpɔe, eye wògblɔ na amesiwo le afima bena: Amesia nɔ anyi kple Yesu, Nazaretetɔ la kpɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus had been arrested, he was led off to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The nation's leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses were meeting there.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo lé Yesu la, kplɔe yi ɖe nunɔlagã Kayafa gbɔ, afisi agbalẽfialawo kple amegãwo kpe ta ɖo.

english_verse: But Peter followed along at a distance and came to the courtyard of the high priest's palace. He went in and sat down with the guards to see what was going to happen.
translation_verse: Ke Petro le eyome ʋĩ gbɔna vaseɖe nunɔlagã ƒe mɔ̃ la gbɔ, eye wòyi ɖe eme, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe dɔlawo gbɔ, bena yeakpɔ alesi woawu nui.

english_verse: But they could not find any, even though many did come and tell lies. At last, two men came forward
translation_verse: ke womekpɔ ɖeke o, eva wònye aʋatsoɖaseɖila geɖewo va hafi. Ke emegbe la aʋatsoɖaseɖila eve va gblɔ bena:

english_verse: and said, “This man claimed he could tear down God's temple and build it again in three days.”
translation_verse: Amesia gblɔ bena: Mate ŋu agba mawuxɔ la, eye magatui le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe.
