english_verse: “That is what you say!” Jesus answered. “But I tell all of you, ‘Soon you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful and coming on the clouds of heaven.’ ”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Wòe gblɔe; gake la mele egblɔm na mi bena: Tso esia dzi miele Amegbetɔvi la kpo ge, wòabɔbɔ nɔ anyi de ŋusẽ ƒe nuɖusi me, ana dziƒo ƒe alilikpowo dzi gbɔna.

english_verse: Then they spit in his face and hit him with their fists. Others slapped him
translation_verse: Tete woɖe ta ɖe mo nɛ, wotu koe, eye amea ɖewo hã ƒo tome nɛ

english_verse: and said, “You think you are the Messiah! So tell us who hit you!” Peter Says He Doesn't Know Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm bena: Kristo, amekae ƒo wò, gblɔe fia mi. Petro ƒe nugbegbe le Yesu gbɔ.

english_verse: Again Peter denied it, and this time he swore, “I don't even know that man!”
translation_verse: Eye wògasẽ nu kple atamkaka gblɔ bena: Nyemenya ame la o.

english_verse: While Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, a servant girl came up to him and said, “You were with Jesus from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Ke Petro bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe gota le akpata me, eye nyɔnudɔlaa ɖe va egbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: Wò hã ènɔ Yesu, Galileatɔ la gbɔ kpɔ.

english_verse: But in front of everyone Peter said, “That isn't so! I don't know what you are talking about!”
translation_verse: Gake esẽ nu le wo katã ƒe ŋku me gblɔ bena: Nyemenya nusi gblɔm nèle o.

english_verse: A little while later some people standing there walked over to Peter and said, “We know you are one of them. We can tell it because you talk like someone from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Eye esia megbe ʋee la amesiwo le tsitre ɖe afima la, va gblɔ na Petro bena: Nyateƒee, wò hã wo dometɔ ɖeka nènye; elabena wò nuƒoƒo le ha ɖem wò.

english_verse: Peter began to curse and swear, “I don't know that man!” Right then a rooster crowed,
translation_verse: Tete la wòde asi fiƒoƒode kple atamkaka me bena: Nyemenya ame la o. Eye kasia koklo ku atɔ.

english_verse: and Peter remembered that Jesus had said, “Before a rooster crows, you will say three times you don't know me.” Then Peter went out and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Eye Petro ɖo ŋku Yesu ƒe nya, si wògblɔ nɛ la dzi bena: Hafi koklo naku atɔ la, àgbe nu le gbɔnye zi etɔ̃. Eye wòdo go, eye wòfa avi vevie.

english_verse: Pilate knew the leaders had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
translation_verse: Elabena ènyae bena, ŋuʋaʋã ŋutie wotsɔe de asi ɖo.

english_verse: On the way they met a man named Simon who was from Cyrene, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross.
translation_verse: Ke esi wodo go yina la, wokpɔ ŋutsua ɖe, si tso Kirene, amesi ƒe ŋkɔ enye Simon, eye wozi eyama dzi bena, wòatsɔ atitsoga la nɛ.

english_verse: and said, “I have sinned by betraying a man who has never done anything wrong.” “So what? That's your problem,” they replied.
translation_verse: Mewo nuvɔ̃ be, mede ʋu maɖifɔ asi. Ke woawo gblɔ bena: Mía gbɔ nya kae wotsoa? Wò ŋutɔ kpɔ edzi!

english_verse: This is why people still call that place “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti woyɔ abɔ ma be ʋubɔ vaseɖe egbegbe.

english_verse: So the words of the prophet Jeremiah came true, “They took the thirty silver coins, the price of a person among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ale wowu nya, si nyagblɔɖila Yeremya gblɔ ɖi la nu bena: „Eye wotsɔ klosalo blaetɔ̃, si enye amesi ŋu Israel-via ɖewo do asi ɖo la, ƒe tanu,

english_verse: They paid it for a potter's field, as the Lord had commanded me.” Pilate Questions Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: eye wotsɔ wo na ɖe zemela ƒe abɔ ta, abe alesi Aƒetɔ la ɖo nam ene.“

english_verse: Jesus was brought before Pilate the governor, who asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “Those are your words!” Jesus answered.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu le tsitre ɖe mɔ̃mefia la ƒe ŋku me, eye mɔ̃mefia la biae bena: Wòe nye Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la mahã? Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Wòe gblɔe.

english_verse: And when the chief priests and leaders brought their charges against him, he did not say a thing.
translation_verse: Eye esi nunɔlagãwo kple dumegãwo tso enu la, meɖo nyaa ɖeke ŋu o.

english_verse: But Jesus did not say anything, and the governor was greatly amazed. The Death Sentence (Mark
translation_verse: Eye meɖo nyaku ɖeka hɔ̃ hã ŋu nɛ o, ale bena mɔ̃mefia la ƒe mowɔ yaa ŋutɔ. Yesu kple Baraba.

english_verse: Pilate set Barabbas free. Then he ordered his soldiers to beat Jesus with a whip and nail him to a cross. Soldiers Make Fun of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Tete wòɖe asi le Baraba ŋu na wo; ke Yesu la, eƒoe kple atam, eye woɖee asi, bena woakpe de ati ŋuti. Woƒo Yesu kple atam, ɖu fewu le eŋu, klãe ɖe ati ŋu, eye wòku.

english_verse: People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo le eŋuti tom le yiyim la, do ɖiŋu nɛ de ta ʋuʋum,

english_verse: But the chief priests and the leaders convinced the crowds to ask for Barabbas to be set free and for Jesus to be killed.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlagãwo kple amegãwo ƒoe ɖe amehawo nu bena, woabia Baraba, eye woawu Yesu.

english_verse: Pilate saw that there was nothing he could do and that the people were starting to riot. So he took some water and washed his hands in front of them and said, “I won't have anything to do with killing this man. You are the ones doing it!”
translation_verse: Eye esi Pilato kpo bena, wɔwɔa ɖeke megali o, ke zi tɔ hoo boŋ la, etsɔ tsi klɔ asi le ameha la ƒe ŋku me gblɔ bena: Nye la, ʋu sia mele asinye me o; mia ŋutɔwo mikpɔ edzi!

english_verse: Everyone answered, “We and our own families will take the blame for his death!”
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ blibo la katã xɔ dzi bena: Eƒe ʋu neva mía kple mía viwo dzi!

english_verse: They made a crown out of thorn branches and placed it on his head, and they put a stick in his right hand. The soldiers knelt down and pretended to worship him. They made fun of him and shouted, “Hey, you king of the Jews!”
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ ŋu he tsihe ɖɔ nɛ, eye wotsɔ ayeti de nuɖusi me nɛ, eye wodze klo ɖe eƒe ŋku me, ɖu fewu le eŋuti gblɔ bena: Mieɖo gbe na wò, Yudatɔwo ƒe fia!

english_verse: He trusted God, so let God save him, if he wants to. He even said he was God's Son.”
translation_verse: Eɖo dzi ɖe Mawu ŋuti; eya naɖee azɔ, ne elɔ̃nɛ, elabena egblɔ be, Mawuvi yenye.

english_verse: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Eye esi woɖu fewu le eŋuti vo la, woɖe awu ʋlaya la le eŋu, eye wogatsɔ ye ŋuta ƒe awuwo do nɛ, eye wokplɔe yina kaklã ge ɖe ati ŋuti.

english_verse: There they gave Jesus some wine mixed with a drug to ease the pain. But when Jesus tasted what it was, he refused to drink it.
translation_verse: wotsɔ aha tsitsi kple veve tɔtɔ ɖo nu nɛ; eye esi wòɖoe kpɔ la, egbe be, yemele eno ge o.

english_verse: Then they sat down to guard him.
translation_verse: Eye wobɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe afima le eŋu dzɔm.

english_verse: Above his head they put a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, “This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ eƒe nutsonya ɖo tagbɔ nɛ bena; Yesu, Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la, enye esi!

english_verse: shouted, “So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days! If you are God's Son, save yourself and come down from the cross!”
translation_verse: eye wole gbɔgblɔm bena: Wò, amesi le mawuxɔ la gbãm gale etum le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la, ɖe ɖokuiwò; nenye Mawuvi nènye la, ekema ɖi le atitsoga la ŋuti!

english_verse: Others said, “Wait! Let's see if Elijah will come and save him.”
translation_verse: Ke ame mamleawo gblɔ bena: Ɖe asi le eŋu! Na ne míakpɔe, abe Eliya ava ɖee ene.

english_verse: At noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until three o'clock.
translation_verse: Ke tso gaƒoƒo adelia dzi la zãdokeli do de anyigba la katã dzi vaseɖe gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi.

english_verse: Then about that time Jesus shouted, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you deserted me?”
translation_verse: Eye le gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi Yesu do ɣli kple gbe sesĩe bena: Eli, eli, lama sabaxtani! si gome enye: Nye Mawu, nye Mawu, nukaŋuti nègblẽm ɖi mahã?

english_verse: One of them at once ran and grabbed a sponge. He soaked it in wine, then put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye enumake wo dometɔ ɖeka ƒu du yi ɖatsɔ ƒumekutsa, eye wòkɔ aha tsitsi ɖe eme fũ, eye wòtsɔe ɖo ayeti nu hekpe ne.

english_verse: At once the curtain in the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, and rocks split apart.
translation_verse: Eye kpo ɖa, mawuxɔmetsovɔ la dze ɖe eve tso tagba vaseɖe egɔme, eye anyigba ʋuʋu, eye kpe gbadzawo wo,

english_verse: Graves opened, and many of God's people were raised to life.
translation_verse: eye yɔdowo nu ʋu, eye ame kɔkɔe geɖe, siwo ɖo alɔ̃ la, ƒe ŋutilãwo tsi tre,

english_verse: They left their graves, and after Jesus had risen to life, they went into the holy city, where they were seen by many people.
translation_verse: eye esi wodo go tso yɔdowo me le eƒe fɔfɔ megbe la, woyi ɖe du kɔkɔe la me, eye woɖe wo ɖokui fia ame geɖewo.

english_verse: The officer and the soldiers guarding Jesus felt the earthquake and saw everything else that happened. They were frightened and said, “This man really was God's Son!”
translation_verse: Ke esi aʋafia la kple amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋuti hele Yesu dzɔm la, kpɔ anyigbaʋuʋu kple nusiwo va dzo la, wovɔ̃ ŋuta hegblɔ bena: Nyateƒe, Mawuvie nye esia!

english_verse: Many women had come with Jesus from Galilee to be of help to him, and they were there, looking on at a distance.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu geɖewo le afima le nu kpɔm le adzɔge, amesiwo dze Yesu yome tso Galilea le esubɔm;

english_verse: That evening a rich disciple named Joseph from the town of Arimathea
translation_verse: Eye esi fiẽsi ɖo la, ŋutsu kesinɔtɔa ɖe tso Arimatia, si ŋkɔ nye Yosef, amesi ŋutɔ hã nye Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃la,

english_verse: went and asked for Jesus' body. Pilate gave orders for it to be given to Joseph,
translation_verse: amesia yi Pilato gbɔ ɖabia Yesu ƒe kukua. Tete Pilato ɖo bena, woatsɔe nɛ.

english_verse: who took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.
translation_verse: Eye Yosef tso ame kuku la, eye wòtso aklala, si fu tititi la xatsa ɖe eŋuti:

english_verse: Then Joseph put the body in his own tomb that had been cut into solid rock and had never been used. He rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb and went away.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔe mlɔ ye ŋuta ƒe yɔdo yeye, si wòna woɖe ɖe kpe gbadza me la me; eye esi wòmũ kpe gãa ɖe ɖo yɔdo la nu la, edzo.

english_verse: All this time Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting across from the tomb.
translation_verse: Eye Maria, Magdalatɔ la, kple Maria keme la wole afima, eye wobɔbɔ nɔ anyi hedze ŋgɔ yɔdo la.

english_verse: On the next day, which was a Sabbath, the chief priests and the Pharisees went together to Pilate.
translation_verse: Eye le dzadzraɖoŋkeke ƒe ŋufɔke dzi la nunɔlagãwo kple farisitɔwo va kpe ta ɖe Pilato gbɔ gblɔ bena:

english_verse: They said, “Sir, we remember what this liar said while he was still alive. He claimed in three days he would come back from death.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mieɖo ŋui bena, esi ameblela ma le agbe la, egblɔ bena: Le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la magatsi tre.

english_verse: So please order the tomb to be carefully guarded for three days. If you don't, his disciples may come and steal his body. They will tell the people he has been raised to life, and this last lie will be worse than the first one.”
translation_verse: Eyata de se bena, woadzo yɔdo la ŋu vaseɖe ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe, bene eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo magava afii ayii, eye woagblɔ na amewo bena: Etsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye beble megbetɔ la nagavɔ̃ɖi wu ŋgɔgbetɔ la o.

english_verse: Pilate said to them, “All right, take some of your soldiers and guard the tomb as well as you know how.”
translation_verse: Pilato gblɔ na wo bena: Dzɔlawo nye ekem, miheyi ne miadzɔe, abe alesi mienya ene.

english_verse: So they sealed it tight and placed soldiers there to guard it.
translation_verse: Eye wodzo heyi ɖatre kpe la ɖe enu, eye woɖo dzɔlawo afima.

english_verse: Jesus' eleven disciples went to a mountain in Galilee, where Jesus had told them to meet him.
translation_verse: Ke nusrɔ̃la wuiɖekɛawo yi Galilea ɖe to, si Yesu fia wo ɖi la dzi.

english_verse: So the chief priests met with the leaders and decided to bribe the soldiers with a lot of money.
translation_verse: Eye esi woa kple amegãwo ƒo ƒu la, wode adaŋu, eye wotso klosalo geɖe na asrafoawo bena:

english_verse: and teach them to do everything I have told you. I will be with you always, even until the end of the world.
translation_verse: miaha wo bena, woawɔ nusiwo katã meɖo na mi la; eye kpɔ ɖa, nye la meli kpli mi ŋkekeawo katã vaseɖe xexeame ƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “Don't be afraid! Tell my followers to go to Galilee. They will see me there.” Report of the Guard
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Migavɔ̃ o! Miyi ɖaka eta na nɔvinyewo bena, wòayi Galilea, eye afima woakpɔm le.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake struck, and the Lord's angel came down from heaven. He rolled away the stone and sat on it.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, anyigba ʋuʋu ŋutɔ, elabena Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔla ɖi tso dziƒo va mli kpe la ɖa le yɔdo la nu, eye wòbɔbɔ no edzi.

english_verse: The angel looked as bright as lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe kpɔkpɔme le abe dzikedzo ene, eye eƒe awu fu tititi abe sno ene;

english_verse: The guards shook from fear and fell down, as though they were dead.
translation_verse: ke dzɔlawo dzo nyanyanya, eye wozu abe ame kukuwo ene le ŋɔ, si wòdzi na wo la ŋuti.

english_verse: The angel said to the women, “Don't be afraid! I know you are looking for Jesus, who was nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla la gblɔ na nyɔnuawo bena: Miawo la migavɔ̃ o; elabena menyae bena, Yesu, amesi woklã ɖe ati ŋu la, dim miele.

english_verse: Now hurry! Tell his disciples he has been raised to life and is on his way to Galilee. Go there, and you will see him. This is what I came to tell you.”
translation_verse: Eye miyi kaba ɖagblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Etsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome; eye kpɔ ɖa, edze mia ŋgɔ yi Galilea, afima míakpɔe le; kpɔ ɖa, metoe na mi.

english_verse: Suddenly Jesus met them and greeted them. They went near him, held on to his feet, and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, Yesu va kpe wo gblɔ bena: Miɖo aƒe! Eye wote ɖe eŋu lé eƒe afɔwo hedze klo nɛ.

english_verse: While the women were on their way, some soldiers who had been guarding the tomb went into the city. They told the chief priests everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Ke esi wole yiyim la, kpo ɖa, dzɔlawo dometɔa ɖewo yi dua me ɖaka nusiwo katã va dzo la ta na nunɔlagãwo.

english_verse: They said to the soldiers, “Tell everyone that Jesus' disciples came during the night and stole his body while you were asleep.
translation_verse: Migblɔ bena: Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va le zã me, eye wofii yii, esime mieɖo alɔ̃.

english_verse: The soldiers took the money and did what they were told. The people of Judea still tell each other this story. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Mark
translation_verse: Eye woxɔ klosalo la, eye wowɔ, abe alesi wòfiã mɔnu wo ene; eye nenem nya sia kaka ɖe Yudatɔwo dome vaseɖe egbegbe.

english_verse: Jesus came to them and said: I have been given all authority in heaven and on earth!
translation_verse: Eye Yesu te va wo gbã, ƒo nu na wo gblɔ bena: Wotsɔ ŋusẽ katã, si le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi la, de asi nam.

english_verse: Go to the people of all nations and make them my disciples. Baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit,
translation_verse: Miheyi ɖawɔ dukɔwo katã ne woanye nusrɔ̃lawo, miade mawutsi ta na wo ɖe Fofo la kple Vi la kpakple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la ƒe ŋkɔa me,

english_verse: They saw him and worshiped him, but some of them doubted.
translation_verse: Eye esi wokpɔe la, wodze klo nɛ, ke amea ɖewo ke ɖi.

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: Eye enumake la wogblẽ asabuawo ɖi, eye wodze eyome.

english_verse: Jesus walked on and soon saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
translation_verse: Eye esi wote yi ŋgɔ ʋee la, ekpɔ Yakobo, si nye Zebedeo vi kple nɔvia Yohanes, woawo hã le ʋu me le asabuwo sam.

english_verse: News about Jesus quickly spread all over Galilee. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye enumake lã eƒe ŋkɔ ɖi hoo le Galilea-nutowo katã me godoo.

english_verse: It began just as God had said in the book written by Isaiah the prophet, “I am sending my messenger to get the way ready for you.
translation_verse: Abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi le nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ƒe agbalẽ la me ene bena: „Kpo ɖa, mele ye dɔla dɔm ɖo ɖe ŋgɔwò, amesi adzra wò mɔ la ɖo;

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Eye kposɔfuwu le Yohanes ŋu, eye lãgbalẽlidziblanu le eƒe ali dzi, eye woɖua ʋetsuviwo henoa gbemenyitsi.

english_verse: John also told the people, “Someone more powerful is going to come. And I am not good enough even to stoop down and untie his sandals.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖe gbe ƒã gblɔ bena: Amesi tri akɔ wum la, le megbenye gbɔna, amesi ƒe atokota ŋu ka medzem be, mabɔbɔ atu o.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to the town of Capernaum. Then on the next Sabbath he went into the synagogue and started teaching.
translation_verse: Eye wodzo yi ɖe Kapernaum; eye enumake le Sabat-ŋkekea dzi la efia nu le ƒuƒoƒe la.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at his teaching. He taught with authority, and not like the teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo wo le eƒe nufiafia la ŋuti; elabena efia nu wo abe amesi si ŋusẽ le la ene, eye menye abe agbalẽfialawo ene o.

english_verse: About that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me le ŋkeke mawo me bena, Yesu tso Nazaret le Galilea va, eye Yohanes de mawutsi ta ne ɖe Yordan-tɔsisi la me.

english_verse: As soon as Jesus came out of the water, he saw the sky open and the Holy Spirit coming down to him like a dove.
translation_verse: Eye enumake esime wòle go dom tso tsia me la, ekpa dziƒowo nu ʋu, eye Gbɔgbɔ la le abe akpakpa ene hele ɖiɖim ɖe edzi;

english_verse: A man with leprosy came to Jesus and knelt down. He begged, “You have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Eye anyidzela ɖe va egbe le kuku ɖem nɛ, eye wòdze klo nɛ gblɔ bena: Ne èlɔ̃ ko, ate ŋu aklɔ ŋutinye.

english_verse: He said, “The time has come! God's kingdom will soon be here. Turn back to God and believe the good news!” Jesus Chooses Four Fishermen (Matthew
translation_verse: Azãgbe la ɖo dzi, eye mawufiaɖuƒe la ɖo vo. Mitrɔ le miaƒe dzi me, eye mixa nyanyuie la dzi se!

english_verse: At once Jesus asked them to come with him. They left their father in the boat with the hired workers and went with him. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Luke
translation_verse: Eye enumake la wòyɔ wo, eye wogblẽ wo fofo Zebedeo kple ʋuléviawo ɖi ɖe ʋua me, eye woyi ɖadze eyome.

english_verse: Jesus went to her. He took hold of her hand and helped her up. The fever left her, and she served them a meal.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòte va la, elé eƒe alɔnu hekɔe ɖe dzi, eye ŋudza la dzo le edzi, eye wòsubɔ wo.

english_verse: And when they found him, they said, “Everyone is looking for you!”
translation_verse: eye wokpɔe, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena; Amewo katã le diwòm.

english_verse: Suddenly a man with an evil spirit in him entered the synagogue and yelled,
translation_verse: Eye enumake amea ɖe, si me gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ le la, le woƒe ƒuƒoƒe, eye wòdo ɣli gblɔ bena:

english_verse: “Jesus from Nazareth, what do you want with us? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are! You are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Nya ka le mía kple wò dome, wò Yesu Nazaretetɔ? Ɖe nèva mía tsrɔ̃ ge mahã? Menya amesi nènye, Mawu ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la nènye.

english_verse: Jesus told the evil spirit, “Be quiet and come out of the man!”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu blu ɖe eta bena: Mia wò nu, eye nado go le eme!

english_verse: The spirit shook him. Then it gave a loud shout and left.
translation_verse: Eye gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ la nyamae, eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesĩe, eye wòdo go le eme.

english_verse: Everyone was completely surprised and kept saying to each other, “What is this? It must be some new kind of powerful teaching! Even the evil spirits obey him.”
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ nuku na wo katã, nenem bena, wobia wo nɔewo bena: Nuka enye esia? Nufiafia yeye! Etsɔ ŋusẽ dea se na gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo, eye woɖoa toe.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “We must go to the nearby towns, so that I can tell the good news to those people. This is why I have come.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mina ne miayi du bubuwo me, bena magblɔ nya le afima hã; elabena esia ta medo go do.

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for the man. So he put his hand on him and said, “I want to! Now you are well.”
translation_verse: Eye esi eƒe dɔme trɔ ɖe eŋuti la edo eƒe abɔ ɖa, eye wòde asi eŋu hegblɔ nɛ bena: Melɔ̃, ŋutiwò nakɔ!

english_verse: As soon as Jesus left the synagogue with James and John, they went home with Simon and Andrew.
translation_verse: Eye enumake esi wodo go tso ƒuƒoƒea la, Yakobo kple Yohanes kpe ɖe wo ŋu yi ɖe Simon kple Andrea ƒe me.

english_verse: When they got there, Jesus was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Ke Simon lɔ̃xo le anyimlɔƒe le ŋudza lém, eye enumake la wogblɔ eŋutinya nɛ.

english_verse: That evening after sunset, all who were sick or had demons in them were brought to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke le fiẽ me, esime ɣe ɖo to la, wotso amesiwo katã ƒe lãme gblẽ, kple esiwo me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo le la, va egbɔe.

english_verse: In fact, the whole town gathered around the door of the house.
translation_verse: Eye du blibo la katã ƒo ƒu de ʋɔtrua nu.

english_verse: Jesus healed all kinds of terrible diseases and forced out a lot of demons. But the demons knew who he was, and he did not let them speak.
translation_verse: Eye wòda gbe le amesiwo katã le da bubu ƒomeviwo katã lém la ŋu, eye wònyã gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ gedewo do goe, eye mede mo na gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo be, woaƒo nu o, elabena wonyae.

english_verse: Very early the next morning before daylight, Jesus got up and went to a place where he could be alone and pray.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòfɔ fɔŋli la, edo go heyi de gbedzi, eye wòdo gbe da le afima.

english_verse: Simon and the others started looking for him.
translation_verse: Eye Simon kple amesiwo kpe de eŋuti la, di eyome mɔ;

english_verse: Then Jesus went to their synagogues everywhere in Galilee, where he preached and forced out demons. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wòyi ɖe woƒe ƒuƒoƒeawo me le Galilea katã hele gbe ƒã ɖem, eye wòle gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo nyãm le go domii.

english_verse: At once the man's leprosy disappeared, and he was well.
translation_verse: Eye enumake la anyi la vo le eŋuti, eye eŋuti ko.

english_verse: After Jesus strictly warned the man, he sent him on his way.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòblu ɖe eta la, ènyae do go enumake,

english_verse: He said, “Don't tell anyone about this. Just go and show the priest that you are well. Then take a gift to the temple as Moses commanded, and everyone will know that you have been healed.”
translation_verse: eye wògblẽ nɛ bena: Kpɔ nyuie! Megagblɔ naneke na amea ɖeke o; ke heyi natsɔ ɖokuiwò afia mawununɔla boŋ, eye na nusiwo ŋuti Mose de se ɖo la, le wò ŋutikɔklɔ la ŋuti, ne wòanye ɖaseɖiɖi na wo.

english_verse: The man talked about it so much and told so many people, that Jesus could no longer go openly into a town. He had to stay away from the towns, but people still came to him from everywhere.
translation_verse: Ke eya do go de asi gbeƒãɖeɖe me lelele kple nya la kaka me ale gbegbe bena, Yesu magate ŋu adze gaglã ayi du me o, ke gbedzi ko wònɔna, eye wotso afisiafi va egbɔ.

english_verse: It was during the time of Abiathar the high priest. David went into the house of God and ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are allowed to eat. He also gave some to his followers.”
translation_verse: Alesi wòyi ɖe mawuxɔ la me, le esime Abyatar enye nunɔlagã, eye woɖu ŋkumeɖobolo, si womeɖe mo le ŋuti nɛ be, woaɖu o, negbe nunɔlawo ko, eye wòna amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋuti la o mahã?

english_verse: Then so many of them came to the house that there wasn't even standing room left in front of the door. Jesus was still teaching
translation_verse: Eye ame geɖewo ƒo ƒu ale bena, womegakpɔ nɔƒea ɖeke le ʋɔtrua nu hã o, eye wògblɔ nya na wo.

english_verse: when four people came up, carrying a man on a mat because he could not walk.
translation_verse: Eye ame ene tso lãmetututɔa ɖe gbɔna va egbɔ.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they made a hole in the roof above him and let the man down in front of everyone.
translation_verse: Eye esi womete ŋu te va egbɔ le ameha la ŋuti o la, woyi ɖaɖe mɔ ɖe xɔ, si me wòle la tame, eye esime woŋɔe vɔ la, woɖiɖi aba, si dzi lãmetututɔ la mlɔ la, ɖe anyi.

english_verse: “Why would he say such a thing? He must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: Aleke wo amesia ƒo nu alea? Egblɔ busunya, ameka ate ŋu atso nuvɔ̃wo ake, ne menye Mawu ɖeka ko o mahã?

english_verse: I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man,
translation_verse: Ke ne mianyae bena, ŋusẽ le Amegbetɔvi la si be, wòatsɔ nuvɔ̃wo ake le anyigba dzi, — egblɔ na lãmetututɔ la bena:

english_verse: “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na wò bena: Tsi tre, tso wò aba, ne nayi aƒewò me.

english_verse: Once again, Jesus went to the shore of Lake Galilee. A large crowd gathered around him, and he taught them.
translation_verse: Eve wògayi ɖe ƒu la nu, eye ameha la katã va egbɔ, eye wòfiã nu wo.

english_verse: Jesus finished by saying, “People were not made for the good of the Sabbath. The Sabbath was made for the good of people.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Wowɔ Sabat le ame ta, eye menye ame le Sabat ta o;

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Levi's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners had become followers of Jesus, and they were also guests at the dinner.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me bena, esi wòle kplɔ̃a ŋu le eƒe me la, nudzɔla kple nuvɔ̃wɔla geɖewo bɔbɔ nɔ anyi kple Yesu kpakple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo, elabena ame geɖe wonye dze eyome.

english_verse: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were Pharisees, and they saw Jesus eating with sinners and tax collectors. So they asked his disciples, “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
translation_verse: Ke esi farisitɔwo dome agbalẽfialawo kpɔ bena, ele nu ɖum kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo kpakple nudzɔlawo la, wogblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Aleke wo bena, woɖua nu, eye wonoa nu kple nudzɔlawo kpakple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo mahã?

english_verse: The followers of John the Baptist and the Pharisees often went without eating. Some people came and asked Jesus, “Why do the followers of John and those of the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Eye Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple farisitɔwo tsia nu dana; eye wova gblɔ nɛ bena: Nukaŋuti Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple farisitɔwo ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo tsia nu dona, eye wò nusrɔ̃lawo ya metsia nu dona o mahã?

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Ke ŋkekewo gbɔna, esime woatsɔ ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ayii le wo gbɔ; ekema woatsi nu adɔ le ŋkeke ma dzi.

english_verse: No one patches old clothes by sewing on a piece of new cloth. The new piece would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke metsɔa avɔ matakpɔ ƒe nuɖeɖi kaa avɔ xoxo o; ke ne menye nenem o la, ava yeye, si wotso kae la, aho avɔ xoxo la ɖe eɖokui ŋu, eye eƒe vuvu awu tsãtɔ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. A Question about the Sabbath (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke metsɔa aha yeye dea lãgbalẽgolo xoxowo me o: ke ne menye nenem o la, aha yeye la awo lãgbalẽgoloawo, eye aha la kple lãgbalẽgoloawo siaa agblẽ; ke wotsoa aha yeye dea lãgbalẽgolo yeyewo me. Nusrɔ̃lawo tugu lu le Sabat dzi.

english_verse: One Sabbath Jesus and his disciples were walking through some wheat fields. His disciples were picking grains of wheat as they went along.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me bena, eyi ɖato lugbleawo me le Sabat dzi, eye le woƒe yiyi me la eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo de asi lutiawo ŋeŋe me.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo gblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ da, wowɔ nusi mele sea nu o la le Sabat dzi!

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Haven't you read what David did when he and his followers were hungry and in need?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Alo miexlẽ nusi Dawid wɔ la kpɔ o, esime hiã tui, eye dɔ wu eya kple amesiwo kpe de eŋuti la o mahã?

english_verse: So the Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: eyaŋuti Amegbetɔvi lae nye Sabat hã dzi Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: He even had to tell his disciples to get a boat ready to keep him from being crushed by the crowds.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena, woadzra ʋuvi la do na ye le ameha la ŋuti bena, ne woagamimi ye ɖo o;

english_verse: The Pharisees wanted to accuse Jesus of doing something wrong, and they kept watching to see if Jesus would heal him on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Eye wole ŋudzɔ nɛ be, aɖa gbe le eŋu le Sabat dzi loo, bena yewoatso enu.

english_verse: Jesus told the man to stand up where everyone could see him.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na amesi titi lé asi na la bena: Tsi tre ɖe titina.

english_verse: Jesus was angry as he looked around at the people. Yet he felt sorry for them because they were so stubborn. Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his bad hand was healed.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ wo godoo kple dziku la, exa nu le woƒe dzimesesẽ la ŋuti, eye wògblɔ na ame la bena: Mlo wò asi! Eye wòmloe, eye eƒe asi la gaɖɔ ɖo.

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples down to the shore of the lake. Large crowds followed him from Galilee, Judea,
translation_verse: Eye Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖe wo ɖokui ɖa yi ƒu la nu; eye ameha gã tso Galilea kple Yudea va dze eyome.

english_verse: Simon was one of the twelve, and Jesus named him Peter.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo ame wuieveawo, Simon, eyae wòna ŋkɔe bena Petro,

english_verse: Jesus decided to ask some of his disciples to go up on a mountain with him, and they went.
translation_verse: Eye wòyi ɖe to la dzi, eye wòyɔ amesiwo ye ŋuta le didim la, va egbɔe, eye woyi egbɔ.

english_verse: There were also James and John, the two sons of Zebedee. Jesus called them Boanerges, which means “Thunderbolts.”
translation_verse: Yakobo, Zebedeo vi la, kple Yohanes, Yakobo nɔvi la, eye wòna ŋkɔ woawo bena Boanerges, si gɔme enye dziɖegbeviwo;

english_verse: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles. The others were Simon, known as the Eager One,
translation_verse: Andrea kple Filipo, Bartolomeo kple Toma, Yakobo, Alfeo vi la, Tadeo, Simon, Kananitɔ la,

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses came from Jerusalem and said, “This man is under the power of Beelzebul, the ruler of demons! He is even forcing out demons with the help of Beelzebul.”
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfiala, siwo tso Yerusalem va la, gblɔ bena Beelzebul le eme, eye wònyã gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do go to gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe fia la dzi.

english_verse: The crowd sitting around Jesus told him, “Your mother and your brothers and sisters are outside and want to see you.”
translation_verse: Eye ameha la le anyinɔƒe ƒo xlãe. Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, dawò kple nɔviwòŋutsuwo kpakple nɔviwònyɔnuwo le xexe le diwòm.

english_verse: Jesus told the people to gather around him. Then he spoke to them in riddles and said: How can Satan force himself out?
translation_verse: Eye esi wòyɔ wo va egbɔ la, eƒo nu na wo le lododowo me bena: Aleke Satana ate ŋu anyã Satana ado goe mahã?

english_verse: Jesus went back home, and once again such a large crowd gathered that there was no chance even to eat.
translation_verse: Eye wòva aƒe me. Eye ameha la gale ƒu ƒom ale bena, womete ŋu ɖu abolo gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: A nation whose people fight each other won't last very long.
translation_verse: Eye ne fiaduƒe mã de ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti la, ekema fiaduƒe ma mate ŋu anɔ anyi o.

english_verse: And a family that fights won't last long either.
translation_verse: Eye ne aƒe mã ɖe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti la, ekema aƒe ma mate ŋu anɔ anyi o.

english_verse: So if Satan fights against himself, that will be the end of him.
translation_verse: Eye ne Satana tsi tre ɖe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti la, ekema emã, eye emate ŋu anɔ anyi o, ke boŋ enu lava tsi.

english_verse: How can anyone break into the house of a strong man and steal his things, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can take everything.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mate ŋu ayi ɖe ŋusẽtɔ la ƒe me, eye wòaha eƒe aƒemenuwo o; negbe ɖeko woabia ŋusẽtɔ la gbã hafi aha eƒe aƒe.

english_verse: I promise you that any of the sinful things you say or do can be forgiven, no matter how terrible those things are.
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Woatsɔ amegbetɔviwo ƒe nuvɔ̃, siwo katã wòwɔna, kple busunya, siwo wogblɔna la, ake wo;

english_verse: But if you speak against the Holy Spirit, you can never be forgiven. That sin will be held against you forever.
translation_verse: ke amesi agblɔ busunya ɖe Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu la, makpɔ tsɔtsɔke vaseɖe mavɔmavɔ me o; ke boŋ enyi nuvɔ̃ mavɔmavɔ ƒe fe;

english_verse: Jesus said this because the people were saying that he had an evil spirit in him. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Matthew
translation_verse: elabena wogblɔ be: Gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ le eme. Amesiwo nye Yesu ƒe ƒometɔ vavãwo.

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers came and stood outside. Then they sent someone with a message for him to come out to them.
translation_verse: Eye dadaa kple nɔviawo va afima, eye wole tsi tre le xexe, da ame ɖe egbɔ be, woayɔe ɖa.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Who is my mother and who are my brothers?”
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo ŋu na wo bena: Amekawo nye danye kple nɔvinyewo mahã?

english_verse: Then he looked at the people sitting around him and said, “Here are my mother and my brothers.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ amesiwo le anyinɔƒe ƒo xlãe dzi godoo la, egblɔ bena: Mikpɔ danye kple nɔvinyewo ɖa!

english_verse: Anyone who obeys God is my brother or sister or mother.”
translation_verse: Amesi ke awɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, eya kee nye nɔvinyeŋutsu, ganye nɔvinyenyɔnu, ganye danye hã.

english_verse: The next time Jesus taught beside Lake Galilee, a big crowd gathered. It was so large that he had to sit in a boat out on the lake, while the people stood on the shore.
translation_verse: Eye wògade asi nufiafia me le ƒua nu, eye ameha gã ŋutɔ ƒo ƒu ɖe eŋu ale bena, wòyi ɖe ʋu me, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ eme le ƒua dzi, ke ameha la katã le ƒua nu.

english_verse: While the farmer was scattering the seed, some of it fell along the road and was eaten by birds.
translation_verse: eye wòva ve me bena, esi wòle ewum la, ɖewo ge ɖe mɔ to, eye xeviwo va mi wo.

english_verse: He used stories to teach them many things, and this is part of what he taught:
translation_verse: Eye wolia nu geɖewo le lododowo me, eye wògblɔ na wo le eƒe nufiafia me bena:

english_verse: Now listen! A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.
translation_verse: Miɖo to! Kpɔ ɖa, nukuwula ɖo go yi nuku wu ge;

english_verse: Other seeds fell on thin, rocky ground and quickly started growing because the soil wasn't very deep.
translation_verse: Eye bubu ge ɖe kpenyigba dzi, afisi mekpɔ anyi geɖe le o; eye wòdo nu ɖa enumake, elabena mekpɔ anyi sɔ gbɔ o;

english_verse: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched and dried up, because they did not have deep roots.
translation_verse: eye esi ɣe dze la, ŋdɔkutsu ɖui; eye esi ke meli nɛ o ŋuti la, eyrɔ.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked out the plants. So they did not produce any grain.
translation_verse: Eye bubu ge ɖe ŋuwo me; eye ŋuwo mie, eye wovu tsyɔ edzi, eye metse ku o.

english_verse: Finally, Jesus said: What is God's kingdom like? What story can I use to explain it?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Nuka ŋu miatsɔ mawufiaɖuƒe la aɖoe mahã? Alo lo ka woaɖo le eŋuti mahã?

english_verse: When Jesus was alone with the twelve apostles and some others, they asked him about these stories.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòsusɔ eya ɖeka ɖi la, amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋuti kple ame wuieve la, wòbia lo la gɔme.

english_verse: But they don't have roots, and they don't last very long. As soon as life gets hard or the message gets them in trouble, they give up.
translation_verse: eye ke meli na wo o, eye wonɔa anyi ʋee ko; ke ne fukpekpe kple yometiti va le nya la ŋuti la, enumake wozua nuɖiaɖia na wo.

english_verse: The reason is, “These people will look and look, but never see. They will listen and listen, but never understand. If they did, they would turn to God and be forgiven.” Jesus Explains the Story about the Farmer (Matthew
translation_verse: bena amesiwo le nu kpɔm la, nakpɔ nu, ke womagadze sii o; eye amesiwo le nu sem la, nase nu, ke womagase egɔme o, bena woagatrɔ, ne woatsɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake wo o.

english_verse: The seeds that fell along the road are the people who hear the message. But Satan soon comes and snatches it away from them.
translation_verse: Ke esiawo nye amesiwo le mɔ to, afisi wowu nya la ɖo; eye ne wosee ko la, enumake Satana vana, eye wotsɔa nya, si wowu ɖe wo me la, yinɛ.

english_verse: The seeds that fell on good ground are the people who hear and welcome the message. They produce
translation_verse: Eye esiwo wowu ɖe anyigba nyui la dzi la, woawo nye amesiwo sea nya la, eye woxɔnɛ, eye wotsena, ɖewo blaetɔ̃, ɖewo blaade, ɖewo alafa.

english_verse: Jesus also said: You don't light a lamp and put it under a clay pot or under a bed. Don't you put a lamp on a lampstand?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ɖe wotsɔa akaɖi vanae, be woada ɖe afianu alo abati te mahã? Alo menye be woatsɔe ada ɖe akaɖiti dzi oa?

english_verse: Listen carefully to what you hear! The way you treat others will be the way you will be treated—and even worse.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Milé to ɖe nusi Sem miele la ŋuti; dzidzenu, si mietsɔ dzidze nui la, eya ke woatsɔ adzidze nui na mi, eye woade edzi na mi.

english_verse: Again Jesus said: God's kingdom is like what happens when a farmer scatters seed in a field.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Mawufiaɖuƒe lã le ale, abe alesi ame tsɔa nuku dea anyigbatu me ene;

english_verse: It is the ground that makes the seeds sprout and grow into plants that produce grain.
translation_verse: Anyigba la na nuku wɔna le eɖokui si; gbã ewɔa togba, ekema liŋɔ, emegbe la kutsetse blibo noa liŋɔ la me.

english_verse: Then when harvest season comes and the grain is ripe, the farmer cuts it with a sickle. A Mustard Seed (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke ne kutsetse la ɖi la, enumake edoa nuŋehɛ ɖa; elabena nuŋeɣi la ɖo.

english_verse: It is like what happens when a mustard seed is planted in the ground. It is the smallest seed in all the world.
translation_verse: Ele abe logoku ene, esi ne woƒãe ɖe anyigba me la, ele sue wu atiku, siwo katã le anyigba la dzi;

english_verse: But once it is planted, it grows larger than any garden plant. It even puts out branches that are big enough for birds to nest in its shade. The Reason for Teaching with Stories (Matthew
translation_verse: eye ne woƒãe la, emiena, eye wòva lolona wua abɔ me tiwo katã, eye wòɖea alɔ gãwo nenem bena, dziƒoxeviwo ate ŋu adze ɖe eƒe vɔvɔli me.

english_verse: He did not tell them anything without using stories. But when he was alone with his disciples, he explained everything to them. A Storm (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye ne menye lododowo o la, meƒoa nu na wo o; ke ne eya kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖeɖe woli la, eɖea nuwo katã gome fia wo. Yesu tsi ahom nu le ƒu dzi.

english_verse: That evening, Jesus said to his disciples, “Let's cross to the east side.”
translation_verse: Eye le nenem ŋkeke ma dzi, esi fìẽsi ɖo la, egblɔ na wo bena: Mina ne míayi go keme dzi.

english_verse: Jesus used many other stories when he spoke to the people, and he taught them as much as they could understand.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nya fia wo le lododo sia ƒomevi geɖewo me, abe alesi wòanya se na wo ene.

english_verse: So they left the crowd, and his disciples started across the lake with him in the boat. Some other boats followed along.
translation_verse: Eye esi wogblẽ ameha la ɖi la, wokui yi, abe alesi wòle ʋu la me ene; eye ʋu bubuwo hã kpe ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: Suddenly a storm struck the lake. Waves started splashing into the boat, and it was about to sink.
translation_verse: Eye ahom sesẽa ɖe va tu, eye ƒutsotsoewo le ŋeŋem ɖe ʋu la me, ale bena ʋu la de asi yɔyɔ me.

english_verse: Jesus was in the back of the boat with his head on a pillow, and he was asleep. His disciples woke him and said, “Teacher, don't you care that we're about to drown?”
translation_verse: Ke eya ŋutɔ le ʋu gome, Zia suɖi le alɔ̃ dom, eye wonyae gblɔ nɛ bena: Nufiala, ɖe miaƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃ metsɔ gbɔwò nya o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus got up and ordered the wind and the waves to be quiet. The wind stopped, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Eye esi wònyɔ la, eblu ɖe ya la ta, eye wògblɔ na ƒu la bena: Zi ɖoɖoe, dze anyi! Tete ya la dzudzɔ ƒoƒo, eye ɖoɖoe gãa ɖe zi.

english_verse: Jesus asked his disciples, “Why were you afraid? Don't you have any faith?”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nuka wo mievɔ̃ ale? Ɖe xɔse mele mia si o mahã?

english_verse: Now they were more afraid than ever and said to each other, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!”
translation_verse: Eye wovɔ̃ geɖe ŋutɔ, eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Ameka gɔ̃e nye esia bena, ya kple ƒu gɔ̃ hã ɖoa toe mahã?

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: elabena egblɔ bena: Ne mede asi eƒe awu ŋu ko la, nye lãme asẽ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace! You are healed, and you will no longer be in pain.”
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ nɛ bena: Vinyenyɔnuvi, wò xɔse la de wò; heyi le ŋutifafa me, wò lãme nasẽ tso wò dɔléle la me!

english_verse: She had gone to many doctors, and they had not done anything except cause her a lot of pain. She had paid them all the money she had. But instead of getting better, she only got worse.
translation_verse: eye wokpe fu geɖe tso gbedala geɖewo gbɔ hegblẽ nusiwo katã le esi, gake mele nyonyom nɛ o, ke boŋ wògado gã ɖe edzi wu la,

english_verse: Then Jesus went inside and said to them, “Why are you crying and carrying on like this? The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòge de aƒea me la, egblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti miele ʋunyaʋunya wɔm hele avi fam ale? Ɖevi la meku o, ke boŋ alɔ̃ dɔm wòle.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed Lake Galilee and came to shore near the town of Gerasa.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ɖo ƒu la godo le Gadaratɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: from the graveyard where he had been living. No one was able to tie the man up anymore, not even with a chain.
translation_verse: amesi ƒe nɔƒe nye yɔdowo me, eye amea ɖeke mete ŋu blane kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ gɔ̃ hã o;

english_verse: He had often been put in chains and leg irons, but he broke the chains and smashed the leg irons. No one could control him.
translation_verse: elabena enuenu woɖea kunyowu eƒe afɔwo, eye woblanɛ kple kɔsɔkɔsɔwo, ke etsoa kɔsɔkɔsɔawo, eye wòŋea kunyowuawo, eye amea ɖeke metea ŋu nana eƒe mo fana o.

english_verse: Night and day he was in the graveyard or on the hills, yelling and cutting himself with stones.
translation_verse: Eye ɖaa zã kple keli wonoa yɔdowo me kple towo dzi henɔa ɣli dom, eye wònɔa kpe xlãm ɖe eɖokui.

english_verse: When the man saw Jesus in the distance, he ran up to him and knelt down.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ Yesu le adzɔge ke la, eƒu du va dze klo nɛ;

english_verse: He shouted, “Jesus, Son of God in heaven, what do you want with me? Promise me in God's name that you won't torture me!”
translation_verse: eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ bena: Nya kae le mía kpli wò dome, Yesu, Mawu dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe Vi! Meta Mawu na wò bena, megawɔ funyafunyam o.

english_verse: He then begged Jesus not to send them away.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖe kuku nɛ vevie ŋutɔ bena, wòaganyã yewo tso afima nutoawo me o.

english_verse: Over on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Ke aƒehawo ƒe ha gãa ɖe le afima le gbe ɖum le to la dzi.

english_verse: So the evil spirits begged Jesus, “Send us into those pigs! Let us go into them.”
translation_verse: Eye wode kuku nɛ gblɔ bena: Dɔ mí ɖe hawo me, ne míayi ɖe wo me.

english_verse: The men taking care of the pigs ran to the town and the farms to spread the news. Then the people came out to see what had happened.
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo le wo kplɔm la si, eye woyi ɖaxlẽe fia le dua me kple agbletawo. Eye wodo go va nusi wònye va ve me la, kpɔ ge ɖa.

english_verse: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had once been full of demons. He was sitting there with his clothes on and in his right mind, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Eye wova Yesu gbɔ, eye wokpɔ amesi me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe legio nɔ la, le anyinɔƒe, eye wòta avɔ, eye eƒe mo kɔ, eye wovɔ̃.

english_verse: Everyone who had seen what had happened told about the man and the pigs.
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo kpɔe la, woxlẽ nusi wòwɔ na amesi me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃awo nɔ la, kple hawo ŋutinya hefiã wo.

english_verse: Then the people started begging Jesus to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Eye wode asi kukuɖeɖe me nɛ bena, woadzo le yewoƒe nutoawo me.

english_verse: But Jesus would not let him. Instead, he said, “Go home to your family and tell them how much the Lord has done for you and how good he has been to you.”
translation_verse: Eye mena mɔe o; ke egblɔ nɛ bena: Heyi aƒewò me ɖe tɔwòwo gbɔ, eye naxlẽ nusianu, si Aƒetɔ la wɔ na wò kple alesi wòkpɔ nublanui na wò la, afia wo.

english_verse: But the people laughed at him. After Jesus had sent them all out of the house, he took the girl's father and mother and his three disciples and went to where she was.
translation_verse: Eye wokoe. Ke esi wonyã wo katã do goe la, èkplɔ ɖevia fofoa kple dadaa kple amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋuti la, eye wòyi afisi ɖevi la mlɔ.

english_verse: Once again Jesus got into the boat and crossed Lake Galilee. Then as he stood on the shore, a large crowd gathered around him.
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu ɖo ʋu gatso ƒua va egodo la, ameha gãa ɖe ƒo ƒu ɖe eŋuti, eye wònɔ ƒu la nu. Yesu da gbe le nyɔnu ʋusisidɔléla kple Yairo vinyɔnuvi ŋuti.

english_verse: The person in charge of the synagogue was also there. His name was Jairus, and when he saw Jesus, he went over to him. He knelt at Jesus' feet
translation_verse: Eye ƒuƒoƒe la ƒe amegãwo dometɔ ɖeka, si ŋkɔ nye Yairo la, va, eye esi wòkpɔe la, edze klo ɖe eƒe afɔ nu,

english_verse: and started begging him for help. He said, “My little daughter is about to die! Please come and touch her, so she will get well and live.”
translation_verse: eye wòɖe kuku nɛ vevie ŋuta gblɔ bena: Vinyenyɔnuvi ɖo kudo nu, va ne natsɔ wò asi ada de edzi, bena eƒe lãme nasẽ, eye wòatsi agbe.

english_verse: Jesus went with Jairus. Many people followed along and kept crowding around.
translation_verse: Eye wòyi kplii, eye ameha gãa de dze eyome ale be, womimii do.

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnua ɖe, si ŋu ʋu le dodom le ƒe wuieve sɔŋ,

english_verse: The woman had heard about Jesus, so she came up behind him in the crowd and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: esi wose Yesu ŋkɔ la, eva dze amehawo le emegbe, eye wòde asi eƒe awu ŋuti;

english_verse: As soon as she touched them, her bleeding stopped, and she knew she was healed.
translation_verse: Eye enumake eƒe ʋu la nu tso, eye wose le eƒe lãme bena, yeƒe dɔ la vɔ.

english_verse: At that moment Jesus felt power go out from him. He turned to the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
translation_verse: Eye enumake Yesu dze sii le eɖokui me bena, ŋusẽ do go tso ye me, eye wòtrɔ de ameha la gbɔ gblɔ bena: Amekae de asi nye awu ŋu mahã?

english_verse: His disciples said to him, “Look at all these people crowding around you! How can you ask who touched you?”
translation_verse: Eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Ekpɔ be, ameha la mimi wò ɖo tso, hafi nèle gbɔgblɔm bena: Amekae ɖe asi ŋunye mahã?

english_verse: But Jesus turned to see who had touched him.
translation_verse: Eye wotsa ŋku godoo, bena yeakpɔ amesi wɔ esia.

english_verse: The woman knew what had happened to her. So she came trembling with fear and knelt down in front of Jesus. Then she told him the whole story.
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnu la le vɔvɔ̃m, eye wòle dzodzom nyanyanya; elabena enya nusi wòwɔ nɛ, eye wòva dze klo nɛ, eye wògblɔ nyateƒe blibo katã nɛ.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from Jairus' home and said, “Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore?”
translation_verse: Esi wogale nu ƒom la, du tso ƒuƒoƒemegã la ƒe me va bena: Wò nyɔnuvi la ku; nukaŋuti nègale fu dem na nufiala mahã?

english_verse: Jesus heard what they said, and he said to Jairus, “Don't worry. Just have faith!”
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu se nya, si gblɔm wole la, egblɔ na ƒuƒoƒemegã la bena: Megavɔ̃ o, xɔ se ko.

english_verse: Jesus did not let anyone go with him except Peter and the two brothers, James and John.
translation_verse: Eye mede mɔ na amea ɖeke be, wòadze eyome o, negbe Petro kple Yakobo kple Yohanes, Yakobo nɔvi la ko.

english_verse: They went home with Jairus and saw the people crying and making a lot of noise.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ƒuƒoƒemegã la ƒe me, eye wòkpɔ amesiwo le ʋunyaʋunya wɔm, eye wole avi fam le ɣli dom sesĩe la, le afima.

english_verse: He took the twelve-year-old girl by the hand and said, “Talitha, koum!” which means, “Little girl, get up!” The girl got right up and started walking around. Everyone was greatly surprised.
translation_verse: Eye enumake nyɔnuvi la tsi tre, eye wozɔ azɔli; elabena exɔ ƒe wuieve, eye wolulu ŋutɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened. Then he said, “Give her something to eat.”
translation_verse: Eye wogbe nya na wo vevie bena, amea ɖeke naganyae o; eye wòbena, woana nanee, ne wòaɖu.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Prophets are honored by everyone, except the people of their hometown and their relatives and their own family.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wò bena: Womedoa kpo nyagblɔɖila bubu o, negbe le eya ŋutɔ fofoawo de kple eƒomeawo dome kpakple eƒe me ko.

english_verse: But when Herod heard about Jesus, he said, “This must be John! I had his head cut off, and now he has come back to life.”
translation_verse: Ke esi Herodes see la, egblɔ bena; Yohanes, si nu metso ta le la, eyae tsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome.

english_verse: After the apostles returned to Jesus, they told him everything they had done and taught.
translation_verse: Eye apostolowo ƒo ƒu ɖe Yesu gbɔ, eye woxlẽ nusiwo katã wowɔ kple nusiwo wòfiã la nɛ.

english_verse: The next Sabbath he taught in the synagogue. Many of the people who heard him were amazed and asked, “How can he do all this? Where did he get such wisdom and the power to work these miracles?
translation_verse: Eye esi Sabat ɖo la, ede asi nufiafia me le ƒuƒoƒe la, eye ame geɖe, siwo see la, ƒe nu ku, eye wogblɔ bena: Afika amesia kpɔ nusiawo tsoe, eye nunya ka ƒomevi nye esi wonae mahã, ale be ŋusẽdɔ siawo va ve me to eƒe asi dzi mahã?

english_verse: Isn't he the carpenter, the son of Mary? Aren't James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon his brothers? Don't his sisters still live here in our town?” The people were upset because of what he was doing.
translation_verse: Alo amesia la, de menye atikpala, si nye Mana vi la, kple Yakobo, Yose, Yuda kpakple Simon nɔvi lae o mahã? Eye nɔvianyɔnuwo hã mele mía dome afisia o mahã? Eye wòzu nuɖiaɖia na wo le eyama ŋuti.

english_verse: He told them, “You may take along a walking stick. But don't carry food or a traveling bag or any money.
translation_verse: eye wòde se na wo bena, woagatsɔ naneke de asi de mɔzɔzɔ ŋu o, negbe atizɔti ko; menye kotoku alo abolo o, alo ga nanɔ woƒe go nu hã o;

english_verse: Herodias had a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she could not do it
translation_verse: Eye Herodia lée de dɔme, eye wòle didim be, yeawui, ke mete ŋui o,

english_verse: because Herod was afraid of John and protected him. He knew that John was a good and holy man. Even though Herod was confused by what John said, he was glad to listen to him. And he often did.
translation_verse: elabena Herodes vɔ̃ Yohanes, amesi wònya bena, enye ame dzɔdzɔe kple ame kɔkɔe wònye la, eye wòkpɔ eta. Eye ne eɖo toe la, eɖoa xaxa me le nu geɖewo ŋuti, eye eƒe gbesese vivina nɛ.

english_verse: I swear that I will give you as much as half of my kingdom, if you want it.”
translation_verse: Eye wòka atam ne bena: Nusi ke nabiam la, mana wò vaseɖe nye fiaɖuƒe la ƒe akpa afã dzi.

english_verse: The girl left and asked her mother, “What do you think I should ask for?” Her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòɖo go yi la, egblɔ na dadaa bena: Nuka mabia mahã? Ke eya gblɔ bena: Bia Yohanes, mawutsidetanamela, ƒe ta.

english_verse: The girl hurried back and told Herod, “Here and now on a serving plate I want the head of John the Baptist!”
translation_verse: Eye enumake wòɖe abla va fia la gbɔ, eye wòbiae gblɔ bena: Meɖi bena, natsɔ Yohanes mawutsidetanamela ƒe ta nam le agba me fifilaasi.

english_verse: Herod was very sorry for what he had said. But he did not want to break the promise he had made in front of his guests.
translation_verse: Eye wòve fia la ŋutɔ; gake la le eƒe atamkaka kple amesiwo le kplɔa ŋuti kpakplii ta la melɔ̃ be, yeagbe enana o.

english_verse: At once he ordered a guard to cut off John's head there in prison.
translation_verse: Eye enumake fia la dɔ eŋudzɔsrafo ɖeka ɖa, eye wòde se ne be, wòaɖatsɔ eƒe ta ve;

english_verse: The guard put the head on a serving plate and took it to the girl. Then she gave it to her mother.
translation_verse: eye wòyi, eye wòtso ta le enu le gaxɔ me, eye wotsɔ eƒe ta ɖe agba me ve, eye wòtsɔe na nyɔnuvi la, eye nyɔnuvi la tsoe na dadaa.

english_verse: When John's followers learned that he had been killed, they took his body and put it in a tomb. Jesus Feeds Five Thousand (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye esi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo see la, wova tso eƒe kukua yi ɖaɖi. Yesu nyi ame

english_verse: But so many people were coming and going that Jesus and the apostles did not even have a chance to eat. Then Jesus said, “Let's go to a place where we can be alone and get some rest.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miva, ne miawo ɖeɖe miayi gbedzi, ne míadzudzɔ mía ɖokui ʋee. Elabena amesiwo le vavam gale yiyim la, wosɔ gbɔ, eye womekpɔ asinu gɔ̃ hã, ne woaɖu nu o.

english_verse: They left in a boat for a place where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Eye woɖo ʋu dzo heyi ɖe gbedzi, woawo ɖeɖe.

english_verse: That evening the disciples came to Jesus and said, “This place is like a desert, and it's already late.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòsusɔ ʋee, ne zã nado la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ gblɔ bena: Teƒe la enye gbedzi, eye zã hã le dodom;

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You give them something to eat.” But they asked him, “Don't you know it would take almost a year's wages to buy all of these people something to eat?”
translation_verse: Eye wòxɔ edzi na wo gblɔ bena: Miawo la mina nu wo, ne woaɖu. Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ekema de miayi aɖaƒle abolo denario alafa eve nu, ne miatso ana wo, ne woaɖu mahã?

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “How much bread do you have? Go and see!” They found out and answered, “We have five small loaves of bread and two fish.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Abolo nenie le mia si mahã? Miyi ɖakpɔe ɖa. Eye esi wonyae la, wogblɔ bena: Wo ame atɔ kple tɔmelã eve.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples to tell the people to sit down on the green grass.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo na wo bena, wo katã nanɔ anyi hamehame ɖe gbe mumu la dzi.

english_verse: They sat down in groups of
translation_verse: Eye wonɔ anyi hamehame, ɖewo alafa, ɖewo blaatɔ̃.

english_verse: All of them saw him and were terrified. But at this same time he said, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: elabena wo katã wokpɔe, eye dzika tso wo ƒo. Ke eƒo nu kpli wo enumake gblɔ bena: Mina miaƒe dzi nadze eme; nyee nye esi, migavɔ̃ o hee!

english_verse: Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish. He looked up toward heaven and blessed the food. Then he broke the bread and handed it to his disciples to give to the people. He also divided the two fish, so everyone could have some.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtso abolo atɔ̃ la kple lã eveawo la, ekpa dziƒo, eye wòyra ɖe wo dzi, eye wòŋe aboloawo me, eye wòtso wo na nusrɔ̃lawo, bena woatsa wo aɖo wo ko me, eye wòmã lã eveawo hã me ɖe wo katã dome.

english_verse: After everyone had eaten all they wanted,
translation_verse: Eye wo katã woɖu nu, eye woɖi ƒo.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples picked up twelve large baskets of leftover bread and fish.
translation_verse: Eye wofa kakɛ, siwo susɔ la, ɖe kevi wuieve me fũ kple lãwo ƒe ɖe hã.

english_verse: At once, Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and start back across to Bethsaida. But he stayed until he had sent the crowds away.
translation_verse: Eye enumake wòƒoe ɖe eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo nu be, woaɖo ʋu, ne wòadze ye ŋgɔ ayi go keme dzi ɖe Betsaida, vaseɖe esime ye ŋutɔ yeaɖe asi le ameha la ŋu.

english_verse: Then he told them goodbye and went up on the side of a mountain to pray.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòɖe mo na wo megbe la, edzo heyi ɖe to la dzi, be yeado gbe ɖa.;

english_verse: Later in the evening he was still there by himself, and the boat was somewhere in the middle of the lake.
translation_verse: Eye esi fiẽsi ɖo la, ʋu la ɖo ƒu titina, eye eya ɖeka susɔ ɖe gota.

english_verse: He could see that the disciples were struggling hard, because they were rowing against the wind. Not long before morning, Jesus came toward them. He was walking on the water and was about to pass the boat.
translation_verse: Eye wòkpɔ wo wole fu kpem le ʋuakuku me; elabena ya ƒo le wo kpem Eye ano zã ƒe ŋudzɔɣi enelia me la ele ƒu dzi zɔm gbɔna wo gbɔ, eye wòdi be, yeato wo ŋuti ayi;

english_verse: When the disciples saw Jesus walking on the water, they thought he was a ghost, and they started screaming.
translation_verse: ke esi wokpɔe wòle ƒua dzi zɔm la, wobu xa bena, ŋɔlie, eye wodo ɣli;

english_verse: He then got into the boat with them, and the wind died down. The disciples were completely confused.
translation_verse: Eye woge ɖe nu la me le wo gbɔ, eye ya la dzudzɔ, eye woƒe nu ku ŋutɔ;

english_verse: Their minds were closed, and they could not understand the true meaning of the loaves of bread. Jesus Heals Sick People in Gennesaret (Matthew
translation_verse: elabena womenya ta le aboloawo nu o, ke boŋ woƒe dzime sẽ. Yesu yɔ dɔ dɔlélewo.

english_verse: As soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye esi wodo go le ʋua me la, enumake wodze sii,

english_verse: So they ran all over that part of the country to bring their sick people to him on mats. They brought them each time they heard where he was.
translation_verse: eye du dzo le afima nutoawo katã me godoo, eye wode asi amesiwo ƒe lãme gblẽ la tsɔtsɔ me ɖe abawo dzi va afisi wose be, ele.

english_verse: In every village or farm or marketplace where Jesus went, the people brought their sick to him. They begged him to let them just touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.
translation_verse: Eye afisi wòyina ɖo le kɔƒewo alo duwo me alo agbletawo la, wotsɔa dɔlélawo va dana ɖe ablɔwo me, eye woɖea kuku ne bena, yewoade asi eƒe awuto ɖeɖeko ŋu; eye ame alesi nu de asi eŋu ko la, ƒe lãme sẽna.

english_verse: Some Pharisees and several teachers of the Law of Moses from Jerusalem came and gathered around Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo kple agbalẽfialaa ɖewo, siwo tso Yerusalem va la, ƒo ƒu ɖe egbɔ.

english_verse: You are good at rejecting God's commands so that you can follow your own teachings!
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mieɖe Mawu ƒe se la ɖa nyuie, bena mianyi mia ŋutɔwo ƒe kɔ.

english_verse: They noticed that some of his disciples ate without first washing their hands.
translation_verse: Eye wokpɔ bena, eƒe nusrɔ̃laa ɖewo le abolo ɖum kple asi ƒoɖi, egɔme nye asi maklɔmaklɔe la;

english_verse: The Pharisees and many others obey the teachings of their ancestors. They always wash their hands in the proper way before eating.
translation_verse: elabena farisitɔwo kple Yudatɔwo katã la, ne womeklɔ asi nyuie o la, womeɖua nu o; ale wonɔa ŋku lém ɖe amegãwo ƒe ko la ŋuti vevie;

english_verse: None of them will eat anything they buy in the market until it is washed. They also follow a lot of other teachings, such as washing cups, pitchers, and bowls.
translation_verse: eye ne wotso asi me gbɔ la, ne womele tsi o la, womeɖua nu o, eye nu bubu geɖewo li, siwo ŋuti woléa ŋku ɖo le tsikpluwo kple zewo kple ganuwo kɔklɔ la me. —

english_verse: The Pharisees and teachers asked Jesus, “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? Why do they eat without washing their hands?”
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo kple agbalẽfialawo biae bena: Nukaŋuti wò nusrɔ̃lawo mezɔna le amegãwo ƒe koa nu o, ke boŋ woɖua abolo asi maklɔmaklɔe mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied: You are nothing but show-offs! The prophet Isaiah was right when he wrote that God had said, “All of you praise me with your words, but you never really think about me.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu na wo bena: Yesaya gblɔe ɖi nyuie le mi alakpatɔwo ŋuti, abe alesi woŋlɔe ɖi ene bena: „Dukɔ sia le buyem kple nuyiwo; gake woƒe dzi te ɖa xaa tso gbɔnye.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.”
translation_verse: Ke dzodzroe wole subɔyem, hele nufiafia, siwo nye amewo ƒe sededewo la fiãm.“

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they own has been offered to God.
translation_verse: ke miawo la miegblɔ be: Ne amea ɖe lagblɔ na fofoa alo dadaa bena: Nusi ke nate ŋu akpɔ tso gbɔnye la, nanye korban ,

english_verse: You won't let those people help their parents.
translation_verse: miena mee be, wòagawɔ naneke na fofoa alo dadaa o;

english_verse: And you ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching. You do a lot of other things just as bad. What Really Makes People Unclean (Matthew
translation_verse: eye miena Mawu ƒe nya la tsi mabumabu le miaƒe ka, si mieɖo anyi la ŋuti; eye nusiawo tugbe geɖe miewɔna.

english_verse: Then Jesus said: What comes from your heart is what makes you unclean.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Nusi ke doa go tsoa ame me la, eya ƒoa ɖi ame.

english_verse: Jesus called the crowd together again and said, “Pay attention and try to understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Eye wògayɔ ameha la va egbɔ, gblɔ na wo bena: Mi katã miɖo tom, ne miase nu gome.

english_verse: After Jesus and his disciples had left the crowd and gone into the house, they asked him what these sayings meant.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdzo le ameha la gbɔ yi ɖe aƒe me la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bia lo la gɔmee.

english_verse: He answered, “Don't you know what I am talking about by now? You surely know that the food you put into your mouth cannot make you unclean.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ale miawo hã mienye ame masenugɔmewoe nye esi mahã? Alo miedze sii kpɔ bena, nusianu, si tsoa gota yina ɖe ame me la, mate ŋu aƒo ɖii o;

english_verse: It doesn't go into your heart, but into your stomach, and then out of your body.” By saying this, Jesus meant that all foods were fit to eat.
translation_verse: elabena menye eƒe dzi me wòyina ɖo o, hafi boŋ eƒe dɔ me wòyina ɖo, eye wòɖadena ɖe kpɔxa, le esia me nuɖuɖuawo katã ŋuti kɔna lena o mahã?

english_verse: unfaithfulness in marriage, greed, meanness, deceit, indecency, envy, insults, pride, and foolishness.
translation_verse: ahasiwɔwɔwo, ŋubiabiãwo, nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo, beble, ahiãdzedze, ŋku vɔ̃ɖi, busubɔbɔ, dàda, movidzɔdzɔ;

english_verse: All of these come from your heart, and they are what make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Matthew
translation_verse: nu vɔ̃ɖi siawo katã doa go tsoa eme ke, eye woƒoa ɖi ame. Yesu da gbe le Kanaan-nyɔnu la ƒe vinyɔnuvi la ŋu.

english_verse: The woman replied, “Lord, even puppies eat the crumbs that children drop from the table.”
translation_verse: Ke eya xɔ edzi gblɔ ne bena: Yoo, Aƒetɔ! Gake avũvi, siwo le kplɔ̃ te la, ɖua ɖeviwo ƒe abolo wuwluiwo tso.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the region near the town of Tyre, where he stayed in someone's home. He did not want people to know he was there, but they found out anyway.
translation_verse: Eye wòdzo le afima heyi ɖe Tiro-nutoawo me. Eye wòyi ɖe aƒea ɖe me, eye melɔ̃ be, amea ɖeke nanyae o, ke mete ŋu ɣla eɖokui o.

english_verse: A woman whose daughter had an evil spirit in her heard where Jesus was. And at once she came and knelt down at his feet.
translation_verse: Elabena nyɔnua ɖe, si gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ le vianyɔnuvi me la, se eŋkɔ, eye wòva dze klo ɖe eƒe afɔ nu.

english_verse: The woman was Greek and had been born in the part of Syria known as Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to force the demon out of her daughter.
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnu la nye Helatɔ, si wodzi le Sirofoinike; eye wòɖe kuku nɛ bena, wòanya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la aɖo goe tso vianyɔnuvi la me.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “The children must first be fed! It isn't right to take away their food and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena; Na ɖeviwo naɖi ƒo gbɔ; elabena menyo bena, woatsɔ ɖeviwo ƒe abolo aƒu gbe na avũviwo o.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “That's true! You may go now. The demon has left your daughter.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Le nya sia ŋuti la heyi; gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la do go tso viwònyɔnuvi la me.

english_verse: When the woman got back home, she found her child lying on the bed. The demon had gone. Jesus Heals a Man Who Was Deaf and Could Hardly Talk
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdzo va eƒe me la, ekpɔ ɖevi la mlɔ aba dzi, eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la do go. Yesu da gbe le aɖetututɔa ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: Jesus left the region around Tyre and went by way of Sidon toward Lake Galilee. He went through the land near the ten cities known as Decapolis.
translation_verse: Esi wògado go tso Tiro-nutoawo me la, etso Sidon heto Galilea-ƒu la nu heva Dekapoli-nutoawo me ke.

english_verse: Some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk. They begged Jesus just to touch him.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ amea ɖe, si nye tokunɔ kple aɖetututɔ la, va egbɔ, eye woɖe kuku nɛ bena, wòatsɔ eƒe asi ada ɖe edzi.

english_verse: After Jesus had taken him aside from the crowd, he stuck his fingers in the man's ears. Then he spit and put it on the man's tongue.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ eyama heƒo asae tso ameha la gbɔ, eye wotsɔ eƒe asibidewo ƒo ɖe eƒe to me, eye wòɖe ta ɖo eƒe aɖe nu;

english_verse: Jesus looked up toward heaven, and with a groan he said, “Effatha!” which means “Open up!”
translation_verse: eye esi wòle dziƒo kpɔm la, eɖe hũ, eye wògblɔ ne bena. „Hefata“, si gɔme enye: Ʋua!

english_verse: At once the man could hear, and he had no more trouble talking clearly.
translation_verse: Tete eƒe to la ʋu, eye enumake eƒe aɖeka hã ɖɔ ɖo, eye wòƒo nu nyuie.

english_verse: Jesus told the people not to say anything about what he had done. But the more he told them, the more they talked about it.
translation_verse: Eye wòde se na wo bena, woagatoe na amea ɖeke o; ke geɖe alesi wòde se na wòe la, geɖe wu woyi ɖakakae.

english_verse: They were completely amazed and said, “Everything he does is good! He even heals people who cannot hear or talk.”
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo wo ŋutɔ, eye wole gbɔgblɔm bena: Ewɔ nuwo katã nyuie, ena tokunɔwo sea nu, eye aɖetututɔwo hã ƒoa nu.

english_verse: Jesus warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
translation_verse: Eye wòde se na wo bena: Mikpɔ nyuie, eye milé be na mia ɖokui le farisitɔwo ƒe amiwo ʋaʋã kple Herodes ƒe amewo ʋaʋã la ŋuti.

english_verse: Then Jesus explained clearly what he meant. Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that.
translation_verse: Eye wòto nya sia na wo faa. Tete Petro de kpoe, eye wòde asi nyagbegbe me nɛ.

english_verse: “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat.
translation_verse: Nye dɔme trɔ ɖe ameha la ŋuti; elabena egbee nye ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe wole ŋutinye, eye womekpɔ naneke, be woaɖu o;

english_verse: Some of them live a long way from here. If I send them away hungry, they might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: eye ne medo mɔ wo dɔme ɣeɣi, be woayi aƒe la, aƒetrɔ latsɔ wo le mɔ dzi, eye wo dome amea ɖewo hã tso didiƒe.

english_verse: After Jesus told the crowd to sit down, he took the seven loaves and gave thanks. He then broke the loaves and handed them to his disciples, who passed them out to the crowd.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo bena, ameha la nabɔbɔ nɔ anyigba; eye wotsɔ abolo adre la, eye esi wòda akpe ɖe wo dzi la, èŋe me, eye wòtsɔe na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo, bena woatsɔe na wo, eye wotsɔe ɖo ameha la kɔ me.

english_verse: They also had a few little fish, and after Jesus had blessed these, he told the disciples to pass them around.
translation_verse: Eye lãvi ʋeea ɖewo hã le wo si, eye esi wòyra ɖe wo dzi la, ena wotsɔ woawo hã ɖo wo kɔ me.

english_verse: he got into the boat with the disciples and crossed to the territory near Dalmanutha. A Sign from Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye enumake wòɖo ʋu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo, eye wova Dalmanuta-nutoawo me. Yesu ƒo nu le dzesiwo kple farisitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔ ʋaʋã ŋuti.

english_verse: The Pharisees came out and started an argument with Jesus. They wanted to test him by asking for a sign from heaven.
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo do go va, eye wode asi nusese me kplii hele dzesi biamii tso dziƒo hele etem kpo.

english_verse: The disciples had forgotten to bring any bread, and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ abolotsɔtsɔ ɖe asi be, eye ɖeke mele wo si le ʋua me o, negbe abolo ɖeka ko.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you talking about not having any bread? Don't you understand? Are your minds still closed?
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdze sii la, egblɔ na wo bena: Nuka miele di kem be, mietsɔ abolo de asi o mahã? Ɖe miedze si nu kpo haɖe alo se nu gome hã oa, alo miaƒe dzime ɖe wògasẽ mahã?

english_verse: Jesus took him by the hand and led him out of the village, where he spit into the man's eyes. He placed his hands on the blind man and asked him if he could see anything.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòlé ŋkuagbãtɔ la ƒe alɔnu la, ekplɔe do go tso du la me, eye esi wòɖe ta ɖe ŋku dzi nɛ, eye wòtsɔ eƒe asiwo ɖo edzi la, ebiae bena: Ele nane kpɔma?

english_verse: The man looked up and said, “I see people, but they look like trees walking around.”
translation_verse: Esi wòwu ŋku dzi la, egblɔ bena: Mekpɔ amewo; mekpɔ wo wole abe atiwo ene hele azɔli zɔm.

english_verse: Once again Jesus placed his hands on the man's eyes, and this time the man stared. His eyes were healed, and he saw everything clearly.
translation_verse: Tete wògatsɔ eƒe asiwo ɖo eƒe ŋkuwo dzi, eye wòklẽ ŋku sesĩe; eye wòɖɔe do, eye wòkpɔ nusianu nyuie.

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “You may return home now, but don't go into the village.” Who Is Jesus? (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wòdɔe ɖo ɖe eƒe me gblɔ bena: Megayi ɖe ɖu la me o. Petro nu Yesu me.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?” “You are the Messiah!” Peter replied.
translation_verse: Eye wòbia wo bena: Ke miawo la, ameka miegblɔna bena, menye mahã? Eye Petro ɖo ŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Wòe nye Kristo la.

english_verse: Jesus warned the disciples not to tell anyone about him. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wogbe nya na wo bena, woagagblɔ nya le ye ŋuti na amea ɖeke o. Yesu gblɔ nya le eƒe fukpekpe ŋuti zi gbãtɔ.

english_verse: Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “The nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make the Son of Man suffer terribly. He will be rejected and killed, but three days later he will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Eye wòde asi wo fiafia me bena: Ele na Amegbetɔvi la bena, woakpe fu geɖe, eye amegãwo kple nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo woado vloe, eye woawui, eye wòatsi tre le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe.

english_verse: But when Jesus turned and saw the disciples, he corrected Peter. He said to him, “Satan, get away from me! You are thinking like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Ke etrɔ kpɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo, eye wogbe nya na Petro gblɔ bena: Te ɖokuiwò ɖa yi megbenye, Satana! Elabena menye Mawu tɔ nèsusu o, negbe nusi nye amegbetɔwo tɔ la ko.

english_verse: Jesus then told the crowd and the disciples to come closer, and he said: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Eye wòyɔ ameha la kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ gblɔ na wo bena: Amesi ke le lɔlɔ̃m bena, yeadze yonyeme la, negbe nu le ye ŋutɔ dokui gbɔ, eye wòatsɔ eƒe atitsoga, eye wòadze yonyeme.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me and for the good news, you will save it.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke di be, yeade yeƒe agbe la, atsrɔ̃e; ke amesi atsrɔ̃ eƒe agbe le nye kple nyanyuie la ŋuti la, aɖee.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself?
translation_verse: Elabena viɖe ka wòanye na ame, ne xexeme blibo la katã zu etɔ, ke wòabu eƒe luʋɔ mahã?

english_verse: What could you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Alo nuka amegbetɔ atsɔ ana agaxɔ eƒe luʋɔ mahã?

english_verse: Don't be ashamed of me and my message among these unfaithful and sinful people! If you are, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke kpe ŋu nye kple nye nyawo le dzidzime wɔahasi kple dzidzime wonuvɔ̃ sia dome la, Amegbetɔvi la hã akpe ŋui, ne ava le Fofoa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me kple mawudɔla kɔkɔeawo.

english_verse: I can assure you that Elijah has already come. And people treated him just as they wanted to, as the Scriptures say they would. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Gake mele egblɔm na mi bena: Eliya va xoxo, eye wowɔ nusi wolɔ̃ la, ɖe eŋuti, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi le eŋuti ene. Yesu da gbe le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ tɔa ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: After Jesus and the disciples had gone back home and were alone, they asked him, “Why couldn't we force out that demon?”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva aƒea me la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖeɖe va egbɔ biae bena: Aleke wɔ míawo miete ŋu nyae do go o mahã?

english_verse: Then Jesus asked a child to stand near him. He put his arm around the child and said,
translation_verse: Eye wotsa ɖevi suea ɖe ɖo wo titina, eye wòlée ɖe eƒe akɔnu gblɔ na wo bena:

english_verse: And his clothes became much whiter than any bleach on earth could make them.
translation_verse: eye eƒe awuwo trɔ le dzo dam hefu tititi, eye nunyãlaa ɖeke mele anyigba dzi ate ŋu awɔ wo woafu alea o.

english_verse: Then Elijah and Moses appeared and were talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye Eliya kple Mose woɖe wo ɖokui fia wo, eye wole nu ƒom kple Yesu.

english_verse: The shadow of a cloud passed over and covered them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my Son, and I love him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Eye alilikpo va do vɔvɔli ɖe wo dzi, eye gbe tso alilikpo la me gblɔ bena: „Amesia enye vinye, si nyemelɔ̃a nu egbɔ o, miɖo to eyama!“

english_verse: At once the disciples looked around, but they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye enumake, esi wole ŋku tsam godoo la, womegakpɔ amea ɖeke o, negbe Yesu ɖeka koe le wo gbɔ.

english_verse: So they kept it to themselves. But they wondered what he meant by the words “raised from death.”
translation_verse: Eye wodzra nya la ɖo, eye wobia le wo nɔewo dome bena: Nukae nye tsitretsitsi tso ame kukuwo dome la mahã?

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say that Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Eye wobiae gblɔ bena: Aleke wòle be, farisitɔwo kple agbalẽfialawo gblɔ bena: Ele na Eliya be, wòava gbãgbiagbã mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered: Elijah certainly will come to get everything ready. But don't the Scriptures also say that the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected?
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ na wo bena: Eliya gbɔna gbãgbiagbã, eye wòaɖo nuwo katã ɖo; eye aleke woŋlɔ ɖi le Amegbetɔvi la ŋuti bena, akpe fu geɖe, eye woado vloe mahã?

english_verse: When Jesus and his three disciples came back down, they saw a large crowd around the other disciples. The teachers of the Law of Moses were arguing with them.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ la, ekpɔ ameha gãa ɖe ƒo xlã wo, eye agbalẽfialawo le nu sẽm kpli wo.

english_verse: They brought the boy, and as soon as the demon saw Jesus, it made the boy shake all over. He fell down and began rolling on the ground and foaming at the mouth.
translation_verse: Eye wokplɔe va egbɔ; esi wòkpɔe la, enumake gbɔgbɔ la nyamae, eye wòtsyɔ kplo hele dablibɛ ƒom le futukpɔ ɖem.

english_verse: “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me.” For or against Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Amesi ke laxɔ ɖevi siawo dometɔ ɖeka le nye ŋkɔ dzi la, nyee wòxɔ, eye amesi ke laxɔm la, menye nye wòxɔ o, ke boŋ amesi dom lae.

english_verse: The crowd was really surprised to see Jesus, and everyone hurried over to greet him.
translation_verse: Eye enumake, esi ameha la katã kpɔe la, dzidzi ƒo wo ŋuta, eye wosi du yi egbɔ hedo gbe nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What are you arguing about?”
translation_verse: Eye wòbia wo bena: Nuka miele nu sẽm kpli wo?
