english_verse: Jesus said, “You people don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
translation_verse: Eye wòdo eŋu na wo gblɔ bena: O, dzidzime maxɔse! Ɣekaɣi mana anyi kpli mi ase ɖo? Eye ɣekaɣi mado dzi ahe mi ase do mahã? Mikplɔe va gbɔnye!

english_verse: Jesus asked the boy's father, “How long has he been like this?” The man answered, “Ever since he was a child.
translation_verse: Eye wòbia fofoa bena: Ɣekaɣi nusia va edzi mahã? Eye wòbena: Tso keke eƒe ɖevime kee.

english_verse: At once the boy's father shouted, “I do have faith! Please help me to have even more.”
translation_verse: Enumake ɖevia fofo do ɣli gblɔ bena: Mexɔe se, xɔ na nye maxɔse la!

english_verse: When Jesus saw that a crowd was gathering fast, he spoke sternly to the evil spirit that had kept the boy from speaking or hearing. He said, “I order you to come out of the boy! Don't ever bother him again.”
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu kpɔ bena, ameha la le ɖu ƒum gbɔna la, ewo ɖe gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ la ta gblɔ bena: Wò gbɔgbɔ maƒonu kple tokunɔ, mede se na wò, do go le eme, eye tso esia dzi la megayi ɖe eme o!

english_verse: The spirit screamed and made the boy shake all over. Then it went out of him. The boy looked dead, and almost everyone said he was.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo go kple ɣlidodo hele enyamam ŋutɔ, eye wòzu abe ɖe woku ene; ale bena ame geɖewo gblɔ bena: Eku.

english_verse: But Jesus took hold of his hand and helped him stand up.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu lé eƒe alɔnu hekɔe ɖe dzi, eye wòtsi tre.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Only prayer can force out this kind of demon.” Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Esia ƒomevi la mate ŋu ado go to naneke me o, negbe to gbedodoɖa kple nutsitsidɔ me ko. Yesu gblɔ nya le eƒe fukpekpe ŋu zi evelia.

english_verse: Jesus left with his disciples and started through Galilee. He did not want anyone to know about it,
translation_verse: Eye esi wodze le afima la, wotso Galilea me yi, eye melɔ̃ bena, amea ɖeke nanya ye o.

english_verse: because he was teaching the disciples that the Son of Man would be handed over to people who would kill him. But three days later he would rise to life.
translation_verse: Elabena efia nu eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Woade Amegbetɔvi la asi na amewo, eye woawui, eye ne wowui la, agatsi tre le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe.

english_verse: The disciples did not understand what Jesus meant, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke woawo la womese nya sia gɔme o, eye wova le ebiabia ŋuti. Ameka ƒo ta le mawufiaɖuƒe la me? Le nuɖiaɖianana ŋuti.

english_verse: The worms there never die, and the fire never stops burning.
translation_verse: afisi woƒe nyẽ mekuna le o, eye dzo la hã metsina le o.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to his home in Capernaum. After they were inside the house, Jesus asked them, “What were you arguing about along the way?”
translation_verse: Eye wòva Kapernaum. Esi wòva aƒe me la, ebia wo bena: Nuka miele ɖi kem le mia nɔewo dome le mɔ dzi mahã?

english_verse: They had been arguing about which one of them was the greatest, and so they did not answer.
translation_verse: Ke wozi kpi; elabena wole nya ʋlim le wo nɔewo dome le mɔ dzi bena: Amekae nye gãtɔ mahã?

english_verse: After Jesus sat down and told the twelve disciples to gather around him, he said, “If you want the place of honor, you must become a slave and serve others!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòbɔbɔ na anyi la, eya ame wuieveawo, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ne amea ɖe ɖi bena, yeanye gbãtɔ la, nanye wo katã ƒe mlɔetɔ kple wo katã ƒe subɔla.

english_verse: Salt is good. But if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made salty again? Have salt among you and live at peace with each other.
translation_verse: Dze la nu nyui wònye; ke ne dze bu eƒe vivi la, nuka tsɔ ge míala ado vivii mahã? Mina dze naɖo mi, eye ŋutifafa nanɔ mia dome.

english_verse: John said, “Teacher, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But he wasn't one of us, and we told him to stop.”
translation_verse: Yohanes gblɔ ne bena: Nufiala, miekpɔ amea ɖe, si le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo nyãm le go dom le wò ŋkɔ la dzi, eye miegbe nɛ, elabena mele mía yome o.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: Don't stop him! No one who works miracles in my name will soon turn and say something bad about me.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ bena: Migagbe ne o! Elabena amea ɖeke meli, si awɔ ŋusẽdɔ le nye ŋkɔ la dzi, eye wòate ŋu agble nya vɔ̃ enumake ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Anyone who isn't against us is for us.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke meto vo ɖe mia ŋuti o la, eya le mía dzi.

english_verse: And anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name, just because you belong to me, will surely be rewarded. Temptations To Sin (Matthew
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke ana tsi kplu ɖeka mi be, miano le nye ŋkɔ me, esi wònye Kristo tɔ míenye ŋuti la, vava mele egblɔm na mi bena: Eƒe fetu la mele eŋu tsi ge o.

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks.
translation_verse: Ke amesi ke laɖia ɖevi sue, siwo xɔa dzinye sena, dometɔ ɖeka nu la, enyo nɛ wu bena, woatso té atsi ɖe ka ne, eye woatsɔe aƒu gbe ɖe ƒu me.

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, get rid of it. You would be better off to go into God's kingdom with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Eye ne wò ŋku ɖia nu wò la, hoe le eme; enyo na wò bena, nayi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la me kple ŋku ɖeka, wu esi ŋku eve nanɔe na wò, eye woatsɔ wò aƒu gbe ɖe dzomavɔʋe la me,

english_verse: After Jesus left, he went to Judea and then on to the other side of the Jordan River. Once again large crowds came to him, and as usual, he taught them.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdzo le afima la, eva Yudea-nutoawo me kple Yordan godo, eye amehawo gava ƒo ƒu ɖe egbɔ, eye abe alesi wònɔa wɔwɔm ene la, egafia nuwo.

english_verse: A woman who divorces her husband and marries again is also unfaithful.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: eye ne nyanu agbe srɔ̃a, eye wòaɖe bubu la, ewo ahasi. Yesu yra ɖeviwo.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. So they came up to him and asked if it was right for a man to divorce his wife.
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo va egbɔ, eye wobiae hele etem kpɔ bena: Alo woɖe ma na ŋutsu bena, wòaɖe asi le srɔ̃a ŋu mahã?

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What does the Law of Moses say about this?”
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo ŋu na wo bena: Aleke Mose de see na mi mahã?

english_verse: They answered, “Moses allows a man to write out divorce papers and send his wife away.”
translation_verse: Ke wogblɔ bena: Mose ɖe mɔ bena, woaŋlɔ srɔ̃gbegbalẽ, eye woaɖe asi le eŋu.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Moses gave you this law because you are so heartless.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Le miaƒe dzimesesẽ ŋuti woŋlɔ se sia ɖi na mi ɖo.

english_verse: But in the beginning God made a man and a woman.
translation_verse: Tso nuwɔwɔ ƒe gɔmedzedzea me ke la atsu kple asi wòwɔ wòe.

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married.
translation_verse: Le esia ta ame agblẽ fofoa kple dadaa ɖi, eye wòalé ɖe srɔ̃nyɔnua ŋuti,

english_verse: He becomes like one person with his wife. Then they are no longer two people, but one.
translation_verse: eye wo kpakple eve woanye ŋutilã ɖeka, ale bena tso esia dzi yina la womeganye ame eve o, negbe ŋutilã ɖeka ko.

english_verse: And no one should separate a couple that God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Azɔ nusi ke Mawu bla ɖekae la, ame nagamã me o.

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were back in the house, they asked him about what he had said.
translation_verse: Eye le aƒea me la nusrɔ̃lawo gabia le nya sia ŋuti.

english_verse: He told them, “A man who divorces his wife and marries someone else is unfaithful to his wife.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Amesi ke aɖe asi le srɔ̃a ŋuti, eye wòaɖe bubu la, ewo ahasi ɖe eyama ŋuti;

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus so he could bless them by placing his hands on them. But his disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ ɖevi suewo va egbɔ be, woada asi ɖe wo dzi; ke nusrɔ̃lawo blu ɖe amesiwo tso wo ve la ta.

english_verse: I promise you that you cannot get into God's kingdom, unless you accept it the way a child does.”
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesi ke mexɔ mawufiaɖuƒe la abe ɖevi ene o la, mele eme yi ge o.

english_verse: When Jesus saw this, he became angry and said, “Let the children come to me! Don't try to stop them. People who are like these little children belong to the kingdom of God.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu kpɔe la, menyo eŋu o, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mina ɖeviwo nava gbɔnye, eye migaxe mɔ na wo o; elabena nenem mewo tɔ enye mawufiaɖuƒe la.

english_verse: Jesus looked closely at the man. He liked him and said, “There's one thing you still need to do. Go sell everything you own. Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come with me.”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu kpɔe du, eye wòlɔ̃e, gblɔ ne bena: Nu ɖeka susɔ na wò; heyi ɖadzra nusiwo le asiwò, eye natsɔ wo ana ame dahewo; ekema kesinɔnu anɔ dziƒo na wò, eye nava anɔ yonyeme, eye natsɔ atitsoga la.

english_verse: When the man heard Jesus say this, he went away gloomy and sad because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Ke eto mo le nya sia ŋuti hedzo kple nuxaxa; elabena nu geɖewo le esi.

english_verse: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “It's hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu tsa ŋku godoo gblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Aleke gbegbe wosẽ na amesiwo si kesinɔnuwo le la, bena wòayi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la mee!

english_verse: The disciples were shocked to hear this. So Jesus told them again, “It's terribly hard to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Ke nusrɔ̃lawo tsi yaa le eƒe nyawo ŋuti. Eye Yesu gaxɔ edzi gblɔ na wo bena: Viwo, esẽ bena, amesiwo ɖoa dzi ɖe kesinɔnuwo ŋuti la, nayi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la me!

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ele bɔbɔe na kposɔ be, wòato abi ƒe vo me, wu alesi kesinɔtɔwo nayi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la mee.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were even more amazed. They asked each other, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo wo ŋuta, eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Ekema ameka gɔ̃e ate ŋu akpɔ ɖeɖe mahã?

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu kpɔ wo du gblɔ bena: Amegbetɔwo gbɔ la womate ŋu awɔ esia o; gake Mawu gbɔ la woate ŋui; elabena woate ŋu awɔ nusianu le Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: The disciples were confused as Jesus led them toward Jerusalem, and his other followers were afraid. Once again, Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and told them what was going to happen to him. He said:
translation_verse: Eye esi wole mo dzi yina Yerusalem la, Yesu dze wo ŋgɔ, eye woƒe mo wɔ yaa, ke amesiwo dze eyome la, wovɔ̃. Eye esi wògayɔ ame wuieveawo va egbɔe la, ede asi nusiwo le edzi va ge la, gbɔgblɔ me na wo bena:

english_verse: We are now on our way to Jerusalem where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses. They will sentence him to death and hand him over to foreigners,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mieyina Yerusalem, eye woade Amegbetɔvi la asi na nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo, eye woatso kufia nɛ, eye woatsɔe ade asi na trɔ̃subɔlawo;

english_verse: and they answered, “When you come into your glory, please let one of us sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Ke wogblɔ nɛ bena: Na bena, mia dome ame ɖeka nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe wò nuɖusi me, eye ɖeka hã nanɔ wò mia me le wò ŋutikɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: Jesus told them, “You don't really know what you're asking! Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from or be baptized as I must be baptized?”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Mienya nusi biam miele o. Alo miate ŋu ano kplu, si no ge nye ŋutɔ malaa? Alo woade mawutsi ta na mi kple mawutsi, si woatsɔ ade ta na nye ŋuta mahã?

english_verse: “Yes, we are!” James and John answered. Then Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from the cup from which I must drink. And you will be baptized just as I must!
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Miate ŋui. Ke Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Kplu, si ke nye ŋutɔ miano la, mianoe, eye mawutsi, si woatsɔ aɖe ta na nye ŋuta la, woatsɔ ade ta na mi;

english_verse: But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for God to decide.”
translation_verse: ke anyinɔnɔ ɖe nye nuɖusi kple mia me la, menye tɔnye be, mana o, negbe amesiwo wodzrɛ ɖo ɖi na la ko.

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with James and John.
translation_verse: Eye esi ame ewo la see la, ede asi dɔmeveve me na wo le Yakobo kple Yohanes ŋuti.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know that those foreigners who call themselves kings like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over the people they rule.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ya wo va egbɔ gblɔ na wo bena; Mienyae bena, amesiwo ŋu bubu le bena, woaɖu dukɔwo dzi la, woawoe ɖua aƒetɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye woƒe amegãwo kpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be everyone's slave.
translation_verse: eye amesi ke di bena, yeanye gbãtɔ le mia dome la, nanye amewo katã ƒe dɔla.

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Blind Bartimaeus (Matthew
translation_verse: Elabena Amegbetɔvi la hã menye ɖe wòva bena, woasubɔ ye o; ke boŋ bena, yeasubɔ, eye bena, yeatsɔ yeƒe agbe la ana le ame geɖewo ƒe xɔxɔ ta. Bartimeo.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to Jericho. And as they were leaving, they were followed by a large crowd. A blind beggar by the name of Bartimaeus son of Timaeus was sitting beside the road.
translation_verse: Eye wova Yerixo; eye esi wòdo go tso Yerixo kple eƒe nusiawo kple ameha gã la, Bartimeo, Timeo vi, si nye nubiala ŋkuagbãtɔ la, bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe mɔ to.

english_verse: When he heard that it was Jesus from Nazareth, he shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wose bena, Yesu, Nazaretetɔ lae la, eɖe asi ɣlidodo me le gbɔgblɔm bena: Yesu, Dawid vi la, kpɔ ye nublanui!

english_verse: Many people told the man to stop, but he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Eye ame geɖewo blu ɖe eta, bena wòazi ɖoɖoe; ke egado ɣli geɖe wu tsãtɔ bena: Dawid vi la, kpɔ ye nublanui!

english_verse: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him over!” They called out to the blind man and said, “Don't be afraid! Come on! He is calling for you.”
translation_verse: Tete Yesu tɔ ɖe tsitre gblɔ bena: Miyɔe ɖa. Eye esi woyɔ ŋkuagbãtɔ la la, wogblɔ nɛ bena: Na wò dzi nadze eme! Tsi tre, ele yɔwòm.

english_verse: The man threw off his coat as he jumped up and ran to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòɖe eƒe awu ƒu gbe la, etso hiã va Yesu gbɔ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man answered, “Master, I want to see!”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Nuka dim nèle be, mawɔ na wòa? Eye ŋkuagbãtɔ la gblɔ nɛ bena: Rabuni, bena makpɔ nu.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “You may go. Your eyes are healed because of your faith.” At once the man could see, and he went down the road with Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Heyi, wò xɔse la ɖe wò! Eye enumake la wòkpɔ nu, eye wòdze eyome le mɔ la dzi.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone to Jerusalem, he went into the temple and looked around at everything. But since it was already late in the day, he went back to Bethany with the twelve disciples. Jesus Puts a Curse on a Fig Tree (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wòyi Yerusalem ɖe mawuƒe la me, eye esi wòtsa ŋku nuwo katã godoo, eye fiẽsi le ɖoɖom la, eyi ɖe Betania kple ame wuieve la.

english_verse: That evening, Jesus and the disciples went outside the city. A Lesson from the Fig Tree (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye ne fiẽsi ɖo la, edoa go le dua me.

english_verse: They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ŋusẽ ka nètso wɔ esiawoe; alo ameka tsɔ ŋusẽ sia na wò be, nawɔ esiawoe mahã?

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, say, ‘The Lord needs it and will soon bring it back.’ ”
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe lagblɔ na mi bena: Nukaŋuti miele esia wɔm mahã la, migblɔ be: Aƒetɔ la le ehiãm, eye enumake aɖoe ɖe afisia.

english_verse: The disciples left and found the donkey tied near a door that faced the street. While they were untying it,
translation_verse: Tete wodzo yi, eye wokpɔ tedzivi la, wode kae ɖe agbo la nu le xexe le mɔ to, eye wotui.

english_verse: some of the people standing there asked, “Why are you untying the donkey?”
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo le tsitre ɖe afima la, dometɔa ɖewo bia wo bena: Nuka wɔ, eye miele tedzivi la tum mahã?

english_verse: They told them what Jesus had said, and the people let them take it.
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ na wo, abe alesi Yesu gblɔ la ene; eye woɖe mɔ le eŋu na wo.

english_verse: The disciples led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back, and Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Tete wokplɔ tedzivi la va Yesu gbɔ, eye wotsɔ woƒe avɔwo ɖo edzi; eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ edzi.

english_verse: In front of Jesus and behind him, people went along shouting, “Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo le eŋgɔ kple esiwo le eyome la, do ɣli gblɔ bena: Hosana! Woayra amesi gbɔna le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔa me.

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses heard what Jesus said, and they started looking for a way to kill him. They were afraid of him, because the crowds were completely amazed at his teaching.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo see, eye wodi, alesi woawɔ awui, elabena wovɔ̃e; elabena kuvia ɖo ameha blibo la katã le eƒe nufiafia la ŋuti.

english_verse: So Jesus said to the tree, “Never again will anyone eat fruit from this tree!” The disciples heard him say this. Jesus in the Temple (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wòde asi gbɔgblɔ me nɛ bena; Tso esia dzi yina la amea ɖeke maɖu wò kutsetsea ɖeke o halase tegbetegbe. Eye eƒe nusiawo see.

english_verse: Then he taught the people and said, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be called a place of worship for all nations.’ But you have made it a place where robbers hide!”
translation_verse: Eye wòfia nu gblɔ na wo bena: Alo womeŋlɔ ɖi bena: Woayɔ nye aƒe la be gbedoxɔ na dukɔwo katã oa? Ke miawo la mietsɔe wɔ adzodalawo ƒe ɖoe.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples: Have faith in God!
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xa dzi gblɔ na wo bena: Mawu dzi xɔse nenɔ mia si!

english_verse: After Jesus and his disciples reached Jerusalem, he went into the temple and began chasing out everyone who was selling and buying. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and the benches of those who were selling doves.
translation_verse: Eye wova Yerusalem; eye esi wòyi ɖe mawuƒe la me la, ede asi amesiwo le nu dzram kple amesiwo le nu ƒlem le mawuƒe la me la, nyanyã me do goe, eye wòmũ gaɖuɖɔlawo ƒe kplɔ̃wo kple amesiwo le ahɔ̃newo dzram la, ƒe zikpuiwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Jesus would not let anyone carry things through the temple.
translation_verse: Eye meɖe mɔ bena, amea ɖeke netso goe ato mawuƒe la me o.

english_verse: Whenever you stand up to pray, you must forgive what others have done to you. Then your Father in heaven will forgive your sins. A Question about Jesus' Authority (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke ne mietsɔe ke o la, ekema mia Fofo, si le dziƒowo la, matsɔ miaƒe vodadawo hã ake mi o. Yesu ʋu eƒe ŋusẽ ta.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to Jerusalem. And as he was walking through the temple, the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses came over to him.
translation_verse: Eye wogava Yerusalem; eye esi wòle tsatsam le mawuƒe la me la, nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo kple dumegãwo va egbɔ;

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I have just one question to ask you. If you answer it, I will tell you where I got the right to do these things.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye hã mabia nya ɖeka mi, ne mieɖo eŋu nam la, nye hã magblɔ ŋusẽ, si metsɔ wɔ esiawoe la, na mi.

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?”
translation_verse: Yohanes ƒe mawutsidedetaname la ɖe, dziƒo wòtso loo, alo amewo gbɔ wòtso mahã? Miɖo eŋu nam!

english_verse: They thought it over and said to each other, “We can't say that God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Eye wòke ɖi le wo nɔewo dome bena: Ne míegblɔ bena: Dziƒo wòtso la, agble bena: Nukaŋuti miexɔ edzi se o mahã?

english_verse: On the other hand, these people think that John was a prophet. So we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.” They were afraid of the crowd
translation_verse: Alo ɖe miagblɔ bena: Amewo gbɔ wotsoa? — Woyɔ dukɔ la; elabena ameawo katã bua Yohanes bena, nyagblɔɖila ŋutɔŋutɔ wònye.

english_verse: and told Jesus, “We don't know.” Jesus replied, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.”
translation_verse: Eye woxɔ edzi gblɔ na Yesu bena: Míenyae o. Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Ekema nye hã nyemagblɔ ŋusẽ, si metsɔ wɔ esiawoe la, na mi o.

english_verse: It is also true that we must love God with all our heart, mind, and strength, and that we must love others as much as we love ourselves. These commandments are more important than all the sacrifices and offerings that we could possibly make.”
translation_verse: eye be woalɔ̃e kple dzi blibo kple gɔmesese blibo kple luʋɔ blibo kple ŋusẽ blibo, eye be woalɔ̃ ame havi abe ame ŋutɔ ɖokui ene la, le wu numemewo kple vɔsasawo katã.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What do you think the owner of the vineyard will do? He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard.
translation_verse: Azã nuka weingble la ƒe aƒetɔ awɔ mahã? Ava, eye woatsrɔ̃ agbledelawo, eye wòatsɔ weingble la aɖe asi na ame bubuwo.

english_verse: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: Nufiala, Mose ŋlɔ ɖi na mi bena: Ne amea ɖe nɔviŋutsu ku, eye wògblẽ srɔ̃a ɖi, eye viwo mele esi o la, nɔvia naɖe srɔ̃a, eye wòado ƒome ɖi na nɔvia.

english_verse: When it was harvest time, he sent a servant to get his share of the grapes.
translation_verse: Eye esi ɣeyiɣia ɖo la, edo dɔla ɖo ɖe agbleŋlɔlawo gbɔ bena, yeaxɔ agble la me kutsetsea ɖewo tso eŋlɔlawo si me.

english_verse: The renters grabbed the servant, beat him up, and sent him away without a thing.
translation_verse: Eye wòlée, eye woƒoe, eye woɖoe ɖa asi ƒuƒlu.

english_verse: Then the man sent another servant, and they killed him. He kept sending servant after servant. They beat some of them and killed some.
translation_verse: Eye wògadɔ bubu ɖa; eye wowu eya kple ame bubu geɖewo, eye woƒo ɖewo, eye wowu ɖewo.

english_verse: The owner had a son he loved very much. Finally, he sent his son to the renters because he thought they would respect him.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi vi ɖeka, si melɔ̃a nu egbɔ o la, gale esi la, mlɔeba la edɔ eya hã ɖo ɖe wo gbɔ gblɔ bena: Wòasi vinyeŋutsuvi la ɖa.

english_verse: But they said to themselves, “Someday he will own this vineyard. Let's kill him! That way we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Tete agbledela mawo gblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Esiae nye domenyila la, miva, ne miawui, eye domenyinyi la nazu mia to.

english_verse: So they grabbed the owner's son, killed him, and threw his body out of the vineyard.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòlée la, wowui, eye wokɔe ƒu gbe ɖe weingble la xa.

english_verse: This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’ ”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gbɔ esia tso, eye wònye nukunu le míaƒe ŋkuwo me“ o mahã?

english_verse: The leaders knew that Jesus was really talking about them, and they wanted to arrest him. But because they were afraid of the crowd, they let him alone and left. Paying Taxes (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wodi bena, yewoalée, ke wovɔ̃ ameha la; elabena wonyae bena, yewo ŋu wòdo lo sia ɖo; eye wogblẽe ɖi hedzo. Nudzɔdzɔ na kaisaro.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were up to, and he said, “Why are you trying to test me? Show me a coin!”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòdze si woƒe alakpadada la, egblɔ na wo bena: Nuka miele teyem kpɔ mahã? Mitsɔ denario la vɛ, ne makpɔ!

english_verse: You surely know about people being raised to life. You know that in the story about Moses and the burning bush, God said, “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
translation_verse: Ke le ame kukuwo gome, bena woatsi tre la, ɖe miexlẽ le Mose ƒe agbalẽ la me, alesi Mawu ƒo nu nɛ le ŋuve la me bena: „Nyee nye Abraham ƒe Mawu kple Isak ƒe Mawu kpakple Yakob ƒe Mawu“ la o mahã?

english_verse: The Pharisees got together with Herod's followers. Then they sent some men to trick Jesus into saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Eye woɖo farisitɔwo kple Herodiatɔwo dome amea ɖewo ɖo ɖe egbɔ, bena ne woalée le nya me.

english_verse: They went to him and said, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are. And you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. Tell us, should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not?”
translation_verse: Eye esi wova la, wobiae bena: Nufiala, míenyae bena, nyateƒetɔ nènye, eye amea ɖeke ƒe nya meɖia wò o; elabena mèkpɔa ame ŋku me o; hafi boŋ nèle Mawu ƒe mɔ fiãm le nyateƒe nu. Woɖe mɔ bena, woana nudzodzo kaisaro loo, alo womeɖe mɔ oa? Ɖe miana loo, alo miana o mahã?

english_verse: They brought him a silver coin, and he asked, “Whose picture and name are on it?” “The Emperor's,” they answered.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔe vɛ. Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ameka ƒe tata kple ŋɔŋlɔ enye sia mahã? Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Kaisaro tɔe.

english_verse: Then Jesus told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.” The men were amazed at Jesus. Life in the Future World (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Nusi nye kaisaro ta la, mitsɔe na kaisaro, eye nusi nye Mawu tɔ la, na Mawu. Eye woƒe mo wɔ yaa ŋutɔ le eŋuti. Yesu ƒo nu le ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi ŋuti.

english_verse: He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living. You Sadducees are all wrong. The Most Important Commandment (Matthew
translation_verse: Mawu menye ame kukuwo ƒe Mawu wònye o; ke boŋ ame gbagbewo tae; mietra ŋutɔ! Yesu ƒo nu le se lolotɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: But they cheat widows out of their homes and pray long prayers just to show off. They will be punished most of all. A Widow's Offering (Luke
translation_verse: amesiwo mia ahosiwo ƒe aƒewo, eye wodaa alakpa nɔa gbe didiwo dom ɖa; amesiawo ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le sesẽ ge awu. Ahosi la ƒe nudzɔdzɔ.

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Eye zadukitɔwo, amesiwo gblɔna bena, tsitretsitsi meli o la, hã va egbɔ, eye wobiae bena:

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Alo ɖe menye esia ta míeɖa ƒu, elabena mienyã ŋɔŋlɔawo kple Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ la o mahã?

english_verse: When Jesus saw that the man had given a sensible answer, he told him, “You are not far from God's kingdom.” After this, no one dared ask Jesus any more questions. About David's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kpɔ bena, eɖo ŋu na ye nunyatɔe la, egblɔ nɛ bena: Wò la mèle adzɔge tso mawufiaɖuƒe la gbɔ o. Tso esia dzi la amea ɖeke medo dzi bia nyaa ɖekee o. Kristo enye Dawid vi kple eƒe aƒetɔ.

english_verse: One of the teachers of the Law of Moses came up while Jesus and the Sadducees were arguing. When he heard Jesus give a good answer, he asked him, “What is the most important commandment?”
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfialawo dometɔ ɖeka va, amesi se woƒe nusesẽwɔwɔ la; esi wonyae bena, eɖo ŋu na wo nyuie la, ebiae bena: Seawo katã dome la kae nye gbãtɔ mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The most important one says: ‘People of Israel, you have only one Lord and God.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu bena: Gbãtɔ enye: Israel, ɖo to, Aƒetɔ, miaƒe Mawu la, Aƒetɔ ɖeka wònye.

english_verse: The second most important commandment says: ‘Love others as much as you love yourself.’ No other commandment is more important than these.”
translation_verse: Evelia nye esia bena: Nalɔ̃ hawòvi abe ɖokuiwò ene. Se bubua ɖeke meli, si lolo wu esiawo o.

english_verse: The man replied, “Teacher, you are certainly right to say there is only one God.
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfiala la gblɔ nɛ bena: Nufiala, ègblɔe nyuie le nyateƒe nu bena: Ɖeka eli, eye bubua ɖeke meli o, negbe eya ko;

english_verse: Jesus was sitting in the temple near the offering box and watching people put in their gifts. He noticed that many rich people were giving a lot of money.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi hedze ŋgɔ nudzɔɖaka la, ekpa alesi amewo le ga dam ɖe nudzɔɖaka la me; eye kesinɔtɔ geɖewo tsɔ geɖe da ɖe eme.

english_verse: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had. Now she doesn't have a cent to live on.
translation_verse: elabena wo katã wotsɔ woƒe agbɔsɔsɔ vivivo la ƒe ɖe da ɖe eme; ke eya la tso eƒe ahedada la me wòtsɔ nusiwo katã le esi na eƒe agbenɔnɔ la, da ɖe eme.

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he said, “How can the teachers of the Law of Moses say the Messiah will come from the family of King David?
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu le nu fiãm le mawuƒe la me la, exɔ dzi gblɔ bena: Aleke wɔ, eye agbalẽfialawo le gbɔgblɔm bena, Kristo la nye Dawid vi mahã?

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be his son?” The large crowd enjoyed listening to Jesus teach. Jesus Condemns the Pharisees and the Teachers of the Law of Moses (Matthew
translation_verse: Dawid ŋuta yɔe be Aƒetɔ, eye afika gɔ̃ wòtso wònye via mahã? Eye ameha gã la ɖo toe dzidzɔtɔe. Nuxɔxlɔ le agbalẽfialawo ŋuti.

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching, he said: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes and be greeted in the market.
translation_verse: Eye le eƒe nufiafia me la egblɔ bena: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi le agbalẽfialawo ŋuti, amesiwo lɔ̃a tsaɖiɖi le awu ʋlayawo me kple gbedoname le ablɔawo me

english_verse: They like the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.
translation_verse: kple nɔƒe gbãlɔwo nɔnɔ le ƒuƒoƒewo kple kplɔ̃tanɔnɔ le nuɖuƒewo;

english_verse: Finally, a poor widow came up and put in two coins worth only a few pennies.
translation_verse: Eye ahosi dahea ɖe va tsɔ lepta eve da ɖe eme, siwo ƒe home enye hoka eve.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples to gather around him. Then he said: I tell you that this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
translation_verse: Eye wòyɔ eƒe nusiawo va egbɔ gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena; Ahosi dahe sia ƒe nusi wòtsɔ da ɖe eme la, wu nusi ame siawo tsɔ da ɖe nudzɔɖaka la me;

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, look at these beautiful stones and wonderful buildings!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdo go tso mawuƒe la me la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ nɛ bena: Nuxala, kpɔ ale kpe siawo kple ale xɔtutu siawo ɖa!

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these huge buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Ele xɔtutu gã siawo kpɔm mahã? Womele kpe gblẽ ge ɖe kpe dzi, si womatu asii aƒu anyi o.

english_verse: Jesus answered: Watch out and don't let anyone fool you!
translation_verse: Eye Yesu de asi gbɔgbɔ me na wo bena: Mikpɔ nyuie, bena amea ɖeke nagaflu mi o.

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will use my name and fool many people.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo ava le nye ŋkɔa dzi agblɔ bena: Nyee nye si! Eye woaflu ame geɖewo.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives across from the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew came to him in private.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Amito la dzi hedze ŋgɔ mawuƒea la, Petro kple Yakobo kple Yohanes kpakple Andrea, woawo ɖeɖe biae bena:

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” where it should not be. Everyone who reads this must try to understand! If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: Ke gbesigbe miakpɔ aƒedo ƒe ŋunyɔnu, si nyagblɔɖila Daniel gblɔ ɖi la, wòanɔ tsitre ɖe afisi mele nɛ be, wòatsi tre ɖo o la — amesi le exlẽm la, nèse egɔme — ekema amesiwo le Yudea la, nasi ayi towo dzi;

english_verse: When you hear about wars and threats of wars, don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Ke ne miase aʋawo kple aʋaŋutiɣliwo la, migaɖi vo o, ele be, esia nava me tsã; gake nuwuwu la meɖo haɖe o.

english_verse: This will be the worst time of suffering since God created the world, and nothing this terrible will ever happen again.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋkeke mawo lanye xaxa, si tɔgbe meva kpɔ tso nuwɔwɔ, si Mawu wɔ la, ƒe gɔmedzedze vaseɖe egbegbe o, eye megale vava ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: They asked, “When will these things happen? What will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
translation_verse: Gblɔ ɣeyiɣi, si dzi nusiawo lava la, na mí, eye nuka lanye dzesi na ɣeyiɣi, si me nusiawo katã lawu nu mahã?

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. There will be earthquakes in many places, and people will starve to death. But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔ latsi tre ɖe dukɔ ŋuti, eye fiaɖuƒe ɖe fiaɖuƒe ŋuti, eye anyigbaʋuʋuwo lava teƒeteƒewo, eye dɔwuame lava; nusiawo nye fuɖuame ƒe gɔmedzedze.

english_verse: Be on your guard! You will be taken to courts and beaten with whips in their synagogues. And because of me, you will have to stand before rulers and kings to tell about your faith.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie; elabena woade mi asi na ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo, eye woaƒo mi le ƒuƒoƒewo; eye míatsi tre ɖe mɔ̃mefiawo kple fiawo ŋku me le tanye, be wòanye ɖaseɖiɖi na wo.

english_verse: But before the end comes, the good news must be preached to all nations.
translation_verse: Eye ele be, woaɖe gbe ƒã nyanyuie la afia dukɔwo katã gbãgbiagbã.

english_verse: When you are arrested, don't worry about what you will say. You will be given the right words when the time comes. But you will not really be the ones speaking. Your words will come from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Eye ne wokplɔ mi de asi la, migatsi dzimaɖi da ɖi ɖe nusi gblɔ ge miala ŋuti o; ke boŋ nusi woana mi le gaƒoƒo ma dzi la, eya miagblɔ; elabena menye miawoe nye amesiwo le nu ƒom o; ke boŋ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe lae.

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray each other and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: Eye nɔvi lade nɔvi ku me, eye fofo lade via asi, eye ɖeviwo latsi tre ɖe dzilawo ŋuti, eye woatsɔ wo ana woawui.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you keep on being faithful right to the end, you will be saved. The Horrible Thing (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye amewo katã wòalé fu mi le nye ŋkɔ la ŋuti; ke amesi ado dzi vaseɖe nuwuwu la, eya lakpɔ ɖeɖe.

english_verse: If you are on the roof of your house, don't go inside to get anything.
translation_verse: ke amesi le xɔta la, nagaɖi va anyi alo wòayi aɖatsɔ nane atso eƒe xɔ me o;

english_verse: If the Lord doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of his chosen and special ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Eye ne menye bena, ɖe Aƒetɔ la ɖe ŋkekeawo dzi o la, ŋutilãa ɖeke makpɔ ɖeɖe o; gake le ame tiatia, siwo wotia ŋuti la, eɖe ŋkekeawo dzi.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: eye amesi le abɔ me la, nagatrɔ ava tsɔ eƒe avɔ ayii o.

english_verse: It will be an awful time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Ke baba na amesiwo fu le wo ƒo kple amesiwo le notsi nam le ŋkeke mawo me!

english_verse: Pray that it won't happen in winter.
translation_verse: Ke mido gbe ɖa bena, miaƒe sisi nagadze vuvɔŋɔli dzi o.

english_verse: False messiahs and false prophets will come and work miracles and signs. They will even try to fool God's chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ke aʋatsokristowo kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖilawo latsi tre, eye woawɔ dzesi wo kple nukunuwo bena, ne woate ŋui la, ne woaflu ame tiatiawo hã.

english_verse: But be on your guard! That's why I am telling you these things now. When the Son of Man Appears (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke miawo la mikpɔ nyuie! Kpɔ ɖa, megblɔ nuwo katã ɖi na mi!

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know that the time has almost come.
translation_verse: nenema ke miawo hã, ne miekpɔ nusiawo le eme vam la, midze sii bena, egogo agbo la nu.

english_verse: The sky and the earth will not last forever, but my words will. No One Knows the Day or Time (Matthew
translation_verse: Dzi kple anyigba nu lava yi, ke nye nyawo nu mele yiyi ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: The stars will fall, and the powers in the sky will be shaken.”
translation_verse: ɣletiviwo lage tso dziƒo, eye dziƒowo ƒe ŋusẽwo aʋuʋu.

english_verse: Learn a lesson from a fig tree. When its branches sprout and start putting out leaves, you know summer is near.
translation_verse: Ke misrɔ̃ lododo la le gboti la ŋuti: Ne tsi ɖo eƒe alɔwo me, eye wòto aŋgbawo la, ekema midze sii bena, dzomeŋɔli le ɖoɖo ge;

english_verse: Then the Son of Man will be seen coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
translation_verse: Eye ekema woakpɔ Amegbetɔvi la le alilikpowo me gbɔna kple ŋusẽ kpakple ŋutikɔkɔe geɖe.

english_verse: He will send his angels to gather his chosen ones from all over the earth. A Lesson from a Fig Tree (Matthew
translation_verse: Tete wòadɔ eƒe dɔlawo ɖa, eye woaƒo ame tiatiawo nu ƒu tso ya eneawo dzi, tso anyigba seƒe vaseɖe dziƒo seƒe.

english_verse: No one knows the day or the time. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: Ke le ŋkeke ma alo gaƒoƒo ma ŋuti la amea ɖeke menyae o, mawudɔla, siwo le dziƒo, hã menyae o, Vi la ŋutɔ hã menyae o, negbe Fofo la ko.

english_verse: So be alert! You don't know when the master of the house will come back. It could be in the evening or at midnight or before dawn or in the morning.
translation_verse: Azɔ la minɔ ŋudzɔ. Elabena mienya ɣekaɣi dzi Aƒetɔ la le vava ge o, eɖanye fiẽ alo zã titina alo koklo kuatɔ alo ŋdi o,

english_verse: So watch out and be ready! You don't know when the time will come.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie, eye minɔ ŋudzɔ; elabena mienya ɣekaɣi azãgbe la le edzi su ge o.

english_verse: You can be sure that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all this happens.
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Dzidzime sia nu mele yiyi ge, vaseɖe esime nusiawo katã, nava ve me o.

english_verse: But if he comes suddenly, don't let him find you asleep.
translation_verse: bena ne eƒe vava ɖi ɖe mi la, ne megakpɔ mi le alɔ̃ me o.

english_verse: It is like what happens when a man goes away for a while and places his servants in charge of everything. He tells each of them what to do, and he orders the guard to keep alert.
translation_verse: Ele abe amea ɖe, si yi nugbe, egblẽ eƒe aƒe eɖi, eye wòna ŋusẽ eƒe dɔlawo, amesiame xɔ eƒe dɔwɔwɔ, eye wòde se na xɔnuvi la bena, wòanɔ ŋudzɔ la ene.

english_verse: I tell everyone just what I have told you. Be alert!
translation_verse: Ke nusi gblɔm mele na mi la, mele egblɔm na amewo katã bena: Minɔ ŋudzɔ!

english_verse: They were saying, “We must not do it during the festival, because the people will riot.” At Bethany (Matthew
translation_verse: elabena wogblɔ bena: Menye ŋkekenyuie la dzi o, bena zi nagatɔ le dukɔ la dome o.

english_verse: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Teacher!” Then Judas kissed him,
translation_verse: Eye esi wova la, enumake wote ɖe eŋu gblɔ bena: Rabi! eye wògbugbɔ nu nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was led off to the high priest. Then the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses all met together.
translation_verse: Eye wokplɔ Yesu yi ɖe nunɔlagã la gbɔ, eye nunɔlagãwo kple amegãwo kpakple agbalẽfialawo katã ƒo ƒu ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: She has done all she could by pouring perfume on my body to prepare it for burial.
translation_verse: Ewo nusi wòate ŋui; edze ŋgɔgbe va si ami na nye ŋutilã la hena ɖiɖi.

english_verse: This made some of the guests angry, and they complained, “Why such a waste?
translation_verse: Ke eve dɔme na wo dometɔa ɖewo, eye wogblɔ bena: Amigbegblẽ sia gɔme ɖe?

english_verse: You may be sure that wherever the good news is told all over the world, people will remember what she has done. And they will tell others. Judas and the Chief Priests (Matthew
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Afisi ke woaɖe gbe ƒã nyanyuie la afia le, le xexe blibo la katã la, woaƒo nu le nusi nyanu sia wo la hã ŋuti hena ŋkuɖoɖo edzi.

english_verse: The two disciples went into the city and found everything just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃lawo dzo heyi, eye wova dua me, eye wokpɔe, abe alesi wògblɔ na wo la ene; eye wodzra ŋutitotolẽvi la ɖo.

english_verse: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve disciples. He went to the chief priests and offered to help them arrest Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye Yuda Iskariot, ame wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka la, tɔ edzi yi ɖe nunɔlagãwo gbɔ, bena yeade eyama asi na wo.

english_verse: The Son of Man will die, just as the Scriptures say. But it is going to be terrible for the one who betrays me. That man would be better off if he had never been born.” The Lord's Supper (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke Amegbetɔvi la le yiyim, abe alesi woŋlɔ di le eŋuti ene; gake baba na ame ma, si dzi woato ade Amegbetɔvi la asi! Enyo na ame ma bena, womegaxae dzi o.

english_verse: Jesus picked up a cup of wine and gave thanks to God. He gave it to his disciples, and they all drank some.
translation_verse: Eye wòtso kplu ɖe asi, eye esi wòda akpe le eta la, etsɔe na wo, eye wo katã wono le enu.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “This very night before a rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Mele egblom na wò bena: Egbe ƒe zã sia me ke, hafi koklo naku atɔ zi eve la, agbe nu zi etɔ̃ le gbɔnye.

english_verse: He answered, “It is one of you twelve men who is eating from this dish with me.
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ na wo bena: Enye ame wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka, amesi ƒe asi le agba me dem kplim.

english_verse: But Peter was so sure of himself that he said, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you!” All the others said the same thing. Jesus Prays (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wòƒo nu kple kakaɖedzi wu bena: Ne anɔ nam be, maku kpli wò hã la, nyemele nu gbe ge le gbewo akpɔ o. Nenema ke wo katã hã wogblɔ. Yesu ʋli le Getsemane.

english_verse: told them, “I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nye luʋɔ le nu xam kakaka vaseɖe ku me; minɔ afisia, eye minɔ ŋudzɔ!

english_verse: Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt down on the ground and prayed, “Father, if it is possible, don't let this happen to me! Father, you can do anything. Don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
translation_verse: Eye wòbena: Aba, Fofo! Etea ŋu wɔa nuwo katã; tsɔ kplu sia yii le gbɔnye; gake menye nusi nye ŋutɔ melɔ̃ o, negbe nusi wò nèlɔ̃ ko.

english_verse: Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.”
translation_verse: Minɔ ŋudzɔ, eye mido gbe ɖa, bena miagadze tetekpɔ me o! Gbɔgbɔ la le lɔlɔ̃m, gake ŋutilã la gbɔdzɔ.

english_verse: But after I am raised to life, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.”
translation_verse: Gake ne metsi tre megbe la, madze mia ŋgɔ ayi Galilea.

english_verse: Peter spoke up, “Even if all the others reject you, I never will!”
translation_verse: Ke Petro gblɔ nɛ bena: Ne wo katã woakpe nuɖiaɖia hã la, menye nye o.

english_verse: and the men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
translation_verse: Ke woawo la wotsɔ woƒe asiwò ɖo edzi, eye wòlée.

english_verse: Jesus went back and prayed the same prayer.
translation_verse: Eye wògadzo yi ɖaɖo gbe ɖa, eye wògblɔ nya ma ke.

english_verse: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he told them, “Sit here while I pray.”
translation_verse: Eye wova ɖo teƒea ɖe, si ŋkɔ enye Getsemane; eye wògblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Mibɔbɔ nɔ afisia, vaseɖe esime mado gbe ɖa.

english_verse: Jesus took along Peter, James, and John. He was sad and troubled and
translation_verse: Eye wòɖe Petro, Yakobo kple Yohanes kpe ɖe eɖokui ŋuti, eye dzidzi ƒoe, eye wòde asi dzodzo me nyanyanya.

english_verse: When Jesus came back and found the disciples sleeping, he said to Simon Peter, “Are you asleep? Can't you stay awake for just one hour?
translation_verse: Eye wòva kpɔ wo wole alɔ̃ me, eye wògblɔ na Petro bena: Simon, alɔ̃ dɔm nèlea? Màte ŋu anɔ ŋudzɔ gaƒoƒo ɖeka oa?

english_verse: But when he returned to the disciples, he found them sleeping again. They simply could not keep their eyes open, and they did not know what to say.
translation_verse: Eye esi wògatrɔ va la, egakpɔ wo le alɔ̃ me; elabena woƒe ŋkuwo dzi wɔ dɔ̃, eye womenya nya, si woaɖo eŋu nɛ o.

english_verse: When Jesus returned to the disciples the third time, he said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough of this! The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.
translation_verse: Eye wòva zi etɔ̃lia gblɔ na wo bena: Miyi alɔ̃dɔdɔ dzi azɔ, eye migbɔ ɖe eme! Esɔ gbɔ, gaƒoƒo la ɖo vɔ! Kpɔ ɖa, woatsɔ Amegbetɔvi la ade nuvɔ̃wɔlawo si me.

english_verse: Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.” Jesus Is Arrested (Matthew
translation_verse: Mitsi tre, mina midzo! Kpɔ ɖa, amesi le yonyeme mɔ fiãm la, egogo! Yesu lẽle.

english_verse: Someone standing there pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo le tsitre de egbɔ la, dometɔ ɖeka ɖi yi heda nunɔlagã la ƒe dɔla, eye wòkpa to nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was still speaking, when Judas the betrayer came up. He was one of the twelve disciples, and a mob of men armed with swords and clubs were with him. They had been sent by the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Eye enumake esi wògale nuƒoƒoa dzi ko la, Yuda, ame wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka la, va do, eye ame geɖewo le eyome kple yiwo kpakple kpowo tso nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo kple amegãwo gbɔ.

english_verse: Judas had told them ahead of time, “Arrest the man I greet with a kiss. Tie him up tight and lead him away.”
translation_verse: Ke eyomemɔfiala ɖo dzesi ɖi na wo gblɔ bena: Amesi ke ƒe nu gbugbɔ ge mala la, eyae; milée, eye mikplɔe yi kɔ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the mob, “Why do you come with swords and clubs to arrest me like a criminal?
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xɔ edzi gblɔ na wo bena: Alesi wotsona de adzodala ŋuti la, nenema mieva lé ye ge kple yiwo kpakple kpowo.

english_verse: Day after day I was with you and taught in the temple, and you didn't arrest me. But what the Scriptures say must come true.”
translation_verse: Gbawotsyogbe menɔa mawuƒe la me kpli mi nɔa nu fiãm, ke mielém o; gake wowɔ esia, bena woawu ŋɔŋlɔawo nu.

english_verse: All of Jesus' disciples ran off and left him.
translation_verse: Eye wo katã wogblẽe di hesi.

english_verse: One of them was a young man who was wearing only a linen cloth. And when the men grabbed him,
translation_verse: Eye ɖekakpuia de, si ta aklala ko la, kplɔe do, eye wòlée;

english_verse: he left the cloth behind and ran away naked. Jesus Is Questioned by the Council (Matthew
translation_verse: ke egblẽ aklala la ɖi hesi dzo amama le wo gbɔ.

english_verse: Finally, some men stood up and lied about him. They said,
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖewo tsi tre, eye woɖi aʋatsoɖase ɖe eŋuti bena:

english_verse: Peter replied, “That isn't true! I don't know what you're talking about. I don't have any idea what you mean.” He went out to the gate, and a rooster crowed.
translation_verse: Ke esẽ nu gblɔ bena; Nyemenya alo se nya, si gblɔm nèle la gome o; eye wòdo go yi ɖe akpala la nu; tete koklo ku atɔ.

english_verse: Peter had followed at a distance, and when he reached the courtyard of the high priest's house, he sat down with the guards to warm himself beside a fire.
translation_verse: Eye Petro le eyome ʋĩ gbɔna vaseɖe nunɔlagã la ƒe mɔ̃ me, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ dɔlawo gbɔ le dzo ƒum. Ɖaseɖiɖi le Yesu ŋu kple eƒe fukpekpe le Kayafa ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: At once the high priest ripped his robe apart and shouted, “Why do we need more witnesses?
translation_verse: Tete nunɔlagã la dze eƒe awu ʋlaya la gblɔ bena: Ɖaseɖila kawoe gahiã mi mahã?

english_verse: This time Peter began to curse and swear, “I don't even know the man you're talking about!”
translation_verse: Ke ede asi fiƒoƒode kple atamkaka me bena: Nyemenya amesia, si ŋuti miele nu ƒom le la o.

english_verse: “We heard him say he would tear down this temple that we built. He also claimed that in three days he would build another one without any help.”
translation_verse: Míese wògblɔ bena: Magbã mawuxɔ sia, si wotsɔ asi wɔe la, eye ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la magatu bubu, si wometsɔ asi wɔe o.

english_verse: But even then they did not agree on what they said.
translation_verse: Eye ale woƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la hã mesɔ o.

english_verse: The high priest stood up in the council and asked Jesus, “Why don't you say something in your own defense? Don't you hear the charges they are making against you?”
translation_verse: Eye nunɔlagã la tsi tre ɖe wo titina, eye wòbia Yesu bena: Mèle nyaa ɖeke tso ge aɖo nya, si gblɔm amesiawo le ɖe ŋuwò la ŋu o mahã?

english_verse: But Jesus kept quiet and did not say a word. The high priest asked him another question, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the glorious God?”
translation_verse: Ke ezi kpi, eye meɖo nyaa ɖeke ŋu nɛ o. Nunɔlagã la gabiae gblɔ nɛ bena: Alo wòe nye Kristo, Mawu, si wokafuna la, ƒe Vi mahã?

english_verse: You heard him claim to be God! What is your decision?” They all agreed he should be put to death.
translation_verse: Miese eƒe busunya la, nuka susum miele mahã? Ke wo katã wobu fɔe be: Edze ku.

english_verse: Some of the people started spitting on Jesus. They blindfolded him, hit him with their fists, and said, “Tell us who hit you!” Then the guards took charge of Jesus and beat him. Peter Says He Doesn't Know Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖewo de asi taɖeɖe me ɖe eŋu, eye wotsyɔ nu mo nɛ, eye wotu kɔe, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena Fia amesi ƒo wò; eye dɔlawo ƒo tome nɛ. Petro gbe nu le Yesu gbɔ.

english_verse: The servant girl saw Peter again and said to the people standing there, “This man is one of them!”
translation_verse: Eye esi dɔlanyɔnu la gakpɔe la, egade asi gbɔgblɔ me na amesiwo le tsitre le afima la, bena: Amesia enye wo dometɔ ɖeka. Ke egasẽ nu.

english_verse: While Peter was still in the courtyard, a servant girl of the high priest came up
translation_verse: Eye esi Petro le mɔ̃ la me le anyigba la, nunɔlagã la ƒe nyɔnudɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka gbɔna,

english_verse: and saw Peter warming himself by the fire. She stared at him and said, “You were with Jesus from Nazareth!”
translation_verse: eye esi wòkpɔ Petro le dzo ƒum la, ekpɔe dũ hebena: Wò hã ena Yesu Nazaretetɔ la gbɔ kpɔ.

english_verse: “No, I'm not!” Peter replied. A little while later some of the people said to Peter, “You certainly are one of them. You're a Galilean!”
translation_verse: Eye emegbe ʋee la amesiwo le tsitre le afima la gagblɔ na Petro bena: Vavã wo dometɔ ɖeka nènye elabena Galileatɔ hã nènye.

english_verse: At once the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered that Jesus had told him, “Before a rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you don't know me.” So Peter started crying.
translation_verse: Eye enumake la koklo ku atɔ zi evelia. Eye Petro ɖo ŋku nya la dzi, alesi Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Hafi koklo naku atɔ zi eve la, agbe nu le gbɔnye zi etɔ̃. Eye wòƒu du do go, eye wòfa avi.

english_verse: Early the next morning the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met together with the whole Jewish council. They tied up Jesus and led him off to Pilate.
translation_verse: Eye enumake le ŋdikanya, esi nunɔlagãwo kple dumegãwo kple agbalẽfialawo kpakple ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo katã de adaŋu la, wòbia Yesu, eye wokplɔe yi ɖade asi na Pilato.

english_verse: But the chief priests told the crowd to ask Pilate to free Barabbas.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlagãwo ƒoe ɖe ameha la nu bena, wòaɖe asi le Baraba boŋ ŋuti na wo.

english_verse: Pilate asked, “But what crime has he done?” “Nail him to a cross!” they yelled even louder.
translation_verse: Eye Pilato gblɔ na wo bena: Nuvɔ̃ ka gɔ̃ wòwɔ mahã? Ke wogado ɣli sesĩe wu bena: Klãe ɖe ati ŋuti!

english_verse: But Jesus did not answer, and Pilate was amazed. The Death Sentence (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke Yesu megaɖo nyaa ɖeke ŋu o, ale bena Pilato ƒe mo wɔ yaa.

english_verse: They made fun of Jesus and shouted, “Hey, you king of the Jews!”
translation_verse: eye wode asi gbedodo me nɛ bena: Eme nefa na wò loo, Yudatɔwo ƒe fia!

english_verse: Then Pilate questioned him again, “Don't you have anything to say? Don't you hear what crimes they say you have done?”
translation_verse: Eye Pilato gabiae bena Mèle nyaa ɖeke ŋu ɖo ge o mahã? Kpɔ alesi wole nuwò tsom le nu geɖewo ŋuti ɖa!

english_verse: Pilate wanted to please the crowd, so he set Barabbas free. Then he ordered his soldiers to beat Jesus with a whip and nail him to a cross. Soldiers Make Fun of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye esi Pilato lɔ̃ bena, yeawu ameha la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, eɖe asi le Baraba ŋuti na wo, eye Yesu la, esi wòna woƒoe kple atam la, etsɔe de asi, bena woaklãe ɖe ati ŋuti.

english_verse: On it was a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, “This is the King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ eƒe nutsotso heɖo eƒe tagba bena: Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la.

english_verse: They yelled, “Nail him to a cross!”
translation_verse: Ke woawo gado ɣli bena: Klãe ɖe ati ŋuti!

english_verse: It was about nine o'clock in the morning when they nailed him to the cross.
translation_verse: Eye le gaƒoƒo etɔ̃lia dzi woklãe ɖe ati ŋuti.

english_verse: A Roman army officer was standing in front of Jesus. When the officer saw how Jesus died, he said, “This man really was the Son of God!”
translation_verse: Ke esi aʋafia, si le tsitre dze ŋgɔe la, kpɔ bena, etsɔ eƒe gbɔgbɔ la na ale la, egblɔ bena: Nyateƒe, nenem me sia enye Mawuvi.

english_verse: The soldiers led Jesus inside the courtyard of the fortress and called together the rest of the troops.
translation_verse: Ke asrafoawo kplɔe yi ɖe xɔ gã, si nye ʋɔnuɖrɔ̃ƒe la me, eye woyɔ asrafoha blibo la katã ƒo ƒu.

english_verse: During Passover, Pilate always freed one prisoner chosen by the people.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkekenyuie dzi la eɖea asi le gatɔ ɖeka ŋu na wo godoo, amesi ke wobiae.

english_verse: And at that time there was a prisoner named Barabbas. He and some others had been arrested for murder during a riot.
translation_verse: Ke gatɔ ɖeka li, si woyɔna be Baraba, hekpe ɖe amesiwo na zi to la ŋuti: amesiwo do hlɔ̃ le zitɔtɔ la me.

english_verse: The crowd now came and asked Pilate to set a prisoner free, just as he usually did.
translation_verse: Eye ameha la yi dzi de asi biabia me bena, newɔ na yewo, abe alesi wònɔa wɔwɔm tsã la ene.

english_verse: Pilate asked them, “Do you want me to free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ke Pilato ɖo eŋu na wo gblɔ bena: Ɖe miele didim bena, maɖe asi le Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la ŋuti na mi mahã?

english_verse: Pilate knew that the chief priests had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
translation_verse: Elabena edze sii bena, ŋuʋaʋã ŋutie nunɔlagãwo tsɔe de asi ɖo.

english_verse: Then Pilate asked the crowd, “What do you want me to do with this man you say is the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Eye Pilato gaxɔ edzi gblɔ na wo bena: Ekema nuka gɔ̃ miele ɖiɖim bena, mawo amesi mieyɔna be Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la mahã?

english_verse: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the purple robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Eye esi woɖu fewu le eŋuti vɔ la, woɖe awu dzi la le eŋu, eye wogatsɔ ye ŋutɔ ƒe awuwo do nɛ, eye wokplɔe do goe, bena woaklãe ɖe ati ŋuti.

english_verse: Simon from Cyrene happened to be coming in from a farm, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross. Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wozi Simon, Kirenetɔ, Aleksandro kple Rufo fofo, amesi tso agbleta va to wo ŋuti yina la dzi bena, wòatsɔ eƒe atitsoga la.

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said to each other, “He saved others, but he can't save himself.
translation_verse: Nenema ke nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo hã le fewu ɖum le wo nɔewo dome bena: Ame bubuwo la, eɖea wo, eye mate ŋu aɖe eɖokui o.

english_verse: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, and he called in the army officer to find out if Jesus had been dead very long.
translation_verse: Ke Pilato ƒe mo wo yaa be, eku xoxo; eye esi wòyɔ aʋafia la vɛ la, ebiae be, ɖe woku xoxo mahã?

english_verse: A man named Joseph from Arimathea was brave enough to ask Pilate for the body of Jesus. Joseph was a highly respected member of the Jewish council, and he was also waiting for God's kingdom to come.
translation_verse: Yosef tso Arimatia, si nye adaŋudela ŋkutatɔ, amesi ŋutɔ hã le mɔ kpɔm na Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la va, eye wòdo dzi yi ɖe Pilato gbɔ ɖabia Yesu ƒe kukua.

english_verse: The soldiers took Jesus to Golgotha, which means “Place of a Skull.”
translation_verse: Eye wokplɔe yi ɖe teƒe, si woyɔna be Golgata, si gome nye ametakoliƒe.

english_verse: They nailed Jesus to a cross and gambled to see who would get his clothes.
translation_verse: Eye woklãe ɖe ati ŋuti, eye wòmã eƒe awuwo, esi wodzidze nu ɖe wo dzi, bene woakpɔ nusi ke ɖesiaɖe laxɔ.

english_verse: People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and shouted, “Ha! So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days.
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo le eŋuti tom le yiyim la, do ɖiŋu nɛ hele ta ʋuʋum, eye wole gbɔgblɔm bena: Hoo na wò, wò amesi le mawuxɔ la gbãm, eye nègale etum le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la;

english_verse: If he is the Messiah, the king of Israel, let him come down from the cross! Then we will see and believe.” The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus. The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Kristo, Israel ƒe fia la, azɔ ɖi le atitsoga la ŋuti, bena míakpɔe, eye miaxɔ ase! Eye amesiwo woklã ɖe ati ŋuti kpe ɖe eŋuti la, woawo hã dzui.

english_verse: After the officer told him, Pilate let Joseph have Jesus' body.
translation_verse: Eye esi wosee tso aʋafia la nu la, etso ame kuku la na Yosef.

english_verse: About noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until around three o'clock.
translation_verse: Eye esi gaƒoƒo adelia ɖo edzi la, zãdokeli do ɖe anyigba blibo la katã dzi vaseɖe gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi.

english_verse: Then about that time Jesus shouted, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you deserted me?”
translation_verse: Eye le gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi Yesu do ɣli kple gbe sesĩe bena: Eli, eli, lama sabaxtani? Esi, ne woɖe egɔme la, enye: Nye Mawu, nye Mawu, nukaŋuti nègblẽm ɖi mahã?

english_verse: Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, “He is calling for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo le tsitre ɖe egbe la, dometɔa ɖewo, esi wosee la, wogblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, ele Eliya yɔm.

english_verse: One of them ran and grabbed a sponge. After he had soaked it in wine, he put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus. He said, “Let's wait and see if Elijah will come and take him down!”
translation_verse: Eye ame ɖeka ƒu du, eye wòkɔ aha tsitsi ɖe ƒumekutsa me, eye wòtsɔe ɖo ayeti nu hekpe ne gblɔ bena: Miɖe asi le eŋu; mina míakpɔ be, Eliya ava ɖee ɖe anyi hã.

english_verse: It was now the evening before the Sabbath, and the Jewish people were getting ready for that sacred day.
translation_verse: Eye esi fiẽsi ɖo la, elabena enye dzadzraɖoŋkeke, si dze Sabat ŋgɔ,

english_verse: Joseph bought a linen cloth and took the body down from the cross. He had it wrapped in the cloth, and he put it in a tomb that had been cut into solid rock. Then he rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb.
translation_verse: Eye wòƒle aklala, eye esi woɖee ɖe anyi la, exatsa aklala ɖe eŋuti, eye wòtsɔe mlɔ yɔdo, si woɖe ɖe kpe gbadza me la me; eye wòmli kpe ɖo yɔdoa nu.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body was placed.
translation_verse: Eye Maria, Magdalatɔ kple Maria, Yose dada, wokpɔ afisi wotsɔe mlɔ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus appeared in another form to two disciples, as they were on their way out of the city.
translation_verse: Ke nusiawo megbe la eɖe eɖokui fia wo dome ame eve, siwo le tsa ɖim yina agbleta la, le nɔnɔme bubu me.

english_verse: Then the disciples left and preached everywhere. The Lord was with them, and the miracles they worked proved that their message was true. ANOTHER OLD ENDING TO MARK'S GOSPEL
translation_verse: Ke woamawo yi ɖaɖe gbe ƒã nya la fia le afisiafi, eye Aƒetɔ la le dɔ wɔm kpli wo, le ŋusẽ dom nya la to dzesi, siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la me.

english_verse: She left and told his friends, who were crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Eya la yi ɖaka eta na amesiwo li kpakplii tsã la, siwo le konyi fam, eye wole avi fam la!

english_verse: Very early on Sunday morning, just as the sun was coming up, they went to the tomb.
translation_verse: Eye le kwasiɖa ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ ƒe ŋdikanya, esi agu dze la, wova yɔdo la gbɔ.

english_verse: On their way, they were asking one another, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance for us?”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ le wo nɔewo dome bena: Ameka amii kpe la ɖa le yɔdo la nu na mí mahã?

english_verse: But when they looked, they saw that the stone had already been rolled away. And it was a huge stone!
translation_verse: Eye esi wowu mo dzi la, wokpe bena, wòmũ kpe la ɖe megbe xoxo; elabena elolo akpa.

english_verse: The women went into the tomb, and on the right side they saw a young man in a white robe sitting there. They were alarmed.
translation_verse: Eye esi woyi ɖe yɔdo la me la, wokpe ɖekakpuia ɖe le nuɖusi gome le anyinɔƒe, eye wòdo awu ɣi ʋlaya, eye dzidzi ƒo wo.

english_verse: Now go and tell his disciples, and especially Peter, that he will go ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.”
translation_verse: Ke miheyi ɖagblɔe na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple Petro hã bena: Edze mia ŋgɔ yina Galilea, afima miakpɔe le, abe alesi wogblɔ ɖi na mi la ene.

english_verse: They will handle snakes and will drink poison and not be hurt. They will also heal sick people by placing their hands on them. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: Woalé dawo, eye ne wono nu wuame hã la, mele wo si ge o; woatsɔ woƒe asiwo aɖo dɔlélawo dzi, eye woƒe lãme lasẽ. Yesu fe dziƒoyiyi.

english_verse: But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye woawo hã wodzo yi ɖaka eta na ame mamlewo; gake womexɔ woawo hã dzi se o. Mawutsidetaname ŋu se.

english_verse: Anyone who believes me and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe me will be condemned.
translation_verse: Amesi ke xɔe se, eye wode mawutsi ta nɛ la, woaxɔe ɖe agbe; ke amesi ke mexɔe se o la, wòabu fɔe.

english_verse: After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God.
translation_verse: Esi Aƒetɔ la ƒo nu na wo vɔ megbe la, wokɔe tẽ yi dziƒo, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Mawu ƒe nuɖusi me.

english_verse: Afterwards, Jesus appeared to his eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them because they were too stubborn to believe the ones who had seen him after he had been raised to life.
translation_verse: Eya megbe la eɖe eɖokui fia ame wuiɖekɛawo ŋuta, esi wole nuɖuƒe; eye wòhe nya ɖe wo ŋu le woƒe dzimaxɔse kple dzimesesẽ la ŋuti bena, womexɔ amesiwo kpoe wòtsi tre la, dzi se o.

english_verse: Then he told them: Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miheyi ɖe xexe la me katã, eye miɖe gbe ƒã nyanyuie la na amewo katã.

english_verse: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.
translation_verse: Ke dzesi siawo lakplɔ amesiwo xɔe se la ɖo: Le nye ŋkɔ la me wòanyã gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ado goe, eye woaƒo nu kple aɖe yeyewo.

english_verse: Many people have tried to tell the story of what God has done among us.
translation_verse: Esi ame geɖewo tso asi de nyatotoa ɖoɖo me le nyadzɔdzɔ, siwo nu wowu le mía dome la ŋuti,

english_verse: They wrote what we had been told by the ones who were there in the beginning and saw what happened.
translation_verse: abe alesi amesiwo kpɔ eteƒe kple ŋku tso gɔmedzedzea me ke, eye wonye nya la ƒe dɔlawo, tsɔe de asi na mí ene la, ta la,

english_verse: So I made a careful study of everything and then decided to write and tell you exactly what took place. Honorable Theophilus,
translation_verse: enyo nye hã ŋu, esi medzro wo katã me kpɔ tsitotsito vaseɖe egɔme ke bena, maŋlɔe na wò ɖekaɖeka, amegã Teofil,

english_verse: I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard. An Angel Tells about the Birth of John
translation_verse: bena nadze si nya, siwo wofia wò la, ƒe nyateƒenyenye. Mawudɔla ɖe gbe ƒã Yohanes mawutsidetanamela ƒe dzidzi.

english_verse: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Le Herodes, si nye Yudea-fia, ƒe ŋkekewo me la mawununɔlaa ɖe li, eŋkɔ enye Zaxarya, si tso Abiya ƒe ŋkekeɖoɖo me, eye srɔ̃a tso Aron ƒe vinyɔnuviwo dome, eye eƒe ŋkɔ enye Elisabet.

english_verse: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.
translation_verse: Eye woa kple eve la katã wonye ame dzɔdzɔewo le Mawu ƒe ŋku me, eye wozɔna le Aƒetɔ la ƒe seawo kple eƒe ɖoɖoa wo katã nu mo makamakae.

english_verse: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
translation_verse: Ke vi mele wo si o, elabena Elisabet tsi ko, eye woa kple eve la siaa woxɔ ƒe geɖe.

english_verse: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.
translation_verse: Ke eva me bena, esime wòle nunɔnɔdɔ wɔm le edzidzedze ƒe ŋkekeɖoɖo la nu le Mawu ƒe ŋku me

english_verse: According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense,
translation_verse: le nunɔnɔdɔ ƒe kɔa nu la, nudzidze dze edzi bena, wòayi ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe xɔa me, eye wòamè nu.

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla ɖe eɖokui fiae, le tsitre ɖe numemlekpui la ƒe nuɖusi me.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Eye esi Zaxarya kpɔe la, eɖi vo, eye vɔvɔ̃ dze edzi.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Ke dɔla la gblɔ nɛ bena: Megavɔ̃ o, Zaxarya; elabena wose wò kukuɖeɖe la, eye srɔ̃wò Elisabet adzi ŋutsuvi na wò, eye nayɔ eƒe ŋkɔ be Yohanes.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: Eye wòanye dzidzɔ kple aseyetsotso na wò, eye ame geɖewo adzo dzi le eƒe dzidzi ŋuti.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Elabena anye gã le Aƒetɔ la ŋku me, eye mele wein alo aha sesẽ no ge o, eye Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ayɔe fũ tso keke dadaa ƒe dɔ me ke.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Eye wòatrɔ Israel-viwo dome ame geɖewo ava Aƒetɔ, woƒe Mawu la gbɔ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye wòanɔ eŋgɔ le Eliya ƒe gbɔgbɔ kple ŋusẽ me be, wòatrɔ fofowo ƒe dziwo ava ɖeviwo gbɔ kple tosẽlawo ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe nunya me, ne wòadzra dukɔ la ɖo ɖi woasu te na Aƒetɔ la.

english_verse: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
translation_verse: Eye Zaxarya gblɔ na dɔla la bena: Nuka me madze si nusia le mahã? Elabena nye la amegã ɖeɖi menye, eye srɔ̃nye hã xɔ ƒe geɖe.

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Eye dɔla la ɖo eŋu nɛ bena: Nyee nye Gabriel, si nɔa tsitre ɖe Mawu ŋku me, eye wòdɔm ɖa, be maƒo nu na wò, eye magblɔ nya nyui sia fia wò

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, wò aɖe latu, eye mele ŋute ge aƒo nu o, halase ŋkeke, si dzi nusiawo ava ve me, le esi mèxɔ nye nya, siwo nu woawu le woƒe ɣeyiɣi me la, dzi se o la ŋuti.

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ la le Zaxarya lalam, eye woƒe mo wɔ yaa le eƒe mawuxɔ me tsitsi la ŋuti.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòɖo go la, mete ŋu ƒo nu na wo o, eye wodze sii bena, ekpe nu le mawuxɔ la me, eye wòmia asi wo, eye wòtsi nu maƒomaƒo.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me bena, esime wowu eƒe subɔsubɔ ŋkekeawo nu la, edzo yi eƒe me.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke siawo megbe la srɔ̃a Elisabet fɔ fu, eye wòɣla eɖokui ɣleti atɔ̃ hegblɔ bena:

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: Elabena ale Aƒetɔ la wɔ nam le ŋkeke, siwo me wòkpɔm ɖa, be wòaɖe nye ŋukpe ɖa le amewo dome. Mawudɔla Gabriel gblɔ Kristo ƒe dzidzi ɖi.

english_verse: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee
translation_verse: Eye le ɣleti adelia me la Mawu dɔ dɔla Gabriel ɖo ɖe Galilea-dua ɖe, si ŋkɔ enye Nazaret la me,

english_verse: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.
translation_verse: ɖe ɖetugbi, si ŋugbe wodo na ŋutsua ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Yosef, tso Dawid ƒe me la gbɔ, eye ɖetugbi la ŋkɔe nye Maria.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Eye esi mawudɔla va me le egbɔ la, egblɔ nɛ bena: Medo gbe na wò, wò amesi nu wòve! Aƒetɔ la li kpli wò.

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Ke eƒe dzi lã kpo le nya la ŋuti, eye wòde ŋugble sẽ bena: Nuka gbedoname gɔ̃ enye esi!

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Eye dɔla la gblɔ nɛ bena: Megavɔ̃ o, Mana! Elabena èkpɔ amenuveve le Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, èle fu fɔ ge, eye nadzi ŋutsuvi, eye nayɔ eƒe ŋkɔ be Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Eya la anye gã, eye woayɔe be dziƒoxɔ la ƒe Vi, eye Aƒetɔ Mawu la atsɔ fofoa Dawid ƒe fiazikpui la anae;

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: eye wòaɖu fia le Yakob ƒe aƒe dzi tegbetegbe, eye nuwuwu manɔe na eƒe fiaɖuƒe la o.

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Eye Maria gblɔ na dɔla la bena: Aleke nusia lava mee, esi nyemenya ŋutsu o mahã?

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Eye dɔla la ɖo eŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ava dziwò, eye dziƒoʋitɔ ƒe ŋusẽ ado vɔvɔli ɖe dziwò, eyaŋuti nusi dzi ge nala la, woayɔe be kɔkɔe, Mawu viŋutsuvi.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, Elisabet, wò ƒometɔ la, fɔ fu le ŋutsuvi dzi ge le eƒe nyagãkuku me, eye ɣleti sia enye adelia na eya, amesi woyɔna be konɔ.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Elabena naneke mese na Mawu o.

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Eye Maria gblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔlanyɔnu menye, ava me nam le wò nya la nu. Eye mawudɔla dzo le egbɔ. Maria va kpɔ Elisabet ɖa.

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Eye Maria tsi tre le ŋkeke siawo me, eye wòɖe abla yi to la dzi, ɖe Yuda-dua ɖe me;

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: eye woge ɖe Zaxarya ƒe me, eye wòdo gbe na Elisabet.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me bena, esi Elisabet se Mana ƒe gbedoname ko la, via ho le eƒe dɔ me; eye Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe yɔ Elisabet fũ,

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ gblɔ bena: Woayra wò le nyɔnuwo dome, eye woayra wò dɔmevi la!

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Eye afika gɔ̃ nusia tso bena, nye Aƒetɔ la dada va gbɔnye mahã?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, esi wò gbedoname ɖi ɖe nye to me la, ɖevi la ho le nye dɔ me le dzidzɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Eye Woayra wò, amesi xɔe se, elabena woawu nusiwo wogblɔ na wò tso Aƒetɔ gbɔ la nu. Maria ƒe kafukafuha.

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Eye Maria gblɔ bena: Nye luʋɔ do Aƒetɔ la ɖe dzi,

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: eye nye gbɔgbɔ tso aseye le Mawu, nye xɔla ŋuti,

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: bena ekpɔ eƒe dɔlanyɔnu ƒe bɔbɔnyenye ɖa; elabena kpɔ ɖa, tso esia dzi la ƒomewo katã woayɔm be yayrame,

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: bena ŋusẽtɔ la wɔ nu dzɔtsuwo nam, eye kɔkɔe nye eƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ li tso dzidzime vaseɖe dzidzime na amesiwo vɔ̃nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nu sesẽ kple eƒe abɔ; ekaka amesiwo ɖo wo ɖokui ɖe dzi le woƒe dzimesusuwo me la me.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: Etu asi ŋusẽtɔwo ƒu anyi tso fiazikpuiwo dzi, eye wòdo ame bɔbɔɖanyiwo ɖe dzi.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: Eya dɔwuitɔwo kple nu nyuiwo, eye kesinɔtɔwo la eɖo wo ɖa ƒuƒlu.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Ede eƒe dɔla Israel dzi hena ŋkuɖoɖo nublanuikpɔkpɔ dzi;

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: ate alesi wòƒo nu na mía fofowo ene, na Abraham kple eƒe ƒome vaseɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Eye Maria nɔ egbɔ anɔ ɣleti etɔ̃; eye wògbugbɔ yi ye ŋutɔ ƒe me. Yohanes dzidzi kple aʋatsotso nɛ.

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Azɔ la Elisabet ƒe vidziɣi ɖo, eye wòdzi ŋutsuvi.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Eye esi eƒe aƒelikawo kple eƒe ƒometɔwo se bena, Aƒetɔ kpɔ nublanui geɖe nɛ la, wokpɔ dzidzɔ kpakplii.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me le ŋkeke enyilia dzi bena, wova aʋa tso ge na ɖevi la, eye wotsɔ fofoa ŋkɔ Zaxarya nɛ.
