english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Eye dadaa xa edzi gblɔ bena: O! Ɖeko woayɔe be Yohanes.

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Amea ɖeke mele wò ƒome, si wotsɔ ŋkɔ sia na o.

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Eye wòmia asi fofoa, alesi wòdi be, woayɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Eye wòbia nuŋlɔkpe suea ɖe, eye wòŋlɔ bena: Yohanes enye eƒe ŋkɔ. Tete wo katã ƒe mo wo yaa.

english_verse: At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe nu ke enumake, eye eƒe ade trɔ, eye wòƒo nu le Mawu kafum.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Eye vɔvɔ̃ va amesiwo katã ɖe aƒelika kpli wo la dzi, eye woƒo nu le nyadzɔdzɔ siawo katã ŋuti le Yudea-tonyigba blibo la katã dzi.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo katã see la, wòlée ɖe ta me le gbɔgblɔm bena: Nuka gɔ̃ ɖevi sia ava zu mahã? Elabena Aƒetɔ la ƒe asi hã li kplii. Zaxarya ƒe kafukafuha.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Eye fofoa Zaxarya yɔ fũ kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe, eye wògblɔ ɖe anyi bena:

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, elabena eva kpɔ eƒe dukɔ ɖa, eye wòwɔ ɖeɖe nɛ,

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: eye wòna xɔxɔ ƒe dzo do na mí le Dawid, eƒe dɔla, ƒe me;

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: abe alesi wòƒo nu to eƒe nyagblɔɖila kɔkɔe, siwo li tso blema ke la, ƒe nu me ene:

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: Ɖeɖe tso miaƒe futɔwo kple amesiwo katã léa fu mi la, ƒe asi me;

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: be yeakpɔ nublanui na mía fofowo, eye yeaɖo ŋku yeƒe nubabla kɔkɔe,

english_verse: He told our ancestor Abraham
translation_verse: atamkaka, si wòka na mia fofo Abraham la dzi?

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: be esi wòɖe mi tso miaƒe futɔwo si me la, wòana miasubɔe kple mavɔ̃mavɔ̃

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: le kɔkɔenyenye kple dzɔdzɔenyenye me, miaƒe ŋkekewo katã le eƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Ke wò, ɖevi la, woayɔ wò be dziƒoʋitɔ ƒe nyagblɔɖila; elabena àdze Aƒetɔ la ŋgɔ, be nadzra eƒe mowo ɖo,

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: be nana xɔxɔ ƒe nyanya le woƒe nuvɔ̃tsɔtsɔke me

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: le míaƒe Mawu ƒe dɔmetɔtrɔ kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ŋuti, esime kekeli dze tso dziƒo ʋĩ va kpɔ mí ɖa,

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: be wòaklẽ na amesiwo bɔbɔ nɔ viviti kple ku ƒe vɔvɔli me, be wòaɖo míaƒe afɔwo ŋutifafa ƒe mɔ dzi.

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eye ɖevi la tsi, eye wòva sẽ ŋu le gbɔgbɔ la me; eye wòle gbedzi vaseɖe eɖeɖefia Israel ŋkeke dzi.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me le ŋkeke mawo me be, sedede tso kaisaro Augusto gbɔ bena, woaxlẽ xexeame katã aŋlɔ.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, amea ɖe le Yerusalem, si ŋkɔ enye Simeon: amesia enye ame dzɔdzɔe kple mawumeme, si le Israel aƒe akɔfafa lalam, eye Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe le eyama dzi.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Ŋɔŋlɔ gbãtɔ sia va me, esime Kirenio le mɔ̃mefia ɖum le Siria.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Eye amewo katã dze mo heyi be, wòaŋlɔ woƒe ŋkɔwo, amesiame yi ɖe ye ŋuta ƒe du me.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Eye Yosef hã dzo le Galilea, tso Nazaret-du la me heyi Yudea ɖe Dawid du, si woyɔna be Betlexem la me, elabena etso Dawid ƒe me kple eƒome la me,

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: be woaŋlɔ eya kple Mana, amesi ŋugbe wodo nɛ, si nye funɔ la, ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: Eye wòdzi ŋutsuvi, si nye eƒe ŋgɔgbevi, eye wòxatsa avɔ ɖe eŋu, eye wòtsɔe mlɔ lãnuɖunu me; elabena womekpɔ teƒe le amedzrodzeƒe o.

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Eye alẽnyilawo le nuto ma ke me le gbedzi, eye wole woƒe alẽha ŋuti dzɔm le zã me.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlaa ɖe tsi tre ɖe wo gbɔ, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe klẽ ƒo xlã wo, eye wovɔ̃ ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Eye dɔla la gblɔ na wo bena: Migavɔ̃ o! Elabena kpɔ ɖa, meva dzidzɔ gã ŋutinya gblɔ ge fia mi, esi lanye na dukɔ blibo la katã;

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: elabena wodzi xɔla, si nye Kristo, Aƒetɔ la, na mi egbe le Dawid dua me.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Eye esia anye dzesi na mi: Míakpɔ vidzĩe, si woxatsa avɔ ɖe eŋu, eye wòmia lãnuɖunu me.

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Eye kasia dziƒoʋakɔha gãa ɖe kpe ɖe mawudɔla la ŋuti, wole Mawu kafum le gbɔgblɔm bena:

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: Ŋutikɔkɔe woana Mawu le dziƒo boo, eye ŋutifafa ava anyigba dzi; amegbetɔwo ŋu woakpɔ ŋudzedze nyui le.

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Eye wòva me, esime mawudɔlawo dzo le wo gbɔ heyi dziƒo la, alẽnyilawo gblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Mina ne miayi Betlexem, aɖakpɔ nusia, si va dzɔ, esi Aƒetɔ la na mienya.

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Eye woɖe abla va, eye wokpɔ Mana kple Yosef kpakple vidzĩe, si le anyimlɔƒe le lãnuɖunu me.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Esi wokpɔe la, wokaka nya, si wogblɔ na wo le ɖevi sia ŋuti.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Ke Mana lé nya siawo katã ɖe ta me, eye wobu wo ŋuti le eƒe dzi me.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Eye alẽnyilawo gbugbɔ, eye wole ŋutikɔkɔe kple kafukafu tsɔm na Mawu le nusiwo katã wose, eye wokpɔ la ŋuti, abe alesi wogblɔ na wo la ene. Wotso aʋa na Yesu hetsɔe ɖo Mawu ƒe ŋku me. Simeon kple Hana.

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Eye esi wotso aʋa nɛ le ŋkeke enyilia dzi la, wotsɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Yesu, abe alesi mawudɔla yɔe ɖi, hafi wòfɔ eƒe fu ene.

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Eye esi wowu woƒe ŋutikɔklɔŋkekeawo nu le Mose ƒe se la nu la, wotsɔe yi Yerusalem, be woatsɔe aɖo Aƒetɔ ŋku me,

english_verse: just as the Law of the Lord says, “Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.”
translation_verse: abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi le Aƒetɔ ƒe se la me ene bena: „Atsu sia atsu, si ʋu dɔnu la, woayɔ eya kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ la“;

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: eye be woana numeme, abe alesi wogblɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe se la me ene bena: „Akpakpa eve alo ahɔ̃nevi eve.“

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la ɖee fiae bena, mele kuku ge, hafi akpɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe Kristo o.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Eye wòle Gbɔgbɔ la me va mawuxɔa me; eye esi dzilawo yi ɖe eme kple ɖevi Yesu, bena woawɔ nɛ le se la ƒe kɔa nu la,

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: eya hã xɔe ɖe eƒe abɔwo dome, eye wòkafu Mawu hegblɔ bena:

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, azɔ èɖo mɔ wò dɔla le ŋutifafa me le wò nya la nu;

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: si nèdzra ɖo ɖe dukɔwo katã ƒe ŋku me;

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: kekeli ƒe nyaɖeɖefia na trɔ̃subɔlawo kple wò dukɔ Israel ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.
translation_verse: Eye fofoa kple dadaa ƒe mo wɔ yaa le nya, siwo wògblɔ le eyama ŋuti la ta.

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Eye Simeon yra wo, eye wògblɔ na dadaa Mana bena: Kpɔ ɖa, woɖo amesia anyi na ame geɖewo ƒe anyidzedze kple tsitretsitsi le Israel, kple dzesi, si woagblɔ nya ɖe eŋuti;

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: ke wò la, yi ato wò ŋutɔ wò luʋɔ me, bena woaɖe ame geɖewo ƒe dzimesusuwo afia.

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.
translation_verse: Eye Hana, nyɔnu nyagblɔɖilaa ɖe li, enye Fanuel ƒe nyɔnuvi tso Aser-ƒome me, si xɔ ƒe geɖe ŋutɔ, eye wònɔ anyi kple srɔ̃a ƒe adre tso eƒe ɖetugbi me;

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Eya hã va tsi tre le gaƒoƒo ma ke dzi, le Aƒetɔ kafum, eye wòƒo nu le eŋuti na amesiwo katã le Yerusalem ƒe ɖeɖe lalam.

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Eye esi wowu nuwo katã nu le Aƒetɔ ƒe sea nu la, wògatrɔ yi Galilea ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe du Nazaret la me.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Eye ɖevi la tsi, eye wòva sẽ ŋu, eye nunya yɔe fũ, eye Mawu ƒe amenuveve le edzi? Yesu, si xɔ ƒe wuieve, le mawuxɔ me, enɔ ɖevi me le Nazaret.

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe dzilawo yia Yerusalem ƒe sia ƒe ɖe ŋutitotoŋkekenyuieɖuƒe.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòxɔ ƒe wuieve la, woyi Yerusalem le ŋkekenyuie ƒe koa nu.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Eye esi wowu ŋkekeawo nu la, Yesu ɖevi la tsi megbe le Yerusalem le woƒe tɔtrɔgbɔ me, eye eƒe dzilawo menye o.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Ke esi wobu xa bena, ana mɔzɔha la dome la, wozɔ ŋkeke ɖeka ƒe mɔ, eye woɖii le woƒe ƒomeawo kple ame nyanyɛawo dome,

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la eva ve me bena, wokpɔe le mawuƒe la me le anyinɔƒe le nusiawo dome, hele to ɖom wo, eye wòle nya biam wo;

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: eye amesiwo katã see la, woƒe mo wɔ yaa le eƒe nugɔmesese kple eƒe ŋuɖoɖowo ŋuti.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wokpɔe la, kuvia ɖo wo, eye dadaa gblɔ nɛ bena: Vinye, nukaŋuti newɔ ɖe mia ŋu ale? Kpɔ ɖa, mia kple fofowò miedi wò kple nuxaxa.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nuka wɔ miedim ma? Ɖe mienya bena, ele nam be, manɔ nusiwo nye fofonye tɔ me o mahã?

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Eye womese nya, si wògblɔ na wo la gɔme o.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Eye wòyi kpli wo, eye wòva Nazaret, eye wòbɔbɔ eɖokui na wo, eye dadaa tsɔ nya siawo katã dzra ɖo ɖe eƒe dzi me.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu tsi ɖe dzi le nunya kple tsitsi kple amenuveve le Mawu kple amewo gbɔ la me.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Eye nudzɔlawo hã va be, wòade mawutsi ta na yewo, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Nufiala, nuka wɔ ge míala?

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Azɔ mitse ku, siwo dze dzimetɔtrɔ, eye migade asi gbɔgblɔ me le mia ɖokui me bena: Abraham ye nye mía fofo o; elabena mele egblɔm na mi bena: Mawu ate ŋu anyɔ viwo atso kpe siawo me ke na Abraham.

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: ke dziɖula Herodes, si wogbe nya na le Herodia, nɔvia srɔ̃ kple nu vɔ̃ɖi, siwo katã Herodes wɔ la ŋuti la,

english_verse: Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests. At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert.
translation_verse: eye Hana kple Kayafa wonye nunɔlagãwo la, Mawu ƒe nya va Yohanes, Zaxarya vi la gbɔ le gbedzi.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: alesi woŋlɔ ɖi le nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ƒe nyagblɔɖigbalẽ me bena: „Amesi le ɣli dom le gbeadzi ƒe gbe enye esi: Midzra Aƒetɔ ƒe mɔ la ɖo, miwɔ eƒe mɔtatawo dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.
translation_verse: Woaxe ʋe sia ʋe, eye woabɔbɔ to sia to kple togbɛ sia togbɛ ɖe anyi, eye mɔ gɔglɔ̃wo lazu dzɔdzɔe, eye mɔ tsakliwo lazu zɔzrɔ̃e!

english_verse: Then everyone will see the saving power of God.’ ”
translation_verse: Eye ŋutilã katã akpɔ Mawu ƒe xɔxɔ la.

english_verse: Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, “You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Azɔ egblɔ na ameha, siwo do go, bena wòaɖe mawutsi ta na yewo la bena: Dawo ƒe dzidzimewo! Amekae gblɔe fia mi bena, miasi atso dɔmedzoe, si gbɔna la nu mahã?

english_verse: The crowds asked John, “What should we do?”
translation_verse: Eye amehawo biae bena: Ekema nuka wɔ ge míala?

english_verse: Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?” John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
translation_verse: Eye asrafowo hã biae gblɔ bena: Miawo hã nuka wo ge míala? Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Migado ŋɔdzi na amea ɖeke xɔ nu le esi o, eye migatso amea ɖeke nu hã dzro o, eye miaƒe fetu nadze mia ŋu!

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Yohanes ɖo ŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye la metsɔ tsi de mawutsi ta na mi; ke amesi tri akɔ wum, amesi ƒe atokotawo nu ka medzem be, matui o la, eya ŋutɔ gbɔna be, wòatsɔ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe kple dzo ade mawutsi ta na mi;

english_verse: In many different ways John preached the good news to the people.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nyanyuie fia dukɔ la hele nu xlɔ̃m wo le nu bubu ƒomevi geɖewo hã ŋuti;

english_verse: Finally, Herod put John in jail, and this was the worst thing he had done. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: etsɔ Yohanes de gaxɔ me hekpe ɖe nusiawo katã ŋuti. Wode mawutsi ta na Yesu. Yesu ƒe dzidzime-xexlẽfiagbalẽ.

english_verse: While everyone else was being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. Then as he prayed, the sky opened up,
translation_verse: Eye esi wòde mawutsi ta na dukɔ la katã, eye woɖee na Yesu hã la, edo gbe ɖa, eye wòva ve me bena, dziƒo ʋu,

english_verse: and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in the form of a dove. A voice from heaven said, “You are my own dear Son, and I am pleased with you.” The Ancestors of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: eye Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la ɖi le nɔnɔmekpɔkpɔ me abe akpakpa ene ɖe, eyama dzi, eye gbe ɖi tso dziƒo gblɔ bena: Wòe nye vinye, si gbɔ nyemelɔ̃a nu le o, wò me mekpɔa ŋudzedze lena.

english_verse: Enosh, and Seth. The family of Jesus went all the way back to Adam and then to God.
translation_verse: amesi nye Enos vi, amesi nye Set vi, amesi nye Adam vi, amesi nye Mawu tɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say: ‘God will tell his angels to take care of you. They will catch you in their arms, and you will not even hurt your feet on the stones.’ ”
translation_verse: eye woƒe asiwò me woatsɔ wò aɖo, bena nagatsɔ wò afɔ axlã de kpea ɖeke o.“

english_verse: After the sun had set, people with all kinds of diseases were brought to Jesus. He put his hands on each one of them and healed them.
translation_verse: Eye esime ɣe le to ɖom la, amesiwo katã si dɔléla bubu ƒomeviwo le la, wotsɔ wo va egbɔ, eye wòda asiwo ɖe wo dome ɖesiaɖe dzi ɖekaɖeka heda gbe wo ŋu.

english_verse: The devil said to Jesus, “If you are God's Son, tell this stone to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Eye Abosam gblɔ nɛ bena: Nenye Mawuvi nènye la, ekema gblɔ na kpe sia, ne wòatrɔ zu abolo.

english_verse: Then the devil led Jesus up to a high place and quickly showed him all the nations on earth.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkplɔe yi to kɔkɔa ɖe dzi la, eɖe xexeme fiaɖuƒewo katã fiae le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me.

english_verse: Just worship me, and you can have it all.”
translation_verse: Azɔ wò ta, ne ède ta agu nam la, wo katã lazu tɔwo.

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus to Jerusalem and had him stand on top of the temple. The devil said, “If you are God's Son, jump off.
translation_verse: Tete wòkplɔe yi Yerusalem, eye wòtsɔe ɖo mawuxɔ ƒe tsutsuẽƒe, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Nenye Mawuvi nènye la, ekema tsɔ ɖokuiwò xlã ɖe anyi tso afisia:

english_verse: He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him. The People of Nazareth Turn against Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wòfiã nu le woƒe ƒuƒoƒewo, eye wo katã wokafui.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and as usual he went to the synagogue on the Sabbath. When he stood up to read from the Scriptures,
translation_verse: Eye wòva Nazaret, afisi wonyii le, eye le eƒe kɔa nu la eyi ɖe ƒuƒoƒe la le Sabat-ŋkeke dzi, eye wòtsi tre be, yeaxlẽ agbalẽ.

english_verse: “The Lord's Spirit has come to me, because he has chosen me to tell the good news to the poor. The Lord has sent me to announce freedom for prisoners, to give sight to the blind, to free everyone who suffers,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe Gbɔgbɔ le dzinye, le esi ta wosi ami nam ɖo, bena magblɔ Nyanyuie afia ame dahewo, edɔm, bena mayɔ dɔ amesiwo ƒe dzi gbã,

english_verse: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtu agbalẽa la, etsɔe na dɔla la, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi, eye amesiwo katã le ƒuƒoƒea la, fɔ ŋku ɖe edzi dzoɣlii.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Eye ameawo katã ɖi ɖase nɛ, eye woƒe mo wo yaa le amenuvevenya, siwo do go tso eƒe nu me lã ŋuti, eye wogblɔ bena: Alo amesia la menye Yosef vie o ɖe?

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Míado lo sia nam tsã be: „Gbedala, da gbe ɖokuiwò ŋu!“ Nusiwo miese bena, nèwɔ le Kapernaum la, wɔe le mía ɖe afisia hã.

english_verse: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nyagblɔɖilaa ɖeke medzea ye ŋutɔ detɔwo ŋu o.

english_verse: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel,
translation_verse: Ke nyateƒe gblɔm mele na mi bena: Ahosi geɖewo le Israel le Eliya ƒe ŋkekewo me, esime wotu dziƒo nu ƒe etɔ̃ kple ɣleti ade, eye dɔwuame gãa ɖe va anyigba la katã dzi;

english_verse: but Elijah was sent only to a widow in the town of Zarephath near the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: eye womeɖo Eliya ɖe wo dometɔa ɖeke gbɔ o, negbe ɖe Sarepta le Zidon-nyigba dzi de nyanu ahosia ɖe gbɔ ko.

english_verse: During the time of the prophet Elisha, many men in Israel had leprosy. But no one was healed, except Naaman who lived in Syria.
translation_verse: Eye anyidzela geɖewo le Israel le nyagblɔɖila Elisa gali, eye womeklɔ wo dometɔa ɖeke ŋuti o, negbe Naeman, Siriatɔ la ko.

english_verse: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Mark
translation_verse: Ke eto wo titina ke heyi kɔ̃. Yesu gblɔ nya le Kapernaum, afisi wòyɔ dɔ gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ tɔa ɖe le.

english_verse: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖi va Kapernaum, si nye Galilea-du la me. Eye wòle nu fiam wo le Sabat-ŋkeke dzi;

english_verse: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.
translation_verse: eye kuvia ɖo wo le eƒe nufiafia la ŋuti, elabena egblɔ nya ŋusẽtɔe.

english_verse: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out,
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsua ɖe le ƒuƒoƒe la, amesi me Abosam ƒe gbɔgbɔ bliba le, eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesĩe bena:

english_verse: Jesus ordered the evil spirit to be quiet and come out. The demon threw the man to the ground in front of everyone and left without harming him.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu wo ɖe eta gblɔ bena: Mia wò nu, eye naɖo go le eme! Eye esi Abosam la tsoe xlã ɖe titina la, eɖo go le eme, eye mewo nu ve-via ɖekee o.

english_verse: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!”
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo wo katã, eye wogblɔ le wo nɔewo dome bena: Nuka nyae nye esi ma? Elabena ekpɔ mɔ kple ŋusẽ hedea se na gbɔgbɔ blibawo, eye woɖoa go.

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye eƒe ŋkɔ ɖi hoo le afima nutowo katã me godoo. Yesu da gbe Petro-lɔ̃xo kple dɔléla bubu geɖewo ŋu.

english_verse: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's home. When Jesus got there, he was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòtsi tre la, edo go le ƒuƒoƒe la heyi ɖe Simon ƒe me. Eye Simon lɔ̃xo le ŋudza sesẽa ɖe lém, eye woɖe kuku nɛ ɖe eta.

english_verse: So Jesus went over to her and ordered the fever to go away. Right then she was able to get up and serve them a meal.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtsi tre bi ɖe edzi la, ewo ɖe ŋudza la ta, eye wòdzo le edzi; ke etsi tre enumake, eye wòsubɔ wo.

english_verse: Demons went out of many people and shouted, “You are the Son of God!” But Jesus ordered the demons not to speak because they knew he was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo hã do go le ame geɖewo me, eye wole ɣli dom le gbɔgblɔm bena: Wòe nye Mawu ƒe Vi la. Eye wòwona ɖe wo ta, eye mena mo wo be, woaƒo nu o, elabena wonyae bena, eyae nye Kristo la.

english_verse: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.
translation_verse: Eye esi ŋu eke la, edo go heyi gbedzi, eye amehawo dii, eye wova egbɔ, eye wosikae ɖi, bena megadzo le yewo gbɔ o.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.”
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ na wo bena: Ele nam be, magblɔ mawufiaɖuƒe la ŋu nyanyuie afia du bubuawo hã; elabena eyata wodɔm ɖo.

english_verse: So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.
translation_verse: Eye wòle nya gblɔm le Galilea ƒuƒoƒeawo.

english_verse: But Jesus would often go to some place where he could be alone and pray. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Walk (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke ete eɖokui heyi gbedzi, eye wòdo gbe ɖa. Yesu da gbe le lãmetututɔa ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, “My friend, your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ woƒe xɔse la, egblɔ bena: Ame, wotsɔ wò nuvɔ̃wo ke wò!

english_verse: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
translation_verse: Eye esi woge ɖe ʋu ɖeka, si enye Simon tɔ me la, eɖe kuku nɛ be, wòatee ayii atso go ŋu ʋee. Eye esi wòbɔbɔ nɔ ʋua me la, efiã nu ɖo ɖe amehawo.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: Eye Simon xɔ edzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Amegã, míedze agbagba zã blibo la katã, eye miekpɔ naneke o, gake le wò nya nu la maɖi ɖɔwo.

english_verse: They did this and caught so many fish that their nets began ripping apart.
translation_verse: Eye esi wowɔ esia la, woɖe lã geɖe ŋutɔ, eye woƒe ɖɔwo le dzedzem;

english_verse: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.
translation_verse: eye wòmia asi wo tɔ, siwo le ʋu bubu me la bena, woava ade asi eme na yewo. Eye wova, eye woyɔ ʋuawo kple eve fũ, ale be woɖe asi toyiyi me.

english_verse: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, “Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.”
translation_verse: nenema ke hãe nye Yakobo kple Yohanes, Zebedeo ƒe viwo, amesiwo nye Simon ƒe hadɔwɔlawo. Eye Yesu gblɔ na Simon bena: Megavɔ̃ o! Tso esia dzi yina la èle amewo ɖe ge.

english_verse: The men pulled their boats up on the shore. Then they left everything and went with Jesus. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye esi woku ʋuawo va ƒo ɖe go la, wogblẽ nuwo katã ɖi, eye wodze eyome. Yesu da gbe le anyidzelaa ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: News about Jesus kept spreading. Large crowds came to listen to him teach and to be healed of their diseases.
translation_verse: Ke geɖe wu nya la de dzi le eŋuti, eye ameha geɖewo va ƒo ƒu be, yewoase nya, eye be wòada gbe yewo ŋu le yewoƒe dɔlélewo me.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Eye esi womekpɔ alesi woawɔ atsɔe vɛ le ameha la ŋuti o la, woyi ɖe xɔta, eye woɖiɖii ɖe anyi to mɔ, si woɖe la me kple eƒe aba la ɖe titina ɖe Yesu ŋku me.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the experts began arguing, “Jesus must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.”
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo de asi ɖikeke me gblɔ bena: Ameka enye esia, si gblɔ busunyawo? Ameka ate ŋu atsɔ nuvɔ̃wo ake, ne menye Mawu ɖeka ko oa?

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Kae bɔbɔ wu, be woagblɔ: wotsɔ wò nuvɔ̃wo ke wò loo, alo woagblɔ bena: Tsi tre, eye nazɔ azɔli mahã?

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”
translation_verse: Ke ne mianyɛ bena, ŋusẽ le Amegbetɔvi la si be, wòatsɔ nuvɔ̃wo ake le anyigba dzi, — egblɔ na lãmetututɔ la bena: Mele egblɔm na wò bena: Tsi tre, eye nakɔ wò aba dzi, eye nayi aƒewò me.

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Eye enumake wòtsi tre le woƒe ŋku me, eye esi wòkɔ nusi dzi wòmlɔ la, edzo yi eƒe me hele Mawu kafum.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed and praised God. What they saw surprised them, and they said, “We have seen a great miracle today!” Jesus Chooses Levi (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo wo katã, eye wokafu Mawu, eye woyɔ fũ kple vɔvɔ̃ hegblɔ bena: Miekpɔ nu makpɔgbeɖewo egbe. Yesu yɔ Lewi.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translation_verse: Eye nusiawo megbe la edo go, eye wòkpɔ nudzɔlaa ɖe, eŋkɔ enye Lewi, le anyinɔƒe le nudzɔƒe, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Dze yonyeme.

english_verse: Levi left everything and went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye wògblẽ nuwo katã ɖi, eye wòtsi tre dze eyome.

english_verse: In his home Levi gave a big dinner for Jesus. Many tax collectors and other guests were also there.
translation_verse: Eye Lewi ɖo kplɔ̃ gãa ɖe ne le eƒe me: eye nudzɔlawo kple ame bubuwo ƒe ha gãa ɖe bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe nuaɖuƒe kpli wo.

english_verse: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo kple woƒe agbalẽfialawo li liʋiliʋi ɖe eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋuti gblɔ bena. Nukaŋuti mieɖua nu, eye mienoa nu kple nudzɔlawo kpakple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Menye lãmesesẽtɔwoe hiãa gbedala o, negbe dɔlélawo ko.

english_verse: I didn't come to invite good people to turn to God. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Matthew
translation_verse: Nyemeva ame dzɔdzɔewo yɔ ge o, negbe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ko hena dzimetɔtrɔ. Yesu ɖo nutsitsidɔ gɔme.

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Ke woawo la wogblɔ nɛ bena: Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo tsia nu dɔna atraɖi, eye wonɔa gbe ɖom ɖa, nenema ke farisitɔwo tɔwo hã wɔna; ke tɔwòwo ɖua nu, eye wonoa nu.

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Alo ɖe ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ƒe xɔlɔ̃wo ate ŋu atsi nu adɔ, esime ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la li kpli wo mahã?

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”
translation_verse: Ke ŋkekewo gbɔna, esime woatsɔ ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ayii le wo gbɔ; ekema woatsi nu adɔ le ŋkeke mawo me.

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo lo hã na wo gblɔ bena: Amea ɖeke metsɔa avɔnuɖeɖi yeye kaa avɔ xoxo o; ke ne menye nenem o la, yeye la hã adze, eye yeye la ƒe nuɖeɖi mawɔ ɖeka kple xoxo la o.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke metsɔa aha yeye dea lãgbalẽgolo xoxowo me o, ke ne menye nenem o la, aha yeye la awo lãgbalẽgoloawo, eye eya ŋutɔ aƒu gbe, eye lãgbalẽgoloawo agblẽ

english_verse: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.
translation_verse: ke boŋ woatsɔ aha yeye aɖe lãgbalẽgolo yeyewo me, eye wo kpakple eve la siaa woanɔ dedie.

english_verse: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, “The old wine is better.”
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke menɔa wein xoxo nom tso, eye wògadia yeye o; elabena egblɔ be: Xoxo la enyo wu.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.
translation_verse: Ke enya woƒe tamesusuwo, eye wògblɔ na ŋutsu, si titi lé asi na la bena: Tso, eye natsi tre ɖe titina. Eye wòtso ɖe tsitrenu.

english_verse: Some Pharisees said, “Why are you picking grain on the Sabbath? You're not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Ke farisitɔa ɖewo gblɔ bena: Nukaŋuti miewɔ nusi mele se la nu be, woawɔ le Sabat-ŋkeke dzi o mahã?

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Dzi nadza mi le ŋkeke ma me, eye midzo kpo, elabena kpɔ ɖa, miaƒe fetu lolo le dziƒo, elabena nenema ke wo fofowo wo nya gblɔɖilawoe.

english_verse: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.
translation_verse: miyra amesiwo ƒo fi ɖe mi, miɖo gbe ɖa ɖe amesiwo ƒo ɖi mi la ta.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “On the Sabbath should we do good deeds or evil deeds? Should we save someone's life or destroy it?”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Mabia mi: Ɖe woɖe mɔ be, woawɔ nu nyui alo woawɔ nuvɔ̃ le Sabat dzi, be woaɖe agbe alo woatsrɔ̃e mahã?

english_verse: One was Simon, and Jesus named him Peter. Another was Andrew, Peter's brother. There were also James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
translation_verse: Simon, si woyɔna hã be Petro, kple nɔvia Andrea, Yakobo kple Yohanes, Filipo kple Bartolomeo,

english_verse: On another Sabbath Jesus was teaching in a synagogue, and a man with a paralyzed right hand was there.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me le Sabat bubu dzi bena, eyi ɖe ƒuƒoƒe la, be yeafia nu; eye amea ɖe le afima, si titi lé nuɖusi na.

english_verse: The teachers and the Pharisees were furious and started saying to one another, “What can we do about Jesus?” Jesus Chooses His Twelve Apostles (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke woawo la movidzɔdzɔ yɔ wo fũ, eye woƒo nu na wo nɔewo, nusi woate ŋu awɔ Yesu. Yesu tia apostolo wuieveawo.

english_verse: The next morning he called his disciples together and chose twelve of them to be his apostles.
translation_verse: Eye esi ŋu ke la, eya eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ, eye wòtia ame wuieve le wo dome, amesiwo wòyɔ hã bena apostolowo:

english_verse: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all. Blessings and Troubles (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye ameha la katã ɖi be, yewoado asi eŋu, elabena ŋusẽ do go tso eme, eye wòda gbe le wo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Matthew, Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus. The rest of the apostles were Simon, known as the Eager One,
translation_verse: Mateo kple Toma, Yakobo, Alfeovi kple Simon, si woyɔna be Zelotes,

english_verse: Jude, who was the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Matthew
translation_verse: Yuda, Yakobo vi, kpakple Yuda Iskariot, si zu yomemɔfiala. Yesu ƒe to dzi nyagbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: You well-fed people are in for trouble. You will go hungry! You people who are laughing now are in for trouble. You are going to cry and weep!
translation_verse: Baba na mi, amesiwo ƒe ƒodo yɔ; elabena dɔ awu mi. Baba na mi amesiwo le nu kom azɔ la, elabena miafa konyi, eye miafa avi.

english_verse: These people had come to listen to Jesus and to be healed of their diseases. All who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.
translation_verse: eye wòda gbe le amesiwo gbɔgbɔ blibawo le fu ɖem na la ŋu.

english_verse: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!
translation_verse: Woayra mi, amesiwo dɔ le mia wum azɔ la, elabena míaɖi ƒo. Woayra mi, amesiwo le avi fam azɔ la, elabena miako nu.

english_verse: God will bless you when others hate you and won't have anything to do with you. God will bless you when people insult you and say cruel things about you, all because you are a follower of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Woayra mi, ne amewo alé fu mi, eye woaɖe mi le woƒe ha me, eye woadzu mi, eye woatso miaƒe ŋkɔ aƒu gbe abe vɔ̃ ene le Amegbetɔvi la ta.

english_verse: You are in for trouble when everyone says good things about you. That is what your own people said about those prophets who told lies. Love for Enemies (Matthew
translation_verse: Baba na mi, ne amewo katã aƒo nu nyuie le mía ŋuti; elabena nenema ke wo fofowo wo na aʋatsonyagblɔɖilawo.

english_verse: If you give to others, you will be given a full amount in return. It will be packed down, shaken together, and spilling over into your lap. The way you treat others is the way you will be treated.
translation_verse: mina, eye woana mi, dzidzenu nyui, si wote, eye woʋuʋu wògbã go la, woatsɔ aɖo miaƒe akɔ; elabena dzidzenu, si mietsɔ dzidze la, eya ke woatsɔ adzidze na miawo hã.

english_verse: is like someone who dug down deep and built a house on solid rock. When a flood came and the river rushed against the house, it was built so well that it didn't even shake.
translation_verse: Eɖi amea ɖe, si le xɔ; tum, amesi ku do wògoglo, eye wòɖo egɔme anyi ɖe kpe gbadza dzi; ke esi to ɖo, eye tɔsisi ƒo ɖe xɔ ma ŋu la, mete ŋu ʋuʋui o le eƒe tutu nyui ta.

english_verse: If someone slaps you on one cheek, don't stop that person from slapping you on the other cheek. If someone wants to take your coat, don't try to keep back your shirt.
translation_verse: Amesi ƒo tome ɖeka na wò la, nyẽ ekeme hã nɛ, eye amesi tso wò awu la, megagbe wò avɔ hã tsɔtsɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: Give to everyone who asks and don't ask people to return what they have taken from you.
translation_verse: Na nu amesiame, si le biawòm, eye amesi tso wò nu la, megabia ta se o.

english_verse: Treat others just as you want to be treated.
translation_verse: Eye alesi miedi bena, amewo nawɔ na mi la, miawo hã miwo na wo nenema ke.

english_verse: If you love only someone who loves you, will God praise you for that? Even sinners love people who love them.
translation_verse: Eye ne mielɔ̃a amesiwo lɔ̃a mi la, akpedada kae li na mi? Elabena nuvɔ̃wɔlawo hã lɔ̃a amesiwo lɔ̃a wo.

english_verse: If you are kind only to someone who is kind to you, will God be pleased with you for that? Even sinners are kind to people who are kind to them.
translation_verse: Elabena ne miewɔ nu nyui na amesiwo woa nu nyui na mi la, akpedada kae li na mi? Nuvɔ̃wɔlawo hã woa nenema ke.

english_verse: Have pity on others, just as your Father has pity on you. Judging Others (Matthew
translation_verse: Mizu nublanuikpɔlawo, abe alesi mia Fofo hã nye nublanuikpɔla ene.

english_verse: Jesus said: Don't judge others, and God won't judge you. Don't be hard on others, and God won't be hard on you. Forgive others, and God will forgive you.
translation_verse: Migadɔ ʋɔnu, eye woagadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi o; migabu fɔ, eye woagabu fɔ mi o, miɖe asi le amewo ŋu, eye woaɖe asi le mia ŋu;

english_verse: Jesus also used some sayings as he spoke to the people. He said: Can one blind person lead another blind person? Won't they both fall into a ditch?
translation_verse: Eye wòdo lo hã na wo bena: Ɖe ŋkuagbãtɔ ate ŋu akplɔ ŋkuagbãtɔa? Alo ɖe wo ame eve la katã madze do me o mahã?

english_verse: Are students better than their teacher? But when they are fully trained, they will be like their teacher.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la mewua eƒe nufiala o, ke amesiame, si wofia nui la, lanɔ abe eƒe nufiala ene.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Ke nukaŋuti nèkpɔ ati fefee le nɔviwò ƒe ŋku me, eye mèdzea si atikpo, si le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku me la o mahã?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: Aleke lawɔ nate ŋu agblɔ na nɔviwò bena: Nɔvinye, na mɔm, ne maɖe ati fefee, si le wò ŋku me, esi wò ŋutɔ mèkpɔ atikpo, si le wò ŋku me la o mahã? Alakpatɔ, ɖe atikpo la le wò ŋku me gbã, eye ekema nakpɔ nyuie be, naɖe ati fefee, si le nɔviwò ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Elabena ati nyuia ɖeke meli, si tsea ku manyomanyo o, eye ati manyomanyoa ɖeke hã metsea ku nyui o.

english_verse: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Elabena ati sia ati ŋutɔ ƒe tsetse wotsɔna dzea sii; elabena womegbea gbowo le ŋutiwo dzi o, alo wotsoa weinkpo le ŋuve me o.

english_verse: Good people do good things because of the good in their hearts, but bad people do bad things because of the evil in their hearts. Your words show what is in your heart. Two Builders (Matthew
translation_verse: Ame nyui la ɖea nu nyui doa go tsoa eƒe dzi ƒe nu nyui dzraɖoƒe; eye ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖea nu vɔ̃ɖi doa go tsoa eƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi dzraɖoƒe; elabena nya, si, ke wu dzi la, eyae nu gblɔna.

english_verse: Why do you keep on saying that I am your Lord, when you refuse to do what I say?
translation_verse: Ke nukaŋuti miele yɔyem bena: Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ, eye miewɔ nusiwo megblɔ na mi la dzi o mahã?

english_verse: Anyone who comes and listens to me and obeys me
translation_verse: Amesiame, si va gbɔnye, eye wose nye nyawo, eye wòwɔ wo dzi la, mafia mi, amesi wòɖi:

english_verse: But anyone who hears what I say and doesn't obey me is like someone whose house wasn't built on solid rock. As soon as the river rushed against that house, it was smashed to pieces!
translation_verse: Ke amesi senɛ, eye mewɔa edzi o la, eɖi amea ɖe, si tu xɔ ɖe anyigba, eye meɖo egɔme anyi o, eye tɔsisi ƒo ɖe eŋu, eye wòmu enumake, eye xɔ ma ƒe atidzedze ɖi gblo.

english_verse: I have officers who give orders to me, and I have soldiers who take orders from me. I can say to one of them, ‘Go!’ and he goes. I can say to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes. I can say to my servant, ‘Do this!’ and he will do it.”
translation_verse: Elabena nye hã menye ame le ŋusẽ te, eye asrafowo le nye hã tenye, eye megblɔna na amesia be: Yi, eye wòyina, eye na ame bubu be: Va, eye wòvana, eye na nye dɔla be: Wɔ esia, eye wòwɔna.

english_verse: He loves our nation and even built us a synagogue.”
translation_verse: elabena elɔ̃ miaƒe dukɔ la, eye eya kee tu miaƒe ƒuƒoƒe la na mi.

english_verse: When the Lord saw the woman, he felt sorry for her and said, “Don't cry!”
translation_verse: Eye esi Aƒetɔ la kpɔ ahosi la la, eƒe dɔme trɔ ɖe eŋuti, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Megafa avi o!

english_verse: The leaders went to Jesus and begged him to do something. They said, “This man deserves your help!
translation_verse: Eye woawo la, esi wova Yesu gbɔ la, woɖe kuku nɛ vevie gblɔ bena: Edzee be, nawɔ esia nɛ;

english_verse: Simon answered, “I suppose it would be the one who had owed more and didn't have to pay it back.” “You are right,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Simon ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Mebu xa bena: Amesi wotsɔ geɖe wu kee lae. Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Ebui nyuie.

english_verse: In this town an army officer's servant was sick and about to die. The officer liked his servant very much.
translation_verse: Eye aʋafiaa ɖe ƒe dɔla, si nye ame vevi nɛ la, le dɔ lém ɖo kudo nu.

english_verse: And when he heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish leaders to ask him to come and heal the servant.
translation_verse: Eye esi wose Yesu ŋkɔ la, edɔ Yudatɔwo ƒe amegãwo ɖo ɖe egbɔ ɖe kuku nɛ bena, wòava ɖe eƒe dɔla.

english_verse: So Jesus went with them. When Jesus wasn't far from the house, the officer sent some friends to tell him, “Lord, don't go to any trouble for me! I am not good enough for you to come into my house.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu yi kpli wo. Ke esi eya, kple aƒe la dome megadidi o la, aʋafia la dɔ eƒe xɔlɔ̃wo ɖe egbɔ gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, megaɖe fu na ɖokuiwò o; elabena medzem bena, nava nye xɔ te o;

english_verse: And I am certainly not worthy to come to you. Just say the word, and my servant will get well.
translation_verse: eyaŋuti nyemebu ɖokuinye hã bena, edzem be, mava gbɔwò o, ke boŋ gblɔ nya ɖeka ko, eye nye dɔla ƒe lãme asẽ.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “In all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu se esiawo la, eƒe mo wɔ yaa le eŋuti, eye esi wòtrɔ la, egblɔ na ameha, si dze eyome la bena: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Le Israel gɔ̃ hã la nyemekpɔ xɔse sia tɔgbe kpɔ o.

english_verse: The officer's friends returned and found the servant well. A Widow's Son
translation_verse: Eye esi ame dɔdɔwo trɔ yi aƒe la, wokpɔ dɔla la bena, eƒe lãme sẽ. Nain-ɖekakpui la.

english_verse: As they came near the gate of the town, they saw people carrying out the body of a widow's only son. Many people from the town were walking along with her.
translation_verse: Ke esi wògogo du la ƒe agbo nu la, kpɔ ɖa, wotsɔ ame kukua ɖe, si nye tenuvi na dadaa, si nye ahosi la, le go domi, eye duametɔ geɖewo kpe ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus went over and touched the stretcher on which the people were carrying the dead boy. They stopped, and Jesus said, “Young man, get up!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wote va la, ede asi aɖaka la ŋuti; eye etsɔlawo tɔ ɖe tsitre. Eye wògblɔ bena: Ɖekakpui, mele egblɔm na wò bena: Tsi tre!

english_verse: The boy sat up and began to speak. Jesus then gave him back to his mother.
translation_verse: Eye ame kuku la fɔ bɔbɔ nɔ anyi, eye wòde asi nuƒoƒo me, eye wòtsɔe na dadaa.

english_verse: Everyone was frightened and praised God. They said, “A great prophet is here with us! God has come to his people.”
translation_verse: Eye vɔvɔ̃ lé wo katã, eye wokafu Mawu gblɔ bena: Nyagblɔɖila gãa ɖe tsi tre le mia dome, eye Mawu kpɔ eƒe dukɔ la ɖa.

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over Judea and everywhere else in that part of the country. John the Baptist (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye nya sia ɖi hoo le eŋuti le Yudea blibo la kple nutoawo katã me godoo. Yohanes dɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖe Yesu gbɔ.

english_verse: John's followers told John everything that was being said about Jesus. So he sent two of them to ask the Lord, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: Eye Yohanes yɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dome lãme eve va egbɔ, eye wòdɔ wo do ɖe Aƒetɔ la gbɔ gblɔ bena: Alo wòe nye amesi gbɔna loo, alo ame bubua ɖee míakpɔ mɔ na mahã?

english_verse: When these messengers came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are you the one we should be looking for? Or are we supposed to wait for someone else?’ ”
translation_verse: Eye esi ŋutsuawo va egbɔ la, wogblɔ bena: Yohanes, mawutsidetanamelae do mí ɖo ɖe gbɔwò bena: Wòe nye amesi gbɔna loo, alo ame bubua ɖee míakpɔ mɔ na mahã?

english_verse: At that time Jesus was healing many people who were sick or in pain or were troubled by evil spirits, and he was giving sight to a lot of blind people.
translation_verse: Eye le gaƒoƒo ma dzi la eda gbe le dɔléla geɖewo kple fukpelawo kple amesiwo me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo le la ŋu, eye wòna ŋkuagbãtɔ geɖewo kpɔ nu.

english_verse: Jesus said to the messengers sent by John, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard. Blind people are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People who have leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can now hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Miheyi ɖagblɔ nusi miekpɔ kple nusi miese la, fia Yohanes bena: Ŋkuagbãtɔwo le nu kpɔm, tekunɔwo le azɔli zɔm, eye anyidzelawo ŋuti le kɔkɔm; tokunɔwo le nu sem, ame kukuwo le tsitre tsim, eye wole nyanyuie la gblɔm fia ame dahewo.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Eye Woayra amesi mekpɔ nuɖiaɖia le ŋutinye o.

english_verse: After John's messengers had gone, Jesus began speaking to the crowds about John: What kind of person did you go out to the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Ke esi Yohanes ƒe ame dodowo dzo yina la, ede asi gbɔgblɔ me na amehawo le Yohanes ŋuti bena: Nuka kpo ge mieɖo go yi gbedzi mahã? Alo ayeti, si ya le ʋuʋum la mahã?

english_verse: What kind of man did you really go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who wear expensive clothes and live in luxury are in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Alo nuka gɔ̃ kpɔ ge mieɖo go yie? Alo amesi ɖo awu bɔbɔea? Kpɔ ɖa, amesiwo le awu ŋɔŋɔewo me, eye wole agbe vivi nom la, woawoe le fiamɔ̃wo me.

english_verse: What then did you go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was! I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Ekema nuka gɔ̃ kpɔ ge miedo go yie? Nyagblɔɖilaea? Ẽ, mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ewu nyagblɔɖila hã.

english_verse: In the Scriptures, God calls John his messenger and says, “I am sending my messenger ahead of you to get things ready for you.”
translation_verse: Esia enye amesi ŋuti woŋlɔ ɖo bena: „Kpɔ ɖa, mele ye dɔla dɔm ɖe ŋgɔwò, amesi adzra wò mɔ la ɖo le ŋgɔwò.“

english_verse: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Le amesiwo nyɔnuwo dzi dome la, ɖeke mewu Yohanes o: ke amesi nye suetɔ le mawufiaɖuƒe la me la, wu eyama.

english_verse: Everyone had been listening to John. Even the tax collectors had obeyed God and had done what was right by letting John baptize them.
translation_verse: Eye esi dukɔ la katã kple nudzɔlawo see la, wotso afia na Mawu, eye wona wotsɔ Yohanes ƒe mawutsi de ta na wo.

english_verse: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Ke farisitɔ kple sefiala, siwo mede mawutsi ta na o la, wowɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu numaɖinui na wo ɖokui.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?
translation_verse: Ameka gɔ̃ ŋuti matsɔ dzidzime sia ƒe amewo aɖoe, eye ameka woɖi mahã?

english_verse: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry!”
translation_verse: Woɖi ɖevi, siwo bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe asi me, eye wole wo nɔewo yɔm gblɔ bena: Mieku dze na mi, eye mieɖu ɣe o; míedzi konyifaha na mi, eye miefa avi o.

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “John has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Elabena Yohanes, mawutsidetanamela va, meɖua abolo o, menoa aha o, eye miegblɔ bena: Gbɔgbɔ vɔ le eme.

english_verse: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, “Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.”
translation_verse: Amegbetɔvi la va, ɖua nu, noa nu, eye miegblɔ bena: Nutsuɖula kple ahatsunola, nudzɔlawo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ƒe xɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what its followers do. Simon the Pharisee
translation_verse: Eye nunya la ƒe viwo katã tso afia nɛ. Nyɔnu nuvɔ̃wɔlaa ɖe si ami na Yesu.

english_verse: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him. So Jesus went to the Pharisee's home and got ready to eat.
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔa ɖe kpee be, wòaɖu nu kplii. Eye esi wòyi ɖe farisitɔ la ƒe me la, ebɔbɔ nɔ kplɔ̃ ŋuti.

english_verse: When a sinful woman in that town found out that Jesus was there, she bought an expensive bottle of perfume.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, nyɔnu nuvɔ̃wɔla ɖe le dua me, eye esi wònye bena, ele kplɔ ŋuti le farisitɔ la ƒe me la, etsɔ alabastrogoe, si me ami le la vɛ,

english_verse: Then she came and stood behind Jesus. She cried and started washing his feet with her tears and drying them with her hair. The woman kissed his feet and poured the perfume on them.
translation_verse: eye wòtsi tre ɖe emegbe le eƒe afɔ nu hele avi fam, eye wòde asi aɖatsifafa me ɖe eƒe afɔwo dzi, eye wòtutu wo kple taɖa, eye wòɖuɖɔ eƒe afɔwo ŋuti, eye wotsɔ ami la hesi na wo.

english_verse: The Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this and said to himself, “If this man really were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him! He would know that she is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ke esi farisitɔ, si kpee la, kpɔ esia la, egblɔ le ye ŋutɔ ɖokui me bena: Ɖe amesia nye nyagblɔɖila la, anya amesi kple amesi ƒomevi nye nyɔnu sia, si le asi dem eŋu; elabena nuvɔ̃wɔla wònye.

english_verse: Jesus said to the Pharisee, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” “Teacher, what is it?” Simon replied.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Simon, nyaa ɖe le asinye, be magblɔ na wò. Eye wògblɔ bena: Nufiala, gblɔe.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Two people were in debt to a moneylender. One of them owed him
translation_verse: Fenyila eve wole fetɔ ɖeka si; ɖeka nyi denario alafa atɔ̃, ke bubu nyi blaatɔ̃.

english_verse: But Jesus told the woman, “Because of your faith, you are now saved. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na nyɔnua bena: Wò xɔse la ɖe wò; yi ɖe ŋutifafa me!

english_verse: Since neither of them could pay him back, the moneylender said that they didn't have to pay him anything. Which one of them will like him more?”
translation_verse: Esi naneke mele wo si be, woaxee o la, etsɔe ke wo ame eve la katã. Azɔ wo dometɔ kae alɔ̃e awu mahã?

english_verse: He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, “Have you noticed this woman? When I came into your home, you didn't give me any water so I could wash my feet. But she has washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtrɔ ɖe nyɔnua gbɔ la, egblɔ na Simon bena: Ele nyɔnu sia kpɔma? Meva aƒewò me, eye mèna tsim be, maklɔ nye afɔwo ŋuti o, ke eya la fa aɖatsi ɖe nye afɔwo dzi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe taɖa hetutu wòe.

english_verse: You didn't greet me with a kiss, but from the time I came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.
translation_verse: Mèɖuɖɔ nu nam o; ke eya la tso esime wòva eme la, medzudzɔ nye afɔwo gbugbɔgbugbɔ o.

english_verse: You didn't even pour olive oil on my head, but she has poured expensive perfume on my feet.
translation_verse: Mesi ami ɖe ta nam o; ke eya la tsɔ ami hesi ɖe nye afɔwo ŋuti.

english_verse: So I tell you that all her sins are forgiven, and that is why she has shown great love. But anyone who has been forgiven for only a little will show only a little love.”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mele egblɔm na wò bena: Wotsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃, siwo sɔ gbɔ la kee, elabena elɔ̃ geɖe; ke amesi wotsɔ ʋee kee la, ʋee ko wolɔ̃na.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the woman, “Your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Wotsɔ wò nuvɔ̃wo ke wò!

english_verse: Some other guests started saying to one another, “Who is this who dares to forgive sins?”
translation_verse: Tete amesiwo le kplɔ̃a ŋuti kplii ta, de asi gbɔgbɔ me le woa ŋutɔ ɖokui me bena: Amekae nye esia, si tsɔa nuvɔ̃wo hã kena mahã?

english_verse: and so were some women who had been healed of evil spirits and all sorts of diseases. One of the women was Mary Magdalene, who once had seven demons in her.
translation_verse: kple nyɔnua ɖewo, amesiwo wòɖe tso gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo kple dɔlélewo me: Maria, si woyɔna be Magdalene, amesi me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ adre do go le

english_verse: The seeds that fell on rocky ground are the people who gladly hear the message and accept it. But they don't have deep roots, and they believe only for a little while. As soon as life gets hard, they give up.
translation_verse: Eye esiwo le kpe gbadza dzi la, woawo nye amesiwo, ne wole esem la, woxɔa nya la kple dzidzɔ, eye esiawo la ke meli na wo o, esiwo xɔna sena ɣeyiɣia ɖe, eye le tetekpɔ ƒe ŋkekewo me la woɖea megbe.

english_verse: Other seeds fell on rocky ground and started growing. But the plants did not have enough water and soon dried up.
translation_verse: Eye bubu ge ɖe kpe gbadza dzi, eye wòmie, eye wòyrɔ, elabena mekpɔ vɔnyigba o.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked the plants.
translation_verse: Ke bubu ge ɖe ŋuwo me, eye ŋua wo mie kplii, eye wovu tsyo edzi.

english_verse: So he answered: I have explained the secrets about God's kingdom to you. But for others I use stories, so they will look, but not see, and they will hear, but not understand. Jesus Explains the Story about a Farmer (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ bena: Miawo la wona mi bena, mianya mawufiaɖuƒe ƒe nu ɣaɣlawo, ke na ame bubuwo la le lododowo me bena, esi wole nu kpam la, ne woagakpɔe o, eye ne wole nu sem la, ne woagase egɔme o.

english_verse: There is nothing hidden that will not be found. There is no secret that will not be well known.
translation_verse: Elabena naneke mele ɣaɣla, si womelé ɖeɖe ge ɖe go o, eye naneke hã mele vivi me, si womelé nyanya ge alo le kekeli me va ge o.

english_verse: and while they were sailing across, he went to sleep. Suddenly a storm struck the lake, and the boat started sinking. They were in danger.
translation_verse: Eye esi woɖe ʋua la, edɔ alɔ̃, eye ahom tu le ta la dzi, eye woƒe ʋu la yɔ, eye woɖo xaxa me.

english_verse: This is what the story means: The seed is God's message,
translation_verse: Ke lo lae nye esi: Nuku la enye Mawu ƒe nya.

english_verse: The seeds that fell among the thornbushes are also people who hear the message. But they are so eager for riches and pleasures that they never produce anything.
translation_verse: Eye esi ge ɖe ŋuwo me la, woawo nye amesiwo see, eye wodzo heyi, eye agbagbadzedze kple kesinɔnuwo kple agbe ƒe dzidzɔwo vu tsyɔ wo dzi, eye wometsena ɖina o.

english_verse: Those seeds that fell on good ground are the people who listen to the message and keep it in good and honest hearts. They last and produce a harvest. Light (Mark
translation_verse: Eye esi le anyigba nyui la me la, woawo nye amesiwo se nya la kple dzi nyui, si dza, eye wòlé eme ɖe asi sesĩe, eye wotsena le dzigbɔɖanyi me.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the disciples, “Don't you have any faith?” But they were frightened and amazed. They said to each other, “Who is this? He can give orders to the wind and the waves, and they obey him!” A Man with Demons in Him (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Afika miaƒe xɔse le? Eye esi wole vɔvɔ̃m la, woƒe mo wɔ yaa wole gbɔgblɔm na wo nɔewo bena: Ameka gɔ̃e nye esia? Elabena ede se na ya wo kple tsi, eye woɖo toe. Yesu da gbe te gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ tɔa ɖe ŋu le Gadara gbɔ.

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a bowl or under a bed. A lamp is always put on a lampstand, so people who come into a house will see the light.
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖeke mesia akaɖi ɣlana ɖe ze te alo tsɔnɛ dana ɖe abati te o, ke boŋ wotsɔnɛ dana ɖe akaɖiti dzi, bena amesiwo ge ɖe eme la, nakpɔ keklẽ.

english_verse: But Jesus answered, “Someone touched me, because I felt power going out from me.”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ bena: Amea ɖe de asi ŋunye; elabena medze sii bena, ŋusẽ do go tso menye.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he told Jairus, “Don't worry! Have faith, and your daughter will get well.”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu see la, exɔ dzi ne bena: Megavɔ̃ o, xɔe se ko, eye wòaɖee!

english_verse: They begged Jesus not to send them to the deep pit, where they would be punished.
translation_verse: Eye woɖe kuku nɛ bena, megade se na yewo be, yewoayi ɖe do globo la me o.

english_verse: The people went out to see what had happened, and when they came to Jesus, they also found the man. The demons had gone out of him, and he was sitting there at the feet of Jesus. He had clothes on and was in his right mind. But the people were terrified.
translation_verse: Eye wodo go, be woakpɔ nusi va ve me, eye esi wova Yesu gbɔ la, wokpɔ amesi me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do go le la, ta ava hele anyinɔƒe le Yesu ƒe afɔ nu, eye eƒe mo ko, eye wovɔ̃.

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers went to see him, but because of the crowd they could not get near him.
translation_verse: Eye dadaa kple nɔviawo va egbɔ, eye womete ŋu te ɖe eŋu o le ameha la ŋuti.

english_verse: As Jesus was getting out of the boat, he was met by a man from this town. The man had demons in him. He had gone naked for a long time and no longer lived in a house, but in the graveyard.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòɖi go la, ŋutsua ɖe, si gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo le eme, eye megado awu kpɔ o, eye menɔa aƒe me o, negbe yɔdowo me ko la, do go tso dua me va kpee.

english_verse: Just then the man in charge of the synagogue came and knelt down in front of Jesus. His name was Jairus, and he begged Jesus to come to his home
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsua ɖe, si ŋkɔ enye Yairo, amesi nye ƒuƒoƒe ƒe amegã la va, eye wòdze klo ɖe Yesu ƒe afɔ nu hele kuku ɖem ne be, wòava ye ƒe me;

english_verse: One day, Jesus and his disciples got into a boat, and he said, “Let's cross the lake.” They started out,
translation_verse: Ke eva ve me le ŋkeke mawo dome ɖeka dzi bena, eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo yi ɖe ʋua ɖe me, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mina ne míayi ta la godo, eye woɖe ʋu yi.

english_verse: So they went to Jesus and woke him up, “Master, Master! We are about to drown!” Jesus got up and ordered the wind and waves to stop. They obeyed, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Ke wova egbɔ, eye wonyae gblɔ bena: Amegã, amegã, miele tsɔtsrɔ̃m! Eye wòfɔ blu ɖe ya kple ƒutsotsoeawo ta, eye wodzudzɔ, eye ɖoɖoe zi kpoo.

english_verse: The man saw Jesus and screamed. He knelt down in front of him and shouted, “Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want with me? I beg you not to torture me!”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòkpɔ Yesu la, edo ɣli, eye wòdze klo nɛ hegblɔ kple gbe sesẽ bena: Nya ka le mía kpli wò domea? Yesu, Mawu, dziƒovĩtɔ la ƒe Vi! Meɖe kuku na wò, megawɔ funyafunyam o.

english_verse: When the men taking care of the pigs saw this, they ran to spread the news in the town and on the farms.
translation_verse: Ke esi wo kplɔlawo kpɔ nusi va ve me la, wosi, eye wògblɔe fia le dua me kple agbletawo.

english_verse: He said this because Jesus had already told the evil spirit to go out of him. The man had often been attacked by the demon. And even though he had been bound with chains and leg irons and kept under guard, he smashed whatever bound him. Then the demon would force him out into lonely places.
translation_verse: Elabena ede se na gbɔgbɔ bliba la be, wòado go tso ame la me Elabena enyamanɛ enuenu, eye esi wole eŋu dzɔm la, wobiae kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ, eye wode kunyowu eƒe afɔwo, eye wòŋe gãwo, eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la nyae ɖe gbe.

english_verse: Jesus asked the man, “What is your name?” He answered, “My name is Lots.” He said this because there were “lots” of demons in him.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu biae bena: Ŋkɔwò ɖe? Eye wògblɔ bena: Legio, elabena gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ geɖe yi ɖe eme.

english_verse: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. So the demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and Jesus let them go.
translation_verse: Eye aƒeha geɖewo le afima le gbe: ɖum le to la dzi, eye woɖe kuku nɛ bena, wòaɖe mɔ na yewo be, yewoayi ɖe woawo me. Eye wòɖe mɔ na wo.

english_verse: Then the demons left the man and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do go tso ame la me heyi ɖe hawo me, eye hawo si du kplikplikpli tso to la kɔgo ge ɖe ƒu la me, eye wono tsi ku.

english_verse: Then all who had seen the man healed told about it.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo kpɔe la, gblɔe na wo, alesi woɖe gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ to la.

english_verse: Everyone from around Gerasa begged Jesus to leave, because they were so frightened. When Jesus got into the boat to start back,
translation_verse: Tete eye Gadara nutometɔwo katã va ɖe kuku nɛ be, wòadzo le yewo gbɔ; elabena vɔvɔ̃ gã lé wo; eye eya la, esi wòɖo ʋua la, egagbugbɔ.

english_verse: the man who had been healed begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him off and said,
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsu, si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ɖo go le la, ɖe kuku nɛ bena, yeana egbɔ; ke edo mɔe gblɔ bena:

english_verse: “Go back home and tell everyone how much God has done for you.” The man then went all over town, telling everything that Jesus had done for him. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Matthew
translation_verse: Trɔ yi aƒewò me, eye naxlẽ nusiwo Mawu wo na wò la afia. Eye wòdzo yi hele gbe ƒã ɖem nusiwo Yesu wo nɛ la, to ɖu blibo la katã me. Yesu da ebe le Yairo ƒe vinyɔnuvi kple nyɔnua ɖe, si le ʋusisidɔ lém la ŋu.

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent everything she had on doctors, but none of them could make her well.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnua ɖe, si le ʋusisidɔ lém ƒe wuieve sɔŋ, amesi gblẽ eƒe agbemenuwo katã na gbedalawo, eye ɖeke mete ŋu da gbe eŋu o la,

english_verse: Everyone had been waiting for Jesus, and when he came back, a crowd was there to welcome him.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu tra va la, ameha la xɔe kple dzidzɔ; elabena wo katã wole elalam.

english_verse: because his twelve-year-old child was dying. She was his only daughter. While Jesus was on his way, people were crowding all around him.
translation_verse: elabena vianyɔnuvi ɖeka pɛ, si xɔ ƒe anɔ ƒe wuieve la, le esi, eye eya le kudɔ ƒom. Ke esi wòyina la, ameha la mimii ɖo.

english_verse: As soon as she came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes, her bleeding stopped.
translation_verse: va te ɖe eŋu le emegbe, eye wòde asi eƒe awu to ŋu; eye enumake eƒe ʋusisi la nu tso.

english_verse: “Who touched me?” Jesus asked. While everyone was denying it, Peter said, “Master, people are crowding all around and pushing you from every side.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ bena: Amekae nye amesi de asi ŋutinye mahã? Eye esi wo katã wosẽ nu la, Petro kple amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋu la, gblɔ bena: Amegã, amehawo mimi wò ɖo, eye wote ɖe dziwò, eye nèle gbɔgblɔm bena: Amekae de asi nunyea?

english_verse: The woman knew that she could not hide, so she came trembling and knelt down in front of Jesus. She told everyone why she had touched him and that she had been healed at once.
translation_verse: Ke esi nyɔnua kpɔ bena, womeɣla ye o la, eva kple dzodzo nyanyanya, eye wòdze klo ne, eye woxlẽ nusi ŋuti wòde asi eŋu, kple alesi eƒe lãme sẽ enumake la, fia le ameha la katã ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ ne bena; Vinyɔnuvi, wò xɔse la ɖe wò, yi ɖe ŋutifafa me!

english_verse: While Jesus was speaking, someone came from Jairus' home and said, “Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore?”
translation_verse: Esi wogale nuƒoƒo dzi la, amea ɖe tso ƒuƒoƒemegã la ƒe me va gblɔ bena: Wò nyɔnuvi la ku, megaɖe fu na nufiala o!

english_verse: Jesus went into the house, but he did not let anyone else go with him, except Peter, John, James, and the girl's father and mother.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva aƒea me la, meɖe mɔ na amea ɖeke be, wòava me kplii o, negbe Petro kple Yohanes kple Yakobo kpakple ɖevi la fofo kple dada ko.

english_verse: Everyone was crying and weeping for the girl. But Jesus said, “The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: Eye wo katã wole avi fam, eye wole konyi fam nɛ. Ke egblɔ bena: Migafa avi o! Meku o, alɔ̃ ko dɔm wòle.

english_verse: The people laughed at him because they knew she was dead.
translation_verse: Eye wokoe, esi wonyã bena, eku.

english_verse: Jesus took hold of the girl's hand and said, “Child, get up!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wonyã wo katã do go la, elé eƒe alɔnu, eye wòyɔe gblɔ bena: Ɖevi, tsi tre!

english_verse: She came back to life and got right up. Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe gbɔgbɔ la gagbugbɔ, eye wòtsi tre enumake, eye wòɖo bena, woana wòaɖu nu.

english_verse: Her parents were surprised, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo eƒe dzilawo; ke egbe nya na wo be, woagagblɔ nusi va ve me la, na amea ɖeke o.

english_verse: The apostles came back and told Jesus everything they had done. He then took them with him to the village of Bethsaida, where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Eye esi apostoloawo tro va la, woxlẽ nusiwo wowɔ la fiae. Eye wòtso wo kpe ɖe eɖokui ŋu hekplɔ wo ɖe aga ɖe dua ɖe, si woyɔna be Betsaida la me.

english_verse: They did this, and all the people sat down.
translation_verse: Eye wowɔ nenema, eye wona wo katã bɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: Herod the ruler heard about all that was happening, and he was worried. Some people were saying John the Baptist had come back to life.
translation_verse: Ke esi dziɖula Herodes se nusiwo katã wòwɔ la, etsi dzodzodzoe, elabena amea ɖewo gblɔ be: Yohanes tsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome;

english_verse: He told them, “Don't take anything with you! Don't take a walking stick or a traveling bag or food or money or even a change of clothes.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Migatsɔ naneke ɖe asi hena mɔzɔzɔ o, ati loo, alo kotoku alo abolo alo klosalo alo awu eve o.

english_verse: When you are welcomed into a home, stay there until you leave that town.
translation_verse: Eye aƒe, si ke me miage ɖo la, minɔ afima, eye miagadze mɔ atso afima.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon the twelve apostles came to Jesus and said, “Send the crowd to the villages and farms around here. They need to find a place to stay and something to eat. There is nothing in this place. It's like a desert!”
translation_verse: Eye esi fiẽ le ɖoɖom la, ame wuieveawo va egbɔ gblɔ ne bena: Ɖe asi le ameha la ŋu, bena wòayi ɖe kɔƒeawo me kple agbleta, siwo ƒo xlã mi la, eye wòadze afima, eye woakpɔ nuɖuɖu, elabena gbedzi míele le afisia.

english_verse: While he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became shining white.
translation_verse: Eye esime wòle gbe dom ɖa la, eƒe mo ƒe dzedzeme trɔ, eye eƒe awu fu tititi hele dzo dam kaŋkaŋ.

english_verse: Jesus strictly warned his disciples not to tell anyone about this. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke egbe nya na wo, eye wòɖe se na wo bena, woagagblɔ esia na amea ɖeke o

english_verse: “Pay close attention to what I am telling you! The Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies.”
translation_verse: Miawo la milé nya sia ɖo miaƒe towo me; elabena wole Amegbetɔvi la de ge asi na amewo.

english_verse: But a lot of people found out about this and followed him. Jesus welcomed them. He spoke about God's kingdom and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Ke esi amehawo dze sii la, wodze eyome, eye wòxɔ wo, eye wòƒo nu na wo le mawufiaɖuƒe ŋuti, eye amesiwo hiã gbedala la, eda gbe le wo ŋu.

english_verse: “Don't stop him!” Jesus said. “Anyone who isn't against you is for you.” A Samaritan Village Refuses To Receive Jesus
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ ne bena: Migagbe nɛ o; elabena amesi meto vo ɖe mía ŋuti o la, eya le mía dzi.

english_verse: About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James with him and went up on a mountain to pray.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me anɔ ŋkeke enyi le nya siawo megbe bena, esi wòɖe Petro kple Yohanes kple Yakobo kpe ɖe eɖokui ŋu la, eyi to la dzi, be yeado gbe ɖa.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will save it.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke ɖi bena, yeaɖe yeƒe agbe la, atsrɔe, ke amesi ke atsrɔ̃ eƒe agbe le tanye la, aɖee.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself or waste your life?
translation_verse: Elabena viɖe ka wòanye na ame, ne xexeme blibo la katã zu etɔ, eye woatsrɔ̃, alo wòabu ye ŋutɔ ɖokui mahã?

english_verse: If you are ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in his glory and in the glory of his Father and the holy angels.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke kpe ŋu nye kple nye nyawo la, Amegbetɔvi la akpe ŋu eya hã, ne ava le eya ŋutɔ kple Fofoa kple mawudɔla kɔkɔeawo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: They appeared in heavenly glory and talked about all that Jesus' death in Jerusalem would mean.
translation_verse: amesiawo ɖe wo ɖokui fia le ŋutikɔkɔe me, eye woƒo nu le eƒe gododo, si nu wu ge wòala le Yerusalem la ŋuti.

english_verse: ) While everyone was still amazed at what Jesus was doing, he said to his disciples,
translation_verse: Eye alɔ̃ tsɔ Petro kple amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋu la ŋutɔ, ke esi woƒe mo kɔ keŋ la, wokpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la kple ŋutsu eve, siwo le tsitre ɖe egbɔ.

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, a shadow from a cloud passed over, and they were frightened as the cloud covered them.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòle nusiawo gblɔm la, alilikpo va, eye wòdo vɔvɔli ɖe wo dzi; ke wovɔ̃, esi woyi ɖe alilikpo la me.

english_verse: From the cloud a voice spoke, “This is my chosen Son. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Eye gbe ɖi tso alilikpo la me gblɔ bena: Amesia enye vinye tiatia, miɖo to eyama!

english_verse: After the voice had spoken, Peter, John, and James saw only Jesus. For some time they kept quiet and did not say anything about what they had seen. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye esi gbe la ɖi la, wokpɔ Yesu ɖeka ko. Eye wozi kpi, eye wometo nusiwo wokpɔ la ƒe ɖeke na amea ɖeke le ŋkeke mawo me o. Yesu da ebe le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ tɔa ɖe ŋu. Yesu gblɔ eƒe fukpekpe ŋu nya ɖi zi evelia.

english_verse: A demon often attacks him and makes him scream. It shakes him until he foams at the mouth, and it won't leave him until it has completely worn the boy out.
translation_verse: eye kpɔ ɖa, gbɔgbɔa ɖe lénɛ, eye kasia wòdoa ɣli, eye wònyamanɛ ale bena, futukpɔ dona le enu, eye bebli hafi wòdzona le edzi, eye wògbãa lãme nɛ bliblibli.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You people are stubborn and don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you?” Then Jesus said to the man, “Bring your son to me.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: O, dzidzime maxɔse kple dzidzime totro kpaɖikpaɖi! Ɣekaɣi dzi manɔ anyi kpli mi, eye mado dzi ahe mi ase ɖo mahã? Kplɔ viwò la va afisi.

english_verse: While the boy was being brought, the demon attacked him and made him shake all over. Jesus ordered the demon to stop. Then he healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
translation_verse: Eye esi wògbɔna la, gbɔgbɔ la hee ƒu anyi, eye wònyamae ŋutɔ. Ke Yesu wo ɖe gbɔgbɔ bliba la ta, eye wòda gbe le ɖevi la ŋu, eye wòtsɔe na fofoa.

english_verse: But the disciples did not know what he meant. The meaning was hidden from them. They could not understand it, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke woawo la womese nya sia gɔme o, eye wòle ɣaɣla ɖe wo bena, ne womagadze sii o, eye wova le nya sia biabia ŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were arguing about which one of them was the greatest.
translation_verse: Eye nusesẽa ɖe ɖo wo dome bena, yewo dometɔ kae nye gã wu?

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he had a child stand there beside him.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu kpo woƒe dzimesusuwo la, etso ɖevia ɖe ɖo exa;

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me. Whichever one of you is the most humble is the greatest.” For or against Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Amesi ke axa ɖevi sia le nye ŋkɔ dzi la, nyee wòxɔ, eye amesi ke axɔm la, exɔ amesi dom la; elabena amesi ke nye suetɔ le mi katã dome la, eyae nye gatɔ.

english_verse: John said, “Master, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But we told him to stop, because he isn't one of us.”
translation_verse: Eye Yohanes xɔ dzi gblɔ bena: Amegã, miekpɔ amea ɖe le gbɔgbɔ vɔwo nyẽm le go dom le wò ŋkɔ dzi; eye miegbe nɛ, elabena mele mía yome o.

english_verse: Not long before it was time for Jesus to be taken up to heaven, he made up his mind to go to Jerusalem.
