translation_verse: Ke eva ve me, esime ŋkekeawo le enu wu ge be, woakɔe ayi dziƒo la, eya ŋutɔ tsɔ eƒe ŋku ɖo Yerusalem yiyi dzi;

english_verse: He sent some messengers on ahead to a Samaritan village to get things ready for him.
translation_verse: eye wòdɔ dɔlawo ɖo ɖe eŋgɔ, eye esi wole yiyim la, wova ge ɖe Samariatɔwo ƒe dua ɖe me, be yewoadzra dzeƒe ɖo ɖi nɛ.

english_verse: But he was on his way to Jerusalem, so the people there refused to welcome him.
translation_verse: Eye womexɔe o, elabena Yerusalem yiyi ɖo eƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: When the disciples James and John saw what was happening, they asked, “Lord, do you want us to call down fire from heaven to destroy these people?”
translation_verse: Ke esi nusrɔ̃lawo, Yakobo kple Yohanes, kpɔe la, wogblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, èlɔ̃ bena, miana dzo natso dziƒo, eye wòafiã wo mahã?

english_verse: But Jesus turned and corrected them for what they had said.
translation_verse: Ke etrɔ, eye wòblu ɖe wo ta gblɔ bena: Alo mienyã gbɔgbɔ ka ƒomevi tɔ míenye o ba?

english_verse: Then they all went on to another village. Three People Who Wanted To Be Followers (Matthew
translation_verse: Elabena Amegbetɔvi la meva, be wòagblẽ amewo ƒe agbe o; ke boŋ, bena wòaɖe wo. Eye wodzo yi ɖe kɔƒe bubu me. Yesu yomedzela etɔ̃awo.

english_verse: Along the way someone said to Jesus, “I'll follow you anywhere!”
translation_verse: Ke esi wole mɔ dzi yina la, amea ɖe gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, afisi ke nayi ɖo la, manɔ yowòme.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't have a place to call his own.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Abeiwo kpɔ dowo, eye dziƒoxeviwo hã kpɔ atɔwo; ke Amegbetɔvi la mekpɔ afisi wòatsɔ ta aziɔ ɖo o.

english_verse: Jesus told someone else to come with him. But the man said, “Lord, let me wait until I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na ame bubu bena: Dze yonyeme! Ke eya gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, ɖe mɔ nam, be mayi aɖaɖi fofonye hafi.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Let the dead take care of the dead, while you go and tell about God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ ne bena: Na ame kukuawo naɖi woa ŋutɔwo ƒe kukuawo; ke wò la yi ɖagblɔ mawufiaɖuƒe la fia.

english_verse: Then someone said to Jesus, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first let me go back and take care of things at home.”
translation_verse: Eye ame bubu hã gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, manɔ yowòme; gake ɖe mɔ nam, be mayi aɖaklã amesiwo le aƒenye me hafi.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Anyone who starts plowing and keeps looking back isn't worth a thing to God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Amesi tsɔ eƒe asi ɖa ɖe kodzi dzi, eye wogale megbe kpɔm la, medze mawufiaɖuƒe la o.

english_verse: He said to them: A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers. Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nuŋeŋe la sɔ gbɔ, ke dɔwɔlawo meɖe ha o; eyaŋuti miɖe kuku na nuŋeŋe la ƒe Aƒetɔ bena, wòadɔ dɔwɔlawo aɖo ɖe eƒe nuŋeŋe la me.

english_verse: Now go, but remember, I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves.
translation_verse: Miheyi! Kpɔ ɖa, mele mia dɔm abe alẽviwo ene ɖo ɖe amegãxiwo dome.

english_verse: Don't take along a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals. And don't waste time greeting people on the road.
translation_verse: Migatsɔ gakotoku alo mɔzɔkotoku alo atokotawo o, eye migado gbe na amea ɖeke le mɔ dzi o.

english_verse: As soon as you enter a home, say, “God bless this home with peace.”
translation_verse: Eye aƒe, si ke me miayi ɖo la, gbã migblɔ bena: Ŋutifafa na aƒe sia!

english_verse: If the people living there are peace-loving, your prayer for peace will bless them. But if they are not peace-loving, your prayer will return to you.
translation_verse: Eye ne ŋutifafamea ɖe le afima la, miaƒe ŋutifafa anɔ edzi; ke ne menye nenem o la, agagbugbɔ ava mia dzi.

english_verse: Stay with the same family, eating and drinking whatever they give you, because workers are worth what they earn. Don't move around from house to house.
translation_verse: Eye aƒe ma me ke mianɔ, aɖu, eye ano nusi ke le wo si; elabena dɔwɔla dze eƒe fetu. Migatso aƒe me yi aƒe me o.

english_verse: If the people of a town welcome you, eat whatever they offer.
translation_verse: Eye ɖu, si ke me mieyi ɖo, eye woxɔ mi la, miɖu nusiwo ke wotsɔ ɖo mia kɔme,

english_verse: Heal their sick and say, “God's kingdom will soon be here!”
translation_verse: eye mida gbe le dɔléla, siwo le eme la ŋu, eye migblɔ na wo bena: Mawufiaɖuƒe la gogo mi vɔ!

english_verse: But if the people of a town refuse to welcome you, go out into the street and say,
translation_verse: Ke du, si ke me miege ɖo, eye womexɔ mi o la, miyi ɖe eƒe ablɔwo me, eye migblɔ bena:

english_verse: I tell you that on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than the people of that town! The Unbelieving Towns (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi bena: Mele sesẽ ge na Sodom le ŋkeke ma dzi abe du ma ene o.

english_verse: But don't be happy because evil spirits obey you. Be happy that your names are written in heaven! Jesus Thanks His Father (Matthew
translation_verse: Gake migakpɔ dzidzɔ bena, gbɔgbɔawo ɖoa to mi o; ke mikpɔ dzidzɔ bena, woŋlɔ miaƒe ŋkɔwo ɖi le dziƒowo. Yesu kafu Fofoa.

english_verse: Many prophets and kings were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear.” The Good Samaritan
translation_verse: elabena mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nyagblɔɖila kple fia geɖewo ɖi bena, yewoakpɔ nusiwo kpɔm miawo miele, eye womekpɔe o, eye be, yewoase nusiwo sem miele, eye womesee o. Lododo le Samaria-ŋutsu amenuvetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Tyre and Sidon will get off easier than you will.
translation_verse: Gake mele sesẽ ge na Tiro kple Zidon le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la me abe miawo ene o.

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? Well, you will go down to hell!
translation_verse: Eye wò, Kapernaum, alo menye ɖe wokɔ wò ɖe dzi yi ɖatɔ dziŋgɔli me oa! Woate wò ɖe to vaseɖe tsiẽƒe ke.

english_verse: Jesus told them: I saw Satan fall from heaven like a flash of lightning.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mekpɔ Satana abe dzikedzo ene ge tso dziƒo.

english_verse: I have given you the power to trample on snakes and scorpions and to defeat the power of your enemy Satan. Nothing can harm you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mena ŋusẽ mi be, míado afɔ dawo kple dzidegbewo kpakple ketɔ la ƒe ŋusẽ katã dzi, eye naneke meli, si awɔ vɔ̃ mi gbeɖe o.

english_verse: An expert in the Law of Moses stood up and asked Jesus a question to see what he would say. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, sefialaa ɖe tsi tre le etem kpɔ gblɔ bena: Nufiala, nuka mawɔ, be manyi agbe mavɔ dome mahã?

english_verse: The man replied, “The Scriptures say, ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind.’ They also say, ‘Love your neighbors as much as you love yourself.’ ”
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Nalɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu, kple wò dzi blibo kple wò luʋɔ blibo kple wò ŋusẽ blibo kple wò tamesusu blibo, kpakple hawòvi, abe alesi nèlɔ̃a wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene.

english_verse: At that same time, Jesus felt the joy that comes from the Holy Spirit, and he said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people. Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Le gaƒoƒo ma ke dzi la etso aseye le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la me gblɔ bena: Fofo, dziƒo kple anyigba ƒe Aƒetɔ, mekafu wò, elabena ètsɔ nusiawo ɣla ɖe nunyalawo kple nugɔmeselawo, eye nèɖe wo fia vidzĩewo; ẽ, Fofo, elabena nenemae nyoa ŋuwò.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who really knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: Eye wòtrɔ ɖe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋu gblɔ bena: Fofonye tsɔ nuwo katã de asi nam; eye amea ɖeke menya amesi enye Vi la o, negbe Fofo la ko, kple amesi enye Fofo la o, negbe Vi la ko kple amesi ke Vi la lɔ̃ be, yeaɖee afiae.

english_verse: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, “You are really blessed to see what you see!
translation_verse: Eye wòtrɔ ɖe eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖeɖe ŋu gblɔ bena: Woayra ŋku, siwo le nusiwo kpɔm miele la kpɔm;

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them?”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Nuka woŋlɔ ɖe segbalẽa me mahã? Aleke xlẽm nèlea?

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Eɖo ŋu nyuie; wɔ esia, eye nakpɔ agbe.

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Ke eya la, esi wòle didim be, yeatso afia na eɖokui la, egblɔ na Yesu bena; Amekae nye hanyevi mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xɔ dzi gblɔ bena: Amea ɖe tso Yerusalem heyina Yerixo; eye wòɖaɖze adzodalawo si me, eye woɖe eƒe awu le eŋu, eye esi woɖe abi eŋu la, wodzo hegblẽe ɖi woku afã kple afã.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: Ke eva ve me bena, mawununɔlaa ɖe va to mɔ ma yina, eye esi wòkpɔe la, eto eŋu heyi.

english_verse: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.
translation_verse: Nenema ke Lewitɔa ɖe hã, esi wòva ɖo teƒe la, eye wòkpɔe la, eto eŋu heyi.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Ke Samariatɔa ɖe le mɔ zɔm va ɖo afisi wòle, eye esi wòkpɔe la, eƒe dome trɔ ɖe eŋu;

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: eye esi wòva egbɔ la, etsɔ ami kple wein hekɔ ɖe eƒe abiawo me, eye wòbia wo, eye esi wòtsɔe ɖo ye ŋutɔ ƒe lã dzi la, ekplɔe yi amedzrodzeƒe, eye wòkpɔ edzi.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Eye esi ŋu eke la, etso denario eve na aƒeatɔ, eye wògblɔ bena: Kpɔ edzi, eye nusi ke nagagblẽ ɖe edzi la, nye la le nye tɔtrɔgbɔ me la maɖo eteƒe na wò.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Ame etɔ̃ siawo dome la kae nèsusu be, ezu havi na amesi dze adzodalawo si me mahã?

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Amesi kpɔ nublanui nɛ lae. Ke Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Heyi, eye nawɔ nenema ke. Nɔvinyɔnu eveawo le Betania.

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me le woƒe mɔzɔzɔ me bena, eyi ɖe kɔƒea ɖe me; eye nyɔnua ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Marta la, xɔe ɖe eƒe me.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Eye nɔvinyɔnu, si woyɔna be Maria la, le esi, eye eya bɔbɔ nɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe afɔ nu, eye wòse eƒe nyawo.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Ke Marta le sreɖi dzem le subɔsubɔ geɖe ŋuti, eye wòva tsi tre gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, de mètsɔ ɖeke le eme bena, nɔvinye gblẽ nye ɖeka ɖi na subɔsubɔ o mahã? Gblɔe nɛ azɔ, ne woakpe asi ɖe eŋu nam.

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: elabena Maria lia nyuia gome, si womele xɔxɔ ge le esi o.

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Eye nye la mele egblɔm na mi bena: Mibia nu, eye woana mi; midi nu, eye miakpɔ; miƒo ʋɔa, eye woaʋui na mi.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Azɔ mí, amesiwo nye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, mienya alesi miana nunana nyui mia viwo, ʋuu keke Fofo, si le dziƒo la, mana Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe amesiwo bianɛ la o mahã? Yesu he nya ɖe farisitɔ, siwo di bena, yewoado vloe bebia dzesi tso dziƒo la ŋuti.

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: eye ɖe ame ma aɖo eŋu nɛ le xɔa me agblɔ bena: Megaɖe fu nam o; ʋɔ la le tutu xoxo, eye vinyewo le aba dzi kplim, nyemate ŋu afɔ ana wò o mahã?

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Ke fofo ka le mia dome, si via abia aboloe, eye wòana kpee, alo tɔmelã, eye wòana dae de tomelã teƒe mahã?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Ne miele gbe dom ɖa la, migblɔ bena: Mía Fofo, si le dziƒowo, wò ŋkɔ ŋuti nakɔ! Wò fiaɖuƒe nava! Woawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu le anyigba dzi, sigbe alesi wowɔna le dziƒo ene!

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Eye tsɔ miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke mí; elabena mía ŋutɔwo hã mietsɔnɛ kea amesiame, si nyia fe le mia si! Eye megalala mí yi ɖe tetekpɔa me o, ke ɖe mí tso vɔ̃ɖitɔ la si me!

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame, si le nu biam la, exɔna: eye amesi le nu dim la, ekpɔna; eye amesi le ʋɔa ƒom la, woʋunɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Elabena sigbe alesi Yona zu dzesi na Niniwe-tɔwo la, nenema ke Amegbetɔvi la hã lanyee na dzidzime sia.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me, esi wògblɔ nusiawo la, nyɔnua ɖe kɔ eƒe gbe dzi le ameha la dome gblɔ nɛ bena: Woayra dɔ, si me nènɔ, kple no, si nènɔ.

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Eye wòle gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ maƒo nu nyãm. Eye wòva ve me, esi gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la do go la, ame maƒonu la ƒo nu, eye amehawo ƒe mo wɔ yaa.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Eye bubuwo le etem kpɔ hele dzesi dim tso egbɔ tso dziƒo.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Ke esi wonyã woƒe tamesusuwo la, egblɔ na wo bena: Fiaɖuƒe sia fiaɖuƒe, si ma ɖe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti la, ezu aƒedo, eye xɔ mũ dze xɔ dzi.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Eye ne Satana hã ma ɖe ye ŋutɔ ŋuti la, aleke eƒe fiaɖuƒe la anɔ anyii mahã? Elabena miegblɔ bena, menya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ɖo goe to Beelzebul dzi.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Eye nye la, ne menya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ɖo goe to Beelzebul dzi la, ekema mia viwo la, ameka dzie woto nyã wo do goe mahã? Le esia ta woawo azu miaƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: Ne ŋusẽtɔ la ɖo aʋawɔnuwo me hele eƒe mɔ̃ ŋuti dzɔm la, eƒe nuwo nɔa dedie;

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: Baba na mi farisitɔwo! Elabena mielɔ̃a nɔƒe gbãtɔwo nanɔ le ƒuƒoƒewo, kple gbedonamewo le ablɔwo me.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Ke sefialawo dometɔ ɖeka: xɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Nufiala, esi nègblɔ esiawo la, èdzu miawo hã.

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: Esi gbɔgbɔ bliba la do go le ame la me la, eyi ɖato ƒuƒuiƒewo le dzudzɔ dim: eye esi mekpɔe o la, egblɔ bena: Magbugbɔ ayi ɖe aƒe, si me metso va la me.

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva la, ekpɔe wòle kpɔkplɔ, eye woɖo atsyɔ̃ nɛ.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: Tete la wòdzo heyi ɖatsɔ gbɔgbɔ bubu adre, siwo vɔ̃ɖi wu ye ŋutɔ hekpe ɖe eɖokui ŋuti, eye woyi ɖe eme, eye wonɔ afima, eye amesia ƒe anyinɔnɔ mlɔetɔ va vɔ̃ɖi wu gbãtɔ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke eya gblɔ bena: Ẽ, Woayra amesiwo le mawunya la sem, eye wole edzi wɔm la boŋ.

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Ke esi farisitɔ la kpɔe la, eƒe mo wɔ yaa bena, mele tsi gbã, hafi le nua ɖu ge o.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: Ke baba na mi farisitɔwo! Elabena mienaa ahamee kple ƒãglo kpakple ama bubu ƒomeviwo katã ƒe ewolia, eye mietoa ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ ŋuti; ke esiawo le be, miawo, eye miagagblẽ ekeme hã ɖi mawɔmawɔ o.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Eye esi amehawo le ƒu ƒom ɖe egbɔ la, ede asi gbɔgblɔ me bena: Dzidzime sia enye dzidzime vɔ̃ɖi; ele dzesi ɖim, eye womele dzesia ɖeke na gee o, negbe Yona ƒe dzesi la ko.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Dziehe-fianyɔnu la atsi tre le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la me kple dzidzime sia ƒe ŋutsuwo, eye wòabu fɔ wo; elabena etso anyigba seƒe ke va Salomo ƒe nunya se ge; eye kpɔ ɖa, amesi wu Salomo, le afisi!

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Niniwe-ŋutsuwo atsi tre le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la me kple dzidzime sia, eye woabu fɔe; elabena wotrɔ le woƒe dzi me le Yona ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe nu, eye kpɔ ɖa, amesi wu Yona, le afisi!

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke mesia akaɖi dana ɖe ɣaɣlaƒe alo afianu te o, ke ɖe akaɖiti dzi boŋ, bena amesiwo le yiyim ɖe eme la, nakpɔ kekeli.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Ŋutilã ƒe akaɖi enye wò ŋku; ne wò ŋku dzi dza la, wò ame blibo la katã hã me lakɔ; ke ne evɔ̃ɖi la, wò ame blibo la katã hã me lado viviti.

english_verse: So be sure your light isn't darkness.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti kpɔ nyuie, bena kekeli, si le mewò la, naganye viviti o.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Mi movitɔwo! Alo ɖe menye amesi wɔ eŋuti la, wɔ eme hã o mahã?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Baba na mi! Elabena mieɖɔa nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe yɔdowo ɖo, ke mia fofowoe wui wo.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòle nu ƒom la, farisitɔa ɖe de kuku nɛ be, wòava ɖu nu le ye gbɔ, eye esi wòyi ɖe eme la, ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ bena: Mi egbe farisitɔwo, mieklɔa kplu kple agba ŋuti, ke mia me yɔ fũ kple adzodada kple vɔ̃ɖinyenye.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Gake mietsɔ nusiwo le eme la, wɔ nunana na ame dahewo, eye kpɔ ɖa, nuwo katã le dzadze na mi.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Baba na mi! Elabena miele abe yɔdo, siwo mele dzedzem o ene, eye amesiwo le wo dzi zɔm la, womenyɛ o.

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Baba na mi sefialawo hã! Elabena mietsɔa agba kpekpe, siwo wu tsɔtsɔ la, ɖoa amewo dzi, eye mia ŋutɔwo la mietsɔa miaƒe asibide ɖeka ka agbawo ŋu o.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Ale míenye ɖaseɖilawo, eye miefiaa kpɔɖeŋu be, mia fofowo ƒe nuwɔwɔ la nyo mia ŋu; elabena woawoe wu wo, ke miawoe ɖoa woƒe yɔdowo ɖo.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Le esia ta hã Mawu ƒe nunya gblɔ bena: Madɔ nyagblɔɖilawo kple apostolowo aɖo ɖe wo gbɔ, eye woawu wo dome ɖewo, eye woati wo yome,

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: bena woabia nyagblɔɖila, siwo katã ƒe ʋu woda, ahe tso xexeme ƒe gɔmedzedze ta, atso dzidime sia si me

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: tso Abel ƒe ʋu dzi vaseɖe Zaxarya, amesi wowu le vɔsamlekpui kple xɔ la domee la, ƒe ʋu la dzi. Ẽ, mele egblɔm na mi bena: Woabiae atso dzidzime sia si me.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Baba na mi sefialawo! Elabena mietsɔ nunya ƒe safui la dzoe, mia ŋutɔwo mieyi ɖe eme o, eye amesiwo le yiyim ɖe eme la, miexe mɔ na wo.

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdo go tso afima la, agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo lée ɖe do me vevie ŋutɔ, eye wole aɖe dem nu me nɛ le nu geɖewo ŋuti,

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: hele eŋu dzɔm, be woadi nyaa ɖe atso eƒe nu me.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Esi ameha, si ƒe xexlẽme ade akpeakpewo, va ƒo ƒu ale bena, wole afɔ ɖom wo nɔewo dzi la, ede asi gbɔgblɔ me na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gbã bena: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le farisitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔ ʋaʋã, si nye alakpadada la, ŋuti.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Ke ne Mawu ɖo atsyɔ̃ alea na gbe, si le gbedzi egbe, eye etsɔ woatsɔe aƒu gbe ɖe kpodzo me la, geɖe wu wòawɔe na miawo, mi xɔseʋeetɔwo!

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke boŋ midi eƒe fiaɖuƒe la, eye woatsɔ nusiawo katã akpe ɖe eŋuti na mi.

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi, xɔ̃nyewo, bena: Migavɔ̃ amesiwo wua ŋutilã, eye esia megbe la naneke megale wo si wu bena, woawɔ o la o.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke woxlẽ miaƒe taɖawo katã hã. Migavɔ̃ o; mia tɔ vena wua atsutsre geɖewo tɔ.

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: Ha sue, megavɔ̃ o! Elabena edze mia Fofo la ŋu be, yeatsɔ fiaɖuƒe la na mi.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Midzra nusi le mia si, eye mina nu ame dahewo; miwɔ kotoku, siwo medo xoxo o la, na mia ɖokui, nu nyui, siwo nu metsina o la, ɖe dziƒo, afisi fiafitɔ megogo o, eye agbagblaʋui hã megblẽa nu le o.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: elabena Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la afia nusi miagblɔ la mi le gaƒoƒo ma dzi. Yesu xlɔ̃ nu dukɔ la kple nusrɔ̃lawo le anyigba dzi nuwo ŋuti.

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: Ke Mawu gblɔ ne bena: Ame tsibome, zã sia me ke woabia wò agbe le asiwò me; ke nusiwo nèdzra ɖo la, ameka tɔ woazu mahã?

english_verse: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesiame, si ke atsɔm aʋu me le amewo ƒe ŋku me la, Amegbetɔvi la hã aʋu eyama me le mawudɔlawo ƒe ŋku me;

english_verse: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.
translation_verse: ke amesi ke gbe nu le gbɔnye le amewo ƒe ŋku me la, woagbe nu le eya hã gbɔ le mawudɔlawo ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.
translation_verse: Eye ne wokplɔ mi yi ɖe ƒuƒoƒewo kple dziɖulawo kple ŋusẽtɔwo ƒe ŋku me la, migatsi dzimaɖi be, aleke miawɔ alo nuka tsɔ ge míala aɖe mia ɖokui nu alo agblɔ o;

english_verse: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.”
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖe tso ameha la me gblɔ nɛ bena: Nufiala, gblɔ na nɔvinye be, wòamã domenyinyi la me kplim.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Ame, amekae ɖom ʋɔnudrɔ̃la alo numãla ɖe mia dzi mahã?

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mikpɔ nyuie, eye milé be na mia ɖokui le ŋukeklẽ ŋuti; elabena ame ƒe agbe menɔa eƒe nukpɔkpɔ vivivo la me o.

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: eye wobu le eɖokui me bena: Nuka wɔ ge mala? Elabena nyemekpɔ afisi maƒo nye kutsetsewo nu ƒu ɖo o.

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Esia mawɔ: mamũ nye avawo, eye matu gatɔwo, eye afima maƒo nye nukuwo kple nye nu nyuiwo nu ƒu ɖo.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Le esia ta mele egblɔm na mi bena: Migatsi dzimaɖi le miaƒe agbe ŋuti nusi miaɖu o, alo le miaƒe ŋutilã ŋuti nusi míado o.

english_verse: Life is more than food or clothing.
translation_verse: Agbe la wu nunyiame, eye ŋutilã wu nutata.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: Mibu dzogbenyãwo ŋu, alesi wowɔnae: Wometrea ɖeti, alo lɔ̃a avɔ o: ke mele egblɔm na mi bena: Salomo gɔ̃ hã le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe katã me meɖo atsyɔ̃ abe esiawo dometɔ ɖeka ene o.

english_verse: Don't keep worrying about having something to eat or drink.
translation_verse: Eye miawo la, migadi nusi miaɖu alo nusi miano o, eye miaƒe tamesusu naganyama mi o.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Elabena nusiawo katã yome xexeame dukɔwo dina; ke mia Fofo nya bena, nusiawo hiã mi.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Ke ne dɔla ma gblɔ le eƒe dzi me bena: Nye aƒetɔ la ƒe vava he ɖe megbe, eye wòaɖe asi dɔlaŋutsuwo kple dɔlanyɔnuwo ƒoƒo me, eye wòaɖu nu, ano nu, eye wòamu aha;

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Miebu xa bena, ŋutifafa na ge meva le anyigba dzi mahã? Kpao, mele egblɔm na mi bena, memamã boŋ ye;

english_verse: Be ready and keep your lamps burning
translation_verse: Mina miaƒe aliwo dzi nanɔ babla, eye miaƒe akaɖiwo nanɔ bibim;

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Woayra dɔla ma, siwo, ne aƒetɔ la va la, akpɔ wo le ŋudzɔ; vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Asa avɔ ɖe ali, eye wòana be, woanɔ kplɔ ŋuti, eye wòatsa wo dzi asubɔ wo.

english_verse: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.
translation_verse: Eye ne ava le ŋudzɔɣi evelia kple etɔ̃lia me, eye wòakpɔ wo nenema la, woayra woamawo.

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Ke minya esia bena, ne aƒeatɔ anya gaƒoƒo, si dzi fiafitɔ ava la, anɔ ŋudzɔ, eye mana mɔe be, wòadze kpɔ age ɖe eƒe aƒe me o.

english_verse: So always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti miawo hã minɔ dzadzraɖoɖi; elabena Amegbetɔvi la ava le gaƒoƒo, si miele mɔ kpɔm ne o la dzi.

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Tete Petro gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, miawoe nèle lo sia dom na loo, alo na wo katã hã mahã?

english_verse: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ bena: Azɔ amekae nye xɔnuvi nuteƒewɔla kple nunyala, amesi eƒe aƒetɔ aɖo eƒe aƒemetɔwo dzi be, wòana woƒe nuɖuɖu wo le ɣeyiɣi nyui dzi mahã?

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Woayra dɔla ma, si, ne eƒe aƒetɔ va la, akpɔe be, èwɔ nenema.

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena, aɖoe eƒe nuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: dɔla ma ƒe aƒetɔ ava le ŋkeke, si mele mɔ kpɔm ne o kple gaƒoƒo, si menya o la dzi, eye wòafee ɖe eve, eye wòana eƒe gomee akpe ɖe ame mawɔnuteƒewo ŋu.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: Eye dɔla ma, si nya eƒe aƒetɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye medzrae do alo wɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu o la, woaƒoe geɖe;

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: eye amesi menyae o, ke wòwɔ nusi dze ƒoƒo la, woaƒoe ʋee. Eye amesiame, si wona nu geɖee la, woabia nu geɖe le esi; eye amesi wode nu geɖe, esi la, woabia nu geɖe wu le esi.

english_verse: I came to set fire to the earth, and I wish it were already on fire!
translation_verse: Meva dzo da ge ɖe anyigba dzi, eye nuka dim mele wu eƒe xoxo xoxo mahã?

english_verse: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.
translation_verse: Ke ele nam be, woade mawutsi ta nam kple mawutsia ɖe, eye ale wotee ɖe ŋunye, vaseɖe esime woawu enu!

english_verse: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.
translation_verse: elabena tso esia dzi yina la ame atɔ̃ ano aƒe ɖeka me, eye woamã wo me, etɔ̃ atsi tre ɖe eve ŋuti, eye eve atsi tre ɖe eta ŋuti.

english_verse: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other. Knowing What To Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Woamã fofo kple viŋutsu me, eye viŋutsu kple fofo me, ɖada kple vinyɔnu me, eye vinyɔnu kple ɖada me; lɔ̃xo kple visrɔ̃ me, eye visrɔ̃ kple lɔ̃xo me. Yesu xlɔ̃ nu le ɣeyiɣi la ƒe dzesiwo kple ame ɖokui le luʋɔ ɖeɖe ŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus said to all the people: As soon as you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say, “It's going to rain,” and it does.
translation_verse: Eye egblɔ na amehawo hã bena: Ne miekpɔ alilikpo le ɖoɖom le ɣetoɖoƒe la, enumake miegblɔna bena: Tsi gbɔna, eye wòva vea me nenema.

english_verse: When the south wind blows, you say, “It's going to get hot,” and it does.
translation_verse: Eye ne dzieheya le ƒoƒom la, miegblɔna bena: Xexeme le dzo xɔ ge, eye wòva vea me.

english_verse: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.
translation_verse: Alakpatɔwo! Mienya alesi miaɖo anyigba kple dziƒo ƒe ŋku me akpɔ: ke aleke wɔ, bena mienya alesi míado ɣeyiɣi sia akpɔ o mahã?

english_verse: Why don't you understand the right thing to do?
translation_verse: Eye nukaŋuti miekpɔa nusi dzɔ la me le mia ŋutɔwo mia ɖokui si o mahã?

english_verse: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mia kple wò ketɔ miele fia ƒe ŋku me yim la, dze agbagba le mo dzi be, naɖe ɖokuiwò le esi me; ne menye nenem o la, ahe wò ayi ʋɔnudrɔ̃la gbɔ, eye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la aɖe wò asi na atikplɔtɔ, eye atikplɔtɔ la ade wò gaxɔ me.

english_verse: You won't get out until you have paid the last cent you owe.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na wò bena: Màdo go le afima o, vaseɖe esime naxe ho mlɔetɔ.

english_verse: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ke le ɣemaɣi me la amea ɖewo le afima, siwo ka Galileatɔ, siwo ƒe ʋu Pilato tɔtɔ kple woƒe numemewo la, ŋutinya ta nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?
translation_verse: Eye wòxɔ dzi gblɔ na wo bena: Ɖe miesusu bena, Galileatɔ siawo nye nuvɔ̃wɔlawo wu Galileatɔwo katã, elabena wokpe fu siawo mahã?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.
translation_verse: Gbeɖe, ke boŋ mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ne mietrɔ le miaƒe dzi me o la, mi katã miatsrɔ̃ nenema ke.

english_verse: Jesus said, “What is God's kingdom like? What can I compare it with?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Nuka mawufiaɖuƒe la ɖi, eye nuka ŋu matsɔe aɖo mahã?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die. A Story about a Fig Tree
translation_verse: Gbeɖe, ke boŋ mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ne mietrɔ le miaƒe dzi me o la, mi katã miatsrɔ̃ nenema ke. Lododo le gboti matseku la ŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo lo sia bena: Amea ɖe do gboti ɖe eƒe weingble me, eye wòva ɖi kutsetsewo le edzi, eye mekpe ɖeke o.

english_verse: The gardener answered, “Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.
translation_verse: Eye wòxɔ edzi gblo nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, na wòanɔ anyi ƒe sia hã, vaseɖe esime maɖe ɖo aƒo xlãe, eye maku aɖu ɖe eŋu;

english_verse: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.” Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
translation_verse: ɖewohĩ ava tse ku; ke ne mele nenema o la, nalãe aƒu anyi.

english_verse: One Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in a synagogue,
translation_verse: Eye wòle nu fiãm le ƒuƒoƒeawo dometɔ ɖeka me le Sabat dzi.

english_verse: and a woman was there who had been crippled by an evil spirit for
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, nyɔnua ɖe, si me dɔléamegbɔgbɔa de le ƒe wuienyi, eye wòxa godã, eye metea ŋu koa eɖokui de dzi kulẽ o la, le afima.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the woman, he called her over and said, “You are now well.”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu kpoe la, eyae va egbe, eye wògblɔ ne bena: Nyɔnu, wotu wò tso wò dɔléle la me!

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Are you trying to fool someone? Won't any one of you untie your ox or donkey and lead it out to drink on a Sabbath?
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ la xɔ dzi gblo ne bena: Alakpatɔwo! Ɖe mia dome amesiame metua eƒe nyi alo tedzi le lãnuɖunu la ŋuti le Sabat dzi, be wòakplɔe ayi tsinoƒe o mahã?

english_verse: This woman belongs to the family of Abraham, but Satan has kept her bound for
translation_verse: Ke Abraham ƒe vinyɔnu sia, si Satana bla, kpɔ ɖa, ƒe wuienyi sɔŋ la, ɖe medze be, woatui le babla sia me le Sabat ŋkeke dzi o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus' words made his enemies ashamed. But everyone else in the crowd was happy about the wonderful things he was doing. A Mustard Seed and Yeast (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye esi wògblɔ esiawo la, ŋukpe lé eƒe adikãtɔwo katã, eye ameha la katã kpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋutikɔkɔedɔ, siwo katã wòwɔ la ŋuti. Lododo le logoku kple amɔwɔ ʋaʋã ŋuti.

english_verse: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said, “You had better get away from here, because Herod wants to kill you!”
translation_verse: Le gaƒoƒo ma me ke farisitɔa ɖewo va gblɔ nɛ bena: Do go, eye nadzo le afisia; elabena Herodes le didim be, yeawu wò.

english_verse: But I am going on my way today and tomorrow and the next day. After all, Jerusalem is the place where prophets are killed. Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Matthew
translation_verse: Gake ele nam be, mazɔ mɔ egbe kple etso kple ŋkeke, si dze eyome; elabena womeɖe mɔ be, woawu nyagblɔɖilaa ɖe le afia ɖeke o, negbe le Yerusalem ko.

english_verse: There the ones who are now least important will be the most important, and those who are now most important will be least important. Jesus and Herod
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, mlɔetɔwo li, siwo azu gbãtɔwo, eye gbãtɔwo li, siwo azu mlɔetɔwo. Herodes di bena, yeawu Yesu. Konyifafa le Yerusalem ŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus said to them: Go tell that fox, “I am going to force out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and three days later I'll be through.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miheyi ɖagblɔ na abei sia bena: Kpɔ ɖa, mele gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo nyãm, eye mele gbe dam amewo ŋu egbe kple etsɔ, eye ŋkeke etɔ̃lia dzi la mawu enu.

english_verse: It is like what happens when someone plants a mustard seed in a garden. The seed grows as big as a tree, and birds nest in its branches.”
translation_verse: Eɖi logoku, si amea ɖe tso ƒã ɖe eƒe abɔ me, eye wòtsi zu ati, eye dziƒoxeviwo va wɔ atɔ ɖe eƒe siawo me.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “What can I compare God's kingdom with?
translation_verse: Eye wògagblɔ bena: Nuka ŋu matso mawufiaɖuƒe la aɖoe mahã?

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he taught the people in the towns and villages.
translation_verse: Eye wòyi ɖato duwo kple kɔƒewo me hele nu fiãm, eye wòle mɔ zɔm yina Yerusalem.

english_verse: Do all you can to go in by the narrow door! A lot of people will try to get in, but will not be able to.
translation_verse: Miʋli be, miayi ɖe agbo bii la me, elabena mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ame geɖewo ladi be, wòayi ɖe eme, eye womate ŋui o.

english_verse: Once the owner of the house gets up and locks the door, you will be left standing outside. You will knock on the door and say, “Sir, open the door for us!” But the owner will answer, “I don't know a thing about you!”
translation_verse: Tso esia dzi, ne aƒetɔ la tsi tre, eye wòtu ʋɔa, eye ne míetsi tre ɖe egodo, de asi ʋɔtrua ƒoƒo me gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ, nui na mí la, axɔ dzi agblɔ na mi bena: Nyemenya mi, afisi mietso o,

english_verse: Then you will start saying, “We dined with you, and you taught in our streets.”
translation_verse: ekema miade asi gbɔgblɔ me bena: Mieɖu nu, eye mieno nu le ŋkuwò me, eye nèfia nu le míaƒe ablɔwo me.

english_verse: But he will say, “I really don't know who you are! Get away from me, you evil people!”
translation_verse: Eye wòagblɔ bena: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nyemenya mi, afisi mietso o; mite ɖa le gbɔnye, mi nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo katã!

english_verse: Then when you have been thrown outside, you will weep and grit your teeth because you will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Afima avifafa kple aɖukliɖuɖu lanɔ, ne miakpɔ Abraham kple Isak kple Yakob kple nyagblɔɖilawo katã le mawufiaɖuƒe la me, ke wotsɔ miawo ya ƒu gbe ɖe egodo.

english_verse: People will come from all directions and sit down to feast in God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Eye woatso ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe kple anyiehe kple dziehe ava, eye woanɔ kplɔ̃ ŋu le mawufiaɖuƒe la me.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, Yerusalem, si wu nyagblɔɖilawo, eye wòƒu kpe amesiwo wodɔ ɖo ɖe egbɔ! Zi nenie medi be, maƒo viwòwo nu ƒu, abe alesi koklonɔ ƒoa viawo nu ƒu ɖe eƒe aʋala le ene, eye mielɔ̃ o!

english_verse: Now your temple will be deserted. You won't see me again until the time when you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa woagblẽ miaƒe aƒe ɖi na mi aƒeɖoe. Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Miegale kpɔ ye ge o, vaseɖe esi me miagblɔ bena: Woayra amesi gbɔna le Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkɔa me.

english_verse: All of a sudden a man with swollen legs stood up in front of him.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, ame tetea ɖe le eƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Jesus turned and asked the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses, “Is it right to heal on the Sabbath?”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xa dzi gblo na sefialawo kple farisitɔwo bena: Woɖe mo be, woada gbe le Sabat dzi loo, alo womeɖe mɔ o mahã? Ke woawo la wozi kpi.

english_verse: But they did not say a word. Jesus took hold of the man. Then he healed him and sent him away.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòde asi eŋu la, eda gbe le eŋu, eye wòdo mɔe.

english_verse: There was nothing they could say. How To Be a Guest
translation_verse: Eye womete ŋu gaɖo nusiawo ŋu o.

english_verse: Jesus saw how the guests had tried to take the best seats. So he told them:
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdze si, alesi ame kpekpeawo tia nɔƒe gbãtɔwo la, edo lo na wo gblo bena:

english_verse: When you are invited to a wedding feast, don't sit in the best place. Someone more important may have been invited.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe kpe wò va srɔ̃ɖeƒe la, meganɔ nɔƒe gbãtɔ o; ɖewohĩ wokpe ame ŋkuta wu wò vɛ:

english_verse: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame, si ado eɖokui ɖe dzi la, woabɔbɔe ɖe anyi, eye amesi abɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi la, woadoe ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the man who had invited him: When you give a dinner or a banquet, don't invite your friends and family and relatives and rich neighbors. If you do, they will invite you in return, and you will be paid back.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na amesi kpee hã bena: Ne èɖo ŋdɔ- alo fiẽkplɔ̃ la, megayɔ xɔ̃wòwo alo nɔviwòwo, alo wò ƒometɔwo, alo hawòvi kesinɔtɔwo o, bena woawo hã nagakpe wò, eye woaɖo eteƒe na wò o.

english_verse: They cannot pay you back. But God will bless you and reward you when his people rise from death. The Great Banquet (Matthew
translation_verse: eye nazu yayrame, esi naneke mele wo si be, woaɖo eteƒe na wò o ŋuti; ke woaɖo eteƒe na wò le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe tsitretsitsi la me. Lododo le flẽnuɖuɖu gã la ŋu.

english_verse: When the servant returned, he said, “Master, I've done what you told me, and there is still plenty of room for more people.”
translation_verse: Eye ɖɔla la gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, wowɔ se, si nède la dzi, eye gake nɔƒe gali.

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking, one of the guests said, “The greatest blessing of all is to be at the banquet in God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Eye esi kplɔ̃ ŋuti nɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka se nusiawo la, egblɔ bena: Woayra amesi aɖu abolo le mawufiaɖuƒe la me!

english_verse: Jesus told him: A man once gave a great banquet and invited a lot of guests.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Amea ɖe ɖo fiẽkplɔ̃ gãa ɖe, eye wokpe ame geɖewo;

english_verse: When the banquet was ready, he sent a servant to tell the guests, “Everything is ready! Please come.”
translation_verse: eye esi fiẽnuɖuɣi la ɖo la, edɔ eƒe dɔla la be, woagblɔ na amesiwo wokpe la bena: Miva, elabena nuawo sɔ gbe vo.

english_verse: One guest after another started making excuses. The first one said, “I bought some land, and I've got to look it over. Please excuse me.”
translation_verse: Eye ameawo katã de asi taflatsedodo me kple tame ɖeka. Gbãtɔ gblɔ ne bena: Meƒle anyigba, eye wòle vevie nam be, mayi aɖakpɔe ɖa; meɖe kuku na wò, bui taflatse nam.

english_verse: Another guest said, “I bought five teams of oxen, and I need to try them out. Please excuse me.”
translation_verse: Bubu gblɔ bena: Meƒle nyi eveveve teƒe atɔ̃, eye meyina be, mado woakpɔ; meɖe kuku na wò, bui taflatse nam.

english_verse: The servant told his master what happened, and the master became so angry he said, “Go as fast as you can to every street and alley in town! Bring in everyone who is poor or paralyzed or blind or lame.”
translation_verse: Eye esi dɔla la trɔ va la, exlẽ nusiawo fia eƒe aƒetɔ. Tete aƒetɔ la ɖo dɔmedzoe, eye wògblɔ na eƒe ɖɔla la bena: Do go kaba yi ɖe ɖu la ƒe ablɔwo me kple kpɔdomiwo, eye nakplɔ ame dahewo kple nuwɔametɔwo kple ŋkuagbãtɔwo kple bunɔwo va afii.

english_verse: His master then told him, “Go out along the back roads and make people come in, so my house will be full.
translation_verse: Eye aƒetɔ la gblɔ na dɔla la bena: Do go yi mɔ gãwo dzi kple kpɔwo godo, eye nazi wo dzi be, woava me, bena nye aƒe la nayɔ fũ.

english_verse: Not one of the guests I first invited will get even a bite of my food!” Being a Disciple (Matthew
translation_verse: Elabena mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ŋutsu mawo, siwo wokpe la, dometɔa ɖeke maɖɔ nye fiẽnuɖuɖu la akpɔ o. Nugbegbe le ame ɖokui gbɔ.

english_verse: Large crowds were walking along with Jesus, when he turned and said:
translation_verse: Eye ameha geɖewo yi kplii, eye wòtrɔ gblɔ na wo bena:

english_verse: You cannot be my disciple, unless you love me more than you love your father and mother, your wife and children, and your brothers and sisters. You cannot follow me unless you love me more than you love your own life.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe va gbɔnye, eye melé fu fofoa kple dadaa kple srɔ̃a kple viawo kple nɔviaŋutsuwo kple nɔvianyɔnuwo, ẽ, ye ŋutɔ ƒe agbe gɔ̃ hã o la, mate ŋu anye nye nusrɔ̃la o.

english_verse: You cannot be my disciple unless you carry your own cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Amesi ke metsɔ eƒe atitsoga, eye wòva dze yonyeme o la, mate ŋu anye nye nusrɔ̃la o.

english_verse: Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. What is the first thing you will do? Won't you sit down and figure out how much it will cost and if you have enough money to pay for it?
translation_verse: Elabena ameka le mia dome, ne ele didim be, yeatu mɔ̃ la, mabɔbɔ nɔ anyi gbã, eye wòabu eŋu kɔnta, ne nu le esi, be wòawu enu la o mahã?

english_verse: Otherwise, you will start building the tower, but not be able to finish. Then everyone who sees what is happening will laugh at you.
translation_verse: Menye bena, ne eɖo egɔme anyi tso, eye mete ŋu wu enu o la, ne amesiwo katã kpɔe la, nade asi fewuɖuɖu me le eŋuti o,

english_verse: They will say, “You started building, but could not finish the job.”
translation_verse: agblɔ bena: Amesia de asi matutu me, eye mete ŋu wu enu o.

english_verse: If he thinks he won't be able to defend himself, he will send messengers and ask for peace while the other king is still a long way off.
translation_verse: Ke ne mele nenema o la, adɔ dɔlawo aɖo ɖe amesi le mɔ dzi ʋĩ gbɔna la gbɔ, be wòabia tomefafa.

english_verse: So then, you cannot be my disciple unless you give away everything you own. Salt and Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Azɔ nenema ke mia dome amesiame, si megbe nusiwo katã le esi la o la, mate ŋu anye nye nusrɔ̃la o.

english_verse: Salt is good, but if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made to taste salty again?
translation_verse: Dze la, nu nyui ye; ke ne dze hã bu eƒe vivi la, nuka woatsɔ ado vivi nɛ mahã?

english_verse: It is no longer good for the soil or even for the manure pile. People simply throw it out. If you have ears, pay attention!
translation_verse: Menyo na anyigba alo na aɖukpo dzi hã o; ɖeko woatsɔe aƒu gbe. Amesi to senu li ne la, nesee.

english_verse: I will go to my father and say to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against God in heaven and against you.
translation_verse: Matsi tre, eye mayi fofonye gbɔ, eye magblɔ nɛ bena: Fofo, mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe dziƒo ŋu kple ŋutiwò.

english_verse: The younger son said to his father, “Give me my share of the property.” So the father divided his property between his two sons.
translation_verse: eye wo dome ɖevitɔ gblɔ na fofoa bena: Fofo, tsa nuawo ƒe akpa, si nye tɔnye la nam. Eye wòmã nuawo me na wo.

english_verse: He had spent everything, when a bad famine spread through that whole land. Soon he had nothing to eat.
translation_verse: Ke esi wògblẽ wo katã vɔ la, dɔwuame sesẽa ɖe va anyigba ma katã dzi, eye hiã de asi etutu me.

english_verse: Tax collectors and sinners were all crowding around to listen to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke nudzɔlawo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo katã nɔa egbɔ vam nɔa to ɖomii.

english_verse: So the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses started grumbling, “This man is friendly with sinners. He even eats with them.”
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo kple agbalẽfialawo li liʋiliʋi gblɔ bena: Amesia xɔa nuvɔ̃wɔlawo, eye woɖua nu kpli wo.

english_verse: Then Jesus told them this story:
translation_verse: Ke edo lo sia na wo gblɔ bena:

english_verse: And when you find it, you will be so glad that you will put it on your shoulder
translation_verse: Eye ne ekpɔe la, akɔe ada ɖe eƒe abɔta kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: and carry it home. Then you will call in your friends and neighbors and say, “Let's celebrate! I've found my lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Eye ne eva aƒe la, ayɔ xɔlɔ̃awo kple aƒelikawo aƒo ƒu, agblɔ na wo bena: Mikpɔ dzidzɔ kplim, elabena mekpɔ nye alẽ, si bu la.

english_verse: Jesus said, “In the same way there is more happiness in heaven because of one sinner who turns to God than over
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nenema ke wòanye dzidzɔ le dziƒo le nuvɔ̃wɔla ɖeka, si trɔ le dzi me la ŋuti wu ame dzɔdzɔe blaasieke vɔ asieke, siwo mehiã dzimetɔtrɔ o la.

english_verse: Jesus told the people another story: What will a woman do if she has ten silver coins and loses one of them? Won't she light a lamp, sweep the floor, and look carefully until she finds it?
translation_verse: Alo nyɔnu ka si klosalo ewo le, ne ebu ɖeka la, ɖe masi akaɖi, eye wòakplɔ xɔa me, eye wòaɖi vevie, vaseɖe esime wòakpɔe o mahã?

english_verse: Then she will call in her friends and neighbors and say, “Let's celebrate! I've found the coin I lost.”
translation_verse: Eye ne ekpɔe la, ayɔ xɔlɔ̃awo kple aƒelikawo aƒo ƒu, agblɔ na wo bena: Mikpɔ dzidzɔ kplim, elabena mekpɔ klosalo, si mebu la.

english_verse: Jesus said, “In the same way God's angels are happy when even one person turns to him.” Two Sons
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nenema ke wòanye dzidzɔ le mawudɔlawo ƒe ŋku me le nuvɔ̃wɔla ɖeka, si trɔ le dzi me la ŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus told them yet another story: Once a man had two sons.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Ŋutsuvi eve le amea ɖe si;

english_verse: Not long after that, the younger son packed up everything he owned and left for a foreign country, where he wasted all his money in wild living.
translation_verse: Eye mede ŋkeke geɖea ɖeke o, ŋutsuvi ɖevitɔ la ƒo eƒe nuwo katã nu ƒu, eye woʋu heyi anyigba didia ɖe dzi, eye afima wògblẽ eƒe nuwo le kple agbe baɖabaɖa nɔnɔ.

english_verse: He went to work for a man in that country, and the man sent him out to take care of his pigs.
translation_verse: Eye wòyi ɖatsɔ eɖokui lé ɖe anyigba ma ƒe dumetɔa ɖe ŋu, eye wòdɔe ɖe eƒe abɔ me, be wòanyi hawo.

english_verse: He would have been glad to eat what the pigs were eating, but no one gave him a thing.
translation_verse: Eye wòdi be, yeatsɔ akanyi, si hawo ɖuna la, ade yeƒe dɔ me, ke amea ɖeke menae a:

english_verse: Finally, he came to his senses and said, “My father's workers have plenty to eat, and here I am, starving to death!
translation_verse: Ke, esi wòyi eɖokui me la, egblɔ bena: Fofonye ƒe agbatedɔwɔla nenie kpɔ abolo sɔ gbɔ, ke nye la mele tsɔtsrɔ̃m le dɔwuame ta.

english_verse: I am no longer good enough to be called your son. Treat me like one of your workers.’ ”
translation_verse: Nyemegadze be, nayɔm be viwò o; wɔm abe wò dɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka ene.

english_verse: The younger son got up and started back to his father. But when he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt sorry for him. He ran to his son and hugged and kissed him.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsi tre va fofoa gbɔ. Ke esi wòle mɔ dzi ʋĩ gbɔna la, fofoa kpɔe, eye eƒe dɔme trɔ ɖe eŋu, eye wòƒu du ɖadze eƒe kɔ dzi, eye wòɖuɖɔ nu nɛ.

english_verse: The son said, “Father, I have sinned against God in heaven and against you. I am no longer good enough to be called your son.”
translation_verse: Ke ɖevi la gblɔ ne bena: Fofo, mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe dziƒo ŋu kple ŋutiwò, eye nyemegadze be, nayɔm be viwò o.

english_verse: But his father said to the servants, “Hurry and bring the best clothes and put them on him. Give him a ring for his finger and sandals for his feet.
translation_verse: Ke fofoa gblɔ na eƒe dɔlawo bena: Miyi ɖatsɔ awu nyuitɔ vɛ, be miado nɛ, eye miɖe asigɛ asi nɛ, kple atokotawo ɖe eƒe afɔwo;

english_verse: Get the best calf and prepare it, so we can eat and celebrate.
translation_verse: eye milé nyivi dami la ve, miwui, eye mina míaɖu nu, eye míakpɔ dzidzɔ;

english_verse: This son of mine was dead, but has now come back to life. He was lost and has now been found.” And they began to celebrate.
translation_verse: elabena vinyeŋutsuvi sia ku, eye wògagbɔ agbe; ebu, eye wogakpɔe. Eye wode asi dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ me.

english_verse: The older son had been out in the field. But when he came near the house, he heard the music and dancing.
translation_verse: Ke viaŋutsuvi xoxoetɔ le agble me; eye esi wòva tu aƒe la, ese saŋkuɖiɖi kple ɣeɖuɖu.

english_verse: So he called one of the servants over and asked, “What's going on here?”
translation_verse: Eye wòyɔ dɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka va egbɔ, eye wòbiae bena: Nukawo nye nu siawo mahã?

english_verse: The servant answered, “Your brother has come home safe and sound, and your father ordered us to kill the best calf.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ ne bena: Nɔviwò va, eye fofowò wu nyivi dami; elabena egakpɔe dedie.

english_verse: The older brother got so angry that he would not even go into the house. His father came out and begged him to go in.
translation_verse: Eye wòbi dzi, eye melɔ̃ be, yeayi ɖe aƒea me o. Ke fofoa ɖo go va ɖe kuku ne.

english_verse: But he said to his father, “For years I have worked for you like a slave and have always obeyed you. But you have never even given me a little goat, so that I could give a dinner for my friends.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo ŋu gblɔ na fofoa bena: Kpɔ ɖa, nenem ƒe geɖe siawo mesubɔ wò, eye nyemeda wò seawo dzi kpɔ o, ke nye la mena gbɔ̃ tatam kpɔ bena, mía kple xɔ̃nyewo míakpɔ dzidzɔ o:

english_verse: This other son of yours wasted your money on prostitutes. And now that he has come home, you ordered the best calf to be killed for a feast.”
translation_verse: ke esi viwòŋutsuvi sia, si gblẽ wò nuwo kple nyɔnu wɔahasiwo la, va ko la, nèwu nyivi dami nɛ.

english_verse: His father replied, “My son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Vinye, wò la èle gbɔnye ɣesiaɣi, eye nusiwo katã nye tanye la, tɔwòe.

english_verse: But we should be glad and celebrate! Your brother was dead, but he is now alive. He was lost and has now been found.”
translation_verse: Ke ele be, dzi nadza wò; elabena nɔviwò sia ku, eye wògagbɔ agbe; ebu, eye wogakpɔe.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: A rich man once had a manager to take care of his business. But he was told that his manager was wasting money.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo hã bena: Ŋutsu kesinɔtɔa ɖe li, si xɔnuvi le esi, eye wotso eyama nu nɛ bena, ele eƒe nuwo gblẽm.

english_verse: So the rich man called him in and said, “What is this I hear about you? Tell me what you have done! You are no longer going to work for me.”
translation_verse: Eye wòyɔe gblɔ nɛ bena: Aleke wɔ, eye mese esia le ŋuwò mahã? Bu akɔnta le wò xɔnuvinyenye la ŋuti, elabena megale ŋu te ge anye xɔnuvi gbeɖe o.

english_verse: The manager said to himself, “What shall I do now that my master is going to fire me? I can't dig ditches, and I'm ashamed to beg.
translation_verse: Ke xɔnuvi la gblɔ le ye ŋutɔ ɖokui me bena: Nuka wɔ ge mala? Elabena nye aƒetɔ le xɔnuvinyenye la xɔm le asinye, nyemate ŋu ade agble o, eye migabia kpea ŋu nam.

english_verse: I know what I'll do, so that people will welcome me into their homes after I've lost my job.”
translation_verse: Menya nusi mawɔ bena, ne woɖem ɖa le xɔnuvinyenye la nu la, ne woaxɔm ɖe woƒe aƒewo me.

english_verse: “A hundred barrels of olive oil,” the man answered. So the manager said, “Take your bill and sit down and quickly write ‘
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Amigo alafa. Tete wògblɔ ne bena: Tsɔ wò fegbalẽ nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi, eye naŋlɔ kaba be blaatɔ̃.

english_verse: The manager asked someone else who was in debt to his master, “How much do you owe?” “A thousand sacks of wheat,” the man replied. The manager said, “Take your bill and write ‘
translation_verse: Eya yome wògblɔ na ame bubu bena: Ke wò ɖe, ho nenie nènyi? Eye wògblɔ bena: Bli golo alafa. Egblɔ nɛ bena: Tso wò fegbalẽ, eye naŋlɔ blaenyi.

english_verse: The master praised his dishonest manager for looking out for himself so well. That's how it is! The people of this world look out for themselves better than the people who belong to the light.
translation_verse: Eye aƒetɔ la kafu xɔnuvi madzɔmadzɔ la, elabena ewo nu le aɖaŋu me. Elabena xexe sia me viwo dze adaŋu wu kekeliviwo hena woa ŋutɔwo ƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: My disciples, I tell you to use wicked wealth to make friends for yourselves. Then when it is gone, you will be welcomed into an eternal home.
translation_verse: Eye nye hã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Mitso anyigbadzinu madzɔmadzɔwo dze xɔlɔ̃woe na mia ɖokui bena, ne wo nu tsi la, woaxɔ mi ɖe agbadɔ mavɔwo me.

english_verse: So Abraham said, “If they won't pay attention to Moses and the prophets, they won't listen even to someone who comes back from the dead.”
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ nɛ bena: Ne womeɖo to Mose kple nyagblɔɖilawo o la, ne amea ɖe tsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome hã la, mele ŋu te ge aƒoe ɖe wo nu o.

english_verse: The Pharisees really loved money. So when they heard what Jesus said, they made fun of him.
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo, siwo nye galɔ̃lawo la, se nusiawo katã, eye woɖo hehe ɖe eta.

english_verse: But Jesus told them: You are always making yourselves look good, but God sees what is in your heart. The things that most people think are important are worthless as far as God is concerned.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miawoe nye amesiwo le afia tsom na mia ŋu tɔwo mia ɖokui le amewo ƒe ŋku me, gake Mawu nya miaƒe dziwo me; elabena nusi nye nu gã le amewo dome la, enye ŋunyɔnu le Mawu ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Until the time of John the Baptist, people had to obey the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets. But since God's kingdom has been preached, everyone is trying hard to get in.
translation_verse: Se la kple nyagblɔɖilawo nɔ anyi vaseɖe Yohanes dzi; tso ekema dzi la wole mawufiaɖuƒe ƒe nyanyuie la gblɔm fia, eye amesiame yi ɖe eme sesẽtɔe.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will disappear before the smallest letter of the Law does.
translation_verse: Ke ele bɔbɔe, be dziƒo kple anyigba nu nayi wu esi se la ƒe ŋɔŋlɔdzesi ɖeka natsi anyi.

english_verse: It is a terrible sin for a man to divorce his wife and marry another woman. It is also a terrible sin for a man to marry a divorced woman. Lazarus and the Rich Man
translation_verse: Amesiame, si aɖe asi le srɔ̃a ŋu, eye wòaɖe bubu la, ewo ahasi; eye amesi aɖe esi ŋu ŋutsua ɖe ɖe asi le la, ewo ahasi. Lododo le kesinɔtɔ kple ame dahe Lazaro ŋuti.

english_verse: There was once a rich man who wore expensive clothes and every day ate the best food.
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsu kesinɔtɔa ɖe li, si doa awu dzi kple aklalabiɖibiɖiwu, eye woɖua agbe gbesiagbe le dzidzɔ me;

english_verse: But a poor beggar named Lazarus was brought to the gate of the rich man's house.
translation_verse: ke ame dahea ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Lazaro la, mlɔ eƒe agbo nu, eye abiwo yɔ eŋuti fũ;

english_verse: He was happy just to eat the scraps that fell from the rich man's table. His body was covered with sores, and dogs kept coming up to lick them.
translation_verse: eye wòle ɖiɖim be, yeaɖu nusiwo le dudum le kesinɔtɔ la ƒe kplɔ̃ dzi la, aɖi ƒo; ke avũwo hã va, eye woɖuɖɔ eƒe abiwo mo nɛ.

english_verse: The poor man died, and angels took him to the place of honor next to Abraham. The rich man also died and was buried.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me bena, ame dahe la ku, eye mawudɔlawo tsɔe yi ɖada ɖe Abraham akɔnu; eye kesinɔtɔ la hã ku, eye woɖii.

english_verse: He went to hell and was suffering terribly. When he looked up and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side,
translation_verse: Eye le tsieƒe, esi wòle fukpekpe me la, ewu eƒe mo dzi, eye wòkpɔ Abraham ɖa ʋĩ, eye Lazaro le eƒe akɔnu.

english_verse: he said to Abraham, “Have pity on me! Send Lazarus to dip his finger in water and touch my tongue. I'm suffering terribly in this fire.”
translation_verse: Eye wòdo ɣli gblɔ bena: Fofo Abraham, ve nunye, eye nadɔ Lazaro ɖa bena woatsɔ eƒe asibidenu ata tsi me, eye wòafa aɖe nam, elabena mele fu kpem le dzo ƒe aɖe sia me.

english_verse: Abraham answered, “My friend, remember that while you lived, you had everything good, and Lazarus had everything bad. Now he is happy, and you are in pain.
translation_verse: Ke Abraham gblɔ bena: Vinye, ɖo ŋku edzi bena, exɔ wò nu nyuiwo vo le wò agbenɔɣi me, eye nenema ke Lazaro xɔ vɔ̃awo; ke azɔ la wole akɔ fam nɛ le afii, eye wò la èle fu kpem.

english_verse: But the rich man said, “Abraham, then please send Lazarus to my father's home.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Ekema meɖe kuku na wò, fofo bena, nadɔe ɖe fofonye ƒe me;

english_verse: Let him warn my five brothers, so they won't come to this horrible place.”
translation_verse: elabena nɔvi atɔ̃ le asinye, bena wòaɖi ɖase na wo, bena woawo hã nagava fukpeƒe sia o.

english_verse: Abraham answered, “Your brothers can read what Moses and the prophets wrote. They should pay attention to that.”
translation_verse: Ke Abraham gblo bena: Mose kple nyagblɔɖilawo le wo si: woaɖo to woamawo!

english_verse: Then the rich man said, “No, that's not enough! If only someone from the dead would go to them, they would listen and turn to God.”
translation_verse: Eye wògbɔ bena: Gbeɖe, fofo Abraham; ke boŋ ne amea ɖe tso ame kukuwo dome yi wo gbɔ la, wòatrɔ le woƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: Why was this foreigner the only one who came back to thank God?”
translation_verse: Alo amesiwo atrɔ atsɔ bubu na Mawu la meli o, negbe amedzro sia ko mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied: If you had faith no bigger than a tiny mustard seed, you could tell this mulberry tree to pull itself up, roots and all, and to plant itself in the ocean. And it would!
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ bena: Ne xɔse le mia si abe logoku ene la, miagblɔ na gboti sia bena: Ho ɖokuiwò naɖaɖo ɖe atsiaƒu me! eye aɖo to mi.

english_verse: If your servant comes in from plowing or from taking care of the sheep, would you say, “Welcome! Come on in and have something to eat”?
translation_verse: Ke mia dome ameka ƒe dɔla le agble ŋlɔm alo le lã nyim, eye ne etso agble va aƒe la, wòagblɔ nɛ bena: Va kaba, eye nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi mahã?

english_verse: There is no use saying, ‘Look! Here it is’ or ‘Look! There it is.’ God's kingdom is here with you.”
translation_verse: alo woagblɔ bena: kpɔ ɖa, afii alo afimee o; elabena kpɔ ɖa, mawufiaɖuƒe la le mia dome.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: The time will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Ŋkekewo gbɔna, le esi me miadi be, míakpɔ Amegbetɔvi la ƒe ŋkekewo dometɔ ɖeka, eye míakpɔe o.

english_verse: Servants don't deserve special thanks for doing what they are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe woada akpe na dɔla la bena, ewɔ nusiwo ƒe se wòde nɛ la dzi mahã?

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: There will always be something that causes people to sin. But anyone who causes them to sin is in for trouble. A person who causes even one of my little followers to sin
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Womate ŋu axe mo na nuɖiaɖiawo ƒe vava o; gake baba na amesi dzi woato ava.

english_verse: would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their neck.
translation_verse: Enyo nɛ be, woatsɔ té atsi ɖe ko ne, eye woatsɔe aƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu me wu esi wòaɖia ɖevi sue siawo dometɔ ɖeka nu.

english_verse: So be careful what you do. Correct any followers of mine who sin, and forgive the ones who say they are sorry.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi! Ne nɔviwò wo nuvɔ̃ la, ka ŋku me nɛ; eye ne etrɔ le eƒe dzi me la, tsɔe kee.

english_verse: Even if one of them mistreats you seven times in one day and says, “I am sorry,” you should still forgive that person.
translation_verse: Eye ne ewo nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò zi adre le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi, eye wògatrɔ zi adre va ɖe kuku na wò la, tsoe kee.

english_verse: The apostles said to the Lord, “Make our faith stronger!”
translation_verse: Eye apostoloawo gblɔ na Aƒetɔ la bena: Na miaƒe xɔse nadzi ɖe edzi na mí.

english_verse: No, you wouldn't say that. You would say, “Prepare me something to eat. Get ready to serve me, so I can have my meal. Then later on you can eat and drink.”
translation_verse: Alo menye ɖe wòagblɔ nɛ bena: Dzra nusi maɖu la ɖo, nasa avɔ ɖe ali asubɔm, vaseɖe esime meɖu nu, eye meno nu, eye esia megbe wò hã naɖu nu, eye nano nu o mahã?

english_verse: And that's how it should be with you. When you've done all you should, then say, “We are merely servants, and we have simply done our duty.” Ten Men with Leprosy
translation_verse: Nenema ke miawo hã, ne miewɔ nusiwo katã woɖo na mi la, migblɔ bena: Dɔla madzemadzewo míenye; nusi le na mi be, miawo la, eya koe miewɔ. Samariatɔ akpedala.

english_verse: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus went along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me, esi wole mo dzi yina Yerusalem la bena, eto Samaria kple Galilea titina.

english_verse: As he was going into a village, ten men with leprosy came toward him. They stood at a distance
translation_verse: Eye esi wòyi ɖe kɔƒea ɖe me la, ŋutsu ewo, siwo nye anyidzelawo la, va kpee, eye wotsi tre ɖe adzɔge;

english_verse: and shouted, “Jesus, Master, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: eye wokɔ woƒe gbewo dzi gblɔ bena: Yesu, amegã, kpɔ mia nublanui!

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “Go show yourselves to the priests.” On their way they were healed.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòkpɔ wo la, egblɔ na wo bena: Miheyi ɖatsɔ mia dokui tia nunɔlawo. Eye wòva ve me, esi woyina la, wo ŋuti kɔ.

english_verse: When one of them discovered that he was healed, he came back, shouting praises to God.
translation_verse: Ke wo dometɔ ɖeka, esi wòkpɔ bena, woda gbe le ye ŋu la, egbugbɔ le Mawu kafum kple gbe sesẽ,

english_verse: He bowed down at the feet of Jesus and thanked him. The man was from the country of Samaria.
translation_verse: eye wòdze klo tsyɔ mo anyi de eƒe afɔ nu hele akpe dam nɛ; eye eya la Samariatɔ wònye.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Weren't ten men healed? Where are the other nine?
translation_verse: Eye Yesu xɔ dzi gblo bena: Alo menye ame ewo ŋutie ko o mahã? Ke afika wo ame asieke la le?

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “You may get up and go. Your faith has made you well.” God's Kingdom (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Tsi tre, nadzo, wò xɔse la de wò. Le mawufiaɖuƒe la ƒe vava ŋuti.

english_verse: The day of the Son of Man will be like lightning flashing across the sky.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi dzikedzo, ne eke dzo le dziƒo ƒe go ɖeka me, wòklẽna de dziƒo ƒe go keme dzii la, nenema Amegbetɔvi la lanɔ le eƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: When people say to you, “Look there,” or “Look here,” don't go looking for him.
translation_verse: Eye woagblɔ na mi bena: Kpɔ ɖa, afimee, kpɔ ɖa, afii! Migayi o, eye migadze wo yome o!

english_verse: When Lot lived, people were also eating and drinking. They were buying, selling, planting, and building.
translation_verse: Alesi ke wòva ve me le Lot ƒe ŋkekeawo me: Wole nuɖuɖu dzi, wole nunono dzi, wole nuƒeƒle dzi, wole nudzadzra dzi, wole nukuwo dodo dzi, wole xɔtutu dzi;

english_verse: Then Jesus' disciples spoke up, “But where will this happen, Lord?” Jesus said, “Where there is a corpse, there will always be vultures.”
translation_verse: Eye woxɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Afikae, Aƒetɔ? Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Afisi nu kuku le la, afima hɔ̃wo ƒoa ƒu ɖo.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus when God's kingdom would come. He answered, “God's kingdom isn't something you can see.
translation_verse: Eye esi farisitɔwo bia ɣeyiɣi, si dzi mawufiaɖuƒe la ava lae la, eɖo eŋu na wo gblɔ bena: Mawufiaɖuƒe la megbɔna kple zi,

english_verse: But first he must suffer terribly and be rejected by the people of today.
translation_verse: Gake ele nɛ gbã be, wòakpe fu geɖe, eye dzidzime sia lado vloe.

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Eve alesi wòva ve me le Noa ƒe ŋkekeawo mee la, nenema wòanɔ le Amegbetɔvi la ƒe ŋkekeawo hã me.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day when Noah went into the big boat. Then the flood came and drowned everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Wole nuɖuɖu dzi, wole nunono dzi, wole srɔ̃ɖeɖe dzi, eye wole wo tsɔm na, be woaɖe, vaseɖe ŋkeke, si dzi Noa yi de aɖakaʋu la me, eye tsiɖɔɖɔ va, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo katã.

english_verse: But on the very day Lot left Sodom, fiery flames poured down from the sky and killed everyone.
translation_verse: ke le ŋkeke, si dzi Lot do go tso Sodom la, dzo kple dzokpe wu tso dziƒo, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo katã:

english_verse: The same will happen on the day when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: nenema ke wòanɔ le ŋkeke, si dzi Amegbetɔvi la laɖe eɖokui afia.

english_verse: At that time no one on a rooftop should go down into the house to get anything. No one in a field should go back to the house for anything.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke ma dzi la amesi lanɔ xɔta, eye eƒe nuwo le xɔ me la, magaɖi be, wòatsɔ wo ayii o, eye nenema ke amesi le agble mè la, megagbugbɔ de nusiwo le emegbe la ŋuti o?

english_verse: Remember what happened to Lot's wife.
translation_verse: Mido ŋku Lot srɔ̃ dzi!

english_verse: People who try to save their lives will lose them, and those who lose their lives will save them.
translation_verse: Amesi ke le didim be, yeaɖe yeƒe agbe la, abui, eye amesi ke labui la, agaxɔe agbagbee.

english_verse: On that night two people will be sleeping in the same bed, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Le zã ma me la ame eve woanɔ aba ɖeka dzi, woaxɔ ɖeka, eye woagblẽ ekeme ɖi.

english_verse: Two women will be together grinding wheat, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Ame eve lanɔ abɔ me, woaxɔ ɖeka, eye woagblẽ ekeme ɖi.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples a story about how they should keep on praying and never give up:
translation_verse: Eye wòdo lo na wo, le alesi wòle na wo be, woaɖo gbe ɖa ɖaa, eye ɖeɖi nagate wo ŋu o la ŋuti,

english_verse: In a town there was once a judge who didn't fear God or care about people.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: ʋɔnudrɔ̃laa ɖe nɔ dua ɖe me, amesi mevɔ̃a Mawu o, eye mesia ame hã o.

english_verse: In that same town there was a widow who kept going to the judge and saying, “Make sure that I get fair treatment in court.”
translation_verse: Ke ahosia ɖe nɔ du ma me, eye wòvaa egbɔ enuenu gblɔna bena: Ɖem le nye ketɔ si me.

english_verse: For a while the judge refused to do anything. Finally, he said to himself, “Even though I don't fear God or care about people,
translation_verse: Eye melɔ̃ o eteƒe didi; ke esiawo megbe la egblɔ le ye ŋutɔ ɖokui me bena: Esi nyemevɔ̃a Mawu o, eye nyemesia ame hã o la,

english_verse: I will help this widow because she keeps on bothering me. If I don't help her, she will wear me out.”
translation_verse: gake le esi ahosi sia le fu ɖem nam ŋuti la, maɖee, bena mlɔeba la wòagava ade fe ŋku me nam o.

english_verse: The Lord said: Think about what that crooked judge said.
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ bena: Mise nusi ʋɔnudrɔ̃la madzɔmadzɔ la gblɔ.

english_verse: Won't God protect his chosen ones who pray to him day and night? Won't he be concerned for them?
translation_verse: Ke ɖe Mawu maɖe eƒe ame tiatia, siwo le ɣli ɖom nɛ ŋkeke kple zã, eye magbɔ dzi ɖi na wo o mahã?

english_verse: He will surely hurry and help them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find on this earth anyone with faith? A Pharisee and a Tax Collector
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Aɖe wo kaba. Gake ne Amegbetɔvi la va la, ɖe wòakpɔ xɔse la le anyigba la dzi mahã? Lododo le farisitɔ la kple nudzɔla la ŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus told a story to some people who thought they were better than others and who looked down on everyone else:
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo lo sia na amea ɖewo, siwo ɖo dzi ɖe woa ŋutɔwo ɖokui ŋu bena, yewonye ame dzɔdzɔewo, eye wobu ame bubuwo be, womenye naneke o la bena:

english_verse: The Pharisee stood over by himself and prayed, “God, I thank you that I am not greedy, dishonest, and unfaithful in marriage like other people. And I am really glad that I am not like that tax collector over there.
translation_verse: Farisitɔ la le tsitrenu, eye wòdo gbe ɖa ɖe ta me be: Mawu, meda akpe na wò bena, nyemele abe ame bubuawo, adzodalawo, ame madzɔmadzɔwo, ahasiwɔlawo, alo abe nudzɔla sia hã ene o.

english_verse: I go without eating for two days a week, and I give you one tenth of all I earn.”
translation_verse: Metsia nu dɔna zi eve le kwasiɖa ɖeka me, eye metsɔa nusiwo katã sua asinye la, ƒe ewolia nana.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “When the two men went home, it was the tax collector and not the Pharisee who was pleasing to God. If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesia la wotso afia nɛ, eye wòtre aƒemeyiyi na ame keme; elabena amesiame, si doa eɖokui ɖe dzi la, woabɔbɔe ɖe anyi; ke amesi bɔbɔa eɖokui ɖe anyi la, woadoe ɖe dzi. Yesu yra ɖeviwo.

english_verse: Some people brought their little children for Jesus to bless. But when his disciples saw them doing this, they told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ vidzĩewo hã va egbɔ, bena wòada asi ɖe wo dzi; ke esi nusrɔ̃lawo kpɔe la, woblu ɖe wo ta.

english_verse: will be given much more in this life. And in the future world they will have eternal life.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Matthew
