translation_verse: eye wòado kpo teƒeɖoɖo geɖe xɔxɔ awu le ɣeyiɣi sia me kple agbe mavɔ la xɔxɔ le xexe, si lava va la me o. Yesu ɖo gbe ƒã le eƒe fukpekpe ŋu zi etɔ̃lia.

english_verse: Jesus took the twelve apostles aside and said: We are now on our way to Jerusalem. Everything that the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will happen there.
translation_verse: Eye wòyɔ ame wuieveawo va egbɔ gblɔ na wo bena: Kpɔ ɖa, mieyina Yerusalem, eye woawu nusiwo katã woŋlɔ ɖi to nyagblɔɖilawo dzi le Amegbetɔvi la ŋuti la nu.

english_verse: An important man asked Jesus, “Good Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Eye amegãa ɖe va biae bena: Nufiala nyui, nuka mawɔ, be manyi agbe mavɔ la dome mahã?

english_verse: He told Jesus, “I have obeyed all these commandments since I was a young man.”
translation_verse: Ke eya gblɔ bena: Mewɔ nusiawo katã dzi tso nye ɖevime ke.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “There is one thing you still need to do. Go and sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu see la, egblɔ ne bena: Egasusɔ nu ɖeka na wò; dzra nusiwo katã le asiwò la, eye namã wo na ame dahewo, eye nu nyui anɔ dziƒo na wò; eye nava adze yonyeme.

english_verse: When the man heard this, he was sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòse esiawo la, evee ŋutɔ; elabena kesinɔtɔ ŋutɔ wònye.

english_verse: Jesus saw how sad the man was. So he said, “It's terribly hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu kpɔe la, egblɔ bena: Ale wòsẽ na amesiwo si nu le la be, wòayi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la me enye esi.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Elabena ele bɔbɔe na kposɔ be, wòato abi ƒe vo me wu alesi kesinɔtɔ nayi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la mee.

english_verse: When the crowd heard this, they asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo see la, gblɔ bena: Ekema ameka gɔ̃e ate ŋu akpɔ ɖeɖe mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Nusiwo womate ŋu awɔ le amegbetɔwo gbɔ o la, woate ŋu awɔe le Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: Peter said, “Remember, we left everything to be your followers!”
translation_verse: Ke Petro gblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, miawo la miegblẽ míaƒe nuwo ɖi, eye miedze yowòme.

english_verse: He will be handed over to foreigners, who will make fun of him, mistreat him, and spit on him.
translation_verse: Elabena woadee asi na trɔ̃subɔlawo, eye woaɖu fewu le eŋuti, eye woaɖo vloe, eye woaɖe ta ɖe eŋu;

english_verse: They will beat him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.
translation_verse: eye woaƒoe kple atam, eye woawui, eye ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la wòatsi tre.

english_verse: When Jesus was coming close to Jericho, a blind man sat begging beside the road.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me, esi wògogo Yerixo la bena, ŋkuagbãtɔa ɖe bɔbɔ nɔ mɔ to le nu biam;

english_verse: The man heard the crowd walking by and asked what was happening.
translation_verse: ke esi wòse bena, ameha le eŋuti tom yina la, ebia be: Nukae nye esia?

english_verse: Some people told him that Jesus from Nazareth was passing by.
translation_verse: Eye woto nɛ bena: Yesu, Nazaretetɔ lae le eŋuti tom.

english_verse: So the blind man shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Eye wòdo ɣli gblɔ bena: Yesu, Dawid vi la, kpɔ nye nublanui!

english_verse: The people who were going along with Jesus told the man to be quiet. But he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo dze ŋgɔ la, blu ɖe eta bena, wòazi ɖoɖoe: ke eya do ɣli wu tsãtɔ bena: Dawid vi lee, kpɔ nye nublanui!

english_verse: Jesus stopped and told some people to bring the blind man over to him. When the blind man was getting near, Jesus asked,
translation_verse: Eye Yesu tɔ ɖe tsitre, eye wòde se be, woakplɔe ava ye gbɔe: eye esi wòte va egbɔ la, ebiae bena:

english_verse: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see!” he answered.
translation_verse: Nuka dim nèle, be mawɔ na wò mahã? Eye wògblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, bena makpe nu!

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Look and you will see! Your eyes are healed because of your faith.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblo nɛ bena: Kpɔ nu, wò xɔse la ɖe wò.

english_verse: At once the man could see, and he went with Jesus and started thanking God. When the crowds saw what happened, they praised God.
translation_verse: Eye enumake wòkpɔ nu, eye wòdze eyome le Mawu kafum, eye dukɔ la katã, esi wokpɔe la, wotsɔ kafukafu na Mawu.

english_verse: When Jesus got there, he looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down! I want to stay with you today.”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu va ɖo teƒea la, ewu mo dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Zaxeo, ɖi kaba; elabena ele nam egbea be, manɔ aƒewò me.

english_verse: Zacchaeus hurried down and gladly welcomed Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖi kaba, eye wòxɔe kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who saw this started grumbling, “This man Zacchaeus is a sinner! And Jesus is going home to eat with him.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wokpɔe la, wo katã woli liʋiliʋi gblɔ bena: Eyina ŋutsu, si nye nuvɔ̃wɔla gbɔ dze ge.

english_verse: Later that day Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “I will give half of my property to the poor. And I will now pay back four times as much to everyone I have ever cheated.”
translation_verse: Eye Zaxeo tsi tre gblɔ na Aƒetɔ la bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ, metsɔ nye nuwo ƒe afã na ame dahewo, eye ne medzɔ nu le amea ɖe si dzro la, meɖoa eteƒe ne zi ene.

english_verse: Jesus said to Zacchaeus, “Today you and your family have been saved, because you are a true son of Abraham.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ ne bena: Egbe xɔxɔ va aƒe sia me, ɖe esi eya hã nye Abraham vi ŋuti.

english_verse: The Son of Man came to look for and to save people who are lost.” A Story about Ten Servants (Matthew
translation_verse: Elabena Amegbetɔvi la va, be yeaɖi, eye yeaɖe amesiwo bu la. Yesu do lo le pounde mamã ŋuti.

english_verse: But they said, “Sir, he already has ten times as much!”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, pounde ewo le esi!

english_verse: But the people of his country hated him, and they sent messengers to the foreign country to say, “We don't want this man to be our king.”
translation_verse: Ke eƒe dumetɔwo lé fui, eye wodɔ ame ɖe eyome gblɔ bena: Mielɔ̃ bena, amesia naɖu fia ɖe mia dzi o.

english_verse: He told them, “Go into the next village, where you will find a young donkey that has never been ridden. Untie the donkey and bring it here.
translation_verse: gblo bena: Miyi kɔƒe, si le mia ŋgɔ la me, eye ne miege ɖe eme la, miakpɔ tedzivi le ka me, esi dzi amea ɖeke menɔ kpɔ o; mitui, eye mikplɔe vɛ.

english_verse: The first servant came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me I have earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: Eye gbãtɔ va do gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, wò pounde la ɖe vi pounde ewo ɖe edzi.

english_verse: The second one came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me, I have earned five times as much.”
translation_verse: Eye evelia va gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, wò pounde la ɖe vi pounde atɔ̃.

english_verse: Another servant came and said, “Sir, here is your money. I kept it safe in a handkerchief.
translation_verse: Eye bubu va gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, kpɔ ɖa, wò pounde, si metsɔ dzra ɖo ɖe taku nu la, nye esi;

english_verse: Why didn't you put my money in the bank? On my return, I could have had the money together with interest.”
translation_verse: nukaŋuti mètsɔ nye ga na gasitsalawo, eye nye la le nye vava me la, ne maxɔe kple deme o mahã?

english_verse: Then he said to some other servants standing there, “Take the money away from him and give it to the servant who earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na amesiwo le tsitre le egbɔ la bena: Mixɔ pounde la le esi, eye mitsɔe na amesi pounde ewo le esi!

english_verse: The king replied, “Those who have something will be given more. But everything will be taken away from those who don't have anything.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesiame, si nu le esi la, woana nui; ke amesi nu mele esi o la, nusi le esi hã la, woaxɔe le esi.

english_verse: Now bring me the enemies who didn't want me to be their king. Kill them while I watch!” Jesus Enters Jerusalem (Matthew
translation_verse: Gake nye ketɔ ma, siwo melɔ̃ be, maɖu fia ɖe wo dzi o la, atikplɔ wo va afii, eye miwu wo le ŋkunye me.

english_verse: When Jesus had finished saying all this, he went on toward Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye esi wògblɔ esiawo la, edze ŋgɔ yina Yerusalem. Yesu ƒe Yerusalem yiyi.

english_verse: As he was getting near Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples on ahead.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me, esi wògogo Betfage kple Betania le to, si woyɔna be Amito la ŋuti la, edo eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dome ame eve

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ ”
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe bia mi bena: Nukaŋuti miele etum hã la, migblɔ ale: Aƒetɔ la le ehiãm.

english_verse: They went off and found everything just as Jesus had said.
translation_verse: Eye esi ame dodowo yi la, wokpɔ alesi wògblɔ na wo.

english_verse: While they were untying the donkey, its owners asked, “Why are you doing that?”
translation_verse: Ke esi wole tedzivi la tum la, nuatɔwo gblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti miele tedzivi la tum?

english_verse: They answered, “The Lord needs it.”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ la le ehiãm.

english_verse: Then they led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back and helped Jesus get on.
translation_verse: Eye wokplɔe vɛ na Yesu; eye wotsɔ woƒe avɔwo ɖo tedzivi la dzi, eye wokɔ Yesu ɖo edzi.

english_verse: And as he rode along, the people spread clothes on the road in front of him.
translation_verse: Eye le eƒe yiyi me la wotsɔ woƒe avɔwo keke de mɔƒo me.

english_verse: When Jesus started down the Mount of Olives, his large crowd of disciples were happy and praised God because of all the miracles they had seen.
translation_verse: Ke esi wògogo va do afisi woɖia Amito la ƒe abu lena la, nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe ha blibo la katã de asi dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple mawukafukafu me kple gbe sesẽ le ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔ, siwo katã wokpɔ la ŋuti

english_verse: They shouted, “Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory to God.”
translation_verse: gblo bena: Woayra fia, si gbɔna le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔa me; ŋutifafa le dziƒo, eye ŋutikɔkɔe le dziƒo boo!

english_verse: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, make your disciples stop shouting!”
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔwo dometɔa dewo tso ameha la dome gblo ne bena: Nufiala, gbe nya na wò nusrɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: When Jesus came closer and could see Jerusalem, he cried
translation_verse: Eye esi wòte va, eye wòkpɔ dua la, efa avi ɖe eŋuti

english_verse: and said: It is too bad that today your people don't know what will bring them peace! Now it is hidden from them.
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Wò hã, ɖe nènya nusi na ŋutifafa wò le wò ŋkeke sia me: ke azɔ la eɣla ɖe wò ŋkuwo!

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time will come when your enemies will build walls around you to attack you. Armies will surround you and close in on you from every side.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋkekewo ava dziwò, eye wò ketɔwo aƒu kpo ɖe ŋuwò, eye woaɖe to aƒo xlã wò, eye woaxaxa wò ɖe eme le goawo katã dzi,

english_verse: They will level you to the ground and kill your people. Not one stone in your buildings will be left on top of another. This will happen because you did not see that God had come to save you. Jesus in the Temple (Matthew
translation_verse: eye woaxlã wo kple viwò, siwo le mewo la, ɖe anyi, eye womele kpe gblẽ ge ɖe kpe dzi le mewo o, le esi mèdze si wò kpɔkpɔɖaɣi o la ta. Yesu dzra mawuƒe la me ɖo.

english_verse: When Jesus entered the temple, he started chasing out the people who were selling things.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòyi ɖe mawuƒe la me la, ede asi amesiwo le nu dzram kple amesiwo le nu ƒlem la nyãnyã me do goe

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be a place of worship.’ But you have made it a place where robbers hide!”
translation_verse: gblɔ na wo bena: Woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Eye nye aƒe la lanye gbedoxɔ; ɖee mia wo miewɔe adzodalawo ƒe do.“

english_verse: Each day, Jesus kept on teaching in the temple. So the chief priests, the teachers of the Law of Moses, and some other important people tried to have him killed.
translation_verse: Eye wòle nu fiãm le mawuƒe la me gbesiagbe. Ke nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo kple dumegãwo di be, yewoawui;

english_verse: But they could not find a way to do it, because everyone else was eager to listen to him.
translation_verse: eye womekpɔ alesi woawɔ o; elabena dukɔ la katã ku de eŋu hele to ɖomii.

english_verse: The spies said to him, “Teacher, we know you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Eye wobiae gblo bena: Nufiala, míenyae bena, nègblɔa nya, eye nefia nu ɖe eteƒe, eye mèkpɔa ame ŋku me o; ke boŋ nèle Mawu ƒe ma la fiãm le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus
translation_verse: Tete zadukitɔwo dometɔa ɖewo, siwo sẽa nu le tsitretsitsi ŋuti bena, meli o la, va biae bena:

english_verse: When God raises people from death, whose wife will this woman be? All seven brothers had married her.
translation_verse: Azɔ le tsitretsitsi la me ɖee, wo dometɔ ka srɔ̃ nyɔnu la azu mahã? Elabena wo ame adre la katã ɖee kpɔ.

english_verse: asked him, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Gblɔe na mi, ŋusẽ ka nètsɔ wɔ esiawoe? Alo amekae tsɔ ŋusẽ sia na wò mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I want to ask you a question.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye hã mabia nya ɖeka mi, ne miagblɔe nam;

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?”
translation_verse: Yohanes ƒe mawutsidedetaname la, dziƒo wòtso loo, alo amewo gbɔ wòtso mahã?

english_verse: They talked this over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Ke woawo la woke ɖi kple wo nɔewo gblɔ bena: Ne miegblɔ bena: Dziƒo wòtso la, agblɔ bena: Ekema nukaŋuti miexɔ edzi se oa?

english_verse: And we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize. The crowd will stone us to death, because they think John was a prophet.”
translation_verse: Ke ne miegblɔ bena: Amewo gbɔ wòtso la, ekema dukɔ la katã laƒu kpe mí; elabena wokpɔ kakaɖedzi bena, Yohanes enye nyagblɔɖila.

english_verse: So they told Jesus, “We don't know who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Eye woɖo ŋu bena, yewomenya afisi wòtso o.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.” Renters of a Vineyard (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ nɛ wo bena: Ekema nye hã nyemagblɔ ŋusẽ, si metso wɔ nusiawo na mi o. Yesu do lo le weingbledela vɔ̃ɖiawo ŋu.

english_verse: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes, and they like to be greeted in the market. They want the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le agbalẽfialawo ŋuti, amesiwo lɔ̃a tsatsa le awu ʋlayawo me kple gbeɖonamewo le ablɔwo me kple nɔƒe gbãtɔwo nɔnɔ le ƒuƒoƒewo kpakple kplɔ̃ta nɔnɔwo le nuɖuƒewo;

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story: A man once planted a vineyard and rented it out. Then he left the country for a long time.
translation_verse: Eye wòde asi lo sia dodo me na dukɔ la bena: Amea ɖe de weingble, eye woɖee asi na agbleŋlɔlawo, eye wòyi nugbe eteƒe didi.

english_verse: When it was time to harvest the crop, he sent a servant to ask the renters for his share of the grapes. But they beat up the servant and sent him away without anything.
translation_verse: Eye le ɣeyiɣi nyui la dzi la edo dɔla ɖo ɖe agbledelawo gbɔ, bena woatsɔ weingble la ƒe kutsetsea ɖewo anɛ, ke agbledelawo ƒoe, eye wodoe ɖa asi ƒuƒlu.

english_verse: When the renters saw the owner's son, they said to one another, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ke esi agbledelawo kpɔe la, wode adaŋu kple wo nɔewo gblɔ bena: Esia nye domenyila la, mina miawui, bena domenyinyi la nazu mía tɔ.

english_verse: I'll tell you what. He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard.” When the people heard this, they said, “This must never happen!”
translation_verse: Ava, eye wòatsrɔ̃ agbledela siawo, eye wòade agble la asi na ame bubuwo. Ke esi wose esia la, wogblɔ bena: Kpao, meganɔ nenema o!

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses knew that Jesus was talking about them when he was telling this story. They wanted to arrest him right then, but they were afraid of the people. Paying Taxes (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfialawo kple nunɔlagãwo di bena, yewoalée le gaƒoƒo ma me, ke wovɔ̃ dukɔ la, elabena wodze sii bena, edo lo sia ɖe yewo ŋu. Nudzɔdzɔ na kaisaro.

english_verse: Jesus' enemies kept watching him closely, because they wanted to hand him over to the Roman governor. So they sent some men who pretended to be good. But they were really spies trying to catch Jesus saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Eye wole eŋu dzɔm, eye wodo adzamenɔla, siwo da alakpa be, yewonye ame dzɔdzɔewo la ɖa, bena woalée le nya me, ne yewoadee asi na fia kple mɔ̃mefia ƒe ŋusẽ?

english_verse: “Show me a coin.” Then he asked, “Whose picture and name are on it?” “The Emperor's,” they answered.
translation_verse: Mifia denario lam: ameka ƒe tata kple ŋɔŋlɔe le edzi mahã? Eye wogblɔ bena: Kaisaro tɔe.

english_verse: Then he told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Eyaŋuti mitsɔ nusi nye kaisaro tɔ la, na kaisaro, eye nusi nye Mawu tɔ la, na Mawu!

english_verse: Jesus' enemies could not catch him saying anything wrong there in front of the people. They were amazed at his answer and kept quiet. Life in the Future World (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye womete ŋu lée le eƒe nya me le dukɔ la ƒe ŋku me o, eye woƒe mo wɔ yaa le eƒe ŋuɖoɖo la ŋuti, eye wozi kpi. La ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi ŋuti.

english_verse: and said: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: Nufiala, Mose ŋlɔ ɖi na mí bena: Ne amea ɖe nɔviŋutsu, tsi srɔ̃ le esi la ku, eye megblẽ viwo ɖi o la, nɔvia naɖe srɔ̃a, eye wòado ƒome ɖi na nɔvia.

english_verse: There were once seven brothers. The first one married, but died without having any children.
translation_verse: Azɔ nɔviŋutsu adre li, eye esi gbãtɔ ɖe srɔ̃ la, eku megblẽ viwo ɖi o;

english_verse: The same thing happened to the third one. Finally, all seven brothers married this woman and died without having any children.
translation_verse: kple etɔ̃lia hã ɖee, eye nenema ke wo ame adre la katã megblẽ viwo ɖi o, eye woku.

english_verse: At last the woman died.
translation_verse: Emegbe la nyɔnu la hã ku.

english_verse: Jesus answered: The people in this world get married.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Xexe sia me viwo ɖea srɔ̃, eye wotsɔa wo nana, be woaɖe;

english_verse: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses said, “Teacher, you have given a good answer!”
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfialawo dometɔa ɖewo xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Nufiala, ègblɔe nyuie.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Why do people say that the Messiah will be the son of King David?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Aleke wɔ miegblɔ bena: Kristo la nye Dawid vi mahã?

english_verse: In the book of Psalms, David himself says, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right side
translation_verse: Elabena Dawid ŋutɔ gblɔ le Psalmo ƒe agbalẽ me bena: Aƒetɔ la gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ bena: „Bɔbɔ nɔ nye nuɖusi me,

english_verse: until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: vaseɖe esime matso wò ketɔwo awɔ wò afɔɖodzinu.“

english_verse: David spoke of the Messiah as his Lord, so how can the Messiah be his son?” Jesus and the Teachers of the Law of Moses (Matthew
translation_verse: Azɔ ne Dawid yɔnɛ be Aƒetɔ la, aleke wo wònye via mahã? Yesu xlɔ̃ nu nusrɔ̃lawo le agbalẽfialawo ŋuti.

english_verse: While everyone was listening to Jesus, he said to his disciples:
translation_verse: Ke esi dukɔ la katã le to ɖomii la, egblɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo bena;

english_verse: But they cheat widows out of their homes and then pray long prayers just to show off. These teachers will be punished most of all.
translation_verse: amesiwo mia ahosiwo ƒe aƒewo, eye wodaa alakpa nɔa gbe ɖiɖiwo dom ɖa; amesiawo laxɔ fɔbubu sesẽtɔ awu.

english_verse: Before all this happens, you will be arrested and punished. You will be tried in your synagogues and put in jail. Because of me you will be placed on trial before kings and governors.
translation_verse: Ke le nusiawo katã ŋgɔ la woaɖo woƒe asiwo mia dzi, eye woati mia yome, akplɔ mi ayi ɖe ƒuƒoƒewo kple gaxɔwo me, be woade mi asi na fiawo kple mɔ̃mefiawo le nye ŋkɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had.” The Temple Will Be Destroyed (Matthew
translation_verse: elabena nenem me siawo katã ƒe nunana la nye woƒe nukpɔkpɔ vivivo la ƒe ɖe; ke eya la, tso eƒe ahedada la me wòtsɔ nusiwo katã le esi la, heda ɖe eme. Yerusalem ƒe afedozuzu kple Kristo vava zi evelia.

english_verse: Some people were talking about the beautiful stones used to build the temple and about the gifts that had been placed in it. Jesus said,
translation_verse: Eye esi amea ɖewo le nu ƒom le mawuxɔ la ŋuti, alesi woɖo atsyɔ̃ nɛ kple kpe nyuiwo kpakple nunana, siwo ŋuti wokɔ na Mawu la, egblɔ bena:

english_verse: “Do you see these stones? The time is coming when not one of them will be left in place. They will all be knocked down.” Warning about Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Nusiawo, siwo ke kpɔm miele la, ŋkekewo gbɔna, le esiwo me womele kpe gblẽ ge ɖe kpe dzi, si womatu asii aƒu anyi o.

english_verse: Some people asked, “Teacher, when will all this happen? How can we know when these things are about to take place?”
translation_verse: Eye wobiae gblo bena: Nufiala, ekema ɣekaɣi nusiawo lava, eye nuka anye dzesi na ɣeyiɣi, si dzi nusiawo lava me mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied: Don't be fooled by those who will come and claim to be me. They will say, “I am Christ!” and “Now is the time!” But don't follow them.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Mikpɔ nyuie, bena woagaflu mi o! Elabena ame geɖewo lava le nye ŋkɔ la dzi agblɔ bena: Nyee nye esi, eye azãgbe la ɖo vɔ! Migadze wo yome o.

english_verse: When you hear about wars and riots, don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but this isn't the end.
translation_verse: Ke ne miase atiawo kple zitɔtɔwo la, migaɖi vo o; elabena ele be, nusiawo nava ve me gbã; gake nuwuwu la maɖo enumake o.

english_verse: Nations will go to war against one another, and kingdoms will attack each other.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na wo bena: Dukɔ latsi tre ɖe dukɔ ŋuti, eye fiaɖuƒe ɖe fiaɖuƒe ŋuti,

english_verse: There will be great earthquakes, and in many places people will starve to death and suffer terrible diseases. All sorts of frightening things will be seen in the sky.
translation_verse: eye anyigbaʋuʋu gã kple dɔwuame kple dɔvɔ̃wo lava teƒeteƒewo, eye ŋɔdzidonuwo kple dzesi gãwo latso dziƒo.

english_verse: You will be betrayed by your own parents, brothers, family, and friends. Some of you will even be killed.
translation_verse: Gake dzilawo kple nɔviŋutsuwo kple ƒometɔwo kple xɔlɔ̃wo ade mi asi, eye woawu mia dometɔa ɖewo.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be hated by everyone.
translation_verse: Eye amewo katã woalé fu mi le nye ŋkɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: If you are living in Judea at this time, run to the mountains. If you are in the city, leave it. And if you are out in the country, don't go back into the city.
translation_verse: Ekema amesiwo le Yudea la, nasi ayi towo dzi, eye amesiwo le etitina la, nadzo ayi, eye amesi wo le agbletawo la, nagayi ɖe eme o.

english_verse: When you see Jerusalem surrounded by soldiers, you will know that it will soon be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke ne miekpɔ aʋakɔwo ɖe to ɖe Yerusalem ŋu la, ekema midze sii bena, eƒe aƒedozuɣi ɖo vo.

english_verse: This time of punishment is what is written about in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋkeke siawo nye hlɔ̃biabiaŋkekewo, bena woawu nusiwo katã woŋlɔ ɖi la nu.

english_verse: It will be an awful time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children! Everywhere in the land people will suffer horribly and be punished.
translation_verse: Ke baba na amesiwo fu le wo ƒo kple amesiwo le notsi nam le ŋkeke mawo me; elabena hiãkame gã lava anyigba la dzi kple dɔmedzoe na dukɔ sia.

english_verse: Then Jesus told them a story: When you see a fig tree or any other tree
translation_verse: Eye wòdo lo na wo gblɔ bena: Mikpɔ gboti la kple atiwo katã ɖa:

english_verse: So, when you see these things happening, you know that God's kingdom will soon be here.
translation_verse: Nenema ke miawo hã, ne miekpɔ nusiawo le eme vam la, midze sii bena, mawufiaɖuƒe la gogo.

english_verse: Then the Son of Man will be seen, coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
translation_verse: Eye ekema woakpɔ Amegbetɔvi la wògbɔna le alilikpo me kple ŋusẽ kple ŋutikɔkɔe geɖe.

english_verse: Strange things will happen to the sun, moon, and stars. The nations on earth will be afraid of the roaring sea and tides, and they won't know what to do.

translation_verse: eye amewo ƒe gbɔgbɔ nu latsi le vovɔ̃ kple mɔkpɔkpɔ na nusiwo le anyigba blibo la katã dzi vam la ŋuti; elabena woaʋuʋu dziƒowo ƒe ŋusẽwo.

english_verse: You can be sure that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all of this takes place.

english_verse: The sky and the earth won't last forever, but my words will. A Warning
translation_verse: Dzi kple anyigba nu lava yi, ke nye nyawo nu mele yiyi ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: Don't spend all of your time thinking about eating or drinking or worrying about life. If you do, the final day will suddenly catch you
translation_verse: Ke mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie, bena nutsuɖuɖu kple ahamumu kple dzimaɖitsitsi ɖe nuɖuɖu ŋu nagate miaƒe dzi ɖe to o, eye ŋkeke ma nagalili mi abe mɔ̃ ene o;

english_verse: Watch out and keep praying that you can escape all that is going to happen and that the Son of Man will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti minɔ ŋudzɔ le ɣeawo katã yi me kple gbedodoɖa, bena miate ŋu asi le nusiawo katã, siwo le eme va ge la nu, eye be míatsi tre ɖe Amegbetɔvi la ŋku me.

english_verse: Jesus taught in the temple each day, and he spent each night on the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Ke le ŋkeke me la ebaa nu le mawuƒe la me, eye le zã me la edoa go yina ɖadɔa to, si woyɔna be Amito la dzi.

english_verse: Everyone got up early and came to the temple to hear him teach.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔ la katã vaa egbe ŋdikanya le mawuƒe la me, be yewoaɖo toe.

translation_verse: Eye dzi dzo wo, eye wodo ŋugbe nɛ be, yewoana gae.

english_verse: Jesus told them, “As you go into the city, you will meet a man carrying a jar of water. Follow him into the house
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Kpɔ ɖa, ne miede dua me la, amea ɖe, si tso tsikplu la, akpe mi; midze eyome yi aƒe, si ke me wòyi ɖo la me.

english_verse: Jesus got up from praying and went over to his disciples. They were asleep and worn out from being so sad.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtsi tre tso gbedodoɖa me la, eva nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ, eye wòkpɔ wo le alɔ̃ dɔm le nuxaxa ta;

english_verse: Judas went to talk with the chief priests and the officers of the temple police about how he could help them arrest Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye wòdzo heyi ɖaƒo nu kple nunɔlagãwo kple aʋafiawo, alesi woawɔ aɖe eyama asi na wo.

english_verse: He agreed and started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus when the crowds were not around. Jesus Eats with His Disciples (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wòlɔ̃ edzi na wo, eye wòle asinu nyuia ɖe dim be, yeadee asi na wo zimatɔmatɔe. Ŋutitotolẽvi kple nuɖuɖu kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he told the apostles, “Take this wine and share it with each other.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtso kplu ɖe asi la, eda akpe ɖe edzi hegblɔ bena: Mixa esia, eye mimã me le mia nɔewo dome;

english_verse: The one who will betray me is here at the table with me!
translation_verse: Ke kpɔ ɖa, yonyememɔfiala ƒe asi le kplɔ̃a dzi kplim.

english_verse: You will eat and drink with me in my kingdom, and you will each sit on a throne to judge the twelve tribes of Israel. Jesus' Disciples Will Be Tested (Matthew
translation_verse: bena miaɖu nu, eye miano nu le nye kplɔ̃ ŋu le nye fiaɖuƒe la me, eye miabɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuiwo dzi, be miadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu Israel-ƒome wuieveawo. Yesu gblɔ na Petro be, agbe nu le ye gbɔ ti etɔ̃.

english_verse: The day had come for the Festival of Thin Bread, and it was time to kill the Passover lambs.
translation_verse: Eye abolo maʋamaʋã ƒe ŋkeke la ɖo, esi dzi wòle be, woawu ŋutitotolẽvi la le.

english_verse: So Jesus said to Peter and John, “Go and prepare the Passover meal for us to eat.”
translation_verse: Eye wòdɔ Petro kple Yohanes gblɔ bena: Miheyi ɖadzra ŋutitotolẽvi la ɖo na mi, be miaɖu.

english_verse: But they asked, “Where do you want us to prepare it?”
translation_verse: Ke wogblɔ nɛ bena: Afika dim nèle bena, míadzra ɖo mahã?

english_verse: The Son of Man will die in the way that has been decided for him, but it will be terrible for the one who betrays him!”
translation_verse: Elabena ele eme bena, Amegbetɔvi la le yiyim le ɖoɖo la nu; gake baba na ame ma, si dzi wòato aɖee asi!

english_verse: Then the apostles started arguing about who would ever do such a thing. An Argument about Greatness
translation_verse: Eye wode asi biabia me le wo nɔewo dome bena, yewo dometɔ ka gɔ̃e le nusia wo ge mahã? Ameka ƒo ta le mawufiaɖuƒe la me?

english_verse: he said to them, “I have very much wanted to eat this Passover meal with you before I suffer.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Medi vevie ŋuta bena, maɖu ŋutitotolẽvi sia kpli mi, hafi ne makpe fu;

english_verse: After the meal he took another cup of wine in his hands. Then he said, “This is my blood. It is poured out for you, and with it God makes his new agreement.
translation_verse: Eye nenema ke wòtsɔ kplu la le fiẽnuɖuɖu la megbe hegblɔ bena: Kplu sia enye nubabla yeye le nye ʋu me, si woka ɖe anyi le mia ta.

english_verse: You have stayed with me in all my troubles.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la mieɖo dzi nɔ anyi kplim le nye tetekpɔwo me;

english_verse: So I will give you the right to rule as kings, just as my Father has given me the right to rule as a king.
translation_verse: eye nye la mele fiaɖuƒe ɖom ɖi na mi, abe alesi Fofonye hã ɖoe ɖi nam ene,

english_verse: Jesus said, “Simon, listen to me! Satan has demanded the right to test each one of you, as a farmer does when he separates wheat from the husks.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la gblɔ bena: Simon, Simon, kpɔ ɖa, Satana le mia dim, bena yeagbɔ mi, abe alesi wogbɔa lu ene;

english_verse: Jesus asked his disciples, “When I sent you out without a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals, did you need anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena. Esi medɔ mi, gakotoku kple mɔzɔkotoku kple atokotawo manɔ mia sii la, ɖe nane hiã mi mahã? Eye wogblɔ bena: Naneke mehiã mí o.

english_verse: The disciples said, “Lord, here are two swords!” “Enough of that!” Jesus replied. Jesus Prays (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, kpɔ ɖa, yi evee nye esi! Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Esɔ gbɔ. Getsemane.

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, I am ready to go with you to jail and even to die with you.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ ne bena: Aƒetɔ, mesu te be, mia kpli wò míayi gaxɔ me kple ku me.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Peter, I tell you that before a rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will say three times that you don't know me.” Moneybags, Traveling Bags, and Swords
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Petro, mele egblɔm na wò bena: Koklo mele atɔ ku ge egbea, hafi nasẽ nu zi etɔ̃ bena, yemenyam o. Ɖe nane hiã mi kpɔ mahã?

english_verse: Do this because the Scriptures say, ‘He was considered a criminal.’ This was written about me, and it will soon come true.”

english_verse: He said to them, “Why are you asleep? Wake up and pray that you won't be tested.” Jesus Is Arrested (Matthew
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti miele alɔ̃ dɔm? Mitsi tre, ne míado gbe ɖa, bena miagadze tetekpɔ me o!

english_verse: “Father, if you will, please don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
translation_verse: Fofo, ne èlɔ̃ la, tsɔ kplu sia yii le gbɔnye; gake menye nye lɔlɔ̃nu o, ke boŋ tsiwo woawɔ.

english_verse: Jesus went out to the Mount of Olives, as he often did, and his disciples went with him.
translation_verse: Eye abe alesi wònɔa wɔwɔm ene la, edo go yi ɖe Amito la ŋu, eye nusrɔ̃lawo hã kplɔe ɖo.

english_verse: When they got there, he told them, “Pray that you won't be tested.”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòɖo teƒea la, egblɔ na wo bena: Mido gbe ɖa bena, miagadze tetekpɔa me o.

english_verse: Jesus walked on a little way before he knelt down and prayed,
translation_verse: Eye wòdzo le wo gbɔ anɔ abe kpedadadzeƒe ene, eye wòdze klo do gbe ɖa gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Jesus was in great pain and prayed so sincerely that his sweat fell to the ground like drops of blood.
translation_verse: Eye le eƒe ʋiʋli me la edo gbe ɖa vevie gawu, eye wòva ve me bena, eƒe fifia le abe ʋukɔwo ene hele gegem ɖe anyigba toŋtoŋ.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, a crowd came up. It was led by Judas, one of the twelve apostles. He went over to Jesus and greeted him with a kiss.
translation_verse: Esi wogale nuƒoƒo dzi la, kpɔ ɖa, amehaa ɖe kple ame wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka, si woyɔna be Yuda la, le ŋgɔ na wo; eye wote ɖe Yesu ŋu, be yeagbugbɔ nu ne.

english_verse: and a servant girl saw him. Then after she had looked at him carefully, she said, “This man was with Jesus!”
translation_verse: Eye esi dɔlanyɔnua ɖe kpɔe le anyinɔƒe ɖe dzo la gbɔ la, ekpɔe du gblɔ bena: Amesia hã nɔ egbɔ kpɔ.

english_verse: One of the disciples even struck at the high priest's servant with his sword and cut off the servant's right ear.
translation_verse: Eye wo dometɔ ɖeka da yi nunɔlagã la ƒe dɔla, eye wòkpa eƒe nuɖusimeto.

english_verse: Jesus asked Judas, “Are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Yuda, nugbugbɔ nètsɔ le Amegbetɔvi la ɖem asi mahã?

english_verse: When Jesus' disciples saw what was about to happen, they asked, “Lord, should we attack them with a sword?”

english_verse: “Enough of that!” Jesus said. Then he touched the servant's ear and healed it.

english_verse: Peter said, “Woman, I don't even know that man!”
translation_verse: Ke egbe nu le egbɔ gblɔ bena: Nyɔnu, nyemenya eyama o.

translation_verse: Eye emegbe ʋee la ame bubu kpɔe, eye wògblɔ bena: Wò hã wo dometɔ ɖeka nènye. Ke Petro gblɔ bena: Ame, menye nyee o.

english_verse: They said, “Tell us! Are you the Messiah?” Jesus replied, “If I said so, you wouldn't believe me.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ne megblɔe na mi la, miele exɔ ge ase o;

english_verse: Jesus was arrested and led away to the house of the high priest, while Peter followed at a distance.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòlée la, wokplɔe heyi ɖe nunɔlagã la ƒe me. Ke Petro dze eyome ʋi gbɔna.

english_verse: At daybreak the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses got together and brought Jesus before their council.
translation_verse: Eye esi ŋu ke la, dumegãwo kple nunɔlagãwo kpakple agbalẽfialawo ɖi anyi, eye wokplɔe heyi ɖe woƒe takpekpe la me gblɔ bena: Nenye wòe nye Kristo la, gblɔe na mi.

english_verse: Peter replied, “I don't know what you are talking about!” Right then, while Peter was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
translation_verse: Ke Petro gblɔ bena: Ame, nyemenya nusi gblɔm nèle o. Eye esi wògale nuƒoƒo dzi la, kasia koklo ku atɔ.

translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ la trɔ kpɔ Petro dũ. Eye Petro ɖo ŋku Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya dzi, alesi wògblɔ nɛ bena: Hafi koklo naku atɔ egbe sia la, agbe nu le gbɔnye zi etɔ̃.

translation_verse: Tso esia dzi la Amegbetɔvi la anɔ anyi ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ ƒe nuɖusi me.

translation_verse: Eye wo katã gblɔ bena: Ekema Mawuvi nènye mahã? Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miawoe le egblɔm bena: Nyee.

english_verse: They replied, “Why do we need more witnesses? He said it himself!”
translation_verse: Tete woawo gblɔ bena: Ɖaseɖiɖi ka gahiã mí? Elabena mía ŋutɔwo miesee tso eya ŋutɔ ƒe nu me.

translation_verse: Eye woƒe ha blibo la katã tsi tre, eye wokplɔe yi Pilato gbɔ.

translation_verse: Tete wode asi enutsotso me gblɔ bena: Míekpɔ amesia wòle miaƒe dukɔ la ƒe tame trɔm, eye wògbe na amewo bena, woagadzɔ nu na kaisaro o hele gbɔgblɔm bena, ye ŋutɔe nye Kristo, fia la.

english_verse: Herod and his soldiers made fun of Jesus and insulted him. They put a fine robe on him and sent him back to Pilate.
translation_verse: Ke Herodes kple eƒe asrafowo ɖo vloe, eye woɖu fewu le eŋu, eye esi wodo aklalabiɖibiɖiwu nɛ la, egbugbɔe ɖo ɖe Pilato gbɔ.

english_verse: But they all kept on saying, “He has been teaching and causing trouble all over Judea. He started in Galilee and has now come all the way here.” Jesus Is Brought before Herod
translation_verse: Ke wogatsi edzi gblɔ bena: Ede zi dukɔ la me hele nu fiãm to Yudea katã me, eye wòdze gɔme tso Galilea vaseɖe afisia.

english_verse: But the whole crowd shouted, “Kill Jesus! Give us Barabbas!”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “Those are your words,” Jesus answered.
translation_verse: Eye Pilato biae gblɔ bena: Wòe nye Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la mahã? Eye wòɖo ŋu nɛ gblɔ bena: Wòe le egblɔm.

english_verse: Pilate told the chief priests and the crowd, “I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Eye Pilato gblɔ na nunɔlagãwo kple amehawo bena: Nyemekpɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke le amesia ŋu o.

english_verse: After Pilate learned that Jesus came from the region ruled by Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem at that time.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdze sii bena, Herodes ɖe ŋusẽ te wòtso la, eɖoe ɖe Herodes gbɔ, amesi ŋuta hã le Yerusalem le ŋkeke siawo me.

english_verse: Herod asked him a lot of questions, but Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Eye wòbia nya geɖewoe, ke eya la meɖo ɖeke ŋu nɛ o.

english_verse: That same day Herod and Pilate became friends, even though they had been enemies before this. The Death Sentence (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye Herodes kple Pilato wozu xɔlɔ̃wo le ŋkeke ma ke dzi; elabena tsã la adikã nɔ wo dome.

english_verse: As Jesus was being led away, some soldiers grabbed hold of a man named Simon who was from Cyrene. He was coming in from the fields, but they put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye esi wokplɔe yina la, wòlé Simon, Kirenetɔa ɖe, si tso agbleta gbɔna, eye wotsɔ atitsoga la ɖo edzi, bena wòatsɔe adze Yesu yome.

english_verse: One of the criminals hanging there also insulted Jesus by saying, “Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and save us!”
translation_verse: Eye vɔ̃wɔla, siwo wohe ɖe ati ŋuti la, dometɔ ɖeka hã gblɔ busunya ɖe eŋu bena: De menye wòe nye Kristo la oa, ɖe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò kple miawo hã.

english_verse: Pilate called together the chief priests, the leaders, and the people.
translation_verse: Eye esi Pilato yɔ nunɔlagãwo kple amegãwo kpakple dukɔ la ƒo ƒu la,

english_verse: Pilate wanted to set Jesus free, so he spoke again to the crowds.
translation_verse: Tete Pilato gaƒo nu na wo hele didim bena, yeaɖe asi le Yesu ŋu.

english_verse: Pilate spoke to them a third time, “But what crime has he done? I have not found him guilty of anything for which he should be put to death. I will have him beaten with a whip and set free.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo zi etɔ̃lia ke bena: Nuvɔ̃ ka gã amesia wo mahã? Nyemekpɔ naneke le eŋu, si dze ku o; azɔ maƒoe, eye maɖe asi le eŋu!

english_verse: The people kept on shouting as loud as they could for Jesus to be put to death.
translation_verse: Ke woawo la wotee ɖe eŋu hele ebiam kple gbe sesĩe bena, ɖeko woaklãe ɖe ati ŋuti. Eye woƒe gbewo wu etɔ.

english_verse: He freed the man who was in jail for rioting and murder, because he was the one the crowd wanted to be set free. Then Pilate handed Jesus over for them to do what they wanted with him. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Nenem eye wòɖe asi le amesi wòlé de gaxɔ me le zitɔtɔ kple hlɔ̃dodo ta la ŋu na wo, amesi wòbia; ke Yesu la, edee asi na woƒe lɔlɔ̃nu. Golgata.

english_verse: If this can happen when the wood is green, what do you think will happen when it is dry?
translation_verse: Elabena ne wole nusiawo wɔm ɖe ati mumu ŋuti la, ekema nuka wo ge wòala de ƒuƒua ŋuti mahã?

english_verse: Around noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until the middle of the afternoon.
translation_verse: Eye ano gaƒoƒo adelia me la zãdokeli do ɖe anyigba blibo la katã dzi vaseɖe gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi,

english_verse: Two criminals were led out to be put to death with Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye wokplɔ vɔ̃wɔla bubu eve hã, be woawu akpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Father, forgive these people! They don't know what they're doing.” While the crowd stood there watching Jesus, the soldiers gambled for his clothes. The leaders insulted him by saying, “He saved others. Now he should save himself, if he really is God's chosen Messiah!”
translation_verse: Eye ameha la le tsi tre le nu kpɔm ɖa. Eye dumegãwo hã ɖo hehe ɖe eta gblɔ bena: Eɖe ame bubuwo, neɖe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui hã, ne esia nye Kristo, Mawu ƒe ame tiatia la.

english_verse: The soldiers made fun of Jesus and brought him some wine.
translation_verse: Eye asrafo, siwo va egbɔ, be woatsɔ aha tsitsi nɛ la, hã ɖu fewu le eŋuti

english_verse: They said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself!”
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Nenye wòe nye Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la, ekema ɖe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò.

english_verse: But the other criminal told the first one off, “Don't you fear God? Aren't you getting the same punishment as this man?
translation_verse: Tete ekeme xɔ edzi hewo ɖe eta gblɔ bena: Alo wò hã, esi nèle fɔbubu ma ke me la, ɖe meva Mawu oa?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise that today you will be with me in paradise.” The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Vavã mele egblɔm na wò bena: Egbea ke nana Paradiso la me kplim.

english_verse: The sun stopped shining, and the curtain in the temple split down the middle.
translation_verse: eye ɣe la ɖo viviti, eye mawuxɔmetsovɔ la dze ɖe eve kpla.

english_verse: Then they went to prepare some sweet-smelling spices for his burial. But on the Sabbath they rested, as the Law of Moses commands.
translation_verse: Eye wogbugbɔ yi ɖadzra atike ʋeʋẽe kple ami ɖo. Ke wodzudzɔ le Sabat dzi le se la nu.

english_verse: A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home.
translation_verse: Eye ameha, siwo katã va ƒo ƒu ɖe nukpɔkpɔ sia ŋu la, esi wokpɔ nusiwo va dzo la, wogbugbɔ hele woƒe akɔtawo ƒom.

english_verse: All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye eƒe ame nyanyɛwo katã kple nyɔnu, siwo dze eyome tso Galilea la, le tsitre le adzoge ke hele nusiawo kpam ɖa. Yesu ɖiɖi.

english_verse: Joseph went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.
translation_verse: amesia yi Pilato gbɔ ɖabia Yesu ƒe kukua.

english_verse: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used.
translation_verse: Eye woɖee ɖe anyi, eye wòxatsa aklala ɖe eŋu, eye wòtsɔe mlɔ yɔdo, si woɖe ɖe kpe gbadza me la me, esi me amea ɖeke memlɔ kpɔ o.

english_verse: It was Friday, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
translation_verse: Eye wònye dzadzraɖoŋkeke, eye Sabat tu aƒe.

english_verse: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu, siwo dze eyome tso Galilea va la, kpɔ yɔdo la ɖa, kple alesi wotsɔ eƒe kuku la mlɔ anyii.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo gblɔ nusiawo na apostoloawo la, woawoe nye Maria, Magdalatɔ, kple Yohana kple Maria, Yakobo dada, kple nyɔnu mamle, siwo kpe de wo ŋuti.

english_verse: When they found the stone rolled away from the entrance,
translation_verse: Ke wokpɔ be, wòmũ kpe la ɖa le yɔdo la nu.

english_verse: they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus,
translation_verse: Eye esi woyi de eme la, womekpɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe kuku la o.

english_verse: and they did not know what to think. Suddenly two men in shining white clothes stood beside them.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me, esi wotsi dzodzodzoe le esia ŋuti la, kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu eve le tsitre de wo gbɔ le awu ʋlaya dadzowo me;

english_verse: The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, “Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive?
translation_verse: ke esi wovɔ̃, eye wode mo to la, wogblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti miele ame gbagbe dim le ame kukuwo dome mahã?

english_verse: ‘The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life.’ ”
translation_verse: Ele be, woade Amegbetɔvi la asi na nuvɔ̃wɔlawo, eye woaklãe de ati ŋuti, eye ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la wòatsi tre!

english_verse: That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, le ŋkeke ma dzi la wo dome ame eve yina de kɔƒea de, si ŋkɔ nye Emaus la me, eya kple Yerusalem dome anɔ stadio blaade.

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What were you talking about as you walked along?” The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nya ka ƒomeviwo nye esi ŋuti miele dze ɖom le le mia nɔewo dome le miaƒe azɔlizɔzɔ me, eye miele nublanuinu wɔm ale?

english_verse: We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la miekpɔ mɔ bena, eyae nye amesi le Israel ɖe ge. Kpe ɖe esiawo katã ŋuti la egbee nye ŋkeke etɔ̃lia, tso esime nusiawo va ve me.

english_verse: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning,
translation_verse: Gawu la mia dome nyɔnua ɖewo hã, siwo de yɔdo la gbɔ ŋdikanya la, do voɖi na mí;

english_verse: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
translation_verse: Eye mía dometɔa ɖewo yi yɔdo la gbɔ, eye wokpɔe, abe alesi nyɔnuawo gblɔ ene; ke eya ŋutɔ la womekpɔe o.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: O, ame masenugɔmewo kple amesiwo ƒe dzi le blewu be, woaxɔ nusiwo katã nyagblɔɖilawo gblo ɖi la, dzi ase.

english_verse: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?”
translation_verse: Alo mele na Kristo be, wòakpe nusiawo ƒe fu, eye wòayi ɖe eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus then explained everything written about himself in the Scriptures, beginning with the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdze egɔme tso Mose kple nyagblɔɖilawo katã dzi la, ede nusiwo le ŋɔŋlɔawo katã me le eŋuti la, ƒe gome fia wo.

english_verse: They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
translation_verse: Eye wozi edzi gblɔ bena: Na anyi kpli mí, elabena zã le dodom, eye ŋkeke la yi vɔ. Eye wòyi de eme, be yeanɔ anyi kpli wo.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me bena, esi eya kple wo le nuɖuƒe la, etsɔ abolo la, eye esi wòyra ɖe edzi, eye wòŋe eme la, etsɔe na wo.

english_verse: At once they knew who he was, but he disappeared.
translation_verse: Tete woƒe ŋkuwo ʋu, eye wodze sii, eye wobu vi le wo gbɔ.

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Alo míaƒe dzi melé dzo le mia me, esi wòle nu ƒom na mi le mɔa dzi, eye wòle ŋɔŋlɔawo me ɖem na mí la o mahã?

english_verse: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.
translation_verse: Eye wotsi tre le gaƒoƒo ma ke dzi, eye wogbugbɔ yi Yerusalem, eye wokpɔ ame wuiɖekɛawo kple amesiwo kpe ɖe wo ŋuti la, ƒo ƒu ɖi,

english_verse: And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter.
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ la tsi tre vavã, eye wòɖe eɖokui fia Simon.

english_verse: Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye woawo la woxlẽ nusiwo va dzo le mɔa dzi kple alesi wodze sii le aboloŋeŋe la me la, fia wo. Yesu ɖo eɖokui fia apostoloawo.

english_verse: While Jesus' disciples were talking about what had happened, Jesus appeared and greeted them.
translation_verse: Ke esi wole nu ƒom le nusiawo ŋuti la, eya ŋutɔ tsi tre ɖe wo titina, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ŋutifafa nanɔ anyi kpli mi!

english_verse: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
translation_verse: Eye woɖi vo, eye wovɔ̃ ŋutɔ, eye wosusu bena, yewokpɔ gbɔgbɔa ɖe.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nuka wɔ mieʋuʋu, eye nukaŋuti ɖikeke ɖo miaƒe dzi me mahã?

english_verse: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nye asiwo kple nye afɔwo ɖa bena, nye ŋutɔe nye esi; miƒo asi ŋunye, eye miakpɔe; elabena lã kple ƒu meli na gbɔgbɔ, abe alesi miekpɔ le ŋunye la ene o.

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation_verse: Eye esi wògblɔ esia la, etso eƒe asiwo kple eƒe afɔwo hefiã wo.

english_verse: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?”
translation_verse: Ke esi womexɔe se o le dzi, si dzo wo kple nuku, si wòwɔ na wo ŋuti la, egblɔ na wo bena: Nuɖuɖua ɖe le mia si le afisia mahã?

english_verse: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.
translation_verse: Eye wotso kalãmi kakɛa ɖe nɛ.

english_verse: He took it and ate it as they watched.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsɔe heɖu le woƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “While I was still with you, I told you that everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Books of the Prophets, and in the Psalms had to happen.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Esiawo nye nye nya, siwo megblɔ na mi, esi megali kpli mi la bena: Ele be, woawu nusiwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe se la kple nyagblɔɖilawo kpakple Psalmowo me le ŋutinye la nu.

english_verse: Then he helped them understand the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Tete woʋu woƒe tame, bena wòase ŋɔŋlɔawo gome;

english_verse: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Nenema woŋlɔ ɖi bena: Kristo lakpe fu, eye wòatsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe;

english_verse: They also say that all people of every nation must be told in my name to turn to God, in order to be forgiven. So beginning in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: eye bena, woaɖe gbe ƒã dzimetɔtrɔ hena nuvɔ̃wo ƒe keke le eƒe ŋkɔa dzi na dukɔwo katã la, adze gɔme atso Yerusalem.

english_verse: you must tell everything that has happened.
translation_verse: Miawoe nye nusiawo ƒe ɖaseɖilawo.

english_verse: I will send you the one my Father has promised, but you must stay in the city until you are given power from heaven. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Eye nye la mado Fofonye ƒe ŋugbedodo la ɖe mia dzi; ke miawo la minɔ Yerusalem-du la me, vaseɖe esime woatso ŋusẽ atso dziƒo ado na mi. Yesu ƒe dziƒoyiyi.

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔ wo do go vaseɖe Betania, eye wòkɔ eƒe asiwo dzi heyra wo.

english_verse: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me, esime wòle wo yram la, wotee ɖa le wo gbɔ, eye wokɔe yi dziƒo.

english_verse: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.
translation_verse: Eye esi wodze klo de ta agu nɛ la, wogbugbɔ yi Yerusalem kple dzidzɔ gã;

english_verse: They spent their time in the temple, praising God.
translation_verse: eye wonɔa mawuxɔ la me ɖaa henɔa Mawu kafum.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: Eya kple Mawue li le gɔmedzedzea me.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: Eya me agbe le, eye agbe la nye amewo ƒe kekeli la.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Eye kekeli la klẽna le viviti me, eye viviti la mexɔe o.

english_verse: God sent a man named John,
translation_verse: Amea ɖe va dzo, si Mawu do, eŋkɔe nye Yohanes.

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: Amesia va le ɖaseɖiɖi ta, bena wòaɖi ɖase le kekeli la ŋuti, bena amewo katã naxɔ ase to eyama dzi.

english_verse: The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.
translation_verse: Kekeli vavã, si klẽna ɖe amesiame me la, li gbɔna ɖe xexea me.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: Ele xexea me, eye wowɔ xexeame to eyama dzi, eye xexeame medze sii o.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: Eva ye ŋutɔ tɔwo gbɔ, eye ye ŋutɔ tɔwo mexɔe o.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: amesiwo womedzi tso ʋu alo tso ŋutilã ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu alo tso ŋutsu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me o ke boŋ Mawu me wodzi wo tso.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Eye Nya la trɔ zu ŋutilã, eye wònɔ anyi le mia dome, eye míekpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe abe Tenuvi, si wodzi tso Fofoa gbã la, ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ene, eye amenuveve kple nyateƒe yɔe fũ.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Elabena tso eƒe agbɔsɔsɔ me la mi katã miexɔ amenuveve ɖe amenuveve dzi.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is truly God and is closest to the Father, has shown us what God is like. John the Baptist Tells about Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mekpɔ Mawu ɣeaɖekeɣi kpɔ o; Tenuvi si le Fofoa kɔme la, eya gblɔe fia mi. Yohanes ɖi ɖase le Yesu ŋu le nunɔlagãwo kple Lewitɔwo ŋku me.

english_verse: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.”
translation_verse: Eye woʋu me, eye mese nu o, eye wòʋu me bena: Menye nyee nye Kristo la o.

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Eye wobiae bena: Ekema amekae? Eliya nenyea? Egblɔ bena: Menye nyee o. Nyagblɔɖila la nènyea? Eye wòɖo ŋu bena: O.

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ameka gã nènye? Bena miana ŋuɖoɖo amesiwo dɔ mi ɖa. Nuka gblɔm nèle le ɖokuiwò ŋu?

english_verse: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
translation_verse: Egblɔ bena: Amesi le ɣli dom le gbeadzi la ƒe gbe menye: „Midzra Aƒetɔ ƒe mɔ la ɖo“ abe alesi nyagblɔɖila Yesaya gblɔ ene.

english_verse: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.
translation_verse: Eye ame dodowo tso farisitɔwo gbɔ.

english_verse: They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
translation_verse: Eye wobiae gblɔ nɛ bena: Nukaŋuti nèle mawutsi dem ta na amewo, esi menye Kristo alo Eliya alo nyagblɔɖila nènye o mahã?

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Yohanes ɖo ŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye la mele mawutsi ɖem ta na amewo kple tsi; amesi mienya o la, le tsitre le mia titina,

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: amesi le megbenye gbɔna, amesi ƒe atokotawo nu ka medzem be, matu o.

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Nusiawo va ve me le Betania le Yordan godo, afisi Yohanes le mawutsi dem ta na amewo le. Yohanes ƒe ɖase evelia ɖiɖi le Yesu ŋu.

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, ekpa Yesu gbɔna ɖe egbɔ, eye wògblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu ƒe alẽvi, si le xexeame ƒe nuvɔ̃ la tsɔm yina la, enye si!

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Nenem me sia enye amesi ŋuti megblɔ le be: Ŋutsua ele le megbenye gbɔna, si tre vava nam, elabena eli, hafi meli.

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Eye nyemenyae o, ke boŋ bena wòaɖee ɖe go afia Israel, le esia ta meva le mawutsi dem ta na amewo ɖe tsi me.

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Eye Yohanes ɖi ɖase gblɔ bena: Mekpɔ Gbɔgbɔ la le ɖiɖim tso dziƒo abe akpakpa ene, eye wònɔ edzi.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Eye nyemenyae o; ke amesi dɔm be, made mawutsi ta na amewo kple tsi la, eya ke gblɔ nam bena: Amesi ke dzi nakpɔ Gbɔgbɔ la le ɖiɖim ɖo, eye wònɔ edzi la, eyae nye amesi le mawutsi dem ta na amewo kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Eye nye la mekpɔe, eye meɖi ɖase bena, amesia enye Mawuvi la. Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃la gbãtɔwo.

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Esi ŋu gake la, Yohanes gatsi tre kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dome ame eve,

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: eye esi wòkpɔ Yesu, si le tsa ɖim, dzi dũ la, egblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu ƒe alẽvie nye ekem.

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃la eveawo se eƒe nuƒoƒo, eye wodze Yesu yome.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu trɔ, eye esi wòkpɔ wo le eyome dzem la, egblɔ na wo bena: Nuka ɖim miele? Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Rabi , afika nenɔna?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo bena: Miva kpɔe. Eye wova, eye wokpɔ afisi wònɔna; eye wonɔ anyi kplii le ŋkeke ma dzi, anɔ gaƒoƒo ewolia dzi.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Eye ame eveawo dometɔ ɖeka, si se Yohanes ƒe nuƒoƒo, eye wòdze Yesu yome la, enye Andrea, Simon Petro nɔvi.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Eya kpɔ ye ŋuta nɔvia Simon gbã, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Míekpɔ Mesia la, .

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Ekplɔe va Yesu gbɔ. Eye esi Yesu kpɔe du la, egblɔ ne bena: Wòe nye Simon, Yona vi la, woayɔ wò be Kefas, .

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Filipo kpɔ Natanael, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Míekpɔ Yesu. Yosef vi tso Nazaret, amesi ŋuti woŋlɔ ɖi le le Mose ƒe se la kple nyagblɔɖilawo me.

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Natanael gblɔ nɛ bena: Ɖe nu nyuia ɖe ate ŋu atso Nazaret mahã? Filipo gblɔ nɛ bena: Va kpo.

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Yesu kpɔ Natanael gbɔna ɖe egbɔ, eye wògblɔ le eŋuti bena: Kpɔ ɖa, Israeltɔ vavãe, amesi me alakpa mele o.

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Natanael gblɔ ne bena: Afika nènyam le? Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Hafi Filipo yɔ wò, esime nèle gbotia te la, mekpɔ wò tso.

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Natanael ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Rabi, wòe nye Mawu ƒe Vi, wòe nye Israel ƒe fia.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Esi megblɔ na wò bena, mekpɔ wò le gbotia te la, èxɔe se mahã? Nu gãwo wu esiawo kpo ge nala.

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Míakpɔ dziƒo nuvo, eye mawudɔlawo anɔ dzi liam, eye woanɔ ɖiɖim ɖe Amegbetɔvi la dzi.

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la woɖu srɔ̃ɖeŋkekenyuie le Kana, le Galilea, eye Yesu ɖada le afima;

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: eye wokpe Yesu hã kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va srɔ̃ɖeƒe.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wein mede wo nu o la, Yesu dada gblɔ nɛ bena: Wein mele wo si o.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Nyɔnu, nya kae le mía kple wò dome mahã? Nye gaƒoƒo meɖo haɖe o.

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Dadaa gblɔ na subɔlawo bena: Nusi ke wòagblɔ na mi la, miwɔe.

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Woɖi kpezɔ ade ɖe afima le Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋutikɔklɔ ƒe kɔa nu; ɖesiaɖe xɔa tɔmedeze eve alo etɔ̃.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Midu tsi ɖe zɔawo me. Eye woɖui ɖe wo me vaseɖe keke wo to ke.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Azɔ mikui yi ɖana nuɖuɖudzikpɔla la. Eye wokui yi nɛ.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Ke esi nuɖuɖudzikpɔla la ɖo tsi, si trɔ zu wein, kpɔ la, — eye menya afisi wòtso o, hafi subɔla, siwo ku tsi la vɛ la, woawo nyae — tete nuɖuɖudzikpɔla la yɔ ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la,

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Amesiame tsoa wein nyuitɔ ɖoa anyi gbã, eye ne wonoe mu la, ekema hafi wotsɔa manyomanyotɔ la vanɛ; wò la èdzra wein nyui la ɖo vaseɖe fifi.

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Ke eya la ƒo nu le eƒe ŋutilã ƒe mawuxɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋutitoto la ɖo, eye Yesu yi ɖe Yerusalem.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsɔ kawo tro atam, eye wonyã wo katã do go le mawuƒe la me kpe ɖe alẽwo kple nyiwo ŋu, eye wòtrɔ gaɖuɖɔlawo ƒe ga kɔ ɖe anyi, eye wòtu asi woƒe kplɔ̃wo ƒu anyi;

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Tete eye nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo ŋku nya, si woŋlɔ ɖi la dzi bena: „Wò aƒe ŋuti ŋuʋaʋã la mim.“

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mimu mawuxɔ sia, eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe la magagbugbɔe atu.

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Eye wòkpɔ amesiwo le nyiwo kple alẽwo kple akpakpawo dzram kpakple amesiwo le ga ɖuɖɔm la bɔbɔ nɔ anyi le mawuƒe la me.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na amesiwo le akpakpawo dzram la bena: Mitsɔ nusiawo dzoe le afisia, eye migatsɔ Fofonye ƒe aƒe la wo nudzraƒee o!

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo xɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Dzesi kawo nèfia mí bena, èwɔ nusiawo mahã?

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Eye esi wòtsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo ŋku edzi bena, egblɔ esia ɖi, eye woxɔ ŋɔŋlɔ la kple nya, si Yesu gblɔ la, dzi se.

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòle Yerusalem le ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la ɖuƒe la, ame geɖewo xɔ eƒe ŋkɔ dzi se, esi wokpɔ eƒe dzesi, siwo wòwɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ŋutɔ medo ŋu ɖe wo ŋu o; elabena edze si wo katã;

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: eye mehiã bena, amea ɖe naɖi ɖase le ame ŋuti o; elabena eya ŋutɔ dze si nusi le ame me.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Ke amea de, si tso farisitɔwo dome la li, eŋkɔe nye Nikodemo, eye wònye Yudatɔwo ƒe amegã.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Amesia va egbɔ le zã me, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Rabi, mienya bena, nufiala nènye tso Mawu gbɔ va; elabena amea ɖeke mate ŋu awɔ dzesi, siwo nèwɔna o, ne menye Mawue li kplii o.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu xɔ dzi, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò bena: Ne womedzi ame tso dziƒo o la, mate ŋu akpa mawufiaɖuƒe la akpɔ o.

english_verse: Nicodemus asked, “How can a grown man ever be born a second time?”
translation_verse: Nikodemo gblɔ nɛ bena: Aleke lawo woadzi amesi ku amegã mahã? Ɖe wòate ŋu ayi ɖe dadaa ƒe dome zi evelia, be woagadzia?

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò bena: Ne womedzi ame tso tsi kple Gbɔgbɔ me o la, mate ŋu ayi ɖe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me o.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Nusi wodzi tso ŋutilã me la, ŋutilã wònye, eye nusi wodzi tso Gbɔgbɔ me la, Gbɔgbɔ wònye.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Megawɔ mo yaa na wò be, megblɔ na wò bena: Ele be, woadzi mi atso dziƒo o.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Ya la le ƒoƒom, afisi ke wolɔ̃na, eye nèsea eƒe gbe, ke mènya afisi wòtso alo afisi wòyina o: nenema kee nye amesiame, si wodzi tso Gbɔgbɔ la me.

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Israel ƒe nufiala nènye, eye menya nusiawo o mahã?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò bena: Míeƒoa nu le nusi mienyã la ŋuti, eye mieɖia ɖase le nusi míekpɔ la ŋuti, eye miexɔa miaƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la o.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Ne megblɔ anyigbadzinuwo ŋutinya na mi, eye miexɔe se o la, aleke lawɔ miaxɔ ase, ne megblɔ dziƒonuwo ŋutinya na mi mahã?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke melia yi dziƒo kpɔ o, negbe amesi ɖi tso dziƒo va ko, eyae nye Amegbetɔvi, si le dziƒo.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Eye abe alesi Mose kɔ da la ɖe dzi le gbeadzi ene la, nenema ke woakɔ Amegbetɔvi la ɖe dzi tsã,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: bena amesiame, si xɔa edzi sena la, nakpɔ agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Elabena ale gbegbe Mawu lɔ̃a xexeame bena, wòtsɔ ye ŋutɔ ƒe Tenuvi hena, bena amesiame, si xɔa edzi sena la, mele tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge o, ke boŋ wòakpɔ agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu medo via ɖe xexeame, be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexeame o; ke boŋ be woaɖe xexeame to eyama dzi.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Amesi xɔa edzi sena la, womadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui o; ke amesi mexɔa edzi sena o la, wòdra ʋɔnui xoxo; elabena mexɔ Mawu ƒe Tenuvi ƒe ŋkɔa dzi se o.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Ke esiae nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la bena, kekeli va xexeame, eye amewo lɔ̃a viviti la wu kekeli la: elabena woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo vɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame, si wɔa nu vlo la, léa fu kekeli la, eye meva kekeli la gbɔ o, bena woagahe adãnya ɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu o.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ke amesi woa nuteƒe la, eya va kekeli la gbɔ, bena woaɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ɖe go afia; elabena Mawu me wòwɔ wo le. Yohanes ƒe ɖase mlɔe, si woɖi le Yesu ŋu.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Nusiawo megbe la Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va Yudea-nyigba dzi, eye wònɔ afima kpli wo, eye wòde mawutsi ta na amewo.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Azɔ nyahehe ɖo Yohanes ƒe nusiawo kple Yudatɔwo dome le ŋutikɔklɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Eye wova Yohanes gbɔ gblɔ nɛ bena: Rabi, amesi le Yordan godo kpli wò, amesi ŋuti nèɖi ɖase le la, kpɔ ɖa, eya ke le mawutsi dem ta na amewo, eye amewo katã yi egbɔ.

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Yohanes ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Ame mate ŋu axa naneke o, ne menye ɖe wonae tso dziƒo o.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Mia ŋutɔwo mieɖi ɖase nam be, megblɔ bena: Menye nyee nye Kristo la o, ke boŋ ame dodo menye le eyama ŋgɔ.

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Amesi si ŋugbetɔ le la, eyae nye ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃, ke ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ƒe xɔlɔ̃, amesi le tsitre le to ɖomi la, kpɔa dzidzɔ ŋutɔ le ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la ƒe gbe ŋuti; azɔ nye dzidzɔ sia zu blibo.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Eyama latsi de edzi tsã; ke nye la mayi to.

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Amesi tso dziƒo gbɔna la, eya ƒo wo katã ta; amesi tso anyigba la, anyigba wòtso, eye anyigbanuwo ŋu wò ƒoa nu lena; amesi tso dziƒo gbɔna la, eya ƒo wo katã ta.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Nusi wòkpɔ kple nusi wòse la, eya ŋuti wòɖia ɖase lena, eye amea ɖeke mexɔa eƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la o.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Amesi le eƒe ɖaseɖiɖi xɔm la, eya ɖo kpe edzi bena, Mawue nye nyateƒetɔ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi Mawu dɔ la, Mawu ƒe nyawo ŋuti wòƒoa nu lena; elabena mena Gbɔgbɔ la le dzidzenu nu o.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Fofo la lɔ̃a Via, eye wòtso nuwo katã de esi me.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Amesi xɔa Via dzi sena la, agbe mavɔ le esi; amesi meɖoa to Via o la, makpɔ agbe o, ke boŋ Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe tsia eyama dzi.

english_verse: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself. Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
translation_verse: gake Yesu ŋutɔ mede mawutsi ta na amewo o, ke boŋ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawoe,

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: egblẽ Yudea ɖi, eye wògadzo heyina Galilea.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Ke ele nɛ be, wòato Samaria ayi.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Samaria-nyɔnu la gblɔ nɛ bena: Aleke wò, si nye Yudatɔ la, nèle tsi biam nye, si nye Samaria-nyɔnu, be yeano mahã? — Elabena Yudatɔwo kple Samaria-tɔwo menyina o —

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Nyɔnua gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, tsikunu mele asiwò o, eye vudoa me goglo; afika gɔ̃ nèkpɔ agbetsi la tsoe mahã?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Alo ɖe nèwu mía fofo Yakob, amesi na vudo la mi, eye eya ŋuta kple viawo kpakple eƒe lãwo no eme tsi mahã?
