english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: ke amesi ke lano tsi, si nye manae ƒe ɖe la, tsikɔ megale eya wu ge akpɔ o vaseɖe mavɔmavɔ me; elabena tsi, si nye manae la, latrɔ azu tsivudo le eme, esi anɔ dzidzim ayi ɖe agbe mavɔ me.

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Nyɔnua gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, na tsi siam, bena tsikɔ nagawum alo mava afisia tsi du ge o.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ nɛ bena: Heyi ɖayɔ srɔ̃wò, eye nava afisia.

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: elabena ŋutsu atɔ̃ nɔ asiwò kpɔ, eye amesi le asiwò fifia la, menye srɔ̃wo wònye o; èto nyateƒe le esia me.

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Nyɔnua gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, medze sii bena, nyagblɔɖila nènye.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Mia fofowo doa gbe ɖa le to sia dzi, eye miawo miegblɔ bena, teƒe le Yerusalem, afisi wòle be, woaɖo gbe ɖa le.

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Nyɔnu, xɔm se bena, gaƒoƒo gbɔna, esi menye to sia dzi alo Yerusalem miado gbe ɖa na Fofo la le o.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Miawo la miedoa gbe ɖa na nusi mienya o; miawo la miedoa gbe da na nusi mienya; elabena xoxo la tso Yudatɔwo gbɔ.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Gake gaƒoƒo gbɔna, eye wòde azɔ, esi nyateƒegbedoɖalawo ado gbe ɖa na Fofo la le gbɔgbɔ kple nyateƒe me; elabena Fofo la dia gbeɖoɖala siawo tɔgbe.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Mawue nye Gbɔgbɔ, eye amesiwo le gbe dom ɖa nɛ la, ele be, woado gbe ɖa le gbɔgbɔ kple nyateƒe me.

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Nyɔnua gblɔ nɛ bena: Menyae bena, Mesia, si woyɔna be Kristo la gbɔna; ne eyama va la, agblɔ nuwo katã afia mí.

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Nye, amesi le nu ƒom kpli wò la, nyee.

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Wole esia dzi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va, eye wòwɔ mo yaa na wo bena, ele nu ƒom kple nyɔnua ɖe, gake amea ɖeke megblɔ bena: Nuka dim nèle alo nuka nu ƒom nèle kplii mahã o.

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Tete nyɔnu la gblẽ eƒe tsize ɖi, eye wòdzo yi ɖe dua me, eye wògblɔ na ameawo bena:

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: Miva kpɔ amea ɖe, si gblɔ nusiwo katã mewo kpɔ la nam; ɖe menye esia nye Kristo la oa?

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Tete wodo go le dua me, eye wova egbɔ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Le esia me la nusrɔ̃lawo ɖe kuku nɛ gblɔ bena: Rabi, va ɖu nu.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ na wo bena: Nye la nuɖuɖu le asinye, be maɖu, si miawo mienya o.

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Ɖe amea ɖe na nanee woɖu mahã?

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye nuɖuɖu enye bena, mawɔ amesi dom ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃anu, eye mawu eƒe dɔwɔwɔ la nu.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Menye miawoe gblɔ bena: Ɣleti ene koe susɔ, eye nuŋeɣi la laɖo o mahã? Kpɔ ɖa, mele egblɔm na mi bena: Miwu miaƒe ŋkuwo dzi, eye miakpɔ agblewo dzi ɖa bena, woƒu xoxo, eye wonyo na ŋeŋe.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Amesi ŋea nu la, kpɔa fetu, eye wòƒoa kutsetse nu ƒu ɖe agbe mavɔ me, bena amesi ƒã nu kple amesi ŋe nu la, siaa nakpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Elabena le eya me nya, si wogblɔ ɖi be: Bu dona, bu ŋena la, enye nyateƒe.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Nye la medo mí, be míaŋe nusi ŋuti miedze agbagba le o; ame bubuwo dze agbagba, eye miawo miege ɖe woƒe dɔwɔwɔ la me.

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Eye tso du ma me Samariatɔwo dome ame geɖe xɔ edzi se le nyɔnu, si ɖi ɖase bena: Egblɔ nusiwo katã mewɔ kpɔ la fiãm la, ƒe nya ŋuti.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Samariatɔwo va egbɔ la, woɖe kuku nɛ bena, wòanɔ yewo, gbɔ, eye wònɔ afima ŋkeke eve.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Eye ame geɖe wu xɔ edzi se le eya ŋutɔ ƒe nya ŋuti,

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ na nyɔnua bena: Azɔ menye le wò nuƒoƒo ŋuti miexɔe se ɖo o; elabena mía ŋutɔwo miese, eye mienya bena, ame siae nye xexeame xɔla vavã. Yesu da gbe le Kapernaum aʋafia la ƒe viŋutsu ŋu.

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Elabena Yesu ŋutɔ ɖi ɖase bena, nyagblɔɖila mekpɔa bubu le eya ŋutɔ de o.

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi wòva Galilea la, Galileatɔwo xɔe, esime wokpɔ nusiwo katã wòwɔ le Yerusalem le ŋkekenyuie la ɖu ƒe; elabena woawo hã de ŋkekenyuie la ɖuƒe.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Ale wògava Kana le Galilea, afisi wòtrɔ tsi wòzu wein le. Ke fiaŋutimea ɖe li, amesi ƒe vi le dɔ lém le Kapernaum.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Esi wose bena, Yesu tso Yudea va Galilea la, eyi egbɔ, eye wòɖe kuku bena, neva, eye woada gbe le ye vi ŋu; elabena eɖo kudo nu.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Ne menye dzesiwo kple nukunuwo miekpɔ o la, miexɔnɛ sena o.

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Fiaŋutime la gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, va, hafi vinye la naku!

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Heyi, viwò le agbe. Eye ame la xɔ nya, si Yesu gblɔ nɛ la dzi se, eye wòyi.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòyina la, eƒe dɔlawo va kpee, eye woka eta nɛ bena: Viwò la tsi agbe.

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Tete wòbia gaƒoƒo, si dzi wòka ɖe eme nɛ la wo tsitotsito. Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Etsɔ le gaƒoƒo adrelia dzi ŋudza la dzo le edzi.

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Tete fofoa dze sii bena, enye gaƒoƒo ma, si dzi Yesu gblɔ ne bena: Viwò la le agbe, eye eya ŋutɔ xɔe se kple eƒeme blibo katã.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Esia nye dzesi evelia, si Yesu wɔ, esi wòtso Yudea va Galilea.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Nusia wo megbe la Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋkekenyuiea ɖe ɖo, eye Yesu yi ɖe Yerusalem.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Ke taa ɖe le Yerusalem le alẽgboa ŋuti, si woyɔna le Hebri-gbe me bena Betesda, esi ŋu akpata atɔ̃ le.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖe, si le ɖɔ lém ƒe blaetɔ̃ vɔ enyi sɔŋ la, le afima.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe nya menɔ mia me o; elabena amesi eyama dɔ ɖa la, eya dzie miexɔ se o.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kpɔ eyama le anyimlɔƒe, eye wonyae bena, enɔ anyi alea eteƒe didi la, egblɔ nɛ bena: Ele didim bena, wò lãme nasẽ mahã?

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Dɔnɔ la ɖo eŋu nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, amea ɖeke mele asinye, bena ne woblu tsia la, wòakɔm ada ɖe ta la me o, ke ne megbɔna la, kasia ame bubu trea emedzedze nam.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Tsi tre, naka wò aba dzi, eye nazɔ azɔli!

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Eye ame la ƒe lãme sẽ enumake, eye wòkɔ eƒe aba dzi hezɔ azɔli. Ke ŋkeke ma enye Sabat.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti Yudatɔwo gblɔ na amesi ŋu woda gbe le la bena: Egbee nye Sabat, eye womeɖe mɔ na wò be, natsɔ wò aba o.

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: Exɔ dzi na wo bena: Amesi na nye lãme sẽ la, eya kee gblɔ nam bena:

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Kɔ wò aba dzi, eye nazɔ azɔli. Wobiae bena: Amekae nye amesi gblɔ na wò bena: Kae dzi, eye nazɔ azɔli mahã?

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ke amesi ŋu woda gbe le la, menya amesi wònye o; elabena Yesu ɖe eɖokui ɖa le ameha, si le afima la ta.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Nusiawo megbe la Yesu kpɔe le mawuƒe la me, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, wò lãme sẽ, megãwɔ nuvɔ̃ azɔ o, bena ne nu vɔ̃ɖi wu esia nagawɔ wò o.

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Ame la to dzi heyi ɖagblɔ na Yudatɔwo bena, Yesu yenye amesi na yeƒe lãme sẽ.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Eye le esia ta Yudatɔwo ti Yesu yome, eye wodi be, yewoawui; elabena ewo nusia le Sabat dzi. Yesu ʋli eɖokui ta.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Ke eɖo ŋu na wo bena; Fofonye le dɔ wɔm vaseɖe fifi, eye nye hã mele ɖo wɔm.

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Le esia ta Yudatɔwo gadii ɖe edzi wu, bena yewoawui; elabena menye ɖe wògblẽ kɔ ɖo na Sabat la ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ eyɔ Mawu hã be eya ŋutɔ Fofoa, eye wòtsɔ eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ɖo Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu ɖo ŋu, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Vi la mate ŋu awɔ naneke le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui si o, ne menye Fofoae le ewɔm wòkpɔ o; elabena nusiwo ke wɔm eyama le la, esiawo Vi la hã wɔna nenema ke.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Ke Fofo la lɔ̃a Via, eye nusiwo katã wɔm eya ŋutɔ le la, efianɛ, eye wòafia dɔwɔwɔ gãwoe awu esiawo, bena miaƒe mo nawɔ yaa.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Elabena sigbe alesi Fofo la fɔa ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre, eye wògbɔa agbe; wo la, nenema ke Vi la hã agbɔ agbe amesiwo wòlɔ̃na.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Elabena Fofo la medrɔ̃a ʋɔnu amea ɖeke o, ke boŋ etsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la katã de asi na Via,

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: bena amewo katã nabu Vi la, abe alesi wòbua Fofo la ene. Amesi mele Vi la bum o la, mebua Fofo la, amesi dɔe ɖa la o.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesi le nye nya la Sem, eye wòle amesi dɔm ɖa la dzi xɔm le sesem la, agbe mavɔ le esi, eye mava ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me o, elabena eto ku me yi ɖe agbe la me xoxo.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Gaƒoƒo gbɔna, eye wòde azɔ, esime ame kukuwo ase Mawuvi la ƒe gbe, eye amesiwo see la, woanɔ agbe.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Elabena sigbe alesi agbe le Fofo la ŋutɔ ɖokui me la, nenema ke wòna Vi la hã be, agbe nanɔ esi le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui me:

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: eye wòna ŋusẽe, be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu hã, elabena Amegbetɔvi wònye.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Esia megawɔ mo yaa na mi o; elabena gaƒoƒo gbɔna, le esi me amesiwo katã le yɔdowo me la, wòase eƒe gbe:

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: eye amesiwo wɔ nu nyuiwo la, woado go hena agbe ƒe tsitretsitsi, ke amesiwo wɔ nu vlowo la, hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe tsitretsitsi.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: Nyemele naneke wɔm le ɖokuinye si o; abe alesi mesena la, nenema ŋu medrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖo, eye nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la le dzɔdzɔe, elabena nyemedia nye ŋutɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu o, ke boŋ amesi dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ko.

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Nye la, ne meɖi ɖase le ɖokuinye ŋu la, ekema nye ɖaseɖiɖi la menye nyateƒe o.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Ame bubue nye amesi le ɖase ɖim le ŋutinye, eye menyae bena, ɖase, si ɖim wòle le ŋutinye la, enye nyateƒe.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Miawo la mieɖo ɖo ɖe Yohanes gbɔ, eye wòɖi ɖase na nyateƒe la.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Ke nye la nyemexɔ ɖaseɖiɖi tso amè gbɔ o, ke mele nusiawo gblɔm, bena míakpɔ ɖeɖe.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Eyama enye akaɖi, si le bibim, eye wòle keklẽm; ke miawo la miedi be, yewoakpɔ dzidzɔ gaƒoƒo ɖeka le eƒe keklẽ la me.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Ke nye la mexɔ ɖaseɖiɖi, si lolo wu Yohanes tɔ; elabena dɔwɔwɔ, siwo Fofo la nam, bena mawu wo nu la, dɔwɔwɔ ma, siwo ke wɔm mele la, le ɖase ɖim le ŋutinye bena, Fofo lae dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Eye Fofo, si dɔm ɖa la, eyama ɖi ɖase le ŋutinye. Miese eƒe gbe ɣeaɖekeɣi alo kpɔ eƒe nɔnɔme hã kpɔ o.

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Miele ŋɔŋlɔawo me dzrom tsitotsito; elabena miesusu bena, miekpɔa agbe mavɔ le wo me, eye woamawo nye nusiwo le ɖase ɖim le ŋutinye;

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: eye mielɔ̃ be, miava gbɔnye, bena míakpɔ agbe o.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: Nyemexɔa kafukafu tso amewo gbɔ o.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Gake menya mi bena, Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la mele mia ŋutɔwo mia ɖokui me o.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Nye la meva le Fofonye ƒe ŋkɔa dzi, eye miele xɔyem o; ɖe ame bubu lava le ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkɔa dzi la, ne eya xɔ ge miala.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Aleke lawɔ miawo miate ŋu axɔ ase, esi miele kafukafu xɔm tso mia nɔewo gbɔ, eye kafukafu ma, si tso Mawu ɖeka gbɔ la, miedia eya o mahã?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Migasusu bena, nye la matso mia nu na Fofo la o; amea ɖe li, si tsoa mia nu, eyae nye Mose, amesi dzi mietsɔ miaƒe nukpɔkpɔ ɖo.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖe miexɔ Mose dzi se la, ne miaxɔ nye hã dzinye ase; elabena eyama ŋlɔ nya ɖi le ŋutinye.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Ke ne miexɔ eyama ƒe ŋɔŋlɔawo dzi se o la, aleke lawɔ miaxɔ nye nyawo dzi ase mahã?

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Tete woƒo wo nu ƒu, eye lubolo atɔ̃, siwo ameawo ɖu la, ƒe kakɛ, siwo susɔ la, yɔ kevi wuieve fũ.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Eye esi woɖi bena, yewoaxɔe ɖe ʋu la me la, kasia ʋu la ɖi go ɖe anyigba, si dzi yim wole la. Yesu enye agbebolo la.

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ekema dzesi ka newɔ, bena míakpɔ, eye miaxɔ dziwò ase mahã? Nuka nèwɔna?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mate ŋu ava gbɔnye o, ne menye Fofo, si dɔm da lae hee vɛ o, eye nye la mafɔe ɖe tsitre le nuwuwuŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: Ɖekakpuia ɖe le afii, eye lubolo atɔ̃ kple tɔmelã memee eve le esi; gake nuka wònye na ame geɖe siawo mahã?

english_verse: The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ bena: Mina ameawo nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi. Ke gbe mumu geɖe le afima. Eye ŋutsu, siwo ƒe xexlẽme nu anɔ akpe atɔ̃ la, bɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: eye woɖo ʋu heyina ƒu la godo ɖe Kapernaum. Ke zã do xoxo, eye Yesu meva wo gbɔ haɖe o.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Nusiawo megbe la Yesu dzo yi ɖe Galilea-ƒu, si nye Tiberia-ƒu la godo.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Eye ameha gãa ɖe dze eyome, elabena wokpɔ dzesi, siwo wòwɔ na dɔlélawo.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Filipo ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Abolo denario alafa eve hã mele wo nu ɖe ge, bena wo dome ɖesiaɖe naxa via ɖe o.

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka, Andrea, Simon Petro nɔvi la, gblɔ nɛ bena:

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu tsa aboloawo heda akpe le wo ta, eye wòtso wo na amesiwo le anyinɔƒe; nenema ke hã wòna tɔmelã memee wo geɖe alesi nu dim wole.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Ke esi woɖi ƒo la, egblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Miƒo kakɛ, siwo susɔ la, nu ƒu, bena naneke nagagblẽ o.

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu dze sii bena, wole vava ge, eye woalé ye sesẽ aɖo fiae la, eɖe eɖokui ɖe aga yi de to la dzi.

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke, eye ameha la le tsitre le ƒu la ƒe go keme dzi la, wokpɔ bena, ʋu bubua ɖeke megale afima o, negbe ɖeka ko, eye bena Yesu meɖo ʋua kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo o, ke boŋ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖeɖekoe yi, —

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Midze agbagba, menye ɖe nuɖuɖu, si gblẽna ta o, ke boŋ ɖe nuɖuɖu, si anɔ anyi hena agbe mavɔ la ta, esi Amegbetɔvi la lana mi; elabena nenem me la ŋu Mawu Fofo la de dzesi!.

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ de nyagblɔlawo me bena: „Eye wo katã woanye amesiwo Mawu fia nu wo.“ Amesiame, si see le Fofoa gbɔ, eye wòsrɔ̃e la, ava gbɔnye.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Azɔ Yudatɔwo he nya le wo nɔewo dome gblɔ bena: Aleke amesia ate ŋu ana eƒe ŋutilã mí, be míaɖu mahã?

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Eye esi fiẽ ɖo la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo yi ɖe ƒu nu;

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Eye le ya gã, si le ƒoƒom ŋuti la, ƒu la dze agbo.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Eye esi woku ʋu la anɔ stadio blave vɔ atɔ̃ alo blaetɔ̃ la, wokpɔ Yesu le ƒua dzi zɔm gbɔna, eye wòle tetem ɖe nu la ŋu, eye wovɔ̃.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ na wo bena: Nyee nye esi, migavɔ̃ o hee!

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: eye ʋu bubuwo tso Tiberia va ɖo afisi medidi tso teƒe, si woɖu abolo, si ta Aƒetɔ la da akpe le la, gbã o.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi ameha la kpɔ bena, Yesu alo eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo mele afima o la, woa ŋutɔwo ɖo duwo me, eye wova Kapernaum hele Yesu dim.

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Eye esi wokpɔe le ƒua godo la, wogblɔ nɛ bena; Rabi, ɣekaɣi nèva afisia?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu na wo, eye wògblɔ bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Miele diyem, menye bena, miekpɔ dzesiwo o; ke boŋ bena, mieɖu aboloawo ƒe ɖe, eye míeɖi ƒo.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔna bena: Nuka miawo, bena mia wɔ Ma wu ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Esiae nye Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ la bena, miaxɔ amesi wòdɔ ɖa la, dzi ase.

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Mía fofowo du mana le gbeadzi, abe alesi woŋlɔ di ene bena: „Ena abolo wo tso dziƒo, be woaɖu.“

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Menye Mose ye na abolo, si tso dziƒo la mi o, ke boŋ Fofonyee na abolo vavã mi tso dziƒo.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe abolo la enye esi ɖi tso dziƒo va, eye wòna agbe xexeame.

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, na abolo sia mí ɖaa.

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Nyee nye agbebolo la, amesi vaa gbɔnye la, dɔ mele ewu ge akpɔ o; eye amesi le dzinye xɔm le sesem la, tsikɔ mele ewu ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Gake megblɔe na mi bena, miekpɔm, eye miexɔm se o.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si Fofo la tsɔ nam la, ava gbɔnye, eye amesi vaa gbɔnye la, nyemale eƒu ge gbe akpɔ o.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Elabena medi tso dziƒo va, menye bena mawɔ nye ŋutɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu o, negbe amesi dɔm da la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ko.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ke esia enye amesi dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, bena nusianu, si wotsɔ nam la, ne magabu ɖeke o, ke boŋ bena mafɔe ɖe tsitre le nuwuwuŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Elabena esiae nye Fofonye la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, bena amesiame, si le Via kpɔm, eye wòle edzi xɔm le sesem la, akpɔ agbe mavɔ, eye nye la mafɔe ɖe tsitre le nuwuwuŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo li liʋiliʋi le eŋuti; elabena egblɔ bena: Nyee nye abolo, si di tso dziƒo va.

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ bena: Alo amesia la menye Yesu, Yosef vi la, amesi toto kple dada miawo mienyã lae o ɖe? Azɔ aleke wɔ amesia le gbɔgblɔm bena: Meɖi tso dziƒo va mahã?

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Menye bena, amea ɖee kpɔ Fofo la kpɔ o, negbe amesi tso Mawu gbɔ la, eyae kpɔ Fofo la.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesi xɔe se la, agbe mavɔ le esi.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Nyee nye agbebolo la.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Mia fofowo ɖu mana le gbeadzi, eye woku.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Esiae nye abolo, si ɖi tso dziƒo va, bena ame naɖu eƒe ɖe, eye maku o.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Nyee nye agbebolo la, si ɖi tso dziƒo va; ne amea ɖe ɖu abolo sia ƒe ɖe la, anɔ agbe tegbetegbe; eye abolo, si na ge mala ɖe xexeame ƒe agbe ta la, enye nye ŋutilã.

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ne menye ɖe mieɖu Amegbetɔvi la ɖe ŋutilã, eye mieno eƒe ʋu o la, ekema agbea ɖeke manɔ mia me o.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖua nye ŋutilã, eye wonoa nye ʋu la, agbe mavɔ le esi, eye nye la mafɔe ɖe tsitre le nuwuwuŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Elabena nye ŋutilã enye nuɖuɖu vavã, eye nye ʋu enye nunono vavã.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Amesi ɖua nye ŋutilã, eye wònoa nye ʋu la, enɔa menye, eye nye hã menɔa eme.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Sigbe alesi Fofo gbagbe la dɔm ɖa, eye nye la mele agbe le Fofoa ŋuti la, nenema ke amesi ɖuam la, eya hã anɔ agbe le ŋutinye.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Esiae nye abolo, si ɖi tso dziƒo va, menye abe esi fofoawo du, eye woku la ene o, amesi ɖu abolo sia la, anɔ agbe tegbetegbe.

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Nusiawo wògblɔ le ƒuƒoƒe la me, le esime wòle nu fiãm le Kapernaum.

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Azɔ eƒe nusrɔlawo dome ame geɖewo, esi wose esia la, wogblɔ bena: Esia nye nya sesẽ; ameka ate ŋu asee mahã?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Azɔ, ne míakpɔ Amegbetɔvi la le dziƒo, afisi wòtso la, yim ɖe?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ ta gbɔa agbe, ŋutilã menyo na naneke o; nya, siwo megblɔ na mi la, Gbɔgbɔ kple agbe wonye.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖewo le mia dome, siwo mexɔna sena o. Elabena Yesu nya tso gɔmedzedzea me wo amesiwo mexɔ edzi se o kple amesi le eyome mɔ fia ge.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Le esia ta megblɔ na mi bena, amea ɖeke mate ŋu ava gbɔnye o, ne menye ɖe wonae tso Fofonye gbɔ o.

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Tso esia dzi la eƒe nusrɔlawo dome ame geɖewo de megbe, eye womegazɔna kpakplii o. Petro nu Yesu me.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na ame wuieveawo bena: Alo miawo hã ɖe miele ɖiɖim be, miadzo mahã?

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Simon Petro ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, ameka gbɔ gɔ̃ míaʋu ayi mahã? Agbe mavɔ nyawo le asiwò.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Eye miexɔe se, eye míedze sii bena, wòe nye Kristo, Mawu ƒe kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Yesu xɔ dzi na wo bena: Menye nyee da mi ame wuieve oa? Eye mia dometɔ ɖeka nye abosam!

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ esia le Yuda, Simon Iskariot vi ŋuti, elabena eyae nye amesi le eyome mɔ fia ge, eye wònye ame wuieveawo dometɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Le nusiawo megbe la Yesu tsa le Galilea; elabena melɔ̃ be, yeatsa le Yudea o, le esi Yudatɔwo ɖi be, yewoawui ta.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Ke Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋkekenyuie, si nye agbadɔŋkekenyuie la ɖo.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Tete la nɔviawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Dzo le afisia, eye nayi Yudea, bena wò nusrɔ̃lawo hã nakpɔ wò dɔwɔwɔ, siwo nèwɔna.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Elabena amea ɖeke mewɔa naneke le ɣaɣlaƒe, eye wòdina be, ye ŋuta vea dze le gaglãgbe o. Ne ewo esiawo la, ekema ɖe ɖokuiwò fia xexeame.

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Elabena nɔviawo ke hã mexɔ edzi se o.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye azãgbe la meɖo haɖe o: ke miawo la miaƒe azãgbe la ɖona ɖaa.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Xexeame mate ŋu alé fu mi o; ke nye la eléa fum, elabena nye la meɖi ɖase le eŋuti bena, eƒe dɔwɔwɔ wo vɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Miawo la, miheyi ŋkekenyuiea ɖuƒe; nye la nyemeyina ŋkekenyuie sia ɖuƒe o; elabena nye azãgbe la mede vo haɖe o.

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ esiawo na wo la, etsi Galilea.

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Ke esi nɔviawo yi ŋkekenyuiea ɖuƒe la, eya hã yi, menye le gaglãgbe o, ke boŋ le adza me.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Azɔ Yudatɔwo dii le ŋkekenyuiea ɖuƒe, eye wogblɔ bena: Afika ame ma le?

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Eye liʋiliʋilili sɔ gbɔ le amehawo dome le eŋuti; ɖewo gblɔ bena: Ame nyui wònye; bubuwo gblɔ bena: Ɖabi, ke boŋ eflu ameha la.

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Gake la amea ɖeke megblɔe le eŋuti kple dzideƒo o; elabena wovɔ̃ Yudatɔwo.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Ke esi ŋkekenyuie la ƒe afã nu yi la, Yesu yi ɖe mawuƒe la me, eye wòfiã nu.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti Yudatɔwo tsi yaa gblɔ bena: Aleke wo amesia nya agbalẽ, esi nasrɔ̃ nu kpo o mahã!

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu ɖo ŋu na wo, eye wògblɔ bena: Nye nufiafia la menye tonye o, ke boŋ amesi dom ɖa la tɔe.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe le didim be, yeawɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, eya ladze sii le nufiafia la ŋuti, nenye Mawu me wòtso, alo nye ŋutɔe le nu ƒom le ɖokuinye ŋuti.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Amesi le nu ƒom le ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti la, dia ye ŋutɔ ƒe kafukafu: ke amesi le amesi ɖoe ɖa la ƒe kafukafu dim la, eyae nye nyateƒetɔ, eye nu madzɔmadzɔ mele eyama me o.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Alo menye Mose ye na se la mi oa, eye mia dometɔa ɖeke mewo se la dzi o; nukaŋuti miele didim be, mia wum mahã?

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ameha la ɖo ŋu bena: Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le mewo: ameka le didim be, yeawu wò mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Dɔ ɖeka ko mewɔ, eye mi katã miaƒe mo wɔ yaa.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mose tsɔ aʋatsotso na mi, menye bena, etso Mose gbɔ o, ke boŋ fofoawo gbɔ wòtso, eye le Sabat dzi la mietsoa aʋa na ame.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Ne wotso aʋa na ame le Sabat dzi, bena woagada Mose ƒe sea dzi o la, nukaŋuti miele dɔmedzoe dom ɖe ŋutinye, elabena mena ame blibo la ƒe lãme sẽ le Sabat dzi mahã?

english_verse: Don't judge by appearances. Judge by what is right.
translation_verse: Migatrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le dzedze nu o; ke boŋ midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Tete Yerusalemtɔa ɖewo gblɔ bena: Alo menye esiae nye amesi wodi be, yewoawu o mahã?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, ele nu ƒom faa, eye womegblɔa nyaa ɖeke nɛ o. Ɖe dumegãwo dze sii vavã bena, amesiae nye Kristo la mahã?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Ke amesia la mienya afisi wòtso; gake ne Kristo ava la, amea ɖeke manya afisi wòtso o.

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu do ɣli le mawuƒe la me hele nu fiãm, eye wòle gbɔgblɔm bena: Ẽ, mienyam, eye mienya afisi metso, eye nyemeva le nye ŋuta ɖokuinye si o, ke nyateƒetɔa ɖe li, amesi dɔm ɖa, amesi miawo mienyã o.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Nye la menyae, elabena egbɔ metso, eye eyamae dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Tete wodi bena, yewoalée, eye amea ɖeke medo asi ɖe egbɔ o; elabena eƒe gaƒoƒo mede haɖe o.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Ke ame geɖewo xɔ edzi se le ameha la dome, eye wogblɔ bena: Ne Kristo ava la, ɖe wòawɔ dzesiwo awu esiawo, siwo amesia wɔ la mahã?

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisitɔwo se alesi amewo le nusiawo ƒe liʋiliʋi lim le eŋuti. Eye farisitɔwo kple nunɔlagãwo dɔ atikplɔtɔwo ɖa, bene woaɖalée.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ bena: Manɔ anyi kpli mi ɣeyiɣi via ɖe ko, eye magblẽ mi ɖi ayi amesi dɔm ɖa la gbɔ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Miadim, eye miakpɔm o, eye afisi nye la mele la, miawo la miate ŋu ava o.

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo gblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Afika amesia le yiyi ge bena, mía te ŋu akpɔe oa? Ɖe wòle, amesiwo kaka ɖe Helatɔwo dome la gbɔ yi ge, eye wòafia nu Helatɔwo mahã?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Nya ka ƒomevi gɔ̃e nye esia, si wògblɔ bena: Miadim, eye miakpɔm o, eye afisi nye la mele la, miawo la miate ŋu ava o mahã?

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Ke le ŋkeke mamletɔ, si nye ŋkekenyuie gatɔ dzi la, Yesu le tsitre, eye wòdo ɣli gblɔ bena: Ne tsikɔ le amea ɖe wum la, neva gbɔnye, eye wòano tsi.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Amesi xɔa dzinye sena, abe alesi ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔ ɖi ene bena: Agbetsitɔsisiwo le sisi ge atso eyama ƒe dɔ me.

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ esia le Gbɔgbɔ la ŋuti, esi amesiwo le edzi xam le sesem la, laxɔ; elabena Gbɔgbɔ la meli haɖe o, le esi womekɔ Yesu ŋuti haɖe o la ta.

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Esi ameha la dometɔa ɖewo se nya siawo la, wogblɔ bena: Vavã amesiae nye nyagblɔɖila la.

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Bubuwo gblɔ bena: Esiae nye Kristo la. Eye bubuwo hã gblɔ bena: Ɖe Kristo la atso Galilea mahã?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋɔŋlɔ la megblɔ bena: Kristo la ava atso Dawid ƒe ƒome kple Betlexem-kɔƒe, afisi Dawid nɔ la me o mahã?

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ale ameha la dome ma le eyama ta.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Ke wo dometɔa ɖewo ɖi be, yewoalée; gake amea ɖeke meɖo asi ɖe egbɔ o.

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Tete atikplɔtɔwo va nunɔlagãwo kple farisitɔwo gbɔ; eye woamawo gblɔ na wo bena: Nukaŋuti miekplɔe vɛ o mahã?

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Atikplɔtɔwo ɖo ŋu bena Amea ɖeke meƒo nu ale, abe alesi amesia ƒo nui ene kpɔ o.

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Tete farisitɔwo xɔ dzi na wo bena: Alo ɖe wòflu miawo hã mahã?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Ɖe amegãwo alo farisitɔwo dometɔa ɖe xɔ edzi se mahã?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Negbe ameha sia, si mele se la me nyam o la, koe le wo ŋuɖinu wɔm.

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Nikodemo, si nye wo dometɔ ɖeka, amesi va egbɔ tsã la, gblɔ na wo bena:

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: Alo ɖe miaƒe se la drɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame, ne menye ɖe woase ame la ƒe numegbe gbã, eye wonyã nusi wòwɔ o mahã?

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Woɖo ŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Alo wò hã Galileatɔ nènye mahã? Dzro me, eye nakpɔ bena, nyagblɔɖilaa ɖeke metsi tre tso Galilea kpɔ o.

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Eye amesiame yi eƒe me.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu dzo yi Amito la dzi.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋdikanya la egava mawuƒe la me, eye ameha la katã va egbɔ, eye esi wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi la, efiã nu wo.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Eye agbalẽfialawo kple farisitɔwo kplɔ nyɔnua ɖe, si wolé le ahasiwɔwɔ me la, va egbɔ, eye wotsɔe ɖo titina

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: hegblɔ ne bena: Nufiala, wolé nyɔnu sia le ahasiwɔwɔ me ke.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Eye Mose de se na mi le se la me bena, woaƒu kpe amesia tɔgbe: azɔ wò la, aleke gblɔm nèle le eŋuti mahã?

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Ke wogblɔ esia hele etem kpɔ, bena yewoakpɔ nyaa ɖe atso enu. Eye Yesu do dɔgɔ̃e, eye wòtsɔ asibide ŋlɔ nu ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wogale ebiabia dzi la, efɔ kɔ te, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Amesi ke nuvɔ̃ mele eŋuti le mia dome o la, netre kpe la fɔfɔ ƒui.

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Eye wògado dɔgɔ̃e hetsɔ eƒe asibide ŋlɔ nu ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Eye esi wosee la, woƒe dzi tsi nya na wo, ave wodo go ɖekaɖeka hedze egɔme tso xoxoawo dzi vaseɖe ɖevitɔwo dzi, eye wogblẽ Yesu ɖeka ɖi kple nyɔnu la le afisi wòle la, le titina.

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Amea ɖeke o, Aƒetɔ. Ke Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Ekema nye hã nyemebu fɔ wò o; heyi, eye tso esia dzi la megawɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Yesu enye xexeame ƒe kekeli.

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu gaƒo nu na wo gblɔ bena: Nyee nye xexeame ƒe kekeli la; amesi ke dzea yonyeme la, mele viviti la me zɔ ge akpɔ o, ke boŋ agbe la ƒe kekeli anɔ esi.

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Tete farisitɔwo gblɔ nɛ bena: Wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ŋuti nèle ɖase ɖim le, wò ɖaseɖiɖi la menye nyateƒe o.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ na wo bena: Nye la, ne meɖi ɖase le nye ŋutɔ ɖokuinye ŋuti hã la, nye ɖaseɖiɖi la nye nyateƒe; elabena menya afisi metso va kple afisi meyina; miawo la mienya afisi metso va alo; afisi meyina o.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Miawo la ŋutilã nu miedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖo, nye la nyemedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu amea ɖeke o.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Gake ne nye la medrɔ̃ ʋɔnu la, ele nyateƒe nu, elabena menye nye ɖekae li o, ke boŋ mía kple amesi dɔm ɖa lae.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ ɖe miaƒe se la me hã bena, ame eve ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi le nyateƒe nu.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Nyee nye amesi le ɖase ɖim le ɖokuinye ŋuti, eye Fofo, si dɔm ɖa la, ɖia ɖase le ŋutinye.

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ nɛ bena: Afika fofowò la le? Yesu ɖo ŋu bena; Mienya mía kple Fofonye o. Ɖe mienyam la, mianya Fofonye hã.

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Egblɔ nya siawo le nunyuiedzraɖoƒe la, esi wòle nu fiãm le mawuƒe la me; eye amea ɖeke melée o, elabena eƒe gaƒoƒo mede haɖe o.

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Azɔ egagblɔ na wo bena: Nye la mele dzodzo ge, eye miadim, eye miaku ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃ la me afisi nye la meyina la, miawo la miate ŋu ava o.

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo gblɔ bena: Ɖe wòyina eɖokui wu ge, esi wògblɔ bena: Afisi nye la meyina la, miawo la miate ŋu ava o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Miawo lã anyigba mietso, ke nye la dziƒo metso; miawo la xexe sia me mietso, nye la nyemetso xexe sia me o:

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Eyata megblɔ na mi bena, miaku ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me; elabena ne miexɔe se bena, nyee nye esi o la, miaku ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me.

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ nɛ bena: Wò la ameka nènye? Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Nusi megblɔ na mi tso gɔmedzedzea me ke lae.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Nu geɖewo le asinye, be magblɔ, eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le mia ŋuti; ke amesi dɔm ɖa la, enye nyateƒetɔ, eye nusiwo nye hã mese le egbɔ la, nu mawo ke megblɔna na xexeame.

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Womenyae bena, eƒo nu na wo le Fofo la ŋuti o.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Ne miekɔ Amegbetɔvi la ɖe dzi la, ekema miadze sii bena, nyee; eye bena nyemewɔa naneke le ɖokuinye si o, ke boŋ abe alesi Fofonye fiãm ene la, nu mawo ke megblɔna.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Eye amesi dɔm ɖa la, li kplim, eye megblẽ nye ɖeka ɖi o: elabena nye la mewɔa nusi dzea eŋu ɖaa.

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na Yudatɔ, siwo xɔ edzi se la bena: Ne mienɔ nye nya la me la, ekema nye nusrɔ̃la vavãwo mienye,

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: eye miadze si nyateƒe la, eye nyateƒe la lawɔ mi ablɔɖeviwoe.

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Woɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Abraham ƒomeawo míenye, eye míenye amea ɖeke ƒe kluvi kpɔ o: aleke wɔ nagblɔ bena: Miazu ablɔɖeviwo mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu na wo bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesiame, si le nuvɔ̃ wɔm la, nuvɔ̃ ƒe kluvi wònye.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Ke kluvi menɔa aƒe me ɖaa o, aƒevi la nɔa anyi ɖaa.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Eyata ne Vi ɖa wɔ mi ablɔɖeviwo la, ekema m anye ablɔɖeviwo vavã.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Menyae bena, Abraham ƒomea wo mienye; gake miedi be, yewoawum, elabena nye nya la mexɔ dzi na mi o.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Nye lã nusiwo ke mekpɔ le Fofonye gbɔ la, eya megblɔna, eye miawo hã nusiwo miese tso: mia fofo gbɔ la, eya miewɔna.

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Woxɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Mia fofoe nye Abraham. Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Ɖe Abraham viwo mienye la, ne miawɔ Abraham ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la miedi be, yewoawum, nye amesi gblɔ nyateƒe, si mese tso Mawu gbɔ la, na mi; Abraham mewɔ esia o.

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Miele mia fofo la ƒe nuwɔnawo wɔm. Wogblɔ ne bena: Miawo la menye ahasiviwo míenye o; fofo ɖekae li na mí, eyae nye Mawu.

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Ɖe Mawu nye mia Fofo la, ne mialɔ̃m, elabena nye la medo go tso Mawu me va; elabena menye ɖokuinye si meva le o, ke boŋ eyae dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti miele si dzem nye nuƒoƒo oa? Elabena miate ŋu ase nye nya la o.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Miawo la mietso fofo, si nye Abosam la me, eye mia fofo ƒe nudzodzrowo miedina be, miawɔ Eya la amewula wònye tso gɔmedzedzea me, eye mele tsitre ɖe nyateƒe la me o, elabena nyateƒe mele eyama me o. Ne ele aʋatso kam la, eƒoa nu tso eya ŋutɔ ɖokui me, elabena aʋatsokala kple aʋatsokafofo wònye.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, le esi mele nyateƒe gblɔm ta la, miele dzinye xɔm le sesem o.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Ameka le mia dome ali nuvɔ̃ ɖe dzinye mahã? Ne megblɔ nyateƒe la, nukaŋuti miexɔm se o mahã?

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Amesi tso Mawu me la, sea Mawu ƒe nyawo; miawo la miele wo sem o, le esi mietso Mawu me o la ta.

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo xɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Ɖe miegblɔe de eteƒe bena, Samariatɔ nenye, eye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le mewo o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Nye la gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ mele menye o; ke mele Fofonye bum, eye miawo miele vlo domem.

english_verse: years old!” they said. “How could you have seen Abraham?”
translation_verse: Ke nye la nyemedia nye kafukafu o; amea de li, si le edim, eye wòle ʋɔnu drɔ̃m.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ne amea ɖe dzra nye nya ɖo la, mele ku kpɔ ge akpɔ o vaseɖe mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo gblɔ nɛ bena: Azɔ ko míedze sii bena, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le mewo. Abraham ku, nyagblɔɖilawo hã ku, eye wòa nèle gbɔgblɔm bena: Ne amea ɖe dzra nye nya ɖo la, mele ku ɖɔ ge akpɔ o vaseɖe mavɔmavɔ me mahã?

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: Ɖe wòa nèwu mia fofo Abraham, si ku la, mahã. Eye nyagblɔɖilawo hã ku! Ameka nèle ɖokuiwò bumii mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Nenye ɖe mekafu ɖokuinye la, ekema nye kafukafu la menye naneke o; Fofonye li, amesi miawo miele gbɔgblɔm bena, enye miaƒe Mawu la, eyae le kafuyem.

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: Eye mienyae o, gake nye la menyae, eye ne megblɔ bena, nyemenyae o la, ekema manye aʋatsokala abe miawo ke ene; gake menyae, eye medzra eƒe nya la ɖo.

english_verse: Your father Abraham was really glad to see me.”
translation_verse: Mia fofo Abraham dzɔ dzi be, yeakpɔ nye ŋkeke la, eye wòkpɔe, eye wòkpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Hafi Abraham nava dzɔ la, nyeama meli xoxo.

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Tete wofa kpewo, be yewoaƒui; ke Yesu ɣla eɖokui, eye wòdo go le mawuƒe la me.

english_verse: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòle eme tsom yina la, ekpɔ amea ɖe, si nye ŋkuagbãtɔ tso eƒe dzidzi me ke.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
translation_verse: Eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo biae bena: Rabi, ameka wo nuvɔ̃, amesia loo, alo eƒe dzilawo bena, wodzii ŋkugbagbãe mahã?

english_verse: “No, it wasn't!” Jesus answered. “But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him.
translation_verse: Yesu do ŋu bena: Menye amesia alo eƒe dzilawoe wo nuvɔ̃ o, ke boŋ bena woaɖe Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ɖe go afia le eyama me.

english_verse: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.
translation_verse: Ele nam bena, mawɔ amesi dɔm ɖa la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo, zi alesi ŋkeke li; zã gbɔna dodo ge, le esi me amea ɖeke mate ŋu awɔ dɔ o.

english_verse: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
translation_verse: Esi mele xexeame la, xexeame ƒe kekeli menye.

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ esiawo la, eɖe ta ɖe anyigba, eye wotsɔ ta la henyã anyi, eye wòtsɔ anyi la hesisi ɖe eƒe ŋkuwo dzi,

english_verse: Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Yi, nale tsi le Siloa-ta la me . Tete wòyi ɖale tsi la, eye wòva le nu kpɔm.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: Eyata eƒe aƒelikawo kple amesiwo kpɔe tsã bena, nubiala wònye la, gblɔ bena: Ɖe menye amesia nɔ anyi henɔa nu biam la o mahã?

english_verse: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
translation_verse: Bubuwo gblɔ bena: Eyae; ɖewo hã gblɔ bena: Ɖabi, ke boŋ ɖe wòɖii; eya ŋutɔ gblɔ bena: Nyee.

english_verse: “Then how can you see?” they asked.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ekema aleke wo wò ŋkuwo ʋu mahã?

english_verse: He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu bena: Amesi woyɔna be Yesu la, eyae nyã anyi, eye wòtsɔe sisi ɖe nye ŋkuwo dzi, eye wògblɔ nam bena: Yi Siloa me nale tsi; ale meyi ɖale tsi, eye mekpɔ nu.

english_verse: “Where is he now?” they asked. “I don't know,” he answered. The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ bena: Afika eyama le? Egblɔ bena: Nyemenyae o. Farisitɔwo dzro nukudɔwɔwɔ la me.

english_verse: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
translation_verse: Tete farisitɔwo hã gabiae, alesi wòwɔ hafi kpɔ nu. Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Anyi wòtso heɖo nye ŋkuwo dzi, eye mele tsi, eye mele nu kpɔm.

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,
translation_verse: Tete farisitɔwo dome ɖewo gblɔ bena: Amesia la menye Mawu gbɔ wòtso o, elabena medzra Sabat la ɖo o. Bubuwo gblɔ bena: Aleke nuvɔ̃wɔla ate ŋu awɔ dzesi siawo tɔgbe mahã? Eye mamã ɖo wo dome.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Azɔ wògagblɔ na ŋkuagbãtɔ la bena: Wò la, esi woʋu ŋkuwo na wò la, aleke gblɔm nèle le eŋuti mahã? Eye wògblɔ bena: Nyagblɔɖila wònye.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Ke Yudatɔwo mexɔe se le eŋuti bena, ŋkuagbãtɔ wònye tsã hele nu kpɔm o, vaseɖe esime woyɔ amesi gale nu kpɔm la, ƒe dzilawo vɛ.

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: Eye wòbia wo bena: Ɖe esia nye miaƒe vi, si miegblɔ bena, ŋkugbagbã wodzii mahã? Aleke wɔ wòle nu kpɔm azɔ mahã?

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzilawo ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Míenyae bena, amesia mía vi wònye, eye ŋkugbagbã wodzii;

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: ke alesi wɔ wòle nu kpɔm azɔ la, míenyae o, alo amesi nu ŋkuwo ne la, míenyae o; mibia eya ŋutɔ, etsi, aƒo nu le eɖokui ŋuti.

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ale wogayɔ amesi ƒe ŋkuwo gbã tsã la zi evelia, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Tsɔ kafukafu na Mawu, miawo míenyae bena, amesia la nuvɔ̃wɔla wònye.

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Tete eyama xɔ dzi bena: Nenye nuvɔ̃wɔla wònye la, nyemenyɛ o, nu ɖeka ko menya bena, ŋkuagbãtɔ menye tsã, azɔ mele nu kpɔm.

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Eye wògagblɔ ne bena: Nuka wòwɔ na wòa? Aleke wòdu ŋku na wò mahã?

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu na wo bena: Megblɔe na mi xoxo, eye miesee o; nukaŋuti miele didim bena, miagasee mahã? Ɖe miawo hã miele didim bena, míazu eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo mahã?

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Eye wodzui gblɔ bena: Wòe nye eyama ƒe nusrɔ̃la, ke miawo la Mose ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo mienye.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Mienya bena, Mawu ƒo nu kple Mose; ke amesia la mienyã afisi wòtso o.

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Ame la xɔ dzi gblɔ na wo bena: Esia mee wòwɔ nuku le bena, mienya afisi wòtso o, eye wòʋu nye ŋkuwo.

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Mienya bena, Mawu meɖoa to nuvɔ̃wɔlawo o, ke boŋ ne amea ɖe vɔ̃a Mawu, eye wòwɔa eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, eyae woɖoa toe.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Tso xexemedzɔgbe taa la womese kpɔ bena, amea ɖe ʋu ŋkuwo na amesi wodzi ŋkugbagbã o.

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Ɖe amesia metso Mawu gbɔ o la, ne mate ŋu awɔ naneke o.

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Woxɔ dzi gblɔ nɛ bena: Nuvɔ̃ me pete wodzi wò ɖo, eye wòa nèle nu fiãm mi mahã? Eye wonyae do goe. Yesu wu gbedada na ŋkuagbãtɔ la nu.

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Yesu se bena, wonyae ɖo goe, eye esi wokpɔe la, egblɔ bena: Ele Mawuvi la dzi xɔm le sesem mahã?

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋu nɛ gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, amekae nye esi, bena maxɔ edzi ase mahã?

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Amesi nèkpɔ kple amesi le nu ƒom kpli wò la, eyae.

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, mexɔe se; eye wòdze klo ɖe ta agu nɛ

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesu gblɔ bena: Nye la ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ta meva xexe sia me ɖo, bena amesiwo mele nu kpɔm o la, ne woakpɔ nu, eye amesiwo le nu kpɔm la, ne woazu ŋkuagbãtɔwo?

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard Jesus say this, they asked, “Are we blind?”
translation_verse: Eye farisitɔ, siwo le eŋuti la see, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ɖe miawo hã míenye ŋkuagbãtɔwo mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Ɖe míenye ŋkuagbãtɔwo la, ne nuvɔ̃ mele mia ŋu o; ke azɔ la miele gbɔgblɔm bena: Miele nu kpɔm; eyata miaƒe nuvɔ̃ la tsi anyi.

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesi metoa agboa nu heyina ɖe alèxɔa me o, ke wòyi ɖaliaa afi bubu gena ɖe eme la, eya nye fiafitɔ kple adzodala.

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: Eya la agbonudzɔla ʋuna nɛ, eye alẽawo sea eyama ƒe gbe, eye wòyɔa ye ŋutɔ ƒe alẽwo kple ŋkɔ, eye wòkplɔa wo doa goe.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: Ne eɖe ye ŋutɔ tɔwo katã do go la, edzea ŋgɔ na wo, eye alẽawo dzea eyome, elabena wodzea si eƒe gbe.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Ke womele ame futɔ yome dze ge o, ke boŋ wòasi le egbɔ, elabena womedzea si ame tutɔwo ƒe gbe o.

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Lo sia Yesu do na wo; ke ame mawo mese nusiwo wògblɔ na wo la gɔme o.

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Nyee nye agbo na alẽawo.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Ame geɖe alesi tre vava nam la, wo katã fiafitɔwo kple adzodalawo wonye; ke alẽawo meɖoa to woamawo o.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Nyee nye agbo la; ne amea ɖe to menye yi ɖe eme la, akpɔ ɖeɖe, eye wòayi ɖe eme agado go, eye wòakpɔ nyiƒe.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Fiafi la mevana o, ne menye le fififi kple wuwu kpakple gbegblẽ ta o.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: Nye la meva, bena woakpɔ agbe kple agbɔsɔsɔ.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Nyee nye alẽkplɔla nyui la, alẽkplɔla nyui la tsoa eƒe agbe ɖoa anyi ɖe alẽawo ta. Eye amesi nye agbatedɔwɔla, eye menye alẽkplɔla o, amesi alẽawo menye eya ŋuta tɔ o la, kpɔa amegãxi gbɔna, eye wògblẽa alẽawo ɖi, eye wòsina, eye amegãxi la léa alẽawo, eye wòka wo gbẽ;

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: esina, elabena agbatedɔwɔla wònye, eye meléa be na alẽawo o.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: Nyee nye alẽkplɔla nyui la; eye menya tɔnyewo, eye tɔnyewo hã nyam;

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: sigbe alesi Fofo la nyam, eye nye hã menya Fofo la ene, eye metsɔ nye agbe ɖo anyi ɖe alẽawo ta.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: Eye alé bubuwo le asinye, siwo metso alẽxɔ sia me o, eye ele nam be, makplɔ woawo hã, eye woase nye gbe, eye woazu alẽha ɖeka kple alẽkplɔla ɖeka.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: Le esia ta Fofo la lɔ̃am ɖo; elabena nye la metsɔ nye agbe ɖo anyi, bena magaxɔe.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mexɔe le asinye o, ke nye ŋutɔe tsɔe ɖo anyi le ɖokuinye si; ŋusẽ le asinye, be matsɔe ɖo anyi, eye ŋusẽ le asinye, be magatsɔe. Nenem se sia la mexɔa tso Fofonye gbɔ.

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Tete mamã gaɖo Yudatɔwo dome le nya siawo ta.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Eye wo dome ame geɖewo gblɔ bena: Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le eme, eye eƒe tame da; nukaŋuti miele to ɖomi mahã?

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Bubuwo gblɔ bena: Nenem nya siawo la menye amesi me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le la, ƒe nyawo o. Ɖe gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ ate ŋu aʋu ŋkuwo na ŋkuagbãtɔwo mahã? Yesu ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ le gbedoxɔ ŋu kɔƒe.

english_verse: That winter, Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Temple Festival.
translation_verse: Eye mawuxɔ ƒe ɖɔɖɔɖoŋkekenyuie ɖo le Yerusalem, eye wònye vuvɔŋɔli;

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: eye Yesu le tsa ɖim le mawuƒea le Salomo ƒe akpata la me.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Tete la Yudatɔwo va ƒo xlãe, eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Ɣekaɣi dzi nana miaƒe luʋɔ natsi dzodzodzoe ase ɖo mahã? Nenye wòe nye Kristo la, gblɔe na mi faa.

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu na wo bena: Megblɔe na mi, eye miexɔe se o: dɔ, siwo wɔm mele le Fofonye ƒe ŋkɔa dzi la, woawo le ɖase ɖim le ŋutinye.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Ke miawo miele exɔm le sesem o: elabena miawo míenye nye alẽwo dometɔwo o, abe alesi megblɔ na mi ene.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Nye alẽwo sea nye gbe, eye nye la menya wo, eye wodzea yonyeme;

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
