translation_verse: eye nye la mena agbe mavɔ wo, eye womele tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge akpɔ o, eye amea ɖeke mele woamawo xɔ ge sesẽ le asinye o.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Fofonye, si tsɔ wo nam la, eya ƒo nuwo katã ta, eye amea ɖeke mate ŋu axɔ wo sesẽ le Fofonye si me o.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Mia kple Fofonye la ɖekae míele.

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Tete la Yudatɔwo gafɔ kpewo, bena yewoaƒui.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu na wo bena; Dɔwɔwɔ nyui geɖewo mefia mi tso Fofonye gbɔ; dɔwɔwɔwo dome ka ta miele kpe fɔ ge aƒum ɖo mahã?

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Menye dɔwɔwɔ nyuiwo ŋuti miele kpe ƒu ge wò ɖo o, ke boŋ le busubɔbɔ ŋuti; elabena ame nènye, eye nèwɔ ɖokuiwò Mawui.

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Yesu xɔ dzi na wo bena: Alo womeŋlɔ ɖe miaƒe se la me o bena: „Me bena: mawuwo míenye“ mahã?

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: Ne eya amesiwo tà mawunya va ɖo la be mawuwo la, womate ŋu ada ŋɔŋlɔ la dzi o;

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: amesi Fofo la wɔ kɔkɔe, eye wòdɔ ɖo ɖe xexea me la, eyama ŋuti mia wo miele gbɔgblɔm le bena: Ebɔ busu, esi mebena: Mawuvi menye mahã?

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Ne nyemele Fofonye ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo wɔm o la, ekema migaxɔ dzinye se o.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Ke ne mele wo wɔm la, ne miexɔ dzinye se o hã la, mixɔ dɔwɔwɔwo dzi se, bena miadze sii, eye miase egɔme bena, Fofo la le menye, eye nye hã mele Fofo la me.

english_verse: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
translation_verse: Tete wogadi bena, yewoalée, ke edo le wo si me heyi.

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Eye wògadzo yi ɖe Yordan godo, afisi Yohanes de mawutsi ta na amewo le gbã, eye wònɔ afima.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Eye ame geɖewo va egbɔ, eye wògblɔ bena: Yohanes mewɔ dzesia ɖeke o, gake nusiwo katã Yohanes gblɔ le amesia ŋuti la, wonye nyateƒe.

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye ame geɖewo xɔ edzi se le afima.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti nɔvianyɔnuawo ɖɔ ame ɖo de egbɔ hegblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, kpɔ ɖa, amesi mèlɔ̃a nu egbɔ o la, le dɔ lém.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu see la, egblɔ bena: Dɔ sia menye kudɔe o, ke boŋ hena Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe, bena woakɔ Mawuvi la ŋuti to eyama me.

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: Eye esi wose bena, ele dɔ lém la, etsi afisi wòle la xɔ ŋkeke eve.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Esia megbe la egblɔ na nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Mina, ne míagayi ɖe Yudea.

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: Nusiawo gblɔ ne bena: Rabi, nyitsɔ laa Yudatɔwo ɖi be, yewoaƒu kpe wò, eye nègale afima yi gea?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Alo menye gaƒoƒo wuievee le ŋkeke ɖeka me oa? Ne amea ɖe zɔ le ŋkeke me la, meklia nu o, elabena ele xexe sia me ƒe kekeli la kpɔm.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe zã zã la, eklia nu, elabena kekeli la mele eyama me o.

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Esiawo wògblɔ, eye le esia megbe la egblɔ na wo bena: Mia xɔlɔ̃ Lazaro le alɔ̃ dɔm; gake la mieyina, bena maɖanyɔe atso alɔ̃ me.

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: Tete nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, ne ele alɔ̃ dɔm la, ekema eƒe lãme asẽ.

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ƒo nu le eƒe ku ŋuti; ke woa wobu xa bena, eƒo nu le alɔ̃dɔdɔ ŋutɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: Eye dzi dzɔm le mia ta bena, nyemele afima o, be miaxɔ ase; ke mina, ne míayi ɖe egbɔ.

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Tete Toma, si woyɔna be Venɔvi la, gblɔ na nɔvia nusrɔ̃lawo bena: Mina, ne miawo hã míayi, bena miaku kpakplii.

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Yesu de la, ekpɔ bena, exɔ ŋkeke ene xoxo le yɔ-doa me.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ke Betania te ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eƒe didime anɔ stadio wuiatɔ̃;

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: eye Yudatɔwo dome ame geɖewo va Marta kple Mana gbɔ, bena yewoafa akɔ na wo le wo nɔvi la ŋuti.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Ke esi Marta se bena, Yesu gbɔna la, eyi ɖakpee, eye Mana tsi aƒea me.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Tete la Marta gblɔ na Yesu bena: Aƒetɔ, ɖe nèle afisia la, ne nɔvinye meku o.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Nɔviwò la atsi tre.

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Marta gblɔ nɛ bena: Menyae bena, atsi tre le tsitretsitsi la me le nuwuwuŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Nyee nye tsitretsitsi la kple agbe la; amesi xɔa dzinye sena la, ne eku hã la, anɔ agbe;

english_verse: “Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ ne bena: E, Aƒetɔ, mexɔe se bena, wòe nye Kristo, Mawuvi la, si gbɔna xexeame.

english_verse: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wògblɔ esia la, etɔ edzi yi ɖayɔ nɔvianyɔnu Maria dzaa, eye wògblɔ bena: Nufiala va, eye wòle yɔwòm.

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
translation_verse: Esi eyama see la, etsi tre kaba, eye wòva egbɔ. —

english_verse: He was still outside the village where Martha had gone to meet him.
translation_verse: Eye Yesu mekpɔ va kɔƒea me haɖe o, ke boŋ egale afisi Marta yi ɖakpee le la ko. —

english_verse: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yudatɔ, siwo le aƒea me kplii, eye wole akɔ fam nɛ la, esi wokpɔ bena, Maria tsi tre kaba do go la, wodze eyome hele susum bena, eyina yɔdo la gbɔ, bena yeafa avi le afima.

english_verse: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Maria va afisi Yesu le, eye wokpɔe la, edze klo ɖe eƒe afɔ nu hegblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, ɖe nèle afisia la, ne nɔvinye meku o.

english_verse: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu kpɔe wòle avi fam, eye Yudatɔ, siwo va kplii hã le avi fam la, edo dɔmedzoe le gbɔgbɔ la me, eye eƒe dzi ʋuʋu,

english_verse: and asked, “Where have you put his body?” They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
translation_verse: eye wòbenã: Afika mietsɔe yi damlɔ mahã? Wogblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, va kpɔe.

english_verse: Jesus started crying,
translation_verse: Yesu fa avi.

english_verse: and the people said, “See how much he loved Lazarus.”
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo gblɔ bena: Mikpɔ alesi wòlɔ̃nɛ ɖa!

english_verse: Some of them said, “He gives sight to the blind. Why couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying?”
translation_verse: Ke wo dometɔa dewo bena: Ame sia, si ʋu ŋkuagbãtɔ ƒe ŋkuwo la, de mete ŋu wɔ, bena amesia hã nagaku o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gale dɔmedzoe dom le eɖokui me heva yɔdo la gbɔ. Ke enye ɖo, eye kpe le enu.

english_verse: Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, “Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ bena: Mikɔ kpe la da! Amesi ku la ƒe nɔvinyɔnu Marta gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, eƒaƒã xoxo, elabena exɔ ŋkeke ene sɔŋ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God?”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Ɖe nyemegblɔ na wò bena, ne èxɔe se la, èkpɔ Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la o mahã?

english_verse: After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, “Father, I thank you for answering my prayer.
translation_verse: Tete wokɔ kpe la da. Ke Yesu wu eƒe mo dzi, eye wòbena: Fofo, meda akpe na wò bena, èdoa tom.

english_verse: I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.”
translation_verse: Nye la menyae bena, edoa tom ɖaasi; ke le ameha, si le tsitre ƒo xlãm la ta, megblɔe ɖo, bena woaxɔ ase bena, wòedɔm ɖa.

english_verse: When Jesus had finished praying, he shouted, “Lazarus, come out!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wògblɔ esia la, edo ɣli kple gbe, sesẽ bena: Lazaro lee, do go!

english_verse: The man who had been dead came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with strips of burial cloth, and a cloth covered his face. Jesus then told the people, “Untie him and let him go.” The Plot To Kill Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye eme kuku, si ƒe afɔwo kple asiwò le babla la, do go kple ameɖivɔwo, eye laku bla ŋku me nɛ. Yesu gblɔ bena: Mitui, eye mina wòayi. Nunɔlagãwo de adaŋu le alesi woawɔ awu Yesu la ŋuti.

english_verse: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yudatɔwo dome ame geɖe, siwo va Maria gbɔ, eye wokpɔ nusiwo Yesu wɔ la, woxɔ edzi se.

english_verse: Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done.
translation_verse: Ke wo dometɔa ɖewo tɔ edzi yi farisitɔwo gbɔ, eye wogblɔ nusiwo Yesu wɔ la, na wo.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, “What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles.
translation_verse: Tete la nunɔlagãwo kple farisitɔwo kpe ta ɖe adaŋudeƒe, eye wogblɔ bena: Nuka míawɔ? Elabena amesia le dzesi geɖewo wɔm.

english_verse: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
translation_verse: Ne miena mɔe alea la, ekema amewo katã le edzi xɔ ge ase, eye Romatɔwo ava, eye woaxɔ miaƒe anyigba kple miaƒe dukɔ le mia si.

english_verse: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all!
translation_verse: Eye wo dometɔ ɖeka, Kayafa, si nye nunɔlagã le ƒe ma me la, gblɔ na wo bena: Miawo mienya naneke kulẽ o,

english_verse: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?”
translation_verse: eye miedea ŋugble ɖe eme hã o bena, enyo na mí bena, ame ɖeka naku ɖe dukɔ la ta, eye bena dukɔ blibo la nagatsrɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. As high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation.
translation_verse: Gake megblɔ esia le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui si o; ke boŋ, esi wònye nunɔlagã le ƒe ma me la ŋuti, wògblɔ nya ɖi bena, Yesu laku ɖe dukɔ la ta;

english_verse: Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people.
translation_verse: eye menye de dukɔ la ta ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ, bena wòaƒo mawuvi, siwo kaka la, nu ƒu ɖekae.

english_verse: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.
translation_verse: Azɔ tso ŋkeke ma dzi la wodo bena, yewoawui.

english_verse: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti Yesu megatsana le Yudatɔwo dome le gaglãgbe o, ke boŋ edzo le afima yi anyigba, si te ɖe gbedzi ŋu la dzi, ɖe dua ɖe, si woyɔna be Efrayim la me, eye eya kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo tsi afima.

english_verse: It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival.
translation_verse: Eye Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋutitoto la do, eye ame gedewo dzo le anyigba la dzi heyi Yerusalem, bena wòakɔ wo dokui ŋuti, hafi ŋutitoto la naɖo.

english_verse: They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, “You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you?”
translation_verse: Eye wodi Yesu, eye woƒo nu kple wo nɔewo, esi wole tsitre le mawuƒe la me bena: Nuka susum miele, de megbɔna ŋkekenyuie la duƒe o mahã?

english_verse: The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlagãwo kple farisitɔwo de se ɖi bena, ne amea de nya afisi wòle la, nefia, ne yewoayi aɖalée.

english_verse: If you serve me, you must go with me. My servants will be with me wherever I am. If you serve me, my Father will honor you.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ɖi be, yeasubɔm la, nèdze yonyeme; eye afisi nye la mele la, afima nye subɔla hã lano; ne amea ɖe subɔam la, eya Fofo la labu.

english_verse: Judas did not really care about the poor. He asked this because he carried the moneybag and sometimes would steal from it.
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ esia, menye ame dahewo nu vem wòle o, ke boŋ fiafitɔ wònye, eye gakotoku la le esi, eye wòfia nusiwo wotsɔna dana ɖe eme.

english_verse: they took palm branches and went out to greet him. They shouted, “Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! God bless the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: wotsɔ deʋayawo, eye wodo go yi ekpe ge, eye wodo ɣli bena: Wosana! Woayra amesi gbɔna le Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkɔa me, amesi nye Israel ƒe fia la.

english_verse: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ke Yesu kpɔ tedzivia ɖe, eye wòde edzi, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena:

english_verse: Mary took a very expensive bottle of perfume and poured it on Jesus' feet. She wiped them with her hair, and the sweet smell of the perfume filled the house.
translation_verse: Tete Maria tsɔ nardomi nyuitɔ pounde ɖeka nu, si ƒe asi sẽ ŋutɔ la, hesi de Yesu ƒe afɔwo ŋuti, eye wòtutu eƒe afɔwo ŋuti kple eƒe taɖa: eye aƒea me yɔ fũ kple ami la ƒe ʋeʋẽ lilili la.

english_verse: A lot of people came when they heard that Jesus was there. They also wanted to see Lazarus, because Jesus had raised him from death.
translation_verse: Tete la Yudatɔwo ƒe ameha geɖeawo se eŋkɔ bena, ele afima, eye wova, menye ɖe Yesu ɖeɖeko ta o; ke boŋ, bena woakpɔ Lazaro hã, amesi wòfa ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome.

english_verse: A meal had been prepared for Jesus. Martha was doing the serving, and Lazarus himself was there.
translation_verse: Eye wowɔ fiẽnuɖuɖu nɛ le afima, eye Marta subɔ kplɔa ŋuti, ke Lazaro enye amesiwo nɔ kplɔa ŋuti kplii la, dometɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: A disciple named Judas Iscariot was there. He was the one who was going to betray Jesus, and he asked,
translation_verse: Tete Yuda Iskariot, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka, amesi le eyome ma fia ge la, gblɔ bena:

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ bena: Na mɔe, edzrae ɖo ɖi na nye ɖigbe.

english_verse: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.” A Plot To Kill Lazarus
translation_verse: Elabena ame dahewo li kpli mi ɖaa; ke nye la nyemeli kpli mi ɖaa o.

english_verse: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlagãwo ɖo bena, yewoawu Lazaro hã;

english_verse: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.”
translation_verse: amesiawo va Filipo, si tso Betsaida le Galilea la gbã, eye woɖe kuku nɛ gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, miele didim be, míakpɔ Yesu ɖa.

english_verse: But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.” Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
translation_verse: Tete farisitɔwo gblɔ le wo nɔewo dome bena: Miekpɔ bena, miete ŋu le naneke wɔm o; kpɔ ɖa, xexeame katã dze eyome. Helatɔwo di bena, yewoakpɔ Yesu, Yesu ƒo nu le eƒe ku ƒe viɖe ŋu.

english_verse: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!”
translation_verse: Fofo, kɔ wò ŋkɔ ŋuti. Tete gbe ɖi tso dziƒo gblɔ bena: Mekɔ eŋuti xoxo, eye magakɔ eŋuti.

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: „Egbã woƒe ŋkuwo, eye wòna woƒe dzi sẽ, bena woagakpɔ nu kple ŋkuwo, eye woase nu gɔme kple dzi, eye woatrɔ, eye mada gbe le wo ŋu o.“

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, ameha geɖe, siwo va ŋkekenyuieɖuƒe la, esi wose bena, Yesu gbɔna Yerusalem la,

english_verse: “People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.”
translation_verse: „Megavɔ̃ o, Zion vinyɔnuvi, kpɔ ɖa, wò fia la nɔ tedzivia ɖe dzi gbɔna!“

english_verse: At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.
translation_verse: Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo mese nusiawo gɔme gbã o; ke esi wokɔ Yesu ŋuti la, tete woɖo ŋku edzi bena, woŋlɔ nu siawo ɖi le eŋuti, eye bena wowɔ nusiawo nɛ.

english_verse: Some Greeks had gone to Jerusalem to worship during Passover.
translation_verse: Ke Helatɔa ɖewo le amesi wo yina gbe do ge ɖa le ŋkekenyuiea ɖuƒe la dome;

english_verse: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him. The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
translation_verse: Filipo va, eye wògblɔe na Andrea, eye Andrea kple Filipo woyi ɖagblɔe na Yesu

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ɖo ŋu na wo gblɔ bena: Gaƒoƒo la ɖo vɔ bena, woakɔ Amegbetɔvi la ŋuti.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena, ne bliku la mege ɖe anyigba me, eye woku o la, ekema eya ɖeka tsia anyi; ke ne eku la, etsea ku geɖe.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Amesi ke lɔ̃a eƒe agbe la, abui: eye amesi ke léa tu eƒe agbe le xexe sia me la, adzrae ɖo ɖi hena agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: Fiti ko nye luʋɔ ʋuʋu kpẽkpẽkpẽ, eye aleke magblɔ? Fofo, ɖem tso gaƒoƒo sia me! Gake esia ta meva gaƒoƒo sia me ɖo.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Azɔ ameha, siwo le tsitre, eye wosee la, gblɔ bena: Dzie ɖe gbe, bubuwo gblɔ bena: mawudɔlaa ɖee ƒo nu kplii.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Yesu xɔ dzi bena: Menye tanyee gbe sia ɖi ɖo o, ke boŋ mia tae.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Azɔ xexe sia me ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la ɖo: fifi ko woatsɔ xexe sia me fia la aƒu gbe.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Eye nye la, ne woakɔm ɖe dzi tso anyigba dzi la, mahe amewo katã ava nye ŋutɔ gbɔnye.

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ esia hefiã ku, si ƒomevi ku ge wòala.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Tete ameha la xɔ edzi nɛ bena: Miawo la miese le se la me bena, Kristo anɔ anyi vaseɖe mavɔmavɔ me, eye wò la, aleke gblɔm nèle bena, ele be, wòakɔ Amegbetɔvi la ɖe dzi mahã? Amekae nye nenem Amegbetɔvi sia?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na wo bena: Kekeli la aganɔ mia dome ɣeyiɣi viaɖe ko. Mizɔ azɔli, esi kekeli la le mia gbɔ, bena viviti la nagatu mi o; eye amesi le azɔli zɔm le viviti me la, menyaa afisi wòyina o.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Esi kekeli la le mia gbɔ la, mixɔ kekeli la dzi se, bena míazu kekeli ƒe viwo Nusiawo Yesu gblɔ, eye wòdzo yi ɖaɣla eɖokui ete wo. Yudatɔwo ƒe dzimaxɔe.

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòwɔ ale dzesi geɖe siawo le woƒe ŋku me hã la, womexɔ edzi se o,

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: bena woawu nya, si nyagblɔɖila Yesaya gblɔ ɖi la nu bena: „Aƒetɔ, ameka xɔ miaƒe nyagbɔgblɔ la dzi se mahã? Eye ameka woɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe abɔ la fia mahã?“

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Le esia ta womete ŋu xɔe se o; elabena Yesaya gagblɔ bena:

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Nusiawo Yesaya gblɔ, elabena ekpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la, eye wòƒo nu le eŋu.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke amegãwo dometɔ geɖewo xɔ edzi se; gake la le farisitɔwo ta la womeʋu eme o, bena woagaɖe yewole ha me o;

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu do ɣli, eye wògblɔ bena: Amesi xɔa dzinye sena la, menye dzinye xɔm wòle le sesem o, ke boŋ amesi dɔm ɖa la dzie.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Eye amesi le kpɔyem la, ele amesi dom ɖa la kpam.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Nye la kekeli menye va xexeame, bena amesiame, si xɔa dzinye sena la, mano viviti me o.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Eye ne amea ɖe sea nye nyawo, eye medzra wo ɖo o la, nyemedrɔ̃a ʋɔnui o; elabena nyemeva, be madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexeame o, ke boŋ bena maɖe xexeame.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Amesi le gbeyem, eye mexɔa nye nyawo o la, ekpɔ amesi le ʋɔnu drɔ̃mi; nya, si megblɔ la, eya ke ladrɔ̃ ʋɔnui le nuwuwuŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Elabena nye la nyemeƒo nu le ɖokuinye si o; ke Fofo, si dɔm ɖa la, eya ŋutɔ na nusi magblɔ kple nusi maƒo la ƒe sem.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Eye menya bena, eƒe se la enye agbe mavɔ. Eyaŋuti nusiwo ƒe nu meƒona, abe alesi Fofo la gblɔ nam ene la, nenema me, ƒoa nui.

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Eye hafi ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie la naɖo, esi Yesu nya bena, yeƒe gaƒoƒo la ɖo vɔ, bena yeadzo le xexe sia me ayi ɖe Fofoa gbɔ, esi wòlɔ etɔ, siwo le xexeame la, elɔ̃ wo vaseɖe nuwuwu.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye le fiẽnuɖuƒe, esi Abosam ɖee Yuda Iskariot, Simon vi la, ƒe dzi me xoxo bena, wòafia eyome mɔ,

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: esi Yesu nya bena, Fofoa tsɔ nuwo katã de esi me, eye bena Mawu gbɔ wòtso va, eye wogale Mawu gbɔ yi ge la,

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: etsi tre le nua ɖuƒe, eye wòɖe eƒe awu da ɖi, eye wòtsɔ tsiletse sa ɖe ali.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: Tete wòtrɔ tsi ɖe tsileze me, eye wòde asi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe afɔwo ŋuti kɔklɔ me, eye wòle wo tutum kple tsiletse, si wosa ɖe ali.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Azɔ wòva ɖo Simon Petro gbɔ. Eya gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, wòe aklɔ afɔ ŋuti nam mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu gblɔ ne bena: Nusi ke wɔm mele la, menyae fifia o; ke emegbe la ase egɔme.

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Petro gblɔ nɛ bena: Wò la màklɔ nye afɔwo ŋuti akpɔ o. Yesu xɔ dzi ne bena: Ne nyemeklɔe na wò o la, ekema mele gomea ɖeke kpɔ ge le gbɔnye o.

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro gblɔ ne bena: Ekema menye nye afɔwo ŋuti ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ nye asiwò kple nye la hã.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Amesi le tsi la, afɔ ŋuti kɔklɔ koe hiã nɛ; elabena eŋuti blibo la katã ɖi; eye mia ŋuti ɖi, gake menye mi katãe o

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Elabena enya amesi le eyome mɔ fia ge; eyaŋuti wògblɔ bena: Menye mi katã ŋutie ɖi o.

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Eye esime wòklɔ woƒe siawo ŋuti vo, eye wòdo eƒe awuwo, eye wògabɔbɔ nɔ anyi la, egblɔ na wo bena: Mienya nusi mewo na mia?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Mieyɔam bena: Nufiala kple Aƒetɔ, eye miegblɔe nyuie, elabena eyae menye.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Elabena mena kpɔɖeŋu mi, bena miawo hã miawɔ, abe alesi nye la mewɔ na mi ene.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Subɔla mewua eƒe aƒetɔ o, eye ame dɔdɔ hã mewua amesi dɔe ɖa la o.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: Menye mi katã ŋuti mele egblɔm ɖo o; menya amesiwo metia, gake bena woawu ŋɔŋlɔ la nu bena: „Amesi le abolo ɖum kplim la, kɔ eƒe afɔkpodzi dzi ɖe ŋunye.“

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Tso esia dzi la mele egblɔm na mi, hafi wòava ve me bena, ne eva ve me la, ne miaxɔe ase bena nyee.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Azɔ ame ma bi kɔ do ɖe Yesu ƒe akɔ nu hegblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, amekae?

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu gblɔ esiawo la, eʋuʋu kpẽkpẽkpẽ le gbɔgbɔ me, eye wòɖi ɖase gblɔ bena: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Mia dometɔ ɖeka lafia yonyeme mo

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka, si Yesu lɔ̃na la, via ɖe ekɔme.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Tete Simon Petro mia ŋku ɖee, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Biae, amesi ŋuti wògblɔ esia ɖo.

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ke kplɔ̃ŋutinɔlawo dometɔa ɖeke menya nusi ŋuti wògblɔ esia ne ɖo, o.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖewo bu xa bena, esi gakotoku la le Yuda si la, eyata Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Ele nusiwo miehiã la, hena ŋkekenyuie la ɖuɖu, alo bena netsɔ nane na ame dahewo mahĩ.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Tete esi wòxɔ alɔgomededea la, edo go enumake; eye zã do. Yesu na se eve eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo, eye wogblɔ Petro ƒe nugbegbe le egbɔ ɖi nɛ.

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: ne wokɔ Mawu ŋuti le eya me la, ekema Mawu hã akɔ eyama ŋuti le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui me, eye enumake wòakɔ eŋuti.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Vinyewo, ɣeyiɣi via ɖe ko maganɔ anyi kpli mi. Miadim, eye abe alesi megblɔ na Yudatɔwo ene bena: Afisi nye la meyina la, miawo la miate ŋu ava o la, nenema kee mele egblɔm na miawo hã azɔ.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, afika nèyina? Yesu ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Afisi nye la meyina la, mele ŋule ge adze yonyeme fifia o; ke emegbe la adze yonyeme.

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Petro gblɔ ne bena: Aƒetɔ, nukaŋuti nyemate ŋu adze yowòme fifia o mahã? Matsɔ nye agbe aɖo anyi, ɖe tawò.

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Atsɔ wò agbe aɖo anyi ɖe tanyea? Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na wò bena: Koklo maku atɔ, hafi nagbe nu le gbɔnye zi etɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Migana miaƒe dzi naʋuʋu nyanyanya o; mixɔ Mawu dzi se, eye mixɔ nye hã dzinye se.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Fofonye ƒe me la nɔƒe geɖewo li; ɖe mele nenema o la, ne megblɔe na mi; elabena meyina, be madzra teƒe ɖo ɖi na mi.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Eye ne meyi, eye medzra teƒe ɖo ɖi na mi la, magava, eye maxɔ mi ɖe nye ŋutɔ gbɔnye, bena afisi nye la mele la, miawo hã mianɔ afima.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Eye afisi meyina la, míenyae, eye mɔ la hã mienyae.

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Toma gblɔ ne bena: Aƒetɔ, mienya afisi nèyina o, eye aleke lawɔ mianya mɔ la mahã?

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Nyee nye mɔ la kple nyateƒe la kpakple agbe la, amea ɖeke mevaa Fofo la gbɔ o, negbe to dzinye ko.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyam la, ne mienya Fofonye hã, eye tso esia dzi la míenyae, eye miekpɔe.

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Filipo gblɔ ne bena: Aƒetɔ, fia Fofo la mi, eye aɖi kɔ na mi.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ bena: Filipo, ɣeyiɣi geɖe siawo menɔ anyi kpli mi, eye mènyam o mahã? Amesi ke kpɔm la, ekpɔ Fofo la, eye aleke gblɔm nèle bena: Fia Fofo la mí mahã?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Ɖe mèxɔe se bena, mele Fofo la me, eye Fofo la hã le menye o mahã? Nya, siwo gblɔm mele na mi la, nyemegblɔ wo le ɖokuinye si o, ke Fofo, si nɔ menye la, le eƒe dowo wɔm.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Mixɔm se bena, mele Fofo la me, eye Fofo la hã le menye; ke ne menye nenem o la, ekema mixɔe se le dɔwɔwɔawo ta.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Amesi xɔa dzinye sena la, dɔ, siwo wɔm mele la, eya hã awɔe; eye gatɔwo wu esiawo wòawɔ, elabena nye la meyina Fofo la gbɔ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Eye nusi ke míabia le nye ŋkɔa dzi la, nu ma ke mawɔ, bena woakɔ Fofo la ŋuti le Via me.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Ne míabia nane le nye ŋkɔa dzi la, nye la màwɔe.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: Ne miele lɔ̃yem la, milé nye seawo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Eye nye la maɖe kuku na Fofo la, eye wòana nyaxɔɖakɔla bubu mi, bena wòanɔ anyi kpli mi vaseɖe mavɔmavɔ me:

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Nyateƒegbɔgbɔ, si xexeame mate ŋu axɔ o, elabena mekpɔnɛ o, eye menyanɛ hã o; ke miawo la mienya eyama, elabena ele mia gbɔ, eye wòanɔ mia me.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: Nyemagblẽ mi ɖi tsyɔ̃eviwo o, megbɔna mia gbɔ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Esusɔ ʋee ko, eye xexeame megale kpɔ ye ge o; ke miawo la miakpɔm; elabena nye la mele agbe, eye miawo hã mianɔ agbe.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke ma me la miadze sii bena, mele Fofonye me, eye miawo miele menye, eye nye hã mele mia me?

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Amesi si nye seawo le, eye wòlé wo me ɖe asi la, ame ma enye amesi le lɔ̃yem: amesi lɔ̃am la, Fofonye alɔ̃e, eye nye hã malɔ̃e, eye maɖe nyẽ ŋutɔ ɖokuinye afiae.

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Yuda, si menye Iskariot lae o la, gblɔ nɛ bena: Aƒetɔ, aleke wɔ bena, nèle ɖokuiwò ɖe ge afia miawo, eye menye xexeame o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Ne amea ɖe le lɔ̃yem la, alé nye nya la me ɖe asi, eye Fofonye alɔ̃ eyama, eye miava egbɔ, eye míawɔ nɔƒe ɖe egbɔ.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Amesi mele lɔ̃yem o la, meléa nye nyawo me ɖe asi o, eve nya, si sem miele la, menye tɔnyee o, ke boŋ Fofo, si dɔm ɖa la tɔe.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: Megblɔ esiawo na mi, esi megale mia gbɔ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Ke nyaxɔɖakɔla, Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe, si Fofo la aɖo ɖa le nye ŋkɔa dzi la, eya afia nuwo katã mi, eye wòaɖo ŋku nusiwo katã megblɔ na mi la, dzi na mi.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa gblẽm mele ɖi na mi; nye ŋutifafa tsɔm mele na mi; menye alesi xexeame nana la, nye la mele mia nam o. Miaƒe dzi nagaʋuʋu nyanyanya o, eye dzika hã nagatso mia ƒo o!

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Miese alesi megblɔ na mi bena: Mele dzodzom, eye magava mia gbɔ. Ɖe mielɔ̃m la, ne miekpɔ dzidzɔ bena, meyina Fofo, amesi lolo wum la gbɔ.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ megblɔe na mi, hafi ne wòava ve me bena, ne eva ve me la, ne miaxɔe ase.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Nyemagaƒo nu geɖe kpli mi o; elabena xexeamefia gbɔna, eye mekpɔ naneke le ŋunye o;

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: gake bena xexeame nanyae bena, melɔ̃a Fofo la, eye alesi Fofo la de se nam la, nenema ke mewɔna. Mitsi tre, ne miadzo le afisia!

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Nyee nye weinti vavã la, eye Fofonyee nye agbledela la.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Alɔ sia alɔ, si le ŋutinye, eye metsena o la, elãnɛ, eye ɖesiaɖe, si tsena la, eɖea eŋu, bena wòatse geɖe awu.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Mia ŋuti kɔ xoxo le nya, si megblɔ na mi la ta.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Minɔ menye, eye nye hã manɔ mia me. Alesi alɔ la mate ŋu atse le eɖokui si, ne menɔ weinti la ŋuti o la, nenema ke miawo hã, ne mieno menye o la, miele eŋute ge atse o.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: Nyee nye weinti la, miawo míenye alɔwo. Amesi nɔa menye, eye nye hã menɔa eme la, eya tsea ku geɖe: elabena nye manɔmee la miele eŋute ge awɔ naneke o.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe menɔ menye o la, woatsɔe aƒu gbe abe weinti ƒe alo ene, eye woaƒu, eye woaƒo wo nu ƒu, eye woatɔ dzo wo, eye woafia.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Ne mienɔa menye, eye nye nyawo hã nɔa mia me la, ekema nusi ke mielɔ̃ bia la, woawɔe na mi.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Esia me wokɔ Fofonye ŋuti le, bena mietsea ku geɖe, eye miazu nye nusrɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Sigbe alesi Fofo la lɔ̃am ene la, nenema ke nye hã melɔ̃a mi; minɔ nye lɔlɔ̃ la me!

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Ne mielé nye seawo me ɖe asi la, mienɔ nye lɔlɔ̃ la me, abe alesi nye hã melé Fofonye ƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye menɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃ la me ene.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: Esiawo megblɔ na mi, bena nye dzidzɔ la nanɔ mia me, eye miaƒe dzidzɔ la nayɔ tu.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Esia nye nye se la bena, mialã mia nɔewo, sigbe alesi melɔ̃a mi ene.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ gã wu esia megale amea ɖeke si bena, woatsɔ eƒe agbe aɖo anyi ɖe xɔlɔ̃awo ta o.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Miawoe nye xɔ̃nyewo, ne miewɔa nusiwo ƒe se mede na mi.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Nyemagayɔ mi be dɔlawo o, elabena dɔla menyaa nusi eƒe aƒetɔ wɔna o; ke meyɔ mi be xɔlɔ̃wo, elabena nusiwo katã mese tso Fofonye gbɔ la, mena mienya wo.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Menye miawoe liam ke boŋ nyee tia mi, eye meɖo mi anyi, bena miayi aɖatse ku, eye miaƒe kutsetse la nanɔ anyi, bena nusi ke miabia Fofo la le nye ŋkɔa dzi la, ne wòana mi.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Esiawo ƒe se dem mele na mi bena, mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo. Le xexeame ƒe fuléle ŋuti.

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: Ne xexeame lé fu mi la, minyae bena, nyee wòtre fulélee.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Ɖe mietso xexeame la, ne xexeame alɔ̃ ye ŋutɔ tɔ; ke esi mietso xexeame o, hafi boŋ nye la metia nu tso xexeame la, eyaŋuti xexeame le fu lém mi ɖo.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nya, si megblɔ na mi la dzi bena: Dɔla mewua eƒe aƒetɔ o. Ne woti yonyeme la, woati miawo hã yome, ne wòlé nye nya me ɖe asi la, wòalé miawo hã to me ɖe asi.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ke woawo esiawo katã ɖe mia ŋuti le nye ŋkɔ la ta, elabena womenya amesi dom ɖa la o.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyemeva ƒo nu kpli wo o la, ne nuvɔ̃ mele wo ŋu o; ke azɔ la taflatsedodoa ɖeke mele wo si le woƒe nuvɔ̃ ŋuti o.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Amesi léa tum la, eléa fu Fofonye hã.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyemewɔ do, siwo amea ɖeke mewɔ kpɔ le wo dome o la, ne nuvɔ̃ mele wo ŋu o; ke azɔ la wokpɔe, eye wolé mía kple Fofonye hã ɖe fu me.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Gake bena woawu nya, si woŋlɔ ɖe woƒe sea me la nu bena: „Woléa fum dzodzro!“

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: Ne nyaxɔɖakɔla va, amesi maɖo ɖe nu atso Fofo la gbɔ, nyateƒe la ƒe Gbɔgbɔ, si doa go tsoa Fofoa gbɔ la, eyama aɖi ɖase le ŋutinye;

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: eye miawo hã míaɖi ɖase, elabena mieli kplim tso gɔmedzedzea me ke.

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: Esiawo megblɔ na mi, bena woagaɖia mia nu o.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Woaɖe mi le woƒe ha me, ẽ, gaƒoƒo li gbɔna bena, amesiame, si awu mi la, abu xa bena, yele subɔsubɔdɔ wɔm na Mawu.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Eye woawɔ esiawo, elabena womenya Fofo la kple nye hã o.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Ke esiawo megblɔ na mi, bena ne woƒe gaƒoƒo ɖo la, ne miaɖo ŋku wo dzi bena, nyee gblɔe na mi. Ke nyemegblɔ esiawo na mi tso gomedzedzea me o; elabena meli kpli mi. Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ le nusrɔ̃lawo kple xexeame ŋu.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ la meyina amesi dom ɖa la gbɔ, eye mia dometɔa ɖeke mebiam bena: Afika neyina o.

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Hafi boŋ, esi megblɔ esiawo na mi la, nuxaxa yɔ miaƒe dzi me fũ.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Gake la nyateƒe gblɔm mele na mi: Enyo na mi be, meyina; elabena ne nyemeyi o la, nyaxɔɖakɔla mele mia gbɔ va ge o; ke ne meyi la, maɖoe ɖe mi.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Eye ne eyama va la, aƒoe ɖe xexeame nu le nuvɔ̃ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye kpakple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋuti:

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: le dzodzoenyenye ŋuti, elabena meyina Fofo la gbɔ, eye miagakpɔm o;

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋuti, elabena wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexe sia me fia la xoxo.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: Nya geɖewo gale asinye be, magblɔ na mi, gake miele eŋute ge atsɔe fifia o.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ke ne eya, si nye nyateƒegbɔgbɔ va la, akplɔ mi ayi ɖe nyateƒe blibo la katã me; elabena maƒo nu le ye ŋutɔ ɖokui si o; ke boŋ nusianu, si ke wòase la, eya wòagblɔ, eye wòagblɔ nusiwo gbɔna la, afia mi.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Eya akɔ ŋutinye: elabena aɖe atso tɔnye me, eye wòagblɔe afia mi.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Nusianu, si le Fofo la si la, tɔnyee; eyaŋuti megblɔ bena, aɖe atso tɔnye me, eye wòagblɔe afia mi.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: Esusɔ ʋee, eye miele kpo ye ge o, eye wògasusɔ ʋee, eye miagakpɔm; elabena meyina Fofoa gbɔ.

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Tete la eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔa ɖewo gblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Nukae nye esia, si wògblɔ na mi bena: Esusɔ ʋee, eye miakpɔm o, eye wògasuso ʋee, eye miakpɔm; eye bena meyina Fofoa gbɔ mahã?

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ bena: Nukae nye esia, si wògblɔ bena: Esusɔ ʋee mahã? Mienya nusi gblɔm wòle o.

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yesu dze sii bena, wole didim be, yewoabiae, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Alo esi megblɔ bena: Esusɔ ʋee, eye miele kpo ye ge o, eye wògasusɔ ʋee, eye miakpɔm la, esia ŋutie miele mia nɔewo biam ɖo mahã?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Miafa avi, eye miafa konyi; ke xexeame lãkpɔ dzidzɔ; miawo la miaxa nu, gake miaƒe nuxaxa latrɔ zu dzidzɔ.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la, ne fu le eɖum la, exaa nu, elabena eƒe gaƒoƒo la ɖo; ke ne edzi vi la vo la, emegaɖoa ŋku eƒe nuxaxa dzi o, le dzidzɔ ta bena, yedzi ame ɖe xexeame.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Azɔ miawo hã miele nu xam fifia; ke magakpɔ mi, eye miaƒe dzi lakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye miaƒe dzidzɔ la, amea ɖeke maxɔe le mia si o.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Eye de ŋkeke ma me la míabia nanekem o. Vavã, vavã mele egblɔm na mi bena: Ne míabia nane Fofoa la, ana mi le nye ŋkɔa dzi.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Vaseɖe fifi la miebia naneke le nye ŋkɔa dzi kpɔ o: Miɖe kuku, eye miaxɔ nu, bena miaƒe dzidzɔ la nayɔ fũ.

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: Esiawo megblɔ na mi le lododowo me; gaƒoƒo gbɔna, le esi me nyemagaƒo nu na mi le lododowo me o, ke boŋ magblɔe afia mi faa le Fofo la ŋuti.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke ma me la miaɖe kuku le nye ŋkɔa dzi, eye nyemele egblɔm na mi bena, nye la mabia Fofo la ɖe mia nu o;

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: ke Fofoa ŋuta lɔ̃a mi, elabena miawo mielɔ̃m, eye miexɔe se bena, medo go tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Metso Fofo la gbɔ, eye meva xexeame: megale xexeame gblẽm ɖi, eye meyina Fofo la gbɔ.

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, fifi ko neƒo nu faa, eye mègblɔ lodonyaa ɖeke o.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Azɔ míenyae bena, ènya nuwo katã, eye mèhiã bena, amea ɖe nabia wò o, le esia la miexɔe se bena, èɖo go tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu na wo bena: Fifi ko miele exɔm le sesem mahã?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, gaƒoƒo li gbɔna, eye wòde vɔ, bena woaka mi ahlẽ, amesiame ayi ye ŋutɔ tɔ gbɔ, eye miagblẽ nye ɖeka ɖi, hafi menye nye ɖekae li o, elabena Fofo la li kpakplim.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Esiawo megblɔ na mi, bena míakpɔ ŋutifafa le menye. Le xexea me la miekpɔ xaxa; gake miaƒe dzi nedze eme; nye la meɖu xexeame dzi.

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Nusiawo Yesu gblɔ, eye woti wu eƒe mo dzi kpɔ dziƒo, eye wògblɔ bena: Fofo, gaƒoƒo la de, kɔ Viwò la ŋuti, bena Viwò hã naka ŋutiwò.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Sigbe alesi nena ŋusẽe ɖe ŋutilãa katã dzi ene, bena nusianu, si nènae la, wòana agbe mavɔ wo.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Ke esiae nye agbe mavɔ la bena, woanya wò, Mawu vavã ɖeka la, kple Yesu Kristo, si nèdɔ ɖa la.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Nye la mekɔ ŋutiwò le anyigba dzi, esi mewu dɔ, si netsɔ nam, be mawɔ la nu.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ wò hã, Fofo, kɔ ŋutinye le wò ŋutɔ gbɔwò kple ŋutikɔkɔe, si mekpɔ le gbɔwò, hafi xexeame va dzɔ la.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: Meɖe wò ŋkɔ la ɖe go fia amesiwo nèɖe tso xexeame nam. Towo wonye, eye netsɔ wo nam, eye wole wò nya la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Fifi ko wonyã bena, nusiwo katã nètsɔ nam la, gbɔwò wotso;

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: elabena nya, siwo netsɔ nam la, metsɔ wo na wo, eye woxɔ wo, eye wonyae vavã bena, gbɔwò medo go tso, eye woxɔe se bena, wòe dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Nye la mele biabiam ɖe wo nu, menye ɖe xexeame nu mele biabiam ɖo o: ke boŋ ɖe amesiwo nètsɔ nam la nu; elabena tɔwo wonye:

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: eye nusiwo katã nye tɔnye la, tɔwòe, eye tɔwo hã tɔnyee, eye wokɔ ŋutinye le wo me.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Eye nyemegale xexeame o, ke woawo le xexeame, eye nye la megbɔna gbɔwò. Fofo kɔkɔe, dzra wo ɖo ɖe wò ŋkɔ, si nètsɔ nam la me, bena woazu ɖeka abe miawo ene!

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke alesi meli kpli wo le xexeame la, nye la medzra wo ɖo ɖe wò ŋkɔ la me; amesiwo nètsɔ nam la, medzɔ wo ŋu, eye wo dometɔa ɖeke mebu o, negbe tsɔtsrɔ̃vi la koe, bena woawu ŋɔŋlɔ la nu.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la megbɔna gbɔwò, eye mele nusiawo gblɔm le xexeame, bena nye dzidzɔ la nanɔ wo me, ayɔ wo fũ.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Nye la metsɔ wò nya la na wo, eye xexeame lé fu wo, elabena wometso xexeame o, abe alesi nye hã nyemetso xexeame o ene.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Nyemele biabiam be, naɖe wo tso xexeame o, ke boŋ bena, nadzra wo ɖo tso vɔ̃ɖitɔ la si me.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Wometso xexeame o, abe alesi nye hã nyemetso xexeame o ene.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Wɔ wo kɔkɔe le nyateƒe la me, wò nya la enye nyateƒe?

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Sigbe alesi nedɔm ɖo ɖe xexeame ene la, nenema ke nye hã medɔ wo ɖo ɖe xexeame.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Mewo ɖokuinye kɔkɔe ɖe wo ta, bena woawo hã woazu ame kɔkɔewo le nyateƒe la me.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: Ke menye ɖe amesiawo nu ɖeɖeko mele biabiam ɖo o; ke boŋ ɖe amesiwo le dzinye xɔ ge ase to woƒe nya me la, hã nu;

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: bena wo katã woazu ɖeka, sigbe alesi wò. Fofo, nèle menye, eye nye hã mete mewo ene, bena woawo hã woazu ɖeka le mía me, bena xexeame naxɔe ase be, wòe dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Eye nye la, ŋutikɔkɔe, si nètsɔ nam la, metsɔe na wo, bena woazu ɖeka, sigbe alesi miawo hã míele ɖeka ene.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Nye ɖa mele woawo me, eye woawo hã wole menye, bena woazu blibo le nu ɖeka me, bena xexeame nadze sii bena, wòe dɔm ɖa, eye nèlɔ̃ wo, abe alesi nèlɔ̃m ene.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: Fofo, amesiwo nètso nam la, mele didim bena, afisi nye la mele la, ne woamawo hã nanɔ ŋutinye, bena woakpɔ nye ŋutikɔkɔe, si nètsɔ nam; elabena èlɔ̃m, hafi woɖo xexeame gɔme anyi.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Fofo dzɔdzɔe, xexeame menya wò o, ke nye la menya wò, eye amesiawo hã wonyã bena, wòe dɔm ɖa;

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: eye mena wonya wò ŋkɔ la, eye mana woanyae, bena lɔlɔ̃, si nètsɔ lɔ̃m la, nanɔ woawo me, eye nye hã mana woawo me.

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã la ƒe kluviwo dometɔ ɖeka, si nye amesi ƒe to Petro kpa la ƒe ƒometɔ la, gblɔ bena: Alo ɖe nyemekpɔ wò le abɔa me kplii o mahã?

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Tete wògabia wo bena: Ameka dim miele? Eye wogblɔ bena: Yesu, Nazaretetɔ lae!

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Megblɔe na mi xoxo bena, nyee nye esi: eyaŋuti nenye nye dim miele la, ekema mina mɔ amesiawo, be woadzo ayi,

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: bena woawu nya, si wogblɔ ɖi la nu bena: „Amesiwo nètsɔ nam la, nyemebu wo dometɔa ɖeke o.“

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Tete Simon Petro ɖi yi, si le esi la, heda nunɔlagã la ƒe dɔla, eye wòkpa eƒe nuɖusimeto, eye dɔla ma ƒe ŋkɔe nye Malxo.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Azɔ asrafoha kple aʋafia gã la kple Yudatɔwo ƒe dɔlawo lé Yesu, eye wobiae,

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: Ke Petro le tsitre ɖe ʋotru la nu le gota. Tete nusrɔ̃la keme, si nye nunɔlagã la ƒe ame nyanyɛ la, do go, eye wòƒo nu kple nyɔnu ʋɔtrunudzɔla la, eye wòkplɔ Petro yi ɖe eme.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Tete dɔlanyɔnu, si nye ʋɔtrunudzɔla la, gblɔ na Petro bena: Wò hã, ɖe menye amesia ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka nènye o mahã?

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Eye kluviawo kple dolawo le tsitre, eye wodo akadzo; elabena vuvɔ le wɔwɔm, eye wole dzo la ƒum, eye Petro hã tsi tre ɖe wo gbɔ le dzo la ƒum.

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Azɔ la nunɔlagã la bia Yesu le eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple eƒe nufiafia ŋuti.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti nèle biayem? Bia amesiwo se nusi megblɔ na wo; kpɔ ɖa, woawo nya nusiwo nye la megblɔ.

english_verse: ) Pilate went back out and said, “I don't find this man guilty of anything!
translation_verse: Ke Simon Petro le tsitre le dzo ƒum. Eye wogblɔ nɛ bena: Alo wò hã eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka nènye mahã? Eyama sẽ nu gblɔ bena: Menye nyee o.

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Azɔ wokplɔ Yesu tso Kayafa gbɔ heyi ɖe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe la, eye fɔŋli ti, ke woa ŋutɔwo meyi de ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe la, bena yewomagagblẽ kɔ ɖo o, ke boŋ bena yewoate ŋu aɖu ŋutitoto la.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Tete Pilato do go va wo gbɔ, eye wògblɔ bena: Nutsotso ka mietsɔ vɛ ɖe amesia ŋu mahã?

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Woɖo ŋu gblɔ nɛ bena: Amesia la, ɖe menye vɔ̃wɔla wònye o la, ne miele ede ge asi na wò o.

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: bena woawu nya, si Yesu gblɔ hefiã ku, si ƒomevi ku ge wòala la nu.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Azɔ Pilato gayi ɖe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe la, eye wòyɔ Yesu, eye wògblɔ ne bena: Alo wòe nye Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la mahã?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu nɛ bena: Wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò si nele esia gblɔm le loo, alo ame bubuwoe gblɔ ŋutinye nya na wò mahã?

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Pilato ɖo ŋu bena: Nye la Yudatɔ menye mahã? Wò ŋutɔ wò dukɔ la kple nunɔlagãwoe tsɔ wò de asi nam, nuka newɔa?

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Nye fiaɖuƒe metso xexe sia me o, nye fiaɖuƒe, ɖe wòtso xexe sia me la, ne nye dɔlawo aʋli tanye, bena womãgadem asi na Yudatɔwo o, ke azɔ la nye fiaɖuƒe metso afisia o.

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Tete Pilato gblɔ nɛ bena: Ekema fia nènye ni? Yesu ɖo ŋu bena: Wòe le egblɔm bena, fia menye. Nye la, esia ta wodzim ɖo, eye esia ta meva xexeame ɖo, bena maɖi ɖase na nyateƒe la. Amesiame, si tso nyateƒe me la, ɖoa to nye gbe.

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ke kɔnuwɔwɔ le mia si bena, maɖe asi le ame ɖeka ŋuti na mi le ŋutitoto la dzi; mielɔ̃ azɔ bena, maɖe asi le Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la ŋuti na mi mahã?

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Tete la wo katã gaɖo ɣli gblɔ bena: Menye amesia o, ke boŋ Baraba. Ke Baraba la adzodalae.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Tete Pilato tso Yesu na woƒo kple atam.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Eye asrafoawo tso ŋu he tsihe, eye wotsɔe ɖo nɛ, eye wodo awu dzi nɛ:

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: eye wova egbɔ gblɔ bena: Mieɖo gbe na wò loo, Yudatɔwo ƒe fia! Eye woƒo tome nɛ.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Pilato gado go, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mikpɔ ɖa, mekplɔe do go vɛ na mi, ne miadze sii bena, nyemekpɔ nya vɔ̃a ɖeke le eŋuti o.

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Ale Yesu do go, ŋutsihe la le eta, eye awu dzi la hã le eŋu enye esi. Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mikpɔ amea ɖa!

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Eye esi nunɔlagãwo kple dɔlawo kpɔe la, wodo ɣli bena: Klãe ɖe ati ŋuti, klãe ɖe ati ŋuti! Pilato gblɔ na wo bena: Ekema mia ŋutɔwo mikplae yii, eye miklãe ɖe ati ŋuti, elabena nye la nyemekpɔ nya vɔ̃a ɖeke le eŋuti o.

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ɖo eŋu ne bena: Se le mía si, eye le se la nu la edze bena, woaku; elabena etsɔ eɖokui wɔ Mawuvi.

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Eye esi Pilato se nya sia la, evɔ̃ wu tsãtɔ;

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: eye wòyi ɖe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe lɔ, eye wògblɔ na Yesu bena: Afika nètso? Ke Yesu meɖo nyaa ɖeke ŋu nɛ o.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Pilato gblɔ nɛ bena: Mele nu ƒo ge nam oa? Mènyae bena, mekpɔ ŋusẽ be, maɖe asi le ŋuwò, eye mekpɔ ŋusẽ be, maklã wò ɖe ati ŋuti oa?

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo ŋu ne bena: Ŋusẽa ɖeke manɔ asiwò ɖe ŋunye o, ne menye ɖe wona wò tso dziƒo o; le esia ta amesi dem asi na wò la, wɔ nuvɔ̃ wu wò.

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Tso esia dzi la Pilato di be, yeaɖe asi le eŋu; ke Yudatɔwo do ɣli gblɔ bena: Ne ekatse ɖe asi le amesia ŋu la, ekema menye kaisaro xɔlɔ̃ o, amesi ke tso eɖokui wɔ fia la, etsi tre ɖe kaisaro ŋu.

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Pilato se nya siawo la, ekplɔ Yesu do goe, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui la dzi le teƒe, si woyɔna be Kpenyigba, eye le Hebri-gbe me la enye Gabata.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Ke enye ŋutitoto la ƒe dzadzraɖoŋkeke, eye anɔ gaƒoƒo adelia dzi. Eye wògblɔ na Yudatɔwo bena: Mikpɔ miaƒe fia la ɖa!

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Tete wòdee asi na wo, bena woaklãe ɖe ati ŋuti.

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Tete asrafoawo va, eye wòŋe gbãtɔ ƒe afɔwo kple kɔtoetɔ, si woklã ɖe ati ŋu kpe ɖe eŋuti la, hã tɔ;

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo ƒe nunɔlagãwo va gblɔ na Pilato bena: Megaŋlɔ bena: Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la o; ke boŋ bena eyama gblɔ bena: Yudatɔwo ƒe fia menye.

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu kpɔ dadaa kple nusrɔla, si wolɔ̃na, wole tsitre ɖe egbɔ la, egblɔ na dadaa bena: Nyɔnu, kpɔ ɖa, viwòŋutsu enye si!

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Eye wòlé Yesu, eye wokplɔe yii, eye wòdo go hele eya ŋutɔ ƒe atitsoga la tsɔm yina ɖe teƒe, si woyɔna be ametakoliƒe, eye woyɔnɛ le Hebri-gbe me be Golgata;

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: afisi woklãe ɖe ati ŋu le, eye ame bubu eve hã kpe ɖe eŋuti, le eƒe axawo kple eve dzi, eye Yesu le titina.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Ke Pilato ŋlɔ eƒe nutsonya heɖo atitsoga la ƒe tagbɔ. Eye wòŋlɔ bena: Yesu, Nazaretetɔ, Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la.

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yudatɔwo dome ame geɖewo xlẽ nuŋɔŋlɔ sia, elabena teƒe, si woklã Yesu ɖo la, te ɖe du la ŋu, eye woŋlɔe ɖe Hebri- kple Hela-kple Roma-gbe me.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Pilato ɖo ŋu bena: Nusi meŋlɔ la, mèŋlɔe xoxo.

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ na wo nɔewo bena: Migana miadze eya o, ke boŋ miadzidze nu ɖe edzi, amesi tɔ woazu, bena woawu ŋɔŋlɔ la nu, si gblɔ bena: „Womã awunyewo na wo nɔewo, eye nye awu ʋlaya la wodzidze nu ɖe edzi.“ Nenem nusiawo asrafoawo wɔ.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Ke dadaa kple dadaa nɔvinyɔnu Maria, Klopa srɔ̃, kpakple Maria, Magdalatɔ, wole tsitre ɖe Yesu ƒe atitsoga la gbɔ.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: ke esi wova Yesu gbɔ, eye wokpɔ bena, eku xoxo la, womeŋe eƒe afɔwo o;

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Ke abɔa ɖe le teƒe, si woklã Yesu ɖo la, eye yɔdo yeyea ɖe, si me amea ɖeke memlɔ kpɔ o la, le abɔ ma me.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, esi Yesu nyae bena, wowu nuwo katã nu azɔ, bena ŋɔŋlɔ la nava ve me la, egblɔ bena: Tsikɔ le wuyem!

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Eye nane le afima, si me aha tsitsi le fũ, tete wotsɔ ƒumekutsa, si me wode aha tsitsii fũ la, lɔ ɖe ayeti nu heɖo nu nɛ.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Eye esi Yesu xɔ aha tsitsia la, egblɔ bena: Wowu nu vɔ! Eye wòde ta anyi, eye wòtsɔ gbɔgbɔ la na.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi wònye dzadzraɖoŋkeke la, Yudatɔwo bia Pilato bena, woaŋe woƒe afɔwo, eye ne woaɖe wo ɖa, bena ame kukuwo nagatsi atitsoga ŋu le Sabat dzi o; elabena Sabat gãe nye ŋkeke ma.
