translation_verse: Eye woƒu kpe Stefano, si le gbe dom ɖa le gbɔgblɔm bena: Aƒetɔ Yesu, xa nye gbegbe la!

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdze klo la, edo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ bena: Aƒetɔ, megado nuvɔ̃ sia teƒe na wo o! Eye esi wògblɔ esia la, eto me do alɔ̃.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Ke Saul gblẽ hame la hegena ɖe aƒewo me, eye wòhea ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo yi ɖadea gaxɔ me.

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo ka hlẽ la, le tsatsam hele nyanyuie la gblɔm fia. Filipo gblɔ mawunya le Samaria. (Ta

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Eye Filipo va Samaria-dua me, eye wòɖe gbe ƒã le Kristo ŋuti na wo.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Eye amehawo ɖo to nusi Filipo gblɔ la kple tame ɖeka, esi wosee, eye wokpɔ dzesi, siwo wòwɔ.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Elabena ame geɖe, siwo me gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo le la, do go hele ɣli dom kple gbe sesẽ; eye wòda gbe le tekunɔwo kple dɔnɔ geɖewo ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Eye wòzu dzidzɔ gãa ɖe le ɖu ma me.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsua ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Simon la, va nɔ dua me heka afa, eye wòna Samaria-dukɔ la ƒe nu ku, esi wògblɔ bena, ye ŋutɔe nye gã;

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: amesia ŋuti wo katã ku ɖo, tso ɖeviwo dzi vaseɖe tsitsiawo dzi, hele gbɔgblɔm bena: Amesiae nye Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ la, si woyɔna be gã.

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Ke woku ɖe eŋu; elabena xoxoxo wòna woƒe nu ku le eƒe afakaka la ŋuti.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Eye esi woxɔ Filipo, amesi le mawufiaɖuƒe la kple Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ ŋuti nyanyuie gblɔm la dzi se la, wode mawutsi ta na wo, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Ke Simon ŋutɔ hã xɔe se, eye esi wode mawutsi ta ne la, enɔ Filipo ŋu kplikplikpli; eye esi wòkpɔ dzesi kple ŋusẽdɔ gã, siwo wɔm wòle la, kuvia ɖoe.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Tete la esi apostolo, siwo le Yerusalem la, se bena, Samaria xɔ mawunya la, woɖo Petro kple Yohanes ɖe wo gbɔ;

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: esi amesiawo va la, woɖo gbe ɖa ɖe wo la, bena woaxɔ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Elabena medze ɖe wo dome amea ɖeke dzi haɖe o; negbe Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ dzi ko wode mawutsi ta na wo ɖo.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Tete woda asi ɖe wo dzi, eye woxɔ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Ke esi Simon kpɔ bena, to apostolowo ƒe asidada ɖe ame dzi me wona Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la, etso ga vɛ na wo

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Mina ŋusẽ sia nye hã, bena amesi ke dzi mada asi ɖo la, naxɔ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Eye Petro gblɔ nɛ bena: Mia kple wò klosalo miatsrɔ̃, elabena ebu xa bena, yeaƒle Mawu ƒe nunana la kple ga.

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Gome kple domenyinyia ɖeke mele nya sia me na wò o; elabena wò dzi medzo le Mawu ƒe ŋku me o.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Elabena mekpɔ wò bena, èle veve helĩhelĩ kple nu madzɔmadzɔ ƒe babla me.

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Eye Simon ɖo ŋu gblɔ bena: Miawo la miɖe kuku na Aƒetɔ la ɖe tanye, bena nusiwo katã miegblɔ la ƒe ɖeke nagava dzinye o.

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Azɔ woawo la, esi woɖi ɖase, eye wogblɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la vɔ la, wogagbugbɔ va Yerusalem; eye wogblɔ nyanyuie la fia le Samaria ƒe kɔƒe geɖewo me. Etiopia fianyɔnu la ƒe nuwo dzikpɔla trɔ dzime.

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlaa ɖe ƒo nu na Filipo gblɔ bena: Tsi tre, eye nayi dziehe gome, ɖe mo, si tso Yerusalem yina Gaza, si nye gbedzimɔ la dzi.

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Eye wòtsi tre heyi; eye kpo ɖa, Etiopia-ŋutsua ɖe, aƒedzikpɔla, si nye Etiopia-towo ƒe fianyɔnu Kandake ƒe ŋusẽtɔ, amesi kpɔa eƒe kesinɔnuwo katã dzi la, eya va Yerusalem gbe do ge da;

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: ke esi wògagbugbɔ, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ eƒe tasiaɖam me la, ele nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ƒe agbalẽ xlẽm.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Eye Gbagba la gblɔ na Filipo bena: Te ɖe ŋu, eye natsɔ ɖokuiwò akpe ɖe tasiaɖam sia ŋu.

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Eye esi Filipo ƒu du yi egbɔ la, ese bena, ele nyagblɔɖila Yesaya ƒe agbalẽ xlẽm, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Ele nya, si xlẽm nèle la gɔme sema?

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Ke eya gblɔ bena: Aleke mate ŋui, ne amea ɖeke mefiam oa? Eye wòɖe kuku na Filipo bena, neɖo tasiaɖam la, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ egbɔ.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Eye nya, si xlẽm wòle la, enye esi: „Wokplɔe abe alẽ ene yina wuwu ge, eye alesi alẽ zia kpi le amesi le fu sẽm nɛ la ƒe ŋku me la, nenema ke eya hã meke eƒe nu o.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Le eƒe bɔbɔɖeanyi me woɖe eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ɖa: Ameka axlẽ eƒe dzidzime afia mahã? Elabena woɖe eƒe agbe ɖa tso anyigba dzi.“

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Eye aƒedzikpɔla la ɖo ŋu na Filipo gblɔ bena: Meɖe kuku na wò, ameka ŋuti nyagblɔɖila la gblɔ esia ɖo, ye ŋutɔ ŋuti loo alo ame bubua ɖe ŋutie mahã?

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye Filipo ke nu, eye wòdze gome tso ŋɔŋlɔ sia dzi hegblɔ Yesu ŋu nyanyuie la fiae.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Eye Filipo gblɔ ne bena: Ne èxɔe; se kple wò dzi blibo la katã la, ekema woɖe mɔ na wò. Eye wòxɔ dzi ne gblɔ bena: Mexɔe se bena, Yesu Kristo enye Mawuvi la.

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Eye wòna woto tasiaɖam la, eye woa kple eve la katã, Filipo kple aƒedzikpɔla la, woɖi ɖe tsi la me, eye wòde mawutsi ta nɛ.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Ke esi wodo go le tsia me la, Aƒetɔ ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la tsɔ Filipo dzoe, eye aƒedzikpɔla la megakpɔe o; elabena edze eƒe mɔ la dzi kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Eye wokpɔ Filipo le Asdod, eye wòle tsatsam hele nyanyuie la gblɔm fia le duawo katã me vaseɖe Kaisarea.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ke Saul sẽ ŋu ɖe dzi gawu, eye wòna Yudatɔ, siwo le Damasko la ƒe nu tsi te, esi wòfiã kɔte bena, amesiae nye Kristo.

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: elabena nye la mafiae alesi wòle nɛ be, wòakpe fu geɖe le nye ŋkɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòva Yerusalem la, ete kpo be, wòamiã eɖokui ɖe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋu; eye wo katã le evɔ̃m, esi womexɔe se bena, nu srɔ̃la wònye o.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: eye wòkpɔ ŋutsua ɖe le ŋutega me, amesi ŋkɔ nye Anania la, gbɔna egbɔ, eye wòle asi dam ɖe edzi, bena wòagakpɔ nu.

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Eye enumake ewɔ abe nanee ge tso eƒe ŋkuwo dzi abe tsrowo ene, eye wògakpɔ nu; eye esi wòtsi tre la, wode mawutsi ta nɛ;

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Ke Saul, si galé ŋɔdzidodo kple hlɔ̃dodo ƒe gbɔgbɔtsixe ɖe ƒo ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋuti la, yi ɖe nunɔlagã gbɔ,

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: eye wòbia agbalẽwoe bena, yeayi Damasko ɖe ƒuƒoƒeawo me, ne yeakpɔ amesiwo le nenem mo sia dzi, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo la, ne yeabia wo akplɔ va Yerusalem.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòle mea dzi, eye wògogo Damasko la, kasia keklẽ tso dziƒo klẽ ƒo xlãe;

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: eye wòdze anyi, eye wose gbea ɖe le gbɔgblɔm ne bena: Saul, Saul, nuka wo nèle yonyeme tima?

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ bena: Wò amekae, Aƒetɔ? Eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ bena: Nyee nye Yesu, amesi yome tim nèle; asẽ na wò be, nada afɔkpo nutɔnu.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu, siwo le mɔ zɔm kplii la, tsi tre ɖi nu maƒomaƒoe; wole gbe la sem, gake womelé amea ɖeke kpɔm o.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Tete la Saul tsi tre tso anyigba; ke esi wòdu ŋku la, mekpɔ amea ɖeke o, eye wòlé eƒe alɔnu, eye wokplɔe yi Damasko.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Eye ŋkeke etɔ̃ sɔŋ mekpɔ nu kpɔ o, meɖu naneke o, eye meno naneke hã o.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃laa ɖe le Damasko, eŋkɔe nye Anania, eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ le ŋutega me bena: Anania! Eye wògblɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, nyee nye esi, Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ la gblɔ ne bena: Tsi tre, eye nayi ablɔ, si woyɔna be dzɔdzɔe la me, eye nabia amea ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Saul tso Tarso la ta se le Yuda-ƒe me; elabena kpɔ ɖa, ele gbe ɖom ɖa,

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke Anania xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ, mese le ame geɖewo nu le ŋutsu sia ŋuti, alesi wòwɔ vɔ̃ geɖe ɖe wò ame kɔkɔe, siwo le Yerusalem la ŋu;

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: eye afisia hã ekpɔ ŋusẽ tso nunɔlagãwo gbɔ, be woabia amesiwo katã yɔa wò ŋkɔ dzi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Gake Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ bena: Heyi, elabena amesia enye dɔwɔnu tiatia nam, be wòatsɔ nye ŋkɔ la ayi ɖe trɔ̃subɔlãwo kple fiawo kpakple Israel-viwo ƒe ŋku me;

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Tete Anania ta dzi yi, eye wòva aƒea me, eye wòda eƒe asiwò ɖe edzi gblɔ bena; Nɔvi Saul, Aƒetɔ la, Yesu, si ɖe eɖokui fia wò le mɔ dzi, esi nègbɔna la, dom ɖa, be nagakpɔ nu, eye ne Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la nayɔ wò fũ.

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: eye woɖu nu, eye wòkpɔ ŋusẽ. Eye wònɔ nusrɔla, siwo le Damasko la gbɔ ŋkekea ɖewo. Saul ƒe dɔ gbãtɔ le Damasko kple Yerusalem.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Eye enumake wòɖe gbe ƒã le Yesu ŋuti le ƒuƒoƒeawo me bena, eyae nye Mawuvi.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Eye, amesiwo katã see la, kuvia ɖo wo, eye wogblɔ bena: Alo menye eyae nye amesi gblẽ amesiwo yɔa ŋkɔ sia dzi le Yerusalem, eye eyata wòva afisia ɖo, be yeabia wo akplɔ ayi ɖe nunɔlagãwo gbɔe oa?

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Eye esi ŋkeke geɖe va yi la, Yudatɔwo de adaŋu, bena yewoawui;

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: gake Saul se woƒe aɖaŋu vɔ̃ ɖoɖo la. Eye wodzo agboawo gɔ̃ hã ŋu ŋkeke kple zã, bena yewoawui.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke nusrɔ̃lawo tsoe le zã me heto gli dzi ɖiɖi ɖe anyigba le kusi me.

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke Barnaba xɔe, eye wòkplɔe yi apostoloawo gbɔ, eye woxlẽe fia wo, alesi wòkpɔ Aƒetɔ la le mo dzi, eye bena eƒo nu nɛ, kple alesi wògblɔ nya dzifeƒotɔe le Yesu ƒe ŋkɔa me le Damasko.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye eya kplii wovaa me, gadoa go le Yerusalem hele nya gblɔm dzideƒotɔe le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔa me;

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: eƒo nu, eye wosẽ nu hã kple Helatɔwo; ke woawo ɖi be, yewoawu.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Tete esi nɔviawo see la, wokplɔe yi Kaisarea, eye woɖoe ɖe Tarso.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Azɔ hame, si le Yudea kple Galilea kple Samaria katã la, kpɔ tomefafa, eye wotu wo ɖokui, eye wole zɔzɔm le Aƒetɔ la vɔvɔ̃ me; eye wosɔ gbɔ to Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la ƒe akɔfafa me. Petro da gbe le Ainea ŋuti, eye wònyɔ Tabita tso kukuwo dome.

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me bena, esi Petro tsa le afiawo katã la, eva ame kɔkɔe, siwo le Lida hã gbɔ.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Eye afima wòkpɔ ŋutsua ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Ainea, amesi mlɔ eƒe aba dzi ƒe enyi sɔŋ, elabena ele lãmetutudɔ lém.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Eye Petro gblɔ nɛ bena: Ainea, Yesu Kristo yɔ dɔ wò: tsi tre, eye wò ŋutɔ naɖo wò aba! Eye enumake wòtsi tre.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Eye amesiwo katã nɔ Lida kple Saron la kpɔe, eye wotrɔ va Aƒetɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu-nusrɔ̃laa ɖe le Yope, amesi ŋkɔ nye Tabita, si gɔmee nye zi, eya la yɔ fũ kple dɔ nyui wɔwɔ kple dɔmenyonu, siwo wòwɔna.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Ke eva me le ŋkeke mawo me bena, elé dɔ, eye woku; eye esi wole tsi nɛ la, wokɔe da ɖe dziƒoxɔ me.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Ke esi Lida te ɖe Yope ŋu, eye nusrɔ̃lawo se bena, Petro le afima la, wodɔ ŋutsu eve ɖo ɖe egbɔ ɖe kuku nɛ bena, megatsi anyi, hafi ava yewo gbɔ o.

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Eye Petro tsi tre, eye wòyi kpli wo. Eye esi wòva la, wokplɔe yi ɖe dziƒoxɔa me, eye ahosiawo katã le tsitre ɖe egbɔ le avi fam hele awutewui kple awu ʋlaya, siwo Zi tɔ, esime woa kpli wo wonɔ anyi la, fiam.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Eye esi Petro nyã wo katã do go la, edze klo, eye wòdo gbe ɖa; eye wòtrɔ ɖe ame kukua gbɔ gblɔ bena: Tabita, tsi tre! Eye eya la ʋu eƒe ŋkuwo, eye esi wòkpɔ Petro la, efɔ bɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Eye wòna asii hekɔe ɖe dzi; eye esi wòyɔ ame kɔkɔeawo kple ahosiawo ve la, etsɔe ɖo woƒe ŋku me agbagbee.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye wose nusia le Yope katã, eye ame geɖewo xɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Ke eva me bena, enɔ Yope xɔ ŋkeke geɖe le Simon ɖe, si fea kpe agbalẽ la gbɔ.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsua ɖe le Kaisarea, eŋkɔe nye Kornelio, amesi nye aʋafia le asrafoha, si woyɔna bena Italiatɔwo tɔ la nu,

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: enye mawumeme, eye wòvɔ̃a Mawu kple eƒe aƒe blibo la; amesi wɔ dɔmenyonu geɖewo na amewo, eye wòdoa gbe ɖa na Mawu ɖaa.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ le ŋutega me kɔte anɔ ŋkeke ƒe ga asieke me bena, mawudɔla ɖe va egbɔ le eme, eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Kornelio!

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Ke esi eya kpɔe gã, eye wòvɔ̃ la, egblɔ bena: Nukae, Aƒetɔ? Eye wògblɔ nɛ bena: Wò gbedodoɖawo kple wò dɔmenyowɔwɔwo yi dzi le Mawu ŋku me hena ŋkuɖoɖodzi.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Azɔ dɔ ŋutsuwo ɖo ɖe Yope, ne wòaɖakpe Simon, sii woyɔna be Petro la vɛ;

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: amesia dze Simon, asi tea kpe agbalẽ la; gbɔ, amesi ƒe aƒe le ƒua nu; eya agblɔ nusi le be, nawɔ la na wò.

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Ke esi dɔla, si ƒo nu kplii la; dzo la, eyɔ eƒe dɔlawo dome ame eve kpe ɖe asrafoa ɖe, si vɔ̃a Mawu la ŋu, tso amesiwo dzɔ a eŋu la dome;

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: eye esi woxlẽ nya siawo katã fia wo la, edɔ wo: ɖo ɖe Yope.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Ke esi ŋu ke, esime wole mɔa dzi, eye wolũ dua la, Petro yi gbe do ge ɖa le xɔta, anɔ ga ade me,

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: eye esi dɔ wui la, edi nu be, yeaɖu: ke esi wole eɖam la, ekpɔ ŋutega,

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: eye wòkpɔ dziƒo nu ʋu, eye nane le ɖiɖim ɖe anyigba abe aklala gãa ɖe, si wosa kɔ dzogoe ene me nɛ ene,

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: nusi me anyigba dzi lãfɔnewo kple lã wɔadãwo kple nu tatawo kpakple dziƒoxevi bubu ƒomeviwo katã le.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Eye gbea ɖe ɖi va egbɔ bena: Petro, tsi tre, wu wo naɖu.

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ke Petro gblɔ bena: Kpao, Aƒetɔ, elabena nyemeɖu nusianu, si nye nu dzodzro kple nu makɔmakɔ kpɔ o.

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Eye gbe la gagblɔ na zi evelia bena: Nusi ŋuti Mawu kɔ la, wò la megayɔe be nu dzodzro o.

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Eye wowɔ esia zi etɔ̃, eye enumake wogakɔ nu la yi dziƒo.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Ke esi Petro tsi dzodzodzoe le eɖokui me, nusi ŋutega, si yekpɔ la lanye la, kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsui siwo Kornelio dɔ ɖo ɖa la, le Simon ƒe aƒe ta biam hele tsitre ɖe agbo la nu;

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: eye woyɔ ame ɖa biae bena, Simon, si woyɔna be Petro la, dze afisia mahã?

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Ke esi Petro le ŋutega la ŋuti bum la, Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ ne bena: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu etɔ̃ le diwòm.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Eyata tsi tre, ne naɖi, eye nayi kpli wo, eye megake ɖia ɖeke o, elabena nyee dɔ wo.

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Eye esi Petro ɖi va ŋutsu, siwo Kornelio dɔ ɖo ɖe egbɔ la gbɔ la, egblɔ bena: Kpɔ ɖa, nyee nye amesi dim miele, nukaŋuti mieva afisia ɖo?

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ bena: aʋafia Kornelio, ame dzɔdzɔe kple amesi vɔ̃a Mawu, amesi ŋuti Yuda-dukɔ blibo la katã ɖi ɖase nyuie le la, eya mawudɔla kɔkɔea ɖe de se na be, nedɔ, ne woayi ɖayɔ wò va eƒe me, bena wòase nyawo tso gbɔwò.

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Tete wòyɔ wo va me, eye wòwɔ amedzro na wo. Eye esi ŋu ke la, etsi tre, eye wòyi kpli wo, eye nɔvi, siwo le Yope la, dometɔa ɖewo kpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Ke esi ŋu gake la, wova Kaisarea. Eye Kornelio le mɔ kpɔm na wo, eye wòyɔ eƒomeawo kple xɔlɔ̃a veviwo va ƒo ƒu.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me bena, esi Petro le eme yim la, Kornelio va kpee, eye wòdze klo ɖe eƒe afɔ nu hede ta agu ne.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Ke Petro kɔe ɖe dzi gblɔ bena: Tsi tre, nye ŋutɔ hã ame menye.

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Eye esi wòle nu ƒom kplii la, eyi ɖe eme, eye wòkpɔ ame geɖewo ƒo ƒu ɖi.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Mia ŋutɔwo mienya, alesi mele sea nu bena, Yuda-ŋutsua ɖe nabɔ ha kple dukɔ bubu me tɔa ɖe alo ava egbɔ o, eye nye la Mawu fiam bena, nyemagayɔ amea ɖeke be ame dzodzro alo ame makɔmakɔ o;

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: eyaŋuti esi woyɔm la, nyemegblɔ nyaa ɖeke ɖe eŋuti hafi va o. Azɔ mele mia biam be: Nya ka ŋuti mieyɔm ɖo mahã?

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Eye Kornelio gblɔ be: Egbee nye ŋkeke eneagbe, esi metsi nu ɖo vaseɖe gaƒoƒo sia dzi, eye le gaƒoƒo asiekelia dzi la mele gbe dom ɖa le aƒenye me, eye kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsua ɖe le tsitre ɖe ŋkunye me le awu, si le dzo dam la me,

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ bena: Kornelio, wose wò gbedodoɖa, eye woɖo ŋku wò dɔmenyowɔwɔwo dzi le Mawu ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Eyata da ame ɖo ɖe Yope, ne woaɖayɔ Simon, si woyɔna be Petro la ve; amesia dze Simon ɖe, si tea kpe agbalẽ la, ƒe me le ƒua nu; ne amesia va la, aƒo nu na wò.

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Eyata medo ame ɖo ɖe gbɔwò enumake, eye èwɔe nyuie be, neva. Azɔ mí katã miele afii le Mawu ƒe ŋku me, bena miase nusiwo katã ƒe se Aƒetɔ la de na wò. Petro ƒe mawunyagbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Tete Petro ke nu gblɔ bena: Medze sii le nyateƒe me be, Mawu mekpɔa ame ŋku me o,

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: hafi boŋ le dukɔ sia dukɔ me, amesi ke venɛ, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, eya dzea eŋu.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Nya, si wòdo ɖo ɖe Israel-viwo, eye wògblɔ ŋutifafanyanyuie la fia to Yesu Kristo dzi, amesi nye amewo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Mia ŋutɔwo mienyã nya, si va ve me le Yudea katã, eye wòdze gome tso Galilea, le mawutsidedetaname, si Yohanes ɖe gbe ƒãe la megbe:

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Yesu, Nazaretetɔ la, alesi Mawu tsa Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la kple ŋusẽ hesi nɛ, amesi tsa hele nu nyui wɔm, eye wòda gbe le amesiwo katã dzi Abosam ɖu la ŋu, elabena Mawu li kplii.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Eye míawoe nye ɖaseɖilawo le nusiwo katã wòwɔ le Yudatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi kple Yerusalem la ŋuti; amesi hã wowu to ehehe ɖe ati ŋuti me.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Eya ke Mawu fɔ ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe, eye wòna woɖee fia,

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: menye dukɔ blibo la katã o, ke boŋ eƒe ɖaseɖila, siwo Mawu tia ɖi xoxo, mí, amesiwo ɖu nu, eye mieno nu kplii le eƒe tsitretsitsi tso ame kukuwo dome megbe.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Eye wòde se na mi be, miaɖe gbe ƒãe afia dukɔ la, eye míaɖi ɖase bena, eyae nye amesi Mawu ɖo, be wòanye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la ɖe agbagbeawo kple kukuawo dzi.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Eyama ŋuti nyagblɔɖilawo katã ɖi ɖase le, bena amesiame, si axɔ edzi ase la, akpɔ nuvɔ̃keke to eƒe ŋkɔ la me. Mawunya ƒe dɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Esi Petro gale nya siawo gbɔgblɔ dzi la, Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la dze amesiwo katã le nya la sem la dzi.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Eye kuvia ɖo xɔsetɔ, siwo tso aʋatsotso la me, ame geɖe alesi nu va kple Petro, bena wotsɔ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe nunana; kɔ ɖe trɔ̃subɔlawo hã dzi.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Elabena wose bena, wole nu ƒom kple aɖewo, eye wole Mawu dom ɖe dzi.

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: Tete Petro xɔ dzi gblɔ bena: Alo amea ɖe ate ŋu axe mɔ ɖe tsi be, woagade mawutsi ta na amesiawo, siwo xɔ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la abe miawo ke ene la o mahã?

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Eye wòde se be, woade mawutsi ta na wo le Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ la me. Eye woɖe kuku nɛ be, wòanɔ yewo gbɔ ŋkekea ɖewo.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Eye apostolowo kple nɔvi, siwo le Yudea la se bena, trɔ̃subɔlawo hã xɔ Mawu ƒe nya la.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Ke esi Petro va Yerusalem la, amesiwo tso aʋatsotsoa me la, sẽ nu kplii

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Ŋutsu aʋamatsomatsotɔwo gbɔ nèyi, eye neɖu nu kpli wo.

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Tete Petro dze gɔme heto nya la na wo ɖekaɖeka bena:

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: Mele Yope-dua me le gbe dom ɖa, eye le ŋutega me la mekpɔ nane le ɖiɖim ɖe anyi abe aklala gãa ɖe, si wosa kɔ dzogoe ene me nɛ ene heɖi tso dziƒo va gbɔnye.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Eye esi melé ŋku ɖe edzi gã la, mebu eŋu, eye mekpɔ anyigba dzi lãfɔnewo kple lã wɔadãwo kple nu tatawo kpakple dziƒoxeviwo le eme.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Eye mese gbea ɖe hã gblɔ nam bena: Petro, tsi tre wu wo naɖu.

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ke megblɔ bena: Kpao, Aƒetɔ, elabena nu dzodzro alo nu makɔmakɔa ɖeke mede nye nu me kpɔ o.

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Gake gbea gaɖo eŋu nam zi evelia tso dziƒo bena: Nusi ŋuti Mawu kɔ la, wò la megabui nu dzodzro o.

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Eye esia va me zi etɔ̃, eye wogahe wo katã yi dziƒoe.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, le gaƒoƒo ma ke dzi la ŋutsu etɔ̃ le tsitre de aƒe, si me mele la nu; amesiwo wodɔ de gbɔnye tso Kaisarea.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Eye Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ nam bena, mayi kpli wo, eye nyemegake ɖia ɖeke o. Eye nɔvi ade siawo hã kpe ɖe ŋunye, eye mieyi ɖe ŋutsu la ƒe me;

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: eye wòka eta na mí, alesi wòkpɔ mawudɔla la le tsitre le eƒe me, eye wògblɔ bena: Dɔ ame ɖo ɖe Yope, ne woaɖayɔ Simon, si woyɔna be Petro la vɛ,

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: amesi lagblɔ nya, siwo me nato akpɔ ɖeɖe la, na mia kple aƒewò katã.

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Eye esi mede asi nuƒoƒo me la, Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la dze wo dzi, abe alesi wòdze miawo hã dzi le gɔmedzedzea me ene.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Tete medo ŋku Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la dzi, alesi wògblɔ bena: „Yohanes de mawutsi ta na ame kple tsi, ke miawo la woade mawutsi ta na mi kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la.“

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Azɔ ne Mawu tso nenem nunana ma ke na wo, abe alesi wòna mi, amesiwo xa Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi se la ene la, nye la ameka menye be, mate ŋu axe mo na Mawua?

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Eye esi wose nya siawo la, wozi ɖoɖoe, eye wokafu Mawu gblɔ bena: Ekema Mawu na dzimetɔtrɔ trɔ̃subɔlawo hã hena agbe. Kristo-hame, si le Antioxia.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Azɔ amesiwo ka hlẽ le xaxa, si va le Stefano ŋuti me la, tso me yi vaseɖe Foinike kple Kipro kpakple Antioxia, ke womegblɔ; nya la na amea ɖeke o, negbe na Yudatɔwo ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke esime wo dome ŋutsua ɖewo tso Kipro kple Kirene va Antioxia la, woƒo nu na Helatɔwo hã hele Aƒetɔ, Yesu ŋuti nyanyuie la gblɔm fia wo.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ ƒe asi li kpli wo, eye ame geɖewo xɔe se, eye wotrɔ va Aƒetɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Eye wo ŋutinya ɖi va hame, si le Yerusalem la, ƒe to me, eye wodo Barnaba ɖo de Antioxia.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Esi amesia va, eye wòkpɔ Mawu ƒe amenuvevea la, edzɔ dzi, eye wòde dzi ƒo na wo katã bena, woanɔ Aƒetɔ la gbɔ kple woƒe dzimeɖoɖo.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Elabena ame nyui wònye, eye wòyɔ fũ kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe kple xɔse; eye wotsɔ ameha gãa ɖe kpe ɖe Aƒetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Eve Barnaba dzo yi Tarso, Saul di ge, eye esi wòkpɔe la, ekplɔe va Antioxia.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Eye wòva me bena, ƒe blibo ɖeka woƒo ƒu le hame la me, eye wofia nu ameha gãa ɖe, eye bena Antioxia woyɔ nusrɔ̃lawo le gbã be kristotɔwo. Beléle na kristohame, si le Yudea le dɔŋɔli.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke siawo me la nyagblɔɖilawo tso Yerusalem va Antioxia.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Eye wo dometɔ ɖeka, si ŋkɔ nye Agabo la, tsi tre, eye wòfia dzesi to Gbɔgbɔ la dzi bena, dɔwuame gãa ɖe le xexe blibo la katã me va ge, esia va ve me le kaisaro Klaudio ŋɔli.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃lawo do bena, wo dome amesiame nado nunanaa ɖe ɖe nɔvi, siwo le Yudea la, alesi woate ŋui.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nusia wowɔ hã, eye wodoe ɖe amegãawo to Barnaba kple Saul si me.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Le ɣemaɣi me fia Herodes ɖo asi hamevia ɖewo dzi, bena yeasẽ ŋuta le wo ŋu.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: Eye wòwu Yakobo, Yohanes nɔvi la, kple yi.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòkpɔ be, edze Yudatɔwo ŋu la, eyi dzi be, yealé Petro hã. Ke enye amɔwɔ maʋãmaʋã ƒe ŋkekewo.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Eye esi wobu esi me la, etsɔe de gaxɔ me, eye wòtsɔe de asi na asrafoha ene, siwo dome ɖesiaɖe me asrafo ene nɔna la, bena woadzɔ eŋu, eye wòdi be, yeaɖee afia dukɔ la le ŋutitoto ŋkeke la megbe.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Eye wodzɔ Petro ŋu le gaxɔ me; gake hame la le gbedodoɖa dzi vevie na Mawu ɖe eta.

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Ke gbesigbe Herodes le eɖe ge ɖe go afia ƒe zã me la, Petro le alɔ̃ dɔm hele babla kple kɔsɔkɔsɔ eve le asrafo eve dome, eye dzɔlawo le ʋɔtrua nu hele gaxɔ la ŋuti dzɔm.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Eye kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlaa de le tsitre de egbɔ, eye kekeli klẽ ɖe gaxɔa me. Eye wòƒo Petro ƒe axada me henyɔe golɔ bena: Tsi tre kaba! Eye eƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔ ge le eƒe asiwò ŋu.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Eye dɔla la gblɔ nɛ bena: Bla wò ali dzi, eye nado wò atokotawo! Eye wòwɔ nenema. Eye wògblɔ ne bena: Do wò awu ʋlaya la, eye nadze yonyeme.

english_verse: Peter left with the angel, but he thought everything was only a dream.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo go dze eyome, eye menyae bena, nusi va me to mawudɔla dzi la, ele me vavã o, ke ebu xa bena, ŋutega yekpɔ.

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Ke esi woto dzɔla gbãtɔwo kple eveliawo ŋu yi la, wova gagbo, si dze ŋgɔ dua la nu, eye eya ŋutɔ ʋu eɖokui na wo; eye esi wodo go la, woto ablɔ ɖeka me, eye kasia mawudɔla la dzo le egbɔ.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Eye esi Petro ƒe mo kɔ la, egblɔ bena: Azɔ menyae vavã bena, Aƒetɔ la dɔ eƒe dɔla ɖa, eye wõɖem tso Herodes si me kpakple Yudatɔwo katã ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ me.

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòle eŋuti bum la, eva Maria, Yohanes, si woyɔna be Marko la, dada ƒe xɔ nu, afisi ame geɖewo ƒo ƒu do hele gbe dom ɖa la.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòƒo agboa la, nyɔnudɔlaa ɖe, si ŋkɔ nye Roda la, va do gbee.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdze si Petro ƒe gbe la, meʋu agbo la o le dzidzɔ, si wòkpɔ la ŋuti; ke eƒu du yi ɖe eme, eye wòka ta na wo bena, Petro le tsitre ɖe agbo la nu.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Woawo gblɔ nɛ bena: Aɖaʋa dzem nèle. Ke ekã ɖe edzi bena, ele me nenema. Gake woawo gblɔ bena: Eƒe mawudɔlae.

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Ke Petro gale eƒoƒo dzi, eye esi wòʋui, eye wokpɔe la, kuvia ɖo wo.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖo asi wo dzi bena, woazi ɖoɖoe, eye wòxlẽ alesi Aƒetɔ la kplɔe do goe tso gaxɔa me la, fia wo. Eye wògblɔ bena: Mika nusiawo ta na Yakobo kple nɔviawo. Eye wòdzo le afima yii afi bubu.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Ke esi ŋu ke la, menye dzidzi via ɖee ƒo asrafoawo le nusi wo Petro la ŋuti o.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Eye esi Herodes du, eye mekpɔe o; la, edrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔlawo, eye wòde se bena, woakplɔ wo ayi amewuƒe. Eye wòdzo le Yudea yi Kaisarea, eye wòna afima.

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Eye dome vee ɖe Tirotowo kple Zidontɔwo ŋu; ke wova egbɔ kple nu sɔsɔe, eye esi wowɔ xɔlɔ̃ kple Blasto, si nye fia ƒe nuwo dzikpɔla la, wòbia tomefafa; elabena woƒe anyigba kpɔa nunyiame tso fia la tɔ dzi.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke ɖoɖoa ɖe dzi, esi Herodes ɖo fiawu la, ebɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi, eye wòƒo nu na wo.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Tete takpelawo do ɣli bena: Mawu ƒe gbee, eye menye ame tɔe o.

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Eye enumake Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla ƒoe, le esi metsɔ bubu na Mawu o la ta, eye ŋɔwo ɖui, eye eƒe agbe nu tso.

english_verse: God's message kept spreading.
translation_verse: Ke mawunya la tsi, eye wokeke ta.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Eye Barnaba kple Saul, esi wowu subɔsubɔdɔ nu la, wogbugbɔ tso Yerusalem, eye wotsɔ Yohanes, si woyɔna be Marko la, kpe ɖe wo ɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Eye nyagblɔɖila kple nufialaa ɖewo le ha me, si le Antioxia la me, siwo nye, Barnaba kple Simeon, si woyɔna be Niger, kple Lukio, Kirenetɔ kple Manahem, amesi wonyi kple dzidula Herodes, kple Saul.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Eye esi wole Aƒetɔ la subɔm, eye wotsia nu dona la, Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la gblɔ bena: Azɔ mitia Barnaba kple Saul nam hena dɔwɔwɔ, si ŋuti meyɔ wo ɖo.

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Tete wotsi nu dɔ, eye wodo gbe ɖa, eye wotsɔ woƒe asiwò da de wo dzi, eye wodo mɔ wo. Paulo gblɔ mawunya le Kipro.

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Azɔ woawo la, esi Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la dɔ wo ɖa la, wova Seleukia, eye tso afima woɖo ʋu yi Kipro.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Eye esi woɖo Salami la, wogblɔ mawunya la fia le Yudatɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒewo me; eye Yohanes hã le wo ŋu abe woƒe subɔla ene.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Ke esi woto ƒukpo blibo la me vaseɖe Pafo la, wokpɔ Yudatɔa ɖe, si nye afakala kple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila, amesi ŋkɔ nye Baryesu,

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: si le dua me dziɖula, Sergio Paulo, ŋutsu nyanua ɖe gbɔ. Amesia yɔ Barnaba kple Saul vɛ, eye wòɖi bena, yease mawunya la.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke afakala Elima tsi tre ɖe wo ŋu, eye wòdi bena, yeatrɔ dua me dziɖula atso xɔse la me.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Tete la Saul, si woyɔna hã be Paulo, si Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la yɔ fũ la, lé ŋku ɖe edzi gã

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: gblɔ bena: Oo, abosamvi, wò amesi yɔ fũ kple alakpa kpakple nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ katã, dzɔdzɔenyenyewo katã ƒe ketɔ, ɖe midzudzɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe mɔ dzɔdzɔewo tɔtrɔ oa?

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ la kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la ƒe asi ava dziwò, eye wò ŋku agba, eye magakpɔ ɣe o vaseɖe ɣeyiɣia ɖe dzi. Eye enumake afu kple viviti dze edzi, eye wòle asi tsam le amesi alé eƒe alɔnu akplɔe la dim.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Tete esi dua me dziɖula kpɔ nusi va ve me la, exɔe se, eye kuvia ɖoe le Aƒetɔ la ƒe nufiafia ŋuti. Paulo gblɔ nyanyuie la le Antioxia, si le Pisidia.

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eye esi Paulo kple amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋuti la, ɖo ʋu tso Pafo la, wova Perge le Pamfilia. Eye Yohanes dzo le wo gbɔ gatrɔ yi Yerusalem.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Ke woawo la wotsa tso Perge, eye wova ɖo Antioxia le Pisidia. Eye woyi ɖe ƒuƒoƒe me le Sabat-ŋkeke dzi, eye wobɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Eye esi woxlẽ se la kple nyagblɔɖilawo megbe la, fuƒoƒemegã dɔ ɖo ɖe wo gbɔ gblɔ bena: Ŋutsuwo, nɔviwo, ne nuxlɔ̃menyaa ɖe le mia si na dukɔa la, migblɔe.

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Tete Paulo tsi tre, eye wòɖo asi wo dzi gblɔ bena: Israel-ŋutsuwo kple mi amesiwo vɔ̃a Mawu la, miɖo to!

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Israel-dukɔ sia ƒe Mawu la ba mia fofowo, eye wòdo dukɔ sia ɖe dzi, esi wònye amedzro le Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye wotsɔ abɔ sesẽ kplɔ wo tso afima.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Azɔ la mikpɔ nyuie, bena nusi wogblɔ ɖi le nyagblɔɖilawo me la, nagava mia dzi o.

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsrɔ̃ dukɔ adre le Kanaan-nyigba dzi, eye wòmã woƒe anyigba me na wo hena domenymyi.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Esi woɖee ɖa la, ena Dawid tsi tre, be wòanye fia na wo, amesi ŋuti hã wòɖi ɖase le gblɔ bena: „Mekpɔ Dawid, Isai vi la, ŋutsu, si dze nye dzi ŋu, amesi lawɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu katã.“

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Tso nenem me sia ƒe dzidzime me Mawu tsɔ xɔla Yesu na Israel le ŋugbedodo la nu:

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: le esime Yohanes gblɔ dzimetɔtrɔ ƒe mawutsidedetaname fia Israel dukɔ blibo la katã le eƒe vava ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Ke esi Yohanes wu eƒe mɔzɔzɔ nu la, egblɔ bena: Ameka miebu xa bena, rnenyea? Menye nyee nye Kristo la o; ke kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna le megbenye, amesi ƒe atokota nu ka medzena be, matu o.

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: Ŋutsuwo, nɔviwò, Abraham ƒomeviwo kple mia dome amesiwo vɔ̃a Mawu la, miawoe wotsɔ xɔxɔnya sia ɖo ɖa.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo le Yerusalem kple woƒe dziɖulawo, esi womedze si amesia kple nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe gbe, siwo woxlẽna le Sabat sia Sabat dzi o la, wowu wo nu to woƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Gake la Mawu fɔe de tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome,

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: eye wòɖe eɖokui fia amesiwo kpe ɖe eŋuti tso Galilea va Yerusalem, ŋkeke geɖewo, amesiwo zu eƒe ɖaseɖilawo azɔ na dukɔ la.

english_verse: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
translation_verse: Eye miawo míele nyanyuie, si ŋugbe wodo na fofoawo la, gblɔm fia mi,

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: bena Mawu wu eya ke nu na mi, amesiwo nye wo viwo, le esime be wòna Yesu tsi tre, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖe Psalmo evelia me ene bena: „Vinye nènye, egbe sia medzi wò.“

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Ke esi wòfɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye megale tɔtrɔ ge ayi de nyunyɔ me o la, egblɔ ale bena: „Matsɔ Dawid ƒe amenuveve, siwo li ke la, ana mi.“

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Eyata wogblɔ le teƒe bubu hã bena: „Wò la mana wò mawumeme la nakpɔ nyunyɔ o.“

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Elabena Dawid, esi wòsubɔ Mawu ƒe tameɖoɖo le ye ŋutɔ ŋɔli la, edɔ alɔ̃; eye wotsɔe mlɔ fofoawo gbɔ, eye wòkpɔ nyunyɔ;

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: ke amesi ke Mawu do ɖe tsitre la, mekpɔ nyunyɔ o.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: Minya esia azɔ, ŋutsuwo, nɔviwò, bena to nenem me sia dzi wogblɔ nuvɔ̃kekenya fia mi, eye nusiwo katã me womete ŋu tso afia na mi ɖe Mose ƒe se la nu le o la, to eyama me la

english_verse: But everyone who has faith in Jesus is set free.
translation_verse: wotsoa afia na amesiame, si xɔ edzi se.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: „Mikpɔ ɖa, mi vlodolawo, eye miaƒe mo nawɔ yaa, eye mitsrɔ̃, elabena nye la mele ɖaa ɖe wɔm le miaƒe ŋkekeawo me, dɔ, si ne amea ɖe axlẽe afia mi la, miele exɔ ge ase o.“ Paulo ƒe mawunyagbɔgblɔ kpɔ dzidzedze.

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Eye esi wole go ɖom la, woɖe kuku na wo bena, woagagblɔ nya siawo na yewo le Sabat keme dzi.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Eye esi ƒuƒoƒemetɔwo ka la, Yudatɔ kple trɔ̃subɔla-zu-Yudatɔ, siwo vɔ̃a Mawu la, dometɔ geɖe dze Paulo kple Barnaba yome, amesiwo ƒo nu na wo, eye wode dzi ƒo na wo bena, woanɔ Mawu ƒe amenuveve la me.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye le Sabat, si dze eyome dzi la, esusɔ ʋee, ne du blibo la katã kloe naƒo ƒu ase mawunya la.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yudatɔwo kpɔ amehawo la, woyɔ fũ kple ŋuʋaʋã eye wogblɔ busunya tsi tre de nusiwo Paulo gblɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ke Paulo kple Barnaba ƒo nu kple dzideƒo bena: Ele vevie bena, woagblɔ mawunya na mi gbã, ke esi mieɖee ɖa tso mia gbɔ, eye miebu mia ɖokui be, miedze agbe mavɔ la o la, kpɔ ɖa, mietrɔ yi trɔ̃subɔlawo gbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Elabena nenema Aƒetɔ la de se na mí bena: „Meɖo wò nanye trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe kekeli, bena nanye xɔxɔ hena anyigba ƒe seƒe ke.“

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye esi trɔ̃subɔlawo see la, dzi dzɔ wo, eye wokafu Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la; eye ame alesi nu woɖo ɖi na agbe mavɔ la, xɔe se.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la kaka ɖe anyigba blibo la katã dzi.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo de zi nyɔnu ŋkutatɔ, siwo vɔ̃a Mawu kple dumegãwo me, eye wona yometiti dzɔ ɖe Paulo kple Barnaba dzi, eye wonyã wo tso woƒe nutoawo me.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Ke woawo la, esi woʋuʋu ke le woƒe afɔwo ŋuti ɖe wo ŋu la, wova Ikonio.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Eye nusrɔ̃lawo yɔ taŋ kple dzidzɔ kpakple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye wòva ve me le Ikonio bena, woa kple eve la woyi ɖe Yudatɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒe la me, eye woƒo nu, ale bena Yudatɔwo kple Helatɔwo dome ame geɖewo xɔe se.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Eye Yudatɔ, siwo mexɔe se o la, de zi trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe luʋɔwo me, eye wodo ada wo ɖe nɔviawo ŋu.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Gake la wotsi afima ŋkeke geɖe hele nu ƒom kple dzideƒo le Aƒetɔ la me, eya amesi ɖi ɖase le eƒe amenuvevenya la ŋuti, le esime wòna wowɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo to woƒe asiwo dzi.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Ke duametɔwo ma, ɖewo de Yudatɔwo dzi, eye bubuwo le apostolowo dzi.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Eye esi trɔ̃subɔlawo kple Yudatɔwo kpakple woƒe dziɖulawo ɖo bena, woadze wo dzi, be woadi gbɔ wo, eye woaƒu kpe wo la,

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Eye ŋutsua ɖe le Listra le anyinɔƒe, si metea ŋu tsia tre ɖe eƒe afɔwo dzi o, eye wònye tekunɔ tso keke dadaa ƒe dɔme ke; amesi mezɔ azɔli kpɔ o.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Eya se Paulo ƒe nuƒoƒo, amesi lé ŋku ɖe edzi gã, eye esi wòkpɔ bena, xɔse le esi be, woayɔ dɔe la,

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: egblɔ kple gbe sesẽ bena: Tsi tre, nadzɔ ɖe wò afɔwo dzi! Eye wòdzo kpo, eye wòzɔ azɔli.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Eye esi amehawo kpɔ nusi Paulo wɔ la, wokɔ woƒe gbe dzi le Likaonia-gbe me bena: Mawuwo tsɔ amewo ƒe nɔnɔme ɖi va mia gbɔ.

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Eye woyɔ Barnaba be Yupiter, ke Paulo be Merkurio; elabena eyae gblɔa nya.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Tete la Yupiter, si le dua xa la, ƒe nunɔla tsɔ nyitsu kple seƒoƒotsihewo va agboa nu, eye wòle ɖidim bena, ye kple amehawo yewoasa vɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Ke esi apostoloawo, Barnaba kple Paulo, see la, wodze woƒe awuwo, eye woƒu du ɖo ameha la me hele ɣli dom, le gbɔgblɔm bena:

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ŋutsuwo, nukae nye esi wɔm miele? Miawo hã amegbetɔ, siwo nu vena la mienye abe miawo ke ene, eye miele nyanyuie la gblɔm fia mi, bena miatrɔ atso nenem yakanu siawo gbɔ ava Mawu gbagbe, si wɔ dzi kple anyigba kple atsiaƒu kpakple nusiwo katã le wo me la gbɔ;

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: amesi le dzidzime, siwo va yi la me la, wòna dukɔwo katã zɔ woa ŋutɔwo ƒe mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Gake la medzudzɔ ɖaseɖiɖi le eɖokui ŋuti o, le esime wòwɔa nyuie, eye wòna tsidzadza mí tso dziƒo kple nuƒãɣiwo, eye wotsɔ nuɖuɖu kple dzidzɔ yɔ míaƒe dziwo me fũ.

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Eye esi wogblɔ nya siawo la, bebli hafi woxe mɔ na amehawo, bena womesa vɔ na wo o. Paulo trɔ va Antioxia.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Ke Yudatɔwo tso Antioxia kple Ikonio va afima, eye esi woƒoe ɖe amehawo nu la, woƒu kpe Paulo, eye wohee do go tso dua me hebu xa bena, eku.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Ke esi nusrɔ̃lawo va ƒo xlãe la, etsi tre heyi ɖe dua me; eye esi ŋu ke la, eya kple Barnaba wodzo yi Derbe.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Eye esi wogblɔ nyanyuie la fia du ma, eye wowɔ ame geɖewo zu nusrɔ̃lawo la, wogbugbɔ va Listra kple Ikonio kpakple Antioxia,

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: hele ŋusẽ ɖom nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe luʋɔwo, eye wole nu xlɔ̃m wo be, woanɔ xɔse la me; eye bena xaxa geɖewo me to ge míala tsã ayi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la me.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye esi wotia amegãwo na wo le ha sia ha me la, wodo gbe ɖa kple nutsitsiɖɔ, eye wotso wo ɖe Aƒetɔ, si dzi woxɔ se la, si me.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Eye esi woto Pisidia la, wova Pamfilia.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Eye esi wogblɔ nya la le Perge la, wotɔ edzi va Atalia.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Tso afima woɖo ʋu va Antioxia, afisi wotsɔ wo de Mawu ƒe amenuveve me le hena dɔ, si nu wowu la.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Ke esi wova afima, eye woƒo hamea nu ƒu la, woka nu gã, siwo Mawu wɔ kpli wo la ta na wo, kple alesi wòʋu dzixɔse ƒe ʋɔtru na trɔ̃subɔlawo.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Eye wonɔ nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ xɔ ŋkeke geɖe.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖewo tso Yudea va fia nu nɔviawo bena: Ne wometso aʋa na mi le Mose ƒe kɔa nu o la, miate ŋu akpɔ xɔxɔ o.

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Eye esi menye nusese kple anukutsyɔtsyɔ via ɖe wònye dzɔ ɖe woawo kple Paulo kple Barnaba dome o la, woɖo bena, Paulo kple Barnaba kpakple wo dometɔa ɖewo nayi apostolowo kple hamemegã, siwo le Yerusalem la gbɔ le biabia sia ta.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Azɔ woawo la, esi hame la dɔ wo ɖa la, woto Foinike kple Samaria hele trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe tɔtrɔŋutinya xlẽm fia. Eye wòzu dzidzɔ gã na nɔviawo katã.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Eye esi wova Yerusalem la, hame la kple apostoloawo kpakple hamemegãwo xɔ wo; eye woka nusiwo katã Mawu wɔ kpli wo la ta na wo?

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖewo, siwo tso farisitɔwo ƒe kɔmamã me, amesiwo xɔ se la, tsi tre, eye wogblɔ bena, ele bena, woatso aʋa na wo, eye woaɖo na wo be, woalé Mose ƒe se la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Eye apostoloawo kple hamemegãwo va kpe ta be, yewoakpɔ nya sia me da.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Ke esi wole nusesẽe geɖe wɔm la, Petro tsi tre, eye wògblɔ na wo bena: Ŋu tsuwo, nɔviwo, mienyae bena, tsã la Mawu dam le mia dome, bena trɔ̃subɔlawo nase nyanyuie la tso nunye me, eye ne woaxɔ ase.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Eye Mawu, si nya dziwo me la, ɖi ɖase na wo, le esime wotsɔ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la na wo, abe alesi wòna miawo hã ene;

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: eye mede vovoa ɖeke mía kpli wo dome o, le esime wòklɔ woƒe dziwo me to xɔse me.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Azɔ nukaŋuti miele Mawu tem kpɔ be, miatsɔ kɔkuti, si mia fofowo kple mia ŋutɔwo hã miete ŋu tsɔ o la, aku nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe kɔa?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ to Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe amenuveve me la miexɔe se bena, míakpɔ xɔxɔ abe woamawo ke ene.

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Tete ameha blibo la katã zi ɖoɖoe, eye woɖo to Barnaba kple Paulo ƒe nyaxexlẽfia le dzesi kple nukunu, siwo katã Mawu wɔ to woƒe asiwo dzi le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome la ŋuti.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Eye esi wozi ɖoɖoe megbe la, Yakobo xɔ edzi gblɔ bena: Ŋutsuwo, nɔviwo, miɖo tom!

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simeon xlẽ fia, alesi Mawu kpɔ trɔ̃subɔlawo ɖa gbã, bena yeaxɔ dukɔ tso wo dome hena eƒe ŋkɔ la.

english_verse: This agrees with what the prophets wrote,
translation_verse: Eye esia sɔ kple nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nyawo, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena:

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: „Nusiawo megbe la magatrɔ ava, eye magatu Dawid ƒe agbadɔ, si mũ dze anyi la, magaɖɔ eƒe gbagbãƒewo ɖo, eye magafɔe ɖe tsitre,

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: bena amewo ƒe susɔe kple dukɔ, siwo katã dzi woyɔ nye ŋkɔ do la, nadi Aƒetɔ la yome mɔ, Aƒetɔ la gblɔe, amesi le nusiawo, siwo

english_verse: I promised it long ago.”
translation_verse: wònya tso keke blema ke la wɔm.“

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti nye la mebu bena, miagaɖe fu na amesiwo trɔ tso trɔ̃subɔlawo dome va Mawu gbɔ la o,

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Elabena tso blema ke Mose ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo le du sia du me le esime be, woxlẽnɛ le ƒuƒoƒewo le Sabat sia Sabat dzi.

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Tete wòdze apostoloawo kple hamemegãwo kpakple ha blibo la katã ŋu bena, yewoatia ŋutsua ɖewo atso yewo dome aɖo ɖe Antioxia akpe ɖe Paulo kple Barnaba ŋu, woawo nye Yuda, si woyɔna be Barsaba, kple Sila, ŋutsu, siwo nye amegãwo le nɔviawo dome.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ agbalẽ de wo si bena: Apostolowo kple hamemegãwo kple nɔviwo ɖuɖɔ nɔvi, siwo tso trɔ̃subɔlawo dome le Antioxia kple Siria kpakple Kilikia la ƒã.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Elabena esi miese be, amea ɖewo tso mia dome va blu miaƒe tame kple nyawo, eye wonyama miaƒe luʋɔwo gblɔ bena, woatso aʋa na mi, eye mialé se la me ɖe asi, evɔ miede sea ɖeke na wo o la;

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Enyo mía ŋu, esi mieƒo nu ɖekae be, míadɔ ŋutsu tiatiawo akpe ɖe míaƒe lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, Barnaba kple Paulo ŋu aɖo ɖe mi,

english_verse: These men have risked their lives for our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: amesiwo tsɔ woƒe agbe na ɖe mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Azɔ míedɔ Yuda kple Sila ɖa, amesiwo ŋutɔ hã lagblɔe na mi nenema ke kple woƒe nu.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Elabena enyo Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la kple miawo hã ŋu be, míagatsɔ agba gãa ɖeke ada ɖe mia dzi wu nu vevi siawo ko o,

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: bena, miatsri trɔ̃wo ƒe vɔsawo kple ʋu kple lã tsiʋumewo kple ahasiwɔwɔ; ne miekpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le wo me la, ekema miewɔe nyuie. Minɔ anyi sesĩe!

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Azɔ woawo la, esi wodo mɔ wo la, wova Antioxia, eye woƒo ameha la nu ƒu, eye wotsɔ agbalẽ la na.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Ke esi woxlẽe la, wodzɔ dzi le akɔfafa la ŋuti

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Eye Yuda kple Sila, amesiwo hã nye nyagblɔɖilawo la, xlɔ̃ nu nɔviawo kple nya geɖewo; eye wodo ŋusẽ wo.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Eye esi wonɔ afima ʋee la, nɔviawo do mɔ wo le ŋutifafa me ɖo ɖe amesiwo dɔ wo ɖa la gbɔ.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Ke Paulo kple Barnaba wonɔ Antioxia hele nu fiãm, eye wole Aƒetɔ ƒe nyanyuie la gblɔm fia kple ame bubu geɖewo hã. Paulo ƒe mawunyagbɔgblɔ mɔzɔzɔ evelia.
