translation_verse: Gake menye sigbe alesi vodada li la, nenema ke nye amenuvevenunana hã o; elabena nenye ame ɖeka ƒe vodada ŋuti ame geɖewo ku ɖo la, ekema Mawu ƒe amenuveve kple nunana, si le Yesu Kristo, ame ɖeka ƒe amenuveve me la, sɔ gbɔ geɖe wu hegbã go ɖe ame geɖewo dzi.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Eye menye alesi to ame ɖeka, si wɔ nuvɔ̃ la dzi, nunana la va ɖo o; elabena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la tso ame ɖeka me zu fɔbubu, ke amenuvevenunana la tso ame geɖewo ƒe vodadawo me zu avatsotsoname.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Elabena nenye to ame ɖeka ƒe vodada me ku la ɖu fia to ame ɖeka dzi la, ekema amesiwo xɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe amenuveve kple nunana ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ la, woaɖu fia geɖe awu le agbe me to Yesu Kristo ɖeka dzi.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ alesi to vodada ɖeka me fɔbubu va amewo katã dzi la, nenema ke to nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖeka me agbe ƒe afiatsotsoname hã va amewo katã dzi.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi to ame ɖeka ƒe tomaɖomaɖo me wowɔ ame geɖewo zu nuvɔ̃wɔlawo la, nenema ke to ame ɖeka ƒe toɖoɖo me hã woawɔ ame geɖewo woazu ame dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Ke se la va tra ɖe eme, bene vodada la nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi; ke afisi nuvɔ̃ la sɔ gbɔ le la, amenuveve la sɔ gbɔ geɖe wu,

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: bene alesi ke nuvɔ̃ la ɖu fia ɖe ku me la, nenema ke amenuveve la hã naɖu fía to dzɔdzɔenyenye me hena agbe mavɔ to Yesu Kristo, mia Aƒetɔ dzi.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Azɔ nuka gblɔ ge míala? Alo ɖe miaganɔ nuvɔ̃ me, bene amenuveve la nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzia?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Gbeɖe! Aleke gɔ̃ mi amesiwo ku na nuvɔ̃ la, miaganɔ agbe le eme mahã?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mienyɛ bena, mí amesiwo katã wode mawutsi ta na ɖe Kristo Yesu me la, ɖe eƒe ku mee wode mawutsi ta na mí ɖo o mahã?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti esi wode mawutsi ta na mí ɖe eƒe ku me la, woɖi mí kpakple bene abe alesi wofɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome to Fofoa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me ene la, nenema ke miawo hã míazɔ le agbe ƒe yeyenyenye me.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Elabena ne míezu ɖeka kplii hena sɔsɔ kplii le eƒe ku me la, ekema míasɔ kplii le eƒe tsitretsitsi hã me;

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: esi mienyã esia bena, woklã miaƒe ame xoxo la ɖe atitsoga ŋu kplii, bene woaɖe nuvɔ̃ŋutilã ɖa, bene míagasubɔ nuvɔ̃ akpa o.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke ku la, wotso afia nɛ, ɖee tso nuvɔ̃ me.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Ke ne mia kple Kristo mieku la, miexɔe se bena, mia kplii mianɔ agbe hã;

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: elabena mienyae bena, Kristo, si wofɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la, megale kuku ge akpa o; ku megale edzi ɖu ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Elabena esi wòku la, eku na nuvɔ̃ zi ɖeka hɔ̃ ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu; ke esi wòle agbe la, ele agbe na Mawu.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Nenema ke miawo hã mibu mia ɖokui ame kukuwo na nuvɔ̃ la, ke ame gbegbewo na Mawu le Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ la me.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Eyata migana nuvɔ̃ la naɖu fia ɖe miaƒe ŋutilã, si le kuku ge la dzi, bena miaɖo to eƒe nudzodzrowo o.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Eye migatsɔ mia ŋutinuwo wo madzɔmadzɔnyenye ƒe aʋawɔnuwo na nuvɔ̃ la o; ke mitsɔ mia ɖokui ɖo anyi na Mawu, abe amesiwo wogbɔ agbe tso ame kukuwo dome ene, eye mitso miaƒe ŋutinuwo wo dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe aʋawɔnuwo na Mawu boŋ?

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Elabena nuvɔ̃ maɖu fia ɖe mia dzi o, elabena miegale se la te o, ke boŋ amenuveve la te miele.

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Ekem aleke wòle? Esi miegale se la te o, hafi amenuveve la te boŋ míele ŋuti la, miaganɔ nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ dzi mahã? Gbeɖe!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae bena, amesi mietso mia ɖokui wɔ kluvi na, bene miaɖo toe la, miezu amesi mieɖoa toe la ƒe kluviwo, eɖanye nuvɔ̃ tɔ hena ku o alo toɖoɖo to hena dzɔdzɔenyenye o mahã?

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Ke woada akpe na Mawu bena, míenye nuvɔ̃ ƒe kluviwo tsã, ke azɔ la tso dzi me mieɖoa to nufiafia ƒe nɔnɔme, si wotsɔ mi de asi na la.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Ke esi woxɔ mi tso nuvɔ̃ si hewɔ ablɔɖeviwoe la, wotsɔ mí wo dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kluviwoe.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Meƒo nu alesi ame ƒoa nu le miaƒe ŋutilã ƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ ŋuti. Elabena sigbe alesi mietsɔ miaƒe ŋutinuwo wɔ makɔmakɔnyenye kple sedzimawɔmawɔ ƒe kluviwoe hena sedzidada la, nenema ke azɔ mitsɔ miaƒe ŋutinuwo wɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kluviwo hena kɔkɔenyenye.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Elabena esime mienye nye nuvɔ̃ ƒe kluviwo tsã la, mievo tso dzɔdzɔenyenye si me.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Ekema kutsetse kae no mia si le ɣemaɣi mahã? Kutsetse, siwo kpea ŋu na mi azɔ; elabena nu kemawo ƒe nuwuwu enye ku.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ, esi woxɔ mi tso nuvɔ̃ si hewɔ ablɔɖeviwoe, eye gake wowɔ mi Mawu ƒe kluviwoe la, miekpɔ miaƒe kutsetse hena kɔkɔenyenye: ke nuwuwu la enye agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Elabena nuvɔ̃ la ƒe fetue nye ku; ke Mawu ƒe amenuvevenunana la enye agbe mavɔ le Kristo Yesu, mia Aƒetɔ me.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Alo nɔviwò, elabena mele nu ƒom na amesiwo nya se la, ɖe mienyae bena, se la ɖua fia ɖe ame dzi le eƒe agbenɔɣi blibo la katã o mahã?

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Elabena nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ la, ŋkeke alesi srɔ̃ŋutsua le agbe la, se blae ɖe eŋuti; ke ne srɔ̃ŋutsua ku la, wotui tso se, si biae ɖe srɔ̃ŋutsua ŋuti la me.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ, ne ezu ame bubu srɔ̃, esime srɔ̃ŋutsua gale agbe la, woayɔe be ahasiwɔla; gake ne srɔ̃ŋutsua ku la, evo tso se la me, eye ne ezu ame bubu srɔ̃ la, meganye ahasiwɔla o.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nenema ke miawo hã mieku na se la to Kristo ƒe ŋutilã me, bene míazu ame bubu, si wofa ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la to, bene míatse ku na Mawu.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Elabena esime míele ŋutilã me la, nuvɔ̃wo ƒe nudzodzro wuamenu, siwo dzo tso sea me la, sẽ ŋu ŋutɔ le míaƒe ŋutinuwo me, bene míatse ku na ku;

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: ke azɔ la wotu mi tso se la me, elabena míeku na nusi lé mí ɖe asi, bene miasubɔ le Gbɔgbɔ ƒe yeyenyenye me, menye le agbalẽŋlɔdzesi ƒe xoxonyenye me o.

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Azɔ nuka gblɔ ge míala? Ɖe se la nye nuvɔ̃a? Gbeɖe! Gake nyemedze si nuvɔ̃ la o, negbe to sea me ko; elabena nyemenya ŋubiabiã la hã o, ne menye se la mee wogblɔ le o be; „Megabiã ŋu o!“

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Ke esi nuvɔ̃ la kpɔ mɔ to sedede me la, eho ŋubiabiãwo katã ɖe dzi le menye; elabena ne se meli o la, nuvɔ̃ ku.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Ke nye la mena agbe semanɔsitɔe tsã; ke esi sedede va la, nuvɔ̃ la gbɔ agbe,

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: ke nye la meku, eye wokpɔe bena, se, si wode hena agbe la, eya ke zu ku nam.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Elabena esi nuvɔ̃ la kpɔ mɔ to sedede me la, eblem, eye wòtso eya ke hewum.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Eva la se la le kɔkɔe, eye sedede la le kɔkɔe, le dzɔdzɔe, eye wònyo.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Ekem ɖe nu nyui la zu ku nama? Gbeɖe! Hafi nuvɔ̃ la boŋ ye, bene wòadze ƒã abe nuvɔ̃ ene, tso nu nyui la wo ku nam, bene nuvɔ̃ la navɔ̃ɖi ɖe dzi ŋuta to sedede la me. Ame la ƒe ʋiʋli vevie le gota kple ememe siaa.

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Elabena míenyae bena, se la nye gbɔgbɔmenu, ke nye la ŋutilã me menye, wotsɔm ƒle ɖe nuvɔ̃ ƒe ŋusẽ te.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Elabena nusi ke mewɔna la, nyemenyae o; elabena menye nusi melɔ̃na la, mewɔna o, ke nusi meléa fu la, eya ke mewɔna.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Ke ne nusi ke nyemelɔ̃na o lae mewɔna la, ekema melɔ̃a sea dzi bena, enyo.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ meganye nyee le esia wɔm o, negbe nuvɔ̃, si le menye lae.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Elabena menyae bena, le menye — egɔmee nye: Le nye ŋutilã me la — nu nyuia ɖeke menɔa anyi o; elabena nu nyui lɔlɔ̃ la le asinye, ke nu nyui wɔwɔ la nyemekpɔ wɔe kura o.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Elabena menye nu nyui, si melɔ̃na la, mewɔna o, ke nuvɔ̃, si nyemelɔ̃na o la, eya ke mewɔna boŋ.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ke ne mewo nusi nyemelɔ̃na o la, ekema meganye nyee le esia wɔm o, negbe nuvɔ̃, si le menye boŋ.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ mekpɔ se sia bena, esime melɔ̃na bena, mawɔ nu nyui la, nuvɔ̃ la lé ɖe ŋutinye.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Elabena mekpɔa dzidzɔ le Mawu ƒe se la ŋuti le ememe la gome;

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: ke mekpɔ se bubu, si le aʋa wɔm kple se, si le nye nyasã me la, le nye ŋutinuwo me, eye wòlém aboyo le nuvɔ̃ ƒe se, si le nye ŋutinuwo me la me.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: O, nye nublanuitɔ! Amekae aɖem tso kuŋutilã si me mahã?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawu to Yesu Kristo, mia Aƒetɔ, la dzi! Eyata azɔ nye ɖeka ma ke metsɔa nyasã la subɔa Mawu ƒe se la, ke metsɔa ŋutilã la subɔa nuvɔ̃ ƒe se lae.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Elabena Gbɔgbɔ, si nye agbe, si le Kristo Yesu me la, ƒe se la xam tso nuvɔ̃ kple ku ƒe se la si.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Elabena nusi se la mete ŋu wo o, esime wògbɔdzɔ to ŋutilã me la, Mawu wɔe, eye wòdo ye ŋutɔ Via ɖo ɖa le nuvɔ̃ŋutilã ƒe sɔsɔ me, eye le nuvɔ̃ ŋuti wodoe ɖa ɖo, eye wobu to nuvɔ̃ la le ŋutilã me,

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: bene woawu sea ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye la nu le mí, amesiwo mezɔna le ŋutilã nu o, negbe le Gbɔgbɔ nu ko la me.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo noa anyi le ŋutilã nu la, ŋutilã ƒe nuwo wodina; ke amesiwo nɔa anyi le Gbɔgbɔ nu la, gbɔgbɔ me nuwo wodina.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: eyata esi ŋutilãnudidi enye adikã ɖe Mawu ŋuti, elabena mebɔbɔa eɖokui ɖe Mawu ƒe se la te o, eye metea ŋui hã o.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo noa anyi le ŋutilã me la, womate ŋu adze Mawu ŋu o.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la mienɔa anyi le ŋutilã me o, negbe le Gbɔgbɔ me, ne ele nenema bena, Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ nɔa mia me la. Ke ne Kristo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ mele amea ɖe me o la, eya menye etɔ o.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ke ne Kristo le mia me la, ekema ŋutilã la ku le nuvɔ̃ ta, gake gbɔgbɔ la enye agbe le dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋuti.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ nɔviwò, fenyilawo míenye, menye ŋutilã si mienyi fe le, bene míanɔ agbe le ŋutilã nu o;

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: elabena ne mianɔ agbe le ŋutilã nu la, miele kuku ge; ke ne mietsɔ Gbɔgbɔ wu ŋutilã ƒe nuwɔwɔwo la, miakpɔ agbe.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Elabena ame alesi nu Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ kplɔna la, woawo la mawuviwo wonye.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Elabena miexa kluvigbɔgbɔ, bene miaganɔ vɔvɔ̃m o; ke vinyenyegbɔgbɔ la boŋ miexɔ, esi me miedo ɣli le be: Aba, Fofo!

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la ŋutɔ ɖia ɖase kpena ɖe míaƒe gbɔgbɔ la ŋu bena, mawuviwo míenye.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Ke ne viwo míenye la, ekema domenyilawo hã míenye: Mawu ƒe domenyilawo kple Kristo ƒe hadomenyilawo, ne ele ale bena, miekpe fu kplii, bene mia ŋuti naka hã kplii.

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Elabena mebuna bena, ɣeyiɣi sia me fukpekpewo medze ŋutikɔkɔe, si wole ɖeɖe ge ɖe go afia le mia ŋuti la o.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Elabena nuwɔwɔ la ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ vevi la le mawuviwo ƒe ɖeɖefia la lalam.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Elabena wobɔbɔ nuwɔwɔ la ɖe gbegblẽ la te, menye eya ŋuta ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu o, ke le amesi bɔbɔe ɖe anyi la ŋuti hena mɔkpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: Eyata woaɖe nuwɔwɔ la ŋutɔ hã tso gbegblẽ ƒe kluvinyenye la me ayi ɖe mawuviwo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ablɔɖe la me.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Elabena mienyae bena, nuwɔwɔ blibo la katã le ŋeŋem, eye fu le eɖum vaseɖe fifi.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Gake menye eya ɖeɖekoe o, hafi miawo hãe, mi amesiwo xɔ Gbɔgbɔ ƒe ŋgɔgbenu la, miawo hã miele ŋeŋem le mía me hele vinyenye, si nye míaƒe ŋutilã ƒe ɖeɖe la lalam.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Elabena woxɔ mí ɖe mɔkpɔkpɔ ŋu; ke mɔkpɔkpɔ, si kpɔa nu kple ŋku la, menye mɔkpɔkpɔ wònye o; elabena nusi ame kpɔna kple ŋku la, nukaŋuti wògale mo kpɔm nɛ mahã?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Ke ne míele mɔ kpɔm na nusi míekpɔna kple ŋku o la, míele elalam le dzidodo me.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Ke nenema ke Gbɔgbɔ la hã dea míaƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ dzi; elabena alesi ke míado gbe ɖa wòadze la, mienyae o, gake Gbɔgbɔ la ŋutɔ tsɔa ŋeŋe, siwo manya gblɔ o la, xɔa mía nya ɖe akɔ.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Ke amesi dzroa dziwo me kpena la, enya nusi nye Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe didi, elabena exɔa nya ɖe ame kɔkɔewo nu, alesi dzea Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Ke mienyae bena, amesiwo lɔ̃a Mawu la, nuawo katã tim hea nyuie vɛ na wo, amesiwo woyɔ le tameɖoɖoɖi la nu.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo wonya ɖi la, eɖo wo ɖi hã, bene woanye Via ƒe nɔnɔme tɔgbe, bene wòanye ŋgɔgbevi le nɔvi geɖewo dome.

english_verse: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them. God's Love
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo wòɖo ɖi la, woawo ke hã wòyɔ; ke amesiwo wòyɔ la, woawo ke hã wòtso afia na; ke amesiwo wòtso afia na la, woawo ke hã ŋuti wòkɔ.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Azɔ, nuka gblɔ ge míala le esia ŋutii? Ne Mawu le mia dzi la, ameka atsi tre ɖe mía ŋutii?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Amesi mehe ye ŋutɔ ƒe Vi ɖe megbe o, ke wòtsɔe hena ɖe mi katã mia ta boŋ; aleke lawɔ, eye matso nuwo katã hã akpe ɖe eŋuti na mí oa?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Amekae atso Mawu ƒe ame tiatiawo nu mahã? Mawue nye afiatsola;

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: amekae abu fɔ? Kristo ye nye amesi ku, ke nusi gawu enye: Amesi wofɔ ɖe tsitre hã, amesi le Mawu ƒe nuɖusi me, amesi xa mí ɖe akɔ hã.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Amekae amã mí atso Kristo ƒe lɔlɔ̃ me mahã? Fukpekpe loo alo xaxa alo yometiti alo dɔwuame alo amamanɔnɔ alo ŋɔdzidodo alo yi mahã?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Ŋutiwò la wowua mí ʋuu le ŋkeke bliboa katã me, wobua mí abe alẽ, siwo woyina wuwu ge la ene.“

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Gake le nusiawo katã me míeɖua dzi glo le amesi lɔ̃ mi la ŋuti.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Elabena menyae keŋ bena, eɖanye ku o, eɖanye agbe o; eɖanye mawudɔlawo o, eɖanye dziɖulawo o; eɖanye ŋusẽwo o; eɖanye nusi le fifi o, eɖanye nusi le vava ge o;

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: eɖanye kɔkɔƒe o, eɖanye gogloƒe o, alo nuwɔwɔ bubua ɖe o, mate ŋu amã mí atso Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃, si le Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ me la gbɔ o.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Nyateƒe gblɔm mele le Kristo me, nyemele aʋatso kam o, esi nye dzitsinya le ɖase ɖim kpe ɖe ŋunye le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe me

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: bena, mele nu xam geɖe, eye nye dzi le veve sem ɖaasi.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Elabena medi bena, nye ŋutɔ mazu busu tso Kristo gbɔ ɖe nɔvinyewo, ƒonyemeawo le ŋutilã nu la ta;

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: amesiwo nye Israeltɔwo, amesiwo to nye vinyenye la kple ŋutikɔkɔe la kple nubablawo kple senana la kple mawusubɔsubɔ la kpakple ŋugbedodoawo;

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: amesiwo to nye fofoawo, amesiwo me Kristo hã dzo tso le ŋutilã nu, amesi nye Mawu, si ƒo wo katã ta la, amesi wokafuna yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Ke mele nenem bena, Mawu ƒe nya zu dzodzro o. Elabena menye amesiwo katã tso Israel me la, wonye Israeltɔwo o;

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: esia nye be: Menye ŋutilã ƒe viwoe nye Mawu ƒe viwo o, ke ŋugbedodo ƒe viwo boŋ woabu be ƒome.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Elabena ŋugbedodonya enye sia bena: „Magbugbɔ ava gbɔwò le wɔleawoɣi, eye viŋutsuvi lanɔ Sara si.“

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Ke menye esia ɖeɖeko o, ke Rebeka boŋ hã, esime wòfɔ fu tso Isak, mía fofo ɖeka gbɔ la —

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Yakob la melɔ̃, ke Esau la melé fu.“

english_verse: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Azɔ nuka gblɔ ge míala? Alo Mawu to medzo oa? Gbeɖe!

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Elabena egblɔ na Mose bena: „Makpɔ nublanui na amesi ke makpɔ nublanui na, eye nye dɔme atrɔ ɖe amesi ke ŋuti nye dome atro ɖo la ŋuti.“

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti azɔ metso amesi le lɔlɔ̃m alo amesi le du sim la gbɔ o, ke etso Mawu, si kpɔa nublanui la gbɔ boŋ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Elabena ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔ na Farao bena: „Esia ke ŋuti mefɔ wò ɖe tsitre, bene maɖe nye ŋusẽ ɖe go afia le ŋuwò, eye bene woaɖe gbe ƒã nye ŋkɔ ŋutinya le anyigba blibo la katã dzi.“

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ la ekpɔa nublanui na amesi ke wòlɔ̃na be, yeakpɔ nublanui na, eye wòsẽa dzime na amesi ke wòlɔ̃na be, yeasẽ dzime na.

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Azɔ la nèle gbɔgblɔ ge nam bena: Nukaŋuti wògahea nya? Elabena ameka ate ŋu atsi tre ɖe eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ŋuti mahã?

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Blewu, oo ame! Ameka nènye, wò amesi le nya hem kple Mawu la mahã? Ɖe numeme la lagblɔ na mela bena: Nukaŋuti nèmem ale mahã?

english_verse: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay?”
translation_verse: Alo zemela mekpɔa ŋusẽ ɖe tsu dzi bena, wòatsɔ anyi, si wonyã la ƒe ɖe amè ze, si ŋu bubu le la, eye wòagatsɔ eƒe ɖe hã amè ze, si ŋu bubu mele o lae mahã?

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Ke ne Mawu, esime wòle didim be, yeaɖe eƒe dziku ɖe go afia, eye yeana wòanya eƒe ŋusẽ la, tsɔ dzigbɔgbɔ blewu geɖe lé dziku ƒe ze, siwo wodzra ɖo ɖi hena gbegblẽ la, ɖe asi,

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: bene yeana wòanya eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ hã ɖe nublanuikpɔkpɔ ƒe ze, siwo wodzra ɖo ɖi hena ŋutikɔkɔe la ŋu, ekema aleke wòle?

english_verse: Whether Jews or Gentiles, we are those chosen ones,
translation_verse: Nenema ke wòyɔ miawo hã, menye tso Yudatɔwo dome ɖeɖe o, ke tso trɔ̃subɔlawo dome hã,

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: abe alesi wogblɔ le Hosea me hã ene bena: „Mayɔ ‚Manyenyedukoe‘ be Nye dukɔe la, kple Amemalɔ̃e be Amelɔlɔ̃e;

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: eye wòava me bena, afisi ke wogblɔ na wo bena: Menye ye dukɔ míenye o la, gama ke woayɔ wo le bena: Mawu gbagbe viwo.“

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Ke Yesaya do ɣli ɖe Israel ŋuti bena: „Ne Israel-viwo ƒe xexlẽme asɔ gbɔ abe ƒutake ene la, woaɖe amesiwo susɔ la;

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: elabena Aƒetɔ la awu nya la nu kaba le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye wòatso nya la me kpuie le anyigba dzi.“

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Eye abe alesi Yesaya gblɔ nya ɖi ene bena: „Ɖe menye Aƒetɔ Zebaot ye susɔ ƒome ɖi na mi o la, anye ne mietrɔ zu abe Sodom ene, eye míaɖi Gomora.“

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Azɔ nuka gblɔ ge mialã? Trɔ̃subɔla, siwo menɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye yome o la, ƒe asi su dzɔdzɔenyenye dzi; ke xɔse mee dzɔdzɔenyenye la tso;

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Kpɔ ɖa, meɖo nukikli ƒe kpe kple nuɖiaɖia ƒe agakpe anyi ɖe Zion, eye amesiame, si xɔa edzi sena la, womado ŋukpee o.“

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Nɔviwò, nye dzimedidi kple nye kukuɖeɖe, si meɖena na Mawu ɖe Israel ta la, enye si bena, woakpɔ xɔxɔ.

english_verse: I know they love God, but they don't understand
translation_verse: Elabena mele ɖase ɖim na wo bena, wole ŋu ʋãm ɖe Mawu ŋu, gake menye kple sidzedze o.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Elabena esi womenya Mawu ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye o, eye wole didim bena, woatsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye atu tsitre la, womebɔbɔ wo ɖokui ɖe Mawu ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye la te o.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Elabena se la ƒe nuwuwu enye Kristo, bene amesiame, si xɔna sena la, nakpɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye.

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Elabena Mose ŋlɔ ɖi le dzɔdzɔenyenye, si tso sea me la ŋuti bena: „Amesi ke wɔ esiawo la, ano agbe to esia me.“

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Ke dzɔdzɔenyenye, si tso xɔse me la gblɔ bena: Megagblɔ le wò dzi me bena: „Ameka aha ayi dziƒo mahã“ o; esia nye bena, woatsɔ Kristo ava anyigba dzi;

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: alo: „Ameka aɖi ayi tsiẽƒe mahã“ o; esia nye bena, woatsɔ Kristo atso ame kukuwo dome ve.

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Ke nuka wògblɔ? „Nya la tso ɖe gbewo kpuie, ele nuwò me kple dziwò me hã;“ esiae nye xɔse, si ƒe gbe ƒã ɖem míele la.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Elabena ne èʋua eme kple wò nu bena, Yesu ye nye Aƒetɔ la, eye nèxɔna sena le wò dzi me bena, Mawu fɔ eyama ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la, akpɔ xoxo;

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: elabena wotsɔa dzi xɔna sena hena dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye wotsɔa nu ʋua eme hena agbexɔxɔ la.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Elabena ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔ be: „Amesiame, si xɔa edzi sena la, womado ŋukpee o.“

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Elabena vovototoa ɖeke mele Yudatɔ kple Helatɔ dome o, elabena Aƒetɔ ma kee nye wo katã tɔ, eyae nye kesinɔtɔ na amesiwo katã yɔnɛ la.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame, si ayɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔa dzi la, woaɖee.

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Azɔ aleke woayɔ amesi dzi womexɔ se o la mahã? Ke aleke woaxɔ amesi ŋutinya womese kpɔ o la dzi ase mahã? Ke aleke woase nya, ne nyanyuie gbeƒãɖelaa ɖeke mele wo si o mahã?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Ke aleke woaɖe gbe ƒã, ne womeɖo wo ɖa hafi o mahã? Abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Nyagblɔla, siwo gblɔa ŋutifafanya kple nyanyuie la ƒe afɔwo nyo loo!“

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Gake la menye wo katãe ɖoa to nyanyuie lã o; elabena Yesaya gblɔ bena: „Aƒetɔ, amekae xa míaƒe nyagbɔgblɔ dzi se mahã?“

english_verse: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Ekema xɔse la tso nyagbɔgblɔ me, hafi nyagbɔgblɔ la tsoa Mawu ƒe nya me vana.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Ke megblɔ be: Alo ɖe womesee o mahã? Ẽ, vavãe! Woƒe numegbe ɖi hoo le anyigba blibo la katã dzi, eye woƒe nyawo de xexeme ƒe seƒewo ke.

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Ke mele gbɔgblɔm bena: Alo ɖe Israel medze sii oa? Mose ye nye gbãtɔ gblɔ be: „Nye la mana miaʋã ŋu ɖe dukɔ, si menye dukɔ o la ŋuti, eye mado dziku na mi le dukɔ masenugɔme ŋuti.

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Ke Yesaya do dzi, eye wògblɔ bena: „Amesiwo medim o la, wokpɔm, eye meɖe ɖokuinye fia amesiwo mebia tanye se o la.“

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Ke le Israel ŋuti la egblɔ bena: „Ŋkeke blibo la katã me medo nye asiwò ɖe dukɔ, si meɖoa to o, eye wòɖea ɖeklemi la.“

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Azɔ mele gbɔgblɔm be: Alo ɖe Mawu gbe eƒe dukɔ la mahã? Gbeɖe! Elabena nye hã Israeltɔ menye tso Abraham ƒome kple Benyamin-to la me.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Mawu megbe eƒe dukɔ, si wonyã ɖi la o. Alo mienyã nya, si ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔ le Eliya ŋɔli, esime wòle tsitre le Mawu ƒe ŋku me, eye wòtso Israel nu la o bena:

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: „Aƒetɔ, wowu wò nyagblɔɖilawo, eye wogbã wò vɔsamlekpuiwo ƒu anyi, eye nye ɖeka hɔ̃ koe susɔ, eye wole nye ku dim.“

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Ekema aleke wòle? Nusi ke yome Israel le didim la, eƒe asi mesu edzi o, ke ame tiatiawo ƒe asi su edzi; ke wona ame mamleawo ƒe dzime sẽ,

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Azɔ nenema ke egbe ŋkeke siawo me hã susɔewo susɔ ɖi le amenuveve ƒe tiatia la nu.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ke ne etso amenuveve me la, magatso dɔwɔwɔwo me o, elabena ekema amenuveve maganye amenuveve o; ke ne etso dɔwɔwɔwo me la, meganye amenuveve o, elabena ekema dɔwɔwɔ maganye dɔwɔwɔ o.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Mawu na alɔ̃dɔdɔgbɔgbɔ wo, ena ŋku wo, bene womagakpɔ nu o, kple to wo, bene womagase nu o“ vaseɖe egbegbe.

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Eye Dawid gblɔ be: „Na woƒe kplɔ̃ nazu mɔ̃ kple kpa kple nuɖiaɖia kpakple teƒeɖoɖo na wo;

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: na woƒe ŋkuwo nado viviti, bene womagakpɔ nu o, eye na woƒe mè nabi glebee ɖaasi.“

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Ekema mebe: Ɖe wokli nu, bene wòadze anyia? Gbeɖe! Ke le woƒe anyidzedze ŋuti wotsɔ xɔxɔ na trɔ̃subɔlawo, bene woana woamawo naʋã ŋu.

english_verse: But if the rest of the world's people were helped so much by their sin and loss, they will be helped even more by their full return.
translation_verse: Ke ne woƒe anyidzedze la zu xexeme ƒe kesinɔnu, eye woƒe bubu la zu trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe kesinɔnu la, aleke gbegbe woƒe xexlẽme ƒe dedeme blibo la mahazui o ma?

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Elabena mele gbɔgblɔm na mi amesiwo nye trɔ̃subɔlawo la bena: — Esi menye trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe apostolo la, mado nye subɔsubɔ ɖe dzi,

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: bene negbe ɖeko mana nye ŋutilãtɔwo aʋa ŋu, eye maxɔ wo dome ɖewo ɖe agbe.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Elabena ne wo gbegbe la nye avuléle xexeme la, nuka anye woƒe xɔxɔ la, negbe agbe, si tso ame kukuwo dome mahã?

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Ke ne abolowo ƒe gbãtɔ la le kɔkɔe la, amɔwɔ blibo la hãe, eye ne ke la le kɔkɔe la, alɔwo hãe.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Ke ne wòŋe alɔwo dome ɖewo ɖa, eye wò, si nye gbemiti la, wotsɔ wò do ɖe wo dome, eye nèkpɔ amiti la ƒe kè kple eƒe atimetsi ƒe gome kpli wo la,

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: ekema megaƒo adegbe ɖe alɔwo ŋuti o, ke ne èƒo adegbe la, menye wòe lé kè la ɖe asi o, hafi kè lae lé wò ɖe asi boŋ.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Azɔ la nèxɔ dzi bena: Woŋe alɔwo ɖa, bene woatsɔ nye la ado ɖe eme.

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Enyo! Woŋe wo ɖa le dzimaxɔse ŋuti, ke wò la xɔse ŋuti nèle tsitre ɖo; megado ɖokuiwò ɖe dzi o, hafi nɔ vɔvɔ̃m boŋ!

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Elabena ne Mawu mekpɔ alɔ, siwo nye atia ƒe dzɔdzɔmetɔwo ƒe nublanui o la, makpɔ wò hã wò nublanui o!

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti kpɔ Mawu ƒe dɔmenyonyo kple sesẽ ɖa: eƒe sesẽ ɖe amesiwo dze anyi la ŋuti, ke eƒe dɔmenyonyo ɖe ŋuwò, menye ɖe nenɔ dɔmenyonyo la me; ne menye nenem o la, woalã wò hã ɖa.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Eye gake woamawo hã, nenye ɖe wometsi dzimaxɔse dzi o la, woagatsɔ wo ado ɖe eme, elabena Mawu ate ŋu agado wo ɖe eme.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Elabena ne wotsɔ wò, si wolã tso amiti, si nye gbemetɔ le dzɔdzɔme nu la, dzi hedo ɖe amiti nyui, si menye wò dzɔdzɔme o la me la, aleke gbegbe womatsɔ wo amesiwo nye dzɔdzɔmetɔwo la, ado ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe amiti la me o ma?

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Elabena nɔvinyewo, nyemele didim bena, nenem nya ɣaɣla sia nanɔ manyamanya ɖe mi o, bene miagabu mia ɖokui aɖaŋudzelawo o bena, dzimesesẽ va Israel ƒe amea ɖewo dzi, halase esime trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe dedeme blibo la nava yi ɖe eme,

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: eye nenema ke woaxɔ Israel blibo la ɖe agbe, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Ɖela la atso Zion, eye wòava aɖe mawumavɔ̃mavɔ̃ ɖa tso Yakob gbɔ:

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: eye esiae nye nubabla, si le mía kpli wo dome, ne maɖe woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa la.“

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Le nyanyuie la nu wonye ketɔwo le mia ŋuti, ke le tiatia la nu wonye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo le fofoawo ta:

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: elabena Mawu ƒe amenuvevenunanawo kple yɔyɔ megavenɛ o.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi miawo hã mieɖo to Mawu tsã o, ke azɔ wokpɔ nublanui na mi le amesiawo ƒe tosesẽ ŋutii la,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: nenema ke woawo hã womeɖo to fifia o te nublanuikpɔkpɔ, si wokpɔ na mi la ŋuti, bene woakpɔ nublanui na woawo hã.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu tu nu amewo katã nu ɖe tomaɖomaɖo me, bene wòakpɔ nublanui na amewo katã. Mawu ƒe nuku-mowo kafukafu.

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Oo, Mawu ƒe kesinɔnuwo kple nunya kple sidzedze me goglo loo! Aleke eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo me dzodzro tsitotsito meli o, eye eƒe mɔwo mele nyanya me gobi o ale!

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Elabena ameka nya Aƒetɔ la ƒe tamesusu, alo ameka zu eƒe adaŋudela kpɔ mahã?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Alo ameka tre nu nanae, bene woagaɖo eteƒe ne mahã?

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Elabena nuwo katã tsoa eya me, eye wotoa eya me, eye woɖoa ta eya gbɔ; eyama tɔ lanye bubu yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Azɔ mexlɔ̃ nu mi, nɔviwò, to Mawu ƒe dɔmetɔtrɔ me bena, miatso miaƒe ŋutilãwo awɔ vɔsasa gbagbe, si ŋuti ko, si dze Mawu ŋu, esi anye miaƒe mawusubɔsubɔ gbɔgbɔmetɔ.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Eye migana miaƒe anyinɔnɔ naɖi xexe sia me o, hafi mitrɔ miaƒe nɔnɔme to miaƒe tamesusu ƒe yeyewɔwɔ me boŋ, bene miadzro nusi nye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, si nyo, eye wòdzea eŋu nyuie, eye wòle blibo la me akpɔ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Elabena to amenuveve, si wonam la me mele egblɔm na mia dome amesiame bena, negadi nu gã wu nusi dze ame be, woadi o; ke nedi ɖokuidziɖuɖu yome boŋ, amesiame abe alesi Mawu dzidze xɔse ƒe dzidzenu nɛ ene la.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi ŋutinu geɖewo le ŋutilã ɖeka ŋu na mi, gake ŋutinuawo katã mewɔa ɖo ɖeka ƒomevi o la,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: nenema ke mí ame geɖewo míenye ŋutilã ɖeka le Kristo me, hafi mía dome ame ɖeka ɖekawo la ŋutinuwo míenye;

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: eye amenuvevenunana, siwo le vovovo la, le mía si le amenuveve, si wona mí la nu; Nenye nyagbɔgblɔɖi la, miagblɔ nya ɖi le xɔse la nu:

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: nenye subɔsubɔ la, mianɔ subɔsubɔ dzi; ne amea ɖe le nu fiam la, nena nufiafia dzi;

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: ne amea ɖe le nu xlɔ̃m la, nena nuxɔxlɔ̃ dzi; amesi naa nu ame la, nena nu le dzimekɔkɔ me; amesi nɔa ame nu la, nedo vevie; amesi kpɔa nublanui na ame la, nekpɔe kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ la neganye alakpanu o! Mitsri nuvɔ̃, milé ɖe nu nyui la ŋuti!

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ na mia nɔewo nayɔ fũ kple dadavilɔlɔ̃, mitre mia nɔewo bubu!

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne veviedodo hiã la, migawo ƒome o; mixɔ dzo le gbɔgbɔ me; miwo nusi ɣeyiɣi la hiã!

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Dzi nedzo mi le mɔkpɔkpɔ me, mido dzi le xaxa me, minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɖaasi!

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Mikpe ɖe ame kɔkɔewo ƒe hiãtuame ŋuti, minɔ amedzrowɔwɔ dzi!

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Miyra amesiwo ɖa mia yome la, miyra, eye migaƒo fi de o!

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Midzɔ dzi kple amesiwo dzi le dzɔdzɔm la, mifa avi kple amesiwo le avi fam la!

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Midi nu ɖeka ma ke hena mia nɔewo; màgaɖi nu kɔkɔwo yome o, hafi mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na ame bɔbɔɖeanyiwo boŋ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Migabu mia ɖokui aɖaŋudzelawo o! Migaɖo vɔ̃ vɔ̃ teƒe na amea ɖeke o, miaƒe tamesusuwo nanɔ nu nyuiwo yome le amewo katã ƒe ŋku me;

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: ne ate ŋu anye, nusi ke atso mia gome la, minɔ anyi kple amewo katã le ŋutifafa me!

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Migabia hlɔ̃ na mia ɖokui o, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, ke miɖe mo na dziku la boŋ, elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena; „Tɔnyee nye hlɔ̃biabia, nye la maɖo eteƒe, Aƒetɔ la gblɔe.“

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Eyata ne do le wò futɔ wum la, na nuduɖui, ne tsikɔ le ewum la, na tsii; elabena ne èwɔ esia la, àƒo dzoka xɔxɔwo nu ƒu ɖe eƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Megana nu vɔ̃ɖi la naɖu dziwò o, ke tso nu nyui la ɖu nu vɔ̃ɖi la dzi boŋ.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Amesiame nabɔbɔ eɖokui na dziɖuɖu, siwo ŋusẽ li na. Elabena dziɖuɖua ɖeke meli o, negbe esi tso Mawu gbɔ ko; ke dziɖuɖu, siwo li la, Mawue ɖo wo anyi.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Eyata amesi ke dzea aglã ɖe dziɖuɖu ŋuti la, etsia tre ɖe Mawu ƒe nuɖoanyi ŋuti; ke amesiwo dzea aglã la, woakpɔ woƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Elabena dziɖulawo menye ŋɔdzi na nuwɔna nyuiwo o, ke na vɔ̃ɖiawo boŋ. Ke ɖe mèlɔ̃ be, navɔ̃ dziɖuɖu la o mahã? Ekema wo nu nyui, eye àkpɔ kafukafu tso egbɔ;

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: elabena Mawu ƒe subɔla wònye le wò nyonyo ŋuti. Ke ne èwɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi la, ŋɔ nadzi wò, elabena melé yi la ɖe asi dzodzro o, elabena Mawu ƒe subɔla kple amesi tsoa dziku biaa hlɔ̃ amesi le nu vɔ̃ɖi wotu la wònye.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Eyata ehiã be, miabɔbɔ mia ɖokui, menye dzikudodo ta ɖeɖeko o, hafi le dzitsinya ŋuti hã boŋ.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Esia ŋuti miedzɔa nu ɖo hã, elabena Mawu ƒe dɔtsɔlawo wonye, amesiwo na nenem nusia wɔwɔ dzi.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Miganyi naneke ƒe fe le amea ɖeke si o, negbe mía nɔewo lɔlɔ̃ ƒe fe ko; elabena amesi ke le ame bubu lɔm la, ewu se la nu.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Elabena nya, si woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Megawɔ ahasi o; megawu ame o; megafi fi o; megabiã ŋu o;“ eye ne se bubua ɖe gali la, ƒe ta le nya sia me be: „Lɔ̃ hawòvi abe ɖokuiwò ene!“

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ la mewɔa vɔ̃ ɖe amehavi ŋuti o; eyata lɔlɔ̃ lae nye sedziwɔwɔ. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena zɔzɔ le kekeli me.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Eye miwɔ esia, elabena mienyã ɣeyiɣi la kɔte bena, gaƒoƒo la de vɔ bena, miafɔ tso alɔ̃ me; elabena azɔ la agbexɔxɔa tu mi wu tsã, esime miexɔ se la.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Zã la va yi vɔ, eye ŋu le kekem! Azɔ la minɛ miaɖe viviti me dɔwɔwɔwo ɖa, eye miado kekeli ƒe aʋawɔnuwo!

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Minɛ míazɔ nyuie, abe alesi dze le ŋkeke me ene, menye le aglotutuwo kple ahamumuwo, menye le ahasi wɔwɔwo kple hadzedzewo, menye le dzrewɔwɔ kple ŋuʋaʋã me o;

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: hafi mido Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo boŋ, eye migana beléle na ŋutilã nazu nudzodzrowo yomenɔnɔ o.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Ke amesi gbɔdzɔ le xɔse me la, mixɔe, gake menye bene miahe nya le tamesusu vovovowo ŋuti o.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Ame ɖeka xɔna sena bena, yeate ŋu aɖu nusianu, ke amesi gbɔdzɔ la, ama ko wòɖuna.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Amesi dua nu la, nagaɖo vlo amesi meɖua nu o la o; eye amesi meɖua nu o la, nagadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu amesi ɖunɛ la o, elabena Mawu xɔe.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Wò la, ameka nènye be, nèdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame bubu ƒe dɔla? Ye ŋutɔ ƒe aƒetɔ wòle tsitre na, alo wòdze anyi na; gake anɔ tsitre, elabena Mawu ate ŋu alée ɖe tsitre.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Ame ɖeka bua ŋkeke ɖeka wua ŋkeke bubu, ke ame bubu bua ŋkeke sia ŋkeke sɔsɔe. Amesiame nakpɔ kakaɖedzi le ye ŋutɔ ƒe tamesusu me.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Amesi bua ŋkeke la, ebunɛ na Aƒetɔ la; eye amesi mebua ŋkeke o la. Aƒetɔ lae mebunɛ na o. Amesi ɖua nu la, eɖunɛ na Aƒetɔ la, elabena eda akpe na Mawu; eye amesi meɖua nu o la, Aƒetɔ lae meɖunɛ na o, eye wodaa akpe na Mawu.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Elabena mia dome amea ɖeke mele agbe na eɖokui o, eye amea ɖeke mekuna na eɖokui o.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Elabena ne míele agbe la, miele agbe na Aƒetɔ la, eye ne mieku la, mieku na Aƒetɔ la. Azɔ nenye míele agbe alo mieku la. Aƒetɔ la tɔ míenye.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Elabena esia ŋuti Kristo ku, eye wògagbɔ agbe ɖo, bene wòaɖu Aƒetɔ ɖe ame kukuwo kple ame gbagbewo siaa dzi.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, nukaŋuti nèdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu nɔviwò mahã? Alo wò hã, nukaŋuti nèdo vlo nɔviwò mahã? Elabena mi katã míava nɔ tsitre ɖe Kristo ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena; „Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be: Meta nye agbe: Woadze klo sia klo nam, eye aɖe sia aɖe aʋu me na Mawu.“

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ mía dome ɖesiaɖe abu akɔnta le ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋuti na Mawu.

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Azɔ la migana miadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mía nɔewo o, hafi midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le nusia ŋuti boŋ bena, amea ɖeke nagatsɔ nukikli alo nuɖiaɖia ada ɖe nɔvia ƒe mɔ dzi o.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Menyae, eye mekpɔ kakaɖedzi le Aƒetɔ Yesu me bena, naneke menye kɔgblẽɖonu le eɖokui si o, negbe amesi ke bua nane kɔgblẽɖonu la, eyama wòzu kɔgblẽɖonu na.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Ke ne nɔviwò le nu xam le wò nuɖuɖu ŋuti la, ekema megale zɔzɔm le lɔlɔ̃ la nu o. Megatsɔ wò nuɖuɖu tsrɔ̃ ame ma, si la Kristo ku ɖo la o!

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Azɔ la migana woagblɔ busunya ɖe miaƒe nu nyui la ŋuti o!:

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Elabena mawufiaɖuƒe la menye nuɖuɖu kple nunono o, ke dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ŋutifafa kple dzidzɔ le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe me boŋ ye.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke subɔa Kristo le nusiawo me la, eƒe nu nyoa Mawu ŋu, eye wòdzea amewo ŋu.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ minɛ míanɔ nusiwo nye ŋutifafatɔ kple nusiwo woatsɔ atu ame nɔewo la yome?

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Megagblẽ Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ le nuɖuɖu ta o! Nusianu ŋuti kɔ hafi; gake la enye vɔ̃ na amesi ɖui le nuɖiaɖia me.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Enyo bena, màɖu lã o, eye màno aha hã o, alo mawɔ nane, si nɔviwò klina alo wòɖia enu alo wògbɔdzɔna le eŋuti la o.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Wò la, xɔse, si le asiwò la, nanɔ asiwò na wò ŋutɔ le Mawu ŋku me. Woayra amesi medrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eɖokui le nusi wòdo kpɔ wòdze la ŋuti o.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Ke amesi le ɖi kem, ne eɖui la, wobu fɔe, elabena èwɔ nusi metso xɔse me o; ke nusianu, si metso xɔse me o la, nuvɔ̃ wònye.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Ke ele na mi, amesiwo ŋu ŋusẽ le la bena, miatsɔ amesiwo ŋu ŋusẽ mele o la ƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo, eye míagadze mía ɖokui ŋu o.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Mía dome amesiame nadze ehavi ŋu hena eƒe nyonyo, bene woatsɔe atu;

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: elabena Kristo hã medze eɖokui ŋu o, hafi abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Amesiwo dzu wò la ƒe dzudzu va dze dzinye.“

english_verse: And the Scriptures were written to teach and encourage us by giving us hope.
translation_verse: Elabena nusi ke woŋlɔ ɖi tsã la, woŋlɔe le míaƒe nufiafia ta, bene miatsɔ ŋɔŋlɔawo ƒe dzidodo kple akɔfafa akpɔ nukpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Ke dzidodo kple akɔfafa ƒe Mawu la awɔ mi bena, miasusu tame ɖeka le mia nɔewo dome le Kristo Yesu nu,

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: bene miatsɔ tame ɖeka kple nu ɖeka akafu Mawu, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo la.

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mixɔ mia nɔewo, abe alesi Kristo hã xɔ mi ene hena Mawu ƒe kafukafu.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Elabena mele egblɔm bena, Yesu Kristo zu subɔla na aʋatsotso le Mawu ƒe nyateƒe ŋuti, bene wòali ke ŋugbedodo, siwo wodo na fofoawo la;

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: eye bena trɔ̃subɔlawo kafu Mawu le eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ ŋuti, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Esiaŋuti makafu wò le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome, eye wò ŋkɔ la madzi kafukafuha na.“

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Eye wògagblɔ be: „Dzi nedzɔ mi trɔ̃subɔlawo hekpe ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋuti.“

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Eye wògagblɔ bena: „Mikafu Aƒetɔ la, mi trɔ̃subɔlawo katã! Mido vivi ɖe eŋuti, mi dukɔwo katã!“

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Eye Yesaya gagblɔ bena: „Isai ƒe kè kple amesi atsi tre, bene yeaɖu fia ɖe xexemedukɔwo dzi la, ava; eyama xexemedukɔwo lãkpɔ mo na.“

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Ke mɔkpɔkpɔ ƒe Mawu la natsɔ dzidzɔ kple ŋutifafa katã aye mi taŋ le xɔxɔse me, bene miakpɔ mɔkpɔkpɔ sɔ gbɔ fũ le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe ŋusẽ me. Nyanyuie la yayra to apostolo la dzi.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Ke nɔvinyewo, nye ŋutɔ meɖo ŋu ɖe mia ŋu keŋ bena, míenye amesiwo dɔmenyonyo yɔ fũ, eye sidzedze yɔ mi taŋtaŋ, bene miate ŋu axlɔ̃ nu mia nɔewo hã.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Gake la metso dzideƒo geɖe wu ŋlɔ na mi le nya si kple nya si ŋuti, nɔvinyewo, abe ɖe magaɖo ŋku wo dzi na mi ene le amenuveve, si Mawu nam la ŋuti,

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: bene manye Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔtsɔla na trɔ̃subɔlawo, eye mawɔ Mawu ƒe nyanyuie la ƒe nunɔnɔdɔ, bene trɔ̃subɔlawo nazu vɔsa, si adze eŋu, eye eŋuti ko to Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Eyata nye adegbeƒoƒo, si le asinye la, ele Kristo Yesu me le Mawu ƒe do ŋuti.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemado dzi agblɔ nyaa ɖeke o, negbe nusiwo Kristo wo to dzinye hena trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe toɖoɖo le nyagbɔgblɔ kple dɔwɔwɔ me,

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: le dzesiwo kple nukunuwo ƒe ŋusẽ me, le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe ŋusẽ me, ale bena tso keke Yerusalem kple eƒe nutowo me godoo vaseɖe Iliriko ke meɖe gbe ƒã Kristo ƒe nyanyuie la le keŋ.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Ke le esiawɔwɔwo me mebui bubunu be, magblɔ nyanyuie la atia, menye afisi woyɔ Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ le xoxo o, bene nyemagatu ɖe ame bubu ƒe gɔmeɖoɖoanyi dzi o,

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: hafi abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Amesiwo womeɖe gbe ƒãe na haɖe o la, woawo akpee, eye amesiwo mesee haɖe o la, woawo aŋɔ ɖe eme.“

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Esiaŋuti hã kuxi kum edziedzi bena, nyemete ŋu va mia gbã haɖe o.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ esi teƒe megali nam le afisia nutowo me o, eye wòle dzroyem vevie ƒe geɖe enye si bena, mava mia gbɔ la,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: gbesigbe ke madze mo ayi Spania la, mava mia gbɔ; elabena mele mɔ kpɔm bena, ne mele afima mɔ tom la, mava kpo mi ɖa, eye miaɖom ɖa ayi afima, ne mia kpɔkpɔ naɖi ko nam ʋee hafi.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Elabena edze Makedonia kple Axaya ŋu bena, woadzo nu na ame dahe, siwo le Yerusalem ƒe ame kɔkɔewo dome la.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Elabena edze wo ŋu, eye wonye woƒe fenyilawo hã; elabena ne trɔ̃subɔlawo kpɔ woƒe gbɔgbɔmenuwo gome la, edze bena, woawo hã woatsɔ woƒe xexemenuwo asubɔ woamawo.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ne mewu esia nu, eye metre nenem kutsetse sia nu na wo la, matso mia gbɔ ayi Spania.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Ke menyae bena, ne meva mia gbɔ la, mava kple Kristo ƒe yayra ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ blibo la.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Ke mele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwo, le mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo kple Gbɔgbɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃ me bena, miade dzinye ate kame le gbedodoɖawo me na Mawu ɖe tanye,

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: bene woaɖem atso tosẽla, siwo le Yudea la si me, eye bena nye subɔsubɔdɔ, si mewɔ hena Yerusalem la, nadze ame kɔkɔewo ŋu nyuie,

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: bene mava mia gbɔ kple dzidzɔ to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, eye mia kple miawo míagbɔ ɖe eme.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutifafa Mawu la nanɔ anyi kpli mi katã! Amen.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Mele Foibe, mia nɔvinyɔnu, si nye Kenxrea-hame ƒe subɔla la, kafum na mi,

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: bene míaxɔe le Aƒetɔ me, alesi dze ame kɔkɔewoe la, eye miakpe ɖe eŋuti le dɔ sia dɔ, si me wòhiã mi le la me; elabena eya ŋutɔ hã nye kpeɖeŋutɔ na ame geɖe, eye na nye ŋutɔ hã. Apostolo la do gbe na Roma-hame la.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Priskila kple Akwila, siwo nye hanyedɔwɔlawo le Kristo Yesu me la, nam ƒã;

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: woawo nye amesiwo tsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe kɔwo ɖo anyi ɖe nye luʋɔ ta, amesiwo menye nye ɖeɖekoe le akpe dam na wo o, ke hame, siwo katã le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome hãe;

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: eye miɖuɖɔ hame, si le woƒe aƒe me la, nam ƒã. Miɖuɖɔ Epeneto, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ, si nye kutsetse gbãtɔ na Kristo le Asia la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Maria, si dze agbagba geɖe le mia ŋuti la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Andronika kple Yunia, siwo nye ƒonyemeawo kple hanyegatɔwo, amesiwo xɔ ŋkɔ le apostoloawo dome, amesiwo tre kristotɔnyenye nam la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Amplia, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ le Aƒetɔ me la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Urbano, si nye mía hadɔwɔla le Kristo me la, kple Staxis, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Apeles, amesi li ke le Kristo me la, nam ƒã. Miɖuɖɔ amesiwo tso Aristobulo ƒe aƒe me la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Herodion, ƒonyemetɔ la, nam ƒã. Miɖuɖɔ amesiwo tso Narkiso ƒe me, siwo le Aƒetɔ me la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Trifena kple Trifosa, siwo le agbagba dzem le Aƒetɔ me la, nam ƒã. Miɖuɖɔ Persis lɔlɔ̃tɔ, si dzea agbagba geɖe le Aƒetɔ me la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Rufo, ame tiatia le Aƒetɔ me la, kple dadaa, si nye nye hã danye la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Asinkrito, Flego, Herme, Patroba, Herma kple nɔvi, siwo li kpli wo la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ Filologo kple Yulia, Nerea kple nɔvianyɔnuvi kple Olimpa kple lãme kɔkɔe, siwo katã li kpli wo la, nam ƒã.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nugbugbɔ kɔkɔe ɖuɖɔ mia nɔewo nam ƒã. Kristo ƒe hamewo katã ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le ameblelawo ŋuti.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Ke mele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwo, bena mialé ŋku ɖe amesiwo wɔa mamãwo kple nuɖiaɖiawo ɖe nufiafia, si miesrɔ̃ ŋu la ŋuti, eye milé mia ɖokui ɖa tso wo gbɔ.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Elabena nenem mesiawo mesubɔa mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo o, ke woƒe ƒodo boŋ wosubɔna, eye wotsɔ nuƒoƒo nyui kple yayranyawo blea amesiwo mesusu vɔ̃a ɖeke o la ƒe dziwo.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Elabena miaƒe toɖoɖo de amewo katã ƒe to me; eyata dzi le dzɔyem le mia ŋuti, ke mele didim bena, mianye nunyalawo le nu nyui me, ke ame dzadzɛwo ɖe nuvɔ̃ ŋuti.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutifafa Mawu la agbã Satana ɖe miaƒe afɔwo te gudugudu kpuie. Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe amenuveve la nanɔ anyi kpli mi katã! Aposrolo la ƒe hadɔwɔlawo do gbe na Roma-hame la.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoteo, hanyedɔwɔla, kple Lukio kple Yason kple Sosipatro, ƒonyemetɔwo, ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Nye Tertio, si ŋlɔ agbalẽ sia la, meɖuɖɔ mi ƒã.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Ke amesi ate ŋu ado ŋusẽ mi le nye nyanyuie kple Yesu Kristo ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe la nu ɖe nya ɣaɣla, si woɣla tso ɣeyiɣi mavɔmavɔwo me ke la, ƒe ɖeɖefia la nu,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: esi woɖe ɖe go fia azɔ, eye to nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe ŋɔŋlɔawome le Mawu mavɔtɔ ƒe sedede la nu, wòna trɔ̃subɔlawo katã nyae hena xɔse ƒe toɖoɖo:

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
