translation_verse: Mawu, si nye nunyatɔ ɖeka hɔ̃ to Yesu Kristo dzi la, tɔ nanye bubu la yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Paulo, Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolo si woyɔ to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me la, kpakple nɔvi Sostenes,

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Mawu ƒe hame, si le Korinto la, amesiwo wowɔ kokoe le Kristo Yesu me, tame kokoe, siwo woyɔ kple amesiwo katã yɔa mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔa dzi le afisiafi le wo gbɔ kple mía gbɔ la:

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, mía Fofo, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi!

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Meda akpe na nye Mawu ɖaasi le mia ta le Mawu ƒe amenuveve, si wona mi le Kristo Yesu me la ŋuti,

english_verse: who helps you speak and understand so well.
translation_verse: bena miezu kesinɔtɔwo le nusianu me le eyama me, le nufiafia katã kple sidzedze katã me,

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: abe alesi woli ke Kristo ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi le mia me ene,

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: bena miele megbe le amenuvevenunanaa ɖeke me o, eye miele mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖeɖefia la lalam,

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: amesi hã ali ke mi yiɖase nuwuwu la dzi, bene mianye ame maɖifɔwo le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔlae nye Mawu, amesi ya mi va Via Yesu Kristo, mía Aƒetɔ la, ƒe hamenɔnɔ me la. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le mamãwo ŋuti.

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Ke mele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwò, le mía Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkɔa dzi bena, mi katã miagblɔ nya ɖeka, eye mamãa ɖeke naganɔ mia dome o; ke míazu blibo le tame ɖeka kple susu ɖeka ma me.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Elabena Xloeƒemetɔwo ɖee fiãm le mia ŋuti, nɔvinyewo bena, dzre le mia dome.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Ke mele esia gblɔm bena, mia dome ɖesiaɖe gblɔna bena: Nye la, Paulo to menye! Nye la, Apolo to menye! Nye la, Kefa tɔ menye! Nye la, Kristo to menye!

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Ɖe wòmã Kristo mea? Alo ɖe Paulo ye woklã ɖe atitsoga ŋu ɖe mia ta, alo ɖe Paulo ƒe ŋkɔ mee wode mawutsi ta na mi ɖoa?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawu bena, nyemede mawutsi ta na mia dome amea ɖeke o, negbe Krispo kple Gayo ko,

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: bene amea ɖeke nagagblɔ be, mede mawutsi ta na mi ɖe nye ŋuta nye ŋkɔ dzi o.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Ke mede mawutsi ta na Stefana ƒe aƒe la hã; emegbe la megade mawutsi ta na ame bubua ɖe mahĩ, nyemenyae o.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Elabena Kristo medɔm be, made mawutsi ta na ame o, hafi bena magblɔ nyanyuie la afia boŋ, menye le nya ƒe nunya me o, bena Kristo ƒe atitsoga la nagazu dzodzro o. Atitsoga la ŋunya gblẽa amegbetɔwo ƒe nunya.

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Elabena atitsoga la ŋutinya enye bometsinya na amesiwo tsrɔ̃ la, ke mí amesiwo woxɔ la, Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ wònye na mí.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Magblẽ nunyalawo ƒe nunya dome, eye maɖe gɔmeselawo ƒe gɔmesese ɖa.“

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Afika nunyala le? Afika agbalẽfiala le? Afika xexe sia me ƒe anukutsyɔla le? Alo menye Mawu trɔ xexe sia me ƒe nunya wòzu bometsitsi o ɖe?

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Elabena esi xexeame metso ye ŋutɔ ƒe nunya dze si Mawu le Mawu ƒe nunya me o ŋuti la, eyata edze Mawu ŋu be, yeato gbeƒãɖeɖe bometsinya me axɔ amesiwo axɔ ase la.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Elabena Yudatɔwo biaa dzesiwo, eye Helatɔwo ɖia nunya yome;

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: ke miawo la mieɖea gbe ƒã Kristo, amesi woklã ɖe atitsoga ŋu la, esi nye nukikli na Yudatɔwo kple bometsinu na Helatɔwo;

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: ke hena wo amesiwo woyɔ la, Yudatɔwo kple Helatɔwo siaa, mieɖea gbe ƒã Kristo, si nye Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ kple Mawu ƒe nunya la.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe bometsitsi nyaa nu wua amegbetɔwo, eye Mawu ƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ sẽa ŋu wua amegbetɔwo,

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Elabena nɔviwò, mikpɔ mia yɔyɔ la ɖa bena, menye nunyala geɖewo le ŋutilã nu o, menye ŋusẽtɔ geɖewo o, menye bubume geɖewo o;

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: hafi Mawu tia xexeame bometsinuwo, bene wòaɖo ŋukpe nunyalawo, eye Mawu tia xexeame gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔnuwo, bene wòado ŋukpe nu sesẽwo;

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: eye xexe sia me nu maɖinuwo kple nusiwo woɖoa vlo kpakple nusiwo menye naneke o lae. Mawu tia, bene wòaɖi gbɔ nusiwo nye nane la,

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: bene ŋutilãa ɖeke nagaƒo adegbe le Mawu ƒe ŋku me o.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Ke eya ŋuta gbɔ wòtso miele Kristo Yesu me, amesi zu nunya kple dzɔdzɔenyenye kple kɔkɔenyenye kpakple fexexeɖeta, si tso Mawu gbɔ la na mí,

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: bene amesi ke ƒoa adegbe la, naƒo adegbe le Aƒetɔ la me, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene.

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Eye nye hã, esime meva mia gbɔ la, nɔviwo, nyemetsɔ nya gã gbɔgblɔ alo nunya gã va le Mawu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi gblɔm le mia fiãm o.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemebu bena, menya nane le mia dome o, negbe Yesu Kristo ko, amesi kekeake woklã ɖe atitsoga ŋu la.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Eye mena mia gbɔ le gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ kple vɔvɔ̃ kpakple dzodzo nyanyanya geɖe me;

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: eye nye nyagbɔgblɔ kple nye gbeƒãɖeɖe mele nunya ƒe nya, siwo ƒoa nya ɖe ame nu la me o; ke boŋ le Gbɔgbɔ kple ŋusẽ ƒe ɖeɖefia la me,

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: bene miaƒe xɔse la naganɔ amewo ƒe nunya me o, hafi nenɔ Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ me boŋ.

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ke nunya gblɔm míele le amesiwo zu blibo la dome, ke menye xexe sia me nunya, alo xexe sia me dziɖula, siwo atsrɔ̃ la to o;

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: ke boŋ míegblɔa Mawu ƒe nunya, si le ɣaɣla la, le nya ɣaɣla me, nunya, si Mawu ɖo anyi, hafi woɖo xexeme gome anyi hena miaƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la,

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: si xexe sia me dziɖulawo dometɔa ɖeke medze sii o, elabena ɖe wodze sii la, anye ne womeklã ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe Aƒetɔ la ɖe atitsoga ŋu o.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Ke abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Nusiwo ŋku mekpɔ kpɔ o, eye to mese kpɔ o, eye womeva ame ƒe dzi me kpo o la, nusiawo Mawu dzra ɖo na amesiwo lɔ̃nɛ la.“

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la Mawu ɖee fia mi to eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dzi; elabena Gbɔgbɔ la dzroa nuwo katã me kpɔna keke Mawu ƒe nu gogloawo me ke.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Elabena amewo dometɔ kae nya nusi le ame me, ne menye ame ƒe gbɔgbɔ, si le eme la koe oa? Nenema ke amea ɖeke menya nusi le Mawu me la o, negbe Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ɖeɖekoe.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la miexɔ xexeme ƒe gbɔgbɔ la o, hafi Gbɔgbɔ, si tso Mawu gbɔ la boŋ miexɔ, bene míate ŋu anya nusi Mawu na mí la.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Eye nusiawo miegblɔna hã, eye míetsɔa nya, siwo amewo ƒe nunya fia mi la o, hafi míetsɔa nya, siwo Gbɔgbɔ la fia mí la boŋ, eye míetsɔa gbɔgbɔmenuwo heɖoa gbɔgbɔmenuwo ŋuti.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Ke dzɔdzɔmeme mexɔa Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe nuwo o, elabena wonye bometsinuwo nɛ, eye mate ŋu adze sii o, elabena Gbɔgbɔ wotsɔna kpɔa eme.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Ke gbɔgbɔmeme la kpɔa nuwo katã me, ke eya ŋutɔ la amea ɖeke mekpɔa eme o.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Elabena ameka dze si Aƒetɔ la ƒe tamesusu, ne wòafia nui mahã? Ke miawo la Kristo ƒe tamesusu le mía si.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Eye nye hã, nɔviwo, nyemete ŋu ƒo nu kpli mi abe gbɔgbɔmemewo ene o, hafi abe ŋutilãmemewo ene, abe vidzĩewo le Kristo me ene.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Mena notsi mi mieno, eye menye nuɖuɖu sesẽ o, elabena miesẽ ŋu haɖe o; eye fifi hã miesẽ ŋu haɖe o,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: elabena míeganye ŋutilãmemewo. Elabena ŋkeke alesi ŋuʋaʋã kple dzrewɔwɔ kple mamã le mia dome la, menye ŋutilãmemewo míenye, eye miezɔna le ŋutilã la nu o ɖe?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Elabena ne ame ɖeka gblɔ be: Nye la Paulo tɔ menye, eye ame bubu gblɔ be: Nye la Apolo tɔ menye la, alo ɖe míenye ŋutilãmemewo oa?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Azɔ ɖe, amekae nye Apolo? Amekae nye Paulo? Subɔlawo wonye, amesiwo dzi mieto xɔ dzi se la, eye amesiame le abe alesi Aƒetɔ lã nae la ene.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Nye la medo nu, eye Apolo de tsii, ke Mawue nana wotsina nyuie.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Eyata amesi do nu la, menye naneke o, eye amesi de tsii hã, menye naneke o, ke Mawu, si na tsitsi lae boŋ.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Ke amesi le nu ɖom kple amesi le tsi demi la, wo kpakple eve le ɖeka, hafi amesiame axɔ ye ŋutɔ ƒe fetu le ye ŋutɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ la nu.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe hadɔwɔlawo míenye; Mawu ƒe agble kple Mawu ƒe xɔtutu miawo míenye.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe amenuveve, si wonam la, nu meɖo gome anyi abe xɔtula dzeaɖaŋu ene, ke ame bubu tui ɖe edzi. Gake amesiame nakpɔ nyuie, alesi wòatui ɖe edzi la.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: ekema amesiame ƒe dɔwɔwɔ adze ƒã, elabena ŋkeke la aɖee ɖe go afia, elabena woaɖee ɖe go afia to dzo me, eye alesialesi ke amesiame ƒe dɔwɔwɔ le la, dzo la adoe akpa.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ, si wòtu ɖe edzi la, tsi anyi la, axa fetu.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ afiã la, abui, ke woaxɔ eya ŋutɔ, gake abe amesi to dzo me ene. Hame la gblẽlawo.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae bena, mawuxɔ míenye, eye Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la nɔa mia me oa?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe gblẽ mawuxɔ la, Mawu agblẽ eyama hã, elabena mawuxɔ la le kɔkɔe, eye esiae miawo la mienye.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke nagable eɖokui o: Ne mia dome amea ɖe bu eɖokui nunyala le xexe sia me la, nezu bometsila, bene wòazu nunyala.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Elabena xexe sia me nunya enye bometsitsi le Mawu gbɔ, elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Eléa nunyalawo le woƒe aɖaŋu vɔ̃ me.“

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Eye wogaŋlɔ be: „Aƒetɔ la dzea si nunyalawo ƒe susuwo bena, wonye dzodzro.“

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: eɖanye Paulo o, eɖanye Apolo o, eɖanye Kefa o, eɖanye xexeame o, eɖanye agbe o, eɖanye ku o, eɖanye nusi li fifi alo nusi le vava ge o; nuwo katã nye mia tɔ,

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: ke miawo la míenye Kristo tɔ, ke Kristo la enye Mawu to.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ale ame nabu mí enye esi: Abe Kristo ƒe dɔlawo kple Mawu ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo ƒe xɔnuviwo ene.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Ke nusi gakpe ɖe eŋuti la, enye bena, wodina tsoa xɔnuviwo gbɔ, bene woakpɔ wo nuteƒewolawoe.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Ke nye la nu via ɖe ŋutɔ ko wònye nam, ne woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnum le miawo alo amea ɖe ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe dzi; evo la nyemedrɔ̃ ʋɔnu nye ŋutɔ ɖokuinye hã o.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemenya naneke le ɖokuinye ŋuti o, ke menye eyata wotso afia nam o, ke Aƒetɔ lae nye amesi drɔ̃ ʋɔnum.“

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Eyata migadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu naneke, hafi ɣeyiɣi la nava ɖo o, halase esime Aƒetɔ la ava, amesi ahe viviti me nya ɣaɣlawo ava kekeli nui, eye wòaɖe dzimedaŋudedewo ɖe go afia la, ekema amesiame akpɔ kafukafu tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Ke nɔviwò, nusiawo megblɔ heɖo mía kple Apolo ŋuti le mia ta, bene miasrɔ̃ nu le mía gbɔ, bena miagasusu awu nusi woŋlɔ ɖi la o, bena mia dome amea ɖeke nagado eɖokui ɖe dzi le ame ɖeka ta ɖe ame bubu ŋuti o.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Elabena ameka na nèto vovo ma? Eye nukae le asiwò, si mèxɔ oa? Ke ne wò hã nèxɔe la, nukaŋuti nèle adegbe ƒom abe menye ɖe nèxɔe ene oa?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Míeɖi ƒo xoxo, míezu kesinɔtɔwo xoxo, miegblẽa mi ɖi ɖua fia; ɖe miaɖu fia gɔ̃, bene miawo hã míaɖu fia kpakpli mi la, ne anyo!

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Elabena mele susum bena, Mawu tsɔ mí apostolowo wɔ mamletɔwo, abe amesiwo woɖo anyi na ku ene, elabena míezu nukpɔkpɔ na xexeame kple mawuɖɔlawo kple amewo siaa.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Míenye bometsilawo le Kristo ŋuti, ke miawo la nunyalawo míenye le Kristo me; miawo la miegbɔdzɔna, ke miawo la miesẽa ŋu; wobua mi, ke miawo la woɖoa vlo mi.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Vaseɖe gaƒoƒo sia dzi la dɔ kple tsikɔ wua mí, eye miezɔa amama, eye woƒoa mí kple kɔ, eye nɔƒe gobia ɖeke meli na mi o.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Eye míedzea agbagba, eye míetsia mía ŋutɔwo míaƒe asiwò wɔa dɔ; ne wodzu mí la, míeyrana; ne woti mía yome la, mieɖoa dzi tsɔnɛ;

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: ne wodo busu mi la, míeɖea kuku; míezu abe xexe sia me ƒe aɖukpodzinuwo ene, amewo katã ƒe gbeɖuɖɔ vaseɖe egbegbe sia.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Menye ɖe meŋlɔ nusiawo, bene maɖo ŋukpe mi o, ke boŋ bene maxlɔ̃ nu mi abe nye lɔlɔ̃viwo ene.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Elabena ne vidzikpɔla akpe ewo le mia si le Kristo me hã la, fofo geɖe meli na mi o; elabena metsɔ nyanyuie la dzi mi le Kristo Yesu me.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mele nu xlɔ̃m mi bena: Mizu srɔ̃nyelawo.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Eyata medɔ Timoteo, si nye vinye blɔtɔ kple nuteƒewɔla le Aƒetɔ me la, ɖo ɖe mia gbɔ; amesia aɖo ŋku nye mɔ, siwo le Kristo me, abe alesi mele nu fiam le ha sia ha me le afisiati ene la, dzi na mi.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖewo do wo ɖokui ɖe dzi, abe ɖe nyemegale mia gbɔ va ge o ene.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Ke ne Aƒetɔ la lɔ̃ la, mava mia gbɔ kpuie, eye nyemele, madze si amesiwo do wo ɖokui ɖe dzi la ƒe nyawo o, ke woƒe ŋusẽ boŋ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Elabena menye nya mee mawufiaɖuƒe la le o, hafi ŋusẽ me boŋ wòle.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Nuka dim miele? Ɖe matso ali ava mia gbɔ loo, alo matsɔ lɔlɔ̃ kple dɔmefafa ƒe gbɔgbɔ la ava mia gbea?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Wose mia ŋkɔ keŋ bena, ahasiwɔwɔ le mia dome, eye ahasiwɔwɔ ma tɔgbe mele trɔ̃subɔlawo dome hã o bena, amea ɖe xɔ fofoa srɔ̃.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Eye miawo la mieɖo mia ɖokui ɖe dzi, eye miefa konyi boŋ, bene woaɖe amesi wɔ nusia la ɖa le mia dome o mahã?

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: bene miatsɔ ame ma ade asi na Satana, bene wòagblẽ eƒe ŋutilã, ne woaxɔ eƒe gbɔgbɔ le Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Miaƒe adegbeƒoƒo menyo o. Mienyae bena, amɔwɔ ʋaʋã via ɖe nana amɔwɔ blibo la katã ʋãna o mahã?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Eyata mitsɔ amɔwɔ ʋaʋã xoxo la ƒu gbe, bene mianye amɔwɔ yeye, abe alesi míenye amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã ene; elabena wowu míaƒe ŋutitotolẽvi, si nye Kristo la hã.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Eyata mina míaɖu ŋutitotoŋkekenyuie, menye le amɔwɔ ʋaʋã xoxo me o, eye menye le vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ kple nu tovo wɔwɔ ƒe amɔwɔ ʋaʋã me o, hafi le dzadzɛnyenye kple nyateƒe ƒe amɔwɔ maʋãmaʋã la me boŋ.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Meŋlɔe na mi le agbalẽ la me bena, migaɖe ha kple ahasiwɔlawo o.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Ke menye xexe sia me ahasiwɔlawo alo ŋubiãlawo alo adzodalawo alo trɔ̃subɔlawo mewɔnɛ kura o, anye ne ɖeko miadzo le xexeame.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ la meŋlɔ na mi bena, miagade ha kple amea ɖe, si ne woyɔnɛ be nɔvi, wònye ahasiwɔla alo ŋubiãla alo trɔ̃subɔla alo busubɔla alo ahamula alo adzodala la o, migaɖu nu kple nenem me sia hã o.

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo le egodo la, Mawu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu woawo. Miɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖa le mia ŋuta mia dome!

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Alo ne mia dome amea ɖe he nya ɖe xɔlɔ̃via ŋuti la, ado dzi be, yeahee ayi ʋɔnu ɖe ame madzɔmadzɔwo ŋku me, eye menye ame kɔkɔewo ŋku me o mahã?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Mienyae bena, lãme kɔkɔewo le ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge xexeame oa? Eye nenye miawo dzi wòato adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexeame la, ɖe miedze na nya suewo dɔdrɔ̃ oa?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Mienyae bena, miadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mawudɔlawo oa, ʋuu keke wòahayi agbe sia me nuwo nye gea?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Azɔ la ne agbe sia me nyadɔdrɔ̃a ɖe le mia si la, mietsɔ amesiwo woɖoa vlo le ha me la boŋ ɖo ʋɔnudrɔlawoe!

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Ŋukpedodo mi ta megblɔe ɖo! A, vavãe, nunyalaa ɖeke mele mia dome oa? Ɖeka hɔ̃ meli, si ate ŋu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le nɔviawo dome oa?

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: Ke nɔvi hea nɔvi yia ʋɔnu boŋ, eye wòwɔa esia le dzimaxɔsetɔwo ŋku me.

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ esia menyo na mi kura o bena, nyadɔdrɔ̃wo le mia dome ɖe mia nɔewo ŋuti. Nukaŋuti miena wowɔ vɔ̃ ɖe mia ŋuti boŋ oa? Nukaŋuti miena woba mi boŋ oa?

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Alo mienyae bena, ame madzɔmadzɔwo manyi mawufiaɖuƒe la ƒe dome oa? Migana woable mi o: Ahasiwɔla wo kple trɔ̃subɔlawo kple matrewɔlawo kple hadzelawo kple ŋutsu, siwo dɔna kple ŋutsuwo,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: kple fiafitɔwo kple ŋubiãlawo kple ahamulawo kple busubɔlawo kple adzodalawo la womanyi mawufiaɖuƒe la ƒe dome o.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Eye nenem mia dome amea ɖewo nɔ tsã; ke wole tsi na mi, ke wona mia ŋuti kɔ, ke wotso afia na mi le Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ la kple mia Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la me.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mɔ nam, ke menye nuwo katãe nyona na ame o. Woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mɔ nam, ke menye nyee le nana ge nane nakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dzinye o.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu li na ƒodo, eye ƒodo hã li na nuɖuɖu; gake Mawu aɖe esia kple ekeme siaa ɖa. Ke ŋutilã meli na ahasiwɔwɔ o, hafi Aƒetɔ la tɔe, eye Aƒetɔ la hã ŋutilã tɔe boŋ.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu fɔ Aƒetɔ la ɖe tsitre, eye wòatsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ afɔ miawo hã ɖe tsitre.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mienyae bena, miaƒe ŋutilãwo la Kristo ƒe ŋutinuwo wonye o mahã? Aleke lawɔ matsɔ Kristo ƒe ŋutinuwo awɔ ahasiwɔla ƒe ŋutinuwo mahã? Gbeɖe!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mienyae bena, amesi tsɔ eɖokui lé ɖe ahasiwɔla ŋuti la, eya kplii enye ŋutilã ɖeka oa? Elabena wogblɔ bena: „Wo kpakple eve la woanye ŋutilã ɖeka.“

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Ke amesi tsɔ eɖokui lé ɖe Aƒetɔ la ŋuti la, eya kplii enye gbɔgbɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Misi le ahasiwɔwɔ nu! Nuvɔ̃ sia nuvɔ̃, si ame wɔna la, menye eƒe ŋutilã me wòle o, ke ahasiwɔla wɔa vɔ̃ ɖe ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã ŋuti.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mienyae bena, miaƒe ŋutilã la Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe, si le nua me, si miexɔ tso Mawu gbɔ la ƒe xɔ wònye, eye míenye mia ɖokui to oa?

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Asi sesẽ miexɔ; eyata mitsɔ miaƒe ŋutilã kple miaƒe gbɔgbɔ, siwo nye Mawu to la, kafu Mawu!

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Nusi ŋuti mieŋlɔ nya nam le la, mebe: Enyo na ame bena, wòagade asi nyanu ŋu o.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Ke le ahasiwɔwɔwo ŋuti la nyanu nane ŋutsu sia ŋutsu si, eye ŋutsu nanɔ nyɔnu sia nyɔnu si.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu nawɔ nusi dzɔ la, na srɔ̃a, eye nyɔnu hã nawɔ na srɔ̃a nenema ke.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi o, negbe srɔ̃ŋutsu la ko; ke nenema ke ŋutsu hã mekpe ŋusẽ ɖe ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi o, negbe nyɔnu la ko.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Migagblẽ mia nɔewo ɖi o, negbe ne wo kpakple eve lɔ̃ halase ɣeyiɣia ɖe dzi hafi, bena miakpɔ asinu ado gbe ɖa, eye nusia megbe la miagava awɔ ɖeka, bene Satana nagate mi akpɔ le miaƒe ɖokuidzimaɖumaɖu la ŋuti o.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Ke mele esia gblɔm le mɔnana nu, eye menye le sedede nu o.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: Elabena mele didim bena, amewo katã nanɔ anyi, abe alesi nye hã mele ene; gake amesiame kpo ye ŋutɔ ƒe amenuvevenuna tso Mawu gbɔ, amea ɖeka kpɔ esi, eye ame bubu hã kpɔ bubu.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ke megblɔ na trewo kple ahosiwo bena, ne woano abe alesi nye hã mele ene la, ekema anyo na wo.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Ke ne womate ŋu aɖu wo ɖokui dzi o la, woaɖe srɔ̃, elabena srɔ̃ɖeɖe nyo wu fieŋufieŋu.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Ke mede se na srɔ̃tɔwo — hafi menye nyee o, ke Aƒetɔ lae boŋ — be, nyɔnu nagagbe srɔ̃a o.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Ke ne egbee la, nenɔ anyi srɔ̃maɖemaɖee, alo negawo ɖeka kpakple srɔ̃ŋutsu la; eye ŋutsu hã nagagbe srɔ̃a o.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Ke ame mamlewo la, nyee le egblɔm na wo — menye Aƒetɔ lae o — bena, ne nyɔnu, si mexɔ se o la, le nɔvia ɖe si, eye wòdze nyɔnua ŋu bena, yeana egbɔ la, negagbee o.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Eye ne ŋutsu, si mexɔ se o la, le nyɔnua ɖe si, eye wòdze ŋutsua ŋu be, yeanɔ egbɔ la, negagbe ŋutsu la o.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋutsu, si mexɔ se o la, ŋuti kɔ le srɔ̃a me, eye nyɔnu, si mexɔ se o la, hã ŋuti kɔ le ŋutsua me; ɖe menye nenem o la, ne mia viwo anye ame makɔmakɔwo, ke azɔ la wole kɔkɔe.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Ke ne amesi mexɔ se o la, gbe srɔ̃a la, negbee faa! Nɔviŋutsu alo nɔvi nyɔnu la menye kluvi le nya siawo ƒomevi me o. Ke Mawu yɔ mí le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Elabena wò nyɔnu, aleke nènyae bena, ale ŋu axɔ srɔ̃wò ɖe agbe mahã? Alo wò ŋutsu, aleke nènyae bena, ate ŋu axɔ srɔ̃wo ɖe agbe mahã?

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Negbe alesi Aƒetɔ la ma na amesiame la alesi Mawu yɔ amesiamee la, nenema ke woazɔ, eye nenema ke meɖo le hawo katã me.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Ne woyɔ amea ɖe, si nye aʋatsotsotɔ la, negahe aʋayi tsyɔ edzi o, ne woyɔ amea ɖe le aʋamatsomatso me la, nagatso aʋa o.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Aʋatsotso la menye naneke o, eye aʋamatsomatso hã menye naneke o, ke Mawu ƒe sedziwɔwɔ enye nu la.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Amesiame nanɔ yɔyɔ, si wotsɔ yɔe la me tututu.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Ne enye kluvi woyɔ la, negave wò o; ke ne ate ŋu azu ablɔɖevi la, wɔ eŋuti do boŋ.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi woyɔ wònye kluvi le Aƒetɔ la me la, enye Aƒetɔ la ƒe ablɔɖevi, nenema ke amesi woyɔ wònye ablɔɖevi la, enye Kristo ƒe kluvi.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Asi sesẽe miexɔ, migazu amewo ƒe kluviwo o.

english_verse: Stay what you were when God chose you. Unmarried People
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, nusi me woyɔ amesiame le la, nenɔ eya me le Mawu ƒe ŋku me!

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Ke ɖetugbiwo la, nyemexɔ asea ɖeke tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ le wo ŋuti o, gake maɖo aɖaŋu na wo, abe amesi kpɔ nublanuikpɔkpɔ tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ, bene manye nuteƒewɔla la ene.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Azɔ mesusu bena, esia nyo le hiãkame, si gbɔna fifi la ŋuti bena, enyo na ame be, wòanɔ anyi nenema.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe wòbia wò ɖe nyɔnu ŋuti la, megadi etutu o; ke ne wotu wò le nyɔnu ŋuti la, megadi srɔ̃ o.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Ke ne eɖe srɔ̃ hã la, mèwɔ nuvɔ̃ o; eye ne ɖetugbi ɖe srɔ̃ la, mewɔ nuvɔ̃ o; ke nenem me siawo akpɔ xaxa le ŋutilã me. Ke nye la ɖe mekpɔ mia nublanui.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Ke esia gblɔm mele, nɔviwo, bena ɣeyiɣi la le kpuie; eyata azɔ la amesiwo si nyɔnu le la, manɔ abe ɖe ɖeke mele wo si o ene;

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: eye amesiwo wɔa xexe sia me ŋuti dɔ la, nanɔ abe ɖe womelé eŋuti dɔ wɔm o ene; elabena xexe sia me ƒe nɔnɔme nu va yina.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke mele didim be, miagakpɔ fuɖeɖea ɖeke o. Amesi meɖe srɔ̃ o la, léa be na nusiwo nye Aƒetɔ la tɔ la, alesi wòawɔ adze Aƒetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu, si ɖe srɔ̃ la, léa be na xexemenuwo, alesi wòawɔ adze nyɔnu la ŋu, eye wòle evedomesi.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Nenema ke nyɔnu, si ɖe srɔ̃ la, kple ɖetugbi hã wole, nyɔnu, si si srɔ̃ mele o la, léa be na nusiwo nye Aƒetɔ la tɔ la, bena wòanɔ kɔkɔe le ŋutilã kple gbɔgbɔ la me; ke nyanu, si ɖe srɔ̃ la, léa be na xexe sia me nuwo, alesi wòawɔ adze ŋutsu la ŋu.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Ke megblɔ esia le mia ŋutɔwo miaƒe viɖe ta, menye bene maɖe mi kple ka o; ke boŋ bene mianɔ kɔnuwɔwɔ nyui kple Aƒetɔ ŋunɔnɔ tututu dzi, alesi dze, eye naneke nagahe mi ɖa o.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe susu be, yemawɔ nyuie ɖe yeƒe ɖetugbi ŋuti o, nenye be, ele srɔ̃ɖeɖe me tom, eye ne ele vevie azɔ be, wòaɖe srɔ̃ la, ekema nusi dim wòle la, newɔe: mewɔ nuvɔ̃ o, nena wòaɖe srɔ̃.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Eyata amesi tso eƒe ɖetugbi na woɖe la, wòe nyuie; ke amesi metsɔe na woɖe o la, awɔe nyuie awu.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Se la bla nyɔnu, ŋkeke alesi srɔ̃a le agbe la, gake nenye be, ŋutsua ku la, ekema evo bena, wòaɖe amesi ke wòlɔ; negbe ɖeko woawɔe le Aƒetɔ la me.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Ke nenye be, enɔ anyi nenema srɔ̃maɖemaɖee la, woayrae awu le nye tamesusu nu. Ke mebuna bena, Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la le nye hã menye.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Ke le trɔ̃wo ƒe vɔsawo ŋuti la mienyae bena, sidzedze li na mi katã. Sidzedze la doa ame ɖe dzi, ke lɔlɔ̃ la tua ame.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe susu bena, yedze si nane la, ekema medze si alesi wòdze be, wòadze sii la haɖe o.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe lã Mawu la, ekema Mawu dze si eyama.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Azɔ mienya le trɔ̃wo ƒe vɔsawo ɖuɖu la ŋuti bena, trɔ̃a ɖeke mele xexe sia me o, eye bena, mawu bubua ɖeke hã meli o, negbe ɖeka hã koe li.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Ke nenye nusiwo woyɔna be mawuwo li hã, eɖanye le dziƒo alo anyigba dzi o, abe alesi mawu geɖewo kple aƒetɔ geɖewo li ene la;

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: gake la Mawu ɖeka, si nye Fofo, amesi me nuwo katã tso, eye miawo mieli nɛ la, kple Aƒetɔ ɖeka, si nye Yesu Kristo, amesi me nuwo katã to va, eye miawo mieto eyama me la, li na mi.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Ke menye amewo katã mee sidzedze sia le o; ke amea ɖewo li, siwo ƒe tamesusuwo gale trɔ ŋuti vaseɖe egbegbe sia, eye woɖunɛ abe trɔ̃wo ƒe vɔsa ene, eye esi woƒe dzitsinya gbɔdzɔ ŋuti la, eyata woƒo ɖii.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Ke nuɖuɖu mawɔ mi bubu le Mawu ƒe ŋku me o, elabena nenye be, míeɖua nu la, míezua gã wu o, eye nenye be, míeɖua nu o la, míezua sue wu o.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Ke mikpɔ nyuie, bena miaƒe ŋusẽ nagazu nukikli na ame gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo o.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ke nenye amea ɖe kpɔ wò amesi si sidzedze le la, nèbɔbɔ nɔ trɔ̃xɔ me le nu ɖum la, menye ɖee ma nède dzi ƒo na amesi gbɔdzɔ la ƒe dzitsinya, bene wòaɖu trɔ̃wo ƒe vɔsawo o mahã?

english_verse: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Eye nɔvi, si gbɔdzɔ, amesi ta Kristo ku ɖo la, atsrɔ̃ le wò sidzedze la ŋuti.

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Ke ne miewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe mia nɔviwo ŋuti ale, eye miede abi woƒe dzitsinya, si gbɔdzɔ ŋuti la, ekema miewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe Kristo ŋuti.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Eyata ne nuɖuɖu ɖia nɔvinye nu la, ekema nyemele lã ɖu ge gbeɖegbeɖe akpɔ o, bene nyemagana nɔvinye nu o.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyemenye apostolo oa? Ɖe nyemenye ɖokuisime oa? Ɖe nyemekpɔ Yesu Kristo, mía Aƒetɔ la oa? Menye miawoe nye nye dɔwɔwɔ le Aƒetɔ la me oa?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Ne nyemenye apostolo na ame bubuwo o hã la, menyee na mi; elabena miawoe nye nye apostolonyenye ƒe nutrenu le Aƒetɔ la me.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Ɖokuinye la ʋiʋli ɖe amesiwo drɔ̃a ʋɔnum la ŋuti enye esi.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe míekpɔ ŋusẽ be, míaɖu nu, eye míano nu oa?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe miekpɔ ŋusẽ bena, míakplɔ nɔvinyɔnu, si anye mía srɔ̃ la, anɔ nugbe yim, abe alesi apostolo bubuawo kple Aƒetɔ la nɔviwò kpakple Kefa hã wona ene oa?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mia kple Barnaba ɖeɖekoe mekpɔ ŋusẽ bena, miagawɔ dɔ oa?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Ameka gɔ̃e woa aʋawɔvi ƒe do, eye wòxea fe na eɖokui? Alo ameka gɔ̃e dea weingble, eye meɖua eƒe kutsetse oa? Alo amekae nyia lãha, eye menoa lãha la ƒe notsi oa?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Elabena woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe segbalẽa me bena: „Megabla nu na nyitsu, si le mɔli tugum la o!“ A, nyitsu ƒe nue le Mawu nu vema?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Alo menye mia ŋuti pete wogblɔe ɖo oa? Mía ta woŋlɔe ɖo bena, amesi ŋlɔa nu la, naŋlɔe le mɔkpɔkpɔ me; eye amesi tugua mɔli la, natugui le mɔkpɔkpɔ me, bena wòakpɔ gome le eme!

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Ne míeƒã gbɔgbɔ me nuwo na mi, eye míexa miaƒe ŋutilãnuwo la, nu gã wònyea?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Ne ame bubuwo kpɔ ŋusẽ sia ƒe gome ɖe mia dzi la, ɖe miawo míekpɔe wu woawo o mahã? Gake miewɔa ŋusẽ sia ŋuti da o, hafi míetsɔa wo katã kpoo boŋ, bene míagaxe mɔ na Kristo ƒe nyanyuie la o.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae bena, amesiwo woa kɔkɔeƒe ƒe dɔwo la, kɔkɔeƒe ƒe nuwo woɖuna, eye amesiwo subɔna le vɔsamlekpui ŋuti la, vɔsamlekpui ƒe nuwo me wokpɔa wo tɔ nua tsonɛ oa?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Nenema ke Aƒetɔ la ɖo na amesiwo gblɔa nyanyuie fiana la bena, woakpɔ agbemenuwo tso nyanyuie la me.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Ke nye la nyemewɔ nusiawo ƒe ɖeke ŋuti dɔ kpɔ o; eye nyemeŋlɔ nusiawo, bene woawɔ nenema nam o; elabena ne meku la, anyo nam awu esi amea ɖe naɖi gbɔ nye kafukafu.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Elabena ne megblɔ nyanyuie fia la, menye kafukafu nam o, elabena ele nam kokoko be, mawɔe; elabena nenye be, nyemegblɔ nyanyuie la fia o la, baba nam!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mewɔ esia kple lɔlɔ̃nu la, fetu te eme nam; ke ne nyemewɔe kple lɔlɔ̃nu o la, wotsɔ xɔnuvidɔ de asi nam.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Azɔ ɖe, nukae nye nye fetua? Eyae nye bena, nye amesi le nyanyuie la gblɔm la, mana fetu naganɔ nyanyuie la ŋuti o, bene nyemagawɔ nye ŋusẽ la ŋuti do le nyanyuie lã ŋuti o.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Elabena ne menye ɖokuisime, si vo tso amewo katã gbɔ hã la, metsɔ ɖokuinye wo amewo katã ƒe dɔla, bene asinye nasu ame geɖeawo dzi;

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: eye mezu abe Yudatɔ ene hena Yudatɔwo, bena asinye nasu Yudatɔwo dzi; eye mezu abe amesi le sea te ene hena amesiwo le sea te, wònye nye ŋutɔ nyemele sea te hafi o, bene asinye nasu amesiwo le sea te la dzi;

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: mezu abe semanɔsitɔ ene hena semanɔsitɔwo, gake la nyemenye semanɔsitɔ na Mawu o, ke mele Kristo ƒe se la me boŋ, bene asinye nasu semanɔsitɔwo dzi.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Mezu gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔ na gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo, bene asinye nasu gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo dzi; amewo katã mezu nusianu na, bene maɖe wo dome amea ɖewo kokoko.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Ke nyanyuie la ta mewo wo katã ɖo, bene nye hã makpɔ gome le eme. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le ʋiʋli le dziɖuɖufetu la tu ŋuti.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Klo mienyae bena, amesiwo le duɖime kem le dusiƒe la, wo katãe kenɛ hafi, gake ame ɖeka koe xɔa dziɖuɖufetu la o mahã? Mike duɖime nenema, ne miaƒe asi nasu edzi!

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ke amesiame, si le kame tem la, eɖɔa ŋu ɖo le nusianu me; ame mawo wɔa nenema, bene woƒe asi nasu dziɖuɖukuku, si gblẽna la dzi; ke miawo la, esi megblẽna o la dzi.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti azɔ nye la mele dudime kem ale, bena nyemele ɖikeke me o, eye mele kɔ dam ale, bena nyemedaa dadagbo o;

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: hafi meƒoa nye ŋutilã wòdoa ʋusrã, eye mewɔnɛ kluvi boŋ, bene esi menye gbeƒãɖela na ame bubuwo la, nye ŋutɔ la nyemagazɔ ame madzemadze o.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemele didim be, miaganyae o, noviwò, bena mía fofowo katã nɔ alilikpo la te, eye wo katã woto ƒu la me,

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: eye wode mawutsi ta na wo katã ɖe Mose me le alilikpo kple ƒu la me.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Eye wo katã woɖu gbɔgbɔ me nuɖuɖu ma ke.

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: Eye wo katã wono gbɔgbɔ me nunono ma ke, elabena wono tso gbɔgbɔ me kpe gbadza, si dze wo yome la me: ke kpe gbadza lae nye Kristo.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Gake wo dome ame gedeawo ƒe nu menyo Mawu ŋu o, elabena woxlã wo de anyi le gbeadzi.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Ke nusiawo zu kpɔdeŋu na mí, bene miaganyenu vɔ̃ɖi dzrolawo, abe alesi wòdzro ame mawo ene la o.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Migazu trɔ̃subɔlawo hã abe wo dome amea ɖewo ene o, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Dukɔ la bɔbɔ nɔ anyi, wòdu nu, eye wono nu, eye wotsi tre, eye wode asi fefe me.“

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Migana miawo ahasi, abe alesi wo dome amea ɖewo wo ahasi, eye ame akpe blave vɔ etɔ̃ tsra le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi ene la o.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mo na ame, ke menye nuwo katãe nyona na ame o; woɖe nuwo katã ƒe mɔ na ame, ke menye nuwo katãe doa ame ɖe ŋgɔgbe o.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Migana miate Kristo akpɔ, abe alesi wo dome amea ɖewo tee kpɔ fe ye dawo tsrɔ̃ wo ene la o.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Migali liʋiliʋi, abe alesi wo dome amea ɖewo li liʋiliʋi, eye nugblẽla tsrɔ̃ wo ene la o.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Ke nusiawo katã va ame mawo dzi abe kpɔɖeŋu ene, eye woŋlɔe ɖi, bene wòanye nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena mí amesiwo dzi xexe sia me ƒe nuwuwu va ɖo la.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Eyata amesi ke susuna be, yele tsitre la, nakpɔ nyuie, bena wòagadze anyi o.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Tetekpɔa ɖeke meva mia dzi kpɔ o negbe ame tɔ ɖeɖeko, gake nuteƒewɔla enye Mawu, amesi mana mɔ bena, woate mi akpɔ awu alesi miate ŋui la o; ke ana gododo le eme hã akpe ɖe tetekpɔ ŋuti, bene miate ŋu atsɔe.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Eyata, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, misi le trɔ̃subɔsubɔ la nu! Le nuɖuɖu kɔkɔe ŋuti.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo mele egblɔm na — mibu nusi gblɔm mele la me kpɔ:

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Yayrakplu, si míeyrana la, menye Kristo ƒe ʋu la ƒe hadedee o ɖe? Eye abolo, si míekana la, menye Kristo ƒe ŋutilã ƒe hadedee o ɖe?

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Elabena abolo ɖekae, ŋutilã ɖeka mi ame geɖewo míenye, elabena mí katã mieɖua abolo ɖeka la ƒe ɖe.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ŋutilãnu Israel ɖa! Menye amesiwo ɖua vɔsawo la, nye vɔsamlekpui la ƒe hadelawo oa?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nuka gblɔm mele? Ɖe mebena, trɔ̃ enye nu loo, alo trɔ̃ ƒe vɔsasa enye nua?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Hafi boŋ mele gbɔgblɔm bena, nusi trɔ̃subɔlawo mèna la, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo womèa wo na, eye menye Mawu o; ke nyemele didim bena, miade ha kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo o.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Miate ŋu ano Aƒetɔ la ƒe kplu, agano gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe kplu hã o; miate ŋu akpɔ gome le Aƒetɔ la ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋuti, agakpɔ gome le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋuti hã o.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Alo ɖe miana Aƒetɔ la naʋã ŋua? Ɖe míesesẽ wui mahã? Le beléte na dzitsinya ŋuti.

english_verse: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke nagadi ye ŋutɔ tɔ o, ke nusi nye ame bubu ta la boŋ.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Nusianu, si wodzrana le lãƒleƒe la, miɖui faa, eye migabia eta se le dzitsinya ŋuti o.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Elabena anyigba la kple nusiwo katã yɔ edzi la, nye Aƒetɔ la tɔ.

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Ke ne dzimaxɔsetɔwo dome amea ɖe kpe mi, eye mielɔ̃ be, yewoayi la, miɖu nusianu, si wotsɔ ɖo mia kɔme la, eye migabia eta se o le dzitsinya ŋuti.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Ke menye mia ŋutɔwo ƒe dzitsinyae mewɔnɛ o, ke ame keme to boŋ; elabena nukaŋuti ame bubu ƒe dzitsinya adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu nye ablɔɖenyenye ma?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Ne metsɔ akpedada ɖu nu la, nukaŋuti woagblɔ busunya ɖe ŋutinye le nusi ta meda akpe ɖo la ŋuti mahã?

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Azɔ la ne miele nu ɖum alo miele nu nom alo miele dɔa ɖe wɔm la, miwɔ ye katã na Mawu ƒe kafukafu,

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Migazu nukikli na Yudatɔwo kple Helatɔwo kple Mawu ƒe hame la o;

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: abe alesi nye hã mele ɖiɖim bena, madze amewo katã ŋu le nusianu me, eye nyemedia nusi nyo na nye ŋutɔ o, ke nusi nyo na ame geɖeawo boŋ, bene woakpe agbexɔxɔ la ene.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Mizu srɔ̃nyelawo, abe alesi nye hã menye Kristo-srɔ̃la ene.

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Ke mele mia kafum, nɔviwò, bena mieɖoa ŋku dzinye le nusianu me, eye mielé nyaɖoɖoawo me ɖe asi, abe alesi meɖo na mi la ene.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Ke mele ɖiɖim bena, mianyae bena, ŋutsu sia ŋutsu ƒe ta enye Kristo, ke nyɔnu ƒe ta enye ŋutsu, ke Kristo ƒe ta enye Mawu.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu sia ŋutsu, si doa gbe ɖa alo gblɔa nya ɖi, eye wòtsyɔ nu ta la, edoa ŋukpe eƒe ta.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnu sia nyɔnu, si doa gbe ɖa alo gblɔa nya ɖi, eye mebia ta o la, edoa ŋukpe eƒe ta, elabena ele abe ɖe wòlũ ta ene.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Elabena ne nyɔnu mebia ta o la, na ne wòako ta keŋ! Ke ne enye ŋukpe na nyɔnu be, wòako ta alo wòalũi la, ekema nebia ta.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Hafi ŋutsu la negatsyɔ nu ta o; elabena Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme kple eƒe bubu wònye, ke nyɔnu enye ŋutsu ƒe bubu.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋutsu metso nyɔnu me o, hafi nyɔnu boŋ ye tso ŋutsu me.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Elabena womewɔ ŋutsu le nyɔnu ta o, hafi wowɔ nyɔnu le ŋutsu ta boŋ.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Eyata ele na nyɔnu bena, wòakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe eƒe ta dzi le mawudɔlawo ŋuti.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Gake srɔ̃nyɔnu mele Aƒetɔ la me ŋutsu manɔmee o, eye srɔ̃ŋutsu hã mele Aƒetɔ la me nyɔnu manɔmee o.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Elabena abe alesi nyɔnu tso ŋutsu me la, nenema ke ŋutsu hã to nyɔnu me va; ke esiawo katã tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Midrɔ̃e le mia ŋutɔwo mia ɖokui me kpɔ, ɖe wòdze be, nyɔnu, si mebia ta o la, nado gbe ɖa na Mawu mahã?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnu la, ne ɖa legbe li nɛ la, enye bubu nɛ; elabena wotsɔ ɖa legbe nɛ ɖe nutsyɔnu teƒe.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Ke ne enyo amea ɖe ŋu be, yeanye dzretɔ la, gake miaƒe nuwɔnawo mele nenem o, eye Mawu ƒe hameawo hã nenema ke. Le alesi edze be, woaɖu nuɖuɖu kɔkɔe la ŋuti.

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Ke esi mede se sia na mi ta, nyemate ŋu akafu mi o bena, mieva kpea ta, menye bena mianye awu o, ke boŋ bene miagblẽ ɖe dzi awu.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Elabena gbã la, ne mieƒo ƒu ɖe hame la ƒe takpekpe me la, mesena bena, mamãwo naa mia dome, eye mexɔa ɖewo dzi sena.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Elabena ele vevie bena, kɔmamãwo hã naɖo mia dome, bene amesiwo li ke la, nadze ƒã le mia dome.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame tsɔa ye ŋutɔ ƒe nuɖuɖu heɖuna gbã le nuaɖuƒe, ɖɔ nɔa amea ɖe wum, ke ame bubu mua aha.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Elabena zi alesi míeɖua abolo sia, eye mienoa nu le kplu sia nu la, miele gbe ƒã ɖem Aƒetɔ la ƒe ku, halase esime wòava va.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ɖunɛ alo nonɛ madzemadze la, eɖua, eye wònoa ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ na eɖokui, elabena mebu Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutilã me kpɔna o.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Nenema ke wòtsɔ kplu le nuɖuɖu la megbe hegblɔ bena: „Esiae nye nubabla yeye ƒe kplu le nye ʋu me; miwo esia, zi alesi mianoe la, ne miatsɔe aɖo ŋku dzinye.“

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Elabena nye la, nusi mexɔ tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ la, metsɔ de asi na mi bena, Aƒetɔ Yesu le zã, si me wofiã eyome mɔ la, etso abolo ɖe asi,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: eye esi wòda akpe le eta la, èŋe eme gblɔ bena: „Mixɔe ɖu, esiae nye nye ŋutilã, si woŋe le mia ta; miwo esia, ne miatsɔe aɖo ŋku dzinye.“

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Eyata amesi ke ɖua abolo sia, alo noa nu le Aƒetɔ la ƒe kplu sia nu madzemadze la, aɖi fɔ le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutilã kple nu la ŋuti.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ke ame naɖo eɖokui akpɔ, eye ale wòaɖu abolo sia ƒe ɖe, eye wòano nu le kplu sia nu.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Esia ŋuti mia dome ame geɖe ƒe lãme gbɔdzɔ, eye amewo le dɔ lém, eye ame geɖewo ku.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖe mieɖu mia ɖokui me kpɔ la, anye ne womele ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge mi o.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Ke ne wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi la, Aƒetɔ la hea to na mi, bene womagabu fɔ mi kple xexeame zi ɖeka o.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Eyata, nɔviwò, ne mieva kpe ta le nu ɖu ge la, ekema milala mia nɔewo.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Ke ne ɖa le amea ɖe wum la, neɖu nu le aƒe me, bene miagava kpe ta hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ o. Ke ne meva la, maɖo nusiwo susɔ la.

english_verse: My friends, you asked me about spiritual gifts.
translation_verse: Ke le gbɔgbɔ me nunanawo ŋuti la, nɔviwò, nyemele didim be, mianye ame manyanuwo o.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Mienyae bena, trɔ̃subɔlawo míenye tsã, eye miena wohe mi yi ɖe trɔ̃ maƒonuwo gbɔ, abe alesi wokplɔ mi ene.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Eyata mana mianyae bena, amesi le nu ƒom le Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ me la, ɖeke megblɔa busunya ɖe Yesu ŋuti o; eye amea ɖeke mate ŋu ayɔ Yesu be Aƒetɔ o, negbe le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la me ko.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ke amenuvevenunana bubu ƒomeviwo li, gake Gbɔgbɔ ma kee,

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: eye subɔsubɔdɔ bubu ƒomeviwo li, gake Aƒetɔ ma kee.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Eye ŋusẽdɔ bubu ƒomeviwo li, gake Mawu ma ke, si wɔa dɔwo katã le amewo katã me lae.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Ke wotso Gbɔgbɔ ƒe ɖeɖefia na amesiame, bene wòanyo na amewo katã.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Elabena woto Gbɔgbɔ la dzi tso nunya ƒe nya na amea ɖe, ame bubu la sidzedze ƒe nya le Gbɔgbɔ ma ke nu,

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: ame bubu la xɔse le Gbɔgbɔ ma ke me; ame bubu la dɔyɔyɔ ƒe amenuvevenunanawo le Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka ma me;

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: ame bubu la nukudɔwɔwɔwo, ame bubu la nyagbɔgblɔɖi, ame bubu la gbɔgbɔwo dodokpɔ, ame bubu la gbegbɔgblɔ bubu ƒomeviwo, ame bubu la gbe bubu ƒomeviwo ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe;

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: gake Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka mao wɔa nusiawo katã, eye wòmã nu na amesiame wo tɔxɛ wo tɔxɛ, abe alesi wòlɔ̃na ene.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Elabena Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka me wode mawutsi ta na mí katã le, bena mianye ŋutilã ɖeka, míeɖanye Yudatɔwo alo Helatɔwo o, míeɖanye kluviwo alo ablɔɖeviwo o, eye wotsɔ Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka kpe na mi katã.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋutilã hã menye ŋutinu ɖeka o, ke ŋutinu geɖe boŋ.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe afɔ lagblɔ be: Esi nyemenye asi o la, eyata nyemenye ŋutilã ƒe ɖe o la; ekem ɖe eyaŋuti menye ŋutilã ƒe ɖe oa?

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Eye nenye de to lagblɔ be: Esi nyemenye ŋku o la, eyata nyemenye ŋutilã ƒe ɖe o la; ekem ɖe eyaŋuti menye ŋutilã ƒe ɖe oa?

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutilã blibo la katã nye ŋku la, afika nusese anɔ? Ne ŋutilã blibo la katã nye nusese la, afika ʋeʋẽsese anɔ mahã?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la Mawu tsɔ ŋutinuwo dome ɖesiaɖe ɖo ŋutilã ŋuti, abe alesi wòlɔ ene.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Ke ne wo katã nye ŋutinu ɖeka la, afika ŋutilã la anɔ?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la ŋutinu geɖewo li, gake ŋutilã ɖeka hɔ̃ koe.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Ŋku mate ŋu agblɔ na asi bena: Wò koe mele ŋunye o, alo ta hã mate ŋu agblɔ na afɔwo bena: Miawo koe mele ŋunye o.

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ŋutilã ŋutinu, siwo wobuna bena, wogbɔdzɔna wu la, woawoe hiãna wu;

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: eye ŋutilã ŋutinu, siwo míebuna bena, bubu mele wo ŋu o la, míedea bubu gã wo ŋu wu, eye mia ŋutinu, siwo menya kpɔm, o la, woawoe xɔa nusiwo nya kpɔna wu.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Ke mia ŋutinu, siwo nya kpɔna la, megahiã naneke o. Ke Mawu wɔ ŋutilã heɖoe teƒeteƒe, eye wòtso bubu gã wu na suetɔ la,

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: bene mamãa ɖeke naganɔ ŋutilã me o, ke ŋutinuwo nalé be na wo nɔewo sɔsɔe boŋ.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Eye ne ŋutinu ɖeka le fu kpem la, ŋutinuwo katã kpea fu nɛ ti, eye ne wode bubu ŋutinu ɖeka ŋu la, ŋutinuwo katã kpɔa dzidzɔ nɛ ti.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la Kristo ƒe ŋutilã míenye, eye mia dome ɖesiaɖe nye ŋutinu.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Eye Mawu ɖo amea ɖewo le ha me: Gbãtɔ apostolowo, evelia nyagblɔɖilawo, etɔ̃lia nufialawo, emegbe la ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔwo, eya megbe la dɔyɔyɔ ƒe amenuvevenunanawo, kpeɖeŋutɔwo, dzikpɔlanyenyewo, gbegbɔgblɔ bubu ƒomeviwo.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Ã, wo katãe nye apostolowoa? Ã, wo katãe nye nyagblɔɖilawoa? Ã, wo katãe nye nufialawoa? Ã, wo katã si ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔ léa?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Ã, wo katãe kpɔ dɔyɔyɔwo ƒe amenuvevenunanawoa? Ã, wo katãe gblɔa gbe bubu ƒomeviwoa? A, wo katãe ɖea nya gɔmea?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Midi amenuvevenunana nyuitɔwo vevie, eye hekpe ɖe esia ŋuti la mafia mɔ nyuitɔ mi!

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe metso amewo kple mawuɖɔlawo ƒe gbegbɔgblɔwo ƒoa nu, ke lɔlɔ̃ mele asinye o la, anye ne mele abe ayawagba, si ɖina alo abe gaƒoƒo, si ɖina la ene.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Eye nenye ɖe nyagbɔgblɔɖi le asinye, eye menya nya ɣaɣlawo katã kple sidzedze katã, eye nenye ɖe xɔse katã le asinye, ale bena mate ŋu aɖe towo ɖa, ke lolo mele asinye o la, anye ne nyemenye naneke o.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Eye nenye ɖe megblẽ nye nuwo katã henyi ame dahewo, eye nenye ɖe metsɔ nye ŋutilã na, bene woafiãm, ke lɔlɔ̃ mele asinye o la, anye ne nyemenyo na naneke o.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: mewɔa nusi medze o, media ye ŋuta tɔ o, mebia dzi o, mebua naneke vɔ̃ o;

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: medzɔa dzi le nu madzɔmadzɔ ŋuti o, ke eya kple nyateƒee dzɔa dzi.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ la nu metsina gbeɖe o; Nenye nyagbɔgblɔɖiwo la, woaɖe wo ɖa, nenye gbegbɔgblɔwo la, woadzudzɔ, nenye sidzedze la, woaɖee ɖa.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Elabena mienyaa nu afã kple afã, eye miegblɔa nya ɖi afã kple afã.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Ke ne nu blibo la va va la, ekem woaɖe nusiwo nye afãafãwo la ɖa.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Esime menye vi la, meƒo nu abe vi ene, eye mesusu abe vi ene, eye mebu tame abe vi ene; ke esime mezu ŋutsu la, meɖe ɖevimenuwo ɖa.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
