translation_verse: Elabena azɔ la míekpɔa nu le ahũhɔ̃e me le abebubu me, ke emegbe la ŋku me kple ŋku me; azɔ la medze si nu afã kple afã, ke emegbe la madze si nu keŋ, abe alesi wodze sim keŋ la ene.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la xɔse kple mɔkpɔkpɔ kpakple lɔlɔ̃, nu etɔ̃ siawo nɔa anyi; ke lɔlɔ̃ la ƒo wo katã ta.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Miti lɔlɔ̃ yome; ke midi gbɔgbɔ me nuwo vevie: vevietɔ bena miagblɔ nya ɖi.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi tsɔa gbegbɔgblɔ ƒoa nu la, meƒoa nu na amewo o, ke na Mawu boŋ; elabena amea ɖeke mesene o, ke gbɔgbɔ me wòle nya ɣaɣlawo gblɔm le;

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: ke amesi le nya gblɔm ɖi la, eƒoa nu na amewo hegblɔa amedoɖeŋgɔgbenya, nuxlɔ̃menya kple akɔfafanyawo.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Amesi tsɔa gbegbɔgblɔ ƒoa nu la, edoa eɖokui ɖe ŋgɔgbe; ke amesi le nya gblɔm ɖi la, edoa hame la ɖe ŋgɔgbe.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Ke mele didim bena, mi katã miatso gbegbɔgblɔwo aƒo nu; ke mele didim wu be, miagblɔ nya ɖi; elabena amesi gblɔa nya ɖi la, ewu amesi tsoa gbegbɔgblɔwo ƒoa nu la sa, negbe ɖeko wòaɖe egɔme, bene hame la nakpe ŋgɔgbedede.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, nɔviwò, nenye ɖe meva mia gbɔ tsɔ gbegbɔgblɔwo le nu ƒom la, viɖe ka wòanye na mi, ne menye ɖe maƒo nu na mi le nyaɖeɖefia me alo sidzedze me alo nyagbɔgblɔɖi me alo nufiafia me o mahã?

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Nenema ke nu agbe manɔme, siwo ɖina, nenye dze alo saŋku, ne woƒe ɖiɖi meto vovo o la, aleke woadze si nusi wokuna alo nusi woƒona mahã?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Elabena ne kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖime mekɔ o la, ameka ladzra eɖokui ɖo na aʋa la mahã?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Nenema ke miawo hã, ne mietso aɖe gblɔ nya, si me mekɔ o la, aleke woadze si nusi miegblɔ la? Elabena mianye amesiwo le nu ƒom ɖe ya me.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne nyemese gbea ɖe o la, manye fiafiala na amesi le nu ƒom la, eye amesi le nu ƒom la hã anye fiafiala nam.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Nenema ke miawo hã, esi míenye veviedolawo le gbɔgbɔwo ŋuti la, midi vevie bena, miagba go hena hame la ƒe ŋgɔgbedede.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Eyata amesi tsoa gbegbɔgblɔ ƒoa nu la, nado gbe da, bene woade gɔme hã.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Elabena ne metsɔa gbegbɔgblɔ doa gbe ɖa la, nye gbɔgbɔ la doa gbe ɖa, gake nye tamesusu metsea ku o.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Azɔ la alekee? Mado gbe ɖa kple gbɔgbɔ, ke mado gbe ɖa kple tamesusu hã; madzi ha kple gbɔgbɔ, ke madzi ha kple tamesusu hã.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Elabena ne èle akpe dam kple gbɔgbɔ la, aleke lawɔ, amesi le numanyamanyatɔ nɔƒe la, agble amen aƒu wò akpedada dzi, esi menya nusi nègblɔ la o mahã?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Elabena wò la eda akpe nyuie, gake mèdo ame bubu la de ŋgɔgbe o.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawu bena, metsɔa gbegbɔgblɔ gblɔa nya wu mi katã.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Ke ne mele ha me la, mele didim bena, matso nye tamesusu agblɔ nya atɔ̃, bene mafia nu ame bubuwo hã awu esi matsɔ gbegbɔgblɔ agblɔ nya akpe ewo.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, migazu viwo le nyasã me o, ke mizu vidzĩewo le nu tovo wɔwɔ me boŋ, ke nyasã me la mizu ame tsitsiwo.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe segbalẽa me bena: „Matsɔ ame bubuwo ƒe aɖewo kple ame bubuwo ƒe nuyiwo aƒo nu kple dukɔ sia, eye nenema hã womaɖe tom o; Aƒetɔ la gblɔe.“

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Eyata gbegbɔgblɔwo nye dzesi, menye na xɔsetɔwo o, ke na dzimaxɔsetɔwo boŋ; gake nyagbɔgblɔɖi mele na dzimaxɔsetɔwo o, ke na xɔsetɔwo boŋ.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Azɔ la nenye hame blibo la katã va kpe ta ɖe afi ɖeka, eye amewo katã tsɔ gbegbɔgblɔ ƒo nu, eye numanyamanyatɔwo alo dzimaxɔsetɔwo ava ge ɖe eme la, womagblɔ bena, tsu kum miele o mahã?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Ke nenye wo katã gblɔa nya ɖi, eye dzimaxɔsetɔ alo numanyamanyatɔa ɖe va ge ɖe eme la, wo katã woaƒo nya ɖe enu wòagloe, eye wo katã woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui,

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: eye eƒe dzimenya ɣaɣlawo adze ƒã, eye ale wòatsɔ mɔ atsyɔ anyi, eye wòado gbe ɖa na Mawu, eye wòaɖe gbe ƒã bena, Mawu le mia dome vavã.

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Azɔ la alekee, nɔviwò? Ne mieva kpe ta la, hadzidzi kple nufiafia kple gbegbɔgblɔ kple nyaɖeɖefia kple gɔmeɖeɖe le mia dome amesiame si; woawo nuwo katã hena ŋgɔgbedede!

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Nenye be, amea ɖe tsɔ gbegbɔgblɔ ƒo nu la, woanye ame eve alo ƒã la ame etɔ̃, eye woaƒo nu ɖekaɖeka, eye ame ɖeka naɖe egɔme.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Ke nenye be, gɔmeɖela meli o la, nezi ɖoɖoe le ha la me: ke neƒo nu na ye ŋutɔ ɖokui kple Mawu.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ke nyagblɔɖilawo la ame eve alo ame etɔ̃ nagblɔ nya ɖi, eye ame mamleawo nabu eme kpɔ.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Ke nenye be, woɖe nya fia ame bubu, si bɔbɔ nɔ anyi la, gbãtɔ la nazi ɖoɖoe.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Elabena mi katã miate ŋu agble nya ɖi ɖekaɖeka, bene wo katã nasrɔ̃ nu, eye woaxlɔ̃ nu wo katã.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Eye nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe gbɔgbɔwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui na nyagblɔɖilawo.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu menye nyamanyamawɔwɔ ƒe Mawu o, ke ŋutifafa ƒe Mawu boŋ.

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: Abe alesi wòle le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe hawo katã me ene la, miaƒe nyɔnuwo nazi ɖoɖoe le takpekpewo me, elabena womeɖe mɔ na wo bena, woaƒo nu o; ke woaɖo to boŋ, abe alesi se ta gblɔ ene.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Ke ne wole didim be, yewoasrɔ̃ nane ta, mina woabia woawo ŋutɔ srɔ̃wo le aƒe me, elabena medze nyɔnuwo bena, woaƒo nu le takpekpe me o.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mia mee mawunya dzɔ tsoa? Alo miawo ɖeɖe gbɔ wòva loo?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe bua eɖokui nyagblɔɖila alo gbɔgbɔmeme la, nedze si nusiwo meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi la bena, Aƒetɔ la ƒe sededewoe.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe medze sii o la, negadze sii o!

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Eyata, nɔviwo, midi nyagbɔgblɔɖi vevie, eye migagbe gbebɔgblɔ o.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Mina woawɔ nuwo katã, alesi dze ɖe eteƒeteƒe.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Ke, nɔviwo, mena mienya nyanyuie, si megblɔ fia mi, si miexɔ hã, esi me míetsi tre ɖo hã,

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: si me woxɔ mi ɖe agbe le hã, ne mielée ɖe asi, abe alesi metsɔ nyanyuie la gblɔ fia mi ene la; anye ne miexɔ edzi se dzodzo.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Elabena nusi nye hã mexɔ la, metsɔ de asi na mi gbãgbiagbã bena, Kristo ku le mia nuvɔ̃ ŋuti le ŋɔŋlɔ la nu,

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: eye bena woɖii, eye bena wogafɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe le ŋɔŋlɔ la nu,

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: eye bena ede eɖokui fia Kefa, emegbe la ame wuieve la.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Eya megbe la eɖe eɖokui fia nɔvi, siwo wu ame alafa atɔ̃ la zi ɖeka, amesiwo dome geɖeawo le agbe vaseɖe fifi, ke amea ɖewo hã ɖɔ alɔ̃.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Emegbe la eɖe eɖokui fia Yakobo, emegbe da apostolowo katã.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Wo katã megbe la eɖe eɖokui fia nye hã abe fu gegee ene.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Elabena nye enye suetɔ le apostoloawo dome, amesi medze be, woayɔ be apostolo o, elabena meli Mawu ƒe hame la yome.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ƒe amenuveve la ŋuti mezu nusi menye, eye eƒe amenuveve, si wotsɔ ve nunye la, menye dzodzro o, elabena medze agbagba geɖe wu wo katã; ke menye nyee o, hafi Mawu ƒe amenuveve, si le kpakplim la boŋ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Azɔ la eɖanye nyee o, eɖanye ame kemewo o, nenema ke míeɖe gbe ƒã, eye nenema ke míexɔe se.

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Ke ne woɖe gbe ƒã Kristo bena, etsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome la, aleke wo mia dome amea ɖewo gblɔ bena, ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsia ɖeke meli o mahã?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsia ɖeke meli o la, ekema Kristo hã metsi tre o.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Ke ne Kristo metsi tre o la, ekema miaƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe enye dzodzro, eye miaƒe xɔse hã enye dzodzro.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Ke woakpɔ mi abe Mawu ƒe aʋatsoɖaseɖilawo hã ene, elabena míeɖi ɖase ɖe Mawu ŋuti bena, efɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre, amesi mefɔ ɖe tsitre hafi o, nenye be, ele me vavã bena, womefɔ ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre o la.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖe womefɔa ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre o la, anye ne Kristo hã metsi tre o.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Ke ne Kristo metsi tre o la, miaƒe xɔse enye yaka, eye miegale miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Ekema amesiwo dɔ alɔ̃ le Kristo me la, hã tsrɔ̃.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ne míekpɔ mɔ na Kristo le agbe sia me ɖeɖeko la, ekema míenye nublanuitɔwo wu amewo katã.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la Kristo tsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye wòzu amesiwo dɔ alɔ̃ la dome ŋgɔgbetɔ.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena esi wònye ame mee ku la to va ŋuti la, ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi la hã to ame ke me va.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Elabena alesi amewo katã ku le Adam me la, nenema ke woagbɔ agbe wo katã hã le Kristo me.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Gake amesiame le ye ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoɖo nu: Gbãtɔ enye Kristo; emegbe la amesiwo le Kristo me le eƒe vavagbe la;

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: emegbe la nuwuwu la ava, esime woatsɔ fiaɖuƒe la ade asi na Mawu Fofoa, esime wòava aɖe amegãnyenye katã kple ŋusẽ katã kple dziɖuɖu katã ɖa la.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Elabena ele ne be, wòaɖu fia, halase esime woatsɔ eƒe futɔwo katã ade eƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Futɔ mamletɔ, si woaɖe ɖa la, enye ku.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena etso nuwo katã de eƒe afɔ te. Ke ne egblɔ bena, wotsɔ nuwo katã de ete la, edze ƒã bena, amesi tso wo katã de ete la, mele eme o.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Ke ne wotsɔ nuwo katã de ete la, ekema Vi la ŋutɔ hã atsɔ eɖokui ade amesi tso nuwo katã de ete la te, bene Mawu nanye wo katã le wo katã me.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Elabena nuka wotu amesiwo na wode mawutsi ta na wo le ame kukuwo ta lale? Ne womafɔ ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre kura o la, nuka wona wode mawutsi ta na wo le woamawo ta mahã?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Nukaŋuti miawo hã míeɖoa ŋɔdzi me le gaƒoƒo sia gaƒoƒo mea?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Meta miaƒe kafukafu, si le asinye le Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ me la bena, gbesiagbee mekuna.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Nenye ame ƒe susu nue mewo aʋa kple lã wɔadãwo le Efeso la, ekema viɖe ka wònye nam? Ne womefɔ ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre o la, ekema „minɛ míaɖu nu, eye miano nu, elabena etso miele kuku ge!“

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Migana woable mi o! Habɔbɔ vɔ̃wo gblẽa nuwɔna nyuiwo.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Mizu mo xexee tɔwo vavã, eye migawɔ nuvɔ̃ o! Elabena simadzemadze Mawu le amea ɖewo me; ŋukpedodo mi ta megblɔe ɖo.

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ke ɖewo amea ɖe agblɔ be: Aleke ame kukuwo le fɔfɔ ge ɖe tsitre mahã? Eye ŋutilã ka wole tsɔtsɔ ge adoe mahã?

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Wò bometsila, nusi nèƒã la, magbɔ agbe o, negbe ɖeko woaku hafi.

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: Eye nusi nèƒãna la, menye nɔnɔme blibo, si le dzɔdzɔ ge lae nèƒã o, hafi nuku gbɔloa ɖe, eɖanye bli alo nu mamleawo dometɔa ɖe o.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu na nɔnɔmee, alesi wòlɔ̃, eye nukuwo dome ɖesiaɖe la etsɔ nuku la ŋutɔ ƒe nɔnɔme nɛ.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Menye lãwo katãe nye lã ɖeka ƒomevi o: ke amegbetɔwo ƒe lã le vovo, lãfɔnewo ƒe lã le vovo, tɔmelãwo ƒe lã le vovo, xeviwo ƒe lã le vovo.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Eye dziƒoŋutilãwo li, eye anyigba dzi ŋutilãwo hã li; gake dziƒotɔwo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le vovo, eye anyigbadzitɔwo tɔ le vovo.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Ye ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le vovo, eye ɣleti ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe hã le vovo, eye ɣletiviwo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe hã le vovo; elabena vovo le ɣletivi kple ɣletivi dome le ŋutikɔkɔe gome.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi hã le: Woƒãa nu le gbegblẽ me, eye woafɔe ɖe tsitre le magblẽmagblẽ me;

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Woƒãa luʋɔŋutilã, eye woafa gbɔgbɔŋutilã ɖe tsitre. Luʋɔŋutilã li, eye gbɔgbɔŋutilã hã li.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Nenema ke woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Ame gbãtɔ, Adam la, zu luʋɔ gbagbe;“ Adam mamletɔ la zu gbɔgbɔ, si na agbe.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Ke menye gbɔgbɔmetɔ enye gbãtɔ o, hafi luʋɔtɔ la boŋ, emegbe la gbɔgbɔmetɔ la.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Ame gbãtɔ, si tso anyigba me la, enye anyigbadzitɔ, ame evelia enye Aƒetɔ si tso dziƒo la.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Alesi ke anyigbadzitɔa le la, nenema ke anyigbadzitɔwo hã le; alesi ke dziƒotɔa le la, nenema ke dziƒotɔwo hã le;

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: eye alesi anyigbadzitɔa ƒe nɔnɔme le mia ŋu la, nenema ke dziƒotɔa ƒe nɔnɔme hã nanɔ mia ŋu.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Ke mele esia gblɔm, nɔviwo, bena ŋutilã kple ʋu mate ŋu anyi mawufiaɖuƒe la ƒe dome o, eye gbegblẽ mate ŋu anyi magblẽmagblẽ ƒe dome o.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ɖa, mele nya ɣaɣla gblɔm na mi: Mí katã miele alɔ̃ dɔ ge o; gake woatrɔ mí katã míaƒe nɔnɔme,

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: kasia le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me, le kpẽkuku mamlea me; elabena woaku kpẽ, eye woafɔ ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre magblẽmagblẽ, eye míawo la woatrɔ miaƒe nɔnɔme.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Elabena ele be, nu gbegblẽ sia nado magblẽmagblẽ, eye nu kuku sia nado makumaku.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Ke esime nu gbegblẽ sia lava ɖo magblẽmagblẽ, eye nu kuku sia lava ɖo makumaku la, ekema nya, si woŋlɔ ɖi la, ava ve me bena: „Womi ku le dziɖuɖu me.“

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: Wò ku, afika wò ti la le? Wò tsieƒe, afika wò dziɖuɖu la le?

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Elabena ku ƒe ti enye nuvɔ̃, ke nuvɔ̃ ƒe ŋusẽ enye se la.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Ke woada akpe na Mawu, si na dziɖuɖu mi to mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi la!

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Eyata, nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, minɔ te sesĩe, maʋãmaʋã, eye migba go ɖaasi le Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me, esi mienyae bena, miaƒe agbagbadzedze menye dzodzro le Aƒetɔ la me o ŋuti la.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Ke le nudzɔdzɔ na ame kɔkɔeawo ŋuti, alesi meɖoe na Galatia-hamewo la, nenema ke miawo hã miwɔ.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Kwasiɖa ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la mia dome amesiame natsɔ nane adzra ɖo ɖi vovo ɖe ye ŋutɔ gbɔ, eye wòaƒo enu ƒu le eƒe viɖekpɔkpɔ nu, bena menye ne meva la, hafi woadze nudzɔdzɔ gome o.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Ke ne meva va la, matsɔ agbalẽwo aɖe asi na amesiwo ke míekpɔ be, wodze la, aɖo wo ɖa, ne woatsɔ miaƒe nunana ayi Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Ke nenye be, edze bena, nye hã mayi la, ekema woayi kplim.

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Ke ne metso Makedonia la, mava mia gbɔ, elabena mato Makedonia.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Ɖewo matsi mia gbɔ ʋee, alo ɖewo mana anyi, halase esime vuvɔŋɔli nu nayi mahĩ, bene miaɖom ɖa ayi afisiafi, si mayi ɖo la.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Elabena nyemele didim bena, makpe mi fifi le mɔzɔzɔ me o; elabena mele mɔ kpɔm bena, ne Aƒetɔ la ɖe mɔ nam la, matsi mia gbɔ ʋee.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Ke matsi Efeso yiɖase Pentekoste dzi.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Elabena woʋu ʋɔtru gã, si na da geɖe la nam, eye adikãtɔ geɖewo li. Alesi woaxɔ Timoteo.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ke ne Timoteo va la, mikpɔ nyuie, bena wòagavɔ̃ le mia gbɔ o, elabena ewɔa Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔ la abe nye ke ene.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Eyata amea ɖeke magado vloe o! Ke miɖoe ɖa le ŋutifafa me boŋ, bene wòava gbɔnye, elabena mele eya kple nɔviawo lalam.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Ke le nɔvi Apolo ŋuti la, meɖe kuku nɛ ŋutɔ bena, eya kple nɔviawo nayi mia gbɔ, eye menye eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu kura be, yeava mia gbɔ fifi o, ke ne ekpɔ asinu nyui la, ava. Nuxɔxlɔ̃wo.

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Minɔ ŋudzɔ, minɔ tsitre le xɔse me, miwo ŋutsu, eye mise ŋu!

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nuwo katã le lɔlɔ̃ me!

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Mele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwò — mienya Stefana ƒe aƒe la bena, eyae nye ŋgɔgbetɔ le Axaya, eye bena, woɖo wo ɖokui ame kɔkɔewo subɔlawo —

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: bena miawo hã miatso mia ɖokui ade nenem me siawo kpakple amesiame, si woa do kpli mi, eye wòdzea agbagba la te.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dzidzɔ le Stefano, Fortunato kple Axaiko ƒe vava la ŋuti; elabena esi mieli kplim o la, amesiawoe xɔ ɖe mia teƒe.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Elabena wona mia kple miaƒe gbɔgbɔ la gbɔ ɖe eme; eyata midze si nenem me siawo. Ɖuɖɔ kple agbalẽ la ƒe nuwuwunyawo.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asia-hameawo ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã! Akwila kple Priskila kpakple hame, si le woƒe aƒe me la, ɖuɖɔ mi vevie ŋutɔ le Aƒetɔ la me!

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo katã ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã! Mitsɔ nugbugbɔ kɔkɔe gbugbɔ nu na mia nɔewo!

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Ɖuɖɔ, si nye Paulo metsɔ nye asi ŋlɔe la, enye esi.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe melɔ̃ Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo o la, nezu busu! Aƒetɔ la gbɔna!

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Paulo, Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolo to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, kple nɔvi Timoteo woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Mawu ƒe hame, si le Korinto, kple ame kɔkɔe, siwo katã le Axaya blibo la katã:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, mia Fofo, kple mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi!

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu, mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo, si nye dɔmetɔtrɔ Fofo kple akɔfafawo katã ƒe Mawu la,

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: amesi fa akɔ na mi le míaƒe xaxa blibo la katã me, bene míawo hã míate ŋu atsɔ akɔfafa, si Mawu tsɔ fa akɔ na mí la, afa akɔ na amesiwo kpea fu sia fu la;

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: elabena alesi Kristo ƒe fukpekpewo so gbɔ ŋutɔ va mía dzi la, nenema ke miekpɔa akɔfafa hã sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ to Kristo dzi.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Ke nenye ɖe míexaxa la, miaƒe akɔfafa kple xɔxɔ, si sẽa ŋu le fukpekpe, siwo ke míawo hã míekpena ƒe dzidodo me la tae; alo nenye ɖe wofa aka na mí la, miaƒe akɔfafa kple xɔxɔ tae.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Eye míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ li ke le mia ŋuti, esi míenyae bena, alesi míekpɔa gome le fukpekpewo me la, nenema ke miekpɔa gome le akɔfafa me hã la ŋuti.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, míele didim be, miaƒe xaxa, si miekpɔ le Asia la, nanɔ manyamanya na mi o, bena wowɔ fu mí geɖe ŋutɔ, wu alesi míete ŋu kpee, ale gbegbe be, míetsi dzodzodzoe keŋ le míaƒe agbe ŋuti.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Ẽ, mía ŋutɔwo mieɖo kpe dzi le mía dokui me bena, míele kuku ge, bene miagaɖo dzi ɖe mía ɖokui ŋu o, hafi ɖe Mawu, amesi fɔa ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre la ŋu boŋ,

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: amesi ɖe mi tso nenem ku gã sia me, eye wogale mía ɖeɖe dzi, eye míele mɔ kpɔm nɛ bena, agaɖe mí hã.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Esi miawo hã míetsɔa miaƒe kukuɖeɖe kpena ɖe mía ŋuti, bene ame geɖe nada akpe le mía ta le amenuvevenunana, si ame geɖe ƒe kukuɖeɖe na wòsu mia si la ŋuti.

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Elabena miaƒe adegbeƒoƒo enye esi: Míaƒe dzitsinya ƒe ɖase, si wòɖina bena, miezɔ le xexe sia me le Mawu ƒe dzimekɔkɔ kple dzi dzadzɛ me, eye menye ŋutilã ƒe nunya me o: ke le Mawu ƒe amenuveve me boŋ, vevietɔ le mia dome.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Elabena mieŋlɔ nya bubu na mi o, negbe nusi miexlẽ alo miedze si hã; ke mele mɔ kpɔm bena, miadze sii yiɖase nuwuwu,

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: abe alesi miedze si mí afã kple afã bena, míenye miaƒe adegbeƒoƒo, abe alesi miawo hã míenye mia to le mia Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkekea dzi la ene. Nusi ta Paulo megayi Korinto o.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: eye bena mato mia gbɔ ayi Makedonia, eye magagbugbɔ tso Makedonia agava mia gbɔ, bena miaɖom ɖa mayi Yudea.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Azɔ esi meɖo esia ɖe tame la, ɖe mewɔe le amefuflu mea? Alo nusi meɖo ɖe ta me la, ɖe meɖoe le ŋutilã nu bena, ẽ nanye ẽ, eye o nanye o le gbɔnye mahã?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Ke Mawue nye nuteƒewɔla, bena miaƒe nya, si miegblɔ na mi la, menye ẽ kple o o.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe Vi, Yesu Kristo, amesi woɖe gbe ƒã le mia dome to mi, amesiwo nye nye, Silvano kple Timoteo dzi la, menye ẽ kple o o, hafi enye ẽ le eyama me boŋ.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe ŋugbedodowo, alesi nu wole la, Yesu me ẽ le; eyaŋuti amen la to eya hã dzi hena Mawu ƒe kafukafu to mia dzi.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Ke amesi li ke mia kple miawo ɖe Kristo me, eye wòsi ami na mí la, enye Mawu;

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: amesi tre mia nu hã, eye wòna Gbɔgbɔ ƒe a wɔbanu mí le míaƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Ke nye la meyɔ Mawu, ne woanye ɖaseɖila na nye luʋɔ bena, esi mekpɔ miaƒe nublanui la ŋutie nyemeva Korinto haɖe o,

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: menye bena, mieɖua aƒetɔ ɖe miaƒe xɔse dzi o, ke míenye hadɔwɔlawo na miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ; elabena miele tsitre le xɔse me.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Ke nye ŋutɔ meɖo tame bena, magatsɔ nuxaxa ava mia gbɔ o.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Elabena ne nye la mena míexa nu la, amekae nye amesi ado dzidzɔ nam, negbe amesi kekeake mena wòxa nu lae?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Eye meŋlɔ esia ke na mi bena, ne meva la, magakpɔ nuxaxa tso amesiwo ŋuti makpɔ dzidzɔ le hafi la gbɔ o, esi meɖo dzi ɖe mi katã mia ŋu bena, nye dzidzɔ enye mi katã mia tɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Elabena le fukpekpe geɖe kple dzimexaxa me metsɔ adatsi geɖe ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi, menye bene wòana miaxa nu o, hafi bene miadze si lɔlɔ̃, si metsɔ lɔ̃ mi vevie wu la.

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe na ame xa nu la, menye nyee wòna mexa nu o, ke boŋ mia dome amea ɖewo — nyemagblɔ be, mi katãe o, bene nyemagate eyama ɖe to akpa o. —

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Nenem me sia la tohehe, si mia dome ame geɖeawo mienae la, sɔ gbɔ nɛ;

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: eyata azɔ la mitsɔe kee, eye mifa akɔ nɛ ɖe eteƒe boŋ, bene nuxaxa geɖe akpala nagami nenem me sia o.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Eyata mele nu xlɔ̃m mi bena: Mina miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ nu nasẽ ɖe eyama dzi.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Elabena eyata meŋlɔ na mi, bene madze si miaƒe kelili, abe ɖe míeɖoa to le nusianu me ene.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ke amesi ke mietsɔ nane ke la, nye hã metsɔe kee, elabena nye hã, ne matsɔ nane ke la, metsɔe ke le mia ta Me Kristo ƒe ŋku me,

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Ke esi meva Troa Kristo ƒe nyanyuie gblɔ ge, eye woʋu ʋɔtru nam le Aƒetɔ me la,

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: nyemekpɔ dzudzɔ le nye gbɔgbɔ me o; elabena nyemekpɔ nɔvinye Tito o, ke boŋ meklã wo, eye meto dzi yi Makedonia.

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Ke woada akpe na Mawu, si nana mieɖua dzi ɖaasi le Kristo me, eye wòɖe eƒe sidzedze ƒe ʋeʋẽ lilili la ɖe go fia to mía dzi le afisiafi.

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Elabena miele abe ame geɖe, siwo baɖa Mawu ƒe nya la ene o; ke boŋ abe vavãnyenye me kple Mawu me mietsɔnɛ tsonɛ gblɔa nya le Mawu ƒe ŋku le le Kristo me ene.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Ɖe míegade asi mia ɖokui kafukafu mea? Alo ɖe ehiã mi, abe amea ɖewo ene bena, miatsɔ kafukafugbalẽ vɛ na mi alo miaxɔ kafukafugbalẽ le mia si mahã?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Miawoe nye míaƒe agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖe miaƒe dziwo me, si amewo katã nya, eye woxlẽnɛ;

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: elabena edze ƒã bena, míenye Kristo ƒe agbalẽ, si wotsɔ míaƒe subɔsubɔdɔ wɔe, si wometsɔ agbalẽŋlɔtsi ŋlɔe o, ke boŋ Mawu gbagbe ƒe Gbɔgbɔ lae wotsɔ ŋlɔe; womeŋlɔe ɖe nuŋlɔkpewo dzi o, ke ɖe nuŋlɔkpe, siwo nye ŋutilã ƒe dziwo la dzi boŋ.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Ke dziɖoɖo ɖe Mawu ŋu sia le mia si to Yesu dzi:

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Menye bena miede enu le mia ɖokui si, be miasusu nane abe mia ŋutɔwo mía ɖokui mee wòtso ene o; ke mía nudede la tso Mawu gbɔ boŋ,

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: amesi hã wo mi miedze be, mianye nubabla yeye ƒe subɔlawo, menye agbalẽŋlɔdzesi tɔwo o, hafi Gbɔgbɔ tɔwo boŋ. Elabena agbalẽŋlɔdzesi la wua ame, ke Gbɔgbɔ la gbɔa agbe ame.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Ke ne ku ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ, si le agbalẽŋlɔdzesiwo me, si woŋlɔ ɖe kpewo dzi la, kpɔ ŋutikɔkɔe ale gbegbe bena Israel-viwo mete ŋu lé ŋku ɖe Mose ƒe ŋku me le eƒe ŋku me ŋutikɔkɔe, si nu tsi la ŋuti o la,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: aleke Gbɔgbɔ ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ manɔ ŋutikɔkɔe me geɖe awu o mahã?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Elabena ne ŋutikɔkɔe li na fɔbubu ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ la, ekema dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ gbã go geɖe wu le ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Elabena nusi ŋutikɔkɔe li na la hã ŋuti meka o le esia gome be, ekeme ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒo eta sa.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Ke ne ŋutikɔkɔe li na nusi nu tsina la, ekema nusi nɔa anyi la, anɔ ŋutikɔkɔe me geɖe awu sã.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi mɔkpɔkpɔ sia le mia si ŋuti la, míewɔa dzideƒo geɖe ŋuti dɔ le nuƒoƒo me,

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: eye míewɔna abe Mose, amesi tso motsyɔnu tsyɔ mɔ, bene Israel-viwo nagakpɔ nusi nu tsina ƒe nuwuwu o la ene o;

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: ke wona woƒe tamesusuwo sẽ. Elabena vaseɖe egbegbe sia la nutsyɔnu sia gale nubabla xoxo ƒe xexlẽ la dzi, eye womekloe o, elabena woɖenɛ ɖa le Kristo me.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Ke vaseɖe egbegbe sia la ɣesiaɣi, si ke woxlẽa Mose la, nutsyɔnu tsyɔa woƒe dziwo dzi.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke ɣesiɣi woatrɔ le woƒe dzi me ava Aƒetɔ la gbɔ la, woaɖe nutsyɔnu la ɖa.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la enye Gbɔgbɔ la, ke afisi Aƒetɔ ƒe Gbɔgbɔ le la, afima ablɔɖe le.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Ke mí katã mietso ŋku, si wometsyɔ nui o la, kpɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe abe ahũhɔ̃e me ene, eye wotrɔa míaƒe nɔnɔme ɖe nɔnɔme ma ke me tso ŋutikɔkɔe me yi ɖe ŋutikɔkɔe me, abe alesi wòtso Gbɔgbɔ ƒe Aƒetɔ la gbɔ ene.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Eyata esi subɔsubɔdɔ sia le mía si, abe alesi míekpɔ nublanuikpɔkpɔ ene la, ɖeɖi mete mia ŋu o.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ke míegbea ŋukpenanu ɣaɣlawo boŋ, eye miezɔna le aɖaŋu vɔ̃ me o, eye miebaɖa mawunya hã o, hafi boŋ mietsɔa nyateƒe ƒe ɖeɖefia ɖea mía ɖokui fiãa amewo katã ƒe dzitsinya le Mawu ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Ke ne wotsyɔ nu miaƒe nyanyuiea dzi la, ekema amesiwo tsrɔ̃ la ƒe ŋku me wotsyɔ nui le,

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: amesiwo dome xexe sia me mawu gbã ŋku na dzimaxɔsetɔwo ƒe tamesusu le la, bene Kristo, si nye Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme la, ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nyanyuie la ƒe kekeli nagaklẽ na wo o.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Elabena mieɖea gbe ƒã mía ɖokui o, ke boŋ Kristo Yesu, bena eyae nye Aƒetɔ la, ke míawo míenye subɔlawo le Yesu ŋuti,

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: elabena Mawu, si gblɔ be: Kekeli nado tso viviti me la, enye amesi klẽ ɖe míaƒe dziwo me, bene Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe sidzedze ƒe kekeli naklẽ le Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Ke kesinɔnu sia le mia si le anyigoewo me, bene ŋusẽ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ, si gbã go la, nanye Mawu tɔ, eye menye mía gbɔ woatso o;

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: womimi mí ɖo le go sia go me, gake gbɔgbɔtsixe metsi mía ƒo o: míetsi dzodzodzoe, gake míebu ŋuɖoɖo keŋ o;

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: woti mia yome, gake womegblɔ mi ɖi o; woxlã mi ɖe anyi, gake wometsrɔ mi o.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Elabena ɣeawokatãyi me wotsɔ mi, amesiwo le agbe la, de asi na ku le Yesu ŋuti, bene Yesu ƒe agbe nado ɖe mía ŋutilã, si nye nu kuku la me.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Eyata ku la sẽa ŋu le mia me: ke agbe la le mia me.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ke esi xɔse ƒe gbɔgbɔ ma ke le mía si la ŋuti, abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Mexɔe se, eyata meƒo nu ɖo“ la; míawo hã míexɔna sena, eyata míegblɔa nya hã;

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: elabena mienya bena, amesi fɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu ɖe tsitre la, afɔ míawo hã kple Yesu, eye wòatsɔ mia kpli mi siaa atu tsitre afia.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Elabena wowɔ wo katã le mia ta, bene amenuveve, si sɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi to ame geɖeawo dzi la, nana akpedada la nagba go hena Mawu ƒe kafukafu.

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Eyata ɖeɖi metea mia ŋu o: ke ne miaƒe gotame gblẽna hã la, míaƒe ememe la zua yeye gbesiagbe.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Elabena míaƒe aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me xaxa, si nu mesena o la, woa ŋutikɔkɔe mavɔ, si nu sẽna ŋutɔ, eye wòƒoa nusianu ta sãsãsã la, na mí,

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: esi míeléa ŋku ɖe nusiwo wokpɔna la ŋu o, ke nusiwo womekpɔa o la boŋ ŋuti mieléa ŋku ɖo. Elabena nusiwo wokpɔna la, mesena yina o; ke nusiwo womekpɔna o la, nɔa anyi tegbetegbe.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Elabena mienyae bena, ne wogbã miaƒe agbadɔxɔ, si nye anyigbadzitɔ la, xɔtutu, si tso Mawu gbɔ la, anɔ mía si — xɔ, si wometso asi wɔe o, si nɔa anyi tegbetegbe le dziƒo la.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Elabena esia me mieŋena le hã, eye wòle mía dzrom bena, woatsɔ mía nɔƒe, si tso dziƒo la, ado na mí;

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: ne ele ale bena, ne wotsɔ awu ɖo na mí, womakpɔ mi amama o la.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Elabena mí amesiwo le agbadɔ me la, mieŋena, esi agba le mía kpem la ŋuti; elabena míele didim bena, woaɖe awu le mia ŋu o, ke boŋ bena, woaɖo awu na mi, bena agbe la nami nusi kuna la.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Ke amesi dzra mi ɖo na esia la, enye Mawu, amesi na Gbɔgbɔ ƒe awɔbanu hã mi.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Eyata dzi le mía ƒo ɖaasi, eye míenyae bena, ne míele aƒe le ŋutilã me la, míeɖo aƒe le Aƒetɔ la gbɔ haɖe o. —

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: Elabena miezɔna le xɔse me, eye menye le nukpɔkpɔ me o. —

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke dzi le mia ƒo, eye wòdze mia ŋu wu be, míadzo le ŋutilã me, eye miana aƒe le Aƒetɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Eyata mieɖoa vevie bena, aƒee míeɖale o, alo mɔtae míeɖale o, míadze eŋu.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Elabena ele na mí katã bena, miatsɔ mía ɖokui afia le Kristo ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui la ŋgɔ, bene amesiame naxɔ nu ɖe alesialesi wòwɔ le ŋutilã me nɔnɔ me la nu, nenye nyuie alo vɔ̃.

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi míenya Aƒetɔ la vɔvɔ̃ la, míeƒoa nya ɖe amewo nu, ke míedze ƒã le Mawu ƒe ŋku me; ke mele mɔ kpɔm bena, míedze ƒã le miaƒe dzitsinya me hã.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Miegale mía ɖokui kafum na mi o; ke miana asinukpɔkpɔ mi, nena míate ŋu aƒo adegbe le mia ŋuti, bena adegbeƒoƒo nanɔ mia si ɖe amesiwo ƒoa adegbe le ŋku me, eye menye le dzi me o la ŋuti.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Elabena ne míaƒe tame da la, eda na Mawu; ne tame nyui li na mí la, mia tae.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: eye míedzro eme kpɔ kpɔ esia bena, esi ame ɖeka ku ɖe amewo katã ta, eyata amewo katã ku. Eye wòku ɖe wo katã ta, bene amesiwo le agbe la, naganɔ agbe na wo ɖokui o, ke ne woanɔ agbe hena amesi ku, eye wògatsi tre le wo ta la boŋ.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Eyata tso esia dzi la míenya amea ɖeke le ŋutilã nu o; ne míenya Kristo gɔ̃ le ŋutilã nu hã la, azɔ la miegale enyam nenema o.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Eyata ne amea ɖe le Kristo me la, eya nye nuwɔwɔ yeye: Xoxotɔ la nu va yi, kpɔ ɖa, nuwo katã zu yeye!

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Ke wo katã tso Mawu gbɔ, amesi lé avu le mía kple eɖokui dome to Yesu Kristo dzi, eye wòna avuléle ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ mí.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu enye amesi nɔ Kristo me lé avu le xexeame kple eɖokui dome, eye mebu woƒe vodadawo na wo o, eye wòtsɔ avulénya la de mia me.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ míenye ame dɔdɔwo le Kristo teƒe, abe alesi Mawu le nu xlɔ̃m to mía dzi ene, eye míeɖea kuku le Kristo teƒe bena: Mina woalé avu le mia kple Mawu dome!

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi menya nuvɔ̃a ɖeke o la, ewɔe ne wòanye nuvɔ̃ ɖe mia teƒe, bene míawo la míazu Mawu ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye le eyama me.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Esi míenye hadɔwɔlawo ŋuti la, míele nu xlɔ̃m mi hã bena, miagaxɔ Mawu ƒe amenuveve la dzodzro o.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Elabena egblɔ bena: „Meɖo to wò le amenuveɣi la, eye mexɔ na wò le xɔxɔgbe la dzi.“ Kpɔ ɖa, fifi enye amenuveɣi, kpɔ ɖa, fifi enye xɔxɔgbe!

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Miena nuɖiaɖiaa ɖeke le naneke me o, bene womagaka mo na míaƒe subɔsubɔ la o,

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: ke boŋ le nuwo katã me la mieɖea mía ɖokui fiana abe Mawu ƒe subɔlawo ene; Le dzidodo geɖe me, le xaxawo me, le hiãkamewo me, le momenuvevewo me,

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: le ƒoƒowo me, le gaxɔwo me, le zitɔtɔwo me, le agbagbadzedzewo me, le ŋudɔdɔwo me, le nutsitsidɔwo me,

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: le dzadzɛnyenye me, le sidzedze me, le dzigbɔgbɔ blewu me, le dɔmenyonyo me, le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe me, le lɔlɔ̃, si me alakpa mele o la me,

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: le anukwarenya me, le Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ me; heto dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe aʋawɔnu, siwo le nuɖusi me kple mia me la me,

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: to bubu kple ŋukpe me, to ɖaseɖiɖi vɔ̃ kple ɖaseɖiɖi nyui me; abe ameblelawo ene, gake nyateƒetɔwoe;

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: abe amesiwo womenya o ene, gake amesiwo wodze si kɔte la woe; abe amesiwo le kukum ene, gake kpɔ ɖa, míele agbe; abe amesiwo woƒo ene, gake womewu wo o;

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: abe amesiwo le nu xam ene, gake wokpɔa dzidzɔ ɖaasi; abe amesiwo nye ame dahewo ene, gake wona ame geɖe zua kesinɔtɔwo; abe amesiwo si naneke mele o ene, gake nusianu le wo si. Paulo xlɔ̃ nu kristotɔwo be, womagade ha kple dzimaxɔsetɔwo o.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Míaƒe nu ke ɖe te na mi Korintotɔwo! Míaƒe dzi keke!

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Miexaxa le mía me o; ke miexaxa le mia ŋutɔwo miaƒe dzi me.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Teƒeɖoɖo sia nu mele egblɔm na mi — abe ɖeviwo megblɔe na ene — bena miawo hã miakeke mia ɖokui.

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Migazu amesiwo atsɔ kɔkuti tutɔ na dzimaxɔsetɔwo ti o! Elabena hadede kae le dzɔdzɔenyenye kple sedzimawɔmawɔ dome? Alo ƒomedodo kae le kekeli kple viviti dome?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Alo aleke Kristo kple Belial asɔa? Alo gome kae li na xɔsetɔ kple dzimaxɔsetɔa?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Alo ɖekawɔwɔ kae le mawuxɔ kple trɔ̃wo domea? Elabena miawoe nye Mawu gbagbe la ƒe xɔ, abe alesi Mawu gblɔ ene bena: „Manɔ wo dome, eye mazɔ wo dome, eye manye Mawu na wo, eye woawo hã woanye nye dukɔ.

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mido go le wo dome, eye miɖe mia ɖokui ɖa, Aƒetɔ la gblɔe, eye migaka asi nu makɔmakɔ ŋuti o, eye nye la maxɔ mi,

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: eye manye Fofo na mi, eye miawo hã mianye vinyeŋutsuviwo kple vinyenyɔnuviwo, Aƒetɔ, ŋusẽkatãtɔ la gblɔe.“

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Azɔ la esi ŋugbedodo siawo le mía si la, lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mina míakɔ mia ɖokui ŋuti tso ŋutilã kple gbɔgbɔ ƒe ɖiƒoƒo sia ɖiƒoƒo me, bena míawu kɔkɔenyenye nu le mawuvɔvɔ̃ me.

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Miʋu mia ɖokui na mí! Miewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe amea ɖeke ŋuti o, miegblẽ amea ɖeke o, mieha amea ɖeke o.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Menye fɔbubu ŋuti mele esia gblɔm ɖo o; elabena megblɔe tsã be, miele míaƒe dziwo me, bene miaku kpli mí, eye mianɔ agbe kpli mí hã.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Dzideƒo geɖe lé asinye le mia ŋuti, meƒo adegbe geɖe hã le mia ŋuti, akɔfafa yɔm taŋ, megba go le dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ me le míaƒe xaxa katã me.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Elabena esi mieva Makedonia hã, míaƒe ŋutilã mekpɔ dzudzɔa ɖeke o, ke míekpe fu le nusianu me boŋ, dzrewɔwɔ le mía gota, eye vovɔ̃ le mía me.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu, amesi fa akɔ na ame bɔbɔɖeanyiwo la, fa akɔ na mí le Tito ƒe vava la me.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Ke menye eƒe vava me ɖeɖeko o, ke le akɔfafa, si wotso fa akɔ nɛ le mia ŋuti la hã me boŋ; elabena egblɔ miaƒe didi vevi kple miaƒe avifafa kple miaƒe ŋuʋaʋã le tanye la fia mí, ale bena mekpɔ dzidzɔ wu tsãtɔ. Nuxaxa, si tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Elabena ne mena míexa nu le agbalẽa me hã la, mevem o; eye ne evem hã la — elabena mekpe bena, agbalẽ ma la, nenye ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe koe wòna míexa nu hã —

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: gake azɔ dzi le dzɔyem, menye esi wòna míexa nu la ŋuti o, hafi bena wòna míexa nu hena dzimetɔtrɔ boŋ; elabena ena míexa nu ɖe Mawu ƒe didi nu, bena bubu naganɔe na mi le naneke me atso mía gbɔ o.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Elabena nuxaxa ɖe Mawu ƒe didi nu la wɔa dzimetɔtrɔ, si mevea ame o, hena xɔxɔ; ke xexeame ƒe nuxaxa hea ku ve.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, nenem nuxaxa sia, si míexa ɖe Mawu ƒe didi nu la, aleke wòhewɔ veviedodo geɖe na mi? Ẽ mia ɖokui taʋiʋli, ẽ dzibibi, ẽ vɔvɔ̃, ẽ didi vevi, ẽ ŋuʋaʋã, ẽ hlɔ̃biabia hã! Nusianu me míeɖe mia ɖokui fia be, mienɔ dzadzɛ le nya sia me.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Eyata ne meŋlɔe na mi hã la, nyemeŋlɔe le amesi wɔ vɔ̃ sia ŋuti alo amesi ŋuti wowɔ vɔ̃ sia ɖo la ŋuti o; ke boŋ bene miaƒe veviedodo le mía ŋuti la nadze ƒã le mia dome le Mawu ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti wofa akɔ na mí; ke hekpe ɖe míaƒe akɔfafa sia ŋuti la miekpɔ dzidzɔ geɖe wu le Tito ƒe dzidzɔ la ŋuti, esi eƒe gbɔgbɔ kpɔ gbɔɖeme tso mi katã mia gbɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Elabena ne meƒo adegbe le nane me le mia ŋuti le eƒe ŋku me la, mezu ŋukpe nam o, hafi alesi miegblɔ nuwo katã na mi le nyateƒe mee la, nenema ke míaƒe adegbe, si míeƒo le Tito ƒe ŋku me la, hã zu nyateƒe.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Eye miaƒe nu lé dzi nɛ geɖe wu, esi wòɖo ŋku mi katã miaƒe toɖoɖo la dzi, alesi mietsɔ vɔvɔ̃ kple dzodzo nyanyanya xɔe la.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Dzi le dzɔyem bena, dzi le ƒonye le nusianu me le mia ta.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ke, nɔviwo, miana mianya Mawu ƒe amenuveve, si wòna le Makedonia hamewo me.

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: Elabena xaxa me dodokpɔ geɖe me woƒe dzidzɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ fũ kple woƒe ahedada, si nu sẽ la, gba go le le woƒe dzimekɔkɔ ƒe kesinɔnuwo me.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Elabena mele ɖase ɖim bena, woa ŋutɔwo lɔ̃ na nu faa alesi wote ŋui, eye wona nu wu alesi wote ŋui hã.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ nuxɔxlɔ̃ geɖe ɖe kuku na mí be, yewoakpɔ gome le ame kɔkɔewo subɔsubɔdɔ ƒe amenuveve kple hadede me;

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: eye menye alesi míekpɔ mɔ la ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ wotsɔ wo ɖokui na Mawu gbã kpakple míawo hã to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me,

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: ale bena míexlɔ̃ nu Tito bena, alesi ke wòdze egɔme xoxo la, nenema ke wòawu amenuveve sia nu le mia dome hã.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ke alesi miegba go le nusianu me le xɔse kple nya kple nunyanya kple veviedodo katã kple lɔlɔ̃, si mietsɔ lɔ̃ mi la me la, nenema ke miagba go le amenuveve sia me hã.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Nyemele egblɔm abe sedede ene o, ke boŋ metsɔ ame bubuwo ƒe veviedodo do miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ hã ƒe vavãnyenye kpɔ.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Elabena mienya mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve bena, kesinɔtɔ wònye hafi, ke mia ŋuti wòva da ahe ɖo, bene miawo la miato eƒe ahedada la me nazu kesinɔtɔwo.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Eye meɖo aɖaŋu le esia me; elabena esia nyo na mi amesiwo meto ewɔwɔ gɔme ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ edidi hã, anɔ ƒe ɖeka enye esi.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ miwu ewɔwɔ la hã nu, bene alesi miesu te helɔ̃ edzi faa la, mia wu nu hã le nusi le mia si la nu nenema ke.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Elabena ne edzilɔlɔ̃ le la, edze ame ŋu be, woaxɔ le nusi le amesi la nu, eye menye le nusi mele esi o la nu o.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Elabena menye be, ame bubuwo nakpɔ gbɔɖeme, eye miawo míakpɔ xaxa hafi o, ke boŋ bene wòasɔ pɛ; ɣeyiɣi sia me miaƒe agbɔsɔsɔ, si glia go la, nanɔ woamawo ƒe hiãtuame teƒe,

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Amesi fɔ nu fũ la, mekpɔ ɖeke ɖe edzi o, eye amesi ke fɔe ʋee ko la, naneke mebiae o.“

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Ke woada akpe na Mawu, amesi tsɔ nenem veviedodo le mia ŋuti sia de Tito ƒe dzi me;

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: elabena exɔ nuxɔxlɔ̃ sia; ke esi wòdo vevie wu ŋuti la, edzo yi mia gbɔ le ye ŋutɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu nu.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ke míedɔ eya kple nɔvi, si ŋu kafukafu le le nyanyuie ŋuti le hamewo katã me la, ɖo ɖa.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Ke menye esia ɖeɖeko o, hafi hamewo tiae hã, bene wòanye mía hamɔzɔla le amenuveve sia, tsi miewɔna hena Aƒetɔ la ƒe kafukafu kple míaƒe lɔlɔ̃ ƒe ɖeɖefia la me.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Nenem míele mo xem na esia, bena amea ɖeke nagaka mo na mí le nudzɔdzɔ gã sia, si miena wodzo la ŋuti o.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Elabena míaƒe tamesusuwo le nu nyui yome, menye le Aƒetɔ la ŋku me ɖeɖeko o, ke le amewo ŋku me hã.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Ke miedɔ wo kpakple mía nayi, si miedo kpɔ le nu geɖe me enuenu, eye miekpɔ bena, edoa vevie; ke azɔ la ele vevie dom geɖe wu tsãtɔ le dziɖoɖoɖeameŋu gã, si wòɖo ɖe mia ŋu la ta.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Le Tito gome la, nye zɔhɛ wònye, eye hadɔwɔla wònye le mia gbɔ; le nɔvi, siwo tso mía gbɔ gome la, hame ƒe ame dɔdɔwo wonye kple bubu na Kristo.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne míeɖe miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple miaƒe adegbe, si míeƒona le mia ŋuti la, ƒe dzesi fia woamawo la, ekema mieɖee fia le hameawo ŋku me.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Mele vevie nam bena, maŋlɔ nya na mi le subɔsubɔdɔ, si wotso subɔ ame kɔkɔewo la ŋuti hafi o.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Elabena menya bena, miele edzi lɔ̃m, eye metsɔ esia ƒo adegbe le mia ŋuti le Makedoniatɔwo gbɔ, bena Axaya dzra eɖokui ɖo xoxo anɔ ƒe ɖeka enye si, eye veviedodo, si tso mia gbɔ la, de dzo ame geɖeawo me.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Ke meda nɔviawo ɖa, bene míaƒe adegbe, si míeƒona le mia ŋuti la, nagazu dzodzro le nya sia me o, bena abe alesi megblɔe ene la, míadzra mia ɖokui ɖo ɖi,

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: bena nenye ɖe Makedoniatɔwo ava kpakplim, eye woakpɔ bena, miedzra mia ɖokui ɖo ɖi o la, ŋu nagakpe mí — míele didim be, miagblɔ be miawo ke la — le dziɖoɖo ɖe mia ŋu sia ŋuti o.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Ke mebui nu vevi bena, mexlɔ̃ nu nɔviawo, bena woadze ŋgɔ ava mia gea, bene woadzra yayra, si ŋugbe mieɖo xoxo la, ɖo ɖi, bene wòasɔ gbe abe yayra ene, eye menye abe ŋukeklẽ ene o.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Ke esia gblɔm mele bena, amesi ƒã nu le nuveve me la, axa nu hã le nuveve me, eye amesi ƒã nu le yayra me la, axa nu hã le yayra me.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Amesiame abe alesi wòɖo ɖi le eƒe dzi me ene, menye kple veve alo dzizizi o; elabena amesi na nu kple dzidzo la, eyae Mawu lɔ̃na.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Ke ŋusẽ le Mawu si bena, amenuveve katã nagbã go na mi, bene miakpɔ agbɔsɔsɔ blibo la katã le nusianu me ɖaasi, eye miagba go awɔ ɖɔ nyui sia dɔ nyui.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Abe alesi woŋlɔ ɖi ene bena: „Ehlẽ nu hena ame dahewo; eƒe dzodzoenyenye noa anyi tegbetegbe.

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Ke amesi tsoa nuku kple abolo hã kea nuƒãla, bene wòakpɔ nuɖuɖu la, ana nuku mi, eye wòana miaƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse natsi nyuie,

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: bena miazu kesinɔtɔwo le nusianu me ahaɖe miaƒe dɔmenyonyo katã, si wɔ be, woada akpe na Mawu to mia dzi la afia.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Elabena nunana sia ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ la menye ɖe wòde ame kɔkɔeawo ƒe hiãtutu nu ɖeɖe o, ke boŋ egba go le akpedada geɖe me hena Mawu hã;

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: elabena subɔsubɔdɔ sia ƒe kpɔɖeŋu nyui la ana woakafu Mawu le miaƒe toɖoɖo Kristo ƒe nyanyuie me ʋuʋu la kple miaƒe hadede kple woawo kpakple amewo katã tso dzimekɔkɔ me la ŋuti;

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: eye woawo hã le kuku ɖem ɖe mia ta, eye miele wo dzrom le Mawu ƒe amenuveve, si sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ na mi la ŋuti.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Woada akpe na Mawu le eƒe nunana manyagblɔ la ŋuti!

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Ke nye Paulo ŋutɔ mele nu xlɔ̃m mi to Kristo ƒe dɔmefafa kple tufafa me, nye amesi nye ame bɔbɔɖokui le miaƒe ŋku me le mia dome; ke esime nyemele mia gbɔ o la, dzi le ƒonye ɖe mia ŋu.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Ke mele kuku ɖem na mi bena, ne mele mia gbɔ la, nyemaɖe dzi ƒo na ɖokuinye kple ŋuɖoɖoɖeŋu, si mele susum be, matsɔ awɔ kalẽ ɖe amea ɖewo, siwo bua mí abe amesiwo zɔna le ŋutilã nu ene ta ŋuti o.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Elabena esi wònye ŋutilã me zɔm míele hã la, miewɔa aʋa le ŋutilã nu o. —

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Elabena míaƒe aʋawɔnuwo menye ŋutilãtɔ o, ke boŋ ŋusẽnu, siwo wotsɔna gbaa mɔ̃wo ƒua anyi la, wonye le Mawu ƒe ŋku me —

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: esi míegbaa tamebubuwo kple nu kɔkɔ sia nu kɔkɔ, si kɔa eɖokui ɖe dzi ɖe sidzedze Mawu ŋuti la, eye mieɖea nyasãwo katã aboyo hena toɖoɖo Kristo;

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: eye mienɔa dzadzraɖoɖi hã, bena ne miaƒe toɖoɖo ade blibo la, míatu fe vɔ̃ le tosesẽ sia tosesẽ ŋuti.
