english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Ɖe miekpɔa nusiwo le ŋku me la ɖa? Ne amea ɖe ɖoa ŋu ɖe eɖokui ŋu bena, Kristo to yenye la, ekema eyama nagasusu esia hã le eɖokui me bena, alesi ke ye ŋutɔ nye Kristo tɔ la, nenema ke míawo hã míenye eto.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Elabena nenye be, maƒo adegbe via ɖe wu le míaƒe ŋusẽ, si Aƒetɔ la tso na mi, bene míado mi ɖe ŋgɔ, eye menye be, miagblẽ mi o la ŋuti la, ŋu mele kpe ye ge o,

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: bene nyemagawɔ abe ɖe metso agbalẽwo do vɔvɔ̃ na mi ene o.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Elabena wogblɔ be: Agbalẽawo kpena, eye wosẽna; ke eya ŋuta nye ame beli, eye eƒe nyawo mele ɖeke me o.

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Ke nenem me sia nasusu le esia ŋuti bena, amesi ƒomeviwo míenye le nya me le agbalẽwo me, esi miele mia gbɔ o la, nenem me mawo tɔgbe ke mianye le dɔwɔwɔ me, ne míele mia gbɔ hã.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Ke míawo la, míaƒo adegbe wòagbɔ me o, ke boŋ le dzidzeka ƒe dzidzedzidze, si Mawu ma na mí la nu, bene miade keke mia gbɔ hã.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Elabena míele mía ɖokui dem akpa, abe ɖe míate ŋu ade mia gbɔ o ene o; elabena míetsɔ Kristo ƒe nyanyuie la de mia gbɔ ke hã.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Mieƒoa adegbe wògbɔa eme le ame bubuwo ƒe dɔwɔƒewo ŋu o; ke mɔkpɔkpɔ le mía si bena, ne miaƒe xɔse le tsitsim la, míatsi azu gã le mia dome le míaƒe dzidzeka la nu,

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: bene míagblɔ nyanyuie la afia le anyigba, siwo le mia godo la hã dzi, bene míagaƒo adegbe le ame bubuwo ƒe dɔwɔƒe le nusi wowɔ vɔ xoxo la ŋuti o.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ke amesi ƒoa adegbe la, naƒo adegbe le Aƒetɔ la me!

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Elabena menye amesi tsia eɖokui la, nye ame nyui o, ke boŋ amesi Aƒetɔ la kafuna lae.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: Ɖe miado dzi atsa nye bometsitsi via ɖe; miado dzi atsɔe nam tso!

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena metsɔ Mawu ŋuʋaʋã le ŋu ʋãm le mia ŋu, elabena medo mia ŋugbe na ŋutsu ɖeka, bena matso ɖetugbi dzadzɛ atu tsitre na Kristo.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Ke mele vɔvɔ̃m bena, amea ɖe menya nu o, alesi da la tsɔ eƒe adaŋu vɔ̃ ble Xawa la, nenema ke woagblẽ miaƒe tamesusuwo tso dzimekɔkɔ, si miekɔ na Kristo la me mahĩ?

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Elabena ne amesi gbɔna la, le gbe ƒã ɖem Yesu bubu, si míeɖe gbe ƒãe o la, alo ne miexɔ gbɔgbɔ bubu, si miexɔ tsã o la, alo miexɔ nyanyuie bubu, si miexɔ tsã o la, ekema mieɖoa dzi xɔnɛ nyuie!

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Elabena mebuna be, nyemetsi megbe le naneke me le apostolo, siwo ko akpa la ŋu o.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Ke me menye ame manyanu le nuƒoƒo me hã la, nyemenyae le sidzedze me o, ke le nusianu me miedze ƒã le amewo katã dome le mia gome.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe esi mebɔbɔ ɖokuinye ɖe anyi, bene woado miawo ɖe dzi la, ɖe mewɔ nuvɔ̃ bena, megblɔ Mawu ƒe nyanyuie la fia mi fetu maxɔmaxɔe mahã?

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: elabena nɔvi, siwo tso Makedonia va la, na nusiwo hiãm la, wòsɔ gbɔ de nunye, eye mekpɔ ɖokuinye dzi le nusianu me, bene nyemaganye agba na mi o, eye magakpɔ ɖokuinye dzi.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Ne menye Kristo ƒe nyateƒe la le menye o fĩ, womagatsi adegbeƒoƒo sia nu nam le Axaya ƒe nutoawo me o.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Ke nusi mewɔna la, mawɔe hã, bene mana mɔnukpɔkpɔ nu natso na amesiwo dia mɔnu, bene woakpɔ wo le nusi me woƒo adegbe le la me abe míawo hã ene.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena nenem me siawo nye aʋatso-apostolowo, dɔwɔla, siwo blea ame, amesiwo trɔa wo ɖokui woa Kristo ƒe apostolowo.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Eye esia menye nukunu o; elabena Abosam ŋutɔ trɔa eɖokui wɔa kekeli ƒe dɔla.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Eyata ne eƒe dɔlawo trɔa wo ɖokui abe dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe dɔlawo ene la, menye nu gã o; amesiawo ƒe nuwuwu ana ɖe woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu.

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Megale egblɔm bena, amea ɖeke nagabum bometsila o; ke ne miebum nenema la, ekema mixɔm abe bometsila ene, bene nye hã maƒo adegbe le ɖokuinye ŋuti vie.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nusi gblɔm mele la, nyemele egblɔm ɖe Aƒetɔ la nu o, ke abe bometsila ene boŋ, le adegbeƒoƒo ƒe dziɖoɖoɖeŋu sia me.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Esi ame geɖe ƒoa adegbe le ŋutilã nu ŋuti la, nye hã maƒo adegbe.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Elabena esi míenye aɖaŋudzelawo ŋuti la, mielɔ̃na doa dzi tsoa bometsilawo ƒe nyawo.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Elabena ne amea ɖe wɔ mi kluviwo, ne amea ɖe ɖu mi keŋ, ne amea ɖe lé mi, ne amea ɖe do eɖokui ɖe dzi, ne amea ɖe ƒo mo na mi la, miedoa dzi tsɔnɛ.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Ŋukpedodo ta megblɔe ɖo, abe ɖe miawo la míegbɔdzɔ ene, ke nenye nusi me amea ɖe wo kalẽ le wònye la, — mele egblɔm le bometsitsi me — anye ne nye hã mawɔ kalẽ le eme.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Hebritɔwo wonyea? Nye hãe! Israeltɔwo wònyea? Nye hãe! Abraham-ƒomeawo wonyea? Nye hãe!

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Kristo ƒe subɔlawo wònyea? — Mele nu ƒom abe amesi ƒe tame ɖa la ene — Nyee wu: Le agbagbadzedze geɖe wu me, le ƒoƒo geɖe akpa me, le gaxɔmedede geɖe wu me, le ku me agbadre.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo si mexɔ ƒoƒo ɖeka ɖi go blane me le zi alɔ,

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: zi etɔ̃ woƒom kple atiwo, zi ɖeka woƒu kpem; menɔ ʋu me wògba zi etɔ̃, zã kple keli menɔ ƒutsotsoewo nu.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Mezɔ mɔ enuenu; meɖo ŋɔdzi me le tɔsisiwo dzi, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le adzodalawo dome, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le nye dukɔmeviwo gbɔ, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le trɔ̃subɔlawo gbɔ, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le du me, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le gbedzi, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le atsiaƒu dzi, meɖo ŋɔdzi me le aʋatsonɔviawo dome;

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: le agbagbadzedze kple kutrikuku me; le ŋudɔdɔwo me agbadre, le dɔwuame kple tsikɔwuame me, le nutsitsidɔwo me agbadre, le vuvɔ kple amamanɔnɔ me.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Nu bubu, siwo gadzo la, wonye: Amewo ƒe ziƒoƒo ɖe ŋunye gbesiagbe, kple beléte na hamewo katã.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Ameka gbɔdzɔ, eye nyemagbɔdzɔ oa? Ameka nu woɖia, eye nyemefiã oa?

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ne ele nam be, maƒo adegbe la, maƒo adegbe le nusiwo le nye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ gome la ŋuti.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Mawu, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo, amesi wokafuna yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me la, nyae bena, nyemeka aʋatso o.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Le Damasko la fia Areta ƒe du me dziɖula dzo Damaskotɔwo ƒe du la ŋuti, bena yealém,

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: eye wotsɔm de golo me to ʋɔtruvi nu heto gli dzi ɖiɖi ɖe anyi, eye mesi dzo tso eƒe asiwò mè.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Ele be, maƒo adegbe; gake menye viɖe nam o; elabena mele Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutegawo kple nyaɖeɖefiawo gbɔ va ge.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ɖa, esiae nye zi etɔ̃lia medzra ɖokuinye ɖo bena, mava mia gbɔ, eye nyemanye agba na mi o; elabena nyemele miaƒe nuwo dim o, ke mia ŋutɔwo dim mele boŋ. Elabena medze bena, viwo natu nuwo ɖo na wo dzilawo o, hafi dzilawo natu nuwo ɖo na viwo boŋ.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Eye menya nenem me sia — eɖanɔ ŋutilã me o, meɖanɔ ŋutilã me o, nyemenyae o; Mawue nyae, —

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: bena wotsɔe dzoe yi ɖe Paradiso la me, eye wòse nya, siwo mele ne woagblɔ o, siwo womeɖe mɔ na ame, bene wòagblɔ o la.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Nenem me sia ŋuti maƒo adegbe le; ke le ɖokuinye ŋuti la nyemaƒo adegbe o, negbe le nye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo ŋuti ko.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Ke nenye ɖe maɖi be, maƒo adegbe la, nyemazu bometsila o; elabena magblɔ nyateƒe; ke nyemele ewɔ ge o, bene amea ɖeke nagabu ŋutinye wu alesi wòkpɔam alo alesi wòsea nya le nunye

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: hekpe ɖe nyaɖeɖefia, siwo ƒo wo katã ta ŋuti la o. Eyata bena nyemagado ɖokuinye ɖe dzi o la, wode ŋu nye ŋutilã me, si nye Satana ƒe dɔla, bene wòaƒom kple ko, bene nyemagado ɖokuinye ɖe dzi o.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Esia ŋuti meyɔ Aƒetɔ la zi etɔ̃, bene wòadzo le ŋunye.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Nye amenuveve so gbɔ na wò; elabena nye ŋusẽ zu blibo le gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ me. Eyata mele lalam wu bena, maƒo adegbe le nye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ ŋuti boŋ, bene Kristo ƒe ŋusẽ nana dzinye.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Eyata mekpɔa ŋudzedze nyui le gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo me, le ŋutasesẽwo me, le hiãkamewo me, le yometitiwo me, le xaxawo me le Kristo ŋuti; elabena ne megbɔdzɔ la, ekema mesẽa ŋu. Paulo ɖo ŋku eƒe lɔlɔ̃ dzi na hame la.

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mezu bometsila; gake miawoe zi dzinye. Elabena nye la miawoe lakafum hafi; elabena nyemetsi megbe le naneke me le apostolo, siwo ko akpa la ŋu o, wònye nyemenye naneke hafi o.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Ke mewo apostolo ƒe dzesiwo le mia dome le dzidodo katã me, le dzesiwo kple nukunuwo kple ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔwo me.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Alo nuka me gɔ̃ mietsi megbe le le hame susɔeawo ŋu, negbe le esia me ko bena, nye ŋutɔ nyemenye agba na mi oa? Mitsɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ sia kem!

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Ke nye la melɔ̃na ŋutɔ bena, magblẽ nu, eye mana woagblẽ nye ŋutɔ le míaƒe luʋɔwo ta, geɖe alesi melɔ̃a mi la, ʋee wu miawo la mielɔ̃am.

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Ke anɔ nenem, nyemenye agba na mi o; ke esi menya aɖaŋu ŋutie, melé mi le aɖaŋu me.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe meto amesiwo medɔ ɖo ɖe mia gbɔ la dome amea ɖe dzi ba mia?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Mexlɔ̃ nu Tito, eye medɔ eya kple nɔvi la ɖo ɖa. Alo ɖe Tito ba mia? Menye gbɔgbɔ ma ke me miezɔ le oa? Menye afɔɖoƒe ma ke me miezɔ le oa?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Fifia katã miele susum bena, míele mía ɖokui ta ʋlim le mia gbɔ. Míele nu ƒom le Mawu ƒe ŋku me le Kristo me; ke, lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, míele wo katã wɔm le miaƒe ŋgɔgbedede ta.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Elabena mele vɔvɔ̃m bena, ne meva mia gbɔ la, nyemakpɔ mi abe alesi mele didim ene o, eye miawo la míakpɔ nye hã, abe alesi miele didim o ene; bena dzrewɔwɔwo, ŋuʋaʋãwo, dɔmedzoedodowo, dzrehehewo, ameŋuzɔzɔwo, sakplisasawo, ɖokuidodoɖedziwo, nyamanyamawɔwɔwo anɔ anyi,

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: bena ne megava la, Mawu abɔbɔm ɖe anyi le mia gbɔ, eye mala konyi le ame geɖe, siwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ tsã, eye wometrɔ le woƒe dzi me le makɔmakɔnyenye kple ahasiwɔwɔ kple hadzedze, siwo wowɔ ŋuti o la ta.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Zi etɔ̃lia enye si megbɔna mia gbɔ; ɖaseɖila eve alo etɔ̃ nu woaƒo nya sia nya ta le.

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Megblɔe xoxo, eye megale egblɔm ɖi, alesi menɔ mia gbɔ zi eveliae la, nenema kee nye fifia hã, esi nyemele mia gbɔ o la, mele egblɔm na amesiwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ tsã kple ame susɔeawo katã bena, ne magava la, nyemakpɔ nublanui o.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Elabena miele dzesi dim le Kristo, si le nu ƒom le menye la si, amesi megbɔdzɔ le mia gbɔ o, ke enu sẽ le mia dome la boŋ.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Wònye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ me wòtso woklãe ɖe atitsoga ŋu hafi, gake la Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ me wòtso wòle agbe. Elabena míawo hã míegbɔdzɔ le eyama me; gake mía kplii míanɔ agbe le Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ me le mia gome.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Mite mia ɖokui kpɔ, abe ɖe miele xɔse me ene; mido mia ɖokui kpɔ! Alo ɖe miedze si mia ɖokui bena, Yesu Kristo le mia me oa? Negbe ɖeko mieli ke o.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Ke mele mɔ kpɔm bena, miedze sii bena, míawo la míenye ame malike o.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Ke mele kuku ɖem na Mawu bena, miagawɔ nuvɔ̃a ɖeke o, menye bena míawo miedze ƒã abe ame likewo ene o; ke boŋ bene miawo miawɔ nu nyui la, ke míawo la míanɔ abe ame malikewo ene.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Elabena míate ŋu awɔ naneke ɖe nyateƒe la ŋuti o; ke nyateƒe la boŋ ye míate ŋu awɔ nane na.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Elabena ne míawo míegbɔdzɔ, eye miawo miesẽ ŋu la, miekpɔa dzidzɔ, eye esia ŋuti míele kuku ɖem ɖo le miaƒe blibodede ŋuti.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Eyata esi nyemele mia gbɔ o ŋuti la, meŋlɔ esiawo bena, ne mele mia gbɔ la, nyemagahe nya sesẽ le ŋusẽ, si Aƒetɔ la nam hena ame ƒe ŋgɔgbedede, eye menye eƒe gbegblẽ o la nu o.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, dzi nadzɔ mi, mizu blibo, mina woafa akɔ na mi, miaƒe tamesusu nanɔ ɖeka, mina anyi le ŋutifafa me, eye lolo kple ŋutifafa Mawu anɔ anyi kpli mi!

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Mitso nugbugbɔ kɔkɔe gbugbɔ nu na mia nɔewo! Ame kɔkɔewo katã ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve kple Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe hamenɔnɔ nanɔ anyi kpli mi katã!

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa woana mi tso Mawu Fofo la kple mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ,

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: amesi tsa eɖokui hena le mia nuvɔ̃ ŋuti, bene yeaɖe mí atso xexeme vɔ̃ɖi, si li fifia me le Mawu, mía Fofo, ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la nu,

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: amesi to anye kafukafu tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Mewo yaa bena, miena wote mi ɖa tso amesi yɔ mi le Kristo ƒe amenuveve me la gbɔ kaba ŋutɔ ale heyina nyanyuie bubua ɖe me,

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: wònye nyanyuie bubua ɖeke meli o, negbe bena amea ɖewo li, siwo blu miaƒe tame, eye wole didim be, yewoadze ŋe Kristo ƒe nyanyuie la.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Ke nenye míawo alo mawudɔla, si tso dziƒo gɔ̃ hã, agblɔ nyanyuie la bubui afia mi, ɖe esi míegblɔ na mi teƒe la, nezu busu!

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Abe alesi míegblɔ tsã la, magagblɔe fifi hã bena, ne amea ɖe gblɔ nyanyuie la bubui fia mi ɖe esi miexɔ teƒe la, nezu busu!

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, ɖe megale nu ƒom, bena wòanyo amewo ŋu loo, alo Mawu ŋua? Alo ɖe mele didim bena, madze amewo ŋua? Ɖe megale amewo ŋu dzem la, anye ne nyemeganye Kristo ƒe dɔla o.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Ke mana mianyae, nɔviwo, bena nyanyuie, si megblɔ fia mi ta, menye amewo to wonye o.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Elabena nye hã nyemexɔe tso ame si me, eye nyemesrɔ̃e hã o, ke boŋ mexɔe to Yesu Kristo ƒe nyaɖeɖefia me.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Elabena miese nye tsãnyinɔnɔ le Yudatɔnyenye me bena, meɖikpi ti Mawu ƒe hame la yome akpa, eye megblɔe.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Eye mede ŋgɔgbe le Yudatɔnyenye me wu nye hati geɖewo le nye dukɔ la dome, eye meɖikpi ʋã ŋu akpa le mía fofowo ƒe nuɖoanyiwo ŋuti.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: bena wòɖe ye ŋuta Via ɖe go fia le menye, bene magblɔ eŋuti nyanyuie la afia le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome la, enumake mía kple ŋutilã kple ʋu míetia nya me o,

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: eye nyemeyi Yerusalem ɖe amesiwo tre apostolonyenye nam la gbɔ o, ke boŋ metɔ dzi heyi ɖe Arabia, eye megagbugbɔ va Damasko.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Ƒe etɔ̃ megbe la meyi ɖe Yerusalem, Petro nya ge, eye menɔ egbɔ ŋkeke wuiatɔ̃.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Ke nyemekpɔ apostolowo dome ame bubua ɖeke o, negbe Yakobo. Aƒetɔ la nɔvi ko.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Ke nusi meŋlɔ na mi la, kpo ɖa, Mawu ƒe ŋku mee bena, nyemeka aʋatso o.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Emegbe la meva Siria kple Kilikia nutoawo me.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Ke Yudea-hame, siwo le Kristo me la, menyam le ŋku me o.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Ke ɖeko wose bena, amesi ti mía yome tsã la, gblɔa xɔse ƒe nyanyuie, si wògblẽ tsã la, fiana azɔ.

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Eye wokafu Mawu le tanye.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, anɔ ƒe wuiene, megayi Yerusalem, mia kple Barnaba, eye metso Tito hã kpe ɖe mía ŋu.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ke meyi le nyaɖeɖefiaa ɖe nu, eye metsɔ nyanyuie, si meɖea gbe ƒã le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome la, ɖo wo ŋku me, ke vevietɔ amesiwo wohuna be, wonye nane la ŋku me, bena nyemele du sim dzodzro alo mesi du dzodzro o.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Ke Tito, si li kplim gɔ̃ hã la, Helatɔ wònye hafi; gake womezi edzi bene, wòana woatso aʋa nɛ o.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Ke wowɔe le aʋatsonɔvia ɖewo, siwo be va tra ɖe eme, bene woatsa ŋku miaƒe ablɔɖenyenye, si le mía si le Kristo Yesu me la me, bene yewoawɔ mí kluviwo ƒã la ŋuti,

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: amesiwo miena mɔ ɖo to wo gaƒoƒo ɖeka hɔ̃ o, bene nyanyuie la ƒe nyateƒe nanɔ te la mia gbɔ ɖaasi.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo wobuna bena, wonye nane la — ameka ke wonye o, nyemetsɔ ɖeke le eme o; Mawu mekpɔa ame ŋku me o — elabena nye la amesiwo wobuna be, wonye nane la, womegblɔ nyaa ɖeke fiam o;

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: ke boŋ la esi wokpɔ bena, wotsɔ nyanyuie de asi nam na aʋamatsomatsotɔwo, abe alesi wotsɔe de asi na Petro hena aʋatsotsotɔwo ene la —

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: elabena amesi wɔ dɔ ŋusẽtɔe na Petro le aʋatsotso ƒe apostolonyenye me la, eya kee wɔ dɔ ŋusẽtɔe na nye hã le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome —

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: eye esi wodze si amenuveve, si wotsɔ nam la, tete Yakobo kple Kefa kpakple Yohanes, amesiwo wobuna bena, wonye sɔtiwo la, wona habɔbɔ ƒe asi mía kple Barnaba, bene míawo míayi trɔ̃subɔlawo gbɔ, ke woawo woayi aʋatsotsotɔwo gbɔ;

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: negbe ɖeko bena miaƒe ŋkuwo nanɔ ame dahewo dzi; nusi kekeake nye hã medoa vevie wɔna. Paulo tsi tre ɖe Petro ŋu, eye wòli ke sesĩe ɖe afiatsotsoname to xɔse me dzi.

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Ke esi Petro va Antioxia la, metsi tre ɖe eŋu le eya ŋutɔ ŋku me; elabena wotso enu.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Elabena hafi amea ɖewo tso Yakobo gbɔ va la, eya kple trɔ̃subɔlawo dua nu; ke esi wova la, èhe eɖokui ɖe megbe, eye wòɖe eɖokui ɖa, elabena evɔ amesiwo tso aʋatsotsoa me la.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Eye Yudatɔ susɔeawo hã da alakpa kpakplii, ale gbegbe bena, wohe Barnaba hã ɖe woƒe alakpadada la me.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Ke esime mekpe bena, womele zɔzɔm dzɔdzɔe le nyanyuie la ƒe nyateƒe la nu o lã, megblɔ na Petro le wo katã ŋku me bena: Ne wò amesi nye Yudatɔ la, nènɔ agbe abe trɔ̃subɔla ene, eye menye abe Yudatɔ ene o la, aleke wo nèzi trɔ̃subɔlawo dzi, bena woanɔ agbe abe Yudatɔwo ene mahã?

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Míawo la Yudatɔwo míenye tso dzɔdzɔme, eye míenye nuvɔ̃wɔlawo tso trɔ̃subɔlawo dome o;

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: ke esi míenyae bena, wometsoa afia na ame tso se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me o, ke boŋ to Yesu Kristo dzixɔxɔse me ɖeɖeko ŋuti la, eyata míawo hã míexa Yesu Kristo dzi se, bene woatso afia na mí to Kristo dzixɔxɔse me, eye menye tso se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me o; elabena wometsoa afia na ŋutilãa ɖeke tso se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me o.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Ke ne wokpɔ mí amesiwo le didim bena, woatso afia na mí le Kristo me la, bena mía ŋutɔwo hã nuvɔ̃wɔlawo míenye la, ekema Kristo le nuvɔ̃ ƒe subɔla nyem! Gbeɖe!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Elabena ne megatu nusiwo memu la, ekema mèfia ɖokuinye vodala.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Ke nye la meto se la me ku na se la, bene manɔ agbe na Mawu. Mía kple Kristo woklã ɖe atitsoga ŋu.

english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: Mele agbe, gake meganye nyee le agbe o, ke boŋ Kristo ye le agbe le menye; ke nusi ƒe agbe mele le ŋutilã me azɔ la, mele agbe le Mawuvi, si lɔ̃m, eye wòtsɔ ye ŋutɔ ɖokui na ɖe tanye la, ƒe dzixɔxɔse me.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Nyemedoa vlo Mawu ƒe amenuveve la o; elabena ne dzɔdzɔenyenye to se la me va la, ekema Kristo ku dzodzro.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: O, mi Galatiatɔ manyanuwo! Amekae trɔ tame na mi bena, mieɖo to nyateƒe la o: Mi amesiwo ŋku me woŋlɔ Yesu Kristo ɖo pete, abe amesi woklã ɖe atitsoga ŋu le mia dome la enea?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Esia ɖeɖeko dim mele be, nasrɔ̃ tso mia gbɔ: Se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo mee miexɔ Gbɔgbɔ la tso loo, alo xɔse ƒe nyagbɔgblɔfia la mee miexɔe tsoe mahã?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Ale ame manyanu siawo tɔgbe míenye mahã? Esi mietso Gbɔgbɔ la dze gome la, azɔ miatsɔ ŋutilã awu enua?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Ɖe míekpe fu geɖe siawo dzodzroa? Neganye dzodzroe hã.

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Azɔ la, amesi tso Gbɔgbɔ la kea mi, eye wòwɔa ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔwo le mia me la: Se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo mee wòto loo, alo xɔse ƒe nyagbɔgblɔfia la me wòtoa?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: Abe alesi Abraham xa Mawu dzi se, eye wobui dzodzoenyenye nɛ ene.

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Eyata midze sii bena, amesiwo tso xɔse me la, woawo koe nye Abraham-viwo.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Ke esi ŋɔŋlɔ la kpɔ ɖi bena, Mawu tso afia na trɔ̃subɔlawo tso xɔse me la, eyaŋuti wògblɔ nyanyuie la ɖi na Abraham bena: „Wò me woayra trɔ̃subɔlawo katã le.“

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti woyra amesiwo katã tso xɔse me la kple xɔsetɔ Abraham.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Elabena ame alesi nu tso se la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me la, wole fiƒode la te; elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Woaƒo fi ade amesiame, si mena nusianu, si woŋlɔ ɖe anyi le sea ƒe agbalẽ me la dzi, bene wòawɔ edzi o la.“

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Ke edze ƒã bena, wometsoa afia na amea ɖeke to se la me le Mawu ŋku me o; elabena „ame dzɔdzɔe la anɔ agbe tso xɔse me.“

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Ke se la metso xɔse me o, hafi boŋ amesi ke wɔ nusiawo dzi la, anɔ agbe le wo me.

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Kristo xe fe ɖe mia ta heɖe mí tso se la ƒe fiƒode la me, esi wòva zu fiƒode le mía ta; elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Woƒo fi de amesiame, si wohe ɖe ati ŋu la,“

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: bene Abraham ƒe yayra la nava trɔ̃subɔlawo dzi le Kristo Yesu me, bene miaxa Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe ŋugbedodo la to xɔse me.

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mele nu ƒom abe ame ene; ame ƒe nubabla, si dzi woɖo kpee la, amea ɖeke metunɛ alo tsɔa nane kpena ɖe eŋuti o.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Ke Abraham la wogblɔ ŋugbedodowo na eya kple eƒe ƒome; womegblɔ be: „Kple ƒomeawo“ abe ame geɖe ene o, ke abe ame ɖeka ene boŋ: „Kple wò ƒome,“ si nye Kristo.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Elabena nenye se la mee domenyinyi la tso la, ekema metso ŋugbedodo la me o; ke Mawu to ŋugbedodo la me tsoe ke Abraham. Se la enye mia hela, si kplɔa tui yia Kristo gbɔ.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nuka ta se la li ɖo? Vodadawo ŋuti wotsɔe kpe ɖe eŋuti, vaseɖe ɣeyiɣi, si dzi ƒome, si ŋugbe wodo ɖi la ava, eye woto mawudɔlawo dzi ɖoe anyi to avuléla si me.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Ke avuléla menye ame ɖeka to o, ke Mawu la eya ɖekae.

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ɖe se la tsi tre ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋugbedodo la ŋuti mahã? Gbeɖe! Elabena ɖe wona sea ɖe, si ate ŋu ana agbe la, anye ne se la me ke dzodzoenyenye la tso vavã.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ke ŋɔŋlɔ la tu nuwo katã nu ɖe nuvɔ̃ te, bene woatsɔ ŋugbedodo la tso Kristo dzixɔxɔse me na amesiwo xɔna sena la.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Ke hafi xɔse la va la, wodzra mí ɖo ɖe se la te, eye wotu ʋɔ ɖe mia nu hena xɔse, si wole ɖeɖe ge ɖe go afia emegbe la.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ale se la zu mia nufiala, si kplɔa mí yia Kristo gbɔe, bene woatso afiã na mí to xɔse me.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Elabena mi katã míenye mawuviwo to Kristo Yesu dzixɔxɔse me.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Elabena mi ame alesi nu wode mawutsi ta na ɖe Kristo me la, miedo Kristo.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Azɔ la Yudatɔ kple Helatɔ megali o; kluvi alo ablɔɖevi megali o; atsu alo asi megali o; elabena mi katã ɖeka miele le Kristo Yesu me.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Ke ne míenye Kristo ta la, ekema Abraham ƒe ƒome kple domenyilawo míenye le ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Ke mele gbɔgblɔm be: Ŋkeke alesi domenyila enye ɖevi la, vovoa ɖeke mele eya kple kluvi dome o, wònye eyae nye nuwo katã ƒe aƒetɔ hafi;

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: ke boŋ ele amenyilawo kple aƒedzikpɔlawo te halase ɣeyiɣi, si fofoa ɖo ɖi la dzi.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Nenema ke nye miawo hã: Esi míenye ɖeviwo la, mieno xexe sia me gɔmedzenuwo ƒe kluvinyenye te.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Ke esi azãgbe la ɖo vo la, Mawu dɔ ye ŋuta Via ɖo ɖa, eye nyɔnua ɖe dzii, eye wodzii ɖe se la te,

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: bene wòaxe fe ɖe amesiwo le sea te la ta, bene vinyenye la nasu mía si.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Ke esi míenye viwo ŋuti la, Mawu dɔ Via ƒe Gbɔgbɔ, si le ɣli ɖom be; Aba, Fofo la, ɖo ɖe míaƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Eyata meganye kluvi o, ke boŋ vi nènye; ke ne ènye vi la, ekema Mawu ƒe domenyila hã nenye le Kristo me.

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Ke ɣemaɣi, esime mienya Mawu o la, mienye nusiwo menye mawuwo tso dzɔdzɔ me o la ƒe kluviwo.

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, esi mienya Mawu alo Mawu boŋ nya mi la, aleke wɔ, eye miegatrɔ yi ɖe gɔmedzenu gbɔdzɔ daheawo gbɔ, eye miegale didim be, miagasubɔ wo tso gɔmedzedzea me mahã?

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Mieléa ŋku ɖe ŋkekewo kple dzinuwo kple azãgbewo kpakple ƒewo ŋuti.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Mele vɔvɔ̃m ɖe mia nu bena, misela medze agbagba dzodzro ɖe mia ta mahĩ?

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Mizu abe nye ene; elabena nye hã mezu abe miawo ene! Nɔviwo, mele kuku ɖem na mi; miewɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Ke mienyae bena, le ŋutilã ƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ ŋuti megblɔ nyanyuie fia mi zi gbãtɔ.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Eye tetekpɔ, si le nye ŋutilã me na mi la, miedo vloe o, eye mienyɔ ŋui o, hafi boŋ miexam abe mawudɔla alo abe Kristo Yesu ene.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Azɔ miaƒe dzidzo ƒe kafukafu la, afika wòle mahã? Elabena mele ɖase ɖim le mia ŋuti bena, ɖe miete ŋui la, ne mieho miaƒe ŋkuwo le to me tso nam.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Esi megblɔ nyateƒe na mi la, eyata mezu miaƒe futɔ mahã?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Alesi wole ŋu ʋãm le mia ŋuti la, menyo o; ke boŋ wole didim be, yewoasa mi ɖe aga, bene miaʋã ŋu le yewo ŋuti.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Ke ŋuʋaʋã le nu nyui ŋuti nyo ɖaasi, eye menye ne mele mia gbɔ ɖeɖeko o.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, amesiwo ƒe fu gale ɖuyem, halase esime woamè Kristo ƒe nɔnɔme ade nua me!

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: Ke medi bena, manɔ mia gbɔ fifi, ne matrɔ nye gbe; elabena nye tame blu le mia ta. Sara kple Hagar wonye kpɔɖeŋu na nubabla yeyea kple xoxoa me hame la.

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Migblɔe nam, mi amesiwo le didim be, yewoanɔ sea te la, miese se la oa?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena, vi eve nɔ Abraham si Ame ɖeka tso kosi me, eye ame ɖeka tso ablɔɖenyɔnu me!

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Ke amesi tso kosi me la, wodzii le ŋutilã la nu, eye amesi tso ablɔɖenyɔnu me la, wodzii to ŋugbedodo la me.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: elabena Hagar enye Sinai-to la le Arabia, ke esɔ kple egbegbe Yerusalem; elabena eya kple viawo le kluvinyenye me.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Ke dziƒo Yerusalem enye ablɔɖe, eyae nye mí katã dada.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Elabena woŋlɔ ɖi bena: „Dzi nadzo wò konɔ, si medzi vi o; tso aseye, eye nado ɣli, wò, amesi melé ku kpɔ o la; elabena amesi tsi akogo la, vi geɖe anɔ esi awu srɔ̃tɔ.“

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, nɔviwo, le Isak nu míenye ŋugbedodo la ƒe viwo.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Ke alesi amesi wodzi le ŋutilã nu la, ti amesi wodzi le Gbɔgbɔ nu la yome tsã la, nenema ke wogale fifia hã.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Ke nuka ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔ ɖia? „Nyã kosi la kple via; elabena kosi la ƒe vi la maganyi dome kple ablɔɖenyɔnu la ƒe vi la o.“

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Eyata, noviwò, míenye kosi la ƒe viwo o, hafi boŋ ablɔɖenyɔnu la to míenye.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Ablɔɖenyenye ŋuti Kristo wɔ mí ablɔɖeviwo ɖo. Eyaŋuti minɔ tsitre sesĩe, eye migana woade kluvinyenye ƒe kɔkuti ko na mi o!

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye Paulo mele egblɔm na mi bena, nenye be, miena wotso aʋa na mi la, Kristo maganye viɖea ɖeke na mi o.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Mi amesiwo ɖi be, woatso afia na mi to sea me la, woklã mi ɖa tso Kristo gbɔ: amenuveve la sie miege le.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena míawo la Gbɔgbɔ me míele dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ la lalam le tso xɔse me.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Elabena le Kristo Yesu me la aʋatsotso mate ŋu awɔ naneke o, eye aʋamatsomatso hã nenema ke, hafi boŋ xɔse, si sẽa ŋu le bla me lae.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Mieƒu du nyuie! Ameka xe mo na mi be, miagaɖo to nyateƒe la oa?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Nyaƒoɖeamenu sia metso amesi yɔ mi la gbɔ o.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Amɔwɔ ʋaʋã via ɖe nana amɔwɔ blibo la katã ʋãna.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Nye la meɖo ŋu ɖe mia ŋu le Aƒetɔ la me bena, miele nu bubua ɖeke susu ge o; ke amesi ke blu miaƒe tame la, eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ anɔ edzi, ameka ke wòɖanye o!

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, nɔviwo, ne megale gbe ƒã ɖem aʋatsotso la, nukaŋuti wogale yonyeme tima? Ekema woɖe atitsoga ƒe nuɖiaɖia ɖa tso.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Oo, ɖe wòala amesiwo de dzi mia me la ɖa!

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Elabena, nɔviwo, woyɔ mi va ablɔɖenyenye gbɔ; ɖekoe ablɔɖenyenye la naganye mɔnunana ŋutilã o, ke boŋ misubɔ mia nɔewo le lɔlɔ̃ me!

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Elabena wowu se blibo la katã nu le nya ɖeka me, le esia me be: „Lɔ̃ hawòvi abe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene.“

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Ke ne mieɖu, eye miemi mia nɔewo la, mikpɔ nyuie, be míagatsrɔ̃ mia nɔewo o!

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm be: Miza le Gbɔgbɔ me, eye miele ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzro dzi wo ge o.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Elabena ŋutilã la dzroa nu ɖe Gbɔgbɔ la ŋuti, eye Gbɔgbɔ la ɖe ŋutilã la ŋuti; elabena esiawo tsi tre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋuti, bene miagawɔ nusiwo mielɔ̃na o.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Ke ne Gbɔgbɔ la le mia kplɔm la, miegale sea te o.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutilã ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo dze ƒã keŋ, esiwo nye: Matrewɔwɔ, ahasiwɔwɔ, makɔmakɔnyenye, hadzedze,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: dɔmevevi, hlɔ̃dodowo, ahamumuwo, aglotutuwo kple esia tɔgbewo; nusiwo gblɔm mele ɖi na mi, abe alesi megblɔ ɖi na mi xoxo la ene, bena amesiwo wo ale nusiawo la, manyi mawufiaɖuƒe la ƒe dome o.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Ke Gbɔgbɔ ƒe kutsetse enye: Lɔlɔ̃, dzidzɔ, ŋutifafa, dzigbɔgbɔ blewu, dɔmekɔkɔ, dɔmenyonyo, anukwaretɔnyenye,

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: dɔmefafa, ɖokuidzidudu; nenem nusiawo la se la metsi tre de wo ŋu o.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo nye Kristo tɔ la, woklã woƒe ŋutilã kple woƒe nudzodzro wuamenu wo kpakple ŋubiabiãwo de atitsoga ŋu.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ke ne mienɔ agbe le Gbɔgbɔ me la, minɛ míazɔ le Gbɔgbɔ me hã.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Miganɛ míaƒe ŋkuwo nabia le bubu dzodzro ŋuti o, ne míagadi ge le mia nɔewo ŋu, eye miaƒe nu nagave dɔme na mía nɔewo o.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, ne vodadaa ɖe ɖi ɖe amea ɖe hã la, mi amesiwo nye gbɔgbɔmemewo la, miɖɔ nenem me sia ɖo le dɔmefafa ƒe gbɔgbɔ la me; eye na ɖokuiwò dzi kpɔm nyuie, bene woagate wò hã akpɔ o.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Mitso mia nɔewo ƒe agbawo, eye ale míawu Kristo ƒe se la nu keŋ.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Elabena ne amea de bu bena, yenye nane, evɔ menye naneke o la, ye ŋutɔ ɖokui blem wòle.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Ke amesiame nado ye ŋutɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ akpɔ, ekema akpɔ nu aƒo adegbe le ye ŋuta ɖokui ɖeɖeko me, eye menye le ame bubu me o.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame atsa ye ŋutɔ ƒe agba.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Ke amesi wofiã nui le nya me la, nade ha kple amesi le nu fiam la, le nu nyuiwo katã me.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Migable mia dokui o; Mawu menana wòdoa hehe de eta o! Elabena nusi ke ame ƒãna la, esia ke wòaŋe.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ƒã nu ɖe eƒe ŋutilã me la, aŋe gbegblẽ atso eƒe ŋutilã me; ke amesi ƒã nu ɖe Gbɔgbɔ me la, aŋe agbe mavɔ atso Gbɔgbɔ me.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Migana ɖeɖi nate mía ŋu le nu nyui wɔwɔ me o; elabena ne míegbɔdzɔ le nu nyui wɔwɔ me o la, míaŋe nu le ye ŋutɔ ƒe azãgbe la dzi!

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti esi asinukpɔkpɔ le mía si la, mina míawɔ nu nyui na amesiame, ke vevietɔ na haxɔsetɔwo. Le aʋatsonufialawo ŋuti. Kristo ƒe atitsoga la enye gɔmedzedze kple nuwuwu.

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesi gãgã, siwo metsɔ nye ŋutɔ nye asi ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi la da!

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Ame alesi nu le didim be, yewoadze nyuie le ŋutilã me la, woawoe zi mia dzi, bena miana woatso aʋa na mi, le esia ta ko, bene woagatsɔ Kristo ƒe atitsoga la ati wo yome o.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo wotso aʋa na ŋutɔ hã, melé se la me ɖe asi o, ke boŋ wole didim be, miana yewoatso aʋa na mi, bene yewoaƒo adegbe le miaƒe ŋutilã me.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Ke nye la megava me nam bena, maƒo adegbe o, negbe le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe atitsoga la ŋuti ko, amesi me woto klã xexeame ɖe atitsoga ŋu nam, eye nye hã woklãm ɖe atitsoga ŋu na xexeame.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Elabena le Kristo Yesu me la aʋatsotso kple aʋamatsomatso siaa menye naneke o, ke nuwɔwɔ yeye boŋ.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Eye ame alesinu zɔna ɖe mɔ sia nu teƒeteƒe la: Ŋutifafa kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ava wo amesiwo nye Mawu ƒe Israel la dzi!

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Tso esia dzi la amea ɖeke megaɖe tu nam o; elabena nye la Yesu ƒe abidzesiwo le nye ŋutilã ŋu.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve nanɔ anyi kple miaƒe gbɔgbɔ la, nɔviwo! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Paulo, Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolo to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe ame kɔkɔewo kple xɔsetɔwo le Kristo Yesu me le Efeso:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, mia Fofo, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi.

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu, si nye mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo, amesi tsɔ gbɔgbɔ me yayrawo katã le dziƒonutowo me yra ɖe mia dzi le Kristo me,

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: abe alesi ke wòtia mí le eyama me, hafi wòɖo xexeame gɔme anyi ene, bene mianye kɔkɔeawo kple mokaka manɔŋutɔwo le eƒe ŋku me,

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: esi wotsɔ lɔlɔ̃ ɖo mí ɖi hena vinyenye to Yesu Kristo dzi na eɖokui le eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ƒe ŋudzedze la nu,

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: bene woakafu eƒe amenuveve ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe, esi wotsɔ ve mia nu le lɔlɔ̃vi la me,

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: esi wòna míenya eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ƒe nya ɣaɣla la le eƒe ŋudzedze, si wòɖo ɖi le eɖokui me la nu

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: hena azãgbewo ƒe ɖoɖo ƒe nuɖoanyi, bene woaƒo nuwo katã nu ƒu ade ta ɖeka te le Kristo me, nusiwo le dziƒo kple nusiwo le anyigba dzi la;

english_verse: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.
translation_verse: eya, amesi me míexɔ domenyinyi la hã le, esime woɖo mí ɖi le amesi wɔa nuwo katã le eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ƒe adaŋudede nu la, ƒe tameɖoɖoɖi la nu,

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: bene mianɔ anyi na eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le kafukafu, mí amesiwo kpɔ mɔ na Kristo gbã la,

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: amesi me miawo hã miele, esime miese nyateƒe la ƒe nya, si nye miaƒe xɔxɔ ƒe nyanyuie la, amesi me hã, esime miexɔ se la, wotre mia nu kple ŋugbedodo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la le,

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: amesi nye miaƒe domenyinyi ƒe awɔbanu hena ye ŋutɔ tɔwo ƒe ɖeɖe hena eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe kafukafu. Paulo ɖe kuku na Mawu bena, hame la natsi ɖe dzi le amenuveve me. Kristo enye hame la ƒe ta.

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Esiaŋuti nye hã, esime mese xɔse, si le mia si le Aƒetɔ Yesu me la, kple miaƒe lɔlɔ̃, si mietsɔ lɔ̃ ame kɔkɔeawo katã ŋutinya la,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: nyemedzudzɔ akpedada le mia ŋuti o, esime meɖoa ŋku mia dzi le nye kukuɖeɖewo me,

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: bena mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe Mawu, si nye ŋutikɔkɔe Fofo la, nana nunya kple nyaɖeɖefia ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la mi le eƒe sidzedze la me,

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: eye bene miaƒe dzi me ŋkuwo dzi nakɔ, bene miadze si nusi nye eƒe ameyɔyɔ la ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ, kple nusi nye domenyinyi ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe kesinɔnu la le ame kɔkɔewo me,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: kple nusi nye eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe gãnyenye, si ƒo wo katã ta la, na mí amesiwo xɔna sena le eƒe ŋusẽ gbɔgbɔ la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ la nu,

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: esi wòwɔ le Kristo me, esime wòfɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye wòtsɔe ɖo ye ŋutɔ ƒe nuɖusi me le dziƒonutowo me

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: ɖe dziɖulanyenye kple ŋusẽ kple ŋutete kple aƒetɔnyenye katã kpakple ŋkɔ sia ŋkɔ, si woyɔna la dzi, menye le ɣeyiɣi sia me ɖeɖeko o, hafi le ɣeyiɣi, si le vava ge la me hã,

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ nuwo katã de eƒe alo te, eye wòtsɔ eya ke ɖo nuwo katã ƒe ta hena hame,

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: si nye eƒe ŋutilã; eya amesi yɔ nuwo katã fũ le wo katã me la ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ la.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Eye wògba agbe miawo hã, amesiwo nye ame kukuwo le dzidadawo kple nuvɔ̃wo me,

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: esiwo me miezɔna le tsã le xexe sia me ƒe ŋɔli le nu, le yameŋusẽ ƒe fia, si nye gbɔgbɔ, si le ŋu sẽm azɔ le vi sẽtowo me la nu —

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: amesiwo dome mí katã hã miezɔna le tsã le miaƒe ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzrowo me, esime miewɔ ŋutilã kple tame ƒe lɔlɔ̃nuwo la, eye míenye dziku ƒe viwo tso dzɔdzɔ me abe ame mlɔeawo hã ene. —

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: egba agbe mi amesiwo nye ame kukuwo le dzidadawo me la, kple Kristo — amenuveve wòtso ɖe mi —

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: eye wòfɔ mi ɖe tsitre kplii, eye wòtsɔ mía kplii ɖo dziƒonutowo me le Kristo Yesu me,

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: bene le ɣeyiɣi, siwo gbɔna me la, wòaɖe ye ŋutɔ ƒe amenuveve ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ geɖe, si ƒo wo katã ta la, ɖe go afia le dɔmekɔkɔ, si wòka ɖe mía ŋu la me le Kristo Yesu me.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: (Elabena amenuveve wotsɔ ɖe mi to xɔse me, eye esia la metso mia ŋutɔwo mia me o, Mawu ƒe nunanae;

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: menye dɔwɔwɔ me wòtso o, bene amea ɖeke nagaƒo adegbe o.)

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Elabena eyama ƒe nuwɔwɔ míenye, wowɔ mí le Kristo Yesu me hena dɔ nyui wɔwɔ, siwo Mawu dzra ɖo ɖi, bene miazɔ le wo me la.

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti la miɖo ŋku edzi bena, tsã la mi amesiwo nye trɔ̃subɔlawo le ŋutilã me, amesiwo woyɔna be aʋamatsomatso le amesiwo woyɔna be aʋatsotso, si wotsɔ asi wɔ le ŋutilã me la gbɔ la,

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: bena mienɔ anyi le ɣemaɣi me Kristo menɔ mia si o, eye míenye ame tutɔwo na Israel ƒe dumetɔnyenye la kple amedzrowo na ŋugbedodo la ƒe nubablawo, eye mɔkpɔkpɔa ɖeke menɔ mia si o, eye Mawu hã menɔ mia si le xexeame o.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la miele Kristo Yesu me, mi amesiwo le adzɔge ʋĩ tsã la, miete va le Kristo ƒe ʋu la me.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Elabena eya kee nye míaƒe ŋutifafa, amesi tsɔ mí kpakple eve la katã wɔ ɖeka, eye wòmu mamã ƒe gli, si nye adikã la,

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: esi wòɖe se la ƒe sededewo le nyaɖoɖowo me la ɖa le eƒe ŋutilã me, bene wòatsɔ wo ame eve la katã awɔ ame yeye ɖeka le ye ŋutɔ ɖokui me, eye wòwɔ ŋutifafa,

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: eye wòlé avu le wo ame eve la siaa kple Mawu dome le ŋutilã ɖeka me to atitsoga me, esi wòwu adikã la le eɖokui me.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Eye wòva gblɔ ŋutifafa ƒe nyanyuie la fia mi amesiwo le adzɔge kple amesiwo le kpuiƒe la.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Elabena eyama ke me mi kpakple eve la katã míekpɔ mɔnu le Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka me la heyina Fofo la gbɔ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ míeganye ame tutɔwo kple amedzrowo o, ke boŋ míenye ame kɔkɔewo ƒe hadumeviwo kple Mawu ƒe aƒemetɔwo,

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: amesiwo wotu ɖe apostolowo kple nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo la dzi, afisi Yesu Kristo ŋutɔ nye dzogoedzikpe le,

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: amesi me wokpe xɔtutu blibo la katã ɖo, eye wòtsi zu mawuxɔ kɔkɔe le Aƒetɔ la me,

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: amesi me wotu miawo hã kpe ɖe eŋuti le, bene mianye Mawu ƒe nɔƒe le Gbɔgbɔ la me.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Esiaŋuti la nye Paulo, Yesu Kristo ƒe gatɔ le mi trɔ̃subɔlawo ŋuti la,

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: nenye ɖe miese Mawu ƒe amenuveve, si wonam le mia ta la ƒe nuɖoanyi,

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: bena le nyaɖeɖefia nu wòna menya nya ɣaɣla la, abe alesi meŋlɔ na mi kpuie va yi la ene,

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: le eya me, ne miele exlẽm la, míate ŋu adze si nye Kristo ƒe nya ɣaɣla la gɔmesese,

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: si womèna amegbetɔviwo nya le ŋɔli bubuwo me o, abe alesi woɖee fia eƒe apostolowo kple nyagblɔɖila kɔkɔewo le Gbɔgbɔ la me azɔ la ene o,

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: esi ƒe subɔla mezu le Mawu ƒe amenuvevenunana, si wòtsɔ nam la nu, le eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ, si nu sẽ la nu;

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: nye amesi nye ame kɔkɔewo katã dome suetɔ la, wotsɔ amenuveve sia na, bene magblɔ Kristo ƒe kesinɔnu, si mele nyanya tsitsotsito o da afia le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome,

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: eye bene mana keklẽ naklẽ na wo katã, bene woanya nusi nye nya ɣaɣla, si woɣla ɖe Mawu, si wɔ nuwo katã la me tso ŋɔli mavɔwo me la, ƒe nuɖoanyi la,

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: bene azɔ la woato hame dzi ana dziɖulawo kple ŋusẽtɔ, siwo le dziƒonutowo me la nanye Mawu ƒe nunya bubu ƒomevi geɖe la

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: le tameɖoɖo, si woɖo ɖi le ŋɔli mavɔwo me, esi nu wowu le Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ me la nu,

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: amesi me miekpɔ dzideƒo kple mɔnu le dziɖoɖo ɖe eŋu me to eyama dzixɔxɔse me.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti la mele kuku ɖem na mi bena, ɖeɖi nagate mia ŋu le nye xaxa, siwo mekpɔ le mia ta, esiwo nye bubu na mi la ŋuti o.

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Eyata medzea nye klo na mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo,

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: amesi gbɔ ƒome sia ƒome, si le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi la, kpɔa eƒe ŋkɔ tsonɛ,

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: bene wòaɖi na mi le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe kesinɔ la nu, bena wòado ŋusẽ mi to eƒe Gbɔgbɔ me le ememe la gome,

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: bene Kristo nanɔ anyi le miaƒe dziwo me to xɔse me,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: eye wòali ke mi, eye wòaɖo mia gɔme anyi le lɔlɔ̃ me, bene mi kpakple ame kɔkɔewo katã míate ŋu adze si nusi nye kekeme kple didime kple goglome kple kɔkɔme,

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: eye bene miadze si Kristo ƒe lɔlɔ̃, si ƒo sidzedze la ta sa la, bene woayɔ mi taŋ, ne miade Mawu ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ blibo la katã nu.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: eya tɔ nanye ŋutikɔkɔe la le ha me le Kristo Yesu me yiɖase dzidzimewo katã dzi, tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Azɔ la nye amesi nye gatɔ le Aƒetɔ la me la, mele nu xlɔ̃m mi bena, miazɔ alesi dze mia yɔyɔ, si wotsɔ yɔ mi la

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: le tamebɔbɔɖeanyi kple dɔmefafa katã me, le dzigbɔgbɔ blewu me, eye mihe adodo kple mia nɔewo le lɔlɔ̃ me,

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: eye mido vevie, bene míadzra gbɔgbɔ ƒe ɖekanyenye la ɖo le ŋutifafa ƒe nublanu la me!

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Ŋutilã ɖeka kple Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka, abe alesi ke woyɔ mi hã le mia yɔyɔ ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖeka la me ene.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖeka, xɔse ɖeka, mawutsidedeta ɖeka,

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖeka, si nye wo katã Fofo, amesi le wo katã dzi, eye wòto wo katã me, eye wòle wo katã me.

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Ke mia dome amesiamee wona amenuveve le Kristo ƒe nunana ƒe dzidzenu la nu.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Eyata wogblɔ be: „Eyi dzi me ʋĩ,“ eye woɖe aboyo aboyomewo yii, eye wòna nunanawo amewo.

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Ke esi wòyi dzi la, nukae, negbe ɖeko bena wòyi anyi me ɖe anyigba ƒe nutowo me hã hafi?

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Amesi va anyi la, eya ke ganye amesi yi dziƒowo katã ƒe dziƒo hã, bene wòayɔ nuwo katã taŋ.

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: bene woadzra ame kɔkɔewo do hena subɔsubɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ hena Kristo ƒe ŋutilã tutu,

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: halase esime mí katã miade Mawuvi la dzixɔse kple sidzedze ƒe ɖekanyenye la gbɔ, azu ŋutsu blibo, eye míade Kristo ƒe tsitsime blibo la ƒe dzidzenu la gbɔ,

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: bene míaganye ɖevi, siwo nufiafia ƒe ya sia ya ƒona yina gaƒona gbɔna, eye wònyama wo to amewo ƒe beble la me to aɖaŋu vɔ, si nu sẽ la me, le nudadafiafia ƒe amebeblemɔ la nu o,

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: ke boŋ la mianye anukwaretɔwo le lɔlɔ̃ me, eye le nusianu me míatsi ali ke ɖe Kristo, si nye ta la me,

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: amesi gbɔ wòtso wokpe ŋutilã blibo la katã, eye wobiae ɖekae, eye woto ƒunuɖeƒewo katã ƒe kpekpe ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu me, le ŋutinu sia ŋutinu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ, si womã nɛ la nu, hewu ŋutilã ƒe tsitsi la nu hena tutu le lɔlɔ̃ me. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena zɔzɔ yeye.

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
