translation_verse: Azɔ la mele esia gblɔm, eye mele ɖase ɖim le Aƒetɔ la me bena, azɔ la miagazɔ abe alesi trɔ̃subɔlawo hã zɔna le woƒe tamesusu ƒe yakanyenye me la ene o,

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: amesiwo ƒe nyasã do viviti, eye wonye amedzrowo le Mawu ƒe agbe la gome le numanyamanya, si le wo me la ŋuti, le woƒe dzimesesẽ la ŋuti,

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: amesiwo, esi woƒe dzitsinya ku atri la, wotsɔ wo ɖokui na hadzedze, bene woano makɔmakɔnyenye katã dzi le ŋukeklẽ me.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: nenye ɖe miese eŋkɔ, eye wofia nu mi le eme, alesi nyateƒe la le Yesu me;

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: bena miaɖe ame xoxo, si nɔ anyi le agbenɔnɔ tsãtɔ la nu, si gblẽa eɖokui le amebeble ƒe nudzodzrowo me la ɖa;

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: ke boŋ mina woawɔ mi yeye le miaƒe tamesusu ƒe gbɔgbɔ la me,

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: eye mido ame yeye, si wowɔ le Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme nu la, le nyateƒe la ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye kple kɔkɔenyenye la me.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti miɖe aʋatsokaka ɖi, eye amesiame nagblɔ nyateƒe na ehavi; elabena ŋutinuwo míenye na mía nɔewo.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Mibi dzi, eye migawɔ nuvɔ̃ o; ɣe la nagaɖo to ɖe miaƒe dzibibi o;

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: eye migana mɔ Abosam hã o!

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Fiafitɔ la nagafi fi o, ke boŋ nedze agbagba, ne woatso eƒe asiwo awɔ dɔ nyui, bene wòakpɔ nane aɖana hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Migana nya vloa ɖeke nado go tso miaƒe nu me gbeɖegbeɖe o, ke boŋ nya, si nyo na ŋgɔgbedede, ne ehiã la, bene wòana amenuveve amesiwo senɛ la.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Eye migawɔ nusi ave Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la o, amesi me wotre mia nu le hena xɔxɔ ƒe ŋkeke la.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Mina woaɖe veve helĩhelĩ kple dɔmedzoe kple dziku kple ɣlidodo kple busubɔbɔ katã kpakple nu tovo wɔwɔ katã hã ɖa le mia dome.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ke mikɔ dome ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu, eye miaƒe dɔme natrɔ ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu, eye mitso ke mia nɔewo, abe alesi Mawu tso ke mi le Kristo me la ene.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Azɔ la mizu mawusrɔ̃lawo abe lɔlɔ̃viwo ene,

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: eye mizɔ le lɔlɔ̃ me, abe alesi Kristo hã lɔ̃ mi, eye wòtso eɖokui hena ɖe mia ta, bene wòanye nunana kple vɔsa na Mawu, bene wòanye ʋeʋẽ lilili nyui la ene.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Ke ahasiwɔwɔ kple makɔmakɔnyenye katã alo ŋukeklẽ la womagayɔ eŋkɔ gɔ̃ hã le mia dome o, abe alesi wòdze ame kɔkɔewo ene,

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: kple ŋukpeanu kple yakanyagbɔgblɔwo kple atsaƒoƒo, siwo medze o, negbe akpedada boŋ.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Elabena mi amesiwo nye sidzelawo, mienyae bena, ahasiwɔla alo ame makɔmakɔ alo ŋuklẽla, si so kple trɔ̃subɔla la, domenyinyia ɖeke meli na wo dometɔa ɖeke le Kristo kple Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me o.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Migana amea ɖeke natsɔ nya ƒuƒlu able mi o; elabena nusia ŋuti Mawu ƒe dziku la va vi sẽtowo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Eyata migazu woƒe hadelawo o;

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Mizɔ abe kekeliviwo ene! Elabena kekeli ƒe kutsetse la le dɔmenyonyo kple dzɔdzɔenyenye kple nyateƒe katã me.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Mido nusi nyoa Aƒetɔ la ŋu la kpɔ,

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: eye migade ha kple viviti me dɔwɔwɔ, siwo metsea ku o la o, ke mihe nya ɖe wo ŋu boŋ.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Elabena nusiwo wowɔ le ɣaɣlaƒe la, enye ŋukpe be woaƒo nu le wo ŋuti gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti la wogblɔ be: Nyɔ, wò amesi le alɔ̃ dɔm la, ne natsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye Kristo ahlẽ ɖe dziwò!

english_verse: Act like people with good sense and not like fools.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti la mikpɔ nyuie be, miazɔ pɛpɛpɛ; menye abe numanyamanyatɔwo ene o, ke boŋ abe nunyalawo ene,

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: amesiwo wɔa ɣeyiɣi la ŋuti da blibo, elabena ŋkekeawo nye vɔ̃.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti la migazu bometsilawo o, ke boŋ midze si nusi nye Aƒetɔ la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Eye migamu aha, esi me nu baɖabaɖa wɔwɔ le la o; ke boŋ Gbɔgbɔ la nayɔ mi fũ,

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: eye mitso Psalmowo kple kafukafuhawo kpakple gbɔgbɔ me hawo ƒo nu kple mia nɔewo: Midzi ha, eye miƒo ha na Aƒetɔ la le miaƒe dzi me,

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: eye mida akpe na Mawu, Fofo la, ɖaahe le nuwo katã ŋuti le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ la me,

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi nyɔnuwo la, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia ŋutɔwo mia srɔ̃wo abe Aƒetɔ la ene;

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: elabena ŋutsue nye ta na nyɔnu, abe alesi Kristo hã nye ta na hame la ene, eye eyae nye ŋutilã la ƒe xɔla.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Gake la alesi hame la bɔbɔa eɖokui na Kristo la, nenema ke nyɔnuwo hã nawɔ na woawo ŋutɔ wo srɔ̃wo le nuwo katã me.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Mi ŋutsuwo la, milɔ̃ mia ŋutɔwo mia srɔ̃wo, abe alesi Kristo hã lɔ̃ hame la, eye wòtso ye ŋutɔ ɖokui hena ɖe eta la ene,

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: bene yeakɔ eŋu, esime wòklɔ eŋuti to tsilele me le nya la me megbe la,

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: bene ye ŋuta natsɔe aɖo tsitre na eɖokui wòanye ŋutikɔkɔehame, si ŋuti ɖiƒoƒoa ɖeke alo ayilélea ɖeke alo nusiawo ƒe ɖeke naganɔ o, ke boŋ la, bene wòana kokoe, eye mokakaa ɖeke naganɔ eŋuti o;

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Nenema ke wòle na ŋutsuwo be, woalɔ̃ woa ŋutɔwo wo srɔ̃wo abe woa ŋutɔwo ƒe ŋutilãwo ene. Amesi lɔ̃a ye ŋutɔ srɔ̃ la, elɔ̃a eɖokui;

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: elabena amea ɖeke melé fu ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã kpɔ o, ke boŋ enyinɛ, eye wòkpɔa edzi, abe alesi Aƒetɔ la wona na hame la ene;

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: elabena eƒe ŋutilã ƒe ŋutinuwo míenye, fefe ŋutilã kple eƒe ƒuawo me mietso.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: „Eyata ŋutsu agblẽ fofoa kple dadaa ɖi, eye wòalé ɖe srɔ̃a ŋuti, eye wo kpakple eve la katã woanye ŋutilã ɖeka.

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Nya ɣaɣla sia lolo, ke nye la mele egblɔm le Kristo kple hame la ŋuti.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Ke miawo hã mia dome ɖesiaɖe nalɔ̃ ye ŋutɔ srɔ̃anyɔnu nenema ke, abe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui ene; ke nyanu la nasi srɔ̃a ɖa.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Mi ɖeviwo la, miɖo to mia dzilawo le Aƒetɔ la me, elabena esia le eteƒe.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: „bene wòanyo na wò, eye nana agbe didie le anyigba dzi!“

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Eye mi fofowo la, migado dziku na mia viwo o, ke miayi wo le Aƒetɔ la ƒe hehe kple nuxɔxlɔ̃ la me.

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Mi dɔlawo la, miɖo to mia aƒetɔwo le ŋutilã nu kple vavã kpakple dzodzo nyanyanya le miaƒe dzimekɔkɔ me abe Kristo ene,

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: menye le ŋku me nuwɔwɔ me abe ameŋudzelawo ene o, ke boŋ abe Kristo ƒe dɔla, siwo woa Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu tso dzi me la ene:

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: mitsɔ lɔlɔ̃nu nyui hesubɔ, abe Aƒetɔ lae miesubɔna ene, eye menye amewo o,

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: esi mienyae bena, nu nyui, si ke amesiame wɔna la, eya ke wòaxɔ tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ, nenye dɔla alo ablɔɖevi.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Eye mi aƒetɔwo, miwo nusiawo tɔgbe ke na wo; midzudzɔ ŋɔdzidodo, esi miawo hã mienyae be, mia kpli wo siaa ƒe Aƒetɔ la le dziƒo, eye ŋkumekpɔkpɔa ɖeke mele egbɔ o la ŋuti. Gbɔgbɔ me na wɔnuwo.

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔvinyewo, mise ŋu le Aƒetɔ kple eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe ŋutete la me!

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Mido Mawu ƒe aʋawɔnu blibo la katã, bene míate ŋu ano te ɖe Abosam ƒe aɖaŋu vɔ̃wo nu;

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: elabena míele kame tem kple ʋu kpakple ŋutilã o, ke boŋ mía kple dziɖulanyenye kple ŋusẽ kple xexe sia me fia, siwo le fifi viviti sia me kpakple vɔɖinyenye ƒe gbɔgbɔ, siwo le dziƒonutowo me lae le kame tem.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Eyata mikpla Mawu ƒe aʋawɔnu blibo la katã, bene míate ŋu anɔ te le ŋkeke vɔ̃ la dzi, eye ne miewu wo katã nu vɔ la, miakpɔ tsitrenɔnɔ.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Azɔ la mitsi tre, eye mitsɔ nyateƒe bla miaƒe aliwo dzi, eye mido dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe akɔtakpoxɔnu,

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: eye mitso dzadzraɖoɖi na ŋutifafa nyanyuie la bla miaƒe afɔ gɔme.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe nusiawo katã ŋuti la milé xɔse ƒe akpoxɔnu, si miate ŋu atsɔ atsi vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe atsurɔ bibiawo la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Eye miɖo xoxo ƒe gakuku la, eye mihe Gbɔgbɔ ƒe yi, si nye mawunya la, ɖe asi.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ gbedodoɖa kple kukuɖeɖewo katã do gbe ɖa le ɣeawokatãɣi me le Gbɔgbɔ me, eye eyaŋuti minɔ ŋudzɔ, ne mianɔ kukuɖeɖewo dzi ɖaahe ɖe ame kɔkɔewo katã ta

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: kple nye hã lanye, bena ne meke nu la, woatsɔ nya nam, bene makpe dzideƒo ana woanya nyanyuie la ƒe nya ɣaɣla,

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: esi ŋuti menye ame dɔdɔ le kɔsɔkɔsɔ me, bene dzi nado ƒonye le eme, abe alesi wòdzem be, maƒo nu ene. Nuwunyawo.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa kple lɔlɔ̃ kple xɔse, si tso Mawu, Fofo la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana nɔviawo.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Amenuveve nanɔ anyi kple amesiwo katã lɔ̃a mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ɖikaɖika la.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Paulo kple Timoteo, Yesu Kristo ƒe dolawo, ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe ame kɔkɔe, siwo katã le Kristo Yesu me le Filipi la, kple dzikpɔlawo kple subɔlawo hã:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, mía Fofo, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi!

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawunye le nye ŋkuɖoɖo, siwo katã meɖoa mia dzi la me —

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: ɖaasi le nye kukuɖeɖe, siwo katã meɖena le mi katã mia ta la me, eye metso dzidzo ɖea kuku —

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: le miaƒe hadede, si le nyanyuie la me tso ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi vaseɖe fifi la ŋuti,

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: esia ke ŋuti meɖoa ŋu ɖo bena, amesi dze do nyui wɔwɔ gɔme le mia me la, eya ke awu enu vaseɖe Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi,

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: abe alesi wòdzo nam bena, masusu esia le mi katã mia ŋuti ene; elabena miele nye dzi me le nye kɔsɔkɔsɔwo kple nyanyuie la taʋiʋli kpakple kakaɖedzi la me; elabena mi katã míenye nye hagomekpɔlawo le amenuveve la me.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawue nye nye ɖaseɖila, alesi mi katã miele dzroyem vevie le Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔmetɔtrɔ la me.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Eye esia ŋuti medoa gbe ɖa ɖo, bena miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ la nana agbɔ sɔm ɖe dzi wu le sidzedze kple dzimenusese katã me,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: bena miate ŋu ade vovo nyui kple vɔ̃ dome, ne mianye ame dzadzɛwo kple nuɖiaɖia manɔŋuitɔwo ɖe Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la ŋu,

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: bene dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe ku, si wotsena to Yesu Kristo dzi la, nayɔ mi fũ hena Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple kafukafu.

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Ke mele didim bena, mianyae, nɔviwo, bena nusiwo va dzo ɖe dzinye la, tra zu nyanyuie la ƒe dziyiyi nyui la boŋ,

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: ale bena nye bablawo dze ƒã le Kristo me ɖe asrafomɔ̃ blibo la katã me kple ame mamleawo katã gbɔ,

english_verse: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
translation_verse: eye nɔviwo dome ame geɖeawo ɖo ŋu ɖe nye bablawo ŋu le Aƒetɔ la me, eye wowɔa kalẽ geɖe wu tsã le mawunyagbɔgblɔ me mavɔ̃mavɔ̃e.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Hafi amea ɖewo ɖea gbe ƒã Kristo le ŋuʋaʋã kple dzrewɔwɔ ŋuti; ke amea ɖewo hã ɖea gbe ƒãe le tameɖoɖo nyui ŋuti:

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Amesiawo gblɔnɛ tso lɔlɔ̃ me; elabena wonyae be, nyanyuie la taʋiʋli ŋuti mele afisia ɖo.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Ame kemeawo gblɔa Kristo fiana tso dzrewɔwɔ me, menye tso dzadzɛnyenye me o; elabena wosusuna be, yewoatsɔ xaxa akpe ɖe nye bablawo ŋuti.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Ekema nukae ma? Ne wowɔe le mo sia mɔ dzi, eɖanye le alakpa alo nyateƒe me o, nenye Kristo koe wogblɔna fiana la, dzi le dzɔyem le esia ŋuti. Ẽ, dzi agadzɔm hã;

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: elabena menyae bena, esia atrɔ zu agbexɔxɔ nam to miaƒe kukuɖeɖe kple Yesu Kristo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu me,

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: le nye lala vevie kple mɔkpɔkpɔ la nu be, ŋu nagakpem le naneke me o, hafi boŋ metsɔa dzideƒo blibo la katã bena, alesi wònɔna ɖaa la, nenema ke wòano fifia hã, be woawɔ Kristo gã ɖe nye ŋutilã ŋuti, eɖanye agbe me alo ku me o.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Elabena nye la Kristo enye agbe nam, eye ku enye viɖe nam.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Ke ne nye agbenɔnɔ le ŋutilã me na nye dɔwɔwɔ tsea ku la, nyemenya nusi matia le eme o.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Elabena mexaxa ɖe nusiawo kpakple eve dome: Ele dzroyem be, madzo ayi aɖana Kristo gbɔ, elabena esia nyo wu sã;

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Eye esia ke ŋuti meɖoa ŋu ɖo, eye menyae bena, manɔ anyi, eye mía kpli mi katã míanɔ anyi hena miaƒe xɔse ƒe ŋgɔgbedede nyui kple dzidzɔ,

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: bena miaƒe adegbeƒoƒo la nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi le Kristo Yesu me le tanye to esia me, bena magava mia gbɔ.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Ɖeko mizɔ, abe alesi wòdze na Kristo ƒe nyanyuie la ene, bena ne mava, eye makpɔ mi ɖa, alo ne nyemele mia gbɔ o, eye mase mia ŋkɔ la, bena miano tsitre le gbɔgbɔ ɖeka me, eye miatso luʋɔ ɖeka aʋli nyanyuie ƒe xɔse la ta hekpe ɖe mia nɔewo ŋuti;

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: eye migaɖi vo le naneke me le miaƒe adikãtɔwo ŋuti o, esi nye gbegblẽ ƒe dzesi na wo, ke miawo la agbexɔxɔ ƒe dzesi wònye na mi, eye esia tso Mawu gbɔ;

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: elabena eɖi na mi le Kristo ta bena, menye ɖe miexɔ Kristo dzi se ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ miekpea fu le eta hã;

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: elabena ʋiʋli ma ke, si miekpɔ le ŋunye, eye azɔ miesenɛ le ŋutinye la, le miawo hã mia si.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Azɔ la ne nuxɔxlɔ̃a ɖe li le Kristo me, ne lolo ƒe dziɖeƒonyaa ɖe li, ne gbɔgbɔ ƒe hadedea ɖe li, ne dɔmetɔtrɔa ɖe kple nublanuikpɔkpɔa ɖe li la,

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: ekema miyɔ nye dzidzɔ la fũ, bene miaƒe tamesusu nana ɖeka, le esi lɔlɔ̃ ɖeka ma ke le mia si, eye mietsɔa gbɔgbɔ ɖeka susua nu ɖeka la ŋuti,

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: migawɔ naneke le dzrewɔwɔ alo bubu dzodzro ta o, ke boŋ mia dome amesiame natso ɖokuibɔbɔ abu nɔvia gã wu ye ŋutɔ ɖokui;

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: amesiame nagakpɔ nusi nye ye ŋutɔ to dzi o, ke boŋ nekpɔ nusi nye ame bubu to la hã dzi!

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Mina susu ma ke, si nɔ Kristo Yesu hã me la, nanɔ miawo hã mia me,

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: amesi esi wònye Mawu ƒe nɔnɔmee wòna hã la, mebui nuhahae bena, eye kple Mawu so o,

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: ke boŋ eɖi gbɔlo eɖokui, esime wòtsɔ dɔla ƒe nɔnɔme ɖo eɖokui dzi, hedzɔ ɖe amewo ƒe nɔnɔme, eye wokpɔ nuwɔna le eŋuti abe ame to ene.

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: Ebɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi, eye wòɖo to yiɖase ku me, yiɖase atitsoga ŋuti ku la me ke.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Esia ke ŋuti hã Mawu do eyama ɖe dzi kakaka, eye wòtsɔ ŋkɔ, si ƒo ŋkɔ sia ŋkɔ ta la kee,

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: bene amesiwo le dziƒo kple amesiwo le anyigba dzi kple amesiwo le anyigba te la, katã nadze klo le Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ la me,

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: eye aɖe sia aɖe naʋu me bena, Yesu Kristo enye Aƒetɔ la hena Mawu Fofoa ƒe kafukafu.

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, abe alesi mieɖoa to ɖaasi ene la, mitsɔ vɔvɔ̃ kple dzodzo nyanyanya wo mia ŋutɔwo miaƒe xɔxɔdɔ la; menye abe esime menɔ mia gbɔ ene la ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ azɔ, esi nyemele mia gbɔ o la, miwɔe geɖe wu!

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu enye amesi wɔa didi kple nuwɔwɔ siaa le mia me le eƒe ŋudzedze la ŋuti.

english_verse: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.
translation_verse: Miwo nuwo katã liʋiliʋilili kple ɖikeke manɔmee,

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: bena miazu mokaka manɔŋutɔwo kple ame dzadzɛwo, mawuvi, siwo nye ame maɖifɔwo le dzidzime gɔglɔ̃ totro kpaɖikpaɖi titina, amesiwo dome mieklẽna le abe akaɖiwo ene le xexeame,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: esi me mieléa agbenya la ɖe asi le hena nye adegbeƒoƒo le Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi, bena nyemeƒu du dzodzro, eye nyemedze agbagba dzodzro hã o.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Ke ne wotsɔm mè le miaƒe xɔse ƒe vɔsasa kple subɔsubɔdɔ ta hã la, dzi le dzɔyem, eye mía kpli mi katã míele dzidzo kpɔm.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Ke nenema ke miawo hã dzi nedzɔ mi, eye mikpɔ dzidzo kpakplim! Alesi woaxɔ Timoteo kple Epafrodito.

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Ke mele mɔ kpam le Aƒetɔ Yesu me bena, madɔ Timoteo aɖo ɖe mia gbɔ kpuie, bena ne menya miaƒe anyinɔnɔme la, nye hã nye dzi nadze eme.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Elabena amea ɖeke mele asinye, si ƒe tamesusu sɔ kple etɔ, amesi alé be na mi le nyateƒe me la o;

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: elabena wo kalẽ la woa ŋutɔwo tɔ dim wole, eye menye nusi nye Yesu Kristo tɔ o.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ke mienya eƒe kelili bena, abe vi kple tɔ ene la, nenema wòsubɔ kplim le nyanyuie la me.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Azɔ la mele mɔ kpɔm bena, madɔ eya ke aɖo ɖa enumake, esi manya alesi nye nya la lanɔ;

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: ke meɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ la ŋu bena, nye ŋutɔ hã mava kpuie.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Gake la mebu bena, ele vevie be, madɔ nɔvinye Epafrodito, si nye hanyedɔwɔla kple hanyeʋawɔla kple miaƒe apostolo kpakple nye nuhiahiã ƒe dɔla la, aɖo ɖe mi;

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: elabena edzroe vevie be, yeakpɔ mi katã, eye wòxa nu ŋutɔ bena, miese eŋkɔ be, dɔ dze edzi.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Eye elé dɔ vavã de kuku ge kloe; gake la Mawu kpɔ nublanui nɛ, ke menye na eya ŋutɔ ɖeɖekoe o, hafi na nye hã, bene nyemagakpɔ nuxaxa ɖe nuxaxa dzi o.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti meɖoe ɖa kaba wu bena, ne miegakpɔe la, míakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye nye hã nye nuxaxa dzi nagaka aɖe.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti la mixɔe le Aƒetɔ la me kple dzidzɔ katã, eye mibu amesiawo tɔgbe.

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: Elabena Kristo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋuti wòde kuku ge ɖo kloe, eye wòtsɔ eƒe agbe ke, bene wòawɔ subɔsubɔdɔ, si susɔ ɖe mia ŋu la, nam ɖe mia teƒe.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔvinyewo, dzi nadzɔ mi le Aƒetɔ la me! Nye la metim bena, maŋlɔ nu mawo ke aɖo ɖe mi o; ke miawo la ena kakaɖedzi mi.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie le avũawo ŋuti, mikpɔ nyuie le dɔwɔla vɔ̃wo ŋuti, mikpɔ nyuie le aʋatsotso vlo ŋuti!

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Elabena mi amesiwo subɔa Mawu le gbɔgbɔ me la, miawoe nye aʋatsotso vavãtɔ la, eye míeƒoa adegbe le Kristo Yesu me, eye míeɖoa dzi ɖe ŋutilã ŋuti o.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: Wònye nye la ŋuɖoɖo ɖe ŋutilã ŋu gɔ̃ hã anɔ asinye hafi, ne ame bubua ɖe bu bena, yeate ŋu aɖo dzi ɖe ŋutilã ŋuti la, nye la mewui;

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke enviagbe wotso aʋa nam, metso Israel dukɔ la me, tso Benyamin ƒe to la me, Hebritɔ tso Hebritɔwo me; le sea nu la farisitɔ menye;

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: le ŋuʋaʋã nu la hame yometila menye; le dzɔdzɔenyenye, si le sea me nu la mokaka manɔŋutɔ menye.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Gake nusiwo nye viɖe nam la, nu mawo ke mebu nu bubu le Kristo ŋuti.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Ẽ, fifi gɔ̃ mebu wo katã nu bubu le Kristo Yesu, nye Aƒetɔ nyanya, si ƒo wo katã ta la ŋuti, amesi ta meɖe asi le nusiawo katã ŋuti ɖo, eye mebu wo aɖukpo dzi nuwoe, bena nye asi nasu Kristo dzi,

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: eye woakpɔm le eyama me, bena nye ŋutɔ nye dzɔdzɔenyenye, si tso sea me la, naganɔ asinye o, ke boŋ esi to Kristo dzixɔse me, dzɔdzɔenyenye, si tso Mawu gbɔ le dzixɔse ta la nana asinye,

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: bene madze si eyama kple eƒe tsitretsitsi ƒe ŋusẽ kple eƒe fukpekpewo ƒe hadede, eye masɔ kplii le eƒe ku me,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: negbe godo la made ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi la gbɔ.

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Menye ɖe nye asi su edzi xoxo, alo mezu blibo xoxo o; ke eyome tim mele, bena negbe ɖeko nye asi lasu nusi ke ŋuti Kristo hã ƒe asi su dzinye ɖo la dzi.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nye ŋuta nyemebu ɖokuinye bena, nye asi su edzi haɖe o.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Ke nu ɖeka ko menya: Nusiwo le megbenye la, meŋlɔ wo be, hafi nusiwo le ŋgɔnye la, nyãm mele, mele dzesiɖoƒe yome tim yiɖase Mawu ƒe ameyɔyɔ le dziƒo ƒe dziɖuɖufetu la dzi le Kristo Yesu me. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena dziɖuɖufetu yometiti.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti ame alesi nu le blibo le mía dome la, minɛ míasusu esia ke, eye ne miesusua nu bubu le nane me la, Mawu aɖe esia ke hã afia mi.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Gake nusi dzi miesu xoxo la, minɛ míazɔ ɖe mo ma ke nu, eye míaƒe tamesusu nana ɖeka.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Mizu hanyesrɔ̃lawo, nɔviwo, eye milé ŋku ɖe amesiwo zɔna nenema ke la ŋuti, abe alesi míenye kpɔɖeŋu na mi ene:

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Elabena ame geɖewo zɔna, amesiwo ŋutinya megblɔ na mi enuenu; gake azɔ la metsɔ avifafa le egblɔm bena, Kristo ƒe atitsoga ƒe futɔwo wonye.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Amesiwo ƒe nuwuwu enye gbegblẽ, amesiwo ƒe ƒodo nye mawu na wo, eye woƒe kafukafu le woƒe ŋukpenanuwo me, amesiwo susua anyigbadzinuwo ŋuti ɖeɖeko.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Ke miaƒe dumetɔnyenye le dziƒo, afisi hã miele xɔla, si nye Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la, lalam tso,

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: amesi aɖuɖɔ miaƒe bɔbɔɖeanyiŋutilã ƒe nɔnɔme, bene wòaɖi eƒe ŋutikɔkɔeŋutilã le eƒe ŋusesẽ, si ta wòlea ŋu tsɔa nuwo katã dea eɖokui te la nu.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Eyata, nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔ, siwo le dzroyem, nye dzidzɔ kple nye fiakuku la, minɔ tsitre sesĩe nenema le Aƒetɔ la me, nye lɔlɔ̃viwo!

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Mele nu xlɔ̃m Ewodia, eye mele nu xlɔ̃m Sintixe, bena woƒe tamesusu nanɔ ɖeka le Aƒetɔ la me.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Ẽ, mele kuku dem na wò hã, hanyedɔwɔla vevi, bena naxɔ na nyɔnu siawo; elabena wodze agbagba le nyanyuie la la hekpe ɖe mía kple Klemens kpakple hanyedɔwɔla susɔeawo, amesiwo, ŋkɔwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbegbalẽa me la ŋuti.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Dzi nadzɔ mi le Aƒetɔ la me ɖaasi; megale egblɔm bena: Dzi nadzɔ mi!

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Amewo katã nanya miaƒe tufafa! Aƒetɔ la gogo.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Migatsi dzimaɖi le naneke ŋuti o, ke boŋ le nusianu me la mitsɔ gbedodoɖa kple kukuɖeɖe na Mawu nanya miaƒe dzimedidiwo, eye mitsɔ akpedada kpe ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Eye Mawu ƒe ŋutifafa, si ƒo gɔmesesewo katã ta la, adzɔ miaƒe dziwo kple miaƒe tamesusuwo ŋu adzra wo ɖo le Kristo Yesu me.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, nusiwo nye nyateƒe, nusiwo dzea bubu, nusiwo le dzɔdzɔe, nusiwo le dzadzɛ, nusiwo dze na lɔlɔ̃, nusiwo dze na gbɔgblɔ, ne nudzeamewɔwɔa ɖe li, eye ne kafukafua ɖe li la, misusu nusiawo ŋuti!

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Nusiwo hã miesrɔ̃, eye miexɔ, eye miese, eye miekpɔ le gbɔnye la, nusiawo ke miwɔ, eye ŋutifafa Mawu la anɔ anyi kpli mi. Apostolo la da akpe na Filipitɔwo le dɔmenyonunana, si woɖo ɖee la ŋuti.

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Ke mekpɔ dzidzɔ geɖe le Aƒetɔ la me bena, azɔ la miagakpɔ ŋusẽ yeye hesusu nusi nyo nam, nusi ŋuti miesusu hã, ke ɣeyiɣi la sesẽ na mi.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Menye ɖe megblɔ esia le hiahiã ŋuti o; elabena nye la mesrɔ̃e bena, anyinɔnɔ, si ke me mele la, nadze ŋunye.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Menya alesi mabɔbɔ ɖokuinye de anyi, eye meganya alesi makpɔ nu geɖe hã; le nusianu kple nuwo katã me la nasrɔ̃ nu ɣaɣla sia bena, maɖi ƒo, eye dɔ nawum hã, makpɔ nu geɖe, eye hiã natum hã.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Metea ŋu wɔa nuwo katã le Kristo, amesi doa ŋusẽm la me.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Gake la miewɔe nyuie be, miexɔ nam le nye xaxa me.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Ke, mi Filipitɔwo hã, mienyae bena, le nyanyuie la ƒe gɔmedzedzea me, esi medzo le Makedonia la, hamea ɖeke mekpe de ŋunye le nunana kple nuxɔxɔ ƒe akɔnta gome o, negbe miawo ɖeɖekoe,

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: eye esime menɔ Tesalonika gɔ̃ hã la, miedo nusi wo hiãm la ɖem zi ɖeka kple zi eve.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Menye be, mele nane dim o, ke boŋ mele didim bena, kutsetse nasɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi na miaƒe akɔnta.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ke nuwo katã le asinye, eye megba go; elabena esi mexɔ miawo tso mia gbɔ to Epafrodito si me, nusiwo nye ʋeʋẽ lilili kple vɔsasa nyui, si dze Mawu ŋu la, meyɔ fũ.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Ke nye Mawu la ana miaƒe hiahiã katã nazu nukpɔkpɔ taŋtaŋ le eƒe kesinɔ la nu le ŋutikɔkɔe me le Kristo Yesu me.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ke Mawu, mia Fofo la tɔ nanye kafukafu tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen. Agbalẽ la ƒe nuwuwu-kple yayradinamenyawo.

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ ame kɔkɔewo katã nam ƒã le Kristo Yesu me! Nɔvi, siwo le gbɔnye la, ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Ame kɔkɔewo katã ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã, vevietɔ amesiwo tso kaisaro ƒe me la.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve nanɔ anyi kpli mi! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Paulo, Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolo to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, kple nɔvi Timoteo la

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe ame kɔkɔe, siwo le Kolose kple nɔvi, siwo nye xɔsetɔwo le Kristo me la: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, mía Fofo, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbã la, woana mi! Akpedada kple gbedodoɖa le Kolosetɔwo ƒe xɔse ta.

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Míeɖa akpe na Mawu, si nye mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo la, ɖaasi le míaƒe gbedodoɖa ɖe mia ta la me,

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: esime miese miaƒe Kristo Yesu dzixɔse kple lɔlɔ̃, si mietso lɔ̃ ame kɔkɔewo katã la,

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: le mɔkpɔkpɔ, si wodzra ɖo na mi le dziƒowo me, si miese tsã le nyanyuie ƒe nyateƒenya la me la ŋuti,

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: esi va mia gbɔ, abe alesi wòle xexe blibo la katã hã me ene, eye wòtsea ku, eye wotsina, abe alesi wòle le miawo hã mia dome tso ŋkeke ma, si dzi miese, eye miedze si Mawu ƒe amenuveve le nyateƒe me la ene,

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: abe alesi miesrɔ̃e hã le Epafra, mia hadɔwɔla lɔlɔ̃tɔ, si nye Kristo ƒe subɔla nyateƒetɔ na mi la gbɔ ene;

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Eyata míawo hã, tso ŋkeke, si dzi míesee la, míedzudzɔ gbedodoɖa kple kukuɖeɖe ɖe mia ta o, bene eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ƒe sidzedze nayɔ mi fũ le gbɔgbɔ ƒe nunya kple gɔmesese katã me,

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: bene miazu alesi dze Aƒetɔ la hena eƒe ŋudzedze katã, miatse ku le dɔ nyui sia do nyui wɔwɔ me,

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: eye miatsi le sidzedze Mawu me, eye wòado ŋusẽ mi kple ŋusẽ katã lé eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ŋutete la nu hena dzidodo kple dzigbɔgbɔ blewu katã;

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: eye mitsɔ dzidzɔ da akpe na Fofo, si na miedze ame kɔkɔewo ƒe domenyinyi ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ le kekeli la me,

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: amesi ɖe mí tso viviti ƒe ŋusẽ la me, eye wòtsɔ mí ɖo eƒe lɔlɔ̃vi ƒe fiaduƒe la me,

english_verse: who forgives our sins and sets us free.
translation_verse: amesi me míekpɔ fexexeɖeta, si nye nuvɔ̃keke la le,

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: amesi nye Mawu makpɔmakpɔ ƒe nɔnɔme kple nuwɔwɔwo katã ƒe ŋgɔgbevi la. Kristo kple eƒe nyanyuie la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Elabena wowɔ nuwo katã le eya ke me, nusiwo le dziƒowo kple nusiwo le anyigba dzi; nusiwo wokpɔna kple nusiwo womekpɔna o; eɖanye fiazikpuiwo o; alo aƒetɔnyenyewo o; eɖanye dziɖulanyenyewo o alo ŋusẽwo o: Wowɔ nuwo katã to eyama me, eye wowɔ wo hena eyama,

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: eye eyama tre dzɔdzɔ na nuwo katã, eye nuwo katã nɔa anyi le eyama me,

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: eye eyamae nye ŋutilã, si nye hame la ƒe ta, amesi nye gɔmedzedze kple ŋgɔgbevi tso ame kukuwo dome, bene wòanye gbãtɔ na nuwo katã;

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: elabena edze Mawu ŋu bena, agbɔsɔsɔ blibo la katã nanɔ eyama me,

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: eye wòto eyama dzi lé avu le nuwo katã kple eɖokui dome, esi wòto eƒe atitsoga ƒe ʋu la me wɔ ŋutifafa kple nusiwo le anyigba dzi kpakple nusiwo le dziƒowo la, to eyama dzi.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Eye mi amesiwo nye ame tutɔwo kple ketɔwo le miaƒe tamesusu me le dɔwɔwɔ vɔ̃wo me tsã la;

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: ke azɔ la elé avu le mia kplii dome le eƒe anyigba dzi ŋutilã la me to ku me, bene woatsɔ mi aɖo kɔkɔetɔwo kple mokaka manɔŋutɔwo kpakple fɔmabumabutɔwo le eƒe ŋku me,

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: nenye bena, mienɔ xɔse me, abe amesiwo gɔme wodo anyi, eye wole tsitre sesĩe ene, eye miagana woate mi ɖa tso nyanyuie ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ, si miese, si woɖe gbe ƒã na nuwɔwɔwo katã le dziƒo te, esi ƒe subɔla nye Paulo mezu la me o.

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Azɔ la mekpɔa dzidzɔ le fu, siwo mekpena le mia ta la me, eye mewua nusiwo susɔ le Kristo ƒe fukpekpewo me la nu le nye ŋutilã me, le eƒe ŋutilã, si enye hame la ta,

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: esi ƒe subɔla mezu le Mawu ƒe xɔnuvinyenye, si wonam le mia ta la nu, bena mawu mawunya ƒe do la nu:

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Nya ɣaɣla, si woɣla ɖi tso ŋɔli mavɔwo kple dzidzimewo me ke; ke azɔ la eɖee fia eƒe ame kɔkɔewo,

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: amesiwo Mawu ɖi be, yeana woanya nusi nye nya ɣaɣla sia ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe kesinɔnyenye le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome, si nye Kristo le mia me, amesi nye ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ,

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: amesi míawo míele gbe ƒã ɖem hele nu xlɔ̃m amesiame, eye míele nu fiam amesiame le nunya sia nunya me, bene miaɖo amesiame anyi blibo le Kristo me:

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: nusi ta hã medzea agbagba ɖo, eye metsina le eƒe ŋusesẽ, si sẽa ŋu ŋusẽtɔe le menye la nu.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Elabena mele didim be, mianya alesi meʋlina ŋutɔ le mia kple amesiwo le Laodikea kpakple ame alesi nu mekpɔ ŋkunye me le ŋutilã me o la ta,

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: bene woafa akɔ na woƒe dziwo, eye woabia wo ɖeka le lɔlɔ̃ me hena gɔmesese ƒe kakaɖedzi blibo ƒe kesinɔnyenye katã, bena woadze si Mawu, Fofo, kple Kristo ƒe nya ɣaɣla la,

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: amesi me woɣla nunya kple sidzedze ƒe kesinɔnuwo katã ɖo.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Ke esia gblɔm mele bena, amea ɖeke nagable mi kple nyaƒoƒoɖeamenu o.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Elabena ne nyemele mia gbɔ ɖe ŋutilã me o hã la, mele mia gbɔ le gbɔgbɔ me, eye dzi le dzoyem, esi mekpea miaƒe ɖoɖo kple miaƒe Kristo dzixɔse ƒe kelili.

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Azɔ abe alesi míexɔ Kristo Yesu, Aƒetɔ la, nenema ke mizɔ le eyama me,

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: eye mianye amesiwo do ke, eye wotu wo ɖe eyama me, eye woli ke wo ɖe xɔse me, abe alesi wofia mi ene, eye miagba go le akpedada me.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie, bena amea ɖeke nagakplɔ mi ayi aboyo to xexemenunya kple beble dzodzro me o, le amewo ƒe nuɖoanyi kple xexeme ƒe gɔmedzenuwo la nu, eye menye le Kristo nu o.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: eye woyɔ mi taŋ le eyama, si nye ta na dziɖulanyenye kple ŋusẽwo katã la me,

english_verse: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
translation_verse: amesi me wotso aʋa na mi le hã kple aʋatsotso, si menye asi wotsɔ tsoe o, to ŋutilã ƒe ame blibo la ƒe ɖeɖeɖa me le Kristo ƒe aʋatsotso me,

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: eye woɖi mi kpakplii le mawutsidedetaname me, amesi me wofɔ mi ɖe tsitre hã le to Mawu, si fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la ƒe ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔ dzixɔse la me.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Eye mi, amesiwo nye ame kukuwo le dzidadawo kple miaƒe ŋutilã ƒe aʋamatsomatso me la, egbɔ agbe mi kpakplii hã, esi wotsɔ dzidadawo katã ke mi,

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: esi wòtutu ŋɔŋlɔ, si wotsɔ asi ŋlɔe ɖe mía ŋuti le sededewo me, si tsi tre ɖe mía ŋuti la, eye woɖee ɖa le mía kple Mawu dome, esime woklãe ɖe atitsoga ŋuti la,

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: eye wòɖe dziɖulanyenye kple ŋusẽwo ɖi, eye wòdo ŋukpe wo le gaglãgbe, eye wòkpɔ dziɖuɖudzidzɔ ɖe wo dzi to me.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Eyata migana amea ɖeke nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi le nuɖuɖu alo nunono ŋuti alo le ŋkekenyuie alo ɣletidzedzi alo Sabat la gome o.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Esiawo nye nusiwo gbɔna la ƒe vɔvɔli; ke nu la ŋutɔ le Kristo me va.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Migana amea ɖeke nate dziɖuɖufetu la mi o, alesi wole didim le ɖokuibɔbɔɖeanyi kple mawudɔlawo ƒe subɔsubɔ me, eye wòge ɖe nusiwo mekpɔ kpɔ o la me, eye eƒe ŋutilãtamesusu ɖoe ɖe dzi glodzoo dzodzro,

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: eye melé ɖe ta ŋuti o, amesi gbɔ ŋutilã blibo la katã kpɔa kpekpeɖeŋuti tsonɛ, eye wobiae ɖeka to ƒunuɖeƒeewo kple kawo me, eye wotsina le tsitsi, si tsoa Mawu gbɔ la nu.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Ne mia kple Kristo mieku na xexe sia me ƒe gɔmedzenuwo la, ekema nukaŋuti miena wogale se dem na mi abe ɖe miegale agbe le xexeame ene bena:

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: „Megalée ɖe asi o! Megaɖɔe kpɔ o! Megaka asi eŋu o!

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: nusiwo katã le gbegblẽ ge to wo ŋutidɔwɔwɔ me le amewo ƒe sededewo kple nufiafiawo nu la mahã?

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Nusiawo tɔgbe xɔ nunya ƒe ŋkɔ le subɔsubɔ, si woa ŋutɔwo tia kple ɖokuibɔbɔɖeanyi kpakple ŋutilã ƒe fuwɔwɔ mè; menye le bubunua ɖeke me o, ke boŋ hena ŋutilã ƒe ƒoɖiɖi.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne wofɔ mia kple Kristo ɖe tsitre la, ekema midi nusiwo le dziƒo, afisi Kristo bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖo le Mawu ƒe nuɖusi me.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ miaƒe tamesusuwo ɖo dziƒonuwo ŋu, menye anyigbadzinuwo ŋu o.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Elabena mieku, eye wotsɔ miaƒe agbe kple Kristo ɣla ɖe Mawu me.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Ne Kristo, si nye miaƒe agbe la, ado la, ekema miawo hã miado kpakplii le ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Eyata miwu mia ŋutinu, siwo le anyigba dzi; ahasiwɔwɔ, makɔmakɔnyenye, fiẽŋufiẽŋui, nudzodzro vɔ̃ kple ŋukeklẽ, si nye trɔ̃subɔsubɔ;

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: nusiwo ta Mawu ƒe dziku va vi sẽtowo dzi ɖo,

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: nusiwo me miawo hã miezɔ le tsã, esime mienɔ agbe le nusiawo me.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ miawo hã miɖe nusiawo katã, siwo nye: Dziku, dɔmedzoe, nu tovo wɔwɔ, busunyagbɔgblɔ, ŋukpenanyawo la ɖa tso miaƒe nu me;

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: migaka aʋatso na mia nɔewo o; elabena mieɖe ame xoxoa kple eƒe nuwɔnawo ɖa,

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: eye mido ame yeye, si wowɔ yeye hena sidzedze le amesi wɔe la ƒe nɔnɔme nu,

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: afisi Helatɔ kple Yudatɔ, aʋatsotso kple aʋamatsomatso, gbegãdzitɔwo kple Skitetɔ, kluvi kple ablɔɖevia ɖeke megali o, ke Kristo enye wo katã, eye wòle wo katã me.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Eyata esi míenye Mawu ƒe ame tiatiawo kple ame kɔkɔewo kpakple lɔlɔ̃viwo ŋuti la, mido dɔmetɔtrɔ kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ, dɔmekɔkɔ, ɖokuibɔbɔɖeanyi, dɔmefafa, dzigbɔgbɔ blewu,

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: eye mihe adodo kple mia nɔewo, eye mitsɔ ke mia nɔewo, ne nyaa ɖe le amea ɖe si ɖe amea ɖe ŋuti la, alesi Kristo hã tsɔ ke mii la, miawo hã miwɔ nenema ke!

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Ke hekpe ɖe nusiawo katã ŋuti la mido lɔlɔ̃, si nye blibonyenye la ƒe nublanu.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Eye Kristo ƒe ŋutifafa naɖu dzi le miaƒe dziwo me, nusi ŋuti woyɔ mi vɛ hã le ŋutilã ɖeka me, eye mizu ame ɖakpewo!

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Mina Kristo ƒe nya la nanɔ mia me geɖe fũ, eye mitsɔ nunya sia nunya fia nu mia nɔewo, eye mixlɔ̃ nu mia nɔewo kple Psalmowo kple kafukafuhawo kpakple gbɔgbɔ me hawo, eye midzi ha le amenuveve me na Mawu le miaƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Eye nusianu, si miewɔna le nuƒoƒo alo dɔwɔwɔ me la, miwɔ ye katã le Kristo Yesu ƒe ŋkɔa dzi, eye mida akpe na Mawu Fofo la le eyama me. Ɖoɖo na kristotɔwo.

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi nyɔnuwo la, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia srɔ̃wo, abe alesi wòdze le Aƒetɔ la me ene.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Mi ŋutsuwo la, milɔ̃ mia srɔ̃wo, eye migawɔ dɔmevevi le wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi ɖeviwo la, miɖo to mia dzilawo le nusianu me; elabena esia dze Aƒetɔ la ŋu nyuie.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Mi fofowo la, migado dziku na mia wo, bene dzika nagatso wo ƒo o.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Mi dɔlawo la, miɖo to miaƒe aƒetɔwo le ŋutilã nu le nusianu me; menye le ame ŋku me nuwɔwɔ me, abe alesi wòdzea amewo ŋu la ene o, ke boŋ le dzimekɔkɔ me le Aƒetɔ la vɔvɔ̃ me;

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: eye nusianu, si ke miewɔna la, mi wɔe tso dzi me, abe Aƒetɔ lae miewɔe na ene, eye menye na amewo o,

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: esi mienya bena, miaxɔ domenyinyi ƒe teƒeɖoɖo tso Aƒetɔ gbɔ la. Miesubɔ Aƒetɔ Kristo!

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke wɔa nu madzɔmadzɔ la, axɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ, si wòwɔ la ƒe fetu, eye ŋkumekpɔkpɔa ɖeke mele eme o.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Mi aƒetɔwo la, miwɔ nusi dzɔ, eye wòsɔ la, na miaƒe dɔlawo, esi mienyae bena, Aƒetɔ li na miawo hã le dziƒo la ta.

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɖaa, eye minɔ ŋudzɔ le eme kple akpedada,

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: eye mido gbe ɖa ɖe miawo hã mía ta, bene Mawu naʋu nya la ƒe ʋɔtru na mí, ne míagblɔ Kristo ƒe nya ɣaɣla, si ŋuti woblam ɖo hã,

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: bene maɖe esia ɖe go afia, abe alesi wòdzem be, maƒo nu la ene.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Mizɔ le nunya me le amesiwo le egodo la ŋku me, eye miwo ɣeyiɣi la ŋuti dɔ blibo.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Mina amenuveve kple dze nanɔ miaƒe nya me ɖaasi, bena mianya alesi wòdze be, miaɖo nya ŋuti na amesiame.

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Nusiwo katã va dzo ɖe dzinye la, Tixiko, nɔvi lɔlɔ̃tɔ kple subɔla nuteƒewɔla kpakple hadɔwɔla le Aƒetɔ me la, ana mianyae,

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: amesi meda ɖo ɖe mia gbɔ le esia ta, bene mianya alesi míele, eye wòafa aka na miaƒe dziwo;

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: eye metso Onesimo, nɔvi nuteƒewɔla lɔlɔ̃tɔ, si tso mia dome la, hã kpe ɖe eŋuti; eye wòana mianya nusiwo katã le afisia. Ɖuɖɔ kple nuwunyawo.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristarxo, hanyegatɔ, kple Marko, Barnaba srɔ̃nyi, si ŋuti miexɔ ɖu le la — ne eva mia gbɔ la, mixɔe —

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: kple Yesu, si woyɔna be Yusto, amesiwo tso aʋatsotsoa me la, ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã; amesiawo ɖeɖekoe nye hanyedɔwɔlawo na Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la, nenem me siawo zu akɔfafa nam.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafra, amesi tso mia dome, si nye Kristo ƒe dɔla la, ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã; eyae nye amesi nɔa mia ta ʋlim le gbedodoɖa me ɖaasi, bene mianɔ tsitre abe amesiwo le blibo, eye wokpɔ kakaɖedzi blibo le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu katã ŋuti ene.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Elabena mele ɖase ɖim le eŋuti bena, ekpɔ agbagbadzedze geɖe le mia kple amesiwo le Laodikea kpakple amesiwo le Hierapoli la ta.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luka, atikewɔla lɔlɔ̃tɔ la, kple Dema woɖuɖɔ mi ƒã.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Míeɖuɖɔ nɔvi, siwo le Laodikea la ƒã hekpe ɖe Nimfa kpakple hame, si le eƒe me la ŋu.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Eye ne miexlẽ agbalẽ la vɔ la, miwɔe be, woaxlẽe le Laodikea hame hã, eye ne miawo hã miaxlẽ Laodikeatɔwo tɔ.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Eye migblɔ na Arxipo bena: Kpɔ subɔsubɔdɔ, si su asiwò le Aƒetɔ me la dzi, be nawu enu!

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ɖuɖɔ, si nye Paulo metsɔ nye asi ŋlɔe la, enye si. Miɖo ŋu nye kɔsɔkɔsɔwo! Amenuveve nanɔ anyi kpli mi!

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Paulo kple Silvano kple Timoteo woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Tesalonikatɔwo ƒe hame, si le Mawu, Fofo la, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo me: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso! Mawu, mía Fofo kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi!

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Miedaa akpe na Mawu ɖaasi le mi katã mia ta, eye mieɖoa ŋku mia dzi le miaƒe gbedodoɖawo me,

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: eye ɖaa míeɖoa ŋku miaƒe xɔse ƒe dɔwɔwɔ kple lɔlɔ̃ ƒe agbagbadzedze kpakple mɔkpɔkpɔ na mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la ƒe dzidodo le Mawu, mía Fofo ƒe ŋku me la dzi.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Elabena, nɔvi, siwo Mawu lɔ̃na la, mienya miaƒe tiatia la;

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: elabena míaƒe nyanyuie la meva mia gbɔ le nya me ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ le ŋusẽ kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe kpakple kakaɖedzikpɔkpɔ geɖe me hã, abe alesi mienya amesi ƒomeviwo míenye le mia dome le mia ta la ene.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Eye miawo miezu míawo kple Aƒetɔ la srɔ̃lawo, esi miexɔ nya la le xaxa geɖe me kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe dzidzɔ,

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: ale bena mietrɔ zu kpɔɖeŋu na amesiwo katã xɔnɛ sena le Makedonia kple Axaya.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Elabena Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la ɖi hoo tso mia gbɔ, menye le Makedonia kple Axaya ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ miaƒe Mawu dzixɔse la ɖo afisiafi, ale bena naneke gbɔgblɔ megahiã mí o;

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: elabena woa ŋutɔwo gblɔa nya fiana le mía ŋuti, vava, si ƒomevi me mieva mia gbɔ le, kple alesi mietrɔ tso trɔ̃wo gbɔ va Mawu gbɔ, bena miasubɔ Mawu gbagbe vavãtɔ la,

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: eye míalala Via tso dziƒo, amesi wòfɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, Yesu, si ɖe mí tso dziku, si gbɔna la me.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Elabena, nɔviwo, mia ŋutɔwo mienyae bena, míaƒe mia gbɔ vava la menye dzodzro o,

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wònye míekpe fu, eye wodo vlo mi le Filipi tsã hafi, abe alesi mienyae ene, gake míekpɔ dzideƒo le mía Mawu me hegblɔ eƒe nyanyuie la fia mi le ʋiʋli geɖe me.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Elabena míaƒe nuxɔxlɔ̃ metso beble alo makɔmakɔnyenye me o, eye mele alakpadada me o,

english_verse: God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
translation_verse: ke boŋ abe alesi Mawu kpo mí míedze bena, wòtso nyanyuie la de asi na mí ene la, nenema ke míegblɔnɛ; menye abe amesiwo dzea amewo ŋu ene o, ke boŋ abe amesiwo dzea Mawu, si dzroa míaƒe dziwo me kpɔna la ŋu ene.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Elabena womekpɔ mi ɣeaɖekeɣi míele numevivinyawo gblɔm, eye míele alakpa hã dam le ŋukeklẽ ta kpɔ o, abe alesi mienyae ene. Mawue nye ɖaseɖila!

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: nenema ke esi mielɔ̃a nu le mia gbɔ o ŋuti la, edze mía ŋu nyuie bena, menye Mawu ƒe nyanyuie la ɖeɖeko míetsɔ na mi o, ke mía ŋutɔwo míaƒe agbe hãe boŋ; elabena mietrɔ zu míaƒe lɔlɔ̃tɔwo.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Elabena, nɔviwo, mieɖo ŋku míaƒe agbagbadzedze kple kutrikuku dzi: Zã kple keli miewɔ dɔ, bena míagazu agba na mia dome amea ɖeke o, eye ale míegblɔ Mawu ƒe nya la fia mi.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Miawoe nye ɖaseɖilawo kple Mawu hã, alesi mieno anyi kɔkɔe kple dzɔdzɔe kple mokaka manɔŋui le mi amesiwo xɔe se la gbɔ,

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: eye mienyae hã bena, abe alesi fofo wɔna na viawo ene la, nenema ke míewɔ na mia dome amesiame: Míexlɔ̃ nu mi, eye miefa akɔ na mi,

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: eye míeɖi ɖase na mi be, miazɔ bena mianye ame dzedzewo na Mawu, amesi yɔ mi va ye ŋutɔ ƒe fiaɖuƒe kple ŋutikɔkɔe gbɔ la.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Eye le esia ta míawo hã miedaa akpe na Mawu ɖaa bena, esime miexɔ mawunya, si miese le mía nu la, miexɔe abe amewo ƒe nya ene o, ke boŋ abe Mawu ƒe nya ene, abe alesi wònye Mawu ƒe nya vavã, si hã sẽa ŋu le mi, amesiwo xɔnɛ sena la me ene.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Elabena miawo, nɔviwo, miezu Mawu hame, siwo le Yudea le Kristo Yesu me la, srɔ̃lawo; elabena miawo hã míekpe fu mawo ke tso mia ŋutɔwo mia dumeviwo gbɔ, abe alesi woawo hã wokpee tso Yudatɔwo gbɔ la ene;

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: amesiwo hã wu Aƒetɔ Yesu kple woa ŋutɔwo ƒe nyagblɔɖilawo, eye woti mía yome, eye womedzea Mawu ŋu o, eye wonye amewo katã ƒe adikãtɔwo,

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: esi wòxea mo na mí, bena míagagblɔ nya na trɔ̃subɔlawo, bene woaxɔ wo ɖe agbe o, bene woayɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃wo taŋtaŋ ɖaasi la ŋuti; ke dziku, si ava wo dzi la, yɔ taŋtaŋ.

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Ke míawo la, nɔviwo, esi woɖe mi ɖa tso mia gbɔ ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe le ŋku me — menye le dzi me o la — geɖe wu mieɖo vevie, eye wòdzro mí ŋutɔ bena, míakpɔ mia ŋku me.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Eyata míedi be, míava mia gbɔ, nye Paulo la zi ɖeka kple zi eve hã: ke Satana xe mɔ na mí.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Elabena amekae nye míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ kple dzidzɔ kple adegbeƒoƒo ƒe fiakuku la, ne menye miawo hãe le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋku me le eƒe vava la me o mahã?

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Elabena miawoe nye míaƒe kafukafu kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti esi miegale ŋu do dzi o la, edze mía ŋu nyuie bena, woagblẽ míawo ɖeɖe ɖi ɖe Atene,

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: eye miedo Timoteo, mía nɔvi kple Mawu ƒe subɔla kple hadɔwɔla le Kristo ƒe nyanyuie me la ɖa, bene wòado ŋusẽ mi, eye wòaxlɔ̃ nu mi le miaƒe xɔse ŋuti,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: bene amea ɖeke nagaʋuʋu le xaxa siawo me o; elabena mia ŋutɔwo mienyae bena, esiawo ke ŋuti woɖo mí ɖo;

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: elabena esime mienɔ mia gbɔ la, miegblɔe ɖi na mi bena, miaɖo xaxa me tsã, abe alesi wòva ve me, eye mienyae hã la ene.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Eyata nye hã, esi nyemegale ŋu do dzi o la, medɔ ɖo ɖa, bene manya miaƒe xɔse, bena misela tela te mi kpɔ, eye míaƒe agbagbadzedze zu dzodzro mahĩ!

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, esi Timoteo tso mia gbɔ va mia gbɔ, eye wòhe dzidzɔnya vɛ na mí le miaƒe xɔse kple miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ ŋuti, eye bena mietsɔa ŋkuɖoɖodzi nyui ɖoa ŋku mía dzi ɖaasi, eye bena edzroa miawo hã be, míakpɔ mí, abe alesi wòdzroa míawo hã be, miakpɔ mi ene la ŋuti;

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
