translation_verse: eyata, nɔviwo, wofa aka na mí le mia ŋuti le míaƒe hiãkaka kple xaxa katã me to miaƒe xɔse me;

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: elabena azɔ la, ne miawo miele tsitre sesĩe le Aƒetɔ me la, míele agbe. Paulo do gbe ɖa ɖe hame la ta.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Elabena akpedada ka míate ŋu atso aɖo teƒe na Mawu le mia ta le dzidzo katã, si míekpɔna le mia ta le mía Mawu ŋku me la ŋuti mahã?

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Zã kple keli míeɖea kuku ŋutɔŋutɔ, bena miakpɔ mia ŋku me, eye miaɖo nusi susɔ na miaƒe xɔse la ɖo wòazu blibo.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu, mía Fofo ŋutɔ kple mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo nana míaƒe mo naɖo ta mia gbɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, Aƒetɔ ana miatsi ɖe dzi ahagba go le lɔlɔ̃ na mia nɔewo kple amewo katã me, abe alesi míawo hã míele na mi la ene,

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: bene wòado ŋusẽ miaƒe dziwo, be woanɔ anyi mokaka manɔŋui le kɔkɔenyenye me le Mawu, mía Fofo la ŋku me le mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo kple eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã ƒe vavagbe la! Amen.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Azɔ mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, miele kuku ɖem, eye míele nu xlɔ̃m mi le Aƒetɔ Yesu me, bene abe alesi miexɔe tso mia gbɔ, alesi dze be, miazɔ, eye miadze Mawu ŋu, eye abe alesi miezɔna hã ene la, miayi dzi geɖe wu;

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: elabena mienya se, siwo miede na mi to Aƒetɔ Yesu dzi.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Elabena esiae nye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, be miawo mia ɖokui kɔkɔe, eye miade mia ɖokui ɖa atso ahasiwɔwɔ me,

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: menye le nudzodzro ƒe fiẽŋufiẽŋui vevie me, abe alesi trɔ̃subɔla, siwo menya Mawu o la wɔna la ene o;

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: eye amea ɖeke nagaba nɔvia, eye wòatafae le dɔwɔwɔ me o; elabena Aƒetɔ lae nye nusiawo katã ƒe hlɔ̃biala, abe alesi miegblɔ tsã, eye míeɖi ɖase na mi la ene.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu meyɔ mí na makɔmakɔnyenye o, ke boŋ na kɔkɔewɔwɔ.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti amesi ke doa vlo esia la, menye amee wòdoa vloe o, ke boŋ Mawu, amesi na eƒe Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe mí lae wòdoa vloe.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Ke le nɔvilɔlɔ̃ ŋuti la mehiã mi bena, míaŋlɔe aɖo ɖe mi o; elabena Mawu fia mia ŋutɔwo be, mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo;

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: elabena miewɔ esia ke na nɔvi, siwo katã le Makedonia blibo la katã. Ke míele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwo, bena miayi dzi geɖe wu,

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: eye miabui nudzeamee be, miano anyi kpoo, eye miawɔ mia ŋutɔwo miaƒe dɔ, eye miatsɔ miaƒe asiwo awɔ dɔ, abe alesi miede se na mi la ene,

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: bene miazɔ nyuie de amesiwo le egodo la ŋuti, bene naneke nagahiã mi o. Míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ na amesiwo le alɔ̃ dɔm la.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Ke, nɔviwo, míele didim bena, mianɔ numanyamanya me le amesiwo dɔ alɔ̃ la ŋuti o, bene miagaxa nu, abe ame bubu, siwo mɔkpɔkpɔ meli na o la ene o.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Elabena ne miexɔnɛ sena bena, Kristo ku, eye wògafɔ ɖe tsitre la, nenema ke Mawu ato Yesu Kristo dzi akplɔ amesiwo dɔ alɔ̃ la hã ayi kpakplii.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Elabena míele esia gblɔm na mi le Aƒetɔ la ƒe nyaa de me bena, mí amesiwo susɔ le agbe yiɖase ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe vavagbe la, miadze ŋgɔ na amesiwo dɔ alɔ̃ la o.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Elabena Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ atsɔ aʋafia gã ƒe gbeɖeɖe kple mawudɔla gatɔ ƒe gbe kple Mawu ƒe kpẽɖiɖi aɖi tso dziƒo, eye amesiwo ku le Kristo me la, woatsi tre gbã;

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: emegbe la mi amesiwo susɔ le agbe la, woahe mí kpakpli wo siaa le alilikpowo me aɖakpe Aƒetɔ la le ya me, eye ale míanɔ anyi kple Aƒetɔ la ɖaasi.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Eyata mitsɔ nya siawo fa akɔ na mia nɔewo.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Ke le ɣeyiɣiwo kple azãgbewo ŋuti la, nɔviwo, mehiã mi be, míaŋlɔe aɖo ɖe mi o;

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: elabena mia ŋutɔwo mienyae kɔte bena, Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la gbɔna, abe alesi fiafitɔ vana le zã me ene.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Elabena ne wole gbɔgblɔm be, ŋutifafa kple anyinɔnɔ dedie li la, tete gbegblẽ ava lili wo, abe alesi fuɖuame va lilia funɔ ene, eye womate ŋu asi le enu kulẽ o.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Ke miawo, nɔviwo, miele viviti me, bena ŋkeke la naɖi ɖe mi abe fiafitɔ ene o;

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: elabena mi katã míenye kekeli viwo kple ŋkeke viwo; míenye zã alo viviti ta o.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ migana míanɔ alɔ̃ dɔm abe ame bubuwo ene o, ke boŋ mina míanɔ ŋudzɔ, eye míanɔ mo xexi.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo dɔa alɔ̃ la, zãe wodɔa alɔ̃, eye amesiwo mua aha la, zãe womua aha;

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: ke mí amesiwo nye ŋkeke tɔwo la, mina mianɔ mo xexi, eye míado xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ ƒe akɔtakpoxɔnu, eye míaɖɔ xaxa ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ƒe gakuku la.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu meɖo mí na dziku o, ke boŋ, bena xɔxɔ nasu mía si to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi,

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: amesi ku ɖe mía ta, bena ne míele ŋu alo míele alɔ̃ me la, míanɔ agbe kpakplii,

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Eyata mifa akɔ na mia nɔewo, eye mido ŋusẽ mia nɔewo, abe alesi miewɔna hã ene. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ kple gbedoname.

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke míele kuku ɖem na mi, nɔviwo: Midze si amesiwo wɔa dɔ vevi le mia dome, eye wonɔ mia nu le Aƒetɔ la me, eye woglɔ̃a nu mi la,

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: eye bena míabu wo geɖe ŋutɔ le lɔlɔ̃ me le woƒe dɔwɔwɔ la ta. Minɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me le mia nɔewo dome.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Ke míele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwo: Migbe nya na nu baɖa wɔlawo, mifa akɔ na dzikatsoƒoetɔwo, mixɔ na gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo, migbɔ dzi ɖi na amewo katã.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie bena, amea ɖeke nagaɖo vɔ̃ vɔ̃ teƒe o, ke boŋ miti nyuididi na mia nɔewo kple amewo katã yome ɖaasi.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Dzi nadzɔ mi ɖaa!

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe!

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Mida akpe le nusianu ŋuti; elabena esiae nye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu le Kristo Yesu me hena mi.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Migatsi Gbɔgbɔ la nu o!

english_verse: or ignore prophecies.
translation_verse: Migado vlo nyagbɔgblɔɖiwo o!

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Ke mido nuwo katã kpɔ, eye milé nu nyui la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Miɖe mia ɖokui ɖa tso vɔ̃ sia vɔ̃ ƒomevi me!

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutifafa Mawu la ŋutɔ nakɔ mia ŋuti keŋkeŋ, eye wòadzra miaƒe gbɔgbɔ kple luʋɔ kpakple ŋutilã blibo la katã ɖo mokaka manɔŋui halase mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe vavagbe la!

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔla enye amesi yɔ mi ve, amesi lawɔe hã.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mido gbe ɖa ɖe mía ta!

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nugbugbɔ kɔkɔe ɖuɖɔ nɔviwo katã nam ƒã.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Metà Aƒetɔ la na mi bena, miaxlẽ agbalẽ sia na nɔvi kɔkɔeawo katã.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve nanɔ anyi kpli mi! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Paulo kple Silvano kple Timoteo woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Tesalonikatɔwo ƒe hame, si le Mawu, mía Fofo, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo me:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, mía Fofo kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi!

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Ele na mí bena, míada akpe na Mawu ɖaasi le mia ta, nɔviwo, abe alesi dze ene; elabena miaƒe xɔse tsina ŋutɔ, eye mi katã mia dome amesiame ƒe lɔlɔ̃, si mietsɔna lɔ̃a mia nɔewo la, sɔa gbɔ ɖe edzi,

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: ale bena mia ŋutɔwo míeƒoa adegbe le mia ta le Mawu ƒe hameawo me le miaƒe dzidodo kple miaƒe xɔse, si le mia si le miaƒe yometitiwo kple xaxa, siwo miekpɔna me la ŋuti;

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: nusiwo nye Mawu ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe la ƒe dzesi bena, wobu mi be, miedze Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe, si ŋuti míekpe fu ɖo la,

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: ne ele ale bena, edzo le Mawu ƒe ŋku me bena, wòatsɔ xaxa aɖo teƒe na amesiwo na xaxa mi;

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: eye mi amesiwo kpo xaxa la, ana gbɔɖeme mi kpakple mí katã siaa le Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo kple eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe dɔlawo ƒe ɖeɖefia tso dziƒo la me

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: le dzo ƒe aɖe me, esime woabia hlɔ̃ amesiwo menya Mawu o kple amesiwo meɖoa to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe nyanyuie la o,

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: amesiwo akpɔ fetu vɔ̃, si nye gbegblẽ mavɔmavɔ la, tso Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋku me kple eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la gbɔ,

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: ne ava, bena wòakpɔ ŋutikɔkɔe le eƒe ame kɔkɔewo me, eye woawo nuku na amewo le dzixɔsetɔwo katã ŋuti le ŋkeke ma dzi; elabena miexɔ míaƒe ɖaseɖiɖi dzi se.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Esiata hã miedoa gbe ɖa ɖaa le mia ta, bena mía Mawu nabu mi be, miedze yɔyɔ la, eye wòawu dɔmenyonyo ƒe ŋudzedze; katã kple xɔse ƒe do la nu le ŋusẽ me,

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: bene wòakɔ mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ la ŋuti le mia me, eye wòakɔ miawo hã mia ŋuti le eyama me le mía Mawu kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve la nu.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Ke míele kuku dem na mi, nɔviwo, le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe vava kple mia ƒuƒoƒo de eyama gbã la ŋuti,

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: bene miagana woate mi ɖa kaba tso miaƒe tamesusu me o, eye miagana woado voɖi na mi hã o, eɖanye to gbɔgbɔ alo to nya me o alo to agbalẽ, si le abe mía gbɔ wòtso ene la me o, abe ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la ɖo va ene.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Migana amea ɖeke nable mi le mɔa ɖeke dzi o; elabena Aƒetɔ la mava o, negbe ɖeko megbedede tso Mawu gbɔ lava gbã, eye woaɖe nuvɔ̃me, si nye gbegblẽvi la, ɖe go,

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: amesi tsia tre, eye wòdoa eɖokui ɖe dzi ɖe nusianu, si woyɔna be Mawu alo nusi wosubɔna la dzi, nenem bena wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi de mawuƒe la me hele eɖokui fiam be, yenye Mawu.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mieɖo ŋku edzi bena, esime megale mia gbɔ la, megblɔ nusiawo na mi oa?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ la mienya nusi xea mo nɛ, bena woaɖee ɖe go le ye ŋutɔ ƒe azãgbe la dzi.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Elabena sedzimawɔmawɔ ƒe nya ɣaɣla la le da wɔm ŋusẽtɔe xoxo; ɖeko wòle be, woaɖe amesi le ma xem vaseɖe fifi la da le mo la dzi hafi;

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: eye tete woaɖe sedzimawɔla ɖe go, amesi Aƒetɔ Yesu lawu kple eƒe nu me gbɔgbɔ, eye wòatsrɔ̃e to eƒe vava ƒe ɖeɖefia la me.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Ame ma ƒe vava lanye le Satana ƒe ŋusẽdɔwɔwɔ nu: Le aʋatsokaka ƒe ŋusẽ kple dzesiwo kple nukunuwo katã

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: kple madzɔmadzɔnyenye ƒe amebeble katã me le amesiwo le tsɔtsrɔm la dome; elabena womexɔ nyateƒe ƒe lolo, bene woaxɔ wo o.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Eye le esia ta Mawu adɔ beble, si nu sẽ la, aɖo ɖe wo gbɔ, bene woaxɔ aʋatsokaka dzi ase,

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: bene woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu amesiwo katã mexa nyateƒe dzi se o, ke boŋ madzɔmadzɔnyenye dze wo ŋu.

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Ke ele na mí be, míada akpe na Mawu ɖaasi le mia ta, nɔvi, siwo Aƒetɔ la lɔ̃na, bena Mawu Mia mi tso gɔmedzedzea me hena xɔxɔ le Gbɔgbɔ ƒe kɔkɔewɔwɔ kple nyateƒe dzixɔse la me,

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: nusi gbɔ woyɔ mi ve to míaƒe nyanyuie la me, bene mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la nasu mia si.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Eyata azɔ, nɔviwo, minɔ tsitre sesĩe, eye milé nuɖoanyi, si wofia mi, eɖanye to nya alo to míaƒe agbalẽ me o la, ɖe asi.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Ke mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋutɔ kple Mawu, mía Fofo, amesi lɔ̃ mi, eye wotsɔ akɔfafa mavɔmavɔ kple mɔkpɔkpɔ nyui na mí to amenuveve me la,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: nafa akɔ na miaƒe dziwo, eye wòado ŋusẽ mi le dɔwɔwɔ nyui kple nya nyui katã me.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, mido gbe ɖa ɖe mia la, bena Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la nayi dzi kaba, eye woakɔ eŋuti, abe alesi wòle le miawo hã mia dome la ene,

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: eye bena woaɖe mí atso votolawo kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me; elabena menye amewo katã si xɔse la le o.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ke nuteƒewɔla enye Aƒetɔ la, amesi ado ŋusẽ mi, eye wòadzra mi ɖo tso vɔ̃ɖitɔ la si me.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Ke mieɖo dzi ɖe mia ŋu le Aƒetɔ la me bena, miewɔa nusi miede se na mi la, eye miegale ewɔ ge hã.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la atrɔ miaƒe dziwo aɖo ta Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple Kristo ƒe dzidodo la gbɔ. Tohehe le kuviawɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Ke miele se dem na mi, nɔviwo, le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ la dzi bena, miahe mia ɖokui ɖa tso nɔvi sia nɔvi, si zɔna sakasaka, eye menye le nuɖoanyi, si wòxɔ le mía si la nu o la gbɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Elabena mia ŋutɔwo mienya alesi wòdze mi be, miasrɔ̃ mi; elabena míewɔ sakasaka le mia dome o,

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: eye mieɖu abolo dzro le amea ɖeke gbɔ o, ke boŋ mietsɔ agbagbadzedze kple kutrikuku wo ɖo zã kple keli, bena míagazu agba na mia dome amea ɖeke o,

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: menye ɖe ŋusẽ mele mía si o, ke boŋ bene míawo mia ɖokui kpɔɖeŋu na mi, bena miasrɔ̃ mí.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Elabena esime mienɔ mia gbɔ hã la, míede se na mi bena, ne amea ɖe melɔ̃ be, yeawɔ dɔ o la, negaɖu nu hã a.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Elabena miese bena, amea ɖewo zɔna sakasaka le mia dome, eye womewɔa dɔa ɖeke o, ke boŋ wowɔa yakadɔwo sɔŋ ko.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Ke míele se dem na nenem me siawo, eye míele nu xlɔ̃m wo le mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo me, bene woawɔ dɔ kpoo, eye woaɖu woa ŋutɔwo ƒe abolo.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, nɔviwo, migana ɖeɖi nate mia ŋu le do nyui wɔwɔ me o.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe meɖo to miaƒe nya, si le agbalẽ sia me o la, miɖe dzesi eyama, eye migade ha kplii o, bene ŋu nakpee.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Ke miabui abe futɔ ene o, ke mixlɔ̃ nui abe nɔvi ene boŋ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutifafa ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ nana ŋutifafa mi le ɣeawokatãɣi me le nusianu me. Aƒetɔ la nanɔ anyi kpli mi katã! Ɖuɖɔ, si apostolo la ŋutɔ tsɔ eƒe asi ŋlɔ.

english_verse: I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
translation_verse: Ɖuɖɔ, si nye Paulo metsɔ nye asi ŋlɔe, si nye dzesi le nye agbalẽ sia agbalẽ me la, enye si; nenemae meŋlɔnɛ.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve nana anyi kpli mi katã! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Paulo, Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolo le Mawu, mía xɔla, kple Kristo Yesu, si nye míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ la, ƒe sedede la nu,

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Timoteo, vinye vavã le xɔse me: Amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, Fofo la, kple Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ gbɔ la, woana wò!

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Alesi mexlɔ̃ nu wò be, nanɔ Efeso, esime meyina ɖe Makedonia, bene naɖe se na amea ɖewo be, womagafia nu bubu o,

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: eye bena womagaɖo to gliwo kple dzidzimenya, siwo seƒeɖo meli na o, elabena nusiawo hea anukutsyɔtsyɔ geɖewo vɛ wu nusi Mawu ƒe nuɖoanyi le xɔse me la ɖina la, nenema ke megale nu xlɔ̃m wò fifia hã.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Ke sedede ƒe nuwuwu enye lɔlɔ̃, si tso dzi dzadzɛ kple dzitsinya nyui kpakple xɔse, si me alakpaa ɖeke mele o la me;

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: nusiwo gbɔ amea ɖewo tre mɔ tso, eye wogbugbɔ yi ɖe nuƒoƒo dzodzrowo gbɔ

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: hele didim be, yewoanye sefialawo, eye womenya nusiwo wogblɔna alo nusiwo dzi woka ɖo la gɔme o.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Ke mienyae bena, se la nyo, ne amea ɖe wɔ eŋu do le se la nu pɛpɛpɛ;

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: eye míenya esia bena, womena se ame dzɔdzɔe o, ke boŋ sedzidalawo kple tosẽlawo kple ame mavɔ̃mawuwo, kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo kple ame makɔmakɔwo kple ahɔhlɔ̃bɔlawo kple tɔwulawo kple nɔwulawo kple amewulawo

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: kple ahasiwɔlawo kple amesiwo dɔna kple ŋutsuviwo kple amesiawo kple aʋatsokalawo kple atam dzodzro kalawo, eye ne nu bubua ɖe li, si tsi tre ɖe nufiafia, si le blibo la ŋuti

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: le Mawu yayratɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nyanyuie, si wotsɔ de asi nam la nu.

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Eye meda akpe na amesi do ŋusẽm, si nye Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ la be, wòbum nyateƒetɔ, eye wòtsɔm ɖo subɔsubɔ la nu,

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: nye amesi nye busunyagblɔla kple yometila kpakple vlodola tsã; ke wokpɔ nublanui nam, elabena mewɔe le numanyamanya me, le dzimaxɔse me.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Ke mía Aƒetɔ ƒe amenuveve sɔ gbɔ geɖe ŋutɔ le xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃, si le Kristo Yesu me la me.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Nyateƒenya wònye, eye wòdze be, woaxɔe keŋ bena, Kristo Yesu va xexeame, nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ɖe ge, amesiwo dome menye gãtɔ le.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ke esia ŋuti wokpɔ nublanui nam, bena Yesu Kristo naɖe eƒe dzigbɔgbɔɖi blewu katã afia le menye gbã, bene wòanye kpɔɖeŋu na amesiwo katã le edzi xɔ ge ase hena agbe mava la.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Ke fia mavɔmavɔtɔ, si nye Mawu magblẽmagblẽ, makpɔmakpɔ ɖeka hɔ̃ la, tɔ nanye bubu kple kafukafu tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mave me! Amen.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Mele sedede sia dem asi na wò, vinye Timoteo, le nyagbɔgblɔɖeanyi, siwo dze ŋgɔ na wò la nu, bene nawɔ aʋa nyui le wo nu,

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: eye nalé xɔse kple dzitsinya nyui ɖe asi, nusi amea ɖewo tso ƒu gbe, eye wodze go le xɔse gome abe ʋu dzego ene;

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: amesiwo dome Himenaio kple Aleksandro wole, amesiwo metsɔ de asi na Satana, bene wòahe to na wo, be woadzudzɔ busunyagbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Azo mele nu xlɔ̃m le nuwo katã ŋgɔ be, woawɔ kukuɖeɖewo, gbedodoɖawo, nyaxɔxɔdeametawo, akpedadawo le amewo katã ta,

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: le fiawo kple amesiwo katã ɖu amegãwo la ta, bene míanɔ anyi kpoo le ŋutifafa mele mawuvɔvɔ̃ kple nusi dzea bubu katã la me.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Elabena esia nyo, eye wòdze Mawu, mía xɔla ŋu,

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: amesi le didim be, woaxɔ amewo katã, bene woava nyateƒe ƒe sidzedze la me.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ɖeka kple avuléla ɖeka, si le Mawu kple amewo dome, si nye ame Kristo Yesu la koe li,

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: nusia ŋuti woɖom ɖi menye gbeƒãɖela kple apostolo — nyateƒe gblɔm mele, nyemele aʋatso kam o — kple trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe nufiala le xɔse kpakple nyateƒe me. Nusi dze na ŋutsu kple nyɔnu be, woawɔ.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Eyata mele didim bena, ŋutsuwo nado gbe ɖa le afisiafi, eye woado asi kɔkɔewo ɖe dzi, dɔmedzoe kple ɖikekea ɖeke manɔmee.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Nenema ke nyɔnuwo nado awu ɖe nɔnɔme nyui me, eye woawɔ leke na wo ɖokui le ŋukpekpe kple ɖokuidziɖuɖu me; menye kple ɖaƒoƒo vivivo kple sika alo adzagbawo alo awu xɔasi dodo o,

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: ke nusi dze nyɔnu, siwo nua Mawu ƒe subɔsubɔ me la, enye be, woawo leke na wo ɖokui to dɔwɔwɔ nyuiwo me.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la nasrɔ̃ nu le ɖoɖoezizi kple toɖoɖo katã me.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Ke nyemeɖe mɔ na nyɔnu be, wòafia nu, eye wòaɖu ŋutsu dzi o, ke boŋ wòalé eɖokui kpoo.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Elabena womè Adam gbã, emegbe la Xawa?

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Eye womeble Adam o, ke nyɔnu lae woble, eye wòge ɖe vodada me.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Ke woaɖee to vidzidzi me, ne ena xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ kple kɔ̃kɔewɔwɔ kpakple ɖokuidziɖuɖu me.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Nyateƒenya wònye: Ne amea ɖe le dzikpɔladɔ dim la, ele dɔwɔwɔ nyui dim.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Azɔ la ele na dzikpɔla bena, mokaka naganɔ eŋu o: Wòanye nyɔnu ɖeka srɔ̃, ɖokuidziɖula, ame ɖɔŋuɖo, nudzeamewɔla, amedzrowɔla, amesi nya nufiafia;

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: menye ahatsunola o, menye ameƒola o, ke ame fatu; menye gedila o, menye galɔ̃la o,

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: amesi kpɔa ye ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe dzi nyuie, amesi si vi ɖotowo le, eye wòléa eɖokui nyuie; —

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: ke ne amea ɖe menya alesi wòa kpɔ ye ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe dzi o la, aleke wòakpɔ Mawu ƒe hame la dzi mahã? —

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Menye amesi ƒe dzimetɔtrɔ teƒe medidi o, bene wòagado eɖokui ɖe dzi, eye wòadze Abosam ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la me o.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Ke ele ne be, wòakpɔ ɖaseɖiɖi nyui atso amesiwo le egodo la hã gbɔ, bene wòagadze dzudzu kple Abosam ƒe mɔ̃tetre me o.

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Nenema ke subɔlawo hã nalé wo ɖokui nyuie: Wòaganye aɖeveetɔwo o, wòaganye aha geɖe nolawo o, wòagaɖi viɖe ƒoɖi o,

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: woalé xɔse ƒe nya ɣaɣla la ɖe asi le dzitsinya dzadzɛ me.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Ke woado amesiawo hã akpɔ gbã, eye ne mokaka mele wo ŋu o la, ekema mina woasubɔ.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nenema ke nyɔnuwo hã nalé wo ɖokui nyuie: Woaganye ameŋuzɔlawo o, woanye amè ɖɔŋuɖowo, nuteƒewɔlawo le nusianu me.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Subɔlawo nanye nyɔnu ɖeka srɔ̃, eye woakpɔ wo viwo kple woa ŋutɔwo ƒe aƒewo dzi nyuie.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Elabena amesiwo subɔna nyuie la, wowɔa nɔƒe nyui na wo ɖokui, eye wokpɔa dzideƒo geɖe le xɔse, si le Kristo Yesu me la me. Nyanyuie la me ma gãtɔ.

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Mele nusiawo ŋlɔm na wò hele mɔ kpɔm be, mava gbɔwò kpuie;

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: ke ne metsi anyi la, ne nanya alesi dze wò be, nazɔ le Mawu ƒe aƒe, si nye Mawu gbagbe ƒe hame kple nyateƒe ƒe sɔti kple gɔmeɖoɖoanyi sesĩ la me.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Eye edze ƒã bena, gã enye mawusosroɖa ƒe nya ɣaɣla la: Mawu ɖe eɖokui fia le ŋutilã me, wotso afia nɛ le Gbɔgbɔ me, eɖe eɖokui fia mawudɔlawo, woɖe gbe ƒãe le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome, woxɔ edzi se le xexeame, woxɔe yi dzi le ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Ke Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔe kɔte bena, le ŋkeke mamleawo me la amea ɖewo ade megbe atso xɔse la me, eye woaɖo to beblegbɔgbɔwo kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe nufiafia

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: to aʋatsonufialawo ƒe alakpadada me, amesiwo wotsɔ ga xɔdzo ɖe dzesi wo le woa ŋutɔwo ƒe dzitsinya me,

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: amesiwo xea mɔ na srɔ̃ɖeɖe, eye wogblɔna be, woatsri nuɖuɖu, siwo Mawu wɔ, bena amesiwo xɔe se, eye wodze si nyateƒe la, naɖu kple akpedada la.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã nyo, eye womatsri naneke o, nenye be, woxɔe kple akpedada;

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: elabena wokɔ eŋuti to Mawu ƒe nya kple gbedodoɖa me. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le mawusubɔsubɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Ne ètsɔ nusiawo ɖo nɔviawo ŋku me la, anye Yesu Kristo ƒe subɔla nyui, si wonyi le xɔse ƒe nyawo kple nufiafia nyui, si yome nèdze la me.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Ke nagbe yakagli makɔmakɔ, siwo nyagãwo tona; boŋ do vevie mawusosroɖa.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Elabena esiaŋuti hã míedzea agbagba, eye míenana wodzua mi ɖo; elabena míetsɔ míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖo Mawu gbagbe, si nye amewo katã xɔla, vevietɔ xɔsetɔwo tɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: De nusiawo ƒe se, eye nafia wo.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Megana amea ɖeke naɖo vlo wò ɖekakpuinyenye o, ke boŋ nanye kpɔɖeŋu na xɔsetɔwo le nya me, le anyinɔnɔ me, le lɔlɔ̃ me, le gbɔgbɔ me, le xɔse me, le dzadzɛnyenye me.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Nɔ agbalẽxexlẽ kple nuxɔxlɔ̃ kple nufiafia dzi, halase esime mava.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Megawɔ ƒome le amenuvevenunana, si le mewo, si wona wò to nyagblɔɖi me, esime hamemegãwo da woƒe asiwo ɖe dziwò la ŋuti o.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Lé be na nusiawo, nɔ nusiawo dzi, bene wò ŋgɔgbedede nadze ƒã le nuwo katã me.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖokuiwò kple wò nufiafia la dzi nyuie, nɔ nusiawo dzi; elabena ne èwɔ esia la, àxɔ ɖokuiwò kple amesiwo ɖoa to wò la, ɖe agbe.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Megawo ɖe ame tsitsi ta o, keboŋ xlɔ̃ nui abe fofo ene, ɖekakpuiwo abe nɔviŋutsuwo ene,

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: nyɔnu tsitsiwo abe dadawo ene, ɖetugbiwo abe nɔvinyɔnuwo ene le dzadzɛnyenye katã me.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Bu ahosi, siwo nye ahosi vavãwo!

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ke ne viwo alo mamayɔviwo le ahosia ɖe si la, woasrɔ̃ alesi woawo nusi adze Mawu ŋu la le woa ŋutɔwo ƒe aƒe me gbã, eye woaɖo teƒe na wo dzia wo: elabena esia nyo le Mawu ŋku me.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnu, si nye ahosi vavã, eye amea ɖeke meli nɛ o la, tsɔa eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖoa Mawu dzi, eye wònɔa kukuɖeɖewo kple gbedodoɖawo dzi zã kple keli.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Ke ahosi, si tsa eɖokui de asi na agbeɖuɖu la, ele agbe henye ame kuku.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Eye de nusiawo ƒe se na wo, bene woanɔ anyi mokaka manɔŋui.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke ne amea ɖe melé be na ye ŋutɔ tɔwo o, eye vevietɔ na ye ŋutɔ ƒe aƒemetɔwo o la, egbe xɔse la, eye wòvɔ̃ɖi wu dzimaxɔsetɔ.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Megatia ahosi, si mexɔ ƒe blaade haɖe o la o: Amesi nye ŋutsu ɖeka srɔ̃,

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: amesi kpɔ ɖaseɖiɖi nyui le dɔwɔwɔ nyuiwo ŋuti; ne enyia viwo, ne ewɔa amedzro, ne eklɔa ame kɔkɔewo ƒe afɔ ŋuti, ne ekpena ɖe fukpelawo ŋuti, ne enɔa ɖo nyui sia do nyui wɔwɔ yome.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Ke gbe ahosi, siwo metsi haɖe o; elabena ne wodze ha ɖe Kristo ŋuti la, wodina be, yewoaɖe srɔ̃,

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: eye fɔbubu sia li na wo bena, wotrɔ gbã nyateƒetɔnyenye la.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Eye wosrɔ̃a kuviawɔwɔ hã henɔa tsatsam tso aƒe me yi aƒe me; eye menye, kuvia ɖeɖeko wowɔna o, ke boŋ wonye nu kpoloe ƒolawo kple yakanuwɔlawo hã henɔa nya madzetowo gblɔm.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Eyata mele didim bena, ahosi, siwo metsi haɖe o la, naɖe srɔ̃, adzi viwo, akpa woƒe aƒewo dzi, bene woagaɖe mo na adikãtɔ la, ne wòadzu hame la o.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Ke ne ahosiwo le ŋutsu xɔsetɔa ɖe alo nyanu xɔsetɔa ɖe si la, wòakpe ɖe wo ŋuti, eye woaganye agba na hame la o, bene hame la nate ŋu akpe ɖe amesiwo nye ahosi vavãwo la ŋuti.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Hamemegã, siwo kpɔa ha la dzi nyuie la, edze be, woatsɔ bubu teƒe eve abu wo, vevietɔ amesiwo dze agbagba le nyagbɔgblɔ kple nufiafia me la.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Elabena ŋɔŋlɔ la gblɔ be: „Megabla nu na nyitsu, si le mɔli tugum la o,“ eye: „Dɔtsɔla dze eƒe fetu.“

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Ne wotso hamemegãa de nu la, megaxɔe o, negbe le ɖaseɖila eve alo etɔ̃ nu ko.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Amesiwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ la, ka mo na wo le amewo katã ŋku me, bene mamleawo hã navɔ̃.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Mele atam kam na wò le Mawu kple Kristo Yesu kpakple mawudɔla tiatiawo ŋku me bena, nalé nusiawo me de asi, eye amea ɖewo ƒe nu naganyo ŋuwò awu amea ɖewo o, eye megawɔ naneke alé go ɖeka me awu bubu o.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Megaɖo asi ame dzi kabakaba o, eye megakpɔ gome le ame bubuwo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo me o. Lé ɖokuiwò dzadzɛ.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Megano tsi ɖeɖe o, ke boŋ no wein via ɖe le wò dɔgbo kple lãmegbegblẽ enuenu la ŋuti.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Amea ɖewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo dze ƒã hedze wo ŋgɔ yi ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me, ke amea ɖewo hã li, siwo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo dze wo yome.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Nenema ke dɔwɔwɔ nyuiwo hã li, siwo dze ƒã, eye esiwo to vovo la, womate ŋu aɣla wo o.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Ame alesi nu le dɔlanyenye ƒe kɔkuti te la, nabu woa ŋutɔwo ƒe aƒetɔwo be, wodze bubu katã, bena woagagblɔ busunya de Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ kple nufiafia la ŋuti o.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo si aƒetɔ xɔsetɔwo le la, womagaɖo vlo wo, le esi wonye nɔviwo la ŋuti o, ke boŋ woasubɔ wo vevie wu; elabena amesiwo kpea woƒe dɔ nyui wɔwɔ ƒe viɖe la, wonye xɔsetɔwo kple lɔlɔ̃tɔwo. Le aʋatsonufialawo ŋuti.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Fia nusiawo, eye nanɔ nuxɔxlɔ̃ dzi! Ne amea de fia nu bubu, eye meléna de Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe nya, siwo le blibo, kple nufiafia, si le mawusubɔsubɔ nu la, nu o la,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: edoa eɖokui de dzi glodzo, eye menya naneke o, ke boŋ eléa anukutsyɔtsyɔwo kple nyaʋawɔwɔ ƒe do, eye nusiawo hea ŋuʋaʋã, dzrewɔwɔ, busunyagbɔgblɔ, nya vɔ̃ susu de ame ŋuti

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: kple nyahehe dzodzro vɛ le ame tamegbegblẽtɔ, siwo si woha nyateƒe le amesiwo buna bena, mawusubɔsubɔ enye viɖenu la dome. Te ɖokuiwò ɖa le nenem me siawo gbɔ. Le mawusosroɖa kple ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Elabena míetsɔ naneke va xexe sia me o, eye edze ƒã bena, míate ŋu atso naneke ayii hã o;

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: ke ne nunyiame kple avɔtata le mía si la, mina nusiawo nasɔ gbɔ na mí.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo ɖina be, yewoayi kesinɔtɔwo la, gena ɖe tetekpɔwo kple mɔ̃tetrewo kpakple movidzɔdzɔ kple nuveviwɔame ƒe nudzodzro geɖe, siwo tsoa amewo xlãna ɖe gbegblẽ kple tsɔtsrɔ̃ me la me.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Elabena nuvɔ̃wo katã ƒe ke enye galɔlɔ̃, si yome mɔ amea ɖewo ɖi, eye wotre mɔ tso xɔse la gbɔ, eye wotsɔ nuxaxa geɖe ŋɔ wo ɖokui flofloflo. Ʋli xɔse ƒe ʋiʋli nyui la!

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, oo Mawu ƒe ame, si le nusiawo nu; ke dze dzɔdzɔenyenye, mawusosroɖa, dzixɔse, lɔlɔ̃, dziɖoɖo, dɔmefafa yome.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Ʋli xɔse ƒe ʋiʋli nyui la; wò asi nasu agbe mavɔ, si ta woyɔ wò ɖo, eye nèʋu emeʋuʋu nyui le ɖaseɖila geɖewo ƒe ŋku me la dzi.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Mele se ɖem na wò le Mawu, si gbɔa agbe nuwo katã, kple Kristo Yesu, si ɖi emeʋuʋu nyui ƒe ɖase le Pontio Pilato gbɔ la, ƒe ŋku me

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: be, nalé sedede sia ɖe asi kpɔtsotso kple mokaka manɔŋui yiɖase mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖeɖefia la dzi,

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: esi dziɖula yayratɔ ɖeka, fiawo dzi fia, aƒetɔwo dzi Aƒetɔ la aɖe fia le ye ŋutɔ ƒe azãgbe la dzi,

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: amesi ko si makumakunyenye le, amesi nɔa anyi le kekeli, si ŋu womate ŋu ate ɖo o la me, amesi amea ɖeke mekpɔ kpɔ o, eye mate ŋu akpɔe hã o, amesi tɔ lanye bubu kple ŋusẽ mavɔmavɔ! Amen. Sedede na kesinɔtɔwo.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: De se na xexe sia me kesinɔtɔwo bena, woagado wo ɖokui ɖe dzi glodzo o, eye womagatsɔ woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ aɖo kesinɔnuwo ƒe dediemanɔmanɔ dzi o; ke boŋ ɖe Mawu gbagbe, si tsɔ nuwo katã na mí fũ be, míawɔ wo ŋuti do la dzi;

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: bene woawɔ dɔmenyo, eye woanye kesinɔtɔwo le nu nyui wɔwɔ me, woalɔ̃ nunana ame, woalɔ̃ hadede,

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: eye woaƒo kesinɔnuwo nu ƒu na wo ɖokui, si anye gɔmeɖoɖoanyi nyui hena ɣeyiɣi si gbɔna, bene woƒe asi nasu agbe vavã la dzi.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Oo, Timoteo! Dzra nusi wode asi na wò la ɖo; gbe dzeɖoɖo ƒuƒlu makɔmakɔwo kple aʋatsosidzedze ƒe nudadafiafia,

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: si me amea ɖewo ʋu, eye wogatre mɔ tso xɔse la gbɔ. Amenuveve nanɔ anyi kpli wò!

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Paulo, Kristo Yesu ƒe apostolo to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, le agbe ƒe ŋugbedodo, si le Kristo Yesu me la nu,

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Timoteo, vinye lɔlɔ̃tɔ: Amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, Fofo la, kple Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ gbɔ la, woana wò! Nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena tenɔnɔ sesĩe.

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawu, amesi mesubɔna, abe alesi menyae, tso tɔgbuitɔgbuinyewo gbɔ ene le dzitsinya dzadzɛ me, abe alesi nyemedzudzɔa ŋkuɖoɖo dziwò le nye kukuɖeɖewo me zã kple keli o ene —

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: ne medo ŋku wò aɖatsiwo dzi la, edzroam be, makpɔ wò, bene dzidzo nayɔm fũ —

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: esi medo ŋku xɔse alakpa manɔmee, si le mewò, si na mamãwo Loide kple dawò Eunike me gbã la dzi, eye menyae pete be, ele wò hã mewò.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Eyata mele ŋku dom edzi na wò be, nade dzo Mawu ƒe amenuvevenunana, si le mewo to nye asiɖoɖo dziwò la me.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu mena vɔvɔ̃gbɔgbɔ mi o, ke boŋ ŋusẽ-kple lɔlɔ̃-kpakple ɖokuidziɖuɖugbɔgbɔe wòna mí.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Eyata ŋu nagakpe wò le mia Aƒetɔ ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi kple nye, amesi nye eƒe gatɔ la ŋuti o; ke boŋ kpe fu kple nyanyuie la le Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ la nu,

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: amesi ɖe mí, eye wotsɔ yɔyɔ kɔkɔe yɔ mí; menye le míaƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu o, ke boŋ le ye ŋutɔ ƒe tameɖoɖoɖi kple amenuveve la nu, si wòtsɔ na mi le Kristo Yesu me, hafi ɣeyiɣi mavɔmavɔwo dze gɔme.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la woɖee fia to mía xɔla Kristo Yesu ƒe dodo me, amesi ɖe ku ɖa, eye wòhe agbe kple magblẽmagblẽ ɖe go va kekeli nu to nyanyuie la me,

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: esi nu woɖom menye gbeƒãɖela kple apostolo kpakple trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe nufiala,

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: nusi ta mekpe nusiawo ƒe fu hã ɖo, ke ŋu mekpem o: elabena menya amesi dzi mexɔ se, eye menyae pete bena, ŋusẽ le esi wòate ŋu adzra nusi wode asi nam la ɖo hena ŋkeke ma.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Lé nya, siwo le blibo, siwo nèse le nunye la ƒe kpɔɖeŋu me ɖe asi le xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃, si le Kristo Yesu me la me.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Dzra nu nyui, si wode asi na wò la ɖo to Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe, si nɔa mía me la me.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Enya esia bena, amesiwo katã le Asia la trɔ dzo le yonyeme, amesiwo dome Figelo kple Hermogene wole.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la nakpɔ nublanui na Onesiforo ƒe aƒe la; elabena ena nye dzi gbɔ ɖe eme enuenu, eye ŋu mekpenɛ le nye kɔsɔkɔsɔwo ŋuti o;

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: ke boŋ, esime wòva Roma la, edim vevie ŋuta, eye wòkpɔm.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la naɖi nɛ, be wòakpɔ nublanuikpɔkpɔ le Aƒetɔ la gbɔ le ŋkeke ma dzi; eye subɔsubɔdɔ geɖe, siwo wòwɔ le Efeso la, wò la ènyae petepete.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Azɔ wò la, vinye, sẽ ŋu le amenuveve, si le Kristo Yesu me la me,

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: eye nusiwo nèse tso gbɔnye le ɖaseɖila geɖewo dome la, nu mawo ke natsɔ ade asi na ame wɔnuteƒewo, amesiwo ate ŋu afia nu ame bubuwo hã.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Azɔ wò la, do dzi le fukpekpe me abe Yesu Kristo ƒe aʋawɔla nyui ene.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke menɔa aʋa wɔm so gatsɔa eɖokui dea nuɖuɖudɔwɔwɔwo me o, bene wòadze amesi tsɔ aʋae la ŋu.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Agbledela, si dzea agbagba la, ele nɛ be, wòatre kutsetse la ƒe ɖe ɖuɖu.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Bu nusi gblɔm mele la me kpɔ; elabena Aƒetɔ la ana gɔmesese wò le nuwo katã me.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku Yesu Kristo, tsi tsi tre tso ame kukuwo dome, amesi tso Dawid ƒe ƒome me le nye nyanyuie nu la dzi,

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: nusi ŋuti mekpe fu ɖo yiɖase bablawo me, abe nuvɔ̃wɔla ene; gake womebu mawunya la o.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Eyata medoa dzi le nuwo katã me ɖe ame tiatiawo ta, bene woawo hã ƒe asi nasu xɔxɔ, si le Kristo Yesu me, kple ŋutikɔkɔe mavɔmavɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Nyateƒenya wònye: Ne míeku kpakplii la, míanɔ agbe hã kpakplim,

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: ne miedo dzi la, míaɖu fia hã kpakplii; ne miegbe nu le egbɔ la, eyama hã lagbe nu le mia gbɔ;

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: ne míenye nuteƒewɔlawo o la, eyama lanɔ anyi nuteƒewɔla; elabena mate ŋu agbe nu le eɖokui gbɔ o. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le aʋatsonufialawo ƒe nyaʋiʋli ƒuƒlu ŋuti.

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu nusiawo na wo, eye naɖi ɖase na wo le Aƒetɔ la ŋku me, bene womagatsɔ nya awɔ dzre, si me viɖea ɖeke mele o la o, ke boŋ woblua nyaselawo ƒe tame.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Do vevie be, natsɔ ɖokuiwò afia Mawu abe ame like kple dɔwɔla, si mehiã be, ŋu nakpee o, kpakple amesi ma nyateƒenya la me pɛpɛpɛ ene.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Ke si le dzeɖoɖo ƒuƒlu makɔmakɔwo nu; elabena woayi dzi geɖe wu le mawumavɔ̃mavɔ̃ me,

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: eye woƒe nya la keke ɖe dzi abe abi vɔ̃ ene, amesiwo dome Himenaio kple Fileto wole,

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: amesiwo tre mɔ tso nyateƒe la gbɔ hele gbɔgblɔm bena, tsitretsitsi va yi xoxo, eye wotrɔa amea ɖewo ƒe xɔse tsyɔa anyi.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Gake la Mawu ƒe gɔmeɖoɖoanyi sesẽ la lia ke, eye nutrenu sia li nɛ. Aƒetɔ la nya amesiwo nye etɔwo, eye amesiame, si yɔa Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkɔ la, nate ɖa le madzɔmadzɔnyenye gbɔ.

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Ke le aƒe gã me la menye sikanuwo kple klosalonuwo ɖeɖekoe nane o, ke boŋ atinuwo kple anyinuwo hã nɔnɛ, ɖewo li bubu le wo ŋu, ɖewo li bubu mele wo ŋu o.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Eyata ne amea ɖe klɔ eɖokui keŋ tso nu mawo me la, anye goe, si ŋu bubu le, si ŋuti kɔ, si nyo na aƒeatɔ ƒe ŋuɖɔwɔwɔ, si wodzra ɖo ɖi hena dɔ nyui sia dɔ nyui wɔwɔ. Le zɔzɔ nyui ŋuti.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Si le ɖekakpuinyenye ƒe nudzodzrowo nu; ke dze dzɔdzɔenyenye, xɔse, lɔlɔ̃ kple ŋutifafa yome hekpe de amesiwo katã yɔ Aƒetɔ la le dzi dzadzɛ me la ŋu.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Ke gbe bometsitsi ƒe yakanukutsyɔtsyɔwo, elabena ènyae bena, wòhea dzre ko vɛ.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Ke ele na Aƒetɔ la ƒe subɔla be, wòagawɔ dzre o, ke boŋ wòanye amesi nyoa dɔme na amewo katã, amesi tea ŋu fiãa nu, amesi doa dzi le vɔ̃ me,

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: amesi gbea nya le dzigbɔɖeanyi me na amesiwo tsia tre ɖe mawunya ŋu, ɖewo Mawu ana dzimetɔtrɔ wo, bene woadze si nyateƒe la,

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: eye woaganyɔ̃ avo atso Abosam, si lé wo aboyo, bene woawɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la ƒe mɔ me mahĩ.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Ke nya esia bena, le ŋkeke mamleawo me la ɣeyiɣi vɔ̃wo lava.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Elabena ameawo lanye ɖokuilɔ̃lawo, galɔ̃lawo, adegbe ƒuƒlu ƒolawo, dadalawo, busunyagblɔlawo, ame maɖoto dzilawo, ame madakpewo kple ame makɔmakɔwo;

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: amesiwo melɔ̃a ame ƒe nya o, amesiwo gbea avuléle, ameŋuzɔlawo, amesiwo mete ŋu ɖua wo ɖokui dzi o, ame wɔadãwo, amesiwo melɔ̃a nu nyui o,

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: yomemɔfialawo, ame mabunuwo, amesiwo doa wo ɖokui ɖe dzi glodzo, amesiwo lɔ̃a hadzedze wu esi woalɔ̃ Mawu,

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: amesiwo si mawusosroɖa ƒe nɔnɔme le, gake wogbe eƒe ŋusẽ la. Te ɖokuiwò ɖa tso amesiawo gbɔ!

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiawo dome amea ɖewo li, siwo gena ɖe aƒewo me dzaa, eye woɖea aboyo nyɔnu abunetɔ, siwo yɔ fũ kple nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ, eye nudzodzro bubu ƒomevi geɖewo kplɔa wo yinɛ,

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: amesiwo srɔ̃a nu ɖaa, eye womate ŋu ava nyateƒe ƒe sidzedze la gbɔ akpɔ o.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Alesi Yane kple Yambre wotsi tre ɖe Mose ŋuti la, nenema ke woawo hã wotsi tre ɖe nyateƒe la ŋuti; Ame tamegbegblẽtɔwo, amesiwo meli ke le xɔse me o.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ke womayi dzi geɖe wu o, elabena woƒe aɖaʋadzedze la dze ƒã na amewo katã, abe ame mawo tɔ ke hã ene. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena agbenɔnɔ le ŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe la nu.

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: nye yometitiwo kple nye fukpekpe, siwo mekpe le Antioxia kple Ikonio kple Listra la yome; yometiti ma, siwo medo dzi kpe la, Aƒetɔ la ɖem tso wo katã me.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo katã ɖina be, yewoanɔ agbe ɖe mawusosroɖa nu le Kristo Yesu me la, woati woawo hã yome tsã.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple ameblelawo la woayi dzi vɔ̃ɖitɔe wu anɔ amewo blem, eye amewo able wo.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Ke wò la nɔ nusiwo nesrɔ̃, eye nèkpɔ kakaɖedzi le wo me la me; elabena ènya amesiwo gbɔ nèsrɔ̃e le,

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: eye esi tso ɖevime ke nènya ŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔeawo la, woate ŋu ana nunya wò hena agbexɔxɔ to xɔse, si le Kristo Yesu me la me.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Ŋɔŋlɔ sia ŋɔŋlɔ, si tso Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ me la, enyo hã na nufiafia, na mokaka, na ɖɔɖɔɖo, na amehehe, si le dzɔdzɔenyenye me,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: bene Mawu ƒe ame la nade blibo, eye wòanɔ dzadzraɖoɖi hena dɔ nyui sia dɔ nyui wɔwɔ.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Mele atam kam na wò, le Mawu kple Yesu Kristo, amesi le ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge ame gbagbewo kple ame kukuwo le eƒe ɖeɖefia kple fiaɖuƒe me la, ƒe ŋku me:

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Ɖe gbe ƒã nya la, nɔ edzi, vovoɣi li alo vovoɣi meli o, ka mo, gbe nya, xlɔ̃ nu le dzigbɔɖeanyi kple nufiafia katã me.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Elabena ɣeyiɣi le vava ge, esime womaxɔ nufiafia, si le blibo la o; ke boŋ, le alesi tome fiẽ wo nu la, woaƒo nufialawo nu ƒu na wo ɖokui le woa ŋutɔwo ƒe nudzodzrowo la nu.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Eye woaɖe to ɖa le nyateƒe la ŋuti, eye woatrɔ ayi gliwo gbɔ.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Ke wò la nɔ mo xexi le nuwo katã me, do dzi le fukpekpewo me, wɔ nyanyuiegblɔla ƒe do, eye nawu wò subɔsubɔdɔ la nu blibo.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Elabena nye la wotsɔm le memem xoxo, eye nye dzodzoɣi la gogo. Paulo ƒe ʋiʋli kple fiakuku la.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Ʋiʋli nyui lae meʋli; mewu nye mɔzɔzɔ la nu, melé xɔse la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Tso ekema dzi la wodzra dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe dziɖuɖukuku la ɖo ɖi nam, si Aƒetɔ, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la dzɔdzɔe la, lanam le ŋkeke ma dzi; ke menye nye ɖeɖekoe o, ke boŋ amesiwo katã lɔ̃ eƒe ɖeɖefia la hãe. Nyadzɔdzɔwo, dɔdasiwo kple ɖuɖɔwo.

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Do vevie be, nava gbɔnye kaba.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Elabena Dema gblẽm tii, le esi wògalɔ̃ fifi xexe sia me la ŋuti, eye wòyi ele Tesalonika; Kreske yi de Galatia, Tito yi de Dalmatia.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka ɖeɖekoe li kplim. Xo Marko, eye nakplɔe de asi ve; elabena enye kpedeŋutɔ nyui nam le subɔsubɔ gome

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Ke Tixiko ta meɖoe ɖe Efeso.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Ne egbɔna la, tsɔ awu ʋlaya, si megblẽ ɖe Troa ɖe Karpo gbɔ la, kple agbalẽawo ɖe asi vɛ, vevietɔ lãgbalẽ la.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Aleksandro, akɔblitula, wɔ vɔ̃ geɖe ɖe ŋunye; Aƒetɔ la aɖo eteƒe ne le eƒe nuwɔnawo nu;

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: wò hã kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi nyuie le eyama ŋuti; elabena etsi tre ɖe míaƒe nyawo ŋuti ŋutɔ.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Le ɖokuinye nuɖeɖe gbãtɔ me la amea ɖeke mede dzinye o, ke boŋ wo katã wogblẽm ɖi. Womagabu esia na wo o.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la tsi tre ɖe gbɔnye, eye wòdo ŋusẽm, bena mawu gbeƒãɖeɖe la nu, eye trɔ̃subɔlawo katã nasee, eye wòɖem le dzata ƒe nu me.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Eye Aƒetɔ la aɖem le nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃wo katã me, eye wòaxɔm heyi ɖe eƒe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me; eya tɔ lanye ŋutikɔkɔe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Ɖuɖɔ Priska kple Akwila kpakple Onesiforo ƒe aƒe la nam ƒã.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasto nɔ Korinto, Trofimo la, megblẽe ɖe Mileto wòle dɔ lém.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Do vevie be, nava, hafi ne vuvɔŋɔli naɖo. Eubulo kple Pude kple Lino kple Klaudia kpakple nɔviwo katã ɖuɖɔ wò ƒã.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo nanɔ anyi kple wò gbɔgbɔ la! Amenuveve nanɔ anyi kpli mi!

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Paulo, Mawu ƒe dɔla kple Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolo le Mawu ƒe ame tiatiawo ƒe xɔse kple nyateƒe ƒe sidzedze, si le mawusosroɖa me la nu,

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: ɖe agbe mava ƒe nukpɔkpɔ ŋu, si Mawu, amesi meka aʋatso o la, do ŋugbe, hafi ɣeyiɣi mavɔmavɔwo dze gɔme;

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: ke eɖe eƒe nya la fia le ye ŋutɔ ƒe azãgbe la dzi le gbeƒãɖeɖe, si wòtsɔ de asi nam la me, le Mawu, mía xɔla ƒe sedede la nu,

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Tito, vinye vavã le mí ame eve ƒe xɔse la nu: Amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, Fofo la, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo, mía xɔla gbɔ la, woana wò! Le hamemegãwo ɖoɖo kple Kretatɔwo ƒe agbe vlo nɔnɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Eyata megblẽ wò ɖe Kreta, bena naɖo nusiwo susɔ la teƒeteƒe, eye naɖo hamemegãwo le du sia du me, abe alesi mede se na wò la ene:

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Amesi ke nye mokaka manɔŋutɔ, nyɔnu ɖeka srɔ̃, amesi si vi xɔsetɔ, siwo nu wometso be, wòwɔa nu vlo alo womeɖoa to o la le.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Elabena ele na dzikpɔla bena, wòanye mokaka manɔŋutɔ, abe Mawu ƒe xɔnuvi ene; Wòaganye ɖokuiŋudzela o, wòaganye dɔmedzoetɔ o, wòaganye aha geɖe nola o, wòaganye ameƒola o, wòagaɖi viɖe ƒoɖi o;

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wòanye amedzrowɔla, nunyuilɔ̃la, ame ɖɔŋuɖo, dzɔdzɔetɔ, kɔkɔetɔ kple ɖokuidziɖula,

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: amesi léa nyateƒenya la me ɖe asi le nufiafia la nu, bena wòate ŋu axlɔ̃ nu le nufiafia, si le blibo la me, eye woaka mo na ɖeklemiɖelawo.
