english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Elabena tosẽla geɖewo kple nya dzodzro gblɔlawo kple ameblelawo li, vevietɔ le aʋatsotsotɔwo dome,

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: amesiwo nu wòle be, woatsi nya ɖo, amesiwo trɔ ƒome blibo geɖewo ƒe tame hele nu dzodzrowo fiãm le viɖe ƒoɖi ta.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ ɖeka, si nye woa ŋutɔwo ƒe nyagblɔɖila la, gblɔ be: „Kretatɔwo nye aʋatsokalawo ɖaa, lã vɔ̃ɖiwo, ƒodo wɔkuviawo.“

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Ɖaseɖiɖi sia nye nyateƒe; le esia ta ka mo na wo vevie, bene woanɔ blibo le xɔse me,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: bene womagaɖo to Yudatɔwo ƒe gliwo kple amesiwo trɔ tso nyateƒe gbɔ la ƒe sededeawo o.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Nuwo katã le dzadzɛ na ame dzadzɛwo; ke ame ƒoɖiwo kple dzimaxɔsetɔwo la, naneke mele dzadzɛ na wo o, ke boŋ woƒe tame kple woƒe dzitsinya siaa ƒo ɖi.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Woʋua eme bena, yewonya Mawu, ke wotsɔ woƒe nuwɔnawo gbe nu le egbɔ; wonye ame nyɔŋuwo kple tosẽlawo kple amesiwo medze dɔ nyui wòwɔa ɖeke kura o.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Ke wò la gblɔ nusiwo dze nufiafia, si le blibo,

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: bena ame tsitsiwo nanye ɖokuidziɖulawo, ɖokuiléla nyuiwo, ame ɖɔŋuɖowo, eye woanɔ blibo le xɔse, lɔlɔ̃ kple dzidodo me.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Nenema ke nyɔnu tsitsiwo hã nanɔ anyi, abe alesi wòdze nyɔnu kɔkɔewo ene: Wòaganye ameŋuzɔlawo o, wòaganye aha geɖe nola wo o; ke boŋ woanye nu nyui fialawo,

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: bene woaxlɔ̃ nu ɖetugbiwo, ne woalɔ̃ wo srɔ̃wo kple wo viwo,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: woanye ɖokuidziɖulawo, ame dzadzɛwo, aƒe me dɔwɔlawo, dɔmenyotɔwo, eye woabɔbɔ wo ɖokui na woa ŋutɔ wo srɔ̃wo, bena woagagblɔ busunya ɖe mawunya la ŋuti o.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Nenema ke xlɔ̃ nu ɖekakpuiwo hã be, woaɖu wo ɖokui dzi nyuie.

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: Le nuwo katã me la tsɔ ɖokuiwò ɖo kpɔɖeŋu le do nyui wɔwɔwo me, megabaɖa nufiafia la o, lé ɖokuiwò nyuie,

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: wò nyagbɔgblɔ nana blibo, si womate ŋu abu fɔ o, bena ŋu nakpe amesi tsi tre ɖe eŋuti, le esi nyaa ɖeke mele esi be, wòagblɔ vɔ̃ ɖe mía ŋuti o la ta.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Xlã nu dolawo bena, woabɔbɔ wo ɖokui na woa ŋutɔwo ƒe aƒetɔwo, be wòadze wo ŋu le nusianu me: Wòaganye ɖeklemiɖelawo o,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: womagafi naneke aɣla o; ke boŋ woaɖe nuteƒewɔwɔ nyui katã afia, bene woaɖo atsyɔ̃ na Mawu, mía xɔla ƒe nufiafia la le nuwo katã me. Mawu ƒe amenuveve, si xɔa ame, eye wòhea ame.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe amenuveve la ɖe eɖokui fia hetso xoxo vɛ na amewo katã,

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: eye wòɖea mí, bena míagbe mawumavɔ̃mavɔ̃ kple xexeame nudzodzrowo, eye míano anyi le ɖokuidziɖuɖu kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kpakple mawusosroɖa me le xexe sia me,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: eye mianɔ yayramɔkpɔkpɔ kple Mawu gã la kple mía xɔla Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ɖeɖefia la lalam,

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: amesi tso eɖokui hena ɖe mía ta, bene yeaxe fe ɖe mia ta axɔ mí atso sedzimawɔmawɔ katã me, eye bene yeaklɔ dukɔ, si doa vevie le dɔ nyui wɔwɔ me la ŋuti hena ye ŋutɔ ɖokui!

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Gblɔ nusiawo, eye naxlɔ̃ nu, eye naka mo kple ŋusẽ katã! Megana amea ɖeke nado vlo wò o!

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu nusiawo na wo bena, woabɔbɔ wo ɖokui na dziɖulowo kple ŋusẽwo, eye woaɖo to wo, eye woasu te hena do nyui sia do nyui wɔwɔ:

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Woagagblɔ busunya ɖe amea ɖeke ŋuti o, wòaganye dzrehelawo o; woanye ame fetuwo, woatsɔ dɔmefafa katã afia amewo katã.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Elabena tsã la miawo hã míenye ame manyanuwo, tosẽlawo, mɔtrelawo, nu dzodzro kple dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ bubu ƒomevi geɖewo ƒe subɔlawo, vɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ kple ŋuʋaʋã me nɔlawo, ame nyɔŋuwo kple amesiwo léa fu wo nɔewo.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Ke esime Mawu, mía xɔla ƒe dɔmenyonyo kple amelɔlɔ̃ do la,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: exɔ mi ɖe agbe; menye le dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe dɔ, si miawo miewɔ la ta o, ke boŋ exɔ mí le eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ la nu to gbugbɔgadzi ƒe tsilele kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe ƒe yeye wɔwɔ la me,

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: si wòkɔ ɖe mía dzi fũ ŋutɔ to Yesu Kristo, mía xɔla la dzi,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: bena mí amesiwo wotso afia na to eƒe amenuveve me la, míazu agbe mavɔ ƒe domenyilawo le nukpɔkpɔ la nu. Nufiafia dɔdɔ kple ɖuɖɔ vovovowo.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Nyateƒenya wònye, eye mele ɖiɖim be, wò la naka ɖe nusiawo dzi, bena amesiwo xɔ Mawu dzi se la, nado vevie anɔ dɔ nyui wɔwɔwo dzi. Nusiawo nyo, eye wonye viɖenu na amewo.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Ke si le bometsitsi ƒe anukutsyɔtsyɔwo kple dzidzimenyawo kple dzrehehewo kpakple avuwɔwɔwo le sea ŋuti la nu; elabena womenyo na naneke o, eye wonye yakanuwo.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Ne èxlɔ̃ nu kɔmamãwɔlaa ɖe zi ɖeka alo zi eve la, nagbee;

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: elabena anyae be, amesia tɔgbe gblẽ keŋ, eye wòwɔa nuvɔ̃ hebua fɔ eɖokui.

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Ne medɔ Artema alo Tixiko de gbɔwò la, do vevie be, nava gbɔnye le Nikopoli; elabena meɖoe bena, manɔ afima le vuvɔŋɔli.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Do mɔ sefiala Zena kple Apolo nyuie, bena naneke nagahiã wo o.

english_verse: Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.
translation_verse: Ke na mia tɔwo hã nasrɔ̃ dɔ nyui wɔwɔwo dzinɔnɔ hena nu vevi, siwo hiã ame la, bene woagatsi ku matsematse o.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Amesiwo katã le gbɔnye la, ɖuɖɔ wò ƒã. Ɖuɖɔ amesiwo katã lɔ̃a mí le xɔse me la nam ƒã. Amenuveve nanɔ anyi kpli mi katã!

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: kple Apia, mia nɔvinyɔnu, kple Arxipo, mía hadɔwɔla, kpakple hame, si le aƒewò me:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu, mía Fofo, kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, woana mi!

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawunye ɖaasi, ne meɖoa ŋku dziwò le nye gbedodoɖawo me,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: esi mesena le wò lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ, si le asiwò hena Aƒetɔ Yesu kple ame kɔkɔewo katã la ŋuti,

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: bene wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe hadede nasẽ ŋu hena Kristo Yesu to nu nyui sia nu nyui, si le mía me la sidzedze me?

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Elabena, nɔvi, miekpɔ dzidzɔ geɖe kple akɔfafa le wò lɔlɔ̃ la ŋuti, le esi ame kɔkɔewo ƒe dziwo kpɔ gbɔɖeme to dziwò la ta.

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: Esi menye amesia tɔgbe la, nye Paulo tsitsi, si nye Kristo Yesu ƒe gatɔ hã azɔ la,

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: mele kuku dem na wò de vinye Onesimo, si medzi le nye bablawo me la ta,

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: amesi menye viɖea ɖeke na wò tsã o; ke azɔ la enye viɖe nyui na wò kple nye hã;

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: amesi megbugbɔ le ɖoɖom ɖe wò la. Wò la xɔ eyama, eyae nye nye ŋutɔ nye dzi,

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: amesi medi be, wòanɔ gbɔnye, bena wòasubɔm de tewòƒe le nyanyuie ƒe bablawo me hafi;

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: gake esi nyemenya wò lɔlɔ̃nu o la, nyemedi be, mawɔ naneke o, bena wò nyuiwɔwɔ la nagato dzizizi me o, ke boŋ wòato lɔlɔ̃nu faa me.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Elabena ɖewohĩ esia ŋuti wòdzo le gbɔwò ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe, bena wòanɔ gbɔwò tegbetegbe;

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: megale abe kluvi ene o, ke boŋ wu kluvi la, ele abe nɔvi lɔlɔ̃ ene, vevietɔ na nye, ke aleke geɖe wu wònyee na wò le ŋutilã me kple Aƒetɔ la me siaa?

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, ne èbum wò hadela la, xɔe abe nye ŋutɔ ene.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Ke ne ewo vɔ̃a ɖe ɖe ŋuwò, alo wònyi fea ɖe le asiwò la, bui nam.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Nye Paulo ŋutɔe tsɔ nye asi ŋlɔe, maxe fea; nyemelɔ̃ be, magblɔ na wò bena, wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò gɔ̃ hã ƒe fe nènyi le asinye o.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Ẽ, nɔvi, na nye la makpɔ viɖe tso gbɔwò le Aƒetɔ la me; na nye dzi nagbɔ ɖe eme le Kristo me!

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Esi meɖo dzi ɖe wò toɖoɖo ŋu ŋuti la, mèŋlɔe na wò; elabena menyae bena, awɔe woagbã dzi wu alesi megblɔ na wò.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Ke dzra dzeƒe ɖo ɖi na nye hã; elabena mele mɔ kpɔm bena, to miaƒe gbedodoɖawo me la woatsɔm ake mi.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: kple Marko kple Aristarxo kple Dema kpakple Luka, hanyedɔwɔlawo, ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve nanɔ anyi kple miaƒe gbɔgbɔ la!

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Esime Mawu ƒo nu na fofoawo le blemaŋɔli to nyagblɔɖilawo dzi zi geɖewo le nya ƒomevi geɖewo me la, eƒo nu kple miawo hã le ŋkeke mamletɔ siawo me le Via me,

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: amesi nye teƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe keklẽ kple eƒe mawunyenye ƒe nɔnɔme, eye wòtsɔa eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe nya léa nuwo katã ɖe asi: eye esi wòwu miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ƒe kɔklɔɖa nu va la, ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe gãnyenye ƒe nuɖusi me le dziƒo;

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: eye zi geɖe alesi wòƒo mawudɔlawo ta le ŋkɔ gã xɔxɔ me la, zi geɖe ma ke wòzu gã wu wo.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Elabena mawudɔlawo dome ameka wògblɔ na kpo bena: „Vinye nènye, egbea medzi wò“ mahã? Eye wògagblɔ bena: „Nye la manye Fofo nɛ, eye eya hã lanye Vi nam“ mahã?

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Ke ne egakplɔ ŋgɔgbevi la va xexeame la, egblɔ bena: „Eye Mawu ƒe dɔlawo katã woade ta agu ne.“

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ le mawudɔlawo ŋuti bena: „Etso eƒe dɔlawo wɔ yawo, eye wòtsɔ eƒe subɔlawo wo dzo ƒe aɖewo;“

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: ke egblɔ le Via ŋuti bena: „Mawu, wò fiazikpui nɔa anyi tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, fiatikplɔ dzɔdzɔe enye wò fiaɖuɖu ƒe fiatikplɔ.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Elɔ̃a dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye nèlea fu madzɔmadzɔnyenye; eyata Mawu, wò Mawu la, tsɔ dzidzɔmi si na wò wu wò hatiwo.

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe ɖo anyigba gɔme anyi le gɔmedzedzea me, eye dziƒowo nye wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Woamawo nu ayi, ke wò la ànɔ anyi ɖaa: eye wo katã anyunyɔ abe avɔ ene,

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: eye aɖo li wo woaɖɔ abe awu ene; gake wò la nenema ko nèle, eye wò ƒewo nu metsona o.

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Ke mawudɔlawo dome ameka wògblɔ na kpɔ bena: „Bɔbɔ nɔ nye nuɖusi me, vaseɖe esime matsɔ wò futɔwo awɔ wò afɔɖodzinui“ mahã?

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Alo wo katã la, ɖe menye subɔsubɔgbɔgbɔwo wonye woɖo ɖa be, woawɔ subɔsubɔdɔ le amesiwo lanyi agbexɔxɔ ƒe dome la ta o mahã?

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Eyata ele na mí bena, míalé to ɖe nusiwo miese la ŋuti geɖe wu, bene miagato eŋuti ayi o.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Elabena ne nya, si wogblɔ ɖi to mawudɔlawo dzi la, li dzi sesĩe, eye vodada sia vodada kple tosesẽ sia tosesẽ kpɔ eŋuti fetu vɔ̃, si dze la,

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: aleke gɔ̃ míawo míele sisi gee, ne mielé be na ale xɔxɔ gã sia o mahã? Esia ŋutinya Aƒetɔ la gblɔ gbã, eye amesiwo see la, ka de edzi na mi,

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: eye Mawu ŋuta hã tsɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo kple ŋusẽnu bubu ƒomevi geɖewo kple Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe nana le ye ŋutɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, ɖi ɖase hekpe ɖe wo ŋuti. Kristo to fukpekpe me heyi ɖe ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Elabena metsɔ xexeme, si le vava ge, si ŋuti míeƒoa nu lena la, de mawudɔlawo ƒe ŋusẽ te o.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖe ɖi ɖase kɔte le afia ɖe bena: „Nukae nye amegbetɔ bena, nèɖoa ŋku edzi, kple amegbetɔvi be, nèléa ŋku ɖe eŋu?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Ebɔbɔe ɖe anyi ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe wu mawudɔlawo; ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu nètso ɖɔ nɛ, eye nètsɔe ɖo wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã nu,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: nuwo katã nètsɔ de eƒe afɔ te.“ Elabena le nuwo katã tsɔtsɔ de eƒe afɔ te me la naneke mesusɔ ɖi, si wometsɔ de ete o; gake azɔ la míekpɔ haɖe ke bena, wotsɔ nuwo katã de ete o.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Gake miekpɔ Yesu, amesi wòbɔbɔ ɖe anyi ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe wu mawudɔlawo la bena, le ku ƒe fukpekpe ta la wotsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu ɖɔ nɛ, bene wòaɖɔ ku akpɔ ɖe amesiame nu to Mawu ƒe amenuveve me.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ta nuwo katã ti ɖo, amesi me nuwo katã to va, amesi kplɔ vi geɖewo yi ɖe ŋutikɔkɔe me la, edzee bena, woawɔ wo xɔxɔ ƒe fia la blibo to fukpekpewo me.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi kɔa amewo ŋuti kple amesiwo ŋuti wokɔ la, wo katã dzɔ tso ame ɖeka me, eyata ŋu mekpee be, wòayɔ wo be nɔviwo o:

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: esime wògblɔ bena: „Matsɔ wò ŋkɔ aɖe gbe ƒã na nɔvinyewo, le hame la titina madzi ha akafu wò.“

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Eye wògagblɔ be: „Matsɔ nye ŋuɖoɖo aɖo edzi.“ Eye wògagblɔ be: „Kpɔ ɖa, mía kple vi, siwo Mawu tso nam la, enye esi.“

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Azɔ alesi viawo kpɔ ʋu kple ŋutilã ƒe gome la, nenema ke eya hã kpɔ ekemawo ƒe gome, bene wòato ku me aɖi gbɔ amesi si ku ƒe ŋusẽ le, si nye Abosam la,

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: eye woade amesiwo katã nɔ kluvinyenye me to vɔvɔ̃ na ku me le woƒe agbenɔɣiwo katã me la.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Elabena vavã, menye mawudɔlawo wòva xɔxɔ ge na o, ke boŋ Abraham ƒome wòva xɔxɔ ge na.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Eyata ele nɛ be, wòaɖi nɔviawo le nuwo katã me, bene wòatrɔ zu nunɔlagã nublanuikpɔla kple nuteƒewɔla le Mawu ƒe dɔwo gome, bene wòalé avu le dukɔ la ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Elabena esi wòkpe fu, eye wotee kpɔ ŋuti la, ate ŋu axɔ na amesiwo wotena kpɔna.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti, nɔvi kɔkɔewo, dziƒoyɔyɔ gomekpɔlawo: Mibu miaƒe xɔsemeʋuʋu ƒe ame dɔdɔ kple nunɔlagã Yesu la ŋuti,

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: amesi nye nuteƒewɔla na amesi ɖoe, abe alesi Mose hã nye nuteƒewɔla le eƒe aƒe blibo la katã me ene.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Elabena zi geɖe alesi amesi dzra aƒe ɖo la kpɔa bubu gã wu aƒea la, zi geɖe ma ke wobu eyama be, edze ŋutikɔkɔe gã xɔxɔ wu Mose.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Elabena aƒe sia aƒe la amee dzranɛ ɖo; ke amesi dzraa nuwo katã ɖo la, eyae nye Mawu.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Eye Mose la nye nuteƒewɔla le eƒe aƒe blibo la katã me abe subɔla ene, bene wòaɖi ɖase le nusiwo woava gblɔ la ŋuti;

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: ke Kristo la nye nuteƒewɔla abe Vi ene le eƒe aƒe dzi; amesi ƒe aƒe míawo míenye, nenye be, mielé dzideƒo kple mɔkpɔkpɔ ƒe adegbeƒoƒo ɖe asi sesĩe vaseɖe nuwuwu.

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti abe alesi Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la gblɔ ene be: „Egbegbe, ne miese eƒe gbe la,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: migasẽ miaƒe dzime, abe alesi wowɔ le dɔmedzoe me le tetekpɔ ƒe ŋkeke la dzi le gbeadzi ene o,

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: esime mia fofowo tem kpɔ, eye woɖom kpɔ, eye wokpɔ nye dɔwɔwɔwo ƒe blane sɔŋ.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Eyata nenem dzidzime sia ƒe nu ku dzi nam, eye megblɔ be: Ɖaasi woƒe dzi tra mɔ; ke womenya nye mɔwo o.

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Eyata meka atam le nye dziku me bena: Ne woahade nye dzudzɔ la me fĩ!“

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mikpɔ nyuie be, dzi vɔ̃ɖi maxɔse naganɔ mia dometɔa ɖeke me o, bene wòagatrɔ atso Mawu gbagbe la gbɔ o,

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: ke mixlɔ̃ nu mia nɔewo gbesiagbe boŋ, ŋkeke alesi woyɔ egbegbe, bene nuvɔ̃ ƒe beble nagasẽ mia dometɔa ɖeke ƒe dzime o.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Elabena míezu Kristo ƒe gomekpɔlawo, nenye be, míalé miaƒe dzideƒo ƒe gɔmedzedze me ɖe asi sesĩe halase nuwuwu la.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Esime wògblɔ be: „Egbegbe, ne miese eƒe gbe la, migasẽ miaƒe dzime, abe alesi wowɔ le dɔmedzoe me ene o!“

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Elabena amekawoe see, eye wòve dome na wo mahã? Alo menye wo katãe, amesiwo Mose kplɔ do go tso Egipte la o mahã?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Ke amekawo wòka atam na bena, ne woahade yeƒe dzudzɔ la me fĩ? Ɖe menye na tosẽlawo o mahã?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Eye míekpɔ bena, womete ŋu yi ɖe eme o le dzimaxɔse ŋuti!

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Eyata esi eƒe dzudzɔ me yiyi ŋugbedodo gali na mi ŋutilã, minɛ miavɔ̃, bene woagakpɔ mía dome amea ɖeke be, etsi eŋuti o

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Elabena wogblɔ nyanyuie la fia míawo hã, abe woamawo ke hã ene; gake nya, si wose la, meɖe via ɖeke na woamawo o; elabena amesiwo see la ƒe xɔse mewɔ ɖeka kple nya la o.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Eyata mí amesiwo xɔe se la, míayi ɖe dzudzɔ ma me, abe alesi wògblɔ ene bena: „Abe alesi meka atam le nye dziku me ene bena: Ne woahade nye dzudzɔ la me fĩ;“ wònye wowu dɔwɔwɔwo nu tso xexeme ƒe gɔmeɖoɖoanyi me hafi.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Elabena egblɔ le afia ɖe le ŋkeke adrelia ŋuti bena: „Eye Mawu dzudzɔ le ŋkeke adrelia dzi tso eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã me.“

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Eye wògagblɔ le afisia bena: „Ne woahade nye dzudzɔ la me fi!“

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Eyata esi wòsusɔ bena, amea ɖewo nayi ɖe eme, eye amesiwo wogblɔ nyanyuie la fia gbã la, meyi ɖe eme o le dzimaxɔse ŋuti la,

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: egaɖo ŋkekea ɖe le Dawid nu le ɣeyiɣi sia megbe bena: „Egbegbe,“ abe alesi wogblɔ ɖi ene bena: „Egbegbe, ne miese eƒe gbe la, migasẽ miaƒe dzime o.“

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖe Yosua kplɔ wo yi ɖe dzudzɔ me la, anye ne megaƒo nu emegbe la le ŋkeke bubua ɖe ŋuti o.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti Sabat ƒe dzudzɔ gasusɔ na Mawu ƒe dukɔ la.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi yi ɖe eƒe dzudzu me la, eya hã dzudzɔ tso eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me, abe alesi Mawu dzudzɔ tso etowo me la ene.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Azɔ minɛ miado vevie, bene míayi ɖe dzudzɔ ma me, bene amea ɖeke nagadze tosesẽ ma ke tɔgbea ɖeke me o.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu ƒe nya la le agbe, eye wòsẽa ŋu, eye wòɖana wua yi nue-vee sia yi nuevee, eye wòƒona ɖe ame yina ɖe eme, halase esime wòmãa luʋɔ kple gbɔgbɔ kple ƒunukpeƒeewo kpakple ƒutomemi me, eye wònye tamesusuwo kple dzimedidiwo ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la;

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: eye nuwɔwɔa ɖeke mele ɣaɣla le eƒe ŋku me o; ke boŋ woklo nu le nuwo katã dzi, eye wotsi ƒeƒle le amesi gbɔ miaƒe nya le la ŋku me!

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi nunɔlagã, si to dziƒowo me yi la, le mía si, si nye Yesu, Mawu Vi la, minɛ mialé miaƒe xɔsemeʋuʋu ɖe asi sesĩe.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Elabena menye nunɔlagã, si mate ŋu anya míaƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔwo na mi o lae le mía si o, ke boŋ enye amesi wote kpɔ le nuwo katã me, abe míawo ke ene, negbe nuvɔ̃ koe mele eŋu o.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Eyata minɛ miatsɔ dzideƒo ate va eƒe amenuvevezikpui la gbɔ, bene míaƒe asi nasu nublanuikpɔkpɔ dzi, eye míakpɔ amenuveve hena mía xɔxɔ le hiahiãgbe.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Elabena nunɔlagã sia nunɔlagã, si wotsɔ tso amewo dome la, woɖoe anyi le amewo ta le Mawu ƒe dɔwo gome, bene wòatsɔ nunanawo kple numemewo ana le nuvɔ̃wo ta,

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: amesi ate ŋu ave ame manyanuwo kple mɔtrelawo nu, esi gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ le eya ŋutɔ hã ŋuti la ta,

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: eye esia ta wòle nɛ bena, abe alesi wòsa vɔ ɖe dukɔ ta ene la, nenema ke wòasa vɔ ɖe ye ŋutɔ ɖokui hã ta le nuvɔ̃wo ŋuti.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke metsɔ bubu sia na eɖokui o, ke boŋ Mawu yɔnɛ abe Aron ene.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Nenema ke Kristo hã metsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe na eɖokui, bene wòanye nunɔlagã o: ke boŋ amesi gblɔ ne bena: „Vinye nènye, egbea medzi wò“ lae:

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: abe alesi wogblɔ le afi bubua ɖe hã ene bena: „Wòe nye nunɔla yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me le Melxizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu.“

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Amesi tso gbedodoɖawo kple kukuɖeɖewo le eƒe ŋutilã me nono ƒe ŋkekewo me hekpe ɖe ɣlidodo sesĩ kple aɖatsiwo ŋu va amesi te ŋu xɔe tso ku me la gbɔ, eye wòɖo toe le esi wòvɔ̃a Mawu la ŋuti;

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: eye wònye Vi wònye hafi, gake wòsrɔ̃ toɖoɖo le fu, siwo wokpe la me;

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: eye esi wowɔe blibo la, ezu agbexɔxɔ mava ƒe gɔmeɖola na amesiwo katã ɖoa toe,

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: amesi Mawu yɔ be nunɔlagã le Melxizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu.

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Nusiawo ŋutie nya geɖe le mía si be, míagblɔ, eye wo gɔmeɖeɖefia nye do, le esi míenye kuviatɔwo le nyasese me la ŋuti.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Elabena ele na mi be, mianye nufialawo le ɣeyiɣi la ƒe didi nu; gake egahiã mí be, woagafia nusiwo nye Mawu ƒe nyawo ƒe gɔmedzenuwo mi, eye míezu abe amesiwo gahiã notsi ko, eye menye nuɖuɖu sesẽ o la ene.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Elabena amesiame, si nɔa notsi nom la, menya naneke le dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe nya ŋuti o; elabena vidzie ko wònye.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Ke nuɖuɖu sesẽ li na amesiwo tsi zu blibo to ŋudɔwɔwɔ me kpɔ sidzenu, siwo nu ma wo, be wòabu nyui kple vɔ̃ me kpo la.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Eyata mina miagblẽ Kristo ƒe nufiafia ƒe gɔmedzedze ɖi, eye míade ŋgɔgbe ate ɖe blibonyenye ŋuti, bene miagaɖo dzimetɔtrɔ tso dɔwɔwɔ kukuwo me kple Mawu dzixɔse

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: kple mawutsidedetaname ŋuti nufiafiawo kple asidada ɖe ame dzi kple ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi kpakple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ mavɔ ƒe gɔme anyi o.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Eye míawo esia, ne Mawu ɖe mo.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Elabena anyigba, si noa tsi, si dzana ɖe edzi agbadre, eye wòmiea amagbe, si nyo na amesiwo ŋlɔe la, xea yayra tsoa Mawu gbɔ;

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: ke ne emie ŋuwo kple srẽwo la, ezu vlo, eye wòtso ɖe fiƒode gbɔ, esi ƒe nuwuwu nye fiafiã. Nuxɔxɔ le dziɖoɖo ɖe ŋugbedodo la ŋu ŋuti.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Ke, lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, miekpɔ kakaɖedzi le mia ŋuti be, miaƒe nya anyo awu, eye wòate ɖe xɔxɔ ŋu, wònye míeƒo nu alea hafi.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu menye madzɔmadzɔtɔ be, wòaŋlɔ miaƒe dɔwɔwɔ kple lalã, si mieɖe fia le eƒe ŋkɔ ta, le esime miesubɔ ame kɔkɔewo, eye miegale edzi le wo subɔm lã be o.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Ke míele didim vevie bena, mia dome amesiame naɖe veviedodo ma ke afia le mɔkpɔkpɔ ƒe kakaɖedzi blibo vaseɖe nuwuwu la ŋuti,

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: bene míagazu kuviatɔwo o; ke boŋ mizu amesiwo toa xɔse kple dzigbɔgbɔ blewu me nyia ŋugbedodowo ƒe dome la, srɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Elabena esime Mawu na ŋugbedodo Abraham la, le esi amea ɖeke megalolo de enu, ne wòatà o ŋuti la, età ye ŋutɔ ɖokui

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: hegblɔ be: „Vavã matsɔ yayra ayra wò, eye mana tawò nasɔ gbɔ fũ.“

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Eye esi wòdo dzi gbɔ dzi ɖi blewu la, eƒe asi su ŋugbedodo la dzi.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Amewo taa amesiwo lolo gawu, eye nutata enye kpeɖoɖodzi hena woƒe nyaʋiʋli katã ƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Eyata esi Mawu lɔ̃ be, yeaɖe yeƒe adaŋudede ƒe limaɖɔmaɖɔ afia ŋugbedodo ƒe domenyilawo kɔte wu la, etso nutàta heɖo kpe edzi,

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: bena míato nu eve, siwo meɖɔlina o, esiwo me Mawu mate ŋu aka aʋatso le o la me akpɔ dzideƒo sesẽ, mí amesiwo sii tso, bene míalé mɔkpɔkpɔ, si wotsɔ ɖo mía ŋku me la, ɖe asi sesĩe;

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: eye mɔkpɔkpɔ ma le mía si abe luʋɔ ƒe seke, si li dedie, eye wòsesẽ, eye wòyina ɖe xɔmetsovɔ ƒe emelɔƒo la ene,

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: afisi Yesu yi ɖo le mía ta abe ŋgɔnɔla ene, amesi va zu nunɔlagã le Melxizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Elabena Melxizedek sia enye Salem-fia kple Mawu, dziƒoʋĩtɔ, nunɔla, amesi yi ɖakpe Abraham, le esime wògbugbɔ tso fiawo siƒe gbɔna, eye woayrae;

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: amesi hã Abraham tsɔ nuawo katã ƒe ewolia na la; wotso ŋkɔ nɛ gbã be dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe fia; ke emegbe la wotrɔe be Salem-fia, si gɔme enye ŋutifafa fia:

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Tɔ kple nɔ kple dzidzimenya mele esi o; ŋkekewo ƒe gɔmedzedze kple agbe ƒe nuwuwu meli nɛ o; ke boŋ Mawuvi la wòɖi, eye wònɔ anyi nye nunɔla yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Ke mibu amesia, si Abraham, amegã xoxo la, tsɔ aboyonuawo ƒe ewolia na la, ƒe gãnyenye ŋuti kpɔ.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Lewi-vi, siwo xɔ nunɔlanyenye la, se le woawo hã si, bena woaxɔ nuwo ƒe ewolia tso dukɔ, si nye wo nɔviwo la si me le se la nu, wònye Abraham ƒe ali me woawo hã wodo tso hafi;

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: ke ame ma, si ƒe dzidzime metso wo gbɔ o la, xɔ nuwo ƒe ewolia tso Abraham si me, eye wòyra amesi si ŋugbedodo le.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Ke ɖikekea ɖeke mele eme o bena, amesi nye gãtɔ la, yra amesi nye suetɔ.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Eye le afisia la, amesiwo kuna la, xɔ nuwo ƒe ewolia: ke afime la, amesi ŋuti woɖi ɖase le be, ele agbe la, xɔnɛ.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Eye woate ŋu agblɔ be: To Abraham dzi woxɔ nuwo ƒe ewolia le Lewi hã, amesi xɔa nuwo ƒe ewolia la si:

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: elabena egale fofoa ƒe ali me ko, esime Melxizedek yi ɖakpee.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Azɔ la ne blibonyenye vana toa Lewitɔwo ƒe nunɔlanyenye me — elabena dukɔ la xɔ se la le eya te la — nukaŋuti wògahiã bena, nunɔla bubu natsi tre le Melxizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu, eye womabui le Aron ƒe ɖoɖo la nu o mahã?

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Elabena ne woɖuɖɔ nunɔlanyenye la, ele be, woaɖuɖɔ se la hã tsã.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ŋuti wogblɔ esia le la, enye to bubu me tɔ, amesiwo dome amea ɖeke mesubɔna le vɔsamlekpui gbɔ o.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Elabena edze ƒã bena, mia Aƒetɔ la ɖo tso Yuda-to la me, to, si Mose megblɔ nyaa ɖeke na le nunɔlanyenye ŋuti o.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Eye esia dze ƒã gawu, ne nunɔla bubu, si le abe Melxizedek ene la, va tsi tre,

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: amesi womeɖo le se, si nye ŋutilãtɔ la ƒe ɖoɖo nu o, ke boŋ le agbe mavɔ ƒe ŋusẽ la nu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Elabena woɖi ɖase le eŋu bena: „Wòe nye nunɔla yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me le Melxizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu.“

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Elabena woɖe se ŋgɔgbetɔ la ɖa le eƒe gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ kple viɖe manyemanye ŋuti,

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: — elabena se la mewɔa naneke blibo o, — eye wotsɔa mɔkpɔkpɔ, si nyo wu sã la vɛ, esi me miato ale ɖe Mawu ŋuti.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: elabena ame mawo zu nunɔlawo atamkaka manɔŋui; ke ame sia zui atamkaka kpe ɖe eŋu heto Mawu dzi, amesi gblɔ nɛ bena: „Yehowa ka atam, eye mele etrɔ ge o: Wòe nye nunɔla yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me le Melxizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu“ —

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: nenema ke hã Yesu zu nubabla, si nyo wu sã la ƒe asiƒuakɔla

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Eye ame mawo dome geɖeawo zu nunɔlawo, le esi ku gbe bena, woagatsi agbe o la ta;

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: ke eya la, esi wònɔ anyi yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me ŋuti la, nunɔlanyenye, si meɖɔlina o la, le esi.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Eyata ate ŋu axɔ amesiwo to edzi va Mawu gbɔ la, ɖe agbe blibo keŋkeŋ, le esi wònɔa agbe ɖaa, bena wòaxɔ wo ɖe akɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Elabena nunɔlagã sia tɔgbe hiã míawo hã: Amesi nye kɔkɔetɔ, ame maɖifɔ, ame maƒoɖi, amesi ɖe eɖokui ɖa tso nuvɔ̃wɔlawo dome, eye wokɔe ɖe dzi wu dziƒowo,

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: amesi mehiã gbesiagbe vɔsasa abe nunɔlagã mawo, amesiwo wɔ vɔsasa gbã ɖe woa ŋutɔwo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta, eye emegbe la ɖe dukɔ la ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta ene o; elabena ewɔ esia zi ɖeka hɔ̃ ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu, esime wòtso ye ŋutɔ ɖokui hena.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Elabena se la tsɔa amesiwo gbɔdzɔ la ɖoa nunɔlagãwo; ke atamkaka, si dze se la yome la, ƒe nya ɖo Vi, si wowɔ blibo la, nunɔlagã yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Ke nya, siwo miegblɔ la, ƒe emenya gãtɔ enye esi. Nunɔlagã sia tɔgbe le mia si, amesi bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe gãnyenye fiazikpui la ƒe nuɖusi me le dziƒowo,

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: amesi nye kɔkɔeƒe kple agbadɔ vavã, si Mawu ŋutɔ tu, eye menye amee tui o la, ƒe subɔla.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Elabena woɖo nunɔlagã sia nunɔlagã, bena wòatsɔ nunanawo kple numemewo ana; eyata ele vevie bena, nane nanɔ nunɔlagã sia hã si be, wòatsɔ ana.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Azɔ la ne enɔ anyigba dzi la, mele nunɔla nye ge kura o; elabena nunɔlawo li, amesiwo tsɔa nunanawo vanɛ le se la nu,

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: nenem me siawo subɔa nusiwo nye dziƒonuwo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu kple vɔvɔli, abe alesi Mawu ɖee fia Mose, esime wòle agbadɔ la wɔ ge la ene; elabena egblɔ be: „Kpɔ dzi, be nawɔ nuwo katã ɖe nɔnɔme, si wofiã wo le toa dzi la nu.“

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la subɔsubɔ, si nyo wu sã la, su esi, abe alesi wònye nubabla, si nyo wu, eye woɖoe anyi ɖe ŋugbedodo, siwo nyo wu la, dzi la ƒe avuléla ene.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖe vodada mele nubabla gbãtɔ ma ŋu o la, anye ne womedi nɔƒe na evelia o.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Elabena eka ŋku me na wo gblɔ be: „Kpɔ ɖa, Yehowa gblɔ bena: Ŋkekewo li gbɔna, eye mabia nu yeye kple Israel ƒe aƒe kpakple Yuda ƒe aƒe la,

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: menye ɖe nu, si mebia kple wo fofowo le gbesigbe melé woƒe alɔnu hekplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la nu o, elabena woawo menɔ nye nubabla me o, eye nye hã nyemele be na wo o, Yehowa ye gblɔe.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Elabena esia nye nu, si mabia kple Israel ƒe aƒe la le ŋkeke siawo megbe, Yehowa ye gblɔe: Matsɔ nye seawo ade woƒe ta me, eye maŋlɔ wo ɖe woƒe dziwo me, eye manye Mawu na wo, eye woawo nanye nye dukɔ.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Eye wo dome amea ɖeke magafia nu xɔlɔ̃via kple nɔvia agble be: „Dzesi Yehowa“ o; elabena wo katã woanyam tso woƒe ɖeviwo dzi vaseɖe tsitsiawo dzi.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Elabena mave woƒe madzɔmadzɔnyenyewo nu, eye nyemagado ŋu woƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple woƒe vodadawo o.“

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Le esime wògblɔ be: „Nu yeye“ la, ena gbãtɔ do xoxo; ke nusi ɖo xoxo, eye wòtsi ŋutɔ la, te ɖe gbegblẽ ŋu.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Azɔ la mawusubɔsubɔ ƒe nuɖoanyiwo kple anyigba dzi kɔkɔeƒe li na nubabla gbãtɔ hã.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Elabena wotu agbadɔ ŋgɔgbetɔ, si me akaɖiti kple kplɔ̃ kple ŋkumeɖobolo nɔna, si woyɔna be kɔkɔeƒe.

english_verse: Behind the curtain was the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ke le xɔmetsovɔ evelia megbe la agbadɔ, si woyɔna be kɔkɔeƒe ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la li,

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: esi me sikadzudzɔmlekpui kple nubablaɖaka, si ŋu wofa sika ɖo kpe ɖo la le, eye eya me sikaze, si me mana le kple Aron ƒe atikplɔ, si ƒo se, kple nubabla ƒe nuŋlɔkpeawo le.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Ke le aɖaka dzi la ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe Kerubiwo li, siwo xe nutsyɔnu la dzi; nusiawo ŋuti nya míate ŋu agblɔ le wo tɔxɛ wo tɔxɛ fifia o.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Ke esi wodzra nusiawo ɖo alea vɔ la, nunɔlawo nɔa agbadɔ ŋgɔgbetɔ me yim ɖaa ɖawɔa mawusubɔsubɔ.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Ke agbadɔ evelia la, nunɔlagã la koe dea eme, ƒe ɖeka zi ɖeka, eye meɖena ʋu, si woatsɔ ana ɖe ye ŋutɔ kple dukɔ la ƒe numanyamanya ta la, matsɔmatsɔe o;

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: eye Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la ɖe esia fia bena, womeʋu mɔ yi ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la me haɖe o, ŋkeke alesi agbadɔ ŋgɔgbetɔ la gali ko,

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: esi nye lododo na ɣeyiɣi, si gali fifi, esi me wotsoa nunana kple vɔsasa, siwo mate ŋu awɔ amesiwo le Mawu subɔm la blibo le dzitsinya nu o la, nana lena;

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: nusiawo katã hekpe ɖe nuɖuɖuwo kple nunonowo kpakple tsilele bubu ƒomeviwo ŋuti la wonye ŋutilã me nuɖoanyiwo ɖeɖeko, siwo woɖo ɖi vaseɖe ɖɔɖɔɖoɣi la dzi.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Ke Kristo va nye nu nyui, siwo le vava ge la ƒe nunɔlagã, eye wòto agbadɔ, si nye gãtɔ kple blibotɔ wu, si wometsɔ asi wɔe o, eye metso xexe sia me o la me,

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: eye metsɔ gbɔ̃tsu wo kple nyiviwo ƒe ʋu hã o, ke boŋ ye ŋutɔ ƒe ʋu wòtsɔ yi ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la me zi ɖeka hɔ̃ ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo kalẽ nu, eye wòtsɔ xɔxɔ mavɔ vɛ.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Elabena ne gbɔ̃tsuwo kple nyitsuwo ƒe ʋu kple nyinɔ ƒe afi, si wowu ɖe ame makɔmakɔwo ŋu la, kɔ wo ŋuti hena ŋutilã ƒe kɔkɔenyenye la,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: geɖe aleke wu Kristo, amesi to Gbɔgbɔ mavɔ la me tsɔ eɖokui na Mawu abe vɔsasa mokaka manɔŋutɔ ene la, ƒe ʋu maklɔ miaƒe dzitsinya tso dɔwɔwɔ kukuwo me, bena miasubɔ Mawu gbagbe la o mahã?

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Eye le esia ta wònye nubabla yeye ƒe avuléla, bena le esi wòku le xoxo tso vodada, siwo le nubabla gbãtɔ me ŋuti ta la, amesiwo woyɔ la, naxa domenyinyi mavɔ ƒe ŋugbedodo.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Elabena amewo ƒe ku ɖoa kpe megbenyagbɔgblɔɖi dzi; elabena ŋkeke alesi amesi gblɔe ɖi la, gale agbe la, ŋusẽa ɖeke menoa eme o.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Eyata esi wokɔ nubabla gbãtɔ ŋu la, womegbe ʋutsɔtsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Elabena esime Mose gblɔ sedede sia sedede na dukɔ blibo la le sea nu la, etso nyiviwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe ʋu hekpe ɖe tsi kple alẽfu dzi kple isop ŋu, eye wòwui ɖe agbalẽ la ŋutɔ kple dukɔ la katã ŋu

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: hegblɔ be: „Esiae nye nubabla ƒe ʋu, si ƒe se Mawu de na mi.“

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Eye nenema ke wòtsɔ ʋu la wu ɖe agbadɔ kple mawusubɔnuawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Eye mate ŋu agblɔ kloe bena, wotso ʋu klo nuwo katã ŋuti le se la nu, eye ne womekɔ ʋu ɖe anyi o la, nuvɔ̃kekea ɖeke manɔ anyi o.

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Eyata ele vevie bena, woatsɔ nusiawo akɔ nusiwo nye dziƒonuwo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu la ŋuti; ke dziƒonuawo ŋutɔ la wotsɔ vɔsasa, siwo nyo wu esiawo la, ko wo ŋuti.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Elabena Kristo meyi ɖe kɔkɔeƒe, si wotso asi wɔe wònye vavãtɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu la me o; ke dziƒo ŋutɔ wòyi, bene wòado ɖe Mawu ŋku me azɔ le mía ta;

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: eye menye bena, wòatsɔ eɖokui ano nanam agbadre, abe alesi nunɔlagã tsɔa lãʋu yina ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la me ƒe sia ƒe ene o;

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: ɖe wònye nenema wòle la, ekem ele nɛ be, wòakpe fu agbadre tso xexeme ƒe gɔmedzedzea me ke; gake azɔ la eɖe eɖokui fia zi ɖeka le xexeame ƒe nuwuwu, bena wòaɖe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa to eɖokuitsɔtsɔ savɔe me.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Eye alesi woɖoe na ame be, woaku zi ɖeka, eye esia megbe wòakpɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la,

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: nenema ke Kristo hã, esime wòtsɔ eɖokui na zi ɖeka, bena wòaɖe ame geɖewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa la, aɖe eɖokui afia zi evelia, manye ɖe nuvɔ̃wo ta o, ke boŋ ɖe amesiwo le elalam la ƒe xɔxɔ ta.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Elabena esi wònye nu nyui, siwo le vava ge la, ƒe vɔvɔli koe li na se la, eye menye nuawo ƒe nɔnɔme vavã o ŋuti la, eyata ƒe sia ƒe vɔsasa, siwo wotsɔna nana ɖaasi la, mate ŋu awɔ amesiwo tena va egbɔ la, blibo gbeɖegbeɖe o;

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: ɖe mele nenema o la, ne womadzudzɔ vɔsasa, le esi wokɔ amesiwo nɔa Mawu subɔm la ŋuti zi ɖeka, ale bena nuvɔ̃wo nyanyaa ɖeke maganɔ wo ŋu o la ta o mahã?

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: elabena nyitsuwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe ʋu mate ŋu aɖe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa akpɔ o.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Eyata esime wòva xexeame la, wògblɔ be: „Vɔsawo kple nunanawo mèdi o, ke boŋ ŋutilã nèdzra ɖo nam;

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: numeme blibowo kple nuvɔ̃vɔsawo medzea ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna, agbalẽ me woŋlɔ nya ɖo le ŋutinye be, oo Mawu, wò lɔlɔ̃nu mawɔ!“

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ be: „Vɔsawo kple nunanawo kple numeme blibowo kple nuvɔ̃vɔsawo“ — siwo wotsɔna vanɛ le sea nu la — „mèdi wo o, eye womenyo ŋuwò hã o,“

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: tete wògblɔ be: „Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna, be mawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu! Eɖe nu gbãtɔ ɖa, be yeaɖo evelia anyi;

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: lɔlɔ̃nu sia me wokɔ mía ŋu le zi ɖeka ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu to Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋutilãtsɔtsɔna me.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Eye nunɔla sia nunɔla nɔa tsitre gbesiagbe henɔa Mawu subɔm, eye wònɔa vɔsa mawo ke, siwo mate ŋu aɖe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa akpɔ o la, tsɔm nɔa nanam agbadre;

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: ke eya la, esime wotsɔ vɔsa ɖeka na ɖe nuvɔ̃wo ta megbe la, ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Mawu ƒe nuɖusi me tegbetegbe,

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: eye tso ekema dzi la ele lalam, halase esime woatsɔ eƒe futɔwo awɔ eƒe afɔɖodzinui.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Elabena vɔsa ɖeka wòtsɔ wɔ amesiwo ŋuti wokɔ la blibo halase tegbe.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ke Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe hã ɖi ɖase le eŋuti na mí;

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: elabena esime wògblɔ be: „Esiae nye nu, si mabia kpli wo le ŋkeke siawo megbe la, Yehowa ye gblɔe: Matsɔ nye seawo ade woƒe dziwo me, eye woƒe tame hã maŋlɔ wo ɖo,

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: eye nyemagaɖo ŋu woƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple woƒe vodadawo o.“

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Ke afisi nuvɔ̃wo ƒe keke le la, vɔsa ɖe nuvɔ̃wo ta meganɔnɛ o.

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Azɔ, nɔviwo, esi dzideƒo le mía si, be míayi ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la me to Yesu ƒe ʋu la me,

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: eyae nye mɔ, si ŋuti wokɔ na mí, be wòanye mɔ yeye gbagbe, si to xɔmetsovɔ me, eyae nye eƒe ŋutilã;

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: eye esi nunɔlagã, si le Mawu ƒe aƒe nu la, le mia si ŋuti la,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: mina miatsɔ dzi nyateƒetɔ ate va le xɔse ƒe kakaɖedzi blibo me, abe amesiwo wòklɔ dzitsinya vɔ̃ ɖa tso woƒe dziwo me, eye wotsɔ tsi zɔzrɔ̃e le na woƒe ŋutilã ene;

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: mina míalé mɔkpɔkpɔ me ʋuʋu ɖe asi sesĩe, bene magaʋã o; elabena amesi na ŋugbedodo la, enye nuteƒewɔla;

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: eye míalé ŋku ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu, bena míade dzi ƒo na mía nɔewo le lɔlɔ̃ kple dɔ nyui wɔwɔ me,

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: eye míagagblẽ mía ŋutɔwo miaƒe ƒuƒoƒewo ɖi, abe alesi amea ɖewo wɔna ene o, ke boŋ míaxlɔ̃ nu mía nɔewo, eye míawɔ esia geɖe wu, zi alesi miekpɔ bena, ŋkeke la le ɖoɖom la.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Elabena ne miexɔ nyateƒe ƒe sidzedze la, hafi bua wɔ nuvɔ̃ la, vɔsasa ɖe nuvɔ̃wo ta megali o,

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: ke boŋ vɔvɔ̃mɔkpɔkpɔ na ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple dzo ƒe ŋuʋaʋã, si afiã adikãtɔwo ɖa keŋ la, koe li.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe do vlo Mose ƒe sea la, ekuna nublanui makpɔmakpɔe le ɖaseɖila eve alo etɔ̃ ƒe nya nu;

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: fetu vɔ̃ wu ka miele susum be, adze amesi tu afɔ Mawuvi la dzi, eye wobu nubabla ƒe nu, si wotsɔ kɔ eŋuti la, nu makɔmakɔa, eye wòdo vlo amenuvevegbɔgbɔ la mahã?

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Elabena míenyae amesi gblɔ be: „Tɔnyee nye hlɔ̃biabia, nye la maɖo eteƒe, Yehowa ye gblɔe;“ eye wògagblɔ be: „Yehowa adrɔ̃ nɔnu eƒe dukɔ la.“

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Enye ŋɔdzinu, ne amea ɖe ge ɖe Mawu gbagbe la ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Ke miɖo ŋu tsã ŋkeke, siwo me miedo dzi le heʋli geɖe le fukpekpewo me, le esime woklẽ ɖe mia me megbe la;

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: eye wotsɔ ŋukpedodowo kple xaxawo wɔmi du ƒe nukpɔkpɔ, eye míezu amesiwo wowɔ nenema ke la ƒe hadelawo.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Elabena gatɔwo hã ƒe nu wɔ nublanui na mi, eye miedo dzi kple dzidzɔ le mia ŋutinuwo haha me, esi mienya bena, ŋutinu, siwo nyo wu, eye wonɔa anyi ɖaa la, li na mi le dziƒo.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Eyata migatsɔ miaƒe dzideƒo, si teƒeɖoɖofetu gã li na la, ƒu gbe o.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Elabena dzidodo hiã mi, bena ne miewɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, miaxɔ ŋugbedodo la.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: „Elabena esusɔ ʋee ko, tete amesi gbɔna la, nava, eye mahe ɖe megbe o;

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: ke ame dzɔdzɔe la anɔ agbe atso xɔse me, eye ne egbugbɔ ɖe megbe la, luʋɔnye makpɔ ŋudzedze nyui le eŋuti o.“

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Ke miawo míenye amesiwo gbugbɔna ɖe megbe ɖe gbegblẽ me la dometɔwo o, ke boŋ amesiwo xɔnɛ sena hena luʋɔ xɔxɔ la dometɔwo míenye.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Ke xɔse enye dziɖoɖo ɖe nusiwo wokpɔ mɔ na ŋu kple kaka ɖe nusiwo womekpɔna o la dzi.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Elabena eya me blematɔwo kpɔ ɖaseɖiɖi nyui le.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me míedze sii be, wotsɔ Mawu ƒe nya dzra xexeame ɖo, bena nusiwo wokpɔna la, metso nusiwo dzena le ŋku me la me o.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Abel tsɔ numeme, si nyo wu Kain tɔ la, na Mawu, nusi me woto ɖi ɖase nɛ be, ame dzɔdzɔe wònye; elabena Mawu ɖi ɖase le eƒe nunanawo ŋuti, eye le eya me, esi wòku hã la, egale nu ƒom.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me wotsɔ Henox yii, bene magakpɔ ku o, eye womegakpɔe o; elabena Mawu tsɔe yii, elabena hafi woatsɔe ayii la, wodi ɖase nɛ bena, edze Mawu ŋu nyuie.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Ke ne xɔse mele mía si o la, míate ŋu adze Mawu ŋu o; elabena ele be, amesi ke fena va Mawu gbɔ ta, naxɔ ase be, Mawu li, eye wonye teƒeɖola na amesiwo dinɛ vevie.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Noa, esime wòxa ɖeɖefia tso Mawu gbɔ le nusiwo womekpɔ haɖe o ŋuti la, etsɔ mawuvɔvɔ̃ wɔ aɖakaʋu hena eƒemetɔwo ɖeɖe, nusi me wòto bu fɔ xexemetɔwo, eye wòzu dzɔdzɔenyenye, si tso xɔse me la, ƒe domenyila.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Abraham ɖo to, esime wòyɔe be, wòado go ayi ɖe afisi wòava xɔ wòanye eƒe domenyinyi la, eye wòdo go; gake menya afisi yim wòle o.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me wònye amedzro le ŋugbedodonyigba dzi abe dzronyigba ene, eye eya kple Isak kpakple Yakob, amesiwo nye ŋugbedodo kema ke ƒe hadomenyilawo la, wonɔ agbadɔwo me;

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: elabena ekpɔ mɔ na du, si gɔmeɖoɖoanyi li na, esi ƒe aɖaŋuwɔla kple tula enye Mawu.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Sara ke hã kpɔ ŋusẽ bena, wòfɔ fu, eye wòdzi vi le eƒe nyagãkuku me; elabena ebu amesi na ŋugbedodoe la nuteƒewɔlae.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Eyata tso ame ɖeka, si ƒe vidzidɔ ku la me, dzidzime va dzɔ sɔ gbɔ abe dziƒoɣletiviwo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ene, eye abe ƒutake, si womate ŋu axlẽ o la ene.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me amesiawo katã woku, eye woƒe asi mesu ŋugbedodo la dzi o, ke wokpɔe, eye wodo ɖoaƒe nɛ le adzɔge, eye woʋu me be, yewonye amedzrowo kple nunɔlawo le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Ke amesiwo gblɔ esia la, ɖee fia be, yewole ɖenyigbaa ɖe dim vevie.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Eye vavã, nenye anyigba, si dzi wodo tso wowɔnɛ la, anye ne wokpɔ vovo gbugbɔ yi.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la denyigba, si nyo wu la, le wo dzrom, esia nye dziƒo tɔ. Eyata ŋu mekpe Mawu le wo ŋuti be, wòyɔe be woƒe Mawu o; elabena edzra du ɖo na wo.

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: elabena esusu bena, ŋusẽ le Mawu si be, wòafɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome ke hã; eyaŋuti wògaxɔe le tsɔtsɔna sia ta.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Isak yra Yakob kple Esau le nusiwo le vava ge la ŋuti.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Yakob, esime wòle kukum la, eyra Yosef ƒe ŋutsuviawo kple eve, eye wòziɔ ɖe eƒe atitɔɖeŋu dzi hedo gbe ɖa.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me esime Yosef ƒe kuɣi ɖo la, eɖo ŋku Israel-viwo ƒe gododo dzi, eye wòde se le eƒe ƒuwo ŋuti.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me, esime wodzi Mose la, eƒe dzilawo ɣlae ɣleti etɔ̃; elabena wokpɔ be, enye vi dzeɖekɛ, eye womevɔ̃ fia ƒe sedede o.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me, esi Mose tsi la, egbe be, womegayɔ ye be Farao ƒe vinyɔnuvi la vi o;

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: elabena elɔ̃ be, yeakpe fu akpe ɖe Mawu ƒe dukɔ la ŋuti wu esi yeakpɔ nuvɔ̃ ƒe vivisese le ɣeyiɣi via ɖe ko me,

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: eye wobu ŋukpe, si wodo Kristo la, kesinɔnu wu Egiptetɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo; elabena ekpɔ teƒeɖoɖofetu la ɖa.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me wògblẽ Egipte ɖi, eye meva fia ƒe dɔmedzoe la o; elabena edo dzi, abe ɖe wòle amesi womekpɔna o la kpɔm ene.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me wòɖo ŋutitoto kple ʋuhehlẽ anyi, bena ŋgɔgbeviawo wula la nagaka asi wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me woto Ƒudzie la me abe anyigba ƒuƒui dzi ene, nusi wɔwɔ Egiptetɔwo hã te kpɔ, eye woku ɖe tsi la me.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Yerixo ŋu gliwo mu dze anyi, esime woƒo xlãe ŋkeke adre megbe.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Le xɔse me Raxab, gbolo la, metsrɔ̃ kpe ɖe tosẽlawo ŋuti o, le esi wòxɔ ŋkutsalawo le ŋutifafa me la ta.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
