translation_verse: Eye nuka míagagblɔ mahã? Elabena ɣeyiɣi la made nam be, magblɔ nya le Gideon, Barak, Simson, Yefla, Dawid, Samuel kple nyagblɔɖilawo ŋuti o,

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: amesiwo ɖu fiaɖuƒewo dzi to xɔse me, wowɔ dzɔdzɔenyenyedɔwo, woxɔ ŋugbedodowo, womiã nu na dzatawo,

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: wotsi dzo ƒe ŋusẽ nu, wòsi le yi nu, wogazu sesĩe tso gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔ me, wosẽ ŋu le aʋawɔwɔ me, eye wòsi futɔwo ƒe aʋakɔwo.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Nyɔnuwo xɔ woƒe ame kukuwo agbagbe le tsitretsitsi me. Ke wowɔ tu ame bubuwo, eye wogbe xɔxɔ, bene woakpɔ tsitretsitsi, si nyo wu;

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: ke ame bubuwo la woto fewuɖuɖu kple ƒoƒo ƒe dodokpɔ me, ke gawu la bablawo kple gaxɔ me nɔnɔ me;

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: woƒu kpe wo, wodze wo kple laxalaxa, wote wo kpɔ, wowu wo kple yi, wonɔa tsatsam le alẽgbalẽwo kple gbɔ̃gbalẽwo me, le koɖoɖo, xaxa kple fukpekpe me,

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: amesiwo xexeame medzena kura o la, wotra mɔ henɔ tsatsam le gbedziwo kple towo kple agadowo kple anyigba ʋewo me.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Eye amesiawo katã la, wònye woxɔ ɖaseɖiɖi nyui to xɔse me hafi, gake woƒe asi mesu ŋugbedodo la dzi o;

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: elabena Mawu kpɔ nua ɖe, si nyo wu la, da ɖi na mí, bena womagawɔ wo blibo miawo mia eme manɔmanɔ o.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Eyata miawo hã, esi ɖaseɖilawo ƒe alilikpo gã ŋutɔ ƒo xlã mí la, mina miaɖe nu kpekpe sia nu kpekpe kple nuvɔ̃, si ɖea to ɖe mi la ɖa, eye mina miatsɔ dzidodo anɔ dudimekeke, si woɖo na mí la dzi,

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: eye míakpɔ Yesu, si nye xɔse ƒe gɔmeɖola kple nuwula la ɖa: Amesi do dzi kpe atitsoga ƒe fu, eye mebu ŋukpe o le dzidzɔ, si woɖo ɖi nɛ la ta, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi le Mawu ƒe fiazikpui ƒe nuɖusi me.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Mibu amesi ɖo dzi kpe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ƒe ɖeklemiɖeɖe na ye ŋutɔ la ŋu, bena ɖeɖi nagate mia ŋu, eye miagbɔdzɔ le mia luʋɔwo me o.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Le aʋawɔwɔ kple nuvɔ̃ me la miekpɔ tsitre sesĩe yiɖase ɖe ʋu me haɖe o;

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: eye mieŋlɔ nuxɔxlɔ̃, si ƒoa nu na mi abe viwo ene la be, eyae nye be: „Vinye, megado vlo Aƒetɔ ƒe tohehe o, eye dzi nagaɖe le ƒowò, ne eka ŋku me na wò o;

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: elabena amesi ke Aƒetɔ la lɔ̃na la, eya wòhea to na, eye wòƒoa vi sia vi, si woxɔna la, kple atam.“

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Ne miedo dzi le tohehe me la, Mawu awɔ ɖe mia ŋu abe viwo ene; elabena vi kae li, si fofoa mehea to nɛ o mahã?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Ke ne mimekpɔ tohehe, si gomekpɔlawo wo katã wonye o la, ekema ahasiviwo míenye, eye menye vi vavãwo míenye o.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Gakpe ɖe esia ŋuti la mia ŋutilã me fofo, siwo nɔ mía si la, he mí, eye miesi wo ɖa; ɖe míaɖo to gbɔgbɔwo ƒe Fofo la boŋ geɖe awu, eye mianɔ agbe o mahã?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Woamawo he to na mí ŋkeke ʋeea ɖewo ko, le alesi wobu be, enyo la nu, ke eya la hea to na mí le miaƒe nyonyo ta, bene míakpɔ gome le eƒe kɔkɔenyenye me.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Ke le fifi ɣeyiɣi me la miebua tohehe kalẽ dzidzɔe o, ke veve boŋ; gake emegbe la etsɔa dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe ŋutifafakutsetse na amesiwo wòmã la. Misro Mawu ɖa le dziƒo Yerusalem ta.

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Eyata migado ŋusẽ asi, siwo wɔ gblɔdɔɔ, kple klo, siwo me tu la,

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: eye miɖe mɔ dzɔdzɔewo na miaƒe afɔwo, bena xɔdrɔ̃ la nagatre mɔ o, ke boŋ woada gbe le eŋu.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Midi ŋutifafa na amewo katã kple kɔkɔenyenye hã yome; elabena amea ɖeke mate ŋu akpɔ Aƒetɔ la, ne nusia mele eŋu o.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie, bena amea ɖeke nagade megbe tso Mawu ƒe amenuveve la gbɔ o, bena veve ƒe ke nagamie aɖe fu na mi, eye wòaƒo ɖi ame geɖe o,

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: bena amea ɖeke maganye ahasiwɔla alo ahɔhlɔ̃bɔla abe Esau, amesi tsɔ ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋgɔgbedzidzi ƒle le nuɖuɖu zi ɖeka ta la ene o.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Elabena mienyae bena, emegbe hã, esime wòdi be, yeanyi yayra ƒe dome la, wotee; elabena mekpɔ tametɔtrɔ ƒe mɔnu o, wònye etsɔ aɖatsiwo dii vevie hafi.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Elabena menye to, si ŋu woate ŋu aka asii kple dzo bibi kple alilikpo dodo kple viviti kple ahom

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: kple kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi kple nyawo ƒe ɖiɖi, si eselawo gbe bena, womagagblɔ na yewo o la, ŋu miete va o. —

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Elabena womete ŋu nɔ te ɖe sedede la nu o: Ne lã hã ka ŋu toa la, woaƒu kpee;

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: eye ale ɖeɖetia la nye ŋɔdzinu gã ŋutɔ bena, Mose gblɔ be: Mele vɔvɔ̃m, eye mele dzodzom nyanyanya. —

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ke Zion-to la kple Mawu gbagbe ƒe du, si nye dziƒo Yerusalem kple mawudɔla akpeakpewo ƒe takpekpe

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: kple ŋgɔgbevi, siwo ŋkɔwo woŋlɔ ɖe dziƒowo la ƒe hame kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, si nye wo katã ƒe Mawu kple ame dzɔdzɔe, siwo wowɔ blibo la, ƒe gbɔgbɔwo,

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: kple Yesu, si nye nubabla yeye la ƒe avuléla kple ʋuhehlẽ, si ƒoa nu nyuie wu Abel to la, gbɔ míete va.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie, bena miagagbe amesi le nu ƒom na mi la o; elabena ne ame mawo, esi wogbe amesi gblɔ nya fia wo le anyigba dzi la, eye womete ŋu si le enu o la, geɖe wu miawo míate ŋu asi o, ne mietrɔ tso amesi ɖe eɖokui fia tso dziƒo la gbɔ;

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: amesi ƒe gbe ʋuʋu anyigba la le ɣemaɣi me; ke azɔ la eɖo ŋugbe gblɔ be: „Esusɔ zi ɖeka, eye menye anyigba ɖeɖeko maʋuʋu o, ke boŋ dziƒo hãe.“

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Ke „zi ɖeka“ sia, si wògblɔ la, fia nusiwo woʋuʋu la ɖeɖeɖa, abe nusiwo wowɔ, bena nusiwo womeʋuʋu o la, nanɔ anyi ene.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Eyata esi míexɔ fiaɖuƒe, si meʋuʋuna o la, mina míada akpedada, si me miato asubɔ Mawu wòadze eŋu, hekpe ɖe mawusosroɖa kple evovo ŋuti.

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: Elabena mía Mawu hã nye dzo, si fiãa nu.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Migaŋlɔ amedzroxɔxɔ be o; elabena le esia wɔwɔ me la amea ɖewo xa dziƒodɔlawo dze wo gbã, gake womenyae o.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku amesiwo wobla la dzi, abe ɖe wobla mi hekpe ɖe wo ŋu ene, kple amesiwo kpe fu la dzi, abe amesiwo hã le ŋutilã me ene.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Bubu nanɔ srɔ̃ɖeɖe me le amewo katã dome, eye womagaƒo ɖi srɔ̃ɖeba la o; elabena ahasiwɔlawo kple matrewɔlawo la, Mawu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Mina miaƒe susu navo tso galɔlɔ̃ me, eye nusiwo le mia si la, nadze mia ŋu; elabena eya ŋutɔ gblɔ be: „Nyemele asi ɖe ge le mia ŋu o, eye nyemele mia gblẽ ge ɖi akpa o.“

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Ale bena míatsɔ dzideƒo agble be; „Yehowa ye nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ, nyemavɔ̃ o; nuka amegbetɔ awɔm ma?“ Miɖo to nufiala wɔnuteƒewo.

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku mia nunɔlawo, amesiwo gblɔ mawunya na mi la dzi, eye mikpɔ woƒe agbenɔnɔ ƒe nuwuwu la ɖa, ne miasrɔ̃ woƒe xɔse.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo nye eyama ke etsɔ kple egbe, yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Migana nufiafia bubu ƒomeviwo kple dzrotɔwo nahe mi ayii o; elabena enyo be, woatso amenuveve ali ke dzi la, eye menye nuɖuɖu, siwo menye viɖea ɖeke na amesiwo wɔ eŋuti ɖa o la, woatsa o.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Vɔsamlekpui le mía si, esi ŋuti amesiwo subɔna le agbadɔ me la, womekpɔ mɔ be, woaɖu nu le o.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Elabena lã, siwo ƒe ʋu nunɔlagã tso yi ɖe kɔkɔeƒe me le nuvɔ̃wo ŋuti la, wotɔ dzo woƒe lã blibo la le asaɖa godo.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Eyata Yesu hã kpe fu le agbo la godo, bene wòatsɔ ye ŋutɔ ƒe ʋu akɔ eƒe dukɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, minɛ míado go ayi ɖe egbɔ le asaɖa godo atso eƒe ŋukpe aɖo mía ɖokui dzi.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖu, si nɔa anyi la, mele mia si le afisia o, ke boŋ miele ɖu, si gbɔna la dim.

english_verse: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Eyata mina miato eyama dzi atsɔ kafukafuvɔsa anɔ Mawu nam; esia nye nuyi, siwo ʋua eŋkɔ me la, ƒe kutsetse.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ke migaŋlɔ dɔmenyowɔwɔ kple hamenunana be o; elabena nenem vɔsa siawo dzea Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Miɖo to mia nunɔlawo, eye midze wo yome; elabena wole mia luʋɔwo ŋu dzɔm, abe amesiwo lana akɔnta le wo ŋuti ene, bene woawo esia kple dzidzɔ, eye menye kple tseɖuɖu o; elabena esia menye viɖea ɖeke na mi o. Nuwunya kple ɖuɖɔwo.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Ke mele nu xlɔ̃m mi geɖe wu bena, miawo esia, bene woagatsom ana mi kaba.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutifafa Mawu, si kplɔ mía Aƒetɔ Yesu, amesi nye alẽwo ƒe kplɔla gã la, ɖo go tso ame kukuwo dome le nubabla mavɔ ƒe ʋu la me la,

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: nadzra mi ɖo blibo le dɔ nyui sia dɔ nyui wɔwɔ me, bena miawɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu; eye wòawɔ nusi dze eŋu la, le mía me to Yesu Kristo dzi, amesi tɔ lanye ŋutikɔkɔe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Ke mele nu xlɔ̃m mi, nɔviwo, bena miaxɔ nuxlɔ̃menya la; elabena nya via ɖewo koe meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Minyae bena, woɖe asi le mía nɔvi Timoteo ŋu; ne eva kaba la, mia kplii míakpɔ mi.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Miɖuɖɔ mia nunɔlawo katã kple ame kɔkɔewo katã nam ƒã. Amesiwo tso Italia la, ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Amenuveve nanɔ anyi kpli mi katã! Amen.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Yakobo, Mawu kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔla, do gbe na ƒome wuieve, siwo ka hlẽ la.

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne miege ɖe tetekpɔ bubu ƒomeviwo me la, mibui dzidzɔ sɔŋ,

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: esi mienyae bena, miaƒe xɔse ƒe dodokpɔ wɔa dzidodo.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Ke dzidodo la nakpɔ eƒe dɔwɔwɔ blibo, bena mianye ame blibowo keŋkeŋ, eye naneke nagahiã mi o.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Ke ne mia dometɔa ɖe le nunya hiãm la, neɖe kuku na Mawu, si na amewo katã faa, eye medoa ŋukpe ame o la, eye wòatsɔe anɛ.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Ke meɖe kuku le xɔse me, eye megake ɖia ɖeke o; elabena amesi le ɖi kem la, eɖi ƒutsotsoe, si ya ƒona yina gbɔna la.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Ke nɔvi, si nye ɖokuibɔbɔɖeanyila la, naƒo adegbe le eƒe kɔkɔɖedzi me;

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: kesinɔtɔ la naƒo adegbe le eƒe bɔbɔdeanyi me; elabena enu ava yi abe gbe ƒe seƒoƒo ene.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Elabena ɣe dzena kple ŋdɔbibi, eye wònana gbe la ƒuna, eye eƒe seƒoƒo laduduna, eye eƒe nɔnɔme nyui la gblẽna: Nenema ke kesinɔtɔ hã le yɔyrɔ ge le eƒe zɔzɔ me.

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Woayra ŋutsu, si doa dzi le tetekpɔ me la; elabena ne eva li ke la, akpɔ agbefiakuku, si ŋugbe Aƒetɔ la do na amesiwo lɔ̃nɛ la. Nuvɔ̃ ƒe ke.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Amesi wote kpɔ la, megagblɔ bena, Mawue te ye kpɔ o; elabena womate ŋu ate Mawu akpɔ kple nuvɔ̃ o, ke eya ŋutɔ la metea amea ɖeke kpɔna o.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Ke wotea amesiame kpɔna, ne eya ŋutɔ ƒe nudzodzro henɛ, eye wòblenɛ;

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: emegbe la ne nudzodzro la fɔ fu la, edzia nuvɔ̃; ke ne nuvɔ̃ la tsi vɔ la, edzia ku.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migana woable mi o:

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Nunana nyuiwo katã kple nunana blibowo katã la dziƒo wotso, tso kekeliwo ƒe Fofo la gbɔ, amesi gbɔ liɖɔɖɔ alo tɔtrɔ ƒe vɔvɔlidodoa ɖeke meli o.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Le eya ŋutɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ta wòtsɔ nyateƒenya la dzi mi, bena míanye eƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe ŋgɔgbetɔ. Mawunyasese kple edziwɔwɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, minya esia: Amesiame naɖe abla le nusese me, nanɔ blewu le nuƒoƒo me, nanɔ blewu hã le dziku me;

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: elabena ame ƒe dziku mewɔa Mawu ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe o.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Eyata miɖe ɖiƒoƒo katã kple vɔɖinyenye geɖe fũ la ɖi, eye mitsɔ dɔmefafa xɔ nya, si wodo ɖe mia me, si ate ŋu aɖe mia luʋɔwo la.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Ke mizu nyadziwɔlawo, eye menye nyasela, siwo blea wo ɖokui ɖeɖeko o!

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Elabena ne amea ɖe nye nyasela, eye menye edziwɔla o la, eyama ɖi ŋutsua ɖe, si kpɔ eƒe dzɔdzɔmeme le ahũhɔ̃e me.

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: Elabena ekpɔ eɖokui dze sii, eye wòdzo heyi, eye enumake la eŋlɔ alesi wòle la be.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Ke amesi kpɔ se blibo, si nye ablɔɖese la me, eye wònɔ edzi la, eya menye nyasela, si ŋlɔa nu be o, ke boŋ dɔ ƒe wɔla, eye woayra eyama le eƒe nuwɔwɔ me.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Ne amea de bua eɖokui bena, mawusubɔla yenye, eye medea ga eƒe ade o, ke wòblea eƒe dzi la, nenem me sia ƒe subɔsubɔ enye dzodzro.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Mawusubɔsubɔ, si ŋuti kɔ, eye ɖiƒoƒoa ɖeke mele eŋu le Mawu Fofo la ŋku me o la, enye si bene, woakpɔ tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo ta le woƒe xaxa me, eye woadzra ame ɖokui ɖo ɖi maƒomaƒoe tso xexeame.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, migatsɔ ame ŋkumekpɔkpɔ lé Yesu Kristo, mía Aƒetɔ, tsi nye ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe Aƒetɔ la, ƒe dzixɔse me ɖe asi o.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Elabena ne ŋutsua ɖe de sikasigɛ asi, eye wòɖo awu nyui heva yi ɖe miaƒe ƒuƒoƒe, eye ame dahea ɖe hã do awu ƒoɖi va me,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: eye mielé ŋku ɖe amesi do awu nyui la ŋu, eye miegblɔ bena: Wò la bɔbɔ nɔ teƒe nyui sia, eye miegblɔ na ame dahe la bena: Wò la tsi tre ɖe afima alo bɔbɔ nɔ afii le nye afɔɖodzinu te la,

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: ɖe miede vovo amewo dome le mia ɖokui me, eye miezu tamesusu vɔ̃wo ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo o mahã?

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, miɖo to: Ɖe menye Mawue ɖia xexeame ame dahewo, be woanye kesinɔtɔwo le xɔse me kple fiaɖuƒe, si ŋugbe wòdo na amesiwo lɔ̃nɛ la, ƒe domenyilawo o mahã?

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Ke miawo la miedo vlo ame dahe la. Ɖe menye kesinɔtɔwo sẽa ŋuta le mia ŋuti, eye menye woawoe hea mi yia ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo o mahã?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Ɖe menye woawo kee gblɔa busunya ɖe ŋkɔ nyui, si wotsɔ yɔ mi la ŋuti o mahã?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Ne miewu fiasedede la nu le ŋɔŋlɔ la nu be: „Nalɔ̃ hawòvi, abe alesi nèlɔa ɖokuiwò ene la,“ ekema miewɔe nyuie.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ke ne miele ame ŋku me kpɔm la, miewɔ nuvɔ̃, eye se la ƒoe ɖe mia nu miedze sii be, sedzidalawo míenye.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi ke alé se blibo la me ɖe asi, ke woada ɖeka dzi la, eda vo ɖe wo katã ŋuti.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi gblɔ bena: „Megawɔ ahasi o la,“ egblɔ hã bena: „Megawu ame o!“ Azɔ ne mèwɔ ahasi o, ke nèwu ame la, ètrɔ zu sedzidala.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Miƒo nu ale, eye miwɔ nu ale, abe amesiwo woatsɔ ablɔɖese la adrɔ̃ ʋɔnui ene.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Elabena nublanuikpɔkpɔ manɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me na amesi mèfia nublanuikpɔkpɔa ɖeke o; ke nublanuikpɔkpɔ ƒoa adegbe ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋuti. Xɔse vavã ɖea eɖokui fiana toa dɔwɔwɔ me.

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne amea ɖe gblɔ be, xɔse le ye si, ke dɔwɔwɔwo mele esi o la, viɖe ka wònye mahã? Ɖe xɔse ma ate ŋu axɔe ɖe agbe mahã?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Ne nɔviŋutsu alo nɔvinyɔnu le amama, eye gbesiagbe nuɖuɖu le wo hiãm,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: eye mia dome amea ɖe gblɔ na wo bena: Miheyi le ŋutifafa me, miƒu dzo, eye miɖu nu ɖi ƒo, gake miena nusiwo hiã ŋutilã o la, viɖe ka wònye mahã?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Nenema ke xɔse hã, ne dɔwɔwɔwo mele eŋu o la, enye nu kuku le eɖokui me.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Ke amea ɖe lagblɔ bena: Wò la xɔse le asiwò, eye nye la dɔwɔwɔwo le asinye. Fia wò xɔse dɔwɔwɔ manɔŋutɔ lam, eye nye hã mafia nye xɔse wò to nye dɔwɔwɔwo me.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Wò la èxɔnɛ sena bena, Mawu ɖekae li; èwɔe nyuie; gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo hã xɔnɛ sena, eye wodzona nyanyanya.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Ke, wò ame gbɔlo, ɖe nèle didim be, yeanyae bena, xɔse dɔwɔwɔ manɔŋutɔ la enye nu kuku mahã?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye dɔwɔwɔwo wotsɔ tso afia na mía fofo Abraham, le esime wòtsɔ via Isak ɖo vɔsamlekpui dzi o mahã?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ bena, xɔse wɔ dɔ kpe ɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu, eye wotsɔ dɔwɔwɔwo wɔ xɔse la blibo.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Eye ale wowu ŋɔŋlɔ, si gblɔ bena: „Abraham xɔ Mawu dzi se, eye wobui nɛ dzɔdzɔenyenye la“ nu enye esi, eye wòyɔe be Mawu xɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Miekpɔ bena, wotsɔ dɔwɔwɔwo tso afia na ame, eye menye xɔse ɖeɖekoe o.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Nenema ke Raxab, gbolo la hã, ɖe menye dɔwɔwɔwo wotsɔ tso afia nɛ, le esi wòxɔ ame dɔdɔwo, eye wòna woto mɔ bubu dzo la ŋuti o mahã?

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Elabena abe alesi ŋutilã gbɔgbɔ manɔmee nye nu kuku la, nenema ke xɔse dɔwɔwɔ manɔŋui hã nye nu kuku.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, migazu nufialawo taŋtaŋ o, esi mienyae bena, ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ sesẽ wu kpɔ ge míala la ŋuti.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Elabena mí katã míeda vo le nu geɖewo me. Ne amea ɖe meda vo le nuƒoƒo me o la, eyae nye ame blibo, eye wòkpɔ ŋusẽ bena, wòaɖu ŋutilã blibo la katã hã dzi.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne míedea numega sɔwo ƒe nu me, bene woaɖo to mi la, ekema míetrɔa lã blibo la katã hã.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ʋuwo hã ɖa! Wònye wololo, eye ya sesẽ hea wo hafi; gake wotrɔ wo kple kuɖɔ sue ŋutɔ heyia afisiafi, si kuɖɔɖola lɔ̃na.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Nenema ke aɖe hã nye ŋutinu suea ɖe ko, eye wokana ɖe nu gãwo ŋu. Kpɔ alesi dzo via ɖe tɔa dzo ave gã la ɖa!

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Eye aɖe la, dzo wònye; madzɔmadzɔnyenye ƒe xexemee nye aɖe le mía ŋutinuwo dome, eyae ƒoa ɖi ŋutilã blibo la katã, eye wòtɔa dzo agbenɔnɔ ƒe tododo blibo la katã, eye dzomavɔʋe tɔ dzo aɖe la ŋutɔ hã.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Elabena womla lã wɔadãwo kple xeviwo kple nutatawo kpakple ƒumelãwo ƒe dzɔdzɔme, eye amegbetɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔme mia wo,

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: ke aɖe la amea ɖeke mate ŋu amlãe o, nuvɔ̃ madzudzɔmadzudzɔ, si aɖi wuame yɔ fũ la wònye.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Nu kema ke me yayra kple fiƒode doa go lena! Nɔvinyewo, medze bena, nusiawo nanɔ nenema o.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Ɖe vudo dzia tsi vivi kple tsi veve hetsoa do ɖeka ma ke me mahã?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ɖe gboti ate ŋu atse amititsetsewo, alo weinka ate ŋu atse gbotitsetsewo mahã? Nenema ke dzevudo mate ŋu adzi tsi nyui hã o. Nunya, si tso dziƒo.

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Amekae nye nunyala kple nugɔmesela le mia dome mahã? Eya netsɔ agbenɔnɔ nyui fia eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo le nunya ƒe dɔmefafa me.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Ke ne ŋuʋaʋã vevi kple dzrehehe le mia dzi me la, migaƒo adegbe, eye migaka aʋatso ɖe nyateƒe la ŋuti o.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Nunya sia la menye dziƒo wòtso va o; ke anyigbadzitɔe, dzɔdzɔmetɔe, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ tɔe.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Elabena afisi ŋuʋaʋã kple dzrehehe le la, afima nu manyomanyo kple nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ sɔŋ nɔna.

english_verse: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
translation_verse: Ke nunya, si tso dziƒo la, gbã la eŋuti kɔna, emegbe la eƒe dɔme fana, efaa tu, elɔna wogbea nya ne, nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple kutsetse nyuiwo yɔe fũ, medea vovo amewo dome o, alakpa mele eme o

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Ke woƒãa dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse le ŋutifafa me na amesiwo wɔa ŋutifafa.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Afika aʋawɔwɔ kple dzrewɔwɔ, siwo le mia dome la tsoa? Ɖe menye afima wotso, tso miaƒe nudzodzro, siwo wɔa aʋa le miaƒe ŋutinuwo me la me o mahã?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Miedzroa nu, eye miekpɔnɛ o; miewua ame, eye mieʋãa ŋu, eye miaƒe asi metea ŋu sua nu dzi o; miewɔa dzre, eye miewɔa aʋa; miate ŋu akpɔ naneke o; elabena miebiana o.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Miebiana, eye miexɔnɛ o; elabena miebiana le mɔ vɔ̃ dzi, bene miagblẽ nu la le miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔwo me. Nuxɔxɔ le ɖokuibɔbɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Mi ahasiwɔlawo, mienya bena, xexeame ƒe xɔlɔ̃dzedze enye ketɔnyenye na Mawu oa? Eyaŋuti amesi dina be, yeanye xexeame ƒe xɔlɔ̃ la, etso eɖokui wɔ Mawu ƒe ketɔ.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe míebuna bena, ŋɔŋlɔ la ƒoa nu dzodzro bena: Gbɔgbɔ, si wòna wòdzra nɔƒe ɖo le mia me la, le edzrom kple ŋuʋaʋã?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Ke ena amenuveve geɖe wu. Eyaŋuti wogblɔ bena: „Mawu tsia tre ɖe dadalawo ŋuti; ke evea ɖokuibɔbɔlawo nu.“

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe Mawu te; ke mitsi tre ɖe Abosam ŋu, eye wòasi le mia gbɔ.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Mite ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye wòate ɖe mia ŋu. Miklɔ miaƒe asiwo, mi nuvɔ̃wɔlawo, eye miwɔ miaƒe dziwo kɔkɔe, mi dzimevesusulawo!

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Midze si miaƒe nublanuitɔnyenye, eye mifa konyi, eye mifa avi; mina miaƒe nukoko natrɔ zu konyifafa, eye miaƒe dzidzɔ natrɔ zu modedeto.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe anyi le Aƒetɔ la ŋku me, eye wòakɔ mi ɖe dzi.

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, migadzu mia nɔewo o! Amesi ke dzua nɔvia, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnui la, edoa vlo se la, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu se la. Ke ne edrɔ̃ ʋɔnu se la la, menye se la dziwɔla o, ke boŋ se la ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la nènye.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Ame ɖeka koe nye sedela kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃la: Eyae nye amesi tea ŋu xɔa ame ɖe agbe, eye wògatea ŋu tsrɔ̃a ame. Ke wò la, ameka nènye hele ʋɔnu drɔ̃m hawòvi mahã? Nuxɔxlɔ̃ le dedienɔnɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Azɔ la miheyi, mi amesiwo gblɔna bena: Egbe alo etsɔ míayi du si kple du si me, eye mianɔ afima ƒe ɖeka, eye míatsa asi, eye míakpɔ viɖe!

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Gake mienya nusi ava dzɔ etsɔ o; elabena nukae nye miaƒe agbe mahã? Elabena dzudzɔ, si dzena ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe, eye emegbe la megadzena o la, ke míenye.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Le esia teƒe la ele na mi be, miagblɔ bena: Ne Aƒetɔ lɔ̃ la, míanɔ agbe, eye míawo esi kple esi.

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la miekana ɖe nu ŋu le miaƒe adegbe ƒuƒlu ƒoƒo me. Kakaɖenuŋu sia katã la vɔ̃ wònye.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti la, amesi ke nya nu nyui wɔwɔ, eye mewɔnɛ o la, enye nuvɔ̃ nɛ.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Azɔ la miheyi, mi kesinɔtɔwo; mifa avi, eye mido wuwui le miaƒe nublanuitɔnyenye, si le mia dzi va ge la ŋuti!

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Miaƒe kesinɔnuwo nyunyɔ, eye agbagblaʋuiwo ɖu miaƒe awuwo.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Miaƒe sika kple klosalo lé ɣebia, eye woƒe ɣebialéle atrɔ zu ɖaseɖiɖi na mi, eye woaɖu miaƒe lãme keŋ abe dzo ene. Mieƒo nu nyuiwo nu ƒu le nuwuwu ŋkekeawo me.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, dɔwɔla, siwo ŋe miaƒe agblemenuwo la ƒe fetu, si miegbe wo nana la, le ɣli dom, eye nuŋelawo ƒe ɣlidodoawo va Zebaot, Aƒetɔ la, ƒe towo me.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Miebu fɔ ame dzɔdzɔe la, eye miewui, eye metsi tre ɖe mia ŋuti o. Le dzigbɔgbɔ blewu ɖe nɔviawo ŋu ŋuti.

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti migba dzi blewu, nɔvinyewo, halase Aƒetɔ la ƒe vavagbe. Kpɔ ɖa, agbledela lalaa anyigba dzi nuʋaʋã xɔasiwo, eye wògbɔa dzi blewu, halase esime ada kple kele dzana nɛ.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Miawo hã migbɔ dzi blewu, mido ŋusẽ miaƒe dziwo; elabena Aƒetɔ ƒe vavaɣi ɖo vɔ.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, migaɖu tse de mia nɔewo ŋuti o, bene womagadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi o; kpɔ ɖa, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la la le tsitre ɖe ʋɔtru la nu.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, mitsɔ nyagblɔɖila, siwo ƒoa nu le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔa me la, ƒe fukpekpewo kple woƒe dzigbɔgbɔ blewu wo miaƒe kpɔɖeŋu.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, míeyɔa amesiwo doa dzi keŋ la be yayratɔwo. Miese Hiob ƒe dzidodo, eye miekpɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe nuwuwu bena, Aƒetɔ la yɔ fũ kple dometɔtrɔ kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ. Le nutàta le susu wodzui me ŋuti.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Ke wu wo katã la, nɔvinyewo, migatà nu o, eɖanye dziƒo alo anyigba alo nutàta bubua ɖeke o; ke miaƒe ẽ nanye ẽ, eye miaƒe o nanye o, ne miagadze ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me o. Gbedodoɖa ƒe ŋusẽ.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Ne mia dome amea ɖe le fu kpem la, nedo gbe ɖa; ne amea ɖe kpɔ dzidzɔ la, nedzi kafukafuhawo.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne mia dome amea de ƒe lãme gblẽ la, neyɔ hamemegãwo vɛ, ne woado gbe ɖa ɖe eta, eye wòasi ami nɛ le Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkɔa me.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Eye xɔse ƒe gbedodoɖa la axɔ dɔléla ma ɖe agbe, eye Aƒetɔ la afɔe ɖe tsitre, eye ne ewo nuvɔ̃wo la, woatsɔ wo akee.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Miʋu mia nuvɔ̃wo me na mia nɔewo, eye mido gbe ɖa ɖe mia nɔewo ta, bene miaƒe lãme nasẽ. Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe kukuɖeɖe, si nu sẽna la, tea ŋu woa nu geɖe.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Eliya nye ame, eye nu venɛ abe míawo ene, eye wòɖo gbea ɖe ɖa, bena tsi nagadza o, eye tsi megadza ɖe anyigba dzi o ƒe etɔ̃ kple ɣleti ade sɔŋ.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Eye wògado gbe ɖa, eye dziƒo na tsi dza, eye anyigba gatse eƒe kutsetse. Lɔlɔ̃ na mɔtrelawo.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne mia dome amea de tre mɔ tso nyateƒe la gbɔ, eye amea de gatrɔe vɛ la,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: nena woanyae bena, amesi trɔa nuvɔ̃wɔla tsoa eƒe mɔtatra me la, laxɔ luʋɔ ɖe agbe tso ku me, eye wòatsyɔ nu nuvɔ̃wo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ dzi.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Petro, Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolo, ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe amedzro, siwo ka hlẽ ɖe Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia kple Bitinia, amesiwo nye ame tiatiawo

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: le Mawu Fofo la ƒe nunyanyaɖi la nu le Gbɔgbɔ ƒe kɔkɔewɔwɔ me hena toɖoɖo kple Yesu Kristo ƒe ʋuhehlẽ: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi na mi! Apostolo la kafu Mawu le xɔsetɔwo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ kple yayra ŋuti.

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu, mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Fofo, amesi gbugbɔ mí gadzi le eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ geɖe la nu hena mɔkpɔkpɔ gbagbe to Yesu Kristo ƒe tsitretsitsi tso ame kukuwo dome la me,

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: hena domenyinyi magblẽmagblẽ, maƒoɖi, maluxe, si wodzra ɖo ɖi le dziƒo na mi,

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: amesiwo ŋu wodzo le Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ me to xɔse me hena xoxo, si su te, bene woaɖee afia le ɣeyiɣi mamletɔ dzi,

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: si me miatso aseye le, wònye ele na mi be, miaxa nu azɔ ɣeyiɣi ʋeea ɖe le tetekpɔ bubu ƒomeviwo me hafi,

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: bena woakpɔ miaƒe xɔse ƒe dodokpɔ be, exɔ asi geɖe wu sika, si gblẽna, wònye wodoe kpɔ kple dzo hafi hena kafukafu kple ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu le Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖeɖefia la me;

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: amesi miele kpɔkpɔm o, gake mielɔ̃nɛ; amesi miekpɔ haɖe o, gake miexɔa edzi sena, eye mietsɔa dzidzɔ, si mele gbɔgblɔ o, si ŋutikɔkɔe li na la, tsoa aseye,

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: esime miexɔa miaƒe xɔse ƒe nuwuwu, si nye miaƒe luʋɔwo ɖeɖe.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Ɖeɖe sia yome mɔ nyagblɔɖila, siwo gblɔ nya ɖi le amenuveve, si le mia dzi va ge ŋuti la, ɖi vevie, eye wodzro eme kpɔ tsitotsito;

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: wodzro azãgbe kple azãgbe, si ƒomevi Kristo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ, si le wo me la, laɖe afia la me kpɔ, esime wòɖi ɖase tsã le fukpekpe, siwo le Kristo dzi va ge, kple ŋutikɔkɔe, si le wo yome dze ge la ŋuti.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Eye wòɖee fia amesiawo bena, menye woa ŋutɔwo ɖokui wosubɔ o, ke boŋ miawo wosubɔ le nusiawo me, nusiwo wogblɔ fia mí azɔ to amesiwo gblɔ nyanyuie fia mi la dzi to Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe, si woɖo ɖa tso dziƒo la me, nusiwo me kpɔkpɔ dzro mawudɔlawo hã. Le zɔzɔ nyui ŋuti.

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Eyata mibla miaƒe tamesusuwo ƒe aliwo dzi, mina mo xexi, eye mitsɔ miaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖo amenuveve, si wotsɔna vaa mia gbɔ le Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖeɖefia me la dzi blibo

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: eye abe vi ɖotowo ene migana miaƒe anyinɔnɔ naɖi tsãtɔ, si me mienɔ le miaƒe nudzodzrowo me, le numanyamanya me la o,

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: ke boŋ abe alesi amesi yɔ mi vɛ la le kɔkɔe ene la, nenema ke miawo hã minɔ kɔkɔe le miaƒe anyinɔnɔ katã me;

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: elabena woŋlɔ bena: „Minɔ kɔkɔe, elabena nye la mele kɔkɔe.“

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Eye ne mieyɔ amesi mekpɔ ame ŋku me o, eye wòdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖe amesiame ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nu la, ƒe ŋkɔ dzi abe Fofo ene la, ekema mizɔ le miaƒe amedzronyenye ƒe ɣeyiɣi la me le vɔvɔ̃ me;

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: elabena mienyae bena, menye nu gbegblẽ, siwo nye klosalo alo sika la, wotsɔ xe fe ɖe mia ta heɖe mi tso miaƒe yakanyinɔnɔ, si su mia si tso mia fofowo gbɔ la me o,

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: ke boŋ kple Kristo ƒe ʋu xɔasi la abe alẽvi, si ŋu mokaka kple kpɔtsotso mele o la, ƒe ʋu ene,

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: amesi wonya ɖi tsã, hafi woɖo xexeame gɔme anyi; gake woɖee ɖe go fia le ɣeyiɣia ƒe nuwuwu le mia ta,

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: mi amesiwo to eyama dzi xɔ Mawu, amesi fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye wòtsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe nɛ la dzi se, ale bena miaƒe xɔse kple mɔkpɔkpɔ nanɔ Mawu dzi.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Esi mieto Gbɔgbɔ la me wɔ miaƒe luʋɔwo kɔkɔe le toɖoɖo nyateƒe la me hena nɔvilɔlɔ̃, si me alakpa mele o la, eyata milɔ̃ mia nɔewo vevie tso dzi dzadzɛ me.

english_verse: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.
translation_verse: Elabena wogbugbɔ mi dzi, menye tso dzidzi gbegblẽ me o, ke boŋ tso dzidzi magblẽmagblẽ me heto Mawu ƒe nya gbagbe, si noa anyi tegbetegbe la me.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Elabena „ŋutilãwo katã le abe gbe ene, eye woƒe atsyɔ̃wo katã le abe gbe ƒe seƒoƒo ene. Gbe ƒuna, eye eƒe seƒoƒo yrɔna;

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: ke Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la noa anyi yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.“ Ke esiae nye nya, si wogblɔ fia mi.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Eyata miɖe vɔ̃ɖinyenye katã kple aɖaŋu vɔ̃ katã kple alakpadada kple ŋuʋaʋã kple ameŋuzɔzɔ katã ɖa,

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: eye abe vidzĩewo ene la gbɔgbɔ me notsi tsimatɔ nadzro mi vevie, bene miatsi to me hena xoxo la,

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: ne mieɖɔe kpɔ bena, Aƒetɔ la nye dɔmenyotɔ.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Amesi gbɔ mieva wònye kpe gbagbe, si amewo gbe; gake le Mawu gbɔ la enye nu tiatia kple nusi xɔ asi sesẽ,

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: eye abe kpe gbagbewo ene la miawo hã mitu mia ɖokui wòazu gbɔgbɔ me xɔ hena nunɔlanyenye kɔkɔe, bena miasa gbɔgbɔ me vɔ, siwo adze Mawu ŋu to Yesu Kristo dzi.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Eyata wòle ŋɔŋlɔ la me bena: „Kpɔ ɖa, meɖo dzogoedzikpe tiatia xɔasi anyi ɖe Zion, eye amesi ke xɔ edzi se la, ŋu mele ekpe ge o.“

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Azɔ mi amesiwo xɔe se la, enye kpe xɔasi na mi; ke dzimaxɔsetɔwo la, kpe, si xɔtulawo gbe la, eya ke zu dzogoedzikpe kple nuklikpe kple nuɖiakpe gbadzaa na wo,

english_verse: They disobeyed the message and stumbled and fell over this stone, because they were doomed.
translation_verse: amesiwo klii, le esi womeɖo to nya la o la ta, nusi ŋuti hã woɖo wo ɖo.

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ke miawoe nye dzidzime tiatia la, fia nunɔlanyenye, dukɔ kɔkɔe, dukɔ, si nye Mawu ŋutɔ tɔ, bene miaɖe gbe ƒã amesi yɔ mi tso viviti me va ye ŋutɔ ƒe nukukekeli gbɔ la, ƒe nutsuwɔwɔwo afia,

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: mi amesiwo menye dukɔ tsã o; ke azɔ la míenye Mawu ƒe dukɔ, mi amesiwo womekpɔ nublanui na o, ke azɔ la wokpɔ nublanui na mi.

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mele nu xlɔ̃m mi abe amedzrowo kple mɔzɔlawo ene be, miade mia dokui ɖa atso ŋutilã nudzodzro, siwo wɔa aʋa ɖe luʋɔ ŋuti la gbɔ,

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: eye miaƒe anyinɔnɔ le trɔ̃subɔlawo dome nanɔ nyuie, bene nusi ta wogblɔ nya ɖe mia ŋuti ɖo abe vɔ̃wɔlawo ene la, le miaƒe dɔ nyui wɔwɔ, siwo wodze si azɔ ŋuti la, woakafu Mawu le kpɔkpɔɖaŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe amewo ƒe nuɖoanyi katã te le Aƒetɔ la ŋuti, eɖanye ɖe fia, si si ŋusẽ le la te o,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: eɖanye ɖe dziɖula, siwo wodɔ ɖe dɔgbe le hlɔ̃biabia vɔ̃wɔlawo kple nyuiwɔlawo kafukafu ta la te o.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Elabena nenemae nye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, bena miatsɔ nu nyui wɔwɔ atsi abunetɔwo ƒe numanyamanya la nu,

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: abe ablɔɖeviwo ene, eye menye abe amesiwo wɔa ablɔɖenyenye la ŋuti dɔ be, wòanye vɔɖinyenye ƒe nutsyɔnu la ene o, ke boŋ abe Mawu ƒe dɔlawo ene.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Mibu amewo katã, milɔ̃ nɔviawo, miyɔ Mawu, mibu fia la. Dɔlawo ƒe dɔ.

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Mi dɔlawo la, mibɔbɔ mia dokui na miaƒe aƒetɔwo le vɔvɔ̃ katã me, menye na aƒetɔ nyuiwo kple ame fatuwo ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ na dɔmevevitɔwo hã.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Elabena esiae nye amenuveve, ne amea de do dzi le xaxawo me, eye wòkpea fu madzemadze le dzitsinya, si vɔ̃a Mawu la ta.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Elabena ne woƒo mi le nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ ŋuti, eye miedo dzi kpee la, adegbeƒoƒo ka wònye ma? Ke ne míekpe fu le nu nyui wowɔ ŋuti, eye miedo dzi kpee la, eya enye amenuveve le Mawu ŋku me.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Elabena esia ŋuti woyɔ mi vɛ ɖo; elabena Kristo hã kpe fu le mia ta, eye wògblẽ kpɔɖeŋu ɖi na mi, bene miadze eƒe afɔɖoƒewo yome,

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: amesi mewɔ nuvɔ̃a ɖeke o, eye womekpɔ beble le eƒe nu me hã o;

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: esime wodzui la, medzu ame ɖe eteƒe o; esime wokpe fu la, meɖo ŋɔdzi na ame o; ke etsɔe ɖe asi na amesi drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe la boŋ.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Amesi tsɔ miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa ɖe ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi heyi ɖe atitsoga ŋu, bene mí amesiwo ku na nuvɔ̃wo la, míanɔ agbe hena dzɔdzɔenyenye; amesi ƒe kabiwo yɔ dɔ mi la.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Elabena miele abe alẽ tatrawo ene; ke azɔ la mitrɔ va miaƒe luʋɔwo ƒe kplɔla kple dzikpɔla la gbɔ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Nenema ke, mi nyɔnuwo la, mibɔbɔ mia dokui na mia ŋutɔwo mia srɔ̃wo, bena ne amea ɖewo meɖo to nya la o la, nyɔnuwo ƒe agbenɔnɔ nyaa ɖeke magblɔ la naɖe wo,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: esi wokpɔ miaƒe agbenɔnɔ dzadzɛ le vɔvɔ̃ me ɖa la,

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: amesiwo ƒe lekewɔwɔ naganye gota gome lekewɔwɔ to ɖaƒoƒo kple sikadodo kple awudodo me o,

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wòanye dzime ƒe ame ɣaɣla le gbɔgbɔ fatu, si nɔa anyi kpoo la, ƒe nɔnɔme magblẽmagblẽ me, si xɔ asi sesẽ le Mawu ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Elabena nenema ke nyɔnu kɔkɔewo hã, amesiwo kpɔ mɔ na Mawu la, wɔ leke na wo ɖokui tsã, eye wobɔbɔ wo ɖokui na woa ŋutɔwo srɔ̃wo,

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: abe alesi Sara ɖoa to Abraham, eye wòyɔnɛ be aƒetɔ la ene, amesi vinyɔnuviwo míezu azɔ, ne miewɔa nu nyui, eye míeyɔa ŋɔdzidodoa ɖeke o.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Nenema ke, mi ŋutsuwo la, minɔ anyi kple nyɔnuwo le nunya me, esi wonye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo wu la ŋuti, eye mitsɔ bubu na wo; elabena woawo hã wonye agbe ƒe amenuveve hadomenyilawo, bene míagaxe mɔ na miaƒe gbedodoɖawo o. Le lɔlɔ̃ kple dɔmefafa ŋuti.

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la mi katã misusu nu ɖeka, ame nu nawɔ nublanui na mi; milɔ̃ mia nɔewo abe nɔviwo ene; miaƒe dɔme natrɔ ɖe ame ŋu; mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Migaɖo vɔ̃ vɔ̃ teƒe alo dzudzu dzudzu teƒe o; ke esia teƒe la miyra boŋ; elabena esia ta woyɔ mi vɛ ɖo, be mianyi yayra ƒe dome.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi le didim be, yealɔ̃ agbe, eye yeakpɔ ŋkeke nyuiwo la, nekpɔ eƒe aɖe dzi ɖe vɔ̃ ŋu kple eƒe nuyiwo dzi, bene woagagblɔ alakpanya o;

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: nete ɖa le vɔ̃ ŋu, eye wòawɔ nu nyui; nedi ŋutifafa, eye woati eyome.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋkuwo le ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu, eye eƒe towo le woƒe kukuɖeɖe ŋu; ke Yehowa klẽa ŋku ɖe amesiwo wɔa vɔ̃ la.

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Eye ameka awɔ vɔ̃ ɖe mia ŋu, ne mienye veviedolawo le nu nyui me mahã?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Ke ne miekpe fu le nu dzɔdzɔe ŋuti hã la, woayra mi. Ke migavɔ̃ woƒe vɔvɔ̃ o, eye ŋɔ hã nagadzi mi o;

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: ke boŋ mikɔ Aƒetɔ Kristo la ŋu le miaƒe dziwo me, eye misu te ɖaasi, bene miana ŋuɖoɖo amesiame, si abia nyaa ɖe mi le mɔkpɔkpɔ, si le mia me la ŋuti; gake miwɔe kple dɔmefafa kpakple vɔvɔ,

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: esi dzitsinya nyui le mia si, bene nusi me wogbɔ nya vɔ̃ de mia ŋuti le abe vɔ̃wɔlawo ene la, woado ŋukpe amesiwo do vlo miaƒe agbenɔnɔ nyui, si le Kristo me la.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Elabena ne enye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, fukpekpe le nu nyui wɔwɔ ŋuti enyo wu fukpekpe le vɔ̃wɔwɔ ŋuti. Le Kristo ƒe tsiẽƒeyiyi kple mawutsidedeta ŋuti.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Elabena Kristo hã kpe fu le nuvɔ̃wo ŋuti zi ɖeka, ame dzɔdzɔe ɖe ame madzɔmadzɔ teƒe, bene wòakplɔ mí ayi Mawu gbɔ; esime wowui le ŋutilã gome, ke wogbɔ agbee le gbɔgbɔ gome;

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: esime hã wòtɔ edzi heyi, eye wògblɔ nya ɖia gbɔgbɔwo le gaxɔ me,

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: amesiwo sẽ to tsã, esime Mawu ƒe dzigbɔgbɔ blewu la lala le Noa ƒe ŋkekeawo me, esime wòle aɖakaʋu dzram ɖo, si me woɖe ame ʋee, siwo le luʋɔ enyi la le hetso tsi me,

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: nusi nye kpɔɖeŋu na mawutsidedetaname, si ɖe miawo hã azɔ, si menye ŋutilãɖiƒoƒo ɖeɖeɖa o, ke boŋ dzitsinya nyui ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe na Mawu heto Yesu Kristo ƒe tsitretsitsi me,

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: amesi yi ɖe dziƒo, eye wòle Mawu ƒe nuɖusi me, eye mawudɔlawo kple dziɖuɖuwõ kpakple ŋusẽwo bɔbɔ wo ɖokui nɛ.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Kristo kpe fu ɖe mia ta le ŋutilã me ŋuti la, miawo hã mikpla tamesusu ma ke abe aʋawɔnuwo ene; elabena amesi kpe fu le ŋutilã me la, edzudzɔ nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ,

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: bena miaganɔ agbe na amewo ƒe nudzodzrowo le ɣeyiɣi, si susɔ be, mianɔ agbe le ŋutilã me la me o, ke boŋ hena Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Elabena agbe ƒe ɣeyiɣi, si va yi la, sɔ gbɔ be, miewɔ trɔ̃subɔlawo ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye miezɔ le hadzedzewo, nudzodzrowo, ahatsunonowo, nutsuɖuɖuwo, aglotutuwo kple trɔ̃subɔsubɔ ŋunyɔtɔ la me;

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: esia wɔ yaa na wo bena, mieƒu du kpli wo yi ɖe nu vlo wɔwɔ ma ke ƒe ba me o, eye wole busunyawo gblɔm le mia ŋuti;

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: amesiawo abu akɔnta na amesi su te, bena yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame gbagbewo kple ame kukuwo la.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Elabena esia ta wogblɔ nyanyuie la fia ame kukuwo hã ɖo bena, ne woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo le amewo gome le ŋutilã me hã la, le Mawu gome la woano agbe le gbɔgbɔ me.

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Ke nuwo katã ƒe nuwuwu ɖo vɔ. Eyaŋuti miɖu mia ɖokui dzi, eye minɔ mo xexi hena gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Ke vevietɔ la mitsɔ lɔlɔ̃ lɔ̃ mia nɔewo vevie; elabena lɔlɔ̃ tsyɔa nuvɔ̃wo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ dzi.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Milɔ̃ amedzrowɔwɔ na mia nɔewo, eye liʋiliʋilili naganɔ me o.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Misubɔ mia nɔewo le alesi amesiame xɔ amenuvevenunana la nu, abe Mawu ƒe amenuveve bubu ƒomevi geɖewo ƒe xɔnuvi nyuiwo ene.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe le nya gblɔm la, negblɔe abe mawunya ene; ne amea ɖe le subɔsubɔm la, netsɔ ŋusẽ, si Mawu tsɔ kee la subɔ, bene woakafu Mawu le nuwo katã me to Yesu Kristo dzi, amesi tɔ lanye ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migana fiafiã ƒe tetekpɔ, si va mia dzi hena mia dodokpɔ la, nawɔ yaa ɖe mi, abe nyaa ɖe ƒomevie va dzɔ ɖe mia dzi ene o;

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: ke boŋ zi geɖe alesi miekpɔ gome le Kristo ƒe fukpekpewo me la, zi geɖe ma ke mikpɔ dzidzɔ bena, le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ɖeɖefia me hã la míakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye miatso aseye.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Ne wodzu mi le Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ ta la, woayra mi, elabena ŋutikɔkɔe kple Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la va dzudzɔ ɖe mia dzi; ame mawo gbɔ la wogblɔ busunya ɖe eŋuti, ke mia gbɔ la wokɔ eŋuti.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Ke mia dome amea ɖeke nagakpe fu abe hlɔ̃dola alo fiafitɔ alo vɔ̃wɔla alo abe amesi doa gaglãsu ɖe ame bubuwo ƒe nya me la ene o;

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: ke ne amea ɖe kpe fu abe kristotɔ ene la, megakpe ŋu ne o, ke nekafu Mawu le nya sia me boŋ.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Elabena azãgbe la ɖo vɔ, bena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la nadze gɔme tso Mawu ƒe aƒe me; ke ne wodze egɔme tso mía dzi la, ekema nuka lanye nuwuwu na amesiwo meɖo to Mawu ƒe nyanyuie la o mahã?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Eye nenye bebli hafi woaxɔ ame dzɔdzɔe la, afika ame mavɔ̃mawu kple nuvɔ̃wɔla lado ɖo mahã?

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Eyata amesiwo kpea fu le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu nu la, natsɔ woƒe luʋɔwo ade asi na wolã nuteƒewɔla la le dɔ nyui wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Hamemegã, siwo le mia dome la, nye, amesi nye mia ha-ha-memegã kple Kristo ƒe fukpekpewo ɖaseɖila kple ŋutikɔkɔe, si wole ɖeɖe ge ɖe go la hã gomekpɔla la, mele nu xlɔ̃m mi be:

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Minyi Mawu ƒe alẽha, si le mia dome, eye mikpɔ edzi; menye le dzizizi ta o, ke boŋ kple lɔlɔ̃nu faa le Mawu nu; menye le viɖe ƒoɖi ta o, ke boŋ kple dzi faa;

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: menye abe amesiwo ɖu aƒetɔ ɖe ha me, si wode asi na wo la, dzi ene o, ke boŋ abe amesiwo nye kpɔɖeŋu na hame la ene,

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: ekema ne alẽkplɔla gã la lado la, miaxɔ ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe fiakuku magblẽmagblẽ la. Le ɖokuibɔbɔ, dziɖoɖo ɖe Mawu ŋu kple ŋudzɔnɔnɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Nenema ke, mi ɖekakpuiwo, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe ame tsitsiwo te; ke mi katã mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe mia nɔewo te, eye mitso ɖokuibɔbɔɖeanyi hetsyɔ; elabena Mawu tsia tre ɖe dadalawo ŋuti, ke evea ɖokuibɔbɔlawo nu.

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Azɔ la mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe Mawu ƒe asi sesẽ la te, bene wòakɔ mi de dzi le ɣeyiɣi, si woɖo ɖi la dzi.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ miaƒe dzimaɖiwo katã da ɖe eyama dzi; elabena eyama léa be na mi.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Minɔ mo xexi, minɔ ŋudzɔ; elabena miaƒe adikãtɔ, Abosam, le tsatsam abe dzata, si le gbe ɖem hele ame dim, be yeavuvu ami ene;

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: minɔ tsitre sesĩe ɖe eyama ŋuti le xɔse me, esi mienyae bena, fukpekpe mawo ke va mia nɔvi, siwo le xexeame la dzi. Yayradiname-nyawo.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Ke amenuveve katã ƒe Mawu, amesi yɔ mi va eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe mavɔ la gbɔ le Kristo Yesu me la, ŋutɔ awɔ mi amesiwo kpe fu via ɖe ko la blibo, ado ŋusẽ mi, ali ke mi, eye wòaɖo mía gɔme anyi.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Eya tɔ lanye ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen. Gbedoname kpe nuwunyawo.

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Meŋlɔ nya kpui sia ɖo ɖe mi to Silvano, amesi mebu nɔvi nuteƒewɔla la, si me hele nu xlɔ̃m, mi, eye mele ɖase ɖim bena, esiae nye Mawu ƒe amenuveve vavãtɔ. Minɔ tsitre sesĩe ɖe eme.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Hame, si wolia kpakpli mi le Babilon kple vinye Marko ɖuɖɔ mi ƒã.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ lɔlɔ̃nugbugbɔ ɖuɖɔ mia nɔewo nam ƒã. Ŋutifafa nanɔ anyi kpli mi amesiwo katã le Kristo Yesu me!

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔla kple apostolo, ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe amesiwo kpɔ xɔse xɔasi ma ke kpli mí le mía Mawu kple mía xɔla Yesu Kristo ƒe dzodzoenyenye la me:

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi na mi le sidzedze Mawu kple Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ, la me.

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Esi eƒe Mawu me ŋusẽ tsɔ nusiwo katã nyo hena agbe kple mawusosroɖa la, ke mi to sidzedze amesi tsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ yɔ mi la me;

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: nusiawo me woto tsɔ ŋugbedodo xɔasi gãtɔwo ke mí, bene miato esiawo me azu Mawu ƒe dzɔdzɔme gomekpɔlawo, ne miesi tso nudzodzrowo ƒe gbegblẽ, si le xexe sia me la gbɔ:

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Elabena ne nusiawo le mia me, eye wole agbɔ sɔm ɖe dzi la, mana mianye kuviatɔwo kple ame matsekuwo le sidzedze mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la me o.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Elabena amesi si nusiawo mele o la, enye ŋkuagbãtɔ, eye mekpɔa didiƒenu o, eye woŋlɔ eƒe tsã nuvɔ̃wo kɔklɔɖa la be.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Eyata, nɔviwo, miɖo vevie wu tsãtɔ, bena miali ke mia yɔyɔ kple tiatia la sesĩe; elabena ne miewɔ nusiawo la, miada vo akpɔ o.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Elabena le ale mɔ sia dzi woana gege ɖe mía Aƒetɔ kple xɔla Yesu Kristo ƒe fiaɖuƒe mavɔ la me nu wòasɔ gbɔ fũ. Le Kristo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple nyagblɔɖi, si li ke sesĩe la ŋuti.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Eyaŋuti nyemadzudzɔ ŋkuɖoɖo nusiawo dzi na mi akpɔ o, wònye mienyae, eye wona mieli ke ɖe nyateƒe, si li kpli mi la me hafi.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Ke mebui nusi dzɔ be, ŋkeke alesi mele agbadɔ sia me la, matsɔ ŋkuɖoɖonudzi na mi anɔ mia nyɔmi.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: Elabena menyae bena, nye agbadɔ la ɖeɖeɖa la lilim, abe alesi mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo hã ɖee fiam la ene.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Ke mado vevie, bena miate ŋu aɖo ŋku nusiawo dzi gbesiagbe le nye dzodzo megbe.
