english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Elabena menye gli, siwo wokpa kple aɖaŋu la, yome míedze, esime miena mienya mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋusẽ kple eƒe vava la o; ke boŋ míenye eƒe gãnyenye, si míekpɔ kple ŋku la, ƒe ɖaseɖilawo.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Elabena exɔ bubu kple ŋutikɔkɔe tso Mawu Fofo la gbɔ, esime nenem gbe sia ɖi tso ŋutikɔkɔe gã nyui la me va egbɔ bena: „Amesia nye Vinye, si nyemelɔ̃a nu egbɔ o, si dzea ŋunye!“

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Eye mia ŋutɔwo miese gbe sia tso dziƒo, esime mieli kplii le to kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Eye nyagblɔɖi, si li ke sesĩe wu la, le mia si, eye miewɔe nyuie bena, míekpɔa edzi, abe akaɖi, si le keklẽm le tsyɔtsyɔƒe ene, halase esime ŋu lake, eye ŋukeɣletivi ladze le miaƒe dziwo me;

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: eye minya esia gbã bena, ŋɔŋlɔ la me nyagblɔɖiwo katã metso ame ŋutɔ ƒe gɔmefiafia gbɔ o;

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: elabena nyagbɔgblɔɖia ɖeke metso lãme ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me kpɔ o, ke boŋ Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe lae ʋã Mawu ƒe ame kɔkɔewo, hafi wogblɔ nya ɖi.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Ke aʋatsonyagblɔɖilawo va tsi tre le dukɔ la dome, abe alesi aʋatsonufialawo lava míawo hã mia dome ene, amesiwo latsɔ gbegblẽ ƒe kɔmamãwo ava tra ɖe eme dzaa, eye woagbe nu le Aƒetɔ, si xe fe ɖe wo ta la gbɔ, eye woahe gbegblẽ kpatakpata ava wo ɖokui dzi.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Eye ame geɖewo adze woƒe hadzenuwɔwɔwo yome, amesiwo ta woagblɔ busunya ɖe nyateƒemɔ la ŋuti ɖo,

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: eye le ŋukeklẽ me woatsɔ nyakpakpawo aɖi viɖe le mia ŋu, amesiwo ƒe fɔbubu mehe ɖe megbe tso blema ke o, eye woƒe gbegblẽ medɔa akalɔ̃e o.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Elabena ne Mawu mekpɔ mawudɔla wɔnuvɔ̃wo ƒe nublanui o, ke wòtsɔ viviti tsiɖitsiɖi ƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔwo bla wo hetu asi wo xlã ɖe dzomavɔʋe me, bena woadzra wo ɖo hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃;

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: eye mekpe blema xexeme la ƒe nublanui o, negbe Noa, dzɔdzɔenyenye le gbeƒãɖela la, hekpe ɖe ame adre bubuawo ŋu ko wòdzra ɖo, esime wòhe tɔɖɔɖɔ va ame mavɔ̃mawuwo ƒe xexeme dzi;

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: eye wòna Sodom kple Gomora ƒe duwo zu afi, eye wòbu fɔ wo to wo tɔtrɔtsyɔanyi me, eye wotsɔ wo ɖo kpɔɖeŋu na amesiwo ava nɔ agbe le mawumavɔ̃mavɔ̃ me;

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: elabena esi ame dzɔdzɔe ma nɔ wo dome, eye wòkpɔ, eye wòse woƒe dɔwɔwɔ, siwo mele sea nu o la, ewɔa fu eƒe luʋɔ dzɔdzɔe la gbesiagbe; —

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: ale Aƒetɔ la nya alesi wòaɖe mawumemewo atso tetekpɔwo me, eye wòadzra ame madzɔmadzɔwo ɖo hena ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe, bene woatu fe vɔ̃ na wo;

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: ke vevietɔ amesiwo zɔna le ŋutilã nu le makɔmakɔnyenye ƒe nudzodzro la me, eye wodoa vlo aƒetɔnyenye la. Ame mabunuwo, ɖokuiŋudzelawo kple amesiwo medzona nyanyanya, ne wogblɔ busunya ɖe ŋutikɔkɔewo ŋuti la o,

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: wònye mawudɔlawo nye gatɔwo wu le ŋutete kple ŋusẽ me hafi; gake womehe busufɔbubu vɛ ɖe wo ŋuti le Aƒetɔ la ŋku me o.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Ke amesiawo le abe lã nyasã manɔsitɔ, siwo wodzi hena lelé kple tsɔtsrɔ̃ le woƒe dzɔdzɔme nu la ene: Wogblɔa busunya le nya, siwo womenya kura o la me, eye woatsrɔ̃ hã le woƒe gbegblẽ la me,

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: eye woaxɔ madzɔmadzɔnyenye ƒe fetu. Amesiwo bua gbesiagbe ƒe aglotutu dzidzɔnui, ɖiƒoƒo kple ŋukpe wonye, eye wotsɔa nusiwo wokpɔ to woƒe amebeble me la, ɖua nu tsui, eye wotua aglo kpli mi;

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: ŋku, siwo yɔ taŋ kple ahasiwɔwɔ, eye nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ metea ŋu ɖia kɔ na wo o la, li na wo; wòblea luʋɔ, siwo meli ke o la, vaa wo ɖokui gbɔ; dzi, si ŋukeklẽ ma ŋutɔ la, li na wo, eye fiƒodeviwo wonye.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Esime wogblẽ mɔ dzɔdzɔe la ɖi la, wotre mɔ, eye wodze Bileam, Beor vi, amesi lɔ madzɔmadzɔnyenye ƒe fetu la yome;

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: ke ekpɔ mokaka le eƒe dzidada la ŋuti: Dɔwɔlã maƒonu la tsɔ ame ƒe gbe ƒo nu, eye woxe mɔ na nyagblɔɖila la ƒe lãnuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Amesiwo nye tsivudo, siwo me tsi mele o, kple alilikpo, siwo ahom ƒona yina gbɔna, amesiwo wodzra viviti tsiɖitsiɖi la ɖo ɖi na yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Elabena esi wogblɔ yakanya lolo gãwo la, wotsɔ ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzrowo kple hadzedze vɔ̃wo ble amesiwo si fifi laa tso mɔtrelawo gbɔ.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Eye wodo ablɔɖenyenye ŋugbe na wo, wònye woa ŋutɔwo la gbegblẽ ƒe dɔlawo wonye hafi: elabena amesi ɖu amea ɖe dzi la, eya ke wɔnɛ kluvi.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Elabena ne wosi le xexeame ƒe makɔmakɔnyenye nu to sidzedze Aƒetɔ kple xɔla Yesu Kristo me, eye wona wogalé wo le nu mawo ke me, eye wogaɖu wo dzi la, ekema woƒe anyinɔnɔ mamletɔ zu vɔ̃ na wo wu tsãtɔ.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖe womedze si dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ o la, ne enyo na wo wu esi wodze sii, eye gake wogagbugbɔ tso sedede kɔkɔe, si wode asi na wo la gbɔ.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Eva me na wo le nyateƒe lododo la nu bena: „Avũ gbugbɔ yi ɖe ye ŋutɔ ƒe xeɖeɖe la gbɔ,“ eye „ha, si wole tsi na la, le mimlim yina ba me.“

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: bene miaɖo ŋku nya, siwo nyagblɔɖila kɔkɔeawo gblɔ ɖi tsã la, kple Aƒetɔ kple xɔla ƒe se, si wòde to miaƒe apostolowo dzi la dzi.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Minya esia gbã bena, le ŋkeke mamleawo dzi la fewuɖulawo lava kple fewuɖuɖu, amesiwo zɔna le woawo ŋutɔwo ƒe nudzodzrowo nu,

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: eye woagblɔ bena: Afika eƒe vava la ƒe ŋugbedodo la le? Elabena tso esime fofoawo dɔ alɔ̃ la, nuwo katã nɔ anyi nenema tso nuwɔwɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze la me.

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Elabena ɖe woɣlae ɖe wo, esi wole edim nenema, bena dziƒowo li tso blema ke, eye anyigba hã li hedo tso tsi me, eye wòto tsi me le Mawu ƒe nya nu;

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: nusiawo na tsiɖɔɖɔ yɔ xexe kema me, eye wotsrɔ̃.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke wotsɔ nya ma ke dzra fifi dziƒo kple anyigba la ɖo, eye woda wo ɖi na dzo, vaseɖe ame mavɔ̃mawuwo ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple gbegblẽ ƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Menye ɖe Aƒetɔ la le wɔwɔm blewu le eƒe ŋugbedodowo dziwɔwɔ me, abe alesi amea ɖewo bunɛ blewuwɔwɔ la ene o; hafi egba dzi ɖi blewu na mi, esi melɔ̃ bena, amea ɖeke natsrɔ̃ o, ke boŋ bena amewo katã natrɔ va dzimetɔtrɔ gbɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkeke le vava ge abe fiafitɔ ene, le esime dziƒowo ava yi kple gbeɖeɖe; ke gɔmedzenuwo labi, eye woalólo le dzo me, eye anyigba kple eme dɔwɔwɔwo lafiã keŋ. Alesi kristotɔwo nadzra wo ɖokui ɖo nu Kristo ƒe vava evelia.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi woalólo nusiawo katã la, ameka ƒomeviwo wòle na mi be, mianye le anyinɔnɔ kɔkɔe kple mawusosroɖa me,

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: eye mialala, eye miadi Mawu ƒe ŋkeke la ƒe vava vevie, le esime woalólo dziƒo le dzo me, eye gɔmedzenuwo hã lalólo le dzoxɔxɔ gã me mahã?

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Ke miele dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye, siwo me dzɔdzɔenyenye anɔ la, lalam le eƒe ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Eyata, lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi miele nusiawo lalam ŋutilã, mido vevie, bena woakpɔ mi le ŋutifafa me ɖimaƒomaƒo kple mokaka manɔŋui le eƒe ŋku me,

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: eye mibu mía Aƒetɔ ƒe dzigbɔgbɔ blewu la bena, enye mia xɔxɔ, abe alesi mía nɔvi lɔlɔ̃tɔ Paulo hã ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi le eƒe nunya, si wonae la nu ene,

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: abe alesi wòƒo nu le nusiawo ŋuti le eƒe agbalẽwo katã me la ene, esiwo me nyaa ɖewo ƒe gɔmesese nye ɖo la le, nya, siwo ame masrɔ̃nuwo kple ame malikewo trɔna, abe alesi wowɔa ŋɔŋlɔ bubuawo hã hena woa ŋutɔwo ƒe gbegblẽ la ene. Nuwunya.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mi lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi mienya nusiawo ɖi ŋuti la, mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie, bene ame gblẽkuwo ƒe beble nagahe mi ayii o, eye mìagadze anyi atso mia ŋutɔwo miaƒe kelili la me o.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ mitsi le mia Aƒetɔ kple xɔla Yesu Kristo ƒe amenuveve kple sidzedze la me. Eya tɔ lanye ŋutikɔkɔe la tso azɔ yiɖase mavɔmavɔ ƒe ŋkeke la dzi! Amen.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Nusi li tso gɔmedzedzea me, nusi miese, nusi míekpɔ kple míaƒe ŋkuwo, nusi míekpɔ kɔte, eye míeƒo asii kpɔ, le agbenya la ŋuti —

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: elabena agbe la da, eye míekpɔe, eye míeɖia ɖase le eŋuti, eye míeɖea gbe ƒã agbe mava, si le Fofoa gbɔ, eye wòɖe eɖokui ɖe go fia mí la fia mi —

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: nusi miekpɔ, eye miese la, mieɖea gbe ƒãe na miawo hã, bene miawo hã miado ƒome kpakpli mí, eye míaƒe ƒomedodo la li kple Fofo la kpakple Via Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Eye míeŋlɔ nusiawo ɖo ɖe mi, bene miaƒe dzidzo nayɔ fũ.

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Eye gbedasi, si miese tso egbɔ, eye míeɖea gbe ƒã na mi la, enye esi bena, Mawu enye kekeli, eye vivitía ɖeke mele eme o.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Ne míegblɔ bena, míedo ƒome kpakplim eye gake miegale viviti me zɔm la, ekema aʋatso kam míele, eye menye nyateƒe dzi wɔm míele o;

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: ke ne míele kekeli me zɔm, abe alesi eya ŋutɔ le kekeli me ene la, ekema míedo ƒome kple mía nɔewo, eye Via Yesu Kristo ƒe ʋu la klɔa nuvɔ̃ katã ɖa le mía ŋuti.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ne miegblɔ bena, nuvɔ̃ mele mia ŋu o la, ekema mía ŋutɔ mía ɖokui blem míele, eye nyateƒe mele mía me o.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Ne mieʋu miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me la, ekema nuteƒewɔla kple dzɔdzɔetɔ wònye, bene woatso míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake mí, eye wòaklɔ madzɔmadzɔnyenye katã ɖa le mia ŋuti.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ne míegblɔ bena, míewɔa nuvɔ̃ o la, ekema míeɖo eyama aʋatsokalae, eye eƒe nya la mele mia me o.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, meŋlɔ nusiawo ɖo ɖe mi, bene miagawɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Eye ne amea ɖe wɔ nuvɔ̃ la, nyaxɔɖakɔla le mia si le Fofoa gbɔ, eyae nye Yesu Kristo, dzɔdzɔetɔ la.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Eye eya kee nye avuléle le miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋuti; ke menye le mía to ŋuti ɖeɖeko o, ke boŋ le xexe blibo la katã hã tɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Ne mielé eƒe seawo me ɖe asi la, eya míatsɔ adze sii bena, míenyae.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Amesi ke gblɔ bena, yenyae, eye gake melé eƒe seawo me ɖe asi o la, aʋatsokala wònye, eye nyateƒe mele eme o.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Amesi ke lé eƒe nya la me ɖe asi la, eya me Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ zu blibo le vavã. Esia míatsɔ adze sii bena, miele eyama me.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Amesi ke gblɔ bena, yenɔa eme la, ele nɛ be, wòazɔ abe alesi eya ŋutɔ hã zɔe ene. Yesu ƒe se vevitɔ ɖeka nye nɔvilɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, menye se yeye meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi o, ke boŋ se xoxo, si le mia si tso gɔmedzedzea me la koe: Se xoxoa enye nya, si miese la.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Se yeye magaŋlɔ aɖo ɖe mi, esi nye nyateƒe le eya me kple miawo hã mia me; elabena viviti le dzodzom, eye kekeli vavã le keklẽm xoxo.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Amesi ke gblɔ bena, yele kekelia me, eye wòléa fu nɔvia la, egale viviti me kpakple egbe.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Amesi ke lɔ̃a nɔvia la, eya naa kekeli la me, eye nuɖianua ɖeke mele eme o.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Ke amesi ke léa fu nɔvia la, eya le viviti me, eye wòzɔa viviti me, eye menya afisi yim wòle o; elabena viviti la gbã eƒe ŋkuwo. Misi le xexeame nu.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Viwo, mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi; elabena wotsɔ nuvɔ̃wo ke mi le eƒe ŋkɔ ta.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Fofowo, mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi; elabena mienya amesi li tso gɔmedzedzea me. Ɖeka kpuiwo, mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi elabena mieɖu vɔ̃ɖitɔ la dzi. Ɖeviwo, meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi; elabena mienya Fofo la.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Fofowo, meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi; elabena mienya amesi li tso gɔmedzedzea me, Ɖekakpuiwo, meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi; elabena míesesẽ, eye Mawu ƒe nya la naa mia me, eye mieɖu vɔ̃ɖitɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Migalɔ̃ xexeame kple nusiwo le eme o. Ne amea ɖe lɔ̃ xexeame la, Fofoa ƒe lɔlɔ̃ mele eme o.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Elabena nusianu, si le xexeame: ŋutilã ƒe nudzodzro kple ŋkuwo ƒe ŋubiabiã kple agbe ƒe adegbe ƒuƒlu ƒoƒo la, metso Fofo la gbɔ o, ke boŋ xexeame wotso.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Eye xexeame va yina kple eƒe nudzodzrowo; ke amesi wɔa Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, noa anyi yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me. Mimã ɖa tso Kristo ƒe futɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Viwo, ɣeyiɣi mamletɔe, eye abe alesi miese be, Kristo ƒe futɔ la gbɔna ene la, nenema ke Kristo ƒe futɔ geɖewo tsi tre azɔ: eya me míedze sii le bena, ɣeyiɣi mamletɔ lae.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Mia dome wodo tso; gake womenye mía dometɔwo o; elabena ɖe wònye mía dometɔwo wonye la, anye ne woanɔ mía gbɔ ɖaa; ke ɖe wodo, bene woaɖe wo afia bena, menye wo katãe nye mía dometɔwo o.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Eye kɔkɔetɔ la si ami na mi, eye mienya nuwo katã.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Nyemeŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi, abe ɖe mienya nyateƒe la ene o, ke boŋ le esi mienyae, eye le esi aʋatsokakaa ɖeke metsoa nyateƒe me o la guti.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Amekae nye aʋatsokala, ne menye amesi sẽ nu bena, Yesu menye Kristo o lae oa? Amesi ke gbe nu le Fofo la kple Vi la gbɔ la, eyae nye Kristo ƒe futɔ la.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si sẽ nu le Vi la ŋuti la, eya ke sie Fofo la hã mele o: amesi ke ʋua Vi la me la, eya ke sie Fofo la hã le.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Miawo la mina nusi miese tso gɔmedzedzea me la, nanɔ mia me. Ne nusi miese tso gɔmedzedzea me la, nɔ mia me la, ekema miawo hã mianɔ Vi la kple Fofo la me.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Eye ŋugbedodo, si eya ŋutɔ ɖo na mí la, eya nye agbe mavɔ la.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Nya siawo meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi le amesiwo le mia blem la ŋuti.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Eye miawo la, amisisiname, si miexɔ le egbɔ la, nɔa mia me, eye mehiã mi be, amea ɖeke nafia nu mi o, ke boŋ abe alesi amisisi ma ke fia nu mi le nuwo katã ŋuti ene la, nenema ke hã wònye nyateƒe, eye menye aʋatso o; eye abe alesi wofia mi ene la, minɔ eme nenema ke. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ bena Kristo me nɔnɔ.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ, vinyewo, mina eya me, bena ne eva do la, ne dzi naɖo mia ƒo, eye ŋu nagakpe mí le eƒe ŋku me le eƒe vava la me o.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Ne mienyae bena, dzɔdzɔetɔ wònye la, ekema midze sii be, amesiame, si le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔm la, egbɔ wodzi eya hã tso.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ lɔlɔ̃ gã, si ƒomevi Fofo la tso ke mi la ɖa, bena woayɔ mí be mawuviwo! Eyata xexeame medze si mi o; elabena medze si eyama hã o.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, azɔ la míenye mawuviwo, eye nusi ke míava trɔ zu la, meɖo haɖe o; ke mienyae bena, ne eva do la, míaɖi eyama: elabena míakpɔe alesi wòle.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Eye amesiame, si tsɔ eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ sia ɖo eyama dzi la, eya kɔ eɖokui ŋuti, abe alesi eya hã ŋuti kɔ ene.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si wɔa nuvɔ̃ la, edaa se hã dzi, eye nuvɔ̃ enye sedzimawɔmawɔ.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Eye mienyae bena, eyama ɖe eɖokui fia, bene yeatsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ayii, eye nuvɔ̃a ɖeke mele eya me o.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si nɔa eya me la, mewɔa nuvɔ̃ o; amesiame, si wɔa nuvɔ̃ la, mekpɔ eyama o, eye medze si eyama hã o.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: Viwo, migana amea ɖeke naflu mi o: Amesi ke le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔm la, ame dzɔdzɔe wònye, abe alesi eya hã nye dzɔdzɔetɔ la ene.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Amesi ke le nuvɔ̃ wɔm la, eya tso Abosam me; elabena Abosam wɔa nuvɔ̃ tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke. Esia ŋuti Mawuvi la ɖe eɖokui fia, bene yeagblẽ Abosam ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si wodzi tso Mawu me la, mewɔa nuvɔ̃ o; elabena Mawu ƒe agbe nɔa eme, eye metea ŋu wɔa nuvɔ̃ o; elabena Mawu me wodzii tso.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Esia me mawuviwo kple abosamviwo dze ƒã le. Amesiame, si mewɔa nu dzɔdzɔe o, kple amesi ke melɔ̃a nɔvia o la, metso Mawu me o.

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Elabena esiae nye gbedasi, si miese tso gɔmedzedzea me la, bene mialɔ̃ mía nɔewo;

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: menye abe Kain, si tso vɔ̃ɖitɔ la me, eye wòwu nɔvia la ene o. Eye nukaŋuti wòwui ɖo? Elabena eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo vɔ̃ɖi, eye nɔvia tɔwo le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne xexemetɔwo léa fu mi la, miaƒe mo megawɔ yaa o.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Míawo la míenyae be, mieto ku me heyi ɖe agbe lãme; elabena míelɔ̃a nɔviwo. Amesi ke melɔ̃a nɔvia o la, etsia ku me.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si léa fu nɔvia la, amewula wònye, eye mienya bena, amewula sia amewula mekpɔa agbe mavɔ wònɔa eme o.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Esia me míedze si lɔlɔ̃a le bena, eyama tsɔ eƒe agbe ɖo anyi ɖe mía ta; eye ele na míawo hã bena, miatsɔ míaƒe agbe aɖo anyi ɖe mía nɔviwo ta.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Amesi ke xexemenuwo le esi, eye wòkpɔ nɔvia hiã tui, eye wosẽ dzime ɖee heku ŋɔe la, ekema aleke Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la nɔa emee mahã?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Viwo, migana miatsɔ nya kple aɖe alɔ̃ amee o, ke boŋ miatsɔ nuwɔwɔ kple nyateƒe alɔ̃ amee.

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Eye esia me míadze sii le bena, mietso nyateƒe la me, eye miana kakaɖedzi míaƒe dziwo le eƒe ŋku me;

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: elabena ne míaƒe dzi bu fɔ mí hẽ la, Mawu enye gã wu míaƒe dzi, eye wònya nuwo katã.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, ne míaƒe dzi mebu fɔ mí o la, ekema dzideƒo le mía si le Mawu ƒe ŋku me,

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: eye nusianu, si míebiae la, míaxɔe atso esi me; elabena míeléa eƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye miewɔa nusiwo dzea eŋu.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Eye esiae nye se la bena, miaxɔ Via Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkɔ dzi ase, eye míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo, abe alesi wòde se na mí ene.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Eye amesi léa eƒe seawo me ɖe asi la, enɔa eme, eye eya hã nɔa eme. Eye esia me miedze sii le be, enɔa mía me, le Gbɔgbɔ, si wòna mi la ta.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migaxɔ gbɔgbɔ sia gbɔgbɔ dzi se o, ke mido gbɔgbɔawo kpɔ, nenye ɖe wotso Mawu gbɔ; eye gbɔgbɔ sia gblɔɖila geɖewo do go yi ɖe xexeame.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Esia me míedze si Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ le: Gbɔgbɔ sia gbɔgbɔ, si ʋua me bena, Yesu Kristo va le ŋutilã me la, etso Mawu gbɔ;

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: eye gbɔgbɔ sia gbɔgbɔ, si meʋua Yesu me o la, metso Mawu gbɔ o; eye esia nye Kristo ƒe futɔ la ƒe gbɔgbɔ, si ŋkɔ miese bena, egbɔna, eye azɔ la ele xexeame xoxo.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Viwo, miawo la Mawu me mietso, eye mieɖu wo dzi; elabena amesi le mia me la, etri akɔ wu amesi le xexeame.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Woawo la xexeame wotso, eyata woƒoa xexeame ƒe nu, eye xexeame ɖoa to wo.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Míawo la Mawu me mietso, eye amesi dze si Mawu la, ɖoa to mi; amesi metso Mawu me o la, meɖoa to mi o. Esia me míedze si nyateƒegbɔgbɔ kple aʋatsogbɔgbɔ le.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mina mialɔ̃ mía nɔewo; elabena lɔlɔ̃ la tso Mawu me, eye amesiame, si lɔ̃a ame la, Mawu gbɔ wodzii tso, eye wòdze si Mawu.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Amesi ke melɔ̃a ame o la, medze si Mawu o; elabena Mawu enye lɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Esia me woɖe Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la ɖe go fia le le mía me bena, Mawu dɔ eƒe Tenuvi ɖo ɖe xexeame, bena míanɔ agbe to eyama me.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Esia me lɔlɔ̃ la le: Menye bena míawo mielɔ̃ Mawu o, ke boŋ bena eya lɔ̃ mí, eye wòdɔ Via ɖo ɖa, bena wòanye avuléle le mía nuvɔ̃wo ta.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi Mawu lɔ̃ mí ale la, ele na míawo hã be, mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Amea ɖeke mekpɔ Mawu ɣeaɖekeɣi kpɔ o; ne mielɔ̃ mía nɔewo la, ekema Mawu noa mía me, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ la zua blibo le mia me.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Esia me míedze sii le bena, míenɔa eyama me, eye eya hã nɔa mía me; elabena etsɔ eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe ɖe na mi.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Eye míawo miekpɔe, eye míeɖia ɖase bena, Fofo la do Via ɖo ɖa, be wòanye xexeame xɔla.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Amesi ke ʋua me bena, Yesu ye nye Mawu Vi la, Mawu nɔa eme, eye eya hẽ nɔa Mawu me.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Eye míawo miedze si lɔlɔ̃, si Mawu tsɔ lɔ̃a mí, eye míexɔ edzi se. Mawue nye lɔlɔ̃, eye amesi nɔa lɔlɔ̃ la me la, eya nɔa Mawu me, eye Mawu hã nɔa eya me.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Esia me lɔlɔ̃ la zu blibo le mía gbɔ le, bena dzideƒo nanɔ mía si le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe; elabena alesi eyama le la, nenema ke míawo hã míele le xexe sia me.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃a ɖeke mele lɔlɔ̃ me o, ke boŋ lɔlɔ̃ blibo nyãa vɔvɔ̃ doa goe: elabena fetu vɔ̃ le vɔvɔ̃ me: ke amesi le vɔvɔ̃m la, mezua blibo le lɔlɔ̃ me o.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Minɛ míalɔ̃e, elabena etre mí lɔlɔ̃!

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe gblɔ be, yelɔ̃a Mawu, eye wòléa fu nɔvia la, aʋatsokala wònye; elabena amesi melɔ̃ nɔvia, si kpɔm wòle o la, aleke wòate ŋu alɔ̃ Mawu, si kpɔm mele o mahã?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Eye miexɔ se sia tso egbɔ bena, amesi ke lɔ̃a Mawu la, nelɔ̃ nɔvia hã.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si xɔse bena, Yesu ye nye Kristo la, Mawu me wodzii tso, eye amesiame, si lɔ̃a amesi dzii la, elɔ̃a amesi ke wodzi tso eyama me hã.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Ne míelɔ̃a Mawu, eye mieléa eƒe seawo me ɖe asi la, esia me míedze sii le bena, míelɔ̃a mawuviwo.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Elabena lɔlɔ̃ na Mawu enye si bena, míalé eƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye eƒe seawo mesesẽ o.

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: Elabena nusianu, si wodzi tso Mawu me la, ɖua xexeame dzi, eye dziɖuɖu, si ɖu xexeame dzi la, eyae nye míaƒe xɔse.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Amekae nye amesi ɖua xexeame dzi, ne menye amesi xɔnɛ sena bena, Yesu ye nye Mawuvi la o mahã? Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi.

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Esiae nye amesi va le tsi kple ʋu me: Yesu Kristo, menye tsi ɖeɖe me koe wòva le o, ke boŋ tsi kple ʋu mee wòva le. Eye Gbɔgbɔ la enye amesi ɖia ɖase: elabena Gbɔgbɔ la enye nyateƒe la.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Ne míexɔa amegbetɔwo ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la, ekema Mawu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la lolo wu; elabena Mawu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi enye esia bena, eɖi ɖase le Via ŋuti.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Amesi ke xɔa Mawu ƒe Vi la dzi sena la, eya kpɔa ɖaseɖiɖi sia le eɖokui me; amesi ke mexɔa Mawu dzi sena o la, eya do Mawu aʋatsokalae; elabena mexɔ ɖase, si Mawu ɖi le Via ŋuti la, dzi se o.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Eye ɖaseɖiɖi la enye si bena, Mawu na agbe mavɔ mí, eye agbe sia le Via me.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Amesi si Vi la le la, agbe le esi; eye amesi si Mawu ƒe Vi la mele o la, agbe mele esi o.

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Nusiawo meŋlɔ na mi amesiwo xɔa Mawuvi la ƒe ŋkɔa dzi sena la, bena miadze sii be, agbe mavɔ le mia si. Kukuɖeɖe tia Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Eye dzideƒo, si le mía si le egbɔ la, enye esi bena, ne míebia nane le eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, aɖo to mí.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Eye ne míenyae bena, eɖoa to mí le nusianu, si ke míebia me la, ekema mienyae bena, miexɔa nusiwo míebia tso egbɔ la.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe kpɔ nɔvia wɔ nuvɔ̃, si mahe ame ayi ku me o la, neɖe kuku, eye wòana agbe amesiwo mewɔ nuvɔ̃, si ahe ame ayi ku me o. Nuvɔ̃a ɖe li, si ahe ame ayi ku me; nyemegblɔ be, woaɖe kuku ɖe eya ta o.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Madzɔmadzɔnyenye katã enye nuvɔ̃, eye nuvɔ̃a ɖe li, si mahe ame ayi ku mee o.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Míenyae bena, amesiame, si wodzi tso Mawu me la, mewɔa nuvɔ̃ o; ke amesi wodzi tso Mawu me la, eya léa eɖokui nyuie, eye vɔ̃ɖitɔ la mekaa asi eŋu o.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Míenyae bena, Mawu me míetso, eye xexeme blibo la katã le vɔ̃ɖi to la me.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Ke míenyae bena, Mawu ƒe Vi la va, eye wòna gɔmesese mí, bene mianya nyateƒetɔ la; eye míele nyateƒetɔ la me, le Via Yesu Kristo me. Esiae nye Mawu vavã la kple agbe mavɔ la.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Viwo, mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le trɔ̃wo ŋuti!

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Hamemegã xoxo la ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe aƒenɔ tiatia kple viawo, amesiwo melɔ̃na le nyateƒe me; eye menye nye ɖeɖekoe lɔ̃a wò o, ke boŋ amesiwo katã dze si nyateƒe la hãe,

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: le nyateƒe, si nɔa mía me, eye wòanɔ anyi kpli mí ɖaa la ŋuti:

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ kpakple ŋutifafa, si tso Mawu Fofo la kple Yesu Kristo, si nye Fofo la ƒe Vi la gbɔ la, anɔ anyi kpli mi le nyateƒe kple lɔlɔ̃ me! Nuxɔxlɔ̃ bena, woanɔ nyateƒe me.

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Dzi dzɔm ŋutɔ bena, mekpɔ viwòwo dometɔa ɖewo le nyateƒe la me zɔm, abe alesi miexɔ se tso Fofo la gbɔ ene.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Eye azɔ la mele kuku ɖem na wò, aƒenɔ — menye se yeye wònye meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe wò o, ke boŋ esi le mía si tso gɔmedzedzea me lae — bena míalɔ̃ mia nɔewo.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Eye esiae nye lɔlɔ̃ la bene, míazɔ ɖe eƒe seawo nu. Esia nye se la bena, miazɔ eme, abe alesi miese tso gɔmedzedzea me ene.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Elabena ameblela geɖe, siwo meʋua me bena, Yesu Kristo va le ŋutilã me o la, do go yi ɖe xexeame. Esiae nye ameblela kple Kristo ƒe futɔ la.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie, bene miagabu dɔ, siwo miewɔ la o, ke boŋ fetu blibo nasu mia si.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Amesiame, si da vo ɖe Kristo ƒe nufiafia ŋu, eye menɔa eme o la, Mawu mele esi o; eye amesi noa Kristo ƒe nufiafia me la, Fofo la kple Vi la le esi.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe va mia gbɔ, eye mehe nufiafia sia ɖe asi vɛ o la, migaxɔe ete aƒea me o, eye migado ɖoa ƒe hã ne o:

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: elabena amesi do ɖoaƒe nɛ la, ede ha kplii le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ vɔ̃wo me.

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Nya geɖe gali be, maŋlɔ aɖo ɖe mi; gake nyemelɔ̃ be, matsɔ agbalẽ kple agbalẽŋlɔtsi aŋlɔ wo o, ke boŋ mele mo kpɔm be, mava mia gbɔ, eye ne mieɖo go ŋku me kple ŋku me la, míaƒo nu, bene miaƒe dzidzɔ nazu blibo.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Nɔviwònyɔnu tiatia la ƒe viwo ɖuɖɔ wò ƒã.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Hamemegã xoxo la ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe Gayo lɔlɔ̃tɔ, si melɔ̃na le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔ, mele didim be, nuwo katã nadze dzi na wò nyuie, eye wò lãme nanɔ sesĩe, abe alesi wò luʋɔ le nyuie la ene.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Elabena dzi dzɔm ŋutɔ, esime nɔviwo va ɖi ɖase le wò nyateƒetɔnyenye ŋuti, alesi nèzɔna le nyateƒe mee.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Nyemekpɔ dzidzɔ gã wu esia be, mese bena, vinyewo zɔna le nyateƒe me o.

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔ, èwɔ nuteƒe le nusianu, si nèwɔ na nɔvi, siwo nye amedzrowo la me,

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: amesiwo va ɖi ɖase le wò lɔlɔ̃ ŋuti le hame la ƒe ŋku me, eye ne èɖo wo ɖa alesi dze Mawu ŋu la, ekema èwɔe nyuie.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Elabena eƒe ŋkɔ la ŋuti wodo go yi ɖo, eye womexɔa naneke le trɔ̃subɔlawo si o.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Eyata ele na mí be, miaxɔ nenem me siawo, bene míazu woƒe hadɔwɔlawo na nyateƒe la. Apostolo la xlɔ̃ nu Gayo bena, megadze kpɔɖeŋu vɔ̃ yome o.

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Meŋlɔ agbalẽ ɖo ɖe hame la; gake Diotrefo, si le didim be, yeaɖo ta ɖe wo nu la, mexɔ mi o.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Eyata ne meva la, maɖo ŋku eƒe dɔwɔwɔ, siwo wòwɔna kple nya vɔ̃, siwo wònɔa gbɔgblɔm ɖe mía ŋuti la dzi; eye nusiawo mesu me nɛ o: Eya ŋutɔ hã mexɔa nɔviawo o, eye wòxea ma na amesiwo lã be, yewoaxɔ wo, eye wòɖea wo le ha me.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔ, megasi nu vɔ̃ɖi o, ke srɔ̃ nu nyui boŋ. Amesi wɔa nu nyui la, Mawu gbɔ wòtso, eye amesi woa nuvɔ̃ la, mekpɔa Mawu o.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Demetrio kpɔa ɖaseɖiɖi nyui tso amewo katã kple nyateƒe la ŋutɔ hã gbɔ, eye miawo hã míele ɖase ɖim le eŋuti, eye ènyae bena, míaƒe ɖaseɖiɖi enye nyateƒe.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Nya geɖe gali be, maŋlɔ aɖo ɖe wò; gake nyemelɔ̃ be, matsɔ agbalẽŋlɔtsi kple agbalẽŋlɔti aŋlɔ wo aɖo ɖe wò o;

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: ke mele mɔ kpɔm bena, mava akpɔ wò ɖa kaba, eye ne mieɖo go ŋku me kple ŋku me la, míaƒo nu.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa nanɔ anyi kpli wò! Xɔlɔ̃wo ɖuɖɔ wò ƒã. Ɖuɖɔ xɔlɔ̃awo ɖekaɖeka nam ƒã!

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Yuda, Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔla kple Yakobo nɔvi la, ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe amesiwo woyɔ, eye wowɔ wo kɔkɔe le Mawu Fofo la me, eye wodzra wo ɖo le Yesu Kristo me la;

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple ŋutifafa kple lɔlɔ̃ nasɔ gbɔ ɖe dzi na mi! Le ameblela viawo ŋuti.

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi medo vevie ŋutɔ, bena maŋlɔ nya le mi katã miaƒe xɔxɔ la ŋuti aɖo ɖe mi la, ezu dzizizi nam be, maŋlɔe atsɔ axlɔ̃ nu mi, bene miaʋli xɔse, si wode asi na ame kɔkɔewo zi ɖeka ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu la ta.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Elabena amea ɖewo va tra ɖe eme dzaa, amesiwo woŋlɔ ɖi tso blema ke hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ sia: Ame mavɔ̃mawuwo, amesiwo trɔa mía Mawu ƒe amenuveve yina ɖe agbe baɖa nɔnɔ me, eye wogbe nu le mia dziɖula kple Aƒetɔ ɖeka, Yesu Kristo la gbɔ.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Ke mele didim bena, maɖo ŋku dzi na mi amesiwo nya nuwo katã xoxo zi ɖeka ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu bena, esime Aƒetɔ la ɖe dukɔ la tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, emegbe la etsrɔ̃ amesiwo mexɔ se o la.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla, siwo medzra woƒe amegãnyenye ɖo o, ke wogblẽ woa ŋutɔwo ƒe nɔƒe ɖi la, wotsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ mavɔwo bla wo hedzra wo ɖo ɖe viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me hena ŋkeke gã la ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Abe alesi wotsɔ Sodom kple Gomora kple du, siwo ƒo xlã wo, siwo wo ahasi akpa abe woawo ene, eye wodze ŋutilã bubu yome la, wo kpɔɖeŋu, esi wokpe dzo mavɔ ƒe fu la:

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Nenema ke drɔ̃ekula siawo hã ƒoa ɖi ŋutilã, eye woɖoa vlo aƒetɔnyenyewo, eye wogblɔa busunya ɖe ŋutikɔewo ŋuti.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Ke Mixael, mawudɔla gã la, esime wòle anuku tsyɔm hele nu ƒom kple Abosam le Mose ƒe kukua ŋuti la, medo dzi gblɔ busufɔbubu ɖe eŋuti o, ke boŋ egblɔ bena: Aƒetɔ la laka mo na wò!

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Ke ame mawo la wogblɔa busunya ɖe nusiwo womenya o la ŋuti; ke nusiwo gɔme wose tso dzɔdzɔme abe lã nyasã manɔsitɔwo ene la, wogblẽ wo ɖokui le nusiawo me.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Baba na wo! Elabena wodze Kain ƒe mo dzi yina, eye wohe wo ɖokui ɖe Bileam ƒe beblefetu la me, eye wotsrɔ̃ le Kora ƒe agudzedze la me.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye ɖiƒoƒo le miaƒe lɔlɔ̃nuɖuɖuwo me, esi woɖua nutsu nyia wo ɖokui le mia gbɔ vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee; alilikpo tsi manɔme, siwo ya ƒona yina gbɔna la, wonye; ati, siwo dzi kutsetse menɔa le nuŋeɣi o, siwo ku zi eve, eye woho wo,

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: ƒutsotsoe dzeagbo, siwo kplɔa woa ŋutɔwo ƒe ŋukpenanuwo va kɔna ɖe go, ɣletivi tramɔ, siwo wodzra ɖo hena viviti tsiɖitsiɖi yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me la, wonye.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Ke Henox hã, amesi nye adrelia tso Adam dzi la, gblɔ nya ɖi ɖe ame mawo ŋuti bena: „Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la kple eƒe ame kɔkɔe akpe nanewo gbɔna,

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: bene wòaɖrɔ ʋɔnu wo katã, eye woaka mo na wo dome amesiwo katã mevɔ̃a Mawu o la, le woƒe dɔwɔwɔ vlo, siwo katã wowɔ mawumavɔ̃mavɔ̃e kple nya sesẽ, siwo katã nuvɔ̃wɔla mavɔ̃mawuwo gblɔ ɖe eŋuti la ta.

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye liʋiliʋililawo, amesiwo ŋu naneke medzena o, evɔ wozɔna le woƒe nudzodzrowo nu hafi, woƒe nu gblɔa dadalawo, eye wokafua ame le eƒe ŋku me le viɖe ta.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ke, mi hiãtɔwo, miɖo ŋku nya, siwo mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe apostolowo gblɔ tsã la dzi,

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: alesi wogblɔ na mi bena: Le nuwuwu ɣeyiɣiawo me la fewuɖula, siwo zɔna le woa ŋutɔwo ƒe nudzodzro vlowo nu la le vava ge.

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye amesiwo wɔa mamãwo, dzɔdzɔmeme, siwo me gbɔgbɔ mele o. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ hena tenɔnɔ sesĩe le xɔse kple nufiafia dzadzɛ la me.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Ke, mi hiãtɔwo la, mitu mia ɖokui ɖe miaƒe xɔse kɔkɔe, si ƒo wo katã ta la dzi, eye mido gbe ɖa le Gbɔgbɔ kɔkɔe la me,

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: eye midzra mia ɖokui ɖo le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la me, anɔ lalam na mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ la bena agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Eye mikpɔ nublanui na amea ɖewo, amesiwo le ɖi kem,

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: miɖe ame bubua ɖewo, eye mihe wo do go tso dzo la me, mitsɔ vɔvɔ̃ kpɔ nublanui na amea ɖewo, eye milé fu awu, si ŋutilã ƒo ɖi la gɔ̃ hã. Nuwunya.

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖeka hɔ̃ ko kple mía xɔla, to Yesu Kristo, mía Aƒetɔ la dzi la, etɔ nanye kafukafu kple gãnyenye kple dziɖuɖu kple ŋusẽ azɔ kple ɖaasi tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen!

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ƒe nyaɖeɖefia, si Mawu tsɔ nɛ, be wòafia nusiwo lava ve me kaba la, eƒe dɔlawo la, enye esi; eye wòto eƒe mawudɔla, si wòdɔ ɖa la, dzi heɖe wo me fia eƒe dɔla Yohanes,

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: amesi ɖi ɖase le Mawu ƒe nya kple Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ŋuti, abe alesi wòkpɔ nuawo katãe ene.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Woayra amesi le nyagblɔɖi sia ƒe nyawo xlẽm kple amesiwo le wo sem, eye wole nusiwo woŋlɔ ɖe eme la, dzram ɖo; elabena ɣeyiɣi la tu aƒe.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Yohanes ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame adre, siwo le Asia la bena: Amenuveve kple ŋutifafa nana anyi kpli mi tso amesi li, eye wònɔ anyi, eye wòle vavagela gbɔ, eye tso gbɔgbɔ adre, siwo le eƒe fiazikpui ŋgɔ la gbɔ,

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: eye tso Yesu Kristo, amesi nye ɖaseɖila nyateƒetɔ kple ame kukuwo ƒe ŋgɔgbetɔ kple anyigba dzi fiawo ƒe dziɖula la gbɔ! Amesi lɔ̃a mí, eye wòtso eƒe ʋu klo míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa le mía ŋuti,

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: eye wòwɔ mí hawo kple nunɔlawo hena eƒe Mawu Fofo la, eya to lanye ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ tso mava me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna kple alilikpowo, eye ŋku sia ŋku lakpɔe, eye amesiwo ƒo mi ɖee hã, lakpɔe, eye anyigba dzi ƒomeawo katã lawu avi hoo le eŋuti! Ẽ, amen.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Nyee nye Alfa kple Omega, gɔmedzedze kple nuwuwu; ale Aƒetɔ Mawu, amesi li, eye wònɔ anyi, eye wòle vava ge, amesi nye ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, gblɔ esi! Amegbetɔvi la ɖe eɖokui fia.

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Nye Yohanes, mia nɔvi kple miaƒe hagomekpɔla le Yesu Kristo ƒe fukpekpe kple fiaɖuƒe kple dzidodo me la, menɔ ƒukpo, si woyɔna be Patmo la dzi le Mawu ƒe nya kple Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ta.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Menɔ gbɔgbɔ me le Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la azi, eye mese gbe gãa ɖe le ɖiɖim le megbenye, abe kpẽ ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene, gblɔ bena:

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Nusi nèkpɔ la, ŋlɔe ɖe agbalẽ me, eye natsɔe aɖo ɖe hame adre, siwo le Efeso kple Smirna kple Pergamo kple Tiatira kple Sardes kple Filadelfia kple Laodikea.

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Eye metrɔ be, makpɔ gbe, si ƒo nu kplim la. Eye esi metrɔ la, mekpɔ sikakaɖiti adre,

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: eye le sikakaɖiti adreawo titina la amea ɖe li, si ɖi amegbetɔvi, edo awu ʋlaya, eye wotsɔ sikalidziblanu bla akɔta.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Eye teƒe ta kple eƒe taɖa fu tititi abe alẽfu ɣi ene, eye abe sno ene, eye eƒe ŋkuwo le abe dzo ƒe aɖe ene,

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: eye eƒe afɔwo ɖi gadzẽ, si wode kpodzo me wòbiã hẽ, eye eƒe gbe le abe tsi sisi geɖewo ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Eye ɣletivi adre le eƒe nuɖusi me, eye yi ɖaɖi: nuevee do tso eƒe nu me, eye eƒe mo le keklẽm, abe alesi ɣe klẽna sesĩe ene. Ɣletivi kple akaɖiti adreawo.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Eye esi mekpɔe la, medze anyi ɖe eƒe afɔ nu abe ame kuku ene. Eye wòda eƒe nuɖusi ɖe dzinye gblɔ bena: Megavɔ̃ o, nyee nye gbãtɔ kple mlɔetɔ

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: kple amesi le agbe, meku, eye kpɔ ɖa, mele agbe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, eye ku kple tsiẽƒe safuiwo le asinye.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Azɔ ŋlɔ nusiwo nèkpɔ kple nusiwo li kpakple nusiwo le vava ge le nusiawo megbe la.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Ɣletivi adre, siwo nèkpɔ le nye nuɖusi me kple sikakaɖiti adre la ƒe nya ɣaɣla enye si: Ɣletivi adreawoe nye hame adreawo ƒe dɔlawo, eye akaɖiti adreawoe nye hame adreawo.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame, si le Efeso la, ƒe dɔla bena: Amesi lé ɣletivi adre ɖe eƒe nuɖusi, amesi le sikakaɖiti adreawo titina zɔm la, eyae gblɔ esiawo bena:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo kple wò agbagbadzedze kple wò dzidodo, eye bena mètea ŋu lɔ̃a ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nya o, eye nèɖo amesiwo gblɔna be, yewonye apostolowo, eye womenyee o la kpɔ, eye nèkpɔ be, aʋatsokalawo wonye,

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: eye nèɖo dzi, eye nèdze agbagba le nye ŋkɔa ŋuti, eye ɖeɖi metea ŋuwò o.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Gake la mekpɔ nusia le ŋutiwò bena, nègblẽ wò gbã lɔlɔ̃ la ɖi.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Eyata ɖo ŋku afisi nège tso la dzi, ne natrɔ le dzi me, eye nawɔ gbã dɔwɔwɔawo; ne menye nenem o la, mava gbɔwò kaba, eye maɖe wò akaɖiti la ɖa tso enɔƒe, ne mètrɔ le wò dzi me o.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Gake esia le asiwò bena, nèléa fu nikolaitɔwo ƒe nuwɔwɔ, siwo nye hã meléa fui la.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Amesi ke to li nɛ la, nese nusi Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔna hameawo bena: Amesi ke ɖu dzi la, mana agbeti, si le Mawu ƒe Paradiso me la, ƒe kutsetsee, ne wòaɖu. Agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hamedzikpɔla kple hame, si le Smirna.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Eye ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame, si le Smirna la, ƒe dɔla bena: Amesi nye gbãtɔ kple mlɔetɔ, amesi ku, eye wògbɔ agbe la, eyae gblɔ esiawo bena:

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo kple wò xaxa kpakple wò ahedada — ke kesinɔtɔ nenye hafi — kple amesiwo gblɔna be, Yudatɔwo yewonye, eye womenyee o, ke boŋ Satana ƒe ƒuƒoƒe wonye la ƒe busubɔbɔ.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Megavɔ̃ fu, siwo nava kpe la, ƒe ɖeke o. Kpɔ ɖa, Abosam latsɔ mia dome amea ɖewo ade gaxɔ me, bene woate mi akpɔ, eye míakpɔ xaxa ŋkeke ewo. Nanye nuteƒewɔla yiɖase ɖe ku me, eye mana agbefiakuku wò!

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Amesi ke to li nɛ la, nese nusi Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ na hameawo bena: Amesi ke ɖu dzi la, ku evelia mawɔ vɔ̃a ɖekee o. Agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hamedzikpɔla kple hame, si le Pergamo.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame, si le Pergamo la ƒe ɖɔla bena: Amesi yi ɖaɖɛ nuevee le esi la, eyae gblɔ esiawo bena:

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo kple afisi nenɔna, afisi Abosam ƒe zikpui le, eye nèlé nye ŋkɔ me ɖe asi sesĩe, eye mèsẽ nu le dzinye xɔxɔse ŋuti le ŋkeke, siwo me ke wowu Antipa, si nye nye ɖaseɖila nuteƒewɔla le mia dome, afisi Abosam nana la o.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Gake la mekpɔ nu via ɖewo le ŋutiwò; elabena amesiwo lé Bileam ƒe nufiafia me ɖe asi la, le gbɔwò le afima, amesi fia Balak bena, wòatsɔ nuɖianu aɖo Israel-viwo ŋku me, ne woaɖu nusiwo wosa vɔe na trɔ̃wo, eye woawɔ ahasi.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Nenema ke amesiwo lé nikolaitɔwo ƒe nufiafia me ɖe asi la, le gbɔwò.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Azɔ trɔ le wò dzi me: ne menye nenem o la, mava gbɔwò kaba, eye matsɔ nye nu me yi awɔ aʋa kpli wò.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Amesi ke to li nɛ la, nese nusi Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ na hameawo bena: Amesi ke ɖu dzi la, mana mana ɣaɣla la ƒe ɖee, eye mana kpe ɣie, eye le kpea dzi la woŋlɔ ŋkɔ yeye ɖi, si amea ɖeke menya o, negbe amesi xɔe la koe. Agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hamedzikpɔla kple hame, si le Tiatira.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Eye ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame, si le Tiatira la, ƒe ɖɔla bena: Mawuvi, amesi ƒe ŋkuwo le abe dzo ƒe aɖe ene, eye eƒe afɔwo le abe gadzẽ biabia ene la, eyae gblɔ esiawo bena:

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo kple wò lɔlɔ̃ kple wò xɔse kple wo subɔsubɔdɔ kpakple wò dzidodo, eye bena wò dɔwɔwɔ mlɔetɔwo wu gbãtɔwo.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Gake la mekpɔ nusia le ŋutiwò bena, neɖe mɔ na nyɔnu Isabel, si yɔ eɖokui bena nyagblɔɖila, eye wòfiã nu nye dɔlawo heble wo, bene woawɔ ahasi, eye woaɖu nusiwo wosa vɔ na trɔ̃wo.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Eye mena ɣeyiɣie, be wòatrɔ le eƒe dzi me, gake melɔ̃ be, yeatrɔ tso eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ me o.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔe aƒu aba dzi, eye amesiwo wɔ ahasi kpakplii la, ne wometrɔ tso woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me o la, matsɔ wo aƒu xaxa gãa ɖe me?

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: eye matsɔ dɔvɔ̃ awu viawo. Eye hameawo kalẽ woanyae bena, nyee nye amesi dzroa ayikuwo kple dziwo me kpɔna, eye maɖo teƒe na mia dome amesiame le eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Ke mele gbɔgblɔm na mi ame mamletɔwo le Tiatira, amesiwo katã melé nufiafia sia me ɖe asi o, amesiwo menya Satana ƒe globoƒewo o la: Nyemele agba bubua ɖeke da ge ɖe mia dzi o;

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: negbe nusi le mia si la, milé eme ɖe asi sesĩe, vaseɖe esime mava.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Eye amesi ke ɖu dzi, eye wòlé nye dɔwɔwɔwo me ɖe asi yiɖase ɖe nuwuwu la, mana ŋusẽe ɖe trɔ̃subɔlawo dzi,

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Amesi ke to li nɛ la, nese nusi Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ na hameawo.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: Eye ŋlo ɖo ɖe hame, si le Sardes la, ƒe dɔla bena: Amesi si Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adreawo kple ɣletivi adreawo le la, eyae gblɔ esiawo bena: Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo bena, ŋkɔ le asiwò be, èle agbe, eye nèku.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Nɔ ŋudzɔ, eye nado ŋusẽ nusiwo susɔ le kuku ge la; elabena nyemekpɔ wò dɔwɔwɔwo le blibo le nye Mawu ƒe ŋku me o.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Eyata ɖo ŋku nusi nèxɔ, eye nèse la dzi, eye nèlé eme ɖe asi, eye natrɔ le wò dzi me. Ne mènɔ ŋudzɔ azɔ o la, ekema mava ado ɖe dziwò abe fiafitɔ ene, eye manya gaƒoƒo, si dzi mava ado ɖe dziwò o.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Gake la èkpɔ ŋkɔ ʋeea ɖewo le Sardes, esiwo meƒo ɖi woƒe awuwo o, eye woazɔ kpakplim le awu ɣiwo me; elabena wodze.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Amesi ke ɖu dzi la, woado awu ɣiwo na eyama, eye nyemele eƒe ŋkɔ tutu ge da le agbegbalẽa me o, eye maʋu eƒe ŋkɔ la me le Fofonye kple eƒe dɔlawo ŋku me.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: Amesi ke to li nɛ la, nese nusi Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ na hameawo. Agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hamedzikpɔla kple hame, si le Filadelfia.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Eye ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame, si le Filadelfia la, ƒe dɔla bena: Amesi enye kɔkɔetɔ kple nyateƒea, amesi si Dawid ƒe safui le, amesi ʋuna amea ɖeke metuna o, eye wòtuna amea ɖeke meʋuna o la, eyae gblɔ esiawo bena:

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo! Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ ʋɔtru, si le nuvo la, ɖo ŋkuwò me, eye amea ɖeke mate ŋu atui o; elabena ŋusẽ ʋeea ɖe koe le asiwò, eye nèlé nye nya la me ɖe asi, eye megbe nu le nye ŋkɔ gbɔ o?

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, maɖe Satana ƒe ƒuƒoƒemetɔa ɖewo, amesiwo gblɔna bena, Yudatɔwo yewonye, eye womenyee o, ke boŋ aʋatso wokana la; kpɔ ɖa, mawɔ wo be, woava ade ta agu ɖe wò afɔ nu, eye woadze sii be, nye la melɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Le esi nèlé nye dzidonya me ɖe asi ŋuti la, eyata nye hã malé wò ɖe asi le tetekpɔ ƒe gaƒoƒo, si le xexeame katã dzi va ge, be woate amesiwo nɔa anyigba dzi akpɔ la me.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Kpɔ da, megbɔna kaba; lé nusi le asiwò me la, ɖe asi sesĩe, bena amea ɖeke nagaxɔ wò fiakuku la o.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Amesi ke ɖu dzi la, mawɔe wòanye sɔti le nye mawukɔa me, eye magaɖo go akpɔ o, eye maŋlɔ nye Mawu ŋkɔ kple nye Mawu ƒe ɖu, si nye Yerusalem yeye, si ɖi tso dziƒo tso nye Mawu gbɔ va la, ƒe ŋkɔ kple nye ŋkɔ yeye la ɖe eyama ŋu.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Amesi ke to li nɛ la, nese nusi Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ na hameawo. Agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hamedzikpɔla kple hame si le Laodikea.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Eye ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe hame, si le Laodikea la, ƒe dɔla bena: Amesi nye Amen, ɖaseɖila nuteƒewɔla kple nyateƒetɔ, amesi nye Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe gɔmedzedze la, gblɔ esiawo bena:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
