translation_verse: Menya wò dɔwɔwɔwo bena, mefa hã o, mèdze dzo hã o. Ɖe medi be, ɖewo nafa alo nadze dzo.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Ke le esi nèle yɔyrɔe, mèdze dzo o, eye mèfa hã o ŋuti la, matu wò aƒu gbe atso nye nu me.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Elabena, ègblɔna be, yenye kesinɔtɔ, eye kesinɔnuwo le ye si, eye naneke mehiãa ye o, eye mènyae be, hiãtɔ kple nublanuitɔ kple ketɔ kple ŋkuagbãtɔ kpakple amamanɔla nènye o.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Mele aɖaŋu ɖom na wòbe, naƒle sika, si wòlólo le dzo me la, le asinye, be nazu kesinɔtɔ, kple avɔ ɣi, be natsyɔ, ne wò ŋukpeƒe nagadze o, kpakple ŋkutike, be nasi ɖe wò ŋkuwo, be nakpɔ nu.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Nye la, ame geɖe alesi nu melɔ̃na la, mekaa ŋku me na, eye mehea to na; eyata ɖo vevie, be natrɔ le wò dzi me?

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mele tsitre le ʋɔa nu le eƒom; ne amea ɖe se nye gbe, eye woʋu ʋɔa la, míage ɖe eme le egbɔ, eye maɖu nu kplii, eye eya hã aɖu nu kplim.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Amesi ke ɖu dzi la, mana woabɔbɔ nɔ anyi kplim ɖe nye fiazikpui la dzi, abe alesi nye hã meɖu dzi, eye mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi kple Fofonye ɖe eƒe fiazikpui dzii la ene.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Amesi ke to li nɛ la, nèse nusi Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ na hameawo.

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Nusia wo megbe la mekpɔ, eye kpɔ ɖa, ʋɔtrua ɖe le ʋuʋu le dziƒo, eye gbe gbãtɔ, si mese la, ƒo nu kplim abe kpẽ ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene, gblɔ bena; Va dziƒo afii, eye mafia nusiwo lava ve me le esiawo megbe la wò.

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Eye enumake menɔ gbɔgbɔ la me, eye kpɔ ɖa, wodo fiazikpui anyi de dziƒo, eye amea ɖe bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi,

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: eye amesi bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la ŋuti le abe yaspis-kpe kple sardis-kpe ene, eye anyieʋɔ, si ŋuti le abe smaragd-kpe ene la, ƒo xlã fiazikpui la.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Eye zikpui blave vɔ ene ƒo xlã fiazikpui la, eye amegã xoxo blave vɔ ene bɔbɔ nɔ zikpuiwo dzi, eye wodo awu ʋlaya ɣiwo, eye sikafiakukuwo le wo ta.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Eye dzikedzowo kple dziɖegbewo kple gbeɖiɖiwo do tso fiazikpui la me. Eye dzokakati adre le bibim le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ, woawoe nye Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adreawo;

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: eye atsiaƒu, si me ka abe kristalo lãlɛ ene la, le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ, eye nu gbagbe ene, siwo ŋgɔgbe kple megbe yɔ fũ kple ŋkuwo la, le fiazikpui la titina, eye woƒo xlã fiazikpui la hã.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Eye nu gbagbe gbãtɔ le abe dzata ene, eye nu gbagbe evelia le abe nyitsu ene, eye nu gbagbe etɔ̃lia ƒe mo le abe ame ƒe mo ene, eye nu gbagbe enelia le abe hɔ̃, si le dzodzom ene.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Eye aʋala ade li na nu gbagbe eneawo dome ɖesiaɖe, eye ŋkuwo yɔ wo ŋuti kple wo me fũ, eye womekpɔ dzudzɔ zã kple keli o hele gbɔgblɔm bena: Kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, Mawu ŋusẽkatãtɔ, amesi nɔ anyi, eye woli, eye wòle vava ge la!

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Eye ne nu gbagbeawo le ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu kple akpedada tsɔm na amesi bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi, amesi le agbe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me la,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ kple mía Mawu, wòe dze be, naxɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu kple ŋusẽ; elabena wòe wɔ nuwo katã, eye wò lɔlɔ̃nu ta woli, eye wowɔ wo ɖo.

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ nu ɖe eme kple ekɔgo katã, eye wotre enu kple nutrenu adre la, le amesi bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui dzi la, ƒe nuɖusi me.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla sesẽa ɖe le gbe ƒã ɖem kple gbe gã bena: Amekae dze be, wòaʋu agbalẽ la, eye wòaɖe eƒe nutrenuawo ɖa?

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Eye amea ɖeke menɔ dziƒo alo anyigba dzi alo anyigba te, si te ŋu ʋu agbalẽ la alo te ŋu kpɔ eme hã o.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Eye mefa avi ʋuu, elabena womekpɔ amea ɖeke, si dze be, wòaʋu agbalẽ la alo wòakpɔ eme hã o.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Tete amegã xoxoawo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ nam bena: Megafa avi o; kpɔ ɖa, dzata, si tso Yuda ƒe to la me, si nye Dawid ƒe ke la, eɖu dzi, be wòaʋu agbalẽ la, eye wòaɖe eƒe nutrenu adreawo ɖa.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Eye le fiazikpui la kple nu gbagbe eneawo titina kple amegã xoxoawo titina la mekpɔ alẽvia ɖe le tsitre ɖi, abe ɖe wowui ene; eye dzo adre kple ŋku adre, siwo nye Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adre, siwo wodɔ ɖo ɖe anyigba katã dzi la, li ne.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Eye wòva, eye wòxɔ agbalẽ la le amesi bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui dzi la ƒe nuɖusi me.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Eye wodzi ha yeye le gbɔgblɔm bena: Wòe wòdze be, naxɔ agbalẽ la, eye naɖe eƒe nutrenuawo ɖa; elabena wowu wò, eye nètsɔ wò ʋu ƒle mí tso to sia to kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kple du sia du kple dukɔ sia dukɔ me hena Mawu,

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: eye nèwɔ wo fiawo kple nunɔlawo na míaƒe Mawu, eye woaɖu fia le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ, eye mese mawudɔla geɖe, siwo ƒo xlã fiazikpui la kple nu gbagbeawo kple amegã xoxoawo ƒe gbeɖiɖi, eye woƒe xexlẽme nu anɔ akpe ewo teƒe akpe ewo kple akpeakpewo,

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: wole gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gã bena: Alẽvi, si wowu la, eyae dze be, wòaxɔ ŋutete kple kesinɔnyenye kple nunya kple ŋusẽ kple bubu kple ŋutikɔkɔe kpakple kafukafu!

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Eye nuwɔwɔ sia nuwɔwɔ, siwo le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi kple anyigba te kple atsiaƒu me kpakple nusiwo katã le wo me la, mese wole gbɔgblɔm bena: Amesi bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui dzi kple alẽvi la, etoe lanye kafukafu kple bubu kple ŋutikɔkɔe kpakple ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me!

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Eye nu gbagbe eneawo gblɔ be: Amen! Eye amegã xoxo blave vɔ eneawo tsyo mo anyi hedo gbe ɖa.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Eye esime alẽvi la ɖe nutrenuawo ƒe ɖeka ɖa la, mekpe, eye mese nu gbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖeka le gbɔgblɔm abe dziɖegbe ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene bena: Va!

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Eye kpo ɖa, mekpɔ sɔ ɣia ɖe, eye amesi ɖoe la, lé dati ɖe asi, eye wotsɔ fiakuku nɛ, eye wòdo go yi ɖale dzi ɖum, bene yeakpɔ dziɖuɖu.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Eye esime wòɖe nutrenu evelia ɖa la, mese nu gbagbe evelia le gbɔgblɔm bena: Va!

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Eye so bubua ɖe, si le dzie la, do go, eye amesi doe la, wona ŋusẽe, be wòaɖe ŋutifafa ɖa le anyigba dzi, bena woawu wo nɔewo, eye wotso yi gã ɖe asi nɛ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Eye esime wòɖe nutrenu etɔ̃lia ɖa la, mese nu gbagbe etɔ̃lia le gbɔgblɔm bena: Va! Eye kpo ɖa, mekpɔ sɔ yibɔa ɖe, eye amesi ɖoe la, lé nudanu ɖe asi.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Eye mese gbea ɖe, abe nu gbagbe eneawo dome wòɖi le ene hele gbɔgblɔm bena: Lu dzidzenu ɖeka naxa denario ɖeka, eye ƒo dzidzenu etɔ̃ naxɔ denario ɖeka, eye megawɔ vɔ̃a ɖeke ami kple wein o.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Eye esime wòɖe nutrenu enelia ɖa la, mese nu gbagbe enelia ƒe gbe wòle gbɔgblɔm bena: Va!

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Eye kpo ɖa, mekpɔ sɔ hẽa ɖe, eye amesi ɖoe la, ƒe ŋkɔe nye Ku, eye tsiẽƒe le eyome. Eye wona ŋusẽ wo ɖe anyigba ƒe akpa enelia dzi, be woatsɔ yi kple dɔwuame kple ku kpakple anyigba dzi lãwo awu amewoe.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Eye esime wòɖe nutrenu atɔ̃lia ɖa la, mekpɔ amesiwo wowu le Mawu ƒe nya kple ɖaseɖiɖi, si wolé ɖe asi ŋuti la, ƒe luʋɔwo le vɔsamlekpui la te;

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: eye wodo ɣli kple gbe gã le gbɔgblɔm bena: Aƒetɔ kɔkɔetɔ kple nyateƒetɔ, ŋkeke nenie nye si mèdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu, eye mèbia hlɔ̃ ɖe míaƒe ʋu ta le amesiwo le anyigba dzi la si o mahã?

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Eye wona lawu ʋlaya ɣi wo dome amesiame, eye wogblɔ na wo bena, woadzudzɔ ɣeyiɣi kpuia ɖe, yiɖase esime woƒe hadɔlawo kple wo nuvi, siwo wole wuwu ge abe woawo ke ene la, hã ƒe xexlẽme nu nade.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Eye esime wòɖe nutrenu adelia ɖa la, mekpɔ, eye anyigbaʋuʋu gãa ɖe va dzo, eye ɣe tro zu yibɔ abe lãfukotoku ene, eye ɣleti tra zu abe ʋu ene.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Eye dziƒoɣletiviwo ge ɖe anyigba abe alesi gboti dudua eƒe tsetse gbogbowo ɖe anyigba, ne ya sesẽa ɖe le ʋuʋum la ene.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ dziƒo ɖa abe agbalẽ ŋɔŋlɔ ene, eye woɖe to sia to kple ƒukpo sia ƒukpo ɖa le wo teƒe.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Eye anyigba dzi fiawo kple amegãwo kple aʋafia gãwo kple kesinɔtɔwo kple ŋusẽtɔwo kple kluviwo katã kpakple ablɔɖeviwo katã ɣla wo ɖokui ɖe dowo kple towo ƒe agawo me;

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ na towo kple agawo bena: Mimu dze mia dzi, eye miɣla mi tso amesi bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui dzi la ƒe ŋku me, eye tso alẽvi la ƒe dziku la nu; elabena eƒe dzikuŋkeke gã la ɖo, eye ameka ate ŋu anɔ tsitre ɖe enu mahã?

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: Migawɔ vɔ̃ anyigba alo atsiaƒu alo atiawo o, vaseɖe esime míatre mía Mawu ƒe dɔtsɔlawo ƒe ŋgowo nu.

english_verse: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
translation_verse: Eye mese amesiwo nu wotre la ƒe xexlẽme — wotre ame akpe alafa ɖeka blane vɔ ene nu le Israel-viwo ƒe toawo katã me:

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: Amen, kafukafu kple ŋutikɔkɔe kple nunya kple akpedada kple bubu kple ŋutete kple ŋusẽ woana mía Mawu la tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Nusiawo megbe la mekpɔ, eye kpɔ ɖa, ameha gã, si amea ɖeke mete ŋu xlẽ o la, tso dukɔ sia dukɔ kple to sia to kple du sia du kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ me, le tsitre de fiazikpui la ŋgɔ kple alẽvi la ƒe ŋku me, wodo awu ʋlaya ɣiwo, eye wolé deʋayawo ɖe asi,

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: eye woɖo ɣli kple gbe gã le gbɔgblɔm bena: Xɔname nanye mía Mawu, si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi, kple alẽvi la tɔ!

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔlawo katã le tsitre ƒo xlã fiazikpui la kple amegã xoxoawo kple nu gbagbe eneawo, eye wotsyɔ woƒe mo anyi ɖe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ, eye wodo gbe ɖa na Mawu nɔ gbɔgblɔm bena:

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Eye amegã xoxoawo dometɔ ɖeka ɖo ŋu gblɔ nam bena: Amekawoe nye esiawo do awu ʋlaya ɣiwo, eye afika wotso mahã?

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Eye megblɔ nɛ bena: Nye aƒetɔ, wòe nyae! Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Amesiawo nye amesiwo ɖo go tso xaxa gã la me, eye wonyã woƒe awuwo, eye wowɔ wo ɣie le alẽvi la ƒe ʋu la me.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Eyata wole Mawu ƒe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ, eye wosubɔnɛ zã kple keli le eƒe xɔ la me, eye amesi bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi la, anɔ wo dome.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Dɔ megale wo wu ge akpɔ o, eye tsikɔ hã megale wo wu ge akpɔ o, eye ɣe kple ŋdɔkutsu megale wo du ge o;

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: elabena alẽvi, si le fiazikpui la titina la, anyi wo, eye wòakplɔ wo ayi agbetsi dzidziwo gbɔ, eye Mawu atutu aɖatsiwo katã ɖa le woƒe ŋkuwo me.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Eye esime wòɖe nutrenu adrelia ɖa la, ɖoɖoe zi le dziƒo anɔ gaƒoƒo afã.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla adre, siwo le tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋku me la, eye wotsɔ kpẽ adre na wo.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla bubu va, eye wòtsi tre ɖe vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ, eye sikadzudzɔdosonu le esi, eye wotsɔ atike ʋeʋẽe geɖe nɛ, bene wòatsɔe akpe ɖe ame kɔkɔewo katã ƒe gbedodoɖawo ŋuti ada ɖe sikavɔsamlekpui, si le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Eye atike ʋeʋẽe la ƒe dzudzɔ kple ame kɔkɔewo ƒe gbedodoɖawo tu tso mawudɔla ƒe asi me yi dziƒo le Mawu ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla la tsɔ dzudzɔdosonu la, eye wòɖe dzo le vɔsamlekpui la me hede eme tu, eye wòtsɔe ƒu gbe de anyigba, eye dziɖegbewo kple gbeɖiɖiwo kple dzikedzowo kple anyigbaʋuʋu va dzɔ. Kpẽ ene gbãtɔwo kuku.

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla adre, siwo lé kpẽ adre ɖe asi la, dzra wo ɖokui ɖo hena kpẽkuku.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla gbãtɔa ku kpẽ la, eye tsikpewo dza, eye dzo kple ʋu tɔtɔ, eye wotsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba, eye anyigba ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia fiã, eye atiwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia fiã, eve gbe mumuwo katã fiã.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla evelia ku kpẽ la, eye wotsɔ nane, si le abe to gãa ɖe ene hele bibim kple dzo la ƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu me, eye ƒu ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia trɔ zu ʋu;

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: eye nu gbagbe, siwo le atsiaƒu me la, ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia ku, eye nuwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia gbã.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla etɔ̃lia ku kpẽ la, eye ɣletivi gãa ɖe, si le bibim abe kakati ene la, ge tso dziƒo, eye wòdze tɔsisiwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kple tsi dzidziwo dzi.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Eye ɣletivi ma ƒe ŋkɔe nye Apsinto , eye tɔwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia trɔ zu tsi veve, eye amewo dome geɖeawo ku le tsiawo ta, le esi wole vevem akpa la ŋuti.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla enelia ku kpẽ la, eye woƒo ɣe ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kple ɣleti ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kpakple ɣletiviwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia, bena woƒe akpa etɔ̃lia nado viviti, eye ŋkeke ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia nagaklẽ o, eye zã hã nenema ke. Babadodo na anyigbadzitɔwo zi etɔ̃.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ, eye mese hɔ̃a ɖe, si le dzodzom lé dziƒo titina la, le gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gãa ɖe bena: Baba, baba, baba na anyigbadzinuwo le mawudɔla etɔ̃, siwo susɔ le kpẽ ku ge la, ƒe kpẽkukuwo ƒe ɖiɖi la ŋuti.

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla atɔ̃lia ku kpẽ la, eye mekpe ɣletivi, si ge tso dziƒo la dze anyigba, eye wotso aʋli me vudo ƒe safui nɛ.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Eye woʋu aʋli me vudo la nu, eye dzudzɔ lu tso vudo la me abe kpodzo gãa ɖe ƒe dzudzɔ ene, eye ɣe kple yame do viviti le vudo la ƒe dzudzɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Eye ʋetsuviwo do go tso dzudzɔ la me ɖe anyigba la dzi, eye wona ŋusẽ wo, abe alesi ŋusẽ le anyigba dzi dziɖegbewo ŋu ene.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ na wo bena, woagawɔ vɔ̃ anyigba dzi gbe mumu alo aŋgba alo atia ɖeke o, negbe amesiwo Mawu ƒe nutrenu mele ŋgonu na o la ɖeɖeko.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Eye wona ŋusẽ wo be, woagawu wo o, ke boŋ bene woawo fu wo ɣleti atɔ̃ sɔŋ; eye woƒe fuwɔwɔ la le abe dziɖegbe ƒe ametete ƒe fuwɔame ene.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Eye le ŋkeke mawo me la amewo aɖi ku, eye womele ekpɔ ge o, eye woadi vevie be, yewoaku, eye ku asi le wo gbɔ.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Eye ʋetsuviawo ƒe nɔnɔme le abe sɔ, siwo wodzra ɖo hena aʋawɔwɔ ene, eye nane le woƒe ta abe fiakuku, siwo ɖi sika ene, eye woƒe mo le abe amewo ƒe mo ene.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Eye taɖa li na wo abe nyɔnuwo ƒe taɖa ene, eye woƒe aɖuwo le abe dzatawo ƒe aɖuwo ene.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Eye akɔtakpoxɔnu le wo si abe gakɔtakpoxɔnu ene, eye woƒe aʋalawo me ƒe ɖiɖi le abe tasiaɖam kple so geɖe, siwo le du sim yina aʋa la ƒe ɖiɖi ene.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Eye asike le wo gɔme abe dziɖegbewo ene, eye ti le wo nu, eye woƒe ŋusẽ le woƒe asikewo me, be woawɔ vɔ̃ amewo ɣleti atɔ̃ sɔŋ.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Eye fiãa ɖe, si nye aʋli me dɔla la, ɖu wo dzi, eye woyɔ eŋkɔ le Hebri-gbe me be Abadon, eye woyɔnɛ le Hela-gbe me be Apolion .

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ ɖeka nu va yi; kpo ɖa, vɔ̃ eve gale megbe gbɔna.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla adelia ku kpẽ la, eye mese gbea ɖe ɖi tso sikavɔsamlekpui, si le Mawu ŋku me la, ƒe dzo eneawo gbɔ,

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm na mawudɔla adelia, si lé kpẽ la ɖe asi la bena: Tu dɔla ene, siwo wobla ɖe Frat-tɔsisi gã la to.

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Eye wotu dɔla ene, siwo dzra wo ɖokui ɖo hena gaƒoƒo kple ŋkeke kple ɣleti kpakple ƒe la, bena woawu amewo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Eye sɔdolawo ƒe aʋakɔ ƒe xexlẽme le akpe ewo teƒe akpe ewo teƒe eve; mese woƒe xexlẽme.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Eye ale mekpɔ sɔwo kple amesiwo do wo la, le ŋutega me: Wodo akɔtakpoxɔnu, siwo ɖi dzo, kple akɔtakpoxɔnu yibɔwo kpakple akɔtakpoxɔnu dzewo, eye sɔawo ƒe ta le abe dzatawo ƒe ta ene, eye dzo kple dzudzɔ kpakple dzokpe do go tso woƒe nu me.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Eye wowu amewo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia le fuwɔame etɔ̃ siawo me, le dzo kple dzudzɔ kpakple dzokpe, si do go tso woƒe nu me la ŋuti.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Elabena sɔawo ƒe ŋusẽ le woƒe nu kple woƒe asikewo me; elabena woƒe asikewo le abe dawo ene, eye ta le wo nu wotsɔna wɔa vɔ̃e.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Eye ame susɔe, siwo fuwɔame siawo mewu o la, wometrɔ le dzi me tso woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔawo me o, bena woagasubɔ gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo kple sika- kple klosalo-kple gadzẽ- kple kpe- kpakple ati-legba, siwo metea ŋu kpɔa nu alo sea nu alo zɔa azɔli hã o la o.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Eye wometrɔ tso woƒe hlɔ̃dodowo kple woƒe afakakawo kple woƒe ahasiwɔwɔwo kpakple woƒe fififiwo me o.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla sesẽ bubua ɖe le ɖiɖim tso dziƒo le alilikpo me, eye anyieʋɔ le eƒe ta me, eye eƒe ŋku me le abe ɣe ene, eye eƒe afɔwo le abe dzosɔtiwo ene,

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: eye agbalẽvi, si woʋu la, de esi, eye wotsɔ eƒe nuɖusifɔ da ɖe atsiaƒu dzi, eye wotsɔ eƒe miãfɔ da ɖe anyigba dzi,

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe gãa ɖe, abe alesi dzata ɖea gbe ene, eye esime wòdo ɣli la, dziɖegbe adreawo ɖe woƒe gbe ɖe go.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Eye esime dziɖegbe adreawo ɖe woƒe gbe ɖe go la, medi be, maŋlɔe; eye mese gbea ɖe tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Tre nusiwo dziɖegbe adreawo gblɔ la nu, eye megaŋlɔ wo o.

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla, si mekpɔ wòle tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu kple anyigba dzi la, do eƒe nuɖusi ɖe dziƒo,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: eye wòta amesi le agbe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, amesi wɔ dziƒo kple nusiwo le eme kple anyigba kple nusiwo le edzi kpakple atsiaƒu kple nusiwo le eme la, bena ɣeyiɣia ɖeke naganɔ anyi o,

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: ke boŋ le mawudɔla adrelia ƒe gbeɖeɖeŋkekewo me, esime woaku kpẽ la, woawu Mawu ƒe nya ɣaɣla la nu le nyanyuie, si wogblɔ fia eƒe dɔla, siwo nye nyagblɔɖilawo la nu.

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Eye gbe, si mese tso dziƒo la, gaƒo nu kplim, eye wògblɔ bena: Yi naɖaxɔ agbalẽvi, si le ʋuʋu le mawudɔla, si le tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu kple anyigba dzi la si.

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Eye meyi mawudɔla la gbɔ yi ɖagblɔ nɛ be, wòatsɔ agbalẽvi la nam. Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Xɔe, eye namii, eye wòaɖu dɔme na wò, ke wòavivi le wò nu me abe anyitsi ene.

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Eye mexɔ agbalẽvi fa le mawudɔla la si, eye memii, eye wòvivi le nye nu me abe anyitsi ene, eye enumake esi meɖui la, eɖu dɔme nam.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Eye wogblɔ nam bena: Ele na wò be, nagagblɔ nya ɖi le dukɔwo kple trɔ̃subɔlawo kple gbegbɔgblɔwo kple fiawo ŋuti.

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Eye naɖe xɔxɔnu, si le gbedoxɔa ŋu la, le eme, eye megadzidzee o; elabena wotsɔe na trɔ̃subɔlawo, eye woanya avuzi le du kɔkɔe la dzi ɣleti blane vo eve sɔŋ.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Eye mana ŋusẽ nye ɖaseɖila eve, bena woagblɔ nya ɖi ŋkeke akpe ɖeka kple alafa eve kple blaade, eye woanɔ akpanya me.

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Amesiawo nye amiti eve kple akaɖiti eve, siwo le tsitre ɖe anyigba ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋku me la.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le amesiawo si be, woatu dziƒo nu, bena tsi magadza le woƒe nyagblɔdiŋkekeawo me o, eye ŋusẽ le wo si ɖe tɔwo dzi, be woatrɔ wo woazu ʋu, eye be woatsɔ fuwɔame tsyo ƒomevi aƒo anyigba la zi geɖe, alesi wolɔ̃.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Eye ne wowu woƒe ɖaseɖiɖi nu vɔ la, ekema lã, si ɖo tso aʋli me la, awɔ aʋa kpli wo, eye wòaɖu wo dzi, eye wòawu wo.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: Eye woƒe ŋutilã kukuwo anɔ du gã la ƒe ablɔ me; woyɔ ɖu sia le lododo me bena: Sodom kple Egipte, afisi hã woklã woƒe Aƒetɔ ɖe ati ŋu le.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Eye dukɔwo ƒe ƒomeawo kple gbegbɔgblɔwo kpakple trɔ̃subɔlawo dometɔa ɖewo lakpɔ woƒe ŋutilã kukuawo ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã, eye womaɖe mɔ be, woaɖi woƒe ŋutilã kukuawo o.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Eye anyigbadzinɔlawo lakpɔ dzidzɔ le wo ŋuti, eye woagli kple dzidzɔ, eye woaɖo nunanawo ɖe wo nɔewo; elabena nenem nyagblɔɖila eve siawo wɔ fu amesiwo nɔ anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Eye ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã megbe la agbegbɔgbɔ tso Mawu gbɔ ge ɖe wo me, eye wotsi tre ɖe woƒe afɔwo dzi, eye vɔvɔ̃ gãa ɖe va dze amesiwo kpɔ wo la dzi.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Eye wose gbe gãa ɖe tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm na wo bena: Miva dziƒo afii! Eye woyi dziƒo le alilikpo me, eye woƒe futɔwo kpɔ wo ɖa.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Eye le gaƒoƒo kema ke me la anyigba ʋuʋu ŋutɔ, eye du la ƒe akpa ewolia mũ dze anyi, eye wowu ame akpe adre le anyigbaʋuʋu la me, eye susɔeawo vɔ̃ ŋutɔ, eye wotsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe na dziƒo Mawu la.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ evelia nu va yi, kpɔ ɖa, vɔ̃ etɔ̃lia gbɔna kaba. Kpẽ adrelia kuku.

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla adrelia ku kpẽ la, eye gbe gãwo ɖi le dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Xexemefiaɖuƒe la trɔ zu mía Aƒetɔ kple eƒe Kristo la tɔ, eye wòaɖu fia tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm bena: Míeda akpe na wò, Aƒetɔ, Mawu ŋusẽkatãtɔ, wò amesi li, eye nenɔ anyi; elabena exɔ wò ŋusẽ gã, eye neɖu fia.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Eye dzi ku dukɔwo, eye wò dziku va, eye ame kukuwo ƒe ɣeyiɣi la ɖo, bene woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo, eye be nana fetu wò dɔla, siwo nye nyagblɔɖilawo, kple ame kɔkɔewo kple amesiwo vɔ̃a wò ŋkɔ la, ɖeviwo kple ame tsitsiwo, eye be natsrɔ̃ amesiwo gblẽa anyigba la.

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Eye wotu mawuxɔ, si le dziƒo, eye wokpɔ eƒe nubablaɖaka le eƒe xɔ la me, eye dzikedzowo kple gbeɖiɖiwo kple dziɖegbewo kple anyigbaʋuʋu kple tsikpe gãwo va dzɔ.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: eye fu le eƒo, eye wòle ɣli dom le fuɖuame ŋuti, eye vidzidzi nye do nɛ.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Eye wokpɔ dzesi bubua ɖe le dziƒo, eye kpɔ ɖa, ʋɔ driba dzi gãa ɖe, si ta adre kple dzo ewo li na, eye fiakuku adre le eƒe tawo.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Eye eƒe asike he dziƒoɣletiviwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia, eye wotsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba. Eye ʋɔ driba la tsi tre ɖe nyɔnu, si le vi dzi ge la, ƒe ŋku me, bena ne edzi via ko la, ne yeatsɔe ami.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Eye wòdzi ŋutsuvi, si latsɔ gatikplɔ akplɔ dukɔwo katã; eye wotsɔ via yi Mawu kple eƒe fiazikpui la gbɔ.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu la si yi gbedzi, afisi Mawu dzra teƒea ɖe ɖo ɖi nɛ le, bena woanyii le afima ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eve kple blaade.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Eye aʋa dzo le dziƒo: Mixael kple eƒe dɔlawo yi aʋa wɔ ge kple ʋɔ driba la. Eye ʋɔ driba kple eƒe dɔlawo wɔ aʋa la,

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: eye womeɖu dzi o, eye womegakpɔ woƒe teƒe hã le dziƒo o.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ ʋɔ driba gã, si nye da xoxo la, esi woyɔna be: Abosam kple Satana, amesi nye xexeame kalẽ blela la, ƒu gbe, eye wotsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba, eye wotsɔ eƒe dɔlawo hã ƒu gbe ɖe anyi hekpe ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Eye mese gbe gãa ɖe le dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Azɔ xɔname kple ŋusẽ kpakple fiaɖuƒe la zu mía Mawu la tɔ, eye ŋusẽ la zu eƒe Kristo la tɔ; elabena wotsɔ mia nɔviwo nutsola, si nɔa wo nu tsom le Mawu ƒe ŋku me zã kple keli la, ƒu gbe.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Eye woɖu edzi to alẽvi la ƒe ʋu kple woƒe ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe nya la me, eye womelɔ̃ woƒe agbe o vaseɖe ku me.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Eyata dzi nedzɔ mi, mi dziƒowo kple amesiwo nɔ wo me la! Baba na anyigba kple atsiaƒu; elabena Abosam ɖi va mia gbɔ, eye dzi le ekum ŋutɔ, elabena ènyae be, vovoɣi via ɖe ko yekpɔ.

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Eye esime ʋɔ driba la kpɔ bena, wotsɔ ye ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba la, eti nyɔnu, si dzi ŋutsuvi la yome.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ hɔ̃ gãa ɖe ƒe aʋala eve na nyɔnu la, bena wòadzo ayi gbedzi ayi ɖe teƒe, afisi woanyii le ɣeyiɣia ɖe kple ɣeyiɣiwo kpakple ɣeyiɣi afã tso da la ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Eye da la tu tsi tso eƒe nu me ɖe nyɔnua yome abe tɔsisi ene, bene tɔsisi la nalée ayii.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Ke anyigba xɔ na nyɔnua, eye anyigba ke nu, eye wono tɔsisi, si ʋɔ driba la tu tso eƒe nu me la.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Eye dzi ku ŋɔ driba la ɖe nyɔnua ŋuti, eye wòdzo yi aʋa wɔ ge kple nyɔnua ƒe ƒome, siwo susɔ, amesiwo ɖea Mawu ƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye Yesu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi le wo si la.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Eye metsi tre ɖe ƒutake la dzi, eye mekpɔ lãa ɖe le ɖoɖom tso atsiaƒu me, eye dzo ewo kple ta adre li nɛ, eye fiakuku ewo le eƒe dzoawo dzi, eye busuŋkɔwo le eƒe tawo ŋu.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Eye lã, si mekpɔ la, le abe lãkle ene, eye eƒe afɔwo le abe sisiblisi ƒe afɔwo ene, eye eƒe nu le abe dzata ƒe nu ene; eye ʋɔ driba la tsɔ eƒe ŋutete kple eƒe fiazikpui kpakple eƒe ŋusẽ gã nɛ.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Eye eƒe tawo dometɔ ɖeka le abe kubi wode eŋu ene, eye wowɔ eƒe kubi la ne wòku; eye xexeame katã ƒe mo wɔ yaa le lã la yome.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Eye wode ta agu na nɔ driba la; elabena etsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ na lã la, eye wode ta agu na lã la le gbɔgblɔm bena: Amekae le abe lã la ene, eye amekae ate ŋu awɔ aʋa kplii mahã?

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Eye wotsɔ nu, si gblɔa nya gãwo kple busunyawo la nɛ, eye wotsɔ ŋusẽ nɛ, be wòanɔ dɔ dzi ɣleti blane vɔ eve

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Eye wòke nu de asi busunyagbɔgblɔ me de Mawu ŋuti, be yeado busu eƒe ŋkɔ kple eƒe agbadɔ kpakple amesiwo nɔa dziƒo.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Eye wona ŋusẽe, be wòawɔ aʋa kple ame kɔkɔewo, eye ne wòaɖu wo dzi, eye wona ŋusẽe ɖe to sia to kple dukɔ sia dukɔ kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kpakple trɔ̃subɔlawo katã dzi.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Eye anyigbadzinɔla, siwo katã ƒe ŋkɔwo womeŋlɔ ɖe alẽvi, si wowu la, ƒe agbegbalẽa me tso xexeame ƒe gɔmeɖoɖoanyi me o la, woasubɔe.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Amesi to li na la, nesee!

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Ne amea ɖe de ame gaxɔ me la, woaɖe eya hã gaxɔ me: ne amea ɖe wu ame kple yi la, ele be, woawu eya hã kple yi. Afii ame kɔkɔewo ƒe dzidodo kple woƒe xɔse le. Lã, si dzo eve le ta na la, do go tso anyigba me.

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ lã bubua ɖe le ɖoɖom tso anyigba me, eye dzo eve li nɛ abe alẽvi tɔ ene, eye wòƒo nu abe ʋɔ driba la ene.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ lã gbãtɔ ƒe ŋusẽdɔwo katã le eƒe ŋku me. Eye wòwɔ anyigba la kple amesiwo nɔ edzi la bena, woadze klo asubɔ lã gbãtɔ, si ƒe kubi wowɔ wòku la.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ dzesi gãwo bena, wòna dzo gɔ̃ hã ge tso dziƒo dze anyigba le amewo ƒe ŋku me.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Eye woble anyigbadzinɔlawo de dzesi, si wotsɔ nɛ, be wòawɔ le lã la ƒe ŋku me la ŋuti hele gbɔgblɔm na anyigbadzinɔlawo bena, woawɔ legba de lã, si ŋu wode abii kple yi, eye wòle agbe la ƒe nɔnɔme me nɛ.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Eye wona ŋusẽe, be wòatsɔ gbɔgbɔ na lã la ƒe legba, bena lã la ƒe legba naƒo nu hã, eye wòawɔ bena, woawu ame geɖe, alesi nu medze klo subɔ lã la ƒe legba o.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Eye wòwɔ bena, woade dzesi amewo katã, ɖeviwo kple ame tsitsiwo kple kesinɔtɔwo kple ame dahewo kple ablɔɖeviwo kple kluviwo ƒe nuɖusi alo woƒe ŋgonu,

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: bena amea ɖeke magate ŋu aƒle nu alo adzra nu o, negbe amesi ŋu lã la ƒe ŋkɔ alo eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe xexlẽme ƒe dzesi le la ko.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Afii nunya le! Amesi ke si gɔmesese le la, nèbu lã la ƒe xexlẽme kpɔ; elabena ame ƒe xexlẽme wònye, eye eƒe xexlẽme enye alafa ade kple blaade vɔ ade.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Eye mese gbea ɖe tso dziƒo abe tsi geɖewo ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene, eye abe dziɖegbe sesẽa ɖe ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene, eye gbe, si mese la, le abe saŋkuƒola, siwo le woƒe saŋkuwo ƒom la, ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Eye wodzi ha yeyea ɖe le fiazikpui la kple nu gbagbe eneawo kpakple amegã xoxoawo ƒe ŋku me; eye amea ɖeke mete ŋu srɔ̃ hadzidzi la o, negbe ame akpe alafa ɖeka blane vɔ ene, siwo woƒle tso anyigba dzi la koe.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Nenem me siawo nye amesiwo meƒo ɖi wo ɖokui kple nyɔnuwo o; elabena ɖetugbiwo wonye. Amesiawo dzea Alẽvi la yome yia afisiafi, si wòyina. Amesiawo la woƒle wo tso amewo dome, be woanye ŋgɔgbetɔwo na Mawu kple alẽvi la.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Eye womekpɔ aʋatsokakaa ɖeke le woƒe nu me o; elabena wonye mokaka manɔŋutɔwo. Mawudɔla kple nyanyuie la.

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ mawudɔla bubua de le dzodzom le dziƒo titina, eye wòlé nyanyuie mavɔ ɖe asi, be yeagblɔ afia anyigbadzinuwo kple trɔ̃subɔlawo katã kple to sia to kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kpakple dukɔ sia dukɔ,

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: eye wòle gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gã bena: Mivɔ̃ Mawu, eye mitsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe nɛ; elabena eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃gaƒoƒo la ɖo, eye miɖe ta agu na amesi wo dziƒo kple anyigba kple atsiaƒu kple tsi dzidziwo.

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla bubu, si nye evelia la, dze eyome le gbɔgblɔm bena: Emu, Babilon gã la mu! Du, si na dukɔwo katã no eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe aha la.

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla bubu, si nye etɔ̃lia la, dze wo yome le gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gã bena; Ne amea ɖe de ta agu na lã la kple eƒe legba, eye wòxɔ eƒe dzesi ɖo eƒe ŋgonu alo eƒe asi ŋu la,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: eya lano Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe aha, si wometɔtɔ kɔ ɖe eƒe dɔmedzoekplu la me o, eye woatsɔ dzo kple dzokpe ewɔ fui le mawudɔla kɔkɔeawo kple alẽvi la ŋku me.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Eye woƒe fu wowɔ ƒe dzudzu la tu le dziƒo yim tso mava me yi ɖe mavɔ me, eye amesiwo de ta agu na lã la kple amesi ke xɔ eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe dzesi la, womakpɔ dzudzɔ zã kple keli o.

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Afii ame kɔkɔe, siwo léa Mawu ƒe seawo kple Yesu ƒe dzixɔse me ɖe asi la, ƒe dzidodo le.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Eye mese gbea ɖe tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Ŋlɔ bena: Woayra ame kuku, siwo ku le Aƒetɔ la me tso esia dzi heyina: ẽ, Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ bena, woadzudzɔ wo dokui tso woƒe agbagbadzedzewo me, elabena woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo dze wo yome. Dzidzɔ nuŋeŋe kple keleme dziŋɔ.

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Eye kpo da, mekpɔ alilikpo yia ɖe, eye amea ɖe bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi abe amegbetɔvi ene, eye sikafiakuku le eta, eye hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛa ɖe le esi.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla bubua ɖe do tso gbedoxɔ me le ɣli dom kple gbe gã do de amesi bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi la bena: Do wò hɛ gobɛ la ɖa, ne naya nu; elabena nuŋeɣi ɖo, eye anyigba dzi nuwo ɖi!

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Eye amesi bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi la, do eƒe hɛ gobɛ ɖe anyigba dzi, eye wòya anyigba dzi nuwo.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla bubua ɖe do tso gbedoxɔ, si le dziƒo la me, eye eya hã lé hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛa de de asi.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla bubua ɖe, si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dzo dzi la, do tso vɔsamlekpui la me, eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe gãa de do de amesi lé hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ ɖe asi la bena: Do wò hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ la da, ne nala anyigba dzi weinka ƒe kpowo; elabena eƒe kutsetseawo di!

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla la do eƒe hɛ gobɛ ɖe anyigba dzi, eye wòtso anyigba dzi weinka ƒe kutsetseawo, eye wòtsɔ wo da ɖe Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe weinfiãnu gã la me.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Eye wofanya weintsetseawo kple afɔ le dua godo, eye ʋu do le weinfiãnu la me le ɖɔɖɔm vaseɖe keke sɔwo ƒe numega ŋuti ke, eye wòde stadio akpe ɖeka kple alafa ade.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ dzesi bubu le lu dziƒo, si lolo, eye wòwɔ nuku; mawudɔla adre lé fuwɔame mamletɔ adreawo de asi; elabena woawo me wowu Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe la nu le.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ atsiaƒu wòle abe ahũhɔ̃e, si me bia hẽ abe dzo ene la ene; eye amesiwo ɖu lã la kple eƒe legba kpakple eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe xexlẽme dzi la, le tsitre de atsiaƒu ɖiahũhɔ̃e la nu, eye Mawu ƒe saŋkuwo le wo si.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Eye wole Mose, Mawu ƒe dɔla, aƒe ha kple alẽvi la ƒe ha dzim hele gbɔgblɔm bena: Aƒetɔ, Mawu ŋusẽkatãtɔ, gã kple nuku nye wò dɔwɔwɔwo; wò dukɔwo dzi fia la, dzɔdzɔe kple nyateƒe enye wò mɔwo!

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, amekae mavɔ̃ wò o, eye makafu wò ŋku la o mahã? Elabena wò ɖeka bɔ koe le kɔkɔe; elabena dukɔwo katã woava ade ta agu le ŋkuwò me; elabena woɖe wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔwo ɖe go fia. Fu wɔ ame adre mlɔeawo. Dzadzraɖo hena dɔmedzoekplu adreawo kɔkɔɖanyi.

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Eye esia megbe la mekpe, eye ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe agbadɔ la ƒe gbedoxɔ le ʋuʋu le dziƒo;

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: eye mawudɔla adre, siwo lé fuwɔame adreawo ɖe asi la, do go tso gbedoxɔ la me, eye wodo aklalabiɖibiɖiwu dzadzɛ, si le dzo sim kaŋkaŋ la, eye wotso sikalidziblanu bla woƒe akɔtawo.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Eye nu gbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖeka tsɔ sikakplu adre, siwo Mawu, si le agbe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me la, ƒe dɔmedzoe yɔ taŋtaŋ la, na mawudɔla adreawo.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Eye dzudzɔ, si tso Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple eƒe ŋusẽ gbɔ la, yɔ gbedoxɔ la me taŋ, eye amea ɖeke mete ŋu ge ɖe gbedoxɔ la me o, vaseɖe esime wowu mawudɔla adreawo ƒe fu wɔa me adreawo nu.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Eye mese gbe gãa ɖe tso gbedoxɔa me le gbɔgblɔm na mawudɔla adreawo bena: Miheyi, ne miatrɔ Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoekpluawo akɔ ɖe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Eye gbãtɔa yi, eye wòtrɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi, eye ƒoƒoe vɔ̃, si vena ŋutɔ la, ƒo amesiwo ŋu lã la ƒe dzesi le kple amesiwo de ta agu na eƒe legba la.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla evelia trɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe atsiaƒu me, eye wòtrɔ zu abe ame kukua de ƒe ʋu ene, eye nu gbagbe sia nu gbagbe, si le ƒua me la ku.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla etɔ̃lia trɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe tɔsisiwo kple tsi dzidziwo me, eye wotrɔ zu ʋu.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Eye mese tsiawo ƒe mawudɔla le gbɔgblɔm bena: Wò amesi li, eye nènɔ anyi, wò kɔkɔetɔ la, wòe nye dzɔdzɔetɔ, le esi nèdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ale la ŋuti;

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: elabena wòtrɔ ame kɔkɔewo kple nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe nu kɔ ɖe anyi, eye nètsɔ ʋu na wo, bena woano, eye wòdze wo nenema.

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Eye mese vɔsamlekpui la le gbɔgblɔm bena: Ẽ, Aƒetɔ, Mawu ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, nyateƒe kple dzɔdzɔe nye wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo.

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla enelia tra eƒe kplu la ka ɖe ɣe dzi, eye wona ŋusẽe be, woatso dzo afiã amewo.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Eye dzoxɔxɔ gã ŋuta ɖu amewo, eye wode busu Mawuƒe ŋkɔ, si kpo ŋusẽ ɖe fuwɔame siawo dzi, eye wometrɔ le woƒe dzi me, bene woatsɔ kafukafu nɛ o.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla atɔ̃lia trɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe lã la ƒe zikpui dzi, eye eƒe fiaduƒe do viviti, eye woɖu ade le fukpekpe la ta,

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: eye wodo busu dziƒo Mawu la le woƒe fukpekpe kple woƒe ƒoƒoeawo ta, eye wometrɔ tso woƒe nuwɔnawo me o.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla adelia trɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe Frat-tɔsisi gã la dzi, eye eme tsi la mie, bene woadzra mɔ ɖo na ɣedzeƒefiawo.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ etɔ̃, siwo le abe akpɔkplɔwo ene la, do go tso ʋɔ driba la kple lã la kpakple aʋatsonyagblɔɖila ƒe nu me:

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: elabena wonye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe gbɔgbɔ, siwo nɔa dzesiwo wɔm, eye wonɔa xexeame katã ƒe fiawo gbɔ yim, bena woaƒo wo nu ƒu hena Mawu, ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, ƒe ŋkeke gã la ƒe aʋawɔwɔ.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna abe fiafitɔ ene; woayra amesi nɔa ŋudzɔ, eye wòdzra eƒe awuwo ɖo, bene wòagazɔ amama, eye woakpɔ eƒe ŋukpe ƒe o.

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Eye woƒo wo nu ƒu ɖe teƒe, si woyɔna le Hebri-gbe me bena Harmagedon.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla adrelia trɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe ya me, eye gbe gãa ɖe ɖi tso gbeɖoxɔa me tso fiazikpui la gbɔ le gbɔgblɔm bena: Wowɔe vɔ!

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Eye du gã la ma ɖe akpa etɔ me, eye dukɔwo ƒe duwo mũ; eye woɖo ŋku Babilon gã la dzi le Mawu ƒe ŋku me, bene woana eƒe dɔmedzoedziku ƒe ahakplui, ne wòano.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Eye ƒukpowo katã si, eye womegakpɔ towo o.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla adre, siwo si kplu adreawo nɔ la, dometɔ ɖeka ƒo nu kplim gblɔ bena: Va afii, ne mafia gbolo gã, si bɔbɔ na tsi geɖewo dzi la, ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ wò;

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: amesia kple anyigba dzi fiawo wo ahasi, eye wòna anyigbadzinɔlawo mũ eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe aha la,

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔm heyi gbedzi le gbɔgbɔ me, eye mekpe nyɔnua ɖe bɔbɔ nɔ lã dzẽa de, si ta adre kple dzo ewo li na, eye busuŋkɔwo le eŋuti fũ la dzi.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu la do aɖabɛwu kple awu dzi, eye wòwɔ leke kple sika kple kpe xɔasi kple adzagbawo, eye sikakplu, si me yɔ fũ kple ŋunyɔnuwo kple eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe makɔmakɔnyenye la, le esi.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Eye woŋlɔ ŋkɔ, si nye nya ɣaɣla lã, ɖe eƒe ŋgonu bena: Babilon gã la, gbolowo kple anyigba dzi ŋunyɔnuwo ƒe dada.

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ nyɔnu la mu ame kɔkɔewo ƒe ʋu kple Yesu ƒe ɖaseɖilawo ƒe ʋu. Eye esime mekpɔe la, nye mo wɔ yaa geɖe ŋutɔ.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla la gblɔ nam bena: Nukaŋuti wò mo wɔ yaa ɖo mahã? Magblɔ nyɔnu la kple lã, si le etsɔm, eye ta adre kple dzo ewo li nɛ la, ŋu nya ɣaɣla afia wò.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Lã, si nekpɔ la, enɔ anyi, eye megali o, eye wòle dodo ge atso aʋli me, eye wòayi ɖe gbegblẽ me. Eye ne anyigbadzinɔla, siwo ƒe ŋkɔwo womeŋlɔ ɖe agbegbalẽa me tso xexeame ƒe gɔmeɖoɖoanyi me o la, akpɔ lã la ɖa, alesi wònɔ anyi, eye megali o, eye wòagava la, woƒe mo awɔ yaa.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Afii gɔmesese, si me nunya le la, hiã le: Ta adreawo nye to adre, siwo dzi nyɔnu la bɔbɔ nɔ,

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: eye wonye fia adre: Wo ame atɔ dze anyi, eye ɖeka ti, mamletɔ la meva haɖe o, eye ne eva la, ele ne be, wòanɔ anyi ʋee ko.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Eye lã, si nɔ anyi, eye megali o la, eya ŋutɔ hã enye enyilia, eye wònye adreawo dometɔ ɖeka, eye wòyina ɖe gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: Eye dzo ewo, si nekpɔ la, woawoe nye fia ewo, siwo mexɔ fiaɖuƒe haɖe o; gake woawo kple lã la woaxɔ ŋusẽ abe fiawo ene gaƒoƒo ɖeka.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Nenem me siawo la tameɖoɖo ɖeka li na wo, eye wotsɔ woƒe ŋutete kple ŋusẽ na lã la.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Amesiawo awɔ aʋa kple Alẽvi la, eye Alẽvi la laɖu wo dzi; elabena aƒetɔwo dzi aƒetɔ kple fiawo dzi fia wònye, eye amesiwo li kplii la, wonye ame yɔyɔwo kple ame tiatiawo kpakple nuteƒewɔlawo.

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Eye wògblɔ nam bena: Tsi, siwo nèkpɔ, siwo dzi gbolo la bɔbɔ nɔ la, wonye dukɔwo kple amehawo kple xexemedukɔwo kpakple gbegbɔgblɔwo.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Eye dzo ewo, siwo nèkpɔ kple lã la, woawo alé fu gbolo la, eye woawɔe aƒedo, eye woaɖe amamae, eye woaɖu eƒe ŋutilã, eye woatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Elabena Mawu tsɔe de woƒe dzi me, bene woawɔ eƒe tameɖoɖo dzi, eye woawɔ tameɖoɖo ɖeka dzi, eye woatsɔ woƒe fiaɖuƒe ana lã la, halase esime woawu Mawu ƒe nyawo nu.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Eye nyɔnu, si nèkpɔ la, enye du gã, si le fia ɖum ɖe anyigba dzi fiawo dzi.

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Eye nusiawo megbe la mekpɔ mawudɔla bubua de le didim tso dziƒo, eye ŋusẽ gã le esi, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe klẽ de anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ le gbɔgblɔm bena: Emu, Babilon gã la mu! Eye wòtrɔ zu gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe nɔƒe kple gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo katã ƒe gaxɔ kple xevi makɔmakɔ, siwo katã wotsri la, ƒe xadza.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Elabena dukɔwo katã no eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe aha la, eye anyigba dzi fiawo wɔ ahasi kplii, eye anyigba dzi sitsalawo trɔ zu kesinɔtɔwo le eƒe hadzedze vivivo ƒe ŋusẽ ŋuti.

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Eye mese gbe bubua ɖe tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Mi amesiwo nye nye dukɔ la, mido go tso me, bene miagade ha kplii le eƒe nuvɔ̃wo me o, eye bena miagaxa eƒe fuwɔame ƒe ɖeke o,

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: elabena eƒe nuvɔ̃wo ko yi ɖatɔ dziƒo, eye Mawu ɖo ŋku eƒe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Miɖo teƒe ne, abe alesi eya hã ɖo eteƒe na mi ene, miɖo teƒe ne teƒe eve le eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu, kplu, si me wòtɔtɔ nu le la, mitɔtɔ nu teƒe eve nu ɖe eme nɛ.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Zi geɖe alesi wòdo eɖokui ɖe dzi, eye wòdze ha la, zi geɖe ma ke miwo fui, eye mina wòafa konyi; elabena egblɔ le eƒe dzi me bena: Mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi abe fianyɔnu ene, eye nyemenye ahosi o, eye nyemegale konyi fa ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Eyata le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi la eƒe fukpekpewo ava edzi: Ku kple konyifafa kpakple dɔwuame, eye woatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ, elabena Aƒetɔ Mawu, amesi drɔ̃ ʋɔnui la, enye ŋusẽtɔ. Fiawo, asitsalawo kple ʋumenɔlawo fa konyi. Wokpɔ dzidzɔ le dziƒo le Babilon mumu ŋuti.

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Eye ne anyigba dzi tia, siwo wɔ amatre kplii, eye wonɔ hadzegbe kplii la, akpɔ eƒe bibi ƒe dzudzɔtutu la, woafa avi, eye woafa konyi nɛ.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Eye woanɔ tsitre le adzɔge ke le eƒe fukpekpe ƒe ŋɔdzi la ŋuti agblɔ bena: Baba na wò, baba na wò, Babilon, wò, si nye du gã kple du sesẽ! Elabena gaƒoƒo ɖeka dzi wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la va.

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Eye anyigba dzi sitsalawo le avi fam, eye wole konyi fam le tawò; elabena amea ɖeke megale woƒe adzɔnuawo ƒle ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Adzɔnu siawo nye: Sika kple klosalo kple kpe xɔasiwo kple adzagbawo kple aklala biɖibiɖi kple aɖabɛ kple seda kple awu dzi kple ati ʋeʋẽe ƒomeviwo katã kple nyiɖu ƒe aɖaŋunu bubu ƒomeviwo katã kple ati xɔasi kple gadzẽ kple ga kple kpe xɔasi ƒe aɖaŋunu bubu ƒomeviwo katã

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: kple botsyo kple ami ʋeʋẽe kple atike ʋeʋẽe kple ami sisi kple lifi kple aha kple ami kple wɔ nyuitɔ kple lu kple aƒemelãwo kple alẽwo kple sɔwo kple tasiaɖamwo kple ame ƒeƒlewo kpakple amewo ƒe luʋɔwo.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Eye atikutsetse, siwo dzroa wò luʋɔ la, dzo le gbɔwò, eye nu viviwo kple atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo katã bu ɖe wò, eye megale wo kpɔ ge gbeɖegbeɖe akpɔ o.

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Eye nusiawo ƒe adzɔdola, siwo to edzi zu kesinɔtɔwo la, woanɔ tsitre le adzɔge ke le eƒe fukpekpe ƒe ŋɔdzi la ŋuti, anɔ avi fam, eye woanɔ konyi fam anɔ gbɔgblɔm bena:

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: Baba, baba na du gã la! Eya, si do aklalabiɖibiɖiwu kple aɖabɛwu kple awu dzi, eye wòwu leke kple sika kple kpe xɔasi kple adzagbawo! Elabena le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me kesinɔnu geɖe siawo golẽ petepete.

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Eye ʋumefia sia ʋumefia kple ʋuɖola sia ʋuɖola kple kahela sia kahela kpakple ƒu dzi dɔwɔlawo katã wole tsitre le adzɔge ke.

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: Eye esi wokpe eƒe bibi ƒe dzudzɔtutu la, wodo ɣli gblɔ bena: Du kae sa kple du gã ma mahã?

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Eye wolɔ kewɔ kɔ ɖe la me, eye wodo ɣli le avi fam hele konyi fam le gbɔgblɔm bena: Baba na wò, baba na wo du gã, si me amesiwo katã si ʋu le le ƒu dzɔ la, tro zu kesinɔtɔwo le eƒe kesinɔnyenye ŋuti! Elabena wotsrɔ̃e le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me.

english_verse: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.”
translation_verse: Dzi nedzo mi le eta, wò dziƒo kple mi ame kɔkɔewo kple mi apostolowo kple mi nyagblɔɖilawo; elabena Mawu dra mia nya na mi hebia hlɔ̃e.

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Eye mawudɔla sesẽa ɖe tsɔ kpea ɖe, si le abe te gãa ɖe ene, eye wòtsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe ƒu me le gbɔgblɔm bena: Ale woatsɔ Babilon, du gã la, axlã ɖe anyi sesĩe enye si, eye womegale ekpɔ ge gbeɖegbeɖe akpɔ o,

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: eye womegale saŋkuƒolawo kple hadzilawo kple dzekulawo kple kpẽkulawo ƒe gbe se ge le mewò gbeɖegbeɖe akpɔ o; eye womegale aɖaŋuwɔla bubu ƒomevia ɖeke kpɔ ge le mewò o, eye womegale tetutu se ge le mewò gbeɖegbeɖe akpɔ o;

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: eye akaɖi ƒe keklẽ megale keklẽ ge le mewò gbeɖegbeɖe akpɔ o; eye womegale ŋugbetɔ kple ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ƒe gbe se ge le mewò gbeɖegbeɖe akpɔ o: elabena wò asitsalawo nye anyigba dzi megãwo; elabena woble dukɔwo katã to wò afakaka me.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Eye wokpɔ nyagblɔɖilawo kple ame kɔkɔewo kpakple amesiwo katã wowu le anyigba dzi la, ƒe ʋu le eme.

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Nusiawo megbe la mese gbe gãa ɖe le abe ameha gãa ɖe ƒe gbeɖiɖi ene, le dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm bena: Mikafu Yehowa! Xɔname kple ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ nanye mía Mawu la tɔ;

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: elabena eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nye nyateƒetɔ kple dzɔdzɔetɔ; elabena edrɔ̃ ʋɔnu gbolo gã, si tsɔ eƒe gbolowɔwɔ gblẽ anyigba dzi la, eye wòbia eƒe dɔlawo ƒe ʋu ƒe hlɔ̃ le esi.
