english_verse: Death is the punishment for witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Mègana nyɔnu dzotɔ nanɔ agbe o.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for having sex with an animal.
translation_verse: “Ame si dɔ kple lã la, miwui.

english_verse: Death is the punishment for offering sacrifices to any god except me.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe sa vɔ na mawu bubu aɖe, eye menye na Aƒetɔ ɖeɖe ko o la, mitsrɔ̃e keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Do not mistreat or abuse foreigners who live among you. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Migawɔ vɔ̃ ɖe amedzro ŋu alo atee ɖe anyi o, elabe miawo hã mienye amedzro kpɔ le Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Do not mistreat widows or orphans.
translation_verse: Migafia fu ahosiwo alo tsyɔ̃evi aɖeke o.

english_verse: If you do, they will beg for my help, and I will come to their rescue.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ fu wo eye wodo ɣli yɔm la, matɔ na wo kokoko.

english_verse: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.
translation_verse: Mado dɔmedzoe helihelĩ, awu mi kple yi, mia srɔ̃wo azu ahosiwo eye mia viwo azu tsyɔ̃eviwo.

english_verse: Don't charge interest when you lend money to any of my people who are in need.
translation_verse: “Ne èdo ga na nye dukɔa me tɔ ame dahe aɖe la, mègayɔe ɖe nu abe ale si fetɔ wɔna ene o, eye mègabia deme ɖe ga la dzi hã o.

english_verse: Before sunset you must return any coat taken as security for a loan,
translation_verse: Ne hawòvi tsɔ eƒe awu alo avɔ ɖo awɔba na wò la, trɔe nɛ hafi ɣe naɖo to,

english_verse: because that is the only cover the poor have when they sleep at night. I am a merciful God, and when they call out to me, I will come to help them.
translation_verse: elabe eya koe le esi wòtsyɔna. Ne etsi gbɔwò ɖe, nu ka hawòvi la atsyɔ amlɔ anyii? Ne efa konyi nam la, masee elabe nublanuikpɔla menye.

english_verse: Don't speak evil of me or of the ruler of your people.
translation_verse: “Mègado vlo Mawu o, eye mègaƒo fi de wò dukɔ ƒe dziɖula aɖeke o.

english_verse: Don't fail to give me the offerings of grain and wine that belong to me. Dedicate to me your first-born sons
translation_verse: “Mègahe ɖe megbe le agblemenuku kple wain siwo do tso wò dɔwɔwɔ me la ƒe akpa ɖe nana ŋu o. “Mitsɔ mia viŋutsu ŋgɔgbeawo nam.

english_verse: and the first-born of your cattle and sheep. Let the animals stay with their mothers for seven days, then on the eighth day give them to me, your God.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nenema ke na miaƒe nyiwo kple alẽwo hã. Ne wodzi ɖe la, nenɔ nɔa gbɔ ŋkeke adrẽ, eye le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, mitsɔe nam.

english_verse: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la mianye nam, eya ta migaɖu lã si lã wɔadãwo vuvu le gbedzi la o; ke boŋ mitsɔe ƒu gbe na avuwo.

english_verse: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.
translation_verse: Mèganɔ amehawo yome aɖawɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi, alo ade ame geɖewo dzi le kodzoɖiƒe atrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe ta atu o.

english_verse: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.
translation_verse: Mègade ame dahe dzi le kodzoɖiƒe o.

english_verse: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.
translation_verse: “Ne èke ɖe wò futɔ ƒe nyi alo tedzi si bú ŋu la, kplɔe vɛ nɛ.

english_verse: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.
translation_verse: Ne agba wú ame si lé fu wò ƒe tedzi eye lã la dze anyi la, mègadze to eŋu yi o. Kpe ɖe eŋu ne miafɔ tedzia ɖe tsitre.

english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: “Mègatrɔ ame dahe ƒe nya dzɔdzɔe ta tu le ʋɔnu o.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: Mègaka aʋatso ɖe ame aɖeke si o, eye mègakɔ ame maɖifɔ, ame si ƒe nya dzɔ la ƒe ʋu ɖi o, elabe nyematso afia na ame vɔ̃ɖi o.

english_verse: Don't accept bribes. Judges are blinded and justice is twisted by bribes.
translation_verse: Mègaxɔ zãnu o, elabe zãnu ɖe wògbãa ŋku na dumegãwo eye wòtrɔa ame siwo ƒe nya dzɔ la boŋ wozua fɔɖilawo.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Mègaté amedzro ɖe anyi o. Mienya ale si amedzro ƒe dzi le elabe miawo hã mienye amedzrowo kpɔ nɔ Egipte-nyigba dzi. Ƒè adrẽlia kple ŋkeke adrẽlia

english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: “De agble ɖe wò anyigba dzi ƒe ade, eye nàƒo ƒu nuku siwo le edzi.

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: Ke le ƒè adrẽlia me la, na anyigba la nagbɔ ɖe eme azu flu ale be ame dahe siwo le wò dukɔ me la nakpɔ nu aɖu, eye nu si wosusɔ ɖi la, gbemelãwo nava ɖui. Wɔ nenema ke le wò waingble kple wò amitigblewo me hã.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: “Wɔ ŋuwò dɔwo ŋkeke ade, eye le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, nàgbɔ ɖe eme, be wò nyi kple wò tedzi, wò kosi ƒe viŋutsu kple amedzro siaa hã nadzudzɔ.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Miwɔ nya siwo katã megblɔ na mi la dzi. Migayɔ mawu bubu aɖeke ŋkɔ o; ɖeke ŋkɔ megaɖi le mia nu gɔ̃ hã o. Ŋkeke nyui gã etɔ̃awo (Mos II,

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: “Migatsɔ nye vɔsalã ƒe ʋu kpe ɖe abolo si me wode amɔwɔʋãnui la ŋu o. Migana nye ŋkekenyui ƒe vɔsalã ƒe ami natsi anyi ŋu nake ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Fu mage le nyɔnuwo ƒo loo, alo nyɔnu aɖe natsi ko le miaƒe anyigba la dzi o. Mana mianɔ agbe wòade edeƒe.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Ne èdze nu siwo nèƒã ɖe agble me la ŋeŋe gɔme la, nàɖu ŋkekenyui, eye ne èƒo wò agblemenuwo nu ƒu ɖe ava eme le ƒè la ƒe nuwuwu me la, ekema nàgaɖu ŋkekenyui.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Miaƒe ŋutsuwo katã nava Aƒetɔ Mawu ŋkume zi etɔ̃ le ƒè ɖeka me.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: “Miɖu ŋkekenyui nam zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Le Abib si nye ɣleti si me mieʋu dzo le Egipte me la, miɖu Abolo Maʋamaʋã Ŋkeke Nyui abe ale si meɖoe na mi la ene. Miɖui ŋkeke adrẽ, eye le ŋkeke adrẽ mawo me la, migaɖu abolo aɖeke si me amɔwɔʋãnu le la o. Ame aɖeke negava ŋkunye me asi ƒuƒlu o.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Tsɔ wò agblemenu gbãtɔ si nàŋe la va Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ƒeme. “Mègaɖa gbɔ̃vi le nɔa ƒe notsi me o. Ŋugbedododwo kple nufiafia

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, medɔ dɔla aɖe ɖe mia ŋgɔ be wòakpɔ mia ta le mɔ dzi, eye wòakplɔ mi ayi teƒe si medzra ɖo ɖi la.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Mibui eye miɖo to eƒe gbe. Migadze aglã ɖe eŋu o, elabe nyee dɔe. Ne mietsi tre ɖe eŋu la, matsɔ miaƒe dzidada ake mi o, elabe nye ŋkɔ le eŋu.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: “Gake ne mieɖo to eƒe gbe nyuie, eye miewɔ nu siwo katã meɖo na mi la, ekema manye futɔ na miaƒe futɔwo kple ketɔ na miaƒe ketɔwo.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: “Ne nye dɔla dze mia ŋgɔ yi Amoritɔwo, Xititɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Kanaanitɔwo, Xivitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo gbɔ, eye metsrɔ̃ wo ɖa keŋkeŋ la,

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: migade ta agu na woƒe mawuwo loo, asubɔ wo loo, alo akpɔ woƒe nuwɔna aɖeke awɔ o. Ke boŋ migblẽ woƒe mawuawo keŋkeŋ eye migbã woƒe legbawo gudugudu.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Misubɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, eye nye la, mayra miaƒe nuɖuɖu kple miaƒe tsi, eye maɖe dɔlélewo ɖa le mia dome.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: Maɖo vɔvɔ̃ si le ŋunye la ɖe mia ŋgɔ, eye dukɔ siwo katã dome miava la, atɔtɔ, eye miaƒe futɔwo atrɔ megbe así le mia nu.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Madɔ téamekplɔɖoewo ɖe mia ŋgɔ be woanyà Xivitɔwo, Kanaanitɔwo kple Xititɔwo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Nyemanyà wo ɖa woadzo le ƒe ɖeka me o. Ne menye nenema o la, anyigba la aɖi gbɔlo, lã wɔadãwo asɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi akpa ɖe mia ŋu.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ manɔ wo nyàm ɖa ʋɛʋɛʋɛ va se ɖe esime miadzi ɖe edzi axɔ anyigba la dzi katã.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Miaƒe liƒo atso Aƒlaƒu la nu aɖado ɖe Filistitɔwo ƒe ƒu la nu; agatso gbedadaƒo la va se ɖe Frat-tɔsisi la nu. Matsɔ anyigba la dzi nɔlawo ade asi na mi, eye mianyà wo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Migabla nu aɖeke kple wo loo, alo kple woƒe mawu o.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Womeganɔ miaƒe anyigba la dzi o. Ne wotsii la, woawɔ vɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye, elabe ne miesubɔ woƒe mawuwo la, anye mɔ̀ na mi godoo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Egblɔ na Mose be: “Wò ŋutɔ, Aron, Nadab, Abihu kple Israel-me tsitsiawo dome ame bla adrẽ, milia toa ne miate ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu. Minɔ adzɔge ne miade ta agu.

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: Mose ɖeka ko nete ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu. Ame mamlɛawo megate va o, eye dukɔ la megalia to la kplii o.”

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Mose va gblɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nyaawo katã kple ɖoɖoawo katã na dukɔ la; tete dukɔ la lɔ̃ ɖe wo dzi kple gbe ɖeka be: “Míawɔ nu siwo katã Aƒetɔ gblɔ na mí la.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Mose ŋlɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nyaawo katã ɖi. Le evea gbe ŋdi la, efɔ yi ɖaɖi vɔsamlekpui ɖe toa gɔme. Eɖi ŋkuɖodzikpe wui eve hã ɖe afi ma, ɖe Israel-to wui eveawo nu.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ena Israelviwo dome ɖekakpuiwo yi ɖawɔ numemevɔsawo na Aƒetɔ, eye wòna wotsɔ nyitsuwo sa ŋutifafavɔ hã nɛ.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Eku nyitsuawo ƒe ʋu ƒe afã ɖe agbawo me da ɖi, eye wòhlẽ afã mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Etsɔ agbalẽ si me wòŋlɔ nublanyaawo ɖo, eye wòxlẽe be dukɔ la nasee. Tete wogblɔ be: “Miawɔ nu siwo katã Aƒetɔ gblɔ na mí la pɛpɛpɛ, eye mianye toɖolawo.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Eyome Mose tsɔ ʋu la wu ɖe ameawo ŋu hegblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, esiae nye nu si Aƒetɔ bla kpli mi le nya siwo katã wògblɔ na mi la nu.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Esia megbe, Mose, Aron, Nadab, Abihu kple Israel-me tsitsi bla adrẽ la yi toa dzi.

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: Tete wokpɔ Israel ƒe Mawu la. Nu gbadza aɖe si dze abe gblotie wotsɔ wɔe ene la le eƒe afɔ te. Nua kɔ keŋkeŋ abe dziŋgɔli ene.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Mewɔ nu vevi aɖeke Israelviwo ƒe ame veviawo o. Wokpɔ Mawu, eye woɖu nu, no nu. Mose le Sinai-to dzi

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Va gbɔnye le toa dzi; lala le afi ma. Matsɔ kpe gbadzɛ siwo dzi meŋlɔ seawo ɖo be nàɖafia Israelviwo la na wò.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Ale Mose tso kple Yosua eye woyi Mawu ƒe to la dzi.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na ame tsitsiawo be: “Minɔ afi sia va se ɖe esime míagbɔ. Mikpɔ ɖa, Aron kple Xur le mia gbɔ. Ne ʋɔnunya aɖe le mia dometɔ aɖe si la, mitsɔe yi wo gbɔe.

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Mose yi toa dzi. Tete alilikpo tsyɔ toa dzi.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe va nɔ Sinai-to la dzi eye alilikpoa tsyɔe ŋkeke ade. Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, eyɔ Mose tso alilikpoa me.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka, aɖabɛ dzẽ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ, ka ɣi, gbɔ̃fu,

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be woadzɔ nu nam. Mixɔ nudzɔdzɔ le ame sia ame si lɔ̃ tso eƒe dzime be yeana num faa la si nam.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Nu siwo miaxɔ la woe nye: sika, klosalo, akɔbli,

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: agbogbalẽ si wode ama dzẽ, gbɔ̃gbalẽ zɔzrɔ̃e, xeti,

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: sohamkpe kple kpe xɔasi bubu siwo woatsɔ aɖo atsyɔ̃ na nunɔlagã ƒe kɔmewu kple akɔtaɖonu.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Na woawɔ kɔkɔeƒe nam be mava nɔ wo dome.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Fa sika nyuitɔ ɖe eme kple ekɔgo siaa, eye nàtsɔ sika nyuitɔ do atsiã ɖe eto kpe ɖo.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Eyome nàkɔ sikasigɛ ene, eye nàklã wo ɖe eƒe dzogoe eneawo ŋu: eve nanɔ akpa ɖeka, eye eve hã nanɔ akpa evelia.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Azɔ nàtsɔ xeti akpa kpo eve eye nàfa sika ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Nàtsɔ kpoawo ƒo ɖe asigɛawo me ne woatsɔ wo akɔ aɖaka lae.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Kpoawo natsi asigɛawo me le aɖakaa ŋu; womaɖee le asigɛawo me o.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Kɔ kerubi ɖeka ɖe akpa ɖeka, eye nàkɔ evelia ɖe akpa evelia. Nàwɔ kerubiawo kple nugbɔawo ɖekae.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Nàtsɔ se siwo mele tsɔtsɔ ge na wò la ade aɖaka la me, eye nàtsɔ nutuvia atu enu.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Kerubi eve siwo le nubablaɖakaa tame la domee maɖe ɖokuinye afia wò le, eye afi mae magblɔ gbedeasi siwo katã wòle be nàxɔ ayi na Israelviwo la le na wò. Kplɔ̃ hena abolo si wotsɔ va sa vɔ na Mawu (Mos II,

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Na to nanɔ eŋu akpe ɖo; to la nakeke sentimeta bla adrẽ vɔ atɔ̃, eye nàtsɔ sika wɔ atsiã ɖe eya hã ŋu akpe ɖo.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Tsɔ sika wɔ asigɛ ene, nàklã ɖekaɖeka ɖe kplɔ̃a ƒe afɔti eneawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Tsɔ xe nàkpa kpo didi eve, eye nàfa sika ɖe wo ŋu; woawoe woatsɔ kɔ kplɔ̃ lae.

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: “Tsɔ sika nyuitɔ nàwɔ akaɖitii. Afɔ nenɔ akaɖitia gɔme eye eƒe titinati, kɔ́ siwo le titinatia ŋu, eƒe alɔwo kple seƒoƒowo katã nanye nu blibo ɖeka ado tso sika la me.

english_verse: with three branches on each of its two sides.
translation_verse: Alɔ ade nenɔ titinatia ŋu. Etɔ̃ nanɔ eƒe axa ɖeka, eye etɔ̃ nanɔ evelia hã.

english_verse: and four on the stem.
translation_verse: Seƒoƒo ene kple wo tameɖonuwo nanɔ atia ŋutɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Kɔawo nawɔ ɖeka ɖe atia ŋu; sika nyuitɔ woatsɔ tu akaɖiti blibo lae.

english_verse: The lampstand and its equipment will require
translation_verse: Woatsɔ sika nyuitɔ kilo bla etɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃ atu akaɖitia kple eŋu nuawo katãe.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Kpɔ egbɔ be woanɔ tututu abe ale si wofia wò le toa dzi la ene.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: “Azɔ nàna woalɔ̃ mɔnuvɔ ne natsi ɖe agbadɔa nu. Tsɔ lãfu blɔtɔ kple dzẽtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ kple ɖeti ɣi dada lɔ̃e. Mitsɔ abui ta nuwo ɖe eto tsɔ ɖo atsyɔ̃ nɛ.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Avɔ siawo dome ɖe sia ɖe nadidi meta wui ene, eye wòakeke meta eve.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: “Tɔ avɔ gã ewo siwo wolɔ̃ kple lãfuka blɔtɔ, hẽtɔ kple dzẽtɔ eye wowɔ kerubiwo ɖe wo me la ɖe agbadɔ la me.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Tɔ atɔ̃ ƒe didimekpawo ɖe wo nɔewo nu, eye nàgatɔ atɔ̃ hã ƒe didimekpawo ɖe wo nɔewo nu nenema ke.

english_verse: The panel of goat hair will be a meter longer than the tent itself, so fold
translation_verse: Avɔ siwo tsi edzi le agbadɔa ƒe didimekpa eveawo dzi la naɖiɖi ava anyime sentimeta bla atɔ̃ ava bu agbadɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Tɔ atɔ̃ kpe ne woazu avɔ ɖeka, eye nàgatɔ ade mamlɛawo hã kpe ne woawo hã nazu nu ɖeka. Ŋe avɔ adelia si le agbadɔa ƒe ŋgɔgbekpa dzi la me ɖe eve.

english_verse: and fasten the two panels at the loops with
translation_verse: “Gatu akɔbliga gɔdɔ̃e bla atɔ̃, eye nàtsɔ wo ku kabotoeawo me be agbadɔ la nakpe azu nu ɖeka.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Eyome natsɔ nubablaɖaka la ƒe nutuvia atu ɖe enu le kɔkɔeƒetɔ kekeake la.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Esiawo megbe la, tsɔ xe nàdze ʋuƒo nàtu na agbadɔa.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: Tsɔ klosalo wɔ gɔme zekpe bla ene ɖe wo te, ale be eve nanɔ ʋɔtruti ɖe sia ɖe gɔme.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Wɔ ʋɔtruti ade na agbadɔa ƒe akpa si le ɣedzeƒe gome, eye

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Mɔ nanɔ dzogoedzi ʋɔtruti eveawo dome le anyime gake le dzime la, woanɔ wo nɔewo ŋu kam, eye asigɛ gã ɖeka nanɔ wo ŋu. Aleae woawɔ ʋɔtruti eveve siwo le dzogoeawo dzi la dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Ale wo katã anye ʋɔtruti enyi siwo te wotsɔ klosalo awɔ gɔme zekpe wui ade ɖo, elabe gɔme zekpe evee anɔ ɖe sia ɖe te.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Gameti titinatɔ si to ʋuƒoawo dome la atso agbadɔa ƒe gɔmedzeƒe yi ɖado ɖe eƒe nuwuƒe.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Fa sika ɖe ʋɔtrutiawo ŋu, eye nàtsɔ sika tu asigɛ siwo me woaƒo gametiawo ɖo la de wo ŋu. Fa sika ɖe gametiawo hã ŋu.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Tu agbadɔ la ne wòanɔ abe ale si wofia wò le toa dzi ene la pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Tsɔ kplɔ̃a ɖo xɔmetsovɔa ŋgɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la, le agbadɔa ƒe dzigbeme gome le kplɔ̃a ƒe sɔsɔme.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Eyome nàtsɔ xe akpa sɔti atɔ̃ na mɔnuvɔ sia. Fa sika ɖe sɔtiawo ŋu, eye nàtsɔ sika wɔ wo ŋu gatagbadzɛwo hã. Mlɔeba la, tsɔ akɔbli kɔ afɔ zekpe ɖeka ɖe sɔti siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe gɔme.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Kpo siawoe woatra ɖe asigɛawo me le vɔsamlekpuia ƒe axa eveawo dzi atsɔ kɔe.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Tsɔ akɔbli wɔ vɔsamlekpui la ŋu nuwo katã: ganu siwo me lãmidzowɔawo anɔ, sofiwo, ametagbɛwo, gaflowo kple dzoɖesonuwo.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Tsɔ ʋuƒowo wɔ vɔsamlekpui lae, eye nàna do nanɔ eme. Wɔe abe ale si wofia wò le toa dzi la ene. Kpɔ si me agbadɔa anɔ (Mos II,

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: Ɖo na Israelviwo be woanɔ ami nyuitɔ tsɔm vɛ na wò hena akaɖia me dede, ale be akaɖiawo nanɔ xɔxɔm edziedzi.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Tu kpɔti bla eve tsɔ lé wo ɖe tsitrenu. Tsɔ akɔbli wɔ kpɔtiawoe, eye nàtsɔ akɔbli ke awɔ afɔ zekpe ɖe ɖe sia ɖe gɔme be wòate ŋu alí ɖe tsitrenu. Ke nàtsɔ klosalo awɔ kpɔtiawo ŋu gaviwo kple helétiwoe.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Tsi mɔnuvɔ ɖe agboa ŋutɔ nu hã. Mɔnuvɔ sia nadidi meta asieke. Tsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzẽtɔ, ka dzẽ kple atitsroka si wotro la lɔ̃e, eye nàtsɔ abui ata nuwo ɖe eto. Tsɔ akɔblikpɔti ene siwo te afɔ zekpe le la lée ɖe enɔƒe.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Nu siwo katã ŋudɔ woawɔ le agbadɔa me hã nanye akɔblinuwo. Agbadɔ la ŋu tsyotiwo kple kpɔa ŋu tɔwo katã hã nanye akɔbli. Beléle na akaɖi la (Mos III,

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Aron kple via ŋutsuwo nanɔ edzi kpɔm. Woakpɔ egbɔ be wòanɔ bibim gbe sia gbe, tso fiẽ va se ɖe ŋdi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, le xɔmetsovɔ si godo nubablaɖaka la le la ŋgɔ. Ele na Israelviwo be woawɔ ɖe ɖoɖo sia dzi tegbee tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: “Azɔ ɖe nɔviwò ŋutsu Aron kple via ŋutsuwo, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar kple Itamar, le Israelviwo dome te ɖe ɖokuiwò ŋu ne woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Yɔ ame siwo katã ŋu ŋutete le, ame siwo mede aɖaŋu tagbɔ na la ƒo ƒu ne woatɔ Aron ƒe awuawo be woaɖo eyama nunɔla nam.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Awu vovovo siwo woatɔ la woe nye: akɔtaɖonu, kɔmewu, dziwui, awutewui ʋlaya, tablanu kple alidziblanu. Woatɔ nunɔlawu siawo na nɔviwò Aron kple via ŋutsuawo, be woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: “Awuawo tɔlawo natsɔ lãfuka blɔtɔ, hẽtɔ kple dzẽtɔ, sikaka kple awuvɔ biɖibiɖi atɔ woe.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Nàtsɔ ka si wogbe kple sika nyuitɔ la awɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ eve, eye nàtɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔawo ɖe gboawo ŋu. Akɔtaɖonu la (Mos II,

english_verse: and engrave on each of them the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Kpeawo nanɔ wui eve ɖe Israel viŋutsuawo nu. Ŋkɔɖelawo naɖe woƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe wo dzi, kpe ɖeka ŋkɔ ɖeka, be woanye Israel-to wui eveawo ƒe dzesi.

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: “Wɔ akɔtaɖonu si anye nyametsonu. Wɔ nyametsotso akɔtaɖonu sia kple aɖaŋu si nètsɔ wɔ kɔmewu lae. Wɔ atsiã ɖe eya hã to abe ale si nèwɔe ɖe kɔmewua to ene.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Nàɖo kpe xɔasiwo ɖe eŋu ɖe agbaka ene me. Agbaka gbãtɔ nanye karneol, topas kple smaragd;

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: agbaka evelia nanye rubin, safir kple oniks;

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: agbaka etɔ̃lia nanye ligurio, axat kple ametist,

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: eye agbaka enelia nanye krisolit, soham kple yaspis. Woatsɔ sika aƒo fefeka ɖe wo ŋu godoo akpe ɖo.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Eyome nàde kɔsɔkɔsɔ eveawo ƒe nu eveawo gbo eveawo ŋu, eye nàtɔ gboawo ɖe kɔmewu la ƒe abɔtawo le ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Woagbe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka asa ɖe asigɛ siwo le akɔtaɖonu la ŋuti la ŋu ahade asigɛ siwo le kɔmewua ŋuti la me, ale be akɔtaɖonu la manɔ ʋaʋãm o, eye wòanɔ akɔgbanu la dzi.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: Emegbe nàtsɔ aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka ɖeɖe alɔ̃ dziwui si dzi woado kɔmewu la ɖo.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Woaɖe kɔme nɛ ɖe titina, afi si woaƒo ta ɖo eye woaƒo kɔme la to akpe, be magadze o.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Sikanyawowoe ɖeka yevuboɖa ɖeka, sikanyawowoe ɖeka yevuboɖa ɖeka; alea woanɔ dziwui la to godoo ava kpee.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Woanɔ Aron ŋu, ne ele subɔsubɔm, eye woanɔ ɖiɖim woase, ne eyi kɔkɔeƒe la le Aƒetɔ ŋkume alo wòdo go, ne menye nenema o la, aku.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Tsɔ sika nyuitɔ wɔ kpe gbadzɛ aɖe eye woaŋlɔ nu ɖe edzi abe ale si woŋlɔa ŋkɔdzesi ene be ‘Ele kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ.’

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Tsii ɖe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ ƒe ka ŋuti le tablanu la ŋu le ŋgɔ.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Anɔ Aron ƒe ŋgonu, ale Aron axɔ fɔɖiɖi siwo anɔ Israelviwo ƒe nunana siwo ŋu wokɔ ŋu la aɖo eɖokui dzi. Anɔ eƒe ŋgonu ɖaa bene woƒe nunanawo nadze Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: “Azɔ nàlɔ̃ awutewui ʋlaya, alidziblanu kple tablanu na Aron viŋutsuawo bene wòade bubu wo ŋu, eye wòaɖo atsyɔ̃ na wo.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Do nu siawo na nɔviwò ŋutsu Aron kple via ŋutsuawo, eyome nàsi ami na wo aɖo wo, akɔ wo ŋu bene woazu nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Nàtɔ agbotɛ ɣi siwo nadidi tso alime ava se klonu la na wo bene woƒe ama me nagadze o.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Aron kple via ŋutsuawo nado wo hafi ayi ɖe agbadɔ si me Aƒetɔ ɖea eɖokui fiana le la. Ele na wo hã be woado wo hafi ate ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, awɔ subɔsubɔdɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la ne woagaɖi fɔ eye woaku o. Esia nanye ɖoɖo na eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo tegbee.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Gbe sia gbe la, nàwu nyitsu ɖeka hena nuvɔ̃vɔsa abe avulénu ene. Ɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le vɔsamlekpui la ŋu to avulénuawo mème le edzi me, eye nàsi ami nɛ awɔe kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Fɔ wo de kusi me tsɔ ɖe asi, eye nàkplɔ nyitsu la kple agbo eveawo vɛ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Kplɔ Aron kple via ŋutsuawo va godoƒegbadɔ la nu eye nale tsi na wo.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Fɔ awuawo vɛ, eye nàdo awutewui ʋlaya la kple dziwui la kpakple kɔmewu la na Aron. Gba wo dzi nɛ kple akɔtagbanu eye nàtsɔ akɔtaɖonu la aɖo eŋu.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Azɔ tsɔ ami sisi la nakɔ ɖe eƒe tame eye nàsii nɛ.

english_verse: caps, and sashes, then ordain them, because they and their descendants will always be priests.
translation_verse: Bla ali dzi na wo eye nàbla tablanu la hã na wo; ekema nunɔladɔ la azu wo tɔ tegbee. Aleae nàɖo Aron kple via ŋutsuawo nunɔlawoe.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Eyome kplɔ nyitsua va godoƒegbadɔa nu. Aron kple via ŋutsuawo nava tsɔ asi aɖo eƒe tame,

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: eye nàwu nyitsua le Aƒetɔ ŋkume le godoƒegbadɔ la ƒe ʋɔtru nu.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: De asibidɛ nyitsua ƒe ʋu me nàtsɔ asisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, eye nàtsɔ ʋu mamlɛa akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpuia te.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Ke nàtɔ dzo nyitsua ƒe lã, eƒe agbalẽ kple mi siwo le dɔme nɛ la le asaɖa la godo, elabe nuvɔ̃vɔsae.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Azɔ he agbo ɖeka vɛ, eye Aron kple via ŋutsuwo natsɔ woƒe asiwo ada ɖe agbo la ƒe tame.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Wu agbo la eye nàtsɔ eƒe ʋu awu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Fli agbo la kakɛkakɛe, nàklɔ dɔmenuawo kple afɔawo eye nàtsɔ wo akpe ɖe eƒe lã mamlɛa kple eƒe ta ŋu.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nàtɔ dzo agbo bliboa katã ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi; numemevɔsa wònye na Aƒetɔ. Enye ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ ƒe dzo si dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Emegbe nàhe agbo evelia vɛ, eye Aron kple via ŋutsuawo natsɔ woƒe asiwo ada ɖe agbo la ƒe tame.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Wu agbo la nàtsɔ eƒe ʋu asisi ɖe Aron kple via ŋutsuwo ƒe nuɖusi togboewo, nuɖusi degblefetsuwo kple nuɖusifɔ degblefetsuwo ŋu, eye nàtsɔ ʋu mamlɛa awu ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu godoo ava kpe.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Eyome tsɔ ʋu si le vɔsamlekpuia dzi la ƒe ɖe kple amisiname la ƒe ɖe awu ɖe Aron kple eƒe awuwo ŋu. Gawu ʋua kple amisiname la ƒe ɖe ɖe via ŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuwo hã ŋu. Ekema Aron ŋutɔ kple eƒe awuwo azu kɔkɔe, eye via ŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuwo hã ŋuti akɔ.”

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: “Azɔ nàɖe ami le agboa ŋu, ɖe asikɛ la kple eŋu miwo, ɖe ami si le eƒe dɔmenuawo ŋu, ɖe ami si le eƒe aklã kple ayiku eveawo ŋu eye nàɖe agboa ƒe nuɖusita elabe ameɖoɖo Mawu ƒe dɔ nu ƒe agboe.

english_verse: Take one loaf of each kind of bread from the basket,
translation_verse: Tsɔ abolo bɔbɔe ɖeka, aboŋgo ɖeka kple tatali ɖeka siwo nye nu maʋamaʋãwo le Aƒetɔ ŋkume le kusia me.

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Tsɔ nuawo katã nàde asiƒome na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo, eye nànyè nuawo le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Emegbe nàxɔ nuawo le wo si ada ɖe vɔsalã la dzi le vɔsamlekpuia dzi, eye nàtɔ dzo wo, bene woaʋẽ lililĩ ɖe Aƒetɔ; Aƒetɔ ƒe dzovɔsa wònye.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: “Ɖe agbo si wowu tsɔ ɖo Aron la ƒe akɔ eye nànyèe le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, emegbe wòazu tɔwò.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Aron viŋutsu si zu nunɔla ɖe eteƒe la nado wo ŋkeke adrẽ, ne wòva godoƒegbadɔ la me be wòasubɔ le kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: “Tsɔ agbo si wowu tsɔ ɖo Aron kple via ŋutsuawo ƒe lã, eye nàɖae le teƒe kɔkɔe aɖe.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Aron kple via ŋutsuawo natsɔ abolo si le kusia me aɖu agbolã la le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Ale woaɖu nu mawo siwo wotsɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le wo ŋu hewɔ wo kɔkɔe hafi ɖo wo la; ke ame bubu aɖeke mekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu mawo o, elabe nu kɔkɔe wonye.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: “Alea ye nàwɔ na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo abe ale si megblɔ na wò ene la tututu; ŋkeke adrẽ sɔŋ nàtsɔ aɖo woe.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adrẽ sɔŋ nàmè avulénuwo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye nàwɔe kɔkɔe ale be vɔsamlekpui la nazu nu kɔkɔetɔ kekeake. Nu sia nu si aka vɔsamlekpui la ŋu la, azu kɔkɔe. Gbe sia gbe vɔsawo (Mos IV,

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Mè alẽvi ɖeka le ŋdi me, eye nàgamè ɖeka le fiẽ me.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Mè alẽvi evelia le fiẽ me eye nàwɔ nuɖuɖuvɔsa kple nunonovɔsa siwo kpe ɖe eŋu la abe ŋdi me tɔ ene. Esia anye dzovɔsa si aʋẽ lililĩ ɖe Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Makɔ̀ godoƒegbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpuia ŋu, eye makɔ̀ Aron kple via ŋutsuawo ŋuti be woanye nunɔlawo asubɔm.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Manɔ Israelviwo dome eye manye woƒe Mawu.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Woadze sii be nyee nye Aƒetɔ, woƒe Mawu si kplɔ wo dzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi, be manɔ wo dome. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, woƒe Mawu.

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Migawɔ lifidzudzɔdonu si miawɔ la tɔgbe aɖeke na mia ɖokui o, ke boŋ miabui nu kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: Tsɔ wo wɔ ami kɔkɔe lae abe ale si ami ʋeʋẽe ɖalawo wɔna la ene; ami kɔkɔe si woasi na nu wòanye.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: numemevɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu nuwo katã kple tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ hã.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: “Tsɔ xé wɔ vɔsamlekpui si dzi woado lifidzudzɔ ɖo.

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.
translation_verse: Fa sika nyuitɔ ɖe eŋu katã; etame, ekɔgo kple eƒe dzoawo ŋu, eye nàtsɔ sika do atsiã ɖe eŋu kpe ɖo.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Wɔ sikasigɛ eveve ɖe eƒe axa eveawo dzi, ɖe atsiãdodo la te, bene woaƒo kpo ɖe eme akɔe.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Tsɔ xé kpa kpoawo, eye nàfa sika ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Tsɔ vɔsamlekpui sia ɖo xɔmetsovɔ, si megbe nubablaɖaka si dzi wotsyɔ nui la, le la ŋgɔ. Afi siae mado go wò le.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Migatsɔ lifi makɔmakɔ aɖeke va edzi o; migatsɔ numemevɔsa alo nuɖuɖuvɔsa bubu aɖeke hã va edzi o, eye migakɔ nunonovɔsa hã ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Aron natsɔ nuvɔ̃ vɔsalã si nye avulénu la ƒe ʋu aɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eƒe dzowo ŋu, zi ɖeka le ƒè ɖeka me. Awɔ nu sia ƒè sia ƒè tso dzidzime yi dzidzime; nu kɔkɔetɔ kekeake wònye na Aƒetɔ.” Nudzɔdzɔ hena Aƒetɔ Nɔƒegbadɔ la

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “Ne èle Israel-dukɔa me tɔwo xlẽm la, ekema ame ɖe sia ɖe naxe fe ɖe eƒe agbe ta na Aƒetɔ, ne èxlẽ wo, be dɔ vɔ̃ɖi aɖeke magaɖo wo dome, esi woxlẽ wo la ta o.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Nàzã ga si Israel-dukɔa me tɔwo na ɖe woƒe agbe ta ɖe godoƒegbadɔ la ƒe dɔ ŋu, bene wòanye ŋkuɖodzinu kple avulénu na Israel-dukɔ la le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.” Akɔblitsileze la

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si awɔ etɔgbe be yeawɔ eŋudɔ abe ami ʋeʋẽe ene la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔmetɔwo dome.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: Make a large bronze bowl and a bronze stand for it. Then put them between the altar for sacrifice and the sacred tent, so the priests can wash their hands and feet before entering the tent or offering a sacrifice on the altar. Each priest in every generation must wash himself in this way, or else he will die right there. The Oil for Dedication and Ordination (Exodus
translation_verse: Ele be woaklɔ asi kple afɔ, ne menye nenema o la, woaku. Esia nanye ɖoɖo si dzi woawɔ tegbee; enye ɖoɖo na eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo gɔ̃ hã le woƒe dzidzimewo katã me.” Ami kɔkɔe la

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Kɔ wo ŋuti be woazu nu kɔkɔetɔwo kekeake, ale be nu sia nu si aka wo ŋu la, nazu kɔkɔe.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Gawu la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: for dedicating the tent and chest,
translation_verse: Sii na godoƒegbadɔ la, nubablaɖaka la,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: kplɔ̃ la kple eŋu nuwo katã, akaɖiti la kple eŋu nuwo katã, lifivɔsamlekpui la,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Si ami na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo nam, awɔ wo kɔkɔe, be woasubɔm abe nunɔlawo ene.

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Israelviwo be: ‘Esia anye nye ami kɔkɔe si woasi na nu le miaƒe dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Womasii na ame ɖe sia ɖe o, eye womawɔ etɔgbe hã o; ele kɔkɔe eye wòanye nu kɔkɔe na mi.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe wɔ ami sia ƒomevi alo sii na ame aɖe si mele be woasii na hafi o la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa le eƒe dukɔmetɔwo dome.’ ” Lifi la

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wo wɔ lifidzudzɔdonui abe ale si ami ʋeʋẽe wɔlawo wɔnɛ ene. De dze eme be wòadza anɔ kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Tu eƒe sue aɖe memee eye nàtsɔe da ɖe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ le agbadɔ la me, afi si mado go wò le. Nu kɔkɔetɔ kekeake wòanye na mi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meyɔ Bezaleel, Uri viŋutsu si nye Xur ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi tso Yuda-to la me.

english_verse: Not only have I filled him with my Spirit, but I have given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.
translation_verse: anya ale si woadze kpe hena nuwo me dede, eye wòanya ale si woadze ati hena aɖaŋu vovovowo wɔwɔe.

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metia Oholiab, Axisamak viŋutsu tso Dan-to la me kpe ɖe eŋu, eye mena nunya ame siwo katã ŋu ŋutete le la, be woate ŋu awɔ nu siwo katã meɖo na mi be miawɔ la:

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israel-dukɔ la be: ‘Miɖo ŋku nye dzudzɔgbeawo dzi, elabe esia nye dzesi le nye kple miawo kpakple miaƒe dzidzimeawo dome, ne mianyae be nye Aƒetɔ, ye wɔ mi kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adee woawɔ dɔ, ke ŋkeke adrẽlia nye dzudzɔgbe, ŋkeke kɔkɔe na gbɔɖeme na Aƒetɔ. Ame sia ame si wɔ dɔ aɖe le dzudzɔgbe la, ele be woawui.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Enye dzesi mavɔ le nye kple Israel-dukɔ la dome be ŋkeke ade mee Aƒetɔ wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba, eye le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, wògbɔ ɖe eme heɖi ɖe eme nyuie.’ ”

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Esi wòƒo nu kple Mose vɔ le Sinai-to dzi la, etsɔ kpe eveawo, siwo dzi sea le la nɛ; kpe siwo dzi Mawu ŋutɔ tsɔ eƒe asibidɛ ŋlɔ nu ɖo la.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Eme kɔ be dukɔ sia la, dukɔ kɔlialiatɔ wonye.

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Le ŋufɔke ŋdi kanya la, wowɔ numemevɔsawo, eye wotsɔ ŋutifafavɔsawo vɛ. Dukɔ la bɔbɔ nɔ anyi, ɖu nu, no nu, eyome wotso eye wode asi fefe me.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na wo be: “Egbe la, mia dome ame sia ame ɖo eɖokui nunɔlae, be yeawɔ dɔ na Aƒetɔ. Ame sia ame tsɔ via ŋutsu alo nɔvia ŋutsu sa vɔe, be wòakɔ yayra ɖe mia dzi.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Esi Israelviwo kpɔ be Mose tsi toa dzi ŋutɔ, mele gbɔgbɔm o la, woƒo wo ɖokui nu ƒu, yi Aron gbɔ eye wogblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, wɔ mawu na mí, ne wòanɔ mía ŋgɔ le míaƒe mɔzɔzɔa me elabe míenya nu si dzɔ ɖe ŋutsu, Mose ma, si kplɔ mí dzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi la dzi o.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Aron gblɔ na wo be: “Miɖe sikatogɛ siwo le mia srɔ̃wo, mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo ƒe towo me la vɛ nam.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Aron xɔ wo, lólo, tsɔ pɛ trɔ asi le eŋu eye wòtsɔe kɔ̀ sikanyivii. Tete wogblɔ be: “O! Israel, wò mawuwoe nye esiawo! Woawoe kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi!”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Tete Aron ɖi vɔsamlekpui ɖe sikanyivi la ŋgɔ, eye wòdo kpó na dukɔa be: “Etsɔ la, míaɖu ŋkekenyui na Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Ɖi toa nàyi. Wò dukɔa, ame siwo nèkplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la wɔ nu gbegblẽ.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Wotra mɔ xoxo; wokɔ̀ nyivi na wo ɖokui de ta agu nɛ le esubɔm. Wosa vɔ nɛ gɔ̃, eye wole gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Wò mawue nye esia, O Israel; eyae kplɔ wò dzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi.’ ”

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Na mafiãe ɖe eme na wo; matsrɔ̃ wo. Ke wò la, mawɔ wò nàzu dukɔ gã aɖe.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Gake Mose ƒo koko na Aƒetɔ, eƒe Mawu la, be: “O, Aƒetɔ, ale ke nàtsɔ ŋusẽ triakɔ kple kalẽsi akplɔ wò dukɔ adzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi vɔ ko ana wò dɔmedzoe nabi ɖe wo ŋu flaflafla ale?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Ale ke nàna mɔnu Egiptetɔwo nanɔ gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Vɔ̃ wòɖo ɖe wo ŋu tae wòkplɔ wo dzoe! Ɖe wòkplɔ wo dzoe be yeaɖawu le towo dome, ne yeatsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le anyigba dzia? Na wò dɔmedzoe sesẽ la nu nabɔbɔ, eye wò dzi nafa. Mègawɔ nu si nèɖo be yeawɔ atsɔ he to na wò dukɔ la o.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò dɔla Abraham, wò dɔla Isak kple wò dɔla Israel, ame siwo wò ŋutɔ nèka atam na be: ‘Mana miaƒe dzidzimeviwo asɔ gbɔ abe ɣletiviwo ene, eye matsɔ anyigba blibo sia si ŋugbe medo la ana miaƒe dzidzimeviwo be wòanye wo tɔ tegbee’ la dzi.”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ƒe tame trɔ eye wòɖe asi le dzɔgbevɔ̃e gã si wòɖo ɖe eƒe dukɔa ŋu la ŋu.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Esi Yosua se dukɔa ƒe ɣli la, egblɔ na Mose be: “Aʋaɣli le ɖiɖim le asaɖa la me!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Ke Mose xɔ edzi be: “Menye dziɖuɣli alo aʋasiameɣli sem mele o; ke boŋ hadzidzi sem mele.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Esi wòte tu asaɖa la eye wòkpɔ nyivi la kple ale si amewo le ɣe ɖumee la, dɔme vee ale gbegbe be wòxlã kpe siwo wòlé ɖe asi la ɖi, wogbã ɖe toa te.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Exɔ nyivi si wowɔ la le wo si, tɔ dzoe wòfiã. Etui memie wòzu wɔ. Ekɔe ɖe tsi me, eye wòna Israelviwo noe.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Tete Mose bia Aron be: “Nu ka dukɔ sia wɔ wò ta nèhe wo de nuvɔ̃ gã me ale?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Aron ɖo eŋu be: “Nye aƒetɔ, meɖe kuku, mègado dziku o; wò ŋutɔ ènya dukɔa be nu gbegblẽ ko wowɔna ɖe!

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Elabe wogblɔ nam be: “Wɔ mawu siwo adze ŋgɔ na mí la na mí, elabe Mose, ŋutsu ma, si kplɔ mí dzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi la, míenya nu si dzɔ ɖe edzi o.’

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Ale megblɔ na wo be: ‘Ame si si sika le la netsɔe vɛ nam.’ Wotsɔe vɛ nam eye metsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe dzo me ko wòtrɔ zu nyivi sia.”

english_verse: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.
translation_verse: Mose kpɔ be dukɔ la dze aglã le Aron ƒe nuwɔna ta eye wodo ŋukpe wo ɖokui le woƒe futɔwo ŋkume.

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Eya ta eyi ɖatsi tsitre ɖe asaɖa la ƒe agbo nu, eye wòdo ɣli be: “Ame kae le Aƒetɔ ƒe akpa dzi? Neva gbɔnye afii!” Tete Levi viwo katã yi egbɔ.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: Ŋutsu sia ŋutsu nesa eƒe yi ɖe ali. Mige ɖe asaɖa la me, tso afii yi afi mɛ, tso agbo nu yi agbo nu. Ame sia ame newu nɔvia ŋutsu, xɔlɔ̃a kple eƒe aƒelika.”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Levi viwo wɔ nu si Mose gblɔ, eye ŋutsu akpe etɔ̃ lɔƒo ku le dukɔ la me gbe ma gbe.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Le ŋufɔke la, Mose gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Miewɔ nuvɔ̃ gã ŋutɔ, eya ta magalia to la ayi Aƒetɔ gbɔ. Ɖewohĩ mate ŋu alé avui le miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Ale Mose gatrɔ yi Aƒetɔ gbɔ gblɔ be: “Ao, Aƒetɔ! Dukɔ sia wɔ nuvɔ̃ gã ŋutɔ; wowɔ sikamawuwo na wo ɖokui.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Meɖe kuku, tsɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃ ke wo, ne menye nenema o la, ekema ɖeko nàtutu nye ŋkɔ ɖa le agbalẽ si nèŋlɔ la me.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Ame si wɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye la eya ƒe ŋkɔe matutu ɖa le nye agbalẽ me.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, heyi nàɖakplɔ dukɔ la yi afi si megblɔ na wò. Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔla adze ŋgɔwò. Gake gbe si gbe mava srã wo kpɔ la mava kple woƒe nuvɔ̃ ŋu tohehe.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖo dɔ vɔ̃ ɖe dukɔ la dome, elabe wona Aron wɔ nyivi na wo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Dzo, dzo le afi sia, wò kple dukɔ si nèkplɔ tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, ne miayi anyigba si ŋu meka atam ɖo na Abraham, Isak kple Yakob be, ‘Miaƒe dzidzimeviwo matsɔe ana’ la dzi.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Miyi anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la dzi; ke nyemanɔ mia dome ayi kpli mi o, ne menye nenema o la, matsrɔ̃ mi le mɔ dzi, elabe dukɔ kɔlialiatɔ mienye.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Elabe do ŋgɔ la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be: ‘Dukɔ kɔlialiatɔe mienye. Ne mezɔ kpli mi aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka pɛ ko hã la, matsrɔ̃ mi keŋkeŋ. Miɖe miaƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo katã da ɖi ne manya nu si mawɔ mi.”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Eya ta Israelviwo megadoa woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo tso Xoreb-to la gbɔ heyi o. Aƒetɔ Nɔƒegbadɔ

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Azɔ la Mose tu Aƒetɔ Nɔƒegbadɔ ɖe asaɖa la godo, ɖe adzɔge ke. Eyɔe be godoƒegbadɔ. Ame sia ame si di be yeabia nu Aƒetɔ la yia godoƒegbadɔ la gbɔ le asaɖa la godo.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Ne Mose yina agbadɔ la gbɔ la, ameawo katã tsona, eye ame sia ame tsia tre ɖe eƒe agbadɔ ƒe mɔnu nɔa Mose kpɔm va se ɖe esime wòge ɖe agbadɔ la me.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ ƒoa nu kple Mose ŋkume kple ŋkume abe xɔlɔ̃ kple xɔlɔ̃ ene. Eyome Mose gatrɔna vaa asaɖa la me. Ke eƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ Yosua, Nun vi, ɖekakpui la ya medzona le agbadɔ la gbɔ o. Aƒetɔ do ŋugbe be yeanɔ kple yeƒe dukɔ la

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aƒetɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, ègblɔ nam be: ‘Kplɔ dukɔ sia’ gake meyɔ ame si dɔ ge nèle be wòakpe ɖe ŋunye la ŋkɔ nam o. Evɔ ègblɔ be: ‘Menya wò, nya wò ŋkɔ, eye mekpɔ ŋudzedze le ŋuwò’ hafi.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Eya ta, azɔ la, meɖe kuku, ne èkpɔ ŋudzedze le ŋunye la, ekema na manya wò mɔwo, eye madze sii be èkpɔ ŋudzedze le ŋunye nyateƒe. Bu eŋu hã be dukɔ sia la, wò ŋutɔ wò dukɔe.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu be: “Mazɔ kpli mi ayi, eye mana miaɖagbɔ ɖe eme.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Mose xɔ edzi be: “Ne màzɔ kplim o la, ekema mègana míaho adzo le afi sia o.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ne mèzɔ kpli mí o la, ale ke amewo awɔ anya be èkpɔ ŋudzedze le nye kple wò dukɔ la siaa ŋu? Menye wò zɔzɔ kpli mi mee woakpɔe adze sii le be nye kple wò dukɔ la míeto vovo le anyigba dzi dukɔ bubuwo katã dome oa?”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Nu si tututu nèbia la, mawɔe elabe meve nu wò, eye menya wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Mose be: “Meɖe kuku, na makpɔ wò ŋutikɔkɔe la.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Mana nye atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo blibo la ava to ŋkuwò me ayi, eye maɖe gbeƒã nye ŋkɔ le ŋgɔwò be ‘Aƒetɔ lae’. Ame sinu medi be mave la, eya nue mave, eye ame si melɔ̃ be makpɔ nublanui nala, eyae makpɔ nublanui na.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Gake nyemana nàkpɔ nye ŋkume ya o, elabe ame aɖeke mate ŋu akpɔ nye ŋkume aganɔ agbe o.”

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ yi edzi be: “Kpɔ ɖa, teƒe aɖe le gbɔnye le afii, afi si nàtsi tsitre ɖe agakpe dzi le,

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: eye ne nye ŋutikɔkɔe la va yina la, maɣla wò ɖe agakpe la to me, atsyɔ asi dziwò va se ɖe esime matso eme ayi.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Eyome mahe asi ɖa eye nàkpɔ nye megbe ɖa; ke nye ŋkume ya la, màkpɔe o.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mebla nu kpli wò. Mele nukunu siwo ƒomevi womewɔ le anyigba blibo la dzi alo le dukɔ aɖeke me kpɔ o la wɔ ge le wò dukɔ blibo la ŋkume. Dukɔ blibo si dome nèle la akpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nukunu, elabe nu dziŋɔ wònye wɔ ge mala.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Dzra ɖo, etsɔ ŋdi nàlia Sinai-to la naɖanɔ lalayem le etame.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke megalia to la kpli wò o. Mègana woakpɔ ame aɖeke le to bliboa ƒe afi aɖeke o; mègana alẽha alo nyiha hã nava ɖu gbe le toa gbɔ o.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ale Mose kpa kpe eve abe gbatɔ̃awo ene. Efɔ ŋufɔke ŋdi kanya, tsɔ kpeawo ɖe asi eye wòlia to la yi etame abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ nɛ ene.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Tete wòva to Mose ŋkume yina, eye wòɖe gbeƒã be: “Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ, Mawu nublanuikpɔla kple amenuvela, ame si gbɔa dzi blewuu eye eƒe amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ sɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete Mose wɔ kaba, de ta agu eye wòdo gbe ɖa.

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, ne èkpɔ ŋudzedze le ŋunye azɔ la, Aƒetɔ, meɖe kuku, va kplɔ mí yii. Togbɔ be dukɔ kɔlialiatɔe nye dukɔ sia hã la, tsɔ míaƒe vodadawo kple míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke mí, eye nàgalɔ̃ axɔ mí abe wò domenyinu ene.” Wogbugbɔ nubabla la wɔ yeyee (Mos II,

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ele na wò ŋutsuwo katã be woava Aƒetɔ, Mawu la, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ŋkume zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si ʋu dɔ nu na nɔa la, tɔnyee. Wò lãwo ƒe ŋgɔgbevi siwo nye atsu, nyi o, alẽ o, tɔnyee.

english_verse: Your men will even marry their women and be influenced to worship their gods.
translation_verse: Eyome àɖe wo vinyɔnuwo na viwò ŋutsuwo, eye ne wo vinyɔnuwo le woƒe trɔ̃nuwo wɔm la, woana viwò ŋutsuwo hã nasubɔ woƒe mawuawo.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: “Mègakɔ̀ mawu aɖeke na ɖokuiwò o.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: “Lé ŋku ɖe se siwo dem mele na wò egbe la ŋu. Kpɔ ɖa, manyà Amoritɔwo, Kanaanitɔwo, Xititɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Xivitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo ɖa le mia ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nyuie be nàgabla nu kple anyigba si dzi yim miele la dzi tɔwo o, be womagava zu mɔ̀ ɖe mia dome o.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ mimu woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, migbã woƒe legbawo, eye mitso woƒe nyɔnumawu Asera-tiwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Mègabla nu kple anyigba la dzi tɔwo gbeɖe o. Ne menye nenema o la, ne wole woƒe trɔ̃nuwo wɔm la, woayɔ wò be nàva ɖu woƒe vɔsanuawo.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Ɖo ŋku Abolo Maʋamaʋã Ŋkeke Nyui la dzi mianɔ ɖuɖum. Ɖu abolo si me womede amɔwɔʋãnui o la ŋkeke adrẽ le nuŋeɣleti, Abib, me abe ale si meɖoe na mi la ene, elabe ɣleti, Abib, mee mieʋu dzo le Egipte.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Gake ne tedzi dzi vi gbãtɔ wònye atsu la, ele be nàtsɔ alẽvi aɖɔlii, eye ne maɖɔlii o la, ekema nàŋe kɔ le enu. Ele be miaɖɔli miaƒe viŋutsu ŋgɔgbeawo katã ta. Ame aɖeke megava ŋkunye me asi ƒuƒlu o.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: “Wɔ dɔ ŋkeke ade, eye nàdzudzɔ le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe. Nuŋlɔɣi wòɖanye o, nuŋeɣi wòɖanye o, dzudzɔ ɖokuiwò.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: Ɖu kwasiɖawo ƒe ŋkekenyui la, ne ède asi lu gbãtɔwo ŋeŋe me, eye nàɖu avaɖoɖoŋkekenyui le ƒea ƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Elabe manyà dukɔwo ɖa le ŋgɔwò eye makeke wò liƒowo ɖe enu. Ne èyi Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ŋkume zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me la, wò anyigba madzro ame aɖeke o.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: “Mègatsɔ nye vɔsalã ƒe ʋu sa vɔe kpe ɖe amɔwɔʋãnu ŋu o. Mègagblẽ lã si nàtsɔ sa vɔe le Paska ɖugbe la ƒe ɖeke ɖi ŋu nake ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: Ƒe sia ƒe la, nàtsɔ wò agblemenuku gbãtɔ si nèŋe la va Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me. Mègaɖa gbɔ̃vi le nɔa ƒe notsi me o.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Ŋlɔ nya siawo ɖi, elabe nya siawo dzie mebla nu kpli wò kple Israel ɖo.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Esi Mose lé kpe eveawo, siwo dzi Se Ewoawo le la ɖe asi, eye wòɖi tso Sinai-toa dzi gbɔna la, eƒe mo nɔ keklẽm, esi wòƒo nu kple Aƒetɔ ta, gake menya o.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Aron kple Israelviwo ƒe ha blibo la kpɔ be eƒe mo nɔ keklẽm. Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo eye womedi be yewoate ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Ke Mose do ɣli yɔ wo le adzɔge. Aron kple ameha la ƒe kplɔlawo yi egbɔ azɔ, eye wòƒo nu kpli wo.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Eyome Israel-ha blibo la va ƒo ƒu ɖe eŋu. Tete wògblɔ se siwo katã Aƒetɔ de na dukɔa le toa dzi la na wo.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Esi wòƒo nu kpli wo vɔ la, etsɔ motsyɔvɔ tsyɔ mo.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Ɣe sia ɣi si wòyina ɖe godoƒegbadɔ la me be yeaƒo nu kple Aƒetɔ la, eɖea motsyɔvɔ la ɖa le mo. Ne edo go va le Aƒetɔ ƒe gbedeasiwo gblɔm na dukɔa la,

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: Israelviwo kpɔna be eƒe mo le keklẽm. Tete wògatsɔa motsyɔvɔ la tsyɔa mo va se ɖe esime ɣeyiɣia gaɖona wògayina ɖaƒoa nu kple Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Miwɔ dɔ ŋkeke ade, ke ŋkeke adrẽlia nye dzudzɔgbe; ele kɔkɔe eye wònye Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke. Ame sia ame si awɔ dɔ aɖe le edzi la, woawui.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ ado dzo gɔ̃ hã le miaƒe nɔƒewo le dzudzɔgbe la dzi o.” Nuwo dzɔdzɔ na Agbadɔ kɔkɔe la (Mos II,

english_verse: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu siwo nya ɖetitetre la tre aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ɖeti, dzẽtɔ kple ɣitɔ ƒe ɖeti tsɔ vɛ.

english_verse: onyx stones or other gems for the sacred vest and breastpiece.
translation_verse: sohamkpe kple kpe xɔasiwo, ne woatsɔ ɖo nunɔlagã ƒe kɔmewu kple akɔtaɖonu ŋu. Nu tɔxɛ aɖewo na Aƒetɔ Nɔƒegbadɔ la (Mos II,

english_verse: And he has given them all kinds of artistic skills, including the ability to design and embroider with blue, purple, and red wool and to weave fine linen.
translation_verse: Ede aɖaŋu wo ame evea ƒe susu me ale gbegbe be wotea ŋu wɔa aɖaŋudɔ ƒomevi vovovowo abe nuwo ƒe dzedzeme ɖeɖe ɖe kpe, ati alo ga dzi, nutata ɖe avɔ me, avɔ biɖibiɖi lɔlɔ̃, avɔlɔlɔ̃ kple lãfuka ene. Wonya dɔwɔla kple aɖaŋudɔwɔla ɖe sia ɖe ƒe dɔ.

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:
translation_verse: “Na ŋutsu ɖe sia ɖe si ŋu ŋutete le le mia dome la nava wɔ nu siwo katã Aƒetɔ di la:

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Israelviwo ƒe ha blibo la be: “Nu si Aƒetɔ be miawɔ lae nye esi:

english_verse: I will welcome an offering from anyone who wants to give something. You may bring gold, silver, or bronze;
translation_verse: Midzɔ nu le mia nɔewo dome na Aƒetɔ. Ame sia ame si se le eƒe dzime be yeana nu faa la, netsɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nunana vɛ. Wonetsɔ sika, klosalo, akɔbli;

english_verse: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzẽtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ, ɖeti ɣi, avɔ si wotsɔ gbɔ̃fu lɔ̃,

english_verse: tanned ram skin or fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: agbogbalẽ si wode ama dzẽe, gbɔ̃gbalẽ, xeti,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices for the oil of dedication and for the incense; or
translation_verse: akaɖimemi, ami sisi si ʋẽna lililĩ, lifi si ʋẽna lililĩ,

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;
translation_verse: nubablaɖaka la kple eŋu kpoawo, amenuvezikpui la kple xɔmetsovɔ la;

english_verse: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: kplɔ̃ la kple eŋu kpoawo, eŋu gbawo katã, kple vɔsabolo la;

english_verse: the lamp with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: akaɖiti la, eŋu nuwo, akaɖigbɛawo kple akaɖimemi;

english_verse: the incense altar with its carrying poles and sweet-smelling incense; the ordination oil; the curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent;
translation_verse: lifivɔsamlekpui la kple eŋu kpoawo, ami sisi la kple lifi si ʋẽna lililĩ kpakple agbadɔnuvɔ;
