english_verse: the altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: numemevɔsamlekpui la kple adzrala si le eŋu si wotsɔ akɔbli wɔe, eŋu kpoawo kple eŋu gbaawo katã; tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ;

english_verse: the curtains with the posts and stands that go around the courtyard and the curtain at the entrance;
translation_verse: kplɔ̃ la ŋu vɔwo, kpɔtiawo kple woƒe afɔwo kple xɔxɔnua ƒe agbonuvɔ;

english_verse: the pegs and ropes for the tent and the courtyard;
translation_verse: agbadɔa ŋu tsyotiwo, kpɔtɔtɔa ŋu tsyotiwo kple woƒe kawo;

english_verse: Moses finished speaking, and everyone left.
translation_verse: Tete Israelviwo ƒe ha blibo la dzo le Mose ŋkume.

english_verse: Then those who wanted to bring gifts to the Lord, brought them to be used for the sacred tent, the worship services, and the priestly clothes.
translation_verse: Emegbe ame sia ame si wòdzɔ dzi na eye wòlɔ̃ kple dzi faa la, va dzɔ nu na Aƒetɔ bene woawɔ eŋudɔ na takpeƒedɔ la kple subɔsubɔdɔ siwo katã hiã le eŋu la kpakple na awu kɔkɔeawo.

english_verse: Men and women came willingly and gave all kinds of gold jewelry such as pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces.
translation_verse: Ale wova, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa, ame sia ame si lɔ̃ faa tso dzime ko la, tsɔ alɔnugawo, togɛwo, asigɛwo, sikakɔwlawo kple sikanu vovovowo va na. Ame sia ame kɔ̀ sikanu aɖe ŋu va na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame tsɔ nu si le esi abe aɖabɛ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ ƒe ka, ka dzẽ, ɖeti ɣi, gbɔ̃fu, agbogbalẽ kple gbɔ̃gbalẽ ene la va na.

english_verse: Anyone who had silver or bronze or acacia wood brought it as a gift to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ate ŋu ana klosalo alo akɔbli la tsɔe va na Aƒetɔ; ame sia ame si si xeti le la tsɔe va na hena dɔ vovovoawo wɔwɔ.

english_verse: And the women who knew how to make cloth from goat hair were glad to do so.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu siwo katã ƒe dzi ʋã eye ŋutete le wo ŋu la tre gbɔ̃fuwo.

english_verse: The leaders brought different kinds of jewels to be sewn on the special clothes and the breastpiece for the high priest.
translation_verse: Kplɔlawo tsɔ sohamkpe kple kpe xɔasiwo vɛ eye woatsɔ wo ɖo kɔmewu la kple akɔtaɖonu la ŋu.

english_verse: They also brought sweet-smelling spices to be mixed with the incense and olive oil that were for the lamps and for ordaining the priests.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ akaɖimemi, ami ʋeʋẽe si wosina kple lifi si ʋẽna lililĩ la hã vɛ.

english_verse: Moses had told the people what the Lord wanted them to do, and many of them decided to bring their gifts. Bezalel and Oholiab (Exodus
translation_verse: Ale Israelviwo, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa, ame siwo wòdzɔ dzi na eye wòlɔ̃ kple dzi faa be wòatsɔ nane ava na hena dɔ si Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be woawɔ la, tsɔe va na Aƒetɔ kple dzi faa. Aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo na Aƒetɔ Nɔƒegbadɔ la (Mos II,

english_verse: Moses said to the people of Israel: The Lord has chosen Bezalel of the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Israelviwo be: “Mikpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ tia Bezaleel, Uri viŋutsu, si nye Xur tɔgbuiyɔvi ame si tso Yuda-to la me la.

english_verse: Not only has the Lord filled him with his Spirit, but he has given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.
translation_verse: Enya ale si wòakpa kpe kple ale si wòatrɔ asi le ati ŋu awɔ nu wo tsyo ƒomevii.

english_verse: The Lord is urging him and Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to teach others.
translation_verse: Ede nunya tɔxɛ tame na eya kple Oholiab, Axisamak viŋutsu tso Dan-to la me be woate ŋu afia nu amewo.

english_verse: and he gave them the gifts that the people of Israel had donated for building the place of worship. In fact, so much was being given each morning,
translation_verse: Woxɔ lɔlɔ̃nu nunana siwo katã Israelviwo tsɔ vɛ be woatsɔ awɔ kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe dɔ la, le Mose si. Amewo ganɔ lɔlɔ̃nu faa nunanawo tsɔm vɛ nɛ kokoko ŋdi sia ŋdi.

english_verse: and said, “Moses, there is already more than we need for what the Lord has assigned us to do.”
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ na Mose be: “Dukɔ la tsɔ nu geɖe wu esi hiã na dɔ si Aƒetɔ be míawɔ la vɛ.”

english_verse: But there was already more than enough to do what needed to be done. The Curtains and Coverings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, nuawo sɔ gbɔ de dɔ la katã wɔwɔ nu xoxo, eye wògbɔ edzi gɔ̃ hã. Takpeƒegbadɔ la tutu (Mos II,

translation_verse: Xɔmetsovɔawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe didime nye meta wui eve, eye eƒe kekeme nye meta eve; avɔawo katã ƒe lolome sɔ.

translation_verse: Ekpe avɔ atɔ̃ ɖe wo nɔewo nu, eye wògakpe atɔ̃ hã ɖe wo nɔewo nu.

english_verse: These eleven sections were joined to make two panels, one with five and the other with six sections.
translation_verse: Ekpe avɔ atɔ̃ vovo, eye wòkpe ade hã vovo.

english_verse: Fifty loops were put along one of the wider sides of each panel,
translation_verse: Etɔ ka kotoe bla atɔ̃ ɖe avɔ kpekpea ƒe to ɖeka, eye wògatɔ ka kotoe bla atɔ̃ ɖe avɔ kpekpe evelia ƒe to ɖeka.

english_verse: and the two panels were fastened at the loops with
translation_verse: Etsɔ akɔbli tu ganuvi bla atɔ̃ hetsɔ kpe agbadɔvɔawo wozu ɖeka.

english_verse: Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.

translation_verse: Ewɔ gameti dometɔ wòto ʋɔtrutiawo titina, tso go ɖeka me va se ɖe go evelia dzi.

translation_verse: Efa sika ɖe ʋɔtrutiawo ŋu, eye wòtsɔ sika tu wo ŋu sigɛ siwo me woaƒo gametiawo ɖo; efa sika ɖe gametiawo hã ŋu.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.

translation_verse: Etsɔ numemevɔsamlekpui la da ɖe nɔƒe si nye takpeƒe la ŋgɔ, eye wòmè numemevɔsa hewɔ nuɖuɖuvɔsa le edzi, abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose ene.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Etsɔ tsileze la da ɖe takpeƒe la kple vɔsamlekpui la dome, eye wòku tsi si woale la ɖe eme.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron kple via ŋutsuwo tsɔe klɔ woƒe asiwo kple afɔwo.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ne wole gege ge ɖe godoƒegbadɔ la me alo wole tete ge ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu la, wolea tsi, abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose ene.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete alilikpo tsyɔ godoƒegbadɔ la dzi, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ agbadɔ la taŋ.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Le Israelviwo ƒe mɔzɔzɔ la katã me la, ne alilikpo la ho tso agbadɔ la dzi la, woawo hã hona yia ŋgɔ.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Ne alilikpo la meho o la, woawo hã mehona o, va se ɖe gbe si gbe wòaho hafi woawo hã naho.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Elabe le woƒe mɔzɔzɔ katã me la, Aƒetɔ ƒe alilikpo la nɔ nɔƒe la dzi le ŋkeke me, eye le zã me la, dzo nɔa eme wòdzena Israel-dukɔ blibo la kpɔna.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Netsɔ eƒe asi ɖo lãa ƒe tame, ekema Mawu axɔe be enye vɔsa si dzè ate ŋu aklɔ eyama si le vɔa sam la ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Eyome newu nyitsu la le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye Aron viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la, natsɔ ʋu la aɖo Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Woahlẽ ʋua ɖe vɔsamlekpui si le agbadɔa mɔnu la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Ekema amea nako ayi le lãa ŋu, eye wòaflii.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Aron viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la, nado dzo ɖe vɔsamlekpuia dzi, ali kɔ nake ɖe edzi nyuie.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ke amea neklɔ lãa ƒe dɔmenuwo kple afɔtiwo kple tsi, eye nunɔla la natɔ dzo wo katã le vɔsamlekpuia dzi abe numemevɔsa ene, si nye dzovɔsa, si ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu.”

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Nenye alẽ alo gbɔ̃ wòdi be yeatsɔ awɔ numemevɔsae la, ele be lãa nanye atsua si nu mewɔ o.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ele be wòawui le vɔsamlekpuia ƒe dzigbeme lɔƒo le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye Aron viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo nawú eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ke neklɔ dɔmenuawo kple afɔawo kple tsi, eye nunɔla la natsɔ wo asa vɔe, eye wòatɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Enye numemevɔsa, dzovɔsa si ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu.”

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: “Ke nenye xe wòdi be yeatsɔ awɔ numemevɔsa lae la, ekema ele be xea nanye akpakpa alo ahɔnɛ.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atsɔe va vɔsamlekpuia gbɔ, eye wòatro kɔ le enu, amèe le vɔsamlekpuia dzi. Woatsyɔ eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Azɔ neɖe eƒe kotakoe, anyɔ fuawo, eye wòatsɔ wo aƒu gbe ɖe vɔsamlekpuia xa le ɣedzeƒe gome, afi si wokɔa dzowɔ ɖo la.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Eyome wòahe eƒe aʋalawo va se ɖe esime xevia navuvu, gake aʋalawo maɖe ɖa le eŋu o. Ale nunɔla la natɔ dzoe le nake si le dzo me le vɔsamlekpuia dzi la dzi. Esiae nye numemevɔsa, dzovɔsa si ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu.”

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe di be yeasa nuɖuɖuvɔ na Aƒetɔ la, netsɔ wɔ memee, ne wòaku ami kɔ ɖe edzi, adi lifi akpe ɖe eŋu,

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔe vɛ na Aron viŋutsuwo, ame siwo nye nunɔlawo la. Netsɔe vɛ na Aron viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la, eye neku wɔ memee kple ami asiʋlo ɖeka kpakple eƒe lifi la katã. Nunɔla la natɔ dzo esia abe eƒe ŋkuɖodzi gome ene le vɔsamlekpuia dzi. Numemevɔsa kple dzovɔsa si ʋẽna lílilĩ na Aƒetɔ lae wònye.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖuvɔsa mamlɛa nazu Aron kple via ŋutsuwo tɔ. Esia nye vɔsa ƒe akpa kɔkɔetɔ wu le dzovɔsa la me na Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: “Nenye abolo amea di be yeamè atsɔ sa vɔa la, ekema megade amɔwɔʋãnu eme o. Ate ŋu awɔe wòanye abolo si wotsɔ amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã ƒo alo akaklã si wome kple amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã, eye wosi ami na la.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Ne nye abolo gbabɛ si womena le agba gbadzɛ dzi ƒomevie nèdi be yeatsɔ sa vɔe la, ele be nàtsɔ wɔ memee si wode amii, eye nuʋãnu aɖeke meyi eme o la, amee.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Flii kakɛkakɛe, eye nàde amii. Eyae nye nuɖuɖuvɔsa.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Nenye abolo si woɖana le agba mee nèdi be yeatsɔ sa vɔe la, ele be nàtsɔ wɔ memee si wobaka kple ami la ɖae.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖuvɔsa siwo ŋu wotrɔ asi le alea la ƒomeviwoe wòle be nàtsɔ asa vɔe na Aƒetɔ. Ne ètsɔe vɛ na nunɔlaa la, eya natsɔe va vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa aku eƒe akpa sue aɖe woda ŋkɔ ɖe akpa sue sia dzi be ŋkuɖodzikpa, eye wòatɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Dzovɔsa si ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu la wònye.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖuvɔsa mamlɛa nazu Aron kple via ŋutsuwo tɔ. Esia nye vɔsa ƒe akpa kɔkɔetɔ wu le dzovɔsa la me na Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: “Mele be amɔwɔʋãnu aɖeke nanɔ nu si miedi be yewoatsɔ asa nuɖuɖuvɔ na Aƒetɔ la me o. Amɔwɔʋãnu alo anyitsi aɖeke neganɔ nuɖuɖu si miedi be yewoatsɔ sa dzovɔ na Aƒetɔ la me o.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Miate ŋu atsɔ miaƒe kutsetse gbãtɔwo va sa vɔe na Aƒetɔ. Ke womatsɔe asa vɔe le vɔsamlekpui dzi abe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ ene o.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “Ne ètsɔ wò agblemenuku gbãtɔwo va sa nuɖuɖuvɔ na Aƒetɔ la, mè blitimuawo, nàgbã wo nyànyanya atsɔ sa nuɖuɖuvɔ lae.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Kɔ ami ɖe edzi, nàtsɔ lifi akpe ɖe eŋu. Nuɖuɖuvɔsae wònye.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la naku bli gbagbã la kple ami la ahatsɔ lifi la katã akpe ɖe eŋu, eye wòatɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Esia nye dzovɔsa na Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe di be yeatsɔ yeƒe nyi ɖeka asa ŋutifafavɔ la, ate ŋu atsɔ nyitsu alo nyinɔ si naneke mewɔ o la ava Aƒetɔ ŋkumee.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Amea natso lãa le godoƒegbadɔ la nu. Ele be wòatsɔ asi aɖo lãa ƒe ta dzi hafi atsoe, eye Aron viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la, nahlẽ eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: hekpe ɖe ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu le eƒe alime kpakple aklã ƒe gbadzaƒe eveawo ŋu.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Aron viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la, atsɔ nu siawo katã akpe ɖe numemevɔsa siwo le nake dzi le vɔsamlekpuia dzi xoxo la ŋu, eye woamè wo katã va se ɖe esime woafiã keŋkeŋ. Dzovɔsa sia ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ doa dzidzɔ na Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Nenye alẽ alo gbɔ̃ wòdi be yeatsɔ sa ŋutifafavɔ lae la, ate ŋu atsɔ atsua alo nɔa awɔe faa gake ele be wòanye lã si naneke kura mewɔ afi aɖeke na o.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ekema atsɔ asi aɖo lãa ƒe ta dzi, eye wòatsoe le godoƒegbadɔ la nu. Aron viŋutsuwo nahlẽ eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu kpakple ami si le aklã ŋu, esiwo akpe ɖe ayikuawo ŋu. Woalã asikɛa ƒe akpa dami la le keke asikɛa ƒe agunu ke.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa natɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Dzovɔsanuɖuɖu wòanye na Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: “Nenye gbɔ̃ amea di be yeatsɔ sa vɔ lae la, netsɔe va sa vɔe le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Atsɔ asi aɖo lãa ƒe ta dzi, eye wòatsoe le afi ma. Aron viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la, nahlẽ eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayikuawo kple ami si le wo ŋu, aklã ŋu miawo kple aklãa ƒe gbadzaƒe eveawo, hekpe ɖe ayikuawo ŋu.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa namè nu siawo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi va se ɖe esime woafiã keŋkeŋ, eye woanye dzovɔsanuɖuɖu si dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu. Lã siwo katã wotsɔ sa vɔe la ƒe ami nye Aƒetɔ tɔ; vɔsa tɔxɛ wonye nɛ.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Eya ta miekpɔ mɔ aɖu lã ƒe ami alo lã ƒe ʋu o. Ɖoɖo sia nanye se na Israelviwo katã, le afi sia afi, tso dzidzime yi dzidzime, heyi ɖe mavɔ me.”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: Ade asibidɛ ʋu la me ahlẽ zigbɔzi adrẽ ɖe xɔmetsovɔ si wotsɔ ma kɔkɔeƒea me la gbɔ, le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ale si wòawɔe lae nye: akplɔ gbɔ̃tsua ayi vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzigbeme afi si wowua numemevɔsalãwo le, atsɔ asi aɖo lãa ƒe ta dzi, eye wòatsoe le afi ma le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Vɔsa sia ƒe taɖodzinue nye be ame si wɔ nuvɔ̃a la nakpɔ nuvɔ̃a ŋuti tsɔtsɔke.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Eyome nunɔla anyrɔ asibidɛ ɖe lãa ƒe ʋu me atsɔ sisi ɖe ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ƒe dzo eneawo ŋu, eye wòatsɔ ʋu mamlɛa akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe afɔnu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be ne ame aɖe ɖe ŋu ɖi da Aƒetɔ ƒe sewo dometɔ aɖe dzi le manyamanya me la, ele nɛ be wòawɔ nu vovovo siwo gbɔna la dometɔ siwo sɔ ɖe eya amea ŋu la.

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Nenye nunɔlae wɔ nuvɔ̃ hehe dzɔgbevɔ̃e va dukɔa dzi la, ele nɛ be wòatsɔ nyitsu si metsi tututu o, eye nu mewɔ o la asa nuvɔ̃vɔ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Akplɔ nyitsu la ava godoƒegbadɔa nu, atsɔ asi aɖo lãa ƒe ta dzi, eye wòatsoe le Aƒetɔ ŋkume le afi ma.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Nunɔla si wosi ami na la, naku nyitsua ƒe ʋu atsɔ ayi agbadɔ la me.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Azɔ nunɔlaa nasisi ʋua ɖe vɔsamlekpui si dzi wotɔa dzo lifi le la ƒe dzowo ŋu. Eyome wòatsɔ nyitsua ƒe ʋu mamlɛa akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui si dzi womèa vɔsawo le, vɔsamlekpui si le godoƒegbadɔa mɔnu la ƒe afɔnu.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: míagblɔe ko be nyitsu bliboa katã ayi asaɖa la godo le teƒe aɖe si dza le Mawu ŋkume, afi si woƒua dzowɔ gbe ɖo. Le afi ma la atsɔ nuawo katã aɖo nakekɔ dzi, eye wòatɔ dzo wo woafiã keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: “Nenye Israel-dukɔ blibo la katãe tra mɔ le ŋuɖeɖi me heda Aƒetɔ ƒe seawo dometɔ ɖeka dzi le manyamanya me la,

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: ekema, enumake si wova kpɔ dze sii be yewowɔ nuvɔ̃ ko la, ele na wo be woatsɔ nyitsu sue aɖe ava wɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsae. Ale si woawɔe nye: Woakplɔ nyitsua ava godoƒegbadɔ la nu,

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: dukɔ la ƒe ame tsitsiwo atsɔ asi aɖo eƒe ta dzi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye woatsoe le afi ma.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ekema nunɔla si wosi ami na la aku nyitsua ƒe ʋu atsɔ yi agbadɔ la me.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: Ade asibidɛ ʋua me ahlẽ zigbɔzi adrẽ ɖe xɔmetsovɔ si wotsɔ ma kɔkɔeƒea me la gbɔ, le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la natsɔ ʋua asisi ɖe lifivɔsamlekpui si le godoƒegbadɔa me la ƒe dzowo ŋuti le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Eyome wòatsɔ nyitsu la ƒe ʋu mamlɛa akɔ ɖe numemevɔsamlekpui si le Mawu ƒe agbadɔa nu la ƒe afɔnu.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Eyome wòakɔ nyitsu la ayi asaɖa la godo, eye wòatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ abe ale si wòtɔa dzo nyitsu si wòtsɔna saa vɔ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃ ta ene. Vɔsa sia ƒe taɖodzinue nye be wòaklɔ dukɔ bliboa ƒe nuvɔ̃ ɖa.

english_verse: Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty.
translation_verse: “Nenye dziɖula aɖee wɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ le ŋuɖeɖi me heto ema me da Aƒetɔ ƒe seawo dometɔ aɖe dzi la,

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ne wona wòdze si eƒe nuvɔ̃ la ko la, ele be wòadi gbɔ̃tsu aɖe si naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o, atsɔ va sa vɔe.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Eyome la nunɔla la anyrɔ asibidɛ ɖe lãa ƒe ʋu me atsɔ sisi ɖe numemevɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzo siwo le eƒe dzogoe eneawo dzi la ŋu, eye wòatsɔ ʋu mamlɛa akɔ ɖe numemevɔsamlekpuia ƒe afɔnu.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, wòatɔ dzo lãa ƒe amiwo katã le vɔsamlekpuia dzi va se ɖe esime woafiã keŋkeŋ, abe ale si wowɔnɛ le ŋutifafavɔsa gome ene. Aleae nunɔla la asa vɔ le nuvɔ̃ si dziɖula la wɔ la ta, eye woatsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃ la akee.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: “Nenye dukɔa me tɔ ƒuƒlu aɖe koe ɖe ŋu ɖi wɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ heto ema me da Aƒetɔ ƒe seawo dometɔ aɖe dzi la,

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ne wona wòdze si eƒe nuvɔ̃ la ko la, ele be wòadi gbɔ̃nɔ aɖe si naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o la, atsɔ va sa vɔe.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ale si wòawɔe lae nye: akplɔ gbɔ̃nɔa ayi vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzigbeme afi si wowua numemevɔsalãwo le, atsɔ asi aɖo lãa ƒe ta dzi, eye wòatsoe le afi ma le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, aɖe ami siwo katã le eŋu, abe ale si woɖea ami le lã siwo wowu be woatsɔ asa ŋutifafavɔ ŋu la ene, eye nunɔla la natɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi va se ɖe esime woafiã keŋkeŋ, be woƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ la nado dzidzɔ na Aƒetɔ. Ne nunɔlaa wɔ esia ko la, ekema esa vɔ ɖe amea ƒe nuvɔ̃ ta, eye woatsɔ amea ƒe nuvɔ̃ la akee.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Nenye alẽe ame aɖe di be yeatsɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsae la, ele be wòanye alẽnɔ si naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Netsɔ eƒe asi ɖo lã la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòawui hena nuvɔ̃vɔsa le afi si wowua numemevɔsalã le la.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Eyome nunɔla la anyrɔ asibidɛ ɖe lãa ƒe ʋu me atsɔ sisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu eye wòatsɔ ʋu mamlɛa akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ƒe afɔnu.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, aɖe ami siwo katã le lãa ŋu abe ale si woɖea ami le alẽ siwo wowu be woatsɔ asa ŋutifafavɔ ŋu la ene, eye nunɔla la natsɔ wo akpe ɖe lã siwo wotsɔ va sa dzovɔ na Aƒetɔ la ŋu, eye wòamè wo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi va se ɖe esime woafiã keŋkeŋ. Ne ewɔ esia ko la, esa vɔ ɖe amea ƒe nuvɔ̃ ta, eye woatsɔe ake amea.”

english_verse: You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ka asi nu makɔmakɔ aɖe ŋu, gbemelã makɔmakɔ aɖe ƒe kukua, alo aƒemelã makɔmakɔ aɖe ƒe kukua, alo nutata makɔmakɔ aɖe ƒe kukua ŋu le manyamanya me la, egblẽ kɔ ɖo; ezu ame makɔmakɔ kple fɔɖila.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe menya o, ko wòka asi ame makɔmakɔ aɖe alo eƒe nane ŋu, ne wòva nya be yeka asi nu makɔmakɔ ŋu ko la, egblẽ kɔ ɖo; ezu ame makɔmakɔ kple fɔɖila.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Alo ne atam ge le ame aɖe nu, eɖanye vɔ̃ alo nyui dzi wòka atam la ɖo, be yeawɔ o, eye menyae o, emegbe wòdze sii la, ekema eɖi nu siawo dometɔ ɖeka ƒe fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ɖi fɔ to nu siawo dometɔ aɖe wɔwɔ me la, ele be wòaʋu nuvɔ̃ si wòwɔ la me le gaglãgbe,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ alẽnɔ alo gbɔ̃nɔ ava sa nuvɔ̃vɔ na Aƒetɔ le vo si wòda heɖi fɔ la ta. Ekema nunɔla la atsɔ lãa asa vɔ alé avu nɛ.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Amea natsɔ wo vɛ na nunɔla. Nunɔla la alé esi wotsɔ le nuvɔ̃vɔ sa gee la gbã, atro kɔ le enu gake mana taa naɖe ɖa le enu o.

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Eyome ahlẽ ʋua ƒe ɖe ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu, eye wòana mamlɛa naɖuɖu ɖe vɔsamlekpuia te. Vɔsa sia nye nuvɔ̃kɔklɔɖa vɔsa.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: “Ke ne amea mate ŋu ana akpakpa eve alo ahɔnɛ eve o la, ekema netsɔ wɔ memee kilo ɖeka vɛ abe eƒe vɔsanu ene. Megakɔ ami ɖe edzi o, eye megatsɔ lifi hã kpe ɖe eŋu o, elabe nuvɔ̃vɔsa wònye.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Atsɔ wɔa vɛ na nunɔla la. Nunɔla la aku asiʋlo ɖeka akɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe dzovɔsa siwo le vɔsamlekpuia dzi xoxo la dzi, eye wòatɔ dzo wo. Wɔ asiʋlo ɖeka ma nye ŋkuɖodzisiʋlo. Vɔsa sia ƒe taɖodzinue nye be wòaklɔ ame si va sa vɔa la ƒe nuvɔ̃ ɖa.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Aleae nunɔla la lasa vɔa le amea ƒe vo si wòda le nu siawo ƒomevi aɖe gome la ta, eye woatsɔ vodada la akee. Wɔ si susɔ la nye nunɔla la tɔ, abe ale si wònɔna le nuɖuɖuvɔsa gome ene.” Vɔsasa le fɔɖiɖi ta ŋuti se

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe ɖe ŋu ɖi ale be vɔsanu siwo wòle be wòaxe na Aƒetɔ dometɔ aɖe tsi eŋu la, eɖi fɔ. Ele nɛ be wòadi agbo atsɔ va sa vɔ na Aƒetɔ atsɔ alé avui le fɔ si eya amea ɖi le manyamanya me la ta. Ele be agbo si naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o la ƒe home nasɔ kple kɔkɔeƒe la tɔ. Fɔɖiɖivɔsa wònye.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Nunɔla nado eƒe agbotɛ ɣi kple awu ʋlaya ɣiawo, eye wòalɔ dzowɔ siwo numemevɔsa dzoa nyè le vɔsamlekpuia dzi akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpuia xa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: alo fɔ nɔvia ƒe nane gake sẽ nu be yemekpɔ nua o, alo ka aʋatso gake ta nu be nyateƒee la: nu siawo katãe amegbetɔwo wɔna wònyea nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Esia nye vɔsa si Aron kple via ŋutsuwo asa na Aƒetɔ gbe si gbe wosi ami na wo dometɔ aɖe la. Ele be wòaku wɔ memee kilo ɖeka, abe esi wotsɔna saa gbe sia gbe nuɖuɖuvɔ ene, atsɔ kilo afã asa vɔ le ŋdi, agatsɔ afã mamlɛa asa vɔ le fiẽ.

english_verse: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong. Daily Sacrifices (Exodus
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atsɔ agboa asa vɔe ɖe amea ƒe nuvɔ̃ la ta na Aƒetɔ, eye woatsɔ nuvɔ̃a ake ame si da ƒu heɖi fɔ la.” Numemevɔsawo

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Le nunɔlawo ƒe ƒomewo me la, ŋutsuwo koe kpɔ mɔ aɖu lã sia; nu kɔkɔewo ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Ne woɖa lãa le ze aɖe me la, ele be woagbã zea. Nenye gaze me woɖae le la, ele be woaklɔ gazea, akpalae kple tsi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo be numemevɔsa ŋuti se siwo nu wòle be woazɔ ɖo la woe nye esiwo gbɔna. Ele be woaɖo numemevɔsa la dzo nu le vɔsamlekpui dzi zã blibo va se ɖe ŋdi, eye ele be vɔsamlekpui dzi dzo la nanɔ bibim le ɣeyiɣi ma katã me.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Aɖe eƒe awuawo ɖi azɔ ado awu bubuwo, eye wòalɔ dzowɔ la aɖakɔ ɖe teƒe aɖe si wowɔ kɔkɔe le asaɖaa godo la.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Ele be vɔsamlekpui dzi dzo la nanɔ bibim ɖaa; womazi kpi akpɔe wòatsi ɣeaɖekeɣi o. Gbe sia gbe ŋdi la, nunɔla la nade nake eme, aɖo numemevɔsalã la ɖe nakeawo dzi, eye wòana ŋutifafavɔsalãwo ƒe ami nafiã keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ele be vɔsamlekpui dzi dzo la nanɔ bibim madzudzɔmadzudzɔe; womazi kpi kpɔe wòatsi ɣeaɖekeɣi o.” Nuɖuɖuvɔsawo

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: “Nuɖuɖuvɔsa ŋu se lae nye esi: Nunɔla, ame si nye Aron ƒe dzidzimevi la koe kpɔ mɔ atsɔ nuɖuɖuvɔsa ayi na Aƒetɔ le vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Aku nuɖuɖuvɔsawɔ memee la si dzi wokɔ ami ɖo la ƒe asiʋlo ɖeka, atsɔ lifi si le vɔsanua dzi la katã akpe ɖe eŋu, eye wòatɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe ŋkuɖodzigome ene. Eƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aron ƒe dzidzimeviŋutsu ɖe sia ɖe kpɔ mɔ aɖu vɔsanu sia. Enye sedede mavɔ tso dzidzime yi dzidzime. Ame sia ame si aka asi Aƒetɔ ƒe dzovɔsa sia ŋu la azu kɔkɔe.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Woabaka wɔa kple ami, amè wɔbakɛa le numegba gbadzɛ dzi va se ɖe esime wòabla. Eyome woaflii kakɛkakɛe, eye woatsɔe asa nuɖuɖuvɔ be wòanye ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo be nuvɔ̃vɔsa ŋuti se nye esi: Woawu lã si wotsɔ le nuvɔ̃vɔ la sa gee la le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, le vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzigbeme le teƒe si wowua numemevɔsalãwo le.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Nunɔla si sa vɔa la aɖu vɔsalã la, ke ele be wòaɖui le teƒe kɔkɔe: Ele be wòaɖui le godoƒegbadɔ la ƒe kpɔ me.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Ne vɔsalã sia ƒe lã ka ame alo nane ŋu la, azu kɔkɔe. Ne eƒe ʋu hlẽ ɖe awu alo avɔ aɖe me la, ele be woanyae le teƒe kɔkɔe.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Ne woɖe lãa ƒe ʋu tsɔ yi godoƒegbadɔ la me hewɔ eŋudɔ le avulélekɔnu me la, ekema womekpɔ mɔ aɖu eƒe lã o; ele be woatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atɔ dzo wo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi na Aƒetɔ; fɔɖiɖivɔsa wònye.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ele nɛ azɔ be wòatsɔ abolo ƒomevi vovovo siwo wòtsɔ vɛ la ƒe ɖeka, ɖeka, ɖeka aƒo ƒu atsɔ na Aƒetɔ abe nunana tɔxɛ ene. Le nua wɔwɔ vɔ megbe la, nunana tɔxɛ sia nazu nunɔla si hlẽ ŋutifafavɔsalã la ƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu la tɔ.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: “Ne lã la ƒe ɖe ka nu makɔmakɔ aɖe ŋu la, megale be woaɖui o, ke boŋ ele be woatɔ dzoe. Ame sia ame si ŋu kɔ la kpɔ mɔ aɖu vɔsa sia ƒe lã faa.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: “Fɔɖiɖivɔsa nye nane si le kɔkɔe ŋutɔ. Eŋutisewoe nye esiwo gbɔna.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Woawu fɔɖiɖivɔsalã hã le afi si wowua numemevɔsalã le, eye woahlẽ eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axa eneawo ŋu.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Woaɖe eƒe teƒe damiwo katã atsɔ sa vɔe. Teƒe siawoe nye asikɛa ƒe agunu, ami si tsyɔ dɔmenuawo dzi,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu mi siwo tsí ɖe lãa ƒe ali ŋu kpakple ami siwo le aklã ŋu.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu sia ŋutsu si tso nunɔlawo ƒe ƒome me la kpɔ mɔ aɖu eƒe ɖe faa. Woaɖui le teƒe kɔkɔe; nu kɔkɔe ŋutɔ wònye.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Fɔɖiɖivɔsa le ko abe nuvɔ̃vɔsa ene. Se ɖekae akplɔ wo. Lã la nye nunɔla si wɔ vɔsakɔnua la tɔ.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe va sa numemevɔ la, lã si wòtsɔ va sa vɔa ƒe agbalẽ nye nunɔla si wɔ vɔsakɔnua tɔ.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖuvɔsa ɖe sia ɖe si womè le kpo me, woɖana le ze me alo tɔna le nutɔgba gbadzɛ me nazu nunɔla si wɔ vɔsakɔnua tɔ.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ke nuɖuɖuvɔsa siwo katã le mumu wode amii la nye nunɔlawo, Aron viawo, katã tɔ. Woamae ɖe wo nɔewo dome.” Ŋutifafavɔsawo

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: “Ale si wòle be ame nasa ŋutifafavɔ na Aƒetɔ la ŋu sewoe nye esi azɔ.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe di be yeasa vɔ atsɔ da akpe na Aƒetɔ la, ele be wòatsɔ abolo maʋamaʋã, akaklã si dzi wokɔ ami ɖo kple tatali, si wobaka wɔ memee kple ami tsɔ tɔ la, akpe ɖe eƒe vɔsalã la ŋu.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Ele be woaɖu vɔsalã la ƒe lã katã wòavɔ le ŋkeke si dzi wotsɔe sa vɔae la dzi. Womagblẽ ɖeke ɖi ŋu nake ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Gake ne ame aɖe tsɔ lã aɖe va sa vɔ le adzɔgbe aɖe si wòɖe ta, alo ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe seselelãme nu la, mehiã be woaɖu vɔsalã si wòtsɔ vɛ la katã le vɔsagbe la o. Woate ŋu agaɖu esi susɔ la le ŋufɔke.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Ne lãa ƒe ɖe tsi anyi va se ɖe ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe, eye ame aɖe ɖui la, Mawu agbe magaxɔ vɔsalaa ƒe vɔsaa o. Eƒe vɔsaa azu nu ƒuƒlu. Woabui nu makɔmakɔ, eye ne ame aɖe ɖui la eyama ɖi fɔ.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Nenema ke, ne ame aɖe ka asi nu makɔmakɔ aɖe, lã makɔmakɔ aɖe alo ŋunyɔnu aɖe ŋu vɔ gake ɖu lã si wotsɔ sa ŋutifafavɔ na Aƒetɔ ƒe lã la, womagabui ɖe Mawu ƒe dukɔ me viwo dome o.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be womekpɔ mɔ aɖu nyitsu alo alẽ alo gbɔ̃ ƒe ami o.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Miate ŋu awɔ lã aɖe si ku le eɖokui si alo esi lã wɔadã aɖe vuvu la ƒe ami ŋudɔ faa, gake miekpɔ mɔ aɖui o.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ɖu lã si wotsɔ sa dzovɔ na Aƒetɔ ƒe ami la, woaɖee ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me tɔwo dome.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Gawu la, afi ka ke miele o, miekpɔ mɔ aɖu xe aɖeke loo, alo lãfɔne aɖeke ƒe ʋu o.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ɖu ʋu la, woaɖee ɖa le eƒe dukɔ me tɔwo dome.”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ele be eya ŋutɔ natsɔe vɛ kple eƒe asi abe dzovɔsa wònye ene. Netsɔ lã la ƒe ami kple eƒe akɔ vɛ, be woanyè akɔ la le Aƒetɔ ŋkume hafi atsɔ wo ana abe nunana tɔxɛ ene.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la natɔ dzo ami la le vɔsamlekpui dzi; ke akɔ la nye nunɔlaawo katã Aron kple viŋutsuawo, tɔ.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Eya ame si tso Aron viŋutsuawo dome, si tsɔ ʋu wɔ ŋutifafavɔsawoe hekpe ɖe amia ŋu la, naxɔ ɖusita abe eƒe gome ene.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Elabe akɔ si wònye kple ata si wotsɔ sa vɔe la woe mexɔ le Israelviwo si tso woƒe ŋutifafavɔsawo me tsɔ na nunɔla Aron kple via ŋutsuwo be woanye woƒe gome mavɔ tso Israelviwo gbɔ.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: se siwo Aƒetɔ de na Mose le Sinai-to la dzi gbe si gbe wòde se na Israelviwo le Sinai-gbedadaƒo be woatsɔ woƒe vɔsawo vɛ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Mose tsɔ agboa ƒe akɔ, eye wònyèe le Aƒetɔ ŋkume hetsɔe nɛ abe nunana tɔxɛ ene. Agboa ƒe akɔ sia nye Mose ƒe gome le nunɔlaɖoɖovɔsa la me abe ale si Aƒetɔ de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Kplɔ Aron kple via ŋutsuawo eye nàtsɔ nunɔlawuawo, amisinanu la, nyitsu si woatsɔ sa nuvɔ̃vɔ, agbo eveawo kple kusi si me abolo maʋamaʋã le la ɖe asi.

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mina ameha blibo la hã nava ɖi anyi ɖe godoƒegbadɔ la nu.”

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na ameha la be: “Nu si ƒe se Aƒetɔ de nam be mawɔ lae nye esi.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Mose na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo do va ŋgɔgbe, eye wòle tsi na wo.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Edo awudziwui la na Aron, bla edzi kple alidziblanu. Eyome edo awu ʋlaya nɛ, do kɔmewu nɛ ɖe edzi. Azɔ wòtsɔ akɔtablanu si le kɔmewua ŋu, akɔtablanu si wolɔ̃ kple aɖaŋu geɖe ŋutɔ la, bla akɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Etsɔ akɔtaɖonu la ɖo eƒe akɔta, eye wòtsɔ Urim kple Tumim bla de akɔtaɖonua me.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Etsɔ tablanu bla ta nɛ, eye wòtsɔ sikatsyɔ̃ɖonu gbabɛ ɖo tablanu la ŋu le eƒe ŋgonu; sikatsyɔ̃ɖonu kɔkɔe si Aƒetɔ de se be Mose nawɔ.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Azɔ Mose tsɔ ami kɔkɔe si wosina la, eye wòsii na nɔƒea kple emenuwo katã hekɔ wo ŋu.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ewú ami ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu zigbɔzi adrẽ, eye wòsi ami na eya hã kple eŋu nuwo katã. Nenema ke wòsi ami na tsilegazea kple zɔ la hã hekɔ wo ŋui.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ekɔ amisinanu la ƒe ɖe ɖe Aron ƒe tame heto ema me ɖoe nunɔlae.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Eyome Mose na Aron viŋutsuawo do va ŋgɔgbe. Edo awutewui ʋlayawo na wo, tsɔ alidziblanu bla wo dzi na wo, eye wòbla ta na wo abe ale si Aƒetɔ de se nɛ ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Ehe nyitsu si wotsɔ le nuvɔ̃vɔ sa gee la vɛ. Ena Aron kple via ŋutsuawo tsɔ asi ɖo nyitsua ƒe ta dzi hena nuvɔ̃vɔsa.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Mose wui, tsɔ asibidɛ de nyitsua ƒe ʋu me sisi ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ƒe dzowo katã ŋu heɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le eŋu to esia wɔwɔ me. Etsɔ ʋu mamlɛa kɔ ɖe anyigba le vɔsamlekpuia ƒe afɔnu. Aleae Mose kɔ vɔsamlekpui la ŋu hewɔe wòzu Aƒetɔ ɖeɖe ƒe nu koŋ.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, eɖe ami si le lãa ƒe dɔmenuwo ŋu la katã, aklã ƒe gbadzaƒewo, ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu, eye Mose tɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ke etsɔ nyitsua ƒe akpa siwo susɔ, eƒe ŋutigbalẽ, lã kple dɔkaviwo, eye wòtɔ dzo wo le asaɖa la godo abe ale si Aƒetɔ de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Eyome ehe agbo si woatsɔ wɔ numemevɔsa la vɛ. Aron kple via ŋutsuawo tsɔ asi ɖo eƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose wui, eye wòhlẽ eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Etsɔ tsi klɔ eƒe dɔmenuwo kple afɔtiawo. Mose tɔ dzo agbo blibo la le vɔsamlekpuia dzi. Enye numemevɔsa, dzovɔsa si ʋẽna lílilĩ na Aƒetɔ abe ale si Aƒetɔ de se na Mose ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Tete Mose he agbo evelia si wole tsɔtsɔ ge aɖo nunɔlawoe la vɛ. Aron kple via ŋutsuawo tsɔ asi ɖo eƒe tame.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Tete wòwui. Esisi eƒe ʋu ɖe Aron ƒe ɖusitogboe, eƒe ɖusidegblefetsu kple eƒe ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ena Aron viŋutsuawo hã te va. Esisi agboa ƒe ʋu ɖe woawo hã ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu, eye Mose hlẽ ʋu mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Eɖe agboa ƒe teƒe damiwo, asikɛa ƒe agunu, ami siwo katã le dɔkaviawo ŋu, aklã ƒe gbadzaƒewo, ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu, kɔ ɖi, eye wòtsɔ lã la ƒe ɖusita kpe ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Etrɔ ɖe kusi si me amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã nuɖuɖuwo le, le Aƒetɔ ŋkume la ŋu azɔ, eye wòtsɔ abolo maʋamaʋã ɖeka kple tatali ɖeka da ɖe lã damiawo kple agboa ƒe ɖusita la dzi.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Etsɔ nu siawo katã de asi me na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo, eye wònyè wo le ya me le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Mose xɔ wo le wo si azɔ tsɔ da ɖe numemevɔsalã la dzi, eye wotɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi kple numemevɔsa la. Esia nye nunɔlaɖoɖovɔsa; dzovɔsa si ʋẽna lílilĩ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete Mose tsɔ amisinanu la ƒe ɖe kple ʋu si le vɔsamlekpuia dzi, eye wòwú wo ɖe Aron kple eƒe awuwo kpakple Aron viŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuwo ŋu. Ale wòkɔ Aron kple eƒe awuwo kpakple via ŋutsuawo kple woƒe awuwo ŋu.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na Aron kple via ŋutsuawo be: “Miɖa lã la le godoƒegbadɔ la nu, eye miɖui kple abolo si le nunɔlaɖoɖo ŋu bolokusi me abe ale si mede se ene be: ‘Aron kple viawo neɖui’.

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Ne lãa alo aboloa ƒe ɖe susɔ la mitɔ dzoe.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adrẽ wotsɔ le mia ɖo ge nunɔlae. Miekpɔ mɔ aɖe afɔ le godoƒegbadɔ nu le ŋkeke adrẽ mawo me o.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Nu siwo katã míewɔ egbe sia la, Aƒetɔ ŋutɔe ɖoe na mí be míwɔ wo nenema tututu be miakpɔ miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋu tsɔtsɔke.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Ele na mi be mianɔ godoƒegbadɔ la nu zã kple keli ŋkeke adrẽ, anɔ nu siwo Mawu ɖo na mi la wɔm, ne menye nenem o la, miaku. Nenemae wode se nam.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Aron kple via ŋutsuawo wɔ nu siwo katã Aƒetɔ ɖo na wo to Mose dzi la pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, Mose yɔ Aron kple via ŋutsuawo kpakple Israel-me tsitsiawo,

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na Aron be: “Lé nyitsu sue ɖeka na nuvɔ̃vɔsa kple agbo ɖeka na numemevɔsa. Wo ame eve la nanye lã siwo naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o. Tsɔ wo sa vɔe le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Gagblɔ na Israelviwo be woatsɔ gbɔ̃tsu sa nuvɔ̃vɔ, eye woatsɔ nyivi ɖeka kple alẽvi ɖeka siwo dome ɖe sia ɖe tsi xɔ ƒe ɖeka, eye naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o la sa numemevɔ;

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: eyome woatsɔ nyitsu ɖeka kple agbo ɖeka wɔ ŋutifafavɔsa na Aƒetɔ; woawɔ nuɖuɖuvɔsa, eye woade amii tsɔ kpe ɖe ŋutifafavɔsa la ŋu, elabe Aƒetɔ le eɖokui ɖe ge afia wo egbe.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ameawo tsɔ nu siwo katã Mose xlẽ na wo la va godoƒegbadɔ la nu, eye ameha bliboa va ƒo ƒu hele tsitre ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na wo be: “Aƒetɔ ye de se be miava wɔ nu sia, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ado miakpɔ.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aron azɔ be: “Te ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu ne nàsa nuvɔ̃vɔ kple numemevɔ tsɔ klɔ wò nuvɔ̃wo kple dukɔa ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa. Eyome nàsa vɔ ɖe dukɔa ta atsɔ lé avu na wo abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ be woawɔe ene.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Aron te ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, eye wòwu nyitsuvi, si wòtsɔ le nuvɔ̃vɔ sa ge ɖe eɖokui ta la.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Via ŋutsuwo tsɔ nyia ƒe ʋu vɛ. Ede asibidɛ eme tsɔ sisi ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ƒe dzowo ŋu, eye wòtsɔ ʋu mamlɛa kɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpuia te.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Etɔ dzo ayikuwo kple ami siwo le aklã ŋu la le vɔsamlekpuia dzi abe ale si Aƒetɔ de se na Mose be woawɔe ene.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ke etɔ dzo lã la kple lãgbalẽ la le asaɖa la godo.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Etso agbo si wòtsɔ le numemevɔ sa gee la azɔ. Aron viŋutsuwo tsɔ agboa ƒe ʋu nɛ, eye wòhlẽe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ agboa ƒe ta kple eƒe akpa bubuawo katã hã vɛ nɛ, eye wòtɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Eklɔ dɔkaviawo kple afɔtiawo azɔ tsɔ da ɖe vɔsalã mamlɛawo dzi le vɔsamlekpuia dzi, eye wòmè wo.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Esiawo megbe la, esa vɔ ɖe dukɔa ta: Elé gbɔ̃tsu si wotsɔ le vɔa sa gee ɖe dukɔa ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta, eye wòwui hetsɔ sa nuvɔ̃vɔ abe ale si wòsa gbãtɔe la ene.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Etsɔ numemevɔ la na le ɖoɖoa nu.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Esa nuɖuɖuvɔ, eye wòku asiʋlo ɖeka le eŋu tɔ dzo le vɔsamlekpuia dzi kpe ɖe numemevɔsa si wosa gbe ma gbe ŋdi xoxo la ŋu.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ewu nyitsu kple agbo siwo dukɔa na be woatsɔ sa ŋutifafavɔ la hã. Via ŋutsuwo tsɔ lãawo ƒe ʋu vɛ nɛ, eye wòhlẽe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Eƒo ƒu ami siwo wòɖe le nyia kple agboa ŋu, lãawo ƒe asikɛ ƒe agunu, ami si tsyɔ dɔmenuawo dzi, ayikuawo kple aklãa ƒe gbadzaƒe eveawo,

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Tete Aron kɔ eƒe asiwo dzi ɖe dukɔ la dzi heyra wo. Eɖi ɖe anyi esime wòsa nuvɔ̃vɔ kple numemevɔ kpakple ŋutifafavɔawo vɔ.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron yi godoƒegbadɔ la me. Esi wodo va la, woyra dukɔ la. Tete Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la dze na dukɔ blibo la katã.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Zi ɖeka ko, ɖeko dzo tso Aƒetɔ gbɔ va fiã numemevɔsa la kple lã damiawo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Esi dukɔa kpɔ nu sia la, wo katã wodo ɣli, eye wotsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Aron viŋutsu eve, Nadab kple Abihu, tsɔ woƒe agba siwo me wotɔa dzo lifi le ɖe dzo ɖe wo me, kɔ lifi ɖe dzoawo me, eye wotsɔ dzo makɔmakɔ va Aƒetɔ ŋkume, dzo si medɔ wo be woado na ye o la wònye.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Dzo va fiã wo, eye woku ɖe eŋkume le afi ma.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aron be: “Esia gblɔm Aƒetɔ le be: ‘Mawɔ ɖokuinye kɔkɔe le ame siwo tena ɖe ŋunye la dome, eye woakɔ ŋutinye le dukɔ blibo la katã ŋkume.’ ” Aron lé eɖokui kpoo.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Mose yɔ Misael kple Elzafan, siwo nye Aron tɔɖea Usiel ƒe viŋutsuwo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Mite va, miva kɔ mia nɔviawo do goe le kɔkɔeƒe la me yi asaɖa la godo.”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aron kple viawo Eleazar kple Itamar be: “Migagblẽ ɖa ɖe ta ʋlayaa o. Migadze miaƒe awuwo o. Ne menye nenema o la, miaku, eye dɔmedzoe abi ɖe ameha blibo la katã ŋu. Ke mia nɔviwo, Israel-dukɔ blibo la ya ate ŋu afa avi le dzo, si Aƒetɔ tɔ la ta faa.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Migadzo le godoƒegbadɔ la nu o. Ne miedzo la miaku elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe ami si wosi na mi la le mia ŋu.” Wowɔ abe ale si Mose gblɔ na wo la ene. Ɖoɖowo na Nunɔlawo

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Aron be:

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Ne wò kple viwò ŋutsuwo miele godoƒegbadɔ la me yi ge la, migano wain alo aha sesẽ aɖeke o. Ne menye nenema o la, miaku. Nya sia nenye ɖoɖo mavɔ na mi tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Mide vovo nu siwo le kɔkɔe kple esiwo mekɔ o, nu siwo dza kple esiwo medza o la dome.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Mifia se siwo katã Aƒetɔ de na Israelviwo to Mose dzi la wo.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aron kple via siwo susɔ, Eleazar kple Itamar be: “Mitsɔ nuɖuɖuvɔsa si susɔ, esi nye dzovɔsa siwo wotsɔ vɛ na Aƒetɔ ƒe akpa aɖe la, wɔ amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã bolo, eye miɖui le vɔsamlekpui la xa elabe vɔsa kɔkɔe ŋutɔ wònye.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Miɖui le teƒe kɔkɔe elabe eyae nye dzovɔ siwo wova sa na Aƒetɔ la ƒe akpa si nye wò kple viwòwo ƒe gome. Elabe nenemae wode se nam.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ ataa kple akɔa akpe ɖe lãa ƒe akpa dami siwo wotɔa dzo le vɔsamlekpuia dzi la ŋu vɛ na wò. Ele be akpa mawo nanye wò kple wò dzidzimeviwo tɔ tegbee, abe ale si Aƒetɔ de see la ene.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Azɔ Mose bia nuvɔ̃vɔsagbɔ̃tsu si susɔ la ta, eye kpɔ ɖa, wotɔ dzoe. Edo dɔmedzoe ɖe Eleazar kple Itamar, Aron viŋutsu eve siwo susɔ la ŋu. Ebia wo be:

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Nu ka tae mieɖu nuvɔ̃vɔsalã la le teƒe kɔkɔe la o? Nu kɔkɔe ŋutɔ wònye ɖe! Aƒetɔ ɖe wòtsɔe na mi be miate ŋu aɖe ameha la ƒe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Wometsɔ eƒe ʋu yi kɔkɔeƒe la me o ɖe! Kɔkɔeƒe lae wòle be miaɖui le, abe ale si mede se na mi ene hafi.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Aron xɔ edzi nɛ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, egbee wosa nuvɔ̃vɔ kple numemevɔ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Ke esiawo ƒomevi gbegbe dzɔ ɖe dzinye. Ɖe meɖu nuvɔ̃vɔsalã egbe ɖe, adze Aƒetɔ ŋua?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Esi Mose se nya sia la, edze eŋu.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Lã ɖe sia ɖe si ƒe afɔkli me fe, tsro le afɔklia ŋu eye wòdzɔa nu gaɖuna.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose kple Aron be:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: “Migblɔ na Israel-dukɔ la be: Esiawoe nye nu gbagbe siwo miate ŋu aɖu le anyigba dzi lãwo dome.

english_verse: You may eat anything that lives in water and has fins and scales. But it would be disgusting for you to eat anything else that lives in water, and you must not even touch their dead bodies.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si le tɔ me, esi ŋu tsiléti alo tsro mele o la, nanyɔ ŋu na mi.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ke mibu nudzodzoe bubu siwo katã afɔ ene li na la be wonye ŋunyɔnuwo.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe atsɔ woƒe kukua la, nenya eƒe awuwo; amea ŋu mekɔ o va se ɖe fiẽ; woanye nu makɔmakɔ na mi.”

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: xɔmenyatri, agbloloe, adoglo, ve kple agama.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Esiawo katã nanye lã makɔmakɔwo na mi le lã suewo katã dome. Ame sia ame si aka asi woƒe kukua ŋu la ŋu mekɔ o va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If something made of wood, cloth, or leather touches one of their dead bodies, it must be washed, but it is still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne woƒe kukua ge dze nane dzi ko, nua zu nu makɔmakɔ. Eɖanye ati, avɔ, lãgbalẽ alo kotoku, tsikunu ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi si ŋudɔ wowɔna la, zu nu makɔmakɔ. Ele be woadee tsi me, eye eŋu mekɔ o va se ɖe fiẽ. Ne fiẽ ɖo la, ekema eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe ƒe kukua ge dze nane si wotsɔ anyi wɔ me la, nua kple nu sia nu si le eme la zu nu makɔmakɔwo; ele be woagbã nua.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si dzi woƒe kukua ge dze la zu nu makɔmakɔ. Nenye abolokpo alo mlekpuie hã, ele be woagbãe gudugudu; ezu nu makɔmakɔ na mi.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Gake ne lã siawo ƒe kukua ge dze tsi dzidzi alo vudo me la, tsia mezu nu makɔmakɔ o. Ke nu sia nu si ka woƒe kukua ŋu la zu nu makɔmakɔ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Ne woƒe kukua ge dze nuku aɖe si ƒã ge woala dzi la, nuku ma mezu nu makɔmakɔ o.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Gake ne wode tsi nukua ɖe nane me ko, lã mawo ƒe ɖe ƒe kukua ge dze eme la, nukua zu nu makɔmakɔ.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Ne lã ɖuɖua aɖe ku, eye ame aɖe ka asi eƒe kukua ŋu la, eyama zu ame makɔmakɔ va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ɖu lã kukua la, ele nɛ be wòanya eƒe awuwo, eye eŋu mekɔ o va se ɖe fiẽ. Ele na ame si kɔ lã kukua la hã be wòanya eƒe awuwo, eye eŋu mekɔ o va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Migado ŋunyɔ mia ɖokui to anyigba dzi lã suesuesuewo ɖuɖu me o. Migagblẽ kɔ ɖo na mia ɖokui kple wo o, ne menye nenema o la, miazu ame makɔmakɔwo.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Elabe nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu; mikɔ mia ɖokui ŋuti, eye minɔ kɔkɔe elabe nye la, ɖe mele kɔkɔe. Migagblẽ kɔ ɖo na mia ɖokui kple lã suesuesue siwo tana la o.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ ame si kplɔ mi tso Egipte, be manye mia Mawu. Ele na mi be mianɔ kɔkɔe elabe nye la, ɖe mele kɔkɔe.”

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Mide vovototo nu makɔmakɔ kple nu kɔkɔe, nu gbagbe siwo dze be woaɖu kple esiwo medze be woaɖu o la dome.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be ne nyɔnu aɖe fɔ fu, eye wòdzi viŋutsuvi la, ekema eŋu mekɔ o ŋkeke adrẽ abe ale si eƒe gbeléɣi le ene.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, woatso aʋa na vidzĩ la.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Ke nenye nyɔnu wòdzi hã la, eŋu mekɔ o, abe ale si ko eŋu mekɔ le eƒe dzinukpɔɣi o la ene, va se ɖe esime ŋkeke wui ene nava yi. Esia megbe la, ŋkeke bla ade vɔ ade nava yi hena eƒe ʋukɔklɔ ɖa.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Eɖadzi ŋutsu o, eɖadzi nyɔnu o, ne ŋkeke siwo ava yi hafi eŋuti nakɔ de ko la, ele be wòatsɔ alẽvi si xɔ ƒe ɖeka la vɛ hena numemevɔsa kple ahɔnɛvi alo kpakpa ɖeka vɛ hena nuvɔ̃vɔsa. Atsɔ nu siawo vɛ na nunɔla le godoƒegbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atsɔ nuawo asa vɔe le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, ato ema me alé avu nɛ. Ekema eŋuti kɔ. Esiae nye se na nyɔnu si dzi vi, eɖanye ŋutsuvi alo nyɔnuvi o.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ne nyɔnua mate ŋu akpɔ alẽvi ana o la, ekema nedi akpakpa eve alo ahɔnɛvi eve, be woatsɔ akpakpa alo ahɔnɛ ɖeka asa numemevɔ, eye woatsɔ evelia asa nuvɔ̃vɔ. Azɔ nunɔla la alé avu nɛ, eye eŋu akɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose kple Aron be:

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Ne nu tè ame aɖe alo wòdze abi alo nanewo kɔ ɖe eŋu abe anyidɔ ene la, ekema woakplɔe ava nunɔla Aron alo via ŋutsuawo, ame siwo hã nye nunɔlawo la, dometɔ ɖeka gbɔ.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Nunɔla la nalé ŋku ɖe nu si do ɖe amea ŋu la ŋuti. Ne fu siwo le teƒea fu ɣie, eye wòwɔ abe ɖe teƒe la nyè ɖe eme ene la, anyidɔe. Ekema ele be nunɔla la natso nya me be amea ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Gake ne teƒea fu kpii, menyé ɖe me o, eye fu siwo le afi ma mezu ɣie o la, nunɔla la neɖe amea ɖe aga kwasiɖa ɖeka.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, nunɔla la negalé ŋku ɖe eŋu nyuie kpɔ. Ne ekpɔ be abia gale abe ale si wònɔ tsã ene, eye mekeke ɖe edzi o la, negasa amea ɖe aga ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Nunɔla la negaɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe. Ne ewɔ abe ɖe wòyrɔ, eye megakeke ɖe edzi o la, ekema netso nya me be abi ƒuƒlu ko nua nye, eya ta amea ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Nunɔla la nagaɖe ŋku ɖee nyuie, eye ne ekpɔ be nua keke ɖe edzi vavã la, ekema netso nya me be anyidɔe eya ta amea zu ame makɔmakɔ.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: “Ne anyi ƒo ɖe ame aɖe ŋu la, ele be woakplɔe ava nunɔla gbɔe.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la alé ŋku ɖe eŋu nyuie. Ne teƒea ɖo loholoho hefu kpii, fu siwo le afi ma kple exawo fu ɣie, eye ne woka asi teƒea wòsenɛ enumake la,

english_verse: he will say, “This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.”
translation_verse: ekema anyi xoxoe le eŋu, eye ele be nunɔla la nabui ame makɔmakɔe. Mehiã be wòagatui ɖe xɔ me o, elabe eŋu mekɔ o.
