english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: nunɔla la negaɖe ŋku ɖee ake nyuie. Ne ekpɔ be dɔa xɔ ame bliboa ŋu, eye eŋu fu ɣie la, ekema netso nya me be amea ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Nunɔla la negalé ŋku ɖe abia ŋu nyuie, eye wòatso nya me be amea ŋu mekɔ o. Abiae nye dzesi be anyidɔ lém amea le, eya ta amea ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Nunɔla la agaɖe ŋku ɖee, eye ne ekpɔ be teƒea fu kpii la, nunɔla la netso nya me be amea ŋu kɔ; ekema amea ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: gake emegbe ko teƒea galólo, wɔ kpii, alo fu gake gade biabiã ge hã la, ele be amea natsɔ teƒea yi ɖafia nunɔla.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Nunɔla la neɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea. Ne edzé abe ɖe teƒea nyé ɖe me vie ene, eye fu siwo le afi ma la fu kpii la, ekema nunɔlaa netso nya me be amea ŋu mekɔ o, elabe anyidɔe va do ɖe aɖi si tee va yi la teƒe.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ke ne nunɔla lé ŋku ɖe teƒea ŋu, eye wòkpɔ be fu siwo le afi ma mefu kpii o, eye teƒea hã menyé ɖe me o, ke boŋ ezu vĩi la, ekema nunɔla la netu amea ɖe xɔ me ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Ne teƒea keke ɖe edzi la, ekema nunɔlaa netso nya me be anyidɔlélee, eye nebu amea ame makɔmakɔe.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Ke ne teƒea metrɔ o, eye mekeke ɖe edzi hã o la, ekema aɖi la ƒe abiteƒe koe, eya ta nunɔla la netso nya me be amea ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: “Alo ne dzo fia ame aɖe, eye dzoteƒea fu kpii alo fu vie gake gawɔ dzĩe vie hã la,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: nunɔla la neɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea nyuie. Ne teƒea wɔ abe ɖe wònyé ɖe me vie ene, eye fu siwo le afi ma fu ɣie la, ekema anyidɔe do ɖe teƒea. Ele be nunɔla la natso nya me be amea ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ne fu siwo le teƒea mezu ɣie o, eye teƒea menyé ɖe me hã o, ke boŋ wòzu kpii la, nunɔlaa nesa amea ɖe aga ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽlia gbe la, nunɔla la negaɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea kpɔ nyuie. Ne ekeke ɖe edzi la, ekema anyidɔe, eye ele be nunɔla la natso nya me be amea ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Gake ne teƒea metrɔ o, mekeke ɖe dzi hã o, eye wòle kpii la, ekema dzobiteƒe ko wònye, eya ta ele be nunɔla la natso nya me be amea ŋu kɔ.”

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: “Ne aklabi wɔ ɖe ŋutsu alo nyɔnu aɖe ƒe tame alo glãɖome la,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: nunɔla la nelé ŋku ɖe eŋu nyuie. Ne aklabia wɔ abe ɖe wònyé ɖe eme ene, eye fu siwo le eme la trɔ zu hẽe abe aŋuti ɖiɖi ene hele belibeli la, ekema anyidɔ ƒe dzesi wònye, eye ele be nunɔla la nabu amea ame makɔmakɔe.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla la lé ŋku ɖe teƒea ŋu, eye wòkpɔ be medze abe ɖe wònyé ɖe eme ene o, gake fu siwo le afi ma menyɔ o la, ekema ele be wòasa amea ɖe aga ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, nunɔla negaɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea kpɔ. Ne mekeke ɖe edzi o, menyé ɖe eme hã o, eye fu siwo le afi ma metrɔ zu hẽe hã o la,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ekema woana amea nalũ ta, gake woatso teƒea ɖi, eye nunɔla la nagasae ɖe aga ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, nunɔla la negaɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea ake. Ne mekeke ɖe edzi o, eye mewɔ hã abe ɖe wònyé ɖe eme ene o la, ekema nunɔla la netso nya me be amea ŋu kɔ. Ekema amea nanya eƒe awuwo, eye eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: ele be nunɔla la nagaɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea ake. Ne ekpɔ be aklabi la keke ɖe edzi la, mehiã be wòagakpɔ ɖa be ɖa alo fu siwo le afi ma la zu hẽe o; amea ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: “Ne nu ɣi aɖewo ƒomevi do ɖe ŋutsu alo nyɔnu aɖe ŋu la,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: nunɔla naɖe ŋku ɖe wo kpɔ nyuie. Ne wole flukpee la, ekema dzi koe do ɖe amea ŋu; amea ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ƒe ta kpã le ŋgonu ɖeɖe, alo le ŋgonu kple megbe siaa hã la, eƒe ta kpã, gake eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Ekema nunɔla nelé ŋku ɖe eŋu kpɔ. Ne efu kpii, eye wòwɔ abe ɖe wòbiã vie ene le ta kpakpã alo ŋgo kpakpã la dzi la,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: “Ne anyi do ɖe ame aɖe ŋu la, ele be wòanɔ nu vuvu me, agblẽ ɖa ɖi wòato, wòatsɔ nu abla ŋɔti kple nu, eye wòanɔ ɣli dom be: ‘Ŋunye mekɔ o loo! Ŋunye mekɔ o loo!’

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ale si anyia le eŋu ko la, enye ame makɔmakɔ; ele nɛ be wòanɔ asaɖa la godo, eye eya ɖeka naʋu ayi ɖanɔ afi ma.” Se siwo ku ɖe anyidɔ ŋuti

english_verse: If a greenish or reddish spot appears anywhere on any of your clothing or on anything made of leather, you must let the priest examine the clothing or the leather. He will put it aside for seven days,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la aɖe ŋku ɖe teƒe si dɔa ɖe tsi ɖo; eyome wòatsɔ nua adzra ɖo ɖe afi aɖe ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Ele nɛ be wòatɔ dzo nudodo la, awu alo nu si wotsɔ lãfu alo ɖeti lɔ̃ alo nu sia nu si wotsɔ lãgbalẽ wɔ la, anyidɔ vɔ̃ɖie; woatɔ dzoe wòafiã.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ekema nunɔla la nade se be woanya nu si me dɔléle la le la, eye wòagadee xɔ ŋkeke adrẽ bubu.

english_verse: after which he will examine it again. If the spot hasn't spread, but is still greenish or reddish, the clothing or leather is unclean and must be burned.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la naɖe ŋku ɖe avɔ si me dɔléle la le esi wonyae vɔ megbe. Ne teƒe si nua ɖi ɖo metrɔ o, eye mekeke ɖe edzi hã o la, nu makɔmakɔ wònye; ele be nàtɔ dzoe, ne anyidɔa ƒe ɖie lé ɖe emegbe alo eŋkume.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne dɔlélea gadze le nudodoa me, awu alo avɔ, nulɔlɔ̃ alo nu si wotsɔ lãgbalẽ wɔe me la, woatɔ dzo nu si me dɔlélea le la.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Ke ne wonya awua, avɔa alo nulɔlɔ̃a alo nu si wotsɔ lãgbalẽ wɔe, eye nua do le eme la, ele be woaganyae zi evelia, ekema nua ŋu kɔ.”

english_verse: These are the rules for deciding if clothing is clean or unclean after a spot appears on it.
translation_verse: Esiae nye se le anyi, si ɖo awu si nye kuntru alo aklala, avɔ alo nulɔlɔ̃ alo nu sia nu si wotsɔ lãgbalẽ wɔe la ŋuti, ale si woabui be eŋu kɔ alo mekɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: nunɔla ana amea ƒe ƒometɔwo adi xevi gbagbe eve siwo ŋu kɔ kple sederti kple ka dzẽ kpakple hisɔp ƒe alɔ sue aɖe vɛ.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa ana woatso xevi ɖeka le tɔsisi ŋgɔ le ze me.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Azɔ woalé xevi evelia, atsɔ eya kple sederti la kple ka dzẽ la kpakple hisɔp la anyrɔ ɖe xeviʋu si le tsia dzi la me,

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: eye wòahlẽe ɖe ame si ŋu kɔm wole la ŋu, zigbɔzi adrẽ, eye wòatso nya me be eŋu kɔ. Tete wòaɖe asi le xevi gbagbe la ŋu wòadzo ayi afi si wòlɔ̃.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Azɔ ame si ŋu kɔm wole la anya eƒe awuwo, alũ ta eye wòale tsi; ekema eŋu akɔ. Ekpɔ mɔ ayi asaɖa la me azɔ, gake ne eyi la, ele be wòatsi eƒe agbadɔ godo ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, agalũ ta, alũ ge, alũ ŋkutafuwo, eye wòaƒlɔ fu siwo katã nyale eyama ŋu ko la ɖa; azɔ wòanya eƒe awuwo, ale tsi; ekema eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: “Le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, ele be wòatsɔ agbovi eve siwo naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o kple alẽnɔe ɖeka si xɔ ƒe ɖeka ko, eye kpɔtsotso aɖeke mele eŋu o kple wɔ memee kilo etɔ̃ si wobaka kple ami, kpakple ami ŋutɔ atukpavi ɖeka vɛ.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Nunɔla si le amea ŋu kɔ ge la nekplɔ amea kple nu siwo katã wòtsɔ vɛ la yi Aƒetɔ ŋkume le godoƒegbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla netsɔ agboviawo dometɔ ɖeka kple ami atukpavi ɖeka la sa fɔɖiɖivɔ. Nenyè wo le Aƒetɔ ŋkume gbã.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Emegbe newu alẽvia le teƒe kɔkɔe afi si wowua nuvɔ̃vɔsalã kple numemevɔsalã le. Ele be wòawɔe alea elabe fɔɖiɖivɔsalã la hã nye nunɔla la tɔ abe nuvɔ̃vɔsalã ke ene; nu kɔkɔe ŋutɔŋutɔ wònye.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa asisi agbovia ƒe ʋu ɖe ame si ŋu kɔm wole la ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple ɖusifɔdegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Le esia yome la, aku ami atukpavi la ƒe ɖe ɖe eƒe miasiƒo me,

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: atsɔ eƒe ɖusisibidɛ ɖeka atɔ eme awu ɖe afi ma zigbɔzi adrẽ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume,

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ ami si susɔ ɖe eƒe asiƒome la ƒe ɖe asisi ɖe fɔɖiɖivɔsalã la ƒe ʋu dzi le ame si ŋuti kɔm wole la ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple eƒe ɖusifɔ ƒe degblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esiawo ŋu la, adi akpakpa eve alo ahɔnɛvi eve, esi ke wòanya te ŋu ana ko la, hã vɛ. Woatsɔ ɖeka asa fɔɖiɖivɔ eye woatsɔ evelia awɔ numemevɔsa.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe wotso nya me be eŋu kɔ la ƒe ŋkeke enyia gbee wòatsɔ nu siawo vɛ na nunɔlaa le godoƒegbadɔa nu le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa agaku amia ƒe ɖe ɖe eƒe miasiƒo me, eye

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: wòatsɔ eƒe nuɖusisibidɛ ɖeka atɔ eme ahlẽ ɖe afi ma zi adrẽ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Eyome nunɔla natsɔ ami si le esi la ƒe ɖe asisi ɖe fɔɖiɖivɔsalã ƒe ʋu dzi le ame si ŋu kɔm wole la ƒe ɖusitogboe, ɖusidegblefetsu kple ɖusifɔdeglefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Esiawoe nye se siwo nu wòle be ŋutigbalẽdɔ vɔ̃ɖi léla si si nu mele o ale be mate ŋu asa vɔ vovovoawo hena eŋukɔkɔ o la nazɔ ɖo.” Ale si woaɖe anyi ɖa le aƒeme

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose kple Aron be:

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Ne mieva ɖo Kanaan-nyigba si matsɔ na mi wòazu mia tɔ la dzi, eye mena anyi do ɖe nane ŋu le aƒe aɖe me le anyigba ma dzi la,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: ekema aƒea tɔ nava gblɔ na nunɔla be: “Ŋutigbalẽdɔ vɔ̃ɖi aɖe ɖe do nye aƒeme.’

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Ele nɛ be wòalé ŋku ɖe dɔlélea ŋu nyuie. Ne nu mumui alo nu dzẽ aɖewo le teƒea, eye wòwɔ abe ɖe wònyè ɖe eme vie wu glia ene la,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: ekema ado go le xɔa me, atu ʋɔa, eye ele be ʋɔa nanɔ tutu ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, agayi aɖaɖe ŋku ɖe teƒea nyuie. Ne dɔlélea keke ɖe edzi le glia ŋu le aƒea me la,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Eyome wòana woadza xɔa me ƒe gliwo ŋu akuko wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe afi sia afi, eye woalɔ anyi si wokuko ɖa le wo ŋu aɖakɔ ɖe teƒe makɔmakɔ aɖe le dua godo.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Azɔ woatsɔ kpe bubuwo aɖo ɖe esiwo woɖe ɖa teƒe, eye woatsɔ anyi bubu atre gliawo.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: nunɔlaa agayi aɖaɖe ŋku ɖe nua. Ne ekpɔ be nua keke ɖe edzi la, ekema anyidɔléle si womate ŋu aɖe ɖa o lae; eya ta xɔa ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Ele be woagbãe, eye woalɔ eŋu kpewo, eŋu tiwo kple eŋu kewo ado go le dua me ayi ɖakɔ ɖe teƒe makɔmakɔ aɖe.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ge ɖe xɔa me le ŋkeke mawo siwo me nunɔlaa tu ʋɔa la dometɔ aɖe dzi la, eyama azu ame makɔmakɔ va se ɖe gbe ma gbe fiẽ.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe mlɔ xɔa me alo ɖu nu le eme le ŋkeke adrẽ mawo ƒe ɖe dzi la, ele nɛ be wòanyà eƒe awuwo.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: “Ne nunɔlaa gava ɖe ŋku ɖe xɔa me esime wogbugbɔ eme dzra ɖo vɔ, eye wòzu be dɔa megado ɖe afi aɖeke o la, ekema ele be wòatso nya me be dɔlélea vɔ ɖa eya ta xɔa ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Gake be wòagakɔ xɔa ŋu la, ele be wòana woadi xevi sue eve, sederti, ka dzẽ kple hisɔp ƒe alɔ sue aɖe vɛ.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Woatso xevi ɖeka ɖe tɔsisi me tsi ŋgɔ le ze me.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Aɖe asi le xevi gbagbe la ŋu azɔ be wòadzo ado go le dua me aɖo ta gbe me. Ne ewɔ esia ko ewu vɔ̃ɖeɖeɖa ŋu kɔnu la nu; ekema xɔa ŋu kɔ azɔ.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: Se siawoe fiaa asi nu si ŋu mekɔ o kple nu si ŋu kɔ la. Esia nye se le ŋutigbalẽdɔ vɔ̃ɖi ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose kple Aron be:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: “Migblɔ na Israelviwo be, ne ŋutsu aɖe le afu ɖɔm la, tsi si le dodom le eŋu la mekɔ o.

english_verse: Anything that he rests on or sits on is also unclean,
translation_verse: Aba sia aba si dzi afuɖɔla mlɔ alo nu sia nu si dzi wòbɔbɔ nɔ la ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ka asi afuɖɔla ŋu alo eƒe ŋuti ka afuɖɔla ŋu la, ele nɛ be wòanya eƒe awuwo, eye wòale tsi, eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne afuɖɔla ɖe ta ɖe ame aɖe si ŋu kɔ ŋu la, ele na amea be wòanya eƒe awuwo eye wòale tsi; eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ka asi nane si dzi afuɖɔla bɔbɔ nɔ kpɔ ŋu la, eyama ŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ, eye ne ame aɖe kɔ́ nane si dzi afuɖɔla bɔbɔ nɔ kpɔ la, ele nɛ be wòanya eƒe awuwo, ale tsi; eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne afuɖɔla meklɔ asi hafi ka ame aɖe ŋu o la, ele na amea be wòanya eƒe awuwo, eye wòale tsi; eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Ne afuɖɔla ka asi ze alo eʋegba aɖe ŋu la, ele be woagbã nua. Ne nye atinue la, ekema woaklɔe kple tsi.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: “Ne afua vɔ na amea la, ele be wòalala ŋkeke adrẽ nava yi, eye wòanya eƒe awuwo, aɖale tsi le tɔsisi me, ekema eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, ele be wòadi akpakpa eve alo ahɔnɛvi eve ɖe asi ava Aƒetɔ ŋkume le godoƒegbadɔ la nu, eye wòatsɔ wo ana nunɔla le afi ma.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa atsɔ ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔ, atsɔ evelia asa numemevɔ, eye nunɔla alé avu nɛ le eƒe afu la ta le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu aɖe nyè tsi la, ele be wòale tsi nyuie, eye eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nudodo ɖe sia ɖe alo lãgbalẽnu ɖe sia ɖe si ŋu tsia ka la, woanyae kple tsi; eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu kple nyɔnu nɔ anyi la, ele be woale tsi; wo ŋu mekɔ o, va de asi na fiẽ.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Ne nyɔnu ɖo asi anyi eye ʋu le dodom le eŋu la, eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe ŋkeke adrẽ. Ne ame aɖe ka eŋu le ŋkeke mawo me la, amea ŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ne nane le eƒe aba alo nunɔdzi dzi, eye ame aɖe ka eŋu la, amea ŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe dɔ kple nyɔnu le eƒe dzinukpɔɣi la, makɔmakɔnyenye si le nyɔnua ŋu la ɖe ɖe ŋutsua hã ŋu eya ta ŋutsua zu ame makɔmakɔ ŋkeke adrẽ. Aba sia aba si dzi wòmlɔ le ŋkeke adrẽ mawo me hã zu nu makɔmakɔ.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Ne nyɔnu aɖe ƒe dzinukpɔɣi meɖo o gake ʋu do le eŋu alo le dodom le eŋu ŋkeke geɖe alo eƒe dzinukpɔŋkekewo de gake ʋu gale dodom le eŋu ko la, ekema eŋu mekɔ o, abe ale si ko eŋu mekɔ o le eƒe dzinukpɔɣi la ŋutɔ ene.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Aba sia aba si dzi wòmlɔ, alo nu sia nu si dzi wòbɔbɔ nɔ le ŋkeke mawo me la hã zu nu makɔmakɔ.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ka nu siawo ŋu la ŋu mekɔ o. Ele be wòanya eƒe avɔwo eye wòale tsi; eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Ne ʋua tso hã la, ele be wòaxlẽ ŋkeke adrẽ, eya megbe la, hafi eŋu kɔ.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, netsɔ akpakpa eve alo ahɔnɛvi eve vɛ na nunɔla le godoƒegbadɔ nu.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa atsɔ ɖeka asa nuvɔ̃vɔ, eye wòatsɔ evelia asa numemevɔ. Nunɔla la alé avu nɛ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume le eƒe makɔmakɔ la ta.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: “Ale miagbe nya na Israelviwo le woƒe nu makɔmakɔwo ŋuti. Ne menye nenema o, nenye be wote ɖe nye agbadɔ si le wo dome la ŋu kple woƒe makɔmakɔnyenye la hegblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ la, woaku.”

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: Egblɔ na Mose be: “Gblɔ na nɔviwò Aron be meganɔ tsotsom ko anɔ kɔkɔeƒe la yim le xɔmetsovɔ la godo ɣe sia ɣi o, elabe afi mae medzena le le alilikpo me le nubablaɖaka la ƒe nutunu la tame. Ne esẽ to la, aku.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Ne edi be yeava kɔkɔeƒea la, ele nɛ be wòakplɔ nyitsu sue ɖeka kple agbo ɖeka ɖe asi, nyitsua hena nuvɔ̃vɔsa eye agboa hena numemevɔsa.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: Ne egbɔna la, ele be wòale tsi, ado eƒe nunɔlawuwo siwo nye: awutewui ʋlaya, agbotɛ ɣi, alidziblanu ɣi kple tablanu ɣi.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Aron netsɔ nyitsu la sa vɔe be wòaklɔ eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe aƒe ƒe nuvɔ̃ ɖa.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Eyome nekplɔ gbɔ̃tsu eveawo yi Aƒetɔ ŋkume le godoƒegbadɔa nu.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Nedzidze nu ɖe wo dzi tsɔ tia esi lanye Aƒetɔ tɔ kple esi layi na Azazel

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Aron netsɔ gbɔ̃tsu si dzi nudzidze dze la na Aƒetɔ la sa nuvɔ̃vɔ,

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: ke netsɔ gbɔ̃tsu si dzi Azazel ƒe nudzidze dze la va ɖo Aƒetɔ ŋkume agbagbee. Newɔ kɔnu tsɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ kɔ ɖe edzi, eye nenyàe ɖo ɖe Azazel gbɔ le gbedadaƒo.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Na Aron nahe eƒe nuvɔ̃vɔsanyitsua vɛ eye wòalé avu na eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe aƒe eye wòawu eya ŋutɔ ƒe nyitsu la na eɖokui,

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: netsɔ sonu ɖe dzoka xɔxɔ tso lifivɔsamlekpui dzi kɔ ɖe eme wòayɔe. Neku lifi memee, si wotsɔ atike ʋeʋẽe wɔ, asiʋlo eve kpe ɖe eŋu ava xɔmetsovɔ la godo.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Nekɔ lifia ɖe dzoa me le Aƒetɔ ŋkume le afi ma, eye eƒe lifia ƒe dzudzɔ abla nutsyɔnu si le nubablaɖakaa nu la kɔtɔɔ ale be Aron mate ŋu akpɔe o, ne menye nenema o la, aku.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Neku nyitsu la ƒe ʋu, eye nètsɔ asibidɛ hlẽe ɖe nutsyɔnua ƒe ŋgɔgbekpa ŋu. Negahlẽ ʋua ƒe ɖe ɖe nubablaɖakaa ŋgɔ hã zigbɔzi adrẽ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: “Eyome newù gbɔ̃tsu si wotsɔ vɛ be woatsɔ sa nuvɔ̃vɔ ɖe dukɔa ta. Neku eƒe ʋu va xɔmetsovɔ la godo, eye newɔ eƒe ʋu abe ale si wòwɔ nyitsu la ƒe ʋui ene; nehlẽe ɖe nutsyɔnu la dzi kple eŋgɔ.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: To esia wɔwɔ me la, alé avu le kɔkɔeƒe la kple Israelviwo ƒe makɔmakɔnyenye dome le woƒe dzidadawo kple nuvɔ̃wo katã ta. Nenemae wòawɔ na godoƒegbadɔ si le woƒe makɔmakɔnyenye dome hã.

english_verse: Only you are allowed in the sacred tent from the time you enter until the time you come out.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke manɔ godoƒegbadɔ la me esime wòge ɖe eme be yealé avu le kɔkɔeƒe la o; va se ɖe esime wòlé avu na eɖokui, eƒe aƒe kple Israel ƒe aƒe blibo la hedo go hafi.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Ekema nedo go yi vɔsamlekpui, si le Aƒetɔ ŋkume la gbɔ, alé avu nɛ. Netsɔ nyitsu la ƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe kple gbɔ̃tsu la ƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe sisi ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Azɔ wòade asibidɛ ɖeka ʋua me ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu zi adrẽ. Ne ewɔ esia ko eklɔ Israelviwo ƒe makɔmakɔnyenyewo katã ɖa le eŋu, eye wòwɔe kɔkɔe.” Nuvɔ̃gbɔ̃tsu la

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: “Ne ewɔ kɔnu tsɔ kɔ kɔkɔeƒe la, godoƒegbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpuia ŋu vɔ la, netsɔ gbɔ̃tsu gbagbe la vɛ.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Aron netsɔ eƒe asiwo kple eve ɖo gbɔ̃tsu gbagbe la ƒe tame, eye wòaʋu Israelviwo ƒe vodadawo, dzidadawo kple woƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã me kɔ ɖe gbɔ̃tsu la ƒe ta dzi. Nena ame si le klalo la nakplɔ gbɔ̃a ayi gbedadaƒo ʋĩi, aɖanyàe de gbe le afi ma.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Ekema gbɔ̃tsua ladro woƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ɖe eɖokui dzi atsɔ ayi gbedadaƒo afi si ame aɖe ke mele o la, eye wòaɖe asi le gbɔ̃tsu la ŋu le afi ma.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Azɔ wòale tsi le teƒe kɔkɔe aɖe, eye wòado eƒe awuwo. Eyome wòado go aɖasa numemevɔ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖeɖe ɖa kple ɖe dukɔa ƒe nuvɔ̃wo kɔklɔ ɖa ta,

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: eye wòatɔ dzo nuvɔ̃vɔsalãa ƒe amiwo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Ele na ame si nyà Azazel ƒe gbɔ̃tsua ɖo ɖee le gbedadaƒo la be wòanya eƒe awuwo, ale tsi hã hafi atrɔ gbɔ va asaɖa la me.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Woakɔ nyitsu kple gbɔ̃tsu siwo wowu tsɔ sa nuvɔ̃vɔ la, eye wotsɔ woƒe ʋu ɖe nu vɔ ɖa le kɔkɔeƒe la ayi asaɖa la godo aɖatɔ dzo wo. Woatɔ dzo woƒe agbalẽwo, woƒe lã kpakple woƒe miwo siaa.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ele na ame si tɔ dzo wo la be wòanya eƒe awuwo, eye wòale tsi hafi atrɔ gbɔ va asaɖa la me.” Tsɔtsɔkeŋkeke gã la ɖuɖu

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: “Se si gbɔna la nenye ɖoɖo na mi heyi ɖe mavɔ me. Eyae nye be: le ɣleti adrẽlia ƒe ŋkeke ewolia dzi la, ele na Israelviwo kple amedzro siwo le wo dome la siaa be miawɔ fu mia ɖokui, eye womawɔ dɔ aɖeke o.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Elabe gbe ma gbee woalé avu na mi be woakɔ mia ŋu tso miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã me, eye mia ŋu nakɔ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe nenye dzudzɔgbe kɔkɔe vevi ŋutɔ na mi, ŋkeke si dzi miawɔ fu mia ɖokui, eye miawɔ dɔ aɖeke kura o. Ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na mi.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Nunɔla si wosi ami na, heɖo nunɔlae ɖe tɔ́a yome lae awɔ avulélekɔnua, eye ele be wòado aklalawu kɔkɔeawo,

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: eye wòalé avu na: Kɔkɔeƒe la, godoƒegbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpui la, na nunɔlawo kple Israel-dukɔ la me tɔwo katã.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ele be woawɔ kɔnu sia zi ɖeka ƒè sia ƒè atsɔ klɔ Israelviwo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ɖa. Milé ɖoɖo siawo me ɖe asi halase tegbee.” Ale Mose wɔ nu siwo katã Aƒetɔ gblɔ nɛ be wòawɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Aron kple via ŋutsuwo kpakple Israelviwo katã be nu si Aƒetɔ de se be miawɔ nye esi:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: eye metsɔe va godoƒegbadɔ la nu hetsɔe wɔ nunana na Aƒetɔ le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la nu o la, ekema amea do hlɔ̃ eye wòkɔ ʋu ɖi. Woatsrɔ̃ amea ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la me.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Wowɔ se sia be Israelviwo nate ŋu tsɔ woƒe vɔsalã si wowuna le gbedzi la avɛ na nunɔla le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, le godoƒegbadɔ la nu, ahawui abe ŋutifafavɔsa ene na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa nahlẽ ʋua ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu le godoƒegbadɔa ƒe mɔnu, eye wòatɔ dzo eƒe ami le vɔsamlekpuia dzi be wòanye ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ale be womagawu woƒe vɔsalãwo na gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo, siwo wowɔa gbolo kple wo la o. Esia nanye ɖoɖo mavɔ na wo le dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na wo be ne Israelvi aɖe loo, alo amedzro aɖe, si le wo dome si sa numemevɔ aɖe alo sa vɔ aɖe,

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: eye metsɔe va agbadɔ la nu va tsɔ sa vɔe na Aƒetɔ o la, woatsrɔ̃e ɖa la dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: “Ne Israelvi aɖe, alo amedzro aɖe si le wo dome la ɖu lã ƒe ʋu la, maɖe ŋku atɔ nenem me ma, si ɖu ʋua eye matsrɔ̃e ɖa le dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Elabe ŋutilã ƒe agbe le ʋu la me, eye metsɔe na mi be wòalé avu le vɔsamlekpui la dzi na miaƒe luʋɔwo. Elabe ʋu lae wɔa avulédɔ le agbe si le ʋua me ta.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Ne Israelvi alo amedzro aɖe si le mia dome lé lã alo xevi aɖe si woɖuna, le adegbe la, ele be wòawui kple lãnu, ana eƒe ʋu naɖuɖu vɔ keŋkeŋ ɖe anyigba, eye wòaku ke atsyɔ ʋua.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: “Elabe nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe ƒe agbe le eƒe ʋu me. Eya tae mede se na Israelviwo be: Migaɖu nu gbagbe aɖeke ƒe ʋu o, elabe nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe ƒe agbe le eƒe ʋu me. Woatsrɔ̃ ame sia ame si aɖui la.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ɖu lã aɖe si ku le eɖokui si alo lã si lã wɔadã aɖe vuvu, amea ɖanye aƒevi alo amedzrovi o, ele nɛ be wòanya eƒe avɔwo, eye wòale tsi; eŋu mekɔ o, va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Ke ne menya avɔ alo le tsi o la, atsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi ƒe agba.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Miganɔ agbe abe ale si amewo nɔnɛ le Egipte-nyigba dzi, afi si mienɔ va yi la, ene loo, alo abe Kanaan-nyigba si dzi mekplɔ mi yinae la dzi tɔwo ene o. Migakpɔ woƒe nuwɔnawo wɔ o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nye sewo dzi eye mizɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: “Mègadɔ kple wò ƒometɔ kekeake aɖeke o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Mègadɔ kple tɔ́wò srɔ̃ o, elabe eƒe ama nye tɔ́wò tɔ.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Mègadɔ kple nɔwò nɔvinyɔnu o, elabe dɔ ɖeka me viwo eya kple nɔwò nye.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Mègadɔ kple tɔgãwò srɔ̃ alo tɔɖewò srɔ̃ o, elabe eya hã sɔ kple tasiwò.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Ne wò kple nyɔnu aɖe miedɔ kpɔ la, mègadɔ kple via alo eƒe mamayɔvi o. Ne èdɔ kple wo dometɔ aɖe la, èwɔ busunu elabe ɖe sia ɖe zu wò ƒometɔ tututu.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ale si srɔ̃wò le agbe la, mèkpɔ mɔ aɖe nɔvia nyɔnu o, eye mègade asi eŋu hã o.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: “Ne nyɔnu aɖe lé gbe la, mègadɔ kplii o, elabe eŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Mègadɔ kple ame srɔ̃ o. Ne èwɔ nu ma la, èƒo ɖi ɖokuiwò le eta.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ viwò aɖeke sa vɔ le dzo me na Molex ne nàto esia me, aƒo ɖi Mawu ŋkɔ o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutsu, mègadɔ kple ŋutsu o; ŋunyɔnue wònye.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: “Migaƒo ɖi mia ɖokui kple nu sia ƒomevi aɖeke o. Elabe nuwɔna siawoe dukɔ siwo nyà ge mele ɖa le mia ŋgɔ le anyigba la dzi la tsɔ ƒo ɖi wo ɖokui.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Woƒe agbenɔnɔ do gu anyigba la; eya ta mele to hem na anyigba la eye wòtru edzinɔlawo ƒu gbe.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Elabe anyigbaa dzi nɔla siwo nɔ mia ŋgɔ la wɔ ŋunyɔnu siawo katã eye anyigba la gblẽ.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, anyigba la atru mi akɔ ɖi, ne miedo gui abe ale si wòtru dukɔ siwo nɔ mia ŋgɔ la kɔ ɖi ene.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Eya ta milé se si mede na mi la ɖe asi. Migawɔ kɔnu nyɔŋu siawo dometɔ aɖeke esi wowɔ le mia ŋgɔ la o, eye migatsɔ wo ƒo ɖi mia ɖokui o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israel ƒe ha blibo la katã be: Minɔ kɔkɔe elabe nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, ɖe mele kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Migatrɔ ɖe legbawo ŋu loo, alo miakɔ mawuwo na mia ɖokui o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: “Ne miesa ŋutifafavɔ na Aƒetɔ la, miwɔe ne wòaxɔe na mi.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Ele be miaɖu lãa katã wòavɔ gbe si gbe wowui. Ne ɖe susɔ la, ele be wòavɔ le ŋufɔke. Ne ɖe gatsi anyi le ŋkeke atɔ̃a gbe la, ele be woatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Ne woɖui le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la ezu ŋunyɔnu; womaxɔe o.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ɖui la atsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi ƒe agba, elabe egblẽ kɔ ɖo na Aƒetɔ ƒe nu kɔkɔe. Woaɖe ame ma ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la me.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: “Ne miele nuku xam le miaƒe agble me la, migaxae yi ɖaʋu ɖe boto ke o, eye migafɔ esiwo dudu ɖe anyigba hã o.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ne ègbè wò waintsetsewo vɔ la, mègagbugbɔ yi agblea me be yeatsa ne yeagbe tsetse siwo yeŋlɔ be tsã la vɔ keŋkeŋ alo nàfɔ esiwo ge ɖe anyigba la vɔ ƒiaƒiaƒia o. Gblẽ wo ɖi na ame dahewo kple amedzrowo. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: “Migafi fi o; migaba ame o eye migaka aʋatso o.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mègatà nye ŋkɔ ɖe nya aɖe si nènya be menye nyateƒe o la dzi o; enye ɖiƒoƒo nye ŋkɔ. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: “Mègaba hawòvi alo ada dzoe o. Apaɖila ƒe fetu megatsi ŋuwò ŋu nake ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Mègaƒo fi de tokunɔ o. Mègada nu ɖe ŋkuagbãtɔ ƒe mɔ dzi be nekli o; ke boŋ sro wò Mawu la ɖa. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Mèganɔ hawòvi ŋu gblẽm tso afii yi afi mɛ o. Mègaka aʋatso ɖe hawòvi si ne ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo natsi tsitre ɖe wò aʋatsoɖaseɖiɖi dzi atso kufia nɛ o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: “Mègalé hawòvi ɖe dɔme o; ke boŋ ɖe agɔ si wòdze le dziwò la fiae be nàgazɔ eŋu awɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Mègawɔ wɔɖenu ɖe wò dukɔmetɔ aɖeke ŋu o, eye mègalé ɖeke ɖe dɔme hã o; ke boŋ lɔ̃ hawòvi abe ale si nèlɔ̃ ɖokuiwò ene. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: “Mizɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu: mègazi kpi ne wò aƒemelã nade aƒemelã bubu aɖe si menye eƒomevi o la dzi o. Mègaƒã nuku ƒomevi vovovowo ɖe agble ɖeka me o. Mègata avɔ si wotsaka ɖetika kple lãfuka tsɔ lɔ̃ la o. Mègado avɔ ma ƒomevi ƒe awu hã o.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu aɖe dɔ kple kosi aɖe si nye ŋutsu bubu ƒe ŋugbetɔ, kosi si ta womexe ablɔɖexɔfe ɖo o, alo kpuie ko, si womena ablɔɖe haɖe o la, ele be woaku nya la me. Ke womawu wo ya o, elabe kosi ko nyɔnua nye.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: “Ne mieva ɖo anyigba la dzi, eye miedo kutsetseti vovovowo la, mibu woƒe tsetsewo nu makɔmakɔwoe, eye migaɖu wo o va se ɖe esime ƒe etɔ̃ nava yi.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Ke le ƒè enelia me la, mitsɔ woƒe tsetseawo katã va sa vɔ nam abe akpedada ƒe dzesi ene.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Le ƒè atɔ̃lia me la, miate ŋu aɖu woƒe tsetseawo azɔ. Ne miewɔ se sia dzi la, atiawo anɔ tsetsem na mi fũu. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Mègaɖu lã si wowu eye ʋu meɖuɖu vɔ le lã me nɛ o la ƒe lã o. Mègasa dzo o. Mègaka afa hã o.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Ne ame ku na wò la, mègasi ŋuti be yele konyi fam o. Mègatá nu ɖe ŋuti hã o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: “Mègana viwò nyɔnu nazu gbolo o. Ne èwɔ esia la, èɖi gbɔe. Gawu la, anyigba la dzi ayɔ fũu kple gbolowo kpakple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Milé nye dzudzɔgbe ŋu ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi pɛpɛpɛ, eye sosroɖa nenɔ mia me ɖe nye kɔkɔeƒe la ŋu. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: “Migade ŋɔliyɔlawo alo afakalawo gbɔ o, eye migadi wo yome mɔ hã o. Ne miewɔ nu ma ko, miezu ame makɔmakɔwo. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: “Mitso ɖe tsitre le ame tsitsi taɣi ŋkume; mibu amegãɖeɖi. Mivɔ̃ mia Mawu. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: “Ne amedzro va le miaƒe anyigba dzi la, migawɔ vɔ̃ ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Minɔ ɖe eya hã ŋu abe ale si ko mienɔna ɖe mia tɔ Israelviwo ŋu ene. Milɔ̃e abe ale si mielɔ̃a mia ɖokui ene. Miɖo ŋku edzi be yewo hã yewonye amedzrowo kpɔ le Egipte-nyigba dzi. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Miwɔ nudamɔ̀, nudakpe kple nudonu siwo de tututu la ko ŋudɔ. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu. Nyee kplɔ mi dzoe le Egipte.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be, “Ne Israel-ŋutsu aɖe alo amedzro siwo le Israel-dukɔ me dometɔ aɖe tsɔ via na wotsɔ sa vɔ na Molex la, woawui: dukɔ bliboa aƒu kpee wòaku.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ maɖe ŋku atɔ nenem me ma; matsrɔ̃e ɖa le nye dukɔmetɔwo dome, le esi wòtsɔ via na Molex, eye wòto ema me do ŋunyɔ nye kɔkɔeƒe heƒo ɖi nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ta.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Ne dukɔ la ŋe aɖaba ƒu nu si ame ma wɔ dzi, eye wogbe womewui o la,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: maɖe ŋku atɔ amea kple eƒe ƒome blibo la katã kpakple ame siwo katã kpe ɖe eŋu be wogbe anukwareɖiɖi nam heyi ɖale Molex subɔm la. Matsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le woƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe de ŋɔliyɔƒe la, maɖe ŋku atɔe, eye maɖee ɖa le eƒe dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Eya ta mikɔ mia ɖokui ŋu, eye minɔ kɔkɔe elabe nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nye seawo katã dzi pɛpɛpɛ elabe nyee nye Aƒetɔ, eye nyee wɔ mi kɔkɔe.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ƒo fi de tɔ́a alo nɔa la, miwui. Eƒo fi de tɔ́a alo nɔa; eƒe ʋu anɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu aɖe wɔ ahasi kple ehavi srɔ̃ la, ele be woawu eya kple nyɔnua siaa.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu aɖe dɔ kple tɔ́a srɔ̃wo dometɔ aɖe la, eklo bubu le tɔ́a ŋu, eya ta ele be woawu eya kple nyɔnua siaa. Woƒe ʋu anɔ woƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu aɖe dɔ kple via ŋutsu srɔ̃ la, ele be woawu eya kple nyɔnua siaa; busunue wowɔ; woƒe ʋu anɔ woƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu aɖe dɔ kple ŋutsu bubu abe ale si wodɔa nyɔnu gbɔ ene la, wo ame eve la wɔ ŋunyɔnu. Ele be woawu wo ame eve la; woƒe ʋu anɔ woƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu aɖe ɖe nyɔnu aɖe kple nyɔnua dada siaa la, ewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi. Ele be woatɔ dzo ŋutsua kple nyɔnu eveawo siaa be amewo naganɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔm le mia dome o.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ne nyɔnu aɖe te kpɔ be yeadɔ kple lã aɖe la, ele be woawu nyɔnua kple lãa siaa; woƒe ʋu anɔ woƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu aɖe ɖe nɔvia nyɔnu – nenye tɔ́ ɖeka viwo alo nɔ ɖeka viwo ko wonye hã la, – ele be woado ŋukpe wo le dutoƒo, eye woanya wo dzoe le dukɔa me. Edɔ kple nɔvia nyɔnu; ele be wòatsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi la ƒe agba.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu aɖe dɔ kple nyɔnu aɖe si kpɔ dzi nu, eye nyɔnua ɖe ama eɖokui, esime ʋu le dodom le eŋu la, woatsrɔ̃ wo kple eve la ɖa le woƒe dukɔ la me.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Mègadɔ kple nɔwò nɔvinyɔnu alo tɔ́wò nɔvinyɔnu o; enye asidede ame ƒe ƒometɔ kekeake ŋu, woatsɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi la ƒe agba.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe dɔ kple tɔgãa, tɔɖea alo nyruia srɔ̃ la, ekpɔ eƒe ƒometɔ ƒe ama me. Eya kple nyɔnua ƒe nuvɔ̃ la le wo dzi: womadzi vi hafi aku o.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe xɔ nɔvia ŋutsu srɔ̃ ɖe la, ewɔ ŋunyɔnu; eɖe nɔvia ŋutsu ƒe ama ɖe go. Eya kple nyɔnua madzi vi aɖeke o.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: “Eya ta milé fɔ ɖe nye sewo kple nye ɖoɖowo katã ŋu, eye miwɔ wo dzi pɛpɛpɛ be anyigba si dzi mekplɔ mi yinae la nagatú mi aƒu gbe o.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Migayi ɖawɔ dukɔ siwo le afi ma, esiwo nyàm mele ɖa le mia ŋgɔ la, ƒe kɔnuwo o. Woƒe nu ɖe wògblẽ ŋunye, le esi wowɔa nu siawo ta.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Medo ŋugbe be matsɔ anyigba nyui, si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la na mi wòanye mia tɔ. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu si tia mi, le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Eya ta ele be miade vovo lã siwo kɔ kple esiwo mekɔ o la dome, eye miade vovo xe siwo mekɔ o kple esiwo kɔ la hã dome. Migatsɔ lã makɔmakɔwo, xe makɔmakɔwo alo nu siwo zɔa ƒodo dzi la do ŋunyɔ mia ɖokui o. Metɔ asi wo dzi na mi be womekɔ o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Minye ame kɔkɔewo, eye minye nye ɖeka ko tɔ elabe nyee nye Aƒetɔ; ɖe mele kɔkɔe. Ɖe metia mi tso dukɔwo dome be mianye tɔnye koŋ.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu alo nyɔnu aɖe nye ŋɔliyɔla alo afakala la, miƒu kpee ne wòaku. Woƒe ʋu anɔ woƒe ta dzi.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Gblɔ na Aron viŋutsuawo siwo nye nunɔlawo la be wo dometɔ aɖeke megagblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui to tete ɖe ame kuku ŋu me le eƒe dukɔ me o,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: alo nɔvia nyɔnu si meɖe srɔ̃ haɖe o, le eya gome la, ate ŋu agblẽ kɔ ɖo dzro.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Ke mekpɔ mɔ aƒo ɖi eɖokui le srɔ̃a ƒe ƒometɔ aɖeke ƒe kukua ta be wòagblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui le eƒe dukɔ la me o.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: “Nunɔla aɖeke mekpɔ mɔ alũ teƒe kotoe aɖeke ɖe ta ƒe akpa aɖe, alo afɔ eƒe ge dzi wòazu kpuie, alo asi eƒe ŋutigbalẽ o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Ele be woanɔ kɔkɔe na woƒe Mawu; mele be woawɔ naneke si ana amewo nado vlo Mawu ŋkɔ o. Woƒe dɔ wònye be woanɔ dzovɔsa wɔm na Aƒetɔ, dzovɔsa si nye nuɖuɖu na woƒe Mawu la. Eya ta ele be woanɔ kɔkɔe.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Ele be woayrae wòanɔ kɔkɔe, elabe eyae tsɔa abolo saa vɔe na mia Mawu la. Bu nunɔla ame kɔkɔe elabe nye Aƒetɔ si kɔ mia ŋu la, ɖe mele kɔkɔe.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla aɖe ƒe vi zu gbolo la, eda tɔ́a ɖe anyi vevie ŋutɔ eya ta ele be woatɔ dzoe wòaku.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: “Nunɔlagãe nye nunɔlawo ƒe tatɔ; wokɔ ami ɖe tame nɛ, eye wokɔ eŋu be wòanɔ nunɔlagãwuwo dom; eya ta mele be wòawɔ ɖa ɖe ta hlayii alo adze eƒe awuwo o.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔ ate ɖe ame kuku ŋu o; ne ete ɖe ame kuku ŋu ko egblẽ kɔ ɖo na eɖokui. Nenye tɔ́a alo nɔa ƒe kukuae hã, mekpɔ mɔ ate ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔ ado le kɔkɔeƒe la me loo, alo agblẽ kɔ ɖo na eƒe Mawu ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la o. Elabe Mawu ƒe ami kɔkɔe si wosi nɛ la le eŋu. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Nyɔnu si menya ŋutsu o la ko wòkpɔ mɔ aɖe.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔ aɖe ahosi, alo nyɔnu si kple srɔ̃a dome klã alo nyɔnu si tsɔ gbolowɔwɔ klo bubu le eɖokui ŋu o. Ɖetugbi leaƒea si tso eya nunɔlagãa ƒe hlɔ̃ me koe wòkpɔ mɔ aɖe,

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: be eƒe dzidzimeviwo, ame siwo anye ame kɔkɔewo la, nagava zu bubumanɔŋuitɔwo le eƒe dukɔ me o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ; nyee kɔ eŋu be wòanye nunɔlagã.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Nuwɔametɔ aɖeke megagogo vɔsamlekpui la be yeasa vɔ nam o: ŋkuagbãtɔ o, bafa o, ame si ƒe ŋkume dɔ gblẽ o, ame aɖe si ƒe ata alo abɔ didi akpa o,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: ame si nu vevi wɔ afɔ alo asi na o,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: kpónɔ o, ame kpui o, ame aɖe si nu wɔ ŋku dzi na, ame aɖe si dze akpa o, ame aɖe si ŋu ŋutigbalẽdɔléle bubu aɖe le o, alo ame aɖe si wota o.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: gake mekpɔ mɔ ate ɖe xɔmetsovɔ kɔkɔe la loo, alo vɔsamlekpui la ŋu o. Mele be wòava ƒo ɖi nu kɔkɔe mawo o elabe nyee nye Aƒetɔ, eye nye ŋutɔe wɔa wo kɔkɔe.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ale Mose gblɔ nya siawo na Aron kple Aron viŋutsuwo kpakple Israel-dukɔ la katã.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Aron kple viawo be: Womeganɔ tetem ɖe nu kɔkɔe siwo ŋuti Israel-dukɔ kɔ nam la ŋuti ale be womaƒo ɖi wo o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Ne mia viwo kple miaƒe dzidzimeviwo dometɔ aɖe ŋu mekɔ o gake wòte ɖe nunana kɔkɔe siwo Israel-dukɔ la va nam ƒe ɖe ŋu la, woaɖee ɖa le dukɔ la dome. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Ne Aron ƒe dzidzimevi aɖe le ŋutigbalẽdɔ lém, alo le afu ɖɔm la, mekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu si wotsɔ sa vɔ na Aƒetɔ la ƒe ɖeke o va se ɖe esime eŋu nagakɔ hafi. Ne nane ka ame kuku ŋu ko, ezu nu makɔmakɔ, eye ne nunɔla aɖe ka nenem nu ma ŋu ko eya hã zu ame makɔmakɔ. Nenema ke ne nunɔla aɖe nyè tsi,

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: alo ka asi lã makɔmakɔ aɖe alo ame aɖe si ŋu mekɔ o la ŋu ko, eya hã zu ame makɔmakɔ.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Ne ɣe ɖo to ko, eŋu kɔ azɔ. Ekema ate ŋu aɖu Aƒetɔ ƒe vɔsanuɖuɖu azɔ faa elabe nuɖuɖu ma la, nunɔlawo katã tɔ wònye.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔ aɖu lã aɖe si ku le eɖokui si la ƒe lã, alo lã aɖe si gbemelã aɖe lé la ƒe lã o. Ne eɖui ko, ezu ame makɔmakɔ. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Ele be woawɔ nye sededeawo dzi pɛpɛpɛ; ne menye nenem o la, woazu fɔɖilawo, eye woaku le esi womezɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖo kɔkɔeawo nu o la ta. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ. Nyee kɔa wo ŋu.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Gake nunɔlaa ƒe kluvi si wòƒle alo si wodzi le eƒeme ya ate ŋu aɖu nunɔlawo ƒe nuɖuɖu ma faa.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla ƒe vinyɔnu ɖe ame aɖe si menye nunɔla o la, ekema megakpɔ mɔ aɖu vɔsanu kɔkɔe la o.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Gake ne nunɔla ƒe vinyɔnu srɔ̃ ku, alo eya kple srɔ̃a dome klã, viwo mele esi o eye wòtrɔ gbɔ va le tɔ́a ƒeme abe tsã ene la, ate ŋu aɖu vɔsanua ƒe akpa si wotsɔ vɛ na tɔ́a ƒe ɖe faa. Adzɔgetɔ aɖeke ya mekpɔ mɔ aɖui o.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe tsɔ la si nu wɔ sa vɔe la, Aƒetɔ agbe maxɔ vɔsa la o.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo mekpɔ mɔ agblẽ kɔ ɖo na Israelviwo ƒe nunana kɔkɔe siwo wodzɔ na Aƒetɔ la o.

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: Womegana ame siwo mekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu siawo o la naɖu wo, ahazu agɔdzelawo eye tohehe nava wo dzi o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ. Nyee kɔa nunanawo ŋu.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe di be yeasa ŋutifafavɔ na Aƒetɔ, eɖanye le adzɔgbe aɖe si wòɖe va yi tae o, eɖanye le eya ŋutɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu mee o, tso nyiha alo alẽha mee o, ele be lã la nade blibo le go sia go me, lã si naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na o. Eya ko hafi eƒe vɔsaa ladze Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Nenye wò ŋutɔ koe di be yeana nu le ye ɖokui si la, ekema wò nunanaa ate ŋu anye lã aɖe si ƒe akpa aɖe didi wu alo le kpuie wu ale si dze la faa. Gake nenye adzɔgbee nèɖe be yeava na nua hafi tsɔ lã ma ƒomevi vɛ la, womaxɔe o.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ lã si womimi vo na, wogbã vo na, wovuvu vo na alo sẽ vo na la sa vɔe na Aƒetɔ loo, alo sa vɔe le miaƒe anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ lã ma ƒomevi si nèƒle le amedzro si wɔ nuɖuɖui na Aƒetɔ o, elabe nu wɔ wo. Womaxɔe na wò o.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Ne wodzi nyivi, alẽvi alo gbɔ̃vi aɖe la, ele be lãvi la nanɔ nɔa ŋu ŋkeke adrẽ. Tso ŋkeke enyilia dzi heyi la, woate ŋu atsɔe asa dzovɔ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Mègawu nyinɔ alo alẽ kple via le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi o.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Ne miedi be yewoasa ŋutifafavɔ la, mizɔ ɖe eŋu ɖoɖowo nu pɛpɛpɛ be vɔsaa nadze Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ele be miaɖu ŋutifafavɔsa la wòavɔ, keŋkeŋ gbe si gbe wosa vɔa; mele be ɖeke natsi anyi ŋu nake ɖe edzi o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: “Ale milé fɔ ɖe nye seawo ŋu, eye miwɔ wo dzi pɛpɛpɛ. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be ŋkekenyui siwo anye takpegbe kɔkɔe na mi la woe nye:

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Le kwasiɖa me la, ŋkeke ade ko miekpɔ mɔ awɔ dɔ; ŋkeke adrẽlia nye dzudzɔgbe, eye wònye takpegbe kɔkɔe. Miawɔ dɔ aɖeke o. Enye dzudzɔgbe na Aƒetɔ le miaƒe nɔƒewo katã.” Paska kple Amɔwɔ Maʋamaʋã Bolo Ŋkeke Nyui (Mos IV,

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Migawɔ dɔ gbe ma gbe o, elabe enye avuléŋkeke si dzi woalé avu le na mi le Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽ mawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe dzi la, miasa dzovɔ na Aƒetɔ. Ŋkeke adrẽlia nye takpegbe kɔkɔe, eye miekpɔ mɔ awɔ dɔ sesẽ aɖeke o.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be, ne mieva anyigba si matsɔ na mi la dzi, eye mieŋe nu le edzi la, miatsɔ nuŋeŋe gbãtɔwo vɛ na nunɔla.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Miku wɔ memee kilo eve, miabakae kple ami, eye miatɔ dzoe, ne wòanye nuɖuɖuvɔsa na Aƒetɔ. Vɔsa sia ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ doa dzidzɔ nɛ. Mitsɔ wain lita ɖeka kpe ɖe eŋu ne eya nanye nunonovɔsa.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu nuku yeyea ƒe mumua, mèmea, tɔtɔea, alo eƒe abolo o va se ɖe esime miatsɔe asa vɔ alea na Aƒetɔ hafi. Miaƒe dzidzimeviwo katã nelé ɖoɖo sia me ɖe asi le afi sia afi si mianɔ la, heyi ɖe mavɔ me.” Nuŋeŋkeke Nyui

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Miekpɔ mɔ awɔ dɔ aɖeke gbe ma gbe o. Ele na mi be mialé ɖoɖo sia me ɖe asi, le afi sia afi si mianɔ la, tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: “Xlẽ kwasiɖa blibo adrẽ tso dzudzɔgbe si dzi mietsɔ miaƒe nuku bablaawo vɛ na Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋufɔke.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ abolo eve tso mia nɔƒewo vɛ na Aƒetɔ ne woanyè. Miaku wɔ memee kilo eve, ade amɔwɔʋãnu eme atsɔ mè aboloawo. Woatsɔe vɛ abe nuku gbãtɔwo ene na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ alẽvi adrẽ, siwo xɔ ƒe ɖeka eye naneke mewɔ afi aɖeke na wo o, nyitsu ɖeka kple agbo eve akpe ɖe aboloawo ŋu. Woatsɔ wo awɔ numemevɔsa, eye woawɔ nuɖuɖuvɔsa kple nunonovɔsa hã akpe ɖe numemevɔsa la ŋu na Aƒetɔ. Dzovɔsa sia ʋẽna lílilĩ ɖe Aƒetɔ, hedzea eŋu.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Eyome miatsɔ gbɔ̃tsu ɖeka awɔ nuvɔ̃vɔsa kple agbotsu ɖagbee eve siwo xɔ ƒe ɖeka ko la asa ŋutifafavɔ.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa nanyè aboloawo kple agbotsu eveawo le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Nu kɔkɔe wonye na Aƒetɔ; ke woazu nunɔlaa tɔ.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Miaɖe gbeƒã gbe ma gbe be enye takpegbe kɔkɔe, eye miekpɔ mɔ awɔ dɔ sesẽ aɖeke o.” Ɖoɖo mavɔ wòanye na miaƒe dzidzimewo katã le miaƒe nɔƒewo katã.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: “Ne miele nuku xam la, migaxae yi ɖaʋu ɖe boto ke o, eye ne miexae vɔ la, migagbugbɔ yi ɖatsa agblea me be yewoafɔ esiwo ge ɖe anyi la o. Ke boŋ migblẽ wo ɖi na ame dahewo kple amedzrowo. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu.” Ƒe yeye ɖuɖu (Mos IV,

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Ɣleti adrẽlia sia ƒe ŋkeke ewolia nye avuléŋkeke. Enye takpegbe kɔkɔe na mi; miatsi nu dɔ eye miawɔ dzovɔsa na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Dzudzɔgbe blibo wòanye na mi, eye miawɔ funyafunya mia ɖokui. Miaɖu dzudzɔgbe sia tso ɣletia ƒe ŋkeke asiekelia ƒe fiẽ va se ɖe ŋufɔke ƒe fiẽ.” Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui (Mos IV,

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Le azãa ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la, midi atikutsetse nyakpɔwo, deʋayawo, atilɔ siwo ŋu aŋgbawo le ʋuduu alo tɔtoti sue ʋuyɛwo ƒe alɔdzewo lé ɖe asi ne miatso aseye, aɖe miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ fia le Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ŋkume. Miwɔ esia ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be: Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui na Aƒetɔ nedze egɔme le ɣleti adrẽlia sia ƒe ŋkeke wui atɔ̃lia dzi. Woaɖui ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke gbãtɔ nye takpegbe kɔkɔe. Miekpɔ mɔ awɔ dɔ sesẽ aɖeke o.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Gbe sia gbe la, miwɔ dzovɔsa na Aƒetɔ. Minɔ ewɔwɔ dzi alea ŋkeke adrẽ. Ŋkeke enyilia nye takpegbe kɔkɔe eye migasa dzovɔ na Aƒetɔ. Takpegbe tɔxɛ nye ŋkeke ma; migawɔ dɔ sesẽ aɖeke le edzi o.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: “Esiawoe nye ŋkekenyui siwo dzi wòle be miakpe ta atsɔ ade bubu Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye miasa dzovɔwo, numemevɔwo, nuɖuɖuvɔwo, ŋutifafavɔwo kple nunonovɔwo hã. Miawɔ vɔsa siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le ŋkeke si woɖo ɖi nɛ la dzi.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Miaɖu azã siawo atsɔ kpe ɖe dzudzɔgbe siwo mieɖuna ɖaa la ŋu. Nenema ke miawɔ vɔsa vovovo siawo hã atsɔ kpe ɖe nu siwo mienana kokoko tsã kple miaƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖenunanawo kpakple nunana siwo miatsɔ vɛ na Aƒetɔ le mia ɖokui si la ŋu.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: “Ne mieƒo anyigba la dzi nuku ʋaʋãwo nu ƒu la, ekema miaɖu Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkekenyui la le ɣleti adrẽlia ƒe ŋkeke wui atɔ̃lia dzi, ŋkeke adrẽ sɔŋ. Ŋkeke gbãtɔ nanye dzudzɔgbe kɔkɔe eye enyilia hã nanye dzudzɔgbe kɔkɔe.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Miɖu azã sia na Aƒetɔ ŋkeke adrẽ ƒe sia ƒe. Miaƒe dzidzimeviwo nalé ɖoɖo sia me ɖe asi heyi ɖe mavɔ me. Ɣleti adrẽlia mee miaɖui le.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Israelviwo katã nanɔ agbadɔ me ŋkeke adrẽ,
