english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Ale mexɔ nunyala kple nuteƒekpɔla siwo mieɖe nam tso toawo me, heɖo wo tatɔwoe ɖe mia nu. Wo dometɔ aɖewo le ame akpe nu, ɖewo le ame alafa nu, bubuwo le ame bla atɔ̃ nu eye ɖewo hã le ame ewo nu. Meɖo dɔwɔla bubuwo hã ɖe toawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe me.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Megblɔ na ʋɔnudrɔ̃laawo le ɣe ma ɣi me be: ‘Ne dzre dzɔ ɖe amewo dome la, mide to nya la me na wo. Midrɔ̃ nya ɖe sia ɖe dzɔdzɔe. Miawo ŋutɔ mia nɔviwo domenyae o, amedzrowo ƒe nyae o, migakpɔ ame aɖeke ŋkume o.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Migadrɔ̃ ame le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me o. Midrɔ̃ amegãwo kple ame bubuawo katã ƒe nya sɔsɔe. Migasi ame aɖeke o, elabe Aƒetɔ gbɔe miaƒe nyametsotso latso. Ne nya aɖe dɔdrɔ̃ sesẽ akpa na mi la, mihee vɛ nam.’

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: Evɔ wònye eyae dzea ŋgɔ na mi, eye wòfiaa afi si miaƒu asaɖa anyi ɖo la mi hafi. Enɔa dzobibi me le zã me, eye wònɔa alilikpo me le ŋkeke me be yeafia mɔ si miato la mi. Aƒetɔ he to na Israelviwo (Mos IV,

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: “Míewɔ nu si Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la gblɔ na mí la pɛpɛpɛ. Míeho tso Xoreb eye míeto gbedadaƒo dziŋɔ gã la heɖo ta Amoritɔwo ƒe tonyigba la dzi va ɖo Kades-Barnea.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la tsɔ anyigba si le mia ŋkume la na mi. Miyi ɖaxɔe wòanye mia tɔ abe ale si Aƒetɔ, mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la do ŋugbee na mi ene. Migavɔ̃ o; ŋɔ hã megadzi mi o!’

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Ke mi katã mieva gbɔnye hegblɔ nam be: ‘Na míadɔ amewo ɖe mía ŋgɔ be woayi ɖatsa ŋku le anyigba la dzi, ale be woava gblɔ mɔ si míato kple du siwo tɔgbe le afi ma la na mí.’

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Nya la dze ŋunye eya ta meɖe ŋutsu wui eve, to ɖeka ame ɖeka, le mia dome.

english_verse: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley
translation_verse: Mena woyi tonyigba la dzi ɖado ɖe keke Eskol-bali me ke, eye wotsa le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Wotsɔ kutsetse siwo wokpɔ le afi ma la ƒe ɖewo vɛ na mí, eye wogblɔ be: ‘Anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, tsɔ na mí la nyo ŋutɔ.’

english_verse: Then you came back to the place of worship at Kadesh-Barnea and wept, but the Lord would not listen to your prayers. Israel Spent Years in the Desert Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ale miegbugbɔ va fa avi na Aƒetɔ be wòaxɔ na mi, ke mesee kaka wòahayi ɖe tsɔ ge le eme na mi o. Ƒe siwo Israelviwo nɔ kegbegbe la

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Ke miawo miedze aglã ɖe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe nya la ŋu eye miegbe be yewomayi anyigba la dzi o.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Nu ka ta míele afi ma yim? Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo mí! Elabe míaƒe amedɔdɔawo va gblɔ be dukɔa me tɔwo sɔ gbɔ wu mí, eye wodzɔ atsu wu mí hã. Woƒe duwo lolo eye gli ƒo xlã wo ɖatɔ keke dziŋgɔli ke. Gawu la, wobe yewokpɔ Enak viwo hã le afi ma.’

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, adze mia ŋgɔ eye wòawɔ aʋa na mi abe ale si wòwɔ le Egipte

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: kple gbedadaƒo la miekpɔ ene. Miekpɔ ale si wòkplɔ mí le míaƒe mɔzɔzɔ bliboa me dedie va ɖo afii, abe ale si vi tɔ́ wɔna na via ene.’

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: “Esi Aƒetɔ se miaƒe nyawo la, dzi kui eye wòka atam be:

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: ‘Ne dzidzime vɔ̃ɖi sia me tɔ aɖe aɖo afɔ anyigba nyui si ŋugbe medo be matsɔ na wo tɔgbuiwo la dzi fĩi.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: Kaleb, Yefune vi, koe lade. Eya ɖeka koe wɔ nuteƒe nam, eya ta matsɔ anyigba si dzi wòde la na eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo.’

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Le miaƒe nuwɔna ta la, Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖe nye hã ŋu gblɔ be: ‘Mose, wò gɔ̃ hã made afi ma o.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Ke de dzi ƒo na wò kpeɖeŋutɔ Yosua, Nun vi la, elabe mana eya nade afi ma eye wòana Israelviwo naxɔ anyigba la.’

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ na mí katã be: ‘Mia vi suesue siwo mele naneke nyam o, eye miegblɔ le wo ŋu, be yewoƒe futɔwo gbɔna wo fɔ ge akplɔ yi aboyome la, woawo boŋ lade anyigba la dzi. Woawoe matsɔ anyigba la na woanɔ edzi.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: “Tete mieɖo eŋu nam be: ‘Míewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu. Azɔ la, míayi aɖawɔ aʋa la abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ na mí ene.’ Ale mia dome ame sia ame bla akpa ɖe aʋawɔwɔ ŋu nɔ bubum be tonyigba la xɔxɔ anɔ bɔbɔe.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Gblɔ na wo be womegayi aʋa la o, elabe nyemanɔ wo dome o! Ne woyi la, futɔwo lasi wo.’

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Megblɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la na mi, ke mietsɔ ɖeke le eme o. Miedze aglã ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye miezɔ ɖo ta tonyigba la dzi dàdatɔe.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Tete Amoritɔ siwo nɔ togbɛawo dzi la do bibibi abe anyiwo ene va kpe mi. Wonyà mi ɖe du nu va ɖo keke Xorma ke, eye woɖu mia dzi le Seir-tonyigba dzi.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: “Ale míenɔ Kades ŋkeke geɖe le miaƒe afi ma nɔnɔ me ɣe ma ɣi.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be:

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: ‘Mietsa le to sia tame eteƒe didi eya ta mitrɔ ɖo ta dzigbeme.’

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Eto nam be magblɔ na mi be: ‘Miele mia nɔvi Esau ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe anyigba dzi to ge. Tonyigba dzie wole. Wole mia vɔ̃ ge; mikpɔ nyuie,

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Miate ŋu aƒle nu le wo si aɖu alo adze tsi le wo si ano ya faa.

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Ale míeyi azɔlia dzi. Míedzo le mía nɔvi Esau ƒe dzidzimeviwo, ame siwo le Seir gbɔ, gblẽ Araba-mɔ si tso Elat yi Ezeon-Geber ɖi, eye míeɖo ta Moab-gbegbe.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Migaɖe fu na Moabtɔwo o, eye migawɔ aʋa kpli wo o. Lot ƒe dzidzimeviwo wonye. Metsɔ Ar-du na wo, eye nyematsɔ woƒe anyigba la ƒe akpa ɖeke na mi o.’ ”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: (Tsã la, ame dzɔtsu aɖewo nɔ Er siwo woyɔna be Emitɔwo. Ame siawo sɔ gbɔ eye wokɔ abe Enakitɔwo ene.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Wobua woawo hã ɖe Refaimtɔwo me, ke Moabtɔwo yɔa wo be Emitɔwo.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Tsã la, Xoritɔwo nɔ Edom-nyigba dzi, ke Esau ƒe dzidzimeviwo nyà wo ɖa, gbã woƒe dukɔa hexɔ woƒe nɔƒea wòzu wo tɔ, abe ale si Israelviwo hã nyà woƒe futɔwo ɖa le anyigba si Aƒetɔ na wo la dzi ene.)

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: “Esi aʋawɔlaawo katã ku le dukɔa me vɔ la,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be:

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: ‘Egbe la, èle Ar to ge, ato Moab-nutome ayi.

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Minɔ tetem ɖe Amonviwo ƒe anyigba ŋu. Migaɖe fu na wo loo, alo awɔ aʋa kpli wo be yewoaxɔ woƒe anyigba o. Lot ƒe dzidzimeviwo wonye eya ta nyemaxɔ anyigba si metsɔ na wo la le wo si atsɔ na mi o.’ ”

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wɔ nu sia tɔgbe ke na Edomtɔwo siwo nye Esau ƒe dzidzimeviwo hã. Etsrɔ̃ Xoritɔwo ɖa ale be Edomtɔwo va xɔ wo teƒe hetsi afi ma va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Esi míeto Moab-nyigba me yi vɔ la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ na mí be: ‘Migahoe ɖe edzi ne miatso Arnon-tɔʋu la. Mikpɔ ɖa, metsɔ Amoritɔ Sixon, si nye Xesbon-fia kple eƒe anyigba de mia si. Mikpe aʋa kplii ne miadze eƒe anyigba la xɔxɔ gɔme.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Tso egbe dzi la, mana ŋɔdzi anɔ mia ŋu le afi sia afi le xexea me. Ame sia ame si ase mia ŋkɔ la vɔvɔ̃ aɖoe, wòadzo nyànyanya.’ Israelviwo ɖu fia Sixon dzi (Mos IV,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: ‘Na ne míato wò anyigba me ayi. Míalé mɔ tẽe ko ayi; míele dzedze ge ato afi bubu aɖeke o.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime miatso Yordan-tɔsisi la ayi anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la le tsɔtsɔm na mí la dzi. Ɖe mɔ na mí abe ale si Esau ƒe dzidzimevi siwo le Edom kple Moabtɔ siwo le Ar la ɖe mɔ na mí míeto woƒe anyigba dzi yi ene.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, Sixon kple eƒe dukɔ la mate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwò o. Xɔ eƒe anyigba wòazu tɔwò.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Sixon kple eƒe aʋawɔlawo katã ho va kpe aʋa kpli mí le Yaza gbɔ.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, tsɔe de asi na mí, ale be míewu eya ŋutɔ, via ŋutsuwo kple eƒe amewo katã.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Ke míelé lãwo, eye míeha duawo.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la na míexɔ duwo tso Aroer le Arnon-tɔʋu to kple balimedua gbɔ va se ɖe Gilead. Duawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe gliwo gbagbã nɔ bɔbɔe na mí.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ke míete ɖe Amonviwo ƒe anyigba loo, alo anyigba siwo le Yabok-tɔsisi to loo, alo tonyigba dzi duwo loo, alo teƒe bubu siwo ŋu Aƒetɔ de se le be míagate ɖo o la, ŋu o.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Mègavɔ̃e o. Matsɔ eya ŋutɔ, eƒe dukɔ blibo la kple eƒe anyigba ana wò. Wɔ eya hã abe ale si nèwɔ Sixon, Amoritɔwo ƒe fia si nɔ Xesbon la ene.’

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Míetsrɔ̃ du sia du me tɔwo. Míewu ŋutsuwo, nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo siaa, abe ale si míetsrɔ̃ Sixon-fia si nɔ Xesbon la ƒe duwo me tɔwo ene.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Ke míelé lãwo katã, eye míelɔ aboyonuwo le duawo me tsɔ dzoe.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Ale míexɔ anyigba si le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, tso Arnon-tɔʋu la nu va se ɖe Xermon-to gbɔ le Amori-fia eveawo si.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Míexɔ Og, Basan-fia, ƒe dziɖuƒewo katã. Míexɔ du siwo le tagba, Gilead kple Basan-nutowo katã me yi ɖado ɖe Salxa kple Edrei.

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: Miele kpekpe ge ɖe mia nɔvi Israelvi mamlɛawo ŋu va se ɖe esime woaxɔ anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu, le wo na ge le Yordan ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe, eye wòana woanɔ ŋutifafa me abe ale si wòwɔ na mi le afii ene. Emegbe la mia dome ame sia ame atrɔ gbɔ va anyigba si mena mi la dzi.’

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: “Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, medo gbe ɖa, ƒo koko na Aƒetɔ be:

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: ‘O Aƒetɔ Mawu, èna medze nu dzɔtsu kple nukunu siwo wɔ ge nàla la kpɔkpɔ gɔme xoxo. Ɖe mawu aɖe le dziƒo alo anyigba dzi si ate ŋu awɔ dɔ siawo kple nu dzɔtsu siwo nèwɔna laa?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Meɖe kuku, ɖe mɔ nam ne matso Yordan-tɔsisi la ado ɖe egodo be makpɔ anyigba nyui si le afi ma kple tonyigba si nyakpɔna kpakple Lebanon-towo ɖa dzro.’

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Ke le mia ta la, ɖeko Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖe ŋunye, eye medi be yease nye nya aɖeke o. Ɖeko wògblɔ nam boŋ be: ‘Ema sɔ gbɔ na wò! Mègado nya ma ɖe gbɔnye azɔ o!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Yi Pisga-to tame, eye nàkpɔ ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, anyigbeme kple dzigbeme ɖa. Lé ŋku ɖe nu siwo nàkpɔ la ŋu nyuie, elabe mèle Yordan-tɔsisi sia tso ge o.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Gblɔ nya si le asiwò la na Yosua. De dzi ƒo nɛ, eye nàdo ŋusẽe elabe eyae akplɔ dukɔ sia atso Yordan ayi anyigba si kpɔm nèle la dzi.’

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Ale míetsi bali la me le du si dze ŋgɔ Bet-Peor la.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Azɔ Mose gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Israel-dukɔ, miwɔ se kple ɖoɖo siwo fia ge mala mi la dzi ale be mianɔ agbe ayi aɖaxɔ anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔ ge na mi la.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Migatsɔ nya aɖeke kpe se siwo de ge mala na mi la o, eye migaɖe nya aɖeke hã le wo me o. Ke boŋ miwɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe se siwo de ge mala na mi la dzi.

english_verse: You saw how he killed everyone who worshiped the god Baal Peor.
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔ miekpɔ nu si Aƒetɔ wɔ le Peor-to dzi. Etsrɔ̃ ame siwo katã subɔ Baal le afi ma la ɖa le mia dome,

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: ke mi ame siwo wɔ nuteƒe na Aƒetɔ la, miawoe tsi agbe li va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Ke kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi, eye nàdzra wò luʋɔ ɖo kple moveviɖoɖo, ne menye nenem o la, àŋlɔ nu siwo wò ŋku kpɔ la be, eye woado le dzime na wò le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me. Na viwòwo kple viwòwo ƒe viwo nanya wo.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Wonenya ale si gbe ma gbe nètsi tsitre ɖe Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ŋkume le Xoreb gbɔ, eye Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Ƒo dukɔ la nu ƒu nam, be mana woase nye nyawo ale be mana woanya ale si woavɔ̃m le ŋkeke siwo katã me woanɔ agbe le anyigba dzi, eye woafia wo viwo hã be woawɔ nenema.

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Migblɔ ale si mieva tsi tsitre ɖe to la te, ale si dzudzɔ yibɔ gba bla to la abe alilikpo ene, ale si viviti do, eye dzo nɔ bibim vlavlavla ɖanɔ dziƒo ke tɔm la na wo.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ƒo nu na mi tso dzo la me na wò. Nyagbewo ɖi miese; ke miekpɔ nɔnɔme aɖeke o; gbe koe ɖi miese.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nu si wòle be miawɔ be miate ŋu awɔ eƒe nubabla dzi la na mi. Eyae nye be miawɔ Se Ewoawo siwo woŋlɔ ɖe kpe eveawo dzi la dzi.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be mafia seawo kple ɖoɖoawo mi ne miawɔ wo dzi le anyigba si xɔ ge mieyina la dzi. Aƒetɔ gbe nya na Israelviwo le trɔ̃subɔsubɔ ŋuti

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: “Gbe si gbe Aƒetɔ ƒo nu na mi tso dzo me le Xoreb gbɔ la, miekpɔ naneke ƒe nɔnɔme o. Eya ta mikpɔ nyuie,

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: ne miagawɔ naneke ƒe nɔnɔme na mia ɖokui wòanye legba mianɔ subɔsubɔm o. Eɖanye ŋutsu alo nyɔnu ƒe nɔnɔme o,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, Aƒetɔ ɖe wòɖe mi tso Egipte si nɔ abe galóloƒe ene la be mianye ye ŋutɔ ƒe dukɔ abe ale si miezu egbe ene.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, Aƒetɔ do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye le mia ta, eye wòka atam be nyematso Yordan-tɔsisi la kaka ayi afɔ ɖo ge anyigba nyui si yele mia na ge, be wòanye miaƒe domenyinu la dzi o.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Nye la, nyematso Yordan-tɔsisi la o; maku ɖe anyigba sia dzi. Ke miawo ya miele etso ge ayi aɖaxɔ anyigba nyui ma wòazu mia tɔ.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Eya ta mikpɔ nyuie ne miagaŋlɔ nu, si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la bla kpli mi la be o. Migawɔ legba alo nu siwo Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la tsri na mi la ƒe nɔnɔme aɖeke na mia ɖokui o,

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ɖe wòle abe dzo binu ene, eye wòʋãa ŋu vevie.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ akaka mi ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye mia dometɔ ʋɛ aɖewo koe asusɔ ɖe afi siwo wònyà mi ɖo ɖa la.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Ne mieyi afi mawo la, miasubɔ mawu siwo amegbetɔ tsɔ ati kple kpe wɔ, mawu siwo mekpɔa nu alo sea nu o; mawu siwo meɖua nu alo ʋeʋẽa nu sena o la miasubɔ.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Ne nu siawo katã va dzɔ ɖe mia dzi le ɣe ma ɣi me, eye mieɖo xaxa me la, ekema miagatrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ, miaƒe Mawu ŋu, eye miawɔ eƒe nya dzi.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la la, nublanuikpɔla wònye. Magblẽ mi ɖi alo atsrɔ̃ mi o, eye maŋlɔ nu, si wòka atam bla kple mia tɔgbuiwo la be o.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ena miese eƒe gbe tso dziƒo ale be wòate ŋu afia nu mi. Ena miekpɔ eƒe dzo kɔkɔe la le anyigba dzi, eye wòƒo nu na mi tso eme.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Esi wòlɔ̃ mia tɔgbuiwo ta la, etia mi ame siwo nye woƒe dzidzimeviwo, eye eya ŋutɔ kplɔ mi kple eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la tso Egipte.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: Esi miegbɔna la, enyà dukɔ triakɔ siwo sesẽ wu mi la ɖa le mia ŋgɔ, be yeakplɔ mi ayi afi ma aɖatsɔ woƒe anyigba na mi wòazu mia tɔ, abe ale si anyigba la le mia si me va se ɖe egbe ene.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Eya ta minyae egbea, migaŋlɔe be gbeɖe o, be Aƒetɔ koe nye Mawu le dziƒo kple anyigba siaa. Mawu bubu aɖeke megali kpe ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Esia ta miwɔ se kple ɖoɖo siwo mede na mi egbea la dzi ne nu sia nu nadze edzi nyuie na mi kple miaƒe dzidzimeviwo siaa. Mianɔ agbe didi le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu le tsɔtsɔm na mi la dzi tegbee.” Sitsoƒedu siwo le Yordan-tɔsisi la ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: va le Yordan ƒe go kemɛ dzi le tagba le Bet-Peor kasa. Anyigba sia nye Sixon, Amoritɔwo ƒe fia si nɔ Xesbon la tɔ. Esi Mose kple Israelviwo ʋu dzo le Egipte va yina la, woawo kple fia sia wɔ aʋa, eye woɖu edzi.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Woxɔ eya kple Og, Basan-fia si hã nye Amoritɔwo ƒe fia la, ƒe anyigba le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Anyigba sia dze egɔme tso Aroer le Arnon-tɔʋu to keke va do ɖe Sion-to si wogayɔna hã be Xermon-to la gbɔ.

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: Anyigba siwo mlo ɖe nu le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome ʋuu ɖado ɖe dzi va se ɖe Ƒukuku nu le anyigbeme kple Pisga-to gɔme la hã le eme.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mose yɔ Israelviwo katã ƒo ƒu, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Israelviwo, miɖo to ne miase se kple ɖoɖo siwo katã gblɔ ge mele na mi egbe sia. Misrɔ̃ wo, milé wo me ɖe asi ne miawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mègawu ame o.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Esi míenɔ Xoreb gbɔ la, Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la bla nu kpli mí.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Menye mía tɔgbuiwo koe wòbla nu sia kplii le ɣe ma ɣi me o, ke boŋ eblae kple mí ame siwo katã le agbe le afii egbe hã.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒo nu kpli mi ŋkume kple ŋkume tso dzo me le to sia gbɔ.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, menɔ mi kple Aƒetɔ dome be magblɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nyawo na mi elabe mienɔ dzo la vɔ̃m, eye miete ŋu lia to la o. Egblɔ be:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu, si kplɔ wò tso Egipte-nyigba dzi afi si nènye kluvi le kpɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mègasubɔ mawu bubu aɖeke kpe ɖe ŋunye o.’ ”

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mègawɔ legba aɖeke na ɖokuiwò o. Mègawɔ naneke si le dziƒo, alo anyigba dzi, alo tsi me le anyigba te o.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Mègade ta agu na wo dometɔ aɖeke alo asubɔ ɖeke o, elabe nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, Mawu ʋãŋu menye. Meɖoa vi tɔ́wo ƒe vodada teƒe na wo vi siwo léa fum va se ɖe woƒe dzidzime etɔ̃lia kple enelia dzi.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Ke mevea dzidzime akpe nane siwo lɔ̃am, eye wowɔa nye sewo dzi la nu.’ ”

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mègayɔ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ŋkɔ dzodzro o, elabe ame si yɔ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ dzodzro la, magbe tohehe nɛ o.’ ”

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Wɔ dɔ ŋkeke ade ko, eye èkpɔ mɔ awɔ ŋuwò dɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi le ŋkeke ade siawo me.

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: Ke ŋkeke adrẽlia nye dzudzɔgbe na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la. Gbe ma gbe la, ame aɖeke megawɔ dɔ aɖeke o. Wò ŋutɔ wòɖanye o, viwò ŋutsu alo viwò nyɔnu wòɖanye o, wò dɔlaŋutsu alo wò dɔlanyɔnu wòɖanye o, wò nyitsu, wò tedzi alo wò lãwo dometɔ aɖe wòɖanye o, mɔzɔla si dze gbɔwò la wòɖanye o, ɖeke megawɔ dɔ aɖeke o. Ele be wò dɔlawo hã, ŋutsu kple nyɔnu, nagbɔ ɖe eme gbe ma gbe abe wò ŋutɔ ke ene.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi be yenye kluvi kpɔ le Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la tsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ kplɔ wò tso afi mae. Esia tae Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le gbɔgblɔm na wò be nàwɔ dzudzɔgbe la ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bu tɔ́wò kple nɔwò abe ale si nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la mede se na wò ene, be nànɔ agbe didi, eye nu nadze dzi na wò le anyigba si mele tsɔtsɔ ge na wò la dzi.’ ”

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mègafi fi o.’ ”

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: “Se siawoe Aƒetɔ de na mi katã esime mieƒo ƒu ɖe toa gbɔ. Nya siawoe Aƒetɔ gblɔ kple gbe sesẽ tso to la dzi tso dzo kple alilikpo dodo me; megagblɔ nya aɖeke kpe ɖe wo ŋu o. Aƒetɔ ŋlɔ seawo ɖe kpe eve dzi hetsɔ nam. Dukɔ la ƒe vɔvɔ̃ (Mos II,

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: “Esime dzo nɔ bibim le toa ŋu, eye miese gbea tso vivitia me la, miaƒe toawo ƒe tatɔwo kple ame tsitsiwo va gbɔnye,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la na míekpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple gãnyenye esi míese eƒe nuƒo tso dzo la me. Míekpɔ nuteƒe egbe! Mawu ƒo nu kple amegbetɔ gake wògale agbe!

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Ke nu ka ta míaku azɔ? Dzobibi gã sia le mía fiã ge. Ne míegase Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu ƒe gbe ko, míeku.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ka le xexe sia me si se Mawu gbagbe la ƒe gbe tso dzobibi me abe míawo ene, ko tsi agbe kpɔ?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Te ɖe eŋu nàse nya siwo katã gblɔm wòle, nàva gblɔ na mí. Míaɖo to ase wo tso nuwò, eye míawɔ wo dzi.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: “Ale Aƒetɔ se miaƒe nya, esi mieƒo nu kplim. Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Mese nya siwo katã dukɔ sia gblɔ na wò. Nu siwo katã wogblɔ la le eteƒe.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Ko wòanye alea woƒe susu anɔ woanɔ vɔ̃yem ɣe sia ɣi! Woalé nye sededewo katã me ɖe asi, eye woawɔ wo dzi la, anyo na woawo kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo siaa tegbee hafi!

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Yi ɖagblɔ na wo be wonegbugbɔ yi woƒe agbadɔwo gbɔ.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ke wò la, tsi tsitre ɖe gbɔnye afii, ne magblɔ nye seawo katã kple ɖoɖoawo kpakple kɔnuawo na wò. Nàfia wo be woawɔ wo dzi le anyigba si tsɔm mele na wo wòazu wo tɔ la dzi.’

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Miwɔ seawo katã dzi ne nu nanyo na mi, ne mianɔ agbe didi le anyigba si azu mia tɔ la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Esiawo nye se kple ɖoɖo kpakple kɔnu siwo Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la gblɔ nam be mafia mi. Miwɔ wo dzi le anyigba si tsɔm wòle na mi be miaxɔ wòazu mia tɔ la dzi.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Le miaƒe agbenɔɣi katã la, mi kple miaƒe dzidzimeviwo katã mivɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, eye miwɔ ɖoɖo kple se siwo katã megblɔ na mi la dzi be mianɔ agbe didi.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Eya ta Israel, see; lé seawo me ɖe asi eye nàwɔ wo dzi. Ne èwɔ esia la, eme anyo na wò, eye nàdzi ɖe dzi fũu, anɔ anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la dzi abe ale si Aƒetɔ, tɔgbuiwòwo ƒe Mawu la do ŋugbe na wò ene.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: “Israel, see! Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, Aƒetɔ ɖeka koe.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Eya ta lɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la kple wò dzi blibo kple wò luʋɔ blibo kpakple wò ŋusẽ katã.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Bla wo ɖe alɔnu kple ŋgonu be nànɔ ŋku ɖom wo dzi.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ŋlɔ wo ɖe wò xɔ ƒe ʋɔtrutiwo kple wò agbowo nu. Nuxlɔ̃amenya le tomaɖomaɖo ŋu

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: “Ne Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la kplɔ wò va anyigba si ŋu wòka atam ɖo na mia tɔgbuiwo, Abraham, Isak kple Yakob, be yeakplɔ wò ava anyigba aɖe si dzi du lolo nyui siwo menye miawoe tso wo o la le,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: eye woƒe xɔwo me yɔ fũu kple xɔmenu nyui siwo menye wòe de wo xɔawo me o. Vudo siwo menye wòe ɖe wo o la li. Waingble siwo menye wòe de wo o kple amitibɔ siwo menye wòe tso wo o la hã li. Ne Aƒetɔ kplɔ wò va anyigba sia dzi, eye nuɖuɖu ɖe sia ɖe si nèhiã la su asiwò la,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: kpɔ nyuie be màgaŋlɔ Aƒetɔ si kplɔ wò tso Egipte, afi si nènye kluviwo le kpɔ la be o.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la; subɔ eya ɖeka ko, eye tsɔ eya ko ŋkɔ ka atam.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Migasubɔ dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã mi la ƒe mawuwo o.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Ne miekatsɛ subɔ mawu bubu aɖe la, Aƒetɔ ado dziku ɖe mia ŋu vevie, atsrɔ̃ mi, miavɔ le anyigba dzi, elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu si le mia gbɔ la, Mawu ʋãŋu wònye.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: “Migate Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la kpɔ abe ale si mietee kpɔ le Masa ene o.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Miwɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe seawo, ɖaseɖiɖiawo kple ɖoɖoawo, siwo wògblɔ na mi la dzi.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: “Ne viwòwo va bia wò gbe aɖe gbe be: ‘Nu ka ta Aƒetɔ gblɔ be míwɔ se siawo katã dzi?’ mahã la,

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: gblɔ na wo be: ‘Míenye kluviwo na Egipte Fiagã kpɔ, eye Aƒetɔ ɖe mí tso esi me kple eƒe ŋusẽsi la.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Míawo ŋutɔ míekpɔ dzesi kple nukunu klitsu, dziŋɔ siwo wòtsɔ tu nu kple Egiptetɔwo, woƒe Fiagã kple eŋumewo katã la.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Eɖe mí tso Egipte, eye wòkplɔ mí va afii hetsɔ anyigba sia na mí abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na mía tɔgbuiwo ene.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe si wòle be míawɔ lae nye be míalé seawo katã me ɖe asi, eye míawɔ wo dzi, ekema akpɔ ŋudzedze le mía ŋu.’

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Eya ta azɔ la, lé se, ɖoɖo kple kɔnu siwo megblɔ na wò egbe la me ɖe asi eye nàwɔ wo dzi.” Yayra siwo le toɖoɖo Aƒetɔ me (Mos V,

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Tsrɔ̃ dukɔ siwo katã Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la tsɔ de asi na wò; mègakpɔ nublanui na wo dometɔ aɖeke o. Mègasubɔ woƒe mawuwo o, elabe ne èwɔ esia la, woazu mɔ̀ ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la tsɔ dukɔ siawo de asi na wò, eye nèɖu wo dzi la, mitsrɔ̃ wo keŋkeŋ. Mègabla nu kpli wo o, eye migave wo nu hã o.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: elabe woana mia viŋutsuwo magasubɔm o, ke boŋ woasubɔ mawu bubuwo. Ne eva eme alea la, Aƒetɔ ado dziku ɖe mia ŋu, eye wòatsrɔ̃ mi enumake.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Ke boŋ nu si miawɔ lae nye be mimu woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, migbã woƒe legbawo, milã woƒe nyɔnumawu Asera-tiwo ƒu anyi, eye mitɔ dzo woƒe aklama kpakpɛwo.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: “Miwɔ esia elabe dukɔ kɔkɔe nànye na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la. Eya ŋutɔe tia wò tso dukɔwo katã dome le anyigba dzi be mianye yeƒe dukɔ tɔxɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ esi Aƒetɔ lɔ̃ mi, eye wòdi be yeawɔ atam si yeka na mia tɔgbuiwo la dzi tae. Esia tae wòwɔ eƒe ŋusẽ ŋudɔ tsɔ ɖe mi tso Egipte Fiagã si me be azɔ la, miaganye eƒe kluviwo akpɔ o.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Eya ta nyae be Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, Mawu nuteƒewɔla kple anukwaretɔ wònye. Ewɔa eƒe nubabla dzi, eye wòkpɔa nublanui hena dzidzime akpewo siwo lɔ̃nɛ, eye woawɔa eƒe se dzi.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame aɖe lé fui ko la, ehea to na nenem me ma enumake.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ayra wò wu dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe. Mia dometɔ aɖeke manye ame si medzia vi o, eye miaƒe lãhawo matsi ko o.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ ŋunyɔnu aɖeke va aƒewò me ne fiƒode si le eŋu la nava dziwò o. Ele be nànyɔ ŋui; nàtsrii keŋkeŋ, elabe fiƒode le eŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Alɔ̃ wò, ayra wò, ana nàdzi ɖe dzi fũu eye viwòwo asɔ gbɔ. Ayra wò agbledeƒewo ale be àkpɔ bli, wain kple ami aɖu. Ana wò nyiwo kple alẽwo nadzi fũu. Aƒetɔ ana nu siawo katã asu asiwò elabe eka atam na tɔgbuiwòwo be yeatsɔ wo na wò le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Ne miese ɖoɖo siawo, lé fɔ ɖe wo ŋu, eye miewɔ wo dzi la, Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la awɔ eƒe nubabla dzi, eye wòalɔ̃ mi tegbee abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na mia tɔgbuiwo ene.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ akpɔ mia ta, ate dɔléle ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ɖa xaa tso gbɔwò, eye mana dɔléle vɔ̃ɖi siwo katã nènya le Egipte-nyigba dzi la dometɔ aɖeke nado ta ɖe gbɔwò o, ke boŋ akplɔ wo aƒu wò futɔwo.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: “Mègagblɔ na ɖokuiwò be dukɔ sia me tɔwo sɔ gbɔ wum ta yemate ŋu anyà wo ɖa o.

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Mègavɔ̃ na wo o, ke boŋ ɖo ŋku nu si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la wɔ Egipte Fiagã kple Egiptetɔwo katã la dzi.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku fuwɔame dziŋɔ siwo wò ŋutɔ nèkpɔ kple ŋku, dzesiwo, nukunuwo, ŋusẽ kple ŋutete si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la tsɔ xɔ wò, eye wòɖe wò do goe la dzi. Alea ke Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la awɔ dukɔ siwo katã nèle vɔvɔ̃m na fifia la hã.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Aɖo téamekplɔɖoewo hã ɖe wo dome be woatɔtɔ keŋkeŋ va se ɖe esime wo dome mamlɛtɔ siwo yi ɖabè la atsrɔ̃ avɔ.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Eya ta womegadzi ŋɔ na mi o elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu si le mia dome la, Mawu triakɔ dziŋɔ wònye.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Anyà dukɔ siawo ɖa le ŋgɔwò ʋɛʋɛʋɛ; matsrɔ̃ wo zi ɖeka o, elabe ne eva eme nenema la, lã wɔadãwo adzi ɖe dzi aɖe fu na wò.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Atsɔ woƒe fiawo ade asi na wò; wu wo, eye wo ŋkɔ maganɔ anyi o. Wo dometɔ aɖeke manɔ te ɖe nuwò o; miatsrɔ̃ wo woavɔ.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Mitɔ dzo woƒe aklama kpakpɛwo. Wo ŋu sika kple klosalo megabiã ŋu na mi, ne miatsɔ o. Ne mietsɔ ɖe la, miage ɖe mɔ̀ me, elabe wonye ŋunyɔnu le Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ŋkume.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Milé se siwo katã mede na mi egbea la me ɖe asi, eye miwɔ wo dzi, ne mianɔ agbe, adzi ɖe edzi, eye miayi aɖaxɔ anyigba si Aƒetɔ ka atam be yeana mia tɔgbuiwo la.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ebɔbɔ wò ɖe anyi, na dɔ wu wò, eye wòna mana si miawo ŋutɔ kple mia tɔgbuiwo siaa mieɖu kpɔ o la mi mieɖu. Ewɔ esia be yeatsɔ afia wò be mele be amegbetɔ naɖo ŋu ɖe nuɖuɖu ko ŋu be eyae na yele agbe o, ke nya sia nya si Aƒetɔ gblɔ la boŋ ye na yele agbe.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Eya ta nàse egɔme nyuie be ale si vi tɔ́ hea vii, fia nunyae la, nenema tututu Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la wɔ na wò.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, wɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nya dzi. Lé eƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye nàvɔ̃e.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la kplɔ wò yina anyigba nyui aɖe dzi. Tɔʋuwo, vudowo kple ta, siwo dzɔ tso towo dzi kple baliwo me la bɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Dɔ mawu wò le afi ma gbeɖe o, eye naneke mahiã wò o. Ga yibɔ le eƒe kpewo me, eye miaku akɔbli tso eƒe togbɛwo hã me.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Àɖu nu aɖi ƒo, eye àkafu Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le anyigba nyui si wòna wò la ƒe nyonyo ta. Nyagbename le Aƒetɔ ŋɔŋlɔ be ŋuti

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: “Kpɔ nyuie be màgaŋlɔ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la be, eye nàgbe eƒe ɖoɖowo, kɔnuwo kple sewo siwo megblɔ na wò la dzi wɔwɔ o.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Ne èɖu nu ɖi ƒo, tu xɔ nyuiwo le wo me,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: wò nyihawo kple alẽwo dzi ɖe edzi, klosalo kple sika su asiwò si fũu, eye nunɔamesi bubuwo hã dzi ɖe edzi na wò la,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: kpɔ nyuie ne màgado ɖokuiwò ɖe dzi aŋlɔ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la be o. Ɖo ŋui be eyae xɔ wò ɖe agbe tso Egipte, afi si nènye kluvi le kpɔ la.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Mègaŋlɔ eya ame si kplɔ wò to gbedadaƒo dziŋɔ gã la, si da vɔ̃ kple dziɖegbe nɔ la be o. Togbɔ be tsi vena vevie le afi ma hã la, ena tsi do tso kpe sesẽwo me.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: Eyae tsɔ mana si miawo kple mia tɔgbuiwo mienya o la na wò nèɖu le gbedadaƒo la. Eyae bɔbɔ wò ɖe anyi, eye wòdo wò kpɔ be yeava wɔ nyui ɖe enu na wò emegbe, eya ta migaŋlɔe be o.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Mègabu be ye ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ kple ŋutetee yetsɔ kpɔ kesinɔnu siawoe o.

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ɖo ŋku edzi be Aƒetɔ, Mawu lae na ŋusẽ wò be nète ŋu kpɔ kesinɔnuawo. Ewɔ esia be yeaɖee afia be yemeŋlɔ nu, si yebla kple tɔgbuiwòwo la be o, ke boŋ eya dzi wɔm yele egbe gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Ne miegbe toɖoɖo Aƒetɔ la, atsrɔ̃ mi abe ale si wòle dukɔ siwo le mia ŋgɔ la tsrɔ̃ ge ɖa ene.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: “Israel-dukɔ, ɖo to nàsee! Egbe la, èle Yordan-tɔsisi la tso ge ayi aɖaxɔ dukɔ siwo sɔ gbɔ, eye wosesẽ wu wò la ƒe anyigba. Èle woƒe du siwo lolo eye wo ŋu gliwo kɔ ɖatɔ keke dziŋgɔli ke la hã xɔ ge.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Dukɔa me tɔwo nye ame kɔkɔ, sesẽwo; Enak viwo, ame siwo ŋu amewo gblɔna le be: ‘Ame ka ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe Enak viwo nu?’

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Ke egbe la, wò ŋutɔ èle ekpɔ ge be Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la dze ŋgɔwò abe dzobibi ene yi tɔa godo. Eya ŋutɔ aɖu wo dzi le ŋgɔwò ale be ànyà wo ɖa, atsrɔ̃ wo kaba ŋutɔ abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na wò ene.

english_verse: After the Lord helps you wipe out these nations and conquer their land, don't think he did it because you are such good people. You aren't good—you are stubborn! No, the Lord is going to help you, because the nations that live there are evil, and because he wants to keep the promise he made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. When Israel Made an Idol (Exodus
translation_verse: “Eya ta eme nekɔ na wò nyuie be menye miaƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ɖoe be yeatsɔ anyigba nyui la na wò wòazu tɔwò ɖo o, elabe dukɔ sẽto nènye.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Ale si nèdo dɔmedzoe na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le gbedadaƒo la la, nenɔ ŋku dzi na wò ɖaa. Tso gbe si gbe mieʋu tso Egipte ke va se ɖe esime mieva afii la, miedzea aglã ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Le Xoreb gbɔ gɔ̃ hã la, miedo dɔmedzoe na Aƒetɔ. Dzi kui vevie ɖe mia ŋu, wòdi be yeatsrɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Netsɔ nàɖi kaba ayi, elabe wò ame siwo nèkplɔ tso Egipte la wɔ nu tovo. Woɖe asi le se si mede na wo la ŋu gɔ̃ xoxo eye wokɔ̀ legba na wo ɖokui.’

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ gagblɔ nam be: ‘Edze nam ƒãa be ame dzeaglãwoe nye ame siawo.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ɖe asi le ŋunye ne matsrɔ̃ wo. Meɖoe be matsrɔ̃ wo ɖa keŋkeŋ le xexea me ale be ame aɖeke magaɖo ŋku wo dzi akpɔ o. Azɔ mawɔ wò nazu dukɔ si asesẽ, eye nasɔ gbɔ wu wo.’

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Ale metrɔ heɖi tso toa dzi, lé nubabla ƒe kpe eveawo ɖe asi. Le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, dzobibi nɔ dzi dem le toa gbɔ.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Ke mekpɔ be miewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ŋu gɔ̃ xoxo, elabe mietu nu, si miebla kple Aƒetɔ, eye miekɔ̀ legba si le nyivi ƒe nɔnɔme la na mia ɖokui.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Ale, le mia ŋkume, mekɔ kpe eve siwo melé ɖe asi la xlã ɖe anyi wogbã enumake.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖe Aron hã ŋu ŋutɔ be yeawui; ke meɖe kuku ɖe eya hã ta ɣe ma ɣi ke.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Mexɔ nyivilegba si miekɔ̀, eye wònye nuvɔ̃ la de dzo me. Metui wòme, zu wɔ, eye melɔe kɔ ɖe tɔʋu si sí tso toa dzi la me.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: “Miegado dɔmedzoe na Aƒetɔ le Tabera, Masa kple Kibrot-Hatava hã.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Aƒetɔ dɔ mi le Kades-Barnea be miyi ɖaxɔ anyigba si wòna mi be wòazu mia tɔ la, miedze aglã ɖe eŋu. Mieɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu alo se eƒe gbe o.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Tso esime menya mi va se ɖe fifi la, aglã ko miedzena ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: “Medra ɖe anyigba, tsyɔ mo anyi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume nenema ʋuu ŋkeke bla ene, zã bla ene, elabe Aƒetɔ ɖoe be yeatsrɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Tete medo gbe ɖa nɛ be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu, dukɔ sia la, wò ŋutɔ tɔwòe; mègatsrɔ̃e o. Wò ŋutɔe xɔe ɖe agbe to nu dzɔtsu wɔwɔ me, eye nèkplɔ wo kple wò ŋusẽsi la tso Egipte.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò dɔlawo Abraham, Isak kple Yakob dzi, ne nàɖe kɔ ɖa le dukɔ sia ƒe tosesẽ, nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ kple woƒe nuvɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, Egiptetɔwo agblɔ be wò amewo kpɔkplɔ yi anyigba si ŋugbe nèdo na wo la dzi glo wò. Woagblɔ hã be ɖeko nèkplɔ wò dukɔ la yi gbedadaƒoe be yeaɖawu elabe elé fu wo.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, wò ŋutɔ wò dukɔe, eye nètsɔ wò ŋusẽ triakɔ kple wò ŋusẽsi la kplɔ wo dzoe le Egipte hafi.’

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: “Azɔ la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: ‘Kpa kpe eve abe gbãtɔwo ene, eye nàtsɔ ʋuƒo akpa aɖaka kpe ɖe wo ŋu. Gbugbɔ va gbɔnye le toa dzi,

english_verse: When I had taken the second set of stones up the mountain, I spent
translation_verse: “Metsi toa dzi ŋkeke bla ene, zã bla ene abe tsã ene. Aƒetɔ se nye kukuɖeɖe ɣe ma ɣi hã, eye wòlɔ̃ be yemagatsrɔ̃ wò o.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: ne maŋlɔ nya siwo nɔ kpe gbãtɔ siwo nègbã dzi la ɖe wo dzi nàtsɔ de aɖaka la me.’

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Ale metsɔ xé kpa aɖaka la, eye mekpa kpe eve abe gbãtɔwo ene. Metsɔ kpe eveawo helia to la.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ŋlɔ nya siwo wòŋlɔ ɖe kpe gbãtɔawo dzi tsã la ɖe kpe eveawo dzi. Nyaawoe nye Se Ewo siwo wòde na mi esime mieƒo ƒu gbe ma gbe ɖe toa gbɔ, eye wòƒo nu na mi tso dzo me. Aƒetɔ tsɔ kpeawo nam.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Tete meɖi tso to la dzi. Metsɔ kpe eveawo de aɖaka si mekpa la me, abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam ene. Kpeawo gale afi ma ɖa.”

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, eye nàsubɔ eya ɖeɖe ko. Ku ɖe eŋu, eye nàtsɔ eya ko ƒe ŋkɔ ka atam.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: Israelviwo ho tso Yaakantɔwo ƒe vudowo gbɔ heva Mosera. Aron ku ɖe afi ma, eye woɖii ɖi. Via Eleazar zu nunɔla ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Esi wodzo le afi ma la, wova Hagudgod, eye wogaho tso Hagudgod va Yotba, afi si tɔʋu geɖe le.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Le toa gbɔ la, Aƒetɔ tia Levi-to la be woawo nanye nubablaɖaka la dzikpɔlawo, anɔ ye subɔm abe nunɔlawo ene, eye woayra ame le yeƒe ŋkɔ me. Dɔ sia gale wo si me va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be matso ne makplɔ mi ayii, ne miaɖaxɔ anyigba si ŋu yeka atam le na mia tɔgbuiwo be yeatsɔe na wo wòazu wo tɔ la. Nu si Mawu di

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: “Azɔ Israelviwo, nu ka dim Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le tso asiwò wu be nàvɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, awɔ nu siwo katã wògblɔ na wò la, alɔ̃e, asubɔe kple dzi blibo kpakple luʋɔ blibo, eye

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: nàwɔ eƒe se kple ɖoɖowo siwo ƒe se mede na wò egbe la dzi be wòanyo na wò?

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, dziƒowo kple dziƒowo ƒe dziƒo nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la tɔ. Nenema ke anyigba kple nu siwo katã le edzi hã la, etɔwoe wonye.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃ na mia tɔgbuiwo de to ale gbegbe be wòtia mi, woƒe dzidzimeviwo ko, tso dukɔwo katã dome, eye mieganye eƒe ame tiatiawo va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Eya ta azɔ la, mitso aʋa na miaƒe dziwo na Aƒetɔ, eye migadze aglã ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ɖu mawuwo katã dzi, eye wòkpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe aƒetɔwo katã dzi. Enye Mawu triakɔ si ŋu ŋusẽ kple ŋɔdzi le. Medea ame aɖeke dzi o, eye mexɔa zãnu o.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: Etsoa afia na tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo, elɔ̃a amedzro, naa nu wòɖuna kple avɔ wòtana.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Eya ta milɔ̃ amedzro elabe miawo hã mienye amedzro kpɔ le Egipte.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Eyae nàkafu. Wò Mawue! Wò ŋutɔ èkpɔ nukunu dziŋɔ siwo katã wòwɔ na wò.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “Eya ta lɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la eye nàwɔ eƒe nufiamewo, ɖoɖowo, kɔnuwo kple sewo dzi ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nyawo dzi menye mia vi siwo menya nu siawo alo mekpɔ wo teƒe o lae mele nya sia gblɔm na o. Mebe miɖo ŋku Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ƒe amehehe kple gãnyenye, ŋusẽ triakɔ kple ŋutete dzi.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔ miekpɔ dzesi kple nukunu siwo wòwɔ le Egipte ɖe Egipte Fiagã la kple eƒe anyigba blibo la ŋu.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: Esi Egipte-ʋakɔ tsɔ woƒe sɔwo kple tasiaɖamwo ti mia yome la, miekpɔ ale si Aƒetɔ na Aƒlaƒu la ŋe ɖe wo dzi, eye wòtsrɔ̃ wo keŋ va se ɖe egbe,

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: kple nu si wòwɔ na mi le gbedadaƒo la va se ɖe esime mieva afii.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nu si wòwɔ Ruben vi, Eliab, viŋutsuwo, Datan kple Abiram, la dzi. Anyigbae ke nu mi wo, wo srɔ̃wo, wo viwo, woƒe dɔlawo, woƒe lãwo kple woƒe avɔgbadɔwo keŋ le Israel-dukɔ blibo la ŋkume,

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: elabe miekpɔ nukunu dziŋɔ, siwo Aƒetɔ wɔ la kple miaƒe ŋkuwo. Yayra siwo le Ŋugbedodonyigba la dzi

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: “Esia ta miwɔ se siwo katã mede na mi egbe la dzi be ŋusẽ nanɔ mia ŋu, eye miate ŋu ayi ɖaxɔ anyigba si dzi yim miele la wòazu mia tɔ.

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ esia la, mianɔ agbe didi le anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo, si ŋugbe Aƒetɔ do na mia tɔgbuiwo be yeatsɔ ana woawo ŋutɔ kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo la dzi.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Ke le anyigba si dzi yim nèle be nàɖaxɔe wòazu tɔwò ya dzi la, towo kple baliwo li, eye wònoa tsi si dzana tso dziƒo.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ŋutɔ léa be nɛ, eye eƒe ŋku nɔa eŋu ɣe sia ɣi tso ƒea ƒe gɔmedzedze va se ɖe nuwuwu.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: “Eya ta milé to ɖe se siwo mede na mi egbe la ŋu. Milɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, eye misubɔe kple dzi blibo kpakple luʋɔ blibo,

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie be dzi nagable mi, ne miatrɔ asubɔ mawu bubuwo, ade ta agu na wo o.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔe la, ekema Aƒetɔ ado dziku ɖe mia ŋu, eye magana tsi nadza na mi o. Ana anyigba naƒu, eye nukuwo mawɔ o. Ale miatsrɔ̃ avɔ le afi ma kaba, le anyigba nyui si Aƒetɔ tsɔ na mi la dzi.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: “Eya ta mixɔ nye nyaawo de dzime ne woanɔ miaƒe ememe ke. Mibla wo ɖe alɔnu kple ŋgonu be miate ŋu anɔ ŋku ɖom wo dzi.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Mifia wo mia viwo. Miƒo nu le wo ŋu le miaƒe aƒewo me, alo ne miele mɔ zɔm, alo ne miemlɔ anyi, alo ne miefɔ la.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Ŋlɔ wo ɖe wò xɔ ƒe ʋɔtrutiwo kple wò agbowo ŋu.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ esiawo la, ekema mi kple mia viwo mianɔ agbe didi le anyigba si ŋugbe Aƒetɔ do na mia tɔgbuiwo la dzi. Ale mianɔ afi ma tegbee abe ale si dziƒo le anyigba tame nɔ ge tegbee ene.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Elabe ne miewɔ se siwo katã mede na mi egbe dzi pɛpɛpɛ, mielɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, miewɔ nu siwo katã wògblɔ na mi, eye mieku ɖe eŋu la,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: anyà dukɔ siawo katã ɖa le mia ŋgɔ, eye miaxɔ dukɔ siwo lolo, eye wosesẽ wu mi la ƒe anyigba.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Afi sia afi si miaɖo afɔe la, azu mia tɔ. Miaƒe liƒo atso gbedadaƒo le anyigbeme ayi Lebanon le dzigbeme. Agatso Frat-tɔsisi gbɔ le ɣedzeƒe aɖase ƒu la nu le ɣetoɖoƒe.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ana ŋɔdzi kple vɔvɔ̃ si le mia ŋu la aɖo anyigba si dzi va ge miala la dzi nɔlawo katã, abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na mi ene. Ame aɖeke manɔ te ɖe mia nu o.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: “Mikpɔ ɖa, metsɔ yayra kple fiƒode le mia ŋkume ɖom egbe.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe se siwo mede na mi egbe dzi la, yayra anɔ mia dzi.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Ke ne miewɔ eƒe seawo dzi o, eye miete ɖa le nu si meɖo na mi egbe gbɔ hesubɔ mawu bubu siwo mienya o la, fiƒode anɔ mia dzi.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu kplɔ wò yi anyigba si dzi yim nèle dzi la, ekema tsɔ Gerizim wɔ yayratoe, eye nàtsɔ Ebal wɔ fiƒodetoe.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: To eve siawo le Yordan ƒe go kemɛ dzi le Kanaantɔ siwo le balia me la ƒe anyigba dzi. Wole ɣetoɖoƒe lɔƒo, eye wote ɖe More ƒe ati gãwo ŋu le Gilgal kasa.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Esusɔ vie ko ne miatso Yordan-tɔsisi la, eye miaxɔ anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la le tsɔtsɔm na mi la. Ne miexɔe wòzu mia tɔ miele edzi la,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: ekema milé se kple ɖoɖo siwo katã meɖo mia ŋkume egbe la ɖe tame eye miawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: “Esiawoe nye se kple ɖoɖo siwo ŋu wòle be mialé fɔ ɖo awɔ wo dzi le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la tsɔ na mi be mianɔ edzi la dzi.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ne mienyà dukɔ siwo ƒe anyigba xɔm miele ɖa la, migbã teƒe siwo katã wosubɔa woƒe mawuwo le la. Togbɛwo alo to kɔkɔwo dzi ke woɖale o, ati damawo te woɖale o, mikaka wo keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Migbã woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo, eye mimu woƒe aƒeliwo. Mitɔ dzo woƒe nyɔnumawu Asera ƒe atiwo, migbã, eye mikaka woƒe legbawo ale be womagasubɔ le teƒe mawo gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Migasubɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, abe ale si woawo subɔa woƒe mawuwoe la ene o.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Ne teƒe si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la afia be woanɔ ye subɔm le la didi na mi akpa la, ekema miwu nyi alo alẽ siwo Aƒetɔ na mi la, ƒe ɖe abe ale si megblɔ na mi ene, eye miaɖui le miaƒe du me le afi si mielɔ̃.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Ame si ŋu kɔ kple ame si ŋu mekɔ o la siaa kpɔ mɔ aɖui abe ale si woɖua sẽ kple zi ƒe lã ene.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Mègaɖui o, ekema Aƒetɔ akpɔ ŋudzedze le mia ŋu, eye eme anyo na mi kple miaƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Tsɔ lãa kple ʋua siaa sa numemevɔ le Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Tsɔ vɔsalã la ƒe ʋu kɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi eye tsɔ lã la ɖu.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Lé nya siwo katã megblɔ na wò la me ɖe asi, eye nàwɔ wo dzi be wòanyo na wò kple wò dzidzimeviwo tegbee ne èwɔ nu si nyo eye wòdzɔ le Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ŋkume.” Sedede ɖe trɔ̃subɔsubɔ nu

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: “Ne Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, atsrɔ̃ dukɔ siwo ƒe anyigba dzi yim nèle la le ŋgɔwò, eye nèxɔ woƒe anyigbawo, hetso duwo ɖe wo dzi,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: ne wotsrɔ̃ wo le ŋgɔwò vɔ la, kpɔ nyuie be màgawɔ woƒe mawusubɔsubɔkɔnuwo o. Mègabia woƒe mawuwo ta se be: ‘Ale ke dukɔ siawo subɔa woƒe mawuwoe?’ ale be wò hã nàsubɔ tɔwò nenema o.
