english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mègasubɔ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, abe ale si woawo subɔa woƒe mawu ene o, elabe ŋunyɔnu siwo katã Aƒetɔ lé fui lae, woawo wɔna le woƒe mawusubɔsubɔ me. Wotɔa dzo wo viŋutsu kple vinyɔnuwo gɔ̃ hã na woƒe mawuwo.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: “Miwɔ nu siwo katã megblɔ na mi la dzi pɛpɛpɛ. Migatsɔ ɖeke kpee loo, alo aɖe ɖeke le wo me o.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: ale be yeakplɔ mi atrae ne miasubɔ mawu bubu aɖe si mienya o. Ne dzesi alo nukunu la va eme gɔ̃ hã la,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: migaxɔ gbeƒãɖela ma alo drɔ̃egɔmeɖela ma ƒe nya dzi se o. Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, ɖe wòle mia dom kpɔ be yeakpɔ ɖa be mielɔ̃a ye, miaƒe Mawu la kple miaƒe dzi blibo kpakple luʋɔ blibo mahã.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Minɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, yome, eye mivɔ̃e. Milé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi, eye mise eƒe gbe. Misubɔe, eye miwɔ nuteƒe nɛ.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Emegbe Israel blibo la nasee, vɔvɔ̃ naɖoe ale be ame aɖeke magawɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi ma tɔgbe le mia dome akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: “Ne èle du siwo Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le na wò ge me la, àse be

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: ŋutsu ɖigbɔ aɖewo tso mia dome yi ɖable dua me tɔwo be yewoneyi ɖasubɔ mawu siwo mienya o.

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: Ne èse nya sia la, ku egɔme tsitotsito, eye ne enye nyateƒe be wowɔ ŋunyɔnu sia le mia dome la,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: ekema wu dua me tɔwo katã kple woƒe lãwo siaa kple yi. Gbã dua gbidigbidi.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ busunu siwo wòle be nàtsrɔ̃ la dometɔ aɖeke na ɖokuiwò o, ne Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔmedzoe helihelĩ la nu nafa, eye wòave nu wò. Ekema akpɔ nublanui na wò eye wòana nàdzi asɔ gbɔ fũu, abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na tɔgbuiwòwo ene.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Esia ava eme na wò, ne èse Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ƒe gbe eye nèlé eƒe se siwo katã mede na wò egbe la me ɖe asi, eye nèwɔ nu si wòdi la.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Dukɔ kɔkɔe mienye na Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la. Eya ŋutɔe tia mi tso dukɔwo katã dome le anyigba dzi be mianye ye tɔ.” Lã siwo ŋu kɔ kple esiwo ŋu mekɔ o (Mos III,

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: “Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu xe siwo katã ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: “Mègaɖu naneke si nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mɔ aɖu lãfɔne siwo katã ƒe afɔkli me fe, eye wodzɔa nu ɖuna.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Lãfɔne siwo dzɔa nu ɖuna, gake woƒe afɔkli me mefe o la ŋu mekɔ o, eya ta miekpɔ mɔ aɖu wo o. Woawoe nye: kposɔ, fɔmizi kple xɔfie.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Migaɖu ha o elabe togbɔ be eƒe afɔkli me fe hã la, medzɔa nu ɖuna o, eya ta eŋu mekɔ o. Migaɖu lãfɔne siawo ƒe lã o, eye migaka asi woƒe kukua gɔ̃ hã ŋu o.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: “Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu tɔmelã siwo katã ŋu tsiléti alo tsro le la.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Ke tɔmelã siwo katã ŋu tsiléti alo tsro mele o la, ŋu mekɔ o, eya ta migaɖu wo o.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Nu dzodzoewo katã nye nu makɔmakɔwo eya ta migaɖu wo o.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Ke miekpɔ mɔ aɖu nu siwo katã dzona, eye womenye nu makɔmakɔwo o la ya.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: “Migaɖu lã aɖe si ku le eɖokui si la o. Miate ŋu atsɔe na amedzro siwo le miaƒe du me alo adzrae na du bubuwo me tɔwo. Ke miawo la, Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, tɔ mienye. Dukɔ kɔkɔe mienye nɛ. “Migaɖa gbɔ̃vi le nɔa ƒe notsi me o.” Se siwo ku ɖe nu ƒe akpa ewolia nana ŋuti

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “Ɖe wò agblemenuwo ƒe ewolia ɖe aga ƒè sia ƒè.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Emegbe nàtsɔ wo ayi mawusubɔƒe ɖeka ma si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, atia be woasubɔ ye le la. Nàɖu wò lu, ami, nyiwo kple alẽwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeawo, eye nàno wò wain le afi ma. Wɔ nu siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe akpa ewolia ŋudɔ na ɖokuiwò le afi ma ne nàtsɔ srɔ̃ ale si nàde bubu Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ŋu ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Ke ne teƒe si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, atia be woasubɔ ye le la didi akpa tso wò aƒe gbɔ ale be màte ŋu alɔ nuawo ayii o la,

english_verse: then sell this part and take the money there instead.
translation_verse: ekema dzra wo eye nàtsɔ gaa yi mawusubɔƒe la.

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Tsɔe ƒle nu sia nu si dze ŋuwò: nyi, alẽ, wain alo aha sesẽ. Tsɔe ƒle nu sia nu si dzro wò ko, eye wò kple wò aƒemetɔwo miɖu nu eye mikpɔ dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, ŋkume le afi ma.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Mègagblẽ Levitɔ siwo le wò duwo me la ɖi ƒuƒlu o, elabe domenyinu aɖeke mele wo si o.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: “Le ƒe etɔ̃ sia ƒe etɔ̃ megbe la, ɖe miaƒe agblemenu siwo nèŋe le ƒè etɔ̃lia ma me la ƒe akpa ewolia, eye nàdzra wo ɖo ɖe wò duwo me.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu ma nanye Levitɔwo tɔ, elabe womexɔ domenyinu aɖeke o. Amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosi siwo le wò duwo me la hã nava xɔ nuɖuɖu ma ƒe ɖe aɖu aɖi ƒo, ale be Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, nayra wò le wò asinudɔ siwo katã nèwɔna la me.”

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: “Ne nɔvi Israelvi aɖe da ahe le wò du aɖe me le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na mi la dzi la, mègasẽ dzime, agbe kpekpe ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Ale si miatsɔ fea ake lae nye esi: Ne ame aɖe do ga na nɔvia Israelvi la, ele be wòatsɔ fea akee; mekpɔ mɔ alĩi o elabe Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ na woɖe gbeƒã be wotsɔ fe ke.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Èkpɔ mɔ alĩ fe amedzro ya, gake mègalĩ nu si nèdo na nɔviwò Israelvi la ƒe fee o.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ayra wò abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe ene, ale be nàdo nu na dukɔ geɖewo gake wò ŋutɔ ya màdo nugbana o. Àɖu dukɔ geɖewo dzi, ke woawo makpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dziwò o.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ʋu asiwò me, ne nàdo nu nɛ le ale si hiãe la nu.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nyuie! Ame aɖeke negatsɔe be ƒè adrẽlia gogo, eye wole fe tsɔ ge ake ta, ne ehavi xaxa heva bia be nedo nane na ye la, wòawɔ dɔmevevi le eŋu agbe edodo nɛ o. Ne èwɔ esia, eye wòfa konyi na Aƒetɔ ɖe ŋuwò la, woabu fɔ wò.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ na nu lae faa, megave wò be yenae o. Elabe ne èwɔ esia la, Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ayra wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã kple nu siwo nèwɔ dɔ kpɔ la siaa.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ke ne nu wɔe, eƒe afɔ gblẽ alo eƒe ŋku gbã, alo nu manyatalenu aɖe wɔe la, ekema mègatsɔe sa vɔ na Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la o.

english_verse: If any of you buy Israelites as slaves, you must set them free after six years.
translation_verse: “Ne nɔviwò Israel-ŋutsu alo nyɔnu dzra eɖokui na wò kluvii la, na wòasubɔ wò ƒe ade. Le ƒè adrẽlia me la, ɖe asi le eŋu wòadzo.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Ne èɖe asi le eŋu la, mègana wòayi asi ƒuƒlu o.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ kɔ dɔme nàdo mɔe kple alẽ, bli kple wain siwo Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, yra wò nèkpɔ la.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Ke ne ebe yemadzo le gbɔwò o, elabe elɔ̃ wò kple wò aƒemetɔwo, eye gbɔwò nɔnɔ sɔ nɛ la,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: kplɔe yi wò ʋɔtru ŋu, eye nàtsɔ nuŋɔnui ŋɔ to nɛ ɖe ʋɔtrua ŋu ekema ezu wò kluvi va se ɖe eƒe kugbe. Wɔ nu sia na wò kosiwo hã.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: “Tsɔ wò nyiwo kple alẽwo ƒe ŋgɔgbevi, siwo nye atsu la na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la. Mègana nyitsua nawɔ dɔ na wò o, eye mègako fu le agboa ŋu hã o.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Àte ŋu aɖu lã siawo tɔgbe le wò duwo me faa. Ame si ŋu mekɔ o kple ame siwo ŋu kɔ la siaa kpɔ mɔ aɖui, abe ale si mieɖua sẽ kple zi ene.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Ke miekpɔ mɔ aɖu woƒe ʋu ya o. Kɔe ɖe anyigba abe tsi ene.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Ɖo ŋku nuŋeɣleti Abib dzi, eye nàɖu Paska na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu le ɣe ma ɣi me, elabe nuŋeɣleti mee Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, kplɔ wò dzoe le Egipte le zã me.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɔ nya dzɔdzɔe ko yome, ne nànɔ agbe, anyi anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le na wò ge la ƒe dome.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɖu abolo maʋamaʋã ŋkeke ade. Ŋkeke adrẽlia anye takpegbe kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la. Ame aɖeke negawɔ dɔ aɖeke gbe ma gbe o.” Nuŋeŋkeke Nyui la (Mos II,

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Yi mawusubɔƒe ɖeka si Aƒetɔ atia la, eye nàwu alẽ alo nyi ɖeka hena Paska la ɖuɖu na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Màte ŋu awu Paska lã la le du sia du si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la tsɔ na wò la me o;

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “ke boŋ wui le teƒe si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la atia be ye ŋkɔ nanɔ la ko. Afi ma nàwɔ ŋutitotovɔsa la le. Wɔe le fiẽ me, ne ɣe le to ɖom le ɣe si ɣi nèʋu tso Egipte.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Ɖa nua ɖu le teƒe si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la atia la, eye ne ŋu ke ŋdi la, gbugbɔ yi wò xɔnu.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Mègaɖi aƒeli aɖeke o, elabe Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, lé fui.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: “Ne èɖi vɔsamlekpui na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la la, migatu nyɔnumawu Asera ƒe ati ɖe egbɔ o.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: “Xlẽ kwasiɖa adrẽ tso gbe si gbe wodze nukuwo ŋeŋe gɔme,

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Na wò ŋutɔ, viwò ŋutsu kple viwò nyɔnuwo, wò dɔlaŋutsu kple dɔlanyɔnuwo, Levitɔ si le wò du me, amedzro, tsyɔ̃evi kple ahosi siwo le wò du me la katã, miakpɔ dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ŋkume le teƒe si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la atia la.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ame sia ame netsɔ nunana aɖe ɖe asi va na, le ale si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, yrae la nu. Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu ɖoɖowo

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: “Na wò ŋutsuwo katã nava subɔ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la zi etɔ̃ le ƒe ɖeka me le teƒe si wòatia la. Woneva le Abolo Maʋamaʋã Ŋkeke Nyui ɖuɣi, kwasiɖawo ƒe ŋkekenyui ɖuɣi kple Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui ɖuɣi. Womegava Aƒetɔ ŋkume asi ƒuƒlu o;

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Mègatsɔ nyitsu alo alẽ si nane wɔ afi aɖe na la sa vɔ na Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la o; enye ŋunyɔnu nɛ.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: Ne nya sia ɖi nèse le ame aɖe ŋu la, ka eme tsitotsito. Ne ele me tututu be ewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi sia le Israel la,

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Emegbe mina Israelviwo katã nasee, avɔ̃, ale be dzi magable wo dometɔ aɖeke wòawɔ nu ma tɔgbe azɔ o.” Nufiafia le fiaɖoɖo ŋuti

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: “Ne èva ɖo anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le na wò ge dzi, eye nèxɔe wòzu tɔwò, eye nètso duwo ɖe edzi vɔ la, adzro wò be nàɖo fia na ɖokuiwò abe dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã wò ene.

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: Kpɔ egbɔ be ame si nàɖo la nanye ame si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, tia na wò la. Ele be amea nanye mia detɔ. Mègaɖo du bubu me tɔ, ame si menye nɔviwò la, fia ɖe nuwò o.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Sɔwo megasɔ gbɔ le fia la si o, eye megaɖo amewo ɖe Egipte be woayi ɖaƒle sɔwo vɛ na ye o, le esi Aƒetɔ gblɔ na mi be miekpɔ mɔ agagbugbɔ ava to mɔ sia dzi gbeɖe o la ta.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Fia la negaɖe srɔ̃ geɖe o, elabe srɔ̃ geɖe ɖeɖe ana eƒe dzi aɖe ɖa le Aƒetɔ ŋu. Nenema ke klosalo kple sika geɖe hã meganɔ esi o.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia anɔ esi wòanɔ xexlẽm le eƒe agbenɔɣi katã, ale be wòanya ale si wòavɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, eƒe Mawu la, eye wòate ŋu alé eƒe se kple ɖoɖo siawo katã me ɖe asi ahawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: Esia ana be mado eɖokui ɖe dzi abu be yenyo wu ye nɔvi Israelvi bubuawo, eye wòagbe toɖoɖo Mawu ƒe se la le mɔ aɖeke nu o. Ekema anɔ agbe aƒo wɔ ɖe aɖu ŋu, eye eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo siaa anɔ zi dzi eteƒe adidi le Israel-dukɔ me.”

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Mele gbeƒãɖela aɖe si le abe wò ene la fɔ ge ɖe te tso woawo ŋutɔ nɔviwo dome na wo. Magblɔ nya siwo medi be magblɔ la nɛ wòayi ɖagblɔ na wo.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Eya hã axɔ nuɖuɖu la wòasɔ kple wo tɔ Levitɔwo tɔ. Ne eƒe ƒometɔwo dzra woƒe ƒomenu aɖe eye wotsɔ akpa si nye etɔ la vɛ nɛ hã la, ekpɔ mɔ axɔ nuɖuɖu wòasɔ kple wo tɔ nunɔla Levitɔwo tɔ. Sedede le trɔ̃subɔsubɔ kɔnuwo ŋuti

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: “Levi-to blibo la, si nye nunɔlawo ƒe to la, maxɔ anyigba aɖeke le Israel-dukɔa me o. Le esia ta woanɔ agbe ɖe nu siwo to bubuawo ava nɔ Mawu nam alo atsɔ va nɔ vɔ sam na Mawu la ko ŋu.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Nu siwo woaxɔ tso dukɔ la gbɔ la woe nye esiwo gbɔna: Ne wowu nyi alo alẽ tsɔ sa vɔe la, woatsɔ lã la ƒe abɔ kple glã kpakple dɔgbo na nunɔlawo.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ŋutɔe tia wo le toawo katã dome be woawo kple wo viŋutsuwo siaa nanye yeƒe nunɔlawo, anɔ amewo subɔm le ye ŋkɔ me tegbee.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: “Ne Levitɔ aɖe tso Israel-du aɖe si mele Israel o la me, afi si wònye amedzro le, va, le eya ŋutɔ ƒe didi nu la, ekpɔ mɔ ayi mawusubɔƒe ɖeka ma si Aƒetɔ atia la faa,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: aɖasubɔ Aƒetɔ, abe nunɔla ene, le afi ma, abe nɔvia Levitɔ bubu siwo katã le afi ma la ene.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: “Ne èɖo anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le na wò ge dzi la, mègakpɔ ŋunyɔnu siwo dukɔ ma me tɔwo wɔna la wɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Ame siawo ƒomevi ɖe sia ɖe nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ, eye ŋunyɔnu siawo wɔwɔ tae wòle dukɔ siwo le mia ŋgɔ la nyàm ɖa ɖo.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mokaka aɖeke meganɔ mia ŋu le Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la gbɔ o. Aƒetɔ do ŋugbe be yeaɖo yeƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖe ɖa

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: “Elabe dukɔ siwo ƒe anyigba xɔ ge nèle la me tɔwo xɔ bokɔnɔwo kple afakalawo dzi se ŋutɔ; ke wò la, Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu meɖe mɔ be nàwɔ nenema o.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le eƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖe abe nye ene fɔ ge ɖe te tso miawo ŋutɔ dome. Miɖo toe.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe miekpe ta le Xoreb gbɔ la, mieɖe kuku be yewomedi be yewoagase Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ƒe gbe loo, alo akpɔ dzobibi gã la o, ne menye nenem o la, yewoava ku.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be, ‘Wogblɔe ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Aƒo nu le nye ŋkɔ me, eye ame si maɖo to eƒe nyawo o la, mahe to nɛ.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne gbeƒãɖela aɖe do eɖokui ɖe dzi eye wògblɔ nya si nyemegblɔ nɛ o le nye ŋkɔ me la, woawui. Nenema ke ne gbeƒãɖela aɖe gblɔ nya aɖe le mawu bubu aɖe ƒe ŋkɔ me la, woawu eya hã.’

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ àbia le ɖokuiwò me be, ‘Ale ke mawɔ anya be nya sia la, menye Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe o?’

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne gbeƒãɖela aɖe gblɔ nya le Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ me, gake nya la meva eme o alo nye nyateƒe o la, ekema menye Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe o; gbeƒãɖela ma ŋutɔe kpa nya la gblɔ eya ta migavɔ̃ na eyama o.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: ekema tia du etɔ̃ bubuwo kpe ɖe gbãtɔ etɔ̃awo ŋu. Aƒetɔ atsɔ anyigba sia na wò ne èlé se si mede na wò egbe la me ɖe asi eye nèlɔ̃e hele zɔzɔm ɖe eƒe ɖoɖowo nu tegbee.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: “Ne Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, tsrɔ̃ dukɔ siwo ƒe anyigba tsɔm wòle na mi eye mienyà wo ɖa vɔ hele woƒe duwo kple aƒewo me la,

english_verse: you must choose three of your towns to be Safe Towns. Divide the land into three regions with one Safe Town near the middle of each, so that a Safe Town can be easily reached from anywhere in your land. Then, if one of you accidentally kills someone, you can run to a Safe Town and find protection from being put to death. But you must not have been angry with the person you killed.
translation_verse: “Ɖoɖo si le ame si meɖo ame wu o la ƒe sísi yi afi ma be wòate ŋu atsi agbe ŋu lae nye esi: Ne ame aɖe wu ehavi, evɔ meɖoe wu o, eye womelé fu wo nɔewo hã tsã o,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: le kpɔɖeŋu me, ame aɖe kple ehavi yi nake fɔ ge le ave me kple fía. Ehavia le nakea lãm kasia ko fíaa tu le atia me dze amea wòku. Ne edzɔ alea la, ekema amewula la ate ŋu así yi du siawo dometɔ ɖeka me eye wòatsi agbe.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenem o la, egbɔ adidi akpa na ame si wu ame. Ale be ne ame si dze abia hlɔ̃ do dɔmedzoe vevie ti eyome la, atui le mɔ ta ahawui. Evɔ la, medze be wòawui hafi o, elabe amewula la melé fu ame si wòwu la tsã o.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Esia tae mele se dem na wò be nàtia du etɔ̃ ɖo.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Miwɔ esia ne womagakɔ ame maɖifɔ ƒe ʋu ɖe wò anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na wò la dzi, eye woabu fɔ wò be nèdo hlɔ̃ o.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe lé fu ehavi, eye wòɖo nugbe ɖe eŋu, de xa ɖi nɛ heƒo kuƒe nɛ wòku, emegbe wòsí yi du siawo dometɔ ɖeka me la,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: ele be amewula la ƒe dumegãwo nadɔ ame ɖa woayi ɖakplɔ amewula la tso du si me wòsí yi la me vɛ, eye woatsɔe ade asi na hlɔ̃biala ne wòabia hlɔ̃e.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Migakpɔ nublanui nɛ kura o. Miɖe amewula sia ƒomevi ɖa atsɔ tútu ame maɖifɔ ƒe ʋu le Israelviwo dome bene nu nanyo na mi.” Blemaliƒowo

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Le domenyinu si asu asiwò le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, tsɔ na wò be wòanye tɔwò dzi la, mègatrɔ hawòvi ƒe liƒo si tɔgbuiwo do ɖa ɖi tso blema ke la o.” Ɖasefowo ŋu nya

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: “Ɖasefo ɖeka megaɖi ɖase le ame aɖe ŋu ko woaxɔ eƒe nya atsɔ bu fɔ amea o. Ele be ɖasefoawo nade eve alo etɔ̃ teti hafi woaxɔ nya la atsɔ wɔ dɔe.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ka aʋatso ɖe ame aɖe si be ewɔ nu gbegblẽ aɖe la,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: Mègakpɔ nublanui na ame aɖeke le nya siawo tɔgbe me o. Tohehea nenye agbe ɖe agbe teƒe, ŋku ɖe ŋku teƒe, aɖu ɖe aɖu teƒe, asi ɖe asi teƒe, eye afɔ ɖe afɔ teƒe.”

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: “Ne èho aʋa ɖe wò futɔwo ŋu, eye nèkpɔ be woƒe sɔwo, tasiaɖamwo kple aʋakɔwo sɔ gbɔ wu tɔwòwo la, mègavɔ̃ o. Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu si kplɔ wò tso Egipte la li kpli wò.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Hafi miakpe aʋa kple futɔwo la, nunɔla aɖe nedo yi aʋakɔ la ŋgɔ eye wòagblɔ na wo be,

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: ‘Israel, see! Egbe la, miele hoho ge ayi aʋa. Migavɔ̃ miaƒe futɔwo o; dzi megaɖe le mia ƒo o; dzidzi megaƒo mi o eye futɔawo megadzi ŋɔ na mi o,

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, ayi kpli mi. Awɔ aʋa kple miaƒe futɔwo eye wòaɖu wo dzi na mi.’

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Ekema aʋakplɔlawo agblɔ na aʋakɔ la be, ‘Ɖe ame aɖe le mia dome si tu xɔ yeye eye mekɔ eŋu, ʋu yi eme haɖe oa? Ne ame aɖe li la, negbugbɔ yi aƒe. Ne menye nenem o la, ne etsi aʋa la, ame bubu akɔ xɔa ŋu, aʋu yi eme.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ɖe ame aɖe le mia dome si de waingble, eye meɖu eme nu aɖeke haɖe oa? Ne ɖe li la, negbugbɔ yi aƒe. Ne menye nenem o la, ne etsi aʋa la, ame bubu koe laɖu agblea me nu.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ɖe ame aɖe le mia dome si bia nyɔnu ta, eye mekpɔ ɖee haɖe oa? Ne ame aɖe li la, negbugbɔ yi aƒe. Ne menye nenem o, ne etsi aʋa la, ame bubu koe laxɔ nyɔnua aɖe.’

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: Aʋakplɔlaawo agayi dzi be: ‘Ɖe ame aɖe le mia dome si le vɔvɔ̃ma? Ne ame aɖe li la, negbugbɔ yi aƒe, ne menye nenem o, ava de vɔvɔ̃ lã me na wo tɔwo.’

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Ne aʋakplɔlaawo ƒo nu kple aʋakɔ la vɔ la, ekema woaɖo aʋafiawo aʋakɔ la nu.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Ke le du siwo le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la le tsɔtsɔm na wò dzi la, miwu ame sia ame le wo me.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Mitsrɔ̃ Xititɔwo, Amoritɔwo, Kanaantɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Xivitɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo keŋkeŋ abe ale si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la gblɔ na wò be nàwɔ ene.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Miwu wo keŋ ale be womaganɔ anyi afia ŋunyɔnu siwo wowɔna na woƒe mawuwo la wɔwɔ mi ne miawɔ vɔ̃ ɖe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ŋu o.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: “Ne èle aʋa wɔm kple du aɖe be yeaxɔe, eye nèle aʋaa dzi eteƒe didi la, mègatsɔ fía mu kutsetseti siwo le dua me o. Èkpɔ mɔ agbe atiawo ƒe tsetse faa; ke mègalã atiawo ŋutɔ ƒu anyi o. Agblemeti menye ame aho aʋa ɖe ame ŋu o.

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Ke àte ŋu agblẽ ati siwo ƒe tsetse womeɖuna o la. Miate ŋu alã wo atsɔ ƒu kpo ɖe dua ŋu va se ɖe esime nàɖu dzi, axɔ dua.”

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: “Ne wofɔ ame kuku aɖe le gbe me le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na wò dzi, eye womenya ame si wui o la,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: ele be wò ame tsitsiwo kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo nayi ɖadzidze teƒe si ame kuku la le kple du siwo ƒo xlãe la dome.

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: Du si tsɔ ɖe ame kukua gbɔ wu la me ame tsitsiwo nana nyinɔvi ɖeka si mewɔ dɔ kpɔ o la.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: Du si tsɔ ɖe ame kukua gbɔ wu la ƒe ame tsitsiawo katã aklɔ asi ɖe nyinɔvi si nu woŋe kɔ le la dzi

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: agblɔ be: ‘Menye míawoe wu ame sia o, eye míenya ame si wui hã o.

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: “Ne èkpe aʋa kple wò futɔwo, eye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, na nèɖu wo dzi heɖe aboyo wo dometɔ aɖewo,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: aɖe awu si wòdo hafi wolée la ɖi, ado bubu. Eyome netsi aƒewò me, eye wòafa tɔ́a kple nɔa ɣleti ɖeka sɔŋ. Le esia megbe la, èkpɔ mɔ aɖee miazu srɔ̃tɔwo.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ke ne nyɔnua ƒe nu megava nyo ŋuwò o la, àte ŋu aɖe asi le eŋu wòadzo ayi afi si wòlɔ̃. Esi nèzi edzi dɔ kplii ta la, mègakpɔ mɔ adzrae alo atsɔe wɔ wò kosii o. Ŋgɔgbeviŋutsu ƒe domenyinyi ŋu ɖoɖowo

english_verse: Suppose a man has two wives and loves one more than the other. The first son of either wife is the man's first-born son, even if the boy's mother is the wife the man doesn't love. Later, when the man is near death and is dividing up his property, he must give a double share to his first-born son, simply because he was the first to be born. A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Esi srɔ̃a si melɔ̃na o la ƒe viŋutsue nye ŋgɔgbetɔ ta la, ele be wòama nuawo ale gbegbe be akpa si atu nyɔnu si melɔ̃na o ƒe ŋgɔgbevi nasɔ gbɔ wu nyɔnu si wòlɔ̃na la ƒe ŋgɔgbevi tɔ zigbɔzi eve. Eƒe alimevi gbãtɔe nye ŋutsuvi sia, eye etɔe nye domenyinu la le se nu. Viŋutsu dzeaglãwo ŋu ɖoɖo

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: “Ne viŋutsu dzeaglã, sẽto aɖe le ame aɖe si, si meɖoa to tɔ́a kple nɔa ƒe gbe o, wohe to nɛ ʋuu wòglo; egbe nusese.

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: Ne eva eme alea la, dzilaawo nelée yi dumemetsitsiwo gbɔ, eye woakplɔe yi dutakpeƒe.

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: Woagblɔ na ame tsitsiawo be: ‘Mía vi sia zu aglãdzela kple tosẽla; mesea míaƒe gbe o. Nu tsu ɖuɖu kple ahamumu koe nye eƒe dɔ.’

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne wogblɔ nya sia vɔ la, dua me ŋutsuwo katã naƒu kpee wòaku, ale be nàɖe vɔ̃ la ɖa le dowòme. Israel katã nase nya sia eye vɔvɔ̃ naɖo wo.” Se bubu vovovowo

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖe si dze ku eye wowui, de ka ve nɛ tsi ɖe ati ŋu la,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: mègagblẽ ame kukua ɖi ŋu nake o. Ɖii gbe ma gbe ke, elabe Mawu ƒo fi de ame si wode ka ve na heku ati. Mègagblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na wò be nànyi eƒe dome la o.”

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: “Ne nɔviwò Israelvi aɖe ƒe nyi alo alẽ tra mɔ nèkpɔ la, mègato eŋu yi o; kplɔe yi nɛ.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Ne nɔviwòa mele kpuiƒe o alo mènya eyama o la, ekema kplɔ alẽa yi aƒewò me. Nà wòanɔ gbɔwò va se ɖe esime nutɔa nava bia eta eye nàɖe asi le eŋu nɛ.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Wɔ alea ne èfɔ eƒe tedzi, eƒe avɔ alo nu bubu ɖe sia ɖe. Mègato nua ŋu yi o.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys that carry heavy loads can stumble and fall, and be unable to get up by themselves. So as you walk along the road, help anyone who is trying to get an ox or donkey back on its feet. Don't Pretend To Be the Opposite Sex Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne nɔviwò Israelvi aɖe ƒe tedzi alo nyi dze anyi ɖe mɔ dzi nèkpɔ la, mègato eŋu yi o; ke boŋ kpe ɖe nɔviwòa ŋu ne miafɔ lãa ɖe tsitre.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Nyɔnu aɖeke megado ŋutsuwu o, eye ŋutsu aɖeke hã megado nyɔnuwu o, elabe nu sia wɔlawo nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ne ètu xɔ yeye la, tɔ kpɔ ɖe xɔa tame ŋu, ale be ame aɖeke nagava ge tso afi ma ne wò kple wò aƒe miaxe hlɔ̃fe o.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: “Mègaƒã nuku bubu aɖeke ɖe wò waingble me kpe ɖe wò wain la ŋu o. Ne èwɔe la, agble bliboa, nuku si nèƒã kple waintsetseawo siaa, azu kɔkɔeƒe la tɔ.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Mègabla nyitsu kple tedzi ɖe agbleŋlɔmɔ̀ ɖeka ŋu ne woaŋlɔ agble na wò o.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Mègata avɔ si wotsɔ lãfu kple ɖeti tsyaka lɔ̃ la o.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “De gbo avɔ si nètsyɔna la ƒe dzogoe eneawo ŋu.” Se siwo ku ɖe ŋutsu kple nyɔnu ƒe anyinɔnɔ dzadzɛ ŋu

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: “Ame aɖe aɖe srɔ̃, emegbe magadi be yeaɖee o,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: eye wòade asi ŋukpenanyawo gbɔgblɔ me ɖe nyɔnua ŋu anɔ eŋkɔ gblẽm be yemekpɔe le aƒe o.

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: Ne esia dzɔ la, nyɔnuvia dzilawo netsɔ abadzivɔ si fia be wokpɔ nyɔnuvia le aƒe la yi dumegãwo gbɔ le ʋɔnu.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Nyɔnuvia tɔ́a nagblɔ na ame tsitsiawo be: ‘Metsɔ vinye nyɔnuvi sia na ŋutsu sia wòɖe, ke fifia la, ebe yemegale edim o.

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: Egblɔ ŋukpenanyawo ɖe eŋu be yemekpɔe le aƒe o. Evɔ vinyea ƒe abadzivɔ si fia be ekpɔe le aƒe lae nye esi.’ Akeke abadzivɔ la me ne ame tsitsiawo woakpɔ.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Ekema dumegãawo nalé ŋutsua, aƒoe.

english_verse: because he accused his bride of not being a virgin. He will have to pay her father
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, woana wòaxe klosaloga alafa ɖeka na nyɔnuvia tɔ́a elabe egblẽ Israel-ɖetugbi ƒe ŋkɔ. Ke ɖetugbia ganye srɔ̃a kokoko, eye mekpɔ mɔ aɖe asi le eŋu le eƒe agbenɔɣi o.

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Evɔ ne enye nyateƒe be womekpɔ nyɔnuvia le aƒe o la,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: ekema wonekplɔ nyɔnuvia yi tɔ́a ƒe xɔ nu, eye dua me ŋutsuwo neƒu kpee wòaku, elabe ewɔ ŋukpenanu le Israel: ede ŋutsu gbɔ, esime wònɔ tɔ́a ƒeme, hafi ɖe srɔ̃. Ale nàɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi la ɖa le dowòme.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: “Ne wolé ŋutsu aɖe wòle asi dem nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ aɖe ŋu la, ele be woawu ŋutsua kple nyɔnua siaa. Ale nàɖe vɔ̃ la ɖa le Israel.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: mikplɔ wo kple eve la yi dua godo ne miaƒu kpe wo, woaku. Woawu nyɔnuvia elabe du mee ŋutsua lée le gake medo ɣli ne woaxɔ nɛ o. Woawu ŋutsu la, elabe egblẽ nɔvia srɔ̃. Ale nàɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi la ɖa le dowòme.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: “Ke nenye gbe mee ŋutsu aɖe lé nyɔnuvi aɖe si ta wobia la le sesẽe de asi eŋu la, ekema woawu ŋutsua ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Migawɔ naneke nyɔnuvia o, elabe mewɔ vɔ̃ si dze ku o. Nya sia sɔ kple ale si ame adze nɔvia dzi awui la ƒe nya.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Gbe mee ŋutsua lé nyɔnuvia le sesẽe hede asi eŋu, eye togbɔ be edo ɣli hã la, ame aɖeke meli axɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu aɖe alé nyɔnuvi aɖe si ta womebia o la sesẽe ade asi eŋu, eye woalé wo la,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: “Ame aɖeke megade asi tɔ́a srɔ̃ ŋu alo aklo avɔ le tɔ́a srɔ̃ ŋu o.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: “Ame si wota alo ame si wolã aʋa na la mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe ha la me o.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ahasivi aɖeke mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe ha la me o, eye kekeke eƒe dzidzimevi ewolia ke hã mekpɔ mɔ anɔ eme gbeɖe o.”

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: “Amontɔ kple Moabtɔ aɖeke mekpɔ mɔ anɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe ha la me o, eye kekeke woƒe dzidzimevi ewolia ke gɔ̃ hã mekpɔ mɔ anɔ eme gbeɖe o.

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Elabe esime mieʋu tso Egipte gbɔna la, wogbe nuɖuɖu kple tsi nana mi le mɔ dzi. Gawu la, woda Bileam, Beor vi, tso Petor le Mesopotamia ɖe mia ŋu be wòaƒo fi ade mi.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, meɖo to Bileam o, eye wòna fiƒode si ava mia dzi hafi la trɔ zu yayra boŋ elabe elɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Zi ale si mienye nye dukɔ la, migakpe ɖe wo ŋu loo, alo adi woƒe nyui gbeɖe o.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: “Miganyɔ ŋu Edomtɔ aɖeke o, elabe mia nɔviwo Edomtɔwo nye. Nenema ke miganyɔ ŋu Egiptetɔ aɖeke hã o, elabe mienɔ wo de kpɔ.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Woƒe dzidzime etɔ̃lia kple dzidzime siwo kplɔ woawo ɖo la kpɔ mɔ anɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe ha la me.” Dzadzɛnɔnɔ le asaɖa la me

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: “Ne èho aʋa ɖe wò futɔwo ŋu, eye nèƒu asaɖa anyi le aʋagbedzi la, kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi be nàgawɔ naneke si ana nazu ame makɔmakɔ o.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu aɖe ku drɔ̃e nyè tsi le zã me la, eŋu mekɔ o eya ta nedo yi asaɖa la godo ɖanɔ afi ma.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Le ɣetrɔ me la, nele tsi. Ne ɣe ɖo to la, ekpɔ mɔ ava asaɖa la me azɔ.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: “Miɖo afɔdzideƒe ɖe asaɖa la godo, afi si miayi afɔdzi le.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Mikpa ati gbabɛ kpe ɖe miaƒe aʋawɔnuwo ŋu, ale be ne miele afɔdzi de ge la, miatsɔe aɖe doe, eye ne miewɔ vɔ la, miagatsɔe ku ke kɔ ɖe afɔdzia dzi.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Mina miaƒe asaɖa gbɔ nanɔ dzadzɛ elabe Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le afi ma le gbɔwò be yeakpɔ tawò, eye yeana nàɖu wò futɔwo dzi. Eya ta mègawɔ ŋunyɔnu aɖeke ɖi ne wòakpɔ, eye wòatrɔ adzo le gbɔwò o.” Se vovovowo

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: “Ne kluvi aɖe sí le eƒe aƒetɔ gbɔ va si wò tso la, mègagbugbɔe yi na eƒe aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Ke boŋ nà wòatsi gbɔwò, anɔ wò du si dze eŋu la me, eye mègawɔ ŋlɔmee le eŋu o.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: “Migana Israel-nyɔnu aɖeke nanye gbolo le trɔ̃ƒe alo ŋutsu aɖeke hã nanye ahasiwɔla anɔ mawusubɔƒe o.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Nyɔnu alo ŋutsu aɖeke megatsɔ ahasiwɔga va xe eƒe adzɔgbeɖefe le Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ƒeme o. Nu eve siawo wɔlawo nye ŋunyɔ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: “Ne èdo ga, nuɖuɖu alo nu bubu aɖe si dzi woxɔa deme ɖo la na nɔviwò Israelvi la, wò ya mègaxɔ deme ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Àte ŋu axɔ deme le du bubu me tɔwo ya si, ke mègaxɔe le nɔviwò Israelvi si o. Ne èwɔ se sia dzi la, Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ayra ɖe nu siwo katã nèwɔ dɔ kpɔ la dzi, le anyigba si dzi yim nèle be nàxɔe wòazu tɔwò la dzi.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: “Ne èɖe adzɔgbe na Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la la, mègahe edziwɔwɔ ɖe megbe o, elabe abiae tso asiwò me kokoko. Ne mèwɔ edzi o la, èwɔ nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: evɔ ne ènya ke nu ɖe adzɔgbe le ɖokuiwò si na Aƒetɔ ya ko la, kpɔ gbɔ nàwɔ edzi godoo.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: “Ne èzɔ to hawòvi ƒe waingble me yina la, èkpɔ mɔ aɖu tsetseawo ale si nu dzro wò va se ɖe esime nèɖi ƒo, ke mègatsɔ ɖeke ɖe naneke me dzoe o.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Ne èzɔ to hawòvi ƒe mɔligble me yina la, àte ŋu atsɔ asi aƒlɔ mɔlikuawoe, ɖeko mègatsɔ nuŋehɛ si mɔli lae o.”

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu aɖe ɖe srɔ̃, emegbe nyɔnua ƒe nu meganyo eŋu o, eye wòdi be yeagbee le ŋukpenanu aɖe si nyɔnua wɔ ta la, neŋlɔ srɔ̃gbegbalẽ de nyɔnua si, eye wòanyàe ɖa le eƒeme.

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: Ne nyɔnua dzo yi ɖaɖe ŋutsu bubu,

english_verse: who then either divorced her in the same way or died.
translation_verse: eye ŋutsu sia hã gbee, ŋlɔ srɔ̃gbegbalẽ de esi henyàe dzo le eƒeme alo ku la,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ŋutsu gbãtɔ si nyàe la mekpɔ mɔ agaɖee o, elabe edo ŋunyɔe va yi. Ne ŋutsua gaɖee la, ekema ewɔ ŋunyɔnu le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Migawɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi sia ƒomevi le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na mi be wòanye domenyinu na mi la dzi o.” Se vovovowo

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe ɖe srɔ̃ teti la, megayi aʋa o, eye womegade dɔ aɖeke asi nɛ o. Mina wòanɔ aƒeme, anɔ eɖokui si ƒe ɖeka ne wòakpɔ dzidzɔ kple srɔ̃a.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ne èdo nu na ame aɖe la, mègaxɔ eƒe té kple tévi ɖe awɔba me o. Ne èxɔ wo la, ƒomea makpɔ naneke atu wɔ aɖa nu, aɖu anɔ agbe o.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ne wolé ame aɖe si fi nɔvia Israelvi aɖe, tsɔ wɔ eƒe kluvi alo dzrae la, ele be woawu fiafi la. Wɔ esia ne nàɖe vɔ̃ sia ɖa le wò dowòme.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku nu si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, wɔ Miryam le mɔ dzi esime mieʋu tso Egipte gbɔna la dzi.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: “Ne èdo nugbana na hawòvi la, mègatii yi eƒeme be yeaxɔ eƒe avɔ ɖe nua nu ale be avɔa nanɔ awɔba o.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ nɔ xexe ne nugbanadolaa ŋutɔ natsɔ avɔa va ɖo awɔba.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Ne nugbanadola la nye ame dahe la, mègana avɔa natsi gbɔwò ŋu nake o.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ne ɣe ɖo to la, gbugbɔe yi nɛ be wòate ŋu awɔ eŋudɔ le zã me. Ne èwɔ esia la, ada akpe na wò, eye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, abu wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: “Mègagbe fexexe na ame dahe alo hiãtɔ o. Nɔviwò wòɖanye o, amedzroe amea nye le wò du aɖe me le wò anyigba dzi o, eƒe fe megatsi ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ne ewɔ dɔ na wò la, xe fe nɛ gbe ma gbe ke; ɣe megaɖo to ɖe fea o, elabe eya ŋue wòle ŋu ɖom ɖo. Ne mèxe fea nɛ o la, ado ɣli ayɔ Aƒetɔ le tawò eye àzu fɔɖila.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Womawu vi tɔ́ ɖe nuvɔ̃ si via wɔ la ta o, eye womawu vi hã ɖe nuvɔ̃ si tɔ́a wɔ la ta o; ke boŋ woawu ame ɖe nuvɔ̃ si amea ŋutɔ wɔ la ta.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: “Mègate amedzro alo tsyɔ̃evi ƒe nya dzɔdzɔe ɖe to o; mègazi ahosi dzi ne wòatsɔ eƒe avɔ de awɔba na wò o.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi be wò hã ènye kluvi kpɔ le Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la xɔ wò ɖe agbe tso afi ma eye nèvo. Esia tae mele se sia dem na wò be nàwɔ alea ɖo.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Ne èŋe nu le wò agble me, eye nèŋlɔ ɖe be ɖi la, migagbugbɔ yi be yeaɖatsɔe o. Eya nezu amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo tɔ. Wɔ esia ale be Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, nayra wò le wò asinudɔwo katã me.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Ne miegbe kutsetsewo le miaƒe amiti dzi la, migatrɔ yi ɖatsa ŋku be yewoagbe ɖe sia ɖe si susɔ ɖe atia me o. Esiwo susɔ la nezu amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo tɔ.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Ne èxa nu le wò waingble me la, mègagbugbɔ yi ɖatsa eme afɔ esiwo susɔ ɖi la keŋkeŋ o. Esiwo susɔ la zu amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kpe ahosiwo tɔ.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi tegbee be ye hã yenye kluvi nɔ Egipte-nyigba dzi kpɔ. Esia tae mele se sia dem na wò be nàwɔ alea ɖo.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Ne fɔɖila la dze ƒoƒo la, ekema ʋɔnudrɔ̃la la nana wòatsyɔ akɔ anyi, eye wòana woaƒoe. Zi ale si woaƒoe la ku ɖe vodada si wòwɔ la ŋu, eye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la la nanɔ afi ma akpɔ eteƒe.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Woate ŋu aƒoe zi bla ene, gake masɔ gbɔ wu nenema o. Ne esɔ gbɔ wu nenema la, ekema woɖi gbɔ nɔviwò la le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Mègabla nu na nyitsu si le mɔli dugum la o.” Nu si dze be nɔviŋutsu nawɔ na nɔvia ŋutsu si ku

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Woabu ŋutsuvi gbãtɔ si nyɔnua dzi la abe ameyinugbea ƒe vi ene, ne wòalé nɔvia kuku la ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe te ale be eƒe dzidzime nagatsrɔ̃ le Israel o.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Ke ne ŋutsu la medi be yeaɖe nɔvia srɔ̃ la o la, ekema nyɔnua ayi dumemetsitsiwo gbɔ le dutakpeƒe eye wòagblɔ na wo be, ‘Srɔ̃nye nɔvi medi be yeana ye nɔvi ƒe ŋkɔ natsi Israel o; egbe be yemaɖem o.’

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Emegbe dumemetsitsiawo ayɔ ŋutsua vɛ, eye woaƒo nu kplii. Ne egbe godoo be yemaɖe nyɔnua o la,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: ekema nɔvia srɔ̃ la ate ɖe eŋu le dumemetsitsiawo ŋkume, aɖe afɔkpa le afɔ nɛ, aɖe ta ɖe mo nɛ, agblɔ be, ‘Ale wowɔa ŋutsu si medi be yeana ye nɔviŋutsu ƒe dzidzime nanɔ anyi o lae nye esi.’

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Woatsɔ ŋkɔ na ŋutsu sia ƒe ƒome le Israel be, ‘Ŋutsu si woɖe - afɔkpa - le - afɔ - na la ƒe ƒome.’ Se bubuwo

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu eve le avu wɔm, eye wo dometɔ ɖeka srɔ̃ va be yeaxɔ na srɔ̃a, eye nyɔnua lé ŋutsu kemɛa ƒe ŋutsu la,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: migakpɔ nublanui na nyɔnua kura o; milã eƒe asi ɖa le eŋu.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Nudanu nyuitɔ kple esi dze la ko nenɔ asiwò; eye nudzidzenu nyuitɔ kple esi dze la ko nenɔ asiwò, ale nànɔ agbe didi le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, tsɔ na wò la dzi.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Wɔ alea elabe Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, lé fu ame sia ame si baa ehavi.” Aƒetɔ ɖe gbe be woawu Amalekitɔwo

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: “Ɖo ŋku nu si Amalekitɔwo wɔ wò esime mieʋu tso Egipte gbɔna la dzi.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Womesi Mawu ɖa kura o. Esi wova tu wò le mɔ dzi, ɖeɖi te ŋuwò eye nègbɔdzɔ la, wotsrɔ̃ ame kudɔe siwo ŋu nu te, eye wotsi megbe la keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Eya ta ne èɖo anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na wò dzi, be nàxɔ anyi edome, eye èvo tso wò futɔ siwo katã ƒo xlã wò la si me la, kpɔ gbɔ be yetsrɔ̃ Amalekitɔwo katã ɖa. Tsrɔ̃ wo keŋkeŋ ale be ame aɖeke nagaɖo ŋku wo dzi le xexeme ƒe afi aɖeke o. Mègaŋlɔ nya sia be o.”

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: “Ne èɖo anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na wò dzi, èxɔe wòzu tɔwò eye ètso duwo ɖe edzi la,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: tsɔ wò agblemenu ɖe sia ɖe si nèŋe gbã le anyigba la dzi la de kusi me, eye nàtsɔe yi mawusubɔƒe ɖeka ma si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, tia la.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Tsɔe yi nunɔla si li ɣe ma ɣi la gbɔ, eye nàgblɔ nɛ be: ‘Mele eme ʋum na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, egbea be meva ɖo anyigba si ŋugbe wòdo na mía tɔgbuiwo be yeatsɔ na mí la dzi.’

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa axɔ kusi la le asiwò atsɔ ɖo Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ le Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ŋkume be: ‘Tɔgbuitɔgbui si ƒe dzidzimevi menye la nye Aramtɔ tsatsala aɖe. Eʋu kple viawo yi Egipte eye wònye amedzro nɔ afi ma. Womesɔ gbɔ hafi yi o, ke wodzi ɖe dzi fũu, eye wova zu dukɔ triakɔ sesẽ aɖe.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Egiptetɔwo sẽ tame le mía ŋu, te mí ɖe anyi, eye wona míewɔ dɔ sesẽ abe kluviwo ene.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Tete míedo ɣli yɔ Aƒetɔ, mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la. Ese míaƒe ɣlidodoa, eye wòkpɔ míaƒe hiã, dagbadagba kple fukpekpewo.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wɔ nukunu kple dzesiwo, eye wòna ŋɔdzinuwo dzɔ. Etsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ wɔnuku la kplɔ mí tso Egipte.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ mí va afii eye wòtsɔ anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo la na mí.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Azɔ, Aƒetɔ, kpɔ ɖa, agblemenu siwo nènam meŋe la ƒe gbãtɔe nye esi metsɔ vɛ na wò.’ Ekema tsɔ kusi la ɖo Aƒetɔ ŋkume eye nàde ta agu, asubɔe.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Azɔ na wò kple aƒewò me tɔwo katã, Levitɔ kple amedzro siwo le gbɔwò la hã miakpɔ dzidzɔ le nu nyui siwo katã Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu na wò la ŋuti.”

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Le ƒè etɔ̃lia sia ƒe etɔ̃lia ƒe nuwuwu la, tsɔ wò agblemenuwo ƒe akpa ewolia na Levitɔwo, amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo ale be ame sia ame nakpɔ nu aɖu, aɖi ƒo le duawo katã me. Ne èwɔ esia vɔ la,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: gblɔ na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, be: ‘Meɖe nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia si nye nu kɔkɔe le aƒenye me la katã ɖa, eye metsɔe na Levitɔwo, amedzrowo, tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo abe ale si nègblɔ nam be mawɔe ene la pɛpɛpɛ. Se siwo nède nam le nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia ŋu la, nyemeda ɖeke dzi o, nyemeŋlɔ ɖeke be hã o.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Esime mele fu nyim la, nyemeɖu ɖeke o. Nyemetsɔ ɖeke hã esime ŋunye mekɔ le kɔnua nu o. Nenema ke nyemetsɔ ɖeke na abe ame kuku ŋu nunana ene o. Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, mese wò gbe, eye mewɔ nu sia nu si nègblɔ nam be mawɔ le nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia gome la.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kpɔ nu tso wò nɔƒe kɔkɔe la le dziƒo, eye nàyra wò dukɔ Israel kple anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo si nètsɔ na mí abe ale si nèka atam na mía tɔgbuiwo ene la.’ ” Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ ƒe dukɔ

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: “Egbe la, Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le se dem na wò be nàwɔ yeƒe se kple ɖoɖo siawo dzi. Eya ta lé wo me ɖe asi, eye nàwɔ wo dzi tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Egbe la, èke nu gblɔ kple kakaɖedzi na Aƒetɔ be eya koe nye yeƒe Mawu. Èdo ŋugbe be yeawɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, alé eƒe ɖoɖo, se kple kɔnuwo me ɖe asi, aɖo to eƒe gbe.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Egbe la, Aƒetɔ ka ɖe dzi na wò be èzu ye ŋutɔ yeƒe dukɔ abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na wò ene, eye wòle gbɔgblɔm na wò be nalé yeƒe sededewo katã me ɖe asi.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ana nàde ŋgɔ wu dukɔ siwo katã wòwɔ, eye nàtsɔ kafukafu, dodoɖedzi kple bubu na eŋkɔ. Ànye dukɔ kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, abe ale si wòdo ŋugbee ene.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Tete Mose kple Israel-me tsitsiwo gblɔ na dukɔ la be: “Lé se siwo katã mede na wò egbe la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Tsɔ kpe ɖi vɔsamlekpui na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ɖe afi ma. Gatsɔ ga yibɔ dɔwɔnu aɖeke ka kpeawo ƒe ɖeke ŋu o.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Tsɔ kpe blibowo sɔŋ, kpe siwo womeka afi aɖeke na o la ɖi vɔsamlekpuia, eye nàwɔ numemevɔsawo le edzi na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Sa ŋutifafavɔ eye nàɖu nu, akpɔ dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ŋkume le afi ma.

english_verse: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read. Curses on Those Who Disobey
translation_verse: Ŋlɔ Mawu ƒe seawo ƒe nya sia nya ɖe kpe siwo nèsi akalo na la dzi. Na nuŋɔŋlɔa me nakɔ nyuie.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Eyome Mose kple nunɔla Levitɔawo gblɔ na Israel-dukɔ blibo la be: “Israel-dukɔ, ɖo to nàsee ɖa! Egbe la, ètrɔ zu Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ƒe dukɔ,

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: eya ta ɖo to eƒe gbe, eye nàwɔ eƒe se kple ɖoɖo siwo gblɔm mele na wò egbe sia la dzi.” Fiƒode siwo anɔ tomaɖola dzi

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na dukɔa gbe ma gbe ke be:

english_verse: Today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. Always obey them, and the Lord will make Israel the most famous and important nation on earth, and he will bless you in many ways.
translation_verse: Ne èɖo to Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ƒe gbe la, yayra siwo katã gbɔna la anɔ dziwò, eye agbenɔnɔ adze edzi na wò.

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Woayra wò le du me, eye wòayra wò le agble me.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ayra wò ŋutɔ viwòwo, wò agblemenukuwo, wò lãwo ƒe viwo; woayra wò nyinɔwo woadzi fũu, eye wò alẽviwo asɔ gbɔ zã.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Woayra wò kusi kple amɔwɔze.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Ne èle aƒe la, woayra wò, eye ne èyi nugbe hã, woayra wò.

english_verse: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ aɖu wò futɔ siwo ho aʋa ɖe ŋuwò la dzi le ŋkuwò me. Mɔ ɖeka dzi woato ava, ke mɔ adrẽ dzi woato así le nuwò.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ayra wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã, eye nu ayɔ wò ava taŋ. Ayra wò le anyigba si tsɔm wòle na wò la dzi.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ne èlé Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye nèwɔ nu si dze eŋu la, aɖo wò nànye dukɔ kɔkɔe nɛ abe ale si wòka atam na wò ene.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã akpɔe be Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ le ŋuwò, eye woavɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ana wò nukpɔkpɔ adzi ɖe edzi: wò ŋutɔ viwòwo, wò lãwo ƒe viwo kple wò agblemenukuwo asɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi fũu le anyigba si ŋu Aƒetɔ ka atam ɖo na tɔgbuiwòwo be yeatsɔ na wò la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ aʋu eƒe nu nyuiwo nɔƒe nu le dziƒo na wò, eye wòana tsi adza ɖe wò anyigba dzi le edzaɣi. Ayra miaƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã ale be nàdo nu na dukɔ geɖewo, ke wò ŋutɔ ya màdo nu le dukɔ aɖeke gbɔ o.
