english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ atsɔ wò awɔ ta na dukɔwo, menye asikɛ o. Ado wò ɖe dzi ɖaa, eye màva anyi o, nenye be èse eƒe se siwo dem mele na wò egbe, eye nèlé wo me ɖe asi hewɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ne èku la, xeviwo kple gbemelãwoe ava ɖu wò lã, eye ame aɖeke mava nyà wo ɖa o.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo anye dzesi le wò kple wò dzidzimeviwo ŋu tegbee be Mawu he to na wò.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: “Evɔ ne mèɖo to Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ƒe gbe o, eye mèlé se kple ɖoɖo siwo katã gblɔm mele na wò egbe la me ɖe asi hewɔ wo dzi o la, fiƒode siwo katã gbɔna la aɖi ŋu wò:

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: Aɖi ŋuwò le du me, aɖi ŋuwò le agble me.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Aɖi wò kusi kple wò amɔwɔze ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: Aɖi ŋuwò le aƒe, aɖi ŋuwò le gbe.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ ana fiƒode anɔ dziwò, àtɔtɔ, màkpɔ ta na dɔ siwo katã nèwɔ la o, va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃ avɔ ɖa kaba le nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo nèwɔ kple esi nègblẽm ɖi la ta.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Le tsidzadza teƒe la, Aƒetɔ ana kewɔ kple ʋuʋudedi adza tso dziƒo ɖe wò anyigba la dzi, va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ ana wò futɔwo nasi wò le aʋagbedzi. Mɔ ɖeka dzi nàto ayi ɖakpe aʋa kpli wo, ke mɔ adrẽ dzi nàsí le wo nu ato adzo. Hiã si atu wò la azu ŋɔdzi gã ŋutɔ na fiaɖuƒewo katã le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ akplɔ ƒoƒoe aƒu wò abe ale si wòwɔ Egiptetɔwo ene. Àka abi makumaku, àdze akpa, aklabi anɔ ŋuwò; ke màhaya akpɔ o.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ana nàku tsu, wò ŋku agbã, eye àtɔtɔ.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Le ŋdɔ me la, ànɔ asi tsam anɔ yiyim abe ŋkuagbãtɔe le viviti me zɔm ene, eye agbenɔnɔ madze dzi na wò o. Woate wò ɖe anyi, eye woada adzo wò enuenu; ke ame aɖeke manɔ anyi axɔ na wò o.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Àbia nyɔnu ta be yeaɖe, ke ŋutsu bubu adɔ egbɔ. Àtu xɔ, ke mànɔ eme akpɔ o. Àde waingble, ke kutsetseawo made wò nu me o.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Woawu wò nyitsu le ŋkuwò me nàkpɔ, gake màkpɔ eƒe lã aɖu o. Woakplɔ wò tedziwo sesẽe le wò ŋkume adzoe, eye womatrɔ wo agbɔe na wò o. Woalé wò alẽwo atsɔ na wò futɔwo, ke ame aɖeke manɔ anyi axɔ na wò o.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ viwò ŋutsuwo kple mia viwò nyɔnuwo ana dukɔ bubu me tɔwo le wò ŋutɔ ŋkuwò me woakplɔ adzoe. Ànɔ mɔ dzi kpɔm gbe sia gbe be wole wo gbugbɔ ge vɛ, gake womatrɔ agbɔ kpɔ o.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Dukɔ si mènya o la me tɔwoe aɖu wò agblemenuwo kple nu siwo katã nèwɔ dɔ hekpɔ la. Woasẽ ŋuta le ŋuwò ɣe sia ɣi, eye woate mi ɖe anyi.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Fukpekpe siawo katã teƒe kpɔkpɔ alea ana nàku tsu.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ akplɔ wò kple fia si nèɖo na ɖokuiwò la ayi dukɔ si mi kple mia tɔgbuiwòwo mienya o la me, eye àsubɔ mawu siwo wotsɔ ati kple kpe wɔ la le afi ma.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Àzu vɔvɔ̃donamenu le dukɔ siwo katã me Aƒetɔ anyà wò aɖo ɖa la me. Wò nya azu lodonya, eye woanɔ alɔ me ɖem le ŋuwò.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Àƒã nuku geɖe, ke ʋɛ aɖe ko nàŋe elabe ʋetsuviwo aɖui keŋ.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Àde waingble alé be nɛ nyuie, ke màgbe kutsetse aɖeke alo akpɔ eme wain hã ano o, elabe ŋɔwo aɖui.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Amitiwo abɔ ɖe wò anyigba la dzi, ke màkpɔ ami awɔ eŋudɔ o, elabe kutsetseawo adudu.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Àdzi viŋutsuwo kple vinyɔnuwo, ke womanye tɔwò o, elabe woaɖe aboyo wo.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Amedzro si le gbɔwò la akpɔ ŋusẽ, eye eŋkɔ ade dzi, ke wò la, àyi to, agayi to.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Ado nu na wò, ke wò la, màdo nu nɛ o. Atrɔ zu ta, ke wò àzu asikɛ.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Le fiƒode si le dziwò ta la, dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo katã adzɔ ɖe dziwò va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃ avɔ, elabe mèse Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ƒe gbe o; mèlé se siwo wòde kple ɖoɖo siwo wòwɔ na wò la me ɖe asi o.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: “Togbɔ be Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, na nu sɔ gbɔ ɖe mia si fũu hã la, mète ŋu kɔ ŋkume subɔe faa tso dzime o.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Eya ta àsubɔ wò futɔ siwo Aƒetɔ adɔ ɖe wò ŋuwò la. Dɔ kple tsikɔ awu wò, àtsi amama, eye hiã atu wò le nu sia nu me. Aƒetɔ ate wò ɖe anyi, awɔ funyafunya wò va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃ vɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ akplɔ dukɔ si ƒe gbe mèse o la tso keke anyigba ƒe seƒe ke ava de wò. Woalũ ɖe dziwò, adze dziwò abe ale si hɔ̃ lũna ɖe nu dzi ƒona ene.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Woanye mo sesẽ kpla tɔwo o, eye womakpɔ nublanui na ame aɖeke o; amegãɖeɖi loo, alo ɖekakpui o.

english_verse: They will take your cattle, sheep, goats, grain, wine, and olive oil, then leave you to starve.
translation_verse: Woaɖu wò lãwo kple agblemenuwo va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃ vɔ. Bli, wain kple ami, wò nyinɔ kple alẽ; ɖekeɖeke masusɔ na wò o, va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃ vɔ.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Woaxaxa wò ɖo le du ɖe sia ɖe si le anyigba si Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, le tsɔtsɔm na wò la me, va se ɖe esime gli kɔkɔ sesẽ siwo ŋu nèle ŋu ɖom ɖo la amu.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Ne wò futɔwo ɖe to ɖe wò duwo, eye woxaxa wò ɖo la, nuɖuɖukpɔkpɔ asesẽ na wò ale gbegbe be àɖu wò ŋutɔ viwò ŋutsu kple viwò nyɔnu, siwo Aƒetɔ na wò la ƒe lã gɔ̃.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: ale be mana viawo ƒe lã si ɖum wòle la ƒe ɖeke wo dometɔ aɖeke o. Elabe naneke mesusɔ ɖi nɛ, esime woɖe to ɖe wò eye futɔwo xaxa wò ɖo le wò duwo katã me o.

english_verse: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ akplɔ fuwɔame sesẽ kple dɔléle vɔ̃ɖi siwo nu mayi akpɔ o la aƒu wò ŋutɔ kple wò dzidzimeviwo siaa.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, ahe dɔléle kple fuwɔame ƒomevi ɖe sia ɖe siwo womeŋlɔ ɖe segbalẽ sia me o la ava dziwò va se ɖe esime nàtsrɔ̃ vɔ.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be miesɔ gbɔ abe ɣletiviwo le dziŋgɔli me ene hã la, ame ʋɛ aɖewo koe latsi agbe le mia dome, elabe mieɖo to Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe gbe o.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Ale si Aƒetɔ kpɔ dzidzɔ le mia ŋu, wɔ nyui na mi, eye wòna miedzi sɔ gbɔ fũu la, nenema ke wòakpɔ dzidzɔ le mia wuwu kple mia tsɔtsrɔ̃ ŋutii. Aɖe mi ɖa abe ale si wohoa ati kple ke ene, le anyigba si dzi yim miele la dzi.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ aka wò ahlẽ ɖe dukɔwo katã dome, tso xexeme ƒe go ɖeka yi go evelia, eye àsubɔ mawu siwo wowɔ kple ati kple kpe. Evɔ la, mia tɔgbuiwo mesubɔ nu siawo kpɔ o.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Miaƒe dzi anɔ tsotsom kpòkpokpo ɣe sia ɣi le nu siwo teƒe kpɔm nèle la ta. Ale be le ŋdi me la, àgblɔ be: ‘Ao, zã mado dzro oa!’ eye le fiẽ me la, àgblɔ be: ‘Ao, ŋu make dzro oa!’

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Aƒetɔ gblɔ be miegale gbugbɔ ge ayi Egipte akpɔ o hã la, akplɔ mi ade tɔdziʋu agbugbɔ yi afi mae. Ne mieɖo la, miawo ŋutɔ miadzra mia ɖokui kluvi kple kosiwoe na miaƒe futɔwo, ke ame aɖeke madi mi be yeaƒle mi o.”

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Nya siawo nye nubabla ƒe nya siwo Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be wòagblɔ na Israelviwo le Moab-nyigba dzi. Nubabla sia kpe ɖe esi wòbla kpli wo le Xoreb gbɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Esi mieva afi sia la, Sixon, Xesbon-fia kple Og, Basan-fia ho aʋa ɖe mía ŋuti, ke míeɖu wo dzi,

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: xɔ woƒe anyigba hema na Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase viwo ƒe to afã.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Eya ta milé nubabla sia ƒe nyawo me ɖe asi eye miwɔ wo dzi bene nu sia nu si miawɔ la nadze edzi na mi.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie be ŋutsu, nyɔnu, ƒome, alo to siwo le tsitre ɖe afii egbe la dometɔ aɖeke nagatrɔ le Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la yome aɖasubɔ dukɔ mawo ƒe mawu aɖeke o. Ame si wɔ esia la, anɔ abe ati si ƒe ke na eƒe tsetsea va zu aɖi le vevem abe atsa ene, anɔ mia dome.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie be ame aɖeke naganɔ mia dome le afii si ase nubablanya siawo gake anɔ dzi dem ƒo na eɖokui be, ne yesẽ to hele nu si dze ye ŋu wɔm hã la, yeanɔ dedie o.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ aɖee ɖa le Israel ƒe toawo katã dome be wòanye kpɔdzidze na amewo eye wòana dzɔgbevɔ̃e nadzɔ ɖe edzi. Fiƒode siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe segbalẽa me si ku ɖe nubabla la dzi mawɔmawɔ ŋu la anɔ eyama dzi.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Gbe aɖe gbe la, miaƒe dzidzimevi siwo gbɔna kple dukɔ bubu me tɔwo atso didiƒe ava kpɔ fuwɔame kple dɔléle siwo Aƒetɔ he va miaƒe anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Miaƒe anyigba la afiã atrɔ zu aŋɔ kple dze. Womate ŋu aƒã nu ɖe edzi o, eye gbe aɖeke hã mate ŋu amie ɖe edzi o. Miaƒe anyigba la anɔ abe Sodom kple Gomora, alo Adma kple Zeboyim siwo Aƒetɔ tsrɔ̃ le dɔmedzoe kple dziku me la ene.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Ne dukɔwo katã kpɔ anyigba la wòle alea la, ekema woabia be: ‘Nu ka tae Aƒetɔ wɔ anyigba sia alea ɖo? Nu ka na wòdo dziku helihelĩ alea gbegbe?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Tete amewo aɖo eŋu be: ‘Esi Aƒetɔ ƒe dukɔ la tu nu si wòbla kple Aƒetɔ, wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu, esime wòkplɔ wo tso Egipte gbɔna la tae.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Woyi ɖasubɔ mawu bubuwo hede ta agu na wo, evɔ la, womesubɔ mawu mawo kpɔ o eye gawu la, Aƒetɔ de se na wo be womegasubɔ wo o hafi.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ tsɔ dziku, adã kple dɔmedzoe ho wo abe ati ene tso woƒe anyigba dzi ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba bubu dzi, afi si wole va se ɖe egbe.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: “Nya ɣaɣla aɖewo li si nye Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la ɖeɖe ko tɔ. Ke nu siwo wòɖe ɖe go la nye mía kple míaƒe dzidzimeviwo tɔ ale be míate ŋu awɔ se sia kple eƒe nyawo katã dzi tegbee.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: “Ne nu siawo katã va eme na wò, yayraa kple fiƒodea, siwo metsɔ ɖo ŋkuwò me, eye nèɖo ŋku wo dzi le dukɔ siwo katã dome Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la nyà wò ɖo ɖa la me,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: eye nètrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, wò kple viwòwo, eye mieɖo to eƒe gbe tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me la,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Ne keke xexea me ƒe seƒe ke wòkaka mi ɖahlẽ ɖo hã la, aƒo mia nu ƒu, akplɔ mi tso afi ma agbɔe,

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: ale be Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la akplɔ wò ava anyigba si tɔgbuiwòwo xɔ la dzi, ale be nàxɔe. Awɔ nyui na wò wu tɔgbuiwòwo, eye wòana nàdzi asɔ gbɔ fũu wu woawo gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, atso aʋa na mia kple wò dzidzimeviwo ƒe dziwo ale be mialɔ̃e kple dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo, eye mianɔ agbe.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Ana fiƒode siawo katã ava wò futɔwo kple ketɔ siwo ti yowòme la dzi.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ke wò la, gaɖo to Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ƒe gbe, eye nàwɔ se siwo katã mede na wò egbe la dzi.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, ana nu siwo katã nèwɔna la adze dzi nyuie. Ana viwòwo, wò lãhawo, wò agblemenuwo kple wò kesinɔnuwo asɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi. Aƒetɔ agakpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋuwò, awɔ nyui na wò, abe ale si wòwɔ na tɔgbuiwòwo ene.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Elabe èɖo to Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ƒe gbe, lé se kple ɖoɖo siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la me ɖe asi, eye nètrɔ ɖe eŋu tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: “Elabe se si dem mele na wò egbe la, menye nane si gɔmesese sesẽ o. Mele didiƒe tso gbɔwò hã o.

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Mele ƒu godo, ne woabia be: ‘Ame ka atso ƒu ayi ɖatsɔe vɛ na mí míase awɔ edzi mahã?’ o.

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Ao. Nya la tsɔ ɖe gbɔwò kpuie. Ele wò nu me; ele wò dzime be nàte ŋu awɔ edzi.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, egbe la metsɔ agbe kple dzɔgbe nyui, ku kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e le ŋkuwò me ɖom be nàtia.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Metsɔ agbe kple ku, yayra kple fiƒode le mia ŋkume ɖom egbe. Mele dziƒo kple anyigba yɔm be woanye nye ɖasefowo. Eya ta mitia agbe, be mi kple miaƒe dzidzimeviwo mianɔ agbe.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Lɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la. Ɖo toe, eye nàku ɖe eŋu elabe eyae nye wò agbe, be nànɔ agbe didi le anyigba si ŋu Aƒetɔ ka atam ɖo na tɔgbuiwòwo, Abraham, Isak kple Yakob, be yeatsɔ na wo la dzi.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Tete Mose yi eƒe nuƒoa dzi na Israelviwo katã

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Milé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye misẽ ŋu. Migavɔ̃ o; womegadzi ŋɔ na mi o elabe, Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu lae le zɔzɔm kpli mi. Maɖe asi le mia ŋu o, eye magblẽ mi ɖi o.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Tete Mose yɔ Yosua, eye wògblɔ nɛ le Israelviwo katã ŋkume be: “Lé dzi ɖe ƒo eye nàsẽ ŋu. Wòe le dukɔ sia kplɔ ge ayi be wòaɖaxɔ anyigba si ŋugbe Aƒetɔ do na wo tɔgbuiwo la dzi. Wòe ana woaxɔ anyigba la wòazu wo tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ akplɔ wò, eye wòanɔ kpli wò. Maɖe asi le ŋuwò o, eye magblẽ wò ɖi o. Eya ta mègavɔ̃ o, eye dzi hã megaɖe le ƒowò o.” Woaxlẽ Mawu ƒe se la ƒe adrẽ sia ƒe adrẽ

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ale Mose ŋlɔ Mawu ƒe se la, eye wòtsɔe de asi na nunɔlawo kple Israel-me tsitsiwo katã. Nunɔlaawo nye Levitɔwo, eye woawoe tsɔa Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Ale be woƒe dzidzimevi siwo menyae o la asee. Ale woasrɔ̃ ale si woavɔ̃ Aƒetɔ le miaƒe agbenɔɣi katã le anyigba si dzi yim miele le Yordan godo be miaxɔe wòanye mia tɔ la dzi.” Aƒetɔ ƒe gbedeasi mamlɛtɔwo na Mose

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Kpɔ ɖa, wò kuɣi ɖo vɔ. Yɔ Yosua, ne miava godoƒegbadɔ la gbɔ, ne made dɔ asi nɛ.” Ale Mose kple Yosua yi ɖatsi tsitre ɖe agbadɔa gbɔ.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ɖe eɖokui fia le alilikpo dodo aɖe si do ɖe agbadɔa ƒe mɔnu la me.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Kpɔ ɖa, esusɔ vie ko àku ayi tɔgbuiwòwo gbɔ. Le wò ku megbe la, Israelviwo agblẽm ɖi, eye woatu nu, si mebla kpli wo la. Woatrɔ megbe adem, eye woayi aɖasubɔ anyigba si dzi yim wole la ƒe mawuwo.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Ekema mado dziku ɖe wo ŋu ɣe ma ɣi, agblẽ wo ɖi. Nyemanye kɔ akpɔ wo o eye woatsrɔ̃. Dzɔgbevɔ̃e geɖe adzɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye woakpe fu vevie. Woagblɔ le ɣe ma ɣi be: ‘Ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo medzɔ ɖe mía dzi, elabe mía Mawu la mele mía dome oa?’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, nyematrɔ ɖe wo ŋu axɔ na wo akpɔ o, elabe wodze mawu bubuwo yome le subɔsubɔm, eye esia nye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, miŋlɔ ha sia ɖi ne miafia Israel-dukɔ blibo la. Mina ha sia nanɔ wo nu woanɔ dzidzim, ne wòanye ɖasefo nam ɖe Israel-dukɔ ŋu.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Makplɔ wo ayi anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi bɔ ɖo si ŋu meka atam ɖo be matsɔe na wo tɔgbuiwo la dzi. Nuɖuɖu mahiã wo le afi ma o, woakpɔ lã me, eye woƒe dzi adze me. Ke woatrɔ megbe adem aɖanɔ mawu bubuwo subɔm. Woado vlom, eye woatu nu, si mebla kpli wo la.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e geɖe kple fukpekpewo le dzɔdzɔm ɖe wo dzi la, ha sia anye nye ɖasefo ɖe wo ŋuti, elabe woƒe dzidzimeviwo madzudzɔ edzidzi akpɔ o. Esi mele nya sia gblɔm fifia gɔ̃ hafi makplɔ wo ayi anyigba si ŋugbe medo na wo la dzi la, menya nu si le susu me na wo.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Mose ŋlɔ ha la ɖi gbe ma gbe ke, eye wòfiae Israel-dukɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ƒo nu kple Yosua, Nun vi la. Aƒetɔ gblɔ nɛ be: “Lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye nàsẽ ŋu. Wòe akplɔ Israelviwo ayi anyigba si ŋugbe medo na wo la dzi. Nye ŋutɔ manɔ kpli wò.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Mose ŋlɔ Mawu ƒe se la tsitotsito ɖe agbalẽ me.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Esi wòŋlɔe vɔ la, egblɔ na nunɔla Levitɔawo, ame siwo tsɔa Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la be:

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Mitsɔ segbalẽ sia da ɖe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe nubablaɖaka la xa, ne wòanye ɖasefo ɖe mia ŋu anɔ afi ma.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Elabe menya be tosẽlawo kple aglãdzelawo mienye. Nyemeku haɖe o, mele mia gbɔ, gake miele aglã dzem ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu alea! Ekem ne meva ku ɖe, ale ke wòahanɔ?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Miƒo miaƒe toawo ƒe ame tsitsiwo kple dɔdzikpɔlawo katã nu ƒu ɖe ŋkunye me le afii, ne maku nya siawo ɖe to me na wo. Mayɔ dziƒo kple anyigba ne woanye nye ɖasefowo.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Menyae be le nye ku megbe la, miazu dukɔ vɔ̃ɖi godoo; miele asi ɖe ge le nu si mefia mi la ŋuti. Ekema dzɔgbevɔ̃e aɖi kpe mi le nuvɔ̃ɖi gbogbo siwo miava nɔ wɔwɔm la ta. Aƒetɔ ado dziku ɖe mia ŋu vevie.” Mose ƒe ha

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Tete Mose gblɔ ha la ƒe nyawo ɖe to me na Israel ƒe takpekpe blibo la va se ɖe esime nyaawo vɔ:

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!
translation_verse: “Miɖo to, dziƒowo, mele nu ƒo ge. Anyigba, se nye numenyawo.

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Nye nufiafia le dzadza ge abe tsi ene; eye nye nyawo le hehlẽ ge abe zãmu ene. Woanɔ abe tsie nyɔ́ ɖe gbe fɛ̃ dzi ene, abe agbafie ɖe amagbe dzi ene.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Mele Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ kafu ge, eye eƒe amewo aƒo nu le mía Mawu ƒe nu dzɔtsu wɔwɔ ŋu!

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: “Enye agakpe, eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo de blibo elabe eƒe mɔwo katã dzɔ. Mawu nye nyateƒetɔ; alakpa mele eme o. Nuteƒewɔla, dzɔdzɔetɔ wònye.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Gake mi viawo miewɔ nu tovo ɖe eŋu, miezu ŋukpenanuwɔlawo eya ta mieganye viawo azɔ o. Dzidzime baɖa, gbegblẽ mienye.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Dukɔ dzɔlã, bometsila, aleae miawɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋua? Alo menye eyae nye tɔ́ si wɔ wò oa? Ɖe menye eya ŋutɔe wɔ wò nèzu dukɔ oa?

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku nya siwo dzɔ gbe aɖe gbe dzi, bu tame le blematɔwo ŋu. Bia tɔ́wò ne wòato nyawo na wò, eye nàbia wò amegãɖeɖiwo ne woagblɔ blemanya na wò.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Esi Dziƒoʋĩtɔ má anyigba na dukɔwo eye wòkaka amegbetɔviwo dome la, edo liƒo na dukɔwo keŋ, ɖe ale si Mawu viwo sɔ gbɔe nu.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke etia Yakob ƒe dzidzimeviwo na eɖokui, be woanye ye ŋutɔ ye tɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: “Efɔ wo le kegbegbe, le gbedadaƒo; afi si yaƒoƒo kplɔ ƒiaƒiaƒia. Ekpla asi kɔ na wo eye wòkpɔ wo dzi, lé be na wo abe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkuvi ene.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Ale si hɔ̃ dea dzo lã me na viawo, be woate ŋu adzo, eye wòsaa agba le viawo dzi, ale si wòkekea eƒe aʋala me, eye wòkɔa wo ɖe dzi la,

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: nenemae Aƒetɔ ɖeɖe kplɔ Israelviwoe. Mawu bubu aɖeke mekpe ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: Ena woɖu anyigba kɔkɔwo dzi, eye wòna woɖu gbemekutsetsewo. Ena anyitsi do tso agakpe me wono, eye wòna ami do tso kpe sesẽwo me.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Ena woƒe nyiwo kple alẽwo na notsi kpekẽ wo fũu. Woƒe alẽviwo, agbowo, nyitsuwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo na lãmi wo zã. Ena bli do ku na wo, eye wòna wain nyuitɔ wo wono.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ ƒe amewo va zu kesinɔtɔwo; ke wodze aglã ɖe eŋu. Woda ami, klã, eye wokpɔ lã me. Wogblẽ Mawu, wo Wɔla ɖi, eye wodo vlo eya, agakpe si xɔna na wo la.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Woƒe mawu bubuwo subɔsubɔ na Mawu ƒe ŋuʋaʋã ho; woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo wɔwɔ do dziku nɛ.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Wosa vɔ na trɔ̃ siwo nye nu dzodzrowo. Wosa vɔ na mawu siwo womenya kura o. Wosa vɔ na mawu yeye totoewo gɔ̃. Evɔ la, wo tɔ́wo mebua mawu siawo ɖe naneke me hafi o.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Mieɖe ŋu ɖi le miaƒe Xɔnametɔ, agakpe si dzi mi la ŋu. Mieŋlɔ Mawu si ƒe dɔ me miedzɔ tso la be.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: “Esi Aƒetɔ kpɔ esia la, edo dziku, eye wògbe via ŋutsuwo kple via nyɔnuwo.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: ‘Nyemagakpe ɖe wo ŋu azɔ o, ne makpɔ nu si ava dzɔ ɖe wo dzi la ɖa, elabe dzidzime gbegblẽ, mawɔnuteƒe wònye.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ nu maɖimawuwo ho ŋuʋaʋã le menye, eye wotsɔ legbawo do dzikui nam. Eya ta nye hã matsɔ ame maɖidukɔwo aho ŋuʋaʋã ɖe wo me, eye matsɔ dukɔ dzɔmovi ado dzikui na wo.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Elabe nye dɔme lé dzo le bibim; ele bibi ge ade keke tsiẽƒe ke. Afiã anyigba kple nu siwo wɔna le edzi, eye wòafiã keke towo ƒe agunu ke hã.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: “ ‘Malɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃ewo katã ali kɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye mada nye aŋutrɔwo katã ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Dɔ awu wo ate wo ŋu, eye asrã kple dɔ vɔ̃ atsrɔ̃ wo. Madɔ lã wɔadãwo ɖa woalé wo aɖu; mana da vɔ̃ɖiwo aɖu wo.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Ɖe medi be matsrɔ̃ wo ɖa keŋkeŋ, ale be ame aɖeke magaɖo ŋku wo dzi le amegbetɔwo dome o hafi.

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Ke nyemedi be woƒe futɔwo nado dziku nam o, eye woƒe ketɔwo nagblɔ dàdatɔe be yewoe ɖu nye dukɔ dzi, eye menye nye Aƒetɔ ŋutɔe wɔ wo vevie nenema o!’ ”

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Ale ke ame ɖeka ate ŋu aɖu ame akpe dzi, eye ame eve pɛ ate ŋu aɖu ame akpe ewo dzi? Mawu, woƒe Xɔnametɔ lae gblẽ wo ɖi; Aƒetɔ ŋutɔe tsɔ wo de asi tae.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Elabe woƒe futɔwo ŋutɔ tso nya me, be ŋusẽ mele yewoƒe mawuwo ŋu abe mía tɔ ene o.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Evɔ woƒe futɔwo gblẽ abe Sodom kple Gomora duwo ene. Wole abe waintsetse siwo nye aɖi, eye wo me tsi vena ene.

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: Wogale abe wain si wotsɔ da ƒe aɖi wɔ ene.”

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋku le nu si wowɔ la dzi; ele lalam na tohegbe.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ abia hlɔ̃, eye wòahe to gbe si gbe wodze anyi. Wo tsrɔ̃ɣi le aƒe tum, eye nu si woɖo ɖe wo ŋu la, le edzi ɖo ge kpata.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ atso afia na eƒe dukɔ, eye wòave eƒe dɔlawo nu, ne ekpɔ be ŋusẽ vɔ le wo ŋu, eye gameme alo ablɔɖevi aɖeke megali o.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Ekema Aƒetɔ abia eƒe dukɔ be: ‘Afi ka miaƒe mawuawo le? Xɔnametɔ si ŋu miele ŋu ɖom ɖo la ɖe?

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: Miaƒe vɔsa ƒe amiɖulawo kple miaƒe nunonovɔsa ƒe wainnolawo ɖe? Wonetsi tsitre ne woaxɔ na mi, eye woakpɔ mia tae!

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: “ ‘Miele ekpɔm azɔ be nye, mebe nye ɖeka koe li, eye mawu aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye oa? Mewua ame, eye megbɔa agbee. Medea abi ame ŋu, eye meyɔa dɔe. Naneke mate ŋu aɖe ame tso asinye me o.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Elabe medo nye asi ɖe dzi heka atam be zi ale si menya le agbe ko la,

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: manyre nye yi dadzo la, eye made asi tohehe me. Mabia hlɔ̃ nye futɔwo, eye maɖo eteƒe na nye ketɔwo.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Mana nye aŋutrɔwo ano ʋu amu, eye nye yi aɖu lã. Ame tsiaʋawo kple aboyomewo ƒe ʋue woano! Futɔwo ƒe kplɔlawo ƒe tatɔwo ƒe lãe woaɖu.’

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: “Dukɔwo, mikpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe dukɔ ŋu elabe ebia hlɔ̃ ame siwo katã wu wo. Ebia hlɔ̃ eƒe futɔwo eye wòtsɔ nuvɔ̃ ke eƒe dukɔ.”

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: egblɔ na wo be: “Milé nya siawo katã siwo megblɔ na mi tsitotsito egbe la me ɖe asi goŋgoŋ. Mide wo mia viwo si, ne woalé seawo me ɖe asi, awɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Nya siawo la, menye nya gbɔlo wonye na mi o; miaƒe agbe kekeake wonye. Eya ta miwɔ wo dzi ne mianɔ agbe didi le anyigba si xɔ ge mieyina le Yordan godo be wòanye mia tɔ la dzi.”

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe ke la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be:

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “De Abarim-togbɛka dzi le Moab-nyigba dzi le Yerixo kasa. Lia Nebo-to, eye nàkpɔ Kanaan-nyigba si tsɔ ge mala na Israelviwo la ɖa.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Èle kuku ge le to sia dzi ayi tɔgbuiwòwo gbɔ abe ale si nɔviwò Aron hã ku le Xor-to dzi heyi tɔgbuiawo gbɔ ene.

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: Anɔ na wò hã alea, elabe mi ame evea miewɔ nuteƒe nam le Israelviwo ŋkume o. Esi miegogo Kades le Zin-gbedadaƒo, eye mienɔ dzrewɔtsi la gbɔ la, miede bubu ŋunye le Israelviwo ŋkume o.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Ànɔ adzɔge akpɔ anyigba la ɖa ya, ke màɖo afɔ anyigba si mele tsɔtsɔ ge na Israelviwo la dzi akpɔ o.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Nya siawo nye yayra si Mose, Mawu ƒe ame la bia na Israelviwo hafi ku.

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ ɖi tso Sinai-to dzi va. Edze abe ɣe ene le Seir tame, tso Paran-to gbɔ. Ame kɔkɔe akpeakpewo kpe ɖe eŋu, eye dzo le bibim le eƒe nuɖusi.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ lɔ̃a eƒe amewo, eye wòkpɔa eƒe ame siwo katã ŋu wokɔ la ta. Ale míede ta agu ɖe eƒe afɔnu, eye míewɔna ɖe eƒe gbeɖeɖe dzi.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Míewɔa se si Mose de na mí la dzi. Se sia nye mí Yakob viwo ƒe domenyinu vevitɔ.

english_verse: Then you and your leaders made the Lord your king.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ zu fia le Yesurun esi dukɔa ƒe tatɔwo ƒo ƒu, esime Israel-toawo katã kpe ta.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: “Na Ruben nanɔ agbe tegbee; megaku o, mègana eƒe amewo nanɔ ʋɛ o.”

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Yuda ŋu be: “Aƒetɔ, se Yuda ƒe gbe, kplɔe va de etɔwo dome. Wɔ aʋa ɖe enu kple wò asi la, eye nànye kpeɖeŋutɔ nɛ ɖe eƒe futɔwo ŋu.”

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Levi ŋu be: “Aƒetɔ, èɖe wò lɔlɔ̃nu fia kple Urim kple Tumim to wò dɔla nuteƒewɔlawo siwo nye Levi viwo la dzi. Ète wo kpɔ le Masa, eye nèwɔ dzre kpli wo le dzrewɔtsia gbɔ.

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Wowɔ nuteƒe na wò wu wo dzilawo, wo nɔviŋutsuwo alo wo viwo. Wowɔ wò sededewo dzi, eye wolé wò nubabla me ɖe asi.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Woawoe afia wò ɖoɖowo Yakob viwo, eye woafia wò se la Israelviwo. Woawoe atsɔ lifi ava ŋkuwò me, eye woatsɔ numemevɔsa blibo la, aɖo wò vɔsamlekpui dzi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, yrae ne wòatsi, ŋusẽ nanɔ eŋu. Kpɔ ŋudzedze le eƒe asinudɔwo ŋu. Gblẽ eƒe futɔwo kple ketɔwo dome keŋkeŋ. Mègana ŋusẽ nagaɖo wo ŋu gbeɖe o.

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Benyamin ŋu be: “Aƒetɔ melɔ̃a nu le egbɔ o. Ekpɔa eta, nɔa egbɔ ɣe sia ɣi eye wòwɔ nɔƒe nɛ ɖe eƒe abɔta.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Yosef ŋu be: “Aƒetɔ neyra eƒe anyigba kple dziƒo ƒe nu nyuitɔwo, eye tsi nedzi nɛ tso anyigba tu me.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: Neyrae kple kutsetse xɔasi siwo ɣe nana woɖina kple kutsetse xɔasi siwo wɔna le wo tseɣi le ɣletiwo me.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Nena nuku siwo wɔna le blematowo dzi la nawɔ nɛ, eye nuku vevi siwo wɔna le blematogbɛwo dzi la nadzi ɖe edzi nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: Nena anyigba dzi nu xɔasiwo nasɔ gbɔ nɛ fũu. Eya, ame si ƒo nu le ŋuve me la neve enu. Yayra siawo katã nenɔ Yosef ƒe to la dzi, elabe eyae nye amegã le nɔviawo dome.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Yosef ƒe ŋusẽ le abe nyitsu tɔ ene. Eƒe dzowo le abe tò tɔwo ene. Yosef ƒe dzoawo nye Manase ƒe ame akpe naneawo kple Efrayim ƒe ame akpe ewoawo. Woawoe wòatsɔ atutu dukɔwo aƒu anyi; va se ɖe anyigba ƒe seƒewo ke.”

english_verse: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Zebulon ŋu be: “Zebulon, dzi nedzɔ wò le wò nugbeyiyi ŋu; Isaxar, kpɔ dzidzɔ le wò aƒenɔnɔ ŋu.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Wokpe dukɔwo va woƒe to la gbɔ, eye wosa vɔ vavãtɔ le afi ma. Wokpɔ woƒe kesinɔnuwo tso ƒu me, eye wokpɔ woƒe nu veviwo tso ƒutake me.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Gad ŋu be: “Woakafu ame si keke Gad ɖe nu! Gad tsyɔ akɔ anyi abe dzata ene le lalam be yeavuvu nu; yeavuvu abɔ alo ta ƒe ayi.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Etia anyigba nyuitɔ na eɖokui, elabe wodzra anyigba sia ɖo ɖi na aʋakplɔla ɖe afi ma. Enɔ dukɔ la nu yi kpli wo, eya kple Israel wɔ gbeɖeɖeawo dzi, kple Aƒetɔ ƒe sedede dzɔdzɔeawo dzi.”

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Dan ŋu be: “Dan nye dzatavi. Eti kpo do tso Basan.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Naftali ŋu be: “Nu nyuiwo asɔ gbɔ ɖe Naftali si fũu; Aƒetɔ ƒe yayra anɔ edzi. Woƒe anyigba atso tá la gbɔ, ayi keke anyigbeme ke.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Aser ŋu be: “Woyra Aser wu viŋutsu bubuawo. Na eƒe nu nanyo nɔviawo ŋu, eye wòatsɔ eƒe afɔ ade ami me.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Wò duwo ƒe agbowo anye ga yibɔ kple akɔbli. Ŋusẽ anɔ ŋuwò le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: “Yesurun, mawu aɖeke meli abe wò Mawu la ene o. Eto dziŋgɔli me le yiyim, be yeakpe ɖe ŋuwò, eye wòle eƒe fianyenye me le dziŋgɔli me tom.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Mawu mavɔtɔ la nye nɔwòƒe; eƒe abɔ mavɔwo lé wò ɖe asi ɣe sia ɣi. Enyà futɔwo ɖa le ŋgɔwò, eye wògblɔ be, ‘Mitsrɔ̃ nu!’

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Ale Israel le anyi, nɔ dedie; Yakob ƒe vudo la ɖeɖe le anyigba, si dzi bli kple wain le, afi si zãmu tso dziƒo dzana le.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: O Israel, kpɔ dzidzɔ! Ame kae le abe wò ene? Dukɔ si Aƒetɔ xɔ ɖe agbe; eyae nye wò akpoxɔnu kple wò kpeɖeŋutɔ; yi si nètsɔna ɖua dzii. Wò futɔwo ava ɖe kuku na wò, be nàkpɔ nublanui na yewo, eye wò la, ànya avuzi le woƒe nuxeƒewo dzi.”

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Mose yi Moab-gbegbe, eye wòlia Nebo-to yi ɖado ɖe Pisga-to tame le Yerixo kasa. Esi wòle afi ma la, Aƒetɔ fia anyigba blibo lae. Anyigba la tso Gilead-nutome yi keke Dan-du gbɔ le dzigbeme.

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: eye wòto Yuda-nutome va se ɖe ƒu nu le ɣetoɖoƒe. Eto anyigbeme na Yuda, zɔ to gbegbe gbadza si le Yerixo, devedu la kple Zoar dome.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Mose be: “Anyigba si ŋu meka atam ɖo na Abraham, Isak kple Yakob be matsɔe na woƒe dzidzimeviwo lae nye esi. Mena èkpɔe, ke nyemana nàyi afi ma o.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ale Mose, Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla, ku ɖe afi ma le Moab-nyigba dzi abe ale si Aƒetɔ la gblɔe ɖi tsã ene.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖii ɖe bali la me le Moab-nyigba dzi le Bet-Peor du kasa; ke ame aɖeke menya teƒe si tututu woɖii ɖo va se ɖe egbe o.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Israelviwo fa Mose ŋkeke bla etɔ̃ sɔŋ le Moab-gbegbe. Emegbe wowu avifafa kple konyifafa ŋkekeawo nu na Mose.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Nunyagbɔgbɔ yɔ Yosua, Nun vi la, fũu elabe Mose da eƒe asiwo ɖe edzi. Israelviwo ɖo to Yosua, eye wowɔ se siwo Aƒetɔ de na Mose wòde na wo la dzi.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖeke meganɔ Israel kpɔ si de Mose nu o. Aƒetɔ ƒoa nu kple eya ŋkume kple ŋkume.

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: Gbeƒãɖela aɖeke hã mewɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo abe esiwo Aƒetɔ dɔ Mose wòyi ɖawɔ le Egipte Fiagã la kple eƒe dudɔwɔlawo kpakple dukɔ blibo la katã ŋkume ene o.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Nenema ke gbeƒãɖela aɖeke hã mete ŋu wɔ ŋusẽdɔ kple nu klitsu siwo katã Mose wɔ le Israel-dukɔ blibo la ŋkume kpɔ o.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Le Mose, Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla, ƒe ku megbe la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yosua, Nun vi, si nye Mose ƒe subɔla be:

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “Nye dɔla Mose ku. Eya ta tso, ne mi kple ame siawo katã miatso Yordan-tɔsisi la, eye miayi ɖe anyigba si mele tsɔtsɔm na Israelviwo la dzi.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: Abe ale si megblɔ na Mose ene la, anyigba la ƒe afi sia afi si miaɖo afɔe la nye mia tɔ; metsɔe na mi.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Anyigba la tso kegbegbe si le anyigbeme va yi Lebanon-to la gbɔ le dzigbeme. Egatso Frat-tɔsisi gã la nu le ɣedzeƒe to Xititɔwo ƒe anyigba me va ɖo ƒu gã la nu le ɣetoɖoƒe gome.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke mate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwò le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me o. Ale si menɔ kple Mose la, manɔ kple wò hã nenema ke. Nyemaɖe asi le ŋuwò o. Nyemagblẽ wò ɖi hã o.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Na segbalẽ sia me nyawo nanɔ nuwò le afi sia afi si nàyi la. Bu wo ŋu zã kple keli ale be woate ŋu akpe ɖe ŋuwò nàɖɔ ŋu ɖo, eye nànɔ agbe ɖe nu siwo katã le eme la nu, elabe eya ko hafi wò mɔ me akɔ, eye nu sia nu adze edzi na wò nyuie.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Menye nyee gblɔe na wò oa? Mebe sẽ ŋu, wɔ kalẽ, mègavɔ̃ o, eye dzi hã megaɖe le ƒowò o, elabe afi sia afi si nàyi la, nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, meli kpli wò.” Yosua ɖe gbe na dukɔ la be woaxɔ Kanaan-nyigba la

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Ale Yosua ɖe gbe na dukɔ la kplɔlawo be:

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Mizɔ to asaɖa la me, eye miaɖe gbe na ameawo be: ‘Midi nuɖuɖu da ɖi elabe miele Yordan-tɔsisi la tso ge le ŋkeke etɔ̃ me, ado ɖe anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la le tsɔtsɔm na mi be wòanye mia tɔ la dzi.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Ke Yosua gblɔ na Ruben kple Gad ƒe dzidzimeviwo kpakple Manase ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe afã be:

english_verse: The Lord's servant Moses said that the Lord our God has given you land here on the east side of the Jordan River, where you could live in peace. Your wives and children and your animals can stay here in the land Moses gave you. But all of you that can serve in our army must pick up your weapons and lead the men of the other tribes across the Jordan River. They are your relatives, so you must help them
translation_verse: Mina mia srɔ̃wo, mia viwo kple miaƒe lãhawo nanɔ anyigba si Mose na mi le Yordan-tɔsisia godo la dzi. Ke kalẽtɔ siwo katã le mia dome la natsɔ aʋawɔnuwo, adze wo nɔvi Israelvi bubuawo ŋgɔ atso Yordan-tɔsisia, ale be woakpe ɖe wo ŋu,

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime Aƒetɔ nana nɔƒe woawo hã abe miawo ke ene, eye woawo hã axɔ anyigba si Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la le tsɔtsɔm na wo la. Ema megbe la, migbugbɔ yi anyigba si nye mia tɔ, si Mose, Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla na mi le ɣedzeƒe gome le Yordan godo la dzi, eye mianɔ afi ma.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu na Yosua be: “Míawɔ nu siwo katã nàgblɔ na mí la, eye afi sia afi si ke nàɖo mí ɖo la, míayi.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Ame si ke dze aglã ɖe ŋuwò, eye wògbe wò gbe dzi wɔwɔ la, woawui. Wò ya sẽ ŋu, eye nàlé dzi ɖe ƒo ko.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Yosua, Nun vi la, dɔ ŋutsu eve tso asaɖa si le Sitim la me le adzame ɖo ɖe Kanaan-nyigba dzi. Egblɔ na wo be: “Miyi ɖatsa le anyigba la dzi nyuie, eye mialé ŋku ɖe nuwo ŋu tsitotsito, vevietɔ milé ŋku ɖe Yerixo-dua ŋu.” Amedɔdɔawo yi, eye woge ɖe gbolo aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Raxab la ƒeme hedze egbɔ.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Ke amewo yi ɖagblɔ na Yerixo-fia be: “Kpɔ ɖa, Israel-ŋutsu aɖewo va afii egbe zã be woatsa ŋku le míaƒe anyigba la me.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Hafi ŋkutsalaawo nadɔ alɔ̃ la, Raxab yi ɖe wo gbɔ le xɔa tame.

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Menya be Aƒetɔ tsɔ anyigba sia na mi. Le ŋɔdzi si le mia ŋu ta la, mí anyigba sia dzi nɔlawo katã míele mia vɔ̃m ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Míese ale si Aƒetɔ na Aƒlaƒu la mie zu ƒuƒuiƒe le mia ŋgɔ, esime mieʋu tso Egipte. Ale si mietu nu kple Sixon kple Og, Amori-fiawo, le Yordan godo hetsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi la hã le nyanya na mí.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Esi míese nya siawo le mia ŋu la, vɔvɔ̃ ɖo mí katã, dzi ɖe le ame sia ame ƒo, eye míele mia vɔ̃m ŋutɔ. Elabe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la, le keke dziƒo ke, eye wògale anyigba dzi afii hã.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Fifia la, mità Aƒetɔ be yewole tɔ́nye ƒometɔwo nu ve ge, alé be na wo, abe ale si nye hã meve mia nu, eye melé be na mii ene. Medi be miaɖo kpe edzi nam kple dzesi aɖe.

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: Mika ɖe edzi nam be nɔnye kple tɔ́nye, nɔvinye ŋutsuwo kple nɔvinye nyɔnuwo kpakple woƒe ƒometɔwo katã le agbe tsi ge, yewole mía xɔ ge ɖe agbe.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Ŋutsuawo gblɔ nɛ be: “Ne mègblɔ nu si wɔ ge míeva la ame aɖeke se o, eye Aƒetɔ tsɔ anyigba sia na mí la, ekema míawo hã míaɖi anukware, ave mia nu, alé be na mi. Evɔ ne míewɔ míaƒe nya dzi o la, Mawu netsrɔ̃ mí ɖe mia teƒe!”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, gli si ƒo xlã Yerixo-dua la ƒe akpa aɖe nye aƒe si me Raxab nɔ la ƒe gli. Ale wòna ŋutsuawo ɖiɖi kple ka to fesre nu ɖe anyi.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Miyi ɖe toawo dzi, be mia yometilawo nagakpɔ mi o. Mibè ɖe afi ma ŋkeke etɔ̃ va se ɖe esime woatrɔ agbɔ. Emegbe la, miate ŋu adzo ayi.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Raxab gblɔ na wo be: “Meda asi ɖe miaƒe nya la dzi.” Ena ŋutsuawo dzo. Esa ka dzĩ la ɖe fesre la ŋu.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Ŋutsuawo dzo, eye woyi ɖabè ɖe toawo dome ŋkeke etɔ̃. Ame siwo ti wo yome la tsa di wo le mɔa katã dzi ʋuu, gake womekpɔ wo o. Ale wogbugbɔ yi Yerixo-dua me.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Emegbe ŋutsu eveawo gbɔ va Yosua, Nun vi la gbɔ, eye wogblɔ nu siwo katã dzɔ la nɛ.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Ðikeke aɖeke mele eme o, be Aƒetɔ tsɔ anyigba la katã na mí. Kpɔ ɖa, esi anyigba la dzi nɔlawo nyase mía ŋkɔ ko la, vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo ŋutɔŋutɔ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke ŋdi kanya la, Yosua kple Israelviwo katã fɔ kaba, dze mɔ tso Sitim va ɖo afi si wole Yordan-tɔsisia tso ge le, eye wotsi afi ma dɔ.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la, wo kplɔlawo tsa le asaɖa la me,

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: ale be miate ŋu anya mɔ si to ge miala, elabe mieto mɔ sia dzi kpɔ o. Ke migate ɖe nubablaɖaka la ŋu o! Nenɔ mia ŋgɔ abe agbadroƒe afã sɔŋ ene tso mia gbɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Yosua gblɔ na ameawo be: “Mikɔ mia ɖokui ŋu, elabe etsɔ la, Aƒetɔ le nukunu wɔ ge le mia dome.”

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yosua be: “Tso egbe dzi la, made asi kɔkɔdodo wò me le Israelviwo katã ŋkume, ale be woanya be ale si menɔ kple Mose la, manɔ kple wò hã nenema ke.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Gblɔ na nunɔla siwo tsɔ nubablaɖaka la be: ‘Ne mieva ɖo Yordan-tɔsisia nu la, mige ɖe tsia me vie ko ne miatɔ ɖi.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Tete Yosua gblɔ na Israelviwo be: “Mite va afii ne miase Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe nya.

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Ebe: ‘Azɔ ko miele si dze gee kɔtɛe be Mawu gbagbe la le mia dome, eye wòle Kanaanitɔwo, Xititɔwo, Xivitɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Girgasitɔwo, Amoritɔwo kple Yebusitɔwo nyà ge ɖa le mia ŋgɔ vavã.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔla siwo tsɔ anyigba la katã ƒe Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ, ƒe nubablaɖaka, ƒe afɔƒome nyaka Yordan me tsia me ko la, Yordan me tsi la adzudzɔ sisí, eye tsi si sí tso dzi gbɔna anyi la, atɔ, amlí kɔ ɖi.’ ”

english_verse: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front,
translation_verse: Ale dukɔ la do tso woƒe agbadɔwo me, eye woho be yewoatso Yordan. Nunɔlawo kɔ nubablaɖaka la dze dukɔa ŋgɔ.

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Esi aɖakatsɔlaawo va ɖo Yordan nu, eye nunɔla siwo kɔ aɖaka la ƒe afɔ nyaka tsia me ko la elabe Yordan ɖɔ gbagba le nuŋeɣi blibo la katã me,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Esime ameawo nɔ tɔgoa me zɔm alea la, nunɔla siwo tsɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖakaa la tsi tsitre ɖe anyigba ƒuƒui le Yordan tɔgoa titina va se ɖe esime ame sia ame to tɔgoa me va ɖo go evelia dzi.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Esi dukɔ blibo la tso Yordan-tɔsisi la vɔ la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yosua be:

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be: ‘Miyi ɖe teƒe si tututu nunɔlawo tsi tsitre ɖo le Yordan-tɔsisia titina la, ne miaɖe kpe wui eve le nunɔlaawo ƒe afɔteƒewo vɛ. Mina woatsɔ kpe siawo ayi afi si tsi ge miala adɔ egbe zã.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together
translation_verse: Ale Yosua yɔ ŋutsu wui eve siwo wòtia tso toawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe me le Israelviwo dome,

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Midze ŋgɔ na Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ƒe nubablaɖaka la, eye miayi ɖe Yordan-tɔsisia titina. Mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe netsɔ kpe ɖeka ɖe abɔta, ɖe Israel-toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: ekema miaɖo eŋu na wo be gbe aɖe gbe la, Yordan-tɔsisi la me ma, eye wòdzudzɔ sisí esime wokɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la le eme tom. Ale kpe siawo anye ŋkuɖodzinu na Israelviwo tegbee.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Ale ŋutsuawo wɔ nu siwo Yosua gblɔ na wo be woawɔ la. Woɖe kpe wui eveawo tso Yordan titina vɛ, ɖe Israel toawo ƒe xexlẽme nu, abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yosua ene, wotsɔ wo va da ɖe afi si wodro ɖo la.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Yosua ŋutɔ hã tsɔ kpe wui eve tu tsitre ɖe teƒe si nunɔla siwo tsɔ nubablaɖakaa tsi tsitre ɖo le Yordan-tɔgoa titina. Kpeawo gale afi ma va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Dukɔa ɖi go ɖe Yordan godo le ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke ewolia dzi, eye woƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Gilgal le Yerixo ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yosua tsɔ kpe wui eve siwo woɖe le Yordan-tɔgoa me la tu ɖe Gilgal.

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na Israelviwo be: “Ne mia viwo bia mi gbe aɖe gbe be: ‘Nu ka ta kpe siawo le afii?’ mahã la,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, na Yordan-tɔsisia mie zu ƒuƒuiƒe na mí va se ɖe esime mieto eme do vɔ, abe ale si wòna Aƒlaƒu la mie zu ƒuƒuiƒe na mía tɔgbuiwo woto eme do ene.

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: Le esia ta, xexemedukɔwo katã lava nya be Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ, eye miavɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la tegbee.”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Esi Amoritɔwo ƒe fia siwo katã le Yordan-tɔsisia ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe gome kple Kanaanitɔwo ƒe fia siwo le ƒu nu se be Aƒetɔ na Yordan-tɔsisia mie zu ƒuƒuiƒe, va se ɖe esime Israelviwo to eme do la, dzika tso wo ƒo ŋutɔ, eye dzi ɖe le wo ƒo. Yosua tso aʋa na Israel-ŋutsuwo

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yosua be: “Tsɔ kpe sesẽ, wɔ hɛ, ne nàgatso aʋa na Israelviwo zi evelia.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Ale Yosua di kpe sesẽ, tu hɛ, eye wòtso aʋa na Israelviwo le Gibeat-Aralot

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Ŋutsu siawo ƒe viŋutsuviwoe Yosua nyi hetsɔ wo ɖo wo tɔ́wo teƒe, eye wòtso aʋa na, elabe wometso aʋa na wo dometɔ aɖeke le mɔa dzi o.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Le aʋatsotso na wo vɔ megbe la, wonɔ afi ma va se ɖe esime abia ku na wo.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yosua be: “Egbe la, meɖe kluvinyenye si le mia ŋu tso Egipte la ɖa le mia ŋu.” Ale woyɔa teƒe ma tso ɣe ma ɣi va se ɖe egbe be Gilgal.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Esime Israelviwo le asaɖa me le Gilgal le gbegbe si te ɖe Yerixo ŋu la, woɖu Paska la le afi ma le ɣletia ƒe ŋkeke wui enelia ƒe fiẽ.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe woɖu anyigba la ƒe agblemenuku zi gbãtɔ ƒe ŋufɔke la, mana la dzudzɔ gege, eye womegakpɔnɛ ɖuna o. Tso gbe ma gbe la, wode asi agblemenuku si tso Kanaan-nyigba me la ɖuɖu me. Yosua kple ŋutsu si lé yi ɖe asi

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Esi Yosua te ɖe Yerixo ŋu la, efɔ mo dzi. Tete wòkpɔ ŋutsu aɖe si le tsitre ɖe eŋgɔ. Yi le esi. Yosua zɔ ɖe edzi biae be: “Mía dzie nèle loo, alo míaƒe futɔwo dzi nèlea?”

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Ŋutsua ɖo eŋu be: “Gbeɖe, Aƒetɔ ƒe aʋakplɔla menye. Azɔ meva ɖo.” Yosua tsyɔ mo anyi, de ta agu, eye wòbiae be: “Nye Aƒetɔ, nu ka nèdi be mawɔ?”

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ƒe aʋakplɔla la gblɔ nɛ be: “Ðe afɔ le afɔkpa me, elabe teƒe kɔkɔe nètsi tsitre ɖo.” Yosua ɖe afɔkpa le afɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: Azɔ le Israelviwo ta la, wodo Yerixo-dua ƒe agbowo le eme, de ga wo me, ale be ame aɖeke mate ŋu age ɖe dua me loo, alo ado go tso eme o.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Nunɔla adrẽ natsɔ agbodzokpẽawo adze nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ. Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, wò kple nunɔlaawo miaƒo xlã dua kpe ɖo zi adrẽ, nunɔlaawo nanɔ kpẽawo kum.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Ne woku kpẽawo, eye wohe wo me ʋuu miese ko la, ekema dukɔ blibo la nedo ɣli hoo sesĩe. Yerixo-dua ƒe gliwo amu adze anyi. Ekema Israelviwo nelũ ɖe emenɔlawo dzi.”

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Ale Yosua, Nun vi la, yɔ nunɔlaawo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Mikɔ nubablaɖaka la, eye mina mia dometɔ adrẽ natsɔ kpẽawo adze ŋgɔ.”

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: Ale wòna wotsɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la ƒo xlã dua kpe ɖo zi ɖeka gbe ma gbe, eye wogbugbɔ va asaɖa la me hetsi afi ma dɔ.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽa gbe la, wofɔ fɔŋli, eye wozɔ ƒo xlã dua kpe ɖo, abe ale si wowɔnɛ ɖaa ene, zigbɔzi adrẽ. Gbe ma gbe koe wozɔ ƒo xlã dua zi adrẽ.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Hafi woaƒo xlãe zi adrẽlia la, nunɔla kpẽkulaawo dzra ɖo ɖe kpẽawo kuku ŋu. Yosua gblɔ na dukɔa be: “Dzidzɔɣli neɖi, elabe Aƒetɔ tsɔ dua de asi na mi!

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Migbã dua. Mitsrɔ̃ nu siwo katã le eme la keŋkeŋ na Aƒetɔ negbe Raxab, gbolo la kple eƒemetɔwo dzaa ko miagblẽ ɖi, elabe eyae xɔ na ame siwo míedɔ la to wo ɣaɣla me.

english_verse: The silver and gold and everything made of bronze and iron belong to the Lord and must be put in his treasury. Be careful to follow these instructions, because if you see something you want and take it, the Lord will destroy Israel. And it will be all your fault.
translation_verse: Ke nu siwo katã wotsɔ klosalo, sika, akɔbli kple ga yibɔ wɔ la, Aƒetɔ ƒe nu kɔkɔewoe wonye. Milɔ woawo ya va eƒe nudzraɖoƒe la.”

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Esi Yosua wu eƒe nuƒoa nu la, ameawo do dzidzɔɣli, eye nunɔla kpẽkulaawo ku kpẽawo. Kaka dukɔa nase kpẽawo ƒe ɖiɖi la, wotso aseye bobobo. Kasia dua ƒe gliwo mu dze anyi gbloo, ame sia ame zɔ to eŋgɔ tẽe ge ɖe eme, eye woxɔ dua.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
