translation_verse: Yotam vie nye Axaz, eya vie nye Xizkiya, eye eya hã vie nye Manase.

english_verse: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Elisama, Elyada kple Elifelet; wole ame asieke.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Ame siawo katã nye David viŋutsuwo. Eƒe ahiãviwo ƒe viŋutsuwo mele eme o. Wo nɔvinyɔnue nye Tamar. Fia Salomo ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Yosiya viwoe nye: Yehohanan ŋgɔgbevi la, evelia nye Yehoyakim. Etɔ̃liae nye Zedekiya, eye eneliae nye Salum.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Yehoyakim ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Yexonya, eya vie nye Zedekiya.

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: Malxiram, Pedaya, Senazar, Yekamya, Hosama kple Nedabya.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pedaya viwoe nye: Zerubabel kple Simei. Zerubabel viwo nye: Mesulam kple Xananya. Wo nɔvinyɔnue nye Selomi.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Via ŋutsu atɔ̃ bubuwoe nye: Xasuba, Ohel, Berexya, Xasadya kple Yusab-Xesed.

english_verse: Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah,
translation_verse: Xananya viwoe nye: Pelatya kple Yesaya. Yesaya ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Refaya, ame si dzi Arnan, Obadya kple Sexanya.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Sexanya vie nye Semaya, eye eya viwo nye: Xatus, Yigeal, Bariax, Nearya kple Safat.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nearya viwoe nye, Elyoenai, Xizkiya kple Azrikam. Wole ame etɔ̃.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elyoenai viwoe nye: Hodavia, Elyasib, Pelaya, Akub, Yaxanan, Delaya kple Anani. Wole ame adrẽ.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Yuda viŋutsuwoe nye: Perez, Xezron, Kelubai, Xur kple Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Reaya, Sobal vi nye Yaxat tɔ́a, eye Yaxat nye Axumai kple Lahad tɔ́. Woawoe nye Zoreatitɔwo ƒe ƒometɔwo.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Asxur, Tekoa tɔ́ ɖe srɔ̃ eve: Xelea kple Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Naara dzi Axuzam, Xefer, Temeni kple Axastari nɛ. Woawoe nye Naara ƒe viŋutsuwo.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Xelea viŋutsuwoe nye: Zeret, Yizhar kple Etnan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Koz nye Anub, Hazobeba kple Harum vi, Axarxel ƒe ƒomeawo.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Bùbu nɔ Yabez ŋu wu nɔviawo. Nɔa tsɔ ŋkɔ Yabez nɛ gblɔ be: “Elabe mese veve le edzidzi me.”

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Yabez do gbe ɖa na Israel ƒe Mawu la be: “O yram, eye nàkeke nye anyigba ɖe enu. Nɔ kplim, eye nàkpɔ tanye tso nuveviwɔame me ale be magawɔm o!” Ale Mawu na nu si wòbia lae. Ƒomexexlẽfia bubuwo

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Kelub, Suxa nɔvi nye Mexir tɔ́a, ame si nye Eston tɔ́a.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Eston nye Bet-Rafa, Paseax kple Texina, ame si nye Naxas tɔ́a. Ame siawo nye Rexa-ŋutsuwo.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenaz viwoe nye Otniel kple Seraya. Otniel viŋutsuwoe nye Xatat kple Meonotai.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Meonotai nye Ofra tɔ́a eye Seraya nye Yoab tɔ́a, ame si ƒe dzidzimeviwo nye atikpalawo. Wonɔ Aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo ƒe Bali la me.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Kaleb, Yefune vi, viwoe nye: Iru, Ela kple Naam. Ela vie nye Kenaz.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodiya srɔ̃ Naham nɔvinyɔnu ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Garmitɔ si tsò Kegila kple Maxat ƒe dzidzimevi siwo nɔ Estemoa.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Simon viwoe nye: Amnon, Rina, Ben-Xanan kple Tilon. Yisi viwoe nye: Zoxet kple Ben-Zoxet. Sela ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Wonye zemelawo nɔ fia ƒe dɔ me, eye wonɔ Netaim kple Gedera. Simeon ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon viŋutsuwoe nye: Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Serax kple Saul.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Saul dzi Salum, eya vie nye Mibsam. Mibsam vie nye Misma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Misma viŋutsuwoe nye Xamuel; eya vie nye Zakur eya vie nye Simei.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: Bet-Markabot, Xazar-Susim, Bet-Birei kple Saarayim-duawo me. Woƒe duwoe nye esiawo va se ɖe David ƒe fiaɖuɣi.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Woƒe kɔƒe siwo kpe ɖe du siawo ŋu la woe nye: Etam, Ayin, Rimon, Toxen kple Asan. Wole kɔƒe atɔ̃.

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: Kɔƒe bubuwo gaƒo xlã du siawo yi ɖase Baal. Esiawoe nye woƒe nɔƒewo, eye ƒomexexlẽfia tɔxɛ le wo si.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ŋkɔwo woxlẽ la nye amegãwo le woƒe ƒomeawo me, eye woƒe aƒekɔwo keke ta ŋutɔ.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Wokaka ɖo ta Gedor, le bali si le afi ma la ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, be yewoaɖadi lãnyiƒe na yewoƒe lãhawo.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Wokpɔ lãnyiƒe dama nyuiwo le afi ma. Anyigba la keke le goawo katã me, eye wokpɔ ŋutifafa kple dzidzeme le afi ma.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Woɖawu Amalekitɔ siwo susɔ ɖe afi ma la, henɔ wo teƒe va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Ruben, Israel ƒe ŋgɔgbevi ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe ŋutinya: Ruben ye nye Israel ƒe ŋgɔgbevi, ke esi wòdɔ kple tɔ́a ƒe ahiãvi ta la, woxɔ ŋgɔgbevinyenye la le esi tsɔ na Israel vi, Yosef viwo. Eya ta womexlẽ eƒe dzidzime fia ɖe eƒe ŋgɔgbevinyenye nu o.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Ruben, Israel ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwoe nye: Henox, Palu, Xezron kple Karmi.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: Baal vie nye Beera, ame si Asiria-fia Tiglat-Pileser ɖe aboyoe; Beerae nye Ruben-to la ƒe tatɔ.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: Bela, Azaz vi, si nye Sema vi, ame si nye Yoel vi. Ƒome sia nɔ Aroer si keke ta tso Nebo yi ɖase Baal-Meon.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Wonɔ ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo, ɖo ta kegbegbe si le Frat-tɔsisi la ƒe go sia dzi elabe woƒe lãhawo dzi ɖe edzi le Gilead-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Le Saul ŋɔli la, Ruben-to la wɔ aʋa kple Hagritɔwo heɖu wo dzi. Ale woxɔ woƒe anyigba si le Gilead ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome la katã wòzu wo tɔ. Gad ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gad ƒe dzidzimeviwo nɔ Ruben ƒe dzidzimeviwo xa le Basan-nyigba si keke de Salxa la dzi.

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Yoel ye nye ƒome lolotɔ ƒe tatɔ. Safam kplɔe ɖo. Yanai kple Safat nɔ Basan.

english_verse: Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
translation_verse: Wo nɔvi siwo ma ɖe ƒome vovovowo me lae nye Mixael, Mesulam, Seba, Yorai, Yakan, Zia kple Eber; wole adrẽ.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Ame siawo nye Abixail ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Abixail nye Xuri vi. Eya nye Yaroax vi, Yaroax nye Gilead vi, Gilead nye Mixael vi, Mixael nye Yesisai vi, Yesisai nye Yaxdo vi, Yaxdo nye Buz vi.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Axi, Abdiel vi, si nye Guni ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi lae nye woƒe ƒomea ƒe tatɔ.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ame siawo katã ƒe ŋkɔ ɖi le Yotam, Yuda-fia kple Yerobeam, Israel-fia ŋɔli. Ɣedzeƒe toawo ƒe aʋakɔwo.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Woho aʋa ɖe Yetur, Natis kple Nodab siwo nye Hagritɔwo la ŋu.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Woɖo dzi ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye wodo gbe ɖa yɔe le aʋa la me. Mawu se woƒe ameyɔgbe la, eye wòkpe ɖe wo ŋu ale be woɖu Hagritɔwo kple dukɔ siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la dzi.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Wowu woƒe futɔ geɖewo, elabe Mawu wɔ aʋa la na wo. Wonɔ ameawo ƒe anyigba dzi va se ɖe esime woyi aboyo me. Manase-to afã si le ɣedzeƒe gome

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Manase ƒe to afã si le ɣedzeƒe gome la dzi sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ. Wokeke ta tso Basan yi Baal-Xermon kple Seir kple Xermon-to ŋu.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Woƒe ƒometatɔwoe nye Efer, Yisi, Eliel, Azriel, Yirmeya, Hodavia kple Yaxdiel. Wonye ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo kple kplɔla xɔŋkɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo me. Wokplɔ ɣedzeƒe gome toawo yi aboyo me

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ruben-to, Gad-to kple Manase ƒe to afã la meɖi anukware na wo tɔ́wo ƒe Mawu la o. Wowɔ ahasi kple dukɔ siwo Mawu nyà ɖa le wo ŋgɔ la ƒe mawuwo.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Ale Israel ƒe Mawu la na Asiria-fia Pul, si wogayɔna hã be Tiglat-Pileser la, tso ɖe Ruben, Gad kple Manase ƒe to afã la ŋu eye wòkplɔ wo dzo yi Xalax, Xaber kple Hara kpakple Gozan-tɔsisi la nu. Wogale afi ma va se ɖe egbe o.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kehat viwoe nye: Amram, Yizhar, Xebron kple Uziel.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amram viwoe nye Aron kple Mose; wo nɔvinyɔnue nye Miryam. Aron viwoe nye: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar kple Itamar.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Ke Yozadak yi aboyo me esi Aƒetɔ to Nebukadnezar dzi ɖe aboyo Yuda kple Yerusalem. Levi vi bubuawo

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Levi viwoe nye Gerson, Kehat kple Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gerson viwo ƒe ŋkɔwoe nye Libni kple Simei.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kehat viwoe nye Amram, Yizhar, Xebron kple Uziel.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Merari viwoe nye Maxeli kple Musi. Ame siawoe nye Levi-ƒomea ƒe tɔgbuiwo.

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: eya vie nye Taxat, eya vie nye Uriel, eya vie nye Uziya, eye eya vie nye Saul.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Elkana viwoe nye Amasai kple Aximot.

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: eya vie nye Eliab, eya vie nye Yexoram, eye eya vie nye Elkana.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samuel viwoe nye: Yoel, ŋgɔgbevia kple eyometɔ Abiya.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: eya vie nye Simea, eya vie nye Xagiya, eye eya vie nye Asaya.

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ame siwo David ɖo be woakpɔ hadzidzi dzi le Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔ la me esime nubablaɖaka la va ɖo afi ma la woawoe nye esiawo.

english_verse: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
translation_verse: Wodzia ha subɔa Mawu le agbadɔ la nu, va se ɖe esime Salomo tu Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔ la le Yerusalem, eye wosubɔna le ɖoɖo nu.

english_verse: Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
translation_verse: ame si nye Yaxat vi, ame si nye Gerson vi, ame si nye Levi vi.

english_verse: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
translation_verse: ame si nye Maxeli vi, ame si nye Musi vi, ame si nye Merari vi, ame si nye Levi vi.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Woɖo wo nɔvi Levi viwo, ne woawɔ dɔ sia dɔ le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me. Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Ke Aron kple via ŋutsuwo doa dzo ɖe numemevɔsamlekpui la kple lifivɔsamlekpui siwo woɖo hena kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe dɔwo katã la dzi be woalé avu na Israel le se siwo katã Mose, Mawu ƒe dɔla la de la nu.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz. The Towns for the Levites (Joshua
translation_verse: eya vie nye Zadok, eye eya vie nye Aximaaz. Levi viwo ƒe nɔƒewo

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Woƒe nɔƒewo le woƒe anyigba me le woƒe aƒetsotso nuwoe nye esiawo: Aron vi siwo tso Kehat viwo ƒe ƒome la me tɔe nye esi: Woawo dzie nudzidze la dze gbã.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ Xebron na wo ɖe Yuda-nyigba dzi kple lãnyiƒe si le eŋu godoo;

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: ke wotsɔ du la ƒe agble kple eƒe kɔƒewo na Kaleb, Yefune vi la.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Benyamin-to la me tɔwoe nye: Geba kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Alemet kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Anatot kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. Du siwo katã le woƒe ƒomea me la le du wui ene.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Wodzidze nu tsɔ du ewo na Kehat viwo, siwo nye to la ƒe ƒome susɔeawo la, tso toa ƒe afã, Manase ƒe to afã me.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Wona du wui atɔ̃ Gerson viwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu ɖe Isaxar-to, Aser-to, Naftali-to kple Manase-to afã me le Basan.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Wodzidze nu, tsɔ du wui eve na Merari viwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu ɖe Ruben-to, Gad-to kple Zebulon-to la me.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Ale Israel viwo tsɔ duawo kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo na Levi viwo.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Wogadzidze nu tsɔ du siwo ŋkɔwo woyɔ la na wo ɖe Yuda-to, Simeon-to kple Benyamin-to me.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ duwo na Kehat viwo ƒe ƒome aɖewo ɖe Efrayim-to la ƒe nutome.

english_verse: And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ Aner kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Bileam kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo na Kehat viwo ƒe ƒome susɔeawo ɖe Manase-to afã la me.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ teƒe tso Manase-to afã me na Gerson viwo: Golan le Basan kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Astarot kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Esiwo tso Naftali-to la me la woe nye: Kedes le Galilea kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Xamon kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Kiryataim kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Esiwo tso Zebulon-to la me wotsɔ na Merari vi susɔeawo la woe nye: Rimono kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Tabor kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Isaxar viŋutsuwoe nye: Tola, Pua, Yasub kple Simron; wole ame ene.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola viŋutsuwoe nye: Uzi, Refaya, Yeriel, Yaxmai, Yibsan kple Samuel. Ame siawoe nye Tola ƒe ƒome la ƒe tatɔwo. Wonye kalẽtɔwo le ƒomea me. Le David ŋɔli la, woƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe xexlẽme de ame akpe bla eve vɔ eve alafa ade.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Wo tɔ́ Efrayim fa na wo ŋkeke geɖe eye nɔviawo va fa akɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Uzi vie nye Yizraxya, eye eya viwoe nye: Mixael, Obadya, Yoel kple Yisiya; wole ame atɔ̃. Wo katã nye ƒometatɔwo.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofax ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Suax, Xarnefer, Sual, Beri, Yimra,

english_verse: In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of
translation_verse: Wo nɔvi siwo tso Isaxar-to la katã me la de aʋakalẽtɔ akpe bla enyi vɔ adrẽ ɖe woƒe ƒomexexlẽme nu. Benyamin ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Benyamin viŋutsuwoe nye: Bela, Bexer kple Yediael; wole ame etɔ̃.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bela viwoe nye: Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Yerimot kple Iri; ame atɔ̃ siwo nye ƒometatɔwo kple kalẽtɔ xɔŋkɔwo. Ðe dzidzimexexlẽfia nu la, woƒe dzidzimeviwo de ame akpe bla eve vɔ eve bla etɔ̃ vɔ ene.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bexer viŋutsuwoe nye: Zemira, Yoas, Eliezer, Elyoenai, Imri, Yeremot, Abiya, Anatot kple Alemet. Ame siawo katã nye Bexer viŋutsuwo.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efrayim vie nye Sutelax; Sutelax vie nye Bered, eye eya vie nye Taxat. Taxat vie nye Eleada, eye eya vie nye Taxat;

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Yadiael vie nye Bihan; Bilhan viwoe nye: Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Zetam, Tarsis kple Axisahar.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ulam vie nye Bedan. Ame siawo katã nye Gilead vi, Maxir vi ame si nye Manase tɔgbuiyɔvi la, ƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Supim kple Xupim nye Ir viwo, eye Xusim nye Axer vi. Naftali ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Naftali ƒe dzidzimeviwo nye: Yaxziel, Guni, Yezer kple Salum; wonye Bilha ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Manase ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manase viwoe nye Asriel kple Maxir. Eƒe ahiãvi si nye Aram-nyɔnu lae dzi wo. Maxir ye nye Gilead tɔ́.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Maxir ɖe srɔ̃ eve; ɖeka ŋkɔe nye Maaxa, si nye Xupim kple Supim nɔvinyɔnu; evelia ŋkɔe nye Zelofxad. Eya dzi nyɔnuviwo sɔŋ.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Maxir srɔ̃ Maaxa dzi viŋutsuvi eve, eye wòna ŋkɔ wo be Peres kple Seres. Peres viŋutsuwoe nye Ulam kple Rekem.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Gilead nɔvinyɔnu Hamolexet dzi Ishod, Abiezer kple Maxla.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Semida viwoe nye Axyan, Sixem, Likxi kple Aniam. Efrayim ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Taxat vie nye Zabad, eye eya vie nye Sutelax kple Ezer kpakple Elead. Ke Gatitɔ siwo nye anyigba dzi tɔwo la wu wo esime wova be woalé woƒe lãwo.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Esi wògadɔ kple srɔ̃a la, efɔ fu eye wodzi ŋutsuvi. Etsɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Beria, elabe dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ ɖe eƒe aƒe dzi.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Efrayim vinyɔnue nye Seera. Eyae tso Bet-Xoron Anyigbe kple Bet-Xeron Dzigbe kpakple Uzen-Seera.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efrayim viŋutsue nye Refax. Eya vie nye Resef, eya vie nye Telax; eya vie nye Taxan.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Woƒe anyigba kple nɔƒewoe nye Betel kple du siwo ƒo xlãe tso Naaran le ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo va se ɖe Gezer kple eŋu du siwo le ɣetoɖoƒe lɔƒo kple tso Sixem kple eŋu duwo me ɖaɖo Aya kple eŋu duwo me.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Manase ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe anyigbawoe nye: Bet-Sean, Taanax, Megido kple Dor kpakple wo ŋu duwo. Teƒe siawo katã nye Yosef, Israel ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe nɔƒe. Aser ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Aser viwoe nye: Yimna, Yisva, Yisvi, Beria kple wo nɔvinyɔnu Serax.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Beria viwoe nye Xeber kple Malkiel, ame si nye Birzayit tɔ́.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Xeber dzi Yaflet, Somer, Xotam kple wo nɔvinyɔnu Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Yaflet viŋutsuwoe nye: Pasax, Bimhal kple Asvat. Ame siawo nye Yaflet viwo.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Somer viwo nye: Axi, Roga, Xuba kple Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Nɔvia Helem viwoe nye: Zofax, Yimna, Seles kple Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Bezer, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Yitran kple Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Yeter ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Yefune, Pispa kple Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Ula ƒe dzidzimeviwo nye Arax, Xaniel kple Rizya.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Ame siawo katã nye Aser ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Wonye ƒometatɔwo, aʋawɔla kalẽtɔwo kple kpɔla xɔŋkɔwo. Aser ƒe dzidzimevi siwo ate ŋu ayi aʋa la de ame akpe bla eve vɔ ade.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Benyamin dzi Bela, eƒe ŋgɔgbevi. Asbel ye nye evelia, etɔ̃liae nye: Axrax,

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bela ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Adar, Gera, Abihud,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: Abisua, Naeman, Axoax,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: Gera, Sefufan kple Xuram.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Naeman, Axiya kple Gera. Wonye woƒe ƒometatɔwo le Geber. Ke woɖe aboyo wo yi Manaxat. Gera, ame si dzi Uza kple Axihud lae kplɔ wo yi aboyo mee.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Elpaal viwoe nye: Eber, Misam kple Semer, ame si tsò Ono kple Lod kpakple wo ŋu duwo. Benyamintɔ siwo nɔ Gat kple Ayalon

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Beria kple Sema nye Ayalontɔwo ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo eye wonyà Gatitɔwo wosí.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: Mixael, Yispa kple Yoxa, ame siwo nye Beria viwo. Benyamintɔ siwo nɔ Yerusalem

english_verse: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: Yismerai, Yizia kple Yobab; ame siawo nye Elpaal viwo.

english_verse: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
translation_verse: Adaya, Beraya kple Simrat; woawo nye Simei viwo.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: Yaaresya, Eliya kple Zixri; woawo nye Yeroxam viwo.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ame siawo nye woƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu, eye wonɔ Yerusalem. Benyamintɔ siwo nɔ Gibeon kple Yerusalem

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Ame si tsò Gibeon la nɔ Gibeon. Srɔ̃a ŋkɔ nye Maaxa.

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye Abdon eye eyometɔwoe nye: Zur, Kis, Baal, Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: Gedor, Axyo kple Zexer.

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: Miklot dzi Simea. Ame siawo hã nɔ wo nɔviwo gbɔ le Yerusalem. Fia Saul ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner dzi Kis, eye Kis dzi Saul, eye Saul dzi Yonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab kple Esbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Yonatan vie nye Merib-Baal, eye Merib-Baal dzi Mixa.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mixa viŋutsuwoe nye: Piton, Melex, Taxrea kple Axaz.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Axaz dzi Yoada eye Yoada dzi Alemet, Azmavet kple Zimri. Zimri dzi Moza.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu ade nɔ Azel si; woawoe nye: Azrikam, Boxru, Ismael, Searya, Obadya kple Xanan. Ame siawo katã nye Azel viwo.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Azel nɔvi Esek ƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye: Ulam, eveliae nye Yeus, eye etɔ̃liae nye Elifelet.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulam viwo nye asrafo kalẽtɔwo kple aŋutrɔdalawo. Viawo kple tɔgbuiyɔviawo sɔ gbɔ de ame alafa ɖeka bla atɔ̃. Ame siawo katã wonye Benyamin-to la me tɔwo.

english_verse: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.
translation_verse: Ame gbãtɔ siwo va nɔ wo nɔƒe le woƒe duawo me la woe nye Israel nunɔlawo, Levi viwo kple gbedoxɔa me dɔwɔlawo.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amewo tso Yuda-to, Benyamin-to, Efrayim-to kple Manase-to la me ɖanɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Adaya nye Yeroxam vi. Eyae nye Pasxur vi, eye eya nye Malkiya vi kple Masai, Adiel vi. Adiel nye Yaxzera vi, eyae nye Mesulam vi, eyae nye Mesilemit vi, eye eya nye Imer vi.

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawoe nye: Salum, Akub, Talmon, Axinam kple wo nɔviwo. Salum ye nye woƒe tatɔ.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Wonɔ fia ƒe agbo nu le ɣedzeƒe gome tsã; woawoe dzɔ Levi viwo ƒe asaɖa la ƒe agbo nu.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Salum, Kore vi si nye Ebyasaf ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi kple nɔviawo tso Korax-ƒome la mee kpɔa subɔsubɔ la dzi, eye wodzɔa agbo la nu abe ale si wo tɔgbuiwo nye Aƒetɔ ƒe asaɖa la ƒe mɔnudzɔlawo tsã ene.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Tsã la, Pinehas, Eleazar vi nye amegã ɖe wo nu, eye Aƒetɔ nɔ kplii.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Zaxarya, Meselemya vi hã nye agbonudzɔla le godoƒegbadɔ la nu.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawo ma ɖe akpa eneawo dzi: ɣedzeƒe, ɣetoɖoƒe, dzigbeme kple anyigbeme.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawo ƒe amegã ene siwo nye Levi viwo ya nɔa dɔ me ɣe sia ɣi, eye woawo kpɔa Mawu ƒe xɔ la kple nudzraɖoƒewo dzi.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Wotsia Mawu ƒe xɔ la gbɔ dɔna, elabe dzɔlawo wonye, eye woƒe dɔdeasi wònye be woaʋu xɔ la ŋdi sia ŋdi. Levi vi bubuawo

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ aɖewo ƒe dɔe nye be woakpɔ subɔsubɔ dɔwɔnuawo dzi, axlẽ wo kpɔ hafi woawɔ wo ŋudɔ, eye woagaxlẽ wo kpɔ ne wowɔ vɔ.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo vi aɖewo tsakaa atike ʋeʋẽewo wɔa ami ʋeʋẽe.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Levitɔ Matitya, ame si nye Salum ƒe ŋgɔgbevi tso Korax-ƒome me lae kpɔa nu siwo wotɔna le agba me la dzi.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Wo nɔvi siwo nye Kehat viwo la kpɔa vɔsabolo la dzi. Woawoe wɔnɛ na dzudzɔgbe sia dzudzɔgbe.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Levi ƒe dzidzimevi aɖewo hã nye hadzilawo le mawuxɔ la me. Womegawɔa dɔ bubu aɖeke o, elabe wole dɔ dzi zã kple keli.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Ame siawo katã nye ƒometatɔwo na Levi ƒe dzidzimeviwo ɖe woƒe ƒomeawo nu. Wo katã wonɔ Yerusalem. Fia Saul ƒe ƒome

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Miklot dzi Simeam, eye wo kple wo nɔviwo nɔ woƒe ƒometɔwo kasa le Yerusalem.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Yeuel ame si tsò Gibeon-dua la nɔ Gibeon. Srɔ̃a ŋkɔe nye Maaxa.

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye Abdon, eye eyometɔwoe nye: Zur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: Gedor, Axyo, Zaxarya kple Miklot.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Ner dzi Kis, Kis dzi Saul, eye Saul dzi Yonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab kple Esbaal.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu ade nɔ Azel si. Wo ŋkɔwoe nye: Azrikam, Boxru, Ismael, Searya, Obadya kple Xanan.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Filistitɔwo wɔ aʋa kple Israelviwo, eye Israelviwo sí le wo nu. Wo dometɔ geɖewo tsi aʋa le Gilboa-toa dzi.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Ale Saul ku elabe mewɔ nuteƒe na Aƒetɔ o, eye melé eƒe sededewo me ɖe asi o. Gawu la, ede ŋɔliyɔla gbɔ ɖabia nu,

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Filistitɔwo nya Saul kple viawo ɖe nu, eye wowu Yonatan, Abinadab kple Malkisua siwo nye Saul viwo.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Esi aʋa la nu sẽ ɖe edzi la, futɔwo ƒe aŋutrɔ va te Saul, eye wòxɔ abi.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Eya ta Saul gblɔ na eƒe aʋawɔnutsɔla be: “Ðe wò yi ƒo ɖem, ne bolobolotɔ siawo nagava ɖi gbɔm o.” Ke eƒe aʋawɔnutsɔla la gbe elabe ele vɔvɔ̃m ŋutɔ. Ale Saul tsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe yi tu ɖi, eye wòdze enu.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Esi aʋawɔnutsɔla la kpɔ be Saul ku la, eya hã dze eƒe yi nu heku.

english_verse: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.
translation_verse: Ale Saul ŋutɔ kple via ŋutsu etɔ̃awo kpakple eƒe ƒomea katã tsrɔ̃ ɖekae.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Esi Israelvi siwo le balia me kpɔ be aʋawɔlawo sí, eye Saul kple viawo ku la, wosí, gblẽ woƒe duwo ɖi, eye Filistitɔwo va xɔ duawo henɔ wo me.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke evea gbe, esi Filistitɔwo va be yewoaɖe nu le ame tsiaʋawo ŋu la, wokpɔ be Saul kple viawo ku ɖe Gilboa-toa dzi.

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: Woɖe nu le eŋu, eye wotsɔ eƒe ta kple eƒe aʋawɔnuwo ɖo ɖe Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi godoo hetsɔ ɖe gbeƒã dzidzɔnya la na woƒe mawuwo kple dukɔ blibo la.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ eƒe aʋawɔnuwo ɖada ɖe woƒe mawuƒe me, eye wotsɔ eƒe ta ku nu ɖe Dagon ƒe xɔ me.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Yabes-Gileadtɔwo katã se nu siwo katã Filistitɔwo wɔ Saul.

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Tete woƒe kalẽtɔwo katã bla akpa, eye woyi ɖatsɔ Saul kple viawo ƒe kukuawo va Yabes. Woɖi woƒe ƒuwo ɖe ati aɖe te le Yabes, eye wotsi nu dɔ ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: ke mebia nu le Aƒetɔ ya gbɔ o. Eya ta Aƒetɔ wui, eye wòna fiaɖuƒe la yi David, Yese vi la si me.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: Yebusitɔwo gblɔ na David be: “Mage ɖe afi sia o.” Gake David xɔ Zion ƒe mɔ́ si nye David ƒe du la.

english_verse: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives,
translation_verse: Israel-dukɔ blibo la va kpe ta ɖe David gbɔ le Xebron hegblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, nɔvi kpamkpam míenye.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Ale Israel-me tsitsiwo katã va fia la gbɔ le Xebron, eye David bla nu kple wo le Xebron le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Eyome wosi ami na David heɖoe fiae ɖe Israel-dukɔ katã nu le Aƒetɔ ƒe nya si wògblɔ to Samuel dzi la nu.

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: David gblɔ be: “Ame si tre Yebusitɔwo sisi la lanye tatɔ kple aʋakplɔla.” Tete Yoab, Zeruya vi kpe aʋa kple wo gbã ale wòzu tatɔ.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: David ƒe aʋawɔla kalẽtɔwo ƒe tatɔ siwo kpe ɖe Israel blibo la ŋu, eye wonɔ megbe nɛ sesĩe le eƒe fiaɖuɖu me la woe nye esiawo. Woawoe wɔ ɖeka tsɔ David ɖo fiae ɖe Israel nu abe ale si Aƒetɔ la gblɔe ene.

english_verse: Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town.
translation_verse: David kple Israel-dukɔ blibo la ho yi Yerusalem si woyɔna be Yebus. Afi mae Yebusitɔ, siwo nye anyigba la dzi tɔwo le.

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: David nɔ mɔ́ la me, eya ta woyɔnɛ be David ƒe du.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: David ƒe ŋusẽ le akɔ trim ɖe edzi, elabe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokpɔla la li kplii. David ƒe asrafo kalẽtɔwo (Sam II,

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Eya kee wu Egipte-ŋutsu kako, si kɔ meta eve hã. Akplɔ si didi abe abaladoti ene la le Egiptetɔ la si. Ke eya tsɔ atizɔti ɖe asi, zɔ ɖe ŋutsua dzi, eye wòdu akplɔ la le esi, tsɔ wui.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: David gblɔ be: “Aa! Ame aɖe makpɔ tsi tso vudo si le Betlehem-gbo la nu me nam mano fifia oa?”

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: David ƒe aʋakalẽtɔwo kple wo ŋu nyawo nye esi: Yasobeam, Xaxmoni vie nye Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo ƒe amegã. Eyae kɔ eƒe akplɔ si nu ame alafa etɔ̃ tsi le aʋakpekpe ɖeka me la ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Ame evelia le Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo dome nye Eleazar Dodo, Axoxitɔ la vi.

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: eya kple David yi ɖanɔ te ɖe agblea titina. Wonyà Filistitɔwo ɖa le agblea me, wu wo. To esia me Aƒetɔ na woɖu dzi keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Asrafoawo ƒe amegã bla etɔ̃awo dometɔ etɔ̃ va David gbɔ le agakpe la gbɔ le Abulam-agado la me, esime Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Refaim-bali la me.

english_verse: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress,
translation_verse: David nɔ mɔ́ la me, eye Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Betlehem.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: wògblɔ be: “Nye Mawu nete esia ɖa xaa tso gbɔnye. Ðe mano ŋutsu siawo ƒe ʋu si nye woƒe agbe la? Wotsɔ woƒe agbe ke ɖaku tsia vɛ. Ale wògbe enono.” Kalẽtɔ etɔ̃awoe wɔ esia.

english_verse: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed
translation_verse: Abisai, Yoab nɔvi ye nye Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo ƒe tatɔ. Eyae tsɔ eƒe akplɔ wɔ aʋa kple ame alafa etɔ̃, eye wòɖu wo dzi. Esia ta wòxɔ ŋkɔ le Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo dome.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Eyae xɔ ŋkɔ wu le Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo dome, eye wòzu woƒe amegã, negbe ɖeko mede Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo nu o.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Yehoyada vi Benaya tso Kabzeel nye asrafo kalẽtɔ aɖe, si wɔ nu tsu geɖe. Eyae wu Moab-ŋutsu wɔadã eve. Eyae ɖawu dzata le vudo me esime tsikpe le dzadzam la.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Nu siawoe Benaya Yehoyada vi la wɔ, eya ta eya hã xɔ ŋkɔ le Aʋawɔla Etɔ̃awo dome.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Wode bubu eŋu le Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo dome, negbe ɖeko mede Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo nu o. David tsɔe ɖo asrafo siwo dzɔa eŋu la nu.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: Wonye aŋutrɔdalawo; wotea ŋu daa aŋutrɔ eye wodaa kpe hã. Wowɔa ɖusi kple mia. Wonye Saul ƒe ƒometɔwo tso Benyamin-to la me.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Amewo tso Gad-to la me va David gbɔ, le mɔ́ me le gbedadaƒo la. Wonye aʋakalẽtɔ nuteƒekpɔla siwo bi le akpoxɔnu kple akplɔ ŋudɔwɔwɔ me. Woƒe mo ɖi vɔvɔ̃ abe dzata tɔ ene. Woƒe afɔ tsɔna le to dzi abe zi ene.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Ame siawo nye asrafomegãwo. Wo dometɔ gblɔetɔ ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe ame alafa ɖeka nu, eye sesẽtɔ ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe ame akpe ɖeka nu.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Woawoe tsò Yordan le ɣleti gbãtɔ le ƒè la me , esime tsia ɖɔ gba go. Wode zi balia me nɔlawo katã me le ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, eye wosí. Fia David ŋu nɔla bubuwo tso Benyamin kple Yuda toawo me

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Amewo tso Benyamin ƒe dzidzimeviwo kple Yuda ƒe dzidzimeviwo dome va David gbɔ le mɔ́ la me.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Edo go yi ɖakpe wo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Nenye ŋutifafa me mieva le, be yewoakpe ɖe ŋunye la, ekema mawɔ ɖeka kpli mi tso dzime. Ke ne ɖe mieva be yewoadem asi na nye futɔwo, le esime nyemewɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke o la, mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la nekpɔe ne wòaka mo!”

english_verse: Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag.
translation_verse: Asrafo aɖewo tso Manase-to la me va David dzi, esime eya kple Filistitɔwo ho aʋa ɖe Saul ŋu. Ke womeyi aʋa la kpli wo o, elabe Filistitɔwo ƒe dumegãwo na wotrɔ dzo. Wogblɔ be: “Ne David trɔ ɖade eƒe aƒetɔ Saul dzi la, ekema míaƒe tae nye ema zu Saul tɔ.”

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Esi wònye aʋakalẽtɔwo kple aʋakplɔlawo wonye ta la, wokpe ɖe David ŋu le aʋakɔ la kpɔkplɔ me.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Azɔ ame siwo te ɖe wo ŋu ɖase Isaxar, Zebulon kple Naftali nutowo me la hã tsɔ nuɖuɖu vovovowo ɖe tedzi, kposɔ, tedzisɔ kple nyitsuwo dzi vɛ: Wotsɔ wɔ, gbotitsetsebolo, waintsetsebolo, wain, nyitsu kple alẽ geɖe hã vɛ elabe dzidzɔ nɔ Israel.

english_verse: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.
translation_verse: Ame siawo katã bla akpa na aʋawɔwɔ. Wova Xebron kple tameɖoɖo kplikpaa be yewoaɖo David fiae ɖe Israel blibo la nu. Taɖodzinu ɖeka siae nɔ Israeltɔ bubuawo katã hã si.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Wonɔ David gbɔ ŋkeke etɔ̃, ɖu nu, no nu elabe wo nɔviwo dzra ɖo ɖe wo ŋu nyuie.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: Tete David kple Israel bliboa yi Baala, si nye Kiryat-Yearim le Yuda, be woaɖakɔ Mawu Aƒetɔ, ame si nɔa kerubiwo tame le teƒe si wosubɔnɛ le la ƒe aɖaka la.

english_verse: Some time later, David talked with his army commanders,
translation_verse: David de adaŋu kple eƒe asrafomegã siwo nye akpewo kple alafawo ƒe kpɔlawo kpakple dumegã bubuawo katã.

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: David vɔ̃ na Mawu gbe ma gbe eye wògblɔ be: “Ale ke matsɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ava gbɔnyee?”

english_verse: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
translation_verse: Nya sia dze ameha bliboa ŋu, eya ta wolɔ̃ be yewoawɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: David gathered everyone from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Ale David ƒo ƒu Israel blibo la, tso Sixor le Egipte ɖase Xamat be woaɖakɔ nubablaɖaka la tso Kiryat-Yearim vɛ.

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: Wotsɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ɖo tasiaɖam yeye dzi tso Abinadab ƒeme, eye Uza kple Axyo le tasiaɖam la kplɔm.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: David kple Israel blibo la le ɣe ɖum le Mawu ŋkume kple woƒe ŋusẽ katã ɖe hadzidzi, saŋku, kasaŋku, asiʋui kple gakogoe kpakple kpẽwo ŋu.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Esi wova ɖo Kidon ƒe lugbɔƒe la, Uza do asi ɖa be yealé aɖaka la elabe nyiawo kli nu.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖe Uza ŋu, eye woƒoe ƒu anyi elabe eka asi aɖaka la ŋu. Uza ku ɖe Mawu ŋkume le afi ma.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Eve David be Aƒetɔ ɖe dziku ɖe Uza ŋu, eye woyɔa teƒe ma be Perez-Uza va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Ale David metsɔ aɖaka la va eɖokui gbɔ le David ƒe du la me o, ke boŋ ena wokɔe yi Obed-Edom, Gat vi la ƒemee.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe aɖaka la tsi Obed-Edom ƒeme ɣleti etɔ̃, eye Aƒetɔ yra eƒe aƒe kple eƒe nuwo katã.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Ale woho yi Baal-Perazim, eye David si Filistitɔwo le afi ma. David gblɔ be: “Mawu to nye asi dzi dze nye futɔwo abe ale si tsiɖɔɖɔ gbãa goe ene!” Eya ta woyɔa teƒe ma be Baal-Perazim.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: David wɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe gbe dzi eye wòɖu Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ la dzi tso Gibeon ɖase Gezer.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Xiram Tiro- fia, dɔ ame ɖe David kple sedertiwo, xɔtulawo kple atikpalawo be woatu xɔ nɛ.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: David gaɖe srɔ̃ wo le Yerusalem eye wògadzi viŋutsu kple vinyɔnuwo fũu.

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: David ŋkɔ ɖi de anyigbawo katã dzi, eye Aƒetɔ de vɔvɔ̃ dukɔwo katã me ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Esi Filistitɔwo se be wosi ami na David wòzu fia ɖe Israel bliboa nu la, wo katã ho be yewoayi aɖadii. David see ale eya hã ho yi wo kpe ge.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Azɔ la Filistitɔwo va kaka ɖe Refaim-bali la me le nu gblẽm.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: Tete David bia nu Mawu be: “Maho aʋa ɖe Filistitɔwo ŋua? Àtsɔ wo ade asi nama?” Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ho yi, eye matsɔ wo ade asi na wò.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Filistitɔwo gblẽ woƒe mawuwo ɖe afi ma eye David ɖe gbe wotɔ dzo wo.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: David gabia nu Mawu, eye Mawu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Mègato wo yome o, ke boŋ trɔ naɖatso wo le klẽtiawo kasa.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Ne èse afɔzi le klẽtiawo me ko la, ho aʋa elabe meho dze ŋgɔwò be maɖu Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ la dzi.”

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: David tu xɔwo na eɖokui ɖe David ƒe du la me, eye wòwɔ nɔƒe na Mawu ƒe aɖaka la hetu agbadɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: David ƒo Israel blibo la nu ƒu ɖe Yerusalem, ne woaɖakɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aɖaka la ava teƒe si wodzra ɖo nɛ.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: Eƒo Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo kple Levi viwo nu ƒu siwo nye:

english_verse: Uriel, the leader of the Kohath clan, and
translation_verse: Kehat ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Uriel kple nɔviawo, ame alafa ɖeka bla eve.

english_verse: Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and
translation_verse: Gerson ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Yoel kple nɔviawo, ame alafa ɖeka bla etɔ̃.

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: Elizafan ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Semaya kple nɔviawo, ame alafa eve.

english_verse: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and
translation_verse: Xebron ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Eliel kple nɔviawo, ame bla enyi.

english_verse: Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with
translation_verse: Uziel ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Aminadab kple nɔviawo, ame alafa ɖeka wui eve.

english_verse: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.
translation_verse: David yɔ nunɔlawo Zadok kple Abyatar kple Levi viwo, Uriel, Asaya, Yoel, Semaya, Eliel kple Aminadab, vɛ.

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: elabe esi mienɔ anyi gbe ma gbe o tae Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la do dziku ɖe mía ŋu le esi míebia gbee abe ale si dze ene o ta.”

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Ale nunɔlaawo kple Levi viawo kɔ̀ wo ɖokui ŋu be yewoaɖakɔ Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe aɖaka la vɛ.

english_verse: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
translation_verse: Levi viwo tsɔ ati kɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ɖe abɔta abe ale si Aƒetɔ ɖo na wo to Mose dzi be woawɔe la ene.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: David gagblɔ na Levi viwo ƒe tatɔwo hã be woana wo teviwo natsɔ saŋkuwo, kasaŋkuwo kple gakogoewo, siwo nye hadzinuwo la anɔ dzidzɔhawo dzim bobobo.

english_verse: Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah. Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer. The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo: Sebanya, Yosafat, Netaneel, Amasai, Zaxarya, Benaya kple Eliezer, nye kpẽkulawo le Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ. Obed-Edom kple Yexiya hã nye agbonudzɔlawo na aɖaka la. Nubablaɖaka la kɔkɔ va Yerusalem (Sam II,

english_verse: David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Ale David kple Israel ƒe ame tsitsiwo kpakple kplɔla siwo kpɔa asrafo akpewo dzi la yi ɖakɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la tso Obed-Edom ƒeme vɛ kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu ve Levi viwo nu wokɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aɖaka la ta la, wotsɔ nyitsu adrẽ kple agbo adrẽ sa vɔe.

english_verse: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.
translation_verse: David ŋutɔ, Levi vi siwo tsɔ aɖaka la, hadzilawo kple Kenanya, agbatsɔlawo ƒe tatɔ, wo katã wodo dziwui si wotsɔ aklala biɖibiɖi tɔe la eye David do aklala biɖibiɖi kɔmewu ɖe etɔ dzi.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Ale Israel blibo la le aseye tsom, le kpẽ kple dze kum, le gakogoewo ƒom, eye wole saŋku kple kasaŋkuwo ƒom sesĩe hekɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la gbɔnae.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Esi Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la va ɖo David ƒe dua me la, Mixal, Saul vinyɔnu do mo ɖa kpɔ David to fesre nu, wòle ɣe ɖum, le kpo tim, eye wòdo vloe le eƒe dzime.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: Esi David sa numemevɔ kple ŋutifafavɔ la vɔ la, eyra dukɔ la le Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ me,

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: eye wòma abolo, ayedetsetsebolo kple waintsetsebolo ɖekaɖeka na Israelviwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: David ɖe subɔlawo tso Levi viwo dome be woanɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ, ayɔ Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ada akpe nɛ, eye woakafui.

english_verse: Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals,
translation_verse: Asaf nye wo kplɔla, eye Zaxarya nye eƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ. Yeiel, Semiramot, Yexiel, Matitya, Eliab, Benaya, Obed-Edom kple Yeiel nye saŋku kple kasaŋkuƒolawo, eye Asaf ŋutɔ nye gakogoeƒola.

english_verse: and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest. David's Song of Praise (Psalms
translation_verse: Benaya kple Yexaziel nanɔ kpẽ kum enuenu le Mawu ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: We must never forget his agreement and his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku eƒe nubabla kple nya si wògblɔ, hena dzidzime akpewo la dzi tegbee.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Israel, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O, eƒe dɔla Israel ƒe dzidzimeviwo, O, mi Yakob viwo, mi eƒe ame tiatiawo.

english_verse: That same day, David instructed Asaph and his relatives for the first time to sing these praises to the Lord:
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbee nye zi gbãtɔ si David tsɔ akpedahadzidzi na Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔ de asi na Asaf kple nɔviawo. Akpedaha (Ps

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, miyɔ eŋkɔ. Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Midzi ha nɛ, midzi kafukafuha nɛ. Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe nukudɔwo katã.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ƒo adegbee. Ame siwo katã dia Aƒetɔ la, nedzɔ dzi!

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power. Worship him always.
translation_verse: Midi Aƒetɔ kple eƒe ŋusẽ, midi eŋkume nɔnɔ enuenu.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nukunu siwo wòwɔ, eƒe dzesiwo kple nyametsotso siwo do le enu la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Eyae nye Aƒetɔ, míaƒe Mawu la, eyae drɔ̃a ʋɔnu xexea me katã.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: “Wòe matsɔ Kanaan-nyigba ana, ne wòanye miaƒe domenyinu.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be woƒe xexlẽme nɔ sue womede naneke o, eye wonye amedzrowo le anyigba la dzi,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: le tsatsam tso dukɔ me yi dukɔ me, tso fiaɖuƒe ɖeka gbɔ yi dukɔ bubu gbɔ hã la,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: meɖe mɔ ame aɖeke te wo ɖe anyi o. Eka mo na fiawo gɔ̃ hã le wo ta.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Ebe: “Migaka asi nye amesiaminawo ŋu o, eye migawɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke nye gbeƒãɖelawo o!”

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Anyigbawo katã, midzi ha na Aƒetɔ. Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe xɔname, tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Miƒo nu le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ŋu le dukɔwo dome; mixlẽ eƒe nukudɔwo fia le anyigba dzi tɔwo katã dome.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ tri akɔ, eye wòdze be woakafui geɖe ŋutɔ. Vɔvɔ̃ le eŋu wu mawuwo katã.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Elabe dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo katã la, nu dzodzrowo ko wonye; ke Aƒetɔ ye wɔ dziƒowo.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Bubu kple atsyɔ̃ le eŋu, ŋusẽ kple dzidzɔ le enɔƒe.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe ƒomeawo katã, mitsɔ bubu kple ŋusẽ na Aƒetɔ. Ẽ, Aƒetɔ ye miatsɔe na!

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple. Worship the Lord, majestic and holy.
translation_verse: Mide bubu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ ŋu, miva eŋkume kple nunanawo! Mitsɔ kɔkɔenyenye ɖo atsyɔ̃, ne miasubɔ Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble!” The world stands firm, never to be shaken.
translation_verse: Anyigba blibo la nedzo nyànyanya le eŋkume, xexea me li ke sesĩe; maʋã gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! And announce to the nations, “The Lord is King!”
translation_verse: Dziƒowo nekpɔ dzidzɔ, anyigba netso aseye, eye woagblɔ le dukɔwo dome be, “Aƒetɔ ye nye fia!”

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all of its creatures and the fields to rejoice with all of their crops.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme neɖe gbe, agblewo kple wo me nuwo nedzɔ dzi.

english_verse: Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth.
translation_verse: Azɔ avemetiwo adzi dzidzɔha le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, elabe eva be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea me.

english_verse: Praise the Lord because he is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, elabe eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Say to him, “Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Migblɔ hã be: “Mawu míaƒe Xɔnametɔ, ɖe mí loo! Ƒo mía nu ƒu, eye nàɖe mí le dukɔwo si me, ne míada akpe na wò, akafu wò ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la, eye míaƒo adegbe be wòe míekafuna.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever.” After David finished, the people shouted, “Amen! Praise the Lord!” David Appoints Worship Leaders at Jerusalem and Gibeon
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me!” Tete dukɔ blibo la ɖo eŋu be: “Neva eme!”, eye wokafu Aƒetɔ. Mawu subɔsubɔ le Yerusalem kple Gibeon

english_verse: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.
translation_verse: David tsɔ Asaf kple nɔviawo ɖo Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ le afi ma, ne woasubɔ ɖe ɖoɖo si wowɔ na ŋkeke sia ŋkeke nu.

english_verse: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon.
translation_verse: David gblẽ nunɔla Zadok kple nɔvia nunɔlawo ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe nɔƒe si le vɔsaƒe si le Gibeon la nu,

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: be woasa vɔ na Aƒetɔ le numemevɔsamlekpuia dzi ɖaa ŋdi kple fiẽ, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe se si Aƒetɔ de na Israel la me la ene.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe ame siawo ŋu la, wogaɖe Heman kple Yedutun kpakple ame tɔxɛ bubu siwo dzi wotɔ asii la be woanɔ akpe dam na Aƒetɔ elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ kpẽwo, gakogoewo kple Mawu ƒe hadzinuwo na Heman kple Yedutun be woatsɔ na hadzilawo, eye Yedutun viwo nye agbonudzɔlawo.

english_verse: After that, everyone went home, and David went home to his family.
translation_verse: Esiawo megbe la, ame sia ame dzo yi eƒeme, eye David hã trɔ yi ɖayra eƒemetɔwo.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Azɔ David le eƒe fiasã me. Egblɔ na gbeƒãɖela Natan be: “Kpɔ ɖa, nye la, mele sedertixɔ me; ke Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka ya le avɔgbadɔ me.”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: Ke esia gɔ̃ hã la, nu tsɛ aɖe ko wònye na wò, O Mawu. Ègado nu si nàva wɔ na nye, wò dɔla sia ƒe ƒomea gbe aɖe gbe ƒe ŋugbe. O Aƒetɔ Mawu, èbum bubume gã aɖee.

english_verse: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: “Yi ɖagblɔ na nye dɔla David be, ‘Aƒetɔ be: Menye wòe atu xɔ nam manɔ eme o.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Elabe tso gbe si gbe mekplɔ Israel dzoe va se ɖe egbe sia la, nyemenɔ xɔ me kpɔ o, ɖeko matso agbadɔ me ayi agbadɔ me, atso nɔƒe ayi nɔƒe.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Menɔ kple Israel-dukɔa le afi sia afi. Ðe mebia Israel ɖela siwo metia be woanɔ nye dukɔa nu la dometɔ aɖe kpɔ be: ‘Nu ka tae mètu sedertixɔ nam o mahã?’

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: Afi sia afi si nèyi la menɔ kpli wò, eye menyà wò futɔwo katã ɖa le ŋgɔwò. Mena nèxɔ ŋkɔ abe anyigba dzi fia gãwo ke ene.

english_verse: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did
translation_verse: Mana nɔƒe nye dukɔ Israel, afi si wòanɔ aɖe dzi ɖi, eye ame aɖeke magaɖe fu na wo o, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo mage ɖe wo dome atsrɔ̃ wo abe tsã,

english_verse: when I let judges rule my people, and I will keep your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that like you, your descendants will be kings.
translation_verse: esi meɖo ɖelawo na nye dukɔ Israel ene o. Mabɔbɔ wò futɔwo katã ɖe anyi. Gawu la, mele egblɔm na wò be Aƒetɔ le xɔ tu ge na wò.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Ne wò agbenɔŋkekewo de be nàyi tɔgbuiwòwo gbɔ la, ekema maɖo wò dzidzimevi si tso wò ŋutɔ viwòwo dome la, yowòme, eye mana eƒe fiaɖuƒe nali ke.

english_verse: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Manye tɔ́a, eye eya anye vinye. Nyemadzudzɔ enu veve abe ale si mewɔ ame si do ŋgɔ na wò la ene o,

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: ke boŋ mana wòali ke ɖe nye aƒeme kple nye fiaɖuƒea nu tegbee, eye eƒe fiazikpui ali ke tegbee.’ ”

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Natan yi ɖagblɔ nya siawo katã kple ŋutega blibo la na David pɛpɛpɛ. David do gbe ɖa da akpe na Mawu (Sam II,

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Wò ŋutɔ ènya nye wò dɔla. Nya ka nye David magagblɔ akpe ɖe bubu si nède ŋunye la ŋu? Elabe ènya wò dɔla nyuie.
