translation_verse: Ale Salomo wu Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la kple fiasã la nu, eye wòwɔ nu sia nu si wòdi be yeawɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe la me vɔ pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream and said: I heard your prayer, and I have chosen this temple as the place where sacrifices will be offered to me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖe eɖokui fia Salomo le zã me, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Mese wò gbedodoɖa, eye metia teƒe sia ne wòanye afi si woasa vɔ nam le.

english_verse: Suppose I hold back the rain or send locusts to eat the crops or make my people suffer with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ne mexe dziƒo nu, eye tsi megale dzadzam o, ne meɖe gbe na ʋetsuviwo be woava gblẽ nu le anyigba dzi, ne meɖo dɔ vɔ̃ ɖe nye dukɔ la me,

english_verse: because it belongs to me, and this is where I will be worshiped forever. I will never stop watching over it.
translation_verse: Azɔ metia xɔ sia, eye mekɔ̀ eŋu be wòanye afi si woasubɔm le tegbee. Ẽ, nye ŋku kple nye dzi anɔ afi ma ŋu ɖaasi.

english_verse: Your father David obeyed me, and now, Solomon, you must do the same. Obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ne ènɔ agbe nyui le ŋkunye me abe tɔ́wò David ene, eye nèwɔ se siwo katã mede na wò dzi helé nye ɖoɖowo kple kɔnuwo me ɖe asi la,

english_verse: and I will keep my solemn promise to him that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: ekema mana wò fiazikpui la nali ke abe ale si mebla nu kple tɔ́wò David, gblɔ nɛ ene be: ‘Wò ame siwo anɔ Israel-fiazikpui la dzi la nu matso akpɔ o!’

english_verse: But if you or any of the people of Israel disobey my laws or start worshiping foreign gods,
translation_verse: “Ke ne miegbugbɔ le yonyeme, eye mieɖe asi le nye ɖoɖo kple nye se siwo mede na mi la ŋu, eye mieyi ɖasubɔ mawu bubuwo hede ta agu na wo la,

english_verse: I will pull you out of this land I gave you. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped, so that people everywhere will think it is only a joke and will make fun of it.
translation_verse: ekema maho mi ɖa le nye anyigba si metsɔ na mi la dzi. Maɖe xɔ sia, si ŋu mekɔ̀ be woasubɔm le eme la hã ɖa le nye ŋku ta, eye mawɔe wòazu hamelo kple alɔmeɖenu le dukɔwo katã dome.

english_verse: This temple is now magnificent. But when these things happen, everyone who walks by it will be shocked and will ask, “Why did the Lord do such a terrible thing to his people and to this temple?”
translation_verse: Ekema, xɔ sia, si xɔ ŋkɔ fifia la awɔ mo yaa na ame sia ame si va yina la, eye wòabia be: ‘Nu ka ta Aƒetɔ wɔ anyigba sia kple xɔ sia ale?’

english_verse: After that, Solomon had his workers rebuild the towns that Hiram had given him. Then Solomon sent Israelites to live in those towns.
translation_verse: egbugbɔ du siwo Xuram tsɔ nɛ la tso, eye wòna Israelviwo nɔ wo me.

english_verse: Solomon attacked and captured the town of Hamath-Zobah.
translation_verse: Salomo ho yi ɖaxɔ Xamat kple Zoba nutowo me.

english_verse: He ordered his workers to build the town of Tadmor in the desert and some towns in Hamath where he could keep his supplies.
translation_verse: Etso Tadmor-du ɖe gbedadaƒo, eye wògbugbɔ nudzraɖoƒedu siwo katã le Xamat-nutome la tso.

english_verse: He strengthened Upper Beth-Horon and Lower Beth-Horon by adding walls and gates that could be locked.
translation_verse: Etso Dzigbe Bet-Xoron kple Anyigbe Bet-Xoron wonye du sesẽ siwo woɖo gli ƒo xlã, eye agbo kple gameti le wo nu.

english_verse: He did the same thing to the town of Baalath and to the cities where he kept supplies, chariots, and horses. Solomon ordered his workers to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere else in his kingdom.
translation_verse: Salomo tso Baalat-du kple eƒe nudzraɖoƒedu siwo katã nɔ esi kple esiwo me tasiaɖamwo kple sɔdolawo katã nɔ kpakple teƒe siwo katã wòdi be yeatu ɖe Yerusalem, Lebanon kple anyigba siwo katã dzi wòɖu fia ɖo la.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the part of Jerusalem called David's City to her new palace that Solomon had built. The sacred chest had been kept in David's City, which made his palace sacred, and so Solomon's wife could no longer live there.
translation_verse: Salomo kplɔ srɔ̃a, Egipte Fiagã ƒe vinyɔnu tso David ƒe du la me va aƒe si wòtso nɛ la me, elabe egblɔ be: “Srɔ̃nye aɖeke manɔ David Israel-fia ƒeme o, elabe teƒe si Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la va la, teƒe kɔkɔe wònye.”

english_verse: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Salomo sa numemevɔ na Aƒetɔ le vɔsamlekpui si wòɖi ɖe akpata la ŋgɔ la dzi.

english_verse: He followed the requirements that Moses had given for sacrifices offered on the Sabbath, on the first day of each month, the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Abe ale si Mose ƒe se la ɖoe ɖi ene la, esaa vɔ le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke, dzudzɔgbewo, dzinu yeyewo kple ƒea ƒe Ŋkeke Nyui ɖoɖi etɔ̃awo dzi. Esiawoe nye: Abolo Maʋamaʋã Ŋkeke Nyui, Kwasiɖawo ƒe ŋkekenyui kple Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui.

english_verse: Solomon then assigned the priests and the Levites their duties at the temple, and he followed the instructions that his father, the man of God, had given him. Some of the Levites were to lead music and help the priests in their duties, and others were to guard the temple gates
translation_verse: Le ɖoɖo si tɔ́a David wɔ ɖi nu la, Salomo ma nunɔlawo ɖe hatsotsowo me hena woƒe subɔsubɔdɔ. Ema Levi viwo hã ɖe hatsotsowo me be ɖewo akafu, eye ɖewo asubɔ kple nunɔlawo le ŋkeke sia ŋkeke ƒe kɔa nu, eye bubuwo nanye agbonudzɔlawo adzɔ agbo ɖe sia ɖe nu le hatsotsoawo me. Ewɔ esia elabe aleae David, Mawu ƒe ame la gblɔe.

english_verse: Everything Solomon had planned to do was now finished—from the laying of the temple's foundation to its completion.
translation_verse: Ale wowu Salomo ƒe xɔ la nu, tso gbe si gbe woɖo Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔ la gɔme anyi va se ɖe gbe si gbe wowu enu la. Dɔa tsɔ afɔ, eye wowu enu keŋ.

english_verse: Solomon went to Ezion-Geber and Eloth, two Edomite towns on the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Emegbe Salomo yi Ezeon-Geber kple Elot le ƒuta le Edom-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Hiram sent him ships and some of his experienced sailors. They went with Solomon's own sailors to the country of Ophir and brought back more than
translation_verse: Xuram tsɔ tɔdziʋuwo kple ƒudzidɔwɔlawo de eƒe dɔlawo si, ɖo ɖe Salomo. Ame siawo kple Salomo ƒe dɔlawo yi Ofir ɖatsɔ sika kilo akpe wui atɔ̃ kple vɔ vɛ na Salomo.

english_verse: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.
translation_verse: Salomo ɖo eƒe biabiawo katã ŋu nɛ; biabia aɖeke meli si Salomo do kpo eŋuɖoɖo nɛ o.

english_verse: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na fia la be: “Nya si mese le mía de le ŋuwò kple wò nunya ŋuti la le eme tututu.

english_verse: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are greater than I was told.
translation_verse: Nya siwo wogblɔ nam la nyemexɔ wo dzi se o, va se ɖe esime nye ŋutɔ meva kpɔ nu sia nu kple nye ŋku. Womegblɔ wò nunya gã la ƒe afã gɔ̃ hã nam o; ènya nu wu ale si amewo le gbɔgblɔm sãa.

english_verse: Your people and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.
translation_verse: O, eme nyo na srɔ̃wòwo loo! Eme nyo na wò dɔlawo, ame siwo nɔa tsitre ɖe ŋkuwò me ɣe sia ɣi, eye wosea wò nunya.

english_verse: I praise the Lord your God. He is pleased with you and has made you king of Israel. God loves the people of this country and will never desert them, so he has given them a king who will rule fairly and honestly.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu, ame si kpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋuwò, eye wòtsɔ wò ɖo eƒe fiazikpui dzi be nànye fia na Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu. Esi wò Mawu lɔ̃ Israel, eye wòdi be neli ke tegbee ta la, etsɔ wò ɖo fiae ɖe wo nu be nàkplɔ dukɔ la nyuie, eye nàwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe.”

english_verse: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, a large amount of jewels, and the best spices anyone had ever seen.
translation_verse: Azɔ fianyɔnua na sika kilo akpe ene, atike ʋeʋẽe geɖe ŋutɔ kple kpe xɔasi fia la. Atike ʋeʋẽe siwo Seba-fianyɔnua na Salomo la tɔgbe megali o.

english_verse: not counting what the merchants and traders brought him. The kings of Arabia and the leaders of Israel also gave him gold and silver.
translation_verse: Esi nudzralawo kple asitsalawo hena vɛ la mele eme o. Arabia-fiawo kple anyigba la dzikpɔlawo hã hea sika kple klosalo vanɛ na Salomo.

english_verse: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the records of Nathan the prophet, Ahijah the prophet from Shiloh, and Iddo the prophet who wrote about Jeroboam son of Nebat.
translation_verse: Salomo ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛawo, tso gɔmedzedzea va se ɖe nuwuwua la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Gbeƒãɖela Natan ƒe Ŋutinyagbalẽwo, Axiya, Silotɔ ƒe gbeƒãɖegbalẽwo kple Gbeƒãɖela Yedo ƒe Ŋutegagbalẽ siwo me wòŋlɔ nu le Israel-fia Yerobeam, Nebat vi ƒe fiaɖuɖu ŋu le la me.

english_verse: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.
translation_verse: Fia la tsɔ nyiɖu wɔ fiazikpui lolo aɖe hã, eye wòfa sika nyuitɔ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: It had a gold footstool attached to it and armrests on each side. There was a statue of a lion on each side of the throne,
translation_verse: Atrakpui fɔflɔ ade le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ, eye afɔɖodzizikpuivi, si wowɔ kple sika la le eŋu. Abɔɖoƒe le anyinɔƒea ƒe axa eveawo dzi, eye dzata eve le tsitre ɖe abɔɖoƒe eveawo xa.

english_verse: and there were two lion statues on each of the six steps leading up to the throne. No other throne in the world was like Solomon's.
translation_verse: Dzata meme wui eve le atrakpui adeawo ƒe axawo dzi eveve. Womewɔ fiazikpui sia tɔgbe le fiaɖuƒe aɖeke me kpɔ o.

english_verse: Solomon's cups and dishes in Forest Hall were made of pure gold, because silver was almost worthless in those days.
translation_verse: Fia Salomo ƒe kpluwo katã nye sika eye Lebanon-ve xɔ la me tsikunuwo katã nye sika nyuitɔ. Le Salomo ŋɔli la, womebu klosalo ɖe naneke me o,

english_verse: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.
translation_verse: elabe fia la ƒe tɔdziʋuwo dea Tarsis kple Xuram ƒe asitsalawo. Ʋuawo gbɔna zi ɖeka le ƒe etɔ̃ me, eye wohea klosalo kple sika, nyiɖu kple kesewo kpakple tsaxe ble gãwo gbɔnɛ.

english_verse: Solomon was the richest and wisest king in the world.
translation_verse: Ale fia Salomo zu kesinɔtɔ kple nunyala gã ŋutɔ wu xexemefiawo katã.

english_verse: Year after year, other kings came to hear the wisdom God had given him. And they brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
translation_verse: Ƒè sia ƒè la, wo dome ɖe sia ɖe hea nunanawo vanɛ nɛ abe klosalo kple sikanuwo, awuwo, aʋawɔnuwo, atike ʋeʋẽewo, sɔwo kple tedzisɔwo ene.

english_verse: He ruled all the nations from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of Philistia in the south, as far as the border of Egypt.
translation_verse: Eɖu fia ɖe fiawo katã dzi, tso Frat-tɔsisi la nu va se ɖe Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi kple Egipte-liƒo dzi.

english_verse: While Solomon was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as the sycamore trees in the western foothills.
translation_verse: Le Salomo ƒe fiaɖuɣi la, ena klosalo bɔ abe kpe ene le Yerusalem, eye sedertiwo sɔ gbɔ abe sikamorti le gbegbe ene.

english_verse: Solomon's horses were brought in from other countries, including Musri. Solomon Dies (
translation_verse: Wodɔa sɔwo tso Egipte kple dukɔ bubuwo me vanɛ na Salomo. Salomo ƒe fiaɖuɖu ŋutinyawo (Fia I,

english_verse: he died and was buried in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.
translation_verse: Salomo ku, eye woɖii ɖe tɔ́a David ƒe du la me, eye via Rexabeam zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to Shechem where everyone was waiting to crown him king.
translation_verse: Rexabeam yi Sixem elabe Israel blibo la ɖi anyi ɖe afi ma be yewoaɖoe fiae.

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard what was happening, and he returned from Egypt, where he had gone to hide from Solomon.
translation_verse: Esi Yerobeam, Nebat vi, ame si sí le fia Salomo nu yi Egipte la se nyaa la, etrɔ tso Egipte gbɔ.

english_verse: The people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said,
translation_verse: Wodɔ ame ɖa woɖayɔe vɛ. Yerobeam kple Israel-dukɔ blibo la va Rexabeam gbɔ, gblɔ nɛ be:

english_verse: “Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard. But if you make our work easier, we will serve you and do whatever you ask.”
translation_verse: “Tɔ́wò ɖo kɔkuti kpekpe mía dzi. Ka tɔ́wò ƒe dɔ sesẽ kple kɔkuti kpekpe la dzi ɖe na mí, ekema míasubɔ wò.”

english_verse: Rehoboam replied, “Come back in three days for my answer.” So the people left.
translation_verse: Rexabeam ɖo eŋu be: “Miyi miatrɔ va le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe.” Ale dukɔ la trɔ dzo.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, “What should I tell these people?”
translation_verse: Fia Rexabeam de adaŋu kple ame tsitsi siwo nɔ tɔ́a Salomo ŋu le eƒe agbenɔɣi. Ebia wo be: “Aɖaŋu ka miaɖo nam be matsɔ ɖo dukɔ la ƒe nya la ŋui?”

english_verse: They answered, “If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should be kind and promise to make their work easier.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ne èwɔ nyui na dukɔ sia, lé be na wo, eye nèƒo nu kple wo nyuie la, ekema woasubɔ wò tegbee.”

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Ke egbe ame tsitsiawo ƒe aɖaŋu si woɖo nɛ la, eye wòyi ɖade adaŋu kple ɖekakpui siwo tsi kplii, eye wova le eŋu azɔ la.

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: Ebia wo be: “Aɖaŋu ka miaɖo nam be matsɔ ɖo dukɔ sia ƒe nya si wògblɔ be: ‘Ka tɔ́wò ƒe kɔkuti kpekpe la dzi ɖe na mí’ la ŋu?”

english_verse: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: Tɔ́nye ɖo kɔkuti kpekpe mia dzi, ke nye kɔkuti akpe wu etɔ. Tɔ́nye ƒo mi kple atam, ke nye la, dziɖegbe matsɔ aƒo mii.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors. He spoke bluntly
translation_verse: Tete fia Rexabeam ɖo nya la ŋu dzretɔe. Egbe ame tsitsiawo ƒe aɖaŋu la,

english_verse: and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested. He said: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: eye wòƒo nu na wo ɖe ɖekakpuiawo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖoa nu be: “Tɔ́nye ɖo kɔkuti kpekpe mia dzi, ke nye kɔkuti akpe wu etɔ. Tɔ́nye ƒo mi kple atam, ke nye la, dziɖegbe matsɔ aƒo mii.”

english_verse: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and regain control of the whole country. So he called together
translation_verse: Esi Rexabeam gbɔ va Yerusalem la, eƒo aʋawɔla akpe alafa ɖeka bla enyi nu ƒu tso Yuda kple Benyamin toawo me be yeawɔ aʋa kple Israel agbugbɔ fiaɖuƒe la axɔ.

english_verse: as well as with shields and spears. He used these fortified cities to keep control of Judah and Benjamin. The Priests and the Levites Support Rehoboam
translation_verse: Eda akpoxɔnu kple akplɔ ɖe du sia du me, eye wòwɔ wo wozu du sesẽwo ŋutɔ. Ale Yuda kple Benyamin zu etɔ. Dzigbeme Nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo ʋu va Yuda

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Lord had told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe va na Semaya, Mawu ƒe ame be:

english_verse: to tell Rehoboam and everyone from Judah and Benjamin,
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Yuda-fia Rexabeam, Salomo vi kple Israelvi siwo katã le Yuda kple Benyamin la be:

english_verse: “The Lord warns you not to go to war against the people from the northern tribes—they are your relatives. Go home! The Lord is the one who made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord's message and did not attack Jeroboam and his troops. Rehoboam Fortifies Cities in Judah
translation_verse: ‘Migaho ɖawɔ aʋa kple mia nɔviwo o. Ame sia ame netrɔ yi aƒe elabe gbɔnye nu sia tso.’ ” Ale woɖo to Aƒetɔ hegbugbɔ, eye womegawɔ aʋa kple Yerobeam o. Rexabeam tso aʋawɔduwo

english_verse: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
translation_verse: Betlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

english_verse: Beth-Zur, Soco, Adullam,
translation_verse: Bet-Zur, Soko, Adulam,

english_verse: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
translation_verse: Gat, Maresa, Sif,

english_verse: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
translation_verse: Adorayim, Laxis, Azeka,

english_verse: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. After he had fortified these cities in the territories of Judah and Benjamin,
translation_verse: Zora, Ayalon kple Xebron. Du siawo zu aʋawɔdu sesẽwo.

english_verse: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine,
translation_verse: Rexabeam wɔ wo me mɔ́wo wosesẽ, eye wòɖe aʋakplɔlawo ɖo wo me. Edzra nuɖuɖu, ami kple wain ɖo ɖe wo me.

english_verse: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Azɔ nunɔla kple Levi vi siwo le Israel bliboa la ʋu tso woƒe nutowo katã me va Rexabeam gbɔ.

english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: Yerobeam kple viawo nyà wo ɖa be womagawɔ nunɔladɔ na Aƒetɔ o; ale Levi viwo gblẽ woƒe duwo kple nuwo ɖi, eye woʋu va Yuda kple Yerusalem.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã ƒe dzi ku ɖe Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu ŋu, eye wodi be yewoasubɔ eya ko la, tso Israel-toawo katã me, dze Levi viawo yome va Yerusalem bene woasa vɔ na Aƒetɔ, wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Ame siawoe na Yuda-fiaɖuƒe la li ke, eye wodo ŋusẽ Rexabeam, Salomo vi la wònɔ te ƒe etɔ̃, elabe le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, wonɔ agbe abe ale si wonɔe le fia David kple fia Salomo ŋɔli ene. Rexabeam srɔ̃wo kple viawo

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: Eya dzi viŋutsuwo nɛ siwo nye: Yeus, Semarya kple Zaham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: Eyome Rexabeam ɖe Maaxa, Absalom vinyɔnu, eye eya hã dzi Abiya, Attai, Ziza kple Selomit nɛ.

english_verse: so he chose their oldest son Abijah to be the next king.
translation_verse: Rexabeam tsɔ Abiya Maaxa viŋutsu ɖo tatɔe ɖe nɔviawo nu elabe edi be eya nava ɖu fia.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: Rexabeam dze aɖaŋu; ema via ŋutsuawo ɖe Yuda kple Benyamin nutoawo katã me. Eɖo wo ɖe aʋawɔduawo me, eye wòna nuɖuɖu wo kpaŋkpaŋ heɖe srɔ̃ na wo.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Rexabeam wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi elabe meɖoe kplikpaa be yeadi Aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: Le fia Rexabeam ƒe ƒè atɔ̃lia me la, Egipte-fia Sisak ho aʋa ɖe Yerusalem ŋu elabe womewɔ nuteƒe na Aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Tete gbeƒãɖela Semaya va Rexabeam kple Yuda-megã siwo sí le Sisak nu va ƒo ƒu ɖe Yerusalem la gbɔ gblɔ na wo be: “Aƒetɔ be: ‘Miegblẽm ɖi, eya ta nye hã metsɔ mi de asi na Sisak.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Tete Israel-megãwo bɔbɔ wo ɖokui, eye wogblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ tɔ dzɔ.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Esi Aƒetɔ kpɔ be wobɔbɔ wo ɖokui la, eƒe gbe va na Semaya be: “Wobɔbɔ wo ɖokui eya ta nyemagatsrɔ̃ o, ke boŋ maxɔ na wo ʋɛ. Nyemaɖe nye dziku ɖe Yerusalem ŋu to Sisak dzi o.

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: Gake mana woasubɔe bene woakpɔ vovototo si le nye subɔsubɔ kple anyigba dzi dziɖulawo subɔsubɔ dome.”

english_verse: Shishak attacked Jerusalem and took all the valuable things from the temple and from the palace, including Solomon's gold shields.
translation_verse: Ale Egipte-fia Sisak ho ɖe Yerusalem ŋu. Elɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me kesinɔnuwo kple fiasã la me kesinɔnuwo. Elɔ nu sia nu; etsɔ sikakpoxɔnu siwo fia Salomo wɔ gɔ̃ hã dzoe.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Fia Rexabeam va wɔ akɔblikpoxɔnuwo ɖe sikatɔawo teƒe, eye wòtsɔ wo de asrafo siwo dzɔa fiasã la ƒe mɔnu la ƒe amegãwo si.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Ne fia la yina Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me la, fia ŋu srafowo tsɔa akpoxɔnuawo dona kplii, eye wogagbugbɔa wo va dana ɖe agbonudzɔxɔa me.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Esi Rexabeam bɔbɔ eɖokui ta la, Aƒetɔ ƒe dziku la nu yi, eye metsrɔ̃ wo keŋ o. Gawu la, nu nyui wɔwɔ nu metso le Yuda o. Rexabeam ƒe fiaɖuɖu ŋutinya kpuie

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Rexabeam ƒe ŋutinyawo tso gɔmedzedzea va se ɖe nuwuwu la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Gbeƒãɖela Semaya ƒe Ŋutinyagbalẽ kple Nukpɔla Ido ƒe Ŋutinyagbalẽwo me. Aʋa nɔ Rexabeam kple Yerobeam dome ŋkekeawo katã.

english_verse: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.
translation_verse: Rexabeam ku, eye woɖii ɖe David ƒe du la me, eye via Abiya zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Le fia Yerobeam ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè wui enyilia me la, Abiya zu fia le Yuda.

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: Yuda-ʋakɔa do aʋaɣli. Eva eme be esi Yuda-ŋutsuwo do ɣli la, Mawu si Yerobeam kple Israel-ʋakɔ la katã le Abiya kple Yuda ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: “Azɔ miebu be yewoate ŋu anɔ te ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe fiaɖuƒe si le David ƒe dzidzimeviwo si me la nu, elabe miesɔ gbɔ fũu eye sikanyivi siwo Yerobeam tsɔ wɔ mawuwo na mi la le mia gbɔ ta.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: Eɖu fia ƒe etɔ̃ le Yerusalem. Nɔa ŋkɔe nye Mixaya; enye Uriel si tso Gibea vinyɔnu. Aʋa nɔ Abiya kple Yerobeam dome.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Abiya tsi tsitre ɖe Zemarayim-to kɔgo le Efrayim-tonyigba dzi, eye wògblɔ be: “Yerobeam kple Israelviwo katã, miɖo to miasee!

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Ðe mienyae be Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, tsɔ Israel-fiaɖuƒe la na David kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo tegbee, to dzenubabla me oa?

english_verse: But Jeroboam, you were King Solomon's official, and you rebelled.
translation_verse: Ke Yerobeam, Nebat vi, si nye David vi, Salomo ƒe dɔla la, dze aglã ɖe eƒe aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: Yakame kple ame ɖigbɔ ƒe vi aɖewo hã ƒo ƒu ɖe eŋu, eye wodo dzi tsi tre ɖe Rexabeam, Salomo vi ŋu. Ke esi Rexabeam nye ɖevi eye dzi mele eƒo o ta la, mete ŋu nɔ te ɖe wo nu o.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Menye miawoe nyà Aƒetɔ ƒe nunɔlawo, Aron kple Levi ɖa le mia dome eye mieɖo nunɔlawo na mia ɖokui ɖe wo teƒe abe anyigba bubu dzi tɔwo ene oa? Ame sia ame si nyatsɔ nyitsui ɖeka kple agbo adrẽ vɛ be woaɖo ye ko la, wotsɔnɛ ɖoa mawu manye mawuwo ƒe nunɔlae.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: Ke míawo ya la, Aƒetɔ ye nye mía Mawu; míetrɔ le eyome o. Ẽ, Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo nye nunɔla siwo subɔa Aƒetɔ, eye Levi viwoe le subɔsubɔdɔwo nu.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Ŋdi sia ŋdi kple fiẽ sia fiẽ la, wotɔa dzo lifi, eye wosaa numemevɔ na Aƒetɔ. Wodaa abolo ɖe kplɔ̃ kɔkɔe la dzi, eye wosia akaɖi siwo le sikakaɖitiawo dzi la fiẽ sia fiẽ, elabe míawo míelé Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, ƒe dɔdeasia me ɖe asi; ke miawo ya mietrɔ le eyome.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu le mía dzi, eye wònye mía kplɔla, eye eƒe nunɔlawo le klalo be yewoaku aʋakpẽwo ɖe mia ŋu. O Israelviwo, migawɔ aʋa kple mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la o, elabe madze edzi na mi o.”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Ke Yerobeam na xadelawo ƒo xlã wo be yewoadze wo dzi to megbe; ale be Yerobeam ƒe aʋakɔwo le Yuda ŋgɔ, eye xadelawo le megbe.

english_verse: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ale wobɔbɔ Israelviwo ɖe anyi. Yudatɔwo kpɔ ŋusẽ elabe woɖo dzi ɖe wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la ŋu.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Abiya ti Yerobeam kple eƒe aʋakɔ la yome ɖaxɔ du siawo: Betel, Yesana kple Eron kpakple wo ŋu kɔƒewo.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ megaɖo Yerobeam ŋu kpɔ le Abiya ŋɔli o. Mlɔeba Aƒetɔ ƒoe ƒu anyi, wòku.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Abiya ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛawo, eƒe nuwɔnawo kple eƒe nyawo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Ido ƒe Ŋutinyagbalẽ me.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Asa wɔ nu si nyo, eye wòdze Aƒetɔ, eƒe Mawu la ŋu.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Eɖe dukɔ bubuwo me tɔwo ƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo kple nuxeƒewo ɖa, gbã aƒeliwo, eye wòtso nyɔnumawu Asera ŋu nuwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na Yudatɔwo be woadi Aƒetɔ, wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la, eye woawɔ eƒe se la kple nufiamewo dzi.

english_verse: He destroyed every local shrine and incense altar in Judah.
translation_verse: Eɖe nuxeƒewo kple lifivɔsamlekpuiwo hã ɖa le Yuda-duwo katã me, ale fiaɖuƒe la kpɔ gbɔdzɔe le ete.

english_verse: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.
translation_verse: Etso du sesẽwo ɖe Yuda, elabe anyigba la kpɔ gbɔdzɔe. Mewɔ aʋa aɖeke ɣe ma ɣi o, esi Aƒetɔ na eƒe to me fa ta.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na Yuda be: “Mina míagbugbɔ du siawo atso, aɖo gli aƒo xlã wo, atu gbetakpɔxɔwo, eye míade agbo kple gametiwo wo nu. Anyigba la gale mía si me elabe míedi Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, eya ta wòna ŋutifafa xɔ aƒe godoo.” Ale wotso duawo, eye nu dze edzi na wo le afi sia afi.

english_verse: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.
translation_verse: Asa ho yi ɖakpee, eye akpa eveawo dze aʋa ɖe Zefata-bali me le Maresa gbɔ.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Tete Asa yɔ Aƒetɔ, eƒe Mawu la gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, ale si nèxɔna na ŋusẽtɔ la, nenema ko nèxɔna na ame beli la hãe. Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu, xɔ na mí elabe ŋuwòe míeɖo ŋu ɖo, eye wò ŋkɔ me míeho aʋa ɖe ame gbogbo siawo ŋu le. Aƒetɔ, wò koe nye mía Mawu. Mègana amegbetɔ aɖeke nanɔ te ɖe nuwò o.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ɖu Etiopiatɔwo dzi. Asa kple eƒe aʋakɔ kpe aʋa kpli wo, eye Etiopiatɔwo sí.

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: Asa kple aʋakɔ si le eŋu la ɖe wo ɖe nu va se Gerar. Wosi Etiopiatɔwo vevie; ɖeke metsi agbe o elabe Aƒetɔ kple eƒe aʋakɔ lae tsrɔ̃ wo. Woha nu geɖe ŋutɔ.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Woɖu du siwo katã ƒo xlã Gerar la dzi elabe vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo le Aƒetɔ ta. Nu geɖe le duawo katã me, ale woha wo keŋ.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wodze lãnyilawo hã dzi, kaka woƒe agbadɔwo, eye wolé alẽ geɖe kple kposɔwo hegbɔ va Yerusalem.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ dze Azarya, Obed vi dzi,

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: eye wòyi ɖakpe Asa. Egblɔ nɛ be: “Asa, wò kple Yudatɔwo kpakple Benyamintɔwo katã, miɖo tom. Aƒetɔ nɔ kpli mi esime mienɔ eŋu. Ne miedii la, ana miakpɔe; ke ne miegblẽe ɖi la, eya hã agblẽ mi ɖi.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe nye esi esime Israel nɔ anyi, eye Mawu ŋutɔŋutɔ menɔ esi o. Nunɔla siwo afia nu wo meli o, eye se aɖeke hã menɔ anyi o.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Ke esi woɖo xaxa me, eye wotrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋu hedii la, wokpɔe.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, mɔzɔla o, aƒenɔla o, ŋutifafa aɖeke meli nɛ o, elabe ʋunyaʋunya gã ŋutɔ nɔ anyigba dzi nɔlawo katã dome.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Wo dome ma kluikluiklui. Dukɔ tso ɖe dukɔ ŋu, eye du tso ɖe du ŋu elabe Mawu he dzɔgbevɔ̃e vovovowo va wo dzi.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Esi Asa se nya siawo kple gbeƒãɖela Obed ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖea la, dzi ɖo eƒo eye wòɖe legba nyɔŋuawo ɖa le Yuda-nyigba blibo la, Benyamin kple du siwo wòxɔ le Efrayim-tonyigba la dzi la me. Edzra Aƒetɔ ƒe vɔsamlekpui si le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe akpata la ŋgɔ la hã ɖo.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Eƒo Yuda blibo la kple Benyamin kpakple ame siwo tso Efrayim, Manase kple Simeon va egbɔ la nu ƒu, elabe ame geɖewo tso Israel va de edzi, esime wokpɔ be Aƒetɔ, eƒe Mawu la li kplii.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wova kpe ta ɖe Yerusalem. Asa le eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè wui atɔ̃lia ƒe ɣleti etɔ̃lia me le ɣeyiɣi sia me.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Wobla nu kple Aƒetɔ, wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la, be yewoasubɔe tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Tete wokɔ gbe dzi sesĩe, ka atam na Aƒetɔ heku kpẽwo kple lãdzowo.

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã le Yuda la kpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ le atam si woka la ŋu, elabe wokae tso dzi blibo me. Wodii kple lɔlɔ̃nu katã eye wokpɔe. Ale Aƒetɔ na gbɔdzɔe wo le go sia go me.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Fia Asa ɖe nɔa Maaxa, si nye nyɔnufia la ɖa be maganye nyɔnufia o, elabe ewɔ nyɔnumawu Asera ƒe legba ɖi. Asa mu legba la ƒu anyi eye wògbãe. Elɔ kakɛawo ɖatɔ dzoe ɖe Kidron-bali la me.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: Ke womeɖe nuxeƒewo ya ɖa le Israel o. Asa ko ƒe dzimee nɔ dzadzɛ le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Etsɔ tɔ́a ƒe nu kɔkɔeawo kple eya ŋutɔ tɔwo siwo nye klosalo kple sikanu kpakple ŋudɔwɔnuawo ɖada ɖe Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.
translation_verse: Aʋa aɖeke megadzɔ kpɔ o, va se ɖe Asa ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè bla etɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃lia me.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Tete Asa tsɔ klosalo kple sika le nudzraɖoƒe siwo le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la kple fiasã la me ɖo ɖe Siria-fia Ben-Hadad, si le Damasko la gblɔ be:

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Na nye kple wò míabla nu abe ale si tɔ́nye kple tɔ́wò wowɔe ene. Nye asi me klosalo kple sika nye esi. Tu nubabla si le wò kple Israel-fia Baesa dome ne wòaho adzo le gbɔnye.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Tete Ben-Hadad lɔ̃ ɖe fia Asa ƒe nyaa dzi nɛ, eye wòdɔ eƒe aʋakplɔlawo ɖo ɖe Israel-duwo me. Wosi Yion, Dan kple Abel-Mayim kpakple Naftali-du siwo katã me wodzraa nuwo ɖo la.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Esi Baesa see la, edzudzɔ Rama-dua tsotso, eye dɔa tsi nenema.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Asa fia la na Yuda blibo la yi ɖalɔ kpe kple ati siwo Baesa tsɔ le Rama-dua tsomee la, eye wòna wolɔ wo yi ɖagbugbɔ Geba kple Mizpa duwo tso. Nukpɔla Xanani

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, nukpɔla Xanani va Yuda-fia Asa gbɔ, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Esi nède me Siria-fia eye mèɖo ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ŋu o ta la, Siria-fia ƒe aʋakɔ sí dzo le gbɔwò.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Ðe aʋakɔ gãwo, tasiaɖamwo kple sɔdola geɖe fũu menɔ Etiopiatɔwo kple Libiatɔwo si hafi oa? Ke esi nède me Aƒetɔ la, ɖe nyemena nèɖu wo dzi oa?

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.

translation_verse: Tete Yosafat tsi tsitre le Yuda kple Yerusalem ƒe takpekpe la me le Aƒetɔ ƒeme le gbadzaƒe yeye la ŋgɔ,

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu, ɖe menye wòe nye Mawu le dziƒo oa? Ẽ, wòe ɖua dukɔwo ƒe fiaɖuƒewo katã dzi, eye asiwò me ŋusẽ kple ŋutete le. Ame aɖeke mete ŋu nɔa te ɖe nuwò o.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: O, mía Mawu, ɖe menye wòe nyà anyigba sia dzi nɔlawo ɖa le wò dukɔ Israel ŋgɔ, eye nètsɔ anyigba la na xɔ̃wò Abraham be wòanye eƒe dzidzimeviwo tɔ tegbee oa?

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: Wotso aƒe ɖe edzi, eye wotu kɔkɔeƒe hã ɖe edzi na wò be woasubɔ wò agblɔ be:

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: ‘Ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e aɖe dzɔ ɖe mía dzi abe tohehe ene, aʋawɔwɔe o, dɔ vɔ̃e o, dɔtoto ye o, míava tsi tsitre ɖe xɔ sia ŋgɔ, le ŋkuwò me, elabe wò ŋkɔ le xɔ sia ŋu, eye míado ɣli ayɔ wò le míaƒe xaxa me la, nàsee ne nàɖe mí.’

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: Azɔ kpɔ ɖa, Amontɔwo kple Moabtɔwo kpakple Seir-todzitɔwo ho ɖe mia ŋu. Evɔ la, ame siawo dome mèɖe mɔ na Israel be woato, esime wotso Egipte o, ke boŋ wode axa na wo, eye wometsrɔ̃ wo o.

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: O, mía Mawu, màdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo oa? Elabe ŋusẽ aɖeke mele mía ŋu, míatsɔ akpe akɔ kple aʋakɔ gã sia si tso ɖe mía ŋu la o. Míenya nu ka míawɔ o; wò ko ŋu míaƒe ŋku le.”

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi me la, Yuda blibo la le tsitre ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋkume; woƒe vidzĩwo, wo srɔ̃wo kple wo viwo keŋ.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: “Yuda-dukɔ blibo la, mi Yerusalemnɔlawo kple fia Yosafat, miɖo to miasee. Aƒetɔ be: ‘Migavɔ̃ o eye aʋakɔ gã sia megadzi ŋɔ na mi o, elabe aʋa la menye mia tɔ o; ke boŋ Mawu tɔe.

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Etsɔ la, miho yi ɖakpe wo. Woalia to ato Ziz-mɔ la dzi ava. Miake ɖe wo ŋu le balia nu le Yeruel-gbedadaƒo ŋgɔ.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Menye miawoe le aʋa sia wɔ ge o. Mitsi tsitre ɖi ko ne miakpɔ ale si Aƒetɔ le xɔxɔ ge na mii la ɖa! O Yuda kple Yerusalem, migavɔ̃ o, eye dzika megatso mia ƒo o. Etsɔ la, mido yi ɖakpe wo; Aƒetɔ li kpli mi!”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat bowed low to the ground and everyone worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete fia Yosafat kple Yuda katã kpakple Yerusalemnɔlawo katã bɔbɔ de ta agu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye wosubɔe.

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Levi vi siwo le Kehat kple Korax ƒe ƒomeawo me la tsi tsitre, eye wokafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, sesĩe.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Le evea gbe ƒe ŋdi kanya la, woho ɖo ta Tekoa-gbedadaƒo. Esi wonɔ mɔ dzem la, Yosafat tsi tsitre ƒo nu na wo be: “Yuda kple Yerusalemnɔlawo, miɖo tom. Mixɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu dzi se ekem ali ke mi. Mixɔ eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo hã dzi se, ekem ana wòadze dzi na mi.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Ede adaŋu kple dukɔ la be ne woho la, Aƒetɔ ƒe hadzila siwo ɖoa atsyɔ̃ kɔkɔe, eye wodzia kafukafuha la nanɔ aʋakɔ la ŋgɔ anɔ ha dzim be: “Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, Elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Tete Amonviwo kple Moabviwo sɔ ɖe Seir-todzitɔwo ŋu, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo keŋ. Esi wotsrɔ̃ Seir-todzitɔwo vɔ la, wotrɔ ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu azɔ hewu keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Esi Yudatɔwo va ɖo gbetakpɔxɔ si le gbedadaƒoa gbɔ, kpɔ aʋakɔa ta ɖa la, kpɔ ɖa, ame kukuwo le anyigba fũu. Ame aɖeke mesí o.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enea gbe la, wokpe ta ɖe Beraka-bali la me, eye wokafu Aƒetɔ. Esia ta woyɔa bali la be Beraka-bali va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ na Aƒetɔ ɖo anyigbawo ƒe fiaɖuƒewo katã me, esime wose be Aƒetɔ wɔ aʋa kple Israel ƒe futɔwo.

english_verse: to invade Judah. The Lord let Jehoshaphat's kingdom be at peace. Jehoshaphat Dies (
translation_verse: Ale Yosafat ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me fa elabe eƒe Mawu na gbɔdzɔe godoo va kpe. Yosafat ƒe nuwuwu (Fia I,

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, Yuda-fia Yosafat ɖawɔ ɖeka kple Israel-fia Axazya. Ewɔ nu vlo be ewɔ esia.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat obeyed the Lord, just as his father Asa had done,
translation_verse: Eto tɔ́a Asa ƒe ʋe me tututu, medze to afi aɖeke o, eye wòwɔ nu si dzɔ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume,

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: ke womeɖe nuxeƒeawo ɖa o, eye dukɔ la mekpɔ trɔ woƒe dzi ɖe wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la ŋu haɖe o.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Yosafat ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛawo, tso gɔmedzedzea va se ɖe nuwuwua la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Yehu, Xanani vi la, ƒe nya siwo wotsɔ de Israel-fiawo ƒe Agbalẽ me la me.

english_verse: They agreed to build several seagoing ships at Ezion-Geber.
translation_verse: Ewɔ ɖeka kplii be yewoakpa tɔdziʋu siwo ade Tarsis la, eye wokpa ʋuawo le Ezeon-Geber.

english_verse: But the prophet Eliezer warned Jehoshaphat, “The Lord will destroy these ships because you have supported Ahaziah.” The ships were wrecked and never sailed.
translation_verse: Tete Eliezer, Dodava vi, tso Maresa ɖe gbeƒã ɖe Yosafat ŋu be: “Esi nèwɔ ɖeka kple Axazya ta la, Aƒetɔ agblẽ nu si nèwɔ la me.” Ale ʋuawo gbã, eye womete ŋu de Tarsis o.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Yosafat ku, eye woɖii ɖe tɔgbuiawo ɖiƒe le David ƒe du la me. Via Yoram zu fia ɖe eteƒe. Yuda-fia Yoram (Fia II,

english_verse: King Jehoshaphat had seven sons: Jehoram, Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah.
translation_verse: Nɔviŋutsuwo nɔ Yoram si siwo nye Yosafat viŋutsuwo. Woawoe nye: Azarya, Yexiel, Zaxarya, Azarya, Mixael kple Sefatya. Ame siawo katã nye Israel-fia Yosafat viŋutsuwo.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Le eƒe fiaɖuɣi la, Edom-dukɔ dze aglã ɖe Yuda-dziɖuɖu ŋu, eye woɖo fia na wo ɖokui.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ na Filistitɔwo kple Arabiatɔ siwo le Etiopiatɔwo xa la dze aglã ɖe Yoram ŋu.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Wo tɔ́ na nu geɖe wo: klosalo kple sika kple nu xɔasi bubu geɖe wo, eye wòna wo dome ame sia ame le Yuda-du sesẽ aɖe nu; ke etsɔ fiaɖuƒe la na Yoram elabe eyae nye eƒe ŋgɔgbevia.

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Esi Yoram va ɖo tɔ́a ƒe fiaɖuƒe la nu, eye wòli ke la, ewu nɔvia ŋutsuawo katã kple Israel-megã aɖewo kple yi.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Eto Israel-fiawo ƒe ʋe me abe ale si Axab ƒomea wɔ la ene elabe Axab vinyɔnue nye srɔ̃a. Ewɔ nu si nye vɔ̃ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ medi be yeatsrɔ̃ David ƒe ƒome la o, elabe ebla nu kple David do ŋugbe nɛ be yeana akaɖi aɖe eya kple viawo tegbee.

english_verse: Jehoram, his officers, and his cavalry marched to Edom, where the Edomite army surrounded them. He escaped during the night,
translation_verse: Ale Yoram kple aʋakplɔlawo dze mɔ kple woƒe tasiaɖamwo, eye woho yi ɖatu Edomtɔwo. Edomtɔwo ƒe aʋakɔwo va ƒo xlã wo; ke le zã me la, wosi wo.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ale Edom dze aglã ɖe Yuda-dziɖuɖu ŋu va se ɖe egbe. Le ɣe ma ɣi me tututu la, Libna-du hã dze aglã ɖe Yoram ƒe dziɖuɖu ŋu, elabe egblẽ Aƒetɔ, tɔgbuiawo ƒe Mawu la ɖi.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Etu nuxeƒewo ɖe Yuda-tonyigba la hã dzi. Ekplɔa Yerusalemnɔlawo yia teƒe siawo woɖasubɔa trɔ̃wo, eye wòkplɔ Yuda-dukɔ trae.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Tete Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Eliya ŋlɔ agbalẽ na Yoram be: “Aƒetɔ, tɔgbuiwò David ƒe Mawu la bu fɔ wò elabe mèto tɔ́wò Yosafat loo, alo tɔgbuiwò Asa ƒe ʋe me o.

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: Èto Israel-fiawo ƒe afɔtoƒe eye nèna Yuda kple Yerusalemnɔlawo subɔ trɔ̃wo abe Axab ƒe ƒometɔwo ene. Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, èwu nɔviwò ŋutsu siwo ɖɔ ʋu wu wò la hã.

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ahe to na wò dukɔ la, viwòwo kple srɔ̃wòwo vevie, eye wòagblẽ wò nunɔamesiwo katã dome.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: Ke wò ŋutɔ la, àdze dɔ vevie. Àdze dɔmedɔ si ana nanyè wò dɔkaviwo tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke.”

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: Wova dze Yuda-dukɔa dzi, eye woha nu siwo katã wokpɔ le fiasã la me la dzoe. Wolé via ŋutsuwo kple srɔ̃awo hã dzoe. Viŋutsu aɖeke mekpɔtɔ nɛ o, negbe Yoaxaz, eƒe dɔmlɔea ko.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Le esiawo katã megbe la, Aƒetɔ na fia la va dze dɔ madamada vɔ̃ɖi aɖe ɖe eƒe dɔka ŋu.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Dɔléle la ɖe fu nɛ tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke ƒe eve sɔŋ. Mlɔeba la, enyè eƒe dɔkawo keŋ, eye wòse veve ʋuu heku. Ke eteviwo medo dzo gã nɛ de bubu eŋu abe ale si wowɔ na tɔgbuiawo ene o.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Esime Yehu nɔ to hem na Axab ƒe ƒomea la, edo go Yuda-megãwo kple Axazya nɔviŋutsu ƒe viwo, ame siwo subɔa Axazya eye wòwu wo.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: Axazya sí ɖabè ɖe Samaria. Ke Yehu na woɖadii eye wolée. Wokplɔe vɛ na Yehu eye wowui heɖi elabe wogblɔ be: “Yosafat, ame si di Aƒetɔ kple dzi blibo la ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi ye.” Ale Axazya ƒe ƒometɔ aɖeke megali ate ŋu aɖu fia o. Yuda-fianyɔnu Atalya (Fia II,

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume abe Axab ƒe ƒometɔwo ene, elabe le tɔ́a ƒe ku megbe la, woawoe ɖo aɖaŋu nɛ wòva zu ku nɛ.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Axazya xɔ woƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo eye wòwɔ ɖeka kple Israel-fia Yoram, Axab vi, woho aʋa ɖe Siria-fia Xazael ŋu. Wokpe aʋa la le Ramot-Gilead. Yoram xɔ abi.

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ɖoe be Axazya nadze anyi to Yoram gbɔyiyi me. Esi wòva la, eya kple Yoram wodo go be yewoaɖakpe Yehu, Nimsi vi, ame si Aƒetɔ si ami na be wòatsrɔ̃ Axab ƒe ƒome la.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Ke Yoseba, fia la vinyɔnu, fi Yoas, fia Axazya viŋutsu le fiavi siwo wobe yewoawu la dome. Ekplɔ eya kple edzikpɔla ɖaɣla ɖe xɔdɔmea ememetɔ me. Ale wɔ Yoseba, fia Yoram vinyɔnu, si nye nunɔla Yoyada srɔ̃ kple Axazya nɔvinyɔnu la ɣla ɖevia ɖe Atalya eye mewu eya o.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Atalya, Axazya nɔ kpɔ be ye vi ku la, etso eye wòtsrɔ̃ Yuda-fiaƒome blibo la.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Eɣla eɖokui ɖe wo gbɔ le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me ƒe ade esime Atalya ɖu dukɔa dzi.

english_verse: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Wotsa le Yuda godoo eye wokplɔ Levi viwo kple Israel-tatɔwo tso Yuda-duwo katã me va Yerusalem.

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Nu si miawɔ lae nye esi: Mi nunɔlawo kple Levi vi siwo yina dɔ me le dzudzɔgbe la, akpa etɔ̃lia nadzɔ agboawo nu.

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Dukɔ blibo la kpɔ dzidzɔ le anyigba la dzi, eye dua me fa elabe wowu Atalya kple yi.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Ke le ƒè adrẽlia me la, Yoyada do dzi ɖabla nu kple ame alafawo ƒe kplɔlawo. Woawoe nye Azarya, Yeroxam vi, Ismael, Yehohanan vi, Azarya, Obed vi, Maaseya, Adaya vi kple Elisafat, Zixri vi.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: Ameha blibo la bla nu kple fia la le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me, eye Yoyada gblɔ na wo be: “Kpɔ ɖa, fiavie aɖu fia, abe ale si Aƒetɔ do ŋugbe le David ƒe dzidzimeviwo ŋui ene.

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: Akpa etɔ̃lia bubu nanɔ fiasã la me, eye akpa etɔ̃lia mamlɛa nanɔ Gɔmeɖoɖogbo la nu. Dukɔ blibo la nanɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnu.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke nagava Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me o, negbe nunɔlawo kple Levi vi siwo le dɔ wɔm le afi ma la ko. Woawo ya kpɔ mɔ age ɖe eme elabe wo ŋu kɔ, ke dukɔ blibo la nawɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe ɖoɖo dzi.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Levi viwo naƒo xlã fia la, eye wo dome ame sia ame nalé aʋawɔnu ɖe asi. Ame si va aƒea me la, woawui. Afi sia afi si fia la to la, minɔ eŋu.”

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Levi viawo kple Yudatɔwo katã wɔ ɖe ale si nunɔla Yoyada ɖe gbe na wo la dzi pɛpɛpɛ. Nunɔla Yoyada meɖe asi le dɔwɔhatsotsoawo ŋu woyi aƒe o. Ame siwo ado le dɔ me le dzudzɔgbe la dzi kple ame siwo ava dɔ me le dzudzɔgbe la dzi la katã li, eye ame sia ame le eƒe amewo nu.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Nunɔla Yoyada tsɔ fia David ƒe akplɔwo, akpoxɔnu gãtɔ kple suetɔ siwo le Mawu ƒe aƒea me la na ame alafawo ƒe kplɔlawo,

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: eye wòɖo ameawo katã ɖi, tso xɔa ƒe anyigbeme godzi va yi eƒe dzigbeme godzi. Woƒo xlã vɔsamlekpui la hã eye ame sia ame lé aʋawɔnu ɖe asi.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Esi Atalya se ameha siwo le du dzi le aseye tsom ɖe fia la ŋu la ƒe hoowɔwɔ la, edo va dukɔ la gbɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Kasia, ekpɔ fia la le tsitre ɖe eƒe sɔti la gbɔ le kɔkɔƒea ƒe mɔnu. Aʋakplɔlawo kple kpẽkulawo ƒo xlãe, eye dukɔ blibo la le aseye tsom; kpẽwo le ɖiɖim eye hadzilawo tsɔ hadzinu vovovowo le kafukafuha dzim. Atalya dze eƒe awuwo, eye wòdo ɣli be: “Dugbãnuɖoɖo ye! Dugbãnuɖoɖo ye!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Nunɔla Yoyada yɔ asrafo alafawo ƒe kplɔlawo va xexe, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Migawui ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me o. Mikplɔe to ameawo dome yii. Ne ame aɖe dze eyome la, miwui kple yi.”

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.

translation_verse: Yoyada bla nu kple dukɔ blibo la kple fia la be yewoanye Aƒetɔ ƒe dukɔ.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ blibo la ge ɖe Baal ƒe subɔƒe la. Womu eƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo ƒu anyi, gbã eƒe legbawo, eye wowu Matan, Baal nunɔla ɖe vɔsamlekpuiawo ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Yoyada tsɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me dɔwo de asi na nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo, ame siwo David ma ɖe hatsotsowo me be woakpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me dɔwo gbɔ. David ɖo wo be woasa Aƒetɔ ƒe numemevɔsa kple dzidzɔ kple hadzidzi abe ale si woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe se la mee ene.

english_verse: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.
translation_verse: Yoyada ɖo agbonudzɔlawo ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe agbowo nu be ame makɔmakɔ aɖeke nagage ɖe eme o.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: Tete Yoyada ɖe ame alafawo ƒe kplɔlawo dukɔ la ƒe ame ŋkutawo, dziɖulawo kple dukɔ blibo la katã, eye wokplɔ fia la tso Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me zɔ dzigbegbo la nu yi fiasã la me, eye wòtsɔ fia la ɖo fiazikpui dzi.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Yoas wɔ nu si dze Aƒetɔ ŋu le nunɔla Yoyada ƒe agbenɔɣi katã.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Fia la kple Yoyada tsɔ gaa na dɔnunɔla siwo le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la dzadzraɖo nu, eye woawo tsɔ xɔtulawo kple atikpalawo be woagbugbɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la aɖɔ ɖo. Ga yibɔ kple akɔbli dɔwɔlawo hã kpe ɖe wo ŋu be woadzra Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ɖo.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Woɖii ɖe David ƒe du la me ɖe fiawo ɖiƒe le nu nyui si wòwɔ na Israel-dukɔ, Mawu kple gbedoxɔ la ta.

english_verse: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.”

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Yoyada ɖe srɔ̃ eve na fia la, eye wodzi ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo nɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Le nu siawo megbe la, Yoas ɖoe be yeadzra Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ɖo.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: Eyɔ nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo ƒo ƒu, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Miyi Yuda-duawo me ne miaɖadzɔ ga le ame sia ame si le Israel blibo la, ne miatsɔ adzra Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖo abe ale si wòhiã ƒe sia ƒe la ene. Mitsɔ dzo ɖe esia wɔwɔ ŋu.” Ke Levi viwo meʋã ɖe ga la dzɔdzɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ale fia la yɔ woƒe tatɔ Yoyada biae be: “Nu ka ta mèkpɔ egbɔ be Levi viwo yi Yuda kple Yerusalem ɖaxɔ adzɔ si Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla Mose ɖo na Israel-hame be wòana ɖe nubabla ƒe agbadɔ la dzikpɔkpɔ ta o?”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Ale fia la na be wowɔ nudzɔɖaka, eye wotsɔe ɖo Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔ la ƒe agbo nu le egodo.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Ena woɖe gbeƒã le Yuda kple Yerusalem godoo be woatsɔ adzɔ si Mawu ƒe dɔla Mose ɖo na Israel-dukɔa le gbedadaƒo la vɛ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Ðelawo kple dukɔ blibo la kpɔ dzidzɔ, eye wova de nu aɖaka la me wòyɔ.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Ne wokpɔ be gaa sɔ gbɔ la, Levi viwo tsɔa aɖaka la yia ame si fia ɖo ɖi la gbɔe. Fia ƒe agbalẽŋlɔla kple nunɔlagã teƒenɔla vana, eye wotrɔa gaa le aɖakaa me gagbugbɔa aɖakaa va dana ɖe eteƒe. Wowɔe alea tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke, eye wokpɔ ga fũu.

english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.
translation_verse: Dɔwɔlawo katã biã ŋku ɖe dɔa ŋu wɔ, eye wogbugbɔ ɖɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ɖo asi tee wòɖo nɔnɔ nyui me.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: Esi wowɔe vɔ la, wotsɔ ga si susɔ la vɛ na fia la kple Yoyada wotsɔ wɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me nuwo, subɔsubɔdɔwɔnuwo kple vɔsanuwo, trewo, sikanuwo kple klosalonuwo. Ale wosaa numemevɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me ɖaa le Yoyada ƒe agbenɔɣi katã. Dukɔ la trɔ le Aƒetɔ yome

translation_verse: Yoyada tsi eye agbe ɖi ƒo nɛ hafi wòku. Exɔ ƒe alafa ɖeka bla etɔ̃.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Azɔ le Yoyada ƒe ku megbe la, Yuda-megãwo va do gbe na fia la tsɔ bubu nɛ. Fia la ɖo to woƒe gbe.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Wogblẽ Aƒetɔ, wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la, ƒe aƒe la ɖi, eye wosubɔ nyɔnumawu, Asera kple legbawo. Le woƒe fɔɖiɖi sia ta la, dɔmedzoe va Yuda kple Yerusalem dzi.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, Aƒetɔ ɖo eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ɖe wo be woagatrɔ ɖe ye ŋu. Wogbe nya na wo, ke womeɖo to wo o.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Tete Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ dze Zaxarya, nunɔla Yoyada vi dzi. Etsi tsitre ɖe dukɔ la ŋgɔ, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Mawu be: ‘Nu ka ta mieda Aƒetɔ ƒe seawo dzi eye dzɔgbevɔ̃e va mia dzi? Miegblẽ Aƒetɔ ɖi eya ta eya hã gblẽ mi ɖi.’ ”

english_verse: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.
translation_verse: Le ƒea ƒe nuwuwu la, Siriatɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ho ɖe Yoas ŋu. Wova Yuda kple Yerusalem, wu amegãwo katã le dukɔa me, eye wolɔ aboyonuwo katã yi na Damasko-fia.

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Siriatɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ le sue hã la, Aƒetɔ tsɔ Yudatɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ gã la de wo si me, elabe wogblẽ Aƒetɔ, wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la ɖi. Wohe to na Yoas to esia me.

english_verse: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.
translation_verse: Yoas viŋutsuwo ƒe ŋutinyawo, gbeƒã gbogbo si woɖe ɖe eŋu kple ale si wogaɖo Mawu ƒe aƒe la gɔme anyi la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Fiawo ƒe Agbalẽ ŋu nya me ɖeɖewo me. Via Amazya va zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: One of God's prophets said, “Your Majesty, don't let these Israelite soldiers march into battle with you. The Lord has refused to help anyone from the northern kingdom of Israel,
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ƒe ame aɖe va fia la gbɔ gblɔ nɛ be: “O, fia, mègana Israel-ʋakɔ sia nayi nua gbe kpli wò o, elabe Aƒetɔ meli kple Israel o; meli kple Efrayim vi siawo o.

english_verse: Amaziah replied, “What am I supposed to do about all the silver I paid those troops?” “The Lord will give you back even more than you paid,” the prophet answered.

translation_verse: Amazya lé dzi ɖe ƒo, eye wòkplɔ eƒe aʋakɔ la yi ɖe Dzebali la me. Wokpe aʋa kple futɔawo le afi ma, eye wowu Edom-srafo akpe ewo.

english_verse: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his officials, then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back a reply that said: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon arranged the marriage between his son and the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Israel-fia Yoas ɖo eŋu ɖo ɖe Yuda-fia Amazya be: “Ŋuve le Lebanon dzi dɔ sederti le Lebanon dzi be: ‘Tsɔ viwò nyɔnu na vinye ŋutsu ne wòaɖe.’ Gbemelã aɖe tso Lebanon tso eme va yi, eye wònya avuzi le ŋuve la dzi.

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. But stay at home and do your celebrating. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Azɔ ègblɔ be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, mesi Edom’, eye wò dzi do wò ɖe dzi nèle adegbe ƒom, ke azɔ la nɔ aƒe. Nu ka ta nèbe yeade ɖokuiwò dzɔgbevɔ̃e me eye wò kple Yuda siaa miatsrɔ̃?”

english_verse: so Jehoash led his army to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Ale Israel-fia Yoas ho yi ɖakpe aʋa kple Yuda-fia Amazya. Wodo go le Bet-Semes si nye Yuda tɔ.

translation_verse: Israel-fia Yoas lé Yuda-fia Amazya si nye Yoas vi kple Axazya tɔgbuiyɔvi la le Bet-Semes, eye wòkplɔe va Yerusalem. Egbã Yerusalem-gli la, tso Efrayim-gbo la nu va se ɖe Dzogoedzigbo si didi abe meta alafa eve ene la gbɔ.

english_verse: Everything else Amaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Amazya ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛawo tso eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe gɔmedzedzea va se ɖe nuwuwua la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe Yuda kple Israel-fiawo ƒe Ŋutinyagbalẽ la me.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah started disobeying the Lord, some people in Jerusalem plotted against Amaziah. He was able to escape to the town of Lachish, but another group of people caught him and killed him there.
translation_verse: Tso esime Amazya trɔ le Aƒetɔ yome ko la, woɖo nugbe ɖe eŋu le Yerusalem, eye wòsí yi Laxis. Ke wodɔ ame ɖe eyome le Laxis woɖawui le afi ma.

english_verse: His body was taken to Jerusalem on horseback and buried beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Wokɔ eƒe kukua ɖe sɔ dzi va ɖi ɖe tɔgbuiawo gbɔ le David ƒe du la me.

english_verse: Uzziah supplied his army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and stones used for slinging.
translation_verse: Uziya na wotsɔ akpoxɔnu, akplɔ, gakuku, gawu, da kple akafo me kpewo gɔ̃ hã na asrafoawo dome ame sia ame.

english_verse: Uzziah had leprosy the rest of his life. He was no longer allowed in the temple or in his own palace. That's why his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Ŋutigbalẽdɔ dziŋɔ sia tsi fia Uziya ŋu va se ɖe eƒe kugbe. Le dɔlélea ta la, enɔ aga le xɔ bubu me, eye wotsri Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me vava nɛ. Via Yotam va nɔ fiasã la nu, eye wòɖu dukɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Everything else Uzziah did while he was king is in the records written by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
translation_verse: Nu bubu siwo Uziya wɔ, tso gɔmedzedzea va se ɖe nuwuwua la, gbeƒãɖela Yesaya, Amoz vi la, ŋlɔ wo ɖi.

english_verse: Some of his skilled workers invented machines that could shoot arrows and sling large stones. Uzziah set these up in Jerusalem at his defense towers and at the corners of the city wall. God helped Uzziah become more and more powerful, and he was famous all over the world. translation_verse: Ewɔ mɔ̀ si aɖaŋuwɔlawo to vɛ la ɖe Yerusalem, eye wòtsɔ wo ɖo gbetakpɔxɔ tame kple gliawo ƒe dzogoewo dzi, be woatsɔ ada aŋutrɔwo kple kpe gãwoe. Uziya ŋkɔ de du eye ŋusẽ ɖo eŋu ale gbegbe, elabe wokpe ɖe eŋu nukutɔe. Wohe to na Uziya le eƒe dàda ta

english_verse: God helped him defeat the Philistines, the Arabs living in Gur-Baal, and the Meunites.
