english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Eya ta nu siwo woɖana le nye aƒeme le ŋkeke ɖeka dzie nye: nyitsu ɖeka, alẽ siwo da ami wu bubuawo katã la dometɔ ade, koklowo kple aƒemexe bubuwo fũu. Le ŋkeke ewo sia ŋkeke ewo megbe la, medzea aha zã dana ɖi. To esiawo katã gbɔ hã, nyemena dukɔa xea mɔ́mefiadzikpɔga si wòle be wòanɔ xexem nam la o, elabe mekpɔe be agba te ɖe ameawo dzi akpa.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: O nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku nu siwo katã mewɔ na dukɔ sia la dzi.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Sanebalat, Tobiya, Gesem Arabiatɔ la kple míaƒe futɔ mamlɛawo se be medzra glia ɖo vɔ ale be gbagbãƒe aɖeke megale eŋu o; esusɔ ʋɔtruwo ko made agboawo nu.

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Tete woɖo ame ɖem be: “Va ne míakpe le kɔƒe siwo le Ono-gbadzaƒe la dometɔ ɖeka me.” Ke ɖe woɖoe be mava ko ne yewoawɔ nu vevim le afi ma.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Eya ta medɔ ame ɖe wo be: “Dɔ vevi aɖe le ŋunye mele wɔwɔm; nyemate ŋu ava o. Ale ke magblẽ dɔa ɖi koŋ ko atso, be mava kpɔ mi le kɔƒe me?”

english_verse: They invited me four times, but each time I refused to go.
translation_verse: Wodɔ ame ɖem alea zigbɔzi ene sɔŋ, eye nye hã meɖo eŋu na wo nenema.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Agbalẽa me nyawoe nye be: “Míele sesem le dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã mí la me tɔwo nu be wò kple Yudatɔwo mieɖo be yewoadze aglã, eye nu ma tae miegbugbɔ glia le ɖoɖom ɖo. Gasmu hã gblɔ nya sia mese. Wobe èdi be yeazu Yudatɔwo ƒe fia.

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: Wobe èdi gbeƒãɖelawo da ɖi gɔ̃ hã xoxo be ne eɖo dzi ko woanɔ gbeƒã ɖem le Yerusalem be: ‘Fia ɖo Yuda si azɔ!’ Nya siawo le ɖiɖi ge ade fia gã gbɔ tsã, eya ta va ne míabu tame le nya bliboa ŋu.”

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Meɖo eŋu ɖo ɖee be: “Wò nya siawo ƒe ɖeke menye nyateƒe o. Wò ŋutɔ koe kpa wo le gbɔgblɔm.”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Woƒe taɖodzinue nye be yewoado vɔvɔ̃ na mí be míaƒe lã me natu ɖe dɔa ŋu ne wòase ɖe afi ma. Ke nye la, medo gbe ɖa be: “O Mawu, do ŋusẽm.”

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Azɔ la, meɖi tsa yi Semaya, Mehetabeel vi Delaya, vi ame si nu wodo ʋɔ ɖo la gbɔ. Egblɔ nam be: “Na nye kpli wò míayi aɖakpe le mawuƒe la ƒe kɔkɔeƒe ne míabè ɖe afi ma, atu ʋɔwo ɖe mía ɖokui nu, elabe wogbɔna wu wò ge. Woava wu wò le zã me.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Tete mexɔ edzi nɛ be: “Ko nye ŋutsu xoxo sia masía? Nye koŋ masí ayi ɖabè ɖe gbedoxɔ me be woava wum ta! Nyemayi o.”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Mekpɔ zi ɖeka be menye Mawue dɔe be wòaɖo afɔ afɔta nam o, ke boŋ Tobiya kple Sanebalat woawoe dae.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Wona gae be woado ŋɔdzi nam ne mawɔ nu si medze o, ale be ema nazu nya woalé ɖe nu atsɔ agblẽ nye ŋkɔ, anɔ alɔ me ɖem le ŋunyee.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Medo gbe ɖa be: “O Mawu, ɖo ŋku Tobiya kple Sanebalat ƒe nuwɔna siawo dzi, ne nàhe to na wo. Ðo ŋku nyɔnu gbeƒãɖela Noadia kple gbeƒãɖela bubu siwo katã te kpɔ be yewoado vɔvɔ̃ nam la hã dzi.” Dɔa nuwuwu

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Glia ɖoɖo wu nu le ɣleti Elul ƒe ŋkeke bla eve vɔ atɔ̃lia dzi. Dɔ bliboa xɔ ŋkeke bla atɔ̃ vɔ eve.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Esi dukɔ siwo katã ƒo xlã mí, siwo nye míaƒe futɔwo la, se be míewu glia dzadzraɖo nu la, vɔvɔ̃ kple ŋukpe lé wo ŋutɔ elabe wokpɔ be mía Mawue kpe ɖe mía ŋu ta dɔa te ŋu wu nu.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi katã la, agbalẽ nɔ Yudatɔwo ƒe amegãwo kple Tobiya dome.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo nɔ Tobiya dzi le Yuda, le esi toa Sexanya, Arax vi, nye Yudatɔ, eye via hã ɖe Berexya vi, Mesulam, ƒe vinyɔnu ta.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Amewo vana koŋ va nɔa ekafum le gbɔnye. Ne wole esia wɔm, eye mede nu eme gblɔ nya aɖe si ku ɖe eŋu ko la, woƒua du yina ɖagblɔnɛ nɛ. Tobiya ŋutɔ ŋlɔ agbalẽ nam zi geɖe be yeatsɔ ado vɔvɔ̃ nam.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Yerusalem-du la lolo ŋutɔ. Ele nyadrii gake amewo mesɔ gbɔ le eme o. Xɔtuƒe geɖewo li siwo wometu xɔ ɖo haɖe o.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from each family group:
translation_verse: Gibeon viŋutsuwo le ame bla asieke vɔ atɔ̃.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Senaa viŋutsuwo le ame akpe etɔ̃ alafa asieke bla etɔ̃.

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from the families of Levites:
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlaawo: Salum viŋutsuwo, Ater viŋutsuwo, Talmon viŋutsuwo, Akub viŋutsuwo, Xatita viŋutsuwo kple Sobai viŋutsuwo, wole ame alafa ɖeka bla etɔ̃ vɔ enyi.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until he lets us know if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Anyigba dzikpɔla la de se na wo be womekpɔ mɔ agaɖu vɔsanu kɔkɔetɔa ƒe ɖeke o, negbe nunɔla aɖe ɖe wòtsɔ Urim kple Tumim va tso nya me hafi. Aboyometsolaawo kple woƒe nuwo ƒe xexlẽme

english_verse: Many people gave gifts to help pay for the materials to rebuild the temple. The governor himself gave
translation_verse: Nu siwo dukɔ mamlɛa na la woe nye: sika kilo alafa ɖeka bla ene kple nunɔlawo ƒe dziwui bla ade vɔ adrẽ.

english_verse: bowls to be used in the temple, and
translation_verse: Reaya viŋutsuwo, Rezin viŋutsuwo, Nekoda viŋutsuwo

english_verse: And so, by the seventh month, priests, Levites, temple guards, musicians, workers, and many of the ordinary people had settled in the towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Ale nunɔlawo, Levi viwo, agbonudzɔlawo, hadzilawo, dukɔmetɔ bubu geɖewo, gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo kple Israel blibo yi ɖale wo deduwo me. Esi ƒè la ƒe ɣleti adrẽlia ɖo la, Israelviwo le woƒe duwo me.

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, the people came together in the open area in front of the Water Gate. Then they asked Ezra, who was a teacher of the Law of Moses, to read to them from this Law that the Lord had given his people. Ezra the priest came with the Law and stood before the crowd of men, women, and the children who were old enough to understand.
translation_verse: Tete Ezra, nunɔla la, tsɔ agbalẽa va ƒuƒoƒea ŋkume. Ŋutsuwo, nyɔnuwo, ame siwo katã nyagbe tsi ase nu eye woase nu gɔme hã ko va ɖi anyi gbe ma gbe, si nye ɣleti adrẽlia ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: Aɖakago gã gbadza aɖe si wokpa koŋ ɖe ŋkekea ŋu la dzie Ezra, agbalẽfiala la tsi tsitre ɖo. Matitya, Sema, Anaya, Uriya, Hilkiya kple Maaseya tsi tsitre ɖe eƒe ɖusime, eye Pedaya, Misael, Malkiya, Xasum Xasbadana, Zaxarya kple Mesulam hã tsi tsitre ɖe eƒe miame.

english_verse: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.
translation_verse: Ezra ʋu agbalẽ la le ameawo katã ŋkume wokpɔ, elabe eya le kɔkɔƒe wu ameawo katã. Esi wòʋui la, ameawo katã tsi tsitre.

english_verse: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete Ezra kafu Aƒetɔ, Mawu gã la, eye dukɔ blibo la do asi ɖe dzi, xɔ edzi be: “Neva eme! Neva eme!” Wobɔbɔ, subɔ Aƒetɔ, eye wotsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: Woxlẽa Mawu ƒe Se la tso agbalẽa me eme kɔna, eye wogagbugbɔna ɖea egɔme be ameawo katã nase eme nyuie.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Tete Nexemya, anyigba dzikpɔla la, Ezra, nunɔla kple agbalẽfiala kple Levi vi siwo fiaa nu dukɔa la gblɔ na dukɔ blibo la be: “Ŋkeke sia le kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la; migafa konyi alo afa avi o.” Elabe dukɔ blibo la fa avi esime wose sea ƒe nyawo.

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na wo be: “Miheyi, ne miaɖu aminu eye miano wain vivi, eye miana nu siawo ƒe ɖe ame si mekpɔ ɖeke aɖu alo ano o la hã, elabe ŋkeke sia le kɔkɔe na mía Aƒetɔ eya ta migalé blanui o; elabe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu nye míaƒe ŋusẽ.”

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Ale Levi viwo tsi hoowɔwɔ la nu le ameawo dome nɔ akɔ fam na wo katã be: “Mizi ɖoɖoe elabe ŋkeke sia le kɔkɔe; migalé blanui o.”

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Tete ameha la kaka eye ame sia ame yi eƒeme ɖaɖu nu, no nu, na nuɖuɖu kple nunono amewo eye wokpɔ dzidzɔ. Wodo vivi geɖe ɖe ŋkekea ŋu, elabe wose nu siwo wogblɔ na wo la me nyuie. Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Le ŋufɔke la, ƒomeawo ƒe tatɔwo kple nunɔlawo kpakple Levi viwo ƒo ƒu va Ezra agbalẽfiala la gbɔ be yewoadzro se la ƒe nyawo me kplii.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Woke ɖe eŋu be woŋlɔ ɖe se si Aƒetɔ de na dukɔa to Mose dzi la me, be ele be Israelviwo naʋu ayi ɖanɔ agbadɔwo me le Agbadɔ ŋkekenyui ɖuɣi le ɣleti adrẽlia me,

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
translation_verse: eye be woaŋlɔ agbalẽ, aɖe gbeƒã le Yerusalem-dua ƒe afi sia afi kple du bubuawo me be: “Miyi togbɛwo dzi ne miatso amiti ŋutɔ ƒe alɔwo, gbememiti ƒe alɔwo, mirte ƒe alɔwo, deʋayawo kple ati dɔdɔe ƒe alɔwo ne miatsɔ va wɔ agbadɔwo abe ale si woŋlɔ ɖi le sea me la ene.”

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Tete dukɔ la yi ɖatso atilɔawo tsɔ va wɔ agbadɔwo ɖe woƒe xɔwo tame, woƒe xɔxɔnuwo, Yerusalem-gbedoxɔ la ƒe xɔxɔnuwo kple gbadzaƒe si le Tsigbo gbɔ kple esi le Efrayim ŋkume.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
translation_verse: Ale dukɔ blibo la, ame siwo katã gbɔ tso aboyo me la, tu agbadɔwo, eye woʋu yi ɖanɔ wo me le ŋkekenyuia ɖuɣi katã, elabe tso Yosua, Nun vi, ŋɔli va se ɖe ɣe ma ɣi kpa Israel-dukɔ mewɔ nu sia kpɔ o, eye wònye dzidzɔ gã na ame sia ame.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Tso ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi va se ɖe mlɔetɔ dzi la, exlẽa nu tso Mawu ƒe segbalẽ la me gbe sia gbe kokoko. Woɖu azã la ŋkeke adrẽ, eye le enyilia gbe la, wowu enu kple takpekpe tɔxɛ, abe ale si wònye kɔnui ene.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Le ɣleti ma ke ƒe ŋkeke bla eve vɔ enelia dzi la, Israelviwo va ƒo ƒu be yewoaɖe vevesese afia ɖe yewoƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta. Wotsi nu dɔ, ta akpanya eye wolɔ ke kɔ ɖe tame.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Do ŋgɔ la, woɖe wo ɖokui ɖe aga tso ame siwo katã menye Israelviwo o la gbɔ. Wotsi tsitre, eye woʋu nuvɔ̃ siwo woawo ŋutɔ kple wo tɔgbuiwo wɔ la me.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Eyome woxlẽ Aƒetɔ, woƒe Mawu ƒe se la na wo. Sea xexlẽ alea xɔ gaƒoƒo etɔ̃ lɔƒo. Le gaƒoƒo etɔ̃ siwo kplɔ sea xexlẽ ɖo me la, woʋu woƒe nuvɔ̃wo me, eye wode ta agu ɖe Aƒetɔ, woƒe Mawu la ŋkume.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Nɔƒe kɔkɔ tɔxɛ aɖe li koŋ na Levi viwo, afi si Yesua, Bani, Kadmiel, Sebanya, Buni, Serebya, Bani kple Kenani, siwo katã nye Levi viwo la tsi tsitre ɖo. Tete Levi vi siawo do gbe ɖa kple gbe sesẽ na Aƒetɔ, woƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said: “Stand and shout praises to your Lord, the eternal God! Praise his wonderful name, though he is greater than words can express.” The People Pray
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesua, Kadmiel, Bani, Xasabneya, Serebya, Hodiya, Sebanya kple Petanya, siwo katã nye Levi viwo la, do ɣli gblɔ be: “Mitsi tsitre ne miakafu Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la; mikafui tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Ame sia ame nekafu eŋkɔ kɔkɔe, si kɔ gbɔ yayra kafukafuwo katã ta.” Nu vɔ̃ me ʋuʋu gbedodoɖa

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: Ezra gblɔ be: “Wò ɖeka koe nye Aƒetɔ; wòe wɔ dziƒowo kple dziƒowo ƒe dziƒo kple wo ŋuti nuwo. Wòe wɔ anyigba kple atsiaƒu kpakple nu siwo katã le anyigba dzi kple atsiaƒu me. Wòe na agbe wo katã. Dziƒoʋakɔwo subɔa wò.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: Wòe nye Aƒetɔ, Mawu, si tia Abram, kplɔe tso Ur le Kaldea, eye nètrɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Abraham.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: Èkpɔe be eɖi anukware na ye, eye nèbla nu kplii. Èdo ŋugbe be yeatsɔ Kanaantɔwo, Xititɔwo, Amoritɔwo, Perizitɔwo, Yebusitɔwo kple Girgasitɔwo ƒe anyigbawo anae wòanye anyigba si dzi eƒe dzidzimeviwo anɔ. Èwɔ wò ŋugbedodo la dzi elabe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla nènye.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: Èkpɔ ale si mía tɔgbuiwo kpe fu le Egipte; èse woƒe ɣli le Aƒlaƒu nu.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: Èwɔ dzesiwo kple nukunu manyagblɔwo tsɔ tsi tre ɖe Egipte Fiagã kple eƒe dɔlawo kpakple eƒe anyigba dzi tɔwo katã ŋu elabe ènya ale si wowɔ amemabunu ɖe wo ŋui. To ema me èna wò ŋkɔ ɖi hoo, abe ale si wògale ɖiɖim egbee ene.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: Èma ƒu la me ɖe eve le wò dukɔ la ŋgɔ, eye nèkplɔ wo to anyigba ƒuƒui le ƒu titina. Ke ame siwo ɖe wo ɖe nu la nyrɔ ɖe tsia ƒe gogloƒewo abe ale si kpe yia to le ƒu dzeagbo me la ene.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ alilikpo dodo kplɔ wo le ŋkeke me, eye le zã me la, èna dzo klẽ ɖe mɔ dzi na wo.

english_verse: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.
translation_verse: Èɖi tso dziƒo va, le Sinai-to gbɔ. Èƒo nu na wò dukɔ le afi ma, wɔ se nyuiwo na wo, eye woxɔ nufiame deblibowo tso gbɔwò.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: Èfia wo be woawɔ wò dzudzɔgbewo kɔkɔe; ède sewo na wo to wò dɔla Mose dzi.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Esi dɔ wu wo la, èna abolo si tso dziƒo la wo, eye esi tsikɔ wu wo la, èna tsi do tso agakpe me na wo. Èɖe gbe na wo be woayi ɖaxɔ anyigba si ŋugbe nèdo na wo la, ne wòanye wo tɔ.

english_verse: Our stubborn ancestors refused to obey— they forgot about the miracles you had worked for them, and they were determined to return to Egypt and become slaves again.
translation_verse: “Gake dàda va xɔ aƒe ɖe mía tɔgbuiwo me; wolia kɔ, eye wogbe be yewomawɔ wò sewo dzi o.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Wowɔ nyivilegba na wo ɖokui, eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo be: ‘Esiae nye wò Mawu si kplɔ wò tso Egipte.’ Togbɔ be wowɔ busunu sia kple bubuwo hã la,

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: mègblẽ wo ɖe gbedzi o, le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔgbɔ la ta. Mèna alilikpo si nɔa ŋgɔ na wo le ŋkeke me la bu ɖe wo loo, alo dzò babla si klẽna ɖe mɔ dzi na wo le zã me la dzó le wo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Your gentle Spirit instructed them, and you gave them manna to eat and water to drink.
translation_verse: Èna wò gbɔgbɔ nyui la wo, be wòafia nu wo. Mèɖe wò mana le woƒe nu me o, eye èna tsi wo wono.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: Ènyi wo ƒe bla ene sɔŋ le gbedadaƒo, eye naneke mehiã wo o. Awu mevuvu le wo ŋu o; woƒe afɔ hã mete o.

english_verse: You let them conquer kings and take their land, including King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ dukɔwo kple fiaɖuƒewo de asi na wo. Èna woxɔ dukɔ siwo do liƒo kpli wo la ƒe anyigbawo. Èna woxɔ Xesbon-fia Sixon ƒe anyigba; èna woxɔ Basan-fia Og ƒe anyigba.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Èna wo viwo sɔ gbɔ abe ɣletiviwo le dziŋgɔli me ene, eye èkplɔ wo va anyigba si nègblɔ na wo tɔgbuiwo be woayi aɖaxɔ wòazu wo tɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: Then their descendants conquered the land. You helped them defeat the kings and nations and treat their enemies however they wished.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzidzimeviawo yi ɖadze anyigba la dzi, eye nèna woɖu Kanaantɔwo, ame siwo nye anyigbaa dzi nɔlawo la, dzi. Ètsɔ Kanaantɔawo, anyigba dzi fiawo kple wo teviwo siaa de wo si me be woawɔ wo ale si wolɔ̃.

english_verse: They captured strong cities and rich farmland; they took furnished houses, as well as cisterns, vineyards, olive orchards, and numerous fruit trees. They ate till they were satisfied, and they celebrated your abundant blessings.
translation_verse: Woxɔ du sesẽ geɖewo, anyigba wɔnukuwo, aƒewo kple xɔwo, siwo me yɔ fũu kple kesinɔnuwo. Woxɔ tsivudowo, waingblewo, amitigblewo kple atikutsetsegble vovovowo. Woɖu nu, ɖi ƒo, da ami, eye to nu nyui gbogbo siwo nève wo nu trɔ kɔ ɖe wo dzime la, woɖu agbe blibo.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: “To esiawo katã gbɔ hã wosẽ to, dze aglã ɖe ŋuwò, tsɔ wò se la ƒu gbe ɖe megbe. Wowu gbeƒãɖela siwo gbe nya na wo, ame siwo xlɔ̃ nu wo be woagbugbɔ va gbɔwò la, eye wowɔ busunu manyagblɔwo.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Eya ta ètsɔ wo de asi na woƒe futɔ siwo na wokpe fu vevie. Le woƒe fukpekpe me la, wodo ɣli yɔ wò be nàxɔ na yewo. Èse woƒe ɣli le dziƒo, eye le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔgbɔ la nu èna xɔnametɔwo wo, wova ɖe wo tso futɔawo si me.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Ke esi wogakpɔ gbɔdzɔe ko la, wogawɔ vɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò. Ale nèzi kpi kpɔ wo wogage ɖe futɔwo si me, eye futɔawo gate wo ɖe to. Gake esi wogado ɣli yɔ wò la, ègase woƒe kokoƒoƒo le dziƒo, eye nègaɖe wo le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã la nu.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Ègbɔ dzi ɖi na wo ƒè geɖee; ètsɔ wò Gbɔgbɔ xlɔ̃ nu wo to wò gbeƒãɖelawo dzi gake wogbe, gagbe ake. Eya ta ètsɔ wo de asi na dukɔ siwo le anyigbawo dzi.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.
translation_verse: Gake le ale si gbegbe nèkpɔa nublanui ta la, mètsrɔ̃ wo loo, alo gblẽ wo ɖi o elabe wò la, Mawu amenuvela, nublanuikpɔlae nènye.

english_verse: Our God, you are powerful, fearsome, and faithful, always true to your word. So please keep in mind the terrible sufferings of our people, kings, leaders, priests, and prophets, from the time Assyria ruled until this very day.
translation_verse: “Eya ta azɔ la, mía Mawu, Mawu gã ŋusẽtɔ, wò ame si ŋu ŋɔdzi le! Wò ame si léa wò nubabla kple wò lɔlɔ̃ matrɔ la me ɖe asi! Mègana fukpekpe siwo katã va míawo ŋutɔ, míaƒe fiawo, míaƒe amegãwo, míaƒe nunɔlawo, míaƒe gbeƒãɖelawo, mía tɔ́wo kple wò dukɔ blibo la dzi, tso Asiria-fiawo ŋɔli va de asi na egbe la, nanye nu tsɛ ko le ŋkuwò me o.

english_verse: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.
translation_verse: Míaƒe fiawo, amegãwo, nunɔlawo kple mía tɔgbuiwo mezɔ ɖe wò se la nu o. Womelé fɔ ɖe wò sededewo kple wò nuxlɔ̃amenyawo ŋu o.

english_verse: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.
translation_verse: Esi wole woƒe fiaɖuƒe me kple wò kesinɔnu gbogbo si nètsɔ ke wo la dome, eye wole anyigba gã wɔnu dzi hã la, womesubɔ wò o, eye wometrɔ tso woƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiawo me o.

english_verse: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock. The People Make an Agreement
translation_verse: Anyigba la metsonu damiawo yina na fia siwo te nètsɔ mí de le míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta la. Fia siawo kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe míaƒe ameti la kple míaƒe lãwo siaa dzi; wowɔa nu sia nu si dze wo ŋu la mí faa. Míaƒe nu wɔ nublanui ŋutɔ!” Dukɔ la ɖe adzɔgbe

english_verse: And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.
translation_verse: Le nu siawo katã ta la, míebla nu, si maʋã o, ŋlɔe ɖi, eye míaƒe amegãwo, míaƒe Levi viwo kple míaƒe nunɔlawo ɖo ŋkɔ ete.

english_verse: As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests:
translation_verse: Ame siwo ɖo ŋkɔ ete lawoe nye anyigbaa dzikpɔla Nexemya, Xaxalya vi Zedekiya.

english_verse: The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel,
translation_verse: Levi viwo: Yesua Azanya vi, Binui si tso Xenadad viŋutsuwo dome kple Kadmiel,

english_verse: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
translation_verse: wo tɔ bubuwoe nye: Sebanya, Hodiya, Kelita, Pelaya, Xanan,

english_verse: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
translation_verse: Mixa, Rexob, Xasabya,

english_verse: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Sekur, Serebya, Sebanya,

english_verse: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation_verse: Hodiya, Bani kple Beninu,

english_verse: The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
translation_verse: Dukɔ la ƒe tatɔwo: Pareos, Paxat-Moab, Elam, Zatu, Bani

english_verse: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
translation_verse: Buni, Azgad, Bebai

english_verse: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation_verse: Adoniya, Bigevai, Adin

english_verse: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation_verse: Ater, Xizkiya, Azur,

english_verse: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation_verse: Xodiya, Xasum, Bezai,

english_verse: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
translation_verse: Xarif, Anatot, Nebai,

english_verse: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
translation_verse: Magpias, Mesulam, Xezir,

english_verse: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
translation_verse: Mesezabeel, Zadok, Yadua,

english_verse: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
translation_verse: Pelatya, Xanan, Anaya

english_verse: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
translation_verse: Hosea, Xananya, Xasub

english_verse: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
translation_verse: Xaloxes, Pilxa, Sobek,

english_verse: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
translation_verse: Rexum, Xasabna, Maaseya,

english_verse: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
translation_verse: Axiya, Xanan, Anan

english_verse: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Agreement
translation_verse: Malux, Xarim kple Baana. Adzɔgbeɖeɖe la

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
translation_verse: míekpe ɖe mía nɔvi dukɔa me bubumewo ŋu hele atam kam be míazɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe Se si wòde to eƒe dɔla Mose dzi la nu, be míalé Aƒetɔ, mía Aƒetɔ ƒe sewo katã, kɔnuwo kple ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi, eye míawɔ wo dzi. Ne míetu atam sia la, fiƒode neva mía dzi.

english_verse: We won't let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Míatsɔ mía vinyɔnuwo ana anyigbaa dzi tɔwo viŋutsuwo woaɖe o, eye míaɖe wo vinyɔnuwo na mía viŋutsuwo o.

english_verse: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
translation_verse: Ne anyigbaa dzi tɔwo tsɔ woƒe adzɔnuwo alo agblemenukuwo vɛ le dzudzɔgbe alo ŋkeke kɔkɔe aɖe dzi be yewoadzra la, míaƒle wo o. Le ƒè adrẽlia sia ƒe adrẽlia me la, míade agble o, eye ne míaƒe fe le ame aɖe ŋu la, míatsɔe akee.

english_verse: This is to pay for the sacred bread, as well as for the daily sacrifices and special sacrifices such as those offered on the Sabbath and during the New Moon Festival and the other festivals. It will also pay for the sacrifices to forgive our sins and for all expenses connected with the worship of God in the temple.
translation_verse: Nu siawo ƒe ɖewoe nye: vɔsabolo, gbe sia gbe nuɖuɖuvɔsa, gbe sia gbe numemevɔsa, dzudzɔgbewo, dzinu yeye vɔsawo, ŋkeke ɖoɖiwo, nu kɔkɔeawo kple vɔsa hena Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖeɖeɖa kpakple mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ŋudɔwo katã.

english_verse: We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
translation_verse: Nenema ke mí nunɔlawo, Levi viwo kple dukɔ hahoa míedzidze nu ɖe nakenana dzi be Israel ƒe to vovovoawo nanɔ etsɔtsɔ va mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me ɖɔlim le wo nɔewo dome ƒè sia ƒè. Woanɔ etsɔm vɛ le ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖiwo dzi be woatsɔe anɔ dzo dom le Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu ƒe vɔsamlekpui dzi abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi le Se la me ene.

english_verse: Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.
translation_verse: Míetsɔe ɖo mía ɖokui dzi hã be ƒe sia ƒe la, míatsɔ míaƒe agblemenuku gbãtɔwo kple míaƒe atikutsetse gbãtɔwo ava Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
translation_verse: Míatsɔ mía viŋutsu ŋgɔgbeviwo kple míaƒe aƒemelãwo: nyiwo, alẽwo kple gbɔ̃wo ƒe vi gbãtɔwo ava na nunɔla siwo le subɔsubɔdɔ wɔm le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe Se la me ene.

english_verse: To the priests in the temple of our God, we will bring the bread dough from the first harvest, together with our best fruit, and an offering of new wine and olive oil. We will bring ten percent of our grain harvest to those Levites who are responsible for collecting it in our towns.
translation_verse: Nenema ke míatsɔ amɔwɔ gbãtɔwo, míaƒe nudzɔdzɔ gbãtɔ, míaƒe kutsetseti ɖe sia ɖe ƒe tsetse gbãtɔ, míaƒe aha kple míaƒe ami gbãtɔwo ava na nunɔlawo le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me. Míadzɔ míaƒe agblemenukuwo ƒe akpa ewolia na Levi viwo, ame siwo dzɔa nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia le míaƒe agblededuwo me la.

english_verse: A priest from the family of Aaron must be there when we give this to the Levites. Then the Levites will put one tenth of this part in the temple storeroom,
translation_verse: Ne Levi viawo le nu ewolia dzɔm la, ele be nunɔla aɖe si nye Aron ƒe dzidzimevi la nanɔ wo ŋu. Levi viawo atsɔ nu ewolia siwo wodzɔ la ƒe ƒuƒoƒo ƒe akpa ewolia ayi nudzraɖoƒexɔwo me le mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers. Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room. We will not neglect the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Xɔ siawo mee Israel-dukɔmeviwo kple Levi viwo atsɔ nuku, aha kple ami siwo wodzɔ la ayii. Xɔ siawo mee gbedoxɔa me tsikunu kple agba vovovoawo nɔna. Afi mawo kee nunɔla siwo le subɔsubɔdɔ wɔm kple agbonudzɔlawo kpakple hadzilawo hã nɔna. Nuawo nayi alea be míagblẽ mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖi ɣeaɖekeɣi o.

english_verse: The nation's leaders and their families settled in Jerusalem. But there was room for only one out of every ten of the remaining families, and so they asked God to show them who would live there.
translation_verse: Dukɔ la ƒe amegãwo tsi Yerusalem-du me wòzu wo nɔƒe koŋ. Ke le ame mamlɛawo gome la, wodzidze nu. Nudzidze la dze ame ewolia sia ame ewolia dzi, eye wònye dzizizi na nenem me mawo be woaʋu ava nɔ Yerusalem-du kɔkɔe la me. Ke ame mamlɛawo anɔ du bubuwo me. Ame aɖewo siwo dzi nudzidze la medze o la hã tsɔ wo ɖokui na faa be yewoanɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families. The Judah Tribe
translation_verse: Nutoa me dzikpɔlawo nɔ Yerusalem. Ke dukɔa me tɔ bubuawo, nunɔlawo, Levi viwo, gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo kple Salomo ƒe dɔlawo ƒe dzidzimeviwo ya nɔ du bubuawo me. Ame sia ame nɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒeme le wo de. Ke hã la, Yuda-to la me tɔ aɖewo kple Benyamin-to la me tɔ aɖewo hã ʋu va tsi Yerusalem.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe, three leaders settled in Jerusalem. The first was Sallu son of Meshullam, and the others were Gabbai and Sallai. Sallu's ancestors were Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, Ithiel, and Jeshaiah. Altogether, there were
translation_verse: Gabai kple Salai. Ale Benyamin-to la me ŋutsu siwo va tsi Yerusalem la ƒe xexlẽme le alafa asieke bla eve vɔ enyi.

english_verse: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command. Priests
translation_verse: Wo nunɔlae nye Yoel, Zixri vi. Yuda, Hasenua vie nye dua dzikpɔla ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ.

english_verse: The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest.
translation_verse: Seraya nye Xilkiya vi kple Mesulam ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi. Etɔgbuitɔgbui aɖewo, tso ɖevitɔ dzi heyi tsitsitɔ dzi la woe nye Zadok, Merayot kple Axitub. Axitub sia nye amegã le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.
translation_verse: Levi viwo: Semaya, Xasub vi, Azrikam ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi. Tɔgbuia tɔ́e nye Xasabya, eye Xasabya tɔ́e nye Buni.

english_verse: Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.
translation_verse: Zabetai kple Yozabad nye Levitɔwo ƒe tatɔwo dometɔ siwo kpɔa Mawu ƒe aƒe la ƒe gotadɔwo ƒe nyawo gbɔ.

english_verse: Then there was Mattaniah son of Mica. His ancestors were Zabdi and Asaph. Mattaniah led the temple choir in the prayer of praise. Bakbukiah, who also settled in Jerusalem, was his assistant. Finally, there was Abda son of Shammua; his grandfather was Galal, and his great-grandfather was Jeduthun.
translation_verse: Matanya, Mixa vi, nye Zabdi ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi, eye wòganye Asaf ƒe tɔgbuitɔgbuiyɔvi. Eyae doa akpedaha ɖa le gbedoɖaɣiwo. Wotia Bakbukya, Matanya nɔviwo dometɔ ɖeka be wòanɔ kpekpem ɖe eŋu; Abda, Samua vi, si tɔgbuie nye Galal eye etɔgbuitɔgbuia nye Yedutun.

english_verse: One hundred seventy-two temple guards settled in Jerusalem; their leaders were Akkub and Talmon.
translation_verse: Agbonudzɔlawo: Akub, Talmon kple wo nɔvi bubu aɖewo. Wo katã ƒe xexlẽme de alafa ɖeka bla adrẽ vɔ eve.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Israelvi mamlɛawo kple nunɔla mamlɛawo kpakple Levi vi susɔeawo kaka ɖe Yuda-duwo me, ɖe sia ɖe nɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.
translation_verse: Gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo nɔ Ofel, eye ŋutsu siwo ŋkɔwo nye Zixa kple Gispa lae nɔ wo nu.

english_verse: Uzzi son of Bani was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem. His grandfather was Hashabiah, his great-grandfather was Mattaniah, and his great-great-grandfather was Mica. He belonged to the Asaph clan that was in charge of the music for the temple services,
translation_verse: Levi vi siwo nɔ Yerusalem-du me la nunɔlae nye Uzi, Bani vi, ame si nye Yasabiya vi, ame si nye Matanya vi, ame si nye Mixa vi tso Asaf-ƒome si kpɔa hadzidzi le gbedoxɔ me ƒe nyawo gbɔ la me.

english_verse: though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.
translation_verse: Elabe fia de se hewɔ ɖoɖo ɖe hadzilawo ƒe nuhiahiãwo ŋu abe ale si wòhiã gbe sia gbe la ene.

english_verse: The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe. The People in the Other Towns and Villages
translation_verse: Petaxya, Mesezabeel viŋutsu si tso Yuda vi Zerax ƒe ƒome me lae nye Israelviwo teƒenɔla le Persia-fia gbɔ. Ame siwo nɔ du bubuwo me

english_verse: Some of the people of Judah lived in the following towns near their farms: Kiriath-Arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel,
translation_verse: Yuda vi siwo nɔ woƒe agblewo me la dometɔ aɖewo nɔ Kiriyat-Arba kple eƒe kɔƒewo me, Dibon kple eƒe kɔƒewo me, Yekabzeel kple eƒe agbletawo,

english_verse: Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-Pelet,
translation_verse: Yesua, Molada kple Bet-Pelet,

english_verse: Enrimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,
translation_verse: En-Rimon, Zora kple Yarmut,

english_verse: Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.
translation_verse: Zanoax, Adulam kple eƒe agbletawo, Laxis kple eƒe agblewo me, Azeka kple eƒe kɔƒewo me. Ale womlo ɖe nu tso Beer-Seba va se ɖe Hinom-bali la me.

english_verse: The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages,
translation_verse: Benyamin viwo nɔ Geba le Mixmas, Aya, Betel kple eƒe kɔƒewo me,

english_verse: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
translation_verse: Anatot, Nob, Ananya,

english_verse: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
translation_verse: Xazor, Rama, Gitaim,

english_verse: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
translation_verse: Xadid, Zeboim, Nebalat,

english_verse: Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley.
translation_verse: Lod kple Ono kple aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo ƒe bali la me.

english_verse: Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ke wotsɔ Levi viwo ƒe ha siwo nɔ Yuda la dometɔ aɖewo ɖakpe ɖe Benyamin viwo ŋu.

english_verse: Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
translation_verse: Nunɔla kple Levi vi siwo zɔ aduadu kple Zerubabel, Sealtiel vi kpakple Yesua la woe nye: Seraya, Yeremya, Ezra,

english_verse: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
translation_verse: Amarya, Malux, Xatus,

english_verse: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
translation_verse: Sexanya, Rexum, Meremot,

english_verse: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
translation_verse: Ido, Ginetoi, Abiya,

english_verse: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
translation_verse: Miyamin, Maadya, Bilga,

english_verse: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
translation_verse: Semaya, Yoyarib, Yedaya,

english_verse: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and another Jedaiah. These were the leading priests and their assistants during the time of Joshua.
translation_verse: Salu, Amok, Xilkiya kple Yedaya. Ame siawo nye kplɔlawo le wo tɔ nunɔlawo dome le Yesua ŋɔli.

english_verse: The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise,
translation_verse: Levi viwo: Yesua, Binui, Kadmiel, Serebya, Yuda kple Matanya. Matanya kple eƒe ƒome me ŋutsuwoe doa kafukafuhawo ɖa le subɔsubɔwɔɣi.

english_verse: while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses. Descendants of Joshua the High Priest
translation_verse: Ne wodo ha ɖa la, Bakbukya kple Umi ye xenɛ. Wo ame eve la nɔa tsitre dzea ŋgɔ hadoɖalaawo. Nunɔlagã Yesua ƒe dzidzimeviwo

english_verse: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada.
translation_verse: Yesua dzi Yehoyakim, Yehoyakim dzi Elyasib, Elyasib dzi Yoyada;

english_verse: Joiada was the father of Jonathan and the grandfather of Jaddua. Leaders of the Priestly Clans
translation_verse: Yoyada dzi Yonatan, eye Yonatan dzi Yadua. Nunɔlawo ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo

english_verse: When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Le Yehoyakim ŋɔli la, nunɔla siwo nye tatɔwo na aƒekɔwo la woe nye: Meraya na Seraya; Xananya na Yeremya;

english_verse: Meshullam of Ezra, Jehohanan of Amariah,
translation_verse: Mesulam na Ezra; Yehohanan na Amarya;

english_verse: Jonathan of Malluchi, Joseph of Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Yonatan na Meluxi; Yosef na Sebanya;

english_verse: Adna of Harim, Helkai of Meraioth,
translation_verse: Adua na Xarim; Xelkai na Merayot;

english_verse: Zechariah of Iddo, Meshullam of Ginnethon,
translation_verse: Zaxarya na Ido; Mesulam na Gineton;

english_verse: Zichri of Abijah, Piltai of Moadiah,
translation_verse: Sixri na Abiya; Piltai na Minyamin-Moadya;

english_verse: Shammua of Bilgah, Jehonathan of Shemaiah,
translation_verse: Samua na Bilga; Yonatan na Semaya;

english_verse: Mattenai of Joiarib, Uzzi of Jedaiah,
translation_verse: Matenai na Yoyarib; Uzi na Pedaya;

english_verse: Kallai of Sallai, Eber of Amok,
translation_verse: Kalai na Salai; Eber na Amok;

english_verse: Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah. The Priestly and Levite Families
translation_verse: Xasabya na Xilkiya; Netaneel na Yedaya. Wode nunɔlawo ƒe aƒekɔtatɔwo kple Levi viwo ƒe aƒekɔtatɔwo ƒe ŋkɔ agbalẽ me

english_verse: During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families.
translation_verse: Le Elyasib, Yoyada, Yehohanan kple Yadua ŋɔli la, woŋlɔ Levi viwo ƒe aƒekɔtatɔwo kple nunɔlawo ŋkɔwo ɖi va se ɖe Persia-fia Dario ƒe fiaɖuɣi.

english_verse: However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
translation_verse: Nenema ke woŋlɔ aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔ siwo nye Levi viwo la ŋkɔwo ɖe nyadzɔdzɔ veviwo ƒe agbalẽwo me va se ɖe Yehohanan, Elyasib vi ŋɔli. Gbedoxɔ me dɔwo mama na amewo

english_verse: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.
translation_verse: Levi viwo ƒe amegãwo: Xasabya, Sevebya kple Yesua, Kadmiel vi la. Wodzea ŋgɔ wo nɔvi bubuawo le mawuxɔ la me, eye wokafua Mawu, daa akpe nɛ hã, abe ale si David, Mawu ƒe ame ɖo ɖi be woanɔ wɔwɔm ene, ameha ɖe ameha yome.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.
translation_verse: Matanya, Bakbukya, Obadya, Mesulam, Talmon kple Akub nye agbonudzɔlawo. Woawoe dzɔa nudzraɖoƒexɔ siwo le agboawo nu la ŋu.

english_verse: All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest. Nehemiah Dedicates the City Wall
translation_verse: Ame siawo wɔ dɔ le Yehoyakim, si nye Yesua vi kple Yozadak ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi la ŋɔli. Nexemya, anyigba nunɔla kple Ezra, ame si nye nunɔla kple agbalẽfiala la hã nɔ anyi le ɣe ma ɣi me. Nexemya kɔ Yerusalem glia ŋu

english_verse: When the city wall was dedicated, Levites from everywhere in Judah were invited to join in the celebration with songs of praise and with the music of cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Esi wòɖo edzi be woakɔ Yerusalem-glia ŋu la, woyi ɖadi Levi viwo tso wo nɔƒewo katã vɛ ne woaɖu glia ŋuti kɔkɔ ŋkekenyui la kple dzidzɔ, akpedada, hadzidzi kpakple gakogoewo, kasaŋkuwo kple dzewo.

english_verse: The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.
translation_verse: Bubuwo tso Bet-Gilgal kple Geba kpakple Azmavet nutowo me elabe hadzilaawo tsò kɔƒe na wo ɖokui ƒo xlã Yerusalem-dua godoo.

english_verse: The priests and Levites held special ceremonies to make themselves holy, and then they did the same for the rest of the people and for the gates and walls of the city.
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo kɔ wo ɖokui ŋu; eyome wokɔ ameha la kple agboawo kpakple glia hã ŋu.

english_verse: I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate.
translation_verse: Azɔ mena Yuda-megãwo kple hadzilawo de glia dzi. Mema hadzilaawo ɖe akpa eve me: akpa gbãtɔ to ɖusime le glia dzi ɖo ta Akɔligbo la gbɔ.

english_verse: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them.
translation_verse: Ame siwo kplɔ wo ɖo la woe nye: Hosaya kple Yuda-megãwo ƒe afã,

english_verse: Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
translation_verse: Azarya, Ezra kple Mesulam,

english_verse: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Yuda, Benyamin, Semaya kple Yeremya.

english_verse: and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played musical instruments like those that had been played by David, the man of God. And they marched behind Ezra, the teacher of the Law.
translation_verse: Nɔviawoe nye: Semaya, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netaneel, Yuda kple Xanani. Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe lé David, Mawu ƒe ame, ƒe hadzinuwo ɖe asi. Ezra, agbalẽfiala gã la, nɔ wo ŋgɔ.

english_verse: When they reached Fountain Gate, they climbed the steps to David's City and went past his palace, before stopping at the Water Gate near the eastern wall of the city.
translation_verse: Esi woɖo Vudogbo gbɔ la, woto wo ŋgɔ tẽe lia atrakpui si yi David ƒe du me. Wolia gli la to David ƒe fiasã gbɔ ɖado ɖe Tsigbo gbɔ le dua ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome.

english_verse: The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall,
translation_verse: Akpedahadzilawo ƒe ha evelia to miame. Nye ŋutɔ kple ame siwo hã va glia dzi la ƒe afã míekplɔ wo ɖo. Míeto Abolokpo gbɔ va Gli Kèke gbɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim Gate, Old Gate, Fish Gate, Hananel Tower, Hundred Tower, and on to Sheep Gate. Finally, we stopped at Gate of the Guard,
translation_verse: Eyome míeto Efrayim-gbo tame to Yexana-gbo tame, to Tɔmelãgbo tame, va to Xananel Gbetakpɔxɔ kple Alafa Gbetakpɔxɔ ŋu va do ɖe Alẽgbo la gbɔ, eye míeva wu nu ɖe Gaxɔgbo la gbɔ.

english_verse: where we stood in front of the temple with the other group, praising God. In the group with me were half of the leaders,
translation_verse: Ale kafukafuhadziha eveawo va tɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe aƒe la me. Nye kple amegã siwo nɔ ŋunye la ƒe afã hã míetɔ ɖi.

english_verse: as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets.
translation_verse: Ame siwo nye kpẽkulawo le míawo ƒe haa me lae nye: Eliyakim, Maaseya, Minyamin, Mixaya, Elyoenai, Zaxarya kple Xananya. Wo katã nye nunɔlawo; wolé kpẽwo ɖe asi.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer also stood there, as Jezrahiah led the singers.
translation_verse: Maaseya, Semaya, Eleazar, Uzi, Yaxanan, Malkiya, Elam kple Ezer hã nɔ míaƒe ha me. Hadzilaawo nɔ ha xlãm ɖe me, le woƒe nunɔla Yizraxya ƒe kpɔkplɔ te.

english_verse: God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem. Preparation for Worship
translation_verse: Wosa vɔ geɖe gbe ma gbe kple aseyetsotso gã elabe Mawu na dzidzɔ yɔ ame sia ame ƒe dzime. Nyɔnuwo kple ɖeviwo hã va tso aseye ɖe ameha la ti, eye dzidzɔseyetsotso si nɔ Yerusalem-du me la ɖi de didiƒe ʋĩi ke. Nu siwo wodzɔna ɖe gbedoxɔ me la dzi kpɔkpɔ

english_verse: On that same day, some leaders were appointed to be responsible for the safekeeping of gifts for the temple and to be in charge of receiving the first part of the harvest and the ten percent of the crops and livestock that was offered to God. These same leaders also collected the part of crops that the Law of Moses taught was to be given to the Levites. Everyone was pleased with the work of the priests and Levites,
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, wotia ŋutsu aɖewo tsɔ ɖo nudzraɖoƒexɔwo nu. Xɔ siwo me wodzraa nu siwo amewo dzɔna na Mawu ƒe aƒe la ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo, dɔwɔwɔ metsonu gbãtɔwo kple nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia ɖo la. Ame siawo ƒe dɔ wònye be woaxɔ agblemenukuwo ƒe akpa siwo nye nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo tɔ le sea nu la tso agble siwo ƒo xlã duwo la me la adzra ɖo ɖe nudzraɖoƒexɔawo me. Yuda-dukɔ blibo la kpɔa dzidzɔ le nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo ŋu,

english_verse: when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon.
translation_verse: le esi wosubɔa woƒe Mawu, eye wowɔa ŋutikɔklɔ ŋu kɔnuwo kple kɔnu bubu siwo Mawu ɖo na wo la ta. Nenema ke wokpɔa ŋudzedze le hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo, ame siwo hã wɔa woƒe dɔwo le ɖoɖo siwo David kple via Salomo wɔ da ɖi nu la ŋu.

english_verse: In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship.
translation_verse: Tso gbe aɖe gbe ke, le David kple Asaf ŋɔli la, hɛnɔawo nɔa anyi nyea hadzilawo kplɔlawo, ne wole kafukafuhawo kple akpedahawo dzim na Mawu.

english_verse: During the time that Zerubbabel and I were in charge, everyone in Israel gave what they were supposed to give for the daily needs of the singers and temple guards from the Levi tribe. Then the Levites would give the priests their share from what they had received.
translation_verse: Le Zerubabel ŋɔli la, Israelviwo dzɔa nu gbe sia gbe, be woatsɔ anɔ hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo dzi kpɔm. Nenema ke wònɔ le Nexemya ŋɔli hã. Woɖea nu siwo nye Levi viwo tɔ gome la ɖe aga na wo, eye Levi viwo hã ɖea nu siwo nye Aron viŋutsuwo tɔ gome la ɖe aga na wo.

english_verse: On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God.
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe woxlẽ Mose ƒe se la na dukɔa la, woƒe to lɔ akpa aɖe si gblɔ be Amontɔ alo Moabtɔ aɖeke megava Mawu ƒe ha la me gbeɖegbeɖe o.

english_verse: This was because they had refused to give food and water to Israel and had hired Balaam to call down a curse on them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Nu si ta wòle alea ɖo lae nye be wometsɔ abolo kple tsi va kpe Israelviwo le woƒe mɔzɔzɔ me o, eye woda Bileam ɖe wo ŋu be wòaƒo fi ade wo, ke mía Mawu trɔ fiƒode la wòzu yayra.

english_verse: Following the reading of the Law of Moses, the people of Israel started sending away anyone who had any foreign ancestors. Nehemiah Makes Other Changes
translation_verse: Esi ameawo se sedede sia la, woɖe amedzro siwo katã tsaka wo la le wo dome. Tɔtrɔ siwo Nexemya he vɛ

english_verse: The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms.
translation_verse: Do ŋgɔ la, wotsɔ xɔ siwo le Mawu ƒe aƒe la ŋu la de nunɔla Elyasib ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te. Esi Elyasib do ƒome kple Tobiya ta la,

english_verse: So he let Tobiah live in one of these rooms, where all kinds of things had been stored—the grain offerings, incense, utensils for the temple, as well as the tenth of the grain, wine, and olive oil that had been given for the use of the Levites, singers, and temple guards, and the gifts for the priests.
translation_verse: edzra xɔdɔme lolotɔ ɖeka me ɖo tsɔ na Tobiya. Evɔ xɔ ma mee wotsɔa numemevɔsa, atike ʋeʋẽe, agbawo kple kpluwo, bli, wain kple ami ƒe akpa ewolia siwo nye Levi viwo, hadzilawo kple agbonudzɔlawo tɔ kpakple nu siwo wodzɔ na nunɔlawo la hã dzrana ɖo tsã.

english_verse: This happened in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes ruled Babylonia. I was away from Jerusalem at the time, because I was visiting him. Later I received permission from the king
translation_verse: Nyemenɔ Yerusalem hafi nu sia nɔ dzɔdzɔm o; menɔ Babilonia elabe le Babilonia-fia Artaxsasta ƒe dziɖuɣi ƒe ƒè bla etɔ̃ vɔ evelia me la, medzo le Yerusalem yi fia la gbɔ. Mebia mɔ fiaa le ɣeyiɣi aɖe megbe,

english_verse: to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple.
translation_verse: eye metrɔ va Yerusalem. Ɣe ma ɣie meva ke ɖe nu gbegblẽ si Elyasib wɔ la ŋu. Edzra Mawu ƒe aƒeme xɔ ɖeka me ɖo na Tobiya wòle eme.

english_verse: It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture.
translation_verse: Dzi kum ŋutɔ. Mefɔ Tobiya ƒe xɔ me nuwo katã ƒu gbe ɖe gota.

english_verse: Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.
translation_verse: Tete mena wokɔ̀ xɔa ŋu, eye mena wogafɔ Mawu ƒe aƒeme nuɖuɖuvɔsaawo kple atike ʋeʋẽeawo va da ɖe eme.

english_verse: I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest.
translation_verse: Meva se hã be womeganɔa nu siwo amewo dzɔ ƒe akpa si nye Levi viwo tɔ kple esi nye hadzilawo tɔ la hã tsɔm na wo o; eya ta Levi viawo kple hadzilaawo, ame siwo nɔa subɔsubɔdɔawo wɔm tsã la, dzo yi ɖale agble dem.

english_verse: I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, “Why is the temple neglected?” Then I told them to start doing their jobs.
translation_verse: Meka mo na amegãawo be: “Nu ka ta miegblẽ Mawu ƒe aƒe la ɖi ale?” Eyome megaƒo Levi viawo kple hadzilaawo nu ƒu hetsɔ wo ɖo wo teƒe.

english_verse: After this, everyone in Judah brought a tenth of their grain, wine, and olive oil to the temple storeroom.
translation_verse: Tete Yuda blibo la gade asi woƒe nukuwo, wain kple ami ƒe akpa ewolia tsɔtsɔ va nudzraɖoƒexɔawo mee.

english_verse: Finally, I appointed three men with good reputations to be in charge of what was brought there and to distribute it to the others. They were Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the teacher of the Law, and Pedaiah the Levite. Their assistant was Hanan, the son of Zaccur and the grandson of Mattaniah.
translation_verse: Azɔ metia nunɔla Selemya, agbalẽŋlɔla Zadok kple Pedaya, si nye Levi viwo dometɔ ɖeka, eye metsɔ nudzraɖoƒexɔawo dzi kpɔkpɔ de wo si. Meɖe Xanan, Zakur vi, si nye Matanya ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi la hã na wo be wòanɔ kpekpem ɖe wo ŋu. Metia ame siawo elabe amewo ɖi ɖase le wo katã ŋu be anukwaretɔwo wonye. Meɖo na wo hã be woawo nanɔ nu siwo amewo dzɔ la mam na wo tɔwo.

english_verse: I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there. The Sabbath
translation_verse: O nye Mawu, wò ŋku nanɔ nu sia dzi, eye mègaŋlɔ nu nyui siwo katã mewɔ na nye Mawu ƒe aƒe la kple mawusubɔsubɔ le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me be o.

english_verse: I also noticed what the people of Judah were doing on the Sabbath. Not only were they trampling grapes to make wine, but they were harvesting their grain, grapes, figs, and other crops, and then loading these on donkeys to sell in Jerusalem. So I warned them not to sell food on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Le ɣe ma ɣiwo me le Yuda la, mekpɔ amewo wonɔ wain fiãm le dzudzɔgbe, eye mekpɔ ame aɖewo hã wonɔ lubablawo tsɔm va aƒee. Nenema ke, wotsɔ waintsetse, gbotitsetse kple agbà ƒomevi vovovowo do agba na woƒe tedziwo hetsɔ va Yerusalem le dzudzɔgbe la. Tete megbe nya na wo gbe si gbe wole nuɖuɖuawo dzram la.

english_verse: People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Tirotɔ siwo nɔ dua me la hã tsɔa tɔmelã kple nu bubu geɖewo vanɛ va dzrana na Yudatɔwo le dzudzɔgbe la le Yerusalem.

english_verse: I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, “This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath!
translation_verse: Tete meka mo na Yuda-bubumewo be: “Miele kɔ gblẽm ɖo na dzudzɔgbe la! Nu vɔ̃ɖi kae nye esi wɔm miele?

english_verse: Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath!”
translation_verse: Ðe menye nu siae mia tɔgbuiwo wɔ ta mía Mawu na dzɔgbevɔ̃e siawo katã va míawo ŋutɔ kple du sia dzi oa? Gake miegale kɔ gblẽm ɖo na dzudzɔgbe la heto ema me le kɔ lim dɔmedzoe geɖe wu ɖi na Israel.”

english_verse: I ordered the gates of Jerusalem to be closed on the eve of the Sabbath and not to be opened until after the Sabbath had ended. Then I put some of my own men in charge of the gates to make certain that nothing was brought in on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Tso ɣe ma ɣi dzi la, mede se be ne ɣe nyaɖo to le Yerusalem-gbowo nu, eye wòsusɔ vie dzudzɔgbe nadze egɔme ko la, woado agboawo, eye ame aɖeke nagaʋu wo o, va se ɖe esime dzudzɔgbe la nava yi. Meɖe amewo tso nye subɔlawo dome ɖo agboawo nu hã be womegalɔ̃ ne ame aɖeke natsɔ agba va dua me le dzudzɔgbe o.

english_verse: Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods.
translation_verse: Ke asitsalawo kple nu kpotoe dzrala aɖewo va tsi Yerusalem-dua godo dɔ zi ɖeka alo eve.

english_verse: But I warned them, “If you do this again, I'll have you arrested.” From then on, they did not come on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Meka mo na wo be: “Nu ka ta miava tsi glia godo adɔ? Ne miegawɔe la, malé mi.” Tso ema dzi la, womegava tsi glia gɔme dɔ le dzudzɔgbe kpɔ o.

english_verse: I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy. God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this. Mixed Marriages
translation_verse: Megblɔ na Levi viwo be woakɔ wo ɖokui ŋu, eye woava dzɔ agboawo nu ne woawɔ dzudzɔgbe la kɔkɔe. Ðo ŋku edzi nàwɔ nyui nam ɖe esia hã nu, O Mawunye, eye nàlém ɖe te le wò lɔlɔ̃ gã, si metrɔna o la nu.

english_verse: I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dze sii le ɣe ma ɣiwo me hã be Yuda-ŋutsu aɖewo ɖe srɔ̃ tso Asdod, Amon kple Moab.

english_verse: About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language.
translation_verse: Wo viwo ƒe afã doa Asdod-gbe, ke womete ŋu doa Yuda-gbe o; dukɔ bubuwo ƒe gbe ko wodona.

english_verse: So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise: In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Meka mo na wo, ƒo fi de wo; meƒo wo, eye menyɔ woƒe ɖa. Mena wotà nu le Mawu ŋkɔ me. Megblɔ na wo be: “Migatsɔ mia vinyɔnuwo na wo viŋutsuwo o, alo miaɖe wo vinyɔnuwo na mia viŋutsuwo loo, alo miawo ŋutɔ miaɖe wo o.

english_verse: God dearly loved King Solomon of Israel and made him the greatest king on earth, but Solomon's foreign wives led him into sin.
translation_verse: Ðe menye nyɔnu siawo ƒomevi ɖeɖee na Israel-fia Salomo wɔ nuvɔ̃ oa? Fia aɖeke mede enu le afi aɖeke o; eƒe Mawu lɔ̃e vevie, eye wòtsɔe ɖo fia ɖe Israel katã nu. Gake dzronyɔnuwoe na eya kekeake hã wɔ nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.
translation_verse: Ɖe míase le mia ŋu be miewɔ nu gbegblẽ gã sia hewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe mía Mawu la ŋu be mieɖe nyɔnu tso dutaa?”

english_verse: Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã Elyasib ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi ɖeka, si nye via Yoyada vi la ke hã nye Sanebalat, Xorontɔ la ƒe toyɔvi, eya ta menyàe ɖa le ŋunye.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: O nye Mawu, wò ŋku nenɔ wo dzi le ale si woɖi gbɔ nunɔlanyenye, eye wodo vlo nubabla si le wò kple nunɔlawo kpakple Levi viwo dome la ta.

english_verse: Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Ale meɖe dzronyigba dzi tɔwo kple woƒe kɔnuwo katã ɖa le wo dome, eye mekpɔ egbɔ be nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo nya woƒe dɔdeasiwo kple se siwo nu wòle be woazɔ ɖo la nyuie.

english_verse: I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple. I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.
translation_verse: Nenema ke metsɔa nakevɔsa vanɛ le ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖiwo dzi hekpe ɖe dɔwɔwɔ metsonu gbãtɔwo tsɔtsɔ vɛ ŋu. O nye Mawu, ɖo ŋku dzinye eye nàwɔ nyui nam ɖe wo nu.

english_verse: Many years ago, a man named Job lived in the land of Uz. He was a truly good person, who respected God and refused to do evil.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu aɖe nɔ Uz-nyigba dzi. Eŋkɔe nye Hiob. Ŋutsu sia nye ame dzɔdzɔe kple fɔmaɖila. Evɔ̃a Mawu, eye wòtsri nuvɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ bia Satana be: “Afi ka nètso?” Satana ɖo eŋu be: “Metso tsatsa ge le anyigba dzi. Meɖi tsa le edzi katã.”

english_verse: Job's sons took turns having feasts in their homes, and they always invited their three sisters to join in the eating and drinking.
translation_verse: Via ŋutsuwo wɔ ɖoɖo, eye wotua aglo ɖua nu le wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe aƒeme le ŋkeke vovovowo dzi, eye wokpea wo nɔvinyɔnu etɔ̃awo hã vanɛ be woava ɖu nu, ano nu kple yewo.

english_verse: After each feast, Job would send for his children and perform a ceremony, as a way of asking God to forgive them of any wrongs they may have done. He would get up early the next morning and offer a sacrifice for each of them, just in case they had sinned or silently cursed God. Angels, the Lord, and Satan
translation_verse: Ne dzidzɔkpɔɣi la wu nu gbe sia gbe la, Hiob dɔa ame ɖa woɖakɔa viawo ŋuti. Efɔna ŋdi kanya ɖasaa numemevɔ ɖe viawo ƒe xexlẽme nu. Egblɔna edziedzi be: “Ðewohĩ, vinyewo anyawɔ nuvɔ̃, eye woado vlo Mawu le woƒe susu me mahĩ.” Ale Hiob wɔa esia edziedzi.

english_verse: One day, when the angels had gathered around the Lord, and Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka la, Mawu viwo va ƒo ƒu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye Satana hã le wo dome va.

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ biae be: “Èlé ŋku ɖe nye dɔla Hiob ŋua? Ame aɖeke mede enu le anyigba dzi o. Mokaka mele eŋu o; enye ame dzɔdzɔe, evɔ̃a Mawu, eye wòtsri vɔ̃wɔwɔ.”

english_verse: “You are like a wall protecting not only him, but his entire family and all his property. You make him successful in whatever he does, and his flocks and herds are everywhere.
translation_verse: Ðe menye kpɔ nètɔ ƒo xlã eya ŋutɔ, eƒe aƒe kple nunɔamesiwo katã le goawo keŋ me oa? Èyra dɔ siwo wòwɔna, eye nèna eƒe nunɔamesiwo dzi ɖe edzi fũu le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Try taking away everything he owns, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Ke ka asi nu siwo katã le esi la ŋu kpɔ be maƒo fi ade wò ŋumakpetɔe oa.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “All right, Satan, do what you want with anything that belongs to him, but don't harm Job.” Then Satan left. Job Loses Everything
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Satana be: “Enyo! Eƒe nuwo katã le asiwò me; ɖeko mègaka asi eya ŋutɔ ŋu o.” Ale Satana dzo le Aƒetɔ gbɔ. Hiob ƒe kesinɔnuwo kple viawo tsrɔ̃

english_verse: Job's sons and daughters were having a feast in the home of his oldest son,
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka, eva eme be Hiob viŋutsuawo kple vinyɔnuawo katã le wo nɔvi tsitsitɔ ƒeme le nu ɖum, le nu nom ɖekae.

english_verse: when someone rushed up to Job and said, “While your servants were plowing with your oxen, and your donkeys were nearby eating grass,
translation_verse: Kasia amedɔdɔ aɖe va Hiob gbɔ va gblɔ nɛ be: “Nyiawo le nu ŋlɔm, eye tedzinɔawo le gbe ɖum le wo xa.

english_verse: a gang of Sabeans attacked and stole the oxen and donkeys! Your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Kasia Sabatɔwo va dze wo dzi helé lãawo dzoe. Wowu dɔlaawo katã kple yi. Nye ɖeka hɔ̃ koe susɔ te ŋu sí va be magblɔe na wò.”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a second one came running and said, “God sent down a fire that killed your sheep and your servants. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Esi amedɔdɔ sia gale nu ƒom la, dɔla bubue nye esi va do. Egblɔ be: “Mawu ƒe dzo ge tso dziƒo va fiã alẽawo kple dɔlaawo keŋkeŋ. Nye ɖeka koe susɔ te ŋu sí va be magblɔe na wò.”

english_verse: Before that servant finished speaking, a third one raced up and said, “Three gangs of Chaldeans attacked and stole your camels! All of your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Ame sia hã mekpɔ ɖe nu le eƒe nyaa me o, kasia ame bubu va do be: “Kaldea-dzoha hatsotso etɔ̃ va dze kposɔawo dzi, lé wo dzoe. Wowu dɔlaawo katã kple yi. Nye ɖeka koe susɔ, eye mesí va be magblɔe na wò.”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a fourth one dashed up and said, “Your children were having a feast and drinking wine at the home of your oldest son,
translation_verse: Dɔla sia hã mekpɔ wu eƒe nyaa nu hafi ame bubu hã va do o, be: “Viwòwo katã nɔ nu ɖum, nɔ nu nom le wo nɔvi tsitsitɔ ƒeme.

english_verse: when suddenly a windstorm from the desert blew the house down, crushing all of your children. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Kasia ahom tu sesĩe tso gbedadaƒo va lɔ xɔ si me wole la ɖe nu hemui ƒu viwoawo dzi gbloo; wo katã woku. Nye ɖeka koe do le eme, eye meva be magblɔe na wò.”

english_verse: When Job heard this, he tore his clothes and shaved his head because of his great sorrow. He knelt on the ground, then worshiped God
translation_verse: Tete Hiob tso, dze eƒe awuwo, lũ ta, tsyɔ mo anyi, eye wòdo gbe ɖa

english_verse: and said: “We bring nothing at birth; we take nothing with us at death. The Lord alone gives and takes. Praise the name of the Lord!”
translation_verse: be: “Amamae mele do tso nɔnye ƒe dɔme, eye amamae maganɔ adzo! Aƒetɔ ye na; Aƒetɔ ye gaxɔe. Woakafu Aƒetɔ!”

english_verse: In spite of everything, Job did not sin or accuse God of doing wrong.
translation_verse: Le nu siawo katã me la, Hiob mewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe Mawu ŋu o, eye mebu fɔe hã o.

english_verse: When the angels gathered around the Lord again, Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka la, Mawu viwo gava do ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye Satana hã nɔ wo dome va.

english_verse: and the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ bia Satana be: “Afi ka nètso?” Satana ɖo eŋu be: “Metso tsatsa ge le anyigba dzi. Meɖi tsa le edzi katã.”

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil. And he hasn't changed, even though you persuaded me to destroy him for no reason.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ bia Satana be: “Èlé ŋku ɖe nye dɔla Hiob ŋua? Ame aɖeke mede enu le anyigba dzi o. Mokaka mele eŋu o; enye ame dzɔdzɔe, evɔ̃a Mawu, eye wòtsri vɔ̃wɔwɔ. Eya gale nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ dzi ko togbɔ be nète ɖe dzinye be magblẽ edome, evɔ mewɔ naneke hafi o.”

english_verse: Satan answered, “There's no pain like your own. People will do anything to stay alive.
translation_verse: Satana ɖo eŋu be: “Ŋutigbalẽ gale ŋutigbalẽ te! Ne eɖo edzi la, gbetɔ atsɔ eƒe nu sia nu ana faa be yeatsi agbe.

english_verse: Try striking Job's own body with pain, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Ke ka asi ametia ŋu kpɔ! Aƒo fi ade wò le ŋkuwò me.”

english_verse: “All right!” the Lord replied. “Make Job suffer as much as you want, but just don't kill him.”
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Satana be: “Kpɔ ɖa, ele asiwò me; wɔ nu sia nu si nèlɔ̃ la, ɖeko mègaɖe eƒe agbe ɖa o.”

english_verse: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.
translation_verse: Tete Satana dzo le Aƒetɔ gbɔ, eye wòna ƒoƒoe vɔ̃ɖi te Hiob ƒe ŋutilã blibo la katã, tso dzodome va se ɖe afɔƒome.

english_verse: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery,
translation_verse: Hiob tsɔ konyifafa bɔbɔ nɔ dzowɔ me, eye wòtsɔ ze gbagbã kakɛ le ŋuti kukomee.

english_verse: his wife asked, “Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die?”
translation_verse: Tete srɔ̃a gblɔ nɛ be: “Ègale wò nuteƒewɔwɔa dzi koa? Ƒo fi de Mawu nàku!”

english_verse: Job replied, “Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well.” In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God. Job's Three Friends
translation_verse: Ke Hiob ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Èle nu ƒom abe nyɔnu movitɔ ene. Ne Mawu na nu nyui mí la, míexɔnɛ. Ne ena vɔ̃ mí ɖe, ɖe míaxɔe oa?” Le nu siawo katã me la, Hiob meke nu gblɔ nya vɔ̃ aɖeke ɖe Mawu ŋu o. Hiob xɔlɔ̃wo va kpɔe ɖa

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah were three of Job's friends, and they heard about his troubles. So they agreed to visit Job and comfort him.
translation_verse: Hiob xɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃ se dzɔgbevɔ̃e siwo katã dzɔ ɖe edzi la, eye woɖo gbe be yewoaɖakpɔe ɖa ase veve ɖe eti, afa akɔ nɛ. Xɔlɔ̃ siawoe nye: Elifaz tso Teman, Bildad tso Suax kple Zofar tso Naama.

english_verse: When they came near enough to see Job, they could hardly recognize him. And in their great sorrow, they tore their clothes, then sprinkled dust on their heads and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Esime wogbɔna le adzɔge ɖa la, wofɔ mo dzi kpɔ Hiob. Ke womekpɔe dze sii o. Ale wowó avi kple ɣli. Wodze woƒe awuwo, eye woku ke hlẽ ɖe ya me wòva kɔ ɖe woƒe tame vevesetɔe.

english_verse: For seven days and nights, they sat silently on the ground beside him, because they realized what terrible pain he was in.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke adrẽ, zã adrẽ wobɔbɔ nɔ anyigba le egbɔ, eye wo dometɔ aɖeke meke nu gblɔ nya aɖeke nɛ o, elabe wokpɔ be ele veve sem ale gbegbe.

english_verse: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth
translation_verse: Mlɔeba Hiob va ke nu, eye wòƒo fi de eƒe dzigbe.

english_verse: by saying to God:
translation_verse: Hiob gblɔ be:

english_verse: Blot out the day of my birth and the night when my parents created a son.
translation_verse: “Neɖi gbe si gbe wodzim la ŋu kpékpekpe! Neɖi zã si gblɔ be, ‘Wofɔ ŋutsuvi ƒe fu’ ŋu kpékpekpe!

english_verse: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.
translation_verse: Viviti kple blukɔ nexɔe. Alilikpowo netsyɔ edzi; zãdokeli nedo ŋɔdzi nɛ!

english_verse: Don't let children be created or joyful shouts be heard ever again in that night.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu nagafɔ fu le zã ma me azɔ o; dzidzɔɣli aɖeke megaɖi le eme o.

english_verse: Let those with magic powers place a curse on that day.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ƒoa fi dea ŋkeke, eye wosaa gbe doa Livyatan la, neƒo fi de zã sia.

english_verse: Darken its morning stars and remove all hope of light,
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋukeɣletiviwo nado viviti. Nekpɔ mɔ na kekeli, gake ɖeke negado o. Negakpɔ agudzedze o.

english_verse: because it let me be born into a world of trouble. Why Didn't I Die at Birth?
translation_verse: Nenɔ na zã ma alea elabe mexe nɔnye ƒe vidzidɔ nu o, eye mena fukpekpe siawo to nunye yi o.” Hiob medi be yeaganɔ agbe o

english_verse: Why was I accepted and allowed to nurse at my mother's breast?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta menɔ akɔ? Nu ka ta meno no?

english_verse: Now I would be at peace in the silent world below
translation_verse: Ne ɖe meku kpoo ɣe ma ɣi la, anye ne fifia mevo.

english_verse: with kings and their advisors whose palaces lie in ruins,
translation_verse: Anye ne nye kple fiawo kpakple adaŋudela siwo gbugbɔ blemafiasãwo tu na wo ɖokui lae anɔ teƒe ɖeka.

english_verse: I wish I had been born dead and then buried, never to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nyemenye fu gege, alo vidzĩ si mekpɔ kekeli kpɔ oa?

english_verse: In the world of the dead, the wicked and the weary rest without a worry. *
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe, afi mae ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzudzɔa fuɖeɖe na ame le, eye ame siwo ŋu ɖeɖi te la, kpɔa gbɔdzɔe le.

english_verse: where captives and slaves are free at last. Why Does God Let Me Live?
translation_verse: Amegã kple ame gblɔe ɖe sia ɖe sɔ le afi ma; kluvi vo tso eƒe aƒetɔ si me.

english_verse: Why does God let me live when life is miserable and so bitter?
translation_verse: “Nu ka ta nèna kekeli ame si le fu kpem, eye nèna ame si ƒe luʋɔ se veve gale agbe?

english_verse: I keep longing for death more than I would seek a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Ku le ame siawo dzrom, ke mele vavam o. Wole ku dim vevie abe kesinɔnu si woɣla ɖe anyigba tume ke la kum wole ene.

english_verse: Nothing could make me happier than to be in the grave.
translation_verse: Woati kpo, atso aseye ne wokpɔ yɔdo la.

english_verse: Why do I go on living when God has me surrounded, and I can't see the road?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta wona kekeli ame si ƒe mɔ bu, ame si ŋu Mawu tɔ kpɔ ɖo laa?

english_verse: Moaning and groaning are my food and drink,
translation_verse: Nye hũɖeɖe xɔ nuɖuɖu teƒe, eye nye ŋeŋe le kɔkɔm ɖi abe tsi ene.

english_verse: and my worst fears have all come true.
translation_verse: Elabe nu si mevɔ̃na lae wɔm, eye nu si dzia ŋɔ nam lae dzɔ ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.
translation_verse: Nyemekpɔ dzidzeme, gbɔɖeme alo gbɔdzɔe aɖeke o; fukpekpe dzi ko mele.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Azɔ Elifaz, Temantɔ la gblɔ be:

english_verse: Please be patient and listen to what I have to say. *
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe ƒo nu ɖe, aku dzi na wòa? Evɔ ɖe, ame ka ate ŋu azi kpi?

english_verse: have guided and encouraged many in need.
translation_verse: Wò nya léa anyidzela ɖe te, eye nèdo ŋusẽ klo beliwo.

english_verse: You respect God and live right, so don't lose hope!
translation_verse: Ðe menye wò Mawu-vɔvɔ̃ lae nye dzideƒo na wò oa? Ðe menye wò agbenɔnɔ fɔmaɖitɔe lae nye wò mɔkpɔkpɔ oa?

english_verse: No truly innocent person has ever died young.
translation_verse: “Bu eŋu kpɔ! Ðe fɔmaɖila aɖe tsrɔ̃ kpɔa? Afi ka wotsrɔ̃ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla le kpɔ?

english_verse: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble,
translation_verse: Nyea mekpɔ be ame siwo dea nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe agble, eye woƒãa fuɖename la, eya kee woŋena.

english_verse: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe ƒuƒu tsrɔ̃a wo, eye eƒe dziku ƒe yaƒoƒo naa wo nu yina.

english_verse: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth,
translation_verse: Dzata le gbe ɖem, eye wòle gbe tem; ke woŋe aɖu le nu me na dzataviawo.

english_verse: they starve, and their children are scattered. A Secret Was Told to Me
translation_verse: Dzata sesẽ mekpɔ nu alé aɖu o, eku, eye dzatanɔ ƒe viwo ka hlẽ.

english_verse: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—
translation_verse: “Azɔ wofi tofi nam, nye to se dalĩdodoa.

english_verse: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;
translation_verse: Le zã me ŋutega ƒe ŋugblededewo me, esime amewo yi alɔ̃ me ʋĩi,

english_verse: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ aɖe ƒo ya to ŋkume nam, eye nye ŋutifu ɖo to.

english_verse: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say,
translation_verse: Etsi tsitre ɖe ŋkunye me; ke nyemenya nu si wònye o, Ðoɖoe zi toŋ. Tete gbe aɖe ɖi be:

english_verse: “No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.
translation_verse: ‘Ðe gbetɔ si kuna la ate ŋu anye dzɔdzɔetɔ le Mawu ŋkumea? Ɖe gbetɔ anye ame dzadzɛ le eƒe Wɔla gbɔa?

english_verse: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu meɖoa dzi ɖe eƒe dɔlawo gɔ̃ hã ŋu o. Eɖea vodada na mawudɔlawo ke hã.

english_verse: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
translation_verse: Ale ke wɔ wòaɖo dzi ɖe gbetɔ siwo wowɔ kple tsu ŋu; ame siwo dzɔ tso ʋuʋudedi me, eye ne wote afɔ ɖe wo dzi la, wogbãna abe agbagblaʋui ene laa?

english_verse: Born after daybreak, you die before nightfall and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Gbetɔ nɔa agbe le ŋdi me, kaka fiẽ naɖo la, megali o. Ebuna nigbii, eye womegadzea sii o.

english_verse: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
translation_verse: Ne wotso woƒe agbadɔka ɖa la, ɖe womekuna le numanyamanya me oa?’ ”

english_verse: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
translation_verse: “Hiob, yɔ ame kpɔ! Ðe ame aɖe atɔ na wòa? Kɔkɔetɔwo dometɔ ka ŋu nàtrɔ ɖo wòaxɔ na wò?

english_verse: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, dzikudodo wua bometsila, eye ŋuʋaʋã wua abunɛtɔ.
