english_verse: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
translation_verse: Mekpɔ bometsila aɖe le kè ƒom ɖe to; ke meƒo fi de enɔƒe enumake.

english_verse: Then hungry and greedy people gobble up their crops and grab their wealth.
translation_verse: Dɔwuitɔwo ɖua eƒe agblemenukuwo; woɖea wo tso ŋuwo me ke gɔ̃ hã, eye tsikɔwuiawo haa eƒe kesinɔnuwo.

english_verse: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
translation_verse: Fukpekpe memiena tso ke me o, eye fuɖename medona tso anyigba me o.

english_verse: it's all part of life, like sparks shooting skyward.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ fu mee wodzi gbetɔ ɖo, abe ale si dzoxi dzona yia dzi ene.”

english_verse: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
translation_verse: “Nenye nyee la, ɖe matrɔ ɖe Mawu ŋu aɖe nye nyawo nɛ.

english_verse: His miracles are marvelous, more than we can count.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔa nu dzɔtsu siwo me ame mate ŋu adzro o, eye eƒe nukunuwo mele xexlẽme o.

english_verse: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
translation_verse: Enana be tsi dzana ɖe anyigba dzi, eye wòɖoa tsi ɖe agblewo me.

english_verse: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
translation_verse: Ekɔa ɖokuibɔbɔlawo ɖe dzi, eye wòfaa akɔ na konyifalawo.

english_verse: God swiftly traps the wicked
translation_verse: Egblẽa ayetɔwo ƒe nugbeɖoɖo me, be womakpɔ ta nɛ o.

english_verse: in their own evil schemes, and their wisdom fails.
translation_verse: Eléa nunyalawo ne wole woƒe ayemenu wɔm, eye wòtsia ayedzelawo ƒe ɖoɖo vɔ̃wo nu alɔtsɔtsɔe.

english_verse: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
translation_verse: Viviti dona ɖe wo le ŋkeke me, eye wotsaa asi ya me ŋdɔkutsu abe zã me wole ene.

english_verse: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
translation_verse: Ke eɖea tsyɔ̃eviwo tso woƒe nu me kple hiãtɔwo tso ŋusẽtɔ si me.

english_verse: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
translation_verse: Ale mɔkpɔkpɔ li na ame gblɔe, eye nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ ƒe nu ku.”

english_verse: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, woyra ame si Mawu hea to na; eya ta mègado vlo Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe amehehe o.

english_verse: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
translation_verse: Elabe edea abi ame ŋu, ke eblanɛ nɛ. Eƒoa ame kple asi; ke asia kee yɔa dɔ.

english_verse: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
translation_verse: Aɖe wò le fukpekpe me zigbɔzi ade sɔŋ, eye adrẽlia me hã, nu vevi aɖeke mawɔ wò o.

english_verse: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ne dɔ to la, aɖe wò tso ku si me. Ne aʋa dzɔ la, aɖe wò le yi ƒe ŋusẽ nu.

english_verse: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
translation_verse: Mana woagblɔ nya aƒo ɖi wò o. Ne nu le gbegblẽm la, màvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
translation_verse: Àko tsɔtsrɔ̃ kple dɔwuame, eye màvɔ̃ lã wɔadãwo o.

english_verse: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
translation_verse: Kpewo manɔ wò agble me o, eye lã wɔadãwo adze xɔlɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.
translation_verse: Ekema ànɔ wò agbadɔ me aɖe dzi ɖi; ne èxlẽ wò alẽwo la, wo katã anɔ dedie.

english_verse: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
translation_verse: Viwòwo hã asɔ gbɔ fũu; woanɔ abe gbe siwo le wɔwɔm le afi sia afi ene.

english_verse: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
translation_verse: Àtsi ŋutɔ hafi ayi yɔ me, abe ale si lu tsina woblana vaa aƒee le nuŋeɣi ene.

english_verse: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Hiob, ɖe míelé ŋku ɖe nu sia ŋu tsitotsito kpɔ be ele eme nyateƒe. See, eye nànyae le wò nyonyo ta.” ta.”

english_verse: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!
translation_verse: “Ne ɖe woaƒo ƒu nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple dzikudodo ada le nudanu me la,

english_verse: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
translation_verse: anye ne woakpe wu ƒutake gɔ̃; eya tae mele nu ƒom kple adã alea.

english_verse: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe aŋutrɔwo ƒo ɖem, nye gbɔgbɔ no woƒe aɖi; Mawu tsɔ ŋɔdzidoname ho aʋa ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
translation_verse: Ðe gbetedzi xlɔ̃na ne wòle gbe dama ɖuma? Ðe nyi xlɔ̃na ne nuɖuɖu le egbɔa?

english_verse: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
translation_verse: Ðe woɖua nu vɔvɔ dzemadeea? Alo ɖe azi ƒe ɣiƒe vivinaa?

english_verse: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
translation_verse: Wowɔ yaa ɖe nu me nam; wole ŋu nyɔm nam.”

english_verse: How I wish that God would answer my prayer
translation_verse: “Ao, Mawu, màna nu si biam mele lam oa? Nu ka ta màwɔ nye didi dzi nam oa?

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: Esia afa akɔ nam. Ne mele veve helihelĩ sem gɔ̃ hã, makpɔ dzidzɔ; elabe nyemegbe nu le Kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe nyawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Why should I patiently hope when my strength is gone?
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ kae gale ŋunye, manɔ lalam? Nuwuwu kae le asinye, magadi be manɔ agbe?

english_verse: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
translation_verse: Kpee wotsɔ memea? Nye ŋutilã ɖe, akɔbli yea?

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye keŋ, eye xɔnametɔ meli nam o.”

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: “Ame siwo gbe dɔmenyowɔwɔ na wo xɔlɔ̃ la, gbe Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la hã vɔvɔ̃.

english_verse: like streams that swell with melting snow,
translation_verse: Tsi babla na wo me nyɔ vĩ, eye tsikpe ɣla ɖe wo me.

english_verse: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
translation_verse: Kposɔhawo dze le woƒe mɔ dzi yi wo gbɔ, ke ɖeko wotsrɔ̃.

english_verse: thought they would find water. But they were disappointed,
translation_verse: Woka ɖe edzi kplikpaa, ke wobu mɔkpɔkpɔ; Wova afi ma, eye wotɔtɔ.

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Alea tututu miawo hã mieva zu nam. Miekpɔ be dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ ɖe dzinye, eye vɔvɔ̃ ɖo mi.

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: Ðe megblɔ be: ‘Mina nanem!’ alo be: ‘Mitsɔ miaƒe kesinɔnu na zãnui ɖe nunye’ mahã?

english_verse: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mebe: ‘Miɖem tso ketɔ si me,’ alo ‘Mixɔm le ŋutasẽla si me’ mahã?”

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: “Enyo, mazi kpoo, ne miafia num. Miɖe nu si me metra le la me nam, ne manya.

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Nyateƒenyawo wɔa dɔ ŋusẽtɔe! Ke nu ka le miaƒe nya si hem miele ɖe ŋunye la me?

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: Ðe miebu be yewoaɖe vodada nam abe nya gbɔlo koe le wɔnavɔleŋutɔ ƒe nu me tsom enea?

english_verse: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!
translation_verse: Miedi gɔ̃ hã be miadzidze nu ɖe tsyɔ̃eviwo dzi, eye miele asi dom ɖa ɖe mia xɔlɔ̃ gɔ̃ hã ŋu.”

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: “Ke azɔ milɔ̃ miakpɔ ŋkunye me. Nyemaka aʋatso na mi o.

english_verse: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.
translation_verse: Taflatsɛ, mitrɔ kpɔm dzro; alakpa meganɔ eme o. Mitrɔ ne miase, nye nya dzɔdzɔe la!

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Aɖeveetɔ menyea? Ðe nyemele dzɔgbevɔ̃e gã, si va dzinye la kpɔm oa?

english_verse: Why is life so hard? Why do we suffer?
translation_verse: “Ðe menye aʋa mee amegbetɔ le le anyigba dzi oa? Eƒe ŋkekewo mele abe apaɖila tɔ ene oa?

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Egale abe ale si kluvi dia vɔvɔli vevie, eye apaɖila kpɔa mɔ na eƒe fetu ene.

english_verse: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
translation_verse: Ale tso ɣleti yi ɣleti la, hiãe nye tɔnye gome; tso zã yi zã la, fukpekpe dzi ko mele.

english_verse: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.
translation_verse: Ne memlɔ anyi la, mebiana be: ‘Ɣe ka ɣi gɔ̃ mafɔ?’ Ŋukeɣi metsɔna o; memlina, trɔna gatrɔna ʋuu va se ɖe fɔŋli.

english_verse: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
translation_verse: Nye ŋutilã katã dze nyé, eye wòƒo ba. Nye ŋutigbalẽ wó, hele tsi ɖim.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: Nye ŋkekewo ƒua du wu avɔlɔ̃ʋu; wo nu yina mɔkpɔkpɔ manɔmee.”

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: “O Mawu, ɖo ŋku edzi be ƒuƒu koe nye nye agbe. Nyemagatrɔ gbɔ, ava kpɔ nunyoname aɖeke kple ŋku o.

english_verse: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Ŋku si le kpɔyem fifia la, magakpɔm o. Ànɔ kpɔyem alea, ko mavɔ ɖa.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Ale si alilikpo kakana hebunae la, nenemae ne gbetɔ yi tsiẽƒe la, megagbɔna o.

english_verse: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Megatrɔna vaa eƒeme o, eye aƒea me tɔwo megadzea sii o.”

english_verse: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.
translation_verse: “Eya ta nyemazi ɖoɖoe o. Nye dzi gbã, gake maƒo nu. Maɖe nye luʋɔ ƒe vevesese afia.

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu menye alo ƒumelã dziŋɔe menye hafi nèɖe dzɔlawo ɖe ŋunyea?

english_verse: but you torture me with terrible dreams. *
translation_verse: ekema ènana be mekua drɔ̃e vɔ̃wo, eye mekpɔa ŋutega dziŋɔwo.

english_verse: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe woalé vehlo nam be maku la, anyo nam sãa wu be mazu ƒu ɖeɖe alea.

english_verse: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
translation_verse: Agbe tim azɔ. Nyemeva agbe nɔ ge tegbee o. Ðe asi le ŋunye; elabe nye ŋkekewo nye yagbɔgbɔ.

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: Èléa ŋku ɖe eŋu ŋdi sia ŋdi, eye nèdonɛ kpɔ aɖabaƒoƒo sia aɖabaƒoƒo.

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: Màɖe kɔ ɖa le ŋunye vie, ne mami ta teti oa?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Wò amegbetɔwo ŋu dzɔla, ne mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe, ɖe mewɔ nane wòa? Nu ka ta nètsɔm ɖo nu dzidzea na ɖokuiwò? Nu ka ta meva zu agba nètsɔ?

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Tete Suaxtɔ Bildad ɖo eŋu be:

english_verse: How long will you talk and keep saying nothing?
translation_verse: “Ɣe ka ɣi nàgblɔ nya siawo ase ɖo, eye wò numenyawo anɔ abe ya sesẽ ene?

english_verse: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
translation_verse: Ðe Mawu trɔa gbo nya dzɔdzɔea? Alo ɖe Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la trɔa nu dzɔdzɔe ta tunaa?

english_verse: He made your children pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Nenye nuvɔ̃e viwòwo wɔ ɖe Mawu ŋu la, ekema eya ƒe to wòhe na wo.

english_verse: So why don't you turn to him
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ne èdi Mawu vevie, eye nèƒo koko na Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la;

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: ne èdza, eye nèwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe la, ekema akpɔ tawò, agatrɔ ɖe ŋuwò kokoko, eye wòagbugbɔ wò aɖo nɔƒe si dze na wò la.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wò gɔmedzedze le nyaŋui hã la, eme ava nyo na wò ŋutɔ emegbe.”

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: Àkpɔ be míawo la, etsɔviwo ko míenye, míenya naneke hã o, míaƒe agbenɔɣi le anyigba dzi le abe vɔvɔli ko ene.

english_verse: But they will instruct you with great understanding.
translation_verse: Màlɔ̃ woafia nu wò, woaƒo nu na wò, eye woaɖe woƒe nugɔmesese afia wò oa?”

english_verse: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ele mumu, eye meɖo sisi me o hã la, etrea ƒuƒu na gbe bubuwo katã.

english_verse: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
translation_verse: Alea wònɔna na ame, siwo katã ŋlɔ Mawu be la. Ame mavɔ̃mawu ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ abu.

english_verse: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
translation_verse: Eƒe dziɖoɖo ɖe nu ŋu mele naneke me o. Ðeko wòle abe yiyiɖɔ ene.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Nu dzea edzi na ame vɔ̃ɖi nyuie abe ale si nuku wɔna vlɔvlɔvlɔ le ɣetotoe nu ene; abe nuku si ɖea ka ɖe abɔ me ene.

english_verse: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
translation_verse: Edoa ke ɖe kpewo dzi, eye wòwɔna ɖe kpeto me.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Ke ne èɖee ɖa le enɔƒe la, teƒe la sẽa nu be: ‘Nyemekpɔ wò kpɔ o.’

english_verse: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, esiae nye dzidzɔ si ame vɔ̃ɖi kpɔna; ke ame bubu dzɔna ɖe eteƒe.”

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu magbe ame maɖifɔ o, eye makpe ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ŋu o.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Ŋu akpe wò futɔwo, eye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ƒe aƒe atsrɔ̃.”

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: “Nyateƒe, menya be ele eme nenema, gake ale ke gbetɔ ƒe nya adzɔ le Mawu gbɔe?

english_verse: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
translation_verse: Ne edi be yeahe nya kplii, eye wòbia biabia akpe ɖeka hã la, mate ŋu aɖo ɖeka teti ŋu o.

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: Enye nunyatɔ, eye eƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ. Ame ka kpe akɔ kplii gale dedie?

english_verse: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
translation_verse: Eya ame si mli towo ɖa, womenya gɔ̃ hã o. Etrɔ wo tsyɔ anyi kple dziku.

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: Eʋuʋu anyigba le enɔƒe ale eƒe sɔtiwo dzo kpèkpekpe.

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: Eya ame si ɖe gbe na ɣe, eye medze o. Exe mɔ na ɣletiviwo, womeklẽ o.

english_verse: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
translation_verse: Eya ɖeka koe keke dziŋgɔli me, eye wòzɔ ƒu dzeagbo dzi.

english_verse: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
translation_verse: Eyae wɔ ɣletiviwo: koklovinɔ, avu kple avutɔ, atifieŋu kple anyigbeme ɣletiviwo.

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: Ewɔa nu gã gã siwo me womate ŋu adzro o, eye wòwɔa nukunu siwo mele xexlẽme o.

english_verse: God walks right past me, without making a sound.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eva toa ŋunye, nyemekpɔnɛ o. Ezɔna yina, nyemedzea sii o.

english_verse: And if he grabs something, who can stop him or raise a question?
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, edua nu le ame si, ame ka ate ŋu axe mɔ nɛ? Ame kae abiae be: ‘Nu ka nye esi wɔm nèle?’ ”

english_verse: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
translation_verse: “Mawu ƒe dziku nu mefana o. Raxab ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔwo gɔ̃ hã de ta agu nɛ.

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: Ne ele alea ɖe, ale ke nye sia, mate ŋu aɖo nya ŋu nɛ? Nya ka makpɔ atsɔ ɖo nya ŋu nɛ?

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Ne mesamae wòlɔ̃ va hã la, nyemexɔe se be alé to ɖe nye nya ŋu o.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: Ena ahom tugum, eye wòna nye abiwo gasɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi; evɔ nyemewɔ naneke hafi o.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Ena gbɔgbɔtsixe tsi ƒonye; nye amea meyɔ taŋ kple vevesese.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Le ŋusẽ me hã, kpɔ ɖa, eya ko ye. Ne enye ʋɔnu la, ame ka ahem yii?

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: Mokaka mele ŋunye o. Nyemetsɔ ɖeke le nu si adzɔ ɖe dzinye la me o. Agbe tim.

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: Nyemegatsɔ ɖeke le eme o. Eya ta mebe: ‘Etsrɔ̃a ame maɖifɔ kple ame vɔ̃ɖi siaa.’

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖi ɖe ame, eye amewo le kukum la, Mawu ɖea alɔ me le ame maɖifɔ siwo le fu kpem la ŋu.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ xexea me de asi na vɔ̃wɔlawo, eye wòtsyɔ nu mo na woƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo. Ne menye Mawue wɔe o ɖe, ekema ame kae?”

english_verse: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.
translation_verse: “Nye ŋkekewo le du dzi sesĩe wu duƒula. Wo nu va yi, dzɔgbe nyui aɖeke makpɔe.

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Wosí va yi abe aƒlaʋu ene, abe ale si hɔ̃ si dea agba anyi ƒoa nui la ene.

english_verse: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
translation_verse: Mawu, ne megblɔ be: ‘Maŋlɔ nye konyifafa be. Madzudzɔ blanuiléle, eye makpɔ dzidzɔ’ la,

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: ekema nye fukpekpewo katã gadoa vɔvɔ̃ nam wu, elabe menya be mèle afia tso ge nam o.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Wobu fɔm xoxo, nu ka ƒe agbagba dzem mele dzodzro?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Ne mele tsi zɔzrɔ̃e, eye meklɔ asi kple adzalẽ gɔ̃ hã la,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: ànyrɔm ɖe ba me, eye manyɔ ŋu na nye awuwo gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: Elabe menye amegbetɔ wònye abe nye ene, ne maɖo eŋu nɛ be: ‘Va míyi ʋɔnu’ o.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Avuléla aɖeke mele mía dome, aɖo asi mí ame evea dzi o.

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: Neɖe eƒe ameƒoti ɖa le ŋunye, eye eƒe ŋɔdzi nagado vɔvɔ̃ nam o.

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: Ekema maƒo nu vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee, elabe menye nenemae mele o.”

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: “Nye agbe le ŋu nyɔm nam. Eya ta make nu ana nye konyifafa nado faa. Maƒo nu esime mele veve sem helihelĩ.

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe ŋkue le asiwòa? Ðe nèkpɔa nu abe ame ko enea?

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: hafi nèle vodada dim le ŋunye, eye nèle gɔnyeme kum be yeakpɔ nuvɔ̃ alea?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: Evɔ la, ènyae be nyemeɖi fɔ hafi o, ke ame aɖeke mate ŋu axɔm, aɖem le asiwò me o.

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Ðo ŋui be tsue nètsɔ wɔm; ɖe nèbe yeagbãm nyányanya magatrɔ zu ʋuʋudedia?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: Ðe mèkɔm ɖi abe notsi ene, eye nèna metò abe notsi babla ene oa?

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ ƒu kple ka lɔ̃ nye ameti lae, eye nèfa lãkusi kple ŋutigbalẽ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Èna agbem, eye nèlɔ̃m nyateƒetɔe. Beléle si nètsɔ nam na mele agbe dedie

english_verse: You have not explained all of your mysteries,
translation_verse: togbɔ be èɣla nu siawo ɖe dzime hã menya be esiae nye wò tameɖoɖo.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: Wò ŋku le ŋunye be ne mewɔ nuvɔ̃ la, yematsɔe akem o.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Ke ne mefɔ ta dzi la, èyɔam ɖe nu abe dzata ene, eye nègawɔa nukunuwo ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Eɖɔlia wò ɖasefowo ɖe ŋunye ɣe sia ɣi; wò dziku le dzi dem ɖe ŋunye, eye nèɖem ɖe nu kple aʋakɔ yeyewo.”

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: “Nu ka ta nèna medo tso nɔnye ƒe dɔme ɖo? Ne ɖe metsi ʋu me la, anye ne ŋku aɖeke mekpɔm o.

english_verse: and been carried to the grave without ever breathing.
translation_verse: Anye ne nyemanɔ anyi kpɔ gbeɖe o; ɖeko woatsɔm tso nɔnye ƒe dɔme aɖade yɔdo me enumake.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: Menye agbenɔŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo koe le asinye oa? Ðe asi le ŋunye! Te ɖa le gbɔnye, ne makpɔ akɔfafa vie,

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Tete Zofar, Naamatitɔ xɔ edzi be:

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Ðe wò adegbeƒoƒo ana amewo nazi ɖoɖoea? Ne èɖu fewu le ame ŋu la, ɖe womado ŋukpe wò oa?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Wò la, èle gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Nye nufiafiae nye nyateƒea; medza le Mawu ŋkume.’

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: Aɖe nunya ƒe nuɣaɣla siwo me goglo la afia wò. Ekema ànyae be Mawu mehea to na wò ɖe wò vodadawo nu o.”

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Ekɔ gbɔ dziƒo ŋu; nu ka nàte ŋu awɔ? Egoglo wu tsiẽƒe; nu ka àte ŋu nya le eŋu?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: Edidi wu anyigba; ekeke wu atsiaƒu.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: Ne eva tso eme yi, alo lé ame de gaxɔ me, alo yɔ ʋɔnu la, ame ka axe mɔ nɛ?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Elabe enya ame maɖinuwo. Ne wòkpɔ nuvɔ̃ la, ɖe mabu eŋu oa?

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Ke abunɛtɔ ase nu gɔme ne wodzi gbetedzivi wònye ame.”

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: “Wò la, ne ètrɔ dzime la, àke wò abɔwo me ado ɖe egbɔ ado gbe ɖa nɛ.

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: Ne nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le asiwò me la, tsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe adzɔge ke. Mègana ŋutasesẽ nanɔ aƒewò me o.

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: Ekema àtsɔ dzideƒo awu mo dzi, mokaka manɔmee. Ekema ànɔ te sesĩe, eye màvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: Àŋlɔ wò fukpekpewo be be woanɔ na wò abe tsi si sí va yi xoxo la ene.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: Wò agbenɔnɔ aklẽ wu ŋdɔ kutsu, eye eme viviti anɔ, abe ŋdikekeli ene.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: Dzideƒo aɖo asiwò, elabe mɔkpɔkpɔ li. Mawu akpɔ tawò, eye àgbɔ ɖe eme le dziɖeɖi me.

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: Àmlɔ anyi ame aɖeke mava ɖi ɖe wò o. Ame geɖewo adi be nàve yewo nu.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ya la, nu ate woƒe ŋku ŋu; sítoƒewo katã labu ɖe wo, eye woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ koe nye be woagbɔ ya mamlɛa ko, aku.”

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Azɔ Hiob ɖo eŋu be:

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: “Ðikeke aɖeke mele me o, miawoe nye ameawo. Ne mieku ko nunya hã ku.

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Nye hã mesea nu gɔme abe miawo ke ene. Nyemedzɔ lã wu mi o. Ame kae menya nu le nya siwo gblɔm miele la ŋu o?

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: Azɔ mezu alɔmeɖenu na xɔ̃nyewo gɔ̃ hã. Evɔ la, nyee yɔa Mawu, wòtɔna hafi. Nye, ame dzɔdzɔe, mawuvɔ̃la, nyee va ɖi kokoe azɔ!

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Ame si le dedie la, eyae dina be yeaɖe alɔ me le dzɔgbevɔ̃etɔ ŋu, eye yeatu asi ame si ɖiɖi la aƒu anyi.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Adzoblasuwo ƒe aƒe ŋu fa, ame siwo doa dziku na Mawu la le dedie; woƒe ŋusẽ zu mawu na wo.”

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: “Ke bia lãwo, ne woafia nu wò, bia dziƒoxewo ne woagblɔe na wò.

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ kae menya be Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ ƒe asie wɔ nu sia oa?

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Ðe to mesea nya kpɔna abe ale si aɖe ɖɔa nu kpɔnae ene oa?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Nunya le ame tsitsi si, eye nugɔmesese le ƒè geɖee xɔxɔ me.”

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: “Ke Mawu ya la, nunya kple ŋusẽ le esi, hekpe ɖe adaŋudede kple nugɔmesese ŋuti.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ne egbã nu la, womegatunɛ o. Ne ede ame xɔ la, womeʋunɛ o.

english_verse: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
translation_verse: Ne exe mɔ na tsi la, ku ɖina. Ne eɖe asi le eŋu la, tsi ɖɔna ɖea nu.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Eya ko si me ŋusẽ kple nunya le; ameblela kple ame si woble la siaa nye etɔ.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Eɖea ama adaŋumegãwo, eye wònana be ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo tsia bome.

english_verse: and makes slaves of kings.
translation_verse: Eɖea ga fiawo, eye wòsaa avɔ ɖe ali na wo.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Eɖea aboyo nunɔlawo amamae, eye wòɖea zikpui le ŋusẽtɔwo te.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Edoa vlo amegãwo, eye wòxɔa ŋusẽ le kalẽtɔwo si.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Exɔa nunya le anyigba dzi fiawo si, eye wònana be wotsaa tsa glãla le gbedadaƒo.

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: Kekeli manɔ anyi ta, wotsaa asi blukɔ me, eye woɖea afɔ abe ahanomunɔ ene.”

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: “Nu si mienya la, nye hã menyae. Nyemele mia te o.

english_verse: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—
translation_verse: Ke medi be maƒo nu kple Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la. Edzrom be mahe nya kple Mawu.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Miawo la, aʋatso dzi dem miele. Alakpadɔyɔlawo mienye.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: O, ne ɖe miazi ɖoɖoe kpoo la, anye ne azu nunya na mi.

english_verse: Are you telling lies for God
translation_verse: Ðe miebe yewoatsɔ aʋatso aʋli Mawu ta, eye yewoada alakpa aɖe enua?

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Ðe miedi be yewoade edzia? Alo ɖe miedi be yewoaʋli nya ɖe Mawu nua?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Anyo be wòadzro mia me kpɔ tsitotsitoa? Alo ɖe miele eflum abe ale si woflua gbetɔ enea?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Ne miede ame dzi le vivime la, ahe nya ɖe mia ŋu godoo.

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Miaƒe xotutuwo le abe dzowɔ ko ene, mia ɖokuitaʋiʋli le ko abe tsu ene.”

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: “Mizi ɖoɖoe; miɖe asi le ŋunye ne maƒo nu, ne nu si adzɔ ɖe dzinye la, nadzɔ!

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Nenye kue hã, maku faa.

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ele wu ye ge; mɔkpɔkpɔ aɖeke mele asinye o. Ke maʋli ɖokuinye ta le eya ŋutɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Ðewohĩ dzideƒo sia axɔm ɖe agbe elabe mawumavɔ̃la aɖeke medona ɖe eŋkume o.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, medzra ɖo nyuie be mato nye nya, elabe menya be tɔnyee adzɔ.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Ame kae li, aʋli nya kplim? Ne ɖe li la, mazi ɖoɖoe, aku gɔ̃.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: Wɔ nu eve dzaa ko nam, ekema nyemaɣla ɖokuinye le ŋkuwò me o:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Ekema yɔm, eye matɔ na wò. Alo nye, maƒo nu ne wò, nàɖo eŋu nam.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Vo nenie meda? Nye nuvɔ̃wo ƒe xexlẽme ɖe? Na manya nye dzidada kple nye nuvɔ̃wo.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nèɣla wò mo ɖem, eye nèbum wò futɔe?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Elabe èŋlɔ nutsotso sesẽwo ɖi ɖe ŋunye, eye nèna mele fu kpem ɖe nye ɖevime vodadawo ta.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Gbetɔ nyunyɔ ko abe nu vóvo ene, abe avɔ si agbagblaʋui ɖu la ene.”

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: “Gbetɔ nyɔnu tɔ dzidzia la, eƒe agbe le kpuie, eye wòyɔ fũu kple xaxa.

english_verse: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.
translation_verse: Edona abe seƒoƒo ene, eyrɔna, eye wòbuna vĩ abe vɔvɔli ene, eye meganɔa anyi o.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Ame sia tɔgbe ŋu nàke ŋku ɖo, akplɔ yi ʋɔnuia?

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Ame kae ate ŋu aɖe nu dzadzɛ tso nu madzamadza me? Ame aɖeke meli o.

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Esi woɖo eƒe ŋkekewo, eƒe ɣletiwo ƒe xexlẽme le gbɔwò, eye nèɖo liƒo na eƒe toƒe afi si ŋu magbɔ o ta la,

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: ɖe kɔ ɖa le eŋu, ne wòavo, eye wòakpɔ dzidzɔ abe ale si apadɔwɔla kpɔnɛ le eƒe ŋkeke ŋui la ene.”

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: “Elabe mɔkpɔkpɔ li na ati, be ne wolãe la, agadze, eye eƒe alɔwo magbe toto o.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: tsi ƒe ʋeʋẽ nana be wògadzena, ɖea alɔ abe ati fɛ̃ ene.

english_verse: Humans are different— we die, and that's the end.
translation_verse: Ke ne amegbetɔ ku la, emlɔa anyi, drana ɖi. Ne gbetɔ mia nu la, afi kae wògale?

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Ale si tsi nona le tá me, eye tsi miena le tɔyo me la,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: nenemae gbetɔ kuna, megagbɔa agbe o. Va se ɖe esime dziƒowo nu nava yi la, gbetɔ manyɔ akpɔ o; naneke manyɔe tso eƒe alɔ̃ me gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: O, ne ɖe nàɣlam ɖe tsiẽƒe, aɖo ŋkeke nam, eye nàdzram ɖo ɖe afi ma va se ɖe esime wò dɔmedzoe nu nafa, eye nàɖo ŋku dzinye la, anyo kpem!

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Ne gbetɔ ku la, ɖe wòagagbɔ agbea? Le nye subɔsubɔɣi bliboa me la, magbɔ dzi ɖi, va se ɖe esime ame bubu nava ɖɔlim.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Àyɔm, eye matɔ na wò; àdi wò asinudɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Elabe ɣe ma ɣi àxlẽ nye afɔɖeɖewo, eye màgalé ŋku ɖe nye nuvɔ̃wo ŋu o.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Àdzi nye dzidadawo goŋgoŋ ɖe kotoku me atre enu, eye atsyɔ nu nye vodadawo dzi.”

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: “Ke to gbãna hetua wɔ, eye agakpe tena ɖa le enɔƒe.

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: Tsi nyia kpe wòvɔna, eye tsiɖɔɖɔ kplɔa ke nyui ɖa le anyigba dzi keŋkeŋ. Alea ke nègblẽa gbetɔ ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ mee.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Ètea amegbetɔ ɖe to ʋuu wotsrɔ̃na. Ètrɔa eƒe mo bubui, eye nènyanɛ ɖa.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Ne woɖe bubu le viawo ŋu la, menyana o, eye ne wodo vlo wo hã la, medzea sii o.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã koe sea veve eye wòxaa nu le eɖokui me.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Tete Elifaz, Temantɔ la ɖo eŋu be:

english_verse: Job, if you had any sense,
translation_verse: “Ðe nunyala aɖo nya ŋu kple bometsinya, eye wòatsɔ ɣedzeƒeya ayɔ eɖokuia?

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Ðe wòatsɔ nuƒo maɖevi alo nya siwo me tsɔɖu aɖeke mele o la, anɔ eɖokui ta ʋlima?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Ke èle asi ɖem le Mawu-vɔvɔ̃ ŋu, eye nèle mɔ xem na ɖokuimeyiyi le Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Elabe wò nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le nu fiam wò nu, eye wò aɖe le nya me tiam ayetɔe.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutɔ wò nue le fɔ bum wò; menye nyee o. Wò ŋutɔ wò nuyiwoe nye ɖasefo ɖe ŋuwò.”

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: “Wòe nye amegbetɔ gbãtɔ wodzia? Alo wòe tre dzɔdzɔ na togbɛwoa?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Ðe nèɖo to Mawu ƒe adzamedaŋudede, eye ɖe nèbu be ye ɖeka koe nya nua?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ta ɣi tɔwo kple amegãɖeɖi siwo tsi wu tɔ́wò la le mía dome.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Ðe Mawu ƒe akɔfanya kple gbe bɔbɔe, si wòtsɔ le nu ƒom na wò la, meɖi naneke na wò oa?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Nu ka ta wò dzi kplɔ wò yina tatra ge, eye nèle ŋku trom alea gbegbe?

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nètsi tre ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye nya siawo tɔgbe le dodom le nuwò?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu meɖoa dzi ɖe eƒe kɔkɔetɔwo ŋu o; dziƒowo gɔ̃ hã medza le eŋkume o.

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: Ko wòahaɖo dzi ɖe amegbetɔ, si wɔa ŋunyɔnu kple nuvɔ̃ɖi, eye nu vlo wɔwɔ bɔbɔ nɛ abe tsinono ene la, ŋua?”

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, ɖo to, mato nya na wò. Magblɔ nu si teƒe mekpɔ la na wò,

english_verse: wisdom known by others since ancient times.
translation_verse: nu si nunyalawo gblɔ, eye wo tɔgbuiwo meɣla ɖeke o,

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: ame siwo ɖeɖe ko wotsɔ anyigba la na, eye amedzro aɖeke metsaka wo o.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi la, vevesese me ko wònɔna le eƒe agbenɔɣi katã. Fu ko ŋutasẽla kpena le agbe me.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdziɣli ɖina le eƒe to me, eye ne nu nyo nɛ wòɖe dzi ɖi la, nugblẽla ƒona ɖe edzi kpoyi.

english_verse: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.
translation_verse: Mexɔe se be yeado le viviti me o; yi koe le elalam.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Ele tsa glalã tsam le nuɖuɖu dim le gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Afi ka wòakpɔe le?’ Enya be vivitidogbe tu ye vɔ.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Xaxa kple vevesese doa ŋɔdzi nɛ. Wodzea edzi abe fia si ho aʋa la ene.

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Elabe edo asi ɖe Mawu ŋkume, eye wòdze aglã ɖe Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ŋu la.

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: Elũ ɖe Mawu dzi kɔlialiatɔe, eye wòtrɔ eƒe akpoxɔnu ƒe titria ƒe do ɖee,

english_verse: They may be rich and fat,
translation_verse: elabe ekpɔ lã me ɖe mo gbɔ, eye eƒe alime de ami.

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: Enɔ du gbagbãwo kple aƒedo siwo zu glikpo la me.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Masí le ku ƒe viviti nu o. Anɔ abe ati si ƒe alɔwo dzo fiã la ene, eye ya aƒo eƒe seƒoƒowo adzoe.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Meganɔ ŋu ɖom ɖe nu dzodzrowo ŋu, anɔ eɖokui blem o, elabe yakanu ko anye eƒe fetu.

english_verse: like a date palm tree without a leaf.
translation_verse: Hafi eƒe ŋkeke nade la, axɔ eƒe fetu deblibo la, eye eƒe atilɔ made ama o.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Alulũ abe waintsetse gbogboe le ka ŋu, eye adudu abe amiti ƒe seƒoƒo ene.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Mawumavɔ̃lawo ƒe ha medzina ɖe edzi o, eye dzo afiã aƒe siwo wotso kple zãnuxɔxɔ.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Wofɔ ayemenuwɔwɔ ƒe fu, hetsɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi dzi, eye woƒe dzime yɔ fũu kple alakpa.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Mese nya siawo tɔgbe zi geɖe. Akɔfala siwo miebe yewonye la, veve ko dzim ɖe edzi mi katã miele nam.

english_verse: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?
translation_verse: Nu kpoloe ƒoƒoa mevɔ kpɔ oa? Nu kae dɔ wò nèle nu ƒom alea gbegbe?

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Nenye miawoe le tenyeƒe la, anye ne nye hã matsi nya ɖe nya nu ɖe mia ŋu alea ke. Maʋuʋu ta, ada mi ɖe anyi.

english_verse: But I would offer hope and comfort instead.
translation_verse: Maƒo nu ade dzi ƒo na mi, eye magblɔ nya geɖe afa akɔe na mi.”

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: “Ne meƒo nu la, nye vevesesea dzi maɖe o, eye ne mezi ɖoɖoe hã, mafa nam o.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Mawu na ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye keŋ azɔ. Ena metsi akogo.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Mawu do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye, eye wòvuvum. Elé fum. Eɖu aɖukli ɖe ŋunye, eye wòklẽ ŋku dom abe nye futɔ ene.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli gblɔ nya vlowo ɖe ŋunye; woƒo tome nam fewuɖutɔe, eye wova sɔ ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Mawu gblẽm ɖe mawumavɔ̃lawo si me, eye wòtsɔm de asi na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Mele ŋutifafa me, ɖe dzi ɖi bɔkɔɔ, eye wòŋem ɖe eve. Tete wògbãm gudugudu. Elé ve nam, eye wòxlãm ɖi mekaka ʋayaʋaya. Etsɔm ɖo nudzidzea na eɖokui.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: Eƒe aŋutrɔdalawo ƒo xlãm. Efé nye ayikuwo me nublanuimakpɔtɔe. Etrɔ nye vevee kɔ ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Metɔ akpanya ɖe nye ŋutigbalẽ ŋu, eye metsɔ nye ŋusẽ katã de ʋuʋudedi me.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Mefa avi ʋuu nye mo do ʋusrã, eye viviti tsiɖitsiɖi do ɖe nye ŋku dzi.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, nyemesẽ ŋuta le ame aɖeke ŋu o, eye nye gbedodoɖa dza.”

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: “O, Anyigba, mègatsyɔ nye ʋu dzi o. Na nye ɣli nade afi sia afi.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, fifi gɔ̃ hã, nye ɖasefo le dziƒo, eye ame si ƒoa nu, ʋlia tanye la le afi ma.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Konyelawo la, xɔ̃nyewoe. Mele aɖatsi fam na Mawu

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: be wòana gbetɔ ƒe nya dzɔdzɔe nadze le eŋkume, abe ale si amegbetɔ tsòna na ehavi ene.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Elabe nye ƒe ʋɛawo le dedem, eye madze mɔ aɖo ta demagbɔnugbe.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Nu té nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu, eye nye ŋkekewo de vɔ; yɔdo koe le dzɔyem.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, amekolawoe ɖe to ɖem. Nye ŋku le woƒe dzikudoname ŋu.”

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: “Mawu, dè megbe nam le ɖokuiwò gbɔ, ne mado le nya me. Ame ka gɔ̃e gali ade megbe nam?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Èwɔe be womase nu gɔme o, eya ta mègana woaɖu dzi o.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Ame si tsia tre ɖe xɔlɔ̃awo ŋu be yeakpɔ gome le woƒe nunɔamesiwo me la, viawo ƒe ŋku abiã.”

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: “Etsɔm do hameloe na dukɔwo, eye amewo le ta ɖem ɖe mo nam.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Mexa nu ʋuu nye ŋkuwo megale nu kpɔm nyuie o. Nye ŋutinuwo zu abe vɔvɔli ene.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Esia na be ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe nu ku, eye ame maɖifɔ do dziku ɖe Mawumavɔ̃la ŋu.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla anɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ dzi, eye ame dzadzɛ akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkeke de; nye dzime didi kple ɖoɖowo me gblẽ.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Wotrɔ viviti zu ŋkekee. Wogblɔ le kekeli ŋu be egogo viviti.

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Ne meɖo ŋu ɖe tsiẽƒe ŋu abe nye aƒe ene, ne meɖo aba ɖe viviti me,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: ne meyɔ yɔdo be: ‘Tɔ́nye’, eye meyɔ nyéwo be: ‘Nɔnye’ alo ‘Nɔvinye nyɔnu’ hã la,

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: afi ka nye mɔkpɔkpɔ le? Ame kae akpɔ be mɔkpɔkpɔ gale asinye?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ðe nye mɔkpɔkpɔ akplɔm yi ʋɔnu le tsiẽƒea? Afɔ ɖeka dzie nye kplii míazɔ ayi ke mea?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Tete Bildad, Suaxtɔ la ɖo eŋu be:

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Ɣe ka ɣi nàdzudzɔ nyamɔ̀ɖoɖo? Mibu tame nyuie gbã hafi míaƒo nu.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta wobu mí lãwoe? Nu ka ta míenye movitɔwo le wo gbɔ?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: “Nyateƒe, ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe akaɖi tsina, eye eƒe dzo ƒe aɖe gɔ̃ hã gbea keklẽ.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Eƒe afɔɖeɖe ziaziazia tona ɖe eme, eye eya ŋutɔ ƒe nugbeɖoɖo tsɔnɛ ƒua anyi.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Kamɔ̀e léa eƒe afɔkɔe, eye mɔ̀ka ɖenɛ.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi lénɛ le afi sia afi, eye woyɔnɛ ɖe nu kplíkplikpli.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Dɔwuame na eƒe ŋusẽ vɔ keŋkeŋ. Dzɔgbevɔ̃e le klalo ɖe eƒe nukikli ŋu.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Dɔléame ɖua eƒe ŋutilã, eye ku ƒe ŋgɔgbevi ɖua asi kple afɔwo nɛ.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Wohenɛ sesẽtɔe tso eƒe aƒe si ŋu wòɖo ŋu ɖo la me vaa fia ŋɔdzidonamela la gbɔ.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Naneke meganɔa eƒe aƒeme o, eye wokɔa aŋɔ ɖe enɔƒe.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Eƒe ke kuna ɖe to me, eye eƒe alɔwo yrɔna le edzi.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Wotua asii tso kekeli me dea viviti me; wonyànɛ dzonae le xexea me.

english_verse: without any children to carry on their name.
translation_verse: Vi alo tɔgbuiyɔvi manɔ esi le wo de o, eye ame matsi agbe anɔ enɔƒe o.

english_verse: Everyone, from east to west, is overwhelmed with horror.
translation_verse: Ɣetoɖoƒetɔwo ƒe nu aku, eye ŋɔ adzi ɣedzeƒetɔwo le eƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, esia tututue dzɔna ɖe ame mavɔ̃mawu dzi, eye aleae ame si medze si Mawu o la ƒe nɔƒe zuna.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Ɣe ka ɣi miawɔ funyafunyam ase ɖo? Ɣe ka ɣi miatsɔ nyawo agbãm nyànyanya ase ɖo?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, zigbɔzi ewo sɔŋ miedzum. Ŋu mekpe mi be yewoda vo ɖe ŋunye oa?

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Ne ele me be meda vo gɔ̃ hã la, nye vodada nye nye ŋutɔ ƒe agba.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Nenye nyateƒee miele mia ɖokui dom ɖe dzi be yewonyo wum, eye be nye ŋukpe tso nye ŋutɔ gbɔ la,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: minya nyuie be Mawue bu fɔm, eye wòda ɖɔ lém.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, medo ɣli be: ‘Evɔ nam loo!’ Ame aɖeke metɔ nam o. Medo boboe; ke ame aɖeke metso xɔ nam o.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Etɔ kpɔ xe mɔ nam; afi aɖeke toto meli o; ena viviti do ɖe nye mɔ dzi.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Mawu do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye vevie, eye wòbum eƒe futɔe.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Eƒe aʋakɔwo ƒo ƒu, lũ ɖe dzinye. Woɖe mɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye woƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe nye aƒe ŋu va kpe.”

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: “Eɖe nɔvinye ŋutsuwo ɖa le ŋunye sãa, eye mezu amedzro na xɔ̃nyewo.

english_verse: and I am forgotten.
translation_verse: Ƒonyemewo kple xɔ̃nye veviwo gblẽm ɖi.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Nye amedzrowo, ẽ, nye dɔlanyɔnuwo gɔ̃ hã le buyem amedzroe, eye mezu ame manyamanya na wo.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Meyɔ nye dɔlaŋutsu, metɔ o; wòle be make nu aƒo koko nɛ.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Nye nu me le ʋeʋẽm ɖe srɔ̃nye, eye mele ya ɖem ɖe nye ŋutɔŋutɔ vinyewo.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Ðevi suewo gɔ̃ hã do vlom, eye ne metso la, wole nu ƒom le ŋunye.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Mele ŋu nyɔm na xɔ̃nye veviwo, eye ame siwo melɔ̃ la tso ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutigbalẽ kple lãkusi lé ɖe nye ƒuwo ŋu; mekpɔ ku ŋkume kple ŋkume.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Xɔ̃nyewo, mive nunye! Mive nunye dzro la! Elabe Mawu ƒe asi ka ŋunye.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Mawu le yonyeme tim, nu ka ta miawo hã miaganɔ yonyeme tim? Ðe nye ŋutilã meɖi ƒo na mi oa?”

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: “O, ɖe ame aɖe aŋlɔ nye nu me nya siawo ɖi hafi; ɖe woade wo agbalẽ me.

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, menyae be nye Xɔnametɔ le agbe, eye mlɔeba la, atsi tsitre ɖe anyigba dzi,

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: eye ne wovuvu nye ŋutigbalẽ ʋayaʋaya ale hã la, manɔ nye ŋutilã me akpɔ Mawu.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Makpɔe tututu. Nye ŋutɔ nye ŋkue akpɔe, menye ame tutɔ tɔ o. Nu te nye dzi ŋu le menye.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Ne miegblɔ be: ‘Ale ke míati eyome? Nya la ƒe dzɔtsoƒe le egbɔ.’

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: Mivɔ̃ yi, elabe dɔmedzoe hea yi ƒe tohehe vanɛ bene mianya be ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ li.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Tete Zofar, Naamatitɔ la ɖo eŋu be:

english_verse: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, metsi dzodzodzoe le ɖokuinye me, eya ta maɖo nya si nègblɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Èdzum ɖe nya me, eye nye nugɔmesese dɔm be maɖo eŋu.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: Ðe mènya o be tso tìtiti esime woɖo amegbetɔ ɖe anyigba dzi la,

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aseyetsotso le kpuie ko, eye mawumavɔ̃la ƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ medidina kura oa?

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ne ekɔ yi dzi ʋĩi, eye eƒe ta ɖatɔ alilikpowo gɔ̃ hã la,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: ayi to ʋĩi abe eya ŋutɔ ƒe mí ene, eye ame si kpɔnɛ la biana be: ‘Eyama ɖe?’

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Ame si kpɔnɛ la magakpɔe o, eye eƒemetɔwo hã magakpɔe o.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Viawo adi nyui na ame dahewo, eye woagbugbɔ eƒe kesinɔnuwo ana wo.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ɖekakpuime ŋusẽ gale eŋu hã la, aku, woaɖii kplii ɖe ke me.”

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: “Ne nuvɔ̃ɖiwɔwɔ le vivim le nu me nɛ abe anyitsi ene, eye wòɣlae ɖe eƒe aɖe te,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: nuɖuɖua atrɔ zu ƒli ƒe aɖi ɖe dɔme nɛ.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Emi amewo ƒe kesinɔnuwo, eye wòle nɛ be wòadzɔ wo. Mawu aɖe wo tso eƒe dɔ me.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Ƒli ƒe aɖi wòno, eye dzakpata ƒe aɖie awui.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Makpɔ gome le anyitsi kple notsi tòto siwo le tsatsam abe tɔsisi kple tɔʋu ene la me o.

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: Elabe egbã ame dahewo hegblẽ wo ɖi; exɔ xɔ si metu o la sesẽe.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Esi mele ƒo ɖim o ta la, mate ŋu adzra eƒe kesinɔnu aɖeke ɖo o.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Le eƒe nu tsu ɖuɖu ta, naneke masusɔ o eya ta nu madze edzi nɛ didie o.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Ne nunɔamesiwo le esi fũu hã, anye nublanuitɔ, eye hiã akae.

english_verse: and God will make them swallow his blazing anger.
translation_verse: Esime wòle didim be yeaɖi ƒo zã la, Mawu atrɔ dziku helihelĩ akɔ ɖi nɛ wòaɖu.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ne esí le ga yibɔ lãnu nu la, akɔbliŋutrɔ aƒo ɖee.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Aŋutrɔ la aŋɔ eƒe vevegoe. Ahee doe tso eƒe lã me. Enu ada dzo wòakpɔ, eye ŋɔdzi alée.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Blukɔ ado ɖe eƒe kesinɔnuwo dzi. Dzo si amegbetɔ meƒlɔ ɖo o la afiãe, eye wòatsrɔ̃ nu sia nu si susɔ ɖe eƒeme la keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Dziƒowo aklo nu le eƒe vodada dzi. Anyigba atso ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe alɔ agblemenuku siwo wòxa ɖe aƒeme la adzoe.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Esia nye ame vlo ƒe gome tso Mawu gbɔ. Enye domenyinu si Mawu ɖo ɖi nɛ.” ɛ.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “O, miɖo to miase nye nya dzro; eya koe nye akɔfafa dim mele tso mia gbɔ.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Migbɔ dzi ɖi nam ne maƒo nu, eye ne meƒo nu vɔ hã, miaɖe alɔ me le ŋunye faa.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ nu tsom melea? Nu ka ta nyematsi dzi o? Nu ka ta maɖe dzi ɖi?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Mitrɔ kpɔm ɖa! Miaƒe nu aku, eye gbɔgblɔ abu ɖe mi.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Hm, ne mebu nu si dzɔ ɖe dzinye ŋu la, metɔtɔna, eye medzona nyànyanya.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tsia agbe, va kua amegã, eye woƒe ŋusẽ dzina ɖe edzi ɖo?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Wonɔa agbe, wo viwo lia ke le wo gbɔ, eye wokpɔa woƒe dzidzimeviwo gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Wonɔa woƒe aƒewo me dedie, womevɔ̃na o, eye Mawu mehea to na wo kple eƒe ameƒoti o.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Woƒe nyitsu yɔa asi woƒe nyinɔ, doa fu. Woƒe nyinɔ fɔa fu dzina, fu megena le wo ƒo o.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Woɖea asi le wo viwo ŋu wodoa go abe alẽha ene, eye wo viwo ɖua ɣe.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Wodzia ha ɖe gakogoe kple gakasaŋku ŋu, eye wodzɔa dzi ɖe dze ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Woƒe ŋkekewo yɔ fũu kple nunyoname, eye kasia ko, wodzo yi tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Wogblɔna na Mawu be: ‘Te ɖa le mía gbɔ! Mímedi be míanya naneke le wò mɔwo ŋu o.

english_verse: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
translation_verse: Ame kae Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la nye be míasubɔe? Viɖe ka míakpɔ ne míedo gbe ɖa nɛ?’

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ɖe woƒe dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ metso woawo ŋutɔ gbɔ oa? Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe adaŋudede te ɖa sãa tso gbɔnye.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: “Ðe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe akaɖi metsina enuenu oa? Ðe dzɔgbevɔ̃e medzɔna ɖe wo dzi oa? Ðe Mawu medoa dziku ɖe wo ŋu, eye wònana be wokpea fu oa?

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Ðe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo mele abe gbe ƒuƒu si ya lɔna ɖe nu ene oa? Ðe womele abe tsro si ahom kplɔna dzonae ene oa?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Àgblɔ be: ‘Mawu lia kɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖi na wo viwo.’ Ao! Neɖo eteƒe na woawo ŋutɔ bene woanya ale si wòle.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nekpɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃ kple ŋku. Woawo ŋutɔ neno Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe dɔmedzoe helihelĩ la.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ne woƒe ŋkeke de woku la, ɖe wogatsɔa ɖe le woƒe aƒemenyawo mea?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dziƒotɔwo gɔ̃ hã la, ɖe ame aɖe afia nunya eyama?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ame bubu ya kpe fu geɖe, eye mese vivi aɖeke le agbe me kpɔ hafi ku o.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Ke wo kple eve la siaa mlɔ ke me sɔsɔe, nyéwo tsyɔ wo dzi abe avɔ ene.”

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, menya miaƒe susu kple aɖaŋu vɔ̃ siwo mieɖo ɖe ŋunye la.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Elabe miebia be: ‘Afi ka amegã ƒe aƒe le? Agbadɔ si me ame vɔ̃ɖi la nɔ la ɖe?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Womegblɔ be le dzɔgbevɔ̃e gbe la, wotoa ame vɔ̃ɖi ŋuti dzaa, eye woxɔna nɛ le dɔmedzoedogbe oa?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Ne wokɔe yi do gbɔ la, wodzɔa yɔdo la ŋu.

english_verse: the earth welcomes them home, while crowds mourn.
translation_verse: Anyikɔwo vivia enu, amewo dzea eyome. Ame siwo dze eŋgɔ la mele xexlẽme o.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: Ne ele alea ɖe, ale ke miafa akɔ nam kple miaƒe nya dzodzro siawo? Miaƒe ŋuɖoɖowo katã nye alakpa.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Tete Elifaz Temantɔ la ɖo eŋu be:

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Ðe amegbetɔ ate ŋu aɖe vi na Mawua? Le nyateƒe me la, ne ame nye nunyala la, eya ŋutɔ ko wòɖe vi na.

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ne ènye ame dzɔdzɔe la, ɖe wòdoa dzidzɔ na Ŋusẽkatãtɔ laa? Ne mokaka mele wò nuwɔnawo ŋu o la, viɖe ka wònye na Mawu?

english_verse: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?
translation_verse: Wò mawuvɔvɔ̃ ta wòle to hem na wò, eye wòkplɔ wò yi ʋɔnuia?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Menye wò nuvɔ̃ɖiwoe keke ta, eye seɖoƒe meli na wò vodadawo tae oa?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Elabe èxɔ nu awɔbae le nɔviwòwo si dzodzro. Èɖe awu le numanɔsitɔwo ŋu, wotsi amama.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Mèna tsi ame siwo gbafa ƒo la wono o, eye nète abolo dɔwuitɔwo.

english_verse: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.
translation_verse: Alɔkpa sesẽ tɔe xɔa anyigba, eye ame ŋkutae nɔa edzi.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Ènya ahosiwo dzoe asi gbɔlo. Èwɔ nu vevi tsyɔ̃eviwo.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Eya ta èɖo mɔ̀ dziŋɔ me, eye ŋɔdzi lé wò kpata.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Wò kekeli do viviti ale be mègale nu kpɔm o. Tsiɖɔɖɔ nyè tsyɔ dziwò.”

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: “Menye dziƒo ʋĩi ke Mawu le oa? Kpɔ ale si ɣletiviwo gbɔ metsɔ o la ɖa!

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Ko nèbe: ‘Nu ka Mawu nya? Ðe wòate ŋu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu to alilikpo dodowo mea?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Alilikpo do xe eŋkume ale be mele nu kpɔm o. Dziŋgɔli ƒe goawo dzi ke wòle tsatsam le.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Blemamɔ si dzi ame vɔ̃ɖiwo zɔ la nèbe yeatoa?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Evɔ wònye etsɔ nu nyuiwo yɔ xɔ na wo taŋ hafi. Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe adaŋudede te ɖa sãa tso gbɔnye.

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Ne esia va eme la, ame dzɔdzɔewo kpɔa dzidzɔ, eye ame maɖifɔwo ɖua fewu le wo ŋu,

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: gblɔna be: ‘Nyateƒe, wotsrɔ̃ míaƒe ketɔwo, eye dzo fiã woƒe nuwo keŋ!’ ”

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: “Wɔ ɖeka kple Mawu, eye ŋuwò afa. To esia me nu nyui asu asiwò.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Na Mawu nafia nu wò, eye nàdzra eƒe nyawo ɖo ɖe wò dzime.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Ne ètrɔ va Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la gbɔ, eye nèbɔbɔ ɖokuiwò, ne èdzudzɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ le aƒewò me,

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: ne ètsɔ sika kɔ ɖe ke me, eye nètsɔ Ofir-sika kɔ ɖe kpekui me le tɔʋuwo me,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ne Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la nye wò sika kple klosalo xɔasi la,

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: ekema àkpɔ dzidzɔ le Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ŋu, eye àwu mo dzi na Mawu.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Ne èdo gbe ɖa nɛ la, asee na wò, eye àwɔ wò adzɔgbe si nèɖe la dzi.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Ne èɖo nane be yeawɔ la, adze edzi na wò, eye kekeli aklẽ ɖe wò mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu bɔbɔa dàdalawo ɖe anyi; ke exɔna na ame siwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Eɖea ame maɖifɔ la; woaɖe wò esi wò asiwo le dzadzɛ ta!”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Egbe hã, mele konyi fam vevie, elabe eƒe asi sẽ ɖe dzinye togbɔ be mele hũɖeɖe dzi hã.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Aa! Ne ɖe manya afi si make ɖe eŋu le, eye mado ɖe eƒe zikpui ŋgɔ la, anyo kpem!

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Ðe wòatsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la aʋli nya kplima? Kpao! Aɖo tom boŋ.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Afi ma la, ame dzɔdzɔe ate ŋu adzro nya me kplii. Tɔnye adzɔ, eye nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la atso afia nam, mavo tegbee.”

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, mezɔ yi ŋgɔ; ke mele afi ma o. Mezɔ ɖe megbe, nyemekpɔe o.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Medii to miame, nyemete ŋu kpɔe o; Metrɔ ɖe ɖusime; ke nyemeke ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Ke enya mɔ si dzi mele. Ne edom kpɔ la, madza abe sika ene.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Meto eƒe afɔtoƒe tututu; meto eƒe mɔ dzi tẽe. Nye afɔ meda le eƒe mɔ dzi o.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Ke eya metrɔna o. Ame ka atrɔ eƒe tameɖoɖo? Nu si wòɖo la, eyae wòwɔna.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Elabe ɖoɖo si wòwɔ nam la, awɔe awu enu. Nu sia tɔgbe geɖewo le susu me nɛ.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Elabe blukɔ ƒo xlãm, eye viviti tsiɖitsiɖi tsyɔ mo nam.

translation_verse: Ne dzi ɖe le wo ƒo la, meɖoa nukomo na wo, eye womegbea nye mo kpɔkpɔ o.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Nyee tia mɔ na wo; menye woƒe tatɔ, eye menɔ wo dome abe fia le eƒe aʋakɔwo dome ene. Ẽ, abe akɔfala le konyifalawo dome ene.”

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: “Ke egbe la, yonyemeviwo hã le fewu ɖum le ŋunye. Ame siawo la, ne wobe maxɔ wo tɔ́wo, ne woanɔ avuwo ŋu woakplɔ nye alẽhawo gɔ̃ hã la, magbe.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Viɖe ka makpɔ le woƒe alɔka me? Ŋusẽ vɔ le wo ŋu keŋ.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Hiã kple dɔwuame na agbe vɔ le wo ŋu. Ame siawo kukoa anyigba ƒuƒu si nye gbegbe kple amemanɔƒe la.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Wokéa aŋɔto le gbeto, eye dɔli ƒe ɖoɖoa nye woƒe nuɖuɖu.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Ame siawo la, wonya wo ɖa le ame dome kple ɣli abe fiafitɔ ene.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Ele be woanɔ tɔsisi ŋu, agadowo, ʋewo kple agakpewo me.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Woxlɔ̃na le avekɔewo me, eye womimina ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu le aŋɔkawo te.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Bometsilawo, ame ɖigbɔwo ƒe viwo wonye. Ame siwo wonyà ɖa kple atam le anyigba dzi la.”

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: “Azɔ ame siawo viwoe kpa ha dem le dzidzim! Mezu hamelo na wo.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Mele ŋu nyɔm na wo; wote ɖe megbe tso ŋunye, eye ne wokpɔm la, womegbea taɖeɖe o.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu gbɔdzɔ nye dati ƒe ka me, hebɔbɔm ɖe anyi ta, woawo hã le nunye ɖiam.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Yakamewo to nye ɖusime tutum ƒu anyi, eye wodi mɔnu be yewoagblẽ donye me.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Woxe mɔ nam, wona nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzi ɖe edzi; ame aɖeke megbe nya na wo o.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi lém. Woti nye bubu yome abe yaƒoƒo ene, eye nye dzidzedze bu abe alilikpo ene.”

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: “Evɔ nam azɔ; medɔ̃! Fukpekpe ɖi kpem!

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Zã le nu tɔm nye ƒuwo tome eye vevesese le kukoyem madzudzɔmadzudzɔe.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Elé awu ɖe ŋunye sesĩe eye wòmia dziwui ɖe ve nam.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔm xlã ɖe ba me; mezu ke kple dzowɔ.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli yɔ wò; metɔna nam o. Metso tsi tsitre ɖi, gake mede nu eme nam o.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Èlém ɖe ya nu, eye ahom nyamam heƒom dzoe.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Menya nyuie be àkplɔm ayi kuwode kple aƒe si wotia na agbagbeawo katã la me.”

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Ke esi mekpɔ mɔ na dzɔgbe nyui la, dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖi kpem. Mekpɔ mɔ na kekeli; ke vivitie dó.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le tsotsom madzudzɔmadzudzɔe. Fukpeŋkekewo ƒo ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Mele zɔzɔm le viviti me, ke menye ɣe ye wɔe o. Metso le boboe dom le dutakpekpe me be woaxɔ nam.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Mezu akpataku nɔvi kple tsatsaboli hati le konyifaɣli dom.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutigbalẽ nyɔ vìi hele fofom; nye lã me dze dzo ʋuu, nye ƒuwo fiã gɔ̃.

english_verse: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.
translation_verse: Nye gakasaŋku le konyifagbe dom, eye nye kpẽkuku ɖina avigbee.”

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: “Mebla nu kple nye ŋku. Ale ke wɔ magatsɔ ahiãŋku anɔ ɖetugbi kpɔmee?

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Menye nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlae tsrɔ̃na, eye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla dzie dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔna ɖo oa?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Ðe Mawu mele nye agbenɔnɔ kpɔm oa? Ðe meléa ŋku ɖe nye afɔɖeɖe ɖe sia ɖe ŋu oa?

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: Ne menɔ agbe alakpatɔe, alo nye afɔ tsɔ ɖe amebeble ŋu la,

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: mina woadam le nudanu nyuitɔ dzi, ne Mawu nadze si nye nuteƒewɔwɔ.

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: ekema ne maƒã nu la, ame bubu neɖui. Woneho nye nukuwo kple ke.”

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: “Ne nye dzi trɔ ɖe nyɔnu ŋu, eye mede xa ɖe hanyevi ƒe ʋɔtru xa la,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: srɔ̃nye netu wɔ na ame tutɔ, eye ame tutɔwo nedɔ kplii.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Elabe nu sia nye ŋukpenanu gã, eye wònye se dzi dada le ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo ŋkume.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: Ẽ, dzobibi wònye; efiãa nu yia keke tsiẽƒe ke. Afiã nu siwo katã nye tɔnye la keŋ.”

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: “Ne nye dɔlaŋutsu alo dɔlanyɔnu ƒo koko nam, eye nyemekpɔ nyaa gbɔ nɛ nyuie o la,

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: nu ka mawɔ ne Mawu tso? Ne edzro nya la me kpɔ la, ale ke maɖo eŋu nɛ?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ðe menye ame si wɔm ɖe dɔ me la kee wɔ eya hã oa? Ðe menye ame ɖekae me mí ɖe vidzidɔ me oa?”

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: “Ðe ame dahe aɖe bia num, metee kpɔ, alo ɖe mena dzi ɖe le ahosi ƒo kpɔa?

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Ðe nye ɖeɖe meka nu ɖu kpɔ, eye nyemeka na tsyɔ̃evi oa?

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Elabe nyee nye tɔ́ nɛ tso eƒe ɖevime ke, eye mefia afɔɖoƒee tso nɔa ƒe dɔme ke.

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: ɖe nye alẽwo ƒe fuwu medea dzo lã me nɛ, eye wòdaa akpe nam tso dzime ke oa?

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Ne medo asi ɖe mo na tsyɔ̃evi elabe ame ade dzinye le ʋɔnu la,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: ekema nye abɔgba netra le nye abɔta, eye nye abɔ netu ɖa le ekpeƒe!

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Nu si ta mewɔ esiawo lae nye be mevɔ̃ Mawu ƒe tohehe dziŋɔ la, eye le Mawu ƒe gãnyenye ta, nyemate ŋu awɔ nuvɔ̃ siawo o.”

english_verse: I have never trusted the power of wealth,
translation_verse: “Nyemeɖo dzi ɖe sika ŋu, alo ɖo ŋu ɖe sika nyuitɔ ŋu kpɔ o.

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: Nyemeda ɖe nye kesinɔnuwo dzi kpɔ alo be metsɔ asi wɔ dɔ kpɔ nu geɖe o.

english_verse: I have never openly or secretly
translation_verse: Nyemesubɔ ɣe kple eƒe keklẽ alo dzinu kple eƒe nyonyo kpɔ o.

english_verse: worshiped the sun or moon.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke meblem megbugbɔ asi ɖo ɖe wo kpɔ o.

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: “Ðe metso aseye esime nye futɔ dome gblẽ alo dzɔ dzi ne vɔ̃ dzɔ ɖe edzia?

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Kpao! Nyemewɔ nuvɔ̃ ke nu, di ku nɛ kpɔ o.
