english_verse: No one ever went hungry at my house,
translation_verse: Ðe aƒenye me tɔwo mebiana be: ‘Ame kae li si mekpɔ nu ɖu kpɔ o?’

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Nyemetsyɔ nu nye dzidadawo dzi abe amegbetɔ ene o, eye nyemeɣla nye nuvɔ̃wo ɖe akɔ nu o.

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Elabe dzidzi ƒoam le ameha gãwo ŋkume, eye ƒometɔwo ƒe dzudzu dzia ŋɔ nam ale be mezia ɖoɖoe hetsia xɔ me madomadoe.

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: O, ame aɖe nese nye nya nam dzro la! Meƒo nu vɔ! Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la neɖo eŋu nam. Nunyetsola hã netsɔ eƒe samagbalẽ vɛ.

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, ne etsɔe vɛ la, madae ɖe abɔta; maxatsae ɖe ta abe fiakuku ene.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Magblɔ nu sia nu si mewɔ la nɛ. Mazɔ abe amegã ene ayi egbɔ.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: Ne nye agble le ɣli dom ɖe tanye, eye eƒe bowo katã le avi fam nam hoo,

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: ne meɖu agblea me nuku aɖe femaxee, eye mena agbletɔ ku la,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: ŋu nemie ɖe lu teƒe, eye gbe vɔ̃e nemie ɖe ƒo teƒe.” Hiob ƒe nyawo vɔ.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Ale ŋutsu etɔ̃awo dzudzɔ nya ŋu ɖoɖo na Hiob, elabe ebu eɖokui ame dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Tete Elihu do dziku be Hiob bu eɖokui ame dzɔdzɔe wu Mawu. Elihu nye Baraxel vi, eye Baraxel nye Buz ƒe dzidzimevi tso Ram-ƒome la me.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: Edo dziku ɖe Hiob xɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo hã ŋu, elabe togbɔ be wobu fɔ Hiob hã la, womete ŋu ɖo eƒe nyawo ŋu nɛ o.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu ye nye ɖevitɔ. Ke Elihu tsɔ eƒe nyawo le Hiob dzɔmee elabe ame kemɛawo tsi wui.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Esi ame etɔ̃awo mete ŋu ɖo Hiob ƒe nyaawo ŋu nɛ o la, dzi ku Elihu.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Elihu, Buzitɔ, Baraxel vi la gblɔ be: Elihu ƒo nu “Nyemetsi o, miawo mietsi wum sãa, eya ta mevɔ̃ be magblɔ nye susu afia mi.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Megblɔ na ɖokuinye be: ‘Tsitsiawo neƒo nu gbɔ; ƒè geɖee xɔlae fiaa nunya ame.’

english_verse: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.
translation_verse: Gake Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe gbɔgbɔ si le amegbetɔ me lae naa gɔmesese.

english_verse: Age is no guarantee of wisdom and understanding.
translation_verse: Nunya mele tsitsime o, eye menye amegãɖeɖiwo koe nya nu si le eteƒe la o.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Eya ta mebe: ‘Miɖo tom; mina nye hã maɖe nye nunya afia.’ ”

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Ðeko migagblɔ be: ‘Míedo go nunya; eglo mí. Eya kple Mawu koe akpla’ o.

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Menye gbɔnyee wòdo eƒe nya ɖo o, eye menye miaƒe nyawo tsɔ ge mala aɖo eŋu nɛ o.”

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: “Eglo wo. Womete ŋu le nya ŋu ɖom o; gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe wo.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ko nyea manɔ anyi ɖi, esime wole tsitre numaƒomaƒoe, eye womegale nya aɖeke ŋu ɖom oa?

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Nya le asinye kpaŋkpaŋ magblɔ; medo dzi ʋuu wòglo.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: Mezu lãgbalẽgolo yeye si wain yɔ taŋ, wotu nu ɖe enu. Ne nyemeƒo nu o la, mawó fifi laa.

english_verse: if I don't speak. *
translation_verse: Maƒo nu, ne mavo. Make nu aɖo nyaawo ŋu.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Nyemade ame aɖeke dzi o, eye nyemavivi nu me na ame aɖeke o.

english_verse: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
translation_verse: Elabe nyemenya ale si wovivia nu mee o; anye ne nye Wɔla aɖem ɖa kpuie.”

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: “Hiob, azɔ se nye nuƒoa, eye nàlé to ɖe nye nyawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔe wɔm, eye Ŋusẽkatãtɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔe na agbem.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: Ne ele ŋuwò la, ɖo eŋu nam; nɔ klalo kple wò nyawo, eye nàdze avu ɖi.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye kple wò ɖe míesɔ le Mawu ŋkume. Tsu woka me nye kple wò siaae.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Eya ta mele be nàvɔ̃m alo abu be mate ɖe ye dzi o.”

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: Èbe: ‘Medza, dzidada mele ŋunye o; ŋunye kɔ, eye nyemeda vo aɖeke o.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu kpɔ nane le ŋunye; ebum futɔe.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: Ede nye afɔ atikpofɔblanu kpekpe me, eye wòle ŋku lém ɖe nye nuwɔna ɖe sia ɖe ŋu.’ ”

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, maɖo nya sia ŋu na wò. Tɔwò medzɔ le esia me o. Mawu kpè wu gbetɔ.

english_verse: So why do you challenge God to answer you?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nèle nya ʋlim kplii be meɖo yeƒe nya aɖeke ŋu na ye o?

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Mawu ƒoa nu le mɔ vovovowo dzi gake amewo medea dzesii o.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: Ewɔa esia bene yeatrɔ wo ɖa le woƒe nuwɔnawo gbɔ, eye yeaɖe dàda ɖa le ame me.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ale wòxɔa eƒe agbe le yɔdo si me, eye meyia kuwode o.”

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: “Wotsɔa vevesese hã hea to na ame le dɔba dzi, eye eƒe ƒuwo me nɔa eɖum ƒùƒuƒu.

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu megadzronɛ o; eƒe nuɖuɖu lɔlɔ̃tɔ gɔ̃ hã nyɔa ŋu nɛ.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Eɖia ku; lã vɔna le eŋu keŋ, eye ƒu siwo medzena tsã o la, dona ɖe go glaŋ.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Ale eƒe agbe gogoa yɔdo, eye wòte ɖe ku Saɖagatsi ŋu.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Ke ne dɔla akpeakpeawo dome ame ɖeka, si nye xɔnametɔ va be yeafia mɔnu nyuitɔ amea,

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: eye wòve enu gblɔ be: ‘Ðee! Mègana wòayi kuwode o. Mekpɔ etafe axe. Ɖe asi le eŋu.

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: Na wòakpɔ lã me; ŋusẽ nagaɖo eŋu, eye wòagaɖo ɖekakpuime’ la,

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: ekema dɔnɔa ado gbe ɖa na Mawu. Mawu axɔe. Ava eŋkume kple dzidzɔ, axlẽ eƒe xɔname afia amewo.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Adzi ha le amewo dome be: ‘Mewɔ nuvɔ̃. Metrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe ta tu; gake Mawu meɖo eteƒe nam o.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: Exɔm ɖe agbe, nyemeyi yɔ me o. Maganɔ agbe, akpɔ kekeli.’ ”

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, edziedzi la, Mawu wɔa nu siawo katã na amegbetɔ

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: bene yeaɖee tso aʋlime si me ne wòaganɔ agbe, akpɔ kekeli.

english_verse: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt,
translation_verse: Hiob, da ŋku ɖi! Zi ɖoɖoe nàɖo tom, ne maƒo nu.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Ne nya le asiwò la, gblɔe mase, elabe medi be matso afia na wò.

english_verse: Otherwise, listen in silence to my wisdom.
translation_verse: Gake ne meli o la, zi ɖoɖoe, nàɖo tom, eye mafia nunya wò.”

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Mi nunyalawo, mise nye nyawo; mi nugɔmeselawo, milé to ɖe ŋunye

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: elabe to sea nyakpɔna abe ale si veme ɖɔa nuɖuɖu kpɔe ene.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Mina míatia nu dzɔdzɔetɔ na mía ɖokui, eye míaɖo kpe nu nyuitɔ dzi le mía dome.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Elabe Hiob be: ‘Tɔnye dzɔ, ke Mawu gbe afiatsotso nam.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be tɔnye dzɔ hã la, wobum aʋatsokalae. Nyemeda vo o, gake wode abi makumaku ŋunye.’

english_verse: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
translation_verse: Ame kae le abe Hiob ene? Edoa ɖiŋu na ame abe ale si wonoa tsii ene.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Elabe egblɔ be: ‘Viɖe mele xɔlɔ̃dzedze Mawu me o.’ ”

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: “Eya ta, mi tamebulawo, milé to ɖe ŋunye! Mawu mawɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi akpɔ o, eye Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la mawɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ gbeɖegbeɖe o!

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Ame kae tsɔ anyigba de asi nɛ? Ame kae ɖo xexeme blibo la gɔme anyi?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Ne wòbe yeatrɔ axɔ yeƒe gbɔgbɔ, eye yeagbugbɔ alɔ agbegbɔgbɔ katã ɖe ye ɖokui me la,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: nu gbagbewo katã atsrɔ̃, eye amegbetɔ agazu ke.”

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Ðe ame si lé fu nya dzɔdzɔe la, ate ŋu anye dziɖulaa? Ðe nàdi be yeabu fɔ dzɔdzɔetɔ, ŋusẽtɔ laa?

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Eyae gblɔna na fia be: ‘Yakame!’, eye wòyɔa dziɖula be: ‘Ame vɔ̃ɖi!’

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: Gawu la, mekpɔa dziɖulawo ŋkume o, eye medea kesinɔtɔwo dzi ɖe ame dahewo ŋu o, elabe wo katã la, eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo wonye.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Wokuna kpata. Le zã titina la, woʋuʋua wo, eye wo nu yina. Woɖe ŋusẽtɔwo ɖa, ke menye kple amegbetɔ ƒe asi o.”

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Viviti tsiɖitsiɖi alo blukɔ aɖeke meli si me vɔ̃wɔla abè ɖo o.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Mawu meɖoa ŋkeke na amegbetɔ be wòava ʋɔnu le ye ŋkume o.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Egbãa ŋusẽtɔwo gudugudu nya gɔme makumakui, eye wòɖoa bubuwo wo teƒe.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Esi wònya woƒe nuwɔnawo ta la, etua asi wo ƒua anyi le zã me, eye wogbãna gudugudu.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta eƒoa wo le dutoƒo;

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Ale wonana be ame dahewo ƒe ɣlidodo dea egbɔ, eye wòsea ame siwo wole funyafunya wɔmee la ƒe ɣli.

english_verse: When God does nothing, can any person or nation find fault with him?
translation_verse: Ne ezi kpoo la, ame kae abu fɔe? Ne eɣla eƒe mo la, eɖanye dukɔ o, eɖanye ame ɖeka o, ame kae ate ŋu akpɔe?

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: Ewɔ esia bene mawumavɔ̃lawo alo ame siwo trea mɔ̀ na ame la, nagaɖu fia o.”

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe agblɔ na Mawu be: ‘Tohehea té ŋunye, nyemagawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Nu si kpɔm nyemele o la, fiam. Meda vo, nyemagawɔe o’ la,

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: le wò, ame si gbe Mawu ƒe nyametsotso la, ƒe susu nu ɖe, ɖe woagahe to na ame sia? Wòe atso nya sia me. Nya si le asiwò la, gblɔe míse.

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: Nugɔmesela kple nunyala siwo le to ɖomem la agblɔ be:

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Hiob menya nu si gblɔm wòle o. Susu mele eƒe nyawo me o.’

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Ðe wòle be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu Hiob tsitotsito aɖase eseƒe hafi elabe eƒe ŋuɖoɖowo le abe vɔ̃wɔla tɔ ene.

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Elabe etsɔ aglãdzedze kpe ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋu. Ele asi kpoloe ƒom, eye wòle nya geɖe gblɔm ɖe Mawu ŋuti le mía ŋkume.”

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: “Ðe nèbu be esɔ be yeagblɔ be: ‘Tɔnye dzɔ wu Mawu tɔ’ mahã?

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Maɖo eŋu na wò kple xɔ̃wòawo!

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Ne èwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe la, nu ka nètsɔ nɛ? Alo ne mèɖi fɔ o la, nu ka nènae?

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: “Le ameteɖeanyi gbogboawo ta amewo doa ɣli. Wodoa boboe ɖe dziɖula ŋutasẽla ta.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Gake ame aɖeke mebiana be: ‘Afi ka Mawu, nye Wɔla le hã?’ o. Eyae naa ŋusẽ mí le zã me.

english_verse: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
translation_verse: Eyae fiaa nu mí wu anyigba dzi lãwo, eye wòna nunya mí wu dziƒoxewo.

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Ame siawo doa ɣli, ke Mawu meɖoa eŋu o le woƒe vɔɖivɔ̃ɖi kple dàda ta.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Mawu mesea ɣli ƒuƒlu o, eye Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la mebua eŋu o.

english_verse: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.
translation_verse: Esi gagblẽ wu lae nye be, wò la, èbe yemele ekpɔm o; yeƒe nya le egbɔ, eye yele esi nu kpɔm!

english_verse: Everything you have said adds up to nonsense.
translation_verse: Hiob ke nu le nya ƒuƒluwo gblɔm ko. Nunya aɖeke mele wo me o.”

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Gbɔ dzi ɖi nam vie ne mafia nu wò elabe nya gali magblɔ ɖe Mawu nu.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Mahe nye nunya tso didiƒe ke vɛ afia be nye Wɔla tɔ dzɔ.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Elabe nyateƒe, menye aʋatso kam mele o; nunyala vavãtɔ ŋutɔe nye esi le gbɔwò.”

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu lolo; ŋusẽ triakɔ le eƒe nunya ŋu, eye medoa vlo ame aɖeke o.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Menana be ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tsia agbe o, eye wòtsòna na ame siwo wote ɖe anyi.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Eléa be na ame dzɔdzɔewo. Edea bubu wo ŋu, eye wonana be wobɔbɔ nɔa fiawo gbɔ le fiazikpui dzi tegbee.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Ne wode kunyowu wo, eye fukpekpe bla wo ɖe ka me la,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: Mawu ɖea woƒe nɔnɔme kple nuvɔ̃ si wowɔ la fiaa wo, ne woanyae be yewole dàdam.

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: Enana be woɖoa to eƒe nuxɔxlɔ̃ hã, eye wòɖea gbe be woadzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Ne woɖo toe, eye wosubɔe la, nu dzea edzi na wo, eye wokpɔa dzidzɔ le woƒe agbenɔɣi katã.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Gake ne womeɖo to o la, woatsi yi nu. Woaku ɖe numanyamanya me.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Ke ame mavɔ̃mawuwo la, dzikudodo dzɔa dzi na wo. Ne Mawu de ka wo la, womeƒoa koko nɛ o.

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: Wokuna le ɖekakpuime, eye woƒe agbe wua nu kple ŋukpe.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔa fukpekpe ɖea fukpelawoe, eye wòtsɔa xaxa wɔa wo woɖoa toe.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Mawu aɖe wò tso xaxa me ava gbadzaƒe, afi si nàvo le, eye wòalɔ nuɖuɖu nyuiwo aɖo kplɔ̃ dzi na wò hafi.”

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: “Ke ŋutasẽla ƒe nyametsotso yɔ tame na wò ale gbegbe be fɔbubu kple tohehe va dziwò.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Ke kpɔ nyuie be dɔmedzoe nagakplɔ wò de fewuɖuɖu me o, eye nu gbogbo si wona wò la nagakplɔ wò trae o.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Ðe wò ɣlidodo ate ŋu aɖe wò tso xaxa me, alo wò ŋusẽ blibo la axɔ na wòa?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Zã si me woatsrɔ̃ dukɔwo ɖa keŋkeŋ la, meganɔ dzrowòm o.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi nyuie! Mègatrɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu o, elabe esia tae fukpekpe le tewòm kpɔ.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ ƒo ŋusẽwo katã ta. Ame kae nye nufiala abe eya ene?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: “Amewo dzia ha kafua nu siwo wòwɔ la. Wò hã ɖo ŋku edzi nàdo wo ɖe dzi.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Amegbetɔwo katã kpɔ nu siwo Mawu wɔ la, wokpɔnɛ tso adzɔge ʋĩi ke.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu lolo! Mele nyanya me na mí o. Eƒe ƒèwo mele didí me o.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: Eyae hea tsi toŋtoŋwo yia dzii, eye wònana be afu zua tsi.

english_verse: and supplies us with rain.
translation_verse: Enana be alilikpowo ɖuɖua tsi yoo ɖe amegbetɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Ðe ame aɖe nya ale si wòkekea alilikpowo me kple ale si eƒe dziɖegbegbadɔ ɖea gbe gbrrr… laa?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ekakaa eƒe dzikedzo ƒoa xlã eɖokui, eye wòtsɔa viviti tsyɔa atsiaƒu dzii.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Esiawo katã Mawu tsɔna drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dukɔwo eye wòtsɔna naa nuɖuɖu geɖe amegbetɔwo hãe.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Etsɔ dzikedzo tsyɔ asi, eye wòɖea gbe, wògblẽa nu si wòdzidze la tututu.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Eƒe gbeɖeɖe ɖea gbeƒã eƒe vava. Etsɔa dziku ʋãa ŋu vɔ̃wɔwɔ.”

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: “Esia na nye dzi lã kpo, ge dze dɔme nam.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Aléle! Mise Mawu ƒe gbeɖeɖe ɖa! Mise ale si wòle bublum la ɖa.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Eɖea asi le dzikedzo ŋu ɖona ɖe dziƒo bliboa te, eye wòdea anyigba ƒe mlɔea nu ke.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Mawu bluna nukutɔe. Ewɔa nu gãwo siwo gɔme míesena o.

english_verse: make us stop and think about God's power,
translation_verse: Enana be amewo dea asi asitɛ me ɖi, bene amewo katã nadze si eƒe nuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe ƒuƒue nana be tsi blana, eye tɔ gãwo zua kpe.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔa tsi doa agba na alilikpo, eye eƒe dzikedzo kakaa wo me.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: Enana be esia vaa eme, ne wòatsɔe ahe to na anyigba dzi nɔlawo loo, alo ne wòawɔ dɔmenyo na woe.”

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: “Hiob, see ɖa! Zi ɖoɖoe, nàbu tame le Mawu ƒe nukunuwo ŋu.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Ènya ale si Mawu ɖea gbe na eƒe alilikpowo, eye wònana be dzi kea dzo tso wo mea?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Ðe nènya ale si alilikpowo wɔna saa agba le ya me, si ɖea nunyatɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ la ƒe nukunuwɔwɔ fianaa?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Wò ame si ne anyigbemeya na xexeme lé ya keŋ, eye wò awuwo xɔ dzo ɖe ŋuwò la,

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: ɖe nàte ŋu ahe dziŋgɔli me dranyii, wòaɖi ahũhɔ̃e si wolólo la abe Mawu enea?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: To nya si míagblɔ na Mawu la na mí! Míenya nya aɖeke agblɔ o; míaƒe susu me do viviti.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Ðee woaɖagblɔ nɛ be medi be maƒo nua? Ne ame aɖe katsa ƒo nu la, ɖeko wòatsrɔ̃ enumake.

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Ne ya ƒo alilikpowo ɖa la, kekeli si dona la nu sẽna ale gbegbe be ame metea ŋu kpɔnɛ o.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Sikatsyɔ̃ tso dzigbeme gbɔna; fianyenye dziŋɔ le Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Eya ta, amegbetɔwo, mivɔ̃e! Mekpɔa ame siwo bua wo ɖokui nunyalawoe la ɖe naneke me o.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu na Hiob azɔ le yali me. Aƒetɔ ƒo nu

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Ame kae nye esi tsɔ nuƒo si me nunya mele o la le adaŋudede tɔtɔm ale?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Tso nàsa avɔ ɖe ali abe ŋutsu ene, ne mabia nya wò nàfia num.”

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: “Afi ka nènɔ hafi meɖo xexeme gɔme anyi? Èbe nunyala yenye ɖe! Gblɔe mase.

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Ame kae ɖo eƒe dzidzemewo? Ame kae da dzidzeka ɖe eŋu? Ènya ɖe!

english_verse: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
translation_verse: Nu ka dzi woɖo xexeme gɔme anyi ɖo, eye ame kae ɖo eƒe dzogoedzikpe?

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: Alo ame kae tú ʋɔ ɖe atsiaƒu nu esime wòdo ʋlo tso vidzidɔme;

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: esi mewɔ alilikpowo tsyɔ nɛ, eye metsɔ viviti tsiɖitsiɖi xatsa ɖe eŋu?

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: Meɖo seɖoƒewo nɛ, de gametiwo kple ʋɔtruwo enu,

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: eye megblɔ nɛ be: ‘Afii nàva se; mèkpɔ mɔ agbɔ eme o. Afii wò ƒutsotsoe dàdala mawo atɔ ɖo.’ ”

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: “Wodzi wò kpa èɖe gbe na ŋu kpɔ be nekea? Èfia agudzedze ƒe nɔƒee kpɔ,

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: be nedze tso anyigba toga, aʋuʋui, ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nahlẽ ɖa le edzia?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Ne ŋu le kekem la, anyigba trɔna abe tsu si dzi wotu nui la ene; abe avɔ ƒe ama vovovowo ene.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Woxɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ‘kekeli,’ le wo si, eye woŋe woƒe abɔ si wodo ɖe dzi la.”

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Woʋu ku ƒe agbowo fia wò kpɔa? Èkpɔ viviti tsiɖitsiɖi ƒe agbowo kpɔa?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Èse anyigba ƒe kekeme gɔmea? Ne ènya nu siawo katã ko, gblɔe míse.

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Kekeli ƒe aƒememɔ ɖe? Ènya viviti nɔƒea?

english_verse: Can you lead them home?
translation_verse: Màkplɔ wo ayi woƒe nɔƒe oa? Maɖanya woƒe aƒememɔ oa?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Kò! Ènyae! Ènyae la! Elabe wodzi wò ɣe ma ɣiwo ke xoxo! Menye egbevi nènye o ɖe!”

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Ède ava siwo me medzra tsikpe ɖo la me kpɔa? Èkpɔ xɔ siwo me medzra dzikpe ɖo la me kpɔa?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: Èɖakpɔ tsikpe kple dzikpe siwo meli kɔ ɖi ɖe xaxaɣi, aʋakpegbe kple aʋawɔɣi ŋua?

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: Mɔ ka kekeli tona dona, eye afi ka ɣedzeƒeya tona va ƒona ɖe anyigba dzi?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Ame kae dze mɔ na tsidzadza gãwo, eye wòɖe toƒe na dzikedzo kple dziɖegbe hã,

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: ne tsi naté anyigba si ɖi ƒuƒlu, be gbe namie ɖe edzi?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Ðe tɔ́ li na tsidzadzaa? Ame kae dzi zãmu ƒe gegeawo?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Ame ka ƒe vidzidɔ mee tsikpe do tso, eye ame ka ƒe alimevie nye zãmu-zu-tsikpe?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Tsiwo lia abe kpe ene, eye tɔ goglowo ŋgɔ bla goŋgoŋ.”

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: “Àte ŋu asa atifieŋuwo ƒe ka, alo atu ka avu kple avutɔa?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Àte ŋu akplɔ ŋukeɣletiviwo do goea? Alo afia mɔ koklovinɔ kple viawoa?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Ènya dziƒowo ƒe sewoa? Àte ŋu ana se siawo nakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe anyigba hã dzia?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: Àte ŋu aɖe gbe na alilikpowo be tsidzadza nedudu tsyɔ ye dzia?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Ame kae tsɔ nunya de ame ƒe ememe ke, eye wòtsɔ nugɔmesese de amegbetɔ ƒe susu me?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: “Ɖe nàte ŋu ada ade na dzata alo ana be dzataviwo naɖi ƒo,

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: ne wotsyɔ akɔ anyi ɖe wo nɔƒe, alo de xa ɖi ɖe woƒe avekɔe mea?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Ame kae dia nuɖuɖu na akpavia ne dɔ le viawo wum, eye wole tsa glãla tsam hele avi fam na Mawu?”

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ ɖoa wo viawo ŋu, eye wotsina ɖe dzi le gbedzi; wodzóna, eye womegatrɔna vaa wo nɔ gbɔ o.”

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: si metsɔ gbegbe na be wòanye eƒeme eye metsɔ dzeteƒe na be wòanye enɔƒe la?

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Hoowɔwɔ si le du gã me ɖia kokoe nɛ; mesea ekplɔla ƒe ɣlidodo aɖeke o.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: “Tò lɔ̃ be yeasubɔ wòa? Atsi wò lãkpo me adɔa?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Àte ŋu ade kae ɖe agbleŋlɔmɔ̀ ŋu alo ana wòanɔ anyigba gudum le yowòme le baliwo mea?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Ðe nàɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu, eye nàgblẽ wò dɔ ɖe esi me esi ŋusẽ kako le eŋu ŋutɔ taa?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Ðe nàɖo dzi ɖe eŋu wòatrɔ aɖatsɔ wò agblemenukuwo ava wò nukugbɔƒe na wòa?”

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: “Tsatsaboli nɔ ƒoa eƒe aʋala kpakpakpa gake lɔlɔ̃ mele eƒe aʋalawo me na viawo o,

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: elabe eɖaa azi ɖe anyigba be ke dzodzo naƒo wo.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: Eŋlɔ be be ame aɖo afɔ wo dzi alo gbemelã aɖe azɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Esẽa ŋuta le viawo ŋu abe menye etɔwo wonye o ene. Ne eƒe agbagbadzedze zu dzodzro hã la, metsɔ ɖeke le eme o.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu na wòŋlɔ nunya be, eye wòte nugɔmesesee.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Gake ne ekɔ aʋala ɖe dzi la, ekoa sɔ kple sɔdola.”

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: “Wòe na ŋusẽ sɔa? Wòe tsɔ kɔdza ɖo atsyɔ̃ nɛa?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Wòe na wòtia kpo abe ʋetsuvi enea? Ne eʋlũ ŋɔti me nèse la, vɔvɔ̃ alé wò.

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Etsɔa afɔ kaa anyigba kple ŋusẽ, le bali me, eye eƒe ŋusẽ doa dzidzɔ nɛ; elũna ɖe aʋawɔnuwo dzi vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Edoa vlo vɔvɔ̃, dzika metsoa eƒo o, eye metrɔa megbe dea yi o.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Daku, akplɔ si le dzo dam la kple hlo le wo nɔewo dzem le exa.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Ne aʋakpẽa ɖi la, egblɔna be: ‘Ahã! Eɖo edzi!’ Esea aʋakpekpe la, aʋakplɔlawo ƒe gbeɖeɖe kple aʋaɣli ƒe ya tso adzɔge ke.”

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: “Wò nunyae naa aʋako saa agba yia dzi ʋĩi, eye wòkekea eƒe aʋala me ɖoa ta anyigbemea?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Afi ma ke wònɔna tsoa ŋku na eƒe nuɖuɖu. Ekpɔa nu le didiƒe ke.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Ʋu viawo nona. Ẽ, afi si wowu ame ɖo la, afi ma wònɔna.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Azɔ Aƒetɔ gabia Hiob be:

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Ðe vɔ̃eɖenamela ahe nya kple Ŋusẽkatãtɔ laa? Ame si be yeaʋli nya kple Mawu la, neɖo eŋu mase.”

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Tete Hiob ɖo eŋu na Aƒetɔ be:

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: Meƒo nu zi ɖeka va yi; ke zi evelia ya nyemele nya aɖeke ŋu ɖo ge o.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu na Hiob le yali me be:

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Sa avɔ ɖe ali abe ŋutsu ene, ne mabia nya wò nàɖo eŋu nam mase.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Ðe nèbe yeatrɔ nye nyametsotso, abu fɔm, ne nàtso afia na ɖokuiwòa?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le asiwò abe Mawu enea? Àte ŋu aɖe gbe abe eya enea?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Ekema tsɔ gãnyenye kple bubu, na ɖokuiwò, eye nàta ŋutikɔkɔe kple atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Ði wo katã ɖe ke me; bla mo na wo ɖe blukɔ me.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Ekema nye hã maʋu eme na wò be wò ŋutɔ wò ŋusẽe ate ŋu axɔ wò ɖe agbea?”

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: “Kpɔ Behemot si mewɔ abe ale si mewɔ wò hãe la ene ɖa. Eɖua gbe abe nyitsu ene.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eƒe ŋusẽ le eƒe ali me kple eƒe ƒodo ŋu lãwo me.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Elĩa eƒe asikɛ ɖe dzi ka abe sederti ene, eye eƒe atagbomekawo lɔ̃ ɖe wo nɔewo me kunyakunya.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Eƒe ƒuwo le abe akɔbli siwo me to le la ene; ẽ, abe gakpo ene.”

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: “Eyae nye gbãtɔ le Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔ gãtɔwo dome, eye ewɔla tsɔ aʋawɔyi de asi nɛ.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Ekpɔa eƒe nuɖuɖu bɔbɔe le towo dzi, afi si gbemelãwo katã ɖia adzrɔ le.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Egbɔna ɖe eme le tɔŋgɔtrefewo te, eye wòbèna ɖe aƒlawo me le simewo.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Aguŋgbawo doa vɔvɔli nɛ, eye amutiwo ƒoa xlãe godoo le tá la me.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ne tɔsisi le tsatsam kple adã hã la, dzika metsoa eƒo o. Ne Yordan tsa va le nuti lɔm nɛ hã, enɔa anyi bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Ðe ame aɖe ate ŋu alée kple ƒè alo aƒo ka ɖe ŋɔti me nɛa?”

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “Ðe nàte ŋu atsɔ ƒè aɖe lo, alo atsɔ ka bla eƒe aɖe ɖe eƒe glã ŋua?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Ðe nàte ŋu ade ka ŋɔti me nɛ, alo atsɔ ƒè aku alɔxatsa nɛa?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Ðe wòabla nu kpli wò be nàtsɔ ye wɔ wò dɔla tegbeea?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Ðe nàfe kplii abe xevi ene alo ade kae na viwò nyɔnuviwoa?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Ðe asitsalawo ado asi ɖe eŋua? Alo ɖe adzɔnuƒlelawo aƒlee ama na asigbedelawoa?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Àte ŋu atsɔ ʋã geɖe aŋɔ eƒe ayi, alo ada akplɔ atɔ ta nɛa?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Katsa nàka asi eŋu kpɔ! Wò ŋutɔ ànya be eléle anye avu manyagblɔ; màgatee kpɔ gbeɖe o!

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Gbetɔ adãwɔla aɖeke meli si ado dzi aʋuʋui o. Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe enu?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Ame ka ŋu wòle, wòate ŋu akpe akɔ kplii eye nu vevi mawɔe o? Ame ka ŋu wòle le dziƒoa te?”

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: “Nyemagbe nuƒoƒo le eƒe ŋutinuwo, eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la kple ameti la ƒe tutume nyakpɔ la ŋu o.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Ame kae ate ŋu afo akpa si le eŋuti gbã la ɖa, ake ɖe gawu evelia ŋu?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Ame kae ate ŋu ake eƒe glã, akpɔ ŋɔdzi manyagblɔ si ƒo xlã eƒe aɖuwo ɖa?

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Ne enyè la, eƒe ŋɔti me kea dzo, eye eƒe ŋkuwo klẽna hẽe abe agudzedze ene.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Dzo ƒe aɖewo dona tso eƒe nu me, eye dzoxiwo hlẽna ŋeŋeŋe.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋɔti me tua dzudzɔ, abe ze si le fiefiem le nakedzo dzi la me ene.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Eƒe gbɔgbɔ naa aka léa dzo, eye dzobibi doa go tso eƒe nu me.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le eƒe kɔ me, eye ŋɔdzi nɔa ɣe ɖum, doa ŋgɔ nɛ.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋuilã tsyɔ vĩi ɖe edzi kunyakunya, eye wòdo akpa trikpaa, hele kakoo. Meʋãna o.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Ne efɔ ɖe afɔ dzi la, vɔvɔ̃ ɖoa mawuawo kekeake hã, eye ne egava dze anyi la, dzidzi ƒoa wo.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Ga yibɔ ɖeko wòle nɛ abe be ene, eye akɔbli le nɛ abe ati vóvo ene.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Ne woda kpo ɖe edzi la, ɖeko wòxɔnɛ abe gbe ƒuƒue ge ɖe edzi ene, eye ne akplɔ le ʋɔ lum la, ɖeko wòɖia kokoe nɛ.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Eƒe dɔ me gbɔ ɖana abe ze gbagbã kakɛ nu ene. Eƒe toƒe ɖena ɖe ba me abe ale si lugbɔmɔ̀ ɖena ɖi ene.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: Enana be tɔ gɔme fiena wlɔwlɔwlɔ abe nuɖaze me ene, eye wòblua atsiaƒu me abe amiɖaze mee le fiefiem ene.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Ne eho dzó yina la, eyome ɖea mɔ heklẽna; edzéna abe atsiaƒu ƒe gogloƒe ɖe wòƒo wɔ̀ ene.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Nuwɔwɔ si mevɔ̃a naneke o lae wònye. Etɔgbe aɖeke mele xexea me o.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Eklẽa ŋku ɖe nu gãwo katã. Eyae nye fia ɖe lã dàdalawo katã dzi.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Menya azɔ be ètea ŋu wɔa nu sia nu, eye nu si nèɖo la, ame aɖeke magblẽ eme o.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: ‘Ame kae ɣla adaŋudede nunya manɔmee?’ Eya tae nu si gɔme nyemese o la ge le nunye, nu siwo wɔ nuku nam akpa, eye nyemenya o.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: ‘Ðo to, ne maƒo nu; mabia nya wò, nàɖo eŋu nam.’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Tsã la, woƒo nu le ŋuwò mese kple to; ke azɔ la, nye ŋutɔ mekpɔ wò kple ŋku.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Esi Aƒetɔ ƒo nu kple Hiob vɔ alea la, egblɔ na Elifaz, Temantɔ la, be: “Medo dɔmedzoe ɖe wò kple xɔ̃wò eveawo ŋu, elabe mieƒo nu dzɔdzɔe le ŋunye abe nye dɔla Hiob ene o.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Eya ta mitsɔ nyitsu adrẽ kple agbo adrẽ ne miayi nye dɔla Hiob gbɔ, ne miawɔ numemevɔsa ɖe miawo ŋutɔ ta. Nye dɔla Hiob ŋutɔ ado gbe ɖa ɖe mia ta. Maxɔ eƒe gbedodoɖa la, eye nyemahe to na mi le miaƒe bometsitsi ta o. Miegblɔ nya dzɔdzɔe le ŋunye abe ale si nye dɔla Hiob ya gblɔe ene o.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Ale Elifaz, Temantɔ la kple Bildad, Suaxtɔ la kpakple Zofar, Naamatitɔ la, yi ɖawɔ nu si Aƒetɔ to na wo la, eye Aƒetɔ xɔ Hiob ƒe gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gbugbɔ Hiob ƒe nunyonamewo ɖo te, esi wòdo gbe ɖa ɖe exɔlɔ̃awo ta. Aƒetɔ tsɔ nu siwo nɔ esi tsã la ƒe teƒe eve nɛ.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Tete nɔvia ŋutsuwo kple nɔvia nyɔnuwo kpakple eƒe ame nyanyɛ xoxoawo katã va kpɔe ɖa, eye woɖu nu kplii le eƒe aƒeme. Wodo baba nɛ, eye wofa akɔ nɛ le vɔ̃ siwo katã Aƒetɔ he va edzi la ta. Wo dome ame sia ame na ga kple sikasigɛe.

english_verse: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.
translation_verse: Ena ŋkɔ vinyɔnu gbãtɔ be Yemima, evelia be Kezia, eye wòyɔ etɔ̃lia be Keren-Hapux.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Edzi viŋutsu adrẽ kple vinyɔnu etɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu aɖeke medze tugbe le dukɔ bliboa me de Hiob vinyɔnu siawo nu o. Azɔ wo tɔ́ na eƒe nunɔamesiwo ƒe akpa aɖe wo abe domenyinu ene, abe ale si wòwɔ na wo nɔviŋutsuawo hãe ene.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Hiob tsi xɔ ƒè geɖee hafi ku.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si mezɔna ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nu loo, alo tɔna ɖe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ƒe mɔ dzi loo, alo nɔa anyi ɖe fewuɖulawo dome o.

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ekpɔa dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe se la ŋu, eye wòbua eŋu zã kple keli.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ele abe ati si wodo ɖe tɔʋu to la ene, esi tsena le etseɣi, eye eƒe aŋgbawo melũa xe o. Nu sia nu si ame sia wɔna la, dzea edzi nɛ.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ya mele alea o. Ke woawo ya le abe nutsro si ya ƒona dzonae ene.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame vɔ̃ɖiwo manɔ te le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me loo, alo nuvɔ̃wɔlawo nanɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo ƒe ha me o.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ dze si ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe mɔ, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ abu gbidii.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta dukɔwo le ɖoɖo vɔ̃wo wɔm, eye dukɔwo le nugbe ɖom ɖe ya me?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Anyigba dzi fiawo tso, eye dziɖulawo ƒo ta kpli, de adaŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ kple eƒe amesiamina ŋu be:

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: “Mina míatso woƒe kɔsɔkɔsɔwo, eye míatu woƒe kawo ɖa le mía ɖokui ŋu.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ dziƒowo la, le nu kom; Aƒetɔ le alɔ me ɖem le wo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Tete wòaƒo nu na wo le eƒe dɔmedzoe me, eye wòado ŋɔdzi na wo le eƒe dziku me be:

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “Meɖo nye fia ɖe Zion, nye togbɛ kɔkɔe la dzi.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Maƒo nu tso Aƒetɔ ƒe sedede ŋu: Egblɔ nam be: “Vinyee nènye, egbeae medzi wò.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Bia tanye se, eye mawɔ dukɔwo wò domenyinui, eye anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo azu tɔwò.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Àtsɔ gakpo agbã wo, eye àkaka wo abe zemela ƒe ze ene.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Eya ta azɔ mi fiawo, midze nunya. Mi anyigba dziɖulawo, woɖo afɔ afɔta na mi hee!

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ vɔvɔ̃ subɔ Aƒetɔ, mitsɔ dzodzo nyànyanya

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: gbugbɔ eƒe afɔ. Ne magado dɔmedzoe, eye miatsrɔ̃ le mɔ la me o; elabe eƒe dɔmedzoe flana kabakaba. Woyra ame siwo katã síi tso la.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye futɔwo sɔ gbɔ loo! Ame geɖewo tso ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo le gbɔgblɔm tso ŋunye be: Kpekpeɖeŋu aɖeke matso Mawu gbɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Ke wò Aƒetɔ, wòe nye nye akpoxɔnu, nye bubu kple ame si do nye ta ɖe dzi.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli sesĩe na Aƒetɔ, eye wòtɔ nam tso eƒe togbɛ kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Memlɔ anyi, eye medɔ alɔ̃; megafɔ, elabe Aƒetɔ lém ɖe te.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Nyemevɔ̃ ame akpeakpe siwo tso ɖe ŋunye ƒo xlãm godoo la o.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, tso! Nye Mawu, ɖem! Elabe wòe ƒo to me na nye futɔwo katã, wòe ŋe aɖu na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ tɔe nye ɖeɖe, wò yayra nenɔ wò dukɔ dzi!

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: O Mawu, nye dzɔdzɔetɔ, ne meyɔ wò la, tɔ nam! Wòe xɔ nam esime hiã tum. Ve nunye, se nye gbedodoɖa!

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Mi amegbetɔ viwo, ɣe ka ɣie miado vlo nye bubu ase ɖo? Ɣe ka ɣie mialɔ̃ nya dzodzrowo ase ɖo? Ɣe ka ɣie mianɔ aʋatso yome ase ɖo?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Ke minyae be Aƒetɔ tia mawumeme la na eɖokui; ne meyɔ Aƒetɔ la, esenɛ.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Mido dziku, ke migawɔ nuvɔ̃ o; mide ŋugble le miawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzime le miaƒe abawo dzi, eye miazi ɖoɖoe.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Misa vɔ siwo dze, eye miɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo gblɔ be: “O, ne míahakpɔ nu nyui aɖe ɖe! O Aƒetɔ, na wò mo ƒe kekeli naklẽ ɖe mía dzi!”

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Wòe de dzidzɔ geɖe nye dzime wu wo, esime bli kple wain bɔ ɖe wo si la.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mamlɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me, adɔ alɔ̃ le ŋutifafa me; elabe wò ɖeka, o Aƒetɔ, koe na mele dedie.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, lé to ɖe nye nyawo ŋu; se nye ŋeŋe.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Nye Fia kple nye Mawu, lé to ɖe nye ɣlidodo ŋu, elabe wòe mele gbe dom ɖa na.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, wòe sea nye gbe le ŋdi, ŋdi la, medzrana ɖo saa vɔ na wò, eye menɔa wò asi nu kpɔm.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Elabe menye Mawu si dzɔa dzi le ŋutasesẽ ŋu lae nènye o; nuvɔ̃ɖi mate ŋu anɔ gbɔwò o.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Dàdala mate ŋu anɔ te ɖe ŋkuwò me o; èléa fu nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo katã.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Ètsrɔ̃a ame siwo kaa aʋatso; Aƒetɔ lé fu ame siwo kɔa ʋu ɖi kple alakpatɔwo.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Ke nye ya to wò amenuveve sɔgbɔ la me, mage ɖe wò aƒeme. Masubɔ wò le wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me kple vɔvɔ̃.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, kplɔm le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ la nu le nye futɔwo ta; na wò mɔ nadzɔ le ŋkunye me.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Elabe nyateƒe aɖeke mele woƒe nu me o, woƒe dzi tsrɔ̃a nu, woƒe vehlo nye yɔdo nuvo, woflua ame kple woƒe aɖe.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Mawu, na woakpɔ fɔɖiɖi ŋu fetu; na woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aɖaŋudedewo naƒu wo anyi; tsɔ wo ƒu gbe le woƒe dzidada gbogboawo ta, elabe wodze aglã ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Gake na ame siwo katã sí wò tso la nakpɔ dzidzɔ le mewò; na woadzi dzidzɔha tegbee, eye nàʋli wo ta; ne ame siwo lɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ la, nakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Elabe wò Aƒetɔ ye yraa ame dzɔdzɔe, wòe tsɔa amenuveve tsyɔna nɛ abe akpoxɔnu ene.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mègaka mo nam le wò dziku me o, alo nàhe to nam le wò dɔmedzoe me o.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ve nunye elabe nu te ŋunye mezu belibeli. Aƒetɔ, da gbe le ŋunye elabe nye ƒuwo le fu kpem.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ hã le fu kpem ale gbegbe! Ke Aƒetɔ, ɣe ka ɣi malala ase ɖo?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, trɔ ɖe ŋunye nàxɔm ɖe agbe. Ɖem le wò amenuveve la ta.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Elabe le ku me la, ŋkuɖoɖo dziwò meli o. Ame kae akafu wò le tsiẽƒe?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Meɖea hũ ʋuu ɖeɖi tea ŋunye; nye aɖatsi ƒoa nye aba belee zã sia zã, eye nye avifafa nana be nye mlɔƒe ƒoa tsi.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Vevesese na nye ŋkuwo lé ayi; wogbɔdzɔ le nye ketɔwo ta.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Mi nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo katã, mite ɖa le gbɔnye; elabe Aƒetɔ se nye avigbe la.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ se nye kokoƒoƒo. Aƒetɔ xɔ nye gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Ŋu akpe nye futɔwo katã, eye woakpe fu vevie. Woagbugbɔ, eye woƒe mo atsi dãa enumake.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, mewòe mebè ɖo; xɔm ɖe agbe tso yonyemetilawo katã si me, eye nàɖem.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, woavuvum abe dzata ene, ahem adzoe, eye ame aɖeke maxɔ nam o.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: ne mewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe xɔ̃nye aɖe ŋu, alo ha nye futɔ aɖe ƒe nu madzemadzee la,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ekema na futɔ la nati yonyeme, eye wòalém; na wòafanyam ɖe anyigba, eye wòaté nye ŋutilã ɖe ke me!

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Tsi tre, Aƒetɔ, le wò dziku me; tso ɖe nye futɔwo ƒe nyanyra ŋu. Nye Mawu, nyɔ, wò ame si ɖo ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ anyi la!

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Na dukɔwo ƒe amehawo naƒo ƒu, aƒo xlã wò. To wo dzi nàgbugbɔ ayi aɖanɔ wò zikpui dzi le dziƒo.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dukɔwo. Aƒetɔ, drɔ̃ ʋɔnum ɖe nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple fɔmaɖimaɖi si le menye la nu.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ nu natso; ke li ke ame dzɔdzɔe la; wò si doa susuwo kple dziwo kpɔna, wò Mawu dzɔdzɔetɔ la.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Nye akpoxɔnu le Mawu si, eya ame si xɔna na ame siwo ƒe dzi toa mɔ ɖeka la.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Mawue nye ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe drɔ̃la. Enye Mawu si dzi kuna gbe sia gbe.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe metrɔ dzime o la, Mawu anyre eƒe yi; ele adeklo dzi, eye wòvu eƒe da me ɖi.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Etrɔ asi le eƒe lãnu wuameawo ŋu da ɖi, eye wòdra dzo eƒe aŋutrɔwo.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla fɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi ƒe fu; nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ ƒe fue nɔa eƒo, eye wòdzia alakpa.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Eɖe ʋe, ha eme, eye wòge dze do si wòɖe la me.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Eƒe nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ la trɔ va dze eya ŋutɔ ƒe ta dzi, eƒe ŋutasesẽ gbugbɔ va dze eya ŋutɔ ƒe dzodome.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mada akpe si dze Aƒetɔ, le eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta, la nɛ. Madzi ha akafu Aƒetɔ, Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mía Aƒetɔ, atsyɔ̃ le wò ŋkɔ ŋu le anyigba blibo la dzi loo! Wò si na wò ŋutikɔkɔe gbɔ dziƒowo ta, ha le ɖiɖim le ŋuwò

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: le vidzĩwo kple ɖeviwo nu. Èna wò ŋusẽ li ke le wò ketɔwo ta, be ɖoɖoe nazi le futɔ la kple hlɔ̃biala la nu.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Ne mekpɔ wò dziƒowo, dɔ siwo wò asiwo wɔ, ɣleti kple ɣletivi, siwo nèɖo anyi la,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: nu kae nye amegbetɔ be nèbua eŋu kple amegbetɔ vi be nèléa be nɛ?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Ke nèwɔe wòsɔ kple Mawu kloe, eye nètsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu ɖɔ nɛ abe fiakuku ene.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Èna wòɖu wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã dzi, eye nètsɔ nuwo katã de eƒe afɔ te:

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: alẽwo kple nyitsuwo katã kpakple gbemelãwo hã,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: dziƒoxeviwo kple ƒumelãwo kpakple nu sia nu si zɔa atsiaƒu me.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mía Aƒetɔ, atsyɔ̃ le wò ŋkɔ ŋu le anyigba blibo la dzi loo!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Mada akpe na Aƒetɔ kple nye dzi blibo; maxlẽ wò nukudɔwo katã afia.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Makpɔ dzidzɔ, eye dzi adzɔm ɖe ŋuwò. Madzi ha akafu wò ŋkɔ, wò Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Esi nye futɔwo trɔ gbugbɔ yi megbe la, wodze anyi, eye wotsrɔ̃ le ŋkuwò me;

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: elabe èhe nye nya dzɔdzɔe ɖe go. Èbɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi, eye nèdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Èhe nya ɖe dukɔwo ŋu; ètsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye nètutu wo ŋkɔ ɖa yi mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Futɔwo tsrɔ̃, vɔ ɖa tegbee. Ègbã woƒe duwo, wozu aƒedo; ŋkuɖoɖo wo dzi megali o.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ nɔ anyi ɖe eƒe fiazi dzi tegbee. Eɖo eƒe fiazikpui anyi glì ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Edrɔ̃a ʋɔnu xexea me ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nu, eye wòtsoa nya me na dukɔwo sɔsɔe.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye mɔ́ sesẽ na ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la; mɔ́ sesẽe wònye le xaxaɣiwo me.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Ame siwo dze si wò ŋkɔ la, ɖoa dzi ɖe ŋuwò, elabe wò Aƒetɔ, mèŋlɔa ame siwo dia wò la be o.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Midzi kafukafuha na Aƒetɔ, ame si le Zion! Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo le dukɔwo dome!

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Elabe eya ame si biaa hlɔ̃ hlɔ̃dolawo la, ɖoa ŋku wo dzi, eye meŋlɔa hiãtɔwo ƒe ɣlidodo be o.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, ve nunye! Kpɔ ale si mele fu kpem le ame siwo lé fum la si mee la ɖa. Wòe kɔm ɖe dzi tso ku ƒe agbowo me

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: be makafu wò le Zion vinyɔnu ƒe agbowo me. Matso aseye le ale si nèɖem la ta.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ge dze do si woɖe ɖi la me, eye ɖɔ si woɖo ɖi la, ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe afɔ.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖe eɖokui fia, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu. Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo zu mɔ̀ ɖe woawo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ayi tsiẽƒe; dukɔ siwo katã ŋlɔ Mawu be la hã ayi.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Elabe womaŋlɔ hiãtɔwo be ɣeawo katã ɣi o, eye ame dahewo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ mabu tegbee o.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, tso! Mègana amegbetɔ naɖu dzi o. Na woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo le ŋkuwò me!

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, do ŋɔdzi na wo! Na dukɔwo nadze sii be amegbetɔ ko yewonye!

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nu ka ta nètsi tsitre ɖe adzɔge ke? Nu ka ta nèɣla ɖokuiwò le xaxaɣiwo me?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tia ame dahewo yome dàdatɔe. Na woatsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aye si woɖo la alé woawo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Elabe ame vɔ̃ɖi tsɔa eƒe dzimedidi ƒoa adegbee, eye ŋubiãla viɖedila doa ɖiŋu na Aƒetɔ hegbea nu le egbɔ.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖo dàdamo la, megadia Aƒetɔ o. Eƒe susu katãe nye be: “Mawu aɖeke meli o.”

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Eƒe nuwɔnawo dzea edzi nɛ ɣe sia ɣi; wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le dziƒo ʋĩi, mele ekpɔm o. Le eƒe ketɔwo katã gome la, mekpɔa wo ɖe naneke me o.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ebuna le eƒe dzime be: “Womaɖe ke le tenye o; nyemaɖo dzɔgbevɔ̃e me le dzidzimewo katã me o.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ɖiŋudodo, alakpa kple ameteteɖeanyi nyawo yɔ nu me nɛ taŋ, eye nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ kple vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye le eƒe aɖe te.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Edea xa ɖe kɔƒewo ŋu. Enɔa bebeƒe wua ame maɖifɔ. Enɔa ŋu tsam na wɔnamanɔŋutɔwo.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Edea xa ɖe ɣaɣlɛƒe abe dzata le ave dodoe me ene. Edea xa ɖi be yealé ame dahe la. Eléa ame dahe la ne wòge ɖe eƒe ɖɔ me.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Eƒoa wɔnamanɔŋutɔ ƒua anyi, miminɛ ɖe anyigba, eye eƒe ŋusẽ tenɛ ɖe anyi.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ebuna le eƒe dzime be: “Mawu ƒe ŋku dzo le edzi; eɣla eƒe mo, makpɔe akpɔ gbeɖe o.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, tso! Mawu, kɔ asi dzi. Mègaŋlɔ fukpelawo be o.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Nu ka tae ame vɔ̃ɖi gbea nu le Mawu gbɔ, eye wògblɔna le eƒe dzime be: “Màhe to nam o”?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Èkpɔe; ẽ, wò ŋku le ame siwo le fu kpem kple ame siwo xaxa la ŋu; asiwò me wole. Wɔnamanɔŋutɔ la tsɔ eɖokui de asi na wò. Wòe nye kpeɖeŋutɔ na tsyɔ̃eviwo.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Ŋe alɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi la kple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla la. Di eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ nàɖe ɖa va se ɖe esime màgakpɔ ɖeke o.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye fia tegbetegbee; dukɔwo atsrɔ̃ le esi me.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Wò Aƒetɔ, àɖo to atrɔ ɖe tufalawo ƒe didi ŋu, ado ŋusẽ woƒe dzi, eye nàƒu to anyi,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: ne nàtso afia na tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la, ale be amegbetɔ aɖeke naganye ŋutasẽla le anyigba la dzi azɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye mesí tso. Ale ke miate ŋu agblɔ nam be: “Sí yi toawo dzi abe xevi ene,

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: elabe kpɔ ɖa, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo vu da me; wotsɔ woƒe aŋutrɔwo ɖo daka dzi be yewoaté nuteƒewɔlawo le blukɔ me;

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: ne wogbã gɔmeɖoɖoawo la, nu ka ame dzɔdzɔe ate ŋu awɔ”?

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le eƒe gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me; Aƒetɔ ƒe fiazikpui le dziƒo, eƒe ŋku le nu kpɔm, eƒe aɖaba doa amegbetɔ viwo kpɔna.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ doa ame dzɔdzɔewo kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo siaa kpɔna, eye eƒe luʋɔ lé fu ame si lɔ̃ ŋutasesẽ.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ana dzoka kple aŋɔ dzodzoe nadza ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi; ya xɔdzo anye woƒe kplu me nu.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, elɔ̃ nu dzɔdzɔe; nuteƒewɔlawo akpɔ eŋkume.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, kpe ɖe ame ŋu elabe mawumeme aɖeke megali o; elabe anukwaretɔwo bu le amegbetɔ viwo dome.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame kaa aʋatso na ehavi; wovivia nu me, eye wonye aɖeveetɔwo.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ netsrɔ̃ nu me vivitɔwo katã kple aɖe siwo gblɔa nya doa wo ɖokui ɖe dzi glodzoo.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: Ame siwo gblɔna be: “Míaƒe aɖe ana míaɖu dzi; míaƒe nu li kpli mí, ame ka nye mía aƒetɔ?”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Matso azɔ, elabe wole ŋuta sẽm le ame dahe ŋu; hiãtɔwo le hũ ɖem. Madae ɖe dedienɔƒe si le edzrom la.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋugbedodo nye ŋugbedodo siwo dza; wonye klosalo si wolólo le kpodzo me le anyigba, eye woklɔe zigbɔzi adrẽ la.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, kpɔ mía ta; dzɔ mía ŋu tso dzidzime sia si me.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le tsatsam le afi sia afi, esime nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le dzi dem le amegbetɔ viwo dome.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi ? Ɖe nàŋlɔm be tegbeea? Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi nàɣla wò ŋkume ɖem?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi wòle be mase veve le nye luʋɔ me, eye nuxaxa nanɔ nye dzime ŋkeke bliboa? Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi woana nye futɔ nade nunye?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, bu eŋu nàɖo eŋu nam. Na nye ŋku dzi nakɔ, ne menye nenem o la, madɔ alɔ̃, atsi alɔ̃ me.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenem o la, nye futɔ agblɔ be: “Mekpe edzi.” Ne menye nenem o la, nye ketɔ atso aseye elabe woʋuʋum.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Ke nyea meɖo dzi ɖe wò amenuveve ŋu; nye dzi atso aseye le wò xɔname ŋuti.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Madzi ha na Aƒetɔ, elabe ewɔ dɔmenyo nam.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Movitɔ gblɔna le eƒe dzime be: “Mawu aɖeke meli o.” Wowɔa nu fitifiti, wowɔa ŋunyɔnuwo. Ame aɖeke meli si wɔa nu nyui o.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le dziƒo kpɔ amegbetɔ viwo ɖa, be yeakpɔ ɖa, ne ame aɖe li si wɔa nu nunyatɔe, si dia Mawu yome mɔ, hã.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ɖe nu baɖa wɔla siwo katã ɖua nye dukɔ, abe ale si woɖua aboloe ene, eye womeyɔa Aƒetɔ o la, menya naneke oa?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Woaɖo ŋɔdzi gã ŋutɔ me le afi ma elabe Mawu li kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo ƒe dzidzime la.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Miate ŋu aɖe alɔ me le ame dahe la ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu, ke Aƒetɔ ye nye eƒe sitsoƒe.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: O, ko ɖeɖe natso Zion ava na Israel ɖe! Ne Aƒetɔ gaɖo eƒe dukɔ ƒe nunyonamewo te la, Yakob atso aseye, eye Israel akpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ame kae adze wò agbadɔ me? Ame kae anɔ wò to kɔkɔe la dzi?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Ame si ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu mokaka mele o, ame si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòtoa nyateƒe le eƒe dzime;

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: ame si metsɔa eƒe aɖe zɔa ame gɔmee o, eye mewɔa nu vevi xɔlɔ̃a loo, alo dea ŋukpe mo na ehavi o;

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: ame si gbɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi meɖia naneke le o; ke wòdea bubu ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ ŋu; ame si kaa atam si gblẽa nu le eŋu gake megatrɔnɛ o;

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: ame si meɖea asi le eƒe ga ŋu ɖe deme dzi o, eye mexɔa zãnu ɖe ame maɖifɔ ŋu o lae. Ame si wɔa nu siawo la, womaʋãe akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Mawu, dzram ɖo, elabe wòe mesí tso.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Megblɔ na Aƒetɔ be: “Nye Aƒetɔe nènye; nu nyui aɖeke mele asinye kpe ɖe ŋuwò o.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Mawumeme siwo le anyigba dzi la nye bubumewo; woƒe nu doa dzidzɔ nam ale gbegbe.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Ame siwo dia mawu bubu ƒe mɔ la, dzia vevesese ɖe edzi na wo ɖokui. Nyemaƒo woƒe vɔsaʋu ɖe anyi alo ake nu ayɔ wo ŋkɔ o.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye tɔnye gome si metia kple nye kplu. Wòe lé nye etsɔme ɖe asi.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Nudzidzenu la dze nyuia ƒe nam; domenyinu la dze ŋunye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Makafu Aƒetɔ, ame si ɖoa aɖaŋu nam; le zã me hã, nye dzi fiaa num.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Metsɔa Aƒetɔ ɖoa ŋkunye me ɣe sia ɣi; esi wòle nye ɖusime ta la, womaʋãm o.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Eya ta dzi le dzɔyem, eye nye luʋɔ le aseye tsom; nye ame blibo la meli dedie.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Elabe màgblẽm ɖe tsiẽƒe alo ana be wò mawumeme la nayi aʋlime o.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Wòe fia agbemɔ lam; dzidzɔ deblibo bɔ ɖe ŋkuwò me, vivisese le wò ɖusime tegbee.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
