translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, se nya dzɔdzɔe; wɔ nane le nye ɣlidodo ŋu! Lé to ɖe nye gbedodoɖa, si metso alakpanu me o la, ŋuti.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Na nye afiatsotso natso gbɔwò. Na wò ŋku nakpɔ nu dzɔdzɔetɔ.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Ne èdo nye dzi kpɔ, ne èva gbɔnye le zã me, ne èdom kpɔ la, màkpɔ vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye le menye o. Nye nu medaa se dzi o.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Le amegbetɔwo ƒe nuwɔnawo me la, metsɔ wò numenyawo kpɔ ɖokuinye dzi; meƒo asa na ŋutasẽlawo ƒe mɔwo.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Nye afɔɖeɖe lí ɖe wò mɔwo dzi sesĩe; nye afɔwo meɖiɖi o.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mawu, mele yɔwòm, elabe àtɔ nam; lé to ɖe ŋunye nàse nye nyawo!

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò amenuveve fia nukutɔe; o xɔnametɔ na sitsoƒedilawo tso ketɔwo nu, le wò ɖusime!

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Dzram ɖo abe gadaglamakui le ŋkuvi me ene; ɣlam ɖe wò aʋala ƒe vɔvɔli te,

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: tso ame vɔ̃ɖi siwo di be yewoatsrɔ̃m le nye futɔ amewula siwo ɖe to ɖem la si me.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Womekpɔa nublanui o, wokea nu gblɔa dàdanyawo.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wokplɔm ɖo; azɔ la, woɖe to ɖem. Woƒe ŋku le ŋunye be yewoaxlãm ɖe anyi.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Woɖi dzata si le nu dim be yeavuvu kple dzatavi si de xa ɖi la.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, tso! Kpe akɔ kpli wo, ƒu wo anyi! Ɖe nye agbe tso ame vɔ̃ɖi la si me kple wò yi.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖem tso amegbetɔwo si me kple wò asi, tso ame siwo kpɔ wo tɔ gome le agbe me le xexea me la si me. Na woƒe ƒodo nayɔ kple nu siwo nèƒo ƒu ɖi na wo la. Na nu nasu wo viwo si, wu ale sinu hiã wo la. Na woagblẽ nane ɖi na woƒe vidzĩwo.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, makpɔ wò mo le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me. Ne menyɔ hekpɔ wò dzedzeme la, aɖi ƒo nam.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye ŋusẽ, melɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye nye agakpe, nye mɔ́ kple ɖenyela, Mawu, nye agakpe si mesí tso. Nye akpoxɔnu, nye xɔname ƒe dzo, nye mɔ́ sesẽ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Meyɔ Aƒetɔ, ame si dze be woakafu, eye wòɖem tso nye futɔwo si me.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Ku ƒe kawo ɖe to ɖem, eye tsi wɔadãwo do dzikatsoƒoe nam.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe ƒe kawo blam, eye ku ƒe mɔ̀wo kpe akɔ kplim.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Le nye xaxa me la, meyɔ Aƒetɔ; medo ɣli na nye Mawu be nekpe ɖe ŋunye. Ese nye gbe le eƒe gbedoxɔ me, eye nye ɣlidodo de egbɔ hege ɖe eƒe to me.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Tete anyigba ʋanya, ʋuʋu; towo ƒe anyinɔwo hã ʋuʋu, eye wodzo kpèkpekpe elabe dzi kui.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Dzudzɔ de dzi tso eƒe ŋɔti me, dzo binu do tso eƒe nu me, eye dzoka le xɔxɔm tso egbɔ.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ebɔ dziƒowo heɖi va anyi; viviti tsiɖitsiɖi le eƒe afɔwo te.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Enɔ kerubi dzi hedzo; eɖiɖi kaba le ya ƒe aʋalawo dzi.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Eɣla eɖokui ɖe blukɔ me, eye tsiɖoɖo kple alilikpo dodo nye agbadɔ si te wòle.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Le keklẽ si le eŋkume me la, dzikpewo kple dzokawo do tso eƒe alilikpowo me.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ hã ɖe gbe le dziƒowo, eye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ɖe gbe, dzikpewo kple dzokawo ɖi wose.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe aŋutrɔwo ɖa wokaka wo me; eɖo dzikedzowo ɖa wotɔtɔ wo.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu gɔme mɔwo dze, eye xexeme ƒe agunuwo tsi go, le wò bublu nu, Aƒetɔ, le wò gbɔgbɔ fuxefuxe nu.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Edo abɔ ɖa tso dzi ke, lém, eye wòhem tso tsi geɖewo me.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Eɖem tso nye futɔ sesẽ la si me kple ame siwo lé fum la si me elabe wotri akɔ wum.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Wodze dzinye le nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e gbe; ke Aƒetɔ nye nye ziɔɖeŋutɔ.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ekplɔm yi gbadzaƒe, eɖem elabe nye nu nyo eŋu.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wɔ nyui nam ɖe nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nu; eɖo eteƒe nam le esi nye asi me dza ta.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Elabe melé ŋku ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe mɔwo ŋu, eye nyemewɔ nu tovo ɖe nye Mawu ŋu o.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Elabe eƒe sewo katã le ŋkunye me, eye nyemeɖe eƒe ɖoɖowo ɖa le gbɔnye o.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Mokaka mele ŋunye le eŋkume o, eye mekpɔ ɖokuinye dzi be nyemagaɖi fɔ o.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ ɖo eteƒe nam le nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nu, le esi nye asi me le dzadzɛ le eŋkume ta.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Èwɔa nuteƒe na nuteƒewɔla, mèkaa mo na ame si ŋu mokaka mele o la o.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Ŋuwò dza ɖe ame dzadzɛ ŋu, eye nèfiaa ɖokuiwò ayetɔe ɖe ayetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Elabe wòe ɖea ame fafawo, eye nèbɔbɔa ŋku gãtɔwo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Ẽ, wòe si nye akaɖi nam. Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu klẽna ɖe nye viviti me.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Mawu sia la, eƒe mɔ le blibo, Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋugbedodo nye nyateƒe. Enye akpoxɔnu na ame siwo katã síi tso la.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Elabe ame kae nye Mawu? Ɖe menye Aƒetɔ ye oa? Ame kae nye agakpe? Mía Mawu la koe ɖe!

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Mawu si tsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzi nam, eye wòna nye mɔ le dedie lae.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nye afɔwo abe zinɔ tɔwo ene, eye wòtsɔm ɖo kɔkɔƒe si le dedie.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Efia aʋawɔwɔ nye asiwo ale be nye abɔwo ate ŋu avu akɔblida me.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ wò xɔname ƒe akpoxɔnu nam; wò nuɖusi lém ɖe te, eye wò kpekpeɖeŋu wɔm menye gã.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Èna gbadzaƒem be maɖe afɔ, eye nye afɔwo meɖiɖi o.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Meti nye futɔwo yome ɖatu wo, nyemetrɔ o, va se ɖe esime wotsrɔ̃ wo vɔ.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Megbã wo nyànyanya ale be womagate ŋu afɔ o; wodze anyi ɖe nye afɔ te.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Elabe ètsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzi nam ɖe aʋawɔwɔ ŋu; èna nye adikatɔwo yi to ɖe tenye.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Èna nye futɔwo trɔ megbe dem, eye metsrɔ̃ ame siwo lé fum la.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli be woakpe ɖe yewo ŋu; ke xɔnametɔ aɖeke meli o. Wodo ɣli na Aƒetɔ; ke metɔ na wo o.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Metu wo gudugudu abe ʋuʋudedi le ya nu ene, eye metsɔ wo ƒu gbe abe gbeɖuɖɔ le ablɔwo dzi ene.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Èɖem tso dukɔwo ƒe avuwɔwɔ me; ètsɔm wɔ anyigba dzi dukɔwo ƒe tae. Dukɔ si nyemenya o lae subɔm.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Dzi ɖe le amedzrowo ƒo, wole dzodzom nyànyanya, eye wodo tso woƒe beɖoƒe sesẽwo.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le agbe, woakafu nye agakpe, eye woado Mawu si xɔna nam la ɖe dzi.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si bia hlɔ̃ nam, eye wòbɔbɔ dukɔwo ɖe tenye;

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: ame si ɖem le nye futɔwo si me; ẽ, wòe kɔm ɖe dzi gbɔ nye ketɔwo ta, wòe ɖem tso ŋutasẽlawo si me.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, makafu wò le esia ta, le dukɔwo dome, eye madzi ha akafu wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Eyae na dziɖuɖu gã eƒe fia la, eye wòve eƒe amesiamina la kple David kpakple eƒe dzidzimeviwo nu tegbee.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Dziƒowo le Mawu ƒe bubu xlẽm fia, eye dziŋgɔli le gbeƒã ɖem eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke gblɔa eƒe nya na ŋkeke bubu, eye zã toa eƒe nunya na zã bubu.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Nuƒo aɖeke meɖi o, nya aɖeke medo o; womese woƒe gbe o.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Gake woƒe gbe de anyigba blibo la dzi, eye woƒe nyawo de xexea me ƒe seƒe ke. Ewɔ agbadɔ ɖe wo me na ɣe.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Edoa go abe ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃e le dodom tso eƒe xɔ me ene, eye abe ŋutsu sesẽ aɖe ene la, eléa eƒe mɔ tsɔna kple du dzidzɔtɔe.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Edzèna tso dziƒowo ƒe mlɔenu, eye wòtrɔna godoo yia woƒe seƒe; naneke mebèna ɖe eƒe dzoxɔxɔ o.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe se le blibo, egbɔa agbe luʋɔ. Kakaɖedzi le Aƒetɔ ƒe ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu, enana be bometsilawo dzea nunya.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nufiamewo dzɔ, wodoa dzidzɔ na dzi. Aƒetɔ ƒe sededewo dza, wonana be ŋku dzi kɔna.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ dza, enɔa anyi tegbee. Aƒetɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo le eteƒe, wo katã wodzɔ.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Wovena wu sika, wu sika nyuitɔ gɔ̃. Wovivina wu anyitsi, wu anyitsi si le tsyɔtsyɔm tso anyígba me.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Gawu la, eyae gbea nya na wò dɔla; fetu gã le wo me léle ɖe asi me.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Ke ame kae ate ŋu adze si eya ŋutɔ ƒe dadaƒuwo? Ɖem le vodada siwo ɣla ɖem la me.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Ɖɔ wò dɔla ɖo tso nuvɔ̃ siwo wònya hewɔ la hã me; mègana woaɖu dzinye o. Ekema mokaka manɔ ŋunye o, eye madza tso dzidada gãwo me.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Na nye numenyawo kple nye ŋugbledede le dzime nadze ŋuwò, nàxɔ, Aƒetɔ, nye agakpe kple nye ɖela.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ netɔ na wò le xaxagbe! Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋkɔ nekpɔ tawò.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Neɖo kpekpeɖeŋu ɖe wò tso kɔkɔeƒe la, eye nedo alɔ wò tso Zion!

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Neɖo ŋku wò nuɖuɖuvɔsawo katã dzi, eye wò numemevɔsawo nedze eŋu.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Newɔ wò dzimedidi dzi na wò, eye wòana nàkpɔ ta na wò ɖoɖowo katã.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Míatso aseye le wò dziɖuɖu ta, eye míado aflagawo ɖe dzi le mía Mawu ŋkɔ me. Aƒetɔ neɖo wò biabiawo katã ŋu na wò.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Azɔ medze sii be, Aƒetɔ akpe ɖe eƒe amesiamina la ŋu. Atɔ nɛ tso eƒe dziƒo kɔkɔe la, eye wòana dziɖuɖuwoe ŋusẽtɔe to eƒe nuɖusi dzi.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo tsɔa tasiaɖamwo ƒoa adegbee, eye ɖewo tsɔa sɔwo; ke míawo ya míetsɔa Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la ŋkɔ ƒoa adegbee.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Woamu adze anyi; ke míawo ya míatso ɖe tsitre, adzɔ ka.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, na dziɖuɖu fia la; tɔ na mí, ne míeyɔ wò.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, fia la kpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ŋusẽ ŋu, eye wòle aseye tsom le wò xɔname ŋu ale gbegbe!

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Èwɔ eƒe dzimedidiwo dzi nɛ, eye mègbe nu si wòke nu bia wò la tsɔtsɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Elabe ètsɔ yayra siwo nye nu nyuiwo la va kpee, eye nèɖɔ sika nyuitɔ fiakuku ɖe ta nɛ.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ebia agbe tso asiwò me, ènae; agbenɔŋkeke geɖewoe nènae tegbetegbee.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Eƒe bubu lolo to wò kpekpeɖeŋu me, atsyɔ̃ kple fianyenye nètsɔ na eyama.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Ẽ, èwɔe wònye yayra vavãtɔ tegbee. Èdo dzidzɔ nɛ, wòtsoa aseye le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Elabe fia la ɖoa dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe amenuveve maʋã o.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Wò asi adi wò futɔwo katã alé, eye wò nuɖusi atu ame siwo lé fu wò.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Àwɔ wo abe kpodzo ene, ne èdo. Aƒetɔ ami wo le dɔmedzoe me, eye dzo afiã wo.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Àtsrɔ̃ woƒe dzidzimeviwo ɖa le anyigba dzi kple wo viwo ɖa le amegbetɔ viwo dome.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Ne woɖo vɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò, ne woɖo nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ aɖe la, womakpɔ dzidzedze o.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Elabe àna woasí adzo, àtsɔ wò da adzidze wo ŋkume.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ho kple wò ŋusẽ! Míadzi ha, eye míakafu wò ŋusẽ!

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, nye Mawu, nu ka ta nègblẽm ɖi? Nu ka tae nèle adzɔge ʋĩi be yemakpe ɖe ŋunye o? Nu ka tae nèle adzɔge ʋĩi tso nye lagbelãgbedodowo gbɔ?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, meyɔa wò le ŋkeke me, gake mètɔna nam o. Meyɔa wò le zã me hã, gake nyemekpɔa gbɔdzɔe o.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Evɔ nèle kɔkɔe, eye Israel ƒe kafukafuwoe nye fiazikpui si dzi nèbɔbɔ nɔ.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Ŋuwòe mía tɔgbuiwo ɖo dzi ɖo; woɖo dzi ɖe ŋuwò, eye nèɖe wo.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Wòe wodo ɣli yɔ, eye nèxɔ na wo; ŋuwòe woɖo dzi ɖo, eye ŋu mekpe wo o.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, ŋɔvie menye, menye amegbetɔ o. Amewo koam, eye nyemeɖi naneke le dukɔa gbɔ o.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã kpɔam la, ɖua fewu le ŋunye; wogbigbia nu ɖe ŋunye, ʋuʋua ta, gblɔna be:

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Etsɔ eƒe nyawo na Aƒetɔ; neɖee, nexɔ nɛ, elabe ekpɔa dzidzɔ le eŋu.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, wòe kplɔm doe tso vidzidɔ me; wòe na menɔ dedie le nɔnye ƒe no nu.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Wotsɔm gblẽ ɖe dziwò esime wodzim, eye tso esime nɔnye dzim ko la, wòe nye nye Mawu.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Mèganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o, elabe xaxa tum vɔ, eye ame aɖeke meli akpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Nyitsu geɖewo ɖe to ɖem; Basan-nyitsu sesẽwo ƒo xlãm.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Woke nu me baa ɖe ŋunye abe dzata dɔwui si le gbe ɖem la ene.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye abe tsie wokɔ ɖi ene, eye nye ƒuwo katã glí le wo nɔewo nu. Nye dzi zu abe anyiŋɔ ene helólo ɖe dɔme nam.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye keŋ abe sonu gaglɛ ene; nye aɖe lé ɖe nye ve me, ètsɔm mlɔ ku ƒe ʋuʋudedi me.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Ẽ, avuwo ƒo xlãm; ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ha ɖe to ɖem. Woƒo nu ɖe nye asiwo kple afɔwo.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mate ŋu axlẽ nye ƒuwo katã. Nye futɔwo kpɔe, eye wolé ŋku ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Woma nye avɔwo ɖe wo nɔewo dome; nye awuwo ya la, wodzidze nu ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, o Aƒetɔ, mèganɔ adzɔge o. Wòe nye kpeɖeŋutɔ nam; ɖe abla nàva kpe ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Ɖe nye luʋɔ le yi nu; ɖe nye agbe tso avu la ƒe ŋusẽ me.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Xɔ nam tso dzata la ƒe nu me! Xɔ nye luʋɔ si le fu kpem la tso nyitsu wɔadãwo ƒe dzowo nu.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Maƒo nu le ŋuwò na nɔvinyewo; makafu wò le amehawo dome.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, mikafui! Mi Yakob ƒomeawo katã, midoe ɖe dzi. Israelviwo katã, vɔvɔ̃ neɖo mi le eŋkume.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Elabe medo vlo fukpela ƒe fukpekpe, alo na wònyɔ ŋu nɛ o; meɣla eŋkume ɖee o, ke boŋ esi wòdo ɣli yɔe la, esee.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Gbɔwòe nye kafukafu tso le ameha gãwo dome. Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe le ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la ŋkume.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Fukpelawo aɖu nu aɖi ƒo; ame siwo dia Aƒetɔ la akafui. Miaƒe dziwo nenɔ agbe tegbee!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo katã aɖo ŋku edzi atrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu; dukɔwo ƒe ƒomewo katã ade ta agu ɖe eŋkume.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ tɔe nye fiaɖuɖu, eye wòle fia ɖum ɖe dukɔwo dzi.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Ẽ, eyae ame siwo katã dàna le anyigba dzi la, ade ta agu na. Ame siwo katã ayi ʋuʋudedi me kple ame si mate ŋu axɔ eɖokui ɖe agbe o la, adze klo nɛ.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Dzidzime siwo gbɔna la asubɔe; amewo axlẽ nya afia le Aƒetɔ la ŋu na dzidzimevi siwo lava dzɔ,

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: eye woaɖe gbeƒã ɖeɖedɔ si wòwɔ la na ame siwo womekpɔ dzi haɖe o la.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye kplɔlanye, naneke mehiãm o.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Gbeɖuƒe damawo wòna metsyɔ akɔ ɖo. Ekplɔam toa tɔ siwo li kpoo la to.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: Egbɔa agbe nye luʋɔ. Ekplɔam to nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe mɔ dzi, le eƒe ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mezɔa kubali doviviti tsiɖitsiɖi me hã la, nyemevɔ̃a vɔ̃ aɖeke o. Elabe èle gbɔnye. Wò atikplɔ kple wò atizɔti faa akɔ nam.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Èɖo kplɔ̃ ɖe akɔnye me le nye futɔwo ŋkume. Èsi ami ɖe ta nam; nye kplu yɔ gba go.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Ẽ, nunyoname kple amenuveve adze yonyeme le nye agbe me ŋkekewo katã me, eye manɔ Aƒetɔ ƒeme ɖaa.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ tɔe nye anyigba la kple nu siwo katã yɔ edzi; etɔe nye xexea me kple emenɔlawo.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Elabe eɖo egɔme anyi ɖe atsiaƒuwo dzi, eye wòɖoe anyi ɖe tɔsisiwo dzi.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Ame kae alia Aƒetɔ ƒe to la? Ame kae atsi tsitre ɖe eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒe asi me dza, eye eƒe dzime kɔ; ame si ƒe luʋɔ tsri aʋatso, eye medaa alakpa kaa atam ƒua edzi o lae.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Axɔ yayra tso Aƒetɔ gbɔ, eyae eƒe xɔname ƒe Mawu la atso afia na.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Esia nye dzidzimevi siwo dinɛ, ame siwo dia Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋkume.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mi agbowo, mikɔ ta dzi! Mi blemaʋɔtruwo, mifɔ dzi, ne Bubufia la nage ɖe eme.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Ame kae nye Bubufia la? Aƒetɔ, ŋusẽtɔ kple kalẽtɔ lae, Aƒetɔ, aʋakalẽtɔ lae!

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Mi agbowo, mikɔ ta dzi! Mi blemaʋɔtruwo, mifɔ dzi, ne Bubufia la nage ɖe eme.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Ame ka gɔ̃e nye Bubufia sia hã? Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae, eyae nye Bubufia la!

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, wòe mewu nye luʋɔ ɖe dzi na.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: O nye Mawu, wò ŋue mele ŋu ɖom ɖo; mègana ŋu nakpem o; mègana nye futɔwo natso aseye ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, na manya wò mɔwo; fia wò toƒewom.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Kplɔm le wò nyateƒe la me, eye nàfia num, elabe wòe nye nye xɔname ƒe Mawu la, elabe wòe mekpɔa mɔ na ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋu wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple wò amenuveve la elabe woli tso tititi ke.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Mègaɖo ŋku nye ɖevimenuvɔ̃wo loo, alo nye dzidadawo dzi o. Ɖo ŋku dzinye le wò amenuveve la nu kple le wò dɔmenyo la ta. O Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔme nyo, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe; eya ta efiaa mɔ si wòle be nuvɔ̃wɔlawo nato la wo.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Ekplɔa ɖokuibɔbɔlawo wowɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòfiaa ame si bɔbɔ eɖokui la eƒe mɔe.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe toƒewo katã nye amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ na ame siwo léa eƒe nubabla kple ɖaseɖiɖiwo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Le wò ŋkɔ la ta, O Aƒetɔ, tsɔ nye fɔɖiɖi la kem elabe elolo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Ame kae vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ? Eyae wòafia mɔ si wòle be wòatia la.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Nu anyo na eya ŋutɔ, eye viawo axɔ anyigba la wòazu wo tɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ dzea xɔlɔ̃ ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ, eye wònana wonyaa eƒe nubabla.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Nye ŋku le Aƒetɔ ŋu ɖaa elabe eyae aɖe nye afɔ tso ɖɔ me.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋunye ne nàve nunye, elabe nye ɖeka metsi anyi le fu kpem.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Ɖe xaxawo ɖa le nye dzime, eye nàɖem tso nye vevesesewo me.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Kpɔ fukpekpe kple xaxa siwo me mele la ɖa, eye nàtsɔ nye nuvɔ̃wo katã kem.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye ketɔ gbogboawo ɖa! Kpɔ ale si wolé fum ŋutasẽtɔe la ɖa!

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: O dzɔ nye agbe ŋu, eye nàɖem; mègana ŋu nakpem o, elabe wòe mesí tso.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Na fɔmaɖimaɖi kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nadzram ɖo elabe wòe mele mɔ kpɔm na.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: O Mawu, ɖe Israel tso eƒe xaxawo katã me.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, tso afia nam elabe mewɔ nuteƒe le nye nuwɔnawo me, eye meɖo ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu maʋamaʋãe.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, dom kpɔ, eye nàdzro menye kpɔ. Dzro nye dzi kple susu me,

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: elabe wò amenuveve la le ŋkunye me, eye mezɔna le wò nyateƒe la me.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Nyemenɔa alakpatɔwo ƒe ha me o, eye nye kple ayetɔwo míedea ha o.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, meklɔ asi fɔmaɖitɔe, eye meƒoa xlã wò vɔsamlekpui la,

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, melɔ̃ nɔwòƒe le wò aƒe la me kple teƒe si wò bubu le.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Mègakplɔm ƒu gbe kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ɖekae loo, alo nàɖe nye agbe ɖa kpe ɖe ʋukɔɖilawo tɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, mezɔna le nye fɔmaɖimaɖi me; ɖem, eye nàve nunye.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Anyigba sɔsɔe dzie mele tsitre ɖo. Makafu Aƒetɔ le takpekpe gãwo me.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye nye kekeli kple nye xɔname. Ame kae mavɔ̃? Aƒetɔ ye nye mɔ́ sesẽ na nye agbe. Ame kae adzi ŋɔ nam?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Ne ame vlowo lũ ɖe dzinye le ŋunye gblẽm, ame siwo nye nye ketɔwo kple nye futɔwo la, woakli nu adze anyi.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be aʋakɔ ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe ŋunye hã la, dzika matso ƒonye o. Togbɔ be aʋa ho ɖe ŋunye hã la, nye ya maɖe dzi ɖi.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Nu ɖeka mebia Aƒetɔ, eya yome madi be manɔ Aƒetɔ ƒeme le nye agbe me ŋkekewo katã me, ale be makpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nyonyo kple ŋku, eye mabia eta se le eƒe gbedoxɔ me.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Elabe aɣlam ɖe enɔƒe le xaxagbe, eye wòadam ɖe beɖoƒe le eƒe agbadɔ me. Akɔm aɖo kɔkɔƒe le agakpe dzi.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Ekema nye ta akɔ dzi azɔ agbɔ nye futɔ siwo katã ɖe to ɖem la ta. Matsɔ dzidzɔɣli asa aseyetsovɔ le eƒe agbadɔ me, eye madzi ha kple gbe vivi na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ne medo ɣli yɔ wò la, see; ve nunye, nàtɔ nam!

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Ègblɔ nam be: “Di ŋkunye me.” Nye dzi gblɔ na wò be: “Aƒetɔ, ŋkuwò me dim mele.”

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Mègaɣla wò mo ɖem o. Mègatutu wò dɔla ɖa le dɔmedzoe me o, wò si nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ. Mègatsɔm ƒu gbe o; mègagblẽm ɖi o. O, nye xɔname ƒe Mawu!

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Elabe tɔnye kple nɔnye gblẽm ɖi; ke Aƒetɔ axɔm.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, fia wò mɔm, eye kplɔm to toƒe sɔsɔe le nye ketɔwo ta.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Mègaɖe asi le ŋunye ne mage ɖe nye ketɔwo si me o; woawɔ nu si wolɔ̃ lam, elabe aʋatsoɖasefowo tso ɖe ŋunye, eye wole ŋutasesẽ gbɔm fuxefuxe.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Mexɔe se be makpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nu nyuiwo le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpɔ Aƒetɔ sinu; sẽ ŋu, lé dzi ɖe ƒo; ẽ, kpɔ mɔ na Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò yɔm mele. Nye agakpe, mègado tokum o, elabe ne èdo tokum la, mazu abe aʋlimeyilawo ene.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Se nye kokoƒogbe, esi mele ɣli dom na wò be nàkpe ɖe ŋunye; esi mewu nye asiwo dzi ɖo ɖe wò kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la!

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔm kpe ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple nu vlo wɔlawo ŋu o. Woawo la, woƒoa nu ŋutifafatɔe kple wo haviwo, esime nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ le woƒe dzime.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Esi womeléa ŋku ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu loo, alo eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo ŋu o ta, agbã wo aƒu anyi, eye magatu wo o.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ elabe ese nye kokoƒogbe.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye nye ŋusẽ kple nye akpoxɔnu; eya ŋue meɖoa dzi ɖo ale wòxɔna nam. Nye dzi le aseye tsom, eye metsɔ nye ha le akpe dam nɛ.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye ŋusẽ na eƒe dukɔ; eyae nye sitsoƒe si xɔna na eƒe amesiamina la.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Xɔ na wò dukɔ la, eye nàyra wò domenyinu la; nye wo kplɔla, eye nàkɔ wo ɖase mavɔ me.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Mi dziƒonɔlawo miɖe gbeƒã Aƒetɔ! Mitsɔ bubu kple ŋusẽ na Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ bubu si dze Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ la nɛ. Misubɔ Aƒetɔ le atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kɔkɔe me.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe ɖi le tɔwo dzi. Mawu bubutɔ lae ɖe gbe. Aƒetɔ ɖe gbe le tɔ geɖewo dzi.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe ŋu; Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe yɔ fũu kple fianyenye.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe ŋe sedertiwo, Aƒetɔ ŋe sedertiwo le Lebanon.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ena Lebanon ti kpo abe nyivi ene, eye Sirion ti kpo abe tòvi ene.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe ke dzo, dzo ƒe aɖewo do.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe na gbedadaƒo ʋuʋu; Aƒetɔ ʋuʋu Kades ƒe gbedadaƒo.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe na logotiwo ta tro, avemetiwo ta ŋe, eye amewo do ɣli le gbedoxɔ me be: “Bubu!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ bɔbɔ nɔ fiazi dzi le tɔɖɔɖɔ dzi. Aƒetɔ bɔbɔ nɔ fiazi dzi abe fia ene tegbee.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nena ŋusẽ eƒe dukɔ! Aƒetɔ netsɔ ŋutifafa yra eƒe dukɔ!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mado wò ɖe dzi, elabe wòe hem do goe, eye mèna nye futɔwo tso aseye ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, medo ɣli be nàkpe ɖe ŋunye, eye nèda gbe le ŋunye.

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe he nye luʋɔ tso tsiẽƒe, eye nègbɔ agbem tso aʋlimeyilawo dome.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Midzi kafukafuhawo na Aƒetɔ, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔeawo. Mida akpe ɖe eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ta.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Elabe eƒe dziku nu mesena yina o, eye eƒe amenuveve nɔa anyi agbenɔɣi katã. Avifafa te ŋu nɔa anyi le zã me; ke aseyetsotso vana le ŋdi.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Nye ya megblɔ le nye nunyonameɣi me be: “Womaʋãm akpɔ gbeɖe o.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ètsɔ wò amenuveve li kem goŋgoŋ abe to triakɔ ene. Èɣla wò ŋkume; dzidzi ƒom.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe medo ɣli yɔ, eye Aƒetɔ, wòe meƒo koko na be:

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Viɖe ka le nye ku ŋu, ne meyi aʋlime? Ɖe ʋuʋudedi akafu wòa? Ɖe wòaɖe gbeƒã wò nuteƒewɔwɔa?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Èna nye nuxaxa zu ɣeɖuɖu nam. Èɖe nye akpanya le ŋunye, eye nètsɔ dzidzɔ bla ali dzi nam,

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: ne nye luʋɔ nakafu wò, eye mazi ɖoɖoe o. Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, mada akpe na wò tegbee.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe mesí tso; mègana ŋu nakpem gbeɖe o, ɖem le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye; xɔ nam alɔ tsɔtsɔe. Zu agakpe si anye sitsoƒe nam; mɔ́ sesẽ si axɔ nam.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Ẽ, wòe nye nye agakpe kple mɔ́. Dze ŋgɔnye, nàkplɔm le wò ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɖem le ɖɔ si woɖo nam le adzame la me elabe wòe nye nye sitsoƒe.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye gbɔgbɔ de asiwò me; èɖem, Aƒetɔ, Mawu nuteƒewɔla.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Èlé fu ame siwo doa vivi ɖe legba siwo nye nu maɖinuwo ŋu, ke nye ya, meɖoa ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Matso aseye, eye dzi adzɔm le wò amenuveve ŋuti elabe ènya nye fukpekpe; nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ŋu nyawo ka wò.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Mèɖe asi le ŋunye na futɔ la o; ke boŋ èda nye afɔ ɖe gbadzaƒe.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ve nunye elabe mexaxa; nuxaxa na nye ŋku lé ayi, nye luʋɔ kple ŋutilã hã nenema.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Elabe konyifafa xɔ nye agbenɔnɔ, eye hũɖeɖe yɔ nye ƒewo. Hiãkame na ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye, eye nye ƒuwo le nyinyím.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Mezu alɔmeɖenu na nye ketɔwo katã; ŋɔdzinu na nye aƒelikawo, bibi na nye ame nyanyɛwo. Ame siwo kpɔam le ablɔ dzi sína le nunye!

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Amewo ŋlɔm be abe ame kuku ene; mezu abe ze gbagbã ene.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Ẽ, ame geɖewo le dalĩ dom mele sesem; ŋɔdzi ƒo xlãm kpe ɖo. Wole nugbe ɖom ɖe ŋunye be yewoaɖe nye agbe ɖa.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Ke meɖo ŋu ɖe ŋuwò, o Aƒetɔ. Mebe: “Wòe nye nye Mawu.”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Nye ɣeyiɣiwo le asiwò me. Ɖem tso nye futɔwo kple yonyemetilawo si me.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Na wò mo naklẽ ɖe wò dɔla dzi; xɔ nam le wò amenuveve la ta.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mègana ŋu nakpem o, elabe wò yɔm mele. Na ŋu nakpe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo; na woayi tsiẽƒe numaƒomaƒoe.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Na aʋatsokalawo ƒe nu nade ga, ame siwo ƒoa nu ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu ameŋkumekpɔtɔe le dàda kple ame mabumabu me.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Wò dɔmenyo sɔ gbɔ loo! Èli kɔe ɖi na ame siwo vɔ̃a wò, eye nèɖee fia ame siwo sí wò tso la, le amegbetɔ viwo ŋkume.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Èɣla wo ɖe beɖoƒe si le ŋkuwò me tso amewo ƒe nugbeɖoɖo nu. Èna wole dedie le wò agbadɔ me; wovo tso amewo ƒe dzrewɔɖe si me.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, elabe eɖe eƒe amenuveve fiam nukutɔe, esime menɔ abe du si woɖe to ɖo la ene.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Esi dzi ɖe le ƒonye la, megblɔ be: “Woɖem ɖa sãa tso ŋkuwò me.” Gake esi medo ɣli yɔ wò be nàkpe ɖe ŋunye la, èse nye kokoƒoƒo.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Milɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã. Aƒetɔ kpɔa anukwaretɔwo ta; ke eɖoa eteƒe na dàdalawo vevie.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Misẽ ŋu, eye milé dzi ɖe ƒo, mi ame siwo katã kpɔa mɔ na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si wotsɔ eƒe dzidada kee, ame si ƒe nuvɔ̃ dzi wotsyɔ nui.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Woyra ame si Aƒetɔ mebu vodada aɖeke na o, eye alakpa aɖeke mele eƒe gbɔgbɔ me o.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Esi nyemeʋu nye nuvɔ̃ me o la, nye ŋeŋe atraɖii ŋkeke blibo la na meɖi ku.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Elabe wò asi sẽ ɖe dzinye ŋkeke kple zã; nye ŋusẽ vɔ keŋ abe dzomeŋɔli ƒe dzoxɔxɔe wɔe ene.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Menya be mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò, nyemeɣla nye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ la o. Megblɔ be: “Maʋu nye dzidadawo me na Aƒetɔ.” Tete nètsɔ nuvɔ̃ si mewɔ la ƒe fɔɖiɖi la kem.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Eya ta na ame sia ame si nye mawumeme la nado gbe ɖa na wò; le xaxaɣi, ne tɔ gãwo ɖɔ hã la, made egbɔ o.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Beɖoƒee nènye nam; èdzram ɖo tso xaxa me. Ètsɔ ɖeɖe ƒo xlãm.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Mafia nu wò, mafia mɔ si nàto la wò. Maɖo aɖaŋu na wò, eye nye ŋku anɔ ŋuwò.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Mèganɔ abe sɔ alo tedzisɔ si si gɔmesese mele o la ene o; ka kple numega wotsɔna mlanɛ. Ne menye nenem o la, manɔ gbɔwò o.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi sea veve geɖe; ke ame si ɖoa ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu la, amenuveve ƒoa xlãe.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Mi ame dzɔdzɔewo, mikpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu; kafukafue dze nuteƒewɔlawo.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ kple kasaŋkuwo; midzi ha kple gbe vivi nɛ ɖe kasaŋku ka ewo tɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye nɛ; mika asi kaawo ŋu aɖaŋutɔe, ɣli neɖi sesĩe.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe nya toa mɔ ɖeka, eye wòwɔa nuteƒe le eƒe dɔwo katã me.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Elɔ̃ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe. Aƒetɔ ƒe amenuveve yɔ anyigba la dzi taŋ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Nya Aƒetɔ tsɔ wɔ dziƒowoe, eye eƒe nu me gbɔgbɔ wòtsɔ wɔ dziƒonuwo katã.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Mina anyigba dzi nɔlawo katã navɔ̃ Aƒetɔ. Mina xexemenɔlawo katã natsɔ bubu anɔ tsitre ɖe eŋkume kple vɔvɔ̃!

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Elabe eƒo nu, eye wòva eme; eɖe gbe, eye wòtsi tsitre ɖi.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ na dukɔwo ƒe adaŋudede zu dzodzro; exe mɔ na dukɔwo ƒe ɖoɖowo.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe adaŋudede le te tegbee, eƒe dzimesusuwo li na dzidzimewo katã.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Woyra du si ƒe Mawu nye Aƒetɔ; dukɔ si wòtia be wòanye yeƒe domenyinu.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kpɔa nu tso dziƒo; ekpɔa amegbetɔ viwo katã.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ekpɔa anyigba dzi tɔwo katã tso afi si wòbɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi le.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Eya ame si wɔ wo katã ƒe dzi, eye wòléa ŋku ɖe woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dziɖuɖu mele eƒe aʋakɔ kpaŋkpaŋ me o, aʋawɔla ƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ meɖenɛ o.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Mɔkpɔkpɔ meli be aʋawɔsɔ ana woaɖu dzi o, eye mate ŋu axɔ na ame kple eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la o.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋku le ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la ŋu; ame siwo kpɔa mɔ na eƒe amenuveve

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Míaƒe luʋɔ le mɔ kpɔm na Aƒetɔ; eyae nye mía kpeɖeŋutɔ kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Ẽ, míaƒe dzi le dzidzɔ kpɔm le eyama me, elabe míeɖoa dzi ɖe eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, na wò amenuveve nanɔ mía dzi abe ale si míele mɔ kpɔm na wò la ene.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Makafu Aƒetɔ ɣeawo katã ɣi, eƒe kafukafu anɔ nunye me edziedzi.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ tsɔa Aƒetɔ ƒoa adegbee; mina fukpelawo nasee, akpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Miva de kɔkɔ Aƒetɔ ŋu kplim, eye mina míaƒo ƒu ado eŋkɔ ɖe dzi!

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Medi Aƒetɔ, etɔ nam, eye wòɖem tso nye vɔvɔ̃wo katã me.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ eyama, eye miaƒe mo naklẽ; ekema ŋu makpe mi akpɔ o.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Ame dahe sia do ɣli, Aƒetɔ se eŋkɔ, eye wòɖee tso eƒe xaxawo katã me.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla dzɔa ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la ŋu, eye wòɖea wo.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Miɖɔe kpɔ, eye miakpɔ ale si Aƒetɔ nyoe! Woyra ame si sínɛ tsona.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Mivɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, elabe hiã metua ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la o!

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Hiã tua dzataviwo, eye dɔ wua wo; ke ame siwo dia Aƒetɔ la, nu nyui aɖeke mehiãa wo o.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Viwo, miva, miɖo to, ne mafia ale si woavɔ̃ Aƒetɔ la mi.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Ame kae le agbe dim? Ame kae agbe didi nɔnɔ biã ŋu na, eye wòdi be eme nanyo na ye?

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Kpɔ wò aɖe dzi le nuvɔ̃ɖi ŋu, eye mègada alakpa o.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Te ɖa tso nuvɔ̃ɖi gbɔ, eye nàwɔ nu nyui; di ŋutifafa, nàkplɔe ɖo.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋku le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo ŋu, eye eƒe to le woƒe ɣlidodo ŋu.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖo adãmo ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ŋu, be yeatsrɔ̃ wo ŋkɔ ɖa le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Ne nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo do ɣli bia kpekpeɖeŋu la, Aƒetɔ senɛ, eye wòɖea wo tso woƒe xaxawo katã me.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ tsɔ ɖe ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la gbɔ kpokploe, eye wòxɔna na ame siwo ƒe gbɔgbɔ tugu la.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ƒe fukpekpewo sɔ gbɔ; ke Aƒetɔ ɖenɛ tsoa wo katã me.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Ekpɔa eƒe ƒuwo katã ta, ɖeka pɛ hã meŋena o.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ awu ame vɔ̃ɖi la, eye ame siwo lé fu nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo la, woabu fɔ wo.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖea eƒe dɔlawo ƒe agbe; womabu fɔ ame siwo síi tso la dometɔ aɖeke o.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò akplɔ kple fía nuevee ɖe ame siwo le yonyeme tim la ŋu! Gblɔ na nye luʋɔ be: “Nyee aɖe wò!”

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Na ŋukpe kple vlododo nava ame siwo le nye agbe yome tim la dzi! Na ame siwo le vɔ̃e bum ɖe ŋunye le tame la nagbugbɔ ɖe megbe, eye woƒe mo neyi to!

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Na woanɔ abe nutsro le ya nu ene, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla nenyà wo ɖe nu!

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Na woƒe mɔ dzi nado viviti anɔ ɖiɖim, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla neyɔ wo ɖe nu.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Elabe nyemewɔ naneke hafi woɖo ɖɔ ɖi nam o; nyemewɔ naneke hafi woɖe ʋe ɖi na nye agbe o.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Na wo dome nagblẽ hafi woanya, eye na ɖɔ si woɖo la naɖe wo! Na woage dze eme atsrɔ̃!

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Ekema nye luʋɔ atso aseye ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye wòakpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe ɖeɖe ŋu.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Nye ƒuwo katã agblɔ be: “O Aƒetɔ, ame kae ɖi wò? Wò ame si ɖea ame beli tso ame si sesẽ nɛ akpa la si me, ame beli kple hiãtɔ tso ame si da adzoe la si me?”

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Woɖo vɔ̃, nyui teƒe nam; nye luʋɔ tsi asi.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Ke nye ya esime wodze dɔ la, meta akpanya. Mewɔ fu ɖokuinye kple nutsitsidɔ, eye mede mo to, do gbe ɖa,

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: abe xɔ̃nye alo nɔvinye ŋutsue mele fafam na ene; menɔa yiyim abe ame si le konyi fam na nɔa, ame si bɔbɔ le funyinyi me ene.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Ke esi mekli nu la, woƒo ƒu kpɔ dzidzɔ, woƒo ta kpli ɖe ŋunye; tekunɔ siwo nyemenya o la, gblẽ ŋunye madzudzɔmadzudzɔe.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ ɖiŋudodo ɖu fewu le ŋunye zi geɖe, henɔa aɖukli ɖum ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣie nanɔ esia kpɔm? Ɖem, tso woƒe nuvuvu me, nye agbe tso dzatawo si me.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Ekema mada akpe na wò le ameha gã la dome; makafu wò le takpekpe gã la me.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Mègana ame siwo nye nye ketɔwo madzemadzee la natso aseye ɖe ŋunye o, eye mègana ame siwo lé fum dzodzro la namia ŋku ɖem o.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Elabe womedia ŋutifafa o, ke boŋ wotsiaa tre ɖe ame siwo li kpoo la ŋu le anyigba la dzi, eye ameblenya nɔa woƒe susu me.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Wokea nu baa ɖe ŋunye; hegblɔna be: “Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃, míaƒe ŋkuwo kpɔe!”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, èkpɔe, mègazi kpi o! O Aƒetɔ, mèganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu tso afia nam, le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nu, eye mègana woatso aseye le tanye o.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Mègana woagblɔ na wo ɖokui be: “Ehɛ̃, alea dim míaƒe dzi le” o. Mègana woagblɔ be: “Míemii” o.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe ame siwo katã tso aseye le nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e ta, eye na woatɔtɔ! Na ŋukpe kple vlododo navu tsyɔ ame siwo le wo ɖokui dom ɖe dzi ɖe ŋunye la dzi!

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Na ame siwo di be woatso afia nam la, nado ɣli akpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woanɔ gbɔgblɔm ɖaa be: “Aƒetɔ, ame si kpɔa dzidzɔ ne nu nyo na eƒe dɔla la lolo loo!”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Ekema nye aɖe aƒo nu tso wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ŋu, eye wòakafu wò ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Elabe evivia nu me na eɖokui be womate ŋu anya yeƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ, eye woalé fui o.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Eƒe numenyawo nye gbegblẽ kple amefuflu. Edzudzɔ nuwɔwɔ nunyatɔe, eye wòdzudzɔ nu nyui wɔwɔ.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ebua nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ ŋu le eƒe aba dzi; edaa eɖokui ɖe mɔ gbegblẽ dzi, eye meƒoa asa na nuvɔ̃ɖi o.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, wò amenuveve la kɔ ɖatɔ dziƒo ke, wò nuteƒewɔwɔ de alilikpowo me ke.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ le abe Mawu ƒe towo ene, wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ de to abe tɔ goglowo ene. O Aƒetɔ, èxɔna na amegbetɔwo kple lãwo siaa.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: O Mawu, wò amenuveve xɔ asi loo! Amegbetɔ viwo bèna ɖe wò aʋalawo ƒe vɔvɔli te.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Wò aƒeme nu gbogboawoe woɖuna kple dzidzɔ, wò dzidzɔdoname ƒe tɔsisi me tsie nènaa wo wonona.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Elabe gbɔwòe agbedzɔtsoƒe le; wò kekeli mee míekpɔa kekeli le.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Na wò amenuveve la naganɔ ame siwo nya wò la dzi, eye wò xɔname nagasu ame siwo wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe le dzime la si.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Mègana dàdalawo nate afɔ ɖe dzinye loo, alo ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi nanyàm ɖa o.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Nu tovo wɔlawoe ma dra ɖe anyi ɖe afi ma; wotutu wo ƒu anyi, eye womagate ŋu afɔ o.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Mègabi dzi le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ta loo, alo nàbiã ŋu ɖe ale si nu dzea edzii na nu vlo wɔlawo la ŋu o!

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: Elabe eteƒe madidi hafi woaɖi golo abe gbe ene, eye woayrɔ abe amagbe ene o.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye nàwɔ nu nyui; ale nànɔ dedie le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nu nenyo ŋuwò, eye wòana nu si wò dzi di la wò.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Gblẽ wò mɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ si me, ɖo ŋu ɖe eyama ŋu, eye awɔe.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Ahe wò nya dzɔdzɔe ɖe go abe kekeli ene, eye nu si dze na wò la me akɔ abe ŋdɔkutsu le ɣeɖota ene.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Zi ɖoɖoe kpoo le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, gbɔ dzi ɖi nàkpɔ esi nu; mègabi dzi le ame si ƒe mɔwo dzea edzi nɛ la ta, ɖe ame si nɔa ɖoɖo wɔm ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu la ŋu o.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Mègado dziku o, eye tsri dɔmedzoedodo! Mègabi dzi le ɖokuiwò me o, nuvɔ̃ɖi me ko wòakplɔ wò adee.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Elabe wole ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tsrɔ̃ ge ɖa; ke ame siwo kpɔa Aƒetɔ sinu la, woaxɔ anyigba la.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Ke ame fafawo axɔ anyigba la, eye woado dzidzɔ na wo ɖokui kple nunyoname geɖewo.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi le nugbe ɖom ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ŋu, eye wòɖua aɖukli ɖe eŋu;

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: ke Aƒetɔ koa ame vɔ̃ɖi la, elabe ekpɔe be eƒe ŋkeke gbɔna.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo he yi ɖe go, eye wovu woƒe da me, be yewoaƒu ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo anyi, be yewoawu ame siwo le mɔ dzɔdzɔe dzi la.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Woƒe yi aƒo ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzi, eye woƒe datiwo aŋe.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Nu sue si le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla si la, nyo wu nu gbogbo siwo le ame vɔ̃ɖi geɖewo si.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Elabe wole ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe alɔ ŋe ge, ke Aƒetɔ léa nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo ɖe te.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nya ame maɖifɔwo ƒe ŋkekewo, eye woƒe domenyinu anɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Womedoa ŋukpe wo le ɣeyiɣi vɔ̃wo me o; nu geɖe nɔa wo si le dɔŋɔli.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ya tsrɔ̃na, Aƒetɔ ƒe futɔwo le ko abe gbeɖuƒewo ƒe atsyɔ̃ ene. Wobuna, hevɔna ɖa abe dzudzɔ ene.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi doa nugbana, eye mete ŋu xenɛ o; ke nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ƒe dɔme nyona, eye wònaa nu ame.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Elabe ame siwo Aƒetɔ yra la, axɔ anyigba la; ke ame siwo wòƒo fi de la ya atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe afɔɖeɖe la, Aƒetɔ gbɔe wòtso, eye eliaa ke ame si ƒe mɔwo doa dzidzɔ nɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Ne edze anyi hã la, matɔ kɔ anyi o; elabe Aƒetɔ léa eƒe asi ɖe asi.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Menɔ ɖevime kpɔ, azɔ la metsi; ke nyemekpɔ wogblẽ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ɖi kpɔ loo, alo viawo nanɔ nuɖuɖu biam o.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Enaa nu faa ɣe sia ɣi, eye wòdoa nu na amewo, eye viawo zua yayra.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Te ɖa tso nuvɔ̃ɖi gbɔ, eye nàwɔ nu nyui; ekema ànɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ lɔ̃a nya dzɔdzɔe, magblẽ eƒe ame kɔkɔewo ɖi o. Adzra nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo ɖo tegbee; ke woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe viwo.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo axɔ anyigba la, eye woanɔ edzi tegbee.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Nunya dona tso nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ƒe nu me, eye eƒe aɖe gblɔa nya dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Eƒe Mawu ƒe se la le eƒe dzime, eƒe afɔɖeɖewo meɖiɖina o.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi léa ŋku ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ŋu, eye wòdina be yeawui.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ maɖe asi wòakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi loo, alo ana woabu fɔe ne wokplɔe yi ʋɔnui o.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Kpɔ Aƒetɔ sinu, eye nàzɔ eƒe mɔ dzi, ekema ado wò ɖe dzi be nàxɔ anyigba la; àkpɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tsɔtsrɔ̃ teƒe.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi aɖe wòle eɖokui dom ɖe dzi; ekɔ, de dzi abe sederti le Lebanon ene.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Megava to afi ma, eye kpɔ ɖa, megali o; togbɔ be medii hã la, womekpɔe o.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: De dzesi ame maɖifɔ la, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ŋu, elabe dzidzimeviwo li na ame si nye ŋutifafame la.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Ke woatsrɔ̃ dzidalawo ya ɖa keŋkeŋ; ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe dzidzimeviwo atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo ƒe xɔname tsoa Aƒetɔ gbɔ; eyae nyea woƒe sitsoƒe le xaxaɣiwo me.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kpena ɖe wo ŋu heɖea wo; eɖea wo tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me, eye wòxɔna na wo, elabe wosínɛ tsona.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mègaka mo nam le wò dziku me loo, alo ahe to nam le wò dɔmedzoe me o!

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Elabe wò aŋutrɔwo nyrɔ ɖe lã me nam, eye wò asi tem ɖe anyi.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Le wò dɔmedzoe ta, lãmesẽ aɖeke megale ŋunye o; le nye nuvɔ̃ ta, ŋusẽ aɖeke megale nye ƒuwo me o.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Nye abiwo ƒaƒã, le ʋeʋẽm, le nye movidzɔdzɔ ta.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Mebɔbɔ dra ɖe anyigba keŋkeŋ; mele tsatsam ŋkeke bliboa le konyi fam.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Elabe nye ali me ʋudzo hẽe, eye lãmesẽ aɖeke megale ŋunye o.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye keŋkeŋ, eye nye lã me gbã gudugudu; mele ŋeŋem elabe zi tɔ le nye dzime.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ènya nye didiwo katã, nye hũɖeɖe mele ɣaɣla ɖe wò o.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le tsotsom, ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye; nye ŋkuwo hã tsí.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Xɔ̃nyewo kple nye zɔhɛwo le adzɔge tso nye dɔ vɔ̃ la gbɔ, eye nye ƒometɔwo le adzɔge ʋĩi tso gbɔnye.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Ame siwo le nye ku dim la tre mɔ̀ ɖi nam, ame siwo di be nu vevi newɔm la, ƒoa nu le ale si woatsrɔ̃m la ŋu eye wodea ŋugble le nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ ŋu ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Ke nye ya mele abe tokunɔ ene, nyemele naneke sem o; abe mumu si mekea nu o la ene.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Ke wò Aƒetɔ sinu kpɔm mele; wò Aƒetɔ enye Mawu, wò koe atɔ nam.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Elabe medoa gbe ɖa be: “Wɔe ko be ame siwo ƒoa adegbe ne nye afɔ ɖiɖi la, nagatso aseye le tanye o!”

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Elabe nye ya mele klalo be madze anyi, eye vevesese dzi ko mele.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Meʋu nye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me; evem be mewɔ nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Ame siwo tsɔa vɔ̃ ɖoa nyui teƒe nam la, zu nye ketɔwo elabe metia nu nyui yome.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, mègagblẽm ɖi o! Ao, nye Mawu, mèganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o!

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Tso kaba nakpe ɖe ŋunye, o Aƒetɔ, nye xɔname!

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Megblɔ be: “Malé fɔ ɖe nye zɔzɔme ŋu be nyemawɔ nuvɔ̃ kple nye aɖe o. Made ga nye nu zi ale si ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le ŋkunye me.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Mezu mumu, eye mezi ɖoɖoe, dzodzroe melé ɖokuinye, nye vevesese gado gã ɖe edzi.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Nye dzi ʋu dzo le dɔme nam. Esi mele eŋuti bum la, dzoa bi; tete nye aɖe gblɔ be:

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ, na manya nye nuwuwu kple nye agbe me ŋkekewo ƒe didime; na madze si ale si nye agbe le du dzii.

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, èwɔ nye agbe me ŋkekewo wonye asi ƒe kekeme ʋɛ aɖewo ko, eye nye agbenɔɣi mede naneke koŋ le ŋkuwò me o. Nyateƒee, ame sia ame le ko abe ƒuƒu ene le ŋkuwò me!

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, amegbetɔ le yiyim abe vɔvɔli ene! Nyateƒee, hloloe ko tsom wole dzodzro; gbetɔ li kɔ nu ɖi gleglegle, evɔ menya ame ka tɔ woava zu o!

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: Azɔ Aƒetɔ, nu kae manɔ mɔ kpɔm na? Wò mee nye mɔkpɔkpɔ le.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso nye dzidadawo katã me. Mègawɔm bometsila ƒe alɔmeɖenu o.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Mezu mumu, nyemekea nu o; elabe wòe wɔe.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò ameƒoti la ɖa le dzinye; ale si nèle ƒoyem kple asii la, na nu te ŋunye.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Ne ètsɔ mokaname he to na amegbetɔ ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃ ta la, eƒe nu vevi dome gblẽna abe agbagblaʋui ye ɖui ene. Nyateƒee, ame sia ame, ƒuƒu ko wònye.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye nàlé to ɖe nye ɣlidodo ŋu; mègazi kpɔ nye aɖatsiwo o! Elabe wò amedzro si tso eme va yina lae menye; menye amedzro abe tɔgbuinyewo katã ene.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Ɖe kɔ ɖa le ŋunye, ne makpɔ dzidzɔ vie, hafi ava dzo avɔ ɖa keŋkeŋ!”

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Megbɔ dzi ɖi kpɔ mɔ na Aƒetɔ kakaka; etrɔ to ɖe ŋunye, se nye ɣlidodo.
