english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Eɖem tso do si me metsi akogo le la me, tso ba finyafinya me, hetsɔm ɖo agakpe dzi, ale nye azɔli ɖo te nu.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ede ha yeye nu nam ha, si akafu mía Mawu la. Ame geɖewo akpɔe, avɔ̃, eye woaɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si ɖoa ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, ame si metrɔna ɖe dàdalawo ŋu o, ame si metrɔna ɖe ame siwo tra mɔ dze alakpamawuwo yome la ŋu o!

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, edzi nukunu siwo nèwɔ na mí kple susu siwo nèɖe ɖe mía ŋu ɖe edzi ale gbegbe; ame aɖeke mate ŋu asɔ kpli wò o! Ne mebe maƒo nu aɖe gbeƒã le wo ŋu la, womele xexlẽme o.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Mèdia akpedadavɔsa kple numemevɔsa o; gake èʋu to nam. Mèbia numemevɔsa kple nuvɔ̃vɔsa o.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, meva; woŋlɔ nu ɖe agbalẽ la me tso ŋutinye.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: O, nye Mawu, enye dzidzɔ nam be mawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu; wò se la le nye dzime.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Meɖe gbeƒã wò ɖeɖenya si nye dzidzɔnya la, le ameha gãwo dome; kpɔ ɖa, nyememia nu ɖe edzi o, o Aƒetɔ, abe ale si nènya ene.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Nyemeɣla wò kpekpeɖeŋu si xɔ nam la ɖe nye dzime o, meƒo nu tso wò nuteƒewɔwɔ kple xɔname ŋuti. Nyemeɣla wò amenuveve la kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖe ameha gã la o.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, mègate wò nublanuikpɔkpɔm o, na wò amenuveve kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ nadzram ɖo tegbee.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Elabe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo mele xexlẽme o la ɖe to ɖem, nye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo zu agba nam ale gbegbe be nyemagate ŋu kpɔ nu o; wosɔ gbɔ wu nye taɖa, dzi ɖe le ƒonye keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, lɔ̃ nàɖem dzro! Ao, Aƒetɔ, ɖe abla nàkpe ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na ame siwo katã le didim be yewoaɖe nye agbe ɖa la natɔtɔ, eye ŋu nakpe wo; na woado vlo ame siwo di be yewoawɔ nu vevim la, eye woate gbugbɔ ɖe megbe!

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Na ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm ɖe ŋunye be: “Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃” la, ƒe nu naku le woƒe ŋukpe ta!

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ke na ame siwo katã dia wò la natso aseye, eye woakpɔ dzidzɔ le mewò; ame siwo lɔ̃a wò xɔname la nagblɔ edziedzi be: “Aƒetɔ lolo!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Nye ya la, ame dahe kple hiãtɔ menye; ke Aƒetɔ la bua ŋunye. Nye ɖela kple kpeɖeŋutɔ nènye, o nye Mawu, mègahe ɖe megbe o!

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si tsɔa ɖe le eme na hiãtɔ! Aƒetɔ ɖenɛ le xaxagbe.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kpɔa eta, eye wòléa eƒe agbe ɖe te; woyɔnɛ le anyigba la dzi be yayratɔ; mègblẽnɛ ɖe eƒe futɔwo si me o.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kpɔa eta le eƒe dɔba dzi. Ne ele dɔ lém la, wòe daa gbe le eƒe lãmegbegblẽwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Nye ya megblɔ be: “Ve nunye, o Aƒetɔ, yɔ dɔm, elabe mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò!”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo le gbɔgblɔm vɔ̃edinametɔe le ŋunye be: “Ɣe ka ɣie wòaku, ne eŋkɔ navɔ ɖa?”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe va kpɔm ɖa la, egblɔa nya ƒuƒluwo ko, esime nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ le eƒe dzime. Ne edo go la, eyina ɖakakanɛ.

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔna be: “Kudɔ ŋutɔ lém wòle, megale fɔfɔ ge tso afi si wòmlɔ la o.

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Xɔ̃nye vevitɔ kekeake si dzi mekana ɖo, ame si ɖu nu le gbɔnye la hã, trɔ ʋu le yonyeme, dem asi.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Aƒetɔ ya, ve nunye, eye nàfɔm ɖe te, be maɖo eteƒe na wo!

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: To esia me medze sii be nye nu nyoa ŋuwò; elabe nye futɔ meɖu dzinye, tso aseye o.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, èlém ɖe te elabe nyemeɖi fɔ o, eye nètsɔm ɖo wò ŋkume tegbee.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen, ẽ, Amen!

english_verse: ) Longing for God
translation_verse: Ame aɖe ƒe gbedodoɖa le aboyo me

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Ale si zinɔ dia tɔʋu me tsi vevie la, nenema nye luʋɔ le diwòmee, o Mawu.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Mawutsikɔ le nye luʋɔ wum, Mawu gbagbe la ƒe tsikɔwuamee! Ɣe ka ɣie mava do akpɔ Mawu ŋkume?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Nye aɖatsiwo zu nuɖuɖu nam zã kple keli, esime amewo le biayem edziedzi be: “Afi ka wò Mawu la le?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Meɖoa ŋku nu siawo dzi ne meyi ɖokuinye me: Ale si nye kple amehawo míedona, menɔa ŋgɔ na wo míeɖona yia Mawu ƒe aƒeme; míetsɔa dzidzɔɣli kple akpedahawo nɔa hatsotso gã me le ŋkekenyui ɖuɣi.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, nu ka tae nèle nu xam, eye nu ka tae gbe vɔ le nuwò le menye? Kpɔ mɔ na Mawu, elabe magakafui, nye kpeɖeŋutɔ

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: kple nye Mawu. Nye luʋɔ le nu xam le menye, eya ta meɖo ŋku dziwò le Yordan-nyigba dzi, le Xermon-to kple Mizar-to la dzi.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Gogloƒe ƒe gogloƒewoe nèyɔa tsi tsonɛ bababa. Esime wò tsitsetsewo ɖe gbe la, wò tsitsotsoewo katã kple tsi kpakawo ŋe ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ vea nunye le ŋkeke me, eye le zã me la, eƒe ha le nunye me. Medoa gbe ɖa na Mawu si na mele agbe.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Mebiaa Mawu, nye agakpe la be: “Nu ka ta nèŋlɔm be? Nu ka ta nye futɔ atem ɖi, manɔ yiyim, anɔ nu xam?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Nye ketɔwo ƒe alɔmeɖeɖe le ŋunye edziedzi be: “Afi ka gɔ̃ wò Mawu la le?” ya la, ɖeko wònɔna nam abe kubie mexɔ ene.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, nu ka tae nèle nu xam, eye nu ka tae gbe vɔ le nuwò le menye? Kpɔ mɔ na Mawu, elabe magakafui, nye kpeɖeŋutɔ kple nye Mawu.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: O Mawu, tso afia nam, eye nàʋli tanye le dukɔ mavɔ̃mawu la gbɔ. Ɖem tso alakpatɔwo kple nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo si me.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Elabe wòe nye Mawu si mesí tso; nu ka tae nètsɔm ƒu gbe? Nu ka tae manɔ yiyim anɔ konyi fam elabe futɔ la tem ɖe anyi?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Ao, ɖo wò kekeli kple nyateƒe ɖem, na ne woakplɔm; na ne woakplɔm va wò to kɔkɔe la dzi afi si nèle!

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Ekema mayi Mawu ƒe vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ, mayi nye Mawu gbɔ kple dzidzɔ gã, eye makafu wò kple kasaŋku, o Mawu, nye Mawu!

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, nu ka tae nèle nu xam, eye nu ka tae gbe vɔ le nuwò le menye? Kpɔ mɔ na Mawu, elabe magakafui, nye kpeɖeŋutɔ kple nye Mawu.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: Míesee kple míaƒe towo, o Mawu mía tɔgbuiwo gblɔe na mí nu siwo nèwɔ le wo ŋɔli, nu siwo nèwɔ le blema:

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ wò ŋutɔ wò asi nyà dukɔwo ɖa, ke èƒo woƒe kè ɖe to; èna dukɔwo kpe fu, ke èna ablɔɖe woawo ya;

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: elabe wometsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe yi xɔ anyigba la loo, alo ɖu edzi kple woawo ŋutɔ ƒe abɔ o; ke wò nuɖusi kple wò abɔ kpakple wò mo ƒe keklẽ lae xɔ na wo; elabe woƒe nu nyo ŋuwò.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Wòe nye nye Fia kple nye Mawu, ame si ɖoe be Yakob nakpɔ dziɖuɖu.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Wò dzie míeto tutu míaƒe ketɔwo ƒu anyi; wò ŋkɔ mee míefanya ame siwo dze mía dzi le.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Elabe nyemeɖo dzi ɖe nye dati ŋu loo, alo be nye yi naxɔ nam o.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Ke wò la èɖe mí tso míaƒe ketɔwo si me, eye nèna ame siwo lé fu mí la tɔtɔ.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Mawu mee míeƒoa adegbe le edziedzi, eye míada akpe le wò ŋkɔ ta tegbee.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Ke ètsɔ mí ƒu gbe hebɔbɔ mí ɖe anyi, eye mèdo yi kple míaƒe aʋakɔwo o.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Èna míesí le ketɔ la nu, eye míaƒe futɔwo kpɔ nu ha.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Èwɔ mí abe alẽ siwo wodzra ɖo hena wuwu ene, eye nèka mí hlẽ ɖe dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Nètsɔ wò dukɔ la dzra asi bɔbɔe, eye mèdo asi lolo ɖe wo ŋu o.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ mí wɔ vlodonu na míaƒe aƒelikawo, koko kple fewuɖunu na ame siwo ƒo xlã mí.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Èna míezu hamelo le dukɔwo dome; nu ɖikokoe le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Mele vlodoame kpɔm ŋkeke blibo la, eye ŋu kpem,

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: le fewuɖulawo kple amedzulawo ƒe nyawo ta, le futɔ la kple hlɔ̃biala la ŋkume.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Nu siawo katã dzɔ ɖe mía dzi, togbɔ be mimeŋlɔ wò be loo, alo gbe wò nubabla dzi wɔwɔ o hã.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Míaƒe dzi metrɔ le yowòme loo, alo míaƒe afɔ natra le wò mɔ dzi

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: be nàto mí nyànyanya le akpatakuwo nɔƒe, eye nàtsɔ blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi atsyɔ mía dzi o.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe míeŋlɔ mía Mawu ŋkɔ be heke abɔ me do gbe ɖa na mawu tutɔ aɖe la,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: ɖe Mawu manya esia oa? Elabe enyaa nuɣaɣla siwo le dzime.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ao, tawòe wole mía wuwu dzi ŋkeke blibo la katã, eye wobu mí abe alẽ siwo wole wuwu ge la ene.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, nyɔ! Nu ka tae nèle alɔ̃ dɔm? Fɔ! Mègatsɔ mí ƒu gbe gbidii o.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Nu ka tae nèɣla wò ŋkume? Nu ka tae nèŋlɔ míaƒe fukpekpe kple teteɖeanyi be?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Elabe wotutu míaƒe luʋɔ ƒu anyi ɖe ʋuʋudedi me; míaƒe ŋutilã lé ɖe anyigba ŋu.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Tso! Va kpe ɖe mía ŋu! Ɖe mí le wò amenuveve la ta!

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Nyati nyui aɖe le fiefiem tso nye dzime wlɔwlɔwlɔ; fia lae mekpa nye kpukpuiawo na. Nye aɖe le abe agbalẽŋlɔla si le klalo ƒe nuŋlɔti ene.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Wòe dze ɖeka wu le amegbetɔ viwo dome; wokɔ amenuveve ɖe wò nuyiwo dzi; eya ta Mawu yra wò tegbee.

english_verse: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword
translation_verse: Bla akpa kple wò yi ɖe aklito, wò kalẽtɔ, le wò atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kple wò fianyenye me!

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Le wò fianyenye me ho yi dziɖuɖutɔe, be nàʋli nyateƒe kple nu dzɔdzɔe ta; na wò nuɖusi nafia nu dziŋɔ wɔwɔwo wò!

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Wò aŋutrɔwo ɖana le fia la ƒe futɔwo ƒe dzime; dukɔwo dzea anyi ɖe tewò.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Wò fiazikpui la, Mawu tɔe. Anɔ anyi tegbee! Wò fiatikplɔ la nye fiatikplɔ si wɔa nu sɔsɔe.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Èlɔ̃ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, eye nèlé fu nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ. Eya tae Mawu, wò Mawu si ami na wò kple dzidzɔmi nèƒo hatiwòwo ta.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Wò awu ʋlayawo le ʋeʋẽm lílili kple lifi, pepre kpakple kotoklobo. Kasaŋkuwo doa dzidzɔ na wò le wò fiasã si wotu kple nyiɖuwo me;

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: fia vinyɔnuwo le wò nyɔnu bubumewo dome; eye fia srɔ̃ le Ofir-sikanuwo me le wò ɖusime.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: O vinyɔnu, ɖo to, nàsee, eye nàbu eŋu; ŋlɔ wò dukɔ kple tɔ́wò ƒe aƒe be,

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: eye wò tugbedzedze adze fia la ŋu. Esi wònye wò aƒetɔ ta la, bɔbɔ ɖokuiwò nɛ.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tiro-dukɔ atsɔ nunanawo adi wò amenuveve, ame siwo kpɔ kesinɔnu wu le dukɔwo me la

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: atsɔ nunɔamesi vovovowo vɛ. Wodo awu siwo wolɔ̃ kple sikanuwo na fia vinyɔnu si le eƒe xɔ me la.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Ele awu ŋɔŋɔewo me, exɔlɔ̃ ɖetugbi leaƒewoe nɔ eŋu wokplɔ yi na fia la.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ dzidzɔ kple aseyetsotso kplɔ wo ge ɖe fiasã la me.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Viwò ŋutsuwo anɔ tɔgbuiwòwo teƒe; àɖo wo amegãwoe ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mana woado wò ŋkɔ ɖe dzi le dzidzimewo katã me; eya ta dukɔwo akafu wò tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Mawu nye míaƒe sitsoƒe kple ŋusẽ, xɔnametɔ ŋutɔ wònye le xaxa me.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Eya ta mímavɔ̃ o, nenye be anyigba ʋuʋu, nenye be towo ʋuʋu le atsiaƒu titina;

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: ne eƒe tɔwo dze agbo, eye wotso futukpɔ, ne towo ʋuʋu le eƒe nyanyra me hã.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Tɔsisi aɖe li si ƒe alɔdzewo doa dzidzɔ na Mawu ƒe du, Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Mawu le eme, maʋã o; Mawu axɔ nɛ kaba le fɔŋli.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo nyra, fiaɖuƒewo lulu; eɖe gbe, anyigba lólo.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la li kpli mí; Yakob ƒe Mawu la nye míaƒe sitsoƒe.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Miva, mikpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo, ale si wòdo aƒedo anyigbae la ɖa!

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Etsia aʋawɔwɔ nu, va se ɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke; eflia dati, ŋea akplɔ, etɔa dzo tasiaɖamwo.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: “Minɔ anyi kpoo, eye minyae be nyee nye Mawu. Wodom ɖe dzi le dukɔwo dome, wodom ɖe dzi le anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la li kpli mí, Yakob ƒe Mawu la nye míaƒe sitsoƒe.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, miƒu akpe! Mido ɣli kple dzidzɔhawo bobobo na Mawu!

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Elabe ŋɔdzi le Aƒetɔ, Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋu. Fiagã ŋutɔe wònye ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Ebɔbɔ dukɔwo ɖe mía te, eye wòde anyigba dzi dukɔwo míaƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Etia míaƒe domenyinu na mí, si nye Yakob, ame si wòlɔ̃na la, ƒe adegbeƒonu.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Mawu yi dzi kple ɣli, Aƒetɔ yi dzi kple kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawue nye Fia ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi; midzi nufiameha!

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖu fia ɖe dukɔwo dzi; Mawu nɔ anyi ɖe eƒe fiazikpui kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe amegãwo ƒo ƒu abe Abraham ƒe Mawu ƒe dukɔ ene. Elabe anyigba dzi kpoxɔnuwo nye Mawu tɔ; wodoe ɖe dzi bobobo.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ lolo, edze kafukafu ŋutɔ le mía Mawu ƒe du la me! Eƒo to kɔkɔe la ta.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Enyakpɔna le kɔkɔeƒe, enye anyigba blibo la ƒe dzidzɔ, Zion-to si le dzigbeme ʋĩi ke, nye Fiagã la ƒe du.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Le eƒe fiasãwo me Mawu ɖe eɖokui fia, be yenye etaʋlila si ŋu woaɖo ŋu ɖo.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, fiawo ƒo ƒu, wo katã ho va kpe ta.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Esi wokpɔe teti ko la, ewɔ nuku na wo, dzidzi ƒo wo, eye wosí dzo.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Wodzo nyànyanya le afi ma, eye wose veve abe nyɔnu si le ku lém ene.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ ɣedzeƒeya gbã Tarsis-tɔdziʋuwo gudugudu.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Abe ale si míesee ene la, nenema míekpɔe le Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la, ƒe du la me, le mía Mawu ƒe du si wòɖo anyi tegbee la me.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Mawu, míebu tame le wò amenuveve ŋu le wò gbedoxɔ me.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Mawu, ale si wò ŋkɔ de dui la, nenemae wokafua wò yi anyigba ƒe seƒe ke. Wò nuɖusi yɔ fũu kple dziɖuɖu;

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: na Zion-to nakpɔ dzidzɔ! Na Yuda nyɔnuviwo natso aseye le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ta!

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Mizɔ ƒo xlã Zion godoo, mizɔ ƒo xlãe kpe ɖo; mixlẽ eƒe xɔ tsralawo,

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: milé ŋku ɖe eƒe gli sesẽwo ŋu, mizɔ eƒe fiasãwo me; ne miatu xo na dzidzime siwo gbɔna

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: be: Mawue nye esi, mía Mawu tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ. Eyae anye mía kplɔla yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, mise esia! Mi xexemenɔlawo katã, miɖo to,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: ame gblɔewo kple ame gãwo, kesinɔtɔwo kple ame dahewo siaa!

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Make nu aƒo nu nunyatɔe; nye dzimesusu anye gɔmesese.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Malé to ɖe lododo ŋu; maɖe nye adzo gɔme ɖe kasaŋku ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta mavɔ̃ le fukpeɣiwo me, esime yonyemetilawo ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒo xlãm,

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: ame siwo ɖoa dzi ɖe woƒe nunɔamesiwo ŋu, eye woƒoa adegbe le woƒe kesinɔnuwo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ŋu?

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, ame aɖeke mate ŋu aƒle eɖokui ta alo axe fe ɖe eƒe agbe ta na Mawu o;

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: elabe fe si wòaxe ɖe eƒe agbe ta xɔ asi, eye ga made enu gbeɖe

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: be ame nanɔ agbe kakaka, eye mayi aʋlime gbeɖe o.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Ẽ, akpɔe be nunyalawo gɔ̃ hã kuna, movitɔwo kple bometsilawo siaa atsrɔ̃, eye woagblẽ woƒe nunɔamesiwo ɖi na ame bubuwo.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Woƒe yɔdowo nye woƒe aƒe mavɔ, teƒe siwo woanɔ tso dzidzime yi dzidzime, togbɔ be woyɔ wo ŋkɔ ɖe anyigbawo ŋu be wonye woawo ŋutɔ tɔ hã.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ mate ŋu anɔ atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo me o, ele abe gbemelã siwo tsrɔ̃na la ene.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Ame siwo kana ɖe wo ɖokui dzi movitɔe la ƒe zɔzɔmee nye esia, ame siwo kpɔa ŋudzedze le ame mawo ƒe nunɔamesiwo ŋu hã ƒe nuwuwu nɔna alea.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Abe alẽwo ene la, woɖo wo ɖi na tsiẽƒe yiyi, ku anye woƒe kplɔla; woaɖi abu tẽe ayi yɔdo me, woƒe nɔnɔme anyunyɔ; tsiẽƒe anye woƒe aƒe.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu aɖe nye luʋɔ tso tsiẽƒe ƒe ŋusẽ si me, elabe axɔm.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe zu kesinɔtɔ, ne bubu le gã dom ɖe edzi le eƒe aƒe ŋu la, mègavɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Elabe ne eku la, matsɔ naneke adzoe o; eƒe bubu makplɔe ɖo ayi kplii o.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ebua eɖokui dzidzɔkpɔlae le agbe me, eye togbɔ be amewo kafua eƒe nu nyui wɔwɔ na eɖokui hã la,

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: ayi tɔgbuiawo gbɔ, ame siwo magakpɔ kekeli akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ mate ŋu anɔ atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo me o, ele abe gbemelã siwo tsrɔ̃na la ene.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la, Mawu, Aƒetɔ le nu ƒom; ƒo nu, yɔ xexea me katã tso ɣedzeƒe va se ɖe ɣetoɖoƒe.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Mawu klẽ tso Zion, tso du si nyakpɔna wu duwo katã la me.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Mía Mawu gbɔna, mezia ɖoɖoe o, dzo le bibim le eŋgɔ ahom sesẽ ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Eyɔ dziƒowo le dzime kple anyigba ɖa, ne wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eƒe dukɔ:

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: “Miƒo nye nuteƒewɔlawo nu ƒu nam, ame siwo sa vɔ tsɔ bla nu kplim.”

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Dziƒowo ɖe gbeƒã eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, elabe Mawu ŋutɔe nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la!

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: O nye dukɔ, miɖo to, mele nu ƒo ge. Israel, maɖi ɖase ɖe ŋuwò. Nyee nye Mawu, wò Mawu.

english_verse: Although you offer sacrifices and always bring gifts,
translation_verse: Nyemele nya hem ɖe ŋuwò le wò vɔsawo ta o, wò numemevɔsawo le ŋkunye me enuenu.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Nyemaxɔ nyitsu aɖeke tso aƒewò me loo, alo gbɔ̃tsu tso wò lãkpɔ me o.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Elabe gbemelã ɖe sia ɖe le ave me, nyiha le togbɛ akpewo dzi, wo katã nye tɔnye.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Dziƒoxeviwo katã le nyanya nam, eye nu siwo katã ʋãna le gbedzi la, tɔnyee.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: “Nenye dɔe le wuyem la, anye ne nyemagblɔe na wò o; elabe xexea me kple nu siwo katã le eme la, tɔnyee.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Ɖe meɖua nyitsuwo ƒe lã, alo noa gbɔ̃wo ƒe ʋua?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Tsɔ akpedada sa vɔe na Mawu, eye nàxe wò adzɔgbeɖefe na Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Yɔm le xaxagbe; ekema maɖe wò, eye nàde bubu ŋunye.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Ke Mawu gblɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi be: “Mɔ kae nèkpɔ be nàxlẽ nye ɖoɖowo afia, alo nàlé nye nubabla ɖe nu?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Elabe wò la, èlé fu amehehe, eye nètsɔ nye nyawo ƒu gbe ɖe megbewò.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Ne èkpɔ fiafitɔ la, èdzea xɔlɔ̃e, eye nèdea ha kple ahasiwɔlawo.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Wò nu gblɔa nya vɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe faa, eye wò aɖe daa alakpa.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Èbɔbɔ nɔa anyi ƒoa nu le nɔviwò ŋutsu ŋu, eye nègblẽa wò ŋutɔ nɔwò viŋutsu ŋu.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Nu siawoe nèwɔ, eye mezi ɖoɖoe; èbu be mele abe wò ke ene. Ke azɔ la, mele mo kam na wò, eye metsɔe le ŋkuwò me ɖom.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: “De dzesi nu sia azɔ, wò ame si ŋlɔ Mawu be, ne menye nenema o la, mavuvu nu, eye ame aɖeke manɔ anyi aɖe ame o.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ akpedada sa vɔe la, dea bubu ŋunye; ame si da eɖokui ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe mɔ dzi la, eyae maɖe Mawu ƒe xɔname afia!”

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Mawu, ve nunye le wò amenuveve nu; le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔgbɔ la nu, tutu nye dzidadawo ɖa.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Le tsi nam keŋkeŋ tso nye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me, eye klɔ nye nuvɔ̃ ɖa le ŋunye!

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Elabe menya nye dzidadawo, eye nye nuvɔ̃ le ŋkunye me ɖaa.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Wò ko ŋue, wò ɖeka ko ŋue mewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖo, eye nu si vɔ̃ɖi le ŋkuwò me lae mewɔ, ale tɔwò adzɔ le wò nyametsotso me, eye mokaka manɔ wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ŋu o.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me wodzim ɖo, eye nuvɔ̃ mee nɔnye fɔ nye fu ɖo.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nyateƒe si tso ememe kee nèdina; eya ta fia nunyam le nye dzi ƒe gogloƒe ke.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Kɔ ŋunye kple hisɔp, eye ŋunye akɔ; le tsi nam, eye mafu wu ɖetifu.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Na dzidzɔ kple aseyetsotso nayɔm taŋ; na ƒu siwo nèŋe la natso aseye.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Ŋe aɖaba ƒu nye nuvɔ̃wo dzi, eye tutu nye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo katã ɖa.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Mawu, wɔ dzi dzadzɛ aɖe nam, eye de gbɔgbɔ yeye dzɔdzɔe menye.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔm ƒu gbe le ŋkuwò me o, eye mègaxɔ wò Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la le asinye o.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Gaɖo dzidzɔ si le wò xɔname me la te nam, eye nàlém ɖe asi kple gbɔgbɔ si me lɔlɔ̃nu le la.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Ekema mafia wò mɔwo sedzidalawo, eye nuvɔ̃wɔlawo atrɔ ava gbɔwò.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: O Mawu, ɖem tso ʋukɔkɔɖi ƒe fɔɖiɖi me, wò, nye xɔname ƒe Mawu, eye nye aɖe adzi ha sesĩe le wò ɖeɖe ŋu.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ke nye nuyiwo, eye nye nu aɖe gbeƒã wò kafukafu.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Vɔsa si dzea Mawu ŋue nye gbɔgbɔ si bɔbɔ eɖokui; o Mawu, màdo vlo dzi gbagbã si tugu la o.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyui na Zion le ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ nyui la nu; gbugbɔ ɖo Yerusalem-gliwo,

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: ekema vɔsa dzɔdzɔewo, numemevɔsawo kple vɔsa deblibowo, adze ŋuwò; ekema woatsɔ nyitsuwo asa vɔe le wò vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu kalẽtɔ, nu ka ta nànɔ adegbe ƒom le nu gbegblẽ si nèwɔ ɖe mawuvɔ̃lawo ŋuti?

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Nugbegblẽ ƒe nugbe ko ɖom nèle le ŋkeke bliboa me. Wò aɖe le abe talũhɛ ɖaɖɛ ene, wò ayemenuwɔla.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Èlɔ̃ nuvɔ̃ɖi wu nu nyui kple aʋatsokaka wu nyateƒe.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: O alakpaɖe! Èlɔ̃ nya siwo katã gblẽa nu.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu agbã wò tegbee; ahe wò tso wò agbadɔ me avuvu; aho wò kple ke atso agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla akpɔe, avɔ̃, eye wòakoe agblɔ be:

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ŋutsu si metsɔ Mawu wɔ eƒe sitsoƒee o, ke boŋ wòɖo dzi ɖe eƒe kesinɔnu gbogboawo ŋu, eye wòtsɔ eƒe nunɔamesiwo wɔ eƒe sitsoƒee la ɖa!”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ke nyea mele abe amiti dama ene le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me. Meɖoa ŋu ɖe Mawu ƒe amenuveve ŋu tegbetegbee.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Mada akpe na wò yi mavɔ me, elabe wòe wɔe. Maɖe gbeƒã wò ŋkɔ, elabe enyo, le mawuvɔ̃lawo ŋkume.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Movitɔ gblɔna le eƒe dzime be: “Mawu aɖeke meli o.” Wowɔa nu fitifiti, wowɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo nyɔa ŋu la; ame aɖeke meli si wɔa nu nyui o.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Mawu kpɔ amegbetɔ viwo ɖa tso dziƒo be yeakpɔ ɖa be ame nyanu aɖe li si biaa Mawu ta sena mahã?

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Wo katã wosa ɖe aga; wo katã wogblẽ keŋ. Ame aɖeke meli si wɔa nu nyui o; gbeɖe, ɖeka pɛ hã meli o.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Ɖe nu vlo wɔla siawo gbe nugɔmesese, ame siwo ɖua nye dukɔmeviwo abe ale si woɖua aboloe ene, eye wogbe Mawu subɔsubɔa?

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ wo ɖa, wole ŋɔdzi gã me, ŋɔdzi si ƒomevi menɔ anyi kpɔ o! Elabe Mawu akaka mawumavɔ̃lawo ƒe ƒuwo; woado ŋukpe wo, elabe Mawu gbe wo.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: O ko ɖeɖe natso Zion ava na Israel ɖe! Ne Mawu agaɖo eƒe dukɔ ƒe nunyonamewo te la, Yakob atso aseye, eye Israel akpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: O Mawu, le wò ŋkɔ la ta, xɔ nam; tso afia nam kple wò ŋusẽ.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: O Mawu, se nye gbedodoɖa; lé to ɖe nye numenyawo ŋu.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Elabe amemabulawo tso ɖe ŋunye, eye ŋutasẽlawo le nye agbe yome tim; womele Mawu ŋu bum o.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawue nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ, Aƒetɔ lae lé nye agbe ɖe te.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Atsɔ vɔ̃ aɖo eteƒe na nye futɔwo; le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ la me, tsrɔ̃ wo ɖa.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Masa vɔ na wò kple lɔlɔ̃nu faa; Aƒetɔ, mada akpe na wò ŋkɔ, elabe enyo.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Elabe wòe ɖem tso fukpekpe ɖe sia ɖe me, eye nye ŋku kpɔe, meɖu nye futɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Mawu, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye mègaɣla ɖokuiwò ɖe nye kokoƒoƒo o.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Lé to ɖe ŋunye, eye nàtɔ nam; nye fukpekpe kpe dzinye. Metɔtɔ

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le veve helihelĩ sem le menye, eye ku le ŋɔdzi dom nam.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ ɖom mele dzodzom nyànyanya, ŋɔdzi lém keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Mebe: “Ao, ɖe aʋala anɔ asinye abe ahɔnɛ ene ɖe! Madzo ayi aɖagbɔ ɖe eme.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: Ẽ, mayi didiƒe aɖe ke aɖatsa, maɖadze gbedadaƒo.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Mawɔ kaba adi beɖoƒe na ɖokuinye así le yaƒoƒo sesẽ kple ahom nu.”

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, gblẽ woƒe ɖoɖowo, eye nàtɔtɔ woƒe gbe; elabe mekpɔ ŋutasesẽ kple avuwɔwɔ le dua me.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Zã kple keli wole dua ƒe gliwo dzi le xlã ƒom, eye nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ kple fuɖename li.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Gbegblẽ le eme, ameteteɖeanyi kple amebaba le eƒe asì me.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Ɖe wònye futɔ aɖee le vlo domem la, anye ne mado dzi atsɔe; menye nye ketɔe le amemabumabunu wɔm ɖe ŋunye o, anye ne mate ŋu abè le egbɔ.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Ke wò, nye zɔhɛ, nye evelia, xɔ̃nye si menya nyuie lae.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Míawoe wɔa ɖeka ɖoa dze viviwo, míezɔa afɔ ɖeka yia Mawu ƒeme tsã.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Na ku Saɖagatsi naɖo agba me na wo; na woayi tsiẽƒe agbagbe, na ŋɔdzi nakplɔ wo ayi woƒe yɔdowo me.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ke nyea meyɔ Mawu, eye Aƒetɔ axɔ nam.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Le fiẽ, ŋdi kple ŋdɔ la, meɖe hũ, fa konyi, eye ase nye gbe.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Aɖe nye luʋɔ manɔ dedie tso aʋa si wɔm mele la me, elabe ame geɖe tso ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Mawu aɖo tom, eye wòabɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi, eya ame si le fia ɖum tso blema ke; elabe womewɔa se aɖeke dzi o, eye womevɔ̃a Mawu o.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Nye evelia da kɔ xɔlɔ̃a, eye wòtu eƒe nubabla la.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Eƒe nuƒo zrɔ̃ dredredrẽ wu notsi babla; ke eɖo aʋawɔwɔ ɖe dzime, eƒe nyawo le bɔlɔbɔlɔ wu ami; ke wole abe yi si wohe ɖe go ene.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Dro wò agba ɖe Aƒetɔ dzi, eye akpɔ tawò. Maɖe mɔ be woaɖe ame dzɔdzɔe ɖa o.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Ke wò, Mawu, àtsɔ wo aƒu gbe ɖe ʋe goglotɔ me. Ʋukɔɖilawo kple ayemenuwɔlawo manɔ woƒe agbe ƒe afã hã o. Ke nye la maɖo dzi ɖe ŋuwò!

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Mawu, ve nunye, elabe amewo fanyam ɖe to; ŋutsu futɔwo tem ɖe anyi ŋkeke bliboa,

english_verse: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
translation_verse: nye futɔwo fanyam ŋkeke bliboa elabe ame geɖe le avu wɔm kplim dàdatɔe.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Ne vɔvɔ̃ ɖom la, meɖoa dzi ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si ƒe nya mekafuna, meɖoa dzi ɖe Mawu ŋu vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee. Nu kae ŋutilã ate ŋu awɔm?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Wodi be yewoagblẽ nu me nam ŋkeke bliboa; tame vɔ̃e sɔŋ ko ɖom wole ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Woƒo ƒu, kpe ta, de xa ɖi, wole ŋku lém ɖe nye afɔtoƒe ŋu. Ale si wole nye ku dim la,

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: ɖo eteƒe na wo ɖe woƒe hlɔ̃nuwɔwɔ nu nenema ke. O Mawu, xlã dukɔwo ɖe anyi le wò dɔmedzoe me!

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Wòe nya akɔnta le nye dablibɛƒoƒo ŋu; kɔ nye aɖatsiwo ɖe wò atukpa me! Ɖe mele wò agbalẽ me oa?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Ekema woagbugbɔ nye futɔwo ɖe megbe gbe si gbe meyɔ wò la. Menya esia be Mawu le dzinye.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si ŋu meɖoa dzi ɖo vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee, nu kae amegbetɔ ate ŋu awɔm?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: O Mawu, edze be mawɔ nye adzɔgbeɖeɖe dzi na wò; matsɔ akpedadavɔsa na wò.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Elabe èɖe nye luʋɔ tso ku me, ẽ, nye afɔ tso anyidzedze me, be mazɔ le Mawu ŋkume le agbe ƒe kekeli me.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nublanui nam, o Mawu, mebe kpɔ nublanui nam, elabe mewòe nye nye luʋɔ ƒe sitsoƒe, va se ɖe esi ahom gblẽnu la nu nava yi.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Adɔ ame ɖa tso dziƒo ne woaxɔ nam, ana ŋu nakpe ame siwo le fanyayem ɖe anyigba. Mawu adɔ eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖa!

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Memlɔ anyi ɖe dzata siwo haa amegbetɔ viwo hevuvua wo la dome; woƒe aɖewo nye akplɔwo kple aŋutrɔwo, woƒe aɖewo nye yi ɖaɖɛwo.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Mawu, kɔ ɖokuiwò dzi gbɔ dziƒowo ta! Na wò ŋutikɔkɔe naxɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Woɖo ɖɔ ɖe nye toƒe; wote nye luʋɔ ɖe to. Woɖe ʋe ɖe mɔ dzi nam, ke woawo ŋutɔ ge dze eme.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le tenu, o Mawu, nye dzi le tenu! Madzi ha kple gbe vivi!

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ, nyɔ! Minyɔ, o kasaŋku kple saŋku! Manyɔ fɔŋli!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mada akpe na wò le dukɔwo dome; madzi kafukafuha na wò le anyigba dzi dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Elabe wò amenuveve lolo ɖatɔ dziƒo, wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖatɔ alilikpowo.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu kɔ ɖokuiwò dzi gbɔ dziƒowo ta! Na wò ŋutikɔkɔe naxɔ anyigba blibo la dzi!

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Mi mawuwo, nyateƒe wònye be miedea se dzɔdzɔewoa? Ɖe miedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe na amegbetɔ viwoa?

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Ao, le miaƒe dzime la, mieɖoa nu tovo, mietsɔ miaƒe asi wɔa ŋutasesẽnu le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tra mɔ tso dɔ me ke, tso woƒe dzigbe, wodaa vo, daa alakpa.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Aɖi le wo si abe da ƒe aɖi ene, wole abe dakpui si ƒe to ku la ene,

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: ale be womesea gbesala ƒe gbesa o, eye dzotɔ ayetɔ aɖeke mekpea wo dzi o.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Ao Mawu, ŋe woƒe aɖuwo le woƒe nu me. Ao Aƒetɔ, klí dzataviwo ƒe tsyowo!

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Na wo nu nayi abe tsisisi ene; na woaɖo afɔ wo dzi abe gbe ene ne woayrɔ.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Na woanyi abe abɔbɔe tre va yi ene, eye woanɔ abe fu gege si mekpɔ ɣe kpɔ o la ene.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Hafi aŋɔkadzo nabi alé miaƒe zewo la, na woaya wo ɖa abe gbe mumu, alo esi le dzo bim la ene.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe akpɔ dzidzɔ ne ekpɔ hlɔ̃biabia; aklɔ eƒe afɔwo ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ʋu me.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Amewo agblɔ be: “Nyateƒee, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo akpɔ woƒe fetu; nyateƒee, Mawu aɖe li si drɔ̃a ʋɔnu le anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo si me, eye xɔm tso ʋutsikɔwuawo si me.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, wode xa ɖe nye agbe ŋu; ame wɔadãwo ƒo ƒu, kpe ta ɖe ŋunye. Aƒetɔ, menye le nye dzidada, alo le nye nuvɔ̃ aɖeke tae o

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: elabe menye le vodada aɖeke ta wole du dzi hedzra ɖo o. Wò ŋutɔ tso nàva kpɔ ɖa, eye kpe ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Wò Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la, wòe nye Israel ƒe Mawu. Nyɔ ne nàhe to na dukɔwo katã, mègaɖe ayemenuwɔla siwo le nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖom la dometɔ aɖeke le eme o.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Wotrɔna fiẽ sia fiẽ nɔa wòwóm abe avuwo ene, eye wonɔa tsatsam nɔa xlã ƒom du la.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Kpɔ wo ɖa, nyagbe, nyagbewo le dodom le wo nu, wonyre woƒe nuyiwo ɖaɖɛ, elabe wobu be: “Ame kae ase mía ŋkɔ?”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Gake wò Aƒetɔ la, ɖeko nèle wo kom dukɔwo katã ɖi kokoe le gbɔwò.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Nye ŋusẽ, madzi kafukafuha na wò, elabe wò Mawu, ènye nye mɔ́.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu ado gom le eƒe amenuveve me; nye Mawu ana makpɔ nye futɔ siwo dzi meɖu.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Mègawu wo o, ne menye nenema o la, nye dukɔ ava ŋlɔ be; tsɔ wò ŋusẽ nyà wo woazu tsa glãla tsalawo, o Aƒetɔ, mía akpoxɔnu, ɖiɖi wo ɖe anyi!

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: fiã wo le dɔmedzoe me, fiã wo va se ɖe esime woavɔ ɖa, ne amewo nadze sii be Mawue ɖu fia ɖe Yakob dzi va se ɖe anyigba ƒe seƒe ke.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Wotrɔna fiẽ sia fiẽ nɔa wòwóm abe avuwo ene, eye wonɔa nu dim nɔa xlã ƒom du la.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Wonɔa tsatsam nɔa nuɖuɖu dim, ne womeɖi ƒo o la, wonɔa gbe tem.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ke nye la madzi ha le wò ŋusẽ ŋu; madzi ha bobobo le ŋdi le wò amenuveve ŋu. Elabe mɔ́ nènye nam kple sitsoƒe nam le nye xaxagbe.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Madzi kafukafuha na wò, nye Ŋusẽ elabe wò Mawu, ènye nye mɔ́, Mawu si ɖe amenuveve fiam.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Mawu, ègbe mí, èkaka kpɔ le mía ŋu, èkpɔ dziku ɖe mía ŋu; ao, gagbugbɔ mí ɖo te dzro.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Wòe na anyigba la ʋuʋu, wòe na wòfe ke nu me; gatre eƒe gbagbãƒewo, elabe ele ʋuʋum.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Wòe na wò dukɔ la to nu sesẽwo me; wòe na wain mí be míano, eye míemu le yiyim sagasaga.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Wòe tu aflaga na ame siwo vɔ̃a wò, ne woasí le aŋutrɔ nu.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Ale be woaɖe ame siwo nèlɔ̃ la, kɔ wò nuɖusi dzi ne míakpɔ dziɖuɖu, eye nàtɔ na mí.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒo nu le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la be: “Makpɔ dzidzɔ, mama Sixem, eye mama Sukot Bali la.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Tɔnyee nye Gilead; tɔnyee nye Manase; Efrayim nye nye gakuku; nye fiatikplɔe nye Yuda.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab nye nye tsileze; meɖe nye afɔkpa da ɖe Edom, medo dziɖuɣli ɖe Filistitɔwo ŋu.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Ame ka akplɔm yi du sesẽ la mee? Ame kae akplɔm yi Edom?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Kpe ɖe mía ŋu ne míaɖu míaƒe futɔwo dzi, elabe gbetɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu menye naneke o!

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Míaƒe kalẽwɔwɔ tso Mawu gbɔ; eyae afanya míaƒe ketɔwo.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mawu, se nye ɣlidodo, lé to ɖe nye gbedodoɖa ŋu;

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: mele yɔwòm tso anyigba seƒe ke, esime nye dzi gbɔdzɔ. Kplɔm yi agakpe si kɔ wum la dzi;

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: elabe wòe nye nye sitsoƒe, xɔ tsrala sesẽ ɖe futɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Na manɔ wò agbadɔ me tegbee! O, ne manɔ dedie le wò aʋala te!

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Elabe wò, Mawu, èse nye adzɔgbeɖeɖewo, wòe tsɔ ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la ƒe domenyinu la nam.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Na fia la nanɔ agbe didi; eƒe ƒewo netso dzidzime yi dzidzime!

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Neɖu fia le Mawu ŋkume tegbee; wò amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ nekpɔ eta!

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Ale madzi ha na wò ŋkɔ ɖaa, ne mele nye adzɔgbeɖefewo xem tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ zi ɖoɖoe kpoo na Mawu ɖeɖe ko, le esi nu kpɔm; eya gbɔe nye xɔname tso.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Eya koe nye nye agakpe kple nye xɔname, nye mɔ́; nyemaʋã akpa o.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣie mi katã miadze ame ɖeka dzi, be yewoagbãe abe gli si le mumum ene, abe kpɔ vuvu ene?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Ɖeko woɖoe be yewoatutui ƒu anyi tso eƒe ɖoƒe kɔkɔ la. Wokpɔa dzidzɔ le aʋatsokaka ŋu. Wokea nu yraa ame, ke woƒoa fi dea ame le dzime.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ zi ɖoɖoe kpoo na Mawu ɖeɖe ko, le esi nu kpɔm; elabe nye mɔkpɔkpɔ tso eyama gbɔ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Eya koe nye nye agakpe kple nye xɔname, nye mɔ́; womaʋuʋum o.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Nye ɖeɖe kple bubu tso Mawu gbɔ. Nye agakpe sesẽ, nye sitsoƒe, nye Mawu.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔ la, miɖo dzi ɖe eŋu ɣeawo katã ɣi; migblɔ miaƒe dzimenyawo nɛ; Mawu nye sitsoƒe na mí.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Ame gblɔewo le ko abe yagbɔgbɔ ene, ame ŋkutawo nye ameflulawo; le nudanuwo dzi la, woyia dzi; wo kple eve la siaa le wodzoe wu yagbɔgbɔ.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Migaɖo dzi ɖe amebaba ŋu o, miaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ dzodzro meganɔ adzodada ŋu o. Ne kesinɔnu dzi ɖe edzi la, migatsɔ miaƒe dzi ku ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Mawu ƒo nu zi ɖeka, mesee zi eve be: Mawu tɔe nye ŋusẽ,

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: eye Aƒetɔ la tɔe nye amenuveve. Elabe wòe ɖoa eteƒe na amegbetɔ ɖe eƒe dɔwɔna nu.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Mawu, wòe nye nye Mawu, mele diwòm; èzu tsikɔ le nye luʋɔ wum, nye ŋutilã gbɔdzɔ le tawò abe kuɖiɖinyigba si ƒu kplákplakpla, eye tsi aɖeke mele edzi o la ene.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ale mekpɔ wò ɖa le kɔkɔeƒe la, kpɔ wò ŋusẽ kple ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Elabe wò amenuveve nyo wu agbe, nye nuyiwo akafu wò.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Ale makafu wò zi ale si mele agbe; mawu nye asiwo dzi ayɔ wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ ɖu ƒutomemi kple lãmi ɖi ƒo, eye nye nu atsɔ aseyetsonuyiwo akafu wò,

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: esime mele ŋuwò bum le nye aba dzi, hele ŋugble dem le ŋuwò zã bliboa la;

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: elabe wòe nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ, eye wò aʋala ƒe vɔvɔli tee medziaa ha le kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ ku ɖe ŋuwò; wò nuɖusie lém ɖe asi.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo le didim be yewoagblẽ nye agbe la, ayi keke anyigba tume ke;

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: woatsɔ wo de asi na yi ƒe ŋusẽ, woazu akpatakuwo ƒe nulélewo.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Ke fia la, akpɔ dzidzɔ le Mawu me; ame siwo katã kaa atam le eŋkɔ me la akafui; elabe woatsyɔ asi nu na alakpatɔwo.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Mawu, se nye gbe, le nye konyifafa me; dzra nye agbe ɖo tso futɔ la ƒe ŋɔdzidoname me.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Ɣlam tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nugbe si woɖo le adzame la gbɔ, tso nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ƒe tameɖoɖo vɔ̃wo me.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Ame siwo nyre woƒe aɖe abe yi ene, ame siwo daa nya vevewo ame abe aŋutrɔwo ene,

english_verse: They fearlessly ambush and shoot innocent people.
translation_verse: wodea xa daa nu ame maɖifɔ, wodanɛ kpata vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Woléa woƒe taɖodzinuvɔ̃ɖi la ɖe asi goŋgoŋ; woƒoa nu tso ale si woatre mɔ̀wo le adzame ŋu, hegblɔna na wo ɖokui be: “Ame kae ate ŋu akpɔ mí?

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Ame kae aku míaƒe hlɔ̃donuwo gɔme? Míedze aye ŋutɔ le míaƒe nugbeɖoɖowo me.” Elabe amegbetɔ ƒe susu kple dzime goglo.

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ada eƒe aŋutrɔ wo, woaxɔ abi enumake.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Atsrɔ̃ wo le woƒe aɖe ta; ame siwo katã kpɔ wo la, aʋuʋu ta.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Ekema amewo katã avɔ̃; woaxlẽ nu si Mawu wɔ la fia, eye woabu nu si wòwɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Mina nuteƒewɔlawo nakpɔ dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye woabe ɖe egbɔ! Mina ame siwo katã ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka la, nakafui!

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Kafukafu ye dze na wò, o Mawu, si le Zion, eye wòe woaxe adzɔgbeɖefewo na,

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: wò ame si sea gbedodoɖa! Gbɔwòe ŋutilãwo katã aɖo tae

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: le nuvɔ̃wo ta. Ne míaƒe dzidadawo wu tsɔtsɔ na mí, wòe tsɔa wo kena.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si nètia, eye nèhee vɛ be wòanɔ wò xɔxɔnuwo! Míaɖi ƒo kple nu nyui siwo le wò aƒeme, wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me!

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖo to mí, wɔ nu dziŋɔwo, tsɔ ɖe míi, o míaƒe xɔname ƒe Mawu; wòe nye mɔkpɔkpɔ na anyigba ƒe seƒewo katã kple atsiaƒu siwo le didiƒe ʋĩi la.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖo towo gɔme anyi kple wò ŋusẽ, eye nètsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzi;

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: wòe na ƒu dzeagbowo zi ɖoɖoe, ƒutsotsoewo ƒe hoowɔwɔ kple dukɔwo ƒe ʋunyaʋunya nu tsi;

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: ale be ame siwo le anyigba ƒe seƒe ke vɔ̃na na wò dzesiwo; wòe nana be agudzedze kple zãdodo kpɔa dzidzɔ doa ɣli.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Wòe va kpɔ anyigba ɖa, eye nède tsii; wòe na wode ami nyuie. Mawu ƒe tɔsisi ɖɔ gbagba; wòe nana be wokpɔa woƒe bli elabe nenemae nèɖoe.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Wòe dea tsi kpoawo dome nyuie, eye kpoawo dzea anyi agbafie naa anyigba bɔbɔna, eye nèyraa nukuwo ƒe tsitsi.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Ƒe la wua enu kple wò nuku gbogboawo; wò tasiaɖamwo ƒe toƒewo tsyɔa lãwo ƒe ami.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: alẽhawo nye tsyɔ lãnyiƒewo, baliwo yɔ fũu kple bli ʋaʋãwo, wo katã wole aseye tsom le ha dzim.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Mi anyigbawo katã, mido dzidzɔɣli ɖe Mawu ŋu;

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: midzi ha si de bubu eŋkɔ ŋu; mitsɔ bubu kple kafukafu nɛ!

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Migblɔ na Mawu be: “Wò nuwɔwɔwo dzi ŋɔ loo! Wò ŋusẽ triakɔ ale gbegbe be ɖeko wò futɔwo ade ta agu le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Anyigba blibo la subɔa wò; wodzia kafukafuha na wò, wodzia kafukafuha na wò ŋkɔ.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Miva kpɔ nu si Mawu wɔ la ɖa: ewɔ nu dziŋɔwo le amegbetɔwo dome.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Etrɔ atsiaƒu wòzu anyigba ƒuƒui, amewo zɔ afɔ to tɔsisi la me. Afi mae míekpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe eŋu le,

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: ele dzi ɖum tegbee kple ŋusẽ, ele ŋku lém ɖe dukɔwo ŋu, aglãdzelawo megado wo ɖokui ɖe dzi o.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo, mikafu mía Mawu la, mina eƒe kafukafu naɖi woase;

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: eyae na míele agbe, eye mena míaƒe afɔwo ɖiɖi o.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: O Mawu, elabe èdo mí kpɔ; wòe do mí kpɔ abe ale si wolóloa klosaloe ene.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Wòe kplɔ mí de ɖɔ me, wòe dro fukpekpe ɖe ali dzi na mí.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Wòe na amewo do sɔ to mía dzi; míeto dzo me, to tɔ me; ke èkplɔ mí va da ɖe teƒe keklẽ.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Matsɔ numemevɔsa ava aƒewò mee; maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe na wò,

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Matsɔ lã damiwo awɔ numemevɔsa na wò, agbowo ƒe vɔsa si tu dzudzɔ mee matsɔ nyitsuwo kple gbɔ̃wo asa vɔ na wò le.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Mi mawuvɔ̃lawo katã miva see ɖa, eye maxlẽ nu si wòwɔ nam la fia.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli yɔe, eye eƒe kafukafu nɔ nye aɖe dzi.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ doa dzidzɔ nam le nye dzime la, anye ne Aƒetɔ la agbe toɖoɖom.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Ke le nyateƒe me la, Mawu see, elé to ɖe nye gbedodoɖa ŋu.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu, elabe megbe nye gbedodoɖa loo, alo te eƒe amenuveve ɖa le gbɔnye o.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Mawu neve mía nu, neyra mí, eye nena eƒe mo naklẽ na mí,

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: ne woadze si wò mɔwo le anyigba dzi kple wò xɔname ƒe ŋusẽ le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: O Mawu, na dukɔwo nakafu wò; na dukɔwo katã nakafu wò!

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Na dukɔwo nakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woadzi aseyetsohawo, elabe wòe drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dukɔwo ɖe eteƒe, eye nèkplɔa dukɔwo le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: O Mawu, na dukɔwo nakafu wò; na dukɔwo katã nakafu wò!

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Anyigba la ƒe kutsetsewo dzi ɖe edzi; Mawu, mía Mawu la yra mí.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Mawu yra mí; mina anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo katã navɔ̃e!

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Mina Mawu neho, mina eƒe futɔwo naka hlẽ; mina ame siwo lé fui la nasí le eŋgɔ.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Nyà wo ɖa abe ale si wogbɔa dzudzɔ ɖae ene; abe ale si dzo lóloa anyiŋɔe ene la, na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo natsrɔ̃ ɖa nenema le Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Ke na ne nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo nakpɔ dzidzɔ; na woatso aseye le Mawu ŋkume; na woaglí kple dzidzɔ!

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Mawu, midzi ha kafu eŋkɔ; ha neɖi bobobo na eya, ame si zɔa alilikpowo dzi. Eŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, mitso aseye le eŋkume.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Mawu si le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe lae nye tɔ́ na tsyɔ̃eviwo, eye wòkpɔa ahosiwo ta.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Mawue nana be ame siwo tsi akogo la kpɔa aƒe si me woanɔ; ekplɔa gamenɔlawo, eye nu dzea edzi na wo; ke aglãdzelawo nɔa kuɖiɖinyigba dzi.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: O Mawu, esi nèdze wò dukɔ ŋgɔ, eye nèɖe afɔ to gbedadaƒo la,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: anyigba ʋuʋu, eye dziƒowo dza tsi, le wò, Mawu ŋkume; anyigba si le Sinai godo hã ʋuʋu le Mawu, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ŋkume.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: O Mawu, wòe nana be tsi dzana fũu ɖe gbe ta; wòe gbɔ agbe wò domenyinu esime wònɔ nu xam.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Wò alẽha kpɔ nɔƒe le edzi; o Mawu, le wò nyonyo ta èna nu hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ɖe gbe; ame siwo tsɔ gbedeasia yii la sɔ gbɔ fũu. Wobe:

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Aʋakɔwo ƒe fiawo sí, wosí!” Nyɔnu siwo le aƒea me ma aboyonuwo.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Togbɔ be lãkpɔ me wole hã la, wonɔ abe ahɔnɛ ƒe aʋala, siwo ŋu wofa klosalo ɖo, eye woƒe fu sesẽwo klẽ ŋleŋleŋle kple sika la ene.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Esime Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la kaka fiawo hlẽ le afi ma la, tsikpe dza le Zalmon dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: O Basan-to, to sesẽ; o Basan-to, to si tame tsutsɔẽƒe geɖewo le!

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta wò to si tame tsutsɔẽƒe geɖewo le nèbiã ŋu to si Mawu di be yeatsɔ wɔ nɔƒee la? Ẽ, afi si Aƒetɔ anɔ tegbee la?

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la tsɔ tasiaɖam sesẽwo, akpe ewo teƒe eve, akpe nanewoe wòtsɔ tso Sinai va kɔkɔeƒe lae.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Èlia to kɔkɔ la, ame siwo nèɖe aboyoe la nɔ yowòme, eye nèxɔ nunanawo le amewo si, aglãdzelawo gɔ̃ hã nae, ale be Aƒetɔ, Mawu la nanɔ afi ma.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ la, ame si lé mí ɖe asi gbe sia gbe; Mawue nye mía xɔname.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Mía Mawu la, xɔname ƒe Mawu wònye, eye Aƒetɔ Mawu lae aɖe mí tso ku si me.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu agbã ta na eƒe futɔwo, ɖa ʋlaya tɔ si le yiyim kple fɔɖiɖi.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la be: “Matrɔ wo agbɔe tso Basan, magbugbɔ wo agbɔe tso atsiaƒu ƒe gogloƒe ke,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: ale be miazɔ woƒe ʋu me, eye miaƒe avuwo ƒe aɖewo nakpɔ wo tɔ gome tso ketɔ la gbɔ.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: O Mawu, wole wò bubuzɔli la kpɔm, nye Mawu kple nye Fia ƒe azɔlizɔzɔ yi kɔkɔeƒe la, kpɔm;

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: hadzilawo le ŋgɔ, saŋkuƒolawo xe megbe, eye ɖetugbi axatsɛƒolawo le titina.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: “Mikafu Mawu le ameha gã la dome, o Aƒetɔ, wò si nye Israel ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo la!”

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Benyamin, woƒe suetɔ le ŋgɔ na wo, Yuda-megãwo kple woƒe ame gbogboawo, Zebulon-megãwo kple Naftali-megãwo.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Le wò gbedoxɔ si le Yerusalem ta la, fiawo tsɔa nunanawo vanɛ na wò.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Blu ɖe gbemelã siwo le aƒlawo me ta; blu ɖe nyitsuwo ƒe ha kpe ɖe nyivi siwo nye wò dukɔwo tɔ la ta. Nya avuzi le ame siwo adzɔxɔxɔ doa dzidzɔ na la dzi; kaka dukɔ siwo lɔ̃a aʋawɔwɔ la hlẽ.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Mina woatsɔ akɔbli tso Egipte vɛ; mina Etiopiatɔwo nawɔ kaba akɔ asi dzi na Mawu.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
