translation_verse: Mi anyigba dzi fiaɖuƒewo, midzi ha na Mawu; midzi kafukafuha na Aƒetɔ la.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Midzii na eya ame si zɔna le dziƒowo, le blemadziƒowo; kpɔ ɖa, eɖe gbe, eƒe gbe gã la ɖi.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Miɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ, ame si ɖu fia ɖe Israel dzi, eye eƒe ŋusẽ dzéna le alilikpowo me.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi le Mawu ŋu le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la; Israel ƒe Mawu la, eyae na ŋusẽ kple ŋutete eƒe dukɔ la. Woakafu Mawu!

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: O Mawu, xɔ nam! Elabe mese ve le tɔ me.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Meɖi ɖe ba finyafinya me, afi si nye afɔ metsɔ anyigba le o; mege ɖe tɔ ƒe gogloƒe, eye tsi ɖɔ va to dzinye.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli ʋuu ɖeɖi te ŋunye; nye gbe me xe. Mekpɔ mɔ na nye Mawu kakaka, nye ŋkuwo dzi wɔ flukpee.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Ame siwo lé fum dzodzro la, sɔ gbɔ wu nye taɖa. Ame siwo di be yewoatsrɔ̃m, alakpatɔ siwo tso ɖe ŋunye la, triakɔ. Azɔ ɖe maɖo nu si nyemefi o la teƒea?

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: Mawu, wòe nya nye bometsitsi; nye vodadawo mele ɣaɣla ɖe wò o.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Elabe tawòe mele vlododo tsɔm, eye ŋukpe lém ɖo.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Mezu amedzro na nɔvinyewo kple ame manyamanya na nɔnye viŋutsuwo.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Elabe ale si meʋã ŋui ɖe wò aƒe la ŋu la xɔ menye keŋkeŋ, eye ame siwo le dzuwòm la ƒe dzuwo lɔm ɖe eme.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Esi mebɔbɔ ɖokuinye tsi nu dɔ la, ezu alɔmeɖeɖe le ŋunye.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Esi meta akpanya abe avɔ ene la, mezu hamelo na wo.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Dutakpeƒenɔlawo le dua ƒe agbo nu le nu ƒom le ŋunye, eye ahanomunɔwo kpa ha dem.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Ke wò Aƒetɔ ye medoa gbe ɖa na. O Mawu, le ɣeyiɣi si dze ŋuwò, le wò amenuveve si gbã go me la, tɔ nam. Kpe ɖe ŋunye nyateƒetɔe,

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: ɖem tso ba finyafinya me; na makpɔ ɖeɖe tso nye futɔwo si me kple tɔ goglowo me.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Mègana tɔɖɔɖɔ la nasí to dzinye loo, alo matsi tɔ goglo me loo, alo yɔdo nagamia nu ɖe dzinye o.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, tɔ nam, elabe wò amenuveve nyo; le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔgbɔ la nu, trɔ ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mègaɣla wò ŋkume ɖe wò dɔla o, elabe meɖo xaxa me; netsɔ nàtɔ nam.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Te ɖe ŋunye, ɖem ɖe gam le nye futɔwo ta!

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Wòe nya ale si wole alɔ me ɖem le ŋunye, le ŋukpe domem, hele vlo domem; nye futɔwo katã le nyanya na wò.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Dzu gbã nye dzi, ale mebu mɔkpɔkpɔ. Medi ame si akpɔ nublanui nam, ke ɖeke meli o, eye medi akɔfalawo, ke nyemekpɔ ɖeke o.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ aɖi nam ɖe nuɖuɖu teƒe, eye esi tsikɔ wum la, wotsɔ aha tsitsi nam be mano.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Na woawo ŋutɔ ƒe kplɔ̃ si le woƒe akɔ me nazu ɖɔ, na woƒe ŋkekenyuiwo nazu mɔ̀, aɖe wo.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dɔmedzoe kɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye ɖe wò dziku helihelĩ ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Na woƒe asaɖawo nazu aƒedo, mègana ame aɖeke nanɔ woƒe agbadɔwo me o.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Elabe woti ame si nèƒo la yome, eye ame si ŋu nède abii la, wogawɔ nu vevii ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: He to na wo, nàgahee na wo ake; mègaɖe asi le wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Tutu wo ŋkɔ ɖa le agbagbeawo ƒe agbalẽ me; mègana woaŋlɔ wo ŋkɔ ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo dome o.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Ke nye la, nu vevi wɔm, eye mele veve sem. O Mawu, na wò xɔname nakɔm ɖe dzi!

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Matsɔ hadzidzi akafu Mawu ŋkɔ; madoe ɖe dzi kple akpedada.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Esia adze Aƒetɔ ŋu wu nyi tata, alo nyitsu si to dzo glama, eye afɔkliwo fe nɛ.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Na ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la nakpɔe, ne woakpɔ dzidzɔ; mi ame siwo le Mawu dim la, mina dzi naɖo mia ƒo.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ ɖoa to hiãtɔwo, eye menyɔa ŋu etɔ siwo le ga me la o.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Mina dziƒo kple anyigba atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã ʋãna le eme la nakafui.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu axɔ na Zion, eye wòagbugbɔ Yuda-duwo atso, eye eƒe dɔlawo anɔ afi ma axɔe, wòazu wo tɔ.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Eƒe dɔlawo ƒe viwo anyi eƒe dome, eye ame siwo lɔ̃ eŋkɔ la, anɔ eme.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: O Mawu, nedze ŋuwò ne nàɖem! Ao Aƒetɔ, netsɔ nàkpe ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe ame siwo le nye agbe yome tim la, eye nàna be woatɔtɔ! Na ame siwo di be nu vevi nawɔm la, nagbugbɔ ɖe megbe azu ame ɖigbɔwo!

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Na ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃” la, nalé blanui le woƒe ŋukpe ta!

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Na ame siwo katã dia wò la, natso aseye, akpɔ dzidzɔ le mewò! Na ame siwo lɔ̃a wò xɔname la nagblɔ ɖaa be: “Mawu lolo!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ke nye la, ame dahe kple hiãtɔ menye, ao Mawu, ʋã ɖe ŋunye! Wòe nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ kple ɖenyela; o Aƒetɔ, mègahe ɖe megbe o!

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: O Mawu, nedze ŋuwò ne nàɖem! Ao Aƒetɔ, netsɔ nàkpe ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe ame siwo le nye agbe yome tim la, eye nàna be woatɔtɔ! Na ame siwo di be nu vevi nawɔm la, nagbugbɔ ɖe megbe azu ame ɖigbɔwo!

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Na ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Ehɛ̃, ehɛ̃” la, nalé blanui le woƒe ŋukpe ta!

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Na ame siwo katã dia wò la, natso aseye, akpɔ dzidzɔ le mewò! Na ame siwo lɔ̃a wò xɔname la nagblɔ ɖaa be: “Mawu lolo!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ke nye la, ame dahe kple hiãtɔ menye, ao Mawu, ʋã ɖe ŋunye! Wòe nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ kple ɖenyela; o Aƒetɔ, mègahe ɖe megbe o!

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe mesí tso; mègana ŋu nakpem akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɖem le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta, eye nàxɔ nam. Ɖo tom, eye nàxɔ nam!

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Nye sitsoƒegakpe nam, mɔ́ sesẽ si axɔ nam, elabe wòe nye nye agakpe kple mɔ́.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: O Mawu, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖi la si me, tso nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔla kple ŋutasẽla la ƒe fego me.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Elabe wò, Aƒetɔ lae, nye nye mɔkpɔkpɔ. Aƒetɔ, wò ŋu meɖoa ŋu ɖo tso nye ɖevime ke.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Ŋuwò meziɔ ɖo tso esime wodzim; wòe ɖem tso nɔnye ƒe dɔme. Nye kafukafu enuenu nye tɔwò.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Nukunu menye na ame geɖewo; ke wòe nye nye sitsoƒe sesẽ.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Nye nu yɔ fũu kple wò kafukafu kpakple wò bubu, ŋkekeawo katã.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔm ƒu gbe le nye tsitsime o, eye mègagblẽm ɖi ne ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye o.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: wogblɔ be: “Mawu gblẽe ɖi, miti eyome ne mialée, elabe ame aɖeke meli aɖee o.”

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mawu, mèganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o, nye Mawu, ʋã nàkpe ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe ame siwo tsɔ nya ɖe ŋunye la, eye na woatsrɔ̃; ame siwo le didim be yewoawɔ nu vevim la, na woaɖe alɔ me le wo ŋu, eye woado vlo wo.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Ke nyea manɔ mɔkpɔkpɔ dzi, eye makafu wò, agakafu wò.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Nye nu axlẽ wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔwo kple wò xɔnamedɔ siwo nèwɔna ŋkeke blibo la, afia, elabe woƒe xexlẽme gbɔ nye nunya ŋu.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Mava kple Aƒetɔ Mawu ƒe nu dzɔtsuwo; makafu wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ; tɔwò ɖeɖe ko makafu.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Mawu, èfia num le nye ɖekakpuime, eye va se ɖe fifia hã, mele gbeƒã ɖem wò nukudɔwo.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Mawu, eya ta esi metsi ƒo wɔ hã mègagblẽm ɖi o, va se ɖe esi maɖe gbeƒã wò ŋusẽ na dzidzime siwo gbɔna. Ẽ, wò ŋusẽ,

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Mawu, wò ŋusẽ kple wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, kɔ de dziƒowo ke. Wòe wɔ nu gãwo, o Mawu, ame kae le abe wò ene?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Wò, ame si na meto fukpekpe sesẽwo me, wòe agagbɔ agbem, àɖem tso ʋe goglowo me, eye àgakɔm ɖe dzi.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Àna nye bubu nadzi ɖe edzi, eye àgafa akɔ nam.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: O nye Mawu, nye hã matsɔ kasaŋku akafu wòe le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ta; madzi ha akafu wò kple gakasaŋku, o Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Make nu ado ɣli kple dzidzɔ, ne mele kafukafuha dzim na wò; nye luʋɔ si nèɖe hã awɔ nenema.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Nye aɖe aƒo nu le wò nu dzɔdzɔe si naa kpekpeɖeŋu ame ŋu la ŋkeke bliboa. Elabe wodo ŋukpe ame siwo di be yewoawɔ nu vevim la, eye wodo vlo wo.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Mawu, tsɔ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ na fia la kple wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ na fiavi la!

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Na ne wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me na wò dukɔ, eye wòatso afia dzɔdzɔe na ame dahewo.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Na towo nahe nunyoname vɛ na wò dukɔ, eye togbɛwo nahe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ vɛ.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Neʋli dukɔ la ƒe ame dahewo ta, neɖe hiãtɔwo, eye wòagbã ameteɖeanyila la!

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Nenɔ agbe, zi ale si ɣe kple ɣleti li la, tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Nenɔ abe tsi si dzana ɖe gbe si ta woya la dzi ene, abe agbafie si dzana ɖe anyigba dzi ene!

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nede dzi le eƒe ŋkekewo me, eye ŋutifafa nexɔ aƒe va se ɖe esi ɣleti maganɔ anyi o.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Eƒe fiaɖuƒe netso atsiaƒu nu yi atsiaƒu nu, eye tso Tɔsisi la nu va se ɖe anyigba ƒe seƒe ke!

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Eƒe ketɔwo nede ta agu le eŋkume, eye eƒe futɔwo neɖuɖɔ ke le anyigba!

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarsis-fiawo kple esiwo le ƒukpowo dzi nedzɔ nu nɛ; na ne Saba kple Seba-fiawo natsɔ nunanawo vɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Fiawo katã nede ta agu nɛ; dukɔwo katã nesubɔe!

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Elabe eɖea hiãtɔwo, ame dahewo kple ame siwo si kpeɖeŋutɔ aɖeke mele o la, ne woyɔe.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Ekpɔa nublanui na ame gblɔewo kple hiãtɔwo, eye wòxɔa hiãtɔwo ɖe agbe.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Eɖea woƒe agbe tso teteɖeanyi kple ŋutasesẽ me, eye woƒe ʋu xɔ asi le eŋkume.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Nenɔ agbe didi! Wonetsɔ sika tso Saba vɛ nɛ! Wonedo gbe ɖa ɖe eta edziedzi, eye woadi yayra nɛ ŋkeke bliboa!

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Bli newɔ fũu le anyigba la dzi; woneƒo aya le towo dzi; wonetse ku abe Lebanon tɔwo ene, eye amegbetɔwo nedzi ɖe duawo me abe gbe le gbedzi ene!

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Eŋkɔ nenɔ anyi tegbee; eŋkɔ nenɔ anyi zi ale si ɣe li la! Amewo netsɔe yra wo ɖokui, eye dukɔwo katã ayɔe be yayratɔ!

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ame si ɖeɖe ko wɔa nukunuwo.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Woakafu eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la tegbee; eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe neyɔ anyigba blibo la dzi! Amen, ẽ, Amen!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: David, Yese vi, ƒe gbedodoɖawo wu nu.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, Mawu ƒe dɔme nyo na nuteƒewɔlawo, na ame siwo dza le dzime la.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Elabe meʋã ŋu dàdala, esi mekpɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nunyoname la.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Elabe womesea veve aɖeke o. Woƒe lã me le sesĩe, eye wonyakpɔna.

english_verse: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.
translation_verse: Womeɖoa xaxa me abe ame bubuwo ene o, eye womekpea fu abe gbetɔ bubuwo ene o.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Eya ta dàda nye woƒe kɔga; ŋutasesẽ nye awu wodo.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Woda ami, woƒe ŋku do hɔ̃ɔ, bometsitsi dona tso woƒe dzime.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Woɖea alɔ me, ƒoa nu le tame vɔ̃e ɖoɖo ŋu. Wodoa wo ɖokui ɖe dzi boo, doa ŋɔdzi be yewoate ame ɖe anyi.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Wogblɔa nya vɔ̃ ɖe dziƒo ŋu, eye woƒe aɖe tsana godoo le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Eya ta amewo trɔna ɖe wo ŋu, kafua wo, eye womekpɔa vodada aɖeke le wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Wogblɔna be: “Ale ke Mawu ate ŋu anya? Ɖe nunya le Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la sia?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, aleae ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le. Woli bɔkɔɔ ɣe sia ɣi, eye wodzia kesinɔnu ɖe edzi.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Melé be na nye dzi wòle dzadzɛ dzodzro, eye meklɔ nye asi be nyemaɖi fɔ o.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Elabe mekpea fu ŋkeke blibo la, eye wohea to nam ŋdi sia ŋdi.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe megblɔ be: “Nye hã maƒo nu alea” la, anye ne meda alakpa ɖe viwòwo ƒe dzidzime ŋu.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Ke esi mebu tame be mase esia gɔme la, edzé nam ɖeɖiteameŋu dɔe,

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime mege ɖe Mawu ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la, eye medze si woƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, ètsɔ wo ɖo teƒe siwo le ɖiɖim; èna wodze tsɔtsrɔ̃ me.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Wotsrɔ̃ le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka me, ŋɔdzi kplɔ wo dzoe keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Wole abe drɔ̃ekuku ene ne ame nyɔ. Èdo vlo woƒe ŋɔli nɔnɔmewo le nyɔnyɔ tso drɔ̃e me megbe.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Esi nye luʋɔ se veve, esi nu ƒo ɖe nye dzi la,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: mezu bometsila kple numanyala; menɔ abe lã ene ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, mele gbɔwò enuenu, wòe lé nye nuɖusi ɖe asi.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Wòe kplɔam kple wò adaŋudede, eye emegbe àxɔm ɖe gbɔwò le ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Ame kae le dziƒo nam, ne menye wòe o? Nyemele naneke dim le anyigba dzi kpe ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutilã kple nye dzi ate ŋu agbɔdzɔ, gake Mawue nye nye dzi ƒe ŋusẽ kple nye gome tegbee.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, ame siwo te ɖe aga sãa tso ŋuwò la, atsrɔ̃; wòe àtsrɔ̃ ame siwo katã mewɔa nuteƒe na wò o la.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, enyo nam be mate ɖe Mawu ŋu. Metsɔ Aƒetɔ Mawu wɔ nye sitsoƒe, ne maxlẽ wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã afia.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Mawu, nu ka ta nègbe mí ɖikaa? Nu ka tae wò dɔmedzoe le dzudzɔ tum ɖe alẽhawo ŋu le wò lãnyiƒe?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò ameha, si nèxɔ ƒle le blema, eye nèɖee be wòanye to, si anye wò domenyinu la dzi. Ɖo ŋku Zion-to si dzi nènɔ la dzi!

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Ɖe afɔ ɖo ta gli, siwo mu ɖi tegbee la gbɔ. Futɔ la gblẽ nu sia nu le kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Wò ketɔwo blu le wò kɔkɔeƒe la titina. Woɖo woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzesiwo ɖi ne woanye dzesiwo.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Ele abe ame aɖe si kɔ fía dzi le ave dodo me ene,

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ fía kple zu gbã eƒe ati, siwo katã ŋu wòwɔ aɖaŋu ɖo la ene.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ na wo ɖokui be: “Míele wo katã bɔbɔ ge ɖe anyi!” Wotɔ dzo Mawu ƒe takpeƒewo katã le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Míele míaƒe dzesiwo kpɔm o. Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖeke megali o, eye ame aɖeke mele mía dome anya ɣe si ɣi wòase ɖo o.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Mawu, ɣe ka ɣi ketɔ la aɖu fewu ase ɖo? Ɖe futɔ la anɔ vlo dom wò ŋkɔ yi mavɔ mea?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nèhe asi ɖe megbe ɖo? Nu ka ta nèbla wò nuɖusi ɖe akɔ nu?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Evɔ Mawu nye Fia tso blema ke, eye wòle xɔnamedɔ wɔm le anyigba titina.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Wòe tsɔ wò ŋusẽ ma atsiaƒu mee; wòe gbã ʋɔdribawo ƒe ta le tɔwo dzi.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Èkaka Livyatan la ƒe ta, eye nètsɔe wɔ nuɖuɖu na nu gbagbewo le gbedadaƒo.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Wòe na tsidzɔƒewo kple tɔʋuwo ŋɔ, eye nèna tɔ mamiemamiewo mie.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Tɔwòe nye ŋkeke; tɔwò kee nye zã. Wòe ɖo nu keklẽwo kple ɣe anyi.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖo anyigba ƒe liƒowo katã; wòe wɔ dzomeŋɔli kple vuvɔŋɔli.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋku ale si futɔ la le fewu ɖumee kple ale si dukɔ mavɔ̃mawu la le dzuwòmee.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ wò ahɔnɛ ƒe luʋɔ de asi na gbemelãwo o; mègaŋlɔ wò hiãtɔwo ƒe agbe be yi mavɔ me o.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò nubabla la dzi! Elabe teƒe doviviti siwo le anyigba dzi la, yɔ fũu kple ŋutasesẽ nɔƒewo.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Mègana woado ŋukpe ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la o. Na hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo nakafu wò.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Mawu, tso nàʋli ɖokuiwò ta! Ɖo ŋku ale si dukɔ mavɔ̃mawu la le fewu ɖum le ŋuwò ŋkeke blibo la!

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Míeda akpe na wò, Mawu. Míeda akpe. Míeyɔ wò ŋkɔ, eye míele wò nukudɔwɔwɔwo xlẽm fia.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: Le ɣeyiɣi si meɖo ɖi la dzi la, madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu sɔsɔe.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Ne anyigba ʋuʋu, eye edzinuwo katã dzo nyànyanya la, nyee léa eƒe sɔtiwo ɖe te.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Megblɔ na adegbeƒolawo be: “Migaƒo adegbe o,” eye na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo be: “Migakɔ miaƒe dzo ɖe dzi o!

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Migakɔ miaƒe dzo ɖe dzi gladzaa loo, alo alia kɔ anɔ nya gblɔm amemabutɔe o!”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Elabe menye ɣedzeƒe alo ɣetoɖoƒe alo gbedadaƒoe dodoɖedzi tsona o;

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: ke boŋ Mawue drɔ̃a ʋɔnu. Eyae bɔbɔa ame si ɖe anyi, eye wodoa ame kemɛ ɖe dzi.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Elabe kplu le Aƒetɔ si me, eye wain si wotɔtɔ nyuie la, te fu ɖe eme, Aku aha tso eme, eye anyigba dzi ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã anoe ƒiaƒiaƒia akpɔ egɔme.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, matso aseye tegbee, eye madzi kafukafuha na Yakob ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Aŋe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe dzowo katã ɖa; ke woado ame dzɔdzɔewo ya ƒe dzowo ɖe dzi.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Wonya Mawu le Yuda; eŋkɔ lolo le Israel.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Woɖo eƒe agbadɔ gɔme anyi ɖe Salem; enɔƒe le Zion.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Afi ma wòŋe aŋutrɔ si le ʋɔ lum, akpoxɔnu kple yi kpakple aʋawɔnuwo le.

english_verse: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.
translation_verse: Èle keklẽm; èɖo atsyɔ̃ wu blematowo.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Woha nu le aʋakalẽawo si; woyi alɔ̃ me ʋĩi, abɔ fa le ŋutsuwɔlawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe Mawu, esi nèblu la, sɔdola kple sɔ siaa dze anyi, ku ƒenyi.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ŋɔdzi le ŋuwò! Ame ka ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwò, ne dzi ku wò?

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Èɖe gbeƒã wò afiatsotso tso dziƒowo; vɔvɔ̃ ɖo anyigba, eye wòzi ɖoɖoe;

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: esime Mawu tso be yeaɖo ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ anyi, ne wòaxɔ na ame siwo katã wote ɖe anyi le anyigba dzi la.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, amegbetɔwo ƒe dɔmedzoe akafu wò, eye dɔmedzoe susɔea nàtsɔ abla ali dzii.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Miɖe adzɔgbe na Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu, eye miwɔ edzi. Mina ame siwo katã ƒo xlãe godoo natsɔ nunanawo vɛ nɛ, na eya ame si wòle be woavɔ̃.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Eyae tsia amegãwo ƒe gbɔgbɔ nu, eye wònye ŋɔdzi na anyigba dzi fiawo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli sesĩe na Mawu, sesĩe na Mawu, be wòate ŋu ase ŋkɔnye.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Le nye xaxagbe la, medi Aƒetɔ la. Le zã me la, meke nye abɔwo me ʋuu, abɔawo mele kuyem o; nye luʋɔ gbe be womafa akɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Mebu Mawu ŋu, fa konyi, de ŋugble, eye nu ti kɔ na nye gbɔgbɔ.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Èke nye ŋku ɖe te, metsi dzodzodzoe, ale be nyemate ŋu aƒo nu o.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Mele blemaŋkekewo ŋu bum. Meɖo ŋku gbe aɖe gbe ƒewo dzi.

english_verse: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:
translation_verse: Meƒo nu kple nye dzi le zã me. Meyi ŋugble me, eye medzro nye gbɔgbɔ me.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Ɖe Aƒetɔ la agbe ame tegbee, eye magave ame nu gbeɖegbeɖe oa?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Ɖe eƒe amenuveve nu yi ɖikaa? Ɖe eƒe ŋugbedodowo nu tsi le ɣeyiɣiwo katã mea?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋku dzo le edzi be, wòave ame nua? Ɖe wòdo ʋɔ ɖe eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ nu le dziku mea?

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Maɖo ŋku Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo dzi; ẽ, maɖo ŋku wò blemanukunuwo dzi.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Mabu tame le wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã ŋu, eye made ŋugble le wò ŋusẽdɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Mawu, wò mɔ le kɔkɔe. Mawu kae lolo abe mía Mawu la ene?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Wòe nye Mawu, ame si wɔa nukunuwo. Wòe ɖe wò ŋusẽ fia le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖe wò dukɔ la, Yakob viwo kple Yosef viwo kple wò abɔ.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Mawu, esi tsiwo kpɔ wò, esi tsiwo kpɔ wò la, wovɔ̃; ẽ, tɔ goglowo gɔme ke dzo kpèkpekpe!

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Alilikpo ɖuɖu tsi yoo; dziŋgɔli ɖe gbe; wò aŋutrɔwo ɖo ta afi sia afi.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Wò gbeɖeɖe ɖi le yali me, wò dzikedzo na xexea me kɔ; anyigba ʋuʋu, dzo kpèkpekpe.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Wò mɔ to atsiaƒu me; wò toƒe le tɔ gãwo me, ke womekpɔ wò afɔtoƒewo o.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Wòe kplɔ wò dukɔ abe alẽha ene to Mose kple Aron ƒe asi dzi.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, miɖo to miase nye nufiafia. Mitrɔ to ɖe nye numenyawo ŋu!

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Make nu le lododo me, maɖe blemanya ɣaɣlawo ɖe go.

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: Nya siwo míese henya, eye mía tɔgbuiwo tsɔ wo tu xo na mí la woe.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mímaɣla wo ɖe wo viwo o; ke boŋ míaxlẽ nu siwo ta wòdze be woakafu Aƒetɔ kple eƒe ŋusẽ kpakple nukunu siwo wòwɔ la afia dzidzime siwo gbɔna la.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Eɖo ɖaseɖiɖi gɔme anyi ɖe Yakob, eye wòde se le Israel. Egblɔ na mía tɔgbuiwo be woafia nu siawo wo viwo,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: ale be dzidzime siwo le wo yome gbɔna, siwo nye vi siwo medzɔ haɖe o la, hã nanya wo, eye woawo hã naxlẽ wo afia wo viwo.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Ale be woada woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖe Mawu dzi, eye womaŋlɔ dɔ siwo Mawu wɔ la be o. Ke boŋ woalé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: Woawo ya womeganɔ abe wo tɔgbui siwo nye dzidzime sẽto, dzeaglã; dzidzime si ƒe dzi meli ke o, esi ƒe gbɔgbɔ mewɔ nuteƒe na Mawu o la ene o.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Efrayim viwo tsɔ da kple dati bla, sí dzo le aʋadzɔgbe.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Womewɔ nu, si wobla kple Mawu la dzi o; ke wogbe zɔzɔ ɖe eƒe se nu.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ nu siwo wòwɔ kple nukunu siwo wòɖe fia wo la be.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nukunu le wo tɔgbuiwo ŋkume wokpɔ, le Egipte-nyigba dzi kple Zoan-gbegbe.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Ema atsiaƒu me ɖe eve, eye wòna woto eme yi. Ena tsi dzɔ ka abe gli ene.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke me la, ekplɔ wo kple alilikpo, eye le zã blibo me la, etsɔ dzo keklẽ kplɔ woe.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Efé agakpewo me le gbedadaƒo, eye wòna tsi do bababa, abe anyigba tume wòtso ene, na wo.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ena tɔwo ŋɔ tso agakpe me, eye wòna tsiwo sí abe tɔsisiwo ene.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ke woyi edzi ganɔ nuvɔ̃ wɔm ɖe eŋu. Wodze aglã ɖe Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋu le kegbegbe.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Wote Mawu kpɔ le dzime, bia nuɖuɖu si dzro wo lae.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Wogblɔ ɖe Mawu ŋu be: “Ɖe Mawu ate ŋu aɖo nuɖukplɔ̃ na mí le gbedadaƒoa?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Eƒo agakpe, tsi do bababa, eye tɔwo ɖɔ gbagba. Ɖe wòate ŋu ana abolo alo lã hã eƒe dukɔa?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Eya ta esi Aƒetɔ see la, dɔme vee ŋutɔŋutɔ, eye wòna dzo fiã Yakob. Edo dziku helihelĩ ɖe Israel ŋu,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: elabe womexɔ Mawu dzi se o, eye womexɔe se be, eƒe ŋusẽ xɔna na ame o.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Ke hã eɖe gbe na dziŋgɔli, eye wòʋu dziƒoʋɔtruwo.

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: Ena dziƒobliku wo, eye wòdudu mana ɖe wo dzi abe tsidzadza ene, woɖu.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Ale gbetɔ hã ɖu mawudɔlawo ƒe abolo! Ena nuɖuɖu wo fũu.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ena ɣedzeƒeya ƒo tso dziƒo, eye wòtsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ kplɔ anyigbemeya vɛ.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ena adelã dza ɖe wo dzi abe ʋuʋudedi ene; xewo dza abe ƒutake ene.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Ena woge dze woƒe asaɖa la titina, ƒo xlã wo nɔƒewo godoo.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Ale woɖu lã ɖi ƒo nyuie, elabe ena nu si dzro wo la wo.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Ke hafi woƒe nudzroame la naɖi ƒo na wo esime nuɖuɖua ganɔ woƒe nu me la,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Mawu do dziku ɖe wo ŋu, wu ame sesẽwo le wo dome, eye wòƒo ɖekakpui akuakuawo ƒu anyi le Israel.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nu siawo dzɔ hã, woganɔ nuvɔ̃ wɔm ko. Togbɔ be ewɔ nukunuwo hã la, womexɔ edzi se o.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Ale wòna woƒe ŋkekewo bu abe ya si wogbɔ ene, eye woƒe ƒewo bu le ŋɔdzi me.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Esi wòwu wo la, wodi eƒe mɔ. Wotrɔ dzime, eye wodi Mawu vevie.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Woɖo ŋku edzi be, yewoƒe Agakpee nye Mawu; Mawu Dziƒoʋĩtɔ lae nye yewo Ɖela.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Ke wotsɔ nu flui, eye woblee kple woƒe aɖe.

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzi meku ɖe eŋu o. Womewɔ eƒe nubabla dzi le anukware me o.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Ke esi eya nye nublanuikpɔla ta la, etsɔ woƒe vodada ke wo, eye metsrɔ̃ wo o. Zi geɖe ne edo dziku la, eléa eɖokui, eye mewɔa nu si wòɖo la katã le dɔmedzoe me o.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋui be ŋutilã ko wonye; ya si ƒona yina, eye megagbɔna o la wonye.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Zi nenie womedze aglã ɖe eŋu le gbedadaƒo o! Zi nenie womedo dziku nɛ le kegbegbe o!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Wotee kpɔ, gatee kpɔ, eye wodo dziku na Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Womeɖo ŋku eƒe ŋusẽ dzi loo, alo gbe si gbe wòɖe wo tso ketɔ la si me,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: esime wòwɔ eƒe dzesiwo le Egipte kple eƒe nukunuwo le Zoan-gbewo dzi o.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Etrɔ woƒe tɔsisiwo wozu ʋu, ale be womete ŋu no wo me tsi o.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Eɖo togbatowo ɖe wo dome, woɖu wo; eɖo akpɔkplɔwo ɖa, wogblẽ nu.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Ena ʋetrawo ɖu woƒe agblemenukuwo, eye ʋetsuviwo gblẽ woƒe nuku, siwo ŋu wokpe fu ɖo la.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Etsrɔ̃ woƒe wainkawo kple tsikpe kple woƒe sikamortiwo kple ketsi.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Ewu woƒe nyihawo kple tsikpe, eye wòwu woƒe alẽhawo kple dziɖegbe.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Eɖe asi le dziku helihelĩ, dɔmedzoe, nyanyra kple xaxa ŋu ɖe wo dzi abe dɔla gblẽnuwo ƒe ha ene.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Eɖe mɔ na eƒe dziku; meɖe wo le ku nu o, ke boŋ etsɔ woƒe agbe de asi na dɔ vɔ̃.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: Ewu ŋgɔgbeviwo katã le Egipte, woƒe ŋusẽ ŋgɔgbetɔ le Xam ƒe agbadɔwo me.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Tete wòkplɔ eƒe dukɔ abe alẽwo ene dzoe, eye wònɔ wo ŋu le gbedadaƒo abe alẽhawo ene.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo dedie ale be womevɔ̃ o; ke atsiaƒu nyè tsyɔ woƒe futɔwo ya dzi.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo va eƒe anyigba kɔkɔe la dzi, va to, si dzi eƒe nuɖusi ɖu dzi le la.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Enyà dukɔwo ɖa le wo ŋgɔ; ema woƒe anyigbawo na wo wozu wo tɔ, eye wòna Israel-toawo tu woƒe agbadɔwo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ke wote Mawu, Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la kpɔ, eye wodze aglã ɖe eŋu. Womelé ŋku ɖe eƒe ɖaseɖiɖiawo ŋu o;

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: ke wotrɔ megbe dee hegbe nuteƒewɔwɔ nɛ abe wo tɔgbuiawo ke ene. Woƒo asa nɛ abe dati si dzi womate ŋu aka ɖo o la ene.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Elabe wotsɔ woƒe nuxeƒewo do dziku nɛ, eye wona wòʋã ɖe woƒe legbawo ŋu.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu va nya la, edo dɔmedzoe vevie, eye wògbe Israel keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Egblẽ enɔƒe si le Silo, agbadɔ si me wònɔna le amegbetɔwo dome la, ɖi.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ de aboyo me kple eƒe atsyɔ̃ na ketɔ la.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe dukɔ de asi na aʋawɔwɔ, eye wòdo dɔmedzoe ɖe eƒe domenyinu la ŋu.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Dzo fiã woƒe ɖekakpuiwo, eye womedzi srɔ̃ɖeha na woƒe ɖetugbiwo o.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Woƒe nunɔlawo tsi yi nu le aʋa me, eye konyifafa bu ɖe woƒe ahosiwo.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ la tso, abe alɔ̃ me wònyɔ tso ene, abe ame sesẽ si wain na wòle ɣli dom ene.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Enyà eƒe futɔwo wotrɔ dzo; edo ŋukpe mavɔ wo.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Egbe Yosef ƒe agbadɔ, eye metia Efrayim-to la o.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ etia Yuda-to, Zion-to si wòlɔ̃ la.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Etu eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la wòkɔ abe dziƒowo ene, eye wòɖo egɔme anyi abe anyigba ene tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Etia eƒe dɔla David, eye wòkplɔe tso alẽhawo gbɔe.

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: Eɖee le alẽ vi nɔwo yome bene wòava nye kplɔla na eƒe dukɔ, Yakob kple Israel, eƒe domenyinu.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ wo dzi kple dzi dzɔdzɔe, eye wòkplɔ wo le aɖaŋu me.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Mawu, dukɔwo nyè zi va be yewoaxɔ wò domenyinu la! Wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la; wodo aƒedo Yerusalem.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ wò dɔlawo ƒe kukuawo na dziƒoxeviwo, wò ame kɔkɔewo ƒe lã na gbemelãwo, ne woaɖu.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Wokɔ woƒe ʋu ɖe anyi abe tsi ene kpe Yerusalem ɖo, eye ame aɖeke meli aɖi wo o.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Míezu alɔmeɖenu na míaƒe aƒelikawo. Ame siwo ƒo xlã mí, ko mí, do vlo mí.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi ? Ɖe nàdo dziku tegbeea? Ɖe wò dɔmedzoe le ŋuʋaʋã me nanɔ bibim abe dzo enea?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dziku la kɔ ɖe dukɔ siwo menya wò o la dzi; ɖe fiaɖuƒe siwo meyɔa wò ŋkɔ o la dzi!

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Elabe wovuvu Yakob, eye wodo aƒedo enɔƒewo.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Mègaɖo ŋku mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe vodada dzi awɔ ɖe enu na mí o. Netsɔ nàkpɔ nublanui na mí elabe wobɔbɔ mí ɖe anyi ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Mía Mawu si xɔna na mí, kpe ɖe mía ŋu le bubu si le wò ŋkɔ ŋu la ta. Ɖe mí, eye nàtsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke mí, le wò ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta dukɔwo anɔ biabiam be: “Afi ka woƒe Mawu la le?” Na wò hlɔ̃biabia dukɔwo, le wò dɔlawo ƒe ʋu si wokɔ ɖe anyi ta la, nadze le mía ŋkume, míakpɔ.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Na gamenɔlawo ƒe ŋèŋe naɖo gbɔwò! Tsɔ wò ŋusẽ triakɔ la, nàdzra ame siwo le kuku ge la ɖo.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, ɖo vlo si míaƒe aƒelikawo do wò la teƒe na wo zigbɔzi adrẽ.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Ekema mí, wò dukɔ, wò lãnyiƒe ƒe alẽha, míada akpe na wò tegbee, eye míanɔ kafuwòm ɖaa tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Wò Israel Kplɔla, ɖo to mí. Wò si kplɔa Yosef ƒe dzidzimeviwo abe alẽha ene; wò si bɔbɔ nɔ kerubiwo dzi, klẽ.

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: Ɖe ɖokuiwò fia Efrayim, Benyamin kple Manase. Ʋuʋu wò ŋusẽ, eye nàva xɔ na mí!

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Mawu, gaɖo mí te. Na wò mo naklẽ, ale be woaxɔ na mí.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi nàdo dziku ɖe wò dukɔ ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Wòe na aɖatsibolo wo woɖu, eye nèdzidze aɖatsi na wo wòyɔ banaa wono.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Èwɔ mí míenye fewuɖunu na míaƒe aƒelikawo, eye míaƒe futɔwo le nu kom le wo nɔewo dome.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, gaɖo mí te. Na wò mo naklẽ, ale be woaxɔ na mí.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Wòe tsɔ wainka tso Egipte vɛ, wòe nyà dukɔwo ɖa, eye nèdoe ɖi.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Wòe dzra anyigba ɖo nɛ; eƒo ke ɖe to, eye wòxɔ anyigba blibo la.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Eɖo vɔvɔli ɖe towo dzi, eye wòɖe alɔ ɖe sederti gãwo dzi.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Eɖe alɔ de ƒu la nu ke, eye eƒe dzedze de Frat-tɔsisi la nu.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nèkaka kpɔ le eŋu ale be ame siwo katã va le yiyim la le eƒe kutsetsewo gbem?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Gbehatsu do tso ave me va vuvui; nu siwo katã to agblea me la ɖui.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, gatrɔ. Do mo ɖa tso dziƒo, nàkpɔ nu. Va lé be na wainka sia;

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: ati viaviã si wò nuɖusi ho do lae!

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Wotɔ dzoe, wòfiã, eye wotsoe ƒu anyi. Na wò ŋkume mokaname natsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Ke na wò asi nanɔ ame si nye wò nuɖusi la ŋu. Amegbetɔ vi si nèwɔ wòsesẽ na ɖokuiwò la.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ekema míagatrɔ megbe ade wò gbeɖe o. Gbɔ agbe mí, eye míado gbe ɖa na wò.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla, gaɖo mí te. Na wò mo naklẽ, ale be woaxɔ na mí.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Midzi ha sesĩe na Mawu, míaƒe ŋusẽ; mitso aseye ɖe Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋu.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Mido ha ɖa, mina axatsɛwo, gakasaŋkuwo kple saŋku, siwo ƒe gbe me kɔ la naɖi!

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Miku kpẽ le míaƒe ŋkekenyui ɖugbe, ne dzinu yeye dze dzi kple ne dzinu sɔ tegblẽe.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Elabe ɖoɖo wònye na Israel, Yakob ƒe Mawu la ƒe se ye.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Esime wòtso ɖe Egipte-nyigba ŋu lae wòtsɔe wɔ see na Yosef. Ame manyamanya aɖe ƒe gbe ɖi mese be:

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “Meɖe agba la ɖa le wò abɔta; meɖe wò asi ɖa le kusi la ŋu.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Esi nèxaxa la, èyɔm, eye meɖe wò. Meɣla ɖokuinye ɖe dziɖegbe me, tɔ na wò. Medo wò kpɔ le Meriba-tsidzidzia gbɔ.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, ɖo to nàse nye nuxlɔ̃amenya. Israel, ne ɖe nàse nye gbe ɖe!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Mawu bubu aɖeke meganɔ mia dome o. Migade ta agu na mawu tutɔ aɖeke o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu si kplɔ mi tso Egipte-nyigba dzi. Mike nu me baa ne made nu eme na mi, wòayɔ.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Ke nye dukɔ gbe nye gbesese. Israel medi nye nya aɖeke o.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Eya ta meɖe asi le wo ŋu ɖe woƒe tosesẽ me, ne woazɔ ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nu.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: O, ɖe medi be nye dukɔ naɖo tom, Israel nazɔ nye mɔwo dzi hafi!

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Madidi o, mabɔbɔ woƒe futɔwo ɖe anyi, eye matrɔ nye asi ɖe woƒe ketɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Ame siwo lé fu Aƒetɔ la, ade ta agu nɛ kple vɔvɔ̃, eye woƒe tohehe anɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Matsɔ lu ʋaʋã nyuitɔ anyi mi, eye mana miaɖi ƒo kple anyitsi tso kpeto me.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Mawu bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe enɔƒe le mawuwo ƒe takpekpe me. Ele mawuwo dome, eye wòtso nya me be:

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Ɣe ka ɣi miadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu madzɔmadzɔ ase ɖo? Ɣe ka ɣi miade ame vɔ̃ɖi dzi ase ɖo?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe na wɔnamanɔŋutɔwo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo. Mitsò na hiãtɔwo kple ame dahewo.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Mixɔ na wɔnamanɔŋutɔwo kple hiãtɔwo; miɖe wo tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me.”

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Womedze si nu loo, alo sea nu gɔme o. Wozɔa viviti me; anyigba la ƒe gɔmeɖoɖowo katã ʋuʋu.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Nyee gblɔ be: “Mawuwo mienye; Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la viwo mi katã mienye!

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Ke hã la, miaku abe amegbetɔwo ene, eye miaƒe agbe nu atso abe dziɖula ɖe sia ɖe tɔ ene.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Mawu, tso, drɔ̃ ʋɔnu anyigba la elabe tɔwòe dukɔwo katã nye.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖoɖoe megazi le ŋuwò o; mèganɔ anyi kpoo alo azi kpi o, Mawu.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm be: “Miva, mina mítsrɔ̃ dukɔ sia ɖa; mina womagaɖo ŋku Israel ŋkɔ dzi azɔ o.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Ẽ, wowɔ ɖeka ɖo nugbe, eye wobla nu ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Edomtɔwo kple Ismaeltɔwo, Moabtɔwo kple Hagaritɔwo,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebaltɔwo, Amontɔwo, Amalekitɔwo Filistitɔwo kple Tironɔlawoe.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiria hã kpe ɖe wo ŋu; woawoe nye Lot ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe alɔ sesẽ la.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Wɔ wo abe ale si nèwɔ Midiantɔwoe ene, abe ale si nèwɔ Sisera kple Yabin le Kison-tɔʋu nui ene!

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: Wotsrɔ̃ ame siawo le En-Dor, eye woƒe ŋutilã zu gbeɖuɖɔ ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Wɔ woƒe bubumewo abe ale si nèwɔ Oreb kple Zeeb ene, eye wɔ woƒe amegãwo abe ale si nèwɔ Zebax kple Zalmunae ene.

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: Ame siawo gblɔ be: “Mina míaxɔ Mawu ƒe lãnyiƒe la le wo si, wòazu mía tɔ.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, wɔ wo abe ʋuʋudedi le yali me ene, eye woanɔ abe nutsro si ya lɔ ɖe nu ene.

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: ti wo yome nenema kple ahom, eye nàdo ŋɔdzi na wo kple ya sesẽ!

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, na ŋu nakpe wo vevie, ne woadi wò, asubɔ wò.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe wo, eye dzi naɖe le wo ƒo tegbee; na woatsrɔ̃ ɖe ŋukpe me.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Na woadze sii be wò ɖeka hɔ̃ si ŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ la, wòe nye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la, ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, wò nɔƒe sɔ nam loo!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Ẽ, gege ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔxɔnu le nye luʋɔ dzrom vevie. Nye ameti blibo la mele ha dzim dzidzɔtɔe ɖe Mawu gbagbe la ŋu.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Atsutsrɔe gɔ̃ hã kpɔa nɔƒe, eye sagbadre wɔa atɔ ɖi na eɖokui afi si wòatsɔ viawo aɖoe le wò vɔsamlekpuiwo gbɔ, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, nye Fia kple nye Mawu.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Woyra ame siwo nɔa aƒewò me dzia ha, kafua wò ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Woyra ame siwo xɔa ŋusẽ tso gbɔwò, eye woƒe dzi le Zion-mɔ gãwo ŋu.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Ne woto Aɖatsi Bali la me la, wowɔnɛ wòzua tsidzɔƒe; tsidzadza gbãtɔwo wɔnɛ táwo nɔƒee.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Woƒe ŋusẽ le dzidzim ɖe edzi. Woakpɔ mawuwo ƒe Mawu la le Zion.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, se nye gbedodoɖa. Yakob ƒe Mawu, see!

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Mawu, kpɔ míaƒe akpoxɔnu la ɖa! Kpɔ wò amesiamina la ƒe mo!

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Elabe wò xɔxɔnunɔnɔ ŋkeke ɖeka nyo wu afi aɖe nɔnɔ ŋkeke akpe ɖeka. Medi be manye mɔnudzɔla le wò aƒeme wu esi manɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe agbadɔ me.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, Mawu nye ɣe kple akpoxɔnu. Enyoa dɔme, eye wòdea bubu ame ŋu. Ame siwo wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, Aƒetɔ metea nu nyui wo o.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Aʋakɔwokplɔla, woyra ame si ɖoa ŋu ɖe ŋuwò la!

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ève wò anyigba nu, eye nègbugbɔ Yakob ƒe kesinɔnuwo nɛ.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Wòe tsɔ wò dukɔ ƒe vodada kee, wòe tsɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ke wo.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Wòe dzudzɔ dɔmedzoedodo; wòe ɖe asi le dziku helihelĩ ŋu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: O Mawu, míaƒe xɔnametɔ, gaɖo mí te, eye mègado dziku ɖe mía ŋu o.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Ɖe nàdo dziku ɖe mía ŋu tegbeea? Ɖe wò dziku anɔ anyi ɖaa tso dzidzime yi dzidzimea?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Ko màgagbɔ agbe mí ne wò dukɔ nakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋuwò oa?

english_verse: Show us your love and save us!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, na míakpɔ wò amenuveve la, eye nàxɔ na mí.

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Na mase nya si gblɔ ge Mawu, Aƒetɔ ala, elabe agblɔ ŋutifafanya na eƒe dukɔ, na eƒe ame kɔkɔewo kple ame siwo trɔ ɖe eŋu le dzime la.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, eƒe xɔname tsɔ ɖe ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la gbɔ ale be ŋutikɔkɔe nanɔ míaƒe anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ ado go wo nɔewo; nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple ŋutifafa agbugbɔ nu na wo nɔewo.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔwɔ amie tso anyigba me, eye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ akpɔ nu le anyigba tso dziƒo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Ẽ, Aƒetɔ ana nu nyuiwo nava, eye míaƒe anyigba ƒe kutsetse adzi ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ adze eŋgɔ, eye wòata mɔ na eƒe afɔtoƒe.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo tom, eye nàtɔ nam, elabe hiã tum, eye meda ahe.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Dzra nye agbe ɖo elabe mevɔ̃a Mawu. Xɔ na wò dɔla, si ɖoa dzi ɖe ŋuwò. Wòe nye nye Mawu.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ve nunye elabe wòe mele ɣli dom na ŋkeke bliboa.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Do dzidzɔ na wò dɔla ƒe luʋɔ elabe Aƒetɔ, wòe mekɔ nye luʋɔ dzi na.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, wò dɔme nyo, eye nètsɔa nu kena. Amenuveve bɔ ɖe asiwò na ame siwo katã yɔa wò la.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye nàlé to ɖe nye kokoƒoɣli ŋu.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Le nye xaxagbe la, meyɔa wò elabe etɔna nam.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mawu aɖeke mele abe wò ene loo, alo dɔwɔwɔ aɖeke naɖi tɔwò o.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, dukɔ siwo katã nèwɔ la, ava de ta agu na wò, eye woade bubu wò ŋkɔ ŋu.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Elabe èlolo, eye nèwɔa nukunuwo; wò ɖeɖe koe nye Mawu.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, fia wò mɔm ne mazɔ le wò nyateƒe la me. Tsɔ nye dzi ɖo wò ɖeka ko ŋu, ne mavɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, meda akpe na wò tso dzi blibo me; makafu wò ŋkɔ tegbee.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Elabe wò amenuveve sɔ gbɔ ɖe dzinye; wòe ɖe nye luʋɔ tso tsiẽƒe ʋĩi ke.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Mawu, amemabulawo tso ɖe ŋunye; ŋutasẽlawo ƒe ha le nye agbe yome tim, mèɖi naneke le wo ŋkume o.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Gake Aƒetɔ, wò la, Mawu nublanuikpɔla kple amenuvela nènye. Ègbɔa dzi blewuu, vea ame nu, wɔa nuteƒe geɖe.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye nàkpɔ nublanui nam. Na wò ŋusẽ wò dɔla, eye nàxɔ na wò dɔlanyɔnu vi la.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Fia wò amenuveve ƒe dzesi aɖem, ne ame siwo lé fum la nakpɔe, eye ŋu nakpe wo. Elabe wò Aƒetɔ ye kpe ɖe ŋunye, eye nèfa akɔ nam.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe du la gɔme anyi ɖe to kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ lɔ̃ Zion ƒe agbowo wu nɔƒe siwo katã le Yakob.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe du, wogblɔ nya nyuiwo le ŋuwò.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Raxab kple Babilonia le dukɔ siwo nyam la dome. Kpɔ ɖa, Filistitɔwo, Tirotɔwo kple Etiopiatɔwo ya la, amewo gblɔna be: “Ame sia la, wodzii ɖe afi ma.”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Woagblɔ le Zion ŋu be: “Wodzi ame sia kple ame kemɛ ɖe eme.” Elabe Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋutɔ ana wòali ke.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ de dukɔwo agbalẽ me be: “Wodzi ame sia ɖe afi ma.”

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Hadzilawo kple ɣeɖulawo siaa agblɔ be: “Mewòe nye nu nyuiwo dzɔ tso.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, meyɔ wò le ŋkeke me be nàxɔ nam. Le zã me la, mele ŋkuwò me le yɔwòm kple ɣli.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Na nye gbedodoɖa naɖo gbɔwò, eye nàlé to ɖe nye ɣlidodo ŋu.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Elabe nye luʋɔ yɔ fũu kple fukpekpe, eye nye agbe te ɖe tsiẽƒe ŋu.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Wobum ɖe aʋlimeyilawo dome, menye ame si ŋu ŋusẽ vɔ le.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Mele abe ame si wogblẽ ɖe ame kukuwo dome ene, abe ame si wowu wòmlɔ yɔdo me ene, abe ame siwo dzi mègaɖoa ŋkui kura o la ene; elabe woɖe wo ɖa le wò asi ŋu.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Èdam ɖe gogloƒe ʋĩi le aʋlime, ɖe gogloƒe ʋĩi si do viviti tsiɖitsiɖi la.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Wò dɔmedzoe kpe le dzinye; wò ƒutsotsoewo tem ɖe to.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Èna nye zɔhɛwo he ɖe megbe le ŋunye; èwɔm mezu ŋunyɔnu na wo. Èdo ʋɔ ɖe nunye, ale be nyemate ŋu así o.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Vevesese na nye ŋku wɔ dɔ̃ɔ. Aƒetɔ, mele yɔwòm gbe sia gbe; meke nye abɔwo me na wò.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Ɖe nèwɔa nukunu na ame kukuwoa? Ɖe ŋɔliwo fɔna kafua wòa?

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ɖe woƒoa nu le wò amenuveve ŋu le yɔdo mea? Ɖe wogblɔa wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le tsiẽƒea?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Ɖe wonya nu le wò nukunuwo ŋu le viviti mea? Ɖe woƒoa nu le wò xɔname ŋu le yɔdo me, afi si woŋlɔa amewo be lea?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nu ka ta nètsɔm ƒu gbe? Nu ka ta nèɣla wò ŋkume ɖem?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Tso keke ɖekakpuime kee mede asi fukpekpe me le; metsɔ ɖe ku gbɔ kpuie. Nuwo le ŋɔdzi dom nam; wɔna vɔ le ŋunye.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Wò dɔmedzoe la va lɔm ɖe me, eye wò avuwɔwɔ dziŋɔ la tsrɔ̃m.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Wòe na lɔlɔ̃tɔ kple xɔlɔ̃ ɖe ɖa le ŋunye; nye zɔhɛwo le viviti me.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, madzi ha le wò amenuveve ŋu tegbee. Make nu aɖe gbeƒã wò nuteƒewɔwɔ na dzidzimewo katã.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Elabe èɖo wò amenuveve gɔme anyi tegbee; wò nuteƒewɔwɔ li ke abe dziƒowo ene.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Wòe gblɔ be: “Mebla nu kple nye ame si metia. Meka atam na nye dɔla David be:

english_verse: David, one of your descendants will always be king.”
translation_verse: ‘Maɖo wò dzidzimeviwo gɔme anyi tegbee. Maɖo wò fiazikpui anyi na dzidzimewo katã.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, na dziƒonɔlawo nakafu wò nukunuwo; na ame kɔkɔewo nadzi ha akafu wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le woƒe takpekpe me.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Mawu si wovɔ̃na le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe takpekpe me; etri akɔ, dzi ŋɔ wu ame siwo katã ƒo xlãe la.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, ame kae sesẽ abe wò Aƒetɔ kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ si ƒo xlã wò la ene?

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Wòe gbã ƒumeʋɔdriba, Raxab, gudugudu abe nu kuku ene, eye nètsɔ wò ŋusẽ triakɔ la, kaka wò futɔwo hlẽ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Tɔwòe nye dziƒo; tɔwòe nye anyigba hã. Xexea me kple emenuwo katã la, wòe ɖo wo gɔme anyi.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Wòe wɔ dzigbeme kple anyigbeme. Tabor-to kple Xermon-to le wò ŋkɔ kafum kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe nye wò fiazikpui ƒe gɔmeɖokpe; amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ dzea ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Woyra dukɔ si nya wò ŋkekenyui ɖuɣi. Aƒetɔ, ame siwo zɔna le wò mo ƒe kekeli me,

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: eye wotsoa aseye kafua wò ŋkɔ ŋkeke blibo la, hedoa wò ɖe dzi le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Elabe wòe nye woƒe ŋusẽ ƒe bubu; wò amenuveve na míaƒe dzo kɔ dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Elabe míaƒe akpoxɔnu nye Aƒetɔ tɔ, mía fia nye Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la tɔ. Mawu do ŋugbe na David

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Èƒo nu na wò dɔla nuteƒewɔlawo le ŋutega me le blema be: “Meɖɔ fiakuku na kalẽtɔ aɖe, eye medo ame aɖe si metia la ɖe dzi tso dukɔ la dome.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Mekpɔ David, nye dɔla. Mesi nye ami kɔkɔe nɛ,

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: ale be nye asi nanɔ eŋu tegbee, nye alɔ hã nado ŋusẽe.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Futɔ malée le aye me o, ame vɔ̃ɖi mabɔbɔe ɖe anyi o.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Magbã eƒe ketɔwo nyànyanya le eŋgɔ, eye maƒo ame siwo lé fui la ƒu anyi.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Nye nuteƒewɔwɔ kple amenuveve anɔ kplii, eye eƒe dzo akɔ dzi le nye ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Matsɔ eƒe asi aɖo atsiaƒu dzi, eye eƒe nuɖusi anɔ tɔsisiwo dzi.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ado ɣli nam be: ‘Wòe nye Tɔ́nye; nye Mawu kple nye xɔname ƒe Agakpe.’
