english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Matsɔe awɔ vinye ŋgɔgbea, eye wòanye fiawo katã ƒe tatɔ le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Nye amenuveve anɔ kplii tegbee, eye nye nubabla kplii anɔ te.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Maɖo eƒe fiaƒome la gɔme anyi tegbee, eye eƒe fiazikpui la anɔ abe dziƒowo ƒe ŋkekewo ene.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Ne viawo gblẽ nye se la ɖi, eye womezɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu o,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: ne wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye ɖoɖowo, eye womewɔ nye sewo dzi o la,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: ekema mahe to na wo kple ati le woƒe dzidada ta, eye maƒo wo kple atam le woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Ke nyemana nye amenuveve nadzo le egbɔ loo, alo magbe nuteƒewɔwɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Nyemagbe nye nubabla la dzi wɔwɔ loo, alo matrɔ nya si meke nu gblɔ la o.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Metà nye ŋutɔ nye ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la zi ɖeka; nyemable David o.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Eƒe fiaƒome la anɔ anyi tegbee, eƒe fiazikpui anɔ ŋkunye me abe ɣe ene.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, ènyàe ɖa, eye nègbee; èdo dɔmedzoe helihelĩ ɖe wò amesiamina la ŋu.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Wòe tu nu si nèbla kple wò dɔla la. Wòe gblẽ kɔ ɖo na eƒe fiakuku la le ʋuʋudedi me.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Ègbã eƒe gliwo katã, eye nèmu eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Afi ma tolawo katã ha eƒe nuwo, eye wòva zu alɔmeɖenu na eƒe aƒelikawo.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Wòe na eƒe ketɔwo ƒe nuɖusi de dzi, wòe na eƒe futɔwo katã kpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Ẽ, èna eƒe yi nu tsi kpo, eye mèna wònɔ te le aʋa me o.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wòe xɔ eƒe fiatikplɔ le esi, eye nètsɔ eƒe fiazikpui xlã ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Wòe tò eƒe ɖekakpuime ŋkekewo ɖe eme, wòe tsɔ ŋukpe tsyɔe.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi ? Ɖe nàɣla ɖokuiwò tegbeea? Ɣe ka ɣi wò dɔmedzoe anɔ bibim abe dzo ene ase ɖo?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋu agbenɔɣi ƒe didime. Èwɔ amegbetɔ viwo katã wonye nu dzodzrowo ko!

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ agbe, eye maku akpɔ o? Ame kae ate ŋu axɔ eƒe luʋɔ tso tsiẽƒe ƒe ŋusẽ si?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, afi ka wò amenuveve si nɔ anyi le blema, si dzi nètà nu ɖo na David le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ me la le?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋu ale si amewo le vlo dom wò dɔlae; ale si metsɔ dukɔwo ƒe dzudzuwo ɖe akɔ nui,

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ tegbee! Amen, ẽ, Amen!

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: Le Mawu kple amegbetɔ ŋu

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, sitsoƒe nènye na mí tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Hafi towo nava dzɔ, alo hafi nàva wɔ anyigba kple xexea me la, wòe nye Mawu tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Wòe trɔa amegbetɔ wògazua ʋuʋudedi, eye nègblɔna be: “Mitrɔ gbɔ, o amegbetɔ viwo!”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Elabe ƒè akpewo le ŋkuwò me ko abe etsɔ si va yi la ene, alo abe ŋudzɔɣi ɖeka le zã me ene.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Wòe kplɔa amegbetɔ viwo dzonae; wole abe drɔ̃e ene, wole abe gbe si gbɔa agbe le ŋdi ene.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Le ŋdi la, eƒo se, eye wògbɔ agbe; le fiẽ la, eɖi golo, eye wòyrɔ.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Elabe wò dziku tsrɔ̃ mí ɖa, eye wò dɔmedzoe ɖu mía dzi keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Wòe tsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo ɖo wò ŋkume; ètsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃ ɣaɣlawo ɖo wò mo ƒe kekeli nu.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Elabe míaƒe ŋkekewo katã va yina le wò dɔmedzoe nu, míaƒe ƒèwo wua enu abe hũɖeɖe ene.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Míaƒe agbenɔƒèwo nye ƒè bla adrẽ, ne míekpɔ ŋusẽ la, edea bla enyi. Ke wo me yɔ fũu kple hloloetsotso kple fukpekpe. Elabe wova yi kaba, eye míedzo dzó.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Ame kae bua tame le wò dziku ƒe ŋusẽ kple wò dɔmedzoe ŋu, anya ale si woavɔ̃ wòe?

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Eya ta, fia ale si míaxlẽ míaƒe ŋkekewoe la mí, be dzi nyanu naɖo mía si.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Na wò amenuveve naɖi ƒo na mí le ŋdi, ne míatso aseye, akpɔ dzidzɔ, le míaƒe ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Do dzidzɔ na mí ɖe ŋkeke geɖe siwo nèwɔ fu mí la nu kple ɖe ƒè geɖee siwo nya vɔ̃wo dzɔ ɖe mía dzi la nu.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Na wò dɔwɔwɔ nadze wò dɔlawo nakpɔ, eye na wo viwo nakpɔ wò ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ŋusẽ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Na Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu, ƒe amenuveve nanɔ mía dzi, eye na míaƒe asinudɔwo nali ke agbã go ɖe mía dzi, ẽ, na míaƒe asinudɔwo nali ke.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe bebeƒe, eye wòle Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe vɔvɔli te la,

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: eyae agblɔ na Aƒetɔ be: “Nye sitsoƒe kple nye mɔ́ nènye; nye Mawu, si ŋu meɖoa ŋu ɖo.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Elabe aɖe wò tso xevimɔ̀trela ƒe mɔ̀ me kple dɔ vɔ̃ si wua ame la, si me.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Atsɔ eƒe fu sesẽwo atsyɔ dziwò, eye àkpɔ sitsoƒe le eƒe aʋalawo te; eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ nye akpoxɔnu gãtɔ kple suetɔ.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Mavɔ̃ ŋɔdzidoname le zã loo, alo aŋutrɔ si le ʋɔ lũm le ŋkeke me loo,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: alo dɔ vɔ̃ si le zɔzɔm le blukɔ me kple nugblẽla si le nu gblẽm le ŋdɔ la o.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Akpe adze anyi ɖe axawò, eye akpe ewo adze wò ɖusime; ke wò ya la, mate ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɖeko nàkpɔe kple wò ŋkuwo, eye àkpɔ ale si woaɖo eteƒe na ame vɔ̃ɖiwoe.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Esi nètsɔ Aƒetɔ wɔ wò sitsoƒee, eye nètsɔ Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la wɔ nɔwòƒee ta la,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: vɔ̃ aɖeke madzɔ ɖe dziwò o, eye dɔ vɔ̃ mate ɖe wò agbadɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Elabe aɖe eƒe dɔlawo ɖe ŋuwò ne woadzɔ ŋuwò le wò mɔwo katã dzi.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Woakɔ wò ɖe woƒe asiwo me be màtsɔ wò afɔ axlã ɖe kpe aɖeke o.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Àzɔ dzata kple dakpui dzi, ànya avuzi le dzatavi kple da dzi.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Esi wòku ɖe ŋunye kple lɔlɔ̃ ta la, maɖee; makpɔ eta, elabe enya nye ŋkɔ.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Ne eyɔm la, matɔ nɛ; manɔ kplii le xaxa me, maɖee, eye made bubu eŋu.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Matsɔ agbe didi aɖi ƒo nɛ, eye mana wòakpɔ nye xɔname.

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Enyo be woada akpe na Aƒetɔ, o Dziƒoʋĩtɔ, enyo be woadzi ha akafu wò ŋkɔ;

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: be woaɖe gbeƒã wò amenuveve le ŋdi kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le zã me,

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: ɖe kasaŋku ka ewo tɔ, saŋku kple gakasaŋku ƒe gbeɖiɖi vivi ŋu.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Elabe wò, Aƒetɔ, etsɔ wò dɔwɔwɔwo do dzidzɔ nam; wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo tae mele ha dzim kple dzidzɔ ɖo.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, wò dɔwo lolo loo! Wò susuwo me goglo ŋutɔ!

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: be, togbɔ be ame vɔ̃ɖiwo miena abe gbe ene, eye nu vlo wɔlawo katã ƒoa se hã la, woɖo wo ɖi be woatsrɔ̃ ɖikaa,

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: ke wò Aƒetɔ la, eɖu dzi tegbee.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, wò futɔwo, o Aƒetɔ, elabe kpɔ ɖa, wò futɔwo atsrɔ̃, nu baɖa wɔlawo katã aka ahlẽ.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Ke ekɔ nye dzo ɖe dzi abe tò tɔ ene; ekɔ ami yeye ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo kpɔ nye futɔwo ƒe anyidzedze, nye towo se ame vɔ̃ɖi siwo tso ɖe ŋunye la ƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ɖea ɖɔ abe deti ene, eye wòkɔna abe sederti le Lebanon-to dzi ene.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Wodo wo ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒeme, woƒo se le mía Mawu ƒe xɔxɔnuwo.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Wonɔa kutsetse dzi le tsitsime hã, tsi nɔa wo me fũu ɣe sia ɣi, eye wodea ama,

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: tsɔ fiana be Aƒetɔ nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla, eyae nye nye agakpe, eye nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ aɖeke mele eme o.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye le fia ɖum, eta fianyenye, Aƒetɔ ye tae, etsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzi. Ẽ, eli ke xexea me; maʋã akpɔ o.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Woli ke wò fiazikpui tso gbe aɖe gbe ke; wò la, èli tso mavɔ me ke.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Tɔ ɖɔɖɔwo dze agbo, o Aƒetɔ, tɔ ɖɔɖɔwo le gbe ɖem, tɔ ɖɔɖɔwo dze agbo kple woƒe hoowɔwɔ.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Ètri akɔ wu tɔ geɖewo ƒe hoowɔwɔ, wu atsiaƒu ƒe agbodzedze sesẽ. Aƒetɔ si le dziƒo ʋĩi tri akɔ!

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Wò sewo le eteƒe tututu; o Aƒetɔ, kɔkɔenyenye dze wò aƒe la yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe nye Mawu si biaa hlɔ̃, Mawu hlɔ̃biala, klẽ do ɖa!

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: O anyigba ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, tso nàtsɔ nu si dze na dàdalawo la ɖo eteƒe na wo!

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Wole nyawo gblɔm blobloblo dàdatɔe, nu vlo wɔlawo katã le adegbe ƒom.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wogbã wò dukɔ la, eye wowɔ nu vevi wò domenyinu la.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Wotso ta le ahosiwo kple amedzrowo nu, eye wowu tsyɔ̃eviwo.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ mele ekpɔm o; Yakob ƒe Mawu la medze sii o.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Mise nu gɔme, mi dukɔa ƒe susu gblɔetɔwo! Movitɔwo, ɣe ka ɣie miadze nunya?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Eya, ame si wɔ to, ɖe mesea nu oa? Eya, ame si wɔ ŋku, ɖe mekpɔa nu oa?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Eya, ame si hea to na dukɔwo ɖe mehea to oa? Eya, ame si fiaa nunya amegbetɔ,

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nya amegbetɔ ƒe susuwo, be ƒuƒu ko wonye.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, woyra ame si nèhea to na kple ame si nètsɔa wò se la fiaa nui,

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: be wòakpɔ gbɔdzɔe le xaxa ŋkekewo me, va se ɖe esime woɖe yɔdo na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ magbe eƒe dukɔ la o, eye magblẽ eƒe domenyinu la ɖi o.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Elabe woagadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo, eye ame siwo katã wɔa nuteƒe le dzime akplɔe ɖo.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Ame kae atso ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu nam? Ame kae atsi tre ɖe nu baɖa wɔlawo ŋu ɖe nunye?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye Aƒetɔ ye kpe ɖe ŋunye o la, anye ne gbe vɔ le nunye xoxo le tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Ne mesusui be: “Meɖiɖi la,” Aƒetɔ, wò amenuveve léam ɖe te.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Ne dzimaɖeɖi sɔ gbɔ le nye dzime la, wò akɔfanamewo dea dzi ƒo na nye luʋɔ.

english_verse: But you are opposed to dishonest lawmakers
translation_verse: Ɖe dziɖula vɔ̃ɖi siwo dea se gbegblẽwo ate ŋu ade ha kpli wòa?

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ zu nye mɔ́ sesẽ, eye nye Mawue nye nye sitsoƒegakpe.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Axe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo wowɔ la ŋuti fe na wo, eye wòatsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le woƒe vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye ta; Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, atsrɔ̃ wo ɖa.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Miva, mina míadzi ha na Aƒetɔ; mina míado dzidzɔɣli ɖe mía xɔnamegakpe la ŋu!

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Mina míado ɖe eŋkume kple akpedada; mina míado dzidzɔɣli ɖe eŋu kple kafukafuhawo!

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu gãe nye Aƒetɔ kple Fiagã si ƒo mawuwo katã ta.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Eya si mee anyigba ƒe globoƒewo le; etɔe nye towo ƒe tsutsɔẽƒewo hã.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Etɔe nye atsiaƒu, elabe eyae wɔe, elabe eƒe asiwoe wɔ anyigba ƒuƒu la.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: O, miva, mina míade ta agu nɛ, asubɔe, mina míadze klo ɖe Aƒetɔ, mía Wɔla ŋkume!

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Elabe eyae nye mía Mawu, eye míenye dukɔ le eƒe lãnyiƒe kple alẽ siwo le esi me. O, ne ɖe miaɖo to eƒe gbe egbe ɖe!

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: Migasẽ miaƒe dzime abe le Meriba kple gbe ma gbe le Masa, le gbedadaƒo la ene o.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣie mia tɔgbuiwo tem kpɔ, dom kpɔ; togbɔ be wokpɔ dɔ siwo mewɔ va yi la hã.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Ƒè bla ene sɔŋ medo ŋunyɔ dzidzime ma, eye megblɔ be: “Wonye dukɔ si daa vo le dzime, eye womedea bubu nye mɔwo ŋu o.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Eya ta meka atam le nye dziku me be: ne woade nye gbɔɖemeƒe la fĩi!

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye na Aƒetɔ; anyigba blibo la katã, midzi ha na Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Aƒetɔ, mikafu eŋkɔ; miƒo nu tso eƒe xɔname ŋu tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le dukɔwo dome kple eƒe nukudɔwɔwɔwo le anyigba dzi dukɔwo dome!

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ lolo, eye wòdze kafukafu gã; edze be woavɔ̃e wu mawuwo katã.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Elabe dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo katã nye legbawo; ke Aƒetɔ ye wɔ dziƒowo.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Bubu kple fianyenye le eŋkume; ŋusẽ kple atsyɔ̃ le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: O, mi dukɔwo ƒe ƒomewo, mitsɔe na Aƒetɔ! mitsɔ bubu kple ŋusẽ na Aƒetɔ;

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ bubu si dze Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ la nɛ; mitsɔ vɔsa vɛ, eye miva eƒe xɔxɔnuwo!

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Misubɔ Aƒetɔ le atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kɔkɔe me, anyigba blibo la nedzo nyànyanya le eŋkume.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Migblɔ le dukɔwo dome be: “Aƒetɔ ye nye fia! Ẽ, xexea me li ke, maʋã akpɔ o; adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo sɔsɔe.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Mina dziƒowo nakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye mina anyigba natso aseye; mina atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme la naɖe gbe.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Mina agble kple agblemenuwo katã natso aseye! Ekema avemetiwo katã adzi ha kple dzidzɔ,

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, elabe egbɔna, elabe egbɔna be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu anyigba la. Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea me ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nu, eye wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo ɖe eƒe nyateƒe nu.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye fia; mina anyigba natso aseye; mina ƒutanyigba geɖewo nakpɔ dzidzɔ!

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Alilikpowo kple viviti tsiɖitsiɖi ƒo xlãe; nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple afia nyui tsotsowoe nye eƒe fiazikpui ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Dzo le bibim le eŋgɔ, eye wòfiã eƒe ketɔwo godoo.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzikedzowo klẽ ɖe xexea me anyigba kpɔe, dzo nyànyanya;

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Towo lólo abe anyiŋɔ ene le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, le anyigba blibo la ƒe Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Dziƒowo ɖea gbeƒã eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, eye dukɔwo katã kpɔa eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Woado ŋukpe aklama kpakpɛ subɔlawo katã, ame siwo tsɔa legba maɖinuwo ƒoa adegbee; mawuwo katã dea ta agu le eŋgɔ.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Zion see, eye dzi dzɔe; Yuda vinyɔnuwo tso aseye, o Mawu, le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ta.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Elabe wò Aƒetɔ ye ƒo nuwo katã ta le anyigba blibo la dzi. Èƒo mawuwo katã ta sãa.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ lɔ̃a ame siwo lé fu nuvɔ̃ɖi, edzraa eƒe ame kɔkɔewo ƒe agbe ɖo, eɖea wo tso nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo si me.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Kekeli do na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo eye dzidzɔ do na ame siwo ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Mi nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo, mitso aseye ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye mida akpe le eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ta!

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye na Aƒetɔ, elabe ewɔ nukunuwo! Eƒe nuɖusi kple eƒe alɔ kɔkɔe la na wòɖu dzi.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ na wonya eƒe dziɖuɖu, eɖe eƒe afiatsotso fia le dukɔwo ŋkume.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋku eƒe amenuveve kple nuteƒewɔwɔ na Israel-dukɔ la dzi. Anyigba ƒe seƒewo katã kpɔ mía Mawu ƒe dziɖuɖu.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Anyigba blibo la katã nedo ɣli kple dzidzɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu; aseyehawo neɖi le mia nu, eye midzi kafukafuhawo!

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Midzi kafukafuha na Aƒetɔ ɖe kasaŋku ŋu, ha neɖi kple kasaŋku kple gbe vivi!

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Neɖi kple dze kpakple kpẽ, mido dzidzɔɣli le Aƒetɔ Fia la ŋkume.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Mina atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme la, naɖe gbe, xexea me kple emenɔlawo hã!

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Tɔɖɔɖɔwo neƒu akpe; togbɛwo katã nawɔ ɖeka adzi ha kple dzidzɔ,

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, elabe egbɔna be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu anyigba la. Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea me ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nu, eye wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo sɔsɔe.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye fia, mina dukɔwo nadzo nyànyanya! Ebɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazi dzi le kerubiwo dzi; mina anyigba naʋuʋu kpèkpekpe.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ lolo le Zion; ekɔ gbɔ dukɔwo katã ta.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Na woakafu wò ŋkɔ gã dziŋɔ la! Ele kɔkɔe!

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Fia triakɔ, ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe lɔ̃la, wòe ɖo nu sɔsɔe wɔwɔ gɔme anyi; wòe drɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe, eye nèwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe le Yakob.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Mido Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la ɖe dzi, eye misubɔe le eƒe afɔɖodzinu ŋgɔ! Ele kɔkɔe!

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron nɔ eƒe nunɔlawo dome, Samuel hã nɔ ame siwo subɔe la dome. Wodo ɣli yɔ Aƒetɔ, eye wòtɔ na wo.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu na wo le alilikpododo me; wolé eƒe ɖaseɖiɖiwo kple se siwo wòde na wo la, me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu, wòe tɔ na wo; Mawu si tsɔa vɔ̃ kena la nènye na wo, ke èbiaa hlɔ̃ wo ne wowɔ nu gbegblẽ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Mido Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, ɖe dzi, eye misubɔ le eƒe to kɔkɔe la dzi; elabe Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, le kɔkɔe!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Anyigbawo katã mido dzidzɔɣli ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Misubɔ Aƒetɔ kple dzidzɔ! Mitsɔ hadzidzi do ɖe eŋkume!

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Minyae be Aƒetɔ ye nye Mawu! Eyae wɔ mí, eye etɔ míenye; eƒe dukɔ kple eƒe alẽwo le eƒe lãnyiƒe míenye.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Mige ɖe eƒe agbowo me kple akpedada, eye mitsɔ kafukafu ge ɖe eƒe xɔxɔnuwo! Mida akpe nɛ, eye mikafu eŋkɔ!

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ nyo; eƒe amenuveve li tegbee, eye eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ li na dzidzimewo katã.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Madzi ha le nuteƒewɔwɔ kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe ŋu; Aƒetɔ, wòe madzi ha na.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Malé fɔ ɖe mɔ si ŋu mokaka mele o la ŋu. Ɣe ka ɣie nàva gbɔnye? Mazɔ kple dzi si ŋu mokaka mele o le nye aƒeme.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Nyematsɔ nu maɖinu aɖeke aɖo ŋkunye me o. Melé fu dzidalawo ƒe nuwɔna; malé ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Dzi matomɔɖekɛ anɔ adzɔge ʋĩi tso gbɔnye; nyemanya naneke le nuvɔ̃ɖi ŋu o.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Ame si gblẽa ehavi ŋu le adzame la, matsrɔ̃e. Ame si si dàdaŋku kple dàdadzi le la, nyemade ha kplii o.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Malé ŋku ɖe nuteƒewɔlawo ŋu le anyigba dzi, ave wo nu, be woate ŋu anɔ gbɔnye; ame si ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu mokaka mele o lae asubɔm.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Ameflula aɖeke manɔ nye aƒeme o, aʋatsokala aɖeke maganɔ ŋkunye me o.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋdi sia ŋdi la, matsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã ɖa le anyigba la dzi, maɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo katã ɖa le Aƒetɔ ƒe du la me.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, se nye gbedodoɖa; na nye ɣlidodo naɖo gbɔwò!

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Mègaɣla wò ŋkume ɖem le nye xaxagbe o! Lé to ɖe ŋunye; gbe si gbe meyɔ wò la, tɔ nam kaba!

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Elabe nye ŋkekewo nu yi abe dzudzɔ ene, eye nye ƒuwo fiã abe dzokpo me wole ene.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Woƒo nye dzi abe gbe ene, eye wòyrɔ. Meŋlɔ nuɖuɖu be.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Nye ŋeŋe sesĩe na be nye ƒuwo lé ɖe nye lã ŋu.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Mele abe akaga le gbedadaƒo kple adzexe le aƒedowo me ene.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Metsi zãdomadɔlɔ̃e, mele abe xevi si tsi akogo le xɔta ene.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo ɖea alɔ me le ŋunye ŋkeke bliboa ame siwo le koyem la, tsɔa nye ŋkɔ ƒoa fi de ame.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Elabe meɖua dzowɔ abe nuɖuɖu ene, eye metɔtɔa nye nunono kple aɖatsi,

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: le wò dɔmedzoe kple dziku ta; elabe ède asi tenye ƒu gbe ɖo ɖa.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkekewo le abe fiẽ vɔvɔli ene, meyrɔ abe gbe ene.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Ke wò Aƒetɔ, èle fiazi dzi tegbee; wò ŋkɔ le dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Wò la àtso akpɔ nublanui na Zion; ɣeyiɣia de be nàve enu; gamea su azɔ.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Elabe eƒe kpewo le vevie na wò dɔlawo, eye wokpɔ nublanui na eƒe ʋuʋudedi.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo avɔ̃ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ, eye anyigba dzi fiawo katã avɔ̃ wò ŋutikɔkɔe la.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ atso Zion-du la, ado le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Atrɔ ɖe ame dahewo ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu, eye mado vlo woƒe kokoƒoƒo o.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Mina woaŋlɔ esia da ɖi na dzidzime si gbɔna la, ale be dukɔ si medzɔ haɖe o la, nakafu Aƒetɔ be:

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: ekpɔ nu le anyi me tso eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la le dzime ke, Aƒetɔ kpɔ anyigba ɖa tso dziƒo,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: be yease gaxɔmenɔlawo ƒe ŋeŋe, be yeaɖe ga ame siwo wotso kufia na la;

english_verse: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
translation_verse: be amewo naɖe gbeƒã Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ le Zion, eye woakafui le Yerusalem,

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: ne dukɔwo ƒo ƒu, eye fiaɖuƒewo kpe ta be woasubɔ Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Ekaka nye ŋusẽ le mɔ ta, etò nye ŋkekewo ɖe eme.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Mebe: “Nye Mawu, esia ta mègaɖem ɖa le nye agbenɔɣi titina o, wò ame si ƒe ƒèwo li le dzidzimeawo katã me.”

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Gbe aɖe gbe kee nèɖo anyigba gɔme anyi, eye dziƒowo nye wò asinudɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Wo nu ava yi, ke wò la, èli. Wo katã woanyunyɔ abe awu ene; èɖɔlia wo abe awudodo ene, eye wo nu yina.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, nenema ko nèle, eye nuwuwu meli na wò ƒèwo o.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Wò dɔlawo ƒe viwo anɔ anyi dedie; woƒe dzidzimeviwo ali ke le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, kafu Aƒetɔ, eye nu siwo katã le menye la, nekafu eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, kafu Aƒetɔ, eye mègaŋlɔ eƒe nyuiwɔwɔwo katã be o.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Eyae tsɔa wò nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo katã kea wò, eyae daa gbe le wò dɔlélewo katã ŋu,

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: eyae ɖe wò agbe tso aʋlime, eyae tsɔ amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ɖɔ na wò,

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: eyae tsɔ nu nyui ɖi ƒo na wò zi ale si nèle agbe, ale be wò ɖekakpuinyenye gagbɔa agbe abe hɔ̃ tɔ ene.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòtsoa afia na ame siwo katã wote ɖe anyi la.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ena Mose nya eƒe mɔwo, eye wòna Israel-dukɔ la dzesi eƒe nuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Nublanuikpɔla kple amenuvelae nye Aƒetɔ, medoa dziku kabakaba o, eye amenuveve bɔ ɖe esi.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Maka mo na ame ɣe sia ɣi loo, alo alé dziku ɖi tegbee o.

english_verse: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.
translation_verse: Mewɔna na mí ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo nu loo, alo ɖoa míaƒe nuvɔ̃ɖiwo teƒe na mí o.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Elabe ale si dziƒo kɔ boo tso anyigba gbɔe la, nenemae eƒe amenuveve nu sẽ ɖe ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la dzi.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Ale si ɣedzeƒe didi tso ɣetoɖoƒe gbɔe la, nenemae wòtea míaƒe dzidadawo ɖa tso mía gbɔ.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Ale si vi tɔ́ kpɔa nublanui na viawoe la, nenemae Aƒetɔ kpɔa nublanui na ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Elabe enya míaƒe wɔwɔme, eɖoa ŋui be ʋuʋudedie míenye.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Gbetɔ ya la, eƒe ŋkekewo le abe gbe ene; ewɔna nyuie abe seƒoƒo le gbe me ene.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Gake ne ya ƒo to edzi ko la, enu yina, eye eteƒe buna keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ ƒe amenuveve li tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me na ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ, eye eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ li na viwo ƒe viwo.

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖo eƒe fiazikpui anyi ɖe dziƒowo, eye eƒe fiaɖuƒe ɖu nuwo katã dzi.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ, mi eƒe dɔlawo, mi kalẽtɔ siwo wɔa eƒe nya dzi, eye mieɖoa to eƒe nyagbe la!

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ, mi eƒe aʋakɔwo katã, mi eƒe subɔla siwo wɔa eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ, mi eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã le teƒe siwo katã le eƒe dziɖuɖu te. Luʋɔnye, kafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, kafu Aƒetɔ. O Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, èlolo ŋutɔ! Wòe ta bubu kple fianyenye,

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: wòe tsyɔ kekeli abe avɔ ene, wòe he dziƒowo me abe agbadɔvɔ ene.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: Wòe tsɔ wò xɔtiwo ƒo tsiwo dzi, wòe wɔ alilikpowo wò tasiaɖamwoe, wòe zɔ ya ƒe aʋalawo dzi,

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: wòe wɔ yawo wò dɔtsɔlawoe, wòe wɔ dzo kple dzo ƒe aɖewo wò subɔlawoe.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖo anyigba la gɔme anyi ɖe eƒe gɔmeɖoɖowo dzi; ale be mate ŋu aʋã akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Wòe do tɔ goglowo nɛ abe awu ene; tsiawo kɔ gbɔ towo ta.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Wosí le wò agbodzedze nu, wode afɔ du me le wò gbeɖeɖe nu.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Towo kɔ yi dzi, baliwo nyè ɖe eme, le teƒe si nèɖo na wo la.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖo liƒo si ŋu womagbɔ o, ale be womagatsyɔ anyigba la ake o.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Wòe na tsiwo ŋɔ le baliwo me; wosí to togbɛwo dome,

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: wonaa tsi gbemelã ɖe sia ɖe le gbedzi be wòano; gbetedziwo faa woƒe tsikɔwuame nu.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Dziƒoxeviwo wɔa nɔƒe ɖe wo xa; wodzia ha le atilɔawo me.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Wòe dea tsi towo tso wò kɔkɔƒe la, wò dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kutsetse ɖia ƒo na anyigba.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Wòe nana be gbe tsina na lãwo kple nukuwo na amegbetɔ be wòade agble, ne wòakpɔ nuɖuɖu tso anyigba me.

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: Wòe naa wain be wòado dzidzɔ na ame ƒe dzi, ami, ne eƒe mo naklẽ kple abolo be wòado ŋusẽ ame ƒe dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Wodea tsi Aƒetɔ ƒe atiwo wòsua wo nyuie, Lebanon-sederti siwo wòdo.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Xeviwo wɔa atɔ ɖe wo me; damixe tso aƒe ɖe kpomitiwo me.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Gbemegbɔ̃wo tɔe nye to kɔkɔawo; agakpewo nye sitsoƒe na hotoklolowo.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Wòe wɔ ɣleti ne wòade dzesi ɣeyiɣiwo; ɣe nya ɣe si ɣi wòaɖo to.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Wòe wɔ viviti wònye zã, esime avemelãwo katã doa go.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Dzataviwo ɖea gbe nɔa nuléle dim, henɔa woƒe nuɖuɖu dim tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Ne agu dze la, wodzona eye wotsyɔa akɔ ɖe woƒe dowo me.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ yia eƒe dɔ gbɔ, eye wòwɔa eƒe dɔ va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wò dɔwɔwɔwo sɔ gbɔ loo! Èwɔ wo katã le nunya me; anyigba yɔ fũu kple wò nuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒue nye ekem ɖaa; elolo, keke; emenu gbogboawo mele xexlẽme o, nugbagbe suewo kple gãwo siaa.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Tɔdziʋuwo toa edzi, eye Livyatan si nèwɔ be wòafe le eme la, le eme.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Nu siawo katã le asiwò nu kpɔm be nàna nuɖuɖu yewo le enaɣi.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Ne ètsɔe na wo la, woƒoa enu ƒu; ne èʋu wò asi me la, nu nyuiwo sua wo si woɖia ƒo.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Ne èɣla wò ŋkume la, wotɔtɔna; ne èxɔ woƒe gbɔgbɔ le wo si la, wokuna, eye wotrɔna yia woƒe ʋuʋudedi me.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Ne èɖo wò Gbɔgbɔ ɖa la, wodzɔna, eye nègawɔa anyigba ŋkume yeyee.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nenɔ anyi tegbee; Aƒetɔ nekpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu,

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: eya ame si kpɔa anyigba, wòdzona nyànyanya, ekaa asi towo ŋu, wotua dzudzɔ!

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Madzi ha na Aƒetɔ zi ale si mele agbe; madzi kafukafuha na nye Mawu esi menya le agbe ko.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Nye ŋugbledede nedze eŋu, elabe mekpɔa dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ me.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Na nuvɔ̃wɔlawo natsrɔ̃ le anyigba dzi keŋkeŋ, eye na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nu nayi! Luʋɔnye, kafu Aƒetɔ! Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, miɖe gbeƒã eŋkɔ, mixlẽ eƒe nuwɔwɔwo fia le dukɔwo dome!

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Midzi ha nɛ, midzi kafukafuha nɛ; miƒo nu le eƒe nukudɔwo katã ŋu!

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ƒo adegbee; mina ame siwo katã dia Aƒetɔ ƒe dzi natso aseye!

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Midi Aƒetɔ kple eƒe ŋusẽ, midi eƒe amegbɔnɔnɔ edziedzi!

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nukudɔ siwo wòwɔ la dzi, eƒe nukunuwo kple afiatsotsowo.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O, mi eƒe dɔla Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwo, mi Yakob viŋutsuwo, eƒe ame tiatiawo!

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Eyae nye Aƒetɔ mía Mawu la, eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo le anyigba blibo la katã dzi.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Eɖoa ŋu eƒe nubabla la tegbee, nya si wògblɔ ɖi na dzidzime akpewo,

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: be: “Miawoe matsɔ Kanaan-nyigba la ana abe domenyinu si anye mia tɔ gome ene.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Esi womesɔ gbɔ o, wole ʋɛ, eye wonye amedzrowo le edzi,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: nɔa tsatsam tso dukɔ gbɔ yi dukɔ gbɔ, tso fiaɖuƒe ɖeka gbɔ yi dukɔ bubu gbɔ la,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: meɖe mɔ na ame aɖeke be wòate wo ɖe anyi o. Eka mo na fiawo le wo ta,

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: be: “Migaka asi nye amesiaminawo ŋu o, migawɔ nu vevi aɖeke nye gbeƒãɖelawo o.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Esi wòhe dɔwuame va anyigba la dzi, eye wòxe mɔ ɖe sia ɖe na nuɖuɖukpɔkpɔ la,

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: edɔ ŋutsu aɖe ɖe wo ŋgɔ, Yosef, ame si wodzra abe kluvi ene.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Kɔsɔkɔsɔ de abi afɔ nɛ, wode ga yibɔ kɔ nɛ;

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: va se ɖe esi nya si wògblɔ la va eme, Aƒetɔ ƒe nya tso afia nɛ.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Fia la dɔ woɖaɖee le gaxɔ me, dukɔwo dziɖula la na ablɔɖee.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Etsɔe ɖo aƒetɔ ɖe eƒe aƒe dzi kple eƒe nuwo katã dzikpɔla,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: be wòafia nu eƒe amegãwo ale si dze eŋu, eye wòafia nunya eƒe ame tsitsiwo.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Tete Israel va Egipte; Yakob nɔ Xam-nyigba dzi amedzroe.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ na eƒe dukɔ la dzi ŋutɔ, eye wòna wokpɔ ŋusẽ wu woƒe ketɔwo.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Etrɔ woƒe dziwo be woalé fu yeƒe dukɔ la, eye woawɔ ayemenu ɖe yeƒe dɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Edɔ eƒe dɔla Mose kple Aron, ame siwo wòtia la.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Wowɔ eƒe dzesiwo le wo dome kple nukunuwo le Xam-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Edɔ viviti ɖa, eye wòna blukɔ do ɖe anyigba la dzi; wodze aglã ɖe eƒe nyawo ŋu.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Etrɔ woƒe tsiwo wozu ʋu, eye wòna woƒe tɔmelãwo ku.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu, tete togbatowo ƒe ha gã aɖe kple muwo va xɔ woƒe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ena tsikpewo dza ɖe tsidzadza teƒe, eye dzi ke dzo to anyigba la katã dzi.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Egblẽ woƒe wainkawo kple gbotiwo, eye wòŋe woƒe dukɔmetiwo.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu, ʋetsuviwo va, eye ʋetrawo do bibibi.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Woɖu gbewo, atiwo kple woƒe kutsetsewo keŋkeŋ le woƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ewu ŋgɔgbeviwo katã le woƒe anyigba dzi, nu siwo katã tso woƒe ŋusẽ me la ƒe gbãtɔwo.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Tete wòkplɔ Israel do goe kple klosalo kpakple sika; ame aɖeke mekli nu le eƒe toawo dome o.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Egiptetɔwo kpɔ dzidzɔ esime wodzo, elabe woƒe ŋɔdzi lé wo.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ena alilikpo do vɔvɔli ɖe wo dzi, eye dzo klẽ na wo le zã me.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Wobia, eye wòna tegli wo; ena abolo wo fũu tso dziƒo.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Eʋu agakpe nu, eye tsi ŋɔ bababa hesí le kegbegbe abe tɔsisi ene.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Elabe eɖo ŋku eƒe ŋugbedodo kɔkɔe la kple eƒe dɔla Abraham dzi.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Ale wòkplɔ eƒe dukɔ la dzoe kple dzidzɔ; eƒe ame tiatiawo dzo kple hadzidzi.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Etsɔ dukɔwo ƒe anyigbawo na wo, eye woxɔ dukɔwo ƒe agbagbadzedzewo metsonuwo

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: kple taɖodzinu be ne woalé eƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi ahawɔ eƒe sewo dzi. Mikafu Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, elabe eƒe dɔme nyo, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Ame kae ate ŋu agblɔ nu klitsu siwo Aƒetɔ wɔ, alo akafui wòade edeƒe?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Woyra ame siwo drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe, eye wowɔa nu dzɔdzɔe ɣeawo katã ɣi!

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋku dzinye ne ève wò dukɔ nu; kpe ɖe ŋunye ne èɖe wo;

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: na makpɔ wò ame tiatiawo ƒe nunyoname, ne matso aseye, akpɔ dzidzɔ kple wò dukɔ la, ne maƒo adegbe akpe ɖe wò domenyinu ŋu.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Mí kple mía tɔgbuiwo míewɔ nuvɔ̃, míewɔ nu vlo, míewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Mía tɔgbuiwo, esime wonɔ Egipte la, womede asixɔxɔ wò nukudɔwo ŋu o. Womeɖo ŋku wò amenuveve si gbã go la dzi o; ke wodze aglã ɖe Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋu le Aƒlaƒu la nu.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Ke exɔ na wo le eŋkɔ la ta, be wòaɖe eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la afia.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Eblu ɖe Aƒlaƒu la ta, eye wòmie; ekplɔ wo to tɔ goglo la me, wozɔ afi ma ko abe kegbegbe ene.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Tsi nyè tsyɔ woƒe ketɔwo; wo dometɔ ɖeka teti hã metsi agbe o.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Tete woxɔ eƒe nyawo dzi se, eye wodzi ha kafui.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Ke eteƒe medidi hafi woŋlɔ eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo be o, womelala eƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo o.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Ke nu dzro wo vevie le gbedadaƒo, eye wote Mawu kpɔ le kegbegbe la;

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: ena nu si wobia la wo, gake eɖo kuɖidɔléle ɖe wo dome.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Esime amewo ʋã ŋu Mose kple Aron, Aƒetɔ ƒe ame kɔkɔe la, le asaɖa la me la,

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: anyigba ke nu mi Datan, eye wotsyɔ Abiram kple eƒe amewo dzi.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Dzo hã bi nu le woƒe ameha la dome, eye dzo fiã ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Wowɔ nyivi le Xoreb, eye wosubɔ legba si wokɔ̀ la.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Woɖɔli Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la kple nyitsu, si ɖua gbe la ƒe nɔnɔme.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ Mawu, woƒe Xɔla si wɔ nu gãwo le Egipte,

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: ame si wɔ nukudɔwo le Xam-nyigba dzi kple ŋɔdzinuwo le Aƒlaƒu la nu la, be.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Eya ta egblɔ be yeatsrɔ̃ wo. Ɖe Mose, eƒe ame tiatia la, menɔ wo teƒe le eŋkume ne wòatsi eƒe dɔmedzoe si atsrɔ̃ wo la nu oa?

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Tete wodo vlo anyigba nyui la, esi womexɔ eƒe ŋugbedodo dzi se o ta.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Wolĩ liʋiliʋĩ le woƒe agbadɔwo me, eye womeɖo to Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe o.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Eya ta ekɔ asi dzi, ka atam na wo be yeana woatsi gbedadaƒo,

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: yeakaka woƒe dzidzimeviwo ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye yeahlẽ wo ɖe anyigbawo dzi.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Tete wotsɔ wo ɖokui lé ɖe Peor Baal ŋu, eye woɖu nu siwo wotsɔ sa vɔe na ame kukuwo la;

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: wotsɔ woƒe nuwɔnawo do dziku na Aƒetɔ, eye dɔ vɔ̃ ge ɖe wo dome.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Tete Pinehas tsi tsitre de nu nyadzɔdzɔ la me, eye dɔ vɔ̃ la nu tso.

english_verse: Now he will always be highly honored.
translation_verse: Wobu esia nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nɛ, tso dzidzime yi dzidzime tegbee.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Wodo dziku nɛ le Meriba-tsi la gbɔ, eye le wo ta la, Mose ge ɖe nya me;

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: elabe wona eƒe gbɔgbɔ se veve, eye nya ge le enu.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Wometsrɔ̃ dukɔawo abe ale si Aƒetɔ gblɔ na wo la ene o.

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: Ke wotsaka kple dukɔwo, eye wosrɔ̃ woƒe nuwɔnawo wɔ.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wosubɔ woƒe legbawo, nu si zu mɔ̀ ɖe wo.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Wotsɔ wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo sa vɔe na gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Wokɔ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi, wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo, siwo wotsɔ sa vɔe na Kanaan-legbawo la, ƒe ʋue, eye wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba la kple ʋu.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Ale woƒo ɖi wo ɖokui to woƒe nuwɔnawo me, eye wowɔ gbolo le woƒe wɔnawo me.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖe eƒe dukɔ la ŋu, eye wònyɔ ŋu eƒe domenyinu la.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wo de asi na dukɔwo ale be ame siwo lé fu wo la, ɖu wo dzi.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Woƒe futɔwo te wo ɖe anyi eye wobɔbɔ wo ɖe woƒe ŋusẽ te.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Eɖe wo zi geɖe; ke woɖo tame dze aglã, eye wobɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi to woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, ekpɔ woƒe xaxa me na wo, esi wòse woƒe ɣli.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Ena ame siwo katã ɖe aboyo wo la, kpɔ nublanui na wo.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu, xɔ na mí, ƒo mía nu ƒu tso dukɔwo dome ne míakafu wò ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la, eye míatsɔ wò kafukafu aƒo adegbee.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Mina dukɔ blibo la nagblɔ be: “Amen!” Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe dɔmenyonyo kafukafu

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ elabe eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Mina ame siwo Aƒetɔ ɖe la nagblɔ nenema; ame siwo wòɖe tso xaxa me,

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: eye wòƒo wo nu ƒu tso anyigbaawo dzi; tso ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe tso dzigbeme kple anyigbeme.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ aɖewo tsa tsaglalã le kegbegbewo; womekpɔ mɔ yi du aɖeke me be woaɖanɔ eme o.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Dɔ kple tsikɔ wu wo; nu te woƒe luʋɔ ŋu le wo me.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Aƒetɔ le woƒe xaxa me, eye wòɖe wo tso woƒe fukpekpe la me.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Mina woada akpe na Aƒetɔ, le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔ viwo la ta.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Elabe ena ame siwo tsikɔ wu la ɖi kɔ; etsɔ nu nyuiwo ɖi ƒo na ame siwo dɔ wu la.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo bɔbɔ nɔ viviti me kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me; gamenɔlawo le fukpekpe kple ga me.

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: Elabe wodze aglã ɖe Mawu ƒe nyawo ŋu, eye womeɖo to Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe adaŋudede o.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Wote woƒe dziwo ɖe anyi kple dɔ sesẽ, wodze anyi; ke ame aɖeke meli axɔ na wo o.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Aƒetɔ le woƒe xaxa la me, eye wòɖe wo tso woƒe fukpekpe la me.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Ehe wo do goe tso viviti kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me, eye wòŋe ga siwo wode wo la ɖa.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Mina woada akpe na Aƒetɔ le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔ viwo la ta.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Elabe egbã akɔbliʋɔtruwo, eye wòlã ga yibɔ gametiwo me ɖe eve.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Ɖewo dze dɔ to woƒe agbe vlo nɔnɔ me, eye wokpe fu le woƒe vodadawo ta.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi nyɔ ŋu na wo; wogogo ku ƒe agbowo.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Aƒetɔ, le woƒe xaxa la me, eye wòɖe wo le woƒe fukpekpe la me.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe nya ɖa, wòyɔ dɔ wo, eye wòɖe wo tso tsɔtsrɔ̃ me.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Mina woada akpe na Aƒetɔ, le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔ viwo la ta!

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Mina woasa akpedadavɔ, eye woatsɔ aseyetsoha axlẽ eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo afia.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Ɖewo le tɔdziʋuwo me le ƒu dzi, nɔ asi tsam le tɔ gãwo dzi.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Wokpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo kple eƒe nukudɔwo le tɔ gɔme ke hã.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Elabe eɖe gbe, eye wòna ahomya sesẽ ho mli ƒutsotsoewo.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Ʋuawo yi dzi boo gbɔ va anyi; wo me nɔlawo bu dzideƒo le woƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e la me.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Wotrɔ to me, zɔ sagasaga abe ahanomunɔwo ene; womeganya nu ka woawɔ o.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Aƒetɔ le woƒe xaxa la me, eye wòɖe wo tso woƒe fukpekpe la me.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Ena ahom la dze kɔ anyi kpoo, eye ɖoɖoe zi le ƒutsotsoeawo nu.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Tete dzi dzɔ wo elabe ɖoɖoe zi azɔ, eye wòkplɔ wo de ʋutɔkɔ abe ale si wodi la ene.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Mina woada akpe na Aƒetɔ le eƒe amenuveve kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔ na amegbetɔ viwo la ta!

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Mina woadoe ɖe dzi le dukɔa ƒe takpekpe me, eye woakafui le ame tsitsiwo ƒe adaŋu me.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Eyae trɔa tɔsisiwo, wozua kegbegbe, eye tsidzɔƒewo zua kuɖiɖinyigba;

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: anyigba wɔnu trɔna zua dzeteƒe le edzinɔlawo ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Etrɔa kegbegbe wòzua tsitáwo; trɔa kuɖiɖinyigba wòzua tsidzɔƒe.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Ale wòɖea mɔ dɔwuitɔwo nɔa afi ma, tsoa du ɖi, nɔa eme.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Wodea nukugblewo kple waingblewo, eye woŋea nu fũu.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: To eƒe yayra me la, wodzina fũu; woƒe nyiwo dzi meɖena kpɔtɔna o.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Ne wozu ʋɛ, eye wobɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi to ameteteɖeanyi, xaxa kple nuxaxa me la,

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: edoa vlo woƒe amegãwo vevie, eye wònana be wobua mɔ henɔa tsa glãla tsam le gbedzi afi si mɔ aɖeke mele o.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Ke ekɔa hiãtɔwo ya ɖe dzi tso fukpekpe me, eye wòwɔa woƒe ƒomewo abe alẽhawo ene.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo kpɔa esia, eye dzi dzɔa wo; ke nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo katã zia ɖoɖoe.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si nya nu la, nelé ŋku ɖe nu siawo ŋu. Mina wòabu tame le Aƒetɔ ƒe amenuveve ŋu.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: Nye dzi dze eme, Mawu, nye dzi dze eme! Madzi ha, maƒo ha vivi. Luʋɔnye, nyɔ!

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Saŋku kple kasaŋku, minyɔ! Mele agudzedze nyɔ ge!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mada akpe na wò le dukɔwo dome. Madzi kafukafuhawo na wò le anyigbadzitɔwo dome.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Elabe wò amenuveve kɔ gbɔ dziƒowo ŋu yi; wò nuteƒewɔwɔ yi ɖatɔ alilikpowo.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu, na woakɔ wò ɖe dzi agbɔ dziƒowo ŋu! Na wò ŋutikɔkɔe naxɔ anyigba blibo la katã dzi!

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Be woaɖe wò ame siwo nèlɔ̃ vevie la; tsɔ wò nuɖusi kpe ɖe mía ŋu, eye nàɖo tom.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Mawu do ŋugbe le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la be: “Makpɔ dzidzɔ ama Sixem, eye mama Sukot-bali la hã me.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead nye tɔnye; Manase nye tɔnye; Efrayim nye nye gakuku; Yuda nye nye fiatikplɔ.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Nye tsileze nye Moab. Maɖe nye afɔkpa aƒu gbe ɖe Edom. Mado dziɖuɣli ɖe Filistitɔwo ta.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Ame ka akplɔm ayi du sesẽ la mee? Ame kae akplɔm aɖo Edom?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖe menye wòe gbe mí oa? Mawu, mègahona kple míaƒe aʋakɔwo o ɖe!

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: O, na kpekpeɖeŋu mí ɖe ketɔ la ŋu! Elabe amegbetɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu mele ɖeke me o.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Ne Mawu le mía dzi la, míawɔ kalẽ; eyae afanya míaƒe ketɔwo kple afɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Wò, Mawu si mekafuna, mègazi ɖoɖoe o.

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: Elabe ame vɔ̃ɖi kple ameblela ke nu ɖe ŋunye, hele nu ƒom le ŋunye kple alakpaɖewo.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ fulényawo ɖe to ɖem, eye wodze dzinye naneke mawɔmawɔe.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Ɖe lɔlɔ̃ si metsɔ na wo teƒe la, wotsɔ nya ɖe ŋunye; togbɔ be medoa gbe ɖa ɖe wo ta hã.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Ale wotsɔa vɔ̃ ɖoa nyui teƒe nam, fuléle ɖe nye lɔlɔ̃ teƒe.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Mida ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖe eŋu; mina amenutsola nakplɔe yi ʋɔnui.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Ne wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnui la, wonebu fɔe. Mina woabu eƒe gbedodoɖa nuvɔ̃e!

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkekewo dzi neɖe kpɔtɔ; ame bubu nexɔ eƒe nuwo!

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Viawo nezu tsyɔ̃eviwo; srɔ̃a nezu ahosi!

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Viawo nenɔ tsa glãla tsam anɔ nu biam; wonenyà wo do goe le aƒedo si me wole la me.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Fetɔ nelɔ eƒe nuwo katã; ame tutɔwo neha nu siwo wòwɔ dɔ kpɔ la.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke meganɔ anyi awɔ dɔmenyo nɛ loo, alo akpɔ nublanui na via tsyɔ̃eviawo o!

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzidzimeviwo netsrɔ̃; eƒe ŋkɔ netutu ɖa le dzidzime evelia me.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Woneɖo ŋku tɔgbuiawo ƒe vodadawo dzi le Aƒetɔ gbɔ, eye migana woatutu nɔa ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa o.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Wonenɔ Aƒetɔ ŋkume ɖaa; womegaɖo ŋku edzi azɔ le anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Elabe meɖo ŋku edzi wɔ dɔmenyo o; ke boŋ eti ame dahe kple hiãtɔ kpakple ame si ƒe dzi gbã la yome yi ku me.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Elɔ̃ fiƒoƒo de ame; na fiƒodewo nava edzi. Melɔ̃ yayra o; yayra nenɔ adzɔge sãa tso egbɔ.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Edo fiƒode abe awu ene; neɖo lã me nɛ abe tsi ene, neyi eƒe ƒuwo tome abe ami ene.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Nenɔ abe avɔ si wòtsyɔna la ene; nenɔ abe alidziblanu si wòtsɔna blaa ali dzi gbe sia gbe la ene!

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Esia nenye ame siwo tsɔ nya ɖe ŋunye kple ame siwo le nya vɔ̃e gblɔm ɖe ŋunye la ƒe fetu tso Aƒetɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Aƒetɔ nye Aƒetɔ, wɔ nyui nam le wò ŋkɔ la ta. Esi wò amenuveve nyo ta la, ɖem!

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Elabe ame dahe kple hiãtɔ menye, eye nye dzi xɔ abi le menye.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Nunye yi abe vɔvɔli le fiẽ me ene; woʋuʋum ƒu gbe abe ʋetsuvi ene.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Metsi nu dɔ ʋuu nye klowo gbɔdzɔ; ami no le lã me nam.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Mezu alɔmeɖenu na nunyetsolawo. Ne wokpɔm la, woʋuʋua ta.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Kpe ɖe ŋunye, Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu! Xɔ nam le wò amenuveve la nu!

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Na woanya be wò asie nye esia; wò Aƒetɔ ye wɔe.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Woawo neƒo fi dem faa, gake wò la, yram. Na ŋu nakpe yonyemetilawo; wò dɔla ya nekpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Ame siwo le nunye tsom la, vlododo netsyɔ wo abe avɔ ene; wonedo woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ŋukpe abe awu ʋlaya ene.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye nu ada akpe gã ŋutɔ na Aƒetɔ. Makafui le ameha gã la dome.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Elabe etsia tsitre ɖe hiãtɔ ƒe ɖusime be yeaɖee tso ame siwo tso kufia nɛ la si me.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ be: “Bɔbɔ nɔ nye ɖusime va se ɖe esime metsɔ wò futɔwo wɔ wò afɔɖodzinui.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le wò fiatikplɔ, wò dziɖuŋusẽ gã la, dɔm ɖa tso Zion be: “Ɖu fia le wò ketɔwo dome.”

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Wò dukɔmetɔwo atsɔ wo ɖokui ake faa le wò aʋakpegbe le to kɔkɔeawo dzi. Abe zãmu tso ŋdi ƒe dɔ me ene la, wò sɔhɛwo ava gbɔwò.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ka atam, eye matrɔ susu o. Ebe: “Wòe nye nunɔla tegbee le Melxizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la le wò ɖusime; agbã fiawo gudugudu le eƒe dɔmedzoedogbe.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le dukɔwo dome, eye wòana ame kukuwo nayɔ wo me fũu; agbã fiawo gudugudu ɖe anyigba gbadza la dzi.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ano tsi le tɔʋu sue si le mɔ to la me; eya ta afɔ ta dzi.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
