translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Mada akpe na Aƒetɔ kple nye dzi blibo le nuteƒewɔlawo dome, le amehawo ƒe ha me.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo lolo; ame siwo katã kpɔa ŋudzedze le wo ŋu la, srɔ̃a nu le wo ŋu.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Eƒe dɔwɔwɔ yɔ fũu kple bubu kpakple gãnyenye, eye eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ li tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Enana be woɖoa ŋku eƒe nukudɔwo dzi; amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔlae nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Enaa nuɖuɖu ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ; eɖoa ŋu eƒe nubabla la ɖaa.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Eɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ƒe ŋusẽ fia eƒe dukɔ la, esime wòtsɔ dukɔwo ƒe domenyinu nɛ.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo le eteƒe, le dzɔdzɔe; kakaɖedzi le eƒe sededewo katã ŋu.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Eɖo ɖeɖe ɖe eƒe dukɔ la, eye wòɖo eƒe nubabla anyi tegbee. Eŋkɔe nye kɔkɔe kple ŋɔdzi.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ nye nunya ƒe gɔmedzedze. Ame siwo katã léa eme ɖe asi la, tea ŋu sea nu gɔme nyuie. Eƒe kafukafu li tegbee.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Woyra ame si vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, ame si kpɔa dzidzɔ ŋutɔ le eƒe sededewo ŋu!

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ anɔ eƒe dzidzimeviwo ŋu le anyigba la dzi. Woayra nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe dzidzime.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Nunyoname kple kesinɔnuwo le eƒeme, eye eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ li tegbee.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Kekeli dona ɖe viviti me na nuteƒewɔlawo. Aƒetɔ nye amenuvela, nublanuikpɔla kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Eme nyona na ame si nyoa dɔme, eye wòdoa nu na ame, ame si wɔa eƒe nuwo katã le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Elabe womaʋã ame dzɔdzɔe akpɔ o; woaɖo ŋku edzi tegbee.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mevɔ̃a nyadzɔdzɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke o; eƒe dzi metsona o, eɖoa dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Dzi le eƒo, mavɔ̃ o, va se ɖe esime wòkpɔ be eƒe didi va eƒe ketɔwo dzi.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Enaa nu faa, enaa nu hiãtɔwo; eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ li tegbee. Eƒe dzo dea dzi le bubu me.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi kpɔa esia, eye dzi kunɛ. Eɖua aɖukli, eye wòbuna ɖa. Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe didi medzea edzi nɛ o.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Mikafui! Mi Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlawo, mikafu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ!

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me!

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Edze be woakafu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ tso ɣedzeƒe va se ɖe ɣetoɖoƒe.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kɔ gbɔ dukɔwo katã ta, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kɔ gbɔ dziƒowo ta.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Ame kae le abe Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la ene, ame si bɔbɔ nɔ dziƒo ʋĩi ke,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: eye wòle dziƒowo kple anyigba kpɔm ɖa ʋĩi le ete?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Efɔa ame dahe tso ʋuʋudedi me, eye wòkɔa hiãtɔ ɖe dzi tso dzowɔ me,

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: be yeawɔ wo woabɔbɔ nɔ amegãwo dome, woanɔ eƒe dukɔa ƒe amegãwo dome.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Enaa aƒe konɔ wònɔa eme, eye wòwɔnɛ vi nɔ, dzidzɔkpɔla, si si viwo le. Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Esime Israel ʋu tso Egipte, Yakob ƒe dzidzimeviwo ʋu tso fiafialawo ƒe anyigba dzi la,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda zu eƒe kɔkɔeƒe, Israel zu eƒe dziɖuƒe.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu kpɔe sí dzo, Yordan gbugbɔ ɖe megbe.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Towo ti kpo abe agbowo ene, togbɛwo abe alẽviwo ene.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: O atsiaƒu, nu kae wɔ wò nèsí? O Yordan, nya kae dzɔ nètrɔ dzo?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: O towo, nu ka ta mieti kpo abe agbowo ene? O togbɛwo, nu ka ta mieti kpo abe alẽviwo ene?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Anyigba, dzo nyànyanya le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, le Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋkume!

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: Eyae trɔ agakpe wòzu tá, kpe sesẽ wòzu tsidzɔƒe.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Menye míawo o, Aƒetɔ, menye míawo ŋu nàde bubui o; ke boŋ wò ŋkɔ la ŋue, le wò amenuveve kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Nu ka ta dukɔwo nanɔ biabiam be: “Afi ka gɔ̃ woƒe Mawu la le?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Míaƒe Mawu la le dziƒowo; nu sia nu si dze eŋu lae wòwɔna.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Woƒe legbawo nye klosalo kple sika, amegbetɔ ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwoe.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Nu li na wo; womeƒoa nu o. Ŋku li na wo; womekpɔa nu o.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: To li na wo, womesea nu o. Ŋɔti li na wo; ke womeʋẽa nu sena o.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Asi li na wo; wometéa nu kpɔ o. Afɔ li na wo; womezɔa azɔli o; womewɔa gbeɖiɖi aɖeke tso ve me o.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Wo wɔlawo sɔ kpli wo, eye ame siwo ɖoa dzi ɖe wo ŋu la le abe woawo ke ene.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Israel, ɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu! Eyae nye woƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Aron ƒe ƒome, miɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu! Eyae nye woƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, miɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu. Eyae nye woƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋku le mía ŋu, ayra mí; ayra Israel-dukɔ la, ayra Aron ƒe ƒome la,

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: ayra ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo siaa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nena miadzi fũu, miawo ŋutɔ kple mia viwo siaa!

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ neyra mi, eya ame si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Dziƒowo nye Aƒetɔ ƒe dziƒowo, ke etsɔ anyigba ya na amegbetɔ viwo.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Ame kukuwo mekafua Aƒetɔ o, eye aʋlimeyilawo hã mekafunɛ o.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ke míawo míakafu Aƒetɔ tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me. Mikafu Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Melɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, elabe ese nye gbe kple kokoƒoƒo.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Esi wòɖoa tom ta la, mayɔe esi menya le agbe ko.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Ku ɖo mɔ̀ ƒo xlãm; tsiẽƒe ƒe ŋɔdzi lém, mekpe hiã kple nuxaxa.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Tete meyɔ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ be: “O Aƒetɔ, meɖe kuku, xɔm ɖe agbe!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Amenuvela kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlae nye Aƒetɔ; mía Mawu la nye nublanuikpɔla.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kpɔa ame gblɔewo ta. Esi megbɔdzɔ la, exɔ nam.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Luʋɔnye, trɔ yi nàgbɔ ɖe eme; elabe Aƒetɔ wɔ nyui na wò.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Elabe èɖe nye luʋɔ tso ku me; nye ŋku tso aɖatsi si me, nye afɔ tso nukikli me.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Mele zɔzɔm le Aƒetɔ ŋkume le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Melé nye xɔse me ɖe asi, esime megblɔ be: “Nu te ŋunye ŋutɔ” gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Esi dzi ɖe le ƒonye la, megblɔ be: “Mɔkpɔkpɔ na amegbetɔ ɖe sia ɖe nye nu dzodzro.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Nu ka matsɔ aɖo dɔmenyo gbogbo siwo katã Aƒetɔ wɔ nam la teƒe nɛ?

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe na Aƒetɔ le eƒe dukɔ blibo la ŋkume.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ame kɔkɔewo ƒe ku nye nu xɔasi le eŋkume.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, wò dɔla menye; wò dɔla si nye wò dɔlanyɔnu viŋutsue menye. Wòe tu ka nye bablawo.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Masa akpedadavɔ na wò, eye mayɔ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefewo na Aƒetɔ le eƒe dukɔ blibo la ŋkume,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnuwo le mewò, o, Yerusalem. Mikafu Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, mikafu Aƒetɔ! Midoe ɖe dzi, mi anyigbadzitɔwo katã!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Elabe eƒe amenuveve lolo na mí, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ li tegbee. Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, elabe eƒe dɔme nyo; eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Mina Israel nagblɔ be: “Eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Mina Aron ƒe ƒome nagblɔ be: “Eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Mina ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ nagblɔ be: “Eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Meyɔ Aƒetɔ le xaxa me; Aƒetɔ tɔ nam, eye wòna ablɔɖem.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Esi Aƒetɔ le dzinye ta la, nyemevɔ̃na o. Nu kae amegbetɔ ate ŋu awɔm?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le dzinye be yeakpe ɖe ŋunye. Le dziɖuɖu me makpɔ ame siwo lé fum la ɖa.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Enyo be woasí Aƒetɔ atso wu be woaɖo dzi ɖe amegbetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo katã ɖe to ɖem; Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ mee metsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Woɖe to ɖem, ƒo xlãm le goawo katã me; ke Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ mee metsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Woƒo kɔ ɖe ŋunye abe anyiwo ene, ke wotsí abe aŋɔkadzo ene; Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ mee metsrɔ̃ wo ɖa le.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Wotu asim sesĩe ale be menɔ anyi dzem; ke Aƒetɔ kpe ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye nye ŋusẽ kple nye ha; eyae zu nye xɔname.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Ɖo to, aseyetsotso kple dzidzɔɣli le ɖiɖim le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe agbadɔ me be: “Aƒetɔ ƒe nuɖusi wɔa kalẽ.

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nuɖusi dea dzi, Aƒetɔ ƒe nuɖusi wɔa kalẽ loo!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Nyemaku o, ke boŋ manɔ agbe axlẽ Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo afia.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ he to nam vevie, gake medem asi na ku o.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Miʋu nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe agbowo nam, ne mage ɖe eme ada akpe na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe agboe nye esia; ame dzɔdzɔewoe ato enu age ɖe eme.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na wò be nètɔ nam, eye nèzu nye xɔname.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Kpe si xɔtulawo gbe lae trɔ zu dzogoedzikpe la.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nuwɔnae nye esia, enye nukunu le mía ŋkume.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Esiae nye ŋkeke si Aƒetɔ wɔ; mina míatso aseye, akpɔ dzidzɔ le edzi.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, xɔ na mí, míeɖe kuku! O Aƒetɔ, míeɖe kuku, na míakpɔ dzidzedze.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mawu neyra ame si gbɔna le Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ me. Míeyra mi tso Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye Mawu, eye eyae na kekeli mí. Mibla ŋkekenyui ƒe vɔsalãwo kple ka ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ƒe dzowo ŋu!

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Wòe nye nye Mawu; mada akpe na wò. Wòe nye nye Mawu, mado wò ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, elabe eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee!

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Mawu yra ame siwo ƒe mɔ ŋu mokaka mele o; ame siwo nɔa agbe ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe se la nu.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Mawu yra ame siwo wɔa eƒe ɖaseɖiɖiwo dzi, eye wodinɛ kple woƒe dzi blibo,

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: ame siwo hã mewɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖeke o; ke wozɔa eƒe mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Ède wò sewo, ne woawɔ wo dzi kple moveviɖoɖo.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: O, ŋusẽ ɖe wòanɔ ŋunye be mate ŋu alé wò ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi sesĩe!

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Ekema womado ŋukpem ne melé ŋku ɖe wò seawo katã ŋu o.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Ne mesrɔ̃ wò se dzɔdzɔeawo la, makafu wò kple dzi wɔnuteƒe.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Mawɔ wò ɖoɖowo dzi; mègagblẽm ɖi keŋkeŋ o. Toɖoɖo Aƒetɔ ƒe se la

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Ale ke ɖekakpui ate ŋu anɔ agbe dzadzɛe? To eŋudzɔdzɔ kple wò nya la me ye.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Medi wò kple nye dzi blibo; mègana matra mɔ tso wò seawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Medzra wò nya ɖo ɖe nye dzime, be nyemate ŋu awɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, èdze kafukafu, fia wò ɖoɖowom!

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Meke nu xlẽ se siwo katã do tso wò nu me la fia.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Mekpɔa dzidzɔ ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu, abe ale si mekpɔa dzidzɔ ɖe kesinɔnuwo katã ŋui ene.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Made ŋugble le wò sewo ŋu, eye mali ŋku ɖe wò mɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Madzɔ dzi ɖe wò ɖoɖowo ŋu; nyemaŋlɔ wò nya be o. Dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe se la ŋu

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Lé wò dɔla nyuie be mate ŋu anɔ agbe alé ŋku ɖe wò nya la ŋu.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Ʋu nye ŋkuwo be mate ŋu akpɔ nukunu siwo le wò se la me.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Amedzroe menye le anyigba dzi; mègaɣla wò seawo ɖem o.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ se veve kakaka le wò sewo dim vevie ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Èblu ɖe dàdala, fiƒode te nɔlawo ta; woawoe tra tso wò sededeawo gbɔ.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Ɖe woƒe ŋukpe kple vlodoame ɖa le ŋunye, elabe melé wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be amegãwo bɔbɔ nɔ anyi le nugbe ɖom ɖe ŋunye hã la, wò dɔla ade ŋugble le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo doa dzidzɔ nam; woawoe nye nye adaŋudelawo. Tameɖoɖo kplikpaa be yeaɖo to Aƒetɔ ƒe se la

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ lé ɖe ʋuʋudedi ŋu; gbɔ agbem le wò nya la nu!

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Esi megblɔ nye nuwɔnawo la, èse wo nam; fia wò ɖoɖowom!

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Na mase wò sewo gɔme, eye made ŋugble le wò nukudɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ xa nu ʋuu, ƒo aɖatsi belee; do ŋusẽm le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Te aʋatsomɔ ɖa sãa tso gbɔnye, eye nànyo dɔme afia wò se lam.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Metia nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe mɔ; metsɔ wò sewo ɖo anyi ɖe ŋkunye me.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, meku ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu; mègana ŋu nakpem o!

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Manɔ du dzi ɖe wò seawo dzi wɔwɔ ŋu, ne èna mese wo gɔme nyuie wu. Gbedodoɖa hena nugɔmesese

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, fia wò ɖoɖowo ƒe mɔm; ne mawɔ wo dzi se ɖe nuwuwu.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Na gɔmesesem be mate ŋu alé wò se me ɖe asi, eye mawɔ edzi kple dzi blibo.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Kplɔm to wò sededewo ƒe mɔ dzi, elabe woƒe nu nyo ŋunye.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Trɔ nye dzi ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu, ke menye ɖe viɖe ŋu o.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Na maɖe kɔ ɖa le nu dzodzrowo kpɔkpɔ ŋuti. Gbɔ agbem le wò mɔ la dzi!

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Ɖo kpe wò ŋugbedodo la dzi na wò dɔla; ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la ƒe ŋugbedodo la.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Na ŋukpe si vɔ̃m mele la nu nayi, elabe wò ɖoɖowo nyo.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wò sewo dzi wɔwɔ le dzroyem; le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta la, gbɔ agbem. Dziɖoɖo ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe se la ŋu

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, na wò amenuveve kple wò xɔname nava nam le wò ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Ekema makpɔ ŋuɖoɖo na ame siwo ɖea alɔ me le ŋunye la, elabe meɖoa dzi ɖe wò nya ŋu.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Mègaɖe nyateƒenya la ɖa le nunye keŋkeŋ o, elabe mele mɔ kpɔm na wò sewo.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mawɔ wò se la dzi enuenu tegbee.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Mazɔ ablɔɖetɔe elabe mewɔ wò sewo dzi.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Maƒo nu le wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu le fiawo ŋkume, eye womado ŋukpem o.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Elabe wò sededeawo doa dzidzɔ nam; melɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Medea bubu wò sewo ŋu, esi melɔ̃ wo ta; made ŋugble le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu. Kaka ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe se la dzi

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku wò nya si nègblɔ na wò dɔla la dzi; eyae na mele mɔ kpɔm.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Esia nye akɔfafa nam le nye fukpekpe me, elabe wò ŋugbedodo la gbɔ agbem.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Mawu mavɔ̃lawo le fewu ɖum le ŋunye vevie, gake nyemete ɖa le wò se la ŋu o.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ne mebu wò se siwo li tso blema ke ŋu la, mekpɔa akɔfafa.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Dzi kuam helihelĩ le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ta, elabe wogblẽ wò se la ɖi.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Wò ɖoɖowo nye nye hadzidziwo le nye amedzroƒe la me.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, meɖoa ŋku wò ŋkɔ dzi le zã me, eye medzra wò se la ɖo.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Yayra sia su asinye elabe medzra wò sewo ɖo. Hɛnɔa do ŋugbe be yeawɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe se la dzi

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe nye tɔnye gome; medo ŋugbe be madzra wò nyawo ɖo.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mele kuku ɖem na wò kple nye dzi blibo be nàve nunye le wò ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Ne mebu tame le wò mɔwo ŋu la, metrɔna ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mewɔna kaba, hehe ɖe megbe meli o, be madzra wò sededewo ɖo.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ame vɔ̃ɖi tsɔ ka tre mɔ̀ ɖe to ɖem hã la, nyemeŋlɔ wò se la be o.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Le zã titina la, mefɔna be makafu wò le wò se dzɔdzɔeawo ta.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Menye ame siwo katã vɔ̃a wò kple ame siwo wɔa wò sewo dzi la, xɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò amenuveve xɔ anyigba dzi keŋ; fia wò ɖoɖowom! Aƒetɔ ƒe se la ƒe asixɔxɔ

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, èwɔ nyui na wò dɔla le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Fia nyametsotso nyui kple sidzedzem elabe mexɔ wò sededewo dzi se.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Hafi woahe to nam la, metra; ke azɔ la, medzra wò nya ɖo.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ènyo, eye nèwɔa nyui; fia wò ɖoɖom.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Mawu mavɔ̃lawo ka aʋatso ɖe asinye tsɔ gblẽ ŋunye; gake melé wò sewo me ɖe asi kple dzi blibo.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzi ku atri abe ami ene, ke nye ya, mekpɔa dzidzɔ le wò se la ŋu.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Enyo nam ŋutɔ be wohe to nam be mate ŋu asrɔ̃ wò ɖoɖowo.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Se si tso wò nu me nyo nam wu klosalo kple sika akpe nanewo. Aƒetɔ ƒe se la le dzɔdzɔe

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Wòe wɔm, eye nètrɔ asi le ŋunye; na gɔmesesem be mate ŋu asrɔ̃ wò sededeawo.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la akpɔm, eye woatso aseye elabe mekpɔ mɔ na wò nya la.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, menyae be edrɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe, eye èwɔ nuteƒe be nèhe to nam.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Na wò amenuveve nafa akɔ nam abe ale si nèdo ŋugbe na wò dɔla ene.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nublanui nam ne manɔ agbe, elabe wò se la doa dzidzɔ nam.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe Mawu mavɔ̃lawo elabe wotem ɖe anyi madzemadzee. Nye ya la, made ŋugble le wò sewo ŋu.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Na ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la, natrɔ ɖe ŋunye be woate ŋu anya wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Na nye dzi nawɔ wò ɖoɖowo dzi mokaka manɔmee, ne ŋu nagakpem o! Gbedodoɖa hena ɖeɖe

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ lala wò ʋuu be nàva xɔ nam; mele mɔ kpɔm na wò nya la.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo kpɔ mɔ na wò ŋugbedodowo do kpo. Mebia be: “Ɣe ka ɣi nàfa akɔ nam?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Elabe mezu abe lãgbalẽgolo si ŋu dzɔble bla ɖo ene; ke hã, nyemeŋlɔ wò ɖoɖowo be o.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Ɣe ka ɣi wò dɔla ado dzi ase ɖo? Ɣe ka ɣi nèle ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge yonyemetilawo?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Mawu mavɔ̃lawo ɖe ʋewo ɖi nam; ame siwo mewɔa wò seawo dzi o.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Kakaɖedzi le wò sededewo katã ŋu; amewo le yonyeme tim alakpatɔe; kpe ɖe ŋunye!

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Wowum kloe le anyigba dzi; nyemegblẽ wò sededewo ɖi o.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Na matsi agbe le wò amenuveve la ta, be mate ŋu awɔ wò ɖaseɖiɖi siwo do tso nuwò la dzi. Aƒetɔ ƒe se la dzi xɔxɔ se

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò nya la li ke ɖe dziƒowo sesĩe tegbee.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Wò nuteƒewɔwɔ li tso dzidzime yi dzidzime. Wòe ɖo anyigba anyi, eye wòle tenu goŋgoŋgoŋ.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Le wò gbeɖeɖe nu la, nuwo le te nu va se ɖe egbe, elabe wo katã subɔa wò.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Ne wò sea ɖe medoa dzidzɔ nam o la, anye ne metsrɔ̃ ɖe nye fukpekpe me.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Nyemaŋlɔ wò sewo be akpɔ o; elabe to wo dzi la, èna agbem.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Tɔwò menye; xɔm ɖe agbe, elabe medina be mawɔ wò sewo dzi.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo de xa ɖi be yewoatsrɔ̃m; ke mebua wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: O, ɖe melɔ̃ wò se la lo! Medea ŋugble le eŋu ŋkeke bliboa.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wò sedede la wɔm menya nu wu nye futɔwo elabe ele gbɔnye ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Mesea nu gɔme wu nye nufialawo katã, elabe medea ŋugble le wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Mesea nu gɔme wu ame tsitsiwo, elabe mewɔa wò sewo dzi.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Metea ɖokuinye ɖa tso nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖe sia ɖe wɔwɔ gbɔ, be mawɔ wò nya dzi.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Nyemete ɖa le wò sewo ŋu o, elabe wòe fia num.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Wò nya nye akaɖi na nye afɔ kple kekeli na nye toƒe.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Meka atam, ka ɖe edzi be mawɔ wò se dzɔdzɔeawo dzi.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mele fu kpem vevie. Aƒetɔ, gbɔ agbem le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, xɔ nye kafukafuvɔsa, eye nàfia wò sewom.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Nye agbe ɖoa ŋɔdzi me enuenu, ke nyemeŋlɔ wò se la be o.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tre mɔ̀ ɖi nam, ke nyemetra tso wò seawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo nye nye domenyinu tegbee; ẽ, woawoe doa dzidzɔ na nye dzi.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Metrɔ nye dzi ɖe wò ɖoɖowo dzi wɔwɔ ŋu tegbee va se ɖe nuwuwu. Dedienɔnɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe se la me

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Melé fu susuevetɔwo; ke melɔ̃ wò se la.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Beɖoƒe kple akpoxɔnu nènye nam; mele mɔ kpɔm na wò nya la.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Mi nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo, mite ɖa le gbɔnye, ne mate ŋu awɔ nye Mawu ƒe sededewo dzi.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Lém ɖe te le wò ŋugbedodo la nu be mate ŋu anɔ agbe. Mègana ŋu nakpem le nye mɔkpɔkpɔ me o.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Lém ɖe te, ne manɔ dedie, eye made bubu wò ɖoɖowo ŋu edziedzi.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Ègbe ame siwo katã tra mɔ tso wò ɖoɖowo gbɔ; ẽ, woƒe ayedzedze nye nu dzodzro.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Èwɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã wozu abe numaɖinu ene, eya tae melɔ̃ wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ɖo.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Nye ame bliboa mele vɔ̃wòm hele dzodzom nyànyanya; wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo na vɔvɔ̃ ɖom. Toɖoɖo Aƒetɔ ƒe se la

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Mewɔ nu si le eteƒe kple nu si dzɔ; mègagblẽm ɖe ame siwo tem ɖe anyi la si me o.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: De megbe na wò dɔla hena nyui. Mègana Mawu mavɔ̃lawo natem ɖe anyi o.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo kpɔ mɔ na wò xɔname kple wò ŋugbedodo dzɔdzɔe la do kpo.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyui na wò dɔla le wò amenuveve la nu, eye nàfia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Wò dɔla menye, na mase nu gɔme, ale be mate ŋu anya wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nuwɔɣi ɖo edzi, elabe wotu wò se la.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Eya ta melɔ̃ wò sededewo wu sika, wu sika nyuitɔ gɔ̃ hã!

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Eya ta mewɔa wò sewo katã dzi; melé fu alakpamɔ ɖe sia ɖe. Didi hena toɖoɖo Aƒetɔ ƒe se la

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo wɔ nuku, eya tae nye luʋɔ léa wo me ɖe asi ɖo.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ne wohe wò nya ɖe go la, eklẽna, eye wònana be ame siwo menya naneke o la, sea nu gɔme.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Metsi dzi, ke nu ɖe te, elabe wò sededewo le dzroyem.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋunye, nave nunye abe ale si nèdina be yeawɔ na ame siwo lɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ la ene.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Li ke nye afɔɖeɖewo le wò ŋugbedodo la nu, eye mègana nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖeke naɖu fia ɖe dzinye o!

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso amegbetɔ ƒe teteɖeanyi me, ale be mate ŋu awɔ wò sewo dzi.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Na wò mo naklẽ na wò dɔla, eye nàfia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, dzɔdzɔetɔ nènye, eye nèdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Èɖo wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo anyi le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ katã me.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Nye ŋuʋaʋã le wuyem, elabe nye ketɔwo ŋlɔ wò nyawo be.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Wodo wò ŋugbedodo kpɔ nyuie, eye wò dɔla lɔ̃nɛ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Nyemele ɖeke me o, eye wodo vlom, gake nyemeŋlɔ wò sewo be o.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ le dzɔdzɔe tegbee, eye wò se la nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Fukpekpe kple nuxaxa va dzinye; ke wò sededewo doa dzidzɔ nam.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wò ɖaseɖiɖiawo le dzɔdzɔe tegbee; na gɔmesesem be mate ŋu anɔ agbe. Gbedodoɖa hena ɖeɖe

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Mele yɔwòm kple nye dzi blibo; Aƒetɔ, tɔ nam. Malé wò ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli yɔ wò, xɔ nam, ne malé ŋku ɖe wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mefɔna doa ŋgɔ na fɔŋli, eye medoa ɣli biaa kpekpeɖeŋu. Mekpɔa mɔ na wò nyawo.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo le te hafi zãdzɔɣi naɖo bene made ŋugble le wò ŋugbedodo ŋu.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Le wò amenuveve ta, se nye gbe; Aƒetɔ, le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe ta, dzra nye agbe ɖo.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Ame siwo le yonyeme tim kple susu vɔ̃ɖi la, gogom vɔ; wole adzɔge sãa tso wò se la gbɔ.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ke wò Aƒetɔ la, èle kpuiƒe; wò sededewo katã nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Menya le wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ŋu tso gbe aɖe gbe ke be èɖo wo anyi tegbee. Kukuɖeɖe hena kpekpeɖeŋu

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye fukpekpe ɖa, eye nàɖem elabe nyemeŋlɔ wò se la be o.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Ɖe kuku ɖe tanye, eye nàɖem le nya me. Gbɔ agbem le wò ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Xɔname le aga sãa tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo gbɔ, elabe womedia wò ɖoɖowo o.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ lolo. Gbɔ agbem le wò ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ ta.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Yonyemetilawo kple nye ketɔwo sɔ gbɔ; ke hã, nyemeʋã ɖa tso wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ne mekpɔ ame mawɔnuteƒewo la, dzi kuam elabe womewɔa wò sededewo dzi o.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Bu ale si melɔ̃ wò sewo la ŋu! Dzram ɖo le wò amenuveve la nu.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Wò nya ƒe taƒoƒo nye nyateƒe; wò se dzɔdzɔeawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe li tegbee. Ɖokuitsɔtsɔ sa vɔe na Aƒetɔ ƒe se la

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Amegãwo le yonyeme tim madzemadzee, gake nye dzi ku ɖe wò nya la ŋu kple vɔvɔ̃ gã.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Mekpɔa dzidzɔ le wò nya la ŋu abe ame si kpɔ aboyonu gã ene.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Melé fu aʋatso; enyɔa ŋu nam, ke melɔ̃ wò se la.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke me la, mekafua wò zigbɔzi adrẽ le wò se dzɔdzɔeawo ta.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Ame siwo lɔ̃ wò sea la kpɔa ŋutifafa gã. Naneke mate ŋu ana woakli nu o.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mele mɔ kpɔm na wò xɔname elabe mewɔa wò sededewo dzi.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ dzraa wò ɖaseɖiɖiwo ɖo; melɔ̃ wo vevie ŋutɔ.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Meléa wò sewo kple ɖaseɖiɖiwo me ɖe asi, elabe nye mɔwo katã le ŋkuwò me. Gbedodoɖa hena kpekpeɖeŋu

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, na nye ɣli naɖo gbɔwò; na nugɔmesesem le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Se nye kokoƒoƒo, eye nàɖem le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Make nu akafu wò be èfia wò ɖoɖowom.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Nye aɖe atsɔ wò nya adzi ha elabe wò sededewo katã le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Na wò asi nanɔ klalo be wòakpe ɖe ŋunye, elabe metia wò sewo.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò xɔname le dzroyem vevie. Wò se la doa dzidzɔ nam.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Na manɔ agbe ne mate ŋu akafu wò, eye na wò sewo nakpe ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Metra mɔ abe alẽ si bu la ene; di wò dɔla la, elabe nyemeŋlɔ wò sededewo be o.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Esi meɖo xaxa me la, meyɔ Aƒetɔ kple ɣli be wòatɔ nam:

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ, ɖem tso aʋatsonuyi si me, tso alakpaɖe si me.”

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Wò alakpaɖe, nu ka woatsɔ na wò? Nu ka hã woagawɔ na wò?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Aʋawɔla ƒe aŋutrɔ ɖaɖɛwo kple yɔkuti ƒe dzoka xɔxɔwo!

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Baba nam be medze Mesex-nyigba dzi hele Kedartɔwo ƒe agbadɔwo me.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Nye nɔƒe nɔ ame siwo lé fu ŋutifafa la dome wòdidi akpa.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Nye la, ŋutifafae medina; ke ne meƒo nu la, wowɔa aʋa!

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Mewu mo dzi ɖe togbɛawo ŋu. Afi ka nye kpekpeɖeŋu atso ava?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nye kpekpeɖeŋu atso Aƒetɔ dzi kple anyigba wɔla gbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Mana wò afɔ naʋã o; eya ame si dzɔa ŋuwò madɔ akɔlɔ̃e o.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, eya ame si dzɔa Israel ŋu madɔ akɔlɔ̃e loo, alo alɔ̃ o.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye ŋuwòdzɔla; Aƒetɔ nye wò vɔvɔli le wò ɖusime.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Ŋdɔ maɖu wò le ŋkeke me loo, alo ɣleti hã le zã me o.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ adzɔ ŋuwò tso vɔ̃wo katã me; akpɔ wò agbe ta.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ adzɔ wò dodo kple wò gbɔgbɔ ŋu tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Dzi dzɔm, esime wogblɔ nam be: “Mina míayi Aƒetɔ ƒeme.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, míele tsitre ɖe wò agbowo me!

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Yerusalem, du si wotso, eye wotsiã ɖe enu sesĩe.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Afi mae toawo yina, Aƒetɔ ƒe toawo, abe ale si wode see na Israel be woaɖada akpe na Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ la ene.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Afi mae woɖo fiazikpuiwo anyi na ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le, David ƒe ƒome la ƒe fiazikpuiwoe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Mibia ŋutifafa na Yerusalem be: “Ame siwo lɔ̃ wò la, agbenɔnɔ nedze dzi na wo!

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa nenɔ wò gliwo me, eye dedienɔnɔ nenɔ wò fiasãwo me!”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Le nɔvinyewo kple xɔ̃nyewo ta, magblɔ be: “Ŋutifafa nenɔ mewò!”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Le Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu ƒe aƒe la ta, madi wò nyui.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Wò ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazi dzi le dziƒo, wòe mewu mo dzi na.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Kpɔ nublanui na mí, Aƒetɔ, kpɔ nublanui na mí! Elabe wodo vlo mí ʋuu wògbɔ eme.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔwo ɖe alɔ me le mía ŋu, wòwu dzi na mí; dàdalawo do vlo mí.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Ne ɖe menye Aƒetɔ ye le mía dzi o ɖe? Na Israel nagblɔ azɔ be:

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: Esime amewo tso ɖe mía ŋu ne ɖe menye Aƒetɔ ye le mía dzi o la,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: anye ne womi mí agbagbee. Esime wodo dɔmedzoe helihelĩ ɖe mía ŋu la,

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: anye ne tɔɖɔɖɔ kplɔ mí dzoe, eye tsisisi zɔ to mía dzi yi;

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: anye ne tɔ dzeagbowo mlí to mía dzi.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Mina mída akpe na Aƒetɔ ame si metsɔ mí wɔ adelã na woƒe aɖuwo o!

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Míesí abe xevi si le mɔ̀trela ƒe mɔ̀ka me ene; mɔ̀ka la lã, eye míawo míesí dzo!

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Míaƒe kpekpeɖeŋu le Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ me, ame si wɔ dzi kple anyigba.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ɖoa dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu la, le abe Zion-to si womate ŋu aʋã o, eye wòli tegbee la ene.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Ale si towo ƒo xlã Yerusalem va kpe ɖo la, nenema Aƒetɔ ƒo xlã eƒe dukɔe, tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wɔ nyui na ame nyuiwo kple ame siwo wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe le dzime.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo dze ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ gɔglɔ̃ dzi la, Aƒetɔ akplɔ wo akpe ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ŋu ayii. Ŋutifafa nenɔ Israel!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Esime Aƒetɔ gbugbɔ Zion ƒe nunyonamewo ɖo te la, míenɔ abe ame siwo ku drɔ̃e ene.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Tete míeko nu kakaka, do aseyetsoɣli. Tete wogblɔ le dukɔwo dome be: “Aƒetɔ wɔ nu gãwo na woamawo.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wɔ nu gãwo na mí; dzi le mía dzɔm!

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, gbugbɔ míaƒe nunyonamewo ɖo te na mí, abe ale si nènaa tɔʋu gaɖɔna le anyigbemekegbegbe la ene.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Na ame siwo ƒã nu kple aɖatsi la, naŋe nu kple aseyetsoɣli!

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Ame si le avi fam tsɔ nuku yina ƒaƒã ge la, agbɔ va aƒe kple aseyetsoɣli, atsɔ eƒe lu bablawo agbɔe.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ metu xɔ o la, ame siwo le etum la le dɔ vlo wɔm. Ne Aƒetɔ medzɔ dua ŋu o la, dzɔla la le ŋudzɔ dzodzro.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Dzodzroe miefɔna kaba, eye mieyina ɖadzudzɔna kaba o; be miaɖu nu si miedagba kpɔ le dzimaɖeɖi me la. Elabe enana be ame siwo wòlɔ̃ la kpɔa alɔ̃ dɔna.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, viŋutsuwo nye domenyinu tso Aƒetɔ gbɔ, vidzidɔ me kutsetse ƒe fetue!

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Abe ale si aŋutrɔwo nɔa aʋawɔla si mee ene la, nenemae viŋutsu siwo wodzi le ɖekakpuime la le.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Woyra ŋutsu si ƒe daku me wole fũu. Womado ŋukpee ne eya kple eƒe futɔwo kpe nya le dutakpeƒe o.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Woyra ame sia ame si vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, eye wòzɔa eƒe mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Àɖu wò ŋutɔ wò asinudɔwɔwɔ ƒe kutsetse; àkpɔ dzidzɔ, eye eme anyo na wò.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃wò nyɔnu anɔ abe wainka si tsena ene le aƒewò me. Viwòwo anɔ abe amiti fɛ̃wo ene anɔ wò kplɔ̃ ŋu godoo.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, alea woyra ame si vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ lae.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ neyra wò tso Zion! Nena nàkpɔ Yerusalem ƒe nu nyuiwo le wò agbe me ŋkekewo katã me!

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Nena nàtso viwòwo ƒe viwo ɖo. Ŋutifafa nenɔ Israel dzi!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Israel negblɔ azɔ be: “Wowɔ funyafunyam vevie tso nye ɖekakpuime ke.

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: Wowɔ funyafunyam vevie tso nye ɖekakpuime, gake womeɖu dzinye o.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Agbleŋlɔlawo ŋlɔ nye dzime, eye wodze boliƒo ɖi lebee.”

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla; etso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe kawo ɖa.

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã lé fu Zion la, ŋu nekpe wo woatrɔ ayi megbe.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: esi meyɔa nuŋela ƒe asiʋlo me alo nublala ƒe abɔdome o!

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ale be ame siwo to afi ma le yiyim la megblɔna be: “Aƒetɔ ƒe yayra nenɔ mia dzi! Míeyra mi le Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ me!” o.

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, globoƒe ke mele yɔwòm tsoe!

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, se nye gbe! Lé to ɖe nye kokoƒogbe ŋu.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Ne wò Aƒetɔ, nèbe yeade dzesi nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo da ɖi ɖe, Aƒetɔ, ame kae anɔ te?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ke tsɔtsɔke le gbɔwò bene woavɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Mele Aƒetɔ lalam, nye luʋɔ le lalam; eƒe nyae mele mɔ kpɔm na.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ le Aƒetɔ lalam wu ale si zãdzɔlawo kpɔa mɔ na ŋdi, wu ale si zãdzɔlawo kpɔa mɔ na ŋdi.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israel, kpɔ mɔ na Aƒetɔ! Elabe amenuveve le Aƒetɔ si ale gbegbe, eye ɖeɖe bɔ ɖe esi.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Eya laɖe Israel tso eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo katã me.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye dzi medàna o; nyemeto ŋku gã o, eye nyemetsɔa nu gãwo wɔwɔ kple nu siwo wɔ nuku akpa la doa agba na ɖokuinye o.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Ke mena nye luʋɔ dze kɔ anyi, zi ɖoɖoe, abe ɖevi si wona wòzi ɖoɖoe le nɔa ƒe no nu ene. Nye luʋɔ le abe ɖevi si wona wòzi ɖoɖoe la ene.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Israel, kpɔ mɔ na Aƒetɔ tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋku David dzi, ne nàwɔ nyui nɛ, le fu siwo katã wòkpe la ta;

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: ale si wòka atam na Aƒetɔ, eye wòɖe adzɔgbe na Yakob ƒe Ŋusẽtɔ la be:

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Nyemage ɖe nye aƒeme loo, alo amlɔ anyi ɖe nye aba dzi o;

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime mekpɔ teƒe na Aƒetɔ, nɔƒe na Yakob ƒe Ŋusẽtɔ la.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Míese eŋkɔ le Efrata, eye míekpɔe le Yaar-gbegbe.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: “Mina míayi enɔƒe; mina míade ta agu ɖe eƒe afɔɖodzinu ŋgɔ.”

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, tso, ne nàyi ɖe wò gbɔɖemeƒe la; wò kple nubablaɖaka, wò ŋusẽ la.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Na wò nunɔlawo nado nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ abe awu ene, eye na wò ame kɔkɔewo natso aseye.

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Le wò dɔla David ta, mègatrɔ megbe de wò amesiamina la o.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ka atam na David, eka ɖe edzi nɛ, eye matrɔe o be: “Wò alimeviŋutsuwo dometɔ ɖeka matsɔ aɖo wò fiazikpui dzi.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Ne viwòwo lé nye nubabla kple nye ɖaseɖiɖi siwo mafia wo la me ɖe asi la, mana wo viwo hã anɔ wò fiazikpui dzi tegbee.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ tia Zion; edi be wòanye nɔƒe na ye.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: Ebe: “Afi sia anye nye gbɔɖemeƒe tegbee; afi siae manɔ elabe eyae medi.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Mayra nuɖuɖu na wo fũu; mana woƒe ame dahewo aɖu nu aɖi ƒo.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Maxɔ woƒe nunɔlawo ɖe agbe, eye woƒe ame kɔkɔewo atso aseye.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Gama David ato dzo le; medzra akaɖi ɖo ɖi na nye amesiamina la.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Eƒe futɔwo la, mado ŋukpe wo; ke mana eƒe fiakuku naklẽ le eta.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ale si wònyo kple ale si wòvivinae, ne nɔviwo le anyi le ɖekawɔwɔ me la ɖa!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ele abe ami xɔasi le tame si le tsyɔtsyɔm ɖe ge me, ɖe Aron ƒe ge me hele tsyɔtsyɔm ɖe eƒe awu ʋlaya ƒe kɔme ene.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ele abe zãmu tso Xermon-to dzi, si le tsyɔtsyɔm ɖe Zion-towo dzi ene. Elabe gamae Aƒetɔ ɖo yayra kple agbee tegbee.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Miva, mikafu Aƒetɔ, mi Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlawo katã, mi ame siwo nɔa tsitre ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒeme le zã me!

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Mido miaƒe asiwo ɖe dzi ɖo ɖe kɔkɔeƒe la gbɔ, eye miakafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ neyra mi tso Zion; eya ame si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Mikafu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ! Mi Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlawo, mikafui!

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo tsia tsitre ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒeme, ɖe mía Mawu ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnuwo!

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ elabe Aƒetɔ nyo. Midzi ha kafu eŋkɔ, elabe evea ame nu.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ tia Yakob na eɖokui, etia Israel wòzu eya ŋutɔ tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Elabe menyae be Aƒetɔ lolo, eye mía Aƒetɔ ƒo mawuwo katã ta.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si dze Aƒetɔ ŋu la, eyae wòwɔna le dziƒo kple anyigba, le atsiaƒuwo me kple gogloƒewo katã.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Eyae nana be alilikpo hona yia dzi tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke. Eyae wɔa dzikedzo na tsidzadza, eye wòkplɔa yaƒoƒo doa goe tso eƒe nudzraɖoƒewo.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Eyae nye ame si wu nuwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo le Egipte; amegbetɔwo tɔ kple lãwo tɔ siaa.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Egipte, eyae nye ame si ɖo dzesiwo kple nukunuwo ɖe dowòme, ɖe Egipte Fiagã la kple eƒe dɔlawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Eya ame si tsrɔ̃ dukɔ geɖewo, eye wòwu fia sesẽ siwo nye:

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ woƒe anyigba wɔ domenyinu, domenyinui na eƒe dukɔ Israel.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò ŋkɔ li tegbee. Woaɖo ŋku wò ŋkɔxɔxɔ dzi tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ atso afia na eƒe dukɔ, eye eƒe dɔ me atrɔ ɖe eƒe dɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe legbawo nye klosalo kple sika; amegbetɔwo ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo wonye.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Nu li na wo; ke womeƒoa nu o. Ŋku li na wo; ke womekpɔa nu o.

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: To li na wo; ke womesea nu loo, alo gbɔa ya to nu me o.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wɔ wo le abe woawo ke ene! Ẽ, ame sia ame si ɖoa dzi ɖe wo ŋu la sɔ kple wo.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Israel-dukɔ, mikafu Aƒetɔ! Aron ƒe ƒome, mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Levi ƒe ƒome, mikafu Aƒetɔ! Mi ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ tso Zion. Eya ame si le Yerusalem! Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ elabe eƒe dɔme nyo, eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na mawuwo dzi Mawu la, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na aƒetɔwo dzi Aƒetɔ la, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ɖeɖe koe wɔa nukunu gãwo, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si wɔ dziƒo to nunya me, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si keke anyigba me ɖe tsiwo dzi, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si wɔ nu keklẽ gãwo, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɣe, be wòaɖu ŋkeke dzi, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo be woaɖu zã dzi, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si wu Egipte-nuwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee,

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòkplɔ Israel do tso wo dome dzoe, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo dzoe kple asi sesẽ kpakple abɔ si wodo ɖe dzi, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si ma Aƒlaƒu la me ɖe eve, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee,

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: wòna Israel to eme ɖi go, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: gake ena Egipte Fiagã la kple eƒe aʋakɔ tsi Aƒlaƒu la me, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si kplɔ eƒe dukɔ to gbedadaƒo, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si wu fia gãwo, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee,

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòwu fia xɔŋkɔwo, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Sixon, Amoritɔwo ƒe fia, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: kple Og, Basan-fia, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee,

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ woƒe anyigba wɔ domenyinu, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee;

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: domenyinui na eƒe dɔla Israel, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si meŋlɔ mí be esime wobɔbɔ mí ɖe anyi o, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee,

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: wòɖe mí tso míaƒe ketɔwo si me, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya, ame si na nuɖuɖu ŋutilãwo katã, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na dziƒo Mawu la, elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Le Babilon-tɔsisiwo nu, gamae míebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖo, fa avi, esime míeɖo ŋku Zion dzi.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Míetsɔ míaƒe kasaŋkuwo ku amuti siwo le afi ma la ŋu.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Elabe gamae ame siwo ɖe aboyo mí la, di hawo tso mía si le. Ame siwo le funyafunya wɔm mí la, di tso mía si be míado dzidzɔ na yewo. Wogblɔ be: “Midzi Zion-ha ɖeka na mí!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Ale ke míadzi Aƒetɔ ƒe ha le dzronyigba dzi?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, ne meŋlɔ wò be la, na nye nuɖusibɔ natu!

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Na nye aɖe nalé ɖe aŋɔ ŋu le nye nu me, ne nyemeɖo ŋku dziwò o, ne nyemetsɔ Yerusalem be eyae do dzidzɔ nam wu nu sia nu o.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋku Edomtɔwo kple gbe si gbe Yerusalem gbã la dzi. Wobe: “Migbãe! Migbãe! Nede keke egɔmegɔmea ke!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Babilon vinyɔnu, wò nugblẽla! Woayra ame si laɖo nu si nèwɔ mí la teƒe na wò.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Woayra ame si alé wò ɖevi suewo axlã ɖe agakpe la.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, meda akpe na wò kple nye dzi blibo. Mele wò kafukafuha dzim le mawuwo ŋkume.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Mede ta agu ɖe wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔea ŋgɔ, eye mekafu wò ŋkɔ le wò amenuveve kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ta; elabe ètsɔ wò ŋkɔ kple wò nya gbɔ nu sia nu ta.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe meyɔ wò la, ètɔ nam. Ède dzi ƒo nam, eye nèdo ŋusẽ nye luʋɔ.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, anyigba dzi fiawo katã akafu wò elabe wose wò numenya.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Woadzi ha le Aƒetɔ ƒe mɔwo ŋu elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe bubu lolo.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Elabe togbɔ be Aƒetɔ le dzi ʋĩi hã, eléa ŋku ɖe ɖokuibɔbɔla ŋu, ke wòdzea si dàdala tso adzɔge.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ne meɖo xaxa me la, èdzraa nye agbe ɖo. Èdoa wò nuɖusi ɖa, ɖe nye futɔ siwo do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye la ŋu, eye wò nuɖusi ɖeam.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ awɔ eƒe tameɖoɖo ɖe ŋunye dzi awu enu. Aƒetɔ, wò amenuveve li tegbee! Mègagblẽ wò asinudɔwɔwɔ la ɖi o.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Ne mebɔbɔ nɔ anyi la, ènya; ne metso hã. Èdze si nye susuwo le keke adzɔge ke.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Èdzro nye mɔ kple nye anyimɔmlɔ me, eye nye toƒewo katã le nyanya na wò.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Hafi nya aɖe nado le nunye gɔ̃ hã la, Aƒetɔ, kpɔ ɖa, ènya wo katã xoxo.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Èƒo xlãm le megbe kple ŋgɔ, eye nètsyɔ asi dzinye.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Nunya sia ƒomevi wɔ nuku nam akpa; ekɔ ale gbegbe, nyemate ŋu ase egɔme o.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Afi ka madzo le wò Gbɔgbɔ la gbɔ ayi? Alo afi ka masí tso ŋkuwò me ayi?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Ne melia yi dziƒo la, èle afi ma. Ne memlɔ anyi ɖe tsiẽƒe hã, èle gama.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Ne meto aʋala dzo le ŋdi me yi ɖale atsiaƒu ƒe seƒe ke hã,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: wò asi akplɔm ɖo ayi gama gɔ̃ hã, eye wò nuɖusi além.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Ne mebe: “Viviti netsyɔ dzinye, eye kekeli si me mele nezu zã” hã la,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: viviti gɔ̃ hã medo tsizi le gbɔwò o; zã me kɔ abe ŋkeke me ene elabe viviti le abe kekeli ene le gbɔwò.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Elabe wòe wɔ ŋutinu siwo le menye, eye nèlɔ̃ wo ɖekae le nɔnye ƒe vidzidɔ me.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Mekafu wò elabe vɔvɔ̃ le ŋuwò, eye nèwɔ nuku. Wò dɔwɔwɔwo nye nuku; èdze sim nyuie.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Esime wonɔ wɔyem le bebeme, eye wonɔ ƒu ƒom nye ŋutinuwo aɖaŋutɔe le bome la, nye ƒuwo menɔ ɣaɣla ɖe wò o.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Esime menye ʋukɔe la, èkpɔm xoxo. Èna woŋlɔ nye agbenɔŋkeke ɖe sia ɖe ɖe agbalẽ me, ŋkeke siwo wotia nam esime wo dometɔ aɖeke meli haɖe o.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Mawu, wò susuwo gɔmesese xɔ asi nam loo! Ale ke gbegbe woƒe xexlẽme meli o!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Ne mebe maxlẽ wo la, wosɔ gbɔ wu ké! Esi menyɔ la, gbɔwò ko megale.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖe nàwu ame vɔ̃ɖi la, eye ʋukɔɖilawo nate ɖa le gbɔnye ɖe!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
