translation_verse: Wo, ame siwo ɖo tame vɔ̃ gbe nu le gbɔwò, wotsia tre ɖe ŋuwò hena nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖe nyemelé fu ame siwo lé fu wò oa? Ɖe nyemenyɔa ŋu ame siwo tsona ɖe ŋuwò la oa?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Melé fu wo keŋkeŋ; mebua wo ɖe nye futɔwo dome.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Mawu, dzro menye ne nàdze si nye dzi. Dom kpɔ ne nàdze si nye susuwo!

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Kpɔe ɖa, ne mɔ vɔ̃ɖi aɖe le menye la, kplɔm to mɔ si li tegbee la dzi.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me; dzram ɖo tso ŋutasẽlawo si me!

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu le dzime, eye wodina edziedzi be aʋa nedzɔ.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Woƒe aɖewo ɖana abe da tɔ ene, eye woƒe nyawo le abe ƒli ƒe aɖi ene.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, dzɔ ŋunye tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me; dzram ɖo tso ŋutasẽla siwo ɖoe be yewoade afɔ ata me nam ƒu anyi la si me.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Dàdalawo tre mɔ̀ ɖe adzame nam; woɖo ɖɔ ɖi nam, eye wotre mɔ̀wo ɖe mɔ to nam.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Megblɔ na Aƒetɔ be: “Wòe nye nye Mawu. Aƒetɔ, ɖo to nàse nye kokoƒogbe!”

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye Aƒetɔ, nye Ɖela sesẽ, wòe kpɔ tanye le aʋakpegbe.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mègawɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi la ƒe didi dzi nɛ o; mègada asi ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi si wòɖo la dzi nɛ o.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ɖe to ɖem la, fɔ ta dzi. Na vɔ̃edinamenya si le wo nu la naɖi woawo ŋutɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Na dzoka xɔxɔ nadza ɖe wo dzi! Na woatsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe ʋewo me; womegado go akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.
translation_verse: Mègana aɖeɖiƒoamela aɖeke nali ke le anyigba la dzi o. Na dzɔgbevɔ̃e nayɔ ŋutasẽla la ɖe nu kplíkplikpli.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Menya be Aƒetɔ xɔa fukpelawo ƒe nya ɖe akɔ, eye wòtsoa afia dzɔdzɔe na hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, ame dzɔdzɔewo ada akpe na wò ŋkɔ; nuteƒewɔlawo anɔ ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mele yɔwòm; netsɔ nàva gbɔnye. Ne meyɔ wò la, ɖo to nàse nye gbe.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Na nye gbedodoɖa nanɔ abe lifidzudzɔ ene le ŋkuwò me, eye ne mewu nye asiwo dzi la, nenɔ abe fiẽnuɖuɖuvɔsa ene.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo dzɔla na nye nu, eye nàdzɔ nuyiwo ƒe ʋɔtru ŋu.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Mègatrɔ nye dzi ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi ŋu, ne maɖe fu na ɖokuinye ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu, eye made ha kple ame siwo wɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi la o. Mègana maɖu woƒe nuɖuɖu vivi o.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Na ame dzɔdzɔe naƒom alo wòagbe nya nam kple dɔmekɔkɔ. Ke mègana ame vɔ̃ɖi ya ƒe ami naka nye ta ŋu gbeɖe o. Elabe medo gbe ɖa edziedzi ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo ta.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Ne wotsɔ wo de asi na ame siwo abu fɔ wo la, ekema woasrɔ̃e be Aƒetɔ ƒe nya nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Ale si wokaa agakpe xlãna ɖe anyi wòkakana ɖe anyigbae la, nenema woakaka woƒe futɔwo ahlẽ ɖe tsiẽƒe ƒe nu mee.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Mawu, gake wò ko ŋu nye ŋku le. Wòe mesí tso; mègagbe tanye ʋiʋli o.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nage ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ɖɔ me, ne nye ya masí to eŋu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye gbe do ɣli yɔ Aƒetɔ! Metsɔ nye gbe ƒo koko na Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Metsɔa nye nyawo ɖoa eŋkume, eye megblɔa nu siwo le fu ɖem nam la le eŋkume.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Ne nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu la, ènyaa nye toƒe. Woɖo mɔ̀ ɖe mɔ si dzi metona la dzi nam.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Menyè kɔ kpɔ ɖusime ɖa; ke ame aɖeke meli si léa ŋku ɖe ŋunye o. Sitsoƒe aɖeke megasusɔ nam o; ame aɖeke megaléa be nam o.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe medo ɣli na gblɔ be: “Wòe nye nye sitsoƒe, tɔnye gome, le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: Help! They are chasing me, and they are too strong.
translation_verse: Lé to ɖe nye ɣlidodoa ŋu elabe wobɔbɔm ɖe anyi ŋutɔ! Ɖem tso yonyemetilawo si me, elabe wosesẽ nam akpa!

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso gaxɔ me ne mada akpe na wò! Ame dzɔdzɔewo aƒo xlãm; elabe àwɔ nyui geɖe nam.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, se nye gbedodoɖa; lé to ɖe nye kokoƒoƒo ŋu! Le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me la, tɔ nam!

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mègakplɔ wò dɔla yi ʋɔnui o, elabe agbagbe aɖeke mele dzɔdzɔe le ŋkuwò me o.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Elabe futɔ la ti yonyeme; exlã nye agbe ɖe anyi. Ena mebɔbɔ nɔ viviti me abe ame siwo ku xoxoxo la ene.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Eya ta nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu; nye dzi lulu ɖe menye.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Meɖoa ŋku blemaŋkekewo dzi; medea ŋugble le nu siwo katã nèwɔ la ŋu, mebua tame le wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Mekea nye abɔwo me na wò. Nye luʋɔ le diwòm vevie abe kuɖiɖinyigbae le tsi dim ene.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nètsɔ nàɖo tom; wɔna vɔ le nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu. Mègaɣla wò mo ɖem o. Ne menye nenema o la, maɖi ame siwo yi aʋlime.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Na mase nu tso wò amenuveve ŋu le ŋdi elabe ŋuwòe mele dzi ɖom ɖo. Fia mɔ si mato lam elabe wòe mekɔ nye luʋɔ dzi na.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖem tso nye futɔwo si me! Gbɔwòe mesí va bè ɖo.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Fia wò lɔlɔ̃nuwɔwɔm elabe wòe nye nye Mawu. Na wò gbɔgbɔ nyui la nakplɔm to mɔ sɔsɔe dzi!

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, le wò ŋkɔ ta, dzra nye agbe ɖo! Le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta, ɖem tso xaxa me.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Xa ɖe wò amenuveve la ta nàɖe nye futɔwo ɖa, eye nàtsrɔ̃ nye ketɔwo katã, elabe wò dɔla menye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Woakafu Aƒetɔ, nye agakpe la! Eyae nye ame si fiaa aʋawɔwɔ nye asiwo kple avuwɔwɔ nye asibidɛwo.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Eyae nye nye agakpe kple mɔ́; nye mɔ́ sesẽ kple ɖenyela, nye akpoxɔnu kple ame si me mebèna ɖo. Eyae nye ame si bɔbɔ dukɔwo ɖe ete.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nu kae nye amegbetɔ be nèdea bubu eŋu? Alo amegbetɔ vi be nèbua eŋu?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Gbetɔ le abe ƒuƒu ene; eƒe ŋkekewo le abe vɔvɔli si va yina la ene.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, viã wò dziƒowo ne nàɖi ɖe anyi! Ka asi towo ŋu, ne woatu dzudzɔ!

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Na dzi nake dzo, ne nàka wo hlẽ. Da wò aŋutrɔwo, ne nàtɔtɔ wo.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Do asi ɖa tso dzi ke, xɔ nam, eye nàɖem tso tɔ geɖewo me, tso amedzroviwo si me.

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: ame siwo ƒe nu daa alakpa, eye woƒe nuɖusi nye aʋatsokasi.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mawu, madzi ha yeye na wò; kasaŋku ewo tɔ dzie maƒo ha na wò le.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Wòe na fiawo ɖua dzi; wòe xɔ na wò dɔla David.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Xɔ nam tso yi gblẽnu la si me, eye nàɖem tso amedzroviwo si me. Ame siwo ƒe nu daa alakpa, eye woƒe nuɖusi nye aʋatsokasi.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Na mía viŋutsuwo nanɔ abe ati siwo tsi wɔ nyuie la ene le woƒe ɖekakpuime. Na mía vinyɔnuwo nanɔ abe dzogoedzisɔti siwo wokpa hena fiasãtutu la ene.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Na agblemenuku nayɔ míaƒe avawo taŋtaŋ. Na míaƒe alẽwo nadzi akpewo, eye woadzi ɖe edzi akpe ewowo le míaƒe lãnyiƒewo.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Na míaƒe nyihawo nadzi fũu. Fu megage le wo ŋu loo, alo woatsi vimadzimadzi o. Mègana nuxaɣli aɖeke naɖi le míaƒe ablɔwo me o.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Dukɔ si woyra alea, nekpɔ dzidzɔ! Dukɔ si ƒe Mawue nye Aƒetɔ, nekpɔ dzidzɔ!

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu kple nye Fia, mado wò ɖe dzi! Makafu wò ŋkɔ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me!

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Mada akpe na wò gbe sia gbe, eye makafu wò tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me!

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ lolo; edze kafukafu gã ŋutɔ. Eƒe gãnyenye me dzodzro meli o.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Wò dɔwɔwɔwo kafukafu anɔ dzidzimewo nu, tso ɖeka me yi bubu me. Woaɖe gbeƒã nu dzɔtsu siwo nèwɔ la.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Made ŋugble le wò bubu kple wò fianyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ kpakple nukunu siwo nèwɔna la ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Amewo aɖe gbeƒã wò dɔwɔwɔ dziŋɔwo ƒe ŋusẽ la, eye maɖe gbeƒã wò gãnyenye.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Woaɖe gbeƒã wò ŋkɔxɔxɔ le wò nyonyo sɔgbɔ la ta, eye woadzi ha bobobo le wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ŋu.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔlae nye Aƒetɔ. Medoa dziku kabakaba o; eƒe amenuveve sɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wɔa nyui na amewo katã, eye wòkpɔa nublanui na nu siwo katã wòwɔ la.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã ada akpe na wò, eye wò ame kɔkɔewo katã akafu wò!

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Woagblɔ nya le bubu si le wò fiaɖuƒe me ŋu, eye woaƒo nu le wò ŋusẽ ŋu,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: be woaɖe wò nu dzɔtsu wɔwɔwo kple bubu kpakple wò fianyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ afia amegbetɔ viwo.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Wò fiaɖuƒe nye fiaɖuƒe mavɔ, eye wò fiaɖuɖu anɔ dzidzimewo katã me. Aƒetɔ wɔa eƒe nyawo katã dzi, eye wòɖea eƒe amenuveve fiana le eƒe nuwɔnawo katã me.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Ŋkuwo katã le asiwò nu kpɔm, eye nèna nuɖuɖu wo le enaɣi.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Èʋu wò asi me, eye nèna nu nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe le eƒe hiahiã nu, wòɖi ƒo.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ tsɔ ɖe ame siwo katã yɔnɛ la gbɔ; ɖe ame siwo yɔnɛ le nyateƒe me la gbɔ.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ewɔa ame siwo katã vɔ̃nɛ la ƒe didi dzi na wo; esea woƒe ɣlidodo, eye wòxɔna na wo.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ dzraa ame siwo katã lɔ̃nɛ la ɖo; ke etsrɔ̃a ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Make nu akafu Aƒetɔ, eye nu sia nu si Mawu wɔ la, nekafu eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Makafu Aƒetɔ le nye agbe me ŋkekewo katã me. Madzi ha akafu nye Mawu esime mele agbe.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Migaɖo dzi ɖe amegãwo ŋu o; ɖe amegbetɔ vi si mate ŋu akpe ɖe ame ŋu o la ŋu o.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Ne eƒe gbɔgbɔ nu tsi la, egbugbɔna yia eƒe anyi gbɔ. Gbe ma gbe kee eƒe ɖoɖowo nu yina.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔe nye Yakob ƒe Mawu la, ame si ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ le Aƒetɔ, eƒe Mawu la me,

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: ame si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba, atsiaƒu kple wo me nuwo katã; ame si wɔa nuteƒe tegbee;

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: ame si tsoa afia na ame siwo wote ɖe anyi; ame si naa nuɖuɖu dɔwuitɔwo. Aƒetɔ ɖea ga gamenɔlawo.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ʋua ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔwo. Aƒetɔ fɔa ame siwo wobɔbɔ ɖe anyi la ɖe tsitre. Aƒetɔ lɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kpɔa amedzrowo ta. Ekpena ɖe ahosiwo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo ŋu; ke enana be ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ yia tsɔtsrɔ̃ me.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ aɖu fia tegbee! Zion, wò Mawu la, aɖu fia le dzidzimewo katã me. Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Enyo be woadzi ha akafu mía Mawu la, elabe amenuvela wònye, eye kafukafuhae dzenɛ.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gbugbɔ Yerusalem-dua le tsotsom; ele Israel ƒe aboyomeawo kplɔm gbɔe.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Eda gbe le ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la ŋu, eye wòbla woƒe abiwo.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Eyae ɖo ɣletiviwo ƒe xexlẽme anyi, eye wòtsɔ ŋkɔ na wo katã.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye nye gã; eƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ, womate ŋu ase egɔme akpɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kɔa ame siwo wobɔbɔ ɖe anyi la ɖe dzi; etsɔa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒua gbe ɖe ké me.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Midzi akpedaha na Aƒetɔ! Miƒo kasaŋku dzi ha viviwo na mía Mawu la.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Eyae tsɔa alilikpowo xea dziŋgɔli ŋkume; eyae naa tsidzadza anyigba; eyae nana be gbewo miena ɖe togbɛwo dzi.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Eyae naa nuɖuɖu gbemelãwo kple akpaviavi siwo le xɔxlɔ̃m.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Mekpɔa dzidzɔ le sɔ ƒe ŋusẽ ŋu loo, alo duƒula ƒe afɔ tsɔtsɔe ŋu o.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ kpɔa dzidzɔ le ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la ŋu, ɖe ame siwo kpɔa mɔ na eƒe amenuveve la ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Yerusalem, kafu Aƒetɔ! Zion, kafu wò Mawu la!

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Elabe eyae na wò agbowo ƒe gametiwo sesẽ; eyae yra viwò ŋutsuwo le mewò.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Eyae na wò liƒowo ŋu fa, eye lu ʋã nyuie fũu na wò.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Eyae ɖe gbe ɖo ɖe anyigba, eye eƒe nya le du dzi sesĩe.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Eyae naa tsikpe abe ɖetifu ene, eye wòwua tsi babla abe dzowɔ ene.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Eyae daa eƒe tsi babla hlẽna abe kpekui ene. Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe eƒe vuvɔ nu?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe nya ɖa, eye tsi bablaawo lólo. Eyae na eƒe ya ƒo, eye tsiwo sí.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Eɖe gbeƒã eƒe nya na Yakob, eƒe ɖoɖowo kple sewo na Israel.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Mewɔ esia na dukɔ bubu aɖeke o; womenya eƒe sewo o. Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Mikafu Aƒetɔ tso dziƒowo! Mikafui le kɔkɔƒewo!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Mi eƒe mawudɔlawo katã, mikafui! Mikafui, mi eƒe aʋakɔwo katã!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Ɣe kple ɣleti, mikafui! Mikafui, mi ɣletivi keklẽwo katã!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Mikafui, mi dziƒo ƒe dziƒowo kple mi tsi siwo le dziƒowo tame!

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Mina woakafu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ elabe eyae ɖe gbe, wowɔ wo.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Eɖo wo gɔme anyi tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Eɖo liƒo si womate ŋu atrɔ o la na wo.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ tso anyigba dzi, mi ƒumelã dziŋɔwo, tɔwo ƒe globoƒewo katã;

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: dzo kple dzikpe, tsikpe kple afu kpakple ahom si wɔa eƒe gbe dzi!

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: Mikafui, mi towo kple togbɛwo katã, kutsetsetiwo kple sedertiwo katã;

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: gbemelãwo kple nyihawo katã, nu tatawo kple xe dzodzoewo katã le anyigba dzi!

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Mikafui, mi anyigba dzi fiawo kple dukɔwo katã, amegãwo kple dziɖulawo katã le anyigba dzi;

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo ƒo ƒu, ame tsitsiwo kple ɖeviwo siaa!

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Mina woakafu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ! Elabe eya ŋkɔ koe de dzi; eƒe gãnyenye gbɔ anyigba kple dziƒo ŋu yi.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ekɔ dzo dzi na eƒe dukɔ. Kafukafu neɖi le eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã, Israel, eƒe dukɔ si te ɖe eŋu la, nu! Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Midzi ha yeye na Aƒetɔ! Midzi ha kafui le eƒe nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe takpekpe me.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Mina Israel nakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe eƒe Wɔla ŋu! Mina Zionviwo natso aseye ɖe woƒe Fia ŋu!

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Mina woakafu eŋkɔ kple ɣeɖuɖu! Wonetsɔ asiʋui kple kasaŋku ƒo ha vivi nɛ!

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ kpɔa dzidzɔ le eƒe dukɔ ŋu. Etsɔa dziɖuɖu ɖoa atsyɔ̃ na ɖokuibɔbɔlawo.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Mina nuteƒewɔlawo nakpɔ dzidzɔ elabe wode bubu wo ŋu. Mina woadzi ha kple dzidzɔ le woƒe abawo dzi.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Mina woakɔ gbe me akafu Mawu sesĩe, eye woalé yi nuevee ɖe asi

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: ne woabia hlɔ̃ dukɔwo eye woahe to na anyigba dzi dukɔwo.

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Woade kɔsɔkɔsɔ woƒe fiawo, eye woade kunyowu woƒe bubumewo.

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Woahe to na wo alea, le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ si woŋlɔ ɖi ɖe wo ŋu la nu. Esia nye bubu si woade eƒe nuteƒewɔlawo katã ŋu. Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Mikafu Mawu le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la me. Mikafui le eƒe alili sesẽ la me.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Mikafui le nu klitsu siwo wòwɔ la ta! Mikafui le eƒe gãnyenye manyagblɔ la nu.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Mikafui kple kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi! Mikafui kple saŋku kpakple kasaŋku!

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Mikafui kple asiʋui kpakple ɣeɖuɖu! Mikafui kple kasaŋku kpakple dze!

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Mina nu sia nu si me gbɔgbɔ le la nakafu Aƒetɔ! Mikafu Aƒetɔ!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Israel-fia Salomo, David vi la ƒe lododowoe nye esiawo:

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Wonana be ame dzea nunya, eye wòxɔa hehe; wonana be ame sea nya detowo gɔme.

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Wonaa hehe ame wòwɔa nu nunyatɔe; wonana be wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, tia nya dzɔdzɔe yome, eye wòtsoa nya me sɔsɔe.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Wofiaa aɖaŋudzedze ame makpɔnuteƒewo, eye wowɔa sɔhɛwo sidzelawo kple tamebulawoe.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Nunyala nese lododoawo, ne wòadzi eƒe nunya ɖe edzi; nugɔmesela nese wo, ne wòadze aɖaŋu ɖe edzi,

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: bene wòase lododowo, abebubuwo, nunyala ƒe nyawo kple adzowo gɔme. Nuxlɔ̃amenya na sɔhɛwo

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃e nye nunya ƒe gɔmedzedze; bometsilawo doa vlo nunya kple amehehe.

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Vinye, ɖo to tɔ́wò ƒe amehehe, eye mègagbe nɔwò ƒe nufiame o,

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: elabe tablanu dzeani wonye na wò ta, kɔmegɛ atsyɔ̃ɖonu na wò kɔ.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Vinye, ne nuvɔ̃wɔlawo le nuwò blem la, mègalɔ̃ o.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Ne wobe: “Va míyi, míaɖade xa, awu ame. Na mífiti ame maɖifɔ dzodzro ko.

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: Míatsrɔ̃ wo abe ale si tsiẽƒe miaa ame agbagbee ene, ne woaɖi wo bliboe abe ale si woyia aʋlimee ene.

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: Míaƒe asi asu kesinɔnu nyuiwo dzi, míatsɔ aboyonu ayɔ míaƒe xɔwo me.

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: Va wɔ ɖeka kpli mí, gakotoku ɖeka nanɔ mí katã si” la,

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: vinye, mègazɔ kpli wo o; mègaɖo afɔ woƒe toƒe o.

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Elabe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu wole du dzi ɖo, eye ʋukɔkɔɖi ŋu wole abla ɖem ɖo.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Elabe dzodzroe woɖoa mɔ̀ na xevi le xevia ŋkume.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Ke ame siawo de xa ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbe ŋu; woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbe ŋu wole adeklo dzi ɖo.

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Alea ko wòwua enu na ame siwo katã tsɔa ŋutasesẽ tia viɖe yomee: Viɖe lae ɖea ekpɔlawo ƒe agbe ɖa. Nunya le amewo yɔm

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nunya le ɣli dom bobobo le ablɔ dzi; ekɔ gbe dzi le asiwo me.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Ele ɣli dom le ame yɔm le dutakpeƒe le gbɔgblɔm le dua ƒe agbowo nu be:

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “O, movitɔwo, ɣe ka ɣi miadzudzɔ movinuwɔwɔ? Fewuɖulawo ɖe, ɣe ka ɣi woadzudzɔ fewuɖuɖu? Bometsilawo ɖe, ɣe ka ɣi woadzudzɔ fuléle nunya?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Milé to ɖe nye mokaname ŋu. Kpɔ ɖa, matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ akɔ ɖe mia dzi, eye mana miadze si nye nyawo.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Miedo toku nye aɖaŋuɖoɖowo katã, eye miegbe nye mokaname.

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Ne ŋɔdzi lɔ mi ɖe nu abe ahomya ene, ne miaƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ho va lɔ mi abe yali gblẽnu ene eye hiã kple xaxa ɖi kpe mi la,

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: woayɔm, ke nyematɔ o; woadim vevie, ke womakpɔm o,

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: elabe wolé fu nunya eye wometia Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Elabe wogbe nye aɖaŋuɖoɖo, eye wodo vlo nye mokanamewo katã.

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: Eya ta woaɖu woƒe nuwɔnawo ƒe kutsetse wòati ko na wo.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Elabe ame makpɔnuteƒewo la, amegbemasemasee wua wo, eye bometsilawo la, kakaɖeameɖokuidzie tsrɔ̃a wo.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ke ame si ɖoa tom la, anɔ anyi le dziɖeɖi me, eye ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e do ŋɔdzi nɛ la, dzi maɖe le eƒo o.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne èxɔ nye nyawo, eye nèlé se siwo mede na wò la me ɖe asi sesĩe,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: ne èɖo to nunya nyuie, eye nètrɔ dzi ɖe eŋu, se egɔme,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: ẽ, ne èdi nunya deto kple ɣli, eye nèkɔ wò gbe dzi yɔ nugɔmesese,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: ne èdii abe klosalo ene, eye nèti eyome abe kesinɔnu si wotsɔ ɣla ene la,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ekema àse Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ gɔme, eye àke ɖe sidzedze Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ ye naa nunya, eƒe nu mee sidzedze kple gɔmesese do tso.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Edzraa nunya vavãtɔ ɖo ɖi na nuteƒewɔlawo, eye wòxɔna na mokakamanɔŋutɔwo.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: Ekpɔa nya dzɔdzɔe yomenɔlawo ƒe nuwɔnawo ta, eye wòdzɔa mawumemewo ƒe mɔ ŋu.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ekema àse nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, nya dzɔdzɔe yome nɔnɔ kple nyametsotso sɔsɔe kpakple agbe nyui nɔnɔ ɖe sia ɖe gɔme.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Elabe nunya age ɖe dzime na wò, eye sidzedze ado dzidzɔ na wò luʋɔ,

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: nuwɔwɔ ɖe nunya me akpɔ tawò, eye nugɔmesese adzɔ ŋuwò.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Woaɖe wò tso mɔ vɔ̃ dzi, eye womana nàde ha kple nu trama ƒola o.

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: Ame siawo gbe nuteƒewɔwɔ, eye wole agbe le viviti me.

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: Wokpɔa dzidzɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu, eye wotsoa aseye ɖe nu tovo wɔwɔ ŋu.

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: Woƒe toƒe le gɔdɔgɔdɔ̃, eye wotra le woƒe mɔ dzi.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Nunya kple nugɔmesese aɖe wò tso nyɔnu dzeha, gbolo, si ɖea ami ɖe eƒe nyawo la si me.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: Eyama gblẽa eƒe ɖetugbimesrɔ̃ ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa nubabla kple eƒe Mawu be.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Eƒe aƒe ɖo ta ku gbɔ; eƒe afɔtoƒewo yina ɖe aʋlime.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke meyia egbɔ gagbɔna o; womegatrɔna va tsoa agbemɔ o.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Esia ta to ame nyuiwo ƒe mɔ dzi, eye nàzɔ ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe toƒe ɖaa.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Elabe nuteƒewɔlawoe anɔ anyigba la dzi; ame mokakamanɔŋutɔwoe asusɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Ke woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖa le anyigba la dzi, eye woaho ame maɖoŋuɖeŋuwo ɖa kple ke le edzi.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Vinye, mègaŋlɔ nye nufiame be o, ke na wò dzi nadzra nye sewo ɖo.

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: Elabe woadzi wò agbe me ŋkekewo ɖe edzi, wò ƒèwo asɔ gbɔ, eye nàkpɔ ŋutifafa.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Mègadzudzɔ nuteƒewɔwɔ kple nyateƒetoto gbeɖe o. Tsɔ wo de kɔ; ŋlɔ wo ɖe wò dzi ŋu.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu kple amegbetɔwo ave nuwò, eye woakpɔ ŋudzedze le ŋuwò.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu kple wò dzi blibo. Mègaɖo ŋu ɖe wò ŋutɔ wò nugɔmesese ŋu o.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Wò susu nenɔ Mawu ŋu le wò nuwɔnawo katã me, ekema ana wò mɔ nadzɔ.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Mègabu ɖokuiwò nunyalae o. Vɔ̃ Aƒetɔ, eye nàtsri vɔ̃.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Esia ada gbe le wò ŋutilã ŋu, eye wòana dzidzeme wò ƒuwo.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò nunɔamesiwo kple wò nuku gbãtɔwo katã de bubu Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: Ekema nuku ayɔ wò ava, eye wain agbagba le wò ahadzraɖoƒe.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Vinye, mègagbe Aƒetɔ ƒe amehehe o; eƒe mokaname megati wò o.

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Elabe ame si Aƒetɔ lɔ̃ la, eyae wòkaa mo na, abe viŋutsu si gbɔ tɔ́a melɔ̃a nu le o la ene.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Ame si ke ɖe nunya ŋu, kpɔa dzidzɔ; ame si ƒe asi su gɔmesese dzi la, kpɔa dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Elabe eme viɖe nyo wu klosalo, eye emetsonu nyo wu sika.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Exɔ asi wu dzonu xɔasitɔ. Nu siwo dzroa wò la, ƒe ɖeke mate ŋu ade enu o.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Elé agbe didi ɖe ɖusi, eye wòlé kesinɔnu kple bubu ɖe mia.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Eƒe mɔwo dzi vivina, eye ŋutifafa le eƒe toƒewo katã.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Ati si naa agbe la wònye na ame siwo lée ɖe asi la, woyɔa ame siwo lée goŋgoŋ la, be dzidzɔmewo.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nunya Aƒetɔ tsɔ ɖo xexea me gɔme anyii, eye nugɔmesese wòtsɔ li ke dziƒowoe.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Eƒe sidzedzee na tɔwo gɔme ŋɔ, eye alilikpowo dza zãmu.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Vinye, lé nunya vavãtɔ kple nuwɔwɔ nunyatɔe me ɖe asi; mègana woadzo le wò ŋku dzi o.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: Ekema woanye agbe na wò luʋɔ kple atsyɔ̃ɖonu na wò kɔ.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Ekema àzɔ dedie le wò mɔ dzi, eye wò afɔ makli nu o.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Ne èbɔbɔ nɔ anyi la, màvɔ̃ o. Ne èmlɔ anyi la, alɔ̃ avivi na wò.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Ne ŋɔdzi do kpata, alo dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi la, dzika megatso ƒowò o.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ ŋue nèɖoa ŋu ɖo; mana wò afɔ nage ɖe mɔ̀ me o.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Ne àte ŋui la, mègagbe nyuiwɔwɔ na ame si wòdzena la o.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Mègagblɔ na hawòvi be: “Yi, nàgbugbɔ ava, etsɔ matsɔe na wò” esime nua le asiwò hafi o.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Mègaɖo vɔ̃ ɖe hawòvi, ame si le gbɔwò le ŋu ɖom ɖe ŋuwò la, ŋu o.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Ne ame mewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò o la, mègawɔ dzre kplii dzodzro o.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Mègaʋã ŋu sesẽnuwɔla o, eye eƒe nuwɔna aɖeke megadzɔ dzi na wò o.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ lé fu nu vlo wɔla, ke tsi metoa eya kple nuteƒewɔla dome o.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe fiƒode le ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aƒe dzi; ke eyraa ame dzɔdzɔe ya ƒe nɔƒe.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Eɖua fewu le fewuɖulawo ŋu, gake evea ɖokuibɔbɔlawo ya nu.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Viwo, mise vi tɔ́ aɖe ƒe nufiame; milé to ɖe eŋu nyuie ne miase nu gɔme.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Elabe aɖaŋu nyui ɖom mele na mi; migaɖe asi le nye nufiame ŋu o.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Esi menye viŋutsuvi dzaa na tɔ́nye kple vi ɖekɛ na nɔnye la,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: tɔ́nye fia num. Egblɔ nam be: “Lé nye nyawo ɖe tame nyuie. Wɔ nye sededewo dzi, ne nànɔ agbe.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Di nunya! Di gɔmesese! Mègaŋlɔ nye numenya be o, eye mègagblẽ wo ɖi o.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Mègaɖe asi le nunya ŋu o, ekema adzra wò ɖo. Lɔ̃e, ekema adzɔ ŋuwò.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nunya ƒe gɔmedzedze nye esi: Di nunya. Le nu sia nu si le asiwò dome la, gɔmesese nanye vevitɔ.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Bui nu xɔasii, ne wòado wò ɖe dzi. Ade bubu ŋuwò ne èkpla asi kɔ nɛ.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Atsɔ tablanu dzeani abla ta na wò, atsɔ fiakuku nyakpɔ aɖɔ na wò.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Vinye, se nye nyawo, ne nàxɔ wo, bene nànɔ agbe, axɔ ƒè geɖee.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Ne èle zɔzɔm la, naneke maɖo ata me na wò o. Ne èle du dzi hã, màkli nu o.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Lé nu si wofia wò la me ɖe asi sesĩe; mègaɖe asi le eŋu o. Dzɔ eŋu, elabe eyae nye wò agbe.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Mègato ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe afɔtoƒe o; mègazɔ afi si nu vlo wɔlawo zɔna o.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Gbe nu le mɔ ma gbɔ, mègato edzi o. Dze to mɔ bubu nàdzo.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Elabe woawo la, ne womewɔ vɔ̃ o kpaa, womedɔa alɔ̃ o; ne womeƒu ame anyi o la, alɔ̃ buna ɖe wo.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔe nye woƒe nuɖuɖu; ŋutasesẽe nye woƒe aha wonona.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe toƒe ya le abe agudzedze ene. Eklẽna gaklẽna ɖe edzi, va se ɖe esime ŋu kena keŋ.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ le abe blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi ene; womenya nu si kli ge woala o.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Mègana woadzo le wò ŋku dzi o; dzra wo ɖo ɖe wò dzime ke.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Elabe agbe wonye na ame siwo ke ɖe wo ŋu; woyɔa dɔ ameti blibo la.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Nɔ ŋudzɔ vevie le wò dzi ŋu, elabe ŋudzɔnɔnɔ me agbe dona tso.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Tsri alakpadada na wò nu, eye nàte wò nuyi ɖa tso aʋatsokaka gbɔ.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Na wò ŋku nakpɔ ŋgɔ tẽe; kpɔ ŋgɔ tututu.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Ɖe toƒe dzɔdzɔe na ɖokuiwò, eye kakaɖedzi anɔ wò mɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Mègadze ɖe ɖusi alo miame o. Te ɖa tso vɔ̃ gbɔ.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Vinye, lé to ɖe nye nunya ŋu; ƒu to anyi ɖe nye nugɔmesese ŋu,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: bene nàwɔ nu nunyatɔe, eye wò numenya nalé sidzedze ɖe te.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Elabe nya si dona le nyɔnu ahasitɔ nu la, le abe anyitsi si le tsyɔtsyɔm la ene, eye eƒe nuƒo zrɔ̃ lalalã wu ami;

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: ke le nuwuwu la, eva vena wu tsa, eye wòɖana abe adekpui nuevee.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Eƒe afɔ ɖia abu yia ku gbɔ, eye eƒe afɔtoƒe ɖoa ta tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Metoa agbemɔ dzi tẽe yina o, etsaa tsa glalã; ke eya ŋutɔ menyana o.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Eya ta vinyewo, miɖo tom, eye migate ɖa le nye numenyawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Miƒo asa na nyɔnu sia tɔgbe! Migagogo eƒe ʋɔtru gɔ̃ hã o,

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: ne menye nenem o la, miatsɔ miaƒe bubu ana ame tutɔwo, miaƒe ƒewo ana ŋutasẽlawo.

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, amedzrowo aɖu miaƒe kesinɔnu aɖi ƒo, eye nu si miedagba kpɔ la, ayi ame manyamanya ƒeme.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Le wò agbe ƒe nuwuwu, ne wɔna vɔ le wò ŋutilã kple wò ameti bliboa ŋu la, àɖe hũ,

english_verse: and shout, “I hated advice and correction!
translation_verse: agblɔ be: “Ao, melé fu hehexɔxɔ! Nye dzi do vlo mokaname.

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Megbe nye nufialawo ƒe gbesese; nyemelé to ɖe woƒe nufiame ŋu o.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖi kpem kloe, le ameha siwo ɖi anyi la dome.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: No tsi tso wò ŋutɔ wò tsido me; no tsi nyui si le dzidzim tso wò ŋutɔ wò vudo me.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò tsidzidziwo agbagba ɖe mɔ mea? Ɖe wò tɔʋuwo atsa le ablɔwo dzia?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Na woanye wò ɖeɖe ko tɔ, menye wò kple amedzrowo tɔ o.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Wò vudo nanye yayra, eye nàkpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Zi nyakpɔ, zinɔ dzetugbe wònye. Na eƒe no nade dzo lã me na wò ɖaa; eƒe lɔlɔ̃ namu wò ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Ke vinye, nu ka ta nyɔnu bubu atɔtɔ wò abe ɖe nèmu aha ene? Nu ka ta nàlé gbolo amia ɖe ɖokuiwò ŋu?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Gbetɔ ƒe toƒe le nyanya na Aƒetɔ, eyae taa eƒe mɔwo katã nɛ.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwoe lénɛ, eye eƒe nuvɔ̃woe blanɛ.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Hehexɔxɔ manɔmee la, ame ɖe wòkuna, eye bometsitsi vivivo kplɔa ame tranae.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne ède megbe na hawòvi, ne èlé fe nu na amedzro aɖe,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: ne wò nu de wò mɔ̀ me, eye wò numenya lé wò bla la,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ekema ège ɖe hawòvi si me. Vinye, nu si nàwɔ aɖe ɖokuiwò lae nye esi: Yi egbɔ, bɔbɔ ɖokuiwò, eye nàƒo koko nɛ vevie.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Tsi zãdomadɔlɔ̃e; mègadɔ akɔlɔ̃e teti hã o.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Ɖe ɖokuiwò abe ale si sãde ɖea eɖokui tso adela si mee, abe ale si xevi ɖea eɖokui tso mɔ̀trela si mee ene.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Wò kuviatɔ, yi anyidi gbɔ; kpɔ eƒe nuwɔna ɖa, ne nàdze nunya!

english_verse: Ants don't have leaders,
translation_verse: Kplɔla, dzikpɔla alo dziɖula aɖeke mele esi o.

english_verse: but they store up food during harvest season.
translation_verse: Ke edzraa eƒe nuɖuɖu ɖo le dzomeŋɔli, eye wòƒoa ƒu eƒe nunyiame ɖi le nuŋeɣi.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ, ɣe ka ɣi nànɔ aba dzi va se ɖo? Ɣe ka ɣi nànyɔ tso alɔ̃ me?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Ne èbe: “Madɔ alɔ̃ vie, madɔ akɔlɔ̃e vie, made asi ata me, madzudzɔ vie” la,

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: ahedada aɖi ɖe wò abe fiafi ene, eye koɖoɖo ado ɖe dziwò abe adzoblasu ene.

english_verse: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
translation_verse: Emiaa ŋku ɖe ame, nɔa afɔ titim ɖe anyigba, eye wòtsɔa asi wɔa dzesii.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Enye ayeme, eɖoa vɔ̃ ɖe tame ɣe sia ɣi, eye wòdea dzre ame dome.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Eya ta dzɔgbevɔ̃e adzɔ ɖe eyama dzi kpata, agbã enumake, eye mate ŋu ahaya o.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Nu adee Aƒetɔ lé fui; ẽ, adrẽ nye ŋunyɔnu nɛ:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: dàdaŋku alakpaɖe asi si kɔa ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: dzi si wɔa ɖoɖo vɔ̃wo, afɔ si ɖea abla ɖe vɔ̃wɔwɔ ŋu,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: aʋatsoɖasefo si daa alakpa kple ame si dea dzre nɔviwo dome. Nyagbename le ahasiwɔwɔ ŋuti

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Bla wo ɖe wò dzi ŋu ɣe sia ɣi, eye nàsa wo ɖe kɔ.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Ne èle azɔli dzi la, woakplɔ wò; ne èmlɔ anyi la, woadzɔ ŋuwò, eye ne ènyɔ la, woaɖo dze kpli wò.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Elabe sea nye akaɖi, eye nufiamea nye kekeli, eye mokaname si naa hehe la, nye agbemɔ,

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: bene woaɖe wò tso nyɔnuvɔ̃ɖi la si me, tso nyɔnu ahasitɔ ƒe amenubeble me.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Mègana eƒe tugbedzedze nadzro wò o. Eƒe aɖaba negaɖe aboyo wò o.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Elabe gbolo la, abolo kakɛ ƒe asi ko wòxɔna; ke nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ ya la, ŋutsu ƒe agbe xɔasi kekeake minyam wòle.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Ɖe ame aɖe dzo ɖe akɔ nu, eye mafiã eƒe awu oa?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe ame azɔ dzoka dzi, eye eƒe afɔ mafiã oa?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Alea pɛ wòle na ŋutsu si di ehavi srɔ̃; ame sia ame si de asi ame srɔ̃ ŋu la, womagbe tohehe nɛ o.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Ne dɔ wu fiafitɔ, wòfi nu ɖu la, ɖe amewo medoa vloe oa?

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Ne wolée la, aɖo eteƒe zigbɔzi adrẽ, eye wòatsɔ eƒe aƒemenuwo katã ana.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Gake ŋutsu si wɔ ahasi kple nyɔnu la, susu mele esi o. Ŋutsu si wɔe tsrɔ̃ eɖokui.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Abi kple vlododo ko wòakpɔ, eye eƒe ŋukpe nu matsi o.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Elabe ŋuʋaʋã nana be ŋutsu doa dɔmedzoe vevie, eye mekpɔa nublanui ne ele hlɔ̃ biam o.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Ayifaɖe aɖeke madze eŋu o, eye malɔ̃ be nunana gbogbowo hã nafa akɔ na ye o.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Vinye, lé nye nyawo me ɖe asi, eye nàdzra nye sededewo ɖo ɖe mewò.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Lé nye sededewo me ɖe asi, ne nànɔ agbe. Lé be na nye nufiame abe wò gadaglamakui ene.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Bla wo ɖe wò asibidɛwo ŋu; ŋlɔ wo ɖe wò dzi ƒe kpe dzi.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na nunya be: “Wòe nye nɔvinye nyɔnu,” eye nàyɔ gɔmesese be xɔlɔ̃ vevi,

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: bene woaɖe wò tso nyɔnu dzeha, gbolo, si ɖea ami ɖe eƒe nyawo la si me. Nyɔnu gbegblẽ la

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Menɔ nye xɔ ƒe fesre nu, le nu kpɔm to adzrala me.

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: Ezɔ to mɔ si le nyɔnu aɖe ƒe dzogoe dzi yina, eye wòzɔ ɖo ta eƒe aƒe gbɔ.

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: Fiẽ me ye, anyigba le tsyɔtsyɔm, eye zã kple blukɔ do vɔ.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Kasia nyɔnu aɖe si do awu abe gbolo ene la va do goe. Aye le susu me nɛ.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Enye ɣlidola kple ame gbegblẽ, eye eƒe afɔ metɔna ɖe aƒeme o.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Kasia, ele mɔ to; kasia, ele asi me; sẽe ko, ede xa ɖe dzogoe dzi.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Elé ɖekakpuia, gbugbɔ nu nɛ, eye wòɖo ŋkume kplalaa, gblɔ nɛ be:

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Ele nam be masa vɔ, eye egbea mexe nye adzɔgbeɖefe.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Eya ta medo va be mado go wò. Wò ko dim mele vevie; azɔ meke ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meɖo kuntru kple abadzivɔ ŋɔŋɔe, si wotsɔ Egipte-ka lɔ̃e la ɖe nye aba dzi.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mewu ami ʋeʋẽe si wotsɔ kotoklobo, dzogbebable kple amiti wɔe la ɖe edzi.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Elabe srɔ̃nye mele aƒe o; eyi mɔdzi.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Eyi kple gakotoku; ɣleti asɔ tegblẽe hafi wòagbɔ va aƒe.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe nya ŋanɛwo ble ɖekakpuia nu, eye wòtsɔ amenublenya viviwo lée.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Ekplɔ nyɔnua ɖo enumake, abe nyitsu si woyina wuwu ge ene; abe sẽ si zɔ yina mɔ̀ me,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: va se ɖe esi aŋutrɔ nadrò eƒe dɔka ene. Ele abe xevi si lũ ɖe mɔ̀ dzi, eye menya be yeƒe agbe ƒe seƒee nye ema o ene.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, azɔ la, miɖo tom; milé to ɖe nye numenyawo ŋu.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Migana miaƒe dzi natrɔ ɖe nyɔnu sia tɔgbe ŋu o; migatra yi eƒe toƒewo o.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Elabe ame siwo wòƒo ƒu anyi la sɔ gbɔ; ame gbogbo aɖe wòtsrɔ̃.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe ƒe mɔ to eƒeme; ekplɔa ame gena ɖe ku ƒe xɔdɔmewo me.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Ɖe nunya mele ɣli dom oa? Ɖe nugɔmesese ƒe gbe mele ɖiɖim oa?

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Ele tsitre ɖe togbɛwo dzi le mɔ to; ele mɔ dogoewo nu.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Ele ɣli dom le agboawo xa, le dua ƒe mɔnu kple ʋɔtruawo nu. Ebe:

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔwoee, miawo yɔm mele. Amegbetɔ viwoee, miawo mekɔ gbe dzi na.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Mi bometsilawo, midze nunya. Mi movitɔwo, mise nu gɔme.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Mise ɖa, elabe nya veviwoe magblɔ. Nu si le eteƒe tututu la, eyae make nu agblɔ.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Make nu agblɔ nyateƒe la; nye nu tsri nya vɔ̃ɖi gbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Nye numenyawo katã le dzɔdzɔe; beble kple alakpa mele wo me o.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Wo katã me kɔ na nugɔmesela, eye wosɔe na ame si ke ɖe sidzedze ŋu.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Mixɔ nye nufiame ɖe klosalo teƒe, eye mixɔ sidzedze ɖe sika nyuitɔ teƒe.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Elabe nunya nyo wu dzonu nyuitɔ, eye naneke meli nàdi wòade enu o.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Nye nunya, mele anyi le aɖaŋu me, eye asinye mee sidzedze kple nyametsotso nyuitɔ le.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃e nye fuléle vɔ̃. Melé fu dàda, ɖokuidodoɖedzi, mɔ vɔ̃ dzi toto kple alakpanyagbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Aɖaŋuɖoɖo kple nunya vavãtɔ le asinye. Nugɔmesese le asinye. Ŋusẽ le asinye.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Dzinyee fiawo tona ɖua fia; dzinyee dziɖulawo tona dea se dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Dzinyee amegãwo tona ɖua dzi, eye bubumewo ɖua anyigba dzi.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Melɔ̃a ame siwo lɔ̃am, eye ame siwo diam vevie la, kpɔam.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu kple bubu le asinye; nunɔamesi kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ siwo megblẽna o la, le gbɔnye.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Nye kutsetse nyo wu sika. Ẽ, enyo wu sika nyuitɔ gɔ̃. Nye viɖe xɔ asi wu klosalo nyuitɔ.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: bene mama kesinɔnu na ame siwo lɔ̃am, eye made nu woƒe nudzraɖoƒe, wòayɔ.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wɔm esime wòdze eƒe dɔ gɔme; nyee nye eƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe ŋgɔgbetɔ tso blema ke.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Eɖom anyi tso tititi ke, nyee wòɖo gbã hafi anyigba nava dzɔ.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Wodzim hafi tɔ goglowo nava do; medo ŋgɔ na tsidzɔƒe siwo me tsi ɖɔ ɖo taŋ la.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Hafi wova ɖo towo ƒe agunuwo anyi, hafi togbɛwo nadzɔ la, wodzim xoxo.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Wodzim hafi wòwɔ anyigba, gbegbewo kple anyikɔ gbãtɔwo gɔ̃.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Mele eteƒe hafi Aƒetɔ wɔ dziƒo esime wòte dziŋgɔli ƒe fli nogo ɖe gogloƒeawo dzi.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣie wòna alilikpowo bla ɖe dzi goŋgoŋ, eye wòɖo gogloƒeawo ƒe tsidziƒewo anyi.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: Meli esime wòɖo seɖoƒe na atsiaƒu bene magada yeƒe sedede dzi o, eye wòɖo anyigba ƒe zɔ anyi.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: Menye dɔnunɔla le exa, eye medoa dzidzɔ nɛ gbe sia gbe. Mekpɔa dzidzɔ le eŋkume ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Mekpɔa dzidzɔ le eƒe xexeme si amewo le la ŋu, eye dzi dzɔam be mele amegbetɔviwo dome.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, vinyewo, miɖo tom. Dzi dzɔa ame siwo toa nye afɔtoƒe.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Miɖo to nye nufiame, ne miadze nunya. Migagbee o.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Dzi dzɔa ame si ɖoa tom, eye wòle ŋudzɔ le nye agbowo nu tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke le lalam le nye ʋɔtruwo nu.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Elabe ame si ƒe asi tum la ƒe asi tu agbe; Aƒetɔ vea eyama nu.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Ke ame si dam ƒu la, wɔa nu vevi eɖokui. Ame siwo katã lé fum la, ku lɔ̃m wole.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nunya tu xɔ; eɖo sɔti adrẽ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Etso eƒe lãwo; etɔtɔ eƒe wain vovovoawo, eye wòɖo eƒe kplɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Edɔ eƒe dɔlanyɔnuviwo ɖa, ne woaɖado kpo le dua ƒe kɔkɔƒewo be:

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Mi ame manyanuwo, miva dze afii!” Egblɔ na movitɔwo be:

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Miva ɖu nu, ne miano nye wain si medzro la.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Miɖe asi le bometsitsi ŋu, ne mianɔ agbe; milé gɔmesese ƒe mɔ tsɔ tẽe!”

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Ame si le fewuɖula ɖɔm ɖo la, ɖe wodzunɛ; ame si le mo kam na ŋutasẽla la, nu vevie wɔnɛ.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Mègaka mo na fewuɖula o; fu ko wòalé wò; ke ne èka mo na nunyala la, alɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Fia nu nunyala, aganya nu ɖe edzi. Fia nu ame dzɔdzɔe, agadzi eƒe nunya ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃e nye nunya ƒe gɔmedzedze; sidzedze Kɔkɔetɔ lae nye nugɔmesese.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Elabe to dzinye la, woadzi wò ŋkekewo ɖe edzi, eye woatsɔ ƒè akpe ƒè na wò.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Ne èdze nunya la, ènya nu na ɖokuiwò, eye ne èɖu fewu la, wò ɖekae akpe fu.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu movitɔe doa aƒa; gboloe, ŋu mekpenɛ o.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Enɔa zikpui dzi le eƒe ʋɔtru nu; enɔa zikpui dzi le dua ƒe kɔkɔƒewo,

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: henɔa ame siwo va yina la, yɔm be:

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Movitɔ, va dze afii!” Egblɔna na numanyala be:

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Tsi si wofi la, ɖe wòvivina. Vivimenuɖuɖu ɖe wòle ŋanaŋana!”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Ke menya be ŋɔliwo le afi ma, eye eƒe ame kpekpeawo le Aʋlime o.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Salomo ƒe lododowoe nye esiawo: Vi nyanu doa dzidzɔ na tɔ́a; ke vi tsibome nye nuxaxa na nɔa.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu si wokpɔ to nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me meɖea vi o; ke nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖea ame tso ku me.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ menana be dɔ wua ame dzɔdzɔe o, ke exea mɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nudidi.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Alɔ gblɔdɔ wɔwɔ nana be wodaa ahe, ke veviedonula ƒe asi hea kesinɔnu vɛ.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Vi si ƒoa nu ƒu le dzomeŋɔli la, vi nyanu ye; ke vi si dɔa alɔ̃ le nuŋeɣi la, vi doŋukpeame ye.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Yayra nɔa ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ta dzi, ke ŋutasesẽ bèna ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu me.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ŋkuɖoɖo ame dzɔdzɔe dzi nye yayra, ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ŋkɔ anyunyɔ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ame si nunya le ta gbɔ na la wɔa se dzi; ke bometsila nu kpoloe ƒola dzea gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Ame si nɔa agbe fɔɖiɖi manɔmee la, nɔna dedie; ke nu fitifiti wɔla ƒe nya dzea go.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Ame si miaa ŋku ɖe ame la hea masɔmasɔ vanɛ, ke ame si kaa mo na ame vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee la, wɔa ŋutifafa.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nu nye agbevudo; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu ɣlaa ŋutasesẽ.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Fuléle hea dzre vɛ, ke lɔlɔ̃ tsyɔa dzidadawo katã dzi.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Wokpɔa nunya le nugɔmesela ƒe nuƒo me; ke ameƒotie dze na ame manyanu ƒe dzime.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒoa ƒu sidzedze ɖi; ke bometsila ƒe nuƒo blóbloblo gogo gbegblẽ.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Hotɔ ƒe du sesẽ nye eƒe kesinɔnu; ke hiãtɔ ƒe ahedada nye eƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe tsɔa eƒe fetu nɔa agbee; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi tsɔa eƒe viɖe wɔa nuvɔ̃e.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃a nufiame, le agbemɔ dzi; ke ame si gbe mokaname la traa mɔ.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Ame si ɣla fuléle la alakpatɔ wònye, eye ame si kaa aʋatso ɖe ame si la, movitɔ ye.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Nya tatra megbea nuƒo vivivo me o; ke ame si kpɔa eƒe nu dzi la, nunyala ye.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe aɖe la, klosalo dzadzɛtɔ ye; ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe susu ya meɖi naneke o.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nuƒo nyia ame geɖe, ke susumanɔamesi wua bometsilawo.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe yayrae wɔa ame kesinɔtɔ, dagbadagba manɔmee.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Nu vlo wɔwɔ nye fefe ko na bometsila la; ke nu wɔwɔ ɖe nunya me doa dzidzɔ na nugɔmesela.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Nu si vɔ̃m ame vɔ̃ɖi le la, eyae dzɔna ɖe edzi. Ke ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe didi ya vaa eme nɛ.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ne ahom tu la, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nu yina; ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ya lia ke tegbee.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Ale si aha tsitsi nyɔa aɖui, eye dzudzɔ yɔa ŋkui la, nenema kuviatɔ le na ame si dɔ dɔe la.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃e dzia agbe ɖe edzi; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe ƒèwo nu tsona kpo!

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Dzidzɔe nye ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe ŋuɖoɖo zua dzodzro.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ nye mɔ́ sesẽ na fɔmaɖila; ke ehea gbegblẽ vaa nu vlo wɔlawo dzi.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Womaɖe ame dzɔdzɔe ɖa le enɔƒe akpɔ o; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ya manɔ anyigba la dzi o.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nunya doa go tso ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nu me; ke alakpaɖe ya, woalãe ɖa.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe numenya sɔa to me; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu nye alakpago.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Amebanudanu nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ; ke nudanu nyuitɔ doa dzidzɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Ne dàda va la, ŋukpe nɔa eyome! Ke nunya nɔa ɖokuibɔbɔla gbɔ.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu meɖea vi le dɔmedzoedogbe o; ke nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖea ame le ku me.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Ame maɖifɔ ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ taa mɔ nɛ tẽe; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe vɔ̃wɔwɔ tsɔnɛ ƒua anyi.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖea wo; ke ametatrɔlawo ŋutɔ ƒe ŋubiabiã léa wo blana.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖi ku la, eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ nu tsina; ke mawumavɔ̃la ƒe ŋuɖoɖo zua dzodzro.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Woɖea ame dzɔdzɔe le xaxa me, eye ame vɔ̃ɖi va xɔa eteƒe.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Mawumavɔ̃la tsɔa eƒe nu tsrɔ̃a ehavii; ke sidzedze wotsɔna ɖea ame dzɔdzɔewoe.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Ne eme nyo na ame dzɔdzɔe la, du blibo kpɔa dzidzɔ, eye ne ame vlo tsrɔ̃ la, dzidzɔɣli ɖina.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe yayra doa du ɖe dzi; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu gbãa du.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ame manyanue doa vlo ehavi; ke nunyala ya zia kpi.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Sakplisala ʋua go nya ɣaɣla; ke ame ɖoŋuɖeŋua ɣlaa nya.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Ne kplɔla meli o la, dukɔ yia to; ke adaŋudela geɖewo hea dedienɔnɔ vɛ.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Ame si de megbe na amedzro la, tsia mavomavo; ame si ƒoa asa na megbedede la, nɔna dedie.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu amenuvela ƒe asi sua bubu dzi; ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo ƒe asi sua kesinɔnu dzi.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Dɔmenyotɔ wɔa nyui na eya ŋutɔ ɖokui; ke ŋutasẽla wɔa nu vevi eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Ŋutasẽla kpɔa viɖe ƒuƒlu; ke ame si ƒãa nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ la xɔa fetu vavãtɔ.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ hea agbe vanɛ, ke nuvɔ̃ɖi yome titi hea ku vanɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
