translation_verse: Ame siwo si alakpasusu le la, ŋunyɔ wonye na Aƒetɔ; ke ame siwo ƒe nuwɔna me fɔɖiɖi mele o la, dzidzɔ wonye nɛ.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Meka ɖe edzi na wò: Ne woagbe tohehe na ame vɔ̃ɖi fĩi! Ke woaɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo ya.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu dzetugbe manyanu le abe ha si sikaŋɔtigɛ le ŋɔti me na ene.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe didi nye nu nyui ɖeɖe sɔŋ; ke ame vlo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ nye dziku.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Ame aɖe naa nu faa; ke ɖeko wògakpɔa nu ɖe edzi. Gake ame bubu ya vea nu ale gbegbe; ke ɖeko wògadaa ahe wu.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Woana dɔmenyotɔ naɖi ƒo, eye ame si na tsi ame la, aɖi kɔ.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Ame si dzraa bli ɖo, medzranɛ o la, woƒoa fi denɛ; ke ame si dzranɛ faa la, woyranɛ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Ame si tia nyui yome la dzea ame ŋu; ke ame si dia vɔ̃ la, vɔ̃ atui.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖoa ŋu ɖe eƒe kesinɔnuwo ŋu la, ayrɔ; ke ame dzɔdzɔe ada ama abe aŋgba mumu ene.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖea fu na eƒe aƒemetɔwo la, aɖu aya, eye bometsila azu dɔtsɔvi na nunyala.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe kutsetse nye ati si naa agbe; ke sedzimawɔmawɔ ɖea ame geɖe ƒe agbe ɖa.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Ne woɖoa nuteƒe na ame dzɔdzɔewo le anyigba dzi la, ɖe womaɖo eteƒe na ame vɔ̃ɖi kple nuvɔ̃wɔla wu oa?

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃a hehexɔxɔ la, lɔ̃a sidzedze; ke ame si lé fu mokaname la, gbemelãe.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ vea ame nyui nu, ke ebua fɔ ayemenuwɔla.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ menana be ame lia ke o; ke kè maʋã le ame dzɔdzɔe te o.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃nyɔnu ɖɔʋu nye fiakuku le srɔ̃a ta; ke srɔ̃nyɔnu ŋukpenanuwɔla le abe ƒutometsi ƒaƒã ene le srɔ̃a me.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe susuwo le eteƒe; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖowo nye beble.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nya dea xa be yeakɔ ʋu ɖi; ke nuteƒewɔla ƒe nuƒo ɖea ame.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Tutu ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒu anyi ko evɔ nɛ; ke ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe aƒe ya nɔa anyi ɖaa.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nunya nue wokafunɛ ɖo; ke wodoa vlo susu tramatɔ.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ame tsɛ si ŋutɔ wɔa dɔ la nyo wu ame si tɔa asi akɔ; ke nuɖuɖu mele esi o.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe sea veve ɖe eƒe lãwo kekeake ti; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ gɔ̃ hã nye ŋutasesẽ.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Ame si de eya ŋutɔ ƒe agble la, akpɔ nuɖuɖu geɖe; ke ame si tia nu maɖinuwo yome la, tagbɔ mele esi o.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔla ƒe xɔ tsrala sesẽ agbã; ke ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ke dzèna.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Nuƒoƒo trama nye mɔ̀ vɔ̃ɖi ɖea ame; ke ame dzɔdzɔe sina le fukpekpe nu.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe mɔ dzɔna le eya ŋutɔ ŋkume; ke nunyala sea aɖaŋuɖoɖo.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Bometsila ɖea eƒe dziku fiana enumake; ke aɖaŋudzela meɖoa dzu ŋu o.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ame si toa nyateƒe la, gblɔa nya dzɔdzɔe; ke aʋatsoɖasefo daa alakpa.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo ƒe nuƒo tamemabutɔe tɔa ame abe yi ene; ke nunyala ƒe nya daa gbe le ame ŋu.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Nyateƒetola nɔa anyi tegbee; ke aʋatsokala nɔa anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Beble le susu me na vɔ̃ɖolawo; ke ŋutifafadilawo kpɔa dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ aɖeke medzɔna ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo dzi o; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi la yɔ fũu kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Alakpatɔ nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ; ke nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe nu nyoa eŋu.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Nunyala mekɔa nu le eƒe sidzedze dzi o; ke susumanɔsitɔ ya doa boblo eƒe bometsitsi.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Veviedonula ƒe asi ɖua fia; ke woazi kuviatɔ dzi be wòawɔ dɔ.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Dzimaɖitsitsi tea ame ɖe to; ke dzideƒonya doa dzidzɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe trɔna tso nuvɔ̃ɖi gbɔ; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ kplɔa wo tranae.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ mekpɔa adelã mena o; ke ame si doa vevie nu la, akpɔ kesinɔnu xɔasi.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Agbe le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe mɔ dzi; ke ame si to mɔ sia dzi la, meyia ku me o.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Vi nyanu sea tɔ́a ƒe nufiame; ke fewuɖula meɖoa to mokaname o.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Ame nyui ɖua nu nyui tso eƒe numenya ƒe kutsetse me; ke ŋutasesẽ nye alakpatɔ ƒe didi.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Ame si kpɔa eƒe nu dzi la, nɔna dedie; ke ame si kea nu baa la, dzea gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Nu dzroa kuviatɔ ƒe luʋɔ, eye makpɔe akpɔ o; ke veviedola ƒe luʋɔ akpɔ nu geɖe.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe léa fu aʋatsokaka; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi wɔa ŋukpenanu kple vlodoamenu.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ dzɔa ame maɖifɔ ƒe nuwɔnawo ŋu; ke nu tovo wɔwɔ hea ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒua anyi.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Ame aɖe wɔ eɖokui kesinɔtɔe, ke naneke mele esi o; bubu wɔ eɖokui ame dahee, evɔ kesinɔnu le esi fũu hafi.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe kesinɔnue ɖenɛ le awɔba me; ke ame dahe ya mekpɔa megbedenu aɖeke o.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe kekeli klẽna nyuie; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe akaɖi tsina.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Dàda la, dzre ko wohena vanɛ, ke nunya nana be woxɔa aɖaŋuɖoɖo.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu si wotsi dzi kpɔ bɔbɔe la azu ʋɛ; ke esi woku kutri kpɔ la, adzi ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Mɔkpɔkpɔ si wohe ɖe megbe la, nana be dzi sea veve; ke ne nu va eme na ame la, enye ati si naa agbe.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Ame si doa vlo nuxlɔ̃amenya la, atsrɔ̃; ke ame si dea bubu sedede ŋu la, axɔ fetu.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe nufiame la, vudo si naa agbe wònye, bene ame naƒo asa na ku ƒe mɔ̀.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Nugɔmesese nyui hea ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ vɛ; ke ame mawɔnuteƒewo ƒe mɔ hea wo dea gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Aɖaŋudzela ɖe sia ɖe wɔa nu le nunya me; ke bometsila doa boblo eƒe bometsitsi.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Dɔtsɔla vlo hea amewo dea xaxa me; ke amedɔdɔ nuteƒewɔla daa gbe le ame ŋu.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Ahedada kple ŋukpe vaa ame si gbea nufiamexɔxɔ la dzi; ke wodea bubu ame si xɔa mokaname la ŋu.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Ne ame ƒe didi va eme la, edzɔa dzi nɛ ŋutɔ, ke nuvɔ̃ tsitsri nye ŋunyɔnu na bometsilawo.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Ame si zɔna kple nunyalawo la, dzea nunya; ke ame si dea ha kple bometsilawo la, akpe fu.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e ɖea nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ɖe nu; ke nunyoname wotsɔna tua fe na ame dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Ame nyui gblẽa domenyinu ɖi na viawo ƒe viwo; ke wolia kɔ nuvɔ̃wɔla ƒe kesinɔnu ɖi na ame dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ƒe afutimenuku ʋãna fũu; ke edome gblẽna to nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Ame si gbea eƒe ameƒoti ŋudɔwɔwɔ na via la, lé fu via; ke ame si lɔ̃ via la doa vevie be yeahe to nɛ.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe kpɔa nu ɖuna ɖia ƒo nyuie; ke dɔ wua ame vɔ̃ɖi ya.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunya tsoa eƒe aƒe; ke bometsitsi gbãnɛ kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe asi.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Ame si nɔa agbe dzɔdzɔe la vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ; ke ame si nɔa agbe trama la doa vloe.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe nuƒo nye ameƒoti na eƒe dàda; ke nunyalawo ƒe nuƒo akpɔ wo ta.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Ne nyitsuwo meli o la, bli menɔa anyi o, ke agblemenu geɖe kpɔkpɔ tsoa nyitsu ƒe ŋusẽ me.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo wɔnuteƒe mekaa aʋatso o; ke aʋatsoɖasefo daa alakpa.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula dia nunya doa kpoe; ke sidzedze le bɔbɔe na nugɔmesela.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Te ɖa le bometsila gbɔ elabe màse nunya le enu o.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Aɖaŋudzela ƒe nunyae nye be yease nu si yeawɔ la gɔme; ke bometsila ƒe movidzɔdzɔe nye beble.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖea alɔ me le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu, ke evea nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo nu.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Ame ŋutɔe nya vevesese si le eƒe dzime, eye ame tutɔ mate ŋu akpɔ dzidzɔ kplii o.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe xɔ agbã; ke nuteƒewɔla ƒe agbadɔ akeke ta.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Mɔ aɖe li si dzéna mɔ dzɔdzɔe na ame; ke eƒe seƒee nye ku.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ne wole nu kom hã, nuxaxa nɔa dzime; dzidzɔ wua enu kple veve.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Tosẽla xɔa eƒe nuwɔnafetu, eye nuteƒewɔla hã xɔa etɔ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Bometsila xɔa nya sia nya dzi sena, ke aɖaŋudzela léa ŋku ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Nunyala ɖoa ŋu ɖo, eye wòƒoa asa na vɔ̃; ke bometsila doa adã, eye meléa fɔ ɖe naneke ŋu o.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ame si doa dɔmedzoe kabakaba la, ɖe wòwɔa lãnu; ke ame si wɔa nu nunyatɔe la, gbɔa dzi ɖi.

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Lãtɔ ƒe domenyinue nye bometsitsi; ke nunyala ƒe fiakukue nye sidzedze.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Ame vlowo dea ta agu na ame nyuiwo, eye ŋutasẽlawo dea ta agu le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe agbo nu.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ƒe aƒelika gɔ̃ hã léa fui; ke xɔlɔ̃ le kesinɔtɔ si fũu.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Ame si doa vlo ehavi la, nye nuvɔ̃wɔla; ke ame si nyoa dɔme na hiãtɔwo la, kpɔa dzidzɔ.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Ɖe vɔ̃ɖolawo metra oa? Gake nyuiɖolawo la, nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ nye wo tɔ.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Kutrikuku ɖe sia ɖe ɖea vi; ke nu kpoloe ƒoƒo hea hiã ko vanɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe fiakuku nye woƒe nunya; ke movitɔwo ƒe tablanu nye woƒe bometsitsi.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Nyateƒeɖasefo xɔa ame ɖe agbe; ke aʋatsoɖasefo blea ame.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ mee ame kpɔa dzideƒo blibo le, eye viawo akpɔ sitsoƒe.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ nye agbevudo, eɖea ame tso ku ƒe mɔ̀ me.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe atsyɔ̃ le dukɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ me; ke ne ame meli o la, ekema amegãɖuɖu yia to.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Ame si medoa dziku kabakaba o la, nugɔmesese bɔ ɖe esi; ame si doa adã kabakaba la, ɖea gbeƒã eƒe bometsitsi.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Dzidzeme naa agbe ame, ke ŋuʋaʋã nana be ƒuto me vóna.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Ame si te ame dahe ɖe anyi la, dzu eƒe Wɔla; ke ame si nyo dɔme na hiãtɔ la, de bubu eŋu.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe vɔ̃wɔwɔ ƒunɛ anyi, ke ame dzɔdzɔe kpɔa sitsoƒe le eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ me.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Nunya xɔ aƒe ɖe nugɔmesela ƒe susu me; ke mele bometsila ya tɔ me o.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ doa dukɔ ɖe dzi; ke nuvɔ̃ nye ŋukpe na dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Fia kpɔa ŋudzedze le subɔla si wɔa nu nunyatɔe la ŋu; ke edoa dziku ɖe ŋukpenanuwɔla ŋu.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Nyaŋuɖoɖo kple gbe bɔbɔe tsia dziku nu; ke gbedada ame nana be dɔmedzoe flana.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe aɖe ɖea sidzedze fiana; ke lãnya dona le bometsila nu ko gboya.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋku le afi sia afi; ele vɔ̃wɔla kple nyuiwɔla siaa kpɔm.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Gbe blewuu nye ati si naa agbe, ke alakpaɖe dea abi ame ƒe gbɔgbɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Bometsila doa vlo tɔ́a ƒe nufiame, ke ame si sea nuxɔxlɔ̃ la, nunyalae.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu geɖe le ame dzɔdzɔe ƒeme; ke fukpekpe dona tso ame vlo ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe nu kakaa sidzedze; ke bometsilawo ƒe susu mewɔa esia o.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe vɔsa nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ, ke nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe gbedodoɖa dzea eŋu.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nuwɔna nye ŋunyɔ na Aƒetɔ; ke elɔ̃a ame si dia nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ yome.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Tohehe sesẽtɔ li na ame si gblẽ mɔ la ɖi; ke ame si lé fu mokaname la, aku.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ne tsiẽƒe kple aʋlime le ʋuʋu ɖi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume ɖe, ɖe amegbetɔ ƒe dzi manɔ ʋuʋu ɖi wu oa?

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula melɔ̃na be woagbe nya na ye o; mayi nunyala gbɔ o.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Nugɔmesela ƒe susu dia sidzedze; ke bometsilawo ƒe nu gblɔa bometsinya.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Hiãtɔwo ƒe ŋkekewo sesẽ; ke dzidzɔkpɔlae ɖoa kplɔ̃ edziedzi.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Nu vi nɔamesi si ŋu Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ kpe ɖo la, nyo wu kesinɔnu geɖe si ŋu dzimaɖeɖi kpe ɖo la.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Amanuɖuɖu si ŋu lɔlɔ̃ kpe ɖo la, nyo wu nyitsu dami lãɖuɖu si ŋu fuléle kpe ɖo la.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoetɔ hea dzre vɛ; ke tufala tsia dzre nu.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Ŋuwo xɔa kuviatɔ ƒe mɔ dzi; ke nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe toƒe nye mɔ tata sɔsɔe.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Vi nyanu doa dzidzɔ na tɔ́a; ke vi tsibome doa vlo nɔa.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Susumanɔsitɔ kpɔa dzidzɔ le bometsitsi ŋu; ke nugɔmesela zɔna nyuie.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Ne adaŋudede meli o la, ɖoɖowo medzea dzi o; ke ne adaŋudela geɖewo li la, ɖoɖowo tsɔa afɔ nyuie.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Nyaŋuɖoɖo nyuie doa dzidzɔ na ame sia ame, eye nya si wogblɔ le egblɔɣi la nyasena ŋutɔ.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Le nunyalawo gbɔ la, agbemɔ ɖo ta dzi bene woaƒo asa na tsiẽƒe le anyigba tume.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gbãa dàdalawo ƒe aƒe; ke edoa liƒo na ahosiwo.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe tameɖoɖo nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ; ke nya dzeto dza le eŋkume.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Ŋuklẽla si kpɔa viɖe madzemadze la dea eƒe aƒemetɔwo xaxa me; ke ame si tsri zãnuxɔxɔ la, anɔ agbe.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe bua nya ŋu nyuie hafi ɖoa eŋu; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi kea nu gblɔa nya vɔ̃ɖi faa.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le adzɔge tso ame vɔ̃ɖi gbɔ; ke esea ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Mokɔkɔ doa dzidzɔ na ame; nya nyui dea ami ƒuto me.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃na woxlɔ̃a nui la, anɔ nunyalawo dome.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Ame si melɔ̃a nufiame o la, doa vlo eɖokui; ke ame si lɔ̃na wokaa mo nɛ la, zua nugɔmesela.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ nye nufiame si kplɔa ame dea nunya me; ɖokuibɔbɔ doa ŋgɔ na bubu.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ wɔa ɖoɖo le susu me; ke eɖeɖe gblɔ la, Aƒetɔ gbɔ wòtsona.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nuwɔnawo katã dzana le eya ŋutɔ ŋkume; ke Aƒetɔ ye doa gbɔgbɔwo kpɔna.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò dɔ de asi na Aƒetɔ la, ekema wò tameɖoɖowo adze edzi.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ wɔ nu sia nu ɖe susu aɖe ta; ewɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi gɔ̃ hã ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e gbe ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Dàdalawo katã nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ. Meka ɖe edzi na wò: Ne woagbe tohehe na wo fĩi!

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: To nuteƒewɔwɔ kple nyateƒe me woléa avu nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ, eye Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃e nana be ame ƒoa asa na vɔ̃.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ƒe nuwɔna dze Aƒetɔ ŋu la, enana be eƒe futɔwo gɔ̃ hã nɔa ŋutifafa me kplii.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Nu vi nɔamesi si ŋu nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kpe ɖo la, nyo wu nukpɔkpɔ geɖe si ŋu nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ kpe ɖo la.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe eƒe mɔ ŋu; ke Aƒetɔ ye fiaa eƒe afɔɖoƒewoe.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe nuƒo la, Mawu gbɔe wòtsona; eya ta medaa vo le afiatsotso me o.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Nudanu nyuitɔ kple nudada nyuitɔ siaa nye Aƒetɔ tɔ; nudakpe siwo katã le kotokua me la nye eƒe nuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: and like honesty and truth.
translation_verse: Nya dzɔdzɔe gbɔgblɔ dzea fiawo ŋu, eye wolɔ̃a nyateƒetola.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dziku nye ku ƒe dɔla, eye nunyala afa dzi nɛ.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Agbe le fia ƒe mokɔkɔ me, eye eƒe ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ le abe alilikpo si nana be tsi dzana le adame ene.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ne nunya su asiwò la, enyo wu sika; ne nugɔmesese su asiwò la, enyo wu klosalo nyuitɔ.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe mɔ tata tsri nuvɔ̃ɖi; ame si léa ŋku ɖe eƒe nuwɔna ŋu la nana be eƒe agbe nɔna dedie.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ɖokuibɔbɔ le hiãtɔwo dome nyo wu aboyonu mama kple dàdalawo.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Ame si léa to ɖe nya ŋu la, nu adze edzi nɛ; ame si ɖoa dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu la, akpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Ame si si dzi nyanu le la, woyɔnɛ be nugɔmesela, eye nuƒo si nyasena la, nana be woxɔa ame dzi sena.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunya nye agbevudo na ame si si wòle; ke bometsitsi nye tohenu na bometsilawo.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe susu nana be eƒe nuƒo dzɔna, eye wòkpena ɖe eƒe nufiafia ŋu.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Nya sɔtome la, anyitsi wònye; evivina na luʋɔ, eye wòyɔa dɔ ŋutilã.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Mɔ aɖe li si dzɔna le ame ŋkume, ke eƒe seƒee nye ku.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu si le dɔwɔla dzrom lae nana be wòwɔa dɔ; dɔwuamee ƒoa du ɖe ete.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Yakame ɖoa vɔ̃ ɖe ame ŋu, eye eƒe nuƒo le abe dzo binu ene.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Ame vlo dea dzre aƒe, eye sakplitɔ klãa xɔlɔ̃ veviwo dome.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Ŋutasẽla blea ehavi nu, eye wòkplɔnɛ toa mɔ manyomanyo dzi.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Ame si miaa ŋku ɖe ame la ɖo vɔ̃ ɖe tame; ame si miaa aɖu ɖe nuyi dzi goŋgoŋ la, wɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Wɔƒoƒo nye bubufiakuku; nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ mee wokpɔnɛ le.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Dzigbɔɖitɔ nyo wu kalẽtɔ, ɖokuidziɖula nyo wu duwo xɔla.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Wodaa nudzidzekpe ɖe akɔ me; ke Aƒetɔ tɔe nye nyametsotso.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Abolo ƒuƒu ɖuɖu le dzidzeme me nyo wu aƒe si me nuɖuɖu le fũu, eye dzre kpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Kluvi nyanu aɖu amegã ɖe viŋutsu ŋukpenanuwɔla dzi, eye akpɔ gome le domenyinu me abe nɔviŋutsuwo dometɔ ɖeka ene.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Wotsɔa sonu ɖe klosalo ŋu, eye wotsɔa dzokpo ɖe sika ŋu; ke Aƒetɔ ye doa dziwo kpɔna.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖea alɔ me le ame dahe ŋu la, doa vlo eƒe Wɔla. Ame si kpɔa dzidzɔ le dzɔgbevɔ̃e ŋu la, matsi tomahe o.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Tɔgbuiyɔviwo nye ame tsitsi ƒe fiakuku, eye viŋutsuwo ƒe atsyɔ̃ ye nye vi tɔ́wo.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Bometsila megblɔa nya vivi o, eye amegã mekaa aʋatso o.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Zãnu le abe akunyakpe ene le enalawo gbɔ; afi sia afi si wòtrɔ ɖo la ekpɔa nu si dim wòle.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔa vɔ̃ kena la nana be lɔlɔ̃ nɔa anyi; ke ame si hea nya xoxo ɖe go la, klãa xɔlɔ̃wo dome.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Ne wohe nya ɖe nugɔmesela ŋu la, edea tame nɛ wu ne woƒo bometsila zi alafa.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe didi koe nye be yeadze aglã, eya ta woadɔ dɔla ŋutasẽla ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Gododo sisiblisinɔ si ŋu woɖe vi le la, nyo wu gododo bometsila si le bometsinu wɔm.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ vɔ̃ ɖo nyui teƒe la, dzɔgbevɔ̃e mado le eƒeme o.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Dzregɔmetoto le abe ale si woŋɔa tɔe ene, eya ta dzudzɔ hafi wòava do gã.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Ame si tsoa afia na ame vɔ̃ɖi kple ame si bua fɔ ame dzɔdzɔe la, woawo kple eve la siaa nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta bometsila lé ga ɖe asi be yeaƒle nunya esime susu mele esi o?

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ̃ lɔ̃a ame ɣe sia ɣi baa; ke nɔvi ya dzɔ be yeaxɔ na ame le xaxaɣi.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃a sedzidada la, lɔ̃a dzrewɔwɔ; ame si de agbo kɔkɔ eƒe mɔ nu la, le gbegblẽ dim.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Ame si si alakpadzi le la, makpɔ nu nyui aɖeke o, eye ame si ƒe aɖe metoa mɔ ɖeka o la, age ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e me.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu si dzɔ lã nye nuxaxa na tɔ́a, eye bometsila tɔ́ mekpɔa dzidzɔ o.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Dzi si kpɔa dzidzɔ la, le abe gbedanu nyui ene; ke gbɔgbɔ xanu nana be ƒuwo ƒuna kplakplakpla.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi xɔa zãnu le bebeme, ne yeatrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe ƒe ta atu.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Nugɔmesela dia nunya ƒe mɔ; ke bometsila ƒe ŋku le anyigba ƒe seƒe ŋu.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Vi tsibome nye nuxaxa na tɔ́a, eye wònana be nɔa si dzii la sea veve.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Menyo be woado fe na ame dzɔdzɔe, alo woaƒo bubume le eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ta o.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Ame si meƒoa nu kabakaba o la sidzedze le esi, eye ame ɖɔŋuɖo nye nugɔmesela.

english_verse: Even fools seem smart when they are quiet.
translation_verse: Ne bometsila gɔ̃ zi ɖoɖoe la, wobunɛ nunyalae; ne emia nu la, wobunɛ nugɔmeselae.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖe eɖokui ɖe aga la, nu si dzroa eya ŋutɔ ko yome wòtina, eye wòtsia tre ɖe nuxɔxlɔ̃ nyui ɖe sia ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Nugɔmesese medzɔa dzi na lãtɔ o, etɔ gbɔgblɔ koe doa dzidzɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe numenya la, tɔ goglo wònye; nunya ƒe vudo si le dzidzim bababa la hã wònye.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Menyo be woade ame vɔ̃ɖi dzi alo ate ame dzɔdzɔe ɖe anyi le ʋɔnu o.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe numenya dea dzre aƒe, eye eƒe nuƒo hea ameƒoƒo vɛ.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe nue henɛ dea gbegblẽ me, eye eƒe nu kee nye mɔ̀ si ɖenɛ.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Sakplitɔ ƒe nyawo le abe nuɖuɖu vivi ene; ɖe wodea lã me ke na ame.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Alɔ gblɔdɔ wɔla la, dɔgblẽla nɔvi wònye.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ la, xɔ tsrala sesẽ wònye; ame dzɔdzɔe sína yia eme, eye wònɔna dedie.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔ ƒe nunɔamesie nye eƒe du sesẽ; ele abe glikpɔ kɔkɔ si le eŋu dzɔm la ene.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Hafi ame nadze anyi la, dàdae yɔa eme gbã; ke ɖokuibɔbɔ doa ŋgɔ na bubu.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Ne ame mekpɔ se nya vɔ, hafi ɖo eŋu o la, ezua bometsitsi kple ŋukpe nɛ.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Dzidodoe nana be ame nɔa te ɖe dɔléle nu; ke ne dzi ɖe le ame ƒo la, ame kae ate ŋu atsɔe?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Nunya sua ame senugɔme si, eye ame nyanu dia sidzedze.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nunanae taa mɔ nɛ, eye wòkplɔnɛ yia ame ŋkutawo gbɔ.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Nuƒola gbãtɔ dzena ame dzɔdzɔe le ʋɔnu; va se ɖe esime nuƒola evelia va ɖea ké le egɔme.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Nudzidze nana be dzre kena, eye wòléa avu le hoʋlila sesẽwo dome.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Nɔvi si ŋu woda vo ɖo la tri akɔ wu du sesẽ, eye dzre sia wɔwɔ sesẽ abe fiasã ƒe gameti ene.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame kpɔa eƒe nuɖuɖu, eye eƒe nuƒometsonue ɖia ƒo nɛ.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Ku kple agbe le aɖe si me; ame si nya nuƒoƒo la aɖu emetsonu.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame si kpɔ nyɔnu ɖe la, kpɔ nu nyui; enye amenuveve tso Aƒetɔ gbɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ɖea kuku; ke kesinɔtɔ ya ɖoa nya ŋu kple adã.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ̃ geɖe dzedze la, ku le eme; ke xɔlɔ̃ aɖewo ya wɔa nuteƒe wu nɔvi gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ame dahe wɔnuteƒe nyo wu alakpatɔ tsibome.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Sidzedze manɔamesi menyo o, eye ame si le zɔzɔm kple dzitsitsi la, traa mɔ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne ame ƒe bometsitsie gblẽ nu le eŋu la, edoa dziku ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu hea xɔlɔ̃ yeye geɖe ɖe ame ŋu; ke ha kana le ame dahe ŋu.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
translation_verse: Womagbe tohehe na aʋatsoɖasefo o, eye aʋatsokala masí o.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo wɔa ameŋkumenu be yewoadze dɔmenyotɔ ŋu, eye ame sia ame dzea xɔlɔ̃ ame si naa nu ame la.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ame dahe nɔviwo léa fui; ɖe exɔlɔ̃wo agbe megbedede sãa le eŋua? Ne ele wo yɔm hã la, womevana o.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Ame dzenunya lɔ̃a eɖokui; ame si dzra gɔmesese ɖo la, nu adze edzi nɛ.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Womagbe tohehe na aʋatsoɖasefo o, eye aʋatsokala atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Mele eteƒe be bometsila naɖu agbe vivi, kaka wòava zu be kluvi naɖu aƒetɔ ɖe dumegãwo dzi o.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Ame si nya nu la, gbɔa dzi blewuu, eye bubu wònye nɛ be wòaɖe kɔ ɖa ne wowɔ nu gbegblẽ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dɔmedzoedodo ɖe wòle abe dzata ƒe gbeɖeɖe ene; ke eƒe ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ le abe zãmu dzaɖegbedzi ene.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Vi dzɔlã nye dzɔgbevɔ̃e na tɔ́a, eye srɔ̃nyɔnu dzrewɔla le abe tsidzadza si mele kekem o la ene.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒe kple kesinɔnu nye domenyinuwo tso vi tɔ́wo gbɔ; ke srɔ̃nyɔnu nyanu ya, Aƒetɔ gbɔ wòtsona.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Kuviawɔwɔ ɖe wònana be wodɔa alɔ̃ tsu, eye kuviatɔ la, dɔe wunɛ.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔa sedede dzi la, nɔa agbe; ame si metsɔ ɖeke le eƒe agbenɔnɔ me o la, aku.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔ dɔmenyo na ame dahe la, do nu na Aƒetɔ; aɖo nu si wòwɔ la teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: He viwò esime mɔkpɔkpɔ gali; ke mègawɔ susu be yeawui o.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Ame si dzi kuna ŋɔdzitɔe la, akpɔ eŋu tohehe, elabe ne èxɔ nɛ la, ɖeko wòagado dziku.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Ne woɖo aɖaŋu na wò la, xɔe. Xɔ nufiame si wona wò la be nadze nunya hena etsɔ si gbɔna la.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ wɔa tameɖoɖo geɖe; ke Aƒetɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu koe ava eme.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔwɔ nye amegbetɔ ƒe atsyɔ̃; ame dahe nyo wu aʋatsokala.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ naa agbe. Ame si wòɖi ƒo na la, nɔa anyi le dziɖeɖi me; vɔ̃ aɖeke mawɔe o.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Ne kuviatɔ de asi nuɖugba me la, maɖee ade nu me gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Ƒo fewuɖula, bometsila adze aɖaŋu; ka mo na nugɔmesela, adze si nu.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Vi si sẽ ŋuta le tɔ́a ŋu, eye wònyà nɔa la, vlodoamela kple ŋukpenanuwɔla wònye.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne èdzudzɔ toɖoɖo nufiame la, atra tso sidzedze si fiam wole wò la gbɔ.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo yakame ɖea alɔ me le nya dzɔdzɔe ŋu; ame vɔ̃ɖi lɔ̃a nya madzɔmadzɔ gbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Tohehe li na fewuɖulawo; ƒoƒo li na bometsilawo ƒe dzime.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Wain la, fewuɖula ye, aha sesẽ la, dzrehela ye; ame si ke wokplɔ trae la, medze nunya o.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi si le fia ƒe dɔmedzoe ŋu la le abe dzata ƒe gbetete ene; ame si do dziku nɛ la, bua eƒe agbe.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒoa asa na dzre la, dea bubu eɖokui ŋu, ke bometsila ɖe sia ɖe anɔ dzre wɔm.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ medea agble le agbledeɣi o; le nuŋeɣi la, mekpɔa naneke ŋena o.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe tameɖoɖo le abe tɔ goglo ene; ke nugɔmesela akui.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo gblɔna be yewonye nuteƒewɔlawo; ke anukwaretɔ la, afi ka woakpɔe le?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe si nɔ agbe fɔɖiɖi manɔmee la, yayra ava emegbeviwo dzi.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Fia si bɔbɔ nɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui dzi la, kpɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo katã dzea sii.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Ame ka ate ŋu gblɔ be: “Mekɔ nye dzi ŋu; nuvɔ̃ mele ŋunye o”?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Amebanudakpe, amebanudzidzenu, wo kple eve la siaa wonye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Ɖevi sue gɔ̃ hã ƒe nuwɔnawo ɖenɛ fiana be eƒe agbenɔnɔ dza eye wòdzɔ.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: To senu kple ŋku kpɔnu la, Aƒetɔ ye wɔ wo kple eve la siaa.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Mègalɔ̃ alɔ̃dɔdɔ akpa o; àva da ahe. Nɔ ŋu nàwɔ dɔ, ekema nuɖuɖu anɔ asiwò.

english_verse: Everyone likes to brag about getting a bargain.
translation_verse: Nuƒlela gblɔna be: “Menyo o! Menyo o!” Ke ne edzo la, ekafua eɖokui.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Xɔ ame si de megbe na amedzro ƒe awu le esi nàtsɔ ɖo awɔba ɖe ame tutɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Abolo si woble ame, xɔ le esi la, vivina na ameblela la; ke emegbe la, kpekui ayɔ nu me nɛ.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Wowɔa ɖoɖowo to adaŋudede me; nunya nekplɔ wò le aʋawɔwɔ me.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Ne èƒo fi de tɔ́wo alo nɔwò la, wò akaɖi atsi le blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Domenyinu si wotsi dzi xɔ le gɔmedzedzea la, yayra manɔ eme le nuwuwu o.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Mègagblɔ be: “Maɖo vɔ̃ vɔ̃ teƒe” o; kpɔ Aƒetɔ sinu eye akpe ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Amebanudakpewo nye ŋunyɔnu na Aƒetɔ, eye amebanudanu menyo o.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye fiaa afɔɖoƒe ame. Ale ke ame ate ŋu ase eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ gɔmee?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Mɔ̀tetre wònye na ame ɖokui be wòagblɔ tamemabutɔe be: “Eŋu kɔ!” Hafi wòava bu tame le adzɔgbe si wòɖe la ŋu emegbe.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Fia nyanu kpɔa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzea sii, eye wònana wozɔa wo dzi kple tasiaɖam.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ nye Aƒetɔ ƒe akaɖi si klẽna ɖe ememe ke.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔwɔ kple anukwareɖiɖi kpɔa fia ta, eye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ léa eƒe fiazikpui ɖe te.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Ɖekakpuiwo ƒe atsyɔ̃ nye woƒe ŋusẽ, ke ame tsitsiwo ƒe bubu nye woƒe wɔƒoƒo.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Ƒoƒo si de abi ame ŋu la nyaa vɔ̃ ɖa; nenemae nye ƒoƒo si de lã me ke na ame la hã.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dzi le abe tɔʋu ene le Aƒetɔ si me. Afi si wòlɔ̃ la, afi ma wòkplɔnɛ ɖoa tae.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nuwɔnawo katã dzɔna le eya ŋutɔ ŋkume; ke Aƒetɔ ye daa dziwo kpɔna.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ dzea Aƒetɔ ŋu wu vɔsa.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Ɖokuiŋudzedze kple ɖokuidodoɖedzi la, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe akaɖi si nye nuvɔ̃ la ko wonye.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Kutrikula ƒe ɖoɖowo ɖea vi fũu godoo; ke hiã kaa ame si wɔa nu kple dzitsitsi ya godoo.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Alakpaɖetsɔtsɔ kpɔ kesinɔnui la, dzudzɔ si nu va yina la kple ku ƒe mɔ̀ wònye.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ŋutasesẽ tsrɔ̃a wo elabe wogbe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Fɔɖila ƒe mɔ glɔ̃; fɔmaɖila wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Xɔ ta ƒe dzogoe dzi nɔnɔ nyo wu aƒeme nɔnɔ kple nyɔnu dzrewɔla.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe luʋɔ dia vɔ̃wɔwɔ; ehavi ƒe nu mewɔa nublanui nɛ o.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Ne wohe to na fewuɖula la, ame manyanu dzea nunya; ne wofia nu nunyala la, edzea si nu.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔetɔ la léa ŋku ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aƒe ŋu, eye wòtsɔa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒua gbe ɖe gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Ame si do toku ame dahe ƒe ɣlidodo la, eya hã ava do ɣli, eye womasee nɛ o.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Nunana ame le adzame tsia dɔmedzoe nu, eye zãnuxɔxɔ faa adãwɔwɔ nu.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nye dzidzɔ na ame dzɔdzɔe; ke enye ŋɔdzi na nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Ame si tra tso nugɔmesese ƒe mɔ dzi la, aɖagbɔ ɖe eme le ame kukuwo de.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃ agbeɖuɖu la, azu hiãtɔ; ame si lɔ̃ wain kple ami la, makpɔ kesinɔnu o.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi wotsɔna léa avu ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe nu, eye ame mawɔnuteƒe wotsɔna léa avu ɖe nuteƒewɔlawo nu.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Kegbegbenɔnɔ nyo wu nyɔnu dzrewɔla dzikudola gbɔ nɔnɔ.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu vevi kple ami nɔa nunyala ƒeme, ke bometsila gblẽa wo dome.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Ame si dia nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple dɔmenyowɔwɔ la, akpɔ agbe, dzidzedze kple bubu.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Nunyala ge ɖe kalẽtɔwo ƒe du me, eye wòmu mɔ́ sesẽ si ŋu wole dzi ɖom ɖo la ƒu anyi.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ame si kpɔa eƒe nu kple aɖe dzi la, medea eɖokui xaxa me o.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Dàdala adegbeƒola si wɔa nu tovo vivivo lae woyɔna be fewuɖula.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ ƒe nudzodzroe wunɛ elabe eƒe asi gbe dɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: But people who obey God are always generous.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi le ŋukeklẽ dzi ɣe sia ɣi esime ame dzɔdzɔe ya naa nu megbemakpɔtɔe.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe vɔsa nye ŋunyɔnu xoxo; ɖe magavɔ̃ɖi wu nenye be wòtsɔe vɛ kple susu vɔ̃ɖi oa?

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Aʋatsoɖasefo atsrɔ̃; ke toɖola ƒe nya anɔ anyi ɖaa.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi lia mo vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee; ke nuteƒewɔla léa ŋku ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nunya kple nugɔmesese kpakple aɖaŋuɖoɖo aɖeke manɔ te ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Woblaa akpa na sɔ ɖe aʋawɔgbe ŋu; ke Aƒetɔ si me dziɖuɖu le.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: He ɖevi ɖe mɔ si wòato la ŋu, eye ne etsi la, mate ɖa le edzi o.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔ ɖua fia ɖe ame dahe dzi; ame si doa nu le ame si la, kluvi wònye na ame si si wòdo nu la le.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒãa nu madzɔmadzɔ la, aŋe dzɔgbevɔ̃e, eye eƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe toheti magadze edzi o.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Woayra ame si nyoa dɔme elabe emaa eƒe abolo kple ame dahe.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Nya fewuɖula ɖa, ekema dzre ake, eye nyawɔwɔ kple dzu avɔ.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃ dzi dzadzɛtɔ, eye wònya nuƒoƒo la, anye fia xɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋku dzɔa sidzedze ŋu; ke egbea nuteƒemawɔla ƒe nya.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Kuviatɔe gblɔna be: “Dzata le xexe. Ava wum le kpɔdomee.”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Gbolo ƒe nu la, do gogloe. Ame si ŋu Aƒetɔ do dɔmedzoe ɖo la, eyae age dze eme.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Ne bometsitsi lé ɖe ɖevi ƒe dzi ŋu la, ameƒoti ye fenɛ ɖa le eŋu.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Ame si te ame dahe ɖe anyi be yeƒe nuwo nedzi ɖe edzi, alo na nu kesinɔtɔ la, ahedada ko wòkplɔ ƒu eɖokui. Nufiamenya bla etɔ̃awo

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Ƒu to anyi, eye nàse nunyalawo ƒe nyawo. Wò susu netrɔ ɖe nye sidzedze ŋu,

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: elabe anyo ne èdzra wo ɖo ɖe mewò eye wo katã le nuwò.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Medi be nàɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu tae mele nu fiam wò egbea ɖo.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyemeŋlɔ nufiame bla etɔ̃ siwo me aɖaŋuɖoɖo kple nunya le la na wò,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: ne mafia wò nu si dze, eye wòle eteƒe, ale be nàtsɔ ŋuɖoɖo nyuitɔwo ayi na ame siwo dɔ wò ɖa la oa?

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Mègada adzo ame dahe le eƒe ahedada ta o; mègate fukpela ɖe anyi le ʋɔnu o,

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: elabe Aƒetɔ axɔ woƒe nya ɖe akɔ, eye wòaɖe ame siwo da adzo wo la ƒe agbe ɖa.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Mègade ha kple dɔmedzoetɔ o, eye mègazɔ kple dzikutɔ o.

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, àsrɔ̃ eƒe nuwɔnawo, eye wò agbe age ɖe mɔ̀ me.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: elabe ne naneke mele asiwò nàtsɔ aɖo fea nu o la, ɖe womaɖe wò aba le tewò oa?

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Mègatrɔ liƒo xoxo siwo tɔgbuiwòwo do la o.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Èkpɔ ame zazɛ̃ si wɔa eƒe dɔ kple aɖaŋua? Fiawoe wòasubɔ; menye ame maɖinuwoe wòasubɔ o.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Mègaɖu ŋɔkula ƒe nu o, eye eƒe nuɖuɖu viviwo megadzro wò o,

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Ne èle kplɔ̃ ŋu be yeaɖu nu kple dziɖula aɖe la, lé ŋku ɖe nu si le ŋkuwò me la ŋu nyuie.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Ne ènye nu tsu ɖula la, ekema ɖu ɖokuiwò dzi vevie.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Eƒe nuɖuɖu viviawo megadzro wò o, elabe ameblenuɖuɖu woe.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: elabe ale si wòbu le dzime la, nenema eyama le. Agblɔ na wò be: “Ɖu nu, no nu!” gake nya sia metso eƒe dzime o.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Mègaɖe fu na ɖokuiwò be yeakpɔ kesinɔnu o; nya nu nàɖee ɖa le susu me.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Kasia wò ŋku nakpɔe ɖa la, maganɔ anyi o, elabe ato aʋala adzo ayi ya me abe hɔ̃ ene.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Nu si nèɖu la, àdzɔe, eye dzidzɔdonamenya siwo nègblɔ la hã azu dzodzro.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Mègaƒo nu na bometsila o, ɖeko wòado vlo nunya si le wò nyawo me la.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Mègatrɔ liƒo xoxowo o, eye mègaxɔ tsyɔ̃eviwo ƒe agblewo le wo si o,

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Vinye, see, eye nàdze nunya, da wò dzi ɖe mɔ dzɔdzɔe dzi.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Mègade ha kple wain tsu nolawo kple lã tsu ɖulawo o,

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: elabe ahamula kple nu tsu ɖula, ɖe wodaa ahe, eye alɔ̃ tsu dɔdɔ ɖe wònana wotsia nu vuvu me.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Ɖo to tɔ́wò si dzi wò, eye mègado vlo nɔwò le eƒe nyagãkuku me o.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Ƒle nyateƒe; mègadzrae o. Ƒle nunya, nufiame kple nugɔmesese hã.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe tɔ́ atso aseye vevie, eye ŋutsu si dzi vi nyanu la, akpɔ dzidzɔ le eŋu.

english_verse: Make your parents proud, especially your mother. –
translation_verse: Na tɔ́wò kple nɔwò nakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye nɔwò si dzi wò la natso aseye.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Vinye, tsɔ wò dzi nam, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe nye mɔwo ŋu,

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: elabe gbolo la, do globo wònye; nyɔnu tsatsala la, vudo xaxɛ wònye.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Edea xa ɖi abe adzodala ene, eye wòwɔnɛ be nuteƒemawɔlawo dzina ɖe edzi le ŋutsuwo dome.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Ame kae ɖea hũ? Ame kae sea veve? Ame kae wɔa dzre? Ame kae faa konyi? Ame kae xɔa abi dzodzro? Ame ka ƒe ŋkue biãna wɔna dɔ̃?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Ame siwo tsia wain gɔme la woe. Ame siwo lɔ̃a wain si wodzro la ɖɔɖɔ kpɔ la woe.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Mègaɖe ŋku ɖe wain, ne wòbiã nyuie, eye wòle dzo dam le kplu me, eye ne wole enom, wòle yiyim wɔliwɔli la o.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, eɖua ame abe da ene, eye wònyɔa aɖi abe dakpui ene.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Wò ŋku akpɔ nu manyatanawo, eye wò susu anɔ nya vlowo gblɔm.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Ànɔ abe ame si le atsiaƒu titina alo ame si le abalati tame la ene.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Àgblɔ be: “Woƒom, ke nu vevi mewɔm o; wotom, ke mevem o. Ɣe ka ɣi gɔ̃ manyɔ? Magadi aha bubu yomemɔ.”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Dzi megaku wò le ame vɔ̃ɖi ta o, eye mègaʋã ŋu ame vɔ̃ɖi o,

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Mègaʋã ŋu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo o, eye megadzro wò be nàde ha kpli wo o,

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: elabe wole ŋutasesẽ ŋu bum le dzime, eye woƒoa nu tso nugbegblẽ ŋu.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: elabe etsɔ me manyo na ame vlo o, eye ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe akaɖi atsi.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Nunya wotsɔna tua xɔe, eye gɔmesese wotsɔna lia kee.

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Sidzedze wotsɔna dea kesinɔnu xɔasi kple dzidzɔdonamenuwo katã xɔawo me, woyɔna taŋ.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Vinye, vɔ̃ Aƒetɔ kple fia la, eye mègagbe toɖoɖo wo dometɔ aɖeke o.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Elabe to amekpɔkplɔ nunyatɔe me miate ŋu aho aʋa, eye dziɖuɖu vana to adaŋudela geɖe dzi.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Elabe gbegblẽ atso wo gbɔ ava kpata. Ame kae nya dzɔgbevɔ̃e si ava tso wo kple eve la gbɔ? Nufiamenya bubuwo

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Nunya kɔ dzi boo akpa na bometsila, eya ta mekea nu le ʋɔnu o.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Esiawo hã nye nunyalawo ƒe nyawo: Ame dzi dede le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me menyo o.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖoa vɔ̃ be yeawɔ la, eyae woyɔna be ame vɔ̃.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe tameɖoɖo nye nuvɔ̃, eye fewuɖula nye ŋunyɔ na amegbetɔwo.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Ame si gblɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi be: “Tɔwò dzɔ” la, dukɔwo aƒo fi adee, eye anyigbadzitɔwo alé fui vevie.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Ne ègbɔdzɔ le xaxagbe la, wò ŋusẽ dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ.

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Gake ame siwo gbea nya na ame vɔ̃ɖi la, dzi adzɔ wo, eye yayra vavãtɔ anɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Xɔ na ame siwo wokplɔ yina wuwu ge, eye ɖe ame siwo woyina tsotso ge la.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Ne ègblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, míenya esia o” la, ɖe ame si daa dziwo kpɔna la medze sii oa? Ɖe ame si dzɔa wò luʋɔ ŋu la, menyae oa? Ɖe maɖo eteƒe na ame ɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔ nu oa?

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖoa nya ŋu ɖe eteƒe la, eya ƒe nuyi ye wogbugbɔna.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Vinye, no anyitsi elabe enyo, eye anyigba si le tsyɔtsyɔm la avivi na wò.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Nya be nenema nunya le na wò luʋɔ. Ne wò asi su edzi la, ekema ŋkekenyuiwo gbɔna na wò, eye wò mɔkpɔkpɔ mazu dzodzro o.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Wɔ wò dɔwo le xexe, eye nàde wò agble, emegbe hafi nàtu xɔ.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Wò ame vɔ̃ɖi, mègade xa ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nɔƒe ŋu o, eye mègagblẽ eƒe aƒe o.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Elabe togbɔ be ame dzɔdzɔe dzea anyi zi adrẽ hã la, egafɔna; ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzea gbegblẽ me.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Mèganye ɖasefo ɖe hawòvi ŋu dzodzro o, eye mègaka aʋatso o.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Ne wò futɔ dze anyi la, dzi megadzɔ wò o. Ne ekli nu la, mègakpɔ dzidzɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, Aƒetɔ akpɔe madze eŋu o, eye wòadzudzɔ dɔmedzoedodo ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Mègagblɔ be: “Ale si wòwɔmee la, nenema kee mawɔe. Maɖo eteƒe nɛ ɖe eƒe nuwɔna nu” o.

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Meto kuviatɔ aɖe ƒe agble ŋu, numanyala aɖe ƒe waingble ŋu, yi kpɔ.

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, aŋɔka xɔ agblea keŋ; gbe to ɖe eme taŋtaŋ, eye eƒe kpeɖoɖowo mu.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔe hebu eŋu. Meɖe ŋku ɖee, eye mesrɔ̃ nu tso eme:

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: “Alɔ̃dɔdɔ vie, akɔlɔ̃edɔdɔ sẽe, asidede asitɛ me, gbɔgbɔɖeme ʋɛ” la,

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Lododo siawo hã nye Salomo tɔwo. Yuda-fia Xizkiya ƒe amewoe gbugbɔ wo ŋlɔ.

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Enye bubu na Mawu be wòaɣla nu; ke fiawo ƒe bubue nye be woaku nu gɔme.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Ale si dziƒo kɔe, eye anyigba gogloe la, nenemae fiawo ƒe dzime dzodzro meli o.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Ɖe ɖi ɖa le klosalo ŋu, ekema aɖaŋudɔwɔla akpɔ dɔwɔnu awɔ tsikunu.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖa le fia ŋkume, ekema eƒe fiazikpui ali ke ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe me.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Mègaɖe ɖokuiwò fia ne fia nakpɔ loo, alo anɔ ame veviwo teƒe o.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Elabe ne wogblɔ na wò be: “Va nɔ kɔkɔƒe le afii” la, enyo wu be woabɔbɔ wò ɖe anyi le amegã la ŋkume. Nu si wò ŋku kpɔ la,

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: mègatsi dzi atsɔe yi ʋɔnui o; elabe nu ka nàwɔ emegbe, ne hawòvi va do ŋukpe wò?

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: He wò ŋutɔ wò nya kple hawòvi; ke mègaʋu go ame bubu ƒe nya ɣaɣla,

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: be ne amea see la, wòado ŋukpe wò, eye wò ŋkɔ vɔ̃e anɔ anyi ɖaa o.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Nya si wogblɔ le egblɔɣi la, le abe sikanutata ɖe klosalonu dzi ene.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe nuxlɔ̃amenya le abe sikasigɛ kple kɔgɛ si wotsɔ sika nyuitɔ wɔ la ene na ame si le to ɖomee la.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Ale si tsi fafɛ faa akɔ na ame le dzomeŋɔli le nuŋeɣii la, nenemae dɔtsɔla nuteƒewɔla le na ame siwo dɔe; efaa dzi na eƒe aƒetɔwo.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Ame si doa nunana ŋugbe evɔ menanae o la, le abe tsi si ɖo kple yaƒoƒo gake gbe dzadza la ene.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Dzigbɔɖie xɔa nu le fia si, eye aɖe bɔbɔe ye gbãa ƒu.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Mèganɔ afɔɖi ƒom hawòvi ƒeme, ne wò nu nagati kɔ nɛ, eye wòayi fu lé ge wò o.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖia aʋatsoɖase ɖe ehavi ŋu la, le abe kpo, yi, alo aŋutrɔ biɖoe ene.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Dziɖoɖo ɖe nuteƒemawɔla ŋu le xaxaɣi le abe aɖu vovo alo afɔ si gli la ene.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Ne dɔ le wò futɔ wum la, na nui wòaɖu, eye ne tsikɔ le ewum la, na tsii wòano.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Elabe ne èwɔ esia la, àna ŋu nakpee ŋutɔŋutɔ, eye Aƒetɔ aɖo eteƒe na wò.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Dzigbemeya hea tsidzadza vanɛ, eye ameŋulĩɖe nana be wodoa dziku, ɖoa adãmo.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Xɔta ƒe dzogoe dzi nɔnɔ nyo wu aƒeme nɔnɔ kple nyɔnu dzrewɔla.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Nya nyui xɔxɔ tso duta le abe tsi fafɛ ene na ame si ƒe ve me ƒu la.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Ale si tsidzidzi bublu alo vudo me tsi ƒaƒã le la, nenemae nye ame dzɔdzɔe si wɔ nu tovo le ame vɔ̃ɖi ŋkume.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Anyitsi geɖe nono menyo o, eye mègadi be woakafu ye akpa o.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Ame si meɖua eɖokui dzi o la, le abe du si ŋu wogbã gli le, eye wòtsi nuvo ene.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Abe vuvɔ le dzoxɔxɔŋɔli alo tsidzadza le nuŋeɣi ene la, nenemae bubu medze bometsila o.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Ale si atsutsrɔe dzonae, sagbadre saa agbae la, nenemae nye fiƒoƒo de ame ɖe ya me.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Sɔƒoka li na sɔ, numega li na tedzi, eye ati li na bometsila ƒe dzime.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Mègaɖo nya ŋu na bometsila ɖe eƒe bometsitsi nu, ne wò hã nàva nɔ abe eya ene o.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Ɖo nya ŋu na bometsila ɖe eƒe bometsitsi nu, ne magabu eɖokui nunyalae o.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Ame si dea du asi na bometsila la, lãa eya ŋutɔ ƒe afɔ, eye wòsẽa ŋuta le eɖokui ŋuti.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Ale si ŋusẽ mele bunɔ ƒe atawo ŋu o la, nenemae lododo le le bometsila ƒe nu mee.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Ame si de bubu bometsila ŋu la, le abe ame si bla kpe ɖe akafo me ene.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Ale si ŋu le le ahamula ƒe asi mee la, nenemae lododo le le bometsila ƒe nu mee.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ale si aŋutrɔdala dea abi ame sia ame ŋui la, nenemae nye ame si tsɔ bometsila alo ahanomunɔ be newɔ dɔ na ye.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Ale si avu trɔna ɖe nu si eya ŋutɔ tru ŋui la, nenema bometsila gbugbɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe bometsinu wɔnae.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Èle ame si le eɖokui bum nunyalae la kpɔma? Mɔkpɔkpɔ le bometsila si wu eyama.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Kuviatɔe gblɔna be: “Dzata le mɔ dzi! Dzata le ablɔ me!”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Ale si ʋɔtru trona le eƒe megbega mee la, nenemae kuviatɔ trɔna le eƒe aba dzi.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Ne kuviatɔ de asi agba me la, egbugbɔ de nu me tea ɖeɖi eŋu ŋutɔ.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ bua eɖokui nunyalae wu ame adrẽ siwo ɖoa nya ŋu ɖe nunya me.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Ame si de nu dzre si mekae o me la, sɔ kple ame si alé to na avu si tso me va yina la.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Ale si tsukunɔ daa akakati bibiwo alo aŋutrɔwo hewua nui la,

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: nenemae nye ame si blea ehavi hegblɔna be: “Fefem ko mele.”

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Ne nake vɔ la, dzo tsina; afi si sakplitɔ mele o la, dzre kena.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Ale si aka nana be dzo xɔnae, eye nake nana be dzo binae la, nenemae dzrewɔla dea dzo dzre mee.
