english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Sakplitɔ ƒe nyawo le abe nuɖuɖu vivi ene; ɖe wodea lã me ke na ame.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Ale si wofaa klosalomí ɖe anyize ŋui la, nenemae nya vivi gbɔgblɔ si ŋu dzi vɔ̃ɖi kpe ɖo la le.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Ketɔ ƒoa nu nyuie trɔa eɖokui bubui; ke edzra alakpa ɖo ɖe eƒe dzime.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Ne eƒo nu nyuie wònyase hã la, mègaxɔ edzi se o, elabe ŋunyɔnu adrẽ le eƒe dzime.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖe do la, age adze eme, eye kpe atrɔ adze emlila dzi.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Alakpaɖe léa fu ame siwo dome wògblẽ keŋkeŋ la, eye nu me vivi tsrɔ̃a nu.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Mègaƒo adegbe le etsɔ si gbɔna la ŋu o, elabe mènya nu si ŋkeke ahe vɛ o.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Kpe la, nu kpekpe ye, eye ke hã kpena; ke bometsila ƒe dzikudoname kpena wu wo kple eve la.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Adã nyrana, dɔmedzoe dzea agbo; ke ame ka ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe ŋuʋaʋã nu?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Mokaname le gaglãgbe nyo wu amelɔlɔ̃ le adzame.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ̃ ƒe abideameŋu menye nu baɖa o; ke futɔ ƒe nugbugbɔname nye fuflu.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Ƒoɖilae nyɔa ŋu anyitsi; ke dɔwuitɔ la, nu veve ɖe sia ɖe vivia enu.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Ame si tra tso eƒe aƒe gbɔ la, le abe xevi si tra tso eƒe atɔ gbɔ yi ʋĩi ene.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Ami kple lifi doa dzidzɔ na dzi, nenema ke xɔlɔ̃ ƒe nya vivi nyo wu ame ŋutɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo na eɖokui.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Mègagblẽ xɔ̃wò alo tɔ́wò xɔlɔ̃ ɖi o, eye mègayi nɔviwò ƒeme gbe si gbe dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ ɖe dziwò la o. Aƒelika tsɔɖeamegbɔ nyo wu nɔviŋutsu si le adzɔge la.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Vinye, dze nunya, eye nàdo dzidzɔ na nye dzi, ale be mate ŋu aɖo nya ŋu na ame si ɖea alɔ me le ŋunye.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Nunyala kpɔa dzɔgbevɔ̃e, eye wòɣlaa eɖokui; ke ame manyanu ya ƒoa ta ɖe eme, eye wòkpɔa etɔ nua.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Xɔ ame si de megbe na amedzro ƒe awu le esi nàtsɔ ɖo awɔba ɖe ame tutɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Ame si yra ehavi ŋdi kanya kple ɣli la, woabui nɛ fiƒodee.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu dzrewɔla sɔ kple betrɔ si ɖuɖuna, ne tsi gã le dzadzam.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Ame si di be yealé avui la, le abe yaƒoƒo nue wòbe yeatsi, eye yeatsɔ yeƒe ɖusi aku amii ene.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Gae nyrea ga, eye amee nyrea ehavi.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Ame si kpɔa eƒe gboti dzi la, aɖu eƒe kutsetse, eye ame si dzɔa eƒe aƒetɔ ŋu la, woade bubu eŋu.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Ale si ŋkume ɖia ŋkume le tsi mee la, nenemae ame ƒe dzi sɔna ɖe ame ŋui.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe kple aʋlime meɖi ƒo kpɔ o; nenema ke ame ƒe ŋku meɖiƒo kpɔ o.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Wodoa klosalo kpɔ le sonu me, eye wodoa sika kpɔ le kpo me, nenema wodoa ame kpɔ, ne wokafui.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Ne ètsɔ tati to bometsila kple bli le to me hã la, eƒe bometsitsi la mado le eŋu akpɔ o.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Wò alẽha ƒe nɔnɔme nenɔ nyanya na wò nyuie, eye nàlé be na wò lãhawo.

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Ne gbe megali o eye gbe fɛ̃wo to, eye woƒo gbewo nu ƒu ɖe towo dzi la,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: wò alẽviwo ana nàkpɔ wò nudodowo, eye àkpɔ ga tso wò gbɔ̃wo me aƒle agblee.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Ekema àkpɔ gbɔ̃notsi fũu na wò nuɖuɖu, na wò aƒemetɔwo ƒe nuɖuɖu kple wò dɔlanyɔnuwo ƒe nunyiame.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke menyaa ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖe nu hafi wòsína o; ke ame dzɔdzɔe ya ɖea dzi ɖi abe dzata ene.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Ne dukɔ da vo la, edziɖulawo sɔa gbɔ; ke to nunyala kpɔnuteƒe dzi la, nuwo gbugbɔna nɔa ɖoɖo nu ɖaa.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Ame dahe si tea ame dahewo ɖe anyi la, le abe tsidzadza si megblẽa nuɖuɖu aɖeke ɖi o la ene.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo mesea nya dzɔdzɔe gɔme o; ke ame siwo dia Aƒetɔ la, sea nuwo katã gɔme nyuie.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ame dahe si ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o la, nyo wu kesinɔtɔ si wɔa nu fitifiti.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ame si léa se la me ɖe asi la, vi nyanue; ke ame si dea ha kple nu tsu ɖulawo la, dea ŋukpe mo na tɔ́a.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔa demexɔxɔ kple gadzìga tsɔna dzia eƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖe edzii la, le kɔ lim nuwo ɖi na ame si wɔa dɔmenyo na ame dahewo.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Ame si do toku sea la, eƒe gbedodoɖawo nye ŋunyɔnu.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Ame si ble nuteƒewɔlawo yi mɔ vɔ̃ɖi dzii la, eya ŋutɔ age dze do si wòɖe ɖi la me; ke fɔmaɖilawo anyi nu nyui ƒe dome.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔ bua eɖokui nunyalae; ke ame dahe nugɔmesela kpɔa egɔme.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Ne ame dzɔdzɔewo ɖu dzi la, aseyetsotso gã wònyena; ke ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe alɔ yi dzi la, amewo sína ɖaɣlaa wo ɖokui.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Ame si tsyɔa nu eƒe dzidadawo dzi la, nu madze dzi nɛ o; ke ame si ʋu wo me eye wòdzudzɔ wo wɔwɔ la, woakpɔ nublanui nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Yayratɔe nye ame si vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ ɣe sia ɣi; ke ame si sẽ dzime goŋgoŋ la, adze dzɔgbevɔ̃e me.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Dziɖula vɔ̃ɖi si le dukɔ dahe dzi ɖum la, le abe dzata si le gbe ɖem alo sisiblisi si be yealé nu ene.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Dziɖula si si nugɔmesese mele o la, nye ŋutasẽla ameteɖeanyila; ke ame si lé fu amebaba la, anɔ agbe didi.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Ame si dzi hlɔ̃fe le la, anɔ sísi dzi va se ɖe eƒe kugbe; ame aɖeke megalée da ɖi o.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔa nuteƒe la, woaɖee; ke ame si wɔa nu fitifiti la, age dze do me.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ame si de agble la, nuɖuɖu abɔ ɖe esi fũu; ke ame si tia nu maɖinuwo yome la, eƒe ahedada agadzi ɖe edzi.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Yayra anɔ nuteƒewɔla dzi fũu; ke ame si tsi dzi ɖe gakpɔkpɔ ŋu la, womagbe tohehe nɛ o.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Amedzidede menyo o; ke le abolo kakɛ si ame axɔ ta la, azu vodala.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Nuvela tsia dzi ɖe kesinɔnu ŋu; ke menyae be hiã le ye dzi va ge o.

english_verse: Honest correction is appreciated more than flattery.
translation_verse: Mokanamela axɔ akpe emegbe wu numevivila.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Ame si da adzo tɔ́a alo nɔa hegblɔ be: “Menye nuvɔ̃ aɖeke o” la, nugblẽlawo xɔlɔ̃ wònye.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋuklẽla hea dzre vɛ; ke ame si ɖoa dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu la, eme aganyo nɛ.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖoa dzi ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe gɔmesese ŋu la, bometsilae; ke ame si zɔna le nunya me la, woaɖee.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Ame si naa nu ame dahe la, hiã matui akpɔ o; ke ame si trɔa mo ɖe aga la, woaƒo fi adee.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo tso la, amewo ɣlaa wo ɖokui; ke ne wotsrɔ̃ la, ame dzɔdzɔewo dzina ɖe edzi.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Ame si wokaa mo na enuenu gake metsɔa ɖeke le eme o la, edome agblẽ keŋkeŋ zi ɖeka, eye womate ŋu ada gbe le eŋu o.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Ne ame dzɔdzɔewo le dzi ɖum la, dukɔa tsoa aseye; ke ne ame vɔ̃ɖi ɖu dzi la, dukɔa ɖea hũ.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Vi si lɔ̃ nunya la, doa dzidzɔ na tɔ́a; ke esi dea ha kple gbolowo la, gblẽa eƒe kesinɔnuwo dome.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ fia tsɔna lia ke dukɔ; ke fia si xɔa nunana vivivo la, gbãnɛ.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Ame si vivia nu me na ehavi la, ɖoa ɖɔ na ehavi ƒe afɔ.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Woléa nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla le eƒe dzidada me; ke nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla adzi ha atso aseye.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe nyaa nu si nye ame dahewo tɔ gome; ke ame vɔ̃ɖi mesea sidzedze sia gɔme o.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Ne nya ɖo nunyala kple bometsila dome la, bometsila la ɖeko wòdoa dɔmedzoe, nɔa nu kom, eye mezia ɖoɖoe o.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Hlɔ̃dolawo léa fu ame maɖifɔ, ke nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo kpɔa eƒe agbe ta.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Bometsila ɖea eƒe dɔmedzoe fiana ale si wòate ŋui; ke nunyala ya léa eɖokui.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Ne dziɖula le to ɖom alakpanyawo la, eƒe amegãwo katã ava zu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Ame dahe kple ameteɖeanyila siaa wosɔ; Aƒetɔ ye na ŋku wo ame evea be woakpɔ nui.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Fia si drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe na ame dahewo la ƒe fiazikpui ali ke tegbee.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Ameƒoti kple mokaname fiaa nunya, ke vi tsiyame nye ŋukpe na nɔa.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le dzi ɖum la, sedzidada dzina ɖe edzi; ke ame dzɔdzɔewo anye woƒe anyidzeƒekpɔlawo.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: He viwò ekema ana gbɔdzɔe wò, eye wòado dzidzɔ na wò.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Ne Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe mele dukɔ aɖe me o la, dukɔa trana; ke woyra ame si léa sea me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Wometsɔa nya ko hea kluvi o, elabe ne ese eme gɔ̃ hã la, mele edzi wɔ ge o.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Èle ame si tsi dzi le nuƒoƒo me la kpɔma? Mɔkpɔkpɔ le bometsila si wu eyama.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Kluvi si wowɔ vi na tso ɖevime ke la, ava zu domenyila emegbe.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoetɔ hea dzre vɛ, eye dzikutɔ daa vo geɖe.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Ɖokuidodoɖedzi bɔbɔa ame ɖe anyi; ke ɖokuibɔbɔ dea bubu ame ŋu.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Ame si dea ha kple fiafitɔ la, lé fu eya ŋutɔ ƒe agbe; ase fiƒode gake magblɔ nya aɖeke o.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔvɔvɔ̃ mɔ̀ wònye ɖea ame; ke ame si ɖoa dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu la, anɔ dedie.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo wɔa ameŋkumenu be yewoadze ame si le dzi ɖum la ŋu; ke Aƒetɔ ye tsoa afia na ame.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Agur, Yake vi, tso Masa, ƒe nyawo. Agur gblɔ na Itiel kple Ukal be:

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, medzɔ lã akpa be manye amegbetɔ. Nyemesea nu gɔme abe amegbetɔ ene o.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Nyemesrɔ̃ nunya o, eye nyemenya naneke le Kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu o.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Ame kae yi dziƒo gagbɔ kpɔ? Ame kae mia asi ɖe ya dzi kpɔ? Ame kae bla tsi ɖe avɔ me kpɔ? Ame kae ɖo xexea me ƒe mlɔenuwo katã anyi? Eŋkɔ ɖe? Via hã ŋkɔ ɖe? Ẽ, ènyae!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nya ɖe sia ɖe nye nyateƒe. Enye akpoxɔnu na ame siwo sinɛ tsona.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ nya aɖeke kpe eƒe nyawo o. Ne menye nenema o la, aka mo na wò, eye àzu aʋatsokala. Lododo bubuwo

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Nu eve biam mele wò: Mègagbe wo nanam hafi maku o:

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Te amebeble kple aʋatsokaka ɖa sãa tso gbɔnye. Mègana ahedada alo kesinɔnum o; nyim kple nuɖuɖu si mehiã la ko.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, maɖi ƒo ahagbe nu le gbɔwò agblɔ be: “Ame kae nye Aƒetɔ?” Alo mada ahe, ahafi fi, eye maƒo ɖi nye Mawu ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Mègagblɔ dɔla ƒe nya vɔ̃e na eƒe aƒetɔ o. Ne menye nenema o la, dɔlaa ava ƒo fi ade wò, eye woabu wò fɔɖilae.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo li si ƒoa fi dea wo tɔ́, eye womeyraa wo nɔ o.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo li siwo buna be yewodza gake womeklɔa woƒe ɖiƒoƒo ɖa o.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo li siwo to ŋku gã, eye wokɔa woƒe aɖaba dzi dàdatɔe.

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: Vinyɔnu eve le alobo si. Wole ɣli dom be: “Tsɔe vɛ! Tsɔe vɛ!” Nu etɔ̃ meɖia ƒo gbeɖe o; nu ene megblɔna gbeɖe be: “Esu” o:

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe, nyɔnu konɔ ƒe vidzidɔ, anyigba si tsi meɖia kɔ na o kple dzo si megblɔna be: “Esu” o.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Ŋku si ɖea alɔ me le tɔ́a ŋu, eye mebua nɔa ɖe naneke me ahaɖo toe o la, bali me akpaviawo ahoe le to me, eye akagawo aɖui.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Nu etɔ̃, wɔ nuku nam ŋutɔ; nu ene, nyemese wo gɔme o:

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: hɔ̃ ƒe nuwɔna le dziŋgɔli me; da ƒe zɔzɔ le agakpe dzi; tɔdziʋu ƒe atsiaƒu dzi toto; ŋutsu ƒe toƒe le nyɔnu ŋu.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Alea nye nyɔnu ahasitɔ hã ƒe agbe: eɖua nu, tutua nu to, eye wògblɔna be: “Nyemewɔ nu gbegblẽ aɖeke o.”

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Nu etɔ̃ nana be anyigba ʋuʋuna; nu ene wua tsɔtsɔ nɛ:

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: ne kluvi va zu fia, ne bometsila ɖu nu ɖi ƒo,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: ne nyɔnu si womelɔ̃ o la va ɖe srɔ̃, ne dɔlanyɔnu va xɔ eƒe aƒenɔ teƒe.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Nu ene le sue le anyigba dzi gake wonya nu ale gbegbe:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: anyidiwo: wonye dukɔ si si ŋusẽ mele o, gake wodia woƒe nuɖuɖu le dzomeŋɔli;

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: hotoklolowo: wonye dukɔ si si ŋusẽ mele o, gake agakpewo me kee wowɔa nɔƒe ɖo;

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: ʋetsuviwo: fia mele wo nu o, gake wo katã wozɔna le ɖoɖo me;

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: adoglowo: woate ŋu alé ɖeka ɖe asi me gake fiasãwo me wonɔna.

english_verse: Three or four creatures really strut around:
translation_verse: Nu etɔ̃ zɔa atsyɔ̃zɔli, eye ene ya zɔa fiazɔli:

english_verse: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle,
translation_verse: Dzata si nye kalẽtɔ le lãwo dome eye mesína le naneke nu o,

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: koklotsu si klẽ aʋala, gbɔ̃tsu, fia si le zɔzɔm le eƒe aʋakɔ ŋgɔ.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Ne ètsi bome le ɖokuiwò dom ɖe dzi, alo nèɖo vɔ̃ ɖe tame la, ɖo asi nu!

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Elabe ne woƒo notsi la, amie dona, eye ne wofiã ŋɔti sesĩe la, ʋue dona. Ne wodo dɔmedzoe helihelĩ la, dzree dzɔna.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Lemuel, Masa-fia, ƒe nufiamenya siwo wòsrɔ̃ le nɔa gbɔ.

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Oo, vinye! Nye dɔmevi, oo! Oo, nye adzɔgbeɖevi!

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ wò ŋusẽ na nyɔnuwo, alo wò mɔwo nanɔ nyanya na fiatsrɔ̃lawo o.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Oo, Lemuel! Menye fiawo ƒe dɔe o; wain nono menyo na fiawo o, dziɖula menoa aha muame o.

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: Elabe ne wonoe la, woaŋlɔ se la be, eye woatrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe ƒe ta atu na ame gblɔewo katã.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Mina aha sesẽ ame siwo le tsɔtsrɔ̃m la; mina wain ame siwo le veve helihelĩ sem la.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Wonenoe ne woaŋlɔ woƒe ahedada be; wonenoe ne womagaɖo ŋku woƒe fukpekpewo dzi o.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Ke nu nàtso afia dzɔdzɔe, eye nàxɔ na ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo. Srɔ̃nyɔnu nyui

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Ame kae akpɔ srɔ̃nyɔnu nyui? Exɔ asi sãa wu dzonu nyuitɔ!

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃a ɖoa dzi ɖe eŋu; naneke mehiãnɛ o.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Ewɔa nyui na ŋutsua, menye vɔ̃ o, le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Edia alẽfu kple anazi, eye wotsɔa eƒe asiwo wɔa dɔe faa kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Ele abe asitsalawo ƒe asiʋu ene, eye wòhea nuɖuɖu tso didiƒewo vɛ.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Efɔna xoxoxo hafi ŋu va kena. Enaa nuɖuɖu eƒe aƒemetɔwo, eye wònaa dɔ eƒe dɔlanyɔnuwo wowɔna.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Ewɔa susu dia agbledenyigba ƒlena, eye wòtsɔa eƒe dɔwɔwɔ me kutsetse dea waingblee.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: Etsɔa ŋusẽ blaa ali dzi, eye wodoa ŋusẽ eƒe alɔwo.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Edea dzesii be yeƒe asitsatsa ɖea vi na ye. Eƒe akaɖi metsina le zã me o.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Eʋua asi me na ame dahewo, eye wòkpena ɖe hiãtɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Mevɔ̃na ɖe eƒemetɔwo nu, ne vuvɔ le wɔwɔm o, elabe wo katã wotsyɔa kuntru dzĩ.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Elɔ̃a kuntru na eɖokui; aklala kple aɖabɛ nye eƒe awuwo.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Amewo dze si srɔ̃a le dua ƒe agbowo nu, ne wònɔ anyi ɖe dumemetsitsiwo dome.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Etɔa aklalawuwo dzrana, eye asitsalawo xɔa alidziblanu tso egbɔ.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ kple bubu nye eƒe avɔ tsyɔtsyɔ, eye etsɔ si gbɔna la ɖia kokoe nɛ.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Eƒoa nu kple nunya, eye dɔmenyo nufiame le eƒe aɖe dzi.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Eléa ŋku ɖe nuwo ƒe yiyime ŋu le eƒe aƒeme, eye meɖua kuviabolo o.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Viawo tsona heyɔnɛ be: Yayrame; srɔ̃a hã nenema, eye wòkafunɛ be:

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Nyɔnu zazɛ̃ geɖewo nya li ya; ke wò la, èƒo wo katã ta.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Nyonyo la, beblee, eye tugbedzedze la, nu dzodzroe; ke nyɔnu si vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ la, ele be woakafui.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ ƒe kutsetse nɛ, eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nekafui le dua ƒe agbowo nu.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla, David vi, ame si nye fia le Yerusalem la, ƒe nyawoe nye esiwo gbɔna:

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla la be: Nu dzodzrowo ƒe nu dzodzro! Nu dzodzrowo ƒe nu dzodzro! Nu sia nu nye nu dzodzro!

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Viɖe ka koŋ amegbetɔ kpɔna tso eƒe dagbadagba me le ɣea te?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Dzidzime ɖeka nu va yina bubu kplɔnɛ ɖo gake anyigba ya li tegbee.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Ɣe dzena, ɣe ɖoa to, eye wòɖea abla yia afi si wòdzena tso.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Ya ƒona yia anyigbeme, eye wòtrɔna vaa dzigbeme. Eƒoa xlã godoo, eye wòtrɔna godòo vaa afi si wòƒo tso.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Tɔwo gadzea egɔme sína yia atsiaƒu me, gake atsiaƒu meyɔna o. Afi si tɔwo sína ɖoa tae la, afi ma ko woyina ɖaa.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Ɖeɖi te nuwo katã ŋu, gbɔgblɔ glo gbetɔ. Nukpɔkpɔ meɖia ƒo na ŋku o. Nusese meyɔa to o.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Nane li, si ŋu wogblɔ le be: “Mikpɔ ɖa, nu yeye nye esia!” mahã? Eli tso blema ke hafi míawo míeva dzɔ.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Egbetɔwo ŋlɔ blematɔwo be, nenema ke ame siwo gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la hã, wo yometɔwo aŋlɔ wo be. Nufiala la ƒe nuteƒekpɔkpɔ le agbe ŋu

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Nye nufiala la, meɖu fia le Yerusalem ɖe Israel-dukɔa dzi.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Meɖo tame be matsɔ nunya adzro nu siwo katã dzɔna le xexea me la me kpɔ, ne mase wo gɔme nyuie. Dɔ si me dzidzɔ mele o la wònye Mawu tsɔ de asi na amegbetɔviwo be woanɔ kutri kum le eŋu.

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Esi melé ŋku ɖe nu siwo katã ame wɔna le ɣea te ŋu la, kpɔ ɖa, nu dzodzrowo sɔŋ ko wonye; yadɔ ko ye.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Nu si glɔ̃ la womate ŋu adzɔe o, eye nu si meli o la, womate ŋu axlẽe o.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Megblɔ le ɖokuinye me be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mede ŋgɔ eye menya nu geɖe wu fia siwo katã ɖu Yerusalem dzi do ŋgɔ nam la. Meto nunya kple sidzedze geɖe me.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Medze agbagba be manya nu si nye sidzedze kple aɖaʋadzedze kpakple bometsitsi. Ke mekpɔe dze sii be esia hã, yadɔ ko ye.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Elabe sidzedze fũu hea dzimaɖeɖi hã vanɛ, eye ame si dzia eƒe nunya ɖe edzi la, dzia nuxaxa ɖe edzi.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: Megblɔ le ɖokuinye me be mate agbeɖuɖu kpɔ, ne nye dzi nadze eme. Gake kpɔ ɖa, esia hã nu dzodzro ko wònye.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Megblɔ le nukoko ŋu be aɖaʋae, eye megblɔ le dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ŋu be nu kae le eme?

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Mede ŋugble be mado dzidzɔ na nye ŋutilã kple wain, ke sidzedze naganɔ menye, eye be mawɔ bometsinu va se ɖe esime mekpɔ nu si nyo be amegbetɔ nawɔ le dziƒoa te le eƒe agbenɔŋkekewo me.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Mewɔ dɔ klitsuwo; metso aƒewo, eye mede waingblewo.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: Metso abɔwo, eye metu modzakaɖebɔwo hedo kutsetseti vovovowo ɖe wo me.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ mewɔ tawo, be matsɔ wo me tsi ade ati fɛ̃awo.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Meƒle kluviwo kple kosiwo, eye wodzi bubuwo hã ɖe nye ŋutɔ nye aƒeme. Alẽwo kple nyiwo hã nɔ asinye fũu. Nye lãwo sɔ gbɔ wu ame sia ame si nɔ Yerusalem kpɔ la tɔ.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: Nenema ke meƒo sika, klosalo kple fiawo kpakple anyigbawo ƒe kesinɔnuwo nu ƒu na ɖokuinye. Meɖo ŋutsuhadzihawo kple nyɔnuhadzihawo na ɖokuinye. Nu siwo katã doa dzidzɔ na ŋutsu la nɔ asinye: nyɔnu nyɔnuwo bɔ ɖe asinye.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Ale meva zu kesinɔtɔwo ƒe kesinɔtɔ, eye mexɔ ŋkɔ wu ame siwo katã nɔ Yerusalem do ŋgɔ nam la. Ke sidzedze ganɔ menye.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si dzro nye ŋku la, mekpɔnɛ. Nyemegbe dzidzɔ aɖeke dodo na ɖokuinye o, elabe dɔ sia dɔ si mewɔna la doa dzidzɔ nam, eye esia nye viɖe si mekpɔ tso nye dagbadagbawo katã me.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Ke esi melé ŋku ɖe nu siwo katã mewɔ kple fu siwo katã mekpe le wo wɔwɔ me ŋu la, kpɔ ɖa, nu dzodzro kple yadɔ ko wo katã wonye. Viɖe aɖeke mele wo me le ɣea te o.

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Azɔ metrɔ be malé ŋku ɖe sidzedze, aɖaʋadzedze kple bometsitsi ŋu elabe nu ka ame si va zi dzi ɖe fia yome la awɔ? Nu si wowɔ va yi xoxo la koe!

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ be sidzedze ƒo bometsitsi ta sãa abe ale si kekeli ƒo viviti ta sãa la ene.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Nunyala to ŋku tsɔna kpɔa nui; ke bometsilawo ya zɔa viviti me. Ke hã la, mede dzesii be nu ɖeka ma koe dzɔna ɖe wo kple eve la siaa dzi.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Eya ta megblɔ le ɖokuinye me be: “Nu si dzɔ ɖe bometsila dzi la, eya kee le dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe nye hã dzinye. Ekema nu ka ta sidzedze le menye ale gbegbe?” Tete megblɔ na ɖokuinye be: “Esia hã nu dzodzro ko wònye.”

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Esiawo katã ta melé fu agbenɔnɔ ɖo, elabe nu siwo wowɔna le ɣea te la veam elabe wo katã nye nu dzodzro kple yadɔ ko.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Melé fu dɔ siwo katã medze agbagba wɔ le ɣea te la, elabe mele wo gblẽ ge ɖi godoo na yonyemedzela.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ame kae nya ne eyama ava nye nunyala loo, alo bometsila? Evɔ wònye eyae gbɔna tɔ ɖo ge ɖe nu siwo katã metsɔ nye ŋusẽ kple nunya wɔ le ɣea te la nu. Esia hã nu dzodzro ko ye.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Dzi ɖe le ƒonye, le dɔ siwo katã medze agbagba wɔ le ɣea te la ŋu,

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: elabe ɣe aɖewo ɣi la, ele na gbetɔ be wòagblẽ nu siwo katã wòku kutri tsɔ eƒe sidzedze, nunya kple aɖaŋu wɔe la ɖi na ame bubu, si mekpe fu aɖeke ɖe eŋu o. Esia hã nye nu dzodzro kple nuvɔ̃ɖi gã aɖe.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Viɖe ka tututue gbetɔ kpɔna tsoa eƒe dagbadagbawo kple ɖeɖiteameŋuwo me le ɣea te?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Eƒe agbenɔŋkekewo katã yɔ fũu kple nuxaxa, eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔ nana be wòsea veve. Le zã me gɔ̃ hã la, meɖea dzi ɖi o. Esia hã nu dzodzro ko wònye.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Ðe menye nu nyuitɔ na gbetɔe nye be wòaɖu nu, ano nu, eye ne ewɔ dɔ kpɔ nu la, wòaɖu agbe oa? Mekpɔ dze sii be eya hã Mawu ƒe nunana wònye.

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu manɔmee la, ame kae ate ŋu aɖu nu alo aɖu agbe?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒe nu nyo Mawu ŋu la, eyae wòtsɔa sidzedze, nunya kple dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ nana. Ke nuvɔ̃wɔla ya la, Mawu nana be wòƒoa ƒu nu, lia kɔe ɖi gleglegle, be ye Mawu ŋutɔ yeatsɔe na ame si dze ye ŋu la. Eya hã nye nu dzodzro kple yadɔ ko.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi li na nu sia nu, eye azã li na tameɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe le dziƒoa te.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Dzigbe li, eye kugbe li; nuƒãɣi li, eye nuŋeɣi li.

english_verse: for killing and healing, destroying and building,
translation_verse: Amewuɣi li, eye gbedaɣi li; nugbãɣi li, eye nutuɣi li.

english_verse: for crying and laughing, weeping and dancing,
translation_verse: Avifaɣi li, eye nukoɣi li; konyifaɣi li, eye ɣeɖuɣi li.

english_verse: for throwing stones and gathering stones, embracing and parting.
translation_verse: Kpefɔƒugbeɣi li, eye kpefɔƒoƒuɣi li; asikplakɔɣi li, eye asimakplakɔɣi li.

english_verse: There is a time for finding and losing, keeping and giving,
translation_verse: Nudiɣi li, eye nubuɣi li; nudzraɖoɣi li, eye nuƒugbeɣi li.

english_verse: for tearing and sewing, listening and speaking.
translation_verse: Nuvuɣi li, eye nutɔɣi li; ɖoɖoeziɣi li, eye nuƒoɣi li.

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ɣi li, eye fuléɣi li; aʋawɔɣi li, eye ŋutifafaɣi li.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Viɖe kae dɔwɔla kpɔna tso eƒe kutrikuku me?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Melé ŋku ɖe dɔdeasi si Mawu na ame sia ame be wòanɔ agbagba dzem le eŋu la ŋu.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si wòwɔ la sɔ na ewɔɣi. Togbɔ be Mawu na amegbetɔ nya ale si ɣeyiɣiwo kple nyadzɔdzɔwo vana ɖe wo nɔewo yomee hã la, amegbetɔ medze si Mawu ƒe nuwɔnawo ƒe gɔmedzedze ɖase ɖe woƒe nuwuwu o.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dze sii be naneke menyo na amegbetɔwo wu be, zi ale si wole agbe la, woakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woaɖu agbe o.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Gawu la, be ame aɖe naɖu nu, ano nu, eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔ nado dzidzɔ nɛ la, Mawu ƒe nunana ye.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: Medze sii hã be nu sia nu si Mawu wɔ la anɔ anyi tegbee; womate ŋu atsɔ naneke akpee o, eye womate ŋu aɖe naneke le eme hã o. Mawu ɖe wòwɔe alea, be woavɔ̃ ye.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Nu si li egbe la, nɔ anyi kpɔ; nu si gbɔna la, li xoxo; ke Mawu gbugbɔa nu siwo nu va yi la wɔna. Mawu le ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge ame sia ame

english_verse: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.
translation_verse: Megakpɔ le ɣea te hã be, le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe la, nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ li, eye le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔƒe hã la, nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ xɔ aƒe.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Megblɔ le ɖokuinye me be Mawu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame dzɔdzɔe la kple ame vɔ̃ɖi la siaa, elabe ɣeyiɣi li na nya sia nya kple nuwɔna sia nuwɔna hã.

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Melé ŋku ɖe amegbetɔwo ŋu, eye mekpɔ be Mawu ɖe wòle wo dom kpɔ be woadze sii be lã ko yewonye.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Teƒe ɖeka ko wo katã yina. Wo katã do go tso anyi me, eye anyi kee wogatrɔna zuna.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Ame kae nya ne gbetɔwo ƒe gbɔgbɔ yia dzi, eye lãwo tɔ ya yia anyigba me mahã?

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Ale mekpɔ be naneke menyo na gbetɔ wu be wòawɔ dɔ, aɖu emetsonu kple dzidzɔ o, elabe eyae wòxɔ vɛ. Ame kae akplɔe gbɔe wòava kpɔ nu si adzɔ le eƒe ku megbe?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Megalé ŋku ɖe ameteteɖeanyi siwo katã yia edzi le ɣea te la hã ŋu. Kpɔ ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la ƒe aɖatsi ɖa, ke akɔfala aɖeke meli na wo o. Ame siwo te wo ɖe anyi la, woawo sie ŋusẽ le; ke ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la ya, akɔfala aɖeke meli na wo o.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ be ame siwo ku gbe aɖe gbe la tɔ me nyo wu ame siwo le agbe fifia la tɔ.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo tɔ me ganyo sãa wu ame siawo tɔ lae nye ame siwo womekpɔ dzi haɖe o, bene womava kpɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo amewo le wɔwɔm le ɣea te la teƒe o.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Tete megakpɔ dze sii be nu si nana be ame kua kutri, eye wòdzea aɖaŋu le dɔwɔwɔ me lae nye ŋuʋaʋã ame havi. Esia hã nu dzodzro kple yadɔ ko wònye.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Bometsila de asi ata me, dɔ wui wòɖi ku glaglaglã.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Anyinɔnɔ kpoo asiʋlo ɖeka nyo wu hloloetsotso kple dagbadagba asiʋlo eve, elabe esiawo la, yadɔ ko wonye.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Megakpɔ nu dzodzro bubu aɖe le ɣea te.

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Eyae nye amemanɔsitɔ ƒe nya: viŋutsu mele esi o; nɔviŋutsu hã meli o. Gake dagbadagba dzi ko wòle madzudzɔmadzudzɔe. Ne ekpɔ kesinɔnu hã la, meɖia ƒo nɛ gbeɖe o. Mebiaa eɖokui be: Ame ka tae mele hloloe tsom alea, gbe nu le ɖokuinye gbɔ hegbe agbeɖuɖu? Esia hã nu dzodzro ko wònye; dɔ vloe.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Evenɔnɔ nyo wu akogotsitsi, elabe evenɔlawo kpɔa viɖe tso wo nɔewo ƒe agbagbadzedze me.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Ne ame ɖeka dze anyi la, evelia afɔe. Ke baba na ame si tsi akogo, elabe ne edze anyi la, eƒe evelia meli afɔe o.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne ame eve mlɔ wo nɔewo xa la, wonaa dzoxɔxɔ wo nɔewo. Ke ale ke ame ɖeka ate ŋu ana dzoxɔxɔ eɖokuii?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ame ɖeka ate ŋu aɖu ame ɖeka dzi hã la, ame eve anɔ te ɖe enu. Kagbigbi nu etɔ̃ menyatsona o.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Woate ŋu aɖe ɖekakpui sia tso gaxɔ me teti ko aɖo fiae, togbɔ be ahedada mee wodzii ɖo le fiaɖuƒe la me hã.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ agbagbeawo katã le ɣea te, kplɔ ɖekakpui si ava zi dzi ɖe ame kemɛa teƒe la ɖo.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Eteviwo sɔ gbɔ fũu, womanyaxlẽ o. Gake dzidzime siwo ava emegbe la makpɔ dzidzɔ le eŋu o. Nyateƒe, esia hã nu dzodzro kple yadɔ ko wònye.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Ne èyi Mawu ƒe aƒeme la, nànya zɔzɔ. Te ɖe Mawu ŋu ne nàse eƒe nya. Esia nyo wu be nasa vɔ abe bometsilawo ene, elabe bometsilawo menya be yewole nuvɔ̃ wɔm o.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Mègaƒo nu tamemabutɔe le Mawu ŋkume o, eye mègayɔ be yeake nu o. Elabe Mawu le dziƒo, ke wò ya, èle anyigba dzi. Eya ta wò nyawo nanɔ ʋɛ ko.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Drɔ̃ekuku vivivo yina kple hloloetsotso, eye bometsitsi dea ha kple nu kpoloe ƒoƒo.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Ne èɖe adzɔgbe na Mawu la, mègahe edziwɔwɔ ɖe megbe o, elabe bometsilawo ƒe nu menyoa Mawu ŋu o. Ale si nèɖe adzɔgbee la, wɔe ɖe edzi.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Ne mèɖe adzɔgbe kura o la, enyo wu be nàɖe adzɔgbe, mawɔ edzi o.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Mègana wò nu nahe wò de nuvɔ̃ me o, eye mègagblɔ le Mawu ƒe amedɔdɔ ŋkume be ɖe wòge le ye nu o. Nu ka ta wòhiã be wò nuƒo nado dziku na Mawu, eye wòagblẽ wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo?

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Drɔ̃e geɖe kuku kple nu kpoloe ƒoƒo la, nu dzodzro wonye. Ke wò la, vɔ̃ Mawu boŋ. Agbenɔnɔ nye nu dzodzro

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Ne èkpɔ be wole ame dahewo tem ɖe to le nuto aɖe me, eye wotsri ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ kple nu si dze ame la wɔwɔ nɛ la, esia megawɔ nuku na wò o; elabe dziɖula si le esia wɔm la ƒe amegã li, le ekpɔm, eye dumegãwo gali wu eya hã.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Le goawo katã me la, enye viɖe na dukɔa be fia natsɔ agbledede aɖo dɔe.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Ga maɖi ƒo na galɔ̃la o, eye viɖe aɖeke made na kesinɔnulɔ̃la o. Esia hã nu dzodzro ko wònye.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Ne kesinɔnu dzi ɖe edzi la, eɖulawo hã dzina ɖe edzi. Viɖe kae le eme na nutɔ wu be wòatsɔ ŋku akpɔe ko?

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Agbatedɔwɔla ɖu nu sue aɖe o, eɖu nu fũu o, edɔa alɔ̃ vivi; ke kesinɔtɔ ya ƒe nunɔamesi gbogboawo menana be wòdɔa alɔ̃ o.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Nu vlo gã si mekpɔ le ɣea te lae nye be kesinɔtɔ li kɔ nu ɖi fũu, wòva wɔ nu vevii.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Ne nya vɔ̃ aɖe dzɔ la, eƒe adzɔdɔwo me gblẽna, eye wòbúa eƒe kesinɔnuwo. Togbɔ be enye dzila hã la, naneke meganɔa esi wòtsɔna naa viawo o.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Ale si wònɔ amamae do tso nɔa ƒe dɔmee la, nenema ke wòganɔna dzonae. Edzea agbagba kpem, gake mekpɔa naneke léna ɖe asi yinae o.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Esia hã nye nu vlo gã aɖe: ale si wòvae la, nenema ke wòagayii. Azɔ viɖe ka koŋ wòkpɔ be wòdagba ɖe ya me?

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Gawu la, egblẽa eƒe agbenɔŋkekewo katã le viviti, vevesese, dɔléle kple dziku geɖe me.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nu si nyea mekpɔ be enyo, eye wòdze lae nye be: ame naɖu nu, ano nu, eye wòadzɔ dzi le dɔ siwo katã wòwɔna, le ŋkeke ʋɛ siwo Mawu nae le ɣea te la ŋuti, elabe esiae nye etɔ gome.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Gawu la, ne Mawu na kesinɔnu kple nu nunɔamesiwo ame aɖe, eye wòna ŋusẽe be wòawɔ wo ŋudɔ akpɔ etɔ gome, adzɔ dzi le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋu la, esia hã Mawu ƒe nunana wònye.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu na eƒe dzi dze eme ta la, mebua tame boo le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo ŋu o.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ nu masɔmasɔ aɖe hã le ɣea te si nye agba na amegbetɔƒomea.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Eya nye ame si Mawu na kesinɔnu, nunɔamesiwo kple bubui, eye nu siwo katã wòdina sua esi, ke Mawu mena ŋusẽe be wòaɖu nu siawo ƒe ɖeke o, boŋ wònye ame tutɔe va ɖunɛ la. Esia hã nye nu dzodzro kple dɔléle vɔ̃ɖi aɖe.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe dzi vi alafa, nɔ agbe, tsi xɔ ƒè geɖee ŋutɔ, ke nu nyuiwo meɖi ƒo nɛ o, alo womeɖii nyuie o la, mebe fu gegee gɔ̃ hã tɔ me nyo wu etɔ.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, mekpɔ ɣe kpɔ alo nyae o. Evɔ la, eyama ƒe dzi dze eme wu ame kemɛ tɔ.

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: Nenye ame la ɖe wònɔ agbe ƒe akpe, ganɔ ƒe akpe kpee, meɖu agbe aɖeke o la, ɖe menye teƒe ɖeka ma ke ko amewo katã yina oa?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Dɔ sia dɔ si amegbetɔ wɔna la, nu ko wòwɔnɛ na, gake eƒe nudzodzro nu metsina o.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Nu kae nunyala tsɔ wú bometsila? Viɖe ka ame dahe si nya zɔzɔ le agbe me la kpɔna?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Nukpɔkpɔ kple ŋku nyo wu nudzroame ƒe tsa glãla tsatsa. Esia hã nu dzodzro kple yadɔ ko wònye.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Nu si dzɔ la, ŋkɔ li nɛ xoxo, eye ele nyanya be amegbetɔ mete ŋu hea nya kple ame si tri akɔ wui la o.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Nuƒoƒo geɖe, nya gbɔlo geɖe; viɖe kae le eme na amegbetɔ?

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Elabe ame kae nya nu si nyo na amegbetɔ le eƒe agbenɔɣi dzodzro si nu va yina abe vɔvɔli ene la me? Elabe ame kae ate ŋu agblɔ nu si ava eme le amegbetɔ megbe la nɛ le ɣea te?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Ŋkɔ nyui nyo wu ami ʋeʋẽe nyui; kugbe nyo wu dzigbe.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Kuteƒeyiyi nyo wu agbeɖuƒeyiyi elabe kue nye ame sia ame ƒe nuwuwu ale be wòanɔ susu me na agbagbeawo.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Nuxaxa nyo wu nukoko, elabe ne ame ƒe mo lé blanui la, eƒe susu me kɔna.

english_verse: A sensible person mourns, but fools always laugh.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe susu nɔa kuteƒe; ke bometsilawo ƒe susu ya nɔa agbeɖuƒe.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Enyo be woase nunyalawo ƒe mokaname wu bometsilawo ƒe hadzidzi.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Elabe bometsilawo ƒe nukoko ɖina abe ale si ŋu wóna le dzo me kpotokpoto le ze te ene. Esia hã nu dzodzro ko wònye.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe, ameteteɖeto ɖe wònana be nunyala zua tsukunɔ; zãnu ɖe wògblẽa ame.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Nu ƒe nuwuwu nyo wu eƒe gɔmedzedze, eye dzigbɔɖila nyo wu dàdala.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Mègado dziku kabakaba o, elabe bometsilawo mee dziku xɔa aƒe ɖo.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Mègabia be: “Nu ka ta tsã nyo wu egbe?” hã o. Ne èbia nenema la, ekema nunya mele wò biabia la me o.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Lé ŋku ɖe Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu. Ame kae ate ŋu adzɔ nu si wòglɔ̃ la?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Kpɔ dzidzɔ le ɣeyiɣi siwo me nu nyo na wò la, eye gbe si gbe hiã tu wò la, bu tame. Mawue ɖo wo kple eve siaa alea, bene agbenɔawo naganya nu si ava dzɔ le wo megbe la o.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Le nye agbe dzodzro sia me la, mekpɔ nu sia nu. Ame dzɔdzɔe ku le eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me. Ame vɔ̃ɖi didi eƒe agbe ɖe edzi le eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!
translation_verse: Mègawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe vivivo o, nenema ke mègadze nunya akpa o. Nu ka ta nèdi ku na ɖokuiwò?

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Mègawɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi gbɔ me o, eye mèganye bometsila o. Nu ka ta nàdi be yeaku hafi wò kuɣi naɖo?

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Menyo be nàlé esia me ɖe asi, eye nàɖe asi le ekemɛ hã ŋu o. Ame si vɔ̃a Mawu la akpɔ dzidzedze ne elé wo kple eve la katã me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Nunya naa ŋusẽ nunyala wu ŋusẽtɔ ewo le du me.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Mègake to ɖi be yease nu sia nu si gblɔm amewo le o. Ne menye nenema o la, àva se wò subɔla wòanɔ fi ƒom de wò.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Metsɔ nunya dzro nu siawo katã me kpɔ. Meɖo kpe edzi be madze nunya. Ke nunya le adzɔge ʋĩi tso gbɔnye.

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Metrɔ ɖe sidzedze ŋu. Medi nunya, ti eyome be madze si nu vevitɔ, eye manya be nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ la, bometsitsie, eye movidzɔdzɔ la aɖaʋadzedze ye.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Meke ɖe nu si vena wu ku la ŋu. Eyae nye nyɔnu si ƒe dzi nye mɔ̀ tetre kple ɖɔ, eye eƒe asiwo nye kunyowu. Ame si wɔa Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la sína le enu. Ke nuvɔ̃wɔla gena ɖe eƒe mɔ̀ me.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla la be: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ nu ɖeka kpe ɖe bubu ŋu be make ɖe ŋuɖoɖoa ŋu.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: Medii, gadii ʋuu, ke nyemeke ɖe eŋu o. Ŋutsu ɖeka ŋu ko meke ɖo le akpe dome, ke nyemekpɔ nyɔnu ɖeka pɛ hã le wo katã dome o.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nu si ko ŋu meke ɖo gobie nye esi: Mawu wɔ amegbetɔ be wòato mɔ ɖeka tẽe, ke eya ŋutɔ di ayemɔ geɖe na eɖokui.

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Ame kae le abe nunyala ene? Ame kae se nuwo ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe me? Nunyae nana be ame ƒe mo klẽna, eye wòɖea moyɔyɔ ɖa. Ðo to fia la

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɖe fia ƒe ɖoɖo dzi le atamkaka kɔkɔe la ta,

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: mègayɔ be yeadzo le egbɔ o. Ne nya aɖe menyo o la, mègalé eme goŋgoŋ o, elabe fia la ate ŋu awɔ nu sia nu si wòlɔ̃.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Elabe ŋusẽ le fia ƒe nya ŋu, eye ame kae abiae be: “Nu kae nye esia wɔm nèle?”

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔ ɖe fia ƒe se dzi la, vɔ̃ aɖeke mawɔe o. Nunyala anya ɣeyiɣi kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃ɣi.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: Esi ɣeyiɣi kple nyametsotso li na nu sia nu ta la, amegbetɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃ zu agba ɖe edzi.

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe yaƒoƒo dzi ne wòaxe mɔ nɛ o. Ame aɖeke mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe kugbe dzi o. Womenaa mɔkeke asrafo le aʋakpeɣi o, eye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ meɖea ewɔla o.

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: Esi melé ŋku ɖe nu siwo katã amewo wɔna le ɣea te ŋu la, mede dzesii be ne ame kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe ehavi dzi la, ewɔa nu vevi eɖokui. Ame dzɔdzɔewo kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: Azɔ mekpɔ ale si woɖi ame vɔ̃ɖiwoe. Le woƒe agbenɔɣi la, wodea Mawu ƒe kɔkɔeƒe la enuenu, eye wokafua wo le du si me wowɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi le la me. Esia hã nu dzodzro ko wònye.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Elabe esi afia menya tsona le nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu kaba o ŋuti la, eya tae amegbetɔ ɖoa nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ɖe dzime.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nuvɔ̃wɔla wɔa nuvɔ̃ zi alafa, ke enɔa agbe didi hã la, nye ya menyae be eme anyo na ame siwo vɔ̃a Mawu, elabe wosía eŋkume.

english_verse: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.
translation_verse: Gake dzɔgbe nyui matu nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla o, eye eƒe agbenɔŋkeke siwo le abe vɔvɔli ene la, madidi o, elabe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla mevɔ̃a Mawu o.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Nu dzodzro aɖe hã dzɔna le anyigba dzi. Ame dzɔdzɔe aɖewo li siwo dzi nya dzɔna ɖo abe ame vɔ̃ɖi wonye ene. Nenema ke ame vɔ̃ɖi aɖewo hã li siwo dzi nya dzɔna ɖo abe ame dzɔdzɔe wonye ene. Mebe esia hã nye nu dzodzro ko!

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Eya ta meda asi ɖe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ dzi elabe naneke menyo na amegbetɔ be wòawɔ le ɣea te wu be wòaɖu nu, ano nu, akpɔ dzidzɔ o. Elabe esia koe nye eƒe agbedɔ metsonu si Mawu tsɔ de esi le ɣea te la.

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: Esi mede ŋugble be manya nu si tututu nye nunya, ne makpɔ nu siwo amegbetɔwo le wɔwɔm le anyigba dzi, zã kple keli, hetsi alɔ̃madɔ la,

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: mekpɔ dze sii le Mawu ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo ŋu be ame aɖeke mate ŋu anya ta le nu siwo le edzi yim le ɣea te la nu o. Ale ke kee gbetɔ dze agbagba be yease nuwo gɔmee hã la, mate ŋu anya ta le wo nu gbeɖe o. Togbɔ be nunyala gblɔna be yenya nane hã la, mate ŋu ase Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo gɔme akpɔ o.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: Mebu tame le nya siawo katã ŋu, eye melé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu nyuie. Mekpɔ be Mawu ƒe asi me ame dzɔdzɔewo kple nunyalawo siaa ƒe nuwɔwɔwo le. Lɔlɔ̃ wònye o, fuléle wònye o, ame aɖeke menya o.

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: Nu ɖeka ƒomevie kpea amewo katã. Nya ɖeka tɔgbee dzɔna ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe kple ame vɔ̃ɖi, ame nyui, ame dzadzɛ kple ame madzamadza, ame si saa vɔ kple ame si mesaa vɔ o la siaa dzi. Ale si wòle na nu nyui wɔla la, nenema ko wòle na nuvɔ̃wɔla hã. Ale si wòle na ame si kaa atam la, nenema ko wòle na ame si vɔ̃a atamkaka la hã.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Nu si vɔ̃ɖi le nu siwo katã dzɔna le ɣea te la domee nye be nya ɖekae dzɔna ɖe amewo katã dzi. Ẽ, gawu la, amegbetɔ ƒe tame yɔ fũu kple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ. Eƒe agbenɔnɔ blibo la nye aɖaʋadzedze, eye eya megbe ko la, edzo yi tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Ke ame si gale agbagbeawo dome ko ya la, mɔkpɔkpɔ le esi, elabe avu gbagbe nyo wu dzata kuku.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Agbagbeawo nyae be yewogbɔna kuku ge; ke kukuawo ya menya naneke o. Fetu aɖeke megali na wo o, elabe woŋlɔ wo be.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Woƒe amelɔlɔ̃, fuléle kple ŋuʋaʋã nu yi xoxoxo. Womagakpɔ gome le nu siwo katã dzɔna le ɣea te la me gbeɖe o.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Eya ta heyi nàɖu wò nu kple dzidzɔ, eye nàno wò wain le dzidzeme me elabe Mawu da asi ɖe nu siwo wɔm nèle la dzi tso gbe aɖe gbe ke.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Wò nudodowo nanye nu ɣi ɣe sia ɣi, eye mègagbe amisisi ɖe tame ɣeaɖekeɣi o.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: Ðu agbe kple srɔ̃wò lɔlɔ̃a le wò agbe ƒuƒlu sia si wona wò le ɣea te la katã me, elabe eyae wò hã nèxɔ vɛ. Esia nye tɔwò gome le agbe me kple agbagba siwo nèdzena le ɣea te la me.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Dɔ sia dɔ si ŋu nède asi be yeawɔ la, wɔe kple wò ŋutete, elabe le tsiẽƒe, afi si yi ge nàla godoo la, dɔwɔwɔ, tamebubu, nunya alo sidzedze aɖeke meli o.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: Megakpɔ dze sii hã be, le ɣea te la, menye du sesẽ ƒulae xɔa gbãtɔ o; menye kalẽtɔe ɖua dzi le aʋa o. Menye nunyalae kpɔa nu ɖuna o; menye ayedzelae kpɔa kesinɔnu o; menye aɖaŋudzela nue wovena o, elabe ɣeyiɣi kple nuɖiɖeame li na wo katã.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ menya ɣe si ɣi vɔ̃ aɖi kpee o. Ale si ɖɔ léa tɔmelã ŋutasẽtɔe, eye mɔ̀ ɖea xeviwoe la, nenema tututue dzɔgbevɔ̃e lilia amegbetɔwo hãe; ɖeko wòdzɔna ɖe wo dzi kpata. Nunya kɔ wu bometsitsi

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: Megake ɖe nunya ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si gbɔna la hã ŋu le ɣea te. Mebui nu vevi aɖee.

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Eva eme be du sue aɖe nɔ anyi si me ame ʋɛ aɖewo ko nɔ. Fia ŋusẽtɔ aɖe ho aʋa ɖe du sia ŋu, eye wòna asrafowo ɖe to ɖee. Eƒo kpo gãwo ɖe dua ŋu.

english_verse: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ke ame dahe nyanu aɖe nɔ dua me. Eya tsɔ eƒe nunya xɔ na du la. Gake ame aɖeke megaɖo ŋku ame dahe la dzi emegbe o.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Ale megblɔ be nunya nyo wu ŋusẽ. Ke hã la, wodoa vlo ame dahe ƒe nunya, eye womeléa to ɖe eƒe nya ŋu o.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Enyo be woaɖo to nunyala ƒe nya, siwo wògblɔ kple gbe bɔbɔe la, wu dziɖula ƒe ɣlidodo le movitɔwo dome.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Nunya nyo wu aʋawɔnuwo; ke nugblẽla ɖeka gblẽa nu nyui geɖe.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Nudzodzoe kuku le ami ʋeʋẽe me, nana be amia ʋẽna kũu. Ale movidzɔdzɔ ʋɛ aɖe kpèna wu nunya kple bubu.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe nugɔmesese kplɔnɛ toa mɔ nyuitɔ dzi; ke bometsila ƒe nugɔmesese kplɔnɛ tranae.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Ne bometsila le zɔzɔm le mɔ dzi yina la, nunya mele tagbɔ nɛ o; eya ta eɖea eɖokui fiaa amewo katã be bometsila yenye.

english_verse: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ne wò dziɖula do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋuwò la, mègadzo le wò teƒe o, elabe ɖokuiléle kpoo tsia vodada gãwo nu.

english_verse: Rulers do some things that are terribly unfair:
translation_verse: Nu tovo aɖe mekpɔ le ɣea te; enye vodada gã. Ede dziɖula ƒe vodada ɖi ge.

english_verse: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;
translation_verse: Wotsɔ bometsila ɖo teƒe kɔkɔ ke, eye kesinɔtɔwo bɔbɔ nɔ teƒe gblɔewo.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ kluviwo le sɔ dzi; ke fiaviwo le afɔ zɔm abe kluviwo ene.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ɖe do la age dze eme, eye ame si le gli gbãm be yeato eme la, eyae da ɖuna.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Kpegbãlae kpe sina, eye nakedzelae xɔa abi.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Ne lãnu tsi kpo, eye womenyre enu o la, ele be woada abɔkame sesĩe; ke nunyae hea dzidzedze vanɛ.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Ne da ɖu ame vɔ hafi wole gbe sam doe la, ekema viɖe aɖeke mele gbesala ŋu o.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe numenya na wovea enu; ke bometsila ƒe nuyiwo hea tsɔtsrɔ̃ vɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe numenya dzea egɔme kple bometsinya, eye eƒe nuƒoƒo wua enu kple aɖaʋanya baɖawo sɔŋ.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, eƒoa nu kpoloe madzudzɔmadzudzɔe. Ame aɖeke menya nu si ava dzɔ o. Ame kae ate ŋu agblɔ nu si etsɔ ahe vɛ?

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe dagbadagba nana be ɖeɖi tea eŋu; elabe menya mɔ si wòato ayi du me gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Ao! Anyigba, baba na wò ne wò fia nye ŋutsuvi ko, eye wò dumegãwo tsona ɖe nuɖuɖu ŋu le ŋdi!

english_verse: But a nation will prosper when its ruler is mature, and its leaders don't party too much.
translation_verse: Anyigba, woyra wò, ne wò fia nye bubume, eye wò dumegãwo yia kplɔ̃ ŋu le ɣeyiɣi nyuitɔ dzi be yewoaɖu nu akpɔ ŋusẽ, menye be woamu aha o.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Ðekematsɔleme nana be xɔta nyéna ɖe eme, eye kuviawɔwɔ nana be xɔ ɖuɖua tsi.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Nukoko tae woɖoa nuɖukplɔ̃ ɖo; wain doa dzidzɔ ɖe agbe ŋu, eye ga nana be ame kpɔa eƒe nu hiahiãwo katã.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Mègake nu ƒo fi de fia le susu me gɔ̃ hã o. Nenema ke mègaƒo fi de gatɔ le wò xɔdɔme kekeake me o, elabe xevi alo nu dzodzoe aɖe ate ŋu aɖakaka nya la.

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Da wò nuɖuɖu ɖo ɖe tɔwo dzi faa, elabe ava kpɔe emegbe godoo.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Ma nuwo ɖe akpa adrẽ alo enyi gɔ̃ hã, elabe mènya dzɔgbevɔ̃e si gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge le anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.
translation_verse: Ame si le ŋku lém ɖe yaƒoƒo ŋu la, maƒã nu o, ame si le ŋku ɖem ɖe alilikpowo la, maŋe nu o.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Abe ale si mènya ale si gbɔgbɔ wɔna gena ɖe ɖevi ƒe ƒuwo me le nɔa ƒe dɔme o ene la, nenema ke mènya naneke le Mawu si wɔ nuwo katã la ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋui o.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Ƒã nu le ŋdi me, eye ne fiẽ ɖo hã mèganɔ anyi dɔ aɖeke mawɔe o. Elabe mènya ne ŋdi me tɔe anyo loo, fiẽ me tɔe ava nyo na wò loo, alo wo kple eve la siaa ye ava nyo o.

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, kekeli me vivina, eye ɣe ƒe keklẽ dzɔa dzi na ŋku.

english_verse: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Ne ame le agbe ƒè geɖee la, nekpɔ dzidzɔ le wo katã me. Ke neɖo ŋku edzi be viviti ŋkekewo hã asɔ gbɔ. Nu siwo katã dzɔna la, nu dzodzro ko wonye. Nunyala la ɖo aɖaŋu na sɔhɛwo

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Wò ɖekakpui, kpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ɖekakpuime. Na wò dzi nado dzidzɔ na wò le wò ɖekakpui ŋkekewo me. Nɔ agbe ɖe wò dzimedidi kple wò ŋkunukpɔkpɔ nu. Ke nyae be Mawu le ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge wò le nu siawo katã ta.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Eya ta ɖe dziku ɖa le dzime, eye wò ŋutilã netsri vɔ̃. Elabe agbenɔnɔ ƒe gɔmedzedze kple ɖekakpuimenɔnɔ la, nu dzodzrowo ko wonye.

english_verse: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, “I don't enjoy life anymore.”
translation_verse: Ðo ŋku wò Wɔla dzi esime nègale ɖekakpuime, hafi fukpeɣiwo nava ɖo, eye ƒe siwo me nàgblɔ le be: “Naneke megadoa dzidzɔ nam o” la nate tu wò.

english_verse: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, ɣe, kekeli, ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo ado viviti, eye alilikpowo akplɔ tsidzadza ɖo.

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, ʋɔtru siwo woʋuna ɖe ablɔ dzi la, anɔ tutu, wɔtutu magaɖi sesĩe o, eye kasia xevi ƒe gbe naɖi la, ame afɔ xoxo, eye nyɔnu hadzilawo katã ƒe gbe me axe.

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, kɔkɔƒe adzi ŋɔ na ame, eye vɔvɔ̃ anɔ mɔ dzi. Yevuziti aƒo se nyuie, ʋetsuvi anɔ eɖokui tem le anyigba, eye nuɖuɖu magadzro ame o. Elabe ele be amegbetɔ ɖe sia ɖe nayi eƒe aƒe mavɔ me, eye konyifalawo nanɔ tsatsam le ablɔ me.
