english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Ðo ŋku edzi hafi klosaloka natso, sikagba nagbã, tsikunu nafli ɖe vudo to, eye tsidumɔ̀ nakaka.

english_verse: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.
translation_verse: Ðo ŋku edzi hafi kewɔ natrɔ yi anyigba si wònye tsã la me, eye gbɔgbɔ la nagbugbɔ yi Mawu, ame si nae la gbɔ.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla la be: Nu dzodzrowo ƒe nu dzodzro. Nuwo katã nu dzodzro ko wonye! Nuwunyawo

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla la meɖe eɖokui fia abe nunyala ɖeɖe ko ene o. Efia nugɔmesese dukɔ la hã. Eda nuwo kpɔ, lé ŋku ɖe nuwo ŋu tsitotsito, eye wòƒo lododo geɖewo nu ƒu.

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: Nufiala la di vevie be yeake ɖe nya siwo nyasena na to la ŋu, eye wòŋlɔ nyateƒenya vavãwo ɖi tsimatɔe.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Nyagblɔla la ƒe nyawo le abe ati nu tsutsɔẽ kple mɔfiati si woƒo ɖe to ene. Wonye nya siwo Alẽkplɔla ɖeka ƒo ƒui.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: Vinye, kpɔ nyuie le nu sia nu si to vovo tso esiawo gbɔ la ŋu. Agbalẽ geɖe wɔwɔ la, seɖoƒe meli nɛ o. Agbalẽsɔsrɔ̃ vivivo hã ɖe wòtea ɖeɖi ŋutilã ŋu.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Mina míase nyaawo katã ƒe taƒoƒo: Vɔ̃ Mawu, eye nàwɔ eƒe sewo dzi, elabe eyae nye amegbetɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe dɔdeasi bliboa.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu le ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge nuwɔna ɖe sia ɖe; nyui o, vɔ̃ o; ne ele ɣaɣla gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: This is Solomon's most beautiful song. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Hawo ƒe Ha si nye Salomo tɔ. Ha Gbãtɔ Nyɔnu la

english_verse: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
translation_verse: Ao, ɖe nàgbugbɔ nu nam hafi! Elabe wò lɔlɔ̃ nyo wu wain.

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: Wò ami sisi le ʋeʋẽm lílilĩ; wò ŋkɔ nye ami ʋeʋẽe si wowú, eya ta ɖetugbiwo lɔ̃a wò ɖo.

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: Na makplɔ wò ɖo; na mízɔ kabakaba. Fia la kplɔm yi eƒe xɔ me. Míatso aseye, akpɔ dzidzɔ kpli wò. Míakafu wò lɔlɔ̃ wu wain gɔ̃ hã. Amewo tɔ dzɔ be wolɔ̃a wò.

english_verse: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.
translation_verse: Yerusalem vinyɔnuviwo, ame yii menye, ke megbɔa dzi ɖi. Mele abe Kedar ƒe avɔgbadɔwo ene, abe Salomo ƒe xɔmetsovɔwo ene.

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Miganɔ kpɔyem ɖe esi menyɔ yibɔɔ alea ta o, elabe ɣee ɖum. Danyevi ŋutsuwo do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye, tsɔm ɖo waingbledzɔlae; ke nye ŋutɔ nye waingble ya la, nyemekpɔ vovo adzɔe o.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Wò, nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, gblɔe nam: Afi ka nènyia wò lãwo le? Le ŋdɔ me ɖe, afi ka wogbɔna ɖe eme le? Evɔ la, nu ka ta manɔ abe tsatsala ene, anɔ hawòviwo ƒe lãhawo gbɔ? Ŋutsu la

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Ne mènyae o la, wò tugbewo ƒe tugbe, kplɔ lãhawo ƒe toƒe ɖo nànyi wò gbɔ̃viwo le alẽkplɔlawo ƒe agbadɔwo gbɔ!

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, èle nam abe sɔnɔ le Egipte Fiagã ƒe tasiaɖam ŋu ene.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Woɖo atsyɔ̃ na wò alɔgowo wonyale kpɔkpɔm, eye dzonu xɔasiwo ɖo atsyɔ̃ na wò kɔ.

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Míawɔ sikakɔsɔkɔsɔ atsɔ klosalokpeviwo ade me na wò. Nyɔnu la

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Esime fia bɔbɔ nɔ eƒe gbɔɖemezikpui me la, nye gbe ʋeʋẽewo nɔ ʋeʋẽm lílilĩ.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a le nam abe kotoklobogoe le nye nowo dome ene.

english_verse: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a le nam abe henaseƒoƒo le waingblewo me le En-Gedi ene. Ŋutsu la

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Aa, nye dzi, èdze tugbe ŋutɔ! Ènyakpɔna koŋ! Wò ŋkuwo nyakpɔna abe ahɔnɛ ene. Nyɔnu la

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dzi, èdze ɖeka ŋutɔ! Ènyakpɔna ale gbegbe! Mía nɔƒe de ama.

english_verse: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Sedertiwo anye míaƒe xɔ ƒe glidzitiwo, eye fɔfɔlĩ anye míaƒe daɖedzitiwo.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Menye rosaseƒoƒo tso Saron; dzogbenya le baliwo me. Ŋutsu la

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Ale si dzogbenya nɔa aŋɔkawo me la, nenema nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a le nyɔnuviwo domee. Nyɔnu la

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: Ale si yevutɔti nɔa atiwo dome le ave me la, nenema nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a le ɖekakpuiwo domee. Menɔa eƒe vɔvɔli te le dziɖeɖi me, eye eƒe kutsetsewo vivia nunye.

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: Ekplɔm yi eƒe ame kpekpewo ƒe nuɖuxɔ me, eye lɔlɔ̃e nye eƒe aflaga le dzinye.

english_verse: Refresh and strengthen me with raisins and apples. I am hungry for love!
translation_verse: Mitsɔ waintsetsebolo gbɔ agbem; mitsɔ yevutɔ fa dzi nam, elabe lɔlɔ̃ de dɔ lã me nam.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Aa, ɖe wòatsɔ eƒe miasi ade nye ta te, atsɔ eƒe nuɖusi akpla kɔ nam pɛ! Ŋutsu la

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: Yerusalem vinyɔnuviwo, meta sãde kple zinɔ le gbe me na mi be: Miganyɔ lɔlɔ̃ o; migaʋuʋui hã o, va se ɖe esime wòdze eya ŋutɔ ŋu hafi! Ha Evelia Nyɔnu la

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a ƒe gbe ɖi mese ɖa! Kpɔ ɖa, eya nye ekem gbɔna. Ele kpo dzom le towo flɔm, eye wòle kpo tim le togbɛwo flɔm.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a ƒo nu gblɔ nam be: “Tso, nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, nye tugbewo ƒe tugbe, va mídzo!

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Elabe vuvɔŋɔli nu yi, eye tsi ke.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Seƒoƒowo wɔ nyuie le anyigba la dzi, hadziɣi ɖo, eye ahɔnɛwo ƒe xɔxlɔ̃ le ɖiɖim le míaƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Gbotsetsewo de asi ɖiɖi me, eye wainkawo ƒo se hele ʋeʋẽm lílilĩ. Tso, nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, nye tugbewo ƒe tugbe, va mídzo!

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: Ao, nye ahɔnɛ le kpeto me, le agawo ƒe gogloƒe, na makpɔ wò ŋkume, na mase wò gbe; elabe wò gbe vivina, eye wò mo nyakpɔna.

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Milé abeiwo na mí, milé suesuetɔwo hã. Woawoe gblẽa nu le waingblewo me, elabe míaƒe waingblewo ƒo se nyuie.” Nyɔnu la

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Tɔnyee nye nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, eye nye hã menye etɔ. Eya, ame si nyia eƒe lãha le dzogbenyawo dome.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, trɔ gbɔ hafi anyinu nafa, eye vɔvɔli nu nayi. Wɔ abe sãde alo zivi si le agakpewo dome le to tsakliwo dzi ene.

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Medi ame si nye luʋɔ lɔ̃na la le nye aba dzi le zã me. Medii ʋuu gake nyemekpɔe o. Meyɔe, gake metɔ nam o.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: “Fifia mafɔ aɖatsa le dua me. Matsa le ablɔwo me kple kpɔdomeewo adi nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a.” Medii kakaka, gake nyemeke ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Dzɔla siwo le tsatsam le dua me la do gom. Mebia wo be: “Miekpɔ nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a le afi aɖea?”

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Nyemekpɔ to wo ŋu yi o, kasia nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a nye esi. Melée, gbe asiɖeɖe le eŋu va se ɖe esime mekplɔe va nɔnye ƒemee; kplɔe ge ɖe ame si tsɔ nye fu la ƒe xɔ me. Ŋutsu la

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Yerusalem vinyɔnuviwo, meta sãde kple zinɔ le gbe me na mi: Miganyɔ lɔlɔ̃ o; migaʋuʋui hã o, va se ɖe esime wòdze eya ŋutɔ ŋu hafi! Ha Etɔ̃lia Nyɔnu la

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Nu kae nye ekem tso gbedadaƒo gbɔna abe dzudzɔ babla ene? Kotoklobo, lifi kple asitsalawo ƒe atikewɔ vovovowo le ʋeʋẽm lílilĩ le eŋu.

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Salomo ƒe apakae! Kalẽtɔ bla ade tso Israel-dukɔ ƒe kalẽtɔwo dome ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: Wo katã bi ɖe yidada me. Wonya aʋawɔɖaŋu nyuie. Ame sia ame ƒe adekpui le aklito nɛ, elabe vɔvɔ̃ le zã ŋu.

english_verse: The throne is made of trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Fia Salomo na wokpa apaka nɛ kple ati tso Lebanon.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: Apaka la ƒe afɔwo nye klosalo, eƒe medeƒe nye sika, anyinɔƒe nye aɖabɛ, eye Yerusalem vinyɔnuviwo tsɔ lɔlɔ̃ ɖo atsyɔ̃ na eme.

english_verse: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.
translation_verse: Mido va. Zion-nyɔnuviwo, mikpɔ Fia Salomo ɖa! Mikpɔ fiakuku si le eta la ɖa! Nɔae ɖɔe nɛ le eƒe srɔ̃ɖegbe, si nye eƒe dzi ƒe dzidzɔkpɔgbe!

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, èdze tugbe loo! Kpɔ ɖa, ènyakpɔna ale gbegbe! Wò ŋkuwo nye ahɔnɛwo le wò moxevɔ la godo. Wò ɖa le abe gbɔ̃hawoe le abu ɖim le Gilead-to ŋu ene.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Wò aɖuwo le abe alẽha si woko fu na vɔ teti, eye wodo tso tsileƒe va ene. Wo katã dzi evenɔviwo, ɖeketɔ meku le wo dome o.

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Wò nuyiwo le abe ka dzẽ ene, eye wò nu nyale kpɔkpɔm. Wò alɔgowo dze abe yevuboɖa si me wofe ene, le wò moxevɔ godo.

english_verse: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
translation_verse: Wò kɔ le abe David ƒe xɔ tsrala si wotu hena gbetakpɔkpɔ ene. Woku akpoxɔnu akpe ɖe eŋu, wo katã nye kalẽtɔwo ƒe akpoxɔnuwo.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: Wò no eveawo le abe sãdevi eve alo zi evenɔvi siwo le gbe ɖum le dzogbenyawo dome ene.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Mawɔ kaba ayi ɖanɔ kotoklobotowo dzi kple lifitogbɛwo dzi, va se ɖe esime anyinu nafa, eye vɔvɔli nu ayi.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, èsɔ, nyakpɔ, dzuƒe aɖeke mele ŋuwò o.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Nye ŋugbetɔ, ɖi va kplim tso Lebanon-to dzi! Ði va kplim tso Lebanon-to dzi! Dzo le Amana-to tame; ɖi le Senir to kple Xermon-to tame, dzatawo kple lãklewo nɔƒewoe.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye nyɔnu, nye ŋugbetɔ, ègblẽ tame nam. Ŋku si nètre kpɔmee kple atsyɔ̃ɖonu si le wò kɔdzonu me la gblẽ tame nam.

english_verse: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye nyɔnu, nye ŋugbetɔ, wò lɔlɔ̃ vivina loo! Wò lɔlɔ̃ vivina wu wain, eye wò ami sisiwo ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ ƒo atike ʋeʋẽewo katã tɔ ta.

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Nye ŋugbetɔ, wò nuyi ɖaa seƒoƒo me tsi vivi; anyitsi kple notsi le wò aɖe te. Wò awuwo me le ʋeʋẽm lílilĩ abe Lebanon tɔ ene.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye nyɔnu, nye ŋugbetɔ, ènye abɔ si ƒe ʋɔ wodo, abɔ si le tutu; tsidzɔƒe si nu wotre.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Wò numiemiewo nye yevuboɖabɔ si me kutsetse nyuiwo, henaseƒoƒo kple gbe ʋeʋẽewo le.

english_verse: saffron, calamus, cinnamon, frankincense, myrrh, and aloes —all the finest spices.
translation_verse: Gbe ʋeʋẽewo kple agumetaku, gbekee, botsyo kple dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe dogbewo katã, kotoklobo kple dzogbebable kpakple atike veviwo katã hã le afi ma.

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Tsidzidzi le abɔ me, tsi gbagbe vudo kple tɔʋu si le sisím tso Lebanon-to dzi lae nènye. Nyɔnu la

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Dzigbemeya, tso! Anyigbemeya, va! Miƒo to nye abɔ me ne eƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ la nade afi sia afi. Na ne nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a nava eƒe abɔ me, ne wòaɖu eƒe kutsetse nyuiawo.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nɔvinye nyɔnu, nye ŋugbetɔ, meva ɖo nye abɔ me. Meké nye kotoklobo kple gbe ʋeʋẽewo. Menyi nye anyixe kple nye anyitsi, eye meno nye wain kple nye notsi. Nyɔnuawo Mía xɔlɔ̃wo, miɖu nu, mino nu mía lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mino aha miamu. Ha Enelia Nyɔnu la

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Mele alɔ̃ me, ke nye dzi ya le ŋu. Se ɖa, nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a le ʋɔ ƒom! Ŋutsu la “Nɔvinye nyɔnu, nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, nye ahɔnɛ, nye ame deblibo, ʋu ʋɔa nam! Elabe zãmu ƒo tame nam belee, eye nye ɖa me yɔ fũu kple adzadza.” Nyɔnu la

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Meɖe nye awu ɖi, ale ke magadoe? Meklɔ nye afɔwo, ɖe magana woaƒo ɖia?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a do asi ɖe eme, eye nye dzi kpɔ dzidzɔ le menye.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Meʋu ʋɔa na nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a; ke nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a trɔ dzo; ebu! Mebu ɖe ɖokuinye, esime wòƒo nu. Medii, gake nyemekpɔe o; meyɔe, gake metɔ o.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Dzɔla siwo le tsatsam le dua me la do gom. Woƒom, de abi ŋunye. Gli ŋu dzɔlawo ɖe nye taɖedzi le ŋunye.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Yerusalem vinyɔnuviwo, meta mi: Ne miekpɔ nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a la, mito nɛ be: Lɔlɔ̃ de dɔ lã me nam! Nyɔnuawo

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:
translation_verse: Tugbewo ƒe tugbe, nu ka wò dzi lɔlɔ̃a tsɔ ƒo lɔlɔ̃tɔ bubuwo tae? Nu ka gɔ̃ wò dzi lɔlɔ̃a tsɔ ƒo lɔlɔ̃tɔ bubuwo tae, hafi nèta nu na mí alea? Nyɔnu la

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a ƒe agbalẽ me klẽ, eye wòbiã. Le ŋutsu akpe ewo me la, ɖeke mede enu o.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Eƒe ta nye sika nyuitɔ kekeake; eƒe ɖa le mlɔmlɔmlɔ, eye wònyɔ yibɔɔ abe akpavia ene.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkuwo le abe ahɔnɛ siwo le notsi hele tɔʋu to ene, eye wosɔ ɖe ŋkuto me nɛ.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Eƒe alɔgo nye atike ʋeʋẽe kpó siwo le ʋeʋẽm lílilĩ. Eƒe nuyiwo nye dzogbenya siwo le kotoklobotsi tsroloe tsyɔm.

english_verse: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.
translation_verse: Eƒe abɔwo nye sikati mlimɔwo, siwo ŋu woɖo kpe xɔasiwoe. Ameti blibo la zrɔ̃ dredredrẽ abe nyiɖu ene, eye wotsɔ safirkpe ɖo atsyɔ̃ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: Eƒe atawo nye kpe ɣi sɔti siwo wòɖo sikafɔ dzi. Eƒe dzedzeme le abe Lebanon-to si dzi sederti nyuitɔwo le la ene.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.

translation_verse: Eƒe nuƒo vivina ŋutɔ; eƒe nuwɔna lé dzi nam ale gbegbe. Yerusalem vinyɔnuviwo, aleae nye dzi lɔlɔ̃ la le! Aleae xɔ̃nye la le!

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, tell us where he has gone. Let us help you find him. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Tugbewo ƒe tugbe, afi ka wò dzi lɔlɔ̃a yi? Afi ka wò lɔlɔ̃tɔ ɖo tae ne míakpe ɖe ŋuwò adii? Nyɔnu la

english_verse: My darling has gone down to his garden of spices, where he will feed his sheep and gather lilies.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a yi eƒe abɔ me, ɖe atike ʋeʋẽe kpówo gbɔ. Anyi eƒe lãha le abɔ la me, eye wòaké dzogbenya.

english_verse: I am his, and he is mine, as he feeds his sheep among the lilies. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a nye tɔnye, eye nye hã menye etɔ. Enyia eƒe lãha le dzogbenyawo me. Ha Atɔ̃lia Ŋutsu la

english_verse: My dearest, the cities of Tirzah and Jerusalem are not as lovely as you. Your charms are more powerful than all of the stars in the heavens.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, èdze tugbe abe Tirza ene, ènyo abe Yerusalem ene, eye èdzia ŋɔ abe aʋakɔ si lé aflagawo ɖe asi ene.

english_verse: Turn away your eyes— they make me melt. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Ðe wò ŋkuwo ɖa le dzinye, elabe wole fu ɖem nam. Wò ɖa le abe gbɔ̃hawoe le abu ɖim le Gilead-to ŋu ene.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Wò aɖuwo le abe alẽha siwo do tso tsileƒe va ene. Wo katã dzi evenɔviwo; ɖeke tɔ meku o.

english_verse: Behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Wò alɔgowo le abe yevuboɖa si me wofe ene, eye wole dzedzem le wò moxevɔ godo.

english_verse: What if I could have sixty queens, eighty wives, and thousands of others!
translation_verse: Fia srɔ̃wo le bla ade, ahiãviwo le bla enyi; ɖetugbiwo ya mele xexlẽme o.

english_verse: You would be my only choice, my flawless dove, the favorite child of your mother. The young women, the queens, and all the others tell how excited you are as they sing your praises:
translation_verse: Ke ɖeka hɔ̃ ko nye tɔnye. Akpakpa wònye, ede blibo! Nɔa melɔ̃a nu le egbɔ o; vi vevi wònye na edzila. Ðetugbiwo kpɔe, kafui. Fia srɔ̃wo kple eƒe ahiãviwo hã kafui.

english_verse: “You are as majestic as the morning sky— glorious as the moon— blinding as the sun! Your charms are more powerful than all the stars above.” She Speaks:
translation_verse: “Ame kae nye esi do gbɔna abe agudzedze ene? Enyakpɔ abe ɣleti ene, ele keklẽm abe ɣe ene, eye wòle ŋɔ dzim abe aʋakɔ si lé aflagawo ɖe asi ene.”

english_verse: I went down to see if blossoms were on the walnut trees, grapevines, and fruit trees.
translation_verse: Meyi ɖe nye azibɔ me ne makpɔ gbe fɛ̃wo ƒe wɔwɔ me le bali me ɖa. Medi be makpɔ ɖa be wainkawo do lotò, eye yevuboɖatiwo ƒo se hã.

english_verse: But in my imagination I was suddenly riding on a glorious chariot. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Kaka manya la, nyee nye esi le tasiaɖam me le nye fiavi xa. Nyɔnuawo

english_verse: Dance! Dance! Beautiful woman from Shulam, let us see you dance! She Speaks: Why do you want to see this woman from Shulam dancing with the others?
translation_verse: Trɔ va; trɔ va! Sulamitɔ! Trɔ va, trɔ va, ne míakpɔ wò nyuie. Nyɔnu la Nu ka ta mianɔ Sulamitɔ kpɔm abe ɣeɖuɖu le aʋakɔ eve ŋkume ene?

english_verse: You are a princess, and your feet are graceful in their sandals. Your thighs are works of art, each one a jewel;
translation_verse: Nyɔnu bubume, wò azɔlizɔzɔ nyale kpɔkpɔm le atokota me loo! Wò kpe toɖoewo le abe kpe xɔasi si aɖaŋudɔwɔla aɖe wɔ ene.

english_verse: your navel is a wine glass filled to overflowing. Your body is full and slender like a bundle of wheat bound together by lilies.
translation_verse: Wò agɔbɔ nye goe toɖoe; si me wain si wotɔtɔ la mevɔna le o. Wò ƒodo nye lu si woli kɔe, eye dzogbenya ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: Your breasts are like twins of a deer.
translation_verse: Wò no eveawo le abe sãdevi eve, alo zinɔ evenɔviwo ene.

english_verse: Your neck is like ivory, and your eyes sparkle like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-Rabbim. Your nose is beautiful like Mount Lebanon above the city of Damascus.
translation_verse: Wò kɔ le abe nyiɖuxɔ tsrala ene. Wò ŋkuwo nye tá le Xesbon le Batrabim-gbo nu. Wò ŋɔti le abe Lebanon-xɔ tsrala si le Damasko ta kpɔm ɖa ene.

english_verse: Your head is held high like Mount Carmel; your hair is so lovely it holds a king prisoner.
translation_verse: Wò ta le wò, ameti la nu abe Karmel ene. Wò taɖa le legbee abe aɖabɛ ene; eƒe nyonyo zu kɔsɔkɔsɔ bla fia.

english_verse: You are very beautiful, so desirable!
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔ, èdze tugbe, nyakpɔna; ɖetugbi, wò nu lé dzi nam loo!

english_verse: You are tall and slender like a palm tree, and your breasts are full.
translation_verse: Èle tsralɛ abe deti ene; wò nowo le abe detawo ene.

english_verse: I will climb that tree and cling to its branches. I will discover that your breasts are clusters of grapes, and that your breath is the aroma of apples.
translation_verse: Mebe made deti la dzi alé eƒe alɔwo. Wò nowo nenye wainkpo le wainka ŋu, eye wò gbɔgbɔ ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ nenɔ abe yevutɔ tɔ ene.

english_verse: Kissing you is more delicious than drinking the finest wine. How wonderful and tasty! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Wò nu me nenɔ abe wain nyuitɔ ene. Nyɔnu la Ekema nàna wain la nasí blewuu ato nuyiawo kple aɖuawo dome ayi.

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you desire me.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a tɔ menye, eye ele diyem vevie.

english_verse: Let's stroll through the fields and sleep in the villages.
translation_verse: Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, va, na mído yi agbleta aɖadze kɔƒe aɖe me.

english_verse: At dawn let's slip out and see if grapevines and fruit trees are covered with blossoms. When we are there, I will give you my love.
translation_verse: Na mído yi waingblewo me kaba aɖakpɔ ɖa be wainkaawo do lotò, seƒoƒowo kè, eye yevuboɖatiwo ƒo se hã. Afi ma matsɔ nye lɔlɔ̃ ana wò le.

english_verse: Perfume from the magic flower fills the air, my darling. Right at our doorstep I have stored up for you all kinds of tasty fruits.
translation_verse: Agbitsawo ƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ kaka ɖi, kutsetse nyui vovovowo le míaƒe ʋɔtru nu. Nye dzi lɔlɔ̃a, medzra wo ɖo na wò; yeyeawo kple xoxoawo siaa.

english_verse: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.
translation_verse: Aa, manye nɔvinye ŋutsu si no nɔnye ƒe no nènye oa? Anye ne mekpɔ wò le ablɔ me la, magbugbɔ nu na wò, eye ame aɖeke mado vlom o.

english_verse: I could take you to the home of my mother, who taught me all I know. I would give you delicious wine and fruit juice as well.
translation_verse: Ekema makplɔ wò ayi nɔnye ƒeme, eye míage ɖe ame si tsɔ nye fu la ƒe xɔ me. Afi ma mana atike ʋeʋẽe, wain kple yevuboɖakutsetsetsi wò nàno le.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: Aa, ɖe wòatsɔ eƒe miasi ade nye ta te, atsɔ eƒe nuɖusi akpla kɔ nam pɛ! Nyɔnuawo

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Yerusalem-nyɔnuviwo, metà mi: Miganyɔ lɔlɔ̃ o; migaʋuʋui hã o, va se ɖe esime wòdze eya ŋutɔ ŋu hafi! Ha Adelia Nyɔnuawo

english_verse: Who is this young woman coming in from the desert and leaning on the shoulder of the one she loves? She Speaks: I stirred up your passions under the apple tree where you were born.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu kae nye ekem tso gbedadaƒo gbɔna, ziɔ ɖe eƒe dzi lɔlɔ̃a ŋu? Nyɔnu la Yevutɔti te menyɔ wò le, afi ma nɔwò lé ku le, afi ma fu ɖu ame si dzi wò la le.

english_verse: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.
translation_verse: Wɔm abe nutrenu le wò dzi ŋu ene, abe nutrenu le wò abɔ ŋu ene. Elabe lɔlɔ̃ tri akɔ abe ku ene, eye ŋuʋaʋã vɔ̃ɖi abe yɔdo ene. Lɔlɔ̃ ƒe bibi le abe dzo ƒe bibi ene; dzo ƒe aɖe sesẽ wònye.

english_verse: Love cannot be drowned by oceans or floods. It cannot be bought— any offer would be scorned no matter how great. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Tsi geɖe mate ŋu tsi lɔlɔ̃ o; tɔɖɔɖɔ mate ŋu kplɔe dzoe o. Ne ame aɖe tsɔ eƒeme kesinɔnuwo katã na ɖe lɔlɔ̃ ta la, ɖeko woaɖu fewu le eŋu. Nyɔnua nɔviŋutsuwo

english_verse: We have a little sister whose breasts are not yet formed. If someone asks to marry her, what should we do?
translation_verse: Nɔvinyɔnu sue aɖe le mía si; mete no o. Nu ka míawɔ na mía nɔvinyɔnu sia, gbe si gbe wova eta bia ge?

english_verse: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nenye gli wònye la, míatsɔ klosalo atɔ kpɔ ɖe edzi; nenye ʋɔtru wònye la, míatsɔ sederʋuƒowo atɔ kpɔ ɖe eŋu. Nyɔnu la

english_verse: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.
translation_verse: Gli menye, eye nye nowo le abe gbetakpɔxɔwo ene. Mele eŋkume abe ame si he ŋutifafa vɛ ene. Ŋutsu la

english_verse: Solomon has a vineyard at Baal-Hamon, which he rents to others for a thousand pieces of silver each.
translation_verse: Waingble le Salomo si le Baal-Hamon. Etsɔ agblea de agbledzikpɔlawo si. Edi tso wo dome ame sia ame si be wòaxe klosaloga akpe ɖeka na ye ɖe kutsetseawo ta.

english_verse: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Nye waingble, nye ŋutɔ nye waingble la, tɔnyee; Salomo, wò la, akpe ate ŋu anɔ asiwò, eye kutsetsedzikpɔlawo la, alafa eve anɔ wo si.

english_verse: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
translation_verse: Wò ame si nɔa abɔwo me, nye zɔhɛwo le to ɖom be yewoase wò gbe; na masee! Nyɔnu la

english_verse: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.
translation_verse: Netsɔ, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ! Wɔ abe sãde alo zivi le atike ʋeʋẽe towo dzi ene!

english_verse: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah: A Guilty Nation
translation_verse: Yesaya, Amoz vi ƒe ŋutega si wòkpɔ. Eku ɖe Yuda kple Yerusalem ŋu, esime Uziya, Yotam, Axaz kple Xizkiya nye fiawo le Yuda-nyigba dzi. Mawu ka mo na eƒe dukɔ

english_verse: The Lord has said, “Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Dziƒowo, misee! Anyigba, ɖo to nàsee! Menyi viwo, wotsi vɔ, ke wodze aglã ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys know who owns and feeds them, but my people won't ever learn.”
translation_verse: Nyitsu nyaa ame si tɔ wònye, eye tedzi nyaa afi si eƒe aƒetɔ daa nuɖuɖu ɖo nɛ. Gake Israel menyam o; nye dukɔ mesea nu gɔme nam o.”

english_verse: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Baba na dukɔ wɔnuvɔ̃ si dzi fɔɖiɖi li kɔ ɖo la. Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ƒe dzidzimeviwo, vi gbegblẽwo. Wogblẽ Aƒetɔ ɖi, wodo vlo Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la, wotrɔ megbe dee.

english_verse: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta miegale aglãdzedze dzi, be woanɔ mia ƒoƒo dzi? Ta blibo la dze dɔ. Nu te dzi blibo la ŋu keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain. A Country in Ruins
translation_verse: Tso afɔƒome va se ɖe dzodome, ƒoƒe aɖeke megali o. Abi, dodro kple abi yeye siwo le ʋu ɖuɖum koe li. Womeyɔ tsi le abiawo me o, womebla wo o, eye womeɖe ami ɖe wo wobɔbɔ o.

english_verse: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
translation_verse: Miaƒe anyigba zu gbegbe, eye dzo fiã miaƒe duwo. Miaƒe ŋkume ale ko, amedzrowo xɔ miaƒe anyigba le mia si, wòzu gbegbe, abe ale si amedzrowo gblẽa nui ene.

english_verse: Enemies surround Jerusalem, alone like a hut in a vineyard or in a cucumber field.
translation_verse: Zion vinyɔnu ɖeka tsi anyi abe agbadɔ le waingble me ene, abe mlɔƒe le dzamatregble me ene, abe du si woƒo xlãe la ene.

english_verse: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
translation_verse: Ðe menye Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae susɔ ame ʋɛ aɖewo ɖi na mí o la, anye ne míanɔ abe Sodom ene, eye míaɖi Gomora.

english_verse: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
translation_verse: Mi Sodom-dziɖulawo, mise Aƒetɔ ƒe nya! Mi Gomoratɔwo, miɖo to miase mía Mawu ƒe nufiafia.

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Nu kae mawɔ kple miaƒe vɔsasa gbogboawo? Agbo siwo miemèna saa vɔe nam kple nyivi damiwo ƒe ami ti kɔ nam. Nyiwo, alẽviwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe ʋu va wu tsɔtsɔ nam.

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Ne mieva be yewoado ɖe ŋkunye me la, ame kae bia tso mia si be miava nɔ afɔɖi ƒom nye xɔxɔnuwo?

english_verse: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
translation_verse: Migatsɔ nu dzodzro va sa vɔe azɔ o; dzudzɔdodoa nye ŋunyɔ nam. Ke ku ɖe dzinu yeyewo, dzudzɔgbewo kple gbeƒãɖeɖe takpegbewo ƒe ŋkekenyuiwo ŋu la, nyemate ŋu atsɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ kple subɔsubɔtakpekpewo o.

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ lé fu miaƒe dzinu yeyewo kple ŋkekenyuiwo. Wozu agba nam, eye wowu tsɔtsɔ nam.

english_verse: “No matter how much you pray, I won't listen. You are too violent.
translation_verse: Ne mieke abɔwo me la, maɣla ŋkume ɖe mi. Ne miedo gbe ɖa kakaka hã la, magbe esese, elabe miaƒe asi ƒo ʋu blibaa.

english_verse: Wash yourselves clean! I hate your filthy deeds. Stop doing wrong
translation_verse: Mile tsi, miwɔ mia ɖokui dzadzɛ. Miɖe miaƒe nuwɔwɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖa le ŋkunye me. Midzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ!

english_verse: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
translation_verse: Misrɔ̃ nu nyui wɔwɔ, eye midi nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ. Miɖe ameteɖeanyi ɖa; miʋli tsyɔ̃eviwo ta, eye miɖe kuku ɖe ahosiwo nu.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Miva ne míalé nya la kpɔ. Togbɔ be miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo le abe nyagãdzĩ ene hã la, woafu abe ɖetifu ene. Togbɔ be wobiã abe aɖabɛ ene la, woafu abe alẽfu ene.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ne mielɔ̃ ɖo to la, miaɖu nu nyuitɔwo tso anyigba la me.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Evɔ ne miegbe, hedze aglã la, yi aɖu mi. Elabe Aƒetɔ ye ke nu gblɔe.” Nu vɔ̃ du la

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Ao! Ale ke wɔ du si wɔa nuteƒe, eye nya dzɔdzɔe gbɔgblɔ nɔ eme la va zu gboloe! Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nɔ eme tsã; ke azɔ la, hlɔ̃dolawo sɔŋ koe le eme.

english_verse: Your silver is fake, and your wine is watered down.
translation_verse: Wò klosalo zu gamí, eye wotsɔ tsi dzro wò wain.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Wò amegãwo va zu aglãdzelawo kple fiafitɔwo xɔlɔ̃wo. Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe lɔ̃a zãnu, eye wodia nunanaxɔxɔ vevie. Womeʋlia tsyɔ̃eviwo ta o, eye wometsɔa ɖeke le eme na ahosiwo o.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Eya ta azɔ la, nya si gblɔm Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Israel ƒe Mawu Ŋusẽtɔ lae nye esi. Ebe: “Aléle! Mavo tso nye ketɔwo si me, eye mabia hlɔ̃ nye futɔwo.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Matrɔ nye asi ɖe ŋuwò, eye malólo wò gamí abe akaŋu wotsɔ wɔe ene, eye maɖe wò tsumíwo katã ɖa.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Magaɖo ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo na mi abe tsã ene kple aɖaŋuɖolawo na mi abe le blema ene. Emegbe woagayɔ wò be nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe du kple du wɔnuteƒe.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Woaɖe Zion to ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ me, eye ame siwo trɔ dzime le eme la, woaɖe wo to nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Ke woagbã aglãdzelawo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo siaa, eye ame siwo gblẽ Aƒetɔ ɖi la nu ayi.

english_verse: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Ŋu akpe mi le ati gã siwo ŋu miekpɔ dzidzɔ le la ŋu, eye miaƒe mo atsi dãa le trɔ̃bɔ siwo mietia la ŋu.

english_verse: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
translation_verse: Elabe miawo ŋutɔ mianɔ abe ati gã si yrɔ kple abɔ si mekpɔ tsi o la ene.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: Ame sesẽ la azu gbe ƒuƒu, eye eƒe dɔwɔwɔ anɔ abe dzoxi ene. Wo kple eve la siaa woalé dzo, eye ame aɖeke manɔ anyi atsii o.

english_verse: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Nya si Yesaya, Amoz vi la kpɔ ku ɖe Yuda kple Yerusalem ŋu la.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Ava eme le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me be to si nye Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la anye kɔkɔtɔ kekeake, eye wòakɔ wu togbɛwo katã, eye dukɔwo katã aƒo zi ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Ale dukɔ geɖewo ava gblɔ be: “Miva, mina míalia Aƒetɔ ƒe to la ayi Yakob ƒe Mawu la ƒeme, bene wòafia eƒe mɔwo mí, eye míazɔ eƒe toƒewo.” Elabe se la atso Zion, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe nya atso Yerusalem.

english_verse: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le dukɔwo dome, eye wòatso nya me na dukɔ geɖewo. Woatsɔ woƒe yiwo atu kodzoewoe, eye woatsɔ woƒe akplɔwo atu hɛ gobɛwoe. Dukɔ magatsɔ yi ɖe dukɔ ŋu o, eye womagasrɔ̃ aʋawɔwɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: O, Yakob ƒe ƒome, miva, mina míazɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe kekeli la me! Aƒetɔ atsi dàda nu

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: Ègblẽ wò dukɔ, Yakob ƒe ƒome la ɖi! Elabe afakala siwo tso ɣedzeƒe la va xɔ aƒe ɖe eme, eye wosa dzo abe Filistitɔwo ene. Gawu la, wodea ha kple amedzrowo.

english_verse: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.
translation_verse: Klosalo kple sika yɔ woƒe anyigba dzi fũu, eye seƒe meli na woƒe kesinɔnuwo o. Sɔwo yɔ woƒe anyigba dzi fũu, eye woƒe tasiaɖamwo manyaxlẽ o.

english_verse: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
translation_verse: Legbawo yɔ woƒe anyigba dzi fũu, eye wodea ta agu na woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo, nu siwo woawo ŋutɔ ƒe asibidɛwo wɔ la.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Ale wobɔbɔ amegbetɔ ɖe anyi, eye woɖiɖi amegbetɔ ɖe anyi! Mègatsɔe ke wo o.

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Yi ɖe kpeto me, eye nàbè ɖe ʋuʋudedi me tso Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋɔdzi nu, tso eƒe gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ nu!

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Woabɔbɔ ŋku gã tolawo ɖe anyi, eye dàdalawo ayi to ale be Aƒetɔ koe anye gã gbe ma gbe.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ɖo ŋkeke ɖe dàdalawo, ame siwo kɔ wo ɖokui ɖe dzi kple nu siwo katã kɔa ta dzi la ŋu, ne woabɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: Eɖoe ɖe Lebanon-sederti kɔkɔ, dama siwo ƒo atiwo katã ta kple Basan-logotiwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: all high mountains and hills,
translation_verse: Eɖoe ɖe to kɔkɔwo katã kple togbɛ kɔkɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: Eɖoe ɖe Tarsis-tɔdziʋuwo katã kple aɖaŋudɔwɔwɔ siwo katã nyakpɔna la ŋu.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Woabɔbɔ amegbetɔ ƒe adegbeƒoƒo ɖe anyi, eye woate amegbetɔwo ƒe dàda ɖe to. Aƒetɔ ɖeka ko anye gã gbe ma gbe.

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: Ke legbawo nu ayi keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ tso be yeado ŋɔdzi na anyigba la, amewo abè ɖe kpetowo kple dowo me be yewoasí le eƒe dɔmedzoe kple eƒe gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ la nu.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, amegbetɔwo atsɔ woƒe klosalolegba kple sikalegba siwo wowɔ be yewoade ta agu na la aƒu gbe na alegeliwo kple agutɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ tso be yeado ŋɔdzi na anyigba la, amewo abè ɖe kpetowo kple agadowo me be yewoasí le eƒe ŋɔdzi kple eƒe gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ la nu.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Eya ta migaɖo dzi ɖe amegbetɔ si nye nu kuku la ŋu o. Asixɔxɔ kae le eŋu?

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la aɖe nunɔamesiwo katã kple nu siwo katã wode mee la ɖa le Yerusalem kple Yuda. Tsi kple nuɖuɖu hã avɔ keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
translation_verse: Kalẽtɔ kple aʋawɔla, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela, afakala kple ame tsitsi,

english_verse: officials and advisors, fortunetellers and others who tell the future.
translation_verse: ame bla atɔ̃ aʋakplɔla kple asrafomegã, adaŋudela, gbesala bíbi kple dzotɔ gã hã avɔ keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be yeana ŋutsuviwo naɖu fia ɖe wo dzi, eye ɖevi suewo nakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Ale amewo ate wo nɔewo ɖe to; ame sia ame atso ɖe nɔvia ŋu, ame sia ame ɖe ehavi ŋu. Sɔhɛwo mabu ame tsitsiwo o, eye yakamewo atsi tre ɖe bubumewo ŋu.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Ava eme be ame alé nɔvia le wo tɔ́ ƒeme agblɔ be: “Wò ya awu ʋlaya le asiwò eya ta nye míaƒe tatɔ, nànɔ aƒedo sia nu.”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, nɔvia ado ɣli be: “Nyemanye dɔyɔla o. Nuɖuɖu alo awu ʋlaya mele aƒenye me o. Migatsɔm ɖo dukɔa ƒe tatɔe o.”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Elabe Yerusalem kli nu! Yuda dze anyi! Elabe woƒe nuƒo kple nuwɔnawo tsi tre ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu. Wodze aglã le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la ŋkume.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Woƒe mo le ɖase ɖim le wo ŋu. Woɖea woƒe nuvɔ̃ fiana abe Sodomtɔwo ene; womeɣlanɛ o. Baba na wo, elabe woawo ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋu wole vɔ̃ wɔm ɖo.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Migblɔ na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla be ele mɔ nyuitɔ dzi elabe aɖu nu si wòwɔ la ƒe kutsetse.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Ke baba na nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla! Vɔ̃ atui elabe nu si eƒe asi wɔ da ɖi la, eya teƒe woaɖo nɛ.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Ɖevi le ŋuta sẽm le nye dukɔ ŋuti, eye nyɔnuwo le edzi ɖum. O nye dukɔ, kplɔwòlawo kplɔ wò trae, eye wobaɖa afɔ na wò. Aƒetɔ drɔ̃ ʋɔnu eƒe amewo

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ xɔ enɔƒe azɔ be yeahe nya. Ele tsitre be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eƒe dukɔ.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ kplɔ dukɔa ƒe ame tsitsiwo kple ekplɔlawo yi ʋɔnui be: “Miawoe fanya waingblewo. Ame dahe ƒe nu siwo mieha la woe yɔ xɔ na mi taŋ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nu ka ta miele nye dukɔ la gbãm, eye miele hiãtɔwo tugum ale?” Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. Wogbe nya na Yerusalem-nyɔnuwo

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Esi Zion vinyɔnuviwo dàna, liaa kɔ ganɛ, wua mo dzi nɔa zɔzɔm, eye ne wole zɔzɔm la, wonɔa kpe ʋuʋum, eye woƒe afɔgawo nɔa ɖiɖim gleŋgleŋgleŋ ta la,

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ la alũ ta na Zion vinyɔnuviwo kolikolikoli, eye Aƒetɔ aɖe ama wo.”

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Ʋeʋẽ kũ axɔ ɖe woƒe ʋeʋẽ lílilĩ teƒe. Ta kokoe aɖɔli ɖaƒoƒo. Akpanya axɔ ɖe awu ʋlaya xɔasi teƒe. Woƒe tugbedzedze atrɔ zu ŋukpe.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Dua me ŋutsuwo atsi yi nu, woƒe kalẽtɔwo atsi aʋa.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Dua ƒe agbowo axa nu, afa konyi; woagbã dua, eye wòabɔbɔ nɔ anyigba.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, nyɔnu adrẽ alé ɖe ŋutsu ɖeka ŋu agblɔ be: “Míawo ŋutɔ míaɖu nu, ata avɔ le mía ɖokui si. Ɖeko míedi be woayɔ wò ŋkɔ ɖe mía ŋu. Ɖe míaƒe ŋukpe ɖa le mía ŋu.” Woagbugbɔ Yerusalem aɖo te

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, Aƒetɔ ƒe atilɔ anye atsyɔ̃ kple bubu, eye anyigba ƒe kutsetse anye adegbeƒoƒo kple atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo na Israel ƒe ame tsiagbewo.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: nenye be Aƒetɔ la tsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe gbɔgbɔ kple dzo ƒe gbɔgbɔ klɔ Zion vinyɔnuviwo ƒe ɖiƒoƒo ɖa, eye wòtutu ʋu si wokɔ ɖe Yerusalem la.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Ekema Aƒetɔ aɖo alilikpo kple dzudzɔ ɖe Zion-to la ƒe takpeƒewo le ŋkeke me kple dzo bibi flaflafla ƒe keklẽ ɖa le zã me. Le nyateƒe me la, Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe anɔ nu sia nu tame.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Agbadɔ anɔ anyi anye vɔvɔli dodo le ŋkeke ƒe dzoxɔxɔ ɣeyiɣiwo me, eye wòanye sitsoƒe kple beɖoƒe le dziya kple tsidzadza ta.

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: Na madzi ha aɖe na nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ. Ha la ku ɖe eƒe waingble ŋu: Waingble aɖe nɔ nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ si le togbɛ wɔnu aɖe tame.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: Edzobo eme, ɖe kpewo le eme, eye wòdo wainka nyuitɔwo ɖe eme. Etu xɔ tsrala ɖe etitina. Ekpa wainfiãnu da ɖe eme hele mɔ kpɔm be atse ku nyuiwo, ke etse ku gbegblẽwo.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Yerusalemnɔlawo kple Yudatɔwo, taflatsɛ, midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le nye kple nye waingble la dome.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Nu kae woagawɔ na nye waingble la, eye nyemewɔe nɛ o? Ke nu ka ta mele mɔ kpɔm be atse ku nyuitɔwo, eye wòtse gbegblẽtɔwo?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Azɔ magblɔ nu si wɔ ge mala nye waingble la na mi: Makaka kpɔ le eŋu, ne lãwo naɖui. Magbã gli le eŋu, ne woazɔ edzi.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: Mana wòazu anyigba mawɔnu. Womaɖe eŋu alo aga eme o, ke aŋɔkawo kple ŋuwo amie ɖe eme. Made se na alilikpowo gɔ̃ be tsi megadza ɖe edzi azɔ o.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Evɔ Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ƒe waingble lae nye Israel-dukɔ la. Yudatɔwoe nye eƒe dzidzɔdonukua. Ekpɔ mɔ na ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃, ke kpɔ ɖa, ʋukɔkɔɖie li. Ekpɔ mɔ na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ke kpɔ ɖa, konyifaɣlie li. Nu vɔ̃ɖi si dukɔ la wɔ

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo le xɔ tum kpe xɔ, hele agble kekem ɖe agble nu va se ɖe esime teƒe aɖeke maganɔ anyi o, bene woawo ɖeɖe ko nanɔ anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ka atam mese be: “Nyateƒee, xɔ gbogboawo atrɔ zu gbegbe, eye xɔ gã nyuiawo azu xɔdowo.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Ðeɖi mate wo dometɔ aɖeke ŋu o; ame aɖeke madze anyi o. Ɖeke madɔ alɔ̃ alo akɔlɔ̃e o. Alidziblanu aɖeke matu o, eye atokotaka aɖeke matso o.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo tsɔa alakpaka dea vodada nɔa hehem, eye wotsɔa tasiaɖamka hea nuvɔ̃e!

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo fɔa fɔŋli hetiaa aha sesẽ yome, nɔa edzi ʋuu va se ɖe esime zã tsina be dzo naɖo lã me na yewo.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Ne wole ŋkekenyui ɖum, le aglo tum la, kasaŋkuwo, saŋkuwo, asiʋuiwo kple kpẽwo kpena ɖe wain ŋu na wo; ke womekpɔa Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ɖe naneke me o, eye womedze si eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ o.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Eya ta woɖe aboyo nye dukɔ elabe mele nu nyam o. Woƒe bubumewo le kukum le dɔwuame te, eye tsikɔ le eƒe amehawo wum kutɔkutɔe.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Ale wole tsiẽƒe dzrom ŋutɔŋutɔ, eye wòke nu ɖi baa. Yerusalem ƒe atsyɔ̃, eƒe amehawo kple dzidzɔkpɔla siwo le eme la age ɖe eme.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Wobɔbɔ amegbetɔ ɖe anyi, woɖi gbɔ amewo, eye dàdalawo ƒe mo yi to.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ɖe eƒe gãnyenye fia le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me, eye Mawu Kɔkɔetɔ la ɖe eɖokui fia le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Alẽviwo aɖu gbe le afi ma abe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe gbeɖuƒee wònye ene, eye lã damiwo kple wo viwo aɖu nu le aƒedoawo me.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm be: “Aƒetɔ newɔ kabakaba. Neʋã ɖe eƒe dɔ ŋu ne míakpɔe. Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe tameɖoɖo nete va ne míadze sii.”

english_verse: You think you are clever and smart.
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo bua wo ɖokui nunyalawo kple nugɔmeselawo le woawo ŋutɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo nye kalẽawo le wain nono me kple ŋutsuwɔlawo, ne wole aha muame tɔtɔm.

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Woawo, ame siwo xɔa zãnu hetsoa afia na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye wotea ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe nya dzɔdzɔe ɖe to.

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Eya ta, abe ale si dzo ƒe aɖe fiãa ahɔliti takpoe kple gbe ƒuƒui ene la, nenema tututue woƒe kè anyunyɔ, eye woƒe seƒoƒo aʋu ya abe ʋuʋudedi ene. Elabe wogbe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ƒe nufiame, eye woɖe alɔ me le Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe nya ŋu.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ do dɔmedzoe ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋu vevie, eye wòdo abɔ ɖe dzi heƒo wo. Towo ʋuʋu kpèkpekpe, eye ame kukuawo tsi kpɔdomee abe gbeɖuɖɔ ene. Ke hã la, eƒe dzi mefa o; eƒe abɔ gale dzi kokoko.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ awɔ dzesi ayɔ dukɔ aɖe le didiƒe ke. Alɔ̃ aku ayɔe tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo ke. Kpɔ ɖa, ele du dzi sesĩe gbɔna!

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Woƒe aŋutrɔwo le ɖaɖam, eye wovu woƒe dawo me. Woƒe sɔwo ƒe afɔwo le abe kpe ene, eye woƒe tasiaɖamfɔwo le abe yali ene.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Woɖea gbe abe dzata ene, eye woxlɔ̃na abe dzataviwo ene. Wotea gbe, léa nu dzonae, eye ame aɖeke mate ŋu axɔe o.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, woaɖe gbe ɖe edzi abe atsiaƒu ƒe agbodzedze ene. Ne ame aɖe kpɔ anyigba la ɖa la, kpɔ ɖa, viviti kple nuxaxa koe li. Eƒe alilikpo na kekeli do viviti.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Le ƒe si me fia Uziya ku la, mekpɔ Aƒetɔ la. Ebɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui kɔkɔ gã aɖe dzi, eye eƒe awu toga yɔ gbedoxɔ la katã.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Serafi siwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe to aʋala adeade la, le eta me. Wotsɔ aʋala eve tsyɔ ŋkume, eve tsyɔ afɔ, eye wotsɔ eve le dzodzomee.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
translation_verse: Ɖeka nɔ ɣli dom ɖo ɖe bubu be: “Kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe, kɔkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la. Eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.”

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: Ɣlidola la ƒe gbe na kpuiawo ƒe gɔmeɖoɖowo ʋuʋu, eye dzudzɔ yɔ xɔ la taŋ.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: “Aléle! Meku loo! Mebu! Elabe nuyi makɔmakɔtɔe menye hele nuyi makɔmakɔtɔwo dome. Ke nye ŋkuwo kpɔ Fia la, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla.”

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Tete serafiawo dometɔ ɖeka dzo va gbɔnye, eye wòlé dzoka hẽ si wòtsɔ abɛ ɖe le vɔsamlekpuia me la ɖe asi.

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: Etsɔe ka nu nam hegblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, esia ka wò nuyi ŋu, eya ta woɖe wò vodadawo ɖa, eye wotsɔ wò nuvɔ̃wo ke wò.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Ke mese Aƒetɔ la ƒe gbe be: “Ame kae madɔ? Ame kae ayi na mí?” Tete meɖo eŋu be: “Nyee nye esi! Dɔm!”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Ale wògblɔ be: “Yi ɖagblɔ na dukɔ sia be: ‘Miase nu, agasee ake; ke mimase egɔme o. Miakpɔ nu, agakpɔe ake; ke mimadze sii o!’

english_verse: “Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.”
translation_verse: Na dukɔ sia ƒe dzi naku atri, eƒe to naku, eƒe ŋku nagbã ale be magakpɔ nu kple ŋku, ase nu kple to, eye wòase nu gɔme kple dzi ne wòatrɔ va, eye woana wòahaya o.”

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Tete mebia be: “Aƒetɔ, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣie?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Va se ɖe esime duwo nagbã azu aƒedo, xɔwo natsi ƒuƒlu, eye anyigba nazu gbegbe.

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ akplɔ amewo adzoe ʋĩi eye teƒe siwo wogblẽ ɖi la asɔ gbɔ le anyigba la titina.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be amewo ƒe akpa ewolia koe susɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi hã la, woagatɔ dzoe, abe ale si ne wolã sesewu alo logoti, eye takpoea susɔna ɖi ene.” Nuku kɔkɔe la nye eƒe takpoe la.

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Esi wova gblɔ na David ƒe ƒome la be Siria-ʋakɔwo va ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Efrayim la, dzika tso eya kple eƒe dukɔ ƒo, wonɔ ƒoƒom abe avemetiwoe le ʋuʋum le ya nu ene.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yesaya be: “Kplɔ viwò, Sear-Yasub, ne miado yi ɖakpe Axaz. Miado goe le dzigbetá la ƒe tɔʋu ƒe mlɔenu le Avɔlɔ̃la ƒe Agblemɔ to.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: Gblɔ nɛ be: ‘Lé ɖokuiwò, nànɔ anyi kpoo. Mègavɔ̃ o, eye dzi megaɖe le ƒowò le dɔmedzoe si fia Rezin kple eƒe Siriatɔwo kpakple fia Remalya do la ta o. Wole ko abe dzoti takpoe eve siwo le dzudzɔ tum la ene.

english_verse: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
translation_verse: Mina míaho ɖe Yuda ŋu, ado ŋɔdzi nɛ, eye míaxɔe na mía ɖokui atsɔ Tabeal vi aɖo fiae ɖe edzi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ Mawu gblɔ be: Ɖoɖo sia madze edzi o, eye mava eme o.

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe fiadue nye Samaria, Remalya vie nye Samaria-fia. Ne miexɔe se o la, ekema mianɔ te gbeɖe o.’ ” Mawulikplimí ƒe dzesi

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: “Bia dzesi tso Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la gbɔ. Ate ŋu atso tsiẽƒe ke loo, alo atso dziƒo ʋĩi ke.”

english_verse: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
translation_verse: Tete Axaz gblɔ be: “Nyemabiae o. Nyemedi be mate Aƒetɔ kpɔ o.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Ale Yesaya gblɔ be: “David ƒe ƒome, azɔ misee. Nu tsɛ wònye be, miana amewo nado dzi ʋuu nu nate wo ŋu tae miebu be, yewoana nu nate Mawunye hã ŋua?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ ana dzesi mi. Kpɔ ɖa, ɖetugbi aɖe fɔ fu. Adzi ŋutsuvi, eye woana ŋkɔe be ‘Mawulikplimí.’

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Hafi ɖevi la nava nya vɔ̃tsitsri kple nyuitiatia la, fia eve siwo le ŋɔdzi dom na wò fifia la ƒe anyigbawo lazu gbegbe.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le Asiria-fia kplɔ ge ava ƒu wò ŋutɔ, wò dukɔa kple tɔ́wò ƒe aƒe bliboa. Ŋkekeawo asesẽ wu ɖe sia ɖe si me dukɔa to kpɔ tso esime Efrayim klã ɖa tso Yuda gbɔ.”

english_verse: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ alɔ̃ aku ayɔ Egipte-ʋakɔwo abe tagbatsuwo ene tso Egipte-tɔsisiwo ƒe dzɔtsoƒe ke vɛ, eye wòayɔ Asiria-ʋakɔwo abe anyiwo ene tso Asiriatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi vɛ.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: Woava nɔ bali globowo, kpetowo kple ŋuvewo me hekpe ɖe lãnyiƒewo katã ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ la aɣe talũhɛ si ta wòaxe fe ɖo la le Asiria-fia, si tso Frat-tɔsisi la godo la, si me, eye wòatsɔe alũ ta, aŋɔmefuwo kple ge na wo.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi me, ne ame le nyinɔe ɖeka kple alẽ eve nyim la,

english_verse: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
translation_verse: akpɔ notsi babla fũu tso wo gbɔ. Ale ame ʋɛ siwo susɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi la dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒe nuɖuɖu anye notsi babla kple anyitsi.

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Amewo atsɔ aŋutrɔ kple da ayi afi ma, elabe aŋɔka kple ŋuwo axɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Woanɔ afi ma yiyi vɔ̃m, elabe togbɛ siwo katã wotsɔa kodzoe ŋlɔna tsã la, aŋɔka kple ŋuwo axɔ wo dzi. Woava zu nyikplɔƒe kple alẽwo ƒe toƒe.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Tsɔ nuŋlɔkpe gã aɖe nàŋlɔ nu si anyaxlẽ bɔbɔe la ɖe edzi be: ‘Aboyonu, afɔ netsɔ! Nuhaha, va kaba!’ ”

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: Mekpɔ ɖasefo siwo dzi meka ɖo, nunɔla Uriya kple Zaxarya, Yeberexya vi, be woaɖu ɖasefo nam.

english_verse: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
translation_verse: Tete medɔ srɔ̃nye gbeƒãɖela la gbɔ, wòfɔ fu, eye wòdzi ŋutsuvi. Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Tsɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be: Aboyonu, afɔ netsɔ! Nuhaha, va kaba!

english_verse: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
translation_verse: “Hafi ɖevia nanya ‘Papa’ alo ‘Dada’ yɔyɔ la, Asiria-fia ava lɔ Damasko ƒe kesinɔnuwo kple Samaria ƒe aboyonuwo adzoe.” Asiria-fia gbɔna

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gaƒo nu kplim gblɔ be:

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: “Esi dukɔ sia do vlo Siloa-tsi si sína blewuu, eye vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo le Rezin kple Remalya vi la gbɔ ta la,

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la akplɔ Tɔsisi la ƒe tsi gã sẽŋu siwo nye Asiria-fia kple eƒe ŋusẽ blibo la ava ƒo ɖe wo dzi duu, ayɔ eƒe baliwo katã me agbã go.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: Así ato Yuda-nyigba dzi, aɖɔ, agbagba, ase ve, eye eƒe alɔdze siwo ke la asɔ wò anyigba la ƒe kekeme, O Mawulikplimí!”

english_verse: All of you foreign nations, go ahead and prepare for war, but you will be crushed.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo, mido aʋaɣli; vɔvɔ̃ neɖo mi. Mi ame siwo katã le didiƒe le anyigba dzi, miɖo to. Mibla akpa vɔvɔ̃ neɖo mi. Mibla akpa; vɔvɔ̃ neɖo mi.

english_verse: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.
translation_verse: Mide adaŋu; ke woagblẽ eme. Miɖo gbe ɖi; ke madze edzi o elabe Mawu li kpli mí! Aƒetɔ gbe nya na gbeƒãɖela la

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ ƒo nu kplim esime eƒe asi sẽ ɖe dzinye eye wògbe nam be magazɔ dukɔ sia ƒe mɔ dzi o. Ebe:

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: “Migayɔ dukɔ sia ƒe nugbeɖoɖo be nugbeɖoɖo o. Migavɔ̃ nu si wovɔ̃na la o, eye womegadzi ŋɔ na mi o.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae miabu kɔkɔe. Eya koe miavɔ̃ eye eya ko nadzi ŋɔ na mi.

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Dzra ɖaseɖiɖi la ɖo. Tre nufiame la nu ɖe nye nusrɔ̃viwo me.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: Mele Aƒetɔ, ame si ɣla eŋkume ɖe Yakob ƒe ƒome la sinu kpɔm hele dzi ɖom ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye kple vi siwo Aƒetɔ nam lae nye esi. Míenye dzesi kple nukunu le Israel tso Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, ame si le Zion-to dzi la gbɔ.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Ke ne woagblɔ na mi be: “Mibia nu se le ŋɔliyɔlawo kple afakalawo, ame siwo doa ŋɔtimegbe nɔa gbe tem la gbɔ la, ɖe dukɔ mabia nu eƒe Mawu oa? Ɖe wòle be woabia nu ase le kukuawo gbɔ na agbagbeawoa?”

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Mitrɔ ɖe nufiame la kple ɖaseɖiɖi la ŋu. Ne womegblɔ esia o la, ekema agu medzena na wo o. Xaxaɣi

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Dukɔ la anɔ tsa glãla tsam; woate wo ɖe anyi eye dɔ awu wo. Ne dɔ le wo wum la, woado dziku ahaƒo fi ade woƒe fia kple woƒe Mawu, ne wowu mo dzi.

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Ne wokpɔ anyi la, xaxa kple viviti koe li. Xaxa ƒe tsizi kple blukɔ me ko woanya wo ɖo ɖa.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: Gake ame siwo nɔ blukɔ me tsã la magase veve o. Eɖi gbɔ Zebulon-nyigba kple Naftali-nyigba tsã, ke le ɣeyiɣi si gbɔna me la, ade bubu ƒutamɔ si le Yordan godo, si nye Galilea, dukɔwo ƒe anyigba la, ŋu.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Dukɔ si le viviti me zɔm la, kpɔ kekeli gã aɖe. Ame siwo le anyigba si dzi viviti tsiɖitsiɖi do ɖo la, kekeli klẽ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Wòe na dukɔ la dzi ɖe edzi. Wòe dzi eƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ɖe edzi. Dzi le wo dzɔm le ŋkuwò me, abe nuŋeɣi ene, abe ame siwo gbɔ tso aʋa le aʋagbedzinuwo mam la ene.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Elabe èŋe kɔkuti si nye agba nɛ, ati si le abɔta nɛ kple ameteɖeanyila ƒe ameƒoti la abe ale si nèwɔe le Midiantɔwo ŋɔli ene.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Woatɔ dzo aʋadefɔkpa ɖe sia ɖe kple aʋadewu ɖe sia ɖe si ƒo ʋu blibaa la woafiã abe nake le dzo me ene.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Elabe wodzi vi na mí! Wona ŋutsuvi mí. Dziɖuɖuŋusẽ anɔ abɔta nɛ. Woayɔe be, “Aɖaŋu Wɔnuku Ɖola, Mawu Ŋusẽtɔ, Tɔ́ Mavɔ, Ŋutifafafiavi”.

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: Eƒe dziɖuɖu akeke ta, eye eƒe ŋutifafa adzi ɖe edzi; seƒe manɔe na wo o. David ƒe fiazikpui kple eƒe fiaɖuƒe la ali ke, ahakpɔ ŋusẽ to ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me tso fifia ɖase mavɔ me. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ƒe ŋusẽe awɔ esia. Aƒetɔ ahe to na Israel

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ ɖo ɖe Yakob be yeahe to nɛ; nya la ka Israel-dukɔ la.

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: Dukɔ blibo la anyae hekpe ɖe Efrayimtɔ kple Samariatɔ, siwo le dàdam hele adegbe ƒom le dzime la ŋu be:

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Anyikpexɔwoe mu, ke míele agakpe kpakpawo tsɔ ge atu bubuwoe. Sikamortiwoe wolã, ke sedertiwoe míado ɖe wo teƒe.”

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Siriatɔwo tso ɣedzeƒe kple Filistitɔwo tso ɣetoɖoƒe ake nu me alé Israel avuvu. Togbɔ be nu siawo dzɔ hã la, eƒe dzi mefa o; eƒe abɔ gale dzi kokoko.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Ke dukɔ la metrɔ va ame si ƒo wo la gbɔ o, eye mebia Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ta se o.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ tsrɔ̃ ta kple asikɛ, deʋaya kple keti ɖa tso Israel le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Ame tsitsi kple ame ŋkutae nye ta la, eye asikɛ lae nye gbeƒãɖela, siwo ƒe nufiafia nye alakpa la.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Dukɔ sia kplɔlawo na wòtra, eye wo yomedzelawo bu.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Esia tae Aƒetɔ la makpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe ɖekakpuiwo ŋu o, eye mave woƒe ahosiwo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo nu o, elabe wo katã wonye Mawu mavɔ̃lawo kple nu tovo wɔlawo; woƒe nyagbɔgblɔ ɖe sia ɖe nye bometsinya. Togbɔ be nu siawo dzɔ hã la, eƒe dzi mefa o; eƒe abɔ gale dzi kokoko.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Elabe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le bibim abe dzo ene. Efiã aŋɔkawo kple ŋuwo, eye wòtɔ dzo ave dodowo ale be dzudzɔ de dzi kɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla ƒe dziku na dzo ƒo anyigba, eye dukɔ la le abe nake le dzo me ene; ame aɖeke mekpɔa nublanui na nɔvia o.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Wole tsyo dam nu le ɖusime; ke dɔ gale wo wum. Wole nu ɖum le mia me; ke womeɖi ƒo o. Ame sia ame le nɔvia ƒe lã vuvum.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manase ɖu Efrayim, eye Efrayim hã ɖu Manase. Wo kple eve la siaa tso ɖe Yuda ŋu. Togbɔ be esia gbegbe dzɔ hã la, eƒe dzi mefa o; eƒe abɔ gale dzi kokoko.
