english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo wɔ se madzɔmadzɔwo kple ame siwo ŋlɔ ɖoɖo siwo te amewo ɖe anyi ɖi la.

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Nu ka miawɔ gbe si gbe wole to hem na mi? Ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e tso adzɔge va do ɖe, nu ka miawɔ? Ame ka miasí atso? Afi ka miagblẽ miaƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖo?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Nu si ko miawɔ lae nye be miabɔbɔ ɖe gamenɔlawo dome, eye miadze anyi ɖe ame tsiaʋawo dome. Togbɔ be nu siawo katã dzɔ hã la, Aƒetɔ ƒe dzi mefa o; eƒe abɔ gale dzi kokoko. Asiria Dziɖula, Mawu ƒe amedɔdɔ mawɔnuteƒe

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: Baba na Asiria Dziɖula, nye dɔmedzoe ƒe ameƒoti la; nye dziku ƒe ati le esi me.

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Medɔe ɖe dukɔ mavɔ̃mawu la ŋu. Meɖe gbe nɛ ɖe dukɔ si ŋu medo dɔmedzoe ɖo la ŋu, be wòasii, ahae, eye wòafanyae abe ba le kpɔdomee ene.

english_verse: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
translation_verse: Ke eya mesusui nenema o, eye mebui le dzime alea o, ke eɖoe ɖe tame be yeagblẽ nu ahatsrɔ̃ dukɔ geɖewo.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: Elabe egblɔ be: “Ɖe nye aʋakplɔlawo katã menye fiawo oa?

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: ɖe nyemawɔ nenema na Yerusalem kple eƒe legbawo, abe ale si mewɔ na Samaria kple eƒe legbawo ene oa?”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ la wu eƒe dɔwo katã nu ɖe Zion-to la kple Yerusalem ŋu vɔ la, agblɔ be: Mahe to na Asiria Dziɖula ɖe eƒe dàda kple adegbe si ƒom wòle la ta.

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Elabe egblɔ be: “Nye ŋutɔe tsɔ nye asi kple nunya wɔe, elabe mese nu gɔme. Meɖe dukɔwo ƒe liƒowo ɖa heha woƒe kesinɔnuwo, eye metutu fiazikpui dzi nɔlawo ƒu anyi abe ŋusẽtɔ ene.

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: Nye asi su dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo dzi abe xevitɔ ene. Abe ale si wolɔa azi siwo xeviwo gblẽ ɖi ene la, nenemae melɔ anyigba blibo lae; ame aɖeke meƒo aʋala alo kè dɔ hexlɔ̃ fĩ o.”

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: Ɖe fía ado eɖokui ɖe dzi le ame si le eŋudɔ wɔm la ŋkumea? Alo laxalaxa atɔ asi akɔ ɖe ame si le ehem la ŋua? Ɖe ameƒoti awɔ ame si kɔe dzi la ŋu dɔa? Alo ɖe atizɔti atɔ̀ amea?

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la aɖo dɔ vɔ̃ ɖe eƒe ame damiawo dome, woaɖi ku, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe abi nu abe ale si dzo fiãa nui ene.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe kekeli azu dzo, eye eƒe Kɔkɔetɔ azu dzo ƒe aɖe ahabi eƒe aŋɔka kple ŋuwo woafiã le ŋkeke ɖeka dzi.

english_verse: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
translation_verse: Atsrɔ̃ eƒe ave dodowo kple agble wɔnuku dzeaniwo keŋkeŋ, eye woanɔ abe ale si dɔléle kpea dɔnɔ dzii ene.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Woate ŋu axlẽ eƒe avemeti siwo susɔ la, eye ɖevi ɖeka aŋlɔ wo ɖe agbalẽ me. Ame ʋɛ aɖewo atrɔ agbɔ

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Ava eme gbe ma gbe be Israel ƒe ame susɔeawo, Yakob ƒe ƒome la, ƒe ame siwo tsi agbe la magaɖo dzi ɖe ame si ƒo wo la ŋu azɔ o, ke boŋ woaɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wò dukɔ Israel sɔ gbɔ abe ƒutake ene hã la, ame ʋɛ aɖewo koe asusɔ agbɔ. Woatsrɔ̃ godoo le sedede dzɔdzɔe si gbã go la nu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ɖoe kplikpaa be yeatsrɔ̃ wo le anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la le gbɔgblɔm be: “Nye dukɔ si le Zion, mègavɔ̃ Asiriatɔwo ne wotsɔ ati ƒo wò, eye wòkɔ kpo dzi ɖe ŋuwò abe Egiptetɔwo ene o.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Elabe le gowòme la, esusɔ vie ko nye dziku la nu nayi eye matrɔ aɖe dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu, atsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la aɖe ameƒoka ɖe wo dzi abe ale si wòƒo Midian le Oreb-kpe la gbɔe ene, eye eƒe atikplɔ anɔ atsiaƒu dzi abe ale si wòdoe ɖe dzi le Egipte ene.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, aɖe eƒe agba le wò abɔta kple kɔkuti le wò kɔ.” Etso Rimon yi. Futɔwo dze dua dzi

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Eva dze Ayat-du dzi. Eto Migron, eye wògblẽ eƒe agba ɖe Mixmas.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Woto todomemɔ, eye wotsi Geba dɔ. Rama dzo nyànyanya; Saul ƒe Gibea de afɔ du me.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Galim-nyɔnuvi, ƒu asi nu! Laisa, ƒu to anyi. Anatot, ɖo eŋu nɛ!

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Madmena de afɔ du me. Gebitɔwo sí ɖabè.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Egbea ke, atɔ ɖe Nob, eye wòaŋlɔ kɔ ɖe Zion vinyɔnu ƒe to la ŋu, ɖe Yerusalem-togbɛ la ŋu.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la alã atilɔwo kple ŋɔdzi, atso esiwo de dzi bobobo la, eye wòamu kɔkɔtɔwo aƒu anyi.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Atsɔ fía amu atiwo le ave dodowo me. Lebanon kple eƒe ati gã nyakpɔwo ava anyi.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Atilɔ adze tso Yese ƒe atitakpo me, eye alɔdzedze atso eƒe kè me.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe Gbɔgbɔ si nye sidzedze kple nugɔmesese ƒe gbɔgbɔ, adaŋudede kple ŋusẽ ƒe gbɔgbɔ, nunya kple Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ ƒe gbɔgbɔ la, anɔ edzi.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Akpɔ dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃ ŋu; madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le nu si eƒe ŋku kpɔna la nu o, eye matso afia le nu si eƒe to sena la nu o.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe, na ame dahewo eye wòatso afia na anyigba dzi wɔnamanɔŋutɔwo ɖe eteƒe. Atsɔ eƒe numenya abe ameƒoti ene ahe to na anyigba la, eye wòatsɔ gbɔgbɔ si tso eƒe nu me la, awu ame vɔ̃ɖi lae.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ anye alidziblanu le eƒe ali, eye nuteƒewɔwɔ anye alidziblanu le eƒe aklito.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Amegãxi kple alẽvi anɔ teƒe ɖeka; lãkle atsyɔ akɔ ɖe gbɔ̃vi gbɔ. Nyivi kple dzata kpakple nyi dami anɔ wo nɔewo gbɔ, eye ɖevi sue aɖe akplɔ wo.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Nyinɔ kple sisiblisinɔ aɖu gbe; wo viwo atsyɔ akɔ ɖe teƒe ɖeka. Dzata aɖu gbe abe nyitsu ene.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Vi nono afe le ƒli ƒe do nu, eye vi si wotso no na la, aƒo asi ɖe dakpui ƒe do me.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Le Mawu ƒe to kɔkɔe la dzi la, womawɔ nu vevi ame alo agblẽ nu o. Elabe sidzedze Aƒetɔ axɔ anyigba la dzi abe ale si tsi yɔ atsiaƒui la ene. Aboyomeyilawo atrɔ gbɔ

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Ava eme ɣe ma ɣi be dukɔwo adi Yese ƒe kè si nye dzesi na dukɔwo la yome, eye bubu anɔ eƒe nɔƒe ŋu.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ la awɔ eƒe ŋusẽ ŋu dɔ zi evelia akplɔ eƒe ame siwo katã susɔ ɖe Asiria, Egipte, Patros, Nubia, Elam, Babilonia, Xamat kple ƒukpowo dzi la agbɔ va aƒee.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Akɔ aflaga dzi na dukɔwo, eye woaƒo Israel ƒe ame siwo wonyà de gbe kple Yudatɔ siwo wokaka hlẽ la nu ƒu tso anyigba ƒe go eneawo dzi la.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe ŋuʋaʋã nu atso, eye ame siwo ɖea fu na Yuda la, aɖe ɖa. Efrayim magaʋã ŋu Yuda azɔ o, eye Yuda magaɖe fu na Efrayim azɔ o.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ woaƒo ƒu adze Filistitɔwo dzi le ɣetoɖoƒe gome, eye woaƒo ƒu aɖaha ame siwo le ɣedzeƒe gome la. Woaɖu Edom kple Moab tɔwo dzi, eye Amonviwo aɖo to wo.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ana Egipte-ƒu la ƒe adɔ̃ namie keŋ, eye wòanye asi ya xɔdzo naƒo to Frat-tɔsisi la dzi. Amae ɖe tɔʋu adrẽ me ale be amewo anɔ atokota me atsoe.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Anye mɔ tata gã tso Asiria na eƒe dukɔ ƒe ame mamlɛ siwo susɔ abe ale si wònɔ na Israel esime wòʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi ene.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, miagblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, mada akpe na wò! Elabe èdo dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋunye; ke azɔ la, wò dzi fa, eye nèfa akɔ nam.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu nye nye xɔnametɔ. Maɖo dzi ɖe eŋu; nyemavɔ̃ o. Elabe Aƒetɔ ye nye nye ŋusẽ kple nye ha; eyae zu nye xɔnametɔ.”

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Miadu tsi le xɔname ƒe vudowo me kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Miagblɔ gbe ma gbe be: “Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ! Miyɔ eŋkɔ! Mina dukɔwo nanya nu siwo wòwɔ la! Miɖe gbeƒã be eŋkɔ de dzi!

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Midzi ha kafu Aƒetɔ le nukunu siwo wòwɔ la ta. Mina xexe blibo la nanya nu si dzɔ.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Zion-nɔla, do ɣli eye nàdzi ha kple dzidzɔ! Elabe Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ triakɔ la le dowòme.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Nya sia nye Mawu ƒe gbedeasi na Yesaya, Amoz vi la. Eku ɖe Babilonia ŋu.

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Mitu aflaga ɖe to ƒeƒle la tame! Mido ɣli yɔ aʋawɔlawo. Miwɔ asi na wo ne woage ɖe bubumewo ƒe agbowo me.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔe ɖe gbe na nye ame kɔkɔeawo. Meyɔ nye aʋakalẽawo kple nye adegbeƒolawo bene woaɖe nye dɔmedzoe afia.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Miƒu to anyi ne miase zinyenye ɖa le toawo dzi! Ele ɖiɖim abe ameha gã aɖe tɔ ene. Miɖo to miasee ɖa! Fiaɖuƒewo kple dukɔ siwo le ta kpem la ƒe hoowɔwɔe le ɖiɖim. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae le aʋakɔwo nu ƒom ƒu be woawɔ aʋa.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Wotso didiƒe ʋĩi, tso keke dziƒowo ƒe mlɔenu ke. Aƒetɔ tsɔ eƒe aʋawɔnuwo gbɔnae kple dziku be yeatsrɔ̃ anyigba blibo la.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Mifa avi elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe. Gbe ma gbe anye Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe nugblẽgbe.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Esia ta asiwo katã ado agblɔ; dzi aɖe le ame sia ame ƒo.

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ aɖo wo. Woase veve kutɔkutɔe, ado lagbelãgbe abe nyɔnu si le ku lém la ene. Woafɔ ŋku ɖe wo nɔewo dzi gã, eye woƒe mo aʋu dzo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la gbɔna; ŋutasesẽ, dziku kple dɔmedzoe helihelĩ ŋkeke ye. Anyigba azu gbegbe, eye Aƒetɔ atsrɔ̃ edzi nuvɔ̃wɔlawo.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Elabe ɣletiviwo kple dziŋgɔli ŋu nukeklẽwo magaklẽ o. Ne ɣe dze la, ado viviti, eye ɣleti magaɖi o.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Mahe to na xexea me ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta, eye mahe to na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta. Mana dàdalawo ƒe dàda nu natso, eye mate ŋutasẽlawo ƒe adegbeƒoƒo ɖe to.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Mana amegbetɔ nave abe sika nyuitɔ ene; amegbetɔ nave abe Ofir-sika ene.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Eya ta gbe si gbe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la aɖe eƒe dɔmedzoe kple dziku dziŋɔ afia la, ana dziƒowo nadzo kpèkpekpe, eye anyigba aʋuʋu le eƒe agunu.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Ame si woakpɔ la, woatɔ nui; ame si dzi asi asu la, atsi yi nu.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Woaxlã wo viwo ɖe nu le woawo ŋutɔ ŋkume. Woaha woƒe aƒewo, eye woazi wo srɔ̃wo dzi adɔ kpli wo.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, made dzo Mediatɔwo me ne woatso ɖe wo ŋu. Woawo la, womebua klosalo ɖe naneke me o; sika gɔ̃ hã mebiãa ŋu na wo o.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Woƒe dawo aƒo ɖekakpuiwo aƒu anyi. Womakpɔ nublanui na fu nɔdɔmee o, eye ɖeviwo ƒe nu mawɔ nublanui na wo o.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babilonia-fiaɖuƒe nye fiaɖuƒe vevi; woɖo atsyɔ̃ nɛ ale gbegbe, eye Kaldeatɔwo tsɔnɛ ƒoa adegbee. Ke anɔ nɛ abe gbe si gbe Aƒetɔ mu Sodom kple Gomora ƒu anyi la ene.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Ame maganɔ afi ma, atso aƒe ɖi o, tso dzidzime yi dzidzime. Arabiatɔ aɖeke matu eƒe agbadɔ ɖi o, eye alẽkplɔlawo makplɔ woƒe lãwo ayi afi ma woatsyɔ akɔ ɖi o.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ gbemelãwo atsyɔ akɔ ɖe teƒea, eye adzexewo ayɔ woƒe xɔwo me. Tsatsaboliwo awɔ atɔ ɖi, eye azizãwo afe le afi ma.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Agbotoewo axlɔ̃ le woƒe mɔ́wo me, eye akpatakuwo aɖe gbe le woƒe fiasã nyakpɔwo me. Babilonia ƒe ɣeyiɣi gogo, eye eƒe ŋkeke la mahe ɖe megbe o.

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ akpɔ nublanui na Yakob, eye wòagatia Israel. Agaɖo wo gɔme anyi ɖe woƒe anyigba dzi ekema amedzrowo akpe ɖe wo ŋu, eye woatsɔ wo ɖokui alé ɖe Yakob ƒe ƒome la ŋu.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Dukɔwo akplɔ wo agbɔ va aƒee. Tete Israel-dukɔ la axɔ wo, woazu eƒe domenyinu abe kluviwo kple kosiwo ene le Aƒetɔ ƒe anyigba la dzi. Ale woalé ame siwo ɖe aboyo wo la, eye woaɖu amegã ɖe ame siwo te wo ɖe to la dzi. Babilon-fia le tsiẽƒe

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Ava eme be ne Aƒetɔ na vovo wò tso fukpekpe kple fuɖeɖe kpakple dɔ sesẽ siwo wotsɔ do kluvi wòe me la,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: ekema adzi fewuɖuha sia ɖe Babilonia-fia ŋu be: “Ameteɖeanyila megali o! Ŋutasesẽ nu tso!”

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ŋe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ŋusẽti, dziɖulawo ƒe atikplɔ,

english_verse: who were furious and never stopped abusing the people of other nations.
translation_verse: siwo wotsɔ ƒo dukɔwo le dziku me atraɖii, te dukɔwo ɖe anyi le dɔmedzoe me heti wo yome madzudzɔmadzudzɔe.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Anyigba blibo la gbɔ ɖe eme, ɖe dzi ɖi bɔkɔɔ, eye wode asi aseyetsohawo dzidzi me.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Sesewuwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm ɖe ŋuwò. Lebanon-sedertiwo le gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Esime womu wò ƒu anyi kpaa, ame aɖeke megava lã mí kpɔ o.’

english_verse: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe le to me ʋĩi, tso hiã be ne èva ɖo la, yeakpe wò. Enyɔ ame kukuwo kple kplɔlawo katã le anyigba dzi be woado dzaa na wò. Ena dukɔwo ƒe fiawo katã tsi tsitre le woƒe fiazikpuiwo dzi.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Wo katã woaɖo eŋu agblɔ na wò be: ‘Wò hã èva gbɔdzɔ abe míawo ke ene! Èzu abe míawo ke ene!’

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Woɖiɖi wò atsyɔ̃ yi tsiẽƒe; wò kasaŋkuwo ƒe ɖiɖi hã yi. Nyéwo nye aba le tewò, eye ŋɔwo nye avɔ nètsyɔ.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: “O Babilon-fia! Wò Ŋukeɣletivi! Wò Agudzeviŋutsu! Kpɔ ale si nège tso dziƒo va dze anyii la ɖa! Woƒo wò ƒu anyi, wò ame si te dukɔwo ɖe anyi la!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Ke ègblɔ le wò dzime be: ‘Malia ayi dziƒo; mali nye fiazikpui ɖe Mawu ƒe ɣletiviwo tame, eye mabɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Takpeƒeto la dzi le dzigbeme ke ɖa.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: Malia ayi alilikpowo tame, eye mawɔ ɖokuinye abe Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ene.’

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ke wotutu wò yi tsiẽƒe, yi keke aʋlime ke.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Ame siwo kpɔ wò la, woaɖe ŋku ɖe wò, abu ŋuwò ʋuu agblɔ be: ‘Ŋutsu si na anyigba dzo nyànyanya, eye wòʋuʋu fiaɖuƒewo lae nye esia ɖe!

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Ame si wɔ xexea me wòzu kegbegbe, gbã eƒe duwo, eye wògbe asiɖeɖe le gamenɔlawo ŋu ɖo ɖe wo de lae nye esia ɖe!’

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzifiawo katã mlɔ anyi ɖe woƒe ɖiƒewo le bubu me; ɖe sia ɖe le eƒe yɔdo me.

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: Ke wò ya, wotsɔ wò ƒu gbe abe atilɔ si wotsɔ ƒu gbe alo lã kuku si wofanya kple afɔ la ene. Ame tsiaʋa siwo tsi yi nu, eye woyi agumekpewo gbɔ lae tsyɔ dziwò.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Màsɔ kple woamawo le yɔ me o, elabe ègblẽ wò anyigba, eye nèwu wò dukɔmetɔwo. “Womagayɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ƒe dzidzimeviwo ŋkɔ gbeɖegbeɖe o.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Midzra amewuƒe ɖo na via ŋutsuwo wuwu le wo tɔ́wo ƒe vodada ta bene womagatso axɔ anyigba la, eye woatso duwo ɖe edzi o.” Mawu agbã Babilon

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Matso ɖe wo ŋu, eye maɖe Babilon ŋkɔ ɖa. Matsrɔ̃ eƒe ame susɔeawo kple dzidzimeviwo ɖa,” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Matsɔe awɔ hlɔ̃madewo nɔƒe kple tsinɔƒee. Matsrɔ̃ teƒea keŋkeŋ abe xae wotsɔ kplɔe ene.” Mawu atsrɔ̃ Asiriatɔwo

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ka atam be: “Nu si meɖo la, eya koe adzɔ! Nu si meɖo kplikpaa la, eyae mawɔ!

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ Asiriatɔ le nye anyigba dzi eye mafanyae kple afɔ le nye towo dzi. Eƒe kɔkuti aɖe ɖa le wo ŋu, eye eƒe agba aɖe ɖa le woƒe abɔta.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Nugbe si meɖo ɖe anyigba blibo la ŋu lae nye esi: Abɔ si mekɔ dzi ɖe dukɔwo katã ŋu lae nye esi.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Elabe ne Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ɖo nu ɖe tame la, ame kae agblẽ eme? Ne edo eƒe alɔ ɖe dzi la, ame kae agbugbɔe? Aƒetɔ atsrɔ̃ Filistitɔwo

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Ƒè si me fia Axaz ku lae woɖe gbeƒã gbedeasi sia:

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: O Filisti-nyigba blibo la, mèganɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm be ati si ƒo wò la ŋe o, elabe dakpui ado tso da ƒe kè me, eye eƒe kutsetse anye da vɔ̃ɖi si to aʋala.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Manyi ame dahewo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo, eye hiãtɔwo amlɔ anyi bɔkɔɔ le dziɖeɖi me. Ke matsɔ dɔwuame awu wò kè, eye woatsrɔ̃ wò ame susɔeawo.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: O agbo, fa avi sesĩe! O du, fa avi! Miawoe, Filistitɔwo, mi katã, vɔvɔ̃ neɖo mi. Elabe dzudzɔ le tutum tso dzigbeme gbɔna; ame ɖeka pɛ hã metsi megbe le wo ŋu o.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Ke ale ke ame aɖo eŋu na dukɔ la ƒe amedɔdɔwoe? Aɖo eŋu be: “Aƒetɔ ye tsò Zion, eye wòanye sitsoƒe na eƒe dukɔ la ƒe hiãtɔwo.”

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Gbedeasi ɖe Moab ŋu. Wogbã Ar le zã me; Moab dɔ̃! Wogbã Kir le zã me; Moab dɔ̃!

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibon yi nuxeƒewo gɔ̃ hã be yeaɖafa avi. Moab le avi fam sesĩe le Nebo kple Medeba duwo ta. Amewo katã lũ ta kokoe, eye woƒlɔ ge.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Wosa akpanya ɖe ali le ablɔwo me. Le xɔtawo kple kpɔdomeewo la, ame sia ame le avi fam, aɖatsi le dodom yoyoyo.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Xesbon kple Eleale le asi ƒum nu, eye wose woƒe ɣli le keke Yahaz ke. Eya ta Moab-ʋawɔlawo do ɣli, eye eƒe luʋɔ ʋuʋu.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Nye dzi le nu xam le Moab ŋu, eƒe amewo sí aʋa yi Zoar kple Eglat etɔ̃lia ke. Elabe wole avi fam le Luxit-to dzi mɔ la dzi elabe konyifaɣli le ɖiɖim le wo nu le Xoronaim-mɔta.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Elabe tsi mie le Nimrim-tɔʋu la me, gbe ƒu, gbe fɛ̃ ku, eye nu mumu aɖeke megali o.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Eya ta woƒo woƒe kesinɔnuwo nu ƒu kple nunɔamesiwo katã, eye wosí to amutitɔʋu la me dzo yi.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Elabe konyifaɣli ɖi kpe Moab-nyigba ɖo. Ɣli de Elglayim ke, eye wòɖo Beer-Elim gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Elabe ʋu yɔ Dibon-tɔʋuwo me taŋ; ke magahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava Dibon dzi. Makplɔ dzata ade Moab ƒe ame síaʋawo kple ame siwo susɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi kokoko.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Woɖo alẽvi ɖe anyigba la dziɖula tso Sela, to kegbegbe la ɖe Zion vinyɔnu ƒe to la gbɔ.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Moab-nyɔnuviwo anɔ abe xevi si wonyà le atɔ me wòsí la ene le Arnon ƒe tɔtsoƒe.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: “De adaŋu, drɔ̃ ʋɔnu, eye na wò vɔvɔli nanɔ abe zã ene le ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ. Ɣla ame siwo wonyà de gbe, eye mègaɖe sisílawo gɔme ɖe go o.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Na Moab ƒe ame siwo wonyà de gbe la nanɔ gbɔwò. Nànye sitsoƒe na wo tso nugblẽla la si me; va se ɖe esime ŋutasesẽ nu natso, tsɔtsrɔ̃ nawu enu, eye amefanyala nate ɖa le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Ekema woatsɔ amenuveve ali ke fiazikpui aɖe, eye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la aɖe anɔ edzi le David ƒe ƒome la me tegbee. Anye ame si dia nya dzɔdzɔe yome, eye wòʋãna ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ŋu.”

english_verse: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
translation_verse: Míese Moab ƒe dàda ale si wòle asi tɔm akɔ vevie; eɖokui dzadzra, dàda, amemabumabu kple adegbeƒoƒo nye alakpa.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Eya ta Moab nefa na eɖokui; ame sia ame nefa na Moab. Mifa konyi ɖe Kir-Xareset ƒe waintsetsebolo ŋu abe ame siwo ŋu ƒoƒo te la ene.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Elabe Xesbon-gblewo yrɔ; Sibma ƒe wainka hã nenema. Dukɔwo ƒe amegãwo fanya eƒe kutsetse nyuitɔ ƒe alɔ siwo de keke Yazer ke, eye wobu ɖe gbegbe. Eƒe alɔwo vu gbɔ atsiaƒu ta!

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Eya ta mafa avi, abe ale si Yazer le avi fam ɖe Sibma ƒe wainka ŋu la ene. Xesbon kple Eleale, mafa aɖatsi ɖe mia dzi, elabe aʋaɣli dze miaƒe kutsetsegbeɣi kple nuŋeɣi dzi.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple vivisese nu tso le abɔ wɔnukuwo me, eye womegale aseye tsom, le dzidzɔ kpɔm le waingblewo me o. Womegafiãa wain le wainfiãnu me o; wotsi dzidzɔɣlidodoa nu.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Ava eme be, ne Moab va do, esime wòtso hloloe le nuxeƒea vɔ, eye wòva kɔkɔeƒe la be yeado gbe ɖa la, mate ŋui o.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Esia nye nya si Aƒetɔ gblɔ ɖe Moab ŋu va yi.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, Aƒetɔ be: “Le ƒe etɔ̃ me tututu, abe ƒedɔwɔla ƒe ƒè ene la, Moab ƒe ŋusẽ ava anyi, togbɔ be eƒe amewo sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ hã. Ame siwo susɔ la anɔ ʋɛ, eye woanye ame gblɔewo.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Gbedeasi ɖe Damasko ŋu. Kpɔ ɖa, Damasko maganye du azɔ o; atrɔ zu aƒedo.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Woagblẽ Aroer ƒe duwo ɖi, woazu lãhawo tɔ; woamlɔ anyi ɖe afi ma, eye ame aɖeke mado vɔvɔ̃ na wo o.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe mɔ́ kple Damasko ƒe fiaɖuƒe nu ayi. Siria ƒe ame susɔeawo ƒe ŋusẽ anɔ abe Israelviwo tɔ ene. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Yakob ƒe bubu dzi aɖe kpɔtɔ, eye ami avɔ le eŋu.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Kutsetse asusɔ ɖe edzi hena esiwo ge fɔlawo, abe ale si wogbea amiti tsetsee ene. Kutsetse eve alo etɔ̃ tsia eƒe ɖɔ me; ene alo atɔ̃ nɔa ati tseku la ƒe alɔwo me. Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu lae gblɔe.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, amegbetɔwo atrɔ ɖe woƒe Wɔla ŋu, eye woƒe ŋku anɔ Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe asi nu kpɔm.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Womatrɔ kɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui siwo nye woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ la ŋu o, eye womanye kɔ akpɔ nyɔnumawu Asera kple ɣelegba siwo woawo ŋutɔ ƒe asi wɔ la o.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, wò du sesẽwo azu gbegbe, abe Xivitɔwo kple Amoritɔwo ƒe aƒedo siwo wogblẽ ɖi hesí le Israelviwo nu la ene.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Elabe èŋlɔ Mawu si xɔ wò ɖe agbe la be, eye mèɖo ŋku wò agakpe si nye wò sitsoƒe la dzi o. Eya tae nède agble siwo nyakpɔ, eye nètsɔ du bubu me tɔwo ƒe wainka do ɖe wo me.

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe nèdo nukua la, ètɔ kpɔ ɖe eŋu, eye esi ŋu ke la, èna wò nukuawo ƒo se. Ke nuŋeɣi la zu dɔ vlo; ezu fukpekpe kple veve helihelĩ segbe. Woɖu futɔwo ƒe dukɔwo dzi

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo le hoo wɔm abe tsi geɖewoe le hoo wɔm ene; ke ablu ɖe wo ta, eye woasí ayi adzɔge ʋĩi. Woɖe wo ɖe nu, abe gbe ƒuƒue le ya nu le towo dzi, alo yali le ahom nu ene.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Fiẽ la, ŋɔdzie! Hafi ŋu nake la, womegali o. Esiae nye ame siwo da adzo mí la, ƒe gome kple mía halawo ƒe fetu.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Baba na anyigba si dzi aʋalawo le ƒoƒom le, le Nubia-tɔsisiwo godo la.

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: Wò, si dɔ amewo ɖe atsiaƒu dzi wole aƒlaʋuwo me to tɔwo dzi la! Mi dɔla ɖeablawo, miheyi dukɔ si ƒe amewo kɔ, ame siwo ƒe ŋutigbalẽ zrɔ̃ la gbɔ. Dukɔ si wovɔ̃na tso dzɔdzɔme ke le didiƒe kple kpuiƒe. Dukɔ sesẽ si ɖua nu sia nu dzi, eye tɔsisiwo to eƒe anyigba me la.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Mi xexea me nɔlawo katã kple anyigbadzitɔwo, ne wotu aflaga ɖe towo dzi la, miakpɔe. Ne woku kpẽ la, miasee.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Manɔ nɔnyeƒe kpoo anɔ nu kpɔm dũu, abe ale si ŋdɔ vena helihelĩ ene, alo abe ale si zãmu dzana le nuŋeɣi le dzomeŋɔli ene.”

english_verse: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
translation_verse: Elabe hafi nuŋeɣi naɖo, ne seƒoƒo nu nayi, eye waintsetsewo naɖi la, atsɔ hɛ gobɛ alã kaawo, aflí alɔawo ɖa, eye wòaŋe wo.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Woagblẽ wo katã ɖi na xe ƒonu siwo nɔa towo dzi kple gbemelã siwo le anyigba dzi. Xe ƒonuwo aɖu wo le dzomeŋɔli, eye gbemelãwo katã aɖu wo le vuvɔŋɔli.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la axɔ nunanawo tso dukɔ si ƒe amewo kɔ kple ame siwo ƒe ŋutigbalẽ zrɔ̃ la gbɔ. Dukɔ si wovɔ̃na tso dzɔdzɔme ke le didiƒe kple kpuiƒe; dukɔ sesẽ si ɖua nu sia nu dzi, eye tɔsisiwo to eƒe anyigba me la gbɔ le Zion-to la dzi, afi si wosubɔa Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la le la.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Gbedeasi ɖe Egipte ŋu. Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ do alilikpo si le du dzi sesĩe la gbɔna ɖe Egipte. Egipte-legbawo adzo nyànyanya le eŋkume, eye dzi aɖe le Egiptetɔwo ƒo.

english_verse: “I will punish Egypt with civil war— neighbors, cities, and kingdoms will fight each other.
translation_verse: Mana avu nadzɔ ɖe Egiptetɔ kple Egiptetɔ dome. Nɔvi kple nɔvi, havi kple havi, du kple du, fiaɖuƒe kple fiaɖuƒe awɔ aʋa.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Dzi aɖe le Egiptetɔwo ƒo keŋkeŋ, eye matɔtɔ woƒe ɖoɖowo. Woabia nu legbawo, dzotɔwo, ŋɔliyɔlawo kple afakalawo.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Matsɔ Egipte ade asi na aƒetɔ sesẽ aɖe, eye fia ŋutasẽla aɖe aɖu wo dzi. Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Tsi amie le Nil-tɔsisi me, eye tɔsisi la amie, aƒu kplakplakpla.

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Eƒe tsimɔɖeɖewo aʋẽ kũu; Nil-tɔsisi le Egipte ƒe alɔdzewo nu atso, amie, eye ava kple keti ayrɔ.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe alé ame siwo trea anazi kple ame siwo lɔ̃a aklala la, eye woabu mɔkpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Woagbã ame siwo nye dukɔa ƒe sɔtiwo la, eye apaɖilawo katã axa nu.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Zoan-megãwo nye bometsilawo sɔŋ; Egipte Fiagã ƒe adaŋudela nyanuawo gblɔa tagbɔkukunya. Ale ke miate ŋu agblɔ na Egipte Fiagã be: “Nunyalawo ƒe vie menye, blemafiawo ƒe dzidzimevie menye” mahã?

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Ke egbe ɖe, afi ka wò nunyalawo le? Na ne woagblɔ nu si Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ɖo ɖe Egipte ŋu la na wò.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zoan-megãwo zu bometsilawo, Memfis-megãwo flu wo ɖokui. Wo, ame siwo nye woƒe towo ƒe dzogoedzikpe la kplɔ Egipte trae.

english_verse: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ na gbɔgbɔ aɖe tɔtɔ wo, eye wòna Egipte le ya mum le eƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã me, abe ahamulae tru kɔ ɖi le eme zɔm ene.

english_verse: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ale nuwɔwɔ aɖeke mele Egipte si ta kple asikɛ, deʋaya kple keti, nayi wɔwɔ ge o. Egipte-dukɔ asubɔ Aƒetɔ

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Egiptetɔwo anɔ abe nyɔnuwo ene. Ne wokpɔ Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la, wòkɔ asi dzi ɖe wo ŋu la, vɔvɔ̃ aɖo wo, woadzo nyànyanya.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Yuda-nyigba la azu ŋɔdzi na Egiptetɔwo. Ne woyɔ Yuda ŋkɔ le Egiptetɔ aɖe gbɔ la, vɔvɔ̃ aɖoe, wòadzo nyànyanya le nugbe si Aƒetɔ ɖo ɖe eŋu la ta.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, du atɔ̃ agblɔ Kanaan-gbe le Egipte-nyigba dzi. Du siawo aka atam na Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la. Woayɔ du siawo dometɔ ɖeka be Ɣedu.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, vɔsamlekpui anɔ Egipte-nyigba titina na Aƒetɔ, eye sɔti anɔ eƒe liƒo dzi na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Nu sia anye dzesi kple ɖaseɖiɖi na Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la le Egipte-nyigba dzi. Ne ameteɖeanyilawo te wo ɖi, eye wodo ɣli yɔ Aƒetɔ la, aɖo xɔnametɔ ɖe wo be wòaʋli wo ta ahaɖe wo.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ aɖe eɖokui afia Egiptetɔwo, eye Egiptetɔwo adze si Aƒetɔ ɣe ma ɣi. Woatsɔ akpedadavɔsa kple numemevɔsa asubɔe. Woaɖe adzɔgbe na Aƒetɔ, eye woawɔ edzi.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ahe to na Egiptetɔwo, ke ana woagahaya. Woatrɔ ɖe eŋu, eye wòaɖo to woƒe gbedodoɖa ayɔ dɔ wo.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, mɔ tata anɔ Egipte kple Asiria dome. Dukɔ eve siawo me tɔwo ayi wo nɔewo gbɔ, eye woawɔ ɖeka asubɔ Aƒetɔ ɖekae.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Israel anye dukɔ etɔ̃lia akpe ɖe Egipte kple Asiria ŋu, eye woanye yayra anɔ anyigba blibo la titina.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Wonye dukɔ siwo Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la yra gblɔ be: “Meyra wò, nye dukɔ Egipte kple wò Asiria si mewɔ kpakple wò Israel, si nye nye domenyinu.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Ƒè si me Asiria-fia Sargon dɔ Tartan, aʋakplɔlagã la ɖe Asdod-du me wòɖawɔ aʋa kple dua hexɔe la,

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: ɣe ma ɣie Aƒetɔ ƒo nu to Yesaya, Amoz vi la dzi. Egblɔ nɛ be: “Yi nàɖe akpanya si nèsa ɖe ali la ɖi, eye nàɖe afɔkpa hã.” Ewɔ ɖe edzi. Enɔ amama, nɔ afɔ ƒuƒlu henɔ yiyim.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ be: “Ale si nye dɔla Yesaya ɖe ama, nɔ afɔ ƒuƒlu ƒè etɔ̃ sɔŋ la, nye dzesi kple kpɔɖeŋu ɖe Egipte kple Nubia ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: Nenemae Asiria-fia akplɔ Egipte ƒe aboyomewo kple Nubia ƒe ame siwo wonyà de gbe la adzoe. Ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo siaa, woanɔ amama, woanɔ afɔ ƒuƒlu, eye naneke maxe kpeteƒe na wo o, wòanye ŋukpe na Egipte.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Ale woƒe nu aku, eye woatsi yaa, le Nubia si ŋu woɖoa ŋu ɖo kple Egipte si wotsɔna ƒoa adegbee la ta.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Tete ƒutanɔlawo agblɔ gbe ma gbe be: ‘Mikpɔ nu si va dzɔ ɖe ame siwo ŋu míele ŋu ɖom ɖo kple ame siwo gbɔ míesí va bè ɖo, be woaɖe mí tso Asiria-fia si me dzi la ɖa! Ke míawo ɖe, ale ke míasí le enui?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Gbedeasi ɖe atsiaƒu nu gbedadaƒo ŋu. Abe ale si yali ƒona toa anyigbemekegbegbe yinae ene la, nenemae dzɔgbevɔ̃e tso anyigba dziŋɔ aɖe dzi gbɔna.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Woɖe ŋutega sesẽ aɖe fiam: Nuhala, haa nu. Nugblẽla, gblẽa nu. Elam, ho va! Media, ɖe to ɖe eŋu! Metsi hũɖeɖe siwo katã wòhe vɛ la nu.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Eya ta ali tsom, eye mese veve helihelĩ abe funɔ si le ku lém la ene. Metɔtɔ, nyemegale nu sem o. Dzidzi ƒom, nyemegale nu kpɔm o.

english_verse: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
translation_verse: Nye susu wɔ tramaa; nye lã me ble fu, eye wona fiẽ si ŋu mele ŋu ɖom ɖo la, zu ŋɔdzi lém.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Woɖo kplɔ̃ heɖo kplɔ̃dzivɔwo; woɖu nu, no nu. Dumegãwo, mitso; misi ami na akpoxɔnuawo!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nam be: “Yi nàɖo gbetakpɔla ne wòaɖe gbeƒã nu si wòkpɔ la.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Ne ekpɔ sɔdolawo le ha me eveve, tedzidolawo le tedziwo dzi, kposɔdolawo le kposɔwo dzi la, neke to ɖi nyuie, neƒu to anyi nyuie.”

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: Tete gbetakpɔla la do ɣli abe dzata ene ɖa be: “Aƒetɔ, menɔ te ɖe gbetakpɔƒe la tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke, eye teƒe ma ko menɔ zãwo katã.”

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, sɔdolawo ƒe hae nye ekem le eveve gbɔna ɖa! Tete wògblɔ be: “Egbã, Babilon gbã! Womu eƒe legbawo katã ƒu anyi!”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: Ao, nye ame siwo wogbã gudugudu, nye ame siwo wogbɔ abe lu ene, nya si mese tso Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Israel ƒe Mawu gbɔ lae meɖe gbeƒã na mi. Gbedeasi tso Edom ŋu

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Gbedeasi tso Duma ŋu. Ame aɖe yɔm tso Edom bia be: “Dzɔla, zã va yi vɔa? Ŋukeɣi ɖoa?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Dzɔla la ɖo eŋu be: “Esusɔ vie, ŋu nake, ke zã gale dodo ge. Ne biabia aɖe le asiwò la, gatrɔ va bia.” Gbedeasi tso Arabia ŋu

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Gbedeasi sia tso Arabia ŋu. Dedantɔwo, mi ame siwo ƒe asihawo tsi Arabia-kegbegbe dɔ.

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: Mi Tema ƒe anyigbadzitɔwo, miku tsi yi ɖakpe ame tsikɔwuiawo, mitsɔ nuɖuɖu yi ɖakpe aʋasílawoe!

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Elabe yiwo nu wosí le: yi si woɖe le aku me, dati si me wovu ɖe wo ŋu kple aʋawɔwɔ ƒe ŋɔdzi nue wosí le.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nam be: “Le ƒè ɖeka me tututu abe ƒèdɔwɔla ƒe dɔwɔɣi ene la, Kedar ƒe ŋusẽwo katã nu ayi.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Kedarviwo ƒe aʋawɔlawo ƒe dati susɔeawo azu ʋɛ, elabe Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu lae gblɔe.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Gbedeasi tso ŋutegabali la ŋu. Nu kae dzɔ be mielia yi dzi, eye mi katã miede xɔta,

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: mi ame siwo doa dzidzɔɣli, wò, du si tɔa zi kple aseyetsotso? Wò ame siwo wowu la, menye yi nue wotsi o, menye aʋa hãe wotsi o.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Wò dziɖulawo katã sí afɔ ɖekae; wometsɔ dati ɖe wo ŋu hafi lé wo asiasii o. Asi su ame siwo katã wotu la dzi, togbɔ be wosí yi didiƒe hã.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Eya ta mebe: “Miɖe kɔ ɖa le ŋunye ne mafa avi hehehe. Migakpe fu be yewoafa akɔ nam le esi wotsrɔ̃ nye dukɔ vinyɔnu ta o.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Elabe ŋkeke le Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la si, eye wòana zitɔtɔ, tsɔtsrɔ̃ kple tɔtɔtɔ nava ŋutegabali la me. Woamu gliwo aƒu anyi, eye woadi xɔxɔ ado ɣli ɖo ɖe to la gbɔ.

english_verse: The people of Elam and Kir attacked with chariots and carried shields.
translation_verse: Elam kpla daku, eye tasiaɖam siwo ame yɔ kple sɔdolawo la kpe ɖe wo ŋu. Kir he eƒe akpoxɔnu ɖe go.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Ale wò bali nyuitɔwo yɔ fũu kple tasiaɖamwo, eye sɔdolawo dze aʋa ɖe agboawo nu.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Eɖe ama Yuda. Ɣe ma ɣi la, ètso ŋku na avexɔ ƒe aʋawɔnuwo.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: Miekpɔ be wogbã teƒe geɖe le David ƒe du la me, eye miexe anyigbemeta ƒe tsiwo.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Miexlẽ Yerusalem-xɔwo, eye miegbã wo be miatsɔ woƒe kpewo ali ke gliawoe.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Mieɖe ʋe ɖe gli eveawo dome le dua me, be tá xoxo si le dua me ƒe tsi nasí age ɖe eme. Ke mieɖo ŋu ɖe eya ame si wɔe ŋu loo, alo bu ame si wɔ ɖoɖo sia xoxoxo, eye wòva eme alea la ɖe naneke me o.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la, nɔ mia yɔm be miafa avi, afa konyi, eye mialũ ta, ata akpanya.

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Ke mieɖu ŋkekenyui, kpɔ dzidzɔ: miewu nyitsu, tso alẽ, mieɖu lã, no wain hegblɔ be: “Mina míaɖu nu, ano nu elabe etsɔ míele kuku ge.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ɖe eɖokui fia hegblɔ ɖe to me nam be: “Womatsɔ vodada sia ake mi akpɔ o, va se ɖe esime miaku! Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe!” Wogbe nya na Sebna

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la gblɔ nam be: “Tso nàyi Sebna, nuwo dzikpɔla sia si le fiaƒea nu la gbɔ nàɖagblɔ nɛ be:

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ kae le asiwò le afii? Ame kae le asiwò le afi sia, hafi nèɖe yɔdo na ɖokuiwò ɖe afii? Èɖe yɔdo ɖe kɔkɔƒe, eye nèwɔ nɔƒe na ɖokuiwò ɖe agakpe me?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wò si le ŋutsunya hem, Aƒetɔ ada wò ɖo ɖa sesĩe, eye wòalé wò goŋgoŋ.

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: Aŋlɔ wò gonyogonyo abe bɔl ene, eye wòatsɔ wò aƒu gbe ɖo ɖe anyigba keke aɖe dzi. Àku ɖe afi ma, eye wò tasiaɖam nyuiawo atsi afi ma. Wò si zu ŋukpe na wò aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la!

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Manyà wò le dɔ me, eye woaxɔ dɔ le asiwò.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: Mado wò awu nɛ, eye matsɔ wò alidziblanu abla ali dzi nɛ. Matsɔ ŋusẽ si metsɔ na wò la ana eyama. Anye tɔ na Yerusalemnɔlawo kple Yuda-to la siaa.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Matsɔ David ƒe ƒome la ƒe safui ade esi. Ne eʋu nane la, ame aɖeke matui o, eye ne etu nane la, ame aɖeke maʋui o.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Mana wòanɔ te ɖe enɔƒe sesĩe abe tsyoti ene, eye wòazu bubufiazikpui na tɔgbuia ƒe aƒe.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: Ke eƒe ƒometɔwo, viawo kple viawo ƒe viwo kpakple ƒomenya kukluiwo katã azu agba nɛ abe agba alo goewoe le tsyoti ŋu ene.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be gbe ma gbe la, tsyoti si woƒo ɖi sesĩe la, aglí, aŋe, eye wòage adze anyi. Agba si le eŋu la akaka gbẽe elabe Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.”

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Gbedeasi tso Tiro ŋu. Ao, mi Tarsis-tɔdziʋuwo, mifa konyi elabe Tiro zu aƒedo, eye aƒe alo ʋudzeƒemɔ aɖeke megali o. Woɖee fia wo le Kipro-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Mi ƒutatɔwo kple Sidon-sitsalawo, mi ame siwo zɔa atsiaƒu dzi, mizi ɖoɖoe kpoo!

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo to ƒu, ƒuwo dzi, hetsɔ Sixor ƒe nukuwo kple Nil ƒe agblemenuwo va eme, eye wòzu dukɔwo ƒe asiɖiƒe.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Sidon, ŋu nekpe wò elabe atsiaƒu ƒo nu, atsiaƒu ƒe mɔ́ sesẽ le gbɔgblɔm be: “Fu meɖum o; nyemedzi vi o, nyemenyi ɖekakpui kple ɖetugbiwo wotsi o.”

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Ne Egiptetɔwo see la, woaxa nu le nu si wose tso Tiro ŋu la ta.

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Miaƒe dzidzɔdu si dzɔ tso blema ke lae nye esia? Eƒe afɔ kplɔe yi didiƒe wòɖatsi afi ma.

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Ame kae ɖo nu sia ɖe Tiro si ɖɔa fiakuku na ame la ŋu? Eƒe asitsalawo nye amegãwo, eye eƒe adzɔdolawo nye ame ŋkutawo le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae ɖoe be yeado ŋukpe dàdatsyɔ̃ɖoɖowo katã, eye yeaɖe bubu le ame ŋkutawo ŋu le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Wò Tarsis vinyɔnu, ɖɔ nàgbã go ɖe wò anyigba dzi abe Nil-tɔsisi ene; ame aɖeke maxe mɔ na wò o.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Eyae do asi ɖe atsiaƒu dzi, eye wòʋuʋu fiaɖuƒewo. Aƒetɔ ɖe gbe ɖe Kanaan ŋu be wonegbã eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: “Wò Sidon-ɖetugbi, wogblẽ wò, màgakpɔ dzidzɔ azɔ o. Tso nàyi Kipro, afi ma gɔ̃ hã màkpɔ gbɔdzɔe o.”

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Kpɔ Kaldeatɔwo ƒe anyigba la ɖa! Ame mawo menye dukɔ tsã o. Asiriatɔwoe wɔ wo wozu dukɔ. Woawo kee wɔ Tiro wòzu gbemelãwo nɔƒe. Wotu xɔ tsralawo, gbã eƒe fiasãwo hegblẽe wozu glikpo.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Mi Tarsis-tɔdziʋuwo, mifa konyi elabe wogbã miaƒe mɔ́ sesẽ la.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: “Wò gbolo si woŋlɔ be, tsɔ kasaŋku nàtsa le dua me godoo. Ƒo ha viviwo; dzi ha geɖewo ne woagaɖo ŋku dziwò!”

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke woatsɔ eƒe viɖe kple gboloho asubɔ Aƒetɔ. Womali kɔe ɖi alo aɖo tɔ ɖe enu o; ke boŋ eƒe nukpɔkpɔ ahe nuɖuɖu fũu kple nutata nyuiwo avɛ na Aƒetɔ subɔlawo.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ agblẽ anyigba; ana wòaɖi gbɔlo. Atrɔ eŋkume abu anyi, eye wòaka edzinɔlawo ahlẽ.

english_verse: including ordinary people and priests, slaves and slave owners, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, the rich and the poor.
translation_verse: Anɔ na dukɔmetɔ abe nunɔla ene, dɔlaŋutsu abe aƒetɔ ene, dɔlanyɔnu abe aƒenɔ ene, nuƒlela abe nudzrala ene, agbanatɔ abe nugbanadola ene, fenyila abe fetɔ ene.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Woagblẽ anyigba wòaɖi gbɔlo ƒiaƒiaƒia; woahae keŋkeŋ. Aƒetɔ ye gblɔ nya sia.

english_verse: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
translation_verse: Anyigba le nu xam, eye wòyrɔ; nu te xexea me ŋu, eye wòle dɔ̃ɔ. Xexemebubumewo le konyi fam.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Wogblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba to edzinɔlawo dzi, elabe woda seawo dzi. Womewɔ ɖe ɖoɖoawo nu o, eye wotu nubabla mavɔ la.

english_verse: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
translation_verse: Eya ta fiƒode le anyigba ŋu ɖim, eye edzinɔlawo le fu kpem ɖe woƒe fɔɖiɖi ta. Eya ta, anyigbadzitɔwo afiã keŋkeŋ, eye gbetɔ ʋɛ aɖe ko asusɔ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Wain yeye ano ƒiaƒiaƒia, wainka ayrɔ, dzidzɔkpɔlawo katã aɖe hũ.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Asiʋuiwo ƒe vivisese nu tso; dzidzɔkpɔlawo ƒe hoowɔwɔ nu tsi, eye kasaŋkuwo ƒe vivisese hã nu tso.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Womagadzi ha ɖe wain nono ŋu o, eye aha muame ave le nu me na enolawo.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Wogbã du ɖigbɔlo la, aƒe ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ʋɔwo le tutu; womagate ŋu age ɖe wo me o.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Wole konyi fam le ablɔwo me be wain vɔ; dzidzɔkpɔkpɔwo katã nu yi, vivisese bu le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Du la zu aƒedo, eye wogbã agboawo wokaka keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Elabe alea ye wòava nɔ le anyigba dzi dukɔwo dome. Anɔ abe ale si woʋuʋua amiti, eye woxaa nu mamlɛtɔ, ne wainxaxa nu va yi lae ene.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Wokɔ woƒe gbe dzi dzi ha kple dzidzɔ. Wodo ɣli tso ɣetoɖoƒe ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe gãnyenye fia.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Eya ta mikafu Aƒetɔ le ɣedzeƒe; mikafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋkɔ le ƒukpowo dzi!

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Míese kafukafu kple bubu hawo tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo na Dzɔdzɔetɔ la. Ke nye ya megblɔ be: “Baba nam! Baba nam! Medɔ̃! Elabe amegɔmezɔlawo le ame gɔme zɔm. Amegɔmezɔlawo le ame gɔme zɔm vevie.”

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: Wò anyigbadzinɔla, ŋɔdzi, ʋe kple mɔ̀ka le lalawòm.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Ame si se ŋɔdzi ŋkɔ hesí la, age adze ʋe me; ame si do le ʋe me la, mɔ̀ aɖee. Elabe woʋu dziƒofesrewo, eye anyigba ƒe gɔmeɖoɖowo dzo kpèkpekpe.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Anyigba fé, wó, ele ʋuʋum keɖekeɖe.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Anyigba le ya mum abe ahamula ene, eye wòle nyenyem abe agblexɔe le ya nu ene. Elabe eƒe dzidadawo zu agba nɛ. Edze anyi; magafɔ o.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, Aƒetɔ ahe to na dziƒoʋakɔwo le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi fiawo le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Woaƒo fiawo katã nu ƒu abe gamenɔlawo ene ɖe do me. Woatu wo ɖe gaxɔ me ɖe afi ma, eye le ŋkeke geɖe megbe la, woahe to na wo.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Ekema ɣleti ƒe nu aku, eye ŋukpe alé ɣe elabe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la aɖu fia le Zion-to la dzi kple Yerusalem, eye wòaɖe eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe afia eƒe ame tsitsiwo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye Mawue nènye. Mado wò ɖe dzi, eye makafu wò ŋkɔ. Elabe èwɔ nukunuwo. Ɖoɖo siwo nèwɔ gbe aɖe gbe ke la, kakaɖedzi le wo ŋu; mètrɔ ɖeke o.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Elabe èna du la zu glikpo, eye nègbã eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo. Amedzrowo ƒe fiasã megali o; womagatui akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: Eya ta dukɔ sesẽwo akafu wò, eye dukɔ wɔadãwo avɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Elabe mɔ́ sesẽ nènye na ame beliwo, sitsoƒe na hiãtɔwo le xaxa me, beɖoƒe le dziya nu kple vɔvɔli le ŋdɔkutsu nu. Ŋutasẽlawo ƒe gbɔgbɔ fuxefuxe le abe ale si yatsi ƒoa glie ene.

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: Ète amedzrowo ƒe nyanyra ɖe to, abe ŋdɔkutsu le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi ene, eye nètsi ŋutasẽlawo ƒe aseyetsotso nu, abe ale si vɔvɔli nana be anyinu fana le ŋdɔkutsu nu ene. Mawu ɖo nuɖukplɔ̃

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la aɖo nuɖukplɔ̃ gã aɖe na dukɔwo katã le to sia dzi. Nuɖuɖu viviwo kple wain si woda ɖi eteƒe didi; nuɖuɖu vivi siwo me ƒutomemi le kple wain siwo nɔ anyi dedie, eye wo me dza la.

english_verse: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
translation_verse: Le to sia dzi la, aklo nu si wotsyɔ dukɔwo katã dzi kple motsyɔnu si wokeke ɖe dukɔwo katã dzi la ɖa.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Atsrɔ̃ ku Saɖagatsi ɖa tegbee. Ekema Aƒetɔ Mawu atutu aɖatsi ɖa le mo na ame sia ame, eye wòaɖe etɔwo ƒe ŋukpe ɖa le xexea me godoo. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Woagblɔ gbe ma gbe be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mía Mawu lae nye esi. Eyae míekpɔ mɔ na be axɔ na mí. Eyae nye Aƒetɔ si míekpɔ mɔ na. Mina míatso aseye, eye míakpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe xɔname ta.” Mawu ahe to na Moab

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe asi anɔ to sia dzi; ke afanya Moab ɖe enɔƒe abe ale si wofanyaa nutsro ɖe aɖukpo dzi ene.

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: Akeke abɔ me abe tsiƒula ene, eye wòate eƒe dàda kple eƒe asi siwo wɔa nu ayetɔe la ɖe to.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Amu eƒe gli kɔkɔ sesẽawo ƒu anyi, eye wòana woazu kewɔ ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, woadzi ha sia le Yuda-nyigba dzi be: “Du sesẽ aɖe le mía si! Exɔna na ame abe gli kple kpɔ sesẽ ene.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Miʋu agboawo be dukɔ dzɔdzɔe, nuteƒewɔla la nage ɖe eme.

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖoa ŋu ɖe ŋuwò la, ènana be wòkpɔa ŋutifafa blibo elabe eɖoa dzi ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ka ɖe Aƒetɔ dzi tegbee elabe Aƒetɔ, ẽ, Aƒetɔ nye agakpe si li tegbee.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Elabe ebɔbɔ kɔkɔƒenɔlawo ɖe anyi; eɖiɖi du kɔkɔ la ɖe anyi; emui ƒu anyi, eye wòtsɔe ƒu ʋuʋudedi me.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Ezu afɔɖodzinu na ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo be woafanyae.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe toƒe le tẽe. Wò Dzɔdzɔetɔ lae wɔe be ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe mɔ dzi sɔ.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, míekpɔ mɔ na wò le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe mɔ dzi. Wò ŋkɔ mavɔ kple bubudede wò ŋkɔ ŋu dim míaƒe luʋɔwo le.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ dia wò le zã me, eye nye gbɔgbɔ dia wò vevie tso ememe ke. Ne wò nyametsotso va anyigba dzi la, xexea me tɔwo srɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ne wove ame vɔ̃ɖi nu la, mesrɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ o; ke ewɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi le ame dzɔdzɔewo dome le anyigba dzi. Medzea si Aƒetɔ ƒe gãnyenye o.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò alɔ le dzi, ke womele ekpɔm o. Na woakpɔ ale si nètsɔa dzo ɖe wò dukɔ ŋui la ɖa, ne ŋu nakpe wo vevie. Na dzo nafiã wò ketɔwo.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, àna ŋutifafa mí elabe èxɔ míaƒe dɔwo katã ƒu akɔ hewu wo nu na mí.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu, aƒetɔ bubuwo ɖu mía dzi kpɔ kpe ɖe ŋuwò. Ke wò ɖeɖe kple wò ŋkɔ ko míakafu.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Ne ame ku la, megagbɔa agbe o, eye ame kuku mefɔna o, elabe èhe to na wo hetsrɔ̃ wo, eye nètutu woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Gake Aƒetɔ, èna wò dukɔ la dzi ɖe edzi. Èna dukɔ la keke ta. Ède bubu ɖokuiwò ŋu, eye èkeke anyigba la ƒe liƒowo ɖe enu.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, le xaxa me la, wodi wò kpekpeɖeŋu. Ne èhe to na wo la, wodoa gbe ɖa na wò.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ale si funɔ léa ku, doa ɣli ne eƒe vidziɣi ɖo la, Aƒetɔ, nenemae míenɔ le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Míefɔ fu, fu ɖu mí, eye míedzi vi baa; ke ya ko wònye míedzi. Míeɖe vi na anyigba la o, elabe ame medzɔ ɖe xexea me o.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Wò ame kukuwo agbɔ agbe! Woƒe ŋutilãwo afɔ. Mi ame siwo le ʋuʋudedi me, minyɔ ne miadzi dzidzɔha. Elabe wò zãmu nye kekeli ƒe ahũ. Àna wòadza ɖe anyigba si dzi vɔvɔli do ɖo la dzi. Mawu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu, agbugbɔ nuwo aɖɔ ɖo

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ, miva, mige ɖe miaƒe xɔgãwo me ne miado ʋɔ ɖe mia ɖokui nu. Mibè vie, se ɖe esime dziku la nu nayi.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ do tso enɔƒe gbɔna be wòahe to na anyigbadzitɔwo ɖe woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta. Anyigba aklo nu ɖa le ʋu si wokɔ ɖe edzi la dzi, eye magate ŋu aɣla ame siwo wowu ɖe edzi la o.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ atsɔ eƒe yi dziŋɔ, gã, sesẽ la ahe to na Livyatan, da si le sisím la; Livyatan, da si le yiyim gɔdɔgɔdɔ̃ la, eye wòawu ƒumeʋɔdriba la.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la: “Midzi ha le waingble nyo la ŋu be:

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: Nye Aƒetɔ ŋutɔe nye edzikpɔla. Medea tsii ɣe sia ɣi. Medzɔa eŋu zã kple keli ale be naneke nagawɔe o.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Nyemekpɔ dziku ɖe wainbɔ la ŋu o. Ne mekpɔ aŋɔka kple ŋuwo le eme la, maho aʋa ɖe wo ŋu atɔ dzo wo woafiã.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Negbe ɖeko woava sim atso, eye woawɔ ŋutifafa kplim hafi! Ŋutifafa ko woawɔ kplim hafi!”
