english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke siwo gbɔna me la, Yakob ato kè. Israel adzè alɔwo, aƒo se, eye eƒe kutsetse axɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɖe wòƒo Israel abe ale si wòƒo eƒolawo enea? Alo ɖe wòwui abe ale si wòwu ame siwo wòwu la enea?

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Ʋɛʋɛʋɛ la, èwɔ avu kpli wo, kplɔ wo yi aboyo me. Èɖe wo ɖa kple dziku gbe si gbe ɣedzeƒeya ʋuduʋudu la ƒo.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Eya ta mɔ sia dzi ko woato atsɔ Yakob ƒe vodada akee, eye wòanye nuvɔ̃ si wotsɔ kee la ƒe viɖe: Ele be woagbã vɔsamlekpuia ƒe kpewo katã, atu wo abe akalo ene, eye woaɖe nyɔnumawu Aserawo kple ɣelegbawo ɖa.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Elabe du sesẽ la ɖi gbɔlo; ame nɔƒe zu aƒedo. Wogblẽe ɖi abe gbedadaƒo ene. Afi mae nyiviwo ɖua gbe le, eye wotsyɔa akɔ ɖo heɖua atilɔwo klíklikli.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Ne eƒe alɔwo ƒu la, woŋea wo, ale nyɔnuwo va tɔa dzo wo. Elabe dukɔ madzesinu wonye, eya ta ame si wɔ wo la, makpɔ nublanui na wo o, eye ame si mè wo la, mave wo nu o.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ aƒo luwo nu ƒu tso Frat-tɔsisi la nu va se ɖe Egipte-tɔʋu la nu, eye woafɔ mi Israelviwo ɖekaɖeka aƒo ƒui.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Woaku kpẽ gã aɖe ɣe ma ɣi, eye Israelvi siwo katã bu ɖe Asiria-nyigba dzi kple esiwo kaka ɖe Egipte-nyigba dzi la, woava subɔ Aƒetɔ le to kɔkɔe la dzi le Yerusalem.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Baba na dziɖula ahamula siwo dàna le Efrayim kple eƒe atsyɔ̃seƒoƒo dzeani si ɖi golo la. Baba na ahamula siwo le to dzi le bali wɔnu tame.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nu sesẽ kako tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ gbɔna. Ava abe tsikpe ƒe dzadza kple ahom si gblẽa nu ene. Atsɔ ŋusẽ aƒoe aƒu anyi, abe tsie ɖɔ gbagba ɖe anyi ene.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Woafanya ahamula si le Efrayim la ƒe dàdafiakuku kple afɔ.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: Ava eme be eƒe atsyɔ̃seƒoƒo dzeani si ɖi golo, eye wòle to dzi le bali wɔnu tame la, anɔ abe gbotsetse si ɖi gbã hafi dzomeŋɔli ɖo ene. Ame si kpɔe la, aɖui alɔ tsɔtsɔe.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la anye atsyɔ̃kuku kple ŋgonublanu dzeani na eƒe dukɔ si susɔ.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ana ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe ƒe gbɔgbɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, eye wòana ŋusẽ ame siwo nyàa futɔwo, trɔa aʋa ɖo ɖe megbe le dua ƒe agbo nu. Yesaya kple gbeƒãɖela ahamulawo tso Yuda

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Elabe wotru kɔ ɖe kplɔ̃awo katã dzi nyamaa, teƒe aɖeke megali o; afi sia afi le ŋu nyɔm.

english_verse: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord's message?
translation_verse: “Ame kae wòle nunya fia gee, eye ame kae wòle gbedeasi la gɔme ɖe ge na? Ɖevi si ɖi no ye loo, alo esi wotso no na la yea?

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: Elabe egblɔ be: Se ɖe se dzi; se ɖe se dzie. Ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu; ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nue. Afii ʋɛ; afi mɛ ʋɛ.”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Aƒetɔ atsɔ gbe bubu gblɔlawo ƒe gbe kple ame siwo kɔkɔna ƒe aɖe aƒo nu na dukɔ sia.

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Dzudzɔ nye esi, migbɔ ɖe eme, mi ame siwo ŋu ɖeɖi te, miɖi ɖe eme!” Ke wogbe nusese.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Eya ta mi fewuɖula siwo le dukɔ sia dzi ɖum le Yerusalem, mise Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe:

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Elabe miegblɔ be: “Míebla nu kple ku, eye míenyi dzo kple tsiẽƒe. Ameƒoti si le nyenyem le yiyim la maɖo mía gbɔ o, elabe míetsɔ aʋatso wɔ míaƒe sitsoƒee, eye míebè ɖe alakpa gbɔ.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mele gɔmeɖokpe aɖe ɖom anyi ɖe Zion; kpe si wodo kpɔ, dzogoedzikpe xɔasi, gɔmeɖoɖo si li ke zã. ‘Ame si xɔe se la, matsi dzi o’.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: Matsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe awɔ dzidzekae, eye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ anye glidzidzenu. Tsikpe atsrɔ̃ aʋatsositsoƒe la, eye tsi akplɔ beɖoƒe la adzoe.”

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Ekema mia kple ku ƒe nubabla me agblẽ, eye mia kple tsiẽƒe ƒe dzonyinyi la hã mali ke o. Ameƒoti si le nyenyem le yiyim la, agbã mi gudugudu.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Ne eva le yiyim la, eƒe asi axe mi kã, elabe ava yi ŋdi sia ŋdi le ŋkeke me kple zã me, eye eƒe ŋɔdzi ɖeɖe ana miase nyawo gɔme.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ akɔ eɖokui ɖe dzi abe ale si wòwɔe le Perazim-to la gbɔ ene. Anyra abe ale si wònyrae le Gibeon-bali me la ene; ne wòawɔ eƒe dɔ, dɔ tɔxɛ ye nye eƒe dɔ la; ne wòawɔ eƒe nuwɔna, nukunue nye eƒe nuwɔna la.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Azɔ la, megaɖi kokoe na mi, ne woava bla mi sesĩe goŋgoŋ wu o. Elabe mese Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ɖoe kplikpaa be yeatsrɔ̃ anyigba blibo la. Mawu ƒe nunya

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Miɖo to, ne miase nye gbe. Milé to ɖe nye nyawo ŋu nyuie.

english_verse: Farmers don't just plow and break up the ground.
translation_verse: Ðe agbledela nɔa nuŋɔŋlɔ dzi ɖaa be wòaƒã nua? Ɖe wòdzraa anyigba ɖo hedzobonɛ ɖaa?

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Alo ne edzobo anyigba vɔ, ɖe mewua ahaliwɔe kple pepre ɖe eme, heƒãa lu kple ƒo ɖe fli me, eye woƒãa bli ɖe liƒo dzi oa?

english_verse: They learn this from their God.
translation_verse: Eƒe Mawu fia nui, eye wòdae ɖe mɔ nyuitɔ dzi.

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Elabe menye luƒotasiaɖam wotsɔna ƒoa ahaliwɔe o, eye womemlia tasiaɖamfɔ toa pepre dzi o; ke boŋ kpo sue wotsɔna ƒoa ahaliwɔe, eye ati sue wotsɔna ƒoa pepree.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Ɖe wotua lu tsɔna ƒoa aboloe; ke wometonɛ ɖaa o. Ne tasiaɖam kple sɔwo zɔ edzi hã la, metua wɔ o.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Esia hã Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la gbɔe wòtso. Enye ame si dea adaŋu nukutɔe, eye nunya deto le esi.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Ao, Ariel, Ariel, baba! Du si me David ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖo kpɔ! Mina ƒè nadze ƒè yome, eye miaɖu ŋkekenyui ɖe ɖoɖo nu,

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: ekema Ariel naɖo xaxa me. Konyifafa kple hũɖeɖe anɔ anyi, eye wòanɔ nam ko abe Ariel ene.

english_verse: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
translation_verse: Maƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe ŋuwò godoo. Mana aʋakɔwo namimi wò ɖo, eye mana asrafowo naƒo kpo kɔkɔwo ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ava gbɔwò kple dziɖegbe, anyigbaʋuʋu, gbeɖiɖi, yali, ahomya kple dzobibi.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe ameha siwo katã ho aʋa ɖe Ariel ŋu kple ame siwo katã tso ɖe eya kple eƒe mɔ́ sesẽ la ŋu, eye woɖaxaxae ɖo la, anɔ abe drɔ̃ekuku kple ŋutegakpɔkpɔ le zã me ene.

english_verse: Those nations that attack Mount Zion will suffer from hunger and thirst. They will dream of food and drink but wake up weary and hungry and thirsty as ever. Prophets Who Fool Themselves
translation_verse: Ale si dɔwuitɔ kua drɔ̃e be yele nu ɖum, ke wònyɔna kple dɔwuamee, eye ale si tsikɔwuitɔ kua drɔ̃e be yele tsi nom, ke wòfɔna kudɔkudɔ, eye eƒe ve me ƒuna kplakplakplae la, nenemae dukɔ siwo katã ho aʋa ɖe Zion-toa ŋu la, anɔ. Dukɔ la gbe nusese

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Mido aso mia ɖokui, ne miazu asotɔwo. Mimia ŋku, ne miazu ŋkunɔwo. Mimu aha; ke menye wain o. Minɔ yiyim sagasaga, ke menye aha sesẽ ye wɔe o.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ trɔ alɔ̃ kpekpe ƒe gbɔgbɔ kɔ ɖe mia dzi. Etre miaƒe ŋku, siwo nye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo la, eye wòtsyɔ nu miaƒe ta, siwo nye nukpɔlawo la.

english_verse: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, “We can't read it, because it's sealed.”
translation_verse: Ale ŋutegawo katã va zu na mi abe agbalẽ si nu wotre la me nyawo ene. Ne wotsɔe na agbalẽnyala, hegblɔ nɛ be: “Xlẽe” la, agblɔ be: “Nyemate ŋui o, elabe wotre enu.”

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Ne wotsɔe na agbalẽmanyala be: “Xlẽe” la, agblɔ be: “Nyemate ŋu axlẽe o.”

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be: “Dukɔ sia vaa gbɔnye kple woƒe nu, eye wodea bubu ŋunye kple woƒe nuyi, ke woƒe dzi le adzɔge tso gbɔnye. Ɖeko wosrɔ̃e le amewo gbɔ be yewoasubɔm susu manɔmee.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Eya ta kpɔ ɖa, magaɖe nukunu geɖe afia dukɔ sia; nukunuwo ƒe nukunu wòanye. Nunya abu ɖe woƒe nunyalawo, eye nugɔmesese así abè ɖe woƒe nugɔmeselawo.” Mɔkpɔkpɔ gbɔna

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo bèna le Aƒetɔ, woƒe aɖaŋuɖola ŋkume, be yewoawɔ ɖoɖo ne wòaganya o. Wowɔa nu le vivime hegblɔna be: “Ame kae le mía kpɔm? Ame kae nya mí?”

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Mietrɔ nuwo ƒe ta tu. Ɖe tsu le abe zemela ene, ne nuwɔwɔ nagblɔ na ewɔla be: “Menye wòe wɔm o,” eye numeme nagblɔ na emela be: “Wò ya mele ɖeke me sem o” mahã?

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Ɖe mesusɔ vie ko ne Lebanon natrɔ zu atibɔ, eye woabu atibɔ ɖe avewo dome oa?

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, tokunɔwo ase agbalẽa me nyawo, eye ŋkunɔwo akpɔ nu le blukɔ kple viviti me.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ame fatuwo akpɔ dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ ŋu, agakpɔe ake, eye ame siwo da ahe wu le amegbetɔwo dome la, atso aseye ɖe Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Elabe ŋutasẽlawo avɔ ɖa, fewuɖulawo nu ayi, eye ame siwo katã bua nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋuti la, woatsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: Woawoe nye ame siwo blea ame dea nya me le ʋɔnu, ame siwo trea mɔ̀ na nyadrɔ̃la le ʋɔnu, eye wotsɔa alakpa bua fɔ ame si ƒe nya dzɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ, ame si ɖe Abraham la gblɔ le Yakob ƒe ƒome la ŋu be: “Ŋu magakpe Yakob azɔ o, eye eƒe mo magayi to o.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Elabe ne ekpɔ via siwo nye nye asinudɔwɔwɔwo le wo dome la, woakɔ nye ŋkɔ ŋuti; woakɔ Yakob ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ŋuti, eye woavɔ̃ Israel ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Ame siwo tra le gbɔgbɔ me la, ase nu gɔme, eye ame siwo lia liʋiliʋĩ la, woasrɔ̃ nunya.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Baba na vi dzeaglã siwo wɔa ɖoɖo siwo menye tɔnye o, eye woɖoa habɔbɔ si me nye gbɔgbɔ mele o, ne woadzi nuvɔ̃ ɖe nuvɔ̃ dzi.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Ame siwo mebiaa mɔm hafi yia Egipte o be yewoasi Egipte Fiagã ƒe ŋusẽ atso, eye woabè ɖe Egipte ƒe vɔvɔli te.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Elabe togbɔ be eƒe amegãwo le Zoan, eye eƒe amedɔdɔwo de Xanes hã la,

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Gbedeasi ɖe anyigbemekegbegbe ƒe lãwo ŋu: To hiãkame kple xaxa ƒe anyigba dzi, afi si dzatanɔ kple dzatatsu, dzakpata kple da si dzòna la le. Afi mae wotsɔa woƒe nuwo ɖoa tedziwo dzi kple woƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖoa kposɔwo ƒe medome tsonɛ, heɖoa ta dukɔ si gbɔ womakpɔ viɖe aɖeke le o la gbɔ.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Egipte ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu mele ɖeke me o, eya ta meyɔe be: “Ʋɔdriba si mate ŋu aʋã o.” Dukɔ masetonu la

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Azɔ la yi nàŋlɔe ɖe nuŋlɔkpe dzi le wo ŋkume, eye nàŋlɔe ɖe agbalẽ me, ne wòanye ɖaseɖiɖi mavɔ le ɣeyiɣi si gbɔna la me.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Elabe dukɔ dzeaglã wonye, vi siwo daa alakpa, ɖevi siwo gbe Aƒetɔ ƒe nufiame la wonye.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Woawoe gblɔna na nukpɔlawo be: “Migakpɔ nu o,” eye wogblɔna na Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo be: “Migaɖe gbeƒã nu si le eteƒe la na mí o; ke boŋ mivivi nu me na mí, migblɔ ameflunyawo faa.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Mite ɖa le mɔ la dzi; mihe ɖa le toƒe la, migana míase Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe nya aɖeke azɔ o.”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Eya ta Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la gblɔ be: “Esi miegbe nya sia, eye mieɖo ŋu ɖe ameteɖeanyi kple ayedzedze ŋuti heziɔ ɖe wo ŋu ta la,

english_verse: This sin is like a crack that makes a high wall quickly crumble
translation_verse: miaƒe vodada sia anɔ na mi abe gli kɔkɔ fefe si tre azã be yeamu la ene. Eƒe mumu ava eme, zi ɖeka kpata.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Eƒe gbagbã anɔ abe ale si zemela ƒe ze gbãna gudugudu, eye ze kakɛ aɖeke masusɔ wòatsɔ aɖe dzo le mlekpui me alo aku tsi le vudo mee o la ene.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la be: “Miakpɔ xɔxɔ, ne mietrɔ dzime, eye mienɔ anyi kpoo. Miakpɔ ŋusẽ, ne miezi ɖoɖoe, eye mieɖo ŋu ɖe ŋunye.” Ke miegbe.

english_verse: said, “No! We will safely escape on speedy horses.” But those who chase you will be even faster.
translation_verse: Miegblɔ be: “Kpao, míado sɔwo sesĩe, así adzo.” Eya ta mianya sí baa. “Míanɔ sɔ ɖiduwo dzi.” Ke mia yometilawo aƒu du sesĩe wu mi.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Ame akpe ɖeka así le ame ɖeka pɛ ƒe vɔvɔ̃doname nu, eye miasí le ame atɔ̃ ƒe vɔvɔ̃doname nu, va se ɖe esime miasusɔ abe aflagati le to tame, abe dzesi le togbɛ dzi ene.

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ le mia si nu kpɔm be yeave mia nu, ale wòtso be yeakpɔ nublanui na mi elabe Aƒetɔ la, Mawu nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla wònye. Woayra ame siwo katã kpɔa esi nu. Mawu ayra eƒe dukɔ

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: O, Zion-dukɔ, si le Yerusalem, migafa avi azɔ o. Ave mia nu godoo le miaƒe ɣlidodo ta. Ne esee ko la, atɔ na mi.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Aƒetɔ la na nuɖuɖu mi le hiã me, eye wòna tsi mi le xaxa me hã la, miaƒe Nufiala magaɣla eɖokui azɔ o; ke boŋ miakpɔ miaƒe Nufiala kple ŋku.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Ne mietrɔ ɖe ɖusime alo miame la, miaƒe to ase nya sia le mia megbe be: “Mɔ lae nye esi; mito edzi.”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Miado gu klosalo siwo wofa ɖe miaƒe aklama kpakpɛwo kple sika si le miaƒe legbawo ŋu. Miakaka wo abe ŋunyɔnuwo ene ahagblɔ be: “Midzo!”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Ana tsi nadza ɖe miaƒe agblemenuku siwo mieƒã la dzi, eye nuɖuɖu si tso anyigba me la, asɔ gbɔ, avivi. Ɣe ma ɣi la, miaƒe lãwo aɖu gbe le lãnyiƒe gbadzawo.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu si wotsaka kple dze, eye wotsɔ sofi kple gaflo gã blui la, eyae nyitsu kple tedzi siwo ŋlɔa agble la aɖu.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe woawu ame fũu, eye mɔ́ kɔkɔwo amu la, tɔʋumetsiwo anɔ tsatsam le to kɔkɔwo kple togbɛ kɔkɔ ɖe sia ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Gawu la, gbe si gbe Aƒetɔ abla eƒe dukɔ ƒe abi si wòxɔ, eye wòada gbe le abi siwo wòde eŋu ŋu la, ɣleti ƒe keklẽ anɔ abe ɣe tɔ ene, eye ɣe ƒe keklẽ adzi ɖe edzi zigbɔzi adrẽ abe ŋkeke adrẽ ƒe keklẽ woƒo ƒui ene. Mawu ahe to na Asiria

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ tso didiƒe ʋĩi gbɔna; eƒe dɔmedzoe le bibim kple dzudzɔ babla kɔtɔɔ. Eƒe nuyiwo dzi yɔ fũu kple dziku, eye eƒe aɖe le abe dzo binu ene.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: Eƒe gbɔgbɔ le abe tɔɖɔɖɔ si me woase ve le ene, ne wòasra dukɔwo kple tsɔtsrɔ̃ ƒe sranu, eye wòade numega si akplɔ wo trae la woƒe nu me.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Miadzi ha abe le ŋkekenyui ɖuɣi ƒe zã me ene. Miaƒe dzi atso aseye abe ame si le zɔzɔm ɖe dzekuku nu yina ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe to la dzi, Israel ƒe agakpe la gbɔ ene.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ana woase eƒe fiagbe la, eye woakpɔ eƒe alɔ sesẽ si wòɖiɖi ɖe anyi le dɔmedzoe helihelĩ, dzobibi flaflafla, tsidzadza gã kple ahom kpakple tsikpewo me.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Elabe ne Aƒetɔ ɖe gbe la, dzidzi aƒo Asiriatɔwo. Aƒo wo kple eƒe ameƒoti la.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Zi geɖe ale si toheti si Aƒetɔ ɖo ɖe eŋu adze edzii la, zi geɖe ma ke asiʋuiwo kple kasaŋkuwo anɔ ɖiɖimee. Aƒetɔ ƒe alɔ anɔ dzi eye wòawɔ aʋa kplii.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Elabe wodzra dzotɔƒe aɖe ɖi xoxo. Wodzrae ɖo ɖi na fia la. Egoglo, eye wòkeke. Dzo kple nakekɔ li fũu. Aƒetɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ si le abe aŋɔtɔʋu ene la atɔ dzoe.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Baba na ame siwo yia Egipte be woakpe ɖe yewo ŋu. Woɖoa ŋu ɖe sɔwo ŋu, eye woɖoa dzi ɖe tasiaɖamwo ŋu elabe wosɔ gbɔ. Woɖoa dzi ɖe sɔdolawo ŋu elabe wosesẽ ŋutɔ; ke wometrɔna ɖe Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ŋu alo dia Aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Evɔ eya hã la, nunyala wònye, eye wòhea dzɔgbevɔ̃e vɛ. Metrɔna le eƒe nya yome o; ke boŋ atsi tre ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aƒe ŋu kple ame siwo kpena ɖe nu tovo wɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Azɔ Egiptetɔwo la, amegbetɔwo wonye; womenye Mawu o. Woƒe sɔwo la, ŋutilã wonye; womenye gbɔgbɔ o. Ne Mawu do eƒe asi ɖa la, dzidzi ƒoa kpeɖeŋutɔ la, eye ame si ŋu wòle kpekpem ɖo la hã adze anyi. Ale wo kple eve la siaa atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: Abe ale si dzata alo dzatavi nɔa nu si wòlé la gbɔ nɔa gbe tem, eye ne woyɔ alẽkplɔlawo ɖe eŋu fũu hã, woƒe ɣli meɖea dzi le eƒo o, eye meɖoa to woƒe hoowɔwɔ o ene la, nenemae Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la aɖi va, bene wòawɔ aʋa le Zion-to kple eƒe togbɛ la dzi.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Abe ale si xeviwo saa agbae ene la, nenema Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la adzɔ Yerusalem ŋui. Adzɔ eŋu, eye wòaɖee. Alé be nɛ, eye wòaxɔ nɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi Israelviwo, migatrɔ ɖe ame si ŋu miedze aglã ɖo vevie la ŋu.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Elabe ɣe ma ɣi la, ame sia ame atsɔ eƒe klosalolegba kple sikalegba siwo miaƒe asiwo wɔ le nuvɔ̃ me na mi la, aƒu gbe.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: “Ekema Asiriatɔ la atsi yi nu, ke manye amegbetɔ ƒe yi nu o. Yi aɖe avuvui, ke menye amegbetɔ tɔ o. Así le yia nu, eye woazi eƒe ɖekakpuiwo dzi be woawɔ dɔ sesẽ.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Eƒe agakpe la ate ɖa le ŋɔdzi ta, eye eƒe amegãwo adzo nyànyanya le aflaga la ŋgɔ.” Aƒetɔ, ame si ƒe dzo le Zion, eye eƒe kpodzo le Yerusalem lae gblɔe.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame anɔ abe beɖoƒe tso yaƒoƒo nu ene. Woanɔ abe tɔʋuwo le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi kple agakpe gã ƒe vɔvɔli le anyigba si nu ti kɔ na la dzi ene.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Ale nukpɔlawo ƒe ŋku magatsi o, eye nuselawo ƒe to ase nu.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Ame mabutamewo ƒe susu adze si nyateƒe, eye kɔkɔlawo ƒe aɖe aƒo nu nyuie eme nakɔ.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Womagayɔ movitɔwo be bubumewo azɔ o, eye womagayɔ ame drawo be ame ŋkutawo o.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Elabe movitɔ la, movinya ko wògblɔna, eƒe dzi susua nu gbegblẽ: ne wòawɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ agblɔ nya trama ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu; enana be dɔwuitɔwo tsia dɔmeɣi, eye wòtea tsi tsikɔwuitɔwo.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Ame dra ɖoa tame vɔ̃; edea adaŋu vɔ̃ be yeatsɔ alakpanya agblẽ ame dahewoe, nenye be hiãtɔ ƒe nya dzɔ gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke bubume wɔa ɖoɖo vavãwo, eye wòzɔna ɖe ɖoɖo vavãawo nu. Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple nuwo gbugbɔ ɖo te nu

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Mitso, mi nyɔnu siwo le vovo me, mise nye gbe. Milé to ɖe nye nyawo ŋu, mi vinyɔnu siwo dzea mia ɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Le ƒe ɖeka kple ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo megbe la, mi nyɔnu siwo dzea mia ɖokui ŋu, miadzo nyànyanya, elabe waintseɣi nu ayi, eye kutsetsegbeɣi mava o.

english_verse: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.
translation_verse: Dzidzi neƒo mi, mi nyɔnu siwo le vovo me. Midzo nyànyanya, mi vinyɔnu siwo dzea mia ɖokui ŋu! Miɖe avɔ ɖi, mianɔ amama, eye miasa akpanya ɖe ali!

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Miƒo akɔta le agble siwo nyo kple waintsetsewo ta.

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: Ŋuwo kple aŋɔkawo mie ɖe nye dukɔ la ƒe anyigba dzi kple du si kpɔa dzidzɔ la ƒe dzidzɔkpɔxɔwo siaa me.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Elabe woagblẽ fiasã la ɖi, eye du si me amewo nɔ fũu la aɖi gbɔlo, togbɛ la kple gbetakpɔxɔ la azu agadowo tegbee. Gbetedziwo afe le afi ma, eye wòazu gbeɖuƒe na lãhawo.

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: Ava eme va se ɖe esime woatrɔ gbɔgbɔ la akɔ ɖe mía dzi tso dziƒo. Gbegbe azu anyigba wɔnuku, eye anyigba wɔnuku azu ave dodo.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Nye dukɔ anɔ teƒe si ŋutifafa le; anɔ dedienɔnɔ teƒewo kple gbɔɖemeƒe siwo zi ɖoɖoe toŋtoŋ la me.

english_verse: even if hailstones flatten forests and cities.
translation_verse: Ave blibo la ava anyi, eye du la ayi to keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: Woyra mi ame siwo ƒã nu ɖe tɔwo katã to, eye mieɖe ka nyitsu kple tedzi wole tsatsam.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Baba na wò nugblẽla si womegblẽ o la. Wò amedeasila si womede asi o. Ne èdzudzɔ nugbegblẽ la, woagblẽ wò. Ne ètasi amedede asi la, woade wò asi.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe míele mɔ kpɔm na; ve mía nu. Do ŋusẽ mí ŋdi sia ŋdi. Xɔ na mí, ne míexaxa.

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: Ne èɖe gbe la, dukɔwo sína. Ne ètsi tsitre la, dukɔwo kana gbẽe.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Woaƒo nu siwo mieha la nu ƒu abe ale si adeɛfɔnake ƒoa nu ƒui ene, eye woadze edzi abe ale si ʋetsuvi tia kpo dzea nu dzii ene.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Wodo Aƒetɔ ɖe dzi elabe ele dziƒo ke. Ana ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nayɔ Zion taŋ.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Ana nàli ke le agbe me xɔname, nunya kple sidzedze asɔ gbɔ na wò. Aƒetɔ -vɔvɔ̃e nye eƒe kesinɔnu.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, kalẽtɔwo le ɣli dom le xexe. Amedɔdɔ siwo he ŋutifafanya vɛ la le avi fam hehehe.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Mɔ gãwo zu gbegbe; mɔzɔla aɖeke megale wo dzi tom o. Wotu nubablawo, wodo vlo ɖasefowo, eye bubu aɖeke megale gbetɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Anyigba la le nu xam, eye wòle veve sem. Lebanon tɔtɔ, eƒe lã me gbã. Saron zu abe kegbegbe ene, eye Basan kple Karmel lũ xe. Aƒetɔ gbe nya na eƒe futɔwo

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Azɔ matso, makɔ ɖokuinye ɖe dzi azɔ; matsi tsitre azɔ.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Miefɔ nutsro ƒe fu, miedzi ahɔliti takpoe; miaƒe gbɔgbɔ nye dzo si afiã mi.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo anɔ abe akalo mee womè wo le ene; abe aŋɔka si wolã de dzo me la ene.”

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo le didiƒe ʋĩi, mise nu si mewɔ la. Mi ame siwo le kpuiƒe, miʋu eme be nyee nye ŋusẽtɔ.

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo nuvɔ̃wɔlawo le Zion, dzidzi ƒo Mawu mavɔ̃lawo: “Mia dometɔ kae anɔ dzo binu gbɔ? Mia dometɔ kae anɔ dzo si le xɔxɔm tegbetegbee la gbɔ?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Ame si zɔna le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me, eye wògblɔa nyateƒe; ame si tsri viɖekpɔkpɔ to ameteteɖeto me; ame si ʋuʋua asi be yemaxɔ zãnu o; ame si xea asi to me be yemase ʋukɔɖinya o; ame si miaa ŋku be yemakpɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ o la,

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: eyae anɔ kɔkɔƒewo. Mɔ́ siwo anɔ agakpewo dzi la anye eƒe sitsoƒe. Woana eƒe nuɖuɖui, eye tsi anɔ esi ɖaa. Atsyɔ̃nu siwo gbɔna

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Wò ŋkuwo akpɔ fia la le eƒe atsyɔ̃ me. Woakpɔ anyigba si keke yi didiƒe ʋĩi ke la.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Àde ŋugble le ŋɔdzi la ŋu abia be: “Afi kae nuxlẽla la le? Afi kae nudala si xɔa adzɔ la le? Afi kae ame si xlẽa xɔ tsralawo la le?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Màgakpɔ dukɔ mabuame si ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ me mekɔ o, eye womate ŋu ase eme la o, dukɔ si kɔkɔna, eye womate ŋu ase eƒe nuƒo me o la, azɔ o.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Kpɔ Zion-du si nye míaƒe ŋkekenyui ɖuƒe la ɖa! Wò ŋkuwo akpɔ Yerusalem, nɔƒe si zi ɖoɖoe; agbadɔ si womakaka o la wònye; eƒe tsyotiwo maho o, eye eƒe kawo matso o.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Ke boŋ Aƒetɔ anye fia na mí le afi ma. Teƒe si tɔsisi gãwo kple tɔʋuwo sí to eye atablukulawo loo, alo tɔdziʋu gãwo mato wo dzi o la.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ nye míaƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, Aƒetɔ ye nye mía dziɖula, Aƒetɔ ye nye míaƒe fia. Eyae laɖe mí.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Wò kaawo me gbɔdzɔ. Womegate ŋu abla abalati la sesĩe, eye womahe abala la me o. Ekema woama aboyonu kple nu gbogbo siwo woha la; bunɔ gɔ̃ hã aha nu.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Dua me tɔ aɖeke magblɔ be: “Mele dɔ lém” o. Woatsɔ ame siwo le eme la ƒe nuvɔ̃ ake wo.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo, mite va see ɖa! Mi anyigba dzi dukɔwo, miɖo to nyuie. Anyigba kple nu siwo katã yɔ edzi, miɖo to. Nu miemie siwo katã le xexea me, misee.

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖe dukɔwo katã ŋu. Edo dɔmedzoe vevie ɖe woƒe aʋakɔwo katã ŋu. Ebu fɔ wo, eye wòtsɔ wo de asi be woawu.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ woƒe ame siwo wowu la aƒu gbe. Woƒe ame kukuawo ƒe ʋeʋẽ kũu axɔ ya me, eye woƒe ʋu así le towo ŋu blibaa.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Dziŋgɔli ŋu nuwo katã anyunyɔ; woaŋlɔ dziŋgɔli abe ale si woŋlɔa agbalẽe ene. Eŋu nuwo katã age abe ale si aŋgbawo gena le wainka kple gboti ŋui ene.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Elabe nye yi mu aha le dziƒo. Kpɔ ɖa, aɖiɖi ɖe Edom, dukɔ si mebu fɔe la dzi, ahatsrɔ̃e.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Yi le Aƒetɔ si; eƒo ʋu; ami ɖoe. Alẽviwo kple gbɔ̃tsuwo ƒe ʋue, agbowo ƒe ayikuwo ŋu mie. Elabe Aƒetɔ le vɔsaŋkekenyui ɖum le Bozra, lãwu ŋkekenyui gã aɖe wònye le Edom-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Woawo kple tòwo siaa woamu adze anyi hekpe ɖe nyivi tatawo kple nyitsu sesẽwo ŋu. Woƒe anyigba ano ʋu, eye ami aɖo woƒe ké.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Elabe hlɔ̃biagbe le Aƒetɔ si; teƒeɖoɖo ƒe ƒè wòanye na Zion.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Edom-tɔʋuwo azu aŋɔ yibɔ; eƒe ke azu dzokpe, eye eƒe anyigba azu aŋɔ si le dzo bim.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Zã kple keli la, matsi o; eƒe dzudzɔ ayi dzi tegbee. Atsi ƒeƒle tso dzidzime yi dzidzime, eye ame aɖeke magato afi ma akpɔ o.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Ke azu aʋako kple hlɔ̃made tɔ, eye adzexe kple akpavia woanɔ edzi. Ahe ka si atɔtɔ wo la me ɖe edzi, eye wòada nudakpe si ahe masɔmasɔ vɛ la ade eƒe ame ŋkutawo dome.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Woana ŋkɔe be fiaɖuƒe aɖeke mele afi ma o, eye eƒe amegãwo katã maganye naneke o.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Ŋuwo amie ɖe woƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo me; dzawo kple aŋɔkawo amie ɖe woƒe mɔ́wo me. Ava zu akpatakuwo kple tsatsaboliwo nɔƒe.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Gbemelãwo kple agbotoewo ado go wo nɔewo. Azizãwo ado ɣli ayɔ wo nɔewo le afi ma, eye wòazu teƒe si gbetsi adzudzɔ, agbɔ ɖe eme le.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Afi ma adzexewo awɔ atɔ ɖo, woaɖa azi, aƒo viwo, eye woatsyɔ akɔ ɖe wo dzi. Aʋakowo aƒo takpli, atsu kple asi, ɖe afi ma.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Midi nu miaxlẽ tso Aƒetɔ ƒe agbalẽ me. Wo dometɔ aɖeke mabu loo, alo anɔ ɣaɣla ɖe nɔvia o. Elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe nue ɖe gbe, eye eƒe gbɔgbɔe ƒo wo nu ƒu.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Eyae dzidze nu na wo. Eƒe asie wòtsɔ da ka hemae na wo. Azu wo tɔ tegbee, eye woanɔ edzi tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Gbedadaƒo kple kuɖiɖinyigba akpɔ dzidzɔ, kegbegbe atso aseye, eye wòaƒo se abe dzogbenya ene.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Aƒo se geɖe, eye wòatso aseye. Akpɔ dzidzɔ, adzi ha. Woatsɔ Lebanon ƒe bubu kple Karmel kpakple Saron ƒe gãnyenye nɛ. Woakpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple mía Mawu la ƒe gãnyenye.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Mido ŋusẽ alɔ gblɔdɔwo, eye mide agbe klo beliwo me.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Migblɔ na ame siwo le vɔvɔ̃m la be: “Milé dzi ɖe ƒo, migavɔ̃ o. Mikpɔ mia Mawu la ɖa! Ava bia hlɔ̃ kple Mawu ƒe teƒeɖoɖo. Eya ŋutɔ ava, eye wòaxɔ na mi!”

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Ekema ŋkuagbãtɔwo ƒe ŋku akpɔ nu, eye tokunɔwo ƒe to ase nu.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Bunɔwo ati kpo abe zi ene, eye mumuwo ƒe aɖe adzi dzidzɔha. Elabe tɔ aŋɔ le gbedadaƒo, eye tɔʋuwo le kegbegbe.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Ke dzodzo azu tá, eye tsi adzɔ tso kuɖiɖinyigba me. Akpatakuwo nɔƒe azu sime, gbe azu ava kple keti.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Mɔ gã aɖe ato afi ma, eye woayɔe be: Mɔ kɔkɔe la. Nu makɔmakɔ aɖeke mato edzi o. Movitɔwo kekeake hã matra mɔ ato edzi o.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Dzata aɖeke manɔ afi ma o; lã wɔadã aɖeke hã mava edzi o. Womakpɔ wo le afi ma o; ke ame siwo woɖe la ko ato edzi.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Ame siwo Aƒetɔ xɔ ƒle la atrɔ agbɔ. Woava Zion kple hadzidzi. Dzidzɔ mavɔ woatsɔ agbɔe. Woakpɔ dzidzɔ atso aseye, eye woaŋlɔ nuxaxa kple hũɖeɖe be.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie be Xizkiya nagable mi be: ‘Aƒetɔ aɖe mí’ o. Ɖe dukɔwo ƒe mawu aɖe te ŋu ɖe eƒe anyigba tso Asiria-fia si me kpɔa?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Tete Rabsake tsi tsitre te va do ɣli sesĩe le Yuda-gbe me be: “Mise fiagã la, Asiria-fia ƒe nya!

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Afi ka Xamat kple Arpad ƒe mawuwo le? Sefarvayim ƒe mawuwo ɖe? Ɖe wote ŋu ɖe Samaria tso asinye mea?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Ebe migana Xizkiya naflu mi o, elabe mate ŋu aɖe mi o.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Rabsake gblɔ na wo be: “Migblɔ na Xizkiya be: ‘Asiria-fia be: Nu ka ŋuti koŋ nèle dzi ɖom ɖo?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Ɖe nèbu be numenya ƒuƒlue nye aɖaŋu kple ŋusẽ si wotsɔna wɔa aʋaea? Ame ka ŋue nèle dzi ɖom ɖo ta nèdze aglã ɖe ŋunye?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, èle ŋu ɖom ɖe Egipte, aƒla ŋeŋe ma si aŋɔ ame si ziɔ ɖe eŋu la ŋu. Nenemae Egipte Fiagã la le na ame siwo katã ɖoa ŋu ɖe eŋu la.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Gake ne miegblɔ nam be: Míeɖoa ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la ŋu la, ɖe menye eya ƒe nuxeƒewo kple vɔsamlekpuiwoe Xizkiya ɖe ɖa hegblɔ na Yuda kple Yerusalem be: Miasubɔ le vɔsamlekpui sia ko ŋgɔ oa?

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: Azɔ va ne wò kple nye aƒetɔ Asiria-fia la miatso gbe: Mana sɔ akpe eve wò, ne àte ŋu akpɔ sɔdolawo woado wo ko.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Ale ke gɔ̃ nàte ŋu atutu aʋakplɔla ɖeka le nye aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla gblɔewo dome ayi megbee, esi nèle ŋu ɖom ɖe Egipte ƒe tasiaɖamwo kple sɔdolawo ŋu?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Gawu la, ɖe meto Aƒetɔ megbe ho ɖe anyigba sia ŋu be matsrɔ̃ea? Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe nam be: Ho aʋa ɖe anyigba sia ŋu ne nàtsrɔ̃e.’ ”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Tete Elyakim, Sebna kple Yoax gblɔ na Rabsake be: “Míeɖe kuku, do Aram-gbe na wò dɔlawo, elabe míesee, ke mègado Yuda-gbe na mí o. Ame siwo katã le glia dzi la see!”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Ke Rabsake ɖo eŋu be: “Wò kple wò aƒetɔ ko gbɔe nye aƒetɔ dɔm ɖo be mava gblɔ nya siawoa? Ɖe menye ame siwo bɔbɔ nɔ glia dzi siwo gbɔna woawo ŋutɔ ƒe mi ɖu ge, eye woano woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aɖuɖɔ kpe ɖe mia ŋu hã la gbɔe oa?”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Migana Xizkiya nana miaɖo ŋu ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu ahagblɔ be: Aƒetɔ aɖe mí godoo, eye du sia mage ɖe Asiria-fia si me o.

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Migaɖo to Xizkiya o, elabe Asiria-fia be: Miwɔ ŋutifafa kplim; mido va gbɔnye ekema mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe aɖu eya ŋutɔ ƒe waintsetse, eye ame sia ame aɖu eya ŋutɔ ƒe gbotitsetse, eye ame sia ame ano tsi tso eya ŋutɔ ƒe vudo me.

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: Anɔ nenema va se ɖe esime mava kplɔ mi ayi anyigba aɖe si le abe mia tɔ ene la dzi. Enye anyigba si dzi bli kple wain le; anyigba si dzi abolo kple wainbɔwo le.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Dukɔ siawo ƒe mawuwo katã dometɔ kae ɖe woƒe dukɔwo tso asinye me kpɔ, ne Aƒetɔ ya naɖe Yerusalem atso asinye me?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Tete Elyakim, Xilkiya vi si nye aƒedzikpɔla, Sebna, agbalẽŋlɔla kple Yoax, Asaf vi si nye agbalẽwo dzraɖoƒedzikpɔla le awu vuvu me yi Xizkiya gbɔ ɖagblɔ Rabsake ƒe nyaawo nɛ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Esi fia Xizkiya se nya siawo ko la, edze eƒe awuwo, ta akpanya, eye wòyi Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Afi ka Xamat-fia kple Arpad-fia le? Afi ka Safarvayim-du, Hena kple Iva fiawo le?”

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Xizkiya be: ‘Egbee nye xaxa, tohehe kple fewuɖugbe. Vi ɖo ata me, ke ŋusẽ aɖeke meli woadzii o.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la se Rabsake ƒe nyaawo. Nya siwo eƒe aƒetɔ Asiria-fia la de esi be wòatsɔ ɖu fewu le Mawu gbagbe la ŋui, eye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ahe to nɛ le nya si wòse la ta. Eya ta mido gbe ɖa ɖe ame siwo susɔ la ta.’ ”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Esi fia Xizkiya ƒe dɔlawo va Yesaya gbɔ la,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Yesaya gblɔ na wo be: “Nya si miagblɔ na miaƒe aƒetɔ lae nye esi: ‘Aƒetɔ be, nya siwo Asiria-fia ƒe amedɔdɔwo tsɔ va ɖe alɔ me le ŋunye miese la, megadzi ŋɔ na mi o.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, made gbɔgbɔ aɖe eme ale be wòase ʋunyaʋunya aɖe, eye wòatrɔ yi wo denyigba dzi. Mana wòatsi yi nu le wo de.’ ” Asiriatɔwo gado ŋɔdzi na fia Xizkiya (Fia II,

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Esi Rabsake se be Asiria-fia dzo le Laxis la, etrɔ eye wòkpɔ Asiria-fia wònɔ aʋa wɔm kple Libna.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Azɔ du va na Asiria-fia la be Nubia-fia Tirhaka ho aʋa ɖe eŋu. Esi wòsee la, edɔ ame ɖo ɖe Yuda-fia Xizkiya, ne woagblɔ nɛ be:

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: “Mègana Mawu si ŋu nèle dzi ɖom ɖo la naflu wò be womatsɔ Yerusalem ade asi na Asiria-fia o.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wò ŋutɔ èse nu si Asiria-fiawo tu kple dukɔwo katã: wotsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi; ko Mawu aɖe wò yaa?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Ɖe dukɔ siwo tɔgbuinyewo tsrɔ̃ - Gozan, Xaran kple Rezef kpakple Edentɔ siwo nɔ Telasar - la ƒe mawuwo ɖe woa?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Xizkiya xɔ agbalẽa le amedɔdɔawo si xlẽ. Eyome eyi mawuƒe la me, eye wòkee ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “O, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Israel ƒe Mawu, wò ame si le kerubiwo tame, wò ɖeka koe nye Mawu ɖe anyigba fiaɖuƒewo katã dzi. Wòe wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: O, Aƒetɔ, le nyateƒe me la, Asiria-fiawo tsrɔ̃ dukɔwo katã kple woƒe anyigbawo

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɔ si dzi wòto va la, eya ke dzie wòato adzo. Magava du sia me o. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: nya si Aƒetɔ gblɔ ɖe eŋu lae nye be: ‘Eɖe alɔ me le ŋuwò, eko wò, Zion vinyɔnu, ɖetugbi leaƒe. Eʋuʋu ta ɖe yowòme, wò Yerusalem-nyɔnuvi.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Eto wò dɔlawo dzi heɖe alɔ me le Aƒetɔ la ŋu be: Nye tasiaɖam gbogboawo metsɔ yi towo tamee, yi keke Lebanon ƒe mlɔenu ke. Metso eƒe sederti kɔkɔwo kple sesewu nyuitɔwo ƒu anyi. Mede keke eƒe kɔkɔƒe ke kple ave dodo me.’

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Meɖe vudowo heno tsi la, eye metsɔ nye afɔƒome na Egipte-tɔsisiwo katã mie.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Mèsee kpɔ oa? Blema kee mewɔe; tso gbe aɖe gbe kee meɖoe. Azɔ mena wòva eme be nàgbã du sesẽwo woazu glikpowo.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Eya ta ŋusẽ avɔ le wo me nɔlawo ŋu, dzi naɖe le wo ƒo, eye gbɔgblɔ abu ɖe wo. Woazu abe agble me ma, gbe mumu, xɔta me gbe kple nuku si tsi to nu la ene.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: Menya wò anyinɔnɔ, wò dodo kple wò gbɔgbɔ kple wò aglãdzedze ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Esi nèdze aglã ɖe ŋunye, eye wò dàda va nye to me ta la, matsɔ nye nublaga ade ŋɔti na wò made nye numega nu na wò, eye magbugbɔ wò ato mɔ si nèto va la dzi.”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: “Azɔ nu si anye dzesi na wò lae nye esi: Le ƒè sia me la, miaɖu nu siwo mie le wo ɖokui si, eye le ƒè evelia me la, miaɖu flunyigba me nuku. Ke le ƒè etɔ̃lia me la, miƒã nu miaŋe, eye mide waingble miaɖu eme kutsetsewo.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Yuda-to la ƒe ame mamlɛ siwo tsi agbe la agato kè ɖo ta to me, eye woatse ku ɖe dzime.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Elabe ame mamlɛawo ado tso Yerusalem, eye agbetsilawo ƒe hatsotso aɖe ado tso Zion-to la dzi. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ƒe dzotsɔtsɔ ɖe nu ŋu awɔ esia ade goe.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ gblɔ ɖe Asiria-fia ŋu be: Mele du sia me va ge alo ada aŋutrɔ ɖe eme o. Matsɔ akpoxɔnu ate ɖe eŋu loo, alo aƒu kpo ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ale Sanxerib, Asiria-fia trɔ yi aƒe, eye wòɖanɔ Ninive.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Eva dzɔ be esime wònɔ gbe dom ɖa le eƒe mawu Nisrox ƒeme la, via ŋutsuwo, Adramelex kple Sarezer ɖawui kple yi, eye wosí yi Ararat-nyigba dzi. Via Esar-Xadon zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Tete Xizkiya trɔ mo ɖe gli ŋu eye wòdo gbe ɖa na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ axɔ nam, eye míadzi ha aƒo kasaŋkuwo le míaƒe agbenɔɣi katã le Aƒetɔ ƒeme.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke mawo me la, Xizkiya nɔ dɔ lém ɖo kudo nu. Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya va gblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ be, ‘Ɖɔ wò aƒe ɖo elabe èle kuku ge; màganɔ agbe o.”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Megblɔ be nyemakpɔ Aƒetɔ, le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi o. Nyemagakpɔ amegbetɔ aɖeke azɔ le xexemenɔlawo dome o.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: “O Aƒetɔ, meɖe kuku na wò, ɖo ŋku ale si mezɔ le ŋkuwò me le nyateƒe kple dzi blibo mee hewɔ nu si nyo le ŋkuwò me la dzi.” Tete Xizkiya wó avi hehehe.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ ƒe gbe va na Yesaya be:

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: “Yi ɖagblɔ na Xizkiya be: Aƒetɔ, tɔgbuiwò David ƒe Mawu la be: Mese wò gbedodoɖa; mekpɔ wò aɖatsi. Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ ƒe wui atɔ̃ akpe wò agbenɔƒewo.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Ke nya kae magblɔ? Elabe eƒo nu nam eye eya ŋutɔ wɔe. Alɔ̃ bu ɖem keŋkeŋ elabe nye luʋɔ le veve sem.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Maɖe wò kple du sia tso Asiria-fia si me, eye maʋli du sia ta.

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Nu si anye dzesi na wò be Aƒetɔ awɔ nu si ŋugbe wòdo na wò lae nye esi:

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa mana vɔvɔli nagbugbɔ yi megbe afɔɖeɖe ewo le gaƒoƒofiaƒe si Axaz tu ɖe ɣe ƒe zɔzɔme nu la dzi.” Tete ɣe ƒe vɔvɔli la gbugbɔ yi megbe afɔɖeɖe ewo tso gaƒoƒofiaƒe si wòle la.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Yuda-fia Xizkiya ƒe nu si wòŋlɔ le eƒe dɔléle kple hayahaya megbe ŋu.

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Megblɔ na ɖokuinye be esi nye agbenɔɣi titina ɖo la, ele nam be mage ɖe tsiẽƒe ƒe agbowo me, le nye agbenɔƒe mamlɛawo me.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Woho nye nɔƒe ɖa, eye wotee ɖa boo tso gbɔnye abe ale si wowɔa alẽkplɔla ƒe agbadɔe ene. Abe avɔlɔ̃la ene la, meŋlɔ́ nye agbe. Etsom le avɔlɔ̃gbati me, eye wòtso ɣe ɖe dzi nam, wòvɔ nam.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Medo boboe va se ɖe ŋdi. Egbã nye ƒuwo katã abe dzata ene, eye wòtso ɣe ɖe dzi nam, wòvɔ nam.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Menɔ ɣli dom sesĩe abe sagbadre alo tsalɛ ye le fafam ene. Menɔ xɔxlɔ̃m abe ahɔnɛ ene; nye ŋkuwo kpɔ dzi ʋuu, nu te wo ŋu. O Aƒetɔ, wotem ɖe anyi. Xɔ nam!

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, nu siawo tae ame nɔa agbe ɖo, eye esiawo katã me nye gbɔgbɔ le agbe le. Eya ta da gbe le ŋunye, eye na manɔ agbe.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mese veve ŋutɔ; ke nye dedienɔnɔ tae. Wò ŋutɔe ɖe nye luʋɔ tso gbegblẽ me, elabe etsɔ nye nuvɔ̃wo ƒu gbe ɖe megbewò.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe mate ŋu ada akpe na wò o; ku Saɖagatsi mate ŋu akafu wò o; aʋlimeyilawo mate ŋu akpɔ mɔ na wò nyateƒetɔnyenye o.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Agbenɔla, agbenɔlawo koe ada akpe na wò abe ale si mele ewɔm egbee ene. Vi tɔe ɖea wò nyateƒetɔnyenye fiaa viawo.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesaya gblɔ be: “Na woatsɔ gbotitsetsebolo aɖo ƒoƒoeawo dzi ne wòahaya.”

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Tete Xizkiya hã bia be: “Nu kae anye dzesi be mayi Aƒetɔ ƒeme?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Xizkiya xɔ wo kple dzidzɔ, eye wòɖe eƒe kesinɔnudzraɖoƒexɔ fia wo. Efia eƒe klosalo, sika, atike ʋeʋẽewo, ami xɔasi, eƒe aʋawɔnuxɔ blibo la kple nu si le eƒe nudzraɖoƒexɔ me la wo. Naneke mesusɔ le Xizkiya ƒeme alo le fiaɖuƒe blibo la me si mefia wo o.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, Babilonia-fia, Merodax Baladan, Baladan vi la, de agbalẽ kple nunanawo asi na eƒe dɔlawo be woatsɔ ayi na Xizkiya elabe ese be edze dɔ, ke ehaya.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Tete Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya va fia Xizkiya gbɔ biae be: “Nya kae ŋutsu siawo va gblɔ? Afi kae wotso va gbɔwò?” Xizkiya ɖo eŋu be: “Didiƒe aɖe kee wotso va gbɔnye; tso keke Babilonia ke!”

english_verse: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Yesaya biae be: “Nu kae wokpɔ le aƒewò me?” Xizkiya ɖo eŋu be: “Wokpɔ nu sia nu si le nye aƒeme. Naneke mesusɔ le nye nudzraɖoƒexɔawo me si nyemefia wo o.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Tete Yesaya gblɔ na Xizkiya be: “Se Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ƒe nya be:

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, gbe ɖeka la, woalɔ nu siwo katã le aƒewò me kple esiwo katã tɔgbuiwòwo ƒo ƒu ɖi va se ɖe fifi la ayi Babilonia. Naneke masusɔ o. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Woakplɔ wò ŋutɔ viwò ŋutsu siwo nèdzi la dometɔ aɖewo adzoe, eye woaɖazu ame tatawo le Babilonia-fia ƒe fiasã me.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Ale Xizkiya gblɔ na Yesaya be: “Aƒetɔ ƒe nya si nègblɔ la nyo.” Elabe esusui be “Ŋutifafa kple dedienɔnɔ anɔ nye ŋkekewo me.”

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: “Mifa akɔ! Mifa akɔ na nye dukɔ!” Mia Mawue gblɔe.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Miƒo nu na Yerusalem kple lɔlɔ̃. Mido ɣli ɖo ɖee be eƒe aʋawɔwɔ wu enu. Wotsɔ eƒe vodada kee. Exɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ŋu fetu zigbɔzi eve tso Aƒetɔ ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Gbe aɖe le ɖiɖim be: “Miɖe mɔ le gbedadaƒo na Aƒetɔ! Miwɔ mía Mawu ƒe mɔ gã la le kegbegbe la wòadzɔ.

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Bali ɖe sia ɖe me akɔ dzi. To sia to kple togbɛ sia togbɛ anyè ɖe eme. Anyigba masɔmasɔwo asɔ, eye teƒe tsakliwo azu zɔzrɔ̃e.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Ekem woaɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe afia, eye amegbetɔƒomea katã aƒo ƒu akpɔe, elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe nue gblɔe.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Gbe aɖe ɖi be: “Ðe gbeƒã!” Mebia be: “Nya ka maɖe gbeƒãe?” Amegbetɔƒomea katã le abe gbe ene, eye eƒe agbenɔɣi katã le abe seƒoƒo le abɔ me tɔ ene.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Gbe ƒuna, eye seƒoƒo yrɔna ne Aƒetɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ gbɔ ɖe wo. Nyateƒee, amegbetɔ la, gbee wònye.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Gbe ƒuna, eye seƒoƒo yrɔna, ke mía Mawu ƒe nya la ya anɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Wò Zion, du nyui xɔvɛla, lia to kɔkɔ la! Wò Yerusalem, du nyui xɔvɛla, kɔ wò gbe dzi kple ŋusẽ! Kɔe dzi, mègavɔ̃ o. Gblɔ na Yuda-duwo be: “Mia Mawu lae nye esi!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ Mawu gbɔna kple ŋusẽ, eye eƒe alɔ aɖu fia ɖe enu. Kpɔ ɖa, fetu le esi, eye teƒeɖoɖo le eŋgɔ.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Anyi eƒe alẽha abe alẽkplɔla ene. Aƒo ƒu alẽviawo ɖe eƒe abɔwo dome, eye wòakɔ wo ɖe akɔ nu. Akplɔ alẽnɔ nonalawo ɖɔɖɔɖɔ. Mawu aɖeke mesɔ kple Israel ƒe Mawu la o

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Ame kae tsɔ asiʋlo dzidze tsi kpɔ, alo tsɔ asi dzidze dziƒowo kpɔ? Ame kae tsɔ nudonui do ʋuʋudedi kpɔ alo da towo kple togbɛwo le nudanu me kpɔ?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Ame kae fia nu si Aƒetɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ awɔ lae kpɔ? Ame kae azu eƒe aɖaŋuɖola afia nui?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Ame kae wòde adaŋu kplii kpɔ bene wòafia sidzedze ye, eye wòafia nui ku ɖe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe ŋu kpɔ? Ame kae wòde adaŋu kplii kpɔ bene wòafia nunya kple nugɔmesese ye?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, dukɔwo le abe tsi si gena toŋtoŋ le ze ŋu la ene. Wobua wo abe ʋuʋudedi le nudanu me ene. Kpɔ ɖa, ƒukpowo le eŋkume abe ʋuʋudedi biɖibiɖi si ya ƒo la ene.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo katã meɖi naneke le eŋkume o. Ebu wo nu maɖinu kple nu dzodzrowoe.

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Legbae loo? Aɖaŋudɔwɔlae kɔ̀nɛ, sika ŋu nunyala faa sika ɖe eŋu, eye klosalo ŋu nunyala dea kɔsɔkɔsɔ eŋu.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Ame ɖoko si mate ŋu ana nu sia o la, tiaa ati manyunyɔ na eɖokui. Edia aɖaŋudɔwɔla nyanu aɖe bene wòali legba aɖe si mamu o la na ye.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Mienya oa? Miesee oa? Ðe womegblɔe na mi tso gɔmedzedzea me ke oa? Ɖe miekpɔ anyigbagɔmeɖoanyila la dze sii oa?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Eya ame si bɔbɔ nɔ anyigba nogo la tame, eye edzinɔlawo le dzedzem abe ʋetsuviwo ene; eya ame si he dziƒowo me abe avɔ falɛfalɛ ene, eye wòkeke wo me abe avɔgbadɔ ene be yeanɔ wo me.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Eya ame si na amegãwo zu nu maɖinuwo, eye wòɖi gbɔ anyigba dzi ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Womekpɔdo wo gɔ̃ hã o, womekpɔƒã wo hã o, eye woƒe ati meƒo ke ɖe to me gɔ̃ hafi wògbɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye woƒu o. Tete ahomya lɔ wo dzoe abe gbe ƒuƒu ene.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Tete Kɔkɔetɔ la be: Ekema ame ka koŋ ŋue miatsɔm asɔ ɖo be masɔ kplii?

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Mifɔ mo dzi ne miakpɔ ɖa! Ame kae wɔ nu siawo? Ame si kplɔa woƒe aʋakɔ doa goe, eye wònya woƒe xexlẽme heyɔa wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ŋkɔ. Le eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ kple ŋutete ta la, wo dometɔ aɖeke mebu o.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Yakob, nu ka ta nèle nu ƒom? Israel, ɖe nèle gbɔgblɔm be: “Nye mɔ le ɣaɣla ɖe Aƒetɔ, eye nye Mawu meléa ŋku ɖe nye nya dzɔdzɔe ŋu o” mahã?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Mienya oa? Miesee oa? Aƒetɔ la, Mawu mavɔ wònye; Xexeme blibo la Wɔlae. Nu metia kɔ nɛ o, ɖeɖi hã metea eŋu o. Eƒe nunya me dzodzro tsitotsito meli o.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Edoa ŋusẽ ame siwo nu ti kɔ na, eye wòdzia ame beliwo ƒe ŋusẽ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Nu ati kɔ na sɔhɛwo gɔ̃ hã, eye ɖeɖi ate wo ŋu. Ɖekakpui kekeake hã agbɔdzɔ, adze anyi.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo kpɔa mɔ na Aƒetɔ ya la, akpɔ ŋusẽ yeye. Woasa agba ayi dzi ʋĩi abe hɔ̃ ene. Woaƒu du, ɖeɖi mate wo ŋu o; woazɔ azɔli, womagbɔdzɔ o.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Mi ƒukpowo, minɔ anyi kpoo miaɖo tom. Mina dukɔwo nakpɔ ŋusẽ yeye. Mina woate va aƒo nu. Mina mí katã míate va ʋɔnu.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Ame kae fɔ dziɖula tso ɣedzeƒe? Ame kae tsɔ dukɔwo de asi le eŋkume? Ame kae na wòle dukɔwo dzi ɖum, eye wòle fiawo fanyam kple afɔ? Ewɔa wo abe ʋuʋudedi ene kple eƒe yi, eye wòwɔa wo abe gbe ƒuƒu le ya nu ene kple eƒe dati.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: Etia wo yome; etoa mɔ la dedie, eƒe afɔ mekaa anyi o.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Ame kae wɔ esia, wu enu, eye wòyɔ dzidzimewo tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke? Nye Aƒetɔ, nyee nye gbãtɔ, eye nye kee nye mlɔetɔ.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Ƒukpowo kpɔe; vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo. Anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo ʋuʋu, eye wote va.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Ame sia ame kpena ɖe ehavi ŋu, eye wògblɔna na nɔvia be: “Lé dzi ɖe ƒo!”

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Aɖaŋudɔwɔla doa ŋusẽ sika ŋu nunyala, eye ame si téa nu kple zu la doa ŋusẽ ame si le nu dzi ƒom le zukpe dzi hegblɔna le nu si tsyiam wòle la ŋu be: “Enyo.” Woƒoa gatagbadzɛ ɖee sesĩe, ale be mate ŋu aʋã o.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Ke wò Israel, nye dɔla, Yakob, wò ame si metia, xɔ̃nye Abraham ƒe dzidzimevi.

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: Wò, si mekplɔ tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo ke, eye meyɔ wò tso keke eƒe dzogoewo dzi ke hegblɔ na wò be: “Nye dɔla nènye; metia wò, eye nyemegbe wò o.”

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Mègavɔ̃ o, elabe meli kpli wò! Ŋɔ megadzi wò o, elabe nyee nye wò Mawu! Mado ŋusẽ wò; makpe ɖe ŋuwò. Matsɔ nye dziɖuɖu ƒe nuɖusi alé wò ɖe te.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
