translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ame siwo katã do dɔmedzoe ɖe ŋuwò la, ŋu akpe wo eye woƒe mo atsi dãa. Ame siwo ke ɖi kpli wò la aɖi gbɔ, eye woatsrɔ̃.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Àdi ame siwo wɔ avu kpli wò; ke màkpɔ wo o. Ame siwo wɔ aʋa kpli wò azu ame ɖigbɔwo.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Elabe nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu lae lé wò nuɖusi ɖe asi. Nyee gblɔ na wò be: “Mègavɔ̃ o; makpe ɖe ŋuwò.”

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Wò ŋɔvi Yakob, mi Israel-ŋutsuwo, mègavɔ̃ o; makpe ɖe ŋuwò. Wò Ɖelae nye Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mawɔ wò nànye luƒotasiaɖam si le yeye, si le ɖaɖam, si si aɖuwo le. Àfanya towo, agbã wo gudugudu, eye àwɔ togbɛwo woanɔ abe nutsro ene.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Àgbɔ wo, ya alɔ wo ɖe nu, eye ahomya aka wo ahlẽ. Ekema wò ya àkpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye àtsɔ Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la aƒo adegbee.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Ne ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo le tsi dim, eye tsi aɖeke meli o; ne woƒe aɖe dzi ƒu le tsikɔwuame ta la, nye Aƒetɔ, matɔ na wo. Nye Israel ƒe Mawu la, nyemagblẽ wo ɖi o.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Mana tɔsisiwo naŋɔ le to ƒeƒlewo tame, eye tsidzɔƒewo anɔ baliwo me. Mana gbedadaƒo nazu tá, eye tsi ado bababa tso anyigba ƒuƒu me.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Mado sederti, xeti, gbemiti kple amiti ɖe gbedadaƒo, eye mado sesewu, fɔfɔlĩ kple kpomi siaa ɖe kegbegbe.

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: Esia ava eme bene amewo nakpɔe, anyàe, bene woabu eŋu, eye woase egɔme be Aƒetɔ ƒe asie wɔ esia; Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ lae wɔe. Aƒetɔ tso ɖe alakpamawuwo ŋu

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be, mihe miaƒe nya ɖe go. Yakob ƒe Fia la be, miʋli mia ɖokui ta míase.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Mikplɔ miaƒe mawuwo vɛ ne woagblɔ nu si gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la na mí. Migblɔ nu si dzɔ le blema la na mí bene míalé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu, anya ale si nyaawo wu nui. Alo migblɔ nu si gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la na mí.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Migblɔ nu si gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge emegbe la na mí, ne míadze sii be mawuwoe mienye nyateƒe. Miwɔ nu nyui aɖe alo nu gbegblẽ aɖe bene ŋɔdzi nalé mí; vɔvɔ̃ naɖo mí.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nu ɖigbɔwoe mienye, eye miaƒe dɔwɔwɔ nye nu dzodzro. Ame sia ame si tia mi la, ŋunyɔnu wònye.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: Meyɔ ame aɖe le dzigbeme, eye wòtso ɣedzeƒe va ɖe gbeƒã nye ŋkɔ. Afanya dziɖulawo abe anyi ene; anyama wo abe ale si zemela nyaa tsui ene.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Ame kae gblɔe tso gɔmedzedzea ne míanya? Ame kae gblɔe ɖi xoxoxo, ne míagblɔ be: “Etɔ dzɔ”? Ame aɖeke megblɔe o; ame aɖeke meɖe gbeƒãe o, eye ame aɖeke hã mese miaƒe nyawo o.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Nyee ɖe gbeƒãe gbã na Zion, eye meɖo du nyui xɔvɛlawo ɖe Yerusalem.

english_verse: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.
translation_verse: Ke esi metsa ŋku la wo dometɔ aɖeke meli o. Aɖaŋuɖola aɖeke mele wo dome be, ne mebia nyae la, wòaɖo eŋu o.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wo katã la, nu maɖinuwo wonye. Woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nye nu dzodzro. Woƒe legbaawo nye yaƒoƒo ko.

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔla si melé ɖe te lae nye esi. Nye ame tiatiae, nye luʋɔ kpɔa dzidzɔ le eŋu. Meda nye gbɔgbɔ ɖe edzi. Eyae ahe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe ɖe go na dukɔwo.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Mado ɣli alo akɔ gbe dzi o. Mana woase eƒe gbe le ablɔwo dzi o.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Maɖe aƒla si ŋe la ɖa le enu o, eye matsi akaɖi me ɖovu si le tsitsim la o. Ahe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe ɖe go le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Magbɔdzɔ o, dzi hã maɖe le eƒo o, va se ɖe esime wòaɖo ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe gɔme anyi ɖe anyigba dzi. Ƒukpowo le mɔ kpɔm na eƒe se la.

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Mawu Aƒetɔ, ame si wɔ dziƒowo, eye wòhe wo me, ame si keke anyigba kple edzi nu miemiewo ɖe nu, ame si na agbegbɔgbɔ anyigbadzinɔlawo kple gbɔgbɔ ame siwo zɔa edzi la be:

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, meyɔ wò hena nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ. Melé wò alɔnu hekpɔ tawò. Metsɔ wò na ameha la abe nubabla ene abe kekeli ene na dukɔwo;

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: ne nàʋu ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔwo, nàɖe ga ame siwo wode gaxɔ me kple ame siwo le viviti me la tso gaxɔ me.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, ŋkɔnyee. Nyematsɔ nye bubu ana ame tutɔ kple nye kafukafu ana legbawo o.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, blemanyawo va eme. Azɔ mele gbeƒã ɖem nu yeyewo. Mele wo gblɔm na mi hafi woava dzɔ.” Kafukafuha

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye na Aƒetɔ! Midzi ha kafui tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke! Mina atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme, ƒukpowo kple wo dzi nɔlawo siaa naɖe gbe.

english_verse: Tell the tribes of the desert and everyone in the mountains to celebrate and sing.
translation_verse: Mina kegbegbe kple edzi du gãwo, du sue siwo me Kedar le la, nakɔ gbe dzi! Mina Selanɔlawo, nadzi dzidzɔha. Mina woado ɣli tso towo tame ke!

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ do abe ŋusẽtɔ ene eƒe lã me le fiefiem abe aʋawɔla ene. Ekɔa gbe dzi, doa ɣli bobobo! Eɖea eƒe ŋusẽ fiaa eƒe futɔwo. Mawu do ŋugbe be yeakpe ɖe yeƒe dukɔ ŋu

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Mezi ɖoɖoe eteƒe didi; memia nu kpoo, eye mezi ɖokuinye dzi. Azɔ mado ɣli abe nyɔnu si fu le ɖuɖum la ene. Malɔ gbɔgbɔtsixe ɖe ƒo anɔ gbɔgbɔm fuxefuxe.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Magblẽ nu le towo kple togbɛwo dzi. Mana gbewo katã naƒu le wo dzi. Mana tɔsisiwo natso kpò, tɔdomekpowo nadze eye táwo namie.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Makplɔ ŋkuagbãtɔwo ato mɔ si womenya o la dzi. Toƒe si womenya o, manɔ ŋgɔ akplɔ wo atoe. Mana viviti nazu kekeli le wo ŋgɔ, eye toƒe tsakliwo azrɔ̃. Nu siawo mawɔ, eye nyemagblẽ wo ɖi o.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Woagbugbɔ ame siwo ɖoa dzi ɖe aklama kpakpɛwo ŋu, eye wogblɔna na legbawo be: “Miawoe nye míaƒe mawuwo” la, ayi megbe, eye woado ŋukpe wo vevie. Israel gbe be yemasrɔ̃ nu o

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Mi tokunɔwo, mise nu! Mi ŋkuagbãtɔwo, mifɔ kɔ dzi ne miakpɔ nu!

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Èkpɔa nu geɖe; ke mèléa ŋku ɖe wo ŋu o. Èkea to ɖi; ke mèsea nu o.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Edze Aƒetɔ ŋu, le eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta, be wòade kɔkɔ eƒe se la ŋu, ne bubu nanɔ eŋu.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Ke dukɔ si woda adzoe, eye woha la wònye. Do zu mɔ̀ ɖe emenɔlawo katã, eye woɣla wo ɖe gaxɔwo me. Wozu nulélewo; ke ame aɖeke meli axɔ na wo o. Woha wo; ke ame aɖeke meli agblɔ be: “Migbugbɔ wo vɛ” o.

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Ame kae de Yakob asi be woaha, eye wòde Israel asi be woada adzoe? Ɖe menye Aƒetɔ ame si ŋu miewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖo ame si ƒe mɔwo dzi wometo o kple ame si ƒe se womeɖo toe o la ŋue oa?

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Ale wòtrɔ eƒe dziku helihelĩ la kple eƒe aʋa ƒe ŋusẽ kɔ ɖe edzi. Etɔ dzoe ƒo xlã va kpe ɖo; ke mese eme o. Dzo la fiãe; ke mede dzi gbɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ Aƒetɔ, ame si wɔ wò Yakob, eye wòmè wò Israel la be: “Mègavɔ̃ o, elabe meɖe wò. Metsɔ wò ŋkɔ yɔ wò. Tɔnyee nènye.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Ne èto tɔ tɔwo me la, meli kpli wò; ne èto tɔsisiwo me la, tsi malé wò o. Ne èto dzo me la, mamè wò o, eye dzo ƒe aɖewo mafiã wò o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Elabe nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la, wò Xɔla. Metsɔ Egipte ƒle tawò. Nubia kple Seba axɔ ɖe tewòƒe.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Elabe èxɔ asi le ŋkunye me, bubu le ŋuwò, eye melɔ̃ wò. Metsɔ amegbetɔwo na ɖe tewòƒe; metsɔ dukɔwo na ɖe wò agbe ta.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Mègavɔ̃ o, elabe meli kpli wò! Makplɔ wò dzidzimeviwo tso ɣedzeƒe gbɔe, eye maƒo mia nu ƒu tso ɣetoɖoƒe vɛ.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: Magblɔ na dzigbeme be: Ɖe asi le wo ŋu, eye na anyigbeme be: Mègasika wo ɖi o! Kplɔ vinye ŋutsuwo tso didiƒe vɛ kple vinye nyɔnuwo tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu vɛ.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kplɔ ame sia ame si ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo, ame sia ame si mewɔ, ame sia ame si memè, trɔ asi le eŋu hena nye bubu la, vɛ.” Israel nye Aƒetɔ ƒe ɖasefo

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Kplɔ dukɔ siwo nye ŋkunɔwo evɔ ŋku le wo si, esiwo nye tokunɔwo evɔ to le wo si la do goe!

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Na dukɔwo katã naƒo ƒu, dukɔwo nakpe ta. Wo dometɔ kae agblɔ nya sia, eye wòagblɔ nya siwo dzɔ va yi la afia mí? Wonekplɔ woƒe ɖasefowo vɛ, ne woaɖi ɖase na wo, eye woaɖo to wo ne woagblɔ be nyateƒee.

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Miawoe nye nye ɖaseɖilawo kple nye dɔla si metia la bene mianyae, axɔ dzinye ase, eye miase egɔme be nyee. Womewɔ mawu aɖeke do ŋgɔ nam o, eye ɖeke hã mava ɖe yonyeme o.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: Nye, nyee nye Aƒetɔ; Xɔnametɔ aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be meɖe gbeƒã, mexɔ na ame, eye megblɔe ɖi esi mawu bubu aɖeke menɔ mia dome o. Miawoe nye nye ɖaseɖilawo,” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: “Nyee nye Mawu, eye tso fifia dzi yina la, nyee. Ame aɖeke mate ŋu axɔ nu le asinye o. Mewɔa nu, ame kae ate ŋu axe mɔ nɛ?” Sisí tso Babilon

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mia Ɖela, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la be: “Mia tae madɔ ame ɖo ɖe Babilon; Manyrɔ Kaldeatɔ, sisíla mawo katã kple woƒe ʋu siwo me wokpɔa dzidzɔ le la.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, miaƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la, Israel Wɔla, miaƒe Fia.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ame si ta mɔ ɖe atsiaƒu me, eye wòɖe toƒe ɖe tɔ wɔadãwo me;

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: eya, ame si nana be tasiaɖamwo, sɔwo, aʋakɔwo kple kalẽtɔwo siaa hona, wotsia anyigba, womegate ŋu fɔna o, eye wònana be wo nu tsi abe ale si akaɖimeɖovu tsina ene lae gblɔ be:

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: Migaɖo ŋku blemanuwo dzi o, eye migatsɔ nu siwo dzɔ va yi la de susu me o.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mele nu yeye wɔm. Ele mo dom ɖa xoxo; ɖe miele dzesi demee oa? Mana mɔ tata naɖo gbedadaƒo, eye tɔwo naŋɔ ɖe kegbegbe.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Gbemelãwo ade bubu ŋunye, akpatakuwo kple tsatsaboliwo hã; elabe mena tsi ŋɔ le gbedadaƒo, eye tɔwo sí le kegbegbe, be mana tsi nye dukɔ tiatia la wòano.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Eyae nye dukɔ si mewɔ na ɖokuinye, ale be wòaɖe gbeƒã akafum. Nu vɔ̃ si Israel-dukɔ wɔ

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Ke Yakob, menye nyee nèyɔ o. Israel, nu ti kɔ nam le tawò.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Mètsɔ wò alẽviwo sa numemevɔ nam o, eye mètsɔ wò vɔsawo de bubu ŋunye o. Nyemetsɔ wò nunanawo do agba na wò o, alo tsɔ lifi ɖe fu na wò o.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Mètsɔ ga ƒle gbekee nam o, eye mètsɔ wò vɔsalã ƒe ami ɖi ƒoe nam o; ke wò nuvɔ̃woe nètsɔ do agba nam. Nèɖe fu nam kple wò vodadawo.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Nye, nyee, nyee atutu wò dzidadawo ɖa le nye ŋutɔ ɖokuinye ta, eye nyemaɖo ŋku wò nuvɔ̃wo dzi o.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Na míayi ʋɔnu. Ɖe wò nya gblɔ, ne woatso afia na wò.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Tɔgbuiwò gbãtɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃, eye wò nunɔlawo da vo ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Eya ta medo gu kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe amegãwo. Mede Yakob asi be woatsrɔ̃e gbidigbidi, eye woaƒo fi ade Israel.

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: “Ke azɔ, nye dɔla Yakob, nye ame tiatia Israel, see!

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ame si wɔ wò, eye wòmè wò tso dɔme ke, ame si akpe ɖe ŋuwò la gblɔ be: Nye dɔla Yakob kple nye ame tiatia Yesurun, mègavɔ̃ o!

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Elabe makɔ tsi ɖe kuɖiɖinyigba dzi bababa kple tɔʋuwo ɖe anyigba ƒuƒu dzi. Matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ akɔ ɖe dzidzimeviwo dzi kple nye yayra ɖe viwòwo dzi.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Woamie abe gbe le tɔ me, abe amuti le tɔ to ene.

english_verse: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.
translation_verse: Ame si agblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ tɔ menye’ ame kemɛ ayɔ eɖokui be Yakob. Ame bubu aŋlɔ ɖe eƒe asi ŋu be: ‘Aƒetɔ tɔ’ eye woatsɔ Israel abe tɔgbuiŋkɔ ene.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Israel Fia kple eƒe Ɖela, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Nyee nye gbãtɔ, eye nyee nye mlɔetɔ. Mawu bubu aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ame kae le abe nye ene? Neɖe gbeƒãe, neɖe gbeƒãe eye wòaɖee afia makpɔ. Ame kae gblɔ nu siwo ava dzɔ la ɖi tso blema ke? Wonegblɔ nu siwo gagbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la na mí.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Migavɔ̃ o, ŋɔ megadzi mi o! Ɖe nyemegblɔe na mi, eye meɖe gbeƒãe tso gbe aɖe gbe ke oa? Miawoe nye nye ɖaseɖilawo. Ɖe Mawu aɖe li kpe ɖe ŋunyea? Agakpe aɖeke meli o; nyemenya ɖeke o.” Woɖu fewu le trɔ̃subɔsubɔ ŋu

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Ame siwo mèa legbawo la, wo katã mele ɖeke me o. Nu siwo ŋu wokpɔa dzidzɔ le la, wonye nu dzodzrowo. Woƒe ɖasefowo mele nu kpɔm o, eye womedzea si nu o, eya ta ŋu akpe wo.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Ame kae wɔa mawu aɖe, alo kɔ̀a legba aɖe si meɖea vi aɖeke o mahã?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, woado ŋukpe ehatiwo katã. Aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo ŋutɔ hã la, amegbetɔwo ko wonye. Wo katã woneƒo ƒu ne woado va. Dzidzi aƒo wo, eye ŋu akpe wo katã.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Gbede tsɔa ga yibɔ dea dzoka xɔxɔ me tua fíae. Etsɔa zu tunɛ, eye wòtsɔa eƒe alɔ sesẽ wɔa dɔ le eŋu. Dɔ wunɛ, wògbɔdzɔna; tsikɔ wunɛ, eƒe lã me tuna.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Atikpala daa dzidzeka, eye wòdea dzesii kple ɣe. Etsɔa fi kpanɛ, eye wòtsɔa nudzidzega tanɛ. Ewɔnɛ ɖe ame ƒe dzedzeme me wonyakpɔna ne wòanɔ aƒeme.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Etsoa sedertiwo. Etiaa fɔfɔlĩ alo logoti, eye wòɖonɛ ɖi wòtsina zua ati sesẽ le avemetiwo dome. Edoa sederti, eye tsidzadza nana be wòtsina.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Ale wòzua dzodonu na amegbetɔ. Etsɔa eƒe ɖe doa dzo ƒuna. Etsɔa ɖe doa dzo mea aboloe. Etsɔa ɖe wɔa mawui hesubɔna, eye wòtsɔa ɖe wɔa aklama kpakpɛ, dea ta agu nɛ.

english_verse: He enjoys the warm fire and the meat that was roasted over the burning coals.
translation_verse: Etsɔa eƒe afã doa dzoe, eye wòmèa lã le edzi ɖuna. Etɔa lã wòɖia ƒo nɛ. Eƒua dzo hã gblɔna be: “Ehɛ̃, dzo ɖo lã me nam. Mekpɔ dzoa.”

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Etsɔa esi susɔ la wɔa mawui, eƒe legba. Edea ta agu nɛ, eye wòsubɔnɛ. Edoa gbe ɖa nɛ gblɔna be: “Ɖem elabe wòe nye nye mawu.”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke mebua eŋu alo nyaa nu alo dzea sii o, ne wòagblɔ be: “Metsɔ afã do dzoe, memè abolo le eƒe dzoka dzi, eye metɔ lã le edzi ɖu, ɖe matsɔ esi susɔ la awɔ ŋunyɔnuia? Ɖe made ta agu na atikpoa?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Enyia eɖokui kple dzofi. Eƒe susu tɔtɔ, eye wòtra mɔ; maɖe eƒe agbe o. Magblɔ na eɖokui be: “Ɖe menye aʋatsoe melé ɖe ɖusi oa?” Aƒetɔ ye nye Wɔla kple Xɔla

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: Yakob, ɖo ŋku nu siawo dzi. Israel, nye dɔla nènye. Nyee wɔ wò nènye nye dɔla. O, Israel, nyemaŋlɔ wò be o.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Meklo wò dzidadawo ɖa abe alilikpo ene kple wò nuvɔ̃ ɖa abe afu ene. Trɔ va gbɔnye elabe nyee ɖe wò.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Mi dziƒowo, midzi ha elabe Aƒetɔ ye wɔe! Mi anyigba ƒe agunuwo, mido ɣli! Migli kple dzidzɔha, mi towo, ave kple emeti ɖe sia ɖe elabe Aƒetɔ ɖe Yakob eye woade bubu eŋu le Israel.

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Ɖewòla, ame si mè wò tso dɔ me ke la be: “Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, si wɔ nuwo katã. Nye ɖeka koe he dziƒo me, eye mekeke anyigba ɖe enu. Ame kae kpe ɖe ŋunye?

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Nyee nye ame si tɔtɔa aʋatsokalawo ƒe dzesi me; medoa bometsila afakalawo, megbugbɔa nunyalawo yia megbe, eye medoa lã woƒe nunya.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Menaa nye dɔlawo ƒe nya vaa me. Mewɔa eƒe amedɔdɔ ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo dzi. Megblɔ le Yerusalem ŋu be ‘amewo aganɔ eme,’ le Yuda-duwo ŋu be ‘woatso wo,’ eye mafɔ eƒe glikpowo ɖe tsitrenu.

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: Megblɔ na tɔ gɔme be: ‘Mie, mana wò tɔsisiwo naƒu kplakplakpla.’

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Megblɔ na Kores be eyae nye nye alẽkplɔla la. Awɔ nye didiwo katã dzi. Megblɔ le Yerusalem ŋu be ‘woatsoe’, eye megblɔ le gbedoxɔ la ŋu be: ‘Woaɖo gɔwòme anyi.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Kores, eƒe amesiamina, ame si ƒe nuɖusi melé, ne mabɔbɔ dukɔwo ɖe anyi le eŋgɔ, eye matu alidziblanu na fiawo, ne maʋu ʋɔwo le eŋkume, eye agbowo matsi dodo o la, be:

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: “Madze ŋgɔwò, eye mana kpoƒewo nasɔ. Matugu akɔbligbowo, eye maŋe gametiwo.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nu xɔasi siwo le blukɔ me kple kesinɔnu siwo woƒo ƒu ɖe ɣaɣlaƒe la ana wò, be nànyae be nye Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu lae tsɔ wò ŋkɔ yɔ wòe.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Le nye dɔla Yakob kple nye ame tiatia Israel ta, metsɔ wò ŋkɔ yɔ wòe. Metsɔ tɔgbuiŋkɔ na wò, togbɔ be mèdze sim o hã.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ; bubu aɖeke megali o. Mawu aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o. Mebla ali dzi na wò, togbɔ be mèdze sim o hã.

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: Mewɔ esia ne amewo nanyae tso ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe be ame aɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ; ɖeke megali o.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Nyee wɔ kekeli, eye mewɔ viviti. Nyee wɔ dzɔgbe nyui, eye mewɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, ame si wɔ nu siawo katã!

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dziƒowo, miɖuɖu; dziŋgɔli nadza nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ. Anyigba nake nu, ne xɔname nado, eye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ hã namie. Nye Aƒetɔ ye wɔe.” Aƒetɔ, xexemenuwo Wɔla kple amegbetɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔmeŋutinya

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Baba na ame si le dzre hem kple ewɔla. Anyize ko wònye le zemela si me ɖe! Ɖe tsu biaa ame si le asi trɔm le eŋu la be: Nu ka wɔm nèle alo ɖe alɔ mele wò numeme la ŋu oa?

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Baba na ame si bia tɔ́a be: ‘Nu ka ta nèdzim?’ alo bia nyɔnu be: ‘Nu ka ƒe ku lém nèle?’ ”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la kple ewɔla la be: “Ɖe miabia nyam ku ɖe vinyewo ŋu alo aɖe gbe nam ku ɖe nye asinudɔwo ŋua?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Nyee wɔ anyigba, eye mewɔ ame ɖe edzi. Nye asie he dziƒo me, eye meɖe gbe na eŋu nuwo katã wodo.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Nyee nyɔ Kores ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ŋu, eye mana eƒe mɔwo nadzɔ. Agbugbɔ nye du la atso, eye wòana ablɔɖe nye ame siwo woɖe aboyoe la, fetu alo nunana manɔmee.” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Egipte ƒe nukpɔkpɔwo, Nubia kple Sabatɔ dzɔtsuwo ƒe adzɔnuwo age ɖe asiwò me, azu tɔwò. Ame siawo adze yowòme; woade ga wo, eye woade ta agu na wò. Woaƒo koko na wò be: ‘Wò ɖeɖe ko gbɔe Mawu le; ɖeke megali o. Mawu bubu aɖeke mekpe ɖe eŋu o.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, wò Israel ƒe Mawu, Xɔnametɔ la, Mawu si ɣla eɖokui la, nènye!

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe lé wo katã, eye woƒe mo tsi dãa. Legbamèlawo katã tɔtɔ le yiyim.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ xɔ Israel ya ɖe agbe tegbee. Womado ŋukpe mi alo gbɔgblɔ nabu ɖe mi akpɔakpɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ye wɔ dziƒowo; eya nye Mawu! Eyae mè anyigba wònye eƒe nuwɔwɔ. Eɖoe anyi be wòanɔ anyi tegbee. Mewɔe be wòanɔ anyi nyamaa o, ke boŋ be ame nanɔ edzi. Eyae gblɔ be: “Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, bubu aɖeke megali o.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Nyemeƒo nu le vivime le anyigba ƒe afi aɖeke si do blukɔ o. Nyemegblɔ na Yakob ƒe dzidzimeviwo be: ‘Midim le teƒe si tɔtɔ la’ o. Nye Aƒetɔ la, nyateƒee megblɔna megblɔ nu si le eteƒe. Aƒetɔ ɖu xexea me kple Babilonia-legbasubɔlawo dzi

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: “Mi dukɔwo, miƒo mia ɖokui nu ƒu ne miava. Mi ame siwo katã tsi agbe le dukɔwo dome, mite va. Wo ame manyanu siwo lé aklama kpakpɛ tikpowo ɖe ta, eye wole gbe dom ɖa na mawu siwo metea ŋu xɔa ame ɖe agbe o.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Miva to miaƒe nya. Mina woaƒo takpli ne woade adaŋu kple wo nɔewo. Ame kae gblɔ nya sia gbe aɖe gbe ke? Ame kae ɖe gbeƒãe le blema? Ɖe menye nye, Aƒetɔ ye oa? Mawu bubu aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o. Mawu nu dzɔdzɔe Wɔla kple Xɔnametɔ menye; bubu aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: “Xexemedukɔwo katã, mitrɔ ɖe ŋunye, ne woaxɔ mi ɖe agbe! Elabe nyee nye Mawu, bubu aɖeke meli o.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Metà nye ŋutɔ ɖokuinye; nyateƒenya si do tso nye nu me la, matrɔ gbeɖe o: ‘Klo sia klo atɔ anyi nam, eye aɖe sia aɖe aka atam nam.’

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Woagblɔ be: Aƒetɔ ko gbɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple ŋusẽ le. Ame siwo katã do dziku ɖe eŋu la, ava egbɔ eye ŋu akpe wo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Israel ƒe dzidzimeviwo katã aɖu dzi to Aƒetɔ dzi, eye woakafui.”

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Bel de ta to, Nebo bɔbɔ ta. Woƒe legba siwo woléna ɖe ta la, zu agba lãwo kple nyihawo tsɔ ɖeɖi te wo ŋu.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Wobɔbɔ ta, wo katã wode ta to. Womate ŋu axɔ agba la o, ke woawo ŋutɔ yi aboyo me.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe ƒome, mi ame siwo katã susɔ ɖe Israel-dukɔ me, miɖo tom. Nyee tsɔ miaƒe fu tso dɔme, kpa mi tso vidzĩme;

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: ne mietsi hã la, nye koe; nyee atsɔ mi kakaka miaƒo wɔ. Nyee wɔ mi, eye malé be na mi. Makɔ mi, axɔ na mi.

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Amewo ɖea sika fũu tso kotoku me kɔna ɖi. Wodaa klosalo le nudanu me. Wotsɔa sikaɖaŋudɔwɔla, ame si mèa mawu na wo. Tete wodzea klo nɛ, eye wosubɔnɛ!

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Wokɔnɛ ɖe abɔta ɖadana ɖe enɔƒe enɔa tsitre ɖe afi ma, eye metea ŋu ʋãna le enɔƒe o. Ne wodo ɣli nɛ hã la, meɖoa eŋu loo, alo xɔna na ame le xaxa me o.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: “Mi nuvɔ̃wɔlawo, miɖo ŋku esia dzi; mibu eŋu, migbugbɔ ɖo ŋku edzi.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nu siwo dzɔ va yi le blema la dzi, ne miadze sii be nyee nye Mawu; ɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o. Nyee nye Mawu, ɖeke mesɔ kplim o.

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Meyɔ xe ƒonu aɖe tso ɣedzeƒe; ŋutsu si awɔ nye ɖoɖowo dzi tso anyigba didi aɖe dzi. Nyee ke nu gblɔe; mana wòava eme godoo. Nyee ɖoe; mele ewɔ ge.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Miɖo tom, mi ame siwo ƒe dzime sẽ; mi ame siwo le adzɔge tso nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Maɖe mi kpuie; egbɔ megadidi kura o. Nye xɔname mahe ɖe megbe o. Maxɔ Zion ɖe agbe, eye mana woagade bubu Israel ŋu.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wò ɖetugbi leaƒe, Babilon vinyɔnu, ɖi ɖe anyi nabɔbɔ nɔ ʋuʋudedi me. Wò Kaldea vinyɔnu, bɔbɔ nɔ anyigba menye fiazikpui dzi o. Elabe azɔ la, womagayɔ wò be vi vevi malɔ̃nugbɔe o.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Yi ɖe teƒo nàtu wɔ! Ɖe wò moxevɔ ɖa! Ɖe wò taɖedzi ɖi! Klo avɔ le ata ŋu, ne nàtso tɔ!

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Wò ama me adze, eye woakpɔ wò ŋukpeƒe. Mabia hlɔ̃; nyemagblẽ ame aɖeke ɖi o.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Mía Ðelae nye Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la. Eŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Kaldea vinyɔnu, bɔbɔ nɔ anyi nazi ɖoɖoe kpoo, eye nàyi ɖe blukɔ me. Elabe womagayɔ wò be aƒenɔ fiaɖuƒewo dziɖula azɔ o.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Medo dɔmedzoe ɖe nye dukɔ ŋu; medo gu nye domenyinu, eye metsɔ wo de asi na wò. Ke mèkpɔ nublanui na wo o, eye nèna amegãɖeɖiwo tsɔ kɔkuti si kpe wo ŋutɔŋutɔ la.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Ègblɔ be: “Manye aƒenɔ dziɖula tegbee!” ale be nu siawo mewɔ dɔ ɖe dziwò loo, alo nàɖo ŋu woƒe nuwuwu dzi o.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Eya ta, azɔ see, wò agbe vivi ɖula, wò ame si ɖe dzi ɖi le bubum be yele dedie. Èle gbɔgblɔm le ɖokuiwò me be: “Nyee, ame aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o. Nyemanɔ anyi abe ahosi ene alo anya ale si vi kuna na amee o.”

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Èɖe dzi ɖi le nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔm le gbɔgblɔm be: “Ame aɖeke mele kpɔyem o.” Wò nunya kple sidzedze kplɔ wò trae, eye nègblɔ le dzime be: “Nyee, ame aɖeke meli kpe ɖe ŋunye o.”

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Lé wò gbesawo kple wò dzo gbogbo siwo ŋu nèku kutri le tso wò ɖetugbime ke la me ɖe asi sesĩe. Ɖewohĩ àte ŋu akpɔ dzidzedze. Ɖewohĩ àte ŋu ado ŋɔdzi na ame aɖe kpli wo.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Ɖeɖi te ŋuwò le aɖaŋuɖoɖo geɖe si nèxɔ la ta. Na dziŋgɔli me nunyalawo natso axɔ na wò. Woawoe kpɔa ɣletiviwo, eye ne dzinu dze dzi la, wogblɔa nu si ava dzɔ ɖe dziwò la na wò.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wole abe gbe ƒuƒu ene; dzo fiãa wo. Womate ŋu aɖe wo ɖokui tso dzo bibi ƒe ŋusẽ nu o. Menye dzoka xɔxɔ wònye ne woaƒu o; menye dzo wònye woabɔbɔ nɔ egbɔ o.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Alea ame siwo ŋu nèku kutri ɖo, eye mia kpli wo mietsa asi tso ɖetugbime ke la woazu na wò. Ame sia ame lé eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ tsɔ, ame aɖeke meli axɔ na wò o.

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: Misee, Yakob ƒe ƒome, mi ame siwo tsɔ Israel ŋkɔ, eye mienye Yuda ƒe alimeviwo. Mi ame siwo tsɔ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ tàa nui, eye mieʋua Israel ƒe Mawu la me, evɔ menye le nyateƒe kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me o.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Elabe woyɔa du kɔkɔe la ɖe wo ɖokui ŋu, eye woziɔ ɖe Israel ƒe Mawu ŋu. Eŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: “Meɖe gbeƒã blemanyawo gbe aɖe gbe ke; nye nu me wodo tso, eye mena wosee. Mewɔe zi ɖeka kpata, eye wodzɔ va yi.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: meɖe gbeƒãe na wò gbe aɖe gbe ke, eye mena nèsee hafi wòava dzɔ ale be màgagblɔ be: ‘Nye legbawoe wɔe; nye aklama kpakpɛwo kple nye legba siwo wokɔ̀ la, woawoe na wòdzɔ o.’

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Èse nu si va dzɔ. Azɔ kpɔ esiawo katã ɖa; ke miawo ɖe miaɖe gbeƒãe oa? Tso azɔ heyina la, mana nàse nu yeyewo kple nu ɣaɣla siwo mènya o la.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Mèsee kpɔ kura o; mènyae gbeɖe o. Tso gbe aɖe gbe ke la, wò to meʋu o. Elabe menyae be ame mawɔnuteƒe nènye. Aglãdzela woyɔna na wò tso esime wodzi wò.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Meɖo asi nye dziku dzi, le nye ŋkɔ ta, eye le tawò meɖo asi ɖokuinye dzi ne amewo nakafum ale be nyemagatsrɔ̃ wò o.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meklɔ ŋuwò, ke menye abe klosalo ene o; medo wò kpɔ le fukpekpe ƒe aŋɔlólokpo me.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Le nye ŋutɔ ta, le nye ŋutɔ tae mewɔe. Elabe nu ka tae wòagblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye ŋkɔ? Nyematsɔ nye bubu na ame bubu aɖeke o. Kores, kplɔla si Aƒetɔ tia

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Yakob kple Israel si meyɔ, miɖo tom! Nye ye; nyee nye gbãtɔ, eye nyee nye mlɔetɔ.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Nye asie metsɔ ɖo anyigba gɔme anyi, eye nye nuɖusie he dziƒo me. Esi meyɔ wo la, wo katã wova tsi tsitre ɖi.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Mi katã mikpe ta ne miasee! Wo dometɔ kae gblɔ nu siawo? Aƒetɔ lɔ̃ eyama. Awɔ nu si wobe newɔ Babilon, eye wòaɖe eƒe ŋusẽ afia Kaldeatɔwo.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Nyee, nye gɔ̃e ƒo nu, yɔe hekplɔe vɛ, eye eƒe nuwɔnawo adze edzi nɛ.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Azɔ mite ɖe ŋunye ne miase nya sia. Tso gɔmedzedzea ke nyemeƒo nu le adzame o. Mele eteƒe tso gbe aɖe gbe ke, esime wòva eme.” Azɔ Aƒetɔ Mawu ɖo nye kple eƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖa. Ðoɖo si Aƒetɔ wɔ na eƒe dukɔ

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wò Ɖela, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la be: “Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu. Nyee nye ame si fiaa nu si aɖe vi na wò la wò. Nyee kplɔa wò toa mɔ si dzi nàto la.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: Ko wòanye ɖe nèwɔ nye seawo dzi ɖe! Anye ne wò ŋutifafa anɔ abe tɔsisi ene, eye wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ anɔ abe ƒutsotsoewo ene.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Anye ne wò alimeviwo asɔ gbɔ abe ke ene, eye wò dzidzimeviwo abe kekui ene. Womatsrɔ̃ woƒe ŋkɔ alo atutui ɖa le ŋkunye me o.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Miʋu tso Babilon. Misí tso Kaldea-nyigba dzi! Miɖe gbeƒã dzidzɔnya sia. Mitso aseye kplii yi anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke be: “Aƒetɔ ɖe eƒe dɔla Yakob!”

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Tsikɔ mewu wo esime wòkplɔ wo to kegbegbewo o. Ena tsi do tso agakpe me na wo. Efe agakpe la me, tsi ɖuɖu bababa.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Ŋutifafa aɖeke meli na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo o.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Mi ƒukpowo, miɖo tom; mi dukɔ siwo le didiƒe ʋĩi, mizi ɖoɖoe ne miase. Aƒetɔ yɔm hafi wodzim. Etsɔ ŋkɔ nam le nɔnye ƒe dɔme ke.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nye nu wòle abe yi ɖaɖɛ ene. Eɣlam ɖe eƒe asi ƒe vɔvɔli me. Ewɔm aŋutrɔ biɖoe, eye wòtsɔm ƒo ɖe eƒe daku me.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Israel, nye dɔla nènye; woakafum to dziwò.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Gake megblɔ be: “Mewɔ dɔ vlo; megblẽ nye ŋusẽ ɖe ya me dzodzro. Ke hã, Aƒetɔ si me nye nyawo le, eye nye fetu le nye Mawu gbɔ.”

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Azɔ Aƒetɔ, ame si mèm tso dɔ me ke be manye yeƒe dɔla ne makplɔ Yakob agbɔ va ye gbɔe, eye woaƒo Israel nu ƒu ɖe egbɔ la, de bubu ŋunye le eŋkume, eye nye Mawu zu nye ŋusẽ.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Ebe: “Mesɔ gbɔ nam be nènye nye dɔla, ne nàfɔ Yakob ƒe toawo ɖe tsitrenu, eye nàɖo Israel ƒe ame siwo woɖe la te o. Ke boŋ matsɔ wò ana abe kekeli ene na dukɔwo ale be nye xɔname nade anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Ɖela kple eƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la gblɔ na ame si wodo vloe, ame si dukɔ la lé fui, ame si nye dziɖulawo ƒe dɔla la be: “Fiawo akpɔe, atso ɖe tsitrenu, eye amegãwo adra ɖe anyigba ade ta agu, le Aƒetɔ, ame si wɔa nuteƒe la ta, le Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la, ame si tia wò la ta.” Woagbugbɔ nuwo aɖɔ ɖo le Yerusalem

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Ɣeyiɣi si me mave nuwò la, meve nuwò. Gbe si gbe maxɔ wò ɖe agbe la, mekpe ɖe ŋuwò. Mekpɔ tawò eye meto dziwò bla nu kple dukɔ la ne nàɖo anyigba la te, eye nàma domenyinu si zu gbegbe la.

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na gaxɔmenɔlawo be: ‘Mido va!’ Gblɔ na ame siwo le viviti me la be: ‘Miva kekeli nu!’ Woaɖu gbe le mɔ to, eye woƒe gbeɖuƒe anɔ togbɛ ƒeƒlewo katã tame.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Dɔ kple tsikɔ magawu wo o, eye ya xɔdzo loo, alo ŋdɔ helihelĩ maɖu wo o. Elabe ame si kpɔ nublanui na wo adze ŋgɔ na wo, eye wòakplɔ wo ayi tsidzidziwo gbɔe.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: Mɔ ato nye towo katã tame, eye magbugbɔ nye mɔ gãwo ado.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, amewo atso didiƒe ʋĩi ava. Ɖewo atso dzigbeme kple ɣetoɖoƒe, eye bubuwo atso Sinitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Dziƒowo, mitso aseye! Anyigba, kpɔ dzidzɔ! Towo, midzi ha kple ɣli! Elabe Aƒetɔ fa akɔ na eƒe dukɔ, eye wòakpɔ nublanui na eƒe ame siwo le fu kpem la.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Gake Zion be: “Aƒetɔ gblẽm ɖi! Nye Aƒetɔ ŋlɔm be.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: “Ɖe nyɔnu aŋlɔ eƒe vi nono be, eye eƒe dɔme matrɔ ɖe vi si eya ŋutɔ dzi la ŋu oa? Ne aŋlɔe be hã la, nye ya nyemaŋlɔ wò be o.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, meŋlɔ wò ŋkɔ ɖe nye asiƒome; wò gliwo le ŋkunye me ɖaa.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Ame siwo agbugbɔ wò aɖo te la ƒe afɔ le tsɔtsɔm wu ame siwo gbã wò la. Ame siwo wɔ wò nèzu aƒedo la ʋu tso mewò dzo yina.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Fɔ wò mo dzi nàtsa ŋku godoo, eye nàkpɔ ɖa. Wo katã woƒo ƒu, wogbɔna ɖe gbɔwò. Aƒetɔ be: Esi mele agbe ko la, àdo wo katã abe atsyɔ̃ɖonu ene; àtsɔ wo abla ali dzi abe ale si ŋugbetɔ wɔnɛ ene.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, wò aƒedo, wò gbegbe kple wò anyigba si wogblẽ la, àxaxa ŋutɔ azɔ na edzinɔlawo, eye ame siwo gblẽe la adzo yi didiƒe ʋĩi.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Ðevi siwo wodzi esime nènɔ fu nyim la agblɔ nàse be: ‘Teƒe sia megalolo nam o. Di teƒe bubu nam, manɔ.’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Ekema àgblɔ le wò dzime be: ‘Ame kae dzi ɖevi siawo nam? Woɖe vi le ŋunye, eye metsi ko. Woɖe aboyom, eye wonyam de gbe ɖe! Ke ame kae kpɔ wo dzi wotsi? Kpɔ ɖa, nye ɖeka koe wogblẽ ɖi ɖe! Afi ka gɔ̃ woawo tso va?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Kpɔ ɖa, makɔ asi dzi na dukɔwo, eye mado nye aflaga ɖe dzi na wo. Ale woatsɔ wò ŋutsuviwo ɖe akɔ nu, eye woakɔ wò nyɔnuviwo ɖe abɔta vɛ.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Fiawo azu tɔ́ na viwòwo, eye woƒe fianyɔnuwoe ana no wo. Woade ta agu atsyɔ mo anyi ɖe ŋkuwò me, eye woaɖuɖɔ ke le wò afɔ ŋu. Tete àdze sii be nyee nye Aƒetɔ. Ame siwo kpɔa mɔ nam la, ŋu makpe wo o.”

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu be: “Woaxɔ aboyomewo le kalẽtɔ si, eye woaxɔ ŋutasẽla ƒe nu si wòlé gɔ̃ hã la le esi nyateƒe. Elabe mawɔ avu kple ame siwo le avu wɔm kpli wò, eye maxɔ viwòwo ɖe agbe.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Mana ame siwo te wò ɖe anyi la, naɖu woawo ŋutɔ ƒe lã, eye woamu woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ʋu abe wain wono mu ene. Ekema amegbetɔƒomea katã adze sii be nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Xɔnametɔ kple wò Ɖela, Yakob ƒe Ŋusẽtɔ la.”

english_verse: The Lord says, “Children, I didn't divorce your mother or sell you to pay debts; I divorced her and sold you because of your sins.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Afi ka mia nɔ ƒe srɔ̃gbegbalẽ si metsɔ gbee la le? Alo nye fetɔwo dometɔ ka medzra mi na? Kpɔ ɖa, miaƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo tae wodzra mi ɖo. Miaƒe dzidadawo tae wogbe mia nɔ ɖo.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Metaa avɔ yibɔ na dziƒowo, eye metsyɔa akpanya na wo.” Aƒetɔ subɔla ƒe toɖoɖo

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu tsɔ nusrɔ̃la ƒe aɖe nam ale be mate ŋu atsɔ nya ado ŋusẽ ame si ŋu ɖeɖi te la. Enyɔam ŋdi sia ŋdi, ʋua to nam be maɖo to abe nusrɔ̃la ene.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu ʋu to nam, eye nyemedze aglã alo de megbe o.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Meɖo dzime ɖi na ameƒolawo. Metrɔ to me na gehelawo. Nyemeɣla nye ŋkume be woagado vlom, eye woatu ta ɖe mo nam o.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu kpena ɖe ŋunye eya ta gbɔgblɔ mebu ɖem o. Ale mena nye mo sẽ abe kpe sesẽ ene, eye menya be ŋu makpem o,

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ Mawu ye kpena ɖe ŋunye. Ame kae abu fɔm? Kpɔ ɖa, wo katã anyunyɔ abe avɔ ene; agbagblaʋui aɖu wo.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Mia dometɔ kae vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, eye wòɖoa to eƒe dɔla ƒe gbe, ame kae le viviti me zɔm, eye kekeli aɖeke meklẽna nɛ o, evɔ wòɖoa dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ ŋu, eye wòziɔna ɖe eƒe Mawu ŋu?

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mi ame siwo katã doa dzo, eye mieƒlɔa dzo ɖo, mizɔ le miaƒe dzo ƒe keklẽ nu kple dzo si mieƒlɔ ɖo la nu. Nu si miakpɔ tso asinye me lae nye esi: Miamlɔ anyi ɖe funyafunya me.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: “Mi ame siwo dia nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, mi ame siwo dia Aƒetɔ, miɖo tom. Mikpɔ agakpe si me wokpa mi tsoe kple agakpegbãƒe si me woɖe mi tsoe la ɖa.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Mibu mia tɔgbui Abraham kple Sara si dzi mi la ŋu kpɔ. Esi eya ɖeka nɔ anyi la, meyɔe, eye meyrae wòdzi sɔ gbɔ fũu.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ afa akɔ na Zion; afa akɔ na eƒe aƒedowo katã. Awɔ eƒe gbedadaƒo abe Eden-bɔ ene kple eƒe kegbegbe abe Aƒetɔ ƒe abɔ ene. Dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple aseyetsotso, akpedada kple kafukafuha anɔ eme.”

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: “Nye dukɔ, miɖo tom; nye amewo, milé to ɖe ŋunye! Elabe nufiame ado tso gbɔnye, eye wòana nye ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ naklẽ abe kekeli ene na dukɔwo.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Nye ɖeɖe tu aƒe, nye xɔname do yi xoxo. Nye ŋusẽ aɖu dukɔwo dzi. Ƒukpowo le mɔ kpɔm nam, eye wole mɔ kpɔm na nye ŋusẽ.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Mifɔ mo dzi ne miakpɔ dziƒowo. Mide mo to ne miakpɔ anyigba, elabe dziƒo abu vĩ abe dzudzɔ ene anyigba anyunyɔ abe avɔ ene, eye edzinɔlawo aku abe tagbatsuwo ene. Ke nye xɔname anɔ anyi tegbee eye nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ nu mayi akpɔ o.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo nya nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, mi dukɔ si ƒe dzime nye se la le, miɖo tom. Ne woɖu fewu le mia ŋu la, migavɔ̃ o. Ne wodo vlo mi la, dzi megaɖe le mia ƒo o.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Elabe agbagblaʋui aɖu wo abe avɔ ene, eye tsiƒomee aɖu wo abe kuntru ene. Ke nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ anɔ anyi tegbee, eye nye xɔname anɔ anyi na dzidzimewo katã.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe alɔ, nyɔ, nyɔ, kpla ŋusẽ! Nyɔ abe le blemaŋɔli ene, abe ale si nènyɔna na dzidzimewo gbe aɖe gbe ene. Ɖe menye wòe fli Raxab kakɛkakɛe, eye nèƒo nu ɖe ʋɔdriba la oa?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Ðe menye wòe na atsiaƒu mie, mie de gogloƒewo ke gɔ̃, eye nèdo mɔ to egɔme be ame siwo nèɖe la, nazɔ edzi yi oa?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Ale ame siwo Aƒetɔ xɔ ƒle la atrɔ gbɔ va Zion kple hadzidzi, eye woanɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm tegbee. Dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple aseyetsotso dzi ko woanɔ, eye nuxaxa kple hũɖeɖe maganɔ anyi o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: “Nye, nyee nye ame si faa akɔ na mi. Nu ka ta miele amegbetɔ kukua, gbetɔ si nu yina abe gbe ene la, vɔ̃m?

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Mieŋlɔ Aƒetɔ, mia Wɔla, ame si he dziƒowo me, eye wòɖo anyigba gɔme anyi la be. Miele ame siwo te mi ɖe anyi kple dziku la vɔ̃m gbe sia gbe, elabe woɖoe be yewoatsrɔ̃ mi. Ke ame si te mi ɖe anyi la ƒe dɔmedzoe la ɖe?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Woaɖe ame si wote ɖe anyi la kaba; maku ayi aʋlime alo nuɖuɖu nahiãe o.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Elabe nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu. Nyee blua atsiaƒu, eye eƒe tsotsoewo dzea agbo. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔlae nye eŋkɔ.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye nya de nuwò, eye meɣla wò ɖe nye asi ƒe vɔvɔli me. Nyee he dziƒowo me, eye meɖo anyigba gɔme anyi, eye mele gbɔgblɔm na Zion be: ‘Nye dukɔ nènye.’ ” Yerusalem ƒe fukpekpe wu nu

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Fɔ, fɔ! Yerusalem, tsi tsitre! Wò si no dɔmedzoekplu me nu tso Aƒetɔ si me. Èno nu muame si le kplua me ƒiaƒiaƒia kpɔ egɔme ke.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Kplɔla aɖeke mele vi siwo katã wòdzi la dome si afia mɔe o, eye esiwo katã wònyi wotsi la hã dometɔ aɖeke meli alé eƒe alɔnu o.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Viwòwo ku ƒenyi, mlɔ anyi ɖe ablɔwo dzi keŋ abe ahlɔ̃e si ɖɔ ɖe la ene. Aƒetɔ ƒe dziku te wo ŋu, wò Mawu ƒe agbodzedze nu sẽ ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Eya ta se nya sia, wò ame si wowɔ nu vevii eye nèmu, evɔ menye wain ye nèno mu o.

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Wò Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu ame si ʋlia eƒe dukɔ la ta la gblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mexɔ kplu si me nu muame le la le asiwò. Màgano nu le dɔmedzoekplu la me azɔ o.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: Matsɔ kplua ade ame siwo wɔ funyafunya wò la si me. Woawoe gblɔ na mi be: ‘Mibɔbɔ ne míazɔ mia dzi ayi.’ Ale miewɔ miaƒe dzime abe anyigba ene abe mɔ dodo ene, wozɔ edzi.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Nyɔ, Zion! Nyɔ kple wò ŋusẽ! Yerusalem, du kɔkɔe, tsɔ wò awu nyuiwo nàdo, elabe bolobolotɔwo kple ame makɔmakɔwo magage ɖe mewò azɔ o.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Wò Yerusalem, si woɖe aboyoe, ʋuʋu ke le ɖokuiwò ŋu! Tso nàbɔbɔ nɔ anyi, wò Zion vinyɔnu, si woɖe aboyoe, ɖe ga si le kɔ na wò la ɖi.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ gblɔ be: “Womexe fe ɖe mia ta tsɔ ƒle mii o, eya ta woaɖe mi femaxee.

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Gbã la, nye dukɔ la yi Egipte ɖanɔ afi ma abe amedzrowo ene, eye Asiriatɔ la te wo ɖe anyi dzodzro.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Eya ta azɔ nu ka wɔm mele le afii, esi mekpɔ be wokplɔ nye dukɔ dzoe dzodzro. Aƒetɔ be wo dziɖulawo le avi fam, eye edziedzi, ŋkeke bliboa la, wole alɔ me ɖem le nye ŋkɔ ŋu.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Eya ta nye dukɔ adze si nye ŋkɔ ale be ɣe ma ɣi la woadze sii be nyee ƒo nu be: Nyee nye esi!”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Du nyui xɔvɛla si le toawo tame gbɔna ƒe afɔɖeɖe nya le kpɔkpɔm loo! Eɖea gbeƒã ŋutifafa, eye wòhea nya nyui vɛ. Eɖea gbeƒã agbexɔxɔ, eye wògblɔna na Zion be: “Wò Mawue le fia ɖum!”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Ðo to nàse ɖa! Wò dzɔlawo ƒe gbe le dzi dem. Wo katã wole ha dzim kple dzidzɔ. Woawo ŋutɔ wokpɔ Aƒetɔ kple ŋku wòtrɔ gbɔna Zion.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Mi Yerusalem ƒe glikpowo, mi katã mido dzidzɔha ɖa bobobo elabe Aƒetɔ fa akɔ na eƒe dukɔ; eɖe Yerusalem.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ klo nu le eƒe alɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu le dukɔwo katã ŋkume. Anyigba ƒe mlɔenuwo katã akpɔ mía Mawu ƒe xɔname.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Midzo, midzo! Miʋu tso afi ma! Migaka asi nu makɔmakɔ aɖeke ŋu o. Miʋu tso eme. Mi ame siwo tsɔa Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒemegbawo, mikɔ̀ mia ɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Elabe ne miele ʋuʋum la, miatsi dzi o. Miele sisí ge adzo o, elabe Aƒetɔ adze mia ŋgɔ, eye Israel ƒe Mawu la axe megbe na mi. Dɔla si le fu kpem la

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔla akpɔ dzidzedze. Woadoe ɖe dzi boo; axɔ ŋkɔ, eye wòanye gã.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Ame geɖe kpɔe wòwɔ nuku na wo, eƒe dzedzeme gblẽ wu ame tɔ gɔ̃ hã, eƒe nɔnɔme vlo wu amegbetɔviwo tɔ.

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Alea pɛ dukɔ geɖewo le ekpɔ ge, wòawɔ nuku na woe. Fiawo aɖo asi nu le eta, elabe nu si womegblɔ na wo kpɔ o lae kpɔ ge woala, eye nu si womese kpɔ o la gɔmee woase.

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Ame kae xɔ nya si míese la dzi se? Ame ka ŋu Aƒetɔ ɖe eƒe ŋusẽ fia ɖo?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Elabe etsi le eŋkume abe ati fɛ̃ aɖe ene abe ati ƒe ke tso anyigba ƒuƒu me ene. Nɔnɔme meli nɛ o, eye medze ɖeka hã o; be míanɔ ekpɔm o. Menyakpɔna kura be eƒe nu nanyo mía ŋu o.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Amegbetɔwo nyɔ ŋui, eye wogbee. Ŋutsu si kpe fu, lé dɔ la wònye. Ele ko abe ame si ame aɖeke medi be yeakpɔ kple ŋku o la ene. Wonyɔ ŋui, eye míebui ɖe naneke me o.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, nyateƒee, eyae tsɔ míaƒe dɔlélewo, eye wòde ta míaƒe vevesesewo te. Ke míawo míebui abe ame si Mawu he to na, ƒoe, eye wòwɔ funyafunyae ene.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Ke wode abi eŋu le míaƒe dzidadawo ta, eye wogbãe gudugudu le míaƒe vodadawo ta. To si wohe nɛ wɔ mí bliboe, eye ameƒoka ƒe abi siwo wòxɔ lae yɔ dɔ mí.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Mí katã míele abe alẽ siwo tra mɔ la ene, eye mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe lé eƒe mɔ tsɔ. Ke Aƒetɔ tsɔ mí katã míaƒe vodadawo ƒe agba ɖo eyama dzi.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Wotee ɖe anyi, wɔ funyafunyae; ke meke nu o. Ale si alẽvi si wokplɔ yina wuwu ge, alo alẽ nɔa eƒe fukolawo si me kpoo la, nenemae eya hã meke nu o.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Wotee ɖe anyi, drɔ̃ ʋɔnu madzɔmadzɔ nɛ hekplɔe dzoe. Eŋɔlimeviwo dometɔ kae bui kpɔ be woɖee ɖa le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi, eye wowɔ funyafunyae le nye dukɔ ƒe dzidadawo ta?

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Esi wòku la, woɖe yɔdo nɛ ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dome, eye woɖii ɖe kesinɔtɔwo gbɔ. Evɔ wònye mesẽ ŋuta kpɔ o, eye alakpanya medo le enu kpɔ o hafi.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu wònye be yeatsɔ dɔléle agbãe gudugudu. Eƒe ku nanye vɔsa si me yeato atsɔ nuvɔ̃ ake amegbetɔ eye wòakpɔ eƒe dzidzimeviwo. Anɔ agbe didi eye nu si Aƒetɔ ɖo be yeawɔ la adze dzi to eƒe asi dzi.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Akpɔ eƒe luʋɔ ƒe fukpekpe ƒe kutsetse, eye wòaɖi ƒo nɛ. Nye dɔla, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla, ƒe sidzedze awɔ ame geɖewo woazu nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo, eye wòade ta woƒe vodadawo te.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Eya ta mana woakpɔ gome le ame xɔŋkɔwo dome, eye eya kple ŋusẽtɔwo ama aboyonu, elabe etsɔ eƒe agbe na faa heku, eye wobui ɖe vodalawo dome. Evɔ wònye eyae xɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃wɔlawo teƒe, eye wòɖe kuku ɖe vodalawo ta.

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Wò konɔ, si medzi vi kpɔ o, dzi ha! Wò, ame si melé ku kpɔ o, dzi ha sesĩe! Elabe nyɔnu tre ƒe viwo asɔ gbɔ wu nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ tɔwo.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Elabe àkeke ta ayi ɖusime kple miame. Wò dzidzimeviwo axɔ dukɔwo ƒe anyigba, eye woanɔ du siwo zu aƒedo la me.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Mègavɔ̃ o, elabe ŋu makpe wò o. Wò mo megatsi dãa o, elabe ŋukpe malé wò o. Elabe àŋlɔ wò ɖetugbime ŋukpe be, eye màgaɖo ŋku vlo si wodo wò esime nènye ahosi la dzi o.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Elabe Wɔwòlae nye srɔ̃wò. Eŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla. Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ lae nye wò Ɖela. Woyɔnɛ be anyigba blibo la ƒe Mawu.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ yɔ wò abe srɔ̃nyɔnu si srɔ̃a gblẽ ɖi wòle nu xam alo ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃ si wogbe la ene. Wò Mawu lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: Megblẽ wò ɖi vie ko; ke matsɔ nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã akplɔ mi aƒo ƒui.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Medo dɔmedzoe, trɔ megbe de wò vie ya; ke matsɔ lɔlɔ̃ si nu metsina o la akpɔ nublanui na wò. Nye Aƒetɔ, wò Ɖelae gblɔe.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: Elabe esia le nam abe Noa ƒe ŋkekewo ene. Ale si meka atam be nyemagana tsi naɖɔ aɖe anyigba azɔ o la, nenemae meka atam be nyemagado dziku ɖe ŋuwò agaka mo na wò azɔ o.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Elabe towo ate ŋu ate ɖa, eye woaɖe togbɛwo ɖa; ke nye amenuveve mate ɖa le ŋuwò o, eye nye ŋutifafa nubabla maɖe ɖa o. Aƒetɔ, ame si kpɔa nublanui na wò lae gblɔe. Ale si Yerusalem ava nɔ

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: “Wò fukpela, si nyamam ahom le, wò ame si womefa akɔ na o, kpɔ ɖa, mele kpe ŋɔŋɔewo tsɔ ge aɖo gɔwòme anyii, eye matsɔ safirkpe aɖo wò gɔmeɖokpewoe.

english_verse: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
translation_verse: Mana wò xɔta ƒe tsutsyɔẽƒewo nanye gbloti, wò agbowo nanye soe, eye wò gliwo katã nanye kpe xɔasiwo.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ afia nu viwòwo katã, eye agbenɔnɔ adze dzi na viwòwo nyuie.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ali ke wò, eye ame aɖeke mate wò ɖe anyi akpɔ o, elabe màvɔ̃ o. Naneke mate ɖe ŋuwò ado ŋɔdzi na wò o.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe di dzre le ŋuwò la, menye nyee dɔe o. Ame sia ame si awɔ avu kpli wò la, atsi asiwò me.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nyee wɔ gbede ame si ƒlɔa akadzo ɖo, eye wòtua lãnu ɖe nu si wòbe yeatsɔe awɔe nu. Nye kee wɔ nugblẽla hã be wòagblẽ nu.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Lãnu sia lãnu si woɖo tu ɖe ŋuwò la madze edzi o. Ame siwo katã tso ɖe ŋuwò hekplɔ wò yi ʋɔnui la, manɔ te ɖe nuwò o. Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔlawo ƒe domenyinu nye esia, eye matso afia na wo.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: “Kuwui….! Mi ame siwo katã wum tsikɔ le la, miva tsi gbɔ! Ame si si ga mele o, neva ƒle nu ɖu! Miva dze wain kple notsi; femaxee, asi mele eŋu o.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Nu ka tae miele miaƒe ga gblẽm ɖe nu si menye nuɖuɖu o la ŋu, eye miele miaƒe ŋusẽ gblẽm ɖe nu si meɖia ƒo o la ta? Milé to ɖe ŋunye nyuie ne miaɖu nu si nyo; ale miaƒe lã me anyo miakpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: Miƒu to anyi, miva gbɔnye. Mise nye nya, ne miaƒe luʋɔ nanɔ agbe. Mabla nu mavɔ kpli mi, mana amenuveve kple lɔlɔ̃ matrɔ si ƒomevi mena David la mi.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mena wònye ɖasefo na dukɔwo, eye meɖoe wo kplɔla kple aʋakplɔla.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, àyɔ dukɔ siwo mènya o la vɛ, eye dukɔ siwo menya wò o la, anɔ du dzi ava gbɔwò. Ava eme alea le Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ta elabe ede bubu ŋuwò.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: “Midi Aƒetɔ, esime miate ŋu ake ɖe eŋu. Miyɔe, esime wòtsɔ ɖe mia gbɔ.
