english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi neɖe asi le eƒe nuwɔna ŋu, eye nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔla neɖe asi le eƒe susuwo ŋu. Netrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu ale be wòakpɔ nublanui nɛ. Netrɔ ɖe mía Mawu ŋu elabe atsɔ nu ake geɖe.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ be: Nye susuwo menye miaƒe susuwo o, eye miaƒe mɔwo menye nye mɔwo o.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Ale si dziƒo kɔ boo tso anyigba gbɔe la, nenema nye mɔwo kɔ wu miaƒe mɔwo, eye nye susuwo kɔ wu miaƒe susuwoe.”

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: “Elabe ale si tsi kple tsikpe dzana tso dziƒo, eye womegagbugbɔna yina o va se ɖe esime wodea tsi anyigba, henana be nukuwo miena, heʋãna, eye wonaa nuku nuƒãla kple abolo nuɖula wòɖuna la,

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: nenemae nya si do tso nye nu me la anɔ: Magbugbɔ ava gbɔnye ƒuƒlu o. Nu si meɖo be newɔ la, negbe ɖe wòwɔe, kpɔ dzidzedze, eye dɔ si gbe meɖoe ɖo la dze edzi nɛ hafi.”

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: “Elabe miaʋu adzo kple dzidzɔ, eye woakplɔ mi aɖo ɖa le ŋutifafa me. Towo kple togbɛwo ade asi hadzidzi me le mia ŋgɔ, eye gbemetiwo katã asi akpe kplokplokplo.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Sesewuwo amie ɖe ŋuwo teƒe, eye gbe ʋeʋẽewo amie ɖe dzawo teƒe. Esia anye ŋkuɖodzinu kple dzesi mavɔ na Aƒetɔ si womaɖe ɖa o.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Milé ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ me ɖe asi eye miwɔ nu si le eteƒe, elabe eteƒe madidi o maxɔ mi ɖe agbe, eye nye ɖeɖe ado.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Migana amedzrovi si ku ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu la, nagblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ le ɖe nye ge ɖa tso eƒe dukɔ ŋu” o, eye migana ame tata hã nagblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, ati ƒuƒu ko menye o.”

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ be: “Mi ame tata siwo wɔa nye dzudzɔgbe ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi, ame siwo tiaa nu si dzea ŋunye, eye mieléa nye nubabla me ɖe asi sesĩe la,

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: mana ŋkuɖodzinu kple ŋkɔ siwo nyo wu ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo la mi ɖe aƒenye me kple gliwo me. Matsɔ ŋkɔ mavɔ si womagaŋlɔ be akpɔ o la na mi, ame siawo tɔgbe.

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Amedzrovi siwo ku ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu be yewoasubɔe, alɔ̃ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ, anye eƒe dɔlawo, ame sia ame si wɔna ɖe dzudzɔgbe ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi, eye megblẽa kɔ ɖo nɛ o, eye wòléa nye nubabla me ɖe asi la,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: mana ame siawo nade nye to kɔkɔe la dzi, eye mado dzidzɔ na wo le nye gbedoxɔ me. Woƒe numemevɔsa kple akpedadavɔsawo adze ŋunye le nye vɔsamlekpui dzi elabe woayɔ nye aƒe be dukɔwo katã ƒe gbedoɖaƒe.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu, ame si ƒo Israel ƒe ame kahlẽawo nu ƒu la be: Magaƒo ame bubuwo nu ƒu nɛ akpe ɖe ame siwo meƒo ƒu xoxo la ŋu.” Mawu bu fɔ Israel-dukɔ la kplɔlawo

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Mi gbemelãwo katã kple avemelãwo katã, miva ɖu nu.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzɔlawo katã nye ŋkuagbãtɔwo; wo katã womenya naneke o. Avu aɖetututɔ siwo mate ŋu awó o la, wo katã wonye. Womlɔ anyi le drɔ̃e kum, eye alɔ̃ le wo nu vivim.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Avu ɖunutsu wonye, womeɖia ƒo gbeɖe o. Alẽkplɔlaawo hã mesea nu gɔme o. Wo katã wolé woƒe mɔ tsɔ, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le viɖe ko dim.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be: “Miva, mina míadi wain. Mina míano aha sesẽ wòasu mí. Etsɔ hã anɔ abe egbe ene; anyo wui sãa.”

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe kuna, eye mevea ame aɖeke o. Woɖea mawumemewo ɖa, esime ame aɖeke mesea egɔme o. Elabe woɖea ame dzɔdzɔewo ɖa le dzɔgbevɔ̃e nu,

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: eye woyina ɖe ŋutifafa me. Ame siwo wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, gbɔna ɖe eme le woƒe abawo dzi.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Ke mi nyɔnu dzosala ƒe viwo, mi ŋutsu ahasitɔ kple gbolo ƒe dzidzimeviwo, mite va!

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Ame ka kom miele? Ame ka ŋu mieke nu ɖo baa, eye miedo aɖe ɖe go biɖaa ɖo? Ɖe menye vodalawo ƒe viwo kple alakpa ƒe dzidzimeviwo mienye oa?

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye miawo ƒe lã mee fiẽna ɖe legbawo ŋu le ati dama ɖe sia ɖe te, eye miewua mia viwo ɖe baliwo me le agakpetowo me oa?

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Ètia balimekpe zɔzrɔ̃ewo na ɖokuiwò, woawoe nye tɔwò gome. Èƒo tsi ɖe anyi na wo, eye nèɖe dza na wo. Ɖe mazi kpi akpɔ nu siawoa?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Èɖo aba ɖe to kɔkɔtɔ kekeake tame, eye miede afi ma ɖasa vɔ.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ wò ŋkuɖodzinu ɖo wò ʋɔtruwo kple ʋɔtrutiwo godo elabe ètrɔ ʋu le yonyeme. Èklo nu le wò aba ŋu, ède edzi, eye nèkekee ɖe nu, eye mia kpli wo mieƒo asì. Wo mlɔƒe dze ŋuwò eye nèkpɔ woƒe ama me.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ ami yi mawu Molex gbɔe, eye nèɖo ami ʋeʋẽe asii fũu. Èɖo wò amedɔdɔwo ɖe didiƒe ke; ɖewo ya yi keke tsiẽƒe ke.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Ètsa, tsa ʋuu ɖeɖi te ŋuwò gake mègblɔ be: “Dɔ vloe” o. Ŋusẽ yeye gaɖo mewò, eya ta nu mete ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Ame kae le ŋɔ dzim na wò, eye ame ka vɔ̃m nèle ta nèzu aʋatsokala ale be mèɖo ŋku dzinye alo bu ŋunye o? Menye esi mezi ɖokuinye dzi kpoo heli, eteƒe didi, tae nègbem vɔvɔ̃ oa?

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Maɖe wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple wò dɔwɔwɔwo afia; ke womakpe ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Ne èdo ɣli la, na wò legba gbogbo siwo nèƒo ƒui la naxɔ na wò. Ya alɔ wo ɖe nu, eye ƒuƒu akplɔ wo dzoe. Ke ame si sim tso la, anyigba la azu etɔ, eye wòanyi nye to kɔkɔe la dome. Mawu do ŋugbe be yeakpe ɖe yeƒe dukɔ ŋu ada gbe le eŋu

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Woagblɔ be: “Mita mɔ, mido mɔ! Mikplɔ mɔwo dzi. Miɖe mɔxenuwo katã ɖa le mɔ me na nye dukɔ.”

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Elabe eya ame si le dzi ʋĩi, eye wòli tegbee, eye eŋkɔe nye Kɔkɔetɔ la, gblɔ be: “Mele dzi kple kɔkɔeƒe la. Meli kple ame si trɔ dzime, eye wòbɔbɔ eɖokui le gbɔgbɔ me la. Magbɔ agbe ame si bɔbɔ eɖokui la ƒe gbɔgbɔ, eye magbɔ agbe ame si trɔ dzime la ƒe dzi.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Elabe nyemanɔ dzre hem ɖaa o, eye nyemanɔ dɔmedzoe dom ɣe sia ɣi o. Elabe gbɔnyee gbɔgbɔ tsona, eye nyee wɔ agbegbɔgbɔ.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Le eƒe ŋubiabiã ƒe vɔɖivɔ̃ɖi tae medo dɔmedzoe ɖo. Meƒoe, ɣla nye ŋkume, eye medo dɔmedzoe. Gake eyi edzi trɔ megbe dem, eye wòlé eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔ tsɔ.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: Mekpɔ eƒe mɔwo gake mayɔ dɔe. Makplɔe, eye mafa akɔ na eya kple eƒe konyifalawo.

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Mana nuyiwo nadzi kafukafuha. Aƒetɔ be: Ŋutifafa, ŋutifafa mana didiƒe kple kpuiƒe nɔlawo siaa; eye mayɔ dɔ wo.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu be: Ŋutifafa aɖeke meli na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo o.”

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: “Do ɣli sesĩe, mègadzudzɔ o! Wò gbe nede dzi bobobo abe kpẽ ene ne nàgblɔ nye dukɔ ƒe dzidada nɛ, nàgblɔ Yakob ƒe ƒome ƒe nuvɔ̃wo nɛ!

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, wole diyem gbe sia gbe, eye woƒe didie nye be yewoanya nye mɔwo, abe dukɔ si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye megblẽa eƒe Mawu ƒe sewo ɖi o la wònye ene. Wole ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe dim tso gbɔnye. Wokpɔa dzidzɔ be yewoate ɖe Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: ‘Nu ka ta míetsi nu dɔ, eye mèlé ŋku ɖe eŋu o? Nu ka ta míebɔbɔ mía ɖokui, eye mèdze sii o?’ Kpɔ ɖa, miewɔa dɔ gbe si gbe mietsi nu dɔ, eye miete miaƒe dɔwɔlawo katã ɖe anyi.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Ɖe nutsitsidɔ si medina kple ŋkeke si dzi amegbetɔ nabɔbɔ eɖokui le lae nye esia? Ne ebi ta ɖe anyi abe keti ene, eye wòmlɔ akpanya kple dzowɔ dzi la, eya yɔm nèle be nutsitsidɔ kple ŋkeke si adze Aƒetɔ ŋua?”

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: “Ɖe menye nutsitsidɔ si medina lae nye esi: be woaɖe ga ame siwo ŋu wosẽ ŋuta le, de ga wo, woatu kɔkuti ƒe kawo, woana ablɔɖe ame siwo wote ɖe anyi, eye woaŋe kɔkuti ɖe sia ɖe oa?

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye eyae nye be: nàna nuɖuɖu dɔwuitɔ, eye nàkplɔ ame dahe siwo tsi ablɔ dzi la ayi aƒewò mee, ne èkpɔ ame aɖe wòle amama la, nàta avɔ nɛ, eye mègawɔ ŋlɔmee le wò ŋutɔ wò ƒometɔwo ŋu oa?

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Ekema wò kekeli ado abe agudzedze ene, eye ahaya kaba. Wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ adze ŋgɔwò, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe axe megbe na wò.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Ekema àyɔ Aƒetɔ, eye wòatɔ na wò. Àdo ɣli, eye wòagblɔ be: Nyee nye esi!” “Ne èɖe kɔkuti, asifiafia ame kple nuvɔ̃ɖi ƒoƒo ɖa le dowòme,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: ne ètsɔ wò nuɖuɖu na dɔwuitɔ, eye nèna nu si hiãm fukpela le la su esi la, ekema wò kekeli aklẽ le viviti me, eye wò blukɔ anɔ abe ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ ene.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ akplɔ wò ɖaa, eye wòana wò dzi nadze eme le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi. Ana wò ƒuwo nakpɔ ŋusẽ, eye ànɔ abe abɔ si wode tsii kple tsidzɔƒe si tsi memiena le gbeɖe o la ene.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Woagbugbɔ wò blemaƒedowo atso, àtu xɔ ɖe dzidzime geɖewo ƒe gɔmeɖoɖowo dzi, eye woayɔ wò be: Gli gbagbãwo ɖɔɖola, mɔwo dzraɖola ablɔwo dzraɖola, afi si woatso aƒe ɖo.” Bubudede dzudzɔgbe ŋu metsonuwo

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: ekema àkpɔ dzidzɔ le Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye mana nàde anyigba ƒe kɔkɔƒewo. Mana nàɖu tɔgbuiwò Yakob ƒe domenyinu, elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe nue gblɔe.”

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe abɔ mele kpuie akpa be mate ŋu axɔ na ame o, eƒe to meku be mate ŋu ase nu o.

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ miaƒe vodadawoe klã mia kple mia Mawu dome, eye miaƒe nuvɔ̃woe ɣla eŋkume ɖe mi ale be megasea miaƒe nya o.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Elabe miaƒe asi ƒo ʋu, eye vodada le miaƒe asibidɛwo ŋu. Miaƒe nu kaa aʋatso, eye miaƒe aɖe gblɔa nya vɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke mesamaa ehavi ɖe eƒe nya dzɔdzɔe ta o, alo yia se gbɔ kple nyateƒe o. Nyateƒe aɖeke menɔa woƒe nyatotowo me o, aʋatso ko wokana. Woɖoa nugbe ɖe ame ŋu, eye wowɔa nu vevii.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Woƒoa dakpui ƒe azi, eye wolɔ̃a yiyiɖɔ. Ame si ɖua woƒe azi la kuna, eye ne wogbã azia la ƒli dona tso eme.

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: Womatsɔ woƒe ka alɔ̃ avɔ akpɔ o, amewo mate ŋu atsyɔ avɔ si wolɔ̃ o. Woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo vɔ̃ɖi, eye wole ŋutasesẽ dzi ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Woƒe afɔwo le du dzi ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ŋu, eye wole abla ɖem be yewoakɔ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi. Woƒe susuwo vɔ̃ɖi. Wogblẽa nu, tsrɔ̃a nu le mɔ gã siwo dzi wotona la.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Womenyaa ŋutifafamɔ la o, eye womewɔa nu dzɔdzɔe aɖeke le mɔ siwo dzi wotona la o. Woɖe mɔ gɔglɔ̃wo, eye ame sia ame si toa wo dzi la mekpɔa ŋutifafa o. Dukɔa ʋu eƒe nuvɔ̃wo me

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Eya ta ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe didi tso mía gbɔ, eye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ megogo mí o. Míele mɔ kpɔm na kekeli, kpɔ ɖa, vivitie. Míele mɔ kpɔm na xexeme ƒe kɔkɔ; ke míele zɔzɔm le blukɔ me.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Míele asi tsam gli ŋu abe ŋkuagbãtɔwo ene, eye míele asi nyem ya me abe ŋkunɔwo ene. Míekli nu le ŋdɔkutsu dzatsɛ abe le zã me ene, eye míele ame gbagbewo dome abe ame kukuwo ene!

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Mí katã míele gbe tem abe sisiblisiwo ene, eye míele xɔxlɔ̃m abe ahɔnɛwo ene. Míekpɔ mɔ na ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔdzɔe; ke ɖeke meli o. Míekpɔ mɔ na xɔname, ke ele adzɔge ʋĩi tso mía gbɔ.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: Elabe míaƒe dzidadawo dzi ɖe edzi le ŋkuwò me, eye míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo le ɖase ɖim tso mía ŋu. Elabe míaƒe dzidadawo le mía ŋu, eye míenya míaƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Míeda vo, eye míegbe Aƒetɔ. Míede megbe tso mía Mawu la gbɔ. Míete ame ɖe anyi, eye míedze aglã. Míeɖonɛ be míaka aʋatso, eye míeɖenɛ gblɔna tso dzime.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Afiatsotso ɖe eteƒe gbugbɔ ɖe megbe, eye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ le tsitre ɖe adzɔge ke. Elabe nyateƒe le nu klim le dutakpeƒe, eye nuteƒewɔwɔ mate ŋu age ɖe eme o.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe bu keŋkeŋ, eye ame si megadina be yeawɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi o la va zua nuléle. Aƒetɔ kpɔe be nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ aɖeke megali o, eye medze eŋu o. Aƒetɔ dzra ɖo be yeaɖe yeƒe dukɔ

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ be ame aɖeke meli o, eye wòwɔ nuku nɛ be avuléla aɖeke gɔ̃ hã meli o. Tete eya ŋutɔ ƒe abɔ he dziɖuɖu vɛ nɛ, eye eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ lée ɖe te.

english_verse: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
translation_verse: Edo nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ abe akɔtakpoxɔnu ene, eye wòɖɔ xɔname ƒe gakuku ɖe ta. Edo hlɔ̃biawu, eye wòtsyɔ ŋuʋaʋã abe taɖedzi ene.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Aɖo eteƒe na wo ɖe woƒe nuwɔnawo nu: eƒe ketɔwo tɔe nye dɔmedzoe, teƒeɖoɖo nye eƒe futɔwo tɔ, eye wòaɖo ƒukpowo ƒe nuwɔwɔ teƒe na wo.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Ɣetoɖoƒetɔwo avɔ̃ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ, eye ɣedzeƒetɔwo avɔ̃ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe; elabe ele vava ge abe tɔsisi si le du dzi sesĩe, esi Aƒetɔ ƒe ahom lɔ ɖe nu la ene.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ava Zion abe Ɖela ene, eye wòaɖe ame siwo trɔ tso woƒe dzidadawo me la hã le Yakob. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Nye la, nu si mebla kpli wo lae nye esi: Nye gbɔgbɔ si le dziwò kple nye nya si metsɔ de nuwò la mate ɖa le wò nu me loo, alo le viwòwo ƒe nu me loo, alo le viwòwo ƒe viwo ƒe nu me o, tso fifia ɖase ɖe mavɔ me. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Tso, nàklẽ! Elabe wò kekeli do! Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe klẽ ɖe dziwò.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, viviti ado ɖe anyigba dzi, eye blukɔ atsyɔ dukɔwo. Ke wò la, Aƒetɔ klẽ ɖe dziwò, eye woakpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le ŋuwò.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ava wò kekeli gbɔ, eye fiawo azɔ wò keklẽ si de dzi la me ava.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Fɔ mo dzi! Tsa ŋku godoo nàkpɔ ɖa! Wo katã woƒo ƒu gbɔna ɖe gbɔwò. Viwò ŋutsuwo atso didiƒe ava eye woalé viwò nyɔnuwo ɖe abɔ dome vɛ.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Ekema àkpɔ esia dzi adzɔ wò. Wò dzi ati kpo, avu gblotoo elabe woatsɔ atsiaƒu me nu gbogbowo na wò dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo ava gbɔwò.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Kposɔwo ƒe hatsotso gãwo ado ɖe dziwò bibibi. Kposɔviwo ƒe hawo atso Midian kple Efa. Esiwo katã atso Seba hã ava. Woatsɔ sika kple kotoklobo avɛ na wò, eye woaɖe gbeƒã akafu Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Woakplɔ lãha siwo katã le Kedar la vɛ na wò, agbowo tso Nebayot asubɔ wò. Woatsɔ wo asa vɔe le nye vɔsamlekpui dzi, wòadze ŋunye, eye made bubu nye ŋutikɔkɔeƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Ame kawo nye esiawo le dzodzom abe alilikpo ene? Wole abe ahɔnɛ siwo ɖo ta wo nɔƒewo la ene.

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Elabe ƒukpowo akpɔ mɔ nam. Tɔdziʋu siwo tso Tarsis ado ŋgɔ, be woakplɔ viwò ŋutsuwo tso didiƒe vɛ. Woatsɔ woƒe klosalo kple sika akpe ɖe wo ŋu be woatsɔ de bubu Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la, ame si de bubu ŋuwò la, ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Amedzroviwo aɖo wò gliwo, eye woƒe fiawo asubɔ wò. Elabe esi medo dɔmedzoe la, meƒo wò. Ke le nye amenuveve me la, mekpɔ nublanui na wò.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Wò agbowo anɔ ʋuʋu ɖi ɖaa; womado wo zã alo keli o, ale be amewo atsɔ dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo vɛ na wò, eye woƒe fiawo akplɔ wo.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Elabe dukɔ kple fiaɖuƒe siwo masubɔ wò o la atsrɔ̃, eye wo nu ayi keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Sesewu, fɔfɔlĩ kple kpomi siwo nye Lebanon ƒe atsyɔ̃ la ava gbɔwò, be nàtsɔ ɖo atsyɔ̃ na nye kɔkɔeƒe la ale be made bubu teƒe si menɔna la ŋu.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ame siwo te wò ɖe anyi la ƒe viwo ava bɔbɔ asubɔ wò, eye ame siwo katã ɖe alɔ me le ŋuwò la ava de ta agu ɖe wò afɔnu ahayɔ wò be: Aƒetɔ ƒe du, Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe Zion!

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wogblẽ wò ɖi, gbe wò nya, eye womegatoa mewò yina o hã la, mana bubu nanɔ ŋuwò tegbee. Ànye dzidzɔ tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Àno dukɔwo ƒe notsi àno fiawo ƒe no, eye nàdze sii be nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Xɔnametɔ, wò Ɖela, Yakob ƒe Ŋusẽtɔ la.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Mahe nuwo vɛ na wò: ɖe akɔbli teƒe, matsɔ sika vɛ; ɖe ga yibɔ teƒe, matsɔ klosalo vɛ; ɖe ati teƒe, akɔbli; ɖe kpewo teƒe, ga yibɔ. Matsɔ Ŋutifafa aɖo dzikpɔlawo na wò, eye wò dɔnunɔlawo anye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Womagase ŋutasesẽ ŋkɔ le wò anyigba dzi azɔ o, eye womagagblẽ alo atsrɔ̃ naneke le dukɔa ƒe liƒowo dzi o. Àyɔ wò gliwo be: Xɔname, eye àyɔ wò agbowo be: Kafukafu.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: Ɣe maganye kekeli na wò azɔ le ŋkeke me o, ɣleti magaɖi be xexeme nakɔ na wò le zã me o. Ke boŋ Aƒetɔ anye wò kekeli tegbee, eye wò Mawu anye wò ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Wò ɣe magaɖo to azɔ o, eye wò ɣleti magaɖo xɔ o; elabe Aƒetɔ anye wò kekeli tegbee, eye wò nuxaɣi nu va yi.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Wò dukɔmetɔwo katã anye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo sɔŋ; anyigba la anye wo tɔ tegbee. Ɖe medo wo, wɔ wo be woade bubu ŋunye.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Ameha sue azu ƒome gã, eye ame ʋɛwo azu dukɔ sesẽ. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ. Mana wòava eme kaba, ne ɣeyiɣia de.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ le dzinye elabe Aƒetɔ si ami nam. Edɔm ɖa be matsɔ nya nyui la ayi na ame siwo wole funyafunya wɔmee, edɔm ɖa be mada gbe le ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la ŋu; be maɖe gbeƒã na aboyomenɔlawo be wona ablɔɖe wo, eye magblɔ na gaxɔmenɔlawo be woɖe wo le ga me.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: Ebe maɖe gbeƒã be Aƒetɔ ƒe amenuveƒe ɖo, eye mía Mawu le hlɔ̃ bia ge. Ebe mafa akɔ na konyifalawo katã.

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: Ebe madi nu na ame siwo le konyi fam le Zion: Matsɔ seƒoƒotsihe ɖo atsyɔ̃ na wo ɖe dzowɔ me nɔnɔ teƒe, masi ami si ana be woakpɔ dzidzɔ la na wo ɖe konyifafa teƒe, mana woata atsyɔ̃taɖedzi si anye kafukafu ɖe gbɔgbɔ si gbɔdzɔ la teƒe. Ale woayɔ wo be nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe logotiwo, Aƒetɔ ƒe ati siwo wòdo be yeatsɔ de bubu ye ɖokui ŋu.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Woatso blemaƒedowo woaɖo gbe aɖe gbe glikpowo; woaɖɔ du gbagbãwo me ɖo, eye woaɖɔ dzidzime geɖewo ƒe nu gbegblẽwo ɖo.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Dukɔ bubu me tɔwo anyi miaƒe lãhawo na mi, amedzrowo ade agble na mi, eye woalé be na miaƒe waingblewo.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, woayɔ mi be: Aƒetɔ ƒe nunɔlawo! eye woatsɔ ŋkɔ na mi be: Mía Mawu ƒe subɔlawo. Miaɖu dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo, eye miakpɔ bubu le woƒe kesinɔnuwo me.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Ɖe miaƒe ŋukpe teƒe la, miakpɔ gome zigbɔzi eve. Ɖe vlodoame teƒe la, dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ anye mia tɔ gome. Eya ta le miaƒe anyigba dzi la, miaxɔ teƒeɖoɖo eve. Dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ anye mia tɔ gome tegbee.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Elabe nye Aƒetɔ la, nya dzɔdzɔe medina. Melé fu adzodada kple nu baɖa wɔwɔ. Maxe woƒe nuwɔna ŋu fe na wo pɛpɛpɛ, eye mabla nu mavɔ kpli wo.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Woadze si woƒe dzidzimeviwo le dukɔwo dome kple wo viwo ƒe viwo le amewo dome le afi sia afi. Ame siwo katã kpɔ wo la, adze si wo be wonye dukɔ si Aƒetɔ yra.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Makpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu vevie; nye luʋɔ atso aseye ɖe nye Mawu ŋu, elabe etsyɔ xɔname ƒe avɔ, eye wòdo nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe awu ʋlaya nam abe ale si ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ blaa atsyɔ̃tae alo ale si ŋugbetɔ doa atsyɔ̃ɖonuwoe ene.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Elabe abe ale si anyigba nana be nuwo miena, eye abɔ nana be nuku siwo woƒã ɖe eme miena ene la, nenemae Aƒetɔ Mawu ana nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple kafukafu ado ɖe dukɔwo katã ŋkume.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Le Zion ta, nyemazi ɖoɖoe o, eye le Yerusalem ta, nyemagbɔ ɖe eme o va se ɖe esime woatso afia nɛ wòadze abe kekeli ene, eye eƒe xɔname nabi abe akakati ene.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo akpɔ ale si wotso afia na wò, eye fiawo katã akpɔ wò ŋutikɔkɔe. Woayɔ ŋkɔ yeye si Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ ake nu ayɔ na wò la na wò.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ànye fiakuku si nyakpɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe asi me kple fia ƒe tablanu le wò Mawu ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Womagayɔ wò azɔ be ame si wogbe o, alo woayɔ wò anyigba be nyɔnu si wogblẽ ɖi o. Ke boŋ woayɔ wò be, mekpɔ dzidzɔ le eŋu, eye woayɔ wò anyigba be, srɔ̃nyɔnu; elabe Aƒetɔ kpɔa dzidzɔ le ŋuwò, eye woaɖe wò anyigba abe srɔ̃ ene.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Elabe ale si ɖekakpui ɖea ɖetugbii la, nenema viwò ŋutsuwo aɖe wòe. Ale si ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ kpɔa dzidzɔ le ŋugbetɔ ŋui ene la, nenema wò Mawu akpɔ dzidzɔ le ŋuwòe.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Yerusalem, meɖo dzɔlawo wò gliwo dzi. Womazi ɖoɖoe le ŋkeke me alo le zã me akpɔ o. Mi ame siwo ɖoa ŋku nu dzi na Aƒetɔ, migagbɔ ɖe eme o.

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: Migana eya hã nagbɔ ɖe eme o, va se ɖe esime wòɖo Yerusalem te, eye wòna wòxɔ ŋkɔ le anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ta nu kple eƒe nuɖusi, kpakple eƒe abɔ sesẽ la be: “Nyemagatsɔ wò bli na wò futɔwo woaɖu azɔ o, eye amedzrowo magano wò wain si ŋu nèkpe fu ɖo la azɔ o.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Ke boŋ ame siwo xaa nukuawo la, woawoe aɖu wo, eye woakafu Aƒetɔ. Ame siwo ƒoa wain tsetseawo nu ƒu la, woawoe ano wain le nye kɔkɔeƒe ƒe xɔxɔnuwo.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Mido yi! Mido to agboawo me yi! Midzra mɔ dzi ɖo na dukɔa. Mita mɔ; mido mɔ gã la! Miɖe kpewo ɖa le edzi! Mikɔ aflaga ɖe dzi na dukɔwo.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ɖe gbeƒã wòde anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke be: Migblɔ na Zion vinyɔnu be: “Kpɔ ɖa, wò xɔname gbɔna. Kpɔ ɖa, eƒe fetu kpe ɖe eŋu, eye eƒe teƒeɖoɖo dze eŋgɔ.”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Woayɔ wò be Dukɔ kɔkɔe, Aƒetɔ ƒe ame siwo woɖe, eye woayɔ wò ya be Du si ƒe nya wodina, du si womegblẽ ɖi o.

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Ame kae nye esi le awu dzĩ me gbɔna tso Bozra-du me le Edom? Ame kae wònye le atsyɔ̃wu me le zɔzɔm ŋusẽtɔe? “Nyee! Nyee le gbeƒã ɖem be amewo tɔ dzɔ. Maxɔ wo ɖe agbe kple ŋusẽ!”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta wò awuwo biã ale, eye wò nudodowo le abe wainfiãlawo tɔ ene?

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: “Nye ɖekae fanya wain kple afɔ, dukɔ aɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o. Mezɔ wo dzi kple dziku, eye mefanya wo le dɔmedzoe me. Woƒe ʋu si me woƒe agbe le hlẽ ɖe nye nudodowo ŋu, eye nye awuwo katã ƒo ʋu.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Elabe meɖo hlɔ̃biagbe ɖe dzime, eye ƒe si me maɖe ame la ɖo.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Metsa ŋku; ke nyemekpɔ xɔnametɔ aɖeke o. Nye nu wɔ nublanui na ɖokuinye; ke ame aɖeke meli axɔ nam o. Ale nye ŋutɔ nye alɔ he dziɖuɖu vɛ nam, eye nye dɔmedzoe kpe ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Mefanya dukɔwo le nye dziku me, mena womu aha le nye dɔmedzoe me, eye mekɔ woƒe ʋu ɖe anyigba.” Aƒetɔ wɔ nyui na Israel

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Maxlẽ Aƒetɔ ƒe amenuveve afia. Makafu Aƒetɔ le nu siwo katã wòna mí la ta. Ewɔ dɔmenyo geɖe ŋutɔ na mí, eye wòve Israel-dukɔ la nu, le eƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple amenuveve geɖe la nu.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Elabe egblɔ be: Nyateƒee, nye amewo wonye. Vi siwo maka aʋatso nam o la wonye, eye wòzu woƒe xɔnametɔ.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Ekpe fu kpli wo le woƒe fukpekpewo me. Mawudɔla si fia be yele wo gbɔ la, ɖe wo. Eɖe wo to eƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ me. Ekɔ wo ɖe dzi, eye wòtsɔ wo le blemaŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Ke wodze aglã ɖe eŋu, eye wodo dziku na eƒe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la. Eya ta etrɔ zu woƒe futɔ, eye eya ŋutɔ wɔ avu kpli wo.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Tete woɖo ŋku blemaŋkekewo dzi, ɖo ŋku Mose, eƒe dɔla dzi: Afi ka ame si kplɔ wo kple eƒe alẽhakplɔlawo tso atsiaƒu la le? Afi ka ame si na eƒe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la nɔ wo dome la le?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Ame kae na eƒe ŋutikɔkɔebɔ la do ŋusẽ Mose ƒe nuɖusi, wòma tsiwo me le wo ŋgɔ be wòade ŋkɔ mavɔ eɖokui ŋu?

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: Ame kae kplɔ wo to gogloƒeawoe? Abe sɔ le kegbegbe ene la, womekli nu o.

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe Gbɔgbɔ na wogbɔ ɖe eme abe nyihawo le bali me ene. Alea ye nèkplɔ wò dukɔ la, be nàtsɔ de bubu wò ŋkɔ ŋu. Gbedodoɖa hena nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple kpekpeɖeŋu

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Do mo ɖa tso dziƒo, tso wò bubuteƒe kɔkɔe si nèle, ne nàkpɔ ɖa! Afi ka wò ŋuʋaʋã kple wò ŋusẽ triakɔ la le? Wò dzitsitsi kple wò dɔmetɔtrɔ de megbe le ŋunye.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Evɔ wòe nye mía Tɔ́. Togbɔ be Abraham menya mí o, eye Israel medze si mí o hã la, wò Aƒetɔ, wòe nye mía Tɔ́, eye ŋkɔwòe nye mía Ðela tso gbe aɖe gbe ke.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nu ka ta nèna míetra tso wò mɔwo dzi? Nu ka ta nèna míesẽ dzime, eye míegavɔ̃a wò o? Xa ɖe wò subɔlawo ta, xa ɖe ame siwo nètia be woanyi wò dome la ta, nàgatrɔ va.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Wò dukɔ kɔkɔe la xɔ wò kɔkɔeƒe la ɣeyiɣi ʋɛ aɖe ko; ke azɔ la, míaƒe futɔwo va nya avuzi le wò teƒe kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Míeva zu abe ame siwo dzi mèɖu fia ɖo kpɔ o kple ame siwo ŋu womeyɔ wò ŋkɔ ɖo kpɔ kura o la ene.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: Ao, ɖe nàdze dziŋgɔli aɖi ɖe anyi, be towo nadzo kpèkpekpe le ŋkuwò me

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: abe ale si dzo biaa nake wuwluiwo, eye wònana be tsi fiena wlɔwlɔwlɔ ene la, anye ne àɖe wò ŋkɔ afia wò futɔwo ale be dukɔwo nadzo nyànyanya le ŋkuwò me!

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Esi nèwɔ nu dziŋɔ siwo míekpɔna o la, èɖi va anyi, eye towo ʋuʋu, dzo kpèkpekpe le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Èdoa go ame si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe kple dzidzɔ, ame siwo ɖoa ŋku dziwò le wò mɔwo dzi. Kpɔ ɖa, èdo dziku, eye míewɔ nuvɔ̃. Míenɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me eteƒe didi, ɖe woaɖe mía?

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Mí katã míezu abe ame makɔmakɔwo ene, eye nu dzɔdzɔe siwo katã míewɔ la zu abe avɔ ƒoɖi ene. Mí katã míeyrɔ abe aŋgba ene, eye míaƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo lɔ mí ɖe nu abe yaƒoƒo ene.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke megadoa gbe ɖa na wò alo ʋãa eɖokui be yeaku ɖe ŋuwò o. Elabe èɣla wò ŋkume ɖe mí, eye nède mí asi na míaƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Ke hã, Aƒetɔ, mía Tɔ́ nènye. Míawo la, tsu míenye, eye wòe nye mía mèla. Wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo mí katã míenye.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, mègado dziku akpa o, eye mègaɖo ŋku míaƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo dzi tegbee o. Kpɔ ɖa, ɖo ŋui be wò dukɔ mí katã míenye.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wò du kɔkɔewo va zu gbedadaƒo. Zion zu gbegbe; Yerusalem zu aƒedo.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Dzo fiã míaƒe aƒe kɔkɔe dzeani si me mía tɔgbuiwo kafua wò le la, eye míaƒe teƒe veviwo katã gblẽ.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, ɖe nànɔ anyi ɖekematsɔlemetɔe le nu siawo katã mea? Ðe nàzi kpi awɔ funyafunya mí vevie alea gbegbea?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: Menɔ ŋudzɔ be ame siwo mebiaa tanye sena o la, nadim. Menɔ klalo be ame siwo menɔ diyem o la, nakpɔm. Megblɔ na dukɔ si mesubɔam o la be: “Nyee nye esi! Nyee nye esi!”

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Meke nye abɔwo me ŋkeke blibo la katã ɖo ɖe dukɔ dzeaglã si le nu manyomanyo wɔm, eye wòle eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoɖo ŋudɔ wɔm la.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Ame siawo le dziku dom nam le ŋkunye me edziedzi, elabe wosaa vɔ le abɔwo me, eye wotɔa dzo lifi le anyikpewo dzi.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Wonɔa anyi ɖe yɔdowo me, eye wotsia teƒe ɣaɣlɛwo dɔna le zã. Woɖua halã, eye detsi nyɔŋu le woƒe detsizewo me.

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: Ame siawo gblɔna be: “Nɔ ɖokuiwò si le adzɔge; mègate ɖe ŋunye o, elabe mele kɔkɔe wu wò!” Wonye dzudzɔ le nye ŋɔti me kple dzo si le bibim ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, woŋlɔe ɖi le ŋkunye me: “Nyemazi kpi o, ke maɖo eteƒe. Maɖo eteƒe na wo ẽ, maɖo eteƒe na wo ɖe woƒe akɔ me.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: Maɖo woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo kple wo tɔgbuiwo tɔ siaa teƒe na wo, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe; elabe wotɔ dzo lifi le towo dzi, eye woɖe alɔ me le ŋunye le togbɛwo dzi. Madzidze nu ɖe akɔ me na wo, atsɔ xe nu siwo wowɔ va yi la ƒe fe na wo.”

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Ale si ne amewo kpɔ wain le wain tsetse ƒe kpo me wogblɔna be: ‘Migagblẽe o, elabe yayra le eme la,’ nenemae mawɔ le nye dɔlawo ta. Nyematsrɔ̃ wo katã o.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Mana dzidzimeviwo nado tso Yakob me, eye ame siwo anyi nye towo ƒe dome la nado tso Yuda. Nye ame tiatiawo anyi eƒe dome, eye nye dɔlawo anɔ afi ma.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Saron azu alẽwo ƒe gbeɖuƒe, eye Axor-bali azu afi si lãhawo atsyɔ akɔ ɖo na nye dukɔ si dim la.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: Ke mi ame siwo gblẽ Aƒetɔ ɖi, mi ame siwo ŋlɔ nye to kɔkɔe la be, mi ame siwo ɖo kplɔ̃ na aklama, mi ame siwo ku wain nyuitɔ tre banaa na dzɔgbe la,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: mana miatsi yi nu. Mi katã miabɔbɔ ɖi woawu keŋ. Elabe meyɔ mi, mietɔ o; meƒo nu, mieɖo to o. Ke boŋ miewɔ nu si nye vɔ̃ le ŋkunye me, eye nu si medzea ŋunye o lae mietia wɔ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu gblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo aɖu nu, ke miawo ya dɔ awu mi. Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo ano nu, ke miawo ya tsikɔ awu mi. Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo akpɔ dzidzɔ, ke miawo ya woado ŋukpe mi.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔlawo adzi ha akpɔ dzidzɔ, ke miaƒe dzi ase veve, miado ɣli, eye miaƒe gbɔgbɔ axa nu, miafa avi.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Miagblẽ mia ŋkɔ ɖi na nye ame tiatiawo woatsɔ nɔ ɖiŋu dom na ame, eye Aƒetɔ Mawu awu mi. Ke atsɔ ŋkɔ bubu na eƒe dɔlawo ya.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Ale be ame sia ame si ayra eɖokui le anyigba la dzi la, atsɔ Mawu Nyateƒetɔ la ayra eɖokui, eye ame sia ame si atà nu le anyigba dzi la, atà Mawu Nyateƒetɔ la. Elabe woŋlɔ fu siwo wokpe gbe aɖe gbe la be, eye nye ŋku dzo le wo dzi.” Aƒetɔ awɔ dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, mewɔ dziƒo yeyewo kple anyigba yeye. Womagaɖo ŋku tsãnuwo dzi alo woava susu me o.

english_verse: Celebrate and be glad forever! I am creating a Jerusalem, full of happy people.
translation_verse: Ke mikpɔ dzidzɔ, mitso aseye tegbee le nu si mewɔ la ŋuti. Elabe kpɔ ɖa, mewɔ Yerusalem wònye aseyetsotso, eye emenɔlawo nye dzidzɔ.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Matso aseye ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eye makpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe nye dukɔ ŋu. Avifafa kple konyifaɣli magaɖi woase le eme azɔ o.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Ðevi aɖeke magaxɔ ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖe ko aku le eme o; ame tsitsi aɖeke maku ne eƒe ŋkeke mede o. Elabe ɖevi axɔ ƒe alafa ɖeka hafi aku, eye nuvɔ̃wɔla si xɔ ƒe alafa ɖeka ku la, fiƒodee.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Woatso aƒewo anɔ wo me, eye woade waingble aɖu eme kutsetse.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Ame matso aƒe, ne ame bubu nava nɔ eme o. Ame mado nu, ne ame bubu nava ɖu o. Elabe ale si ati tsinae la, nenema nye dukɔ atsii, eye nye ame tiatiawo aɖu nu si wotsɔ woƒe asi wɔ dɔ kpɔ la metsonu, eteƒe nadidi.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Womawɔ dɔ vlo o, eye womadzi vi wòaku dzɔgbevɔ̃eku o, elabe woanye Aƒetɔ ƒe ame yayrawo ƒe dzidzimeviwo, eye wo viwo anɔ wo ŋu.

english_verse: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
translation_verse: Matɔ, hafi woayɔm. Womaɖe nu le nya me, hafi mase nyaawo o.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Amegãxi kple alẽvi aɖu gbe le wo nɔewo xa. Dzata aɖu gbe abe nyitsu ene, eye ʋuʋudedi anye da ƒe nuɖuɖu. Naneke mawɔ nu vevi alo atsrɔ̃ naneke le nye to kɔkɔe blibo la dzi o. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Dziƒo nye nye fiazikpui, eye anyigba nye nye afɔɖodzinu. Xɔ ka ƒomevie miate ŋu atu nam, eye teƒe kae magbɔ ɖe eme le?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Nye asie metsɔ wɔ nu siawo katã, eya ta tɔnyee nye wo katã. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Ke ame si ŋu malé ŋku ɖo lae nye esi: ame si bɔbɔa eɖokui le gbɔgbɔ me, eye wòvɔ̃a nye nyawo la.”

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: “Ame si wu nyitsu la sɔ kple ame si wu ame. Ame si tsɔ alẽvi sa vɔe la sɔ kple ame si tro kɔ le avu nu. Ame si sa nuɖuɖuvɔ la sɔ kple ame si tsɔ haʋu sa vɔe. Ame si tɔa dzo lifi la sɔ kple ame si kafua trɔ̃. Ale ame siawo wɔa nu si woawo ŋutɔ dina la, eye woƒe luʋɔ kpɔa dzidzɔ le ŋunyɔnu siwo wowɔna la ŋu.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nye hã matia fukpekpe na wo, eye mana nu si wovɔ̃na la nadzɔ ɖe wo dzi. Elabe meyɔ ame; ke ame aɖeke meɖo tom o. Ke boŋ wowɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi le ŋkunye me, eye wowɔ nu si ŋu nyemekpɔ dzidzɔ le o.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ ƒe nya, miɖo to miasee. Aƒetɔ be: “Miawo ŋutɔ mia nɔvi siwo lé fu mi, eye wogbe mi le tanye la be: ‘Mina woade bubu Aƒetɔ ŋu ale be míakpɔ dzidzɔ si miekpɔ.’ Evɔ la, woawo boŋ wole ŋukpe do gee.”

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: “Miɖo to! Hoowɔwɔ aɖe le dua me. Gbe aɖe ɖi tso gbedoxɔ me. Aƒetɔ ƒe gbee! Ele to hem na eƒe futɔwo!”

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: “Edzi vi hafi va lé ku; edzi viŋutsuvi hafi fu va ɖui.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Ame kae se nya sia tɔgbe kpɔ? Ame kae kpɔ nu siawo tɔgbe kpɔ? Ɖe anyigba aɖe ate ŋu adzɔ gbe ɖekaa? Ɖe dukɔ aɖe hã ate ŋu adzɔ le aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka mea? Gake Zion ya lé ku, eye wòdzi viawo enumake.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le biabiam be: Ɖe maʋu vidzidɔ nu, eye womadzi vi oa? Ɖe nye, ame si nana be wodzia vi la, ɖe maxe vidzidɔ nua?” Mia Mawu lae gblɔe.

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: “Mi ame siwo katã lɔ̃ Yerusalem ƒe nya! Mikpɔ dzidzɔ kplii! Mitso aseye ɖe eŋu! Mi ame siwo katã fa konyi kplii. Midzɔ dzi kplii kple aseyetsotso.

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Miwɔ esia ne miano eƒe no, ne wòafa akɔ na mi; ale be mianoe kple dzidzɔ wòade na mi tso eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ la me.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mana nu nadze dzi nɛ abe tɔsisi ene, eye dukɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo ava nɛ abe tɔʋu si gba go ene, eye miano no, woalé mi ɖe axada me, eye mianɔ eƒe ata ta.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Ale si vi nɔ faa akɔ na viae la, nenema mafa akɔ na mii. Woana miaƒe dzi nadze eme le Yerusalem.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Miakpɔe, eye dzi adzɔ mi. Miaƒe ƒuwo amlo abe gbe dama ene. Ekema woadze sii be Aƒetɔ léa be na ame siwo subɔnɛ, eye wòdoa dziku ɖe eƒe futɔwo ŋu.”

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: “Elabe Aƒetɔ ava le dzo me, eye eƒe tasiaɖamwo le abe ahomya ene. Aɖe eƒe dziku afia kple adã, eye wòanyra le dzo ƒe aɖe me.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ atsɔ dzo adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eye wòaɖe eƒe yi ɖe ŋutilãwo katã dzi. Ame siwo Aƒetɔ awu la asɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ.”

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: “Ame siwo kɔa wo ɖokui ŋu, eye wowɔa wo ɖokui dzadzɛ, be yewoage ɖe abɔwo me, hekplɔ nu si le abɔa titina la ɖo, be yewoaɖu halã kple ŋunyɔnu la kpakple afiwo la, wo katã woatsrɔ̃.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: “Elabe menya woƒe dɔwɔnawo kple woƒe susuwo. Megbɔna mava ƒo dukɔwo kple gbegbɔgblɔwo katã nu ƒu, eye woava kpɔ nye ŋutikɔkɔe la.

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: Mawɔ dzesi ɖe wo dome. Maɖo agbetsilawo tso wo dome ɖe dukɔwo, ɖe Tarsis, Put kple Lud, siwo daa aŋutrɔ; ɖe Tubal, Yavan kple ƒukpo siwo le keke didiƒe ʋĩi ke hã dzi. Ame siwo mese ŋkɔnye kpɔ, eye womekpɔ nye ŋutikɔkɔe hã kpɔ o. Woaɖe gbeƒã nye gãnyenye le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Woakplɔ mia nɔviwo katã tso dukɔwo katã dome vɛ abe nunana ene na Aƒetɔ. Woanɔ sɔwo dzi, tasiaɖamwo kple apakawo me, eye bubuwo anɔ tedzisɔwo kple kposɔwo dzi ava Yerusalem, nye to kɔkɔe la dzi. Anɔ abe ale si Israelviwo dea nuɖuɖuvɔsa nu dzadzɛwo me tsɔna vaa Aƒetɔ ƒeme ene. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mawɔ wo dometɔ aɖewo nunɔlawoe, eye ɖewo anye Levi viwo.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Ale si dziƒo yeyeawo kple anyigba yeye si wɔ ge mala la anɔ ŋkunye mee la, nenemae miaƒe dzidzimeviwo kple miaƒe ŋkɔ anɔ anyii.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ava eme be tso dzinu yeye yi dzinu yeye, eye tso dzudzɔgbe yi dzudzɔgbe la, amegbetɔwo katã ava ŋkunye me, asubɔm.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe!

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: “Ne wodzo yina la, woakpɔ ame siwo dze aglã ɖe ŋunye la ƒe kukuawo, elabe woƒe nyéwo maku o, eye dzo si le womem la hã matsi gbeɖe o. Wo kpɔkpɔ anye ŋunyɔ na amegbetɔƒomea katã.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Nya siawo nye Yeremya, Xilkiya vi, ƒe nyawo. Xilkiya nye nunɔla siwo nɔ Anatot le Benyamin-nyigba dzi la dometɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ de gbe asi na Yeremya le Yuda-fia Yosiya, Amon vi la, ŋɔli le eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè wui enelia me.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Egaxɔ gbedeasi esime Yehoyakim, Yosiya vi la, nye fia, va se ɖe Yuda-fia Zedekiya, Yosiya vi la, ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè wui ɖekɛlia ƒe nuwuwu. Ƒe sia ƒe dzinu atɔ̃lia mee woɖe aboyo Yerusalemnɔlawo. Aƒetɔ yɔ Yeremya

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Azɔ Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be:

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Hafi mawɔ wò ɖe nɔwò ƒe dɔme la, menya wò, eye hafi woadzi wò la, mekɔ ŋuwò tsɔ ɖo gbeƒãɖela na dukɔwo.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: “O, Aƒetɔ Mawu, kpɔ ɖa, nyemenya nuƒoƒo o; nyemetsi o.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Mègagblɔ be: ‘Nyemetsi o,’ ke afi sia afi si maɖo wò ɖo la, yi, eye nàgblɔ nya siwo katã magblɔ na wò be nàgblɔ la.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Mègavɔ̃ wo o, elabe meli kpli wò be maɖe wò.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ do asi ɖa, tɔ́ nu nam, eye wògblɔ nam be: “Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ nye nyawo de nuwò me.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ wò ɖo dukɔwo kple fiaɖuƒewo nu egbe, be nàlã nu, agbã nu, nàtsrɔ̃ nu, agblẽ nu, nàtso aƒe, eye nàƒã nu.” Yeremya kpɔ ŋutega eve

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ biam be: “Yeremya, nu ka kpɔm nèle?” Meɖo eŋu be: “Mele ŋutenɔti aɖe kpɔm.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Eya tututue nèkpɔ. Mele ŋute ɖe nye nyawo ŋu, akpɔ egbɔ be wova eme pɛpɛpɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Azɔ Aƒetɔ gaƒo nu nam zi evelia be: “Nu ka kpɔm nègale?” Meɖo eŋu be: “Mele ze aɖe, si le fiefiem, eye wòviã tso dzigbeme ɖo ɖe gbɔnye lɔƒo la, kpɔm.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Dzɔgbevɔ̃e atso dzigbeme lɔƒo adzɔ ɖe anyigba la dzi nɔlawo katã dzi,

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: elabe kpɔ ɖa, mele dukɔ siwo katã le dzigbeme la yɔm. Wo katã woava, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ali eƒe fiazikpui anyi ɖe Yerusalem ƒe agbowo nu. Woaƒo xlã eƒe gliwo katã, eye woatso ɖe Yuda-duwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Mahe to na wo ɖe woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo katã wowɔ hegblẽm ɖi la ta: wotɔ dzo lifi na mawu bubuwo, eye wosubɔ nu siwo woawo ŋutɔ tsɔ asi wɔe la.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, bla ali dzi, tso, eye nàgblɔ nya sia nya si meɖe gbe na wò be nàɖagblɔ na wo la, na wo. Womegadzi ŋɔ na wò o, ne menye nenem o la, mana vɔvɔ̃ naɖo wò boŋ le wo ŋkume.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, nye la, metsɔ wò wɔ du sesẽ, ga yibɔ sɔti kple akɔbligli egbe; ne nàtsi tre ɖe anyigba blibo la, Yuda-fiawo, eƒe amegãwo, eƒe nunɔlawo kple dukɔmetɔwo ŋuti.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Woawɔ avu kpli wò; ke womanɔ te ɖe nuwò o, elabe meli kpli wò be maɖe wò.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be:

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: “Yi ɖakui ɖe to me na Yerusalem be, Aƒetɔ be: Meɖo ŋku wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le wò ɖetugbime, wò lɔlɔ̃ nam abe ŋugbetɔ ene la, dzi. Meɖo ŋku esime nèkplɔm ɖo to gbedadaƒo kple anyigba si dzi womeƒãa nu ɖo o la hã, dzi.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Israel nɔ kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ, eƒe kutsetse ƒe nuŋeŋe gbãtɔe wònye. Ame siwo katã ka asi eŋu la, kpɔ wo tɔ nua, eye vɔ̃ dzɔ ɖe wo dzi.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Israel tɔgbuitɔgbuiwo ƒe nuvɔ̃

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Nu manyomanyo ka mia tɔgbuiwo kpɔ le ŋunye si ta wodzo ʋĩi le gbɔnye, hesubɔ nu dzodzrowo, eye wozu ame ɖigbɔwo?

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Womebia tanye se be, ‘Aƒetɔ, ame si kplɔ mí tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ɖe? Afi ka eya, ame si kplɔ mí to gbedadaƒo, to kegbegbe kple ʋewo me, to kuɖiɖinyigba kple anyigba si dzi viviti tsiɖitsiɖi do ɖo la, to anyigba si dzi ame meto kpɔ o, afi si ame aɖeke mele o la, le?’

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Mekplɔ mi va anyigba wɔnu dzi be miaɖu eƒe kutsetsewo kple nu nyui siwo le edzi. Ke esi mieva la, mieƒo ɖi nye anyigba la, eye mietsɔ nye domenyinu la wɔ ŋunyɔnui.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Nunɔlawo mebia be: ‘Afi ka Aƒetɔ le?’ hã o. Ame siwo si se la le hã, menyam o. Dziɖulawo da vo ɖe ŋunye, gbeƒãɖelawo ɖea gbeƒã le Baal ŋkɔ me, eye wokplɔ nu siwo ŋu viɖe aɖeke mele o la ɖo.” Aƒetɔ tsɔ nya ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋu

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: “Eya ta mawɔ dzre kpli mi, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe, agawɔe kple mia viwo ƒe viwo hã.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: Tso ƒu yi Kipro-ƒukpo dzi, eye nàkpɔ, alo ɖo ame ɖe Kedar, eye nàlé ŋku ɖe nuwo ŋu tsitotsito, ne nàkpɔ ɖa be esia tɔgbe dzɔ kpɔ mahã.

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Ðe dukɔ aɖe ɖɔli eƒe mawuwo kpɔ, togbɔ be menye mawuwo wonye gɔ̃ hã oa? Ke nye dukɔ ya tsɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖɔli nu si ŋu viɖe aɖeke mele o lae.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Elabe nye dukɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi eve: Wogblẽ nye, woƒe agbetsidzɔƒe la ɖi ɖaɖe vudowo na wo ɖokui; vudo gbagbã siwo me tsi mate ŋu atɔ ɖo gbeɖe o la, wonye.” Israel-dukɔ ƒe nuteƒemawɔmawɔ yomedzenu

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: “Israel ɖe, kluvie wònyea? Aƒe mee wodzii ɖo wòva zu subɔvia? Ke nu ka ta wòzu nuléle na futɔwo?

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Dzatawo xlɔ̃, ɖe gbe sesĩe ɖe eŋu. Wona eƒe anyigba zu gbegbe. Wogbã eƒe duwo wozu aƒedo; ame megale wo me o.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Gawu la, Memfistɔwo kple Taxpanxestɔwo kaka wò fiakuku la le tawò.

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Ɖe menye wò ŋutɔe na esia dzɔ ɖe dziwò esi nègblẽ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ɖi, esime wònɔ kplɔwòm le mɔ ta oa?

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wò vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye ahe to na wò, eye wò megbedede le ŋunye abu fɔ wò. Nyae, eye nàdze sii be enye vɔ̃ kple veve be nàgblẽ Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la ɖi. Egbem vɔvɔ̃ petepete.” Aƒetɔ Mawu, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. Israel gbe Aƒetɔ subɔsubɔ

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: “Elabe tso gbe aɖe gbe ke nèŋe wò kɔkuti, tso wò kawo, eye nègblɔ be: ‘Nyemasubɔ o.’ Ẽ, èbɔbɔ ɖe anyi abe gbolo ene le togbɛ kɔkɔ ɖe sia ɖe tame kple ati dama ɖe sia ɖe te.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Evɔ ɖe medo wò abe wainka nyuitɔ si metia tso ka vavãtɔwo dome la ene. Ale ke wɔ nètrɔ zu wainka gbegblẽ, eye nèzu abe gbe me wainka si ŋu viɖe mele o la ene?

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nèle tsi kple adzalẽ nyuitɔ kekeake hã la, wò vodada si zu ɖi le ŋuwò la, le dzedzem le ŋkunye me kokoko. Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: Ale ke wɔ nàte ŋu agblɔ be: ‘Nyemegblẽ ɖokuinye o; nyemedze Baal yome o’? Lé ŋku ɖe wò nuwɔna ŋu le bali la me, ekema àdze si nu si nèwɔ. Èle abe kposɔnɔ ɖidu si le tsa glãla tsam le eƒe mɔ dzi ene.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Lé be na wò afɔ be magatsi ƒuƒlu o; kpɔ wò ve me dzi, be tsikɔ magawu wò o. Ke ègblɔ be: ‘Gbeɖe! Dzodzroe! Elabe melɔ̃ amedzrowo, eye woawo yome manɔ.’ ” Edze be woahe to na Israel

english_verse: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
translation_verse: “Ale si ne wolé fiafi ŋu kpenɛ la, nenema ŋu akpe mi Israel-dukɔa me tɔwo katãe: Miawo ŋutɔ, miaƒe fiawo, amegãwo, nunɔlawo kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo katã.

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: Miawoe gblɔna na ati be: ‘Wòe nye tɔ́nye’, eye miegblɔna na kpe be: ‘Wòe dzim.’ Elabe mietrɔ megbe dem, miedze ŋgɔm o. Evɔ ne miege ɖe fukpekpe me la, miegblɔna be: ‘Tso, nàxɔ na mí!’

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Afi ka miaƒe mawu siwo miewɔ na mia ɖokui la le? Ne miege ɖe fukpekpe me la, mina woatso ava xɔ na mi, ne woate ŋui ko! Yuda, ale si wò duwo sɔ gbɔe la, nenema wò mawuwo hã sɔ gbɔe.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: “Nu ka ta miele dzre wɔm kplim? Mi katã miedze aglã ɖe ŋunye. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Mehe to na mia viwo dzodzro, wometsɔ ɖeke le nye amehehe me o. Miawo ŋutɔ ƒe yie vuvu miaƒe gbeƒãɖelawo abe dzata dɔwuitɔ ene.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: O, dzidzime kae nye esi? Miɖo to miase Aƒetɔ ƒe nya. Gbedadaƒoe menye na Israel loo, alo anyigba si dzi blukɔ do ɖo tsiɖitsiɖi lae menyea? Nu ka tae nye dukɔ le gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Míevo, mímagava gbɔwò azɔ o’?

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Ðe ɖetugbi aŋlɔ eƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo be alo ŋugbetɔ aŋlɔ eƒe srɔ̃ɖewu bea? Ke nye dukɔ ya ŋlɔm be; ŋkekeawo mele xexlẽ me o.”

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: “Ale ke gbegbe nèdze aɖaŋu le ahiãdidi mee! Ale be nèfiaa wò mɔwo nyɔnuvɔ̃ɖiwo gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Gawu la, ame dahe maɖifɔwo hã ƒe ʋu si me agbe le ƒo wò awutewui, miekpɔ wo wonɔ ʋɔ gbãm o. Togbɔ be èwɔ nu siawo katã hã la,

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: ègblɔ be: ‘Nyemeɖi fɔ o. Nyateƒee, eƒe dzi fa.’ Kpɔ ɖa, nye kpli wò míaɖi kodzo elabe ègblɔ be: ‘Nyemewɔ nuvɔ̃ o.’

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Nu ka tae nènɔa wò mɔwo trɔm ko tamemabumabui? Egipte ana ŋu nakpe wò abe ale si Asiria do ŋukpe wòe ene.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Àtrɔ tso afi ma ade mo to kple ŋukpe, elabe Aƒetɔ gbe ame siwo ŋu nèle dzi ɖom ɖo la. Màkpɔ viɖe aɖeke tso wo gbɔ o.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: “Ne ŋutsu aɖe gbe srɔ̃a, eye wòyi ɖaɖe ŋutsu bubu la, ɖe wòagagbugbɔ ayi nyɔnu ma gbɔa? Ɖe megblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba ma vevie ne èwɔe oa? Èwɔ gbolo kple ahiãvi geɖewo tso, hafi nèbe yeatrɔ agava gbɔnye! Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: Fɔ mo dzi nàkpɔ to ƒeƒlewo tame ɖa! Afi kae womedɔ kpli wò le kpɔ o? Èbɔbɔ nɔ mɔ to nɔ wò ahiãviwo lalam abe Arabiatɔ aɖee le ame aɖe lalam le gbedadaƒo ene. Ètsɔ wò gbolowɔwɔ vivivo ƒo ɖi anyigba la.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Esia ta agbafie gbe wɔwɔ, eye adatsi hã megadzana o. Ke wò mo va le abe gbolo tɔ ene; ŋu megakpea wò o.

english_verse: You call me your father or your long-lost friend;
translation_verse: Menye fifi laa ko nèyɔm hegblɔ nam be: ‘Tɔ́nyee nènye, èdze xɔlɔ̃m tso nye ɖevime ke oa?

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: Ðe nàdo dziku ɖaa? Ɖe nye nu agblẽ ŋuwò tegbeea?’ Kpɔ ɖa, nègblɔe baa, gake nèto gbɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo katã nàte ŋui.” Ele be Israel kple Yuda natrɔ dzime

english_verse: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Esime fia Yosiya nɔ zi dzi la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Èkpɔ nu si Israel nuteƒemawɔla ma wɔa? Eyi togbɛ kɔkɔ ɖe sia ɖe tame kple ati dama ɖe sia ɖe te, eye wòwɔ gbolo le afi ma.

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ekpɔ be megbe Israel, nuteƒemawɔla ma, na srɔ̃gbegbalẽe henyae le eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ta hã la, Yuda, Israel nɔvinyɔnu alakpanuwɔla la, mevɔ̃ o; ke boŋ eya hã yi ɖawɔ gbolo.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: Esi gbolowɔwɔ nye nu tsɛ le egbɔ ta la, egblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba la, eye wòwɔ ahasi to ati kple kpewo subɔsubɔ me.
