english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzinu kple ŋunyɔnue dzɔ le anyigba la dzi:

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela ɖea gbeƒã nya siwo mele eme o; nunɔlawo le aƒetɔ ɖum ɖe ame dzi, ale si gbeƒãɖelawo fia woe nu; edze nye dukɔmetɔwo ŋu nenema! Gake nu kae miawɔ ne nu sia nu va wu nu?

english_verse: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Benyamintɔwo lee, misí do le Yerusalem loo! Miku kpẽ le Tekoa, eye mitu aflaga ɖe Bet-Hakerem elabe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ho tso dzigbeme gbɔna. Nu le tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: Alẽkplɔlawo kple woƒe alẽhawo atso ɖe eŋu; woatu avɔgbadɔwo aƒo xlãe. Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe aɖu gbe le enɔƒe.

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: “Midzra ɖo ne míaho aʋa ɖe eŋu! Mitso! Mina míadze wo dzi le ɣeɖota!” “Baba na mí, elabe zã do vɔ; elabe fiẽsi ɖo!”

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: “Mitso! Mina míadze wo dzi le zã me, eye míagbã eƒe fiasãwo.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Mitso eƒe atiwo ƒu anyi, miƒu kpo ɖe Yerusalem ŋu. Eyae nye du si woahe to na; ameteteɖeanyi ɖeɖe koe le eme.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Ale si vudo nana be emetsi nɔa dzidzim ɖaae la, nenema Yerusalem na eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le dzi yimee. Nu vlo wɔwɔ kple ŋutasesẽ ŋkɔ le ɖiɖim le eme. Dɔléle kple abi le ŋkunye me ɖaa.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Yerusalem, kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi nyuie. Ne menye nenem o la, madzo le gbɔwò, eye mawɔ wò gbegbe, afi si ame aɖeke maganɔ o.” Israel-dukɔ dzeaglã la

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la gblɔ be: “Ƒo ƒu Israelvi siwo susɔ la abe waintsetse ene; abe waintsetsexala ene la, gatsɔ asi zɔ alɔawo ŋu.”

english_verse: I have told the people that you, Lord, will punish them, but they just laugh and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ ka maƒo nu na, agbe nya na, be wòasee? Kpɔ ɖa, woƒe to me xe, womate ŋu ase nu o. Kpɔ ɖa, ne wose wò gbedeasi la, eɖia kokoe na wo, medoa dzidzɔ na wo o.

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: Eya ta nye hã medo dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu abe Aƒetɔ ke ene. Medo dzi ʋuu, eglom azɔ. “Ðee ɖe ɖeviwo ŋu le ablɔ me kple ɖekakpuiwo hã ŋu le ƒuƒoƒewo. Woalé srɔ̃ŋutsu kple srɔ̃nyɔnu, ame tsitsi kple amegãɖeɖi siaa.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ woƒe aƒewo ana ame bubuwo, woƒe agblewo kple wo srɔ̃wo hã azu ame bubuwo tɔ. Elabe mado asi ɖa ahe to na anyigba la dzi nɔlawo.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: “Elabe wo katã woklẽa ŋu ɖe viɖe madzɔmadzɔ kpɔkpɔ ŋuti, tso ame gblɔewo dzi va se ɖe ame ŋkutawo dzi, eye tso gbeƒãɖelawo dzi va se ɖe nunɔlawo dzi, ame sia ame nye alakpanuwɔla.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Womelé be na nye dukɔ ƒe abi klɔ nyuie o. Wogblɔna be: ‘Ŋutifafa! Ŋutifafa!’ Esime ŋutifafa aɖeke meli o hafi.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋu kpe wo, esi wowɔ ŋunyɔnuwoa? Kpao, ŋu mekpe wo kura o. Womenya ŋukpe o, eya ta woadze anyi kple anyidzelawo. Ɣesiɣi mehe to na wo la, woaɖe wo ɖa.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Israel gbe Aƒetɔ ƒe mɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Mitsi tsitre ɖe mɔwo to ne miakpɔ nu, eye mibia blemamɔwo ta se afi si mɔ nyuitɔ le, ne miazɔ edzi, ne mia luʋɔwo nakpɔ gbɔdzɔe. Ke woawo gblɔ be: ‘Míele edzi to ge o!’

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Meɖo dzɔlawo na mi hegblɔ be: ‘Milé to ɖe kpẽa ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu!’ Ke woawo gblɔ be: ‘Míele to lé ge ɖe eŋu o!’

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Eya ta mi dukɔwo, misee, mi amehawo, minya nu si gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Anyigba, ɖo to nàsee! Kpɔ ɖa, mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava dukɔ sia dzi le nu si do tso woƒe susu vɔ̃wo me la ta, elabe wometsɔ ɖeke le nye nyawo me o. Nye se ya la, wogbee.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Nu ka dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe donu si wotsɔ tso Seba vɛ, alo gbekee xɔasi, siwo wotsɔ tso didiƒe vɛ la nye nam? Nyemexɔ miaƒe numemevɔsawo o, eye miaƒe akpedadavɔsawo hã medze ŋunye o.

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ be: ‘Maɖo nu ɖi na dukɔ sia wòakli. Wo katã woaku: Vi tɔ́ kple viŋutsu, aƒelika kple xɔlɔ̃ siaa.’ ” Woho aʋa tso dzigbeme gbɔna

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, dukɔ aɖe tso dzigbeme gbɔna. Dukɔ triakɔ aɖe le hohom tso didiƒe aɖe ke.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Da kple akplɔ le wo si. Wosẽa ŋuta, eye womekpɔa nublanui na ame o. Woƒe ʋunyaʋunyawɔwɔ le abe atsiaƒu ƒe hoowɔwɔ ene. Wole sɔwo dom, eye wobla akpa abe aʋawɔla ene. Wodzra ɖo be yewoawɔ aʋa kple wò, Zion vinyɔnu.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Míese nya la; abɔ ge le mía ŋu, ŋɔdzi lé mí, eye míele veve sem, abe funɔ si le ku lém ene.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke megayi agble alo ato mɔ dzi o, elabe yi le futɔ la si, eye ŋɔdzi ƒo xlã mí godoo va kpe.

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: O nye dukɔ vinyɔnu, ta akpanya ne namli le dzowɔ me. Fa konyi vevie, eye nàfa avi hehehe abe ame si viŋutsu ɖeka hɔ̃ ku na ene, elabe nugblẽla le ƒoƒo ge ɖe dziwò kpoyi.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Aglãdzela masetonu wo katã wonye; wo kple ameŋugblẽlawoe zɔna. Wole abe akɔbli kple ga yibɔ ene. Wo katã tim wonye nu fitifiti wɔlawo.

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ke womeɖo tom alo se nye gbe o. Gake wolia kɔ. Wowɔ nu gbegblẽ wu wo tɔgbuiwo.”

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Migaɖo dzi ɖe ameblenya siwo gblɔm wole be: ‘Aƒetɔ ƒe gbedoxɔe nye esia, Aƒetɔ ƒe gbedoxɔe, Aƒetɔ ƒe gbedoxɔe!’ la ŋu o.”

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: “Elabe ne mieɖɔ miaƒe agbenɔnɔ kple nuwɔnawo ɖo tututu, eye ne miedrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe le mia nɔewo dome ɖe eteƒe,

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ekema mana mianɔ teƒe sia, le anyigba si metsɔ na mia tɔgbuiwo tso blema ke la dzi tegbee.”

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, miele dzi ɖom ɖe ameblenya ŋuti dzodzro.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Ɖe mianɔ fi fim, anɔ ame wum, anɔ ahasi wɔm, anɔ atam dzodzro kam, anɔ dzo tɔm lifi na Baal, eye miakplɔ mawu siwo mienya o la ɖo;

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: hafi ava tsi tsitre ɖe ŋkunye me, le aƒe sia, si ŋu woyɔa nye ŋkɔ ɖo la me, agblɔ be: ‘Woɖe mí’ ko miagayi ŋunyɔnu siawo katã wɔwɔ dzia?

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Ðe xɔ sia, si ŋu woyɔa nye ŋkɔ ɖo la, zu adzodalawo ƒe beɖoƒe le mia gbɔa? Kpɔ ɖa, nye ŋutɔ hã mekpɔ nu si wɔm miele. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Azɔ miyi nye teƒe si nɔ Silo, afi si mena nye ŋkɔ nɔ tsã, ne miakpɔ nu si metu kplii le nye dukɔ Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta la ɖa.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Azɔ Aƒetɔ be esi miewɔ nu siawo katã, eye esi meƒo nu na mi atraɖii mieɖo tom o, esi meyɔ mi, mietɔ o ta la,

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: eya ta mawɔ aƒe si ŋu woyɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖo, esi ŋu mieɖoa dzi ɖo kple teƒe si metsɔ na mia kple mia tɔgbuiwo la, abe ale si mewɔ Siloe ene.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Matsɔ mi aƒu gbe tso nye ŋku ta abe ale si metsɔ mia nɔvi siwo katã nye Efrayim ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒu gbee ene.” Israel-dukɔ la ƒe tomaɖomaɖo Mawu

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Ɖe wò ya, mele nu siwo wɔm wole le Yuda-duwo me kple Yerusalem ƒe ablɔwo dzi la kpɔm oa?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Viwo le nake fɔm, wo tɔ́wo le dzo dom, eye wo nɔwo le amɔwɔ blum ne woatsɔ wɔ tatali na nyɔnumawu Dziƒofianyɔnu. Woƒo aha ɖi na mawu bubuwo be yewoatsɔ do dziku nam.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Nyee wole dziku dom naa? Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Ɖe menye woawo ŋutɔe le ŋukpe dom wo ɖokui oa?

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be, kpɔ ɖa, matrɔ nye dziku kple dɔmedzoe helihelĩ akɔ ɖe teƒe sia dzi. Makɔe ɖe amegbetɔ kple lã, gbemetiwo kple kutsetsewo gɔ̃ hã dzi. Abi nu, womate ŋu atsii o.”

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Esi mekplɔ mia tɔgbuiwo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, nyemegblɔ nya aɖeke alo de se na wo le numemevɔsa kple vɔsawo ŋu o.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Ke boŋ mewɔ se sia na wo be: ‘Mise nye gbe, ne manye mia Mawu, eye miawo mianye nye dukɔ, eye mizɔ mɔ si ƒe se mede na mi la dzi, be eme nanyo na mi.’

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Ke wogbe nye gbe sese, eye womeɖo tom o. Ke wozɔ ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aɖaŋu vɔ̃ kple dzimesesẽ nu, eye wozɔ megbemegbee; womeɖe zɔ yi ŋgɔ o.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Tso gbe si gbe mia tɔgbuiwo ʋu tso Egipte-nyigba dzi va ɖo egbe la, meɖoa nye dɔlawo, siwo nye nye gbeƒãɖelawo la, ɖe wo enuenu tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be: ‘Esia nye dukɔ si gbe Aƒetɔ, eƒe Mawu ƒe gbe sese, gbe hehexɔxɔ. Nyateƒetoto vɔ keŋ; womegasenɛ le ame aɖeke nu o. Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le Hinom-bali me

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Milũ miaƒe taɖa, miatsɔ aƒu gbe. Midzi avihɛwo le to ƒeƒlewo tame elabe Aƒetɔ gbe mi, eye wònyà mi, dzidzime, si doa dɔmedzoe nɛ la.’ ”

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Elabe Yudaviwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi le ŋkunye me. Wotsɔ woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo da ɖe xɔ si ŋu woyɔa nye ŋkɔ ɖo la me, ale wogblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Woɖi Tofet-vɔsamlekpui la ɖe Hinom vi ƒe bali la me, ale be woatsɔ wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo asa vɔe le dzo me le afi ma. Nyemegblɔ na wo be woawɔ esia o; meva tame nam gɔ̃ hã kpɔ o.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Eya ta, kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ be ɣeyiɣi aɖe gbɔna esime womagayɔe be Tofet alo Hinom vi ƒe bali azɔ o; ke boŋ woayɔe be Amewubali. Woaɖi ame ɖe afi ma elabe teƒe bubu aɖeke maganɔ anyi woaɖi ame ɖo o.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Dukɔ sia ƒe ame kukuwo azu nuɖuɖu na dziƒoxeviwo kple gbemelãwo siaa, eye ame aɖeke mado vɔvɔ̃ na wo anyà wo ɖa o.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Matsi aseyetsoha, dzidzɔɣli kple ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ kple ŋugbetɔ ƒe dzidzɔkpɔhawo nu le Yuda-duwo me kple Yerusalem ƒe ablɔwo dzi, elabe anyigba la azu gbegbe.”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Ɣe ma ɣi la, woaho Yuda-fiawo, woƒe amegãwo, nunɔlawo kple gbeƒãɖelawo kpakple Yerusalemnɔlawo ƒe ƒuwo tso woƒe yɔdowo me.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Woasia wo ɖe ɣe kple ɣleti kpakple dziƒo ŋu nuwo katã nu. Nu siawo ƒe nya wolɔ̃, eye wosubɔ, nu siawo yome wodze, wodi, eye wode ta agu na. Womaƒo wo nu ƒu loo, alo aɖi wo o. Woazu abe lãmí ene ɖe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Dukɔ vɔ̃ɖi sia ƒe ame siwo katã susɔ ɖe teƒe siwo katã menyà wo ɖo ɖa la, adi be yewoaku boŋ wu be yewoanɔ agbe.” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. Nu vɔ̃ kple tohehe

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be, Aƒetɔ be: “Ne ame dze anyi la, ɖe megafɔna oa? Ne ame aɖe tra mɔ la, ɖe megagbugbɔna oa?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Ke nu ka ta nye dukɔ ya tra mɔ dzo le gbɔnye, eye wògbe kokoko be yemagbugbɔ ava o? Woxɔ ameblenya dzi se, eye wogbe tɔtrɔ.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: Meɖo to nyuie be mase nya aɖe, ke womeƒo nu nyuie o. Ame aɖeke metrɔ dzime tso eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ gbɔ hebia be: ‘Nu kae nye esi mewɔ?’ hã o. Ame sia ame lé eƒe mɔ tsɔ abe sɔ si lũ ɖe aʋa me ene.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Damixe gɔ̃ hã nya eƒe ɣeyiɣi. Nenema ke ahɔnɛ, sagbadre kple tsalɛ nya woƒe ʋuʋuɣi ayi teƒe bubu. Gake nye dukɔ ya menya Aƒetɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo o.”

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: “Ale ke wɔ miegblɔ be: ‘Míenye nunyalawo, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe se la le mía si me?’ Ke mikpɔ ɖa, agbalẽŋlɔlawo ƒe nuŋlɔti trɔ se la wòzu aʋatso.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Ŋu akpe nunyalawo, dzi aɖe le wo ƒo, eye asi atu wo. Kpɔ ɖa, wogbe Aƒetɔ ƒe nya, ke nunya kae le wo si?

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Womelé be na nye dukɔ ƒe abi klɔ nyuie o. Wogblɔna be: ‘Ŋutifafa! Ŋutifafa!’ Esime ŋutifafa aɖeke meli o hafi.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋu kpe wo, esi wowɔ ŋunyɔnua? Kpao, ŋu mekpe wo kura o. Womenya ŋukpe o, eya ta woadze anyi ɖe anyidzelawo ti. Ne mehe to na wo la, woaɖe wo ɖa. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Ɣe si ɣi medi be maƒo wo nu ƒu la, kutsetsewo menɔ wainka la ŋu loo, alo gboti la dzi o. Woƒe aŋgbawo gɔ̃ hã yrɔ, eye nu si metsɔ na wo la ge le wo si.”

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Nu ka tae míegale anyinɔƒe kokoko? Miva ƒo ƒu, mina míyi du sesẽwo me, aɖatsrɔ̃ ɖe afi ma. Elabe Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la, ɖoe be míatsrɔ̃ godoo. Ekpe tsi si me aɖi le la na mí be míano elabe míewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Míele mɔ kpɔm na ŋutifafa, ke nu nyui aɖeke meva o; míele mɔ kpɔm na hayahaya, ke kpɔ ɖa, ŋɔdzi ye.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: “Woƒe sɔwo ƒe gbɔgbɔ fuxefuxe le ɖiɖim tso Dan. Woƒe sɔtsuwo ƒe xɔxlɔ̃ ʋuʋu anyigba blibo la. Wova vuvu anyigba la kple edzinuwo katã, dua kple emenɔlawo siaa.

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Elabe, kpɔ ɖa, mele dawo, dakpui siwo ŋu gbesa mate ŋu aɖi o la ɖom ɖe mia dome, eye woaɖu mi.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Yeremya xa nu ɖe eƒe dukɔ ta

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Naneke matsi nye nuxaxa nu o; nu te nye dzi ŋu le menye.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Ɖo to nàse nye dukɔ vinyɔnu ƒe ɣli ɖa! Ele ɖiɖim le anyigba la ƒe afi sia afi be: “Ɖe Aƒetɔ mele Zion oa? Ɖe eƒe Fia la mele eme oa?” “Nu ka tae wodo dziku nam kple woƒe aklama kpakpɛwo kple dutalegbawo?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: “Nuŋeɣi va yi, dzomeŋɔli wu nu; ke womexɔ na mí o!”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Elabe abi si nye dukɔ vinyɔnu xɔ na nye dzi gbã. Mexa nu ʋuu; dzi ɖe le ƒonye keŋ.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Ɖe atike aɖeke mele Gilead oa? Gbedala aɖeke mele afi ma oa? Ke nu ka ta womada gbe le nye dukɔ vinyɔnu ŋu o?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Ko wòanye nye ta nanye tsidzɔƒe, nye ŋkuwo nanye vudo, anye ne manɔ avi dzi zã kple keli na nye dukɔ vinyɔnu si wowu la.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe makpɔ mɔzɔlawo ƒe dzeƒe aɖe le kegbegbe la, anye ne megblẽ nye dukɔ ɖi, ʋu dzo le wo gbɔ, elabe ahasiwɔla ametetola ƒe ha wo katã wonye.

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Woƒe aɖe le klalo na aʋatsokaka abe dati me wovu ene. Ale aʋatsokaka kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe anyigba la dzi ɖe nyateƒetoto teƒe. Wotsona le nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖeka gbɔ yia bubu gbɔ, eye womedze sim o, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame flua ehavi, eye ame aɖeke metoa nyateƒe o. Wofia aʋatsokaka woƒe aɖe, wowɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi, eye ŋusẽ megale wo ŋu be woatrɔ dzime o.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Ametete ɖe anyi le dzidzim, gale dzidzim ɖe edzi, eye amebeble le agbɔ sɔm, gale agbɔ sɔm ɖe edzi; wogbe sidzedzem, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Kpɔ ɖa, malólo wo abe ga ene, eye mado wo akpɔ. Elabe nu kae magate ŋu awɔ na nye dukɔ?

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Woƒe aɖe nye aŋutrɔ wuame; eblea ame. Ame sia ame kea nu gblɔa nya na ehavi bɔkɔɔ; ke eɖo nugbe ɖe eŋu le dzime.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Ðe nyemahe to na wo le esiawo ta oa? Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Ðe nye ŋutɔ nyemabia hlɔ̃ dukɔ sia tɔgbe oa?”

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: “Fa avi kple ɣli na towo, eye nàdzi avihɛ na gbegbe siwo nye lãnyiƒe; elabe wogblẽ, eye amegbetɔ aɖeke megatoa teƒe mawo o. Womegasea nyihawo ƒe xɔxlɔ̃ o; dziƒoxeviwo kple gbemelãwo siaa ʋu dzo.

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Mawɔ Yerusalem wòazu glikpo ɖi, anye akpatakuwo nɔƒe. Mawɔ Yuda-duwo woazu gbegbe; amegbetɔ maganɔ afi ma o.”

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: Ame kae nya nu ale gbegbe be wòate ŋu ase nu sia gɔme? Ame kae Aƒetɔ ke nu gblɔ nya sia na be wòagblɔ? Nu ka tae anyigba la gblẽ hezu gbedadaƒo alea, ale be ame aɖeke megatoa edzi yina o?

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu be: “Elabe wogblẽ nye se si mede na wo la ɖi, eye womeɖo to nye gbe hezɔ ɖe enu o;

english_verse: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wosẽ dzime, eye wosubɔ Baalwo abe ale si wo tɔgbuiwo fia woe ene.

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: Kpɔ ɖa, mana gbe veve dukɔ sia wòaɖu, eye makpe tsi si me aɖi le la nɛ wòano.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Makaka wo ahlẽ ɖe dukɔ siwo ƒe ŋkɔ woawo kple wo tɔgbuiwo siaa mese kpɔ o la dome. Mada aʋakɔ ɖe wo ŋu be woatsrɔ̃ wo va se ɖe esime woavɔ ɖa keŋkeŋ.” Yerusalemnɔlawo do ɣli be woaxɔ na yewo

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Mibu eŋu ne miayɔ nyɔnu avifalawo vɛ. Miɖo ame ɖe nyɔnu siwo nya avihadzidzi nyuie ne woava.

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Mina woawɔ kaba ado aviha ɖa na mí, ne míaƒe ŋkuwo nafa aɖatsi blobloblo, eye míaƒe aɖaba naƒo tsi belee.

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Elabe wose aviɣli le ɖiɖim ɖaa le Zion be: ‘Wotsrɔ̃ mí! Wodo ŋukpe mí vevie! Elabe míeʋu le anyigba la dzi elabe womu mía nɔƒewo ƒu anyi.’ ”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Nyɔnuwo, mise Aƒetɔ ƒe nya! Mina eƒe numenya nage ɖe miaƒe towo me. Mifia avihɛ mia vinyɔnuwo, eye ame sia ame nefiae ehavi.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Elabe ku to fesre ge ɖe mía gbɔ, ge ɖe míaƒe fiasãwo me. Ele mía viwo wum le ablɔwo dzi, eye wòle míaƒe ɖekakpuiwo tsrɔ̃m le kpɔdomeewo.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ be: ‘Ame kukuwo akaka ɖe anyigba abe gbeɖuɖɔ le agble me ene. Woanɔ abe lubabla si tsi nuŋela yome, eye ame aɖeke meli aƒo wo nu ƒu o la ene.’ ”

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Ke ame si be yeaƒo adegbe la, neƒoe be yese nu gɔme, eye yedze sim be nyee nye Aƒetɔ, ame si vea ame nu, drɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe le anyigba la dzi; elabe nu siawoe doa dzidzɔ nam.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Mahee na Egipte, Yuda, Edom, Amonviwo, Moab kple ame siwo katã le kegbegbe, ƒlɔa ta kolikoli la hã. Elabe dukɔ siawo katã nye bolobolotɔwo, eye Israel-dukɔ blibo la meɖe eƒe dzi ƒe aʋanuyi ɖa o.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Migasrɔ̃ dukɔwo ƒe nuwɔna o. Dzesi siwo dzena le dziŋgɔli me la, megaɖe dzi le mia ƒo o, elabe woɖea dzi le dukɔwo ƒo.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Elabe dukɔwo ƒe kɔnyinyiwo nye alakpanuwɔwɔ. Wotsoa ati le ave me, eye aɖaŋunukpala tsɔa fíavi trɔa asi le eŋuti.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Amewo tsɔa klosalo kple sika ɖoa atsyɔ̃ nɛ. Wotsɔa zu ƒoa gatagbadzɛ ɖee sesĩe be magaʋã o.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Woƒe legbawo le abe nu siwo nyaa xeviwo le dzamatregble me ene. Womete ŋu ƒoa nu o; ele be woakɔ wo elabe womete ŋu zɔna o. Migavɔ̃ wo o, elabe womate ŋu awɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke o, eye nu nyui wɔwɔ ƒe ŋutete hã mele wo ŋu o.”

english_verse: Our Lord, great and powerful, you alone are God.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ame aɖeke mede nuwò o; èlolo, eye wò ŋusẽ na wò ŋkɔ dzi ŋɔ.

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe Fia, ame kae mavɔ̃ wò o? Elabe esia koe dze wò; elabe le dukɔwo ƒe nunyalawo katã dome, eye le woƒe fiaɖuƒewo katã me la, ɖeke meli si le abe wò ene o.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Wo katã wodzɔ lã, wonye bometsilawo. Nu ka koŋ woate ŋu asrɔ̃ tso legba siwo nye ati kpakpɛwo gbɔ?

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ klosalo si woƒo gbabɛ la tso Tarsis vɛ, wotsɔ sika tso Ofir vɛ. Wonye aɖaŋudɔwɔla ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ kple sikaɖaŋudɔwɔla ƒe dɔ. Wota aɖabɛvɔ blɔtɔ kple dzĩtɔ siwo katã avɔlɔ̃lawo lɔ̃ aɖaŋutɔe la na wo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ nye Mawu nyateƒetɔ la. Enye Mawu gbagbe kple Fia si li tegbee. Ne edo dɔmedzoe la, anyigba ʋuʋuna. Ne dzi kui la, dukɔwo metea ŋu nɔa te ɖe enu o.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Ke gblɔ na wo be: “Mawu siwo mewɔ dziƒo kple anyigba o la, atsrɔ̃ le anyigba dzi kple le dziƒoa te.” Kafukafuha na Mawu

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Eyae wɔ anyigba kple eƒe ŋusẽ, etsɔ nunya ɖo xexea me gɔme anyi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe nugɔmesese keke dziƒo me.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Ne eɖe gbe la, dziŋgɔli me tsiwo dzea agbo. Enana be afu dona yia dzi tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke. Ewɔ dzikedzo na tsidzadza, eye wònana be ya dona tso eƒe nudzraɖoƒe.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame dzɔ movi, eye medze si nu o. Sikanutula ɖe sia ɖe ƒe legbawo doa ŋukpee, elabe nu siwo wòtu la nye alakpa; agbe mele wo me o.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nu dzodzro siwo nye kpɔfufluwo la wonye. Gbe si gbe woahe to na wo la, woatsrɔ̃.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Yakob ƒe gomekpɔla ya mele abe woawo ene o. Elabe eyae wɔ nuwo katã, eye Israel-to la nye eƒe domenyinu. Eŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la. Aboyo me yiɣi gbɔna

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo ŋu woɖe to ɖo, miƒo ƒu miaƒe agbawo miakɔ tso anyigba.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ anyigba sia dzi nɔlawo aƒu gbe azɔ. Mana woakpe fu, eye woasee le wo ɖokui me.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: “Baba nam le nu vevi si wɔm la ta. Abi la le veyem! Ke megblɔ be: Fukpekpe sia dze nam vavã, ɖeko mado dzi atsɔe.”

english_verse: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
translation_verse: Wogblẽ nye agbadɔ, eye wotso eŋu kawo katã. Vinyewo dzo le gbɔnye; womegali o. Ame aɖeke megali atu nye agbadɔ nam, eye wòatsi nye agbadɔvɔwo o.

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Elabe kplɔlaawo dzɔ lã, eye womebia gbe Aƒetɔ o. Eya ta nu medze edzi na wo o, eye woƒe alẽhawo katã ka hlẽ.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Miɖo to miase ɖa! Wobewobe aɖe le ɖiɖim! Kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna! Hoowɔwɔ gã aɖe le ɖiɖim tso dukɔ si le dzigbeme la gbɔ gbɔna. Woawɔ Yuda-duwo woazu gbegbe, akpatakuwo nɔƒe.

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, menyae be amegbetɔ ƒe mɔ mele eya ŋutɔ si me o, eye mele amegbetɔ ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutete me be wòafia mɔ eɖokui o.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, he to nam ke megagbɔ eme o! Menye le dɔmedzoe me o! Ne menye nenem o la, matsrɔ̃ keŋkeŋ!

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dɔmedzoe la kɔ ɖe dukɔ siwo medze si wò kple ame siwo mesubɔa wò o la dzi. Elabe woamawoe vuvu Yakob. Wovuvui, eye wotsrɔ̃e gbidigbidi; eƒe nɔƒewo zu gbegbe.

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: ‘Woaƒo fi de ame si mewɔ ɖe nubabla sia ƒe nyawo dzi o,

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: nu si mebla kple mia tɔgbuiwo esi mekplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, tso ga yibɔ lóloƒe la. Megblɔ na wo be miɖo to nye gbe, eye miwɔ nu siwo katã megblɔ na mi la. Ale mianye nye dukɔ, eye nye la, manye miaƒe Mawu.

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: Ekema mawɔ atam si meka na mia tɔgbuiwo be matsɔ anyigba si dzi notsi kple anyitsi le la na wo abe ale si wòsu mia si egbe ene.” Tete meɖo eŋu be: “Aƒetɔ, neva eme!”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Yi ɖe Yuda-duwo me kple Yerusalem ƒe ablɔwo dzi ne nàɖe gbeƒã gbedeasi la na wo be: Mise nya siwo ku ɖe nubabla la ŋu, eye miawɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Elabe megbe nya na mia tɔgbuiwo vevie, esi mekplɔ wo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, be woaɖo tom. Mexlɔ̃a nu wo edziedzi va ɖo egbe be, miɖo tom.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Gake wogbe toɖoɖo, gbe nusese. Wo katã wosẽ dzime, eye wowɔ ɖe woƒe dzi vɔ̃ɖi kuatri nu. Eya ta mena fiƒode siwo katã ŋu meƒo nu le, le nubabla la me la, ɖi wo ŋu.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
