english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Wogatrɔ yi wo tɔgbuiwo ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo gbɔ, ame siwo gbe toɖoɖo nye nyawo. Wodze mawu bubuwo yome le subɔsubɔm. Israel-dukɔ kple Yuda-dukɔ siaa tu nu, si mebla kple wo tɔgbuiwo la.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, mana dzɔgbevɔ̃e nadzɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye womate ŋu así le enu o. Woayɔm kple ɣli, ke nyemaɖo to wo o.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Elabe, o Yuda, wò mawuwo va sɔ gbɔ abe wò duwo ene, eye abe ale si Yerusalem ƒe ablɔwo sɔ gbɔe ene la, nenemae nèɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo ŋukpenatɔe be yeatɔ dzo lifi le wo dzi na Baal.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: “Eya ta mègado gbe ɖa ɖe dukɔ sia ta o; mègado gbe ɖa be yeaɖe kuku alo aƒo koko ɖe wo ta o. Elabe ne woxaxa, eye wodo ɣli yɔm la, nyemasee na wo o.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ kae gale nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ si le nye aƒeme, esi wòwɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi siawo? Ɖe adzɔgbeɖeɖe kple vɔsalã kɔkɔewo axe mɔ na gbegblẽ si le dziwò va gea? Ɖe miate ŋu akpɔ dzidzɔa?

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ yɔa wò tsã be: Amiti dama si tse ku nyuiwo. Ke atɔ dzoe, eye eƒe alɔwo afiã keŋkeŋ le ahomya sesẽ me.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, ame si ɖo gɔwòme anyi la, ƒo fi de wò le nuvɔ̃ɖi si Israel-dukɔ kple Yuda-dukɔ la wɔ, esi wotɔ dzo lifi na Baal tsɔ do dɔmedzoe nam ta.” Woɖo nugbe ɖe Yeremya ƒe agbe ŋu

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ na be manyae, eye menyae. Ale nèɖe woƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo fiam.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, mele abe alẽvi fafa si wokplɔ yina wuwu ge la ene. Nyemenya be ŋunyee woɖo nugbe ɖo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Mina míatsrɔ̃ ati la kple eƒe tsetse, mina míaɖee ɖa le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi ale be womagaɖo ŋku eŋkɔ dzi azɔ o.”

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la dzɔdzɔetɔ! Wòe doa dzimesusuwo kple tamesusuwo kpɔna. Asiwò mee metsɔ nye nyawo dee, eya ta bia hlɔ̃ ame siawo makpɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ gblɔ le Anatotitɔ siwo le wò ku dim, eye wogblɔ be: “Mèganɔ gbeƒã ɖem le Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ me o. Ne ègayi edzi la, àtsi mía si me.” la ŋu be:

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, mahe to na wo. Woƒe ɖekakpuiwo atsi yi nu le aʋa me, eye woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple nyɔnuviwo aku le dɔwuame ta;

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: wo dometɔ aɖeke masusɔ o. Elabe mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e ava Anatotitɔwo dzi le ƒe si me meɖo be mahe to na wo la.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, ne metsɔ nya ɖe ŋuwò hã la, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlae nènye. Ke hã la, medi be mabia nya wò le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ŋuti. Nu ka tae ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ dzea edzi na wo? Nu ka ta eme nyona na nu fitifiti wɔlawo katã ɖo?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Èɖo wo gɔme anyi, eye woto ke. Wotsi hetse ku. Èle woƒe nu me kpokploe; ke woƒe dzi ya le adzɔge ʋĩi tso gbɔwò.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, wò la, èdze sim; èkpɔa nye nuwɔna, eye nèdoa nye susu kpɔ, nya ale si wòtrɔ ɖe ŋuwòe. He wo yii, abe alẽ siwo wu ge woyina la ene, eye nàɖo wo ɖi hena wuwugbe.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ɣe ka ɣi anyigba axa nu ase, eye gbe aƒu le agble me ase ɖo? Elabe le edzinɔlawo ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta la, lãwo kple xewo le tsɔtsrɔ̃m. Elabe amewo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Mawu makpɔ ale si wòava nɔ na mí mlɔeba o.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: “Ne èke duɖime kple afɔzɔlawo, eye wona ɖeɖi te ŋuwò la, ale ke nàhayi duɖime ke ge kple sɔwoe? Ne èle anyi dzem le anyigba si dzi nèle dedie le la, ale ke wɔ ge nàla le Yordan ƒe ave dodowo me?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Elabe wò ŋutɔ nɔviwòwo kple tɔ́wò ƒemetɔwo gɔ̃ hã wɔ nu fitifiti ɖe ŋuwò. Togbɔ be wole vivi dom ɖe ŋuwò, le nya viviwo gblɔm na wò hã la, mègaxɔ wo dzi se o.” Aƒetɔ xa nu le eƒe dukɔ ta

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: “Megbe nu le nye aƒe la gbɔ; megblẽ nye domenyinu la ɖi. Metsɔ ame si nye luʋɔ lɔ̃na la de asi na eƒe futɔwo.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: Nye domenyinu zu nam abe dzata le ave me ene. Ele gbe tem ɖe ŋunye, eya ta melé fui.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Ðe nye domenyinu la mele nam abe xe ƒonu ŋɔŋɔe ene oa? Ɖe xe ƒonu bubu siwo ƒo xlãe godoo la tso ɖe eŋua? Miyi ɖaƒo ƒu gbemelãwo katã! Mikplɔ wo vɛ ne woava vuvu nu.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Alẽkplɔla geɖewo gblẽ nye waingble. Wonyà avuzi le nu si nye tɔnye dzi, eye wowɔ tɔnye gome si doa dzidzɔ nam la wòva zu gbedadaƒo ɖeɖe sɔŋ.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Le to ƒeƒlewo katã tame le kegbegbewo, nugblẽlawo do; elabe Aƒetɔ na eƒe yi le nu gblẽm tso anyigba ƒe go ɖeka dzi yi go kemɛ dzi; ŋutilã aɖeke mekpɔ ŋutifafa o.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Woƒã lu, ke ŋue woxa. Woku kutri, ke womekpɔ viɖe aɖeke o. Le Aƒetɔ ƒe dziku si wòdo vevie ta la, nuku si woaŋe la akpe ŋu na wo.” Aƒetɔ do ŋugbe na dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã Israel

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ tso dukɔ vɔ̃ɖi siwo katã ƒo xlã, eye woka asi nye domenyinu si metsɔ na nye dukɔ Israel la ŋu be: “Kpɔ ɖa, maho wo ɖa tso woƒe anyigba dzi, eye maho Yuda-to la ɖa le wo dome.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Ne meho wo ɖa vɔ megbe la, magakpɔ nublanui na wo. Mana wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nagbugbɔ yi eƒe domenyinu gbɔ, eye ame sia ame ayi eya ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Ava eme be ne wodo vevie nu, eye wosrɔ̃ nye dukɔ ƒe mɔwo, ne woaka atam le nye ŋkɔ me be: ‘Zi ale si Aƒetɔ le agbe la’ abe ale si woawo hã fia nye dukɔ be wòata Baal ene la, ekema mana woawo hã nadzi ɖe edzi le nye dukɔ la me.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ke ne dukɔ aɖe meɖo to o la, mahoe ɖa ahatsrɔ̃e gbidigbidi.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Yi nàɖaƒle aklala, avɔ saɖeali, nàsa ɖe ali; mègadee tsi me o.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Ale meyi ɖatso avɔ la sa ɖe ali abe ale si Aƒetɔ la gblɔe ene.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gaƒo nu nam zi evelia be:

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Ɖe avɔ si nèƒle hesa ɖe ali la; tso nàyi ɖaɣlae ɖe kpeto me le Frat-tɔsisi la to.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke geɖe megbe la, Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Tso nàyi Frat-tɔsisi la to nàɖatsɔ avɔ saɖeali si mebe nàɣla ɖe afi ma la.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Ale meyi Frat-tɔsisi la to, eye meku teƒe si meɣla avɔ saɖeali la ɖo la. Kpɔ ɖa, avɔ la nyunyɔ keŋ; meganyo na naneke o.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be:

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Alea tututu magblẽ Yuda ƒe dàda kple Yerusalem ƒe dàda gã lae.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Dukɔ vɔ̃ɖi sia si gbe toɖoɖom, si sẽ dzime, eye wòwɔa nu si dze eŋu, dzea mawu bubuwo yome hesubɔa wo la, anɔ abe avɔ saɖeali sia ene; maganyo na naneke o.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ be: Ale si avɔ saɖeali nɔa ali na ame sesĩe la, nenemae mena Israel-dukɔ blibo la kple Yuda-dukɔ blibo la lé ɖe ŋunyee. Mewɔ esia be woanye dukɔ, ŋkɔ, kafukafu kple bubu nam; ke wogbe toɖoɖo.” Waingoe la

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Gblɔ nya sia na wo: “Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: ‘Ele be nàku wain ɖe goe ɖe sia ɖe me wòayɔ banaa.’ Woabia wò be: ‘Ɖe míenya be wokua wain ɖe goe me wòyɔna banaa oa?’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Ekema nàgblɔ na wo be: ‘Aƒetɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, matsɔ ahamumu fũu ayɔ anyigba sia dzi nɔlawo katã: Fia siwo le David ƒe zi dzi, nunɔlawo, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo kple Yerusalemnɔlawo katã.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Matsɔ wo axlã ɖe wo nɔewo, vi kple tɔ́ siaa. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Nyemakpɔ nublanui loo, alo aɖe ame aɖe le eme loo, alo nye dɔme nàtrɔ ɖe ame aɖe ŋu be magbe etsɔtsrɔ̃ keŋkeŋ o.’ ” Yeremya gbe nya na dukɔ la le dàda ŋu

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ɖo to nàse nya la; mèganɔ dàdam o. Elabe Aƒetɔ ye ƒo nu.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Mide bubu Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ŋu, hafi wòana viviti nado, hafi miakli nu le towo dzi ne ɣe gbã amigo, eye ne miele mɔ kpɔm na kekeli la, wòatrɔe wòazu viviti, eye wòawɔe wòanye blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ke ne miegbe toɖoɖo la, nye luʋɔ afa avi le adzame le miaƒe dàda ta. Nye ŋkuwo afa avi hehehe, eye aɖatsi ado le ŋkume nam yoyoyo elabe wokplɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe alẽha la yi aboyo me.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na fia kple nyɔnufia be: “Miɖi le miaƒe zi dzi elabe miaƒe atsyɔ̃fiakuku la ge le mia ta.”

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Wotu du siwo le anyigbemekegbegbe la ƒe agbowo, eye ame aɖeke meli aʋu wo o. Woɖe aboyo Yuda-dukɔ la katã; wo katã woyi aboyo me.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: “Fɔ mo dzi, eye nàkpɔ ame siwo gbɔna tso dzigbeme ɖa! Afi ka alẽha si dzi wobe nàkpɔ la le? Wò alẽha si nyakpɔna la ɖe?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Nu ka nàgblɔ ne woɖo ame siwo wò ŋutɔ nèfia nu, hedze xɔlɔ̃ wo la, wò tatɔwoe? Ɖe màse veve abe nyɔnu si le ku lém la ene oa?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ne èbia le wò dzime be: ‘Nu ka ta nu siawo dzɔ ɖe dzinye? la,’ wò nu baɖa gbogboawo wɔwɔ tae woklo avɔ le ŋuwò, eye wogblẽ wò ɖo.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Ðe ame aɖe ate ŋu trɔ eƒe ŋutigbalẽ alo lãkle natrɔ eƒe agbalẽ ŋɔtaŋɔtaa? Ekema mi ame siwo nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ma la, ɖe miate ŋu awɔ nu nyuiea?

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Makaka mi ahlẽ abe nutsro ye ya le ƒoƒom le kegbegbe ene.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be esia nye tɔwò gome si wodzidze na wò be nàxɔ la, elabe èŋlɔm be, eye nèɖo dzi ɖe alakpanuwo ŋu.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ maklo wò avɔ aƒu mo na wò, eye woakpɔ wò ŋukpeƒe.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: Mekpɔ wò ŋunyɔnuwo, wò ahasiwɔwɔwo kple wò asiyɔgbe abe sɔtsu ene; wò gbolowɔwɔ vivivo le togbɛwo dzi kple agblewo me. Yerusalem, baba na wò! Ɣe ka ɣi gɔ̃ woana ŋuwò nakɔ?”

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Eƒe bubumewo dɔa wo subɔlawo ɖa be woadu tsi vɛ. Woyia vudoa gbɔ, ke womekpɔa tsi o, eye wotrɔna gbɔna kple ze ƒuƒluwo. Ŋukpe léa wo wotɔtɔna, eye wotsyɔa nu ta.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Esi tsi megale dzadzam o, eye anyigba ƒu ta la, ŋukpe lé agbledelawo, eye wotsyɔ nu ta.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Zinɔ si dzi vi fɛ̃ gɔ̃ hã gblẽa vidzĩa ɖi dzona le egbɔ elabe gbe mumu aɖeke meli o.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Gbetedziwo tsia tsitre ɖe to ƒeƒlewo tame noa ya abe akpatakuwo ene. Nu tea woƒe ŋku ŋu, elabe gbe mumu aɖeke meli o.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be míaƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiawo le ɖase ɖim le mía ŋu hã la, xa ɖe wò ŋkɔ ta nàxɔ na mí. Elabe míaƒe megbedede le ŋuwò sɔ gbɔ, eye míewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: Wòe nye Israel ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ; eƒe xɔnametɔ le xaxa me. Nu ka ta nànɔ anyigba la dzi abe amedzro ene, alo abe mɔzɔla si atsi adɔ, afɔ adzo ene?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nèbe yeanɔ abe ŋutsu si tɔtɔ la ene, alo abe kalẽtɔ si mate ŋu axɔ na ame o la ene? Aƒetɔ, èle mía dome ɖe! Wò ŋkɔe woyɔna ɖe mía ŋu. Mègagblẽ mí ɖi o.”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ le dukɔ sia ŋu be: “Wolɔ̃a tsa glãla tsatsa alea; womeɖua wo ɖokui dzi tɔna ɖe teƒe ɖeka o, eya ta woƒe nu medzea Aƒetɔ ŋu o. Azɔ la, aɖo ŋku woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔwo dzi, eye wòahe to na wo le woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Mègaɖe kuku nam be mawɔ nyui na dukɔ sia o.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wotsi nu dɔ gɔ̃ hã la, nyemase woƒe ɣli o. Togbɔ be wosa numemevɔ kple nuɖuɖuvɔ hã la, womadze ŋunye o. Ke boŋ matsɔ aʋawɔwɔ, dɔwuame kple dɔ vɔ̃ atsrɔ̃ woe.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: “O Aƒetɔ Mawu, kpɔ ɖa, gbeƒãɖelawo le gbɔgblɔm na wo be: ‘Aʋawɔwɔ kple dɔwuame matsrɔ̃ mi o, ke boŋ mana ŋutifafa si ŋu kakaɖedzi le la mi le teƒe sia.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Aʋatso kam gbeƒãɖela mawo le le nye ŋkɔ me. Nyemedɔ wo loo, alo ɖe gbe na wo o. Nyemegblɔ nya aɖeke na wo hã o. Ŋutega si wogblɔ na mi be yewokpɔ la metso gbɔnye o, eye nya siwo gblɔm wole ɖi la, menye nye nyawoe o. Wole gbeƒã ɖem alakpaŋutega, afakaka maɖevi kple woawo ŋutɔ ƒe susu siwo ble wo la.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ be gbeƒãɖela siwo nyemedɔ o, evɔ woyi ɖale gbeƒã ɖem le nye ŋkɔ me be: ‘Aʋawɔwɔ kple dɔwuame mele anyigba sia dzi va ge o’ la, mana woamawo atsi aʋa, eye dɔwuame atsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Dɔwuame kple aʋawɔwɔ atsrɔ̃ ame siwo wogblɔ nya siawo na la hã, eye woatsɔ wo aƒu gbe ɖe Yerusalem ƒe ablɔwo dzi, ame aɖeke maɖi wo o: Woawo ŋutɔ, wo srɔ̃wo, wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo siaa. Mahe to na wo vevie ɖe woƒe vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye nu.

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Gblɔ nya sia na wo be: ‘Na nye ŋkuwo nafa aɖatsi yoo zã kple keli, mègana woadzudzɔ o. Elabe wode abi nye dukɔ si nye ɖetugbi leaƒe la ŋu vevie. Abia lolo; wowɔ nu vevi gã aɖee.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Ne meyi gbe me la, kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔa ame tsiaʋawo ƒe ŋutilãwo le afi ma. Ne mege ɖe dua me la, kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔa ame siwo le kukum le dɔwuame ta la hã le afi ma. Elabe gbeƒãɖela kple nunɔla siaa le woƒe dɔwo wɔm le anyigba la dzi, eye womenya nu si wɔm wole la o.’ ” Dukɔ la ƒo koko na Aƒetɔ

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Ɖe nègbe Yuda-dukɔa godogodoa? Ðe wò luʋɔ lé fu Ziontɔwoa? Nu ka tae nèƒo mí alea, be dɔyɔyɔ mí megali o? Míele mɔ kpɔm na ŋutifafa, ke nu nyui aɖeke meva o. Míele mɔ kpɔm na hayahaya, ke kpɔ ɖa, ŋɔdzi koe li.

english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, míedze si míaƒe vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye kple mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ elabe míewɔ vɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Le wò ŋkɔ la ta, mègagbe mí o. Mègaklo bubu le wò ŋutikɔkɔe fiazikpui la ŋu o. Ɖo ŋku wò nu, si nèbla kpli mí la dzi. Mègatui o.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ðe dukɔwo ƒe alakpamawuwo dometɔ aɖe ate ŋu ana tsi nadzaa? Alo ɖe dziƒo ate ŋu ana agbafie nawɔa? Ɖe menye wò, Aƒetɔ, ye nye mía Mawu oa? Míele mɔ kpɔm na wò, elabe wòe wɔa nu siawo katã.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Ne Mose kple Samuel le tsitre ɖe ŋkunye me hã la, nye dzi matrɔ ɖe dukɔ sia ŋu o. Nyà wo ɖa le ŋkunye me, eye na woadzo!

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ne wobia wò be: ‘Afi ka yi ge míala?’ Ɖo eŋu na wo be: ‘Aƒetɔ be: Ame siwo woɖo ɖi na dɔ vɔ̃ la, woneyi dɔ vɔ̃ gbɔ. Ame siwo woɖo ɖi na yi la, woneyi yi gbɔ. Ame siwo woɖo ɖi na dɔwuame la, woneyi dɔwuame gbɔ. Ame siwo woɖo ɖi na aboyo me yiyi la, woneyi aboyo me.’ ”

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: “Meɖoe be nu vevi ƒomevi ene nawɔ wo, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe: Yi nawu wo, avuwo navuvu wo, dziƒoxeviwo kple gbemelãwo navuvu wo, eye woatsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Mawɔ wo woazu ŋɔdzinu na fiaɖuƒewo katã le anyigba dzi, le nu si Manase, Xizkiya vi, Yuda-fia, wɔ le Yerusalem la ta.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: “O Yerusalem, ame ka akpɔ nublanui na wò? Ame ka afa kpli wò? Ame ka atɔ ɖe ŋuwò ahabia wò agbe ta ase?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Miegbem, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe, eye miele megbe dem le ŋunye. Ale medo asi ɖa tsrɔ̃ mi; mekpɔ nublanui na mi do kpo.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Metsɔ lugbɔnu gbɔ wo le anyigba la ƒe agbowo nu. Mena ame ku na wo, metsrɔ̃ nye dukɔ; wometrɔ le woƒe mɔwo dzi o.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Mena woƒe ahosiwo sɔ gbɔ wu ƒutake. Metsrɔ̃ ɖekakpuiwo nɔwo le ŋdɔkutsu helihelĩ nu. Mena vɔvɔ̃ kple ŋɔdzi tu wo kpoyi.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Nyɔnu si dzi vi adrẽ la ku ƒenyi yi ɖi me; zã do ɖee, togbɔ be ɣe le dzi hã. Wodo ŋukpee, eye eƒe mo tsi dãa. Mana ame siwo susɔ la, natsi woƒe futɔwo ƒe yi nu.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Yeremya fa konyi na Aƒetɔ

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Nɔnye, èwɔ num be nèdzim. Amewo tsi tre ɖe ŋunye le dzre wɔm kplim le anyigba blibo la dzi. Nyemedo nugbana na ame aɖeke o, eye ame aɖeke hã medo nugbana nam o; gake ame sia ame le fi ƒom dem.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, woƒe fiƒode neɖi ŋunye, nenye be nyemeƒo koko na wò di nyui na wo o fĩi! Neɖi ŋunye nenye, be nyemeɖe kuku ɖe wo ta, esime futɔwo xaxa wo ɖo, eye woge ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e me o fĩi!

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: Ɖe ame aɖe ate ŋu aŋe ga yibɔ, ga yibɔ tso dzigbeme kple akɔblia?

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: “Matsɔ wò kesinɔnuwo kple wò nu xɔasiwo ana woaha femaxee, le nuvɔ̃ siwo katã nèwɔ le anyigba bliboa dzi la ta.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Mana miasubɔ miaƒe futɔwo le anyigba si mienya o la dzi, elabe nye dziku le bibim, eye matsi akpɔ o.”

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ènya nye nyawo. Ðo ŋku dzinye, eye nàva xɔ nam. Bia hlɔ̃ yonyemetilawo nam. Mègagbɔ dzi blewuu ne matsi eme o. Ðo ŋui be tawòe wodo ŋukpem ɖo.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Esi nèƒo nu nam la, mese wò nyawo, eye mexɔ wo de menye. Nyaawo vivi, eye wodo dzidzɔ nam elabe wò ŋkɔe woyɔ ɖe ŋunye, Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Nyemebɔbɔ nɔ dzidzɔkpɔlawo dome alo ɖu agbe o; ke boŋ èna dzi kum vevie, eye ɖeko meɖe ɖe aga kpoo.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Nu ka tae manɔ veve sem ɖaa? Nu ka ta nye abiawo nye abi makumaku? Ðe nèdi be yeanɔ nam abe tɔʋu si blea ame alo tsi si miena kaba la enea?

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ be: “Ne ètrɔ va la, magaɖo wò te, eye àganɔ ŋkunye me asubɔm. Ne ègblɔ nya vavãwo, eye menye nyamaɖinyawo o la, ekema ànɔ abe nye nu ene. Woatrɔ ɖe gbɔwò; ke wò la, màtrɔ ɖe wo ŋu o.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: Mawɔ wò nànye akɔbligli sesẽ na dukɔ sia. Woawɔ aʋa kpli wò, ke womaɖu dziwò o. Elabe meli kpli wò be maxɔ na wò, eye maɖe wò.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Maɖe wò le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me, eye maxɔ wò le ŋutasẽlawo ƒe fego me.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be:

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Mele be nàɖe srɔ̃ alo adzi viŋutsuwo alo vinyɔnuwo ɖe teƒe sia o.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Dɔ vɔ̃ awu wo. Womafa na wo loo, alo aɖi wo gɔ̃ hã o. Woƒe ŋutilã atsi anyigba abe lãmí ene. Woatsi yi nu le aʋa me, eye dɔwuame atsrɔ̃ wo. Woƒe ŋutilã kukuawo anye nuɖuɖu na xewo kple gbemelãwo.”

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: “Elabe Aƒetɔ be: Mègage ɖe aƒe si me wole konyi fam le la o. Mègayi ɖafa na ame aɖeke alo ado baba nɛ o. Elabe nye Aƒetɔ, meɖe nye ŋutifafa, amenuveve kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ɖa le dukɔ sia dzi.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Bubumewo kple ame gblɔewo katã aku le anyigba sia dzi, ke ame aɖeke maɖi wo alo afa na wo o. Womasi wo ɖokui alo alũ ta kokoe atsɔ fa na wo o.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke maɖu nu le kuteƒe afa akɔ na kutɔwo loo, alo ana aha ame si tɔ́a alo nɔa ku be woatsɔ fa akɔ nɛ o.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: Mele be nàge ɖe aƒe si me woɖo kplɔ̃ le agbe ɖum le la o. Mele be nàbɔbɔ nɔ wo dome aɖu nu, ano nu kpli wo o.

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: Kpɔ ɖa, matsi aseyetsoɣli kple dzidzɔɣli, ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ƒe gbe kple ŋugbetɔ ƒe gbe nu le mia ŋkume, le mia ŋɔli.”

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: “Ne ègblɔ nya siawo katã na wo la, woabia wò be: ‘Nu ka tae Aƒetɔ ɖoe be dzɔgbevɔ̃e gã sia nadzɔ ɖe mía dzi? Vo kae míeda? Nuvɔ̃ kae míewɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la ŋu?’

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ekema ɖo eŋu na wo be Aƒetɔ be: ‘Elabe mia tɔgbuiwo gblẽm ɖi hedze mawu bubuwo yome. Wosubɔ wo, eye wode ta agu na wo; ke wogblẽ nye boŋ ɖi, eye womelé nye seawo me ɖe asi o.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Ke nu si miawo mieva wɔ la vɔ̃ɖi wu mia tɔgbuiwo tɔ. Kpɔ ɖa, mia dome ame sia ame wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi si eƒe dzi di la, eye miegbe toɖoɖom;

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: eya ta matsɔ mi aƒu gbe tso anyigba sia dzi, aɖo ɖe anyigba si miawo kple mia tɔgbuiwo siaa mienya o la dzi. Mianɔ afi ma asubɔ mawu bubuwo zã kple keli, eye nyemave mia nu o.’ ” Tɔtrɔ gbɔ tso aboyo me

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ be: Eya ta, kpɔ ɖa, ɣeyiɣi gbɔna esime amewo magagblɔ be: ‘Zi ale si Aƒetɔ le agbe, ame si kplɔ Israelviwo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la o.

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ke ‘Zi ale si Aƒetɔ le agbe, ame si kplɔ Israelviwo tso dzigbemenyigba kple anyigba siwo katã dzi wònyà wo ɖo ɖa la dzi la.’ Elabe magakplɔ wo ava woawo ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba si metsɔ na wo tɔgbuiwo la dzi.” Tohehe si le vava ge la

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, maɖo ɖɔkplɔla geɖewo ɖa, ne woalé wo. Emegbe maɖo adela geɖewo ɖa, ne woayɔ wo ɖe nu tso towo kple togbɛwo katã dzi kpakple agadowo me.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Elabe nye ŋku le nu siwo katã wɔm wole la kpɔm; ɖeke mele ɣaɣla ɖem o. Woƒe vodadawo le ŋkunye me.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Gbã la, maxe woƒe vodadawo kple woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ŋu fe na wo zigbɔzi eve, elabe woƒo ɖi nye anyigba la kple woƒe legba siwo melé fui la ƒe nu kukuwo, eye wotsɔ woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo yɔ nye domenyinu la fũu.” Yeremya do gbe ɖa ka ɖe Aƒetɔ dzi

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, nye ŋusẽ kple nye mɔ́ sesẽ, ne mexaxa la, wòe nye nye sitsoƒe. Dukɔwo atso anyigba ƒe seƒewo ke ava gbɔwò, agblɔ be: “Mía tɔgbuiwo menyi naneke dome wu alakpa o; nu maɖinu siwo me viɖe aɖeke mele o.

english_verse: worthless idols made by human hands.”
translation_verse: Ðe amegbetɔ ate ŋu awɔ mawuwo na eɖokuia? Esiawo menye mawuwo o.”

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Eya ta kpɔ ɖa, mana woadze si nye ŋusẽ kple nye ŋutete; ne woanyae be ŋkɔnyee nye Aƒetɔ la.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: “Wotsɔ nuŋlɔga ŋlɔ Yuda ƒe nuvɔ̃e. Wotsɔ lotamekpe tsutsɔẽ ŋlɔe, wòde to, ɖe woƒe dzikpewo dzi kple woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo ƒe dzowo ŋu,

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: esime wo viwo ƒe ŋku le woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo kple nyɔnumawu Asera ƒe nu siwo le ati damawo te kple togbɛ kɔkɔwo

english_verse: So I'll take everything you own, including your altars, and give it all to your enemies.
translation_verse: kpakple towo tame le gbegbe la dzi. Mana woaha miaƒe kesinɔnuwo kple miaƒe nu xɔasiwo katã le nuvɔ̃ siwo miewɔ le miaƒe anyigba katã dzi la ta.

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Mana domenyinu si metsɔ na mi la nage le mia si, eye mana miasubɔ miaƒe futɔwo le anyigba si mienya o la dzi; elabe wode dzo nye dziku me, eye wòabi tegbee.” Nyagbɔgblɔ vovovowo

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Aɖi ame si ƒe dzi te ɖa le Aƒetɔ ŋu, eye wòle dzi ɖom ɖe amegbetɔ ŋu hetsɔe wɔ eƒe ŋusẽe la, ŋu kpékpekpe.

english_verse: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.
translation_verse: Eyama le abe ati masemasẽ le kegbegbe ene; ne nu nyui va la, makpɔe o. Anɔ kuɖiɖinyigba dzi le gbedadaƒo kple dzenyigba dzi, afi si menye ame nɔƒe o.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si ɖo dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ ŋu, eƒe nu ɖoŋuɖeŋua ye nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Ele abe ati si wodo ɖe tɔ to, eye wòɖe ke ɖe tɔʋu ŋu la ene. Ne ŋdɔ le vevem la, mevɔ̃na o, elabe eƒe aŋgbawo dea ama ɖaa. Ne tsi mele dzadzam o hã la, metsia dzimaɖi o; elabe enɔa tsetse dzi ɖaa.”

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe dzi nye alakpatɔ wu nu sia nu. Nu gbegblẽ ŋutɔŋutɔ wònye. Ame ka ate ŋu ase egɔme?

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: “Nye Aƒetɔ ye dzroa amegbetɔ ƒe susu me, doa eƒe dzi kpɔna, be maɖo eteƒe na ame sia ame ɖe eƒe zɔzɔme kple nuwɔnawo nu.”

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Ame si to nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ me kpɔ kesinɔnu ƒo ƒui ɖi la, le abe tegli si ƒo vi gake menye eya ŋutɔe ɖa azia ƒo o la ene. Kesinɔnua abu ɖee le eƒe agbenɔɣi titina, eye wòazu bometsila le eƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Míaƒe kɔkɔeƒe la le abe ŋutikɔkɔefiazikpui si woda ɖe to tame tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la ene.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, wòe nye Israel ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ. Ame siwo katã gblẽ wò ɖi la, ŋu akpe wo. Ame siwo trɔ le yowòme la, woaŋlɔ woƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe kewɔ me. Elabe wogblẽ Aƒetɔ, tsidzɔƒe gbagbe la ɖi. Yeremya bia Aƒetɔ be nekpe ɖe ye ŋu

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, yɔ dɔm ne mahaya. Xɔ nam, ne makpɔ xɔxɔ elabe wòe mekafuna.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wole gbɔgblɔm nam be: “Afi ka Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋɔdzidonamenyawo le? Woneva!”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Nyemegbe be nyemaganye alẽkplɔla le yowòme loo, alo madi be ŋu vɔ̃e nake na wo o. Wò ŋutɔ ènyae. Nya siwo megblɔ la, le nyanya na wò.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Mèganye ŋɔdzi nam o. Wòe nye nye sitsoƒe le dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe yonyemetilawo; ke mègana ŋu nakpe nye ya o. Dzi neɖe le wo ƒo, ke dzi megaɖe le nye ya ƒo o. Na woakpɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe la, tsrɔ̃ wo, nàgatsrɔ̃ wo ake. Ɖoɖo siwo dzi wòle be woawɔ le dzudzɔgbe

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: Ðe gbeƒã be: ‘Mi Yuda-fiawo, Yuda-dukɔ bliboa kple mi ame siwo katã le Yerusalem siwo toa agbo siawo me gena ɖe eme, miɖo to miase Aƒetɔ ƒe nya.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ be: ‘Ke ne miawo ya mieɖo tom, eye mimetsɔ agba to du sia ƒe agbowo nu ge ɖe eme le dzudzɔgbe la o, eye miewɔ dzudzɔgbe la kɔkɔe, mimewɔ dɔ aɖeke gbe ma gbe o la,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: ekema mana miaƒe fiawo kple fiaviwo age ɖe Yerusalem-dua ƒe agbowo me aɖu fia abe David ene. Woawo kple woƒe amegãwo, Yudatɔwo kple Yerusalemnɔlawo siaa aɖo tasiaɖamwo, ado sɔwo age ɖe du sia me, eye ame anɔ eme fũu tegbee.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Amewo atso Yuda-duwo kple Yerusalem-gbletawo, Benyamin-nyigba dzi, baliwo me kple towo dzi kpakple Yuda ƒe anyigbeme ava. Woatsɔ numemevɔsa, akpedadavɔsa, nuɖuɖuvɔsa kple lifidzudzɔdonu akpe ɖe akpedadavɔsa ŋu ava Aƒetɔ ƒemee.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Evɔ ne miegbe toɖoɖom, eye mimewɔ dzudzɔgbe la kɔkɔe o, ale be mietsɔ agba to Yerusalem ƒe agbowo mee le dzudzɔgbe la, ekema mana dzo nafiã eƒe agboawo kple Yerusalem ƒe fiasãawo, eye womate ŋu atsii akpɔ o.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told me,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ na Yeremya be:

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Tso, nàyi zemela ƒeme ne magblɔ nye nyawo na wò le afi ma.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Ale meyi aƒea me, eye mekpɔ zemela wòle dɔ wɔm le eƒe zemenu dzi.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Nu si mem zemelaa le la gblẽ, eya ta etsɔ tsu la me nu bubu si wòdi abe ale si dze zemela la ŋu wòbe yeawɔe la ene.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be:

english_verse: People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.
translation_verse: “Israel-dukɔ, ɖe nyemate ŋu awɔ mi abe ale si zemela sia wɔ ene oa? Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Kpɔ ɖa, Israel-dukɔ, ɖeko miele asinye me abe ale si tsu le zemela si mee ene.

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Ne meɖoe be maho dukɔ alo fiaɖuƒe aɖe ɖa, agbãe, eye matsrɔ̃e le ɣeyiɣi aɖe me,

english_verse: and that nation turns from its evil, I will change my mind.
translation_verse: ke dukɔa trɔ dzime tso nuvɔ̃ɖi si wòwɔ, si ta megblɔ nenema ɖo gbɔ la, ekema nyemawɔ vɔ̃ si meɖo be mawɔe la o.

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: ke wòwɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi le ŋkunye me, eye mese nye gbe o la, ekema nyui si meɖo be mawɔ nɛ la, nyemagawɔe nɛ o.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Eya ta, azɔ la, gblɔ na Yuda-dukɔa kple Yerusalemnɔlawo be: ‘Aƒetɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, mele nugbe ɖom ɖe mia ŋu. Mana dzɔgbevɔ̃e nadzɔ ɖe mia dzi. Mia dome ame sia ame negbe nu le nuvɔ̃ɖi si wɔm wòle la gbɔ, eye wòaɖɔ eƒe agbenɔnɔ kple nuwɔna ɖo.’

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: “Ke woɖo eŋu be: ‘Nya gbɔloe nye ekem. Míawɔ nu si míesusu la. Mía dome ame sia ame asẽ to awɔ nu ɖe eƒe dzi vɔ̃ɖi kuatri la nu.’ Dukɔ la gbe Aƒetɔ

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: “Eya ta Aƒetɔ be: Mibia se le dukɔwo dome be nya sia tɔgbe dzɔ ame aɖe se kpɔa? Nu gbegblẽ ŋutɔŋutɔe Israel-dukɔ, ɖetugbi la, wɔ.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Ðe tsikpe vɔna le agakpewo dome le Lebanon-towo dzia? Ðe tɔʋu fafa siwo le sisím tso eƒe towo dzi la miena?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Gake nye dukɔ ya ŋlɔm be, eye wodoa lifidzudzɔ na legbawo. Wokli nu le woƒe mɔwo dzi, eye womegatoa blemamɔwo dzi o. Wole mɔ dzeɖexɛwo dzi tom, ke menye mɔ gã la ŋutɔ dzi o.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Wona woƒe anyigba ɖi vɔvɔ̃, eye woanɔ alɔ me ɖem le eŋu ɖaa. Adzi ŋɔ na ame sia ame si ato eŋu ayi la, eye wòaʋuʋu ta.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Makaka wo ahlẽ abe ɣedzeƒeyae lɔ nu ɖe nu ene. Matrɔ megbe ade wo, eye ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ ɖe wo dzi la, nyematrɔ ɖe wo ŋu o.” Amewo ɖo nugbe ɖe Yeremya ŋu

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ be: “Miva, mina míaɖo nugbe ɖe Yeremya ŋu; elabe nufiame mabu ɖe nunɔlawo o, adaŋudede mabu ɖe nunyalawo loo, alo nya nabu ɖe gbeƒãɖelawo o. Eya ta mina míatsɔ aɖe aƒoe, eye mímagalé to ɖe eƒe nya aɖeke ŋu o.”

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, lé to ɖe nye nya ŋu, eye nàse nye kukuɖeɖe.

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Ðe wotsɔa vɔ̃ ɖoa nyui teƒea? Ke woawo ɖe ʋe ɖi nam be mage dze eme. Ðo ŋku ale si meva tsi tsitre ɖe ŋkuwò me, eye meƒo nu nyui le wo ŋu na wò, be wò dzi nafa ɖe wo ŋu la dzi.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Gake azɔ la, na dɔwuame natsrɔ̃ wo viwo, wonetsi yi nu le aʋa me. Wo srɔ̃wo nezu vi manɔsitɔwo kple ahosiwo. Dɔ vɔ̃ nedze woƒe ŋutsuwo dzi woatsrɔ̃, eye woƒe ɖekakpuiwo netsi yi nu le aʋa me.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Kplɔ adzohawo ƒu wo kpata woaha woƒe aƒewo, eye woƒe ɣli nede dzi bobobo. Elabe woɖe ʋe nam be mage dze eme eye woɖo mɔ̀ na nye afɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ be: “Yi nàɖaƒle ze le zemela gbɔ. Ðe dukɔa ƒe ame tsitsi aɖewo kple nunɔlawo ƒe ame tsitsiwo kpe ɖe ɖokuiwò ŋu,

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: eye nàdo go to Zekakɛgbo nu. Yi ɖe Hinom vi ƒe bali me, eye nàɖe gbeƒã nya si gblɔ ge mala na wò la le afi ma.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be: ‘Mi Yuda-fiawo kple Yerusalemnɔlawo, miɖo to miase Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe nya. Kpɔ ɖa, mele dzɔgbevɔ̃e he ge ava teƒe sia dzi, eye ame siwo katã asee la ƒe to me aɖi yeŋ.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: Woɖi vɔsamlekpui na Baal ne woatɔ dzo wo viwo le wo dzi atsɔ sa numemevɔ nɛ. Nyemeɖo nu sia na wo be woawɔ o; meva tame nam gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Eya ta, kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ be ɣeyiɣi gbɔna esime womagayɔ teƒe sia be Tofet alo Hinom vi ƒe bali o, ke woayɔe be Amewubali.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Magblẽ ɖoɖo siwo Yuda-dukɔ kple Yerusalemnɔlawo awɔ le teƒe sia la me na wo. Mana woƒe futɔwo nawu wo le aʋa me, eye woatsi woƒe kudilawo si me. Matsɔ woƒe kukuawo na xewo kple gbemelãwo.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Mana du sia nazu ŋɔdzinu kple alɔmeɖenu. Ame sia ame si to eŋu yina la atsi yaa, eye wòaɖe alɔ me le eŋu le nu siwo katã dzɔ ɖe edzi la ta.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Mana woaɖu wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo ƒe lã, ame sia ame aɖu ehavi ƒe lã, le aʋa kple xaxa si me woƒe futɔwo kple woƒe kudilawo ade woe la ta.’

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: “Ekema gbã ze la le ame siwo kplɔ wò yii la ŋkume,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: eye nàgblɔ na wo be Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: ‘Magbã dukɔ sia kple du sia alea abe ale si wogbãa zee, eye womegatea ŋu trenɛ o la ene. Woaɖi ame ɖe Tofet gɔ̃ hã, elabe teƒe aɖeke maganɔ anyi woaɖi ame ɖo o.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Mana Yerusalem-xɔwo, Yuda-fiawo ƒe xɔwo kple xɔ siwo katã tame wotɔ dzo lifi le na dziŋgɔlimenuwo katã, eye woƒo aha ɖi na mawu bubuwo le la nazu teƒe makɔmakɔ abe Tofet ene.’ ”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Tete Yeremya gbɔ tso Tofet, afi si Aƒetɔ ɖoe ɖo be woaɖaɖe gbeƒã yeƒe gbedeasi le la. Eyi ɖatsi tsitre ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔxɔnu, eye wògblɔ na dukɔ blibo la be:

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: Kpɔ ɖa, mahe dzɔgbevɔ̃e siwo katã megblɔ ɖe du sia kple du siwo katã tsɔ ɖe egbɔ ŋu la ava wo dzi, elabe wolia kɔ, gbe nye nyawo sese.”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Azɔ nunɔla Pasxur, Imer vi, si nye dzikpɔlawo ƒe amegã le Aƒetɔ ƒeme se nya siwo Yeremya nɔ gbeƒã ɖemee.

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Tete Pasxur ƒo Yeremya, gbeƒãɖela la, eye wòtsɔ eƒe afɔwo de atikpofɔblanu kpekpe me. Wodae ɖe Benyamin-gbo dzigbetɔ si le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒea me la nu.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, Pasxur na wova ɖe atikpofɔblanu kpekpe la le afɔ na Yeremya. Tete wògblɔ na Pasxur be: “Aƒetɔ magayɔ wò be Pasxur azɔ o. Wò ŋkɔ azɔe nye Ŋɔdzi xɔ afi sia afi.

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, mana nàzu ŋɔdzi na wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò kple xɔ̃wòwo katã. Woƒe futɔwo awu wo kple yi le wò ŋutɔ ŋkuwò me. Matsɔ Yuda-dukɔ blibo la ade asi na Babilon-fia. Akplɔ wo ayi aboyo me le Babilon, eye woawu wo kple yi le afi ma.

english_verse: He will clean out the royal treasury and take everything else of value from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Gawu la, mana futɔwo aha du sia. Woaha woƒe kesinɔnuwo, nukpɔkpɔwo kple woƒe nu veviwo katã kpakple Yuda-fiawo ƒe kesinɔnuwo katã ayi Babilonia.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Pasxur, ke le wò ŋutɔ kple wò aƒemetɔwo gome ya la, woaɖe aboyo mi akplɔ ayi Babilonia. Àku ɖe afi ma woaɖi akpe ɖe xɔ̃wò siwo katã nèka aʋatso ɖe gbeƒã na la ŋu.” Yeremya fa konyi na Aƒetɔ

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, èblem, eye woblem. Èsesẽ wum, eye nèɖu dzinye. Ame sia ame le koyem; mezu alɔmeɖenu ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: Elabe ne mele nu ƒom ɣe sia ɣi la, ele be manɔ ɣli dom anɔ bublum sesĩe be: “Ŋutasesẽ kple Tsɔtsrɔ̃!” Elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe nya zu vlododo kple alɔmeɖeɖe le ŋunye ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Ne mebe: “Nyemayɔ eŋkɔ o, nyemagaƒo nu le eŋkɔ me o” la, ekema gbedeasia nɔa nye dzime abe dzobibi si nu wotu nu ɖo le nye ƒuwo me ke ene. Enana be ɖeɖi tea ŋunye, eye wòglom.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Elabe mesea dalĩdodowo be: “Ŋɔdzi xɔ afi sia afi! Ɖe egɔme ɖe go! Mina míaɖe egɔme ɖe go!” Xɔ̃nye veviwo kekeake hã le egblɔm, eye wole mɔ kpɔm na nye anyidzedze. “Ɖewohĩ, woate ŋu ablee, míaƒe asi asu edzi, eye míabia hlɔ̃e.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ, li kplim abe aʋawɔla sesẽ ene; eya ta yonyemetilawo adze anyi. Womaɖu dzinye o. Ŋu akpe wo vevie elabe womaɖu dzi o. Ŋukpe mavɔ si womate ŋu aŋlɔ be akpɔ o la anɔ wo ŋu.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla, ame si doa ame ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kpɔna, ame si nyaa ame ƒe tamesusu kple dzimenya, na makpɔ ale si nèle hlɔ̃ bia ge woe, elabe asiwò me metsɔ nye nyawo dee.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Aƒetɔ! Mikafu Aƒetɔ! Elabe eɖe hiãtɔ ƒe agbe tso nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo si me!

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Neɖi gbe si gbe wodzim la ŋu kpékpekpe! Wonegayra gbe si gbe nɔnye dzim la o.

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Neɖi ame si he dzidzɔnya vɛ na tɔ́nye be: “Wodzi ŋutsuvi na wò,” eye dzi dzɔe ŋutɔ la, ŋu kpékpekpe!

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Ame ma nenɔ abe du siwo Aƒetɔ tsrɔ̃ nublanuimakpɔmakpɔtɔe ene. Nese dziɖeleameƒoɣli le ŋdi me, eye wòase aʋaɣli le ŋdɔ me,

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: elabe mewum ɖe dɔ me ne nɔnye ƒe vidzidɔ nanye yɔdo nam be fu natsi nɔnye ƒo tegbee o.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta koŋ wodzim ɖo? Be manɔ fukpekpe kple nuxaxa ko dzi, anɔ ŋukpe ɖum aɖase ɖe nye agbe ƒe nuwuwua?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nya sia na Yeremya, esime Zedekiya, Yuda-fia dɔ Pasxur, Malkiya vi kple nunɔla Zefanya, Maaseya vi ɖo ɖee be:

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Bia gbe Aƒetɔ na mí elabe Nebukadnezar, Babilon-fia le aʋa wɔm kpli mí. Ɖewohĩ Aƒetɔ ave mía nu to eƒe nukudɔwo katã me, esi ana wòagbugbɔ adzo le mía gbɔ.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na ame siawo be: ‘Aƒetɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, metsɔ agbemɔ kple kumɔ le mia ŋkume ɖom.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Ame si tsi du sia me la, atsi aʋa loo, alo aku le dɔwuame alo dɔ vɔ̃ si me. Gake ame si do yi ɖatsɔ eɖokui na Kaldeatɔ siwo ɖe to ɖe dua la, atsi agbe, eye eƒe agbe anɔ abe nunana tso aʋagbedzi ene.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Elabe meɖoe kplikpaa be mawɔ vɔ̃ du sia, ke menye nyui o. Madee asi na Babilon-fia ne wòatɔ dzoe.’ ” Woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu Yuda-fiawo

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Yuda-fia ƒe aƒe be: ‘Mise Aƒetɔ ƒe nya:

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: David ƒe ƒome, Aƒetɔ be: Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe ŋdi sia ŋdi, eye mixɔ na ame siwo woda dzoe tso ameteɖeanyilawo si me. Ne menye nenem o la, nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo wɔm miele la ana nye dɔmedzoe abi ɖe mia ŋu, eye ame aɖeke mate ŋu atsii o.’ ”

english_verse: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, metso ɖe ŋuwò, wò balimenɔla, wò agakpe si le gbadzaƒe. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Wò si le gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Ame ka aɖi ava dze mía dzi? Ame kae ate ŋu ava mía nɔƒe?’

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Mahe to na mi ɖe nu siwo miewɔ la ƒe metsonuwo nu. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Matɔ dzo eƒe ave la, eye dzoa abi nu siwo katã ƒo xlãe.”

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Elabe ne miewɔ nya sia dzi tututu la, ekema fia siwo anɔ David ƒe fiazikpui dzi la, ato agbo sia nu ado ayi agbɔ. Woawo ŋutɔ kple woƒe dɔlawo kpakple dukɔ sia me nɔlawo katã anɔ tasiaɖamwo me, eye woado sɔwo.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be, ke ne miewɔ nya siawo dzi o la, metà ɖokuinye, ne aƒe sia mazu aƒedo o fĩi!

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ gblɔ le Yuda-dukɔ ƒe fiasã la ŋu be: ‘Èle nam abe Gilead le Lebanon-towo tame ene. Ke mawɔ wò nàzu kegbegbe kokoko, du si me ame aɖeke manɔ o.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Maɖo nugblẽlawo ɖa, wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe atsɔ eƒe aʋawɔnu ɖe asi vɛ. Woalã wò sederti nyuitɔwo, eye woatsɔ wo ade dzo me.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: Emegbe dukɔ geɖewo ava to du sia ŋu ayi, anɔ wo nɔewo biam be: Nu ka ta Aƒetɔ wɔ du gã sia wòzu alea ɖo?

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tete woaɖo eŋu be: Esi wogblẽ nu, si wobla kple Aƒetɔ woƒe Mawu la ɖi, eye wode ta agu na mawu bubuwo hesubɔ wo la tae.’ ” Yeremya ƒe gbedeasi na Yoaxaz

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Migafa avi na ame si ku la o; migafa konyi nɛ o. Ke mifa avi hehehe na ame si dzo yina la boŋ elabe megale tɔtrɔ ge agbɔ ne wòagakpɔ wo denyigba o.

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: Baba na ame si gblɔ be: ‘Matu xɔ gã aɖe na ɖokuinye, eye mana tuɖedziawo me nakeke.’ Ede fesre xɔa ŋu, klã sederʋuƒowo ɖe eme, eye wòsi aŋɔ dzĩ nɛ.

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: Ðe nèbuna be yenye fia elabe èle ɖi kem le sedertiwo ŋudɔwɔwɔ mea? Ɖe tɔ́wò meɖu nu, no nu, drɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòwɔ nu dzɔdzɔe oa? Eya tae eme nyo nɛ ɖo.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Eʋli ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo ta, eye eme nyo nɛ. Ɖe menye ale si wodzea sim lae nye esia oa? Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ke ŋku kple dzi siwo le viɖe madzemadze kpɔkpɔ ŋu koe le asiwò. Be nàkɔ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi, asẽ ŋuta le ame ŋu, eye nàte ame ɖe anyi.”

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ gblɔ ɖe Yuda-fia Yehoyakim, Yosiya vi ŋu be: “Womafa nɛ be: ‘Ao, nɔvinye ŋutsu!’ alo ‘Ao, nɔvinye nyɔnu!’ o. Womafa nɛ be: ‘Ao, míaƒe Aƒetɔ!’ alo ‘Ao, míaƒe fia bubutɔ!’ o.

english_verse: You will be given a burial fit for a donkey; your body will be dragged outside the city gates and tossed in the dirt. I, the Lord, have spoken. King Jehoiachin and the People of Jerusalem The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ke boŋ woaɖii tedziɖiɖii. Woatee le anyigba, eye woatsɔe aƒu gbe ɖe adzɔge ke tso Yerusalem ƒe agbowo nu.” Yeremya ƒe gbedeasi le nu si gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe Yerusalem dzi la ŋu

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: “Yi Lebanon-towo dzi ne nàdo ɣli. Yi Basan-nyigba dzi ne nàna wò gbe naɖi bobobo. Wò gbe nede dzi le Moab-towo dzi elabe wogblẽ wò ahiãviwo katã dome.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Meƒo nu na wò esime eme nyo na wò; ke nègblɔ be: ‘Nyemasee o.’ Alea ko wò zɔzɔme le tso wò ɖekakpuime ke be mèse nye gbe o.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Yaƒoƒo akplɔ wò alẽkplɔlawo katã adzoe, eye wò ahiãviwo ayi aboyo me. Ekema ŋu akpe wò, gbɔgblɔ abu ɖe wò le nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo katã nèwɔ la ta.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: Ke wò Lebanontɔ, ame si wɔ atɔ ɖe sedertiwo dome, wò nu awɔ nublanui ne ède asi vevesese me abe funɔ si le ku lém la ene.” Mawu ƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ Xonya

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ be: “Zi ale si mele agbe, togbɔ be Yuda-fia Xonya, Yehoyakim vi la nye ŋkɔsigɛ le nye nuɖusi hã la, maɖe wò aƒu gbe le asi.

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: Matsɔ wò ade asi na ame siwo le wò ku dim, ame siwo vɔ̃m nèle la; made wò asi na Babilon-fia Nebukadnezar kekeake kple Kaldeatɔwo.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Matsɔ wò kple nɔwò si dzi wò la aƒu gbe ɖe anyigba bubu dzi, afi si womedzi mi ɖo o, eye miaku ɖe afi ma.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ðe Xonya, ŋutsu sia, zu ze gbagbã si wogbe, ze si ame aɖeke megaléa be na oa? Nu ka tae wotsɔ eya kple viawo ƒu gbe ɖo ɖe anyigba si womenya o la dzi?

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: O nye dukɔ, nye dukɔ, nye dukɔ! Se Aƒetɔ ƒe nya!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Ŋlɔ ŋutsu sia ŋkɔ ɖi be medzi vi kpɔ o. Ame si naneke madze edzi na le agbe me o. Elabe dzidzimevi aɖeke manɔ esi aɖu fia le David ƒe fiazikpui dzi, eye wòagaɖu fia le Yuda-dukɔ me akpɔ o.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Baba na alẽkplɔla siwo tsrɔ̃ nye alẽwo le nye lãnyiƒe, eye woka hlẽ la.”

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la gblɔ ɖe alẽkplɔla siwo le eƒe dukɔa dzi ɖum la ŋu be: “Miawoe kaka nye alẽwo, nyà wo de gbe, eye mielé be na wo o. Kpɔ ɖa, mahe to na mi le nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo miewɔ la ta. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Ekema maƒo nye alẽha mamlɛawo nu ƒu tso dukɔ siwo katã me menyà wo ɖo ɖa la, woagbugbɔ ava woawo ŋutɔ ƒe gbeɖuƒe, eye woadzi asɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Maɖo alẽkplɔla siwo alé be na wo la na wo. Womagavɔ̃ azɔ o, dzi magaɖe le wo ƒo o, eye wo dometɔ aɖeke mabu o. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, ɣeyiɣi aɖe gbɔna esime matia fia nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla aɖe tso David ƒe dzidzimeviwo dome. Fia sia aɖu fia kple nunya, adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ɖe eteƒe, eye wòawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Le eƒe fiaɖuɣi la, woaxɔ Yuda-dukɔ ɖe agbe, eye Israel-dukɔ anɔ dedie. Ŋkɔ si woayɔ nɛ lae nye: ‘Aƒetɔ, míaƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ.’ ”

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, ɣeyiɣi gbɔna esime amewo magatà nu agblɔ be, ‘Zi ale si Aƒetɔ le agbe, ame si kplɔ Israelviwo tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la’ o,

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: ke boŋ be, ‘Metà Aƒetɔ gbagbe ame si kplɔ Israelviwo tso dzigbemenyigba kple anyigba siwo katã dzi wònyà wo ɖo ɖa la dzi vɛ la.’ Ekema woanɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi.” Yeremya ƒe gbedeasi ɖe Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ŋu

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: Nya siwo gbɔna la ku ɖe gbeƒãɖelawo ŋu: Nye dzi gbã ɖe dɔme nam; nye ƒuwo katã le ʋuʋum. Mezu abe ahamula ene, abe ŋutsu si wain wú ko na la ene, le Aƒetɔ ta, le eƒe nya kɔkɔeawo ta.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Elabe ahasitɔwo yɔ anyigba la dzi taŋ. Anyigba le nu xam le fiƒode la ta. Lãnyiƒewo ƒu kplakplakpla le gbedadaƒo. Woƒe mɔwo vɔ̃ɖi, eye woƒe kalẽwɔwɔ mele eteƒe o.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: “Gbeƒãɖelawo kple nunɔlawo siaa nye nu tovo wɔlawo. Le keke nye aƒeme gɔ̃ hã, mekpɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: Gbeƒãɖela siwo le Samaria hã le nane wɔm, menya le kpɔkpɔm o. Wole gbeƒã ɖem le Baal ŋkɔ me, eye wokplɔ nye dukɔ Israel trae.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Gake nu si wɔm gbeƒãɖela siwo le Yerusalem le mekpɔ la vɔ̃ɖi: Wole ahasi wɔm, le alakpa dam; wole ŋusẽ dom nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ƒe asi ale be ame aɖeke mele tɔtrɔm le eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me o. Wo katã va zu abe Sodomtɔwo ene nam, eye emenɔlawo le abe Gomoratɔwo ene.”

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la le gbɔgblɔm ɖe gbeƒãɖelawo ŋu be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mana gbe veve wo, woaɖu, eye makpe tsi si me aɖi le la na wo, woano. Elabe gbeƒãɖela siwo le Yerusalem la gbɔ nu tovo wɔwɔ tso kaka ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.”

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Migaɖo to nya siwo gbeƒãɖelaawo le gbeƒã ɖemee na mi la o. Mia flum wole. Ŋutega siwo gblɔm wole la nye woawo ŋutɔ ƒe susu. Menye Aƒetɔ ye ke nu gblɔ nya aɖeke na wo o.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm edziedzi na ame siwo gbe Aƒetɔ ƒe nya la be, ‘Eme anyo na mi’, eye wole gbɔgblɔm na ame siwo katã dze aglã ɖe ŋunye, le nu siwo dze wo ŋu wɔm la be, ‘Dzɔgbevɔ̃e aɖeke madzɔ ɖe mia dzi o.’ ”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Gbeƒãɖela siawo dometɔ kae nɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe takpekpe me kpɔ be wòakpɔ nu, eye wòase eƒe nya? Wo dometɔ kae ke to ɖi, se eƒe nya?

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe ahom ɖa! Dɔmedzoe do yina. Ele totrom abe yali ene, eye wòbla ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ta kɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe dzi mafa o va se ɖe esime wòwɔ nu si wòɖo be yeawɔ wu enu vɔ keŋ hafi. Emegbe la, miase egɔme nyuie.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: “Nyemedɔ gbeƒãɖelaawo o gake wolé du tsɔ. Nyemegblɔ nya aɖeke na wo o, ke woyi ɖaɖe gbeƒã gbedeasi.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Gake nenye ɖe wode adaŋu kplim, anye ne wote ŋu ɖe gbeƒã nye gbedeasi na nye dukɔ, eye anye ne woaɖe asi le woƒe agbe vlo nɔnɔ ŋu ahadzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo wɔm wole la.”

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Ðe ame aɖe ate ŋu abè ɖe ɣaɣlaƒe, eye nyemate ŋu akpɔe oa? Ðe nyemele afi sia afi le dziƒo kple anyigba oa? Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Mese gbeƒãɖela siwo le gbeƒã ɖem alakpanyawo le nye ŋkɔ me le gbɔgblɔm be, ‘Meku drɔ̃e, drɔ̃e meku.’

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Ɣe ka ɣie gbeƒãɖelawo adzudzɔ alakpadada, ame siwo bua alakpanyawo ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dzime,

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: ame siwo buna be yewoana nye dukɔ naŋlɔ nye ŋkɔ be to drɔ̃e siwo wokuna helĩna na wo nɔewo la me, abe ale si wo tɔgbuiwo gɔ̃ hã ŋlɔ nye ŋkɔ be hetsɔ Baal ɖo eteƒe la ene?

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Mina gbeƒãɖela si ku drɔ̃e la nalĩ eƒe drɔ̃e la abe ale si wolĩa drɔ̃e ene, gake ame si se nye gbedeasi la, neɖe gbeƒãe le nyateƒe me. Ðe woatsɔ gbe asɔ ɖe lu ŋua? Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Ɖe nye gbedeasi mele abe dzo ene, gale abe zu si gbãa agakpe gudugudu la ene oa?

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Kpɔ ɖa, metsi tre ɖe ame siwo ɖea gbeƒã alakpadrɔ̃ewo la ŋuti kple ame siwo lĩa woƒe drɔ̃eawo tsɔna kplɔa nye dukɔ tranae to woƒe alakpadada kple woƒe adegbe ƒuƒlu ƒoƒo me.
