translation_verse: Woklẽ woƒe aʋalawo ɖo ɖe wo nɔewo le dziŋgɔlia te, eye nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe tsɔ eƒe aʋala eve tsyɔ eɖokui.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Ne wole yiyim la, mese woƒe aʋalawo me le ɖiɖim abe tɔ gãwo ƒe hoowɔwɔ, abe Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe gbeɖeɖe kple aʋakɔwo ƒe ɣlidodo ene. Ne wotɔ la, woɖiɖia woƒe aʋalawo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Gbe aɖe ɖi tso dziŋgɔli si le wo tame la me. Ne wotɔ la, woɖiɖia woƒe aʋalawo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Nane ɖi fiazikpui nɔ dziŋgɔli si le wo tame la dzi. Ele abe gbloti ene, eye nane si ɖi amegbetɔ ƒe nɔnɔme la bɔbɔ nɔ nu si ɖi fiazikpuia dzi.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Esi melé ŋku ɖe eƒe ali ŋu yi dzi gome la, ele abe akɔbli si le keklẽm la ene, eye nane dzé ƒo xlãe abe dzo ene va kpe ɖo. Esi melé ŋku ɖe eƒe ali ŋu va anyi gome la, ele abe dzo ene nɔ keklẽm va kpe ɖo.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Keklẽ si ƒo xlãe la le abe ale si anyieʋɔ dona ɖe alilikpo ŋu le tsidzagbe ene. Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe nɔnɔmee nye esia. Esi mekpɔe la, metsyɔ mo anyi, eye mese ame si nɔ nu ƒom la ƒe gbe.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, tso nànɔ tsitre nu ne maƒo nu kpli wò.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Esi wòƒo nu nam la, Gbɔgbɔ la ɖo menye, eye wòfɔm ɖe te ɖe nye afɔwo dzi, eye mesee wònɔ nu ƒom nam.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, madɔ wò ɖe Israelviwo gbɔ, ɖe ame dzeaglãwo ƒe dukɔ, ame siwo dze aglã ɖe ŋunye la gbɔ. Wo kple wo tɔgbuiwo da nye sewo dzi va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Dukɔ si gbɔ mele dɔwòm ɖo la nye ame mabunuwo, eye woƒe tame sẽ. Mele dɔwòm ɖe wo gbɔ, ne nàgblɔ na wo be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Esi wònye ƒome si sẽa to wonye la,

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: wosee o, womesee o , woanyae be Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖe nɔ yewo dome kpɔ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: Ke wò amegbetɔ vi, mègavɔ̃ wo loo, alo avɔ̃ woƒe nyawo o. Togbɔ be dza kple ŋuwo ƒo xlã wò, eye nènɔ anyi ɖe dziɖegbewo dzi hã la, mègavɔ̃ woƒe nyawo loo, alo woƒe dzedzeme nadzi ŋɔ na wò o. Elabe ƒome si ƒe to sẽ la wonye.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, gblɔ nye nyawo na wo, woɖasee o, woɖagbe esese o, elabe ƒome dzeaglã wonye.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: “Ke wò amegbetɔ vi, ɖo to nu si gblɔ ge mala na wò. Mègadze aglã abe ƒome dzeaglã ma ene o. Ke nu nàɖu nu si tsɔ ge mala na wò.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Esi melé ŋku ɖe eŋu la, kpɔ ɖa, asi aɖe nye esi wodo ɖe gbɔnye, eye kpɔ ɖa, agbalẽ si dzi woŋlɔ nu ɖo la le eme.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Ekekee ɖe ŋkunye me. Woŋlɔ nu ɖe eme kple egodo. Woŋlɔ konyifafa, hũɖeɖe kple vevesese nyawo ɖe eme.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, ɖu agbalẽ si metsɔ na wò la. Ðui wòayɔ wò ƒodo.” Tete meɖui. Evivi le nye nu me abe anyitsi ene.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, yi Israel-dukɔ la gbɔ ne nàgblɔ nye nyawo na wo.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: Menye dukɔ geɖe siwo fiana, eye woƒe gbe sesẽ siwo ƒe nyawo gɔme manyase na wò la woe o. Le nyateƒe me nenye woawo gbɔe medɔ wò ɖo ɖa hã, woaɖo to wò.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Gake Israel-dukɔ la maɖo to wò o; elabe womelɔ̃na be yewoaɖo tom o. Elabe ŋgonu kplala li na Israel-dukɔ blibo la, eye woƒe dzi ku atri.

english_verse: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mena wò ŋkume sẽ ɖe woƒe ŋkume ŋu, eye wò ŋgonu le kplala ɖe woƒe ŋgonu ŋu.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Yi aboyome siwo nye mia deviwo la gbɔ nàgblɔ na wo be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu be’ woɖasee o, woɖagbe esese o.”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Tete Gbɔgbɔ la kɔm ɖe dzi, eye esi Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ho le enɔƒe la, mese anyigbaʋuʋu ƒe hoowɔwɔ gã aɖe le megbenye.

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Nu gbagbeawo ƒe aʋala siwo nɔ wo nɔewo ŋu kam, tasiaɖamfɔ siwo nɔ wo xa ƒe ɖiɖi woe nɔ hoo wɔm abe anyigbaʋuʋu gã aɖe ene.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la kɔm ɖe dzi, eye wòkplɔm dzoe. Medzo kple dziku helihelĩ le nye gbɔgbɔ xɔdzo me. Aƒetɔ ƒe asi sẽ ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Meva aboyome siwo nɔ Kebar-tɔsisi la nu le Tel-Abib la gbɔ. Menɔ wo dome le afi ma ŋkeke adrẽ, eye nye nu ku. Aƒetɔ ɖo Xezekiel dzɔlae (Xez

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke adrẽ megbe la, Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, meɖo wò dzɔlae na Israel-dukɔ la. Nenye be èse nya tso nunye me la, nàgbe nya na wo nam.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Ne mègblɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi la be: ‘Àku godoo,’ eye mègbe nya nɛ loo, alo xlɔ̃ nui be wòakpɔ eɖokui dzi le eƒe mɔ vɔ̃ dzi, ne wòatsi agbe o la, ame vɔ̃ɖi ma aku ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me. Ke mabia eƒe ʋu tso asiwò me.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Ke ne ègbe nya na ame vɔ̃ɖi la, eye metrɔ tso eƒe vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye me, alo tso eƒe mɔ vlo dzi o la, aku ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me. Ke wò la, èɖe wò agbe.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla dzudzɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, eye wòwɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi, eye meɖo nu nɛ wòkli la, aku. Elabe mègbe nya nɛ o. Aku le eƒe nuvɔ̃ ta, eye womaɖo ŋku eƒe nu dzɔdzɔe siwo wòwɔ va yi la dzi o. Ke mabia eƒe ʋu tso asiwò me.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Evɔ ne ègbe nya na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla be megawɔ nuvɔ̃ o, eye mewɔ nuvɔ̃ o la, anɔ agbe godoo. Elabe ese nyagbename la, eye wò la, èɖe wò agbe. Xezekiel magate ŋu aƒo nu o

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe asi nɔ dzinye le afi ma, eye wògblɔ nam be: “Tso, yi bali la me, eye maƒo nu kpli wò le afi ma.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Ale metsi tsitre heyi bali la me, eye kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nɔ afi ma abe ŋutikɔkɔe si mekpɔ le Kebar-tɔsisi to ene. Tete metsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Ke Gbɔgbɔ la ge ɖe menye hefɔm ɖe tsitre. Eƒo nu kplim gblɔ be: Yi, tu ɖokuiwò ɖe xɔ me le aƒewò me.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Mana wò aɖe nalé ɖe wò aŋɔ ŋu, ale be àzu mumu, eye màte ŋu aka mo na wo o. Elabe dukɔ dzeaglã wonye.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ke ne meƒo nu kpli wò la, maʋu nu na wò, eye nàgblɔ na wo be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu be’; ame si asee la, nesee; ame si agbe esese la, negbe. Elabe dukɔ dzeaglã wonye.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: “Azɔ wò amegbetɔ vi, tsɔ anyikpe da ɖi. Ta du aɖe, Yerusalem-du la, ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, tsɔ gagba gbadza aɖe nàwɔ gakpɔ atso wò kple du la dome. Trɔ mo de du la ne wòanɔ abe ɖe woɖe tò ɖe eŋu ene, eye nàɖe tò ɖe eŋu axaxae. Esia nye dzesi na Israel-dukɔ la.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Àtrɔ ŋkume ade Yerusalem-dua si woɖe tò ɖo la, wò abɔ nanɔ ƒeƒle. Ɖe gbeƒã ɖe du la ŋu.

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, made ka wò ale be màte ŋu atrɔ ɖe axa bubu dzi hafi wò tòɖeɖe ɖe dua ŋu ƒe ŋkekeawo nawu enu o.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: “Ke wò la tsɔ bli, lu, gbagbayi, ayi, ƒo kple mɔli de ze ɖeka me ahaƒo aboloe. Nàɖui le ŋkeke alafa etɔ̃ bla asieke siwo me nèmlɔ wò axa dzi la.

english_verse: and drink only two large cups of water.
translation_verse: Tsi kplu eve nàno gbe ɖeka. Àno tsi zi ɖeka gbe ɖeka.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Ƒo aboloa abe lubolo ene, mèe le amemi dzi le wo ŋkume nàɖu.”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ be: “Alea Israel-dukɔ le woƒe abolo makɔmakɔ ɖu gee le dukɔ siwo dome manyà wo ɖo ɖa la.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: “Ao, Aƒetɔ Mawu! Kpɔ ɖa, nyemegblẽ kɔ ɖo na ɖokuinye kpɔ o. Tso nye ɖekakpuime va se ɖe fifi la, nyemeɖu lã si ku le eɖokui si, alo esi lã aɖe vuvu la kpɔ o; lã vóvo mede nye nu me kpɔ o.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be: “Kpɔ ɖa, maɖe mɔ na wò be nàmè wò abolo le nyimi dzi ɖe amemi teƒe.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Gawu la, egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, kpɔ ɖa, maŋe abolo ƒe ziɔɖeŋu le Yerusalem. Woaɖu abolo si woda na wo le nudanu dzi la kple vɔvɔ̃, eye woadzidze tsi na wo, woano wòawɔ mo yaa na wo.

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: Mawɔ esia ne abolo kple tsi nahiã wo, eye woakpɔ wo nɔewo ŋkume awɔ yaa, eye woatsrɔ̃ le woƒe tohehe la te.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: “Wò amegbetɔ vi, tsɔ yi ɖaɖɛ aɖe. Wɔ eŋudɔ abe takola ƒe talũhɛ ene. Tsɔe lũ wò ta kple ge. Ekema tsɔ nudanu, eye nàma ɖa la me.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Tɔ dzo akpa etɔ̃liawo ƒe ɖeka le dua titina, ne tòɖeɖe ɖe dua ƒe ŋkekewo wu enu. Tsɔ yi nàfli akpa etɔ̃liawo ƒe ɖeka bubu ƒo xlã du la godoo. Hlẽ akpa etɔ̃lia mamlɛtɔ ɖe ya me, eye maɖe yi le aku me ɖe wo yome.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Ɖe sue aɖe le eŋu nàsa ɖe wò awu to.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Gaɖe sue aɖe le esia hã ŋu nàde dzo me ne wòafiã; esia mee dzo atso adze Israel-dukɔ blibo la dzi.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Yerusalem nye esia; metsɔe da ɖe dukɔwo titina, anyigbawo ƒo xlãe godoo.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Yerusalem dze aglã ɖe nye sewo ŋu wòvɔ̃ɖi wu dukɔwo. Etsi tre ɖe nye ɖoɖowo ŋu wu anyigba siwo ƒo xlãe. Egbe nye sewo, eye mezɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu o.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Elabe mievlo wu dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã mi godoo, eye miegbe zɔzɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu, eye miegbe nye sewo dzi wɔwɔ. Ke miewɔ dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã mi godoo la ƒe sewo dzi.

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Kpɔ ɖa, nye, nye ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã metsi tre ɖe mia ŋu. Madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le mia dome le dukɔwo ŋkume.

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: Le wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã ta la, mawɔ numawɔkpɔ ɖe ŋuwò, esi tɔgbe nyemagawɔ akpɔ o.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Eya ta vi tɔ́wo aɖu wo viŋutsuwo le mewò, eye viŋutsuwo aɖu wo tɔ́wo. Madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò, eye makaka mia dometɔ siwo tsi agbe la ahlẽ ɖe ya nu.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Zi ale si mele agbe la, malã wò aƒu anyi godoo elabe ègblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye kɔkɔeƒe la kple wò nugbegblẽwo katã kpakple wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã. Nye ŋku mato esia dzi o, eye nyemakpɔ nublanui o.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Dɔ vɔ̃ awu wò akpa etɔ̃liawo ƒe ɖeka, eye dɔwuame atsrɔ̃ wo le mia dome. Akpa etɔ̃lia bubu atsi yi nu le ame siwo ƒo xlã wò godoo la si me. Makaka akpa etɔ̃lia mamlɛtɔ ahlẽ ɖe ya nu, eye maɖe yi le aku me ɖe wo yome.”

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: Ale mawɔ nye dziku ŋudɔe nye esi: “Maɖe nye dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu, eye nye dzi afa. Ne woanyae be nye Aƒetɔ ye ƒo nu le nye ŋuʋaʋã me, eye meɖe nye dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Àzu mokakanɔŋutɔ, vlodonu, nyagbenamenu kple ŋɔdzinu na dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã wò godoo, nenye be meɖo kodzo kpli wò le dɔmedzoe kple dziku me, eye metsɔ dziku he to na wò. Nye Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Maɖo dɔwuame kple lã wɔadãwo ɖe mi, eye woatsrɔ̃ mia viwo. Dɔ vɔ̃ kple ʋukɔkɔɖi ato dowòme ayi. Maɖe yi ɖe dziwò. Nye Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, trɔ mo ɖe Israel-toawo ŋu, eye nàɖe gbeƒã ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: Gblɔ be: Mi Israel-towo, mise Aƒetɔ Mawu ƒe nya! Aƒetɔ Mawu le gbɔgblɔm ɖe towo, togbɛwo, agatowo kple baliwo ŋu be: Kpɔ ɖa, nye, nye ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã matsɔ yi ɖe mia ŋu, eye magbã miaƒe nuxeƒewo.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo atsi anyi, eye woagbã vɔsamlekpui siwo dzi mietɔa dzo lifi le la. Matsɔ miaƒe ame siwo wowu la aƒu gbe ɖe miaƒe legbawo ŋkume.

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: Matsɔ Israelviwo ƒe kukuawo ada ɖe woƒe legbawo gbɔ, eye makaka miaƒe ƒuwo aƒo xlã miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiawo.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Afi sia afi si miele la, miaƒe duwo azu aƒedo, eye woagblẽ miaƒe nuxeƒewo ale be miaƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo agbã, eye woatsrɔ̃; woagbã miaƒe legbawo, aɖe wo ɖa. Woamu vɔsamlekpui siwo dzi miedoa lifi dzo le la aƒu anyi, eye woatsrɔ̃ miaƒe dɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wowu la atsi mia dome, eye miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: “Ke mana mia dometɔ aɖewo natsi agbe. Nenye be ame aɖewo sí le yi nu hekaka ɖe dukɔwo dome la,

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: ekema mi ame siwo sí la miaɖo ŋku dzinye le dukɔwo dome, afi si woɖe aboyo wo yii. Nenye be megbã woƒe ahasiwɔdzi, si gbe nu le gbɔnye, eye mena woƒe ŋku dzeha siwo dze woƒe legbawo yome la tsí. Woanyɔ ŋu na wo ɖokui le nuvɔ̃ɖi kple ŋunyɔnu siwo katã wowɔ la ta.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Woadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ. Vɔ̃ si megblɔ be mawɔ ɖe wo ŋu la menye dzodzro ye o.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Ƒu akpe, tu afɔ anyi, eye nàgblɔ be: Aléle, le Israel-dukɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi kple ŋunyɔnuwo katã ta woatsi yi, dɔwuame kple dɔ vɔ̃ si me.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Dɔ vɔ̃ awu ame si le didiƒe, ame si le kpuiƒe atsi yi nu, ame si woɖe, eye wòtsi agbe la aku ɖe dɔwuame si me. Aleae maɖe nye dziku ɖe wo ŋui.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ. Nenye be woƒe ame siwo wowu la mlɔ woƒe legbawo dome ƒo xlã woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo le togbɛ kɔkɔ ɖe sia ɖe tame, le towo katã dzi, le ati dama ɖe sia ɖe te kple logoti dodowo katã gɔme; afi sia afi si wotsɔ lifi do dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe na woƒe legbawo katã le la.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Makɔ asi dzi ɖe wo ŋu, eye mana anyigba la nazu aƒedo kple gbegbe le woƒe amenɔƒewo katã tso gbedadaƒo va se ɖe Ribla. Ekema woanyae be nyee nye Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Wò amegbetɔ vi, Aƒetɔ Mawu gblɔ le Israel-nyigba la ŋu be: Ewu nu! Nuwuwu ɖo na anyigba la ƒe dzogoe eneawo.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyematso wò ɖi loo, alo akpɔ nublanui na wò o. Ke boŋ mahe to na wò ɖe wò nuwɔnawo ta esime wò ŋunyɔnuwo le dowòme. Ekema miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Dzɔgbevɔ̃e le dzɔgbevɔ̃e yome! Kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna.

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Nuwuwu va ɖo, nuwuwu la va ɖo; enyɔ ɖe ŋuwò. Kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna.

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Wò anyigbadzinɔla, wò tsɔtsrɔ̃ do. Ɣeyiɣi la de, ŋkeke la gogo. Hoowɔwɔ ƒe ŋkekee; menye aseyetsotso le towo dzi ƒe nya ye o.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Azɔ esusɔ vie matrɔ nye dɔmedzoe akɔ ɖe dziwò, eye makpɔ dziku ɖe ŋuwò vevie. Madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò ɖe wò nuwɔnawo nu, eye mahe to na wò ɖe wò ŋunyɔnuwo katã ta.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Nyematso wò ɖi loo, alo akpɔ nublanui na wò o. Mahe to na wò ɖe wò nuwɔnawo nu ɣe si ɣi wò ŋunyɔnuwo gale dowòme. Ekema adze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ, ame si ƒoa ame.”

english_verse: Disaster is near! Injustice and arrogance are everywhere,
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke la! Kpɔ ɖa, egbɔna! Wò tsɔtsrɔ̃ ƒo se. Wò dàda do lotò.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Ŋutasesẽ trɔ zu ameƒoti hena vɔɖivɔ̃ɖinyenye; wo dometɔ aɖeke maganɔ anyi o. Woƒe nu gbogboawo loo, alo woƒe kesinɔnu maganɔ anyi o. Ŋkɔ xɔxɔ gɔ̃ hã maganɔ wo dome o.

english_verse: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi la de, ŋkeke la tu aƒe. Mègaɖe mɔ nuƒlela nakpɔ dzidzɔ o; nudzrala hã megafa konyi o. Elabe wokpɔ dziku ɖe woƒe amehawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: “Woku kpẽ, eye wona wo katã wobla akpa. Gake ame aɖeke meyi aʋa o; elabe nye dɔmedzoe le woƒe amehawo katã dzi.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Yi le kpɔ godo, dɔ vɔ̃ kple dɔwuame le aƒeme. Ame si le agble me la aku ɖe yi nu, eye ame si le du me la, dɔwuame kple dɔ vɔ̃ avuvui.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖewo tsi agbe hesí la, woanɔ towo dzi abe ahɔnɛwo le baliwo me ene. Wo katã woanɔ konyi fam, ame sia ame ɖe eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Asiwo katã agbɔdzɔ, eye klowo katã azu beli abe tsi ene.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Woata akpanya, ŋɔ adzi wo; ŋukpe alé wo katã, eye wo katã ƒe ta abebe.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ woƒe klosalo aƒu gbe ɖe ablɔwo me, eye woƒe sika anɔ abe nu makɔmakɔ ene na wo. Woƒe klosalo kple sika mate ŋu aɖe wo le Aƒetɔ ƒe dzikudogbe la o. Womate ŋu atsɔe atsi woƒe dɔwuame nu alo wòana woaɖi ƒo o. Elabe eyae nye nukikli na woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonu ƒo adegbe ƒuƒlui. Wotsɔ wo wɔ legba siwo nye ŋunyɔnuwo kple nu siwo wòlé fui. Eya ta mawɔe nu makɔmakɔ na wo.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Maɖe kɔ ɖa le wo ŋu ne woagblẽ kɔ ɖo na nye teƒe xɔasi la. Adzogliwo age ɖe eme agblẽ kɔ ɖo nɛ,

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: eye woawɔe aƒedoe.” “Elabe ʋukɔkɔɖi yɔ anyigba la dzi, eye ŋutasesẽ yɔ du la me.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Makplɔ dukɔ siwo vɔ̃ɖi wu la vɛ ne woaxɔ woƒe aƒewo. Matsi woƒe dàdaŋusẽ nu, eye woagblẽ kɔ ɖo na woƒe kɔkɔeƒewo.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Ne vevesese helihelĩ do la, woadi ŋutifafa, ke womakpɔe o.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e adze dzɔgbevɔ̃e yome. Wobewobe akplɔ wobewobe ɖo. Woadi ŋutega tso gbeƒãɖela la gbɔ. Ke se la abu ɖe nunɔla la, eye adaŋudede abu ɖe ame tsitsiwo.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Fia la afa konyi, dzi aɖe le amegã la ƒo. Ame siwo le anyigba la dzi la ƒe asiwo afa le ŋɔdzi ta. Maɖo eteƒe na wo ɖe woƒe nuwɔwɔ nu, eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo ɖe woƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ nu, eye woadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Le ƒè adelia ƒe ɣleti adelia ƒe ŋkeke atɔ̃a gbe la, menɔ nye aƒeme kple Yuda-metsitsi siwo nɔ anyi dze ŋgɔm esime Aƒetɔ Mawu ƒe asi va dzinye.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: Tete meda ŋku ɖi, eye kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ nane si ɖi ame ƒe nɔnɔme. Le teƒe si ɖi eƒe ali ƒe anyi me la, nane li abe dzo ene, eye le eƒe ali ƒe dzime la, nane ɖi keklẽ si le dzo dam abe akɔbli ene.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: Edo nane ɖa abe asi ene heku nye taɖa me. Gbɔgbɔ la kɔm ɖe ya me le anyigba kple dziƒo dome. Ekplɔm le Mawu ƒe ŋutega me va Yerusalem, va agbo emetɔ si dze ŋgɔ dzigbeme lɔƒo, afi si legba ʋãŋu si nana be woʋãa ŋu la le.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nɔ afi ma, abe ŋutega si mekpɔ le bali la me ene.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, trɔ mo ɖe dzigbeme nàfɔ mo dzi.” Mefɔ kɔ dzi kpɔ dzigbeme, eye kpɔ ɖa, le vɔsamlekpui la ƒe agbo la nu le eƒe dzigbeme la, legba ʋãŋu la le afi ma.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, èkpɔ nu si wɔm wolea? Èkpɔ ŋunyɔnu gã si wɔm Israel-dukɔ la le, le afi sia be yewoatsɔ nyàm ɖa ʋĩi tso nye kɔkɔeƒe laa? Gake èle ŋunyɔnu siwo lolo wu esia la kpɔ ge.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Ekplɔm va xɔxɔnu la ƒe mɔnu. Melé ŋku ɖe eŋu, eye kpɔ ɖa, do le gli la me.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, ɖe do ɖe gli la me.” Esi meŋɔ glia la, kpɔ ɖa, ʋɔtru aɖe li.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Ge ɖe eme ne nàkpɔ ŋunyɔnuvɔ̃ɖi siwo wɔm wole le afi sia la ɖa.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Ale mege ɖe eme. Mekpɔ wota nuwo ɖe glia ŋu ƒo xlã; lã vovovo siwo tana, lã nyɔŋuwo kple Israel-dukɔ ƒe legbawo katã.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Israel-dukɔ ƒe ametsitsiwo dometɔ bla adrẽ le tsitre dze ŋgɔ wo. Yaazanya, Safan vi nɔ tsitre le wo dome. Ɖe sia ɖe lé eƒe sonu ɖe asi, eye lifidzudzɔ de dzi kɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, èkpɔ nu si wɔm Israel-dukɔ ƒe ametsitsiwo le le viviti me, ame sia ame kple eƒe nutatawo le eƒe xɔ mea? Elabe wole gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Aƒetɔ mele mía kpɔm o, Aƒetɔ gblẽ anyigba la ɖi.’ ”

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Egagblɔ nam hã be: “Ègale ŋunyɔnu siwo lolo wu esiawo, siwo wɔm wole la kpɔ ge.”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Tete wòkplɔm va agbo si le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe ƒe dzigbeme la nu, eye kpɔ ɖa, nyɔnuwo nɔ anyi ɖe afi ma nɔ avi fam na Tamus.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ be: “Amegbetɔ vi, èkpɔea? Ègale ŋunyɔnu siwo lolo wu esia la kpɔ ge.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, èkpɔea? Nu tsɛ wònye be Yuda-to nanɔ ŋunyɔnu siawo wɔm le afi sia vɔ tso, hafi agatsɔ ŋutasesẽ ayɔ anyigba la dzi be yewoagado dziku nam ɖe edzia? Kpɔ ɖa, wotsɔ gbe vɔ̃ɖi wuame le dodom ɖe ŋɔti nu.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Eya ta matsɔ dɔmedzoe atu nu kpli wo. Nyemaŋe aɖaba aƒu edzi, alo akpɔ nublanui o. Ne wofa avi do ɣli ɖe to me nam hã, nyemasee o.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli sesĩe ɖe to me nam be: “Mi ame siwo le to he ge na du la, mite va. Ame sia ame nelé eƒe amewunu ɖe asi.”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu ade tso agbo si le dzime si dze ŋgɔ dzigbeme lɔƒo va; ame sia ame kple eƒe aʋawɔnu si wòtsɔ le ame wu gee la, le eya ŋutɔ si, eye ŋutsu aɖe si do aklalawu la le wo ŋuti. Elé kpe si dzi woaŋlɔ nu ɖo la ɖe axa me. Woyi ɖatɔ ɖe akɔblivɔsamlekpui la gbɔ.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Azɔ Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ho tso kerubiwo dzi afi si wònɔ tsã la heyi ɖe xɔ la ƒe kpui nu. Eyɔ ŋutsu si do aklalawu, eye nuŋlɔkpe le eƒe aklito la.

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ nɛ be: “Yi ɖatsa le Yerusalem-du la me, eye nàde dzesi ame siwo katã fa konyi, eye wole ŋeŋem le ŋunyɔnu siwo katã wole wɔwɔm le eme la ta.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Miwu ame tsitsiwo enumake, ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo, ɖevi suewo kple nyɔnuwo. Ke migaka asi ame siwo ƒe ŋgonu dzesi le la ŋu o. Midze egɔme tso nye kɔkɔeƒe la.” Ale wodze egɔme tso ame tsitsi siwo le aƒea me mɔnu la dzi.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na wo be: “Migblẽ kɔ ɖo na aƒe la, mitrɔ ame kukuawo kɔ ɖe xɔxɔnuawo keŋkeŋ. Miho ɖe edzi miayi.” Ale woyi ɖawu amewo le dua me.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Esi wole ameawo wum la, nye ɖeka metsi anyi. Metsyɔ mo anyi, fa avi, do ɣli gblɔ be: “Ao, Aƒetɔ Mawu! Ɖe nàtsrɔ̃ Israel ƒe ame mamlɛawo katã le wò dɔmedzoe si nètrɔ kɔ ɖe Yerusalem dzi la taa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Tete wòɖo eŋu nam be: “Israel-dukɔ kple Yuda-to ƒe fɔɖiɖi sɔ gbɔ akpa. Anyigba la yɔ fũu kple nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ; elabe wole gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Aƒetɔ gblẽ anyigba la ɖi, eye Aƒetɔ mele nu kpɔm o.’

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Nye ya, nyemaŋe aɖaba aƒu edzi, alo akpɔ nublanui o; ke maɖo eteƒe na wo ɖe woƒe nuwɔnawo nu.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu si do aklalawu, eye nuŋlɔkpe le aklito nɛ la trɔ gbɔ va gblɔ be: “Mewɔ abe ale si nèɖe gbe nam la ene.”

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: Tete meda ŋku ɖi, eye kpɔ ɖa, nane dze le dziŋgɔli si keke ɖe kerubiawo tame abe gbloti ene; eɖi fiazikpui ƒe nɔnɔme.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na ŋutsu si do aklalawu la be: “Yi afɔti siwo le totrom le kerubiawo gɔme la to me; ku dzokawo ɖe wò asiwo me tso kerubiawo dome nahlẽ ɖe dua me.” Mekpɔe wòyi.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Azɔ kerubiawo nɔ gbedoxɔ la ƒe anyigbeme hafi ŋutsua ge ɖe xɔ la me. Alilikpo aɖe va xɔ xɔxɔnu emetɔ la me keŋ.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ho dzo le kerubiawo dzi tso xɔa ƒe kpui nu. Alilikpoa yɔ xɔ la taŋ, eye Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe keklẽ la xɔ xɔxɔnu la katã.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Wose kerubiawo ƒe aʋalawo ƒe ɖiɖi le keke xɔxɔnu kɔtotɔ ke abe ale si Aƒetɔ, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe gbe ɖina ne wòle nu ƒom la ene.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Kerubi ɖeka do asi ɖa tso kerubiawo dome ɖe dzo si le kerubiawo dome la me. Eku dzoka la ƒe ɖe kɔ ɖe ŋutsu si do aklalawu la ƒe asiwo me. Exɔ dzoka la, eye wòdo go.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Kerubiawo dzé abe amegbetɔ ƒe asie le woƒe aʋalawo te ene.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Esi melé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu la, kpɔ ɖa, tasiaɖamfɔ ene nɔ kerubiawo xa; ɖeka nɔ kerubi ɖe sia ɖe gbɔ. Afɔawo nɔ dzo dam abe adzagba ene.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Dzedzeme ɖeka li na wo ame eneawo katã. Edze abe ɖe afɔ ɖeka le nɔvia me ene.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Ne wole yiyim la, wozɔna ɖe woƒe axa eneawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe dzi, eye wometrɔna o. Afi si ŋgɔgbetɔ ɖo tae la, afi mae wo katã woyina eye wometrɔna ne wole azɔli dzi o.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Toga li na afɔ eneawo eye kekemegati lɛlɛlɛwo le wo si. Ŋkuwo le togaawo ŋu ƒo xlã godoo.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: Mese wona ŋkɔ afɔawo be yalifɔwo.

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe to mo ene: Gbãtɔ nye kerubi ƒe mo, evelia nye amegbetɔ ƒe mo, etɔ̃lia nye dzata ƒe mo, eye enelia nye hɔ̃ ƒe mo.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Ne wotɔ la, afɔawo hã tɔna, eye ne wodzo yi ya me la, woawo hã wodzona yia ya me kpli wo. Elabe nu gbagbeawo ƒe gbɔgbɔ nɔ wo me.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe dzo le xɔ la ƒe kpui nu heyi ɖanɔ kerubiawo tame.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Kerubiawo ƒo aʋala hedzo yi ya me tso anyigba esime menɔ wo kpɔm wonɔ dzodzom. Afɔawo nɔ wo ŋu, eye woyi ɖatɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe ɣedzeƒegbo nu, eye Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la nɔ wo tame.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Esiawoe nye nu gbagbe siwo mekpɔ le Israel ƒe Mawu la te le Kebar-tɔsisi to, eye menya be kerubiwo wonye.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Woƒe mo ɖi mo siwo mekpɔ le Kebar-tɔsisi la to tututu. Ɖe sia ɖe ɖo ta ŋgɔ tẽe.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Megblɔ nu siwo katã Aƒetɔ ɖe fiam la na aboyomenɔlaawo.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Amegbetɔ vi, ŋutsu siawoe nye ame siwo ɖoa tame gbegblẽ, eye woɖoa aɖaŋu vɔ̃ le du sia me.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Woawoe gblɔna be: ‘Ɣeyiɣi mede ne woatu xɔ o. Du siae nye detsiƒoze, eye míawoe nye lã la.’

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ ƒe Gbɔgbɔ va dzinye, eye wògblɔ nam be: “Gblɔ be, Aƒetɔ be: Ao, Israel-dukɔ nu sia susum miele, elabe menya nu siwo vaa susu me na mi.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Miaƒe ame kukuwo ko dzim miele ɖe edzi le du sia me, eye miena ame kukuwo yɔ eƒe ablɔwo dzi fũu.

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Du lae nye detsiƒoze, eye ame kuku siwo mietsɔ mlɔ eme la woe nye lã, ke miawo la, woakplɔ mi adzoe le eme.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: Miele yi vɔ̃m; ke mahe yi ava mia dzi. Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: Makplɔ mi adoe le eme, eye matsɔ mi ade asi na amedzrowo, eye madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Miatsi yi nu, madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi le Israel ƒe liƒo dzi ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Du sia manye miaƒe detsiƒoze, eye miawo mimanye lã le eme o. Madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi le Israel ƒe liƒo dzi.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Mianyae be nyee nye Aƒetɔ elabe miezɔ nye ɖoɖowo dzi, alo wɔ nye sewo dzi o. Ke dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã mi godoo la ƒe sewo dzie miewɔ.”

english_verse: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Eva eme be esi menɔ gbeƒã ɖem la, Pelatya, Benaya vi la ku. Tete metsyɔ mo anyi, fa avi, do ɣli sesĩe be: “Ao! Aƒetɔ Mawu, ɖe nèbe yeatsrɔ̃ Israel ƒe ame mamlɛawo keŋkeŋua? Mawu ana Israel agazu abe ale si wònɔ tsã ene

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, nɔviwòwo, nɔviwòwo gɔ̃ hã, ame siwo le aboyo me kpli wò, Israel-dukɔ blibo la, woawo katã ŋue Yerusalemnɔlawo gblɔ le be: ‘Wodzo le Aƒetɔ gbɔ sãa. Míawoe wotsɔ anyigba sia na be wòanye mía tɔ.’

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Eya ta gblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Togbɔ be meɖo wo ɖe dukɔwo dome ʋĩi, eye togbɔ be mekaka wo ɖe anyigbawo dzi hã la, menye kɔkɔeƒe na wo ɣeyiɣi aɖe le anyigba siwo dzi woyi.’

english_verse: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.
translation_verse: Eya ta gblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Maƒo mia nu ƒu tso dukɔwo dome afi si woka mi hlẽ ɖo, eye matsɔ Israel-nyigba la na mi.’

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Nenye be wova ɖo afi ma la, woaɖe eƒe nu tɔŋkuwo kple ŋunyɔnuwo ɖa.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Mana dzi ɖeka naɖo wo si, eye made gbɔgbɔ yeye wo me. Maɖe kpedzi ɖa le woƒe dɔme atsɔ lãkusidzi ade wo me,

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: ne woazɔ ɖe nye ɖoɖowo nu, eye woaɖo to awɔ nye seawo dzi. Woanye nye dukɔ, eye manye Mawu na wo.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo ƒe dzi ti woƒe nu tɔŋkuawo kple ŋunyɔnuawo yome la, maɖo eteƒe na wo ɖe woƒe nuwɔnawo nu. Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.” Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe dzo le Yerusalem

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Tete kerubiawo dzo kple woƒe aʋalawo, tasiaɖamfɔawo nɔ wo ŋu, eye Israel ƒe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nɔ wo tame.

english_verse: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe dzo le dua me, eye wòyi ɖanɔ to si le dua ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome la dzi.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la kɔm le ŋutega me to Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dzi va aboyomenɔlawo gbɔ le Kaldea. Tete ŋutega si kpɔm menɔ la nu tso.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, ƒome dzeaglã dome nèle, ame siwo si ŋku le be woakpɔ nu, ke womekpɔa nu o, ame siwo si to le be woase nu, ke womesea nu o.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: Elabe ƒome dzeaglã wonye. Eya ta amegbetɔ vi, do aboyomeyigba, eye nàdze mɔ le ŋkeke me ɖo ta aboyo me ne woakpɔ. Dzo le nɔwòƒe nàyi afi bubu abe aboyomeyila ene le wo ŋkume. Ɖewohĩ woase nu gɔme, togbɔ be ƒome dzeaglã wonye hã.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: He agba si nèdo la do goe le ŋkeke me ne woakpɔ, abe aboyomeyigba ene. Wò ŋutɔ dze mɔ le fiẽ me le wo ŋkume abe ame si dzi wozi, kplɔ yina aboyo me la ene.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Ŋɔ gli la le wo ŋkume, eye nàto eme ado go.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wo ŋkumee nàkɔ wò agba ɖe abɔta le, eye nàdro agba la le zã me ado go. Tsyɔ nu mo, ne magakpɔ anyigba la o. Elabe wòe metsɔ ɖo dzesi na Israel-dukɔ la.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Mewɔ abe ale si woɖo nam la ene. Mehe nye agba ɖe go le ŋkeke me abe aboyomeyigba ene, eye le fiẽ la meŋɔ gli la kple nye ŋutɔ nye asi. Medo go le zã helé nye agba ɖe abɔta le wo ŋkume.

english_verse: The next morning, the Lord
translation_verse: Le ŋdi la, Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, ɖe Israel-dukɔ, dukɔ dzeaglã la mebia wò be: ‘Nu ka wɔm nèle’ oa?

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Gbedeasi sia yi na amegã si le Yerusalem la kple Israelvi siwo le eme.’

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be: ‘Dzesie menye na mi: Ale si mewɔ la, nenema woawɔ na wo. Wole aboyo me yi ge azu aboyomewo.’

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Amegã si le wo dome la adro eƒe agba ɖe abɔta le blukɔ me, eye wòadze mɔ. Aŋɔ gli ato eme ado go; atsyɔ nu ŋkume, ale be mate ŋu atsɔ ŋku akpɔ anyigba la o.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Maɖo ɖɔ nɛ, eye nye mɔ̀ aɖee. Makplɔe yi Babilon le Kaldeatɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi. Ke mele ekpɔ ge o, eye afi mae wòaku ɖo.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Maka eƒe xɔnametɔ siwo katã ƒo xlãe la kple eƒe aʋakɔwo hlẽ ɖe yawo katã nu. Maɖe yi ɖe go akplɔ wo ɖo,

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: ne woadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ, nenye be mekaka wo ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye meka wo hlẽ ɖe anyigbawo dzi.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Ke mana wo dome ame ʋɛ aɖewo nasí le yi nu, tso dɔwuame kple dɔ vɔ̃ nu. Ale be woava ɖi ɖase le woƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã ŋu le dukɔ siwo me yi ge woala la dome, ne woadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.” Gbeƒãɖela si le dzodzom nyànyanya la ƒe dzesi

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, ƒo kpakpakpa nàɖu wò abolo, eye nàdzo nyànyanya ano tsi kple vɔvɔ̃.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na dukɔ si le anyigba la dzi be: Aƒetɔ Mawu gblɔ ɖe Yerusalemnɔla siwo le Israel-nyigba dzi la ŋu be: Woaɖu woƒe abolo kple vɔvɔ̃, eye woano tsi kple dzodzo nyànyanya. Elabe nuwo le vɔvɔ ge le anyigba la dzi ƒiaƒiaƒia, le edzinɔlawo ƒe ŋutasesẽ ta.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Du siwo me amewo nɔ kpɔ la azu aƒedo, eye anyigba la azu gbegbe, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, lodonya kae nye esi gblɔm miele le Israel-nyigba la ŋuti be: ‘Ŋkekeawo didi, eye ŋutegawo hã mava eme o’?

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Eya ta gblɔ na wo be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Mana lododo sia nu natso, eye womagadoe le Israel o.’ Ke gblɔ na wo be ŋkekeawo tu aƒe, eye ŋutega ɖe sia ɖe le eme va ge.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Elabe alakpaŋutegawo kple nukpɔkpɔ siwo nye numevivi maganɔ Israel-dukɔ la me azɔ o.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ke nye Aƒetɔ ŋutɔ magblɔ nye nya si magblɔ la, eye wòava eme. Megale megbe tsi ge o, ke le mi ƒome dzeaglãwo ƒe ŋkeke mee magblɔ nya awɔ edzi le. Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, kpɔ ɖa, Israel-dukɔ la be: ‘Ŋutega si kpɔm wòle la gbɔ metsɔ o, eye ɣeyiɣi siwo le ŋgɔ ʋĩi la ŋu wòle gbeƒã ɖem le.’

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eya ta gblɔe na wo be: Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Nye nya aɖeke megale megbe tsi ge o. Ke nya si magblɔ la ava eme.” Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, ɖe gbeƒã ɖe Israel ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ŋu, ɖe gbeƒã na ame siwo tsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe susu ko le gbeƒã ɖemee la be: ‘Mise Aƒetɔ ƒe nya!’

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Baba na gbeƒãɖela movitɔ siwo mekpɔ naneke hafi kplɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖo o!

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israel, wò gbeƒãɖelawo le abe abeiwo le glikpowo dzi ene.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: Mimexe miaƒe gbagbãƒewo, alo ɖo Israel-dukɔ la ƒe gliwo be wòate ŋu anɔ te le aʋa me le Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la dzi o.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Woƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe mele eteƒe o, eye nu si wokpɔ la nye alakpa. Wobe: ‘Aƒetɔ be’; evɔ Aƒetɔ medɔ wo hafi o, eye wole mɔkpɔkpɔ me be awɔ yewoƒe nya dzi.

english_verse: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
translation_verse: Ɖe menye kpɔfuflu miekpɔ, eye mieɖe gbeƒã alakpanya ɣe sia ɣi si miebe: ‘Aƒetɔ be’, evɔ nyemeke nu oa?”

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Esi miegblɔ ameflunya, eye miekpɔ alakpaŋutegawo la, eya ta kpɔ ɖa, metsi tre ɖe mia ŋu. Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Nye asi atso ɖe gbeƒãɖela siwo flua ame, eye woƒe nukpɔkpɔ nye alakpa la ŋu. Womanɔ nye dukɔ ƒe adaŋudeha me loo, alo woaŋlɔ wo ŋkɔ ɖe Israel-dukɔ ƒe ŋkɔgbalẽ me loo, alo ade Israel-nyigba dzi o; ne woadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ Mawu.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: Elabe le nyateƒe me la, woawoe kplɔ nye dukɔ la trae hegblɔ be: ‘Ŋutifafa li’, esime ŋutifafa aɖeke meli o. Elabe ne dukɔa ɖo gli la, gbeƒãɖela siawo sia akalo nɛ.

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na ame siwo si akalo la be glia le mumu ge. Tsi gã adza, tsikpe gãwo adza, eye ahom atu.

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: Ne glia mu la, ɖe womabia be: ‘Afi ka miaƒe akalo si miesi la le oa?’

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: ‘Mado dɔmedzoe ana ahom atu, eye tsi gã adza le nye dziku me, eye mado dɔmedzoe ana tsikpe gãwo nadza ne nu nagblẽ.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Mamu gli si miesi akalo na la, atutui aƒu anyi, eye eƒe gɔmeɖokpe natsi go. Ne emu la, miatsi eme, eye miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: Aleae maɖe nye dziku ɖe gli la kple ame siwo si akalo nɛ la ŋui. Magblɔ na mi be gli la kple ame siwo si akalo la nɛ siaa megali o.

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ɖe gbeƒã ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eye wokpɔ ŋutifafaŋutega tso eŋu, esime ŋutifafa meli o hafi.’ ” Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe. Gbeƒãɖeɖe ɖe nyɔnu aʋatsogbeƒãɖelawo ŋu

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: “Azɔ, wò amegbetɔ vi, trɔ mo ɖe wò dukɔ me nyɔnuviwo ŋu, ame siwo ɖea gbeƒã woawo ŋutɔ ƒe susuwo la ŋu.

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be, Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Baba na ame siwo saa dzoka ɖe woƒe alɔnu, eye wotsyɔ nu ta kple ŋkume na ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo be yewoatsɔ lé luʋɔwoe! Ɖe mialé nye dukɔmeviwo ƒe luʋɔ, be luʋɔ bubuwo natsi agbe ne miakpɔ viɖea?

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Miegblẽ kɔ ɖo nam le nye dukɔ la ŋkume le lu asiʋlo ɖeka kple abolo kakɛ ta. Miewu ame siwo medze na ku o, eye miegblẽ esiwo dze na ku la ɖi to alakpa si mieda na nye dukɔ, si ɖoa to alakpanya la me.”

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Kpɔ ɖa, metso ɖe miaƒe dzoka siwo mietsɔna léa luʋɔwoe la ŋu. Matso wo le miaƒe alɔnu, eye maɖe ga luʋɔ siwo mielé abe xevi ene la.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Maɖe avɔ siwo mietsyɔ ta kple mo la hã ɖa, eye maɖe nye dukɔ tso mia si me, eye womaganye nuléle le mia si me azɔ o. Ekema miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: Elabe mietsɔ alakpa ɖe dzi le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ƒo, togbɔ be nyemeɖe dzi le eƒo hafi o hã. Miede dzi ƒo na nuvɔ̃wɔla be negatrɔ tso eƒe mɔ vɔ̃ dzi ne wòatsi agbe o.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Eya ta miagakpɔ amefluŋutegawo azɔ loo, alo aka nu o. Maɖe nye dukɔ tso mia si me. Ekema miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete Israel-metsitsi aɖewo va gbɔnye va nɔ ŋkunye me.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, ŋutsu siawo va kple woƒe dzimelegbawo, eye woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ siwo nye nukikli la le ŋkume na wo. Ɖe maɖe mɔ be woava bia gbema?

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Eya ta ƒo nu kpli wo nàgblɔ na wo be, Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Ŋutsu sia ŋutsu si tso Israel-dukɔ la me, si lé eƒe legba ɖe dzime, eye eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ nye nukikli le eŋkume, hafi va Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela gbɔ la, nye Aƒetɔ ŋutɔe aɖo nya ŋu nɛ; le eƒe legbawo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ta.

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: Ale be nye asi nasu Israel-dukɔ ƒe ame siwo katã ʋu le yonyeme le woƒe legbawo ta la ƒe dziwo dzi.”

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: Eya ta gblɔ na Israel-dukɔ la be, Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Mitrɔ dzime, mitrɔ le miaƒe legbawo yome, eye miɖe kɔ ɖa le miaƒe ŋunyɔnuwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: Elabe Israel vi, alo amedzro si le Israel-nyigba dzi, si te ɖa le ŋunye helé eƒe legbawo ɖe dzime, eye wòtsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ wɔ nuklinu ɖe mo, gake wòto egbɔ va Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela gbɔ be yeabia nu tso gbɔnye la, nye Aƒetɔ ŋutɔe laɖo nya ŋu nɛ.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Makpe akɔ kplii, atsɔ ŋutsu ma awɔ dzesi ado hameloe. Matsrɔ̃e ɖa le nye dukɔ la dome, ne miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: Ke ne gbeƒãɖela aɖe kpɔ kpɔfuflu, eye wògblɔ nya aɖe la, nye Aƒetɔ ye flu gbeƒãɖela ma. Mado nye asi ɖe egbɔ, eye matsrɔ̃e ɖa le nye dukɔ Israel dome.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ woƒe tohehe, ale si gbeƒãɖela la ƒe tohehe le la, nenemae ame si va gbe bia ge hã tɔ anɔ.

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: Ale be Israel-dukɔ magatra mɔ tso gbɔnye loo, alo agblẽ kɔ ɖo na wo ɖokui kple woƒe dzidadawo azɔ o; bene woanye nye dukɔ, eye manye woƒe Mawu.” Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe. Noa, Daniɛl kple Hiob

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, ne anyigba aɖe wɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye, megaxɔ dzinye se o, eye mekɔ nye alɔ dzi ɖe eŋu hegblẽ mɔ si dzi wòtona kpɔa abolo, hena dɔ to le afi ma, eye metsrɔ̃ amewo kple lãwo le edzi,

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: nenye be ŋutsu etɔ̃ siawo: Noa, Daniɛl kple Hiob gɔ̃ hã nɔ eme la, woaɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbe le woƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta. Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: Ne medɔ lã wɔadãwo ɖe anyigba la dzi, be woagblẽ nu, ne wòazu gbegbe, be lãwo nawɔe be ame aɖeke mate ŋu ado mo ɖe afi ma o,

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: nenye be ŋutsu etɔ̃ siawo kura gɔ̃ hã nɔ eme la, zi ale si mele agbe la, nye Aƒetɔ Mawu mebe: Womaɖe viŋutsu alo vinyɔnu o, negbe woawo ɖeɖe ko woaɖe; ke anyigba la azu gbegbe.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Alo ne mehe yi ɖe asi yi anyigba ma dzi, hegblɔ be yi netsrɔ̃ amewo kple lãwo siaa le edzi,

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: togbɔ be ŋutsu etɔ̃ siawo nɔ eme hã la, nye Aƒetɔ Mawu mebe, zi ale si mele agbe la, womaɖe viŋutsu alo vinyɔnu o, negbe woawo ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: Alo ne meɖo dɔ vɔ̃ ɖe anyigba ma dzi hetrɔ nye dɔmedzoe kple ʋu kɔ ɖe edzi, ne woatsrɔ̃ amewo kple lãwo,

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.
translation_verse: ne Noa, Daniɛl kple Hiob gɔ̃ hã nɔ eme la, nye Aƒetɔ Mawu mebe, zi ale si mele agbe la, womaɖe viŋutsu alo vinyɔnu o. Woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbe ko woaɖe to woƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Ale ke wòanɔ ne meɖo tohehe sesẽ ene ɖe Yerusalem: yi, dɔwuame, lã wɔadãwo kple dɔ vɔ̃, be matsrɔ̃ amewo kple lãwo?

english_verse: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame aɖewo tsi agbe le edzi be woakplɔ viŋutsuwo kple vinyɔnuwo do goe, ne wova do ɖe mia gbɔ, eye miekpɔ woƒe zɔzɔme kple nuwɔnawo la, miafa akɔ na mia ɖokui le dzɔgbevɔ̃e si mehe va Yerusalem dzi kple nu siwo katã mehe va edzii la ta.

english_verse: You will be convinced that I, the Lord God, was right in doing what I did.
translation_verse: Woafa akɔ na mi, ne miekpɔ woƒe zɔzɔme kple nuwɔnawo, eye miadze sii be nyemewɔ nu siwo katã mewɔ ɖe eŋu la dzodzro o.” Nye Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya va nam be:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, what happens to the wood of a grapevine after the grapes have been picked? It isn't like other trees in the forest,
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, nu kae na waintinake to nake bubuwo ŋu? Nu kae na wainti ƒe alɔ to avemeti bubuawo ŋu?

english_verse: because the wood of a grapevine can't be used to make anything, not even a small peg to hang things on.
translation_verse: Ɖe wotsɔa eƒe ati wɔa nanea? Ɖe wotsɔa eƒe ati wɔa tsyoti be woaku nu ɖe eŋua?

english_verse: It can only be used as firewood. But after its ends are burnt and its middle is charred, it can't be used for anything.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wodenɛ dzo me abe nake ene. Ne dzo fiã eƒe nugbɔ eveawo wozu aka, eye eƒe domedome ƒo dzo la, ɖe woagawɔ nane kplia?

english_verse: The wood is useless before it is burned, and afterwards, it is completely worthless.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, esi wòle blibo la, womewɔ naneke kplii o. Azɔ ŋudɔwɔnu kae wòaganye esi wòfiã heƒo dzo?

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise that just as the wood of a grapevine is burned as firewood,
translation_verse: Eya ta Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Ale si metsɔ waintinake le avemetiwo dome do dzoe la, nenema maɖe asi le Yerusalemnɔlawo ŋui.

english_verse: I will punish the people of Jerusalem with fire. Some of them have escaped one destruction, but soon they will be completely burned. And when that happens, you, Ezekiel, will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Makpe akɔ kpli wo. Nenye be wosí le dzo nu hã, dzo afiã wo, eye miadze sii be, nyee nye Aƒetɔ, ne mekpe akɔ kpli wo.

english_verse: I will make their country an empty wasteland, because they have not been loyal to me. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mawɔ anyigba la wòazu gbegbe, elabe womegaxɔ dzinye se o.” Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, remind the people of Jerusalem of their disgusting sins
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ vi, na Yerusalem nadze si eƒe ŋunyɔnuwo.

english_verse: and tell them that I, the Lord God, am saying: Jerusalem, you were born in the country where Canaanites lived. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na Yerusalem be, Aƒetɔ Mawu be: Wò dzɔƒe kple afi si wodzi wò le lae nye Kanaantɔwo ƒe anyigba. Tɔ́wò nye Amoritɔ, eye nɔwò nye Xititɔ.

english_verse: When you were born, no one cut you loose from your mother or washed your body. No one rubbed your skin with salt and olive oil, and wrapped you in warm blankets.
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe wodzi wò la, wometso ƒoƒolika na wò hafi ava yi tsi le ge na wò, ne ŋuwò naɖi o. Womesi dze na wò loo, alo xatsa avɔ ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Not one person loved you enough to do any of these things, and no one even felt sorry for you. You were despised, thrown into a field, and forgotten.
translation_verse: Ŋku aɖeke mekpɔ nublanui na wò, ne wòayi nu siawo dometɔ aɖeke wɔ ge na wò, le esi eƒe dɔme trɔ ɖe ŋuwò ta o. Ke boŋ gbe mee wotsɔ wò ƒu gbe ɖo, elabe ènyɔ ŋu na amewo, gbe si gbe wodzi wò la.”

english_verse: I saw you lying there, rolling around in your own blood, and I couldn't let you die.
translation_verse: “Esi meva to ŋuwò yina kpɔ wò nènɔ mimlim le wò ʋu me la, megblɔ na wò le wò ʋua me be: ‘Nɔ agbe,

english_verse: I took care of you, like someone caring for a tender, young plant. You grew up to be a beautiful young woman with mature breasts and hair, but you were still naked.
translation_verse: nàtsi abe gbemeti ene.’ Ètsi, kɔ hezu ɖetugbi. Nète no, eye wò ɖa to. Gake nènɔ amama keŋkeŋ.”

english_verse: When I saw you again, you were old enough to have sex. So I covered your naked body with my own robe. Then I solemnly promised that you would belong to me and that I, the Lord God, would take care of you.
translation_verse: “Esi megava to ŋuwò yi helé ŋku ɖe ŋuwò la, kpɔ ɖa, wò srɔ̃ɖeɣi ɖo. Metsɔ nye awu tsyɔ na wò, eye metsyɔ nu wò ama. Ẽ, medo ŋugbe na wò, mebla nu kpli wò, eye nèzu tɔnye. Aƒetɔ Mawu ye gblɔe.

english_verse: I washed the blood off you and rubbed your skin with olive oil.
translation_verse: Tete mele tsi na wò, klɔ ʋu le ŋuwò, eye mesi ami na wò.

english_verse: I gave you the finest clothes and the most expensive robes, as well as sandals made from the best leather.
translation_verse: Meta avɔ siwo wotsɔ ka ŋɔŋɔewo lɔ̃e la na wò; lãgbalẽfɔkpa nyuitɔe medo na wò. Meta aklala na wò hetsɔ sedavɔ wɔ taɖedzi na wò.

english_verse: I gave you bracelets, a necklace,
translation_verse: Meɖo atsyɔ̃ na wò kple abɔgɛwo kple kɔwla.

english_verse: a ring for your nose, some earrings, and a beautiful crown.
translation_verse: Medo ŋɔtigɛ kple togɛ na wò heɖɔ atsyɔ̃fiakuku na wò.

english_verse: Your jewelry was gold and silver, and your clothes were made of only the finest material and embroidered linen. Your bread was baked from fine flour, and you ate honey and olive oil. You were as beautiful as a queen,
translation_verse: Ale wodo sika kple klosalo na wò. Wò nutata nye aklala kple sedavɔ kple avɔ si wotsɔ ka ŋɔŋɔe lɔ̃e la. Wɔ memee, anyitsi kple amie nèɖuna. Ètsi va dze tugbe ale gbegbe heɖu fia.

english_verse: and everyone on earth knew it. I, the Lord God, had helped you become a lovely young woman.
