english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Elabe woƒe dzi le bibim abe kpodzo ene le woƒe ayedzedze ta. Dɔmedzoe nɔa wo me zã blibo, eye le ŋdi me la, eléa dzo vla.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Wo katã woxɔ dzo abe kpodzo ene, eye wovuvua woƒe dziɖulawo. Woƒe fiaawo katã dze anyi, eye wo dometɔ aɖeke meyɔam o. Israel kple dukɔ bubuwo

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Efrayim tsaka kple dukɔwo; Efrayim nye abolo si wometrɔ o.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Ame tutɔwo le ŋusẽ xɔm le esi gake menyae o. Eƒe ta ƒo wɔ, gake menyae o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel ƒe dàda le ɖase ɖim le eŋu, ke wometrɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ, woƒe Mawu la ŋu o, eye womedii le nu siawo katã me o.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: Israel le abe ahɔnɛ ene; etsi bome eye susu mele esi o: Wole Egipte yɔm, wole Asiria yim.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Ne woyina la, mada nye asabu ɖe wo dzi, aɖiɖi wo ɖe anyi abe dziƒoxewo ene; mahe to na wo le woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Baba na wo, elabe wotra tso gbɔnye. Wonetsrɔ̃, elabe wodze aglã ɖe ŋunye! Ðe medi be maɖe wo hafi, ke woka aʋatso ɖe asinye.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Womedo gbe ɖa nam tso dzi vavã me o, ke boŋ wofa avi le woƒe abawo dzi. Wode abi gãwo wo ɖokui ŋu be yewoakpɔ bli kple wain. Wodze aglã ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nyee he wo, eye mena ŋusẽ le wo ŋu hã la, woɖo vɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Wotrɔ ɖe Baal ŋuti. Wole abe dati si me do agblɔ ene. Woƒe amegãwo atsi yi nu, le woƒe aɖe ƒe dàda ta. Woatsɔ esia aɖe alɔ me le wo ŋu le Egipte-nyigba dzi.

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: Tsɔ kpẽ ɖo nu nàku! Elabe akaga aɖe le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la tame, esi wotu nye nubabla la ta, esi wogbe nye se la ta.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Israel yɔam be, nye Mawu, mí Israelviwo míedze si wò.

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Ke Israel gbe nyuiwɔwɔ; futɔ la anya wo ɖe nu.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: Woɖo fiawo, ke wometo dzinye o. Woɖo amegãwo, ke nyemenya naneke le wo ɖoɖo ŋu o. Wotsɔ woƒe klosalo kple sika kɔ̀ legba, siwo atsrɔ̃ woawo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Samaria, wò nyivi la le ŋu nyɔm nam. Medo dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu vevie. Ɣe ka ɣi gɔ̃ woava zu ame dzadzɛwo

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Yae woƒã, eye yali woaŋe. Bli matse ku le woƒe agble me o. Ne etse ku gɔ̃ hã la, amedzrowo koe ava ɖui.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Womi Israel; wole dukɔwo dome abe ze gbagbã si ŋudɔ womagawɔ o la ene xoxo.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Elabe woyi Asiria, gbetedzi tsiakogo le tsa glalã tsam, ke Efrayim ya na nu eƒe ahiãviwo.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wona nu amedzrowo le dukɔwo dome hã la, maƒo wo nu ƒu kpuie, eye woadzudzɔ amisisi na fiawo kple amegãwo vie.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Elabe Efrayim ɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo fũu be woatsɔ awɔ nuvɔ̃e, wova zu vɔsamlekpuiwo nɛ na nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Ne meŋlɔ nye se akpe nanewo nɛ hã, ɖeko wòbua wo abe ame tutɔ tɔwoe wonye ene.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Wolɔ̃ vɔsasa; wotsɔa lã saa vɔe eye woɖunɛ. Ke woƒe nu medze Aƒetɔ ŋu o. Azɔ aɖo ŋku woƒe vododawo dzi, eye wòahe to le woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta. Woagbugbɔ ayi Egipte.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Elabe Israel ŋlɔ wo Wɔla be, eye wòtu fiasãwo. Yuda dzi du sesẽwo ɖe edzi; ke maɖo dzo ɖe eƒe duwo me eye wòafiã eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo.

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Israel, mèganɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm o! Mègatso aseye abe dukɔwo ene o; elabe èwɔ gbolo gblẽ wò Mawu ɖi. Elɔ̃ gbolo ƒe nunana le lugbɔƒewo katã.

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Lugbɔƒe kple ahafiãƒe manyi wo o, eye wain yeye aflu wo.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Womaganɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe anyigba dzi o, ke Efrayim atrɔ ayi Egipte, eye woaɖu nuɖuɖu makɔmakɔ le Asiria.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Womaƒo wain ɖe anyi na Aƒetɔ o. Womatsɔ woƒe vɔsawo ado dzidzɔ nɛ o. Woƒe nuɖuɖu anɔ abe konyifalawo ƒe nuɖuɖu ene, eye eɖulawo katã agblẽ kɔ ɖo, elabe woƒe nuɖuɖu atsi dɔwuame ko nu na wo; mava Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me o.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Azɔ nu ka miawɔ le ŋkekenyui ɖugbe la kple Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkekenyui la dzi?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, woyina ɖe Asiria; Egipte aƒo wo, Memfis aɖi wo. Dza ato ɖe woƒe klosalonu veviwo dzi, eye ŋugbewo avu ɖe woƒe nɔƒewo.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Tohegbewo ɖo; teƒeɖogbewo va ɖo vɔ. Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela nye movitɔ, gbɔgbɔmeme la ku tsu le woƒe vodada gbogboawo, kple fuléle gã la ta.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Gbeƒãɖela nye gbetakpɔla na Efrayim, nye Mawu ƒe dukɔ, ke xevimɔ̀ka le eƒe toƒewo katã, eye fuléle le eƒe Mawu ƒe aƒeme.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Wogblẽ wo ɖokui kple nu fitifiti wɔwɔ abe ale si wònɔ le Gibea ƒe ɣeyiɣi me ene. Mawu aɖo ŋku woƒe vodada, eye wòahe to na wo ɖe woƒe nuvɔ̃ ta. Israel ƒe nuvɔ̃ kple eyomedzenu

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Mefɔ Israel-dukɔ la, abe ale si wofɔa wainka tsetse le gbedadaƒo ene. Mekpɔ mia tɔgbuiwo, abe ale si wokpɔa gbotsetse gbãtɔ le gboti dzi le nuŋeɣi ene. Ke esi wova Baal Peor la, wokɔ wo ɖokui ŋu na Baal, eye wova zu ŋunyɔnu abe nu si wolɔ̃ la ene.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Efrayim ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe adzò adzó abe xevi ene; vidzidzi kple fufɔfɔ aɖeke meli o!

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Evɔ ne wodzi viwo, nyi wo wotsi gɔ̃ hã la, mana woaku va se ɖe esime ɖeke masusɔ o. Baba na wo, ne medzo le wo gbɔ.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Efrayim viŋutsuwo, abe ale si mekpɔ woe ene la, woɖo wo ɖi wonye nuléle; Efrayim akplɔ via ŋutsuwo ayi ɖe amewuƒe.

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, tsɔe na wo. Nu ka tsɔ ge nàla na wo? Tsɔ vidzidɔ si gea fu kple no tsimanɔmee na wo. Aƒetɔ he to na Israel

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖe sia ɖe le Gilgal; afi mae medze fuléle wo gɔme tsoe. Le woƒe nuwɔna vɔ̃ɖiwo ta la, manyà wo ɖa tso nye aƒeme. Nyemagalɔ̃ wo azɔ o; woƒe amegãwo katã nye aglãdzelawo.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Woƒo Efrayim, woƒe ke ƒu; womatse ku o. Togbɔ be woadzi hã la, mawu wo vi lɔlɔ̃awo. Gbeƒãɖela la ƒo nu le Israel ŋu

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu atsɔ wo aƒu gbe elabe womeɖo toe o; woanye tsatsalawo le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Israel nye wainka ʋaʋã si tse fũu. Ne eƒe kutsetse dzi ɖe edzi la, ekema eɖia vɔsamlekpuiwo hã fũu. Ne eƒe anyigba ʋã nu la, eme legba nyakpɔwo ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzi metoa nyateƒe o. Azɔ la, ele be woatsɔ woƒe fɔɖiɖi ƒe agba. Aƒetɔ agbã woƒe vɔsamlekpuiawo, eye wòatsrɔ̃ woƒe legbawo.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Elabe azɔ la, wòagblɔ be: “Fia aɖeke mele mía si o, elabe míevɔ̃a Aƒetɔ o. Evɔ ɖe fia, nu ka wòate ŋu awɔ na mí?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Wogblɔa yakanyawo, woblaa nu kple wo nɔewo hekaa atam dzodzro ƒua edzi. Ale ʋɔnudɔdzɔ̃ amie abe aɖigbe le bo dzi le agble me ene.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Samarianɔlawo adzo nyànyanya, na Bet-Aven nyivi la. Eƒe amewo afa konyi nɛ, eye eƒe trɔ̃nuawo afa avi ɖe eŋuti; afa eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe si dzo le edzi la.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Ẽ, woakɔ nua ŋutɔ ayi Asiria abe adzɔ ene na fia gã la. Woado ŋukpe Efrayim, eye ŋukpe alé Israel le eƒe legba ta.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samaria-fia atsrɔ̃ abe ati fefee le tɔ ŋgɔ ene.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Nuxeƒe siwo le Aven, si nye Israelviwo ƒe nuvɔ̃ la, woatsrɔ̃e. Ŋuwo kple aŋɔkawo awɔ ɖe woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo dzi, eye woagblɔ na towo be: “Mitsyɔ mía dzi!” na togbɛwo be: “Mimu dze mía dzi!” Aƒetɔ gblɔ tohehe si wòana Israel

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Israel, tso Gibea ŋɔli ke miewɔ nuvɔ̃; afi mae woyi ewɔwɔ dzi tsoe. Ɖe aʋa matu wo le Gibea oa?

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Mava ɖe dukɔ gbegblẽ ŋu, eye woaƒo dukɔwo nu ƒu ɖe wo ŋu, eye woahe to na wo ɖe woƒe vodada eveawo ta.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Efrayim nye nyivi mamla si lugudugudu dzɔa dzi na, eye nyemeɖe fu na eƒe kɔ nyui la o; ke azɔ la, made kɔkuti na Efrayim. Ele be Yuda naŋlɔ nu eye ele be Israel nadzoboe na eɖokui.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Miƒã nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ na mia ɖokui, miŋe lɔlɔ̃ si anɔ anyi ɖaa, mide agble yeye. Elabe ɣeyiɣi de be miadi Aƒetɔ, be wòana agbexɔxɔ nadza ɖe mia dzi abe tsi ene.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Mieƒã nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ, ŋe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ tso eme, eye mieɖu alakpadada si nye eƒe kutsetse. Esi nèɖo ŋu ɖe wò tasiaɖamwo kple aʋawɔla gbogboawo ŋu ta la,

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: aʋaɣli aɖi le wò dukɔ la dome eye woagbã wò mɔ́wo katã, abe ale si Salman gbã Bet-Arbel le aʋawɔgbe ene; woxlã vi nɔwo kple wo viwo ɖe nu wokaka.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Israel ƒe aƒe, alea wole wɔ wò gee, le wò nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ vivivo la ta. Le ahom la me la, woawu Israel-fia ya keŋkeŋ. eŋ.

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Esi Israel nye ɖevi la, melɔ̃e, eye Egipte ye meyɔ vinye le.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Zi ale si mele wo yɔm la, zi nenema ke wotrɔa megbe deam. Woyi dzi le vɔ sam na Baalwo, eye wole lifidzudzɔ dom na legbawo.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Evɔ wònye nyee fia azɔlizɔzɔ Israel, eye mekɔe ɖe nye abɔwo dome hafi; ke womedze sii be nyee da gbe le yewo ŋu o.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Mehe wo ɖe ŋunye kple lɔlɔ̃ abe kae mede wo he ene. Menɔ na wo abe ame si ɖea kɔkuti le kɔ na ame ene. Mebɔbɔ na nu wo woɖu.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Woatrɔ ayi Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye Asiria anye woƒe fia, elabe wogbe be yewomatrɔ ava gbɔnye o.

english_verse: War will visit their cities, and their plans will fail.
translation_verse: Yi atso ɖe woƒe duwo ŋu, aŋe duawo ƒe agbowo keŋ, eye wòavuvu wo le woƒe mɔ́wo me.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Aglãdzedze ɖe ŋunye doa dzidzɔ na nye dukɔ. Woɖoe ɖi be woade kɔkuti kɔ na wo, eye wo dometɔ aɖeke maɖee o.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Efrayim, ale ke matsɔ wò anae? Israel, ale ke matsɔ wò ade asii? Nu ka ta mawɔ wò abe Adma ene? Nu ka ta mawɔ wò abe Zeboyim ene? Nye dzi maɖe mɔ nam be mawɔ nenema gbeɖe o. Nye lɔlɔ̃ na wò nu sesẽ ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Nyemawɔ nye dɔmedzoe helihelĩ la ŋudɔ o. Nyemagatsrɔ̃ Efrayim azɔ o. Elabe Mawue menye, menye amegbetɔ o. Kɔkɔetɔ la le mia dome, eye nyemava agblẽ nu o.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Woadi Aƒetɔ yome mɔ, aɖe gbe abe dzata ene, ẽ, ele gbe ɖe ge eye viawo anɔ dzodzom nyànyanya atso ɣetoɖoƒe ava.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Woava anɔ dzodzom nyànyanya abe xeviwo ene tso Egipte, abe ahɔnɛwo ene tso Asiria-nyigba dzi, eye matrɔ wo ɖo ɖe woƒe aƒewo me, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Woahe to na Israel kple Yuda

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Efrayim kple Yuda tsɔ alakpadada ɖe to ɖem eye Israel ƒe aƒe la tsɔ amefuflu ɖe to ɖem, ke Mawu gadze si Yuda kokoko, eye wòwɔa nuteƒe na Kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si Israelviwo wɔna tso ŋdi va se ɖe fiẽ la nye nu dzodzro. Alakpanuwɔwɔ kple ŋutasesẽ le dzidzim ɖe edzi le wo dome gbe sia gbe. Wowɔ ŋutifafa kple Asiria, eye wotsaa amisi kple Egipte.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le nya he ge kple Yuda, eye wòahe to na Israel le nu si wɔm eƒe amewo le la ta. Aɖo eƒe nuwɔnawo teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Elé nɔvia ƒe afɔkpodzi le dɔ me. Esi wòɖo ŋutsume la, ete kame kple Mawu.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Ete kame kple mawudɔla, eye wòɖu edzi. Efa avi, eye wòɖe kuku na mawudɔla la be neve ye nu. Edo go Mawu le Betel, eye Mawu ƒo nu kplii le afi ma.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla la, Aƒetɔ nye eŋkɔ:

english_verse: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
translation_verse: Asitsala, si ƒe asi me amebanudanu le la, lɔ̃a ametete ɖe anyi.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Efrayim gblɔ be: “Ẽ, mekpɔ hotsui ŋutɔ! Kesinɔnu geɖe su nye ŋutɔ asinye.” Ke eƒe hotsui gbogbo la mate ŋu atrɔ fɔ si wòɖi la o.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la tso Egipte- nyigba dzi ke; magana nànɔ agbadɔwo me abe le ŋkekenyui ɖuɣi ene.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: Meƒo nu kple gbeƒãɖelawo, nyee dzi ŋutegawo ɖe edzi, eye medo lowo to gbeƒãɖelawo dzi.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Ne nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ le Gilead la, woavɔ ɖa kokoko; nenye be le Gilgal wotsɔa nyitsuwo saa vɔ la, woƒe vɔsamlekpuiwo hã anɔ abe kpe siwo woli kɔe ɖe bo dzi le agble me ene.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: To gbeƒãɖela aɖe dzi Aƒetɔ kplɔ Israel tso Egipte, eye wòkpɔ eta to gbeƒãɖela aɖe dzi.

english_verse: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
translation_verse: Israel do dziku nɛ vevie, ale Aƒetɔ ana eƒe hlɔ̃dodo nanɔ eyama dzi, eye wòaɖo eƒe vlodoame teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Ne Efrayim ƒo nu la, ŋutsuwo dzona nyànyanya. Bubu nɔ eŋu le Israel. Ke eɖi fɔ to Baal subɔsubɔ me, eye wòku.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Azɔ wogale nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ dzi ko, eye wowɔ nuwo ƒe nɔnɔme na wo ɖokui. Wotsɔ klosalo kɔ̀ legbawo aɖaŋutɔe. Wo katã wonye aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ. Tete wogblɔ be: “Misa vɔ na esiawo!” Amegbetɔ nagbugbɔ nu na nyiviwo!

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Eya ta woanɔ abe afu si dona le ŋdi me ene, alo zãmu si nu yina ŋdi kanya ene. Woanɔ abe nutsro si ya kplɔna dzonɛ le lugbɔƒe, alo dzudzɔ si toa fesre nu ene.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la, tso Egipte-nyigba dzi. Mènya Mawu aɖeke kpe ɖe ŋunye o. eye xɔnametɔ aɖeke mekpe ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Nyee kpɔ tawò le gbedadaƒo, le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Ke esi woɖu nu ɖi ƒo, heɖi ƒo nyuie la, wode asi dàda me, eya ta woŋlɔm be.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Eya ta manɔ abe dzata ene na wo; abe lãkle ene made xa ɖe mɔ dzi anɔ wo lalam.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Madze wo dzi abe sisiblisinɔ si ƒe viwo wolé dzoe la ene. Mafé akɔta na wo, eye mavuvu wo abe dzata ene le afi ma, abe ale si lã wɔadã avuvu woe ene.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: Israel, mele mia tsrɔ̃ ge! Ame kae ate ŋu akpe ɖe mia ŋu?

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Azɔ miaƒe fia la ɖe? Ne wòaxɔ na mi. Miaƒe amegãwo katã ɖe? Ne woaʋli mia ta. Menye woawo ŋui miegblɔ le be, “Ɖo fia kple amegãwo na mí” oa?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dziku mee mena fiawo mi le hexɔ wo le mia si le dɔmedzoe me.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: Wobla Efrayim ƒe vodada da ɖi, eye wodzra eƒe nuvɔ̃ ɖo ɖe nudzraɖoƒe.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: Vidzidzi ƒe vevesese tui, ke viŋutsuvi manyanu wònye; elabe eya ŋutɔ medo ta ɖe vidzidɔ nu be woadzi ye o.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Ɖe maɖe wo tso tsiẽƒe ƒe ŋusẽ si mea? Ɖe maxɔ wo tso ku Saɖagatsi sia? Ku, wò dɔ vɔ̃wo ɖe? Tsiẽƒe, wò tsɔtsrɔ̃ ɖe? Nublanuikpɔkpɔ le ɣaɣla ɖe nye ŋkuwo.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be awɔ nyuie abe aƒla ene hã la, ɣedzeƒeya, Aƒetɔ ƒe yaƒoƒo ava, atsó tso gbedadaƒo la; eƒe vudowo amie, eye eƒe tsidzɔƒewo aƒu. Atsɔ nu siwo katã le vevi na wo la adzoe.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Samaria atsɔ eƒe fɔɖiɖi ƒe agba elabe edze aglã ɖe eƒe Mawu ŋu. Woatsi yi nu le aʋa me; woatsɔ woƒe vidzĩwo axlã ɖe nu woakaka, eye woadze ƒo le woƒe funɔwo nu.

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Israel, gatrɔ va Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu la gbɔ, elabe miekli nu le miaƒe vodadawo ta.

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Nya siawo nenɔ mia nu miatrɔ ayi Aƒetɔ gbɔ aɖagblɔ nɛ be: “Tsɔ vodadawo katã ke, xɔ nu si nyo eye míana nu si míeke nu gblɔ be míana la.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiria maxɔ na mí o, míele sɔwo do ge o. Míagagblɔ na legba siwo míewɔ kple asi la azɔ be, ‘Mía Mawu’ o. Wòe kpɔa nublanui na tsyɔ̃eviwo.” Aƒetɔ do ŋugbe na Israelviwo be yeana woaganɔ agbe yeye

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Mayɔ dɔ woƒe nuteƒemawɔmawɔ. Malɔ̃ wo tso dzime ke, elabe nye dzi fa ɖe wo ŋu azɔ.

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Manɔ na Israelviwo abe zãmu ene. awɔ abe dzogbenya ene, eye wòali ke zã abe ati siwo le Lebanon ene.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Eƒe alɔwo avu dranyii, eye wòanyakpɔ abe amiti ene. Woanɔ ʋeʋẽm lílili abe ati siwo le Lebanon ene.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Woatrɔ va anɔ nye vɔvɔli te. Woawɔ nyuie abe abɔ ene. Woatse abe wainka ene, eye woaʋẽ lílili abe Lebanon-wain ene.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Efrayim, nu ka mawɔ kple legbawo? Nyee ɖoa miaƒe gbedodoɖawo ŋu, eye meléa be na mi. Mele abe sesewu dama ene, gbɔnyee miaƒe kutsetse tso. Nuwunya

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Ame si nye nunyala la, nese nu siawo gɔme, eye ame si sea nugɔme la nedze sii; elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe mɔwo dzɔ, eye ame dzɔdzɔewo zɔa edzi, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo klia nu dzea anyi ɖe edzi.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Gbe si Aƒetɔ de asi na Yoel, Petuel vi be wòayi aɖagblɔ lae nye esi:

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Amegãɖeɖiwo, miɖo to ne miase ɖa; Yuda-nyigba dzi nɔlawo katã, mizi ɖoɖoe kpoo! Ðe nu sia tɔgbe dzɔ le mia ŋɔli, alo mia tɔgbuiwo ŋɔli kpɔa?

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Migblɔe na mia viwo, ne woawo hã nagblɔe na wo viwo, eye wo viwo hã nagblɔe na dzidzime si le wo yome.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Minyɔ, ahanomunɔwo, ne miafa avi, Mi wain tsu nolawo, mido ɣli; elabe woɖe wain vivi la le nu me na mi.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Dukɔ aɖe me tɔwo ho aʋa va nye anyigba la dzi. Ŋusẽ le wo ŋu; wosɔ gbɔ ale gbegbe. Woƒe aɖu le abe dzatatsu tɔ ene, eye woƒe tsyo le abe dzatanɔ tɔ ene.

english_verse: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
translation_verse: Wogblẽ míaƒe wainkawo; woŋe míaƒe gbotiwo ɖu. Wofo tsro le wo ŋu tsɔ ƒu anyi, va se ɖe esime atilɔawo fu ɣie.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Mixa nu abe ɖetugbi si ta akpanya tsɔ le eƒe ɖetugbimesrɔ̃ si ku la fam ene.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖuvɔsa kple nunonovɔsa nu tso le Aƒetɔ ƒeme. Eya ta nunɔlawo, Aƒetɔ ƒe subɔlawo fa konyi.

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Agble zu gbegbe; anyigba le nu xam, elabe nukuwo gblẽ, aha yeye no ƒiaƒiaƒia, amitiwo ƒu.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Agbledelawo, miaƒe mo netsi dãa; waingbledelawo, miƒu asi nu ɖe lu kple ƒo ŋu, elabe agble me nukuwo katã gblẽ keŋ.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Wainka ku, gboti yrɔ; yevuboɖatiwo, detiwo, yevutɔtiwo kple agblemetiwo katã yrɔ. Amegbetɔ aɖeke megale dzidzɔ kpɔm o.

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Mita akpanya miafa konyi, mi nunɔlawo! Mifa avi kple ɣli, mi ame siwo subɔna le vɔsamlekpuia gbɔ. Mita akpanya yi mawuƒe la me miaɖatsi afi ma dɔ, mi, nye Mawu subɔlawo, elabe nuɖuɖuvɔsa kple nunonovɔsa nu tso le mia Mawu ƒeme.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nutsitsidɔ kɔkɔe; miyɔ takpekpe tɔxɛ! Miƒo ame tsitsiwo kple anyigba la dzi nɔlawo katã nu ƒu ɖe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ƒeme, ne miado ɣli ayɔ Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Ðe nuɖuɖu nu metsi le mía ŋkume, eye dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple aseyetsotso nu metso le mía Mawu ƒeme oa?

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Blikuwo tsi anyigba ƒuƒu me ku, bli mewɔ o. Ale nuɖuɖudzraɖoƒewo ɖi ƒuƒlu eye avawo mu.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Lãwo le xɔxlɔ̃m nublanuitɔe, nyihawo tɔtɔ eye wole tsa glalã tsam elabe gbeɖuƒe aɖeke meli na wo o. Nu te alẽhawo gɔ̃ hã ŋu.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: O, Aƒetɔ! Wò yɔm mele. Elabe dzo bi gbe le lãnyiƒewo, eye dzo ƒe aɖewo fiã agblemetiwo katã.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Gbemelãwo gɔ̃ hã le xɔxlɔ̃m le yɔwòm, elabe tɔwo mie eye lãnyiƒewo bi dzo.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Miku kpẽ le Zion, miƒu asi nu le nye to kɔkɔe la dzi! Mina anyigba dzi nɔlawo katã nadzo nyànyanya! Elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la gbɔna; etu aƒe vɔ!

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Viviti tsiɖitsiɖi kple blukɔ dogbe; alilikpo kple tsizi dogbe ye! Ʋetsuviwo ƒe aʋakɔ gãwo aho abe vivitie do ɖe to ŋu ene. Etɔgbe medzɔ kpɔ o, magadzɔ hã akpɔ le dzidzime siwo katã gbɔna la me o.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Woɖi sɔ, eye wole du dzi abe sɔwoe le aʋagbedzi ene.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Wole kpo tim le towo ŋu, eye woƒe nuwɔna le ɖiɖim abe tasiaɖamwo ƒe hoowɔwɔ ene. Wole zi nyem abe dzoe le gbe ƒuƒu fiãm ene. Wodze aʋa abe aʋakɔ gã aɖe ene.

english_verse: The very sight of them is frightening.
translation_verse: Ne wote tu amewo la, dzidzi ƒoa ame sia me, eye mowo funa títiti.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Ʋetsuviawo le du dzi abe kalẽtɔwo ene, ɖe sia ɖe to ŋgɔ tẽe, ɖeke medze to nɔvia ƒe toƒe,

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: alo mimi nɔvia ɖo o. Wogblẽ aʋawɔnu ɖe sia ɖe si le woƒe mɔ me la dome; naneke mexe mɔ na wo o.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Wolũ ɖe dua dzi; wole du ƒum le gliwo dzi le gegem ɖe xɔwo me, ɖewo ya to fesre nu abe fiafitɔ ene.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Esime wogbɔna la, anyigba dzo kpèkpekpe; dziƒo ʋuʋu; ɣe kple ɣleti do viviti; ɣletiviwo gbe keklẽ.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le gbe ɖem na eƒe aʋakɔ. Aʋawɔlaawo sɔ gbɔ, sesẽ eye woɖoa toe. Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la tri akɔ; edzi ŋɔ ŋutɔ. Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe enu? Aƒetɔ gblɔ na eƒe amewo be woatrɔ dzime

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Mitrɔ dzime miatrɔ va gbɔnye to nutsitsidɔ, avifafa kple konyifafa me.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Mitrɔ dzime tso ememe ke. Migadze miaƒe awuwo me ko o.” Mitrɔ va Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la gbɔ. Ðe wòvea ame nu, kpɔa nublanui na ame eye wògbɔa dzi blewuu; eƒe lɔlɔ̃ metrɔna o. Etsɔa vɔ̃ kena; tohehe na ame venɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ðewohĩ Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu atrɔ susu, agayra mi eye nukuwo aganyo na mi fũu ale be miagakpɔ bli kple wain ava sa vɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Miku kpẽ la le Zion-to dzi. Miwɔ nutsitsidɔ kɔkɔe; miyɔ takpekpe tɔxɛ!

english_verse: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
translation_verse: Miƒo dukɔmetɔwo nu ƒu, mikɔ wo ŋu. Miyɔ ame tsitsiwo vɛ; ɖeviwo kple vi nonowo gɔ̃ hã neva. Mina ŋugbetɔ kple srɔ̃a nado le xɔ me va.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Mina nunɔlawo, Aƒetɔ ƒe subɔlawo nafa avi le akpata la kple vɔsamlekpui la dome agblɔ be: “O, Aƒetɔ, kpɔ nublanui na wò amewo. Mègana wò dukɔ la nazu alɔmeɖenu na dukɔ bubuwo, ale be woanɔ ahama sim le wo ŋu anɔ gbɔgblɔm be: ‘Afi ka woƒe Mawu la le?’ mahã o.” Mawu na anyigba la ganyo nu

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Tete anyigba la ƒe nu wɔ nublanui na Aƒetɔ, eye wòkpɔ nublanui na eƒe amewo.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu gblɔ na eƒe amewo be: “Kpɔ ɖa, maɖo bli, wain kple ami ɖe mi, ne miaɖu aɖi ƒo. Nyemagana miazu alɔmeɖenu le dukɔwo dome azɔ o.

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: Maɖe ʋetsuvi ƒe aʋakɔ si tso dzigbeme va la ɖa; manyàe ɖo ɖe kuɖiɖinyigba dzi kple gbegbe. Manyà ŋgɔgbetɔwo ɖo ɖe Dzeƒu nu, eye mana megbetɔwo naɖo ta Domeƒu nu. Mana woaƒaƒã anɔ ʋeʋẽm le nu si wowɔ mi la ta.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: Anyigba, mègavɔ̃ o; tso aseye nàkpɔ dzidzɔ le nu gã si Aƒetɔ wɔ na wò la ta.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Gbemelãwo, migavɔ̃ o, elabe lãnyiƒewo ade ama, atiwo atse kplanyaa eye kutsetse ado agba ɖe gboti kple wainka dzi.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: “Zionviwo, dzi nedzɔ mi! Mitso aseye ɖe Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ŋu, elabe egana tsi dza na mi le edzaɣi: tsi dza le adame tsi dza le keleme abe ale si wòdzana ene.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Lu ayɔ lugbɔƒe fũu, wain kple ami ayɔ nuwo agbagba le ahafiãƒe.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Medɔ nye aʋakɔ gã la ɖa: Ʋetsuvi, ʋetra, abɔ kple ŋɔ wova gblẽ nuwo na mi. Ke maɖo wo teƒe na mi.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Azɔ miaɖu nu, aɖi ƒo, eye miaƒe dzi adze eme. Ale miakafu Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu, ame si wɔ nukunuwo na mi. Amewo magaɖe alɔ me le nye dukɔ ŋu akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israel, àdze sii azɔ be mele mia dome. Nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la; bubu aɖeke megali o. Amewo magaɖe alɔ me le nye dukɔ ŋu akpɔ gbeɖe o. Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: “Emegbe matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ la akɔ ɖe ame sia ame dzi: Mia viŋutsuviwo kple mia vinyɔnuviwo aɖe gbeƒã nye nya, miaƒe amegãɖeɖiwo aku drɔ̃ewo, eye miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo akpɔ ŋutegawo.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: “Ɣe ma ɣi la, matrɔ nye gbɔgbɔ la akɔ ɖe nye nyɔnudɔlawo kple ŋutsudɔlawo gɔ̃ hã dzi.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Mana nukunuwo nado ɖe dziŋgɔli ŋu kple anyigba dzi. Ʋu, dzo kple dzudzɔ babla kɔtɔɔ wòanye.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Ɣe ado viviti; ɣleti abiã abe ʋu ene, hafi Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke gã dziŋɔ la naɖo.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ava eme be woaxɔ ame sia ame si yɔ Aƒetɔ la, ɖe agbe. Ame aɖewo así le afɔku la nu le Zion-to dzi kple Yerusalem. Sisíla siawo anye ame siwo woyɔ be woatsi agbe, abe ale si Aƒetɔ do ŋugbe ene.”

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, makplɔ aboyomewo agbɔ va Yuda kple Yerusalem.

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: Maƒo dukɔwo katã nu ƒu akplɔ ayi Yehosafat-bali me. Madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo le afi ma le nu siwo wowɔ ɖe nye dukɔ kple nye domenyinu Israel ŋu la ta. Wona nye amewo kaka ɖe dukɔwo dome, eye woma nye anyigba.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Wodzidze nu ɖe nye amewo dzi. Wode gbolo gbɔ tsɔ ŋutsuvi xe fe nɛ. Wodzra nyɔnuvi tsɔ dze wain no.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: “Nu kae miedi be yewoawɔ ɖe ŋunye, Tiro, Sidon kple Filistitɔwo ƒe nutomewo? Wɔɖenue miedi be yewoawɔ nam loo? Ne eyae la, ekema nye asi atre tsɔtsɔ na mia tɔ. Maɖo nu si miewɔ ɖe ŋunye la teƒe na mi kaba alɔtsɔtsɔe.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Miawoe lɔ nye klosalo kple sika dzoe, eye mietsɔ nye kesinɔnu veviwo yi ɖada ɖe miaƒe gbedoxɔwo me.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Mietsɔ Yudaviwo kple Yerusalemviwo dzra na Helatɔwo be woakplɔ wo adzoe tso wo de ayi adzɔge ke.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, makplɔ wo tso teƒe siwo woƒle wo yii la agbɔe, eye maɖo nu si miewɔ la teƒe na mi.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Madzra mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo na Yudatɔwo. Woawo aɖadzra wo na Sabatɔwo, le tɔmanyaƒe nɔmanyaƒe. Nye Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.”

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Miɖe gbeƒã nya sia na dukɔwo be: Mikɔ mia ɖokui ŋu. Mibla akpa ɖe aʋawɔwɔ ŋu. Miʋuʋu kalẽtɔwo ne woatso. Aʋawɔlawo katã nedo, Wonete va!

english_verse: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
translation_verse: Mitsɔ miaƒe kodzoewo tu yiwoe. Mitsɔ miaƒe hɛ gobɛwo tu akplɔwoe. Ame beli negblɔ be: “Nyee nye aʋakalẽa.”

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Netsɔ! Miva! Mi dukɔ siwo katã ƒo xlã mí la. Miyi ɖaƒo ƒu ɖe afi ma. O Aƒetɔ, kplɔ wò kalẽtɔwo vɛ!

english_verse: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo neho ne woava Yehosafat-bali me. Afi mae mabɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖo glì, adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo katã godoo akpe ɖo.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Minyè hɛ gobɛwo elabe nuŋeɣi ɖo. Miva, mifanya nu abe ale si wofanyaa kutsetse ɖiɖiwo le wainfiãƒe, va se ɖe esime wainfiãnu la yɔna, gbagbana ene. Woƒe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ gbɔ eme.

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Ame akpewo, akpeakpewo ɖi anyi ɖe nyametsobali la me. Elabe Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la tu aƒe le nyametsobali la me.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Ɣe kple ɣleti do viviti; ɣletiviwo gbe keklẽ. Mawu ayra eƒe amewo

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le gbe ɖem tso Zion, eƒe gbe le dzi dem bobobo tso Yerusalem; dziƒowo kple anyigba ʋuʋu. Ke Aƒetɔ nye sitsoƒe na eƒe dukɔ kple mɔ́ sesẽ na Israel.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Azɔ la, miadze sii be nyee nye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la. Mele Zion, nye to kɔkɔe la dzi. Yerusalem anye du kɔkɔe, futɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ aɖeke magava to eme ayi gbeɖe o.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: “Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, towo atsyɔ wain yeye; togbɛwo aɖuɖu notsi, eye tsi ayɔ Yuda-tɔʋuwo katã agbagba. Tsi aŋɔ bababa tso Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me aɖade tsi nuwo le Xeti-bali la me.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: Egipte azu aƒedo eye Edom azu gbegbe ɖiƒuƒlu le ale si wosẽ ŋuta le Yudaviwo ŋu, eye wokɔ woƒe ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi le woawo ŋutɔ ƒe anyigba dzi la ta.

english_verse: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.
translation_verse: Ke ame anɔ Yuda kple Yerusalem tegbee.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
translation_verse: Mabia hlɔ̃ ɖe ame siwo wowu la nu. Nyemaɖe asi le agɔdzela ŋu o. Nye Aƒetɔ manɔ Zion.”

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Amos, ame si nɔ alẽkplɔlawo dome, tso Tekoa ƒe nyawoe nye esiawo. Wonye nya siwo wòkpɔ ku ɖe Israel-dukɔ ŋuti ƒe eve hafi anyigba nava ʋuʋu. Ɣe ma ɣi la, Uziya nye Yuda-fia, eye Yerobeam, Yoas vi, nye Israel-fia.

english_verse: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
translation_verse: Amos be: “Aƒetɔ le gbe ɖem abe dzata ene le Zion-to dzi, eƒe gbe de dzi le Yerusalem. Lãkplɔviwo ƒe gbeɖuƒewo fa konyi, eye Karmel tame yrɔ.” Mawu ahe to na dukɔ siwo ƒo xlã Israel-dukɔ Siria

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Damaskotɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo, elabe wowɔ funyafunya Gileadtɔwo vevie.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mana dzo afiã fia Xazael ƒe aƒe, eye Ben-Hadad ƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo abi dzo keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Maŋe gameti siwo le Damasko-du ƒe agbowo ŋu la klíklikli, atsrɔ̃ Aven, nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔbalia me nɔlawo kple fiatikplɔtsɔlawo le Bet-Eden. Woaɖe aboyo Siriatɔwo ayi Kir-nyigba dzi.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Filistia

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Gazatɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo. Woɖe aboyo dukɔ blibo, eye wokplɔ wo abe kluviwo ene ɖade asi na Edomtɔwo.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mana dzo afiã dua ƒe gliwo, eye wòabi eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Matsrɔ̃ Asdodnɔlawo, eye maɖe Askalon-fia la ɖa. Mahe to na Ekron-du, eye Filistitɔ siwo susɔ la atsrɔ̃.” Aƒetɔ Mawulae gblɔe. Tiro

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Tirotɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo. Elabe wogbe ŋkuɖoɖo nɔvinu, si wobla la dzi wɔwɔ, eye woɖe aboyo dukɔ blibo, kplɔ wo abe kluviwo ene heyi ɖade asi na Edomtɔwo.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mana dzo afiã Tiro-du ƒe gliwo, eye wòabi eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo keŋkeŋ.” Edom

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Edomtɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo. Woti wo nɔviwo yome vevie be yewoatsrɔ̃ wo kple yi, eye womekpɔ nublanui na wo kura o. Wodo dɔmedzoe ɖe wo ŋu helihelĩ, eye woƒe dzi de fafa ge do kpoe.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mana dzo afiã Teman, eye wòabi Bozra ƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo keŋkeŋ.” Amon

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Amontɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo. Esime wonɔ woƒe dziɖuƒe kekem ɖe enu la, wodze ƒo le Gilead funɔwo nu.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mana dzo afiã Raba-du ƒe gliwo, eye wòabi eƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo keŋkeŋ. Aʋaɣli aɖi, ahom atu ŋɔdzitɔe,

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: eye woakplɔ woƒe fia la kple eŋumewo siaa ayi aboyo mee.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Moabtɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo. Wotɔ dzo Edom-fia ƒe ƒuwo wofiã zu akalo.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mana dzo afiã nu le Moab-nyigba dzi, eye wòabi Keriot ƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo keŋkeŋ. Zi atɔ, kalẽtɔwo anɔ ɣli dom, kpẽ anɔ ɖiɖim sesĩe, eye Moabtɔwo aku le ʋunyaʋunya la me.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Mawù Moab-fia kple eŋumewo katã le anyigba la dzi.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Yuda

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Yudatɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo. Wogbe Aƒetɔ ƒe sewo dzi wɔwɔ, eye womelé eƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi o. Ke wona alakpalegba siwo wo tɔgbuiwo subɔ la kplɔ wo trae boŋ.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mana dzo afiã nu le Yuda-nyigba dzi, eye wòabi mɔ́ sesẽwo keŋkeŋ le Yerusalem-dua me.” Mawu ahe to na Israel

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Israeltɔwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wo, eye wogale wo wɔwɔ dzi. Eya ta mahe to na wo godoo. Wodzra nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ɖe klosalo nu. Nenema ke wodzra ame dahe ɖe atokota dodo ɖeka ƒe asi nu.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Wotea ame dahe ɖe to, eye womexɔa hiãtɔ ƒe nya dzɔdzɔe le ʋɔnu o. Vi kple tɔ́a ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã dɔna kple ɖetugbi ɖeka ma ke heƒoa ɖi nye ŋkɔ.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Le woƒe mawusubɔƒewo la, womlɔa avɔ si le awɔba me le wo gbɔ la dzi, eye wonoa agɔdzeha si woxɔna le ame si la le mawuƒewo me.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: “Evɔ wònye mia tae metsrɔ̃ Amoritɔwo ɖo. Togbɔ be wodzɔ atsu kɔ abe sederti ene, eye wosesẽ abe sesewu ene hã la, metsrɔ̃ wo keŋkeŋ abe ale si wohoa ati kple ke ene.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Gawu la, mekplɔ mi dzoe le Egipte-nyigba dzi, eye mena miezɔ gbedadaƒo ƒe bla ene sɔŋ va xɔ Amoritɔwo ƒe anyigba wòzu mia tɔ.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Metia mia viŋutsu aɖewo be woanye gbeƒãɖelawo, eye megatia miaƒe ɖekakpui aɖewo hã be woanye Mawu ƒe kluwo. Israelviwo, esia mele eme oa?” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: “Ke miezi nye kluwo dzi be woano aha, eye miede se na nye gbeƒãɖelawo hã be womegaɖe gbeƒã nye gbedeasi o.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mate mi ɖe anyi abe ale si wotea bligba ɖe keke dzi ene.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Afɔtsɔtsɔetɔ aŋlɔ sisí be, ŋusẽtɔ mate ŋu awɔ eƒe ŋusẽ ŋudɔ o, eye kalẽtɔ maɖe eƒe agbe o.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Nenema ke aŋutrɔdala manɔ te o, du sesẽ ƒula masí o, eye sɔdola maɖe eƒe agbe o.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, ame si nye dzideƒotɔ le kalẽawo dome gɔ̃ hã así adzo amamae.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Israelviwo, mi dukɔ blibo si wokplɔ do go tso Egipte-nyigba dzi, miɖo to miase nya si Aƒetɔ gblɔ ɖe mia ŋu.

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: Ebe: “Miawo koe nye dukɔ si metia le dukɔ siwo katã le anyigba dzi la dome, eya ta mahe to na mi ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ta.” Gbeƒãɖela ƒe dɔdeasi

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: “Ðe ame eve ate ŋu adze mɔ ne womeɖo gbe ɖi oa?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Ðe dzata tsitsi ɖea gbe le ave me, ne menye nu wòkpɔ be yealé oa? Ðe dzata xlɔ̃na le enɔƒe, ne menye ɖe wòkpɔ nu lé oa?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Ðe xevi gena ɖe mɔ̀ me, ne wometre mɔ̀ ɖi nɛ oa? Mɔ̀ kae dana, ne menye nanee ge ɖe eme o?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Ame kae mevɔ̃na, ne aʋayikpẽ ɖi le du me o? Dzɔgbevɔ̃e kae dzɔna le du me, ne menye Aƒetɔ gbɔ wòtso o?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Aƒetɔ Mawu mewɔa naneke o, dzaa ɖe wòɖe eƒe ɖoɖowo fia eƒe dɔla, gbeƒãɖelawo.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Dzata ɖe gbe, ame kae mavɔ̃ o? Aƒetɔ Mawu la ƒo nu, ame kae agbe gbeƒãɖeɖe?” Samaria le tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Miɖe gbeƒã na ame siwo le fiasãwo me le Asdod kple Egipte be: “Miƒo ƒu ɖe Samaria-towo dzi ne miakpɔ ale si wole ʋunyaʋunya wɔm, eye wote amewo ɖe anyi le afi mae la ɖa.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Ame siawo li kɔ nu siwo wokpɔ to nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ kple ŋutasesẽ me ɖe woƒe mɔ́ sesẽwo me gleglegle. Womeganya nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ o.”

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, Aƒetɔ be: “Futɔwo aɖe to ɖe woƒe anyigba godoo, akaka woƒe mɔwo, eye woaha woƒe fiasãmenuwo adzoe.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Abe ale si alẽkplɔla ɖea lã ƒe afɔti eve alo to kakɛ ko le dzata ƒe nu me ene la, nenema kee woaɖe Israelvi siwo le Samaria la hãe kple zikpui kakɛ kpakple abati ƒe dzogoe.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: “Misee, ne miatsɔe axlɔ̃ nu Yakob ƒe dzidzimeviwo.” Aƒetɔ Mawu, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Gbe si gbe mahe to na Israelviwo ɖe woƒe nuvɔ̃ ta la, magbã Betel-vɔsamlekpuiwo. Woaŋe vɔsamlekpuiawo ƒe dzowo aƒu anyi.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Magbã vuvɔŋɔlixɔwo akpe ɖe dzomeŋɔli tɔwo ŋuti. Xɔ siwo woɖo atsyɔ̃ na kple nyiɖu agbã gudugudu, eye xɔ gã gãwo avɔ ɖa.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: “Samaria-nyɔnuwo, mi ame siwo da ami abe Basan-nyinɔwo ene. Mi ame siwo te ame dahewo ɖe anyi, gbã hiãtɔwo gudugudu, eye miegblɔna na mia srɔ̃wo be: ‘Ku aha vɛ míno!’ miɖo to miase nya sia.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu Kɔkɔetɔ la tà eɖokui le gbɔgblɔm be: “Kpɔ ɖa, ɣeyiɣi li gbɔna, esime woaɖe mi kple ƒè ahe adzoe. Woahe ame mamlɛtɔ ke hã kple ƒè adzoe.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Miato dua ƒe gli gbagbãwo me, ame sia ame akpɔ ŋgɔ tẽe, eye woatsɔ mi aƒu gbe ɖe Harmon.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Israel gbe nusɔsrɔ̃

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: “Israelviwo, miva Betel ne miawɔ nuvɔ̃. Miva Gilgal ne miawɔe ɖe edzi. Misa vɔ ŋdi, eye mitsɔ miaƒe nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia va na ŋkeke etɔ̃ sia ŋkeke etɔ̃.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Miyi ɖatsɔ abolo si me amɔwɔ ʋaʋã le la sa akpedadavɔ na Mawu, eye miaɖe gbeƒã, aƒo adegbe be yewona nu faa tso dzime. Elabe esia wɔwɔe dzɔa dzi na mi.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: “Nyee na dɔ to le miaƒe duwo katã me, ke miegbe be yewomatrɔ ava gbɔnye o.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: “Esime wòsusɔ ɣleti etɔ̃ ne miaŋe nu, eye miehiã tsidzadza vevie la, nye kee te tsi mi. Mena tsi dza le du ɖeka me, ke medza le bubu me o. Mena tsi dza le agble ɖeka me, ke agble evelia ya me ƒu kplákplakpla.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Amewo mua ya sagasaga tsoa du eve alo etɔ̃ me yia du ɖeka me be yewoano tsi, gake womeɖia kɔ o; ke miegbe mietrɔ va gbɔnye o.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Mena ŋdɔ sesẽ ɖu miaƒe nukuwo, eye dɔ dze wo dzi wotsi to nu. Ʋetsuviwo ɖu miaƒe abɔwo, waingblewo, kutsetsetiwo kple amitiwo, ke miegbe mietrɔ va gbɔnye o.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Mehe dɔ vɔ̃ va mia dzi abe ale si mehee va Egiptetɔwo dzii ene. Mena miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo tsi yi nu le aʋa me, eye futɔwo xɔ miaƒe sɔwo le mia si dzoe. Mena ame siwo ku le miaƒe asaɖa me la ƒe ʋeʋẽ ɖo ŋɔti me na mi; ke miegbe mietrɔ va gbɔnye o.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Metsɔ mi xlã ɖe anyi abe ale si Mawu xlã Sodom kple Gomora ɖe anyii ene, eye mienɔ abe ga yibɔ si woɖe le dzo me ene. Ke mietrɔ va gbɔnye o.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: “Israelviwo, midzra ɖo ne miado gom. Azɔ mele to he ge na mi.”

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, eya ame si wɔ towo kple yaƒoƒo, eye wòna amegbetɔ nya eƒe susu; eya ame si trɔa agudzedze wòzua zã, eye wòzɔa anyigba ƒe kɔkɔƒewo ke la, eŋkɔe nye: Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla!

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Israelviwo, miɖo to ne miase konyifaha si dzi ge mala ɖe mia ŋu:

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: “Israel-dukɔ ɖetugbi la dze anyi! Magafɔ akpɔ o! Wogblẽe ɖi le eƒe anyigba dzi; ame meli afɔe o.”

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu be: “Ne du aɖe ho kple ame akpe ɖeka yi aʋa la, alafa ɖeka koe agbɔ, eye ne du bubu ho kple alafa la, ewo koe agbɔ le Israel.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ le gbɔgblɔm na Israelviwo be: “Miva gbɔnye ne mianɔ agbe!

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: Migayi Betel o, elabe ele gbagbã ge. Migayi Gilgal o, elabe emenɔlawo le aboyo me yi ge. Nenema ke migayi keke Beer-Seba hã o.”

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Miva Aƒetɔ gbɔ ne mianɔ agbe. Ne menye nenem o la, aɖi va abe dzo ene, eye wòafiã Yosef ƒe aƒe la. Dzo la afiã amewo le Betel, eye etsila manɔ anyi o.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: Baba na mi ame siwo trɔa nya dzɔdzɔe wòzua veve, eye wòvena wu atsà, eye mietea nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖe to.

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔ ɣletivi atifieŋu, avu kple avutɔ; ame si trɔa viviti tsiɖitsiɖi wòzua kekeli, eye wòtrɔa ŋkeke wòzua zã. Ame si yɔ atsiaƒumetsiwo ƒo ƒu hetrɔ wo kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi. Eŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eyae tsrɔ̃ ŋusẽtɔwo, eye wògbã woƒe mɔ́ gudugudu.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Miete ame dahewo ɖe anyi, eye miexɔ blidzɔ le wo si. Eya ta togbɔ be mietu kpexɔ nyuiwo hã, miele wo me nɔ ge akpɔ o. Togbɔ be miede waingble siwo ʋã ŋutɔ hã, miele wo me wain no ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: Elabe menya ale si gbegbe miaƒe dzidadawo sɔ gbɔe, eye miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo dzi ŋɔe. Miete nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ɖe anyi, miexɔ zãnu, eye miebu fɔ ame dahe madzemadzee le ʋɔnu.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, ne ɣeyiɣia ɖo la, nunyala nezi ɖoɖoe, elabe ɣeyiɣi vɔ̃e wònye gbɔna.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nyui, menye vɔ̃ o, ne mianɔ agbe, eye Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla la nanɔ kpli mi, abe ale si miegblɔnɛ ene.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Milé fu vɔ̃wɔwɔ, eye mialɔ̃ nyuiwɔwɔ. Midrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe. Ðewohĩ Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ave Yosef ƒe dzidzime si susɔ la nu.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla, Aƒetɔ la, gblɔ be: “Amewo anɔ konyi fam le ablɔwo katã me, eye bubuwo anɔ boboe dom hoo le kpɔdomeewo katã. Woayɔ agbledelawo gɔ̃ hã be woava fa konyi akpe ɖe kuteƒehadzilawo ŋu.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Ne meva to mia dome yi vɔ la, amewo anɔ konyi fam le waingblewo katã me.” Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo dzrom Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la le la, baba na mi. Viɖe ka le ŋkeke ma ŋu na mi? Elabe viviti wòanye, manye kekeli o.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke la anɔ abe ŋutsu aɖe si sí le dzata nu va do go sisiblisi ene! Alo ele abe ŋutsu aɖe si gbɔ va aƒeme tsɔ asi ɖo gli ŋu ko da ɖui ene.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la anye viviti, manye kekeli o; viviti tsiɖitsiɖi wòanye, eme makɔ kura o.

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: “Melé fu miaƒe ŋkekenyuiwo, eye miaƒe azãɖuɖuwo megadoa dzidzɔ nam o.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Mite ɖa le gbɔnye kple miaƒe hadzidziwo. Ɣli ko wonye le to me nam. Nyemedi be mase miaƒe kasaŋkuƒoƒo aɖeke o.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Le esia teƒe mina nya dzɔdzɔe nasí abe tsi ene, eye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ natsa abe tɔ makumaku ene.

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: “Israelviwo, ɖe miesa akpedadavɔ alo nuɖuɖuvɔ nam le gbedadaƒo le ƒe bla eneawo mea?

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Eya ta esi miesubɔ legba siwo nye miaƒe fia Sakut ƒe nɔnɔme kple miaƒe mawu Kevan ƒe ɣletivi ƒe nɔnɔme siwo miewɔ na mia ɖokui ta la, miatsɔ wo ɖe asi, hafi

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: makplɔ mi ayi aboyo me le Damasko godo.” Aƒetɔ, ame si ŋkɔe nye Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Baba na mi, mi ame siwo ɖe dzi ɖi le Zion kple mi ame siwo ƒe to me fa le Samaria-du me. Miawoe nye dukɔ deŋgɔ sia ƒe ame ŋkuta vevi siwo gbɔ dukɔmetɔwo vana.

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Miyi ɖakpɔ Kalne ɖa. Mito afi ma yi ɖakpɔ Xamat, du gã la kple Gat, Filistitɔwo ƒe du la ɖa. Ðe wonyo wu Yuda kple Israel-fiaɖuƒewoa? Ðe woƒe anyigba lolo wu mia tɔa?

english_verse: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
translation_verse: Miele bubum be ŋkeke vɔ̃ la maɖo fifia o. Nu si wɔm miele la le ŋkeke vɔ̃ la hem vɛ boŋ.

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: “Baba na mi, mi ame siwo mlɔa anyi ɖe nyiɖubatiwo dzi, drana ɖe akpasawo me ɖua alẽvilã tso alẽhawo dome, eye mieɖua nyivilã tso nyikpo me.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Hakpakpa vivia mia nu abe David ene, eye mieƒoa haawo le kasaŋku dzi.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Mienoa wain le tre gãwo me, eye miesia ami ʋeʋẽe nyuitɔwo, ke mele mia vem be Yosef ƒe aƒe la le gbagbã ge o.

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Eya ta miawoe anɔ ŋgɔ na aboyomeyilawo, eye miaƒe agbeɖuɖu vivivo la nu ayi keŋ.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu tà eɖokui. Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Dàda si le Yakob ƒeme la le ŋu nyɔm nam; metsri woƒe fiasãwo. Matsɔ woƒe du gã la kple emenu ɖe sia ɖe ana woƒe futɔ.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Nenye be ame ewo susɔ ɖe aƒe ɖeka me la, woaku.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ame kukua ƒe ƒometɔ si ŋkume amea ɖiɖi kpɔ la, ava be yeatsɔ ame kukua adzoe le aƒea me aɖatɔ dzoe. Ƒometɔ la ayɔ ame si susɔ ɖe aƒea me la abia be: “Ame aɖe susɔ kpe ɖe ŋuwòa?” Ame la aɖo eŋu be: “Ao!” Tete ƒometɔ la agblɔ be: “Zi ɖoɖoe. Mele be miayɔ Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ o.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ le gbe ɖe ge, eye xɔwo agbã gudugudu, gãtɔwo kple suetɔwo siaa.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Ðe sɔ ƒua du le aganua? Ðe wonaa nyitsu ŋlɔa nu le atsiaƒu dzia? Ke miawo ya mietrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe wòzu aɖi, eye mietrɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ metsonu wòzu veve.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Miele dzidzɔ kpɔm ɖe Lo-Debar ŋu, eye miele gbɔgblɔm dàdatɔe be: “Míawo ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽe míetsɔ ɖu Karnaim dzii.”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Elabe kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ, Mawu Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Israel-dukɔ, maɖo dukɔ aɖe me tɔwo ɖa woava xɔ miaƒe anyigba la. Woate mi ɖe anyi tso Xamat-mɔ nu le dzigbeme va se ɖe tɔʋu si le Araba ƒe anyigbeme.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ Mawu ɖe nu fiam le ŋutega me. Ewɔ ʋetsuviwo ƒe ha gã aɖe mekpɔ. Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, woya gbe na fia vɔ, eye gbe gade asi toto me nyuie.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Esi ʋetsuviawo ɖu gbe ɖe sia ɖe le anyigba dzi vɔ la, megblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ Mawu, tsɔe ke dzro, meɖe kuku. Yakob ƒe aƒe ɖe, ɖe wòate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwòa? Mele ɖeke me o!”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Ale Aƒetɔ ɖe asi le nu si wòɖo be yeawɔ la ŋu, eye wògblɔ be: “Nu si nèkpɔ la, madzɔ o!” Amos kpɔ dzo le ŋutega me

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Aƒetɔ Mawu la gaɖe nu bubu fiam le ŋutega me. Le eme la, mekpɔe wònɔ dzadzram ɖo be yeahe to na yeƒe amewo kple dzo. Dzo la bi tɔ gãwo, eye wòde asi anyigba hã bibi me.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Ale megblɔ be: “Mègawɔe o, Aƒetɔ Mawu, meɖe kuku. Yakob ƒe ƒome ɖe, ɖe wòate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwòa? Mele ɖeke me o!”

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ gaɖe asi le nu si wòɖo be yeawɔ la ŋu, eye wògblɔ be: “Nu si nègakpɔ la hã madzɔ o.” Aƒetɔ Mawu lae gblɔe. Amos kpɔ glidzidzeka le ŋutega me

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gaɖe nu bubu fiam le ŋutega me. Le eme la, mekpɔe wòle tsitre ɖe gli aɖe gbɔ, eye glidzidzeka le esi.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Ebiam be: “Amos, nu kae nye esi le asinye?” Meɖo eŋu be: “Glidzidzekae.” Aƒetɔ gblɔ nam be: “Kpɔ ɖa, medi be matsɔe afia nye amewo be wole abe gli gɔglɔ̃ ene. Nu si meɖo be mawɔ la, nyemagatsɔe ake o.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Teƒe siwo Isak ƒe dzidzimeviwo subɔam le la azu gbegbe. Israel ƒe kɔkɔeƒewo azu aƒedo, eye matsrɔ̃ fia Yerobeam ƒe dzidzimeviwo kple yi le aʋa me.” Amos kple Amazya

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
