translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe gado be gbeƒãɖela yenye la, tɔ́a kple nɔa, siwo dzii la, agblɔ nɛ be, ‘Mànɔ agbe o elabe èle alakpanya gblɔm le Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ me.’ Ne eɖe gbeƒã la, edzilawo ŋutɔ aƒo nu ɖee wòaku.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, gbeƒãɖela ɖe sia ɖe si aɖe gbeƒã le eƒe ŋutega ŋu la, ŋu akpee. Ðeke magado lãfuwu atsɔ flu amee azɔ o,

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: ke boŋ agblɔ be, ‘Nyemenye gbeƒãɖela o; agbledelae menye. Agble koe medena tso ɖevime ke.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Azɔ ne ame aɖe biae be, ‘Nu ka ƒe abie le medome na wò?’ la, aɖo eŋu be, ‘Xɔ̃nyewo ƒe aƒemee mexɔ abia le.’ ” Woɖe gbe be woawu lãkplɔla la

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: “Yí, nyɔ ne nàtso ɖe nye lãkplɔla ŋu, ɖe ŋutsu si tsi tre ɖe gbɔnye la ŋu,” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. “Dza lãkplɔvi la, ne alẽawo naka ahlẽ; matrɔ asi le suetɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: Woatsrɔ̃ etɔ̃liawo ƒe eve le anyigba blibo la dzi, eye woagblẽ etɔ̃liawo ƒe ɖeka ɖi wòatsi agbe.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Matsɔ etɔ̃liawo ƒe ɖeka sia ade dzo me, alólo wo abe ale si wolóloa klosaloe ene; mado wo akpɔ abe ale si wodoa sika kpɔ ene. Woayɔ nye ŋkɔ, eye matɔ na wo. Magblɔ be: ‘Woawoe nye nye dukɔ.’ eye woawo agblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ ye nye nye Mawu.’ ‘Aƒetɔ ye nye nye Mawu.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke li gbɔna esime woama wò nu si woha le mewò la.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Elabe mana dukɔwo katã asɔ nu aho aʋa ɖe ŋuwò. Woaxɔ dua, aha nu siwo le aƒewo me eye woagblẽ nyɔnuwo. Woakplɔ dua me tɔwo ƒe afã ayi aboyo me, ke ame mamlɛawo ya anɔ anyi.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Ekema Aƒetɔ atso aɖawɔ aʋa kple dukɔ siawo, abe ale si wòwɔa aʋa le aʋakpegbe ene.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, atsi tsitre ɖe Amito si le Yerusalem ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome la dzi. Tete bali gã aɖe ama Amito la me ɖe eve tso ɣedzeƒe va yi ɣetoɖoƒe, ale be to la ƒe afã ate yi dzigbeme eye evelia ate yi anyigbeme.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Woana toa ƒe bali la natɔ elabe toawo ƒe bali la aka wo ŋu. Miasí abe ale si mia tɔgbuiwo sí, esime anyigba ʋuʋu le Yuda-fia Uziya ŋɔli ene. Ekema Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu la ava eye wòakplɔ ame kɔkɔeawo katã akpe ɖe eŋuti.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, vuvɔ, tsi babla,

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, tsi gbagbe así tso Yerusalem; eƒe afã aɖo ta ɣedzeƒeƒu la me eye afã así aɖo ta ɣetoɖoƒeƒu la me. Tsi la anɔ sisí dzi ƒè blibo la, le dzomeŋɔli kple vuvɔŋɔli siaa.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ aɖu fia ɖe xexeme bliboa dzi. Gbe ma gbe Aƒetɔ anye Mawu ɖeka eye wòatɔ ŋkɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ ahe dɔléle dziŋɔ ava dukɔ siwo katã wɔ aʋa kple Yerusalem la me tɔwo dzi. Ŋutilã aƒaƒã ɖe amewo ŋuti le esime wogale agbe; ŋku aƒaƒã ɖe to me na wo, eye aɖe aƒaƒã ɖe nu me na wo.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe la, Aƒetɔ ana woatɔtɔ anɔ vɔvɔ̃m ale gbegbe be ame sia ame adze ehavi dzi eye woawɔ nu vevi wo nɔewo.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Azɔ ame siwo katã tsi agbe le dukɔ siwo ho aʋa ɖe Yerusalem ŋu me la ayi Yerusalem ƒe sia ƒe aɖasubɔ Fia la, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la, eye woaɖu Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui la.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ne dukɔ aɖe me tɔwo gbe be yewomayi aɖasubɔ Aƒetɔ, Fia la o la, tsi madza na wo o.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Alea woahe to na Egiptetɔwo kple dukɔ bubu siwo katã mava Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui la ɖuƒe o lae.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Nenema ke nuɖaze siwo katã le Yerusalem kple Yuda la ŋu akɔ na Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la, ale be vɔsalawo katã ava fɔ wo ayi aɖaɖa nu le wo me. Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, asitsala aɖeke maganɔ Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ƒeme o.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe nya si wògblɔ na Maleaxi be wòagblɔ na Israel-dukɔ lae nye esi: Aƒetɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃ na Israel-dukɔ la

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ gblɔ be: “Melɔ̃ mi.” Ke miawo miebia be: “Ale ke nèlɔ̃ mí?” Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu be: “Esau ɖe, menye Yakob nɔvie wònye oa?” “Ke melɔ̃ Yakob,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: eye melé fu Esau ya. Mena tonyigba si nye eƒe domenyinu la zu kegbegbe, eye wòtsi anyi va zu akpatakuwo nɔƒe.”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Ne Edomtɔwo, ame siwo nye Esau ƒe dzidzimeviwo gblɔ be: “Togbɔ be wogbã míaƒe duwo hã, míagbugbɔ wo atso” la, Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la be: “Woate ŋu atui, ke magbãe aƒu anyi va se ɖe esime woanɔ wo yɔm be anyigba vɔ̃ɖi. Dukɔ si ŋu Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖo tegbee.”

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔ miaƒe ŋkuwo akpɔ nu sia, eye miagblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ tri akɔ gbɔ Israel ƒe liƒowo ŋu gɔ̃ hã!” Aƒetɔ ka mo na nunɔlawo

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la le gbɔgblɔm na nunɔlawo be: “Vi dea bubu tɔ́a ŋu, eye dɔla hã tsɔa bubu na eƒe aƒetɔ. Nenye nyee nye mia Tɔ́ nyateƒe la, afi ka nye bubu le? Nenye nyee nye miaƒe Aƒetɔ la, afi ka vɔvɔ̃ si le ŋunye la le? Miedoa vlom, eye miele biabiam be: ‘Nu ka míetsɔ do vlo wòe?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Miedoa vlom elabe mietsɔa nuɖuɖu makɔmakɔ va nanam le nye vɔsamlekpui dzi. Ke miele biayem be: ‘Nu ka míetsɔ ƒo ɖie?’ Miebuna be woate ŋu aɖi gbɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe kplɔ̃ la faa.

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Ne mietsɔ lã ŋkuagbã va sa vɔe nam la, ɖe menye nuvɔ̃ɖie miewɔ oa? Alo ne mietsɔ lã nuwɔe alo lã lédɔwo va nam la, ɖe menye nuvɔ̃ɖie miewɔ oa? Tsɔ lã ma ƒomevi yi ɖana wò anyigbadziɖula kpɔ! Ðe wò nu anyo eŋu, eye wòave nuwòa?” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, miɖe kuku na Mawu vevie be wòave mía nu. Ðe miebu be ne nunana sia ƒomevi tso mia si me la, ave mia dometɔ aɖe nua? Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe mia dometɔ ɖeka ayi aɖatu gbedoxɔa ƒe ʋɔwo be wòaxe mɔ na mi ne miadzudzɔ dzudzɔ ƒuƒlu dodo ɖe nye vɔsamlekpui dzi la, ne anyo wu. Fifia la, nu dzodzro ko wònye wɔm miele. Miaƒe nu medze ŋunye o. Ne mietsɔ vɔsanu aɖe va nam la, nyemaxɔe o. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Elabe tso ɣe ƒe dzedze va se ɖe eƒe toɖoɖo la, nye ŋkɔ lolo le dukɔwo dome, eye wotɔa dzo lifi nam le afi si afi hesaa vɔ nam wòdzea ŋunye. Elabe nye ŋkɔ de dzi le dukɔwo dome. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ke miawo ya mieƒo ɖim gblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ ƒe vɔsamlekpui ŋu mekɔ o; nuɖuɖu si le edzi la le ŋu nyɔm.’

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Miegagblɔ hã be: ‘Nu sia ti mí!’, eye mieɖo hehe ɖe tanye. Azɔ mietsɔ miaƒe adzonuwo alo lã nuwɔewo alo lã lédɔwo va sa vɔe nam. Ðe maxɔ nu siawo tso mia sia?

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Aɖi ameflula la ŋu kpékpekpe! Lãtsu si le eƒe lãha mee wòtsɔ ɖe adzɔgbe be yeanam, ke elé lã nuwɔe va wu nam ɖe eteƒe! Nye la, Fiagã menye, eye dukɔwo katã vɔ̃am.” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: “Azɔ nunɔlawo, mia tɔe nye se sia.

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la gblɔ be: Ne mieɖo to o, eye ne made dzi gbɔ na mi be miade bubu nye ŋkɔ ŋu o la, ekema mana fiƒode nava mia dzi, eye maƒo fi ade miaƒe yayrawo. Le nyateƒe me la, mena wozu fiƒode gɔ̃ hã xoxo, elabe miexɔ nye nya kple dzi o.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, maka mo na mia viwo, eye mahlẽ miaƒe vɔsalãwo ƒe mí ɖe mo na mi. Maɖe mi ɖa le ŋkunye me.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ale miadze sii be nyee ɖo se sia ɖe mi, ale be nu, si mebla kple Levi-to la, nagatu o. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: Le nu, si mebla kplii me la, medo agbe kple ŋutifafa ŋugbe nɛ, eye metsɔ nu siawo nɛ be wòavɔ̃m. Etsɔ bubu nam, eye wòvɔ̃ nye ŋkɔ.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe nɔ eƒe nu me wòfia, eye womekpɔ vɔ̃ le eƒe nuyiwo dzi o. Ezɔ kplim le ŋutifafa kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me. Ena ame bubu geɖewo hã dzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Elabe ele be nunɔla ƒe nuyiwo nadzɔ nunya ŋu, eye edze be amewo nadi nufiame tso eƒe nu me. Elabe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ƒe amedɔdɔe wònye.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ke mieɖe asi le mɔ la ŋu. Mietsɔ miaƒe nufiafia na ame geɖewo kli nu, eye mietu nu, si mebla kple Levi. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Eya ta nye hã meɖi gbɔ mi, eye mena wodo vlo mi le Israel-dukɔ blibo la ŋkume, elabe mielé nye ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi o, eye miekpɔa ame ŋkume le miaƒe nufiame me.” Dukɔ la mewɔ nuteƒe na Mawu o

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Ðe menye tɔ́ ɖekae le mí katã si oa? Ðe menye Mawu ɖekae wɔ mí katã oa? Nu ka ta míeɖia anukware na mía nɔewo o? Míegblẽ kɔ ɖo na mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe nubabla la.

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Yuda mewɔ nuteƒe o, eye wòwɔ ŋunyɔnu le Israel kple Yerusalem. Elabe Yuda gblẽ kɔ ɖo na Aƒetɔ ƒe kɔkɔeƒe si wòlɔ̃na la, eye wòɖaɖe dutamawu vinyɔnu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ neɖe nu sia wɔla ɖa le Yakob ƒe agbadɔwo me, ame sia ame si kpɔ eteƒe alo ɖo eŋu alo tsɔ vɔsanu vɛ na Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la!

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Miegawɔ nu bubu. Miefa avi, fa aɖatsi kɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye miefa konyi yi afi mae elabe miaƒe nunanawo megadzea eŋu kaka wòaxɔ wo o.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Miebia be: “Nu ka ta megaxɔa wo o?” Nyateƒe, megaxɔa wo o, elabe ètu nu, si nèbla kple wò ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃, si nèzɔna kplii, eye mèwɔ nuteƒe nɛ o, togbɔ be Aƒetɔ nye ɖasefo na mi ame evea hã.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Menye ŋutilã ɖeka kple gbɔgbɔ ɖekae Mawu wɔ na mí oa? Nu ka dim wòle? Mawu me viwo. Eya ta mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi ale be mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nawɔ nuteƒe na eƒe ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la gblɔ be: “Melé fu srɔ̃gbegbe. Melé fu ame si tsɔ ŋutasesẽ tsyɔ eƒe avɔ dzi. Eya ta mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi ale be miaganye nutemawɔlawo o.” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la tu aƒe

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Miaƒe nyagbɔgblɔ ti Aƒetɔ. Ke miebia be: “Nya ka gblɔm míele wòtii?” Menye ɖe miele gbɔgblɔm be: “Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo katã ƒe nu nyoa Aƒetɔ ŋu, elɔ̃ woƒe nya” oa? Alo menye ɖe miele biabiam be: “Afi ka Mawu, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la dzɔdzɔetɔ la le?” oa?

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, mele nye dɔla dɔm ɖa ne wòadzra mɔ dzi ɖo le ŋgɔnye, eye Aƒetɔ si miele mɔ kpɔm na la ava eƒe gbedoxɔ me kpoyi. Kpɔ ɖa, dɔla si ŋu nèdzɔa dzi le be wòava ɖe gbeƒã nye nubablaa la, gbɔna. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Ke ame kae ate ŋu ado dzi anɔ anyi le eƒe vavagbe? Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ne edo? “Elabe ele abe galólola ƒe dzo kple nunyala ƒe adzalẽ ene.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: Abɔbɔ nɔ anyi abe galólola kple sikaŋukɔla ene, eye wòakɔ Levi viwo ŋu, aklɔ wo ŋu abe sika kple klosalo ene va se ɖe esime woava sa vɔ siwo dze la na Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Tete vɔsa si Yuda kple Yerusalem ava sa na Aƒetɔ la adze eŋu abe ale si wònɔ le blema ŋkekewo kple ƒe siwo va yi me la ene.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: “Ekema mate ɖe mia ŋu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu. Manye ɖasefo zazɛ̃ ɖe mia ŋu atsi tre sesĩe ɖe dzotɔwo, ahasiwɔlawo, atam dzodzro kalawo kple dɔtɔ siwo mexea fetu dedee na woƒe dɔwɔlawo o la, ŋuti. Maganye ɖasefo ɖe ame siwo tea ahosiwo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo ɖe anyi, gbea amedzroxɔxɔ, eye womevɔ̃am o la hã ŋuti.” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. Nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia nana

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: “Elabe nye Aƒetɔ nyemetrɔ o, eya ta mi Yakob viwo mietsrɔ̃ o.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Tso mia tɔgbuiwo ŋɔli ke la, mietrɔ megbe de nye sewo, eye miewɔ wo dzi o. Mitrɔ ɖe ŋunye, ne nye hã matrɔ ɖe mia ŋu. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. Ke miebia be: ‘Ale ke míatrɔ ɖe ŋuwòe?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ðe amegbetɔ afi Mawua? Ke miawo ya miele fiyem. Ke miebia be: ‘Ale ke míele fiwòmee?’ Le miaƒe nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia kple nunanawo mee.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Woƒo fi de mi elabe miele fiyem; miaƒe dukɔ blibo lae.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia la katã va nudzraɖoƒe lae, ale be nuɖuɖu nanɔ nye aƒeme. Miwɔe, miatsɔe adom kpɔ be nyemaʋu dziƒo nu adudu yayra akɔ ɖe mia dzi wòagbɔ eme o mahã. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Mablu ɖe nugblẽlawo ta be womagagblẽ nukuwo le miaƒe anyigba dzi o. Wainka magbe tsetse na mi le agble me o. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ale dukɔwo katã abu mi yayramewoe elabe miaƒe dzi adze eme le anyigba la dzi.” Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe. Mawu do ŋugbe be yeakpɔ nublanui na dukɔ la

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ be: “Miegblɔ nya sesẽ geɖe ɖe ŋunye. Ke miebia be: ‘Nya ka míegblɔ ɖe ŋuwò?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Miegblɔ be: ‘Mawusubɔsubɔ nye nu dzodzro. Ne míewɔ eƒe nya dzi la, viɖe kae le eme na mí? Alo ne míezɔ abe konyi fam míele ene le Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla la ŋkume be nu si míewɔ ve mí la, viɖe kae le eme na mí?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Ke míekpɔ azɔ be woyra dàdalawo. Gawu la, nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo kpɔa dzidzedze le agbe me, eye ne wowɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi tsɔ te Mawu kpɔe gɔ̃ hã la, womehea to na wo o.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ la ɖo dze kple wo nɔewo, eye Aƒetɔ ɖo to, se woƒe nyawo. Woŋlɔ ame siwo vɔ̃a Aƒetɔ, eye wotsɔa bubu nɛ la ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe agbalẽ me le Aƒetɔ ŋkume bene woatsɔ anɔ ŋku ɖom wo dzii.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla be: “Woawoe anye nye amewo. Woanye ame tɔxɛwo nam gbe ma gbe, esime mawɔ nu si medi be mawɔ. Makpɔ nublanui na wo abe ale si vi tɔ́ kpɔa nublanui na via ŋutsuvi si subɔnɛ la ene.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ekema miagakpɔ vovototo le ame dzɔdzɔe kple ame vɔ̃ɖi dome, mawusubɔla kple ame si mesubɔa Mawu o la dome.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Elabe kpɔ ɖa, ŋkeke aɖe le bibim abe kpodzo ene gbɔna. Dàdalawo kple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo katã anɔ abe gbe ƒuƒu ene. Gbe ma gbe la, woafiã keŋ, ale be ke kple alɔ aɖeke masusɔ o. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.
translation_verse: Ke mi ame siwo vɔ̃a nye ŋkɔ la, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe ɣe adze na mi, eye wòayɔ dɔ mi abe ɣetotoe ene. Ekema miavo anɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm adzo abe nyiviwoe do tso lãkpɔ me le kpo tim ene.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Gbe si gbe mawɔ nu si medi be mawɔ la, miaɖu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi keŋkeŋ, eye woanɔ abe dzowɔ ene ɖe miaƒe afɔ te. Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla lae gblɔe.”

translation_verse: Gawu la, womesia akaɖi hetsɔa atigo tsyɔa edzi o. Akaɖiti dzi boŋ wodanɛ ɖo bene wòaklẽ na aƒea me tɔwo katã.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: “Migabu xaa be meva be maɖe Mose ƒe se la, alo Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe nufiafia ɖa o. Nyemeva be maɖe wo ɖa o, ke boŋ be mawɔ wo woade blibo.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: “Miese wogblɔ na blematɔwo be: ‘Mègawu ame o. Ame si wu ame la, edze be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui.’

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, mele egblɔm na mi be: ame sia ame si do dɔmedzoe ɖe nɔvia ŋuti la, edze be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui. Ame si yɔ nɔvia be: ‘Takukutɔ’ la, edze be woahee ayi ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo ŋkume, eye ame si ke ayɔ nɔvia be: ‘Lãtɔ’ la, edze na dzomavɔʋemeyiyi.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: gblẽ wò nunana la ɖe afi ma le vɔsamlekpuia ŋgɔ, ne nàyi aɖadzra wò kple nɔviwò la dome ɖo gbã, hafi nàva na wò nunana la.”

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe sama wò, eye wò kplii miezɔ afɔ ɖeka yina ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe la, dze agbagba nàdzra wò kplii dome ɖo le mɔa dzi lali. Ne menye nenem o la, ame si wò kplii miekpe nya la atsɔ wò ade asi na ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, eye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la atsɔ wò ade asi na kpovitɔ, eye eya ade wò gaxɔ me.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na wò be èle gaxɔ ma me nɔ ge, va se ɖe esime nàxe fe si wobla na wò la, wòavɔ keŋkeŋ.” Nufiafia le ahasiwɔwɔ ŋuti

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: “Wogblɔ hã be: ‘Ame si ke agbe srɔ̃a la, ele be wòana srɔ̃gbegbalẽe.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: “Miegase wogblɔ na blematɔwo be: ‘Mègatà nu alakpatɔe o, ke boŋ nàwɔ wò adzɔgbe si nèɖe na Aƒetɔ la dzi.’

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: “Miese wogblɔ be: ‘Ŋku ɖe ŋku teƒe, eye aɖu ɖe aɖu teƒe.’

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, mele egblɔm na mi be: migatsi tre ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ŋu o. Ne ame aɖe ƒo wò nuɖusito me la, trɔ ekemɛ hã nɛ wòaƒo.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe di be yeasama wò axɔ wò dziwui le asiwò la, na mɔe ne wòaxɔ wò avɔ hã faa.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne ŋusẽtɔ aɖe zi dziwò be nàtsɔ yeƒe agba, azɔ agbadroƒe ɖeka ƒe mɔ la, zɔ eve ƒe mɔ kplii.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Na nu ame si bia nu wò, eye ne ame aɖe di be yeaɣe nu le asiwò la, mègagbe o.” Nufiafia le ketɔwo lɔlɔ̃ ŋuti (Luk

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: “Miese wogblɔ be, ‘Lɔ̃ xɔ̃wòwo, eye nàlé fu wò ketɔwo.’

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, mele egblɔm na mi be: milɔ̃ miaƒe ketɔwo, eye mido gbe ɖa ɖe ame siwo le mia yome tim la ta,

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: bene miazu mia Tɔ́, si le dziƒo la viwo. Elabe eyae naa eƒe ɣe dzena na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple ame nyuiwo siaa, eye wònaa eƒe tsi dzana na ame dzɔdzɔewo kple ame madzɔmadzɔwo siaa.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Ne mielɔ̃ ame siwo lɔ̃ mi ɖeɖe ko la, fetu kae le eme na mi? Ɖe nudzɔlawo gɔ̃ hã mewɔna nenema ke oa?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Alo ne miedoa gbe na mia nɔviwo ɖeɖe ko la, wɔwu ka wònye miewɔ? Ɖe trɔ̃subɔlawo gɔ̃ hã mewɔna nenema ke oa?

english_verse: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Mide blibo boŋ abe ale si mia Tɔ́ si le dziƒo la le blibo ene.”

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie, ne miagawɔ nu nyui si miaƒe subɔsubɔ bia tso mia si la le amewo dome bene woakpɔ o. Ne miewɔ nu siawo le dutoƒo la, fetu aɖeke meli na mi le mia Tɔ́ si le dziƒowo la gbɔ o.

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ne èle nu nam ame dahe la, mègana wò miasi nanya nu si wò nuɖusi le wɔwɔm la o,

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: “Ne miele gbe dom ɖa la, migawɔ nu abe alakpatɔwo ene o. Woawo lɔ̃a gbedodoɖa le tsitrenu le ƒuƒoƒewo kple ablɔwo dzi bene amewo nakpɔ yewo. Mele egblɔm na mi be woƒe fetue nye ema woxɔ xoxo.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ne èle gbe do ge ɖa la, yi ɖe wò xɔgãme, nàtu ʋɔa, eye nàdo gbe ɖa na Tɔ́wò le ɣaɣlaƒe, eye eya ame si kpɔa nu le ɣaɣlaƒe la, aɖo eteƒe na wò.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: “Ne miele gbe dom ɖa la, migaƒo nu kpoloe, abe ale si trɔ̃subɔlawo wɔnɛ la ene o. Woawo buna xaa be ne yewogblɔ nya geɖe la, Mawu aɖo to yewo.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Miganɔ abe woamawo ene o. Mia Tɔ́ nya nu siwo le mia hiãm xoxo hafi miebianɛ.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Eya ta mido gbe ɖa ale: ‘Mía Tɔ́ si le dziƒowo wò ŋkɔ ŋuti nekɔ.

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: Wò fiaɖuɖu neva; Ne wowɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu le anyigba dzi, sigbe ale si wowɔnɛ le dziƒo ene.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Elabe ne mietsɔ amewo ƒe vodada ke wo la, ekema mia Tɔ́ si le dziƒo la hã atsɔ mia tɔ ake mi.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Ke ne mietsɔ ke amewo o la, ekema mia Tɔ́ hã matsɔ ake mi o.” Nufiafia le nutsitsidɔ ŋuti

english_verse: Instead, comb your hair and wash your face.
translation_verse: Ke ne ètsi nu dɔ la, de ami ɖa me eye nàfu mo nyuie,

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: ale be wò nutsitsidɔ la nagadze na amewo o, negbe na Tɔ́wò si le ɣaɣlaƒe la ko, eye Tɔ́wò, si kpɔa nu le ɣaɣlaƒe la, aɖo eteƒe na wò.” Dziƒoe nye kesinɔnuwo dzraɖoƒe (Luk

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Miaƒe nudidi vevitɔ nanye be Mawu naɖu fia ɖe yewo dzi ne yewoawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe, eye woatsɔ nu bubu siwo katã miehiã la akpee na mi.”

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: “Eya ta migatsi dzimaɖi le etsɔ si gbɔna la ƒe nuwo ŋuti o. Etsɔ si gbɔna la ƒe kuxiwo nenɔ aga. Egbe tɔwo sɔ gbɔ xoxo.”

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: “Migadzra kesinɔnuwo ɖo na mia ɖokui le anyigba dzi afii o, elabe le afii la, agbagblaʋui gblẽa nu, nuwo léa ɣebia, eye fiafitɔwo gbãa ʋɔ hefiaa nu.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ midzra kesinɔnuwo ɖo na mia ɖokui ɖe dziƒo. Afi ma la, agbagblaʋui megblẽa nu o; nuwo meléa ɣebia o, eye fiafitɔ hã megbãa ʋɔ fiaa nu o.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Elabe afi si wò nu xɔasi le la, afi mae wò dzi hã lanɔ.” Ame blibo la ƒe akaɖi (Luk

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: ke ne wò ŋku menyo o la, wò ameti blibo la me lado viviti.” Mawu kple nunɔamesiwo (Luk

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: “Ame aɖeke mate ŋu asubɔ aƒetɔ eve o, elabe alé fu ɖeka, eye wòalɔ̃ na evelia, alo aku ɖe ɖeka ŋu, eye wòagbe evelia. Miate ŋu asubɔ Mawu kple kesinɔnuwo o.”

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: “Eya ta migatsi dzimaɖi agblɔ be, ‘Nu ka míaɖu?’ alo ‘Nu ka míano?’ alo ‘Nu ka míata?’ mahã o.

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: “Esia tae mele gbɔgblɔm na mi be migatsi dzimaɖi le nu si miaɖu kple nu si miano anɔ agbe, alo nu si miado alo ata la ŋuti o. Alo ɖe agbe mexɔ asi wu nunyiame, eye ameti la mexɔ asi wu nudodo kple nutata oa?

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ dziƒoxewo ɖa, womeƒãa naneke o, womeŋea nu hã o, eye womeƒoa nu ƒu ɖe ava me o; ke mia Tɔ́ si le dziƒowo la nyia wo! Ɖe miele vevie nɛ sãa wu xewo oa?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: “Nenema ke nu ka ta mietsi dzi ɖe nudodo kple nutata ŋu? Mibu ale si dzogbenya si le gbe me la tsinae la ŋuti kpɔ. Metrea ɖeti loo, alo lɔ̃a avɔ o.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi be fia Salomo, le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe gã la me gɔ̃ hã la, meɖo atsyɔ̃ abe dzogbenya ene o.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Azɔ ne Mawu ɖo atsyɔ̃ na gbe si le agbe egbe, eye etsɔ ko woatsɔe aƒu gbe ɖe kpodzo me wòafiã la, ɖe maɖo atsyɔ̃ na miawo boŋ geɖe wu oa? Xɔseʋɛtɔwo!”

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Trɔ̃subɔlawoe dia nu siawo katã tɔgbe. Ke mia Tɔ́ si le dziƒo la nyae be nu siawo katã hiã mi.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: “Migadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame bubuwo ne Mawu hã nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi o.

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Elabe ale si mietso nya me le ame bubuwo ŋui la, nenema ke woatso nya me le mia ŋui, eye nudzidzenu si mietsɔ dzidze nui na amewo la, eya ke woatsɔ adzidzee na miawo hã.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Ale ke wɔ nèle ati fefee sue, si ɖo nɔviwò ƒe ŋkume la kpɔm, ke atikpo si le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi la ya, mele dzedzem na wò kura gɔ̃ hã o?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Ale ke wɔ nàte ŋu agblɔ na nɔviwò be: ‘Taflatsɛ, nà maɖe ati fefee la le ŋkume na wò.’ Evɔ atikpo blibo le wò ya wò ŋku dzi!

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Wò, alakpatɔ! Ɖe atikpo si le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi la ɖa gbã, ekema àte ŋu akpɔ nu nyuie, be nàɖe ati fefee sue la ɖa le nɔviwò ƒe ŋku dzi.”

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Ne mi, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo mienya ale si miana nunana nyuiwo mia viwo la, ɖe mia Tɔ́ si le dziƒowo la mana nu nyuiwo ame siwo bianɛ la wu sãa oa?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Mia dome ame kae li, ne via bia aboloe la, wòatsɔ kpe ade esi?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Mibia nu eye woana mi; midi nu, eye miakpɔe; miƒo ʋɔ, eye woaʋui na mi.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Elabe ame sia ame si biaa nu la, wonanɛ, eye ame sia ame si dia nu la, ekpɔnɛ, eye ame sia ame si ƒo ʋɔ la, woaʋui nɛ.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Alo ne ebia kalãmii la, wòatsɔ da ade esi?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: “Eya ta nu sia nu si miedina be amewo nawɔ na yewo la, miawo hã miwɔ nu ma ke na wo. Esia ko gblɔm Mose ƒe se la kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe nufiafia la le.” Agbo suetɔ la (Luk

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: “Ale ame sia ame si sea nye nyawo, eye wòwɔa wo dzi la le abe ame nyanu, si tu eƒe xɔ ɖe kpe dzi la ene.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Ke agbo la le sue, mɔa dzi toto sesẽ, eye wòɖo ta agbe la me; ame ʋɛ aɖewo koe dzea sii.” Ati sia ati kple eƒe kutsetse (Luk

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: “Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le alakpagbeƒãɖelawo ŋuti. Wovaa mia gbɔ, eye wodzena le gota gome abe alẽ ko ene, ke le wo me la, wonye amegãxi nyanyrawo.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Miadze si wo to woƒe nuwɔna me. Aŋɔka mate ŋu atse wainkpowo o, eye srẽ mate ŋu atse gbo o.

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Ale ati nyui sia ati nyui tsea ku nyui, eye ati manyomanyo tsea ku manyomanyo.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Ati nyui mate ŋu atse ku manyomanyo o, eye ati manyomanyo hã mate ŋu atse ku nyui o.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Ke ati si metsea ku nyui o la, wotsonɛ ƒua anyi, eye wotsɔnɛ dea dzo me.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Ale alakpatɔ siwo ɖea gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la ƒe nuwɔnawo miatsɔ adze si woe.” Ame kae ayi ɖe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me? (Luk

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Ke ame sia ame si se nye nyawo, eye mewɔa wo dzi o la, le abe ame manyanu, si tu eƒe xɔ ɖe ke me la ene.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Tsi dza, tɔwo ɖɔ, eye ya sesẽwo ƒo va lɔ xɔ la. Tete xɔa mu dze anyi gbloo!” Yesu ƒe ŋusẽ

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: “Menye ame sia ame si le yɔyem be, ‘Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ’ lae ayi ɖe dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me o. Ke boŋ ame si le Tɔ́nye si le dziƒowo la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu wɔm lae ayi.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Ne ŋkekea ɖo edzi la, ame geɖewo layɔm be, ‘Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ’, ahabiam be, ‘Menye wò ŋkɔ mee míeɖe gbeƒã wò gbedeasi le oa? Menye wò ŋusẽ mee míenya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do goe le oa? Alo menye wò ŋkɔ dzi míeto wɔ nukunu geɖewo oa?’

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Ekema magblɔ na wo be, ‘Nyemenya mi kura o. Nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo, mite ɖa le gbɔnye!’ ” Xɔtula eveawo (Luk

translation_verse: Tsi dza, tɔwo ɖɔ eye ahom tu va lɔ xɔa sesĩe. Gake memu o, elabe woɖo egɔme anyi ɖe kpe gbadza dzi.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu wu nya siawo gbɔgblɔ nu la, ameha la ɖi vo le ale si wòfia nui la ta.

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Elabe efia nu abe ame si si ŋusẽ le la ene, ke menye abe woƒe agbalẽfialawo ene o.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”

translation_verse: Ne woti mia yome le du aɖe me la, misí yi bubu me. Vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, miele dɔ wɔ ge ato Israel-duwo katã me vɔ hafi Amegbetɔ Vi la lava o.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: “Nusrɔ̃vi aɖeke mewúa eƒe nufiala o, eye kluvi aɖeke mewúa eƒe aƒetɔ o.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Ale ele be wòasɔ gbɔ na nusrɔ̃vi be wòava zu abe eƒe nufiala ene, eye ele be wòaɖi ƒo na kluvi be wòazu abe eƒe aƒetɔ ene. Ne woyɔ aƒe aɖe ƒe tatɔ be Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe fia la, ŋkɔ vlo wu kae womana aƒea me viwo o?” Ame si woavɔ̃ na (Luk

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Migavɔ̃ ame siwo wua ŋutilã gake womate ŋu awu luʋɔ la o. Ke boŋ mivɔ̃ ame si ate ŋu atsrɔ̃ ŋutilã kple luʋɔ siaa le dzomavɔʋe me.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Ho si wodzraa atsutsrɔe eve la meɖi naneke o, ke ne menye mia Tɔ́ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu o la, xevi siawo dometɔ ɖeka pɛ gɔ̃ hã mage ɖe anyigba o.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, woxlẽ miaƒe taɖawo katã gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Eya ta migavɔ̃ o; miawo la, miexɔ asi sãa wu atsutsrɔewo.” Nyameʋuʋu le Kristo ŋu kple nugbegbe le egbɔ (Luk

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Azɔ ame sia ame si aʋu nya me le amewo ŋkume be tɔnyee yenye la, nye hã maʋu eyama me le Tɔ́nye si le dziƒowo la ŋkume;

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: ke ame si ke lagbe nu le gbɔnye le amewo ŋkume la, nye hã magbe nu le eyama gbɔ le Tɔ́nye si le dziƒowo la ŋkume.” Yesu he memama vɛ (Luk

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: “Migabu be meva tomefafa na ge le anyigba dzi o. Nyemeva tomefafa na ge o, ke boŋ yi na ge meva.

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: Elabe meva viŋutsuvi kple tɔ́a, vinyɔnuvi kple nɔa, lɔ̃xo kple lɔ̃xoyɔvi dome ma ge,

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: eye ame ƒe ketɔ anye eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒemetɔwo.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si lɔ̃ tɔ́a alo nɔa wum la, mate ŋu anye nye nusrɔ̃la o, eye ame sia ame si lɔ̃ via ŋutsu alo via nyɔnu wum la, medze be wòanye nye nusrɔ̃la o.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Ame si ke metsɔ eƒe atitsoga, heto nye afɔtoƒe o la, mate ŋu anye nye nusrɔ̃la o.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Ame si ke di be yeaɖe yeƒe agbe la, abui; ke ame si ke abu eƒe agbe le tanye la, akpɔe.” Teƒeɖoɖo (Mar

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Ame si xɔ Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela la, akpɔ gome le gbeƒãɖela la ƒe fetu si wòaxɔ la me, eye ame si xɔ ame dzɔdzɔe, le esi wònye ame dzɔdzɔe ta la, akpɔ gome le ame dzɔdzɔe la ƒe fetu si wòaxɔ la me.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: “Ame si xɔ mi la, nyee wòxɔ, eye ame si xɔm la, exɔ ame si dɔm ɖa la hã.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Ame si na tsi fafɛ kplu ɖeka pɛ nenem me sue siawo dometɔ ɖeka le tanye la, vavã mele egblɔm na mi be, woaɖo eteƒe nɛ kokoko.”

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Esi amedɔdɔ siawo dzo yina la, Yesu ƒo nu le Yohanes ŋu na ameha la be: “Nu kae miedo go yi gbedadaƒo be yewoaɖakpɔ? Aƒla si le ya ƒom lae loo?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Yohanes va, meɖua nu o, menoa aha o, eye amewo gblɔ be: ‘Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le eme!’

english_verse: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he left and began teaching and preaching in the towns.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Yesu de dɔ siawo asi na eƒe nusrɔ̃la wui eveawo vɔ la, edzo le afi ma be yeaɖafia nu, eye yeagblɔ nya le woƒe duwo me.

english_verse: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers
translation_verse: Esi Yohanes mawutsilenamela, ame si le gaxɔ me la se nu siwo Kristo la le wɔwɔm la, edɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo ɖe egbɔ,

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: be woabia Yesu be: “Wòe nye ame si wobe ele vava ge loo, alo ame bubue míakpɔ mɔ naa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have heard and seen.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Miheyi ɖagblɔ nu siwo miese kple nu siwo miekpɔ la na Yohanes:

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Ŋkuagbãtɔwo le nu kpɔm; tokunɔwo le nu sem; tekunɔwo le azɔli zɔm; kpodɔlelawo ŋuti le kɔkɔm; wole ame kukuwo fɔm ɖe tsitre, eye wole Nyanyui la gblɔm na ame dahewo.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Mawu yra ame si mekpɔ nuɖiaɖia le ŋunye o.”

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta koŋ miedo go? Be miakpɔ ame aɖe si do awu bɔbɔea? Kpɔ ɖa, awu bɔbɔe dolawo le fiasãwo me.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta koŋ miedo go? Be miakpɔ Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖe ta yea? Ẽ, magblɔe na mi, ame si miekpɔ la wú Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe gblɔm mele na mi be le ame siwo nyɔnuwo dzi dome la, ame aɖeke mewú Yohanes mawutsilenamela o. Gake ame suetɔ le dziƒofiaɖuƒe la me gɔ̃ hã wú eyama.

english_verse: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.
translation_verse: Tso Yohanes mawutsilenamela ŋɔli va se ɖe fifi la, wole fu wɔm dziƒofiaɖuƒe la, eye ame siwo tsi tre ɖe Mawu ƒe dziɖuɖu ŋu la le ʋiʋlim be yewoaxe mɔ na eƒe vava.

english_verse: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.
translation_verse: eye ne mielɔ̃ be yewoaxɔ wo dzi ase la, misee be Yohanes ye nye Eliya si wobe ava do ŋgɔ la.

english_verse: You people are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other,
translation_verse: “Ke azɔ la, nu ka ŋu matsɔ dzidzime sia asɔ ɖo? Woɖi ɖevi siwo bɔbɔ nɔ asi me. Wole ɣli dom le gbɔgblɔm na wo nɔewo be:

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: ‘Míeku dzidzɔkpẽ na mi, ke miegbe ɣeɖuɖu! Míedo aviha ɖa, ke miegbe konyifafa!’

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ Vi la va, eɖua nu eye wònoa nu, eye amewo gblɔ be: ‘Mikpɔ nu tsu ɖula, aha tsu nola sia ɖa! Enye nudzɔlawo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo xɔlɔ̃.’ Ke ame ƒe nuwɔna mee eƒe nunya dzena le.” Du siwo mexɔ se o (Luk

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Du siwo me Yesu wɔ ŋusẽdɔ geɖeawo le la me tɔwo metrɔ dzime o. Ale wòfa na wo gblɔ be:

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Ke wò Kapernaum, ɖokuiwò dom nèle ɖe dzi kaka yi ɖatɔ dziƒoa? Woabɔbɔ wò ɖe anyi yi ɖase keke tsiẽƒe ke! Elabe ɖe wowɔ nukunu siwo wowɔ le mewò le Sodom la, anye ne dua gali va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na wò be Mawu akpɔ nublanui na Sodom le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la wu wò godoo!” Miva gbɔnye ne miadzudzɔ (Luk

english_verse: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Yesu gblɔ be: “Tɔ́, dziƒo kple anyigba ƒe Aƒetɔ! Meda akpe na wò be nèɖe nu siwo le ɣaɣla ɖe nunyalawo kple nugɔmeselawo la fia ɖevi suewo.

english_verse: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Ẽ, Tɔ́, elabe nenemae dze ŋuwò.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: “Tɔ́nye tsɔ nuwo katã de asi nam. Ame aɖeke menya ame si nye Vi la o, negbe Tɔ́ la ko, eye ame aɖeke menya ame si nye Tɔ́ la o, negbe Vi la kple ame si ke Vi la lɔ̃ be yeaɖee afia la ko.

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: “Mite va gbɔnye, mi ame siwo katã ŋu ɖeɖi te, eye agba le mia wum la, eye nye la, mana miadzudzɔ.

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nye kɔkuti la ɖo mia ɖokui dzi, eye misrɔ̃ nu tso gbɔnye ne miakpɔ gbɔɖeme, elabe nye dɔme fa, eye mebɔbɔ ɖokuinye ɖe anyi le dzime.

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: Nye kɔkuti la tsɔtsɔ le bɔbɔe, eye nye agba la le wodzoe.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this!”
translation_verse: Ke esi Farisitɔwo kpɔ esia la, wogblɔ na Yesu be: “Kpɔ ɖa, wò nusrɔ̃lawo le nu si se meɖe mɔ be woawɔ le Dzudzɔgbe o la wɔm!”

english_verse: The crowds were so amazed they asked, “Could Jesus be the Son of David?”
translation_verse: Ameha blibo la ƒe nu ku le nu si Yesu wɔ la ŋuti, eye wobia be: “Ɖe menye Fia David tɔgbuiyɔvi si ŋugbe wodo lae nye esia oa?”

english_verse: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.
translation_verse: Ke ne Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la na ŋusẽm be manya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ado goe la, ekema Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la dze egɔme le mia dome vɔ xoxo.

english_verse: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Alo ɖe miexlẽ le Mose ƒe se la me be enye nyateƒe be nunɔla siwo le mawuxɔa me la gblẽa kɔ ɖo na Dzudzɔgbe ɖe sia ɖe, gake menye vodada nawo oa?

english_verse: He went into the house of God, and then they ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are supposed to eat.
translation_verse: Ege ɖe Mawu ƒe aƒe la me, eye togbɔ be se meɖe mɔ be eya kple eŋutimewo naɖu vɔsabolo la o, elabe nunɔlawo koe kpɔ mɔ aɖui hã la, eya kple eŋutimeawo ɖui.

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be: ‘Nublanuikpɔkpɔ dim mele, menye vɔsasa o.’ Ɖe miese nya sia gɔme tututu la, anye ne miele fɔ bu ge ame siwo meɖi fɔ o la o;

english_verse: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues,
translation_verse: Esi Yesu dzo le afi ma la, eyi ɖe woƒe ƒuƒoƒe aɖe.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “Hold out your hand.” The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na ame si ƒe asi siti lé la be: “Mlo asi.” Emloe, eye asi la ɖɔ ɖo gaɖo eƒe nɔnɔme abe evelia ene.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
translation_verse: Esi Yesu se be woɖo nugbe ɖe ye ŋuti la, edzo le afi ma; ke ameha gã aɖe kplɔe ɖo. Eda gbe le dɔlélawo katã ŋu,

english_verse: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: eye wòde se na wo be womagana amewo nadze si ye o.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as Isaiah the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Egblɔ esia be Mawu ƒe nya si wògblɔ to eƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya dzi la nava va eme be:

english_verse: “Here is my chosen servant! I love him, and he pleases me. I will give him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, nye dɔla si metia lae nye esi. Enye ame si melɔ̃, eye mekpɔ ŋudzedze le eŋu. Makɔ nye Gbɔgbɔ ɖe edzi, eye wòaɖe gbeƒã nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ na trɔ̃subɔlawo.

english_verse: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.
translation_verse: Ame si mele dzinye o la, tsi tre ɖe ŋunye, eye ame si meƒoa ƒu nu kplim o la, kakaa nu hlẽna.

english_verse: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, wokplɔ ame aɖe, si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le, eye wònye ŋkuagbãtɔ kple aɖetututɔ la va Yesu gbɔ. Yesu da gbe le eŋuti, ale be wòte ŋu ƒo nu eye wòkpɔ nu hã.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.
translation_verse: Yesu dze si woƒe susu, eya ta wògblɔ na wo be: “Fiaɖuƒe ɖe sia ɖe si me nɔlawo ma, eye wotsi tre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu la, gbãna. Nenema ke du alo aƒe ɖe sia ɖe si me nɔlawo ma, eye wotsi tre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu la, adze anyi.

english_verse: If I use the power of Beelzebul to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? Your followers are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Ne miele gbɔgblɔm be meto Belzebul, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe fia dzi nya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do goe la, ekema ame ka dzie mia viwo ya tona nyaa gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo doa goe? Nu si mia viwo wɔna lae adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi.

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when the demon doesn't find a place,
translation_verse: “Ne gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ do go le ame me la, eyina ɖatsana le ƒuƒuiƒewo nɔa dzudzɔƒe dim. Ke ne mekpɔ ɖeke o la,

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and the person ends up in worse shape than before. That's how it will be with you evil people of today. Jesus' Mother and Brothers (Mark
translation_verse: eyina ɖakplɔa gbɔgbɔ adrẽ bubu siwo vɔ̃ɖi wu eya ŋutɔ la kpena ɖe eɖokui ŋu vanɛ. Wogena ɖe ame la me, eye wonɔa afi ma. Ale wɔ ame ƒe agbe si wòva nɔna emegbe la va gblẽna wu esi wònɔ tsã. Nenema tututu wòle nɔnɔ ge na egbe dzidzime vɔ̃ɖi sia.” Yesu nɔ kple Yesu nɔviŋutsuwo (Mar

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit. You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces.
translation_verse: “Ne ati aɖe nyo la, eƒe tsetse hã anyo, ke ne atia menyo o la, eƒe tsetse hã manyo o. Kutsetse si ƒomevi ati aɖe tsena lae ɖea ati si ƒomevi wònye la fiana.

english_verse: You are a bunch of evil snakes, so how can you say anything good? Your words show what is in your hearts.
translation_verse: Mi da ƒe dzidzimeviwo, ale ke lawɔ mi ame siwo vɔ̃ɖi la miate ŋu agblɔ nya nyuiwo? Elabe nu si yɔ ame ƒe dzime taŋ la, eyae eƒe nu gblɔna.

english_verse: I promise you on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi be: ame sia ame ana akɔnta tso nya vlo ɖe sia ɖe si wògblɔ kpɔ ɖekematsɔlemetɔe la ŋuti le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la.

english_verse: On that day they will be told they are either innocent or guilty because of the things they have said. A Sign from Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Elabe wò nyawo tsɔ ge woala atso afia na wòe loo, alo abu fɔ wòe.” Dzesi wɔnuku aɖe biabia Yesu (Mar

english_verse: Some Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses said, “Teacher, we want you to show us a sign from heaven.”
translation_verse: Tete agbalẽfiala aɖewo kple Farisitɔ aɖewo gblɔ nɛ be: “Nufiala, míedi be nàwɔ dzesi aɖe ne míakpɔ.”

english_verse: But Jesus replied: You want a sign because you are evil and won't believe! But the only sign you will get is the sign of the prophet Jonah.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo be: “Dzidzime vɔ̃ɖi, mawu bubuwo kplɔɖolawo! Miele dzesi dim tso gbɔnye, ke womana dzesi bubu aɖeke mi wu Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yona ƒe dzesia o.

english_verse: He was in the stomach of a big fish for three days and nights, just as the Son of Man will be deep in the earth for three days and nights.
translation_verse: Elabe abe ale si Yona nɔ ƒumelãtsua ƒe dɔme ŋkeke etɔ̃ zã etɔ̃ ene la, nenema ke Amegbetɔ Vi la hã lanɔ anyigba tume ŋkeke etɔ̃ zã etɔ̃.

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Nineveh will stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah.
