translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ na wo be: “Ati sia ati si Tɔ́nye si le dziƒo medo o la, woahoe ɖa.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: “Nu ka ta wò nusrɔ̃lawo daa mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe kɔnuwo dzi? Elabe womeklɔa asi hafi ɖua nu o!”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Why do you disobey God and follow your own teaching?
translation_verse: Ke Yesu hã bia wo be: “Nu ka ta miawo hã miedaa Mawu ƒe se dzi le miaƒe kɔnyinyiwo ta?

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Ke miawo ya miegblɔ be: ‘Ne ame aɖe gblɔ na tɔ́a alo nɔa be: Nu si wòle be mana wò la, metsɔe na Mawu la, ekema megahiã be amea nabu tɔ́a alo nɔa o.’

english_verse: Is this any way to show respect to your parents? You ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching.
translation_verse: Eya ta to miaƒe kɔnyinyiwo dzi la, miena Mawu ƒe nya ɖi gbɔlo.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.” What Really Makes People Unclean (Mark
translation_verse: Wole subɔnyem dzodzro, elabe wole amegbetɔwo ƒe sededewo kofiam ɖe Mawu tɔ teƒe.’ ” Nu siwo ƒoa ɖi ame (Mar

english_verse: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.”
translation_verse: Miɖe asi le wo ŋu. Ŋkuagbãtɔwo wonye gale ŋkuagbãtɔwo kplɔm. Ne ŋkuagbãtɔ le ŋkuagbãtɔ kplɔm la, do me ko wo kple eve la katã woage adze.”

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu mede nu eme nɛ o. Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo te ɖe eŋu, ɖe kuku nɛ gblɔ be: “Do mɔe ne wòayi elabe ele ɣli dom akpa le mía yome.”

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: Menye nu si yina ɖe ame ƒe nu me lae ƒoa ɖi ame o, ke boŋ nu si doa go tso ame nu lae ƒoa ɖi ame.”

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Tete nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ hegblɔ nɛ be: “Ènya be esi Farisitɔwo se nya si nègblɔ la, eɖia wo nua?”

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Petro gblɔ nɛ be: “Ɖe lododo sia gɔme na mí.”

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ke miawo hã ame masenugɔmewo mieganye kokokoa?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae be nu sia nu si ge ɖe ame ƒe nu me la yina ɖe eƒe dɔme, eye wòdenɛ le nugodo oa?

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Ke nu siwo doa go tso ame nu la tsoa ame ƒe dzime, eye woawoe ƒoa ɖi ame.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Elabe ame ƒe dzimee susu vɔ̃ɖi, amewuwu, ahasiwɔwɔ, matrewɔwɔ, fififi, aʋatsoɖaseɖiɖi, nya vɔ̃ gbɔgblɔ ɖe ame ŋu doa go tsona.

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Nu siawoe ƒoa ɖi ame, ke ne womeklɔ asi hafi ɖu nu o la, eya meƒoa ɖi ame o.” Nyɔnu aɖe ƒe xɔse (Mar

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ be: “Alẽ siwo bu le Israel-ƒeme gbɔ ko wodɔm ɖo ɖa.”

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Ameha gã aɖe va egbɔ kple tekunɔwo, ŋkuagbãtɔwo, nuwɔametɔwo, aɖetututɔwo kple dɔnɔ bubu ƒomevi geɖewo. Wotsɔ wo da ɖe eƒe afɔnu, eye wòyɔ dɔ wo.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Yesu dzo le teƒe ma yi ɖe Tiro kple Sidon nutowo me.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Kanaan-nyɔnu aɖe, si tso nuto mawo me la va egbɔ kple ɣli be: “Nye Aƒetɔ, David Vi, kpɔ nublanui nam! Vinye nyɔnuvi le fu kpem ŋɔdzitɔe tso gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ si me!”

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnua va dze klo ɖe eƒe afɔnu gblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, kpe ɖe ŋunye!”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Menyo be woatsɔ ɖeviwo ƒe nuɖuɖu aƒu gbe na avuviwo o.”

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Nyɔnua ɖo eŋu be: “Nyateƒee, Aƒetɔ, ele nenema baa, gake avuviwo hã ɖua abolo wuwlui, siwo duduna ɖe anyi tso woƒe aƒetɔ ƒe kplɔ̃ dzi ɖe.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Esi Yesu see la, egblɔ nɛ be: “Oo, aƒenɔ, wò xɔse tri akɔ loo! Nu si dim nèle la, neva eme na wò.” Via nyɔnuvi la ƒe lã me sẽ enumake. Yesu yɔ dɔ dɔléla geɖewo

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Yesu dzo le afi ma, eye wòzɔ to Galilea-ƒua nu va ɖo togbɛ aɖe gbɔ. Eliae, eye wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Esi amehawo kpɔ aɖetututɔwo le nu ƒom, nuwɔametɔwo zu ame blibowo, tekunɔwo le azɔli zɔm, eye ŋkuagbãtɔwo le nu kpɔm la, ewɔ nuku na wo ŋutɔ, ale wokafu Israel Mawu la. Yesu na nu ame akpe ene woɖu (Mar

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Yesu yɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va eɖokui gbɔ hegblɔ na wo be: “Ameha la ƒe nu wɔ nublanui nam, elabe ŋkeke etɔ̃ sɔŋ nye esi wole ŋunye, ke naneke mele wo si woaɖu o. Nyemedi be mana woayi aƒe dɔmeɣi ne nu nava tso wo le mɔ ta o.”

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo biae be: “Afi kae míakpɔ nuɖuɖu le, le gbegbe afii, wòasɔ gbɔ ade ame gbogbo siawo nu?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Yesu bia be: “Abolo nenie le mia si?” Nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo eŋu be: “Wo ame adrẽ kple tɔmelã sue ʋɛ aɖewo.”

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu bia tso ameawo si be woabɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: Etsɔ abolo adrẽ kple lã la, eye esi wòda akpe na Mawu la, eka wo tsɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo. Nusrɔ̃laawo ma nuɖuɖua na ameha la.

english_verse: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.
translation_verse: Wo katã woɖu nu, ɖi ƒo. Esi wofɔ kakɛ siwo susɔ la ƒo ƒu la, woyɔ kusi adrẽ.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Ale ke wɔ miedze sii be menye abolo ŋuti meƒo nu le na mi o? Mikpɔ nyuie le Farisitɔwo kple Zadukitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔʋãnu la ŋuti!”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu va ɖo Kaisarea Filipi-dua me la, ebia eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Ame kae amewo gblɔna be Amegbetɔ Vi la nye?”

english_verse: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Who Is Jesus? (Mark
translation_verse: Azɔ ko nusrɔ̃lawo se egɔme be menye amɔwɔʋãnu ŋutie wòle nu xlɔ̃m yewo le o, ke boŋ le Farisitɔwo kple Zadukitɔwo ƒe nufiafia ŋutie. Petro ʋu nya me le Yesu ŋu (Mar

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Fiẽ me la, miegblɔna be: ‘Dziŋgɔli biã eya ta xexeme le kɔkɔ ge.’

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Nenema ke le ŋdi me la, miegblɔna be: ‘Dziŋgɔli biã, eye wòxe litii eya ta tsi le dzadza ge egbea.’ Mielé ŋku ɖe dziŋgɔli ŋu alea hedzea si ale si xexea me ava nɔ. Nu ka ta miete ŋu se dzesi siwo le eme vam egbegbe la gɔme o?

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu be: “Ame aɖewo be Yohanes mawutsilenamelae nènye, ɖewo hã be Eliya, eye bubuwo be Yeremya alo Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela bubu aɖee nènye.”

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Tso gbe ma gbe dzi la, Yesu de asi nyameɖeɖe me na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be ele be yeayi Yerusalem aɖakpe fu geɖe tso amegãwo, nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo si me. Woawu ye, eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la, Mawu afɔ ye ɖe tsitre.

english_verse: Jesus then warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Mikpɔ nyuie eye milé be na mia ɖokui le Farisitɔwo kple Zadukitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔʋãnu la ŋuti.”

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃laawo gblɔ le wo nɔewo dome be: “Esi míetsɔ abolo aɖeke ɖe asi o la tae wògblɔ esia ɖo.”

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ Vi la le vava ge le Tɔ́a ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me kple dɔlawo, eye wòaxe fe na ame sia ame ɖe agbe si ƒomevi wònɔ la nu.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Azɔ la mele egblɔm na wò be wòe nye kpe eye wò, kpe sia dzi matu nye hame la ɖo. Ku gɔ̃ hã mate ŋu aɖu edzi o.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: Tete Yesu bia wo be: “Ke miawo ɖe, ame kae menye le mia gbɔ?”

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro ɖo eŋu be: “Wòe nye Kristo la, Mawu gbagbe la Vi.”

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Mawu yra wò, Simon, Yona vi, elabe menye amegbetɔ aɖekee ɖe esia fia wò o, ke Tɔ́nye si le dziƒowo la boŋ ye.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Matsɔ dziƒofiaɖuƒe la ƒe safuiwo ana wò. Nu sia nu si nàbla le anyigba dzi la anɔ babla le dziƒo, eye nu sia nu si nàtu le anyigba dzi la anɔ tutu le dziƒo.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Yesu de se na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be womegagblɔe na ame aɖeke be yee nye Kristo la o. Yesu ƒo nu le eƒe fukpekpe kple ku ŋuti (Mar

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Ke Petro ɖe kpɔe hede asi mokaka me nɛ gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, Mawu nete esia ɖa xaa tso gbɔwò. Nu sia mele dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe dziwò akpɔ gbeɖe o!”

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Yesu trɔ gblɔ na Petro be: “Dze nam mayi, Satana! Ènye mɔxenu nam elabe wò tamesusuwo menye Mawu tɔ o, ke boŋ amegbetɔwo tɔ ko.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu gblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Ne ame aɖe di be yeanɔ yonyeme la, negbe nu le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui gbɔ, netsɔ eƒe atitsoga, eye wòanɔ yonyeme.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Elabe ame sia ame si di be yeaɖe ye ŋutɔ yeƒe agbe la, abui; ke ame sia ame si abu eƒe agbe le tanye la, akpɔe.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Ne xexeme blibo la zu ame aɖe tɔ, eye wòbu eƒe agbe ɖe, viɖe kae wòkpɔ? Alo nane li, si ame atsɔ aɖɔli eƒe agbea?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi be ame aɖewo le mia dome afii, siwo mele kuku ge hafi akpɔ Amegbetɔ Vi la wòava le eƒe fianyenye me o.”

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Esi wole afi ma la, Yesu ƒe dzedzeme trɔ le wo ŋkume. Eƒe mo klẽ abe ɣe ene, eye eƒe awuwo fu tititi abe kekeli ene.

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Ale nusrɔ̃laawo nya be Yohanes mawutsilenamela ŋue wògblɔ nya la le na yewo. Yesu da gbe le ŋutsuvi aɖe si me gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le la ŋu (Mar

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ade le esiawo megbe la, Yesu yɔ Petro, Yakobo kple nɔvia Yohanes, eye wòkplɔ woawo ɖeɖe yi ɖe to kɔkɔ aɖe dzi.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Tete nusrɔ̃la etɔ̃awo kpɔ Mose kple Eliya wonɔ dze ɖom kple Yesu.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Tete Petro gblɔ na Yesu be: “Aƒetɔ, enye dzidzɔ na mí ŋutɔ be míeva afii! Ne èlɔ̃ la, matu agbadɔ etɔ̃ ɖe afii; tɔwò ɖeka, Mose tɔ ɖeka, eye Eliya hã tɔ ɖeka.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Esime wògale nu ƒom la, alilikpo keklẽ aɖe do vɔvɔli ɖe wo dzi, eye gbe ɖi tso alilikpo la me be: “Vinyee nye ame sia! Nyemelɔ̃a nu le egbɔ o; mekpɔ ŋudzedze blibo le eŋu. Miɖo toe!”

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Esi nusrɔ̃lawo se gbe sia la, vɔvɔ̃ lé wo, eye wotsyɔ mo anyi.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Yesu te ɖe wo ŋu, ka asi wo ŋu hegblɔ na wo be: “Mifɔ! Migavɔ̃ o!”

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Esi wofɔ mo dzi la, womegakpɔ ame aɖeke le afi ma o, negbe Yesu ɖeka ko.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Azɔ nusrɔ̃laawo bia Yesu be: “Nu ka tae agbalẽfialawo gblɔna be ele be Eliya nava do ŋgɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Nyateƒee, ele be Eliya nava do ŋgɔ be woaɖɔ nu sia nu ɖo.

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: Ke mele egblɔm na mi be Eliya va xoxo, evɔ amewo medze sii o, eye wowɔ nu si dze wo ŋu la ɖe eŋu. Nenema kee wole fu wɔ ge Amegbetɔ Vi la hãe.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kple nusrɔ̃la etɔ̃awo va ɖo ameha la gbɔ la, ŋutsu aɖe va dze klo ɖe eŋgɔ

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: hegblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, kpɔ nublanui na vinye ŋutsuvi! Kpeŋuidɔ le eŋu, eye wòle fu wɔmee ŋɔdzitɔe. Zi geɖe la, edzea dzo me, alo tsi me.

english_verse: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.”
translation_verse: Mekplɔe va wò nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔe, ke womete ŋu da gbe le eŋu o.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ be: “O, dzidzime maxɔse totro kpaɖikpaɖi! Ɖe manɔ mia gbɔ ɖaa? Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi mado dzi ahe mi aɖase ɖo? Mikplɔ ɖevia va afii.”

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu blu ɖe gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ la ta, eye wòdo go le ŋutsuvia me. Ale ŋutsuvia ƒe lã me sẽ enumake.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Ke nusrɔ̃laawo va Yesu gbɔ le adzame hebiae be: “Ale ke wɔ míawo ya míete ŋu nya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃a do goe o?”

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Esi wova ƒo ƒu le Galilea la, Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Wole Amegbetɔ Vi la de ge asi na amewo.

translation_verse: Esi Yesu dze mɔ yina ɖe Yerusalem la, eyɔ nusrɔ̃la wui eveawo ɖe kpɔe, eye wògblɔ na wo le mɔa dzi be:

english_verse: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, “When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Ebia nyɔnua be: “Nu ka dim nèle?” Eɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Wɔe be vinye ŋutsuvi eve siawo dometɔ ɖeka nanɔ wò ɖusime, eye evelia hã nanɔ wò miame le wò fiaɖuƒea me.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from?” James and John said, “Yes, we are!”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ɖo eŋu gblɔ be: “Mienya nu si biam miele la o. Ɖe miate ŋu ano fukpekpekplu si no ge mala laa?” Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Míate ŋui.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from my cup! But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for my Father to say.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nyateƒee, mianoe baa, ke be mianɔ anyi ɖe nye ɖusime kple nye miame ya la, eya menye nyee aɖe mɔ le eŋuti o. Ame siwo Tɔ́nye dzrae ɖo ɖi na la ko tɔe.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.
translation_verse: Esi nusrɔ̃la ewoawo se nya sia la, wokpɔ dziku ɖe nɔvi eveawo ŋuti.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu yɔ wo va eɖokui gbɔ gblɔ na wo be: “Mienya be ame siwo ɖua trɔ̃subɔlawo dzi la ɖua amegã ɖe wo dzi, eye woƒe kplɔlawo kpɔa ŋusẽ blibo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.
translation_verse: Migana wòanɔ nenema le miawo ya mia dome o, ke boŋ ame si di be yeanye amegã le mia dome la, nanye miaƒe subɔla.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ame si di be yeanye gbãtɔ le mia dome la, hã nanye miaƒe subɔla.

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men (Mark
translation_verse: Nenema kee Amegbetɔ Vi la gɔ̃ hã meva be woasubɔ ye o, ke boŋ bene yeasubɔ amewo, eye be yeatsɔ yeƒe agbe ana atsɔ axɔ ame geɖe.” Yesu da gbe le ŋkuagbãtɔ eve ŋuti (Mar

english_verse: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.
translation_verse: Esi wodo go tso Yerixo-dua me yina la, ameha gã aɖe kplɔ wo ɖo.

english_verse: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Ŋkuagbãtɔ eve bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe mɔa to, eye esi wose be Yesu va yina la, wodo ɣli gblɔ be: “Kpɔ nublanui na mí, David Vi!”

english_verse: They answered, “Lord, we want to see!”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu be: “Aƒetɔ, na be míaƒe ŋkuwo naʋu.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, “Go work in the vineyard today!”
translation_verse: “Mibu esia ŋu kpɔ. Vi eve le ame aɖe si. Eyi ɖe gbãtɔ gbɔ ɖagblɔ nɛ be: ‘Vinye, yi nàwɔ dɔ le nye waingble me egbea.’

english_verse: But when they saw the man's son, they said, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ke esi agblea dzikpɔlawo kpɔ via la, wogblɔ na wo nɔewo be: ‘Ame si gbɔna doa me nyi ge lae nye esi. Miva ne míawui bene eƒe domenyinu la nazu mía tɔ!’

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will at once let you have the donkeys.”
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe bia nya aɖe mi la, migblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ lae le wo hiãm,’ eye aɖe asi le wo ŋu na mi enumake.”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Esia dzɔ be nya siwo Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela ɖe gbeƒãe ɖi la nava eme be:

english_verse: “Announce to the people of Jerusalem: ‘Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey.’ ”
translation_verse: “Migblɔ na Zion-du la be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, wò fia gbɔna gbɔwò ɖokuibɔbɔtɔe. Ele tedzi dzi gbɔna, eye wòle dɔwɔlã si nye tedzivi la dom.’ ”

english_verse: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.
translation_verse: Ale nusrɔ̃laawo yi, eye wowɔ abe ale si Yesu gblɔ na wo la ene.

english_verse: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Wokplɔ tedzinɔa kple via vɛ. Wotsɔ woƒe avɔwo ɖo ɖe wo dzi, eye Yesu bɔbɔ nɔ wo dzi.

english_verse: When Jesus came to Jerusalem, everyone in the city was excited and asked, “Who can this be?”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu ge ɖe Yerusalem la, du blibo la ƒo zi eye amewo bia be: “Ame kae nye esia?”

english_verse: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.
translation_verse: Ke esi nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo kpɔ nukunu siwo wòwɔ kple ale si ɖeviwo nɔ ɣli dom nɔ gbɔgblɔm le gbedoxɔa me be: “Ɖe mí loo! David Viŋutsu” la, eku dzi na wo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew Jesus was talking about them.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi nunɔlagãwo kple Farisitɔwo se eƒe lododoawo la, eme kɔ na wo be yewo ŋutie wòdo wo ɖo.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be called a place of worship.’ But you have turned it into a place where robbers hide.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Woŋlɔ ɖi be: ‘Woayɔ nye aƒe be gbedoɖaƒe,’ ke miawo la, mietsɔe wɔ adzodalawo ƒe beɖoƒe.”

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray, you will be given whatever you ask for.” A Question about Jesus' Authority (Mark
translation_verse: Azɔ ne xɔse le mia si la, nu sia nu si miado gbe ɖa abia ko la, miaxɔe.” Nyabiabia le Yesu ƒe ŋusẽ ƒe tsoƒe ŋu (Mar

english_verse: The men said to Jesus, “Don't you hear what those children are saying?” “Yes, I do!” Jesus answered. “Don't you know that the Scriptures say, ‘Children and infants will sing praises’?”
translation_verse: Wobia Yesu be: “Èle nya si gblɔm ame siawo le la sema?” Eɖo eŋu na wo be: “Ẽ, alo ɖe miexlẽe be, ‘Vidzĩwo kple vi nonowo ƒe nu mee nèna kafukafu si de blibo doa go tsona’ la kpɔ oa?”

english_verse: Then Jesus left the city and went out to the village of Bethany, where he spent the night. Jesus Puts a Curse on a Fig Tree (Mark
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, Yesu gblẽ wo ɖi, eye wòdzo le dua me yi ɖe Betania ɖatsi afi ma dɔ. Yesu ƒo fi de gboti la (Mar

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I have just one question to ask you. If you answer it, I will tell you where I got the right to do these things.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Nye hã mabia nya ɖeka mi, eye ne mieɖo eŋu nam la, ekema nye hã magblɔ ŋusẽ si metsɔ le nu siawo wɔmee la na mi.

english_verse: When Jesus got up the next morning, he was hungry. He started out for the city,
translation_verse: Esi wòtrɔ yina ɖe dua me le ŋufɔke ŋdi la, dɔ nɔ ewum.

english_verse: But Jesus said to them, “If you have faith and don't doubt, I promise you can do what I did to this tree. And you will be able to do even more. You can tell this mountain to get up and jump into the sea, and it will.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Nyateƒe tututu tom mele na mi be, ne miexɔ se, eye mieke ɖi kura o la, menye nu si mewɔ na ati sia ɖeɖe ko miawɔ o. Ne miegblɔ na to sia be: ‘Ho, nàyi ɖadze ƒu me’ la, ava eme.

english_verse: So they told Jesus, “We don't know.” Jesus said, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.” A Story about Two Sons
translation_verse: Ale woɖo eŋu na Yesu be: “Míenya o.” Egblɔ na wo be: “Ekema nye hã nyemagblɔ afi si mexɔ ŋusẽ tsoe hele nu siawo wɔmee la na mi o.” Lododo le viŋutsuvi eveawo ŋu

english_verse: Jesus told the chief priests and leaders to listen to this story: A land owner once planted a vineyard. He built a wall around it and dug a pit to crush the grapes in. He also built a lookout tower. Then he rented out his vineyard and left the country.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Migase lododo bubu. Agbledela aɖe de waingble, tɔ kpɔ ƒo xlãe. Etu wainfiãnu kple agbledzɔxɔe ɖe eme. Emegbe la, etsɔe de asi na ame siwo wɔa dɔ le waingble me, eye wòdzo yi du bubu aɖe me.

english_verse: Jesus had gone into the temple and was teaching when the chief priests and the leaders of the people came up to him. They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu trɔ va mawuxɔa me hele nu fiam la, nunɔlagãwo kple dumegãwo va egbɔ, eye wobiae be: “Ame ka ƒe ŋusẽ nètsɔ le nu siawo wɔmee, eye ame kae ɖe mɔ na wò?”

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?” They thought it over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Ame ka gbɔ Yohanes xɔ ŋusẽ tsoe hele mawutsi na amewo? Mawu gbɔ ye wòxɔe tsoe loo, alo amewo gbɔ yea?” Woda nya la kpɔ le wo nɔewo dome be: “Ne míegblɔ be: ‘Mawu gbɔe wòxɔe tsoe’ la, abia mí be: ‘Ekema nu ka ta miexɔ edzi se o?’

english_verse: On the other hand, these people think John was a prophet, and we are afraid of what they might do to us. That's why we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Ke ne míegblɔ be: ‘Amewo gbɔe wòxɔe tsoe’ hã menyo o; míele vɔvɔ̃m na ameha la elabe wo katã woxɔe se be Yohanes nye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela.”

english_verse: His son told him he would not do it, but later he changed his mind and went.
translation_verse: Eɖo eŋu be: ‘Nyemayi o.’ Ke emegbe la, edze sii be yeda vo, ale wòyi agblea.

english_verse: The man then told his younger son to go work in the vineyard. The boy said he would, but he didn't go.
translation_verse: Eyi ɖe evelia gbɔ gagblɔ nya mawo ke na eya hã. Eya ɖo eŋu be: ‘Yoo, tɔ́nye, mayi.’ Ke mede o.

english_verse: Which one of the sons obeyed his father? “The older one,” the chief priests and leaders answered. Then Jesus told them: You can be sure tax collectors and prostitutes will get into the kingdom of God before you ever will!
translation_verse: Vi eve siawo dometɔ kae wɔ wo tɔ́a ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu?” Woɖo eŋu be: “Gbatɔ̃ lae.” Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Mele egblɔm na mi le nyateƒe me be nudzɔlawo kple ahasiwɔlawo tre mawufiaɖuƒea me yiyi na mi.

english_verse: When John the Baptist showed you how to do right, you would not believe him. But these evil people did believe. And even when you saw what they did, you still would not change your minds and believe. Renters of a Vineyard (Mark
translation_verse: Elabe Yohanes va mia gbɔ be yeafia mɔ dzɔdzɔe, si dzi miato la mi, gake miexɔ edzi se o. Nudzɔlawo kple ahasiwɔlawo boŋ xɔ edzi se. Esi miekpɔ esia dze sii kɔtɛe gɔ̃ hã la, mietrɔ susu emegbe be yewoaxɔ edzi ase o.” Lododo le waingbledzikpɔla vɔ̃ɖiawo ŋuti (Mar

english_verse: When it was harvest time, the owner sent some servants to get his share of the grapes.
translation_verse: Esi kutsetseawo gbeɣi ɖo la, edɔ eƒe dɔlawo ɖo ɖe waingblea dzikpɔlawo be woaxɔ ye tɔ gome vɛ na ye.

english_verse: But the renters grabbed those servants. They beat up one, killed one, and stoned one of them to death.
translation_verse: Ke agblea dzikpɔlawo lé eƒe dɔlaawo. Woƒo ame ɖeka, wu ame ɖeka eye woƒu kpe etɔ̃lia.

english_verse: He then sent more servants than he did the first time. But the renters treated them in the same way.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, egadɔ dɔla bubu siwo sɔ gbɔ wu esiwo yi gbã la, ke agblea dzikpɔlawo gawɔ woawo hã nenema ke.

english_verse: Finally, the owner sent his own son to the renters, because he thought they would respect him.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, edɔ eya ŋutɔ via ɖo ɖe wo gbɔ gblɔ be: ‘Ɖewohĩ woasi vinye ŋkume ɖa.’

english_verse: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
translation_verse: Tete wolée, hee do goe tso waingblea me, eye wowui.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “When the owner of that vineyard comes, what do you suppose he will do to those renters?”
translation_verse: Azɔ ne waingbletɔa va ɖe, nu ka wòawɔ waingbledzikpɔla siawo?”

english_verse: The chief priests and leaders answered, “He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu be: “Le nyateƒe me la, atsrɔ̃ ame vlo siawo eye wòatsɔ waingblea ade asi na agbledzikpɔla bubu, siwo atsɔ etɔ gome vɛ nɛ ɖe ɣeyiɣi dzi tututu le nuŋeɣi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You surely know that the Scriptures say, ‘The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ɖe miexlẽ esia le mawunya me kpɔ oa? Woŋlɔ ɖi be: ‘Kpe si xɔtulawo gbe la, eya kee va zu dzogoedzikpe. Aƒetɔ lae wɔ esia. Ewɔ nuku na mí ale gbegbe.’

english_verse: I tell you God's kingdom will be taken from you and given to people who will do what he demands.
translation_verse: “Eya ta mele egblɔm na mi be woaxɔ mawufiaɖuƒea le mia si, eye woatsɔe ana dukɔ si tse ku la.” [

english_verse: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will be crushed, and anyone it falls on will be smashed to pieces.”
translation_verse: “Ame si ke dze kpe sia dzi la, aŋe klíklikli, ke ame si ke dzi wòadze ya la, agbãe nyányanya.”]

english_verse: So they looked for a way to arrest Jesus. But they were afraid to, because the people thought he was a prophet.
translation_verse: Eya ta wodi be yewoalée, ke wovɔ̃ na ameha la elabe ameawo bu Yesu abe Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela ene.

translation_verse: Woyɔ ame geɖewo, ke ame ʋɛ aɖewo ko wotia.” Nyabiabia le dugadzɔdzɔ ŋuti (Mar

english_verse: The Pharisees got together and planned how they could trick Jesus into saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Farisitɔwo yi ɖawɔ ɖoɖo le ale si woawɔ atsɔ Yesu ŋutɔ ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ alée la ŋuti.

english_verse: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: be: “Nufiala, Mose gblɔ be ne ŋutsu aɖe, si si vi aɖeke mele o la ku la, ele be nɔvia ŋutsu naɖe eƒe ahosia bene wòadzi vi ahado ƒome ɖi nɛ.

english_verse: Once again Jesus used stories to teach the people:
translation_verse: Yesu gaƒo nu na wo le lododowo me. Egblɔ be:

english_verse: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a king gave a wedding banquet for his son.
translation_verse: “Dziƒofiaɖuƒea ɖi fia aɖe, si ɖu srɔ̃ɖe ŋkekenyui na via ŋutsuvi.

english_verse: The king sent some servants to tell the invited guests to come to the banquet, but the guests refused.
translation_verse: Edɔ eƒe dɔlawo ɖo ɖa be woayi aɖayɔ ame siwo wokpe la ava srɔ̃ɖe ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒee, ke ame kpekpeawo gbe vava.

english_verse: He sent other servants to say to the guests, “The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet!”
translation_verse: Ke egadɔ dɔla bubuwo ɖo ɖe ameawo gblɔ be: ‘Nuɖuɖua sɔ gbe vɔ. Wowu nye nyitsu kple nyivi damiwo, eye wodzra nu sia nu ɖo da ɖi. Miva srɔ̃ɖe ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe.’

english_verse: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo wokpe la mebu eƒe nya la kura o, eye wodzo yi woƒe dɔ vovovowo wɔƒe. Ame ɖeka dzo yi agble, eye ame evelia dzo yi asi.

english_verse: Others grabbed the servants, then beat them up and killed them.
translation_verse: Ame mamlɛawo lé eƒe dɔlawo, do ŋukpe wo, eye wowu wo.

english_verse: This made the king so furious that he sent an army to kill those murderers and burn down their city.
translation_verse: Fia la do dɔmedzoe ale gbegbe be wòdɔ eƒe asrafowo ɖo ɖa woyi ɖawu hlɔ̃dola siawo, eye wotɔ dzo woƒe dua.

english_verse: Then he said to the servants, “It is time for the wedding banquet, and the invited guests don't deserve to come.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, egblɔ na eƒe dɔlawo be: ‘Srɔ̃ɖe ŋkekenyui nuɖuɖua sɔ gbe, ke ame siwo mekpe la, medze o.

english_verse: Go out to the street corners and tell everyone you meet to come to the banquet.”
translation_verse: Eya ta fifia la, miyi ɖe dua ƒe ablɔ gãwo dzi ne miayɔ ame sia ame si miekpɔ la va srɔ̃ɖe ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒee.’

english_verse: When the king went in to meet the guests, he found that one of them wasn't wearing the right kind of clothes for the wedding.
translation_verse: “Ke esi fia la va be yeakpɔ ame kpekpeawo ɖa la, ekpɔ ŋutsu aɖe si medo srɔ̃ɖewu o.

english_verse: Tell us what you think! Should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not?”
translation_verse: Eya ta gblɔ wò susu na mí. Ele se nu be míadzɔ duga na Roma Fiagã loo, alo mele se nu o?”

english_verse: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers and finally to all seven of them.
translation_verse: Nu sia kee dzɔ ɖe nɔvia ŋutsu evelia kple etɔ̃lia va se ɖe adrẽlia dzi.

english_verse: They sent some of their followers and some of Herod's followers to say to him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Wodɔ woƒe nusrɔ̃la aɖewo kple Herodes-habɔbɔmenɔlawo dometɔ aɖewo ɖo ɖe egbɔ gblɔ be: “Nufiala, míenya be nyateƒetɔ nènye, eye nèle Mawu ƒe mɔa fiam le nyateƒe me. Mètsɔa ɖeke le nu si amewo gblɔna la me o elabe mèkpɔa ame ŋkume o.

english_verse: Let me see one of the coins used for paying taxes.” They brought him a silver coin,
translation_verse: Mitsɔ ga si ŋudɔ miewɔna la vɛ makpɔ.” Wotsɔ ga la vɛ nɛ.

english_verse: “The Emperor's,” they answered. Then Jesus told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu be: “Roma Fiagã la tɔwoe.” Azɔ Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ekema mitsɔ nu siwo nye Roma Fiagã tɔ la na Roma Fiagã, eye mitsɔ nu siwo nye Mawu tɔ la hã na Mawu.”

english_verse: At last the woman died.
translation_verse: Le nu siawo katã megbe la, nyɔnua hã va ku.

translation_verse: Se eve siawo dzie wotu Mose ƒe seawo kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe nufiafia katã ɖo.” Nyabiabia le Kristo la ŋuti (Mar

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe people would rise to life after death. So that same day some of the Sadducees came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe ke la, Zadukitɔ siwo gblɔna be tsitretsitsi tso ame kukuwo dome meli o la, dometɔ aɖewo va Yesu gbɔ biae

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Mietra, elabe mienya mawunyaawo kple ŋusẽ si le Mawu si la o.

english_verse: When God raises people to life, they won't marry. They will be like the angels in heaven.
translation_verse: Ne ame kukuwo tsi tsitre la, womaɖe srɔ̃ o eye womatsɔ nyɔnu ana atsu hã o, ke boŋ wo katã woanɔ abe mawudɔla siwo le dziƒo ene.

english_verse: And as for people being raised to life, God was speaking to you when he said,
translation_verse: Ke ɖe miexlẽ nu si Mawu gblɔ na mi le ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi ŋuti kpɔ oa? Egblɔ be:

english_verse: “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living.
translation_verse: ‘Nyee nye Abraham ƒe Mawu, Isak ƒe Mawu kple Yakob ƒe Mawu.’ Menye ame kukuwo ƒe Mawu wònye o, ke boŋ agbagbeawo tɔe wònye.”

english_verse: The crowds were surprised to hear what Jesus was teaching. The Most Important Commandment (Mark
translation_verse: Esi amehaawo se esia la, woƒe mo wɔ yaa le eƒe nufiafia la ŋuti. Se vevitɔ la (Mar

english_verse: After Jesus had made the Sadducees look foolish, the Pharisees heard about it and got together.
translation_verse: Esi Farisitɔwo se be Yesu de ga nu na Zadukitɔwo la, wova ƒo ƒu

english_verse: “Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law?”
translation_verse: “Nufiala, Mose ƒe se kae nye vevitɔ wu?”

english_verse: This is the first and most important commandment.
translation_verse: Esiae nye sedede gbãtɔ kple vevitɔ.

english_verse: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Sedede si ɖii lae nye: ‘Lɔ̃ hawòvi abe ale si nèlɔ̃ ɖokuiwò ene.’

english_verse: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them,
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Farisitɔwo ƒo ƒu ale la, Yesu bia wo be:

english_verse: ‘The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: ‘Aƒetɔ la gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ be, Bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe nye ɖusime va se ɖe esime matsɔ wò ketɔwo ade wò afɔ te.’

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: “Ale kee nye miaƒe susu le Kristo la ŋu? Ame ka Vie wònye?” Woɖo eŋu be: “David Vie.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “How then could the Spirit lead David to call the Messiah his Lord? David said,
translation_verse: Yesu bia be: “Ke ale ke wɔ gbɔgbɔ la na David yɔe be: ‘Aƒetɔ’? Egblɔ be:

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: Azɔ ne David yɔ Kristo la be ‘Aƒetɔ’ la, ale ke wɔ wòganye Via?”

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke mete ŋu ɖo nya la ŋu nɛ alo te ŋu do dzi gabia nya bubu aɖee tso gbe ma gbe dzi kpɔ o.

english_verse: And now your temple will be deserted.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, wogblẽ wò aƒe ɖi wòzu aƒedo.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: “Yerusalem, ao, Yerusalem! Wòe wu Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo eye nèƒua kpe ame siwo Mawu dɔ ɖo ɖe gbɔwò! Medi zi geɖe be maƒo viwòwo nu ƒu ɖe gbɔnye, abe ale si koklonɔ ƒoa viawo nu ƒu ɖe eƒe aʋala te la ene, gake nègbe.

english_verse: Anyone who swears by the altar also swears by everything on it.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame si ke tà vɔsamlekpuia la, età vɔsamlekpuia kple nunana siwo katã le edzi la hã.

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Yesu ƒo nu na amehaawo kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ be:

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: “Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo sie ŋusẽ le be woaɖe Mose ƒe se la gɔme.

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: Eya ta miwɔ nu sia nu si wogblɔ na mi la, eye milé wo me ɖe asi, ke migakpɔ woƒe nuwɔna miawɔ o, elabe womenɔa agbe ɖe nu si wofiana la nu o.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Wowɔa nu sia nu be amewo nakpɔ ko. Woƒe ŋkuɖodzinuwo keke, eye wowɔa adza didiwo ɖe woƒe awu ʋlayawo to.

english_verse: They love the best seats at banquets and the front seats in the synagogues.
translation_verse: Ne wokpe wo yi nuɖuƒe la, bubuteƒenɔnɔ vivia wo nu, eye ne woyi ƒuƒoƒewo la, wolɔ̃a zikpui nyuitɔwo dzi nɔnɔ.

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: Wodina be amewo nado gbe na yewo bubutɔe le asi me, eye be woayɔ yewo be ‘Nufiala bubutɔ.’

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, migana woayɔ mi be ‘Nufiala’ o, elabe nufiala ɖeka koe le mia si, eye mi katã mienye nɔviwo.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Nenema ke migayɔ ame aɖeke le anyigba dzi be mia ‘Tɔ́’ o, elabe Tɔ́ ɖeka koe le dziƒo na mi.

english_verse: None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la migana woayɔ mi be ‘Kplɔla’ o, elabe ame ɖeka koe nye mia kplɔla; eyae nye Kristo la.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo! Alakpatɔwo! Miexɔa ahosiwo ƒe aƒewo le wo si, eye miedoa gbe didi ɖa hetsɔna flua amewoe. Eya ta miaƒe fɔbubu kple tohehe asesẽ wu.]

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: Baba na mi, Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo! Alakpatɔwo! Miezɔ ƒu dzi, zɔ anyigba dzi le trɔ̃subɔla ɖeka pɛ dim be yewoatrɔ wòazu Yudatɔ. Ke ne mietrɔ ame sia la, miewɔnɛ wòzua dzomavɔʋemenɔla zigbɔzi eve wu miawo ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã!”

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: “Baba na mi, kplɔla ŋkuagbãtɔ siwo gblɔna be: ‘Ne ame aɖe tà mawuƒea la, megblẽ naneke o; ke ame si tà sika si le mawuƒea me la, edze be wòawɔ ŋugbe si wòdo la dzi godoo.’

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Ŋkuagbãtɔ movitɔwo! Kae le vevie wu: sika la loo, alo mawuƒe si na sika la ŋu kɔ?

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Miawo kee gafia hã be: ‘Ne ame aɖe tà vɔsamlekpuia dzi la, edze be wòawɔ ŋugbe si wòdo la dzi.’

english_verse: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
translation_verse: Ŋkuagbãtɔwo! Kae dze bubu wu: nunana la loo, alo vɔsamlekpui si na nunana la ŋu kɔ la yea?

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Ne età mawuƒea la, età mawuƒea kple Mawu, ame si le afi ma la hã.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ame si tà dziƒo la, età Mawu ƒe fiazikpui kple Mawu ŋutɔ, ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la hã.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: “Baba na mi, Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo! Alakpatɔwo! Mienaa kalɛ̃, ahaliwɔe kple tsyo ƒe akpa ewolia pɛpɛpɛ, ke miegblẽ sea ƒe nufiafia vevitɔ, siwo nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, nublanuikpɔkpɔ kple xɔse ya boŋ ɖi. Nu siawo wòdze be miawɔ gbã ahatsɔ ekemɛawo wɔwɔ akpe ɖe wo ŋu hafi.

english_verse: You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.
translation_verse: Kplɔla ŋkuagbãtɔwo! Mietsyɔa nudzodzoewo le aha ŋgɔ, ke kposɔ blibo miemina!

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.
translation_verse: “Baba na mi, Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo! Alakpatɔwo! Mieklɔa miaƒe nunonuwo kple nuɖugbawo godo pɛpɛpɛ, ke wo me yɔ fũu kple nu siwo mieda adzoe kple nu siwo mieklẽ ŋu xɔ la sɔŋ.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: Wò Farisitɔ ŋkuagbãtɔ, klɔ nunonu la kple nuɖugba la me gbã ekema egodo hã aɖi.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: “Baba na mi, Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo! Alakpatɔwo! Miele abe yɔdo siwo ŋuti wosi akalo ɖo nyuie, eye wonyale kpɔkpɔm la ene. Evɔ la, wo me yɔ fũu kple ameƒuwo kple ŋunyɔnu geɖe.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Nenema ke miawo hã miedzena ame dzɔdzɔewoe le gota, le amewo ŋkume, ke alakpadada kple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ yɔ mia me taŋ. Yesu gblɔ Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo ƒe tohehe ɖi (Luk

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: “Baba na mi, Agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo! Alakpatɔwo mienye! Miedzraa Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe yɔdowo ɖo, eye mieɖoa atsyɔ̃ na ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe yɔdodzikpewo,

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: eye miegblɔna be, ‘Ɖe míenɔ anyi le mía tɔgbuiwo ŋɔli la, anye ne mímawɔ ɖeka kpli wo awu Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo gbeɖe o.’

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Ale wɔ mieɖi ɖase le mia ɖokui ŋuti be yewoe nye ame siwo wu Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo la ƒe dzidzimeviwo!

english_verse: So keep on doing everything they did.
translation_verse: Fifia la, miyi edzi ne miaƒo mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔwo katã ta.

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: Mi da kple da ƒe dzidzimeviwo! Ɖe miebu be yewoate ŋu así adzo, ne womagabu fɔ mi aɖo ɖe dzomavɔʋea me oa?

english_verse: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things! Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Luke
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi be, nu siawo katã ava mi dzidzi sia dzi. Yesu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ na Yerusalem (Luk

english_verse: You won't see me again until you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Magblɔe na mi, miegale kpɔ ye ge azɔ o, va se ɖe esime ɣeyiɣia nade miagblɔ be, ‘Woyra ame si gbɔna le Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ me.’ ”

english_verse: After Jesus left the temple, his disciples came over and said, “Look at all these buildings!”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu do go tso mawuxɔ la me yina la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ be yewoafia ale si wotso mawuƒe blibo lae.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ na wo be: “Miele nu siawo katã kpɔma? Mele egblɔm na mi le nyateƒe me be womele kpeɖoɖo aɖeke gblẽ ge ɖe bubu dzi le afii si womakaka aƒu anyi o.” Fuɖename kple yometitiwo (Mar

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
translation_verse: Elabe ame geɖewo atsɔ nye ŋkɔ ɖe nu ava gblɔ be: ‘Nyee nye Kristo la!’ Woakplɔ ame geɖewo atrae.

english_verse: You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Miase aʋawɔwɔ kple aʋawɔwɔ ŋu nyawo. Ke nu siawo megatso dzika ƒo na mi o. Ele be esiawo nava eme godoo, ke womefia be xexea me ƒe nuwuwu la ɖo haɖe o.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Amitoa dzi la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo va egbɔ dzaa hebiae be: “Ɣe ka ɣie nu sia ladzɔ? Gblɔe na mí. Nu kae anye dzesi be nègbɔna, eye be xexea me le enu wum?”

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo lawɔ aʋa kple wo nɔewo, eye fiaɖuƒewo latsi tre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋuti. Dɔ ato, eye anyigba aʋuʋu le teƒeteƒewo.

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Ke baba na funɔwo kple ame siwo le no nam wo viwo le ɣe ma ɣi me.

english_verse: But this is just the beginning of troubles.
translation_verse: Nu siawo katã le ko abe fúɖuame ƒe gɔmedzedze ene.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: “Le ɣeyiɣi mawo me la, woatsɔ mi ade asi be woawɔ funyafunya mi, eye woawu mi gɔ̃ hã. Amegbetɔƒomea alé fu mi le tanye.

english_verse: Many will give up and will betray and hate each other.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo aɖe asi le woƒe xɔse ŋu. Woafia wo nɔewo yome mɔ, eye woalé fu wo nɔewo.

english_verse: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.
translation_verse: Azɔ aʋatsogbeƒãɖela geɖewo ado, eye woakplɔ ame geɖewo atrae.

english_verse: Someone may say, “Here is the Messiah!” or “There he is!” But don't believe it.
translation_verse: “Azɔ ne ame aɖe agblɔ na mi be: ‘Miva kpɔ ɖa, Kristo la le afii!’ alo ‘Ele afi mɛ ɖa!’ la, migaxɔe se o,

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Mido gbe ɖa be miaƒe sisíɣi la nagadze vuvɔŋɔli alo Dzudzɔgbe dzi o!

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!
translation_verse: “Ne miekpɔ ‘Aƒegbãnu dziŋɔ’ la si ŋuti Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Daniɛl ƒo nu le la wòanɔ tsitre ɖe kɔkɔeƒea me la”,

english_verse: If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: “ekema mina ame siwo le Yudea la nasí ayi toawo dzi.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ame si le agble la hã megatrɔ va agbledzɔxɔ me be yeatsɔ yeƒe awu o.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Ne menye ɖe woɖe ɣeyiɣi ma dzi kpɔtɔ o la, anye ne womaxɔ amegbetɔ aɖeke ɖe agbe o. Ke le ame tiatiawo ta la, woatò ɣeyiɣia ɖe eme.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne miawo hã miekpɔ nenem nu siawo katã la, midze sii be egogo agboa nu vɔ.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ Vi la ƒe vavaɣi anɔ abe nu si dzɔ le Noa ŋɔli la ene.

english_verse: No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.
translation_verse: “Ke ŋkeke ma alo gaƒoƒo ma la, ame aɖeke menyae o. Mawudɔla siwo le dziƒo hã menyae o. Vi la ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã menyae o, Tɔ́ la dzaa koe nyae.

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Le ɣeyiɣi ma me la, ame eve anɔ dɔ wɔm le agble me, woaxɔ ɖeka, agblẽ ɖeka ɖi.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: “Eya ta minɔ ŋudzɔ, elabe mienya ŋkeke si dzi miaƒe Aƒetɔ la le vava ge o.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.
translation_verse: Ke minyae be ɖe aƒea tɔ anya zã ƒe gaƒoƒo si dzi fiafitɔa ava la, anɔ ŋudzɔ ale be mana mɔ fiafitɔa be wòato afi aɖeke age ɖe aƒea me o.

english_verse: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come. Faithful and Unfaithful Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Eya ta ele be miawo hã mianɔ ŋudzɔ elabe Amegbetɔ Vi la le vava ge le ɣeyiɣi si me miele mɔ kpɔm nɛ o la me. Dɔla nuteƒewɔla kple dɔla mawɔnuteƒe (Luk

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.
translation_verse: Ke nenye be dɔla vɔ̃ɖi la gblɔ le eɖokui me be, ‘Nye aƒetɔ la magbɔ fifia o’,

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: “Azɔ la, ame kae nye dɔla nuteƒewɔla kple nunyala? Eyae nye ame si si eƒe aƒetɔ ɖo eƒe aƒemetɔwo nu be wòana nuɖuɖu wo le ɣeyiɣi nyuitɔ dzi.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Woyra dɔla ma si eƒe aƒetɔ la ava tu wòanɔ dɔ si wòɖo nɛ la wɔm.

english_verse: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi le nyateƒe me be atsɔ dɔla ma aɖo eƒe nunɔamesiwo katã nu.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.

translation_verse: “Ame si axɔ ɖevi siawo dometɔ ɖeka le tanye la, nyee wòxɔ, eye ame si xɔm la, menye nyee wòxɔ o, ke boŋ exɔ ame si dɔm ɖo ɖa la.” Ame si ke metsi tre ɖe mía ŋu o la, ele mía dzi (Luk

english_verse: The crowd was really surprised to see Jesus, and everyone hurried over to greet him.
translation_verse: Esi ameha la kpɔ Yesu la, woɖi vo ŋutɔ; tete woƒu du yi egbɔ hedo gbe nɛ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What are you arguing about?”
translation_verse: Yesu bia eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Nya ka hem miele kpli wo?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “O dzidzime maxɔse! Ɖe manɔ mia gbɔ ɖaa? Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi mado dzi ahe mi aɖase ɖo? Mikplɔe va gbɔnyee.”

english_verse: Jesus asked the boy's father, “How long has he been like this?” The man answered, “Ever since he was a child.
translation_verse: Yesu bia ŋutsuvia tɔ́a be: “Ɣe ka ɣi dɔlélea dze egɔme?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Tso keke eƒe ɖevime kee.

english_verse: At once the boy's father shouted, “I do have faith! Please help me to have even more.”
translation_verse: Enumake ɖevia tɔ́a do ɣli be: “Mexɔ se, ke nye xɔse mesɔ gbɔ o, kpe ɖe ŋunye wòadzi ɖe edzi!”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that a crowd was gathering fast, he spoke sternly to the evil spirit that had kept the boy from speaking or hearing. He said, “I order you to come out of the boy! Don't ever bother him again.”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kpɔ be ameha aɖe le du dzi gbɔna la, eblu ɖe gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ la ta be: “Wò gbɔgbɔ tokunɔ aɖetututɔ, do go le ɖevia me, eye mègage ɖe eme azɔ gbeɖe o!”

english_verse: The spirit screamed and made the boy shake all over. Then it went out of him. The boy looked dead, and almost everyone said he was.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la nyama ɖevia hedo ɣli sesĩe eye wòdo go le eme. Ɖevia zu abe ame kuku ene, ale be ameawo dometɔ geɖewo gblɔ be: “Eku.”

english_verse: But Jesus took hold of his hand and helped him stand up.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu lé eƒe alɔnu hekɔe dzi, eye wòtso ɖe tsitrenu.

translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Esia ƒomevi ya la, womate ŋu anyàe ado goe to mɔ bubu aɖeke dzi o, negbe to gbedodoɖa me ko.” Yesu gaƒo nu le eƒe ku ŋuti (Mat

translation_verse: Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dzo le afi ma yi ɖato Galilea. Ke Yesu medi be ame aɖeke nanya o,

translation_verse: elabe enɔ nu fiam eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Wole Amegbetɔ Vi la de ge asi na amewo, eye woawui, eye ne wowui la, agatsi tsitre le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe.”

translation_verse: Afi si nyé mekuna le o, eye dzo hã metsina o.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to his home in Capernaum. After they were inside the house, Jesus asked them, “What were you arguing about along the way?”
translation_verse: Wova Kapernaum, eye esi wòge ɖe aƒeme la, Yesu bia eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Nu ka ŋue mienɔ ɖi kem le, le mɔ dzi?”

english_verse: They had been arguing about which one of them was the greatest, and so they did not answer.
translation_verse: Ke woawo zi kpi, elabe wonɔ nya ʋlim le wo nɔewo dome le mɔa dzi le ame si nye ame vevitɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down and told the twelve disciples to gather around him, he said, “If you want the place of honor, you must become a slave and serve others!”
translation_verse: Yesu bɔbɔ nɔ anyi, yɔ ame wui eveawo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Ame si ke di be yeaxɔ nɔƒe gbãtɔ la, ele nɛ be wòanye amewo katã ƒe mlɔetɔ kple woƒe subɔla.”

english_verse: Salt is good. But if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made salty again? Have salt among you and live at peace with each other.
translation_verse: Dze la, nu nyui wònye. Ke ne nu si wɔe wònye dze la do le eme la, nane li miatsɔ adee wòaganye dzea? Mina dze naɖo mi, eye minɔ ŋutifafa me kple mia nɔewo.”

english_verse: John said, “Teacher, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But he wasn't one of us, and we told him to stop.”
translation_verse: Yohanes gblɔ na Yesu be: “Nufiala, míekpɔ ame aɖe si le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo nyàm do goe le wò ŋkɔ me, eye míegbe nɛ, elabe mele mía yome o.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: Don't stop him! No one who works miracles in my name will soon turn and say something bad about me.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ be: “Migagbe nɛ o, elabe ame aɖeke meli, si awɔ ŋusẽdɔ le nye ŋkɔ me, eye le eya megbe kasia wòate ŋu agblɔ nya vɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Anyone who isn't against us is for us.
translation_verse: Ame si ke metsi tre ɖe mía ŋu o la, mía dzi wòle.

translation_verse: Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be, ne ame aɖe ana tsi kplu ɖeka mi be miano, le esi Kristo ŋkɔ le mia ŋuti ta la, axɔ eŋuti teƒeɖoɖo godoo.” Amehehe de nuvɔ̃ me (Mat

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks.
translation_verse: “Ame si ke akplɔ ɖevi sue, siwo xɔ dzinye se la dometɔ aɖe ade nuvɔ̃ me la, ne wotsɔ té gã aɖe tsi ɖe kɔ nɛ, eye wotsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu me la, enyo nɛ wu.

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, get rid of it. You would be better off to go into God's kingdom with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Ne wò ŋku hea wò dea nuvɔ̃ me la, hoe le eto me. Enyo na wò be nàyi ɖe mawufiaɖuƒe la me kple ŋku ɖeka, wu be ŋku eve nanɔ ŋuwò, gake woatsɔ wò aƒu gbe ɖe dzo mavɔ me.

english_verse: After Jesus left, he went to Judea and then on to the other side of the Jordan River. Once again large crowds came to him, and as usual, he taught them.
translation_verse: Yesu dzo le afi ma yi Yudea-nutowo me kple Yordan godo. Ameha gaƒo ƒu ɖe eŋu, eye wògafia nu wo abe ale si wòwɔna la ene.

english_verse: A woman who divorces her husband and marries again is also unfaithful.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne nyɔnu gbe srɔ̃a, eye wòɖe ŋutsu bubu la, eya hã wɔ ahasi.” Yesu yra ɖevi suewo (Mat

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. So they came up to him and asked if it was right for a man to divorce his wife.
translation_verse: Farisitɔ aɖewo va le etem kpɔ hebiae be: “Woɖe mɔ be ŋutsu nagbe srɔ̃a?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What does the Law of Moses say about this?”
translation_verse: Yesu bia wo be: “Se kae Mose de na mi?”

english_verse: They answered, “Moses allows a man to write out divorce papers and send his wife away.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be: “Mose ɖe mɔ be ŋutsu naŋlɔ srɔ̃gbegbalẽ, ekema wòaɖe asi le srɔ̃a ŋu.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Moses gave you this law because you are so heartless.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Miaƒe tosesẽ tae Mose ŋlɔ se sia na mi ɖo.

english_verse: But in the beginning God made a man and a woman.
translation_verse: Tso xexeme ƒe gɔmedzedze me ke la, atsu kple asi Mawu wɔ.

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame agblẽ tɔ́a kple nɔa ɖi, alé ɖe srɔ̃a ŋu.

english_verse: He becomes like one person with his wife. Then they are no longer two people, but one.
translation_verse: Wo kple eve la woazu ame ɖeka, elabe tso esia dzi yina la, womeganye ame eve o, ke boŋ wozu ɖeka.

english_verse: And no one should separate a couple that God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Eya ta nu si Mawu bla ɖekae la, migana ame nama eme o.”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were back in the house, they asked him about what he had said.
translation_verse: Esi wotrɔ va aƒeme la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gabia nu le nya sia ŋuti.

english_verse: He told them, “A man who divorces his wife and marries someone else is unfaithful to his wife.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ne ame aɖe agbe srɔ̃a nyɔnu, eye wòaɖe bubu la, ewɔ ahasi ɖe eyama ŋuti.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus so he could bless them by placing his hands on them. But his disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo kplɔ ɖeviwo gbɔna Yesu gbɔ, be wòada asi ɖe wo dzi, ke eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo he nya ɖe ameawo ŋu.

english_verse: I promise you that you cannot get into God's kingdom, unless you accept it the way a child does.”
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi le nyateƒe me be ame si ke mexɔ Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu, abe ɖevi ene o la, mage ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me o.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw this, he became angry and said, “Let the children come to me! Don't try to stop them. People who are like these little children belong to the kingdom of God.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kpɔe la, edo dziku, eye wògblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Mina ɖeviawo nava gbɔnye; migaxe mɔ na wo o, elabe ame siawo ƒomevi tɔe nye mawufiaɖuƒe la.

english_verse: Jesus looked closely at the man. He liked him and said, “There's one thing you still need to do. Go sell everything you own. Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come with me.”
translation_verse: Yesu fɔ mo dzi kpɔe, hegblɔ nɛ be: “Nu ɖeka susɔ na wò; heyi nàdzra nu si le asiwò, eye nàtsɔ ga la na ame dahewo, ekema kesinɔnu anɔ dziƒo na wò, ne nàva nɔ yonyeme.”

english_verse: When the man heard Jesus say this, he went away gloomy and sad because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Esi ŋutsua se nya siawo la, eƒe mo da tu, eye wòdzo kple nuxaxa, elabe nu geɖe le esi.

english_verse: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “It's hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu tsa ŋku godoo hegblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Esesẽ ŋutɔ vavã na ame siwo nye kesinɔtɔwo la be woage ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu te!”

english_verse: The disciples were shocked to hear this. So Jesus told them again, “It's terribly hard to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Esi nusrɔ̃laawo se nya siawo la, wotsi yaa; ke Yesu yi edzi gblɔ na wo be: “Vinyewo, asesẽ ŋutɔ na ame siwo ɖoa dzi ɖe kesinɔnuwo ŋu la, be woage ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la me!

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ele bɔbɔe na kposɔ be wòato abui ƒe vo me wu, be kesinɔtɔ nage ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la me.”

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were even more amazed. They asked each other, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Nya siawo wɔ nuku na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋutɔŋutɔ, eye wobia wo nɔewo be: “Ekema ame ka gɔ̃e woate ŋu axɔ ɖe agbe?”

english_verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Yesu kpɔ wo dũu, eye wògblɔ be: “Amegbetɔwo gbɔ la, esia mate ŋu ava eme o, ke mele nenema le Mawu ya gbɔ o, elabe Mawu ya te ŋu wɔa nu sia nu.”

english_verse: The disciples were confused as Jesus led them toward Jerusalem, and his other followers were afraid. Once again, Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and told them what was going to happen to him. He said:
translation_verse: Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dze mɔ yina Yerusalem azɔ. Yesu dze wo ŋgɔ, eye esia wɔ mo yaa na wo; ame siwo dze wo yome la le vɔvɔ̃m. Egayɔ nusrɔ̃la wui eveawo va eɖokui gbɔ, eye wògade asi nu siwo le dzɔdzɔ ge ɖe edzi la gbɔgblɔ me na wo be:

english_verse: We are now on our way to Jerusalem where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses. They will sentence him to death and hand him over to foreigners,
translation_verse: “Miɖo to ne miasee ɖa! Míeyina Yerusalem; woatsɔ Amegbetɔ Vi la ade asi na nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo; woatso kufia nɛ, eye woadee asi na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la.

english_verse: Jesus asked them what they wanted,
translation_verse: Ebia wo be: “Nu ka dim miele be mawɔ na mi?”

english_verse: and they answered, “When you come into your glory, please let one of us sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Ne èɖo wò ŋutikɔkɔe me la, nàna be mía dometɔ ɖeka nabɔbɔ nɔ wò ɖusime, eye evelia nanɔ wò miame.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “You don't really know what you're asking! Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from or be baptized as I must be baptized?”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Mienya nu si biam miele la o. Ɖe miate ŋu ano nu le veve ƒe kplu si nu mele nu no ge le la, alo axɔ mawutsilele si woale nam la?”

english_verse: “Yes, we are!” James and John answered. Then Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from the cup from which I must drink. And you will be baptized just as I must!
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Míate ŋui.” Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Miano nu le kplu si nu mele nu no ge le; mawutsi, si woale nam la, woalee na miawo hã ya.

english_verse: But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for God to decide.”
translation_verse: Gake be mianɔ anyi ɖe nye ɖusime alo miame la, eya menye nyee aɖe mɔ le eŋuti o. Ame siwo wodzrae ɖo ɖi na la tɔ wònye.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with James and John.
translation_verse: Esi ame ewoawo se Yakobo kple Yohanes ƒe biabia la la, wodo dziku ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know that those foreigners who call themselves kings like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over the people they rule.
translation_verse: Yesu yɔ wo va eɖokui gbɔ gblɔ na wo be: “Mienyae be ame siwo wobuna be wonye tatɔwo na trɔ̃subɔlawo la ɖua amegã ɖe wo dzi, eye woƒe kplɔlawo kpɔa ŋusẽ blibo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to Jericho. And as they were leaving, they were followed by a large crowd. A blind beggar by the name of Bartimaeus son of Timaeus was sitting beside the road.
translation_verse: Wova ɖo Yerixo. Esi Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kpakple ameha gã aɖe dzo le Yerixo-dua me yina la, Bartimeo, Timeo vi, si nye nubiala ŋkuagbãtɔ la, nɔ anyi ɖe mɔ to.

english_verse: When he heard that it was Jesus from Nazareth, he shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Esi wòse be Yesu Nazaretetɔ lae va yina la, ede asi ɣlidodo me be: “Yesu, David Vi, kpɔ nublanui nam!”

english_verse: Many people told the man to stop, but he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo nyra ɖee be nezi ɖoɖoe. Ke eya do ɣli sesĩe ɖe edzi wu be: “David Vi lee, kpɔ nublanui nam dzro!”

english_verse: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him over!” They called out to the blind man and said, “Don't be afraid! Come on! He is calling for you.”
translation_verse: Yesu tɔ hegblɔ be: “Miyɔe ɖa.” Woyɔ ŋkuagbãtɔ la, gblɔ nɛ be: “Wò dzi nedze eme. Tso va; ele yɔwòm.”

english_verse: The man threw off his coat as he jumped up and ran to Jesus.
translation_verse: Eɖe asi le dziwui si le eŋu la ŋu ƒu gbe, eye wòti kpo va Yesu gbɔ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man answered, “Master, I want to see!”
translation_verse: Yesu biae be: “Nu ka nèdi be mawɔ na ye?” Ŋkuagbãtɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: “Nufiala, na makpɔ nu.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “You may go. Your eyes are healed because of your faith.” At once the man could see, and he went down the road with Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Heyi; wò xɔse da gbe le ŋuwò.” Enumake ŋkuagbãtɔ la ƒe ŋku ʋu, eye wòdze Yesu yome le mɔa dzi.

translation_verse: Esi Yesu ɖo Yerusalem la, ege ɖe mawuƒe la me. Etsa ŋku godoo, lé ŋku ɖe nu sia nu ŋu, eye esi fiẽsi ɖo vɔ ta la, eya kple ame wui eveawo dzo yi Betania. Yesu ƒo fi de gboti la (Mat

translation_verse: Esi fiẽ wɔ la, wodo go le dua me. Nufiafia le gboti la ŋuti (Mat

translation_verse: Wotɔ gbee be: “Ŋusẽ ka dzi nèto le nu siawo wɔm; alo ame kae na ŋusẽ wò be nàwɔ nu siawo?”

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, say, ‘The Lord needs it and will soon bring it back.’ ”
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe bia mi be, ‘Nu ka ta miele ka ɖemee?’ mahã la, migblɔ nɛ be: ‘Aƒetɔ lae le ehiãm,’ ekema aɖoe ɖa enumake.”

english_verse: The disciples left and found the donkey tied near a door that faced the street. While they were untying it,
translation_verse: Ale wodzo yi, eye wokpɔ tedzivi aɖe le ka me le kpɔnu le mɔ to, eye wotu kae.

english_verse: They told them what Jesus had said, and the people let them take it.
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu na wo abe ale si Yesu gblɔ na wo la ene. Tete woɖe mɔ le eŋu na wo.

english_verse: The disciples led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back, and Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Esi wokplɔ tedzivia vɛ na Yesu la, wotsɔ woƒe avɔwo ɖo ɖe edzi, eye Yesu nɔ edzi.

english_verse: In front of Jesus and behind him, people went along shouting, “Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
translation_verse: Tete ame siwo le Yesu ŋgɔ kple esiwo le eyome la de asi ɣlidodo me le gbɔgblɔm be: “Aƒetɔ, ɖe mí loo! Woyra ame si gbɔna le Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ me!

english_verse: God bless the coming kingdom of our ancestor David. Hooray for God in heaven above!”
translation_verse: Woyra mía tɔ́ David ƒe dziɖuɖu si gbɔna la. Ɖeɖe wònye tso Mawu gbɔ ke!”

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses heard what Jesus said, and they started looking for a way to kill him. They were afraid of him, because the crowds were completely amazed at his teaching.
translation_verse: Nya sia ɖo nunɔlagãwo kple agbalẽfialawo gbɔ, eye wodi mɔnu be yewoawui le vɔvɔ̃ nɛ ta, elabe eƒe nufiafia wɔ mo yaa na ameha blibo la.

english_verse: So Jesus said to the tree, “Never again will anyone eat fruit from this tree!” The disciples heard him say this. Jesus in the Temple (Matthew
