english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: Elabe ekpɔ nublanui na eƒe kosi maɖinu la. Tso esia dzi heyina la, dzidzime ɖe sia ɖe abum yayramee.

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: Elabe Ŋusẽtɔ la wɔ nu dzɔtsuwo nam. Eŋkɔ ŋuti nakɔ!

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Ekpɔa nublanui na ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Eɖe eƒe ŋusẽ fia; ekaka dàdalawo kple woƒe tamesusuwo hlẽ.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: Etu asi ŋusẽtɔwo ƒu anyi tso woƒe fiazikpuiwo dzi, eye wòdo ame maɖinuwo ɖe dzi.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: Ena nu nyui dɔwuitɔwo ɖu ɖi ƒo, eye wòna kesinɔtɔwo dzo yi kple dɔmeɣi.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋku edzi ve eƒe dɔla Israel nu, eye wòkpe ɖe eŋu,

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: abe ale si wòdo ŋugbe na mía tɔgbui Abraham kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo, be yeawɔ na wo tegbee la ene.”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Maria tsi Elizabet gbɔ abe ɣleti etɔ̃ ene, eye wòtrɔ yi aƒe. Yohanes mawutsilenamela dzidzi

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Esi Elizabet ƒe ɣeyiɣi de la, edzi ŋutsuvi.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Eƒe aƒelikawo kple ƒometɔwo se be Aƒetɔ la ve enu geɖe ŋutɔ, eye wokpɔ dzidzɔ kplii.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke enyia gbe la, wova be woatso aʋa na ɖevia, eye wodi be yewoatsɔ Zaxarya, si nye tɔ́a ƒe ŋkɔ la, nɛ.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Ke nɔa gblɔ be: “Ao! Woayɔe be Yohanes boŋ.”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Wò ƒometɔ aɖeke metsɔ ŋkɔ sia kpɔ o ɖe!”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Tete wowɔ dzesi bia tɔ́a Zaxarya be ŋkɔ ka wòdi be woatsɔ na ɖevia mahã.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Zaxarya bia be woatsɔ nuŋlɔkpe na ye, eye wòŋlɔ ɖe edzi be: “Eŋkɔe nye Yohanes.” Ameawo katã ƒe mo wɔ yaa.

english_verse: At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.
translation_verse: Enumake Zaxarya ƒe nu ʋu, eƒe aɖeka ɖɔ ɖo, eye wòƒo nu kafu Mawu.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo eƒe aƒelikawo katã. Amewo ƒo nu le nya siawo ŋuti hoo le Yudea-tonyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã see la bu eŋuti hegblɔ be: “Nu ka gɔ̃ ɖevi sia ava zu? Elabe Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋku le eŋu.” Zaxarya ƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe Mawu ƒe gbedeasi

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔ Yohanes tɔ́, Zaxarya taŋ, eye wòɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi be:

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Woakafu Aƒetɔ Israel ƒe Mawu la, elabe eva kpɔ eƒe dukɔa ɖa, eye wòxɔe ɖe agbe.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: Ena Xɔla ŋusẽtɔ do na mí tso eƒe dɔla David ƒe ƒomea me.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Mawu do ŋugbe to eƒe blemagbeƒãɖela kɔkɔeawo dzi,

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: be woaɖe mí tso míaƒe ketɔwo kple ame siwo lé fu mí la si me.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: Ebe yeave mía nu, abe ale si yedo ŋugbe na mía tɔgbuiwo la ene, eye yeaɖo ŋku yeƒe nubabla kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: He told our ancestor Abraham
translation_verse: Awɔ atam si wòka na mía tɔgbui Abraham la dzi,

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: be yeana woaɖe mí tso míaƒe futɔwo si me, bene míasubɔ ye vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee.

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: Mía ŋuti nakɔ, eye míawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe le eŋkume, le míaƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Ke vinye, woayɔ wò be Mawu Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe gbeƒãɖela. Elabe ànɔ Aƒetɔ la ŋgɔ, adzra eƒe toƒe ɖo.

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Àna eƒe dukɔmeviwo nadze sii be woxɔ yewo ɖe agbe, eye wotsɔ yewoƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke yewo.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la lɔ̃ mí, ale be ŋu ake na mí tso dziƒo ke.

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: Kekeli aklẽ na ame siwo le viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me kple ame siwo le ku ƒe ŋusẽ te la, eye wòakplɔ mí ayi ŋutifafa mee.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɖevi la va tsi, eye wòkpɔ ŋusẽ le gbɔgbɔ me. Enɔ gbedadaƒo va se ɖe esime woɖee fia Israel-dukɔ la.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke mawo me la, Roma Fiagã Augusto ɖe gbe be woaxlẽ ame siwo katã le xexea me, aŋlɔ woƒe agbɔsɔsɔ ɖi.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Ŋutsu aɖe nɔ Yerusalem le ŋkeke mawo me. Eŋkɔe nye Simeon. Enye ame dzɔdzɔe si subɔa Mawu ŋutɔ. Ame sia nɔ mɔ kpɔm na ɣeyiɣi si me Mawu afa akɔ na Israel la. Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la le eyama dzi.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Wowɔ amexexlẽ gbãtɔ sia, esime Kirenio nye mɔ́mefia le Siria.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame yi wo de be woaxlẽ ye aŋlɔ ɖi.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Ale Yosef hã tso le Nazarete-dua me le Galilea, yi Yudea, ɖe David ƒe du si woyɔna be Betlehem la me. Yosef yi afi ma, elabe David ƒe dzidzimevi wònye.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Eya kple Maria, eƒe ŋugbetɔ si nye funɔ lae yi be woaxlẽ yewo.

english_verse: and while they were there,
translation_verse: Esi wole afi ma la, Maria ƒe vidziɣi ɖo.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: Edzi ŋutsuvi si nye eƒe ŋgɔgbevi. Exatsa avɔ ɖe eŋu hetsɔe mlɔ afi si wodaa lãwo ƒe nuɖuɖu ɖo la, elabe womekpɔ teƒe le amedzrodzeƒe la o. Alẽkplɔlawo kple mawudɔlawo

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Alẽkplɔla aɖewo nɔ gbedzi le nuto ma me le zã me nɔ woƒe alẽha ŋuti dzɔm.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔla do ɖe wo dzi, eye Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe klẽ ƒo xlã wo. Wovɔ̃ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Ke mawudɔla la gblɔ na wo be: “Migavɔ̃ o! Mikpɔ ɖa, mele gbeƒã ɖem dzidzɔnya gã aɖe na miawo kple amewo katã.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Wodzi Xɔla si nye Kristo Aƒetɔ la na mi le David-dua me egbe.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Nu si anye dzesi na mie nye be miakpɔ vidzĩ si ŋu woxatsa avɔ ɖo, wòmlɔ afi si wodaa lãwo ƒe nuɖuɖu ɖo la.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Enumake dziƒoʋakɔ gã aɖe va kpe ɖe mawudɔla la ŋuti le Mawu kafum le gbɔgblɔm be:

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: “Ŋutikɔkɔe woana Mawu le dziƒo boo! Ŋutifafa neva ame siwo ŋu Mawu kpɔa ŋudzedze le le anyigba dzi la dome.”

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Esi mawudɔlaawo dzo le wo gbɔ yi dziƒo la, alẽkplɔlaawo gblɔ na wo nɔewo be: “Mina míayi Betlehem aɖakpɔ nu sia, si dzɔ, si Aƒetɔ la na míenya la ɖa.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Ale woɖe abla yi, eye woɖakpɔ Maria, Yosef kple vidzĩ, si mlɔ lãwo ƒe nuɖuɖudaɖoƒe la.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Esi wokpɔe la, woƒo nu le nya si wogblɔ na wo tso ɖevia ŋuti la na amewo.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Maria lé nya siawo katã ɖe tame henɔ wo ŋuti bum.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Alẽkplɔlawo trɔ dzo, eye wonɔ Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ dom ɖe dzi, nɔ ekafum elabe wokpɔ nu si wose tso mawudɔlawo gbɔ la wòle eme tututu. Wotsɔ ŋkɔ na Yesu

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Esi ŋkeke enyia de be woatso aʋa na ɖevia la, wotsɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Yesu. Ŋkɔ siae mawudɔla yɔ da ɖi be woatsɔ nɛ, hafi wofɔ eƒe fu. Wotsɔ Yesu va mawuxɔ me

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Esi ɣeyiɣi si wòle be woakɔ wo ŋuti le Mose ƒe sea nu la ɖo edzi la, wotsɔ Yesu yi ɖe Yerusalem be yewoatsɔe aɖo Aƒetɔ la ŋkume.

english_verse: just as the Law of the Lord says, “Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Woŋlɔe ɖi le Aƒetɔ la ƒe sea me be: “Atsu sia atsu si ʋu dɔ nu la woaɖoe ɖi wòanye nu kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ la.”

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: Ale woyi Yerusalem be yewoasa vɔ, abe ale si Aƒetɔ la ƒe sea bia ene. Akpakpa eve alo ahɔnɛvi eve wotsɔna saa vɔ siae.

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Eɖee fiae be maku o, va se ɖe esime wòakpɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe Kristo la.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la na wòva ge ɖe mawuxɔa me. Esi Yesu dzilawo va ɖo kple ɖevia, bene yewoawɔ kɔnua nɛ le sea nu la,

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: Simeon xɔe ɖe eƒe abɔwo dome hekafu Mawu gblɔ be:

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ, do mɔ nye, wò dɔla azɔ, ne madzo le ŋutifafa me, elabe èwɔ wò ŋugbedodo la dzi nam.

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: si nèdzra ɖo na dukɔwo katã la kple nye ŋku.

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: Xɔxɔ sia nye kekeli si ɖe wò lɔlɔ̃nu fia ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, eye wòhe ŋutikɔkɔe vɛ na wò dukɔ Israel.”

english_verse: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.
translation_verse: Nya siwo Simeon gblɔ le ɖevia ŋuti la wɔ mo yaa na tɔ́a kple nɔa.

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Simeon yra wo, eye wògblɔ na nɔa, Maria be: “Kpɔ ɖa, woɖoe ɖi be, to ɖevi sia dzi la, ame geɖe adze anyi, eye ame geɖe hã afɔ ɖe tsitre le Israel. Wogaɖoe ɖi hã be anye dzesi, si ŋu amewo aƒo nu atsi tre ɖo,

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: bene ame geɖewo ƒe dzimesusu nadze. Wò hã la, vevesese aƒo ɖe wò dzi, abe adekpui ɖaɖɛ ene.”

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu aɖe, si nye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela la hã nɔ anyi. Eŋkɔe nye Hana, eye wònye Fanuel vinyɔnu tso Aser ƒomea me. Eya kple srɔ̃a wonɔ agbe ƒe adrẽ le srɔ̃ɖeɖe vɔ megbe.

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Eya hã va ɖo le gaƒoƒo ma ke dzi, eye wòda akpe na Mawu heƒo nu tso ɖevia ŋuti na ame siwo le mɔkpɔkpɔ me be Mawu aɖe Yerusalem la. Tɔtrɔ yi Nazaret

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Esi Yosef kple Maria wɔ nu sia nu ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe sea nu vɔ la, wotrɔ yi woawo ŋutɔ ƒe du, Nazaret si le Galilea-nyigba dzi la me.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Yesu, ɖevi la tsi ɖe edzi, eye wòkpɔ ŋusẽ. Eyɔ fũu kple nunya, eye Mawu ƒe amenuveve nɔ edzi. Yesu le mawuxɔ me

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu dzilawo yia Yerusalem ƒè sia ƒè ɖaɖua Pasla la.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu xɔ ƒè wui eve la, eya hã yi Yerusalem kple edzilawo le ŋkekenyuia ƒe kɔa nu.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Esi woɖu ŋkekenyuia vɔ la, Yesu dzilawo trɔ ɖo ta aƒe, ke Yesu ya tsi Yerusalem, woawo menya o.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Wobu be ele ameha la dome, eya ta wozɔ ŋkeke ɖeka ƒe mɔ, dii le woƒe ƒometɔwo kple ame nyanyɛwo dome.

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke etɔ̃ megbe la, wova ke ɖe eŋu le mawuxɔa me. Ebɔbɔ nɔ nufialawo dome, nɔ to ɖom, eye wònɔ nya biam wo.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã se eƒe nyawo la ƒe mo wɔ yaa le eƒe nugɔmesese kple nyaŋuɖoɖo ŋu.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu dzilawo kpɔe la, wotsi yaa. Nɔa biae be: “Vinye, nu kae nye esi nèwɔ ɖe mía ŋuti ale? Kpɔ ɖa, nye kple tɔ́wò míetsi dzi di wò ʋuu kple ŋkubiã.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ale ke wɔ miedim? Ɖe mienya be ele nam be manɔ Tɔ́nye ƒeme oa?”

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Ke edzilawo mese nya si wògblɔ na wo la gɔme o.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Yesu gbɔ va Nazaret kple edzilawo, eye wòɖo to wo. Nɔa lé nya siawo katã ɖe tame.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Yesu tsi ɖe edzi. Eƒe nunya hã dzi ɖe edzi, eye Mawu kple amewo siaa kpɔ ŋudzedze le eŋu.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Nudzɔlawo hã va be woale mawutsi na yewo. Wobia Yohanes be: “Nufiala, nu ka wòle be míawɔ?”

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, miwɔ nu si fia be mietrɔ dzime tso miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me. Miganɔ gbɔgblɔm na mia ɖokui be Abraham ye nye yewo tɔ́ o, elabe mele egblɔm na mi be Mawu ate ŋu ana viwo nado tso kpe siawo me na Abraham.

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Eka mo na dziɖula Herodes, elabe exɔ nɔvia srɔ̃, Herodia, ɖe, eye wòwɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi bubu geɖewo hã.

english_verse: Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests. At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert.
translation_verse: Hana kple Kayafa nye nunɔlagãwo. Ƒe sia mee Mawu ƒe gbedeasi va na Yohanes, Zaxarya vi, le gbedadaƒo.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya ƒe agbalẽ me be: “Ame aɖe le ɣli dom le gbedadaƒo. Ebe, ‘Midzra Aƒetɔ la ƒe mɔa ɖo! Midzɔ eƒe afɔmɔwo.

english_verse: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.
translation_verse: Woaku nu axe ʋe sia ʋe, eye woagbã to kple togbɛ ɖe sia ɖe ɖe anyi. Woadzɔ afi siwo glɔ̃ la, eye woawɔ teƒe tsakliwo woazrɔ̃.

english_verse: Then everyone will see the saving power of God.’ ”
translation_verse: Amegbetɔƒome blibo la lakpɔ Mawu ƒe xɔxɔ la!’ ”

translation_verse: Amehawo bia Yohanes be: “Ekema nu ka míawɔ?”

english_verse: Some soldiers asked him, “And what about us? What do we have to do?” John told them, “Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.”
translation_verse: Asrafowo hã biae be: “Míawo hã ɖe, nu ka wòle be míawɔ?” Yohanes ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Migado ŋɔdzi na ame aɖeke axɔ nu le esi sesẽtɔe o. Migatso ame aɖeke nu alakpatɔe o, eye mina miaƒe fetu nadze mia ŋu!”

english_verse: John said, “I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
translation_verse: Yohanes ʋu eme na wo katã gblɔ be: “Nye la, tsie metsɔ le mawutsi lem na mi, ke ame si tri akɔ wum la gbɔna. Nyemedze atu eƒe afɔkpaka gɔ̃ hã o. Eya latsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe kple dzo ale mawutsi na mi.

translation_verse: Yohanes tsɔ nuxlɔ̃amenya bubu geɖewo ɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la na amewo.

translation_verse: eye Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la le ahɔnɛ ƒe nɔnɔme me ɖi ɖe Yesu dzi. Gbe ɖi tso dziƒo be: “Wòe nye vinye lɔlɔ̃a; mekpɔ ŋudzedze le ŋuwò.” Yesu ƒe dzidzimexexlẽfia (Mat

translation_verse: Efia nu le woƒe ƒuƒoƒewo, eye ame sia ame kafui. Wogbe Yesu le Nazaret (Mat

translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ la ƒe Gbɔgbɔ le dzinye, elabe esi ami nam, be magblɔ Nyanyui la na ame dahewo. Edɔm ɖa be maɖe gbeƒã na aboyomenɔlawo, be woɖe wo le ga me; na ŋkunɔwo, be woʋu ŋku na wo; na ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la, be wokpɔ ablɔɖe,

translation_verse: Yesu tu agbalẽ la, eye wòtsɔe de dɔla la si hebɔbɔ nɔ anyi. Ame siwo katã le ƒuƒoƒea fɔ ŋku ɖe edzi dzoɣlii.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Ameawo katã ƒo nu nyui le Yesu ŋuti, eye amenuvenya siwo do go tso eƒe nu me la wɔ nuku na wo. Wobia be, “Menye Yosef vi lae nye esia oa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ɖikeke aɖeke mele eme o be miado lo sia nam be, ‘Dɔyɔla, yɔ dɔ ɖokuiwò’; nu si míese be nèwɔ le Kapernaum-dua me la, wɔe le mia de, afii hã.”

translation_verse: “Medi be mianya nyateƒe sia be ahosi geɖewo nɔ Israel le Eliya ŋɔli, esime ku ɖi ƒe etɔ̃ ɣleti ade, eye dɔ to le anyigba blibo la dzi,

translation_verse: Yesu yi ɖe Kapernaum si nye du aɖe le Galilea-nyigba dzi la me, eye wòfia nu le Dzudzɔgbewo.

english_verse: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.
translation_verse: Eƒe nufiafia wɔ nuku na ameawo, elabe eƒe nyawo fia be ŋusẽ tɔxɛ le esi.

translation_verse: Ame sia ame ƒe nu ku, eye wogblɔ na wo nɔewo be: “Nya kae nye esia? Eblu ɖe gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ta kple ŋusẽ, eye wodo go.”

translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, Yesu dzo yi teƒe ziɖoɖoe aɖe, ke amewo dii va ke ɖe eŋu, eye wodi be wòatsi yewo gbɔ hafi.

translation_verse: Ke egblɔ na wo be: “Ele nam be magblɔ Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu ŋuti Nyanyui la afia le du bubuwo hã me, elabe esia ta wodɔm ɖa ɖo.”

translation_verse: Yesu ge ɖe ʋua ɖeka, si nye Simon tɔ la me, eye wòbia tso esi be wòaku ye ate ɖa tso go ŋui ʋɛ. Yesu bɔbɔ nɔ tɔdziʋua me, eye wòfia nu ameha la.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: Simon ɖo eŋu na Yesu be: “Amegã, míedze agbagba zã blibo la katã, eye míeɖe naneke o; gake maɖi ɖɔ la, le wò nya nu.”

translation_verse: Esi woɖi ɖɔa la, woɖe lã ale gbegbe be woƒe ɖɔawo de asi dzedze me.

translation_verse: Ale womia asi wo tɔ siwo le ʋu kemɛa me la, be woava kpe ɖe yewo ŋu. Wova, eye woɖe lãawo de ʋu eveawo me. Ʋuawo yɔ ale gbegbe be wode asi toyiyi me.

english_verse: His partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were surprised too. Jesus told Simon, “Don't be afraid! From now on you will bring in people instead of fish.”
translation_verse: Nenema ke ewɔ nuku na Yakobo kple Yohanes, Zebedeo vi, siwo nye Simon ƒe hadɔwɔlawo hã. Ke Yesu gblɔ na Simon be: “Mègavɔ̃ o. Tso esia dzi heyina la, amegbetɔwo ɖe ge nàla!”

translation_verse: Esi woku woƒe ʋuawo va ɖi go la, wogblẽ woƒe nuwo katã ɖi, eye wodze eyome. Yesu da gbe le ŋutsu kpodɔlela aɖe ŋu (Mat

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Le ameha la ta, womete ŋu ge ɖe xɔa me o. Eya ta wolia xɔa ta, ɖe mɔ to xɔgbakpeawo dome, heɖiɖi amea kple eƒe aba ɖe Yesu gbɔ le ameawo dome.

translation_verse: Tete agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo de asi wo nɔewo biabia me be: “Ame kae nye esi le busunya sia gblɔm? Ame aɖeke mate ŋu atsɔ nuvɔ̃ ake o, negbe Mawu ko!”

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Nya siawo dometɔ ka gbɔgblɔe le bɔbɔe wu: ‘Wotsɔ wò nuvɔ̃wo ke wò’ loo, alo ‘Tsi tre nàzɔ azɔli?’

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”
translation_verse: Be mianya be ŋusẽ le Amegbetɔ Vi la si le anyigba dzi be wòatsɔ nuvɔ̃ ake ta la,” egblɔ na lãmetututɔ la be: “Mebe tsi tsitre, ŋlɔ wò aba, ne nàyi aƒeme!”

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Enumake ŋutsua tsi tsitre le wo ŋkume, kɔ nu si dzi wòmlɔ la, eye wòdzo yi aƒeme, hele Mawu kafum.

translation_verse: Kuvia kple vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo katã, eye wokafu Mawu gblɔ be: “Nu siwo míekpɔ egbe wɔ nuku loo!” Yesu yɔ Levi (Mat

translation_verse: Ale Farisitɔwo kple woƒe agbalẽfialawo lĩ liʋiliʋĩ hebia Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Nu ka tae mieɖua nu, eye mienoa nu kple nudzɔlawo kpakple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo?”

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo gblɔ na Yesu be: “Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo tsia nu dɔna edziedzi, hedoa gbe ɖa. Farisitɔwo ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo hã wɔna nenema ke. Ke wò nusrɔ̃lawo ya ɖua nu, eye wonoa nu ɖaa.”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.
translation_verse: Yesu bia wo be: “Ɖe miate ŋu ana ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la xɔlɔ̃wo atsi nu adɔ, esime ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la le wo gbɔa?

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Yesu do lo aɖe hã na wo be: “Ame aɖeke medzea eƒe awu yeye be yeatsɔ aka awu xoxoe o. Ne ewɔe la, avuvu awu yeye la. Gawu la, awu yeye kakɛ la masɔ kple awu xoxo la o.

translation_verse: Nenema ke ame aɖeke metsɔa wain yeye dea lãgbalẽgolo xoxo me o. Ne ewɔe la, wain yeye la awó lãgbalẽgoloa, aha la ŋutɔ aƒu gbe, eye lãgbalẽgoloa hã agblẽ.

english_verse: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.
translation_verse: Eya ta ele be woatsɔ wain yeye ade lãgbalẽgolo yeye me.

translation_verse: Gawu la, ame aɖeke menoa wain xoxo vɔ, gadia yeyea o; elabe egblɔna be, ‘Xoxoa nyo wu.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Mitso aseye, eye miti kpo kple dzidzɔ gbe ma gbe. Fetu sɔgbɔ le dziƒo na mi, elabe alea kee wo tɔgbuiwo wɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo hã ŋu va yi.

english_verse: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.
translation_verse: Mibia yayra na ame siwo ƒoa fi dea mi, eye mido gbe ɖa ɖe ame siwo dzua mi la ta.

translation_verse: Ke ameawo dze agbo ŋutɔ, eye wode adaŋu le wo nɔewo dome le nu si woawɔ Yesu ŋuti. Yesu tia amedɔdɔ wui eveawo (Mat

translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, eyɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo vɛ, eye wòtia ame wui eve tso wo dome. Ena ŋkɔwo be amedɔdɔwo.

english_verse: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all. Blessings and Troubles (Matthew
translation_verse: Ame sia ame di be yeaka asi Yesu ŋu. Yayra vavãtɔ kple konyifafa (Mat

english_verse: You well-fed people are in for trouble. You will go hungry! You people who are laughing now are in for trouble. You are going to cry and weep!
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo ɖi ƒo fifia, baba na mi, elabe dɔ le mia wu ge. Mi ame siwo le nu kom fifia, baba na mi, elabe miele konyi fa ge, afa avi.

english_verse: These people had come to listen to Jesus and to be healed of their diseases. All who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.
translation_verse: Amewo tso Yudea kple Yerusalem, Tiro kple Sidon ƒuta nutowo katã me va be yewoase Yesu ƒe nya, eye be wòada gbe le yewo ŋu. Ame siwo gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo le fu ɖem na la hã nɔ wo dome va, eye Yesu da gbe le wo ŋu.

english_verse: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!
translation_verse: Woyra mi ame siwo dɔ le wuwum fifia la, elabe miaɖi ƒo! Woyra mi ame siwo le avi fam fifia la, elabe miako nu!

english_verse: God will bless you when others hate you and won't have anything to do with you. God will bless you when people insult you and say cruel things about you, all because you are a follower of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Woyra mi ne amewo lé fu mi, ne woɖe mi le woƒe ha me, ne wodzu mi, eye woƒo nuvɔ̃ le mia ŋu le Amegbetɔ Vi la ta.

english_verse: You are in for trouble when everyone says good things about you. That is what your own people said about those prophets who told lies. Love for Enemies (Matthew
translation_verse: Baba na mi, ne amewo katã ƒo nu nyui le mia ŋu, elabe nenema kee wo tɔ́wo kafu aʋatsogbeƒãɖelawoe va yi.” Nufiafia le ketɔwo lɔlɔ̃ ŋuti (Mat

english_verse: If you give to others, you will be given a full amount in return. It will be packed down, shaken together, and spilling over into your lap. The way you treat others is the way you will be treated.
translation_verse: Mina nu ame, ekema Mawu hã ana nu mi. Nudzidzenu nyui, si woʋuʋu, hetee, wòyɔ gbagba lae woatsɔ adoe akɔ ɖe nu me na mi. Elabe nudzidzenu si mietsɔ dzidze nui na amewo la, eya kee Mawu atsɔ adzidze nui na mi.”

english_verse: is like someone who dug down deep and built a house on solid rock. When a flood came and the river rushed against the house, it was built so well that it didn't even shake.
translation_verse: Eɖi ame aɖe, si di be yeatu xɔ. Eɖe do wògoglo, eye wòɖo xɔa gɔme anyi ɖe kpe dzi. Tɔ ɖɔ, eye ahom tu va lɔ xɔ la, ke memu o, elabe wotui nyuie.

english_verse: If someone slaps you on one cheek, don't stop that person from slapping you on the other cheek. If someone wants to take your coat, don't try to keep back your shirt.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒo to me na wò la, trɔ evelia hã nɛ. Ame si xɔ wò awu ʋlaya le asiwò la, tsɔ wò dziwui hã nɛ.

english_verse: Give to everyone who asks and don't ask people to return what they have taken from you.
translation_verse: Na nu ame sia ame si bia nu wò, eye ne ame aɖe tsɔ wò nane la, mègabia eta o.

english_verse: Treat others just as you want to be treated.
translation_verse: Nu si miedina be amewo nawɔ na mi la, miwɔ nu ma ke na woawo hã.

english_verse: If you love only someone who loves you, will God praise you for that? Even sinners love people who love them.
translation_verse: “Ne mielɔ̃ ame siwo lɔ̃ mi ɖeɖe ko la, akpe kae li woada na mi? nuvɔ̃wɔlawo hã lɔ̃a ame siwo lɔ̃a wo ɖe.

english_verse: Have pity on others, just as your Father has pity on you. Judging Others (Matthew
translation_verse: Mizu nublanuikpɔlawo, abe ale si mia Tɔ́ hã nye nublanuikpɔla ene.” Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ame bubuwo (Mat

english_verse: Jesus said: Don't judge others, and God won't judge you. Don't be hard on others, and God won't be hard on you. Forgive others, and God will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Migadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame o, ekema Mawu madrɔ̃ ʋɔnu miawo hã o. Migabu fɔ ame o, ekema Mawu mabu fɔ miawo hã o. Mitsɔ vodada ke, ekema Mawu atsɔ ake miawo hã.

english_verse: Jesus also used some sayings as he spoke to the people. He said: Can one blind person lead another blind person? Won't they both fall into a ditch?
translation_verse: Yesu do lo hã na wo be: “Ɖe ŋkuagbãtɔ ate ŋu akplɔ ŋkuagbãtɔa? Ɖe wo ame eve la mage adze do me oa?

english_verse: Are students better than their teacher? But when they are fully trained, they will be like their teacher.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃vi menyaa nu wua eƒe nufiala o; ne ɖe sia ɖe srɔ̃ nu vɔ la, ɖeko wòanɔ abe eƒe nufiala ene.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Ale ke wɔ nèle ati fefee, si le nɔviwò ƒe ŋku dzi la kpɔm, ke mèbu atikpo si le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi la ŋu o?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: Ale ke lawɔ nàte ŋu agblɔ na nɔviwò be: ‘Nɔvi, na maɖe ati fefee la le ŋku dzi na wò, esi mèle atikpo si le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi ya kpɔm o? Wò alakpatɔ, ɖe atikpoa ɖa le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋku dzi gbã, ekema àkpɔ nu nyuie, ate ŋu aɖe ati fefee la ɖa le ŋku dzi na nɔviwò.” Ati sia ati kple eƒe kutsetse (Mat

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: “Ati nyui aɖeke metsea ku manyomanyo o, eye ati manyomanyo aɖeke hã metsea ku nyui o.

english_verse: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Ati sia ati ƒe kutsetsee wotsɔna dzea si ati si ƒomevi wònye. Womegbea gbo le srẽ dzi o, eye nenema ke womegbea wainkpowo le aŋɔka dzi o.

english_verse: Good people do good things because of the good in their hearts, but bad people do bad things because of the evil in their hearts. Your words show what is in your heart. Two Builders (Matthew
translation_verse: Ame nyui la, nu nyui siwo wòdzra ɖo ɖe eƒe dzime la mee wòɖea nu nyuiwo ɖe go tsonɛ, ke ame vɔ̃ɖi la, nu baɖa siwo wòdzra ɖo ɖe eƒe dzime la mee wòɖea nuvɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe go tsonɛ. Elabe nu si yɔ ame ƒe dzime taŋ lae eƒe nu gblɔna.” Xɔtula eveawo (Mat

english_verse: Why do you keep on saying that I am your Lord, when you refuse to do what I say?
translation_verse: “Nu ka ta miele yɔyem be, ‘Aƒetɔ, Aƒetɔ,’ gake miewɔa nu si megblɔ na mi la o?

english_verse: Anyone who comes and listens to me and obeys me
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si vaa gbɔnye, eye wòsea nye nyawo hewɔa wo dzi la, mafia ame si wòɖi la mi.

english_verse: But anyone who hears what I say and doesn't obey me is like someone whose house wasn't built on solid rock. As soon as the river rushed against that house, it was smashed to pieces!
translation_verse: Ke ame si se nye nyawo, eye mewɔ wo dzi o la, le abe ame aɖe, si tu eƒe xɔ ɖe ke me, eye gɔmeɖoɖo meli nɛ o la ene. Esi tɔ ɖɔ va lɔ xɔa la, emu enumake dze anyi hekaka keŋkeŋ.”

english_verse: I have officers who give orders to me, and I have soldiers who take orders from me. I can say to one of them, ‘Go!’ and he goes. I can say to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes. I can say to my servant, ‘Do this!’ and he will do it.”
translation_verse: Elabe nye hã mele amegãwo te, eye asrafowo le nye hã tenye. Ne megblɔ na ame sia be, ‘Yi!’ la, eyina, eye ne megblɔ na kemɛa be, ‘Va!’ la, evana, eye ne megblɔ na nye dɔla la be, ‘Wɔ esia!’ la, ewɔnɛ.”

english_verse: He loves our nation and even built us a synagogue.”
translation_verse: elabe elɔ̃ míaƒe dukɔ la. Eyae tu míaƒe ƒuƒoƒea na mí.”

english_verse: When the Lord saw the woman, he felt sorry for her and said, “Don't cry!”
translation_verse: Yesu kpɔ ahosi la, eye eƒe nu wɔ nublanui nɛ. Tete wògblɔ nɛ be: “Mègafa avi o.”

english_verse: The leaders went to Jesus and begged him to do something. They said, “This man deserves your help!
translation_verse: Esi amedɔdɔawo va Yesu gbɔ la, woɖe kuku nɛ vevie gblɔ be: “Edze be nàwɔ esia na aʋakplɔla la,

english_verse: Simon answered, “I suppose it would be the one who had owed more and didn't have to pay it back.” “You are right,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Simon ɖo eŋu na Yesu be: “Mebu be anye ame si wòtsɔ ga geɖe kee lae.” Yesu gblɔ na Simon be: “Ebui wòsɔ ɖe edzi pɛ.”

english_verse: And when he heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish leaders to ask him to come and heal the servant.
translation_verse: Esi wòse Yesu ŋkɔ la, edɔ Yudatɔwo ƒe amegãwo ɖo ɖe egbɔ hele ebiam be wòava da gbe le yeƒe dɔla la ŋu.

english_verse: So Jesus went with them. When Jesus wasn't far from the house, the officer sent some friends to tell him, “Lord, don't go to any trouble for me! I am not good enough for you to come into my house.
translation_verse: Yesu yi kpli wo. Esi wògogo aƒea la, aʋakplɔla la dɔ xɔlɔ̃awo ɖo ɖe Yesu gbɔ gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, mègaxaɖe fu na ɖokuiwò o, elabe medzem be nàge ɖe nye aƒeme o,

english_verse: And I am certainly not worthy to come to you. Just say the word, and my servant will get well.
translation_verse: eya ta nyemebu ɖokuinye hã be medze, be mava gbɔwò o. Ke gblɔ nya ɖeka, ne nàna nye dɔla la ƒe lã me nasẽ.

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “In all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu se esia la, ewɔ nuku nɛ, eye wòtrɔ ɖe ameha siwo le eyome la ŋu gblɔ be: “Mele egblɔm na mi be nyemekpɔ xɔse sia tɔgbe le Israel-vidzidzi aɖeke me gɔ̃ hã kpɔ o.”

english_verse: The officer's friends returned and found the servant well. A Widow's Son
translation_verse: Kaka amedɔdɔawo nade aƒea me la, wokpɔ be dɔla la ƒe lã me sẽ. Yesu fɔ ahosi aɖe vi ɖe tsitre

english_verse: As they came near the gate of the town, they saw people carrying out the body of a widow's only son. Many people from the town were walking along with her.
translation_verse: Esi wògogo dua ƒe agbo nu la, wotsɔ ame kuku aɖe do go yina ɖiɖi ge. Enye vi ɖeka hɔ̃ na nɔa, si nye ahosi. Ameha gã aɖe tso dua me nɔ ahosia yome.

english_verse: Jesus went over and touched the stretcher on which the people were carrying the dead boy. They stopped, and Jesus said, “Young man, get up!”
translation_verse: Yesu te va amekukutsɔnu la gbɔ, eye woka asi eŋu. Amekukutsɔlawo tɔ, eye Yesu gblɔ na ame kukua be: “Ɖekakpui, mele egblɔm na wò be fɔ!”

english_verse: The boy sat up and began to speak. Jesus then gave him back to his mother.
translation_verse: Tete ame kukua fɔ bɔbɔ nɔ anyi, hede asi nuƒoƒo me, eye Yesu tsɔe de asi na nɔa.

english_verse: Everyone was frightened and praised God. They said, “A great prophet is here with us! God has come to his people.”
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ lé ameawo katã, eye wokafu Mawu gblɔ be: “Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela triakɔ aɖe va do ɖe mía dome! Mawu ve eƒe dukɔa nu!”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over Judea and everywhere else in that part of the country. John the Baptist (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu ŋu nya sia ɖi hoo le Yudea kple nuto mawo katã me. Amedɔdɔwo tso Yohanes mawutsilenamela gbɔ (Mat

english_verse: John's followers told John everything that was being said about Jesus. So he sent two of them to ask the Lord, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: eye wòdɔ wo ɖo ɖe Aƒetɔ la gbɔ be woabiae be: “Wòe nye ame si wobe ele vava ge loo, alo ame bubue míakpɔ mɔ naa?”

english_verse: When these messengers came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are you the one we should be looking for? Or are we supposed to wait for someone else?’ ”
translation_verse: Esi wova Yesu gbɔ la, wogblɔ nɛ be: “Yohanes mawutsilenamelae dɔ mí ɖe gbɔwò be míabia wò be, ‘Wòe nye ame si wobe ele vava ge loo, alo ame bubue míakpɔ mɔ naa?’ ”

english_verse: At that time Jesus was healing many people who were sick or in pain or were troubled by evil spirits, and he was giving sight to a lot of blind people.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Yesu da gbe le dɔléla geɖewo ŋu. Eda dɔ vɔ̃wo, nya gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do goe, eye wòʋu ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔ geɖewo.

english_verse: Jesus said to the messengers sent by John, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard. Blind people are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People who have leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can now hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Miheyi ɖagblɔ nu siwo miekpɔ kple nu siwo miese la na Yohanes: ŋkuagbãtɔwo le nu kpɔm, tekunɔwo le azɔli zɔm, kpodɔlelawo ŋuti le kɔkɔm, tokunɔwo le nu sem, wole ame kukuwo fɔm ɖe tsitre, eye wole Nyanyui la gblɔm na ame dahewo.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Woyra ame si mekpɔ nuɖiaɖia le ŋunye o.”

english_verse: After John's messengers had gone, Jesus began speaking to the crowds about John: What kind of person did you go out to the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Esi Yohanes ƒe amedɔdɔawo dzo la, Yesu ƒo nu le Yohanes ŋuti na ameha la hebia be: “Nu kae miedo go yi gbedadaƒo be yewoaɖakpɔ? Aƒla si le ya ƒom lae loo?

english_verse: What kind of man did you really go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who wear expensive clothes and live in luxury are in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Nu ka miedo go yi be yewoaɖakpɔ? Sedawu biɖibiɖi dolae loo? Ao. Kpɔ ɖa, ame siwo do sedawu biɖibiɖi xɔasiwo, eye wole agbe ɖum la, le fiasãwo me.

english_verse: What then did you go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was! I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Nu ka gɔ̃ miedo go yi be yewoaɖakpɔ? Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖe yea? Ẽ, magblɔe na mi, ame si miekpɔ la wú Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: In the Scriptures, God calls John his messenger and says, “I am sending my messenger ahead of you to get things ready for you.”
translation_verse: Eya ŋue woŋlɔ nya ɖi le be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, mele nye dɔla dɔm ɖa do ŋgɔ, ame si adzra wò mɔa ɖo le ŋgɔwò.’ ”

english_verse: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.
translation_verse: Yesu yi edzi gblɔ be: “Mele egblɔm na mi be amegbetɔ vidzidzi aɖeke mewú Yohanes o. Gake ame si nye suetɔ le mawufiaɖuƒea me la, lolo wu eyama.”

english_verse: Everyone had been listening to John. Even the tax collectors had obeyed God and had done what was right by letting John baptize them.
translation_verse: Do ŋgɔ la, ame hahoawo, vevietɔ nudzɔlawo wɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye wona Yohanes le mawutsi na wo.

english_verse: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Ke Farisitɔwo kple agbalẽfialawo ya gbe Mawu ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo, eye Yohanes mele mawutsi na wo o.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?
translation_verse: Yesu yi edzi gblɔ be: “Nu ka gɔ̃ matsɔ asɔ kple dzidzime sia? Nu ka woɖi?

english_verse: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry!”
translation_verse: Woɖi ɖevi siwo bɔbɔ nɔ asi me ko hele gbɔgblɔm na wo nɔewo be: ‘Míeku dzidzɔkpẽ na mi, ke miegbe ɣeɖuɖu. Míedo aviha ɖa, ke miegbe avifafa.’

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “John has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: “Yohanes mawutsilenamela va, meɖua nu o, menoa aha o, eye miegblɔ be, ‘Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le eme!’

english_verse: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, “Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.”
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ Vi la va, ɖua nu, noa nu, eye miawo ke miebe: ‘Mikpɔ nu tsu ɖula, aha tsu nola sia ɖa! Enye nudzɔlawo kple nuvɔ̃wɔlawo xɔlɔ̃.’

english_verse: Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what its followers do. Simon the Pharisee
translation_verse: Evɔ wònye ame siwo katã do tso Mawu ƒe nunya me la ƒe nuwɔna tsoa afia na Mawu hafi.” Yesu le Simon Farisitɔ la ƒeme

english_verse: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him. So Jesus went to the Pharisee's home and got ready to eat.
translation_verse: Farisitɔ aɖe kpe Yesu be wòava ɖu nu kple ye. Esi Yesu ge ɖe aƒea me la, ebɔbɔ nɔ kplɔ̃ ŋuti be yeaɖu nu.

english_verse: When a sinful woman in that town found out that Jesus was there, she bought an expensive bottle of perfume.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu maɖɔʋu aɖe le dua me. Esi wòse be Yesu le nu ɖum le Farisitɔ la ƒeme la, etsɔ ami ʋeʋẽe si le goe si wotsɔ kpe ɣi tɔxɛ wɔe la me la ɖe asi vɛ.

english_verse: Then she came and stood behind Jesus. She cried and started washing his feet with her tears and drying them with her hair. The woman kissed his feet and poured the perfume on them.
translation_verse: Etsi tsitre ɖe Yesu megbe le eƒe afɔ gbɔ hele avi fam. Efa aɖatsi ɖe Yesu ƒe afɔwo dzi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe taɖa tutu afɔawo ŋui. Egbugbɔ afɔawo ŋu, eye wòtsɔ ami ʋeʋẽe la si na wo.

english_verse: The Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this and said to himself, “If this man really were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him! He would know that she is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Esi Farisitɔ si kpe Yesu va nuɖuƒea kpɔ esia la, egblɔ le eɖokui me be: “Ɖe wònye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelae nye ame sia la, anye ne adze sii be nyɔnu sia, si le asi kam ye ŋu la, nuvɔ̃wɔla wònye.”

english_verse: Jesus said to the Pharisee, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” “Teacher, what is it?” Simon replied.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu ƒo nu nɛ gblɔ be: “Simon, nya aɖe le asinye medi be magblɔ na wò.” Simon bia Yesu be: “Nufiala, nya kae?”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Two people were in debt to a moneylender. One of them owed him
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Ame eve nyi fe le ame aɖe ŋu. Ame ɖeka nyi klosaloga alafa atɔ̃ ƒe fe, eye ame evelia nyi bla atɔ̃ ƒe fe.

english_verse: But Jesus told the woman, “Because of your faith, you are now saved. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ na nyɔnua be: “Wò xɔse ɖe wò. Heyi le ŋutifafa me.”

english_verse: Since neither of them could pay him back, the moneylender said that they didn't have to pay him anything. Which one of them will like him more?”
translation_verse: Esi naneke menɔ wo si be woatsɔ axe fe lae o ta la, fetɔ la tsɔ wo ame eve la katã ƒe feawo ke wo. Ame eve siawo dometɔ kae nèbu be alɔ̃ fetɔ la wu?”

english_verse: He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, “Have you noticed this woman? When I came into your home, you didn't give me any water so I could wash my feet. But she has washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.
translation_verse: Yesu trɔ ɖe nyɔnua gbɔ azɔ gblɔ na Simon be: “Èle nyɔnu sia kpɔma? Esi mege ɖe aƒewò me la, mèku tsi nam be maklɔ afɔe o, ke nyɔnu sia fa aɖatsi ɖe nye afɔwo dzi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe taɖa tutu wo ŋui.

english_verse: You didn't greet me with a kiss, but from the time I came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.
translation_verse: Mègbugbɔ nu nam tsɔ do dzaa nam o, ke tso esime mege ɖe eme ko la, afɔ ŋu ko gbugbɔm eya le nam.

english_verse: You didn't even pour olive oil on my head, but she has poured expensive perfume on my feet.
translation_verse: Mèsi ami ɖe ta nam o, ke nyɔnu sia si ami ɖe nye afɔwo ŋuti.

english_verse: So I tell you that all her sins are forgiven, and that is why she has shown great love. But anyone who has been forgiven for only a little will show only a little love.”

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nuku na Farisitɔ la be Yesu meklɔ asi hafi le nua ɖum o.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: “Baba na mi, Farisitɔwo, elabe miena ahamɛ, amagbe ʋeʋẽe kple amagbe bubu ɖe sia ɖe ƒe akpa ewolia, ke miegbe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple mawulɔlɔ̃ ya. Nu siawoe wòdze be miawɔ gbã ahatsɔ ekemɛawo wɔwɔ akpe ɖe wo ŋu hafi.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi amehawo bɔ ɖe Yesu ŋu la, egblɔ na wo be: “Dzidzime sia vɔ̃ɖi loo! Wole dzesi dim, ke womana ɖeke wo o, negbe Yona ƒe dzesia ko.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la, anyigbeme fianyɔnua atsi tsitre kple mi dzidzime sia, eye wòabu fɔ mi, elabe etso anyigba seƒe ke va be yease Salomo ƒe nya siwo me nunya le; ke kpɔ ɖa, ame aɖe le afii si lolo wu Salomo.

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Ninivetɔwo atsi tsitre le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la kple mi dzidzime sia, eye woabu fɔ mi, elabe wotrɔ dzime esime Yona gblɔ mawunya na wo. Kpɔ ɖa, ame aɖe le afii si lolo wu Yona.” Ame blibo la ƒe akaɖi (Mat

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: “Ame aɖeke mesia akaɖi dana ɖe ɣaɣlaƒe alo tsyɔa nu edzi o, ke edanɛ ɖe akaɖiti dzi boŋ bene wòaklẽ na ame siwo le xɔa me vam la.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Wò ŋku le abe akaɖi ene na wò ameti blibo la. Ne wò ŋku nyo la, wò ameti blibo la me kɔ. Ke ne wò ŋkumenyo o la, wò ameti blibo la me ado viviti.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Movitɔwo! Ɖe menye ame si wɔ eme la kee wɔ egodo hã oa?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Baba na mi! Elabe miedzra Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe yɔdowo ɖo, evɔ wònye mia tɔgbuiwoe wu wo.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu le nu ƒom la, Farisitɔ aɖe kpee be wòava ɖu nu kple ye. Ale wòyi ɖabɔbɔ nɔ anyi be yeaɖu nua.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: “Mi Farisitɔwo, mieklɔa miaƒe kplu kple agbawo godo, ke mia me yɔ fũu kple fififi kpakple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nu si le eme la na ame dahewo, ekema nu sia nu ŋuti akɔ na mi le miaƒe kɔnyinyia nu.”

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Baba na mi! Miele abe yɔdo ene. Medzena o, eye amewo zɔa edzi le manyamanya me.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Baba na mi sefialawo hã, elabe miedoa agba kpekpe siwo manyatsɔ o la na amewo, gake miawo ŋutɔ la, miedoa asibidɛ ɖeka pɛ hã ɖa be yewoakpe ɖe wo tsɔlawo ŋu o.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Ale miezu ɖasefowo, heda asi ɖe mia tɔgbuiwo ƒe nuwɔnawo dzi, elabe woawoe wu Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo, eye miawo miedzra woƒe yɔdowo ɖo.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Esia ta hãe Mawu ƒe Nunyagbalẽ la gblɔ be, ‘Maɖo Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo kple amedɔdɔwo ɖe wo. Woawu ɖewo, eye woati bubuwo yome.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Ale woabia Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo katã ƒe ʋu si wokɔ ɖe anyi, tso keke xexea me ƒe gɔmedzedzea me ke la, tso mi dzidzime sia si me.

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: Tso Abel ƒe ʋu dzi va se ɖe Zaxarya, ame si wowu le vɔsamlekpuia kple kɔkɔeƒea dome ƒe ʋu dzi. Ẽ, mele egblɔm na mi be, woahe to na mi dzidzime sia le wɔna siawo katã ta.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Baba na mi sefialawo! Mieɖe nunyasafui la dzoe. Miawo ŋutɔ mieʋui ge ɖe eme o, eye ame siwo di be yewoage ɖe eme la hã, miexe mɔ na wo.”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Esi Yesu dzo le afi ma la, agbalẽfialawo kple Farisitɔwo do dziku ɖe eŋu vevie. Wobia nyae le nu geɖewo ŋuti,

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: eye wole xá me nɛ, be wòaƒo nu ade eɖokui nya me.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi sia me la, ame akpeakpewo ƒo ƒu, ale gbegbe be wole afɔ ɖom wo nɔewo dzi. Tete Yesu ƒo nu na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gbã gblɔ be: “Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie le Farisitɔwo ƒe amɔwɔʋãnu, si nye alakpanuwɔwɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Azɔ ne Mawu ɖo atsyɔ̃ ale gbegbe na gbe si le gbe me egbe, eye etsɔ ko woatsɔe aƒu gbe ɖe kpodzo me wòafiã la, ɖe maɖo atsyɔ̃ na miawo boŋ geɖe wu oa? Xɔseʋɛtɔwo!

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke midi eƒe fiaɖuɖu boŋ, eye nu siawo katã lazu mia tɔ.” Dziƒoe nye kesinɔnuwo dzraɖoƒe (Mat

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: “Xɔ̃nyewo, mele egblɔm na mi be migavɔ̃ ame siwo wua ŋutilã, eye le esia megbe la, naneke megale wo si woate ŋu awɔ wu ema o.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Eya ta miawo la, migavɔ̃ o, elabe woxlẽ miaƒe taɖa gɔ̃ hã. Miexɔ asi sãa wu atsutsrɔewo.” Nyameʋuʋu le Kristo ŋu kple nugbegbe le egbɔ (Mat

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: “Alẽha sue, migavɔ̃ o! Elabe edze mia Tɔ́ la ŋu be wòatsɔ fiaɖuƒea ana mi.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Midzra nu siwo le mia si la, eye mitsɔ wo na ame dahewo. Mitɔ gakotoku siwo megblẽna o la na mia ɖokui, eye midzra miaƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖo ɖe dziƒo bene woanɔ dedie. Fiafi mele afi ma o, eye agbagblaʋui hã meɖua nu li o.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: Elabe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la afia nu si miagblɔ le ɣeyiɣi ma me la mi.” Lododo le kesinɔtɔ movitɔ la ŋuti

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: Ke Mawu gblɔ nɛ be: ‘Kpɔ movitɔ ɖa! Ŋu make ɖe wò o. Ke azɔ la, ame ka tɔe nu siwo nèdzra ɖo la ava zu?’ ”

english_verse: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Mele egblɔm na mi be ame sia ame si aʋu eme le amewo ŋkume be tɔnyee yenye la, Amegbetɔ Vi la hã awɔ nenema ke nɛ le Mawu ƒe dɔlawo ŋkume.

english_verse: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.
translation_verse: Ame si agbem le amewo ŋkume la, woagbe eya hã le Mawu ƒe dɔlawo ŋkume.

english_verse: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.
translation_verse: Ne wokplɔ mi yi ƒuƒoƒewo kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo kpakple dziɖulawo gbɔ la, migatsi dzimaɖi le ale si miaʋli mia ɖokui ta, alo le nya si miagblɔ la ŋuti o.

english_verse: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.”
translation_verse: Ame aɖe tso amehawo dome gblɔ na Yesu be: “Nufiala, ƒo nu na nɔvinye ne nye kplii míama domenyinu si nye mía tɔ la.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ŋutsu, ame kae ɖom ʋɔnudrɔ̃la alo numala na mi?”

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: Eyi edzi gblɔ na wo be: “Miɖɔ ŋu ɖo, eye mikpɔ nyuie le ŋukeklẽ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ŋuti, elabe amegbetɔ ƒe agbe mele nunɔamesi gbogbo siwo le esi la me o.”

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: Eya ta wògblɔ le eɖokui me be: ‘Nu ka mawɔ? Elabe teƒe megale asinye afi si madzra nu siwo meŋe la ɖo o.’

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: Eɖo eŋu na eɖokui be, ‘Menya nu si mawɔ. Mamu nye avawo, eye matu esiwo lolo wu la ɖe wo teƒe. Afi mae madzra nye nu siwo meŋe kple nu bubuwo katã ɖo.’

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Esiawo megbe la, Yesu gblɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo be: “Esia tae mele gbɔgblɔm na mi be migatsi dzimaɖi le nu si miaɖu anɔ agbe, alo le nu si miado alo ata la ŋuti o.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: Mibu ale si dzogbenya tsinae la ŋuti kpɔ. Metrea ɖeti loo, alo lɔ̃a avɔ o. Ke mele egblɔm na mi be fia Salomo, le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe gã la me gɔ̃ hã, meɖo atsyɔ̃ de dzogbenya tɔ nu o.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Nu siawoe xexemedukɔwo katã kplɔ ɖo; ke mia Tɔ́ la nya be nu siawo hiã mi.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Ke ne dɔla la gblɔ le eɖokui me be: ‘Nye aƒetɔ magbɔ fifia o!’ eye wòde asi ŋutsu kple nyɔnu subɔlawo ƒoƒo me, aɖu nu, ano nu ahamu aha la,

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Ɖe miebu be ŋutifafa na ge meva le anyigba dzia? Kpao! Mele egblɔm na mi be memama boŋ ye mehe vɛ.

english_verse: Be ready and keep your lamps burning
translation_verse: “Minɔ ŋudzɔ, eye mina miaƒe akaɖiwo nanɔ bibim.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Subɔla siwo woƒe aƒetɔa agbɔ ava tu woanɔ ŋudzɔ la, woazu dzɔgbenyuitɔwo. Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be aƒetɔa asa avɔ ɖe ali, ana woanɔ kplɔ̃ ŋu, eye wòasubɔ wo.

english_verse: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.
translation_verse: Ame siwo aƒetɔa agbɔ ava tu le fɔŋli ga etɔ̃ alo ga ene me woanɔ ŋudzɔ la, akpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Ke mienyae be ne aƒetɔ aɖe anya ɣeyiɣi si me tututu fiafitɔ ava la, anɔ ŋudzɔ, eye mana mɔ fiafitɔ la be wòaŋɔ gli age ɖe eƒe xɔ me o.

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Petro bia be: “Aƒetɔ, míawo koe nèle lo sia dom na loo, alo amewo katã yea?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be: “Ame kae nye aƒedzikpɔla nuteƒewɔla kple nunyala si eƒe aƒetɔ aɖo eƒe subɔlawo nu, be wòana nuɖuɖu wo ɖe ɣeyiɣi nyuitɔ dzi?

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Woyra dɔla ma, si aƒetɔa ava tu wòanɔ dɔ si woɖo nɛ la wɔm.

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi le nyateƒe me be atsɔ dɔla sia aɖo eƒe nunɔamesiwo katã nu.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: eƒe aƒetɔ ava le ŋkeke si dzi mele mɔ kpɔm nɛ o kple ɣeyiɣi si menya o la me. Ahe to nɛ vevie eye wòana gomee le ame mawɔnuteƒewo dome.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: Dɔla si nya eƒe aƒetɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, gake mele klalo alo wɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu o la, woaƒoe zi geɖe.

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Ke dɔla si menya eƒe aƒetɔa ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu o, eye wòwɔ nu si dze tohehe la, woaƒoe ʋɛ ko. Ame sia ame si wona nu geɖee la, woabia nu geɖe tso esi hã.” Yesu he memama vɛ (Mat

english_verse: I came to set fire to the earth, and I wish it were already on fire!
translation_verse: “Dzoe meɖe va kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi, eye medi gɔ̃ bene wòalé kaba.

english_verse: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.
translation_verse: Mawutsilele aɖe li, si wòle be woale nam, eye metsi dzodzodzoe be woalee nam kaba.

english_verse: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.
translation_verse: Tso esia dzi heyina la, ne ame atɔ̃ le aƒe ɖeka me la, wo dome lama. Ame etɔ̃ atso ɖe eve ŋuti, eye eve atso ɖe etɔ̃ ŋuti.

english_verse: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other. Knowing What To Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Vi tɔ atsi tre ɖe via ŋutsu ŋuti, eye viŋutsu atsi tre ɖe tɔ́a ŋuti. Vi nɔ atsi tre ɖe via nyɔnu ŋuti, eye vinyɔnu atsi tre ɖe nɔa ŋuti. Lɔ̃xo atsi tre ɖe vi srɔ̃ ŋuti, eye vi srɔ̃ latsi tre ɖe lɔ̃xoa ŋuti.” Sidzedze ɣeyiɣi la (Mat

english_verse: Jesus said to all the people: As soon as you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say, “It's going to rain,” and it does.
translation_verse: Yesu gagblɔ na amehaawo be: “Ne miekpɔ alilikpo wòho tso ɣetoɖoƒe la, miegblɔna enumake be tsi gbɔna, eye wòvaa me hã.

english_verse: When the south wind blows, you say, “It's going to get hot,” and it does.
translation_verse: Ne ya ƒo tso anyigbeme lɔƒo la, miegblɔna be xexeme le dzo xɔ ge, eye wòvaa me nenema.

english_verse: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.
translation_verse: Alakpatɔwo! Miete ŋu léa ŋku ɖe anyigba kple dziƒo ƒe nɔnɔme ŋu, eye mienyaa nu si gbɔna la gblɔna, ale ke wɔ miete ŋu lé ŋku ɖe fifi ɣeyiɣi sia ŋu, hekpɔ nu si gbɔna la agblɔ o mahã?” Wɔ ɖeka kple wò ketɔ (Mat

english_verse: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.
translation_verse: Ne wò kple wò ketɔ miele mɔ dzi yina ʋɔnu le fia ŋkume la, dze agbagba nàdzra mia dome ɖo le mɔa dzi. Ale be magakplɔ wò ayi ʋɔnudrɔ̃la gbɔ, ne ʋɔnudrɔ̃la la natsɔ wò ade asi na kpovitɔ, ne wòava de wò gaxɔ me o.

english_verse: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi tututu la, ame aɖewo le ameawo dome gblɔ ale si Pilato wu Galileatɔ aɖewo, siwo nɔ vɔ sam ale be woƒe ʋu tɔtɔ kple woƒe vɔsalãwo tɔ la na Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Ɖe miebu be Galileatɔ siawo nye nuvɔ̃wɔlawo wu Galileatɔ bubuawo katã, eya tae wokpe fu alea gbegbea?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.
translation_verse: Kpao! Mele egblɔm na mi be, ne mietrɔ dzime o la, mi katã miatsrɔ̃ alea ke.

english_verse: Jesus said, “What is God's kingdom like? What can I compare it with?
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ be: “Nu ka Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la ɖi? Nu ka ŋutie matsɔe asɔ ɖo!

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die. A Story about a Fig Tree
translation_verse: Kpao! Mele egblɔm na mi be, ne mietrɔ dzime o la, mi katã miatsrɔ̃ alea ke.” Lododo le gboti matseku la ŋuti

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.
translation_verse: Yesu do lo sia hã na wo be: “Ame aɖe do gboti ɖe eƒe wainbɔ me. Eva di kutsetse le atia dzi be yeagbe, gake mekpɔ ɖeke o.

english_verse: The gardener answered, “Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.
translation_verse: Ke abɔa dzikpɔla ɖo eŋu nɛ be: ‘Aƒetɔ, na wòanɔ anyi ƒe sia me hã. Maku do aƒo xlãe ahado aɖu ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.” Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Ne ƒe trɔ, eye wòtse ku la, ekema enyo; gake ne meva eme nenema o la, àte ŋu alãe azɔ faa.’ ” Yesu da gbe le nyɔnu tekunɔ aɖe ŋu le Dzudzɔgbe

english_verse: One Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in a synagogue,

english_verse: The Pharisee stood over by himself and prayed, “God, I thank you that I am not greedy, dishonest, and unfaithful in marriage like other people. And I am really glad that I am not like that tax collector over there.
translation_verse: Farisitɔ la nɔ tsitrenu do gbe ɖa le tame be: ‘Mawu, meda akpe na wò be nyemele abe ame bubuwo ene o: adzodalawo, nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo, ahasiwɔlawo, alo abe nudzɔla sia hã ene o.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “When the two men went home, it was the tax collector and not the Pharisee who was pleasing to God. If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew

translation_verse: Wotsɔ vidzĩwo gɔ̃ hã va Yesu gbɔ be wòada asi ɖe wo dzi. Esi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kpɔ wo la, wohe nya ɖe ameawo ŋu.

translation_verse: Yesu yɔ eƒe nusrɔ̃la wui eveawo va eɖokui gbɔ gblɔ na wo be: “Misee, míeyina Yerusalem, eye nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖi to Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo dzi tso Amegbetɔ Vi la ŋuti la ava eme.

english_verse: An important man asked Jesus, “Good Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ƒe amegã aɖe va bia Yesu be: “Nufiala nyui, nu ka mawɔ be makpɔ agbe mavɔ?”

english_verse: He told Jesus, “I have obeyed all these commandments since I was a young man.”
translation_verse: Amegã la be: “Mewɔ se siawo katã dzi tso nye ɖevime ke.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “There is one thing you still need to do. Go and sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu see la, egblɔ nɛ be: “Nu ɖeka gasusɔ na wò. Heyi nàdzra nu siwo katã le asiwò la, eye nàtsɔ nu si nèkpɔ la na ame dahewo, ekema kesinɔnu anɔ asiwò le dziƒo, ne nàva nɔ yonyeme.”

english_verse: When the man heard this, he was sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Esi amegã la se esia la, exa nu elabe kesinɔnu geɖe le esi.

english_verse: Jesus saw how sad the man was. So he said, “It's terribly hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Yesu kpɔ esia, eye wògblɔ be: “Esesẽ na kesinɔtɔwo ŋutɔ be woage ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ele bɔbɔe na kposɔ be wòato abui ƒe vo me wu, be kesinɔtɔ nage ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me.”

english_verse: When the crowd heard this, they asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: Ame siwo se nya siawo la gblɔ be: “Ekem ɖe, ame ka gɔ̃e woate ŋu axɔ ɖe agbe?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Nu si amegbetɔ mete ŋu wɔna o la, Mawu ya wɔnɛ.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Remember, we left everything to be your followers!”
translation_verse: Tete Petro gblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, míawo la, míegblẽ míaƒe aƒewo ɖi hedze yowòme.”

english_verse: He will be handed over to foreigners, who will make fun of him, mistreat him, and spit on him.
translation_verse: Wole ede ge asi na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la. Woaɖu fewu le eŋuti, ado vloe, aɖe ta ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: They will beat him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.
translation_verse: Woaƒoe kple atam, eye woawui. Ke le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la, agafɔ ɖe tsitre.”

english_verse: When Jesus was coming close to Jericho, a blind man sat begging beside the road.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu gogo Yerixo la, ŋkuagbãtɔ aɖe bɔbɔ nɔ mɔ to nɔ nu biam.

english_verse: The man heard the crowd walking by and asked what was happening.
translation_verse: Ŋkuagbãtɔ la se ameha si va yina la ŋkɔ. Ebia be: “Nu kae le dzɔdzɔm?”

english_verse: Some people told him that Jesus from Nazareth was passing by.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Yesu Nazaretetɔ lae va yina.”

english_verse: So the blind man shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Tete wòdo ɣli be: “Yesu, David Vi, kpɔ nublanui nam!”

english_verse: The people who were going along with Jesus told the man to be quiet. But he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Ame siwo le ŋgɔ la nyra ɖee be wòazi ɖoɖoe, ke egado ɣli sesĩe wu be: “David Vi lee, kpɔ nublanui nam!”

english_verse: Jesus stopped and told some people to bring the blind man over to him. When the blind man was getting near, Jesus asked,
translation_verse: Yesu tɔ, eye wòbia be woakplɔe vɛ. Esi ŋkuagbãtɔ la te ɖe Yesu ŋu la, Yesu biae be:

english_verse: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see!” he answered.
translation_verse: “Nu ka nèdi be mawɔ na ye?” Ŋkuagbãtɔ la gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, na be makpɔ nu!”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Look and you will see! Your eyes are healed because of your faith.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ nu! Wò xɔse da gbe le ŋuwò.”

english_verse: At once the man could see, and he went with Jesus and started thanking God. When the crowds saw what happened, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ŋutsua kpɔ nu enumake, eye wòdze Yesu yome hele Mawu kafum. Esi ameha la kpɔe la, wokafu Mawu.

english_verse: When Jesus got there, he looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down! I want to stay with you today.”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu ɖo teƒea la, efɔ mo dzi kpɔ Zaxeo. Egblɔ nɛ be: “Zaxeo, ɖi kaba, elabe ele be manɔ aƒewò me egbe.”

english_verse: Zacchaeus hurried down and gladly welcomed Jesus.
translation_verse: Zaxeo ɖi enumake, eye wòxɔ Yesu kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who saw this started grumbling, “This man Zacchaeus is a sinner! And Jesus is going home to eat with him.”
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo kpɔe la lĩ liʋiliʋĩ gblɔ be: “Ŋutsu sia yina nuvɔ̃wɔla gbɔ dze ge!”

english_verse: Later that day Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “I will give half of my property to the poor. And I will now pay back four times as much to everyone I have ever cheated.”
translation_verse: Zaxeo tsi tsitre gblɔ na Aƒetɔ la be: “Aƒetɔ, matsɔ nye nuwo ƒe afã ana ame dahewo, eye ne meba ame aɖe le go aɖe me la, maɖo eteƒe zi ene.”

english_verse: Jesus said to Zacchaeus, “Today you and your family have been saved, because you are a true son of Abraham.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Agbexɔxɔ va aƒe sia me egbe, elabe ame sia hã nye Abraham ƒe dzidzimevi.

english_verse: The Son of Man came to look for and to save people who are lost.” A Story about Ten Servants (Matthew
translation_verse: Elabe Amegbetɔ Vi la ɖe wòva be yeadi, eye yeaxɔ ame siwo bu la ɖe agbe.” Lododo le sikaga ŋuti (Mat

english_verse: But they said, “Sir, he already has ten times as much!”
translation_verse: Ke woawo gblɔ na fia la be: ‘Aƒetɔ, sikaga ewo le eya si xoxo ɖe!’

english_verse: But the people of his country hated him, and they sent messengers to the foreign country to say, “We don't want this man to be our king.”
translation_verse: Ke eƒe dumeviwo lé fui, eya ta wodɔ amewo ɖo ɖe eyome be: ‘Míedi be ame sia naɖu fia ɖe mía dzi o.’

english_verse: He told them, “Go into the next village, where you will find a young donkey that has never been ridden. Untie the donkey and bring it here.
translation_verse: be: “Miyi kɔƒe si le mia ŋgɔ la me. Ne miege ɖe eme la, miakpɔ tedzivi aɖe le ka me, si ame aɖeke medo kpɔ o. Miɖe kae, ne miakplɔe vɛ.

english_verse: The first servant came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me I have earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: Dɔla gbãtɔ va do gblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ, wò sikaga la ɖe vi sikaga ewo ɖe edzi.’

english_verse: The second one came and said, “Sir, with the money you gave me, I have earned five times as much.”
translation_verse: Evelia va gblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ, wò sikaga si nènam la ɖe vi sikaga atɔ̃ ɖe edzi.’

english_verse: Another servant came and said, “Sir, here is your money. I kept it safe in a handkerchief.
translation_verse: Dɔla bubu va gblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ, wò sikaga lae nye esi. Mesae ɖe taku nu dzra ɖo.

english_verse: Why didn't you put my money in the bank? On my return, I could have had the money together with interest.”
translation_verse: Nu ka ta mètsɔ nye ga la de gadzraɖoƒe, ale be ne metrɔ gbɔ la, maxɔe kple demea o?’

english_verse: Then he said to some other servants standing there, “Take the money away from him and give it to the servant who earned ten times as much.”
translation_verse: Tete fia la gblɔ na ame siwo tsi tsitre ɖe afi ma la be: ‘Mixɔ sikaga la le esi miatsɔ na ame si si ewo le la.’

english_verse: The king replied, “Those who have something will be given more. But everything will be taken away from those who don't have anything.
translation_verse: Ke fia la ɖo eŋu be: ‘Mele egblɔm na mi be ame sia ame si si nu le la, woatsɔ nu geɖe wu akpee nɛ, ke ame si si nu mele o la, nu sue si le esi la hã woaxɔe le esi.

translation_verse: Azɔ la, mikplɔ nye ketɔ siwo medi be maɖu fia ɖe yewo dzi o la vɛ, ne miawu wo le ŋkunye me afii.’ ” Gege ɖe Yerusalem-dua me kple aseyetsotso (Mat

translation_verse: Esi Yesu gblɔ nya sia vɔ la, edze ŋgɔ ɖo ta Yerusalem.

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ ”
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe bia mi be: ‘Nu ka ta miele ka ɖemee?’ hã la, miɖo eŋu be: ‘Aƒetɔ lae le ehiãm!’ ”

english_verse: They went off and found everything just as Jesus had said.
translation_verse: Amedɔdɔawo yi, eye wokpɔ nuawo abe ale si Yesu gblɔe na wo la ene.

english_verse: While they were untying the donkey, its owners asked, “Why are you doing that?”
translation_verse: Ke esi wole ka ɖem tedzivia la, nutɔwo bia wo be: “Nu ka ta miele ka ɖem tedzivia?”

english_verse: They answered, “The Lord needs it.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu be: “Aƒetɔ lae le ehiãm.”

english_verse: Then they led the donkey to Jesus. They put some of their clothes on its back and helped Jesus get on.
translation_verse: Ale wokplɔ tedzivia vɛ na Yesu. Wotsɔ woƒe awu ʋlayawo ɖo ɖe edzi hekɔ Yesu ɖo tedzivia dzi.

english_verse: And as he rode along, the people spread clothes on the road in front of him.
translation_verse: Esi wòdoe yina la, wotsɔ woƒe avɔwo ɖo ɖe mɔa dzi.

english_verse: When Jesus started down the Mount of Olives, his large crowd of disciples were happy and praised God because of all the miracles they had seen.
translation_verse: Esime Yesu le Amito la ƒe abu ɖim la, nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe ha blibo la tso aseye hekafu Mawu sesĩe le nukunu siwo katã wokpɔ la ta gblɔ be:

english_verse: They shouted, “Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory to God.”
translation_verse: “Woyra fia si gbɔna le Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ me! Ŋutifafa le dziƒo! Mawu tɔe nye ŋutikɔkɔe la!”

english_verse: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, make your disciples stop shouting!”
translation_verse: Farisitɔ aɖewo nɔ ameha la dome gblɔ na Yesu be: “Nufiala, gbe nya na wò nusrɔ̃lawo.”

english_verse: When Jesus came closer and could see Jerusalem, he cried
translation_verse: Esi Yesu gbɔna, eye wòkpɔ dua ta la, efa avi ɖe eŋuti

english_verse: and said: It is too bad that today your people don't know what will bring them peace! Now it is hidden from them.
