english_verse: Jerusalem, the time will come when your enemies will build walls around you to attack you. Armies will surround you and close in on you from every side.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke li gbɔna, si me wò futɔwo aƒo kpo kɔkɔ ɖe ŋuwò. Woaɖe to ɖe wò, axaxa wò ɖe eme tso akpa sia akpa.

english_verse: They will level you to the ground and kill your people. Not one stone in your buildings will be left on top of another. This will happen because you did not see that God had come to save you. Jesus in the Temple (Matthew
translation_verse: Woatsɔ wò kple viwòwo siaa axlã ɖe anyi. Womele kpe ɖeka teti hã gblẽ ge ɖe bubu dzi le mewò o, elabe mèdze si ɣeyiɣi si me wova xɔ wò ge o.” Yesu nyà asitsalawo do goe le mawuƒe la me (Mat

english_verse: When Jesus entered the temple, he started chasing out the people who were selling things.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu ge ɖe mawuxɔ la me, eye wòde asi nudzralawo nyanya me do goe.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be a place of worship.’ But you have made it a place where robbers hide!”
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be, ‘Woayɔ nye aƒe la be gbedoɖaƒe,’ ke miawo ya mietrɔe zu adzodalawo ƒe beɖoƒe.”

english_verse: Each day, Jesus kept on teaching in the temple. So the chief priests, the teachers of the Law of Moses, and some other important people tried to have him killed.
translation_verse: Yesu fiaa nu le mawuxɔa me gbe sia gbe. Nunɔlagãwo, agbalẽfialawo kple dumegãwo di mɔnu le eŋu be yewoawui.

english_verse: But they could not find a way to do it, because everyone else was eager to listen to him.
translation_verse: Ke womekpɔ mɔ si dzi woato awui o, elabe dukɔ blibo la ku ɖe eŋu hele eƒe nyawo sem.

english_verse: The spies said to him, “Teacher, we know you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ame siawo va Yesu gbɔ, gblɔ nɛ be: “Nufiala, míenya be èƒoa nu hefiaa nu si le eteƒe, eye mèkpɔa ame ŋkume o, ke boŋ èfiaa Mawu ƒe se la le nyateƒe me.

translation_verse: Ame aɖewo tso Zadukitɔ siwo gblɔna be ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi aɖeke meli o la, dome

translation_verse: Esi wo ame adrẽa katã ɖee kpɔ ɖe, wo dometɔ ka srɔ̃ nyɔnua anye, le ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsigbe?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I want to ask you a question.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Nye hã mabia nya ɖeka mi; miɖo eŋu nam azɔ.

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?”
translation_verse: Yohanes ƒe mawutsilele la ɖe, Mawu gbɔ wòtso loo, alo amegbetɔwo gbɔ wòtsoa?”

english_verse: They talked this over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: Wolé nya la kpɔ le wo nɔewo dome gblɔ be: “Ne míegblɔ be, ‘Mawu gbɔ wòtso la,’ abia mí be, ‘Nu ka tae miexɔ edzi se o?’

english_verse: And we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize. The crowd will stone us to death, because they think John was a prophet.”
translation_verse: Evɔ ne míegblɔ be, ‘Amegbetɔwo gbɔ wòtso la,’ ɖeko ameawo katã laƒu kpe mí, elabe woka ɖe edzi be Yohanes la, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelae wònye.”

english_verse: So they told Jesus, “We don't know who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Eya ta woɖo eŋu be: “Míenya afi si wòtso o.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story: A man once planted a vineyard and rented it out. Then he left the country for a long time.
translation_verse: Yesu do lo sia na ameawo be: “Ame aɖe de waingble, eye wòtsɔe de asi na agbledzikpɔlawo hedzo yi dukɔ bubu me ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe.

english_verse: When it was time to harvest the crop, he sent a servant to ask the renters for his share of the grapes. But they beat up the servant and sent him away without anything.
translation_verse: Esi ɣeyiɣia de la, edɔ eƒe subɔla ɖeka ɖo ɖe agbledzikpɔlaawo gbɔ hebia wo be woatsɔ waingblea me kutsetse aɖewo aɖo ɖe ye. Ke agbledzikpɔlaawo ƒo subɔla la, eye wonyàe ɖo ɖa asi ƒuƒlu.

english_verse: When the renters saw the owner's son, they said to one another, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ke esi agbledzikpɔlaawo kpɔ via la, wogblɔ le wo nɔewo dome be: ‘Ame si gbɔna doa me nyi ge lae nye ekem! Mina míawui, ne domenyinu la nazu mía tɔ.’

english_verse: I'll tell you what. He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard.” When the people heard this, they said, “This must never happen!”
translation_verse: Agbɔ va, eye wòatsrɔ̃ agbledzikpɔla mawo, eye wòatsɔ waingble la ade ame bubuwo si.” Esi ameawo see la, wogblɔ be: “Gbeɖe! madzɔ akpɔ o!”

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses knew that Jesus was talking about them when he was telling this story. They wanted to arrest him right then, but they were afraid of the people. Paying Taxes (Matthew
translation_verse: Agbalẽfialawo kple nunɔlagãwo di be yewoalé Yesu enumake, elabe wonyae be yewo ŋutie wòdo lo sia ɖo, ke wovɔ̃ na ameha la.

english_verse: Jesus' enemies kept watching him closely, because they wanted to hand him over to the Roman governor. So they sent some men who pretended to be good. But they were really spies trying to catch Jesus saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Eya ta wonɔ mɔnu dim le eŋu. Woda ameflulawo ɖe eŋu le adzame be woase nya aɖe le enu atsɔ alée, akplɔe kple se ahadee asi na mɔ́mefia la ƒe amewo.

english_verse: “Show me a coin.” Then he asked, “Whose picture and name are on it?” “The Emperor's,” they answered.
translation_verse: “Mitsɔ klosaloga aɖe vɛ makpɔ.” Esi wotsɔe vɛ la, ebia be: “Ame ka ƒe nɔnɔmetata kple nuŋɔŋlɔe le edzi?” Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Roma Fiagã la tɔwoe.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.”

translation_verse: Wodea mawuxɔa me enuenu ɖakafua Mawu.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: Eya kple Mawu li le gɔmedzedzea me.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: Nya la me agbe dzɔ tso, eye agbe siae he kekeli vɛ na amegbetɔ.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Kekeli la klẽna ɖe viviti me, ke viviti la mete ŋu tsii kpɔ o.

english_verse: God sent a man named John,
translation_verse: Mawu dɔ eƒe dɔla aɖe ɖa. Eŋkɔe nye Yohanes.

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: Ame sia va be yeaɖi ɖase le kekelia ŋuti be amewo katã nato ye dzi axɔ ase.

english_verse: The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.
translation_verse: Kekeli vavãtɔ, si klẽna na ame sia ame la gbɔna xexea me.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: Kekeli sia le xexea me, eye eya dzie woto wɔ xexea me. Ke xexea me medze sii o.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: Eva eya ŋutɔ wo de, ke wo detɔwo mexɔe o.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: Ame siawo ƒe dzidzi mele abe dzɔdzɔme tɔ ene o. Wometo ŋutilã ƒe dzodzro alo ŋutsu ƒe didi me dzi wo o. Ke boŋ Mawu ŋutɔe lɔ̃ be yeaxɔ wo awɔ ye viwoe.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Nya la va zu amegbetɔ henɔ mía dome, eye amenuvenu kple nyateƒe yɔe taŋ. Míekpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe. Ŋutikɔkɔe si wòxɔ abe Tɔ́ la Vi ɖeka hɔ̃ la ene la.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Tso eƒe blibonyenye me la mí katã, míxɔ amenuvenu ɖe amenuvenu dzi.

english_verse: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.”
translation_verse: Yohanes meɣla nya aɖeke ɖe wo o, ke boŋ eʋu eme hekɔ nya me gblɔ be: “Menye nyee nye Kristo la o.”

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Wobiae be: “Ekema ame kae nènye? Wòe nye Eliyaa?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Menye nyee o.” Woyi edzi bia Yohanes be: “Wòe nye gbeƒãɖela laa?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Ao.”

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Tete wobiae be: “Ekema ame ka koŋ nènye? Na ŋuɖoɖo mí ne míaɖagblɔ na ame siwo dɔ mí ɖa la. Ame ka wò ŋutɔ nèbe yenye?”

english_verse: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
translation_verse: Yohanes gblɔ na wo be: “Nyee nye ame si le ɣli dom le gbedadaƒo la ƒe gbe. ‘Midzɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe mɔ la’ abe ale si gbeƒãɖela Yesaya gblɔe ɖi ene.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ame siwo wodɔ ɖa tso Farisitɔwo gbɔ la

english_verse: They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
translation_verse: bia Yohanes be: “Ne menye wòe nye Kristo la alo Eliya alo Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela la o la, ale ke wɔ nèle mawutsi lem na amewo?”

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Yohanes ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Mele mawutsi lem na amewo kple tsi, gake ame aɖe tsi tsitre le mia dome, ame si miedze sii o.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Ele megbenye gbɔna, eye nyemedze atu eƒe afɔkpaka gɔ̃ hã o.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Nya siawo katã va eme le Betania le Yordan godo, afi si Yohanes nɔ tsi lem na amewo le la. Mawu ƒe Alẽvi la

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke eye Yohanes kpɔ Yesu wògbɔna ɖe egbɔ la, egblɔ be: “Mikpɔ, Mawu ƒe Alẽvi si tsɔ xexea me ƒe nuvɔ̃ yina lae nye esi!

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Eyae nye ame si ŋuti megblɔ le be: ‘Ame aɖe le megbenye gbɔna, ede ŋgɔ wum’ elabe eli hafi meva dzɔ.

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ hã nyemedze si ame sia o, gake meva hele mawutsi lem na amewo kple tsi bene woaɖe eyama afia Israel-dukɔ la.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Yohanes gblɔ le eŋuti be: “Mekpɔ gbɔgbɔ la wòle abe ahɔnɛ ene ɖiɖi tso dziƒo va nɔ edzi.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Nye la nyemedze sii o; ke ame si dɔm ɖa be male mawutsi na amewo kple tsi la gblɔ nam be: ‘Ame si dzi nàkpɔ Gbɔgbɔ la wòaɖi ɖo, ahanɔ edzi la, eyae nye ame si ale tsi na amewo kple Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la.’

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Azɔ nye la, mekpɔe, eya ta mele egblɔm na mi be ame siae nye Mawu Vi la.” Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃la gbãtɔwo

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, Yohanes kple eƒe nusrɔ̃la eve tsi tsitre ɖi

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: eye wòkpɔ Yesu wòva yina. Egblɔ be: “Mikpɔ ɖa, Mawu ƒe Alẽvi lae nye esi!”

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la eveawo se nu si Yohanes gblɔ; ale wodze Yesu yome.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Yesu trɔ, eye esi wòkpɔ wo le eyome la, ebia wo be: “Nu ka dim miele?” Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Nufiala, afi kae nènɔna?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Miva kpɔe ɖa.” Ale woyi kplii ɖakpɔ enɔƒe, eye wonɔ egbɔ gbe ma gbe.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la eve, siwo se Yohanes ƒe nya la eye wodze Yesu yome la dometɔ ɖekae nye Andrea, Simon Petro nɔvi.

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Ale wòkplɔ Simon va Yesu gbɔ. Yesu kpɔe dũu, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Wòe nye Simon, Yohanes vi laa? Tso esia dzi la, woayɔ wò be Kefas,” si gɔmee nye kpe. Yesu yɔ Filipo kple Nataniel

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Filipo kpɔ Nataniel, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Míeke ɖe ame si ŋuti Mose kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ŋlɔ nya ɖi le la ŋu. Eyae nye Yesu, Yosef vi tso Nazaret.”

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Nataniel bia be: “Ɖe nu vavã aɖe ate ŋu ado tso Nazaret hã?” Filipo gblɔ nɛ be: “Va kpɔe ɖa!”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kpɔ Nataniel wògbɔna ɖe egbɔ la, egblɔ le eŋuti be: “Kpɔ ɖa, Israel vi akuakua ŋutɔe nye ame sia. Alakpa aɖeke mele eme o.”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Nataniel bia Yesu be: “Afi ka nènyam le?” Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Hafi Filipo nayɔ wò le gbotia te la, mekpɔ wò xoxo.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Nataniel gblɔ be: “Nufiala, wòe nye Mawu Vi la. Israel-fia lae nènye!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Esi megblɔ be mekpɔ wò le gbotia te la, èxɔe sea? Èle nu gãwo wu esiawo kpɔ ge.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Yesu gayi edzi gblɔ nɛ be: “Nyateƒe tom mele na wò be àkpɔ dziƒo nu wòaʋu, eye àkpɔ mawudɔlawo anɔ dzi liam anɔ ɖiɖim ɖe Amegbetɔ Vi la dzi.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la, wowɔ srɔ̃ɖeɖe aɖe le Kana le Galilea. Yesu dada hã nɔ eteƒe,

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: eye wokpe Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo hã va srɔ̃ɖeƒe lae.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Esi wain vɔ le wo si la, Yesu dada te ɖe Yesu ŋu gblɔ nɛ be: “Wain vɔ le wo si.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “O, nɔnye, esia menye wò nya o. Nye ɣeyiɣi mede haɖe o.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Yesu nɔ yi ɖe ame siwo nye subɔlawo la gbɔ hegblɔ na wo be: “Nu sia nu si wògblɔ na mi la, miwɔe.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Esi wònye dekɔnu na Yudatɔwo be woaklɔ wo ɖokui ŋu hafi age ɖe aƒeme ta la, woɖi kpezɔ ade ɖe aƒea me. Tsi tɔmedeze eve alo etɔ̃e nɔa zɔ siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe me.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na subɔlawo be: “Midu tsi kɔ ɖe zɔawo me.” Wodu tsia kɔ ɖe wo me, woyɔ banaa.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na subɔlaawo be: “Miku tsia ɖe yi na nuɖuɖudzikpɔla la.” Ale woku tsia yi nɛ.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖudzikpɔla la ɖɔ tsi si trɔ zu wain la kpɔ. Menya afi si wòtso o, ke subɔla siwo du tsi la ya nya. Nuɖuɖudzikpɔla la yɔ ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ la,

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Ame sia ame kua wain nyuitɔ na amewo gbã, eye ne amewo no eya mu vɔ, emegbe hafi wòhea esi menyo o la ɖe go. Ale ke wɔ wò ya nèdzra wain nyuitɔ ɖo va se ɖe fifi?”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Ke nu si ŋuti wòle nu ƒom le lae nye eƒe ŋutilã ƒe mawuxɔ.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ƒe Ŋutitotoŋkeke la tu aƒe, eye Yesu yi Yerusalem.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Tete wògbi ka wɔ ameƒokae, eye wònyà ame siwo katã si alẽ kple nyiwo le la do go tso mawuxɔa me. Ekaka gaɖɔlilawo ƒe gawo hlẽ, eye wòmu woƒe kplɔ̃wo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Tete eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo ŋku mawunya sia dzi be: “O, Mawu, ŋuʋaʋã ɖe wò aƒe la ŋu le bibim le menye abe dzo ene.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Mikaka mawuxɔ sia, eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃ me la, magatui.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ ame siwo le nyi, alẽ kple ahɔnɛ dzram la kpakple gaɖɔlilawo wobɔbɔ nɔ mawuxɔ la me.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ na ame siwo le ahɔnɛwo dzram la be: “Mitsɔ nu siawo do goe le afii, eye migatsɔ Tɔ́nye ƒe aƒe la wɔ asi mee o.”

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo va Yesu gbɔ hebiae be: “Esi nèwɔ nu siawo la, dzesi kae le asiwò nàfia mí?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Eya ta esi wofɔe ɖe tsitre tso ku me la, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖo ŋku edzi be egblɔ nya sia. Ale woxɔ mawunya la kple Yesu ƒe nya si wògblɔ la dzi se. Yesu nya nu le amegbetɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔme ŋu

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Esime Yesu nɔ Yerusalem le Paskaa ɖuɣi la, ame geɖe siwo kpɔ dzesi siwo wòwɔ la xɔ edzi se.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu ŋutɔ meɖo ŋu ɖe wo ŋu o, elabe edze si ame sia ame

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: eye mehiã be ame aɖeke naɖi ɖase le amegbetɔ ŋuti nɛ o. Eya ŋutɔ nya nu si le amegbetɔ ƒe dzime.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ƒe amegã aɖe nye Farisitɔ. Eŋkɔe nye Nikodemo.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Ame sia va Yesu gbɔ gbe ɖeka zã, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Nufiala, míenya be nufiala nènye tso Mawu gbɔ va, elabe ame aɖeke mate ŋu awɔ dzesi siwo nèwɔna, ne menye Mawue li kplii o.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Nyateƒe tom mele na wò be, ne womedzi ame tso dziƒo o la, mate ŋu akpɔ Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la o.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Nyateƒe tom mele na wò be, ne womedzi ame tso tsi kple Gbɔgbɔ la me o la, mate ŋu age ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la me o.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ dzidzia la, amegbetɔ ko wònye, eye nu si tso Gbɔgbɔ la me la, gbɔgbɔmenu wònye.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Megawɔ mo yaa na wò be megblɔ be, ‘Ele be woadzi wò tso dziƒo’ o.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Ya ƒona yia afi si dze eŋu, eye nèsea eƒe ɖiɖi ko, ke mènya afi si wòtso kple afi si yim wòle la o. Nenema kee nye ame sia ame si wodzi tso Gbɔgbɔ la me la hã.”

english_verse: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
translation_verse: Nikodemo bia be: “Ale ke esia ate ŋu ava emee?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Nufiala nènye le Israel, ale ke wɔ mèse nu siawo gɔme o?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na wò le nyateƒe me be, nu si míenya la ŋutie míeƒoa nu le, eye míeɖia ɖase le nu si míekpɔ la ŋuti, gake miexɔa míaƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la o.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Ne meƒo nu le anyigbadzinuwo ŋuti na wò, eye mèxɔ wo dzi se o la, ekema ne meƒo nu le dziƒonuwo ŋuti na wò la, ale ke lawɔ nàte ŋu axɔ wo dzi ase?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke melia yi dziƒo kpɔ o, negbe ame si ɖi tso dziƒo va la ko. Eyae nye Amegbetɔ Vi la.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Abe ale si Mose kɔ da la ɖe dzi le gbea dzi ene la, nenemae wòle be woakɔ Amegbetɔ Vi la hã ɖe dzii,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: bene ame sia ame si xɔ edzi se la nakpɔ agbe mavɔ.”

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: “Elabe Mawu lɔ̃ xexea ale gbegbe be wòtsɔ Via ɖeka hɔ̃ la na, be ame sia ame si xɔ edzi se la, nagatsrɔ̃ o, ke boŋ wòakpɔ agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu medɔ Via ɖo ɖe xexea me be wòava bu fɔe o, ke boŋ be wòato eyama dzi aɖe xexea me.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Ame si xɔ Vi la dzi se la, womabu fɔe o. Ke ame si mexɔ edzi se o la, wobu fɔe xoxo elabe mexɔ Mawu Vi ɖeka hɔ̃ la dzi se o.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Ale si wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu lae nye be, kekeli la va xexea me, ke amewo lɔ̃ viviti la wu kekeli la elabe woƒe nuwɔnawo vɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Elabe ame sia ame si wɔa nuvɔ̃ la tsri kekeli la, eye mevaa kekeli la gbɔ o, elabe ne eva egbɔ la, woaɖe eƒe nuwɔnawo ɖe go.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ke ame si wɔa nuteƒe la, dona ɖe kekeli la nu bene eme nakɔ na amewo be yewɔa nu ɖe Mawu ƒe didi nu.” Yesu kple Yohanes mawutsilenamela

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo yi ɖe Yudea-nutome. Enɔ afi ma, eye wòle tsi na amewo.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Nyaʋiʋli aɖe si ku ɖe Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋutikɔklɔ ŋuti la, ɖo Yohanes ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple Yudatɔ aɖe dome.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Wova Yohanes gbɔ eye wogblɔ nɛ be: “Nufiala, wò ŋku le ame si nɔ Yordan godo kpli wò, eye nèɖi ɖase le eŋuti la dzia? Eyae nye ema le tsi lem na amewo, eye amewo katã ɖo ta egbɔ.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Yohanes gblɔ na wo be: “Ame mate ŋu axɔ naneke, ne menye Mawue nae o.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔe nye nye ɖasefo be megblɔ be: ‘Menye nyee nye Kristo la o, ke boŋ nye la, ɖeko wodɔm be mado ŋgɔ nɛ.’

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Ame si si ŋugbetɔ le la, eyae nye ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃, eye exɔlɔ̃ si tsi tsitre ɖi hele to ɖomee la kpɔa dzidzɔ ŋutɔ ne ese eƒe gbe. Nenema ke nye hã nye dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ de bliboe.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Eya layi dzi godoo, ke nye la, mayi to.” Ame si tso dziƒo va

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖi tso dziƒo va lae ƒo nuwo katã ta. Ame si tso anyigba dzi la nye anyigba dzi tɔ, eye anyigbadzinuwo ŋutie wòƒoa nu le. Ame si ɖi tso dziƒo va la ƒo wo katã ta.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Eyae ɖia ɖase le nu si wòkpɔ kple nu si wòse la ŋu, gake ame aɖeke mexɔa eƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la o.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Ke ame si xɔ ɖase si wòɖi la, ɖo kpe edzi be Mawu nye nyateƒetɔ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Ame si Mawu dɔ la, gblɔa Mawu ƒe nyawo elabe Mawu tsɔ Gbɔgbɔ la yɔe taŋ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Tɔ́ la lɔ̃ Via, eya ta wòtsɔ nuwo katã de esi ɖo.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Ame si xɔ Vi la dzi se la, agbe mavɔ le esi, ke ame si meɖoa to Vi la o la, makpɔ agbe o, ke Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe le eyama dzi.

english_verse: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself. Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
translation_verse: Evɔ le nyateƒe me la, Yesu ŋutɔ melea tsi na amewo o, eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo koe lenɛ.

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: Ɖe esia ta la, Yesu dzo le Yudea-nutome eye wòtrɔ yi Galilea.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Ke ele nɛ be wòato Samaria-nutome hafi ayi.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Samaria-nyɔnu la gblɔ na Yesu be: “Ale ke wɔ wò Yudatɔ, nèle tsi nono biam nye, Samaria-nyɔnu?” Elabe Yudatɔwo kple Samariatɔwo menyina o.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la gblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, tsikunu mele asiwò o, eye vudo la me goglo. Afi kae nàkpɔ tsi si naa agbe la tsoe?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Wòe wú mía tɔgbui Yakob si ɖe vudo sia na mí, eye eya ŋutɔ, viawo kple eƒe nyiwo no emetsia?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ke ame si ano tsi si manae la, tsikɔ magawui akpɔ o. Elabe tsi si manae la atrɔ azu tsivudo si me agbetsi le la ɖe eyama me. Tsi sia adzi eye wòana agbe mavɔ.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Nyɔnua gblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, na tsi siam ne tsikɔ magawum azɔ o, alo bene magava afi sia, be mava du tsi o.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Heyi nàyɔ srɔ̃wò miava.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la gblɔ na Yesu be: “Aƒetɔ, mekpɔ dze sii be Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelae nènye.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Mía tɔgbuiwo subɔ Mawu le to sia dzi, ke mi Yudatɔwo ya miebe Yerusalem koe nye afi si wòdze be woasubɔ Mawu le.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒenɔ, xɔ nye nya sia dzi se be ɣeyiɣi li gbɔna, si me amewo magado gbe ɖa na Tɔ́ la le to sia dzi loo, alo le Yerusalem o.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Mi Samariatɔwo la, miesubɔa nu si mienya o; ke mí Yudatɔwo la, míenya ame si míesubɔna, elabe Yudatɔwo dzie agbexɔxɔ to va.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Ke ɣeyiɣi li gbɔna, si me mawusubɔla vavãwo asubɔ Tɔ́ la le gbɔgbɔ kple nyateƒe me elabe ame siawo tɔgbee Tɔ́ la di be woasubɔ ye. Nenem ɣeyiɣi sia de gɔ̃ hã xoxo.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Mawu la, Gbɔgbɔ wònye, eya ta ame siwo subɔnɛ la, ele na wo be woasubɔe le gbɔgbɔ kple nyateƒe me.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la gblɔ nɛ be: “Menyae be Mesia gbɔna. Ne eva la, eya lagblɔ nya sia nya na mí.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Nye ame si le nu ƒom kpli wò la, nyee.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Tete ko Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gbɔ va ɖo. Ewɔ nuku na wo be ele nu ƒom kple nyɔnu. Ke wo dometɔ aɖeke mebia be, “Nu ka dim nèle?” alo “Nu ka ta nèle nu ƒom kple nyɔnua?” mahã o.

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la gblẽ eƒe tɔmedeze la ɖi, eye wòyi dua me ɖagblɔ na amewo be:

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Miva kpɔ ame aɖe, si gblɔ nu siwo katã mewɔ kpɔ la nam ɖa. Alo eyae nye Kristo laa?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Tete wodo go tso dua me ɖo ta Yesu gbɔ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi sia me la, nusrɔ̃laawo ɖe kuku na Yesu be: “Nufiala, va ɖu nu.”

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Ke eɖo eŋu na wo be: “Nuɖuɖu le asinye maɖu si miawo mienya o.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Ale nusrɔ̃laawo bia wo nɔewo be: “Alo ame aɖee va na nanee wòɖua?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nye nuɖuɖue nye be mawɔ ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye mawu eƒe dɔ nu.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Menye miawoe gblɔna be, ‘Esusɔ ɣleti ene ko ne nuŋeɣi la naɖo’ oa? Ke mele egblɔm na mi be mida ŋku ɖe agbleawo dzi eye miakpɔ ale si nukuawo tsi na ŋeŋee.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Ame si le nu ŋem la, eyae woxea fe na eye wòƒoa ƒu nukuwo hena agbe mavɔ. Ale be nuwula kple nuŋela siaa nakpɔ dzidzɔ ɖekae.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Nya si wogblɔna be: ‘Ame ɖeka ƒãa nu eye ame bubu ŋenɛ’ la le eteƒe le nya sia me.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Nye la, medɔ mi be miayi aɖaŋe nuku si ta miekpe fu ɖo o la. Ame bubuwo kpe fu ɖe eta, eye miawo miekpɔ viɖe tso woƒe dɔwɔwɔ me.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Samariatɔ geɖe siwo tso dua me va la xɔ Yesu dzi se, le nyɔnua ƒe ɖase si wòɖi le eŋuti be: “Egblɔ nu sia nu si mewɔ kpɔ la nam” la ta.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Ale esi Samariatɔwo va Yesu gbɔ la, wobia tso esi be wòatsi yewo gbɔ, eye Yesu tsi wo gbɔ ŋkeke eve.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Ame bubu geɖewo hã gaxɔ Yesu dzi se le eya ŋutɔ ƒe nya siwo wògblɔ la ta.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Tete wogblɔ na nyɔnu la be: “Meganye wò nyawo tae míexɔ se ɖo o. Míawo ŋutɔe see eye míedze sii be ame siae nye xexea me Xɔla vavã.” Yesu da gbe le fiaŋutime aɖe vi ŋu

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Elabe eya ŋutɔ ɖi ɖase be bubu menɔa Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖeke ŋu le eya ŋutɔ de o.

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu va ɖo Galilea la, woxɔe atuu elabe esi wode ŋkekenyui ɖuƒe le Yerusalem la, wokpɔ nu siwo katã wòwɔ le ŋkekenyui la ɖuɖu me.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Yesu gatrɔ va Kana le Galilea afi si wòtrɔ tsi wòzu wain le la. Dziɖuɖu ƒe amegã aɖe nɔ Kapernaum, ame si vi dze dɔ.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Esi wòse be Yesu tso Yudea va Galilea la, eyi ɖe egbɔ, ɖaɖe kuku nɛ be wòava da gbe le ye viŋutsuvi ŋuti na ye, elabe ɖevia ɖo kudo nu.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Ne miekpɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo o la, miexɔnɛ sena o.”

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Amegã la ɖe kuku nɛ gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, ne míeyi kaba o la, vinye la aku.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Heyi, viwò la atsi agbe.” Ŋutsua xɔ Yesu ƒe nya si wògblɔ nɛ la dzi se, eye wòdze mɔ.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Esi wòyina la, eƒe dɔlawo va kpee, eye wogblɔ nɛ be via tsi agbe.

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Amegã la bia gaƒoƒo si dzi ɖevia de asi hayahaya me, eye wogblɔ nɛ be: “Etsɔ si va yi ƒe ɣetrɔ ga ɖeka mee asrã la kɔ́ le edzi.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Vi tɔ́ la ɖo ŋku edzi be gaƒoƒo ma me tututue Yesu gblɔ na ye be: “Viwò la atsi agbe.” Ale eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe aƒemetɔwo katã xɔ Yesu dzi se.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Esia nye dzesi evelia si Yesu wɔ esi wòtrɔ tso Yudea va Galilea.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, Yudatɔwo ƒe ŋkekenyui aɖe ɖo edzi, eye Yesu yi Yerusalem.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Azɔ tá aɖe le Yerusalem le Alẽgbo la gbɔ si woyɔna le Hebri-gbe me be Betesda. Akpata atɔ̃ le eto. Dɔlélawo ƒe ha gã aɖe mlɔ anyi ɖe

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Ŋutsu aɖe si le dɔ lém ƒe bla etɔ̃ vɔ enyi sɔŋ la le afi ma.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Eƒe nya la mele mia me o, elabe ame si wòdɔ ɖa la miexɔ eyama dzi se o.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kpɔe eye wòdze sii be ame la nɔ dɔba dzi eteƒe didi ŋutɔ la, ebiae be: “Èdi be wò lã me nasẽa?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Dɔnɔa ɖo eŋu be: “Amegã, ne woblu tsia la, ame mele asinye akɔm ada ɖe tá la me o; ale ne meyina ko la, ame bubu trea gege ɖe eme nam.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Tsi tre, kɔ wò aba ne nàzɔ.”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Enumake ŋutsua ƒe lã me sẽ. Ekɔ eƒe aba eye wòzɔ. Gbe ma gbe nye Dzudzɔgbe,

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: ale Yudatɔwo gbe nya na ame si ŋu woda gbe le la gblɔ be: “Egbee nye Dzudzɔgbe. Se meɖe mɔ be nàtsɔ wò aba o.”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: Eɖo eŋu na wo be: “Ame si da gbe le ŋutinye la, eya kee gblɔ nam be: ‘Kɔ wò aba nàzɔ!’ ”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Wobiae be: “Ame kae nye ame si gblɔ na wò be: ‘Kɔ wò aba nàzɔ?’ ”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ame si ŋuti woda gbe le la, medze si Yesu o, elabe ameha gã aɖe nɔ afi ma, eye Yesu ɖe eɖokui ɖe aga le wo dome.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Emegbe la, Yesu kpɔ ame la le mawuxɔ la me eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, wò lã me sẽ! Mègawɔ nuvɔ̃ azɔ o. Ne ègawɔe la, nuvɔ̃ɖi wu esia awɔ wò.”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu la dzo yi ɖagblɔ na Yudatɔwo be Yesue nye ame si da gbe le ye ŋu.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ale Yudatɔwo de asi Yesu yometiti me, elabe eda gbe le ame ŋu le Dzudzɔgbe.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Tɔ́nye gale dɔwɔwɔ dzi ko, eye nye hã mele dɔ wɔm.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Esia ta Yudatɔwo gadi vevie wu be yewoawu Yesu, elabe menye ɖoɖo si le Dzudzɔgbe ŋu la ko dzi wòda o, ke boŋ egblɔ hã be: Mawue nye ye Tɔ́, ale eto esia me fia be yesɔ kple Mawu. Mawu na ŋusẽ Via

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nyateƒe tom mele na mi, be Vi la mate ŋu awɔ naneke le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui si o. Nu si wɔm Tɔ́ la le wòkpɔ la, eya kee Vi la hã wɔna.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Elabe Tɔ́ la lɔ̃ Via eye wòfia nu sia nu si eya ŋutɔ le wɔwɔm la Vi la hã. Ele dɔ gãwo wu esiawo fia ge Vi la be wòawɔ ale be miaƒe nu naku.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Abe ale si Tɔ́ la fɔa ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre, eye wònaa agbe wo ene la, nenema ke Vi la hã naa agbe ame si wòdi lae.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Tɔ́ la medrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame aɖeke o, ke etsɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ katã de Vi la si,

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: bene ame sia ame nabu Vi la, abe ale si wòbua Tɔ́ la ene. Ame si mebua Vi la o la, mebua Tɔ́ la, ame si dɔe ɖa la hã o.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: “Nyateƒe tom mele na mi, be ame si sea nye nya eye wòxɔ ame si dɔm ɖa la dzi se la, agbe mavɔ le esi. Womadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui o, ke eto ku me yi ɖe agbe la me xoxo.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be ɣeyiɣi li gbɔna, si me ame kukuwo ase Mawu Vi la ƒe gbe, eye ame siwo see la woanɔ agbe. Nenem ɣeyiɣi sia de gɔ̃ hã xoxo.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Abe ale si agbe le Tɔ́ la ŋutɔ me ene la, nenema ke wòna agbe le Vi la ŋutɔ hã me.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.

translation_verse: “Nyemate ŋu awɔ naneke le nye ŋutɔ nye ŋusẽ me o. Nu si mese la, eya nue medrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ɖo, eye nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ la le dzɔdzɔe elabe nyemewɔa nye ŋutɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu o, ke boŋ ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nue mewɔna.

translation_verse: “Ne meɖi ɖase le ɖokuinye ŋuti la, nye ɖaseɖiɖi la menye nyateƒe o.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Ame bubu li, si ɖia ɖase le ŋunye, eye menya be ɖase si ɖim wòle le ŋutinye la nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Miedɔ ame ɖo ɖe Yohanes gbɔ, eye wògblɔ nyateƒe la na mi.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, nyemele gbɔgblɔm be mehiã amegbetɔ ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi le ŋutinye o. Megblɔ esia bene woaxɔ mi ɖe agbe.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Yohanes le abe akaɖi si le bibim eye wòle keklẽm la ene, eye mielɔ̃ be yewoakpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe kekelia nu ɣeyiɣi ʋɛ aɖe ko.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, ɖaseɖiɖi si de blibo wu Yohanes tɔ la le asinye. Elabe dɔ siwo Tɔ́nye ɖe mɔ nam be mawɔ awu enu, siwo wɔm mele la, woawoe le ɖase ɖim le ŋutinye be Tɔ́ lae dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Tɔ́nye, ame si dɔm ɖa la, eya ŋutɔe ɖi ɖase le ŋutinye. Miese eƒe gbe kpɔ o, eye miekpɔ ale si wòle la hã kpɔ o.

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Miele mawunyagbalẽawo me dzrom tsitotsito elabe miesusu be yewokpɔa agbe mavɔ le wo me. Mawunyagbalẽawoe le ɖase ɖim le ŋutinye.

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Gake miegbe be yewomava gbɔnye akpɔ agbe o.

translation_verse: “Nyemedi be amewo nakafum o.

translation_verse: Ke menya be mielɔ̃ Mawu o.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Meva le Tɔ́nye ŋkɔ me, ke miexɔm o. Ne ame bubu aɖe ava le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkɔ me la, miaxɔ eyama.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Ale ke lawɔ miate ŋu axɔ ase, esi miele kafukafu dim tso mia nɔewo gbɔ eye miedi kafukafu si tso Mawu ɖeka hɔ̃ la ko gbɔ o?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Migabu be nyee atso mia nu na Tɔ́ la o. Mose, ame si dzi mieda miaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖo lae le mia nu tsom.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Ɖe miexɔ Mose dzi se vavã la, anye ne miaxɔ nye hã dzinye ase, elabe eya ŋlɔ nya ɖi le ŋutinye.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Ke ne miexɔ nu si wòŋlɔ ɖi la dzi se o la, ale ke lawɔ miaxɔ nye nyawo dzi ase?”

translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ be: “Mina ameawo nabɔbɔ nɔ anyi.” Azɔ gbe geɖe le afi ma. Ale ŋutsu siwo ade abe akpe atɔ̃ ene la bɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: Woge ɖe tɔdziʋu me eye wode asi ƒua tsotso me ɖo ta Kapernaum. Zã do azɔ, ke Yesu meva ɖo wo gbɔ haɖe o.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.

translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, ame siwo tsi ƒu la ƒe go kemɛa dzi la, kpɔ be ʋu ɖeka koe nɔ ƒu la nu, eye Yesu menɔ eme kpe ɖe eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋu esime wodze mɔ o. Nusrɔ̃laawo ɖeɖe koe ɖo ʋua dzo.

translation_verse: Migaku kutri ɖe nuɖuɖu si gblẽna la ta o, ke boŋ miku kutri ɖe nuɖuɖu si anɔ anyi hena agbe mavɔ la ta. Nuɖuɖu siae Amegbetɔ Vi la lana mi, elabe eyama dzie Mawu Tɔ́ la da asi ɖo.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe agbalẽ me be, ‘Mawu lafia nu amewo katã!’ Ame sia ame si ɖoa to Tɔ́ la eye wòsrɔ̃a nu tso egbɔ la, vaa gbɔnye.

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Esi fiẽsi ɖo la, Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ɖi va ƒua nu.

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Ƒu la dze agbo, elabe ya sesẽ nɔ ƒoƒom.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃laawo ku ʋua to ƒu la dzi abe agbadroƒe etɔ̃ alo ene ƒe didime ene. Tete wokpɔ Yesu wòle ƒua dzi zɔm gbɔna ɖe ʋua gbɔ, eye vɔvɔ̃ ɖo wo.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nyee. Migavɔ̃ o!”

translation_verse: Esi ameha la dze sii be Yesu megale afi ma o, eye eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo hã meli o la, woawo hã woge ɖe ʋuawo me eye wova Kapernaum hele Yesu dim. Yesue nye abolo si naa agbe

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Nyateƒe tom mele na mi, be menye dzesi siwo miekpɔ la tae miele diyem o, ke boŋ abolo si mieɖu ɖi ƒo la tae.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Wobia Yesu be: “Nu ka míawɔ afia be míele Mawu ƒe dɔ wɔm?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Nu si Mawu di be miawɔ lae nye be miaxɔ ame si wòdɔ ɖa la dzi ase.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Mía tɔgbuiwo ɖu mana le gbedadaƒo, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene be: ‘Ena nuɖuɖu wo tso dziƒo bene woaɖu.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo azɔ be: “Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be menye Mose ye na abolo mi tso dziƒo o! Tɔ́nyee na abolo vavãtɔ si tso dziƒo la mi.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu ƒe aboloe nye esi tso dziƒo va. Eyae naa agbe xexea me.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, na abolo sia mí ɣe sia ɣi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nyee nye abolo si naa agbe la. Ame si va gbɔnye la dɔ mawui gbeɖe o, eye ame si xɔ dzinye se la, tsikɔ mawui akpɔ o.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ke megblɔe na mi be miekpɔm, gake miexɔe se o.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si Tɔ́nye tsɔ nam la ava gbɔnye, eye ame si va gbɔnye la, nyematsɔe aƒu gbe o.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Elabe meɖi tso dziƒo va, menye be mawɔ nye ŋutɔ nye lɔlɔ̃nu o, ke boŋ be mawɔ ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ko.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ame si dɔm ɖa la ƒe lɔlɔ̃nue nye be nu siwo katã wòtsɔ nam la dometɔ aɖeke nagabu o, ke boŋ be magbɔ agbe wo katã le ŋkeke mlɔetɔ la dzi.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Tɔ́nye ƒe lɔlɔ̃nue nye be ame sia ame si kpɔ Vi la, eye wòxɔ edzi se la nakpɔ agbe mavɔ, eye nye la, mafɔe ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke mlɔetɔ la dzi.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ be: “Nyee nye abolo si ɖi tso dziƒo va” la, Yudatɔwo lĩ liʋiliʋĩ le Yesu ŋuti.

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be: “Ɖe menye Yesu, ame si nye Yosef vi lae nye esia oa? Míenya tɔ́a kple dadaa ɖe. Azɔ ale ke wɔ wòle gbɔgblɔm be yeɖi tso dziƒo va?”

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Esia mefia be ame aɖe kpɔ Tɔ́ la kpɔ o. Ame si tso Mawu gbɔ la, eya koe kpɔ Tɔ́ la kpɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be ame si xɔ se la, agbe mavɔ le esi.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Nyee nye abolo si naa agbe.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Mia tɔgbuiwo ɖu mana le gbedadaƒo, ke woku.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Esia nye abolo si ɖi tso dziƒo va bene ame sia ame si ɖui la, nagaku o.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Nyee nye abolo si naa agbe si ɖi tso dziƒo va. Ne ame aɖe ɖu abolo sia la, anɔ agbe tegbee, eye abolo si matsɔ ana be xexea me nakpɔ agbe lae nye nye ŋutilã.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Ale Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be, ne mieɖu Amegbetɔ Vi la ƒe ŋutilã eye mieno eƒe ʋu o la, agbe mele mia me o.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖua nye ŋutilã eye wònoa nye ʋu la, agbe mavɔ le esi, eye nye la, mafɔe ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke mlɔetɔ la dzi.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Elabe nye ŋutilã nye nuɖuɖu vavãtɔ, eye nye ʋu nye nunono vavãtɔ.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖua nye ŋutilã eye wònoa nye ʋu la, ele menye eye nye hã mele eme.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Abe ale si Tɔ́ gbagbe la dɔm ɖa, eye mele agbe le Tɔ́ la ta ene la, nenema ke ame si ɖuam la hã anɔ agbe le tanye.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Abolo si tso dziƒo lae nye esia. Mele abe abolo si ƒomevi tɔgbuiawo ɖu, eye woku la ene o. Ame si ɖu abolo sia la anɔ agbe tegbee.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nya siawo le ƒuƒoƒe, esime wònɔ nu fiam le Kapernaum. Agbe mavɔ nyawo
