english_verse: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu dze sii le eɖokui me be yeƒe nusrɔ̃lawo le liʋiliʋĩ lĩm le nya sia ŋuti la, egblɔ na wo be: “Ɖe esia ɖia mia nua?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Ke ne miekpɔ Amegbetɔ Vi la, wòle dziƒo, afi si wònɔ tsã la yim ɖe, nu ka miawɔ?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ lae naa agbe, ke amegbetɔ ƒe ŋusẽ mele ɖeke me o. Nya siwo megblɔ na mi la, nye gbɔgbɔmenya siwo me agbe le.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Ke ame aɖewo le mia dome siwo mexɔe se o.” Yesu dze si ame siwo mexɔ edzi se o kple ame si lafia eyome mɔ la tso gɔmedzedzea me ke.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Eyi edzi gblɔ be: “Esia ta megblɔ na mi be ame aɖeke mate ŋu ava gbɔnye o, negbe Tɔ́ lae ɖe mɔ nɛ.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Tso esia dzi la, Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃la geɖewo trɔ le eyome eye womegazɔna kplii o.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Yesu bia ame wui eveawo be: “Miawo hã miedi be yewoadzoa?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Simon Petro ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, ame ka gbɔ míadzo ayi? Agbe mavɔ nyawo le asiwò.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Míexɔe se eye míekpɔe dze sii be wòe nye Mawu ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ɖe menye nyee tia mi ame wui eveawo oa? Ke mia dometɔ ɖeka nye Abosam.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Yuda, Simon Iskariot vi la ŋutie wògblɔ esia le elabe eya, ame si nye ame wui eveawo dometɔ ɖeka lae le eyome mɔ fia ge.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, Yesu yi ɖatsa le Galilea-nutome. Medi be yeatsa le Yudea-nutome o, elabe Yudatɔwo nɔ edim be yewoawu.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ƒe Agbadɔ Me Nɔnɔ Ŋkeke Nyui la tu aƒe le ɣe ma ɣi me.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Eya ta Yesu nɔviŋutsuwo gblɔ nɛ be: “Dzo le afi sia nàyi ɖe Yudea-nutome bene wò nusrɔ̃la siwo le afi ma hã nakpɔ dɔ siwo wɔm nèle.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Ame si dina be amewo nanya yeƒe dɔwɔwɔ la, mebèna o. Esi nèle dɔ siawo wɔm la, ɖe ɖokuiwò fia xexea me.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Elabe nɔvia ŋutsuwo kekeake hã mexɔ edzi se o.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nye ɣeyiɣi meɖo haɖe o, ke ɣeyiɣi ɖe sia ɖe sɔ na miawo ya.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Xexea me mate ŋu alé fu mi o, ke elé fu nye ya, elabe mele ɖase ɖim tso eŋuti be eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo vɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Miawo la, miheyi ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe. Nye la, nyemayi ŋkekenyui sia ɖuƒe o, elabe nye ɣeyiɣi mede haɖe o.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ esia na wo la, eya ŋutɔ gatsi Galilea. Yesu le Agbadɔmenɔnɔ ŋkekenyui ɖuƒe

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Ke esi nɔviawo dzo yi ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe la, Yesu hã yi, menye be amewo nakpɔ ye o, ke eyi le adzame.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo nɔ edim le ŋkekea ɖuƒe henɔ biabiam be: “Afi ka ŋutsu ma le?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Amehawo do dalĩ gblɔ nya geɖe le Yesu ŋuti. Esime ame aɖewo gblɔ be: “Enye ame nyui” la, bubuwo ya gblɔ be: “Kpao, ele amewo kplɔm trae.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Ke ame aɖeke meɖee gblɔ sesĩe o, elabe wole Yudatɔwo vɔ̃m.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke Nyui la ƒe titina lɔƒo la, Yesu yi ɖe mawuƒe la me eye wòfia nu amewo.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Eƒe nufiafia wɔ nuku na wo eye wogblɔ be: “Ale ke wɔ ame sia nya agbalẽ alea, evɔ la, mede nusrɔ̃ƒe kpɔ o?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Nu si fiam mele la menye nye ŋutɔ tɔnyee o; ame si dɔm ɖa la tɔe wònye.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Ame si di be yeawɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, anya nenye be nye nufiafia la tso Mawu gbɔ loo, alo nye ŋutɔ nye ŋusẽe metsɔ le nu ƒomee.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒoa nu le eɖokui ŋuti la le kafukafu dim na eɖokui, ke ame si dia ame si dɔe ɖa la ƒe kafukafu la, enye nyateƒetɔ eye alakpa mele eme o.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Ɖe menye Mose ye na se la mi oa? Ke mia dometɔ aɖeke melé se la me ɖe asi o. Nu ka ta miedi be yewoawum?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Amehawo gblɔ nɛ be: “Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ le mewò! Ame kae di be yeawu wò?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Dɔ ɖeka ko mewɔ eye mi katã miaƒe nu ku.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Mose wɔ se na mi be miatso aʋa, eye mietsoa aʋa na amewo le Dzudzɔgbe.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Ne edze be woatso aʋa na ame aɖe le Dzudzɔgbe bene magada Mose ƒe se la dzi o la, nu ka ta miedo dziku ɖe ŋunye elabe meda gbe le ame aɖe ƒe ameti blibo la ŋu eƒe lã me sẽ keŋkeŋ le Dzudzɔgbe?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Yerusalemtɔ aɖewo bia be: “Menye ame sia dim wole be yewoawu oa?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Eyae nye esi le nu ƒom faa le dutoƒo eye ame aɖeke mebia nya aɖekee o! Ɖe eme kɔ na dumegãwo azɔ keŋ be ame siae nye Kristo laa?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Míawo la, míenya afi si ame sia tso, gake ne Kristo la ya do la, ame aɖeke manya afi si wòtso o.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Azɔ esime Yesu le nu fiam le mawuƒe la me la, ekɔ gbe dzi bia be: “Ɖe miebe yewonyam eye yewoanya afi si metso la hã? Nyemeva le ɖokuinye si o; ame si dɔm ɖa la nye nyateƒetɔ. Miawo mienyae o,

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: ke nye ya menyae elabe eya gbɔe metso va eye eyae dɔm ɖa.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Tete wodi be yewoalée, ke ame aɖeke meka asi eŋu o, elabe eƒe ɣeyiɣi la mede haɖe o.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Ke ame geɖewo xɔ edzi se. Wogblɔ be: “Ne Kristo la va do la, ɖe wòawɔ dzesiwo wu esiwo ame sia wɔa?” Wodɔ dzɔlawo ɖa be woalé Yesu

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisitɔwo se nu siwo ƒe dalĩ dom ameha la le le Yesu ŋuti, eya ta nunɔlagãwo kple Farisitɔwo dɔ kpovitɔwo ɖa be woayi aɖalée.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Maganɔ mia dome ʋɛ eye emegbe la, madzo ayi ame si dɔm ɖa la gbɔ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Miadim, ke miakpɔm o, elabe afi si mele la, miate ŋu ava afi ma o.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo bia wo nɔewo be: “Afi ka ame sia ɖo be yeayi eye míadii do kpo? Ɖe wòɖoe be yeayi Yudatɔ siwo kaka ɖe Helatɔwo dome la gbɔ aɖafia nu Helatɔwoa?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Egblɔ be, ‘Miadim, ke miakpɔm o.’ Egagblɔ hã be, ‘Afi si mele la, miate ŋu ava o.’ Egɔme ɖe?” Agbetsi dzidziwo

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Le ŋkekenyuia ƒe ŋkeke mlɔetɔ si nye ŋkeke vevitɔ dzi la, Yesu tsi tsitre, eye wòɖe gbeƒã be: “Ne tsikɔ le ame aɖe wum la, neva gbɔnye wòano tsi.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: ‘Ame si xɔ dzinye se la, tɔsisi siwo naa tsi si me agbe le la ladzi tso eƒe dzime.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Azɔ la, egblɔ esia le Gbɔgbɔ si ame siwo xɔ edzi se la laxɔ la ŋuti, elabe esi womekpɔ kɔ̀ Yesu ŋutɔ hã ŋuti haɖe o ta, womena Gbɔgbɔ la haɖe o. Memama ɖo Yudatɔwo dome

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Esi ameawo se Yesu ƒe nya siawo la, wo dometɔ aɖewo gblɔ be: “Nyateƒee, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela lae nye ame sia.”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Bubuawo be: “Kristo lae nye esi.” Ke ame aɖewo ya bia be: “Galilea ye Kristo la latsoa?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Mawunya megblɔe ɖi be Kristo la anye Fia David ƒe dzidzimevi, eye wòatso Betlehem, si nye kɔƒe si me David nɔ la me oa?”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ale ameawo dome ma le Yesu ta.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ aɖewo di be yewoalée. Ke ame aɖeke meka asi eŋu o. Yudatɔwo ƒe amegãwo mexɔ Yesu dzi se o

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Esi kpovitɔwo trɔ va nunɔlagãwo kple Farisitɔwo gbɔ la, wobia wo be: “Ale ke wɔ mielée vɛ o?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Kpovitɔawo ɖo eŋu be: “Ame aɖeke meƒo nu kpɔ abe ale si ame sia ƒo nui ene o.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Farisitɔwo bia wo be: “Ãa, ɖe wòflu miawo hã?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Amegã alo Farisitɔ kae xɔ edzi se mienya?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Ke ameha sia, si menya naneke le Mose ƒe se la ŋu o la, woƒo fi de wo!”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Nikodemo, ame si de Yesu gbɔ va yi la nɔ wo dome. Ebia wo be:

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Ɖe míaƒe se la drɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame nenye be womese eƒe numegbe, eye wonya nu si wòwɔ la oa?”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Galilea ye wò hã nètsoa? Dzro mawunyagbalẽawo me kpɔ, ekema àkpɔe adze sii be Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖeke mele dodo ge tso Galilea o.”

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Tete ame sia ame dzo yi eƒeme.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: [Ke Yesu yi ɖe Amito la dzi.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke ŋdi kanya la, Yesu gava mawuxɔ la me, eye amewo katã va egbɔ. Ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi eye wòfia nu wo.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ na Yesu be: “Nufiala, wolé nyɔnu sia wòle ahasi wɔm.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Le se la me la, Mose na ŋusẽ mí be míaƒu kpe ame sia tɔgbe. Nu ka gblɔm wò ya nèle le eŋuti?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Wobia nya sia Yesu be yewoatee kpɔ ne yewoakpɔ nya aɖe atso enui. Ke Yesu bɔbɔ ɖi eye wòle nu ŋlɔm kple eƒe asibidɛ ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Esi woganɔ nya biamee kokoko la, Yesu fɔ kɔ dzi gblɔ na wo be: “Mia dometɔ si ŋu nuvɔ̃ mele o la, netsɔ kpe ƒu nyɔnu la gbã.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Yesu gabɔbɔ ɖi eye wòle nu ŋlɔm ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Ke esi ameawo se nyaa la, wodzo ɖekaɖeka tso tsitsiawo dzi va se ɖe esime wòsusɔ eya kple nyɔnua ɖeɖe ko ɖi.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Yesu fɔ dzi eye wòbiae be: Aƒenɔ, ameawo ɖe? Ame aɖeke mebu fɔ wò oa?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ao, Aƒetɔ.” Ale Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Ekema nye hã nyemabu fɔ wò o. Heyi, mègawɔ nuvɔ̃ azɔ o.”] Yesu, xexea me ƒe kekeli

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Yesu gaƒo nu na ameawo be: “Nyee nye xexea me ƒe kekeli, ame si dze yonyeme la, mazɔ viviti me o.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Tete Farisitɔwo gblɔ nɛ be: “Èle ɖase ɖim le ɖokuiwò ŋuti, eya ta wò ɖaseɖiɖi la menye nyateƒe o.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Nenye be meɖi ɖase le ɖokuinye ŋu hã la, nye ɖaseɖiɖi nye nyateƒe, elabe menya afi si metso va kple afi si meyina. Miawo la, mienya afi si metso alo meyina la o.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Miawo la, miedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu le amegbetɔwo ƒe nukpɔkpɔ nu; ke nye la, nyemedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame aɖeke o.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, ne medrɔ̃ ʋɔnu hã la, nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzɔ, elabe menye nye ɖekae drɔ̃a ʋɔnu o, ke boŋ nye kple ame si dɔm ɖa lae.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Nye la, meɖia ɖase le ɖokuinye ŋu, eye Tɔ́nye si dɔm ɖa la hã ɖia ɖase le ŋutinye.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Wobia Yesu azɔ be: “Afi ka tɔ́wò le?” Eɖo eŋu na wo be: “Mienyam o, eye mienya Tɔ́nye hã o. Ne ɖe mienyam la, anye ne mienya Tɔ́nye hã.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nya siawo le nudzɔƒe la, esime wòle nu fiam le mawuƒe la me. Ke ame aɖeke melée o, elabe eƒe ɣeyiɣia mede haɖe o. Miate ŋu ayi afi si meyina la o

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Yesu gagblɔ na ameawo be: “Nye la, mele dzodzo ge. Miadim eye miaku ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃ me. Afi si nye la meyina la, miawo miate ŋu ava o.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Tete Yudatɔwo gblɔ be: “Eɖokui wu ge wòala ta wògblɔ be, ‘Miate ŋu ava afi si yim mele la o’ mahã?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Miawo la, anyigba sia dzi mietso, ke nye la, dziƒoe metso va. Xexe sia me tɔwoe mienye; ke nye la, nyemenye xexe sia me tɔ o.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Eya tae megblɔ na mi be miaku ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃ me. Ne miexɔe se, be menye ame si menye o la, miaku ɖe miaƒe nuvɔ̃ me.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Wobiae be: “Ame ka nènye?” Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Megblɔe na mi le gɔmedzedzea me, eya ke gblɔm megale na mi.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Nya geɖe le asinye ɖe mia ŋu, be matsɔ abu fɔ mi, ke ame si dɔm ɖa la, nyateƒetɔ wònye eye nu si mese tso egbɔ la ƒe gbeƒã ɖem mele na xexea me.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Womese egɔme be Tɔ́ la ŋutie Yesu le nu ƒom le na yewo o.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Eya ta egblɔ na wo be: “Ne miekɔ Amegbetɔ Vi la ɖe dzi la, hafi miadze sii be nyee nye ame si mebe menye la, eye nyemele naneke wɔm le nye ŋutɔ nye ŋusẽ me o. Nu si Tɔ́ la fiam lae megblɔna.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Ame si dɔm ɖa la li kplim. Megblẽ nye ɖeka ɖi o, elabe mewɔa nu si dzea eŋu ɣe sia ɣi.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siawo la, ame geɖe xɔ edzi se. Ablɔɖeviwo kple kluviwo

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu gblɔ be: “Miɖe asi le eŋu. Mina wòadzrae ɖo na nye ɖigbe.

english_verse: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.” A Plot To Kill Lazarus
translation_verse: Ame dahewo ya le mia gbɔ ɖaa, ke nye la, nyemanɔ mia gbɔ ɖaa o.” Woɖo nugbe ɖe Lazaro ŋu

english_verse: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus.
translation_verse: Ale nunɔlagãwo de adaŋu be yewoawu Lazaro hã,

english_verse: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ale wova Filipo, si tso Betsaida le Galilea la gbɔ eye wogblɔ nɛ be: “Amegã, míedi be míakpɔ Yesu.”

english_verse: But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.” Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
translation_verse: Farisitɔwo gblɔ na wo nɔewo be: “Mikpɔ ɖa, naneke mele edzi dzem na mí o. Kpɔ ɖa! Xexea me katã kplɔe ɖo!” Helatɔ aɖewo di be yewoakpɔ Yesu

english_verse: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!”
translation_verse: Tɔ́, nà wò ŋkɔ nade dzi!” Tete gbe ɖi tso dziƒo be: “Mena wòde dzi xoxo, eye magana wòade dzi ake.”

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: “Egbã woƒe ŋkuwo, eye wòna wosẽ to, be womagakpɔ nu kple ŋku, eye woƒe susu nase nu gɔme, ne woatrɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye mada gbe le wo ŋu o.”

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, ameha gã siwo va ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe la se be Yesu gbɔna ɖe Yerusalem.

english_verse: “People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.”
translation_verse: “Zion-du, mègavɔ̃ o! Wò fiae nye esi gbɔna, le tedzivi dom.”

english_verse: At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.
translation_verse: Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo mese nu siawo gɔme gbã o, ke esi wokɔ̀ Yesu ŋuti emegbe la, woɖo ŋku edzi be nu si woŋlɔ ɖi tso eŋu lae nye ema wowɔnɛ.

english_verse: A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle.
translation_verse: Nu si ta ameha la yi ɖakpe Yesu lae nye be wose be ewɔ dzesi sia.

english_verse: Some Greeks had gone to Jerusalem to worship during Passover.
translation_verse: Helatɔ aɖewo hã nɔ ame siwo yi be yewoasubɔ Mawu le ŋkekenyuia ɖuƒe la dome.

english_verse: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him. The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
translation_verse: Filipo yi ɖagblɔe na Andrea eye wo ame evea woyi ɖagblɔe na Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Ɣeyiɣia de azɔ be woado Amegbetɔ Vi la ɖe dzi.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi le nyateƒe me be, ne bliku mege ɖe anyigba me eye wòku o la, bliku ɖeka ko wònye li. Ke ne eku la, etsea ku geɖe.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃ eƒe agbe la, abui. Ke ame si lé fu eƒe agbe le xexe sia me la, adzrae ɖo hena agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: “Nye luʋɔ le nu xam fifia. Nya ka magblɔ? Ɖe magblɔ be, ‘Tɔ́, ɖem tso fukpeɣi sia me’ loo? Ao, ke boŋ ɣeyiɣi sia tae meva ɖo.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ameha si tsi tsitre ɖi la see eye wogblɔ be dzie ɖe gbe, ke ame bubuwo be: “Mawudɔla aɖee ƒo nu kplii.”

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Mia tae gbe sia ɖi, ke menye nye tae o.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Eɖo edzi azɔ be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexe sia me; eɖo edzi azɔ be woanya xexe sia me dziɖula ɖa.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Ne wokɔm ɖe dzi tso xexea me la, mahe amewo katã ava nye ŋutɔ gbɔnyee.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ esia be yeatsɔ afia ku si ƒomevi ku ge yeala.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Tete ameha la ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Míenya le se la me be Kristo la anɔ anyi tegbee. Ale ke wɔ nègblɔ be ele be woakɔ Amegbetɔ Vi la ɖe dzii? Ame kae nye Amegbetɔ Vi sia?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Kekelia aganɔ mia gbɔ ʋɛ ko. Zi ale si kekelia li la mizɔ, ne menye nenema o la, zã ado ɖe mi. Ame si le viviti me zɔm la, menya afi si yim wòle o.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Esi kekelia le mia gbɔ la, mixɔ kekeli la dzi se bene miazu kekeli viwo.” Ameawo ƒe dzimaxɔse Esi Yesu gblɔ nya sia vɔ la, edzo le wo gbɔ yi ɖabè.

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ewɔ dzesi geɖe ŋutɔ le wo ŋkume hã la, womexɔ edzi se o,

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: ale be Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya ƒe nya si wògblɔ ɖi la nava eme be: “Aƒetɔ, ame kae xɔ nya si míegblɔ la dzi se, eye ame kae woɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋusẽ fia?”

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Eya ta womete ŋu xɔe se o elabe Yesaya gagblɔ hã be:

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Yesaya gblɔ nya sia elabe ekpɔ Yesu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖa, eye wòƒo nu le eŋu.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wòle alea hã la, amegã geɖewo gɔ̃ hã xɔ Yesu dzi se. Ke wonɔ vɔvɔ̃m be Farisitɔwo ava nya yewo le ƒuƒoƒe la me, eya ta womegblɔe fia o.

english_verse: And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God. Jesus Came To Save the World
translation_verse: Elabe wolɔ̃na be amewo nakafu yewo wu be Mawu nakafu yewo. Yesu ƒe nyawo abu fɔ ame

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yesu do ɣli gblɔ be: “Ame sia ame si xɔ dzinye se la, menye nye dzie wòxɔ se o, ke boŋ ame si dɔm ɖa la dzie wòxɔ se.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si kpɔm la, ekpɔ ame si dɔm ɖa la hã.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Ɖe meva xexea me abe kekeli ene, ale be ame sia ame si xɔ dzinye se la, naganɔ viviti me o.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe se nye nyawo eye mewɔ ɖe wo dzi o la, nye la, nyemebu fɔe o, elabe nyemeva fɔ bu ge xexea me o, ke boŋ meva be maxɔe ɖe agbe.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Ame si gbem eye mexɔ nye nyawo o la, ame si abu fɔe la li. Nya siwo megblɔ lae abu fɔe le ŋkeke mlɔetɔ dzi.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Elabe menye nye ŋutɔ nye ŋusẽe metsɔ ƒo nui o, ke Tɔ́ si dɔm ɖa la ŋutɔe na ŋusẽm be maƒo nu, agblɔ nu si megblɔ.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Menya be eƒe se la naa agbe mavɔ. Eya ta nya siwo megblɔna la, megblɔa wo abe ale si Tɔ́ la gblɔ nam tututu la ene.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Hafi Paska la naɖo la, Yesu nya be yeƒe ɣeyiɣi de be yeadzo le xexe sia me ayi Tɔ́ la gbɔ. Elɔ̃ ame siwo nye etɔ le xexea me. Elɔ̃ wo yi ɖase keke nuwuwu ke.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu kple eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo nɔ anyi le fiẽnuɖuƒe. Vɔ̃ɖitɔ la dee susu me na Yuda, si nye Simon Iskariot vi la xoxoxo be wòade Yesu asi.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Ke Yesu nya be Tɔ́ la tsɔ nu sia nu de asi na ye. Enya be Mawu gbɔe yetso va eye Mawu gbɔ yim yegale.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: Azɔ etsi tsitre le nua ɖuƒe, ɖe eƒe awu da ɖi eye wòtsɔ tsiletse sa ɖe ali.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: Etrɔ tsi ɖe agba me, eye wòde asi eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe afɔkɔklɔ me. Etsɔ tsiletse si wòsa ɖe ali la tutu afɔ na wo.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Esi wòɖo Simon Petro dzi la, Petro gblɔ na Yesu be: “Aƒetɔ, wòe aklɔ afɔ nama?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Nu si wɔm mele la, màse egɔme haɖe o, ke emegbe la, àse egɔme.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Petro gblɔ nɛ be: “Ao, màklɔ nye afɔ akpɔ gbeɖe o!” Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ne nyemeklɔ afɔ na wò o la, màkpɔ gome aɖeke le gbɔnye o.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro gblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, ekema manye nye afɔ ɖeɖe o, ke boŋ klɔ nye asi kple ta hã!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Ame si le tsi la, megahiã ŋutikɔklɔ o; negbe afɔ ko wòaklɔ, elabe eƒe afi sia afi ɖi xoxo. Miawo la, mia ŋuti ɖi, ke menye mi katãe o.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu nya ame si lafia eyomemɔ, eya tae wògblɔ be: “Menye mi katã ŋutie ɖi o.”

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Esi Yesu klɔ afɔ na eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo vɔ la, egado awu eye wòɖabɔbɔ nɔ kplɔ̃a ŋu. Ebia wo be: “Miese nu si mewɔ na mi la gɔmea?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Mieyɔam be Nufiala kple Aƒetɔ. Ele eme nenema tututu elabe eyae menye.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Kpɔɖeŋu wònye mena mi, be miawo hã miawɔ abe ale si mewɔe na mi la ene.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi le nyateƒe me be ŋusẽ mele subɔla si wu eƒe aƒetɔ o, eye nenema ke ŋusẽ mele dɔla hã si wu ame si dɔe ɖo ɖa la o.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: “Menye mi katã ŋuti mele glɔm ɖo o; menya ame siwo metia. Ke ele be mawunya sia nava eme be: ‘Ame si le abolo ɖum kplim la, tso ɖe ŋunye.’

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Mele nya sia gblɔm na mi hafi wòava dzɔ, ale be ne eva dzɔ la, miaxɔe ase be nyee nye ame si li tegbee.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Esi wòte ɖe Yesu ŋu alea ta la, ebi kɔ do ɖe eƒe akɔta eye wòbiae be: “Aƒetɔ, ame kae?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, etsi dzi vevie le eɖokui me ale wòʋu eme gblɔ be: “Nyateƒe tututu tom mele na mi be mia dometɔ ɖeka ladem asi.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃laawo dometɔ ɖeka si Yesu lɔ̃na la, bɔbɔ nɔ Yesu gbɔ kpuie.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Ale Simon Petro mia ŋku ɖee hegblɔ nɛ be: “Bia ame si gblɔm wòle lae.”

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ aɖewo bu be esi wònye Yuda sie woƒe gakotokua le ta la, ɖewohĩ Yesu ɖe wògblɔ nɛ be neƒle nu si yewole tsɔtsɔ ge aɖu ŋkekenyui lae loo, alo ɖe wòbe netsɔ nane na ame dahewo.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Yuda xɔ aboloa la, edo go enumake. Zã do. Se yeye la

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Nenye be woɖe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe fia le Amegbetɔ Vi la me la, ekema Mawu aɖe Amegbetɔ Vi la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe afia le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui me enumake.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Vinyewo, nyemaganɔ mia gbɔ eteƒe nadidi o. Miadim. Nya si megblɔ na Yudatɔwo va yi la, eya ke ko gblɔm mele na miawo hã fifia be: ‘Afi si meyina la, miate ŋu ava o.’

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Simon Petro biae be: “Aƒetɔ, afi ka yim nèle?” Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Afi si yim mele la, màte ŋu adze yonyeme ayi fifia o, ke emegbe la, àdze yonyeme.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Petro biae be: “Aƒetɔ, nu ka ta nyemate ŋu adze yowòme haɖe o? Maku ɖe tawò gɔ̃ hã.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Àku ɖe tanyea? Nyateƒe tututu tom mele na wò be koklo maku atɔ hafi nàgbe nu le gbɔnye zigbɔzi etɔ̃ o.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: “Migana dzika natso mia ƒo o. Mixɔ Mawu dzi se eye mixɔ nye hã dzinye se.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Tɔ́nye ƒeme la, nɔƒe geɖe li. Ne ɖe mele nenema o la, anye ne nyemagblɔ be meyina nɔƒe dzra ge ɖo ɖi na mi o.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne meyi ɖadzra nɔƒe ɖo na mi vɔ la, matrɔ ava kplɔ mi ayi ɖokuinye gbɔ, ale be afi si mele la, miawo hã mianɔ afi ma.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Afi si meyina la, mienya mɔa.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Toma biae be: “Aƒetɔ, míenya afi si yim nèle o, ale ke míanya mɔ lae?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Nyee nye mɔ la, nyateƒe la kple agbe la. Ame aɖeke mevaa Tɔ́ la gbɔ o, negbe to dzinye ko.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyam la, anye ne mienya Tɔ́nye hã. Ke tso fifia heyina la, mienya eyama eye miekpɔe hã.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Filipo gblɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, fia Tɔ́ la mí ekema esɔ gbɔ na mí.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Filipo, nye sia le mia gbɔ xoxoxoa, mènyam kpɔ o? Ame sia ame si kpɔm la, ekpɔ Tɔ́ la. Ale ke wɔ nègagblɔ be, ‘Fia Tɔ́ la mí’?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Ɖe mèxɔe se be mele Tɔ́ la me eye Tɔ́ la hã le menye oa? Nya siwo gblɔm mele na mi la, metso nye ŋutɔ gbɔnye o. Ke boŋ Tɔ́ la, ame si le menye lae le eƒe dɔ wɔm.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Mixɔ dzinye se ne mebe mele Tɔ́ la me, eye Tɔ́ la hã le menye. Ne miexɔ nya siawo se o la, ekema mixɔe se le dɔwɔwɔ siawo ta.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe tututu tom mele na mi be ame sia ame si xɔ dzinye se la, awɔ dɔ siwo wɔm mele la. Ẽ, awɔe wu tɔnye sãa, elabe Tɔ́ la gbɔ yim mele.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si miebia le nye ŋkɔ me la mawɔe na mi, ale be woaɖe Tɔ́ la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe afia le Via me.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Ne miebia nane le nye ŋkɔ me la, nye la, mawɔe. Yesu do Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ŋugbe

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Ne mielɔ̃m la, milé nye seawo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Mele kuku ɖe ge na Tɔ́ la, ale be wòaɖo Nyaxɔɖeakɔla bubu, si ava nɔ mia gbɔ tegbee la, ɖe mi.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Eya nye Gbɔgbɔ si fiana be Mawu nye nyateƒetɔ. Xexea me mate ŋu axɔe o, elabe mate ŋu akpɔe hafi ava yi si dze gee o. Ke miawo ya, mienyae elabe ele mia gbɔ eye wòanɔ mia me.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: “Nyemagblẽ miawo ɖeɖe ko ɖi abe tsyɔ̃evi ene o. Magbɔ va mia gbɔ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Esusɔ ʋɛ ko xexea me magakpɔm o, ke miawo ya miakpɔm. Esi mele agbe ta la, miawo hã mianɔ agbe.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, miadze sii be mele Tɔ́nye me eye miawo miele menye eye nye hã mele mia me.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Ame si lé nye seawo me ɖe asi eye wòwɔa wo dzi la, eyae nye ame si lɔ̃m. Ame si lɔ̃m la, Tɔ́nye alɔ̃e. Nye hã malɔ̃e eye maɖe ɖokuinye afiae.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Yuda, esi menye Iskariot o la, gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, ale ke wɔ wònye míawo ko nèle ɖokuiwò ɖe ge afia, ke màɖe ɖokuiwò afia xexea me ya o?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ne ame aɖe lɔ̃m la, alé nye nya la me ɖe asi. Tɔ́nye alɔ̃e eye mía kple Tɔ́nye míava ɖo nɔƒe ɖe egbɔ.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Ame si melɔ̃m o la, meléa nye nyawo me ɖe asi o. Nya si megblɔ miese la menye nye ŋutɔ tɔnyee o, ke boŋ Tɔ́ la, ame si dɔm ɖa la tɔ ye.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “Megblɔ nya siawo na mi elabe megale mia gbɔ ko.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Ke Nyaxɔɖeakɔla si nye Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe si Tɔ́ la aɖo ɖa le nye ŋkɔ me la, afia nu sia nu mi eye wòaɖo ŋku nya siwo katã megblɔ na mi la dzi na mi.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa nenɔ mia dzi. Nye ŋutifafa mele mia nam. Nyemele mia nam abe ale si xexea me nanɛ la ene o. Migana dzika natso mia ƒo o, eye vɔvɔ̃ hã megaɖo mi o.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Miese, megblɔ na mi va yi be: ‘Mele dzodzom, ke matrɔ agbɔ va mia gbɔ.’ Ne ɖe mielɔ̃m la, anye ne miekpɔ dzidzɔ be meyina Tɔ́ la gbɔ. Elabe eya tri akɔ wum.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Azɔ mele esia gblɔm na mi do ŋgɔ, ale be ne eva dzɔ la, miaxɔe ase.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Nyemagaƒo nu na mi ayi edzi boo o, elabe xexemedziɖula la gbɔna. Ke ŋusẽ mele esi ɖe dzinye o,

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: elabe mewɔa Tɔ́ la ƒe gbe dzi pɛpɛpɛ bene xexea me nanyae be melɔ̃ Tɔ́ la. Mitso mídzo le afi sia.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: “Nyee nye wainti vavãtɔ la, eye Tɔ́nyee nye agbledela la.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Alɔ sia alɔ si le ŋunye eye metsea ku o la, elãnɛ ɖa. Ke ɖe sia ɖe si tsea ku la, eɖea eŋu nyuie bene wòatse ku geɖe wu.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Wokɔ mia ŋuti xoxo to nya si megblɔ na mi la me.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Minɔ menye eye nye hã manɔ mia me. Ale si alɔa ɖeɖe mate ŋu atse ku le eɖokui si o, negbe ɖe wòle waintia ŋu la, nenema ke miawo hã, ne mienɔ me nye o la miate ŋu atse ku o.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Nyee nye wainti la, eye miawo mienye alɔawo. Ame si wɔ ɖeka kplim eye nye hã mewɔ ɖeka kplii la, eyae tsea ku geɖe elabe nye manɔmee la, miate ŋu awɔ naneke o.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Ame si mewɔ ɖeka kplim o la, wotsɔnɛ ƒua gbe, abe atilɔ ene eye wòƒuna. Woƒoa ƒu atilɔawo ƒua gbe ɖe dzo me wofiãna.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ ɖeka kplim eye nye nyawo hã le mia me la, mibia nu sia nu si miedi la ko; woawɔe na mi.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne mietse ku geɖe la, esia ɖe Tɔ́nye ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe fia, eye wòɖo kpe edzi be nye nusrɔ̃lawo mienye.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Ale si Tɔ́ la lɔ̃m la, nenemae nye hã melɔ̃ mii. Mina nye lɔlɔ̃ na mi nayi edzi le mia me.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Ne mielé nye seawo me ɖe asi la, nye lɔlɔ̃ na mi ayi edzi le mia me, abe ale si nye hã melé Tɔ́nye ƒe seawo me ɖe asi, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ nam le edzi yim le menye la ene.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “Mele nya siawo gblɔm na mi, ne dzidzɔ si le menye la nanɔ miawo hã mia me, bene miaƒe dzidzɔ nade blibo.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Se si nam mele mie nye be: Milɔ̃ mia nɔewo abe ale si melɔ̃ mii ene.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ deto meli wu be ame natsɔ eƒe agbe ake ɖe xɔlɔ̃a ta o.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ ɖe nye nyawo dzi la, ekema mienye xɔ̃nyewo.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Nyemegale mia yɔm be dɔlawo o, elabe dɔla menya nu si eƒe aƒetɔ wɔna o. Ke meyɔ mi be xɔ̃nyewo, elabe nu siwo katã mese tso Tɔ́nye gbɔ la, mena mienya wo.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Menye miawoe tiam o, ke boŋ nyee tia mi, eye meɖo mi ɖa be miayi aɖatse ku eye be ku si miatse la nanɔ anyi ɖaa. Ale be nu sia nu si miabia Tɔ́ la le nye ŋkɔ me la, wòana mi.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Ale se si mele mia nam lae nye be: Milɔ̃ mia nɔewo. Xexea me ƒe fuléle

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Ne xexea me lé fu mi la, minyae be elé fum do ŋgɔ na mi.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Ne xexea me tɔ mienye la, anye ne xexea me lɔ̃ mi abe etɔwo ene. Ke esi metia mi tso xexea me eye mieganye xexea me tɔ o tae wòlé fu mi ɖo.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nya si megblɔ na mi la dzi be: ‘Ŋusẽ mele subɔla si wu eƒe aƒetɔ o.’ Ne woti yonyeme la, woati miawo hã mia yome tsã. Ne wolé nye nyawo me ɖe asi la, woalé miawo hã mia tɔ me ɖe asi.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ke woawɔ nu siawo katã ɖe mia ŋuti le tanye, elabe womenya ame si dɔm ɖa la o.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe nyemeva ƒo nu na wo o la, anye ne womewɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Ke azɔ la, wowɔ nuvɔ̃ eye taflatsɛdodo aɖeke meli na wo o.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si lé fum la, lé fu Tɔ́nye hã.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe nyemewɔ dɔ si ame aɖeke mewɔ kpɔ o la le wo dome o la, anye ne womewɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Ke azɔ la, wokpɔ nu siwo mewɔ gake wolé fu nye kple Tɔ́nye siaa.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Esia va eme ale be nu si woŋlɔ ɖe woƒe segbalẽa me la nava eme be: ‘Ɖeko wolé fum dzodzro.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Ke mele Nyaxɔɖeakɔla ɖo ge ɖe mi tso Tɔ́ la gbɔ. Eyae nye Gbɔgbɔ si fiana be Mawu nye nyateƒetɔ. Ne etso Tɔ́ la gbɔ va la, aɖi ɖase na mi le ŋunye.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Miawo hã ɖasefowo mianye elabe miele gbɔnye tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke.

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “Megblɔ nya siawo katã na mi ale be amewo nagana miagbɔdzɔ o.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Woaɖe mi le woƒe ha me. Le nyateƒe me la, ɣeyiɣi li gbɔna si ne ame aɖe wu mi la, wòabu be Mawu ƒe dɔ wònye wɔm yele.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Wole nu sia wɔ ge ɖe mia ŋuti, elabe womenyam o, eye womenya Tɔ́ la hã o.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Ke mele nya siawo gblɔm na mi ale be ne ɣeyiɣia ɖo, eye wova ve me la, miaɖo ŋku edzi be megblɔ wo na mi. Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ƒe dɔ “Nyemegblɔ nya siawo na mi le gɔmedzedzea me o elabe mele mia gbɔ.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, mele tɔtrɔm ayi ame si dɔm ɖa la gbɔ, ke mia dometɔ aɖeke mebiam be afi ka yim mele hã o.

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Gake esi megblɔ nya siawo na mi la, mielé blanui.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wòle alea hã la, nyateƒe tom mele na mi be: Enyo na mi be madzo, elabe ne nyemedzo o la, Nyaxɔɖeakɔla la mava mia gbɔ o. Ke ne meyi la, maɖoe ɖa.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Nenye be wòva la, ana xexea me tɔwo nadze si nu si nye nuvɔ̃, dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: Woadze si nu si nye nuvɔ̃ elabe womexɔ dzinye se o;

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: woadze si nu si nye dzɔdzɔenyenye elabe mele Tɔ́ la gbɔ yim eye miagakpɔm akpɔ o;

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: woadze si nu si nye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ elabe wobu fɔ xexe sia me dziɖula xoxo.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: “Nya geɖe gale asinye magblɔ na mi, gake awu tsɔtsɔ na mi fifia.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ne Gbɔgbɔ si fiana be Mawu nye nyateƒetɔ la va la, ana mianya nyateƒe la katã tso Mawu gbɔ. Elabe magblɔ nya aɖeke le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ me o, ke nu si wòse la ko wòagblɔ, eye wòaƒo nu le nu siwo ava dzɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Eyama aɖe nye ŋutikɔkɔe afia elabe aɖe gbeƒã nu si wòxɔ tso gbɔnye la na mi.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Nu siwo katã nye Tɔ́ la tɔ la, tɔnyee. Eya ta megblɔ be asee tso gbɔnye ahagblɔ na mi. Nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe nuxaxa kple dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Tete eƒe nusrɔ̃la aɖewo bia wo nɔewo be: “Nya kae nye esia wògblɔ na mí be, ‘Esusɔ vie miagakpɔm o, ke madidi o miagakpɔm!?’ Egagblɔ hã be, ‘Elabe mele Tɔ́ la gbɔ yim.’

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be, ‘Esusɔ vie’ si wògblɔ la gɔme ɖe? Míese nu si gblɔm wòle la gɔme o.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yesu nya be nya aɖe le wo si wodi be yewoabia. Ale egblɔ na wo be: “Mebe, ‘Esusɔ vie miagakpɔm o, ke madidi o miagakpɔm.’ Nya sia me dzrom miele kple mia nɔewoa?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be miafa avi, afa konyi, ke xexea me lakpɔ dzidzɔ. Miawo la, miaxa nu, ke miaƒe nuxaxa latrɔ azu dzidzɔ.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Ne fú le nyɔnu ɖum la, exaa nu elabe eƒe ɣeyiɣia de. Ke ne edzi vi vɔ la, ekpɔa dzidzɔ be yedzi ame ɖe xexea me, eye wòŋlɔa veve helihelĩ si wòse la be.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Ale miele nu xam fifia, ke megale mia kpɔ ge eye dzi adzɔ mi ale gbegbe be ame aɖeke mate ŋu atsi miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ nu o.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, miegale naneke bia gem o. Nyateƒe tom mele na mi be, ne miebia nane Tɔ́ la la, ana mi le tanye.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Va se ɖe fifi la, miebia naneke to dzinye kpɔ o. Mibia ko, woana mi ale be miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ nade blibo. Yesu ɖu xexea me dzi

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: “Megblɔ nya siawo na mi to lododo me. Ke ɣeyiɣi gbɔna, si me nyemagaƒo nu na mi le lododo me o, ke boŋ maɖe nya me na mi faa tso Tɔ́ la ŋu.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, miabia nu le nye ŋkɔ me eye magahiã be mabia Tɔ́ la ɖe mia nu o,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: elabe Tɔ́ la ŋutɔ lɔ̃ mi. Elɔ̃ mi elabe miawo hã mielɔ̃m eye miexɔe se be eya gbɔe metso va.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Tɔ́ la gbɔ metso va xexea me, eye mele tɔtrɔm tso xexea me ayi Tɔ́ la gbɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo gblɔ be: “Ehɛ̃, fifi ko nèle nu ƒom na mí faa nye esi, eye meganye le lododo me o.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Míenya azɔ be ènya nu sia nu eye megahiã be ame aɖeke nabia nya aɖeke wò o. To esia me míexɔe se be Mawu gbɔe nètso.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Miexɔe se azɔa?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi li gbɔna; si me woaka mi ahlẽ ale be ame sia ame nayi eya ŋutɔ ƒeme eye nye ɖeka matsi anyi. Ɣeyiɣi sia ɖo gɔ̃ hã xoxo. Ke menye nye ɖeɖee li o elabe Tɔ́ la le gbɔnye.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Megblɔ esia na mi ale be ŋutifafa nasu mia si esi miewɔ ɖeka kplim ta. Xaxa tu mi le xexea me. Ke milé dzi ɖe ƒo. Nye la, meɖu xexea me dzi!”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu gblɔ nya siawo vɔ la, ewu mo dzi kpɔ dziƒo gblɔ be: “Tɔ́, ɣeyiɣia de. Do Viwò la ɖe dzi ale be Viwò la hã nado wò ɖe dzi.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Elabe èna ŋusẽe ɖe amegbetɔƒomea katã dzi be wòana agbe mavɔ ame siwo katã nètsɔ nɛ la.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Agbe mavɔ lae nye be woanya wò, Mawu Nyateƒetɔ ɖeka hɔ̃ la kple Yesu Kristo si nèdɔ ɖa la.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Nye la, mewɔ dɔ si nède asi nam be mawɔ le xexea me la wu enu, eye to eme la, meɖe wò ŋutikɔkɔe fia.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Azɔ Tɔ́, tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si mekpɔ le gbɔwò hafi xexea me nava dzɔ la ɖe nye ŋutikɔkɔe fia le wò ŋutɔ ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: “Meɖe wò fia ame siwo nètia ɖa tso xexea me, eye nètsɔ wo nam la kɔtɛe. Tɔwòwoe wonye ya, ke ètsɔ wo nam. Wolé wò nya la me ɖe asi pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Wonya azɔ be nu sia nu si nètsɔ de asi nam la tso gbɔwò.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Metsɔ nya si nède asi nam be matsɔ ayii na wo la hã na wo, eye woxɔe. Wonya be gbɔwòe metso nyateƒe, eye woxɔe se be wòe dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Nye la, mele kuku ɖem ɖe wo ta. Nyemele kuku ɖem ɖe xexea me ta o, ke boŋ ɖe ame siwo nètsɔ nam la ta elabe tɔwòwoe wonye.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Nye nuwo katã nye tɔwò, nenema ke tɔwòwo katã hã nye tɔnye, eye woɖe nye ŋutikɔkɔe fia to wo dzii.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, megbɔna gbɔwò. Nyemegale xexea me o, ke woawo ya woli. Tɔ́ kɔkɔe, wò ŋutɔ tsɔ wò ŋusẽ si nènam la kpɔ wo ta be woazu ɖeka, abe ale si nye kple wò míele ɖekae ene.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Esi menɔ wo gbɔ la, mekpɔ wo ta le wò ŋkɔ si netsɔ nam la me. Medzɔ wo ŋu ale gbegbe be wo dometɔ aɖeke mebu o, negbe ame si wòle be wòatsrɔ̃ godoo la ko, bene mawunya nava eme.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, megbɔna gbɔwò. Megblɔ nya siawo le xexea me bene woawo hã nakpɔ dzidzɔ, abe ale si nye hã mele ekpɔmee la ene.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Nye la, megblɔ wò nya la na wo, ke esi wometso xexea me o abe ale si nye hã nyemetso xexea me o ene ta la, xexea me lé fu wo.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Nyemele biabiam be nàɖe wo ɖa le xexea me o, ke boŋ be nàkpɔ wo ta dedie tso vɔ̃ɖitɔ la si me.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Esi nyemetso xexea me o ta la, woawo hã wometso xexea me o.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Wɔ wo kɔkɔe le nyateƒe la me; wò nya la nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Medɔ wo ɖo ɖe xexea me, abe ale si wò hã nèdɔm ɖo ɖe xexea mee ene.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Le woawo ta la, mewɔ ɖokuinye kɔkɔe bene woawɔ woawo hã kɔkɔe le nyateƒe la me.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: “Nyemele esia biam na woawo ɖeɖe ko o, ke boŋ mele ebiam na ame siwo axɔ dzinye se to nya si woagblɔ na wo la hã me.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: Meɖe kuku, wɔ wo woazu ɖeka. Tɔ́, nà be woawo hã nanɔ mía me, abe ale si nèle menye eye nye hã mele mewò la ene, ale be xexea me naxɔe se be wòe dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Nye la, metsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si nètsɔ nam la na wo, be woawo hã woazu ɖeka, abe ale si mía kple wò míele ɖekae ene.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Nye la, mele wo me eye wò hã nèle menye, be woazu ɖeka ade blibo keŋ ale be xexea me nanyae be wòe dɔm ɖa eye nèlɔ̃ wo, abe ale si nèlɔ̃m ene.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Tɔ́, medi be ame siwo nètsɔ nam la hã nanɔ afi si mele la kplim bene woakpɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si nètsɔ nam, elabe èlɔ̃m hafi woɖo xexea me gɔme anyi.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Tɔ́ Dzɔdzɔetɔ, xexea me menya wò o, ke nye ya menya wò eye ame siawo hã nya be wòe dɔm ɖa.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: Mena wodze si wò kɔtɛe eye mana woagadze si wò ɖe edzi wu, ale be lɔlɔ̃ si nètsɔ nam la, nanɔ wo me eye nye hã manɔ wo me.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã la ƒe dɔlawo dometɔ ɖeka, si nye ame si ƒe to Petro kpa nɔvi la biae be: “Ɖe nyemekpɔ wò le egbɔ le abɔa me oa?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Egabia wo be: “Ame ka dim miele?” Woɖo eŋu be: “Yesu Nazaretetɔ lae.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Megblɔ na mi xoxo be nyee. Eya ta nenye diyem miele la, miɖe mɔ na ame siawo nadzo.”

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: Egblɔ esia be woawu nya si wògblɔ va yi la nu be: “Ame siwo nètsɔ nam la dometɔ aɖeke mebu o.”

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Tete Simon Petro he yi si le esi la ɖe go, eye wòda nunɔlagã la ƒe dɔla hekpa ɖusime to nɛ. Dɔla sia ŋkɔe nye Malxo.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Ale asrafoha la kple woƒe aʋakplɔlagã kpakple Yudatɔwo ƒe dɔlawo lé Yesu heblae.

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: esime Petro ya le tsitre le xexe ɖe agboa nu. Nusrɔ̃la bubu sia si nye nunɔlagã la ƒe ame nyanyɛ la do go yi ɖaƒo nu na nyɔnuvi si le agboa nu dzɔm la, eye wòkplɔ Petro ge ɖe eme.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Nyɔnuvi agbonudzɔla sia bia Petro be: “Wò hã ɖe, menye ame sia ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo dometɔ ɖeka nènye oa?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Gbeɖe, nyemenye eƒe nusrɔ̃la o.”

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Azɔ esi vuvɔ nɔ wɔwɔm ta la, dɔlaawo kple dzɔlaawo do akadzo, tsi tsitre ƒo xlãe nɔ ƒuƒum. Petro hã le tsitre ɖe wo gbɔ nɔ dzoa ƒum. Nunɔlagã la bia gbe Yesu (Mat

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã la bia gbe Yesu le eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kple eƒe nufiafia ŋuti.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Nu ka tae nègale gbe biamem? Bia ame siwo se nye nyawo. Woawo la, wonya nya siwo megblɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu le babla nenema, eye Hana ɖoe ɖe Kayafa, nunɔlagã la gbɔ. Petro gagbe nu le Yesu gbɔ (Mat

english_verse: ) Pilate went back out and said, “I don't find this man guilty of anything!
translation_verse: ) Esi Pilato gblɔ nya sia vɔ la, egado go yi Yudatɔwo gbɔ le xexe eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Nyemekpɔ be ame sia wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖeke o.

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Ŋdi kanya la, wokplɔ Yesu tso Kayafa ƒeme yi ɖe mɔ́mefia la ƒe fiasã me. Yudatɔwo ƒe amegãwo ŋutɔ mege ɖe fiasã la me o, elabe wodi be yewo ŋuti nanɔ kɔkɔe hena ŋutitoto la ɖuɖu.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Eya ta Pilato do go yi wo gbɔ eye wòbia wo be: “Nya kae mietsɔ ɖe ame sia ŋu?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ame sia ɖe menye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔla o la, anye ne míekplɔe vɛ na wò o.”

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: Nu sia dzɔ be nya si Yesu gblɔ ɖi le ku si ƒomevi ku ge wòala ŋu la nava eme.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Pilato trɔ yi ɖe fiasã la me eye wòyɔ Yesu biae be: “Wòe nye Yudatɔwo ƒe fia laa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Wò ŋutɔ koe bia nya siam loo, alo ame aɖewoe gblɔ nye nya na wò?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Pilato ɖo eŋu be: “Yudatɔwo menyea? Wò ŋutɔ mia detɔwo kple nunɔlagãwoe kplɔ wò vɛ nam. Nu kae nèwɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Nye fiaɖuƒe metso xexe sia me o. Ne nye fiaɖuƒe ɖe wòtso xexe sia me la, anye ne nye dɔlawo ʋli tanye eye nyemege ɖe Yudatɔwo si me o. Ke nye fiaɖuƒe la metso xexe sia me o.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Pilato biae be: “Ekema fiae nènyea?” Yesu ɖo eŋu be: “Wòe gblɔe be fiae menye. Nye la, esia tae medzɔ ɖo, eye eya tae meva xexea me ɖo be magblɔ nyateƒe la afia. Ame sia ame si ɖoa tom la tso nyateƒea me.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Pilato bia be: “Nu kae nye nyateƒe?” Wotso kufia na Yesu (Mat

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Le miaƒe dekɔnu nu la, ele be maɖe asi le gaxɔmenɔla ɖeka ŋu na mi le Paskaa me. Miedi be maɖe asi le Yudatɔwo ƒe fia la ŋu na mia?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli be: “Gbeɖe, menye ame sia o! Ɖe asi le Baraba ŋu na mí!” Ke Baraba la, adzodala wònye.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Tete Pilato na wokplɔ Yesu dzoe eye wòna woƒoe.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Asrafoawo tsɔ ŋu lɔ̃ kuku heɖɔ nɛ. Esi wodo awu ʋlaya dzĩ aɖe nɛ vɔ la,

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: wote ɖe eŋu gblɔ nɛ be: “ Miedo gbe na wò, Yudatɔwo ƒe fia!” Azɔ la, woƒo tome nɛ.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Pilato gado go yi xexe ake eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Mikpɔ ɖa, makplɔe vɛ na mi bene miadze sii be nyemekpɔ be ewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖeke o.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Ale Yesu do go va, ŋudzakuku la le eta eye awu ʋlaya dzĩ la le eŋu. Pilato gblɔ na wo be: “Mikpɔ ɖa, ame lae nye esi!”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Esi nunɔlagãwo kple dzɔlawo kpɔe la, wodo ɣli be: “Klãe ɖe ati ŋuti! Klãe ɖe ati ŋuti!” Pilato gblɔ na wo be: “Miawo ŋutɔ mikplɔe yii miaɖaklã ɖe ati ŋuti. Nye la, nyemekpɔ be ewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖeke o.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Se le mía si, eye le se la nu la, edze be wòaku elabe etsɔ eɖokui wɔ Mawu Vie.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Esi Pilato se nya siawo la, egavɔ̃ wu tsã.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Egatrɔ yi ɖe fiasã la me eye wòbia Yesu be: “Du ka mee nètso?” Ke Yesu zi kpi.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Pilato biae be: “Màɖo nya la ŋu nam oa? Alo mènya be ŋusẽ le asinye be maɖe asi le ŋuwò alo mana woaklã wò ɖe ati ŋu oa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ne ɖe womena ŋusẽ wò tso dziƒo o la, anye ne màkpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dzinye o. Eya ta ame si tsɔm de asi na wò la ƒe nuvɔ̃ vɔ̃ɖi wu tɔwò.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Esi Pilato se esia la, edi be yeaɖe asi le eŋu hafi, ke Yudatɔwo do ɣli bobobo gblɔ be: “Ne èɖe asi le ame sia ŋu la, ke menye Roma Fiagã la xɔlɔ̃ nènye o! Ame sia ame si tsɔ eɖokui wɔ fiae la, tsi tre ɖe Roma Fiagã la ŋu!”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
