translation_verse: Esi Pilato se nya siawo la, ekplɔ Yesu do goe, eye eya ŋutɔ bɔbɔ nɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpui dzi le teƒe si woyɔna be Kpenyigba la. Woyɔa teƒe sia le Hebri-gbe me be Gabata.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbee nye Dzadzraɖoŋkeke na Ŋutitoto la. Anɔ ŋdɔ ga wui eve lɔƒo. Pilato gblɔ na Yudatɔwo be: “Miaƒe fia lae nye esi!”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Tete Pilato ɖe asi le Yesu ŋu na wo be woaklã ɖe ati ŋu. Woklã Yesu ɖe atitsoga ŋu (Mat

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Ale asrafoawo va eye woŋe afɔ na ame gbãtɔ kple ame kemɛ, siwo woklã kpe ɖe Yesu ŋu la.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ƒe nunɔlagãwo gblɔ na Pilato be: “Mègaŋlɔ nua be, ‘Yudatɔwo ƒe Fia la’ o, ke boŋ ŋlɔe be, ‘Ame sia gblɔ be, Nyee nye Yudatɔwo ƒe Fia la.’ ”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Esi Yesu kpɔ dadaa kple nusrɔ̃la si gbɔ melɔ̃a nu le o, le tsitre ɖe egbɔ kpuie la, egblɔ na dadaa be: “Danye, kpɔ ɖa, viwòe nye esi!”

english_verse: ) Jesus was taken away,
translation_verse: ) Ale wokplɔe yii.

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Eya ŋutɔ tsɔ eƒe atitsoga va ɖo teƒe si woyɔna be Ametakoliƒe. Woyɔnɛ le Hebri-gbe me be Golgata.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Woklãe ɖe ati ŋu le afi sia. Woklã ame bubu eve hã ɖe ati ŋu kpe ɖe eŋu. Wole eƒe axa eveawo dzi, eye Yesu le wo titina.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Pilato ŋlɔ nutsonya ɖe atitsoga la ƒe tagbɔ. Nu si wòŋlɔ lae nye: “YESU NAZARETETƆ, YUDATƆWO ƑE FIA LA.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Yudatɔ geɖewo xlẽ nutsonya sia elabe afi si woklã Yesu ɖo la te ɖe dua ŋu. Gawu la, woŋlɔ nua ɖe Hebri-gbe, Roma-gbe kple Hela-gbe me.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Pilato ɖo eŋu be: “Nu si meŋlɔ la, meŋlɔe vɔ.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Asrafoawo gblɔ na wo nɔewo be: “Migana míavuvu eya o; midzidze nu ɖe edzi ne míakpɔe ɖa be ame kae axɔe hã.” Nya sia dzɔ be mawunya sia nava eme be: “Woma nye awuwo ɖe wo nɔewo dome; nye awutewui ʋlaya la, wodzidze nu ɖe edzi.”

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Aleae asrafoawo wɔ enye esi. Azɔ Yesu dada, dadaa nɔvinyɔnu Maria, ame si nye Klopa srɔ̃ kple Maria Magdalatɔ le tsitre ɖe atitsoga la gbɔ.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Ke esi woɖo Yesu gbɔ la, wokpɔ be eku xoxo eya ta womegaxaŋe eƒe afɔwo o.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Azɔ abɔ aɖe le afi si woklã Yesu ɖe ati ŋu le la. Yɔdo yeye aɖe le abɔ la me si me womeɖi ame ɖo kpɔ o.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Azɔ Yesu nya azɔ be nu sia nu wu nu vɔ. Ke be mawunya si gbɔna la nava eme la egblɔ be: “Tsikɔ le wuyem.”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Tsikunu aɖe le afi ma si me wokɔ wain veve ɖo wòyɔ. Ale wotsɔ tsilɔnu si wode wain vevea me la tɔ ɖe hisɔp nu ɖo nu na Yesu.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Esi wòno wain vevea la, egblɔ be: “Wowu enu azɔ!” Tete wòde ta to hemia nu. Asrafowo tɔ nu Yesu ƒe axadame

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Dzadzraɖoŋkekee nye gbe ma gbe, eye Dzudzɔgbe si kplɔe ɖo la nye ŋkeke kɔkɔe na Yudatɔwo, eya ta womedi be ame kukuawo natsi atitsogaawo ŋu Dzudzɔgbe naɖo o. Esia ta wobia Pilato be wòaɖe mɔ ne woaŋe woƒe afɔwo, eye woaɖe wo tso atitsogaawo ŋu.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Ke asrafoawo dometɔ ɖeka tsɔ akplɔ tɔ Yesu ƒe axadame. Tete ʋu kple tsi do enumake.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Ame si kpɔ nu sia teƒe lae ɖi ɖase le eŋu be wò hã nàxɔe ase. Nu si wògblɔ la nye nyateƒe eye wònya kɔtɛe hã be nyateƒee yeto.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Esiawo dzɔ ale be mawunya sia nava eme be: “Womele eƒe ƒu aɖeke ŋe ge o.”

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Mawunya bubu hã gblɔ be: “Woafɔ ŋku ɖe ame si ƒe axadame wotɔ nui la dzi.” Yesu ɖiɖi (Mat

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Esi wònye gbe ma gbee nye Dzadzraɖoŋkeke eye gawu la, yɔdoa hã te ɖe wo ŋu ta la, woɖii ɖe afi ma.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, Yosef, Arimatiatɔ la va bia Pilato be yeatsɔ ame kukua adzoe. Yosef sia nye Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃la aɖe le adzame le vɔvɔ̃ na Yudatɔwo ta. Pilato ɖe mɔ nɛ. Ale Yosef va tsɔ ame kukua dzoe.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Ale wobla atikea ɖe ame kuku la ŋu kple aklala abe ale si Yudatɔwo wɔa ame kuku hafi ɖina la ene.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Toma ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Nye Aƒetɔ kple nye Mawu!”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Azɔ le Kwasiɖagbe ŋdi kanya esi xexea me mekɔ haɖe o la, Maria Magdalatɔ va yɔdoa gbɔ. Ekpɔ be woɖe kpea ɖa le yɔdoa nu.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la kemɛ si ɖo yɔdoa gbɔ gbã la hã ge ɖe eme. Ekpɔ aklala la kple takua eye wòxɔe se.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, esime Yesu va la, Toma, ame wui eveawo dometɔ ɖeka si wogayɔna hã be Evenɔvi la, menɔ wo tɔwo dome o.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ mawudɔla eve, siwo le awu ɣiwo me. Wobɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe afi si wotsɔ Yesu ƒe kukua mlɔe; ɖeka le eƒe tagbe eye evelia le eƒe afɔnu.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ale wòƒu du yi ɖe Simon Petro kple nusrɔ̃la kemɛ si gbɔ Yesu melɔ̃a nu le o la gbɔ, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Wova kɔ Aƒetɔ la dzoe le yɔdoa me, eye míenya afi si wodae ɖo o.”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Petro kple nusrɔ̃la kemɛa dò go, eye woɖo ta yɔdoa gbɔ.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Wo ame evea ƒu du, ke nusrɔ̃la kemɛa dze le Petro ŋu va ɖo yɔdoa gbɔ gbã.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: Mege ɖe yɔdoa me o, ke boŋ ɖeko wòbɔbɔ do kɔ ɖa kpɔ eme, eye wòkpɔ aklala la ɖeɖe ko le afi ma.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Simon Petro le eyome va ɖo, ke eya ge ɖe yɔdoa me. Ekpɔ aklala la le afi ma.

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: Taku si wotsɔ bla ta na Yesu hã li gake mele aklala la gbɔ o, ke boŋ woƒoe da ɖe afi bubu.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Ke Maria tsi tsitre ɖe yɔdoa to nɔ avi fam. Esi wòle avi fam la, ebɔbɔ be yeakpɔ yɔdoa me ɖa.

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Wobiae be: “Aƒenɔ, nu ka ta nèle avi fam?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Wotsɔ nye Aƒetɔ la dzoe eye nyemenya afi si wokɔe yi ɖada ɖo o!”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Yesu biae be: “Aƒenɔ, nu ka ta nèle avi fam? Ame ka dim nèle?” Eya bu be abɔa dzikpɔla lae eya ta egblɔ na Yesu be: “Amegã, nenye wòe kɔe dzoe la, ekema gblɔ afi si nèkɔe da ɖo la nam, ale be mayi aɖakɔe adzoe.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Mègaka asi ŋunye o, elabe nyemekpɔ yi dziƒo le Tɔ́ la gbɔ haɖe o. Ke yi ɖe nɔvinyeawo gbɔ nàgblɔ na wo be meyina dziƒo ɖe Tɔ́nye kple mia Tɔ́, nye Mawu kple miaƒe Mawu la gbɔ.”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ esia la, etsɔ eƒe asi kple axadame fia wo. Nusrɔ̃laawo kpɔ Aƒetɔ la eye dzi dzɔ wo.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Le Kwasiɖagbe ma ƒe fiẽ la, nusrɔ̃laawo ƒo ƒu ɖe xɔ me. Wonɔ vɔvɔ̃m na Yudatɔwo eya ta wodo ʋɔawo. Tete Yesu va tsi tsitre ɖe wo dome, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Ŋutifafa na mi!”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Yesu gagblɔ na wo be: “Ŋutifafa na mi! Mele mia dɔm ɖa abe ale si Tɔ́ la dɔm ɖa ene.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ esia vɔ la, egbɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Mixɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Ne mietsɔ amewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke wo la, wotsɔ wo ke wo, ke ame siwo tɔwo mietsɔ ke wo o la, wometsɔ wo ke wo o.” Yesu kple Toma

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Ale nusrɔ̃la bubuawo gblɔ nɛ be: “Míekpɔ Aƒetɔ la!” Ke Toma gblɔ na wo be: “Ne nyemekpɔ gatagbadzɛbiawo teƒe le eƒe asiwo me, eye metsɔ nye asibidɛ ƒo ɖe gatagbadzɛbiawo teƒe eye metsɔ nye asi ƒo ɖe eƒe axadame o la, nyemaxɔe ase akpɔ o.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Ŋkeke enyi megbe la, nusrɔ̃lawo gaƒo ƒu ɖe aƒea me eye Toma hã le wo dome. Ʋɔawo nɔ tutu, ke Yesu va tsitre ɖe wo titina eye wògblɔ be: “Ŋutifafa na mi.”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na Toma be: “Tsɔ asibidɛ de afii, eye nàkpɔ nye asiwo ɖa. Do asi ɖa eye nàƒoe ɖe nye axadame. Dzudzɔ ɖikeke, ne nàxɔ se.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Esi nèkpɔm tae nèxɔe sea? Woyra ame siwo mekpɔm o, ke wòxɔe se.” Agbalẽ sia ƒe taɖodzinu

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Yesu gawɔ dzesi bubu geɖe le eƒe nusrɔ̃laawo ŋkume siwo womeŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me o.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Ke woŋlɔ esiawo ɖi be miate ŋu axɔe ase be Yesue nye Kristo, Mawu Vi la, eye ne miexɔe se la, miato eyama dzi akpɔ agbe.

english_verse: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Esiawo megbe la, Yesu gaɖe eɖokui fia eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo le Tiberia-ƒua nu. Ale si wòɖe eɖokui fia la nye esi:

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Simon Petro kple Toma si woyɔna be Evenɔvi kple Nataniel tso Kana le Galilea kple Zebedeo viwo kpakple Yesu ƒe nusrɔ̃la bubu eve woƒo ƒu ɖi.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Simon Petro gblɔ na wo be: “Meyi tɔƒo mava.” Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Míawo hã míayi kpli wò.” Ale woyi ɖage ɖe tɔdziʋua me heyi. Ke womeɖe lã aɖeke zã blibo la o.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Fɔŋli la, Yesu va tsi tsitre ɖe ƒua nu, ke nusrɔ̃laawo menya be Yesue o.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Ɖeviwo, míeɖe lã aɖea?” Woɖo eŋu be: “Ao!”

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na wo be: “Mida ɖɔa ɖe ʋua ƒe ɖusime, eye miakpɔ aɖe.” Ale woda ɖɔa. Woɖe lã ale gbegbe be wode ɖɔa he ge do kpoe.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la si gbɔ Yesu melɔ̃a nu le o la gblɔ na Petro be: “Aƒetɔ lae!” Esi Petro se be Aƒetɔ lae la, etsɔ eƒe dziwui sa ɖe ali elabe amama wòle ɖi, eye wòdzo dze tsia me doo.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Esi woɖi go ɖe ƒua ta la, wokpɔ akadzo le afi ma si me lã aɖe le eye abolo aɖe hã le afi ma.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Tete Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Mitsɔ lã si mieɖe fifia la ƒe ɖe vɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Yesu gblɔ na wo be: “Miva ɖu nu.” Ke nusrɔ̃laawo dometɔ aɖeke medo dzi biae be: “Ame ka nènye?” hã o, elabe wonya be Aƒetɔ lae.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Yesu va eye wòtsɔ aboloa na wo. Nenema ke wòtsɔ lã la hã na wo.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Zigbɔzi etɔ̃liae nye esi Yesu ɖe eɖokui fia eƒe nusrɔ̃lawo le esime wòfɔ tso ku me megbe. Yesu ƒo nu kple Petro

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Esi woɖu nu vɔ la, Yesu bia Simon Petro be: “Simon, Yona vi, èlɔ̃m wu ale si ame siawo lɔ̃m mahã?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Ẽ, Aƒetɔ, ènya be melɔ̃ wò.” Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Nyi nye alẽviawo!”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Yesu gabiae zi evelia be: “Simon, Yona vi, èlɔ̃ma?” Eɖo eŋu be: “Ẽ, Aƒetɔ, ènya be melɔ̃ wò.” Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ nye alẽawo dzi!”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Yesu gabiae zi etɔ̃lia be: “Simon, Yona vi, èlɔ̃ma?” Biabia sia ve Petro, elabe zigbɔzi etɔ̃ sɔŋ nye esi Yesu biae be: “Èlɔ̃ma?” Ale Petro ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, wò ŋutɔ ènya nu sia nu ɖe. Ènya be melɔ̃ wò ɖe.” Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Nyi nye alẽawo!

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Nyateƒe tom mele na wò be, esi nènye ɖekakpui la, ète ŋu saa avɔ ɖe ali na ɖokuiwò hezɔna yia afi sia afi si nèdi la. Ke ne èva tsi ku amegã la, ɖe nèle wò abɔwo me keke ge ale be ame bubu nasa avɔ ɖe ali na wò, eye wòakɔ wò ayi afi si mèdi o la.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Egblɔ esia be yeatsɔ aɖe ku si ƒomevi Petro le kuku ge, atsɔ aɖe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe afia lae. Esia megbe la, Yesu gblɔ nɛ be: “Dze yonyeme.” Yesu kple nusrɔ̃la si gbɔ melɔ̃a nu le o

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Petro trɔ eye wòkpɔ nusrɔ̃la si gbɔ Yesu melɔ̃a nu le o la wòkplɔ wo ɖo gbɔna. Nusrɔ̃la siae nɔ anyi ɖe Yesu gbɔ kpuie le fiẽnuɖuɣi ma eye wòbia Yesu be: “Aƒetɔ, ame ka gɔ̃e le yowòme mɔ fia ge?”

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Esi Petro kpɔe la, ebia Yesu be: “Aƒetɔ, nu kae ladzɔ ɖe ame sia dzi?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ne medi be neganɔ anyi va se ɖe esime magbɔ ɖe, etsɔ gbɔwòa? Wò la, dze yonyeme!”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Nya sia kaka ɖe Yesu yomedzelawo dome be nusrɔ̃la sia maku o. Evɔ la, Yesu megblɔ nɛ be maku o, ke boŋ ɖe wògblɔ nɛ be: “Ne medi be neganɔ anyi va se ɖe esime magbɔ ɖe, etsɔ gbɔwòa?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la siae le ɖase ɖim le nu siawo ŋuti eye eyae nye ame si ŋlɔ wo da ɖi hã. Ale míenya be nu siwo ŋuti wòɖi ɖase le la nye nyateƒe. Nuwunyawo

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Yesu gawɔ nu bubu geɖewo hã. Nenye ɖe woŋlɔ wo katã da ɖi ɖekaɖeka la, mebu be womate ŋu akpɔ agbalẽawo daɖoƒe le xexe blibo la katã gɔ̃ hã me o.

english_verse: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first
translation_verse: Teofilo lɔlɔ̃tɔ, Le nye Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ me la, meŋlɔ nu tso nu siwo Yesu wɔ kple nu siwo wòfia, tso esime wòdze eƒe dɔ gɔme

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: va se ɖe ŋkeke si dzi wokɔe yi dziƒo la ŋuti. Hafi woakɔe ayi dziƒoe la, eto Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ƒe ŋusẽ me gblɔ nu siwo wòle be ame siwo wòtia, abe eƒe amedɔdɔwo ene la nawɔ.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Esi wògale wo gbɔ la, ede se na wo gblɔ be: “Migadzo le Yerusalem o, ke boŋ milala nunana si ŋugbe Tɔ́ la do, esi ŋuti meƒo nu le na mi la.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Yohanes le mawutsi na amewo kple tsi, ke le ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo megbe la, woatsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe alee na miawo ya.” Wokɔ Yesu yi dziƒo

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Ale esi amedɔdɔawo gakpe ta la, wobia Yesu be: “Aƒetɔ, ɖe nèle fiaɖuƒe la gbugbɔ ge ana Israel azɔa?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Yesu ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Miawo la, mehiã be mianya ɣeyiɣi alo azãgbe siwo Tɔ́ la ŋutɔ ɖo ɖi le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ nu la o.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Ke ne Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la va mia dzi la, miaxɔ ŋusẽ, eye mianye nye ɖaseɖilawo le Yerusalem kple Yudea katã kpakple Samaria va se ɖe xexeme ƒe seƒe ke.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ esia vɔ la, woƒe ŋkume alea ko, wokɔe yi dzii, eye alilikpo aɖe xɔe dzoe le wo gbɔ.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Ke esime wogale dziƒo kpɔm gã wòyina la, kasia ŋutsu eve le awu ɣi me le tsitre ɖe wo gbɔ. Ame siawo gblɔ na wo be:

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: “Galilea-ŋutsuwo, nu ka ta miele tsitre le dziƒo kpɔm ale? Yesu sia, si wokɔ dzoe le mia gbɔ yi dziƒo la, gale vava ge abe ale si miekpɔe wòle yiyim la ene.” Wotia Yuda teƒenɔla

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Esi woɖo dua me la, woyi ɖe dziƒoxɔ si me wonɔ la dzi. Amedɔdɔawoe nye: Petro kple Yohanes, Yakobo kple Andrea, Filipo kple Toma, Bartolomeo, kple Mate, Yakobo Alfeo vi kple Simon, Ɖokuisinɔnɔdilawo ƒe habɔbɔmenɔla kple Yuda Yakobo vi.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Ame bubuwo hã nye: Maria, Yesu dada kple Yesu nɔviŋutsuwo. Ame siawo katã ƒoa ƒu kple susu ɖeka henɔ gbe dom ɖa vevie.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: “Azɔ la, Yuda tsɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi si wòwɔ la ƒe fetu yi ɖaƒle anyigba aɖe. Anyigba sia dzi wòge va dze anyi heku le. Eƒe ƒodo wó, eye eƒe dɔmenuwo ka hlẽ.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã le Yerusalem la, va se nya sia, ale wotsɔ ŋkɔ na anyigba ma be, ‘Ʋunyigba’ si woyɔna le wo degbe me be, ‘Akeldama.’

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: “Elabe woŋlɔe ɖi le Psalmowo me be: ‘Eƒe aƒe neɖi gbɔlo, eye ame aɖeke neganɔ eme o!’ Wogaŋlɔ ɖi hã be: ‘Ame bubu nexɔ eƒe dɔ.’

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: tso Yohanes mawutsilename ƒe gɔmedzedze va se ɖe gbe si gbe wokɔe dzoe le mía gbɔ; ŋutsu siawo dometɔ ɖeka nazu ɖaseɖila le eƒe tsitretsitsi ŋu hã akpe ɖe mía ŋu.”

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Ale wotia ame eve ɖo wo ŋkume: Woawoe nye: Yosef, si woyɔna be Barsaba ame si wogayɔna hã be Yusto kple Matia.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Tete wodo gbe ɖa gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, wòe nya amegbetɔwo katã ƒe dzime. Ɖe ame eve siawo dometɔ ɖeka, si nètia la ɖe go.

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: Nà be wòava nɔ subɔsubɔdɔ sia me abe amedɔdɔ ene, ɖe Yuda teƒe. Yuda gbe dɔ sia, eye wòyi ɖe teƒe si eya ŋutɔ di la.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, wodzidze nu ɖe ame eveawo dzi. Tete nudzidze la dze Matia dzi, ale wotsɔe kpe ɖe amedɔdɔ wuiɖekɛawo ŋu.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke bla atɔ̃lia le Paska yome la, wo katã woƒo ƒu ɖe aƒe ɖeka me.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Kasia nane ɖi tso dziƒo abe yaƒoƒo ene hexɔ aƒe si me wole la katã.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ge ɖe wo katã me, eye wòna wode asi gbe bubu vovovowo gbɔgblɔ me.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Yudatɔ vɔ̃mawu siwo tso xexemedukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me la nɔ Yerusalem ɣe ma ɣi.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Esi nua ɖi la, ameha gã aɖe ƒo zi va kpe ta. Woƒe nu ku ŋutɔ, elabe wo dome ame sia ame se ameawo nɔ nu ƒom le eya ŋutɔ degbe me.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Wotsi yaa hegblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, menye Galileatɔwoe nye ame siwo katã le nu ƒom oa?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Ale ke wɔ mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le woƒe nyawo me sem ɖe eya ŋutɔ degbe me?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Vavalawo tso Partia, Media kple Elam; Mesopotamia, Yudea kple Kapadokia, Pontio kple Asia,

english_verse: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, parts of Libya near Cyrene, Rome,
translation_verse: Frigia kple Pamfilia, Egipte kple Libia ƒe akpa si te ɖe Kirene ŋu. Ame aɖewo hã tso Roma,

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Kreta kple Arabia. Mí vavala siawo katã la, eɖanye Yudatɔ o, eɖanye trɔ̃subɔla-zu-Yudatɔ o, mí katã míele esem wole Mawu ƒe nu dzɔtsuwo gblɔm fia le míawo ŋutɔ mía degbe me.”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Ale wotɔtɔ, tsi yaa hele wo nɔewo biam be, “Nu sia gɔme ɖe?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Ke ame aɖewo ɖu fewu le nusrɔ̃laawo ŋu gblɔ be, “Aha yeyee le wo mum.” Petro ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Petro kple ame wuiɖekɛawo tso ɖe tsitrenu, eye wòkɔ gbe dzi ƒo nu na amehaawo gblɔ be: “Nɔvi Yudatɔwo kple mi ame siwo katã le Yerusalem, miɖo to ne miase nya si gblɔ ge mala la na mi.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Menye ahae ame siawo mu, abe ale si miebui la ene o, elabe ŋdi ga asieke koe ƒo.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Ke nu si le dzɔdzɔm la nye nya si Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yoel gblɔ ɖi be:

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Mawu gblɔ be: Ava eme le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me, be matsɔ nye Gbɔgbɔ ana amegbetɔwo katã. Mia viŋutsuwo kple mia vinyɔnuwo aɖe gbeƒã nye gbedeasi; miaƒe ɖekakpuiwo akpɔ ŋutega, eye miaƒe amegãɖeɖiwo aku drɔ̃e.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Ẽ, le ŋkeke mawo me la, matsɔ nye Gbɔgbɔ la ana nye ŋutsudɔlawo kple nye nyɔnudɔlawo, eye woaɖe gbeƒã nye gbedeasi.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Mana dzesiwo nado ɖe dziŋgɔli me, eye nukunuwo adzɔ le anyigba dzi. Ʋu kple dzo kpakple dzudzɔ babla kɔtɔɔ ado.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Ɣe lado viviti, eye ɣleti latrɔ zu ʋu. Hafi Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkeke la naɖo; atsyɔ̃ŋkeke gã ma!

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Ava va eme be ame sia ame si yɔ Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ la, woaxɔe ɖe agbe.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Nɔvi Israeltɔwo, miɖo to miase nya sia ɖa: Yesu Nazaretetɔ la enye ame si me Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ le, eye wòɖe esia ɖe go wòdze ƒãã miekpɔ. Mawu to edzi wɔ nu dzɔtsuwo, nukunuwo kple dzesiwo. Miawo ŋutɔ mienya nu siawo nyuie, elabe wodzɔ le mia dome.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Le nu si Mawu nya tso keke gbe aɖe gbe ke nu la, eɖoe ɖi be woatsɔ Yesu ade asi. Ale mieto ame siwo wɔa nu madzɔmadzɔ la dzi klãe ɖe ati ŋu hewui.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu tsi ku ƒe vevesesewo nu, eye wòfɔe ɖe tsitre, elabe ku mate ŋu aɖu edzi, wòatsi yɔ me gbeɖe o.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Esia tae David gblɔ le eŋu be: ‘Menɔ Aƒetɔ la kpɔm le ŋkunye me ɣe sia ɣi, elabe ele nye ɖusime ale be nyemagavɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Eya ta dzi dzɔm, eye nye aɖe tso aseye. Gawu la, maɖe dzi ɖi ahanɔ mɔ kpɔm, togbɔ be menye amegbetɔ si dzɔ na ku hã.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Elabe màgblẽ nye luʋɔ ɖe tsiẽƒe o, Ẽ, màna wò ame kɔkɔe la nanyunyɔ le yɔdo me o.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Wòe na menya agbemɔ. Ne èle gbɔnye ko la, makpɔ dzidzɔ ɖaa.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “Nɔvinyewo, medi be maka ɖe edzi na mi be mía tɔgbui David ku. Woɖii, eye eƒe yɔdo le mía dome va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Ke esi wònye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela ta, enya nu si ŋugbe Mawu do heka atam ɖo kpe edzii nɛ be yeana eƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi aɖe nava nɔ eƒe zi dzi aɖu fia kokoko.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: David kpɔ nu si Mawu ɖo be yeawɔ la do ŋgɔ, ale wòƒo nu le Kristo ƒe tsitretsitsi tso ame kukuwo dome ŋu. Egblɔ be: ‘Womegblẽe ɖe tsiẽƒe o, eye eƒe ŋutilã menyunyɔ o.’

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Yesu siae Mawu fɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye mí katã míekpɔ eteƒe.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Esi wodoe ɖe dzi wòyi ɖale Mawu ƒe ɖusime la, exɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe si ŋugbe Tɔ́ la do nɛ la. Esiae wòkɔ ɖe mía dzi, abe ale si miele ekpɔm hele esemee la ene.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Togbɔ be David ŋutɔ meyi dziƒo o hã la, egblɔ ɖi be: ‘Aƒetɔ la gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ la be: Bɔbɔ nɔ nye ɖusime,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime mawɔ wò futɔwo woanye wò afɔɖodzinu.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Eya ta azɔ la, mi Israeltɔwo katã, mele egblɔm na mi, ne mianya kɔtɛe be Yesu, ame si miawo mieklã ɖe ati ŋu lae Mawu va ɖo wòzu Aƒetɔ kple Kristo.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Azɔ esi ameawo se nya siawo la, wolulu ŋutɔ eya ta wobia Petro kple amedɔdɔ bubuawo be: “Nɔviwo, nu kae míawɔ?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Petro ɖo eŋu be: “Mitrɔ dzime, eye miana woale mawutsi na mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le Yesu Kristo ŋkɔ me, bene woatsɔ miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake mi, eye woatsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ana mi.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Elabe wodo nu sia ŋugbe na miawo, mia viwo kple ame siwo le keke didiƒe ʋĩi ke hã. Ame sia ame si Aƒetɔ mía Mawu la yɔ koe wodo ŋugbe sia na.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Petro ɖi ɖase gblɔ nya bubu geɖewo hã, eye wòxlɔ̃ nu wo gblɔ be: “Miɖe mia ɖokui tso dzidzime gbegble sia si me!”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Wolé fɔ ɖe amedɔdɔawo ƒe nufiafia, hamegbenɔnɔ, ha la ƒe nuɖuɖu ɖekae kple gbedodoɖa ŋu vevie. Hame yeye la ƒe agbenɔnɔ

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo ame sia ame le nukunu kple dzesi geɖe siwo va eme to amedɔdɔawo dzi la ta.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Xɔsetɔawo katã ƒoa ƒu wɔa nu sia nu ɖekae, eye ame sia ame kpɔa gome le nu si le nɔvia si la me.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Wodzra woƒe nunɔamesiwo, eye woma ga si wokpɔ la ɖe wo nɔewo dome ɖe ame sia ame ƒe hiahiã nu.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Wokpea ta gbe sia gbe ɖe mawuxɔ la me, eye wokɔa dɔme ɖua nu le agba ɖeka me le wo nɔewo ƒe aƒewo me kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: Xɔsetɔawo nɔ Mawu kafum, eye amewo katã kpɔ ŋudzedze le wo ŋu. Tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke la, Aƒetɔ la na ame yeye siwo wòxɔ ɖe agbe la va kpena ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka ɣetrɔ ga etɔ̃ me le gbedoɖaɣi la, Petro kple Yohanes woyina ɖe mawuxɔ me.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Amewo kɔ ŋutsu aɖe gbɔna ɖe mawuxɔ la ƒe agbo si woyɔna be “Agbonyui” la nu. Ŋutsu sia nye tekunɔ tso esime wodzii. Wokɔnɛ va dana ɖe afi ma gbe sia gbe, wònɔa nu biam ame siwo gena ɖe mawuxɔa me.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Esi tekunɔa kpɔ Petro kple Yohanes wodi be yewoage ɖe xɔa me la, ebia wo be woana nane ye.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Petro kple Yohanes kpɔe dũu hegblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ mí ɖa!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Ale tekunɔ la fɔ mo dzi henɔ wo kpɔm tututu, nɔ mɔ kpɔm be wole nane tsɔ ge ana ye.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Ke Petro gblɔ nɛ be: “Ga aɖeke mele asinye o, ke nu si le asinye la eya mana wò. Le Yesu Kristo Nazaretetɔ la ŋkɔ me, tso nàzɔ azɔli!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Petro lé tekunɔa ƒe nuɖusi hekɔe dzi. Enumake ŋusẽ ɖo ŋutsua ƒe afɔwo kple afɔkɔewo me.

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: Eti kpo tsi tsitre hede asi azɔlizɔzɔ me. Ege ɖe mawuxɔ la me kpli wo, le zɔzɔm le kpo tim hele Mawu kafum.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame kpɔe wòle azɔli zɔm le Mawu kafum.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: Esi wokpɔe dze sii be eyae nye nubiala si nɔa Agbonyui la nu le mawuxɔa nu la, woƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe wo le nu si wowɔ nɛ la ŋuti. Petro ƒe nyagbɔgblɔ le mawuxɔ la me

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Petro kple Yohanes le teƒe si woyɔna be “Salomo ƒe akpata” la me, eye ŋutsu la lé ɖe wo ŋu goŋgoŋ. Ewɔ nuku na amewo, eye wo katã wotɔ zi yi afi ma.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Esi Petro kpɔ ameawo la, egblɔ na wo be: “Israeltɔwo, nu ka ta nu sia wɔ nuku na mi ɖo? Nu ka ta miefɔ ŋku ɖe mía dzi, abe míawo ŋutɔ míaƒe ŋusẽ kple mawuvɔvɔ̃ mee míeto wɔ ame sia wòzɔ azɔli ene?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Mawu si nye Abraham, Isak, Yakob kple mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la, kɔ eƒe dɔla Yesu ŋu. Ke miawo ya miedee asi, hegbe nu le egbɔ le Pilato ŋkume, evɔ la, Pilato ya ɖoe be yeaɖe asi le eŋu hafi.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ame kɔkɔe kple ame dzɔdzɔe Yesu nye hã la, miebia be woaɖe asi le ŋutsu amewula ŋu na yewo,

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: eye miewu eya ame si naa agbe la boŋ. Ke Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye míenye esia ŋuti ɖaseɖilawo.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Yesu ƒe ŋkɔe do ŋusẽ ame sia. Eƒe ŋkɔ dzixɔsee na ŋutsu sia haya abe ale si wòdze ƒãã miele kpɔkpɔm ene. Yesu dzixɔsee na lãmesẽ blibo ŋutsu sia le mi katã mia ŋkume afii.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “Azɔ nɔvinyewo, menya be mia kple mia dziɖulawo la, miewɔ nu si miewɔ la le manyamanya me.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Ke nya si Mawu na eya ŋutɔ ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ɖe gbeƒãe gbe aɖe gbe ke, be ele be yeƒe Kristo la nakpe fu lae wòwɔ wòva eme.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Eya ta mitrɔ dzime, eye miagbugbɔ aɖo ta Mawu gbɔ bene wòatutu miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Ale be Aƒetɔ la nana miagbɔ ɖe eme eye wòaɖo Kristo si eya ŋutɔ tia ɖi na mi la ɖa.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: Yesu sia anɔ dziƒo va se ɖe esime Mawu aɖɔ nuwo katã ɖo, abe ale si wòna eƒe gbeƒãɖela kɔkɔeawo ɖe gbeƒãe ɖi gbe aɖe gbe ke la ene.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ be: ‘Aƒetɔ Mawu ana eƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖe ado tso nɔviwòwo dome, abe ale si wòna nye hã medoe ene. Miɖo to miase nu sia nu si wòagblɔ na mi la.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Ame si meɖo to Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela sia o la, woatsrɔ̃e le amewo dome.’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Gbeƒãɖela siwo katã ɖe gbeƒã, tso Samuel dzi va to bubu siwo katã kplɔe ɖo la dzi la hã ƒo nu le nu siwo le dzɔdzɔm le ŋkeke siawo me la ŋu.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Miawoe nye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo viwo, eye miekpɔ gome le nu, si Mawu bla kple mia tɔgbuiwo la me. Mawu gblɔ na Abraham be: ‘Wò dzidzimeviwo dzi mato ayra xexemedukɔwo katã.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ale esi Mawu na eƒe dɔla la va do la, mia gbɔe wòdɔe ɖa gbã, be wòayra mi, eye wòana mia dome ame sia ame nadzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Esi Petro kple Yohanes le nu ƒom na ameawo la, nunɔlawo, mawuxɔa dzikpɔlawo ƒe amegã kple Zadukitɔwo va do ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Wodo dziku ɖe wo ŋu, elabe amedɔdɔawo le nu fiam ameawo hele gbeƒã ɖem be wofɔ Yesu ɖe tsitre, eya ta ame kukuwo gbɔna fɔfɔ ge.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Wolé Petro kple Yohanes le fiẽ ma eye wode wo gaxɔ me va se ɖe esime ŋu ke.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo se woƒe nyawo la dometɔ geɖe xɔ se. Ale ŋutsu xɔsetɔwo ƒe xexlẽme ade abe akpe atɔ̃ ene.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, Yudatɔwo dziɖulawo, dumegãwo kple agbalẽfialawo wɔ takpekpe le Yerusalem.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Ame siwo kpe ta lae nye nunɔlagã Hana, Kayafa, Yohanes kple Aleksandro hekpe ɖe ame siwo katã tso nunɔlagã la ƒe ƒomea me la ŋu.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Wona amedɔdɔawo tsi tsitre ɖe wo ŋgɔ, eye wobia wo se be: “Ame ka ƒe ŋusẽ mietsɔ le nu sia wɔmee? Ame ka ƒe ŋkɔ mee miele ewɔm le?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔ Petro taŋ eye wòɖo eŋu na wo be: “Dziɖulawo kple dumegãwo,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: nenye nu nyui si míewɔ na tekunɔ aɖe, si ŋuti miele gbe biam mí le be ale ke wɔ ŋutsu sia haya mahã la,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: ekema mi katã misee, ne Israel-dukɔ blibo la nanya, be Yesu Kristo Nazaretetɔ, ame si mieklã ɖe ati ŋu, ke Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la dzie wòto be ame sia haya le tsitre ɖe mia ŋkume afii.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Yesu siae nye kpe si mi xɔtulawo miegbe, ke wòva zu dzogoedzikpe.

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Yesu megbe la, ame bubu aɖeke mexɔa ame ɖe agbe o, eye amegbetɔ aɖeke mele anyigba dzi, si dzi míato akpɔ agbexɔxɔ o.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ameawo ƒe mo wɔ yaa, elabe wokpɔ be, togbɔ be Petro kple Yohanes menya agbalẽ o, eye womexɔ hehe tɔxɛ aɖeke o hã la, woƒo nu kple kakaɖedzi, eye wokpɔe dze sii be wonɔ Yesu yome.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Ke esi wokpɔ ame si ŋu woda gbe le, wòle tsitre ɖe Petro kple Yohanes gbɔ la, womeganya nya si woagblɔ ɖe wo ŋu o.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Ale wona wodo le takpeƒea, eye woyi adaŋu me. Wogblɔ be:

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: “Ale ke míawɔ ame siawoe? Edze ƒã na Yerusalemnɔlawo katã be wowɔ nukunu gã aɖe to wo dzi, eye míawo míate ŋu agblɔ be mele eme o.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ke be nya sia nagakaka ɖe edzi aɖo ame bubuwo hã gbɔ o ta la, mina míade vɔvɔ̃ lã me na wo agblɔ be womegaƒo nu na ame aɖeke le ame sia ƒe ŋkɔ me o.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ale woyɔ wo vɛ hede se na wo be womegakpɔ mɔ aƒo nu, alo afia nu le Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ me akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Ke Petro kple Yohanes ɖo eŋu na wo be: “Mia ŋutɔwo mibu eŋu kpɔ be kae dzɔ le Mawu ŋkume be míawɔ: miawo míaɖo toe loo, alo Mawu míaɖo toea?

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Míawo ya nu si míekpɔ kple nu si míese la míate ŋu agbe nuƒoƒo le eŋu o.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Ame si woyɔ dɔe le nukunu sia me la xɔ ƒe wu bla ene. Xɔsetɔawo do gbe ɖa be yewoakpɔ dzideƒo

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Esi woɖe asi le Petro kple Yohanes ŋu la, wotrɔ yi wo tɔwo gbɔ eye wogblɔ nya si nunɔlagãwo kple dumegãwo gblɔ na wo la na wo.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Esi wo tɔawo se nya la la, wo katã woƒo nu kple gbe ɖeka na Mawu be: “Aƒetɔ Mawu, wòe wɔ dziƒo, anyigba, atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le wo me!

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: Wòe to Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la dzi na mía tɔgbui David, ƒo nu be: ‘Nu ka ta trɔ̃subɔlawo dze agbo, eye dukɔwo le tame bum dzodzro?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Anyigbadzifiawo bla akpa, eye dziɖulawo kpe ta le adaŋu dem, ɖe Aƒetɔ la kple eƒe Kristo la ŋu.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, Herodes kple Pontio Pilato wɔ ɖeka kple ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o kple Israel vi siwo le du sia me, eye wotso ɖe wò dɔla kɔkɔe Yesu, ame si nèsi ami na la ŋu.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Woƒo ƒu be woawɔ ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe si nèwɔ le aɖaŋu me ɖi xoxoxo be wòava eme la dzi.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, azɔ la, kpɔ ŋɔdzi si dom wole na mí la ɖa ne nàde dzi ƒo na mí, wò dɔlawo, be míagblɔ wò nya la dzideƒotɔe.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Do asi ɖa nàyɔ dɔ amewo, eye na míatsɔ wò dɔla kɔkɔe Yesu ƒe ŋkɔ awɔ nukunuwo kple dzesiwoe.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Esi wodo gbe ɖa vɔ la, teƒe si woƒo ƒu ɖo la ʋuʋu. Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔ wo katã taŋ, eye wogblɔ Mawu ƒe nya la dzideƒotɔe. Hametɔawo ma woƒe nunɔamesiwo

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, xɔsetɔawo katã ƒe susu le ɖeka eye wowɔa nu abe ame ɖeka ene. Wo dometɔ aɖeke megabu nu si nye etɔ la be enye ye ɖeka tɔ o, ke boŋ nu sia nu si nye wo dometɔ aɖe tɔ la zu hamenu na wo.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Amedɔdɔawo ɖi ɖase kple ŋusẽ blibo be Aƒetɔ Yesu tsi tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome nyateƒe, eye Mawu ve wo katã nu ŋutɔ.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Hiãtɔ aɖeke menɔ wo dome o, elabe wo dome ame siwo si anyigba kple xɔwo le la dzra wo, eye wotsɔ ga si wokpɔ la

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: vɛ na amedɔdɔawo. Woma ga la na ame sia ame ɖe eƒe hiahiã nu.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu aɖe, si ŋkɔe nye Anania kple srɔ̃a Safira wodzra woƒe nunɔamesi aɖe.

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: Eɖe ga la ƒe ɖe dzra ɖo, eye wòtsɔ esi susɔ la vɛ na amedɔdɔawo. Nu sia nɔ nyanya me na srɔ̃a hã.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Ke Petro biae be: “Anania, nu ka ta Abosam xɔ aƒe ɖe wò susu me eye nètsɔ ga si nèkpɔ tso anyigba la me la ƒe ɖe dzra ɖo heka aʋatso na Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Esi mèdzra anyigba la o ɖe, ɖe menye tɔwòe wònye oa? Azɔ esi nèdzrae la, àte ŋu awɔ eŋudɔ ale si nèlɔ̃. Nu ka ta nèɖo tame be yeawɔ nu sia? Menye amegbetɔ nèka aʋatso na o, ke boŋ Mawu ye.”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Esi Anania se nya sia la, edze anyi eye wòku. Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo ame siwo katã see la ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Ɖekakpuiawo tso, xatsa avɔ ɖe ame kukua ŋu, eye wokɔe yi ɖaɖi.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Abe gaƒoƒo etɔ̃ megbe ene la, srɔ̃a va do. Eya mese nya si dzɔ va yi la o.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Petro biae be: “Ga home siae mia kple srɔ̃wò miexɔ ɖe anyigba si miedzra la taa? Gblɔe nam.” Nyɔnua ɖo eŋu be: “Ẽ, eyae.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Ale Petro gblɔ nɛ be: “Ale ke wɔ mi ame evea miesɔ nu le Aƒetɔ la ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la tem kpɔ? Kpɔ ɖa, ɖekakpui siwo yi ɖaɖi srɔ̃wò la, woawoe nye ekem trɔ va le ʋɔtrua nu. Woakɔ wò hã ayii.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Enumake nyɔnu la dze anyi ɖe Petro ƒe afɔnu heku klenee. Esi ɖekakpuiawo ge ɖe eme la, wokpɔ be nyɔnua ku ɖi. Ale wokɔ eya hã yi ɖaɖi ɖe srɔ̃a xa.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo hame blibo la kple ame bubu siwo katã se nya sia ŋutɔ. Amedɔdɔawo wɔ nukunu kple dzesi geɖewo

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Mawu to amedɔdɔawo dzi wɔ dzesi kple nukunu geɖewo le dukɔ la dome. Xɔsetɔawo katã kpea ta ɖe Salomo ƒe akpata la me.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ame bubuawo bua wo ŋutɔ hã la, womedo dzi ge ɖe wo dome o.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu kple nyɔnu geɖe wu gaxɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se, eye wova le gegem ɖe ha la me.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Esia na be amewo kɔ woƒe dɔnɔwo ɖe abatiwo kple abawo dzi do ɖe ablɔ me, be ne Petro va yina la, eƒe vɔvɔli teti nadze dɔnɔawo dzi.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Du siwo ƒo xlã Yerusalem me nɔlawo hã kɔ woƒe dɔnɔwo kple ame siwo gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ le fu ɖem na la vɛ, eye woda gbe le wo katã ŋu. Woti amedɔdɔawo yome

english_verse: The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlagã la kple eŋume siwo nye Zadukitɔwo ƒe hatsotso la, le ŋu ʋãm amedɔdɔawo vevie.

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Wolé amedɔdɔawo, eye wokplɔ wo de dukɔa ƒe gaxɔ me.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Ke le zã me la, Aƒetɔ la ƒe mawudɔla aɖe va ʋu ʋɔawo na wo, kplɔ wo do goe eye wògblɔ na wo be:

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Midzo yi ɖatsi tsitre ɖe mawuxɔ la me, eye miagblɔ agbe yeye sia ŋunya na amewo katã.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Esi amedɔdɔawo se nya sia la, woge ɖe mawuxɔ la me fɔŋli, eye wofia nu ameawo. Azɔ esi nunɔlagã la kple eŋumewo va la, woyɔ adaŋudelawo kple ame tsitsi siwo le Israel la vɛ. Wodɔ amewo ɖo ɖe gaxɔa me be woakplɔ amedɔdɔawo vɛ.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Ke esi ameawo de la, womekpɔ amedɔdɔawo le gaxɔa me o. Wotrɔ va gblɔ be:

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Esi míede la, míekpɔ gaxɔa ƒe ʋɔwo wole tutu pɛpɛpɛ, eye dzɔlaawo hã nɔ ŋu, le tsitre le agboa nu. Ke esi míeʋu ʋɔawo la, míekpɔ ame aɖeke le xɔa me o.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi mawuxɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe amegã kple nunɔlagãwo se nya sia la, wotɔtɔ ale gbegbe eye wonɔ tame bum le nu si ava dzɔ emegbe la ŋu.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Ke ame aɖe va gblɔ na wo be: “Ame siwo mielé de gaxɔ me la, woawoe nye ekem le mawuxɔ la me hele nu fiam amewo.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Tete mawuxɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe amegã kplɔ eteviwo yii, eye wokplɔ amedɔdɔawo vɛ. Wometsɔ sesẽ kplɔ woe o, elabe wole vɔvɔ̃m be amehawo aƒu kpe yewo.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Esi wokplɔ wo vɛ la, wona wotsi tsitre ɖe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo ŋkume, eye nunɔlagã la gblɔ na amedɔdɔawo be:

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “Míede se na mi vevie be miagafia nu le ame sia ƒe ŋkɔ me o, gake miena miaƒe nufiafia kaka ɖe Yerusalem-du blibo la me, eye mieɖoe be yewoahe fiƒode si le eƒe ku me la ava mía dzi.”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Ke Petro kple amedɔdɔ bubuawo ɖo eŋu be: “Mawue wòle be míaɖo toe, ke menye amegbetɔwo o.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Yesu, ame si mieklã ɖe ati ŋu hewu la, mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Mawu doe ɖe dzi hedae ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɖusime be wòanye Kplɔla kple Xɔla, ale be wòana Israel-dukɔa natrɔ dzime, eye woatsɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake wo.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Míawo kple Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe si Mawu naa ame siwo ɖoa toe lae nye nya sia ŋuti ɖaseɖilawo.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Esi ʋɔnudrɔ̃laawo se nya sia le amedɔdɔawo nu la, wodo dziku, eye wodi be yewoawu wo.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu aɖe nɔ ʋɔnudrɔ̃laawo dome. Enye Farisitɔ kple sefiala si dukɔ blibo la buna. Eŋkɔe nye Gamaliel. Ame sia tsi tsitre eye wòbia be woakplɔ amedɔdɔawo adoe vie.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na ame siwo le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒea azɔ be: “Mía tɔ Israeltɔwo, mikpɔ nyuie le nu si miedi be yewoawɔ ame siawo la ŋu.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Le eya yome la, Yuda, Galileatɔ la hã va do le amexlẽɣi. Ehe ame geɖewo ɖe eɖokui ŋu, ke eya hã va ku, eye ame siwo katã dze eyome la ka hlẽ.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Eya ta nye ya mebe migade nu eme na ame siawo o; miɖe asi le wo ŋu ne woayi. Elabe ne nu si woɖo hele wɔwɔm la tso amegbetɔ gbɔ la, agblẽ.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Ke nenye be Mawu gbɔe wòtso la, miate ŋu agblẽe akpɔ o. Ne miekpɔ nyuie o la, ava dzé gɔ̃ hã be miele tsitre tsim ɖe Mawu ŋu.” Ʋɔnudrɔ̃laawo xɔ aɖaŋu si Gamaliel ɖo la.

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Woyɔ amedɔdɔawo vɛ, heƒo wo eye wokui ɖe to me na wo vevie be womegaƒo nu le Yesu ŋkɔ me azɔ o. Esia megbe la, woɖe asi le wo ŋu.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Esi wodzo le ʋɔnua yina la, wonɔ dzidzɔ kpɔm ŋutɔ, be wobu yewo hã be yewodze, woado ŋukpe yewo le Yesu ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Azɔ gbe sia gbe la, amedɔdɔawo nɔ nu fiam henɔ gbeƒã ɖem madzudzɔmadzudzɔe be Yesue nye Kristo la. Wonɔ esia wɔm le mawuxɔ la me kple tso aƒeme yi aƒeme.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Le ɣeyiɣi siawo me la, nusrɔ̃lawo va nɔ agbɔ sɔm ɖe edzi. Ale xɔsetɔ siwo doa Hela-gbe la lĩ liʋiliʋĩ be, ne Hebritɔwo le nu siwo ŋudɔ wowɔna gbe sia gbe la mam la, wotsoa yewoƒe ahosiwo ɖi.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Esia ta amedɔdɔ wui eveawo yɔ nusrɔ̃lawo katã ƒo ƒu gblɔ na wo be: “Masɔ be míagblẽ mawunyagbɔgblɔ ɖi aɖanɔ nuɖuɖu mam o.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔviwo, mitia ame adrẽ siwo dzi mieka ɖo, ame siwo me Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la le, eye wonye nunyalawo la tso mia dome, míatsɔ aɖo dɔ sia nu.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Esia ana be míawo míavo ɖe gbedodoɖa kple mawunyagbɔgblɔ ŋu koŋ.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Nya la dze ameha blibo la ŋu, ale wotia ame siawo: Stefano, ame si si xɔse le, eye Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔe taŋ, Filipo, Prokoro, Nikanora, Timona, Parmena kple Nikolao, ame si nye trɔ̃subɔla-zu-Yudatɔ tso Antioxia.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Woɖe ame tiatia siawo fia amedɔdɔawo, eye woawo do gbe ɖa heda asi ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nya la va keke ta ɖe edzi. Nusrɔ̃la siwo le Yerusalem la ƒe xexlẽme dzi ɖe edzi fũu, eye nunɔla geɖewo hã va le xɔse la me ɖom. Stefano léle

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Stefano, ame si nu Mawu ve, eye wòkpɔ ŋusẽ la wɔ nukunu kple dzesi gãwo le ameawo dome.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Ke ame aɖewo tsi tre ɖe eŋuti. Ame siawo tso Ablɔɖetɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒe la me. Emenɔlawo tso Kirene kple Aleksandria, eye ɖewo hã tso Kilikia kple Asia. Woʋli nya kple Stefano,

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: ke womete ŋu nɔ te ɖe nunya si Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la nae wòle nu ƒomee la nu o.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Ale wode nya ŋutsu aɖewo nu be woagblɔ be: “Míese wònɔ busunya gblɔm ɖe Mose kple Mawu ŋu.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Wode zi amehaawo, dumegãwo kple agbalẽfialawo me ɖe eŋuti, eye wova tui, lée hekplɔe va ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe lae.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Wodi aʋatsoɖaseɖilawo ɖe eŋu. Ame siawo va gblɔ be: “Ŋutsu sia la, busunya ko gblɔm wòle ɖe kɔkɔeƒe sia kple Mose ƒe se la ŋu.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Elabe míesee le enu wògblɔ be Yesu Nazaretetɔ la le teƒe sia gbã ge, eye wòatrɔ kɔnu siwo Mose ɖo ɖi na mí la.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒea la fɔ ŋku ɖe Stefano dzi gã, eye wokpɔ eƒe mo wòdzé abe mawudɔla tɔ ene.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã la bia Stefano be: “Nya siawo le emea?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Stefano ɖo eŋu be: “Nɔvinyewo kple tɔ́nyewo, misee ɖa! Hafi mía tɔgbui Abraham naʋu aɖanɔ Xaran la, Mawu Ŋutikɔkɔetɔ la ɖe eɖokui fiae le Mesopotamia.

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ nɛ be: ‘Ʋu le mia denyigba dzi kple wò ƒometɔwo gbɔ, eye nàyi anyigba si mafia wò la dzi.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Ale Abraham ʋu le Kaldea-nyigba dzi, eye wòva nɔ Xaran. Le tɔ́a ƒe ku megbe la, Mawu na wòʋu va le anyigba si dzi míele fifia la dzi.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Mawu meka anyigba la ƒe akpa aɖeke si anɔ abe afɔ ɖeka pɛ teti ene hã na Abraham, be wòanye eya ŋutɔ tɔ o. Gake Mawu do ŋugbe be yeatsɔ anyigba la ana eya kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo, wòanye wo tɔ tegbee, togbɔ be vi aɖeke menɔ Abraham si ɣe ma ɣi o hã.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Nu si Mawu gblɔ nɛ lae nye be: ‘Wò dzidzimeviwo anye amedzro le anyigba aɖe si menye wo de o la dzi. Woanɔ afi ma abe kluviwo ene ƒe alafa ene sɔŋ, eye woawɔ fu wo vevie.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Ke mabu fɔ dukɔ si subɔ ge woala la. Emegbe la, woadzo le anyigba ma dzi ava subɔm le teƒe sia.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu bla nu kple Abraham. Nubabla sia ƒe dzesidenue nye aʋatsotso. Eya ta esi Abraham dzi Isak la, etso aʋa nɛ le ŋkeke enyia gbe. Isak dzi Yakob, eye Yakob dzi tɔgbui wui eveawo.

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: eye wòɖee tso eƒe fukpekpewo katã me. Esi Yosef do ɖe Egipte Fiagã ŋkume la, Mawu ve enu hena nunyae ale be fia la tsɔe ɖo nudzikpɔlagã ɖe Egipte-nyigba kple fia la ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, dɔ va to le Egipte kple Kanaan-nyigbawo dzi, eye wòhe fukpekpe geɖe vɛ ale be mía tɔgbuiwo mekpɔ naneke aɖu o.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Ke esi Yakob se be bli le Egipte la, edɔ mía tɔgbuiwo ɖo ɖe afi ma, zi gbãtɔ, wode gbɔ.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Esi wogayi zi evelia la, Yosef ɖe eɖokui fia nɔviawo. Ale Egipte Fiagã hã nya Yosef ƒe ƒometɔwo.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ale Yakob yi ɖe Egipte, afi si eya kple mía tɔgbuiawo ku ɖo.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, wotsɔ woƒe kukuawo gbɔe va Sixem va ɖi ɖe yɔdo si Abraham tsɔ klosaloga ƒlee le Xemor viwo si la me.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Esi ɣeyiɣi si Mawu ɖo be yeawɔ ŋugbe si yedo na Abraham dzi la nɔ aƒe tum la, dukɔ la dzi ɖe edzi sɔ gbɔ fũu le Egipte.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, fia aɖe va nɔ dzi ɖum le Egipte, ame si menya Yosef kura o.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Fia sia wɔ aye flu dukɔ la. Ezi wo dzi be woagblẽ wo vidzĩwo ɖi woaku.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi sia mee wodzi Mose. Mose ƒe nu nyo Mawu ŋu. Wonyii le tɔ́a ƒeme ɣleti etɔ̃.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Esi woɖee ɖe go la, Egipte Fiagã vinyɔnuvi xɔe wɔ eya ŋutɔ viŋutsuvie henyii wòtsi.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Wofia Egiptetɔwo ƒe nunya ɖe sia ɖe Mose, ale be ŋusẽ blibo va ɖo eƒe nya kple nuwɔna ŋu.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ be Egiptetɔ aɖe le anyra wɔm le Israel vi aɖe ŋu. Esi wòyi xɔxɔ ge na Israel vi si ŋu nu té la, eƒo Egiptetɔ la wu.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Mose bu be ye nɔviawo ase egɔme be Mawu ɖe wòdi be yeato ye dzi aɖe wo, ke womese egɔme nɛ nenema o.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Ŋufɔke la, Mose gava. Eva ke ɖe ame eve ŋu wole kɔ dam, eye wòbe yealé avu wo. Egblɔ na wo be: ‘Mikpɔ ɖa! Nɔviwo mienye, nu ka ta miele nu vevi wɔm mia nɔewo?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Ke ame si nɔ nu vevi wɔm nɔvia la tutu Mose ɖa hebiae be: ‘Ame kae ɖo wò dziɖula kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃la ɖe mía nu?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Ɖe nèdi be yeawu nye hã, abe ale si nèwu Egiptetɔ ma etsɔ enea?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Esi Mose se nya sia la, esí yi ɖe Midian-nyigba dzi. Enɔ afi ma abe amedzro ene, eye wòdzi viŋutsuvi eve le afi ma.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Ƒe bla ene megbe la, mawudɔla ɖe eɖokui fia Mose le ŋuve si le dzo bim le gbegbe si te ɖe Sinai-to ŋu la me.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Esi Mose kpɔ nu sia la, ewɔ nuku nɛ ŋutɔ. Ete ɖe eŋu be yeakpɔe nyuie, ke Aƒetɔ la ƒe gbe ɖi be:

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
