translation_verse: ‘Nyee nye tɔgbuiwòwo ƒe Mawu la: Abraham, Isak kple Yakob ƒe Mawu la.’ Mose nɔ dzodzom nyanyanya eye medo dzi lé ŋku ɖe eŋu nyuie o.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: ‘Ɖe afɔ le afɔkpa me, elabe afi si nètsi tsitre ɖo la teƒe kɔkɔe ye.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Mekpɔ ale si wole fu fiam nye dukɔ la le Egipte la kɔtɛe. Mese woƒe ŋeŋe, eya ta meɖi va wo ɖe ge. Azɔ va, ne madɔ wò ɖe Egipte.’ ”

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Togbɔ be Mose siae wogbe hegblɔ na be, ‘Ame kae ɖo wò dziɖula kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃lae?’ hã la, eyae Mawu va dɔ, to mawudɔla si ɖe eɖokui fiae le ŋuve si le dzo bim me la dzi, be wòanye wo dziɖula kple wo xɔla.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Mose kplɔ wo dzoe tso Egipte. Ewɔ nukunu kple dzesi geɖewo le Egipte-nyigba dzi, le Aƒlaƒu la nu kple le gbedadaƒo, ƒe bla ene sɔŋ.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Mose siae gblɔ na Israelviwo be: ‘Mawu ana eƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖe nado tso mia dome, abe ale si wòna medoe la ene.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Eyae nye ame si nɔ kpli Israel-hame la, esime wonɔ gbedadaƒo. Mose sia kple mía tɔgbuiwo li, esime mawudɔla ƒo nu nɛ le Sinai-to dzi, eye wòxɔ Mawu ƒe gbedeasi si li ɖaa la vɛ na mí.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Ke mía tɔgbuiwo medi be yewoaɖo toe o. Wogbe eƒe nya, eye tɔtrɔ yi Egipte ɖo susu me na wo.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Tete wome nyivi eye wova sa vɔ na legba sia. Wokpɔ dzidzɔ hedo vivi ɖe nu si woawo ŋutɔwo tsɔ asi wɔe la ŋu.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Ke Mawu gbugbɔ le wo yome eye wòtsɔ wo de asi be woasubɔ dziŋgɔlimenuwo abe ale si eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ŋlɔe ɖi ene be: ‘O Israel-dukɔ, nyee miewu lãwo hesa vɔ na le ƒe bla ene me le gbedadaƒoa?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Menye mawu, Molox ƒe nɔƒe kple Romfan ƒe ɣletivi ƒe nɔnɔme, miewɔ hesubɔ oa? Eya ta mana miayi aɖanɔ ame bubuwo ƒe anyigba dzi le keke Babilonia godo ke.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Agbadɔ si ɖoa ŋku edzi na mía tɔgbuiwo be Mawu li kpli wo la nɔ wo si le gbedadaƒo. Nɔnɔme si me Mawu fia Mose be wòawɔe ɖo la nu tututue wowɔe ɖo.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Agbadɔ sia, si mía tɔgbuiwo xɔ tso wo tɔ́wo gbɔ la, nɔ wo si esime Yosua nɔ wo kplɔm, eye woxɔ dukɔ siwo Mawu nya ɖa le wo ŋgɔ la ƒe anyigba. Enɔ wo dome va se ɖe David ŋɔli.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: David ƒe nu dze Mawu ŋu, eya ta ebia Mawu be wòaɖe mɔ na ye yeawɔ nɔƒe na Yakob ƒe Mawu la,

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: eye Salomo ye va tu xɔ la nɛ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: “Gake Mawu, ame si ƒo nu sia nu ta la, menɔa xɔ si wotu kple asi la me o. Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela la gblɔ be:

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Dziƒoe nye nye fiazikpui, eye anyigba nye nye afɔɖodzinu. Aƒetɔ la be: Xɔ ka tututue miate ŋu atu nam? Alo afi ka mate ŋu anɔ agbɔ ɖe eme?

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela ka yomee mia tɔgbuiwo meti o? Wowu ame siwo do ŋgɔ va ɖe gbeƒã be Dzɔdzɔetɔ la gbɔna la, eye miawo hã miede Dzɔdzɔetɔ la asi hewui.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo xɔ sé la tso mawudɔlawo gbɔ vɛ la boŋ ye gbe be yewomawɔ ɖe sea dzi o.” Stefano wuwu

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Esi wose Stefano ƒe nyawo la, woƒe dzi ho, eye woɖu aɖu klíklikli ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Ke Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔ Stefano taŋ. Ewu mo dzi eye wòkpɔ Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple Yesu, wòle tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ɖusime.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ be: “Mikpɔ ɖa! Mekpɔ dziƒo wòʋu, eye mekpɔ Amegbetɔ Vi la wòle tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe ɖusime.”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Ke ameawo katã do ɣli sesĩe, xe asi to me, eye wolũ ɖe edzi enumake.

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: Wotutui do goe le dua me, eye wofɔ kpe heƒui. Ɖaseɖilawo ɖe woƒe awuwo da ɖe ɖekakpui aɖe, si ŋkɔe nye Saulo gbɔ.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Esi wole kpe ƒum Stefano la, edo gbe ɖa gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ Yesu, xɔ nye gbɔgbɔ.”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Edze klo do ɣli sesĩe be: “Aƒetɔ, mègaɖo nuvɔ̃ sia teƒe na wo o.” Esi wògblɔ esia la, eku.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Azɔ Saulo de asi hame la gbagbã me. Etsana tso aƒeme yi aƒeme eye wòhea ŋutsu kple nyɔnuwo siaa yina ɖadea gaxɔ me. Wogblɔ Nyanyui la le Samaria

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Azɔ ame siwo ka hlẽ la gblɔ Nyanyui la le afi siwo woto la.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Filipo yi ɖe Samariatɔwo ƒe du aɖe me, eye wòɖe gbeƒã Kristo la na wo.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Esi ameha la se eƒe nyawo eye wokpɔ dzesi siwo wòwɔ la, wo katã woxɔ eƒe nya la.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Elabe gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo do go tso ame siwo me wole la kple ɣli, lãmetututɔwo haya eye tekunɔwo zɔ azɔli.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Ale dua me tɔwo katã kpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu aɖe nɔ dua me si ŋkɔe nye Simon. Enye dzosala. Do ŋgɔ la, ewɔa nukunuwo le Samaria-dukɔa me, amewo kpɔna. Egblɔna be ŋusẽtɔ gã aɖee yenye.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã le dukɔa me, ɖeviwo kple ame tsitsiwo siaa, bunɛ eye wogblɔna le eŋu be: “Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ si woyɔna be: ‘Ŋusẽtriakɔ’ la le ame sia si.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Woɖoa to eƒe nyawo, elabe tso ɣe aɖe ɣi ke la, eƒe nuwɔnawo wɔa nuku na amewo.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Ke esi Filipo va gblɔ Nyanyui la na wo tso Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu kple Yesu Kristo ŋkɔ ŋu, eye woxɔe se ko la, wole mawutsi na wo dome ame geɖe, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Simon ŋutɔ hã xɔe se, eye wole mawutsi nɛ wòdze Filipo yome. Esi wòkpɔ dzesi kple nukunu gã siwo le eme vam la, ewɔ nuku nɛ ŋutɔ.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi amedɔdɔawo se le Yerusalem be Samariatɔwo xɔ Mawu ƒe nya la la, woɖo Petro kple Yohanes ɖe wo gbɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Esi woɖo afi ma la, wodo gbe ɖa ɖe xɔsetɔawo ta bene woaxɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wole mawutsi na wo ɖe Aƒetɔ Yesu ŋkɔ me hã la, womexɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la haɖe o.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ale Petro kple Yohanes da asi ɖe ame siawo dzi, eye woxɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Simon de dzesii be asi ko amedɔdɔawo da ɖe xɔsetɔawo dzi, eye woxɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la, eya ta etsɔ ga home aɖe na Petro kple Yohanes

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: hegblɔ be: “Mitsɔ ŋusẽ sia na nye hã, ale be ame si dzi mada asi ɖo la, eya hã naxɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Ke Petro ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Neɖi mia kple wò ga la ŋu! Ɖe nèbu be yeaƒle Mawu ƒe nunana la kple ga?

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Wɔƒe aɖeke meli na wò le subɔsubɔdɔ sia me kpli mí o, eye gome aɖeke hã meli nàkpɔ o, elabe wò dzime mekɔ le Mawu gbɔ o.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Mekpɔ be èle ŋu ʋãm vevie eye nèzu nuvɔ̃ ƒe kluvi.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Simon ɖo eŋu na Petro kple Yohanes be: “Mido gbe ɖa na Aƒetɔ la ɖe tanye, ale be nu siwo miegblɔ la dometɔ aɖeke nagadzɔ ɖe dzinye o.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Petro kple Yohanes ɖi ɖase, eye wogblɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya la vɔ la, wogbugbɔ yi Yerusalem, le gbeƒã ɖem Nyanyui la le Samaria-kɔƒe geɖewo me. Etiopia-fianyɔnu ƒe dɔdzikpɔla trɔ dzime

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔla aɖe gblɔ na Filipo be: “Tsi tre nàyi anyigbeme gome, eye nàɖo ta mɔ si tso Yerusalem va yi Gaza la dzi.” Mɔ sia to gbedadaƒo. Ale Filipo tso heyi.

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi sia me la, Etiopia dudɔwɔla si kpɔa fianyɔnu, Kandake, ƒe kesinɔnuwo katã dzi la trɔ tso gbedoɖaƒe le Yerusalem,

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: yina aƒe. Ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe tasiaɖam me nɔ Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya ƒe agbalẽ xlẽm.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la gblɔ na Filipo be: “Te ɖe tasiaɖam sia ŋu.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Ale Filipo ƒu du yi ɖe egbɔ. Ese eŋkɔ wònɔ Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya ƒe agbalẽ xlẽm. Filipo biae be: “Èle nu si xlẽm nèle la gɔme sema?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Dudɔwɔla la ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ale ke mawɔ ase egɔme, ne ame aɖeke meɖe egɔme nam o?” Ale wòbia tso Filipo si be wòage ɖe eme ava nɔ ye xa.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Mawunya si xlẽm wònɔ lae nye esi: “Edzé abe alẽ si wokplɔ yina wuwu ge, alo abe alẽvi si li kpoo le eƒe fukola si me la ene. Meke nu gblɔ nya aɖeke o.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Wobɔbɔe ɖe anyi, eye womedrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe nɛ o. Ame aɖeke mate ŋu aƒo nu tso eƒe dzidzimeviwo ŋu o, elabe woɖe eƒe agbe ɖa tso xexea me.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Dudɔwɔla la bia Filipo be: “Meɖe kuku, ame ka ƒe nya gblɔm Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela la le? Eya ŋutɔ ŋunyae loo, alo ame bubu aɖe tɔ yea?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Ale Filipo ƒo nu nɛ. Edze egɔme tso mawunya sia dzi, eye wòyi edzi gblɔ Nyanyui la le Yesu ŋu nɛ.

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Enumake dudɔwɔla la ɖe gbe be tasiaɖam la netɔ. Esi wòtɔ la, Filipo kple ŋutsua ge ɖe tsia me, eye Filipo le mawutsi nɛ.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Esi wodo le tsia me la, Aƒetɔ la ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la kplɔ Filipo dzoe, eye dudɔwɔla la megakpɔe o. Eyi eƒe mɔzɔzɔ dzi kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke Filipo va do ɖe keke Azoto ke. Enɔ tsatsam nɔ Nyanyui la gblɔm le duawo katã me, va se ɖe esime wòɖo Kaisarea.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Ke ŋusẽ ɖo Saulo ŋu wu tsã, eye ale si wòɖe nya me, be Yesue nye Kristo la la, me kɔ ale gbegbe be Yudatɔ siwo le Damasko la ƒe nu ku.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Fɔ nàge ɖe dua me, eye woagblɔ nu si wòle be nàwɔ la na wò.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ mafia ale si gbegbe wòle be wòakpe fu le nye ŋkɔ la ta lae.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Esi Saulo va ɖo Yerusalem la, edi be yeage ɖe nusrɔ̃lawo dome. Ke nusrɔ̃lawo katã nɔ vɔvɔ̃m nɛ, elabe womexɔ se be eya hã nye nusrɔ̃la o.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: eye wòkpɔ ŋutsu aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Anania le ŋutega me wòva da asi ɖe edzi, wògakpɔ nu.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Enumake nane si le abe tsro ene la ge le Saulo ƒe ŋku dzi, eye wògakpɔ nu. Etsi tsitre eye wole mawutsi nɛ.

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi sia me la, Saulo ganɔ ŋɔdzi dom na Aƒetɔ la ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kokoko, be yeawu wo. Eyi nunɔlagã gbɔ,

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: eye wòbiae be woaŋlɔ agbalẽ na ye yeatsɔ ayi ɖe ƒuƒoƒe siwo le Damasko la, ale be ne yekpɔ ame aɖe, si le Aƒetɔ la ƒe mɔa dzi la, yeablae akplɔe va Yerusalem, eɖanye ŋutsu alo nyɔnu o.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Esi Saulo le eƒe mɔzɔzɔ dzi gogo Damasko la, kekeli klẽ tso dziƒo ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Edze anyi, eye wòse gbe aɖe le gbɔgblɔm nɛ be: “Saulo, Saulo! Nu ka ta nèle yonyeme tim?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Saulo bia be: “Aƒetɔ, wò ame kae?” Gbe la ɖo eŋu be: “Nye Yesu, ame si yome tim nèle lae.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Ame siwo nɔ mɔ zɔm kplii la tɔ te ɖe afi ma; gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe wo. Togbɔ be wose gbea hã la, womekpɔ ame aɖeke o.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Saulo fɔ le anyigba, ke esi wòʋu ŋku la, mete ŋu le nu kpɔm o. Ale wolé eƒe asi hekplɔe ge ɖe Damasko-dua me.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Enɔ anyi ŋkeke etɔ̃ sɔŋ; mekpɔ nu o, meɖu nu o eye meno naneke hã o.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nusrɔ̃la aɖe nɔ Damasko si ŋkɔe nye Anania. Ekpɔ ŋutega si me Aƒetɔ la yɔe be: “Anania!” Etɔ nɛ be: “Aƒetɔ, nyee nye esi!”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: “Tso nàyi ɖe ablɔ si ŋkɔe nye Ablɔdzɔdzɔe la dzi, eye nàbia Yuda ƒeme ta. Ne ège ɖe aƒea me la, bia ŋutsu aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Saulo tso Tarso la ta se. Ŋutsu sia le gbe dom ɖa,

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Anania ɖo eŋu be: “Aƒetɔ, mese nya le ame geɖewo nu tso ŋutsu sia ŋu. Wogblɔ be ewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi geɖe ɖe wò ame siwo ŋu nèkɔ le Yerusalem la ŋu.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Wobe exɔ ŋusẽ tso nunɔlagã siwo le Yerusalem la gbɔ, be yeava lé ame siwo katã subɔa wò le afi sia la.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: “Heyi, elabe ɖe metia ame sia be wòanye ŋudɔwɔnu nam. Medi be wòana ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, fiawo kple Israel-dukɔmetɔwo nanya nye ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ale Anania tso yi ɖage ɖe aƒe si me Saulo le la me. Eda asi ɖe edzi gblɔ nɛ be: “Nɔvi Saulo, Aƒetɔ Yesu, ame si ɖe eɖokui fia wò le mɔ dzi esi nègbɔna lae dɔm ɖe gbɔwò, be wò ŋkuwo naʋu, nàgakpɔ nu eye nàxɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: Eɖu nu eye wòkpɔ ŋusẽ. Saulo gblɔ mawunya le Damasko Saulo nɔ xɔsetɔ siwo le Damasko la gbɔ ŋkeke geɖe.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Eyi ɖe ƒuƒoƒewo enumake, eye wòɖe gbeƒã be: “Yesue nye Mawu Vi la.”

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã ɖo toe se eƒe nyawo la ƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye wobia be: “Alo ɖe menye ŋutsu siae wɔ funyafunya ame siwo xɔ Yesu ŋkɔ dzi se le Yerusalem oa? Gawu la, ɖe menye susu ma ke tae wòva afi sia ɖo be yeava lé xɔsetɔwo abla akplɔ yi ɖe nunɔlagãwo gbɔe oa?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Ŋkeke geɖe megbe la, Yudatɔwo ɖo nugbe ɖe Saulo ŋu be yewoawui,

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: gake ese nugbeɖoɖoa. Yudatɔwo nɔ agboawo nu dzɔm zã kple keli be yewoawui.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka le zã me la, Saulo ƒe nusrɔ̃lawo kɔe de kusi me, to gli ta heɖiɖii ɖe anyi, eye wòdzo. Saulo le Yerusalem

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke Barnaba kplɔe va amedɔdɔawo gbɔe. Eƒo nu na wo le ale si Saulo kpɔ Aƒetɔ la le mɔ dzi, eye Aƒetɔ la ƒo nu nɛ kple ale si wògblɔ mawunya vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee le Damasko le Yesu ŋkɔ me la ŋu.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ale Saulo hã ge ɖe wo dome le Yerusalem, eye wògblɔ mawunya vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Edzro nya me kple Yudatɔ siwo doa Hela-gbe, ke wodi mɔnu le eŋu be yewoawui.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Esi nɔviawo see la, wokplɔe yi ɖe Kaisarea, eye woɖoe ɖe Tarso tso afi ma.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Azɔ la, hame siwo katã le Yudea, Galilea kple Samaria la ƒe to me fa, eye wotsi ɖe edzi. Wonɔ agbe ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya nu, eye wodzi ɖe edzi, elabe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la na woƒe dzi dze eme. Petro de Lida kple Yopa

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Petro tsa le xɔsetɔ geɖewo dzi de teƒe geɖe. Eyi ɖe Lida hã be yeakpɔ ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la ɖa le afi ma.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Edo go lãmetututɔ aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Ainea. Ŋutsu sia nɔ dɔba dzi ƒè enyi sɔŋ.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Tete Petro gblɔ nɛ be: “Ainea, Yesu Kristo yɔ dɔ wò. Tsi tre nàɖo wò aba.” Ainea tsi tsitre enumake.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Esi ame siwo katã le Lida kple Saron kpɔe la, woxɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu nusrɔ̃la aɖe nɔ Yopa si ŋkɔe nye Tabita. Ewɔ dɔ nyui geɖe, eye wònyo dɔme na hiãtɔwo.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Eva dze dɔ, eye wòku. Esi wole tsi nɛ vɔ la, wokɔe yi ɖamlɔ dziƒoxɔ dzi.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Lida medidi tso Yopa gbɔ o. Ale esi nusrɔ̃lawo se be Petro le Lida la, wodɔ ame eve ɖee gblɔ be: “Míeɖe kuku, tso kpla nàva kpɔ mí ɖa.”

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Ale Petro tso heyi kple amedɔdɔawo. Esi woɖo afi ma la, wokplɔ Petro yi ɖe dziƒoxɔa dzi. Ahosiwo katã va le tsitre ɖe Petro gbɔ le avi fam, eye wotsɔ awutewui kple awu siwo Tabita tɔ le eƒe agbenɔɣi la le fiafiam.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Petro na ameawo katã do go le xɔa me. Edze klo hedo gbe ɖa. Etrɔ ɖe ame kukua gbɔ yɔe gblɔ be: “Tabita, tsi tsitre!” Tete nyɔnua ʋu ŋku. Esi wòkpɔ Petro la, efɔ bɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Petro de asi asi me nɛ, hekɔe wòtso ɖe tsitrenu. Eyɔ ame siwo ŋu wokɔ kple ahosi siwo le afi ma la vɛ, eye wòtsɔe de wo si agbagbee.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nya sia ɖi hoo le Yopa, ale be ame geɖewo va xɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Petro tsi Yopa ŋkeke geɖe, eye wònɔ Simon, lãgbalẽdɔwɔla la gbɔ.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Ŋutsu aɖe nɔ Kaisarea si ŋkɔe nye Kornelio. Enye aʋakplɔla le Roma-srafoha si woyɔna be “Italia-srafoha” la me.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Kornelio doa vevi mawusubɔsubɔ, eye eya kple eƒe aƒemetɔwo katã nye mawuvɔ̃lawo. Enaa nu hiãtɔwo faa, eye wòdoa gbe ɖa na Mawu ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka ɣetrɔ abe ga etɔ̃ me ene la, Kornelio kpɔ Mawu ƒe dɔla aɖe le ŋutega me. Dɔla la va yɔe be: “Kornelio!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ ɖoe, eye wòle dɔla la kpɔm gã. Kornelio bia be: “Aƒetɔ, nu kae?” Mawudɔla la ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ale si nèdoa gbe ɖa kple ale si nèwɔa dɔmenyo na amewo la dze Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, dɔ ame ɖe Yopa be wòaɖayɔ Simon si wogayɔna hã be Petro la vɛ.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: Edze Simon, lãgbalẽdɔwɔla, ame si ƒe aƒe le ƒu nu lɔƒo la gbɔ.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Esi mawudɔla si ƒo nu kplii la dzo la, Kornelio yɔ eƒe dɔla eve vɛ. Etia eƒe asrafo siwo subɔnɛ la dometɔ ɖeka si nye mawuvɔ̃la la kpe ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ nu siwo katã dzɔ la na wo la, edɔ wo ɖe Yopa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Ŋkeke evea gbe esi wole mɔzɔzɔ dzi hegogo Yopa la, Petro yi ɖe aƒe si me wòle la ƒe xɔta be yeado gbe ɖa. Anɔ abe ŋdɔ ga wui eve me ene.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Dɔ nɔ ewum, eye nuɖuɖu dzroe. Ke esi wole nua ɖam la, ekpɔ ŋutega.

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: Ekpɔ dziƒo wòʋu ɖi. Ekpɔ nane si ɖi aklala gbadza gã aɖe. Woɖiɖii to eƒe dzogoe eneawo dzi ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Lãfɔnewo, nutatawo kple xevi ƒomevi vovovowo le nua dzi.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Gbe aɖe ɖi gblɔ nɛ be: “Petro, tso, nàwu nu siawo nàɖu!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ke Petro ɖo eŋu be: “Gbeɖe, Aƒetɔ, nu si ŋu mekɔ le kɔa nu alo nu si woƒo ɖii la mede nye nu me kpɔ o.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Gbea gaɖi nɛ zi evelia gblɔ be: “Nu si ŋuti Mawu kɔ la medze be nàbui nu makɔmakɔ o.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Wowɔ nu sia zi etɔ̃ sɔŋ. Tete wokɔ nua zi ɖeka yi dziƒoe.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Petro tɔtɔ eye wònɔ tame bum vevie be yease ŋutega la gɔme. Ɣeyiɣi sia me tututu la, Kornelio ƒe amedɔdɔ siwo yi ɖabia Simon ƒe aƒe ta se la va ɖo agboa nu.

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: Wokɔ gbe dzi bia be: “Afi siae Simon si woyɔna be Petro la va dze mahã?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Petro ganɔ tame bum le ŋutega la ŋu ko. Kasia Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, ŋutsu etɔ̃ va le diwòm.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Tso, nàɖi yi wo gbɔ ne miayi. Mègahe ɖe megbe o, elabe nye ŋutɔe dɔ wo ɖe gbɔwò.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Ale Petro ɖi yi ɖe ameawo gbɔ, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Nyee nye ame si dim miele. Gbɔnye fa.”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Woɖo eŋu be: “Míawo hã mía gbɔ fa. Aʋakplɔla Kornelio ye dɔ mí ɖe gbɔwò. Enye nuteƒewɔla vɔ̃mawu, ame si ƒe nyanyui Yudatɔwo katã gblɔna. Ebe mawudɔla kɔkɔe aɖe bia tso ye si be yeneɖo ame ɖe wò nàva ye ƒeme, ne nàva gblɔ gbɔwò nya na ye.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Ale Petro na amedzroawo ge ɖe aƒea me hedze egbɔ, eye wotsi afi ma dɔ. Esi ŋu ke la, edzra ɖo eye eya kple amedɔdɔawo kpakple nɔvi siwo le Yopa dome ame aɖewo dze mɔ.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Woɖo Kaisarea ŋkeke evea gbe. Kornelio kple eƒe ƒometɔwo kpakple exɔlɔ̃ vevi siwo wòkpe la le mɔ kpɔm na wo.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Esi Petro ge ɖe aƒea me la, Kornelio do va kpee. Edze klo ɖe eƒe afɔnu, eye wòde ta agu nɛ.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Ke Petro fɔe dzi, eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Tsi tre. Amegbetɔ ko nye hã menye.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Wo ame eve la nɔ dze ɖom ge ɖe eme, eye Petro kpɔ ame geɖewo ƒo ƒu ɖi.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Petro gblɔ na wo be: “Miawo ŋutɔ mienyae be se meɖe mɔ na Yudatɔ aɖeke be wòade ha kple dukɔ bubu me tɔ aɖe, alo wòaɖi tsa ayi egbɔ teti hã o. Ke Mawu na menya be medze be mabu ame aɖeke be eya medze woazɔ kplii loo, alo enye ame ƒoɖi o.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Esia tae esi miedɔ ame ɖem la, nyemegbe vava o. Azɔ la, mabia mi se: Nya ka ŋutie mieyɔm ɖo?”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Kornelio gblɔ be: “Ŋkeke enee nye esi va yi la, menɔ gbe dom ɖa le nye aƒeme le ɣetrɔ ga etɔ̃ me. Kasia ŋutsu aɖe, si do awu si le dzo dam la va le tsitre ɖe gbɔnye.

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: ‘Kornelio, Mawu se wò gbedodoɖa eye wòkpɔ ale si nèwɔa dɔmenyo na amewoe.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Dɔ ame ɖe Yopa, ne woaɖayɔ Simon si wogayɔna hã be Petro la vɛ. Edze Simon, lãgbalẽdɔwɔla, ame si ƒe aƒe le ƒu nu lɔƒo la gbɔ.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Ale medɔ ame ɖe wò enumake. Enyo ŋutɔ be nèva. Mí katã míeƒo ƒu ɖe Mawu ŋkume afii, be míase nya si Aƒetɔ la de asiwò be nàgblɔ na mí la.” Petro ƒe nuƒo

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Tete Petro ƒo nu na wo gblɔ be: “Nyateƒe, mekpɔe dze sii be Mawu medea vovototo ame me o.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ le dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me la, ame si vɔ̃nɛ eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, eyae dzea eŋu.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Mienya nya si wògblɔ ɖo ɖe Israel-dukɔ la. Nya sia nye gbeƒã si woɖe be Nyanyui la he ŋutifafa vɛ to Yesu Kristo si nye amewo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ la dzi.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Woɖe gbeƒã nya la le Yudea-nyigba katã dzi. Wodze egɔme tso Galilea, esime Yohanes ɖe gbeƒã mawutsilename vɔ megbe.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Mienya be Mawu tsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ si ami na Yesu Nazaretetɔ la. Mienya be etsa yi teƒe geɖe, wɔ nyui na amewo, eye wòda gbe le ame siwo katã Abosam te ɖe anyi la ŋu, elabe Mawu nɔ kplii.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Nu siwo katã wòwɔ le Israel-dukɔa me kple Yerusalem la, míawoe kpɔ eteƒe kple ŋku. Ke woklãe ɖe ati ŋu hewui.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Gake Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe, eye wòɖee fia amewo.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Menye ame sia amee kpɔe o; ke mí ame siwo Mawu tia be míanye ɖaseɖilawo la, míekpɔe. Esi wòfɔ tso ku me la, míawoe ɖu nu heno nu kplii.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na mí be míɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la na amewo, eye míɖi ɖase be Kristoe nye ame si Mawu ɖo be wòava drɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame gbagbewo kple ame kukuwo siaa.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Eya ŋue Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo katã ɖi ɖase le be le eyama ƒe ŋusẽ ta la, ame sia ame si xɔ edzi se la, woatsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃wo akee.” Ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o hã xɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Petro mekpɔ wu eƒe nuƒoa nu hafi Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ɖi ɖe ame siwo katã se nya la dzi o.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Xɔsetɔ aɖewo siwo nye Yudatɔ la kplɔ Petro yi ɖe Yopa. Esi wokpɔ be Mawu tsɔ eƒe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la kɔ ɖe ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la gɔ̃ hã dzi la, woƒe nu ku.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Elabe wose wole nu ƒom le gbe bubuwo me hele Mawu kafum. Petro ƒo nu gblɔ be:

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Ame siawo hã xɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la abe míawo ke ene, ɖe ame aɖe ate ŋu axe mɔ be womale mawutsi na wo oa?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Ale wòna wole mawutsi na wo ɖe Yesu Kristo ŋkɔ me. Emegbe la, ameawo bia tso Petro si be wòanɔ yewo gbɔ ŋkeke aɖewo.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Amedɔdɔ kple nɔvi siwo le Yudea la se be ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã xɔ Mawu ƒe nya la.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Eya ta esime Petro va Yerusalem la, hamea ƒe hatsotso si dina be woatso aʋa hafi age ɖe hamea me la tso ɖe eŋu hehe nya kplii. Wobiae be:

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: “Nu ka tae nèyi ɖadze bolobolotɔwo gbɔ, eye mia kple wo mieɖu nu?”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Petro gblɔ nu si va dzɔ la fia wo tsitotsito. Ebe:

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “Yopa-dua me mele, le gbe dom ɖa, eye woɖe nane fiam le ŋutega me. Mekpɔ nane si ɖi aklala gbadza gã aɖe. Woɖiɖii to eƒe dzogoe eneawo dzi tso dziƒo ɖe gbɔnye.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Esi melé ŋku ɖe eŋu nyuie la, mekpɔ lãfɔnewo, lã wɔadãwo, nutatawo kple dziƒoxeviwo le edzi.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Gbe aɖe ɖi gblɔ nam be: ‘Petro, tso nàwu nu siawo nàɖu!’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ke meɖo eŋu be: ‘Gbeɖe, Aƒetɔ, nu si ŋuti mekɔ le kɔa nu alo nu si woƒo ɖii la, mede nye nu me kpɔ o.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ke gbe la gaɖi zi evelia tso dziƒo ɖo eŋu be: ‘Nu si ŋu Mawu kɔ la medze be nàbui nu makɔmakɔ o.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Wowɔ nu sia zi etɔ̃ sɔŋ. Azɔ wohe nuawo katã gayi dziƒoe.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi sia me tututu la, ame etɔ̃ aɖewo va ge ɖe aƒe si me mele la me. Wodɔ ame siawo ɖem tso Kaisarea.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔ nam be mayi kple ame siawo ɖikeke aɖeke manɔmee. Nɔvi xɔsetɔ ade siawo hã kpe ɖe ŋunye míeyi ɖe ŋutsua ƒeme.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Egblɔ na mí be yekpɔ mawudɔla wòle tsitre ɖe yeƒe aƒeme. Ebe mawudɔla la gblɔ na ye be: ‘Ɖo ame aɖe ɖe Yopa ne wòaɖayɔ Simon, ame si woyɔna hã be Petro la vɛ.

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: Eya agblɔ nya si ana woaxɔ mia kple wò aƒe ɖe agbe la na mi.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Esi medze nye nuƒoa gɔme la, Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ɖi ɖe wo dzi, abe ale si wòɖi ɖe míawo hã mía dzi le gɔmedzedzea me la ene.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Tete meɖo ŋku Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya si wògblɔ la dzi be: ‘Yohanes le mawutsi na amewo kple tsi, ke miawo ya, woatsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe alee na mi.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Ne Mawu tsɔ nunana si tututu wòtsɔ na mí, esime míexɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu dzi se la na ame siawo hã la, ame kae menye axe mɔ na Mawu?

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Esi wose nya sia la, womenya nya ka woagagblɔ o. Ke boŋ wokafu Mawu gblɔ be: ‘Ke Mawu ʋu mɔ na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã be woatrɔ dzime anɔ agbe!’ ” Antioxia-hame la

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Le Stefano ƒe ku megbe la, woti xɔsetɔwo yome vevie. Ale wokaka do ɖe Foenisia, Kipro kple Antioxia henɔ Nyanyui la gblɔm na Yudatɔwo ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ke xɔsetɔ bubu aɖewo, siwo tso Kipro kple Kirene la va Antioxia, eye woɖe gbeƒã Aƒetɔ Yesu na Helatɔwo hã.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la kpe ɖe wo ŋu, ale ame geɖewo xɔ se hetrɔ ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Yerusalem-hame la se nya sia, eye wodɔ Barnaba ɖo ɖe Antioxia.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Esi wòɖo la, dzi dzɔe elabe ekpɔ be Mawu ve ameawo nu ŋutɔ. Ede dzi ƒo na wo katã be woanɔ Aƒetɔ la yome kplikpaa, eye woawɔ nuteƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Barnaba nye ame ɖɔʋu aɖe. Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔe taŋ, eye eƒe xɔse li ke. Ale ame geɖe to edzi xɔ Aƒetɔ la dzi se.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, Barnaba yi ɖe Tarso ɖadi Saulo.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Esi wòkpɔe la, ekplɔe va Antioxia. Wo ame eve la nɔ hamea gbɔ ƒe ɖeka, eye wofia nu ame geɖe. Antioxia, afi siae woyɔ xɔsetɔwo le zi gbãtɔ be: “Kristotɔwo.”

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela aɖewo tso Yerusalem va Antioxia.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ ɖeka ŋkɔe nye Agabo. Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la na wògblɔ nya ɖi be dɔ gã aɖe le toto ge le xexea me katã. Esia va ve me le Roma Fiagã Klaudio ƒe dziɖuɣi.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Ale nusrɔ̃laawo ɖoe be ame sia ame nadzɔ nu si wòate ŋui, ne yewoatsɔ ayi ɖakpe ɖe hametɔ siwo le Yudea la ŋu.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wodzɔ nua, eye wotsɔe na Barnaba kple Saulo wotsɔ yi na hamemetsitsiawo.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi lɔƒo la, Fia Herodes ti hametɔ aɖewo yome ŋɔdzitɔe.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Esi wòkpɔ be esia dze Yudatɔwo ŋu la, elé Petro hã. .

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Esi wòlée la, edee gaxɔ me. Ena asrafo wui ade siwo le hatsotso ene me la le Petro ŋu dzɔm. Herodes ɖoe be ne Paska la va yi vɔ la, ekema yeahee ɖe go adrɔ̃ ʋɔnui le dutoƒo.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Ale Petro le gaxɔa me, ke hametɔwo nɔ gbe dom ɖa na Mawu vevie ɖe eta. Woɖe Petro le gaxɔ me

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke si dzi tututu Herodes le Petro ɖe ge ɖe dutoƒo la ƒe zã me la, wode kɔsɔkɔsɔ eve Petro eye wòle alɔ̃ dɔm le asrafo eve dome. Dzɔlawo nɔ ʋɔtrua nu hã henɔ gaxɔ la ŋu dzɔm.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Kasia Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔla do, eye kekeli klẽ ɖe gaxɔa me. Mawudɔla la ƒo Petro ƒe axadame, nyɔe hegblɔ nɛ be: “Fɔ kaba!” Enumake kɔsɔkɔsɔawo ge le Petro ƒe alɔnu.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla la gblɔ nɛ be: “Bla ali dzi, nàdo afɔkpa.” Petro wɔ nenema. Mawudɔla la gagblɔ nɛ be: “Do wò awu ʋlaya nàdze yonyeme.”

english_verse: Peter left with the angel, but he thought everything was only a dream.
translation_verse: Ale Petro kplɔe ɖo eye wodo le gaxɔa me. Petro menya be nu si le eme vam to mawudɔla la dzi la, le dzɔdzɔm vavã o.

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Esi woto dzɔla gbãtɔwo kple eveliawo ŋu la, wova ɖo dua ƒe agbo si wowɔ kple gakpo la nu. Agboa ŋutɔ koe ʋu le eɖokui si siaa, eye wodo dzo. Wozɔ mɔdodo aɖe dzi yina, kasia mawudɔla la dzo le egbɔ.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Petro ƒe mo kɔ azɔ, eye wògblɔ be: “Nyateƒe, menya azɔ be, Aƒetɔ lae dɔ eƒe dɔla ɖa wòva ɖem tso Fia Herodes si me. Eɖem tso nu siwo katã Yudatɔwo kpɔ mɔ na be adzɔ ɖe dzinye la hã me.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Esi wòkpɔ esia dze sii la, eyi ɖe Maria, Yohanes si woyɔna be Marko la, dada ƒeme. Ame geɖe ƒo ƒu ɖe afi ma le gbe dom ɖa.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Petro ƒo agbo la, eye nyɔnuvidɔla aɖe, si ŋkɔe nye Roda la do va, be yeakpɔ ɖa be ame kae hã.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Esi nyɔnuvia se Petro ƒe gbe me la, edze sii be eyae. Dzi dzɔe ale gbegbe be megaxaʋu agbo la gɔ̃ hã o, ɖeko wòsi du trɔ yi eme ɖagblɔ na wo be Petro ye le tsitre ɖe agboa nu.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ nɛ be: “Èdze aɖaʋa!” Ke nyɔnuvia ka ɖe edzi be nyateƒee. Ameawo gblɔ nɛ be: “Ekem anye Petro ƒe mawudɔlae!”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Petro ganɔ agboa ƒoƒo dzi. Esi woʋui hekpɔ Petro la, woƒe nu ku.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Petro wɔ asi na wo be woazi ɖoɖoe. Emegbe la, eƒo nu na wo tso ale si Aƒetɔ la ɖee tso gaxɔa me la ŋu. Egblɔ na wo be: “Miyi ɖagblɔ nya sia na Yakobo kple nɔvi bubuawo hã.” Esia megbe la, Petro dzo le wo gbɔ yi ɖe teƒe bubu.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Esi ŋu ke la, asrafoawo tɔtɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ, elabe womenya nu si dzɔ ɖe Petro dzi o.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Herodes na wodii ʋuu, ke womekpɔe o. Edrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo eye wòɖe gbe be woakplɔ wo aɖawu. Esia megbe la, Fia Herodes trɔ tso Yudea, yi Kaisarea, eye wòɖanɔ afi ma. Fia Herodes ƒe ku

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka la, Herodes do dɔmedzoe ɖe Tirotɔwo kple Sidontɔwo ŋu. Ale ameawo wɔ ɖeka va egbɔ. Gbã la, wokpɔ Blasto, ame si nye fia la ƒe nuwo dzikpɔla la hebia tso esi be wòakpe ɖe yewo ŋu. Woyi ɖe fia la gbɔ azɔ hebia tomefafa, elabe Herodes ƒe dukɔ mee wokpɔa nuɖuɖu tsonɛ.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Woɖo ŋkeke eye gbe ma gbe la, Herodes do fiawu, bɔbɔ nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi, eye wòƒo nu na ameha blibo la.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Ameawo do ɣli be: “Mawu ƒe gbee le ɖiɖim; menye amegbetɔ tɔe o!”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Enumake Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔla ƒo Herodes, elabe metsɔ bubu na Mawu o. Ale wòdze nyé heku.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Esi Barnaba kple Saulo wu dɔ si wode asi na wo la nu vɔ la, wokplɔ Yohanes si woyɔna be Marko la ɖe asi trɔ gbɔ tso Yerusalem.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela kple nufiala aɖewo nɔ Antioxia-hamea me. Woƒe ŋkɔwoe nye Barnaba, Simeon si woyɔna be Ameyibɔ, Lukio tso Kirene, Manahem ame si wonyi kple dziɖula Herodes kple Saulo.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Esime wonɔ Aƒetɔ la subɔm eye wotsi nu dɔ la, Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la gblɔ na wo be: “Miɖe Barnaba kple Saulo ɖe aga nam, ne woawɔ dɔ si ta meyɔ wo ɖo la.”

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Ale wotsi nu dɔ, do gbe ɖa eye woda asi ɖe wo dzi hedo mɔ wo. Barnaba kple Saulo le Kipro

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la fia mɔ Barnaba kple Saulo, eye woyi Seleukia. Woɖo tɔdziʋu tso afi ma yi Kipro-ƒukpo dzi.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Esi woɖo Salami la, wogblɔ mawunya le Yudatɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒewo. Yohanes hã nɔ wo ŋu abe kpeɖeŋutɔ ene.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Esi wozɔ to ƒukpo blibo la dzi va ɖo Pafo la, wodo go Yudatɔ dzosala aʋatsogbeƒãɖela aɖe. Eŋkɔe nye Yesuvi.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu sia le Sergio Paulo si nye dua dziɖula la gbɔ. Sergio Paulo nye nunyala deŋgɔ aɖe. Dziɖula sia yɔ Barnaba kple Saulo va eƒemee hebia tso wo si be woagblɔ Mawu ƒe nya la yease.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke Elima tsi tsitre ɖe wo ŋu, eye wòdi be yeatrɔ dua dziɖula la ƒe susu, ne magase nya la ava yi edzi xɔ ge ase o.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Ke Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔ Saulo, ame si wona ŋkɔe be Paulo la taŋ. Ekpɔ dzosala la dũu,

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ nɛ be: “Wò Abosam vi, wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe ketɔ; wò ame si tsɔ alakpa kple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ɖo dɔe! Ke màdzudzɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe mɔ dzɔdzɔe la gɔglɔ̃ oa?

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la ahe to na wò fifi laa. Wò ŋku agbã, màgakpɔ ɣe o, va se ɖe ɣeyiɣi aɖe.” Enumake afu xe ŋku dzi na Elima, eye eƒe ŋku tsí. Enɔ asi nyem ya me nɔ ame dim be wòakplɔ ye.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Esi dua dziɖula la kpɔ nu si dzɔ la, exɔ nya la dzi se, elabe nu si wofia tso Aƒetɔ la ŋu la, wɔ nuku nɛ ale gbegbe. Barnaba kple Paulo le Antioxia si le Pisidia

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Azɔ Paulo kple etɔwo ɖo tɔdziʋu tso Pafo va ɖo Perge le Pamfilia. Ke Yohanes trɔ le wo yome gbugbɔ yi Yerusalem.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Woyi mɔzɔzɔa dzi tso Perge va ɖo Antioxia si le Pisidia. Dzudzɔgbe la, woyi ɖe ƒuƒoƒe la, eye wobɔbɔ nɔ anyi.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Esi ƒuƒoƒea nunɔlawo xlẽ nya tso Mose ƒe se la kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe agbalẽwo me vɔ la, woɖo ame ɖe Paulo kple etɔwo be: “Nɔviwo, ne nuxlɔ̃amenya aɖe le mia si, miedi be yewoagblɔ na anyinɔƒea la, migblɔe faa.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Ale Paulo tsi tsitre wɔ asi na ameawo hedze eƒe nuƒoa gɔme. Ebe: “Israeltɔwo kple mi ame siwo vɔ̃a Mawu, miɖo tom.

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Israel-dukɔ la ƒe Mawu la tia mía tɔgbuiwo, eye wòwɔ wo dukɔ deŋgɔ aɖe, esime wonɔ Egipte-nyigba dzi. Mawu kplɔ wo kple eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la dzoe le Egipte.

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Esi wòtsrɔ̃ dukɔ adrẽ le Kanaan-nyigba dzi la, etsɔ woƒe anyigba na mía tɔgbuiwo abe woƒe domenyinu ene. Nudzɔdzɔ siawo katã xɔ abe ƒe alafa ene bla atɔ̃ ene.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Ke esi Mawu ɖe Saulo le zi dzi la, eɖo David fiae ɖe eteƒe na wo. Mawu ɖi ɖase le David ŋu be: ‘David, Isai vi la nye ame si tɔgbe tututu dim mele. Eyae nye ame si awɔ nu siwo katã medi la.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Mawu to ame sia ƒe dzidzime dzi ɖo Xɔla aɖe ɖe Israel-dukɔ, be yeawɔ ŋugbe si yedo la dzi. Xɔla siae nye Yesu.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Hafi Xɔla sia nava la, Yohanes va ɖe gbeƒã na Israel-dukɔ la be amewo katã natrɔ dzime, eye woale mawutsi na wo.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Esi wòsusɔ vie Yohanes nawu eƒe dɔ nu la, ebia be: ‘Ame kae miebu be menye? Menye nyee nye ame si miele mɔ kpɔm na la o. Gbeɖe! Amea le megbenye gbɔna. Nyemedze aɖe eƒe afɔkpa gɔ̃ hã o.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: “Nɔvinyewo, Abraham tɔgbuiyɔviwo kple mawuvɔ̃la siwo le mia dome, míawoe woɖo gbedeasi sia ɖa, be Mawu xɔ mí ɖe agbe!

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Ame siwo le Yerusalem kple wo dziɖulawo menya be Xɔla lae nye ema o. Gawu la, womese mawunya si Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo xlẽna Dzudzɔgbe sia Dzudzɔgbe la gɔme o, ale wobu fɔ Xɔla la. Esiae wɔe be nu siwo woɖe gbeƒãe le Xɔla sia ŋu ɖi la va ve me.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Ke Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome.

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: Emegbe eɖe eɖokui fia ame siwo zɔ kplii tso Galilea va Yerusalem la ŋkeke geɖe. Ame siawoe le ɖase ɖim le eŋuti na amewo.

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: Eyae nye be Mawu wɔ nu si ŋugbe wòdo na mía tɔgbuiwo la na mí, wo viwo, elabe efɔ Yesu ɖe tsitre tso ku me, abe ale si woŋlɔ ɖe Psalmo evelia me ene be: ‘Vinyee nènye; Mezu tɔ́wò egbe.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Ke esi Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye eƒe ŋutilã manyunyɔ akpɔ o la, egblɔ le eŋuti be: ‘Matsɔ yayra kɔkɔe si dzi meka ɖo na David la, ayra wò.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Eya tae wògagblɔ le Psalmo bubu me be: ‘Màɖe mɔ be wò dɔla kɔkɔe la, nanyunyɔ o.’

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Ke esi David wɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi wu enu vɔ le ame siwo dome wòdzɔ ɖo la, eku, eye woɖii ɖe tɔgbuiawo dome, eye eƒe ŋutilã nyunyɔ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Ke ame si Mawu fɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome ya la, menyunyɔ o.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔviwo, medi be mianya kɔtɛe be Yesu sia dzie woto le gbeƒã ɖem nuvɔ̃tsɔtsɔke.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, mi fewuɖulawo, miaƒe mo newɔ yaa, ne miatsrɔ̃. Elabe nu siwo wɔm mele le mia ŋɔli la, ne ame aɖe ɖe eme na mi gɔ̃ hã la, miele exɔ ge ase o!’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Esi Paulo kple Barnaba do yina la, ameawo bia tso wo si be woagava ƒo nu na yewo le nu siawo ke ŋuti le Dzudzɔgbe si dze ema yome.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Esi ameawo do le takpeƒea la, Yudatɔwo kple trɔ̃subɔla-zu-Yudatɔ siwo vɔ̃a Mawu la dze Paulo kple Barnaba yome. Amedɔdɔawo do ŋusẽ wo be womegaŋlɔ ale si Mawu ve wo nui la be o.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Le Dzudzɔgbe si dze ema yome la, dua me tɔwo katã kloe ƒo ƒu be yewoase Mawu ƒe nya la.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Esi Yudatɔwo kpɔ amehaawo la, woʋã ŋu amedɔdɔawo. Wogblɔ busunya tsi tre ɖe nu siwo Paulo gblɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Tete Paulo kple Barnaba ƒo nu na wo vɔvɔ̃ manɔmee be: “Miawo boŋ wòdze be woagblɔ Mawu ƒe nya la na gbã hafi. Ke esi miebu mia ɖokui be yewomedze na agbe mavɔ o ta la, míetrɔ ɖe ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la gbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Elabe nenemae Aƒetɔ la ɖe gbe na mí be: ‘Meɖo wò anyi abe kekeli ene na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, ale be to dziwò la, woaxɔ ame sia ame ɖe agbe le afi sia afi.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Esi ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la se nya sia la, dzi dzɔ wo, eye wokafu Mawu ƒe nya la. Ale ame geɖe siwo Mawu tia ɖi na agbe mavɔ la xɔe se.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya la kaka ɖe nuto ma katã me.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Ke Yudatɔwo na nyɔnu bubume siwo vɔ̃a Mawu la kple dumegãwo tso ɖe Paulo kple Barnaba ŋu. Woti wo yome, henya wo dzoe le woƒe nutoa me.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Paulo kple Barnaba ʋuʋu ke le afɔ tsɔ fia be yewotsi tre ɖe ameawo ƒe nuwɔna ŋu, eye wodzo yi Ikonio.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Nusrɔ̃la siwo le afi ma la kpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ, eye Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la yɔ wo taŋ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Esi Paulo kple Barnaba va ɖo Ikonio la, woyi ɖe Yudatɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒe. Nya siwo wogagblɔ la wɔ dɔ ɖe ameawo dzi ale gbegbe, be Yudatɔ kple Helatɔ geɖewo xɔe se.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ke Yudatɔ siwo gbe be yewomaxɔe se o la, gblẽ ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la ƒe susu ale be wotso ɖe xɔsetɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Amedɔdɔawo nɔ afi ma ŋkeke geɖe. Woƒo nu tso Aƒetɔ la ŋuti dzideƒotɔe. Aƒetɔ la ɖee fia be yeƒe amenuvenya la le eme eye wòto wo dzi wɔ dzesi kple nukunu geɖe.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Ke dua me tɔwo ma ɖe akpa eve me; akpa ɖeka le Yudatɔwo dzi, eye akpa evelia le amedɔdɔawo dzi.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, Yudatɔ aɖewo kple ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o kpakple woƒe kplɔla aɖewo ɖo nugbe ɖe amedɔdɔawo ŋu, be yewoaɖe fu na wo ahaƒu kpe wo.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ŋutsu aɖe le Listra si wodzi wònye tekunɔ, eye mezɔ azɔli kpɔ o.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Eɖo to se Paulo ƒe nyawo. Paulo lé ŋku ɖe edzi gã hekpɔe dze sii be exɔ se woada gbe le eŋu.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Esi ameha la kpɔ nu si Paulo wɔ la, wodo ɣli gblɔ le Likaonia-gbe me be: “Mawuwo zu ame va mía dome!”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Wona ŋkɔ Barnaba be Zeus, eye esi wònye Paulo ye le wo nu ɖem ta la, woyɔ eya be Herme.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Tete Yupiter, si nye mawu, si ƒe gbedoxɔ le dua gbɔ la ƒe nunɔla tsɔ nyitsuwo kple seƒoƒowo va agbo la nu, elabe eya kple eŋumewo di be yewoasa vɔ na amedɔdɔawo.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Esi Barnaba kple Paulo se esia la, wodze awu le wo ɖokui ŋu, eye wosi du ge ɖe ameawo dome gblɔ kple ɣli be:

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: “Nɔviwo, nu ka ta miele nu siawo wɔm? Amegbetɔwo ko míenye abe miawo ke ene! Míeva be míaɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la na mi, be miatrɔ tso nu dzodzro siawo gbɔ ava Mawu gbagbe la gbɔ. Eyae wɔ dziƒo, anyigba, atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le wo me la.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Le blema la, Mawu ɖe mɔ na dukɔ vovovoawo wonɔ agbe ale si dze wo ŋu.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Ke nu nyui siwo wòwɔna ɣe sia ɣi la ɖia ɖase be eli vavã. Ewɔa dɔmenyo, enaa tsi dzana na mi tso dziƒo, nukuwo wɔna le ɣelaɣi eye wònaa nuɖuɖu mi, hedoa dzidzɔ na mi.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Bebli hafi wotsɔ nya siawo xe mɔ na ameawo, be womagasa vɔ na wo o.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Ke Yudatɔ aɖewo tso Antioxia le Pisidia kple Ikonio va afi ma. Wotrɔ ameha la ƒe susu. Ale be woƒu kpe Paulo, hee va da ɖe dua godo, elabe wobu be eku.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Ke esi nusrɔ̃laawo va ƒo xlãe la, efɔ, eye wòyi dua me. Esi ŋu ke la, eya kple Barnaba wodzo yi Derbe. Paulo kple Barnaba trɔ yi Antioxia le Siria

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Paulo kple Barnaba gblɔ Nyanyui la le Derbe, eye ame geɖe va zu woƒe nusrɔ̃lawo. Emegbe la, wogbugbɔ va to Listra kple Ikonio heva do ɖe Antioxia le Pisidia.

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Wodo ŋusẽ nusrɔ̃lawo, eye wode dzi ƒo na wo, be woalé xɔse la me ɖe asi nyateƒetɔe kple nya siawo be: “Ele na mí be míakpe fu geɖe hafi age ɖe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la me.”

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Wotia hamemegãwo ɖe ha ɖe sia ɖe nu. Amedɔdɔawo do gbe ɖa, tsi nu dɔ, eye wotsɔ ame siawo de asi na Aƒetɔ, si dzi woxɔ se la.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, woto Pisidia-nutome va do ɖe Pamfilia.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Esi wogblɔ nya la le Perge la, woyi Atalia.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Woɖo tɔdziʋu tso afi ma gbugbɔ va Antioxia le Siria. Afi siae wotsɔ amedɔdɔ siawo de Mawu si me le gbã, be wòave wo nu ne woaɖawɔ dɔ sinu wum wole la.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Esi wova ɖo la, woƒo hametɔawo nu ƒu, eye woɖe gbeƒã nu siwo katã Mawu kpe ɖe wo ŋu wowɔ kple ale si wòʋu mɔ na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã, eye woxɔ se la na wo.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Wonɔ nusrɔ̃la siwo le afi ma la gbɔ eteƒe didi.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Azɔ ame aɖewo tso Yudea va Antioxia va le nu fiam hametɔwo be: “Ne wometso aʋa na mi le Mose ƒe kɔa nu o la, womate ŋu axɔ mi ɖe agbe akpɔ o.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Paulo kple Barnaba ʋli nya sia sesĩe kple ameawo. Ale wotia Paulo kple Barnaba kpakple ame bubu aɖewo, siwo tso Antioxia la, be woayi Yerusalem aɖakpɔ amedɔdɔawo kple hamemetsitsiwo le nya sia ŋu.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Esi hame la dɔ wo ɖa alea la, woto Foenisia kple Samaria hele ale si ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã trɔ dzime la xlẽm fia. Nya sia do dzidzɔ na hametɔwo katã ŋutɔ.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Esi wova ɖo Yerusalem la, amedɔdɔawo, hamemetsitsiwo kple hamea xɔ wo nyuie. Paulo kple Barnaba gblɔ nu siwo katã Mawu wɔ to wo dzi la na wo.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Ke xɔsetɔ siwo tso Farisitɔwo ƒe habɔbɔ me la tso gblɔ be: “Ehiã be woatso aʋa na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, eye woana woawɔ Mose ƒe sea dzi.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ale amedɔdɔawo kple hamemetsitsiwo ƒo ƒu, be yewoabu nya sia ŋu.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Esi woʋli nya la ʋuu la, Petro tso, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Nɔvinyewo, miaɖo ŋku edzi be ɣeyiɣi aɖe nye esi va yi la, Mawu tiam tso mia dome, be ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, nase Nyanyui la le nunye ne woaxɔe ase.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu, ame si nya nu si le ame ƒe dzime la, lɔ̃ ɖe ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã xɔxɔ dzi, elabe etsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la na woawo hã, abe ale si wòtsɔe na míi ene.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: Mede vovototo aɖeke míawo kpakple woawo dome o. Eklɔ woƒe dziwo me, elabe woxɔ edzi se.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ke nu ka ta miele Mawu tem kpɔ fifia? Nu ka tae miele agba si míawo kple mía tɔgbuiwo siaa míete ŋu tsɔ o la, lém ɖo ta na nusrɔ̃laawo?
