translation_verse: Ke nya ka mawunya la gblɔ? Ebe: “Abraham xɔ Mawu dzi se, eya ta Mawu bui be ele dzɔdzɔe.”

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe wɔ dɔ woxe fe nɛ la, womebua fetua abe dɔmenyo ene o, ke boŋ abe nu si nye eya ŋutɔ tɔ wotsɔ nɛ la ene.

english_verse: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame aɖe xɔ se be Mawu wɔa ame mavɔ̃mawu wòzua ame dzɔdzɔe togbɔ be ame sia mewɔ dɔ aɖeke o hã la, le eƒe xɔse ta, Mawu tsɔnɛ be enye ame dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Ale wɔ David hã gblɔ be ame si Mawu bu be ele dzɔdzɔe, evɔ menye ɖe nane si wòwɔ la ta o la, enye yayrame. Egblɔ be:

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Ame siwo nye Yudatɔwo ɖeɖe ko Mawu yra loo, alo eyra ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hãa? Míegblɔ be wobu Abraham be ele dzɔdzɔe le eƒe xɔse ta.

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Ke nɔnɔme ka mee wònɔ hafi wobui nɛ? Ɖe wotso aʋa nɛ hafi loo, alo wometsoe nɛ o? O, ɣe ma ɣi la, wometsoe nɛ haɖe o.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Emegbe hafi wova tso aʋa na Abraham, abe dzesi ene atsɔ aɖo kpe edzi, be Mawu bui be ele dzɔdzɔe le eƒe xɔse ta, togbɔ be le ɣe ma ɣi la, womekpɔ tso aʋa nɛ haɖe o hã. Ale Abraham va zu tɔ́ na ame siwo katã xɔ se. Togbɔ be wometso aʋa na wo o hã la, wobu wo be wole dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Nenema ke wòganye tɔ́ na ame siwo wotso aʋa na la hãe. Menye esi wotso aʋa na wo la ta ɖeɖe ko o, ke boŋ le esi wonɔ agbe le xɔse me, abe ale si mía tɔ́ Abraham nɔe ene, hafi wova tso aʋa nɛ la ta. Mawu do ŋugbe na Abraham

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Mawu do ŋugbe na Abraham kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo be yeatsɔ xexea me awɔ domenyinui na wo. Menye esi Abraham wɔ sea dzi tae Mawu do ŋugbe sia nɛ ɖo o, ke boŋ esi wòxɔ se, eye Mawu bui be ele dzɔdzɔe la tae.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Nenye be ame siwo wɔa sea dzi la koe axɔ nu si ŋugbe Mawu do la, ekema xɔse la zu nu dzodzro, eye ŋugbedodo la hã, woɖee ɖa.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe dzikue se la hena vanɛ. Ke afi si se mele o la, womedaa se dzi hã le afi ma o.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Le esia ta la, xɔse dzie ŋugbedodo la tsi tsitre ɖo, ale be nu si ŋugbe wodo la va zu nu si Mawu ve mía nu hetsɔ na mí, ame siwo katã nye Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwo la faa. Menye ame siwo wɔa sea dzi la ɖeɖe koe wòli na o, ke boŋ eli na ame siwo katã xɔ se la hã abe ale si Abraham xɔ se ene, elabe Abraham ye nye mí ame siwo katã xɔ se la tɔ́.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖi be: “Metsɔ wò ɖo dukɔ geɖewo tɔ́e.” Ale ŋugbedodo sia li ke le Mawu ŋkume. Mawu sia dzie Abraham xɔ se, eyae gbɔa agbe ame kukuwo, eye eyae yɔa nu siwo mele xexea me tsã o la wovana nɔa anyi.

english_verse: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mɔkpɔkpɔ aɖeke meganɔ anyi o hã la, Abraham ya ganɔ mɔ kpɔm kple xɔse kokoko, be yele dukɔ geɖewo tɔ́ zu ge, abe ale si wogblɔe na ye la ene be: “Alea gbegbee wò dzidzimeviwo le agbɔ sɔ gee nye esi!”

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: Meke ɖi le eɖokui me, le nu si ŋugbe Mawu do nɛ la ŋu, wòava zu be mexɔ Mawu dzi se o. Ke boŋ eƒe xɔse gasẽ ŋu ɖe edzi wu, eye wòtsɔ bubu na Mawu.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: Eka ɖe edzi bliboe be Mawu ate ŋu awɔ nu si ŋugbe wòdo la godoo.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Nya si wogblɔ be: “Mawu bui be ele dzɔdzɔe” la, menye Abraham ɖeɖe ko ta wogblɔe ɖo o,

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: ke boŋ míawo hã mía tae. Mí ame siwo xɔ Mawu, ame si fɔ Yesu mía Aƒetɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome dzi se la, woabu míawo hã be míele dzɔdzɔe nenema ke.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Míaƒe vodadawo tae wowui ɖo, eye Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre, ale be woabu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Mawu bu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe to xɔse me vɔ la, ŋutifafa le mía kple Mawu dome, to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: To eyama dzi la, mɔ ʋu na mí azɔ, be Mawu nave mía nu, eye míele eƒe amenuvenu la me fifia. Míele mɔ kpɔm kple dzidzɔ, be míawo hã míakpɔ gome le Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Gawu la, míekpɔa dzidzɔ ne míexaxa gɔ̃ hã, elabe míenya be xaxawo nana be míesrɔ̃a dzidodo,

english_verse: And endurance builds character, which gives us a hope
translation_verse: eye dzidodo nana be míelia ke, eye kelili nana be míesrɔ̃a ale si míakpɔ mɔe,

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: eye mɔkpɔkpɔ menana be míeɖua ŋukpe o. Elabe Mawu trɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃ la kɔ ɖe míaƒe dzime to Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe, si wona mí la dzi.

english_verse: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.
translation_verse: Elabe esime wɔna vɔ le mía ŋu keŋ la, ɣe ma ɣi me tututue Kristo ku ɖe ame mavɔ̃mawuwo ta.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Bebli hafi ame aɖe alɔ̃ be yeaku ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe aɖe ta; ɖewohĩ ame aɖe ado dzi be yeaku ɖe ame si nyoa dɔme na ame la ya ta.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ɖe ale si wòlɔ̃ mí la fia mí, le esia me be, esime míeganye nuvɔ̃wɔlawo la, Kristo ku ɖe mía ta.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Ale, esi wobu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe le Kristo ƒe ku la ta la, Mawu aɖe mí geɖe wu tso eƒe dziku me.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Elabe esime míenye Mawu ƒe futɔwo la, Via ku ɖe mía ta helé avu mí. Esi wòlé avu mí vɔ fifia la, ele mía ɖe ge geɖe wu, elabe ele agbe.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Menye ema ɖeɖe koe o, ke boŋ Mawu wɔe be míawo hã míekpɔa dzidzɔ, to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi, elabe eyae lé avu le mía kple Mawu dome. Vovototo si le Adam kple Kristo dome

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ to ame ɖeka ko dzi ge ɖe xexea me, eye ku to nuvɔ̃ dzi va. Ale ku kaka ɖe amegbetɔƒomea katã dome elabe ame sia ame wɔ nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, nuvɔ̃ nɔ xexea me hafi Mose ƒe se la va. Ke ne se meli o la, womebua naneke be enye nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Tso Adam ŋɔli ʋuu va se ɖe Mose ŋɔli la, ku nɔ ame wum. Evɔ la, ame siwo wum wònɔ la ƒe nuvɔ̃wo mele abe esi Adam wɔ la ene hafi o. Adam de sɔsɔ ge kple ame si le vava ge la.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Nenye be ame geɖewo ku le vo, si ame ɖeka aɖe da ta la, ekema eme kɔ ƒãa be Mawu ave ame geɖewo nu, eye wòatsɔ eƒe nunana la ana wo faa geɖe wu, le ale si ame ɖeka ma, si nye Yesu Kristo la, ve mía nui la ta.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Nunana si Mawu na faa la, mele abe nu si ame ɖeka ma ƒe nuvɔ̃ he vɛ la ene o. Nu vɔ̃ si ame ɖeka ma wɔ la, wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu, bu fɔ; ke nunana si Mawu na faa la wɔe be wobu ame geɖe siwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ la ya boŋ be wole dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Eme kɔ ƒãa be ame ɖeka ƒe nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ la na be ku va ɖu dzi, le ame ɖeka sia ta. Ke nunana si Mawu ve ame nu hena faa la wɔ dɔ geɖe wu sãa! Ewɔ ame siwo xɔe la be wole dzɔdzɔe, eye ŋusẽ ɖo wo ŋu be woanɔ agbe, le ame ɖeka ma, si nye Yesu Kristo la ta.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Ale, abe ale si ame ɖeka ƒe nuvɔ̃, si wòwɔ na be wobu fɔ amewo katã be wo tɔ medzɔ o ene la, nenema ke ame ɖeka aɖe ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe si wòwɔ la, na be wodo ɣé na amewo katã be wo tɔ dzɔ, eye woxɔ wo ɖe agbe.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Abe ale si ame ɖeka ƒe tomaɖomaɖo na be amewo katã zu nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ene la, nenema ke ame bubu hã ƒe toɖoɖo le nana ge be ame geɖe nazu ame dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Se la ya ɖeko wòva be nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ nagasẽ ŋu ɖe edzi; ke afi si nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ sẽ ŋu le la, Mawu gavea ame nu geɖe wu.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ale be, abe ale si nuvɔ̃ ɖu dzi kple ku ene la, nenema ke Mawu ƒe amenuvenu hã le dzi ɖumee, be ame nawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe, ale be wòava nɔ agbe mavɔ to Yesu Kristo mía Aƒetɔ la dzi.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Azɔ nya ka gblɔ ge mía la ? Ɖe míagblɔ be mínɔ nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ dzi, ale be Mawu hã nanɔ mía nu vem ɖe edzi wua?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Gbeɖe! Ale ke wɔ mí ame siwo ku na nuvɔ̃ xoxo la, míaganɔ ewɔwɔ dzi?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mienyae be mí ame siwo katã wole mawutsi na be míawɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu la, ɖe wolee na mí be míawɔ ɖeka kplii le eƒe ku me hã oa?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Eya ta esi wole mawutsi na mí ko la, míeku abe eya ene xoxo, eye woɖi mí kpakplii. Ale be, abe ale si wofɔ Kristo tso ame kukuwo dome le Tɔ́ la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me ene la, nenema ke míawo hã míanɔ agbe yeyee.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Elabe ne míewɔ ɖeka kplii le ku si wòku la me la, ekema míaganɔ ɖeka kplii godoo atsi tsitre hã tso ame kukuwo dome abe eya ke ene.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Míenya esia be woklã nɔnɔme xoxo, si nɔ mía si la, ɖe atitsoga ŋu kple Kristo, be ŋutilã sia, si lɔ̃ nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ la, natsrɔ̃ ɖa keŋ, ale be míaganye nuvɔ̃ ƒe kluviwo azɔ o.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Elabe ne ame aɖe nyaku ko la, edo le nuvɔ̃ si me.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Ke ne míeku kple Kristo la, ekema míexɔe se be míanɔ agbe hã kpakplii.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Míenya be esi wofɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome ta, magaku akpɔ o. Ku megakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Ku si wòku la, nuvɔ̃e wòkui na, zi ɖeka ko, hena ɣeyiɣiawo katã; ke agbe si wòle fifia ya nye Mawu tɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Alea ke wòle be miawo hã miabu mia ɖokui, be yewoku na nuvɔ̃, eye azɔ yewole agbe na Mawu le ɖeka si miewɔ kple Yesu Kristo ta.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Eya ta migana nuvɔ̃ naɖu dzi azɔ le miaƒe ameti si le kuku ge la me, ale be wòazi mia dzi miawɔ eƒe didiwo dzi o.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Migaɖe asi le miaƒe ŋutinu aɖeke ŋu na nuvɔ̃, ne wòatsɔe ayi nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖeke wɔ gee o. Le esia teƒe la, mitsɔ mia ɖokui kè Mawu faa boŋ, abe ame siwo woɖe tso ku me va agbe me la ene. Miɖe asi le miaƒe ŋutinuwo ŋu na Mawu, be woanye ŋudɔwɔnu siwo wòatsɔ awɔ nu dzɔdzɔe lae.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Mele be nuvɔ̃ nagaɖu mia dzi azɔ o, elabe miegale se te o, ke boŋ Mawu ƒe amenuvenu tee miele. Míenye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe kluviwo

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Nya ka wònye gblɔm míele? Ɖe míagblɔ be míate ŋu aganɔ nuvɔ̃ wɔm faa, elabe míegale se te o, eye Mawu le mía nu vem taa? Gbeɖe!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Mienya nyuie be, ne mietsɔ mia ɖokui wɔ subɔlawoe na ame aɖe, be yewoaɖo toe la, miezu ame si ƒe gbe dzi wɔm miele la ƒe kluviwo. Nenye nuvɔ̃ ƒe gbe dzie miewɔ la, yomedzenu lae nye ku; nenye Mawu ƒe gbe dzie miewɔ la, yomedzenu lae nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Akpe na Mawu kakaka! Elabe mi ame siwo nye nuvɔ̃ ƒe kluviwo tsã la, mieva xɔ nufiafia sia kple dzi blibo hele edzi wɔm pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Ale be miedo le nuvɔ̃ si me, eye mieva zu Mawu ƒe kluviwo, be miawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Mele nu ƒom ko, abe amegbetɔ ene, le ale si amegbetɔ gbɔdzɔnae ta, be miate ŋu ase eme. Nu si mewɔnɛ lae nye be, tsã la, mieɖe asi le miaƒe ŋutinuwo ŋu, eye wozu kluviwo nɔ nu makɔmakɔ kple nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi wɔm. Nenema ke migaɖe asi le miaƒe ŋutinuwo ŋu fifia hã, be woanye kluvi siwo awɔ nu dzɔdzɔe, esi fia be woawɔ nu si le kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Esi mienye nuvɔ̃ ƒe kluviwo la, menye dzizizi be miawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe o.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Viɖe ka miekpɔ tso nuwɔna mawo, siwo va le ŋu kpem na mi fifia la me? Ku koe nuwɔna mawo hena vɛ mlɔeba.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Ke fifia la, woɖe mi tso nuvɔ̃ si me, eye mieva zu Mawu ƒe kluviwo. Viɖe, si miekpɔ lae nye be mietsɔ miaƒe agbe nae blibo, be woawɔe kɔkɔe, eye le nuwuwu la, miakpɔ agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Kue nye nu si nuvɔ̃ tsɔna xea fee, ke nunana si Mawu na faa lae nye agbe mavɔ, esi ame siwo le hadede me kple Kristo Yesu mía Aƒetɔ la, xɔna.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mi ame siwo nya Mose ƒe se la la, miase nya sia me nam. Miawo ŋutɔ mienyae, be se la bla ame, zi ale si wòle agbe la ko.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Le kpɔɖeŋu me, se bla nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ ɖe srɔ̃a ŋu, nenye be ŋutsua nyale agbe ko. Ke ne ŋutsua ku la, ekema nyɔnu la vo tso se ma, si blae ɖe ŋutsua ŋu la si me.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Ale ne ede ŋutsu bubu gbɔ, esime srɔ̃a le agbe la, ekema ezu ahasitɔ. Ke ne srɔ̃a ku la, se sia megablae o, eye ne eɖe ŋutsu bubu la, mewɔ ahasi o.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, alea wòle kple miawo hã. Le se la gome la, mieku, elabe mienye Kristo ƒe ŋutinu aɖe, eye fifia la, miezu eya, ame si wofɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la tɔ, bene míawɔ dɔ nyui, si aɖe vi na Mawu.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Elabe esime míenɔ agbe ɖe dzɔdzɔme nu la, didi vɔ̃, siwo se la nyɔna le míaƒe ŋutilã me la wua mí.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, míedo tso se la si me, elabe míeku na se si de ga mí goŋ tsã la. Ale míaƒe subɔsubɔ meganye tsãtɔ, si ku ɖe se, si woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me la tɔgbe ŋu o, ke boŋ ezu agbenɔnɔ yeye, si Gbɔgbɔ la nana míenɔna la. Se la nana be ame wɔa nuvɔ̃

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Nya ka míagblɔ azɔ? Ɖe míagblɔ be se la nye nuvɔ̃a? Mele nenema kura o! Ke ne se la ɖe meli o la, anye ne nyemedze si nu si nye nuvɔ̃ o. Ne se la ɖe megblɔ be: “Mègabiã ŋu o” la, anye ne nyemenya ale si wobiãa ŋui o.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: To se la dzi la, nuvɔ̃ kpɔ mɔnu nyɔ ŋubiabiã ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi le menye. Ne se la ɖe meli o la, anye ne ŋusẽ aɖeke manɔ nuvɔ̃ si o.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ menɔ agbe se la manyamanyae kpɔ. Ke tso esime meva nya be se la li ko la, nuvɔ̃ nyɔ hefɔ ɖe tsitre zi ɖeka,

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: eye meku. Ale se si wona be wòahe agbe vɛ nam la, zu ku boŋ nam.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Ale nuvɔ̃ kpɔ mɔnu to se la dzi blem, hewum.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Nu kɔkɔe se la ŋutɔ nye hafi. Nenema ke ɖoɖoawo hã le kɔkɔe, dzɔdzɔe eye wonyo.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Ekema nu nyui siae zu ku nama? Ao, menye nenema o. Ke boŋ nuvɔ̃e wɔ nu nyui la ŋudɔ tsɔ he ku vɛ nam. Ale si nuvɔ̃ nye nuvɔ̃ɖi la dze ƒã le esia me be etoa se la ŋutɔ me gavɔ̃ɖina ɖe edzi wu gɔ̃. Aʋawɔwɔ si le edzi yim le ame me

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Míenya be sea la, gbɔgbɔmenu wònye; nye la, menye amegbetɔ si wodzra na nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ nyemesea nye nuwɔna gɔme o. Nu si medi be mawɔ la, menye eyae mewɔna o, ke nu si melé fui la boŋ mewɔna.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Azɔ nenye be nu si nyemedi be mawɔ o lae mewɔna la, ekema melɔ̃ ɖe edzi be se la tɔ dzɔ.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ale nu si wɔm mele la, meganye nye ŋutɔe le ewɔm o, ke boŋ nuvɔ̃ si le menye lae.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Menya be nu nyui aɖeke mele nye ŋutɔ menye o, le ale si medzɔ abe amegbetɔ ene la ta. Togbɔ be medina vevie be mawɔ nu nyui hã la, nyemete ŋu wɔnɛ o.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Nu nyui si medina be mawɔ la, nyemewɔa eya o, ke boŋ nuvɔ̃ɖi, si nyemedina be mawɔ o lae mewɔna.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ne nu si nyemedina be mawɔ o lae mewɔna la, ekema meganye nye ŋutɔe nye ma le nua wɔm o, ke boŋ nuvɔ̃ si le menye lae.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Ale meke ɖe se sia ŋu le ɖokuinye me be, ne medi be mawɔ nyui la, vɔ̃ boŋ koe mewɔna.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Mekpɔa dzidzɔ le Mawu ƒe se la ŋuti le ɖokuinye me ke.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Ke mekpɔ be se bubu sãa ye le dɔ wɔm le nye ŋutinuwo me, eye eya tsi tre ɖe esi dzi meda asi ɖo le nye susu me la ŋu. Se sia tsɔm de ga me na nuvɔ̃ ƒe se, si le dɔ wɔm le nye ŋutinuwo me la.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Ao, nye nublanuitɔ! Ame kae aɖem tso ŋutilã sia, si hem ɖo ta ku gbɔe la si me?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Akpe na Mawu kakaka to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi! Azɔ la, ale si mele lae nye esi: mewɔa Mawu ƒe se la dzi le ɖokuinye si le dzime, ke mele nuvɔ̃ ƒe se te le nye ŋutilã me.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ame aɖeke mate ŋu abu fɔ ame siwo le hadede me kple Kristo Yesu la o.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Elabe Gbɔgbɔ ƒe se, si naa agbe le Kristo Yesu me la, ɖem tso nuvɔ̃ kple ku ƒe se la si me.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Nu si se la mete ŋu wɔ o, elabe ŋutilã la xɔ ŋusẽ le esi la, eyae Mawu wɔ azɔ. Edɔ Via ɖa le amegbetɔ ƒe ŋutilã, si wɔa nuvɔ̃ la me, ɖe nuvɔ̃ ta, eye wòva bu fɔ nuvɔ̃ heɖee ɖa.

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: Mawu wɔ esia ale be mí ame siwo zɔna le Gbɔgbɔ nu, ke menye le ŋutilã nu o la, míade blibo le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ si se la di tso mía si be míawɔ la me.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Elabe ame siwo nɔa agbe abe ale si woƒe ŋutilã dii ene la, nu siwo ŋutilã hiã la, ŋu ko wobuna. Ke ame siwo nɔa agbe abe ale si Gbɔgbɔ la dii ene la, nu siwo Gbɔgbɔ la hiã la, ŋu ko wobuna.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Ame si bua nu siwo eƒe ŋutilã di la ɖeɖe ko ŋu la, aku; ke ame si bua nu siwo Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la di la ɖeɖe ko ŋu la, eyae anɔ agbe ahakpɔ ŋutifafa.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Ke ne Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la xɔ anyinɔ ɖe mia me keŋ la, miegale agbe ɖe nu si ŋutilã di la nu o, ke boŋ nu si Gbɔgbɔ la di la nue miele agbe le. Ame si me Kristo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ mele o la, menye Kristo tɔ o.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ke ne Kristo le mia me la, ekema togbɔ be miaƒe ŋutilã aku le nuvɔ̃ ta hã la, miaƒe gbɔgbɔ ya anɔ agbe, esi wobu mi be miele dzɔdzɔe xoxo ta.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ne mienɔ agbe ɖe nu siwo ŋutilã di nu la, miaku. Ke ne mietsɔ Gbɔgbɔ la wu dɔwɔna, siwo ŋutilã wɔna la, mianɔ agbe.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la kplɔna la, Mawu viwo wonye.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Menye gbɔgbɔ, si nɔa kluviwo me la wotsɔ na mi, bene mianɔ vɔvɔ̃m o; ke boŋ Gbɔgbɔ si nɔa viwo mee miexɔ. Esia ta ne míedo ɣli be: “Aba, Tɔ́!” la,

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ŋutɔe wɔ ɖeka kple míaƒe gbɔgbɔ heɖia ɖase na mí be Mawu viwo míenye.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Ke nenye be Mawu viwo míenye la, ekema Mawu ƒe domenyilawo hã míenye, eye míanyi dome kple Kristo. Ale si míekpe fui abe Kristo ene la, nenema kee woado míawo hã ɖe dzi abe eya ene. Ŋutikɔkɔe si le vava ge la

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Le nye nukpɔkpɔ nu la, ne wotsɔ fu siwo kpem míele fifia la sɔ ɖe ŋutikɔkɔe si ɖe ge woala afia mí ŋu la, fukpekpeawo meɖi naneke kura o.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã le lalam hetsi dzi vevie be Mawu naɖe viawo ɖe go afia.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Elabe wobu fɔ Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo be wonye nu maɖinuwo, ke menye le wo ɖokui si o; Mawu ŋutɔe ɖoe be wòanɔ nenema. Ke hã la, mɔkpɔkpɔ sia li,

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Elabe míenya be va se ɖe fifi la, Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo katã le veve sem hele ŋeŋem, abe nyɔnu funɔ si fú le ɖuɖum la ene.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Ke menye Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔwo ɖeɖe ko hãe o, ke boŋ mí ame siwo do ŋgɔ ɖɔ Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe nunanawo kpɔ la hãe. Míele ŋeŋem le mía ɖokui me, hele lalam be woaɖe míaƒe ŋutilã be míazu viwo.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Mɔkpɔkpɔ siae na Mawu xɔ mí ɖe agbe. Nu si kpɔm ame aɖe le xoxo la, megakpɔa mɔ nɛ o. Ame ka gakpɔa mɔ na nu si kpɔm wòle la?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Ke ne míele mɔ kpɔm na nu si míekpɔna o la, ekema míedo dzi le elalam.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Alea tututue Gbɔgbɔ la kpena ɖe mí ame siwo gbɔdzɔ la hã ŋui, elabe míenya ale si míado gbe ɖa wòadze Mawu ŋu o. Ke Gbɔgbɔ la ŋutɔe xɔa nya ɖe mía nu le Mawu gbɔ kple ŋeŋe manyagblɔ.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si dzroa amewo katã ƒe dzime kpɔna la, nya Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe didi, elabe Gbɔgbɔ lae xɔa nya ɖe ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la nu, abe ale si Mawu ŋutɔ ɖoe la ene.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Míenyae be Mawu wɔa nuwo katã wova zua nyui na ame siwo lɔ̃e la. Ame siawoe eya ŋutɔ yɔ, abe ale si wòɖoe da ɖi la ene.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Mawu tia ame siwo wònya xoxo la ɖi be woava zu abe ye Vi la ene, ale be ye Vi nava nye ŋgɔgbevi le nɔvi geɖewo dome.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Azɔ nu ka fiam nya siawo katã le? Ne Mawu le mía dzi la, ame ka atsi tre ɖe mía ŋuti?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Mawu ma, si megbe Via tsɔtsɔ na mí o, ke boŋ wòtsɔe na faa ɖe mí katã mía ta la, ɖe matsɔ nu bubuwo katã hã akpe ɖe eŋuti na mí oa?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Ame ka ate ŋu atsɔ nya ɖe Mawu ƒe ame tiatiawo ŋu? Mawu ŋutɔe bua ame be ele dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Ɖe ame aɖe ate ŋu abu fɔ mía? Kristoe nye ame si ku; ke, gawu la, eyae nye ame si wofɔ ɖe tsitre hã, ame si le Mawu ƒe ɖusime, eye wòxɔa nya ɖe mía nu.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Ame ka alo nu ka gɔ̃ ate ŋu ama mí ɖa tso Kristo ƒe lɔlɔ̃ na mí gbɔ? Fukpekpe, alo xaxa, alo yometiti, alo dɔwuame, alo amamanɔnɔ, alo ŋɔdzinu aɖe, alo amewuwu kple lãnu loo?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Woŋlɔe ɖe mawunya la me be: “Wole mía wuwu dzi ɖe tawò ŋkeke blibo la; Wobu mí ko abe alẽ, siwo wu ge woyina la ene.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Ke le nu siawo katã me la, míeɖu dzi wu ale si míebui gɔ̃ hã, elabe Kristo lɔ̃ mí.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Elabe meka ɖe edzi bliboe be naneke meli, si ama mí ɖa tso eƒe lɔlɔ̃ gbɔ o: kue loo, alo agbe yea? Mawudɔlawoe loo, alo gbɔgbɔmeŋusẽwo yea? Nu siwo li fifiae loo, alo nu siwo gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge la yea?

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Nu si megblɔ la nye nyateƒe; nyemeka aʋatso o, elabe Kristo tɔ menye. Nye dzitsinya, si dzi Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ɖu la, hã gblɔna nam kple kakaɖedzi be nyemele aʋatso kam o.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Edzrom gɔ̃ hã be le woawo ta la, Mawu naƒo fi adem faa, ahanyàm ɖa tso Kristo ŋuti hafi.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Elabe woawoe nye Israel-dukɔ, si Mawu tia, eye woawoe trɔ zu viawo. Eɖe eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe fia wo, woawoe wòbla nu kplii. Woawoe Mawu tsɔ eƒe se la na hefia ale si woasubɔe la ƒe mɔnu wo. Woawoe wòdo ŋugbeawo hã na.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Wodzɔ tso tɔgbuitɔgbui xɔŋkɔawo me, eye woawo mee Kristo dzɔ tso abe amegbetɔ ene. Woakafu Mawu, si ɖu nu sia nu dzi yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nya la mezu dzodzro hafi o, elabe menye ame siwo katã dzɔ tso Israel-ƒomea me lae nye Israel vi akuakuawo o.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Egɔmee nye be menye vi siwo Abraham dzi abe amegbetɔ ene la woe nye Mawu viwo o, ke boŋ esiwo ŋugbe Mawu do nɛ hafi wòdzi wo lae nye eƒe dzidzimeviwo.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Nya si Mawu gblɔ tsɔ do ŋugbea nɛ lae nye be: “Ƒe si gbɔna ƒe ɣe alewo ɣi la magatrɔ ava, eye Sara adzi ŋutsuvi.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Nenema ke le Rebeka gome hã la, viŋutsuvi eve siwo wòdzi la, mía tɔgbui Isak kee nye wo tɔ́.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖi be: “Melɔ̃ Yakob ƒe nya, ke melé fu Esau ya.”

english_verse: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Nu ka míagblɔ tso esia ŋuti? Be Mawu hã wɔa nu madzɔmadzɔ loo? Gbeɖe!

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Elabe egblɔ na Mose be: “Ame sinu medi be mave la, eya nue mave, eye ame si medi be makpɔ nublanui na la, eyae makpɔ nublanui na.”

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Ale be menye ame aɖe ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu alo eƒe agbagbadzedze ŋu tiatia la ku ɖo o, ke boŋ ale si Mawu vea ame nui ŋu wòku ɖo.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ na Farao le mawunya me be: “Nu si ta metsɔ wò ɖo fia lae nye be mato dziwò aɖe nye ŋusẽ ɖe go afia, ale be nye ŋkɔ nade du le xexea me katã.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Ale ame si Mawu di be yeakpɔ nublanui na la, eyae wòkpɔnɛ na, eye ame si wòdi be yeana wòasẽ to la, eyae wònana wòsẽa to. Mawu doa dɔmedzoe gahekpɔa nublanui na ame hã

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Ame aɖe abiam be: “Ne ele nenema la, ekema nu ka ta Mawu gabua fɔ ame ɖo? Ame ka ate ŋu atsi tre ɖe eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu ŋuti?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Wò amegbetɔ, ame ka nènye aƒo nu do ɖe Mawu gbɔ nenema? Ɖe nu si ame aɖe tsɔ anyi me la, ate ŋu abia emela la be: “Nu ka ta nèmem alea ɖo?” mahã?

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Nenye be Mawu le eƒe dziku kple ŋusẽ ɖe ge afia ame siwo ŋu wòdo dziku ɖo, siwo latsrɔ̃ godoo, evɔ wògahegbɔ dzi blewuu, helé wo ɖe te ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe la, nya kae le asiwò?

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Alo ne Mawu di be yeaɖe kesinɔnu, siwo le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me la ɖe go afia mí ame siwo wòkpɔ nublanui na, ame siwo eya ŋutɔ yɔ tso Yudatɔwo kple ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la dome,

english_verse: Whether Jews or Gentiles, we are those chosen ones,
translation_verse: eye wòdzra mí ɖo ɖi, be míava xɔ ŋutikɔkɔe sia la, nya aɖe le ame aɖe si wòagblɔa?

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Egblɔ le Hosea ƒe agbalẽ me kɔtɛe be: “Dukɔ si menye nye dukɔ o lae mayɔ be ‘Nye dukɔ.’ Ame siwo nyemelɔ̃ o lae mayɔ be ‘Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo.’

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: Afi si wogblɔ na wo le be: ‘Mienye nye dukɔ o’ la, afi ma tututue woayɔ wo le be: ‘Mawu gbagbe la viwo.’ ”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Israel ŋutie Yesaya do ɣli le gblɔ be: “Togbɔ be Israelviwo sɔ gbɔ abe ƒutake ene hã la, wo dome ame ʋɛ aɖewo koe lakpɔ xɔxɔ,

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: elabe Aƒetɔ la adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame siwo katã le anyigba dzi la pɛpɛpɛ kple alɔ tsɔtsɔe, eye nya sia nya awu enu zi ɖeka.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Yesaya gagblɔ nya ɖi be: “Ɖe menye Aƒetɔ Ŋusẽkatãtɔ lae gblẽ dzidzimevi aɖewo ɖi na mí o la, anye ne míetrɔ zu abe Sodom ene, eye miasɔ kple Gomora.” Nyanyui la nye Israelviwo hã tɔ

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Nu ka koŋ wònye gblɔm mele? Mebe ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, eye womele ʋiʋlim be yewoawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe o la, va zu ame dzɔdzɔewo, le xɔse si le wo si la ta.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Nu ka tae wòle nenema? Elabe wometsɔ xɔse di nu si wodi lae o, ke boŋ woɖo ŋu ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbagbadzedze ŋu. Ale wokli kpe, si ame klina la,

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖi ene be: “Kpɔ ɖa, mele kpe, si ame akli adze anyi la, ɖom anyi ɖe Zion; amewo akli kpe sia adze anyi. Ke ame siwo ado dzi ɖe eyama ŋu la, womaɖu ŋukpe o.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nu si dim mele vevie tso nye dzime ke, eye mele kuku ɖem na Mawu tso eŋu lae nye be wòaxɔ Israel hã.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Womenya mɔ si dzi Mawu tona bua ame be ele dzɔdzɔe o, eya ta mɔ si dzi woawo ŋutɔ ato adze Mawu ŋu ko dim wole, elabe womenya ale si woawɔ atsɔ wo ɖokui ana Mawu, ale be wòabu wo be wole dzɔdzɔe o.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Elabe Kristo ye va xɔ ŋusẽ le se la si, bene ame sia ame si xɔ se ko la, woabui ame dzɔdzɔe. Mawu xɔa ame sia ame ɖe agbe

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Mose ŋlɔ da ɖi be ame si dzea agbagba be yeanɔ agbe ɖe sea nu pɛpɛpɛ, anɔ dzɔdzɔe la, atsi agbe.

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Ke nu si wogblɔ tso nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ si ku ɖe xɔse ŋu lae nye be: “Mègagblɔ na ɖokuiwò be: ‘Ame ka alia ayi dziƒo?’ o.

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Nya ka boŋ gblɔm wòle? Ebe: “Mawu ƒe nya la te ɖe ŋuwò kpuie, ele wò nu me kple wò dzime.” Eyae nye xɔsenya, si míele gbeƒã ɖemee la.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Ne èke nu ʋu eme gblɔ be Yesue nye Aƒetɔ la, eye nèxɔe se le wò dzime, be Mawu fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la, woaxɔ wò ɖe agbe.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Elabe dzie ame tsɔna xɔna senae, eye wobunɛ be ele dzɔdzɔe, eye nue wòtsɔna ʋua emee eye woxɔnɛ ɖe agbe.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be: “Ame sia ame si xɔ edzi se la, maɖu ŋukpe akpɔ o.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Vovototo aɖeke mele Yudatɔ kple ame si menye Yudatɔ o la dome le go sia me o, elabe ame ɖeka ma ke koe nye wo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ, eye wònyoa dɔme faa na ame siwo katã yɔnɛ la.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Mawunya gagblɔ be: “Ame sia ame si ayɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ la, woaxɔe ɖe agbe.”

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Ke ale ke amewo lawɔ ayɔ ame si dzi womexɔ se o la? Ale ke amewo lawɔ axɔ ame si ŋkɔ womese kpɔ o la dzi ase? Ale ke woawɔ ase eŋkɔ, ne womeɖe gbeƒãe na wo o?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Ale ke woaɖe gbeƒã lae, ne womedɔ gbeƒãɖelawo ɖo ɖa o? Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Ale gbegbe ame siwo tsɔ Nyanyui la vɛ la ƒe afɔwo nyakpɔ loo!”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Ke menye amewo katãe xɔ Nyanyui la o, elabe Yesaya ŋlɔe ɖi be: “Aƒetɔ, ame kae xɔ nya si míeɖe gbeƒãe la dzi se?”

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Ke mabia be: Ɖe ameawo mese nya la oa? Wosee baa. Elabe mawunya gblɔe be: “Gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe gbe ɖi kpe xexea me katã ɖo, eye nya si woɖe gbeƒãe la de afi sia afi, si amegbetɔ nɔna la.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Magabia ase be: “Ekema ɖe Israel-dukɔ la mese gbeƒã si woɖe la gɔme oa?” Gbã la, Mose gblɔ be: “Mana miaʋã ŋu dukɔ, si menye dukɔ hafi o la, eye mana miakpɔ dziku ɖe dukɔ, si wɔa movinu la ŋu.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Yesaya ya do dzi gblɔ gɔ̃ be Mawu gblɔ be: “Ame siwo medim o la, woawoe va kpɔm. Ame siwo mebia tanye se o la, woawoe meɖe ɖokuinye fia.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Egagblɔ hã le Israel ŋu be: “Meke nye abɔwo me do ɖe dukɔ si meɖɔa to o, eye wòɖea ɖeklemee la gbɔ.

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ke mabia be: “Ekema Mawu ɖe wòɖe asi le eƒe dukɔ ŋu keŋkeŋ loo?” Gbeɖe! Nye ŋutɔŋutɔ hã Israeltɔ menye, henye Abraham ƒe dzidzimevi, eye metso Benyamin-to la me.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Mawu meɖe asi le eƒe dukɔ, si eya ŋutɔ tia da ɖi la ŋu kura o. Alo ɖe mienya nya, si woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me le Eliya ŋuti, le ale si wòʋli nya kple Mawu le Israel ta la oa?

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: Ebe: “Aƒetɔ, wowu wò gbeƒãɖelawo, eye wogbã wò vɔsamlekpuiwo gúdugudu. Nye ɖeka koe susɔ ɖi, eye wodi be yewoawu nye hã.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Nu ka! Israel-dukɔ ƒe asi mete ŋu su nu si dim wònɔ la dzi o. Ame ʋɛ siwo Mawu tia la koe kpɔe, ke ena ame mamlɛawo sẽ to goŋgoŋ.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Ale, le fifi ɣeyiɣiwo me hã la, egasusɔ ame ʋɛ aɖewo, siwo nu wove hetia da ɖi la.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖe wòve wo nu hetia wo, ke menye le woawo ŋutɔ ƒe agbagbadzedze aɖeke ta o. Nenye be nu si wowɔ dzie Mawu kpɔ hafi tia wo la, anye ne ale si wòve wo nui la, meganye amenuvevee wònye o.

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: David hã gblɔe be: “Na woƒe nuɖukplɔ̃ gã, siwo woɖona la, natrɔ zu gamɔ̀ aɖe wo kple nu si woakli adze anyi, eye woahe to na wo!

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Nà woƒe ŋku dzi natsyɔ kplo, ale be womagate ŋu akpɔ nu o; eye nàna woƒe fukpekpe nawɔ wo woaxa gobaa tegbee.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Ale mele biabiam be: Ekema esime Israel kli nu dze anyi la, ɖe wòtsrɔ̃ gbidiia? Gbeɖe! Esi wowɔ nuvɔ̃ ta la, Mawu xɔ ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, bene Israeltɔwo naʋã ŋu dukɔ siawo.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Fifia la, mi ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o lae mele nya sia gblɔm na. Esi wònye ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la ƒe amedɔdɔe menye la, mele dàdam ɖe nye subɔsubɔdɔ la dzi.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ to esia wɔwɔ me la, mana nye ŋutɔ mía de Yudatɔwo naʋã ŋu, ale be Mawu naxɔ wo dometɔ aɖewo ɖe agbe mahĩ.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Elabe esi Mawu ɖe asi le wo ŋu la, ŋutifafa va eya kple xexea me dome. Ke ne Mawu gbugbɔ wo gaxɔ ɖe, ale ke wòahanɔ? Ɖeko wòanɔ abe fɔfɔ tso ku me gɔ̃ ene!

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Ne nuku gbãtɔ le kɔkɔe la, ekema nuŋeŋe la katã hã le kɔkɔe. Nenema ke ne ati la ƒe ke le kɔkɔe la, ekema eƒe alɔdzeawo hã le kɔkɔe.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Wolã ati, si wodo la ƒe alɔdze aɖewo ɖa, eye wotsɔ mi, ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, siwo le abe ati, si wɔ le gbe me le eɖokui si ene la ƒe alɔwo do ɖe eŋu. Ale miawo hã mieva le gome kpɔm le nuɖuɖu si tso ati la ƒe ke me la me.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Migabu be yewo tɔ nyo wu ame siwo le abe atilɔ, siwo wolã ɖa ene la, tɔ o. Ne èdi be yeada la, ekema ɖo ŋku edzi be menye yee nye ke, si lé ati la ɖe te o, ke boŋ alɔdze, si ke la lé ɖe te la, ko yenye.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ àgblɔ be: “Ɖe wolã atilɔawo ɖa be woatsɔm ado ɖe wo teƒe.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Ele eme baa. Wolã wo ɖa, elabe womexɔ se o. Le gowòme la, wò xɔse tae nèle te ɖo, eya ta mele be nàdo ɖokuiwò ɖe dzi o, ke boŋ ɖe wòle be nànɔ vɔvɔ̃m.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Elabe ne Mawu mekpɔ nublanui na Yudatɔ, siwo le abe atilɔ, siwo dzɔ kple atia la ene o la, ekema makpɔ nublanui na wò hã o.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ale si Mawu nyo dɔme kple ale si eƒe asi sẽna ɖe ame dzii la ɖa! Eƒe asi sẽna ɖe ame siwo dze anyi la dzi, ke enyo dɔme na wò ya, zi ale si wò nuwɔna wɔnɛ be wòaganɔ dɔmenyo wɔm na wò kokoko. Ne manye nenema o la, woalã wò hã ɖa.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Israelviwo kura gɔ̃ hã la, ne wotrɔ va xɔ Mawu dzi se ko la, woagagbugbɔ wo ada ɖe wo nɔƒe, elabe ŋusẽ le Mawu si be woagagbugbɔ wo ada ɖe wo nɔƒe.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, ɖe miele abe ati, si wɔ le eɖokui si le gbe me, eye wolã eƒe alɔwo va do ɖe ati, si wodo la ŋu la ene. Israel-dukɔ le abe ati, si wodo la ene. Ale be ele bɔbɔe na Mawu be wòagatsɔ ati dodo sia ƒe alɔ lalãawo agbugbɔ ado ɖe eŋuti wòanyo. Mawu kpɔa nublanui na ame sia ame

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, medi be magblɔ nya ɣaɣla aɖe na mi mianya, ale be miaganɔ bubum be yewonya nu ŋutɔ o. Esiae nye be: Israel-dukɔ ƒe akpa aɖe sẽ to, va se ɖe esime ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, siwo ƒe xexlẽme de pɛpɛpɛ la nava Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Ne esia va eme vɔ la, ekema woaxɔ Israel-dukɔ blibo la hã ɖe agbe. Elabe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Ɖela la atso Zion ava, eye wòaɖe mawumavɔmavɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ɖa le Yakob ƒe ƒome la me.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Esia anye nu, si mabla kpli wo, ne metsɔ woƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke wo.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Le Nyanyui la gome la, wozu Mawu ƒe futɔwo le mia ta. Ke le ale si wotia wo ɖi gome ya la, wonye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo le wo tɔgbuiawo ta.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nunanawo kple ale si wòyɔa amee la, nɔa anyi ɖaa; wometrɔna o.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Tsã la, mieɖo to Mawu o, ke azɔ la, Mawu ve mia nu, elabe Yudatɔwo meɖo to o.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Esi amewo katã gbe be yewomaɖo to Mawu o ta la, Mawu wɔ wo wozu abe gamenɔlawo ene, ale be wòate ŋu ave ame sia ame nu. Edze be woakafu Mawu

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe kesinɔnuwo sɔ gbɔ loo! Eƒe nunya kple sidzedze me goglo loo! Ɖe ame aɖe ate ŋu akpɔ nya aɖe agblɔ, ne Mawu tso nya mea? Ame aɖeke mate ŋu ase eƒe mɔwo gɔme akpɔ o!

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Ame kae se Aƒetɔ la ƒe susuwo gɔme? Ame kae ate ŋu aɖo aɖaŋu nɛ?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Ame kae na nui kpɔ, be wòava ɖo eteƒe na ye?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Eyae wɔ nu sia nu, eyae lé nuwo katã ɖe te, eye eya me ke nu sia nu wua nu le hã. Mawu tɔe nye bubu yi ɖe mavɔ me. Amen.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, esi Mawu le nublanui kpɔm na mí nukutɔe ta la, mele kuku ɖem na mi vevie, be miatsɔ mia ɖokui ana Mawu, abe vɔsalã gbagbe, si ŋuti kɔ keŋkeŋ, eye wòdze Mawu ŋu la ene. Esiae nye ale si miasubɔ Mawu nyateƒetɔe le mia ɖokui me.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Miganɔ agbe abe ale si xexe sia me tɔwo nɔnɛ la ene o. Ke boŋ mina Mawu natrɔ miaƒe susuwo be woazu yeye, ale be miaƒe nɔnɔme natrɔ keŋkeŋ. To esia me la, miate ŋu adze si Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu kple nu si nyo, eye wòdzea eŋu hede blibo la.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Le ale si wove nunye nui la, mele egblɔm na mi katã be mia dome ame aɖeke negabu eɖokui gãe wu ale si dze la o. Le esia teƒe la, mibu nu siwo fia ɖokuibɔbɔ la ŋu, eye ame sia ame natso nya me na eɖokui le xɔse si Mawu nae la nu.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Ŋutinuwo sɔ gbɔ le míaƒe ameti sia ŋu, evɔ la, wo katã mewɔa dɔ ɖeka ma ke le eŋu o.

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: Nenema ke togbɔ be míenye ame vovovowo hã la, ameti ɖeka ko míenye hele hadede me kple Kristo, eye mía dome ame sia ame le abe ŋutinu aɖe ene, le ameti ɖeka la ŋu.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Nunana vovovo siwo Mawu ve mía nu na mí la, to vovo, eya ta mina míawɔ wo ŋudɔ. Ne Mawu na ŋutete mí be míaɖe gbeƒã eƒe gbedeasi la, mina míaɖe gbeƒãe le xɔse, si le mía si la nu.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Ne Mawu na ŋutete mí be míasubɔ amewo la, ele be míasubɔ wo ale si dze. Nenye nufiafiae la, ele be míafiae.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Nenye dzidede ƒo na amee la, ele be míawɔ eya hã. Ame si naa nu ame la, nekɔ dɔme nae faa. Ame si le ame nu la, newɔ eƒe wɔƒe kple vevidodo. Nenema ke ame si kpɔa nublanui na ame hã, nekpɔe kple mokɔkɔ.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Milɔ̃ mia nɔewo nyateƒetɔe. Mitsri nuvɔ̃, eye milé nu si nyo la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Milɔ̃ mia nɔewo, abe ale si dadaviwo lɔ̃a wo nɔewo ene. Ame sia ame nedi vevie be yeatsɔ bubu na ye nɔvi gbã.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ dzo ɖe dɔ ŋu wɔ; migawɔ kuvia o. Misubɔ Aƒetɔ la kple dzo le miaƒe dzime.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Esi miele mɔ kpɔm na nane ta la, dzi nedzɔ mi. Ne miele fu kpem la, mido dzi. Minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɖaa.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Mikpe ɖe hametɔ siwo hiã tu la ŋu, eye milé fɔ ɖe amedzroxɔxɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Mibia Mawu be wòayra ame siwo tia mia yome. Neyra wo; megaƒo fi de wo o.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ dzidzɔ kple ame siwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm, eye mifa avi kple ame siwo le avi fam.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Gbe nedze gbe dzi na mi. Migada o, ke boŋ mide ha kple ame siwo amewo mebuna ɖe naneke me o la. Migatsɔ mia ɖokui be yewonya nu ŋutɔ o.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe wɔ vɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò la, mègaɖo eteƒe nɛ o. Mibu tame le nu si nyo hedze bubu le amewo katã ŋkume la ŋu, ne miawɔ eya ko.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Ne anyawɔ, eye wòaku ɖe miawo boŋ ŋu la, ekema minɔ kple amewo katã le tomefafa me.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, migabia hlɔ̃ na mia ɖokui gbeɖe o; ke boŋ mina Mawu ŋutɔ nabiae. Elabe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be: “Nyee abia hlɔ̃a; nyee le eteƒe ɖo ge.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Le esia teƒe la, mawunya gblɔ be: “Eya ta ne dɔ le wò futɔ wum la, na nui wòaɖu, ne tsikɔ le ewum la, na tsii wòano, elabe ne èwɔ esia la, àna ŋu nakpee ŋutɔŋutɔ.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Mègana nuvɔ̃ɖi la naɖu dziwò o, ke tsɔ nu nyui la ɖu nuvɔ̃ɖi la dzi boŋ.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Ele be ame sia ame naɖo to dziɖulawo, elabe dziɖuɖu aɖeke meli, si menye Mawue ɖoe anyi o. Dziɖuɖu siwo li la, Mawu ŋutɔe ɖo wo anyi.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wɔa nu nyui la, mevɔ̃a dziɖulawo o; nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawoe vɔ̃a wo. Èdi be ame si le dzi ɖum la, megado ŋɔdzi na ye oa? Ekema wɔ nu nyui, ne wòakafu wò.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Dziɖula nye Mawu ƒe dɔla hena wò nyui, ke ne èwɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi la, vɔ̃ eyama, elabe wona ŋusẽe be wòawɔ eŋudɔ ale si dze. Mawu ƒe dɔtsɔla wònye be wòahe to na nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo, atsɔ aɖe Mawu ƒe dziku afia.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Le esia ta la, ehiã be ame nabɔbɔ eɖokui na dziɖuɖu, menye esi Mawu magado dziku ɖe eŋu ta ɖeɖe ko o, ke boŋ esi amea ƒe dzitsinya na wònya nu si dze be wòawɔ la hã ta.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Susu sia ta ke hãe miedzɔa duga ɖo, elabe dziɖulawo nye Mawu ƒe subɔla, siwo kpɔa nya siawo gbɔ.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Migana ame aɖeke ƒe nu nanye fe atsi mia ŋu o. Lɔlɔ̃ dzaa ko nanye fe si anɔ mia dome. Ame si lɔ̃ ehavi la, ewɔ se blibo la katã dzi.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Se siwo Mawu de be: “Mègawɔ ahasi o; mègawu ame o; mègafi fi o; mègabiã ŋu ɖe hawòvi ƒe nu ŋu o,” kple bubuawo katã la ƒe taƒonyae nye se sia be: “Lɔ̃ hawòvi abe ale si nèlɔ̃ wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene.”

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, miedze si ɣeyiɣi vevi si me miele. Game su be mianyɔ tso alɔ̃ me, elabe Mawu ƒe ɖeɖe la tu aƒe fifia wu esime míexɔ se teti la.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Zã va yi vɔ; ŋu le kekem. Mina míadzudzɔ nu siwo wowɔna le viviti me la wɔwɔ, ne míatsɔ aʋawɔnu, siwo ŋudɔ wowɔna le kekeli me la akpla.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Mina míanɔ agbe nyuie abe ame siwo le kekeli me zɔm la ene. Migana míanɔ aglo tum alo ano aha amu o. Migana míanɔ ahasi wɔm alo anɔ agbe nɔm yakayaka o. Migana míanɔ dzre wɔm alo anɔ ŋu ʋãm o.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ mina míado Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe nɔnɔme abe awu ene, eye migana míanɔ ŋutilã la ŋuti bum ava zu eƒe nudzroamewo dzi wɔlawo o.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Mixɔ ame si ƒe xɔse meli ke haɖe o la ɖe mia dome faa, eye migaʋli nya kplii tso nu si wòle be wòawɔ kple esi mele be wòawɔ o la ŋu o.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Ame aɖe ƒe xɔse wɔnɛ be wòte ŋu ɖua nu sia nu faa, ke ame bubu si ƒe xɔse meli ke o la, amagbewo ko eya ɖuna.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Evɔ ɖe, ame ka ƒomevi wò ŋutɔ nènye hafi be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame bubu ƒe dɔla? Eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒetɔ ŋkume wòle, eye aƒetɔa nya ne dɔla la le te loo, alo edze anyi. Madze anyi hã o, elabe Aƒetɔ la ate ŋu ana wòanɔ te.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ame aɖe hã abu ŋkeke aɖe be ele vevie wu ŋkeke bubu, esime ame aɖe ya tsɔ ŋkekeawo katã ko be wosɔ. Ele be wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe naka ɖe nu si ta wòbui nenema ɖo la dzi.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si de asixɔxɔ ŋkeke aɖe ŋu la, wɔnɛ be yeatsɔ ade bubu Aƒetɔ la ŋui. Nenema ke ame si ɖua nu sia nu la hã ɖunɛ be yeatsɔ ade bubu Aƒetɔ la ŋu, elabe edaa akpe na Mawu ɖe nuɖuɖua ta. Ame sia ame si meɖua nane o la, wɔa esia be yeatsɔ ade bubu Aƒetɔ la ŋu, eye wòdaa akpe na Mawu ɖe eta.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Mía dometɔ aɖeke mele agbe na eɖokui o, eye ame aɖeke mekuna hã na eɖokui o.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne míele agbe la, Aƒetɔ lae míele agbe na, eye ne míeku hã, Aƒetɔ lae míeku na. Azɔ la, míeɖale agbe o, míeɖaku o, Aƒetɔ la tɔ ko míenye.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Esia ta hãe Kristo ku, eye wòfɔ gahele agbe ɖo, bene wòazu Aƒetɔ ɖe kukuawo kple agbagbeawo siaa dzi.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, nu ka ta nèdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu nɔviwò ɖo? Alo nu ka ta nèbua nɔviwò ame maɖiamee? Mawu ŋkume ko mí katã míegbɔna tsitre tsi ge ɖo, be wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mí.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Elabe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be: ‘Zi ale si menyale agbe ko la, ame sia ame le klo dze ge nam, eye ame sia ame akafum godoo.’ ”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Ale mía dome ame sia ame le akɔnta na ge Mawu le eɖokui ŋu. Mègana hawòvi Kristotɔ nawɔ nuvɔ̃ o

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Eya ta mina míadzudzɔ ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ mía nɔewo. Ke boŋ mina míaɖo tame be ame aɖeke nagawɔ nane si aɖia nɔvia nu, alo nu si ana be nɔvia nawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Esi wònye ɖe mewɔ ɖeka kple Aƒetɔ Yesu ta la, menya eye meka ɖe edzi bliboe be naneke menye nu makɔmakɔ le eɖokui si o. Ame si bu nane be enye nu makɔmakɔ la, eyae wòzui na.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Ne nu si nèɖuna la nana nɔviwò sea veve la, ekema esia fia be mèlɔ̃e o. Mègana nuɖuɖu si nèɖuna la, natsrɔ̃ ame si ta Kristo ku ɖo la o.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Eya ta migana ame bubuwo nado vlo nu si miawo miebu be enye nu nyui la o.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Ame si subɔa Kristo le nu siawo me la, eya ƒe nue nyoa Mawu ŋu, eye eya ŋue amegbetɔwo hã dea bubui.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Ale mina míaɖoe kplikpaa be míawɔ nu si ko ahe ŋutifafa vɛ, eye gawu la, wòanye nu si akpe ɖe ame bubuwo ŋu, be woƒe xɔse nali ke.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Migaxa ɖe nuɖuɖu ta ahagblẽ Mawu ƒe dɔ o. Le nyateƒe me la, nu sia nu ŋuti kɔ, ke menye be nuɖuɖu, si ame aɖe ɖu la, naɖia nɔvia nu wòawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nu nyuitɔ koe nye be mègaɖu lã alo ano wain alo awɔ nu bubu aɖeke, si ana nɔviwò nawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Na nu si dzi nèxɔ se la, nanɔ mi kple Mawu ɖeɖe ko dome. Ame si wɔa nu si wòbu be eyae nye nyuitɔ, eye eƒe dzi mebu fɔe o la, eyae nye yayrame.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Ke ame si ke ɖi le nuɖuɖu aɖe ŋu hafi ɖui la, wobu fɔe elabe nu si wòwɔ la, metso xɔse me o. Nu sia nu si wowɔ, xɔse manɔmee la, nye nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Ele na mí ame siwo ŋu ŋusẽ le la be míakpe ɖe ame siwo ŋu ŋusẽ mele o la ŋu; menye be míawɔ nu si adze míawo ŋutɔ ŋu ko o.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Le esia teƒe la, ele be mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nawɔ nu si adze ehavi ŋu be wòanyo nɛ, eye wòali ke.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Kristo hã mewɔ nu si sɔ na eya ŋutɔ ko o. Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Dzu si amewo dzu na wò la, va lɔm ɖe eme.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si naa ame nɔa te sesĩe, eye wòdea dzi ƒo na ame la, nawɔe be miaƒe gbe nasɔ eye miawɔ nu si Kristo Yesu di la.

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: Ale mi katã miatsɔ gbe ɖeka ado Mawu, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Tɔ́ la ɖe dzi. Wogblɔ Nyanyui la na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Eya ta mixɔ mia nɔewo abe ale si Kristo hã xɔ mii ene. Miwɔ esia ale be amewo nakafu Mawu.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Mele egblɔm na mi be Kristo va zu subɔla na Yudatɔwo, be yeaɖee afia be Mawu la, nyateƒetɔ wònye, ale be woaɖo kpe ŋugbe si Mawu do na tɔgbuitɔgbuiawo la dzi,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: ale be to esia wɔwɔ me la, ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã nava kafu Mawu le ale si wòvea ame nui ta. Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Eya ta makafu wò le ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la dome, eye madzi ha akafu wò ŋkɔ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Wogaŋlɔ ɖi hã be: “Mi ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, mikpɔ dzidzɔ kple Mawu ƒe dukɔ, si wòtia la!”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ŋɔŋlɔ bubu be: “Mi ame siwo katã menye Yudatɔwo o, mikafu Aƒetɔ la, eye mina dukɔwo katã nakafui!”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela Yesaya hã gblɔ be: “Isai ƒe dzidzimevi aɖe ava do, woakɔe ɖe dzi be wòava ɖu ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la dzi. Eya ŋue woaɖo ŋu ɖo.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si nana wokpɔa mɔ nɛ la nana dzidzɔ kple ŋutifafa nayɔ mia me taŋ, elabe miexɔ edzi se, ale be Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la nado ŋusẽ mi be mɔkpɔkpɔ nagati mi o. Paulo ɖe nu si ta wòŋlɔ nya deto siawo ɖo la me

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nye ŋutɔ mekpɔ kakaɖedzi blibo be miezu ame vɔ keŋkeŋ, eye mienya nu geɖe ŋutɔ, ale be miate ŋu axlɔ̃ nu mia nɔewo.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Le agbalẽ sia me la, medo dzi ŋlɔ nu geɖe faa, be matsɔ aɖo ŋku nanewo dzi na mi. Mewɔ esia elabe Mawu ve nunye de dɔ sia asi nam be mawɔ.

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Dɔ lae nye be masubɔ Kristo Yesu le ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, dome. Ale mewɔ subɔsubɔdɔ sia, heɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui si tso Mawu gbɔ la, na wo, ale be ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la nava zu vɔsa nyui si ŋuti Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la kɔ, eye wòdze Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Esi wònye mía kple Kristo ye wɔ ɖeka ta la, mate ŋu aƒo adegbe le dɔ si wɔm mele na Mawu ŋuti.
