english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Nyemado dzi agblɔ nya aɖeke le naneke ŋuti wu nu si Kristo wɔ to dzinye, le nya siwo megblɔ kple dɔ siwo mewɔ la me, be ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, naɖo to Mawu o.

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: Esia va eme to dzesi kple nukunu siwo mewɔ kple Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe ƒe ŋusẽ la me. Ale mezɔ to Yerusalem yi ɖato keke Iliriko ke kpe ɖo, heɖe gbeƒã Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la wòde go keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Nye didi vevitɔe nye be maɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la, le afi si womese Kristo ŋkɔ le kpɔ o, be nyemagayi xɔ tu ge ɖe gɔmeɖokpe si ame bubu ɖo da ɖi xoxo la dzi o.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Ame siwo womeɖe gbeƒã na tso eŋu kpɔ o la, woawoe akpɔe, eye ame siwo mese naneke tso eŋu kpɔ o la, woawoe ase egɔme.” Paulo ɖoe be yeayi Roma

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Esia ta meɖoe zi geɖe be mava mia gbɔ, ke medze edzi nam o.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Ke fifia esi mewu nye dɔ nu le nuto sia me vɔ, eye ƒè geɖeewo nye esi mele didim be mava kpɔ mi ɖa hafi ta la,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: madi be ne meva yina ɖe Spania la, mava kpɔ mi ɖa azɔ. Mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be ne meva ɖo ta afi ma la, mato mia gbɔ, akpɔ mi ɖa, anɔ mia gbɔ miakpɔ dzidzɔ ʋɛ hafi miaɖom ɖe ŋgɔgbea.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Makedoniatɔwo kple Axayatɔwo ɖoe be yewoadzɔ nu faa aɖo ɖe ame dahe siwo le ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la dome le Yerusalem la.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nu wònye woawo ŋutɔ ɖo be yewoawɔ kple dzi faa. Le nyateƒe me la, edze be woawɔe vavã. Elabe ne ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la va le gome kpɔm le nunyoname si Mawu na woƒe gbɔgbɔwo me la, ekema edze be Yudatɔwo hã nakpɔ gome le nu nyui siwo woawo hã wokpɔ le xexe sia me la me.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Ne mewɔ dɔ sia, hetsɔ nunana la de wo si vɔ keŋ la, ekema madze mɔ ava to mia gbɔ ahayi ɖe Spania.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Menya be ne meva ɖo mia gbɔ la, matsɔ Kristo ƒe yayra si le Nyanyui la me la vɛ na mi, wòasɔ gbɔ fũu.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, le ale si míexɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi se kple le lɔlɔ̃ si Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la na mí ta la, mele kuku ɖem na mi be miakpe ɖe ŋunye ado gbe ɖa kpakplim vevie na Mawu, ɖe tanye.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Miwɔ esia bene ame siwo mexɔ Yesu Kristo dzi se le Yudea o la, nagawɔ nu vevim o; gawu la, be subɔsubɔdɔ si wɔ ge meyina le Yerusalem la, nadze ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la ŋu le afi ma.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Ale be ne Mawu lɔ̃ la, mava mia gbɔ kple dzidzɔ, eye maɖi ɖe eme.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Mawu si naa ŋutifafa la, nenɔ kpli mi katã. Amen.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Medi be matɔ asi mía nɔvinyɔnu Foebe, ame si nye subɔla vevi aɖe le Kenxrea-hame la me dzi na mi.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Mixɔe, esi wònye Aƒetɔ la tɔ ta, abe ale si wòdze be miaxɔ ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la ene. Kpekpeɖeŋu ɖe sia ɖe si wòhiã tso mia gbɔ la, minae, elabe eya hã kpena ɖe ame geɖe ŋuti; nye ŋutɔ hã mele eme.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Priskila kple Akwila, ame siwo kpe ɖe ŋunye míewɔ dɔ hesubɔ Kristo Yesu ɖekae, esi míele hadede me kpakplii ta.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe agbe ɖo anyi ɖe tanye. Akpe na wo kakaka! Menye nye koe le akpea dam na wo o, ke hame siwo katã le ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la dome la hãe.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na hame si le wo ƒeme la hã. Medo gbe na Epaineto, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ si trɔ dzime va zu Kristo tɔ le Asia la.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Maria, ame si wɔ dɔ kple vevidodo le mia dome la.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na nye ƒometɔwo, Androniko kple Yunio, ame siwo nɔ gaxɔ me kplim la hã. Wonye ame ŋkutawo le amedɔdɔawo dome, eye wozu Kristotɔwo do ŋgɔ nam.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Ampliatus, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ, si le hadede me kple Aƒetɔa la.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Urbano, ame si hã le dɔ wɔm na Kristo kplim kple nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ Staxis.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Apeles, ame si li ke le hadede kple Kristo me. Medo gbe na Aristobolo ƒometɔwo hã nyuie.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na nye ƒometɔ Herodion kple Narkiso ƒemetɔ, siwo le hadede me kple Kristo la.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Trifaena kple Trifosa, ame siwo le Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔ wɔm. Medo gbe na Persis lɔlɔ̃a, ame si le agbagba dzem eye wòle dɔ wɔm na Aƒetɔ la.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Rufo, ame tiatia si le hadede me kple Aƒetɔ la kple dadaa, ame si nye nye hã danye.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Asinkrito, Flego, Herme, Patroba, Herma kple nɔvi siwo le wo gbɔ la.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Filologo kple Yulia, Nerea kple nɔvia nyɔnu kple Olimpa kpakple hametɔ bubu, siwo katã le wo gbɔ la.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Mido gbe na mia nɔewo eye ame sia ame nana asi nɔvia lɔlɔ̃tɔe. Kristo ƒe hameawo katã do gbe na mi nyuie. Paulo xlɔ̃ nu xɔsetɔ siwo le Roma

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mele nu xlɔ̃m mi be miade dzesi ame siwo hea memama dea amewo dome kple nuɖiaɖia vanɛ, eye wotsia tre ɖe nu si wofia mi la ŋu la. Midze na wo.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Elabe menye Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo subɔm ame siawo le o, ke boŋ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ƒodoe. Wotsɔa nya viviwo nɔa amewo kafum, eye woblea ame siwo mele vɔ̃ aɖeke susum o la.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Ke miawo ya la, ame sia ame nya ale si miele to ɖom Nyanyui lae, eya ta mekpɔa dzidzɔ le mia ŋuti. Nu si dim mele na mie nye be miadze nunya le nu nyui wɔwɔ me, ke le nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ gome ya la, mianye ame dzadzɛwo.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Eteƒe madidi o, Mawu si naa ŋutifafa la, agbã Satana gúdugudu ɖe miaƒe afɔ te. Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoteo, ame si le dɔ ɖeka wɔm kplim, Lukio, Yason kple Sesipatro, ame siwo nye nye ƒometɔwo la, hã do gbe na mi nyuie.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Nye, Tertio, mia nɔvi si le hadede me kple Aƒetɔa la, hã medo gbe na mi. Nyee ŋlɔ agbalẽ sia.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Mina míakafu Mawu! Ate ŋu ado ŋusẽ míaƒe xɔse le ale si wòna meɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la tso Yesu Kristo ŋu kple ale si wòɖe nyateƒenya ɣaɣla si wòɣla ɖi tso keke gbe aɖe gbe ʋĩi ke fia la ta.

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo va na míenya wo, eye abe ale si Mawu mavɔtɔ la ɖoe ene la, ena dukɔwo katã nyae, ale be amewo katã naxɔ edzi ase ahaɖo toe.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Mina míakafu Mawu nunyala ɖeka hɔ̃ sia, to Yesu Kristo dzi, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Nye Paulo, ame si woyɔ to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me, be mava zu Yesu Kristo ƒe amedɔdɔ kple nɔvi Sostene ye le agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: Míele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe Mawu ƒe hame si le Korinto kple ame siwo ŋu wokɔ, eye wole hadede me kple Kristo Yesu la. Woyɔ mi ame siawo kple ame siwo katã subɔa mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo le afi sia afi la vɛ, be miava zu ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ. Yesu siae nye mí kple woawo siaa ƒe Aƒetɔ.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Mawu, mía Tɔ́ kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu, eye woana ŋutifafa mi. Yayra siwo le hadede kple Kristo me

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Medaa akpe na nye Mawu ɣe sia ɣi le mia ta, be wòto Kristo Yesu dzi ve mia nu.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Ale si miele ɖase ɖim tso Kristo ŋu hã ƒo ke ɖe to sesĩe le mia dome

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: ale gbegbe be, esi miele lalam na ɣeyiɣi si mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo nado la, gbɔgbɔmeyayra ɖe sia ɖe su mia si xoxo.

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: Eya ŋutɔ alé mi ɖe asi, vodada aɖeke manɔ mia ŋu o, le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si yɔ mi vɛ be miava de ha kple Via, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la, nuteƒewɔla wònye. Memama si le hame la me

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, metsɔ mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo lé afɔ na mi be miaƒe nu nasɔ, eye memama naganɔ mia dome o. Milé nɔvisi le nya siwo ŋu miebuna kple nu siwo dzi mieɖoa kpee la me.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, mele esia gblɔm, elabe Xloe ƒemetɔwo na menya be dzre le mia dome.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Nu si mewɔnɛ lae nye be: wobe mia dome ame aɖewo be: “Paulo dzie mele.” Bubu ya be: “Apolo dzie mele.” Ame kemɛ be: “Kefas yome mele,” eye bubu hã be: “Kristo ƒe akpa dzie nye ya mele.”

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Mabia mi se: Akpa vovovo mee woma Kristo ɖoa? Pauloe woklã ɖe ati ŋuti ɖe mia ta loo, alo Paulo ŋkɔ mee wole mawutsi na mi ɖoa?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawu be hekpe ɖe Gayo kple Krispo ŋuti la, nyemegale mawutsi na ame aɖeke,

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: ne woava gblɔ be nye ŋkɔ mee wole tsi na yewo le o.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Ahã, meɖo ŋku edzi be megale mawutsi na Stefana ƒemetɔwo hã. Ame siawo megbe la, nyemegaɖo ŋku edzi be mele mawutsi na ame bubu aɖeke o.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Menye mawutsilele gbee Kristo ɖom ɖo o, ke boŋ be maɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la. Womedi tso asinye hã be matsɔ nu nyui ƒoƒo ƒe aɖaŋu aɖe gbeƒã lae o, anye ne ŋusẽ aɖeke maganɔ Kristo ƒe atitsoga la ŋu o. Kristoe nye Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ kple nunya

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Atitsogaŋunya si meɖea gbeƒãe la, movinya ko wònye le ame siwo le tsɔtsrɔ̃m la gbɔ; ke mí, ame siwo woxɔ ɖe agbe ya la, Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ wònye na mí.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Mana nunyala ƒe nunya natsrɔ̃, eye maɖe nugɔmesela ƒe nugɔmesese ɖa.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Ekema afi ka ame si be yenya nu la le? Afi ka agbalẽfiala la le? Xexe sia me nyaʋlila la ɖe? Ɖe Mawu metrɔ amegbetɔ ƒe nunya wòzu movidzɔdzɔ oa?

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Esi xexea me de eya ŋutɔ ƒe nunya tsɔ ge adze si Mawu do kpoe ta la, edze Mawu ŋu be wòatsɔ míaƒe movinya si míeɖea gbeƒãe la aɖe ame siwo xɔ edzi se la ƒe agbe.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo la nukunu wodina be yewoakpɔ, eye Helatɔwo ya tia nunya yome,

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: ke míawo ya la, Kristo si woklã ɖe ati ŋuti la ƒe gbeƒã ɖem míele. Atitsoganya sia nye nuɖiaɖia na Yudatɔwo, eye wònye movinya le Helatɔwo gbɔ.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Le ame siwo Mawu tia gome ya la, woɖanye Yudatɔwo alo Helatɔwo o, Kristo siae nye Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ kple eƒe nunya.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Elabe nunya le Mawu ƒe nuwɔna si dzé abe movinu ene la me sãa wu amegbetɔ tɔ, eye Mawu ƒe nuwɔna si dzé abe ɖe wògbɔdzɔ ene la, ŋusẽ le eme wu amegbetɔ tɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mikpɔ mi ame siwo woyɔ la ɖa! Le xexea me ƒe nukpɔkpɔ nu la, nunyalawo mesɔ gbɔ le mia dome o; ŋusẽtɔwo hã mebɔ ɖe mia dome o, eye nenema ke mia dome ame geɖe hã medzɔ tso ƒome siwo ŋu bubu le la me o.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Mawu tia nu siwo dzé movinuwoe le xexea me la be yeatsɔ wo ado ŋukpe nunyalawoe, eye wòtia nu siwo gbɔdzɔ la hã, be yeatsɔ ado ŋukpe ŋusẽtɔwoe.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: Gawu la, nu siwo amewo mebuna ɖe naneke me o, eye womeɖi naneke o lae Mawu tia. Etia nu siwo menɔ anyi kpɔ o kura gɔ̃ hã, be yeatsɔ aɖe nu siwo li xoxo la ɖa.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: Mawu wɔ esia, ale be amegbetɔ aɖeke nagaƒo adegbe le eŋkume o.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Eya tae woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Ame si be yeaƒo adegbe la, netsɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒo adegbee.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, esia tae esi meva mia gbɔ, be maɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe nya ɣaɣla la la, nyemetsɔ nya gãwo, alo aɖaŋunuƒoƒo ɖe gbeƒãe na mi o.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Elabe esi menɔ mia dome la, meɖoe be naneke manɔ nye susu me wu Yesu Kristo si woklã ɖe ati ŋu la o.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Ame beli kple vɔvɔ̃nɔtɔ menye, hedzona nyanyanya ɣe ma ɣi.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: Nyemezã nya lolo, siwo me amegbetɔwo ƒe nunya be ɖo o, ke boŋ meɖe gbeƒã gbedeasi la dzaa ko, abe ale si Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ɖee fia to eƒe ŋusẽ me la ene.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Nyemedi hã be miaƒe xɔse natsi tsitre ɖe amegbetɔwo ƒe nunya dzi o, ke boŋ ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ la dzi. Mawu ƒe nunya

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Míenyaƒoa nu le nunya ŋu na ame deŋgɔwo baa; gake menye xexe sia me ƒe nunya alo edziɖulawo, ame siwo si woxɔ ŋusẽ le xoxo la, ƒe nya gblɔm mele o.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Ke nunya si ŋu míeƒoa nu le la wotsyɔ nu edzi, heɣlae ɖe Mawu me. Mawu da asi ɖe edzi hafi xexea me va dzɔ, be woato nunya sia dzi ado mí ɖe dzi.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Xexe sia me dziɖula aɖeke menya nya ɣaɣla sia o, elabe ne ɖe wonyae la, anye ne womeklã Aƒetɔ ŋutikɔkɔetɔ la ɖe atitsoga ŋu o.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Ke woŋlɔe ɖi be: “Nu si ŋkumekpɔ kpɔ o; nu si to mese kpɔ o, nu si meva susu me na ame aɖeke kpɔ o lae, Mawu dzra ɖo ɖi na ame siwo lɔ̃e la.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖe nu siawo fia míawo ya to eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dzi, elabe Gbɔgbɔ la dzroa nu sia nu me tsitotsito. Edzroa keke Mawu ƒe nu goglowo ke gɔ̃ hã me.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Ame kae nya nu si le ame aɖe ƒe susu me ke? Ɖe menye eƒe gbɔgbɔ si le eya ŋutɔ me la ke koe nyae oa? Nenema ke ame aɖeke menya nu si le Mawu ƒe susu me o, negbe Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ko.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Menye gbɔgbɔ si le xexe sia me lae míexɔ o, ke boŋ Gbɔgbɔ si tso Mawu gbɔ lae míexɔ, be míate ŋu ase nu siwo Mawu tsɔ na mí faa la gɔme.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Ale menye nunya si míesrɔ̃ tso amegbetɔwo gbɔ la, míetsɔna ƒoa nui o, ke boŋ nu siwo Gbɔgbɔ la fia mí lae, bene míaɖe nyateƒe si le gbɔgbɔ me la afia ame siwo me Gbɔgbɔ la le la.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Ame si me Gbɔgbɔ la mele o la, mete ŋu xɔa Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe nunanawo o. Movinyawo ko woɖina nɛ. Mate ŋu ase wo gɔme hã o, elabe ame si me Gbɔgbɔ la le la koe anya be nu vevi wonye.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Ke ame si le gbɔgbɔ me la nyaa nu si nyo kple esi menyo o, ɖeko ame aɖeke mete ŋu dzea si eyama o.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Ame kae nya susu si le tame na Aƒetɔ la? Ame kae afia nui?” Míawo ya la, Kristo ƒe tamesusue le mía si.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, esi meva mia gbɔ la, nyemete ŋu ƒo nu na mi, abe ame siwo le gbɔgbɔ me la ene o, ke boŋ abe ame siwo le ŋutilã me ene. Meƒo nu na mi abe vidzĩ siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo la ene.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Notsie mena mi, mieno; menye nuɖuɖu sesẽ o, elabe ɣe ma ɣi la, mietsi aɖu nu sesẽ o, eye fifi kura gɔ̃ hã la, miate ŋu aɖui o,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: elabe xexe sia me susu koe gale mia si. Nenye be miele ŋu ʋãm mia nɔewo, eye miele dzre hem la, ɖe esia mefia be miegale agbe nɔm abe xexe sia me tɔwo ene, eye miele nu wɔm abe amegbetɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ko ene oa?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe be: “Paulo tɔe menye,” eye bubu hã be: “Apolo dzie mele” la, ɖe menye ame siwo meli ke o la ko mieganye oa?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Evɔ ɖe, ame kae nye Apolo? Ame kae nye Paulo? Ɖe menye subɔlawo ko míenye, eye mieto mía dzi zu xɔsetɔwo oa? Dɔ si Aƒetɔ la ɖo na mía dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe koe míewɔ.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Nye ya ɖeko medo nukua, eye Apolo hã tsi ko wòdee, ke Mawue nye ame si na wòtsi.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Ame si do nukua kple ame si de tsii la, ɖe wosɔ, eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe axɔ fetu ɖe dɔ si wòwɔ la nu.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Míenye hadɔwɔlawo na Mawu, eye miawo mienye Mawu ƒe agble. Ẽ, Mawu ƒe xɔ hãe mienye.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Nye la, Mawu ve nunye eye wòɖom abe xɔtula gã ene. Ale meɖo xɔa gɔme anyi. Ame bubu va le etum ɖe edzi. Ame sia ame si le etum ɖe edzi la, nalé be na ale si wòatui ɖe edzii,

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: ame sia ame ƒe dɔ si wòwɔ la, ava dze, elabe wole eɖe ge afia le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la. Dzoe wole tsɔtsɔ ge aɖee ɖe goe, eye dzoa ado dɔ si ƒomevi ame sia ame wɔ la kpɔ.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Ne xɔ si ame aɖe tu ɖe gɔmeɖoɖoa dzi tsi anyi la, ekema axɔ fetu.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ame si tɔ fia la, abu eƒe fetu, ke bebli hafi woaxɔe ɖe agbe abe ame si do tso dzodzeaƒeme la ene.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae be Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔe mienye, eye be Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la le mia me oa?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe gblẽ Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ la, Mawu agblẽ eya hã, elabe Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ la, nu kɔkɔe wònye. Miawoe nye gbedoxɔ sia.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke megaflu eɖokui o. Ne mia dometɔ aɖe bu be yenye nunyala le xexe sia me la, netsɔ eɖokui wɔ movitɔe boŋ, ale be wòava zu nunyala.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Elabe xexe sia me tɔwo ƒe nunya nye movidzɔdzɔ ko le Mawu gbɔ. Woŋlɔe ɖe mawunya me be: “Eléa nunyalawo, ne wole nane wɔm le aye me.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Wogagblɔ hã be: “Aƒetɔ la nya be nunyalawo ƒe tamesusuwo nye nu dzodzro.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Eɖanye Paulo, Apolo alo Kefas o; eɖanye xexea me, alo agbe, alo ku, alo nu si li fifia, alo nu si le vava ge o, wo katã mia tɔwo wonye.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, Kristo tɔ mienye, eye Kristo nye Mawu tɔ.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame nabu mí abe Kristo ƒe dɔlawo kple ame siwo wotsɔ Mawu ƒe nya ɣaɣla la de asi na, be woakpɔ edzi la ene.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Ele vevie be míanye nudzikpɔla siwo ŋu woate ŋu aɖo ŋu ɖo.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Le gonyeme la, meɖe fu nam kura, be miawo alo ame bubu aɖe nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnum o. Nyemedrɔ̃a ʋɔnu nye ŋutɔ ɖokuinye gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Nyemenya ne mewɔ nu gbegblẽ aɖeke o, ke esia mefia be menye ame dzɔdzɔe o. Aƒetɔ lae nye nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Eya ta migadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame aɖeke hafi ɣeyiɣia nade, alo hafi Aƒetɔ la nava o. Ne eva la, ahe nu siwo woɣla ɖe viviti me la ɖe kekeli nu, eye wòaklo nu le adaŋu si amewo de ɣla ɖe susu me la dzi. Ɣe ma ɣie Mawu akafu ame sia ame si wòdze be woakafu la.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, metsɔ nye ŋutɔ kple Apolo ƒe nya sia ɖo kpɔɖeŋui na mi, bene miasrɔ̃ nu tso mía gbɔ, ne miagatra tso mawunya gbɔ o. Migatsɔ dàda bu ame aɖewo amegãwoe ahabu bubuwo ya ame maɖinuwoe o.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Ame ka gɔ̃e tsɔ wò ya wɔ ame tɔxɛe? Nu kae le asiwò, esi menye ɖe wotsɔe na wò o? Nenye ame aɖee na wò la, nu ka ta nèle adegbe ƒom abe wò ŋutɔ wò nu wònye ene mahã?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Ã, ɖe mieɖi ƒo xoxoa? Miezu kesinɔtɔwo vɔa? Fia hã ɖum miele míawo manɔmea? Fiae mianɔ ɖuɖum pɛ, ne míawo hã míaɖui kpli mi hafi.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Edzé nam abe Mawu ɖe wòkplɔ mí, amedɔdɔwo ya vɛ abe amegbetɔwo katã ƒe mlɔetɔ kekeake ene. Gawu la, míezu abe ame siwo wotso kufia na be woawu le nukpɔƒe la ene. Ẽ, modzakaɖenuwo ko míezu na xexea me gbadzaa, mawudɔlawo kple amegbetɔwo siaa.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Míawo míezu movitɔwo le Kristo ta, ke miawo ya Kristotɔ nyanuwo mienye. Míawo míenye ame gblɔewo, ke miawo ya ŋusẽ le mia ŋu. Bubu le mia ŋu, ke míawo ya womekpɔa mí ɖe naneke me o.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Va se ɖe fifia gɔ̃ hã la, dɔ kple tsikɔ le mía wum. Míetsi nu vuvu me; woƒoa mí nyamanyama dzodzro, eye míele tsa glãla tsam, aƒe aɖeke mele mía si o.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Míekua kutri hewɔa dɔ kple míawo ŋutɔ míaƒe asi. Ne amewo ƒo fi de mí la, míeyraa wo. Ne woti mía yome la, míedoa dzi tsɔnɛ.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Ne amewo dzu mí la, míedia woƒe nyui. Míeva zu aɖukpodzinu kple gbeɖuɖɔ na xexea me katã va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Nyemele nya sia ŋlɔm be matsɔ ado ŋukpe mi o, ke boŋ be matsɔe axlɔ̃ nu mi abe vinye lɔlɔ̃awo ene.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nufiala geɖewo le mia si le hamea me hã la, mia tɔwo mesɔ gbɔ o. Meto Nyanyui la gbɔgblɔ me va zu mia tɔ, elabe miewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Eya ta mele nu xlɔ̃m mi be miato nye afɔtoƒe.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Esia tae mele Timoteo, vinye lɔlɔ̃a nuteƒewɔla, si le hadede me kple Aƒetɔ la, ɖom ɖe mi. Medi be wòaɖo ŋku ale si menɔa agbee abe Kristo ene la dzi na mi. Nu siawo ke ko mefiana le hameawo katã me le afi sia afi.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Mia dometɔ aɖewo le wo ɖokui dom ɖe dzi abe ɖe nye megale mia gbɔ va ge o ene.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ la lɔ̃ la, eteƒe madidi kura hafi mava mia gbɔ o. Nenye be meva la, nye matsi dzi be manya nya siwo gblɔm dàdala mawo le o, ke boŋ madi be manya ŋusẽ si le wo si.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la mele nuƒo me o, ke boŋ ŋusẽ mee wòle.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Ka dim miele? Matsɔ ameƒoti ɖe asi vɛ loo, alo mava kple lɔlɔ̃ kpakple gbɔgbɔ fatua?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Míele esem godogodo le mia ŋu be mia dometɔ aɖewo le ahasi wɔm. Ahasi si ƒomevi wɔm wole la tɔgbe mele trɔ̃subɔlawo kura gɔ̃ hã dome o. Wobe ame aɖe xɔ eya ŋutɔ tɔ́a srɔ̃!

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Hafi miele dàdam alea! Avi boŋ wòle be mianɔ fafam! Miɖe ame si wɔ nu sia ɖa le mia dome.

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: eye miatsɔ ame sia ƒe ŋutilã ade asi na Satana be wòatsrɔ̃e gbidigbidi, ale be woaxɔ eƒe gbɔgbɔ ya ɖe agbe le Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Medze be mianɔ adegbe ƒom hafi o. Ɖe mienyae be amɔwɔʋãnu vi aɖe koe nana amɔwɔ blibo la katã ʋãna oa?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Eya ta mitsɔ amɔwɔ ʋaʋã xoxo la ƒu gbe bene miazu amɔwɔ yeye, elabe le nyateƒe me la, amɔwɔ maʋamaʋãe mienye. Wowu Kristo si nye míaƒe Paskalẽvia la.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Eya ta mina míaɖu ŋkekenyui la, menye kple amɔwɔ ʋaʋã xoxo si nye susu baɖa kple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ o, ke boŋ kple amɔwɔ maʋamaʋã si nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple nyateƒetoto.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Le agbalẽ si meŋlɔ na mi kpɔ va yi me la, megblɔ na mi be migade ha kple ame siwo nɔa agbe baɖa o.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Menye xexe sia me ahasiwɔlawo, ŋubiãlawo, adzodalawo kple trɔ̃subɔlawoe mewɔnɛ o, anye ne ɖeko miado go le xexe sia me.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: Ke nu si ŋlɔm mele na mi lae nye be, ne nɔvi aɖe nye hametɔ gake wògale ahasi wɔm, alo le ŋu biãm alo le trɔ̃ subɔm, alo le dzre hem, alo le aha mum, alo le adzo dam la, migade ha kplii o. Migaɖu nu kplii gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
translation_verse: Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ame siwo mele hamea me o la metsɔ gbɔnye o. Ɖe menye ame siwo le hamea me lae wòle be miadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui oa?

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Ame siwo mele hamea me o ya la, Mawue drɔ̃a ʋɔnu wo. Mawunya gblɔ be: “Minya ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖa le mia dome.”

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Ne nya ɖo nɔvi xɔsetɔ eve dome la, ɖe ame ɖeka tsɔnɛ yina ɖe ame siwo mele hamea me o la gbɔ loo, alo etsɔnɛ yia hametɔwo gbɔa?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Alo ɖe mienyae be xɔsetɔwoe le ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge xexea me gbe aɖe gbe oa? Mi ame siwo gbɔna ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge xexea me la, ɖe miate ŋu adrɔ̃ nya kukluiwo, akpɔ ta na wo oa?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Ekema mienyae be míawoe gbɔna ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge mawudɔlawo gɔ̃ hã oa? Ʋuu keke wòahanye agbemenya suesuewo!

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta nenye be nya siawo ɖo mia dome la, mietsɔa wo yina ɖe ame siwo hamea mebuna gobii o la gbɔe?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Ŋu nekpe mi dzro! Ke ɖe miele gbɔgblɔm be nunyala ɖeka pɛ hã mele mia dome si ate ŋu adrɔ̃ nya le nɔvi xɔsetɔwo dome o tae,

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: miele mia nɔewo kplɔm le ʋɔnu yim le ame siwo menye xɔsetɔwo o la gbɔa?

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Be miele mia nɔewo kplɔm le ʋɔnu yim la ɖe mia dzi kpɔtɔ. Nu ka ta miazi kpi woawɔ vɔ̃ ɖe mia ŋu boŋ o? Nu ka ta miana woaba mi boŋ o?

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae be ame siwo wɔa nu madzɔmadzɔ la manyi Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la dome oa? Migana woable mi o! Nu baɖa wɔlawo, alo trɔ̃subɔlawo, alo ahasiwɔlawo, alo nyɔnu siwo dɔna kple nyɔnuwo loo, alo ŋutsu siwo dɔna kple ŋutsuwo,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: alo fiafiwo, alo ŋuklẽlawo, alo ame siwo noa aha muna, alo ame siwo dzua ame, alo ame siwo daa adzo ame ƒe nu la, manyi Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la dome akpɔ o.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Nu siawoe mia dometɔ aɖewo wɔna tsã; ke azɔ la, wole tsi na mi, kɔ mia ŋuti hebu mi ame dzɔdzɔewoe le Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋkɔ kple mía Mawu la ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la me. Mitsɔ miaƒe ŋutilã de bubu Mawu ŋui

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Wogblɔna be: “Woɖe mɔ nam be mawɔ nu sia nu.” Ke menye nu sia nu wɔwɔe nyo na ame o. Wonyagblɔna be, “Woɖe mɔ nam be mawɔ nu sia nu” baa, ke nyemele mɔ na ge be naneke naɖu dzinye o.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Wogagblɔna hã be, “Ɖe wowɔ nuɖuɖu be woaɖu ɖe ƒodo me. Nenema ke ɖe wowɔ ƒodo be woaɖu nu ɖe eme.” Ke Mawu gbɔna wo kple eve la siaa ɖe ge ɖa. Womewɔ ŋutilã be woatsɔe awɔ ahasii o, ke boŋ ɖe wowɔe be wòanye Aƒetɔ la tɔ, eye Aƒetɔ la hã nanye ŋutilã la tɔ.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Abe ale si Mawu fɔ Aƒetɔ la ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome ene la, nenema kee wòatsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ la afɔ míawo hã ɖe tsitree.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae be miaƒe ŋutilãwo la Kristo ƒe ameti la ŋutinuwo wonye oa? Ne ele nenema la, ɖe wòle be matsɔ Kristo ƒe ŋutinuwo awɔ nyɔnu si tsɔ ahasiwɔwɔ ɖo dɔe la ƒe ŋutinuwoea? Gbeɖe!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Ɖe mienya be ŋutsu si dɔ kple nyɔnu ahasitɔ la, eƒe ŋutilã zu ɖeka kple etɔ oa? Elabe mawunya gblɔ be: “Wo ame eve la, woazu ŋutilã ɖeka.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Ke ame si wɔ ɖeka kple Aƒetɔ la ya la, eƒe gbɔgbɔ zu ɖeka kple Aƒetɔ la tɔ.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Mitsri ahasiwɔwɔ loo! Nu vɔ̃ bubu ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi si ame wɔna la, melɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã ɖe eme o, ke ame si wɔa ahasi ya la, wɔa nuvɔ̃ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã ŋu.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae be miaƒe ŋutilã la Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe si Mawu na mi, wòle mia me la, ƒe gbedoxɔe wònye oa? Kpɔ ɖa, menye mia ɖokui tɔe mienye o!

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Fe gã ŋutɔ woxe ɖe mia ta, eya ta mitsɔ miaƒe ŋutilã de bubu Mawu ŋui.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Fifia la, medi be maƒo nu tso nya siwo miebia le agbalẽ si mieŋlɔ ɖo ɖa me la ŋuti. Magblɔ be anyo ŋutɔ ne ŋutsu anɔ anyi eye madɔ kple nyɔnu o.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Ke be miaxe mɔ na ahasiwɔwɔ ta la, srɔ̃nyɔnu nenɔ ŋutsu ɖe sia ɖe si, eye nyɔnu ɖe sia ɖe neɖe srɔ̃.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu newɔ nu sia nu si dze, eye wòhiã la na srɔ̃a. Nyɔnu hã newɔe na srɔ̃a nenema ke.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Elabe srɔ̃nyɔnu mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi o, ke boŋ srɔ̃ŋutsu lae kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi. Nenema ke srɔ̃ŋutsua hã mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã dzi o, ke boŋ srɔ̃nyɔnu lae.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Migate mia ɖokui mia nɔewo o, negbe miawo ŋutɔe lɔ̃ ɖe edzi do ŋgɔ be yewoanɔ anyi nenema hena ɣeyiɣi aɖe, avo, ado gbe ɖa. Ke ne eva eme nenema hã la, migate ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu kaba, elabe ne miete ŋu do dzi ɖu mia ɖokui dzi o la, Satana ava te mi akpɔ.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Megblɔ esia be mana mɔ mi le nu sia ŋuti, ke menye se dem mele na mi o.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ke le ame siwo si srɔ̃ mele o kple ahosiwo gome la, madi be magblɔ na wo be, ne wole anyi srɔ̃maɖee, abe ale si meli ene la, enyo na wo.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, nenye be womate ŋu aɖu wo ɖokui dzi o la, ekema woaɖe srɔ̃. Elabe anyo be ame naɖe srɔ̃ wu be fieŋufieŋu nanɔ fu ɖem nɛ.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Le srɔ̃tɔwo gome la, medi be made se na wo, ke menye nyee le sea dem o, Aƒetɔ la boŋ ye. Se lae nye be srɔ̃nyɔnu negaklã ɖa tso srɔ̃a gbɔ o.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Nenye be ewɔe la, ekema nenɔ anyi srɔ̃maɖee, alo negbugbɔ wɔ ɖeka kple srɔ̃ŋutsua, eye wòatrɔ ayi egbɔ. Srɔ̃ŋutsu hã negagbe srɔ̃a o.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Menye Aƒetɔ lae le esia gblɔm o. Ke nye ŋutɔ medi be magblɔ na ame mamlɛawo be, nenye be srɔ̃ le ŋutsu xɔsetɔ aɖe si, eye nyɔnua menye xɔsetɔ o, evɔ wòdi be yeanɔ atsuƒea la, ŋutsua megagbee o.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne nyɔnu aɖe ɖe ŋutsu aɖe, si menye xɔsetɔ o, evɔ ŋutsua lɔ̃ be yeayi edzi anye srɔ̃a la, nyɔnua megagbee o.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Elabe srɔ̃ŋutsu dzimaxɔsetɔ la ŋuti kɔ le srɔ̃nyɔnua ta. Nenema ke srɔ̃nyɔnu dzimaxɔsetɔ la hã ŋuti kɔ le srɔ̃ŋutsua ta. Ne ɖe mele eme nenema o la, anye ne mia viwo ŋu makɔ o, ke abe ale si wòle ene la, wo ŋu kɔ.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Azɔ nenye be srɔ̃tɔawo dometɔ si menye xɔsetɔ o di be yeaklã ɖa tso esi nye xɔsetɔ gbɔ la, neheyi faa. Ne eva eme alea la, se aɖeke mebla nɔvi xɔsetɔ la le go sia me o; ɖeko Mawu di be míanɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Ame aɖe menya nu o, wò nyɔnu, ɖewohĩ wòe ava xɔ srɔ̃wò ɖe agbe. Nenema ke wò srɔ̃ŋutsu, ɖewohĩ wòe ava xɔ srɔ̃wò ɖe agbe. Agbe si ƒomevi Aƒetɔ la ɖo be míanɔ

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ame sia ame nenɔ agbe, abe ale si Aƒetɔ la nɔe la ene, eye nenɔ anyi, abe ale si wòle hafi Mawu yɔe la ene. Esia nye nye ɖoɖo na hameawo katã.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ne wotso aʋa na ame aɖe, alo wometsoe nɛ o la, menye naneke kura o, ke Mawu ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi wɔwɔe nye nu si le vevie.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame nenɔ nɔnɔme si me wòle hafi woyɔe wòva zu xɔsetɔ la me faa.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Kluvie nènye hafi woyɔ wòa? Mewɔ naneke o. Evɔ la, nenye be àte ŋu awɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ sia ŋudɔ azu ablɔɖevi la, tso ɖe eŋu nàwɔe.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Elabe ame si nye kluvi hafi Aƒetɔ la yɔe la, ezu Aƒetɔ la ƒe ablɔɖevi. Nenema ke ame si nye ablɔɖevi hafi woyɔe la, ezu Kristo ƒe kluvi.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Fe gãe woxe ɖe mia ta, eya ta migazu amegbetɔwo ƒe kluviwo o.

english_verse: Stay what you were when God chose you. Unmarried People
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔviwo, ame sia ame nenɔ ko abe ale si wòle hafi woyɔe la ene. Srɔ̃manɔsitɔwo kple ahosiwo

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Le ame siwo meɖe srɔ̃ o gome la, nyemexɔ ɖoɖo aɖeke tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ na wo o, ke nu si gblɔ ge mala la, nye nye ŋutɔ nye susu, elabe Aƒetɔ la ve nunye be amewo ɖoa ŋu ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Le nye susu nu la, le ale si xexea me le sesẽm le egbe ŋkekewo me ta la, enyo be ame sia ame nanɔ anyi, abe ale si wòli la ko ene.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Ne srɔ̃ le asiwò la, mègadi be yewoaklã ne yeavo o. Ne nyɔnu mele asiwò o la, mègatsi dzi be yeaɖe srɔ̃ o.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Evɔ ne ègaɖe srɔ̃ hã la, mèwɔ nuvɔ̃ o, eye ne ɖetugbi aɖe ɖe srɔ̃ la, mewɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Ɖeko ame siwo ɖe srɔ̃ la le xexemefu kpe ge eye nye la, nyemedi fukpekpe ma na mi hafi o.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nu si gblɔm mele lae nye be, ɣeyiɣi si woɖo la de vɔ. Eya ta tso fifia dzi heyina la, ŋutsu siwo si srɔ̃ le la, nenɔ anyi abe ɖe womeɖe srɔ̃ kpɔ o ene.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Ame siwo tsɔ xexemenuwo didi ɖo dɔe be wo katã nanye yewo tɔ, nenɔ anyi abe ɖe wometsɔ ɖeke le xexemenuwo me o ene. Elabe nɔnɔme si le xexe sia me si fifia la nu le yiyim.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Nye didie nye be miagatsi dzimaɖeɖi o. Ŋutsu si meɖe srɔ̃ o la, tsia dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔwo ŋu, eye wòdina vevie be yeadze eŋu.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Ke ŋutsu srɔ̃tɔ la, tsia dzi ɖe xexea me nuwo ŋu, eye wòdina vevie be yeadze ye srɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Ale wòtsia evedomesi. Nenema ke nyɔnu alo ɖetugbi srɔ̃manɔsitɔ hã tsia dzi ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔwo ŋu, eye wòdina vevie be yeƒe ŋutilã kple gbɔgbɔ siaa nanɔ kɔkɔe. Ke nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ tsia dzi ɖe xexemenuwo ŋu, eye wòdina vevie be yeadze ye srɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Mele esia gblɔm na mi le miawo ŋutɔ miaƒe nyonyo ta, ke menye ɖe mele didim be mana miaxaxa o. Ɖeko medi be ɖoɖo nyuitɔ nanɔ anyi ne miavo atsɔ susu ɖeka ahasubɔ Aƒetɔ lae.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu aɖe bia ɖetugbi ta be yeaɖe, eye wòkpɔ be dzodzro sesẽ le ye me, yemete ŋu le ye ɖokui dzi ɖum o la, woate ŋu aɖe wo nɔewo faa abe ale si wòdi la ene. Mewɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: But it is better to have self-control and to make up your mind not to marry.
translation_verse: Ke ame si naneke mele fu ɖem na o, eye wòte ŋu ɖu eɖokui dzi heɖoe kplikpaa be yele nyɔnu si wotsɔ na ye la ɖe ge godogodo la, ewɔe nyuie.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Ale ŋutsu si ɖe nyɔnu si wotsɔ nɛ la wɔe nyuie, ke ame si meɖe etɔ o la, gawɔe nyuie wu.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Se bla nyɔnu srɔ̃tɔ ɖe srɔ̃a ŋuti, zi ale si ŋutsua le agbe. Ke nenye be ŋutsua ku la, nyɔnua vo agaɖe ŋutsu bubu ɖe sia ɖe si wòlɔ̃ la faa. Evɔ la, ele be wòaɖee abe Kristotɔ ene.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Le nye ya nye susu nu la, ne etsi anyi srɔ̃maɖee la, eƒe dzi adze eme wu. Nye susue nye ema, ke mebu be Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la le menye.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Fifia la, medi be maƒo nu tso nuɖuɖu si wotsɔ sa vɔe na trɔ̃wo la ŋuti. Míenya baa be nunya le mí katã mía si. Gake “Nunya” ɖe wònana be ame doa eɖokui ɖe dzi, ke lɔlɔ̃ ya, ɖe wòtua ame ɖo.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe bu be yenya nane la, menyae wòde edeƒe haɖe o.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame aɖe lɔ̃ Mawu la, Mawu dze si eyama.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Azɔ le nuɖuɖu si wotsɔ sa vɔe na trɔ̃wo ɖuɖu ŋuti la, míenya le nyateƒe me be trɔ̃ aɖeke mele xexea me o, eye mawu bubu aɖeke hã meli o. Mawu ɖeka hɔ̃ koe li míenya.

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: Nenema ke Aƒetɔ ɖeka hɔ̃ koe li. Eyae nye Yesu Kristo, ame si dzi nuwo katã to va dzɔ, eye miawo hã miele agbe to eyama me.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, ame geɖe menya nu sia alea o. Esi wònye trɔ̃subɔsubɔ ɖe wòma ame aɖewo vevie va se ɖe fifia gɔ̃ hã ta la, ne woɖu nuɖuɖu si wotsɔ sa vɔe na trɔ̃wo la, ewɔna na wo abe ɖe wotsɔe sa vɔe vavã na legba ene, elabe woƒe dzitsinya mesẽ ŋu o.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Menye nuɖuɖue ana míadze Mawu ŋu o. Ne míegbe nane ɖuɖu la, megblẽ naneke le mía ŋuti o. Nenema ke ne míeɖui hã la, medo mí ɖe ŋgɔ le go aɖeke me o.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Ɖeko mikpɔ nyuie, be ablɔɖe si miekpɔ alea la, nagava zu nuɖiaɖia na ame siwo ŋu ŋusẽ mele o la o.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Elabe kasia míkpɔ, ame aɖe, si ƒe dzitsinya mesẽ ŋu o, kpɔ wò, ame si “nya” nu si wɔm nèle, nèle nu ɖum le trɔ̃ƒe! Ɖe wò nuwɔna sia made dzi ƒo na ame gblɔe sia, be eya hã nadi be yeaɖu nuɖuɖu si wotsɔ sa vɔe na legba oa?

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Ale esi nèwɔ vɔ̃ ɖe nɔviwò xɔsetɔwo ŋu, eye nède abi woƒe dzitsinya ŋu, esime wogbɔdzɔ ta la, èwɔ vɔ̃ ɖe Kristo ŋu.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Eya ta nenye be nu si maɖu ana nɔvinye nawɔ nuvɔ̃ la, ekema nyemaɖu lã akpɔ o. Ne menye nenema o la, mava na nɔvinye nawɔ nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye ablɔɖeme menye oa? Ɖe menye amedɔdɔe menye oa? Ɖe nyemekpɔ Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ la oa? Menye miawoe nye dɔ si mewɔ na Aƒetɔ la ƒe dzesi oa?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Ne nyemenye amedɔdɔ kura o hã la, menyee na miawo ya teti, elabe miawoe nye kpeɖodzinu be Aƒetɔ la ƒe amedɔdɔe menye vavã.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Ɖe medze be woana nuɖuɖu kple nunono mí oa?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Ɖe míekpɔ mɔ akplɔ srɔ̃nyɔnu ɖe ŋuti azɔ mɔe abe ale si amedɔdɔ bubuawo, Aƒetɔ la nɔviwo kple Kefas hã wɔnɛ ene oa?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Alo nye kple Barnaba ɖeɖe koe wòle be míawɔ dɔ kokoko akpɔ mía ɖokui dzia?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Asrafo kae wɔa aʋa gaxea fe na eɖokui? Ame kae dea waingble, eye meɖua kutsetseawo ƒe ɖeke o? Alo ame kae kpɔa lãha dzi, ke eya ŋutɔ menoa notsia ƒe ɖe o?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe Mose ƒe se la hã me be: “Mègabla nu na nyitsu si le mɔli dugum la o.” Nyitsu tɔe le vevie na Mawu loo,

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: alo míaƒe nya boŋ wònye gblɔm wòle? Míawo tae wòŋlɔe da ɖi ɖo, elabe ele be ame si de agblea kple ame si ŋe nukua la katã nanɔ mɔ kpɔm, be yewo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe le nuku si yewoŋe la ƒe ɖe ɖu ge.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Ne míeƒã gbɔgbɔmenukuwo ɖe mia me, eye emegbe míeva kpɔ gome le xexemenu siwo su mia si me la, ɖe míeba mia?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Ne miena ame bubuwo kpɔ gome sia ƒomevi la, ɖe mele be míawo boŋ míakpɔe geɖe wu oa? Togbɔ be wòle alea hã la, míewɔ ŋusẽ sia ŋudɔ o, ke boŋ míetsɔa nu sia nu kpoo, elabe míedi be míatsɔ naneke axe mɔ na Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la o.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Ɖe mienyae be ame siwo wɔa dɔ le gbedoxɔ me la, gbedoxɔ mee wokpɔa woƒe nuɖuɖu tsonɛ oa? Gawu la, menye lã si wotsɔ sa vɔe le vɔsamlekpui dzi la ƒe ɖe kee ame siwo subɔna le afi ma la ɖuna oa?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Alea kee Aƒetɔ la ɖoe, be ame siwo ɖea gbeƒã Nyanyuia la hã nakpɔ woƒe gbe sia gbe nuhiahiãwo tso Nyanyui la gbɔgblɔ me.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mekpɔ mɔ awɔ ŋusẽ siawo ŋudɔ hã la, nyemewɔ ɖeke ŋudɔ o, eye nyemele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na mi be mabia nu si nye tɔnye gome la hã tso mia si o. Madi be maku boŋ wu be ame aɖe natsɔ nu si dzi mele dàdam ɖo la awɔ nu tsɛe.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Nyemekpɔ mɔ anɔ dàdam be meɖea gbeƒã Nyanyui la o. Ɖe woɖe gbe nam be magblɔe kokoko. Ne mekatsɛ gbe Nyanyui la gbɔgblɔ la, baba nam!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe esia tso nye ŋutɔ nye didi me la, anye ne fetu anɔ eme nam. Ke menye nye ŋutɔe le egblɔm le ɖokuinye si o; dɔdeasi wònye nam be mawɔ.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Azɔ fetu kae le eme nam? Eya koe nye be magblɔ Nyanyui la fetumaxɔe, eye nyemawɔ ŋusẽ si dzem le eme la hã ŋudɔ na ɖokuinye o.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mevo keŋ eye mele ɖokuinye si hã la, metsɔ ɖokuinye wɔ kluvi na ame sia ame, bene nye asi nate ŋu asu ame geɖe dzi ne woatrɔ dzime.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: Ne mele Yudatɔwo dome la, mewɔa ɖokuinye Yudatɔe, be maɖe woamawo. Togbɔ be nye ŋutɔ nyemele sea te o hã la, ne mele ame siwo le sea te dome la, mewɔa ɖokuinye abe ame si le sea te ene, be maɖe ame siwo le sea te la hã.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne mele ame siwo mele sea te o dome la, mewɔa ɖokuinye wo dometɔ ɖekae, bene maɖe woawo hã. Esia mefia be nyemewɔa Mawu ƒe se dzi o, ke boŋ be Kristo ƒe se la tee mele.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Ne mele ame beliwo dome la, mewɔa ɖokuinye ame belii be maɖe wo. Mezu nu sia nu ƒomevi na ame sia ame ƒomevi, be ale ke kee wòanɔ hã la, maɖe wo dometɔ aɖewo godoo.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Nyanyui la tae mewɔa nu siawo katã ɖo, be makpɔ gome le yayra si le eme la me.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Mienyae be, ne duɖimekelawo le du ƒum la, wo dome ame sia ame ƒua dua ya, ke ame ɖeka koe xɔa dziɖuɖununana la. Eya ta miƒu dua nyuie, ne miaxɔ nunana la.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Duɖimekela ɖe sia ɖe ɖua eɖokui dzi le nu sia nu me. Ewɔa esia be yeaxɔ dziɖuɖudzesi si gblẽna la. Ke míawo ya la, dziɖuɖudzesi si megblẽna gbeɖegbeɖe o la nyam míele.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Eya ta nye ya nyemeƒua du glɔmɔglɔmɔ o. Nenema ke nyemedaa kɔ ɖe ya me hã o,

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: ke boŋ mewɔa funyafunya nye ŋutilã, heɖua edzi. Ne nyemewɔe alea o la, maɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la na amewo vɔ, ke nye ŋutɔ ya la, womakpɔ ŋudzedze le ŋunye o.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, medi be mianya be mía tɔgbuiwo katã nɔ alilikpo la te, eye wo katã woto Aƒlaƒu la me do.

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Ale wole mawutsi na wo le alilikpo la kple ƒu la me, eye wozu Mose yomedzelawo.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Wo katã woɖu gbɔgbɔmenuɖuɖu ma ke,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: gaheno gbɔgbɔmenunono ma ke. Gbɔgbɔmegakpe si nɔ zɔzɔm kpli wo la me tsie wono. Agakpe siae nye Kristo.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Ke mía tɔgbuiwo dome ame aɖewo ƒe nu medze Mawu ŋu o, eya ta wotsrɔ̃ le gbea dzi.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Nu siawo zu kpɔdzidze le nya gbem na mí, bene míawo hã míagawɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi abe woawo ene o.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Migasubɔ trɔ̃, abe ale si wo dometɔ aɖewo wɔ la ene o. Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Dukɔ la va ɖi anyi be yeaɖu ŋkekenyui, ke esia va trɔ zu ahamunuwɔwɔ kple ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeɖuɖu.”

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Amewo gblɔna be: “Woɖe mɔ be míawɔ nu sia nu”, ke menye nu sia nue nyo na ame o. “Woɖe mɔ be míawɔ nu sia nu”, ke menye nu sia nue doa ame ɖe ŋgɔgbe o.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Migana míate Aƒetɔ la kpɔ, abe ale si wo dometɔ aɖewo tee kpɔ, eye dawo tsrɔ̃ wo la ene o.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Migalĩ liʋiliʋĩ, abe ale si wo dometɔ aɖewo lĩi, eye nugblẽla va tsrɔ̃ wo gbidii la ene o.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Nu siawo va dzɔ ɖe wo dzi abe kpɔdzidze ene. Woŋlɔ wo da ɖi, be mí ame siwo le agbe le ɣeyiɣi mamlɛ siawo me la, míasrɔ̃ nu tso wo me.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Le esia ta la, ame si susu be yele tsitre la, nekpɔ nyuie ne magadze anyi o.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Ale si wotea amegbetɔ bubuwo kpɔnae la, nenema ke ko wotea miawo hã kpɔnae. Ke Mawu wɔa eƒe nya dzi, eya ta mele mɔ ɖe ge be woate mi akpɔ wòawú ale si miate ŋu atsɔ la o. Afia mɔ si miato ado le eme la mi, bene miate ŋu aɖu tetekpɔa dzi.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, mitsri trɔ̃subɔsubɔ.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Mele nu ƒom na mi abe ame nyanuwo ene. Miawo ŋutɔ mida nya si gblɔm mele na mi la kpɔ!

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Ne míeno nu le kplu si dzi mí katã míebia yayra ɖo nu la, ekema míekpɔa gome le Kristo ƒe ʋu la me. Nenema ke ne míema aboloa na mi míeɖu la, ekema míekpɔa gome le Kristo ƒe ŋutilã me.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be miesɔ gbɔ hã la, esi wònye abolo ɖeka ko ŋudɔ míewɔna ta, mí katã míezu ŋutilã ɖeka.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ Israelviwo ɖa! Ame siwo ɖua nu siwo wotsɔ sa vɔe la, ɖe menye Mawu subɔm woawo hã wole le vɔsamlekpuia ŋgɔ oa?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta mele nya siawo gblɔm ɖo? Ɖe mele gbɔgblɔm be lã si wotsɔ sa vɔe na trɔ̃, alo trɔ̃ la ŋutɔ nye nu vavã aɖe loo?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Kpao, menye nenema gblɔm mele o. Nya si gblɔm mele lae nye be nu si trɔ̃subɔlawo tsɔ sa vɔe la, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃woe wotsɔe sa vɔe na, ke menye na Mawu o. Nyemedi be miade ha kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo o.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Miate ŋu anɔ nu nom le Aƒetɔ la ƒe kplu nu, aganɔ enom le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo hã tɔ nu o. Nenema ke miate ŋu anɔ nu ɖum le Aƒetɔ la ƒe kplɔ̃ ŋuti, aganɔ eɖum le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo hã tɔ ŋuti o.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Ɖe míele didim be Aƒetɔ la nado dziku, aʋã ŋua? Ɖe míesesẽ wu eyamaa?

english_verse: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke negadi eya ŋutɔ ɖokui tɔ o, ke boŋ nedi ehavi ƒe nyui.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Lã sia lã si wole dzadzram le asi me la, miɖui faa. Migana miaƒe dzitsinya naɖe fu na mi, mianɔ egɔme biam o.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Elabe mawunya gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ la tɔe nye xexea me kple nu sia nu si le eme la.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe, si menye xɔsetɔ o, kpe mi be miva ɖu nu kple ye, eye mielɔ̃ yi la, miɖu nu sia nu si wòtsɔ ɖo mia kɔme la faa, eye migana miaƒe dzitsinya naɖe fu na mi mianɔ egɔme biam o.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Menye wò ŋutɔ wò dzitsinyae mewɔnɛ o, ke boŋ ame la tɔe mewɔnɛ. Ame aɖe abia be, “Nu ka ta wòle be ame bubu ƒe dzitsinya naxe mɔ na nu si nye ya mekpɔ mɔ awɔ laa?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Ne meda akpe na Mawu ɖe nye nuɖuɖu ta la, ale ke wɔ woagabu fɔm ɖe nu si ta meda akpe ɖo laa?”

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Ale ne miele nu ɖum, alo miele nu nom, alo miele nu bubu ɖe sia ɖe wɔm la, miwɔ wo be miatsɔ ade bubu Mawu ŋui.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Migana miaƒe nuwɔna aɖeke naɖia Yudatɔwo, Helatɔwo alo Mawu ƒe hame la nu o.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nye nuwɔna miawɔ abe ale si nye hã mekpɔa Kristo tɔ wɔna la ene. Nutsyɔtsyɔ ta le sɔleme

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Mekafu mi, elabe mieɖo ŋku dzinye le nu sia nu me, eye gawu la, mielé kɔnu siwo meɖo anyi na mi la me ɖe asi, abe ale si mefia mi la ene.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Ke medi be eme nakɔ na mi be Kristoe nye ŋutsu sia ŋutsu ƒe tatɔ; srɔ̃ŋutsue nye srɔ̃nyɔnu ƒe tatɔ, eye Mawue nye Kristo ƒe tatɔ.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu si tsyɔa nu ta hafi doa gbe ɖa, alo ɖea gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la, mede bubu eƒe tatɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnu si metsyɔa nu ta hafi doa gbe ɖa, alo ɖea gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi o la, mede bubu eƒe tatɔ ŋu o. Ele ko abe ɖe wòlũ ta ene.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Nenye be nyɔnu matsyɔ nu ta o la, ke nelũ ta boŋ! Ke nenye be wònye ŋukpe nɛ be wòalũ ta la, ekema netsyɔ nu ta.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ya la, mele be wòatsyɔ nu ta o, elabe eyae nye ame si ɖea Mawu ƒe dzedzeme kple ŋutikɔkɔe fiana, eye nyɔnu ya ɖea ŋutsu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe fiana.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Menye ŋutsue woɖe tso nyɔnu me o, ke boŋ nyɔnue woɖe tso ŋutsu me.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Gawu la, womewɔ ŋutsu ɖe nyɔnu ta o, ke nyɔnue wowɔ ɖe ŋutsu ta.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Esia ta, le mawudɔlawo ta la, ele be nyɔnu natsyɔ nu ta atsɔ afia be yele ye srɔ̃ ƒe ŋusẽ te.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Elabe abe ale si woɖe nyɔnu tso ŋutsu mee ene la, nenemae nyɔnu hã dzi ŋutsui. Eme kɔ be ɖe woɖe nyɔnu tso ŋutsu me, ke nyɔnue dzia ŋutsu. Mawu gbɔe nu sia nu tso.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔ mibu eŋu kpɔ. Esɔ be nyɔnu naɖe nu le ta hafi ado gbe ɖaa?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: Evɔ ne nyɔnu ya ɖo ɖa la, atsyɔ̃nu wònye nɛ. Elabe ɖe wonae be wòatsɔ aɖo atsyɔ̃e.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Ke ne ame aɖe di be yeaʋli nya sia la, medi be wòanya be nyemelɔ̃ ɖe wɔna bubu aɖeke dzi wu esia o. Nenema ke Mawu ƒe hameawo hã melɔ̃ ɖe bubu aɖeke dzi o. Aƒetɔ la ƒe nuɖuɖu kɔkɔe la (Mat

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Le nuxlɔ̃amenya siwo gbɔna me ya la, nyemakafu mi o. Nu si tae la nye be ne miekpe ta be yewoasubɔ Mawu la, nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo yia edzi le mia dome la sɔ gbɔ wu nu nyuiwo.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Gbã la, mese be ne miekpe ta la, memama le mia dome. Mexɔ nya sia dzi se le go aɖe me,

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: elabe ele be memama nanɔ mia dome godoo, ale be ame siwo nye nyateƒetɔwo le mia dome la, nadze ƒãa.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Ne mieva kpe ta la, ame sia ame doa ŋgɔ dzea eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuɖuɖu dzi ɖuna. Ale, esime dɔ le ame aɖewo wum la, ame bubuwo ya mu aha gɔ̃!

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ɣe sia ɣi si mieɖu abolo sia, eye mieno nu le kplu sia nu la, miele gbeƒã ɖem Aƒetɔ la ƒe ku, va se ɖe esime wòagatrɔ ava.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Elabe ame si mebua Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutilã ŋu kpɔna nyuie hafi ɖua aboloa, eye wònoa nu le kplu la nu o la, nu si wòɖu kple nu si wòno la, hea ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ vaa edzi.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Esi woɖu nua vɔ la, etsɔ kplu la hã hegblɔ be: “Kplu siae nye nubabla yeye, si dzi woɖo kpee kple nye ʋu. Ɣe sia ɣi si mieno nu le enu la, miaɖo ŋku dzinye.”
