english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Nu si Aƒetɔ la fiam la, eyae nye hã mele mia fiam. Le zã, si me wode Yesu asi la, etsɔ abolo.

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Esi wòda akpe le eta vɔ la, eŋe eme hegblɔ be: “Nye ŋutilãe nye esia. Mia tɔe. Miwɔ nu sia ne miatsɔe aɖo ŋku dzinyee.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Ale ame sia ame si ɖua abolo sia, alo noa nu le Aƒetɔ la ƒe kplu sia nu le mɔ madzemadze nu la, eɖi fɔ, elabe ewɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutilã kple ʋu ŋu.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame nedzro eɖokui me kpɔ nyuie hafi wòaɖu abolo sia, eye wòano nu le kplu sia nu.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Nuwɔna sia tae mia dome ame geɖe ƒe lã me gbɔdzɔ, ɖewo le dɔ lém, eye ɖewo hã ku.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe míedzro mía ɖokui me kpɔ nyuie la, ekema womadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mí o.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Ke ne Aƒetɔ la drɔ̃ ʋɔnu mí la, ekema ele mía ɖɔm ɖo be womagabu fɔ mí kple ame siwo menye xɔsetɔwo o la ɖekae o.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, ne miekpe ta be yewoaɖu nua la, milala mia nɔewo.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Ne dɔ le ame aɖe wum la, neɖu nu le aƒeme. Ne menye nenem o la, woabu fɔ mi. Ne meva ɖo mia gbɔ la, maɖo aɖaŋu na mi le nu siwo susɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: My friends, you asked me about spiritual gifts.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, le gbɔgbɔmenunanawo gome la, nyemedi be naneke naɣla ɖe mi o.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Mienya be esime mienye trɔ̃subɔlawo la, wokplɔ mi trae yi ɖe trɔ̃ siwo meƒoa nu o la gbɔ, eye wowɔ dɔ ɖe mia dzi hã.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Eya ta medi be eme nekɔ na mi be ame si me Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la le la mekea nu gblɔna be: “Neɖi Yesu ŋu kpékpekpe!” o, eye ame si me Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la le la koe ate ŋu agblɔ be, “Yesue nye Aƒetɔ!”

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Nunana vovovowo li, ke Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka ma koe naa nuawo.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Subɔsubɔdɔ vovovowo li, ke Aƒetɔ ɖeka ma koe míesubɔna.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Dɔwɔna ƒomevi geɖewo li, ke Mawu ɖeka ma koe doa ŋusẽ amewo wowɔa wo katã.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Woɖea Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe dɔwɔna ɖe go le ame sia ame me be wòaɖe vi na amewo katã.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Woto Gbɔgbɔ la dzi na ale si woaƒo nu nunyatɔe la ame aɖe. Gbɔgbɔ ma ke nana be ame bubu nyaa ale si wòaƒo nu tso nu si wòdze sii la ŋu, be amewo nate ŋu ase egɔme.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Eya kee tsɔa xɔse naa ame aɖe, eye wònaa ŋusẽ ame bubu ya be wòada gbe le ame ŋu.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la kee naa ŋusẽ ame bubu be wòawɔ nukunuwo. Eganaa ŋusẽ ame bubu hã be wòaɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi, ke enaa ŋusẽ ame bubu ya be wòanya vovototo le gbɔgbɔ vovovowo dome. Gbɔgbɔ la kee naa ŋusẽ ame bubu be wòagblɔ gbe vovovowo, eye wònaa ŋusẽ ame bubu ya be wòaɖe gbe vovovowo gɔme.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka ma koe wɔa dɔ siawo katã, eye wòmaa nunanawo na ame sia ame ɖekaɖekae, abe ale si dze eŋu la ene. Ameti la kple ŋutinu vovovoawo

english_verse: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe ameti la le ɖeka, ke ŋutinu geɖewo le eŋu. Ŋutinu vovovo siawo le ameti ɖeka ma ko ŋu. Alea tututu Kristo hã le.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Woto Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka me wɔ mí katã ameti ɖekae. Eɖanye Yudatɔ alo Helatɔ o; eɖanye kluvi alo ablɔɖevi o, mawutsi ɖeka ma ko wole na mí katã, eye wotsɔ Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka ma ƒe tsi kpe na mí katã míeno.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Ŋutinu ɖeka mewɔa ame o, ke boŋ ŋutinu geɖewoe le ame blibo la ŋu.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Ne afɔ agblɔ be: “Esi nyemenye asi o ta la, nyemenye ameti la ƒe akpa aɖeke o” la, nya sia maɖee ɖa le ameti la ŋu o.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne to agblɔ be: “Esi nyemenye ŋku o ta la, nyemenye ameti la ƒe akpa aɖeke o” la, nya sia maɖee ɖa le ameti la ŋu o.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Ne ŋku ɖeɖee nye ameti bliboa la, ale ke wòawɔ ase nu? Ne to ɖeɖee nye ameti bliboa la, ale ke wòawɔ ase nu ƒe ʋeʋẽ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ɖo ŋutinuawo katã ɖe wo teƒe ɖekaɖeka le ameti la ŋu, abe ale si wòdi la ene.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutinu ɖeka dzaa ko nye ameti bliboa katã la, ale ke ameti blibo la anɔ?

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Ŋku mate ŋu agblɔ na asi be: “Nyemehiã wò o” o. Alo ta nagblɔ na afɔ be: “Mèle vevie nam o!”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Le go bubu me la, ŋutinu siwo dzéna abe ŋusẽ aɖeke ɖe mele wo ŋu o ene la boŋ ŋudɔ míewɔna wu.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Nenema ke ŋutinu siwo dzéna abe bubu ɖe mele wo ŋu o ene la ŋue míedea bubui wu. Esiwo menyakpɔna o lae míeɖoa atsyɔ̃ tɔxɛ na,

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: eye míegblẽa akpa siwo nyakpɔna ya ɖi. Ke Mawu trɔ asi le ameti la ŋu ale gbegbe be wòna bubu tɔxɛ akpa siwo le beli la wu.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Ewɔ esia bene memama naganɔ ŋutinuawo dome o, ke boŋ be ɖe sia ɖe natsɔ beléle ma ke na nɔvia.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutinu ɖeka se veve la, mamlɛawo katã sea veve kplii. Nenema ke ne wode bubu wo dometɔ ɖeka ŋu la, bubuawo katã kpɔa dzidzɔ kplii.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Kristo ƒe ametie mi katã mienye, eye mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nye eƒe ŋutinu vovovoawo dometɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖo amewo ɖe hamea me ale: Gbã amedɔdɔawo, evelia Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo, etɔ̃lia nufialawo; emegbe nukunuwɔlawo, gbedalawo, kpeɖeŋutɔwo, kplɔlawo kple gbe vovovowo gblɔlawo.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Menye ame sia amee nye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela o ɖe? Menye ame sia amee nye nufiala o ɖe? Menye ame sia amee nye nukunuwɔla o ɖe?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Menye ame sia amee wona dɔyɔyɔ ƒe ŋusẽe o ɖe? Menye ame sia amee te ŋu gblɔa gbe vovovowo o ɖe? Menye ame sia amee te ŋu ɖea gbegbɔgblɔwo gɔme o ɖe?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Miti amenuvevenunana siwo kɔ wu la yome. Fifia la, mafia nu si ƒo ɖe sia ɖe ta la mi.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe megblɔa gbe siwo katã amegbetɔwo kple mawudɔlawo gɔ̃ hã gblɔna, ke lɔlɔ̃ mele asinye o la, ekema nye nuƒoƒo le ko abe gakogoe alo ayawagba siwo ƒe ɖiɖi vea to me la ene.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe mete ŋu ɖea gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi eye mese nya ɣaɣlawo katã gɔme, henya nu sia nu; alo ne xɔse deblibo le asinye, ale be mate ŋu aho towo gɔ̃ hã ɖa, ke lɔlɔ̃ mele asinye o la, ekema nyemenye naneke kura o.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Ne metsɔ nu siwo katã le asinye la na amewo, eye mena wotɔ dzom gɔ̃ agbagbee, ke lɔlɔ̃ mehele asinye o la, mewɔ dɔ vlo.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ mewɔa ŋukpenanu o, eye media eɖokui tɔ o. Medoa dziku kabakaba, alo léa vɔ̃ si wowɔ ɖe eŋu la ɖe dɔme o.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Mekpɔa dzidzɔ le nu madzɔmadzɔ ŋuti o, ke nu si nye nyateƒe la ŋutie wòkpɔa dzidzɔ le.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ nu metsina gbeɖe o. Ne amewo le gbeƒã ɖem Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la, enu ava yi. Ne ame aɖe ƒoa nu gblɔa gbe vovovowo la, ava dzudzɔ. Ne ame aɖe nya nu ʋuu hã la, eƒe nunya nu ava yi.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Míaƒe nunya kple gbeƒãɖeɖe Mawu ƒe gbedeasi mede blibo o.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Ne nu si de blibo la ŋutɔ va ɖo la, ekema nu siwo mede blibo o la, nu ava yi.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Esi menɔ ɖevime la, meƒoa nu abe ɖevi ene, mebua tame abe ɖevi ene, eye mesea nu gɔme abe ɖevi ene. Ke esi metsi zu ŋutsu la, meɖe asi le ɖevimenuwɔna ŋu.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Fifia la, míele nu kpɔm le ahũhɔ̃e me flukpee ko, ke emegbe la, míava kpɔ nu ŋkume kple ŋkume. Nu si menya fifia la, mede blibo o, ke emegbe la, mase nu sia nu gɔme keŋkeŋ, abe ale si Mawu hã nyam keŋkeŋ ene.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Ale nu etɔ̃e li. Woawoe nye: xɔse, mɔkpɔkpɔ kple lɔlɔ̃. Ke wo dome vevitɔe nye lɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Mina lɔlɔ̃ nanye miaƒe taɖodzinu, ke midi gbɔgbɔmenunana bubuwo hã, vevietɔ be miate ŋu aɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ƒoa nu ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o me la, eƒoa nu na Mawu ɖeɖe ko, ke menye na amewo o, elabe ame aɖeke mesea nya si gblɔm wòle la gɔme nɛ o, togbɔ be nya siwo ɣla ɖe Gbɔgbɔ la me la ŋue wòƒoa nu tsoe hafi.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Ke ame si ɖea gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi ya ƒoa nu na amewo bene woatsi ɖe edzi. Edea dzi ƒo na wo hefaa akɔ na wo.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒoa nu ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o me la, kpena ɖe eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ko ŋu, ke ame si ɖea gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi ya kpena ɖe hame blibo la ŋu.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nenye be meva mia gbɔ hele nu ƒom ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o me la, esia aɖe vi aɖe na mia? Ke nenye be mehe nyaɖeɖefia aɖe, alo nunya aɖe, alo Mawu ƒe gbedeasi aɖe, alo nufiafia aɖe ya vɛ la, nye vava aɖe vi godoo.

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Ne aʋayikpẽ maɖi eme nakɔ o la, ame ka adzra eɖokui ɖo be yeayi aʋagbedzi?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Nenema tututue miawo hã miewɔna: ne miele gbe si ke me ame aɖeke mese o la dom nyamanyama, eye nyaawo hã me meɖe nyuie o ɖe, ale ke ame aɖe ate ŋu anya nu si gblɔm miele la? Nu ko wònye minɔa ƒoƒom ɖe ya me dzro.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Ke ne nyemese gbe aɖe o la, manye fiafiala le gbe ma gblɔla gbɔ, eye eya hã anye fiafiala le gbɔnye.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Le miawo hã gome la, esi wònye ɖe mietsi dzi ɖe gbɔgbɔ la ƒe nunanawo ŋu ta la, mido vevie nu le esiwo ana be hamea natsi ɖe edzi la me.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Ale ame si ƒoa nu ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o me la, nedo gbe ɖa be woana yeate ŋu aɖe egɔme hã.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ne medoa gbe ɖa ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o me la, ekema nye gbɔgbɔ koe nye ema le gbea dom ɖa, ke nye susu ya mekpɔ viɖe aɖeke o.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Azɔ, nu ka wòle be mawɔ? Mado gbe ɖa kple nye gbɔgbɔ kpakple susu siaa. Madzi ha kple nye gbɔgbɔ kpakple nye susu hã.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Ne menye nenem o la, ne èda akpe na Mawu le gbɔgbɔ me ɖeɖe ko la, ale ke ame si menya nu si nègblɔ o la lawɔ alɔ̃ “Amen” ɖe wò akpedada la dzi, esime mese nu si gblɔm nèle la gɔme o mahã?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Eme kɔ be ɖewohĩ ànyada akpe nyuie tà, ke meɖe vi na ame bubu aɖeke o.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawu be meƒoa nu ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o la me wu mi katã.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Gake le sɔleme la, enyo nam sãa be magblɔ nya atɔ̃ ɖeɖe ko kple nye susu atsɔ afia nu amewoe, wu be magblɔ nya akpe ewo ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o la me.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, miganɔ tame bum abe ɖeviwo ene o. Le nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me la, minɔ abe vidzĩwo ene baa, ke mibu tame ya abe ame tsitsiwo ene.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe segbalẽa me be: “Maƒo nu na dukɔ sia to gbe bubu gblɔlawo kple amedzrowo dzi, ke ema gɔ̃ hã mana woaɖo tom o. Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Ale nuƒoƒo ɖe gbe si ame aɖeke mese o la me nye nu tɔxɛ le ame siwo menye xɔsetɔwo o la gbɔ, ke menye le xɔsetɔwo gbɔ o. Evɔ la, gbeƒãɖeɖe Mawu ƒe gbedeasi ya nye xɔsetɔwo ƒe nuwɔna, ke menye ame siwo menye xɔsetɔwo o la tɔ o.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Eya ta nenye be hame bliboa va kpe ta, eye wole nu ƒom ɖe gbe si ke ame aɖeke mese o me la, ne ame siwo mele hamea me o, alo ame siwo menye xɔsetɔwo o la va ge ɖe eme la, ɖe womagblɔ be miedze aɖaʋa oa?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Ke ne mi katã miele gbeƒã ɖem Mawu ƒe gbedeasi, eye ame si mele hamea me o, alo menye xɔsetɔ o la va ge ɖe eme la, ase nya aɖe godoo wòawɔ dɔ ɖe edzi, eye wòayi eɖokui me. Atsɔ nya si wòse la adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eɖokui,

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: eye nu siwo wòɣla ɖe eƒe dzime la, adze go. Atsyɔ mo anyi asubɔ Mawu agblɔ be: “Nyateƒee, Mawu le mia dome.” Ɖoɖowo na hame la

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, azɔ nu ka wòle be míawɔ? Ne mieva kpe ta be yewoasubɔ Mawu la, anɔ eme be hadzidzi aɖe, nufiamenya aɖe, nyaɖeɖefia aɖe, nuƒoƒo ɖe gbe si ame aɖeke mese o la me, alo nyagɔmeɖeɖe anɔ ame aɖe si. Mikpɔ egbɔ be nu sia nu si yewowɔ la na hamea tsi ɖe edzi.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Ame eve, alo ne ede ƒãa la, ame etɔ̃ ko naƒo nu ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ bubuwo me. Ame ɖeka naƒo nu vɔ hafi nɔvia naƒoe, eye ame aɖe naɖe nu si gblɔm wole la gɔme.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Ne gbesela aɖeke meli o la, ekema wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nazi ɖoɖoe le takpeƒe la. Neƒo nu na eya ŋutɔ ɖokui kple Mawu ko.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela eve alo etɔ̃ naƒo nu, eye nyaselawo nada woƒe nyawo kpɔ.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Nenye be woɖe nane fia ame aɖe, si hã le takpekpea me la, ekema ame si le nu ƒom la naɖo to gbɔ.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Mɔɖeɖe li be mi katã miaɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi, ame ɖeka neƒo nu vɔ hafi nɔvia naƒoe, bene ame sia ame nate ŋu asrɔ̃ nane, ale be nu si wòse la, nado ŋusẽe.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ si nana be ame ɖea gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la le amea ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ te.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu melɔ̃a nuwɔna si mele ɖoɖo nu la o, ke boŋ ŋutifafae wòdina. Abe ale si wòle le ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ ƒe hameawo katã me ene la,

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: ele be nyɔnuwo nazi ɖoɖoe le hametakpekpewo me. Womeɖe mɔ na wo be woaƒo nu o. Abe ale si segbalẽ la gblɔe ene la, ele be woabɔbɔ wo ɖokui.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Ne wodi be yewoanya nane la, wonebia wo srɔ̃wo le aƒeme, elabe enye ŋukpenanu be nyɔnu naƒo nu le sɔleme.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Nu ka! Menye mia gbɔe mawunya la tso va o, eye gawu la, menye miawo ɖeɖe koe xɔe hã o.

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe bu be yenye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela, alo gbɔgbɔmeme la, ekema ele be wòanya be nu siwo ŋlɔm mele na mi la, Aƒetɔ la ƒe sededewo wonye.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe metsɔ ɖe le eme o la, migatsɔ ɖe le eme na eya hã o.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, nenye miaƒe didi vevie be yewoaɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la, ke migaxe mɔ na ame si gblɔa gbe aɖe, si gɔme ame aɖeke mesena o la o.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ bubu wɔ nu sia nu ɖe ɖoɖo nu.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nɔvinyewo, medi be maɖo ŋku Nyanyui, si metsɔ vɛ miexɔ, hele tsitre ɖe edzi sesĩe la dzi na mi.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Ne mielé eme ɖe asi sesĩe la, woaxɔ mi ɖe agbe. Ne menye nenem o la, ekema ɖeko miexɔe se dzodzro.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Nu vevitɔ si wofiam, eye nye hã mefia mi lae nye be: Kristo ku ɖe míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta, abe ale si mawunya gblɔe ene.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Woɖii, eye le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la, wofɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome le mawunya nu.

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: Eɖe eɖokui fia Kefas, emegbe la, ame wui eveawo kpɔe.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Ema yome la, nɔvi siwo ƒe xexlẽme wu alafa atɔ̃ sɔŋ kpɔe zi ɖeka. Togbɔ be nɔvi siawo dometɔ geɖe ku hã la, wo dome akpa gãtɔ gale agbe.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Emegbe Yakobo kpɔe, eye amedɔdɔwo katã hã kpɔe.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nye, ame si le abe vidzĩ si ƒe ŋkeke mede hafi wodzii o ene la hã, mekpɔe.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, nyee nye suetɔ kekeake le amedɔdɔawo dome. Nyemedze be woayɔm be amedɔdɔ gɔ̃ hã hafi o, elabe meti Mawu ƒe hame la yome.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu ve nunye meva zu nu si menye, eye ale si wòve nunyee la, mezu dzodzro o. Ke boŋ meva wɔ dɔ wu amedɔdɔawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe. Le nyateƒe me la, menye nye ŋutɔe wɔ dɔa o, Mawue ve nunye.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Eya ta eɖanye nyee o, woawoe o, gbeƒã ma ko ɖem míele, eye eya dzie miexɔ se. Míaƒe tsitretsitsi tso ame kukuwo dome

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Azɔ ne míeɖe gbeƒã be wofɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la, ale ke wɔ mia dometɔ aɖewo gale gbɔgblɔm be womele ame kukuwo fɔ ge ɖe tsitre o mahã?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ne ame kuku metsia tsitre o la, ekema womefɔ Kristo hã ɖe tsitre o.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Ne womefɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre o la, ekema míaƒe gbeƒãɖeɖe nye nu dzodzro, eye miawo hã miaƒe xɔse nye nu dzodzro ko.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Ne enye nyateƒe be ame kuku metsia tsitre o, eye míawo míeɖi ɖase be Mawu fɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre, evɔ wòhenye mefɔe ɖe tsitre hafi o la, ekema míeka aʋatso ɖe Mawu si.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe womefɔa ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre o la, ekema womefɔ Kristo hã o.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Ne womefɔ Kristo o la, ekema miaƒe xɔse zu nu gbɔlo, eye miegale miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me ko.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Gawu la, ame siwo xɔ Kristo dzi se hafi ku la hã tsrɔ̃.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Nenye be agbe sia me ɖeɖe koe míele mɔ kpɔm na Kristo le la, ekema míawoe nye ame siwo ƒe nu wɔ nublanui wu le amegbetɔwo katã dome.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ke nyateƒe wònye be wofɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye eyae nye ame si fɔ do ŋgɔ na ame kukuwo katã.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Abe ale si ku to ame ɖeka dzi va xexeme ene la, nenema ke ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi hã to ame ɖeka dzi vae.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Abe ale si amewo katã ku to Adam dzi ene la, nenema ke to Kristo dzi amewo katã agagbɔ agbe.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Ke woafɔ ame sia ame ɖe tsitre le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoɖo nu. Kristo ye wofɔ gbã. Emegbe ne egbugbɔ va la, woafɔ ame siwo nye Kristo tɔ la hã.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Ekema nuwuwu la aɖo, eye wòagbugbɔ fiaɖuƒe la ana Mawu Tɔ́ la. Do ŋgɔ la, Kristo atsrɔ̃ dziɖulawo, amegbetɔwo ƒe ŋusẽwo kple gbɔgbɔmeŋusẽ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Elabe ele be Kristo naɖu dzi, va se ɖe esime Mawu natsɔ eƒe futɔwo katã ade eya, Kristo, ƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Kue nye futɔ mamlɛtɔ si tsrɔ̃ ge wòala.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be: “Etsɔ nuwo katã de eƒe afɔ te.” Ne wogblɔ be “nuwo katã” la, eme kɔ ƒãa be Mawu, ame si ŋutɔ tsɔ nuawo de Kristo ƒe afɔ te la ya, mele eme o.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne wotsɔ nuwo katã de Kristo ƒe dziɖuɖu te vɔ la, ekema woabɔbɔ Vi la ŋutɔ hã ɖe Mawu, ame si tsɔ nuwo katã de ete la te, ale be Mawu ɖeka ko naɖu nu sia nu dzi.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Ɖe mele nenema o la, ekema nu ka tae amewo nana be wolea mawutsi na wo ɖe ame kukuwo nu ɖo? Ne womele ame kukuwo fɔ ge ɖe tsitre kura o la, nu ka tae woanɔ tsi lem na amewo ɖe wo nu?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Nu ka tae míaƒe agbe le xaxa me ɣe sia ɣi?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, metà ale si medana ɖe mia dzi be míewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu mía Aƒetɔ la na mi, be ku tsɔ ɖe gbɔnye kpuie gbe sia gbe.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Nenye be le amegbetɔ ƒe nuƒo nu, mewɔ avu kple “lã wɔadãwo” le Efeso la, viɖe kae le eme nam? Ne womele ame kukuwo fɔ ge ɖe tsitre o la, ekema nya si wogblɔna be: “Mina míaɖu nu, ano nu, elabe etsɔ ko míele kuku ge!” la, le eteƒe.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Migbugbɔ tame bu nyuie, ne miadzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ. Mele esia gblɔm be ŋu nakpe mi, elabe ame aɖewo le mia dome, siwo menya naneke tso Mawu ŋu o. Ale si ame kukuwo le tsitre tsi gee

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ke ame aɖe abia be, ale ke wole ame kukuwo fɔ ge ɖe tsitree, eye ŋutilã ka ƒomevi me nɔ ge woala mahã?

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Wò movitɔ! Ɖe mènyae be nuku si nèƒã la, megagbɔa agbe o, negbe ɖe wòku hafi oa?

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: Menye nu si le tsitsi ge la ƒomevie nèƒãna o, ke boŋ eƒe ku sue aɖe, abe bliku alo ati bubu aɖe ƒe ku enee.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Mawue tsɔa nɔnɔme si wòlɔ̃ la na ku si woƒã la; nuku ƒomevi ɖe sia ɖe kple ale si wòava nɔ le eƒe tsitsime lae li.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Ŋutilãwo katã mesɔ o; amegbetɔ ƒe ŋutilã li, nenema ke lãfɔnewo, xewo kple tɔmelãwo hã tɔ li, ɖe sia ɖe kple etɔ.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Dziƒonuwo ƒe ŋutilã li, eye anyigbadzinuwo tɔ hã li. Ke dziƒonuwo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple ale si wonyakpɔnae la, to vovo tso anyigbadzinuwo tɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Alea pɛ ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi hã lanɔ. Ne woɖi ŋutilã ɖe to me la, egblẽna, ke ne wofɔe ɖe tsitre la, magagblẽ o.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Woɖia ŋutilã si dzena míekpɔna la ɖe to me, ke ne wofɔe ɖe tsitre la, anye gbɔgbɔmeŋutilã. Ne gotagomeŋutilã li la, ekema gbɔgbɔmeŋutilã hã li.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Esia tae mawunya gblɔ be: “Adam si nye ame gbãtɔ la va zu nu gbagbe,” ke Adam mamlɛtɔ va zu gbɔgbɔ si naa agbe.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Menye gbɔgbɔmetɔ lae va gbã o, ke boŋ ŋutilãmetɔ lae, eya megbe hafi gbɔgbɔmetɔ la va.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Anyi mee ame gbãtɔ la tso. Ʋuʋudedi ko wònye, ke ame evelia ya tso dziƒo.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Ame siwo le anyigba dzi la le abe ame siwo woɖe tso anyi me le anyigba me la ene. Nenema ke ame siwo le dziƒo la, le abe ame si tso dziƒo va la ene.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Abe ale si míele ame si tso anyi me la ƒe nɔnɔme me ene la, nenema ke míava nɔ ame si tso dziƒo va la hã ƒe nɔnɔme mee.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nu si gblɔm mele lae nye be ŋutilã kple ʋu mate ŋu akpɔ gome le Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu la me o, eye nu si gblẽna la mate ŋu anyi nu si megblẽna o la ƒe dome o.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ɖa, medi be magblɔ nya ɣaɣla sia na mi. Mí katã míele alɔ̃ dɔ ge o, ke woatrɔ mí katã míaƒe nɔnɔme

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: zi ɖeka ne kpẽ mamlɛtɔ ɖi. Ne kpẽa ɖi la, woafɔ ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre, woazu nu magblemagblẽ, eye Mawu atrɔ míaƒe nɔnɔme.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Elabe ele be woatsɔ nɔnɔme si megblẽna o la, ado na nɔnɔme si gblẽna la, eye woatsɔ nɔnɔme si mekuna o la ado na nɔnɔme si kuna la.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Ke ne wotsɔ nɔnɔme si megblẽna o la do na nɔnɔme si gblẽna, eye wotsɔ nɔnɔme si mekuna o la do na nɔnɔme si kuna la, ekema mawunya sia ava eme be: “Wotsrɔ̃ ku gbidigbidi. Dziɖuɖu blibo do!”

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: “O, ku, wò dziɖuɖu la ɖe? O, ku wò ti la ɖe?”

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Ku ƒe ti nye nuvɔ̃ eye nuvɔ̃ ƒe ŋusẽ nye se la.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Ke akpe na Mawu, ame si na míeɖu dzi to mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, minɔ te sesĩe, eye migaʋã kura o. Mido vevie ne miawɔ Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔ ɖaa. Miɖo ŋui be dɔ siwo katã miewɔna na Aƒetɔa la ƒe ɖeke mezua dɔ vlo gbeɖe o.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Le nudzɔdzɔ na xɔsetɔ bubuwo gome la, miwɔe abe ale si meɖo na hame siwo le Galatia-nutoa me la ene.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Kwasiɖagbe sia Kwasiɖagbe la, ame sia ame neɖe ga home aɖe tso nu si wòkpɔ tso eƒe dɔwɔnawo me la dzra ɖo, ale be mahiã be mava ɖo hafi mianɔ nu dzɔm o.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Ne meva ɖo la, maŋlɔ agbalẽ ade ame siwo miatia la si, be woatsɔ miaƒe nunanawo ayi Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Ne ehiã be nye ŋutɔ mayi la, ekema ameawo azɔ kplim. Paulo ƒe ɖoɖowo

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Mele Makedonia to ge hafi ava ɖo mia gbɔ, elabe meɖoe be mato afi ma gbã.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ manɔ mia gbɔ ʋɛ alo manɔ mia gbɔ le vuvɔŋɔli la gɔ̃ hã, ale be miate ŋu ado mɔm ne maɖo ta afi si wòle be magayi la.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Fifia ya la, nyemedi be magava to mia gbɔ ko atso eme ayi o, ke boŋ ne Aƒetɔ la ɖe mɔ la, mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be matsi mia gbɔ ʋɛ.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mɔnu nyui aɖe be mawɔ dɔ xɔasi aɖe, togbɔ be ame geɖewo tsi tre ɖe ŋunye hã. Ale si woaxɔ Timoteo

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ne Timoteo va ɖo la, mikpɔ gbɔ be eƒe dzi dze me le mia dome, elabe Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔa ko wɔm eya hã le abe nye ke ene.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame aɖeke megakpɔe ame wodzoe o. Mido mɔe be wòatrɔ va ɖo gbɔnye le ŋutifafa me, elabe mele mɔ kpɔm na eya kple nɔviawo.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Le mía nɔvi Apolo ŋuti la, medze agbagba ƒoe ɖe enu vevie, be wòazɔ kple nɔvi bubuawo ava kpɔ mi ɖa hafi, ke medi be yeava fifia o. Ne mɔ ʋu nɛ la, ava emegbea. Nuwunyawo kple gbedoname

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Minɔ ŋudzɔ, eye milé nu si dzi miexɔ se la me ɖe asi sesĩe. Miwɔ kalẽ, eye misẽ ŋu!

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Miwɔ nu sia nu kple lɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nɔvinyewo, mexɔe se be mienya nu tso Stefana kple eƒe aƒe la ŋuti. Woawoe nye ame gbãtɔ, siwo trɔ dzime le Axaya-nutome, eye wotsɔ wo ɖokui ke faa, be yewoasubɔ ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: Mele kuku ɖem na mi be miaɖe mɔ faa be ame siawo tɔgbe kple ame bubu, siwo hã wɔa dɔ le hamea me kple esiwo kua kutri kpena ɖe mia ŋu la, nakplɔ mi.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dzidzɔ be Stefana, Fortunato kple Axaiko va ɖo dedie, elabe wole mia teƒe le afii.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Wona nye kple miawo siaa ƒe dzi dze me. Mide bubu ame siawo tɔgbe ŋu.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Hame siwo le Asia la do gbe na mi nyuie. Akwila kple Priskila kpakple hame si kpea ta le wo ƒeme la do gbe na mi nyuie, esi miewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo ta.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Nɔviawo katã do gbe na mi hee! Mido gbe na mia nɔewo, eye ame sia ame nana asi nɔvia lɔlɔ̃tɔe.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Nye Paulo ŋutɔe tsɔ nye asi ŋlɔ gbedoname sia le ɖoɖom ɖe mi.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Ame si melɔ̃ Aƒetɔ la o la, neɖi eŋu kpékpekpe! Mía Aƒetɔ, va!

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yesu neve mia nu.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃ nenɔ kpli mi ame siwo katã wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu la. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Paulo, Kristo Yesu ƒe amedɔdɔ kple mía nɔvi Timoteo gbɔ. Mawu ƒe didie wònye be meva zu amedɔdɔ. Míele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe Mawu ƒe hame si le Korinto kple Mawu ƒe ame siwo katã le Axaya-nuto blibo la me.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Mawu mía Tɔ́ kple mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu, eye woana ŋutifafa mi. Paulo da akpe na Mawu

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Tɔ́ la. Tɔ́ sia nye nublanuikpɔla, eye wònye Mawu si faa akɔ na mí le nu sia nu me.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: Efaa akɔ na mí le míaƒe fukpekpewo katã me, ale be míate ŋu atsɔ akɔfafa si míexɔ tso egbɔ la, afa akɔe na ame bubu siwo le fu kpem la.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Míenya be miekpea fu abe míawo ke ene. Míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ si naneke mate ŋu aɖe ɖa o lae nye be woafa akɔ na mi, abe ale si woafae na míawo hã ene.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, míedi be mianya nu le xaxa si me míeɖo le Asia la ŋu nyuie. Wowɔ fu mí ale gbegbe be ŋusẽ va vɔ le mía ŋu keŋ, eye míeganya be míatsi agbe gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, eva wɔ na mí abe ɖe wotso kufia na mí ene. Esia va eme bene míate ŋu aɖo dzi ɖe Mawu, ame si ko fɔa ame kukuwo ɖe tsitre ŋu, ke menye ɖe míawo ŋutɔ mía ɖokui ŋu o.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Eɖe mí tso ŋɔdzi gã si kú do na mí la me, eye egale mía ɖe ge godoo. Mawu sia kee míele mɔ kpɔm na be egale mía ɖe ge.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Miawo hã mikpe ɖe mía ŋu, miado gbe ɖa, ale be ame geɖewo nada akpe na Mawu na mí be eve mía nu heɖo míaƒe gbedodoɖa geɖewo ŋu. Paulo trɔ eƒe ɖoɖowo

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Nenye be nane li, si míatsɔ aƒo adegbee la, eyae nye be míaƒe dzitsinya ɖia ɖase be míenɔa agbe nyuie le amewo katã ŋkume, vevietɔ le mia dome. Menye amegbetɔ ƒe nunya me esia tso o, ke boŋ Mawue vea mía nu nana be míekɔa dzime faa hetoa nyateƒe.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Nya si miate ŋu axlẽ ahase egɔme ɖeɖe ko míeŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi. Ke mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be miava se mía gɔme bliboe le nuwuwu.

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: Eme kɔ be fifia la, miese míaƒe nuwɔnawo gɔme nyuie, ale be le Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe ŋkeke la dzi la, miate ŋu atsɔ mí aƒo adegbee, eye míawo hã míate ŋu atsɔ mi aƒo adegbee.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Nu sia dzie meka ɖo tae meɖoe gbã be mava kpɔ mi ɖa hafi. Ɖe medi be mave mia nu zigbɔzi eve sɔŋ hafi.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Gbã mava kpɔ mi ɖa, ne meyina ɖe Makedonia, emegbe ne metrɔ tso afi ma gbɔna la, magato mia gbɔ, ne miado mɔm mayi Yudea.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Esi meɖo be mawɔ esia ɖe, edzé abe ɖe mele ame aɖe flum enea? Ɖe mewɔa nye ɖoɖowo abe xexemetɔwo ene agblɔ be “Ẽ” agagblɔ be “O” le nukeke ɖeka ma ke mea?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Abe ale si Mawu wɔa eƒe nya dzi ene la, míawo hã míaƒe “Ẽ” na mi metrɔna zua “O” o.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Mawu Vi, Yesu Kristo, ame si nye ŋutɔ, Silvano kple Timoteo míeɖe gbeƒãe le mia dome la, menye ame si lɔ̃na be, “Ẽ” vɔ wònye “O” o. “Ẽ” ɖeɖe koe le eyama me.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe ŋugbedodoawo katã va zu “Ẽ” le eyama me. Esia tae mielɔ̃a Amen to eyama dzi tsɔna kafua Mawui ɖo.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Mawue nye ame si doa ŋusẽ míawo kple miawo siaa le ha si dem míele kple Kristo la me. Eyae nye ame si tia mí,

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: de dzesi mí be ye tɔe míenye, eye wòtsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la de míaƒe dziwo me, abe kpeɖodzinu ene na nu siwo miava xɔ la.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Mawu nye ɖasefo le nye kple miawo dome be nublanuie mekpɔ na mi, eya ta nyemegava Korinto o ɖo.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Menye ɖe míebe míate nu si míexɔ se la ɖe mia dzi o, elabe miaƒe xɔse le te sesĩe xoxo. Ke ɖeko míele dɔ wɔm kpli mi, ale be miakpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Ale meɖoe be nyemegale mia gbɔ va ge bene miase veve o.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Elabe ne mena miese veve la, ame kae gale dzidzɔ do ge nam? Menye miawo koe oa?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Esia tae meŋlɔ agbalẽa na mi nenema ɖo, ale be ne meva mia gbɔ la, ame siwo wòdze be woado dzidzɔ nam la dometɔ aɖeke mana maxa nu o. Elabe menya mi nyuie ate ŋu agblɔ be, ne mele dzidzɔ kpɔm la, ekema miawo hã miekpɔa dzidzɔ.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Dzi kpekpe, nuxaxa kple aɖatsi geɖe metsɔ ŋlɔ agbalẽa na mi. Nyemeŋlɔe be mana miaxa nu o, ke boŋ be mianya ale si gbegbe melɔ̃ mii. Vodadatsɔtsɔ ke vodala

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe na mese veve la, me nye nyee wòna mese veve o, ke boŋ, ne nye magblɔe akpa o la, mi katãe woka.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Esɔ gbɔ be mia dome akpa gãtɔ he to na ame sia xoxo.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Ke nu si wòle be miawo miawɔ fifia lae nye be miatsɔ nu si wòwɔ la akee, ahado ŋusẽe boŋ, ale be nuxaxa fũu akpa nagana wòayi to keŋkeŋ o.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Ale mele kuku ɖem na mi be miɖo kpe edzi nɛ be yewolɔ̃e vevie.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Nu sia ta koŋ ye meŋlɔ agbalẽa na mi ɖo, be matsɔ ado mi akpɔ be mieɖoa to le nu sia nu me mahã.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ne mietsɔ ame aɖe ƒe nu si wòwɔ la kee la, nye hã metsɔe kee. Le nyateƒe me la, nenye be metsɔ ame aɖe ƒe nu si wòwɔ la kee tututu la, mia tae metsɔe kee ɖo, abe ale si mawɔe le Kristo ŋkume la ene.

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: Mewɔ esia, ale be Abosam nagaba mí o, elabe míenya eƒe ayemɔwo nyuie. Nu si na be Paulo tsi dzi le Troa

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Esi meva ɖo Troa be maɖe gbeƒã Kristo ƒe Nyanyuia la, mekpɔ be mɔ ʋu nam siaa be mawɔ dɔ na Aƒetɔ la le afi ma.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Ke nye dzi medze eme o, elabe nyemekpɔ nɔvinye Tito le afi ma o. Ale meklã ameawo hetso eme yi ɖe Makedonia. Ale si míeɖua dzi to Kristo dzii

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Akpe na Mawu si nana mièɖua dzi godoo le Kristo me eye wòɖe eƒe sidzedze ƒe ʋeʋe lilili la ɖe go fia to mía dzi le afi sia afi.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: Ʋeʋẽ sia he agbe vɛ na ame siwo xɔm wole ɖe agbe la, ke ame siwo dze na ku ya la, ʋeʋẽ la zu ku na wo. Ame kae dze ate ŋu awɔ dɔ sia?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Míawo ya la, míele abe ame geɖe, siwo tsɔa Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la abe nu kpotoe dzadzra ko ene o. Esi wònye Mawue tia mí ta la, míewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo, eye míeƒoa nu nyateƒetɔe le Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Ɖe míegade asi mía ɖokui kafukafu me kea? Abe ale si wòle na ame aɖewo ene la, ɖe míehiã kafukafugbalẽ si míaxɔ tso mia gbɔ, alo atsɔ vɛ na mia?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Ao, miawo ŋutɔe nye míaƒe agbalẽ, si woŋlɔ ɖe miaƒe dziwo dzi, si ame sia ame nya, hexlẽna.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Edze ƒãa be Kristo ƒe agbalẽ mienye míexɔ vɛ. Menye nuŋlɔtsie wotsɔ ŋlɔe o, ke Mawu gbagbe la ƒe Gbɔgbɔe wotsɔ ŋlɔe. Gawu la, menye nuŋlɔkpe dzi woŋlɔ agbalẽ sia ɖo o, ke boŋ amegbetɔwo ƒe dziwo dzie.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Míate ŋu agblɔ esia, elabe le Kristo ta míeka ɖe Mawu dzi.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Le mía gome la, naneke mele míawo ŋutɔ si, si míatsɔ aƒo adegbee, be eya tae míete ŋu le dɔ sia wɔm o. Nu si na míete ŋu le dɔa wɔm la, Mawu gbɔe wòtso.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Eyae na nu sia nu si míehiã la mí, be míanye nubabla yeye la ƒe dɔlawo. Womeŋlɔ nubabla yeye sia ɖi o, Gbɔgbɔ la mee wòle. Nubabla si woŋlɔ ɖi la, wua ame, ke Gbɔgbɔ la ya naa agbe.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Esi Mose tsɔ se si woŋlɔ ɖe kpe dzi si nye ku ƒe dɔla vɛ la, se sia ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe sesẽ ale gbegbe be Israelviwo mete ŋu kpɔ Mose ƒe mo o. Eʋɔa ŋutikɔkɔe sia menɔ anyi ɖaa o.

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: Ne esia le eme alea ɖe, ɖe ŋutikɔkɔe si ado ne wona Gbɔgbɔa la, masesẽ wu esia boo oa?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Elabe ne ŋutikɔkɔe li na fɔbubu ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ la, ekema dzɔdzɔenyenye subɔsubɔdɔ la agba go geɖe wu le ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, nu si do kple ŋutikɔkɔe gbã la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la bu, elabe nu si va do azɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe to gbãtɔ tɔ ŋu.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutikɔkɔe li na nu si klona la, ekema nu si le anyi ɖaa la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe asesẽ wu sãa.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Mɔkpɔkpɔ siae le mía si ta dzi le mía ƒo.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Míawo ya míele abe Mose, ame si tsɔ motsyɔnu tsyɔ mo, ale be Israelviwo nagakpɔ keklẽ si le eƒe mo, si nu latsi la ene o.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Woƒe susu me gado viviti kokoko. Elabe va se ɖe egbe gɔ̃ hã la, ne woxlẽ mawunya tso Nubabla Xoxoa me la, motsyɔnu ma gale mo nɛ ko. Kristo me ko motsyɔnu sia ɖena ɖa le.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, nenye be woxlẽ Mose ƒe agbalẽawo na wo egbegbe gɔ̃ hã la, ɖeko wògawɔna abe ɖe wotsyɔ nu woƒe susu dzi ene.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame aɖe trɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ la ŋu la, motsyɔnu sia ɖena ɖa.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Aƒetɔ lae nye Gbɔgbɔ la, eye afi si Aƒetɔ la ƒe Gbɔgbɔ le la, ablɔɖe hã le afi ma.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Ke woɖe motsyɔnu la ɖa le mo na mí katã, eye míele Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kpɔm abe ahũhɔ̃e me wòle ene. Wole mía trɔm ɖe eƒe nɔnɔme me, eye míaƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le dzidzim ɖe edzi. Aƒetɔ si nye Gbɔgbɔ lae le esia wɔm.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu kpɔ nublanui na mí tsɔ subɔsubɔdɔ sia na mí be míawɔ ta la, dzi meɖena le mía ƒo o.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Míegbe ŋukpenanu kple bebemenuwɔwɔ. Míegbe ayemenuwɔwɔ kple Mawu ƒe nya la tɔtrɔ bubui. Ke boŋ míehea nyateƒe la ɖe go, eye to esia me míeɖea mía ɖokui fiaa ame sia ame ƒe dzitsinya, abe ale si míawɔe le Mawu ŋkume la ene.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Elabe nenye be wotsyɔ nu míaƒe Nyanyui la dzi gɔ̃ hã la, ekema ame siwo tsrɔ̃ vɔ yina la ko wotsɔ nu tsyɔ edzi na.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Xexe sia me mawu gbã ŋku na ame maxɔse siawo ƒe susu, ale be womate ŋu akpɔ Nyanyui la ƒe kekeli si nye Kristo, ame si le Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme me la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe o.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Elabe menye míawo ŋutɔ mía ɖokui míeɖea gbeƒãe o. Kristo Yesue míeɖea gbeƒãe be eyae nye Aƒetɔ, eye míawo míenye miaƒe subɔlawo le Yesu ta.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mawu si gblɔ be, “Kekeli neklẽ tso viviti me” la, eya kee klẽ ɖe míaƒe dziwo me, be yeana míadze si Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒãa le Kristo ŋkume.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Ke mí ame siwo me kesinɔnu sia le la, míele abe anyizewo ene. Esia le alea bene woadze sii be Mawu gbɔe ŋusẽ triakɔ la tso; menye mía gbɔ o.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Wowɔa fu mí le go sia go me, ke wɔna mevɔna le mía ŋu o; wotɔtɔa míaƒe susu, ke dzi meɖena le mía ƒo o.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Wotia mía yome, ke wo megble mí ɖi o; wotsɔa mí xlãna ɖe anyi, gake womewua mí o.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Esi míele agbe la, ku le ŋɔdzi dom na mí ɣe sia ɣi le Yesu ta, ale be Yesu ƒe agbe hã nadzé le míaƒe ŋutilã si kuna la me.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Ale ku le dɔ wɔm le mía me, ke agbe le dɔ wɔm le miawo mia me.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ke xɔse le mía si. Mawunya gblɔ be, “Mexɔe se, eya ta meƒo nu ɖo.” Gbɔgbɔ ma ke, si nana be ame xɔna sena la, le míawo hã mía si, eya ta míawo hã míeƒoa nu ɖo.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Míenya be Mawu, si fɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu ɖe tsitre la, afɔ míawo hã ɖe tsitre kple Yesu, eye wòakplɔ mí kpakple miawo siaa ava eŋkume.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Elabe nu sia nu si dzɔna ɖe mía dzi la, mia tae, be ne amenuvenu si sɔgbɔ ɖe edzi to ame geɖewo dzi la, nagba go hena Mawu ƒe kafukafu. Agbenɔnɔ ɖe xɔse nu

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Le esia ta la, dzi meɖe le mía ƒo o. Togbɔ be míaƒe ŋutilã sia le gbegblẽm vivivi hã la, wole agbe gbɔm míaƒe gbɔgbɔ ya gbe sia gbe.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Fu sue si kpem míele fifia la, manɔ anyi ɖaa o. Ele mía dzram ɖo na ŋutikɔkɔe mavɔ, si womate ŋu atsɔ asɔ kple naneke o la.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Elabe menye nu si le dzedzem la ŋue míaƒe ŋku le o, ke boŋ nu si mele dzedzem o la ŋue. Nu si wokpɔna kple ŋku la, menɔa anyi ɖaa o; ke nu si womekpɔna kple ŋku o lae nɔa anyi ɖaa.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Elabe míenya be, ne wokaka míaƒe anyigbadzigbadɔ sia, si me míele fifia, esi nye míaƒe ŋutilã hã la, xɔ sesẽ bubu le mía si le dziƒowo le Mawu gbɔ. Eya la, menye asi wotsɔ tui o, eye wònye aƒe si anɔ anyi ɖaa.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, fifi gɔ̃ hã míeɖea hũ, eye míedina vevie be woana míaʋu ayi ɖe aƒe si le mía si le dziƒo la me,

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: ale be ne wona míeʋu yi xɔ sia me la, míegale amama tsi ge o.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Elabe esime míegale agbadɔ sia me ko la, míele hũɖeɖe dzi hetsi dzi. Menye esi míele didim be woaɖe anyigbadziŋutilã sia le mía ŋu ta o, ke boŋ be woatsɔ dziƒotɔ ado na mí, ale be nu si le agbe la nava xɔ nu si kuna la teƒe keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Mawue nye ame si trɔ asi le mía ŋu na nu sia tututu da ɖi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la na mí abe kpeɖodzinu ene.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Eya ta dzi le mía ƒo ɖaa, elabe míenya be, zi ale si ŋutilã sia ganye aƒe na mí ko la, míele adzɔge tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: Elabe míezɔna le xɔse me, menye le nukpɔkpɔ me o.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Dzi le mía ƒo, eye míedi be míado go le ŋutilã sia me boŋ, ne míadzo aɖanɔ aƒe le Aƒetɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Eya ta aƒee míeɖale o, nugbee míeɖale o, míaƒe taɖodzinu koe nye be míawɔ nu si adze eŋu.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Elabe ele na mí katã be míado ɖe Kristo ŋkume, be wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mí. Ame sia ame laxɔ fetu si dze nɛ la, nyui alo vɔ̃, le agbe si ƒomevi wònɔ le ŋutilã sia me la nu. Xɔlɔ̃wɔwɔ kple Mawu to Kristo dzi

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Ale esi míenya ale si woavɔ̃ Aƒetɔ lae ta la, míeƒonɛ ɖe amewo hã nu be woavɔ̃e. Mawu ya nya ale si tututu míele, eye mexɔ se be miawo hã mienya mí le miaƒe dzime ke.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Menye ɖe míegale mía ɖokui kafum na mi ake o, ke boŋ ɖe míele mɔnukpɔkpɔ sia nam mi be miatsɔ mí aƒo adegbee. Míewɔ esia, ale be miate ŋu akpɔ nya aɖo eŋu na ame siwo tsɔa ame ƒe dzedzeme ko ƒoa adegbee, ke menye nu si le eƒe dzime la o.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Elabe ne míaƒe tagbɔ gblẽ la, Mawu tae wògblẽ ɖo. Ne míaƒe susu le te la, miawo tae wòle te ɖo.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Kristo ƒe lɔlɔ̃e ɖu mía dzi, elabe eme kɔ ƒãa na mí be ame ɖeka koe ku ɖe amewo katã ta, eye esia fia be amewo katãe ku.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Ame sia ku na amewo katã, ale be ame siwo le agbe la, naganɔ agbe na wo ɖokui o, ke boŋ na ame si ku, eye wofɔe ɖe tsitre le wo ta la ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Ale tso azɔ heyi la, míegatsɔa amegbetɔ ƒe susu tsoa nya me le ame aɖeke ŋu o. Togbɔ be míetsɔ amegbetɔ ƒe susu tso nya me le Kristo ŋu kpɔ hã la, míegawɔnɛ azɔ o.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Eya ta ne ame aɖe wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo la, ezu nuwɔwɔ yeye. Nuwɔwɔ xoxotɔ la nu va yi, yeyetɔ lae va ɖo.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Mawue wɔ nu siawo katã. Eyae to Kristo dzi lé avu le mí kple eya ŋutɔ ɖokui dome, eye wòna subɔsubɔdɔ sia mí, be míawɔ ame bubuwo hã woava zu exɔlɔ̃wo.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Nya lae nye be Mawu to Kristo dzi lé avu le amegbetɔ kple eya ŋutɔ ɖokui dome. Mebu amegbetɔ ƒe vodada nɛ o, ke boŋ etsɔ dɔ sia de asi na mí be míaɖe gbeƒã be yedzra ye kple amegbetɔwo dome ɖo.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Ale míenye Kristo ƒe amedɔdɔwo. Mawu to mía dzi le nu xlɔ̃m mi. Eya ta míele Kristo teƒe le kuku ɖem na mi be mina woadzra mi kple Mawu dome ɖo.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Kristo mewɔ nuvɔ̃ aɖeke kpɔ o hã la, Mawu na wòzu nuvɔ̃me ɖe mía teƒe, ale be ne míewɔ ɖeka kplii la, Mawu nabu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Mí, ame siwo le hadɔ wɔm kple Mawu la, míele nu xlɔ̃m mi be migana ale si Mawu ve mia nui la, nazu dzodzro o.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Elabe egblɔ be: “Esi ɣeyiɣi la de nam be mave nuwò la, meɖo to wò. Esi ŋkekea ɖo nam, be maxɔ wò ɖe agbe la, mekpe ɖe ŋuwò.” Misee ɖa! Mebe Mawu ƒe amenuveɣi la ɖo. Mawu le ame xɔm ɖe agbe fifi laa!

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Míetsɔ naneke xe mɔe na ame aɖeke o, bene womagakpɔ vodada le subɔsubɔdɔ si wɔm míele la ŋu o.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ míeɖea mía ɖokui fiana le nu sia nu si míewɔna la me be Mawu ƒe subɔlawo míenye. Ne míexaxa, alo le fu kpem, alo ne hiã tu mí la, míedoa dzi sesĩe.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Ne woƒo mí, alo de mí gaxɔ me; ne wode zi mía me alo wona míewɔ dɔ abe kluvi ene; ne míetsi ŋudɔ alo míetsi nu dɔ hã la,

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: míedze agbagba be míanɔ dzadzɛ. Gawu la, míetsɔ nunya, dzidodo kple dɔmenyowɔwɔ fia be Mawu ƒe dɔlawo míenye. Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la, lɔlɔ̃ deto

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: kple míaƒe gbedeasi la ƒe nyateƒenyenye kpakple Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ kpena ɖe mía ŋu. Míeléa nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖe ɖusi kple mia abe míaƒe aʋawɔnuwo ene. Woawoe míetsɔna ʋlia mía ɖokui tae, eye woawo míegatsɔna lũna ɖe futɔwo dzi hãe.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Wodea bubu mía ŋu, gadoa ŋukpe hã mí; wodaa mí ɖe anyi, gakafua mí hã. Togbɔ be wobua mí alakpatɔwoe hã la, nyateƒe la ko míegblɔna.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Wowɔ abe ɖe womedze si mí o ene, ke ame sia ame dze si mí. Wobu mí abe ɖe míele kukum ene, ke míele agbe. Togbɔ be wohe to na mí hã la, womewu mí o.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Wobu mí konyifalawoe, ke dzi le mía dzɔm ɖaa. Míedzé abe ame dahewo ene, ke míawoe nana be ame geɖewo zua kesinɔtɔwo. Wokpɔ mí abe naneke ɖe mele mía si o ene, evɔ wònye míawo sie nu sia nu le hafi.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Nɔvi Korintotɔwo, míekɔ dzime ɖe mia ŋu heƒo nu na mi faa.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Menye míawoe mekɔ dzime ɖe mia ŋu o, ke miawo boŋ ye mekɔ dzime ɖe mía ŋu o.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Le esia ta, mele nu ƒom na mi faa abe vinyewo ene. Miawo hã mikɔ dzime ɖe mía ŋu faa nenema ke. Migade ha kple trɔ̃subɔlawo le nuwɔna aɖeke me o

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Migade ha kple ame siwo mexɔ se o la le nuwɔna aɖeke me o. Ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ ate ŋu aƒo ƒu awɔ nanea? Alo ɖe kekeli kple viviti ate ŋu ade haa?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Ale ke Kristo kple Beliel, vɔ̃ɖitɔ la, ƒe gbe ate ŋu asɔe? Nya kae le xɔsetɔ kple dzimaxɔsetɔ dome?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Kadodo kae le Mawu ƒe aƒe kple trɔ̃wo dome? Elabe Mawu gbagbe la ƒe aƒee míenye. Mawu ŋutɔ gblɔ be, “Maɖo nɔƒe ɖe wo me, eye manɔ wo dome. Manye woƒe Mawu, eye woawo woanye nye dukɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be, “Eya ta mido go le wo dome, eye mima ɖa tso wo gbɔ. Migawɔ nu makɔmakɔ aɖeke o, eye maxɔ mi atuu.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Manye mia tɔ́, eye miawo mianye vinye ŋutsuwo kple vinye nyɔnuwo. Aƒetɔ Ŋusẽkatãtɔ lae gblɔ esia.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi wodo nu siawo katã ŋugbe na mí ta la, mina míakɔ mía ɖokui ŋuti tso nu siwo katã ƒoa ɖi ŋutilã kple gbɔgbɔ siaa la me, ale be to mawuvɔvɔ̃ me la, míazu ame kɔkɔewo keŋkeŋ. Paulo kpɔ dzidzɔ

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Mikɔ dzime ɖe mía ŋu. Míedze agɔ le ame aɖeke dzi o, míegblẽ ame aɖeke o; míeba ame aɖeke hã o.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Nyemegblɔ esia be mabu fɔ mi o. Abe ale si megblɔ ɣe aɖe ɣi va yi ene la, miaƒe nu lé dzi na mí ale gbegbe be ne edze ku dzi la, míaku kpli mi faa, eye ne egadze agbe dzi hã, míanɔ agbe kpli mi.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Meka ɖe mia dzi ŋutɔ. Metsɔa mi ƒoa adegbee ale gbegbe! Nye dzi dze eme. Le míaƒe fukpekpewo katã me la, dzi dzɔm kaka glo!

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Esi míeva ɖo Makedonia kura gɔ̃ la, míekpɔ vovo le mía ɖokui me o. Míekpe fu le go sia go me. Amewo nɔ dzre wɔm kpli mí, eye míenɔ vɔvɔ̃m le mía ɖokui me.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Ke esime Tito va la, Mawu, ame si dea dzi ƒo na ame siwo ƒo dzi ɖe le la, de dzi ƒo na mí.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Menye eƒe vava ɖeɖe koe de dzi ƒo na mí o, ke boŋ dzideƒonya si wòxɔ tso mia gbɔ vɛ la hãe. Eva gblɔ ale si miedi vevie be yewoakpɔm, ale si miele nye nu xam kple ale si miele ŋudzɔ be yewoaʋli tanye la nam. Esia na be megakpɔ dzidzɔ geɖe wu tsã.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Elabe ne nye agbalẽa na miexa nu hã la, mevem be meŋlɔe o, elabe mede dzesii be nye agbalẽa na miese veve, togbɔ be wònye ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko hã. Evɔ ne egavem hã,

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: fifia la, dzi dzɔm. Menye esi miese veve ta o, ke boŋ be miese veve hetrɔ dzime. Miese veve, abe ale si Mawu di la ene, eya ta meganye míawoe wɔ naneke si ve mi o.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
