translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe se veve, abe ale si Mawu di ene la, etrɔa dzime, eye woxɔnɛ ɖe agbe; mevenɛ o. Ke ne ame aɖe se veve, abe ale si xexea me di ene la, ku ko wòhena vanɛ.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ale si vevesese sia tɔgbe, si Mawu di la, le dɔ wɔm le mia me la ɖa; enana be miedoa vevie nu wɔna; enana be miedina be yewoanɔ dzadzɛ; enana be miedoa dziku ɖe nu masɔmasɔ ŋu; enana be mievɔ̃na; enana be miekpɔa mɔ na nu vevie; enana be mietsɔa dzo ɖe nu ŋu; enana be miedina be woahe to na nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔla. Le nuwo katã me la, mieɖe mia ɖokui fia be miele dzadzɛ le nya la me.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Ale togbɔ be meŋlɔ agbalẽ na mi hã la, menye ame si wɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ la tae meŋlɔe ɖo o, eye menye ame si ŋu wowɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ la ɖo la hã tae o. Ke boŋ medi be maɖe ale si miedoa vevie nu ɖe mía teƒe la afia mi le Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Esia koŋ tae dzi gaɖo mía ƒo ɖo. Ke hekpe ɖe dzideƒo si míekpɔ ŋu la, dzi gadzɔ mí geɖe wu le dzidzɔ si Tito kpɔ la ta, elabe mi katã miena eƒe dzi dze eme.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Metsɔ mi ƒo adegbee nɛ, eye miedo ŋukpem o. Ke abe ale si nya sia nya si míegblɔna na mi nye nyateƒe ene la, ale si metsɔ mi ƒo adegbee na Tito hã va nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Ne eɖo ŋku mi katã miaƒe toɖoɖo, bubu kple sosroɖa si mietsɔ xɔe la dzi la, miaƒe nu galéa dzi nɛ vevie ɖe edzi wu.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Dzi le dzɔyem ŋutɔ, elabe meɖo dzi ɖe mia ŋu le nu sia nu me.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, míedi be mianya nu si Mawu ve hame siwo le Makedonia la nu wote ŋu wɔ la.

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: Wote wo kpɔ le fukpekpe sesẽ me. Togbɔ be woda ahe ŋutɔ hã la, wokɔ dzime na nu geɖe kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Mate ŋu aɖi ɖase be wotsɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu na nu faa le woƒe ŋutete nu. Megblɔ be wona nu wu woƒe ŋutete gɔ̃.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Woɖe kuku vevie be míaɖe mɔ na yewo be yewo hã yewoakpɔ gome le subɔsubɔdɔ si wɔm míele na ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la me.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Míekpɔ mɔ na esia kura hafi o. Gbã la, woɖe asi le wo ɖokui ŋu na Aƒetɔ la, eye emegbe to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me la, woɖe asi le wo ɖokui ŋu na míawo hã.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, míebia tso Tito si vevie be esi wove enu, wòdze dɔ sia wɔwɔ gɔme le mia dome xoxo ta la, neyi edzi ne wòawɔe awu enu.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Fifia la, miede blibo keŋ le nu sia nu me. Miaƒe xɔse, nuƒoƒo kple nunya de blibo. Miedoa vevie nu le nu sia nu me, eye mielɔ̃ mí ŋutɔ. Esia ta mikpɔ egbɔ be yewozu blibo le amenuvedɔ sia hã me.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Nyemele esia gblɔm abe sedede ene o, ke matsɔ ame bubuwo ƒe vevidodo aɖo mia ŋkume ne makpɔe ɖa be miawo hã miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ de blibo mahã.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Mienya ale si mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ve mía nui. Kesinɔtɔ wònye hafi, ke le mia ta la, eva da ahe, ale be miawo miato eƒe ahedada me ava zu kesinɔtɔwo.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Mele aɖaŋu ɖom na mi le nya sia me be anyo ne miawu dɔ si gɔme miedze le ƒe si va yi me la nu. Miawoe nye hame gbãtɔ, si di be yeawɔ dɔ sia, eye miawoe dze egɔme gbã hã.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Fifia la, ele be miawu dɔ si gɔme miedze la nu. Ale si wònye miaƒe didi vevie le ɣe ma ɣi me be yewoawɔ dɔ sia la, mitsɔ nu siwo le mia si la wɔe wu enui.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Elabe ne enye ame aɖe ƒe didi vevie be yeana nu la, nu si wòna lae Mawu xɔna, ke menye nu si mele esi o la o.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Menye ɖe mele gbɔgblɔm be ele be miawɔ ame bubuwo ƒe agba wòazu wodzoe, ke miawo ya mia tɔ nagakpe ɖe dzi o.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Ke be nuwo nasɔ la, ele be woakpɔ gome le nu siwo sɔ gbɔ ɖe mia si fifia la me, elabe hiã tu wo, ale be ne hiã va tu miawo hã emegbe la, miakpɔ gome le nu siwo sɔ gbɔ ɖe woawo hã wo si la me. Ale nu sia nu asɔ pɛ le go sia go me.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be, “Ame si ƒo nu geɖe nu ƒu la, nu geɖe menɔa esi o. Ame si ƒo nu ʋɛ aɖe nu ƒu la, nu mehiãnɛ o.” Tito kple exɔlɔ̃wo

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Ke akpe ko míada na Mawu be wòna Tito hã do vevie be yeakpe ɖe mia ŋu abe míawo ke ene.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Esi míedi tso esi be wòava mia gbɔ la, elɔ̃; ke enye eya ŋutɔ ƒe didi vevie xoxo be yeava.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Míele eya kple nɔvi si hameawo katã kafuna, le ale si wòkakaa Nyanyui lae ta la, ɖom ɖe mi.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, hameawo tiae be wòazɔ mɔ kpli mí hena amenuvedɔ sia wɔwɔ. Dɔ sia la, ɖe míele ewɔm be woatsɔ akafu Aƒetɔ lae, eye míatsɔ aɖe ale si míedi vevie be míawɔe la afia.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Míelé mía ɖokui nyuie, ale be ame aɖeke nagahe nya ɖe mía ŋu le ale si míewɔ nunana sia, si wona kple dzi faa la ŋudɔe o.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Elabe míaƒe taɖodzinue nye be míawɔ nu si nyo le Mawu kple amegbetɔwo siaa ŋkume.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Ale míele mía nɔvi sia ɖom ɖa kpe ɖe wo ŋu. Míedoe kpɔ zi geɖe, eye míekpɔ be enye ame si doa vevie nu le nu geɖe me. Gawu la, exɔ mia dzi se azɔ ŋutɔ, eya ta wògadi vevie wu be yeakpe ɖe mia ŋu.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Le Tito gome la, enye xɔ̃nye kple hadɔwɔla le subɔsubɔdɔ si wɔm míele na mi la me. Le mía nɔvi bubuawo gome la, hameawo ƒe dɔlawo wonye, eye wodea bubu Kristo ŋu.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Eya ta miɖe miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple ale si míetsɔa mi ƒoa adegbee la fia ame siawo, ale be hameawo katã nanya.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mekpɔ be mehiã kura be maŋlɔ agbalẽ na mi tso nunana si wòle be miana, be woatsɔ akpe ɖe ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la ŋu hafi o.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Menya ale si miele klalo be yewoana kpekpeɖeŋu lae. Metsɔ mi ƒo adegbee na Makedoniatɔwo be nɔvi siwo le Axaya la, le klalo le ƒe si va yi me ke be yewoana kpekpeɖeŋu. Ale miaƒe vevidodo nu sia de dzo wo dome ame akpa gãtɔ me.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Mele nɔvi siawo ɖom ɖe mi, ale be woakpɔ be ale si metsɔ mi le adegbe ƒomee na wo le nya sia me la, menye dzodzro o. Abe ale si megblɔnɛ na wo be miele ŋudzɔ ene la, minɔ ŋudzɔ nenema.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, ne nɔvi siwo le Makedonia la dometɔ aɖe va kplim, eye wòkpɔ be miele ŋudzɔ o la, ekema ŋu akpe mí; nyemedi be maƒo nu tso ŋu si akpe miawo ya ŋu o, elabe woabu be meka ɖe mia dzi fũu akpa.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Esia tae mebui be ehiã be maɖo nɔviawo ɖe mia gbɔ do ŋgɔ, ne woakpe ɖe mia ŋu be miadi nunana si ŋugbe miedo la ada ɖi. Ale be wòanye nu si miena kple lɔlɔ̃nu faa, ke menye ɖe wozi mia dzi hafi o.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku edzi be ame si ƒã nu ʋɛ aɖe la, nu ʋɛ aɖe ko wòaŋe, ke ame si ƒã nu geɖe la, aŋe nu geɖe.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame sia ame neʋu asi me, ne wòana nu faa, abe ale si wòɖoe la ene, ke menye kple dzi kpekpe o, elabe ame si naa nu kple dzidzɔ la, eyae Mawu lɔ̃na.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Mawu ate ŋu ana nu sia nu si miehiã la mi ɣe sia ɣi wòasɔ gbɔ wu ale si miehiã la gɔ̃, ale be nu si miehiã la nasu mia si, eye nu nagatsi anyi miana, be woatsɔ awɔ dɔ nyui ɖe sia ɖee.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be, “Eʋua asi me maa nu na ame dahewo faa eƒe dɔmenyowɔwɔ li ɖaa.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si naa nuku agbledela wòƒãna, eye wònana be nukua dzina ɖe edzi, ale be agbledela kpɔa nuɖuɖu geɖe tsoa eme la, ana nu siwo le mia si la nadzi ɖe edzi zã, bene miatsɔ awɔ dɔmenyo geɖe.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Awɔe be nu nabɔ ɖe mia si fũu miatsɔ awɔ dɔmenyoe le nu sia nu me. Esia ana be ame bubuwo ada akpe na Mawu le nu si miena wo to mía dzi la ta.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Kpekpeɖeŋu si miena la, menye ɖeko wòana be ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la nakpɔ woƒe nuhiahiãwo o, ke boŋ ana hã be ame geɖe ŋutɔ nada akpe na Mawu ale gbegbe.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Ne miedze agbagba na kpekpeɖeŋu sia la, amewo akafu Mawu be miexɔ Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la, eye mieɖo to eye be mienyo dɔme dzɔ nu na yewo kple ame bubuwo.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Esi wole mia susum vevie ta la, woado gbe ɖa ɖe mia ta, elabe Mawu ve mia nu ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Akpe na Mawu le eƒe nunana si wu gbɔgblɔ la ta.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Nye Paulo ŋutɔ, metsɔ Kristo ƒe ɖokuibɔbɔ kple tufafa le nu xlɔ̃m mi. Nye ame si bɔbɔa ɖokuinye ne mele mia ŋkume, ke mewɔa nu dzideƒotɔe ne nyemele mia gbɔ o lae.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Taflatsɛ, ne meva la, nyemedi be maɖee afia be dzideƒo le asinye be meka ɖe ɖokuinye dzi o. Ke mia dome ame aɖewo bu be xexe sia me susu ko nu míewɔa nu ɖo. Ame siawo ya la, meɖoe be manyra ɖe wo vevie.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, togbɔ be xexea mee míele hã la, menye aʋa si tɔgbe wowɔna le xexe sia me lae míele wɔwɔm o.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Elabe aʋawɔnu siwo ŋudɔ wɔm míele la metso xexea me o; wotso Mawu gbɔ, eye wote ŋu gbãa mɔ́ sesẽwo gɔ̃ hã gudugudu.

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: Míegbãa alakpanya siwo amewo ʋlina kple nuwɔna ɖe sia ɖe si fia dada, eye wòxea mɔ be womadze si Mawu o la. Míeléa susu ɖe sia ɖe, abe ale si woléa ame siwo dzi woɖu le aʋa me la ene.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Azɔ ne mieɖe asi le mia ɖokui ŋu bliboe heɖo to la, ekema míele ŋudzɔ be míahe to na ame siwo katã sẽa to la.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Milé ŋku ɖe nu siwo le dzedzem le mia ŋkume la ŋu. Ne ame aɖe ka ɖe edzi be Kristo tɔe yenye la, neɖo ŋku edzi be, abe ale si ye hã yenye Kristo tɔ ene la, nenema ke míawo hã míenye Kristo tɔwoe.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Elabe ne maƒo adegbe vie wu ale si dze, le ŋusẽ si Aƒetɔ la na mí be míatsɔ anyi mi ne miatsi, ke menye be míatsɔ agblẽ nu le mia ŋu o ŋuti gɔ̃ hã la, ŋu makpem o.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Nyemedi be wòadzé na mi abe ŋɔdzi dom mele na mi kple nye agbalẽwo ene o.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Elabe wogblɔ be, “Paulo ƒe agbalẽwo ɖea kpe ŋutɔ, eye ŋusẽ le wo ŋu. Evɔ ne ele ame gbɔ la, ŋusẽ aɖeke mele eya ŋutɔ ŋu o, eye eƒe nyawo hã mele ɖeke me o.”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Eme nekɔ na ame siawo tɔgbe be nu siwo míeŋlɔna ɖe agbalẽ me ɖona ɖe ame le afi aɖe la, woawo dzie míewɔna le amea gbɔ.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Ke míawo la, míaƒo adegbe wòagbɔ liƒo dzi o, ke boŋ míase ɖe afi si Mawu ɖo na mí la, eye dɔ si míewɔ le mia dome hã le eme.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Míawoe nye ame gbãtɔ siwo zɔ ʋuu tsɔ Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la vɛ na mi. Eya ta ne míele nu ƒom le mia ŋuti la, míegbɔ liƒo dzi o, elabe míewɔ dɔ va ɖo mia gbɔ.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Ale míeƒoa adegbe wògbɔa liƒo dzi, gena ɖe ame bubuwo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me o. Le esia teƒe la, míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔe nye be miaƒe xɔse nadzi ɖe edzi, eye dɔ si wɔm míele le mia dome la nakeke ta.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Ale be míate ŋu agblɔ Nyanyui la agbɔ mia ŋu ayi ɖe dukɔ bubuwo hã me, eye magahiã be míaƒo adegbe le dɔ si ame aɖewo wɔ xoxo le teƒe mawo la ŋu o.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be, “Ne ame aɖe di be yeaƒo adegbe la, neƒo adegbe tso Aƒetɔ la ŋu.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Elabe menye ame si kafua eɖokui lae nye ame ɖɔʋu o, ke ame si Mawu kafuna la boŋ ye.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: Taflatsɛ, mele movinu aɖe wɔ ge. Mise egɔme nam. Migabui vɔ̃e nam fũu o.

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: Mele ŋu ʋãm, abe ale si Mawu ʋãa ŋui la ene ɖe mia ta. Metsɔ mi abe ɖetugbi dzadzɛ, si mede ŋutsu gbɔ kpɔ o la ene na Kristo be wòaɖe, eye be eya ɖeka ko nanye mia srɔ̃ŋutsu.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Ke mele vɔvɔ̃m be abe ale si da tsɔ aye ble Eva ene la, wole susu tɔtɔ ge na miawo hã, ale be miagate ŋu ato nyateƒe na Kristo asubɔe kple dzi dzadzɛ o.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe va ɖe gbeƒã Yesu bubu, si to vovo tso esi míeɖe gbeƒãe na mi la gbɔ, alo miexɔ gbɔgbɔ bubu, si to vovo tso esi miexɔ tsã la gbɔ, alo miexɔ nyanyui aɖe, si to vovo tso esi miexɔ la gbɔ la, ekema miedze agbagba do dzi xɔe kaba akpa!

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Nyemebu be amedɔdɔ deŋgɔ mawo nyo wum le go aɖeke me kura o.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Ne nyemete ŋu ƒoa nu nyuie o hã la, menya nu tso nu geɖe ŋu ya nyuie. Le nyateƒe me la, míena esia me kɔ na mi ƒãa le nu sia nu me le go sia go me.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Esi meɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe Nyanyui la na mi la, nyemexɔ naneke le mia si o. Mebɔbɔ ɖokuinye ɖe anyi boŋ be woado miawo ɖe dzi. Esia nye nuvɔ̃ mewɔa?

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Esi menɔ mia dome, eye hiã tum la, nyemeɖe fu na ame aɖeke o. Nɔvi siwo tso Makedonia va lae di nu siwo hiãm la nam. Ale megbe nyemeɖe fu na ame aɖeke le naneke me o, eye nyemawɔe hã o.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Zi ale si Kristo ƒe nyateƒe la le menye ko la, naneke mate ŋu axe mɔ nam, ale be nyematsɔ esia aƒo adegbee le Axaya-nutoawo me o.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Nu ka tae? Be nyemelɔ̃ mi o taa? Mawu nya be melɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Ke nu si wɔm mele la, mayi edzi, ale be maɖe kè le ame siwo gblɔna dàdatɔe be ale si yewowɔa dɔe la sɔ kple mía tɔ la te.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Amedɔdɔ alakpatɔwoe nye ame siawo, dɔwɔla ameblelawoe. Wowɔ wo ɖokui abe Kristo ƒe amedɔdɔwoe wonye ene.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Ẽ, mewɔ nuku o, elabe Satana ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã trɔa eɖokui abe kekeli ƒe mawudɔla ene.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Ale mewɔ mo yaa kura be eƒe dɔlawo hã natrɔ wo ɖokui abe dɔla siwo wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la ene o. Woƒe nuwuwu asɔ kple woƒe nuwɔnawo. Fu siwo Paulo kpe abe amedɔdɔ ene

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Megale egblɔm ake be ame aɖeke megabu be movitɔe menye o. Evɔ ne miegabum nenema hã la, ekema mixɔm abe movitɔ ene, ale be nye hã mate ŋu aƒo adegbe vi aɖe.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, nya si gblɔm mele la, menye Aƒetɔ lae na ŋusẽm be magblɔe o, ke mele egblɔm abe ale si dzi ɖoa movitɔ ƒo, wòƒoa adegbee la ene.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Esi wònye xexemenuwoe ame geɖewo tsɔna ƒoa adegbee ta la, nye hã matsɔ wo aƒoe.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Esi wònye nunyalawo mienye ta la, miegbɔa dzi blewuu hesea nya me na movitɔwo.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe tsɔ mi wɔ kluvii, alo wɔ nu vevi mi, alo ba mi, alo amea mekpɔ mi ɖe naneke me o la, ɖeko miegbɔa dzi ɖi nɛ.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Enye ŋukpe nam be malɔ̃ ɖe edzi be míegbɔdzɔ nenema gbegbe. Ke nu sia nu si ame aɖe do dzi be yeatsɔ aƒo adegbee la, nye hã mado dzi atsɔe aƒoe.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Ame siawo ɖe, Hebritɔwo wonye loo? Nye hã Hebritɔ menye. Israelviwo wonye loo? Nye hã Israelvi menye. Abraham tɔgbuiyɔviwo wonye loo? Nye hã Abraham tɔgbuiyɔvi menye.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Kristo ƒe dɔlawo wonye loo? Menye Kristo ƒe dɔla nyui wu wo. Mewɔ dɔ sesĩe wu wo. Wodem gaxɔ me zi geɖe wu wo. Zi ale si woƒom la, mele xexlẽ me o, eye enuenu la, meɖoa kudo nu gɔ̃.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Zigbɔzi atɔ̃ sɔŋ Yudatɔwo ƒom, ati bla etɔ̃ vɔ asieke.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Romatɔwo ƒom kple woƒe ameƒoti zigbɔzi etɔ̃. Woƒu kpem zi ɖeka. Meɖo tɔdziʋu zigbɔzi etɔ̃ wògbã; zã blibo kple ŋkeke blibo metsi ƒu dzi.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Enuenu ne mele mɔ zɔm la, tɔ dea lénye ge; meɖoa ŋɔdzi me le adzodalawo, mía de Yudatɔwo kple ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã si me. Meɖoa ŋɔdzi me le du me, gbedadaƒo kple ƒu dzi siaa. Nenema ke meɖoa ŋɔdzi me le nɔvi alakpatɔwo hã si me.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Meku kutri wɔ dɔ sesĩe; metsi zãdomadɔlɔ̃e zi geɖe. Enuenu nuɖuɖu menɔa asinye o; dɔ kple tsikɔ wuam. Vuvɔ wɔam, eye nyemekpɔa teƒe aɖeke nɔna, alo kpɔa naneke dona o.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Nyemedi be maƒo nu le nu bubuwo ya ŋu o. Ke metsia dzodzodzoe gbe sia gbe elabe hameawo ƒe nyawo te ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe gbɔdzɔ la, nyee gbɔdzɔ wu. Ne wokplɔ ame aɖe de nuvɔ̃ me la, dziku wònyena nam.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ne mebe maƒo adegbe la, nu siwo me megbɔdzɔ le la woe matsɔ aƒo adegbee.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Mawu si nye Aƒetɔ Yesu Tɔ́, ame si wokafuna tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me la, nya be nyemele aʋatso kam o.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Le Damasko la, mɔ́mefia si le dua me ɖe Fia Areta teƒe la, na dzɔlawo nɔ dua ŋu dzɔm be woalém.

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: Ke amewo tsɔm de kusi me, ɖiɖim ɖe anyi to fesre nu le dua ƒe gli ŋu, eye mesí dzo le egbɔ.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be viɖe aɖeke mele adegbeƒoƒo me o hã la, ele nam be maƒo adegbe. Azɔ maƒo nu le ŋutega siwo Aƒetɔ la na mekpɔ kple nu siwo wòɖe fiam la ŋu.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, zi etɔ̃liae nye esi medzra ɖo be mava mia gbɔ. Nyemava nye agba na mi o, elabe nyemele miaƒe naneke dim o, negbe miawo ŋutɔ ko. Medze be viwo naƒo nu ƒu ada ɖi na wo dzilawo o, ke boŋ dzilawoe ƒoa nu ƒu dana ɖi na wo viwo.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Mebe menya be wokɔ ŋutsu sia yi ɖe Paradiso mee, ke nenye ŋutilã mee wònɔ de alo menye ŋutilã mee o hã la, nyemenya o. Mawue nya.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu sia se nya siwo ame mate ŋu agblɔ afia o, eye womate ŋu ake nu agblɔ o.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Evɔ ne mebe maƒo adegbe le ɖokuinye ŋu la, nyemaƒoe abe movitɔ ene o, elabe nu si magblɔ la, anye nyateƒe ɖeɖe sɔŋ. Ke nyemaƒo adegbe o, elabe ame aɖe ava bu be menye amegã wu ale si mele, eye eƒe susu le ŋunye masɔ kple nu si wòkpɔ le ŋunye, alo wòse le ŋunye la o.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Eya ta, be nyemagado ɖokuinye ɖe dzi tso nu geɖe, siwo Mawu ɖe fiam ŋuti o la, wode dɔ si le abe ŋu ene la, lã me nam. Dɔ sia zu Satana ƒe dɔla le lã me nam, eye wòɖea fu nam vevie, bene nyemagado ɖokuinye ɖe dzi akpa o.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Zigbɔzi etɔ̃ sɔŋ meɖe kuku na Mawu be wòana mavo tso dɔléle sia si me.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ke ɖeko wògblɔ nam be, “Amenuvenu si nèkpɔ tso gbɔnye la sɔ gbɔ na wò, elabe nye ŋusẽ dzena ƒãa, ne ŋusẽ aɖeke mele ame ŋutɔ ŋu o.” Eya ta matsɔ nu siwo na be ŋusẽ mele ŋunye o la ko aƒo adegbee dzidzɔtɔe geɖe wu, bene Kristo ƒe ŋusẽ naxɔ aƒe ɖe menye.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Esia ta ne ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye, eye wole dzuyem, alo mele fu kpem, alo woti yonyeme, alo nuwo mele edzi dzem nam nyuie o la, meɖea dzi ɖi le Kristo ta. Elabe ne ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye la, ekema megakpɔa ŋusẽ yeye. Paulo tsi dzi le Korintotɔwo ƒe agbenɔnɔ ŋu

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mewɔ movinu pɛ! Ke miawoe dɔm mewɔe, elabe miawoe wòle be miakafum hafi. Togbɔ be nyemeɖi naneke o hã la, amedɔdɔ deŋgɔ mawo menyo wum le go aɖeke me kura o.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Nukunu, dzesi kple ŋusẽdɔ geɖe, siwo mewɔ le mia dome dzigbɔɖeanyitɔe la, ɖo kpe edzi be amedɔdɔ akuakua menye vavã.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Nu nyui aɖe li, si mewɔ na hame bubuawo, hete miawo yaa? Menye eya koe nye be nyemezu agba na mi oa? Mitsɔ vodada sia kem.

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Makpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ be magblẽ nye ŋusẽ katã kple nye nuwo ɖe mia ta. Ne megalɔ̃ mi ɖe edzi geɖe wu la, nu ka ta miawo miaɖe miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ nam dzi akpɔtɔ?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Mina míatsɔe be nye ŋutɔ nyemenye agba na mi o. Ke ɖewohĩ miagblɔ be ayetɔe menye, eye meflu mi.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Meto ame siwo medɔ ɖo ɖe mi la dometɔ aɖe dzi ba mia?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Meɖe kuku na Tito be wòayi, eye medɔ nɔvi Kristotɔ la hã kpe ɖe eŋu ɖo ɖa. Tito va ba mia? Menye susu ɖeka koe le nye kple eya si, míetsɔ wɔ nu si míewɔ la oa? Menye mɔ ɖeka ko míeto oa?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Ke ɖe miele bubum le ɣeyiɣi siawo katã me be mía ɖokui ta ko ʋlim míele le mia gbɔa? Mele eme nenema o! Míele nu ƒom na mi, abe ale si Kristo adi be míaƒo nu na mi le Mawu ŋkume la ene. Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, nu si ko míedi be míawɔ lae nye be míakpe ɖe mia ŋu, ne miatsi ɖe edzi.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Mevɔ̃ be ɖewohĩ ne meva mia gbɔ la, nyemava tu mi, mianɔ abe ale si medi be mianɔ la ene o. Nenema ke miawo hã miele kpɔ ye ge, abe ale si miedi be manɔ la ene o. Ɖewohĩ dzrewɔwɔ, ŋuʋaʋã, dɔmedzoedodo, ɖokuitɔdidi, ameŋugbegblẽ, ameŋunyagbɔgblɔ, dàda kple masɔmasɔ anɔ mia dome.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Megavɔ̃ hã be ne meva la, nye Mawu la abɔbɔm ɖe anyi le mia ŋkume, eye mafa konyi ɖe ame geɖe, siwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ abe nu makɔmakɔ wɔwɔ, ahasiwɔwɔ kple hadzedze ene, ke wometrɔ dzime o la nu.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Zi etɔ̃liae nye esi megbɔna ɖe mia gbɔ. Mawunya gblɔ be, “Ne wotsɔ nya ɖe ame aɖe ŋu la, ele be ɖaseɖila eve, alo etɔ̃ nagblɔ be nya la le eme hafi woabu fɔ ame la.”

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Esi meva mia gbɔ zi evelia la, megbe nya na ame siwo wɔ nuvɔ̃ tsã kple ame bubu ɖe sia ɖe. Fifia la, nyemegale mia gbɔ o, eye megale nya gbem na wo ake, elabe ne megava la, nyemagbe tohehe na wo o.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Esia nye kpeɖodzi si dim miele be yewoanya be Kristoe le nu ƒom to dzinye. Eya megbɔdzɔ le nu siwo wòwɔna kple mi la me o. Eƒe ŋusẽ le te le mia dome.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Esi woklãe ɖe ati ŋu la, egbɔdzɔ, ke Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ gbɔ agbee. Esi míewɔ ɖeka kpakplii la, míawo hã míegbɔdzɔ, ke Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ agbɔ agbe mí, ale be míawo hã míate ŋu awɔ nu si wòle be míawɔ kpakpli mi la.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Midzro mia ɖokui me kpɔ be miaƒe xɔse gale te mahã. Mido mia ɖokui kpɔ nyuie. Miekpɔe dze sii be Yesu Kristo le yewo me oa? Alo ɖe miedo mia ɖokui kpɔ, hekpɔ be yewomedze oa?

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be miava nya be míawo ya míele te.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Ke míele kuku ɖem na Mawu be miagawɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke o. Menye bene míadzé, abe ame siwo wodo kpɔ hekpɔ be wole te la ene ta o. Míele gbe sia dom ɖa bene miawɔ nu si dze, togbɔ be edzé abe míaƒe dɔwɔna ɖe medze edzi o ene hã.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Elabe míate ŋu awɔ naneke atsi tre ɖe nyateƒe la ŋuti o, ke nu si míawɔ adoe ɖe ŋgɔ ko míawɔ.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Ne míawo míegbɔdzɔ, eye ŋusẽ ɖo miawo mia ŋu la, edzɔa dzi na mí. Ale míedoa gbe ɖa be miayi ŋgɔ ahade blibo.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Esia tae mele nu sia ŋlɔm na mi esime nyemele mia gbɔ o, ale be ne meva ɖo la, nye asi nagasẽ ɖe mia dzi akpa le ŋusẽ si Aƒetɔ la nam la ŋudɔwɔwɔ me o. Wona ŋusẽ siam be matsɔe akpe ɖe mia ŋui miatsi, ke menye be matsɔe agblẽ nui o.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔvinyewo, minɔ anyi nyuie. Miɖɔ miaƒe agbenɔnɔ ɖo; miwɔ ɖe nye nuxlɔ̃amenya dzi; miaƒe tamesusu nesɔ; minɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me. Mawu si lɔ̃ amegbetɔ, eye wònaa ŋutifafa la, nenɔ kpli mi.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Mido gbe na mia nɔewo, eye ame sia ame nana asi nɔvia lɔlɔ̃tɔe. Ame siwo katã ŋu wokɔ la do gbe na mi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu, Mawu nelɔ̃ mi, eye Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe nenɔ mi katã mia dome!

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Mawu Tɔ́ la kple mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu, eye woana ŋutifafa mi.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristoe tsɔ eɖokui na ɖe míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta, be yeaɖe mí tso egbe xexe vɔ̃ɖi sia me. Esia nye mía Mawu kple Tɔ́ la ƒe didi.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Amen. Nyanyui ɖeka la

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Ewɔ nuku nam ŋutɔ be fifi laa ko, miele tɔtrɔm xoxo tso ame si to Kristo dzi, ve mia nu eye wòyɔ mi la gbɔ ɖo ta Nyanyui bubu ƒomevi aɖe gbɔ.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, Nyanyui bubu aɖeke megali hafi o, ke boŋ ame aɖewo koe li le to gblẽm na mi, eye wole didim be yewoatrɔ Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la bubui.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Ke nenye be ame aɖe, míawo loo, alo mawudɔla tso dziƒo gɔ̃ hã, ava gblɔ Nyanyui bubu aɖe, si to vovo tso esi míeɖe gbeƒãe na mi xoxo la gbɔ la, neɖi eŋu kpékpekpe!

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Nya si míegblɔ la, eya ke gblɔm megale. Mebe ne ame aɖe ɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui bubu aɖe, si to vovo tso esi miexɔ xoxo gbɔ la, neɖi eŋu kpékpekpe!

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, nya si gblɔm mele la, ɖe mele egblɔm be madze amegbetɔwo ŋu loo, alo Mawu ŋua? Ɖe mele didim be madze amegbetɔwo ŋua? Nenye ɖe megale didim be madze amegbetɔwo ŋu la, anye ne nyemeganye Kristo ƒe dɔla o. Ale si Paulo va zu amedɔdɔe

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, medi be mianya nyuie be Nyanyui si meɖe gbeƒãe miese la, menye amegbetɔ tɔe wònye o.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Nyemexɔe tso amegbetɔ aɖeke gbɔ o, eye menye ame aɖeke hãe fiam o, ke boŋ Yesu Kristoe ɖee fiam.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Miese ale si menɔ agbee tsã, abe Yudatɔ akuakua ene. Miese ale si meti Mawu ƒe hamea me nɔlawo yome vevie, eye medze agbagba vevie be matsrɔ̃ hamea.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Metsɔ dzo tɔxɛ ɖe mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe kɔnyinyiwo ŋuti ale gbegbe be menɔ ŋgɔ na hatinye geɖewo le Yudatɔnyenye me le mía detɔwo dome.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: Enyo dɔme ɖe Via fiam, ale be maɖe gbeƒã eƒe Nyanyui la, le ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, dome. Esi esia va eme la, nyemebia amegbetɔ aɖeke be nefia afɔɖoƒem o.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Nyemede Yerusalem gɔ̃ hã be makpɔ ame siwo zu amedɔdɔwo do ŋgɔ nam la hã o, ke boŋ meyi ɖe Arabia enumake, eye esi metrɔ gbɔ la, megava yi Damasko.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Ƒe etɔ̃ megbe hafi meyi ɖe Yerusalem be maɖakpɔ Kefas ɖa. Menɔ egbɔ ŋkeke wui atɔ̃.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Ke nyemekpɔ amedɔdɔ bubuawo dometɔ aɖeke o, negbe Yakobo, Aƒetɔ la nɔviŋutsu ko.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Nya si ŋlɔm mele na mi la, nyateƒee. Mawue nye nye ɖasefo be menye aʋatso kam mele o.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, mede Siria kple Kilikia nutoawo me.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Ke Kristo-hame siwo le Yudea-nyigba dzi la, mekpɔm kpɔ o.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Ɖeko wosee le amewo nu wole gbɔgblɔm be: “Ame si nɔ mía yome tim tsã la, va le gbeƒã ɖem xɔse sinu wòdi be yeatsi la!”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ale wokafu Mawu le tanye.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Le ƒe wui ene megbe la, nye kple Barnaba míegayi Yerusalem, eye mekplɔ Tito hã ɖe asi.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Mawue ɖee fiam hafi meyi. Meɖe kpɔ ame siwo dzé ame ŋkutawo le wo dome la, eye meƒo nu tso Nyanyui, si megblɔna na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la ŋu na wo. Mewɔ esia, be dɔ si wɔm mele tso ɣe aɖe ɣi ke la, nagazu dzodzro o.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Tito, si le ŋunye la nye Helatɔ hã la, ame aɖeke mezi edzi be netso aʋa o.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Ke hametɔ alakpatɔ aɖewo to ayemɔ dzi ge ɖe hame la me henɔ mɔnu dim be yewoagblẽ ablɔɖe si Kristo Yesu na mí la, awɔ mí míazu kluviwo.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Esi wònye ɖe míedi be nyateƒe blibo, si le Nyanyui la me nanɔ anyi dedie na mi ta la, míelɔ̃ ɖe woƒe nya la dzi kura o.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ame ŋkuta siwo buna be yewonye nane la, meɖo aɖaŋu aɖeke nam o. Mebe ame ŋkuta mawo meɖo aɖaŋu yeye aɖeke nam o.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ wokpɔe dze sii be dɔ si Mawu de asi nam lae nye be magblɔ Nyanyui la na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la, abe ale si wòdee asi na Petro hã, be eya nagblɔe na Yudatɔwo ene.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Elabe ame si to Petro dzi wɔ dɔ le Yudatɔwo dome la, eya kee to nye hã dzinye wɔ dɔ le ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la dome.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Yakobo kple Kefas kpakple Yohanes, ame siwo wobuna abe hamea ƒe sɔtiwo ene la, kpɔ dze sii be Mawu ve nunye ŋutɔ, eya ta wona asi nye kple Barnaba, tsɔ fia be yewoxɔ mí alɔ eve. Woɖo kpe edzi be míawo míayi ɖe ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la gbɔ, eye yewo hã yewoaɖo ta Yudatɔwo gbɔ.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Nu si ko wodi tso mía si be míawɔ lae nye be míaɖo ŋku ame dahe, siwo le yewo dome la dzi, evɔ la, esia tututue nye ŋutɔ hã medina be mawɔ. Paulo he nya ɖe Petro ŋu le Antioxia

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Esi Kefas va Antioxia la, metsi tre ɖe eŋu, ŋkume kple ŋkume, hehe nya ɖe eŋu, elabe ewɔ nu masɔmasɔ aɖe.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Hafi ame aɖewo natso Yakobo gbɔ ava la, Petro ɖua nu kple ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la. Ke esi ame siawo va ko la, ehe eɖokui ɖe aga, eye megadi be yeaɖu nu kple ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la o, elabe evɔ̃ na ame siwo gblɔ be ele be ame natso aʋa la.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Hametɔ bubu, siwo nye Yudatɔwo la hã de eƒe alakpanuwɔna sia dzi, ale be Barnaba kekeake hã wɔ alakpanu sia kpli wo.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Ke esi mekpɔ be nu si wòwɔ mesɔ ɖe nyateƒe si le Nyanyui la me nu o la, megblɔ na Kefas le wo katã ŋkume be: “Nenye be wò, ame si nye Yudatɔ, nànɔ agbe abe ame si menye Yudatɔ o ene la, nu ka ta nàtee ɖe ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la ya dzi, be woanɔ agbe abe Yudatɔwo ene?” Xɔse koe xɔ Yudatɔwo kple ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la ɖe agbe

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Yudatɔwo míenye tso dzɔdzɔme, eye menye ame manye Yudatɔ, nuvɔ̃wɔlawo o.

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: Míawo míenya be menye ame si le sea dzi wɔm lae woabu be ele dzɔdzɔe o, ke boŋ ame si xɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se lae. Eya ta míawo gɔ̃ hã míexɔ edzi se, be woabu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe, esi míexɔ edzi se la ta. Menye esi míewɔ sea dzi tae woabu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe o.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Ke nenye be míele agbagba dzem be woabu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe, elabe míewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo, emegbe wòva dze go be míawo hã míewɔa nuvɔ̃ la, ekema ɖe mefia be Kristo de nuvɔ̃ dzi oa? Gbeɖe!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Nenye be metu asi sedziwɔwɔ ƒu anyi, eye megagbugbɔe le fɔfɔm ɖe tsitrenu la, ekema nye ŋutɔ meɖe ɖokuinye fia abe sedzidala ene.

english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: Nye kple Kristoe woklã ɖe atitsoga ŋu. Eya ta azɔ la, meganye nye ŋutɔe le agbe o, ke Kristo ye le agbe le menye. Agbe si mele le ŋutilã me fifia la, Mawu Vi si lɔ̃m, eye wòtsɔ eɖokui na ɖe tanye la dzixɔse mee meli ɖo.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Nyemeɖe ale si wòvea ame nui la ƒu gbe o, elabe nenye ɖe Mawu bunɛ na ame be esi wòwɔ Mose ƒe se la dzi ta ele dzɔdzɔe la, anye ne Kristo ƒe ku la zu dzodzro.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Aa, mi Galatiatɔ movitɔwo! Ame ka koŋ ye trɔ susu le tame na mi alea gbegbe? Ɖe menye miawo ŋutɔ mia ŋkumee woɖee fia le kɔtɔe le dutoƒo be woklã Yesu Kristo ɖe atitsoga ŋu oa?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Mina mabia nya ɖeka sia mi: Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɛe si miexɔ la, sea dzi miewɔ kaka xɔe loo, alo Nyanyui lae miese, hexɔ edzi se tae miexɔea?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Movitɔwo mienye alea gbegbea? Esi mietsɔ Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dze egɔmee ɖe, miawo ŋutɔ miaƒe ŋusẽ miebe yewoatsɔ awu enui azɔa?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Ɖe nu siwo katã teƒe miekpɔ la zu dzodzroa? Womanye dzodzro kura o ɖe!

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Ale si miewɔa sea dzi tae Mawu tsɔ Gbɔgbɔ la na mi, hele nukudɔwo wɔm le mia dome ɖo loo, alo esi miese eƒe nya la hexɔ edzi se la taea?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be: “Wobu Abraham be enye ame dzɔdzɔe, elabe exɔ Mawu dzi se.”

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Eya ta ele be mianya, be ame siwo si xɔse le la woe nye Abraham viwo.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Mawunya kpɔe do ŋgɔ, be Mawu gbɔna ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la wɔ ge woazu ame dzɔdzɔewo, le xɔse si le wo si la ta. Esia tae wògblɔ Nyanyui la na Abraham xoxo da ɖi be: “Woayra anyigba dzi dukɔwo katã to dziwò.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Eya ta azɔ la, ame siwo xɔ sè la, woyra wo kpe ɖe Abraham, xɔsetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Ke woƒo fi de ame siwo katã lé sea dzi wɔwɔ me ɖe asi, elabe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Ame sia ame si mezɔna ɖe nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe segbalẽa me nu, eye wòwɔa wo dzi o la, fiƒode le edzi.”

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Azɔ edze ƒãa be Mawu mebua ame aɖeke be ele dzɔdzɔe, ɖe esi wòwɔ sea dzi la ta o, elabe mawunya gagblɔ be: “Ame si ƒe xɔse nana be wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, anɔ agbe.”

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Ke se la metsɔ ɖeke le xɔse ƒe nya me o, elabe nu si woŋlɔ tso eŋuti lae nye be: “Ame si wɔa wo dzi la, anɔ agbe.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Esi Kristo trɔ zu fiƒodeme ɖe mía teƒe ta la, eɖe mí tso se la ƒe fiƒode te, elabe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya la me be: “Ame sia ame si woklã ɖe ati ŋu la, fiƒode le edzi.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Ale be to Kristo Yesu dzi la, woayra xexemedukɔ bubuwo hã, abe ale si woyra Abraham ene, eye míatsɔ xɔse axɔ Gbɔgbɔ si ŋugbe Mawu do la. Se la kple Ŋugbedodo la

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, medi be mana kpɔɖeŋu aɖe mi tso agbenɔnɔ me. Mienya be ne ame aɖe ŋlɔ nu le ale si woanyi eƒe dome ŋu da ɖi, eye wòɖo kpe edzi vɔ ko la, womegatea fli ɖe eme, alo gatsɔa nya aɖeke kpenɛ o.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Abraham kple eƒe dzidzimevie Mawu do ŋugbe na. Womegblɔ be “na dzidzimewo” abe dzidzime geɖewo gblɔm wòle ene o, ke boŋ wobe “na wò dzidzimevi”, si fia be ame ɖeka hɔ̃ ko glɔm wòle. Ame siae nye Kristo.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Nenye be Mawu ƒe nunana sia, ɖe wòtso sea me la, anye ne meganye ŋugbedodo o. Evɔ la, nu wònye Mawu tsɔ do ŋugbe na Abraham faa.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Ke fifia ɖe, nu ka tae se la li ɖo? Ɖe wotsɔ sea vɛ be wòana ame nadze si nu si nye vodada, va se ɖe esime dzidzimevi si wodo ŋugbea na la nava. Gawu la, mawudɔlawoe tsɔ sea na ame si nye domenɔla wòtsɔ vɛ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Ke domenɔla menɔa anyi na ame ɖeka o, evɔ la, Mawu ya, ɖeka hɔ̃ koe. Se la ƒe taɖodzinu

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Se la ɖe wòtsi tre ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋugbedodoawo ŋua? Kura koŋ o! Nenye be ŋusẽ ɖe wòle se la si be wòana ame nanɔ agbe la, anye ne ame awɔ se dzi anɔ dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ke mawunya ya bu nuwo katã abe nu siwo le nuvɔ̃ te la ene, ale be ŋugbedodo si kpe ɖe Kristo dzixɔse ŋu la, nanye ame siwo xɔ edzi se la tɔ.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Azɔ, hafi Kristo dzixɔse nava la, se la lé mí de kpɔ me tu ʋɔ ɖe mía nu hele lalam na ɣeyiɣi si me Mawu ahe Kristo dzixɔse sia avɛ la.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ale se la nɔ mía kplɔm va se ɖe esime Kristo va, ale be woabu mí ame dzɔdzɔewoe, elabe míexɔ edzi se.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Ke esi Kristo dzixɔse la va ɖo azɔ la, míegale kplɔla aɖeke te o.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Elabe esi mi katã miexɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se hewɔ ɖeka kplii ko la, miezu Mawu viwo.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo katã wole mawutsi na, be miawɔ ɖeka kple Kristo la, mietsɔ Kristo do abe awu ene.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Eya ta vovototo aɖeke megale Yudatɔ kple Helatɔ, kluvi kple ablɔɖevi, ŋutsu kple nyɔnu dome o, ke boŋ mi katã miewɔ ɖeka hele hadede me kple Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Nenye be mienye Kristo tɔ la, ekema Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwo mienye, eye mienye nu si ŋugbe wodo la ƒe domenyilawo.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Nu si mewɔnɛ lae nye be, ne vi aɖe nye domenyila, evɔ wògale ɖevime ko la, togbɔ be domenyinuawo katã nye etɔ hã la, zi ale si wòganye ɖevi ko la, vovototo mele eya kple kluvi dome o.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: Ele amedzikpɔlawo kple nuawo dzikpɔlawo ƒe ŋusẽ te, va se ɖe esime ɣeyiɣi si tɔ́a ɖo ɖi na eƒe nuawo xɔxɔ la nade.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Nenema ke míawo hã, le míaƒe ɖevime la, míenɔ gbɔgbɔ siwo dzɔ kple xexea me la ƒe ŋusẽ te, abe kluviwo ene.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Ke esi ɣeyiɣia de la, Mawu ɖo Via ɖa. Nyɔnue dzii le se la te.

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: Eyae wòɖo ɖa be wòava xe fe ɖe ame siwo le sea te la ta, axɔ mí awɔ viwoe.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Mawu di be yeafia be ye viwo mienye, eya ta wòɖo Via ƒe Gbɔgbɔ si doa ɣli lɔlɔ̃tɔe be: “Ao, Tɔ́nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ!” la, ɖa ɖe míaƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Ale le Mawu ta la, mèganye kluvi azɔ o, ke èzu vi, eye ne èzu vi la, ekema èzu Mawu ƒe nuwo domenyila hã to Kristo dzi. Paulo meɖe dzi ɖi le Galatiatɔwo ŋuti o

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Tsã la, esime mienya Mawu o la, mienye kluviwo na nu siwo dze kɔtɛe be womenye mawu o la.

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: Ke azɔ esi mieva nya Mawu, alo magblɔ boŋ be Mawu va nya mi la, ale ke wɔ miegale didim be yewoagbugbɔ ayi gbɔgbɔ mawo gbɔ, be miaganye woƒe kluviwo? Mikpɔ ɖa, togbɔ be wodzɔ kple xexea me hã la, wonye gbɔgbɔ siwo ŋu ŋusẽ mele kura o.

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Mietia ŋkeke aɖewo, ɣleti aɖewo, ɣeyiɣi aɖewo kple ƒe aɖewo da ɖi henyia kɔ tɔxɛ le wo dzi.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nam abe agbagba si katã medze le mia ŋu la, zu dzodzro vɔ ene.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, mitrɔ zu abe nye ene dzro, elabe nye hã metrɔ zu abe miawo ene. Miewɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Abe ale si mienya ene la, nye lãmegbegblẽe na be meva gblɔ mawunya na mi zi gbãtɔ.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ale si menɔ sesẽ na mi hã la, nyemenyɔ ŋu na mi be miagbem xɔxɔ o, ke boŋ miexɔm abe mawudɔla, alo abe ale si miaxɔ Kristo Yesu ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hãe ene.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Dzidzɔ kple vivi si miedo ɖe ŋunye ɣe ma ɣi la ɖe, afi kae wòle fifia? Nye ŋutɔ mate ŋu aɖi ɖase na mi be ɣe ma ɣi la, nenye ɖe wòanyawɔ la, anye ne miabe yewoaho yewoƒe ŋku le eto me gɔ̃ hã atsɔ nam hafi.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Esi meto nyateƒe na mi tae meva zu miaƒe futɔa?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Ame siwo le vivi dom ɖe mia ŋu la, mia flum ko wole. Ɖeko wodi be yewoaɖe mi ɖa le ŋunye, ale be miatrɔ ɖe woawo boŋ ŋuti.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Enyo be miatsi dzi ɖe nu nyui wɔwɔ ŋu ɣe sia ɣi, ke menye ne mele mia gbɔ ɖeɖe ko o.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: Vinye lɔlɔ̃awo, mele veve sem ɖe mia ta, abe nyɔnu si fú le ɖuɖum la ene, va se ɖe esime nɔnɔme si le Kristo si la, nage ɖe mia me.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: Nenye mia gbɔe mele fifi laa la, anye ne anyo pɛ hafi. Nye gbe ɖeko wòatrɔ ahaɖe ale si miele nam la afia. Metsi dzi ɖe mia ŋu vevie ŋutɔ. Hagar kple Sara ƒe kpɔɖeŋu

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo di be se la naɖu yewo dzi la, miɖo nya sia ŋu nam: Ɖe miese nu si se la gblɔ oa?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Ebe viŋutsuvi evee nɔ Abraham si. Ɖeka nye kosi vi, eye evelia nye ablɔɖenyɔnu vi.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Ɖevi si kosia dzi la, wodzii abe ale si amegbetɔ dzia vi ko la ene. Ke ɖevi si ablɔɖenyɔnua dzi ya la, Mawue do eŋugbe na edzilawo.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Nu siawo le nu tɔxɛ aɖewo fiam: Nyɔnu eve siawo le nubabla eveawo teƒe. Wo dometɔ ɖekae nye Hagar. Etso Sinai-to dzi, eye ɖevi siwo wòdzi la, wonye kluviwo.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Hagar sɔ kple Sinai-to le Arabia. Eyae nye Yerusalem-du si li egbe la, elabe eya kple emenɔlawo katã ganye kluviwo ko.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Ke Yerusalem-du si le dziƒo ya la, ablɔɖedue. Eyae nye mía nɔ,

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: elabe mawunya gblɔ be: “Wò, konɔ, kpɔ dzidzɔ! Wò, nyɔnu si medzi vi kpɔ o, do ɣli, eye nàfa dzidzɔvi, wò, ame si melé ku kpɔ o! Elabe nyɔnu, si gbɔ srɔ̃a dzo le la, viwo asɔ gbɔ wu nyɔnu, si le srɔ̃a gbɔ ɖaa la tɔwo.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nɔvinyewo, miawo la, ɖe wodo mia ŋugbe hafi dzi, abe Isak ene.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Tsã ma la, ame si wodzi, abe ale si amegbetɔ dzia vi ko ene la, ɖe wòti ame si ŋugbe wodo hafi dzi la yome. Nenema ke ko wògale egbe hã.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Ke nu ka mawunya la gblɔ? Ebe: “Nyà kosi la kple via woadzo, elabe kosi vi mele dome nyi ge kple ablɔɖenyɔnu vi o.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Ale, nɔviwo, menye kosi viwo míenye o, ke boŋ ablɔɖenyɔnua viwoe míenye.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Ablɔɖee Kristo di be míakpɔ tae wòɖe mí ɖo, eya ta minɔ tsitre sesĩe, eye migana woate mi ɖe to, be woagawɔ mi kluviwoe ake o.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nye Paulo, mele egblɔm na mi be, ne mieɖe mɔ wotso aʋa na mi la, Kristo meganye viɖe aɖeke na mi o.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo le didim be woabu yewo be yewole dzɔdzɔe, elabe miewɔ sea dzi la, mieɖe mia ɖokui ɖa le Kristo ŋuti. Ale mietrɔ megbe de Mawu be negave yewo nu azɔ o.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Le mía gome ya la, míegbɔ dzi blewuu hele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be woabu mí be míele dzɔdzɔe, elabe míexɔ Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dzi se.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu la, wotso aʋa na ame aɖe o, wometsoe nɛ o, mewɔ naneke o. Nu si ko le vevie nye ale si míatsɔ xɔse alɔ̃ mía nɔewoe.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Mienɔ agbagba dzem ŋutɔ tsã hafi. Ame ka gɔ̃e va xe mɔ na mi be miagaɖo to nyateƒe la o?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Menye ame si yɔ mi vɛ lae trɔ miaƒe susu alea o.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Amɔwɔʋãnu vi aɖe koe nana be amɔwɔ blibo la ʋãna.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Meka ɖe edzi be Aƒetɔ la awɔe be miegale ame aɖeke ƒe susu xɔ ge o, negbe tɔnye ko. Ke ame ka kee le miaƒe susu trɔm hã la, Mawu le to he ge nɛ kokoko.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ke ne ɖe megale gbeƒã ɖem kokoko be ele vevie be woatso aʋa la, nu ka tae woaganɔ yonyeme tim? Ke ne ɖe wònye nenemae megblɔ la, anye ne nu si nye nuɖianu le Kristo ƒe atitsoga la ŋu la ɖe ɖae!

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Ame siwo le susu tɔtɔm na mi alea gbegbe ɖe, womatsɔ hɛ atá wo ɖokui ko wòavɔ oa?

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ɖe woyɔ mi vɛ be miava kpɔ ablɔɖe, avo. Ɖeko ablɔɖe si miekpɔ la naganye mɔɖeɖe na nuvɔ̃ɖi, siwo miaƒe ŋutilã dina la o. Ke boŋ misubɔ mia nɔewo kple lɔlɔ̃,

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: elabe sea ƒe taƒonyae nye nyagbe sia be: “Lɔ̃ hawòvi abe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Ke ne miele nu vevi wɔm mia nɔewo abe lã wɔadãwo ene la, mikpɔ nyuie be miava wu mia nɔewo o. Vovototo si le Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ kple amegbetɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔme dome

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Elabe nu siwo amegbetɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔme dina la, tsi tre ɖe Gbɔgbɔ la tɔwo ŋuti, eye nu siwo Gbɔgbɔ la hã dina la, tsi tre ɖe ame ƒe dzɔdzɔme tɔwo ŋuti. Nu siawo tsi tre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋuti, bene miagawɔ nu si miedi la o.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Ke ne Gbɔgbɔ la le mia kplɔm la, ekema miegale se la te o.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, dɔ siwo amegbetɔ ƒe dzɔdzɔme wɔna la dzena ƒãa. Esiawo nye: matrewɔwɔ, nu makɔmakɔ wɔwɔ, hadzedze,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: dɔmevevi, ahamumu, aglotutu kple nu siwo ɖi esiawo tɔgbe wɔwɔ. Megale egblɔm na mi da ɖi, abe ale si megblɔe na mi da ɖi tsã la ene, be ame siwo wɔa nu siawo tɔgbe la, manyi mawufiaɖuƒe la dome akpɔ o.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Ke nu siwo doa go tso Gbɔgbɔ la me la woe nye: lɔlɔ̃, dzidzɔ, ŋutifafa, dzigbɔɖi, dɔmenyo, nu nyui wɔwɔ, nuteƒewɔwɔ,

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: tufafa kple ɖokuidziɖuɖu. Se aɖeke metsi tre ɖe nu siawo dometɔ aɖeke ŋu o.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Ame siwo nye Kristo Yesu tɔ la, klã woƒe ŋutilã kple eƒe nudzroamewo kple fieŋufieŋuwo katã ɖe atitsoga ŋuti.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Nenye Gbɔgbɔ lae na agbe mí la, ekema mina míanɔ agbe ɖe eƒe didi nu.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Migana míado mía ɖokui ɖe dzi, alo ado dziku na mía nɔewo, alo aʋã ŋu mía nɔewo o. o.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne mia dometɔ aɖe da vo la, mi ame siwo kplɔm Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ le la, midze agbagba, miagbɔ dzi ɖi blewuu aɖɔe ɖo. Ke kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi nyuie be womagate wò ŋutɔ hã akpɔ o.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Mikpe fu ɖe mia nɔewo ti, ale be miawɔ Kristo ƒe se la dzi.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe bu be yenye nane, evɔ menye naneke o la, eɖokui ko flum wòle.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame nedo eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuwɔna kpɔ. Ne ewɔ esia la, akpɔ nu si ŋu wòaƒo adegbe le, le eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ɖeɖe ko me. Ke menye be wòatsɔ eƒe nuwɔna asɔ kple ame bubu tɔ o,

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: elabe ame sia ame le eya ŋutɔ ƒe agba tsɔ ge.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Ame si le nu srɔ̃m tso mawunya ŋu la, nena ame si le nua fiamee la nakpɔ gome le nu nyui siwo katã le esi la me.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Migable mia ɖokui o. Womeflua Mawu o. Nu si ame ƒã la, eya ke wòaŋe.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒã nu ɖe ŋutilãmedidi me la, nu si wòaŋe tso eme lae nye gbegblẽ. Ke ame si ƒã nu ɖe Gbɔgbɔmedidi me la, agbe mavɔe nye nu si wòaŋe tso eme.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Migana nu nyui wɔwɔ nati mí o, elabe ne meti mí o la, míava kpɔ eme viɖe le ɣeyiɣi si dze la dzi.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Eya ta esi mɔnukpɔkpɔ gale mía si la, mina míawɔ nu nyui na ame sia ame, vevietɔ na míaƒe Kristo ƒome la, si nye xɔsetɔwo. Nuxlɔ̃amenya kple gbedoname

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesi lolo siwo nye ŋutɔ metsɔ asi ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi la ɖa!

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Ame siwo di be yewoadze amegbetɔwo ŋu lae le fu ɖem na mi be wonetso aʋa na mi. Nu si ta wole nu sia wɔm ɖo koe nye be amewo nagati wo yome le Kristo ƒe atitsoga la ta o.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wotso aʋa na gɔ̃ hã mewɔa sea dzi o. Nu si ko dim ame siawo le be yewoawɔe nye be yewoaƒo adegbe be miawo gɔ̃ hã miebɔbɔ ɖe yewoƒe se la te, eye miena wotso aʋa na mi.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, nyemegadi kura be maƒo adegbe na mi tso nu bubu aɖeke ŋu, wu mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe atitsoga la o. Kristo mee woklã xexea me ɖe atitsoga ŋu ɖo nam, eye Kristo me kee woklã nye hã ɖe atitsoga ŋu ɖo na xexea me.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Wotso aʋa na ame aɖe o, womeɖatso aʋa nɛ o, eya mele vevie o. Ame yeye nyenye lae le vevie.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Mawu neve ame siwo zɔna ɖe ɖoɖo sia nu la nu, eye wòana ŋutifafa wo. Newɔ esia na eƒe Israel yeye la hã.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Tso fifia dzi heyina la, ame aɖeke megaɖe fu nam o, elabe nye la, abikukuteƒe siwo le ŋunye la fia be Yesu tɔ menye.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve miaƒe gbɔgbɔ nu! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Nye Paulo, ame si va zu Kristo Yesu ƒe amedɔdɔ to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me lae le agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi, ame siwo ŋu wokɔ le Efeso, eye mienye nuteƒewɔla siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Mawu neve mia nu, eye ŋutifafa si tso Mawu mía Tɔ́ kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo gbɔ la, nenɔ kpli mi. Mawu yra ame siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Míekafu Mawu, si nye mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Tɔ́, elabe esi míewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo ta la, eto Gbɔgbɔ la dzi tsɔ nu nyui ɖe sia ɖe si le keke dziƒonutowo me ke la yra míi.
