english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Hafi Mawu nawɔ xexea me la, etia mí da ɖi xoxo, be míava wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo, ale be míanye ame kɔkɔewo kple ame siwo ŋu mokaka manɔ o la le eŋkume.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu lɔ̃ mí ta la, eɖoe da ɖi xoxo be to míaƒe ɖekawɔwɔ kple Yesu Kristo me la, míazu ye viwo. Esia koŋ ye nye eƒe didi.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: Esia ta ele be míakafu Mawu, elabe nukutɔe la, eve mía nu faa to Via lɔlɔ̃ la dzi.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ena míenya ɖoɖo si wòwɔ le Kristo ŋu heɣla da ɖi la, eye míese egɔme bliboe.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Esiae nye be ne ɣeyiɣia de la, woaƒo nu siwo katã le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi la nu ƒu ɖekae ade Kristo te.

english_verse: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.
translation_verse: Mawu na nu sia nu si wòdi la va eme pɛpɛpɛ le eya ŋutɔ ƒe didi nu. Eya ŋutɔe ɖoe ɖi be miawɔ ɖeka kple Kristo.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu tia mí, ame siwo le mɔ kpɔm na Kristo xoxoxo la ɖi be míanɔ agbe akafu yeƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Esia tae esi miawo hã miese nyateƒenya, si nye Nyanyui si ɖe gbeƒã be Mawu ɖe mi, elabe miexɔ Mawu dzi se ta la, etsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe si ŋugbe wòdo la de dzesi mi da ɖi.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ siae nye kpeɖodzinu na mí be míawo hã míele Mawu ƒe dome nyi ge godoo. Kpeɖodzinu sia anɔ mía si va se ɖe esime domenyinu la nava su mía si bliboe. Paulo ƒe gbedodoɖa

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Le susu sia ta la, esi mese be miexɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu dzi se, eye mese ale si mielɔ̃ ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: akpedada dzi ko mele na Mawu ɖe mia ta ɖaa. Meɖoa ŋku mia dzi ne mele gbe dom ɖa,

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: eye mebia mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe Mawu, ame si nye Ŋutikɔkɔekatãtɔ la, be wòana gbɔgbɔ si ana miadze nunya la mi, eye be wòaɖe Mawu afia mi, be mianya ame si wònye la.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Mebianɛ be wòaʋu miaƒe ŋkuwo, be miakpɔ nu si wòyɔ mi vɛ, be miava kpɔ mɔ na la; ale si gbegbe domenyinu siwo li na eƒe ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la xɔ asii,

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: kple ale si eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la le dɔ wɔm le mí, ame siwo xɔ edzi se la mee. Ŋusẽ sia, si le dɔ wɔm le mia me la,

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: sɔ kple ŋusẽ si wotsɔ fɔ Kristo ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye wòna wòbɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe eƒe ɖusime le dziƒowo la.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Dziɖuɖuwo, ŋusẽ siwo le amegbetɔwo si ɖe nuwo dzi kple ŋusẽ tɔxɛ bubuwo katã kpakple fiaɖuƒewo le ete. Eŋkɔ ƒo ŋkɔ siwo katã le fifi xexe kple xexe si le vava ge la me la ta.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ nu sia nu de Kristo ƒe afɔ te, eye wòtsɔe na hamea abe nuwo katã ƒe ta ene.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Hame siae nye Kristo ƒe ŋutilã si na wòde blibo, eye Kristo hãe nye ame si naa nuwo katã tim dea blibo.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Tsã la, esi mieda vo, eye miewɔ nuvɔ̃ la, ɖe mieku; ke fifia la, wogbɔ agbe mi.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Le ɣe ma ɣi me la, mienɔ agbe abe xexemetɔwo ene. Mieɖo to ŋusẽ siwo le ya me dzi ɖum la ƒe fia. Eyae nye gbɔgbɔ si le dɔ wɔm fifia, le ame siwo gbe be yewomaɖo to Mawu o la me.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ame siawo domee mí katã míenɔ kpɔ, hezɔ ɖe nudzodzro si hona le míaƒe ŋutilã me la nu. Nu si míaƒe ŋutilã kple susu di be míawɔ lae míewɔna. Nɔnɔme sia, si nɔ mía me tae Mawu do dɔmedzoe ɖe mía ŋu, abe ale si wòdoe ɖe amegbetɔƒomea katã hã ŋui ene.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: togbɔ be míeda vo heku hã la, ena míegbɔ agbe kple Kristo. Mawu ɖe wòve mía nu koŋ heɖe mí.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Esi míewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu ta la, efɔ mí ɖe tsitre kplii, eye wòna míebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Kristo gbɔ le dziƒonutowo me.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Mawu wɔ esia be yeaɖee afia dzidzime siwo agava dzɔ la be seɖoƒe aɖeke meli na ale si yeve mía nu, henyo dɔme na míi le Kristo Yesu ta la o.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Eve mia nu heɖe mi, esi miexɔ edzi se la ta. Menye miawo ŋutɔe wɔ naneke o, ke boŋ Mawu ƒe nunana wònye.

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: Nenema ke menye ame aɖeke ƒe agbagbadzedzee hee vɛ, ne wòava tsɔe aƒo adegbee o.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Elabe Mawue wɔ mí kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe asi, be míawɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu, ale be míawɔ dɔ nyui, siwo ŋuti wòtrɔ asi le da ɖi be míava wɔ la. Ame siwo xɔ Kristo dzi se la nye dukɔ ɖeka

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku edzi, be menye Yuda vidzidziwo mienye o. Yudatɔwo, ame siwo wotso aʋa na la, yɔa mi be bolobolotɔwo. Evɔ la, aʋatsotso sia la, ŋutilãmenu ko wònye, eye amegbetɔ koe tsɔ asi wɔe.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku edzi, be ɣe aɖe ɣi va yi la, adzɔge ke mienɔ tso Kristo gbɔ, eye mienye Israel-dukɔ la ƒe dumevi le mɔ aɖeke nu kura o. Mienya naneke le nu, si Mawu bla kple eƒe amewo kple nu siwo ŋugbe wòdo na wo la ŋu o. Gawu la, mɔkpɔkpɔ aɖeke menɔ mia si na naneke o, eye Mawu aɖeke gɔ̃ hã menɔ mia si o.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Ke fifia la, to Kristo ƒe ʋu si wokɔ ɖi me la wokplɔ mi, ame siwo nɔ adzɔge ʋĩi tsã la va wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Eyae he ŋutifafa va mía dome, hewɔ mí akpa eveawo ɖekae, eye wòɖe dzrewɔwɔ si zu gli ma mía dome la ɖa.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: Eɖe Yudatɔwo ƒe se la kple kɔnyinyiwo ɖa, to agbe si wònɔ le ŋutilã me la me, be yeaƒo ƒu akpa eveawo, awɔ wo ame yeye ɖekae, be woawɔ ɖeka kple ye, ale be ŋutifafa nava.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Kristo to ku si wòku le atitsoga ŋuti la me lé avu akpa eveawo, eye wòwɔ wo ame yeye ɖekae na Mawu. Ale wɔ dzre la ke.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Esi wòva la, eɖe gbeƒã na mi, ame siwo nɔ adzɔge ʋĩi ke kple ame siwo le kpuiƒe siaa, be ŋutifafa va azɔ loo!

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: To eyama me la, mɔ ʋu siaa azɔ, be Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la nakplɔ mí, akpa eveawo katã, ava Mawu Tɔ́ la gbɔe.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Ale mieganye amedzrowo alo mɔzɔla siwo va to anyigba aɖe dzi ko yina la o, ke boŋ mi kple ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la, miezu dukɔ ɖeka ƒe dumeviwo kple Mawu ƒe aƒemetɔwo.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Gɔmeɖoɖo si amedɔdɔwo kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ɖo anyi la dzie wotu mi ɖo, eye Kristo Yesu ŋutɔe nye dzogoedzikpe la.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Eya dzie wokpe xɔtutu la ƒe akpa vovovoawo katã ɖo wòbla zu xɔ ɖeka, eye eyae nana be xɔ blibo la tsina ɖe edzi va zua gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe na Aƒetɔ la.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Esi miewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo ta la, wotsɔ miawo hã tu xɔa ƒe akpa aɖe, bene mi katã miazu aƒe si me Mawu ato eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dzi anɔ la.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ mianyase ale si Mawu ve nunye, eye wòɖom dzikpɔlae be mawɔ dɔ le mia dome la.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Abe ale si meŋlɔ na mi kpuie va yi ene la, Mawu ɖe ɖoɖo si wòwɔ heɣla ɖi la fiam.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Ne miexlẽ agbalẽ sia la, miate ŋu akpɔ ale si mese nya ɣaɣla si le Kristo me la gɔmee.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Tsã la, womena amegbetɔƒomea nya ɖoɖo ɣaɣla sia o; ke fifia la, Mawu to eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la dzi ɖee fia eƒe amedɔdɔ kɔkɔeawo kple eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Ena be to Nyanyui la me la, ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la hã va zu dome ɖeka nyilawo kple Yudatɔwo, ŋutinuwo na ŋutilã ɖeka ma ke, eye woawo hã wova kpɔ gome azɔ le ŋugbe si wodo to Kristo Yesu dzi la me.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Mawu to eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ me ve nunye nukutɔe ale gbegbe be wòna meva zu Nyanyui sia ƒe subɔla.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Ale, togbɔ be menye suetɔ kekeake le ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ dome hã la, Mawu ve nunye be meɖe gbeƒã kesinɔnu gbogbo, siwo le Kristo me la na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Edɔm ɖo ɖa be mana amegbetɔƒomea nanya ɖoɖo si Mawu, ame si wɔ nuwo katã la, wɔ heɣla ɖi tso keke gbe aɖe gbe ke la,

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: ale be woato hamea dzi aɖe Mawu ƒe nunya sɔgbɔ la afia dziɖulawo kple ŋusẽtɔ siwo le dzi ɖum le dziƒonutowo me la.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Esia nye ɖoɖo mavɔ, si Mawu wɔ da ɖi tso keke gbe aɖe gbe ke. Azɔ ena ɖoɖo sia va eme to Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Esi míexɔ Kristo dzi se ta la, dzi ɖo mía ƒo be míate ɖe Mawu ŋu dzideƒotɔe.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Eya ta mele kuku ɖem na mi be fu siwo kpem mele ɖe mia teƒe la, nagana dzi naɖe le mia ƒo o, elabe bubu sɔŋ boŋ de ge wòala mia ŋu. Ale si Kristo lɔ̃ míi

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: Eya tɔe nye ƒome, siwo katã le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi la, eye eƒe ŋkɔe le wo ŋu.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Mele gbe dom ɖa be Mawu nana eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la natsɔ ŋusẽ si le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe gbago la me la ade keke miaƒe ememe la me ke.

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: Miaƒe xɔse nana be Kristo naxɔ anyinɔ ɖe miaƒe dzime, ne miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ naƒo ke ɖe to, ahali ke zã,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: eye ŋusẽ naɖo mia ŋu, ale be mia kple ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la katã miase ale si gbegbe Kristo lɔ̃ mii la gɔme. Lɔlɔ̃ sia keke ta; ede didiƒe ʋĩi; ekɔ yi dzi boo, eye wògoglo!

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Gawu la, Mawu nena miadze si Kristo ƒe lɔlɔ̃ si gbɔ amegbetɔ ƒe nugɔmesese ŋu yi sãa la, ale be Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme la nayɔ mia me taŋ!

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Ŋutikɔkɔe nanye eyama tɔ, le hame la kple Kristo Yesu me, to dzidzimewo katã dzi, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Amen.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nye, ame si le gaxɔ me le Aƒetɔ la ta la, mele kuku ɖem na mi, be mianɔ agbe si asɔ ɖe agbe si tɔgbe woyɔ mi be miava nɔ la nu.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui, eye minye ame fafawo. Migbɔ dzi blewuu, eye mitsɔ lɔlɔ̃ gbɔ dzi ɖi na mia nɔewo.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Esi Gbɔgbɔ la bla mi ɖekae la, mido vevie mianɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Ŋutilã ɖeka kple Gbɔgbɔ ɖeka koe li, nenema ke nu ɖeka dzaa koe Mawu yɔ mi be miava kpɔ mɔ na.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖeka kple xɔse ɖeka koe le mía si, eye mawutsi ɖeka ko hãe wole na mí.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Gawu la, Mawu kple Tɔ́ ɖeka koe li na amegbetɔƒomea katã. Eyae ɖu nuwo katã dzi, le dɔ wɔm to nuwo katã me, eye wòle nuwo katã me.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Eya tae mawunya gblɔ be: “Esi wòlia yi dzi ʋĩi la, aboyome geɖewo nɔ eyome, eye wòma nunanawo na amewo.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi wogblɔ be, “Elia yi dzi” la, edze ƒãa be eɖi va yi keke anyigba tume ke hã.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Ame ɖeka ma, si ɖi ɖe anyi la, eya kee galia yi dzi ʋĩi, hegbɔ nu sia nu ŋu be yeaxɔ aƒe ɖe nu sia nu me.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: Mawu wɔ esia, be mí katã míava zu ɖeka le nu si dzi míexɔ se la me, eye míava dze si Mawu Vi la keŋkeŋ. Míatsi aɖo ŋutsume asɔ ta kple Kristo, eye eƒe nɔnɔme blibo la nasu mía si.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Ekema míaganye ɖevi sue, siwo nufiafia yeye ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ya ƒona yina gbɔnae, eye ayetɔwo blena dea woƒe aɖaŋu vɔ̃ me la o.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Le esia teƒe la, mí, abe ame siwo me lɔlɔ̃ le ene la, míanye nyateƒetolawo, ale be míatsi le go ɖe sia ɖe me le Kristo, si nye ta la me.

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: Eyae lé ameti blibo la ƒe ƒunuɖeƒewo kple kawo ɖe asi wole te le ŋutilã la me, ale be ameti la ƒe akpa vovovoawo wɔa dɔ pɛpɛpɛ, tsina hetua wo ɖokui ɖo le lɔlɔ̃ me. Ame siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo la ƒe agbenɔnɔ

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: Azɔ mele egblɔm na mi, le Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ me, be miganɔ agbe kple susu wodzoe, abe ale si ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la nɔnɛ ene o.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Woƒe susu me kple nugɔmesese do viviti. Esi woƒe dzi ku atri ta la, numanyamanya xɔ aƒe ɖe wo me, eye woƒe agbenɔnɔ to vovo tso agbe si Mawu di be ame nanɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzitsinya ku atri, eya ta hadzedze ma wo, eye wobiãa ŋku ɖe nu makɔmakɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi wɔwɔ ŋu.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Nye ya metsɔe be miese nya tso Yesu ŋu, eye wofia nyateƒenya si le eme la mi.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Miɖe asi le dzɔdzɔme xoxo si nɔ mia si, si na mienɔ agbe si ƒomevi mienɔ va yi la ŋu. Nudzroame siwo blea ame lae gblẽ agbe si mienɔ tsã la.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: Migbugbɔ miaƒe gbɔgbɔ kple susu wɔ yeyee,

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: eye mitsɔ nɔnɔme yeye, si wowɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme me, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe hele kɔkɔe la, do abe awu ene.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, miɖe aʋatsokaka ƒu gbe. Ame sia ame neto nyateƒe na nɔvia, elabe mia dome ame sia ame nye ŋutinu aɖe na ameti ɖeka ma ke.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Dzi neku mi, ke migawɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Dziku la neganɔ anyi, zã nado ɖe edzi o.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Migana mɔnukpɔkpɔ aɖeke Abosam o.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Ame si fia fi la, nedzudzɔ fififi. Netsɔ eƒe asi wɔ dɔ ɖɔʋu aɖe boŋ, bene nane nanɔ esi wòatsɔ ana hiãtɔ.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Migana nya ƒoɖi aɖeke nado tso miaƒe nu me o. Ne mieƒo nu la, nya si akpe ɖe eselawo ŋu, eye wòsɔ ɖe ɣe ma ɣi dzi tututu la ko miagblɔ, ale be wòahe yayra avɛ na eselawo.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Migawɔ nu si ave Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la o, elabe eyae wotsɔ de dzesi mii, be Mawu axɔ mi le ŋkeke ma dzi.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Miɖe veve helihelĩ, dɔmedzoe kple dziku katã ɖa. Nenema ke miɖe ɣlidodo, ameŋugbegblẽ kple susu vɔ̃ bubu ɖe ame ŋu hã ɖa.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Ale esi wònye vi lɔlɔ̃wo mienye na Mawu ta la, misrɔ̃ eƒe nɔnɔme.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ nedze le miaƒe agbenɔnɔ me, abe ale si Kristo lɔ̃ mí, eye wòtsɔ eya ŋutɔ ɖokui na ɖe mía ta, hezu nunana si ʋẽ lílilĩ, si wotsɔ sa vɔe na Mawu la ene.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ keŋkeŋ lae mienye, eya ta medze kura be woagayɔ ahasiwɔwɔ, nu makɔmakɔ wɔwɔ alo ŋukeklẽ aɖeke ŋkɔ gɔ̃ le mia dome o.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Eme nekɔ na mi ƒãa be ahasiwɔlawo, nu makɔmakɔ wɔlawo alo ŋuklẽlawo ame siawo dometɔ aɖeke makpɔ ɖuƒe aɖeke le Kristo kple Mawu ƒe fiaɖuƒe la me akpɔ o.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Migana ame aɖeke natsɔ movinya aɖeke able mi o, elabe nu sia tɔgbee na Mawu do dɔmedzoe ɖe ame siwo sẽ to la ŋu.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Eya ta migade ha kpli wo o.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Elabe tsã la, viviti mee mienɔ, ke fifia la, miele kekeli me, hele ha dem kple Aƒetɔ la. Eya ta minɔ agbe abe ame siwo le kekeli me la ene,

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: elabe nuwɔna siwo agbenɔnɔ le kekeli me hena vanɛ la woe nye: nu nyui wɔwɔ, nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ kple nyateƒetoto.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Midze agbagba miasrɔ̃ nuwɔna si dzea Aƒetɔ la ŋu la.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Migakpɔ gome aɖeke le nu siwo amewo wɔna le viviti me la me o. Viɖe aɖeke mele wo me o; miʋu go wo boŋ.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Elabe enye ŋukpe be woaƒo nu le nu si wowɔna le adzame la ŋu gɔ̃.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si wohena ɖe go vaa kekeli nu la, dzena wokpɔna, elabe kekelie nana be nu sia nu dzena ƒãa.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Esia ta wogblɔ be: “Nyɔ, wò alɔ̃dɔla, fɔ tso ame kukuwo dome, eye Kristo aklẽ ɖe dziwò.”

english_verse: Act like people with good sense and not like fools.
translation_verse: Ale milé ŋku ɖe miaƒe agbenɔnɔ ŋu nyuie. Miganɔ agbe abe ame manyanuwo ene o, ke boŋ abe nunyalawo ene.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Eya ta migawɔ nu abe movitɔwo ene o, ke boŋ midze agbagba miase nu si dim Aƒetɔ la le la gɔme.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Migano aha mu o, elabe ɖe wònana be ame wɔa nu baɖa. Ke boŋ mina Gbɔgbɔ la nayɔ mia me taŋ.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nya siwo le Psalmowo, hadzidziwo kple gbɔgbɔmehawo me ƒo nu na mia nɔewo, eye mitsɔ kafukafuhawo kple hadzidzi viviwo kafu Aƒetɔ la le miaƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Mawu Tɔ́ la le nu sia nu me le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋkɔ me. Srɔ̃nyɔnuwo kple srɔ̃ŋutsuwo

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃nyɔnuwo, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia srɔ̃wo, abe ale si miawɔ na Aƒetɔ la ene.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Elabe srɔ̃nyɔnu ƒe tae nye srɔ̃a, abe ale si hamea hã ƒe ta nye Kristo ene. Hame lae nye Kristo ƒe ŋutilã, eye Kristo ŋutɔe nye eƒe Ɖela.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃ŋutsuwo, milɔ̃ mia srɔ̃wo, abe ale si Kristo hã lɔ̃ hamea, hetsɔ eƒe agbe na ɖe eta la ene.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: Ewɔ esia be yeatsɔ akɔ hame la ŋuti, esime wòklɔ eŋuti kple tsi kpakple eƒe nya la.

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: Medi be ɖikui aɖeke nanɔ eŋu, teƒe aɖeke nalé ayi nɛ, alo ɖinu bubu ƒomevi aɖeke nanɔ eŋu o. Ɖe wòdi be hamea nanɔ kɔkɔe, mokaka naganɔ eŋu o. Ale wòaɖo atsyɔ̃ blibo nɛ nyuie hafi atsɔe aɖo ye ŋutɔ ye ŋkume.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Alea pɛ wòle be srɔ̃ŋutsuwo nalɔ̃ wo srɔ̃wo, abe ale si wolɔ̃ woawo ŋutɔ ɖokui ene. Ŋutsu si lɔ̃ srɔ̃a la, eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ye wòlɔ̃.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke meléa fu eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutilã o, ke boŋ ɖe wònyinɛ heléa be nɛ nyuie, abe ale si Kristo hã wɔna na hame la ene,

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: elabe ŋutinuwo míenye na Kristo ƒe ŋutilã.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be: “Esia ta ŋutsu aɖe ɖa tso tɔ́a kple nɔa ŋu, ava lé ɖe srɔ̃a ŋu, eye wo ame evea azu ame ɖeka.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Nya si ɣla ɖe mawunya sia me la goglo. Nye ya metsɔe be Kristo kple hame lae wowɔnɛ.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Nu si mewɔnɛ koŋ lae nye be ele na srɔ̃ŋutsu ɖe sia ɖe be wòalɔ̃ srɔ̃a abe eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ene, eye srɔ̃nyɔnu ɖe sia ɖe hã nakpɔ egbɔ be yetsɔ bubu na ye srɔ̃ŋutsu.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Ɖeviwo, miɖo to mia dzilawo, elabe Aƒetɔ la tɔwoe mienye. Edze be miawɔ esia.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: be nu nadze edzi na wò, eye nànɔ agbe didi le anyigba la dzi.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Tɔ́wo, migado dziku na mia viwo o, ke boŋ mihe wo, be woate ŋu alé wo ɖokui, eye woawɔ ɖoɖo dzi, abe ale si Aƒetɔ la fia la ene. Dɔlawo kple aƒetɔwo

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Dɔlawo, miɖo to aƒetɔ siwo le mia si le agbe sia me la kple vɔvɔ̃ kpakple dzodzo nyanyanya, eye mikɔ dzime subɔ wo, abe Kristo subɔm miele ene.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Migawɔ ameŋkume nu ko be yewoadze wo ŋu o, ke boŋ abe Kristo ƒe dɔlawo ene la, miwɔ nu si Mawu di la tso miaƒe dzime ke.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Mikɔ dzime ɖe dɔ ŋu wɔ, abe Aƒetɔ lae miele ewɔm na ene, menye abe na amegbetɔwo ene o.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Minyae be Aƒetɔ la axe fe na ame sia ame, le nu nyui ɖe sia ɖe si wòwɔ la ta, ne enye kluvi alo ablɔɖevi.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Aƒetɔwo, miawo hã miwɔ nenema ke na miaƒe dɔlawo, eye midzudzɔ vɔvɔ̃dodo na wo. Miɖo ŋku edzi, be ame si nye miawo kple woawo siaa ƒe Aƒetɔ la le dziƒo. Eya la, mekpɔa ame aɖeke ŋkume o. Mawu ƒe akpoxɔnu blibo la

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Mlɔeake la, ale si miele ha dem kple Aƒetɔ la la, nagasẽ ŋu ɖe edzi wu to eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la me.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Mikpla aʋawɔnu siwo katã Mawu tsɔ na mi la, ale be miate ŋu atsi tre ɖe vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe ayemɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Elabe menye mí kple amegbetɔwoe le aʋa wɔm o, ke boŋ mí kpakple gbɔgbɔmeŋusẽwo, gbɔgbɔmedziɖulawo, dziɖula siwo le xexe doviviti sia me kple nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ƒe ŋusẽ siwo le dziƒonutowo me ke lae le aʋa wɔm.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Eya ta mikpla Mawu ƒe aʋawɔnu blibo la, ale be ne ŋkeke vɔ̃ ma va tu mi la, miate ŋu anɔ te awɔ aʋa va se ɖe nuwuwu, eye ŋusẽ naganɔ mia ŋu.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Eya ta mitso kpla! Mitsɔ nyateƒe la bla ali dzii, eye mitsɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖo akɔta abe akɔtakpoxɔnu ene.

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: Nyanyui, si hea ŋutifafa vanɛ la, nanye aʋayifɔkpa si miado.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esiawo katã ŋuti la, milé xɔse, si nye akpoxɔnu la ɖe asi. Eyae miate ŋu atsɔ atsi futɔ la ƒe aŋutrɔ siwo le bibim flaflafla la nui.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ gakuku, si nye Mawu ƒe agbexɔxɔ la ɖɔ, eye milé Mawu ƒe nya, si nye Gbɔgbɔ la ƒe aʋawɔyi la ɖe asi goŋgoŋ.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Mina Gbɔgbɔ la nakplɔ mi mianɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɣe sia ɣi. Mibia Mawu vevie be wòakpe ɖe mia ŋu. Le esia ta la, mido vevie mianɔ ŋudzɔ, eye mido gbe ɖa vevie ɖe ame siwo katã ŋuti wokɔ la ta.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: Mido gbe ɖa ɖe nye hã tanye, be Mawu natsɔ nya ade nunye magblɔ dzideƒotɔe, eye maɖe gbeƒã nya ɣaɣla, si le Nyanyui la me la.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nyanyui sia tae menye amedɔdɔ si le ga me ɖo. Mido gbe ɖa be mate ŋu agblɔe dzideƒotɔe, abe ale si wòdze be magblɔe la ene. Gbedoname mamlɛawo

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Mawu Tɔ́ la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo, nena ŋutifafa kple lɔlɔ̃, si ŋu xɔse kpe ɖo la mi, nɔvinyewo katã.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mawu neve ame siwo katã lɔ̃ mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la nu kple lɔlɔ̃ sinu metsina gbeɖe o la.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Paulo kple Timoteo gbɔ. Míenye Kristo Yesu ƒe dɔlawo. Míele eŋlɔm na mi hametɔ siwo katã ŋuti wokɔ le Filipi, eye miele hadede me kple Kristo Yesu la. Ha la nunɔlawo kple miaƒe kpeɖeŋutɔwo katã hã le eme.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Mía Tɔ́ Mawu kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu, eye woana ŋutifafa mi. Paulo do gbe ɖa ɖe agbalẽa xlẽlawo ta

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Ne meɖo ŋku mia dzi ko la, medaa akpe na Mawu;

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: eye ɣe sia ɣi si mele gbe dom ɖa ɖe mia ta la, medonɛ ɖa kple dzidzɔ.

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: Meda akpe na Mawu be mía kple miawo míekpe asi ɖe Nyanyui dɔ la ŋu le wɔwɔm tso ŋkeke gbãtɔ ma dzi va se ɖe egbe.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Meka ɖe edzi be ame si dze dɔ nyui sia wɔwɔ gɔme le mia me la, awu enu le Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Nye susu le mia ŋu ɖaa. Esɔ be manɔ mi katã mia ŋu bum alea, elabe Mawu ve nye kple miawo siaa nu be miele fu kpem kplim, esime mele gaxɔ me. Gawu la, miekpe ɖe ŋunye míele Nyanyui la ta ʋlim be wòali ke.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawue nye nye ɖaseɖila, abe alesi mi katã miele dzronyem vevie le Yesu Kristo ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la me tae.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Mele gbe dom ɖa be miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ nagade to ɖe edzi wu, ne miadze si nyateƒe la, ate ŋu atso nya me nyuie na mia ɖokui.

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: Esia ana be miate ŋu atia nu si nye nyuitɔ, ale be le Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi la, mianye ame dzadzɛ, siwo ŋu mokaka manɔ o la.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Eye mia yɔ taŋ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse si tso Yesu Kristo gbɔ, hena Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple kafukafu. Hadede kple Kristo me ko agbe vavã le

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, medi be mianya be, le nyateƒe me la, nu siwo dzɔ ɖe dzinye la, va na be Nyanyui la ɖe zɔ yi ŋgɔgbe boŋ.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Elabe asrafo siwo katã le fiasã la me kple ame bubu siwo katã le afi sia la, kpɔe dze sii be Kristo tae mele gaxɔ me ɖo.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, wo dome ame aɖewo ɖea gbeƒã Kristo elabe woʋã ŋum, eye wodi be yewoaʋli nu kplim, ke ame bubuwo hã ɖea gbeƒãe kple susu nyui.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃e dɔ ameha evelia sia be woaɖe gbeƒã nyuie alea, elabe wonyae be Mawu ɖe wòdam ɖe afi sia be maʋli Nyanyui la ta.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Ameha gbãtɔ ya ɖea gbeƒã Kristo le nu si anyo na woƒe akpadzitɔwo la ɖeɖe ko ta, ke menye le nyateƒe me o. Wosusu be yewoawɔ esia, ale be veve si sem mele le gaxɔ me la, nagado gã ɖe edzi wu.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Esia mewɔ naneke o, elabe ame aɖe ɖaɖe gbeƒã Kristo alakpatɔe o, eɖaɖee anukwaretɔe o, nye ya la, be woɖea gbeƒã Kristo la, eya ɖeɖe do dzidzɔ nam.

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ẽ, dzidzɔ ko makpɔ, elabe menyae be le gbe si dom miele ɖa kple ale si Yesu Kristo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la le kpekpem ɖe ŋunyee ta la, mado le gaxɔa me.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Nu si ŋu mele ŋu ɖom ɖo hele mɔ kpɔm na vevie lae nye be ŋu nagakpem kura o, ke boŋ dzi naganɔ ƒonye kokoko, vevietɔ fifia. Ale nenye ɖe maku, alo ɖe manɔ agbe hã la, matsɔ nye ŋutilã ade bubu Kristo ŋui.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Le nye ya gome la, Kristoe mele agbe na, evɔ nenye ɖe maku boŋ la, anye ne eya agaɖe vi nam wu sãa.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe maganɔ agbe la, mawɔ dɔ si aɖe vi. Ke ku o, agbe o, nyemenya esi matia o.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Metsi evedomesi. Ke nye ya ɖe medi be madzo aɖanɔ Kristo gbɔ boŋ hafi, elabe esia nyo wu sãa.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Esi meka ɖe esia dzi ta la, menya be manɔ mia gbɔ, ayi dɔ si wɔm mele kpli mi katã la dzi, bene miayi ŋgɔ ahakpɔ dzidzɔ le Kristo dzixɔse me.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Esia ana be ne megava mia gbɔ la, miakpɔ mɔ aƒo adegbe to dzinye be yewowɔ ɖeka kple Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Nu si hiã fifia koe nye be mianɔ agbe si dze Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la xɔlawo. Ale be ne meva mia gbɔ loo, alo nyemegava o hã la, mase le mia ŋu be miaƒe gbɔgbɔ le ɖeka, eye mietsɔ susu ɖeka le tsitre ɖe mia nɔewo xa kplíkplikpli le xɔse, si le Nyanyui la me la, ta ʋlim.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Migana nu si ame siwo tsi tre ɖe mia ŋu la awɔ la ƒe ɖeke nado ŋɔdzi na mi o. Milé dzi ɖe ƒo. Esia anye dzesi tso Mawu gbɔ na wo kɔtɛe be wole tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge godoo, eye be miawo ya, woaxɔ mi ɖe agbe.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Elabe womeyɔ mi vɛ be miaxɔ Kristo dzi ase ɖeɖe ko o, ke boŋ be miakpe fu ɖe eta hã.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, miawo hã mige ɖe aʋa la me kplim. Aʋa sia tututue miekpɔm menɔ wɔwɔm va yi, eye abe ale si miesee ene la, eya ke wɔm megale fifia hã.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, dzi ɖo mia ƒo, elabe miewɔ ɖeka kple Kristo. Eƒe lɔlɔ̃ dea dzi ƒo na mi. Miedea ha kple Gbɔgbɔ la, eye mienyoa dɔme hekpɔa nublanui na mia nɔewo.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: Eya ta, be miana makpɔ dzidzɔ wòade edeƒe la, mina miaƒe tamesusu nanɔ ɖeka; milɔ̃ mia nɔewo ame ŋkume makpɔmakpɔtɔe, miaƒe gbɔgbɔ nawɔ ɖeka, eye miabu nu ɖeka ko ŋu.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Migawɔ naneke tso ɖokuitɔdidi alo dàda me o. Mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui, eye mibu ame bubuwo be wonyo wu yewo.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Mina susu ma ke, si nɔ Kristo Yesu si la, nanɔ miawo hã mia si. Esiae nye:

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be enye ame si nɔ Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme me hã la, mebui nuhahae, be ye kple Mawu yewosɔ o.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ eɖe asi le bubuteƒe, si le esi la ŋu faa, eye wòtsɔ eɖokui wɔ subɔlae. Wodzii abe amegbetɔ ene.

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe nɔnɔmee nɔ esi, eye wòbɔbɔ eɖokui, ɖo to, va se ɖe keke ku me ke; atitsogaŋuku gɔ̃ hãe wòku.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Esia ta Mawu doe ɖe dzi boo, eye wòtsɔ ŋkɔ, si ƒo ŋkɔwo katã ta la nɛ.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Ale be, ne Yesu ŋkɔ ɖi ko la, edze be nuwɔwɔ siwo katã le dziƒo, anyigba dzi kple anyigba te la, nadze klo,

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: eye wo katã naʋu eme be: “Yesu Kristoe nye Aƒetɔ la!” be woatsɔ akafu Mawu Tɔ́ lae. Miklẽ abe akaɖi ene le xexea me

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, abe ale si mieɖoa tom ɣe sia ɣi ene la, togbɔ be nyemele mia gbɔ o hã, mido vevie nu wu ale si ne mele mia gbɔ la miewɔnɛ gɔ̃. Mitsɔ vɔvɔ̃ kple dzodzo nyanyanya wɔ dɔ si aƒo miaƒe ɖeɖe la ta la.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Mawu le dɔ wɔm le mia me, be yeana mialɔ̃ awɔ dɔ si adze eŋu.

english_verse: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.
translation_verse: Migalĩ liʋiliʋĩ le naneke wɔwɔ me o, eye migaɖe ɖeklemee hã o,

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: ale be le xexe gbegblẽ sia, si yɔ fũu kple nuvɔ̃ me la, miawo mianye Mawu vi maɖifɔ, siwo dza, eye mokaka aɖeke mele wo ŋu o la. Miawo la, miklẽ le xexemetɔwo dome abe keklẽ siwo le dziŋgɔli me la ene.

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: Milé nya si naa agbe la ɖe asi goŋgoŋ, ale be le Kristo ƒe ŋkeke la dzi la, mate ŋu aƒo adegbe be nyemeƒu du dzodzro, alo wɔ dɔ vlo o.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Nenye be wòahiã be woakɔ nye ʋu ɖe miaƒe xɔse, si le abe vɔsalã ene la dzi hã la, dzi adzɔm eye matso aseye kple mi katã.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Nenema ke wòle be miawo hã miakpɔ dzidzɔ atso aseye kplim! Timoteo kple Epafrodito

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be Aƒetɔ Yesu aʋu mɔ nam be maɖo Timoteo ɖe mia gbɔ kpuie, ale be wòagbɔ ava gblɔ mia gbɔnya nam, ne dzi nagadzɔm.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Le anukware me la, ame aɖeke mele asinye si atsɔ ɖe le miaƒe nya me abe eya ene o.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ame bubuawo katã ya la, woawo ŋutɔ ƒe nyui ko dim wole, ke menye nu si nye Yesu Kristo tɔ o.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔ mienya be Timoteo la, ame vevi wònye, eye be enɔ ŋunye kplíkplikpli le Nyanyui la kaka me, abe ale si viŋutsuvi nɔa tɔ́a ŋui la ene.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Eya ta mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be ne menya ale si nye nyawo va le ko la, maɖoe ɖe mia gbɔ kaba.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Mexɔe se hã be Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ aɖe mɔ na nye ŋutɔ hã be mava kpuie.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Mebui be ehiã be maɖo nɔvinye Epafrodito, ame si nye kplii míewɔ dɔ, eye míewɔ aʋa ɖekae la ɖe mi. Enye miaƒe amedɔdɔ kple ame si va kpe ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: Esi wònya be miese be yeƒe lã me gblẽ la, exa nu vevie, eye wòtsi dzi ŋutɔ, be yeakpɔ mi katã.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, edze dɔ, eye wòde kuku ge kloe, ke Mawu ve eya kple nye siaa nu. Ɖe menye nenema o la, anye ne nye vevesese awu tsɔtsɔ nam.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Esia tae nye ŋutɔ hã metsi dzi, be maɖoe ɖa, ale be ne miegakpɔe la, dzi nadzɔ mi, ne nye hã maɖe dzi ɖi vie.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Eya ta mixɔe alɔ eve le Aƒetɔ la ta kple dzidzɔ gã aɖe. Mide bubu ame siawo tɔgbe ŋu,

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: elabe etsɔ eɖokui ke, be yeawu subɔsubɔdɔ si miele wɔwɔm nam la nu, eye to esia wɔwɔ me la, eku kloe.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔvinyewo, dzi nedzɔ mi be miele hadede me kple Aƒetɔ la. Metim be magaŋlɔ nu siawo ke na mi o, elabe esia ana be mianɔ dedie.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Minɔ ŋudzɔ na nuvɔ̃wɔla mawo! Minɔ ŋudzɔ na avu mawo! Minɔ ŋudzɔ na ame siwo dea abi woƒe ŋutilã ŋu, be yewotso aʋa!

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Elabe mí ame siwo subɔa Mawu le gbɔgbɔ me la boŋ ye wotso aʋa si dze la na, ale míekpɔa dzidzɔ be míedea ha kple Kristo Yesu. Míawo ya míeɖoa dzi ɖe ŋutilãmekɔnyinyi ŋu o.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: Nye boŋ wòle be maɖo dzi ɖe ŋutilãmekɔnyinyi ŋu hafi. Ne ame aɖe bu be ye wòle be yeaɖo dzi ɖe eŋu la, megogom kura o, tɔnye wu sãa.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Nye la, ŋkeke enyia gbee wotso aʋa nam. Israel vidzidzie menye, eye metso Benyamin-to la me. Hebritɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ si Hebritɔ akuakuawo dzi lae menye. Le Yudatɔwo ƒe sea dzi wɔwɔ gome la, Farisitɔe menye.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Le dzotsɔtsɔ ɖe Yudatɔnyenye ŋu gome la, mewɔe ʋuu, va zu hamea yometila. Le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖe sea nu gome la, mokaka aɖeke menɔ ŋunye o.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Ke ne viɖe nɔ wo me nam va yi hã la, le Kristo ta, wozu nu maɖeviwo.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, mebu nu siawo katã be wonye nu maɖeviwo, elabe meva dze sii be Kristoe nye nye Aƒetɔ. Nunya sia xɔ asi wu nunyawo katã. Esia tae mebú nye nuwo katã, eye metsɔ wo ko abe aɖukpodzinuwo ene, be nye asi nasu Kristo dzi,

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: eye mawɔ ɖeka kplii. Ale nyemagawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe aɖeke le ɖokuinye si, le se la ta o, ke boŋ mawɔ nu, si Kristo dzixɔse bia be mawɔ la ko. Esiae nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ si tso Mawu gbɔ, eye wòku ɖe xɔse ŋuti.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Ale nu si ko dim mele lae nye be madze si Kristo, ame si fɔ tso ame kukuwo dome kple eƒe ŋusẽ si le dɔ wɔm la, ale be mate ŋu akpe fu, eye maku abe eya ene,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: ale ne wòate ŋu ava eme ko la, nye hã mafɔ tso ku me. Paulo le du dzi ɖo ta dziɖuƒea

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Nyemele gbɔgblɔm be nye asi su taɖodzinu la dzi, alo be mede blibo vɔ o. Ke mele ʋiʋlim vevie be nye asi nasu edzi, elabe Kristo Yesu wɔm mezu etɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, nyemetsɔe be nu sia su asinye xoxo o. Nu ɖeka ko ŋu nye susu le. Esiae nye be meŋlɔ nu siwo le megbenye la be, eye nu siwo le ŋgɔnye la ko nyam mele kple nye ŋusẽ katã.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Dziɖuƒea ko nyam mele kple ŋkubiã, ale be mava xɔ nunana si ta Mawu to Yesu Kristo dzi, yɔm la, le dziƒo afi ma.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Mina susu sia nanɔ mí, ame siwo tsi le gbɔgbɔ me la si. Ke nenye be susu bubu ƒomevi aɖe le mia dometɔ aɖe si la, Mawu aɖe ema hã ɖe go afia mi.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Ɖoɖo siwo dzi míewɔ va se ɖe fifi la, mina míagalé wo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, mikpɔ nye nuwɔna miawɔ. Mide dzesi ame siwo le agbe, abe ale si míenɔe hetsɔ ɖo kpɔɖeŋu na mi la ene.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Togbɔ be megblɔ nya sia na mi zi geɖe va yi xoxo hã la, megale egblɔm ake fifia kple aɖatsi, be ame geɖewo ƒe agbenɔnɔ fia be wolé fu ku si Kristo ku le atitsoga ŋu la.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Ame siawo le gege ge ɖe fukpekpe mavɔmavɔ me, elabe woƒe mawue nye woƒe ƒodo. Nu si nye ŋukpenanu boŋ ŋuti wodzɔa dzi le, eye wotsɔ woƒe susu da ɖe xexemenuwo dzi.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Ke míawo ya la, mía dee nye dziƒo, eye míele Xɔla si nye Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la lalam be wòatso afi ma ava.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: Eyae atsɔ ŋusẽ si wɔe be wòte ŋu ɖu nu sia nu dzi la, atrɔ míaƒe ŋutilã beli sia, wòasɔ kple eya ŋutɔ tɔ, si nye ŋutikɔkɔeŋutilã la.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, mi ame siwo ƒe nya melɔ̃, mi ame siwo doa dzidzɔ nam, eye mienye nye dziɖuɖukuku, mi ame siwo susum mele, minɔ te sesĩe. Miwɔ ɖeka ne mianɔ agbe kple Aƒetɔ la alea, nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Mele kuku ɖem na Ewodia kple Sintixe be woawɔ ɖeka le Aƒetɔ la ta.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Nenema ke mele kuku ɖem na wò, nye hadɔwɔla nyateƒetɔ, be nàkpe ɖe nyɔnu siawo ŋu. Woawo kple Klemens kpakple hadɔwɔla bubuawoe ku kutri, kpe ɖe ŋunye vevie le Nyanyui la kaka me. Woŋlɔ ame siawo ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe agbenɔlawo ƒe agbalẽ la me.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Dzi nedzɔ mi ɣe sia ɣi le Aƒetɔ la me. Megale egblɔm ake be: dzi nedzɔ mi!

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Migbɔ dzi blewuu na amewo katã. Aƒetɔ la gogo.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Migatsi dzimaɖi le naneke ŋuti o, ke boŋ ne miele gbe dom ɖa la, migblɔ nu siwo katã hiã mi la na Mawu, eye miada akpe nɛ.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu ƒe ŋutifafa si gbɔ amegbetɔ ƒe nugɔmesese ŋu yi sãa la, nadzra miaƒe dziwo kple susuwo ɖo dedie le Kristo Yesu me.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔvinyewo, mina nu nyuitɔ kple esiwo dze na kafukafu la ɖeɖe ko naxɔ aƒe ɖe miaƒe susu me. Esiawoe nye: nu sia nu si nye nyateƒe, nu sia nu si dze na bubu, nu sia nu si le dzɔdzɔe, nu sia nu si dza, nu sia nu si nyakpɔna kple nu sia nu si dzèa ame.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Minɔ agbe ɖe nu siwo miesrɔ̃ tso gbɔnye, nu siwo miexɔ, nya siwo miese le nunye kple nu siwo miekpɔ le nye agbenɔnɔ me la nu, eye Mawu, ame si naa ŋutifafa la, nanɔ kpli mi. Paulo da akpe na Filipitɔwo le woƒe nunana ta

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Le Aƒetɔ la ta la, dzi dzɔm ŋutɔ be le ɣeyiɣi geɖe megbe la, miegade asi ŋunye bubu me. Togbɔ be mietsɔ ɖe le eme nam le ɣeyiɣi mawo me hã la, miekpɔ mɔnu ɖee fia o.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Nyemele konyi fam be hiã tum o, elabe mesrɔ̃e le nu sia nu me le afi sia afi be ale si menyale ko la, nadze ŋunye.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Menya nu si nye ahedada, eye menya nu si nye gakpɔkpɔ hã. Le nu sia nu me la, mesrɔ̃ ale si wòle be ame nanɔ ɣeawo katã ɣi: le dɔwuame alo ƒoɖiɖi me; le ahedada alo hokpɔkpɔ me.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ si Kristo naam lae wɔe be mete ŋu doa go nu sia nu.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Ke miewɔe nyuie ŋutɔ, be miekpe ɖe ŋunye le nye xaxa me.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Mi Filipitɔwo, miawo ŋutɔ mienya be tso esime míede asi gbeƒãɖeɖe Nyanyui la me, eye medzo le Makedonia ko la, miawo koe nye hame si le kpekpem ɖe ŋunye, le nu namem.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Esime menɔ Tesalonika gɔ̃ hã la, mieɖoa nunanawo ɖem edziedzi.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Menye nunana la dim mele hafi o, ke boŋ viɖe si miawo miakpɔ ɖe edzi to nunana me la boŋ dim mele.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Miexe fe nam wòde kaka gbɔ edzi gɔ̃. Nunana siwo mieɖo ɖa to Epafrodito dzi la va su asinye, ale be mekpɔ nye nuhiahiãwo katã. Miaƒe nunana siawo le abe vɔsa, si le ʋeʋẽm lílilĩ, eye wòdze Mawu ŋu hedo dzidzɔ nɛ la ene.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Ke nye Mawu la ana miaƒe hiahiã katã nazu nunɔamesi taŋtaŋ le eƒe kesinɔnu la nu, le ŋutikɔkɔe me le Kristo Yesu me.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Woakafu mía Mawu si nye mía Tɔ́ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Amen. Gbedoname

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na ame siwo katã ŋu wokɔ, eye wole hadede me kple Kristo Yesu la. Nɔvi siwo le gbɔnye la do gbe na mi.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã ŋu wokɔ le afii la do gbe na mi nyuie, vevietɔ Roma Fiagã la ƒe aƒemetɔwo.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Paulo, ame si va zu Kristo Yesu ƒe amedɔdɔ le Mawu ƒe didi nu la gbɔ. Nye kple Timoteo ye le eŋlɔm na mi.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Míele eŋlɔm na mi, mía nɔvi, siwo le Kolose, siwo ŋu wokɔ eye mienye hametɔ nuteƒewɔla, siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo la. Mawu, mía Tɔ́ neve mia nu eye wòana ŋutifafa mi. Paulo da akpe na Mawu le Kolosetɔwo ta

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ne míele gbe dom ɖa ɖe mia ta la, míedaa akpe na Mawu, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Tɔ́ ɣe sia ɣi,

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: elabe míese be miexɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se, eye mielɔ̃a hametɔwo katã nyuie.

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: Wodzra nu si miele mɔ kpɔm na la ɖo ɖi na mi ɖe dziƒo. Miese mɔkpɔkpɔ sia ŋu nya xoxo esime wogblɔ nyateƒenya, si nye Nyanyui la na mi.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Nyanyui sia le tsitsim ɖe edzi hele ku tsem le xexea me godoo, abe ale si wòle ŋgɔ yim le miawo hã mia dome, tso keke gbe si gbe ke miese ale si Mawu vea ame nui, eye miese egɔme tututu la ene.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Epafra ye nye ame si fia nu mi. Enye míaƒe hadɔwɔla lɔlɔ̃tɔ, ame si wɔ Kristo ƒe dɔ nyateƒetɔe ɖe tenyeƒe.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Eyae va gblɔ lɔlɔ̃ si Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la tsɔ de mia me la, ƒe nya na mí.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Ale tso gbe si gbe míese mia ŋkɔ ko la, gbe ko dom miele ɖa ɖe mia ta ɣe sia ɣi. Míeɖea kuku na Mawu be wòana miadze si eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye miaŋɔ ɖe nunya kple gɔmesese, si eƒe Gbɔgbɔ la nana la me bliboe,

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: be miate ŋu anɔ agbe si adze na Aƒetɔ la, eye miadze eŋu. Ekema miawɔ nu nyui ɖeɖe ko, eye miagase Mawu gɔme ɖe edzi wu.

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: Mawu netsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la lé mi ɖe te sesĩe, be miate ŋu ado dzi ahagbɔ dzi ɖi.

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ dzidzɔ da akpe na Tɔ́ la ɣe sia ɣi, elabe eyae wɔe be míedze, be mí kple ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la, míanyi dome le kekeli me.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Mawue xɔ mí tso viviti ƒe dziɖuɖu te, eye wòtsɔ mí ɖo Via lɔlɔ̃a ƒe fiaɖuƒe me.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Mawu Vi lae nye Mawu si womekpɔna kple ŋku o la ƒe dzedzeme. Edzɔ hafi nuwɔwɔ bubuwo katã va dzɔ.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Elabe eya me woto wɔ nuwo katã: eɖanye dziƒonuwo alo anyigbadzinuwo o; eɖanye nu si wokpɔna kple ŋku alo esi womekpɔna kple ŋku o; eɖanye gbɔgbɔmeŋusẽwo o; eɖanye fiawo loo, alo dziɖulawo loo, alo ŋusẽtɔwo o. Mawu Vi la dzi woto wɔ wo katã tim, eye eyae wowɔ wo na.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Mawu Vi la li hafi nu sia nu va dzɔ, eye eya dzi nu sia nu to le ɖoɖo nu pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Eyae nye ta na hame la, eye hame la nye eƒe ŋutilã. Hame la dzɔ tso eyama me, eye Vi lae nye ame gbãtɔ, si tsi tsitre tso ku me, ale be wòado ŋgɔ le nu sia nu me.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Edze Mawu ŋu be nɔnɔme si tututu le ye si la, nanɔ ye Vi la hã si.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Egadze eŋu be yeagawɔ ɖeka kple xexeme blibo la katã, eɖanye nu siwo le anyigba dzi alo nu siwo le dziƒo o. Vi la ƒe ʋu si kɔ ɖi le atitsoga ŋu lae he ŋutifafa sia vɛ.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Tsã la, masɔmasɔ nɔ mi kple Mawu dome, eye mielé fui le susu me henɔ nuvɔ̃ɖiwo wɔm.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, Mawu gaxɔ mi atuu to ŋutilãmeku si Via ku la me. Ku sia mee Via to gbugbɔ mi ɖo Mawu ŋkume, abe ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ, siwo ŋu fɔbubu aɖeke mele o, eye wole dzadzɛ la ene.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Ele vevie kokoko be mialé nu si dzi miexɔ se la me ɖe asi. Minɔ te sesĩe eye mili ke. Migaɖe miaƒe susu ɖa le mɔkpɔkpɔ si Nyanyui la he vɛ na mi la ŋu o. Nyanyui siae woɖe gbeƒãe na nuwɔwɔ siwo katã le xexea me, eye eya ƒe subɔlae nye, Paulo hã meva zu. Paulo wɔ dɔ abe hame la ƒe subɔla ene

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Fifia la, enye dzidzɔ nam be makpe fu ɖe mia ta. Mele fu kpem le nye ŋutilã me, be mawu fu siwo susɔ Kristo nakpe, ɖe eƒe ŋutilã, si nye hame la ta la, nu.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖom be mazu miaƒe subɔla, ale be maɖe gbeƒã eƒe nya la, be amewo nanya mawunya la nyuie wòade go.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Nya sia nye nya ɣaɣla tso keke blema ke, eye dzidzime aɖeke menyae tsã o, ke azɔ la, Mawu ɖee fia ame siwo xɔ edzi se la.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Mawu lɔ̃ be yeaɖe nya ɣaɣla sia ƒe asixɔxɔ kple eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe na dukɔwo katã afia ame siwo xɔ edzi se la. Nya ɣaɣla lae nye: Kristo le mia me, eya ta ŋutikɔkɔe gã ŋutɔ li na mi.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Nenem Kristo siae míele gbeƒã ɖemee, eye míetsɔ míaƒe nunya katã le nu xlɔ̃m ame sia ame, hele nu fiam wo, ale be míava atsɔ wo dome ame sia ame aɖo Mawu ŋkume, abe ame siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo eye wotsi de blibo la ene.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Esia ƒe kutri kum mele hele ʋiʋlim kple ŋusẽ siwo katã Mawu dea menye la.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Medi be mianya aʋa sesẽ si wɔm mele ɖe miawo kple Laodikeatɔwo kpakple ame bubu siwo mekpɔ nyam ŋkume kple ŋkume haɖe o la ta la.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Mele esia gblɔm, ale be dzi naɖo wo ƒo, eye be woawɔ ɖeka kple wo nɔewo le lɔlɔ̃ me. Gawu la, woase nu gɔme bliboe, eye woadze si Mawu ƒe nu ɣaɣla si nye Kristo la. Esia nye kesinɔnu gã ŋutɔ.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Kristo mee wotsɔ kesinɔnu gã sia, si nye nunya kple sidzedze katã la ɣla ɖo.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Mele esia gblɔm na mi, bene ame aɖeke nagatsɔ aɖe ŋanɛ aflu mi o.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nyemele mia gbɔ le ŋutilã me o hã la, mele mia gbɔ le gbɔgbɔ me, eye edzɔ dzi nam be mekpɔ ale si miewɔa nu ɖe ɖoɖo nu, eye miexɔ Kristo dzi se kplikpae la. Ɖekawɔwɔ kple Kristo nana be agbe dea blibo

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Esi miexɔ Kristo abe Aƒetɔ ene ta la, miwɔ ɖeka kplii le miaƒe agbenɔnɔ me.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Miƒo kè ɖe to le eyama me, eye mitu mia ɖokui ɖo ɖe eyama dzi, bene miali kè le xɔse si wofia mi la me. Hekpe ɖe esia ŋuti la, minɔ akpedada dzi ɖaa.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie be ame aɖeke nagatsɔ xexemenunya kple ameblenya gbɔlo, siwo wotu ɖe amegbetɔwo ƒe kɔnyinyi dzi, alo ɖe xexemeŋusẽwo ƒe gbɔgbɔwo dzixɔse dzi la, akplɔ mi atrae o. Wometu nu siawo ɖe Kristo dzi o,

english_verse: God lives fully in Christ.
translation_verse: elabe mawunyenye blibo nɔ Kristo ƒe ŋutilã me.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Esi miewɔ ɖeka kple eya, ame si nye ta na gbɔgbɔmeŋusẽ kple gbɔgbɔmedziɖula ɖe sia ɖe la, miawo hã miaƒe agbenɔnɔ de blibo.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Esi woɖi mi kplii le mawutsilele me la, wofɔ mi ɖe tsitre hã kplii, elabe miexɔ Mawu, si fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome la, ƒe ŋusẽ dzi se.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Tsã la, miawo hã mienye ame kukuwo, elabe mienɔ nuvɔ̃ me, eye wometso aʋa na mi le Kristo me o; ke azɔ la, Mawu gbɔ agbe miawo hã kpakple Kristo la, elabe wotsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo katã ke mí.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Etutu nuŋɔŋlɔ si tsi tre ɖe mía ŋu hebu fɔ mí le sea nu la ɖa keŋkeŋ, elabe eklãe ɖe atitsoga ŋu.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Exɔ ŋusẽ le gbɔgbɔmeŋusẽwo kple gbɔgbɔmedziɖulawo si, do ŋukpe wo le dutoƒo, eye wòkplɔ wo abe aboyomewo ene kple aseyetsotso yi ɖe eƒe asaɖa la me.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Eya ta migana ame aɖeke naka ŋkume na mi azɔ le nya siwo ku ɖe nuɖuɖu kple nunono alo azãɖuɖuwo, ɣletidzedzi kple Dzudzɔgbe ŋuti la me o.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Esiawo katã nye nu siwo le megbe gbɔna la ƒe vɔvɔliwo ko; nu si le vɔvɔli la ŋutɔ ɖem lae nye Kristo.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Migana ame aɖeke nazi mia dzi be miabɔbɔ mia ɖokui alakpatɔe alo miade ta agu na mawudɔlawo o. Ame sia ƒomevi gblɔna be ŋutegakpɔkpɔ le vevie, eye wòdoa eɖokui ɖe dzi glodzoo; ke dzodzroe, elabe ŋutilãmesusu koe le esi. Ne mieɖo to ame sia ƒomevi la, miaƒe asi masu nu si nyam miele la dzi o.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Ame sia megakuna ɖe Kristo si nye ta la ŋuti o. Evɔ la, ta la gbɔe ŋutilã blibo la, ƒunuɖeƒewo kple lãmekawo siaa, kpɔa eƒe nunyiame tsonɛ eye eyae lénɛ ƒoa ƒui wòtsina, abe ale si Mawu di la ene. Agbe yeye nɔnɔ le Kristo me

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Esi mieku kple Kristo ta la, miedo go le xexemegbɔgbɔwo ƒe ŋusẽ te. Nu ka ta miegana wode se kukluiwo na mi abe xexemeŋusẽ tee miegale ene?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Se siawo katã ku ɖe nu siwo ŋuti dɔ wowɔna wòvɔna la ŋu. Amegbetɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo kple nufiafia ko wonye.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Edze le gota gome abe ne ame aɖe lé fɔ ɖe se siawo ŋu vevie, eye wòbɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe anyi, hewɔ funyafunya eƒe ŋutilã alea la, nunya gã aɖe ɖe wòle eme ene. Ke nu siawo wɔwɔ mekpena ɖe ame ŋuti, wòtea ŋu ɖua eƒe ŋutilã me nudzroamewo dzi koŋ o.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Esi wònye ɖe wofɔ mi ɖe tsitre kple Kristo ta la, miti nu siwo le dziƒo, afi si Kristo ŋutɔ bɔbɔ nɔ Mawu ƒe ɖusime le la, yome.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Miaƒe susu nenɔ dziƒonuwo ŋu, ke menye anyigbadzinuwo ŋu o,

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: elabe esi mieku la, wotsɔ miaƒe agbe de Kristo tɔ me heɣla ɖe Mawu me.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Ne Kristo, ame si nye míaƒe agbe la do la, ekema miawo hã miado kplii le ŋutikɔkɔe me. Tsãgbenɔnɔ kple fifitɔ

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
