translation_verse: Eya ta miwu anyigbadzinu siwo le mia me la. Esiawoe nye: ahasiwɔwɔ, nu makɔmakɔ wɔwɔ, nudzroame vɔ̃wo, fieŋufieŋu kple ŋubiabiã. Le nyateƒe me la ŋubiabiã la, trɔ̃subɔsubɔe.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Nu siawoe ahe Mawu ƒe dziku ava tosẽlawo dzii.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Le agbe si mienɔ tsã me la, miawo hã miewɔa nu siawo.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, miɖe asi le nu siawo katã ŋu: dziku, dɔmedzoe, vɔ̃ediname, busunyagbɔgblɔ kple nya ƒoɖi gbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Esi mieɖe miaƒe dzɔdzɔme xoxo la kple eƒe nuwɔnawo da ɖi vɔ la, migaka aʋatso na mia nɔewo azɔ o.

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nɔnɔme yeye la do. Mawu gbugbɔ nɔnɔme sia le wɔwɔm yeyee ɣe sia ɣi, ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe nɔnɔme me, be wòadze si ye.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Le go sia me ya la, vovototo aɖeke megale Helatɔ kple Yudatɔ, ame si wotso aʋa na kple ame si wometsoe na o, fiafiala, gbetometɔ, kluvi kple ablɔɖevi dome o. Ɖeka ko wo katã wole le Kristo me, eye Kristo le wo katã hã me.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Esi miezu Mawu ƒe ame tiatiawo, kɔkɔetɔwo kple lɔlɔ̃tɔwo ta la, mitsɔ nɔnɔme siwo sɔ ɖe eŋu la do. Esiawoe nye: veveseseɖeameti, dɔmenyo, ɖokuibɔbɔ, tufafa kple dzigbɔgbɔ blewuu.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Migbɔ dzi ɖi na mia nɔewo. Ne ame aɖe da vo ɖe mia ŋu la, mitsɔe kee, abe ale si Aƒetɔ la hã tsɔ miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke mi la ene.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Gawu la, lɔlɔ̃ nexɔ aƒe ɖe mia me, elabe eyae blaa nuwo katã ɖekae wòdea blibo.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Kristo ƒe ŋutifafa la neɖu dzi le miaƒe dziwo me, elabe eya ŋutie woyɔ mi va ƒo ƒui, abe hame ɖeka ene ɖo. Minye akpedalawo.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la nexɔ aƒe ɖe mia me blibo. Mifia nu, eye mixlɔ̃ nu mia nɔewo kple nunya geɖe. Mitsɔ Psalmowo, hadzidziwo kple gbɔgbɔmehawo da akpe na Mawu le miaƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Mina nu sia nu si miagblɔ alo awɔ la, nanɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu ŋkɔ me, eye mida akpe na Mawu Tɔ́ la, to eyama dzi. Hadomegbenɔnɔ le agbe yeye la me

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi srɔ̃nyɔnuwo, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia srɔ̃wo, abe ale si wòdze le Kristotɔwo dome la ene.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Nenema ke mi srɔ̃ŋutsuwo hã, milɔ̃ mia srɔ̃wo eye migawɔ dɔmevevi le wo ŋu o.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɖeviwo, miɖo to mia dzilawo le nuwo katã me, elabe esiae dzea Aƒetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Tɔ́wo, migado dziku na mia viwo, ne dzi naɖe le wo ƒo o.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Dɔlawo, miɖo to ame siwo nye miaƒe aƒetɔwo le xexea me la, le nu sia nu me. Migawɔ ame ŋkume nu be yewoadze ame ŋu o, ke boŋ misubɔ wo nyateƒetɔe abe mawuvɔ̃lawo ene.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Dɔ sia dɔ si wɔm miele la, miwɔe kple dzi faa. Miwɔe abe Aƒetɔ lae miele ewɔm na, eye menye na amegbetɔwo o ene.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Minyae be miele domenyinu la xɔ ge, abe miaƒe fetu ene, elabe Aƒetɔ Kristo la ŋutɔ subɔm miele.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Woaxe fe na nu gbegblẽ wɔla hã ɖe eƒe nuwɔna nu. Ameŋkumekpɔkpɔ aɖeke mele eme o.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Mi aƒetɔwo hã, esi mienyae be Aƒetɔ le miawo hã mia si le dziƒo ta la, miwɔ nu si dzɔ eye wòle eteƒe la na miaƒe dɔlawo. Nuxɔxlɔ̃

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɖaa. Ne miele gbe dom ɖa la, miaƒe susu nenɔ te eye mida akpe na Mawu ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Mido gbe ɖa ɖe míawo hã mía ta, bene Mawu naɖe mɔ na mí, ne míaɖe gbeƒã Kristo ƒe nya ɣaɣla la, esi ta mele ga me gɔ̃ hã ɖo.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Mido gbe ɖa be mate ŋu aɖe nya ɣaɣla sia afia, eme nakɔ, abe ale si wòdze be mawɔe la ene.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Mizɔ kple ame siwo mele hamea me o la nunyatɔe, eye miwɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ ɖe sia ɖe ŋuti dɔ nyuie.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Miƒo nu bubutɔe, be wòanyase na to ɣe sia ɣi, ne mianya ale si wòdze be miaɖo nya ŋui na ame sia ame. Gbedoname mamlɛawo

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Tixiko, nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔ, ame si nye subɔla anukwaretɔ kple nye hadɔwɔla le Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔ la me la, agblɔ nu siwo katã le dzɔdzɔm ɖe dzinye fifia la na mi.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Esia ta koŋ mele eɖom ɖe mi, bene miase mía gbɔnya ɖe sia ɖe, eye wòade dzi ƒo na mi.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Onesimo, mía nɔvi anukwaretɔ lɔlɔ̃tɔ, ame si nye mia dometɔ ɖeka la hã kpe ɖe eŋuti gbɔna. Woagblɔ afii nyawo katã na mi.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristarxo, ame si le gaxɔ me kplim la do gbe na mi. Nenema kee nye Marko, Barnaba nɔvi la hã. Wogblɔ nu si miawɔ nɛ la na mi xoxo, eya ta ne eva ɖo mia gbɔ la, mixɔe atuu.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yesu Yusto hã do gbe na mi. Woawo koe nye Yudatɔ siwo trɔ zu Kristotɔwo, eye wole dɔ wɔm kplim hena mawufiaɖuƒe la. Ame siawoe faa akɔ nam.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafra, Kristo ƒe dɔla, si tso miawo ŋutɔ mia dome la hã do gbe na mi. Ele gbedodoɖa dzi ɖe mia ta vevie, bene mianɔ te sesĩe eye miade blibo awɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu le nu sia nu me.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Mate ŋu aɖi ɖase le eŋu be ele dɔ dzi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe le miawo, Laodikeatɔwo kple Hierapolistɔwo ta.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luka, atikewɔla lɔlɔ̃tɔ la kple Demas, wodo gbe na mi.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Mido gbe na nɔvi siwo le Laodikea la nam. Nenema ke mido gbe na Mimfa kple hame si kpea ta le eƒeme la hã nam.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Ne miexlẽ agbalẽ sia vɔ la, miɖoe ɖe hame si le Laodikea la hã be woawo hã naxlẽ. Nenema ke miawo hã mixlẽ Laodikeatɔwo tɔ la hã.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, migblɔ na Arxipo be nelé be na Aƒetɔ la ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ, si wotsɔ de asi nɛ la, bene wòawɔe ade goe.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Gbedoname sia ya la, nye Paulo ŋutɔe tsɔ nye asi le eŋlɔmee. Miɖo ŋku edzi be megale gaxɔ me ko. Mawu neve mia nu.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Nye Paulo kple Silvano kpakple Timoteo ye le agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na mi, hame si le Tesalonika, eye wòle ha dem kple Mawu Tɔ́ la kpakple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la. Mawu Tɔ́ la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu eye woana ŋutifafa mi. Tesalonikatɔwo ƒe agbenɔnɔ kple xɔse

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Míedaa akpe na Mawu ɣe sia ɣi ɖe mi katã mia ta, eye ne míele gbe dom ɖa la, megblɔa miaƒe nya nɛ ɖaa.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Ne míele mía Mawu kple Tɔ́ la ŋkume la, míeɖoa ŋku edzi be miaƒe nuwɔna fia be miexɔ Mawu dzi se vavã, eye miaƒe agbagbadzedze hã ɖe miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ fia. Gawu la, ale si miele tsitre sesĩe la ɖee fia be miele mɔ kpɔm na mia Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Mía nɔviwo, mi ame siwo Mawu lɔ̃ vevie, míenya nyuie be Mawu ŋutɔe tia mi.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Nyanyui si míehe vɛ na mi la, menye nya ɖeɖe ko wònye míegblɔ na mi o, ke boŋ ŋusẽdɔ kple Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la hã kpe ɖe eŋu, eye gawu la, míeka ɖe edzi be ele eme vavã. Esi míenɔ mia gbɔ la, míeɖe ame si ƒomevi míenye la fia mi, miekpɔ. Miawo tae míewɔ esia ɖo.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Mieto míawo kpakple Aƒetɔ la ƒe afɔtoƒe eya ta, togbɔ be miekpe fu geɖe ŋutɔ le nya la xɔxɔ me hã la, Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la do ŋusẽ mi, miekpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Esia wɔe be mieva zu kpɔɖeŋu na xɔsetɔ siwo katã le Makedonia kple Axaya.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Menye ɖeko Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya la ɖi tso mia nu hoo de Makedonia kple Axaya amewo se o, ke boŋ ale si miexɔ Mawu dzi see la hã kaka de afi sia afi, ale be megahiã gɔ̃ hã be míawo míagake nu agblɔ nya aɖeke o.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Ameawo ŋutɔ koe le nu ƒom le ale si miexɔ míi kple ale si miegbe nu le legbawo gbɔ, trɔ hele Mawu gbagbe, nyateƒetɔ la boŋ subɔmee la ŋuti.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: Gawu la, ezu nya wolé ɖe nu be miele Mawu Vi, Yesu, ame si wofɔ ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye wòɖe mí be Mawu nagakpɔ dziku ɖe mía ŋu gbe aɖe gbe o la, lalam.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, abe ale si miawo ŋutɔ mienya ene la, míaƒe mia gbɔ vava mezu dzodzro o.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be míekpe fu, eye wodo ŋukpe mí, hetsi tre ɖe mía ŋu kple ŋkubiã le Filipi, abe ale si mienya ene hã la, míeɖo dzi ɖe mía Mawu la ŋu, eye míegblɔ eƒe Nyanyui la na mi.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Nu si xlɔ̃m míele mi la metso amebeble alo susu makɔmakɔ me o. Gawu la, míele esia wɔm be míato ayemɔdzi aflu mi o,

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Abe ale si mienya ene la, míetsɔ ameflunya viviwo kafu ame aɖeke, alo to aye me klẽ ŋu ɖe ame aɖeke ƒe nu ŋu kpɔ o. Mawue nye míaƒe ɖasefo!

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Le esia teƒe la, ɖe míebɔbɔ mía ɖokui ɖe anyi le mia dome boŋ, abe vidzikpɔla si léa be na eya ŋutɔ viawo ene.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Míelɔ̃ mi ale gbegbe, be menye Mawu ƒe Nyanyui la ɖeɖe ko ƒe gome míedi be miakpɔ kpli mí o, ke boŋ be míatsɔ míawo ŋutɔ mía ɖokui ana mi; elabe miaƒe nu ɖe wòlé dzi na mí koŋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, miɖo ŋku edzi be esime míenɔ Mawu ƒe Nyanyui la gblɔm na mi la, ɖe míewɔ dɔ zã kple keli hekpɔ mía ɖokui dzii, ale be míagazu agba na mia dometɔ aɖeke o.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Miawo kple Mawu siaa, miate ŋu aɖi ɖase le mía ŋu be esi míenɔ mi, ame siwo xɔ se la gbɔ la, míaƒe nɔnɔme ɖe wòdza hele kɔkɔe eye mokaka menɔ eŋu o,

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: elabe mienya ale si míexlɔ̃ nu mia dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple lɔlɔ̃, abe ale si tɔ́ wɔna na viawo la ene.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, míegade dzi ƒo na mi be mianɔ agbe si adze Mawu, ame si yɔ mi va eya ŋutɔ ƒe fiaɖuƒe kple ŋutikɔkɔe me la, ŋu.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Nu ɖeka si ta míegadaa akpe na Mawu ɖo ɣe sia ɣi lae nye be, esi míetsɔ eƒe gbedeasi vɛ na mi la, miexɔe atuu, menye abe amegbetɔ ƒe gbedeasi ene o, ke boŋ abe Mawu ƒe nya si tututu wònye la ene. Mawu ƒe gbedeasi siae wɔa dɔ le mi, ame siwo xɔ se la me.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, miawo hã miesɔ kple Mawu ƒe hame siwo wɔ ɖeka kple Kristo le Yudea la, elabe miawo hã miekpe fu le miawo ŋutɔ mia detɔwo si me, abe ale si woawo hã kpe fu le Yudatɔwo si me la ene.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Yudatɔ siawoe wu Aƒetɔ Yesu kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo, eye woawo kee ti míawo hã yome. Wodo dziku na Mawu eye wotsi tre ɖe amegbetɔwo katã ŋu.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo kee xe mɔ na mí, be míagagblɔ mawunya la na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o, bene woaxɔ wo ɖe agbe o. To esiawo wɔwɔ vivivo me la, woƒe nuvɔ̃wo va sɔ gbɔ kaka gba go. Azɔ la, Mawu ƒe dziku va dze wo dzi bliboe. Paulo ƒe didi be yeagaɖi tsa akpɔ hame la ɖa

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe koe nye esi míedzo le mia gbɔ. Togbɔ be míegale mia kpɔm kple ŋku o hã la, míaƒe susu ya le mia ŋu vevie. Edzro mí ŋutɔ eye míedze agbagba geɖe be míagakpɔ mi ŋkume kple ŋkume.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Míeɖoe be míava kpɔ mi ɖa - nye Paulo ŋutɔ meɖoe zi geɖe - ke Satana xe mɔ na mí.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Azɔ ɖe, ame kawoe nye míaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ, dzidzɔ kple fiakuku, si dzi míele dàda ge ɖo, ne mía Aƒetɔ Yesu vaa? Ɖe menye miawoe oa?

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, miawoe nye míaƒe atsyɔ̃ kple dzidzɔ baa!

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Ale esi míesusu mi kakaka wòglo mí la, míeɖoe be míawo míatsi Atene

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: eye míedɔ Timoteo, mía nɔvi kple hadɔwɔla, ame si subɔa Mawu to Kristo ƒe Nyanyui la kaka me la, ɖo ɖe mi. Míaƒe didie nye be wòali ke miaƒe xɔse, eye wòado ŋusẽ mi,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: ale be fu siwo kpem miele la, nagaɖe dzi le ame aɖeke ƒo o. Miawo ŋutɔ mienyae be esiae nye míaƒe dɔ.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Esime míenɔ mia gbɔ la, míegblɔe na mi kɔtɛe do ŋgɔ be fuwo fuwo kpe ge miala, abe ale si wòle eme vam miele kpɔkpɔm ene.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Mede dzi do ge do kpoe, esia tae medɔ Timoteo ɖo ɖa ɖo, be wòava akpɔ ale si miaƒe xɔse la le, ava agblɔ nam. Menɔ vɔvɔ̃m be ta menyo o, ametekpɔla va te mi kpɔ eye míaƒe agbagbadzedze zu dzodzro mahĩ!

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ esi Timoteo trɔ tso mia gbɔ va ɖo mía gbɔ la, ehe dzidzɔnya vɛ na mí tso miaƒe xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ ŋuti. Eva gblɔ na mí be miaƒe ŋku le mía dzi ŋutɔ ɣe sia ɣi, eye miedi vevie be yewoakpɔ mí, abe ale si míawo hã míedi vevie be míagakpɔ mi ene.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔviwo, le míaƒe xaxawo kple fukpekpewo katã me hã la, dzi gaɖo mía ƒo, le xɔse si le mia si la ta,

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: elabe ne miele te sesĩe le Aƒetɔ la me la, ekema agbe gaɖo mía me.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Ɖe míate ŋu ada akpe na Mawu le mia ta wòade edeƒea? Dzidzɔ gã si miedo na mí, le mía Mawu ŋkume la, wu gbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Míele gbedodoɖa dzi vevie zã kple keli be míagado go ŋkume kple ŋkume, ale be nu siwo gakpɔtɔ le miaƒe xɔse la ŋuti la, míatsɔ wo akpee na mi.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mía Mawu kple Tɔ́ la ŋutɔ kple mía Aƒetɔ Yesu nekplɔ mí be míava mia gbɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la nena be ale si mielɔ̃ mia nɔewo kple ame bubuwo katãe la natsi ɖe edzi ahakeke ta, abe ale si míelɔ̃ mii la ene.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Ale wòali ke miaƒe dziwo, bene mianɔ te sesĩe azu ame siwo ŋu wokɔ, ame siwo ŋu mokaka mele o, le mía Mawu kple Tɔ́ la ŋkume, le gbe si gbe mía Aƒetɔ Yesu kple eƒe ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la ava do la.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, nɔviwo, miesrɔ̃ ale si mianɔ agbee wòadze Mawu ŋu tso mía gbɔ eye miele enɔm hã, ke esi míede ha kple Aƒetɔ Yesu ta la, míele nu xlɔ̃m mi hele ŋusẽ dom mi be miayi edzi geɖe wu.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Mienya ɖoɖo siwo Aƒetɔ Yesu na míewɔ na mi la.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Enye Mawu ƒe didi be mianɔ agbe dzadzɛ eye miagawɔ ahasi o.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: ke megana eƒe fieŋufieŋu naɖu edzi, abe ale si trɔ̃subɔla siwo menya Mawu o la, nana be wo tɔ ɖua wo dzi la ene o.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Le nu siawo me la, Mawu medi be ame aɖeke nada vo ɖe nɔvia ŋu alo abae o. Abe ale si míete gbe ɖe edzi na mi va yi xoxo ene la, Aƒetɔ la ɖe wòhea to na ame si wɔa nuvɔ̃ siawo dome ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu meyɔ mí vɛ be míava agblẽ o, ke boŋ be míava zu ame siwo ŋu wokɔ.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ale ame si ke gbe ɖoɖo siawo dzi wɔwɔ la, menye amegbetɔ wògbe o, ke boŋ Mawu si na eƒe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la mi lae wògbe.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Le mia nɔewo lɔlɔ̃ gome ya la, mehiã kura be maŋlɔ naneke na mi tso eŋu o, elabe Mawu ŋutɔ fia mi be mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo xoxo.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, mielɔ̃ hametɔ siwo katã le Makedonia-nyigba blibo la dzi. Ke, nɔviwo, míele ŋusẽ dom mi be miagayi edzi geɖe wu.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Miaƒe taɖodzinu nanye be mianɔ agbe kpoo eye ame sia ame nakpɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe nyawo gbɔ. Mitsɔ miaƒe asiwo wɔ dɔe, abe ale si míebia tso mia si la ene.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Esia awɔe be miagaziɔ ɖe ame aɖeke ŋu o, eye ame siwo mele hamea me o la, abu mi. Aƒetɔ la ƒe vava evelia

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, míedi vevie be mianya nu le ame siwo ku la ƒe nya ŋuti, bene miaganɔ nu xam, abe ame bubu siwo si mɔkpɔkpɔ mele o la ene o.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Zi ale si míexɔe se be Yesu ku eye wògafɔ la, míegaxɔe se kplikpaa hã be Mawu ato Yesu dzi akplɔ ame siwo ku la ayi eɖokui gbɔe.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ ƒe nya wònye gblɔm míele na mi, be mí, ame siwo susɔ le agbe le Aƒetɔ la ƒe vavagbe la, míele ŋgɔ do ge na ame siwo ku la o.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ aɖi tso dziƒo ava kple gbeɖeɖe sesẽ, eye mawudɔlagã la aku Mawu ƒe kpẽ la. Ame gbãtɔ siwo le tsitre tsi ge lae nye ame siwo xɔ Kristo dzi se, hafi ku la.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Eya yome hafi woaƒo ƒu mí, ame siwo susɔ gale agbe le ɣe ma ɣi me kple wo katã ɖe alilikpowo me, ale be míayi aɖakpe Aƒetɔ la le ya me, eye ale míanɔ anyi kplii ɖaa.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Eya ta mitsɔ nya siawo fa akɔ na mia nɔewoe hee.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mehiã be magaŋlɔ naneke na mi tso ɣeyiɣiawo kple azãgbeawo ŋuti o,

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: elabe miawo ŋutɔ mienya be Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la ɖe wòle nɔnɔ ge, abe ale si fiafitɔ ɖina ɖe ame le zã me la ene.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi si me amewo anɔ gbɔgblɔm be: “Ŋutifafa ɖo aƒe eye míele dedie” la, ɣe ma ɣi tututue wole wo tsrɔ̃ ge kpata abe ale si fúɖuame lilia funɔ, eye mete ŋu sína le enu o la ene.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Ke, nɔviwo, miawo ya la, menye viviti mee miele ne ŋkeke sia nava aɖi ɖe mi abe fiafitɔ ene o,

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: elabe kekeli kple ŋkeke me tɔwo mi katã mienye, ke menye zã kple viviti me tɔwo o.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Eya ta migana míanɔ alɔ̃ dɔm abe ame bubuwo ene o, ke boŋ mina míanɔ ŋudzɔ ahanɔ mo xexi.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Zã mee ame dɔa alɔ̃, eye zã mee ahamulawo mua aha.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Ke esi míawo míenye ŋkekemetɔwo ta la, mina míanɔ mo xexi. Míaƒe akɔtakpoxɔnu nanye xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃, eye míaƒe gakuku nanye mɔ si kpɔm míele be wole mía xɔ ge ɖe agbe,

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: elabe Mawu meɖoe ɖi be yeƒe dɔmedzoe la natsrɔ̃ mí o, ke boŋ be yeato mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo dzi axɔ mí ɖe agbe.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Kristoe ku ɖe mía ta ale be, ɖe míele agbe o, ɖe míeku o, míanɔ egbɔ.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Eya ta mido ŋusẽ mia nɔewo, eye miakpe ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu be miatsi ɖe edzi, abe ale si miele ewɔmee ene. Ɖoɖo mamlɛawo kple gbedoname

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, míele kuku ɖem na mi be miatsɔ bubu na mia dome ame siwo le kutri kum, le mia kplɔm le Aƒetɔ la ƒe mɔ dzi eye woxlɔ̃a nu mi la.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Mibu wo vevie eye mialɔ̃ wo le dɔ si wɔm wole la ta. Minɔ kple mia nɔewo le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, ke míele aɖaŋu ɖom na mi be migbe nya na kuviatɔwo, mido ŋusẽ ame siwo ƒo dzi ɖe le, mido alɔ ame siwo gbɔdzɔ eye migbɔ dzi ɖi na ame sia ame.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie be ame aɖeke nagaɖo vɔ̃ vɔ̃ teƒe o, ke boŋ midi nyui na mia nɔewo kple ame sia ame.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Mikpɔ dzidzɔ ɖaa.

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Minɔ gbedodoɖa dzi ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Mida akpe ɖe nu sia nu si adzɔ la ta elabe esiae nye nu si Mawu di tso mi, ame siwo le ha dem kple Kristo Yesu la si.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Migatsi Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la nu o,

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: ke boŋ mido nu sia nu kpɔ, ne mialé nu si nyo la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Mite ɖa xaa tso nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi gbɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si naa ŋutifafa la ŋutɔ nakɔ mia ŋuti keŋkeŋ. Nena miaƒe gbɔgbɔ, luʋɔ kple ŋutilã nanɔ dedie, mokaka manɔŋui le gbe si gbe mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo agava.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Ame si yɔ mi vɛ la nuteƒewɔla wònye eye awɔe godoo.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mido gbe ɖa ɖe mía ta.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Míedo gbe na nɔviawo katã nyuie!

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Míele biabiam tso mia si, abe ale si Aƒetɔ la di ene, be miaxlẽ agbalẽ sia na hametɔwo katã.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nye Paulo kple Silvano kpakple Timoteo woe le gbe dom na mi hametɔ siwo le Tesalonika, hele ha dem kple Mawu mía Tɔ́ kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Mawu Tɔ́ la kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mia nu eye woana ŋutifafa mi. Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le Kristo ƒe vavaɣi

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, ele na mí be míada akpe na Mawu ɣe sia ɣi le mia ta. Esia dze, elabe miaƒe xɔse le tsitsim ɖe edzi ŋusẽtɔe, eye miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ na mia nɔewo hã le to dem ŋutɔ.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Míetsɔa mi ƒoa adegbee na Mawu ƒe hameawo elabe, togbɔ be wole mia yome tim, eye miele fu geɖe kpem hã la, miaƒe xɔse la gale te sesĩe ko.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Nu siawo katã nye dzesi be Mawu ƒe ʋɔnu si wòdrɔ̃ la me kɔ, eya ta wobu mi be miedze anɔ eƒe fiaɖuƒe, si ta miele fu kpem ɖo la me.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Edzɔ le Mawu ŋkume be yeahe fukpekpe ava ame siwo le fu fiam mi la dzi,

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: ke yeana mi, ame siwo wote ɖe anyi kple míawo hã, míagbɔ ɖe eme. Mawu le esia wɔ ge, ne mía Aƒetɔ Yesu do tso dziƒo kple eƒe mawudɔlawo le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ me la. Dzo ƒe aɖewo me nɔ ge wòala,

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: eye wòahe to na ame siwo medze si Mawu o kple ame siwo mewɔ ɖe mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe Nyanyui la dzi o la.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Ne Aƒetɔ la va do, gbe ma gbe, be woadoe ɖe dzi le eƒe ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la dome, eye ame siwo xɔ Mawu dzi se, to míaƒe ɖaseɖiɖi na mi me la nade ta agu nɛ la, woahe to na ame mavɔ̃mawu siawo, atsrɔ̃ wo tegbetegbee, eye woaɖe wo ɖa le Aƒetɔ la ŋkume, afi si eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la le la.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Esia tae míele gbe dom ɖa ɖe mia ta ɣe sia ɣi ɖo. Míebiaa mía Mawu, be wòana be miaƒe agbenɔnɔ nasɔ kple agbe si ƒomevi woyɔ mi be miava anɔ la. Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, Mawu nena miaƒe didi, be yewoawɔ nu nyui la nava eme. Eƒe ŋusẽ nana dɔ si miaƒe xɔse na miele wɔwɔm la nadze edzi nyuie.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Mía Mawu kple Aƒetɔ Yesu neve mia nu, ale be miado mía Aƒetɔ Yesu ŋkɔ ɖe dzi, ne eya hã nado mi ɖe dzi.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nɔviwo, mele kuku ɖem na mi be nya si miese tso mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe vava kple ale si míaƒo ƒu ado goe ŋu la,

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: megaʋuʋu mi dzro ko, alo atɔtɔ miaƒe susu o. Eɖi be gbɔgbɔmeɖeɖefia aɖe, alo numenya aɖe, alo agbalẽ aɖe, si wobe etso mía gbɔ la, le gbɔgblɔm be Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkeke la va ɖo xoxo.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Migana ame aɖeke nable mi le mɔ aɖeke nu kura o, elabe hafi ŋkeke ma nava la, ele be aglãdzedze ɖe Mawu ŋu nado ŋgɔ gbã eye aglãdzela si le tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge godoo la nadze ƒãa.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Ame sia le tsitre tsi ge ɖe Mawu, alo nu ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi si wosubɔna la ŋuti. Ayi ɖe mawuxɔ la me, abɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖi, ahagblɔ be Mawue yenye.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Mieɖo ŋku edzi be, esime menɔ mia gbɔ la, megblɔ nya sia na mi ɖe?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Ke miawo mienya nu si le asi ɖom edzi be megava haɖe o, va se ɖe esime eƒe ɣeyiɣi la nade, woaɖee afia.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Aglãdzedze ƒe ŋusẽ le dɔ wɔm le vivime xoxo, ke nu si koe kpɔtɔ lae nye be ame si le asi ɖom edzi la nate ɖa.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Ekema aglãdzela la adze ƒãa, ke gbɔgbɔ si le dodom tso Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe nu me ɖeɖe la ko awui, eye keklẽ si ado kple Aƒetɔ Yesu la koe atsrɔ̃e.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Satana ana ŋusẽ aglãdzela sia be wòatsɔ awɔ nukunu kple dzesi aɖewoe,

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: eye wòato ameblemɔnu vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi aflu ame geɖe, siwo atsrɔ̃ la, elabe wogbe be yewomaxɔ nyateƒe la, ne woaɖe yewo o.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Eya ta Mawu tsɔ gbɔgbɔ si nana be ame trana la de wo me, be wòana woaxɔ nu si nye aʋatso la dzi ase,

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: bene woabu fɔ ame siwo katã mexɔ nyateƒe la dzi se o, ke boŋ wokpɔa dzidzɔ le nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ ŋuti la. Wotia mi be woaxɔ mi ɖe agbe

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Ke, mi nɔvinye, siwo Aƒetɔ la lɔ̃ vevie, ele be míada akpe na Mawu ɣe sia ɣi le mia ta, elabe miawoe nye ame gbãtɔ siwo Mawu tia be yeaxɔ ɖe agbe. Etsɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la kɔ mia ŋutii, eye miexɔ nyateƒenya la dzi se.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Esia ta wòto Nyanyui, si míegblɔ na mi la dzi yɔ mi, be miakpɔ gome le mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔviwo, minɔ te sesĩe. Milé nu siwo míegblɔ na mi be miawɔ le míaƒe nufiafia kple agbalẽ, si míeŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi la, me ɖe asi sesĩe.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋutɔ kple Mawu, mía Tɔ́, ame si lɔ̃ mí, heve mía nu, eye wòna akɔfafa mavɔmavɔ mí, gana be míele mɔ kpɔm na nu vavã aɖe la,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: nado ŋusẽ miaƒe dziwo. Nena miaƒe dɔ nyui wɔwɔ kple nu nyui ƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe nali ke zã.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Mlɔeake la, nɔvinyewo, mido gbe ɖa ɖe mía ta, be Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya la nakeke ta ahaɖu dzi, abe ale si wòle le mia dome la ene.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Mido gbe ɖa, be míagadze ŋutasẽlawo kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si me o, elabe menye ame sia amee xɔ se o.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la la, nuteƒewɔla wònye. Ana miali ke sesĩe, eye wòadzɔ mia ŋu be miagawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ta la, míeka ɖe edzi be miele nu siwo katã míeɖo na mi la dzi wɔm, eye ana miagayi edzi, awɔe nenema ke.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ nekplɔ miaƒe dziwo, be mialɔ̃ Mawu, ahanɔ te sesĩe le miaƒe ɖekawɔwɔ kple Kristo me. Dɔwɔwɔ le vevie

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, míele se dem na mi le Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋkɔ me, be mite ɖa tso nɔvi ɖe sia ɖe si wɔa kuvia, eye meléa ɖoɖo siwo míena mi la me ɖe asi o, la gbɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔ mienya ale si wòhiã, be miakpɔ míaƒe nuwɔna awɔ. Esi míenɔ mia dome la, míewɔ kuvia kura o.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Míeɖu nu le ame aɖeke gbɔ femaxee o, ke boŋ míedze agbagba, ku kutri zã kple keli, wɔ dɔ ɖu, be míaganye agba na ame aɖeke o.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Menye esi ŋusẽ mele mía si, be míana miakpɔ mía dzi tae o, ke boŋ ɖe míewɔe be miawo hã miakpɔ awɔ.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Elabe esi míenɔ mia dome gɔ̃ hã la, míede se na mi be: “Ne ame aɖe melɔ̃ be yeawɔ dɔ o la, megaɖu nu hã o.”

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Míele esia gblɔm, elabe míele sesem be kuviatɔ aɖewo le mia dome. Womewɔa dɔ aɖeke o, ke boŋ ame bubuwo ƒe nya me ko wonɔa nu demee.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Míegbe nya na ame siawo, le Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ŋkɔ me, eye míele nu xlɔ̃m wo be woawɔ dɔ kpoo, atsɔ kpɔ wo ɖokui dzii.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Azɔ nɔviwo, miawo la, ɖeɖi megate mia ŋu le nu nyui wɔwɔ me o.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe medi be yeawɔ ɖe nu si gblɔm míele le agbalẽ sia me dzi o la, mide dzesii, eye migade ha kplii o, ne ŋu nakpee.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Migatsɔe abe futɔ ene ya o, migbe nya nɛ nɔvitɔe boŋ. Nuwunyawo

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Aƒetɔ, si naa ŋutifafa la ŋutɔ nena ŋutifafa mi ɣeawo katã ɣi le nu sia nu me. Aƒetɔ la nenɔ kpli mi katã.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve mi katã mia nu.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Paulo, si nye amedɔdɔ gbɔ. Mawu mía Xɔla kple Kristo Yesu, ame si míele mɔ kpɔm na lae tiam meva zu amedɔdɔ.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: Mele eŋlɔm na wò, Timoteo, vinye vavãtɔ le xɔse la me. Mawu Tɔ́ la kple Kristo Yesu mía Aƒetɔ nave nuwò, akpɔ nublanui na wò, eye woana ŋutifafa wò. Paulo xlɔ̃ nu Timoteo le aʋatsonufiafia ŋu

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, gblɔe na wo be wonedzudzɔ ɣeyiɣi gbegblẽ ɖe ŋutinya kpakpɛwo kple tɔgbuitɔgbuiwo ƒe dzidzimewo xexlẽfia ŋu. Nyaʋiʋli ko wohena vanɛ, eye womedoa ɖoɖo si Mawu wɔ la ɖe ŋgɔ o. Xɔse dzaa koe te ŋu wɔa esia.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Susu si ta míele se sia dem ɖoe nye be míanyɔ lɔlɔ̃ si tso dzi dzadzɛ, dzitsinya nyui kple xɔse vavã me la le wo me.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo tra mɔ tso nu siawo gbɔ, eye wotrɔ ɖe nyamedzodzro siwo me viɖe aɖeke mele o la ŋu.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be womese nu si woawo ŋutɔ gblɔna kple nya siwo dzi wokana ɖo la gɔme o hã la, wodi be yewoanye Mawu ƒe se la fialawo.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, míenya be se la nyo, nenye be ame wɔ eŋudɔ, abe ale si dze ene.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Esi míese nu sia gɔme alea ta la, míenya hã be womedea se na nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla o, ke boŋ na aglãdzela kple tosẽla, ame mavɔ̃mawu kple nuvɔ̃wɔla, ame makɔmakɔ kple ŋukpenanuwɔla, ame siwo wua wo tɔ́ kple wo nɔ kpakple na amewulawo.

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: Ame bubu siwo wogadea se na la hã woe nye ahasiwɔlawo, ŋutsu siwo dɔna kple ŋutsu, amefilawo, aʋatsokalawo, atam dzodzro kalawo kple nuwɔna bubu siwo katã menyasɔ ɖe nufiafia nyui sia nu o la ko.

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Nufiafia sia le Nyanyui vavã si wode asi nam be magblɔ la me. Enye Mawu si míekafuna la ƒe Nyanyui la. Paulo da akpe ɖe ale si Mawu kpɔa nublanui na ame la ta

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Mele akpe dam na Kristo Yesu mía Aƒetɔ, ame si na ŋusẽm be mawɔ dɔ sia, elabe eyae dom kpɔ hekpɔ be menye nuteƒewɔla, eye wòtɔ asi dzinye be mawɔ yeƒe subɔsubɔdɔ sia;

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: evɔ wònye nyee gblɔ busunyawo ɖe eŋu, ti eyome, hedo vloe kpɔ hafi. Ke ekpɔ nublanui nam, elabe mewɔ nu siawo katã le manyamanya me, esime nyemexɔ se o.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ve nunye ale gbegbe be wòna nye asi su xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ si le ɖekawɔwɔ kple Kristo Yesu me la dzi.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Nya si wogblɔna be Kristo Yesu va xexe sia me be yeaxɔ nuvɔ̃wɔlawo ɖe agbe la, nyateƒenya wònye, eye wòle be woaxɔe blibo. Nyee nye nuvɔ̃wɔla vɔ̃ɖitɔ wu ame sia ame.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu kpɔ nublanui nam, ale be Kristo Yesu nate ŋu atsɔ nye, ame si nye nuvɔ̃wɔla gãtɔ, awɔ kpɔɖeŋu na ame siwo ava xɔ edzi ase hena agbe mavɔ la, be ɖe yegbɔa dzi blewuu ŋutɔ.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Mina míatsɔ kafukafu kple bubu na Fia si le dzi ɖum tso keke gbe aɖe gbe ke la, Mawu ɖeka hɔ̃ makumaku la, Mawu si womekpɔna o, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Vinye Timoteo, gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe nya, siwo wogblɔ na wò va yi la tae mele dɔ vevi sia dem asi na wò be nàwɔ ɖo. Wɔ nya si wogblɔ la ŋudɔ nàtsɔ awɔ aʋa vavã lae

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: kple xɔse kpakple dzitsinya nyui. Ame aɖewo meɖo to woƒe dzitsinya o, ale woƒe xɔse gblẽ.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Ame siawo dometɔ aɖewoe nye Himenaio kple Aleksandro. Metsɔ wo de asi na Abosam, bene woanya be menyo be yewoagblɔ busunya o.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Nu gbãtɔ si madi tso mia si be miawɔ lae nye be miaɖe kuku na Mawu ɖe amewo katã ta, ado gbe ɖa ɖe wo ta, abia nu ɖe wo nu ahada akpe na Mawu ɖe wo katã nu.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: Miwɔ esia na fiawo kple ame siwo katã le teƒe kɔkɔwo hã, ale be míate ŋu anɔ agbe le tomefafa kple ŋutifafa me kpoo, bene míate ŋu asubɔ Mawu bubutɔe le mɔ sia mɔ nu.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Esia nyo, eye wòdze Mawu mía Xɔla ŋu,

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: elabe enye Mawu ƒe didi vevie be woaxɔ amewo katã ɖe agbe be woava dze si nyateƒe la.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖeka hɔ̃ koe li, eye avuléla ɖeka ko hãe le Mawu kple amegbetɔwo dome. Eyae nye Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Esia tae wodɔm abe amedɔdɔ kple nufiala ene ɖo ɖe ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o la gbɔ, bene maɖe gbeƒã gbedeasi sia tso xɔse kple nyateƒe ŋu. Nyemele aʋatso kam o; nyateƒe tom mele.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Le sɔleme ɖe sia ɖe la, madi be ŋutsuwo nado gbe ɖa. Ŋutsuawo nanye ame siwo ŋu wokɔ na Mawu, eye woate ŋu ado asi ɖe dzi ne wole gbe dom ɖa, dziku kple ɖikeke manɔmee.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Nenema ke madi be nyɔnuwo hã nado awu ɖe nɔnɔme nyui, si matɔ ŋku o la, me. Ke menye be woaƒo ɖa atsiãtɔe, eye woado sika kple nu xɔasiwo o. Gawu la, womegado awu xɔasiwo o.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Ke boŋ woawɔ dɔ nyui si adze wo, abe ale si nyɔnu siwo ɖenɛ fiana be yewovɔ̃a Mawu la wɔnɛ ene.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Ele be nyɔnu nabɔbɔ eɖokui asrɔ̃ nu le ɖoɖoezizi kpoo me.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Nyemele mɔ ɖem na nyɔnu aɖeke be wòafia nu alo wòaɖu ŋutsu dzi o. Ele be wòazi ɖoɖoe kpoo.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Elabe Adam wowɔ gbã hafi wova wɔ Xawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, menye Adam ye woble o, ke boŋ nyɔnu lae woble, eye wòzu Mawu ƒe sedzidala.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Ke woaxɔ nyɔnu ɖe agbe to vi siwo wòdzi la me, nenye be wòdo vevie nu le xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ me, eye wòwɔ eɖokui kɔkɔe henɔ agbe dzadzɛ.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Nya si wogblɔna be ame si di nunɔladɔ la di dɔ nyui be yeawɔ la, nyateƒenya wònye.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mele be mokaka nanɔ nunɔla ŋu o. Ele be srɔ̃ ɖeka ko nanɔ esi, eye wòanye ame si léa eɖokui nyuie hewɔa susu ŋudɔ ale si dze. Ele be bubu nanɔ eŋu, wòanye ame si xɔa amedzro, eye wòanye nufiala nyui hã.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: Mele be nunɔla nanye ame si noa aha muna, alo ame si medzea kɔ anyi o; ke boŋ ele be wòanye ame fatu. Gawu la, mele be wòanye ame si lɔ̃a dzrewɔwɔ, eye wòdia ga vevie o.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: Ele be wòanye ame si kpɔa eƒe aƒe dzi nyuie, eye wònaa viawo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui hebua ame le nu sia nu me.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Elabe nenye be ame menya ale si wòakpɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe aƒe dzi nyuie o la, ale ke wòate ŋu akpɔ Mawu ƒe hame la dzii?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Mele be nunɔla nanye ame si trɔ dzime eteƒe medidi o. Ne menye nenem o la, ado eɖokui ɖe dzi ahadze anyi, abe ale si wònɔ na vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ene.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esiawo katã ŋu la, ele be ame siwo mele hamea me o la gɔ̃ hã natsɔ bubu na nunɔla, ale be womagado ŋukpee bene vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe mɔ̀ naɖee o. Ame siwo ƒomevi anye kpeɖeŋutɔwo le hamea me

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Ele be woanye ame siwo lé xɔse ƒe nyateƒenya ɣaɣla la me ɖe asi kple dzitsinya nyui.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Ke nà woado wo kpɔ gbã, eye ne mokaka mele wo ŋu o la, nà woawɔ subɔsubɔdɔ abe kpeɖeŋutɔwo ene.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ele be nyɔnu kpeɖeŋutɔwo hã nanye ame siwo ɖoa mo vevi ɖe dɔ ŋu wɔna. Womaganye ame siwo zɔa ame ŋu o, ke boŋ woanye ame siwo léa wo ɖokui nyuie, eye wowɔa nuteƒe le nuwo katã me.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Kpeɖeŋutɔwo naɖe srɔ̃ ɖeka ko, eye nà woawo ŋutɔ nakpɔ wo viwo kple woƒe aƒe dzi nyuie.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Kpeɖeŋutɔ siwo wɔ woƒe dɔwo nyuie la, da wo ɖokui ɖe bubuteƒe, eye dzi anɔ wo ƒo woate ŋu aƒo nu tso ale si woxɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se la ŋu na amewo. Nya ɣaɣla gã la

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na wò hã la, mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be mava kpɔ wò ɖa kpuie.

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: Ke mele eŋlɔm, ale be ne metsi megbe la, ekema nànya ale si ame nanɔ agbee le Mawu ƒe aƒe si nye Mawu gbagbe la ƒe hame la me. Eyae nye sɔti kple kpó le megbe na nyateƒe la.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, míele eme ʋum ƒãa be nya si ɣla ɖe míaƒe mawusubɔsubɔ me la lolo ŋutɔ. Eyae nye: Eɖe eɖokui fia le amegbetɔ ƒe nɔnɔme me. Gbɔgbɔ la ɖee fia be ele dzɔdzɔe, eye mawudɔlawo kpɔe. Woɖe gbeƒãe na dukɔwo, eye woxɔ edzi se le xexea me godoo, eye wokɔe yi dzi le ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la gblɔe kɔtɛe be le ŋkeke mamlɛ siawo me la, ame aɖewo aɖe asi le xɔse la ŋu. Ame siawo aɖo to gbɔgbɔ siwo blea ame kple gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe nufiafia.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: Ameblela siawo ƒe dzitsinya ku abe ga xɔdzoe wotsɔ mee ene, eye woawoe akaka nufiafia sia.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Woawoe blea amewo be womegaɖe srɔ̃ o. Gawu la, wodea se na amewo hã be womegaɖu nuɖuɖu, siwo Mawu wɔ la dometɔ aɖewo o. Evɔ la, Mawu ŋutɔe wɔ nuɖuɖu siawo be ame siwo xɔ se, eye wodze si nyateƒea la, naɖu ahada akpe ɖe wo ta hafi.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Elabe nu sia nu si Mawu wɔ la nyo, eye mele be woatsri ɖeke o, ke boŋ ele be woaxɔ ɖe sia ɖe ahada akpe ɖe eta.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nya la kple gbe si míedona ɖa ɖe eta la, nana be nuɖuɖua ŋuti kɔna xoxo. Ame si nye Kristo Yesu subɔla vavãtɔ

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Esi nètsɔ mawunya la nyi ɖokuiwòe, eye nèlé nufiafia nyuitɔ sia me ɖe asi ta la, fia nu siawo nɔviawo, ekema ànye subɔla vavãtɔ na Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Ke mègaɖo to gli makɔmakɔ si nyagãwo tona la o. Tsɔ mawuvɔvɔ̃ he ɖokuiwòe.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Esia tae míele ʋiʋlim hele dɔ wɔm sesĩe, eye míele ŋu ɖom ɖe Mawu gbagbe si nye Ɖela na amewo katã, vevietɔ xɔsetɔwo la ko ŋu.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Ka ɖe nya siawo dzi, eye nàfia wo.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Mègana ame aɖeke nado vlo wò, esi nènye ɖekakpui ko ta o. Ke dze agbagba be wò nuƒo, wò nɔnɔme, ale si nèlɔ̃ amee, xɔse si le asiwò kple ale si nèle dzadzɛ la, nanye kpɔɖeŋu na xɔsetɔwo.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Dze agbagba nànɔ mawunya xlẽm na hametɔwo ne wokpe ta. Nɔ nu xlɔ̃m amewo eye nànɔ nu fiam wo, va se ɖe esime mava.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Mègagbe nunana si wove nuwò na wò la ŋudɔwɔwɔ o. Wona nunana sia wò, to gbeƒãɖeɖe Mawu ƒe nya me esime hamemegãwo da woƒe asi ɖe dziwò.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Kpɔ egbɔ nàwɔ dɔdeasi siawo. Lé fɔ ɖe wɔna siawo ŋuti, ale be wò ŋgɔyiyi nadze ƒãa amewo nakpɔ.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Lé be na ɖokuiwò kple nu si fiam nèle la siaa. Lé nufiafia la me ɖe asi sesĩe elabe ne èwɔ esia la, àxɔ wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò kple ame siwo sea wò nyawo la hã, ɖe agbe.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Mèganyra ɖe ame tsitsi o, ke boŋ xlɔ̃ nui, abe ale si nàxlɔ̃ nu tɔ́wò ene. Xlɔ̃ nu ɖekakpuiwo abe nɔviwò ŋutsuwo ene,

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: nyɔnu tsitsiwo abe nɔwò ene, eye ɖetugbiwo abe nɔviwò nyɔnuwo ene, le dzadzɛnyenye blibo me.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Tsɔ bubu na ahosi siwo si ame mele o la.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ne viwo alo mamayɔviwo le ahosi aɖe si la, nà viawo nanya nu gbãtɔ si dze be woawɔ na woƒe ƒometɔwo, abe ale si hiã le mawusubɔsubɔ me la ene. Esiae nye be vi siawo nakpɔ wo dzilawo dzi, elabe nuwɔna siae dzea Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Ke ahosi, si si ame mele wòakpɔ edzi o la, eya ɖeka tsia anyi, eye wòkpɔa mɔ na Mawu ɖeɖe ko. Ewɔa eƒe ɣeyiɣi ŋudɔ doa gbe ɖa na Mawu zã kple keli heɖea kuku nɛ be nekpe ɖe ye ŋu.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Ke ahosi si tsɔ agbeɖuɖu ɖo dɔe la, ku gɔ̃ xoxo, togbɔ be eya ŋutɔ abu be yele agbe hã.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Gblɔ nya siawo kple kakaɖedzi, ale be ahosiawo nanɔ agbe si ŋu mokaka manɔ o la.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe gbe eya ŋutɔ ƒe amewo dzi kpɔkpɔ, vevietɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ƒometɔwo dzi kpɔkpɔ la, ekema etrɔ megbe de xɔse la, eye wòvɔ̃ɖi wu ame si mexɔ se o la.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Ne ahosi aɖe xɔ wu ƒe bla ade, eye wònye ame si ɖe srɔ̃ zi ɖeka ko kpɔ la, de eŋkɔ agbalẽ me.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: Ele be wòanye: ame si xɔ ŋkɔ to dɔ nyui, siwo wòwɔna la me; ame si he viawo nyuie; ame si xɔa amedzro; ame si klɔa nɔvi Kristotɔ bubuwo ƒe afɔ ŋu; ame si kpena ɖe ame ŋu le xaxa me, eye wòanye ame si wɔa nu si nyo le mɔ sia mɔ nu.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Ke mègade ahosi siwo metsi o la ŋkɔ agbalẽ me o, elabe ne srɔ̃ɖeɖe le wo dzrom la, woɖea kɔ ɖa le Kristo ŋu.

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: Ale wova zua vodalawo le esi woda woƒe ŋugbedodo gbãtɔ dzi ta.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, wogblẽa woƒe ɣeyiɣi nɔa tsatsam tso aƒeme yi aƒeme, eye to ema wɔwɔ me la, wova zua kuviatɔwo. Menye kuviatɔwo ko wozuna o, ke boŋ wozua ameŋunyagblɔlawo kple ame siwo metɔna ɖe afi ɖeka o, kpakple ame siwo nɔa nya si mesɔ be woagblɔ o la hã gblɔm.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Ale madi be ahosi siwo metsi o la, naɖe srɔ̃ adzi vi, eye woakpɔ woƒe aƒe dzi, ale be womagana mɔnukpɔkpɔ aɖeke míaƒe futɔwo, be woagblɔ nya ƒoɖi aɖeke tso mía ŋu o.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Mele esia gblɔm, elabe ahosi aɖewo tra mɔ dze Abosam yome gɔ̃ hã xoxo.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Nenye be ahosiwo le nyɔnu Kristotɔ aɖe si le eƒe ƒome me la, ele nɛ be wòakpɔ wo dzi, eye megatsɔ agba la da ɖe hamea dzi o. Esia awɔe be hame la nate ŋu akpe ɖe ahosi siwo si ame mele o la ŋu.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Na woatsɔ bubu na hamemegã siwo le hame la kplɔm nyuie, vevietɔ esiwo doa vevie mawunyagbɔgblɔ kple nufiafia, eye woana bubu si dze na wo la ƒe teƒe eve wo.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Elabe mawunya gblɔ be, “Mègabla nu na nyitsu si le mɔli dugum la o.” Egagblɔ hã be, “Ame si wɔ fetudɔ la, edze be woaxe fe nɛ.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe tso hamemegã aɖe nu la, mègaxɔ nya la nɛ o, negbe ɖe nèse nutsotso ma ke le ame evelia alo etɔ̃lia nu hafi.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Ka mo na ame siwo le nuvɔ̃ wɔm la, le ame sia ame ŋkume, ale be ame mamlɛawo nakpɔe avɔ̃.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Mele tsitre ɖe Mawu kple Kristo Yesu kpakple mawudɔla tiatiawo ŋkume hele biabiam tso asiwò be nàlé se siawo me ɖe asi pɛpɛpɛ. Ame aɖeke ƒe nu meganyo ŋuwò wu ame bubu tɔ o. Mègakpɔ ame ŋkume le wò nuwɔna aɖeke me o.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Mègatsi dzi be yeada asi ɖe ame dzi aɖoe wòanye dɔwɔla na Aƒetɔ la o. Mègade ha kple ame aɖeke hã miawɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Wɔ ɖokuiwò dzadzɛ.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Esi wò lã me le gbegblẽm enuenu ta la, mèganɔ tsi ɖeɖe ko nom azɔ o, ke boŋ nɔ wain hã nom vivivi be wòakpe ɖe wò dɔgbo ŋu.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ si ame aɖewo wɔna la dzena ƒãa zi ɖeka, eye wòfia be woahe to na wo, ke ame bubu aɖewo tɔ ya dzea go emegbe.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Nenema kee dɔ nyui siwo ame wɔna la hã dzena ƒãa wokpɔna. Ke ne womedze ƒãa amewo kpɔ o hã la, woava dze emegbe godoo woakpɔ.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Na kluviwo katã natsɔ bubu blibo na woƒe aƒetɔwo, ale be ame aɖeke nagagblɔ nya ƒoɖi ɖe Mawu ŋkɔ kple míaƒe nufiafia la ŋu o.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Mele be kluvi siwo ƒe aƒetɔwo nye Kristotɔwo la, natsɔ wo awɔ wo hatii kple susu be nɔviwo ko yewo katã yewonye o. Le esia teƒe la, ele na wo be woabu woƒe aƒetɔwo vevie wu boŋ, elabe aƒetɔ mawo, siwo kpɔa viɖe tsoa woƒe subɔsubɔ me la hã nye xɔsetɔwo kple lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, abe woawo ke ene. Aʋatsonufiafia kple kesinɔnu vavãtɔwo Fia nu siawo eye nàtsɔ wo axlɔ̃ nu amewoe.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si fia nu bubu si mesɔ kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe nyawo alo nu si le mawusubɔsubɔ nyateƒetɔ me o la,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: le eɖokui dom ɖe dzi glodzoo, eye mele naneke nyam o, ke boŋ nyahehe vivivo koe zu dɔléle nɛ. Ŋuʋaʋã, dzre, amedzudzu, vɔ̃susu ɖe ame ŋu,

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: kple nyaʋiʋli si mehiã o la, koe kplɔa esiawo ɖo le ame siwo ƒe susu megale dɔ wɔm nyuie o, eye womegale nyateƒe la me o la dome. Ame siawo buna be mawusubɔsubɔ nye viɖedidi ƒe mɔnu aɖe.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Ele eme baa be viɖe geɖe ŋutɔ le mawusubɔsubɔ me, nenye be nu si le mía si xoxo la dze mía ŋu.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Elabe míetsɔ naneke va xexea mee o, eye eme kɔ be míete ŋu le naneke tsɔ ge adzoe hã o.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Eya ta ne nuɖuɖu, nudodo kple nutata le mía si la, mina esiawo nadze mía ŋu.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo dina be yewoazu kesinɔtɔwo la gena dzea tetekpɔ me godoo, eye movinu siwo yome tim wole la kplɔa wo dea mɔ̀ si le tetre ɖi la me, ale nu vevi wɔa wo. Nu gblẽna le wo ŋu, eye wotsrɔ̃na gbidii.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Elabe galɔlɔ̃ mee nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo katã ame wɔna la dzɔna tso. Ga ŋue ame aɖewo tsi dzi ɖo hedii kple ŋkubiã, eye wotra mɔ dzo le nu si dzi woxɔ se la gbɔ ʋĩi. Ale wova xa nu, se veve ʋuu, woƒe dzi gbã. Paulo ɖo aɖaŋu na Timoteo

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, Mawu ƒe amee nènye, eya ta to adzɔge na nu siawo katã. Ɖoe kplikpaa boŋ be yeawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe, asubɔ Mawu, axɔ ase, alɔ̃ ame, anɔ te sesĩe eye be yeafa tu.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Kè xɔse ƒe duɖime la sesĩe, ale be wò asi nasu agbe mavɔ si nye nunana le eyome la dzi. Agbe sia ŋutie Mawu yɔ wò ɖo, eye nèke nu ʋu eme nyuie le ame geɖe, siwo nye ɖasefowo na wò la, ŋkume.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Le Mawu si naa agbe nuwo katã kple Kristo Yesu, ame si ʋu eƒe xɔse me nyuie le Pontio Pilato gbɔ la ŋkume,

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: mele eɖom dziwò koŋ be nàlé ɖoɖo siawo me ɖe asi, woanɔ anyi pɛpɛpɛ, mokaka aɖeke naganɔ wo ŋu o, va se ɖe gbe si gbe mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo nava la.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Mawu, ame si dze kafukafu, Dziɖula ɖeka hɔ̃ la, fiawo katã ƒe Fia, aƒetɔwo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ la, aɖe Kristo afia le ɣeyiɣi nyuitɔ, si eya ŋutɔ ɖo ɖi la dzi.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Eya ɖeka koe mekuna o eye kekeli si ŋu ame mate ŋu ate ɖo o lae ƒo xlãe. Ame aɖeke mekpɔe kpɔ o, eye ame aɖeke hã mate ŋu akpɔe o. Woatsɔ bubu nɛ, eye eya aɖu dzi ɖaa. Amen.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Xlɔ̃ nu kesinɔtɔ siwo le xexe sia me la be womegado wo ɖokui ɖe dzi, alo anɔ ŋu ɖom ɖe woƒe nunɔamesi siwo manɔ anyi ɖaa o la, ŋu o. Ke boŋ nà woaɖo ŋu ɖe Mawu, ame si naa nu nyui ɖe sia ɖe mí fũu be míawɔ eŋudɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na wo be ele be woawɔ nu si nyo, woanye kesinɔtɔwo le dɔ nyui wɔwɔ me, eye woaʋu asi me anyo dɔme na hiãtɔwo faa.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Ne wowɔ esia la, ekema wole nu geɖe ƒom ƒu ɖi na wo ɖokui hena ɣeyiɣi si gbɔna la, ale be woƒe asi nava su agbe vavãtɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Timoteo, dzra nu si wotsɔ de asi na wò la ɖo nyuie. Te ɖe megbe tso yakadzeɖoɖo si mefia mawuvɔvɔ̃ o la gbɔ. To adzɔge na movinyaʋiʋli si amewo kaa aʋatso gblɔna be nunya wònye la.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Elabe to gbeƒãɖeɖe esiawo me ame aɖewo tra mɔ dzo le xɔse la gbɔ. Mawu neve mi katã mia nu.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Paulo, Kristo Yesu ƒe amedɔdɔ to Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me gbɔ. Ɖe wodɔm koŋ be maɖe gbeƒã agbe si ŋugbe wodo na mí, ne míele hadede me kple Kristo Yesu.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: Mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe wò, Timoteo, vinye lɔlɔ̃tɔ. Mawu Tɔ́ la kple Kristo Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ la nave nuwò, akpɔ nublanui na wò, eye woana ŋutifafa wò. Paulo da akpe na Mawu, eye wòdo ŋusẽ Timoteo

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Medaa akpe na Mawu si subɔm mele kple dzitsinya si me kɔ la, abe ale si tɔgbuinyewo wɔe ene. Ne mele gbe dom ɖa, eye nye ŋku dze dziwò la, medaa akpe nɛ ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
