translation_verse: Ne meɖo ŋku aɖatsi si nɔ mo na wò dzi la, medina vevie, zã kple keli, be magakpɔ wò, ale be dzi nadzɔm.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Meɖoa ŋku xɔse nyateƒetɔ si le asiwò la dzi. Xɔse sia ƒomevie nɔ mamawò Lois me gbã, eye wòganɔ nɔwò Eunike hã me, eye azɔ la, meka ɖe edzi be eyae le wò hã mewò.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Eya ta mele ŋku ɖom edzi na wò be nàna Mawu ƒe nunana si wòna wò, esime meda asi ɖe dziwò la, nagakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi wu.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: Elabe Gbɔgbɔ si Mawu na mí la, menana be míevɔ̃na o; ke boŋ enye Gbɔgbɔ si naa ŋusẽ ɖoa mía me, míelɔ̃a ame, eye míeɖua mía ɖokui dzi.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya la gbɔgblɔ na amewo megakpe ŋu na wò o. Nenema ke nya si nàgblɔ na amewo tso nye, ame si le gaxɔ me ɖe Aƒetɔ la ta ŋu hã, megakpe ŋu na wò o. Ke boŋ ɖo dzi ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ ŋu, eye nàlɔ̃ akpe fu si wòle be wò hã nàkpe ɖe Nyanyui la ta la.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖe wòxɔ mí ɖe agbe heyɔ mí be míava nye ye ŋutɔ yeƒe amewo. Menye nu tɔxɛ aɖe si míewɔ la tae o, ke boŋ enye nu si eya ŋutɔ ɖo koŋ be yeave mía nu awɔ na mí. Míaƒe hadede kple Kristo Yesu mee wòto ve mía nu tso keke gbe aɖe gbe ke.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ke azɔ la, woɖe eƒe amenuveve kple ɖoɖo sia ɖe go fia mí to mía Xɔla Kristo Yesu ƒe vava eme. Eyae to Nyanyui la me ɖe ku ɖa, eye wòhe agbe vɛ na mí, bene míagaku akpɔ o.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖom mezu amedɔdɔ kple nufiala be maɖe gbeƒã Nyanyui la,

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: eye esiawo tae mele fu kpem ɖo abe ale si dze la ene. Ke ŋu mele kpeyem o, elabe menya ame si dzi mexɔ se. Menya be ate ŋu adzɔ nu si wòtsɔ de asi nam la ŋu va se ɖe ŋkeke ma dzi.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Lé nyateƒenya siwo mefia wò la me ɖe asi, eye nànɔ xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ si le hadede kple Kristo Yesu me la me.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe si le mía me la, nedo ŋusẽ wò bene nàdzra nu nyui si wode asi na wò la ɖo.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Abe ale si nènya ene la, ame siwo katã le Asia, siwo dome Figelo kple Hermogene le la, trɔ dzo le gbɔnye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la nekpɔ nublanui na Onesiforo kple eƒemetɔwo, elabe ena nye dzi dze eme enuenu, eye gawu la, nye gaxɔmenɔnɔ mekpe ŋu nɛ o.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Esime wòva ɖo Roma teti la, edim vevie va se ɖe esime wòke ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la neve enu le ŋkeke ma dzi! Mexɔ se be mèŋlɔ subɔsubɔdɔ geɖe si wòwɔ nam le Efeso la be kura o.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, vinye, do ŋusẽ nu to ale si Mawu ve mía nu, eye míele hadede me kple Kristo Yesu la me.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Tsɔ nufiafia, siwo nèse tso nunye le ɖasefo geɖewo ŋkume la ɖe gbeƒãe, eye nàdee asi na ame siwo dzi nèka ɖo la, ale be woawo hã nate ŋu afia ame bubuwo.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Do dzi nàkpe fu faa, abe Kristo Yesu ƒe asrafo wɔnuteƒe ene.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Asrafo si le aʋa wɔm, eye wòdi be yeawɔ nu adze yeƒe aʋakplɔla ŋu la, megawɔa dɔ bubu aɖeke si menye asrafodɔ o la o.

english_verse: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
translation_verse: Hafi duɖimekela aɖe naxɔ dziɖuɖukuku la, ele nɛ be wòake duɖime la le se si wode la nu.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Agbledela si wɔ dɔ kple kutrikuku lae ɖua nu si wòŋe la gbã.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Bu nya siwo gblɔm mele la ŋu, elabe Aƒetɔ la akpe ɖe ŋuwò be nàse ɖe sia ɖe gɔme.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku Yesu Kristo, ame si wofɔ tso ku me, eye wònye Fia David tɔgbuiyɔvi la dzi. Nya siae nye Nyanyui si mele gbeƒã ɖemee.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Eya tae mele fu kpem ɖo, eye wode gam gɔ̃ hã abe ame si wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi aɖe ene. Ke womede ga Mawu ƒe nya la ya o.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Esia tae medoa dzi kpea fu ɖe sia ɖe le nu sia nu me le ame tiatiawo ta ɖo, ale be Mawu naxɔ woawo hã ɖe agbe to Kristo Yesu dzi, bene woƒe asi nasu ŋutikɔkɔe mavɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Nyateƒenya wònye wogblɔna be: “Ne míeku kpakplii la, míanɔ agbe hã kpakplii.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Ne míedo dzi kpe fu la, míaɖu fia hã kpakplii. Ne míegbe nu le egbɔ la, eya hã agbe nu le mía gbɔ.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Ne míawo míewɔ nuteƒe o la, eya wɔa nuteƒe ɖaa, elabe eya ŋutɔ mate ŋu agbe nu le eɖokui gbɔ o.” Dɔwɔla si ƒe dɔwɔwɔ dzea Mawu ŋu

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku nu sia dzi na wò ameawo. Xlɔ̃ nu wo le Aƒetɔ la ŋkume be womegawɔ dzre le nya siwo mehea nu nyui aɖeke vanɛ o la ŋu o, elabe nya mawo la, nu ko wogblẽna le wo selawo ŋu.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Do vevie nu abe dɔwɔla si ƒe dɔ mekpea ŋu nɛ o la ene, be wò dɔ nadze Mawu ŋu. Dze agbagba nàfia nyateƒenya la amewo pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: To adzɔge na dzeɖoɖo siwo mefia mawuvɔvɔ̃ o la, elabe woawoe nana be amewo megavɔ̃a Mawu o ɖe edzi.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Ale si abi vɔ̃ nyrana hekekenae la, nenemae dzeɖola siawo ƒe nyawo zɔnae. Ame siawo dometɔ aɖewoe nye Himenaio kple Fileto.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: Wotra mɔ tso nyateƒe la gbɔ, eye wole gbɔgblɔm be ame kukuwo tsi tsitre va yi xoxo. Ale wole ame geɖewo ƒe xɔse tɔtɔm.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Ke gɔmeɖokpe si Mawu ɖo na xɔse la la le te sesĩe. Nya si ɖo kpe edzi lae nye: “Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔ nya ame siwo nye eya ŋutɔ tɔwo.” Bubu hãe nye: “Ame sia ame si gblɔ be Mawu tɔ yenye la, nedzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Le aƒe gã ɖe sia ɖe me la, menye sika kple klosalo tsikunuwo koe nɔa anyi o, ke boŋ tsikunu siwo wokpa kple esiwo wome la hã nɔa anyi. Wowɔa ɖewo ŋudɔ le bubunuwo wɔɣi, ke wowɔa bubuwo ya ŋudɔ ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Nenye be ame aɖe kɔ eɖokui ŋuti tso nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me la, woawɔ eŋudɔ le bubunu tɔxɛwo wɔɣi, elabe wokɔ eŋuti na Mawu, eye wònye tsikunu vevi na aƒea tɔ. Ale woate ŋu awɔ eŋudɔ ɣe sia ɣi awɔ dɔ nyui ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Eya ta to adzɔge na nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ siwo dzroa ɖekakpuiwo vevie la, eye wò kple ame siwo tsɔ dzi dzadzɛ yɔa Aƒetɔ la be nekpe ɖe yewo ŋu la, miaʋli vevie ɖekae le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, xɔse, lɔlɔ̃ kple ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Mègade nu movinyahehe siwo me susu ɖɔʋu aɖeke mele o la me o. Wò ŋutɔ ènya be dzre ko wohena vanɛ mlɔeba.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Mele be Aƒetɔ la subɔla nanye dzrewɔla o, ke boŋ ele be wòanye ame si nyoa dɔme na ame sia ame, nufiala nyui kple dzidola.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: Gawu la, ele be wòanye ame si gbɔa dzi blewuu gbea nya na ame siwo tsia tsitre ɖe eŋu la. Ɖewohĩ Mawu ave ame siawo nu be woatrɔ dzime, eye woava dze si nyateƒe la.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ woado le Abosam ƒe mɔ̀ si me woge ɖo be woawɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la me, eye tame vɔ̃ si wòɖo ɖe wo ŋu la magadze edzi nɛ o.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi be le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me la, xexeme le sesẽ ge.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Amewo anye wo ɖokui ko tɔ dilawo, galɔ̃lawo; ame siwo anɔ wo ɖokui dom ɖe dzi, ɖokuiŋudzelawo, amedzulawo, ame siwo maɖo to wo dzilawo o, ame madaakpewo, ame siwo manɔ kɔkɔe o.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Ame bubuwo anye ame siwo makpɔ nublanui na ame o, ame siwo manyo dɔme na ame o, ameŋugblẽlawo, ame siwo mate ŋu aɖu wo ɖokui dzi o, adãwɔlawo, ame siwo malɔ̃ nu nyui o.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Ɖewo hã anye: yomemɔfialawo, ame siwo mabu nu o, ame siwo ado wo ɖokui ɖe dzi glodzoo, ame siwo alɔ̃ nu siwo ado dzidzɔ na woawo ŋutɔ wu esi woanye Mawu lɔ̃lawo,

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: ame siwo ŋú wòadze le be wole Mawu subɔm, evɔ la, wogbe eƒe ŋusẽ. To adzɔge ke na ame siawo!

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Ame siawo dometɔ aɖewo li siwo gena ɖe aƒewo me ayetɔe, eye wotrɔa nyɔnu gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔwo ƒe susu. Nyɔnu siawo ƒe nuvɔ̃ zu agba na woawo ŋutɔ le esi wokplɔ nudzroame vovovowo ɖo ta.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Wonye ame siwo léa to ɖe ame sia ame ko ƒe nya ŋu tamemabutɔe, ke womate ŋu adze si nyateƒe la akpɔ o.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Abe ale si Yane kple Yambre tsi tre ɖe Mose ŋui ene la, nenemae ame siawo hã tsi tre ɖe nyateƒe la ŋui. Nu fitifiti si wɔm wole la xɔ woƒe susu, eye woƒe xɔse megale te o.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ke womayi ŋgɔ wu ema o, elabe woƒe movidzɔdzɔ le dzedze ge ƒãa ame sia ame nakpɔ. Nenema tututue wòdzɔ ɖe Yane kple Yambre dzii. Nuxlɔ̃amenya mamlɛawo

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Ke wò ya la, ètsɔ nye afɔ le nye nufiafia, nye nɔnɔme, nu si nye nye taɖodzinu le agbe me, nye xɔse, nye dzigbɔɖi, nye lɔlɔ̃ kple nye tenɔnɔ me.

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: Nenema ke woti yowòme, eye nèkpe fu abe nye ke ene. Wò ŋutɔ ènya ale si woti yonyeme le Antioxia, Ikonio kple Listra kple ale si medo dzii; ke Aƒetɔ la ɖem tso wo katã me.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, ame siwo katã di be yewoanɔ hadede me kple Kristo Yesu, eye yewoavɔ̃ Mawu le yewoƒe agbe me la, woati wo yome godoo.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple ameblelawo ƒe agbenɔnɔ agagblẽ ɖe edzi wu tsã; woanɔ amewo blem, evɔ wònye ɖe woble woawo hã hafi.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, yi edzi nàlé nu si wofia wò kple nu si dzi nèxɔ se la me ɖe asi goŋgoŋ, elabe ènya wò nufialawo.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: Ènya mawunyawo tso wò ɖevime ke, eye esiawo ate ŋu afia afɔɖoƒe wò be woaxɔ wò ɖe agbe, nenye be èxɔ Kristo Yesu dzi se.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Mawue ʋã amewo be woaŋlɔ mawunya ɖe sia ɖe ɖi, eya ta wonyo be woatsɔ afia nu ame, agbe nya na ame, aɖɔ ame ɖo, eye be woatsɔ wo ahe ame be wòawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe;

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: ale be ame si subɔa Mawu la, nade blibo, eye wòasu te ahawɔ dɔ nyui ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Le Mawu kple Kristo Yesu, ame si ladrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame gbagbewo kple ame kukuwo, ame si le vava ge ava ɖu dzi abe fia ene ŋkume la, mele nu xlɔ̃m wò be

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: nàɖe gbeƒã nya la. Èkpɔ vovo o, mèkpɔ vovo o, do ŋusẽe. Ƒoe ɖe amewo nu, gbe nya na ame eye nàxlɔ̃ nu ame. Gbɔ dzi blewuu nàwɔ esiawo katã, eye mègadzudzɔ nufiafia o.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Elabe ɣeyiɣi gbɔna, esime amewo magadi be yewoaɖo to ase nufiafia nyuitɔ o. Le esia teƒe la, woadi nufialawo na wo ɖokui be woafia nu si tɔgbe tututu dim woawo ŋutɔ le la wo.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Womadi be yewoatrɔ to ɖe nyateƒenya la ŋu kura o, ke ŋutinya kpakpɛwo sese ŋu ko woado vivi ɖo.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Ke le wò ya gome la, nɔ te sesĩe ɣe sia ɣi. Ne èle fu kpem la, do dzi. Wɔ mawunyagblɔla ƒe dɔ, eye nàwɔ wò subɔsubɔdɔ la wu enu keŋ.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Le nye ŋutɔ gome la, ɣeyiɣia de nam vɔ be woatsɔm asa vɔe. Nye dzodzoɣi le agbe sia me ɖo edzi vɔ.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Meke duɖime la nyuie vɔ. Meƒu du la wu enu keŋkeŋ. Mele te le xɔse la me.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Azɔ la, dziɖuɖununana si wonana ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta la koe le lalayem. Aƒetɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla lae atsɔe anam gbe ma gbe. Ke menye nye ɖeka ko na ge wòala o, ke boŋ ana ame siwo katã lɔ̃e, eye wole mɔ kpɔm na eƒe vava la hãe. Paulo gblɔ nu siwo le edzi yim le egbɔ la ɖo ɖe Timoteo

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Dze agbagba nàva gbɔnye kaba,

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: elabe Dema gblẽm ɖi dzo. Eya galɔ̃ fifi xexe sia me ko, ale wòdzo yi ɖe Tesalonika. Kreske yi ɖe Galatia, eye Tito yi ɖe Dalmatia.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka ɖeka koe le gbɔnye. Di Marko nàkplɔ ɖe asi vɛ, elabe esubɔam nyuie ŋutɔ le dɔ si wɔm mele la me.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Medɔ Tixiko ya ɖo ɖe Efeso.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Ne ègbɔna la, tsɔ awu ʋlaya si megblẽ ɖe Karpo gbɔ le Troa la ɖe asi vɛ nam. Tsɔ agbalẽawo hã, vevietɔ esiwo wowɔ kple lãgbalẽ.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Aleksandro, akɔblinutula la wɔ nane ɖe ŋunye; nua vem ŋutɔ. Aƒetɔ la aɖo ŋu nu vevi si wòwɔm la teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖokuiwò dzi nyuie le eyama ŋu, elabe etsi tsitre ɖe míaƒe gbedeasi la ŋu.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Esi woyɔm zi gbãtɔ le ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒea be maʋli ɖokuinye ta la, ame aɖeke mede dzinye o; ame sia ame gblẽm ɖi dzo. Mawu megaɖo eteƒe na wo o.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Ke Aƒetɔ la ya nɔ kplim, eye wòdo ŋusẽm, ale be mete ŋu ɖe gbeƒã gbedeasi la na ame siwo katã menye Yudatɔwo o la. Ale wòɖem tso ku si me.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la aɖem tso nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖe sia ɖe me, eye wòakplɔm dedie ayi ɖe eƒe fiaɖuƒe si le dziƒo la me. Etɔe nye ŋutikɔkɔe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen. Gbedoname mamlɛawo

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na Priska kple Akwila kpakple Onesiforo ƒemetɔwo katã nyuie.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasto tsi Korinto, ke megblẽ Trofimo ya ɖe Mileto, elabe ele dɔ lém.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Dze agbagba nàva hafi vuvɔŋɔli naɖo. Eubulo, Pude, Lino kple Klaudia kpakple nɔviawo katã do gbe na wò nyuie.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la nenɔ kple wò gbɔgbɔ. Mawu neve mi katã mia nu.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Paulo, Mawu ƒe dɔla kple Yesu Kristo ƒe amedɔdɔ gbɔ. Ɖe wodɔm be makpe ɖe Mawu ƒe ame tiatiawo ŋu be woƒe xɔse natsi ɖe edzi, eye mafia nyateƒe si le míaƒe mawunya la me la wo.

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: Mawunya sia na míele mɔ kpɔm na agbe mavɔ si ŋugbe Mawu, ame si mekaa aʋatso o la, do gbe aɖe gbe ʋĩi ke la.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Mawu, mía Xɔla ɖe eƒe gbedeasi ɖe go kɔtɛe le ɣeyiɣi si eya ŋutɔ ɖo ɖi la dzi, eye wòtsɔe de asi nam be maɖe gbeƒãe.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Mele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na wò Tito, vinye nyateƒetɔ; wò ame si hã xɔ nu si dzi nye hã mexɔ se la dzi se. Mawu Tɔ́ la kple Kristo Yesu mía Xɔla la nave nuwò, eye woana ŋutifafa wò. Dɔ si Tito wɔ le Kreta

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Megblẽ wò ɖe Kreta, ale be nàɖɔ nu siwo susɔ la ɖo. Medi tso asiwò be nàɖo hamemegãwo ɖe du sia du me, abe ale si meɖoe na wò la ene.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Ame si nàɖo la nanye mokaka manɔŋutɔ, ame si ɖe nyɔnu ɖeka, ame si viwo nye xɔsetɔwo, eye wometsoa wo nu be wowɔa nu baɖa, alo womesea ame gbe o.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Ele be wòanye ame si xɔa amedzro, ame si lɔ̃ nu nyui wɔwɔ, ame si te ŋu léa eɖokui, ame si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, ame si le kɔkɔe kple ame si ɖua eɖokui dzi.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Mele esia gblɔm elabe tosẽla kple nya ƒuƒlu gblɔla kpakple ameblela geɖe siwo tso Yudatɔ siwo va xɔ se la dome li, le yiyim.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: Ele be woatsi nya ɖe ame siawo nu, elabe wole ƒome blibowo ƒe susu tɔtɔm, eye wole nufiafia si medze o la fiam ɖe viɖe ƒoɖi si woakpɔ la ta.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Woawo ŋutɔ dometɔ ɖeka si nye mawunyagblɔla la gblɔ be, “Kretatɔwo kaa aʋatso ɖaa, gbemelã vɔ̃ɖi, nu tsu ɖula, kuviatɔwo wonye.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Nya sia nye nyateƒe. Le esia ta la, ka mo na wo vevie bene woate ŋu atsi tsitre ɖe xɔse la me sesĩe,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: ale be womagatrɔ to ɖe ŋutinya kpakpa siwo Yudatɔwo gblɔna, alo ɖe se, si ame siwo gbe nyateƒea la, dena na wo la ŋu o.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Ame siwo dza la, nu sia nu nɔa dzadzɛ na wo, ke ame siwo ŋu mekɔ o, eye womexɔna sena o la, naneke menɔa dzadzɛ le wo gbɔ o. Woƒe susuwo kple dzitsinya ŋu mekɔ o.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Ame siawo gblɔna be yewonya Mawu, ke woƒe nuwɔnawo ɖenɛ fiana be ɖe wogbe nu le egbɔ boŋ. Wonye ame nyɔŋu, sẽto siwo medze na dɔ nyui aɖeke wɔwɔ kura o.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Ke le wò ya gome la, fia nu si sɔ kple nufiafia nyuitɔ la.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Fia ŋutsu tsitsiwo be woanye ame siwo léa wo ɖokui nyuie, ame siwo ɖoa mo vevi ɖe nu ŋu wɔna, ame siwo wɔa susu ŋudɔ nyuie, ame siwo anɔ te le xɔse kple lɔlɔ̃ me, eye woanye ame siwo doa dzi.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Fia nyɔnu tsitsiwo hã be woanɔ agbe kɔkɔe. Mele be woanye ame siwo zɔa ame ŋu, alo noa aha fũu o. Ele be woafia nu si nyo,

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: ale be woate ŋu ahe ɖetugbiwo be woalɔ̃ wo srɔ̃wo kple wo viwo siaa.

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: Ele be woanye ame siwo wɔa susu ŋudɔ nyuie, ame siwo dza, ame siwo wɔa aƒemedɔ, ame siwo nyoa dɔme eye wobɔbɔa wo ɖokui na woawo ŋutɔ srɔ̃wo, ale be amewo nagagblɔ nya vlo aɖeke ɖe Mawu ƒe nya la ŋu o.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Nenema ke xlɔ̃ nu ɖekakpuiwo hã be woaɖu wo ɖokui dzi.

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: Wò ŋutɔ dze agbagba nàfia kpɔɖeŋu nyuitɔ le nu sia nu si nàwɔ la me. Le wò nufiafia me la, nye anukwaretɔ kple moveviɖola.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Ɖɔ gbe ɖo nàƒo nu nyuie, ale be amewo nagatsi tre ɖe wò nyawo ŋu o. Esia ana be ŋu nakpe ame siwo atsi tre ɖe ŋuwò, esi womekpɔ nya vlo aɖeke agblɔ tso mía ŋu o ta.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Fia dɔlawo hã be woabɔbɔ wo ɖokui na woƒe aƒetɔwo, eye nu sia nu si woawɔ la, nadze woƒe aƒetɔwo ŋu. Womegaɖo nya ŋu na wo amemabutɔe o.

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: Womegafi nu suetɔ kekeake hã o, ke boŋ woneɖee fia be nuteƒewɔla siwo dzi woate ŋu axɔ ase bliboe lae yewonye, ale be nu sia nu si woawɔ la, nade bubu Mawu, mía Xɔla ƒe nufiafia la ŋu.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu ɖee fia kɔtɛe be yedi be yeave amegbetɔƒomea nu, eye yeaxɔ ame sia ame ɖe agbe.

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: esime míele lalam hele mɔ kpɔm na ŋkeke vevi ma, si dzi mía Mawugã kple mía Xɔla Yesu Kristo ado le ŋutikɔkɔe me la.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: Eyae tsɔ eɖokui ke faa ɖe mía ta be yeaɖe mí tso nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi me, eye yeakɔ mía ŋuti na ye ɖokui be míanye ye ɖeka ko tɔ, eye míadi vevie be míawɔ nu si nyo la ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Wɔ wò ŋutete ŋudɔ nàtsɔ ado ŋusẽ amewo ahagbe nya na woe. Mègana ame aɖeke nado vlo wò o.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi na hametɔwo be woabɔbɔ wo ɖokui na dziɖulawo kple ame siwo kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe wo dzi la. Ele be woaɖo to wo, eye woanɔ ŋudzɔ be yewoawɔ dɔ nyui ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Womegagblɔ ame ƒe nya vɔ̃e, alo anɔ dzre wɔm o, ke woanye ame fatuwo eye woatsɔ bubu tɔxɛ na amewo katã le nuwɔna ɖe sia ɖe me.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Elabe tsã la, míawo ŋutɔ hã movitɔwo, tosẽlawo kple tatralawo míenye. Míenye kluviwo na nudzroame kple dzidzɔdonamenu vovovowo. Míewɔ míaƒe ɣeyiɣiwo ŋudɔ le nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ kple ŋuʋaʋã me. Amewo lé fu mí, eye míawo hã míelé mía nɔewo ɖe fu me.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Ke esi Mawu, mía Xɔla ɖe ale si wònyoa dɔme, eye wòlɔ̃ amegbetɔ ɖe go la,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: exɔ mí ɖe agbe. Menye nu dzɔdzɔe aɖe si míewɔ la tae o, ke boŋ nublanuie wòkpɔ na mí. Wogbugbɔ mí gadzi to tsi si wole na mí la me, eye Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la gawɔ mí yeyee.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Mawu kɔ eƒe Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ɖe mía dzi faa to Yesu Kristo mía Xɔla dzi,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: ale be míate ŋu ato ale si wòve mía nui la me, be woabu mí ame dzɔdzɔewoe, eye míava kpɔ agbe mavɔ, si míele mɔ kpɔm na la.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Nya sia nye nyateƒe. Medi be nàte gbe ɖe nya siawo dzi vevie, ale be ame siwo va xɔ Mawu dzi se la, naɖo tame be yewoawɔ dɔ nyuiwo. Esiawo nye nu nyuitɔwo kekeake, eye viɖe le wo me na amegbetɔwo.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Ke madi be nàdze na movinyawo ʋiʋli, dzidzimexexlẽfia, amewo dome mama kple dzrewɔwɔ ɖe se la ta. Viɖe aɖeke mele wo me o. Yakanuwo sɔŋ ko wonye.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Le ame si hea memama dea amewo dome gome ya la, ne ègbe nya nɛ zi eve alo zi etɔ̃ ko la, ɖe asi le eŋu.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Nyae be ame ma ƒomevi ƒe susu me do viviti. Ewɔa nuvɔ̃ faa hebua fɔ eɖokui. Nuxlɔ̃amenya mamlɛawo

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Nenye be meɖo Artema alo Tixiko ɖe gbɔwò la, dze agbagba vevie nàva gbɔnye le Nikopoli, elabe meɖoe be manɔ afi ma le vuvɔŋɔli.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Dze agbagba nàdo mɔ senyala Zena kple Apolo hã kaba, eye nàkpɔ egbɔ be yedi nu siwo ahiã wo la na wo.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã le gbɔnye afii la do gbe na wò. Míedo gbe na ame siwo lɔ̃ mí le xɔsea me la nyuie. Mawu neve mi katã mia nu.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Nye Paulo, ame si wode gaxɔ me le Kristo Yesu ta kple mía nɔvi Timoteo gbɔe agbalẽ sia tso. Míele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe wò, Filemɔ̀n, mía hadɔwɔla lɔlɔ̃tɔ, mía nɔvinyɔnu Apia, mía hadɔwɔla Arxipo kple

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Mawu mía Tɔ́ kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo nave mia nu, eye woana ŋutifafa mi. Filemɔ̀n ƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple xɔse

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Ne menyale gbe dom ɖa ko la, meɖoa ŋku dziwò, eye medaa akpe na nye Mawu ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Mewɔa esia, elabe mese be èlɔ̃ Aƒetɔ Yesu hexɔ edzi se, eye nèlɔ̃ ame siwo katã ŋu wokɔ la.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Mele gbe dom ɖa be ha si dem míele abe xɔsetɔwo ene la, nasẽ ŋu ɖe edzi, ale be míase nu nyui, siwo le ɖekawɔwɔ kple Kristo me la gɔme, eye míakpɔ gome le wo me.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Nɔvinye, mekpɔ dzidzɔ eye nye dzi dze eme, elabe wò lɔlɔ̃ na be ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la, kpɔ gbɔɖeme. Paulo ɖe kuku ɖe Onesimo ta

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: Esi menye nɔviwò si le hadede me kple Kristo ta la, mekpɔ mɔ azi dziwò be nàwɔ nu si hiã la hafi.

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: Ke le lɔlɔ̃ ta la, medi be maɖe kuku na wò boŋ. Nye Paulo ŋutɔŋutɔ, ame si nye Kristo Yesu ƒe amedɔdɔ, hele gaxɔ me fifia gɔ̃ hã ɖe eta la,

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: mele kuku ɖem ɖe vinye Onesimo ta. Meva zu tɔ́ nɛ, esime mele gaxɔ me.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Tsã la, ame ko wònye; viɖe aɖeke menɔ eŋu na wò o; ke fifia la, viɖe le eŋu na nye kple wò siaa.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: Metrɔe le ɖoɖom ɖe wò. Ɖe wòwɔ nam abe nye ŋutɔ nye dzie mele ɖoɖom ɖe wò ene.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe mana wòatsi gbɔnye, anɔ kpekpeɖeŋu namem ɖe tewòƒe, esime mele gaxɔ me le Nyanyui la ta la, anye ne anyo nam ŋutɔ hafi.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Ke nyemedi be mazi dziwò hafi nàkpe ɖe ŋunye o. Medi be nàwɔe kple dzi faa. Eya ta nyemawɔ naneke si manye wò lɔlɔ̃nu o.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ nu si ta Onesimo dzo le gbɔwò ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe lae nye be wòatrɔ agbɔ ava nɔ gbɔwò koŋ emegbe.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Fifia la, menye kluvi gbɔlo ko wòganye o, ke boŋ ezu ame tɔxɛ wu kluvi. Etrɔ zu nɔviŋutsu lɔlɔ̃tɔ, vevietɔ na nye ŋutɔ. Ke egale vevie na wò ya wu, elabe enye wò kluvi abe amegbetɔ ene, eye wòganye nɔviwò ŋutsu si le hadede me kple Aƒetɔ la azɔ.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Ale, ne èbuam abe xɔ̃wò ene la, ekema gagbugbɔ xɔe atuu, abe ale si nàxɔ nye ŋutɔe ene.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Nenye be wòdze agɔ le dziwò, alo wònyi fe le ŋuwò la, bui nam.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Nye Paulo ŋutɔe tsɔ nye asi ŋlɔ esiae be: Maxe fea. Evɔ la, nyemedi be maɖo ŋku edzi na wò, be wò ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã ènyi ɖokuiwò ƒe fe le ŋunye o.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye, ɖe esia ta la, nà makpɔ viɖe vi aɖe tso gbɔwò, le Aƒetɔ la ta dzro. Nà nye dzi nadze eme le Kristo ta.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Mele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na wò kple kakaɖedzi be àɖo tom, eye menya nyuie be àwɔ wu ale si mebia tso asiwò gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, dze agbagba nàdi dzeƒe da ɖi nam, elabe mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be Mawu aɖo mi katã miaƒe gbedodoɖawo ŋu, eye wòana magbɔ ava mia gbɔ. Gbedoname

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafra, ame si hã le gaxɔ me kplim le Kristo Yesu ta la, do gbe na wò.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Nenema ke, nye hadɔwɔlawo Marko, Aristarxo, Dema kple Luka hã do gbe na wò nyuie.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo neve miaƒe gbɔgbɔ nu.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Le blema la, Mawu ƒo nu na mía tɔgbuiwo zi geɖe to eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo dzi le mɔ vovovo nu.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Ke le egbe ŋkeke mamlɛ siawo me la, Mawu ƒo nu na mí to Via dzi. Vi siae eya ŋutɔ tia be wòanyi nuwo katã dome. Eyama ke dzie Mawu to wɔ xexea me hã.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Vi lae ɖe ale si Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe le la fia, eye Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme tututue le eya hã si. Vi lae tsɔ eƒe nya ƒe ŋusẽ la lé xexeme blibo la ɖe te. Esi eyama klɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa vɔ la, eyi ɖabɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Mawu Bubutɔgã si le dziƒo ʋĩi la ƒe ɖusime. Mawu Vi lae nye gã

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Mawu wɔ Via wòzu gã wu mawudɔlawo, elabe ŋkɔ si Mawu va tsɔ nɛ la xɔ asi wu mawudɔlawo tɔ.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Azɔ ɖe, mawudɔlawo dometɔ kae Mawu gblɔ na kpɔ be: “Wòe nye Vinye, egbee medzi wò.” Alo wògblɔ na be: “Manye Tɔ́wò, eye wò la, nànye vinye”?

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, esi Mawu ɖoe be yeaɖo yeƒe ŋgɔgbevi ɖe xexea me la, egblɔ be: “Mawu ƒe dɔlawo katã, misubɔe.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Ke Mawu gblɔ le mawudɔlawo ŋu be: “Mawu tsɔ yaƒoƒo wɔ eƒe dɔlawo, dzo ƒe aɖewo nye eƒe subɔlawo.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ le Via ya ŋu be: “O Mawu, wò fiaɖuɖu anɔ anyi ɖaa. Wò fiaɖuɖu yɔ fũu kple nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Èlɔ̃ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, eye nèlé fu sedzimawɔmawɔ, eya ta wò Mawu la tia wò, heda wò ɖe bubuteƒe si dzidzɔ le wu hatiwòwo tɔ, ale nègbɔ wo katã ŋu.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Mawu gagblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ, wòe wɔ anyigba le gɔmedzedzea me, eye dziƒowo nye wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Nu siawo atsrɔ̃, ke wò la, èli ɖaa. Woatsi ado xoxo abe awu ene.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Èle wo ŋlɔ ge abe awu ene eye woatrɔ; ke wò la, nenema ko nɔ ge nàla tegbee, eye seɖoƒe meli na wò agbe me ŋkekewo o.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Ke mawudɔla kae Mawu gblɔ na kpɔ be: “Bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe nye ɖusime, va se ɖe esime matsɔ wò futɔwo awɔ wò afɔɖodzinui”?

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Mawudɔlawo katã la, ɖe menye Mawu ƒe subɔlawo wonye, eye wòdɔa wo ɖa be woakpe ɖe ame siwo xɔ ge yeala ɖe agbe la ŋu oa?

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, ele na mí be míalé fɔ ɖe nya siwo míese la ŋu nyuie. Ne menye nenema o la, míatra tso wo gbɔ.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Elabe nenye be gbedeasi si mawudɔlawo xɔ vɛ la nye nyateƒe, eye ne ame aɖe da vo alo sẽ to la, wohea to nɛ ɖe enu pɛpɛpɛ la,

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: ale ke míawɔ así le tohehe nu, ne miegbe toɖoɖo agbexɔxɔnya gã sia mahã? Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔe gblɔ agbexɔxɔ sia ƒe nya gbã, eye ame siwo see le enu la hã va ɖo kpe edzi na mí be enye nyateƒe.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ dzesiwo kple nukunuwo kpakple ŋusẽdɔ vovovowo hã ɖi ɖase le agbexɔxɔ sia ŋu. Hekpe ɖe esiawo ŋu la, Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe ƒe nunana si wòma ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe didi nu, na amewo la hã ɖo kpe agbexɔxɔ gã sia dzi. Ame si kplɔa mí yia agbexɔxɔ sia gbɔe

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Menye mawudɔlawo tee Mawu tsɔ xexe si le vava ge, si ƒe nya gblɔm míele la, dee o.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Ke mawunya ƒe akpa aɖe ɖi ɖase gblɔ be: “Nu kae nye amegbetɔ, be wò ŋku le eŋu. Nu ka koŋ ye nye amegbetɔ vi, be nèléa be nɛ?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Èbɔbɔe ɖe anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe wu mawudɔlawo. Ke nèva tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu ɖɔ nɛ abe fiakuku ene,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: eye nèna wòɖu nuwo katã dzi.” Azɔ la, nenye be wona wòɖu nuwo katã dzi la, ke naneke meli si dzi mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖo o. Ale si nuwo le fifia la, medze ƒãa na mí haɖe be ekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe nuwo katã dzi o.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Ke Yesu sia, si wobɔbɔ ɖe anyi wu mawudɔlawo ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko la, míekpɔ be Mawu tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu ɖɔ nɛ abe fiakuku ene. Ale le Mawu ƒe amenuveve ta la, ekpe fu heto eme ku ɖe amewo katã ta.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Esɔ be Mawu, ame si wɔ nuwo katã, eye wòlé wo ɖe te la, nana be Kristo nade blibo to fu siwo wòkpe la me, ale be wòakplɔ ame siwo nye Mawu viwo la vɛ, be woava kpɔ gome le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Elabe eya ame si kɔa amewo ŋu kple ame siwo ŋu wòkɔ la siaa dzɔƒe ɖekae li na wo. Eya tae menye ŋukpe nɛ be wòayɔ wo be ye nɔviwo o.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Ale egblɔ be: “Maɖe gbeƒã wò ŋkɔ na nɔvinyewo, eye mí kple hametɔwo míadzi ha akafu wò.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Egagblɔ be: “Maɖo dzi ɖe Mawu ŋu”, eye wògagblɔ hã be: “Nye kple vi siwo Mawu tsɔ nam lae nye esi.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Esi vi siwo wòwɔnɛ la nye amegbetɔwo henye ŋutilã kple ʋu ta la, Yesu hã trɔ zu amegbetɔ, eye wònɔ agbe abe woawo ke ene. Ewɔ esia ale be to eƒe ku me wòatsrɔ̃ Abosam, ame si si ku ƒe ŋusẽ le la.

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: Gawu la, Yesu wɔ esia be ame siwo katã vɔ̃a ku le woƒe agbenɔɣi bliboa me la, nadzudzɔ kuvɔvɔ̃ keŋ.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, menye mawudɔlawoe wòva xɔxɔ ge na o, ke boŋ Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwoe.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Eya ta ele be woawɔe wòanɔ abe nɔviawo ene le mɔ sia mɔ nu, ale be wòate ŋu azu nunɔlagã si kpɔa nublanui na ame, eye wòsubɔa Mawu nyateƒetɔe bene wòana woaɖe amewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Esi eya ŋutɔ hã kpe fu, eye wotee kpɔ ta la, ete ŋu kpena ɖe ame siwo wotena kpɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Nɔvinye kɔkɔe siwo Mawu yɔ tso dziƒo la, mibu Yesu, ame si nye míaƒe xɔse ƒe amedɔdɔ kple nunɔlagã la ŋu kpɔ.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nuteƒe na ame si ɖoe, abe ale si Mose hã wɔ nuteƒe le Mawuƒe la me ene.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Abe ale si wodea bubu xɔtula ŋu wu xɔ si wòtu ene la, nenema kee Yesu hã dze na bubu gã wu Mose.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Elabe aƒe ɖe sia ɖe la, amee tunɛ, ke Mawue nye ame si ɖo nuwo katã anyi.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Mose kpɔ Mawuƒe blibo la dzi abe subɔla ene nuteƒetɔe, bene wòaɖi ɖase le nu siwo ŋu Mawu ava ƒo nu le emegbe la ŋu.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Ke Kristo ya kpɔ Mawuƒe la dzi abe Vi ene nyateƒetɔe. Míawoe nye eƒe aƒe, ne míeɖo dzi ɖe eŋu hele mɔ kpɔm nɛ vevie kple kakaɖedzi. Dzudzɔƒe li na Mawu ƒe amewo

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Eya ta Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la gblɔ be: “Ne miese Mawu ƒe gbe egbegbe la,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: migasẽ to, abe ale si mia tɔgbuiwo wɔ, eye wodze aglã ɖe Mawu ŋu la ene o.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Wote Mawu kpɔ ɣe ma ɣi le gbedadaƒo. Mia tɔgbuiwo tem kpɔ le afi ma ƒe bla ene sɔŋ, eye wokpɔ nye dɔwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Ale dzi kum ɖe dzidzime ma ŋu, eye megblɔ be: ‘Ɣe sia ɣi wodaa vo eye wotrana, elabe womenya nye mɔwo o.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Dzi kum, eye meka atam gblɔ be: ‘Ne woaɖo afɔ nye anyigba si dzi mebe woadzudzɔ le la fĩi!’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Nɔviwo, mikpɔ nyuie be dzi vɔ̃ɖi maxɔse naganɔ mia dome ame aɖeke si, ale be wòade megbe tso Mawu gbagbe la gbɔ o.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ mixlɔ̃ nu mia nɔewo gbe sia gbe, zi ale si “Egbegbe” si wogblɔ la ka míawo hã, ale be nuvɔ̃ nagable mia dometɔ aɖeke, ne eƒe dzime nasẽ o.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Elabe ne míeɖo dzi ɖe Kristo ŋu vevie va se ɖe nuwuwu abe ale si míedze egɔmee ene la, eya ko hafi míakpɔ gome kplii.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be: “Ne miese Mawu ƒe gbe egbegbe la, migasẽ to, abe ale si mia tɔgbuiwo wɔ, eye wodze aglã ɖe Mawu ŋu la ene o.”

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Ame kawoe se Mawu ƒe gbe vɔ, hafi dze aglã do dziku nɛ? Ɖe menye ame siwo katã Mose kplɔ do go tso Egipte lae oa?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Ame kawo wòka atam gblɔ na be: “Ne woaɖo afɔ nye anyigba si dzi mebe woadzudzɔ le la fĩi”? Ɖe menye ame siwo sẽ to lae oa?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Ale eme kɔ na mí be nu si ta womete ŋu de anyigba la dzi o lae nye be womexɔ se o.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Eya ta esi mɔnukpɔkpɔ gali be amewo nakpɔ gome le dzudzɔ si ŋugbe Mawu do la me la, mina míavɔ̃, ne menye nenema o la, mia dome ame aɖewo atsi mɔ ta, eye womade dzudzɔƒe sia o.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Elabe wova gblɔ Nyanyui la na wo abe ale si wova gblɔe na míawo hã ene, ke nya si wose la, meɖe vi aɖeke na wo o, elabe togbɔ be wosee hã la, womexɔ edzi se o.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Ke mí ame siwo xɔe se la, míege ɖe dzudzɔƒe ma. Mawu gblɔ be: “Dzi kum, eye meka atam gblɔ be: ‘Ne woaɖo afɔ nye anyigba si dzi mebe woadzudzɔ le la fĩi.’ ” Mawu gblɔ esia, togbɔ be ewɔ eƒe dɔwo wu nu, esime wòwɔ xexea me wu nu vɔ hã.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu gblɔ le ŋkeke adrẽlia ŋu le afi aɖe be: “Le ŋkeke adrẽlia dzi la, Mawu dzudzɔ, eye megawɔ dɔ aɖeke o.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Egagblɔ le afi sia ke hã be: “Ne woaɖo afɔ nye anyigba si dzi mebe woadzudzɔ le la fĩi.”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ame siwo xɔ Nyanyui la gbã mete ŋu ge ɖe dzudzɔƒe la o, elabe womeɖo to Mawu o ta hã la, mɔ la gale ʋuʋu ɖi ko be ame aɖewo nagage ɖe eme.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Ale Mawu gaɖo ŋkeke bubu si nye “Egbegbe” eye wòƒo nu emegbe ʋĩi to David ƒe nya si ŋu míeƒo nu le va yi me be: “Ne miese Mawu ƒe gbe egbegbe la migasẽ to o.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Elabe nenye ɖe Yosua kplɔ wo de dzudzɔƒe si ŋugbe Mawu do na wo la, anye ne Mawu magaƒo nu le ŋkeke bubu aɖeke ŋu o.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Ale dzudzɔgbe aɖe li si dzi Mawu ƒe amewo adzudzɔ le,

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: elabe ame sia ame si de Mawu ƒe dzudzɔƒea la, dzudzɔ dɔwɔwɔ abe ale si Mawu hã dzudzɔe ene.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Eya ta mina míawo hã míaʋli sesĩe be míage ɖe dzudzɔƒe ma, eye ame aɖeke nagasẽ to ava tsi mɔ ta o.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu ƒe nya la le agbe, eye wòle dɔ wɔm. Eɖana wu yi nu evee ɖe sia ɖe. Eƒona ɖe ame yia to ke, eye wòmaa luʋɔ kple gbɔgbɔ dome, emaa ƒunuɖeƒewo kple ƒutomemi dome, eye wòdzroa ame ƒe susu kple dzimedidiwo me tsitotsito.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔ aɖeke mele ɣaɣla ɖee o. Woklo nu le nuwo katã dzi wole dzedzem ƒãa le eŋkume. Eya gbɔe míana akɔnta le míaƒe nyawo ŋu le. Yesu, Nunɔlagãwo ƒe amegã

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi Yesu, Mawu Vi, si nye Nunɔlagã, ame si to dziƒowo me do la le mía si ta la, mina míalé míaƒe xɔse si me míeʋu la me ɖe asi sesĩe.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Elabe menye nunɔlagã si mate ŋu ase nu gɔme na mí, ne míegbɔdzɔ lae le mía si o, ke boŋ esi wote kpɔ le nu sia nu me abe míawo ke ene, ke mewɔ nuvɔ̃ o lae le mía si.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Eya ta mina míate ɖe Mawu ƒe fiazikpui si gbɔ wòvea ame nu le la ŋu dzideƒotɔe, ale be le hiãgbe la, Mawu nakpɔ nublanui na mí ave mía nu.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã sia te ŋu gbɔa dzi blewuu na ame manyanuwo kple mɔtralawo, elabe eya ŋutɔ hã gbɔdzɔna.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, ele nɛ be wòasa vɔ ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple ame bubuwo tɔ siaa ta.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke meɖoa eɖokui nunɔlagãe hedea bubu sia eɖokui ŋu o, ke boŋ Mawue yɔnɛ abe ale si wòyɔ Aron ene.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Ale Kristo hã medo eɖokui ɖe dzi be woaɖo ye nunɔlagãe o, ke Mawue ɖoe hegblɔ be: “Vinye ŋutsuvi nènye; egbea ye medzi wò.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Egagblɔ le teƒe bubu aɖe hã be: “Nunɔla nènye tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me, abe Melxizedek ene.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Esime Yesu nye amegbetɔ la, edo gbe ɖa ɖe kuku vevie kple ɣli bobobo kpakple aɖatsi na ame si te ŋu ɖee tso ku me la. Mawu se eƒe gbedodoɖa kple kukuɖeɖe la, elabe evɔ̃a Mawu.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Mawu Vi wònye hã la, esrɔ̃ toɖoɖo to fu siwo wòkpe la me.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu wɔe wòde blibo le go sia go me vɔ la, eva zu ame si dzi ame siwo katã ɖoa toe la tona kpɔa ɖeɖe mavɔ.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Eyae nye ame si Mawu wɔ wònye nunɔlagã abe Melxizedek ene. Migade megbe tso xɔse la gbɔ o

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Nya geɖewo le mía si, siwo míedi be míagblɔ tso nya sia ŋu hafi, gake wo gbɔgblɔ nye dɔ, elabe miete ŋu le nu gɔme sem kabakaba o.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Esia le eme elabe togbɔ be ele be miawo hã mianye nufialawo fifia hafi hã la, miegahiã ame bubu be wòagafia gɔmedzenu gbãtɔ, siwo le mawunya me la mi. Miele abe vidzĩ siwo gahiã notsi ko, ke menye nuɖuɖu sesẽ o la ene.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si le notsi nom la, ɖevi ko wòganye, eye menya naneke le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ŋu o.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Ke ame tsitsiwoe ɖua nu sesẽ. Woawo la, wohe woƒe susu le nu geɖe me. Esia na be wote ŋu dea vovototo nyui kple vɔ̃ dome.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Eya ta mina míaɖe zɔ adzo le gɔmedzenu siwo wofia le Kristo ŋu la gbɔ, atsi ɖe edzi. Migana míagbugbɔ afia nu le ale si miatrɔ dzime tso nuwɔna maɖeviwo gbɔ kple ale si miaxɔ Mawu dzi asee la mi yeyee o.

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: Míefia nu vovovowo mi le mawutsilele, asidada ɖe ame dzi, ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ mamlɛtɔ ŋu.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Mawu yra anyigba si noa tsi si dzana ɖe edzi enuenu, eye numiemiewo miena ɖe edzi ale be wòɖea vi na ame siwo ta wode agble ɖe edzi la.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Ke anyigba si dzi ŋu kple srẽ ɖeɖe ko mie ɖo hewɔ la, viɖe aɖeke mele eŋu o. Woƒo fi dee vɔ kloe. Mlɔeba la, ɖeko woava tɔ dzoe.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, togbɔ be míeƒo nu alea hã la, le miawo ya gome la, míeka ɖe mia dzi be mienya nu nyui siwo ku ɖe ale si Mawu axɔ mi ɖe agbe la ŋuti.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu menye ame madzɔmadzɔ, ne wòaŋlɔ miaƒe dɔwɔwɔ kple lɔlɔ̃ si mieɖe fia le eŋkɔ ta la be o. Miekpe ɖe ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ la ŋu, eye miegale edzi le kpekpem ɖe wo ŋu va se ɖe fifi.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Ke míedi vevie be mia dome ame sia ame nagado vevie nu nenema ke, eye wòanɔ mɔ kpɔm kple kakaɖedzi blibo va se ɖe nuwuwu,

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: ale be miagazu nugɔmemaselawo o. Ke míedi be miakpɔ ame siwo tsɔ xɔse kple dzigbɔgbɔ blewuu xɔ nu siwo ŋugbe Mawu do la ƒe nuwɔna awɔ. Mawu ɖo kpe eƒe ŋugbedodo dzi

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Esi Mawu do ŋugbe na Abraham la, età eya ŋutɔ ɖokui nɛ, elabe ame aɖeke meli kɔ wui si wòatà o.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: Ebe: “Mayra wò eye mana nàdzi asɔ gbɔ fũu kokoko.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Ale esi Abraham gbɔ dzi blewuu hedo dzi la, eƒe asi su nu si ŋugbe Mawu do nɛ la dzi.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Amewo tàa nu yɔa nane si lolo wu woawo ŋutɔ, ne wodi be yewoaɖo kpe nya si yewogblɔ la dzi atsɔ awu nyaʋiʋliwo katã nu.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Esia tae Mawu tà nu tsɔ ɖo kpe eƒe ŋugbedodo la dzii ɖo, elabe edi be eme nakɔ na ame siwo lava xɔ nu si ŋugbe yedo na wo la be yeƒe ɖoɖo metrɔna gbeɖe o.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu wɔ nu eve, siwo nye ŋugbedodo kple nutàta siwo mate ŋu atrɔ o, eye womate ŋu atsɔ wo aka aʋatsoe hã o la ŋudɔ. Le nu siawo ta la, dzi gaɖo mí ame siwo va sii tso la ƒo ale gbegbe be míele mɔ kpɔm na nu si ŋugbe wòdo na mí la.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Mɔkpɔkpɔ siae lé míaƒe luʋɔwo ɖe te abe ale si seke léa tɔdziʋu ɖe te la ene. Eto xɔmetsovɔ la ŋu eye wòge ɖe vɔsaƒe kɔkɔe si le ememe la.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Afi siae Yesu ge ɖo ɖe mía teƒe abe ŋgɔdola ene. Eyae nye ame si va zu nunɔlagã abe Melxizedek ene yi ɖe mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Melxizedek sia nye Salem-fia eye wònye Mawu Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe nunɔla. Edo go Abraham esime Abraham trɔ tso aʋagbedzi afi si wòɖawu fiawo le, eye wòyrae.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Abraham tsɔ nu siwo katã dzi eƒe asi su la ƒe akpa ewolia nɛ. Gbã la, ŋkɔ “Melxizedek” gɔmee nye “fia nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla.” Evelia nye Salem-fia si fia be enye “Ŋutifafafia.”

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Womeƒo nu le tɔ́a alo nɔa ŋu o. Womeƒo nu le eƒe dzidzime hã ŋu o. Ale womenya naneke le eƒe dzidzi alo ku ŋuti o. Esia ta eɖi Mawu Vi la, eye wònye nunɔla si li tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ale si ame sia nye ame vevii la ɖa! Abraham, mía tɔgbui tsitsi la kura gɔ̃ hã tsɔ aboyonuawo ƒe akpa ewolia nɛ.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Le sea nu la, woɖe mɔ na Levi ƒe dzidzimevi siwo ɖua nunɔla be woaxɔ nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia le wo de Israelviwo si, togbɔ be woawo hã wonye Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwo hã.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Ke ame sia, si metso woƒe dzidzime la me o la, xɔ nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia le Abraham si, eye wòyra eya ame si Mawu do ŋugbe la na.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Ɖikeke aɖeke mele eme o, be ame si de ŋgɔ wu lae yra ame gblɔe la.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Le nunɔlawo gome la, amegbetɔe xɔa nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia; ke le Melxizedek gome la, ame si ŋu woɖi ɖase le be ele agbe lae xɔe.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Woate ŋu agblɔ kura be Levi, ame si xɔ nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã na nuwo ƒe akpa ewolia to Abraham dzi,

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: elabe esime Abraham do go Melxizedek la, womekpɔ dzi Levi haɖe o; egale Abraham ƒe ali me ko.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Levitɔwo ƒe nunɔlaɖuɖu dzie se la to va na Israel-dukɔ la. Azɔ la, nenye be Levitɔwo ƒe nunɔlaɖuɖu sia de blibo la, ɖe wògahiã be nunɔla bubu si le abe Melxizedek ene la, nagava ɖe Aron viwo teƒea?

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ne nunɔlaɖuɖu trɔ la, se si le eŋu la hã trɔna godoo.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Ame si ŋu wogblɔ nya siawo le la, to bubu mee wòtso, eye ame aɖeke metso to ma me wɔ subɔsubɔdɔ le vɔsamlekpuia gbɔ kpɔ o.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Edze ƒãa be Yuda-to la mee mía Aƒetɔ la dzɔ tso. Mose megblɔ nya aɖeke tso to sia ƒe nunɔlaɖuɖu ŋuti o. Nunɔla bubu si le abe Melxizedek ene

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Nya sia me gakɔ ɖe edzi wu, esime nunɔla bubu si ɖi Melxizedek la va do.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Elabe woɖi ɖase le ame sia ŋuti be: “Wò la, èzu nunɔla tegbee, abe Melxizedek ene.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Gbã la, woɖe se xoxo la ɖa, elabe ŋusẽ kple viɖe aɖeke menɔ eŋu o,

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: eye mewɔ naneke wòde blibo o. Evelia, ena míele mɔ kpɔm na nu si nyo wu sãa la, eye míeto esia me te ɖe Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Ke esi woɖo Yesu ya nunɔlae la, Mawu ka atam nɛ gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ la ka atam, eye matrɔ eƒe susu o. ‘Wò la, èzu nunɔla tegbee.’ ”

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Esia wɔe be Yesu va zu ame si de megbe na nubabla sia si nyo wu sãa la.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Nunɔla xoxotɔwo sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ, elabe wokuna kabakaba le dɔa gbɔ.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Ke esi Yesu ya le agbe tegbee ta la, enye nunɔla yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Ale ete ŋu xɔa ame siwo tena ɖe Mawu ŋu la ɖe agbe ɣe sia ɣi to eya ŋutɔ ɖokui dzi, elabe ele agbe ɖaa bene yeato míaƒe nyawo na Mawu.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Edze be nunɔlagã sia tɔgbe nanɔ mía si. Ame si le kɔkɔe, mokaka mele eŋu o eye ɖi aɖeke mele eŋu o. Woɖe ame sia ɖe aga sãa tso nuvɔ̃wɔlawo gbɔ, eye wodoe ɖe dzi wòle dziƒowo tame ke.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Mehiã kura be nunɔlagã sia nanɔ vɔ sam gbe sia gbe, gbã, ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta, emegbe, ɖe ame bubuwo tɔwo ta, abe ale si nunɔlagã bubuawo wɔnɛ la ene o. Ewɔ esia zi ɖeka ko hena ɣeyiɣiawo katã, esime wòtsɔ eɖokui sa vɔe.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Mose ƒe se la ɖoa amegbetɔ si nye gbɔdzɔgbɔdzɔtɔ la nunɔlagãe. Ke Mawu ƒe atam si wòka le Mose ƒe se la megbe la, ɖo Vi la nunɔlagãe tegbee eye wòwɔe wòde blibo.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nya vevitɔ si le nya si gblɔm míele la me lae nye be: Nunɔlagã sia le mía si. Ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Bubutɔgã la ƒe fiazikpui ƒe ɖusime le dziƒo.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã sia subɔna le kɔkɔeƒe si nye agbadɔ vavãtɔ la me. Aƒetɔ la ŋutɔe tu agbadɔ sia, ke menye amegbetɔ o.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Woɖoa nunɔlagã ɖe sia ɖe be wòatsɔ nunanawo ana eye wòasa vɔ, eya ta ele vevie be nane nanɔ nunɔla sia hã si bene wòatsɔ ana.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nenye be anyigba dzie wòle la, manye nunɔla kura o, elabe nunɔla siwo naa nu ɖe se la nu la li xoxo.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Nunɔladɔ si wowɔna la ɖi dziƒotɔ le go aɖe ko me, eye wònye nukpɔwɔɖeŋu aɖe ko. Elabe esi Mose be yeatu agbadɔa la, Mawu gblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ egbɔ nàwɔ nu sia nu ɖe nɔnɔme si wofia wò le toa dzi la nu.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Ke subɔsubɔdɔ si le Kristo si la nyo wu xoxotɔ sãa, abe ale si nubabla si wòtsɔ lé avu lae hã nyo wu ene, elabe wotu eya ɖe ŋugbedodo siwo nyo wu la dzi.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Ne vodada aɖeke ɖe mele nubabla gbãtɔ ma ŋu o la, anye ne magahiã be woabla nu yeye o.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Ke Mawu kpɔ vodada le amewo ŋu esime wògblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ la be: Ŋkeke gbɔna esime mawɔ nubabla yeye kple Israel ƒe aƒe la kple Yuda ƒe aƒe la.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Nubabla sia manɔ abe esi mewɔ kple wo tɔgbuiwo, esime melé woƒe alɔnu kplɔ wo do goe tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la ene o. Elabe womewɔ nuteƒe le nu, si mebla kple wo la me o; ale nye hã nyemetsɔ ɖeke le eme na wo o. Ale gblɔm Aƒetɔ la le nye esi.”

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gagblɔ be: “Le ŋkeke ma megbe la, nu, si mele babla ge kple Israel ƒe aƒe lae nye esi: Matsɔ nye sewo ade woƒe susu me, eye maŋlɔ wo ɖe woƒe dzi ŋu. Manye woƒe Mawu, eye woawo anye nye dukɔ.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke magafia nu ehavi alo nɔvia agblɔ be: ‘Dze si Aƒetɔ la’ o, elabe ame sia ame ŋutɔ ladze sim tso ɖevi suetɔ dzi va se ɖe ame tsitsitɔ kekeake dzi.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Elabe makpɔ nublanui na wo le nu madzɔmadzɔ siwo wowɔ la ta, eye nyemagaɖo ŋku nuvɔ̃ siwo wowɔ la dzi akpɔ o.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Esi wògblɔ be nubabla “yeye” la, efia be ena gbãtɔ la do xoxo. Azɔ nu si tsi, do xoxo vɔ la, eteƒe madidi hafi wòabu ɖa o.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, le nubabla xoxotɔ ŋɔli la, mawusubɔsubɔ ŋuti sewo li, eye wotu anyigbadzigbadɔ si me wosubɔna le la.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Woma agbadɔa me ɖe eve kple avɔ. Woyɔa teƒe gbãtɔ be Kɔkɔeƒe, eye afi siae wodaa akaɖiti, kplɔ̃ kple vɔsabolo la ɖo.
