english_verse: Behind the curtain was the most holy place.
translation_verse: Le xɔmetsovɔ evelia megbe la, agbadɔ bubu li. Woyɔa eya be Kɔkɔeƒe ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Nu siwo le afi sia la woe nye sikavɔsamlekpui si dzi wotɔa dzo lifi le, nubablaɖaka si ŋu wofa sika ɖo keŋ kpe ɖo. Nubablaɖaka la me nuwoe nye sikaze aɖe, si me mana le, Aron ƒe ati lalã si dzè kple nuŋlɔkpe eve siwo dzi woŋlɔ Mawu ƒe seawo ɖo.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Kerubiwo le aɖaka sia tame siwo le Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖem fia, eye wodo vɔvɔli ɖe zikpui si gbɔ wokpɔa nublanui na ame la dzi. Míate ŋu aƒo nu tso nu siawo ŋu tsitotsito fifia o.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Esi woɖo nuawo ɖi alea la, nunɔlawo yina ɖe agbadɔ gbãtɔ, si le gota gome la me edziedzi ɖasubɔna le afi ma.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Ke nunɔlagã koe gena ɖe agbadɔ evelia ya me, zi ɖeka ƒe ɖeka. Ne eyina la, etsɔa lãʋu ɖe asi. Ʋu siae wòtsɔna naa Mawu ɖe eya ŋutɔ kple dukɔ la ƒe numanyamanya ta.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: To esia me, Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ɖee fia be zi ale si agbadɔ ŋgɔgbetɔ la gali ko la, mɔ meʋu be woage ɖe Kɔkɔeƒe ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe la o.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Esia nye nufiame aɖe le egbeŋkeke siawo ŋu. Togbɔ be wonaa nunanawo kple vɔsanuwo le ɖoɖo sia nu hã la, womete ŋu wɔnɛ be mawusubɔla ƒe dzitsinya ŋu kɔna keŋkeŋ o,

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: elabe nu siawo katã ku ɖe nuɖuɖu, nunono kple kɔnu ƒomevi vovovo siwo ku ɖe ame ƒe ŋutilãŋukɔkɔ ko ŋu. Wowɔ ɖoɖo siawo katã na amegbetɔ, va se ɖe esime woava ɖɔ nuwo ɖo.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Ke Kristo va do abe nunɔlagã ene na nu nyui siwo va la. Enye nunɔla le agbadɔ si lolo, eye wòde blibo sãa wu xoxotɔ la me. Eya la, menye asie wotsɔ tui o, si gɔmee nye be metso xexe sia me o.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: Kristo ge ɖe Kɔkɔeƒe la zi ɖeka hɔ̃ ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu. Menye gbɔ̃tsu kple nyivi ƒe ʋue wòtsɔ yii o; ke boŋ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ʋue! Ale wòwɔe be Mawu naxɔ mí ɖe agbe tegbee.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Gbɔ̃tsu kple nyitsu ƒe ʋu kpakple nyinɔ si wotɔ dzoe wòfiã la ƒe afie wotsɔna wuna ɖe ame makɔmakɔ ŋu, eŋuti kɔna.

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: Ke Kristo to Gbɔgbɔ mavɔ la dzi tsɔ eya ŋutɔ ɖokui na Mawu abe vɔsanu si ŋu mokaka mele o la ene. Ale ke wɔ eƒe ʋu sia maklɔ míaƒe dzitsinya ŋu tso dɔwɔna siwo me viɖe aɖeke mele o la me, bene wòana míasubɔ Mawu gbagbe la nyuie wu o mahã?

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Esia ta Kristo nye ame si tsɔ nubabla yeye la lé avui, ale be ame siwo woyɔ la naxɔ domenyinu mavɔ, si ŋugbe wodo la. Esia va eme elabe amee ku, eye esia ɖe vodada siwo nɔ anyi le nubabla xoxo la ŋɔli ɖa.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Zi ale si ame si wɔ domenyigbalẽ la gale agbe la, womate ŋu awɔ agbalẽa ŋudɔ o.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Esia ta wotsɔ ʋu ɖo kpe nubabla xoxotɔ gɔ̃ hã dzii.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Le susu sia ta la, ne Mose ɖe gbeƒã sedede ɖe sia ɖe na dukɔ bliboa vɔ la, etsɔa nyivi kple gbɔ̃tsu ƒe ʋu kple tsi kpena ɖe alẽfu dzĩ kple hisɔp ŋu wuna ɖe agbalẽ la kple ameawo dzi

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: hegblɔna be: “Nubabla ƒe se si Mawu de na mi la ƒe ʋue nye esi.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Etsɔa ʋu la wuna ɖe agbadɔa kple nu siwo katã ŋudɔ wowɔna le subɔsubɔa me la hã dzi.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me le sea nu la, ʋue wotsɔna kɔa nu sia nu kloe ŋui, eye ne womekɔ ʋu ɖi o la, wometsɔa nuvɔ̃ kena o. Yesu tsɔ eɖokui sa vɔe heɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Ale ehiã be woawɔ kɔnu siawo atsɔ akɔ nu siwo ɖi dziƒonuwo ko la ŋutii. Ke le dziƒonuwo ŋutɔ gome la, wotsɔ vɔsanu siwo nyo wu anyigbadzitɔwo la kɔ wo ŋutii.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Elabe Kristo meyi ɖe Kɔkɔeƒe si wotsɔ asi tui, eye wònye vavãtɔ la ƒe kpɔɖeŋu ko la me o, ke boŋ dziƒo ŋutɔe wòyi, afi si wòle Mawu ŋkume ɖe mía teƒe le.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Meyi ɖe afi ma be yeatsɔ ye ɖokui anɔ vɔsamee edziedzi, abe ale si nunɔlagã la gena ɖe Kɔkɔeƒe ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe sia ƒe kple lãʋu si menye eya ŋutɔ tɔ o la ene o.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Nenye nenemae wòle la, anye ne fukpekpe dzi ko Kristo anɔ tegbee tso xexea me ƒe gɔmedzedzea me ke. Ke ale si wòle fifia la, Kristo va zi ɖeka hɔ̃ ko le xexea me ƒe nuwuwu ŋkeke siawo me, bene yeatsɔ ye ŋutɔ ye ɖokui asa vɔe, aɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖoe ɖi be amegbetɔ naku zi ɖeka ko, eye le eya megbe la, woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnui.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Nenema ke wotsɔ Kristo hã sa vɔe zi ɖeka ko, bene wòaɖe ame geɖewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa. Ale ne egava zi evelia la, magawɔ naneke le nuvɔ̃ ŋuti o, ke boŋ ame siwo le mɔ kpɔm nɛ vevie la ko wòaxɔ ɖe agbe.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Yudatɔwo ƒe se la la, nu nyui siwo le vava ge la ƒe vɔvɔli ko wònye, menye eyae nye nu vavãtɔ la o. Esia ta se la mate ŋu ato vɔsasa siwo wowɔna ƒè sia ƒè la dzi awɔ ame siwo tena vaa Mawu gbɔ la, woade blibo gbeɖe o.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɖe wòate ŋu awɔ ame wòade blibo la, anye ne amewo dzudzɔ vɔsasa. Nenye ɖe subɔla siwo ta wosa vɔ ɖo la ŋuti kɔ zi ɖeka ko la, anye ne woƒe dzitsinya maganɔ fɔ bum wo be nuvɔ̃ le wo ŋuti o.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: elabe nyitsu kple gbɔ̃tsu ƒe ʋu mate ŋu aɖe nuvɔ̃ ɖa le ame ŋu akpɔ o.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Esia ta esi Kristo gbɔna ɖe xexea me la, egblɔ na Mawu be: “Menye vɔsasa kple nunanawo dim nèle o, ke boŋ èwɔ ŋutilã nam.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Numeme nunanawo kple nuvɔ̃ɖeɖeɖa nunanawo medzea ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be: ‘Yoo Mawu, meva be mawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu’, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe mawunya me le ŋutinye ene.”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Gbã la, egblɔ be: “Menye vɔsasa, nunanawo, numemewo kple nu siwo wonana ɖe nuvɔ̃ ta lae nèdi alo woawoe dzea ŋuwò o.” Evɔ wònye se la nue wonaa nu siawo ɖo hafi.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Egagblɔ hã be: “Yoo, meva be mawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu.” Eɖe ɖoɖo gbãtɔ la ɖa be yeatsɔ evelia aɖo eteƒe.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: Esi Yesu Kristo wɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu hetsɔ eƒe ŋutilã na zi ɖeka ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu ta la, Mawu kɔ mía ŋuti.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Nunɔla ɖe sia ɖe tsia tsitre ɖe Mawusubɔƒe la gbe sia gbe. Etsɔa nunana mawo ke saa vɔe edziedzi, togbɔ be womate ŋu aɖe nuvɔ̃wo ɖa akpɔ o hã.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Ke esi Kristo va sa vɔ ɖeka ma ko ɖe nuvɔ̃wo ta hena ɣeawo katã ɣi la, eyi ɖabɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Mawu ƒe ɖusime.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Tso ɣe ma ɣi dzi la, ele lalam va se ɖe esime woatsɔ eƒe futɔwo awɔ eƒe afɔɖodzinui.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Kristo sa vɔ zi ɖeka ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu, eye wòwɔ ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la bliboe.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la hã ɖi ɖase na mí le esia ŋuti. Gbã la, egblɔ be:

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be: ‘Le ŋkeke mawo megbe la, nu, si mabla kpli wo la nye esi: Matsɔ nye sewo ade woƒe dzime, eye maŋlɔ wo ɖe woƒe susu me.’ ”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ kpe ɖe eŋu be: “Nyemagaɖo ŋku woƒe nuvɔ̃wo kple woƒe vodadawo dzi o.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Ne wotsɔ nu siawo ke la, megahiã be woasa vɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ ta o. Mina míate ɖe Mawu ŋu

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Eya ta nɔviwo, dzi ɖo mía ƒo be míage ɖe Kɔkɔeƒe ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe la to Yesu ƒe ku si wòku la dzi.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe ŋutilã ɖe mɔ gbagbe yeye na mí to xɔmetsovɔ la me.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Ale esi nunɔla triakɔ si le Mawuƒe la nu la le mía si la,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: mina míate ayi Mawu gbɔ kple dzi si toa nyateƒe, xɔse si li ke sesĩe, dzi si ƒe dzitsinya vɔ̃ɖi woklɔ ɖa keŋkeŋ kple ŋutilã si wole tsi zɔzrɔ̃e na nyuie la.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Mina míalé nu si me míeʋu hele mɔ kpɔm na la me ɖe asi sesĩe maʋamaʋãe, elabe ame si do ŋugbe la na mí la, nuteƒewɔla wònye.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Mina míabu ale si míanyɔ mía nɔewo ɖe nɔvilɔlɔ̃ kple agbenɔnɔ nyui ŋu la ŋu.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Migana míagbe míaƒe takpeƒewo yiyi, abe ale si mia dometɔ aɖewo wɔna la ene o. Ke boŋ mina míade dzi ƒo na mía nɔewo ɖe edzi vevie wu, esi míenya be ŋkeke la tu aƒe ta.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Elabe ne míenya nyateƒe la vɔ keŋ, hafi gaɖoe le nuvɔ̃ wɔm la, ekema vɔsasa aɖeke megali aɖe nuvɔ̃ la ɖa o.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Ke ɖeko míanɔ mɔ kpɔm kple vɔvɔ̃ na fɔbubu kple dzo bibi gã si afia Mawu ƒe futɔwo la.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe da Mose ƒe se la dzi la, womekpɔa nublanui nɛ o, ɖe wowunɛ; ɖasefo eve alo etɔ̃ koe hiã.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Ke ne ame aɖe tu afɔ Mawu Vi la dzi, eye mebu nubabla ƒe ʋu si kɔ eŋuti la ɖe naneke me o, eye wòdo vlo Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ si vea ame nu la, ɖe medze be woahe to nɛ vevie wu oa?

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Elabe míenya eya, ame si gblɔ be: “Nyee nye hlɔ̃biala; nye la, maɖo eteƒe.” Egagblɔ hã be: “Aƒetɔ la adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu eƒe dukɔ.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Baba na ame si ge ɖe Mawu gbagbe la si me!

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Ke miɖo ŋku ŋkeke siwo va yi, esime miedze si Mawu teti la dzi. Ɣe ma ɣi la, miedo dzi, ʋli sesĩe eye miekpe fu geɖe hã.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Ɣe aɖewo ɣi la, wodzua mi gɔ̃ hã le dutoƒo, eye miexaxana, eye ɣe aɖewo ɣi hã la, wobua mi dea ame siwo ŋuti wowɔa esiawo ɖo la dome.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, mia kple gamenɔlawo miekpe fu, eye togbɔ be amewo xɔ miaƒe nunɔamesiwo le mia si sesẽtɔe hã la, mieɖe asi le wo ŋu na wo faa kple dzidzɔ, elabe miawo ŋutɔ mienya be nunɔamesi siwo nyo wu emawo, eye woanɔ anyi ɖaa la le mia si.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Eya ta migana dzi naɖe le mia ƒo o, elabe fetu gã aɖe li na mi.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Ehiã be miado dzi ale be miate ŋu awɔ Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye miaxɔ nu si ŋugbe wòdo la.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Elabe mawunya gblɔ be: “Esusɔ ʋɛ ko ne ame si gbɔna la nava ɖo; matsi megbe o.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Ke nye ame dzɔdzɔe la anɔ agbe elabe exɔ dzinye se. Evɔ ne ehe ɖe megbe la, nyemagakpɔ ŋudzedze le eŋu o.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Míawo ya la, mímele ame siwo hena ɖe megbe hetsrɔ̃na la dome o, ke boŋ míele ame siwo si xɔse le, eye wole agbe la dome.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Xɔse nye ale si ame kana ɖe nu si wòle mɔ kpɔm na la dzi, eye wòɖoa dzi ɖe nu si kpɔm mele o la ŋu be eli.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Mawu kpɔ ŋudzedze le mía tɔgbuiwo ŋu le blema.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na míese egɔme be Mawu ƒe nyae wotsɔ wɔ xexea me, ale be wowɔ nu si kpɔm míele la tso nu si womekpɔna o la me.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Xɔsee Abel tsɔ na nu Mawui, eye eƒe vɔsasa dze Mawu ŋu wu Kain tɔ, ale Mawu bui nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlae. Mawu xɔ eƒe nunanawo, eye wòto eme ɖi ɖase nyui le eŋu. Abel ku baa, gake egale nu ƒom to eƒe xɔse dzi.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Xɔse tae wokɔ Henox yi dzii, ale be meku o. Womegakpɔe o, elabe Mawue kɔe yii. Azɔ hafi woakɔe ayii la, woɖi ɖase le eŋu be eƒe nu dze Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Ne xɔse mele ame aɖe si o la, eƒe nu mate ŋu adze Mawu ŋu akpɔ o. Elabe ele be ame sia ame si vaa Mawu gbɔ la naxɔe ase be Mawu li, eye wònana be ame siwo le edim la kpɔnɛ.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Noa ɖo to Mawu esime wògblɔ nɛ be nu si medzɔ ame aɖeke kpɔ kpɔ o la gbɔna dzɔdzɔ ge. Ekpa aɖakaʋu si ɖe eya kple eƒemetɔwo. To esia me la, ebu fɔ xexemetɔwo, eye wòva xɔ domenyinu si li na ame dzɔdzɔe siwo xɔ se la.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Abraham ɖo to Mawu esi wòyɔe be wòaʋu ayi anyigba si wòava xɔ abe eƒe domenyinu ene la dzi. Ale eʋu yi, togbɔ be menya afi si yim wòle o hã.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Abraham nɔ anyigba si ŋugbe wodo nɛ la dzi abe amedzro ene. Eya kple Isak kpakple Yakob wonɔ agbadɔ me, togbɔ be anyigba si dzi wonɔ la ŋugbee wodo na wo hafi hã.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Abraham wɔ esia elabe enɔ mɔ kpɔm na du gã si si gɔmeɖoɖo li na si Mawu ŋutɔ tu la.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na ŋusẽ gaɖo Sara ke hã ŋu wòfɔ fu, togbɔ be etsi ku nyagã hã, elabe ebu Mawu ame si do ŋugbe la nɛ la be enye nuteƒewɔla.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Eya ta tso Abraham ɖeka ma, si ku vɔ keŋ la me la, dzidzimevi siwo sɔ gbɔ abe ɣletiviwo alo ƒutake maxlemaxlẽ ene la va dzɔ.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Ame siawo katã ku kple xɔse, eye woƒe asi mesu nu si ŋugbe Mawu do na wo la dzi o, ke wokpɔe le adzɔge ʋĩi hedo wòezɔ nɛ ya. Wolɔ̃ ɖe edzi be amedzrowo kple mɔzɔlawo ko yewonye le anyigba sia dzi.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Elabe ame siwo gblɔa nya sia la, ɖee fia kɔtɛe be yewole denyigba aɖe dim.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Nenye anyigba si dzi woʋu dzo le la dim wole la, anye ne woakpɔ mɔ atrɔ ayi.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ke abe ale si wòle ene la, wole denyigba si nyo wu ema la dim. Esiae nye denyigba si le dziƒo. Eya ta mekpea ŋu na Mawu be woyɔnɛ be yewoƒe Mawu o, elabe edzra du gã aɖe ɖo ɖi na wo.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ le Isak ŋu le mawunya me na Abraham be: “Isak viwoe ava zu wò dzidzimeviwo.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Abraham bui be Mawu ate ŋu afɔ Isak ɖe tsitre tso ku me gɔ̃ hã. Esia ta wògagbugbɔe xɔ abe ɖe wòfɔ tso ku me ene.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Isak yra Yakob kple Esau le nu si woava zu emegbe la ŋuti.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na esime Yakob ɖo kudo nu la, ede ta agu ɖe eƒe atizɔti dzi, do gbe ɖa eye wòyra Yosef viŋutsuawo.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na esime Yosef ƒe kuɣi ɖo la, wòƒo nu le Israelviwo ƒe dzodzo le Egipte ŋu, eye wòɖo ale si wòaɖi yee la na wo.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Mose dzilawo ɣlae ɣleti etɔ̃ sɔŋ tso esime wodzii, elabe wokpɔ be ɖevia nyakpɔ ŋutɔ, eye womevɔ̃ se si Egipte Fiagã de la o.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na esi Mose tsi la, wògbe be womegayɔ ye be Egipte Fiagã vinyɔnuvi la vi o.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ elɔ̃ be yeakpe fu kple Mawu ƒe amewo wu, be yease vivi le nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ me ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: Mose bu be ŋukpe si woado ye le Kristo la ta la xɔ asi sãa wu kesinɔnu siwo le Egipte, elabe ekpɔ fetu si wòava xɔ la dzi ɖa.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Mose dzo le Egipte, eye mevɔ̃ fia ƒe dɔmedzoe o, elabe elé Mawu si kpɔm mele o la me ɖe asi sesĩe, abe ɖe wòle ekpɔm gã ene.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Mose ɖo Ŋutitotoŋkeke la anyi, eye wòna wohlẽ ʋu ɖe ʋɔtrutiwo ŋu bene dɔla si atsrɔ̃ ŋgɔgbeviwo la nagawɔ nu vevi Israelviwo ya o.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Israel-dukɔ la tso Aƒlaƒu la abe anyigba ƒuƒui dzi zɔm wole ene. Evɔ esime Egiptetɔwo hã te etsotso kpɔ la, wotsi eme no tsi ku.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na gli si ƒo xlã Yerixo-dua la mu dze anyi gbloo, esime Israelviwo zɔ ƒo xlãe ŋkeke adrẽ.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na Raxab, gbolo la, metsrɔ̃ kple tosẽlawo o, elabe exɔ ŋkutsalaawo nyuie wodze egbɔ.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Nya ka magagblɔ? Elabe ɣeyiɣi meli be maƒo nu le Gideon, Barak, Simson, Yefta, David, Samuel kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ŋu o.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Xɔsee na ame siawo dometɔ aɖewo ɖu fiaɖuƒewo dzi le aʋa me; ɖewo na amewo wɔ nu dzɔdzɔe; ɖewo xɔ nu siwo ŋugbe wodo na wo la, eye ɖewo mía nu na dzatawo.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: Xɔse kee na amewo tsi dzo si le bibim flaflafla la. Eyae na womewu ame aɖewo o. Xɔsee na ŋusẽ gaɖo ame siwo gbɔdzɔ la ŋu, eye eyae na amewo wɔ kalẽ le aʋa me. Eya kee na woƒe futɔwo ka hlẽ.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Xɔsee na amewo fɔ vi kukuwo ɖe tsitre na nyɔnuwo. Wowɔ funyafunya ame aɖewo eye wogbe be womegaɖe yewo le ga me o, va se ɖe esime woku. Wowɔ esia ale be woava nɔ agbe si nyo wu sãa la.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Woɖu fewu le ame bubuwo ŋu, ƒo wo, de kɔsɔkɔsɔ gɔ̃ hã wo hede wo gaxɔ me.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Woƒu kpe ame aɖewo, eye wodze ɖewo ɖe eve kple laxalaxa. Wowu ɖewo kple yi, ɖewo zu hiãtɔ xaxa, tsi alẽgbalẽ kple gbɔ̃gbalẽ me nɔ yiyim, eye amewo wɔ funyafunya wo.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Xexe sia me medze ame siawo anɔ hafi o! Ke wole tsa glalã tsam le gbedadaƒo kple towo dzi, le dowo kple agadowo me.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ame siawo katã ƒe xɔse ɖi ɖase le wo ŋu nyuie hã la, nu si ŋugbe Mawu do na wo la mesu wo si o.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu kpɔ nu nyui si nyo wu la, da ɖi na mí eye míawo manɔmee la, womawɔ woamawo woade blibo o.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Le esia ta, le ɖaseɖila geɖe siwo ƒo xlã mi abe alilikpo ene ta la, mina míaɖe nu kpekpewo katã kple nuvɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe si lé ɖe mía ŋu kaɖii la ƒu gbe, eye míake duɖime si dze ŋgɔ mí la kple kutrikuku.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Mina míaƒe ŋku nanɔ Yesu ŋu ɖa. Eyae ɖo míaƒe xɔse la gɔme anyi, eye wòwɔe wòde blibo. Esi wònya dzidzɔ si le eŋgɔ ta la, edo dzi kpe fu le atitsoga ŋu, eye wòbu ŋukpe si le atitsoga ŋu la nu tsɛ ko. Ke azɔ la, ebɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe Mawu ƒe fiazikpui la ƒe ɖusime.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Mibu Yesu ŋu ɖa ne ɖeɖi nagate mia ŋu o. Eyae do dzi lɔ̃ nuvɔ̃wɔlawo tsi tre ɖe eŋu vevie.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be miele aʋa wɔm kple nuvɔ̃ hã la, mieva ɖo afi si wòhiã le be woakɔ miaƒe ʋu ɖi haɖe o.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Ɖe mieŋlɔ dzideƒonya si me woyɔ mi le be viŋutsuviwo la bea? Eyae nye be: “Vinye, ne Aƒetɔ la he to na wò la, mègabui nu tsɛ o. Ne eka mo na wò la, dzi megaɖe le ƒowò o.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Elabe ame si Aƒetɔ la lɔ̃na la, eyae wòhea to na; ame sia ame si wòxɔ vii la, eyae wòƒona.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Ne wole hehe nam mi la, mido dzi. Mawu ɖe wòle mia kplɔm abe viwo ene. Vi kae li si tɔ́a menaa hehee o?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Ne wona hehe ame sia ame vɔ, eye wogblẽ miawo ya ɖi, womena hehe mi o la, ekema gbɔmeviwo mienye, ke menye vi ŋutɔŋutɔwo o.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, tɔ́wo le mía si le anyigba dzi be woana hehe mí, eye míetsɔa bubu na wo. Ɖe mele be míabɔbɔ mía ɖokui ɖe gbɔgbɔwo Tɔ́ la te bene míanɔ agbe oa?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Tɔ́ mawo ya na hehe mí le ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe, si dze wo ŋu la ko me, ke Mawu ya naa hehe mí bene wòanyo na mí, ale be míawo hã míava zu kɔkɔe.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me, va se ɖe fifi gɔ̃ hã, ne wole hehe nam ame aɖe la, medzɔa dzi nɛ o; evenɛ boŋ. Emegbe la, hehe sia nana be wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe eye wònɔa agbe le ŋutifafa me. Nuxlɔ̃amenyawo kple nyagbenamewo

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Eya ta mido ŋusẽ miaƒe asi siwo wɔ gblɔdɔ kple miaƒe klo siwo tu la.

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Miɖe mɔ dzɔdzɔewo ne miato wo dzi bene bunɔ, nagatra mɔ o, ke boŋ wòahaya.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Miʋli be ŋutifafa nanɔ mia kple amewo katã dome. Midze agbagba mianɔ kɔkɔe, elabe ame si ke mele kɔkɔe o la, makpɔ Aƒetɔ la o.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ egbɔ be Mawu ƒe amenuveve la su ame sia ame si. Gawu la, mikpɔ nyuie be nya aɖeke nagana miase veve vevie, eye wòahe masɔmasɔ avɛ be ame geɖe nagava zu ame ƒoɖiwo o.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke naganye ahasiwɔla alo ŋukpenanuwɔla abe Esau ene o. Eya tsɔ eƒe ŋgɔgbevinyenye ɖɔli nuɖuɖu agba ɖekae.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Abe ale si mienya ene la, emegbe la, Esau di vevie be woayra ye abe ŋgɔgbevi ene, eye wòfa avi vevie. Ke womeyrae o, elabe megakpɔ mɔ atrɔ nu si eya ŋutɔ wɔ la o.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Elabe menye Sinai-to si ame mate ŋu akpɔ o la gbɔe mieva o. Viviti tsiɖitsiɖi kple blukɔ do, ahom le tutum, ke to la le dzo bim flaflafla.

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: Kpẽ kple gbeɖiɖi si le nu ƒom la ɖi. Ke eselawo ɖe kuku be womegagblɔ nya aɖeke kpee azɔ o.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Elabe womate ŋu anɔ te ɖe se si wode na wo la nu o. Woɖe gbe na wo be: “Ne lã aɖe kura gɔ̃e ka afɔ toa ŋu la, woneƒu kpee wòaku.”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, Zion-to la gbɔe mieva. Mawu gbagbe la ƒe du, Yerusalem dziƒotɔ kple eƒe mawudɔla siwo manyaxlẽ o, siwo kpe ta la gbɔe miele.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Gawu la, ŋgɔgbevi siwo ƒe ŋkɔ woŋlɔ ɖe dziƒo la ƒe hame si kpe ta la mee mieva. Miele Mawu, amewo katã ƒe Ʋɔnudrɔ̃la la kple ame dzɔdzɔe siwo wowɔ wode blibo la ƒe gbɔgbɔwo ŋkume.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Afi ma la, Yesu, ame si nye nubabla yeye la ƒe avuléla hã li, eye ʋu si wòhlẽ si le nu ƒom amenuvetɔe wu Abel ƒe ʋu la hã li.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie ne miagagbe ame si le nu ƒom la ƒe gbe o. Elabe nenye be woawo mete ŋu sí le ame si gbe nya na wo le anyigba dzi la nu o la, ale ke míawo ya míate ŋu así le ame si le nya gbem na mí tso dziƒo la nu?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi la, eƒe gbe ʋuʋu xexea me, ke azɔ la, edo ŋugbe be: “Megale xexea me ʋuʋu ge ake zi ɖeka, ke azɔ la, maʋuʋu dziƒo hã akpe ɖe eŋuti.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: “Ake zi ɖeka” sia fia be nuwɔwɔ siwo woʋuʋu la, woaɖe wo ɖa, ke esiwo womete ŋu ʋuʋu o la, atsi anyi.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Eya ta mina míada akpe be fiaɖuƒe si mate ŋu aʋã o la su mía si. Ale mina míatsɔ bubu kple vɔvɔ̃ asubɔe ne míadze eŋu,

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: elabe míaƒe Mawua la, dzo si fiaa nu keŋkeŋ lae wònye.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Mina nɔvilɔlɔ̃ naxɔ aƒe ɖe mia me ɖaa.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Migagbe amedzroxɔxɔ o, elabe to esia me la, amewo xɔ mawudɔlawo amedzrowoe gake womenya o.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku gaxɔmenɔlawo dzi abe mia kple woawoe le gaxɔa me ene. Nenema ke miɖo ŋku ame siwo wole funyafunya wɔmee la hã dzi, abe ŋutilã ɖekae li na mi kple wo ene.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Mide bubu srɔ̃ɖeɖe ŋu le mia dome, eye srɔ̃tɔwo nawɔ nuteƒe na wo nɔewo, elabe Mawu adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu matrewɔlawo kple ahasiwɔlawo.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Miɖe galɔlɔ̃ ɖa keŋ le miaƒe agbenɔnɔ me, eye nu si le mia si la, nedze mia ŋu, elabe Mawu gblɔ be: “Nyemele asi ɖe ge le ŋuwò, alo agblẽ wò ɖi akpɔ o.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Eya ta míate ŋu agblɔ dzideƒotɔe be: “Aƒetɔ lae nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ, nyemavɔ̃ o; nu ka amegbetɔ ate ŋu awɔm?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku miaƒe kplɔla siwo gblɔ Mawu ƒe nya na mi la dzi. Milé ŋku ɖe ale si woƒe agbenɔnɔ va wu nui la ŋu, ne miakpɔ ale si woxɔ Mawu dzi see asrɔ̃.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo ɖeka ma koe nɔ anyi tsã, eyae gali fifia eye wòanɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Migana nufiafia ƒomevi vovovo, siwo nu ta mele o la, nakplɔ mi atrae o. Mawue vea mia nu doa ŋusẽ miaƒe dziwo, ke menye se siwo ku ɖe nuɖuɖuwo ŋu, eye womekpena ɖe ame siwo wɔa wo dzi la ŋu o lae o.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Vɔsamlekpui aɖe le mía si; ame siwo subɔna le agbadɔa me la, mekpɔ mɔ aɖu edzi nu o.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Nunɔlagã la tsɔa lãʋu yia kɔkɔeƒe la abe vɔsa ene ɖe amewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta, ke wotɔa dzo vɔsalã la ŋutɔ le asaɖa la godo.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Nenema ke Yesu hã kpe fu le dua godo, bene yeakɔ ameawo ŋu kple eya ŋutɔ ƒe ʋu.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Eya ta mina míawo hã míayi ɖe egbɔ le asaɖa la godo bene woado ŋukpe mí, abe ale si wodo ŋukpe eya hã ene faa.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Elabe du aɖeke mele mía si le xexe sia me si anɔ anyi ɖaa o; ke du si gbɔna la dim míele.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Migaŋlɔ nu nyui wɔwɔ kple nunana ame be o, elabe vɔsa siawoe dzea Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Miɖo to miaƒe kplɔlawo, eye mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na wo, elabe woawoe le mia ŋu dzɔm abe ame siwo lana akɔnta la ene. Mina woawɔ esia kple dzidzɔ, ke menye kple dzi kpekpe o, elabe eya maɖe vi na mi o.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Mido gbe ɖa ɖe mía ta. Míeka ɖe edzi be míaƒe dzime kɔ, eye míedi be míawɔ nu bubutɔe le nu sia nu me.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Mele biabiam tso mia si vevie be miado gbe ɖa, ale be Mawu nagana mava mia gbɔ kpuie. Gbedodoɖa

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Mawu Ŋutifafanala, ame si fɔ Aƒetɔ Yesu, alẽawo ƒe kplɔlagã la tso ame kukuwo dome, to nubabla mavɔ ƒe ʋu la me la,

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: netsɔ nu nyuiwo katã na mi faa, ale be miate ŋu awɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu. Neto Yesu Kristo dzi, ne wòawɔ nu si dzea eŋu la le mia me. Eya tɔ nanye ŋutikɔkɔe tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen. Nuwunyawo

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, togbɔ be nu si meŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi mesɔ gbɔ o hã la, mele kuku ɖem na mi be miawɔ ɖe nye nuxlɔ̃amenyawo dzi.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Mele nyanya nam mi be woɖe asi le mía nɔvi Timoteo ŋu. Nenye be wòva ɖo gbɔnye teti ko la, nye kplii míava kpɔ mi ɖa.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Medo gbe na miaƒe kplɔlawo kple ame siwo katã ŋu wokɔ la. Ame siwo katã tso Italia va la do gbe na mi.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Mawu neve mi katã mia nu. Amen.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Yakobo, Mawu kple Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔla gbɔ. Mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi, Yuda ƒome wui eve, siwo kaka yi ɖe anyigba bubuwo dzi la. Medo gbe na mi loo! Xɔse kple Nunya

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne miege ɖe tetekpɔ vovovowo me la, mikpɔ dzidzɔ ale si miate ŋui,

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: elabe mienyae be ne wodo miaƒe xɔse kpɔ la, eya mee mietona lia ke sesĩe.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Ale mina miaƒe kelili nadze ƒãa to miaƒe nuwɔna me, bene miate ŋu anye ame siwo de blibo keŋkeŋ, eye miagahiã naneke o.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Ne mia dome ame aɖe hiã nunya la, nebia Mawu, anae. Enyoa dɔme naa nu ame sia ame faa, eye medoa ŋukpe ame o.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Ke ne ele gbe dom ɖa la, ele be wòaxɔ Mawu dzi ase. Megake ɖi o, elabe ame si kea ɖi la, le ko abe ƒutsotsoe si ya ƒona yina gbɔnae la ene.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: Ɖikela, si ƒe susu trɔna kabakaba eye meli ke le eƒe nuwɔna aɖeke me o la, megabu be yeaxɔ naneke tso Aƒetɔ la gbɔ o. Ahedada kple hotsuikpɔkpɔ

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Nɔvi si nye ame dahe neƒo adegbe be Mawu do ye ɖe dzi.

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: Nenema ke nɔvi kesinɔtɔ hã neƒo adegbe be Mawu bɔbɔ ye ɖe anyi, elabe kesinɔtɔ ƒe agbe nu ava yi abe gbe ƒe seƒoƒo ene.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Ne ɣe dze, eye ŋdɔ ʋu sesĩe la, eɖua gbe wòyrɔna, ale eƒe seƒoƒo duduna, eye eƒe atsyɔ̃ buna vĩ. Alea ke kesinɔtɔ hã anɔ hloloe tsom ʋuu ko, aku. Dodokpɔ kple tetekpɔ

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Mawu yra ame si do dzi le tetekpɔ me, elabe ne eto eme do la, woatsɔ agbe mavɔ si ŋugbe Aƒetɔ la do na ame siwo lɔ̃e la anae, abe dziɖuɖufiakuku ene.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Ne wote ame aɖe kpɔ la, megagblɔ be: “Mawu gbɔ wòtso” o, elabe womate ŋu ate Mawu kpɔ be wòawɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Gawu la, Mawu ŋutɔ metea ame kpɔna be wòawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Ame ŋutɔ ƒe nudzroamewoe blenɛ eye wohenɛ dea tetekpɔ me.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Ne nudzroame la fɔ fu la, edzia nuvɔ̃. Ne nuvɔ̃ va tsi nyuie la, edzia ku. Mawu gbɔe nunana nyuiwo katã tso

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migana ame aɖeke nable mi o.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Nunana nyui kple nunana deblibo ɖe sia ɖe tso dziƒo. Wotso kekeliwo katã ƒe wɔla, Tɔ́ la gbɔ. Naneke metrɔna si doa vɔvɔli ɖe egbɔ o.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Mawu sia tsɔ lɔlɔ̃nu faa dzi mí, to nyateƒenya la me, be míava zu abe ŋgɔgbevi ene na eƒe nuwɔwɔwo. Nyanyui la sese kple edziwɔwɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, miaƒe ŋku nenɔ nya sia dzi. Ame sia ame nese nya kabakaba, ke megaƒo nu ya kabakaba o, eye megakpɔ dziku hã kabakaba o.

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Elabe dziku menana be ame wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe si Mawu di be newɔ la o.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Miwɔ Nyanyui la dzi. Miganye nyaselawo ɖeɖe ko, anɔ mia ɖokui blem o.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Elabe nyasela si mewɔa nya dzi o la, ɖi ŋutsu si kpɔ eƒe mo le ahũhɔ̃e me.

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: Kasia ne wòatrɔ adzo la, eŋlɔ ale si wòle la be xoxo.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, ame si bua se si de blibo eye wòna ablɔɖe amewo ŋu hekua kutri wɔa nya la dzi la, Mawu ayrae le nu sia nu si wòawɔ la me. Eya mele abe nyasela si ŋlɔa nu be la ene o.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe bu be yesubɔa Mawu, eye meléa eɖokui nyuie le nuƒoƒo me o la, eble eɖokui, eye eƒe mawusubɔsubɔ nye dzodzro.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Mawusubɔsubɔ si dza, eye ɖi mele eŋu le Mawu kple Tɔ́ la ŋkume o lae nye esi: be woakpe ɖe tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo ŋu le woƒe xaxa me, eye ame nate eɖokui ɖa tso nu siwo ƒoa ɖi ame le xexea me la gbɔ.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, abe ame siwo xɔ mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo, ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe Aƒetɔ la dzi se ene la, migatia ame me le miaƒe nuwɔna me o.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Mina míatsɔe be ame aɖe ta avɔ nyui aɖe, do sikasigɛ va miaƒe takpeƒe, eye ame bubu aɖe, si ya ta avɔ ƒoɖi hã va.

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: Miekɔ mo ɖe avɔ nyui tala la, ʋã ɖe eŋu gblɔ nɛ be: “Meɖe kuku, va nɔ anyi ɖe afii.” Ke miegblɔ na ame dahe la ya be: “Tsi tre ɖe afim!” alo “Bɔbɔ nɔ anyi ɖe nye afɔnu!”

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ esia la, ekema menye susu vɔ̃ɖie nye ekem mietsɔ tso nya mee, hehe vovototo de mia ɖokuiwo dome oa?

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Nɔvinye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, miɖo to miasee ɖa. Menye ame siwo maxɔsetɔwo buna be wonye ame dahewo lae Mawu tia wova zu gbɔgbɔ me kesinɔtɔwo, elabe woxɔ Kristo dzi se oa? Ɖe menye woawoe anyi fiaɖuƒe si ŋugbe Mawu do na ame siwo lɔ̃e la dome oa?

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Ke miawo miedo vlo ame dahe! Ɖe menye kesinɔtɔwoe tea mi ɖe anyi oa? Menye woawoe hea mi yia ʋɔnui oa?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Menye kesinɔtɔwo kee gblɔa nya vlowo ɖe bubuŋkɔ si wotsɔ na mi, esime mieva zu Kristotɔwo la ŋu oa?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ ɖe fiaɖuƒea ƒe se la dzi tututu, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe mawunya me ene la, ekema miewɔ nu si dze. Nu si woŋlɔ ɖi lae nye be: “Ele be nàlɔ̃ hawòvi, abe wò ŋutɔ ɖokuiwò ene.”

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ke ne mietiaa ame me le miaƒe nuwɔna me la, ekema miewɔ nuvɔ̃, eye se la bu fɔ mi be mienye edzidalawo.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Elabe ame sia ame si wɔ seawo katã dzi, evɔ wòheda ɖeka pɛ dzi la, ezu wo katã dzi dala.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Elabe ame si de se be: “Mègawɔ ahasi o” la, eya kee gade se be: “Mègawu ame o.” Eya ta nenye be mèwɔ ahasi o, evɔ nèhewu ame la, ekema èzu sedzidala.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Ale mina miaƒe nuƒo kple miaƒe nuwɔna naɖee fia be se si na ablɔɖe mi lae woatsɔ adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mii.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Elabe le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me la, Mawu makpɔ nublanui na ame si mekpɔa nublanui na ame o. Gake Mawu ƒe nublanuikpɔkpɔ ƒo eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ta. Xɔse kple nuwɔna

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne ame aɖe gblɔ be xɔse le ye si, eye eƒe nuwɔna meɖenɛ fiana o la, viɖe kae wòkpɔ? Eƒe xɔse la ate ŋu axɔe ɖe agbea?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Mina míatsɔe be avɔ vuvu le nɔvinyɔnu alo nɔviŋutsu xɔsetɔ aɖewo ŋu, eye womekpɔa nu ɖuna gbe sia gbe o.

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mia dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ na wo be: “Miheyi le ŋutifafa me. Miaƒe lã me nexɔ dzo. Miɖu nu miaɖi ƒo” eye medi nu siwo hiã na woƒe ŋutilã la na wo o la, viɖe kae le eme?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Ale ne xɔse ko le ame aɖe si, eye nuwɔna mekpe ɖe eŋu o la, eƒe xɔsea ku.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Ke ame aɖe agblɔ be: “Wò la, xɔse le asiwò, eye nye la, ɖe metsona ɖe nu ŋu wɔna.” Nye ŋuɖoɖoe nye be, “Ɖe wò xɔse si ŋu nuwɔna mekpe ɖo o la fiam, eye nye hã mato nye nuwɔna me aɖe nye xɔse afia wò.”

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Èxɔe se be Mawu ɖeka koe li. Enyo, nyateƒee. Gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo gɔ̃ hã xɔe se nenema, eye wovɔ̃na hedzona nyanyanya ɖe!

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Wò movitɔ, èdi be woaɖee afia ye be xɔse si ŋu nuwɔna mekpe ɖo o la nye nu ƒuƒlua?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta Mawu bu mía tɔgbui Abraham be ele dzɔdzɔe? Eƒe nuwɔna tae! Elabe etsɔ via Isak yi ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi be yeatsɔe asa vɔe na Mawu.

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Miekpɔe vɔa? Eƒe xɔse kple nuwɔnae zɔ aduadu, eye eƒe nuwɔnae na eƒe xɔse hã de blibo.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Ale mawunya sia va eme be: “Abraham xɔ Mawu dzi se, eya ta Mawu bui be ele dzɔdzɔe,” eye Mawu yɔe be ye xɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Miekpɔe azɔa? Womekpɔa ame ƒe xɔse ko dzi hebunɛ be ele dzɔdzɔe o; eƒe nuwɔnae kpena ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Alea tututue Mawu bu Raxab, gbolo la hãe be ele dzɔdzɔe le eƒe nuwɔna ta. Nu si Raxab wɔ lae nye be, esime wòxɔ Israelviwo ƒe ŋkutsalawo wodze egbɔ la, ekpe ɖe wo ŋu na wosí to mɔ bubu dzo.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Azɔ la, eme kɔ be ale si ameti la ɖeɖe nye nu kuku, ne gbɔgbɔ mele eme o la, nenemae xɔse hã nye nu kuku, ne nuwɔna mekpe ɖe eŋuti o.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, migana mia dome ame geɖe nawɔ wo ɖokui nufialawoe o. Abe ale si mienya ene la, woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mí ame siwo fiaa nu la tsitotsito wu ame bubuwo.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Elabe mí katã míedaa vo geɖe. Ne ame aɖe li, eye medaa vo le nuƒoƒo me o la, eyama de blibo, eye ŋusẽ le esi ɖe ameti blibo la katã dzi.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Ne míede numega nu me na sɔwo be woaɖo to mí la, míete ŋu trɔa sɔ blibo la dona ɖe afi si míelɔ̃.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ tɔdziʋuwo hã ɖa. Togbɔ be wololo ŋutɔ, eye ya sesẽe kua wo hã la, kuɖɔ sue aɖe ko ŋudɔ kuɖɔɖola wɔna hetrɔa ʋu bliboa wòɖoa ta afi si wòdi be neyi la.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Alea tututu aɖe hã le. Togbɔ be ŋutinu sue aɖe ko wònye hã la, nu gãwo ŋutie wòkana ɖo. Kpɔ ɖa! Dzo sue aɖe koe gena ɖe ave gã aɖe me, hebinɛ keŋ.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Aɖe, ɖe wòle abe dzo ene. Xexeme si me nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔwɔ xɔ aƒe ɖo lae aɖe nye le míaƒe ŋutinuwo dome. Eƒoa ɖi ameti blibo la, hetɔa dzo agbenɔnɔ ƒe yiyime. Ke eya ŋutɔ la dzo mavɔ dea dzo eme wòbina flaflafla.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Míate ŋu amla lã wɔadã, xe, nutata kple ƒumelã ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi. Le nyateƒe me la, amegbetɔ mlaa wo katã.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Ke amegbetɔ aɖeke mate ŋu amla aɖe ya akpɔ o. Aɖe nye nuvɔ̃ɖi si ŋu ɖeɖi metena o, eye aɖi si wua ame la, yɔe taŋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Nu ɖeka ma, si me yayra dona le la, eya ke mee fiƒode hã dona le! Nɔvinyewo, mele be wòanɔ alea hafi o.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Ɖe vudo ate ŋu adzi tsi vivi agadzi dzetsi tso do ɖeka ma ke mea?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ɖe gboti ate ŋu atse amititsetsewoa? Alo ɖe wainka ate ŋu atse gbotitsetsewoa? Nenema ke vudo si dzia dzetsi la, mate ŋu agadzi tsi vivi hã o. Nunya si tso dziƒo

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ame kae nye nunyala kple nugɔmesela le mia dome? Netsɔ agbenɔnɔ nyui ɖe esia fia to eƒe nuwɔna me, eye newɔe kple ɖokuibɔbɔ si do tso nunya me.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Evɔ nenye be ŋuʋaʋã vɔ̃ɖi le miaƒe dzime, eye mia dome ame sia ame dina be ye tɔ me ko nenyo la, migaka aʋatso ɖe nyateƒe la si atsɔ miaƒe nunya aƒo adegbee o.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Nunya sia metso dziƒo o; anyigba dzi tɔe, dzɔdzɔme tɔe, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ tɔe.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Elabe afi si ŋuʋaʋã le, eye amewo dina be yewo tɔ ko me nenyo la, masɔmasɔ kple nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ ɖe sia ɖe hã anɔ anyi.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Ame siwo léa avu, hehea ŋutifafa vanɛ la ƒãa nuku si ƒe kutsetse nye nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Nu kae hea aʋawɔwɔ kple dzrewɔwɔ dea mia dome? Ɖe menye nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo dzroa miaƒe ŋutinuwo la woe hea wo vanɛ oa?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Miedi nu si dzro mi; miekpɔe o, eye miewu ame. Nenema ke mieklẽ ŋu be yewoaxɔ nane le ame aɖe si; miaƒe asi mesu edzi o, eye miewɔ dzre heho aʋa ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu. Miekpɔa nu si dim miele la o, elabe miebiaa Mawu o.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Miebiaa nu Mawu, eye miexɔnɛ o, elabe miebiana kple susu nyui o. Miebiaa nu Mawu, ale be miatsɔe ado dzidzɔ na mia ɖokui ko.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Ame mawɔnuteƒewo! Mienya be ame si dze xɔlɔ̃ xexea me la, tsɔ eɖokui wɔ Mawu ƒe futɔe oa? Eya ta ame sia ame si di be yeadze xɔlɔ̃ xexea me la, tsɔ eɖokui wɔ Mawu ƒe futɔe.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Miebu be ɖe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me dzodzro be: “Mawu ʋãa ŋu vevie ɖe eƒe gbɔgbɔ si wòna, be wòanɔ mia me la nu” mahã?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Ke evea ame nu geɖe ŋutɔ, eya ta wogblɔ be: “Mawu tsia tre ɖe ame siwo dàna la ŋu, eye wòvea ame siwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui la nu.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Eya ta mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe Mawu te. Mitsi tre ɖe Abosam ŋu, ne wòasí adzo le mia gbɔ.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Mite ɖe Mawu ŋu, ne eya hã nate va mia gbɔ. Nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo, miklɔ asi! Mi ɖikelawo, miwɔ miaƒe dzi dzadzɛ!

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Mise veve; mifa konyi; mifa avi. Mina miaƒe nukoko nazu konyifafa, eye miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ nazu modede to.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui le Aƒetɔ la ŋkume, ne wòado mi ɖe dzi. Mègadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu nɔviwò Kristotɔ o

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, migagblɔ nya si medze o la ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu o. Ame si gblɔa nya si medze o la ɖe nɔvia ŋu, alo drɔ̃a ʋɔnu nɔvia la, egblɔ nya si medze o la ɖe se la ŋuti, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu se la. Nenye se lae nèdrɔ̃a ʋɔnui la, ekema menye sedziwɔla nènye o, ke boŋ eƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃la nènye.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Mawu koe nye sedela kple ʋɔnudrɔ̃la. Eya koe nye ame si te ŋu xɔa ame ɖe agbe, eye wògate ŋu tsrɔ̃a ame hã. Ame ka nènye hafi le ʋɔnu drɔ̃m hawòvi? Mègaɖo nugbe ɖe etsɔ si gbɔna la ŋu o

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mise ɖa, mi ame siwo gblɔna be: “Egbe alo etsɔ míele du si alo ekemɛ me yi ge. Míanɔ afi ma ƒè ɖeka atsa asi eye míakpɔ viɖe.”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Mienya nu si le dzɔdzɔ ge etsɔa? Mienya nu si agbe, si miele la nyea? Afu si dona ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko gabuna la ko mienye.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Le nya sia gbɔgblɔ teƒe la, ele be miagblɔ boŋ be: “Ne Mawu lɔ̃ la, míanɔ agbe, eye míawɔ nu si alo ekemɛ.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Ke abe ale si wòle ene la, ɖeko miekana ɖe nu ŋu heƒoa adegbe dzodzro. Kaka ɖe nu ŋu alea nye nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame sia ame si nya nu nyui wɔwɔ, eye mewɔnɛ o la, ewɔ nuvɔ̃.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔwo, misee ɖa azɔ. Mifa avi, eye mido boboe le fukpekpe dziŋɔ, si gbɔna mia dzi va ge la ta.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Miaƒe kesinɔnuwo nyunyɔ, eye agbagblaʋuiwo ɖu miaƒe awuwo keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Miaƒe sika kple klosalo lé ɣebia, eye aɖi si le wo ŋu la aɖi ɖase tso mia ŋu. Ɣebia la amè miaƒe ŋutilã wòafia abe dzobi ene. Mieli kɔ kesinɔnuwo gleglegle da ɖi le ŋkeke mamlɛ siawo me.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Ke kpɔ ɖa, ame siwo ŋlɔ agble na mi, eye miegbe fexexe na wo la le mia nu tsom kple ɣli. Ame siwo ŋe nu na mi ƒe ɣli va ge ɖe Aƒetɔ Aʋakplɔlagã la ƒe to me.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Mieɖu agbe hetsɔ nu xɔasiwo do dzidzɔ na mia ɖokui atraɖii le agbe sia me, eye mieɖu nu heda ami ɖi na wuwugbe.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Miebu fɔ ame dzɔdzɔe, ke meʋli eɖokui ta o, eye miewui. Migbɔ dzi blewuu, eye mido gbe ɖa

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Eya ta, nɔvinyewo, migbɔ dzi blewuu va se ɖe gbe si gbe Aƒetɔ la nava. Mikpɔ agbledela ɖa! Ne ele mɔ kpɔm na nuku si kpɔ ge wòala tso anyigba me la, egbɔa dzi ɖi nɛ blewuu va se ɖe esime tsi dzana le ada me kple kele me.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Miawo hã migbɔ dzi blewuu nenema ke. Milé dzi ɖe ƒo, elabe Aƒetɔ la ƒe vavaɣi ɖo vɔ.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Migaɖu tse ɖe mia nɔewo ŋu ne Mawu nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu mi o. Kpɔ ɖa, ʋɔnudrɔ̃la va ɖo.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, miɖo ŋku Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela siwo ɖe gbeƒã le Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ me dzi. Mina ale si wokpe fu hedo dzii la, nanye kpɔɖeŋu na mi.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ɖa, míebua ame siwo doa dzi yayramewoe. Miese ale si Hiob do dzii, eye miekpɔ nu si Mawu ɖo ɖi nɛ le nuwuwu. Aƒetɔ la ƒe dɔme trɔna ɖe ame ŋu, eye wòkpɔa nublanui na ame.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ke nye nya vevitɔ na mie nye be migatà nu o; eɖanye dziƒo o, eɖanye anyigba o, eɖanye nu bubu aɖe o, migatàe o. Ne nya la le eme la, migblɔ be “Ẽ”. Ne mele eme o la, migblɔ be “O”, ne Mawu magabu fɔ mi o.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe le fu kpem le mia dome la, nedo gbe ɖa. Ne dzi le ame aɖe dzɔm le mia dome la, nedzi kafukafuhawo.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ƒe lã me gblẽ le mia dome la, neyɔ hamemegãwo vɛ ne woava do gbe ɖa ɖe eta, eye woasi ami nɛ le Aƒetɔ la ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Gbe si wodo ɖa kple xɔse ɖe dɔléla la ta la, ana eƒe lã me nasẽ, eye Aƒetɔ la ana wòahaya. Ne ewɔ nuvɔ̃ hã la, Mawu atsɔe akee.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Eya ta miʋu miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me na mia nɔewo, eye miado gbe ɖa ɖe mia nɔewo ta, bene Mawu nada gbe le mia ŋu. Ŋusẽ geɖe le ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu. Ewɔa dɔ vevie.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Eliya la, amegbetɔ ko wònye abe míawo ke ene. Ke esi wòdo gbe ɖa vevie be tsi nagadza o la, tsi gbe dzadza ɖe anyigba dzi ƒe etɔ̃ kple afã sɔŋ!

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Emegbe egado gbe ɖa, eye Mawu na tsi dza. Ale anyigba ganyo nu.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, ne mia dometɔ aɖe de megbe tso nyateƒenya la gbɔ, eye ame aɖe gakplɔe vɛ la,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: minyae be ame sia ame si kplɔ nuvɔ̃wɔla aɖe tso eƒe nuvɔ̃ mɔ dzi vɛ la, ana woaxɔ nuvɔ̃wɔla ma ɖe agbe tso ku si me, eye wòana woatsɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃ gbogbo siwo wòwɔ la akee.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Petro, Yesu Kristo ƒe amedɔdɔ gbɔ. Mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi, Mawu ƒe ame tiatia siwo kaka yi ɖe Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia kple Bitinia nutowo me la.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Ɖe wotia mi abe ale si Mawu Tɔ́ la ŋutɔ ɖoe ɖi la ene, eye Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la kɔ mia ŋu miezu kɔkɔe be miava aɖo to Yesu Kristo, eye wòatsɔ eƒe ʋu la aklɔ mia ŋuti. Mawu neve mia nu, eye nena ŋutifafa nasɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi na mi ɖaa. Nu si míele mɔ kpɔm na ɖaa la

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Mina míakafu Mawu, mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo Tɔ́ la! Ekpɔ nublanui na mí ale gbegbe be wogbugbɔ mí dzi, le esime wòfɔ Yesu Kristo ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome. Esia na be mɔkpɔkpɔ si le mía si la le tè.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: Nu si míele mɔ kpɔm na la nye domenyinu si megblẽna o, meƒoa ɖi o, meklona hã o, eye wodzrae ɖo ɖi na mi ɖe dziƒo.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo xɔ edzi se, eye wotsɔ Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ dzra mi ɖo, be woava xɔ mi ɖe agbe le ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ dzi la tɔe nye domenyinu sia.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ dzidzɔ le nya sia ŋuti, togbɔ be miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ la teƒe madidi o hã, elabe miele fu kpe ge le dodokpɔ vovovowo me,

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: ale be woakpɔ ɖa be xɔse akuakua le mia si mahã. Ale si wodoa sika si gblẽna kpɔ le dzo me la, nenemae wole miaƒe xɔse si xɔ asi wu sika gɔ̃ hã do ge akpɔ le dzo me, akpɔ ɖa be anɔ anyi ɖaa mahã. Ale be woate ŋu akafu mi, ado mi ɖe dzi ahatsɔ bubu na mi, ne Yesu Kristo va do gbe ma gbe.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Togbɔ be miekpɔe o hã la, mielɔ̃e; esi miele ekpɔm fifia o hã la, miexɔ eyama dzi se, eye miaƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ wu gbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: Ale si miexɔ edzi see la na be woxɔ miaƒe luʋɔwo ɖe agbe.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela siwo ɖe gbeƒã le ale si Mawu le mia nu ve ge ŋu la, kù nu gɔme eye wobia nya se tsitotsito le ale si Mawu le mia xɔ ge ɖe agbe ŋu.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Esime wonɔ gbeƒã ɖem ale si Kristo le fu kpe ge kple ŋutikɔkɔe si kpɔ ge wòala emegbe la, wobia nya tso ame si dzi Kristo ƒe Gbɔgbɔ si le wo me la tɔ asii kple ɣeyiɣi si wowɔnɛ la ŋu.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Mawu ɖee fia eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo, be menye woawo ŋutɔ ɖokui subɔm wole o, ke boŋ miawoe. Woƒo nu tso nu siwo ame siwo le gbeƒã ɖem Nyanyui la na mi fifia to Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe, si woɖo ɖa tso dziƒo dzi la ŋu. Mawudɔlawo gɔ̃ hã di xoxo be yewoanya nu le nu siawo ŋuti hafi. Mawu yɔ mí be míava nɔ agbe kɔkɔe

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Eya ta minɔ ŋudzɔ, eye milé mia ɖokui nyuie. Minɔ mɔ kpɔm vevie na ale si Mawu le mia nu ve gee, ne Yesu Kristo do la.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Abe vi ɖotowo ene la, migana nudzroame siwo ɖu mia dzi tsã le numanyamanya me la, nagakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe mia dzi fifia hã o.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Ame si yɔ mi vɛ la ɖe wòle kɔkɔe, eya ta ele na miawo hã be mianɔ kɔkɔe le miaƒe nuwɔna ɖe sia ɖe me.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Elabe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Minɔ kɔkɔe, elabe nye la, ɖe mele kɔkɔe.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Ne mieyɔa Mawu, ame si mekpɔa ame ŋkume o, eye wòdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe na ame sia ame le ale si wònɔ agbe nu la be Tɔ́, ne miele gbe dom ɖa nɛ la, ekema ele na mi be miavɔ̃e le miaƒe nuwɔna me, esime miele dzronyigba dzi.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Mienya be menye klosalo alo sika si gblẽna lae wona ɖe mia ta, hexɔ mi tso agbenɔnɔ maɖevi si mia tɔgbuiwo fia mi la si me o.

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
