translation_verse: Kristo ƒe ʋu xɔasi lae! Ʋu sia le abe alẽvi si de blibo, eye wòsɔ keŋ la tɔ ene.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Mawu tiae da ɖi hafi woɖo xexea me gɔme anyi, eye wòɖee fia le ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ siawo me le mia ta.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: To eyama dzi la, mieva xɔ Mawu, ame si fɔe ɖe tsitre tso ame kukuwo dome, eye wòna bubunɔƒee la dzi se azɔ. Ale mieva xɔ Mawu dzi se hele mɔ kpɔm nɛ.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Azɔ esi mieɖo to nyateƒe la, heto eme kɔ mia ɖokui ŋu be yewoalɔ̃ yewo nɔewo le nyateƒe me ta la, ele be mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo vevie tso dzime ke.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Elabe mawunya gblɔ be: “Amegbetɔwo katã le abe gbe ene, eye woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo katã le abe gbe ƒe seƒoƒo ene. Gbe yrɔna, eye eƒe seƒoƒo duduna,

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: ke Aƒetɔ la ƒe nya la li ɖaa.” Nya siae nye Nyanyui si woɖe gbeƒãe na mi.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Eya ta midzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi wɔwɔ. Aɖaŋu vɔ̃ ɖoɖo na ame, alakpanuwɔwɔ, ŋuʋaʋã kple ameŋugbegblẽ nedo ɖa le mia dome.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Abe vidzĩ fɛ̃wo ene la, mina gbɔgbɔ la ƒe notsi si wometɔ tsii o la nadzro mi vevie, ale be ne mienoe la, miate ŋu atsi ɖe edzi bene woaxɔ mi ɖe agbe.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be: “Miawo ŋutɔ mieɖɔ ale si Aƒetɔ la nyoa dɔme na amee la kpɔ.”

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Eya ta mite va Aƒetɔ la gbɔ. Eyae nye kpe gbagbe si amewo gbe, ke enye kpe si wotia, eye wòxɔ asi ŋutɔ le Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Miawo hã miele abe kpe gbagbewo ene, eya ta mitsɔ mia ɖokui tu gbɔgbɔmexɔe. Xɔ sia mee mianye nunɔlawo ƒe ha kɔkɔe le, eye miato Yesu Kristo dzi asa gbɔgbɔmevɔ si adze Mawu ŋu la na Mawu.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Elabe woŋlɔ ɖe mawunya me be: “Mikpɔ ɖa! Mele dzogoedzikpe tiatia xɔasi aɖe ɖom anyi ɖe Zion. Ame sia ame si xɔ edzi se la, maɖu ŋukpe o.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, mi ame siwo xɔ se la, kpe sia xɔ asi ŋutɔ le mia gbɔ, ke le ame siwo mexɔ se o la ya gbɔ la enye: “Kpe si xɔtulawo gbe, eye wòva trɔ zu dzogoedzikpe vevitɔ.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, dzidzime si Mawu tia, nunɔlawo ƒe ha si akplɔ amewo abe fia ene, dukɔ kɔkɔe kple Mawu ŋutɔ ƒe amewoe mienye. Mawu tia mi, eye wòdi tso mia si be miaɖe gbeƒã ame si yɔ mi tso viviti me va eƒe kekeli wɔnuku la gbɔ la ƒe nukunuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Ɣe aɖe ɣi va yi la, mienye Mawu ƒe dukɔ o; ke azɔ la, mienye eƒe dukɔ. Ɣe aɖe ɣi va yi la, Mawu mekpɔ nublanui na mi o; ke azɔ la, ekpɔ nublanui na mi. Minɔ agbe abe Mawu ƒe kluviwo ene

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mi ame siwo nye amedzrowo kple mɔzɔlawo le dzronyigba dzi, miaƒe nuxlɔ̃amenyae nye esi: Migawɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo dzroa miaƒe ameti blibo la, eye wowɔa aʋa kple miaƒe luʋɔ la ƒe didi dzi o.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Minɔ agbe nyuie le trɔ̃subɔla siwo dome miele la gbɔ, ale be ne woƒo nu le mia ŋu be mienye nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo gɔ̃ hã la, emegbe la, woava kpɔ dɔ nyui siwo miewɔ, eye woakafu Mawu le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la.

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: Mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui nenema ke na dziɖula siwo Fiagã dɔna ɖa be woahe to na nu gbegblẽ wɔlawo, eye woakafu nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo la hã.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu ƒe didie nye be miawɔ nu nyui, ale be bometsilawo ƒe numanyamanya nadze ne womagakpɔ nya aɖeke agblɔ tso mia ŋu o.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Minɔ agbe abe ablɔɖeviwo ene, eye migatsɔ ablɔɖe si miekpɔ la wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖii o, ke boŋ minɔ agbe abe Mawu ƒe kluviwo ene.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Mitsɔ bubu na ame sia ame. Milɔ̃ nɔvi xɔsetɔwo katã. Mivɔ̃ Mawu. Mitsɔ bubu na Fiagã la. Fu si Kristo kpe la ƒe kpɔɖeŋu

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Dɔlawo, mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na miaƒe aƒetɔwo, eye mitsɔ bubu blibo na wo. Menye na aƒetɔ nyui fatuwo ɖeɖe ko o, ke boŋ mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na esiwo nye dɔmeveveetɔwo hã.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Nenye be ame aɖe le fu kpem madzemadzee, eye le Mawu ta wòdo dzi se veve la, Mawu akpɔ dzidzɔ le eŋu.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Ne miewɔ nu gbegblẽ aɖe, si ta woƒo mi ɖo, eye miedo dzi xɔ ƒoƒoa la, kafukafu kae le esia me na mi? Evɔ ne miewɔ nu nyui hekpe fu ɖe eta, eye miedo dzi tsɔe la, Mawu akpɔ ŋudzedze le mia ŋu.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Nu sia gbɔe Mawu yɔ mi vɛ, elabe Kristo hã kpe fu ɖe mia ta, eye wògblẽ eƒe kpɔɖeŋu ɖi na mi be miato yeƒe afɔtoƒe.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Kristo mewɔ nuvɔ̃ aɖeke kpɔ o, eye meble ame aɖeke kpɔ hã o.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Esi wodzui la, medzu ame ɖe eteƒe o; esime wonɔ fu wɔmee la, medo ŋɔdzi na ame aɖeke o, ke boŋ eɖo dzi ɖe Mawu, ame si drɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe la ŋu.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Kristo ŋutɔe tsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ɖe eƒe ŋutilã me yi ati la ŋu. Ewɔ esia ale be míaku na nuvɔ̃, eye míanɔ agbe ahawɔ nu dzɔdzɔe. Wotsɔ abi siwo wode eŋu la yɔ dɔ mi.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, ɖe mietra mɔ nɔ tsatsam abe alẽwo ene; ke azɔ la, mietrɔ va miaƒe luʋɔkplɔla kple eŋudzɔla la gbɔ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Srɔ̃nyɔnuwo, miawo hã mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia srɔ̃wo nenema ke, ale be miaƒe agbe nyui nɔnɔ natrɔ wo dome ame siwo mewɔa Mawu ƒe nya dzi o la, be woava xɔ edzi ase. Mahiã kura be miawo miake nu agblɔ nya aɖeke gɔ̃ hã o,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: elabe ne miede bubu mia ɖokui ŋu, eye mienɔ agbe dzadzɛ la, awɔ dɔ ɖe mia srɔ̃wo dzi.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Miawo la, migaƒo ɖa atsiãtɔe o. Migatsɔ sikanu kple awu xɔasiwo ɖo atsyɔ̃e bene yewoanyakpɔ na amewo o.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ miɖo atsyɔ̃ na gbɔgbɔ fatu si li kpoo le mia me la kple atsyɔ̃ɖonu si megblẽna o la. Atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo siae nye xɔasitɔ kekeake le Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu kɔkɔe siwo ɖo ŋu ɖe Mawu ŋu le blema la, aleae wobɔbɔ wo ɖokui na wo srɔ̃wo, eye wònye atsyɔ̃ woɖo na wo ɖokuii.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Nenemae Sara hã bɔbɔ eɖokui na Abraham, eye wòyɔnɛ be, “Nye aƒetɔ.” Sara vinyɔnuviwo miawo hã miezu azɔ, nenye be miewɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eye naneke medoa ŋɔdzi na mi o.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Nenema ke mi srɔ̃ŋutsuwo hã, ne mia kple mia srɔ̃wo mieli la, mibu wo ŋu le miaƒe nuwɔnawo me elabe nyɔnuwoe wonye. Mibu wo, elabe mi kpakple woawo siaa nue Mawu ve be miava nɔ agbe. Ne miewɔ esia la, naneke maxe mɔ na miaƒe gbedodoɖawo o. Fukpekpe ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Mlɔeba la, mina mi katã miaƒe susu nanɔ ɖeka; ame ƒe nu newɔ nublanui na mi; milɔ̃ mia nɔewo abe dadaviwo ene; minyo dɔme na amewo, eye mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ne wowɔ vɔ̃ ɖe ame aɖe ŋu la, megawɔ vɔ̃ ɖe eteƒe o; ne wodzu ame aɖe hã, megadzu ame ɖe eteƒe o. Ɖe esiawo teƒe la, mibia yayra na wo boŋ, elabe ɖe woyɔ mi vɛ, be miava kpɔ yayra ƒe gome.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be: “Ame sia ame si di be yeanɔ agbe ase vivi nɛ, eye yeakpɔ ŋkekenyuiwo la, nya vlo aɖeke negado le enu o; megaka aʋatso hã o.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Nedzudzɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ, ne wòawɔ nu nyui. Nedi ŋutifafa, eye wòati eyome.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Elabe Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋku le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo ŋu, eye wòke to ɖi, be yease nu siwo woabia la. Ke eklẽa ŋku ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Ne miedoa vevie nu nyui wɔna la, ame ka koŋ awɔ nu vevi mi?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, ne ehiã eye miekpe fu le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta gɔ̃ hã la, Mawu yra mi. Migavɔ̃ woamawo o, eye migatsi dzimaɖi hã o.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Ɖe esia teƒe la, mitsɔ bubu na Kristo abe Aƒetɔ ene le miaƒe dzime. Minɔ ŋudzɔ ɣe sia ɣi, be miate ŋu aɖe nya me na ame sia ame si di tso mia si, be miaɖe nya me na ye tso nu si miele mɔ kpɔm na la ŋu,

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: ke migbɔ dzi blewuu miawɔ esia kple bubu. Mina miaƒe dzitsinya navo, ale be ne wodzu mi la, ŋu nakpe ame siwo gblɔa nya vlo tso nɔnɔme nyui, si le mia si le hadede kple Kristo me la ŋuti.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Elabe ne enye Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, enyo be ame nakpe fu ɖe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta, wu be wòakpe fu ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Elabe Kristo hã ku ɖe amewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo ta zi ɖeka ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu. Togbɔ be enye ame dzɔdzɔe hã la, eku ɖe nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔlawo ta be yeate ŋu akplɔ mí ayi Mawu gbɔe,

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: eye wòyi ɖagblɔ mawunya na gbɔgbɔ siwo le gaxɔ me.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Woawoe nye ame siwo meɖo to Mawu ƒe gbe ɣe ma ɣi, esime Noa nɔ eƒe aɖakaʋu la kpam la o. Ke Mawu gbɔ dzi blewuu na wo. Ame ʋɛ siwo de enyi pɛ koe woxɔ ɖe agbe le tsiɖɔɖɔ la me.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Mawutsilele sɔ kple tsiɖɔɖɔ sia, eye eyae xɔ mi ɖe agbe azɔ. Menye ɖikɔklɔɖa le ame ŋu ƒe tsi wònye o, ke boŋ enye kukuɖeɖe na Mawu, be wòana ame ƒe dzitsinya navo. Mawutsilelee xɔ mi ɖe agbe to Yesu Kristo ƒe tsitretsitsi tso ku me me.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Eyi dziƒo, eye wòle Mawu ƒe ɖusime hele mawudɔlawo, dziɖulawo kple ŋusẽ siwo le dziƒo la dzi ɖum.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Eya ta esi Kristo kpe fu abe amegbetɔ ene ta la, miawo hã miɖo tame abe eyama ene, ne miatsɔ ado ŋusẽ mia ɖokuii, elabe ame sia ame si kpe fu abe amegbetɔ ene la, megawɔa nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Ale tso fifia heyina la, minɔ agbe ɖe Mawu ƒe didi nu, ke menye ɖe nu si dzroa amegbetɔ la nu o.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi siwo me mieto nɔ agbe hewɔ nu siwo trɔ̃subɔlawo wɔna la didi. Nu siwo ƒe agbe mienɔ va yi la woe nye: hadzedze, wɔwɔ ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo dzroa ame la nu, ahamumu, nu tsu ɖuɖu, aglotutu kple trɔ̃subɔsubɔ si mele se aɖeke nu o.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Azɔ ewɔ nuku na wo be miegale zɔzɔm kpli wo hele yakagbe nɔm ŋɔdzitɔe o, eya ta wole mia dzum.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Ke woava ɖe wo ɖokui nu na Mawu, ame si le klalo le ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge ame gbagbewo kple ame kukuwo siaa la.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Esia ta gɔ̃ wogblɔ Nyanyui la na ame kukuwo hã ɖo, ale be togbɔ be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo le amegbetɔwo gome abe amegbetɔ ɖe sia ɖe ene hã la, le gbɔgbɔ gome la, woanɔ agbe abe Mawu ene. Ele be míawɔ Mawu ƒe nunanawo ŋudɔ atsɔ asubɔ mía nɔewo

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Nuwo katã ƒe nuwuwu ɖo vɔ, eya ta minɔ ŋudzɔ eye milé mia ɖokui nyuie be miate ŋu ado gbe ɖa.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Ke nu si le vevie wu wo katã lae nye be mialɔ̃ mia nɔewo vevie, elabe lɔlɔ̃ tsyɔa nuvɔ̃ geɖe siwo ame wɔna la dzi.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Ne mia dometɔ aɖe dze nɔvia gbɔ abe amedzro ene la, nexɔe liʋiliʋĩlilĩ manɔmee.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Mia dome ame sia ame xɔ nunana tɔxɛ aɖe tso Mawu gbɔ. Abe nudzikpɔla nyui, siwo le nunana ƒomevi vovovowo dzi kpɔm na Mawu ene la, miwɔ nunana siawo ŋudɔ bene woaɖe vi na mia nɔewo.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe le mawunya gblɔm la, negblɔe abe ame si Mawu de gbe asi na be wòagblɔ na amewo ene. Ne ame aɖe le subɔsubɔdɔ wɔm la, netsɔ ŋusẽ si Mawu tsɔ nɛ la wɔe, ale be le nuwo katã me la, woakafu Mawu to Yesu Kristo dzii. Eyama tɔe nye bubu kple ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen. Fukpekpe abe Kristotɔ ene

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Ɖe esia teƒe la, mikpɔ dzidzɔ be yewo hã yewole fu kpem abe Kristo ene, ale be ne edo le ŋutikɔkɔe me la, miawo hã miate ŋu akpɔ dzidzɔ ahatso aseye.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Ne amewo dzu mi, esi mienye Kristo yomedzelawo ta la, mikpɔ dzidzɔ, elabe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe gbɔgbɔ kple Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ le mia dzi.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Ke mia dome ame aɖeke megakpe fu abe amewula, fiafitɔ, nu gbegblẽ wɔla alo ame si dea nu nya si metsɔ egbɔ o la me ene o.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, ne mia dometɔ aɖe kpe fu, esi wònye Kristotɔ ta la, megakpe ŋu nɛ o, ke boŋ nekafu Mawu be Kristo ŋkɔ le ye ŋu.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ɣeyiɣi la de azɔ be woadze ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ gɔme, eye Mawu ƒe aƒemetɔwo dzie wole egɔme dze ge atsoe. Ne wodze egɔme tso mía dzi la, ale kee wòava nɔ na ame siwo mexɔ Mawu ƒe Nyanyui la dzi se o?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Mawunya gblɔ be, “Ne ele ale, be bebli, hafi woaxɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔla ɖe agbe ɖe, ke ale ke wòanɔ na ame mavɔ̃mawu kple nuvɔ̃wɔla?”

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame siwo kpea fu, abe ale si Mawu di ene la, newɔ nu dzɔdzɔe, eye wonetsɔ woƒe luʋɔ de asi na wo Wɔla, ame si wɔa nuteƒe la.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nye, ame si ŋutɔ hã nye hamemegã la, medi be maxlɔ̃ nu hamemegã siwo le mia dome. Nye ŋutɔ mekpɔ ale si Kristo kpe fui la teƒe, eye ne woɖee fia la, mele gome kpɔ ge le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la hã me. Nyee le nu xlɔ̃m mi be:

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Milé be na Mawu ƒe alẽha si wode mia si be miakpɔ edzi la. Menye kple dzizizi o, ke boŋ kple lɔlɔ̃nu faa, abe ale si Mawu di tso mia si la ene. Migawɔ dɔ sia be yewoakpɔ viɖe si medze o la tso eme o, ke mikɔ dzime wɔe faa.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Migawɔ nu abe amegã ɖum miele ɖe ame siwo wotsɔ de mia si la dzi ene o, ke boŋ minye kpɔɖeŋu na alẽha la.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Ale ne Alẽkplɔlagã la do la, miaxɔ fiakuku vavã si megblẽna o la.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Nenema ke mi ɖekakpuiwo hã mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe hamemegãwo te. Mi katã mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui na mia nɔewo, le miaƒe nuwɔna ɖe sia ɖe me kple mia nɔewo, elabe mawunya gblɔ be: “Mawu tsia tsitre ɖe dàdalawo ŋu, ke evea ame siwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui la nu.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Eya ta mibɔbɔ mia ɖokui ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋusẽsi la te, bene wòado mi ɖe dzi le ɣeyiɣi si wòɖo ɖi la me.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ nu siwo katã le fu ɖem na miaƒe susu la da ɖe Mawu dzi, elabe eyae léa be na mi.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Milé mia ɖokui nyuie; minɔ ŋudzɔ! Miaƒe futɔ, Abosam, le tsatsam abe dzata si le gbe ɖem, eye wòle ame dim be yeavuvu ami la ene.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ xɔse tsi tre ɖe eŋu sesĩe, esi mienyae be mia nɔvi xɔsetɔ siwo le xexea me godoo la hã le fukpekpe mawo ke me tom la ta.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Ke ne miekpe fu le ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe me megbe vɔ la, Mawu, ame si ƒe amenuveve seɖoƒe meli na o; ame si yɔ mi be miava kpɔ gome le ŋutikɔkɔe mavɔ si le ɖekawɔwɔ kple Kristo me la me la, ŋutɔ agbugbɔ mi atu tsitre, ana miali ke zã, ado ŋusẽ mi eye wòaɖo mia gɔme anyi.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Eya tɔ nanye ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Amen. Gbedoname

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Meŋlɔ nya ʋɛ siawo to Silvano dzi ɖo ɖe mi. Mebunɛ nɔvi nuteƒewɔlae. Medi be mado ŋusẽ mi kple nu si teƒe nye ŋutɔ mekpɔ la be Mawu ƒe amenuveve vavã lae nye esia. Milé eme ɖe asi sesĩe.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Babilonia-hame si Mawu tia la hã do gbe na mi nyuie. Nenema ke vinye Marko hã do gbe na mi.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Mido gbe na mia nɔewo, eye mia dome ame sia ame nana asi nɔvia lɔlɔ̃tɔe. Ŋutifafa nenɔ kple mi ame siwo katã le hadede me kple Kristo la.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔla kple amedɔdɔ gbɔ. Mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi ame siwo ƒe asi su xɔse si le tè abe mía tɔ ene la dzi la, le mía Mawu kple Xɔla Yesu Kristo ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Mawu negave mia nu ɖe edzi, eye wòana ŋutifafa mi zã, be miagadze si eyama kple Yesu, mía Aƒetɔ la geɖe wu. Ale si Mawu yɔ amewo hetia woe

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ na nu siwo katã míehiã le agbe me la mí faa, be míate ŋu anɔ agbe asubɔe. Ewɔ esia elabe míedze si eya, ame si yɔ mí be míava kpɔ gome le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple nyonyo me la.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Mawu to mɔ sia dzi na nunana xɔasi vavãtɔ siwo ŋugbe wòdo la mí, ale be miate ŋu ato nunana siawo dzi así le nudzroame vɔ̃ɖi siwo tsrɔ̃a ame le xexea me la nu, eye miava zu ame siwo akpɔ gome le Mawu ƒe dzɔdzɔme la me.

english_verse: Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding,
translation_verse: Le susu vevi sia ta la, midze agbagba miatsɔ nyuiwɔwɔ akpe ɖe miaƒe xɔse ŋu. Nenema ke nunya nekpe ɖe nyuiwɔwɔ ŋu;

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Ne nɔnɔme siawo su mia si hexɔ aƒe ɖe mia me keŋ la, woana miaƒe nuwɔna me nakɔ, eye miaɖe vi, esi miedze si mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ta.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Elabe ne nɔnɔme siawo mesu ame aɖe si o la, ekema eƒe ŋkuwo gbã vɔ, eye magate ŋu akpɔ nu le didiƒe o. Ame sia ŋlɔ be, be woklɔ nuvɔ̃ siwo yewɔ kpɔ la ɖa le ye ŋu.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Eya ta nɔvinyewo, mido ŋusẽ nu vevie wu tsã, tsɔ ɖo kpe edzi be ale si Mawu yɔ mi, hetia mi la le eteƒe, elabe ne miewɔ esia la, miele megbe de ge tso ame si dzi miexɔ se la gbɔ akpɔ o.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ale woaʋu mɔ na mi siaa be miage ɖe mía Aƒetɔ kple Xɔla Yesu Kristo ƒe fiaɖuɖu mavɔ la me.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mienya nu siawo xoxo, eye mieli ke zã ɖe nyateƒe si miexɔ la me hafi hã la, meɖoe be manɔ ŋku ɖom wo dzi na mi ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ be esɔ be zi ale si megale agbe la, enyo be manɔ ŋku ɖom nu siawo dzi na mi, anɔ mia nyɔm.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: Elabe mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ɖee fiam be eteƒe madidi kura hafi maku o.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Esia ta medi be makpɔ egbɔ be le nye ku megbe la, miate ŋu anɔ ŋku ɖom nu siawo dzi edziedzi. Ame siwo kpɔ Kristo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe la teƒe

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Nya si míegblɔ na mi le ale si mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo le vava ge ŋusẽtɔe ŋu la, menye ŋutinya kpakpa si wokpa aɖaŋutɔe la mee míeɖee le gblɔ na mi o. Míawo ŋutɔe kpɔ eƒe bubu, atsyɔ̃ kple ŋusẽ la tututu kple ŋku hafi gblɔe na mi.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Míele eteƒe gbe ma gbe, esime Mawu Tɔ́ la tsɔ bubu kple ŋutikɔkɔe nɛ. Gbe ɖi tso Ŋutikɔkɔekatãtɔ la gbɔ va nɛ be: “Vinye lɔlɔ̃e nye esia; mekpɔ ŋudzedze le eŋu!”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Míawo ŋutɔe se gbeɖiɖi sia tso dziƒo, esime míele Yesu gbɔ le to kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ale wɔ míawo boŋ míeva ka ɖe gbedeasi si Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo ɖe gbeƒãe la dzi wu gɔ̃ hã. Midze agbagba mialé be na gbedeasi la abe akaɖi si le keklẽm le viviti me la ene, va se ɖe esime fɔŋli naɖo, eye ŋukeɣletivi la nadze ɖe miaƒe dzime.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Nu vevitɔ si wòle be mianya lae nye be ame aɖeke ŋutɔ metsona ko ɖea Mawu ƒe gbedeasi si woŋlɔ ɖi gɔme le eɖokui si o.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu ƒe gbedeasi aɖeke metso ame ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu me woɖe gbeƒãe kpɔ o, ke boŋ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe lae nana be amewo ɖea gbeƒã gbedeasi si tso Mawu gbɔ la.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Abe ale si aʋatsogbeƒãɖelawo do ɖe amewo dome tsã ene la, nenemae aʋatsonufialawo hã le dodo ge ɖe mia dome. Woato ayemɔ dzi ahe aʋatsonufiafia si agblẽ nu la vɛ. Ame siawo agbe nu le woƒe Aƒetɔ si xɔ wo ƒle la ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã gbɔ. Woƒe nuwɔna ana woatsrɔ̃ wo ɖokui kaba.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo akplɔ woƒe agbe baɖa nɔnɔ ɖo, ale be le aʋatsonufialawo ta la, amewo agblɔ nya vlowo ɖe nyateƒemɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Esi wonye ŋuklẽlawo ta la, woakpa alakpanyawo atsɔ akpɔ viɖe le mia ŋui. Wobu fɔ aʋatsonufiala siawo tso blema ke da ɖi, eye ame si le wo tsrɔ̃ ge la meɖe ŋu ɖi kpɔ o.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, Mawu mekpɔ nublanui na mawudɔla mawo esi wowɔ nuvɔ̃ o, ke boŋ etsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe dzomavɔʋe si do viviti tsiɖitsiɖi la me, bene woadzra wo ɖo ɖe afi ma, ne woava drɔ̃ ʋɔnu wo.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Nenema ke Mawu mekpɔ nublanui na ame siwo nɔ xexea me le Noa ŋɔli la hã o. Ena tsi ɖɔ hetsrɔ̃ ame mavɔ̃mawu siwo katã nɔ xexea me la keŋkeŋ, negbe Noa, ame si ɖe gbeƒã be amewo newɔ nu dzɔdzɔe kple ame adrẽ bubu ko Mawu ɖe le eme.

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Ena dzo tsrɔ̃ Sodom kple Gomora gbidii wozu dzowɔ ɖeɖe. Ewɔ wo be woazu kpɔdzidze na ame mavɔ̃mawu bubu, siwo ava nɔ agbe la.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe sia nɔ ameawo dome gbe sia gbe. Ese nu siwo katã nɔ edzi yim, eye wòkpɔ wo kple ŋku hã, ale ameawo ƒe sedzidada ɖe fu na eƒe susu ŋutɔ.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Nenye be Aƒetɔ la wɔ esia la, ekema eya ŋutɔ nya ale si wòaxɔ ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la ɖe agbe tso woƒe tetekpɔwo me, eye wòadzra nu madzɔmadzɔ wɔla ɖo va se ɖe ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la be woahe to nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Ewɔa esia, vevietɔ na ame siwo nɔa agbe ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo dzroa woƒe ameti blibo la nu, eye womebua ŋusẽ si ɖua wo dzi la ɖe naneke me o. Aʋatsonufiala siawo nye ame mabunuwo. Wodzea wo ɖokui ŋu, eye ne wole nya vlowo gblɔm ɖe ŋutikɔkɔetɔ siwo le dziƒo ŋu la, vɔvɔ̃ meɖoa wo wodzona nyanyanya o.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Evɔ la, mawudɔla siwo ŋu ŋutete kple ŋusẽ le sãa wu ame siawo kura gɔ̃ hã, metsoa wo nu tso woƒe nu vlo wɔwɔ ŋu na Aƒetɔ la gbeɖe o.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Ame siawo le abe gbemelã manyanu, siwo dzɔdzɔme wɔ be ame natre mɔ́ alé awu la ene. Wogblɔa nya vlo ɖe nu si gɔme womese o la ŋu. Woatsrɔ̃ ame siawo abe ale si amewo tsrɔ̃a gbemelã mawoe ene.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Woakpe fu, ɖe fu si wona amewo kpe la nu. Woɖua agbe le ŋkeke me elabe wobunɛ dzidzɔdonamenui. Wonye ŋukpenanuwɔlawo kple ame ƒoɖiwo. Wobɔa ha kpli mi ɖua azã, evɔ wònye wo ɖokui flum wole be yewole agbe ɖum hafi.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Woto ahiãwɔŋku eye wo tsɔtsɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃e metia wo o. Woblea ame siwo meli ke o la. Womla woƒe dzi ɖe ŋukeklẽ ŋu. Mawu ƒe fiƒode le ame siawo dzi.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Wotra mɔ, elabe wogbe mɔ dzɔdzɔetɔ la dzi toto. Woto Bileam, Beor vi la ƒe ʋe me. Eya kpɔa dzidzɔ le viɖe si wòakpɔ le nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ me la ŋu.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: Ke woka mo na Bileam, esi wòda Mawu ƒe se dzi. Eya ŋutɔ ƒe tedzie ƒo nu nɛ abe amegbetɔ ene, eye wòxe mɔ na aɖaʋanu si wɔm eya, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela la le.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Aʋatsonufiala siawo le abe vudo siwo medzia tsi o, alo abe alilikpo si ƒom ahom le kple du la ene. Woawoe Mawu dzra teƒe ma, si do viviti tsiɖitsiɖi la da ɖi na.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Woƒoa nu dàdatɔe eye wogblɔa movinyawo. Wozɔna ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi, siwo dzroa woƒe ameti bliboa la nu, eye wodzea ha heblea ame siwo gbe nu le agbenɔnɔ vɔ̃ɖi, siwo gbɔ wosí le eteƒe medidi o la.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Ame siawo doa ablɔɖe ŋugbe na amewo, evɔ la, woawo ŋutɔ nye nu fitifiti wɔwɔ ƒe kluviwo, elabe ne nane ɖu ame dzi la, amea zu nu ma ƒe kluvi.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Ne amewo to sidzedze mía Aƒetɔ kple Xɔla Yesu Kristo me, sí le nu siwo ƒoa ɖi ame le xexe sia me la nu, kasia ko nu mawo ke gagbugbɔ va lé wo, heɖu wo dzi la, agbe si ƒomevi wova nɔna le nuwuwu la gblẽna wu esi wonɔ tsã.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Ne ɖe ame siawo megaxanya naneke kura le nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ƒe mɔ la ŋu o la, ne enyo na wo wu, be woanya mɔ sia vɔ agagbugbɔ ɖe megbe tso se kɔkɔe si Mawu de na wo la gbɔ.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Nu si dzɔ ɖe wo dzi la ɖee fia kɔtɛe be lododo siawo nye nyateƒe: “Avu si tru la gbugbɔ yi eya ŋutɔ ƒe tutru la gbɔ” kple “Ha si wole tsi na nyuie lae nye ekem gale mimlim le ba me.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: Medi be miaɖo ŋku nya siwo Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela kɔkɔeawo ɖe gbeƒãe da ɖi kple Aƒetɔ kple Xɔla la ƒe sedede si miaƒe amedɔdɔawo xɔ vɛ la dzi.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Gbã la, eme nekɔ na mi be le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me la, fewuɖulawo lava. Woanɔ agbe ɖe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo dzroa woƒe ameti blibo la nu, eye woaɖu fewu le mia ŋu.

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: Woagblɔ be: “Ame si do ŋugbe be yele vava ge gɔ̃ ɖe? Elabe tso esime mía tɔwo ku va se ɖe fifi la, ɖeko nu sia nu gale edzi yim, abe ale si wole tso esime wowɔ wo le xexea me ƒe gɔmedzedzea me ene.”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula siawo ɖoe koŋ be yewomaxɔ nyateƒenya sia o. Eyae nye be Mawu ƒe nyae na dziƒowo le te va se ɖe egbe. Eya kee na anyigba do tso tsi me, heto tsi me li,

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: eye tsie Mawu tsɔ tsrɔ̃ xexea me nuwoe kpɔ.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe nya la kee lé dziƒo kple anyigba ɖe tè fifia hã, eye wòdzra wo ɖo be woava tɔ dzo wo. Edzra wo ɖo va se ɖe ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe, esime woatsrɔ̃ ame mavɔ̃mawuwo.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Le ame aɖewo ƒe susu nu la, Aƒetɔ la mele ʋaʋãm ɖe ŋugbe si wòdo la dzi wɔwɔ ŋu o. Mele eme nenema o, ke boŋ ɖe wògbɔ dzi blewuu na mi, elabe medi be ame aɖeke natsrɔ̃ o, ke boŋ be amewo katã natrɔ dzime.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ƒe ŋkeke la aɖo, abe ale si fiafitɔ vanae ene. Gbe ma gbe la, dziƒowo aklo ɖa ava yi kple gbeɖiɖi sesẽ, eye dziƒonuwo katã alé dzo afia keŋ. Nenema ke anyigba kple nuwɔwɔ siwo katã le edzi la hã afia.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Esi nu siawo katã le tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge alea ɖe, ame ka tɔgbe wòle be mianye? Ele be mianɔ agbe kɔkɔe, eye miavɔ̃ Mawu,

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: esime miele mɔ kpɔm hetsi dzi be Mawu ƒe ŋkeke la neva kaba. Elabe gbe ma gbee dziƒowo le dzo lé ge afiã, eye nu sia nu atsrɔ̃ keŋ. Woalólo nu siwo katã le dziŋgɔli la me le dzo me.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Ke míawo la, míanɔ lalam na dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye si ŋugbe Mawu do la. Afi siae nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ xɔ aƒe ɖo.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Ele be miabu ale si mía Aƒetɔ la gbɔ dzi blewuu la be enye mɔnukpɔkpɔ na mi be woaxɔ mi ɖe agbe. Nya sia kee mía nɔvi lɔlɔ̃tɔ, Paulo hã ŋlɔ ɖo ɖe mi le nunya si Mawu nae la nu.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, esia nye nya si wògblɔ le eƒe agbalẽwo katã me. Nya aɖewo gɔmesese sesẽ, le eƒe agbalẽawo me, eye ame manyanuwo kple ame malikewo trɔ wo gɔmeɖeɖe bubui, abe ale si wowɔna kple mawunya bubuawo hã ene. Esia wɔwɔ nana be wotsrɔ̃na.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Ke nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, miawo ya la, mienya nu tso nu siawo ŋu xoxo. Eya ta mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie, ale be aglãdzelawo ƒe vodada nagaɖe kè le mia te miadze anyi o.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Mía Aƒetɔ kple Xɔla Yesu Kristo neve mia nu, bene miagadze si eyama ɖe edzi geɖe wu. Etɔ nanye ŋutikɔkɔe tso fifia halase mavɔ me. Amen.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Míele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na mi tso nya si naa agbe si li tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke la ŋu. Ɖe míese nya sia hekpɔe kple míawo ŋutɔ míaƒe ŋkuwo. Nyateƒee, ɖe míekpɔe tututu, eye míeka asi eŋu hã.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Esi woɖe nya si naa agbe la ɖe go la, míekpɔe. Ale míeƒo nu le eŋu heɖe gbeƒã agbe mavɔ si le Tɔ́ la gbɔ, esi wona míawo hã míenya la, na mi.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nu si míekpɔ hese la, eya gblɔm míele na miawo hã, ale be miawo hã miava kpe ɖe mía ŋu, ne míade ha kple Tɔ́ la kpakple Via Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Ale míele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na mi, bene dzidzɔ si kpɔm míele la nade blibo. Mawu nye kekeli

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nya si míese tso Vi la gbɔ, eye míetsɔe le gbeƒã ɖem na mi lae nye be: Mawu nye kekeli, eye viviti aɖeke mele eme kura o.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Ne míegblɔ be míele hadede me kplii, evɔ míegale zɔzɔm le viviti me kokoko la, ekema míaƒe nyagbɔgblɔ kple nuwɔna nye alakpa ɖeɖe sɔŋ.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Ne míele kekeli la me, abe ale si eya ŋutɔ hã le kekeli la me la ene la, ekema míele ha dem kple mía nɔewo, eye Via Yesu ƒe ʋu la klɔ nuvɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe ɖa le mía ŋuti keŋ.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ne míegblɔ be nuvɔ̃ mele mía ŋu o la, míeble mía ɖokui, eye nyateƒe la mele mía me o.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Ke ne míeʋu míaƒe nuvɔ̃ me la, Mawu awɔ nu si le eteƒe kple nu si le dzɔdzɔe ko la na mí. Eyae nye be atsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake mí, eye wòaklɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ siwo katã míewɔ la ɖa le mía ŋu.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Evɔ ne míegblɔ be nuvɔ̃ mele mía ŋu o la, míedo aʋatsokala Mawu eye eƒe nya la mele mía me o.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, mele nu siawo ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi, ale be miagawɔ nuvɔ̃ o. Ke ne ame aɖe wɔ nuvɔ̃ hã la, Yesu Kristo dzɔdzɔetɔ la ʋlia mía ta le Tɔ́ la gbɔ.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Eya dzi Mawu to tsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke mí. Menye míawo ɖeɖe ko tɔ wòtsɔ ke o, ke boŋ amegbetɔƒomea katã tɔ hãe.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Nenye be míewɔa Mawu ƒe seawo dzi la, ekema efia be míeka ɖe edzi be míenyae vavã.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ame si gblɔna be: “Menyae,” evɔ mewɔa eƒe seawo dzi o la, alakpatɔ wònye, eye nyateƒe la mele eme o.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Ke ame si léa eƒe nya la me ɖe asi la, eya ƒe lɔlɔ̃ na Mawue de blibo vavã. Ale si wòle be míaka ɖe edzi be míele Mawu mee nye be:

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si gblɔna be yele hadede me kplii la, ele nɛ be wòanɔ agbe abe Yesu Kristo ene tututu. Se yeye la

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, nu si ŋlɔm mele ɖo ɖe mi la, menye se yeye wònye o, ke boŋ se xoxo si mienya tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke lae. Se xoxo sia nye gbedeasi si miese xoxo la.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, se si ŋlɔm mele ɖo ɖe mi la, se yeye wònye, eye nyateƒe si le eme la, dzé le Kristo kple miawo siaa me. Elabe viviti la nu yi vɔ, eye kekelia ŋutɔŋutɔ le keklẽm xoxo.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Ame si gblɔ be yele kekeli la me, evɔ wòhelé fu nɔvia la, viviti me ko wògale va se ɖe fifi.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃ nɔvia la, eya le kekeli la me, eye naneke mana wòawɔ nuvɔ̃ o.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Ke ame si lé fu nɔvia la, viviti me wòle. Ele viviti me zɔm, eye menya afi si tututu wòɖo tae o, elabe viviti la na eƒe ŋkuwo gbã.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɖevi suewo, miawoe mele agbalẽa ŋlɔm na, elabe wotsɔ miaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ke le Kristo ta.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Tɔ́wo, miawoe mele agbalẽa ŋlɔm na, elabe mienya eya ame si li tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke. Nenema ke mele eŋlɔm na mi ɖekakpuiwo hã, elabe mieɖu vɔ̃ɖitɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Ɖevi suewo, mebe miawoe mele agbalẽa ŋlɔm na, elabe mienya Tɔ́ la. Tɔ́wo, mebe miawoe mele agblẽa ŋlɔm na, elabe mienya ame si li tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke. Ɖekakpuiwo, mebe miawoe mele agbalẽa ŋlɔm na, elabe ŋusẽ le mia ŋu, Mawu ƒe nya la le mia me, eye mieɖu vɔ̃ɖitɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Migalɔ̃ xexea me loo, alo nu siwo le eme la ƒe ɖeke o. Ne ame aɖe lɔ̃ xexea me la, lɔlɔ̃ aɖeke mele eme na Tɔ́ la o.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Elabe xexea me nuwo katã: nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo dzroa amegbetɔ, nuvɔ̃ɖi si ame kpɔna wòdzronɛ kple nu siwo dzi ame dana ɖo le xexea me la dometɔ aɖeke metso Tɔ́ la gbɔ o; xexea mee wotso.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Xexea me kple nudzroame siwo katã le eme la nu va yina, ke ame si wɔa nu si Mawu di la ya, nɔa anyi ɖaa. Kristo ƒe futɔ la

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, ɣeyiɣia de vɔ! Miese be Kristo ƒe futɔ la le vava ge. Kristo ƒe futɔ geɖewo va do, eya tae míenya be ɣeyiɣia de.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me la, menye mía dometɔwoe nye ame siawo o, eya tae wodzo le mía gbɔ ɖo. Nenye mía dometɔwoe wonye vavã la, anye ne wogale mía dome. Ke wodzo, ale be eme nakɔ ƒãa be wo dometɔ aɖeke mele mía dome o.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Ke Kristo kɔ Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la ɖe mia dzi, eye mi katã mienya nu sia nu.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Menye esi mimenya nyateƒe la o tae mele nu siawo ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi o, ke boŋ esi mienya nyateƒe la, eye mienya nyuie hã be alakpa mele eme o la tae.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ame ka koŋ ye nye alakpatɔ? Eyae nye ame si gblɔna be menye Yesue nye Kristo la o. Ame sia tututue nye Kristo ƒe futɔ la. Eyae gbe nu le Vi la kple Tɔ́ la siaa gbɔ.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Elabe ame sia ame si gbe nu le Vi la gbɔ la, Tɔ́ la hã menye etɔ o; ame sia ame si xɔ Vi la la, Tɔ́ la hã nye etɔ.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Mina gbedeasi si miexɔ le gɔmedzedzea me la, nanɔ mia me. Nenye be mielé gbedeasi si miese le gɔmedzedzea me la ɖe asi la, ekema miate ŋu anɔ hadede me kple Vi la kpakple Tɔ́ la.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Nu si ŋugbe Kristo ŋutɔ do na mí lae nye agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Ame siwo able mi tae mele esia ŋlɔm na mi ɖo.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Ke le miawo ya gome la, ami si Kristo si na mi la gale mia me ko eye mehiã be ame aɖeke nagafia nu mi o. Elabe eƒe amisisi la fiaa nu sia nu mi, eye nu si wòfiana la menye alakpa o, ke boŋ nyateƒe ɖeɖe sɔŋ ye. Eya ta milé nu si wòfia mi la me ɖe asi, ne mianɔ Kristo me.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Ale vinyewo, minɔ Kristo me, ale be ne wòva do gbe ma gbe la, dzi naɖo mia ƒo, eye ŋu nagakpe mi, miade mo to o.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Ne mienya be Kristo nye ame dzɔdzɔe la, ekema ele be miaka ɖe edzi be ame sia ame si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la Mawu vie.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ale si gbegbe Tɔ́ la lɔ̃ mí la ɖa! Elɔ̃ mí ale gbegbe be woyɔa mí be Mawu viwo. Ẽ, nyateƒee, viawo míenye baa! Nu si ta koŋ xexea me medze si mí o lae nye be medze si Mawu o.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, fifia la, Mawu viwo míenye. Nu si tututu míava zu koŋ la medze nyuie haɖe o. Ke míenyae be ne Kristo va do la, míanɔ abe eya ŋutɔ ene, eye ale si tututu wòle lae míakpɔ.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si le mɔ kpɔm na Kristo alea la, kɔa eya ŋutɔ ɖokui ŋu, abe ale si Kristo hã le kɔkɔe ene.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si wɔa nuvɔ̃ la, zu Mawu ƒe sedzidala. Nu vɔ̃ nye Mawu ƒe sedzidada.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Míenya be Kristo ɖe wòva be yeatsɔ amewo ƒe nuvɔ̃wo adzoe, eya ta nuvɔ̃ aɖeke mele eyama me o.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si le hadede me kple Kristo la, mewɔa nuvɔ̃ o. Ame sia ame si wɔa nuvɔ̃ la, mekpɔ Kristo kpɔ kaka ahayi si dze gee o.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, migana ame aɖeke nable mi o. Ame sia ame si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la le dzɔdzɔe abe ale si Kristo hã le dzɔdzɔe ene.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔa nuvɔ̃ la, vɔ̃ɖitɔ la tɔe wònye, elabe vɔ̃ɖitɔ la wɔ nuvɔ̃ tso keke gɔmedzedzea me ke. Nu si ta Mawu Vi la va ɖoe nye be yeagblẽ vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe dɔwɔnawo keŋ.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si nye Mawu vi la, mewɔa nuvɔ̃ o, elabe Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme le eyama me. Mate ŋu awɔ nuvɔ̃ o, elabe Mawue nye Tɔ́a.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Vovototo si le Mawu viwo kple vɔ̃ɖitɔ la viwo dome lae nye be: Ame sia ame si mewɔa nu dzɔdzɔe o, alo melɔ̃ nɔvia o la, menye Mawu vi o. Milɔ̃ mia nɔewo

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Gbedeasi si miese le gɔmedzedzea me lae nye be ele na mí be míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Ke miganɔ abe Kain, ame si nye vɔ̃ɖitɔ vi eye wòwu nɔvia la ene o. Nu ka tae wòwui ɖo? Ewui, elabe eya ŋutɔ wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi, ke nɔvia ya wɔ nu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Nɔvinyewo, megawɔ nuku na mi be ame siwo le xexea me lé fu mi o.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Le mía gome la, míenya be míeto ku me hege ɖe agbe la me, elabe míelɔ̃ mía nɔewo. Ame sia ame si melɔ̃ nɔvia o la, tsi ku me.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si lé fu nɔvia la, amewulae, eye mienya be agbe mavɔ mele amewula aɖeke me o.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: To esia me la, míenya nu si koŋ nye lɔlɔ̃: Eyae nye be Kristo tsɔ eƒe agbe na ɖe mía ta, eya ta ele na míawo hã be míatsɔ míaƒe agbe ana ɖe mía nɔewo ta.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Nenye be xexemenuwo le ame aɖe si, eye hiã tu nɔvia wòkpɔ, gake eƒe dzi meʋãe be yeakpe ɖe eŋu o la, ale ke wòate ŋu agblɔ le eya ŋutɔ ƒe dzime be yelɔ̃ Mawui?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, migana míatsɔ nya kple nuƒoƒo ko alɔ̃ amee o, ke boŋ míaƒe lɔlɔ̃ nanye nyateƒetɔ si adzé le míaƒe nuwɔna me. Dzideƒo le mía si le Mawu ŋkume

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: To esia me míenya be míenye nyateƒe la tɔ, eye dzi anɔ mía ƒo le Mawu ŋkume,

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: ɣe si ɣi míaƒe dzi bu fɔ mí; elabe Mawu nye gã wu míaƒe dzi, eye wònya nu sia nu.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, nenye be míaƒe dzi mebu fɔ mí o la, ekema dzideƒo anɔ mía si le Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Míexɔa nu sia nu si míebiana la tso egbɔ, elabe míewɔa eƒe seawo dzi, eye míewɔa nu siwo dzea eŋu.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Eƒe se lae nye be: míaxɔ Via Yesu Kristo dzi ase, eye míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo, abe ale si Kristo di tso mía si la ene.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã wɔa Mawu ƒe sewo dzi la, le Mawu me eye Mawu hã le wo me. To eƒe Gbɔgbɔ si wòna mí la me la, míenya be Mawu le mía me.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, migaxɔ ame siwo katã gblɔna be Gbɔgbɔ la le yewo me la dzi se o, ke mido wo kpɔ, ne miakpɔ ɖa be Gbɔgbɔ si le wo me la tso Mawu gbɔ vavã mahã. Elabe aʋatsogbeƒãɖela geɖewo do go le tsatsam le xexea me.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Nu si miakpɔ anya be Gbɔgbɔ la tso Mawu gbɔe nye esi: Ame si gblɔna be Yesu Kristo va abe amegbetɔ ene la ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Ke ame si meʋua Yesu me alea o la ƒe gbɔgbɔ la metso Mawu gbɔ o. Yesu ƒe futɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔ si ŋkɔ miese be egbɔna lae nye esia, eye azɔ la eva ɖo xexea me.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, Mawu tɔwoe mienye eye mieɖu aʋatsogbeƒãɖela siawo dzi, elabe ame si ƒe Gbɔgbɔ le mia me la ƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ wu ame siwo le xexea me la ƒe gbɔgbɔ tɔ.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Esi wònye xexea me wotso ta la, xexea me nuwo ŋu ko woƒoa nu tsonɛ, eye ame siwo tso xexea me la ɖoa to wo.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Ke míawo la, Mawu tɔwoe míenye. Ame sia ame si nya Mawu la, ɖoa to mí, eye ame si ke menye Mawu tɔ o la, meɖoa to mí o. Nu sia míekpɔna hedzea si Gbɔgbɔ si nye nyateƒe tɔ kple esi nye alakpa tɔ la. Mawu nye lɔlɔ̃

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, mina míalɔ̃ mia nɔewo, elabe Mawu gbɔe lɔlɔ̃ tso. Ame sia ame si lɔ̃a ame la, Mawu vie wònye, eye wòdze si Mawu.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si melɔ̃a ame o la, medze si Mawu o, elabe Mawu nye lɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Ale si Mawu ɖe eƒe lɔlɔ̃ fia mí lae nye be edɔ eya ŋutɔ Via ɖeka hɔ̃ la ɖo ɖe xexea me bene míanɔ agbe to eyama dzi.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: To esia me la, míenya nu si koŋ nye lɔlɔ̃. Menye ale si míawo míelɔ̃ Mawu lae nye lɔlɔ̃ o, ke boŋ ale si Mawu lɔ̃ mí, eye wòdɔ Via ɖo ɖa be wòanye ame si dzi yeato atsɔ míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo ake mí lae nye lɔlɔ̃.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, esi Mawu lɔ̃ mí alea ta la, ele na míawo hã be míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke mekpɔ Mawu kpɔ o. Ne míelɔ̃ mía nɔewo la, ekema Mawu le mía me, eye wòwɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃ la wòde blibo le mía me.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Ale si míewɔ nya be míele Mawu me, eye Mawu hã le mía me lae nye be etsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe Gbɔgbɔ la na mí.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Míekpɔ esia, eye míetsɔe ɖe gbeƒãe na amewo be Tɔ́ la ɖo Via ɖa be wòava zu amewo Ɖela le xexea me.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ʋua eme be Yesue nye Mawu Vi la la, Mawu le eyama me, eye eya hã le Mawu me.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Ale míawo míedze si Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ si wòtsɔ na mí la, eye míexɔ edzi se hã. Mawu nye lɔlɔ̃, eye ame sia ame si lɔ̃a ame la, ele Mawu me, eye Mawu hã le eme.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Esia ta wòle be lɔlɔ̃ nade blibo le mía me, ale be dzideƒo nanɔ mía si le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe la, elabe míaƒe agbenɔnɔ le xexea me sɔ kple Kristo tɔ.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Vɔvɔ̃ aɖeke mele lɔlɔ̃ me o, ke lɔlɔ̃ si de blibo la nyaa vɔvɔ̃ ɖa. Eya ta ame si vɔ̃na la ƒe lɔlɔ̃ mede blibo o, elabe vɔvɔ̃ hea tohehe vanɛ.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Míelɔ̃a Mawu elabe eyae lɔ̃ mí gbã.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe gblɔ be: “Melɔ̃ Mawu” evɔ wòlé fu nɔvia la, aʋatsokala wònye. Elabe ame sia ame si melɔ̃a nɔvia si wòkpɔna o la, mate ŋu alɔ̃ Mawu si mekpɔna o la hã o.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Ale se si Kristo na mí lae nye be: Ame sia ame si lɔ̃a Mawu la, nelɔ̃ nɔvia hã.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si xɔ se be Yesue nye Kristo la la, Mawu vi wònye. Ke ame sia ame si lɔ̃a dzila aɖe la, lɔ̃a via hã.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Eya ta ne míelɔ̃ Mawu, eye míewɔ eƒe seawo dzi la, ekema míenya be míelɔ̃ Mawu viwo hã.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Ne míewɔ Mawu ƒe seawo dzi la, ekema efia be míelɔ̃ eyama. Mawu ƒe seawo dzi wɔwɔ mesesẽ o,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: elabe ame sia ame si nye Mawu vi la, ɖu xexea me dzi. Nu si míetsɔ ɖu xexea me dzi lae nye míaƒe xɔse.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Evɔ ɖe, ame kae ate ŋu aɖu xexea me dzi? Ame si xɔe se be Yesu ye nye Mawu Vi la koe. Ɖaseɖiɖi le Yesu Kristo ŋu

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristoe nye ame si va to tsi kple ʋu me. Meva le tsi ɖeɖe ko me o, ke boŋ eva le tsi la kple ʋu la me.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la ɖi ɖase be nyateƒee, elabe Gbɔgbɔ lae nye nyateƒe la.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo etɔ̃e li. Woawoe nye: Gbɔgbɔ la, tsi la kple ʋu la. Nu ɖeka dzi ko nu etɔ̃awo katã lɔ̃ ɖo.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Nenye be míexɔ amewo ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi dzi se la, ekema Mawu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi nye nyateƒe wu, elabe eya ɖi ɖase tso Via ŋu.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Ale ame sia ame si xɔ Mawu Vi la dzi se la, xɔ ɖaseɖiɖi la ɖe eɖokui me. Nenema ke ame sia ame si mexɔ Mawu dzi se o la, do aʋatsokala Mawu elabe mexɔ ɖase si Mawu ɖi le Via ŋu la dzi se o.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Ɖaseɖiɖi lae nye be Mawu tsɔ agbe mavɔ na mí, eye eyae nye agbe si le Via me.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si xɔ Via la, agbe sia le eme. Nenema ke ame sia ame si mexɔ Mawu Vi la o la, agbe sia mele eme o. Agbe mavɔ

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Mele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na mi ame siwo xɔ Mawu Vi la dzi se, ale be mianya be agbe mavɔ su mia si.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Nu si na be míeɖoa dzi ɖe eŋu lae nye be, ne míebia nane le eƒe didi nu la, esenɛ.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Ne míenya be esea nu sia nu si míebianɛ la, ekema míenya hã be nu sia nu si míebiana la, míexɔnɛ tso egbɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe kpɔ nɔvia wòle nuvɔ̃ aɖe si mehea ku vanɛ o la wɔm la, ele be wòado gbe ɖa na Mawu, ame si lana agbee. Ame siwo wɔa nuvɔ̃ si mehea ku vanɛ o la ƒe nyae nye esia. Ke nuvɔ̃ aɖe li si hea ku vanɛ. Menye nuvɔ̃ sia ƒomevi tae mebe woado gbe ɖa ɖo o.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Nu madzɔmadzɔ ɖe sia ɖe wɔwɔ nye nuvɔ̃, ke nuvɔ̃ aɖewo ya li, siwo mehea ku vanɛ o.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Míenya be ame si nye Mawu vi la, mewɔa nuvɔ̃ o, elabe Mawu Vi la kpɔa eta, eye vɔ̃ɖitɔ la mewɔa nu vevi aɖekee o.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Míenya be Mawu tɔ míawo ya míenye, ke xexeme blibo la katã le vɔ̃ɖitɔ la ƒe ŋusẽ te.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Míenya be Mawu Vi la va, eye wòna míese nu gɔme, ale be míedze si Mawu nyateƒetɔ la. Ame si nye nyateƒetɔ la mee míele agbe le: Ẽ, Via Yesu Kristo mee míele agbe le. Eyae nye Mawu nyateƒetɔ la kple agbe mavɔ la.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, mite ɖa le trɔ̃wo gbɔ.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye, miaƒe hamemegã la gbɔ. Mele eŋlɔm na aƒenɔ si nye Mawu ƒe ame tiatia kple viawo, ame siwo melɔ̃ le nyateƒe la me. Menye nye koe lɔ̃ wo o, ke boŋ ame siwo katã dze si nyateƒe la hãe,

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: elabe nyateƒe la le mía me, eye wòle mía me nɔ ge tegbee.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Mawu Tɔ́ la kple Yesu Kristo, Tɔ́ la Vi nave mía nu, akpɔ nublanui na mí, eye woana ŋutifafa mí, ame siwo lɔ̃ mía nɔewo le nyateƒe la me. Nyateƒe kple lɔlɔ̃

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ be mekpɔ viwò aɖewo wole agbe nɔm le nyateƒe la me, abe ale si Tɔ́ la di tso mía si ene.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Ale mele agbalẽ sia ŋlɔm na mi, Aƒenɔ bubutɔ, be míalɔ̃ mía nɔewo. Menye se yeye wònye wɔm mele na mi o, ke boŋ esi míexɔ tso gɔmedzedzea me ke la koe.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Ameblela geɖewo do kaka ɖe xexea me. Ame siawo gblɔ be Yesu Kristo meva xexea me abe amegbetɔ ene o. Ameblelae nye ame sia tɔgbe, eye wònye Kristo ƒe futɔ.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ mia ɖokui dzi nyuie be nu si míeku kutri, va xɔ fifia la, nagabu o, ke boŋ be fetu blibo la katã nazu mia tɔ.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si melé Kristo ƒe nufiafia la me ɖe asi o, ke boŋ wòfia nu bubu la, Mawu mele eme o. Ke ame sia ame si lé nufiafia sia me ɖe asi la, Tɔ́ la kple Vi la siaa le esi.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe va mia gbɔ, eye metsɔ nufiafia sia vɛ o la, migaxɔe ɖe mia ƒeme o. Migalɔ̃ gbe teti hã nɛ o,

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: elabe ame si lɔ̃ gbe pɛ ko nɛ hã, kpɔ gome le nuvɔ̃ɖi si amea wɔ la me. Nya mamlɛawo

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nya geɖe le asinye, siwo medi be maŋlɔ aɖo ɖe mi hã la, nyemaŋlɔ wo ɖe agbalẽ dzi kple nuŋlɔtsi aɖo ɖe mi o. Le ema teƒe la, mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be nye ŋutɔ mava mia gbɔ ava gblɔ wo na mi ŋkume kple ŋkume, ale be mí katã míakpɔ dzidzɔ wòade edeƒe.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Nɔviwò nyɔnu, Mawu ƒe ame tiatia viwo, do gbe na wò nyuie.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye, miaƒe hamemegã la gbɔ. Mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe wò, Gayo lɔlɔ̃tɔ, ame si melɔ̃ le nyateƒe la me vevie la.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ, mele gbe dom ɖa be nu sia nu nadze edzi na wò nyuie, eye wò lã me hã nanɔ sesĩe. Menya be wò luʋɔ le tè sesĩe.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ, esime nɔvi xɔsetɔ aɖewo va gblɔ ale si nègalé nyateƒe la me ɖe asi kokoko, abe ale si nèlée ɖe asi xoxo ene la nam.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Esi mese be vinyewo le agbe nɔm le nyateƒe la nu la, mekpɔ dzidzɔ ŋutɔ. Wokafu Gayo

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ, èwɔa nuteƒe le subɔsubɔdɔ siwo nèwɔna na nɔviawo la me, vevietɔ na amedzrowo.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Wova gblɔ ale si nèlɔ̃ woe la na hame si le afii. Taflatsɛ, dze agbagba nàdo mɔ wo bene woagayi woƒe mɔzɔzɔ dzi, abe ale si dze le Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔ me la ene.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Elabe eƒe ŋkɔ la tae wodze mɔ ɖo, eye womexɔ naneke le trɔ̃subɔla aɖeke si o.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Ale edze be míakpe ɖe ame siawo tɔgbe ŋu be míaɖee afia be dɔ ɖeka wɔlawo míenye le nyateƒe la me. Diotrefo kple Demetrio

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Meŋlɔ agbalẽ ɖo ɖe hamea, ke Diotrefo ame si dina be yeatsɔ ye ɖokui awɔ woƒe nunɔlae la, mebum ɖe naneke me kura o.
