english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Nenye be meva ɖo la, magblɔ nya vlo siwo katã gblɔm wòle tso mía ŋu la na mi. Menye ema ɖeɖe ko o, ne nɔviawo va la, egbena be yemagaxɔ wo o. Gawu la, exea mɔ na ame siwo dina be yewoaxɔ wo la hã, eye wòɖe nɔvi siawo dometɔ aɖewo le hamea me.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔ, mègasrɔ̃ nuvɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ o, ke srɔ̃ nu nyui wɔwɔ boŋ. Ame si wɔa nu nyui la, nye Mawu tɔ; ame si wɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi la, medze si Mawu o.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ame sia ame ƒo nu nyui le Demetrio ŋu; nyateƒe la ŋutɔ kura gɔ̃ hã gblɔ eƒe nya nyui. Nye hã mele ɖase ɖim le eŋu, eye menya be nya si megblɔ la nye nyateƒe. Gbedoname

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be nya geɖe le asinye, medi be maŋlɔ aɖo ɖe wò hã la, nyematsɔ nuŋlɔti kple nuŋlɔtsi aŋlɔ woe o.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Mele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be míele go do ge kpuie, ne míaƒo nu tso wo ŋu ŋkume kple ŋkume.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa nenɔ kpli wò. Xɔ̃wòwo katã do gbe na wò nyuie. Medo gbe na mía xɔlɔ̃awo katã nyuie.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Agbalẽ sia tso nye Yuda, Yesu Kristo ƒe dɔla si nye Yakobo nɔvi la gbɔ. Mele eŋlɔm ɖo ɖe ame siwo Mawu yɔ. Mawu Tɔ́ la lɔ̃ ame siawo vevie, eye wòle wo ta kpɔm da ɖi na Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Ale si Mawu le nublanui kpɔm na mi, ŋutifafa si wòna mi kple ale si wòlɔ̃ mii la, negasẽ ŋu ɖe edzi wu. Aʋatsonufialawo

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, ɖe medi vevie be maŋlɔ agbalẽ na mi tso ale si Mawu xɔ mi katã ɖe agbe la ŋu hafi, ke didi bubu gava nyɔ le menye, be maŋlɔ agbalẽ sia na mi kaba ahatsɔ ado ŋusẽ mi, be miaʋli xɔse la ta. Xɔse siae Mawu tsɔ na eƒe ame siwo ŋu wòkɔ la, zi ɖeka ko ɖe ɣeyiɣiawo katã nu.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Elabe ame mavɔ̃mawu aɖewo va ge ɖe mía dome dzaa pɛ míenya o. Wotrɔ gbedeasi si míexɔ tso ale si mía Mawu la vea ame nui la ŋu bubui, bene wòasɔ ɖe woƒe agbe baɖa nɔnɔ nu. Ame siawo gbe míaƒe Nufialagã ɖeka hɔ̃ kple Aƒetɔ si nye Yesu Kristo la. Ẽ, Mawu ŋutɔ ɖoe da ɖi xoxo tso keke gbe aɖe gbe ke be yeabu fɔ ame siawo alea.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, togbɔ be mienya nu siawo katã keŋkeŋ xoxo hã la, medi be magaɖo ŋku wo dzi na mi be Mawu, ame si ŋutɔ ɖe Israel-dukɔ la tso Egipte-nyigba dzi la, tsrɔ̃ ame siwo mexɔ edzi se o la emegbe.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku edzi be mawudɔla siwo mewɔ ŋusẽ si wona wo ŋudɔ nyuie o, eye wodzo le woawo ŋutɔ nɔƒe la, wode kɔsɔkɔsɔ wo ɖikaa, eye eya ŋutɔ tsɔ wo da ɖe viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me, be woanɔ afi ma va se ɖe esime woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu abu fɔ wo le ŋkeke gã ma dzi.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Nenema ke miɖo ŋku Sodom kple Gomora kpakple du siwo ƒo xlã wo la hã dzi. Wo me nɔlawo nɔ agbe baɖa hewɔ ahasi vevie. Ale Mawu tsɔ dzo matsimatsi tɔ wo, be wòanye kpɔdzidze na amewo katã.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ame siawo kua drɔ̃e, eye wowɔa vɔ̃ ɖe woawo ŋutɔ gɔ̃ hã ƒe ŋutilã ŋu. Womeɖoa to ŋusẽ si ɖua wo dzi la o, eye wogblɔa nya vlowo ɖe nuwɔwɔ siwo dze bubu la ŋu.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Ke mawudɔlawo ƒe nunɔla Mixael kura gɔ̃ hã mewɔ nu sia tɔgbe o. Esime wònɔ dzre wɔm kple Abosam ɖe ame si akɔ Mose ƒe kukua ta la, Mixael megblɔ nya vlo aɖeke ɖe Abosam ŋu o. Ke nya si ko wògblɔ lae nye be, “Aƒetɔ la laka mo na wò!”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Ke ame siawo gblɔa nya vlowo ɖe nu sia nu si gɔme womese o la ŋu; nu siwo wonya tso dzɔdzɔme, abe ale si gbemelãwo hã nyae ene la, woawoe nye nu siwo tututu tsrɔ̃a wo.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Baba na wo! Woto Kain ƒe ʋe me. Le viɖe si woakpɔ ta la, woŋlɔ wo ɖokui be, eye woda vo abe Bileam ene. Wodze aglã abe Korax ene, eye wotsrɔ̃ nenema ke.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Ame siawo ƒe ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ va zu ɖi tá miaƒe lɔlɔ̃ si ƒoa ƒu mi ɖekae le miaƒe nuɖuƒewo. Ale si woawo ɖeɖe ko ƒe dzi nadze eme ko wodina. Wole abe alilikpo madzatsi, si ya le ƒoƒom la ene. Wosɔ kple ati siwo metsea ku le kutseɣi o, eye wòwɔ abe ɖe woho wo kple ke, eye woku gbidii ene.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: Wosɔ kple ƒu dzeagbo ƒe ƒutsotsoe, eye woƒe ŋukpenanuwɔwɔ le abe ƒutsotsoeawo ƒe futukpɔ ene. Ɣletivi siwo le tsatsam, eye Mawu dzra nɔƒe ɖo ɖi na wo ɖe viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me, be woanɔ afi ma tegbee lae wonye.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Ame siawo ŋutie Henox si nye Adam ƒe dzidzimevi adrẽlia ɖe gbeƒã le be, “Aƒetɔ la kple eƒe mawudɔla akpe nanewo gbɔna,

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: eye woava drɔ̃ ʋɔnu amewo katã. Woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame mavɔ̃mawuwo katã le nu baɖa, siwo katã wowɔ la ta.” Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu vɔ̃wɔla mavɔ̃mawuwo le nya baɖa, siwo wogblɔ ɖe Mawu ŋu la ta.

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Ame siawo lĩa liʋiliʋĩ ɣe sia ɣi hebua fɔ ame bubuwo. Wowɔa nu ɖe didi vɔ̃, si nyɔ le wo me la nu; wodoa wo ɖokui ɖe dzi, eye woblea ame ŋánaŋana be yewoakpɔ nu si dim yewole la. Nyagbename kple nuxlɔ̃amenyawo

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, ke miawo la, miɖo ŋku nya siwo mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo ƒe amedɔdɔwo gblɔ na mi gbe aɖe gbe ʋĩi la dzi.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ na mi be, “Le ŋkeke mamlɛawo me la, amewo lado, woaɖu fewu le mia ŋu, eye woawɔ nu sia nu si dzro wo la mawuvɔvɔ̃ manɔmee.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Woawoe nye ame siwo maa ame dome, ame siwo ƒe susu le xexe sia me nuwo ko ŋu; ame siwo me Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la mele o.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃tɔwo, ke miawo la, mina miaƒe xɔse si nye nu kɔkɔetɔ kekeake la natsi ɖe edzi. Mido gbe ɖa le Gbɔgbɔ Kɔkɔe la me.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Miɣla mia ɖokui ɖe Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ la me. Minɔ mɔ kpɔm na mía Aƒetɔ Yesu Kristo be wòakpɔ miaƒe nublanui, eye wòana miava nɔ agbe mavɔ.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nublanui na wo dometɔ siwo le ɖi kem.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Mihe ɖewo do goe tso dzo la me, ne miaxɔ wo ɖe agbe. Mikpɔ nublanui na ɖewo kple vɔvɔ̃. Milé fu awu siwo wodo gɔ̃ hã, elabe nuvɔ̃ɖi siwo woƒe ŋutilã dina la ƒo ɖi wo. Akpedada gbedodoɖa

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Mawu ɖeka hɔ̃, mía Xɔla, to Yesu Kristo mía Aƒetɔ dzi, eya koe míatsɔ bubu na, ahabui gãe; eya ko aɖu mía dzi ahakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe mía dzi ɣeyiɣiwo katã, tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me. Amen.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Esia nye Yesu Kristo ƒe ɖeɖefia si Mawu nae be wòaɖe afia eƒe dɔlawo le nu siwo le dzɔdzɔ ge kpuie la ŋuti. Kristo to eƒe mawudɔla dzi na eƒe dɔla Yohanes nya nu siawo.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Yohanes ɖi ɖase le nu siwo katã wòkpɔ la ŋu. Eɖi ɖase le Mawu ƒe nya la kple nya si do le Yesu Kristo nu la ŋu.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Woyra ame si xlẽ Mawu ƒe gbedeasi sia. Woyra ame siwo se nu si woxlẽ la, eye wowɔ nya si woŋlɔ ɖi la dzi la, elabe ɣeyiɣi la tu aƒe. Yohanes do gbe na hame adrẽawo

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Nye Yohanes ye le nya siawo ŋlɔm ɖo ɖe mi, hame adrẽ, siwo le Asia-nutome la be: Mawu si li fifia, si le anyi tso gbe aɖe gbe, eye wòle vava ge la neve mia nu, eye wòana ŋutifafa mi. Nenema ke gbɔgbɔ adrẽ siwo le tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ kple

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo, ɖaseɖila nyateƒetɔ si nye ame siwo Mawu fɔ tso ame kukuwo dome la ƒe ŋgɔdola, eye wònye anyigbadzifiawo hã dziɖula la, neve mia nu eye woana ŋutifafa mi. Eyama ame si lɔ̃ mí, eye wòɖe mí tso míaƒe nuvɔ̃wo me kple eƒe ʋu,

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: ame si ɖo fiaɖuƒe anyi na mí, eye wòwɔ mí nunɔlawoe, be míasubɔ yeƒe Mawu kple Tɔ́ la, tɔe nye ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Amen.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Mikpɔ ɖa, ele vava ge le alilikpowo dzi! Ame sia ame akpɔe! Ame siwo tsɔ nu ƒo ɖee hã le ekpɔ ge! Anyigbadzitɔwo katã lawó avi hoo ɖe eŋuti! Esia nye nyateƒe! Amen.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, si li fifia, si le anyi tso gbe aɖe gbe, eye wòle vava ge la gblɔ be: “Nyee nye Gbãtɔ ganye Mlɔetɔ.” Woɖe Kristo fia

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Nye Yohanes, mia nɔvi, ame si nɔ Yesu yome kpli mi, eye míedo dzi kpe fu le dzigbɔɖeanyi me le fiaɖuƒe la ta, lae le nya sia gblɔm. Menɔ ƒukpo si woyɔna be Patmos la dzi le Mawu ƒe nya la ta, be maɖi ɖase le Yesu ŋu.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Le Aƒetɔ la ƒe ŋkeke dzi la, Gbɔgbɔ la ɖo menye. Tete mese gbe aɖe ɖi le megbenye sesĩe abe kpẽkuku ene

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: be: “Ŋlɔ nu si nèkpɔ la ɖi, eye nàtsɔ agbalẽ la aɖo ɖe hame adrẽ, siwo le Efeso, Smirna, Pergamo, Tiatira, Sardis, Filadelfia kple Laodikea.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Metrɔ be makpɔ ame si le nu ƒom nam la ɖa. Kasia mekpɔ sikakaɖiti adrẽ.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Nane, si le abe amegbetɔ ene la le wo dome. Edo awu ʋlaya legbe, si ɖo afɔgɔme nɛ, eye wòbla edzi ɖe akɔta kple sikanudziblanu.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Eƒe ta kple taɖa fu tititi abe alẽfu ɣi alo tsikpe ene, eye eƒe ŋkuwo le abe dzo bibi ene.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: Eƒe afɔwo le keklẽm abe ga dzẽ si wode dzo me heƒã la ene, eye eƒe gbe le abe tsitsetse gã aɖe ƒe ɖiɖi ene.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Elé ɣletivi adrẽ ɖe nuɖusi; yi nuevee ɖaɖɛ do tso eƒe nu me, eye eƒe mo le keklẽm abe ŋdɔkutsu ene.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Esi mekpɔe la, medze anyi ɖe eƒe afɔnu hezu abe ame kuku ene. Ke etsɔ eƒe nuɖusi da ɖe dzinye gblɔ be: “Mègavɔ̃ o, nyee nye Gbãtɔ ganye Mlɔetɔ,

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: kple ame si le agbe. Meku kpɔ, ke azɔ la, mele agbe. Ku kple tsiẽƒe ƒe safuiwo le asinye.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ŋlɔ nu siwo nèkpɔ, esiwo li fifi kple esiwo le dzɔdzɔ ge emegbe la ɖi.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Nya ɣaɣla si le ɣletivi adrẽ siwo nèkpɔ le nye nuɖusi kple sikakaɖiti adrẽawo me lae nye esi: Ɣletivi adrẽawo nye hame adrẽawo ƒe mawudɔlawo, eye akaɖiti adrẽawo nye hame adrẽawo.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ŋlɔ nya sia ɖo ɖe Efeso-hamea ƒe mawudɔla be: “Ame si lé ɣletivi adrẽawo ɖe ɖusi, eye wòle zɔzɔm le sikakaɖiti adrẽawo dome la ƒe nyae nye esi.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Menya dɔ si nèwɔ. Menya ale si nèku kutri kple ale si nèdo dzi hekpe fui. Menya be mèlɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nya o. Èdo ame siwo yɔa wo ɖokui be amedɔdɔwo, ke womenye amedɔdɔwo o la kpɔ, eye nèdze sii be aʋatsokalawo wonye.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Menya ale si nègbɔ dzi blewuu, le dzi dom hele fu kpem le nye ŋkɔ la ta, eye ɖeɖi mete ŋuwò kpɔ o la.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Gake nya si le asinye ɖe ŋuwò lae nye be: mègalɔ̃m fifia, abe ale si nèlɔ̃m tsã ene o.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Eya ta ɖo ŋku teƒe si nège tso la dzi. Trɔ dzime, eye nàwɔ nu, abe ale si nèwɔna tsã la ene. Ne menye nenema o la, mava ɖe wò akaɖiti la ɖa le enɔƒe. Trɔ dzime godoo!

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Ke nu si dze ŋunye le ŋuwò lae nye be èlé fu Nikolaitɔwo ƒe nuwɔna, abe ale si nye hã melé fui ene.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Ame si to li na la, nese nu si gblɔm Gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo be: ‘Ame si ɖu dzi la, mana ati si naa agbe si le Mawu ƒe abɔ me la ƒe tsetsea ƒe ɖee wòaɖu.’ Gbedeasi na Smirna-hame la

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ŋlɔ nya sia ɖo ɖe Smirna-hamea ƒe mawudɔla be: “Ame si nye Gbãtɔ ganye Mlɔetɔ; ame si ku eye wògagbɔ agbe la ƒe nyae nye esi. Ebe:

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: ‘Menya wò fukpekpewo kple ale si nèda ahee. Evɔ wònye kesinɔtɔ nènye hafi. Menya nya vlo, siwo ame siwo gblɔna be yewonye Yudatɔwo, ke womenye Yudatɔwo o la gblɔna hegblẽa ŋuwò. Wole Abosam ƒe ƒuƒoƒometɔwo dome.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Mègavɔ̃ fu si kpe ge nàla kpuie la o. Kpɔ ɖa, Abosam le mia dome ame aɖewo de ge gaxɔ me, bene yeado mi akpɔ, eye miakpe fu ŋkeke ewo. Wɔ nuteƒe yi ɖase ɖe ku me gɔ̃ hã, eye mana agbe wò abe nye dziɖuɖufiakuku ene.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: “Ame si to li na la, nese nu si gblɔm Gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo be: ‘Ame si ɖu dzi la, ku evelia mawɔ nu vevi aɖekee o.’ Gbedeasi na Pergamo-hame la

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ŋlɔ nya sia ɖo ɖe Pergamo-hamea ƒe mawudɔla be: Ame si si yi nuevee ɖaɖɛ le la ƒe nyae nye esi be:

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: ‘Menya nɔwòƒe. Ele afi si Satana ƒe fiazikpui le. Èlé nye ŋkɔ ɖe asi sesĩe. Esime wowu Antipa, nye ɖaseɖila nyateƒetɔ la le mia dome, afi si Satana tso aƒe ɖo gɔ̃ hã la, mègbe nu le gbɔnye o; ègaxɔ dzinye se kokoko.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Gake nya ʋɛ aɖewo le asinye ɖe ŋuwò. Ame aɖewo le gbɔwò siwo lé Bileam ƒe nufiafia me ɖe asi. Evɔ la, Bileam siae ɖoe na Balak be wòatsɔ nuɖianu axe mɔ na Israelviwo, ale be woɖu nu si wotsɔ sa vɔe na trɔ̃wo, eye wowɔ ahasi.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Nenema ke mia dometɔ aɖewo hã dze Nikolaitɔwo hã ƒe nufiafia yome.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Eya ta trɔ dzime kpoo! Ne menye nenem o la, eteƒe madidi o mava gbɔwò eye matsɔ yi si le nye nu me la awɔ aʋa kple nenem me siawo.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Ame si to li na la, nese nu si gblɔm Gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo be: ‘Ame si ɖu dzi la, mana mana ɣaɣla la ƒe ɖee. Hekpe ɖe esia ŋu la, matsɔ kpe ɣi si dzi woŋlɔ ŋkɔ yeye ɖo la hã anae. Ame aɖeke menya ŋkɔ sia o, negbe ame si xɔe la ko.’ Gbedeasi na Tiatira-hame la

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ŋlɔ nya sia ɖo ɖe Tiatira-hamea ƒe mawudɔla be: Mawu Vi si ƒe ŋkuwo le abe dzo bibi ene, eye eƒe afɔwo le keklẽm abe ga dzẽ si woƒã ene la ƒe nyae nye esi be:

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: ‘Menya dɔ si nèwɔ. Menya wò lɔlɔ̃, wò xɔse, wò subɔsubɔ kple ale si nèdo dzi hekpe fui. Dɔ siwo wɔm nèle fifia la sẽ ŋu wu tsãtɔwo.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Gake nya si le asinye ɖe ŋuwò lae nye be èɖe mɔ na nyɔnu, Izebel ma, ame si yɔ eɖokui be Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela, eye wòle nu fiam nye dɔlawo hele wo blem be woawɔ ahasi, eye woaɖu nu si wotsɔ sa vɔe na trɔ̃wo.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Mena ɣeyiɣii be wòatrɔ dzime, ke egbe be yemadzudzɔ ahasiwɔwɔ o.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mana wòadze dɔ atsi aba dzi, eye ne ame siwo wɔ ahasi kplii la metrɔ tso eƒe nuvɔ̃ wɔwɔ gbɔ o la, mana woakpe fu ŋɔdzitɔe.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Mawù viawo eye hameawo katã lanya be nyee nye ame si dzroa ame ƒe dɔmenyawo kple dzimenyawo me tsitotsito. Maɖo eteƒe na mia dome ame sia ame ɖe eƒe nuwɔna nu.’

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: “Ke mi Tiatiratɔ bubu siwo mexɔ Izebel ƒe nufiafia la o, mi ame siwo mesrɔ̃ nu si yɔm wole be Satana ƒe nya ɣaɣla detowo o la, misee be nyemado agba bubu na mi o;

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: ɖeko milé nu si dzi miexɔ se la me ɖe asi sesĩe va se ɖe mava.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Ame si lé nye dɔme ɖe asi va se ɖe nuwuwu, eye wòɖu dzi la, mana ŋusẽe ɖe dukɔwo dzi.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Ame si to li na la, nese nu si gblɔm Gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: “Ŋlɔ nya sia ɖo ɖe Sardis-hamea ƒe mawudɔla be: Ame si si Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adrẽawo kple ɣletivi adrẽawo le la ƒe nyae nye esi be: ‘Menya dɔ si nèwɔ. Menya be èxɔ ŋkɔ be yele agbe, gake kpɔ ɖa, èku.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Nyɔ ne nàdo ŋusẽ nu si susɔ si be yeaku hafi la. Elabe mekpɔ be wò dɔwɔwɔwo mede blibo le nye Mawu ŋkume o.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Eya ta ɖo ŋku nu si wofia wò kple nu si nèse la dzi. Lé wo me ɖe asi, eye nàtrɔ dzime, elabe mèle ɣeyiɣi si mele gbɔwò va ge la nya ge o. Ne mèle ŋudzɔ o la, mava do ɖe dziwò abe fiafitɔ ene.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Ke ame ʋɛ aɖewo susɔ ɖe Sardis, ame siwo meƒo ɖi woƒe awuwo o. Woawo anɔ awu ɣi me azɔ kplim, elabe woawoe dze.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖu dzi la, woado awu ɣi nɛ nenema ke, eye nyematutu eƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le agbenɔlawo ƒe agbalẽ la me o. Maʋu eyama me le Tɔ́nye kple eƒe mawudɔlawo ŋkume kɔtɛe be enye tɔnye.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: “Ame si to li na la, nese nu si gblɔm Gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo. Gbedeasi na Filadelfia-hame la

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ŋlɔ nya sia ɖo ɖe Filadelfia-hamea ƒe mawudɔla be: Ame sia nye kɔkɔetɔ kple nyateƒetɔ si si David ƒe safuiwo le, ne eʋu ʋɔ la, ame aɖeke mate ŋu atui o; ne etui la, ame aɖeke mete ŋu ʋunɛ o. Eyae le gbɔgblɔm be:

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: ‘Menya dɔ si nèwɔ. Kpɔ ɖa, meɖo ʋɔtru si le ʋuʋu ɖi la ŋgɔwò si ame aɖeke mate ŋu atu o. Elabe togbɔ be ŋusẽ sue aɖe koe le asiwò hã la, èlé nye nya la me ɖe asi, eye mègbe nu le gbɔnye o.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, ame aɖewo li, siwo nye Satana ƒe ƒuƒoƒometɔwo. Ame siawo gblɔna be Yudatɔwo yewonye, evɔ la, womenye Yudatɔwo o; aʋatso kam wole. Kpɔ ɖa, woava dze klo ɖe wò afɔnu, eye wo katã woadze sii be melɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Esi nèwɔ nye nya dzi, do dzi hekpe fu ta la, nye hã maɖe wò tso dodokpɔ sesẽ si le xexea me katã dzi va ge, eye woado anyigbadzinɔlawo katã akpɔ la me.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Megbɔna. Lé nu si le asiwò la sesĩe, bene ame aɖeke nagaxɔ wò fiakuku la le asiwò o.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖu dzi la, mawɔe wòanye sɔti le nye Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ me. Anɔ afi ma tegbee, eye magado le eme akpɔ o. Maŋlɔ nye Mawu ŋkɔ kple nye Mawu ƒe du si nye Yerusalem yeye, si ɖi tso dziƒo nye Mawu gbɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe eŋu. Maŋlɔ nye ŋutɔ nye ŋkɔ yeye la hã ɖe eŋu.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: “Ame si to li na la, nese nu si gblɔm Gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo. Gbedeasi na Laodikea-hame la

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Ŋlɔ nya sia ɖo ɖe Laodikea-hamea ƒe mawudɔla be: Ame si nye Amen, nuteƒewɔla kple ɖaseɖila nyateƒetɔ, ame si nye nu siwo Mawu wɔ la ƒe dzɔtsoƒe ƒe nyae nye esi be:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: ‘Menya dɔ si nèwɔ. Mèfa o; mèxɔ dzo hã o. Medi be nàfa alo nàxɔ dzo.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Ke esi nèle yɔyrɔe: mèfa o, eye mèxɔ dzo hã o ta la, matu wò aƒu gbe tso nye nu me.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Ègblɔna be: Kesinɔtɔ menye, nu le asinye eye nyemehiã naneke o. Ke mèdze sii be hiãtɔ, nublanuitɔ, ame dahe, ŋkuagbãtɔ kple ame si le amama lae yenye o.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Mele aɖaŋu ɖom na wò be nàƒle sika nyuitɔ, si wololo le dzo me le asinye be nàzu kesinɔtɔ. Ƒle avɔ ɣi hã nàta be wò ŋukpeƒe nagadze o. Ƒle ŋkutike nàsi ɖe wò ŋku dzi ne nàkpɔ nu.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ame siwo melɔ̃ la, woawoe mekaa mo na, eye woawo hãe mehea to na. Eya ta wɔ kaba nàtrɔ dzime.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mele tsitre ɖe ʋɔa nu le eƒom. Ne ame aɖe se nye gbe, eye wòʋu ʋɔa la, mage ɖe eme le egbɔ. Nye kplii míade asi agba ɖeka me aɖu nu.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖu dzi la, mana wòanɔ axanye le nye fiazikpui la dzi abe ale si nye hã meɖu dzi, eye mebɔbɔ nɔ Tɔ́nye xa le eƒe fiazikpui dzii ene.’

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Ame si to li na la, nese nu si gblɔm Gbɔgbɔ la le na hameawo.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Esiawo megbe la, kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ ʋɔtru aɖe, le ʋuʋu le dziƒo! Gbe si ɖi mese gbã abe kpẽkuku ene, eye wòƒo nu nam va yi la, gblɔ be: “Va dziƒo afii, ne maɖe nu siwo le dzɔdzɔ ge emegbe la afia wò.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Enumake gbɔgbɔ la ɖo menye, eye kasia mekpɔ fiazikpui aɖe le dziƒo si dzi ame aɖe bɔbɔ nɔ.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi la le dzo dam abe yaspa kple sardis kpe xɔasiwo ene, eye anyieʋɔ si le abe emeraldkpe ene la ƒo xlã fiazikpui la.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Fiazikpui bla eve vɔ ene bubuwo ƒo xlã fiazikpui sia, eye ametsitsi bla eve vɔ ene, siwo do awu ɣi, eye woɖɔ sikafiakukuwo la bɔbɔ nɔ zikpui siawo dzi.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Dzikedzo, dziɖegbe kple gbeɖiɖiwo le dodom tso fiazikpui la me. Akakati adrẽ le bibim le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ. Esiawo nye Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adrẽawo.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Azɔ, le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ la, nane li abe atsiaƒu si wotsɔ ahuhɔ̃e kɔkɔetɔ wɔ la ene. Eme kɔ lalalã. Nugbagbe ene, siwo ŋkuwo sɔ gbɔ le megbe kple ŋgɔgbe na fũu la le fiazikpui la ƒe axa ɖe sia ɖe dzi.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Nugbagbe gbãtɔ le abe dzata ene, evelia le abe nyitsu ene, etɔ̃lia ƒe mo nye amegbetɔ tɔ, eye enelia le abe hɔ̃ si le dzodzom la ene.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Aʋala ade li na nugbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe, eye ŋkuwo yɔ wo me kple wo ŋuti afi sia afi kpe ɖo. Wole hadzidzi dzi zã kple keli madzudzɔmadzudzɔe be: “Aƒetɔ Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la le kɔkɔe ele kɔkɔe, ele kɔkɔe! Ele anyi tso gbe aɖe gbe ke, eli fifia, eye wòle vava ge.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ɣe sia ɣi, ne nugbagbeawo tsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe, bubu kple akpedada na ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi, eye wòle agbe tegbee la ko la,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “Mía Aƒetɔ kple mía Mawu, ŋutikɔkɔe bubu kple ŋusẽ dze na wò, elabe wòe wɔ nuwo katã. Èwɔ wo abe ale si nèdi la ene, eye wole te le wò lɔlɔ̃nu nu.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Esia yome la, mekpɔ agbalẽ aɖe, si fiazikpuidzinɔla la lé ɖe nuɖusi. Woŋlɔ nu ɖe agbalẽa me kple egodo siaa eye wotre enu kple nutrenu adrẽ.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mawudɔla sesẽ aɖe wòle gbeƒã ɖem sesĩe be: “Ame kae dze aɖe nutrenuawo ɖa, eye wòaʋu agbalẽ la?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Ke womekpɔ ame aɖeke le dziƒo alo le anyigba dzi alo le anyigba te si te ŋu ʋu agbalẽ la alo te ŋu kpɔ eme o.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Mefa avi vevie, elabe womekpɔ ame aɖeke si dze aʋu agbalẽa alo akpɔ eme o.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Tete ametsitsiawo dometɔ ɖeka gblɔ nam be: “Mègafa avi o. Kpɔ ɖa, Dzata si tso Yuda-to la me, eye wònye David ƒe dzidzimevi la ɖu dzi be wòaɖe nutrenu adrẽawo ɖa, eye wòaʋu agbalẽ la.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mekpɔ alẽvi aɖe le tsitre ɖe fiazikpui la titina le nugbagbe eneawo dome, eye ametsitsiawo ƒo xlã wo. Edzé abe ɖe wowu alẽvi la ene. Dzo adrẽ kple ŋku adrẽ li nɛ. Dzo siawoe nye Mawu ƒe gbɔgbɔ adrẽ, siwo wòɖo ɖe xexea me katã.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Alẽvi la zɔ yi ɖaxɔ agbalẽ la le ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la si.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Wodzi ha yeye aɖe be: “Wòe dze axɔ agbalẽ la, aɖe nutrenuawo ɖa vavã! Elabe wòe wowu, eye nètsɔ wò ʋu xɔ amegbetɔ ƒle hena Mawu. Wotso to sia to, gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ, dukɔ sia dukɔ kple amegbetɔƒomea katã me.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: Èwɔ wo wozu nunɔlawo ƒe fiaɖuƒe na mía Mawu, eye woaɖu dzi le anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Kasia mebe magakpɔ la, mese mawudɔla akpeakpe, siwo wu xexlẽ la ƒe gbe le ɖiɖim ƒo xlã fiazikpuia, nugbagbe eneawo kple ametsitsiawo.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm sesĩe be: “Alẽvi si wowu la, eyae dze axɔ ŋusẽ, kesinɔnu, nunya, ŋutete, bubu, ŋutikɔkɔe kple kafukafu!”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Tete mese Mawu ƒe nuwɔwɔ ɖe sia ɖe, si le dziƒo kple anyigba dzi, le anyigba te, le atsiaƒu me kple nu siwo katã le wo me la le gbɔgblɔm be: “Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi kple Alẽvi la tɔe nye kafukafu, bubu, ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋutete tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me!”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Nugbagbe eneawo xɔ ɖe edzi be: “Amen!” Tete ametsitsiawo tsyɔ mo anyi, eye wosubɔe.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mekpɔ Alẽvi la wòɖe nutrenu adrẽawo dometɔ gbãtɔ ɖa. Tete mese nugbagbeawo dometɔ ɖeka ƒo nu abe dzie ɖe gbe ene gblɔ be: “Va!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, mekpɔ sɔ ɣi aɖe. Edola lé dati ɖe asi, eye wotsɔ fiakuku aɖe nɛ. Edo go abe dziɖula ene, eye wòyi be yeaɖaɖu dzi.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Emegbe la, Alẽvi la ɖe nutrenu evelia ɖa, eye mese nugbagbe evelia gblɔ be: “Va!”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Sɔ bubu do. Ebiã hẽe. Woɖe mɔ na edola be wòaɖe ŋutifafa ɖa le anyigba dzi, ale be amewo nawu wo nɔewo, eye wotsɔ yi gã aɖe nɛ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Alẽvi la ɖe nutrenu etɔ̃lia ɖa, eye mese nugbagbe etɔ̃lia gblɔ be: “Va!” Kpɔ ɖa, sɔ yibɔ aɖe do. Edola lé nudanu ɖe asi.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Mese gbe aɖe abe nugbagbe eneawo dome wòɖi tso ene gblɔ be: “Lu nudzidzenu ɖeka naxɔ sikaga ɖeka, eye ƒo nudzidzenu etɔ̃ naxɔ sikaga ɖeka, ke mègagblẽ ami kple wain o!”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Esia yome la, Alẽvi la ɖe nutrenu enelia ɖa, eye mese nugbagbe enelia gblɔ be: “Va!”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, sɔ flukpe aɖe do. Edola la ŋkɔe nye Ku, eye Tsiẽƒe le eyome. Wona ŋusẽ wo ɖe xexea me ƒe akpa enelia dzi be woatsɔ aʋawɔwɔ, dɔwuame, dɔ vɔ̃ kpakple lã wɔadãwo awu amewoe.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Esi Alẽvia ɖe nutrenu atɔ̃lia ɖa la, mekpɔ ame siwo wowu le Mawu ƒe nya la kple ale si woɖi ɖase le eŋuti la ta la ƒe luʋɔwo le vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli sesĩe be: “Aƒetɔ dziɖula, kɔkɔetɔ kple nyateƒetɔ, ɣe ka ɣi koŋ nèle ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge ame siwo wu mí le anyigba dzi, eye nàbia hlɔ̃ na mí mahã?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ awu ɣi ʋlaya na wo dome ame sia ame, eye wogblɔ na wo be woagalala ʋɛ, va se ɖe esime woatsɔ wo havi subɔlawo kple wo nɔvi siwo wu ge woala, abe woawo ke ene la ƒe xexlẽme akpe ɖe wo tɔ ŋu, ale be xexlẽmea nade.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mekpɔ Alẽvi la wòɖe nutrenu adelia la ɖa. Kpɔ ɖa, anyigba ʋuʋu sesĩe. Ɣe trɔ zu yibɔ hele abe avɔ yibɔ ƒlatsa ene; ɣleti trɔ zu abe ʋu ene.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Ɣletiviwo ge dze anyi, abe ale si atikutsetse gbogbowo duduna ɖe anyigba ne ya sesẽ ƒo ene.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Dziŋgɔli bu vĩ zi ɖeka abe ale si woŋlɔa agbalẽ ene, eye woɖe to kple ƒukpo ɖe sia ɖe ɖa le enɔƒe.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzifiawo, dziɖulawo, aʋakplɔlagãwo, kesinɔtɔwo, ŋusẽtɔwo kple ame bubuwo katã, kluviwo kple ablɔɖeviwo siaa ɣla wo ɖokui ɖe agadowo me kple agakpe siwo le towo dome la te.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ na towo kple agakpewo be: “Mimu dze mía dzi, ne miaɣla mí tso ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi la ŋkume kple Alẽvi la ƒe dziku nu,

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: elabe woƒe dɔmedzoe ŋkeke dziŋɔ la ɖo. Ame kae ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe enu?”

english_verse: from Benjamin. People from Every Nation
translation_verse: siwo wotia le Israel

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: gblɔ be: “Migawɔ nu vevi anyigba, atsiaƒu alo atiwo o, va se ɖe esime míatsɔ nutrenu la ade dzesi ŋgonu na míaƒe Mawu la ƒe dɔlawo gbɔ.”

english_verse: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
translation_verse: Tete woyɔ ame siwo wode dzesii kple nutrenuawo tso Israel ƒe toawo katã me la ƒe xexlẽme mese. Eyae nye ame akpe alafa ɖeka bla ene vɔ ene.

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: gblɔ be: “Amen! Kafukafu, ŋutikɔkɔe, nunya, akpedada, bubu, ŋusẽ kple ŋutete nanye mía Mawu la tɔ tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me! Amen!”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mekpɔ ameha gã aɖe, si ame aɖeke mate ŋu axlẽ o la. Wotso amegbetɔƒomea katã me. Wotso to sia to, dukɔ sia dukɔ kple gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ me, eye wodze ŋgɔ fiazikpui la kple Alẽvi la. Wo katã wodo awu ɣi ʋlaya, eye wolé deʋayawo ɖe asi.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm kple ɣli sesĩe be: “Mía Mawu si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpui la dzi kple Alẽvi la koe xɔa ame ɖe agbe!”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Mawudɔlawo katã tsi tsitre ƒo xlã fiazikpui la kple ametsitsiawo kpakple nugbagbe eneawo, eye wo katã wotsyɔ mo anyi ɖe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ, hesubɔ Mawu

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Ame tsitsiawo dometɔ ɖeka biam se be: “Ame kawoe nye esiawo le awu ɣi ʋlaya me? Afi ka wotso?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Meɖo eŋu be: “Nye Aƒetɔ, nyemenya o. Wòa ènya.” Egblɔ nam be: “Woawoe nye ame siwo to fukpekpe dziŋɔ la me do dedie. Wonya woƒe awuwo, wofu tititi le Alẽvi la ƒe ʋu me.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Eya tae wole tsitre ɖe Mawu ƒe fiazikpui la ŋgɔ le eƒe gbedoxɔ me le esubɔm zã kple keli. Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la, ana woanɔ dedie le eŋkume.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Dɔ alo tsikɔ megale wo wu ge akpɔ o. Ɣe alo ŋdɔkutsu megale wo ɖu ge akpɔ o.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Alẽvi si le fiazikpui la titina la nye wo kplɔla. Akplɔ wo ayi afi si tsi si naa agbe le dzidzim le la, eye Mawu atutu aɖatsi le ŋkume na wo.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Esi Alẽvi la ɖe nutrenu adrẽlia ɖa la, ɖoɖoe si kpoo le dziƒo abe gaƒoƒo afã ene.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Emegbe mekpɔ mawudɔla adrẽ le tsitre le Mawu ŋkume, eye wotsɔ kpẽ adrẽ de wo si.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla bubu si tsɔ sikadzudzɔdonu ɖe asi la va tsi tsitre ɖe vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ. Wotsɔ atike ʋeʋẽe geɖe nɛ be wòatsɔ akpe ɖe Mawu ƒe amewo katã ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu aɖo sika vɔsamlekpui si le fiazikpuia ŋgɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Atike ʋeʋẽe, si wotɔ dzoe la ƒe dzudzɔ tu kpe ɖe Mawu ƒe amewo ƒe gbedodoɖawo ŋu, tso mawudɔla si le tsitre ɖe Mawu ŋkume la ƒe asiwo me yi dzi.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Emegbe la, mawudɔla la ɖe dzo tso vɔsamlekpui la me de dzudzɔdonu la me, eye wòtsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba dzi. Tete dzi ɖe gbe sesĩe, gbeɖiɖiwo ɖi, dzi ke dzo, eye anyigba ʋuʋu. Kpẽwo kuku

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Tete mawudɔla adrẽ, siwo si kpẽ adrẽawo le la dzra ɖo be yewoaku kpẽawo.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla gbãtɔ la ku eƒe kpẽ. Tete tsikpe kple dzo tɔtɔ kple ʋu kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi. Anyigba ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia fiã; ati siwo le anyigba dzi la ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kple gbe mumuwo keŋ fiã.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Mawudɔla evelia ku etɔ. Tete wotsɔ nane si le abe to gã aɖee le dzo bim ene la ƒu gbe ɖe atsiaƒu me.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia trɔ zu ʋu; nugbagbe siwo katã le atsiaƒu me la ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia ku, eye tɔdziʋuwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia gblẽ gbidii.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla etɔ̃lia ku eƒe kpẽ la, eye ɣletivi gã aɖe, si le keklẽm abe akakati ene la, ge tso dziƒo va dze tɔsisiwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kple tsidzidziwo me.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Woyɔa ɣletivi la be Gbeveve. Tsiwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia trɔ zu tsi veve. Tsi sia wu ame geɖewo, elabe etrɔ zu aɖi.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla enelia ku eƒe kpẽ. Tete woƒo ɣe ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia, ɣleti ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kple ɣletiviwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia ale be woƒe keklẽ ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia do viviti. Esia wɔe be ŋkeke ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia kple zã hã ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia megakpɔ kekeli o.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mekpɔ hɔ̃ aɖe wòle dzodzom le ya me ʋĩi, eye mese wònɔ gbɔgblɔm sesĩe be: “Baba, baba, baba na anyigbadzinɔlawo! Kpẽ bubu, siwo mawudɔla etɔ̃, siwo susɔ gale kuku ge la tɔ vɔ̃ɖi wu!”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mawudɔla atɔ̃lia ku eƒe kpẽ. Tete mekpɔ ɣletivi aɖe, wòge tso dziƒo va dze anyigba dzi. Wotsɔ aʋlimesafuiwo de esi.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Eʋu aʋlimegbo la, eye dzudzɔ tu tso eme kɔtɔɔ abe kpodzo gã aɖe mee wòdo tso ene. Ale ɣe ŋkume kple ya me tsyɔ kplo, le dzudzɔ si tu tso aʋlime la ta.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Ʋetsuviwo dudu tso dzudzɔ la me ɖe anyigba, eye wona aɖi sinu sẽ abe dziɖegbe tɔ ene la ʋetsuviawo.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ na wo be womegagblẽ gbe, ati alo numiemiewo o, ke boŋ be woawɔ nu vevi ame siwo ƒe ŋgonu Mawu ƒe dzesi la mele o la.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Woɖe mɔ na ʋetsuviawo be woafia fu ame siawo ɣleti atɔ̃, ke womegawu wo ya o. Ne woté ame la, evena abe ale si dziɖegbe téa ame wòvenae ene.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Le ɣleti atɔ̃ siawo me la, ame adi ku, gake makpɔe o; adzroe vevie be yeaku, ke ku así le egbɔ.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Ʋetsuviawo ƒe dzedzeme le abe sɔ siwo wobla akpa na hena aʋawɔwɔ la ene. Nane le ta na wo abe sikafiakuku ene, eye woƒe mo le abe ame tɔ ene.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Woƒe ɖa ɖi nyɔnu tɔ, eye woƒe aɖu le abe dzata tɔ ene.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Wo ŋu tsro le abe gakɔtakpoxɔnu ene. Woƒe aʋalawo me le ɖiɖim abe ale si tasiaɖam kple sɔ geɖewo nɔa du dzi yina aʋakpeƒe ene.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Woƒe asikɛ kple té le abe dziɖegbe tɔ ene, eye woƒe asikɛawo me ŋusẽ si woatsɔ awɔ nu vevi ame ɣleti atɔ̃ la le.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Fia le wo nu. Eyae nye mawudɔla si le aʋlime nu. Eŋkɔe nye Abadon le Hebri-gbe me, eye woyɔnɛ le Hela-gbe me be Apolion.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Fuwɔame dziŋɔ gbãtɔ nu va yi. Kpɔ ɖa, esusɔ eve bubu siwo gale megbe gbɔna.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla adelia ku eƒe kpẽ la. Tete mese gbe aɖe ɖi tso sikavɔsamlekpui si le Mawu ŋkume la ƒe lãdzo eneawo me.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Gbe la gblɔ na mawudɔla adelia, si si kpẽ la le la be: “Tu ka mawudɔla ene, siwo wobla da ɖe Frat-tɔsisi gã la to la.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ale wotu ka mawudɔla eneawo. Wodzra wo ɖo eye wole klalo na gaƒoƒo la, ŋkeke la, ɣleti la kple ƒè la, ne woawu amegbetɔwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Mese be sɔdolawo ƒe aʋakɔ ƒe xexlẽme le akpe ewo teƒe ewo teƒe eve.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ale si mekpɔ sɔawo kple wo dolawo le ŋutega la mee nye esi: Wodo akɔtakpoxɔnu. Ɖewo biã abe dzoxɔxɔ ene, ɖewo le kpii abe safirkpe ene, eye bubuwo hã le hẽe abe sulfa ene. Sɔawo ƒe ta le abe dzata tɔ ene, eye dzo, dzudzɔ kple dzokpe le dodom tso woƒe nu me.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ fuwɔame etɔ̃, siwo nye dzo, dzudzɔ kple dzokpe si do tso sɔawo ƒe nu me la wu amegbetɔwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ si le sɔawo si la le woƒe nu me kple asikɛ me. Woƒe asikɛ le abe da ene, eye ta li na wo. Woawoe wotsɔna wɔa nu vevi amee.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã susɔ ɖi, siwo fuwɔame siawo mewu o la metrɔ le nu si woawo ŋutɔ wotsɔ asi wɔe la subɔsubɔ yome o. Womedzudzɔ gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo, sika kple klosalo, ga dzẽ kple ati kpakpɛ, siwo mekpɔa nu alo sea nu alo zɔa azɔli o la subɔsubɔ o.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Wometrɔ dzime tso woƒe amewuwu, afakaka, ahasiwɔwɔ kple fififi gbɔ o.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Emegbe la, mekpɔ mawudɔla sesẽ bubu aɖe ɖi tso dziƒo. Ele alilikpowo dome, eye anyieʋɔ ƒo xlã eƒe ta. Eƒe mo le abe ɣe ene, eye eƒe afɔwo le abe dzosɔtiwo ene.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Elé agbalẽvi aɖe, si le ʋuʋu la ɖe asi. Etsɔ eƒe nuɖusifɔ ɖo atsiaƒu dzi, eye wòtsɔ miafɔ ɖo anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Tete wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ abe dzata ƒe gbeɖeɖe ene. Esi wòdo ɣli la, dziɖegbe adrẽawo ƒe gbe ɖi.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Esi dziɖegbe adrẽawo ɖe gbe la, medi be maŋlɔ nu ɖi; ke mese gbe aɖe ɖi tso dziƒo gblɔ be: “Tre nu si dziɖegbe adrẽawo gblɔ la nu, eye mègaŋlɔe ɖi o.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Tete mawudɔla si mekpɔ wòle tsitre ɖe anyigba kple atsiaƒu dzi la do eƒe nuɖusibɔ ɖe dziƒo, eye

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: wòka atam le Mawu ame si li tegbee, si wɔ dziƒo kple emenuwo, anyigba kple edzinuwo, atsiaƒu kple emenuwo ƒe ŋkɔ me gblɔ be: “Hehe ɖe megbe aɖeke maganɔ anyi o.

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Ke ne mawudɔla adrẽlia ku eƒe kpẽ la, ekema Mawu ƒe ɖoɖo ɣaɣla si wòɖe gbeƒãe na eƒe dɔla siwo nye eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo la lava va eme.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Azɔ gbe si mese tso dziƒo la gaƒo nu nam ake gblɔ be: “Yi nàxɔ agbalẽvi si le ʋuʋu le mawudɔla si le tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu kple anyigba dzi la si.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Ale meyi ɖe mawudɔla la gbɔ, eye megblɔ nɛ be wòatsɔ agbalẽvi la nam. Egblɔ nam be: “Xɔe, nàɖui. Ele veve ge le dɔme na wò, ke avivi le wò nu me abe anyitsi ene.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Mexɔ agbalẽvi la le esi heɖu. Evivi le nye nu me abe anyitsi ene, ke esi memii la, eve le dɔme nam.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be: “Ele na wò be nàgaɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi le dukɔ geɖewo, amegbetɔƒomea, gbegbɔgblɔwo kple fia geɖewo ŋu.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Ke mègadzidze xɔxɔnu si le mawuxɔa ŋu la o, elabe wotsɔe na trɔ̃subɔlawo. Woawoe le afɔ tu ge du kɔkɔe la dzi nyamanyama ɣleti bla ene vɔ eve.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Mana ŋusẽ nye ɖaseɖila eve woanɔ akpanya me, aɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la le ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eve bla ade me.”

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Ɖaseɖila eveawoe nye amiti eve kple akaɖiti eve, siwo le anyigba ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋkume.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ne futɔ aɖe be yeawɔ nu vevi wo la, dzo dona tso woƒe nu me tsrɔ̃a wo. Ne ame aɖe adi be yeawɔ nu vevi wo la, aleae wole ewu gee.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le wo si be esime wole gbeƒã ɖem Mawu ƒe gbedeasi la, woaxe dziƒo nu be tsi magadza o. Wokpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe tsiwo hã dzi be woatrɔ wo woazu ʋu, eye be woahe fuwɔame ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ava anyigba dzi, edziedzi abe ale si wodi la ene.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Ne wowu woƒe ɖaseɖiɖi la nu vɔ la, ekema lã si do tso aʋlime la awɔ aʋa kpli wo. Aɖu wo dzi, eye wòawu wo.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: Woƒe ŋutilã kukuawo atsi dugã si ƒe ŋkɔ ɣaɣlae nye “Sodom kple Egipte” la ƒe ablɔwo dzi. Afi siae woklã woƒe Aƒetɔ la ɖe atitsoga ŋu le.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã me la, amewo atso dukɔ sia dukɔ, to sia to, gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kple amegbetɔƒomea me ava nɔ woƒe kukua kpɔm, eye womaɖe mɔ be woaɖi wo o.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzinɔlawo akpɔ dzidzɔ le ame eve siawo ƒe ku ŋuti. Woatso aseye eye woaɖo nunana ɖe wo nɔewo, elabe Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela eve siawo he fukpekpe geɖe va anyigbadzinɔlawo dzi.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã megbe la, ya si naa agbe la tso Mawu gbɔ va ge ɖe wo me, eye wofɔ ɖe tsitre! Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo ame siwo katã kpɔ wo la ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, ɖaseɖila eveawo se gbe sesẽ aɖe ɖi tso dziƒo gblɔ na wo be: “Miva afii!” Ale le woƒe futɔwo ŋkume wonɔ alilikpo aɖe me yi dziƒo.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Ɣe ma ɣi tututu la, anyigba ʋuʋu sesĩe, du la ƒe akpa ewolia gbã gudugudu. Ame akpe adrẽ ku le anyigbaʋuʋu la me. Vɔvɔ̃ ɖo ame mamlɛawo, eye wokafu Mawu si le dziƒo la.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Fuwɔame dziŋɔ evelia va yi; kpɔ ɖa, etɔ̃lia gbɔna fifi laa. Kpẽ adrẽlia kuku

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Azɔ, mawudɔla adrẽlia ku eƒe kpẽ, eye gbe sesẽwo ɖi le dziƒo be: “Xexe sia me ƒe fiaɖuƒe la zu mía Aƒetɔ kple eƒe Kristo la ƒe fiaɖuƒe, eye aɖu dzi tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me!”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: gblɔ be: “Aƒetɔ Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, ame si li, eye wòle anyi tso gbe aɖe gbe! Míeda akpe na wò, be nèwɔ wò ŋusẽ triakɔ la ŋudɔ, eye nèɖo wò fiaɖuƒe la gɔme anyi.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Dzi ku trɔ̃subɔlawo, ke ɣeyiɣi la de, be nàɖe wò dɔmedzoe afia, eye wòɖo edzi, be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame kukuwo. Eɖo edzi hã be nàxe fe na wò dɔlawo, gbeƒãɖelawo, ame siwo ŋu wokɔ kple ame siwo vɔ̃a wò ŋkɔ la, amegãwo kple ame bubuwo katã. Ɣeyiɣi la de, be woatsrɔ̃ ame siwo gblẽ anyigbaa la!”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe xɔ si le dziƒo la nu ʋu, eye wokpɔ eƒe nubablaɖaka la le gbedoxɔ la me. Kasia dzi ke dzo, gbeɖiɖiwo ɖi, dzi ɖe gbe, anyigba ʋuʋu, eye tsikpe gãwo dza vevie.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Fu le nyɔnua ƒo. Fu la le eɖum, eye le veve si sem wòle ta la, ele ɣli dom sesĩe.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Nu wɔnuku bubu aɖe hã gado ɖe dziŋgɔli me. Kpɔ ɖa, enye ʋɔdriba lolo dzẽ aɖe. Ta adrẽ li nɛ, eto dzo ewo, eye wòɖɔ fiakuku adrẽ.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe asikɛ kplɔ ɣletiviwo ƒe akpa etɔ̃lia tso dziƒo ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba dzi. Azɔ ʋɔdriba la tsi tsitre dze ŋgɔ nyɔnu si ɖum fu le la, be ne edzi via ko la, yeatsɔ ɖevia ami.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la dzi ŋutsuvi. Eyae nye ame si atsɔ gatikplɔ aɖu dukɔwo katã dzii. Tete wokɔ ɖevi la enumake yi Mawu kple eƒe fiazikpui la gbɔ.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Ke nyɔnu la sí yi gbedadaƒo, afi si Mawu dzra teƒe ɖo ɖi nɛ le, be woakpɔ edzi ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eve bla ade.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Azɔ aʋa dzɔ le dziƒo. Mixael kple eƒe dɔlawo ho aʋa ɖe ʋɔdriba la ŋu, eye ʋɔ driba la kple eƒe dɔlawo kpe aʋa kpli wo.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Woɖu ʋɔdriba la kple eƒe dɔlawo dzi, eye teƒe aɖeke megale dziƒo na eya kple eƒe dɔlawo woaganɔ o.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Ale woda ʋɔdriba gã la ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba dzi. Eyae nye da xoxo si xɔ ŋkɔ be: Abosam kple Satana, si ble xexeme blibo la. Eya kple eƒe dɔlawoe woda ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Azɔ mese gbe aɖe ɖi sesĩe le dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Mawu xɔ ame ɖe agbe azɔ! Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ kple fiaɖuɖu do! Eƒe Kristo la ƒe ŋusẽ do! Elabe wotsɔ ame si nɔa mía nɔviwo nu tsom zã kple keli na Mawu la, ƒu gbe tso dziƒo.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Woɖu edzi to Alẽvi la ƒe ʋu kple nyateƒenya si woɖe gbeƒãe la me, elabe wolɔ̃ faa be yewoaku, eye womebu woƒe agbe nu vevi o.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Eya ta dzi nedzɔ mi, dziƒowo kple mi afi ma nɔlawo. Ke baba na mi, anyigba kple atsiaƒu! Elabe Abosam ɖi va mia dome kple dziku. Ẽ, enyae be ɣeyiɣi ʋɛ aɖe koe susɔ na ye!”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Esi ʋɔdriba la kpɔ be woda ye ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba dzi la, eti nyɔnu si dzi ŋutsuvi la yome.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ke wotsɔ hɔ̃ gã aɖe ƒe aʋala eve na nyɔnu la be wòadzo, así le ʋɔdriba la gbɔ ayi gbedadaƒo, afi si woanyii le ƒe etɔ̃ kple afã, ale be wòavo tso esi me.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Tete ʋɔdriba la tu tsi si sí abe tɔsisi ene ɖo ɖe nyɔnua yome bene tsia nalée.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Ke anyigba xɔ na nyɔnu la. Anyigba ke nu heno tsi si ʋɔdriba la tu ɖo ɖa la katã.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Tete ʋɔdriba la do dziku vevie ɖe nyɔnu la ŋu, eye wòdzo yi be yeaɖawɔ aʋa kple eƒe dzidzimevi siwo susɔ ɖi la. Woawoe nye ame siwo katã wɔa Mawu ƒe sededewo dzi, eye wolé nyateƒenya si woɖe fia wo le Yesu ŋuti la me ɖe asi anukwaretɔe la.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Tete ʋɔdriba la tsi tsitre ɖe ƒua ta.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mekpɔ lãfɔne aɖe wòle dodom tso atsiaƒu la me. Dzo ewo, ta adrẽ li nɛ, eye fiakuku le dzoawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe dzi. Woŋlɔ busuŋkɔwo ɖe eƒe taawo ŋu.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Lã si mekpɔ la le abe lãkle ene. Eƒe afɔwo le abe sisiblisi tɔwo ene, eye eƒe nu le abe dzata tɔ ene. Ʋɔdriba la tsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋusẽ, eƒe fiazikpui kple dziɖuŋusẽ gã la na lã sia.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Lã la ƒe tawo dometɔ ɖeka dzé abe kubi wode eŋu ene, ke abia ku nɛ. Anyigbadzitɔwo katã ƒe mo wɔ yaa, eye wokplɔ lã la ɖo.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Amewo subɔ ʋɔdriba la, elabe etsɔ ŋusẽ si le esi na lã sia. Wosubɔ lã la gblɔ be: “Ame kae le abe lã sia ene? Ame kae ate ŋu awɔ aʋa kplii?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Woɖe mɔ na lã la be wòagblɔ dàdanya kple busunya geɖewo, eye wòaɖu dzi ɣleti bla ene vɔ eve.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Eke nu gblɔ busunya ɖe Mawu, eƒe ŋkɔ la, eƒe nɔƒe kple ame siwo katã le dziƒo la ŋu.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Woɖe mɔ nɛ hã be wòawɔ aʋa kple ame siwo ŋu wokɔ, eye wòaɖu wo dzi. Wogana ŋusẽe ɖe to sia to kple dukɔ sia dukɔ, gbegbɔgblɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple amegbetɔƒomea katã dzi.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzinɔla siwo katã ƒe ŋkɔ mele Alẽvi si wowu la ƒe agbenɔlawo ƒe agbalẽ me, tso esime woɖo xexea me gɔme anyi o la, lasubɔe.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Ame si to li na la, nesee!

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: “Ne ehiã be woaɖe aboyo ame aɖe la, woaɖe aboyoe. Ne ehiã be woawu ame aɖe kple yi la, woawui kple yi. Wogblɔ esia bene ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la nado dzi eye woaxɔ se.”

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Azɔ mekpɔ lã bubu, si do go tso anyigba me. Dzo eve le eta abe alẽvi tɔ ene, eye wòƒo nu abe ʋɔdriba ene.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Exɔ ŋusẽ triakɔ si le esi la tso lã gbãtɔ la gbɔ, eye wòwɔ eŋudɔ le eŋkume. Ezi anyigba kple edzinɔlawo katã dzi be woasubɔ lã gbãtɔ, si ŋu wode kubi kpɔ la.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Lã evelia sia wɔ nukunu gãwo. Ena dzo gɔ̃ hã ge tso dziƒo va dze anyigba dzi le amewo ŋkume.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Eble anyigbadzinɔlawo to nukunu siwo woɖe mɔ nɛ be newɔ le lã gbãtɔ ŋkume la me. Lã la gblɔ na xexemetɔwo be woawɔ lã si ŋu wode abii kple yi, ke wòtsi agbe la ƒe nɔnɔmekpakpa.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Wona ŋusẽ lã evelia be wòana gbɔgbɔ lã gbãtɔ la ƒe nɔnɔmekpakpa si wowɔ la, ale be nɔnɔmekpakpa la nate ŋu aƒo nu, eye wòawu ame siwo katã masubɔe o la.
