english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Lã sia zi amewo katã dzi: ɖeviwo kple ametsitsiwo, kesinɔtɔwo kple ame dahewo, kluviwo kple ablɔɖemewo be woade dzesi woƒe nuɖusi kple ŋgonu.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Ale be ame aɖeke mate ŋu aƒle nu alo adzra naneke o, negbe dzesi la ɖe wòle eŋu hafi. Dzesi siae nye lãa ƒe ŋkɔ alo xexlẽmedzesi si le ŋkɔa teƒe.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Nunya hiã le nya sia ŋu bubu me. Ame si sea nu gɔme la, nebu lã la ƒe xexlẽmedzesi la kpɔ, elabe enye dzesi si sɔ kple ame ŋkɔ. Xexlẽmedzesi lae nye alafa ade bla ade vɔ ade.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Tete mese gbe aɖe ɖi le dziƒo, abe tsitsetse gã ƒe ɖiɖi alo dziɖegbe sesẽ ene. Gbe si mese la gaɖi kasaŋkuƒoƒo hã.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Wole ha yeye aɖe dzim le fiazikpui la kple nugbagbe eneawo kpakple ametsitsiawo ŋkume. Ame aɖeke mate ŋu asrɔ̃ ha la o, negbe ame akpe alafa ɖeka bla ene vɔ ene, siwo ta woxe fe ɖo le anyigba dzi la ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Wonye ame siwo medɔ kple nyɔnu kpɔ o, eye wonye ɖetugbi siwo mede ŋutsu gbɔ kpɔ o. Woawoe nye ame siwo nɔa Alẽvi la yome yia afi sia afi si wòyina la. Woawo tae woxe fe ɖo, le amegbetɔwo dome, eye wonye ame gbãtɔ siwo wotsɔ na Mawu kple Alẽvi la.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Womeka aʋatso kpɔ o; mokaka aɖeke hã mele wo ŋu o. Mawudɔla etɔ̃awo

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu aɖe, si le dzodzom le dziƒo kple anyigba dome. Nyanyui mavɔ la le esi, eye wòdi be yeaɖe gbeƒãe na anyigbadzinɔlawo, amegbetɔƒomeawo katã, to sia to, gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kple dukɔ sia dukɔ.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla la do ɣli sesĩe gblɔ be: “Mivɔ̃ Mawu, eye mitsɔ bubu nɛ, elabe ɣeyiɣi la de be wòadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu amegbetɔƒome la. Misubɔ eyama, si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba, atsiaƒu kple tsidzidziwo.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla evelia kplɔ gbãtɔ ɖo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Egbã loo! Babilonia xɔŋkɔ la gbã loo! Du si kpe ahasiwɔwɔ na dukɔwo katã wono abe wain ene, eye wòhe dɔmedzoe va wo dzi la, gbã gudugudu!”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla bubu kplɔ gbãtɔ eveawo ɖo le gbɔgblɔm kple ɣli sesĩe be: “Ne ame aɖe subɔ lã la kple eƒe nɔnɔmekpakpa la, eye eƒe dzesi le eƒe ŋgonu alo asi ŋu la,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: ano Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe kple dziku sesẽ la abe wain tsimatɔ si wokɔ ɖe kplu me wòyɔ banaa la ene. Woatsɔ dzo kple dzokpe awɔ funyafunya ame sia le mawudɔla kɔkɔeawo kple Alẽvi la ŋkume.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Dzudzɔ si le tutum le funyafunya me la, ade dzi tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Ame siawo, siwo subɔ lã la kple eƒe nɔnɔmekpakpa la kple ame siwo ŋu lã la ƒe ŋkɔdzesi le la, makpɔ gbɔɖeme zã kple keli akpɔ o.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ esia be ame siwo ŋu wokɔ kple ame siwo lé Mawu ƒe sewo me ɖe asi, eye woxɔ Yesu dzi se la nado dzi.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mese gbe aɖe ɖi tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Ŋlɔ ɖi be: Tso azɔ heyina la, woyra ame siwo le hadede me kple Aƒetɔ la hafi ku la!” Gbɔgbɔ la xɔ ɖe edzi be: “Woyra wo nyateƒe! Woavo tso woƒe fukpekpe me, elabe woƒe dɔwɔwɔ layi kpli wo.” Nuŋeɣi le anyigba dzi

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Azɔ mekpɔ alilikpo ɣi aɖe, si dzi nane si le abe amegbetɔ ene la bɔbɔ nɔ. Sikafiakuku le eta, eye hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ aɖe le esi.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla bubu do tso mawuxɔ la me, eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ gblɔ na ame si bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi be: “Nuŋeɣi ɖo! Do nuŋehɛ la ɖa ne nàŋe nu, elabe anyigbadzinukuwo ʋã na ŋeŋe!”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Ale ame si bɔbɔ nɔ alilikpo la dzi nye eƒe hɛ gobɛ la le anyigba dzi, eye wòŋe anyigbadzinukuwo.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu wòdo tso mawuxɔ si le dziƒo la me. Hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ aɖe le eya hã si.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Tete mawudɔla bubu, si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dzo dzi la do tso vɔsamlekpui la me. Edo ɣli sesĩe gblɔ na mawudɔla si lé hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ la ɖe asi la be: “Waintsetseawo ɖi! Do wò hɛ gobɛ la ɖa ne nàtso wainkpowo le anyigba la ƒe wainbɔ la me.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Ale mawudɔla la nye eƒe hɛ la le anyigba dzi, eye wòtso waintsetse siwo le anyigba dzi. Elɔ wo ƒo ɖe wainfiãnu gã si nye Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe la me.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Wofanya waintsetseawo kple afɔ le dua godo, eye ʋu ɖuɖu tso wainfiãnu la me. Ʋu la ɖɔ ŋutɔ. Eme goglo abe afɔ atɔ̃ ene, eye wòtsa heyi abe agbadroƒe alafa eve sɔŋ ene.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mekpɔ dzesi gã bubu le dziƒo si wɔ nuku ale gbegbe. Esiae nye mawudɔla adrẽ siwo si fuwɔame adrẽ le la. Fuwɔame siawoe nye mamlɛtɔwo, elabe woawoe ɖe Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe mamlɛtɔ fia.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Mekpɔ atsiaƒu wòle abe ahuhɔ̃e si me biã hẽe abe dzo ene la ene. Ame siwo ɖu lã la, eƒe nɔnɔmekpakpa kple xexlẽmedzesi si nye eƒe ŋkɔ dzi la, le tsitre ɖe ahuhɔ̃eƒu la nu, eye Mawu ƒe kasaŋkuwo le wo si.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Wodzi Mawu ƒe dɔla, Mose kple Alẽvi la ƒe ha be: “O Aƒetɔ Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, wò dɔwɔwɔwo lolo eye wowɔ nuku loo! Wò dukɔwo ƒe Fia, Wò mɔwo le dzɔdzɔe eye wonye nyateƒe!

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, ame ka gɔ̃e mavɔ̃ wò o? Ame kae made bubu wò ŋkɔ ŋuti o? Elabe wò koe le kɔkɔe, dukɔwo katã ava subɔ wò, elabe woɖe wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖe go fia.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ mawuxɔ si le dziƒo kple Mawu ƒe agbadɔ si me wònɔna la wole ʋuʋu ɖi.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla adrẽ, siwo si me fuwɔame adrẽawo le la do tso mawuxɔ la me. Wodo aklala bíɖibiɖi wu dzadzɛ si le dzo dam la, eye wotsɔ sikanudziblanu bla akɔtae.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Tete nugbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖeka tsɔ sikakplu adrẽ, siwo yɔ taŋ kple Mawu, ame si li tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me la ƒe dɔmedzoe la, na mawudɔla adrẽawo.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Dzudzɔ si do tso Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple eƒe ŋusẽ me la, yɔ mawuxɔ la taŋ. Ame aɖeke mete ŋu ge ɖe mawuxɔ la me o, va se ɖe esime fuwɔame adrẽ siwo mawudɔla adrẽawo he vɛ la nu va yi keŋ.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Azɔ mese gbe aɖe ɖi sesĩe tso mawuxɔ la me le gbɔgblɔm na mawudɔla adrẽawo be: “Miyi ne miatrɔ nu si le Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoekpluawo me la kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi!”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Ale mawudɔla gbãtɔ yi ɖatrɔ nu si le eƒe kplu la me la kɔ ɖi. Tete ame siwo ŋu lã la ƒe dzesi le kple ame siwo subɔ eƒe nɔnɔmekpakpaa la, ka abi vɔ̃, si ʋẽna la.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla evelia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplu la me la kɔ ɖe atsiaƒu me, eye tsia trɔ zu abe ame kuku ƒe ʋu ene. Ale nugbagbe siwo katã le atsiaƒu me la ku.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla etɔ̃lia trɔ etɔ kɔ ɖe tɔsisiwo kple tsidzidziwo dzi, eye wotrɔ zu ʋu.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Tete mese mawudɔla si le tsiwo nu la gblɔ be: “O Kɔkɔetɔ, wò ame si li tso blema ke, ètso afia dzɔdzɔe le wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ siawo me loo!

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Ame siawo kɔ wò ame siwo ŋu wokɔ kple wò gbeƒãɖelawo ƒe ʋu ɖi, eya ta nèna ʋu wo bene woano. Tohehe siae dze wo vavã!”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Tete mese vɔsamlekpui la gblɔ be: “Ẽ, Aƒetɔ Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, ètsoa afia dzɔdzɔe eye nètoa nyateƒe le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me!”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla enelia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplu la me la kɔ ɖe ɣe ŋkume, eye wona mɔ ɣe be wòafiã ame kple eƒe dzo.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Dzoxɔxɔ sesẽ la me amewo vevie eye wogblɔ busunya ɖe Mawu, ame si si ŋusẽ le ɖe fuwɔame siawo dzi la ŋu. Ke wogbe be yewomatrɔ dzime atsɔ bubu na Mawu o.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla atɔ̃lia trɔ etɔ kɔ ɖe lã la ƒe fiazikpui la dzi. Tete viviti do ɖe lã la ƒe fiaɖuƒe me. Amewo ɖu aɖe le veve si sem wole la ta,

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: eye wogblɔ busunya ɖe Mawu si le dziƒo la ŋu. Togbɔ be abi vɔ̃ɖiawo le wo vem vevie hã la, wogbe be yewomatrɔ dzime tso yewoƒe nuwɔnawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla adelia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplu la me la kɔ ɖe Frat-tɔsisi gã la me, eye tɔsisi la mie zu ƒuƒuiƒe hezu toƒe na fia siwo tso ɣedzeƒe la.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ etɔ̃, siwo le abe akpɔkplɔwo ene la, wodo go tso ʋɔdriba la, lã la kple aʋatsogbeƒãɖela aɖe ƒe nu me.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Wonye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo ƒe gbɔgbɔ siwo wɔa nukunuwo. Gbɔgbɔ siawo doa go yina ɖe fia siwo le anyigba blibo la dzi la gbɔ, bene woaƒo wo nu ƒu na aʋawɔwɔ le Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe ŋkeke gã la dzi.

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃awo kplɔ fiaawo va ƒo ƒu ɖe teƒe aɖe, si woyɔna le Hebri-gbe me be Armagedon.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla adrẽlia trɔ nu si le eƒe kplu la me kɔ ɖe ya me. Tete gbe gã aɖe ɖi tso fiazikpui la dzi le mawuxɔ la me le gbɔgblɔm be: “Evɔ loo!”

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Du xɔŋkɔ la dze ɖe akpa etɔ̃ me, eye dukɔwo ƒe dugãwo gbã. Mawu ƒe ŋku dze Babilonia-du xɔŋkɔ la dzi, eye wòtsɔ eƒe dɔmedzoekplu la nɛ wòno eƒe dzikuha si le eme la wòvɔ keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Ƒukpowo katã bu vĩ, eye to aɖeke megali woakpɔ o.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mawudɔla adrẽ, siwo si kplu adrẽawo le la dometɔ ɖeka va gbɔnye eye wògblɔ nam be: “Va, ne mafia ale si wohe to na gbolo xɔŋkɔ si bɔbɔ nɔ tsi geɖewo dzi la wò.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Anyigbadzifiawo wɔ ahasi kple gbolo xɔŋkɔ sia, eye eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ mu xexemetɔwo abe wain ene.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ekplɔm yi gbedadaƒo le gbɔgbɔ me. Mekpɔ nyɔnu aɖe, si bɔbɔ nɔ lã dzĩ aɖe dzi. Busuŋkɔ geɖewo le lã la si, eye ta adrẽ kple dzo ewo li nɛ.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la do awu hẽ kple awu dzĩ aɖe, eye wòɖo atsyɔ̃ kple sikanuwo, kpe xɔasiwo kple adzagba. Elé sikakplu si yɔ taŋ kple ŋunyɔnu kpakple nu makɔmakɔ siwo wòkpɔ tso eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ me la ɖe asi.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ ŋkɔ si gɔme le ɣaɣla la ɖe eƒe ŋgonu be: “Babilonia xɔŋkɔ, gbolowo nɔ, xexeme ŋunyɔnuwo nɔ.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dze sii, be nyɔnua no ame siwo ŋu wokɔ kple ame siwo wowu le Yesu dzixɔse ta la ƒe ʋu kaka hemu. Esi mekpɔe la, ewɔ nuku nam ŋutɔ.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ke mawudɔla la biam be: “Ale ke wɔ wòwɔ nuku na wò?” Eyi edzi gblɔ nam be: “Magblɔ nya ɣaɣla, si le nyɔnua kple lã, ta adrẽ kple dzo ewo, si dzi wòle ŋu la na wò.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Lã si nèkpɔ la nɔ agbe kpɔ, ke fifia la, eku. Ado go tso aʋlime ava eye woatsrɔ̃e. Ame siwo le agbe le anyigba dzi, siwo ƒe ŋkɔ mele agbenɔlawo ƒe agbalẽ me hafi woɖo xexea me gɔme anyi o la, ƒe mo awɔ yaa ne wokpɔ lã la, elabe enye ame si nɔ anyi kpɔ, eye megali o, ke egale vava ge.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Esia hiã nugɔmesese kple nunya. Ta adrẽawo nye togbɛ adrẽ, siwo dzi nyɔnu la nɔ anyi ɖo.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Woganye fia adrẽ hã. Fia siawo dometɔ atɔ̃ ƒe fiaɖuƒe gbã xoxo, ɖeka le dzi ɖum fifia, eye mamlɛtɔ medo haɖe o. Ne eva do la, anɔ anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ke lã si nɔ agbe kpɔ, eye megali fifia o lae nye fia enyilia, ke enye fia adrẽawo dometɔ ɖeka si yina tsɔtsrɔ̃ ge.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: Dzo ewo, siwo nèkpɔ la nye fia ewo, siwo ƒe dziɖuɣi meɖo haɖe o, ke wona ŋusẽ wo gaƒoƒo ɖeka be woaɖu fia kple lã la.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Taɖodzinu ɖeka koe le wo ame ewo la katã si, eye wotsɔ woƒe bubu kple ŋusẽ na lã la.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Woawɔ aʋa kple Alẽvi la, eye Alẽvi la laɖu wo dzi, elabe eyae nye aƒetɔwo katã ƒe Aƒetɔ kple fiawo katã ƒe Fia. Eyomedzela nuteƒewɔla siwo wòyɔ hetia la, aɖu dzi kplii.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla la gagblɔ nam hã be: “Tsi siwo dzi gbolo la bɔbɔ nɔ nèkpɔ la nye dukɔwo, amehawo, amegbetɔƒome kple gbegbɔgblɔ vovovowo.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Dzo ewo siwo nèkpɔ kple lã la alé fu gbolo la. Woaxɔ nu sia nu le esi, wòatsi amama. Woaɖu eƒe ŋutilã, eye woatɔ dzoe wòafiã.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Elabe Mawu de esia dzime na wo bene woawɔ nu si yeɖo ɖi la dzi, eye wòna be woawɔ ɖeka atsɔ woƒe dziɖuŋusẽ la ana lã la, va se ɖe esime Mawu ƒe nyawo lava eme.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: “Nyɔnu si nèkpɔ la, nye du xɔŋkɔ si le anyigbadzifiawo dzi ɖum.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu si ɖi tso dziƒo gbɔna. Ŋusẽ le esi ŋutɔ, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe klẽ ɖe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Edo ɣli ŋusẽtɔe be: “Egbã loo! Babilonia xɔŋkɔ la gbã gudugudu! Etrɔ zu gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo, gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔwo, xe makɔmakɔwo kple xe siwo wotsri la ƒe nɔƒe.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Elabe dukɔwo katã no eƒe dɔmedzoeha si eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ he vɛ la. Anyigbadzifiawo wɔ ahasi kplii, eye xexemesitsalawo zu kesinɔtɔwo to eƒe hadzedze vivivo me.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Tete megase gbe bubu tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Nye amewo, mido go le eme! Ne menye nenem o la, miawo hã miava wɔ nuvɔ̃ siwo wòwɔ, eye woatsɔ fuwɔamewo ahe to na mi, abe ale si wotsɔ wo he to nɛ ene.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Elabe woli kɔ eƒe nuvɔ̃wo wokɔ ɖatɔ keke dziƒo ke, eye Mawu ɖo ŋku nu madzɔmadzɔ siwo wòwɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Miwɔe nɛ, ɖe ale si eya hã wɔe na mi la nu. Miɖo eteƒe nɛ zigbɔzi eve, ɖe ale si eya wɔ mi la teƒe. Kplu si me wòku aha ɖo na mi la, miku eƒe teƒe eve nɛ.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Mina wòakpe fu, eye wòafa konyi ale si dze; ɖe eƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kple agbeɖuɖu vivivo la nu. Elabe egblɔna na eɖokui ɖaa be: ‘Fianyɔnue menye le afii. Nyemenye ahosi o, Nyemaxa nu akpɔ o!’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Ale fuwɔame siwo nye dɔléle, nuxaxa kple dɔwuame, aƒo ɖe edzi le ŋkeke ɖeka me. Woatɔ dzoe wòafiã keŋkeŋ, elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu, ame si drɔ̃ ʋɔnui la, ŋusẽtɔ wònye.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Ne anyigbadzifia siwo wɔ ahasi kplii, eye woɖu agbe kplii, kpɔ dzo si le efiãm la ƒe dzudzɔ wòle tutum la, woado ɣli afa avi ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Woanɔ adzɔge ʋĩi le vɔvɔ̃ na fu si kpem wòle la ta, agblɔ be: “Ao! Ao! Wò, du xɔŋkɔ! Wò, Babilonia ŋusẽtɔ! Gaƒoƒo ɖeka pɛ ko wotsɔ drɔ̃ ʋɔnu wò alea!”

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Asitsala gã siwo le anyigba dzi la hã fa avi, fa konyi kplii, elabe ame aɖeke megaƒlea eƒe adzɔnuawo o.

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Adzɔnu siawoe nye sika, klosalo, kpe xɔasi kple adzagba, aklala bíɖibiɖi, avɔ hẽ, seda kple awu dzĩ. Bubuwo hãe nye ati ʋeʋẽe ƒomeviwo katã, nu siwo katã wokpa kple nyiɖu kple ati xɔasiwo, nu siwo katã wowɔ kple ga dzẽ kple ga yibɔ kpakple kpe xɔasi.

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: Adzɔnu bubuwo hã ganye ati ʋeʋẽe si woyɔna be sinamɔn, ami ʋeʋẽe kple lifi, kotoklobo, wain, nuɖami, wɔ memee, lu, dɔwɔlãwo, ami sisi, aƒemelãwo, sɔwo, tasiaɖamwo, kluviwo kple keke ame ƒe agbe gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Asitsalaawo gblɔ be: “Nu nyui siwo wò luʋɔ dina la bu ɖe wò vĩ. Wò kesinɔnuwo katã kple wò atsyɔ̃ hã bu; màgakpɔ wo akpɔ gbeɖe o.”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Asitsala siwo zu kesinɔtɔwo to nu siawo dzadzra me la anɔ tsitre ɖe adzɔge ʋĩi tso egbɔ, elabe wole vɔvɔ̃m na fu si kpem wòle la. Woafa avi, afa konyi kple ɣli

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: agblɔ be: “Ao! Ao! Du xɔŋkɔ; du si woɖo atsyɔ̃ na kple aklala bíɖibiɖi wu, avɔ dzĩ bíɖibiɖi wu kple awu dzĩ; du si wodo sika kple kpe xɔasiwo kpakple adzagba na lae nye esi!

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu siawo katã zu nu gbegblẽ le gaƒoƒo ɖeka pɛ ko me!” Tɔdziʋumegãwo katã kple mɔzɔlawo, tɔdziʋukulawo kple ame bubu siwo katã ɖoa tɔdziʋu tsaa asi to ƒu dzi la tsi tsitre ɖe adzɔge ke,

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: eye wofa avi kple ɣli esime wokpɔ du si le dzo bim la ƒe dzudzɔ.

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Wolɔ kewɔ kɔ ɖe tame, fa avi hefa konyi gblɔ be: “Baba! Baba ko woado na du xɔŋkɔ sia! Afi siae tɔdziʋutɔwo kpɔ nu tso eƒe kesinɔnuwo me le ɖe! Ezu aƒedo le gaƒoƒo ɖeka pɛ ko me.”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ mawudɔla ŋusẽtɔ aɖe wòtsɔ kpe, si le abe té gã aɖe ene la, hedae ɖe atsiaƒu me, gblɔ be: “Alea woatsɔ Babilonia-du la axlã ɖe anyii, womagakpɔe akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Kasaŋku, saŋku, dze kple kpẽ magaɖi le mewò azɔ o. Womegale aɖaŋudɔwɔla aɖeke hã kpɔ ge le mewò o. Nenema ke womagase wɔtuté ƒe ɖiɖi o.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Akaɖi hã magaklẽ o, eye ŋugbetɔ kple srɔ̃a ƒe gbe magaɖi le mewò gbeɖe o. Elabe wò asiƒlelawoe nye xexeme ŋusẽtɔwo, eye nètsɔ wò afakaka ble dukɔwo katã.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Babilonia-dua mee wokpɔ Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo kple ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la ƒe ʋu le. Menye woawo tɔ ɖeɖe ko o, ke wokpɔ ame siwo katã wowu le anyigba dzi la tɔ hã.”

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mese gbe aɖe abe ameha gã aɖe ƒe gbe ene le ɖiɖim le dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be: “Mikafu Mawu! Agbexɔxɔ, ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ nye mía Mawu la tɔ.

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: Edrɔ̃a ʋɔnu nyateƒetɔe, eye wòtsoa afia dzɔdzɔe. Ebu fɔ gbolo si gblẽ anyigba dzi kple eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ la, hebia hlɔ̃e, elabe eyae wu eƒe subɔlawo.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Wogado ɣli ake be: “Mikafu Mawu! Gbolodua ƒe dzudzɔ la anɔ tutum ayi dziƒo tegbee.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Tete gbe ɖi tso fiazikpui la gbɔ be: “Mikafu mía Mawu la, mi esubɔlawo katã, mi ɖevi kple ametsitsi siwo katã vɔ̃nɛ.”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Emegbe gbe aɖe ɖi. Ele abe ameha gã aɖe ƒe ɣlidodo, alo tsitsetse gã aɖe ƒe ɖiɖi alo dziɖegbe sesẽ ene. Ele gbɔgblɔm be: “Mikafu Mawu, elabe Aƒetɔ mía Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la le fia ɖum!

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Mina míakpɔ dzidzɔ, adoe ɖe dzi atsɔ bubu nɛ, elabe Alẽvi la ƒe srɔ̃ɖe ŋkekenyui la ɖo, eye srɔ̃a dzra eɖokui ɖo vɔ.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Wotsɔ aklala bíɖibiɖi wu si le dzo dam la nɛ be wòado.” Elabe aklala bíɖibiɖi nye nu si ɖea ame siwo ŋu wokɔ la ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ fiana.

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Azɔ mawudɔla la gblɔ nam be: “Ŋlɔ ɖi be: Woyra ame siwo wokpe be woava Alẽvi la ƒe srɔ̃ɖenuɖuƒe.” Egagblɔ nam be: “Mawu ƒe numenya tututu enye esia.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Tete medze klo ɖe eƒe afɔnu be masubɔe, ke egblɔ nam be: “Mègawɔ nu ma o! Subɔlawo ko nye kple wò kpakple nɔviwò siwo le ɖase ɖim le Yesu ŋu la míenye. De ta agu na Mawu ɖeɖe ko.” Elabe ɖase si woɖina le Yesu ŋu lae do ŋusẽ Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo. Sɔ ɣi dola la

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mekpɔ dziƒo wòʋu ɖi, eye sɔ ɣi aɖe le dzedzem. Ame si bɔbɔ nɔ edzi la ŋkɔe nye “Nuteƒewɔla” kple “Nyateƒetɔ.” Edrɔ̃a ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe, eye wòwɔa aʋa le dzɔdzɔenyenye nu.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkuwo le abe dzo ƒe aɖe ene, eye fiakuku geɖewo le eta. Woŋlɔ ŋkɔ aɖe ɖe eŋu si ame aɖeke menya o, negbe eya ŋutɔ ko.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Edo awu aɖe, si wonyrɔ ɖe ʋu me. Eŋkɔe nye “Mawu ƒe nya la.”

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Dziƒoʋakɔwo do aklala bíɖibiɖi wu dzadzɛ ɣiwo, eye wole sɔ ɣiwo dzi kplɔe ɖo.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Aʋayi ɖaɖɛ aɖe le enu si wòatsɔ atsrɔ̃ dukɔwoe. Aɖu wo dzi kple gatikplɔ eye afanya nu kple Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe dziku kple dɔmedzoe, abe ale si wofanyaa wain le wainfiãnu me la ene.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Ŋkɔ si woŋlɔ ɖe eƒe awu ʋlaya kple ata ŋu lae nye: “Fiawo ƒe Fia” kple “Aƒetɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ.”

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Emegbe la, mekpɔ mawudɔla aɖe, wòle tsitre ɖe ɣe ŋkume. Edo ɣli sesĩe yɔ xe siwo katã dzona le ya me la gblɔ be: “Miva loo! Miva ƒo ƒu ne miaɖu Mawu ƒe fiẽnuɖuɖu gã la.

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Miva ɖu fiawo, aʋafiawo, asrafowo, sɔwo kple sɔdolawo ƒe ŋutilã; ame sia ame tɔ ko, ablɔɖemewo kple kluviwo, ametsitsiwo kple ɖeviwo siaa ƒe ŋutilã!”

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ lã la kple anyigbadzifiawo kpakple woƒe aʋakɔwo woho aʋa ɖe sɔdola la kple eƒe aʋakɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Woɖe aboyo lã la kple aʋatsogbeƒãɖela si wɔ nukunuwo. Nukunu siawo wòtsɔ ble ame siwo ŋu lã la ƒe dzesi le kple ame siwo subɔ eƒe nɔnɔmekpakpaa lae. Wotsɔ lã la kple aʋatsogbeƒãɖela la ƒu gbe agbagbee ɖe dzotá si me dzokpewo le bibim le la me.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Mamlɛawo ya la, wowu wo kple yi si do tso sɔdola la ƒe nu me, eye xewo katã ɖu woƒe ŋutilã ale si woate ŋui.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Emegbe la, mekpɔ ame aɖewo wonɔ anyi ɖe fiazikpui aɖewo dzi. Wona ŋusẽ ame siawo be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu. Mekpɔ ame siwo wowu elabe woɖi ɖase le Yesu kple mawunya la ŋu ta la ƒe luʋɔwo. Ame siawo mede ta agu na lã la, alo eƒe nɔnɔmekpakpa o, eye eƒe dzesi mele woƒe ŋgonu alo asi ŋu o. Wogbɔ agbe eye woɖu fia kple Kristo ƒe akpe ɖeka.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Ame siwo kpɔ gome le ame kukuwo ƒe tsitretsitsi gbãtɔ sia me la, Mawu yra wo hewɔ wo kɔkɔe. Ku evelia mekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe wo dzi o. Woanye Mawu kple Kristo ƒe nunɔlawo, eye woaɖu dzi kplii ƒe akpe ɖeka. Woɖu Satana dzi

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: Ado go aɖable dukɔ siwo le xexea me ƒe dzogoe eneawo katã dzi, siwo nye Gog kple Magɔg la. Aƒo wo nu ƒu hena aʋawɔwɔ. Wosɔ gbɔ abe ƒutake ene.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Wozɔ to xexe bliboa me, eye wova ɖe to ɖe ame siwo ŋu wokɔ kple du lɔlɔ̃ la. Ke dzo ge tso dziƒo va fiã wo keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Wotsɔ Abosam, ame si ble wo la ƒu gbe ɖe dzotá si me dzokpewo le bibim le la me. Afi siae wotsɔ lã la kple aʋatsogbeƒãɖela la ƒu gbe ɖo va yi. Woawɔ funyafunya wo le afi sia zã kple keli tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le xexea me ƒe nuwuwu

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mekpɔ fiazikpui lolo ɣi aɖe eye ame aɖe bɔbɔ nɔ edzi. Anyigba kple dziƒo bu ɖa le eŋkume, eye teƒe megali na wo woanɔ o.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ ame kuku geɖe: amegãwo kple ame gblɔewo siaa. Wotsi tsitre ɖe fiazikpuia ŋgɔ. Agbalẽ aɖewo le ʋuʋu ɖi. Wògaʋu agbalẽ bubu aɖe hã; eyae nye agbenɔlawo ƒe agbalẽ. Wotsɔ nu si woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽawo me la drɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame kukuawo ɖe woƒe nuwɔnawo nu.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu ɖe ame kuku, siwo le eme la ɖe go, eye ku kple tsiẽƒe hã ɖe asi le ame kuku siwo le wo me la ŋu. Azɔ wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnu ame sia ame ɖe nu si wòwɔ la nu.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Emegbe wotsɔ ku kple tsiẽƒe ƒu gbe ɖe dzotá la me. Dzotá siae nye ku evelia.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ƒe ŋkɔ womekpɔ le agbenɔlawo ƒe agbalẽa me o la, wotsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe dzotá la me.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, mekpɔ dziƒo yeye kple anyigba yeye. Elabe dziƒo gbãtɔ kple anyigba gbãtɔ nu va yi. Atsiaƒu hã megali o.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Azɔ mese gbe gã aɖe tso fiazikpui la gbɔ gblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, Mawu ƒe nɔƒe le amegbetɔwo dome azɔ. Anɔ wo gbɔ, eye woanye eƒe dukɔ. Mawu ŋutɔ anɔ kpli wo, [eye wòanye woƒe Mawu.]

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Atutu aɖatsi ɖe sia ɖe ɖa le woƒe ŋkume. Ku maganɔ anyi o. Nenema ke nuxaxa, avifafa kple vevesese hã maganɔ anyi o, elabe nu siwo nɔ anyi gbã la nu va yi.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Tete ame si bɔbɔ nɔ fiazikpuia dzi la gblɔ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, megbugbɔ nu sia nu wɔ yeye.” Egagblɔ hã be: “Ŋlɔe ɖi, elabe nyateƒenyawoe, eye woate ŋu aɖo dzi ɖe wo ŋu.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Egblɔ nam be: “Nu sia nu de azɔ! Nyee nye Gbãtɔ ganye Mlɔetɔ, gɔmedzedzea kple nuwuwua. Ame si tsikɔ le wuwum la, mana tsi si naa agbe lae tso vudo si dzina ɖaa la me wòano femaxee.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ɖu dzi la, nu siawo asu esi. Manye eƒe Mawu, eye eya hã anye vinye.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ke vɔvɔ̃nɔtɔwo, dzimaxɔsetɔwo, ŋunyɔnuwɔlawo, amewulawo, matrewɔlawo, afakalawo, trɔ̃subɔlawo kple aʋatsokalawo katã ya la, woakpɔ wo tɔ gome le dzotá si me dzokpewo le bibim le la me. Esiae nye ku evelia.” Yerusalem yeye la

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Azɔ mawudɔla siwo tsɔ kplu adrẽ, siwo yɔ taŋ kple fuwɔame adrẽ mamlɛawo la dometɔ ɖeka va gbɔnye hegblɔ nam be: “Va, ne mafia ŋugbetɔ si nye Alẽvi la srɔ̃ wò.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la ɖo menye eye mawudɔla la kɔm yi ɖe to kɔkɔ gã aɖe dzi. Efia Yerusalem, du kɔkɔe lam, wòɖi tso Mawu gbɔ le dziƒo gbɔna.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Ele keklẽm kple Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe. Eƒe keklẽ le abe kpe xɔasi tɔxɛ ene. Ele abe yaspakpe ene eye eme kɔ abe ahuhɔ̃e ene.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Gli kɔkɔ titri, ƒo xlãe, eye agbo wui eve le gliawo ŋu. Mawudɔla wui eve le agboawo nu. Woŋlɔ Israel-to wui eveawo ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe agboawo ŋu.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Agbo etɔ̃ le ɣedzeƒe, etɔ̃ le dzigbeme, etɔ̃ le anyigbeme eye etɔ̃ le ɣetoɖoƒe hã.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Gɔmeɖokpe wui evee li na dua ƒe gliawo, eye woŋlɔ Alẽvi la ƒe amedɔdɔ wui eveawo ƒe ŋkɔwo ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla si ƒo nu kplim la lé sikanudzidzeti si wòatsɔ adzidze dua, eƒe agboawo kple gliawo ɖe asi.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Dzogoe ene li na dua, eye eƒe axawo ƒe didime kple kekeme sɔ. Mawudɔla la dzidze dua kple eƒe nudzidzeti la, eye wòkpɔ be axa ɖeka didi agbadroƒe akpe ɖeka alafa atɔ̃. Dua ƒe didime, kekeme kple kɔkɔme sɔ.

english_verse: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
translation_verse: Mawudɔla la dzidze gli la hã; eya kɔ meta bla ade, le nudzidzenu si ŋudɔ wɔm wòle la nu.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Kpe si wotsɔ ɖo gli lae nye yaspa, eye wotsɔ sika nyuitɔ si me kɔ abe ahuhɔ̃e ene la tso du la ŋutɔe.

english_verse: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
translation_verse: Wotsɔ kpe xɔasi ƒomevi vovovowo ɖo atsyɔ̃ na dua ƒe gliwo ƒe gɔmeɖokpeawoe. Gɔmeɖokpe gbãtɔ nye kpe si woyɔna be yaspa, evelia nye safir, etɔ̃lia nye xalkedon, enelia nye smaragad,

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: atɔ̃lia nye sardonik, adelia nye sardis, adrẽlia nye krisolit, enyilia nye beril, asiekelia nye topas, ewolia nye krisopras, wui ɖekɛlia nye hiakint, wui evelia nye ametist.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Du la ƒe agbo wui eveawo nye adzagba wui eve. Adzagba blibo ɖeka wotsɔ wɔ agboawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖee. Dua ƒe ablɔ nye sika nyuitɔ sɔŋ eye wokpɔa nu toa eme abe ahuhɔ̃e ene.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Nyemekpɔ gbedoxɔ aɖeke le du la me o, elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ kple Alẽvi la nye eƒe gbedoxɔ.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Ɣe alo ɣleti mehiã le dua me o, elabe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nye eƒe kekeli, eye Alẽvi la nye eƒe akaɖi.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Eƒe kekeli mee dukɔ siwo le xexea me la lazɔ, eye anyigbadzifiawo atsɔ woƒe kesinɔnuwo ava emee.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Womatu dua ƒe agbowo le ŋkeke me o, eye zã mado le eme akpɔ o.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo atsɔ woƒe atsyɔ̃ɖonuwo kple kesinɔnuwo ava dua mee.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Ke nu makɔmakɔ aɖeke mage ɖe dua me o. Aʋatsokalawo kple ŋukpenanuwɔlawo manɔ eme o. Ame siwo ƒe ŋkɔ woŋlɔ ɖe Alẽvi la ƒe agbalẽ si me woŋlɔ agbenɔlawo ƒe ŋkɔ ɖo la koe anɔ eme.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla la fia tɔsisi si me tsi naa agbe lam. Tsia me kɔ keŋkeŋ abe ahuhɔ̃e dzadzɛtɔ ene, eye wòle dodom tso Mawu kple Alẽvi la ƒe fiazikpui la me

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: hele sísim to dua ƒe ablɔ titina. Ati si naa agbe la le tɔsisi la ƒe go eveawo dzi. Etsena ɣleti sia ɣleti. Eƒe aŋgbawo nye dɔyɔgbe na dukɔwo.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Womagakpɔ busunu aɖeke le dua me o. Mawu kple Alẽvi la ƒe fiazikpui anɔ eme, eye eƒe dɔlawo ade ta agu nɛ.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Zã megale dodo ge o, eye akaɖi alo ɣe ƒe keklẽ mahiã wo o, elabe Aƒetɔ Mawu la lanye kekeli na wo, eye woaɖu dzi tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Yesu ƒe vava

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mawudɔla la gblɔ nam be: “Nyateƒenyawoe eye woate ŋu aɖo dzi ɖe wo ŋu. Aƒetɔ Mawu, ame si tsɔ eƒe gbɔgbɔ la na eƒe gbeƒãɖelawo la dɔ eƒe mawudɔla ɖa, be wòaɖe nu siwo le eme va ge kpuie la afia eƒe dɔlawo.

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna fifi laa!” Mawu yra ame siwo lé nya siwo woɖe gbeƒãe le agbalẽ sia me la me ɖe asi!

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Nye Yohanes, nyee nye ame si se nu siawo eye mekpɔ wo. Esi mese nu siawo eye mekpɔ wo la, medze klo ɖe mawudɔla si ɖe wo fiam la ƒe afɔnu be made ta agu nɛ.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Ke egblɔ nam be: “Mègawɔ nu ma o! Subɔlawo ko nye kple wò kpakple nɔviwò, siwo nye Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo kpakple ame siwo katã ɖoa to nya, siwo le agbalẽ sia me la míenye. De ta agu na Mawu ɖeɖe ko!”

english_verse: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Azɔ mawudɔla la gblɔ nam be: “Mègaɣla nya siwo wogblɔ ɖi le agbalẽ sia me la o, elabe nu siawo le eme va ge kpuie.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔa nuvɔ̃ɖi la, nenɔ nuvɔ̃ɖia wɔwɔ dzi ko; ame si wɔa ɖinu la, nenɔ ɖinuwɔwɔa dzi ko; ame si wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe la, nenɔ nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔa dzi ko, eye ame si le kɔkɔe la, neyi edzi wòanɔ kɔkɔe ko.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna fifi laa! Mehe nye fetu gbɔnae. Maxe fe na ame sia ame ɖe nu si wòwɔ la nu.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Gbãtɔ ganye Mlɔetɔ; gɔmedzedzea kple nuwuwua.”

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Woyra ame siwo nya woƒe awu ʋlayawo, bene woana mɔ wo woaɖu ati si naa agbe la ƒe tsetse, eye woato agboawo nu age ɖe dua me.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Ke dua godo nɔlawo nye: avuwo, afakalawo, matrewɔlawo, amewulawo, trɔ̃subɔlawo kple ame sia ame si lɔ̃ aʋatso eye wòkanɛ.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Nye Yesu ŋutɔe dɔ nye mawudɔla ɖa, be wòaɖi ɖase na mi le nu siawo ŋuti ne hameawo nase. Nyee nye David ƒe ke kple eƒe dzidzimevi tututu; nyee nye ŋukeɣletivi keklẽ la.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la kple ŋugbetɔ la gblɔ be: “Va!” Ame si see la negblɔ be: “Va!” Ame si wum tsikɔ le la, neva. Ame si le tsi si naa agbe la dim la, neva xɔe no femaxee. Taƒonya

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Nye la, mele egblɔm na ame sia ame si se nya siwo woɖe gbeƒãe le agbalẽ sia me la be: Ne ame aɖe tsɔ nane kpe wo la, Mawu atsɔ fuwɔame siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la akpe eƒe fukpekpewoe nɛ.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne ame aɖe ɖe nane le nya siwo woɖe gbeƒãe le agbalẽ sia me la me la, Mawu mana eƒe asi nasu nu nyui siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ sia me la dzi o: makpɔ gome le ati si naa agbe la me o, eye makpɔ gome le du kɔkɔe la hã me o.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Ame si le ɖase ɖim le nu siawo ŋu la gblɔ be: “Ẽ, megbɔna fifi laa!” Amen, Aƒetɔ Yesu, va!

english_verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: Le gɔmedzedzea me la, Mawu wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba.

english_verse: The earth was barren, with no form of life; it was under a roaring ocean covered with darkness. But the Spirit of God was moving over the water. The First Day
translation_verse: Anyigba nɔ nyamaa, nɔnɔme aɖeke meli nɛ o. Ele ƒuƒlu, eye viviti do ɖe tsi gbana la dzi, eye Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ nɔ agba sam le tsia dzi.

english_verse: God said, “I command light to shine!” And light started shining.
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Kekeli nedo.” Eye kekeli do.

english_verse: God looked at the light and saw that it was good. He separated light from darkness
translation_verse: Mawu kpɔ be kekeli la nyo, eye wòma kekeli la tso viviti la gbɔ.

english_verse: and named the light “Day” and the darkness “Night.” Evening came, then morning—that was the first day. The Second Day
translation_verse: Mawu yɔ kekeli la be “ŋkeke,” eye wòyɔ viviti la be “zã.” Ale zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke gbãtɔ.

english_verse: God said, “I command a dome to separate the water above it from the water below it.”
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Lilikpo nedo, eye wòama tsi si le lilikpo la te kple esi le lilikpo la tame la me. Eye wòva eme nenema.”

english_verse: and named it “Sky.” Evening came, then morning—that was the second day. The Third Day
translation_verse: Mawu yɔ lilikpo la be “dziƒo.” Zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke evelia.

english_verse: God said, “I command the water under the sky to come together in one place, so there will be dry ground.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Mina tsi si le lilikpo la te la naƒo ƒu ɖe teƒe ɖeka be anyigba ƒe ƒuƒuiƒe nadze.” Eva eme nenema.

english_verse: God named the dry ground “Land,” and he named the water “Ocean.” God looked at what he had done and saw that it was good.
translation_verse: Mawu yɔ ƒuƒuiƒe la be “anyigba,” eye wòyɔ tsi siwo ƒo ƒu la be, “atsiaƒuwo.” Mawu kpɔe be enyo.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to produce all kinds of plants, including fruit trees and grain.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Mina nuwo namie ɖe anyigba la dzi: ati tsekuwo kple ati siwo tsena, eye ku nɔa tsetseawo me wotɔxɛwotɔxɛe la.” Eva eme nenema.

english_verse: The earth produced all kinds of vegetation. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Tete nuwo mie ɖe anyigba la dzi: ati siwo tsea ku wotɔxɛwotɔxɛe, eye Mawu kpɔe be enyo.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the third day. The Fourth Day
translation_verse: Zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke etɔ̃lia.

english_verse: God said, “I command lights to appear in the sky and to separate day from night and to show the time for seasons, special days, and years.
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Mina akaɖiwo nanɔ dziŋgɔli la me be woama ŋkeke ɖa tso zã gbɔ, eye woanye dzesi siwo afia ɣeyiɣiwo, ŋkekewo kple ƒewo,

english_verse: I command them to shine on the earth.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: eye woanye akaɖiwo le dziŋgɔli la me be woana kekeli anyigba.” Eye wòva eme nenema.

english_verse: God made two powerful lights, the brighter one to rule the day and the other to rule the night. He also made the stars.
translation_verse: Mawu wɔ nu keklẽ gã eve: ɣe kple ɣleti, be woaklẽ ɖe anyigba dzi. Eɖoe be nu keklẽ gãtɔ si nye ɣe la naklẽ le ŋkeke me, eye suetɔ si nye ɣleti la naklẽ le zã me. Ewɔ ɣletiviwo hã.

english_verse: Then God put these lights in the sky to shine on the earth,
translation_verse: Mawu tsɔ wo ɖo lilikpo la ŋu, be woana kekeli anyigba,

english_verse: to rule day and night, and to separate light from darkness. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: aɖu zã kple ŋkeke dzi, eye woama kekeli ɖa tso viviti gbɔ. Nu sia dze Mawu ŋu.

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fourth day. The Fifth Day
translation_verse: Ale zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke enelia.

english_verse: God said, “I command the ocean to be full of living creatures, and I command birds to fly above the earth.”
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Tɔmelãwo nedzi ɖe tsiawo me, eye xeviwo nedzo le yame le dziŋgɔli la ƒe ŋkume.”

english_verse: So God made the giant sea monsters and all the living creatures that swim in the ocean. He also made every kind of bird. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu wɔ ƒumelã gãwo kple nu gbagbe siwo tana, eye wonɔa tsi me la ƒomevi vovovowo kple xevi siwo dzona la ƒomeviwo katã. Mawu kpɔe be enyo.

english_verse: Then he gave the living creatures his blessing—he told the ocean creatures to increase and live everywhere in the ocean and the birds to increase everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Mawu yra wo gblɔ be, “Midzi ne miasɔ gbɔ, miayɔ atsiaƒuwo me, eye miana xeviwo nasɔ gbɔ le anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: Evening came, then morning—that was the fifth day. The Sixth Day
translation_verse: Eye zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke atɔ̃lia.

english_verse: God said, “I command the earth to give life to all kinds of tame animals, wild animals, and reptiles.” And that's what happened.
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Anyigba nedzi lã kple nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi: nyiwo, nu tatawo kple gbemelã ɖe sia ɖe tɔgbi.” Eye wòva eme nenema.

english_verse: God made every one of them. Then he looked at what he had done, and it was good.
translation_verse: Mawu wɔ lã wɔadãwo, nyi kple nu tatawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe tɔgbi. Eye Mawu kpɔ be enyo.

english_verse: God said, “Now we will make humans, and they will be like us. We will let them rule the fish, the birds, and all other living creatures.”
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ be, “Mina míawɔ ame ɖe míaƒe nɔnɔme me, wòaɖi mí, eye wòaɖu ƒumelãwo, dziƒoxewo, aƒemelãwo kple gbemelãwo katã kpakple nu gbagbe siwo katã tana le anyigba dzi la dzi.”

english_verse: So God created humans to be like himself; he made men and women.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu wɔ ame ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe nɔnɔme me. Mawu ƒe nɔnɔme me wòwɔ ame ɖo; ŋutsu kple nyɔnu wòwɔ.

english_verse: God gave them his blessing and said: Have a lot of children! Fill the earth with people and bring it under your control. Rule over the fish in the ocean, the birds in the sky, and every animal on the earth.
translation_verse: Mawu yra wo gblɔ na wo be, “Midzi miayɔ anyigba blibo la dzi, eye miaɖu edzi; miawoe nye tɔmelãwo, dziƒoxewo kple lã siwo katã tana le anyigba dzi la dzi ɖulawo.”

english_verse: I have provided all kinds of fruit and grain for you to eat.
translation_verse: Mawu gagblɔ be “Metsɔ nu miemie siwo tsea ku le anyigba blibo la dzi kple ati tsekuwo na mi abe miaƒe nuɖuɖu ene.

english_verse: And I have given the green plants as food for everything else that breathes, including animals, both wild and tame, and birds. And so it was.
translation_verse: Metsɔ gbewo kple atiwo katã na lãwo kple xeviwo kple nu siwo katã tana, siwo me agbe le, le anyigba dzi abe woƒe nuɖuɖu ene.” Eye wòva me nenema.

english_verse: God looked at what he had done. All of it was very good! Evening came, then morning—that was the sixth day.
translation_verse: Mawu lé ŋku ɖe nu siwo katã wòwɔ la ŋu, eye wòkpɔe be wonyo ŋutɔ. Zã do, eye ŋu ke. Esiae nye ŋkeke adelia.

english_verse: So the heavens and the earth and everything else were created. The Seventh Day
translation_verse: Ale Mawu wu dziƒo kple anyigba kpakple nu siwo katã le xexea me la wɔwɔ nu.

english_verse: By the seventh day God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Eya ta le ŋkeke adrelia gbe, esi Mawu wu eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo nu la, edzudzɔ eɖokui tso eƒe dɔwɔnawo katã me.

english_verse: God blessed the seventh day and made it special, because on that day he rested from his work.
translation_verse: Mawu yra ŋkeke adrelia, eye wòwɔe kɔkɔe, elabena eyae nye ŋkeke si dzi wòdzudzɔ xexea me wɔwɔ le. Mawu wɔ Adam da ɖe Edenbɔ me

english_verse: That's how God created the heavens and the earth. The Garden of Eden When the Lord God made the heavens and the earth,
translation_verse: Esiawoe nye dziƒo kple anyigba ƒe dzɔdzɔmenyawo, le wo wɔwɔ me le ɣeyiɣi si me Yehowa Mawu wɔ anyigba kple dziƒo.

english_verse: no grass or plants were growing anywhere. God had not yet sent any rain, and there was no one to work the land.
translation_verse: Do ŋgɔ la, atiwo kple gbewo memie ɖe anyigba dzi haɖe o, elabena Yehowa Mawu meɖo tsidzadza ɖa haɖe o, eye ame aɖeke hã menɔ anyi ade agble ɖe anyigba la dzi o.

english_verse: But streams came up from the ground and watered the earth.
translation_verse: Gake tsi dzi tso anyigba ƒe tume le teƒe aɖewo, eye wòtsa le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord God took some soil from the ground and made a man. God breathed life into the man, and the man started breathing.
translation_verse: Azɔ Yehowa Mawu tsɔ anyi me amegbetɔ, eye wògbɔ agbegbɔgbɔ ɖe eƒe ŋɔtime, eye wòzu luʋɔ gbagbe.

english_verse: The Lord made a garden in a place called Eden, which was in the east, and he put the man there.
translation_verse: Esia megbe la, Yehowa Mawu wɔ abɔ aɖe ɖe Eden le ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo, eye wòtsɔ ame si wòwɔ la da ɖe abɔ la me.

english_verse: The Lord God filled the garden with all kinds of beautiful trees and fruit trees. Two other trees were in the middle of the garden. One of these gave life—the other gave the wisdom to know the difference between right and wrong.
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu do ati siwo nya kpɔna la ƒomeviwo katã ɖe abɔ la me. Ati siawo tsea ku viviwo. Agbeti kple ati si nana wodzea si nyui kple vɔ̃ la le abɔ la titina.

english_verse: From Eden a river flowed out to water the garden, then it divided into four rivers.
translation_verse: Tɔsisi aɖe tso Eden ƒe anyigba dzi tsa to abɔ la me hede tsii. Tɔsisi la ma ɖe alɔdze ene me.

english_verse: The first one is the Pishon River that flows through the land of Havilah,
translation_verse: Alɔdze gbãtɔ ŋkɔe nye Pison. Etsa to Havilanyigba blibo la dzi, afi si sika le.

english_verse: The second is the Gihon River that winds through Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Alɔdze evelia ŋkɔe nye Gihon. Etsa to Kus ƒe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: The Tigris River that flows east of Assyria is the third, and the fourth is the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Alɔdze etɔ̃lia ŋkɔe nye Tigris. Etsa to Asiria ƒe ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo. Alɔdze eneliae nye Frat tɔsisi la.

english_verse: The Lord God put the man in the Garden of Eden to take care of it and to look after it.
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu tsɔ ame la da ɖe Edenbɔ la me abe abɔdzikpɔla ene.

english_verse: But the Lord told him, “You may eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu de se na ame la be, “Èkpɔ mɔ aɖu ati sia ati le abɔ sia me,

english_verse: except the one that has the power to let you know the difference between right and wrong. If you eat any fruit from that tree, you will die before the day is over!”
translation_verse: gake mèkpɔ mɔ aɖu ati si nana wodzea si nyui kple vɔ̃ ya o, elabena ne èɖui la, ku kee nàku.” Mawu wɔ Eva

english_verse: The Lord God said, “It isn't good for the man to live alone. I will make a suitable partner for him.”
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu gblɔ be, “Menyo be ame la ɖeka ko nanɔ anyi o. Mawɔ kpeɖeŋutɔ si asɔ ɖe eŋu la nɛ.”

english_verse: So the Lord God made him fall into a deep sleep, and he took out one of the man's ribs. Then after closing the man's side,
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa Mawu na ŋutsu la dɔ alɔ̃ yi eme ʋĩi. Emegbe la, eɖe ame la ƒe axaƒuti ɖeka, eye wòxe teƒe si wòɖee tsoe la.

english_verse: the Lord made a woman out of the rib. The Lord God brought her to the man,
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu tsɔ axaƒuti si wòɖe le amea me la wɔ nyɔnu, eye wòkplɔe va ame la gbɔ.

english_verse: and the man exclaimed, “Here is someone like me! She is part of my body, my own flesh and bones. She came from me, a man. So I will name her Woman!”
translation_verse: Tete ame la do dzidzɔɣli be, “Ɛhɛ̃! Esiae nye ƒu tso nye ƒu me kple lã tso nye lãme. Woayɔe be ‘nyɔnu’, elabena ŋutsu me woɖee tsoe.”

english_verse: That's why a man will leave his own father and mother. He marries a woman, and the two of them become like one person.
translation_verse: Esia ta ŋutsu gblẽa fofoa kple dadaa ɖi, eye wòkuna ɖe srɔ̃a ŋu ale gbegbe be ame eveawo zua ame ɖeka.

english_verse: Although the man and his wife were both naked, they were not ashamed.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Adam kple srɔ̃a nɔ amama hã la, ŋu mekpea wo dometɔ aɖeke o.

english_verse: The snake was sneakier than any of the other wild animals that the Lord God had made. One day it came to the woman and asked, “Did God tell you not to eat fruit from any tree in the garden?”
translation_verse: Da nye lã si dze aye wu lã bubu siwo katã Yehowa Mawu wɔ la. Da va nyɔnu la gbɔ, eye wòbiae be, “Ɖe wònye nyateƒe be Mawu de se na mi be migaɖu ati siwo katã le abɔa me la dometɔ aɖeke ƒe tsetsea oa?”

english_verse: The woman answered, “God said we could eat fruit from any tree in the garden,
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la gblɔ na da la be, “Míate ŋu aɖu ati ɖe sia ɖe si le abɔ sia me la ƒe tsetse,

english_verse: except the one in the middle. He told us not to eat fruit from that tree or even to touch it. If we do, we will die.”
translation_verse: gake Mawu gblɔ be, ‘Migaɖu ati si le abɔ la titina ƒe tsetse o, migaka asi eŋu hã o, ne menye nenema o la, miaku.’ ”

english_verse: “No, you won't!” the snake replied.
translation_verse: Da la gblɔ be, “Miele kuku ge akpɔ o!

english_verse: “God understands what will happen on the day you eat fruit from that tree. You will see what you have done, and you will know the difference between right and wrong, just as God does.”
translation_verse: Mawu nya nyuie be ne mieɖui ko la, miazu abe ye ene, elabena miaƒe ŋkuwo aʋu, eye mianya nyui kple vɔ̃.”

english_verse: The woman stared at the fruit. It looked beautiful and tasty. She wanted the wisdom that it would give her, and she ate some of the fruit. Her husband was there with her, so she gave some to him, and he ate it too.
translation_verse: Esi nyɔnu la kpɔ be ati la ƒe tsetse nyo na ɖuɖu, eye wònya kpɔ, eye wònana wodzea nunya la, egbe ɖe ɖu. Ena ɖe srɔ̃a si le egbɔ la hã wòɖu.

english_verse: At once they saw what they had done, and they realized they were naked. Then they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
translation_verse: Esi woɖu kutsetsea ko la, wodze sii enumake be yewole amama, eye ŋu de asi wo kpekpe me. Ale wotɔ aŋgbawo hesa ɖe ali.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon, when the breeze began to blow, the man and woman heard the Lord God walking in the garden. So they hid behind some trees. Sin Brings a Curse
translation_verse: Gbe ma gbe ƒe ɣetrɔ la, amea kple srɔ̃a se Yehowa Mawu ŋkɔ wònɔ tsa ɖim le abɔ la me. Ale woɣla wo ɖokuiwo ɖe atiawo dome.

english_verse: The Lord God called out to the man and asked, “Where are you?”
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu yɔ amea, eye wòbiae bena, “Afi ka nèle?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I was naked, and when I heard you walking through the garden, I was frightened and hid!”
translation_verse: Adam ɖo eŋu be, “Mese ŋkɔwò nègbɔna, vɔvɔ̃ ɖom, eye nyemedi be nàkpɔm manɔ amama o, eya ta meɣla ɖokuinye.”

english_verse: “How did you know you were naked?” God asked. “Did you eat any fruit from that tree in the middle of the garden?”
translation_verse: Mawu biae be, “Ame kae gblɔ na wò be èle amama? Ɖe nèɖu ati si ŋu mede se na mi le la ƒe tsetsea?”

english_verse: “It was the woman you put here with me,” the man said. “She gave me some of the fruit, and I ate it.”
translation_verse: Amea ɖo eŋu be, “Ɛ̃, nyɔnu si nèwɔ nam lae na kutsetsea ƒe ɖem meɖu.”

english_verse: The Lord God then asked the woman, “What have you done?” “The snake tricked me,” she answered, “and I ate some of that fruit.”
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu bia nyɔnu la be, “Nu ka ta nèwɔ nu sia ɖo?” Nyɔnu la ɖo eŋu be, “Da lae blem.”

english_verse: So the Lord God said to the snake: “Because of what you have done, you will be the only animal to suffer this curse— For as long as you live, you will crawl on your stomach and eat dirt.
translation_verse: Eya ta Yehowa Mawu gblɔ na da la be, “Ɖe nu si nèwɔ ta la, “Maƒo fi ade wò ɖeka le aƒemelã kple gbemelã siwo katã le anyigba dzi la dome! Wò ƒodo dzi nàzɔ eye ʋuʋudedi anye wò nuɖuɖu le wò agbemeŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: You and this woman will hate each other; your descendants and hers will always be enemies. One of hers will strike you on the head, and you will strike him on the heel.”
translation_verse: Tso azɔ dzi la, made fuléle wò kple nyɔnu la dome, eye fuléle ma ke anɔ wò dzidzime kple nyɔnu la tɔ dome. Eya la agbã ta na wò, eye wò la àɖu afɔkpodzi nɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord God said to the woman, “You will suffer terribly when you give birth. But you will still desire your husband, and he will rule over you.”
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ na nyɔnu la be, “Àdzi vi le fukpekpe kple vevesese geɖe me, gake srɔ̃wò ƒe nu aganyo ŋuwò kokoko, eye srɔ̃wò anye aƒetɔ na wò.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the man, “You listened to your wife and ate the fruit I told you not to eat. And so, the ground will be under a curse because of what you did. As long as you live, you will have to struggle to grow enough food.
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ na Adam be, “Esi nèɖo to srɔ̃wò, eye nèɖu kutsetse si ŋu mede se na mi le ta la, meƒo fi de anyigba ɖe tawò. “Le wò agbemeŋkekewo katã me la, àku kutri be yeakpɔ nuɖuɖu tso anyigba me.

english_verse: Your food will be plants, but the ground will produce thorns and thistles.
translation_verse: Anyigba ana ŋuwo kple aŋɔkawo namie na wò, eye nàɖu woƒe gbewo.

english_verse: You will sweat all your life to earn a living; you were made out of soil, and you will once again turn into soil.”
translation_verse: Àdze agbagba le wò agbemeŋkekewo katã me hafi akpɔ abolo aɖu va se ɖe esime nàku. Agatrɔ azu anyi, nu si wotsɔ wɔ wòe la; elabena anyi wotsɔ wɔ wòe, eye anyi ke nàgatrɔ azu.”

english_verse: The man Adam named his wife Eve because she would become the mother of all who live.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu la na ŋkɔ srɔ̃a be Eva si gɔmee nye “Agbenala,” elabena egblɔ be, “Eyae azu amegbetɔƒome blibo la dzila.”

english_verse: Then the Lord God made clothes out of animal skins for the man and his wife.
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu wɔ lãgbalẽwu do na Adam kple srɔ̃a.

english_verse: The Lord said, “They now know the difference between right and wrong, just as we do. But they must not be allowed to eat fruit from the tree that lets them live forever.”
translation_verse: Yehowa Mawu gblɔ be, “Esi ame la zu abe míawo ene, eye wònya nyui kple vɔ̃ la, nya kae adzɔ ne aɖu agbeti la, eye wòanɔ agbe tegbetegbe?”

english_verse: So the Lord God sent them out of the Garden of Eden, where they would have to work the ground from which the man had been made.
translation_verse: Esia ta Yehowa Mawu nyae ɖa tso Edenbɔ la me, eye wòɖoe ɖa be wòayi aɖade agble ɖe anyigba si me woɖee tsoe la dzi.

english_verse: Then God put winged creatures at the entrance to the garden and a flaming, flashing sword to guard the way to the life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Ale Mawu nya ame la, eye wòtsɔ mawudɔla sesẽ siwo wòde yi dadzowo asi na la da ɖe Edenbɔ la ƒe ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo be woadzɔ mɔ woato aɖo ta agbeti la gbɔ la nu.

english_verse: Adam and Eve had a son. Then Eve said, “I'll name him Cain because I got him with the help of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Adam dɔ kple srɔ̃a, Eva, eye wòfɔ fu dzi Kain. Eva gblɔ be, “To Yehowa ƒe amenuveve me la, medzi ŋutsu.”

english_verse: Later she had another son and named him Abel. Abel became a sheep farmer, but Cain farmed the land.
translation_verse: Eva gadzi ŋutsuvi bubu, eye wòna ŋkɔe be Abel. Abel nye lãnyila, eye Kain nye agbledela.

english_verse: One day, Cain gave part of his harvest to the Lord,
translation_verse: Le nuŋeɣi la, Kain tsɔ eƒe agblemenukuwo sa vɔ na Yehowa,

english_verse: but not with Cain and his offering. This made Cain so angry that he could not hide his feelings.
translation_verse: gake mexɔ Kain tɔ o. Nu sia na Kain xa nu, eye wòdo dɔmedzoe heɖo adã.

english_verse: The Lord said to Cain: What's wrong with you? Why do you look so angry?
translation_verse: Yehowa bia Kain be, “Nu ka ta nèdo dɔmedzoe vevie, eye nèyɔ mo ɖo?

english_verse: If you had done the right thing, you would be smiling. But you did the wrong thing, and now sin is waiting to attack you like a lion. Sin wants to destroy you, but don't let it!
translation_verse: Wò mo ate ŋu akɔ kple dzidzɔ ne ɖe nèwɔ nu si wòle be nàwɔ la! Ke esi nèwɔ vɔ̃ ta la, nu vɔ̃ le wò ʋɔtru nu le lalawòm be yeaɖu dziwò. Ke dze agbagba be nàɖu edzi!” Kain wu Abel eye Yehowa nyae

english_verse: Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let's go for a walk.” And when they were out in a field, Cain attacked and killed him.
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka la, Kain gblɔ na nɔvia, Abel be, “Na míayi gbedzi.” Esi woyi gbea dzi la, Kain wu nɔvia, Abel.

english_verse: Afterwards the Lord asked Cain, “Where is Abel?” “How should I know?” he answered. “Am I supposed to look after my brother?”
translation_verse: Emegbe la, Yehowa bia Kain be, “Afi ka nɔviwò, Abel le?” Kain ɖo eŋu be, “Nyemenya o. Nɔvinyeŋudzɔlae menyea?”

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Why have you done this terrible thing? You killed your own brother, and his blood flowed onto the ground. Now his blood is calling out for me to punish you.
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ nɛ be, “Nu kae nye esi nèwɔ? Kpɔ ɖa, nɔviwò ƒe ʋu do ɣli tso anyigba dzi va ɖo gbɔnye na hlɔ̃biabia.

english_verse: And so, I'll put you under a curse. Because you killed Abel and made his blood run out on the ground, you will never be able to farm it again.
translation_verse: Ke fifia fiƒode le dziwò, eye menya wò ɖa tso anyigba si nèdo gui kple nɔviwò ƒe ʋu la dzi.

english_verse: When you try to farm the land, it won't produce anything for you. From now on, you'll be without a home, and you'll spend the rest of your life wandering from place to place.
translation_verse: Anyigba maganyo nuku na wò o, ne èku kutri le edzi vevie gɔ̃ hã! Azɔ la, àzu tsaglãlatsala kple godzela le anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: “This punishment is too hard!” Cain said.
translation_verse: Kain ɖo eŋu na Yehowa be, “Nye tohehe kpe wu tsɔtsɔ nam,

english_verse: “You're making me leave my home and live far from you. I will have to wander about without a home, and just anyone could kill me.”
translation_verse: elabena ènyam ɖa tso nye agble kple wò ŋutɔ gbɔ, èwɔm tsaglãlatsala kple godzela, eye ame sia ame si akpɔm la, adi be yeawum.”

english_verse: “No!” the Lord answered. “Anyone who kills you will be punished seven times worse than I am punishing you.” So the Lord put a mark on Cain to warn everyone not to kill him.
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ nɛ be, “Womawu wò o, elabena mada wò tohehe teƒe adre ɖe ame si awu wò la dzi.” Ale Yehowa de dzesi tɔxɛ Kain ŋu si ana be ame aɖeke mawui o.

english_verse: But Cain had to go far from the Lord and live in the Land of Wandering, which is east of Eden. More and More People
translation_verse: Ale Kain dzo le Yehowa ƒe ŋkume, eye wòyi ɖanɔ Nodnyigba si le Edenbɔ ƒe ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo la dzi.

english_verse: One day, Lamech said to his two wives, “A young man wounded me, and I killed him.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “I won't let my life-giving breath remain in anyone forever. No one will live for more than
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa gblɔ be, “Mele be nye Gbɔgbɔ naganɔ amegbetɔwo me tegbee o, elabena amegbetɔwo wɔ nu vɔ̃ le goawo katã me. Woƒe agbemeŋkekewo anye ƒe alafa ɖeka kple blaeve.”

english_verse: The children of the supernatural beings who had married these women became famous heroes and warriors. They were called Nephilim and lived on the earth at that time and even later.
translation_verse: Le ɣe ma ɣi me kple emegbe gɔ̃ hã la, esime mawu viwo ɖea amegbetɔwo ƒe nyɔnuwo la, wo viwo zua ame dzɔatsuwo, eye ŋutinya geɖewo nɔ wo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord saw how bad the people on earth were and that everything they thought and planned was evil.
translation_verse: Esime Yehowa kpɔ ale si gbegbe amegbetɔwo vɔ̃ɖie, eye wòkpɔ be woƒe agbenɔnɔ ɖo ta nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ ko gbɔ la,

english_verse: He was sorry that he had made them,
