translation_verse: Tsɔ nubablaɖaka si me Se Ewoawo le la de eme, eye nàtsi xɔmetsovɔ la ale be wòaɣla nubablaɖaka la ɖe Kɔkɔeƒe ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe la.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, kɔ kplɔ̃ la da ɖe eme, nàkɔ kplɔ̃a ŋutinuwo da ɖe kplɔ̃ la dzi, nàtsɔ akaɖiti la de eme, eye nàsi akaɖiawo.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: “Kɔ sikavɔsamlekpui si dzi woado dzudzɔ ɖo la da ɖe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ. Tsi xɔmemɔnuvɔawo ɖe agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu,

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: eye nàkɔ numevɔsamlekpui la da ɖe agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu.

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: Kɔ tsileze la da ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpui la dome, eye nàku tsi ɖe eme.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, wɔ xɔxɔnu la ƒo xlã agbadɔ la godoo, eye nàtsi xɔmemɔnuvɔ la ɖe xɔxɔnu la ƒe mɔnu.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Hlẽ ami sisi la ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la kple eŋunuwo ŋuti, eye nàkɔ wo ŋu; ekema vɔsamlekpui la ŋuti akɔ nyuie.

english_verse: and with the bowl and its stand.
translation_verse: Si ami na tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ, eye nàwɔe kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Azɔ la, kplɔ Aron kple via ŋutsuwo va agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu eye nàle tsi na wo.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Do awu kɔkɔewo na Aron eye nàsi ami nɛ, akɔ eŋu be wòasubɔm abe nunɔla ene.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Emegbe la, nàkplɔ via ŋutsuwo vɛ, nàdo woƒe awuwo na wo,

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Le ƒe evelia ƒe ɣleti gbãtɔ ƒe ŋkeke gbãtɔ dzi la, wotu agbadɔ la.

english_verse: The posts, stands, and framework were put in place,
translation_verse: Mose kɔ zɔwo de sɔtiawo te, eye wòklã ʋuƒowo ɖe sɔtiawo ŋu.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Etsɔ kpe siwo dzi woŋlɔ Se Ewoawo ɖo la da ɖe nubablaɖaka la me, etsi aɖakatsɔtiawo ɖe eŋu, eye wòtsɔ sikanutunu, amenuveveteƒe la tu enu.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, ekɔ nubablaɖaka la va agbadɔ la me, eye wòtsɔ xɔmetsovɔ la xe eŋkume abe ale si Yehowa ɖo nɛ pɛpɛpɛ la ene.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ekɔ Kplɔ̃ la da ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la me le anyiehe lɔƒo, le xɔmetsovɔ la godo,

english_verse: The lampstand was put along the south wall,
translation_verse: Mose kɔ akaɖiti la da ɖe kplɔ̃ la kasa le agbadɔ la me le dziehe lɔƒo.

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: Esi akaɖiawo le Yehowa ŋkume le ɖoɖoawo nu,

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: eye wòkɔ sikavɔsamlekpui la da ɖe agbadɔ la me te ɖe xɔmetsovɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Etsɔ atike ʋeʋĩwo do dzudzɔ ɖe edzi abe ale si Yehowa ɖo nɛ ene.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Etsi xɔmemɔnuvɔ la ɖe agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu,

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: ekɔ numevɔsamlekpui la da ɖe gota te ɖe agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu ŋu, eye wòme numevɔsa kple nuɖuvɔsa le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe ale si Yehowa ɖo nɛ pɛpɛpɛ la ene.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Emegbe la, ekɔ tsileze la da ɖe Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la kple vɔsamlekpui la dome. Eku tsi ɖe eme wòyɔ ale be nunɔlawo ate ŋu awɔ eŋu dɔ le asikɔklɔ kple afɔkɔklɔ me.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron kple Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo klɔ woƒe asiwo kple afɔwo le afi sia.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ɣe sia ɣi si woato vɔsamlekpui la ŋu be yewoage ɖe agbadɔ la me la, wotɔna, klɔa asi kple afɔ, abe ale si Yehowa ɖo na Mose ene.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Mose tɔ kpɔ ƒo xlã nɔƒe la kple vɔsamlekpui la, eye wòtsi xɔmemɔnuvɔ ɖe nɔƒe la ƒe mɔnu. Ale Mose wu eƒe dɔ la nu mlɔeba. Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ agbadɔ la me

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Tete lilikpo la tsyɔ Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la dzi eye Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe yɔ eme.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Ne lilikpo la ho, eye wòɖe zɔ la, Israelviwo yia mɔzɔzɔ la dzi, dzea eyome.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Ke ne lilikpo la tɔ la, woawo hã wotɔna va se ɖe esime lilikpo la gaɖe zɔ.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe lilikpo la tɔna ɖe agbadɔ la dzi le ŋkeke me. Ke le zã me la, dzo klẽna le lilikpo la me, ale be Israelviwo katã nate ŋu akpɔe. Nu sia yi edzi le woƒe mɔzɔzɔwo katã me.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Ele be wòatsɔ eƒe asi ada ɖe numevɔsa la ƒe ta dzi, eye woaxɔ numevɔsa la ɖe vɔsalã la teƒe be wòalé avu ɖe enu.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ekema amea awu nyitsuvi la le afi ma le Yehowa ŋkume. Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo, ame siwo nye nunɔlawo la atsɔ ʋu la ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui si le agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu la ƒe axawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Ele nɛ be wòako numevɔsalã la eye wòaflii.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Aron ƒe viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la ado dzo ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye woaɖo nake ɖe dzo la dzi.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Amea aklɔ eƒe dɔmenuwo kple afɔwo, nunɔla la atɔ dzo wo ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye woazu numevɔsa kple dzovɔsa si ƒe ʋeʋẽ adze Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne vɔsa la nye numevɔsa tso alẽhawo alo gbɔ̃hawo dome la, ele nɛ be wòana atsua si ŋuti kpɔtsɔtsɔ mele o la.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ame si le vɔ la sam la awui le Yehowa ŋkume le vɔsamlekpui la ƒe anyiehe lɔƒo. Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo, ame siwo nye nunɔlawo la ahlẽ lã la ƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu akpe ɖo.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ke amea aklɔ dɔmenuawo kple afɔawo, eye nunɔlawo atɔ dzo wo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Anye numevɔsa kple dzovɔsa si ƒe ʋeʋẽ ado dzidzɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne nunana na Yehowa nye numevɔsa si woawɔ kple xevi la, ele be wòanye akpakpa alo ahɔnɛvi.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atsɔ xevi la ayi vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ, atro kɔ le enu, ana eƒe ʋu naɖuɖu ɖe anyi le vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axadzi, eye woame lã la le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la aɖe eƒe agbonu kple emenuwo, eye wòatsɔ wo aƒu gbe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo, afi si dzowɔ le la.

english_verse: Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, alé eƒe aʋalawo, eye wòafe xevi la me, gake eƒe aʋalawo maɖe ɖa le xevi la ŋu o. Azɔ la, nunɔla la atɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye wòanye vɔsa si adze Yehowa ŋu. Enye numevɔsa kple dzovɔsa si ƒe ʋeʋẽ adze Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: “ ‘Ame si di be yeasa nuɖuvɔ na Yehowa la atsɔ wɔ memee, akɔ ami kple dzudzɔdotike ɖe edzi,

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔe ana Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo, nunɔlawo. Nunɔla la aɖe wɔ memee la kple ami la ƒe asiʋlo ɖeka akpe ɖe dzudzɔdonuawo katã ŋuti, eye wòafiae abe ŋkuɖodzinu ene le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, wòanye numevɔsa, ʋeʋĩ lĩlĩlĩ si dzea Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ wɔ la ƒe mamlɛa ana Aron kple via ŋutsuwo abe woƒe nuɖuɖu ene; ke woabu esiawo katã abe nuɖuvɔsa kɔkɔe na Yehowa ene.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne wotsɔ abolo si wome le kpo me vɛ abe vɔsa na Yehowa ene la, ele be woamee kple wɔ memee kple ami, gake amɔʋãtike manɔ eme o. Woate ŋu atsɔ akpɔnɔ si wome kple wɔ maʋamaʋã, eye wokɔ ami ɖe edzi hã ana abe nuɖuvɔsa ene.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Ne woatɔ nane kple ami atsɔ ana abe nuɖuvɔsa ene la, woatsɔ wɔ memee maʋamaʋã atɔe.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Woaflii kakɛkakɛ, eye woakɔ ami ɖe edzi. Esia hã nye nuɖuvɔsa aɖe.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Ne wò nuɖuvɔsa nye nu si woɖa la, woaɖae kple wɔ memee, eye woakɔ ami ɖe edzi.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ne wò nuɖuvɔsa nye nu si wome le kpo me, tɔ alo mee le dzo dzi la, ele be nàtsɔ nuɖuvɔsa la ayi na nunɔla, eye eya atsɔe ayi vɔsamlekpui la dzi, eye eya atsɔe ana Yehowa.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaa atɔ dzo vɔsanu la ƒe akpa aɖe ko, ke Yehowa akpɔ ŋudzedze le vɔsanu blibo la ŋuti.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Vɔsanu mamlɛa nye Aron kple viawo tɔ, ke woabu wo katã abe numevɔsa kɔkɔe na Yehowa ene.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mele be amɔʋãtike nanɔ nuɖuvɔsa siwo mietsɔna vaa Yehowa ŋkume la me o, elabena mele be miatɔ dzo nuʋãtike alo anyitsi le dzovɔsa si miewɔna na Yehowa la me o.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Miate ŋu atsɔ wo vɛ na Yehowa abe nukuwo ƒe ŋgɔgbetɔwo ƒe nunanawo ene, gake mele be woatɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe nu si aʋẽ lĩlĩlĩ la ene o.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mide dze miaƒe nuɖuvɔsawo katã me. Migagbe nubabla ƒe dze si nye miaƒe Mawu tɔ dede miaƒe nuɖuvɔsawo me o; mide dze miaƒe vɔsawo katã me.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne ètsɔ nane tso wò agblemenuku gbãtɔwo me, awɔ nuɖuvɔsa na Yehowa la, ele na wò be nànyɔ bli la, nàtoe alo nàtɔe hafi atsɔ vɛ.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Kɔ ami ɖe edzi, eye nàkpe dzudzɔdonu ɖe eŋu, elabena nuɖuvɔsae.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ekema nunɔla la atɔ dzo bli gbagbã la kple amia ƒe ɖe kple dzudzɔdonu la katã abe dzovɔsa ene na Yehowa.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne ame aɖe di be yeasa akpedavɔ la, ate ŋu atsɔ nyitsu alo nyinɔ asa vɔ lae, gake lã la nade blibo ne woatsɔe asa vɔe na Yehowa.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ lã la vɛ la ada asi ɖe lã la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòawui le agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu. Aron ƒe viŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la ahlẽ ʋu la ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axawo ŋu.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu le lã la ƒe ali gbɔ kple esi le aklã la ŋu; aɖewo kple ayikuawo.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Nunɔlaawo atɔ dzo nu siawo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi hekpe ɖe numevɔsa la ŋu. Nuɖuvɔsa sia anye ʋeʋẽ lĩlĩlĩ si adze Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne wotsɔ gbɔ̃ alo alẽ sa akpedavɔe na Yehowa la, ele be wòade blibo; ate ŋu anye agbo alo alẽnɔ, gbɔ̃tsu alo gbɔ̃nɔ.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Nenye alẽvie wòatsɔ vɛ la, ele be wòatsɔe ava Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ele be wòada eƒe asi ɖe lã la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòawui le Mawu ƒe agbadɔ la ŋkume. Ekema Aron kple via ŋutsuwo ahlẽ ʋu la ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu kple aklã.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atɔ dzo nu siawo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi wòanye nuɖuvɔsa na Yehowa.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne ame aɖe tsɔ gbɔ̃ vɛ be yeasa vɔ na Yehowa la,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: atsɔ eƒe asi ada ɖe gbɔ̃ la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòawui le Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu. Aron viŋutsuwo ahlẽ eƒe ʋu ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axawo kple ene ŋu,

english_verse: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides,
translation_verse: eye wòatɔ dzo ami si le dɔ me nɛ

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: kple ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu te ɖe lã la ƒe ali ŋu kple ami si le lã la ƒe aklã ŋu la, esi woaɖe ɖa kple ayikuawo.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe nuɖuɖu ene, wòanye numevɔsa, wòanye nu si le ʋeʋẽm nyuie. Ami la katã nye Yehowa tɔ.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Esia nye se na mi tegbetegbe le miaƒe anyigba blibo la dzi be miekpɔ mɔ aɖu ami alo ʋu o.’ ”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ade eƒe asibidɛ ʋu la me, eye wòahlẽ ʋu la zi adre le Yehowa ŋkume ɖe xɔmetsovɔ si ma Kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe la me la ŋkume.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ada eƒe asi ɖe gbɔ̃ la ƒe ta dzi, awui le afi si wowua numevɔsalãwo le, eye wòatsɔe na Yehowa. Esiae nye eƒe nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ekema nunɔla la ade asibidɛ ʋu la me asisi ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, eye wòakɔ ʋua mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa gade se siawo na Mose:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be, ‘esiawoe nye se siwo ku ɖe ame siwo ada le Yehowa ƒe seawo dzi le ŋuɖeɖi me la ŋu.

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne nunɔla aɖe wɔ nu vɔ̃ le ŋuɖeɖi me, eye wòto esia me he fɔɖiɖi va ameawo dzi la, ele nɛ be wòatsɔ nyitsuvi fɛ̃ si de blibo la asa nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa na Yehowa.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Ele be wòakplɔ nyitsuvi fɛ̃ la ava Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu, atsɔ eƒe asi ada ɖe nyitsu la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòawui le afi ma le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Ekema nunɔla la atsɔ nyitsu la ƒe ʋu ayi Agbadɔ la me,

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, nunɔla la asisi ʋu la ƒe ɖe ɖe dzudzɔdovɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu le Yehowa ŋkume le Agbadɔ la me; atsɔ ʋua mamlɛa akɔ ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la te le Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: kple nyitsu la ƒe lã mamlɛa katã ayi asaɖa la godo, teƒe si ŋuti kɔ kple afi si wotsɔa afi ƒua gbe ɖo la, eye wòatɔ dzoe le nakedzo dzi le afi si woli kɔe la dzi.

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne Israel dukɔ blibo la wɔ nu vɔ̃ le ŋuɖeɖi me, eye wòwɔ nu si Yehowa de se na wo be womawɔ o la, ameawo katã ɖi fɔ.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ne wova dze si woƒe nu vɔ̃ la, woana nyitsu fɛ̃ aɖe hena nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa. Woatsɔ nyitsu la ava Agbadɔ la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Dukɔ la ƒe ametsitsiwo ada asi ɖe nyitsu la ƒe ta dzi, eye woawui le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atsɔ nyitsu la ƒe ʋu ayi Agbadɔ la me,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ade eƒe asibidɛ ʋu la me, eye wòahlẽe zi adre ɖe xɔmetsovɔ la ŋgɔ le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, asisi ʋu la ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu le Agbadɔ la me le Yehowa ŋkume, eye wòakɔ ʋua mamlɛa katã ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te le Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Azɔ la, nunɔla la atsɔ nyitsu la ayi asaɖa la godo, eye wòatɔ dzoe le afi ma abe ame ɖeka ƒe nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa wònye ene, evɔ la, nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa wònye ɖe dukɔ blibo la ta.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ne wova na wònya emegbe ko la, ele be wòatsɔ gbɔ̃tsu si de blibo la vɛ abe eƒe vɔsa ene.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ekema nunɔla la atsɔ nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsalã sia ƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe, atsɔ eƒe asibidɛ asisi ʋu la ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, eye wòakɔ ʋu la ƒe mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Woatɔ dzo lã la ƒe ami katã ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe akpedavɔsalã ƒe amie wònye ene. Ale nunɔla la alé avu ɖe dumegã si wɔ nu vɔ̃ la nu, eye Mawu atsɔ eƒe nu vɔ̃ akee.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne dukɔmevi aɖe da le Yehowa ƒe sewo dzi, gake menya be yewɔ nu vɔ̃ o la, eɖi fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ke ne eva nya teti ko la, ele nɛ be wòatsɔ gbɔ̃nɔ si de blibo la vɛ be yeatsɔe alé avui ɖe yeƒe nu vɔ̃ ta.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Atsɔe va afi si wowua numevɔsalãwo le, ada asi ɖe lã la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòawui.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Woaɖe ami siwo katã le dɔ me na lã la, abe ale si wowɔna le akpedavɔsa me ene, eye nunɔla la atɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Nu sia adze Yehowa ŋu. Ale nunɔla la alé avu ɖe amea nu, eye Mawu atsɔ eƒe nu vɔ̃ akee.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ke ne edi be yeasa vɔ la kple alẽ la, ekema ele be wòanye alẽnɔ si de blibo.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Akplɔe va afi si wowua numevɔsalãwo le, ada asi ɖe lã la ƒe ta dzi, eye wòawui abe nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsalã ene.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la ade asibidɛ vɔsaʋu la me asisi ɖe numevɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋuti, eye woakɔ ʋua ƒe mamlɛa katã ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Woawɔ lã la ƒe ami ŋu dɔ abe ale si wowɔa eŋu dɔ le akpedavɔsa me ene. Nunɔla la atɔ dzo lã la ƒe ami ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe ale si wowɔna kple vɔsanu bubu ɖe sia ɖe si wotɔa dzoe na Yehowa la ene. Ekema nunɔla la alé avu ɖe amea nu, eye Mawu atsɔ eƒe nu vɔ̃ akee.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Alo ne ede asi ame ƒe nu makɔmakɔ aɖe, nu sia nu si ana wòagblẽ kɔ ɖo la ŋu, togbɔ be menyae hafi o hã la, ne eva nya la, aɖi fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Le go siawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe me la, ele be wòaʋu eƒe nu vɔ̃ me,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: eye wòatsɔ alẽnɔ alo gbɔ̃nɔ asa nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa na Yehowa. Nunɔla la alé avu ɖe enu, ekema Mawu atsɔ eƒe nu vɔ̃ akee, eye mele be wòagawɔ ɖe atam si wòka la dzi o.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atsɔ xevi eveawo dometɔ si wotsɔ nɛ gbã la, asa nu vɔ̃ vɔsae. Atro kɔ le xevi la nu, gake mana eƒe kɔ naɖe le enu o.

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la ahlẽ ʋua ƒe ɖe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe axawo dzi, eye wòakɔ ʋua mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te. Esiae nye nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ne amea da ahe ale gbegbe be mate ŋu atsɔ akpakpawo alo ahɔnɛ fɛ̃wo asa nu vɔ̃ vɔe o la, ekema ana wɔ memee kilogram ɖeka. Mele be woakɔ ami ɖe edzi loo alo atsakae kple dzudzɔdonu o, elabena nu vɔ̃ vɔsae.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Atsɔe vɛ na nunɔla la; nunɔla la aɖe wɔ la ƒe asiʋlo ɖeka ɖe wɔ blibo la teƒe, eye wòatɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe dzovɔsa bubu ɖe sia ɖe na Yehowa ene. Esiae anye eƒe nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ale nunɔla la alé avu ɖe enu le nu vɔ̃ sia tɔgbi ɖe sia ɖe ta, eye Mawu atsɔe akee. Wɔ la ƒe mamlɛa azu nunɔla la tɔ abe ale si wowɔna le nuɖuvɔsa gome ene.’ ” Fɔɖivɔsa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe gblẽ kɔ ɖo, eye wòwɔ nu vɔ̃ le manyamanya me, ku ɖe Yehowa ƒe nu kɔkɔewo dometɔ aɖe ŋu la, abe tohehe ene la, alé agbo ɖeka le lãhawo dome vɛ na Yehowa, esi ŋuti kpɔtsɔtsɔ mele o la, eye eƒe home sɔ kple klosalo si wòle be wòana le Kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe nudanu nu. Enye fɔɖivɔsa na Yehowa.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ne ŋu ke la, nunɔla la ado eƒe awutewui kple eƒe dziwui, akplɔ numevɔsa la ƒe dzowɔ akɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la xa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: alo ne efɔ nu bubu aɖe, evɔ wòda alakpa le eŋuti alo wòka atam dzodzro alo wòwɔ nu vɔ̃ siawo dometɔ ɖeka si amewo awɔ,

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Nu siae nye nu si Aron kple via ŋutsuwo ana Yehowa le gbe si gbe woasi ami nɛ: wɔ memee kilogram ɖeka abe gbe sia gbe ƒe nuɖuvɔsa ene. Woatsɔ afã vɛ ŋdi, eye afã evelia le fiẽ.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ɖe sia ɖe le nunɔlawo dome kpɔ mɔ aɖu vɔsalã sia. Ke woawo koe kpɔ mɔ aɖui, elabena nu kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: “De se siawo na Aron kple via ŋutsuwo tso numevɔsa ŋuti, ‘Woagblẽ numevɔsa la ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzodoƒe, eye dzo nanɔ bibim le ete zã blibo la.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, aɖɔli eƒe awuwo, atsɔ dzowɔ la ayi teƒe si ŋuti kɔ le asaɖa la godo.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzo aganɔ bibim kokoko; mele be wòatsi o. Nunɔla la agade nake yeyewo dzo la me ŋdi sia ŋdi, eye wòatsɔ gbe sia gbe ƒe numevɔsa ada ɖe edzi, atɔ dzo gbe sia gbe ƒe ŋutifafavɔsa ƒe ami.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ele be dzo nanɔ bibim le vɔsamlekpui la dzi madzudzɔmadzudzɔe. Mele be wòatsi gbeɖe o.’ ” Nuɖuvɔsa

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: “Se siwo le nuɖuvɔsa ŋu la woe nye: ‘Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo atsi tsitre ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ, eye woasa vɔ la le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la aɖe wɔ memee la ƒe asiʋlo ɖeka, akɔ ami kple dzudzɔdonu ɖe edzi, eye wòatɔ dzoe le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe Yehowa tɔ ene tso nu si wotsɔ vɛ la me. Yehowa axɔe kple dzidzɔ gã.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Te gbe ɖe edzi na wo be, ne womee le abolokpo me la, amɔʋãtike manɔ eme o. Metsɔ numevɔ si wosa nam la ƒe akpa sia na nunɔlawo. Ke numevɔsa blibo la le kɔkɔe abe ale si nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa kple fɔɖivɔsa blibo la le ene.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ɖe sia ɖe si dzɔ tso Aron me, nunɔla ɖe sia ɖe, ate ŋu aɖui tso dzidzime yi dzidzime. Ke nunɔla siwo ŋuti kɔ koe kpɔ mɔ aɖu vɔsanu siwo wome na Yehowa.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ na Mose bena,

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Tsɔ ami tɔe le nutɔgba me wòabi nyuie ekema nàtsɔe vɛ na Yehowa wòanye vɔsa si dzea eŋu.

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Gblɔ na Aron kple via ŋutsuwo be se siwo le nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa ŋu la woe nye esiawo. “Vɔsa sia nye nu kɔkɔe. Woawu vɔsalã la le Yehowa ŋkume, afi si wowua numevɔsalãwo le.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Nunɔla si asa vɔ sia la aɖu vɔsalã la le Agbadɔ la ƒe kpɔ me.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ŋuti wokɔ, eye wozu nunɔlawo la koe kpɔ mɔ aka asi lã la ŋu. Ne ʋu hlẽ ɖe ame aɖe ƒe awu ŋu la, woanyae le teƒe kɔkɔe aɖe.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Ne wotsɔ vɔsalã la ƒe ʋu aɖe yi Agbadɔ la me, be woalé avu le Kɔkɔeƒe la la, ekema nunɔlawo mekpɔ mɔ aɖu vɔsalã la o. Woatɔ dzo lã blibo la le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atɔ dzo nu siawo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe fɔɖivɔsa ene na Yehowa.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ vɔsa sia ƒe akpa aɖe aɖo Yehowa ŋkume abe vɔsa tɔxɛ ene, ekema woatsɔe ana nunɔla si hlẽa vɔsalã ƒe ʋu.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Womaɖu lã si ƒe akpa aɖe ka nu makɔmakɔ aɖe ŋu o, ke boŋ woatɔ dzoe, eye ame si ƒe ŋuti kɔ la koe aɖu lã si wòate ŋu aɖu.

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: “Esiawoe nye se siwo ku ɖe fɔɖivɔsa ŋu. Nu kɔkɔe ƒe nu kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Woawu fɔɖivɔsalã la le afi si wowua numevɔsalãwo le, eye woatsɔ eƒe ʋu ahlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo akpe ɖo.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atsɔ lã la ƒe amiwo katã, eƒe asike, ami si le dɔmenuwo ŋu,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ayiku eveawo kple ami si le wo ŋu kple eƒe aklã asa vɔe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu siwo tso nunɔlawo ƒe ƒome me la koe aɖu lã la ƒe mamlɛa. Woaɖui le teƒe kɔkɔe aɖe, elabena vɔsa kɔkɔe wònye.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: “Se siawo kee le nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa kple fɔɖivɔsa siaa ŋu. Woatsɔ lã la ƒe mamlɛa ana nunɔla si wɔ avulévɔsa la wòanye eƒe nuɖuɖu.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Nenye numevɔsae la, ekema woatsɔ lã la ƒe agbalẽ hã ana nunɔla la.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nuɖuvɔsa bubuawo katã, ne wode ami wo, alo womede ami wo o hã, anye Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo katã tɔ.

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: “Esiawoe nye akpedavɔsa tɔxɛwo na Yehowa ŋu sewo:

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: “Nenye akpedada tae wole vɔ la sam ɖo la, ekema woatsɔ abolo si wowɔ kple amɔ maʋamaʋã la akpe ɖe vɔsalã la kple akaklɛ̃ si dzi wokɔ ami ɖo kple wɔ memee si woblu kple ami hetsɔ tɔ wɔkakloe la ŋu.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Le lã la tsɔtsɔ sa vɔe kple etsɔtsɔ na Yehowa abe ŋutifafavɔsa ene be woaɖe ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ kple akpedada tɔxɛ afia vɔ megbe la, woaɖu vɔsalã la gbe ma gbe ke, eye ɖeke matsi anyi ŋu nake o.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: “Ke ne ame aɖe tsɔ nane vɛ si menye akpedavɔsa o, ke boŋ wònye vɔsa ɖe atam si amea ka ta alo wònye lɔlɔ̃nununana la, ekema vɔsalã si womeɖu le ŋkeke si dzi wosa vɔ la le o la, woate ŋu aɖui ne ŋu ke.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Ne woɖu akpedavɔsalã la ƒe ɖe le ŋkeke etɔ̃a gbe la, womaxɔe nɛ o, womabui na ame si sa vɔ la o, elabena eŋuti mekɔ o, eye ame si aɖui la aɖi fɔ.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Woaɖe ame sia ame si aka asi nu makɔmakɔ aɖe ŋu, ne nu makɔmakɔ la tso amegbetɔ alo lã aɖe gbɔ, gake wòaɖu ŋutifafavɔsanu ƒe ɖe la le etɔwo dome, elabena eƒo ɖi nu si nye nu kɔkɔe la.’ ” Sedede be womaɖu lã ƒe ami kple ʋu o

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “De se na Israelviwo be, ‘Miekpɔ mɔ aɖu lã ƒe ami o, eɖanye nyi, alẽ alo gbɔ̃ ƒe ami o.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Miate ŋu awɔ lã si lé dɔ heku alo lã si lã wɔadã aɖe wu la ƒe ami ŋu dɔ le mɔ bubuwo nu, gake mimaɖui gbeɖegbeɖe o.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Woaɖe ame sia ame si aɖu lã si wome na Yehowa abe vɔsa ene ƒe ami la le Mawu ƒe ha me.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Eye afi sia afi si miele la, mele be miaɖu xevi alo lã aɖeke ƒe ʋu o.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ɖu ʋu la, woaɖee ɖa le eƒe amewo dome.’ ” Nunɔlawo ƒe ɖuƒe

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Yehowa gagblɔ na Mose be,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ele be wòatsɔ vɔsalã la ƒe ami kple eƒe akɔ vɛ, eye woanye wo le yame le vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ si fia be wotsɔ wo na Yehowa.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Nunɔla la atɔ dzo ami la le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, ke lã la ƒe akɔ anye Aron kple via ŋutsuwo tɔ.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aron ƒe viŋutsu si atsɔ akpedavɔsalã la ƒe ʋu kple ami ana la axɔ lã la ƒe ɖusita,

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: elabena metia lã la ƒe akɔ kple ata be woanye Israelviwo ƒe nunana na Aron. Ele be woatsɔ vɔsalãwo ƒe akpa siawo ana Aron kple via ŋutsuwo ɣe sia ɣi.”

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Yehowa de se siawo na Mose le Sinai to dzi, be wòana Israelviwo nanya ale si woasa vɔe na Yehowa le Sinai gbedzi.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Mose tsɔ agbo la ƒe akɔ, eye wòtsɔe na Yehowa to enyenye le yame le vɔsamlekpui la ŋgɔ me. Ameŋukɔkɔ ƒe agbo la ƒe akpa siae nye Mose tɔ abe ale si Yehowa ɖoe ene.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ na Mose be,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Kplɔ Aron kple via ŋutsuwo vɛ, nàtsɔ woƒe awuwo, ami sisi la, nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsanyitsu la, agbo eveawo kple kusi si me abolo maʋamaʋã le,

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: eye nàna ameha blibo la naƒo ƒu ɖe Mawu ƒe Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu.”

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Ale Mose gblɔ na ƒuƒoƒe la be, “Ale Yehowa ɖo nam be mawɔe nye esi.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Mose na Aron kple via ŋutsuwo te va eye wòle tsi na wo,

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Edo akɔtatsyɔnu la hã nɛ, eye wòtsɔ nu si wotsɔna bia gbe Mawui, “Urim” kple “Tumim,” de akɔtatsyɔnu la ƒe kotoku me.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, etsɔ tablanu la bla ta nɛ, eye wòtsi sikaŋgoblanu kɔkɔe la ɖe tablanu la ŋu le ŋgɔgbe abe ale si Yehowa de se nɛ ene.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, Mose tsɔ ami sisi la, eye wòwui ɖe Agbadɔ la kple nu sia nu si le eme la ŋu, eye wòkɔ wo ŋuti.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Esi wòɖo vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ la, ewu ami sisi la ɖe eŋu zi adre, eye wògawui ɖe nu siwo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi kple tsileze la kple eƒe zɔ ŋu hekɔ wo ŋu.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, eɖo Aron nunɔlae to amikɔkɔ ɖe ta me nɛ me, eye to esia hã me wòkɔ eŋu.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Le esia yome la, Mose do awu na Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo, bla alidziblanuawo na wo, eye wòɖɔ kuku la na wo abe ale si Yehowa gblɔ nɛ ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Mose lé nyitsu la hena nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa la. Aron kple via ŋutsuwo da asi ɖe nyitsu la ƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Mose wu nyitsu la, tsɔ eƒe ʋu ƒe ɖe, eye wòtsɔ eƒe asibidɛ sisi ʋua ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo katã ŋu be yeakɔ vɔsamlekpui la ŋuti. Ekɔ ʋua mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te. Ale wòkɔ eŋuti, eye wòwɔe wòanye avuléle nɛ.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Mose ɖe ami siwo katã le dɔmenuawo, aklã kple ayiku eveawo ŋu, eye wòtɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Etɔ dzo nyitsu la ƒe lã mamlɛa, eƒe agbalẽ kple dɔmenuwo le asaɖa la godo abe ale si Yehowa gblɔ nɛ ene.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Emegbe la, etsɔ agbo la hena numevɔsasa na Yehowa. Aron kple via ŋutsuwo da woƒe asiwo ɖe agbo la ƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose wui, eye wòhlẽ ʋu la ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋuti godoo.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, etsɔ tsi klɔ agbo la ƒe dɔmenuwo kple afɔwo, eye wòtɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Ale agbo blibo la fia le Yehowa ŋkume. Esia nye numevɔsa si dze Yehowa ŋu ŋutɔ, elabena Mose zɔ ɖe nu siwo katã Yehowa ɖo nɛ be wòawɔ la dzi pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Mose trɔ ɖe agbo evelia si nye ameŋukɔkɔ ƒe agbo la ŋu. Aron kple via ŋutsuwo da woƒe asiwo ɖe agbo la ƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Mose wui, eye wòsisi ʋua ɖe Aron ƒe nuɖusito, eƒe asi ƒe adegblefetsu ɖusitɔ kple eƒe ɖusifɔ ƒe adegblefetsu ŋu.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Le esia yome la, esisi ʋua ɖe Aron ƒe viŋutsuwo ƒe ɖusitowo, woƒe asi adegblefetsu ɖusitɔwo kple woƒe ɖusifɔwo ƒe adegblefetsu ŋu, eye wòhlẽ ʋua mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Mose tsɔ agbo la ƒe ami, asike la, ami si le dɔmenuwo ŋu, aklã kple ayiku eveawo kple wo ŋu miwo kpe ɖe eƒe ɖusita ŋu.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nu siwo wòtsɔ da ɖe agbo la ƒe lã ƒe akpa siawo dzi la woe nye abolo maʋamaʋã ɖeka si tso kusi si wotsɔ ɖo Yehowa ŋkume la me, abolo si wode amii kple akpɔnɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose tsɔ nu siawo katã de asi na Aron kple via ŋutsuwo, eye wonye wo le yame abe vɔsa tɔxɛ na Yehowa ene.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Mose gaxɔ nu siawo le wo si, eye wòtɔ dzo wo kpe ɖe numevɔsa la ŋuti na Yehowa le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Vɔsa sia dze Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose tsɔ ami sisi la azɔ kple ʋu si wòhlẽ ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu la ƒe ɖe, eye wòhlẽe ɖe Aron kple via ŋutsuwo kple woƒe awuwo ŋu. Ale wòkɔ Aron kple via ŋutsuwo kple woƒe awuwo ŋu, be Yehowa nawɔ wo ŋu dɔ.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, Mose gblɔ na Aron kple via ŋutsuwo be, “Miɖa lã la le Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu, eye miaɖui kple abolo si le ameŋukɔkɔ ƒe kusi la me abe ale si Yehowa de se na mi ene.

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Mitɔ dzo lã la kple aboloawo ƒe mamlɛawo.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: “Minɔ Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu ŋkeke adre, eye le ŋkeke adreawo megbe la, miawu miaƒe ŋutikɔkɔ nu, elabena ŋkeke adree wòaxɔ.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Nu siwo katã wowɔ egbe la, Yehowae de se be woawɔ wo hena miaƒe ŋutikɔkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Ele be mianɔ Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu zã kple keli ŋkeke adre, eye miawɔ nu siwo Yehowa de se na mi be miawɔ. Ne miewɔe o la, miaku. Esiawoe nye se siwo Yehowa de nam.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Ale Aron kple via ŋutsuwo wɔ nu siwo katã Yehowa ɖo na Mose.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Le ŋutikɔkɔ ƒe ŋkeke enyia gbe la, Mose yɔ Aron kple via ŋutsuwo kple Israel ƒe ametsitsiwo,

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: eye wògblɔ na Aron be wòalé nyitsu ɖeka tso nyiha la me hena nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa kple agbo ɖeka hena numevɔsa, eye wòasa vɔ le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Mose yi edzi be, “Gblɔ na Israelviwo be woatia gbɔ̃tsu ɖeka hena woƒe nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa kple nyivi ɖeka kple alẽvi ɖeka, lã siwo de blibo hena woƒe numevɔsa.

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: Kpe ɖe esia ŋu la, woatsɔ nyitsu ɖeka kple agbo ɖeka asa akpedavɔ, eye woatsɔ wɔ si woblu kple ami la asa nuɖuvɔ na Yehowa, elabena egbe la, Yehowa aɖe eɖokui afia wo.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ale ameawo tsɔ nu siawo katã va Agbadɔ la ƒe mɔnu, abe ale si Mose gblɔ na wo la ene, eye ameawo tsi tsitre ɖe afi ma le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na ameawo be, “Ne miewɔ Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖowo dzi la, eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe aɖe eɖokui afia mi.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aron be wòate ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, eye wòasa nu vɔ̃ vɔsa kple numevɔ, alé avu gbã ɖe eɖokui ta, eye emegbe la, ɖe ame bubuawo ta abe ale si Yehowa ɖo ene.

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Ale Aron te ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu, eye wòtsɔ nyivi la wɔ nu vɔ̃ vɔsae ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe nu vɔ̃wo ta.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Via ŋutsuwo tsɔ ʋu la nɛ. Ede asi eme, sisii ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo ŋu, eye wòkɔ mamlɛa ɖe vɔsamlekpui la te.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, etɔ dzo nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsalã la ƒe ami, ayikuawo kple aklã la le vɔsamlekpui la dzi, abe ale si Yehowa ɖo na Mose ene.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Etɔ dzo lã la kple eƒe agbalẽ le asaɖa la godo.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Nu si kplɔ esia ɖo lae nye Aron wu numevɔsalã la. Via ŋutsuwo tsɔ ʋua nɛ, eye wòhlẽe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Wofli lã la tsɔ vɛ nɛ kpe ɖe lã la ƒe ta ŋu. Etɔ dzo wo katã le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Ekpala dɔmenuawo kple afɔawo, eye wòtɔ dzo wo ɖe vɔsamlekpui la dzi abe numevɔsa ene.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, etsɔ ameawo ƒe nunanawo sa vɔe. Ewu gbɔ̃tsu la, eye wòtsɔe sa vɔe abe ale si wòsa nu vɔ̃ vɔsa ɖe eɖokui ta ene.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Ale wòsa numevɔ la na Yehowa, le se siwo wòde nɛ la nu.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, esa nuɖuvɔ la. Eku wɔ la ƒe asiʋlo ɖeka, eye wòtɔ dzoe kpe ɖe gbe sia gbe ƒe ŋdivɔsa ŋu le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, ewu nyitsu la kple agbo si ameawo tsɔ vɛ la na akpedavɔsa. Aron viŋutsuwo tsɔ lãawo ƒe ʋu vɛ, eye wòhlẽe ɖe vɔsamlekpui la ŋu godoo.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Eɖe nyitsu la kple agbo la ƒe amiwo, ami siwo le ayikuawo ŋu kpe ɖe esiwo le woƒe dɔmenuwo ŋu la ŋuti, eye wògaɖe woƒe ayikuwo kple aklãwo hã.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Ke Aron nye lãawo ƒe akɔwo kple ɖusitawo le yame le Yehowa ŋkume abe wo tsɔtsɔ na Mawu ƒe dzesi ene, abe ale si Mose ɖo nɛ ene.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, Aron wu eƒe asiwo dzi ɖe dukɔ la dzi, yra wo; eye esi wòsa nu vɔ̃ vɔ, numevɔ, kple akpedavɔ vɔ la, eɖi le vɔsamlekpui la dzi.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron woyi Agbadɔ la me, eye esi wodo go la, woyra ameawo. Tete Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖe eɖokui fia ameha blibo la,

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: eye dzo tso Yehowa gbɔ fia numevɔsa la kple amiawo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Esi ameawo kpɔe la, wo katã wodo dzidzɔɣli, eye wotsyɔ mo anyi le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Ke Aron ƒe viŋutsu eve, Nadab kple Abihu, ɖe dzo makɔmakɔ ɖe woƒe dzudzɔdosonuwo me, ɖe dzudzɔdonu kɔ ɖe dzo la dzi, eye wodo dzudzɔ na Yehowa. Nu sia mesɔ ɖe se si Yehowa de na wo la dzi o,

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: eya ta dzo tso Yehowa gbɔ, eye wòtsrɔ̃ wo; ale woku le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Tete Mose gblɔ na Aron be, “Esiae Yehowa gblɔ esi wògblɔ be, ‘Maɖe ɖokuinye afia ame siwo tena ɖe ŋutinye la kɔkɔe eye woade bubu ŋunye le amewo katã ŋkume.’ ” Eye Aron zi ɖoɖoe kpoo.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Mose yɔ Misael kple Elzafan, wo tɔɖia Uziel ƒe viŋutsuwo eye wògblɔ na wo be, “Miyi miakɔ mia nɔviwo ƒe ŋutilã fiafiawo tso Agbadɔ la ŋkume yi ɖada ɖe asaɖa la godo.”

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aron kple Via ŋutsu eve, Eleaza kple Itamar be, “Migafa ame kukuawo o, eye migagblẽ miaƒe ɖa ɖi mavumavui abe konyifafa ƒe dzesi ene o; migadze miaƒe awuwo hã o. english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Ke miawo ya la, mele be miadzo le Agbadɔ la nu o. Ne miedzo la, miaku elabena Yehowa ƒe ami si wosi na mi la gale mia dzi.” Eye wowɔ se si Mose de na wo la dzi.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ na Aron bena,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Wò kple viwò ŋutsuwo, migano wain alo aha muame aɖeke ne miele Mawu ƒe Agbadɔ me yi ge o. Ne mienoe la, miaku. Esia nye ɖoɖo mavɔ hena dzidzime siwo gbɔna.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Wò dɔdeasiwo anye be mialé avu ɖe amewo nu, miafia vovototo siwo le nu kɔkɔewo kple nu makɔmakɔwo, nu siwo dza kple nu siwo medza o la dome,

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: eye miafia Israelviwo se siwo katã Yehowa de na mi to Mose dzi la ameawo.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Mose gblɔ na Aron kple Via ŋutsu eve siwo susɔ, Eleaza kple Itamar be, “Mitsɔ nuɖuvɔsa si susɔ esi woɖe wɔ asiʋlo ɖeka le eŋu na Yehowa le vɔsamlekpui la dzi; miakpɔ egbɔ be amɔʋãtike mele eme o, eye miaɖui le vɔsamlekpui la gbɔ. Vɔsa sia nye nu kɔkɔe,

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: eya ta miaɖui le Kɔkɔeƒe la. Miawo kple mia viwo tɔe wònye tso vɔsa si wome na Yehowa la me, elabena eyae nye se si wode nam.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. translation_verse: “Ele be ameawo natsɔ ata si woɖe ɖe aga kple akɔ si wona esi wotɔ dzo amiawo la vɛ. Woatsɔ wo ana Yehowa to wo nyenye le yame me. Ekema woazu wò kple viwòwo tɔ, elabena esiae nye Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖo.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Ebia wo be, “Nu ka ta mieɖu nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa la, si nye nu kɔkɔe ƒe nu kɔkɔe la le teƒe kɔkɔe la o, le esime wotsɔe na mi be miatsɔ aɖe ameawo ƒe nu vɔ̃wo kple dzidadawo ɖa, eye mialé avu le woawo kple Yehowa dome?

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Ke Aron xɔ nya ɖe wo nu le Mose gbɔ hegblɔ be, “Wosa woƒe nu vɔ̃ vɔsa kple numevɔ le Yehowa ŋkume; ke nenye ɖe meɖu nu vɔ̃ ŋuti vɔsa la egbe la, ɖe wòadze Yehowa ŋua?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, miaƒe Mawu. Minɔ dzadzɛe le nu siawo ŋuti, eye mianɔ kɔkɔe, elabena kɔkɔetɔe menye. Eya ta migaƒo ɖi mia ɖokuiwo to asikaka nu siwo tana le anyigba la dometɔ aɖeke ŋu me o.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Elabena nyee nye Yehowa si kplɔ mi tso Egiptenyigba dzi be manye miaƒe Mawu. Ele na mi be mianɔ kɔkɔe, elabena kɔkɔetɔe menye.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ na Mose kple Aron bena,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe kpɔ nutete alo dzi alo teƒe aɖe si fu le eƒe ŋutilã ŋu si ate ŋu azu ŋutilã ƒe dɔxɔleameŋu la, woakplɔe ayi nunɔla Aron alo Via ŋutsu siwo nye nunɔlawo la dometɔ ɖeka gbɔ.
