translation_verse: Ke Satana bia Mawu be, “Ɖe Hiob vɔ̃a Mawu dzodzroa?

english_verse: “You are like a wall protecting not only him, but his entire family and all his property. You make him successful in whatever he does, and his flocks and herds are everywhere.
translation_verse: Menye wòe tɔ kpɔ ƒo xlã eya amea, eƒemetɔwo kple nu sia nu si le esi la oa? Èyra eƒe asinudɔwo ale be eƒe alẽhawo kple lãhawo gbagbã ɖe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Try taking away everything he owns, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Ke do wò asi ɖa, ne nàxlã asi ɖe nu siwo katã le esi, ekema le nyateƒe me aƒo fi ade wò le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋkume.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “All right, Satan, do what you want with anything that belongs to him, but don't harm Job.” Then Satan left. Job Loses Everything
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ na Satana be, “Enyo ta, nu sia nu si le esi la le asiwò me, ke mègaka asibidɛ eya amea ŋutɔ ŋu o.” Ale Satana dzo le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: Job's sons and daughters were having a feast in the home of his oldest son,
translation_verse: Gbe ɖeka la, esime Hiob ƒe viŋutsuwo kple via nyɔnuwo nɔ nu ɖum, nɔ wain nom le wo nɔvi tsitsitɔ ƒe aƒe me la,

english_verse: when someone rushed up to Job and said, “While your servants were plowing with your oxen, and your donkeys were nearby eating grass,
translation_verse: dɔla aɖe va Hiob gbɔ gblɔ nɛ be, “Nyiawo nɔ agble ŋlɔm, tedziawo nɔ gbe ɖum le wo gbɔ lɔƒo,

english_verse: a gang of Sabeans attacked and stole the oxen and donkeys! Your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: kasia Sebeatɔwo va dze wo dzi kplɔ wo dzoe. Wowu dɔlawo kple yi eye nye ɖeka koe te ŋu si be mava gblɔe na wò!”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a second one came running and said, “God sent down a fire that killed your sheep and your servants. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Esi wòganɔ nu ƒom ko la, dɔla bubu va eye wògblɔ be, “Mawu ƒe dzo ge tso dziƒo eye wòfia alẽawo kple dɔlawo, nye ɖeka koe si be mava gblɔe na wò!”

english_verse: Before that servant finished speaking, a third one raced up and said, “Three gangs of Chaldeans attacked and stole your camels! All of your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Esi mekpɔ ɖe nu le nya la me o la, dɔla bubu va gblɔ be, “Kaldeatɔwo ƒe adzoha etɔ̃ va dze wò kposɔwo dzi eye wolé wo dzoe. Wowu dɔlawo kple yi, nye ɖeka koe te ŋu si be mava gblɔe na wò!”

english_verse: That servant was still speaking, when a fourth one dashed up and said, “Your children were having a feast and drinking wine at the home of your oldest son,
translation_verse: Esi ame sia hã mekpɔ ɖe nu le nya si gblɔm wònɔ me o la, dɔla bubu ge ɖe eme eye wògblɔ be, “Viwò ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo nɔ nu ɖum, nɔ wain nom le wo nɔvi tsitsitɔ ƒe aƒe me.

english_verse: when suddenly a windstorm from the desert blew the house down, crushing all of your children. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.”
translation_verse: Kasia ya sesẽ aɖe ƒo tso gbegbe va lɔ xɔ la ƒe dzogoe eneawo ɖe me. Tete xɔ la mu dze wo dzi eye woku; nye ɖeka koe te ŋu si be mava gblɔe na wò!”

english_verse: When Job heard this, he tore his clothes and shaved his head because of his great sorrow. He knelt on the ground, then worshiped God
translation_verse: Esi Hiob se esia la, etso hedze eƒe awu ʋlaya eye wòlũ eƒe taɖa. Edze klo de ta agu,

english_verse: and said: “We bring nothing at birth; we take nothing with us at death. The Lord alone gives and takes. Praise the name of the Lord!”
translation_verse: hedo gbe ɖa be, “Amamae menɔ hafi do go tso danye ƒe dɔ me, eye amamae manɔ hafi atrɔ adzo. Yehowae na eye Yehowae gaxɔe; woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ!”

english_verse: In spite of everything, Job did not sin or accuse God of doing wrong.
translation_verse: Le esiawo katã me la, Hiob mewɔ nu vɔ̃ to fɔbubu Mawu me be ewɔ nu gbegblẽ o.

english_verse: When the angels gathered around the Lord again, Satan was there with them,
translation_verse: Gbe bubu gbe la, dziƒodɔlawo va do ɖe Yehowa ŋkume eye Satana hã va do kpli wo ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋkume.

english_verse: and the Lord asked, “Satan, where have you been?” Satan replied, “I have been going all over the earth.”
translation_verse: Yehowa bia Satana be, “Afi ka nètso va do?” Satana ɖo eŋu be, “Metso tsatsa ge le anyigba dzi eye menɔ yiyim, nɔ gbɔgbɔm le edzi.”

english_verse: Then the Lord asked, “What do you think of my servant Job? No one on earth is like him—he is a truly good person, who respects me and refuses to do evil. And he hasn't changed, even though you persuaded me to destroy him for no reason.”
translation_verse: Tete Yehowa bia Satana be, “Èlé ŋku ɖe nye dɔla Hiob ŋua? Ame aɖeke mele anyigba dzi de enu o, enye ame maɖifɔ kple ame dzɔdzɔe, ame si vɔ̃a Yehowa eye wòtsri vɔ̃. Togbɔ be ède adã menye ɖe eŋu be magblẽ edome esi mewɔ naneke o hã la, egalé eƒe blibodede la me ɖe asi ko.”

english_verse: Satan answered, “There's no pain like your own. People will do anything to stay alive.
translation_verse: Satana ɖo eŋu na Yehowa be, “Ŋutilã ɖe ŋutilã teƒe, ekema ame atsɔ nu sia nu si le esi la katã ana ɖe eƒe agbe ta.

english_verse: Try striking Job's own body with pain, and he will curse you to your face.”
translation_verse: Do wò asi ɖa eye nàtu nu kple eƒe ŋutilã kple eƒe ƒuwo, ekema nàkpɔe ɖa be mado ɖiŋu na wò le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋkume o mahã?”

english_verse: “All right!” the Lord replied. “Make Job suffer as much as you want, but just don't kill him.”
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ na Satana be, “Enyo ŋutɔ. Kpɔ ɖa, ele asiwò me, gake mègaka asi eƒe agbe ya ŋu o.”

english_verse: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.
translation_verse: Ale Satana dzo le Yehowa ŋkume hekplɔ abi vɔ̃ɖi aɖewo ƒu Hiob, tso eƒe afɔgɔme va se ɖe eƒe dzodome.

english_verse: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery,
translation_verse: Tete Hiob tsɔ ze kakɛ nɔ ŋuti kum esi wònɔ anyi ɖe afi me.

english_verse: his wife asked, “Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die?”
translation_verse: Srɔ̃a va egbɔ biae be, “Ɖe nègalé wò blibodede la me ɖe asi koa? Do ɖiŋu na Mawu ne nàku!”

english_verse: Job replied, “Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well.” In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God. Job's Three Friends
translation_verse: Hiob ɖo eŋu nɛ be, “Èle nu ƒom abe nyɔnu bometsila ene. Ɖe míaxɔ nu nyuiwo ko tso Mawu gbɔ eye menye vɔ̃ hã oa?” Le nu siawo katã me la, Hiob mewɔ nu vɔ̃ le eƒe nuƒoƒo me o. Hiob xɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah were three of Job's friends, and they heard about his troubles. So they agreed to visit Job and comfort him.
translation_verse: Esi Hiob xɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo, Temanitɔ Elifaz, Suhitɔ, Bildad kple Naamatitɔ, Zofar se dzɔgbevɔ̃e siwo katã dzɔ ɖe Hiob dzi la wodze mɔ tso woƒe aƒewo me le ŋkeke si woɖo ɖi la dzi be woaɖafa nɛ eye woafa akɔ nɛ.

english_verse: When they came near enough to see Job, they could hardly recognize him. And in their great sorrow, they tore their clothes, then sprinkled dust on their heads and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Esi wokpɔe le adzɔge la, womete ŋu dze sii o, ale wowo avi gboo kple ɣli, wodze woƒe awu ʋlayawo eye wolɔ ke kɔ ɖe tame.

english_verse: For seven days and nights, they sat silently on the ground beside him, because they realized what terrible pain he was in.
translation_verse: Ale wonɔ anyi ɖe egbɔ le anyigba ŋkeke adre kple zã adre sɔŋ. Ame aɖeke mebia nya aɖekee o elabena wokpɔ ale si wònɔ veve semii.

english_verse: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, Hiob ke nu eye wòƒo fi de eƒe dzigbe.

english_verse: Blot out the day of my birth and the night when my parents created a son.
translation_verse: “Ŋkeke si dzi wodzim la netsrɔ̃, nenema ke nye zã si me wogblɔ be, ‘Wodzi viŋutsu na mí!’

english_verse: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.
translation_verse: Viviti kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi negaxɔe, lilikpo netsyɔ edzi eye blukɔ nedo ɖe eƒe kekeli dzi.

english_verse: Erase that night from the calendar and conceal it with darkness.
translation_verse: Viviti tsiɖitsiɖi nexɔ zã ma eye womegaxlẽe ɖe ƒea ƒe ŋkekewo me alo woadee ɣleti aɖeke ƒe ŋkekewo me o.

english_verse: Don't let children be created or joyful shouts be heard ever again in that night.
translation_verse: Zã ma netsi ko eye dzidzɔɣli aɖeke megaɖi le eme o.

english_verse: Darken its morning stars and remove all hope of light,
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋukeɣletiviwo nedo viviti, kekeli si lalam wòle la megado nɛ o eye megakpɔ fɔŋli ƒe ɣetotoe gbãtɔwo o,

english_verse: because it let me be born into a world of trouble. Why Didn't I Die at Birth?
translation_verse: elabena metu vidzidɔ ƒe ʋɔtruwo ɖe nunye, be nye ŋkuwo makpɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e o.

english_verse: Why was I accepted and allowed to nurse at my mother's breast?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta ata aɖewo le klalo be woakɔm ɖe akɔ eye no aɖewo li be mano?

english_verse: Now I would be at peace in the silent world below
translation_verse: Anye ne memlɔ anyi le ŋutifafa me, le alɔ̃ dɔm, le ɖiɖim ɖe eme.

english_verse: and with rulers once rich with silver and gold.
translation_verse: Anye ne mele dziɖula siwo si sika le eye woƒe aƒewo me yɔ fũu kple klosalo la gbɔ.

english_verse: I wish I had been born dead and then buried, never to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Alo nu ka ta womeɖim ɖe tome abe fu gege ene, abe vidzĩ si mekpɔ ɣe kpɔ o la ene o?

english_verse: In the world of the dead, the wicked and the weary rest without a worry. *
translation_verse: Afi ma ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzudzɔa nyanyra le eye afi ma ame siwo nu ti kɔ na la le gbɔgbɔm ɖe eme le.

english_verse: where captives and slaves are free at last. Why Does God Let Me Live?
translation_verse: Ame gblɔewo kple amegãwo siaa le afi ma eye kluvi kpɔa ablɔɖe tso eƒe aƒetɔ ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Why does God let me live when life is miserable and so bitter?
translation_verse: “Nu ka tae kekeli klẽna na ayaɖulawo eye wònaa agbe luʋɔ si le nu xam?

english_verse: I keep longing for death more than I would seek a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta wòna agbe ame siwo le ku dim, evɔ mevana na wo o kple ame siwo le edim vevie wu kesinɔnu si woɣla

english_verse: Nothing could make me happier than to be in the grave.
translation_verse: kple ame siwo kpɔa dzidzɔ, tsoa aseye ne woɖo yɔdo me?

english_verse: Why do I go on living when God has me surrounded, and I can't see the road?
translation_verse: Nu ka ŋutie wòna agbe ame si ƒe mɔwo le ɣaɣla kple ame si ŋuti Mawu tɔ kpɔ ɖo?

english_verse: Moaning and groaning are my food and drink,
translation_verse: Elabena hũɖeɖe xɔ ɖe nuɖuɖu teƒe eye nye ŋeŋe ƒona ɖi abe tsi ene.

english_verse: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.
translation_verse: Nyemekpɔ ŋutifafa, tomefafa alo gbɔɖeme aɖeke o, negbe ʋunyaʋunya ko.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Tete Temanitɔ Elifaz ɖo eŋu na Hiob be,

english_verse: You respect God and live right, so don't lose hope!
translation_verse: Ɖe wò Mawuvɔvɔ̃ manye wò dzideƒo eye wò blibodede nanye wò mɔkpɔkpɔ oa?

english_verse: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble,
translation_verse: Abe ale si mede dzesii ene la, ame siwo ŋlɔ vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi ƒe agble eye woƒã dzɔgbevɔ̃e lae ŋenɛ.

english_verse: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.
translation_verse: Ne Mawu gbɔ ɖe wo dzi la woyrɔna eye ne eƒe dziku fla la wotsrɔ̃na.

english_verse: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth,
translation_verse: Dzatawo aɖe gbe, axlɔ̃ sesĩe gake woate ŋu aŋe aɖu na dzataviwo.

english_verse: they starve, and their children are scattered. A Secret Was Told to Me
translation_verse: Dzata kuna ne mekpɔ nu lé o eye dzatanɔwo kakana.

english_verse: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—
translation_verse: “Wotsɔ nya aɖe vɛ nam le adzame, nye towo see wotsɔe do dalĩ nam.

english_verse: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;
translation_verse: Le drɔ̃ewo me le zã me, esi amewo dɔ alɔ̃ yi eme ʋĩi la,

english_verse: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ aɖe ɖo asagba va to nye ŋkume yi eye ɖadoe ɖo to ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say,
translation_verse: Etɔ gake nyemate ŋu agblɔ nu si wònye o. Nɔnɔme aɖe va tsi tsitre ɖe ŋkunye me eye mese gbe bɔlɔe aɖe be,

english_verse: “No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.
translation_verse: ‘Ɖe ame kodzogbea anɔ dzɔdzɔe wu Mawua? Ɖe amegbetɔ anɔ dzadzɛe wu eƒe Wɔlaa?

english_verse: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
translation_verse: Ne Mawu meka ɖe eƒe dɔlawo dzi o eye wòbua fɔ eƒe dɔlawo be woda vo,

english_verse: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
translation_verse: ʋuu keke, ke wòahanye ame siwo le anyixɔwo me, ame siwo gɔme woɖo anyi ɖe ke me eye wogbãa wo bɔbɔe abe ŋɔvi ene!

english_verse: Born after daybreak, you die before nightfall and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Wogbãa wo gudugudu le fɔŋli kple zã dome, ame aɖeke menyana gɔ̃ hã o, ale wotsrɔ̃na gbidii.

english_verse: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
translation_verse: Ɖe womehoa woƒe agbadɔkawo, ale be woaku numanyamanyae oa?’ ”

english_verse: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
translation_verse: “Ne àlɔ̃ la, yɔ ame aɖe gake ame kae atɔ na wò? Kɔkɔetɔwo dometɔ ka ŋu nàtrɔ ɖo?

english_verse: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
translation_verse: Tosesẽ wua bometsila eye ŋubiã wua numanyala.

english_verse: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ mekpɔ bometsila wònɔ ke tom gake kasia woƒo fi de eƒe aƒe.

english_verse: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
translation_verse: Elabena fukpekpe medoa go tso ke me alo dzɔgbevɔ̃e medona tso anyigba tume o.

english_verse: it's all part of life, like sparks shooting skyward.
translation_verse: Gake abe ale si dzoxi dzona yia dzii ene la, nenemae wodzi ame na hiãtuame.

english_verse: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
translation_verse: “Ke nenye nyee wònye la, anye ne maɖe kuku na Mawu atsɔ nye nya aɖo eƒe ŋkume.

english_verse: His miracles are marvelous, more than we can count.
translation_verse: Ewɔa dzesi siwo gɔme womate ŋu ase o eye wòwɔa nukunu siwo womate ŋu axlẽ o.

english_verse: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
translation_verse: Enana tsi dzana ɖe anyigba dzi, eye wòɖoa tsi ɖe gbegbe.

english_verse: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
translation_verse: Edoa ɖokuibɔbɔlawo ɖe dzi eye wòkɔa ame siwo le nu xam la dana ɖe dziɖeɖi me.

english_verse: in their own evil schemes, and their wisdom fails.
translation_verse: Eléa nunyalawo le woƒe ayemenuwɔwɔwo me eye wòkplɔa ame drãwo ƒe nu drã wɔwɔ dzonae.

english_verse: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
translation_verse: Viviti dona ɖe wo le ŋkeke me eye wotsaa asi blukɔ me abe zã mee ene.

english_verse: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
translation_verse: Eɖea hiãtɔwo tso yi si le woƒe nu me la me eye wòɖea wo le ŋusẽtɔwo ƒe fego me.

english_verse: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
translation_verse: Ale mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖoa hiãtɔ si eye nu madzɔmadzɔ miaa eƒe nu.

english_verse: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.
translation_verse: “Woayra ŋutsu si Mawu ɖɔna ɖo eya ta mègado vlo Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe amehehe o.

english_verse: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
translation_verse: Elabena edea abi ame ŋu eye wògablanɛ, ewɔa nuvevi ame gake eƒe asi yɔa dɔ.

english_verse: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
translation_verse: Aɖe wò le dzɔgbevɔ̃e ade me eye le adrelia me la, vɔ̃ aɖeke mawɔ wò o.

english_verse: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Aɖe wò le ku ƒe asi me le dɔŋɔli eye le aʋa me la, aɖe wò le yi ƒe asi me.

english_verse: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
translation_verse: Aɖe wò le aɖeɖiƒoame me, eye màvɔ̃ ne gbegblẽ va o.

english_verse: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
translation_verse: Wò la àko nu ne gbegblẽ kple dɔwuame le nu gblẽm eye màvɔ̃ anyigbadzilã wɔadãwo o.

english_verse: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
translation_verse: Elabena wò kple kpe siwo le agble me la miabla nu eye lã wɔadãwo anɔ anyi kpli wò le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.
translation_verse: Ànyae be wò agbadɔ le dedie eye ne èxlẽ wò nunɔamesiwo la, àkpɔe be ɖeke mebu o.

english_verse: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
translation_verse: Ànyae be viwòwo asɔ gbɔ eye wò dzidzimeviwo asɔ agbɔ abe gbe mumu le anyigba dzi ene.

english_verse: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
translation_verse: Ànɔ agbe wòade edeƒe, ayi yɔ me kple dzidzɔ abe lu ye woxa hebla le nuŋeɣi ene.

english_verse: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
translation_verse: “Míedo esia kpɔ eye wònye nyateƒe. Eya ta see ne nànɔ agbe ɖe eŋu.”

english_verse: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!
translation_verse: “Ne ɖe woada nye vevesese eye woada nye fukpekpewo ɖe nudanu me ɖe!

english_verse: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
translation_verse: Vavã woakpe wu ke si katã le ƒuta, eya ta mewɔ nuku be nye nyawo mele ame ŋu dzem o.

english_verse: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
translation_verse: Ɖe gbetedzi xlɔ̃na ne ele gbe mumu gbɔ alo nyi xlɔ̃na ne wotsɔ gbe ƒuƒu nɛ be wòaɖua?

english_verse: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
translation_verse: Ɖe woaɖu nu vɔvɔ dzemademee alo ɖe koklozi ƒe ɣia vivinaa?

english_verse: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
translation_verse: Megbe be nyemaɖui o, nuɖuɖu mawo tɔgbi ɖe wònana medzea dɔ.

english_verse: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
translation_verse: Ekema esia aganye akɔfafa nam ko kple nye dzidzɔ le vevesese si nu mele tsotsom o la me be, nyemagbe nu le Kɔkɔetɔ la ƒe nyawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Why should I patiently hope when my strength is gone?
translation_verse: “Ŋusẽ kae gale asinye be maganɔ mɔ kpɔm? Mɔnukpɔkpɔ kawoe gali ta magbɔ dzi ɖi?

english_verse: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
translation_verse: Kpe ƒe ŋusẽe le asinyea? Akɔblie nye nye ŋutilãa?

english_verse: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋusẽ aɖe le asinye be makpe ɖe ɖokuinye ŋu, esi azɔ la wonya dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ ɖa le ŋunyea?

english_verse: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
translation_verse: “Ele na xɔlɔ̃wo be woakpe ɖe ame si ƒo dzi ɖe le la ŋu togbɔ be egbe nu le Ŋusẽkatãtɔ vɔvɔ̃ gbɔ hã.

english_verse: then suddenly disappear in the summer heat.
translation_verse: gake eƒe sisi nu tsona ne kuɖiɣi ɖo eye dzoxɔxɔ nana wòmiena la ene.

english_verse: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
translation_verse: Asihawo ɖea asi le woƒe mɔwo ŋu hedzea gbe toa tagba eye wokuna ɖe mɔ dzi.

english_verse: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
translation_verse: Azɔ miawo hã mieɖee fia be, mienye ŋudɔwɔnu aɖeke o, miekpɔ nu si ŋu ŋɔdzi le eye mievɔ̃.

english_verse: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
translation_verse: Ɖe megblɔ kpɔ be, ‘Mina nane ɖe nunye, mixe fe ɖe tanye tso miaƒe kesinɔnuwo me,

english_verse: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?
translation_verse: miɖem le ketɔ la ƒe asi me alo mixɔm le ŋutasẽla ƒe fegomea?’

english_verse: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
translation_verse: “Mifia num eye mazi ɖoɖoe; mifia afi si meda ƒu le lam.

english_verse: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
translation_verse: Aleke nyateƒenyawo mehe venae o! Ke nu ka miaƒe nyahehewo ɖe fia?

english_verse: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
translation_verse: Ɖe miedi be yewoaɖɔ nya si megblɔ la ɖo eye miawɔ ame si ƒo dzi ɖe le la ƒe nyawo abe yaƒoƒo enea?

english_verse: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!
translation_verse: Miadzidze nu gɔ̃ hã ɖe tsyɔ̃eviwo dzi eye miatsɔ mia xɔlɔ̃wo gɔ̃ hã aɖɔli nue.

english_verse: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
translation_verse: “Azɔ la, minyo dɔ me miatrɔ mo ɖe gbɔnye, ɖe mate ŋu ada alakpa le mia ŋkumea?

english_verse: Stop accusing me falsely; my reputation is at stake.
translation_verse: Miɖe asi, migawɔ nu madzɔmadzɔ o migbugbɔ bu eŋuti elabena nye nuteƒewɔwɔ ɖo xaxa me.

english_verse: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
translation_verse: Ɖe vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi aɖe le nye nuyiwo dzia? Ɖe nye nu made dzesi beble oa?”

english_verse: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
translation_verse: Abe ale si kluvi dina be zã nedo kaba alo agbatetsɔla kpɔa mɔ na eƒe fetu vevie ene la,

english_verse: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
translation_verse: nenemae wotsɔ ɣleti siwo me fukpekpe le kple zã siwo me hiãtuame le la nam.

english_verse: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.
translation_verse: Ne memlɔ anyi la, nye susu gblɔna be, ‘Ɣe ka ɣi gɔ̃e mele fɔfɔ ge?’ Zã didina eye meƒoa togotogoe le aba dzi va se ɖe fɔŋli.

english_verse: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
translation_verse: Nye ŋutilã dze abi kple nyẽ helé dzɔbu eye nye ŋutigbalẽ wó gblogblogblo hele tsi ƒaƒã tsyɔm.

english_verse: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
translation_verse: “Nye ŋkekewo le du ɖim wu avɔlɔ̃ʋu eye wowua enu mɔkpɔkpɔmanɔmee.

english_verse: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
translation_verse: O Mawu, ɖo ŋku edzi be, nye agbe la, ƒuƒu ko wònye, nye ŋkuwo magakpɔ dzidzɔŋkekewo akpɔ o.

english_verse: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
translation_verse: Ŋku si le kpɔyem fifia la magakpɔm akpɔ o, miadim eye nyemanɔ anyi o.

english_verse: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
translation_verse: Abe ale si lilikpo buna eye enu va yinae ene la, nenemae ame si yi tsiẽƒe la megagbɔna o.

english_verse: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Magatrɔ ava eƒe aƒe me akpɔ o, eye eƒe nɔƒe hã magadze sii o.

english_verse: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.
translation_verse: “Eya ta nyemazi ɖoɖoe o, maƒo nu tso nye gbɔgbɔ ƒe vevesese me, eye mafa konyi le nye luʋɔ ƒe nuxaxa me.

english_verse: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
translation_verse: Nyee nye atsiaƒu alo lã dziŋɔ si le atsiaƒu ƒe gogloƒe be, nèɖe dzɔlawo ɖo ŋunyea?

english_verse: but you torture me with terrible dreams. *
translation_verse: ekema ètsɔa drɔ̃ewo doa vɔvɔ̃ nam eye nètsɔa ŋutegawo doa ŋɔdzi nam.

english_verse: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.
translation_verse: Ale be melɔ̃ kudɔƒoƒo kple ku wu nye ŋutilã sia.

english_verse: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
translation_verse: Menyɔ ŋu nye agbe, nyemanɔ agbe ɖaa o. Ɖe asi le ŋunye, viɖe mele nye ŋkekewo ŋu o.

english_verse: What makes you so concerned about us humans?
translation_verse: “Nu kae nye amegbetɔ be nèdo kɔkɔe alea, be nètsɔ ɖe le eme nɛ nenema gbegbe,

english_verse: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
translation_verse: be nèléa ŋku ɖe eŋu ŋdi sia ŋdi eye nèdonɛ kpɔ aɖabaƒoƒo ɖe sia ɖe?

english_verse: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
translation_verse: Ɖe màgaɖe ŋku ɖa le ŋunye alo ana gbɔdzɔem aɖabaƒoƒo ɖeka hɔ̃ɔ gɔ̃ hã oa?

english_verse: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
translation_verse: Ne mewɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖe, O amegbetɔwo ŋu dzɔla, nu ka mehewɔ ɖe ŋutiwò? Nu ka ŋuti nède dzesim heɖe ŋku tɔm ale? Ɖe mezu agba ɖe dziwòa?

english_verse: Why do you refuse to forgive? Soon you won't find me, because I'll be dead.
translation_verse: Nu ka ta mèɖe ŋku ɖa le nye dzidadawo ŋu eye mètsɔ nye nu vɔ̃wo kem o? Elabena esusɔ vie mamlɔ ke me, àdim gake nyemaganɔ anyii o.”

english_verse: How long will you talk and keep saying nothing?
translation_verse: “Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣie nànɔ nya siawo gblɔm? Wò nyawo nye yaƒoƒo sesẽ ɖeɖe ko.

english_verse: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu atso afia ŋkunɔa? Ɖe Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la atrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe abua?

english_verse: So why don't you turn to him
translation_verse: Gake ne àkpɔ Mawu dzi ɖa, aƒo koko na Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la,

english_verse: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
translation_verse: ekema ne èle dzadzɛe, le dzɔdzɔe, fifia gɔ̃ hã la, atso le tawò eye wòagaɖo wò te, ada wò ɖe teƒe si wòle be nànɔ.

english_verse: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
translation_verse: Wò gɔmedzedze anɔ sue gake emegbe àdzi asɔ gbɔ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.
translation_verse: “Bia dzidzime siwo do ŋgɔ, eye nàkpɔe ɖa be nu ka wo fofowo srɔ̃ mahã,

english_verse: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
translation_verse: elabena míawo la, etsɔviwo míenye, míenya naneke o eye míaƒe ŋkekewo le anyigba dzi le abe vɔvɔli ko ene.

english_verse: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
translation_verse: Esi wogale mumu ko eye womeɖo sisi me haɖe o la, woyrɔna kaba wu gbe si le gbedzi.

english_verse: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
translation_verse: Aleae wòvaa emee na ame siwo katã ŋlɔ Mawu be eye nenemae Mawumavɔ̃lawo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ tsrɔ̃nae.

english_verse: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
translation_verse: Nu si ŋu wòɖo dzi ɖo la meɖo ŋusẽ o eye nu si wòde mee la nye yiyiɖɔ.

english_verse: they take hold and fall because it's so flimsy.
translation_verse: Ede me eƒe ɖɔ eye wòlã, eku ɖe eŋu, gake etso ɖe eƒe asi me.

english_verse: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
translation_verse: Ɖeko wòle abe ati si wode tsii nyuie le ŋdɔgbe ene ekekea eƒe alɔwo ɖe abɔa me,

english_verse: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
translation_verse: eƒe kewo blana ɖe agakpe geɖewo ŋu eye wodia teƒe le kpewo dome.

english_verse: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
translation_verse: Gake ne wohoe le enɔƒe la, teƒe la gbea nu le egbɔ eye wògblɔna be, ‘Nyemekpɔ wò kpɔ o.’

english_verse: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
translation_verse: Vavã eƒe agbe yrɔna eye atiku bubuwo miena ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
translation_verse: “Enye nyateƒe be Mawu megbea ame si ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o alo doa ŋusẽ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ƒe asi o.

english_verse: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, agana nukoko nayɔ wò nu me fũu, eye wòatsɔ dzidzɔɣli ayɔ wò nuyiwo nu.

english_verse: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe alé wò futɔwo eye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe agbadɔwo maganɔ anyi o.”

english_verse: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
translation_verse: “Vavã menya be esia nye nyateƒe, gake aleke amegbetɔ kodzogbea anɔ dzɔdzɔe le Mawu ŋkumee?

english_verse: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be anye ame ƒe didi be yeahe nya kplii hã la, mate ŋu aɖo nya ɖeka pɛ hã ŋu nɛ le nya akpe dome o.

english_verse: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
translation_verse: Eƒe nunya de to, eƒe ŋusẽ keke ta, ame kae tso ɖe eŋu kpɔ gbe abixɔxɔ?

english_verse: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
translation_verse: Emli towo ɖa gake womenya o eye wòtrɔ wo bu anyi le eƒe dziku me.

english_verse: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
translation_verse: Eʋuʋu anyigba le enɔƒe eye wòna eƒe sɔtiwo ʋuʋu kpekpekpe.

english_verse: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
translation_verse: Eƒoa nu na ɣe eye meklẽna o, etsɔa nu xea ɣletiviwo ŋkume ale be womeklẽna o.

english_verse: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
translation_verse: Eya ɖekae keke dziƒowo me eye wòzɔa ƒutsotsoewo dzi.

english_verse: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
translation_verse: Eyae wɔ ɣletivi siwo woyɔna be, Avutɔ, Koklovinɔ kple Atifieŋu kple dzieheɣletiviwo.

english_verse: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nu dzɔtsu siwo me dzodzro meli o eye wòwɔ nukunu siwo mele xexlẽme o.

english_verse: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
translation_verse: Mawu meɖoa asi eƒe dziku dzi o, Rahab ƒe aʋakɔwo gɔ̃ hã bɔbɔ ɖe eƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
translation_verse: “Eya ta aleke nye ya mate ŋu aɖe ɖeklemie? Afi ka makpɔ nyawo le atsɔ ahe nya kplii?

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Ne meyɔe eye wòtɔ nam gɔ̃ hã la, nyemebu be aɖo tom o.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: Atsɔ ahomya agbãm gudugudu eye wòadzi nye abiwo ɖe edzi dzodzro.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Maɖe mɔ nam be magakpɔ gbɔdzɔe o, ke boŋ ana vevesese nakpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Ne ŋusẽ ƒe nya wònye la, kpɔ ɖa, ŋusẽtɔe wònye! Ke ne enye ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe nya la, ame kae akplɔe ayi ʋɔnui?

english_verse: Even if I were innocent, God would prove me wrong.
translation_verse: Ne nyemeɖi fɔ o gɔ̃ hã la, nye nu abu fɔm, eye ne nyemedze agɔ o hã la, abu fɔm.

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: “Togbɔ be nyemeɖi fɔ o hã la, nyemetsɔ ɖeke le eme na ɖokuinye o eye medo vlo nye ŋutɔ nye agbe.

english_verse: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
translation_verse: Wo katã le ɖeka eya ta megblɔ be, ‘Etsrɔ̃a ame maɖifɔ kple ame vɔ̃ɖi la siaa.’

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Ne ameƒoti he ku vɛ kpata la, eɖea alɔme le ame maɖifɔ ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ bubu ŋuti.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Ne anyigba aɖe ge ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe asi me la, ekema etsyɔa nu mo na eƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo. Ne menye eyae o ɖe, ekema ame kae?

english_verse: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.
translation_verse: “Nye ŋkekewo le du ɖim wu duƒula, wodzo dzo kabakaba dzidzɔ aɖeke manɔmee.

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Wozɔ mii va yi abe aƒlaʋuwo ene eye abe hɔ̃woe de agba anyi be yewoaƒo nu le anyigba ene.

english_verse: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
translation_verse: Ne megblɔ be, ‘Maŋlɔ nye konyifafa be eye madzudzɔ adãɖoɖo, aɖo nukomo la,’

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: ekema nye fukpekpewo katã doa ŋɔdzi nam elabena menyae be màbum fɔmaɖilae o.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Esi wobum fɔɖilae xoxo ɖe, nu ka tae maganɔ ʋiʋlim dzodzro?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Ne mele tsi kple tsiledzalẽ eye metsɔ nunyadzalẽ klɔ asi gɔ̃ hã la,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: aganyrɔm ɖe anyiʋe me, ale be manyɔ ŋu na nye awuwo gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: “Menye amee wònye abe nye ene ne maɖo nya ŋu nɛ, be makplɔe ayi ʋɔnui ahe nya kplii o.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ɖe wòli aƒo nu le mía dome, ada asi ɖe mí ame evea dzi

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: ame si aɖe Mawu ƒe ameƒoti ɖa le ŋutinye, ale be eƒe ŋɔdzi magado vɔvɔ̃ nam o la, ne anyo.

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: Ekema maƒo nu na eya amea mavɔmavɔ̃e, gake abe ale si wòle nam fifia ene la, nyemate ŋui o.”

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: “Nye agbe le ŋu nyɔm na nye ŋutɔ, eya ta maɖe asi le nye konyifafa ŋu wòado bababa eye maƒo nu le nye luʋɔ ƒe vevesese me.

english_verse: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
translation_verse: Ɖe wòle nuwò vivim be yele teyem ɖe to, be nètsɔ wò asinudɔwɔwɔ ƒu gbe eye nèle alɔgbɔnu kom na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ɖoɖowoa?

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Ŋutilãmeŋkue le tawòa? Ɖe nèkpɔa nu abe ale si amegbetɔ kodzogbea kpɔa nu enea?

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: be nàtsa adi nye vodadawo, aku nye nu vɔ̃wo gɔme,

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: evɔ nènya be nyemedze agɔ o eye ame aɖeke mate ŋu axɔm le wò asi me oa?

english_verse: Will you now destroy someone you created?
translation_verse: “ ‘Wò asiwoe wɔm eye womem. Ɖe nàtrɔ azɔ atsrɔ̃ma?

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku edzi be anyie nètsɔ mem. Ɖe nàgatrɔm azɔ mazu anyia?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: Ɖe mètrɔm kɔ ɖe anyi abe notsi ene eye nèna mebla abe notsi babla ene oa?

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: Ɖe mèfa ayi kple lãkusi ɖe ŋunye eye nètem ƒo ƒu ɖe nye ƒuwo kple lãmekawo ŋuti oa?

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Èna agbem henyo dɔ me nam eye le wò ametakpɔkpɔ la ta nèdzɔ nye gbɔgbɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: Ne mewɔ nu vɔ̃ la, wò ŋkuwo anɔ ŋutinye eye màgbe tohehe nam le nye vodada ta o.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Ne mefɔ mo dzi la, ekema èɖeam ɖe nu abe dzata ene eye nèɖea wò ŋusẽ dziŋɔ la fiana ɖe ŋutinye.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Èɖoa ɖasefo bubuwo ŋunye eye nèdoa dziku ɖe ŋutinye ɖe edzi, ale wò aʋakɔwo tsona ɖe ŋunye ɖe wo nɔewo yome abe ƒutsotsoewo ene.

english_verse: and been carried to the grave without ever breathing.
translation_verse: Ɖe nyemedzɔ o alo wokɔm tso danye ƒe dɔ me yi yɔdo mee la, ne enyo ta!

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: Ɖe nye ŋkeke ʋɛawo mewu nu kloe vɔ oa? Ɖe mo ɖa le ŋunye ale be nye hã makpɔ dzidzɔ vi aɖe,

english_verse: before I travel to the land
translation_verse: hafi ayi demagbɔnugbe, ne mayi ɖe viviti kple blukɔ ƒe anyigba dzi,

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Naamatitɔ, Zofar ɖo eŋu na Hiob be,

english_verse: So much foolish talk cannot go unanswered.
translation_verse: “Ɖe woagbe nya siawo ŋu ɖoɖo na wòa? Ɖe woabe nyawɔla sia tɔ dzɔa?

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò nya dzodzro siawo ade ga nu na amewoa? Ɖe ame aɖeke meli aka mo na wò ne èle fewu ɖum oa?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ègblɔ na Mawu be ‘Kpɔtsɔtsɔ mele nu siwo dzi mexɔ se la ŋu o eye medza le ŋkuwòme.’

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: ne wòaɖe nunya ƒe nu ɣaɣlawo afia wò elabena mo evee li na nunya. Vavã, nya esia be: Mawu ŋlɔ wò nu vɔ̃wo dometɔ aɖewo be gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Wokɔkɔ wu dziƒowo, nu ka nàte ŋu awɔ? Wogoglo wu tsiẽƒe ƒe gogloƒewo, nu ka nènya?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: “Ke hã la, ne ètsɔ wò dzi nɛ blibo, ne èwu wò asiwo dzi do ɖe egbɔ,

translation_verse: ekema àkɔ wò mo dzi ŋukpemanɔmee, ànɔ te sesĩe eye mavɔ̃ o.

translation_verse: Tete Hiob ɖo eŋu nɛ be,

translation_verse: “Mewɔ nuku be miawo koe nye amewo eye ne mieku la nunya aku kpli mi o!

translation_verse: Gake susu le asinye abe miawo ke ene. Mienyo wum o. Ame ka menya nu siawo katã o?

translation_verse: “Togbɔ be meyɔ Mawu eye wòtɔ nam hã la, mezu nu ɖikokoe na xɔ̃nyewo. Togbɔ be mele dzɔdzɔe eye fɔɖiɖi mele ŋunye o hã la, mezu alɔmeɖenu na wo!

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu siwo li le dziɖeɖi me la do vlo dzɔgbevɔ̃etɔ eye nenema ke woawɔ na ame siwo ƒe afɔ ɖiɖi.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Adzohawo ƒe agbadɔwo li le ŋutifafa me eye ame siwo do dziku na Mawu la li le dedinɔnɔ me. Nenema kee nye ame siwo tsɔa woƒe mawu ɖe woƒe asi me.

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: “Ke bia gbemelãwo, ne woafia nu wò alo dziƒoxeviwo, ne woagblɔe na wò.

translation_verse: Nu siawo katã dometɔ kae menyae be, Yehowa ƒe asie wɔ esiawo katã o?

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Ɖe to medoa nyawo kpɔ abe ale si aɖe ɖɔa nuɖuɖu kpɔe ene oa?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye amegãɖeɖiwo gbɔe nunya tso aƒe ɖo oa? Ɖe agbe didi mehea gɔmesese vɛ oa?

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: “Mawu tɔe nye nunya kple ŋusẽ; aɖaŋudede kple gɔmesese hã nye etɔ.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Nu si wògbã kɔ ɖi la, womagate ŋu agbugbɔ atui o. Ame si wòde gaxɔ me la, womate ŋu aɖe asi le eŋu o.

english_verse: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
translation_verse: Ne eɖo asi tsidzadza dzi la, ku ɖina, ne egaɖe asi le eŋu fũu hã la, eɖea anyigba

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Etɔe nye ŋusẽ kple dziɖuɖu, ame si woble kple ameblela katã wonye etɔ.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Ekplɔa dumegãwo dzonae amama eye wònana Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo zua bometsilawo.

translation_verse: Edoa ŋunyɔ bubumewo eye wòxɔa lãnu le kalẽtɔwo si.

english_verse: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
translation_verse: Exɔa susu le anyigbadzifiawo si eye wònana wonɔa tsaglalã tsam le gbegbe.

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: “Nye ŋkuwo kpɔ nu siawo katã, nye towo se wo eye wose wo gɔme.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Nu si nènya la, nye hã menyae, mède ŋgɔ wum o.

english_verse: But I prefer to argue my case with God All-Powerful—
translation_verse: Gake medi vevie be maƒo nu kple Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la eye mahe nya kple Mawu.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Ke miawo la, miele ŋunye gblẽm kple aʋatsonyawo, mi katã mienye gbedala siwo ŋu viɖe aɖeke mele o!

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Ne mi katã miahaɖo to ɖe! Le mia gbɔ la, esia anye nunya.

english_verse: and listen to my argument.
translation_verse: Mise ɖokuinyenuɖeɖe azɔ, mise nye nuyiwo ƒe kokoƒoƒo.

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Ɖe miebe yewoade edzia? Ɖe miebe yewoaxɔ nya ɖe Mawu nua?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Anyo na mi ne edo mi kpɔa? Miate ŋu ablee abe ale si miable amewo enea?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Le nyateƒe me, aka mo na mi, ne miede edzi le adzame.

english_verse: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
translation_verse: Ɖe eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe mado ŋɔdzi na mi oa? Ɖe eƒe ŋɔdzi malé mi oa?

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Miaƒe nya tsitsiwo nye lododo gbɔlowo eye dedinɔnɔ ƒe gli siwo mieɖo la nye anyigliwo ko.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: “Mizi ɖoɖoe ne miana mɔm maƒo nu, ekema nu si be yeadzɔ ɖe dzinye la nedzɔ.

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Nu ka ŋuti metsɔ ɖokuinye de xaxa me eye metsɔ nye agbe ɖo nye asiƒome?

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ele wu ye ge hã la, matsɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ ada ɖe eya amea dzi ko. Le nyateƒe me maʋu go nye mɔwo ɖe ŋkume nɛ.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Vavã esia ava zu ɖeɖe nam elabena mawumavɔ̃la aɖeke mate kpɔ be yeado ɖe eŋkume o!

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Azɔ meɖo nye nyawo ɖe ɖoɖo nu vɔ, menya be tɔnye adzɔ godoo.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Ɖe ame aɖe ate ŋu atsɔ nya ɖe ŋunyea? Ne ame aɖe ate ŋui la, ekema mazi ɖoɖoe aku.

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: “O Mawu, nu eve siawo ko medi be nàwɔ nam, eye nyemaɣla ɖokuinye ɖe wò o.

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Ekema yɔm eye matɔ alo maƒo nu eye nàɖo eŋu.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ kple nu gbegblẽ nenie mewɔ? Ɖe nye vodada kple nu vɔ̃ fiam.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Nu ka tae nèɣla wò mo eye nèbum wò futɔe?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Ɖe nàwɔ funyafunya aŋgba si ya lɔ ɖe nua? Ɖe nàti atsa yomea?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Elabena èŋlɔ nu vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖi ɖe ŋunye eye nèna nye ɖekakpuimenu vɔ̃wo va dzinye.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: Ède gakɔsɔkɔsɔ nye afɔwo, wò ŋkuwo le nye toƒewo katã ŋu eye nède dzesi nye afɔƒome.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: “Ale mevɔ le eme abe nu si ƒaƒã alo avɔ si gbagblaʋui ɖu la ene.”

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔ si nyɔnu dzi ƒe agbemeŋkekewo le kpuie eye woyɔ fũu kple fukpekpe.

english_verse: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.
translation_verse: Ekena abe seƒoƒo ene eye wòyrɔna, ele abe vɔvɔli si dzona kaba eye metɔna ɖi o la ene.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Ɖe nàke ŋku ɖe esia tɔgbi ŋua? Ɖe nàkplɔe va ʋɔnui le ŋkuwòmea?

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Èɖo ame ƒe ŋkekewo ɖi xoxo; èɖo eƒe ɣletiwo da ɖi eye nèɖo liƒo siwo dzi mate ŋu agbɔ o la ɖi nɛ.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: Eya ta ɖe ŋku ɖa le eŋu eye nàɖe asi le eŋu va se ɖe esime eƒe ɣeyiɣi de abe agbatedɔwɔla ene.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: “Mɔkpɔkpɔ li na ati gɔ̃ hã, ne wolãe la, egadzena yeyee eye eƒe alɔ yeyeawo nu matsi o.

translation_verse: ke hã la, ne tsi nya ʋẽ ɖee ko la, egadzena eye wòtoa alɔwo abe ati si wodo ene.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;

translation_verse: nenemae amegbetɔ mlɔa anyie eye megafɔna o va se ɖe esime dziƒo nu ava yi. Amegbetɔwo magafɔ alo anyɔ tso woƒe alɔ̃dɔdɔ me o.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: “O, ne ɖe nàɣlam ɖe yɔdo me, atsyɔ nu dzinye va se ɖe esime wò dziku nu va yi ɖe! Alo nàɖo ɣeyiɣi nam eye emegbe nàɖo ŋku dzinye ɖe!

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Ne ame ku la, ɖe wòaganɔ agbea? Le nye ɣeyiɣi sesẽwo me hã, manɔ nye yeyewɔwɔ ƒe ŋkeke la lalam.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Àyɔm eye matɔ, wò dzi alé dzo ɖe nu si wò asiwo wɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—

translation_verse: Woatre nye dzidadawo nu ɖe akplo me eye àtsyɔ nu nye nu vɔ̃wo dzi.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: “Gake abe ale si ke ɖena le to te wòŋena dzea eme eye agakpe ʋãna le eteƒe ene la,

translation_verse: abe ale si tsi nyia kpewoe eye tsidzadza kplɔa ke si le anyigba dzonae ene la, nenemae nègblẽa ame ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ mee.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Èdzea edzi kple ŋusẽ zi ɖeka eye ɖe wòvɔnae nye ekema; ètrɔa eƒe dzedzeme henyanɛ dzonae.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Negbe eya ŋutɔ ƒe veve si sem wòle le ŋutilã me koe eye eya ŋutɔ fana na eɖokui.”

translation_verse: Èse Mawu ƒe aɖaŋudede kple toa? Gbɔwò ko nunya tso aƒe ɖoa?

translation_verse: Ta ƒowɔ tɔwo kple amegãɖeɖiwo le mía dzi, ame siwo tsi wu fofowò gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?

translation_verse: ale be nènyɔ wò dziku ɖe Mawu ŋu eye nètrɔ nya siawo kɔ ɖi tso wò nu me?

translation_verse: Ne Mawu meka ɖe eƒe kɔkɔetɔwo dzi o eye dziƒowo gɔ̃ hã medza le eƒe ŋkume o,

translation_verse: aleke wòahanye amegbetɔ si nye aɖi, esi dovo eye wòno nu vɔ̃ɖi abe tsi ene!

translation_verse: “Ɖo tom ne maɖe nu me na wò; na magblɔ nu si teƒe mekpɔ la na wò,

translation_verse: ame siwo ko wotsɔ anyigba la na, esi amedzro aɖeke meto wo dome o.

translation_verse: Ele tsaglalã tsam le nuɖuɖu dim abe akaga ene elabena enya be vivitidogbe la tu aƒe kpokploe.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Xaxa kple vevesese na ŋɔdzi lé eya amea ŋutɔ eye wova dze edzi abe fia si le klalo na aʋakpekpe ene.

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Elabena eŋlɔ kɔ do ɖe mo na Mawu eye wòdze aglã ɖe Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ŋu,

translation_verse: helũ ɖe edzi ɖekematsɔlemetɔe kple akpoxɔnu titri sesẽ aɖe.
