english_verse: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.
translation_verse: Magakpɔ hotsui o eye eƒe kesinɔnuwo maganɔ anyi alo eƒe nunɔamesiwo nagbagba ɖe anyigba dzi o.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Masi le viviti la nu o, dzo ƒe aɖe ana eƒe alɔwo nayrɔ eye Mawu ƒe numegbɔgbɔ akplɔe adzoe.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Megable eɖokui, atsɔ eƒe dzi aɖo nu si nye tofloko la ŋu o elabena ɖeke maɖe vi nɛ o.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Anɔ abe wainka si ŋu wogbe waintsetse gbogbowo katã le la ene alo abe amiti si dudu eƒe seƒoƒowo ene.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Elabena mawumavɔ̃lawo ƒe ha madzi ɖe edzi o eye dzo afia ame siwo lɔ̃a zãnuxɔxɔ ƒe agbadɔwo.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Wofɔa fukpekpe ƒe fu, hedzia nu vɔ̃ɖi eye beble ɖoa atsyɔ̃ ɖe woƒe vidzidɔwo me.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Mese nya siawo tɔgbi wòsɔ gbɔ, akɔfala gbɔlowo ko mi katã mienye!

english_verse: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?
translation_verse: Miaƒe nuƒo legbe, gɔdɔ̃gɔdɔ̃awo mawu nu akpɔ oa? Nu kae le mia vem be miegale nyahehe dzi kokoko?

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Nenye miawoe le tenyeƒe la, nye hã maƒo nu abe miawo ke ene, agblɔ nyatinyatiwo ɖe mia ŋu eye maʋuʋu ta ɖe mia ŋu.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: “Gake ne meƒo nu la, nye vevesesewo dzi maka ɖe kpɔtɔ o eye ne medzudzɔ hã la, veveseseawo medzona o.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: O Mawu, vavãe èna mevɔ le eme keŋkeŋ eye nètsrɔ̃ nye aƒekɔ la katã.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: Èna meɖi ku, vɔ keŋ eye wòzu ɖaseɖiɖi, nye kuɖiɖi tsi tsitre hezu ɖasefo ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒom, hevuvum le eƒe dziku me eye wòɖu aɖukli ɖe ŋunye, nye ketɔ fɔ ŋku ɖaɖɛwo ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Amewo ke woƒe nuwo baa hedo ɣli ɖe tanye. Woƒo tome nam fewuɖutɔe eye wowɔ ɖeka ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Mawu dem asi na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo eye wòkɔm ƒu gbe ɖe ŋutasẽlawo ƒe fego me.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Nuwo nɔ edzi dzem nam nyuie gake ekakam. Elé kɔʋume nam hegbãm gudugudugudu. Etsɔm wɔ ade si minyam wòle,

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: eƒe aŋutrɔdalawo ɖe to ɖem. Eŋɔ nye ayikuwo nublanuimakpɔmakpɔtɔe eye wòna nye vevego gbã hekɔ ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: “Metɔ akpanya hetsyɔ na nye ŋutilã eye metsɔ nye mo de ke me.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Avifafa na nye mo biã dzẽe, vɔvɔli ƒo xlã nye ŋkuwo,

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: evɔ nye asiwo mewɔ nu tovo aɖeke o eye nye gbedodoɖa hã dza hafi.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: “O, anyigba, mègatsyɔ nye ʋu dzi o eye ɖoɖoe megazi le nye ɣlidodo nu o!

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Azɔ gɔ̃ hã la, nye ɖasefo le dziƒo eye nye nyaxɔɖeakɔla le afi ma.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Tanyeʋlila nye xɔ̃nye, esi nye ŋkuwo le aɖatsi ɖuɖum na Mawu.

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: Eɖea kuku na Mawu ɖe ame ta abe ale si ame ɖea kuku ɖe xɔlɔ̃a tae ene.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: “Ƒe ʋɛ aɖewo koe ava yi hafi madze mɔ ayi demagbɔnugbe.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu belibelibeli, nye ŋkekewo hã le kpuie eye yɔdo le lalayem.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Vavãe, fewuɖulawo ƒo xlãm, ele be nye ŋkuwo nanɔ woƒe amenuɖiaɖia ŋu.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: “O Mawu, tsɔ ŋugbedodo si dim nèle la nam. Ame kae gali si ade megbe nam?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Ètu woƒe susu ɖe gɔmesese ŋu eya ta màna woƒe alɔ nade dzi o.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe gbe exɔlɔ̃wo ɖe nu si woanae ta la, viawo ƒe ŋkuwo atsi.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: “Mawu tsɔm wɔ lodonue na ame sia ame, ame si ƒe ŋkume amewo ɖea ta ɖo gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Nuxaxa na be nye ŋkuwo dzi tsyɔ eye nye ameti blibo la mele abe vɔvɔli ene.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe mo wɔ yaa le esia ta; dɔ me ve ame maɖifɔwo ɖe mawumavɔ̃lawo ŋuti.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, ame dzɔdzɔewo alé woƒe mɔwo me ɖe asi eye asi dzadzɛtɔwo akpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe edzi.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: “Mi katã mitrɔ va ko, migadze agbagba kpɔ! Gake nyemakpɔ nunyala aɖeke le mia dome o.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkekewo va yi, nye ɖoɖowo me gblẽ eye nenema kee nye nye dzi ƒe didiwo hã.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Ame siawo trɔ zã wòzu ŋkeke, ke esi viviti do ɖe wo la, wogblɔ be, ‘Kekeli tsɔ ɖe mía gbɔ’

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Ne aƒe si ko mele mɔ kpɔm na la nye yɔdo, ne meɖo aba ɖe viviti me,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: ne megblɔ na zãnuxɔxɔ be, ‘Wòe nye fofonye,’ eye megblɔ na ŋɔvi be, ‘Wòe nye danye’ alo ‘Wòe nye nɔvinye nyɔnu’ la,

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: ekema afi ka nye mɔkpɔkpɔ la le?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ɖe wòayi ɖe ku ƒe agbowo mea? Ɖe nye kplii míayi tome ɖekaea?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Tete Suhitɔ, Bildad ɖo eŋu na Hiob be,

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: Ɣe ka ɣi miadzudzɔ nya siawo gbɔgblɔ? Midze nunya ekema míate ŋu aƒo nu.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Nu ka ŋuti wobu mí movitɔwoe eye wobu mí bometsilawoe le wò ŋkume?

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Wò ame si vuvu ɖokuiwò kɔ ɖi le wò dziku me, ɖe wòle be woagblẽ anyigba ɖi ɖe tawò alo woaɖe agakpewo ɖa le wò teƒea?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: “Wotsia ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe akaɖi eye eƒe dzo megabina o.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Megatea ŋu ɖea abla o eye eya ŋutɔ ƒe nuɖoɖowo ƒunɛ anyi.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Mɔ léa afɔkpodzi nɛ eye mɔ̃ka blanɛ sesĩe.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Eɖu eƒe ŋutilã ƒe akpa aɖewo eye ku ƒe ŋgɔgbevi vuvu eƒe ŋutinuwo

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Woɖee ɖa le eƒe agbadɔ si nye eƒe sitsoƒe la me eye wokplɔe yina na ŋɔdziwo ƒe fia.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Dzo bibi xɔ aƒe ɖe eƒe agbadɔ me eye aŋɔka bibi kaka ɖe eƒe nɔƒe.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Eƒe kewo yrɔna le ete ke eye eƒe aŋgbawo yrɔna le eƒe tame.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Wonyanɛ tso kekeli nu yina ɖe viviti me eye woɖenɛ ɖa le xexea me.

english_verse: Everyone, from east to west, is overwhelmed with horror.
translation_verse: Ɣetoɖoƒetɔwo ƒe nu ku le nu si dzɔ ɖe edzi ta eye vɔvɔ̃ ɖo ɣedzeƒetɔwo.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Vavãe, aleae ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nɔƒe nɔna, aleae ame si menya Mawu o la ƒe nɔƒe nɔna.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣie miawɔ funyafunyam eye miatsɔ miaƒe nyawo agbãm?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Zi ewo sɔŋue nye esi miedo vlom eye mieti kpo dze dzinye ŋumakpemakpetɔe.

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Nenye nyateƒee be metra mɔ la, vodada sia nye nye ɖeka ko ƒe nya.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Nenye vavãe miebe yewoakɔ mia ɖokuiwo ɖe dzi agbɔ tanye, ahazã vlo si wodom la aɖia nunyee la,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ekema minyae be Mawu dze agɔ le dzinye eye wòtsɔ eƒe ɖɔ ƒo xlãm.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: “Togbɔ be mefa avi sesĩe be, ‘Wodze agɔ le dzinye!’ hã la, ame aɖeke metɔ nam o eye togbɔ be medo ɣli be woaxɔ nam hã la, wometso nam o.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Exe nye mɔ be nyemate ŋu ato edzi ayi o, etsɔ viviti tsyɔ nye toƒewo.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Eƒe dziku bi ɖe ŋunye eye wòbum ɖe eƒe ketɔwo dome.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Eƒe aʋakɔwo lũ ɖe eme kple ŋusẽ, woƒu kpo ɖe ŋunye eye woƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe nye agbadɔ ŋu godoo va kpe.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: “Eɖe nɔvinye ŋutsuwo ɖa le ŋunye eye wòklã nye kple xɔ̃nyewo dome keŋkeŋkeŋ.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Meyɔ nye dɔla gake metɔ o togbɔ be metsɔ nye nu ɖe kuku nɛ hafi.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Nye nu me le ʋeʋẽm ɖe nye ŋutɔ srɔ̃nye eye mele ŋu nyɔm na nye ŋutɔ nɔvinye ŋutsuwo.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Ŋutsuvi suewo gɔ̃ hã koam eye ne meva do la, woɖua fewu le ŋunye.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Mele ŋu nyɔm na xɔ̃nye veviwo katã eye ame siwo melɔ̃ la, tso ɖe ŋutinye.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Mezu ŋutilã kple ƒu ɖeɖe, eye meɖo kudo nu.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: “Mikpɔ nye nublanui, xɔ̃nyewo, mikpɔ nublanui nam elabena Mawu ƒe asi ƒom.

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta mieti yonyeme abe ale si Mawu ti yonyemee ene? Nye ŋutilã si mieɖu la mesɔ gbɔ na mi oa?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: “O nenye ɖe woaŋlɔ nye nyawo ɖi, nenye ɖe woaŋlɔe ɖe agbalẽ me eye

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Menya be nye Xɔnametɔ le agbe, eye mlɔeba la, atsi tsitre ɖe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Eye ne nye ŋutigbalẽ vuvu keŋkeŋkeŋ hã la, makpɔ Mawu le nye ŋutilã me,

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutɔ makpɔe, makpɔe kple nye ŋkuwo, menye ame bubu aɖeke tɔ o. Aleke nye dzi mehetsi dzi ɖe eŋui o!

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: “Ne miegblɔ be, ‘Aleke míadi vɔ̃ nɛ? Eya ŋutɔ gbɔ kuxiawo tso’ la,

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: ekema yi nedo vɔvɔ̃ na miawo ŋutɔ elabena dziku atsɔ yi ahe toe eye mianya be ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ li.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Tete Naamatitɔ, Zofar ɖo eŋu nɛ be,

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Mese mokaname aɖe si ɖe bubu le ŋunye, eye nye gɔmesese de dzi ƒo nam be maɖo nyawo ŋu.

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nukoko nu mesena yina o, eye Mawumavɔ̃lawo ƒe aseyetsotso nɔa anyi ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Togbɔ be eƒe dada yi ɖatɔ dziƒo, eƒe ta yi ɖatɔ lilikpowo ke hã la,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: atsrɔ̃ gbidii abe eya ŋutɔ ƒe afɔdzi ene eye ame siwo kpɔe la agblɔ be, ‘Afi ka wòle?’

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Ŋku si kpɔe la magakpɔe akpɔ o, eye eƒe nɔƒe hã magakpɔe akpɔ o.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ele be viawo nawɔ ɖɔɖɔɖo anyo dɔ me na ame dahewo, eya ŋutɔ ƒe asiwo aɖe asi le eƒe kesinɔnuwo ŋu.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ɖekakpuimeŋusẽ dzodzoe si yɔ eƒe ƒuwo me la aku kplii ayi ke me.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: “Togbɔ be nu vɔ̃ɖi vivi le eƒe nu me, eye wòɣlae ɖe eƒe aɖe te,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: eƒe nuɖuɖu ave le eƒe dɔ me, eye wòazu da ƒe aɖi le eƒe dɔgbowo me.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Atu kesinɔnu siwo wòmi la aƒu gbe. Mawu ana eƒe dɔgbowo nadzɔ wo katã aƒo ɖi.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Eno da ƒe aɖi eye ƒli ƒe aɖi awui.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Makpɔ gome le tɔʋu kple tɔsisi siwo me anyitsi kple notsi babla le sisim le la me o.

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: elabena ete ame dahewo ɖe to wozu hiãtɔwo eye wòxɔ aƒe siwo metu o.

english_verse: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
translation_verse: “Vavã makpɔ gbɔdzɔe le eƒe nudzodzrowo me o eye maɖe eɖokui to eƒe nunɔamesiwo dzi o.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Naneke masusɔ nɛ esi wòavuvu o eƒe kesinɔnuwo matɔ ɖi o.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Le eƒe nukpɔkpɔ gbogboawo dome la, xaxa ava edzi eye hiãtuame ƒe ŋusẽ katã ava edzi.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Togbɔ be esi le gayibɔlãnu nu hã la, akɔbliŋutrɔ ƒo ɖee.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Eɖee do goe tso eƒe lãme eye wòho eƒe tsutsyɔeƒe le eƒe aklã me. Ŋɔdzi alée,

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: eye viviti tsiɖitsiɖi le eƒe kesinɔnuwo lalam. Dzo si womeƒlɔ ɖo o la afiae eye wòabi nu si susɔ ɖe eƒe agbadɔ me la keŋkeŋkeŋ.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Dziƒo aɖe eƒe vodada ɖe go eye anyigba atso ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Tsiɖɔɖɔ akplɔ eƒe aƒe adzoe eye le Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoeŋkeke la dzi la, tsi sisiwo akplɔe adzoe.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Esia nye gomekpɔkpɔ si Mawu ɖo ɖi na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye wònye domenyinu tso Mawu gbɔ na wo.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “Ɖo to nyuie nàse nye nyawo, esia nenye akɔfafa si nànam.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Migbɔ dzi ɖi nam, ne maƒo nu eye ne meƒo nu vɔ la, miate ŋu ayi miaƒe alɔmeɖeɖe dzi.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: “Amegbetɔe mele konyi fam na? Nu ka ta nyemagbe dzigbɔɖeanyi o?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Mikpɔm ɖa, ne miaƒe mo nawɔ yaa eye miaƒu asi nu.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Ne mebu nu sia ŋuti la ŋɔ dziam eye nye ameti blibo la medzona nyanyanya.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nɔa agbe, tsina, kua amegã, eye woƒe ŋusẽ dzina ɖe edzi ɖo?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Wonɔa agbe, kpɔa wo viwo lia ke heƒoa xlã wo eye woƒe dzidzimeviwo tsina le wo ŋkume.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Woƒe aƒewo me le dedie, wovo tso vɔvɔ̃ ƒe asi me eye Mawu ƒe ameƒoti mevaa wo dzi o.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Woƒe nyitsuwo megbea asiyɔyɔ o, woƒe nyinɔwo dzia vi eye fu megena le wo ƒo o.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Wodzia ha ɖe asiʋuiwo kple kasaŋkuwo ŋu eye wotua aglo ɖe kpẽ ƒe ɖiɖi ŋu.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Woɖua woƒe ƒewo le dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ me eye woyia yɔ me le ŋutifafa me

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: gake wogblɔna na Mawu be, ‘Ɖe asi le mía ŋu! Medzro mí be míanya wò mɔwo o.

english_verse: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
translation_verse: Ame kae nye Ŋusẽkatãtɔ be míasubɔe? Viɖe ka míakpɔ ne míedo gbe ɖa nɛ?’

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Evɔa woƒe dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ mele woawo ŋutɔ ƒe asi me o, eya ta menɔ adzɔge na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aɖaŋudede.

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Zi nenie wole abe gbe ƒuƒu si ya lɔ ɖe nu alo atsa si ahom lɔ ɖe nu ene?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be, ‘Mawu ɖo amegbetɔ ƒe tohehe ɖi na via ŋutsuwo.’ Anyo be wòahe to na amea ŋutɔ, ne wòanya nu si wònye!

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkuwo nekpɔ eƒe gbegblẽ, eye wòano Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe dɔmedzoekplu

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: elabena ɖe wòtsɔ ɖe le eme na ƒometɔ siwo wògblẽ ɖe megbe esi ɣleti siwo woɖo ɖi nɛ la wu nua?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: “Ɖe ame aɖe ate ŋu afia gɔmesese Mawu, esi wònye eyae drɔ̃a ʋɔnu ame kɔkɔtɔ gɔ̃ hã?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Ame bubu ku le eƒe luʋɔ ƒe nuxaxa me eye mese vivi na nu vivi aɖeke kpɔ o.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Ke wo ame evea mlɔ kasanu le ke me, eye ŋɔviwo ɖi ba ɖe wo kple evea dzi.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: “Menya nu siwo susum miele la nyuie kple nu vɔ̃ɖi siwo ɖom miele be miadze agɔ le dzinye.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Miegblɔ be, ‘Afi ka ame xɔŋkɔ la ƒe aƒe le eye agbadɔ si me ame vɔ̃ɖiwo nɔ la ɖe?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: woɖea ame vɔ̃ɖi le dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe, eye woɖenɛ le dzikugbe oa?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Wokɔnɛ yia yɔdo gbɔe eye wodzɔa eƒe yɔdokpe ŋu.

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Temanitɔ, Elifaz ɖo eŋu be,

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Ɖe ame anye viɖenu na Mawua? Ɖe nunyala gɔ̃ hã anye viɖenu nɛa?

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Dzidzɔ ka wòanye na Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ne ènye ame dzɔdzɔe? Eye viɖe ka wòakpɔ ne fɔɖiɖi mele wò mɔwo ŋu o?

english_verse: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?
translation_verse: “Wò Mawuvɔvɔ̃ tae wòka mo na wò hetsɔ nya ɖe ŋuwòa?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ mekpe ŋutɔ oa? Ɖe nuwuwu li na wò nu vɔ̃woa?

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Èbia megbedanu tso nɔviwò ŋutsuwo si susumanɔmetɔe eye nèɖe avɔ le amewo ŋu wotsi amama.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Mèna tsi ame siwo nu ti kɔ na la wono o eye nète nuɖuɖu dɔwuitɔwo,

english_verse: although you were rich, respected, and powerful.
translation_verse: evɔ nèhenye ŋusẽtɔ, anyigba le asiwò eye nèle anyigba dzi, bubu le ŋuwò.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Èɖo ahosiwo ɖa asi ƒuƒlu eye nèɖe tsyɔ̃eviwo ƒe ŋusẽ ɖa.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: eya ta viviti do ale gbegbe be màgate ŋu akpɔ nu o eye eya tae tɔɖɔɖɔ va tsyɔ dziwò ɖo.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: “Ɖe Mawu mele dziƒo kɔkɔtɔ oa? Ɖe mekpɔ ale si ɣletivi kɔkɔtɔwo kɔkɔe oa?

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Gake ègblɔ be, ‘Nu ka Mawu nya? Ɖe wòdrɔ̃a ʋɔnu to viviti ma tɔgbi mea?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Lilikpo dodowo xe eŋkume eya ta mekpɔa mí ne ele tsatsam le dziƒo ƒe agbo sesẽwo me o.’

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Ɖe nàgalé mɔ xoxo si dzi ame vɔ̃ɖiwo zɔ va yi la me ɖe asia?

english_verse: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
translation_verse: Wogblɔ na Mawu be, ‘Ɖe asi le mía ŋu! Nu kae Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la awɔ mí?’

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Evɔ wònye eyae tsɔ nu nyuiwo yɔ xɔ na wo fũu, eya ta menɔ adzɔge na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aɖaŋudede.

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo kpɔ woƒe gbegblẽ eye dzi dzɔ wo, ame maɖifɔwo gblɔ ɖe wo ŋu fewuɖutɔe be,

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Wotsrɔ̃ míaƒe futɔwo vavã eye dzo va fia woƒe kesinɔnuwo.’

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: “Tsɔ ɖokuiwò na Mawu eye nànɔ ŋutifafa me kplii, to esia me la, dzɔgbenyui ava wò mɔ dzi.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Xɔ nufiame tso eƒe nu me, eye nàtsɔ eƒe nyawo adzra ɖo ɖe wò dzi me

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Ne ètrɔ va Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la gbɔ la, agaɖo wò te. Ne èɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ɖa xaa tso wò agbadɔ gbɔ,

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: eye nètsɔ wò dzonu veviwo kɔ ɖe ke me, tsɔ wò sika adodoe si tso Ofir ƒu gbe ɖe agakpewo tome la,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ekema Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la anye wò sika kple klosalo nyuitɔ.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Àdo gbe ɖa nɛ, wòaɖo to wò eye àxe wò adzɔgbeɖefewo nɛ.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Nu si nèɖo la, ava eme na wò eye kekeli aklẽ ɖe wò mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Ne woɖiɖi amewo ɖe anyi, eye nègblɔ be, ‘Fɔ wo ɖe dzi!’ la, ekema woafɔ ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Aɖe ame si ŋu fɔɖiɖi le gɔ̃ hã, ame si woaɖe to wò asi ƒe kɔkɔenɔnɔ me.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Egbe gɔ̃ hã nye konyifafa do gã ɖe edzi, eƒe asi sẽ ɖe dzinye, evɔ mele hũu ɖem hafi.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe manya afi si makpɔe le, nenye ɖe mayi enɔƒe la, anyo ŋutɔ!

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Ne makpɔ ale si wòaɖo eŋu nam eye mabu nya si wòagblɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Ɖe wòatsi tsitre ɖe ŋunye kple ŋusẽ gã aɖea? Ao, ke boŋ aɖo tom

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Afi ma ame dzɔdzɔe ate ŋu atsɔ eƒe nyawo aɖo eŋkume le eye woaɖem tegbee tso nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la ƒe asi me.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: “Gake ne meyi ɣedzeƒe la, mele afi ma o, ne meyi ɣetoɖoƒe la, nyemekpɔe le afi ma hã o.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Ne ele dɔ wɔm le anyiehe la, nyemekpɔnɛ o, ne etrɔ ɖe dziehe hã la, nye ŋku melɔnɛ o.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Gake enya mɔ si dzi mele, ne edom kpɔ la, mato eme abe sika ene.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Nye afɔwo le eƒe afɔtoƒewo yome kplikplikpli, melé eƒe mɔ tsɔ eye nyemedze ɖe aga o.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: “Ke eya ɖekae li, ame ka ate ŋu axe mɔ nɛ? Nu sia nu si dze eŋu lae wòwɔna.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Ena se siwo wòde ɖi la va eme ɖe ŋutinye eye ɖoɖo siawo tɔgbi gale esi ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, viviti la alo blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi si tsyɔ mo nam la mena ɖoɖoe zi le nunye o.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Nu ka ŋuti Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la meɖo ɣeyiɣiwo ɖi hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ o? Nu ka ta ame siwo nyae la nanɔ mɔ kpɔm na ŋkeke siawo dzodzro?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Amewo ɖea liƒokpewo ɖa, wokplɔa lãha siwo wofi la yia gbeɖuƒee.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Wokplɔa tsyɔ̃eviwo ƒe tedziwo dzonae eye woxɔa ahosi ƒe nyi abe awɔbanu ene.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Ame dahewo ɖoa gbe nɔa nuɖuɖu dim abe gbetedziwo le gbegbe ene eye kuɖiɖinyigbawo dia nuɖuɖu na wo viwo.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Woŋe gbe le agblewo dzi na lãwo eye wofɔa nuku siwo ge la le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe waingblewo me.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Esi avɔ mele wo si o ta la womlɔ anyi ƒuƒlu le zã me eye naneke meli woatsyɔ le vuvɔ me o.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Tsi ƒoa wo tea wo ŋu nyuie le towo dzi, wokuna ɖe agakpewo ŋu elabena bebeƒe meli o.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Woɖea tsyɔ̃evi le no nu eye woxɔa ame dahe ƒe vi ɖe fe si wònyi la nu.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Esi wònye avɔ mele wo si o ta la, wole yiyim amama, wolé lu bablawo ɖe ta, evɔ dɔ le wo wum.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Wole amiti ƒe ku tum le te dzi, wofiaa wain le wainfiaƒewo gake tsikɔ le wo wum.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Ame siwo le kudɔ ƒom ƒe ŋeŋe de dzi le dua me kɔtɔɔ eye ame siwo xɔ abi la ƒe luʋɔwo le ɣli dom be woaxɔ na yewo, gake Mawu mebu fɔ ame aɖeke be edze agɔ o.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Ne viviti do la, hlɔ̃dola la tsona hewua ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo, le zã me la, enɔa zɔzɔm abe fiafitɔ ene

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Ahasitɔ ƒe ŋku nɔa viviti lalam, egblɔna le eƒe susu me be, ‘Ŋku aɖeke makpɔm o,’ eye wòɣlaa eƒe mo.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Ke wo katã la, viviti tsiɖitsiɖie le na wo abe ŋdikekeli ene eye wodzea xɔ̃ viviti ƒe ŋɔdzinuwo.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: “Evɔ la, futukpɔ ko wonye le tsi ŋgɔ, woƒoa fi dea anyigba ƒe akpa si nye woƒe gome ale be ame aɖeke mayi ɖe waingblewo me le afi ma o.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Abe ale si dzoxɔxɔ kple kuɖiɖi kplɔa tsikpe si lolõ la dzonae ene la, nenemae yɔdo kplɔa ame siwo wɔa nu vɔ̃ la hã dzonae.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Vidzidɔ ŋlɔa wo be, wozua nuɖuɖu na ŋɔviwo, womegaɖoa ŋku ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi o, ke boŋ woŋena abe atilɔ ene.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Wohaa konɔwo kple vimanɔsitɔwo eye womekpɔa nublanui na ahosiwo o.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Gake Mawu kplɔa kalẽtɔwo dzonae kple eƒe ŋusẽ. Togbɔ be woli ke hã la, kakaɖedzi mele wo si be woanɔ agbe o.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Ɖewohĩ ana woaɖe dzi ɖi abu be yewole dedie gake eƒe ŋkuwo le woƒe mɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: “Ne mele alea o la, ame kae aɖe aʋatso nam eye wòana nye nyawo nazu tofloko?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Bildad, Suhitɔ ɖo eŋu nɛ be,

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Dziɖuɖu kple ŋɔdzi nye Mawu tɔ, eyae ɖo ɖoɖo anyi ɖe dziƒo ƒe kɔkɔƒewo.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Ɖe woate ŋu axlẽ eƒe aʋakɔwoa? Ame ka tame eƒe kekeli meklẽ ɖo o?

english_verse: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Ekema aleke amegbetɔ anye dzɔdzɔetɔ le Mawu ŋkume? Aleke amegbetɔ, nyɔnu tɔ dzidzia, anɔ dzadzɛe?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Ne ɣleti ƒe keklẽ menye naneke nɛ o eye ɣletiviwo hã medza le eŋkume o la,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: aleke amegbetɔ si nye ŋɔvi kple ame vi si nye ŋɔ la ayi nane nye ge le eŋkume!”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Miekpe ɖe ame beli la ŋu ŋutɔ! Miekpe ɖe ame gblɔe la ƒe abɔ ŋu ŋutɔ!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Aɖaŋu kae nye esi nèna ame si si nunya mele o! Eye sidzedze kae nye gã si nèɖe fia!

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: “Ame kukuwo le vevesese gã aɖe me, nenema kee nye ame siwo le tɔ gɔme kple ame siwo le tɔ me.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Ku le ƒuƒlu le Mawu ŋkume, eye wometsyɔ nu gbegblẽ dzi o.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Ekeke dzigbeme ƒe lilikpowo ɖe teƒe siwo naneke mele o eye wòna anyigba le yame, naneke melée ɖe asi o.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Eŋlɔ tsiwo ɖe lilikpowo me, gake woƒe kpekpe mena lilikpoawo gbã o.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Etsɔ nu tsyɔ ɣleti si sɔ tegblẽe la ƒe ŋkume eye wòkeke eƒe lilikpowo ɖe edzi.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Eɖe liƒo na dzite ɖe tsiwo dzi eye wòde mama kekeli kple viviti dome.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Ne ele mo kam na nuwɔwɔwo la, dziƒosɔtiwo ʋuʋuna eye wodzona nyanyanya.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ena atsiaƒu dze agbo to eƒe ŋusẽ dzi eye wòfli Rahab kakɛkakɛ to eƒe nya dzi.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Ena dziŋgɔli me kɔ to eƒe ŋɔtimegbɔgbɔ dzi eye eƒe asi ŋɔ da vɔ̃ɖi si ɖiɖi va yina.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Esiawoe nye eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ƒe sue aɖe ko eye aleke dalĩ si wodo le eŋuti miese la le bɔlɔe ale! Eya ta ame kae ate ŋu ase eƒe ŋusẽ ƒe gbeɖeɖe gɔme?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Meta Mawu si gbe afiatsotso nam la ƒe agbe kple Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, ame si do vevesese na nye luʋɔ be,

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Nyemalɔ̃ gbeɖe be tɔwò dzɔ o va se ɖe esi maku la, nyemasẽ nu le nye blibodede ŋu o.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: “Nye futɔwo nenɔ abe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ene eye nye ketɔwo abe ame madzɔmadzɔwo ene!

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Elabena mɔkpɔkpɔ kae le ame vlo si ne wolãe ɖa eye Mawu ɖe eƒe agbe ɖa?

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu ase eƒe ɣlidodo, ne eɖo xaxa mea?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Ɖe eƒe nu anyo Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ŋua? Ɖe wòayɔ Mawu ɣe sia ɣia?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: “Mafia nu mi tso Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ ŋuti eye nyemaɣla Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe mɔwo ɖe mi o.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Miawo ŋutɔ miekpɔ esiawo katã. Ekema nu kae nye nuƒo manyatalenu gbogbo siawo?

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: “Esia nye gome si Mawu ɖo ɖi na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple domenyinyi si ŋutasẽla xɔna tso Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Aleke ke viawo sɔ gbɔe hã la, woɖo wo ɖi na yi eye eƒe dzidzimeviwo makpɔ nu aɖu aɖi ƒo akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Dɔvɔ̃ awu ame siwo susɔ nɛ eye woƒe ahosiwo mafa na wo o.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be eli kɔ klosalo abe ke ene, wòdo agba avɔ wòkɔ abe to ene hã la,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: ame dzɔdzɔewo ado nu siwo wòli kɔe eye ame maɖifɔwo ama eƒe klosalo.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Xɔ si wòtu la anɔ abe gbagblaʋui ƒe azi si wòƒo teti ko la ene eye wòanɔ abe zãɖialawo ƒe agbadɔ si wòwɔ la ene.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Emlɔ anyi abe hotsuitɔ ene gake esusɔ vie maganɔ nɛ nenema o elabena esi wòʋu eƒe ŋkuwo la, naneke megali o.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi ƒona ɖe edzi abe tɔɖɔɖɔ ene eye ahom kplɔnɛ dzonae le zã me.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Ɣedzeƒeya kɔe dzoe eye wòdzo, ale wòkplɔe ɖa le enɔƒe.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eɖokui xlã ɖe edzi nublanuimakpɔmakpɔtɔe, esi wòsi le eƒe ŋusẽ nu afɔtsɔtsɔe.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Esi akpe ɖe eta fewuɖutɔe eye wònyae ɖa le enɔƒe.”

english_verse: Gold and silver are mined, then purified;
translation_verse: “Klosalokuƒe li eye teƒe li si wololõa sika le.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Wokua gayibɔ le tome eye wokpɔa akɔbli ne wololõ akɔblikpe.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ɖo seƒe na viviti, etsana le didiƒewo kple viviti tsiɖitsiɖitɔ kekeake me hena tomenuwo.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Anyigba si me wokpɔa nuɖuɖu tsonae lae wotrɔ le tome abe dzo me wòto ene.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Xe ƒonuwo menya toƒe ɣaɣla ma o eye aʋako aɖeke ƒe ŋku mekpɔe kpɔ o

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe asi gbã kpe sesẽawo eye wòna towo te dze go.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Eɖea mɔ ɖe kpeawo tome eye eƒe ŋkuwo kpɔa eƒe nu xɔasi vovovowo katã.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Etsana le tsidzɔƒewo eye wòhea nu ɣaɣlawo vaa kekeli nu.

english_verse: But where is wisdom found?
translation_verse: “Ke afi ka woakpɔ nunya le? Afi ka gɔmesese nɔna?

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Gogloƒe gblɔ be, ‘Menye tɔnyee o,’ Atsiaƒu gblɔ be, ‘Mele gbɔnye o,’

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Womate ŋu aƒlee kple sika nyuitɔ alo woada klosalo ɖe eƒe home nu o.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Sika alo kristalkpe masɔ kplii o eye womatsɔ sikanuwo gɔ̃ hã aɖɔlii o.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Womayɔ sui kple adzagba ƒe ŋkɔwo gɔ̃ hã ɖe eŋu o elabena nunya ƒe asixɔxɔ kɔ wu gbloti tɔ sãsãsã.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Womatsɔ Kuskpe xɔasi, topaz, asɔ kplii o eye sika nyuitɔ mate ŋu aƒlee o.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Eɣla ɖe nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ŋkukpɔƒe eye woɣlae ɖe dziƒoxeviwo gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe kple ku gblɔ be, ‘Nyasegblɔ tso eŋuti koe ɖo míaƒe towo me.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Mawue nya egbɔmɔ eye eya koe nya afi si wòle.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Esi wòɖo ya ƒe ŋusẽ anyi, hedzidze tsiwo vɔ,

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: esi wòwɔ se na tsidzadza, heta mɔ na dziɖegbe kple ahom vɔ la,

english_verse: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
translation_verse: enye kɔ kpɔ nunya, dzro eme kpɔ eye wòda asi ɖe edzi, hedoe kpɔ.

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ na amegbetɔ be, ‘Kpɔ ɖa, Aƒetɔ la vɔvɔ̃e nye nunya eye nugbegbe le vɔ̃ gbɔe nye gɔmesese.’ ”

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: esi eƒe akaɖi klẽ ɖe nye ta dzi eye eƒe kekeli na mezɔ to blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me!

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: O, nenye ɖe wòanɔ nam abe nye lãmesẽŋkekewo me ene, esi kadodo kple Mawu kplikplikpli na wòyra nye aƒe,

english_verse: and all of my children were nearby.
translation_verse: esi Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ganɔ kplim ko eye vinyewo ƒo xlãm,

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: esi nye toƒe nye notsi kpeke ɖeɖe eye amitimi ɖuɖu bababa tso agakpe me nam.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: “Ne meyi dua ƒe agbo nu, henɔ anyi ɖe zikpui dzi gli, le dua ƒe ablɔme la,

english_verse: the young leaders stepped aside, *
translation_verse: ɖekakpuiawo kpɔam, heƒoa asa nam eye ame tsitsiwo tsona ɖe tsitrenu,

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: dumegãwo tɔna ne wole nu ƒom hetsɔa asi ɖoa nu.

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame si ɖo tom la kafuam eye ame siwo kpɔm la ƒoa nu nyui tso ŋutinye

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: elabena mexɔna na hiãtɔ siwo le ɣli dom be woakpe ɖe yewo ŋu kple tsyɔ̃evi si si kpeɖeŋutɔ mele o.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Ame si le kukum la ƒe yayra vaa dzinye eye menana ahosi ƒe dzi kpɔa dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Metsɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye do abe awu ene eye nuteƒewɔwɔ nye nye awu ʋlaya kple tablanu.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Menye ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔ kple afɔ na tekunɔ.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Menye tɔ na hiãtɔwo eye mexɔa nya ɖe amedzrowo nu.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Meŋea tsyo na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo eye meɖea nu si woda adzoe la le woƒe aɖutame.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: “Mebu be, ‘Maku ɖe nye ŋutɔ nye aƒe me, nye ŋkekewo asɔ gbɔ abe ke ene.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Nye kewo aƒo ɖe to, ade tsi gbɔ eye zãmu adza ɖe nye alɔwo dzi zã blibo la.

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: “Amewo ɖoa tom henɔa nye asinu kpɔm, nɔa lalam na nye aɖaŋuɖoɖo le ɖoɖoezizi me.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Ne meƒo nu la, womegaƒoa nu o eye nye nyawo gena ɖe woƒe towo me bɔlɔɔ.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Womexɔnɛ sena ne meko nu na wo o, nye mo ƒe kekeli nye nu xɔasi na wo.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Metiaa mɔ si woato la na wo, menɔa wo dome abe woƒe tatɔ ene eye menɔa wo dome abe woƒe fia le eƒe aʋakɔwo dome ene. Menɔna abe ame si faa akɔ na konyifalawo ene.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: “Ke azɔ la, ame siwo menye xoxo na, ame siwo fofowo manyɔ ŋui be womade ha kple nye lãkplɔvuwo gɔ̃ hã o la ɖua fewu le ŋutinye.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Nu ka woƒe alɔkpa sesẽ la wɔ nam, esi ŋusẽ vɔ le wo ŋu?

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Hiã kple dɔwuame na wowɔ ɖeƒomevie hele tsatsam le dzogbe kple kuɖiɖinyigbawo dzi le zã me.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Le gbe me woda amagbewo eye woƒe nuɖuɖue nye dɔli ƒe ke.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Woɖe wo ɖa le wo nɔvi amegbetɔwo ƒe ha me eye wodo ɣli ɖe wo ta abe fiafitɔwo wonye ene.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Wole xɔxlɔ̃m le gbe me eye woƒo ta kpli ɖe avekawo te.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Wonya wo le anyigba la dzi abe ame ɖigbɔ̃wo kple yakamewo ƒe dzidzimeviwo ene.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: “Ke azɔ la, wo viŋutsuwo kpa ha dem, heɖu fewu le ŋunye le ha la me eye mezu lodonu le wo dome.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Wonyɔa ŋum, henɔa adzɔge nam eye woɖea ta ɖe mo nam faa.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Esi azɔ Mawu lã nye datika, hewɔ fum la, wowɔa nu si dze wo ŋu la le ŋkunye me.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Wo detɔwo tso ɖe ŋutinye le nye ɖusime, woɖo mɔwo ɖi na nye afɔ eye woƒu woƒe aʋakpowo ɖe ŋunye.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Wogbã nye mɔ, edze edzi na wo be wogblẽ donyeme eye ame aɖeke mekpe ɖe wo ŋu gɔ̃ hã o.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzidodowo nye tsyɔ dzinye, wonya nye bubu ɖe nu abe ale si ya lɔa nu ɖe nue ene eye nye dedinɔnɔ bu abe lilikpo ene.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: “Azɔ nye agbe nu va le yiyim eye hiãŋkekewo lém.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Zã ŋɔa nye ƒuwo eye nye vevesese manyagblɔ nu metsona o.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Mawu tsyɔ eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la dzinye abe avɔ ene, eye wòle awu ɖe ve nam.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Ekɔm ƒu gbe ɖe ba me eye mezu ke kple dzofi.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: “O Mawu, mefa avi yɔ wò gake mètɔ nam o, metsi tsitre gake ɖeko nèkpɔm dũu.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: Èƒom tsa, hena ya lɔm ɖe nu eye nènyamam le ahom la me.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Menya be àhem ayi ku me, teƒe si woɖo ɖi na kodzogbeawo katã.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Gake esi mekpɔ mɔ na nyui la, vɔ̃ tum, esi mekpɔ mɔ na kekeli la, viviti koe va nam.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Dzoxɔxɔ si le edzi yim le menye la metɔna o, fukpekpeŋkekewo kpe akɔ kplim.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Nye amea menyɔ tsiɖitsiɖitsiɖi le yiyim gake menye ɣee ɖum o, metsi tsitre ɖe ameha la titina hedo ɣli bia kpekpeɖeŋu.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Meva zu nɔviŋutsu na amegãxiwo kple hati na golowo.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutigbalẽ nyɔ tsiɖitsiɖitsiɖi hele fofom le ŋutinye eye asrã dze dzinye kple dzoxɔxɔ gã aɖe.

english_verse: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.
translation_verse: Nye kasaŋku do konyifagbe eye nye dze le avigbe dom.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: “Mebla nu kple nye ŋku be megakpɔ ɖetugbi aɖeke ahiãdzetɔe o.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Ɖe menye gbegblẽ wònye na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple dzɔgbevɔ̃e na nu tovo wɔlawo oa?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Ɖe mekpɔ nye mɔwo eye wòxlẽ nye afɔɖeɖe ɖe sia ɖe oa?

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: ekema Mawu nedam le nudanu nyuitɔ dzi eye wòanya be nyemeɖi fɔ o.

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: ekema ame bubuwo neɖu nu siwo meƒã eye woneho nye nukuwo le bo dzi.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: “Ne nyɔnu aɖe flu nye dzi alo mede xa ɖe nye aƒelika ƒe ʋɔtru nu la,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: ekema srɔ̃nye netu bli na ŋutsu bubu eye ŋutsu bubuwo nedɔ kplii.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Elabena esia anye ŋukpenanu kple nu vɔ̃ si dze na ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: Enye dzo si bina hena gbegblẽ, eye wòaho nye nukuwo akɔ ɖi.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: “Ne nyemetso afia nyui na nye dɔlaŋutsuwo kple dɔlanyɔnuwo ne wotsɔ nya ɖe ŋunye o la,

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: nu ka mawɔ ne Mawu bia gbem? Ŋuɖoɖo ka mana ne eyɔm be mana akɔnta?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ɖe menye ame si wɔm ɖe vidzidɔ me lae wɔ woawo hã oa? Ɖe menye eya koe wɔ mí ame evea katã ɖe mía dadawo ƒe dɔ me oa?

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: “Nenye be mete hiãtɔwo woƒe didiwo alo mena nu te ahosiwo ƒe ŋkuwo ŋu,

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: nenye be nye ɖeɖe meɖu nye abolo heku ŋɔ tsyɔ̃evi la, eya ko woagblɔ nya aɖe,

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: evɔ la tso nye ɖekakpuime ke, menyi tyɔẽviwo abe fofo ene eye tso nye ɖevime ke, mefia mɔ ahosiwo.

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: eye eƒe dzi meyram be metsɔ avɔ si wowɔ kple nye alẽwo ƒe fu nɛ be wòade dzo lãme nɛ o,

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: ne mekɔ nye asi dzi ɖe tsyɔ̃evi ŋu, evɔa menya be woxɔa nye nya le ʋɔnu la,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: ekema na be nye abɔ nage le abɔgba ŋu eye wòaŋe le ekpeƒe.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Elabena gbegblẽ si tso Mawu gbɔ la le ŋɔ dzim nam, eye vɔvɔ̃ na eƒe atsyɔ̃ mana mawɔ nu mawo o.

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: nenye ɖe mekpɔ dzidzɔ le nye kesinɔnu gbogboawo ta, nu siwo nye alɔ wɔ dɔ kpɔ,

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Gake nyemeɖe mɔ na nye nu be wòawɔ nu vɔ̃ to ɖiŋudodo na eƒe agbe me o.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe meɣla nye nu vɔ̃ abe ale si amewo wɔna ene, be meɣla nye dzidada ɖe nye dzi me,

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: elabena mevɔ̃ na ameha la ŋutɔ eye mevɔ̃ na dukɔ la ƒe vlododo ale gbegbe be, mezi ɖoɖoe hegbe gododo ɖe gota la, anye ne enye nya bubu kura.

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: “O, ɖe ame aɖe le asinye aɖo tom ɖe! Kpɔ ɖa mede asi ɖokuinyetaʋlinyawo te, azɔ la, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la neɖo eŋu nam, ame si le nunye tsom la hã neŋlɔ nunyetsonyawo ɖe agbalẽ dzi.

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Vavã malée ɖe nye abɔta eye maɖɔe ɖe ta abe fiakuku ene.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Mana nutsotsoe tso nye afɔɖeɖe ɖe sia ɖe ŋuti eye mate ɖe eŋu abe fiavi ene.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: “Nenye ɖe nye anyigba fa avi ɖe ŋutinye eye eƒe boliƒowo yɔ kple aɖatsi,

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: nenye be meɖu eƒe kutsetsewo femaxee alo mena dɔwɔla siwo le agblea dzi la ƒe gbɔgbɔ gbã gudugudugudu la,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: ekema aŋɔkawo nemie nam ɖe lu teƒe eye gbe wuwluiwo nemie ɖe ƒo teƒe.” Esiae nye Hiob ƒe nyawo ƒe nuwuwu.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Ale ŋutsu etɔ̃ siawo dzudzɔ nyaŋuɖoɖo na Hiob, elabena enye ame dzɔdzɔe le eya ŋutɔ ŋkume.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Tete dzi ku Buzitɔ, Elihu, ame si nye Barakel ƒe vi, tso Ram ƒe ƒomea me vevie ɖe Hiob ŋu le esi wòbu eɖokui dzɔdzɔetɔe wu Mawu la ta.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: Edo dziku ɖe exɔlɔ̃ etɔ̃awo hã ŋu elabena mɔ aɖeke meli si dzi woato abu fɔ Hiob o, gake wobu fɔe.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Azɔ la, Elihu lala be yeaƒo nu na Hiob elabena wotsi wui.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Gake esi wòkpɔ be nya aɖeke megale ame etɔ̃awo si o la, Elihu gado dziku ɖe edzi.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Ale Buzitɔ, Barakel ƒe vi Elihu gblɔ be, “Nyemetsi o, mienye xoxo nam eya ta mevɔ̃ eye nyemete ŋu do dzi gblɔ nu si menya la na mi o.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Mebu be, ‘Tsitsi neƒo nu eye ƒe geɖe nefia nunya.’

english_verse: now I truly realize wisdom comes from God.
translation_verse: Gake gbɔgbɔ si le ame me, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe gbɔgbɔe naa gɔmesesee.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: “Eya ta megblɔ be, Miɖo tom, nye hã magblɔ nu si menya la na mi.

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Migagblɔ be, ‘Míeke ɖe nunya ŋuti o, Mawu neɖe vodada nɛ, menye amegbetɔ o.’

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Gake Hiob metsɔ nya ɖe ŋunye o eye nyematsɔ miaƒe nyahehewo aɖo nya ŋu nɛ o.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: “Woƒe mo wɔ yaa, nya aɖeke megale wo si woagblɔ o eye gbɔgblɔ bu ɖe wo.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ɖe magalala, esi wozi ɖoɖoe eye azɔ wotsi tsitre ɖe afi ma kpaɖii nya aɖeke ŋu maɖomaɖoea?

english_verse: No! I will give my opinion,
translation_verse: Nye hã magblɔ tɔnye sinua; nye hã magblɔ nu si menya

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: elabena nya le asinye fũu, eye nye gbɔgbɔ le dzinye zim.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Nyemade ame aɖeke dzi alo aflu ame aɖeke o

translation_verse: esi meɖo ɖi na xaxaɣi, aʋaŋkekewo kple aʋakpegbe la kpɔa?

translation_verse: Ame kae ɖo toƒe na tsi gã siwo dzana kple mɔ na ahom sesẽwo,

translation_verse: Ènya dziƒo ƒe sewoa? Àte ŋu aɖo Mawu ƒe fiaɖuɖu anyi ɖe anyigba dzia?

translation_verse: Ame kae tsɔ nunya na dzi alo gɔmesese na susu?

translation_verse: Ame ka sie nunya le be wòaxlẽ lilikpowo? Ame kae ate ŋu aviã tsizɔ siwo le dziƒo,

translation_verse: “Wòe daa ade na dzatanɔ eye nèdia nuɖuɖu na dzatawo, ne dɔ le wo wum

translation_verse: “Ame kae na ablɔɖe gbetedzi? Ame kae tu kae?

translation_verse: Hoowɔwɔ si le edzi yim le dua me la le kokoe ɖim nɛ eye mele tasiaɖamkula ƒe ɣlidodo sem o.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Etsana le togbɛwo dzi dia gbeɖuƒe eye wòtsaa ŋu na gbe mumu ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: “Ɖe to si le gbe me la alɔ̃ asubɔ wòa? Atɔ ɖe wò gbeɖuƒe le zã mea?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Àte ŋu ade kae ɖe agbleŋlɔnu ŋua? Alɔ̃ anɔ yowòme aŋlɔ balimea?

translation_verse: Ɖe nàɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu le eƒe ŋusẽ gã la ta? Àtsɔ wò dɔ kpekpewo agble ɖe eƒe asi mea?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Àte ŋu aɖo dzi ɖe eŋu be atsɔ wò lu agbɔe na wò dedie eye wòaƒoe ƒu ɖe wò lugbɔƒea?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: “Golo ƒoa eƒe aʋala kpakpakpa dzidzɔtɔe gake womate ŋu atsɔe asɔ kple damixe ƒe fu kple aʋalã o.

translation_verse: eye metsɔ ɖeke le eme be, ame aɖe ate ŋu aɖo afɔ edzi, agbãe loo, alo lã wɔadã aɖe agbãe o.

translation_verse: Ke hã la, ne ekeke aʋala me, hedze duƒuƒu gɔme la, sɔ kple sɔdola ƒe nu ɖia kokoe nɛ.

translation_verse: “Wòe na ŋusẽ sɔ alo wòe tsɔ kɔdza de kɔ nɛa?

translation_verse: Wòe na wòtia kpo abe ʋetsuvi ene eye wòdoa ŋɔdzi kple eƒe ŋɔtimegbɔgbɔa?

translation_verse: Emlɔa anyi ɖe ati dama te eye wòɣlaa eɖokui ɖe aƒla siwo le sime la me.

translation_verse: Ame ka ate ŋu ake eƒe nu, nu si me aɖuwo katã kpe ɖe wo nɔewo nu le kple vɔvɔ̃?

translation_verse: Dzoxiwo dona tso eƒe nu me, eye nenema kee nye dzo ƒe aɖewo hã.

translation_verse: Dzudzɔ dona le eƒe ŋɔtime abe ale si tsize si woɖo aƒladzo dzi la fiena tua dzudzɔe ene.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Eƒe gbɔgbɔ dea dzo aka me eye dzo bibi dona tso eƒe nu me.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le eƒe kɔ me eye dɔmedzoe le eŋgɔ.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Eƒe ayi mlɔ wo nɔewo dzi eye wolé ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu sesĩe, ale be womate ŋu afoe ɖa o.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: Enana gogloƒewo fiena wlɔwlɔwlɔ abe aŋɔɖaze ene eye wòblua atsiaƒu me abe amiɖaze me blum wole ene.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Naneke mele anyigba dzi sɔ kplii o, enye nuwɔwɔ si mevɔ̃a naneke o.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Eklẽa ŋku ɖe nu siwo katã doa wo ɖokui ɖe dzi eye wònye fia ɖe nu siwo katã dana la dzi.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Azɔ menya be àte ŋu awɔ nu sia nu, ame aɖeke mate ŋu agblẽ wò ɖoɖowo me o.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Èbia be, ‘Ame kae nye esi tsyɔ nu nye aɖaŋudede dzi numanyamanyatɔe?’ Nyateƒee, meƒo nu le nu siwo nyemenya o la ŋuti, nu siwo goglo akpa na nye nyanya.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: “Ègblɔ be, ‘Ɖo to azɔ, ne maƒo nu, ne mabia gbe wò, ne nàɖo eŋu nam.’

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Nye towo se nya le ŋuwò, ke azɔ la, nye ŋkuwo kpɔ wò

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Esi Yehowa gblɔ nya siawo na Hiob vɔ la, egblɔ na Temanitɔ, Elifaz be, “Medo dɔmedzoe ɖe mia kple xɔ̃wò eveawo ŋu elabena miegblɔ nu si le eteƒe la tso ŋutinye abe nye dɔla Hiob ene o

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: eya ta azɔ mitsɔ nyitsu adre kple agbo adre, ne miayi ɖe nye dɔla Hiob gbɔ eye miasa numevɔ na mia ɖokuiwo. Nye dɔla Hiob ado gbe ɖa ɖe mia ta, mase eƒe gbedodoɖa eye nyemaɖo miaƒe bometsinuwo teƒe na mi o elabena mieƒo nu nyui tso ŋutinye abe nye dɔla Hiob ene o.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Ale Temanitɔ, Elifaz, Suhitɔ, Bildad kple Naamatitɔ, Zofar wɔ abe ale si Yehowa de see na wo ene eye Yehowa xɔ Hiob ƒe gbe si wòdo ɖa ɖe wo ta.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Esi Hiob do gbe ɖa ɖe exɔlɔ̃awo ta vɔ la, Yehowa gawɔe kesinɔtɔe abe tsã ene eye wòdzi eƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖe edzi nɛ zi eve wu tsã.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Nɔviŋutsuwo kple nɔvia nyɔnuwo katã kple eƒe ame nyanyɛwo katã va egbɔ eye woɖu nu kplii le eƒe aƒe me. Wofa akɔ nɛ, hede dzi ƒo nɛ ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e siwo Yehowa he va edzii la ta eye wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe na klosaloga kple sikasigɛe.

english_verse: The Lord now blessed Job more than ever; he gave him
translation_verse: Yehowa yra Hiob fifia wu tsã. Alẽ akpe wuiene (

english_verse: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.
translation_verse: Ena ŋkɔ nyɔnuvi gbãtɔ be, Yemima, evelia be, Kezia eye etɔ̃lia be Keren Hapuk.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Viŋutsu adre kple vinyɔnu etɔ̃ hã nɔ esi.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Womegakpɔ nyɔnu aɖeke le anyigba blibo la dzi wòdze tugbe de Hiob ƒe vinyɔnuwo nu o. Wo fofo na domenyinu wo ɖe wo nɔviŋutsuwo xa.

english_verse: years—long enough to see his great-grandchildren have children of their own—
translation_verse: ) eye wòkpɔ viawo kple woƒe viwo ƒe dzidzime ene sɔŋ.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Ale Hiob tsi, nɔ agbe wòde edeƒe hafi ku.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Woayra ame si mezɔna ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nu alo nɔa tsitre ɖe nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo ƒe mɔ dzi loo alo nɔa anyi ɖe fewuɖulawo dome o,

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: ke boŋ ekpɔa dzidzɔ le Yehowa ƒe se la ŋu, eye wòdea ŋugble le eŋu zã kple keli.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Eya amea ɖi ati si wodo ɖe tɔʋuwo to, esi tsea ku le etseɣi, melũa xe o, eye nu sia nu si wòwɔna la, edzea edzi nyuie.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Mele alea na ame vɔ̃ɖi ya o! Wole abe blitsro si ya ƒona dzonae la ene.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Eya ta ame vɔ̃ɖi manɔ te le ʋɔnudrɔ̃gbe, alo nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo nanɔ ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe ha me o.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa kpɔa ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe mɔ ta, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ atsrɔ̃ gbidii.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Nu ka ta dukɔwo le nugbe ɖom, eye amewo le nu dzodzrowo ɖom?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzifiawo ɖo afɔ anyi sesĩe, eye dumegãwo ƒo ta kpli ɖe aɖaŋu me ɖe Yehowa kple eƒe amesiamina la ŋu.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Wole gbɔgblɔm be, “Mina míado le Yehowa kple eƒe amesiamina la te, eye míana ablɔɖe mía ɖokuiwo.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Ame si woɖo zi dzi le dziƒo la ko nu, eye Yehowa ɖe alɔme le wo ŋu.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Tete wòka mo na wo le eƒe dɔmedzoe me, eye wòdo ŋɔdzi na wo le eƒe dziku helĩhelĩ me hegblɔ be,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “Meɖo nye ŋutɔ nye fia ɖe Zion, nye to kɔkɔe la dzi.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Maɖe gbeƒã Yehowa ƒe sedede la; Yehowa gblɔ nam be, “Wòe nye vinye ŋutsu, egbea mezu fofowò.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Biam, ne matsɔ dukɔwo awɔ wò domenyinui kple anyigba ƒe seƒewo ke awɔ tɔwòe.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Àtsɔ gafiatikplɔ aɖu wo dzii, eye àxlã wo ɖi, woakaka abe ale si ze gbãnae ene.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Eya ta mi fiawo, midze nunya, eye mi anyigbadzidumegãwo, miɖo to nuxlɔ̃ame.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ ɖokuibɔbɔ kple bubu subɔ Yehowa le dzidzɔ gã me kple dzodzo nyanyanya.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ ɖokuibɔbɔ do ɖe fia la ŋkume, ne menye nenema o la, ado dziku, eye wòatsrɔ̃ mi kpata, elabena eƒe dɔmedzoe ate ŋu afla ɣe sia ɣi. Woayra ame siwo katã tsɔe wɔ sitsoƒee.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: O, Yehowa, aleke nye futɔwo sɔ gbɔ ale! Aleke ame geɖewo tso ɖe ŋunye ale!

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo le gbɔgblɔm tso ŋutinye be, “Mawu maɖee akpɔ o.” Sela

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: O, Yehowa, ke wò la, ènye akpoxɔnu ƒo xlãm; ètsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kɔ ɖe dzinye, eye nèkɔ nye ta dzi.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Yehowae medo ɣli na sesĩe, eye wòtɔ nam tso eƒe to kɔkɔe la dzi. Sela

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Memlɔ anyi hedɔ alɔ̃; meganyɔ, elabena Yehowae kpɔ tanye.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Nyemavɔ̃ na ame akpe nane siwo ho, ɖe to ɖem godoo la o.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Tso, O, Yehowa! Ɖem, O, nye Mawu! Ƒo tome na nye futɔwo katã; eye nàŋe aɖu na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbɔe ɖeɖe tsona. Na be wò yayra nanɔ wò amewo dzi. Sela.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Nye Mawu dzɔdzɔetɔ, tɔ nam ne meyɔ wò. Na gbɔdzɔem le nye xaxa me; kpɔ nye nublanui, eye nàse nye gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: O! Amegbetɔviwo, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣie miaɖi gbɔ̃ nye ŋutikɔkɔe? Va se ɣe ka ɣie mialɔ̃ beble, ahadze aʋatsomawuwo yome? Sela

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Minyae be Yehowa tia mawuvɔ̃lawo na eɖokui, eya ta Yehowa asee, ne meyɔe.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Migawɔ nu vɔ̃ ne dzi ku mi o; ne miele miaƒe abawo dzi la, midzro miaƒe dziwo me, eye mizi ɖoɖoe. Sela

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Misa vɔ siwo le dzɔdzɔe, eye miɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo le biabiam be, “Ame kae afia nu nyui aɖe mí?” Na wò mo ƒe kekeli naklẽ ɖe mía dzi, O! Yehowa.

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ dzidzɔ gã aɖe yɔ nye dzi me wu ame siwo bli kple wain yeye do agbogbo na.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mamlɔ anyi, adɔ alɔ̃ le ŋutifafa me, elabena wò, Yehowa, koe na mele dedie.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖo to nye nyawo, eye nàse nye hũɖeɖe.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Fianye kple Mawunye, ɖo to nye ɣlidodo, elabena wòe mele gbe dom ɖa na.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, le ŋdi me la, àse nye gbe; le ŋdi me la, matsɔ nye biabiawo aɖo ŋkuwò me, eye manɔ lalam kple mɔkpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Menye Mawu si kpɔa dzidzɔ le vɔ̃ ŋutie nènye o; wò la, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo mate ŋu anɔ gbɔwò o.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Ɖokuiŋudzelawo mate ŋu atsi tsitre ɖe ŋkuwò me o; elabena èlé fu nu vlo wɔlawo katã.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Ètsrɔ̃ aʋatsokalawo; Yehowa tsri hlɔ̃dolawo kple ameblelawo.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Ke nye ya, mava wò aƒe me to wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã la me. Matsɔ bubu ade ta agu ɖe wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la ŋgɔ.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Kplɔm, O! Yehowa, le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye nu le nye futɔwo ta, eye wɔ wò mɔwo dzɔdzɔe le ŋkunye me.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Womate ŋu axɔ nya siwo doa go tso woƒe nu me la ɖeka pɛ hã dzi ase o, woƒe dzi yɔ fũu kple gbegblẽ. Woƒe ve me le abe yɔdo si le ʋuʋu ɖi la ene, eye wotsɔa woƒe aɖe gblɔa alakpanyawoe.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, bu fɔ wo! Na be woƒe ayemɔwo naƒu wo anyi. Ɖe wo ɖa le woƒe nu vɔ̃ gbogboawo ta, elabena wodze aglã ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Ke na ame siwo si wò tso la nakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye na be woadzi ha kple dzidzɔ tegbee. Keke wò ametakpɔkpɔ ɖe wo dzi, ale be ame siwo lɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ la natso aseye le mewò.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, èyraa ame dzɔdzɔewo vavã, eye nètsɔa wò amenuveve ƒoa xlã wo abe akpoxɔnu ene.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mègaka mo nam le wò dziku me alo ahe to nam le wò dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ me o.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Yehowa, kpɔ nublanui nam, elabena nu te ŋunye. O! Yehowa, yɔ dɔm, elabena nye ƒuwo le veve sem.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ le nuxaxa me. Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi, O! Yehowa, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, trɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye nàɖem; ɖem, le wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ta.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke meɖoa ŋku dziwò ne eku o. Ame kae kafua wò tso eƒe yɔdo me?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Mevɔ le eme keŋkeŋ le ŋeŋe ta; metsɔ aɖatsi ƒo nye aba, elabena mefa avi zã blibo la, eye nye aɖatsi wɔe be nye dɔƒe ƒo tsi belebele.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Nuxaxa na ɖeɖi te nye ŋkuwo ŋu; womegale nu kpɔm tututu o, le nye futɔwo ta.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Mite ɖa le gbɔnye, mi nu vlo wɔlawo, elabena Yehowa se nye avifafa.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Yehowa se ɣli si medo be wòakpɔ nye nublanui; Yehowa xɔ nye gbedodoɖa alɔ eve.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo katã ŋu akpe mi, eye miaƒe mo atsi dãa; woagbugbɔ ɖe megbe enumake kple ŋukpe.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nye Mawu, wòe mesi tso, xɔ nam, eye nàɖem tso ame siwo katã le yonyeme tim la ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Ne menye nenema o la, woavuvum abe ale si dzata vuvua nui ene, eye woavuvum ʋayaʋaya, xɔnametɔ aɖeke mava ɖem o.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: ne mewɔ nu vɔɖi ɖe ame si li kplim le ŋutifafa me ŋuti alo meda adzo nye futɔ naneke mawɔmawɔtɔe la,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ekema na nye futɔ nati yonyeme, eye eƒe asi nasu dzinye; na be wòafanyam ɖe anyigba, eye wòana matsi ke me adɔ. Sela

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
