translation_verse: O! Yehowa, tso, le wò dziku me; tso ɖe nye futɔwo ƒe nyanyra ŋuti. Nyɔ, nye Mawu, ne nàɖo ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ anyi.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Na be amehawo naƒo ƒu ɖe ŋuwò. Ɖu fia ɖe wo dzi tso dziƒo;

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: na be Yehowa nadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔ la. O! Yehowa, tso afia nam le nye dzɔdzɔenyenye ta, O! Dziƒoʋĩtɔ, tso afia nam le nye nuteƒewɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu dzɔdzɔetɔ, ame si dzroa susuwo kple dziwo me, na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ nu natso, eye nàna dedinɔnɔ ame dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Nye akpoxɔnue nye Mawu Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la, ame si ɖea ame si dza le eƒe dzi me.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Mawue nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃la dzɔdzɔe, Mawu si ɖea eƒe dɔmedzoe fiana gbe sia gbe.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Nu metia kɔ nɛ o, anyre eƒe yi, eye wòavu eƒe dati me.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Ame si fɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi ƒe fu, eye dzɔgbevɔ̃e zu fu wòfɔ la, adzi beble ƒe vi.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖe ʋe, heku eme wògoglo nyuie la age dze ʋe si eya ŋutɔ ɖe la me.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e si wòhe vɛ la atrɔ abali ɖe eya ŋutɔ ŋuti, eye eƒe ŋutasesẽ atrɔ ava eya ŋutɔ ƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mada akpe na Yehowa le eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ta, eye madzi kafukafuha na Yehowa Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: O Yehowa, míaƒe Aƒetɔ, aleke wò ŋkɔ ƒe gãnyenye yɔ anyigba katã dzi ale! Èɖo wò ŋutikɔkɔe anyi ɖe dziƒowo tame.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Èɖo kafukafu anyi ɖe ɖeviwo kple vi nonowo ƒe nu me le wò futɔwo ta be nàmia nu na futɔ kple hlɔ̃biala la.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Ne mekpɔ wò dziƒowo, siwo nye wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo, ne mekpɔ ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo, nu siwo nètsɔ ɖo wo nɔƒee la,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: Nu kae nye amegbetɔ be wò ŋkuwo le eŋuti kple amegbetɔvi be nèléa be nɛ?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Èwɔe wòsɔ kple Mawu kloe, eye nètsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple bubu ɖɔ nɛ.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Èwɔe be wòanye agbo ɖe wò asinudɔwɔwɔ dzi; eye nètsɔ nu sia nu de eƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: dziƒoxeviwo, ƒumelãwo kple nu siwo katã ƒua tsi le atsiaƒu me la le eƒe kpɔkplɔ te.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: O Yehowa, míaƒe Aƒetɔ, aleke wò ŋkɔ ƒe gãnyenye yɔ anyigba katã dzi ale!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Makafu wò, O! Yehowa, kple nye dzi blibo, maɖe wò nukunuwɔwɔwo katã afia.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Dzi adzɔm, eye matso aseye le mewò; O Dziƒoʋĩtɔ, madzi kafukafuhawo na wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo trɔ megbe; wokli nu, eye wo katã wotsrɔ̃ le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Elabena wòe xɔ nye nya, eye nèɖe nye dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖe go. Ènɔ wò fiazikpui dzi, eye nèdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Èka mo na dukɔwo, eye nètsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo hetutu woƒe ŋkɔwo ɖa tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Tsɔtsrɔ̃ mavɔ va futɔ la dzi, elabena èho woƒe duwo, eye womagaɖo ŋku wo dzi gɔ̃ hã akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Yehowa aɖu fia tegbetegbe; eɖo eƒe fiazikpui anyi hena ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea me le dzɔdzɔenyenye me; akplɔ dukɔwo katã le nuteƒewɔwɔ me.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Yehowa nye sitsoƒe na ame siwo wote ɖe anyi kple mɔ sesẽ le xaxaɣiwo.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Ame siwo nya wò ŋkɔ la aɖo dzi ɖe ŋuwò, elabena wò Yehowa, megble ame siwo dia wò la ɖi kpɔ o.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Midzi kafukafuhawo na Yehowa, ame si nɔ fiazikpui dzi gli le Zion, miɖe gbeƒã nu siwo wòwɔ la le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Elabena eya, ame si biaa hlɔ̃ hlɔ̃dolawo la, ɖoa ŋku edzi, medoa toku hiãtɔwo ƒe ɣlidodo o.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: O Yehowa, kpɔ ale si nye futɔwo le yonyeme tim ɖa! Kpɔ nye nublanui, eye nàkɔm tso ku ƒe agbowo me,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: be maɖe wò kafukafu afia le Zion Vinyɔnu ƒe agbowo me, eye le afi ma matso aseye le ɖeɖe si nènam la ta.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ge dze do si woawo ŋutɔ woɖe la me; woƒe afɔwo ɖo ɖɔ si woawo ŋutɔ woɖo ɖi le bebeme la me.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe eɖokui fia to eƒe ʋɔnu dzɔdzɔe dɔdrɔ̃ me; ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo atsɔ wo ade mɔ me. Ŋugbledede. Sela

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo gbugbɔ yi yɔ me, nenema kee nye dukɔ siwo ŋlɔ Mawu be.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Ke womaŋlɔ hiãtɔ be ɖikaa alo ame si le fu kpem la, mɔkpɔkpɔ nabu ɖee o.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Tso, O Yehowa! Mègana amegbetɔ naɖu dzi o, na woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ƒo wo ƒu anyi kple ŋɔdzi; na dukɔwo nanya be amegbetɔwo yewonye. Sela.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nu ka ta nèle adzɔge ʋĩi ɖo? Nu ka ta nèɣla ɖokuiwò le xaxaɣiwo ɖo?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi dadala he hiãtɔ ƒu anyi, ke wògena ɖe mɔ si wòtre da ɖi la me.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nu siwo eƒe dzi dina la, egblɔnɛ adegbeƒotɔe; eyraa ŋuklẽlawo, eye wòɖea alɔme le Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi la media eƒe mɔ o, le dada viviwo ta, le eƒe ŋugblededewo katã me la, meɖoa ŋku Mawu dzi o.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Eƒe mɔwo dzea edzi nɛ nyuie ɣe sia ɣi, edoa eɖokui ɖe dzi, wò sewo didi tso egbɔ; eye wòɖoa hehe ɖe eƒe futɔwo ta.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Egblɔna na eɖokui be, “Naneke maʋuʋum o, makpɔ dzidzɔ ɣe sia ɣi, eye nyemage ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e me akpɔ o.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Fiƒode, alakpa kple ŋɔdzidodo yɔ eƒe nu me fũu, eye gbegblẽ kple nu vɔ̃ɖi le eƒe aɖe te.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Edea xa ɖe kɔƒewo xa; ewu ame maɖifɔwo le xame, eye wòtsa ŋu na ame si wòalé le bebeme.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Edea xa ɖe ɣaɣlɛƒe abe dzatae be ɖe ave xa ene; ale be wòalé amemanɔsitɔ; eléa amemanɔsitɔ, eye wòhea wo ɖe eƒe ɖɔ me dzonae.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Egblɔna na eɖokui be, “Mawu ŋlɔ be; etsɔ nu tsyɔ eƒe mo, eye mele nu kpɔm o.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Tso, Yehowa! O! Mawu, kɔ wò abɔ dzi. Mègaŋlɔ hiãtɔ be o.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Nu ka ta ame vɔ̃ɖi la le alɔme ɖem le Mawu ŋuti ɖo? Nu ka ta wògblɔna na eɖokui be, “Mayɔm be mana akɔnta o” ɖo?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Ke wò, O! Mawu, koe kpɔa dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple vevesese; èbua eŋuti, eye asiwò me wole. Ame si le fukpekpe me la, tsɔa eɖokui dea asi na wò; elabena wòe nye xɔnametɔ na tsyɔ̃eviwo.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Ŋe abɔ na ame vɔ̃ɖi kple nu tovo wɔla; yɔe ne wòana akɔnta tso nu vɔ̃ɖi siwo wòwɔ ame aɖeke mekpɔe o la ŋuti.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye fia tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me; dukɔwo atsrɔ̃ ɖa le eƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, èse hiãtɔwo ƒe didi; ède dzi ƒo na wo, eye nèɖo to woƒe ɣlidodo.

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: Èʋli tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la ta, ale be amegbetɔ si nye anyi la magado ŋɔdzi na amewo azɔ o.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Yehowae mesi tso. Aleke miele gbɔgblɔm nam be, “Dzo abe xevi ene nàyi ɖe wò to dzi?

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Elabena kpɔ ɖa, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo he woƒe da me; wotsɔ woƒe aŋutrɔwo ɖo datikawo ŋuti be woada ame siwo dza le woƒe dzi me la le blukɔ me.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Esi wole gɔmeɖokpeawo gbãm la, nu ka dzɔdzɔetɔ la awɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Yehowa le eƒe gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me; Yehowa le eƒe fiazikpui dzi le dziƒo. Elé ŋku ɖe amegbetɔviwo ŋu, eye wòdo wo kpɔ.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Yehowa doa ame dzɔdzɔe kpɔna, ke eƒe luʋɔ tsri ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kple ame siwo lɔ̃a ŋutasesẽ.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ana dzoka xɔxɔ kple aŋɔ dzodzoe nadza ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi, eye ya xɔdzo anye wo tɔ gome.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowae nye dzɔdzɔetɔ, elɔ̃a nuteƒewɔwɔ; ame siwo dza le woƒe dzi me la akpɔ eƒe ŋkume.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Xɔ nam, Yehowa elabena, mawuvɔ̃lawo megali o, eye nuteƒewɔlawo bu le amegbetɔwo dome.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Ame sia ame kaa aʋatso na ehavi, eye wovivia nu me, elabena woƒe nuyiwo blea ame.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Yehowa nelã beblenuyiwo katã kple aɖe siwo doa wo ɖokui ɖe dzi

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: hegblɔna be, “Míaɖu dzi kple míaƒe aɖewo, míaƒe nuyiwo nye mía tɔ, ame kae aɖu amegã ɖe mía dzi?”

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Yehowa be, “Esi wotea ame gblɔewo ɖe to, eye hiãtɔwo ŋena ta la, matso azɔ. Maɖe wo tso ame siwo le vlo dom wo la ƒe asi me.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Kpɔtsɔtsɔ mele Yehowa ƒe nyawo ŋuti o, wole abe klosalo si wololo le anyikpo me, eye wòdza zi gbɔ zi adre la ene.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo zɔna le ablɔɖe me, eye wodea bubu yakanuwɔwɔwo ŋu le amegbetɔwo dome.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, àna míanɔ dedie, eye àdzɔ mía ŋu tso ame siawo tɔgbi ƒe asi me tegbetegbe.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi? Ɖe nàŋlɔm be ɖikaɖika? Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi nàɣla wò ŋkume ɖem?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi mawɔ avu kple nye tamesusu, eye gbe sia gbe nuxaxa nayɔ nye dzi me? Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi nye futɔwo aɖu dzinye?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Kpɔm ɖa, eye nàɖo nya ŋu nam, O! Yehowa, nye Mawu. Na kekeli naklẽ ɖe nye ŋkuwo dzi, ne menye nenema o la, madɔ alɔ̃ ayi ku me.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Ekema nye futɔwo agblɔ be, “Meɖu edzi,” eye nye ketɔwo akpɔ dzidzɔ ne medze anyi.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Ke nye ya meɖo dzi ɖe wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ŋu, nye dzi le aseye tsom le wò xɔname ŋuti.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Madzi ha na Yehowa, elabena ewɔ nyui nam.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Bometsila gblɔna le eƒe dzi me be, “Mawu aɖeke meli o.” Wonye ame tovowo, eye woƒe nuwɔnawo nye ŋunyɔnu; ame ɖeka hɔ̃ɔ hã mele wo dome si wɔa nu nyui o.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Yehowa bi kɔ kpɔ amegbetɔviwo ɖa tso dziƒo, be wòakpɔe ɖa be nugɔmesela aɖe le wo dome, eye wòdia Mawu vevie mahã?

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ɖe nu tovo wɔlawo, ame siwo ɖua nye amewo abe abolo ene, eye womeyɔa Yehowa o la manya esia oa?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi lé wo ale gbegbe, elabena Mawu le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe hame.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Mi nu tovo wɔlawo, miegblẽ ame dahewo ƒe ɖoɖowo me, gake Yehowae nye woƒe sitsoƒe.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: O! Xɔname ado tso Zion na Israel. Ne Yehowa gaɖo eƒe amewo ƒe nunyonamewo te la, na Yakob natso aseye, eye Israel nakpɔ dzidzɔ!

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Yehowa, ame kae dze anɔ wò kɔkɔeƒe la? Ame kae anɔ wò togbɛ kɔkɔe la dzi?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Ame si fɔɖiɖi mele eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe lae. Ame si toa nyateƒe tso eƒe dzi me ke

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: eye ameŋugbegblẽ mele aɖe dzi nɛ o, ame si mewɔa vɔ̃ ɖe ehavi ŋu o, eye meƒoa ɖi nɔvia amegbetɔ o,

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: ame si ame baɖa ƒe nu menyoa eŋu o, ke boŋ edea bubu ame siwo vɔ̃a Yehowa la ŋuti, ame si kaa atam si hea vevesese vanɛ, gake megbea edziwɔwɔ o,

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: ame si medoa ga xɔa deme ɖe edzi o, eye mexɔa zãnu ɖe ame maɖifɔ ŋuti o. Ame si wɔa nu siawo la, naneke maʋãe akpɔ gbeɖegbeɖe o.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: O! Mawu, na manɔ dedie, elabena wò mee mebe ɖo.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Megblɔ na Yehowa be, “Wòe nye nye Aƒetɔ; nu nyui aɖeke mele asinye kpe ɖe ŋuwò o.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Ame kɔkɔe siwo le anyigba dzi la woe nye bubume siwo ƒe nu nyoa ŋunye vevie.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ati mawu tutɔwo yome la, adzi woƒe vevesesewo ɖe edzi. Nyemasa woƒe ʋuvɔsawo na mawu mawo, alo ayɔ woƒe ŋkɔwo o.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa, èɖo tɔnye gome kple nye kplu da ɖi nam; èna nye gomekpɔkpɔ le dedie nam.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Liƒo ƒe dzidzeka la dze teƒe nyuiwo nam; le nyateƒe me la, domenyinu si do dzidzɔ nam la su asinye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Makafu Yehowa, ame si ɖoa aɖaŋu nam; le zã me ke hã, nye dzi xlɔ̃a num.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Metsɔ Yehowa ɖo ŋkunye me ɖaa, elabena ele nye nuɖusime, eya ta nyemavɔ̃ o.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Esia ta nye dzi le dzidzɔ kpɔm, nye aɖe tso aseye, eye nye ŋutilã hã agbɔ ɖe eme le dedinɔnɔ me,

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: elabena màgblẽm ɖi na yɔdo alo ana wò, Kɔkɔetɔ la, nàkpɔ gbegblẽ o.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Èna menya agbemɔ la; àtsɔ dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ayɔ menye le ŋkuwò me, eye matsɔ vivisese si mevɔna o la anɔ wò nuɖusime tegbee.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: See, O! Yehowa, ɖo to nye ɣlidodo kple nye dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kukuɖeɖe. Ƒu to anyi ɖe nye gbedodoɖa si metso alakpanuyiwo me o.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Afiatsotso nam netso gbɔwò, eye na wò ŋkuwo nakpɔ nu si le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be èdzro nye dzi me eye nèlé ŋku ɖe ŋunye tsitotsito le zã me; ne èdom kpɔ hã la, màkpɔ naneke le menye o. Meɖoe kplikpaa be nye nu mawɔ nu vɔ̃ o.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Le amegbetɔwo ƒe nuwɔnawo me la, metsɔ wò numenya kpɔ ɖokuinye dzii be, nyemage ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔwo dzi o.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Nye afɔɖeɖewo li ɖe wò toƒewo, eye nye afɔ meɖiɖi o.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Mele yɔwòm, O! Mawu, elabena àtɔ nam; ƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye, eye nàse nye gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò lɔlɔ̃ gã la ƒe nukunu fia, wò ame si tsɔa wò nuɖusi ɖea ame siwo si wò tso, tso woƒe futɔwo ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Kpɔ tanye abe wò ŋku ƒe gadaglamakui ene, eye nàɣlam ɖe wò aʋala ƒe vɔvɔli te,

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖi siwo le funyafunya wɔmem kple futɔ siwo ɖe to ɖem la ƒe asi me.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Wotu woƒe ŋutasẽdziwo, eye wotsɔa woƒe nuwo gblɔa dadanyawoe.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wodo afɔ nam, eye azɔ la, woɖe to ɖem, woƒe ŋkuwo le te ne woaxlãm ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Wole abe dzata dɔwui si le nu dim be yealé, hele adeklo dzi le avekɔe me ene.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, tso, kpe akɔ kpli wo, he wo ƒu anyi, eye tsɔ wò yi nàɖem le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, tsɔ wò asi ɖem le ame siawo tɔgbi kple xexemetɔ siawo ƒe asi me, ame siwo ƒe fetu le agbe sia me. Ètsia ame siwo nèlɔ̃ vevie la ƒe dɔwuame nu; wo viŋutsuwo kpɔ nu nyui geɖe, eye wodzraa kesinɔnuwo ɖo ɖi na wo viwo.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, makpɔ wò ŋkume le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye ne menyɔ hekpɔ wò nɔnɔme ko la, maɖi ƒo.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nye ŋusẽ, melɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Yehowa nye nye agakpe, nye mɔ kple nye xɔnametɔ. Nye Mawu nye nye agakpe, eyae mesi tso. Eyae nye nye akpoxɔnu kple ɖeɖe ƒe ŋusẽ kple nye mɔ sesẽ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Meyɔ Yehowa, ame si dze na kafukafu, eɖem tso nye futɔwo katã ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Ku ƒe kawo blam, eye nu siwo gblẽa ame la ƒo ɖe dzinye abe tɔʋu ene.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Tsiẽƒe ƒe kawo blam, eye ku ƒe mɔtetrewo ɖi kpem.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Meyɔ Yehowa le nye xaxa me; medo ɣli na nye Mawu be wòaɖem. Ese nye gbe tso eƒe gbedoxɔ me ke, eye nye ɣlidodo ɖo egbɔ, ge ɖe eƒe to me.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Tete anyigba dzo nyanyanya, eye wòʋuʋu; towo ƒe agunuwo ke hã ʋuʋu heyeheye, eye wodzo kpekpekpe, elabena dzi kui.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Dzudzɔ do tso eƒe ŋɔtime; dzo ƒe aɖewo do tso eƒe nu me eye dzoka xɔxɔwo kplɔe ɖo.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ema dziŋgɔli ɖe eve, wòto eme ɖi va anyi, eye lilikpo do blukɔ le eƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ede kerubiwo dzi, eye wòdzo dzo. Eɖo asagba ɖe ya ƒe aʋalawo dzi.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Viviti nye avɔ si wòtsyɔ, eye lilikpo yibɔ si dzaa tsi lae nye agbadɔ si ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Lilikpo, kpetsi kple dzikedzo do tso eƒe mo ƒe keklẽ la me.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖe gbe tso dziƒo, eye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la na wose eƒe gbe.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: Eda eƒe aŋutrɔ, eye wòkaka eƒe futɔwo, eɖo dzikedzo ɖa, eye wòtɔtɔ wo.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu ƒe balimewo dze gaglã, eye anyigba ƒe gɔmeɖoɖo tsi ƒuƒlu. Le Yehowa ƒe nyaheɖeameŋu kple gbɔgbɔ si do tso eƒe ŋɔtime ta.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Edo asi ɖa tso dziƒo lém, Heɖem tso tɔ goglowo me.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Eɖem tso nye futɔ ŋusẽtɔwo ƒe asi me, tso nye ketɔwo ƒe asi me, ame siwo sesẽ wum akpa la ƒe asi me.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Woƒo ɖe dzinye le nye dzɔgbevɔ̃egbe, gake Yehowa nye nye kpeɖeŋutɔ.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Eɖem tsɔ da ɖe teƒe gbadzaa; eɖem, elabena nye nu nyo eŋu.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Yehowa nɔ kplim le nye dzɔdzɔenyenye nu, eye wòwɔ nyui nam le esi nye asi me dza la ta.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Elabena melé Yehowa ƒe mɔwo me ɖe asi; nyemewɔ vɔ̃ hetrɔ le nye Mawu yome o.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Eƒe sewo katã le ŋkunye me; eye nyemetrɔ le eƒe ɖoɖowo yome o.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Nyemeɖi fɔ le eŋkume o, eye mete ɖokuinye ɖa tso nu vɔ̃ gbɔ.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔ nyui nam le nye dzɔdzɔenyenye kple esi nye asi me dza le eŋkume la ta.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Èwɔa nuteƒe na nuteƒewɔla, eye nèfiaa ɖokuiwò fɔmaɖilae na ame si ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Ame si dza le eƒe dzi me la, èɖea ɖokuiwò fianɛ be èdza, eye nèfiaa ɖokuiwò ayetɔe ɖe ayetɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Èɖea ame siwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui, ke ame siwo si dadaŋku le la, èɖiɖia wo ɖe anyi.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Wò, O! Yehowae na nye akaɖi le bibim, eye nye Mawu trɔ nye viviti wòzu kekeli.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Mawu ya ƒe mɔwo de blibo, Yehowa ƒe nya nye nyateƒe sɔŋ. Enye akpoxɔnu na ame siwo tsɔe wɔ sitsoƒee.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Elabena ame kae ganye Mawu kpe ɖe Yehowa ŋu? Ame kae ganye Agakpe, ɖe menye míaƒe Mawu la koe oa?

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Mawue nye nye mɔ sesẽ, Eyae na nye mɔ zu gbadzaa.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nye afɔwo abe zi tɔwo ene, eye wòna metea ŋu tsia tsitre ɖe teƒe kɔkɔwo.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Efia aʋawɔwɔ nye asiwo, eye nye asiwo ate ŋu abɔ dati si wowɔ kple akɔbli.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ wò dziɖuɖu ƒe akpoxɔnu la nam, eye wò nuɖusi lém ɖe te. Èbɔbɔ ɖokuiwò be nàdo kɔkɔm.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Èkeke mɔ le tenye, be nye klowo magli le tenye o.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Meti nye futɔwo yome, eye metu wo. Nyemetrɔ le wo yome o, va se ɖe esime wotsrɔ̃.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Metsrɔ̃ wo be womagate ŋu afɔ gbeɖe o, ale wodze anyi ɖe nye afɔ nu.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Wòe na ŋusẽm hena aʋa la wɔwɔ, Èna mebɔbɔ ame siwo katã tso ɖe ŋunye la ɖe anyi.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Èna nye futɔwo trɔ megbe dem helé du tsɔ, eye metsrɔ̃ nye futɔwo.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli be Yehowa naxɔ na yewo, gake ame aɖeke mexɔ na wo o, elabena Yehowa metɔ na wo o.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Metu wo memie abe ʋuʋudedi si ya lɔ ɖe nu la ene, eye metrɔ wo ɖe mɔtata dzi abe anyi ene.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Èɖem tso ame siwo va dze dzinye la ƒe asi me, ètsɔm ɖo dukɔwo nu, eye ame siwo nyemenya o la dzie meɖu fia ɖo.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Dzi ɖena le wo katã ƒo, eye wotsɔa dzodzo nyanyanya hedoa goe le woƒe mɔ sesẽwo me.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa li tegbee! Woakafu nye Agakpe la! Woado Mawu, nye Xɔla la, ɖe dzi bobobo!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Eyae nye Mawu si biaa hlɔ̃ nam, eye wòbɔbɔa dukɔwo ɖe nye afɔ te,

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: ame si ɖeam tso nye futɔwo ƒe asi me. Èkɔm ɖe dzi gbɔ nye futɔwo ta, eye nèɖem tso ŋutasẽlawo ƒe asi me.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, makafu wò le dukɔwo dome le esia ta, eye madzi kafukafuha na wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Ena dziɖuɖu gãwo eƒe fia la; eɖe amenuveve si nu meyi o la fia David, eƒe amesiamina la kple eƒe dzidzimeviwo tegbee.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Dziƒo ɖe Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ɖe go, eye dziŋgɔli le gbeƒã ɖem eƒe asinudɔwo.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke, wole Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kafum, eye tso zã yi zã, wole eƒe gãnyenye ɖem fia.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Nuƒoƒo alo gbegbɔgblɔ aɖeke meli si me womese woƒe gbe le o.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: Woƒe gbe ɖina le anyigba dzi afi sia afi, eye woƒe nyawo dea xexea me ƒe mlɔenu ke gɔ̃ hã. Etu agbadɔ ɖe dziƒowo na ɣe,

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: eye wòle abe ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃e le go dom tso eƒe agbadɔ me ene. Ele abe duƒula si le dzidzɔ kpɔm be wòalé eƒe mɔ atsɔ ene.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Ɣe dzena tso dziƒo ƒe go ɖeka dzi, eye wòzɔna yia go kemɛ dzi, naneke meɣla ɖe eƒe dzoxɔxɔ o.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe se la de blibo, enaa agbegbɔgbɔ luʋɔ! Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖowo le eteƒe, eye wonana bometsilawo dzea nunya.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe mɔwo dzɔ, wonana dzi kpɔa dzidzɔ. Yehowa ƒe sewo me kɔ, wonana ame dzea nunya.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe sewo me kɔ; wonɔa anyi ɖaa. Yehowa ƒe sewo li ke sesĩe, eye ɖikeke aɖeke mele woƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋu o.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Woxɔ asi wu sika kple sika nyuitɔ; wovivina wu anyitsi kple anyitsi si woɖe le anyito me.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Wò sewo wotsɔ xlɔ̃ nu wò dɔlae, elabena viɖe gã geɖe le wo dzi wɔwɔ me.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Ame kae ate ŋu ade dzesi nu gbegblẽ si wòwɔ? Tsɔ nye vodada siwo metsɔ ɣla la kem.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò dɔla tso lɔlɔ̃nuwɔwɔ ƒe nu vɔ̃wo hã me; womaɖu dzinye akpɔ o. Ekema mazu fɔɖiɖi manɔŋutɔ, eye ŋutinye akɔ tso vodada gã me.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Na be nye numenyawo kple nye dzi ƒe ŋugbledede nadze ŋuwò, O! Yehowa, nye Agakpe kple nye Xɔnametɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa netɔ na wò ne èɖo xaxa me; Yakob ƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ nanye ŋuwòdzɔla.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Neɖo kpekpeɖeŋu ɖe wò tso kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wòaɖo xɔname ɖe wò tso Zion.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Neɖo ŋku wò vɔsawo katã dzi, eye wòaxɔ wò numevɔsawo. Sela

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Nena nu si wò dzi di la wò, eye wòana wò ɖoɖowo katã nadze edzi na wò.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Míado dzidzɔɣli ne èɖu dzi, eye míakɔ míaƒe aflagawo dzi le míaƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ me. Yehowa awɔ nu siwo katã nèbiae la na wò.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Azɔ menya be Yehowa ɖe eƒe amesiamina, etɔ nɛ tso eƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔe la kple eƒe nuɖusi ƒe ŋusẽ, si wòtsɔna ɖea amee.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo ɖoa ŋu ɖe tasiaɖamwo ŋu, eye ame aɖewo ɖoa dzi ɖe sɔwo ŋu, ke míawo ya míeɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu la ƒe ŋkɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Ame mawo la, wodzea klo, eye wodzea anyi, ke míawo ya, míenɔa tsitre, eye míedzɔna kã.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, xɔ na fia la! Tɔ na mí ne míeyɔ wò!

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, fia la le dzidzɔ kpɔm le wò ŋusẽ me. Ale gbegbe wòle aseye tsom le dziɖuɖu gã siwo nènae la ta!

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Ètsɔ nu si eƒe dzi di la nɛ, eye nèwɔ nu siwo wòtsɔ eƒe nu bia la dzi nɛ. Sela

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ yayra xɔasi geɖewo do dza nɛ, eye nètsɔ fiakuku si wowɔ kple sika nyuitɔ la ɖɔ nɛ.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ebia agbe wò, eye nènae hedidi eƒe ŋkekewo tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkɔxɔxɔ de du to dziɖuɖu siwo nènae la me. Ètsɔ atsyɔ̃ kple bubu kɔ ɖe eya amea dzi.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Vavã ènae yayra si nu meyina o, eye nèna dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ kple aseyetsotsoe le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Elabena fia la ɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye le Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o ta la, mavɔ̃ akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Wò asi alé wò futɔwo katã, eye wò nuɖusi atu wò ketɔwo.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Ne wò vavaɣi ɖo la, àwɔ wo abe kpodzo bibi ene. Yehowa ami wo le eƒe dɔmedzoe me, eye eƒe dzo afia wo katã.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Àtsrɔ̃ woƒe dzidzimeviwo ɖa le anyigba dzi, eye àtsrɔ̃ woƒe nunɔamesiwo ɖa le amegbetɔwo dome.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: elabena ne èdidi wò aŋutrɔ ɖe wo dzi la, woatrɔ ʋu me ade wò adzo.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Ède ŋgɔ, O! Yehowa, le wò ŋusẽ me; eya ta míadzi ha, eye míakafu wò ŋusẽ.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Nye Mawu, nye Mawu, nu ka ŋuti nègblẽm ɖi? Nu ka ta nèle adzɔge ʋĩi na xɔxɔ nam, eye nète ɖa xaa tso nye hũɖeɖe gbɔ?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: O! Nye Mawu, medo ɣli na wò le ŋkeke kple zã me; megale edzi ko, gake mètɔ nam o.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, èle kɔkɔe, eye Israel ƒe kafukafuhawo zu fiazikpui nènɔ anyi ɖe edzi gli.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Mewòe mía fofowo tsɔ woƒe xɔse dee, woka ɖe dziwò, eye nèɖe wo.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli na wò, eye nèɖe wo, dziwòe woka ɖo, eye ŋu mekpe wo o.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, ŋɔ menye, menye amegbetɔ o, elabena amewo ɖu fewu le ŋunye, eye wodo vlom.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã kpɔm la ɖe alɔme le ŋunye; woflɔa dzu ɖe dzinye, eye woʋuʋua ta ɖe ŋunye gblɔna be:

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Eka ɖe Yehowa dzi, Yehowa neɖee míakpɔ. Yehowa neɖee, elabena eƒe nu nyo eŋu.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Ke wòe hem tso vidzidɔ me, eye le danye ƒe no nu ke, èna meka ɖe dziwò.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Wòe nye nye Mawu tso danye ƒe dɔ me ke, eye tso ɖevime wotsɔm de asi na wò.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Mèganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o, elabena xaxa tum, eye ame aɖeke meli axɔ nam o.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Nyitsu geɖewo ɖe to ɖem; Basan nyitsu sesẽwo ƒo xlãm.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Woke woƒe nuwo ɖe ŋunye baa abe dzata si le gbe tem hele nu si wòlé la vuvum ene.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Woƒom ɖe anyi abe tsi ene, eye nye ƒuwo katã gli le woƒe kpeƒewo. Nye dzi lolõ ɖe dɔ me nam gbanaa hesi to menye.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye abe ze gbagbã ene, eye nye aɖe lé ɖe nye nu me, elabena ètsɔm mlɔ ku ƒe ʋuʋudedi me.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Avuwo ƒo xlãm, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ha ɖe to ɖem, eye wotsɔ nu ŋɔ nye asiwo kple afɔwo.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mate ŋu axlẽ nye ƒuwo, amewo fɔ ŋku ɖe dzinye, eye wokpɔ dzidzɔ le nye anyidzedze ŋuti.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Woma nye awuwo na wo nɔewo, eye woda akɔ ɖe nye awu ʋlaya dzi.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ke wò, O! Yehowa, mèganɔ adzɔge o; O! Nye ŋusẽ, va kaba nàɖem.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Ɖe nye agbe tso yi ƒe asi me, eye ɖe nye agbe xɔasi la tso avuwo ƒe ŋusẽ me.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Ɖem le dzatawo ƒe nu me, eye nàɖem le towo ƒe dzowo nu.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Maɖe gbeƒã wò ŋkɔ na nɔvinyewo, eye le amehawo dome, makafu wò.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo vɔ̃a Yehowa, mikafui! Mi, Yakob ƒe dzidzimeviwo, mide bubu eŋuti! Misroe ɖa, mi Israel ƒe dzidzimeviwo!

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Elabena menyɔ ŋu alo do vlo ame siwo le fu kpem la ƒe hiãtuame o; meɣla eƒe mo ɖee o, ke boŋ eɖo to eƒe ɣlidodo na kpekpeɖeŋu.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Gbɔwòe nye kafukafuha si medzina le ameha gãwo dome la ƒe tanya tsona. Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefewo le ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la ŋkume.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Hiãtɔwo aɖu nu aɖi ƒo; ame siwo dia Yehowa la akafui. Miaƒe dziwo nenɔ agbe tegbee!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Anyigba ƒe mlɔenu katã hã aɖo ŋku edzi, atrɔ ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye anyigbadzidukɔwo ƒe ƒomeawo katã ava de ta agu ɖe eŋkume.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Elabena fiaɖuɖu la nye Yehowa tɔ, eye wòɖu fia ɖe dukɔwo dzi.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔ siwo katã le anyigba dzi la aɖu nu, eye woasubɔe; ame siwo katã mate ŋu anɔ agbe o, eye woyi ɖe ke ƒe tume la adze klo ɖe eŋkume.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Dzidzimewo asubɔe, eye dzidzime siwo ava dzɔ la, woagblɔ nya na wo tso Aƒetɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Woaɖe gbeƒã eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye na ame siwo meva dzɔ haɖe o, elabena eyae wɔe.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye kplɔnyela, eya ta naneke mahiãm o.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Lãnyiƒe damawo dzi wòna metsyɔ akɔ ɖo, eye wòkplɔm yi tɔʋu fafɛwo gbɔe,

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: hena nye luʋɔ gbɔ agbe. Ekplɔm to dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔwo dzi le eƒe ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Ne mezɔ to ku ƒe balime si do viviti tsiɖitsiɖi hã la, nyemavɔ̃ dzɔgbevɔ̃e aɖeke o, elabena wòe le gbɔnye, eye wò lãkplɔti kple atikplɔ faa akɔ nam.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Èɖo kplɔ̃ ɖe akɔnyeme le nye ketɔwo ƒe ŋkume. Èsi ami ɖe ta nam, nye kplu yɔ gbagba.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Vavãe, dzɔgbenyui kple amenuveve adze yonyeme le nye agbemeŋkekewo katã me, eye manɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe me ɖaa.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Anyigba kple nu siwo katã yɔ edzi, xexea me kple emenɔlawo katã nye Yehowa tɔ.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Elabena eɖoe anyi ɖe atsiaƒu dzi, eye wòɖo egɔme anyi ɖe tɔsisiwo dzi gli.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Ame kae alia Yehowa ƒe togbɛ? Ame kae atsi tsitre ɖe eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒe asi me dza, eye eƒe dzi me le dzadzɛe, ame si metsɔ eƒe luʋɔ na legba o, eye mekaa aʋatso heta nu dzodzro o.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Eya axɔ yayra tso Yehowa gbɔ, eye Mawu, eƒe Ɖela la, atso afia nɛ.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: O! Yakob ƒe Mawu, aleae dzidzime si dia wò, eye wòdia ŋkuwòme la le. Sela

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: O! Mi agbowo, miʋu; mi blemaʋɔtruwo, miʋu, ne Ŋutikɔkɔefia la nage ɖe eme.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Ame kae nye Ŋutikɔkɔefia la? Yehowa ŋusẽtɔ kple kalẽtɔ lae, Yehowa si wɔa kalẽ le aʋagbedzi lae.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: O! Mi agbowo, miʋu; mi blemaʋɔtruwo, miʋu, ne Ŋutikɔkɔefia la nage ɖe eme.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Ame kae nye Ŋutikɔkɔefia sia? Yehowa Ŋusẽkatãtɔ lae nye Ŋutikɔkɔefia la. Sela.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wòe mekɔ nye luʋɔ ɖe dzi na.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: O! Nye Mawu, ŋuwòe meɖo dzi ɖo. Mègana ŋu nakpem, alo nàɖe mɔ nye futɔwo naɖu dzinye o.

english_verse: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe dziwò la, ŋu makpee akpɔ gbeɖe o; gake ŋu akpe ame siwo nye vivimenuwɔlawo.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, fia wò mɔwo kple wò toƒewom,

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: kplɔm le wò nyateƒe la me, eye nàfia num, elabena wòe nye nye Mawu kple nye Ɖela, eye nye mɔkpɔkpɔ le mewò ŋkeke blibo la katã.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖo ŋku wò lɔlɔ̃ kple wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔgbɔ la dzi, elabena woli tso blema ke.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mègaɖo ŋku nye ɖekakpuimenu vɔ̃wo kple nye aglãdzemɔwo dzi o; ke boŋ ɖo ŋku dzinye le wò lɔlɔ̃ la ta, elabena nyuiwɔwɔ le mewò.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Yehowa nyo, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe, eya ta efiaa eƒe mɔ nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Ekplɔa ɖokuibɔbɔlawo to nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ me, eye wòfiaa eƒe mɔ wo.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe mɔwo katã nye lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ na ame siwo léa eƒe nubablamenyawo ɖe asi.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, togbɔ be nye dzidada sɔ gbɔ ale gbegbe hã la, tsɔ wo kem le wò ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Ekema ame kawoe nye ŋutsu ma siwo vɔ̃a Yehowa? Afia nu wo le mɔ si woato la dzi.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Woakpɔ dzidzedze le woƒe agbemeŋkekewo me, eye woƒe dzidzimeviwo anyi anyigba la ƒe dome.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔa nya ɣaɣlawo na ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ, eye wòɖea eƒe nubabla fiaa wo.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo le Yehowa ŋu ɖaa, elabena eya koe aɖe nye afɔ le mɔ me.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋunye ne nàve nunye, elabena metsi akogo, eye hiã tum.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Nye dzi ƒe nuxaxawo do gã ɖe edzi, na vovom tso nye vevesesewo me.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Nye kɔ nàkpɔ nye nuxaxa kple nye vevesese ɖa, eye nàɖe nye nu vɔ̃wo katã ɖa.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ale si nye futɔwo dzi ɖe edzii ɖa, eye nàkpɔ ale si wolé fum ɖikaɖikae ɖa!

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye agbe ta, eye nàɖem; megana ŋu nakpem o, elabena mewòe mebe ɖo.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔwɔ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye nedzɔ ŋunye, elabena nye mɔkpɔkpɔ le mewò.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, ɖe Israel tso woƒe xaxawo katã me.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, tso afia nam, elabena menɔ agbe si ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o. Meɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu, nyemeʋã kpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, lolom, dom kpɔ; eye nàdzro nye dzi kple tamesusu hã me,

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: elabena wò lɔlɔ̃ le ŋkunye me ɖaa, eye mezɔna le wò nyateƒe la me ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Nyemanɔ anyi ɖe ameblelawo dome, alo ade ha kple alakpanuwɔlawo o.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Meklɔ nye asiwo le fɔmaɖimaɖi me, eye meƒo xlã wò vɔsamlekpui, O! Yehowa,

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, melɔ̃ aƒe si me nèle, afi si wò ŋutikɔkɔe le.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ nye luʋɔ kpe ɖe nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo ŋuti kple nye agbe kpe ɖe hlɔ̃dolawo ŋuti,

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: ame siwo ƒe asi me ɖoɖo vɔ̃ɖiwo le, eye woƒe nuɖusime yɔ fũu kple zãnuxɔxɔ o.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, menɔ agbe si ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o, eya ta ɖem, eye nàkpɔ nublanui nam.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Nye afɔ le sɔsɔeƒe. Makafu Yehowa le takpekpe gã la me.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye nye kekeli kple nye ɖeɖe. Ame ka mavɔ̃? Yehowae nye mɔ sesẽ na nye agbe, ame ka adzi ŋɔ nam?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Ne ame vɔ̃ɖiwo lũ ɖe dzinye be woavuvum, ne nye futɔwo kple nye ketɔwo lũ ɖe dzinye la, woakli nu adze anyi.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be aʋakɔ gã aɖe ɖe to ɖem hã la, nye dzi mavɔ̃ o, togbɔ be wodze aʋa ɖe ŋunye hã la, azɔ koŋ dzi aɖo ƒonye.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Nu ɖeka mebia Yehowa, esiae nye be manɔ Yehowa ƒe aƒe me le nye agbemeŋkekewo katã me, ne malé ŋku ɖe Yehowa ƒe nyonyo ŋu, eye madii le eƒe gbedoxɔ me.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Elabena le xaxaɣiwo la, atsyɔ nu dzinye le eƒe nɔƒe la me; aɣlam ɖe eƒe agbadɔ ƒe bebeƒe, eye wòakɔm aɖo agakpe kɔkɔ aɖe dzi.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Ekema nye ta akɔ dzi agbɔ nye futɔ siwo ƒo xlãm godoo la ta; matsɔ dzidzɔɣli asa vɔ nɛ le eƒe agbadɔ kɔkɔe la me. Madzi ha, eye maƒo saŋku na Yehowa.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, se nye gbe, ne meyɔ wò; kpɔ nublanui nam, eye nàtɔ nam.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Nye dzi le gbɔgblɔm le ŋuwò be, “Di eƒe ŋkume!” Yehowa, wò ŋkumee madi.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Mègaɣla wò ŋkume ɖem o, mègatrɔ wò dɔla ɖo ɖa le dɔmedzoe me o, elabena wòe nye nye xɔnametɔ. O! Mawu, nye Ɖela, mègagbe nu le gbɔnye alo agblem ɖi o.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be tɔnye kple nɔnye gblem ɖi hã la, Yehowa axɔm.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, fia wò mɔwom; kplɔm to mɔ dzɔdzɔe dzi, le ame siwo tem ɖe to la ta.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Mègatsɔm de asi na nye futɔwo ƒe didi o, elabena alakpaɖasefowo tso ɖe ŋutinye kpe ɖe ame siwo lɔ ŋutasesẽ ƒe gbɔgbɔtsixɛ ɖe ƒo la ŋuti.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Esia nye nu si dzi meka ɖo la be: Makpɔ Yehowa ƒe nu nyuiwo le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Kpɔ mɔ na Yehowa; sẽ ŋu, eye nàlé dzi ɖe ƒo. Kpɔ mɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nye Agakpe, wò yɔm mele, mègado tokum o. Elabena ne èzi ɖoɖoe la, manɔ abe ame siwo yi aʋlime la ene.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Esi mekɔ nye asiwo dzi ɖo ɖe wò Kɔkɔeƒewo ƒe Kɔkɔƒe la gbɔ la, se nye ɣlidodo na nublanuikpɔkpɔ, ne meyɔ wò be nàxɔ nam.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Mègakplɔm kpe ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu o, ame siwo ƒoa nu kple aƒelikawo fafɛ, gake vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi le woƒe dzi me.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Esi womede bubu Yehowa ƒe nuwɔnawo kple eƒe asinudɔwo ŋuti o ta la, àgbã wo aƒu anyi, eye màgbugbɔ wo atu akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, elabena ese ɣli si dom mele le nublanuikpɔkpɔ biam.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye nye ŋusẽ kple akpoxɔnu; nye dzi ka ɖe eya amea dzi, eye wòɖem. Nye dzi ti kpo le dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ta, eye mada akpe nɛ to hadzidzi me.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye eƒe dukɔ ƒe ŋusẽ; ɖeɖe ƒe mɔ sesẽ wònye na eƒe amesiamina.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò dukɔ, eye nàyra wò domenyinu; nànye woƒe kplɔla, eye nàkɔ wo ɖe akɔnu tegbetegbe.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Mitsɔ bubu na Yehowa, O! Mi ŋusẽtɔwo, mitsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ na Yehowa.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si dze Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ nɛ; misubɔ Yehowa le eƒe kɔkɔenyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ me.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe ɖi le tsiwo dzi; Ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe Mawu la ɖe gbe, eye Yehowa ɖe gbe le tsi gãwo dzi.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Ŋusẽ le Yehowa ƒe gbe ŋu, eye ŋutikɔkɔe nye Yehowa ƒe gbe.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ena Lebanon ti kpo abe nyivi ene, eye Sirion hã abe tovi ene.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe ke dzo mia abe dzikedzo ene.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe gbe ʋuʋu dzogbenyigba, eye Yehowa ʋuʋu Kades Dzogbenyigba.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Yehowa na gboti sesẽwo ʋuʋu heyeheye, eye wòna avewo lũ xɛ. Le eƒe gbedoxɔ me la, ame sia ame do ɣli be, “Ŋutikɔkɔe!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Yehowa nɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi gli le tsiɖɔɖɔ dzi. Woɖo Yehowa fia tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Yehowa naa ŋusẽ eƒe dukɔ; eye wòyraa eƒe amewo kple ŋutifafa.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mado wò ɖe dzi, elabena wòe hem do goe tso ʋe globo me, eye mèna mezu nu ɖikokoe na nye futɔwo o.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nye Mawu, mebia kpekpeɖeŋu tso gbɔwò, eye nèyɔ dɔm.

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wòe ɖem tso tsiẽƒe, eye mèna meyi aʋlime o.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Yehowa, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, eye mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Elabena medoa dɔmedzoe eteƒe didina o, ke eƒe amenuveve ya nɔa anyi agbenɔɣi katã. Avifafa anɔ anyi le zã me, gake aseyetsotso ava le ŋdi me.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Esi mekpɔ be meli ke la, megblɔ be, “Nye la, nyemaʋuʋu kpɔ gbeɖe o.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, esi nève nunye la, èna nye to li ke zã, gake esi nèɣla wò ŋkume ɖem la, nye mo tsi dãa.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Yehowa, wòe meyɔ, Yehowae medo ɣli na be wòakpɔ nublanui nam.

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Viɖe kae le eme ne donyeme gblẽ alo ne meyi ɖe aʋlime? Ɖe ʋuʋudedi akafu wòa? Ɖe wòaɖe gbeƒã wò nuteƒewɔwɔa?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Èna nye avifafa zu ɣeɖuɖu; èɖe akpanya le ŋutinye hetsɔ dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ do nam,

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: ale be nye dzi nadzi ha na wò, eye mazi ɖoɖoe o. O! Yehowa, nye Mawu, mada akpe na wò tegbetegbe.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mewòe mebe ɖo; mègana ŋu nakpem akpɔ gbeɖe o; ɖem le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la ta.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ƒu to anyi ɖe ŋunye, va kaba nàɖem, nànye nye xɔxɔ ƒe agakpe kple mɔ sesẽ ne nàɖem.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Le wò ŋkɔ la ta, kplɔm, eye nàfia mɔm, elabena wòe nye nye agakpe kple mɔ sesẽ.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɖem le mɔ si woɖo ɖi nam la me, elabena wòe nye nye mɔ sesẽ.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Asiwò me metsɔ nye gbɔgbɔ de, eya ta Yehowa, nyateƒe ƒe Mawu, va nàɖem.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Metsri ame siwo ku ɖe legba maɖinuwo ŋu; ke nye la meku ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Makpɔ dzidzɔ, eye matso aseye le wò lɔlɔ̃ la me, elabena èkpɔ nye hiã henya nye luʋɔ ƒe nuxaxa.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Mètsɔm de asi na nye futɔ o, ke boŋ èɖo nye afɔ gbadzaƒe.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, kpɔ nublanui nam, elabena nye dzi ʋu dzo, nuxaxa na nye ŋkuwo dzi wɔ dɔ̃ɔ, eye konyifafa na nye luʋɔ kple ŋutilã gbɔdzɔ.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Vevesese sɔŋ yɔ nye agbe me, eye ŋeŋe xɔ nye agbenɔƒewo me. Ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye le nye fukpekpewo ta, eye nye ƒuwo hã nyunyɔ ɖe lãme nam.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Le nye futɔwo ƒe nuwɔnawo ta mezu alɔmeɖenu na nye aƒelikawo vevie ŋutɔ. Mezu ŋɔdzinu na xɔ̃nyewo, eye ame siwo do gom le mɔtata dzi la sina le nunye.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Woŋlɔm be abe ɖe meku xoxo ene, ale mezu ze gbagbã.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Mese ame geɖewo ƒe ameŋugblẽnyawo; ŋɔdzi ɖe to ɖem, wode adaŋu tso ŋunye, eye woɖo nugbe be yewoaɖe nye agbe ɖa.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Ke wò, Yehowa, dzie meka ɖo; megblɔ be, “Wòe nye nye Mawu.”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Nye ɣeyiɣiwo le asiwò me; ɖem tso nye futɔwo kple ame siwo le yonyeme tim la ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Na wò mo naklẽ ɖe wò dɔla dzi, ɖem le wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ta.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mègana ŋu nakpem o, elabena wòe medo ɣli na; ke na ŋu nakpe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, eye ɖoɖoe nazi le wo nu le yɔme.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: De ga nu na woƒe alakpanuyiwo, elabena wotsɔa dada kple ɖekematsɔleme gblɔa nya vlo ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe ŋu.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Wò nu nyui siwo nèdzra ɖo ɖi na ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la lolo ŋutɔ. Nu nyui siwo nèkɔ ɖe ame siwo si wò tso dzi le amewo ƒe ŋkume la lolo.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Èɣla wo ɖe ɣaɣlaƒe si le gbɔwò, tso amewo ƒe ayemenuwo gbɔ. Èɣla wo ɖe nɔwòƒe be woanɔ dedie tso aɖeɖiƒoame gbɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, elabena eɖe eƒe nukulɔlɔ̃ la fiam le esime mele du si ŋu woƒu kpo ɖo la me.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Megblɔ le nye dzikatsoƒo me be: “Woɖem ɖa le wò ŋkume azɔ!” Ke hã la, èse nye nublanuiɣlidodo esi meyɔ wò be nàxɔ nam.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Milɔ̃ Yehowa, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo! Yehowa kpɔa nuteƒewɔlawo ta, ke eɖoa eteƒe na dadalawo wòsɔa gbɔ dea woƒe nuwɔnawo nu.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Misẽ ŋu, eye milé dzi ɖe ƒo, mi ame siwo katã tsɔ miaƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ de Yehowa me.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Woayra ame si wotsɔ eƒe dzidadawo kee, eye wotsyɔ nu eƒe nu vɔ̃wo dzi.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Woayra ŋutsu si Aƒetɔ la meɖe vodada na o, eye alakpa mele eƒe gbɔgbɔ me o.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Esi mezi ɖoɖoe la, nye ŋeŋe atraɖii ŋkeke blibo la katã na nye ƒuwo nyunyɔ.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Elabena wò asi sẽ ɖe dzinye zã kple keli katã, eye ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye abe dzomeŋɔli ƒe dzoxɔxɔ mee mele ene. Sela

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Tete meɖe nye nu vɔ̃wo fia wò, eye nyemetsyɔ nu nye dzidadawo dzi o. Megblɔ be, “Maʋu nye dzidadawo me na Yehowa”, eye nètsɔ nye nu vɔ̃wo ƒe yomedzenuwo kem. Sela

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Mawumemewo katã nedo gbe ɖa na wò zi ale si nèli kpli wo, elabena enye nyateƒe be ne tɔsisi gãwo ɖɔ la, womade wo gbɔ o.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Wòe nye nye bebeƒe, àɖem tso xaxa me, eye àtsɔ ɖeɖe ƒe aseyetsohawo aƒo xlãm. Sela

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Mafia nu wò, eye mafia mɔ si nàto la wò. Maxlɔ̃ nu wò, eye makpɔ tawò.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kpea fu geɖe, ke Yehowa ƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ƒoa xlã ame siwo ɖoa dzi ɖe eŋu la.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Midzi ha kple dzidzɔ na Yehowa, mi ame dzɔdzɔewo; edze mi ame siwo ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka la be woakafui.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa kple kasaŋkuwo, eye miƒo ha nɛ le ka ewo ƒe kasaŋku dzi.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye nɛ; miƒo ha nɛ kple ŋusẽ, eye míado dzidzɔɣli.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɔ̃a dzɔdzɔenyenye kple nuteƒewɔwɔ; anyigba yɔ fũu kple eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nya wotsɔ wɔ dziƒowoe, eye eƒe numegbɔgbɔ wotsɔ wɔ wo ŋuti nuwoe.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: Eƒo atsiaƒumetsiwo nu ƒu ɖe kpluwo me, eye wòdzra tɔ goglowo ɖo ɖe nudzraɖoƒewo.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Anyigba katã nevɔ̃ Yehowa, eye xexemetɔwo katã nede bubu eŋu.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Elabena eƒo nu, eye wòva dzɔ; eɖe gbe, eye wòli ke goŋgoŋgoŋ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa gblẽ dukɔwo ƒe adaŋudedewo me, eye wòtɔtɔ anyigbadzitɔwo ƒe ɖoɖowo.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa ya ƒe ɖoɖowo nɔa anyi maʋamaʋãe ɖikaa, eye eƒe dzimesusuwo li tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Woayra dukɔ si ƒe Mawue nye Yehowa, ame siwo wòtia be woanyi yeƒe dome.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Yehowa bi kɔ tso dziƒo ke, eye wòkpɔ amegbetɔviwo katã.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ele eƒe nɔƒe ke hekpɔ ame siwo katã le anyigba dzi,

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: eya ame si wɔ ame sia ame ƒe dzi, eye wòléa ŋku ɖe nu sia nu si wowɔna la ŋu.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Aʋakɔ gbogbo si le fia aɖe si la mate ŋu aɖee o, eye ŋusẽ triakɔ hã meɖea kalẽtɔ o.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Ne eɖo ɖeɖe dzi la, sɔ maɖe ame si tsɔ eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe edzi o, togbɔ be ŋusẽ triakɔ le esi hã la, mate ŋu aɖee o.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Ke Yehowa ƒe ŋku le ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la ŋu, ame siwo tsɔa woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ dana ɖe eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la dzi,

english_verse: He protects them from death and starvation.
translation_verse: be wòaɖe wo tso ku ƒe asi me, eye wòana woatsi agbe le dɔŋɔli.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Míele lalam le mɔ kpɔm na Yehowa, eyae nye míaƒe xɔname kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Míaƒe dziwo le dzidzɔ kpɔm le eya amea me, elabena mieka ɖe eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ aƒo adegbe le Yehowa me, ame siwo le veve sem la nesee ne woakpɔ dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Mido kɔkɔ Yehowa kplim; mina míawɔ ɖeka ado eƒe ŋkɔ ɖe dzi.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Meyɔ Yehowa, eye wòtɔ nam heɖem tso nye vɔvɔ̃wo katã me.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ame siwo tsɔ woƒe ŋku da ɖe edzi la aklẽ, ŋukpe matsyɔ mo na wo o.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Hiãtɔ sia yɔe, eye Yehowa ɖo toe, heɖee le eƒe xaxawo katã me.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔlawo ƒua asaɖa anyi ƒoa xlã ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ, eye wòɖea wo.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Miɖɔe kpɔ, ne miakpɔe be Yehowa ƒe dɔ me nyo; woayra ŋutsu si be ɖe eya amea me.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Mivɔ̃ Yehowa, mi eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, elabena naneke mehiãa ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la o.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Dɔ awu dzatawo, eye woagbɔdzɔ, gake ame siwo dia Yehowa ya la, kesinɔnu aɖeke mahiã wo o.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Miva, vinyewo, miɖo tom, ne mafia Yehowavɔvɔ̃ mi.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Mia dometɔ siwo lɔ̃ agbe, eye miedi be miakpɔ ŋkekenyui geɖewo la,

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: mikpɔ miaƒe aɖewo dzi nyuie tso vɔ̃ ŋuti, eye miaƒe nuyiwo tso aʋatsokaka ŋuti.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Mite ɖa le vɔ̃ gbɔ, eye miawɔ nu nyui, midi ŋutifafa, eye miati eyome.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋku le ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu, eye eƒe towo le woƒe ɣlidodo ŋu;

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: ke Yehowa klẽa ŋku ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo be wòaɖe wo ɖa le anyigba dzi, eye womagaɖo ŋku wo dzi akpɔ o.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo do ɣli, Yehowa see, eye wòɖe wo le woƒe xaxawo katã me.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
