translation_verse: Xɔ na mí, eye nàɖe mí kple wò nuɖusi, be ame siwo nèlɔ̃ la nakpɔ xɔxɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒo nu tso eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la be; “Le dziɖuɖu me, mama Sekem, eye madzidze Sukɔt Balime hã.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead nye tɔnye, Manase hã tɔnyee. Nye gakukue nye Efraim, eye Yuda nye nye fiatikplɔ.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab nye nye asiklɔgba, meɖe nye tokota ƒu gbe ɖe Edom dzi, eye medo dziɖuɖuɣli ɖe Filistia ta.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Ame ka akplɔm ayi du si ŋu woɖo gli sesẽ ƒo xlãe la me? Ame ka akplɔm ayi Edom?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Kpe ɖe mía ŋu, ɖe míaƒe futɔwo ŋuti, elabena amegbetɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu mele ɖeke me o.

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: To Mawu dzi, míaɖu dzi, eye míafanya míaƒe futɔwo ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Se nye ɣlidodo, O Mawu, eye nàlé to ɖe nye gbedodoɖa ŋu.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Meyɔ wò tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu, meyɔ wò, esi nu te nye dzi ŋu belibelibeli; azɔ kplɔm yi ɖe agakpe si kɔ wum la dzi,

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: elabena wòe nye nye sitsoƒe kple mɔ sesẽ, le futɔ la ta.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Medi vevie be manɔ wò agbadɔ me tegbee, eye mabe ɖe wò aʋala ƒe fafaƒe. Sela

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, èse nye adzɔgbeɖeɖewo, eye nètsɔ ame siwo vɔ̃a wò ŋkɔ la ƒe domenyinu nam.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Dzi fia la ƒe agbemeŋkekewo ɖe edzi nɛ, eƒe ƒewo nasɔ gbɔ be wòakpɔ dzidzime geɖewo.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Neɖu fia le Mawu ŋkume tegbee, eye na wò lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ nakpɔ eta.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Ekema madzi kafukafuha na wò ŋkɔ tegbee, eye maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefewo gbe sia gbe.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Mawu me ko nye luʋɔ kpɔ gbɔɖeme le, eye eya ko gbɔ nye xɔxɔ tsona.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Eya koe nye nye agakpe, nye xɔxɔ kple nye mɔ sesẽ, eya ta nyemaʋã akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi nànɔ ame ɖeka ƒoƒo dzi? Ɖe mi katã mialé ame si le abe gli gbagbã kple kpɔ si le mumum ene la aƒu anyia?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Woɖoe vavã be yewoatutui tso eƒe nɔƒe kɔkɔ la, elabena wolɔ̃a alakpadada. Wotsɔa woƒe nuwo gblɔa yayranyawoe, ke fiƒode le woƒe dzi me. Sela

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: O! Nye luʋɔ, gbɔ ɖe eme le Mawu ɖeka ko me, elabena eya gbɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ tso.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Eya hɔ̃ɔ koe nye nye agakpe, nye xɔxɔ kple nye mɔ sesẽ, eya ta nyemaʋuʋu o.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Nye xɔxɔ kple bubu ku ɖe Mawu ŋu, eyae nye nye agakpe sesẽ kple nye sitsoƒe.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: O! Mi dukɔwo, miɖo dzi ɖe eŋu ɣe sia ɣi; mitsɔ miaƒe hiahiãwo kɔ ɖe edzi, elabena Mawue nye míaƒe sitsoƒe. Sela

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Vavã, ƒuƒu ko ame gbɔlowo nye, eye alakpa nye ame siwo nye ame ŋkutawo, elabena ne woda wo le nudanu dzi la, tofloko ko wonye, eye wo katã ƒuƒu ko wonye.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Mawu gblɔ nya ɖeka, eye mese nu eve le eme be, “Wò, O Mawu, ɖeka koe sesẽ,

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: eye O Aƒetɔ, wò la lɔlɔ̃ bɔ ɖe asiwò. Vavã, àɖo eteƒe na ame sia ame ɖe nu si wòwɔ la nu.”

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, wòe nye nye Mawu, mele diwòm vevie; tsikɔ le nye luʋɔ wum ɖe ŋuwò, nye ameti blibo la mele diwòm, le kuɖiɖinyigba si ƒu kplakplakpla, eye tsi aɖeke meli o la dzi.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ wò le kɔkɔeƒe la, eye mekpɔ wò ŋusẽ kple wò ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Esi wò lɔlɔ̃ nyo wu agbe ta la, nye nuyiwo ado wò ɖe dzi.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Makafu wò, zi ale si mele agbe, eye mado nye asiwo ɖe dzi le wò ŋkɔ me.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ aɖi ƒo abe nuɖuɖu nyuitɔ kekeakee wòɖu ene; hadzidzi anɔ nu nam, eye nye nu adzi kafukafuhawo na wò.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Le nye aba dzi, meɖoa ŋku dziwò, mebua ŋutiwò le nye ŋunɔɣi le zã me.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Esi nènye nye xɔnametɔ ta la, madzi ha le wò aʋala ƒe vɔvɔli te.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ ku ɖe ŋuwò goŋgoŋgoŋ, eye wò ɖusibɔ lém ɖe te.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Woatsrɔ̃ ame siwo le nye agbe yome tim, woayi ɖe keke anyigba la ƒe tume ke.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Woatsɔ wo ade asi na yi, eye woazu nuɖuɖu na amegaxiwo.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Ke fia la akpɔ dzidzɔ le Mawu me; ame siwo katã kaa atam le Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ me la akafui, ke woamia nu na alakpatɔwo.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Ɣlam tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nugbeɖoɖo kple ame vlo mawo ƒe howɔwɔ me.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Wonyrea woƒe aɖewo abe yi ene, eye wodzidzea woƒe nyawo ɖe ame dzi abe aŋutrɔ siwo nu aɖi le la ene.

english_verse: They fearlessly ambush and shoot innocent people.
translation_verse: Wodea xa hedaa aŋutrɔ ame maɖifɔ la, eye wodanɛ zi ɖeka vɔvɔ̃manɔŋutɔe.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Wodea dzi ƒo na wo nɔewo le woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi ɖoɖowo me, woƒoa nu tso ale si woatre mɔ ɖe vivime la ŋuti gblɔna be, “Ame kae le ekpɔ ge?”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Woɖoa nu vɔ̃ɖi hegblɔna le eŋuti be, “Míewɔ ɖoɖo deŋgɔ la vɔ!” Vavãe, ame ƒe susu kple dzi me nye ayenuwɔƒe,

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: gake Mawu ada aŋutrɔ wo eye wòalɔ wo zi ɖeka kpoyi woamu adze anyi.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Ana woawo ŋutɔ ƒe aɖe nade wo nya me eye wòahe wo ade tsɔtsrɔ̃ me. Ame siwo katã akpɔ wo la aʋuʋu ta ɖe wo ŋu fewuɖutɔe.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Tete vɔvɔ̃ aɖo amegbetɔƒomea katã; woado Mawu ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ɖe dzi, eye woade ŋugble le nu si wòwɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe akpɔ dzidzɔ le Yehowa me, eye wòasii atso. Ame siwo katã dza le woƒe dzi me la akafui!

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, kafukafu le lalawòm le Zion; wòe míaxe míaƒe adzɔgbeɖefewo na.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: O! Wò ame si sea gbedodoɖa, gbɔwòe amewo katã ava.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Esi nu vɔ̃ do agba ɖe mía dzi la, ètsɔ míaƒe dzidadawo ke mí.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo nètia, eye nèkplɔ wo vɛ be woanɔ wò xɔxɔnuwo! Ètsɔ wò aƒe me, wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la me nu nyuiwo ɖi ƒoe na mí.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Èna ŋuɖoɖo mí to dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe ŋɔdzidɔwo me, O, Mawu míaƒe xɔnametɔ, anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke, kple atsiaƒu siwo le didiƒe ke la katã ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Wò ame si na towo va dzɔ to wò ŋusẽ me, eye nètsɔ ŋusẽ bla ali dzii,

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: wò ame si tsi atsiaƒu ƒe hoowɔwɔ kple ƒutsotsoe dzeagbowo kpakple dukɔwo ƒe ʋunyaʋunyawo nu.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Ame siwo le didiƒe la vɔ̃ wò nukunuwo; èna dzidzɔhawo ɖi tso afi si ɣe dzena tsona kple afi si wòɖoa to ɖo.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Èlé be na anyigba, de aɖui wòsui nyuie, eye nède tsii fũu. Tsi yɔ Mawu ƒe tɔʋuwo banaa, ne wòana bli eƒe dukɔ, elabena nenema nèɖoe.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Ède tsi eƒe boliƒowo, eye nègbã kpoteƒewo wozu sɔsɔe. Ètsɔ agbafie bɔbɔ anyigba lae, eye nèyra eƒe nukuwo.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ wò kesinɔnu gbogboawo ɖo atsyɔ̃e na ƒe la, eye wò agblekekewo yɔ gbagba.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Gbe damawo dzi yɔ fũu kple lãhawo, eye balimewo ƒe afi sia afi yɔ kple bli; wo katã do dzidzɔɣli, eye wodzi ha.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Mi anyigbawo katã mido ɣli, mitso aseye ɖe Mawu ŋu!

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Midzi eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe ha; mikafu Mawu ƒe gãnyenye!

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Migblɔ na Mawu be, “Wò dɔwɔwɔwo dziŋɔ loo! Wò ŋusẽ tri akɔ ale gbegbe be, wò futɔwo de ta agu na wò.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Anyigba la katã de ta agu na wò, wole kafukafuha dzim na wò, wole kafukafuha dzim na wò ŋkɔ.” Sela

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Va, nàkpɔ nu si Mawu wɔ, ale si le amegbetɔwo ta wòwɔ ŋɔdzidɔ geɖewo!

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Etrɔ atsiaƒu wòzu anyigba ƒuƒui, wozɔ afɔ to tsi la titina; miva míatso aseye le eya amea me.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Ele fia ɖum kple eƒe ŋusẽ tegbee, eƒe ŋku le dukɔwo ta kpɔm, aglãdzela aɖeke megatso ɖe eŋuti o. Sela

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: O! Mi dukɔwo, mikafu míaƒe Mawu la; mina eƒe kafukafu nade dzi woase.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Eyae kpɔ míaƒe agbe ta, eye mena míaƒe afɔ ɖiɖi o.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Elabena O Mawu, wòe do mí kpɔ, wòe lolõ mí abe klosalo ene.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Wòe de mí gaxɔ me, eye nèdo agba ɖe megbe na mí.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Èna amewo zɔ míaƒe ta dzi, eye míeto dzo me kple tɔ me, gake èkplɔ mí va anyigba si dzi nuwo do agbogbo ɖo fũu.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Mava wò gbedoxɔ me kple numevɔsa, eye maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefewo na wò,

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Matsɔ lã damiwo kple agbowo asa numevɔe na wò, hekpe ɖe nyitsuwo kple gbɔ̃wo ŋuti. Sela

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Miva se, mí ame siwo katã vɔ̃a Mawu; mina magblɔ nu siwo wòwɔ nam la na mi.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Metsɔ nye nu do ɣli nɛ, eƒe kafukafu le nye aɖe dzi.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Ɖe mena nɔƒe nu vɔ̃ le nye dzi me la, ne Aƒetɔ la meɖo tom o,

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: gake Mawu ɖo tom vavã, eye wòse nye gbe le gbedodoɖa me.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Woakafu Mawu, ame si medo toku nye gbedodoɖa, alo te eƒe lɔlɔ̃ ɖa le gbɔnye o!

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Mawu, ve mía nu, eye nàyra mí, na wò mo naklẽ ɖe mía dzi, Sela

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: Ale be woanya wò mɔwo le anyigba dzi kple wò xɔxɔ le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, dukɔwo akafu wò, anyigbadzidukɔwo katã akafu wò.

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo akpɔ dzidzɔ, adzi ha, atso aseye, elabena èɖu dukɔwo dzi le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye nèkplɔ anyigbadzidukɔwo. Sela

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Mawu, dukɔwo katã akafu wò; wòe dukɔwo katã akafu.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Ekema anyigba ana woaxa eƒe nukuwo fũu, eye Mawu, míaƒe Mawu la ayra mí.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Mawu ayra mí, eye anyigba ƒe mlɔenutɔwo katã avɔ̃e.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Mawu tso, na wò futɔwo naka hlẽ, na wò ketɔwo nasi le nuwò.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Gbɔ wo ɖa abe ale si ya gbɔa dzudzɔ dzonae ene. Abe ale si yɔkumi lolõna le dzo nu ene la, nenema ame vɔ̃ɖiwo atsrɔ̃e le Mawu ŋkume.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ya akpɔ dzidzɔ, atso aseye le Mawu ŋkume; na woakpɔ dzidzɔ, eye woatu aglo.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Mawu, midzi kafukafuha na eƒe ŋkɔ, mido ame si le lilikpowo dzi gbɔna la ɖe dzi, eŋkɔe nye Yehowa, eye mitso aseye le eŋgɔ;

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: eya ame si nye tɔ na tɔmanɔsitɔwo, ahosiwo ta ʋlila, eye wònye Mawu si le enɔƒe kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Mawu kplɔa ame siwo tsi akogo la dea ƒomewo me, enana ablɔɖe gamenɔlawo, eye wodzia dzidzɔhawo. Ke ame dzeaglãwo la, egblẽa wo ɖe kuɖiɖinyigba dzi.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, ne èdo dze wò dukɔ la ŋgɔ, hezɔ to gbegbe la, Sela

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: anyigba ʋuʋu, dziƒowo dza tsi bɔbɔbɔ le Mawu, si nɔ Sinai la ŋkume, le Mawu, Israel ƒe Mawu la ŋkume.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, èna tsi dza fũu, eye nèna wò domenyinu si nu ti kɔ na belibelibeli la gakpɔ ŋusẽ.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Mawu, wò amewo yi ɖanɔ edzi, eye tso wò nu gbogboawo me, èna nu ame dahewo.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ ɖe gbeƒã nya la, eye ameha gã aɖe do ɣli kplii be,

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Fiawo kple aʋakɔwo, misi kaba, elabena amewo le afunyinuwo ham le asaɖawo me.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Esi miele alɔ̃ dɔm le lãkpowo dome la, wotsɔ klosalo fa ɖe nye ahɔnɛ ƒe aʋala ŋu, eye wotsɔ sika si le keklẽm la fa ɖe eƒe fuwo ŋuti.”

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Esi Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la kaka anyigbadzifiawo hlẽ la, enɔ abe tsikpee dza ɖe Zalmɔn dzi ene.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Basan towo ƒe dzedzeme kple kɔkɔme nya kpɔ ŋutɔ; to tsaklitsakliwo Basan toawo nye.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe tasiaɖamwo nye akpe nanewo kple akpe teƒe akpewo; Aƒetɔ la tso Sinai va ɖo eƒe teƒe kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Esi nèlia yi dzi la, ètɔ ka aboyomewo hekplɔ dzoe, èxɔ nunana tso amewo gbɔ, tso aglãdzelawo gɔ̃ hã gbɔ, be wò, O! Yehowa Mawu, àte ŋu anɔ afi ma.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Kafukafu woana Aƒetɔ, Mawu míaƒe Ɖela, ame si tsɔa míaƒe agbawo gbe sia gbe. Sela

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Míaƒe Mawu nye Mawu si xɔna na ame; ɖeɖe tso ku me vana to Aƒetɔ Yehowa ko dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Vavã, Mawu agbã ta na eƒe futɔwo kple dzodome na ame siwo gale woƒe nu vɔ̃wo dzi yim.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la gblɔ be, “Makplɔ wo vɛ tso Basan; makplɔ wo ado goe tso atsiaƒu ƒe gogloƒe ke,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: be nàklɔ afɔ ɖe wò futɔwo ƒe ʋu me, eye wò avuwo ƒe aɖewo hã nakpɔ wo tɔ gome.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, wole míaƒe azɔlime kpɔm, wole ale si nye Mawu kple fianye zɔ ge ɖe kɔkɔeƒe lae la kpɔm.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Woɖo ɖe fli me, hadzilawo le ŋgɔgbe, hafialawo ɖo, eye ɖetugbi siwo le axatsɛ ƒom la tsɔ wo ɖe dome.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Mikafu Mawu le ameha gã la dome. Mikafu Yehowa le Israelviwo ƒe takpekpe me.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, Benyamin ƒe to si nye suetɔ lae le ŋgɔ na wo, Yuda ƒe dumegã gbogboawo le afi ma, eye Zebulon kple Naftali ƒe amegãwo hã le afi ma.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, yɔ wò ŋusẽ vɛ; O! Mawu, ɖe wò ŋusẽ fia mí abe tsã ene.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Le wò Yerusalem gbedoxɔ ta la, fiawo atsɔ nunanawo vɛ na wò.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Blu ɖe lã wɔadã siwo le aƒlawo me kple nyitsuwo ƒe ha siwo le dukɔwo ƒe nyiviwo dome la ta. Netsɔ klosalokɔ gãwo vɛ le ɖokuibɔbɔ me. Kaka dukɔ siwo aʋawɔwɔ doa dzidzɔ na.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Ame dɔdɔwo atso Egipte ava, eye Kus abɔbɔ eɖokui ɖe Mawu te.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: O! Mi anyigbadzifiaɖuƒewo, midzi ha na Mawu, midzi kafukafuha na Aƒetɔ la, Sela

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Eya ame si nɔ blemalilikpowo dzi, eye wòɖe gbe kple gbe sesẽ aɖe.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Miɖe gbeƒã Mawu ƒe ŋusẽ, ame si ƒe atsyɔ̃ le Israel dzi, eye eƒe ŋusẽ le dziŋgɔli ŋu.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: O! Mawu, ŋɔdzi le ŋuwò le wò kɔkɔeƒe la; Israel ƒe Mawu la na ŋusẽ kple ŋutete eƒe dukɔ la. Woakafu Mawu!

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Mawu, ɖem, elabena tsi ɖɔ ɖe ŋunye va se ɖe nye kɔgbɔ ke.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Meɖo ba yi ɖe tome ke, afi si afɔɖoƒe mele o. Meɖo tɔ goglowo me; tsi ɖɔ to tanye.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli be woaxɔ nam, ale nu ti kɔ nam, eye nye ve me hã ƒu kplakplakpla. Mekpɔ mɔ na Mawu ʋuu, eye ɖeɖi te nye ŋkuwo ŋu.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Ame siwo lé fum ɖe nanekemawɔmawɔ ta la sɔ gbɔ wu nye taɖa. Amewo lé fum yakatsyɔ, eye woti yonyeme be woatsrɔ̃m. Ale meɖo nu si nyemefi o la eteƒe dzizizitɔe.

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, ènya nye bometsitsi, eye nye fɔɖiɖi mele ɣaɣla ɖe wò o.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Tawòe wodo vlom ɖo, eye ŋukpe tsyɔ mo nam.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Menye amedzro na nye ŋutɔ nɔvinye ŋutsuwo kple ame manyamanya na danyevi ŋutsuwo.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Elabena lɔlɔ̃ na wò aƒe zu dzo ge ɖe menye, eye ame siwo dzu wò la ƒe dzudzu va dzinye.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Esi mefa avi, tsi nu dɔ la, vlododo boŋ wozu nam;

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: esi meta akpanya la, mezu nu ɖikokoe na amewo.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Ame siwo nɔ anyi ɖe agbo nu la ɖe alɔme le ŋunye, eye ahamulawo kekeake hã kpa ha dem.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, medo gbe ɖa na wò le wò amenuveɣi; O! Mawu, le wò lɔlɔ̃ gã la ta, tɔ nam kple wò xɔname si medana le edzi o.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso agbi me, mègana mayi to o, ɖem le ame siwo lé fum la ƒe asi me, tso tɔ goglowo me.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Mègana tsi naɖɔ to tanye, alo gogloƒe namim, eye ʋe globo natu eƒe nu ɖe dzinye o.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, tɔ nam, le wò lɔlɔ̃ deto la ta, eye trɔ ɖe ŋutinye le wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ gã la ta.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mègaɣla wò mo ɖe wò dɔla o; ke boŋ tɔ nam kaba, elabena meɖo xaxa me.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Te ɖe ŋunye, eye nàxɔ nam, ɖem le nye ketɔwo ta.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ènya ale si wodo vlom, ɖi gbɔ̃m, eye wodo ŋu kpem; nye futɔwo katã le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Vlododo na nye dzi gbã, eye mezu xɔnamemanɔsitɔ; mekpɔ mɔ na babadoname, gake ɖeke meli o. Mekpɔ mɔ na akɔfalawo, gake nyemekpɔ ɖeke o.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ veve de nye nuɖuɖu me, eye esi tsikɔ wum la, wotsɔ aha tsitsi nam be mano.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Woƒe kplɔ̃ si woɖo na wo la nezu mɔ na wo; nezu teƒeɖoɖo kple mɔ na wo.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dziku kɔ ɖe wo dzi, eye nàna wò dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ nalé wo.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Woƒe nɔƒe neɖi gbɔlo; mègana be ame aɖeke neganɔ woƒe agbadɔwo me o.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Elabena woti ame siwo ŋu nède abii la yome, eye wole nu ƒom le ame siwo nèwɔ nuvevii la ƒe vevesese ŋu.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Bu fɔ wo, eye nàgabu fɔ wo ɖe edzi; mègana woakpɔ gome le wò xɔname me o.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Tutu woƒe ŋkɔwo ɖa le agbegbalẽ la me, eye mègana woaŋlɔ woƒe ŋkɔ ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo dome o.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Mele vevesese kple nuxaxa me; O! Mawu, na wò xɔname natɔ kpɔ ƒo xlãm.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Matsɔ hadzidzi akafu Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ, eye madoe ɖe dzi kple akpedada.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Esia adze Yehowa ŋu wu nyi, eye wòado dzidzɔ nɛ wu nyitsu kple eƒe dzowo kpakple eƒe afɔkliwo.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Hiãtɔwo akpɔe ahatso aseye, eye mi ame siwo dia Mawu la, míaƒe dziwo nenɔ agbe ɖaa!

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖoa to hiãtɔwo, eye medoa vlo eƒe ame siwo le aboyome o.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Dziƒo kple anyigba nekafui, atsiaƒuwo kple nu siwo katã ʋãna le wo me,

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: elabena Mawu aɖe Zion, eye wòagbugbɔ Yuda ƒe duwo atso. Ekema amewo aɖanɔ afi ma, axɔe wòazu wo tɔ;

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: eƒe dɔlawo ƒe viwo atsɔe anyi domee, eye ame siwo lɔ̃ eƒe ŋkɔ la anɔ afi ma.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, netsɔ nàɖem; O! Yehowa, va kaba nàxɔ nam.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe kple tɔtɔ neva ame siwo le nye agbe yome tim la dzi. Ame siwo le nye gbegblẽ dim la negbugbɔ ɖe megbe kple ŋukpe.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Na be ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm be, “Ɛhɛ̃! Ɛhɛ̃!” la natrɔ megbe adzo kple ŋukpe.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo dia wò la netso aseye; woakpɔ dzidzɔ le mewò, eye ame siwo lɔ̃a wò xɔname la negblɔ ɖaa be, “Woado Mawu ɖe dzi ɖaa!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ke nye la, O Mawu, meda ahe, eye hiã tum, eya ta va gbɔnye kaba. O! Yehowa, mègahe ɖe megbe o, elabena wòe nye nye xɔnametɔ kple nye Ɖela.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, netsɔ nàɖem; O! Yehowa, va kaba nàxɔ nam.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe kple tɔtɔ neva ame siwo le nye agbe yome tim la dzi. Ame siwo le nye gbegblẽ dim la negbugbɔ ɖe megbe kple ŋukpe.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Na be ame siwo le gbɔgblɔm be, “Ɛhɛ̃! Ɛhɛ̃!” la natrɔ megbe adzo kple ŋukpe.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo dia wò la netso aseye; woakpɔ dzidzɔ le mewò, eye ame siwo lɔ̃a wò xɔname la negblɔ ɖaa be, “Woado Mawu ɖe dzi ɖaa!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Ke nye la, O Mawu, meda ahe, eye hiã tum, eya ta va gbɔnye kaba. O! Yehowa, mègahe ɖe megbe o, elabena wòe nye nye xɔnametɔ kple nye Ɖela.

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mewòe mebe ɖo, mègana ŋu nakpem akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Xɔ nam, eye nàɖem le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la ta; trɔ wò to ɖe gbɔnye, eye nàxɔ nam.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Nye sitsoƒe ƒe agakpe, afi si mate ŋu abe ɖo ɣe sia ɣi. Ɖe gbe be woaxɔ nam, elabena wòe nye nye agakpe kple mɔ sesẽ.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: O! Nye Mawu, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me, eye nàɖem tso nu tovo wɔlawo kple ŋutasẽlawo ƒe fego me.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Elabena tso ɣe aɖe ɣi ke, wòe nye nye mɔkpɔkpɔ kple nye dzideƒo tso nye ɖekakpuime ke, O! Aƒetɔ Yehowa.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Tso nye dzigbe ke, wò ko ŋu meku ɖo, elabena wòe ɖem tso danye ƒe dɔ me, eya ta makafu wò ɖaa.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Mezu nu maɖinu na ame geɖewo, gake wòe nye nye mɔ sesẽ.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Wò kafukafu yɔ nye nu me, eye meɖea gbeƒã wò atsyɔ̃ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔm ƒu gbe, ne meku amegã o, eye mègagblẽm ɖi ne ŋusẽ vɔ le ŋunye o.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be, “Mawu gblẽe ɖi, míti eyome, míalée, elabena ame aɖeke mava axɔ nɛ o.”

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, mèganɔ adzɔge tso gbɔnye o, O! Nye Mawu, va kaba nàxɔ nam.

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Na be nunyetsolawo natsrɔ̃ kple ŋukpe, eye nàna be vlododo kple ŋukpe natsyɔ ame siwo di be yewoawɔ nuvevim la dzi.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Ke nye ya la, mɔkpɔkpɔ anɔ asinye ɖaa, eye makafu wò, agakafu wò ɖe edzi.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Nye nu aɖe gbeƒã wò dzɔdzɔenyenye kple wò xɔname ŋkeke blibo la, togbɔ be nyemenya eƒe kpekpeme o hã.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Mava aɖe gbeƒã wò nu dzɔatsuwo, O Aƒetɔ Yehowa. Maɖe gbeƒã wò dzɔdzɔenyenye, wò ɖeka tɔ ko.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: O! Mawu; tso nye ɖekakpuime ke, nèfia num, eye va se ɖe egbe la, mele gbeƒã ɖem wò nu dzɔatsuwo.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, ne metsi, ƒo wɔ hã la, mègagblẽm ɖi o, va se ɖe esime maɖe gbeƒã wò ŋusẽ na dzidzime si ava dzɔ kple wò ŋusẽ na ame siwo woava dzi.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: O! Mawu, wò dzɔdzɔenyenye yi ɖatɔ dziŋgɔli ke, wò ame si wɔ nu dzɔatsu geɖewo. O! Mawu, ame kae le abe wò ene?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be èna mekpɔ xaxa geɖe kple vevesese hã la, àgaɖo nye agbe te, eye àva kplɔm ado goe tso anyigba ƒe tume ke.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Àdzi nye bubu ɖe edzi, eye àgafa akɔ nam.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: O! Nye Mawu, makafu wò kple kasaŋku le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ta; madzi kafukafuha na wò kple gasaŋku, O! Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Nye nuyiwo ado dzidzɔɣli, ne mele kafukafuhawo dzim na wò, nye ame si nèɖe.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Nye aɖe agblɔ wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe dɔwo ŋkeke blibo la, elabena ŋukpe kple tɔtɔ va ame siwo di be yewoawɔ nuvevim la dzi.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, tsɔ wò afia nyui tsotso do na fia la, kple wò dzɔdzɔenyenye na fiavi la.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu na wò dukɔ la le dzɔdzɔenyenye me, eye wòatso afia nyui na ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Towo atsɔ kesinɔnuwo vɛ na wò dukɔ, eye togbɛwo atsɔ dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe kutsetse vɛ na wo.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Aʋli ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la ta, axɔ na hiãtɔwo ƒe viwo, eye wòagbã ameteɖetola la nyanyanya.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Zi ale si ɣe kple ɣleti li la, anɔ te le dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Anɔ abe tsidzadza ɖe anyigba si dzi woƒo gbe le kple agbafie si dza ɖe anyigba hede tsii ene.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ayi ŋgɔ le eƒe ɣeyiɣiwo me, eye kesinɔnuwo ado agbogbo va se ɖe esime ɣleti magaɖi o.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Aɖu fia tso atsiaƒu ƒe go sia dzi ayi go kemɛ dzi, tso tɔsisi to ase ɖe anyigba la ƒe mlɔenuwo ke.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Dukɔ siwo le gbegbe la ade ta agu nɛ, eye eƒe futɔwo aɖuɖɔ ʋuʋudedi.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarsis fia kple didiƒe ƒutatɔwo ahe adzɔ vɛ nɛ, eye Sieba kple Seba fiawo atsɔ nunanawo vɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Fiawo katã ade ta agu nɛ, eye dukɔwo katã asubɔe,

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: elabena aɖe hiãtɔ si le avi fam kple wɔmenɔ si xɔnametɔ aɖeke meli na o.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Akpɔ nublanui na ame gblɔewo kple hiãtɔwo, eye wòaɖe ame dahewo tso ku me.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Aɖe wo le teteɖeanyi kple ŋutasesẽ me, elabena woƒe ʋu xɔ asi le eŋkume.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Fia la nenɔ agbe tegbee! Wonetsɔ Seba sika nɛ. Amewo nedo gbe ɖa ɖe eta ɖaa, eye wòayra ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Bli nedo agbogbo ɖe anyigba la katã dzi; eye neʋã ɖe togbɛwo katã dzi. Blitiawo netri abe Lebanontɔwo ene, eye woanɔ abe gbe le gbedzi ene.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkɔ nenɔ anyi ɖaa, eye nenɔ anyi zi ale si ɣe le keklẽm. Woayra dukɔwo katã to eya amea dzi, eye woayɔe be yayratɔ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa Mawu, Israel ƒe Mawu la, eya ame si ko wɔa nu dzɔatsuwo.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Woakafu eƒe ŋkɔ si ŋu ŋutikɔkɔe le la tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me; eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe neyɔ anyigba blibo la dzi. Amen, ɛ̃, Amen.

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Esiawo wu Yese ƒe vi, David ƒe gbedodoɖawo nu.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: Asaf ƒe ha.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Vavã, Mawu wɔ nyui na Israel kple ame siwo dza le woƒe dzi me.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Elabena mebiã ŋu ɖokuiŋudzela esi mekpɔ ale si nu le edzi dzem na ame vɔ̃ɖiwoe.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Hiãkame aɖeke mele wo dzi o, eye wole lãmesẽ kple dedinɔnɔ me.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Eya ta dada nye woƒe kɔga, eye wodo nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ abe awu ene.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Dzidada dona tso woƒe dzi si ku atri la me, eye seɖoƒe meli na woƒe susu ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖoɖo o.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Woɖua fewu, ƒoa nu vlodoametɔe, eye le woƒe dada me la, woklẽa ŋku ɖe amewo be woabɔbɔ na wo.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Woƒe nuwo xɔ dziƒo wɔ wo tɔe, eye woƒe aɖewo xɔ anyigba wòzu wo tɔ.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Eya ta woƒe amewo trɔ ɖe wo gbɔ, eye wono tsi fũu.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be, “Aleke Mawu awɔ anya? Ɖe nunya le Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la sia?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Aleae ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le, wole ablɔɖe me ɣe sia ɣi, eye wodzia woƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖe edzi.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, dzodzro ko wònye be mewɔ nye dzi dzadzɛ, eye dzodzroe meklɔ nye asi ɖe fɔmaɖimaɖi me.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Mekpea fu ŋkeke blibo la, eye ŋdi sia ŋdi wohea to nam.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Ɖe megblɔ be, “Ale maƒo nui nye si” la, anye ne mede viwòwo asi.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Enye teteɖeanyi gã aɖe te menɔ esi medze agbagba be mase nu siawo gɔme,

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime mege ɖe Mawu ƒe Kɔkɔeƒe la, tete mese afi si woawu nu ɖo la gɔme.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Vavã, ètsɔ wo ɖo didiƒe, eye nètsɔ wo xlã ɖe anyi wogblẽ keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Aleke wohetsrɔ̃ kpata ale, ŋɔdzi kplɔ wo dzoe kaba ŋutɔ!

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, abe ale si drɔ̃e nɔna ne ame nyɔ tso alɔ̃ me ene la, do vlo wo abe drɔ̃e manyatalenu ene.

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: mezu bometsila kple numanyala, eye mele abe lã tagbɔkukutɔ ene le ŋkuwò me.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Ke mele gbɔwò ɣe sia ɣi, eye nèlé nye ɖusibɔ ɖe asi.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Èkplɔm le wò aɖaŋudede nu, eye àkplɔm emegbe ayi wò ŋutikɔkɔe mee.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Ame kae le dziƒo nam, negbe wò ko? Naneke mele anyigba si medi kpe ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Nye ŋutilã kple nye dzi nu ava yi, gake Mawue nye nye dzi ƒe ŋusẽ kple nye gomekpɔkpɔ tegbetegbe.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Ame siwo le adzɔge tso gbɔwò la atsrɔ̃, elabena ètsrɔ̃ ame siwo katã meto nyateƒe na wo o.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ke nye ya la, enyo be mate ɖe Mawu ŋu. Aƒetɔ Yehowae mewɔ nye sitsoƒee, maxlẽ wò nuwɔwɔwo katã afia.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: O! Mawu, nu ka ŋuti nègble mí ɖi ɖikaa? Nu ka ta wò dɔmedzoe bi ɖe wò alẽ siwo le wò lãnyiƒe ŋuti?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku ame siwo nèƒle le blema, dukɔ si nye wò domenyinu, ame siwo nèɖe kple Zion, to afi si nènɔ la dzi.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe gli siwo gbã ɖikaɖika la ŋu, gbegblẽ siawoe futɔ la he va wò teƒe kɔkɔe lae.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Wò futɔwo le gbe ɖem le afi si nèdo go mí le; wova tsi woƒe aflaga ɖe teƒe la be wòanye dzesi anɔ afi ma.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe fiawo kple yiwo dza aɖaŋu siwo wowɔ ɖe gliawo ŋu.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Wotɔ dzo wò kɔkɔeƒe la wòbi va anyigba, eye wodo gu teƒe si wò Ŋkɔ nɔna.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Wogblɔ le woƒe dzi me be, “Míagbã wo gudugudu!” Wotɔ dzo teƒe sia teƒe si wosubɔa Mawu le, le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Womegawɔa nukunu aɖeke na mí o; womegblẽ nyagblɔɖila aɖeke ɖi o eye mía dometɔ aɖeke menya ɣeyiɣi si nu sia nu ava yi o.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: O! Mawu, ɣe ka ɣi futɔ la aɖu fewu le ŋuwò ase ɖo? Ɖe ketɔ la ado vlo wò ŋkɔ tegbeea?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, O Mawu, wòe nye fianye tso blema ke; wòe tsɔ ɖeɖe va anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Wòe tsɔ wò ŋusẽ ma atsiaƒu, eye nègbã tɔmelã dziŋɔwo ƒe ta le tsiwo me.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Wòe gbã Leviatan ƒe ta, eye nètsɔe wɔ nuɖuɖui na gbemelãwo.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Wòe ʋu nu le tsitsetsewo kple tɔʋuwo nu wosi bababa, eye wòe na tɔ siwo sina ɖaa la mie.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke nye tɔwò, eye zã hã tɔwòe; wòe wɔ ɣe kple ɣleti.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖo liƒo na anyigba, eye wòe wɔ vuvɔŋɔli kple dzomeŋɔli.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ wò akpakpa ƒe agbe de asi na lãwɔadãwo o, eye mègaŋlɔ wò hiãtɔwo ƒe gbe be ɖikaa o.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Tsɔ ɖe le wò nubabla la me, elabena ŋutasesẽ ƒe wɔnawo yɔ anyigba la ƒe ɣaɣlɛƒewo fũu.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Mègana ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la nate gbugbɔɖemegbe kple ŋukpe o; ke boŋ ame dahewo kple hiãtɔwo nekafu wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, tso eye nàʋli wò bubu ta; ɖo ŋku ale si bometsilawo le alɔme ɖem le ŋuwò ŋkeke blibo lae dzi.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, míeda akpe na wò, míeda akpe na wò, elabena wò ŋkɔ tsɔ ɖe mía gbɔ, eye amewo le wò nukunuwo xlẽm fia.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: Ègblɔ be, “Meɖo ɣeyiɣi da ɖi, elabena nyee adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Ne anyigba kple edzinɔlawo ʋuʋu kpekpekpe la, nyee léa eƒe sɔtiwo ɖe asi sesĩe. Sela

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Megblɔ na ɖokuiŋudzelawo be, ‘Midzudzɔ dada,’ eye na ame vɔ̃ɖi be, ‘Mègakɔ wò dzo ɖe dzi o.

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Mègakɔ wò dzowo ɖe dzi ɖe dziƒo ŋu o, eye mègahe ve hafi nànɔ nu ƒom o.’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Dodoɖedzi metsoa ɣedzeƒe, ɣetoɖoƒe alo gbegbe vana na ame o,

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: ke boŋ Mawue nye afiatsola, eɖea ame sia le zi dzi, eye wòdoa ame kemɛ ɖe dzi.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Kplu aɖe le Yehowa ƒe asi me, wain si lɔ fu ɖe nu, eye wotsɔ nu ʋeʋĩ tɔtɔe la le eme; ekui na ame vɔ̃ɖi siwo le anyigba dzi, wonoe, no ahaƒã si le egɔme la hã ƒiaƒiaƒia.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Ke nye la, manɔ esia gblɔm ɖaa be; madzi kafukafuha na Yakob ƒe Mawu la;

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: maŋe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe dzowo, ke woado ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe dzowo ɖe dzi.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Wonya Mawu le Yuda, eye eƒe ŋkɔ lolo le Israel.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Eƒe agbadɔ le Salem, eye eƒe nɔƒe le Zion.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Afi ma wòŋe aŋutrɔ bibiwo, akpoxɔnuwo kple yiwo le, nu siwo nye aʋawɔnuwo. Sela

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Woha kalẽtɔwo, wodɔ woƒe alɔ̃ mamlɛtɔ; aʋawɔla siawo dometɔ ɖeka pɛ hã magate ŋu akɔ eƒe asiwo dzi o.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: O! Yakob ƒe Mawu, esi nèblu ko la, sɔ kple tasiaɖam siaa tɔ ɖe teƒe ɖeka.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Wò ko wòle be woavɔ̃. Ame ka ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe nuwò ne èdo dɔmedzoe?

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Èɖe gbeƒã wò afiatsotso tso dziƒo, anyigba vɔ̃, eye wòzi ɖoɖoe.

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, esi nètso be yeatso afia, aɖe anyigba la ƒe hiãtɔwo la, nu sia nu zi ɖoɖoe. Sela

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Miɖe adzɔgbe na Yehowa, miaƒe Mawu la, eye mixe adzɔgbeɖefeawo; anyigba siwo katã ƒo xlã mi la netsɔ nunanawo vɛ na Ame si wòle be woavɔ̃ la.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Etsi dziɖulawo ƒe gbɔgbɔ nu; anyigbadzifiawo katã vɔ̃nɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli na Mawu be wòaxɔ nam; medo ɣli na Mawu be wòaɖo tom.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Esi meɖo xaxa me la, medi Aƒetɔ la; le zã me la, meke nye abɔwo me, gake ɖeɖi mete wo ŋu o, eye nye luʋɔ gbe akɔfafaxɔxɔ.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, meɖo ŋku dziwò, eye meɖe hũu. Mele ŋeŋem, eye nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu. Sela

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Èna nye ŋkuwo gbe miamia; fuɖeɖewo sɔ gbɔ ale gbegbe be nyemate ŋu aƒo nu o.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Mebu gbe aɖe gbe ŋkekewo kple blemaƒewo ŋu.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Ɖe Aƒetɔ la agbe ame tegbetegbea? Ɖe magave ame nu akpɔ oa?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Ɖe eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la vɔ tegbetegbea? Ɖe eƒe ŋugbedodo vɔ hena ɣeyiɣiawo katã?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Ɖe Mawu ŋlɔ nublanuikpɔkpɔ bea? Ɖe wòɖo asi eƒe dɔmenyonyo dzi le dɔmedzoe ta?” Sela

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Tete megblɔ be, “Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe nuɖusi ƒe ƒewo ko maƒo koko na.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Maɖo ŋku Yehowa ƒe nuwɔwɔwo dzi, ɛ̃, maɖo ŋku nukunu siwo nèwɔ le blema la dzi.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Made ŋugble le wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã ŋu, eye mabu ta me le wò nuwɔwɔ dzɔatsuwo ŋu.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, wò mɔwo le kɔkɔe mawu kae lolo abe míaƒe Mawu la ene?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Wòe nye Mawu si wɔ nukunuwo, eye nèɖe wò ŋusẽ fia le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ wò abɔ sesẽ la ɖe wò dukɔ la, ame siwo nye Yakob kple Yosef ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Sela

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, tsiwo kpɔ wò, tsiwo kpɔ wò, eye woŋe, gogloƒewo ke hã dzo nyanyanya.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Lilikpo ɖuɖu tsi bababa, dziŋgɔli ɖe gbe, eye wò aŋutrɔwo klẽ dzo bibibi, yi gagbɔ.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Wose wò gbeɖeɖe le yali me, wò dzikedzo klẽ ɖe xexea me, eye anyigba ʋuʋu hedzo nyanyanya.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Wò mɔ to atsiaƒu me, eye wò toƒe le tɔ gãwo me, gake womekpɔa wò afɔteƒe o.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Èkplɔ wò dukɔ abe alẽha ene, to Mose kple Aron ƒe asiwo dzi.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: O! Nye dukɔ, mise nye nufiame, eye miɖo to nye numenyawo.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Make nye nu, aƒo nu le lododowo me. Magblɔ nu siwo le ɣaɣla, nu siwo li tso blema ke.

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: Nu siwo míese, eye míenya, nu siwo mía fofowo tsɔ tu xoe na mí.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Míawo míaɣlae ɖe mía viwo o, ke boŋ míagblɔ Yehowa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ siwo dze na kafukafu, eƒe ŋusẽ kple nukudɔ siwo wòwɔ la na megbeviwo.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Ewɔ ɖoɖowo na Yakob, eye wòɖo se anyi ɖe Israel, se siwo ŋu wòde se na mía fofowo be woafia wo viwo,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: ale be dzidzime megbetɔwo hã nanya wo, eye vi siwo womedzi haɖe o hã nanya wo, ne woawo hã nafia wo viwo.

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: Ekema woatsɔ woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ ada ɖe Mawu dzi, eye womaŋlɔ eƒe nuwɔwɔwo be o, ke boŋ woalé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: Ke womanɔ abe wo fofo kɔlialiatɔwo, dzidzime dzeaglã, ame siwo ƒe dzi meku ɖe Mawu ŋu o, eye woƒe gbɔgbɔ meto nyateƒe nɛ o la ene o.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be aŋutrɔwo le Efraimtɔwo si hã la, wotrɔ megbe si dzo le aʋakpegbe.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Womelé Mawu ƒe nubabla me ɖe asi o, eye wogbe be yewomanɔ agbe ɖe eƒe se la nu o.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ nu si wòwɔ la be, esiwo nye nukunu siwo wòɖe fia wo.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ewɔ nukunu le wo fofowo ŋkume le Egiptenyigba dzi, le Zoan nuto me.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Ema atsiaƒu, hekplɔ wo to emee, eye wòna tsi la tɔ dzɔ kã abe glikpɔ ene.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Etsɔ lilikpo kplɔ woe le ŋkeke me, eye wòtsɔ dzo keklẽ kplɔ woe le zã me.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Efe agakpe me le gbegbe, eye wòna tsi wo wòsɔ gbɔ abe atsiaƒumetsiwo ene.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ena tsi do tso agakpe me eye tsi la si bababa abe tɔsisiwo ene.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ke woyi edzi gawɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖe eŋu, eye wodze aglã ɖe Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋu le gbedzi.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe lɔlɔ̃nu te Mawu kpɔ, esi wobia nuɖuɖu si le wo dzrom vevie.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Woƒo nu tsi tsitre ɖe Mawu ŋu be, “Ɖe Mawu ate ŋu aɖo kplɔ̃ na mí le gbedzia?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Esi wòtsɔ nu ƒo agakpe la, tsi do bababa, eye tɔʋuwo si kplakplakpla. Gake ɖe wòate ŋu ana nuɖuɖu mía? Ate ŋu ana lã eƒe dukɔa?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Esi Yehowa se wo ŋkɔ la, dzi kui vevie; eƒe dzo bi ɖe Yakob ŋu, eye eƒe dɔmedzoe de dzi ɖe Israel ŋu,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: elabena womexɔ Mawu dzi se, alo ka ɖe eƒe xɔname dzi o.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Ke hã la, eɖe gbe na lilikpowo le dzi, eye wòʋu dziƒo ƒe ʋɔtruwo,

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: ena mana dza tso dziƒo na dukɔ la be woaɖu, eye wòna bli wo tso dziƒo.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ɖu mawudɔlawo ƒe nuɖuɖu, eye wòɖo nuɖuɖu si sinu wohiã la ɖe wo.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Etu ka ɣedzeƒeya tso dziƒo, eye wòkplɔ dzigbeya kple eƒe ŋusẽ.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ena lã dza ɖe wo dzi abe ʋuʋudedi ene, eye xe dzodzoewo abe ƒutake ene.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Ena woge dze woƒe asaɖa me, eye woƒo xlã woƒe agbadɔwo.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Ale woɖui ʋuu heɖi ƒo taŋ, elabena ewɔ nu si dzrom wole la dzi na wo.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Ke hafi nuɖuɖu si wodzro la navɔ, eye esi wògale nu me na wo ko la,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe bi ɖe wo ŋu; ewu ame sesẽwo le wo dome, eye wòlã Israel ɖekakpuiwo ƒu anyi.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: To nu siawo katã gbɔ hã la, wogayi nu vɔ̃ wɔwɔ dzi, eye togbɔ be ewɔ nukunuwo hã la, womexɔe se o.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Ale wòna woƒe ŋkekewo wu nu nanekemakpɔkpɔe, eye woƒe ƒewo wu nu le ŋɔdzi me.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Ɣe sia ɣi si ke Mawu wu wo ko la, wodinɛ, eye wogatrɔna ɖe eŋu kple vevidodo.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Woɖoa ŋku edzi be Mawue nye woƒe Agakpe, eye Mawu Dziƒoʋĩtɔ lae nye woƒe Ɖela.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Ke emegbe la, wotsɔa woƒe nu flunɛ, eye wotsɔa woƒe aɖe daa alakpa nɛ.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Gake ekpɔ nublanui na wo; etsɔ woƒe vodadawo ke wo, eye metsrɔ̃ wo o. Zi geɖe la, eɖoa asi eƒe dziku dzi, eye menaa eƒe dɔmedzoe katã bina o.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋku edzi be ŋutilã ko wonye, eye wonye ya si ƒona yina gake megatrɔna gbɔna o.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Zi nenie womedze aglã ɖe eŋu le gbedzi, eye womedo vevesese nɛ le kuɖiɖinyigba dzi o!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Enuenu wotea Mawu kpɔna, eye wodoa dziku na Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Womeɖo ŋku eƒe ŋusẽ dzi, gbe si gbe wòɖe wo tso ŋutasẽla ƒe asi me,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: gbe si gbe wòɖe eƒe nukudzesiwo fia le Egipte kple eƒe nukudɔwo fia le Zoan nuto me o.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Etrɔ woƒe tɔsisiwo wozu ʋu, eye womete ŋu no woƒe tɔʋumetsi o.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Eɖo togbato ƒe ha gã aɖe ɖe wo dome, woɖu wo kple akpɔkplɔwo wogblẽ woƒe nuwo.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Etsɔ woƒe nukuwo na ʋetrawo kple woƒe kutsetsewo na ʋetsuviwo.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Egblẽ woƒe waingblewo kple kpetsi, eye woƒe gbotiwo kple tsidzadza sesẽ.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Etsɔ woƒe nyihawo na kpetsi, eye wòtsɔ woƒe lãhawo na dzikedzo.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe dɔmedzoe nyanyra, dziku helĩhelĩ, xaxa kple fuwɔame, siwo nye mawudɔla siwo gblẽa nu la ɖe wo.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Eɖe mɔ ɖi na eƒe dɔmedzoe; meɖe woƒe agbe tso ku me o, ke boŋ etsɔ wo de asi na dɔvɔ̃.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: Ewu Egiptetɔwo ƒe ŋgɔgbevi siwo nye woƒe ŋutsunyenye ƒe kutsetse gbãtɔwo le Ham gbadɔwo te.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Gake ekplɔ eƒe dukɔ la abe lãhawo ene, eye wòkplɔ wo abe alẽwo ene to gbedzi.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo le dedinɔnɔ me, ale be womevɔ̃ o, gake ƒu la tsyɔ woƒe futɔwo dzi.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Ale wòkplɔ wo va eƒe anyigba kɔkɔe la ƒe liƒo dzi, va tonyigba si eƒe nuɖusi xɔ la gbɔ.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Enya dukɔwo le wo ŋgɔ, eye wòma woƒe anyigba na wo be wòanye woƒe domenyinu, eye wòna Israel ƒe toawo nɔ woƒe aƒewo me.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ke wote Mawu kpɔ, wodze aglã ɖe Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋu, eye womelé eƒe sewo me ɖe asi o.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Abe wo fofowo ene la, womeɖo to o, wowɔ nu dzimaxɔsetɔe, eye wole abe dati doagblɔ ene, elabena womate ŋu aka ɖe wo dzi o.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe nuxeƒewo do dɔmedzoe nɛ, eye woƒe legbawo na ŋuʋaʋã tso le eya amea me.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Esi Mawu se wo ŋkɔ la, dzi kui vevie ŋutɔ, eye wògbe Israel keŋkeŋ.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Ale wògblẽ agbadɔ si le Silo la ɖi, agbadɔ si wòtu ɖe amegbetɔwo dome.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Eɖo nubablaɖaka si nye eƒe ŋusẽ la ɖe aboyome, eye wòtsɔ eƒe atsyɔ̃nu de asi na futɔ la.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe dukɔ de asi na yi, eye wòdo dɔmedzoe vevie ɖe eƒe domenyinu la ŋu.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Ena dzo fia eƒe ɖekakpuiwo, eye womedzi srɔ̃ɖeha na eƒe ɖetugbiwo o.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe nunɔlawo de asi na yi, eye avi bu ɖe woƒe ahosiwo.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Tete Aƒetɔ la nyɔ tso alɔ̃ me abe ale si aha kɔna le mo na ame si no wain mu la ene.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Enya eƒe futɔwo do ɖe megbe, eye wòdo ŋukpe mavɔ wo.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, wògbe nu le Yosef ƒe agbadɔwo gbɔ, eye metia Efraim ƒe to la o.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Ke boŋ etia Yuda ƒe to la, esi nye Zion to si wòlɔ̃na vevie.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Etu eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la abe kɔkɔƒe ene, eye abe anyigba si wòli kee tegbetegbe ene.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Etia David dɔla, eye wòɖee le alẽkpo me;

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: tso alẽkplɔdɔ me, eye wòkplɔe vɛ be wòakplɔ eƒe dukɔ, Yakob kple eƒe domenyinu, Israel.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: David kpɔ wo dzi le dzi dzɔdzɔe me, eye wòkplɔ wo le aɖaŋu me.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, dukɔwo nye zi ɖe wò domenyinu la dzi, wodo gu wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la, eye wogbã Yerusalem wòzu anyiglagoe.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ wò dɔlawo ƒe kukuawo na dziƒoxewo abe nuɖuɖu ene, eye wotsɔ wò ame kɔkɔeawo ƒe ŋutilã na anyigbadzilã wɔadãwo.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Wokɔ woƒe ʋu ɖi abe tsi ene ƒo xlã Yerusalem, eye ame aɖeke meli aɖi ame kukuawo o.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Míezu fewuɖunu na míaƒe aƒelikawo, eye míezu alɔmeɖenu kple vlodonu na ame siwo ƒo xlã mí.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi? Ɖe nàdo dɔmedzoe tegbeea? Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi wò ŋuʋaʋã abi abe dzo ene?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Trɔ wò dziku helĩhelĩ la kɔ ɖe dukɔ siwo menya wò o la dzi kple fiaɖuƒe siwo meyɔa wò ŋkɔ o la dzi.

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Elabena wovuvu Yakob, eye wogbã eƒe denyigba.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Mègawɔ na mí ɖe mía fofowo ƒe nu vɔ̃ nu o; na wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ nava do go mí kaba, elabena míeɖo xaxa gã aɖe me.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, mía Ɖela, kpe ɖe mía ŋu le wò ŋkɔ ƒe bubu ta. Ɖe mí, eye nàtsɔ míaƒe nu vɔ̃wo ake mí le wò ŋkɔ la ta.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Nu ka ŋuti dukɔwo agblɔ be, “Afi ka woƒe Mawu la le?” Le míawo ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkume, na dukɔwo nanya be, èbia hlɔ̃ na wò dɔla siwo ƒe ʋu wokɔ ɖi.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Aʋaléleawo ƒe ŋeŋe neɖo gbɔwò, tsɔ wò asi ƒe ŋusẽ ɖe ame siwo wotso kufia na.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, ɖo vlo, si míaƒe aƒelikawo do wò la teƒe na wo zi adre.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Ekema mí wò dukɔ, wò lãnyiƒe ƒe alẽwo akafu wò tegbee, eye tso dzidzime yi dzidzime míaɖe wò kafukafu afia.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: O, Israel ƒe Kplɔla, ɖo to mí, wò ame si kplɔ Yosef ƒe dzidzimeviwo abe lãha ene; wò ame si nɔ anyi ɖe kerubiwo titina gli, klẽ

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: le Efraim, Benyamin kple Manase ŋgɔ. Nyɔ wò ŋusẽ, va nàxɔ na mí.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, gaɖo mí te; na wò mo naklẽ ɖe mía dzi, be míakpɔ xɔxɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi wò dɔmedzoe abi ɖe wò dukɔ ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Èna aɖatsibolo wo woɖu, eye nèna aɖatsi wo wono taŋtaŋ.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ mí wɔ dzrewɔnui na míaƒe aƒelikawo, eye míaƒe futɔwo ɖe alɔme le mía ŋu.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, gaɖo mí te; na wò mo naklẽ ɖe mía dzi, be míakpɔ xɔxɔ.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Èdzra eŋuti ɖo nyuie, eye wòto ke hevu tsyɔ anyigba.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Edo vɔvɔli ɖe towo tame eye wòɖe alɔ de sedati kɔkɔwo tame.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Eɖe alɔ yi ɖe keke ƒuta ke, eye eƒe kewo yi ɖe keke Frat tɔsisi la nu ke.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Nu ka ŋuti nègbã kpɔ le eŋu, ale be ame siwo to afi ma yi la fɔ wain tsetsewo?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Gbehawo nya avuzi le edzi, eye gbemelãwo ɖui.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Trɔ va mía gbɔ, O Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ! Do kɔ ɖa tso dziƒo, eye nàkpɔ nu! Kpɔ wainka sia ta,

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: ke si wò nuɖusi do, viŋutsu si wò ŋutɔ nèhe wòtsi.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Wolã wò wainka, wotɔ dzoe, eye wò mokaname na wò amewo tsrɔ̃.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Wò asi nenɔ ŋutsu si le wò nuɖusime, amegbetɔvi si nènyi na ɖokuiwò la dzi.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ekema míatrɔ le yowòme o; gbɔ agbe mí, eye míayɔ wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, gaɖo mí te; na wò mo nàklẽ ɖe mía dzi be míakpɔ xɔxɔ.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Midzi ha, mikpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe Mawu, míaƒe ŋusẽ la ŋu, eye mitso aseye kple ɣli ɖe Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋu!

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Mido ha ɖa, xatsɛwo neɖi, miƒo kasaŋku kple gakasaŋku siwo ƒe gbe me kɔ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Miku lãdzokpẽwo le Dzinu Yeye dzi kple ne dzinu sɔ tegblẽe le míaƒe ŋkekenyuiɖugbe.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Esia nye se na Israel kple ɖoɖo na Yakob ƒe Mawu la.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Esi Mawu tso ɖe Egiptetɔwo ŋu la, eɖoe anyi be wòanye se na Yosef, afi si míese gbegbɔgblɔ si gɔme míese o la le:

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: Egblɔ be, “Meɖe agba la ɖa le woƒe abɔta, eye woɖe woƒe asiwo ɖa le kusi la ŋuti.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Mieyɔm le miaƒe xaxa me, eye mexɔ na mi. Metɔ na mi le dziɖegbelilikpo la me. Medo mi kpɔ le Meriba tsi la gbɔ. Sela

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Mísee, o nye dukɔ, maxlɔ̃ nu mi. O! Israel, nenye ɖe nàɖo tom ɖe!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Dzromawu aɖeke maganɔ dowòme o; màgade ta agu na mawu tutɔ aɖeke o.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
