translation_verse: Nyee nye Yehowa, wò Mawu, ame si kplɔ wò do goe tso Egipte. Ke wò nu baa, eye mana wòayɔ.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Ke nye dukɔ meɖo to nye gbe o; Israel gbe, mebɔbɔ eɖokui nam o,

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: eya ta meɖe asi le wo ŋu na woƒe dzi sesẽwo, ne woadze nu siwo woawo ŋutɔ ɖo la yome.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: “Ɖe wònye nye dukɔ aɖo tom, eye Israel nazɔ nye mɔwo dzi la,

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: aleke nyemahabɔbɔ woƒe futɔwo ɖe anyii kaba, eye nyemahakɔ nye asiwo dzi ɖe woƒe ketɔwo ŋui o!

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Ame siwo lé fu Yehowa la ada alakpa le eŋkume, eye woƒe tohehe anɔ anyi tegbee.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Ke míaɖu bliwɔ nyuitɔ, eye matsɔ kpetomenyitsi aɖi ƒoe na mi.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Mawu nɔ zi me na takpekpe gã la, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu le “mawuwo” dome.

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi miaʋli ame baɖa la ta, eye miatso afia ade ame vɔ̃ɖi la dzi?” Sela

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: “Miʋli ame gblɔewo kple tsyɔ̃eviwo ta, eye miwɔ dɔmenyo na hiãtɔwo kple ame siwo wote ɖe to.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Mixɔ na ame gblɔewo kple hiãtɔwo, eye miɖe wo tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: “Womenya naneke o, womese naneke gɔme o. Wole zɔzɔm le blukɔ me, eye anyigba ƒe agunuwo katã ʋuʋu.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: “Megblɔ be, ‘Mawuwoe mienye; mi katã mienye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe viŋutsuwo’,

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: gake miaku abe amegbetɔwo ko ene eye miatsi aʋa abe fia ɖe sia ɖe ko ene.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, tso, eye nàdrɔ̃ ʋɔnu anyigba la elabena dukɔwo katã nye wò domenyinu.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: O! Mawu, mègazi kpi o, O! Mawu, mègazi ɖoɖoe o, mèganɔ anyi kpoo o.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ale si wò futɔwo le nyanyram ɖa, kpɔ ale si wò ketɔwo kɔ ta dzii ɖa.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Wole nu baɖa ɖom ɖe wò dukɔ ŋu le ayeme, eye woɖo nugbe ɖe ame siwo nèlɔ̃na la ŋu.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be, “Miva, míatsrɔ̃ wo, be womaganye dukɔ o, eye womagaɖo ŋku Israel ƒe ŋkɔ dzi akpɔ gbeɖe o.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Wotsɔ tameɖoɖo ɖeka de adaŋu, eye wobla ɖe ŋuwò,

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: ame siwo le Edom ƒe agbadɔwo me, Ismaelitɔwo, Moabtɔwo, Hagritɔwo,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebalitɔwo, Amonviwo, Amalekitɔwo, Filistitɔwo kple ame siwo tso Tiro.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiria gɔ̃ hã kpe ɖe wo ŋu, be wòado alɔ Lot ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Sela

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Wɔ wo abe ale si nèwɔ Midian, Sisera kple Yabin le Kison tɔsisi la to ene,

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: ame siwo tsrɔ̃ le Endor, eye wole abe gbeɖuɖɔ ene le anyigba.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Wɔ woƒe bubumewo abe Oreb kple Zeb ene, eye woƒe dumegãwo abe Zeba kple Zalmuna ene,

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: ame siwo gblɔ be, “Mina míaxɔ Mawu ƒe lãnyiƒewo.”

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: O! Nye Mawu, wɔ wo abe betsyo kple blitsa si ya lɔ ɖe nu ene.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Abe ale si dzo biaa ave, alo dzo ƒe aɖe tɔa dzo towo ene la,

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: nenemae nàti wo yomee kple wò ya sesẽ, eye nàdo ŋɔdzi na wo kple wò ahom.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Tsɔ ŋukpe tsyɔ mo na wo, ale be amewo nadi wò ŋkɔ, O Yehowa.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Na ŋukpe nalé wo, woƒe mo natsi dãa, eye wonetsrɔ̃ le ŋukpe me.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Na woanya be wò, ame si ŋkɔe nye Yehowa la, wò koe nye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ɖe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Dziƒoʋakɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ, wò nɔƒe dzeani loo!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wò xɔxɔnuwo le nye luʋɔ dzrom kutɔkutɔe. Nye dzi kple ŋutilã le vivi dom ɖe Mawu gbagbe la ŋu.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Dziƒoʋakɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ, Fianye kple Mawunye, sagbadre gɔ̃ hã kpɔ nɔƒe, eye atsutsrɔe wɔ atɔ na eɖokui, afi si wòatsɔ viawo ada ɖo, be wòate ɖe wò vɔsamlekpui la ŋu.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo nɔa wò aƒe me la, elabena wole kafuwòm ɖaa. Sela

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo ƒe ŋusẽ le mewò, ame siwo ƒe dzi ku ɖe xɔsemɔzɔzɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Ne woto Baka Balime la, wowɔnɛ wòzua tsidzɔƒewo, eye kelemetsi tsyɔa edzi kple yayra.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Wole azɔli dzi tso ŋusẽ me yi ŋusẽ me va se ɖe esime wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe nado ɖe Mawu ŋkume le Zion.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Yehowa, Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ; O! Yakob ƒe Mawu, ɖo to nye gbedodoɖa. Sela

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: O! Mawu, nye kɔ nàkpɔ míaƒe akpoxɔnu, eye nakpɔ wò amesiamina la kple amenuveve.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ŋkeke ɖeka le wò xɔxɔnu nyo wu akpe le afi aɖe; enyo be manye agbonudzɔla le Mawu ƒe aƒe me wu be manɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe agbadɔ me,

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: elabena Yehowa Mawue nye ɣe kple akpoxɔnu. Yehowae naa amenuveve kple bubu, eye metea nu nyui ame siwo fɔɖiɖi mele woƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Dziƒoʋakɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ, woayra ŋutsu si ɖoa dzi ɖe ŋuwò la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, èɖe amenuveve fia wò anyigba; ègaɖo Yakob ƒe nunyonamewo te.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ wò dukɔ la ƒe vodada kee, eye nètsyɔ nu woƒe nu vɔ̃wo katã dzi. Sela

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Èɖe asi le wò dzikudodo helĩhelĩ ŋuti eye nèdzudzɔ dɔmedzoe kaɖikaɖi dodo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, míaƒe Ɖela, gaɖo mí te, míaƒe nu meganɔ dzi kum na wò o.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Ɖe nàdo dɔmedzoe ɖe mía ŋu ɖikaa? Ɖe nàdidi wò dɔmedzoe la wòazɔ ato dzidzimewo katã mea?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Màgagbɔ agbe mí, be wò dukɔ nàkpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe ŋuwò oa?

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Maɖo to ase nya si Yehowa Mawu agblɔ; edo ŋutifafa ƒe ŋugbe na eƒe dukɔ, eƒe ame kɔkɔewo, gake ɖeko mègana woatrɔ ayi bometsitsi gbɔ o.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Vavã eƒe ɖeɖe tsɔ ɖe ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la gbɔ, ale be eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nanɔ míaƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ do go wo nɔewo, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ŋutifafa gbugbɔ nu na wo nɔewo.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Nuteƒewɔwɔ mie tso anyigba me, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye do mo ɖa kpɔ anyigba tso dziƒo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Yehowa ana nu si nyo la mí vavã, eye míaƒe anyigba atse eƒe ku.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye le eŋgɔ, eye wòle mɔ tam na eƒe afɔtoƒewo.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Ɖo tom, O Yehowa, eye nàtɔ nam, elabena meda ahe, eye hiã tum.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye agbe ta, elabena metsɔ ɖokuinye na wò. Wòe nye nye Mawu, eya ta ɖe wò dɔla si ɖo dzi ɖe ŋuwò.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, kpɔ nye nublanui, elabena mele yɔwòm ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, tsɔ dzidzɔ vɛ na wò dɔla, elabena wòe medo nye luʋɔ ɖe dzi na.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, ènyo, eye nètsɔna kena, lɔlɔ̃ bɔ ɖe asiwò na ame siwo katã yɔa wò.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye nàlé to ɖe nye nublanuiɣli ŋu.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Le nye xaxagbe, mayɔ wò elabena àtɔ nam.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ aɖeke megale mawuawo dome abe wò ene o; nuwɔna aɖeke mesɔ kple tɔwò o.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, dukɔ siwo katã nèwɔ la ava asubɔ le ŋkuwò me, eye woatsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe ana wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Elabena èlolo, eye nèwɔ nu dzɔatsuwo; wò koe nye Mawu.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, fia wò mɔm, eye mazɔ le wò nyateƒe la me; tsɔ dzi si to mɔ ɖeka la nam, ale be mavɔ̃ wò ŋkɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Makafu wò, O Aƒetɔ, nye Mawu, kple nye dzi blibo. Mado wò ŋkɔ ɖe dzi tegbee,

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: elabena wò lɔlɔ̃ nam lolo ŋutɔ, eye nèɖem tso keke tsiẽƒe ʋĩi ke.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, dadalawo tso ɖe ŋunye, ŋutasẽlawo ƒe ha ti nye agbe yome, eye wonye ŋutsu siwo mebu wò ɖe naneke me o.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, ke wò la, Mawu si kpɔa nublanui, eye wòvea ame nu lae nènye, mèdoa dɔmedzoe kabakaba o, lɔlɔ̃ bɔ ɖe asiwò, eye nèwɔa nuteƒe.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋutinye, eye nàkpɔ nublanui nam; na wò ŋusẽ wò dɔla, eye nàɖe viwò ŋutsu nuteƒewɔla.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Ɖe wò nyuiwɔwɔ ƒe dzesi fiam, be nye futɔwo nakpɔe, eye ŋu nakpe wo, elabena o Yehowa, wòe kpe ɖe ŋunye, eye nèfa akɔ nam.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe agunu anyi ɖe to Kɔkɔe la dzi.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɔ̃ Zion ƒe agbowo wu Yakob ƒe nɔƒewo katã.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: O! Mawu ƒe du, wogblɔ nu nyui geɖewo tso ŋuwò. Sela

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: “Maŋlɔ Rahab kple Babilon ƒe ŋkɔ ɖe ame siwo nyam la dome, nenema kee nye Filistia kple Tiro hekpe ɖe Kus ŋuti, magblɔ be, ‘Wodzi esia le Zion.’ ”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Vavã, woagblɔ le Zion ŋu be, “Wodzi esia kple ekemɛ le afi ma, eye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ŋutɔ aɖo egɔme anyi.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Yehowa aŋlɔ ɖe dukɔwo ƒe agbalẽ me be, “Wodzi esia le Zion.” Sela

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Ne wole ha dzim la, woadzi ha be, “Nye agunuwo katã le mewò.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Mawu si ɖem, mele ɣli dom le ŋkuwò me zã kple keli.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Nye gbedodoɖa nede gbɔwò, ƒu to anyi ɖe nye kokoƒoƒo ŋu,

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: elabena nye luʋɔ yɔ fũu kple xaxawo, eye nye agbe ɖo kudo nu.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Wobum ɖe ame siwo yi aʋlime la dome; mele abe ŋutsu si si ŋusẽ mele o la ene.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Woɖem ɖe aga da ɖe ame kukuwo dome, eye mele abe ame siwo wowu wole yɔdo me la ene, ame siwo dzi miagaɖo ŋkui o, eye woɖe wo ɖa le wò dzikpɔkpɔ te.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Ètsɔm de ʋe goglotɔ me, yi ɖe keke viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Wò dziku helĩhelĩ le dzinye vevie, eye nètsɔ wò ƒutsotsoewo tsyɔ dzinye. Sela

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Èxɔ xɔ̃nye veviwo le asinye, eye nètsɔm wɔ ŋunyɔnu na wo. Ètsɔm da ɖe xaxɛƒe, nyemate ŋu asi o,

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: eye nuxaxa wɔe be nye ŋkuwo dzi tsyɔ. O! Yehowa, mele yɔwòm gbe sia gbe, eye meke nye abɔwo me na wò.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Ɖe nàte ŋu aɖe wò nukunuwo afia ame kukua? Ɖe ame siwo ku la ate ŋu atsi tsitre akafu wòa? Sela

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ɖe woaɖe gbeƒã wò lɔlɔ̃ le yɔdo me kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le tsiẽƒea?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Ɖe woanya nu le wò nukunuwo ŋu le viviti me, alo le wò dzɔdzɔenyenyedɔwo ŋu le anyigba manyamanya dzia?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nu ka ta nègbem, eye nèɣla wò mo ɖem ɖo?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Tso nye ɖekakpuime ke, mekpe hiã, eye meɖo kudo nu, mekpe fu le wò ŋɔdzidodowo ta, eye dzi ɖe le ƒonye.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Wò dziku helĩhelĩ tsyɔ dzinye, eye wò ŋɔdzi gblẽ donyeme.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Woƒo xlãm ŋkeke blibo la abe tsiɖɔɖɔ ene, eye wonye tsyɔ dzinye.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Èɖe nye zɔhɛwo kple xɔ̃nyewo ɖa le ŋunye, eye vivitie nye xɔ̃nye si tsɔ ɖe gbɔnye.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Madzi ha le Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃ gã la ŋu ɖaa, matsɔ nye nu aɖe gbeƒã wò nuteƒewɔwɔ tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Maɖe gbeƒã be wò lɔlɔ̃ li ke tegbee, eye nèɖo wò nuteƒewɔwɔ anyi ɖe dziƒo ŋutɔŋutɔ.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Ègblɔ be, “Mebla nu kple nye ame tiatia, meka atam na David, nye dɔla be,

english_verse: David, one of your descendants will always be king.”
translation_verse: ‘Maɖo wò ƒome anyi tegbee, eye mana wò fiazikpui nali ke na dzidzimewo katã.’ ” Sela

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, dziƒowo le wò nukunuwo kafum, kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ hã le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe hame.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe adaŋudeha me la ŋɔdzi le Mawu ŋu ŋutɔ, ŋɔdzi le eŋu wu ame siwo katã ƒo xlãe.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Dziƒoʋakɔwo ƒe Mawu, ame kae ɖi wò? O! Yehowa, wò la, ŋusẽtɔe nènye, eye wò nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒo xlã wò.

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Wòe ɖu atsiaƒu ƒe agbodzedze dzi, ne ƒutsotsoewo le dzi dem la, ènana wodzea akɔ anyi.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Ègbã Rahab gudugudu abe ame siwo wowu la dometɔ ɖeka ene, eye nètsɔ wò abɔ sesẽ kaka wò futɔwo.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Dziƒowo nye tɔwò, anyigba hã tɔwòe; wòe wɔ xexea me kple emenuwo katã.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Wòe wɔ anyiehe kple dziehe; ne Tabɔr kple Hermon se wò ŋkɔ ko la, wodzia ha, tsoa aseye.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Woli wò fiazikpui anyi ɖe dzɔdzɔenyenye kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ dzi, eye lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ le zɔzɔm le ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo srɔ̃ ale si woakafu wòe, eye wozɔna le wò mo ƒe kekeli me, O Yehowa.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Wotsoa aseye le wò ŋkɔ me ŋkeke blibo la, eye wokpɔa dodoɖedzi le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Elabena wòe nye woƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ, eye to wò amenuveve me, nèkɔ míaƒe dzo ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Vavã, míaƒe akpoxɔnu nye Yehowa tɔ, miaƒe fia nye Israel ƒe Kɔkɔetɔ la.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Ɣe aɖe ɣi la, èƒo nu na wò ame kɔkɔewo le ŋutega me be, “Metrɔ ŋusẽ kɔ ɖe kalẽtɔ aɖe dzi; medo ɖekakpui aɖe ɖe dzi le nye amewo dome.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Meke ɖe David, nye dɔla ŋu, eye mesi ami nɛ kple nye ami kɔkɔe.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Nye asi alée ɖe asi, le nyateƒe me, nye alɔ ado ŋusẽe.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Futɔ aɖeke mazi edzi wòadzɔ ga nɛ o, eye ame vɔ̃ɖi aɖeke matee ɖe to o.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Mafanya eƒe futɔwo le eŋgɔ, eye maƒo ame siwo tso ɖe eŋu la aƒu anyi.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Nye lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la anɔ anyi kplii, eye woakɔ eƒe dzo ɖe dzi to nye ŋkɔ dzi.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Makɔ eƒe asi dzi ɖe atsiaƒu dzi, eye eƒe nuɖusi ɖe tɔsisiwo dzi.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ayɔm be, ‘Wòe nye Fofonye, nye Mawu, nye Agakpe kple Ɖela.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Matsɔe awɔ nye ŋgɔgbevi kple fia si wodo ɖe dzi wu le anyigbadzifiawo katã dome.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Malé nye lɔlɔ̃ nɛ me ɖe asi ɖaa, eye nye nubabla kplii mada le edzi akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Maɖo eƒe ƒome anyi tegbee, eye zi ale si dziƒo li la, nenema ke eƒe fiazikpui hã anɔ anyii.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: “Ne viawo gblẽ nye sewo ɖi, eye womewɔ nye ɖoɖowo dzi o,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: ne woda le nye sedede dzi, eye wogbe nye gbeɖeɖewo dzi wɔwɔ la,

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: gake nyemaxɔ nye lɔlɔ̃ le esi, alo ada le nye nuteƒewɔwɔ dzi o.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Nyemagbe nye nubabla la dzi wɔwɔ o, eye nyematrɔ nu si nye nu gblɔ la o.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Meta nye kɔkɔenyenye zi ɖeka hena ɣeyiɣiwo katã be, nyemada alakpa na David o.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Ke boŋ eƒe ƒome anɔ anyi tegbee, eye eƒe fiazikpui ali ke le nye ŋkume abe ɣe ene.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Gake ègbe, èdo vlo, eye nèdo dɔmedzoe ɖe wò amesiamina ŋu vevie.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ète fli ɖe nu si nèbla kple wò dɔla me, eye nèdo gu eƒe fiakuku, tsɔe ƒu gbe ɖe ke me.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Ègbã eƒe gliwo, eye nèwɔ eƒe mɔ sesẽwo wozu aƒedo.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã to afi ma la hae, eye wòzu alɔmeɖenu na eƒe aƒelikawo.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Èdo eƒe futɔwo ƒe nuɖusi ɖe dzi, eye nèna eƒe ketɔwo katã tso aseye.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Èna eƒe yi nu tsi, eye mèkpe ɖe eŋu le aʋawɔwɔ me o.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Èna eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe wu enu, eye nètsɔ eƒe fiazikpui ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Èɖe eƒe ɖekakpuimeŋkekewo dzi kpɔtɔ, eye nètsɔ ŋukpe tsyɔ nɛ abe avɔ ene. Sela

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣie? Ɖe nàɣla ɖokuiwò tegbea? Ɣe ka ɣi wò dziku abi abe dzo ene ase ɖo?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku ale si nye agbe le du dzii la dzi. Tofloko kae nye si, nèwɔ amegbetɔviwo na!

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ kae anɔ agbe, eye maku o, alo aɖe eɖokui tso tsiẽƒe ƒe ŋusẽ me? Sela

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, afi ka wò lɔlɔ̃ gã tsãtɔ le, wò lɔlɔ̃ si nye atam nèka na David le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ me la le?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, ɖo ŋku ale si woɖu fewu le wò dɔla ŋuti kple ale si nye dzi tsɔ dukɔwo ƒe vlodoame la dzi.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖo ŋku vlodoame si wò futɔwo tsɔ le alɔme ɖem le wò amesiamina ƒe afɔɖeɖe ɖe sia ɖe ŋuti la dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa tegbetegbee! Amen, ɛ̃, Amen.

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: Mose, Mawu ƒe ame ƒe gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: Yehowa, wòe nye míaƒe sitsoƒe le dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Hafi towo nava dzɔ, alo hafi nàwɔ anyigba kple xexea me, tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, wò koe nye Mawu.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Ènana amegbetɔwo gatrɔna zua kewɔ, eye nègblɔna be, “O! Amegbetɔviwo, mitrɔ zu kewɔ.”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Elabena ƒe akpewo le ŋkuwò me le abe etsɔ ŋkeke si va yi la ene, alo abe ŋudzɔɣi le zã me ene.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Èkplɔa amewo dzonae to ku me; wole abe gbe mumu le ŋdi me ene.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be emie le ŋdi yeyee hã la, le fiẽ me la, eƒu, eye wòku.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Wò dɔmedzoe la tsrɔ̃ mí eye wò dɔmedzoe do ŋɔdzi na mí.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ míaƒe vodadawo ɖo wò ŋkume kple míaƒe nu vɔ̃ siwo míewɔ le ɣaɣlaƒe la ɖo wò mo ƒe kekeli nu.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Míaƒe ŋkekewo katã nu va yi le wò dziku ta, eye míewu míaƒe ƒewo nu kple ŋeŋe.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Míaƒe agbemeŋkekewo le ƒe blaadre, alo blaenyi, gake ne ŋusẽ gale mía ŋutie nye ema, elabena woƒe didi nye fuɖename kple aɖukliɖuɖu; wo nu va yi kaba, eye míedzo.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Ame kae nya wò dɔmedzoe ƒe ŋusẽ? Elabena wò dziku nu sẽ abe ale si woavɔ̃ wòe ene.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Fia ale si míaxlẽ míaƒe ŋkekewo dedie la mí, ale be dzi si me dziƒonunya le la nasu mía si.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, bɔbɔ wò asi! Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi? Kpɔ nublanui na wò dɔlawo.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Tsɔ wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ɖi ƒoe na mí le ŋdi me, be míadzi ha kple dzidzɔ, eye míatso aseye le míaƒe ŋkekewo katã me.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Na míatso aseye, ɖe ŋkeke siwo katã nètu nu kpli mí kple ƒe siwo katã me nèhe fukpekpe va mía dzi la ta.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Na woaɖe wò dɔwɔwɔwo afia wò dɔlawo kple wò atsyɔ̃ afia wo viwo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ, míaƒe Mawu, na wò amenuveve nanɔ mía dzi, eye nàli ke míaƒe asinudɔwo na mí, ɛ̃, míaƒe asinudɔwo, nàna woali ke nyuie.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ame si nɔ Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe bebeƒe la agbɔ ɖe eme le Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe vɔvɔli te.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: Magblɔ na Yehowa be, “Eyae nye nye sitsoƒe kple nye mɔ sesẽ, nye Mawu si ŋu meku ɖo.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Vavã, aɖe wò le xevimɔtrela ƒe mɔ kple dɔvɔ̃ dziŋɔ me.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Atsɔ eƒe fuwo atsyɔ dziwò, àkpɔ sitsoƒe le eƒe aʋala te, eye eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ anye wò akpoxɔnu kple mɔxenu aƒo xlã wò.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Màvɔ̃ zãmeŋɔdzi alo aŋutrɔ si le ʋɔ lũm le ŋkeke me,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: dɔvɔ̃ si le tsatsam le viviti me, alo dɔxɔleameŋu si le nu gblẽm le ŋdɔ la o.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Akpe adze anyi ɖe axawò, eye akpe ewo ɖe wò nuɖusime, ke wò la, mate ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɖeko nàkpɔe kple wò ŋkuwo, eye àkpɔ ale si woahe to na ame vɔ̃ɖiwoe.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Ne ètsɔ Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la, Yehowa, ame si nye nye sitsoƒe wɔ nɔwòƒee la,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: ekema dzɔgbevɔ̃e maɖi kpe wò o, eye gbegblẽ mate ɖe wò agbadɔ ŋu o,

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: elabena ade se na eƒe dɔlawo tso ŋutiwò, be woakpɔ tawò le wò mɔwo katã dzi.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Woakɔ wò ɖe woƒe asiwo me, be màtsɔ wò afɔ axlã ɖe kpe aɖeke o.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Àɖo afɔ dzata kple ƒli dzi, eye ànya avuzi le dzata dziŋɔ kple da vɔ̃ɖi dzi.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Yehowa be, “Maɖee, elabena elɔ̃m, madzɔ eŋu, elabena enya nye ŋkɔ.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Ayɔm, eye matɔ nɛ; manɔ anyi kplii le xaxa me, maɖee, eye made bubu eŋuti.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Matsɔ agbe didi aɖi ƒo nɛ, eye maɖe nye xɔxɔ afiae.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Enyo be woakafu Yehowa, eye woadzi ha na wò ŋkɔ, o Dziƒoʋĩtɔ,

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: ne woaɖe gbeƒã wò lɔlɔ̃ le ŋdi me kple wò nuteƒewɔwɔ le fiẽ me,

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: ɖe ka ewo gakasaŋku kple kasaŋku ƒe gbe vivi nu.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, èna mekpɔ dzidzɔ le wò nuwɔnawo ta. Medzi ha tso aseye le wò asinudɔwo ta.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò dɔwɔwɔwo lolo loo, aleke wò susuwo me goglo ale?

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Numanyala menya esia o, eye bometsilawo mese egɔme o,

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: be togbɔ be ame vɔ̃ɖi tsi mlɔmlɔmlɔ abe gbe ene, eye nu tovo wɔlawo ƒo se hã la, woatsrɔ̃ wo gbidigbidi.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Ke wò, o Yehowa, woado wò ɖe dzi tegbetegbe.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Vavã, wò futɔwo, o Yehowa, atsrɔ̃ le nyateƒe me, eye nu vlo wɔlawo katã aka ahlẽ gbẽe.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Èkɔ nye dzo ɖe dzi abe to tɔ ene, eye nèkɔ ami nyuitɔwo ɖe dzinye.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo kpɔ ale si woɖu nye ketɔwo dzii, eye nye towo se ale si wonya avuzi le nye futɔ vɔ̃ɖiwo dzii.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo atsi abe ale si deti tsinae ene, woatsi akɔ abe Lebanon ƒe sedati ene;

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: ati siwo wodo ɖe Yehowa ƒe aƒe me, woatsi nyuie le míaƒe Mawu la ƒe xɔxɔnu.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Aleke gbegbe wotsii hã la, woaganɔ tsetsem, eye woƒe aŋgbawo ada ama, eye womalũ xɛ o.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Woaɖe gbeƒã be, “Yehowae nye dzɔdzɔetɔ; eyae nye nye Agakpe, eye vɔ̃ɖinyenye aɖeke mele eme o.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Yehowa le fia ɖum, eta gãnyenye, Yehowa ta gãnyenye, eye ŋusẽ le esi. Eli ke xexea me, maʋã o.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Woɖo wò fiazikpui anyi tso blema ke, eye nèli tso mavɔ me ke.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒuwo dze agbo, o Yehowa, atsiaƒuwo le ɣli dom, atsiaƒuwo dze agbo, eye woƒe tsotsoewo le ŋeŋem.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Ke ètri akɔ wu tɔsisi gãwo ƒe gbeɖeɖe, ètri akɔ wu atsiaƒu ƒe agbodzedze, ɛ̃, Yehowa le dziƒo tri akɔ.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Wò sewo le te goŋgoŋgoŋ; O! Yehowa, kɔkɔenyenye ɖo atsyɔ̃ na wò aƒe ɣeawo katã ɣi.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, Mawu si biaa hlɔ̃, O! Mawu si biaa hlɔ̃, klẽ.

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Tso, o xexea me ƒe Ʋɔnudrɔ̃la, ɖo nu si dadalawo wɔ la teƒe na wo.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi ame vɔ̃ɖi la atso aseye?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Wole nya tovowo gblɔm, eye dada yɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã me fũu.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wogbã wò dukɔ la nyanyanya, wote wò domenyinu la ɖe to.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Wowu ahosiwo kple amedzrowo, eye wowu tsyɔ̃eviwo hã.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Wogblɔ be, “Yehowa mele ekpɔm o, Yakob ƒe Mawu la metsɔ ɖeke le eme o.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: Mikpɔ nyuie, mi gegeme siwo le dukɔ la me, mi bometsilawo, ɣe ka ɣi miadze nunya?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Ɖe eya ame si wɔ to la mase nu oa? Ɖe eya ame si wɔ ŋku la makpɔ nu oa?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Ɖe eya ame si hea to na dukɔwo la mahe to oa? Ɖe eya ame si fiaa nu ame la, ahiã na nunya?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Yehowa nya amegbetɔ ƒe susu, eye wònya be tofloko ko wònye.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: O, Yehowa, woayra ame si nèhe to na, ame si nèfia nui tso wò se la me,

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: eye nèna gbɔdzɔe tso dzɔgbevɔ̃eŋkekewo me, va se ɖe esime wòɖe ʋe na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa magbe eƒe dukɔ la o, eye magblẽ eƒe domenyinu ɖi o.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Woagaɖo ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ anyi ɖe dzɔdzɔenyenye dzi, eye ame siwo katã ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka la adze eyome.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Ame ka atso ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ŋu nam? Ame ka atsi tsitre ɖe nu tovo wɔlawo ŋu ɖe nunye?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Ɖe menye Yehowae kpe ɖe ŋunye o la, anye ne eteƒe madidi o la, manɔ ɖoɖoezizi me le tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Esi medo ɣli be, “Nye afɔ le ɖiɖim” la, wò lɔlɔ̃, O! Yehowa, de megbe nam.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Esi dzitsitsi yɔ menye la, wò akɔfaname he dzidzɔ vɛ na nye luʋɔ.

english_verse: who gang up to murder innocent victims.
translation_verse: Wowɔa ɖeka ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu, eye wotsoa kufia na ame maɖifɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Gake Yehowae nye nye mɔ sesẽ, nye Mawu kple agakpe si nye nye sitsoƒe.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Aɖo woƒe nu vɔ̃wo teƒe na wo, eye wòatsrɔ̃ wo le woƒe vɔ̃ɖinyenye ta, ɛ̃, Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu la atsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Miva, mina míatso aseye ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye míado dzidzɔɣli ɖe míaƒe xɔxɔ ƒe Agakpe la ŋu.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Mina míado ɖe eŋkume kple akpedada, eye míadoe ɖe dzi to saŋku kple hadzidzi me.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowae nye Mawu gã la, eye wònye fiagã si ƒo mawuwo katã ta.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Anyigba ƒe gogloƒewo le eƒe asi me, eye towo ƒe tsutsueƒe ke hã nye etɔ.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu hã nye etɔ, elabena eyae wɔe, eye eƒe asie wɔ anyigba ƒuƒui hã.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Elabena eyae nye míaƒe Mawu, eye míenye amewo le eƒe lãnyiƒe, kple lãha le eƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te. Egbe, ne miese eƒe gbe la,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: migasẽ miaƒe dzi me abe ale si miewɔ le Meriba kple ale si miewɔ gbe ma gbe le Masa le gbea dzi ene o.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Afi mae mia fofowo, togbɔ be wokpɔ nu si mewɔ hã la, wodom kpɔ, eye wotem kpɔ le.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Medo dɔmedzoe ɖe dzidzime ma ŋu ƒe blaene sɔŋ, megblɔ be, “Wonye ame siwo ƒe dzi tra mɔ, eye womenya nye mɔwo o.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Ale le nye dɔmedzoe me, meka atam be, “Womayi ɖe nye dzudzɔ la me gbeɖe o.”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye na Yehowa; Mi anyigbawo katã, midzi ha na Yehowa.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Yehowa, mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ; miɖe gbeƒã eƒe xɔxɔ gbe sia gbe.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Miɖe eƒe Ŋutikɔkɔefia le dukɔwo dome kple eƒe nukudɔwo fia le anyigbadzitɔwo katã dome.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa lolo, eye wòdze kafukafu ŋutɔ; ele be woavɔ̃e wu mawuwo katã.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo nye legbawo, ke Yehowae wɔ dziƒowo.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Atsyɔ̃ kple gãnyenye le eŋgɔ, eye ŋusẽ kple ŋutikɔkɔe le eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la me.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: O! Mi dukɔwo ƒe ƒomewo, mitsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe kple ŋusẽ na Yehowa.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe si dze eƒe ŋkɔ la nɛ, eye mitsɔ vɔsanuwo va eƒe xɔxɔnuwoe.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Misubɔ Yehowa le eƒe kɔkɔenyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ me, eye anyigba katã nedzo nyanyanya le eŋkume.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Migblɔ le dukɔwo dome be, “Yehowae le fia ɖum.” Eɖo xexea me gɔme anyi goŋgoŋgoŋ, mate ŋu aʋã o; eye adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu amewo ameŋkumemakpɔmakpɔtɔe.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Mina dziƒowo natso aseye, anyigba nekpɔ dzidzɔ, atsiaƒu kple emenuwo katã neɖe gbe,

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: eye gbegbe kple emenuwo katã netso aseye. Ekema avemetiwo adzi ha atso aseye;

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: woadzi ha le Yehowa ŋgɔ, elabena egbɔna, eye wògbɔna ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge. Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea me le dzɔdzɔenyenye me kple dukɔwo le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Yehowa le fia ɖum, anyigba nekpɔ dzidzɔ, eye ƒutadu siwo le didiƒe ke la netso aseye.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Lilikpowo kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi ƒo xlãe, eye dzɔdzɔenyenye kple afia nyui tsotso nye eƒe fiazikpui ƒe gɔmeɖokpe.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Dzo le bibim le eŋgɔ, eye wòle eƒe futɔwo fiam le akpa sia akpa.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzikedzo si akaɖi ɖe xexea me, eye anyigba kpɔe heʋuʋu heyeheye.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Towo lolo abe yɔkumi ene le Yehowa ŋgɔ, ɛ̃, le anyigba ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋkume.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Dziƒowo le gbeƒã ɖem eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye, eye dukɔwo katã kpɔ eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋukpe lé aklamakpakpɛsubɔlawo katã, ame siwo tsɔa legbawo ƒoa adegbee, ke misubɔe, mi mawuwo katã!

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Zion see, dzi dzɔe, eye Yuda ƒe kɔƒewo hã tso aseye le wò afia nyui tsotsowo ta, o Yehowa.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò koe nye Dziƒoʋĩtɔ ɖe anyigba la katã dzi, eye wodo wò ɖe dzi gbɔ mawuwo katã ta sãsãsã.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo lɔ̃a Yehowa la, mitsri vɔ̃, elabena edzɔa etɔ siwo wɔa nuteƒe la ƒe agbe ŋuti, eye wòɖea woƒe agbe tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Kekeli klẽna ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo dzi, eye dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ yɔa ame siwo ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka la ƒe dziwo me.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Mi ame dzɔdzɔewo, mitso aseye le Yehowa me, eye mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Midzi ha yeye na Yehowa, elabena ewɔ nu dzɔatsuwo; eƒe nuɖusi kple eƒe abɔ kɔkɔe la wɔ ɖeɖedɔ nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa na wonya eƒe ɖeɖe, eye wòklo nu le eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye dzi na dukɔwo.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Eɖo ŋku eƒe lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ dzi na Israel ƒe aƒe la, eye anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke hã kpɔ míaƒe Mawu la ƒe ɖeɖe.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mi anyigbawo katã, mido dzidzɔɣli na Yehowa, migli kple hadzidzi kple saŋkuƒoƒo.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Yehowa kple kasaŋku, mitsɔ kasaŋku, hadzidzi,

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: kpẽkuku kple lãdzokuku kpakple dzidzɔɣli do ɖe Yehowa, fia la ŋkume.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Mina atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme la nado ɣli, anyigba kple edzinɔlawo katã hã.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Mina tɔsisiwo naƒo asikpe, eye towo katã nadzi ha ɖekae le dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ta.

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: Wonedzi ha le Yehowa ŋkume, elabena eva ʋɔnu drɔ̃ ge anyigba la. Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu anyigba la le dzɔdzɔenyenye me kple dukɔwo ameŋkumemakpɔmakpɔtɔe.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Yehowa le fia ɖum, dukɔwo nedzo nyanyanya, enɔ eƒe fiazikpui dzi gli le kerubiwo dome, anyigba neʋuʋu.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Yehowa nye gã le Zion, ekɔ gbɔ dukɔwo katã ta.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Wonekafu wò ŋkɔ gã, dziŋɔ la, eya amea le kɔkɔe.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Fia la nye ŋusẽtɔ, elɔ̃a afia nyui tsotso, wò la, èɖo dzɔdzɔenyenye anyi, eye nèwɔ nu si le dzɔdzɔe le Yakob me.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Mido Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu la ɖe dzi, eye mide ta agu ɖe eƒe afɔ nu, elabena eya amea le kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mose kple Aron le eƒe nunɔlawo dome; Samuel le ame siwo yɔ eƒe ŋkɔ la dome; woyɔ Yehowa ŋkɔ, eye wòtɔ na wo.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu na wo tso lilikpo dodo me, eye wolé se kple ɖoɖo siwo wòtsɔ na wo la me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu, wòe tɔ na wo; togbɔ be èhe to na wo le woƒe nu tovowo ta hã la, ènye tsɔtsɔke ƒe Mawu na Israel.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Mido Yehowa, miaƒe Mawu la ɖe dzi, eye misubɔe le eƒe to kɔkɔe la dzi, elabena Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu la le kɔkɔe.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Mi anyigbawo katã, mido dzidzɔɣli ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Misubɔ Yehowa kple dzidzɔ, eye mitsɔ aseyetsohawo do ɖe eŋkume.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Minyae be Yehowae nye Mawu. Eyae wɔ mí, eye míenye etɔ, eƒe amewo kple alẽwo le eƒe lãnyiƒe míenye.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Mige ɖe eƒe agbowo me kple akpedada, eƒe xɔxɔnuwo kple kafukafu; mida akpe nɛ, eye mikafu eƒe eŋkɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa nyo, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa; nenema kee eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ hã nɔa anyi tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, madzi ha le wò lɔlɔ̃ kple afia nyui tsotso ŋuti, eye madzi kafukafuha na wò.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Makpɔ nyuie be menɔ agbe si ŋu mokaka mele o, eya ta gbe ka gbe nàva asrãm kpɔ? Mazɔ le aƒenye me kple dzi si ŋuti mokaka mele o.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Nyematsɔ nu si me vɔ̃ le la aɖo nye ŋkume o. Metsri xɔsemanɔsitɔwo ƒe nuwɔnawo, womalé ɖe ŋunye o.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Made ga nu na ame si ƒo ɖi ehavi ƒe ŋkɔ le bebeme, eye ame si ŋku gã le esi eye wòdana le dzi me la, eya nyematɔ ɖe egbɔ o.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Nye ŋku anɔ nuteƒewɔlawo ŋu le anyigba dzi, be woanɔ anyi kplim. Ame si fɔɖiɖi mele eƒe zɔzɔme ŋu o la, anye nye nunɔla.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Ame si nye ameblela la, manɔ aƒenye me o, eye ame si daa alakpa la matsi tsitre ɖe ŋkunye me o.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋdi sia ŋdi la, mana ame vɔ̃ɖi siwo le anyigba dzi la nazi ɖoɖoe. Maɖe nu tovo wɔla ɖe sia ɖe ɖa le Yehowa ƒe du la me.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, se nye gbedodoɖa, eye nye kokoƒoƒo hena kpekpeɖeŋu neɖo gbɔwò.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Mègaɣla wò ŋkume ɖem, ne mele xaxa me o. Trɔ wò to ɖe gbɔnye, eye ne meyɔ wò la, nàtɔ nam kaba.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Elabena nye ŋkekewo nu va yi abe dzudzɔ ene, eye nye ƒuwo xɔ dzo hẽe abe dzokpo ene.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Nye dzi xɔ abi, eye wòyrɔ abe gbe ene. Meŋlɔ nye nuɖuɖu gɔ̃ hã be.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Le nye ŋeŋe sesĩe ta la, meɖi ku zu ƒu ɖeɖe.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Mele abe ʋlukuku si le gbegbe ene, alo abe ʋlukuku si le gli gbagbãwo tome ene.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Mele ŋu le aba dzi, eye mele abe xevi si tsi akogo le xɔ tame ene.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Nye futɔwo le alɔme ɖem le ŋunye ŋkeke blibo la, eye ame siwo tso ɖe ŋunye la tsɔ nye ŋkɔ wɔ ɖiŋudonui.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Elabena meɖu dzowɔ abe nuɖuɖu ene, eye metsɔ aɖatsi tɔtɔ nye nunonoe,

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: le wò dziku helĩhelĩ la ta elabena èdom ɖe dzi, eye nètsɔm ƒu gbe ɖe adzɔge.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkekewo le abe fiẽ ƒe vɔvɔli ene, eye meyrɔ abe gbe ene.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò la èle fia ɖum tegbetegbe, eye wò ŋkɔxɔxɔ li tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Ke wò la àtso, akpɔ nublanui na Zion, elabena ɣeyiɣi de be nàve enu, ɛ̃, ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖi la de.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Elabena eƒe kpewo xɔ asi le wò dɔlawo gbɔ, eye eƒe ʋuʋudedi gɔ̃ hã ʋãa nublanuikpɔkpɔ le wo me.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo avɔ̃ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, eye anyigbadzifiawo katã ade bubu wò ŋutikɔkɔe ŋu.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa agbugbɔ Zion atso, eye wòado le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe me.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Aɖo hiãtɔwo ƒe gbedodoɖa ŋu, eye mado vlo woƒe kokoƒoƒo o.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Miŋlɔ esia ɖi hena dzidzime siwo ava dzɔ, ale be ame siwo womedzi haɖe o la nakafu Yehowa be:

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: “Yehowa kpɔ nu tso eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la, eye wòkpɔ anyigba tso dziƒo,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: be wòase gamenɔlawo ƒe ŋeŋe, eye wòaɖe ga ame siwo wotso kufia na.”

english_verse: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
translation_verse: Ale woaɖe gbeƒã Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ le Zion kple eƒe kafukafu le Yerusalem,

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: ne dukɔwo kple fiaɖuƒewo ƒo ƒu be woasubɔ Yehowa.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Eŋe nye ŋusẽ le nye agbemɔ dzi, eye wòɖe nye ŋkekewo dzi kpɔtɔ,

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: eya ta megblɔ be, “O! Nye Mawu, mègakplɔm dzoe le nye ŋkekewo ƒe titina o, wò ame si ƒe ƒewo li tso dzidzime yi dzidzime.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Le gɔmedzedzea me la, èɖo anyigba ƒe agunu anyi, eye dziƒowo nye wò asinudɔwɔwɔ.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Woatsrɔ̃, ke wò ya ànɔ anyi ɖaa; woanyunyɔ abe avɔ ene, eye àɖɔli wo abe avɔ ene ahatsɔ wo aƒu gbe.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, ègale ale si nènɔ, eye wò ƒewo mawu enu akpɔ o.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Wò dɔlawo ƒe viwo anɔ ŋkuwò me, eye woaɖo woƒe dzidzimeviwo anyi le ŋkuwò me.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: O! Nye luʋɔ, kafu Yehowa; nu siwo katã le menye la, mikafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: O! Nye luʋɔ, kafu Yehowa, eye mègaŋlɔ nu nyui siwo katã wòwɔ na wò la be o.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ wò vodadawo katã kea wò, eye wòdaa gbe le wò dɔlélewo katã ŋu.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖea wò agbe tso ʋe me, eye wòtsɔa lɔlɔ̃ kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ ɖɔna na wò.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔa nu nyuiwo ɖia ƒo na wò didiwo, ale be wò ɖekakpuinyenye gaɖoa yeye me abe hɔ̃ tɔ ene.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Yehowa lɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ, eye wòtsoa afia na ame siwo katã wote ɖe anyi.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ena Mose nya eƒe mɔwo, eye wòna Israelviwo nya eƒe nuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa nublanui, eye wòvea ame nu, medoa dɔmedzoe kabakaba o, eye lɔlɔ̃ bɔ ɖe esi.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Metsɔa nya ɖe ame ŋu ɣe sia ɣi, alo léa dɔmedzoe ɖi ɖikaa o.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Elabena abe ale si dziƒo kɔ tso anyigba gbɔe ene la, nenemae eƒe lɔlɔ̃ loloe na ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Abe ale si ɣedzeƒe didii tso ɣetoɖoƒe gbɔ ene la, nenemae wòte míaƒe dzidadawo ɖa tso mía gbɔe.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Abe ale si fofo ƒe dɔ me trɔna ɖe viawo ŋuti ene la, nenemae Yehowa kpɔa nublanui na ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ,

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: elabena enya ale si wowɔ mí, eye eɖo ŋku edzi be ʋuʋudedi ko míenye.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ ƒe ŋkekewo le abe gbe ene, edzena abe seƒoƒo le gbedzi ene;

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: ya ƒona toa edzi, eye meganɔa anyi o, womegaɖoa ŋku eteƒe gɔ̃ hã dzi o.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Gake tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, Yehowa ƒe lɔlɔ̃ li kple ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye nɔa anyi kple wo viwo ƒe viwo

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖo eƒe fiazikpui anyi ɖe dziƒo, eye eƒe fiaɖuƒe le wo katã dzi ɖum.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Mi eƒe dɔlawo, mikafu Yehowa, mi ŋusẽtɔ siwo wɔa eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu, eye miewɔa eƒe nya dzi.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, mi eƒe dziƒoʋakɔwo katã, mi eƒe dɔla siwo wɔa eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, mi eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo katã, le afi sia afi, le eƒe dziɖuɖu te. O! Nye luʋɔ, kafu Yehowa.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: O! Luʋɔnye, kafu Yehowa. O! Yehowa, nye Mawu, èlolo loo; èɖo atsyɔ̃, eye nèta gãnyenye.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Etsyɔ kekeli abe avɔ ene, ehe dziƒo me abe avɔgbadɔ ene,

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: eye wòɖo eƒe dziƒoxɔwo ƒe sɔtiwo ƒe agunu anyi ɖe woƒe tsiwo dzi. Etsɔ lilikpowo wɔ eƒe tasiaɖam, eye wònɔ ya ƒe aʋalawo dzi.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Yae nye eƒe dɔtsɔlawo, eye dzo ƒe aɖewo nye eƒe dɔlawo.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Eɖo anyigba anyi ɖe eƒe gɔmeɖokpe dzi, eya ta maʋã akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ gogloƒewo tsyɔ nɛ abe avɔ ene, eye tsiawo tɔ ɖe toawo tame.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Ke esi nèblu la, tsiawo si, eye esi nèɖe gbe la, wolé du tsɔ.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Wosi to towo tame, heva to balimewo, va ɖo teƒe si nètia na wo la.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Èɖo liƒo si dzi womate ŋu adze to o la na wo, eye womagakaka axɔ anyigba dzi akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ena tsitsetsewo kɔ ɖe agawo me, eye wosi to towo dome.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Wonaa tsi gbemelãwo, eye wotsia gbetedziwo ƒe tsikɔwuame nu.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Dziƒoxeviwo wɔa atɔ ɖe tsisisiawo to, eye wodzia ha le atilɔwo dzi.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Edea tsi towo tso eƒe xɔ dzigbemetɔ me; eƒe dɔ ƒe kutsetse ɖia ƒo na anyigba.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Ena gbe mie na nyihawo, eye wòƒãa nuku na amegbetɔ be wòaxa, ale wòna nuɖuɖu do tso anyigba la me na wo;

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: wain si doa dzidzɔ na ame ƒe dzi, ami si ana be eƒe mo nanɔ keklẽm kple abolo si alé eƒe dzi ɖe te.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Wode tsi Yehowa ƒe atiawo nyuie, Lebanon ƒe sedati siwo wòdo.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Afi mae xeviwo wɔ woƒe atɔwo ɖo, eye aŋɔɣi wɔ eƒe nɔƒe ɖe gbotiwo me.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: To kɔkɔwo nye gbemegbɔ̃wo tɔ, eye agakpewo tome zu bebeƒe na hlɔ̃madɛwo.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Ɣleti dea vovototo ɣeyiɣiwo dome, eye ɣe nya ɣeyiɣi si wòaɖo to.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Ètsɔ viviti vɛ, eye wòzu zã, ale lã siwo katã le ave me la doa go.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Dzatawo ɖea gbe na nuléle, eye wodia woƒe nuɖuɖu tso Mawu gbɔ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Ɣe dzena, eye wotrɔna dzona ɖamlɔa woƒe dowo me.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Tete ame do go yi dɔ me, yi ɖe eƒe dɔ gbɔ va se ɖe fiẽ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò dɔwɔwɔwo sɔ gbɔ loo! Èwɔ wo katã le nunya deto me, anyigba dzi yɔ fũu kple wò nuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒue nye ekem, elolo hekeke, lã siwo mele xexlẽme o la yɔe, nenema kee nye nu gbagbe bubuwo hã, suewo kple gãwo siaa.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Meliwo zɔa edzi yina, gagbɔna, eye afii mae boso si nèwɔ la hã le.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Esiawo katã le asiwò nu kpɔm be nàna nuɖuɖu yewo le wo naɣi.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Ne èna wo la, woƒonɛ ƒu; eye ne èʋu wò asi la, ètsɔa nu nyui ɖia ƒo na wo.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Ke ne èɣla wò mo la, ŋɔdzi léa wo, eye ne èxɔ woƒe gbɔgbɔ le wo si la, wokuna, trɔna zua kewɔ.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Ne èdɔ wò Gbɔgbɔ ɖa la, wodzɔna, eye nèwɔa anyigba ƒe ŋkume yeyee.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe nenɔ anyi tegbee. Yehowa nekpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ŋu,

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: eya ame si do mo ɖe anyigba dzi, eye anyigba dzo nyanyanya; eya ame si ka asi towo ŋu, eye wotu dzudzɔ.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Madzi ha na Yehowa le nye agbemeŋkekewo katã me, eye zi ale si mele agbe la, madzi kafukafuha na nye Mawu la.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Nye ŋugbledede nedze eŋu, esi mele dzidzɔ kpɔm le Yehowa me.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Ke nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo netsrɔ̃ ɖa le anyigba dzi, eye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo maganɔ anyi o. O! Luʋɔnye, kafu Yehowa. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, miyɔ eƒe ŋkɔ, eye miɖe gbeƒã nu siwo wòwɔ la le dukɔwo dome.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Midzi ha nɛ, midzi kafukafuha nɛ, miɖe gbeƒã eƒe nukunuwɔwɔwo.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Miƒo adegbe le eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ŋu, mina ame siwo dia Yehowa la ƒe dzi natso aseye.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Midi Yehowa, mibia eƒe ŋusẽ, midi eƒe ŋkume ɖaa.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Miɖo ŋku nukunu siwo wòwɔ, eƒe dzesiwo kple eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo dzi.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O! Eƒe dɔla Abraham ƒe dzidzimeviwo. O! Yakob ƒe viwo, ame siwo wòtia.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Eyae nye Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu la, eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ xɔ anyigba la katã dzi la me.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Eɖoa ŋku eƒe nubabla kple se siwo wòde na dzidzime akpewo la dzi ɖaa,

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: “Wòe matsɔ Kanaanyigba la na, abe wò domenyinu ene.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Ke esi wonye ame ʋɛ aɖewo ko, womesɔ gbɔ o, eye wonye amedzrowo le anyigba dzi la,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: wotsa tso dukɔ me yi dukɔ me, tso fiaɖuƒe ɖeka me yi bubu me.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Meɖe mɔ be ame aɖeke nate wo ɖe anyi o, le wo ta, wòka mo na fiawo be,

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: “Migaka asi nye amesiaminawo ŋu o, eye migawɔ nu vevi nye nyagblɔɖilawo o.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ena dɔ to ɖe anyigba la dzi, eye wògblẽ woƒe nuɖuɖukpɔtsoƒewo katã,

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: ke edɔ ŋutsu aɖe si woyɔna be Yosef, ame si wodzra abe kluvi ene la ɖe wo ŋgɔ.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Wode kunyowu afɔ nɛ, wode abi eŋu, eye wotsɔ gakɔsɔkɔsɔ de kɔ nɛ,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime nya si wògblɔ ɖi la va eme, eye va se ɖe esime Yehowa ƒe nya naɖo kpe edzi, be nya si wògblɔ la nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Fia la dɔ ame woyi ɖaɖee le game, eye dukɔ la dziɖula na ablɔɖee.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Etsɔe ɖo amegãe ɖe eƒe aƒe nu, eye wònye eƒe nunɔamesiwo katã dzikpɔla,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: be wòade dɔ asi na eƒe dɔnunɔlawo ale si dze eŋu, eye wòafia nunya eƒe dumegãwo.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Ale Israel ge ɖe Egiptenyigba dzi, eye Yakob nɔ Hamnyigba dzi abe amedzro ene.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa na eƒe dukɔ la dzi ɖe edzi, eye wòna wosɔ gbɔ fũu akpa na woƒe futɔwo,

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: ame siwo ƒe dzi wòtrɔ be woalé fu eƒe dukɔ la, eye woaɖo nugbe ɖe eƒe dɔlawo ŋu.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Edɔ Mose, eƒe dɔla kple Aron, eƒe ame tiatia ɖa.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Wowɔ eƒe dzesi gãwo le wo dome kple eƒe nukunuwo le Hamnyigba dzi.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Eɖo viviti ɖa, eye anyigba la dzi do blukɔ elabena ɖe wometsi tsitre ɖe eƒe nyawo ŋu oa?

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ena woƒe tsiwo trɔ zu ʋu, eye to esia me woƒe tɔmelãwo ku.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu, eye tagbatsutsu kple togbato ƒe ha gã aɖe va xɔ woƒe dukɔ la katã me.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Etrɔ woƒe tsidzadza wòzu kpetsi, eye dzikedzo kpe ɖe eŋuti le woƒe anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Eƒo woƒe wainkawo kple gbotiwo ƒu anyi, eye wòmu ati siwo le woƒe dukɔ me la ƒu anyi.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Eƒo nu, eye ʋetsuviwo va ƒo ɖi, nenema kee nye abɔ gbogbo aɖewo hã;

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: woɖu numiemie mumu ɖe sia ɖe le woƒe anyigba la dzi, eye woɖu nuku ɖe sia ɖe si le bo dzi hã.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Ke ekplɔ Israel do goe, wodo agba kple klosalo kple sika, eye ame beli aɖeke menɔ woƒe toawo dome o.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Egipte kpɔ dzidzɔ esi wodo go dzo, elabena Israel ƒe ŋɔdzi lé wo.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ekeke lilikpo ɖe wo dzi abe avɔ ene, eye wòna dzo wo be wòanye akaɖi na wo le zã me.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Wobiae, eye wòna tegliwo woɖu, eye wòtsɔ dziƒobolo ɖi ƒo na woe.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Eʋu agakpe la, tsi do na wo bababa, eye wòsi to gbegbe la abe tɔsisi ene.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Elabena eɖo ŋku eƒe ŋugbe kɔkɔe si wòdo na eƒe dɔla Abraham la dzi.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ eƒe dukɔ la do goe kple aseyetsotso, eƒe ame tiatiawo kple dzidzɔɣli.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Etsɔ dukɔwo ƒe anyigbawo na wo, eye nu si ame bubuwo ku kutri kpɔ la va zu domenyinu na wo.

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ale be woalé eƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi, eye woawɔ eƒe sewo dzi. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔ me nyo, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Ame kae ate ŋu aɖe gbeƒã Yehowa ƒe nu dzɔatsu siwo wòwɔ alo akafui wòade go?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo léa dzɔdzɔenyenye me ɖe asi, ame siwo wɔa nu si nyo la ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖo ŋku dzinye ne èle wò dukɔ la nu vem, va kpe ɖe ŋunye ne èle wo ɖem,

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: be nye hã makpɔ gome le wò ame tiatiawo ƒe dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ me, be makpɔ dzidzɔ kple wò dukɔ la, eye mawɔ ɖeka kple wò domenyinu la, akafu wò.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Esi mía fofowo nɔ Egipte la, womebu wò nukunuwo ŋu o; womeɖo ŋku wò dɔmenyo gbogboawo dzi o, ke boŋ wodze aglã le ƒu la to, le Ƒu Dzĩ la to,

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: gake eɖe wo le eƒe ŋkɔ la ta, be wòana woanya eƒe ŋusẽ triakɔ la.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Eblu ɖe Ƒu Dzĩ la ta, eye wòmie; ale wòkplɔ wo to ƒugɔme abe tagba ƒuƒui ene.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Tete woxɔ eƒe ŋugbedodowo dzi se, eye wodzi ha kafui.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
