translation_verse: Kasia woŋlɔ nu si wòwɔ la be xoxo, eye womelala xɔ aɖaŋu tso egbɔ o.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Le gbea dzi la, wodzro nu vevie, eye le gbegbe la, wote Mawu kpɔ.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Ale wòtsɔ nu si biam wole la na wo, gake eɖo dɔvɔ̃ ɖe wo dome.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Woʋã ŋu Mose kple Aron le asaɖa la me, ame si ŋuti wokɔ na Yehowa.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Anyigba ke nu mi Datan, eye wòɖi Abiram kple eyomedzelawo agbagbe.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Dzo va fia wo yomedzelawo, eye dzo ƒe aɖewo fia ame vɔ̃ɖiawo.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Wowɔ nyivi le Horeb to la gbɔ, eye wosubɔ legba si wowɔ kple ga.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe Ŋutikɔkɔe ɖɔli nyitsu si ɖua gbe.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Woŋlɔ Mawu si ɖe wo la be, Mawu si wɔ nu gãwo na wo le Egipte

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: kple dzesiwo le Hamnyigba dzi kple ŋɔdzinuwo le Ƒu Dzĩ la to.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Eya ta wògblɔ be, yele wo tsrɔ̃ ge. Ɖe Mose, eƒe ame tiatia la metsi tsitre ɖe gbagbãƒe la hexe mɔ na eƒe dziku helĩhelĩ la o la, anye ne etsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Wodo vlo anyigba dzeani la, eye womexɔ eƒe ŋugbedodo dzi se o.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Wolĩ liʋĩliʋĩ le woƒe agbadɔwo me, eye womeɖo to Yehowa o.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Eya ta wòdo eƒe asiwo ɖe dzi ka atam na wo be yele nana ge wo katã natsrɔ̃ ɖe gbea dzi,

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: woƒe dzidzimeviwo atsi dukɔwo dome, eye yeakaka wo ɖe anyigbawo dzi.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ Baal Peor ƒe kɔkuti ku kɔ na wo ɖokuiwo, eye woɖu nu siwo wotsɔ sa vɔ̃e na mawu siwo me agbe mele o.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe nu vɔ̃ɖiawo do dɔmedzoe na Yehowa, eye dɔvɔ̃ gbã gboo ɖe wo dome.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Gake Finehas tsi tsitre hetso nya me, tete dɔvɔ̃ la nu tso.

english_verse: Now he will always be highly honored.
translation_verse: Wobu esia dzɔdzɔenyenye nɛ hena dzidzime mavɔ siwo ava dzɔ.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Le Meriba tsiawo gbɔ, wodo dɔmedzoe na Yehowa, eye Mose kpɔ nya le woawo ta.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Elabena wodze aglã ɖe Mawu ƒe Gbɔgbɔ ŋuti, eye nya vlowo ge le Mose nu.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Wometsrɔ̃ ameawo abe ale si Yehowa de se na wo ene o,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: ke boŋ wotsaka kple dukɔwo, eye wosrɔ̃ woƒe kɔnyinyiwo.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Wosubɔ woƒe legbawo, esi zu mɔ me woge ɖo.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Wotsɔ woƒe ŋutsuviwo kple woƒe nyɔnuviwo sa vɔe na gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Wokɔ ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi, wo viŋutsuwo kple wo vinyɔnuwo ƒe ʋu, ame siwo wotsɔ sa vɔe na Kanaan legbawo, eye wotsɔ woƒe ʋu gblẽ kɔ ɖo na anyigba la.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: eya ta Yehowa do dɔmedzoe ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋuti, eye wònyɔ ŋu eƒe domenyinu.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wo de asi na dukɔwo, eye woƒe futɔwo ɖu fia ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Woƒe futɔwo te wo ɖe to, eye wotsɔ wo de woƒe ŋusẽ te.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Eɖe wo zi geɖe, gake woɖoe kplikpaa be yewoadze aglã, eye wovɔ le eme keŋkeŋ le woƒe nu vɔ̃ me.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Ke ekpɔ woƒe hiã la ɖa, esi wòse woƒe ɣlidodo;

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Ena ame siwo katã ɖe aboyo wo la kpɔ nublanui na wo.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu, ɖe mí, eye nàƒo mía nu ƒu tso dukɔwo dome, be míada akpe na wò ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la, eye míaƒo adegbe le wò kafukafu ŋu.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, Israel ƒe Mawu la, tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Dukɔ blibo la nàgblɔ be, “Amen!” Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena enyo, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Ame siwo Yehowa ɖe la negblɔ esia; ame siwo wòɖe tso futɔ la ƒe asi me,

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: ame siwo nu wòƒo ƒui tso anyigbawo dzi, tso ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, anyiehe kple dziehe.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo tsa tsaglãla le gbedzi kple gbedadaƒo, eye womekpɔ mɔ si woato ayi du aɖe si me woanɔ la o.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Dɔ kple tsikɔ wu wo, eye nu te woƒe luʋɔ ŋu le wo me.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli yɔ Yehowa le woƒe xaxa la me, eye wòɖe wo le woƒe hiã la me.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Ekplɔ wo tẽe yi ɖe du aɖe si me woanɔ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woneda akpe na Yehowa le eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ta kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔna na amewo la ta.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Elabena etsɔa nu nyuiwo ɖia ƒoe na ame siwo dɔ kple tsikɔ le wuwum.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo nɔ viviti kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖi me, gamenɔla siwo le fu kpem le gakɔsɔkɔsɔwo me,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: elabena wodze aglã ɖe Mawu ƒe nyawo ŋuti, eye wodo vlo Dziƒoʋĩtɔ la ƒe aɖaŋudede.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Eya ta wòtsɔ wo de asi na dɔ sesẽ wɔwɔ, womu sɔgɔsɔgɔsɔgɔ, eye ame aɖeke meli akpe ɖe wo ŋu o.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe xaxa la me, eye wòɖe wo le woƒe hiã la me.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Eɖe wo le viviti kple blukɔ tsiɖitsiɖitsiɖi la me, eye wòtso woƒe gakɔsɔkɔsɔwo.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woneda akpe na Yehowa le eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ta kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔna na amewo la ta,

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: elabena eŋe akɔbligbowo, eye wòlã gayibɔ ƒe gametiwo me.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Wo dometɔ aɖewo zu bometsilawo to woƒe aglãdzenuwo wɔwɔ me, eye wokpe fu le woƒe dzidadawo ta.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Wonyɔ ŋu nuɖuɖu ɖe sia ɖe, eye woɖo ku ƒe agbowo nu.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Wodo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe xaxa la me, eye wòɖe wo le woƒe hiã la me.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Edɔ eƒe nya ɖa, eye wòyɔ dɔ wo, heɖe wo tso tsiẽƒe.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woneda akpe na Yehowa le eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ta kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔna na amewo la ta.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Wonesa akpedavɔ nɛ, eye woaɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo afia to aseyetsohawo me.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Ame aɖewo le meli me zɔ atsiaƒu dzi, wonye asitsalawo le tɔ gãwo dzi.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Wokpɔ Yehowa ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo, wokpɔ eƒe nukudɔwo le atsiaƒu gɔme,

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: elabena eƒo nu, elɔ ahom kɔ ɖe ƒu la dzi, eye eƒe tsotsoewo dze agbo.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Woyi dziƒo boo, eye wogadze eme le gogloƒe ke, ale le woƒe agbe ƒe xaxa me, woƒe dzideƒo lolo gbana.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Wole mumum sɔgɔsɔgɔsɔgɔ, le nu klim abe ame siwo mu aha ene, eye womegale naneke gɔme sem o.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Tete wodo ɣli na Yehowa le woƒe xaxa la me, eye wòɖe wo le woƒe hiã la me.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Etsi ahom la nu wòzi ɖoɖoe abe dalĩ dom wole ene, eye ƒutsotsoeawo hã ɖo to kpoo.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Wokpɔ dzidzɔ esi wòdze kɔ anyi, eye wòkplɔ wo va se ɖe esime wova ɖo afi si wodi be yewoanɔ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Woneda akpe na Yehowa le eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ta kple eƒe nukudɔ siwo wòwɔna na amewo la ta.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Wonedoe ɖe dzi le dukɔ la ƒe ƒuƒoƒo me, eye woakafui le dumegãwo ƒe takpekpe me.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Etrɔ tɔsisiwo wozu gbegbe kple tsidzɔƒewo wozu kuɖiɖinyigba,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: eye agbledeƒe zu dzeƒi le ame siwo le teƒe ma ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Etrɔ gbegbe wòzu tɔʋu, eye kuɖiɖinyigba zu tsidzɔƒe;

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: afi mae wòkplɔ dɔwuitɔwo be woava nɔ, eye wotso du si me woanɔ.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Woƒã nukuwo ɖe agble me, wode waingblewo, eye wotse ku geɖe hena xaxa.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Eyra wo, eye woƒe xexlẽme dzi ɖe edzi ŋutɔ. Nenema ke mena woƒe lãhawo dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ o.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Tete wozu ʋɛ, wobɔbɔ wo ɖe anyi le teteɖeanyi, dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple nuxaxa me;

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: eye eya ame si trɔa vlododo kɔna ɖe ame ŋkutawo dzi la, wɔe be wole tsaglãla tsam le gbegbe afi si mɔtoƒe aɖeke mele o.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Ke ekɔ hiãtɔwo ɖe dzi tso woƒe hiã me, eye wòna woƒe ƒome dzi ɖe edzi abe lãhawo ene.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe kpɔe, eye wòkpɔ dzidzɔ, gake ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã mia woƒe nu.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame si nye nunyala la, neɖo to nu siawo, eye wòabu Yehowa ƒe lɔlɔ̃ deto la ŋuti.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, nye dzi le te goŋgoŋgoŋ. Madzi ha, aƒo saŋku kple nye luʋɔ blibo.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Saŋku kple kasaŋku, minyɔ! Manyɔ fɔŋli.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, makafu wò le dukɔwo dome, eye madzi ha le ŋuwò le anyigbadzitɔwo dome,

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: elabena wò lɔlɔ̃ de blibo, hekɔ wu dziƒowo, eye wò nuteƒewɔwɔ yi ɖatɔ lilikpowo.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, woado wò ɖe dzi agbɔ dziƒowo ŋu, eye na wò ŋutikɔkɔe naxɔ anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Ɖe mí, eye nàkpe ɖe mía ŋu kple wò nuɖusibɔ, be ame siwo nèlɔ̃ vevie la nakpɔ ɖeɖe.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Mawu ƒo nu tso eƒe kɔkɔeƒe la be, “Mama Sekem le dziɖuɖu me, eye madzidze Sukɔt Balime.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead nye tɔnye, Manase hã tɔnyee; nye gakukue nye Efraim, eye Yuda nye nye fiatikplɔ.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moab nye nye tsiletɔkpo, matsɔ nye atokota aƒu gbe ɖe Edom dzi, eye mado dziɖuɖuɣli ɖe Filistia ŋu.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Ame ka akplɔm ayi du sesẽ la mee? Ame ka akplɔm ayi Edom?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, ɖe menye wòe oa? Nu ka wɔ nègbe mí, eye mègadona kple míaƒe aʋakɔwo o?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Kpe ɖe mía ŋu ɖe míaƒe futɔwo ŋuti, elabena èna amegbetɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu mele nemi hã me o.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Ne Mawu le mía dzi la, míaɖu dzi, eye wòafanya míaƒe futɔwo ɖe eƒe afɔ te.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, wò ame si mekafu, mègazi ɖoɖoe o,

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ fulényawo ƒo xlãm; wotso ɖe ŋunye nanekemawɔmawɔe.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ fɔbubu nam ɖe nye lɔlɔ̃ teƒe, ke nye la, ame si doa gbe ɖa vevie lae menye.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ vɔ̃ ɖo nyui teƒe nam, eye wotsɔ fuléle ɖo nye lɔlɔ̃ teƒe.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Tia ame vɔ̃ɖi aɖe wòatso ɖe eŋu; eye na amenutsola natsi tsitre ɖe eƒe nuɖusime.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Ne wodrɔ̃ ʋɔnui la, woneɖe agɔdzedze nɛ, eye eƒe gbedodoɖawo nebu fɔe.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Eƒe ŋkekewo nenɔ ʋɛ eye ame bubu naxɔ eƒe amekplɔdɔ awɔ.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Viawo nezu tsyɔ̃eviwo, eye srɔ̃a nezu ahosi.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Viawo nenɔ tsaglãla tsam, anɔ nu biam; wonenya wo do goe le woƒe aƒe gbagbãwo me.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Fetɔ aɖe nexɔ eƒe nunɔmesiwo katã, eye amedzrowo neha nu siwo wòwɔ dɔ kpɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Ame aɖeke megave enu loo, alo akpɔ nublanui na eƒe tsyɔ̃eviwo o.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzidzimeviwo netsrɔ̃, eye woaɖe woƒe ŋkɔwo ɖa le dzidzime si gbɔna la me.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Woneɖo ŋku fofoawo ƒe vodadawo dzi le Yehowa ŋkume, eye womegatutu dadaa ƒe nu vɔ̃ ɖa akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Woƒe nu vɔ̃wo nenɔ Yehowa ŋkume ɖaa, ale be wòaɖe woƒe ŋkɔ ɖa le anyigba dzi,

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: elabena mebu dɔmenyowɔwɔ ŋuti kpɔ o, ke boŋ eƒo hiãtɔ, ame dahe kple ame si ƒe dzi gbã la ƒu anyi woku.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Elɔ̃a ɖiŋudodo, eya ta ɖiŋudodo neva eya ŋutɔ ƒe ta dzi; amewo yayra medoa dzidzɔ nɛ o, eya ta yayra nete ɖa xaa tso eya ŋutɔ gbɔ.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Etsɔ ɖiŋudodo do abe awu ene, wòge ɖe eƒe lãme abe tsi ene, eye wòɖo eƒe ƒuwo me abe ami ene,

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: eya ta netae abe avɔ ene, eye nebla ali dzi nɛ abe alidziblaka ene tegbetegbe.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Esia nenye fe si Yehowa axe na nunyetsolawo kple ame siwo gblɔa nya vɔ̃ ɖe ŋutinye.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, o Aƒetɔ Yehowa, wɔ nyui nam le wò ŋkɔ la ta, ɖem le wò lɔlɔ̃ si wɔa nyui la ta,

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: elabena hiãtɔ kple ame dahe menye, eye nye dzi xɔ abi le menye.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Nunye yi abe vɔvɔli le fiẽ me ene eye woʋuʋum abe ʋetsuvi ene.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Le nutsitsidɔ ta la, nye klowo zu belie, eye meɖi ku glaglaglã.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Mezu alɔmeɖenu na nunyetsolawo, eye woʋuʋua ta ne wokpɔm.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nye Mawu, kpe ɖe ŋunye, ɖem le wò lɔlɔ̃ la ta.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wonenya be to wò asi dzie nèwɔ esia.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Woaƒo fi ade ame, ke wò la àyra ame, ne wotso ɖe ŋunye la, ŋu akpe wo, ke wò dɔla ya atso aseye.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Nunyetsolawo ado vlododo abe awu ene, eye wòata ŋukpe abe avɔ ene.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye nu ado Yehowa ɖe dzi, eye le ameha gã la dome, makafui,

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: elabena etsi tsitre ɖe hiãtɔ la ƒe nuɖusime, be yeaɖe eƒe agbe tso ame siwo bu fɔ̃e la ƒe asi me.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Yehowa gblɔ na nye Aƒetɔ la be, “Nɔ anyi ɖe nye nuɖusime, va se ɖe esime matsɔ wò futɔwo awɔ wò afɔɖodzinui.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa adidi wò ŋusẽ ƒe fiatikplɔ ɖe edzi tso Zion, eye àɖu fia le wò futɔwo dome.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Wò aʋakɔwo alɔ̃ faa ade megbe na wò le wò aʋakpegbe. Ànɔ atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo kɔkɔe, si do go tso fɔŋli ƒe dɔ me ke la me, axɔ wò ɖekakpuimezãmu.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Yehowa ka atam, eye matrɔ eƒe susu akpɔ o, be “Wòe nye nunɔla tegbee, le Melkizedek ƒe ɖoɖo la nu.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ la le wò nuɖusime, agbã fiawo nyanyanya le eƒe dɔmedzoeŋkeke la dzi.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Adrɔ̃ ʋɔnu dukɔwo, eye wòali kɔ woƒe kukuawo, nenema ke wòagbã dziɖulawo le anyigba blibo la dzi.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ano tsi le tɔʋu si le mɔto la me, eya ta afɔ eƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. Mado Yehowa ɖe dzi kple nye dzi blibo le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe adaŋudeha me kple amehawo dome.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo lolo kpem; ame siwo wodoa dzidzɔ na la bua wo ŋuti.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Ŋutikɔkɔe kple atsyɔ̃ nye eƒe nuwɔwɔwo, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenye li tegbee.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Ena woɖo ŋku eƒe nukudɔwo dzi; Yehowa nye amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Enaa nuɖuɖu ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ, eye wòɖoa ŋku eƒe nubabla dzi tegbetegbe.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Eɖe eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ƒe ŋusẽ fia eƒe dukɔ la eye wòtsɔ dukɔ bubuwo ƒe anyigba na wo.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Eƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo le eteƒe, eye wodzɔ; nenema ke woate ŋu aka ɖe eƒe sewo hã dzii,

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: elabena wole te tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, eye wòde sewo le nuteƒewɔwɔ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye me.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Eɖo ɖeɖe ɖi na eƒe dukɔ, eɖo eƒe nubabla anyi tegbee, eye eƒe ŋkɔ le kɔkɔe; ŋɔdzi hã le eŋu.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Yehowa vɔvɔ̃e nye nunya ƒe gɔmedzedze, eye ame siwo katã léa eƒe sewo me ɖe asi la, gɔmesese nyui sua wo si. Eya tɔe nye kafukafu tegbee.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. Woayra ŋutsu si vɔ̃a Yehowa, eye wòkpɔa dzidzɔ vevie le eƒe sewo ŋu.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Viawo anye ŋusẽtɔwo le anyigba la dzi, eye woayra dzi dzɔdzɔetɔwo ƒe dzidzime.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu kple nu nyuiwo le eƒe aƒe me, eye eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye nɔa anyi ɖikaa.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Le viviti me gɔ̃ hã la, kekeli klẽna na ame dzɔdzɔewo, nenema ke wònɔna na ame si vea ame nu, kpɔa nublanui, eye wòwɔa nu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Nyui ava na ame si nyoa dɔ me, doa nugbana faa, eye wòwɔa eƒe nuwo to mɔ dzɔdzɔe dzi.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Vavã, maʋã akpɔ o; woaɖo ŋku ame dzɔdzɔe dzi tegbee.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mavɔ̃ na nya vɔ̃ sese o, eƒe dzi li ke, eye wòkana ɖe Yehowa dzi.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Mavɔ̃ naneke o, elabena dzi le eƒo; eye mlɔeba la, akpɔ eƒe futɔwo ta ɖa le dziɖuɖu me.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Ema eƒe kesinɔnuwo na ame dahewo fũu, eƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye li tegbee, eye woakɔ eƒe dzo ɖe dzi bobobo le bubu me.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi akpɔe, eye dzi akui, aɖu aɖukli, avɔ le eme keŋkeŋkeŋ. Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe dzimedidiwo azu tofloko.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. O! Mi Yehowa ƒe dɔlawo, mikafui, mikafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me ke.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ tso ɣeyiɣi si ɣe adze va se ɖe esi wòaɖo to ɖe afi si wòɖoa to ɖo.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Yehowa nye gã ɖe dukɔwo katã dzi, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe gbɔ dziƒowo ta.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Ame kae le abe Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu la ene, ame si nɔ anyi ɖe fiazikpui dzi le dziƒo,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: eye wòbɔbɔ be yeakpɔ dziƒowo kple anyigba ɖa?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Efɔ ame dahe ɖe tsitre tso ke me, eye wòfɔ hiãtɔ ɖe dzi tso dzowɔ me;

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: hetsɔ wo ɖo dumegãwo xa, ɛ̃, woƒe dumegãwo xa.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ame si na konɔ nɔa eƒe aƒe me, hekpɔa dzidzɔ abe viwo dada ene. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Esi Israel do go tso Egipte, esi Yakob ƒe aƒe la do go tso gbe bubu gblɔlawo dome la,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda zu Mawu ƒe kɔkɔeƒe, eye Israel zu eƒe fiaɖuƒe.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Atsiaƒu kpɔe, eye wòsi dzo, Yɔdan tɔsisi hã te yi megbe.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Towo ti kpo abe agbowo ene, eye togbɛwo abe alẽviwo ene.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: O! Atsiaƒu, nu ka ta nèsi ɖo, O! Yɔdan tɔsisi, nu ka ta nète yi megbe ɖo?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Mi towo, nu ka ta mieti kpo abe agbowo ene, eye mi togbɛwo abe alẽviwo ene ɖo?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: O! Anyigba, dzo nyanyanya le Aƒetɔ la ŋkume, le Yakob ƒe Mawu la ŋkume,

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: eya ame si trɔ agakpe wòzu tɔʋu kple agakpe sesẽ wòzu tsidzɔƒe.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Menye míawoe o, o Yehowa, menye míawoe o, ke boŋ ŋutikɔkɔe la nye wò ŋkɔ tɔ, le wò lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ ta.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Nu ka ta dukɔwo le gbɔgblɔm be, “Afi ka woƒe Mawu la le?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Míaƒe Mawu la le dziƒo, eye nu sia nu si dze eŋu lae wòwɔna,

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: gake woawo ya ƒe legbawo nye klosalo kple sika, eye amegbetɔ ƒe asiwoe wɔ wo,

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: eya ta nu li na wo, gake womate ŋu aƒo nu o, ŋku li na wo, gake womate ŋu akpɔ nu o;

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: to li na wo, gake womesea nu o, ŋɔti li na wo, gake womeʋẽa nu sena o;

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: asi li na wo, gake wometea nu kpɔna o, afɔ li na wo, gake womate ŋu azɔ loo, alo aƒo nu to ve me o.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wɔ wo la, anɔ abe woawo ke ene, eye nenema kee nye ame siwo tsɔ woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: O! Israel ƒe aƒe, ɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eyae nye wò kpeɖeŋutɔ kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: O! Aron ƒe aƒe, ɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eyae nye wò kpeɖeŋutɔ kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ, miɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eyae nye miaƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ kple akpoxɔnu.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖo ŋku mía dzi, eya ta ayra mí. Ayra Israel ƒe aƒe la, ayra Aron ƒe aƒe la,

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: ayra ame siwo vɔ̃a Yehowa, suewo kple gãwo siaa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Yehowa nana miadzi ɖe edzi, miawo ŋutɔwo kple mia viwo.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Yehowa neyra mi, eya dziƒo kple anyigba Wɔla.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Dziƒo kɔkɔtɔ nye Yehowa, Wɔla la tɔ, ke etsɔ anyigba na amegbetɔ.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Menye ame kukuwoe kafua Yehowa o, menye ame siwo zi ɖoɖoe le aʋlimee o;

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ke boŋ mí ame siwo doa Yehowa ɖe dzi fifia kple ɖaasi lae. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Melɔ̃ Yehowa, elabena ese nye gbe; ese nye avifafa be wonekpɔ nublanui nam.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Esi wòtrɔ to ɖe gbɔnye ta la, mayɔe zi ale si mele agbe.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Ku ƒe kawo blam, eye tsiẽƒe ƒe vevesese va dzinye. Hiã tum, eye nuxaxa va dzinye.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Tete meyɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ be, “O! Yehowa, ɖem!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Yehowa nye amenuvetɔ kple dzɔdzɔetɔ; míaƒe Mawu la yɔ fũu kple nublanuikpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa ame siwo fa tu le dzi me la ta; esi menɔ hiahiã gã aɖe me la, eɖem le eme.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: O! Luʋɔnye, gagbɔ ɖe eme, elabena Yehowa nyo dɔ me na wò.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wòe ɖe nye luʋɔ tso ku me, nye ŋkuwo tso aɖatsi si me, nye afɔwo tso anyidzedze me;

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: be mate ŋu azɔ le Yehowa ŋkume le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Mexɔe se, eya ta megblɔ be, “Wokaa hiãm ŋutɔ.”

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Eye le nye moya me, megblɔ be, “Amegbetɔwo katã nye aʋatsokalawo.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Aleke mawɔ aɖo dɔmenyo siwo katã Yehowa wɔ nam la teƒe nɛ?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Makɔ xɔxɔ ƒe kplu la ɖe dzi, eye mayɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe na Yehowa le eƒe dukɔ blibo la ŋkume.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Eƒe ame kɔkɔewo ƒe ku nye nu xɔasi le Yehowa ŋkume.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, menye wò dɔla vavã, wò dɔlae menye, wò subɔla ƒe viŋutsue menye, eye nèɖem tso nye gakɔsɔkɔsɔ siwo blam la me.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Masa akpedavɔ na wò, eye mayɔ Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Maxe nye adzɔgbeɖefe na Yehowa, le eƒe dukɔ blibo la ŋkume,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: le Yehowa ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnuwo, le mia dome, o Yerusalem. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Mi dukɔwo katã, mikafu Yehowa; midoe ɖe dzi, mi ame siwo katã le anyigba dzi.

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ na mí sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ, eye Yehowa ƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ li tegbee. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Mida akpe ne Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔ me nyo, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Israel negblɔ be; “Eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Aron ƒe aƒe la negblɔ be; “Eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Ame siwo vɔ̃a Yehowa la negblɔ be, “Eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Le nye vevesese me, medo ɣli yɔ Yehowa, etɔ nam, eye wòɖe gam.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Yehowa li kplim, eya ta nyemavɔ̃ o. Nu ka amegbetɔ awɔm?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Yehowa li kplim, eyae nye nye xɔnametɔ. Makpɔ nye futɔwo ta ɖa le dziɖuɖu me.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Enyo be woatsɔ Yehowa awɔ sitsoƒee wu, be woaɖo ŋu ɖe amegbetɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo katã ɖe to ɖem, gake le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me, metsrɔ̃ wo katã.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Woɖe to ɖem, gake le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me, metsrɔ̃ wo katã.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Woƒo kɔ ɖe ŋunye abe anyiwo ene, gake wo nu va yi kaba abe ŋuvedzo ene; ɛ̃, Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ mee metsrɔ̃ wo le.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Wotu asim do ɖe megbe, eye medze anyi kloe, gake Yehowa xɔ nam.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye nye ŋusẽ kple nye ha, eye wòzu nye xɔname.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Aseyetsotso kple dziɖuɣli le ɖiɖim le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe agbadɔ me be, “Yehowa ƒe nuɖusi wɔ nu dzɔatsuwo!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe nuɖusi le dzi bobobo! Yehowa ƒe nuɖusi wɔ nu dzɔatsuwo!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Nyemaku o, ke boŋ manɔ agbe, eye maɖe gbeƒã nu siwo Yehowa wɔ.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Yehowa he to nam vevie, gake metsɔm de asi na ku o.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Miʋu dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe agbowo nam, mage ɖe eme, eye mada akpe na Yehowa.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Esiae nye Yehowa ƒe agbo, afi si dzɔdzɔetɔwo ato age ɖe eme.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Mada akpe na wò, elabena èɖo tom, eye nèzu nye xɔname.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Kpe si xɔtulawo gbe la, eyae va zu dzogoedzikpe.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Yehowae wɔ esia, eye wònye nukunu le míaƒe ŋkume.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Esia nye ŋkeke si Yehowa wɔ, mina míakpɔ dzidzɔ, atso aseye le eme.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖe mí, o Yehowa, na wòadze edzi na mí dzro.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Woayra ame si gbɔna le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me. Míeyra wò tso Yehowa ƒe aƒe me.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye Mawu, eye wòna eƒe kekeli klẽ ɖe mía dzi. Mitsɔ miaƒe atilɔwo ɖe asi ne miage ɖe ŋkekenyuiɖulawo ƒe hame ayi ɖe keke vɔsamlekpui la ƒe dzowo gbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Wòe nye nye Mawu, eya ta mada akpe na wò; wòe nye nye Mawu, eya ta mado wò ɖe dzi.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena eƒe dɔ me nyo, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li tegbetegbe.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo kpɔtsɔtsɔ mele woƒe mɔwo ŋu o, ame siwo zɔna ɖe Yehowa ƒe se la nu.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo léa eƒe ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi, eye wodinɛ kple woƒe dzi blibo.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Womewɔa vɔ̃ aɖeke o; ke boŋ wozɔna le eƒe mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Èwɔ se siwo dzi wòle be woawɔ ɖo blibo la da ɖi.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: O! Ɖe nye mɔwo li ke sesĩe le wò sewo dzi wɔwɔ me la, anyo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Ekema ŋu makpem ne mebu wò sewo katã ŋu o.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Makafu wò le dzi dzɔdzɔe me, ne mele wò se dzɔdzɔeawo srɔ̃m.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Mawɔ ɖe wò sededewo dzi, eya ta mègagblẽm ɖi keŋkeŋ o. ב Beth

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Aleke ɖekakpui awɔ, be eƒe mɔ dzi nanɔ dzadzɛe ɣe sia ɣi? To agbenɔnɔ ɖe wò nya la nu mee.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Madi wò kple nye dzi blibo, eya ta mègana matra tso wò sewo gbɔ o.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Meɣla wò nya ɖe nye dzi me, be nyemawɔ nu vɔ̃ ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, woakafu wò ɖaa; fia wò sededewom.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nye nu axlẽ se siwo katã do tso wò nu me la afia.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Melé wò ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi dzidzɔtɔe, abe ale si ame kpɔa dzidzɔ ɖe kesinɔnu gbogbowo ŋu ene.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Mede ŋugble le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu, eye melé ŋku ɖe wò mɔwo ŋu.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Wò sededewo doa dzidzɔ nam, nyemaŋlɔ wò nya la be o. ג Gimel

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyui na wò dɔla, be manɔ agbe. Mawɔ wò nya la dzi.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Ʋu nye ŋkuwo be makpɔ nukunuwo le wò se la me.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Amedzroe menye le anyigba dzi, eya ta mègaɣla wò sededewo ɖem o.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Nu te nye luʋɔ ŋu, le wò sewo yometiti ɣe sia ɣi ta.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Èka mo na dadalawo, ame siwo woƒo fi de, eye wotra tso wò sewo gbɔ.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋukpe kple vlododo ɖa le ŋunye, elabena melé wò sewo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be dziɖulawo nɔ anyi ɖe teƒe ɖeka, eye wole ŋunye gblẽm hã la, wò dɔla ade ŋugble le wò sededewo ŋu.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Wò ɖoɖowo dzɔa dzi nam; wonye nye aɖaŋuɖolawo. ד Daleth

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Wotsɔm mlɔ anyigba le ke me, kpɔ nye agbe ta le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mexlẽ nye mɔwo fia, eye nèɖo tom. Fia wò sededewom.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Na mase wò sewo ƒe nufiafia gɔme; ekema made ŋugble le wò nukunuwo ŋu.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Nuxaxa na nye luʋɔ gbɔdzɔ; do ŋusẽm le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Ɖem le alakpamɔwo dzi, eye nàve nunye to wò se la dzi.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Metia nyateƒe ƒe mɔ, eye nye dzi ku ɖe wò sewo ŋu.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Meku ɖe wò sewo ŋu vevie, o Yehowa, eya ta mègana ŋu nakpem o.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Mele du dzi le wò sewo ƒe mɔ dzi, elabena èna nye dzi gbɔ ɖe me. ה He

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: O, Yehowa, fia ale si madze wò sededewo yomee lam, ekema malé wo me ɖe asi va se ɖe nuwuwu.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Na gɔmesesem, ekema malé wò se la me ɖe asi, eye mawɔ edzi kple nye dzi blibo.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Dam ɖe wò sededewo ƒe mɔ dzi, elabena afi ma mekpɔa dzidzɔ le.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Trɔ nye dzi ɖe wò sewo ŋu, ke menye ɖe ɖokuitɔdidi ƒe viɖe ŋu o.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Ɖe nye ŋku ɖa le nu maɖinuwo ŋu, eye nàɖe nye agbe le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Wɔ wò ŋugbedodo la dzi na wò dɔla, ale be woavɔ̃ wò.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋukpe si vɔ̃m mele la ɖa, elabena wò sewo nyo.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Mele wò sewo dim vevie ŋutɔ! Le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ta, ɖe nye agbe. ו Waw

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la neva gbɔnye; nenema kee nye wò xɔname hã le wò ŋugbedodo la nu,

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: ekema maɖo eŋu na ame si le alɔme ɖem le ŋunye, elabena meka ɖe wò nya dzi.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Mègaɖe nyateƒe ƒe nya la le nye nu me o, elabena meda nye mɔkpɔkpɔ ɖe wò sewo dzi.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mawɔ ɖe wò se la dzi ɣe sia ɣi, tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Mazɔ le ablɔɖe me, elabena medi wò ɖoɖowo yomemɔ.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Maƒo nu tso wò sewo ŋu le fiawo ŋkume, eye ŋu makpem o.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Wò sededewo doa dzidzɔ nam, elabena melɔ̃a wo.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Medo nye asiwo ɖe dzi na wò sedede siwo melɔ̃ la, eye mede ŋugble le wò sededewo ŋu. ז Zayin

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋku nya si nègblɔ na wò dɔla la dzi, elabena ètsɔ mɔkpɔkpɔ de menye.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Esiae nye nye akɔfafa le nye fukpekpe me, be wò ŋugbedodo ɖe nye agbe.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Dadalawo ɖua fewu le ŋunye faa, gake nyemetrɔ le wò se la yome o.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, meɖo ŋku wò blemasewo dzi, elabena mekpɔa akɔfafa le wo me.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Ŋɔdzi lém le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ta, ame siwo gbe nu le wò se la gbɔ.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Afi sia afi si medze la, wò sewo nyea nye ha ƒe tanya.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, le zã me la, meɖoa ŋku wò ŋkɔ dzi, eye malé wò sewo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Esia nye tɔnye gome, elabena mewɔa wò ɖoɖowo dzi. ח Heth

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wòe nye nye gomekpɔkpɔ, eya ta medo ŋugbe be mawɔ ɖe wò nyawo dzi.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Medi wò ŋkume kple nye dzi blibo, eya ta ve nunye le wò ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Melé ŋku ɖe nye mɔwo ŋu, eye metrɔ nye afɔ ɖe wò nuɖoanyiwo ŋu.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Maɖe abla, nyemahe ɖe megbe o, be mawɔ ɖe wò sededewo dzi.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be ame vɔ̃ɖiwo blam kple ka hã la, nyemaŋlɔ wò sewo be o.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Mefɔ le zãtitina be mada akpe na wò ɖe wò se dzɔdzɔeawo ta.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Menye xɔ̃ na ame siwo katã vɔ̃a wò kple ame siwo katã dze wò sewo yome.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, anyigba dzi yɔ fũu kple wò lɔlɔ̃, eya ta fia wò sededewom. ט Teth

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wɔ nyui na wò dɔla le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Fia nunya kple afia nyui tsotsom, elabena mexɔ wò sededewo dzi se.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Hafi woava aka hiãm la, metra mɔ, ke azɔ la, meɖo to wò nya la.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wò la, ènyo, eye nu si nèwɔ la hã nyo, eya ta fia wò sededewom.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be dadalawo tsɔ alakpa sisi ɖe ŋunye keŋ hã la, melé wò sewo me ɖe asi kple nye dzi blibo.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Woƒe dzi ku atri, eye megasea naneke o, ke nye la, mekpɔa dzidzɔ ɖe wò se la ŋu.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Enyo be woka hiãm, ale be mate ŋu asrɔ̃ wò sededewo.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Se siwo do tso wò nu me la xɔ asi nam wu sika kple klosalo akpewo. י Yodh

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Wò asie wɔm, eye wò asimee medo tso; tsɔ gɔmesese nam, be masrɔ̃ wò sededewo.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Na ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la nakpɔ dzidzɔ ne wokpɔm, elabena metsɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe wò nya la dzi.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, menya be wò sewo le dzɔdzɔe, eye le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye la me, nèka hiãm.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Na be wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la nanye nye akɔfafa, le ŋugbe si nèdo na wò dɔla la ta.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Wò dɔmenyo neɖiɖi ɖe dzinye, be manɔ agbe, elabena wò se lae nye nye dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Na ŋu nakpe dadala, le esi wòwɔ vɔ̃ ɖe ŋunye, nye nanekemawɔmawɔe; ke nye la, made ŋugble le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Na ame siwo vɔ̃a wò la natrɔ ɖe ŋunye, ame siwo se wò nuɖoanyiwo gɔme.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Na kpɔtsɔtsɔ manɔ nye dzi ŋuti ɖe wò sededewo ŋu o, ale be ŋu makpem o. כ Kaph

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Nu ti kɔ na nye luʋɔ le wò ɖeɖedidi vevie ta, gake metsɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe wò nya la dzi.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Nu te nye ŋkuwo ŋu, le mɔkpɔkpɔ na wò ŋugbedodo la ta. Megblɔ be, “Ɣe ka ɣi nàfa akɔ nam?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mele abe waingolo le dzudzɔ me ene hã la, nyemeŋlɔ wò sededewo be o.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi wò dɔla alala? Ɣe ka ɣi nàhe to na yonyemetilawo?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Dadalawo ɖe ʋe ɖi nam, nu si tsi tsitre ɖe wò se la ŋu.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Wò sededewo katã nye nu si dzi woaka ɖo; kpe ɖe ŋunye, elabena amewo ti yonyeme susumanɔmetɔe.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Esusɔ vie woɖem ɖa le anyigba dzi kloe, gake nyemeŋlɔ wò ɖoɖowo be o.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Le wò lɔlɔ̃ la ta, kpɔ nye agbe ta, eye maɖo to se siwo do tso wò nu me. ל Lamedh

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò nya la nye nya mavɔ, eli ke goŋgoŋgoŋ ɖe dziƒo.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Wò nuteƒewɔwɔ li le dzidzimewo katã; wòe ɖo anyigba gɔme anyi, eye wòli ke ɖaa.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Wò sewo gali va se ɖe egbe, elabena wòe nuwo katã subɔna.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Nenye ɖe wò se la menye nye dzidzɔ o la, anye ne metsrɔ̃ le nye hiãkame me.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Nyemaŋlɔ wò ɖoɖowo be o, elabena èkpɔ nye agbe ta to wo dzi.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɖem, elabena tɔwò menye, elabena medi wò ɖoɖowo ƒe mɔ.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo le lalam be woatsrɔ̃m, ke nye la, madzro wò sewo me.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: O, ale gbegbe mehelɔ̃ wò se lae! Medea ŋugble le eŋuti ŋkeke blibo la.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wò sededewo wɔm nunyalae wu nye futɔwo katã, elabena wole gbɔnye ɖaa.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Gɔmesese su asinye wu nye nufialawo katã, elabena medea ŋugble le wò ɖoɖowo ŋu.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Gɔmesese le asinye wu dumegãwo, elabena mewɔ ɖe wò ɖoɖowo dzi.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Meɖe nye afɔ ɖa le mɔ vɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe dzi, ale be mawɔ ɖe wò nya la dzi.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Nyemedzo le wò sewo gbɔ o, elabena wò ŋutɔe fia num.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Gɔmesese su asinye to wò sewo dzi, eya ta metsri mɔ gɔglɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe. נ Nun

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Wò nya la nye akaɖi na nye afɔ kple kekeli na nye mɔ.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Meka atam, eye meɖo kpe edzi be, wò se dzɔdzɔewo yome ko manɔ.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mekpe fu geɖe, eya ta o Yehowa, kpɔ nye agbe ta, le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, xɔ kafukafu si nye nu dzra ɖo ɖi la, eye nàfia wò sewom.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be metsɔ nye agbe ɖo nye asiƒome enuenu hã la, nyemaŋlɔ wò se la be o.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi la tre mɔ nam, gake nyemetra tso wò nuɖoanyiwo gbɔ o.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wò ɖoɖowo nye nye domenyinu tegbee, elabena wonye nye dzi ƒe dzidzɔ.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Nye dzi ku ɖe wò sededewo dzi wɔwɔ ŋu va se ɖe nuwuwu. ס Samekh

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Melé fu susuevetɔwo, gake melɔ̃ wò se la.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Wòe nye nye sitsoƒe kple nye akpoxɔnu, metsɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ de wò nya la me.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Mite ɖa le gbɔnye, mi nu vlo wɔlawo, be mate ŋu alé nye Mawu ƒe sewo me ɖe asi!

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Lém ɖe asi le wò ŋugbedodo la nu, ekema manɔ agbe, eye mègana ŋu nakpem le nye mɔkpɔkpɔ me o.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Lém ɖe te, ekema makpɔ ɖeɖe, eye ɣe sia ɣi made bubu wò sededewo ŋu.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Ègbe nu le ame siwo katã tra mɔ tso wò sededewo gbɔ la gbɔ, elabena woƒe alakpadada nye nu dzodzro.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Ègbe nu le ame vɔ̃ɖi siwo katã le anyigba dzi la gbɔ abe gbeɖuɖɔ ene, eya ta melɔ̃ wò nuɖoanyiwo.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Nye lãme le ƒoƒom le vɔvɔ̃ na wò ta, eye nye mo wɔ yaa le wò sewo ta. ע Ayin

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Mewɔ nu si dzɔ kple nu si le eteƒe, eya ta mègaɖe asi le ŋunye na ame siwo tem ɖe anyi la o.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Kpɔ wò dɔla la ƒe dedinɔnɔ gbɔ, mègana dadalawo natem ɖe to o.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Nu te nye ŋkuwo ŋu le wò ɖeɖedidi ta.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Wɔ nu kple wò dɔla le wò lɔlɔ̃ ta, eye nàfia wò sededewom.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Wò dɔlae menye, eya ta na sidzedzem, be mase wò nuɖoanyiwo gɔme.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɣeyiɣi de na wò be nàɖe afɔ, elabena wole wò sewo tum.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Elabena melɔ̃ wò sewo wu sika kple sika nyuitɔ.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Eye esi mebu wò ɖoɖowo katã be wole dzɔdzɔe ta la, metsri mɔ gɔglɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe. פ Pe

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wò sewo nye nuku, eya ta meɖo to wo.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Kekeli vana ne woʋu go wò nyawo, eye nugɔmesese sua ame gblɔewo gɔ̃ hã si.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Meke nu ɖe te hele gbɔgbɔm fuxefuxe, le wò sewo dim vevie.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe ŋunye, eye nàkpɔ nye nublanui abe ale si nèwɔnɛ ɖaa na ame siwo lɔ̃a wò ŋkɔ la ene.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Na maɖe afɔ le wò nya la nu, eye mègana nu vɔ̃ aɖeke naɖu dzinye o.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso amewo ƒe teteɖeanyi me, be mawɔ ɖe wò ɖoɖowo dzi.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Na wò mo naklẽ na wò dɔla, eye nàfia wò sededewom.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Aɖatsi le sisim le nye ŋkuwo me abe tɔʋu ene, elabena womewɔ wò sewo dzi o. צ Tsadhe

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò la, dzɔdzɔetɔe nènye, eye wò sewo hã le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Nu siwo nèɖo anyi hã la le dzɔdzɔe, woaka ɖe wo dzi ɖikeke manɔmee.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Dzo si metsɔ ɖe ŋuwò la na megbɔdzɔ, elabena nye futɔwo gbe nu le wò nyawo gbɔ.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Wodo wò ŋugbedodowo katã kpɔ nyuie, eye wò dɔla lɔ̃ wo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be wodo vlom, eye nyemele ɖeke me o hã la, nyemeŋlɔ wò ɖoɖowo be o.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Wò dzɔdzɔenyenye li tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, eye wò se la hã nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Fukpekpe kple xaxa va dzinye, gake wò sededewo doa dzidzɔ nam.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wò nuɖoanyiwo le dzɔdzɔe ɖaa, eya ta na gɔmesesem, be manɔ agbe. ק Qoph

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mele yɔwòm kple nye dzi blibo, eya ta tɔ nam, eye mawɔ wò sededewo dzi.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Wòe meyɔ, xɔ nam, eye malé wò ɖoɖoawo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mefɔ hafi ŋu ke, eye medo ɣli be woaxɔ nam, ke metsɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe wò nya la dzi.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Nye ŋkuwo le te le zã blibo la katã me, be made ŋugble le wò ŋugbedodowo ŋu.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Se nye gbe, le wò lɔlɔ̃ la ta, O! Yehowa, ɖe nye agbe, le wò sewo ƒe ɖoɖo nu.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Ame siwo le nu vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖom la gogo, gake wodidi tso wò se la gbɔ.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ètsɔ ɖe gbɔnye ɖe! Wò sededewo katã hã nye nyateƒe.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Mesrɔ̃ nu tso wò se la me gbe aɖe gbe ke, be èɖo wo gɔme anyi be woanɔ anyi tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me. ר Resh

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Kpɔ nye hiãtuame ɖa, eye nàɖem, elabena nyemeŋlɔ wò se la be o.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Ʋli tanye, eye nàɖem, kpɔ nye agbe ta le wò ŋugbedodo la nu.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Ɖeɖe le adzɔge na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, elabena womedia wò sededewo ƒe mɔ o.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò nublanuikpɔkpɔ sɔ gbɔ, eya ta kpɔ nye agbe ta le wò sewo nu.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Futɔ siwo ti yonyeme la sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ, gake nyemetrɔ le wò ɖoɖowo yome o.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Menyɔ ŋu xɔsemanɔsitɔwo, elabena womewɔa wò nya la dzi o.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ale si melɔ̃ wò sewoe ɖa; eya ta o Yehowa, kpɔ nye agbe ta le wò lɔlɔ̃ la ta.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Wò nyawo katã nye nyateƒe, eye wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe sewo katã nye se mavɔwo. ש Sin kple Shin

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Dziɖulawo tia nye agbe yome susumanɔŋutɔe, gake nye dzi dzo nyanyanya le wò nya la ta.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dzidzɔ le wò ŋugbedodo la me abe ame si ke ɖe afunyinu gbogbo aɖe ŋu ene.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Metsri, eye menyɔ ŋu alakpa, ke melɔ̃ wò se la.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Mekafua wò zi adre le ŋkeke me, le wò se dzɔdzɔeawo ta.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Ame siwo lɔ̃a wò se la, kpɔa ŋutifafa gã aɖe, eye naneke mawɔ wo woakli nu o.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mele wò xɔxɔ lalam, eye manɔ wò sededewo yome.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mawɔ ɖe wò nuɖoanyiwo dzi, elabena melɔ̃ wo ŋutɔ.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Mawɔ ɖe wò sewo kple ɖoɖowo dzi, elabena nye mɔwo katã le nyanya na wò. ת Taw

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nye ɣlidodo nede gbɔwò, tsɔ gɔmesese nam le wò nya la nu.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Nye gbedodoɖawo nede gbɔwò; ɖem le wò ŋugbedodo la ta.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Nye nuyiwo negbã go kple kafukafu, elabena èfia wò sededewom.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Nye aɖe adzi ha le wò nya la ŋu, elabena wò sededewo katã le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Wò asi nenɔ klalo akpe ɖe ŋunye, elabena metia wò sewo.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò xɔname le dzroyem vevie ŋutɔ, elabena wò se lae nye nye dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Na manɔ agbe, ne makafu wò, eye na wò sewo nalém ɖe te.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Metra mɔ abe alẽ bubu ene. Di wò dɔla la, elabena nyemeŋlɔ wò sededewo be o.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Meyɔ Yehowa le nye xaxa me, eye wòtɔ nam.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖem, tso aʋatsonuyiwo kple alakpaɖewo ƒe asi me.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: O! Alakpaɖe, nu ka wòawɔ na wò, eye nu ka wòatsɔ akpee na wò?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Atsɔ aʋawɔla ƒe aŋutrɔ ɖaɖɛwo ahe to na wòe kpe ɖe yɔkuti ƒe dzoka xɔxɔwo ŋuti.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Baba nam be mele Mesek, eye mele Kedar ƒe agbadɔwo me!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Menɔ ame siwo lé fu ŋutifafa la dome wòdidi fũu akpa.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafamee menye, gake ne meƒo nu la, woawo kpea aʋa.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Mewu mo dzi ɖe togbɛawo ŋu, afi ka nye xɔname atso ava?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nye xɔname atso Yehowa, ame si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba la gbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Mana wò afɔ naɖiɖi o, eya ame si dzɔa ŋuwò la madɔ akɔlɔ̃e o.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Vavã, eya ame si dzɔa Israel ŋu la, madɔ akɔlɔ̃e loo, alo adɔ alɔ̃ o.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Yehowae nye tawòkpɔla, Yehowae nye wò vɔvɔli le wò nuɖusime

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: eya ta ɣe maɖu wò le ŋkeke me loo, alo ɣleti le zã me o.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Yehowa aɖe wò le vɔ̃wo katã me, eye wòakpɔ wò agbe ta.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Yehowa adzɔ wò vava kple wò dzodzo ŋuti, fifia yi ɖase mavɔmavɔ me.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Mekpɔ dzidzɔ kple ame siwo gblɔ nam be, “Mina míayi Yehowa ƒe aƒe me.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: O! Yerusalem, míaƒe afɔwo le wò agbowo nu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Wotso Yerusalem, eye nèle abe du si tsyia ɖe wo nɔewo nu ene.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Afi ma to vovovoawo yina, Yehowa ƒe toawo, be woakafu Yehowa, le ɖoɖo si wòna Israel nu.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Afi ma woɖo ʋɔnudrɔ̃zikpuiwo ɖo, David ƒe aƒe la ƒe fiazikpuiwo.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Mido gbe ɖa, abia ŋutifafa na Yerusalem be, “Ame siwo lɔ̃ wò la nenɔ dedie.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Ŋutifafa nenɔ wò gliwo me kple dedinɔnɔ le wò fiasãwo me.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Le nɔvinye ŋutsuwo kple xɔ̃nyewo ta, magblɔ be, “Ŋutifafa nenɔ mewò.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Le Yehowa, míaƒe Mawu la ƒe aƒe la ta, madi dzidzedze na wò.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Mewu mo dzi na wò, wò ame si ƒe fiazikpui le dziƒo.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, kpɔ nublanui na mí, O! Kpɔ míaƒe nublanui, elabena míenɔ te ɖe vlododo nu eteƒe didi.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Míetsɔ dadalawo ƒe alɔmeɖeɖe gbogboawo, eye míenɔ te ɖe ɖokuiŋudzelawo ƒe vlodoame gbogboawo nu eteƒe didi.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Ne menye Yehowae le mía dzi o la, Israel negblɔ be,

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: “Ɖe menye Yehowae le mía dzi o la, esi amegbetɔwo tso ɖe mía ŋu,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: eye woƒe dɔmedzoe bi ɖe mía ŋu la, anye ne womi mí agbagbee,

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: anye ne tsi ɖe mí hesi to mía dzi,

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: anye ne tɔ dzeagbowo kplɔ mí dzoe.”

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, ame si meɖe mɔ be woavuvu mí kple woƒe aɖu o.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Míesi abe xevi si do le mɔtrela ƒe mɔka me la ene; mɔka la tso, eye míesi dzo.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Míaƒe xɔname le Yehowa, dziƒo kple anyigba Wɔla la gbɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ɖoa dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu la le abe Zion to si meʋãna o, eye wònɔa anyi ɖikaa la ene.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Abe ale si towo ƒo xlã Yerusalem ene la, nenema Yehowa ƒo xlã eƒe dukɔ lae, tso fifia yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe fiatikplɔ manɔ anyigba si woka na ame dzɔdzɔewo la dzi o, ne menye nenema o la, ame dzɔdzɔewo ava tsɔ woƒe asi awɔ nu vɔ̃ɖii.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wɔ nyui na nu nyui wɔlawo, ame siwo ƒe dzi to mɔ ɖeka.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ke ame siwo trɔ ɖe mɔ gɔglɔ̃ dzi la, Yehowa atsɔ wo aƒu gbe, kpe ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo ŋu. Ŋutifafa nenɔ Israel dzi.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Esi Yehowa kplɔ aboyomeyilawo gbɔe va Zion la, míenɔ abe drɔ̃ekulawo ene.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Nukoko yɔ míaƒe nu me fũu, eye dzidzɔhawo yɔ míaƒe aɖewo dzi. Tete wogblɔ le dukɔwo dome be, “Yehowa wɔ nu gã na wo ameawo.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Nyateƒee, Yehowa wɔ nu gãwo na mí, eya ta dzidzɔ yɔ mía me.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, gaɖo míaƒe nunyonamewo te, abe tɔʋu si le Gbegbe ene.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
