translation_verse: Ame siwo ƒã nu kple aɖatsi la, axa nu kple dzidzɔhawo.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Ame si do go le nukuwo ƒãm kple aɖatsi la atrɔ agbɔ kple dzidzɔhawo, atsɔ lu bablawo agbɔe.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Ne Yehowa metu xɔ o la, etulawo le agbagba dzem dzodzro. Ne Yehowa medzɔ du la ŋu o la, dzodzroe dua ŋu dzɔlawo le ŋudzɔ.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Dzodzroe miefɔna kaba le ŋdi, henɔa agbagba dzem le nu si miaɖu la ŋuti va se ɖe fiẽ, ke ame siwo wòlɔ̃na la, enana wodɔa alɔ̃ ɖina ɖe eme.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Viŋutsuwo nye domenyinu tso Yehowa gbɔ, eye viwo nye fetu tso eya amea gbɔ.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu siwo ame aɖe dzi le eƒe ɖekakpuime la, le abe aŋutrɔ le kalẽtɔ si ene.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Woayra ŋutsu si ƒe daku me wole fũu. Ŋu makpe wo o, ne woawo kple futɔwo wɔ avu le agbo la me.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Woayra ame siwo vɔ̃a Yehowa, ame siwo zɔna le eƒe mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Àɖu wò ŋutɔ wò dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kutsetse, eye yayra kple dzidzedze anye tɔwò gome.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃wò anɔ abe wainka si tse kplanyaa la ene anɔ aƒewò me; viwò ŋutsuwo anɔ abe amitiɖɔmi ene le wò kplɔ̃ ŋu godoo.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Kpɔ ɖa, aleae woyraa ŋutsu si vɔ̃a Yehowa lae.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Yehowa neyra wò tso Zion le wò agbemeŋkekewo katã me, eye àkpɔ Yerusalem ƒe dzidzedze.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ànɔ agbe akpɔ viwòwo ƒe viwo. Ŋutifafa nenɔ Israel dzi.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Wotem ɖe anyi ale gbegbe tso nye ɖekakpuime ke. Israel negblɔ be,

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Wotem ɖe anyi ale gbegbe tso nye ɖekakpuime ke, gake womeɖu dzinye o.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Agbleŋlɔlawo ŋlɔ nye dzimegbe, eye woɖe boliƒowo wodidi,

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: gake Yehowa nye dzɔdzɔetɔ, etso kam tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe babla me.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Na be ame siwo katã tsri Zion la, nagbugbɔ ɖe megbe kple ŋukpe.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Na be woanɔ abe gbe si wotsɔ gbã xɔe ene, gbe si yrɔna, hafi ayi miemie ge.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ame siwo to afi ma yi la megagblɔ be, “Yehowa ƒe yayra nenɔ dziwò; míeyra wò le Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ me” o.

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mele koko ƒom na wò tso nye dzi me ke.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ, ɖo to nye gbe. Wò to nenɔ te nàse nye nublanuiɣli.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ne àlé amewo ƒe nu vɔ̃wo ɖe agbalẽ me ada ɖi la, O! Aƒetɔ, ame ka ate ŋu anɔ te?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ke wò la, tsɔtsɔke le gbɔwò, eya ta wovɔ̃a wò ɖo.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Mele Yehowa ƒe asinu kpɔm, nye luʋɔ le lalam, eye metsɔ nye mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe eƒe nya dzi.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Nye luʋɔ le lalam na Aƒetɔ la wu ale si zãɖialawo kpɔa mɔ na ŋu ƒe keke; mebe wu ale si zãɖialawo kpɔa mɔ na ŋu ƒe keke.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: O! Israel, tsɔ wò mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe Yehowa dzi, elabena lɔlɔ̃ matrɔ le Yehowa si, eye ɖeɖe blibo le eya amea gbɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Eya ŋutɔ aɖe Israel tso eƒe nu vɔ̃wo katã me.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: gake mena nye luʋɔ zi ɖoɖoe, heli kpoo abe ale si ɖevi si ɖi no la nɔa dadaa ƒe akɔnu ene, eye nye luʋɔ le abe ɖevi si ɖi no la ene.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: O! Israel, tsɔ wò mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe Yehowa dzi, tso fifia yi ɖase ɖe mavɔmavɔ me ke.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖo ŋku David kple fukpekpe siwo katã me wòto la dzi.

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: Eka atam na Yehowa, eye wòɖe adzɔgbe na Yakob ƒe Ŋusẽtɔ la be,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Nyemage ɖe aƒenye me, alo aɖamlɔ nye aba dzi o.

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: va se ɖe esime mekpɔ teƒe na Yehowa kple nɔƒe na Yakob ƒe ŋusẽtɔ la.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Míesee le Efrata, eye míedo goe le Yaar gbegbe be,

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: “Mina míayi ɖe enɔƒe, mina míade ta agu ɖe eƒe afɔɖodzinu ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, tso, ne nàva wò gbɔɖemeƒe, wò kple wò ŋusẽ ƒe nubablaɖaka la gbɔ.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Wò nunɔlawo nedo dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe awu, eye wò ame kɔkɔewo nedzi ha le dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ta.”

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Le David, wò dɔla ta la, mègagbe wò amesiamina la o.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Yehowa ka atam na David; eka atam vavã si matu o la be, “Matsɔ wò ŋutɔ wò dzidzimevi aɖo fiae ɖe wò fiazikpui dzi.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Nenema ke ne viwò ŋutsuwo lé nye nubabla kple nye se siwo mefia wo me ɖe asi la, ekema wo viwo anɔ wò fiazikpui dzi tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa tia Zion, eye wòtiae be wòanye ye nɔƒe be,

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: “Esia nye nye gbɔɖemeƒe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, afi siae manɔ fiazikpui dzi le gli, elabena nye ŋutɔe tiae.”

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Matsɔ nu nyui geɖewo ayrae, eye matsɔ nuɖuɖu aɖi ƒoe na eƒe ame dahewo.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mado xɔxɔ ƒe awu na eƒe nunɔlawo, eye eƒe ame kɔkɔewo adzi ha le dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ ta tegbetegbe.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: “Le afi sia, mana dzo nado na David, eye masi akaɖi aɖo anyi na nye amesiamina la.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Matsɔ ŋukpe ado na eƒe futɔwo, ke fiakuku si anɔ eƒe ta la, anɔ keklẽm.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Aleke wohenyo, eye wòvivinae, ne nɔviwo nɔ teƒe ɖeka le ɖekawɔwɔ me!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ele abe ami xɔasi si wokɔ ɖe ta me, eye wòtsra va kɔ ɖe ge me ene, ɛ̃, etsra kɔ ɖe Aron ƒe ge me hetsyɔ ɖe eƒe awu ƒe kɔme.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ele abe Hermon zãmue le dzadzam ɖe Zion to dzi ene, elabena afi mae Yehowa kɔ yayra kple agbe gɔ̃ hã ɖo tegbetegbe.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, mi eƒe dɔlawo katã, mi ame siwo subɔna le Yehowa ƒe aƒe me le zã me.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Mido miaƒe asiwo ɖe dzi le kɔkɔeƒe la me, eye mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. Mikafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, mikafui, mi Yehowa ƒe dɔlawo.

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Mi ame siwo subɔna le Yehowa ƒe aƒe me, le míaƒe Mawu la ƒe xɔxɔnuwo.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa, elabena Yehowa nyo; midzi ha na eƒe ŋkɔ, elabena esia vivina.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa tia Yakob be wòanye ye tɔ, eye wòtia Israel be wòanye yeƒe domenyinu xɔasi la.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Menya be Yehowa lolo, eye míaƒe Aƒetɔ la lolo wu mawuwo katã.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔa nu sia nu si dze eŋu le dziƒo kple anyigba, le atsiaƒuwo me kple woƒe gogloƒewo katã.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Enaa lilikpo hona tso anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke, edɔa dzikedzo be wòava kple tsidzadza, eye wòɖea yaƒoƒo ɖe go tso eƒe nudzraɖoƒewo.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Eƒo Egipte ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo ƒu anyi; amegbetɔwo kple lãwo siaa ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: O! Egipte, edɔ eƒe dzesiwo kple nukunuwo ɖo ɖe mía dome, ɖe Farao kple eƒe dɔlawo katã ŋu.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Eƒo dukɔ geɖewo ƒu anyi, eye wòwu fia sesẽwo.

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Ewu Sixɔn, Amoritɔwo ƒe fia, Ɔg, Basantɔwo ƒe fia kple Kanaan fiawo katã,

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: eye wòtsɔ woƒe anyigba wɔ domenyinu, na eƒe dukɔ Israel.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wò ŋkɔ li tegbetegbe, o Yehowa, èxɔ ŋkɔ le dzidzimewo katã me.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa atso afia na eƒe dukɔ, eye wòakpɔ nublanui na eƒe dɔlawo.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Dukɔwo ƒe legbawo nye klosalo kple sika, amegbetɔ ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo wonye.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Nu li na wo, gake womeƒoa nu o, ŋku li na wo gake womekpɔa nu o,

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: to li na wo, gake womesea nu loo, alo gbɔna to woƒe nu me o.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wɔ wo la anɔ abe woawo ke ene, eye nenema kee nye ame siwo katã ɖoa dzi ɖe wo ŋu.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: O! Israel ƒe aƒe, mikafu Yehowa, O! Aron ƒe aƒe, mikafu Yehowa,

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: O! Levi ƒe aƒe, mikafu Yehowa, eye mi ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la, mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa tso Zion, eya ame si nɔ Yerusalem. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Yehowa, elabena enyo. Eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na mawuwo dzi Mawu la, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na aƒetɔwo dzi Aƒetɔ la, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya ɖeka hɔ̃ɔ koe wɔa nukunu dzɔatsuwo, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya ame si tsɔ eƒe nugɔmesese wɔ dziƒowoe, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ame si keke anyigba ɖe tsiwo dzi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔ nu keklẽ gãwo, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Be ɣe naɖu ŋkeke dzi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Be ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo naɖu zã dzi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya ame si ƒo Egiptetɔwo ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwo ƒu anyi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔ Israel do goe le wo dome, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Kple asi sesẽ kple abɔ si wòdo ɖe dzi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya ame si ma Ƒu Dzĩ la ɖe eve, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eye wòkplɔ Israel to eƒe titina, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ke ekplɔ Farao kple eƒe aʋakɔ la de Ƒu Dzĩ la me, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya ame si kplɔ eƒe dukɔ la to gbedzi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒo fia gãwo ƒu anyi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eye wòwu fia sesẽwo, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Sixɔn, Amoritɔwo ƒe fia, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: kple Ɔg, Basantɔwo ƒe fia, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eye wòtsɔ woƒe anyigba wɔ domenyinu, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Domenyinu na eƒe dɔla, Israel, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya ame si ɖo ŋku mía dzi, esime wobɔbɔ mí ɖe anyi, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eye wòɖe mí tso míaƒe futɔwo ƒe asi me, elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Eya ame si naa nuɖuɖu nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mida akpe na Dziƒo Mawu la, Elabena eƒe lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babilonia tɔsisiwo toe míenɔ, hɛnɔ avi fam, esi míeɖo ŋku Zion dzi.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Míetsɔ míaƒe kasaŋkuwo ku amuti siwo le afi ma,

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: elabena afi mae ame siwo ɖe aboyo mí la bia ha tso mía si le; ame siwo wɔ fu mí la bia dzidzɔhawo tso mía si hegblɔ be, “Midzi Zion hawo dometɔ ɖeka na mí!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Aleke miadzi Yehowa ƒe hawo le dzronyigba dzi?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: O! Yerusalem, ne meŋlɔ wò be la, nye nuɖusibɔ nèŋlɔ eƒe ŋusẽ be,

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: eye nye aɖe nelé ɖe nye nu me, ne nyemeɖo ŋku dziwò o, ne nyemebu Yerusalem, nye dzidzɔ kɔkɔtɔ kekeake o.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖo ŋku nu si Edomtɔwo wɔ la dzi, gbe si gbe wogbã Yerusalem. Wodo ɣli be, “Mimui ƒu anyi, migbãe, va se ɖe eƒe gɔmeɖokpewo dzi ke!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: O! Babilonia vinyɔnu, woɖo wò ɖi na tsɔtsrɔ̃, woayra ame si aɖo nu si nèwɔ mí la teƒe na wò,

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: ame si alé wò vidzĩwo axlã ɖe agakpewo.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, makafu wò kple nye dzi blibo; madzi wò kafukafuha le mawuwo ŋkume.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Made ta agu do ɖe wò gbedoxɔ kɔkɔe la gbɔ, eye makafu wò ŋkɔ, le wò lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ ta, elabena èkɔ, wò ŋkɔ kple wò nya gbɔ nu sia nu ta sãsãsã.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Ètɔ nam esi meyɔ wò, eye nède dzi ƒo nam, hedo ŋusẽ nye dzi.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, anyigbadzifiawo katã akafu wò, ne wose wò numenya.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Na woadzi ha le Yehowa ƒe mɔwo ŋu, elabena Yehowa ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe lolo.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be Yehowa le dzi me ke hã la, ekpɔa ame dahewo gbɔ, ke edzea si dadala tso adzɔge.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Togbɔ be mele zɔzɔm le xaxa me hã la, èkpɔ nye agbe ta, eye nèkɔ wò asi dzi do ɖe nye futɔwo ƒe dɔmedzoe ŋu, hetsɔ wò nuɖusi xɔ nam.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Yehowa ana eƒe ta me si wòɖo ɖe ŋunye la nava eme. O! Yehowa, wò lɔlɔ̃ li ɖaa, mègagblẽ wò asinudɔwɔwɔwo ɖi o.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Ènya nye anyinɔnɔ kple nye tsitretsitsi, eye nènya nye susuwo tso adzɔge ke.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Ènya nye godoɣi kple nye anyimlɔɣi, ale nènya nye mɔwo katã nyuie.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, hafi nya aɖe nava nye aɖe dzi la, ènya nya la katã xoxo.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Ètsɔm ɖe tome, le megbe kple ŋgɔ siaa, eye nèɖo wò asi dzinye.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Nunya sia wɔ nuku nam akpa, nyemate ŋu aɖo afi ma o, elabena ekɔkɔ nam akpa.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Afi ka madzo le wò Gbɔgbɔ la gbɔ ayi? Afi ka masi atso wò ŋkume ayi?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Ne meyi dziƒo la, èle afi ma, ne meɖo nye mlɔƒe ɖe gogloƒewo hã la, èle afi ma.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Ne medzo yi yame le fɔŋli ƒe aʋalawo dzi, ne meyi ɖanɔ atsiaƒu ƒe mlɔenu ke hã la,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: wò asi akplɔm, eye wò nuɖusi além ɖe asi sesĩe.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Ne megblɔ be, “Vavã, viviti la ana maɣla, eye kekeli azu zã aƒo xlãm” la,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: viviti la gɔ̃ hã mado blukɔ na wò o, zã aklẽ na wò abe ŋkeke ene, elabena viviti le na wò abe kekeli ene.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Elabena wòe wɔ nye ememe ke; eye nèlém ƒo ƒu ɖe danye ƒe dɔ me.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Mekafu wò, elabena èwɔm ŋɔdzitɔe kple nukutɔe. Wò dɔwɔwɔwo nye nukunu, menya esia nyuie.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Nye ameti blibo la, mele ɣaɣla ɖe wò o, esi nèwɔm le ɣaɣlaƒe. Esi wolɔ̃m ɖe wo nɔewo me le anyigba ƒe gogloƒe la,

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: wò ŋkuwo kpɔ ale si menye ʋukɔe. Ŋkeke siwo katã woɖo nam la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe wò agbalẽ me hafi ŋkeke gbãtɔ dze egɔme.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, wò susuwo xɔ asi nam ŋutɔ! Wò susuwo sɔ gbɔ loo!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Ne mebe maxlẽ wo la, woasɔ gbɔ wu ke. Ne menyɔ tso alɔ̃ me la, megale gbɔwò ko.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: O! Mawu, negbe ɖe nàtsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo hafi! Mite ɖa le gbɔnye, mi hlɔ̃dolawo!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Woƒoa nu tso ŋutiwò kple susu baɖa, wò futɔwo wɔa wò ŋkɔ ŋu dɔ yakayaka.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖe nyemelé fu ame siwo lé fu wò, eye menyɔ ŋu ame siwo tso ɖe ŋuwò oa?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Fuléle koe le asinye na wo, eye mebu wo nye ketɔwoe.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Dzro menye, o Mawu, eye nànya nye dzi; dom kpɔ, eye nànya nye susu si tsi dzodzodzoe.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Kpɔe ɖa be mɔtatra aɖe le menye hã, eye nàkplɔm to mɔ mavɔtɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me eye dzɔ ŋunye le ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo ta,

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: ame siwo ɖoa nu vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe woƒe dzi me, eye wodoa aʋa gbe sia gbe.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Wonyre woƒe aɖewo wole ɖaɖam abe da tɔ ene, eye da ƒe aɖi le woƒe nuyiwo ŋu. Sela

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me, dzɔ nye agbe ŋu le ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo ta, ame siwo ɖo be woaɖe afɔ le tenye.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Dada tre mɔ da ɖe ɣaɣlaƒe nam, woɖo ɖɔ, keke eme da ɖi nam eye wotre azãwo da ɖe nye toƒe. Sela

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, megblɔ na wò be, “Wòe nye nye Mawu.” See, o Yehowa, se nye nublanuiɣli.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ Yehowa, nye Ɖela sesẽ, ame si ɖɔ gakuku nam le aʋakpegbe.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mègana ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe didi nava eme na wo o, eye mègana woƒe ɖoɖowo nadze edzi na wo o, ne menye nenema o la, woanɔ dadam. Sela

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Na fukpekpe si ame siwo ɖe to ɖem ƒe nuyiwo he vɛ la, nanye tsyɔ woƒe ta dzi.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Na dzoka xɔxɔwo nadza ɖe wo dzi; wonetsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe dzo me kple ʋe globowo me, eye womegafɔ akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ameŋugblẽlawo megali ke ɖe anyigba dzi o, eye gbegblẽ neva ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo dzi.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Menya be Yehowa tsoa afia na ame dahewo, eye wòxɔa nya ɖe hiãtɔwo nu.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo akafu wò ŋkɔ vavã, eye dzi dzɔdzɔetɔwo anɔ ŋkuwò me ɖaa.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, mele yɔwòm, va gbɔnye kaba. Se nye gbe, ne meyɔ wò.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Nye gbedodoɖa neva gbɔwò abe dzudzɔ ʋeʋĩ ene, eye na be nye asi siwo medo ɖe dzi la, nanɔ na wò abe fiẽvɔsa ene.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖo dzɔla nye nu ŋu, eye nɔ ŋudzɔ ɖe nye nuyi ƒe ʋɔtru ŋu.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Mègana be woahe nye dzi ɖe nu vɔ̃ɖi ŋuti, be mayi gome kpɔ ge le nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ me kple ŋutsu, nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔlawo o, eye mègaɖe mɔ be maɖu woƒe nuɖuɖu viviwo o.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Na ame dzɔdzɔe naƒom, enye dɔmenyo wòwɔ nam, na wòaka mo nam, enye ami wòsi ɖe ta nam. Nye ta magbe exɔxɔ o. Gake nye gbedodoɖa tsia tsitre ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe wɔnawo ŋu ɖaa,

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: woatutu woƒe dziɖulawo tso togbɛwo dzi aƒu agame, eye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo anya be megblɔ nye nyawo memie ɖe eteƒe.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Woagblɔ be, “Abe ale si ame ŋlɔa nu hedzoboa anyigbae ene la, nenemae woakaka míaƒe ƒuwoe ɖe yɔdowo nu.”

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: O! Aƒetɔ Yehowa, meda nye ŋkuwo ɖe dziwò, mewòe mebe ɖo, mègatsɔm na ku o.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Ɖem le mɔ siwo wotre nam la me, tso mɔkli si nu tovo wɔlawo ɖo ɖi la me.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo naɖo woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ɖɔwo me, ne matso eme ayi le dedinɔnɔ me.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Medo ɣli na Yehowa sesĩe, eye mekɔ nye gbe dzi na Yehowa be wòakpɔ nye nublanui.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Metrɔ nye nuxaxawo kɔ ɖe eŋkume, eye metrɔ nye vevesesewo kɔ ɖe eya amea gbɔ.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Ne nu ti kɔ na nye gbɔgbɔ le menye la, wò koe nya nye mɔ. Ŋutsuwo tre mɔ ɖe mɔ si metona la dzi nam.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Trɔ ɖe nye ɖusime ne nàkpɔ; ame aɖeke metsɔ ɖeke le eme nam o. Bebeƒe aɖeke meli nam o, eye ame aɖeke metsɔ ɖeke le eme nam o.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, wòe mele ɣli dom na. Megblɔ be, “Wòe nye nye sitsoƒe, kple nye gome le agbagbeawo ƒe anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Ɖem tso nye gaxɔ me, be makafu wò ŋkɔ. Ekema ame dzɔdzɔewo aɖe to ɖem, le wò nyui si nèwɔ nam la ta.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, se nye gbedodoɖa, lé to ɖe nye nublanuiɣli ŋu, eye nàxɔ nam le wò nuteƒewɔwɔ kple dzɔdzɔenyenye ta.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mègabu fɔ wò dɔla o, elabena amegbetɔ aɖeke mele dzɔdzɔe le ŋkuwò me o.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Futɔ la ti yonyeme, egbãm ɖe anyigba, eye wòna menɔ viviti me abe ame siwo ku xoxo va yi la ene.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu le menye, eye nye dzi wɔ yaa le menye.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Meɖo ŋku blemaŋkekeawo dzi, hede ŋugble le wò dɔwɔwɔwo katã ŋuti, eye mebu nu siwo wò asiwo wɔ la ŋuti.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Mekeke nye abɔwo me na wò, eye nye luʋɔ ƒe ve me ƒu ɖe ŋuwò abe kuɖiɖinyigba ene. Sela

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, tɔ nam kaba, elabena nu te nye gbɔgbɔ ŋu. Mègaɣla wò mo ɖem o, ne menye nenema o la, manɔ abe ame siwo yi aʋlime ene.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Na ŋdi natsɔ wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ƒe nya vɛ nam, elabena dziwòe meka ɖo. Fia mɔ si mato lam, elabena wòe medo nye luʋɔ ɖe dzi na.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ɖem tso nye futɔwo ƒe asi me, elabena mewòe mebe ɖo.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Fiam ale si mawɔ wò lɔlɔ̃nu, elabena wòe nye nye Mawu; na wò Gbɔgbɔ nyui la nakplɔm to anyigba sɔsɔe dzi.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, le wò ŋkɔ la ta, kpɔ nye agbe ta, le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ta, ɖem le xaxa me.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Le wò lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la ta, mia nu na nye futɔwo; tsrɔ̃ nye ketɔwo katã, elabena wò dɔlae menye.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Woakafu Yehowa, nye Agakpe la, ame si fia aʋawɔwɔ nye asi kple asibidɛwo.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Enye nye Mawu lɔlɔ̃tɔ kple nye mɔ sesẽ, nye sitsoƒe kple nye xɔnametɔ kpakple nye akpoxɔnu, nye Mawu si me mebe ɖo, ame si bɔbɔ nye dukɔ ɖe tenye.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, nu kae nye amegbetɔ be nètsɔ ɖe le eme nɛ kple amegbetɔvi be nèbua eŋuti?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ le abe gbɔgbɔ ko ene, eye eƒe ŋkekewo le abe vɔvɔli si va yina kaba la ene.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, dze wò dziƒowo ne nàɖi va, eye nàka asi towo ŋu, be woatu dzudzɔ.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Dɔ dzikedzo ɖa woakaka futɔwo, da wò aŋutrɔ, eye nàtsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Do wò asi ɖa tso dziƒo nàxɔ nam, eye nàɖem tso tsi sesẽwo kple amedzrowo ƒe asi me,

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: ame siwo ƒe nu me yɔ fũu kple alakpa, eye woƒe nuɖusi blea ame.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: O! Mawu, madzi ha yeye na wò, matsɔ kasaŋku, ka ewo tɔ aƒo ha na wò,

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: wò ame si na dziɖuɖu fiawo, eye nèɖe wo dɔla David tso yi vɔ̃ɖi ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Xɔ nam, eye nàɖem tso amedzrowo ƒe asi me, ame siwo ƒe nu me yɔ fũu kple alakpa, eye woƒe nuɖusi blea ame.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Ekema mía viŋutsuwo le woƒe ɖekakpuime, anɔ abe ati siwo wode tsii nyuie ene, eye mía vinyɔnuwo anɔ abe sɔti si ŋu wota nu ɖo hetsɔ ɖo atsyɔ̃e na fiasã ene.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Míaƒe avawo ayɔ fũu kple nuku vovovowo. Míaƒe alẽwo adzi ɖe edzi le akpewo kple akpe ewowo me le míaƒe lãnyiƒewo.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Nenema ke míaƒe nyiwo atsɔ agba kpekpewo vɛ. Ale gli gbagbã maganɔ anyi o, aboyomeyiyi maganɔ anyi o, eye xaxa ƒe avifafa magaɖi le míaƒe mɔtatawo dzi azɔ o.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Woayra dukɔ si wòava eme na alea le nyateƒe me; Woayra dukɔ si ƒe Mawue nye Yehowa.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Mado wò ɖe dzi, nye Mawu, fia la. Makafu wò ŋkɔ tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Makafu wò gbe sia gbe, eye mado wò ŋkɔ ɖe dzi tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Gãe nye Yehowa, eye eya koe dze na kafukafu, elabena ame aɖeke mate ŋu anya eƒe gãnyenye ƒe goglome o.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Dzidzime ɖeka akafu wò dɔwɔwɔwo na dzidzime bubu, eye woatu xo le wò nu dzɔatsuwo ŋu.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Woaƒo nu le wò gãnyenye ƒe atsyɔ̃ɖoɖo ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ŋuti, eye made ŋugble le wò dɔwɔwɔ wɔnukuwo ŋuti.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Woaƒo nu le wò ŋɔdzidɔwɔwɔwo ƒe ŋusẽ ŋuti, eye maɖe gbeƒã wò nuwɔwɔ dzɔatsuwo.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Woaɖu wò nyuiwɔwɔ gbogboawo ƒe azã, eye woadzi ha atso aseye le wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ŋuti.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Yehowa nye amenuvela kple nublanuikpɔla; medoa dɔmedzoe kabakaba o, eye lɔlɔ̃ bɔ ɖe esi.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Yehowa nyoa dɔ me na ame sia ame, eye wòkpɔa nublanui na ame siwo katã wòwɔ.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: O! Yehowa, ame siwo katã nèwɔ la akafu wò, eye wò ame kɔkɔewo ado wò ɖe dzi.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Woaƒo nu le wò fiaɖuƒe la ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ŋu, eye woagblɔ nya tso wò ŋusẽ ŋuti,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: ale be amewo katã nanya wò nuwɔwɔ dzɔatsuwo kple wò fiaɖuƒe ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ƒe atsyɔ̃.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Wò fiaɖuƒe la nye fiaɖuƒe mavɔ, eye wò fiaɖuɖu anɔ anyi le dzidzimewo katã me. Yehowa awɔ nuteƒe le eƒe ŋugbedodowo katã me, eye wòaɖe lɔlɔ̃ afia ame siwo katã wòwɔ.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Ŋkuwo katã le wò asinu kpɔm, eye nèna nuɖuɖu wo le enaɣi.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Èʋu wò asiwo me, eye nètsɔ nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe ƒe nu si wòdi la nɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: Yehowa nye dzɔdzɔetɔ le eƒe mɔwo katã dzi, eye wòlɔ̃a eƒe nu siwo katã wòwɔ.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsɔ ɖe ame siwo yɔnɛ la gbɔ, ame siwo katã yɔnɛ le nyateƒe me.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ewɔa ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la ƒe dzimedidiwo na wo, esea woƒe ɣlidodo, eye wòɖea wo.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa ame siwo katã lɔ̃nɛ la ta, gake atsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Nye nu agblɔ Yehowa ƒe kafukafu. Nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe nekafu eƒe ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me.

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Makafu Yehowa le nye agbemeŋkekewo katã me. Madzi kafukafuha na nye Mawu la, zi ale si mele agbe.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Ne woƒe gbɔgbɔ do go le wo me la, wogatrɔna zua kewɔ, gbe ma gbe ke woƒe ɖoɖo siwo katã wowɔ la zua tofloko.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Woayra ame si ƒe xɔnametɔ nye Yakob ƒe Mawu la, eye eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ le Yehowa, eƒe Mawu la me.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Eya ame si wɔ dziƒo kple anyigba, atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme, Yehowa nye nuteƒewɔla tegbetegbe.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Etsoa afia na ame siwo wote ɖe anyi, eye wònaa nuɖuɖu dɔwuitɔwo. Yehowae naa ablɔɖe gamenɔlawo.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Yehowa ʋua ŋku na ŋkuagbãtɔwo, Yehowa fɔa ame siwo wote ɖe anyi la ɖe dzi, Yehowa lɔ̃a ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe nya.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa amedzrowo ta, eye wònye tsyɔ̃eviwo kple ahosiwo hã ta kpɔla. Ke etɔtɔa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔwo.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yehowa le fia ɖum tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me. O! Zion, wò Mawu la aɖu fia le dzidzimewo katã me. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. Aleke mehenyoe be woadzi kafukafuha na míaƒe Mawu la o! Aleke wòhevivina, eye wòdze be woakafui!

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbugbɔ tso Yerusalem du la, eye wòkplɔ Israel ƒe aboyomewo gbɔe.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Eda gbe le ame siwo ƒe dzi gbã la ŋu, eye wòbla woƒe abiwo na wo.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Eyae ɖo xexlẽme na ɣletiviwo, eye wòyɔa ɖe sia ɖe ƒe ŋkɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Gãe nye míaƒe Aƒetɔ la, eye eƒe ŋusẽ tri akɔ ŋutɔ, seɖoƒe meli na eƒe gɔmesese o.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yehowa kpɔa ame siwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui la dzi, ke etsɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi ya xlã ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Midzi ha na Yehowa kple akpedada, eye miƒo ha na míaƒe Mawu la kple kasaŋku.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Etsɔa lilikpo xea yamee, eye wònana tsi dzana ɖe anyigba la dzi hewɔnɛ be gbe miena ɖe togbɛwo dzi.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Enaa nuɖuɖu nyiwo kple akpaviã siwo le xɔxlɔ̃m nɛ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Eƒe dzidzɔ mele sɔ ƒe ŋusẽ me loo, alo amegbetɔ ƒe afɔ me o;

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: ke boŋ Yehowa ƒe dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ le ame siwo vɔ̃nɛ la me, ame siwo tsɔa woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ dana ɖe eƒe lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o la dzi.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: O! Yerusalem, do Yehowa ɖe dzi, O! Zion, kafu wò Mawu la,

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: elabena eyae glã wò agbowo ƒe gametiwo, eye wòyra ame siwo le mewò.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ena ŋutifafa le wò liƒowo dzi, eye wòtsɔ mɔlu nyuitɔ ɖi ƒo na wòe.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Eɖo eƒe sedede ɖe anyigba la dzi, eye eƒe nya kaka kple du ɖo teƒewo.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ekaka tsikpe abe ɖetifu ene, eye wòkaka afu abe dzofi ene.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Eɖo kpetsi ɖe anyigba abe kpekui ene. Ame ka ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe wò ya fafɛ la nu?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Edɔ eƒe nya ɖa, eye wòlolo wo. Ede ŋusẽ eƒe yawo me, eye tsiwo de asi sisi me.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Eɖe eƒe nya fia Yakob eye wòɖe eƒe sewo kple sededewo fia Israel.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Mewɔ esia na dukɔ bubu aɖeke o, eye womenya eƒe sewo o. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. Mikafu Yehowa tso dziƒowo, mikafui le kɔkɔƒewo le dzi me.

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Mi eƒe dɔlawo katã mikafui, dziƒoʋakɔwo hã mikafui.

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Ɣe kple ɣleti nekafui, mikafui, mi ɣletivi keklẽwo.

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Mi dziƒo kɔkɔtɔwo, mikafui, eye mi tsi siwo le alilĩa tame hã mikafui.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Wo katã nekafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, elabena eɖe gbe, eye wova dzɔ.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Etsɔ wo ɖo wo nɔƒe tso mavɔ me yi ɖe mavɔ me, ede se si nu mayi akpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa tso anyigba, mi nuwɔwɔ gã siwo le atsiaƒu me kple gogloƒewo katã.

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Dzikedzo kple kpetsi, tsikpe kple lilikpowo, ahomya si wɔ eƒe lɔlɔ̃nu,

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: mi towo kple togbɛwo katã, atikutsetsetiwo kple sedatiwo katã,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: gbemelãwo kple nyiwo katã, nuwɔwɔ suewo kple xe dzodzoewo,

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: anyigbadzifiawo kple dukɔwo katã, mi dumegãwo kple dziɖula siwo katã le anyigba dzi,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ɖekakpuiwo kple ɖetugbiwo, ame tsitsiwo kple ɖeviwo siaa nekafui.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ, elabena eƒe ŋkɔ ɖeɖe koe de dzi, eye eƒe atsyɔ̃ le anyigba kple dziƒowo tame.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ena dzo aɖe do na eƒe dukɔ, esi nye Israel, eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã ƒe kafukafu, ame siwo tsɔ ɖe eƒe dzi gbɔ. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Mikafu Yehowa. Midzi ha yeye na Yehowa, midzi eƒe kafukafuha le ame kɔkɔewo ƒe asaɖa me.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Israel nekpɔ dzidzɔ le woƒe Wɔla me, Zionviwo netso aseye ɖe woƒe fia la ŋu.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Wonekafu eƒe ŋkɔ kple ɣeɖuɖu, eye woneƒo ha nɛ kple asiʋuiwo kple kasaŋku.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Elabena Yehowa do dzidzɔ ɖe eƒe dukɔ ŋu, eye wòtsɔ ɖeɖe ɖɔ na ame gblɔewo.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Ame kɔkɔewo nekpɔ dzidzɔ le eƒe bubu me, eye woadzi ha kple dzidzɔ le woƒe abawo dzi.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Mawu kafukafu nenɔ woƒe nu me, eye wòanye yi nuevee anɔ woƒe asiwo me,

english_verse: Take revenge and punish the nations.
translation_verse: ne woatsɔ abia hlɔ̃ dukɔwo, eye woatsɔe ahe toe na amewo,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: ne woabla woƒe fiawo kple gakɔsɔkɔsɔ, eye woade kunyowu woƒe bubumewo,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ne woawɔ fɔ si wobu wo, woŋlɔ da ɖi ɖe wo ŋu la dzi. Esia nye eƒe ame kɔkɔewo katã ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe. Mikafu Yehowa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Miakafu Yehowa. Mikafu Mawu le eƒe Kɔkɔeƒe la me. Mikafui le eƒe dziƒo sesẽ la me.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Mikafui le eƒe ŋusẽdɔwo ta. Mikafui le eƒe gãnyenye si ƒo wo katã ta la ta.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Mitsɔ kpẽkuku kafui. Mitsɔ saŋku kple kasaŋku kafui.

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Mikafui kple asiʋui kple ɣeɖuɖu. Mikafui kple kasaŋkuƒoƒo kple dzekuku.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nu sia nu si me gbɔgbɔ le la, nekafu Yehowa. Mikafu Yehowa!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Israel fia Solomo, David ƒe vi ƒe lododowo nye esiawo:

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: na nunya kple amehehe, na nya goglowo gɔmesese,

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: hena agbe dzɔdzɔe kple agbe ɖevi nɔnɔ, be woawɔ nu si dzɔ, nu si le eteƒe kple nu si nyo,

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: be ame gblɔewo nadze aɖaŋu eye woana nunya kple sidzedze sɔhɛwo,

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: nunyalawo neɖo to, ne woasrɔ̃ nu akpe ɖe esi wonya xoxo la ŋu eye ame siwo si sidzedze le xoxo la naxɔ aɖaŋu,

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: be woase nunyalawo ƒe lododowo abebubuwo kple adzowo gɔme.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Yehowa vɔvɔ̃e nye nunya ƒe gɔmedzedze, ke bometsilawo doa vlo nunya kple amehehe. Dzidede ƒo na amewo be woasrɔ̃ nunya Nuxɔxlɔ̃ amewo le ha baɖa dede ŋuti

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Vinye, ɖo to fofowò ƒe nuxɔxlɔ̃ eye mègagbe nu le dawò ƒe nufiame gbɔ o.

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Anye seƒoƒokuku aɖo atsyɔ̃ na wò ta kple kɔga anɔ kɔwò.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Vinye, ne nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo le nuwò blem la, mègalɔ̃ na wo o.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Ne wogblɔ na wò be, “Va kplɔ mí ɖo, na míade xa ɖe ame aɖe ƒe ʋu ŋuti, na míanɔ xame na luʋɔ maɖifɔ aɖe,

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: ne míamii agbagbee abe tsiẽƒe ene, eye míamii blibo abe ame siwo ge dze ʋe globo me ene

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: ekema nu xɔasi vovovowo asu mía si eye míatsɔ afunyinuwo ayɔ míaƒe xɔwo mee

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: eya ta de mía dzi ale be míana gakotoku ɖeka wò” la,

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: vinye, mègakplɔ wo ɖo o, mègaka afɔ woƒe toƒewo o

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: elabena woƒe afɔ ɖea abla ɖe nu vɔ̃ ŋu eye wogona ɖe ʋukɔkɔɖi ŋu.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Enye movidzɔdzɔ be woaɖo ɖɔ ɖi na xeviwo le wo katã ƒe ŋkume!

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Ame siawo de xa ɖi na woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ʋu eye wole adeklo dzi ɖe woawo ŋutɔ ɖokuiwo ŋu!

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nunya le ɣli dom le mɔtata dzi eye wòkɔ gbe dzi le ƒuƒoƒewo.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Ele ɣli dom le mɔtata siwo dzi zinyenye le la ƒe dzogoewo dzi eye wòle eƒe nyawo gblɔm le dua ƒe agbowo me be,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi mi gegemewo mialɔ̃ bometsinuwɔwɔ? Va se ɖe ɣe ka yi fewuɖulawo akpɔ dzidzɔ le fewuɖuɖu ŋu, bometsilawo alé fu sidzedze?

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: eye miedo toku nye aɖaŋuɖoɖowo, hegbe nye mokaname ta la,

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: ɛ̃, ne eƒo ɖe mia dzi abe ahom sesẽ ene, gbegblẽ hã zɔ to mia dzi abe yali ene, eye xaxa kple hiã va mia dzi kpoyi!

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: “Ekema woayɔm gake nyematɔ o, woadim gake womakpɔm o.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Le esi wolé fu sidzedze eye wometia Yehowavɔvɔ̃ o,

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: le esi wogbe nye aɖaŋuɖoɖo hedo vlo nye mokaname ta.

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: Azɔ la woaɖu woƒe mɔwo ƒe kutsetse eye woƒe ɖoɖowo ƒe kutsetse aɖi ƒo na wo

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: elabena gegemewo ƒe afɔɖeɖe baɖawo awu wo eye bometsilawo ƒe ɖekematsɔleme atsrɔ̃ wo.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ke ame sia ame si ɖoa tom la, anɔ agbe le dedinɔnɔ me eye aɖe dzi ɖi bɔkɔɔ, mavɔ̃ na dzɔgbevɔ̃e o.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne èxɔ nye nyawo eye nèdzra nye sededewo ɖo ɖe mewò,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: ne ètrɔ to ɖe nunya ŋu hetsɔ wò dzi na gɔmesese,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: ne èyɔ sidzedze eye nèdo ɣli na gɔmesese,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: ne èdii abe klosalo alo kesinɔnu si woɣla ene la,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ekema àse Yehowavɔvɔ̃ gɔme eye àke ɖe Mawu nyanya ŋu

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: elabena Yehowae naa nunya, eye sidzedze kple gɔmesese doa go tso eƒe nu me.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Eɖo dziɖuɖu ɖi na nuteƒewɔlawo eye wònye akpoxɔnu na ame siwo ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o,

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: elabena edzɔa ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe toƒewo ŋu eye wòkpɔa eƒe nuteƒewɔlawo ƒe mɔwo ta.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ekema àse nu si nyo, le dzɔdzɔe eye wòdze la gɔme, ɛ̃, àse mɔ nyui ɖe sia ɖe gɔme,

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: elabena nunya age ɖe wò dzi me, eye sidzedze ado dzidzɔ na wò luʋɔ.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Tamebubu nyui akpɔ tawò, eye gɔmesese adzɔ ŋuwò.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Nunya aɖe wò tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔwo dzi, tso nya tovo gblɔlawo ƒe asi me,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: ame siwo gblea mɔ dzɔdzɔetɔwo ɖi hezɔna le mɔ doblukɔwo dzi,

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: ame siwo nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ doa dzidzɔ na, eye wotsoa aseye le nu tovo ƒe vɔ̃ɖinyenye ŋu,

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: ame siwo ƒe mɔwo glɔ̃ eye wotrana le woƒe mɔwo dzi.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Nunya aɖe wò le nyɔnu ahasitɔ hã ƒe asi me kple srɔ̃nyɔnu si da afɔ la ƒe amenubeble me

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: ame si gblẽ eƒe ɖetugbimesrɔ̃ ɖi eye mewɔ ɖe nu si wòbla kplii le Mawu ŋkume la dzi o

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: elabena eƒe aƒe ɖo ta ku me eye eƒe mɔwo ɖo ta ame siwo le tsiẽƒe la ƒe gbɔgbɔwo gbɔ.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Ame siwo katã yia egbɔ la megatrɔna gbɔna loo alo gena ɖe agbemɔ la dzi o.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Ale àto ame nyuiwo ƒe mɔwo dzi eye àlé ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe mɔwo ɖe asi.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo anɔ anyigba dzi eye ame maɖifɔwo asusɔ ɖe edzi

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: gake woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖa le anyigba dzi eye woaho nuteƒemawɔlawo ɖa le edzi.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Vinye, mègaŋlɔ nye nufiame be o, eye nàlé nye sededewo ɖe wò dzi me,

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: elabena woadidi wò agbenɔƒewo ɖe edzi ƒe geɖe, eye woahe dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ vɛ na wò.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ megate ɖa le gbɔwò gbeɖe o, tsɔ wo de kɔ eye nàŋlɔ wo ɖe wò dzi ƒe nuŋlɔkpe dzi.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Ekema àkpɔ amenuveve kple ŋkɔ nyui le Mawu kple amewo ŋkume.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Ɖo ŋu ɖe Yehowa ŋu kple wò dzi blibo, mègaku ɖe wò ŋutɔ wò nugɔmesese ŋu o;

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: ɖo ŋu ɖe eŋu le wò mɔwo katã dzi ekema awɔ wò toƒewo dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Mèganye nunyala le wò ŋutɔ wò ŋkume o, ke boŋ vɔ̃ Yehowa eye nàtsri vɔ̃.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Esia ahe dɔyɔyɔ vɛ na wò ŋutilã kple nunyiame vɛ na wò ƒuwo.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: De bubu Yehowa ŋu kple wò kesinɔnuwo kple wò agblemenukuwo ƒe ŋgɔgbetɔwo,

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: ekema wò avawo ayɔ agbagba, eye wain yeye ayɔ wò ahazewo agbagba.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Vinye, mègado vlo Yehowa ƒe amehehe o eye mègagbe eƒe mokaname o

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: elabena Yehowa ɖɔa ame siwo wòlɔ̃ la ɖo abe ale si fofo wɔna na vi si ƒe nu dzea eŋu la ene.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Woayra ame si ke ɖe nunya ŋu kple ame si si gɔmesese su

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: elabena nunya xɔ asi wu klosalo eye viɖe geɖe le eme wu sika.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Asixɔxɔ le eŋu wu adzagba eye nu siwo katã dim nèle la, ɖeke mesɔ kplii o.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Agbe didi le eƒe ɖusi ƒe asi me, eye kesinɔnuwo kple bubu le eƒe miasi ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Eƒe mɔwo nye mɔ siwo dzi vivi le eye ŋutifafa le eƒe toƒewo katã.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Enye agbeti na ame siwo xɔ eya amea eye ame siwo ƒe asi su edzi la woayra wo.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Nunyae Yehowa tsɔ ɖo anyigba la ƒe gɔmeɖokpe anyii eye wòtsɔ gɔmesese ɖo dziƒowo ɖe wo teƒe.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe nunya ma gogloƒewoe eye lilikpowo dzaa zãmu.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Vinye, lé afia nyui tsotso kple sidzedze me ɖe asi, mègana woadzo le ŋkuwòme o.

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: Woanye agbe na wò kple kɔga aɖo atsyɔ̃ na wò kɔ.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Ekema àlé wò mɔ atsɔ le dedinɔnɔ me eye wò afɔ maɖiɖi o.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Ne èmlɔ anyi la, màvɔ̃ o, ne èmlɔ anyi la, àdɔ alɔ̃ vivi.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Mègavɔ̃ ŋɔdzi si ava kpoyi alo gbegblẽ si vaa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo dzi o

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: elabena Yehowa anye wò dzideƒo eye mana wò afɔ naɖo mɔ me o.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Mègagbe nyuiwɔwɔ na ame siwo dze nɛ, ne ele wò ŋusẽ me be nàwɔe o.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Mègagblɔ na wò aƒelika be, “Yi nàtrɔ va, etsɔ matsɔe na wò” esi wòle asiwò fifia o.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Mègaɖo vɔ̃ ɖe wò aƒelika, ame si le gbɔwò le anukwareɖiɖi me la ŋu o.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Mègatsɔ nya ɖe ame aɖeke ŋu dzodzro esi mewɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke ɖe ŋuwò o.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Mègabiã ŋu ŋutsu nu sesẽ wɔla alo azɔ le eƒe mɔ aɖeke dzi o,

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: elabena Yehowa nyɔa ŋu ŋutsu nu tovo wɔla gake elɔ̃a ame siwo wɔa nu dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe fiƒode le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aƒe dzi, ke eyrana ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe aƒe dzi.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Yehowa ɖua fewu le dadala fewuɖulawo ŋu, ke evea ame siwo bɔbɔa wo ɖokui la nu.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo nyia bubu ƒe dome, ke bometsilawo la, etsɔa wo dea asi na ŋukpe.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Vinyewo, mise mia fofo ƒe nufiame; miɖo to ne miaxɔ gɔmesese.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Nusɔsrɔ̃ deto mele mia nam eya ta migagbe nye nufiafia o.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Esi menye ɖevi sue kple vi fɛ̃ le fofonye ƒe aƒe me kple vi ɖekɛ na danye la,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: efia num hegblɔ be, “Ku ɖe nye nyawo ŋu kple wò dzi katã, lé nye sededewo me ɖe asi ekema ànɔ agbe.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Dze nunya, di gɔmesese, mègaŋlɔ nye nyawo be alo aƒo asa na wo o.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Mègagbe nu le nunya gbɔ o ekema adzɔ ŋuwò, lɔ̃e ekema akpɔ tawò.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nunya ƒo nuwo katã ta eya ta dze nunya. Togbɔ be wò nunɔamesiwo katã nàtsɔ aƒlee hã la, di gɔmesese.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: De asixɔxɔ eŋu ekema ado wò ɖe dzi, xɔe atuu ekema ade bubu ŋuwò.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Atsɔ amenuveve aɖɔ na wò ta abe seƒoƒotsihe ene eye wòatsɔ atsyɔ̃fiakuku aɖɔ na wò.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ɖo to afii, vinye, ne nàxɔ nye nyawo, ekema wò agbenɔƒewo asɔ gbɔ fũu.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Mele nunya ƒe mɔ fiam wò eye mekplɔ wò to toƒe dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Ne èle zɔzɔm la, naneke maxe mɔ na wò afɔɖeɖewo o eye ne èsi du la, màkli nu o.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Lé nufiame ɖe asi, mègana wòado le asiwò o; dzɔ eŋuti nyuie elabena eyae nye agbe na wò.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Mègaka afɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe toƒewo alo nàzɔ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ dzi o.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Ƒo asa na woƒe mɔwo, mègazɔ wo dzi o, lé wò mɔ tsɔ nàyi afi si yim nèle

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: elabena ne womewɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi o kpaa, womedɔa alɔ̃ o eye womedɔa akɔlɔ̃e teti hã o va se ɖe esime woana ame aɖe nadze anyi.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Woɖua vɔ̃ɖinyenye ƒe abolo eye wonoa nu sesẽ wɔwɔ ƒe wain.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe toƒe le abe ŋdi kanya ƒe ɣetotoe ene, eklẽna, gaklẽna ɖe edzi ne ŋu ɖe le eme nyuie.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ le abe viviti tsiɖitsiɖi ene eye womenya nu si na wole nu klim o.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Mègana woadzo le wò ŋkume o, ke boŋ dzra wo ɖo ɖe wò dzi me,

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: elabena wonye agbe na ame siwo ke ɖe wo ŋu kple dɔyɔyɔ na ame ƒe ŋutilã blibo la.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Dzɔ wò dzi ŋu wu nuwo katã, elabena eyae nye agbe ƒe vudo.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Ɖe nya dzodzrowo ɖa le wò nu me, eye te aʋatsonyawo ɖa xaa tso wò nuyiwo gbɔ.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Wò ŋkuwo nekpɔ ŋgɔ tẽe eye wò mo nelé mɔ ɖeka tsɔ le ŋgɔwò.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Ɖe toƒe sɔsɔewo na wò afɔwo eye nàlé mɔ siwo dzi sẽ nyuie la ko atsɔ.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Mègadze ɖe ɖusime alo miame o, eye ɖe wò afɔ ɖa le vɔ̃ me.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Vinye, lé to ɖe nye nunya ŋu eye nàƒu to anyi nyuie ɖe nye sidzedze ƒe nyawo ŋu,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: be nànya nu si nàwɔ eye wò nuyiwo adzra gɔmesese ɖo

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: elabena nyɔnu ahasitɔ ƒe nuyiwo le anyitsi tsyɔm, eye eƒe numenyawo zrɔ̃ wu ami

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: gake le nuwuwu la evena wu veve eye wòɖana wu yi nuevee.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Eƒe afɔ yina ɖe tsĩeƒe ke eye eƒe afɔɖeɖewo yina ɖe yɔdo me tẽe

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Mebua ta me le ale si wòanɔ agbee ŋu kura o, eƒe toƒewo glɔ̃ gake menyae o

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: eya ta azɔ la, vinyewo, miɖo tom, migaƒo asa na nu si megblɔ na mi o.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Miaƒe toƒewo nete ɖa xaa tso egbɔ, migagogo eƒe aƒe ƒe agbonu o,

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: ne menye nenema o la, miava gblẽ miaƒe ɖekakpuime ƒe ŋusẽ ɖe ame bubuwo ŋu kple miaƒe ƒewo ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ŋu.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Le wò agbe ƒe nuwuwu la, ànɔ ŋeŋem, ne wò ŋutilã kple wò ameti blibo la vɔ le eme.

english_verse: and shout, “I hated advice and correction!
translation_verse: Àgblɔ be, “Metsri amehehe kɔkɔkɔ! Eye nye dzi do vlo ɖɔɖɔɖo!

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Nyemaɖo to nye nufialawo alo aƒu to anyi ɖe nye amegãwo ŋu o.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Esusɔ vie donyeme nagblẽ keŋkeŋ le ameha la katã dome.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: No tsi tso wò ŋutɔ wò tsiʋe me kple tsi dzidzi tso wò ŋutɔ wò vudo me.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Ɖe wòle be wò tsitsetsewo nagbagba ɖe mɔtatawo dzi kple wò tsi sisi ɖe du ƒe ablɔwo mea?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Wonenye wò ɖeka ko tɔ, mègamae kple ame tutɔwo gbeɖe o.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Woayra wò vudo eye nàkpɔ dzidzɔ ɖe wò ɖekakpuimesrɔ̃ ŋu.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Eyae nye zinɔ lɔlɔ̃a kple sãde dzeani la, eƒe nowo neɖi kɔ na wò ɣe sia ɣi, eye eƒe lɔlɔ̃ nede dzo mewò ɖaa.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Vinye, nu ka ŋuti nàƒo kpakpakpa ɖe nyɔnu ahasitɔ ŋu? Nu ka ŋuti nàlé alime na ame bubu srɔ̃?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Elabena ame sia ame ƒe mɔ le ƒuƒlu le Yehowa ŋkume eye wòdoa woƒe mɔwo katã kpɔ.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu vɔ̃ɖi siwo wòwɔna la zua mɔ ɖenɛ, eye eƒe nu vɔ̃ zua ka blanɛ sesĩe.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Aku le ɖokuidzimaɖumaɖu ta eye eƒe bometsitsi gã la akplɔe atrae.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne ède megbe na wò aƒelika, eye nèsi akpe tsɔ do ŋugbee na ame tutɔ,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: ne ŋugbe si nèdo zu mɔ me nèɖo eye wò numenyawo bla wò la,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ekema vinye, wɔ esia ne nàtsɔ aɖe ɖokuiwòe, esi nège ɖe hawòvi ƒe asi me ta. Yi nàbɔbɔ ɖokuiwò, ɖe kuku na hawòvi la amenubletɔe!

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Wò ŋkuwo megadɔ alɔ̃ o eye wò aɖaba megadɔ akɔlɔ̃e o.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Ɖe ɖokuiwò le eƒe asi me abe ale si sãde sina le adela ƒe asi me ene alo abe ale si xevi dona le xevimɔtrela ƒe kamɔ mee ene.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Wò, kuviatɔ, yi anyidi gbɔ; kpɔ eƒe mɔwo ɖa, eye nàdze nunya!

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Wò, kuviatɔ va se ɖe ɣe ka ɣi nàmlɔ afi ma? Ɣe ka ɣi nànyɔ tso alɔ̃ me?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Dɔ alɔ̃ vie, dɔ akɔlɔ̃e sẽe, ŋlɔ wò abɔwo nàdzudzɔ vie,

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: tete ahedada aƒo ɖe dziwò abe adzodala ene eye hiã abe aʋakalẽtɔ si bla akpa ene.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: ame si ɖoa nu vɔ̃ɖi, beble le eƒe dzi me, eye ɣe sia ɣi wòdea dzre aƒe la

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: eya ta gbegblẽ aƒo ɖe edzi kpoyi eye woatsrɔ̃ eya amea zi ɖeka, naneke maɖee le eme o.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Nu adree Yehowa tsri, eye nu adree nye nu siwo wònyɔa ŋui:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: dadaŋkuwo, alakpaɖe, asi siwo kɔa ʋu maɖifɔ ɖi,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: dzi si ɖoa nu vɔ̃ɖiwo, afɔ siwo ɖea abla ɖe vɔ̃wɔwɔ ŋuti

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: aʋatsoɖaseɖila si kɔa alakpa ɖi, kple ŋutsu si dea dzre nɔviwo dome. Nuxɔxlɔ̃ amewo le ahasiwɔwɔ ŋuti

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Bla wo ɖe wò dzi ŋuti tegbee eye nàsae ɖe wò kɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Ne èle zɔzɔm la, woafia mɔ wò, ne èle alɔ̃ dɔm la, woadzɔ ŋuwò eye ne ènyɔ la, woaƒo nu na wò

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: elabena sedede siawo nye akaɖi, nufiafia sia nye kekeli eye ɖɔɖɔɖo si amehehe hena vɛ la nye agbe ƒe mɔ,

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
