translation_verse: esi aɖe wò tso nyɔnu ahasitɔ ƒe asi me kple srɔ̃nyɔnu dzego la ƒe aɖe ŋanɛ ƒe asi me.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Eƒe tugbedzedze megana eƒe nu nadzro wò le wò dzi me alo nàna eƒe ŋku mawo nalé wò o,

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: elabena gbolo aɖi gbɔ̃ wò, nànɔ abe abolo ko ene eye nyɔnu ahasitɔ aɖe agbe le mewò.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋutsu aɖe aɖe dzo ɖe atata eye eƒe awuwo nagbe fiafia?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Ɖe ŋutsu aɖe azɔ le dzoka xɔxɔ dzi eye eƒe afɔwo nagbe fiafia?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Nenemae wòanɔ na ŋutsu si dɔna kple ŋutsu bubu srɔ̃, womagbe tohehe na ame si ka asi eŋuti o.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Womedoa vlo fiafitɔ ne efi fi be wòatsɔ atsi eƒe dɔwuame nu, ne dɔ la ewum o

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: gake ne wolée la, ele nɛ be wòaɖo nua teƒe zi adre, esia ana eƒe kesinɔnu siwo katã le esi le eƒe aƒe me la navɔ le esi.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Ke ame si wɔ ahasi kple srɔ̃tɔ la mebua ta me o eye ame si wɔnɛ la gblẽa eɖokui dome.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: elabena ŋuʋaʋã ana srɔ̃ŋutsu ƒe dɔmedzoe nafla eye ne ele hlɔ̃ biam la, makpɔ nublanui o.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Maxɔ avulénu aɖeke o, eye maxɔ zãnu aɖeke hã o, aleke gbegbee wòloloe hã.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Vinye, lé nye nyawo me ɖe asi eye nàdzra nye sededewo ɖo ɖe mewò.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Lé nye sededewo me ɖe asi ekema ànɔ agbe eye dzɔ nye nufiamewo ŋuti abe wò gadaglamakui ene.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Bla wo ɖe wò asibidɛwo ŋu eye nàŋlɔ wo ɖe wò dzi ƒe nuŋlɔkpe dzi.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Gblɔ na nunya be, “Nɔvinye nyɔnu nènye.” Eye nàyɔ ƒometɔ na gɔmesese,

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: woana nyɔnu ahasitɔ la nanɔ adzɔge na wò, eye woaɖe wò le srɔ̃nyɔnu dzego la ƒe amenublenyawo ƒe asi me.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Mele nye xɔ ƒe fesrẽ nu, hekpɔ nu to fesrẽnuvɔ la me.

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: le fiẽ me, esime anyigba nɔ tsyɔtsyɔm, eye zã do blukɔ.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Tete nyɔnu aɖe do go va kpee, edo awu abe gbolo ene eye ayedzedze le mo nɛ.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Eƒe gbe le dzi dem, metsɔ ɖeke le eme na ame aɖeke o eye eƒe afɔwo gbe tɔtɔ ɖe aƒe me,

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: ele kpɔdome fifia, kasia egado ɖe ablɔme xoxo eye wòdea xa ɖe dzogoe ɖe sia ɖe dzi.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Elé ɖekakpui la hegbugbɔ nu nɛ ŋɔnɔe eye wòɖo mo kplalaa gblɔ nɛ be,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Ŋutifafavɔsa le aƒenye me, egbe mexe nye adzɔgbeɖefewo o,

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: eya ta medo be mava do go wò, medi wò eye meke ɖe ŋuwò!

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Meɖo aklala biɖibiɖi ƒe abadzivɔ si wode amadede vovovowoe, esi wowɔ le Egipte la ɖe nye aba dzi.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mewu lifi, anowɔtre kple ami ʋeʋĩ vovovowo ɖe nye aba dzi,

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Nye aƒetɔ mele aƒe o, ezɔ mɔ didi aɖe.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Etsɔ eƒe gakotoku si ga yɔ fũu la dzoe eye ne dzinu sɔ tegblẽ hafi wòagbɔ.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Etsɔ amenublenya siawo blee eye wòtsɔ eƒe aɖe ŋanɛ la kplɔe trae.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Etso zia enumake hekplɔe ɖo abe nyitsu wokplɔ yina wuwu ge alo abe zi si ɖo afɔ mɔ me ene.

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: Va se ɖe esime aŋutrɔ naƒo ɖe eƒe aklã, abe xevie dzo ɖe kamɔ dzi eye menyae be yeƒe ku le afi ma o la ene

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: eya ta azɔ la, vinyewo, miɖo tom eye miƒu to anyi ɖe nu si megblɔ la ŋu.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Migana miaƒe dzi natrɔ ɖe eƒe mɔwo ŋu loo, alo miatra age ɖe eƒe toƒewo o.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Elabena ame siwo tsi esi me la sɔ gbɔ, eye ame siwo wòwu la de ha.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Eƒe aƒe nye tsiẽƒe ƒe mɔ gbadza siwo ɖo ta ku ƒe xɔgãwo me.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Etsi tsitre ɖe kɔkɔƒe siwo le mɔto la tame, afi si afɔmɔwo do go le.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Ele tsitre ɖe dua ƒe agbowo ƒe mɔ xa kple agbo la me le ɣli dom sesĩe be,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “O ŋutsuwo, miawoe mele ɣli dom na eye mekɔ nye gbe dzi na amegbetɔƒomea katã.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Mi bebewuwo, midze nunya; mi bometsilawo gɔmesese nesu mia si.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Miɖo to elabena nya xɔasiwo le asinye be magblɔ; meke nye nu be magblɔ nu si le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Nye nu gblɔa nu si le eteƒe, elabena nye nuyi tsri vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Nye numenyawo katã le dzɔdzɔe; ɖeke meglɔ̃ alo nye ayemenya o.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Wo katã le dzɔdzɔe na ame si si sidzedze le; fɔɖiɖi mele wo ŋu na ame siwo si gɔmesese le o.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Tia nye amehehe ɖe klosalo teƒe kple nye gɔmesese ɖe sika nyuitɔ teƒe

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: elabena nunya xɔ asi wu adzagba eye nu siwo dim wò dzi le la ƒe ɖeke mesɔ kplii o.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: “Nye, nunya kple ŋuɖɔɖoe nɔa teƒe ɖeka; gɔmesese kple sidzedze le asinye.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Yehowa vɔvɔ̃e nye be nàlé fu vɔ̃, eya ta metsri dada kple ɖokuidodoɖedzi, agbe baɖa nɔnɔ kple nya dzodzrowo gbɔgblɔ.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Tɔnyee nye aɖaŋudede kple afia nyui tsotso, gɔmesese kple ŋusẽ le asinye.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Dzinyee fiawo tona ɖua fia eye dziɖulawo dea se siwo le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Melɔ̃a ame siwo lɔ̃am eye ame siwo diam la kpɔam.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Hotsui kple bubu bɔ ɖe asinye, nenema kee nye kesinɔnu siwo megblẽna o kple dzidzedze.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Nye kutsetse nyo wu sika nyuitɔ, eye nu si dona tso menye la ƒo klosalo nyuitɔ ta sãa.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Mezɔna le dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ dzi kple nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe toƒewo,

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: eye mekɔa kesinɔnu ɖe ame siwo lɔ̃am la dzi, henana woƒe nudzraɖoƒewo gbagbana.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: “Yehowa dzim abe eƒe nuwɔwɔwo ƒe ŋgɔgbetɔ ene, hafi wòava wɔ nuwo le blema.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Etɔ asi dzinye tso mavɔ me ke, tso gɔmedzedzea me, hafi xexea me nava dzɔ.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Wodzim esime atsiaƒuwo menɔ anyi o, eye vudo siwo dzia tsi fũu la hã menɔ anyi o.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Hafi woatsɔ towo ada ɖe woƒe nɔƒewo, eye togbɛwo nadzɔ la, nye la, wodzim xoxo.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Hafi wòava wɔ anyigba alo gbegbe alo anyigbadziʋuʋudediwo gɔ̃ hã la, wodzim xoxo.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Menɔ afi ma hafi wòtsɔ dziƒowo ɖo wo nɔƒe eye wòdzidze dzite da ɖe gogloƒewo tame.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: Esi wòɖo lilikpowo ɖe dziƒo, eye wòli ke tɔ goglowo ƒe dzɔtsoƒe,

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: esi wòɖo liƒo na atsiaƒu be eƒe tsiwo magbɔ teƒe si wòde se be woase la dzi o eye wòɖo anyigba gɔme la, medzɔ xoxo.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: Ale menye aɖaŋudɔwɔla nɔ eƒe axadzi, dzidzɔ yɔ menye gbe sia gbe eye metsoa aseye le eŋkume ɣe sia ɣi.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Medzɔ dzi le eƒe xexe blibo la me eye amegbetɔwo ƒe nu do dzidzɔ nam.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: “Eya ta, azɔ la, mi vinyewo, miɖo tom; woayra ame siwo lé nye mɔwo me ɖe asi.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Ɖo to nye sededewo eye nàdze nunya, mègado tokue o.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Woayra ame si ɖoa tom, nɔa ŋudzɔ le nye ʋɔtru nu gbe sia gbe eye wòlalana le nye kpui nu

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: elabena ame si ke ɖe ŋutinye la, ke ɖe agbe ŋu eye wòxɔa amenuveve tso Yehowa gbɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Ke ame si mete ŋu ke ɖe ŋutinye o la, wɔa nu vevi eɖokui eye ame siwo katã léa fum la lɔ̃a ku.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nunya tu eƒe xɔ eye wòɖo eƒe sɔti adreawo te.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Etrɔ asi le eƒe lã si wòwu ŋu, tɔtɔ eƒe wain, eye wòɖo eƒe kplɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Edɔ eƒe dɔlanyɔnuwo eye wòtsi tsitre ɖe dua ƒe kɔkɔƒe ke hedo ɣli be,

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Mi bebewuwo katã mige ɖe eme le afii!” Egblɔ na numanyalawo be,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Miva, miɖu nye nu eye mino nye wain si metɔtɔ.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Miɖe asi le bometsitsi ŋu, ekema mianɔ agbe eye miazɔ le gɔmesese me.

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: “Ame si le nya gbem na fewuɖula la le eƒe dzu dɔm eye ame si ka mo na ame vɔ̃ɖi la xɔa dzudzu.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Mègaka mo na fewuɖula o, ne menye nenema o la, alé fu wò; ke boŋ ka mo na nunyala eye alɔ̃ wò nya.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Fia nu nunyala, aganya nu ɖe edzi wu, fia nu ame dzɔdzɔe eye agasrɔ̃ nu akpe ɖe esi wònya xoxo la ŋuti.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: “Yehowa vɔvɔ̃e nye nunya ƒe gɔmedzedze eye sidzedze Kɔkɔetɔ la nye gɔmesese

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: elabena to dzinye wò ŋkekewo adzi ɖe edzi fũu eye woatsɔ ƒewo akpe wò agbenɔƒewo.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Ne èdze nunya la, wò nunya ahe viɖe vɛ na wò; ke ne ènye fewuɖula la, wò ɖeka koe akpe fu.”

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Enɔ anyi ɖe eƒe aƒe ƒe ʋɔtru nu, enɔ anyi ɖe zikpui dzi le du la ƒe kɔkɔƒe kekeake

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Mí ame siwo katã nye bebewuwo la, mige ɖe eme le afii!” Egblɔna na ame siwo menya nu o la be,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Tsi si wofi la vivina, eye nu si woɖu le vivime la vivina!”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Ke womenya gɔ̃ hã be ame kukuwo le afi ma o eye eƒe ame kpekpewo le yɔdo ƒe gogloƒe ke o.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Solomo ƒe lododowo: Ɖevi si nya nu la nana fofoa kpɔa dzidzɔ, ke ɖevi si tsi bome la hea nuxaxa vɛ na dadaa.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu si wokpɔ to mɔ fitifitiwo dzi la menye viɖe aɖeke o, gake dzɔdzɔnyenye ɖea ame tso ku me.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Yehowa menaa dɔ wua ame dzɔdzɔewo o, ke egblẽa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe didiwo me.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒoa nukuwo nu ƒu le dzomeŋɔli la nye vi nyanu, ke ame si dɔa alɔ̃ le nuŋeɣi la, vi ŋukpenuwɔlae.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Yayra anye fiakuku anɔ ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ta ke ŋutasesẽ yɔa ame vɔ̃ ƒe nu me.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Ŋkuɖoɖo ame dzɔdzɔe dzi anye yayra, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ŋkɔ aƒaƒã.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ame si nunya le dzi me na la xɔa sededewo, ke bometsila, nukpoloeƒola, atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Ame si ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o la zɔna le dedinɔnɔ me, ke asi atu ame si toa mɔ gɔglɔ̃wo dzi.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Ame si tea ŋku ɖe ame kple dziku la hea nuxaxa vɛ, eye bometsila, nukpoloeƒola, atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nu nye agbevudo, ke ŋutasesẽ yɔa ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu me.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Fuléle hea mama vɛ, gake lɔlɔ̃ tsyɔa dzidadawo katã dzi.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Nunya le nugɔmeselawo ƒe nuyi dzi, ke ameƒoti adze dzime na numanyalawo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo dzraa gɔmesese ɖo, ke bometsila ƒe nu hea gbegblẽ vɛ.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo nye du si ŋu wotɔ glikpɔ sesẽ ɖo, ke hiãtɔwo ƒe ahedada nye woƒe gbegblẽ.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe dɔwɔfetu hea agbe vɛ nɛ, gake ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe viɖe hea tohehe vɛ nɛ.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖo to amehehe la le agbemɔ fiam gake ame si gbea ɖɔɖɔɖo la kplɔa ame bubuwo tranae.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Ame si ɣla fuléle ɖe eƒe dzi me la, alakpanuyi le esi eye ame si nɔa ame ŋu gblẽm la, bometsilae.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Afi si nya geɖe le la, nu vɔ̃ megbea afi ma nɔnɔ o, ke ame si lé eƒe aɖe la, nunyalae.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe aɖe le abe klosalo nyuitɔ ene, ke viɖe mele ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe dzi ŋu o.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nuyi hea nunyiame vɛ na ame geɖewo, gake bometsilawo kuna le simadzemadze ta.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe yayra hea kesinɔnu vɛ, eye metsɔa fukpekpe aɖeke kpena ɖe eŋu o.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Bometsila kpɔa dzidzɔ le nu tovo wɔwɔ ŋu, ke ame si sea nu gɔme la, nunyae nye eƒe dzidzɔ.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Nu si vɔ̃m ame vɔ̃ɖi le lae ava tui, ke nu si dim dzɔdzɔetɔ le la, eyae woanae.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Ne ahomya ƒo va yi la, ame vɔ̃ɖi la maganɔ anyi o, ke ame dzɔdzɔe ya anɔ te sesĩe ɖaa.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Abe ale si aha tsitsi nɔna na aɖu eye dzudzɔ nɔna na ŋku ene la, nenema kuviatɔ le na ame siwo dɔ dɔe.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Yehowavɔvɔ̃ nana agbe didina. Ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe agbenɔƒewo le kpuie.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe viɖee nye dzidzɔ gake ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ zua dzodzro.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe mɔ nye sitsoƒe na ame dzɔdzɔe, ke enye gbegblẽ na nu tovo wɔlawo.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Womaho ame dzɔdzɔe la akpɔ gbeɖe o gake ame vɔ̃ɖi ya manɔ anyigba la dzi o.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nunya dona tso dzɔdzɔetɔ la ƒe nu me, gake woalã alakpaɖe la ɖa.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nuyiwo nya nya dzeto gbɔgblɔ, gake ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu gblɔa nya tovowo.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsri nudanu amebatɔ, ke nudakpe si de blibo la nye eƒe dzidzɔ.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Dada doa ŋgɔ na ŋukpeɖuɖu, ke ɖokuibɔbɔ hea nunya vɛ.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe ta me nyui ɖoɖo kplɔa wo, ke nuteƒemawɔlawo la, woƒe dzi me eve susu tsrɔ̃a wo.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu nye nu dzodzro le dzikudogbe, ke dzɔdzɔenyenye ɖea ame tso ku me.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Ame maɖifɔwo ƒe dzɔdzɔenyenye taa mɔ dzɔdzɔe ɖe wo ŋgɔ, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe vɔ̃wɔwɔ hea wo ƒua anyi.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔ ɖea wo, ke didi vlowo zua mɔ ɖea nuteƒemawɔlawo.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Woɖea ame dzɔdzɔe tso fu me eye wòvaa ame vɔ̃ɖi la dzi boŋ.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Mawumavɔ̃la tsɔa eƒe nu gblẽa ehavi domee, ke woɖea ame dzɔdzɔe la to sidzedze me.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Ne nu dze edzi na ame dzɔdzɔe la, du blibo kpɔa dzidzɔ, ke ne ame vɔ̃ɖi tsrɔ̃ la, wodoa dzidzɔɣli.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: To dzɔdzɔetɔ ƒe yayra dzi wodoa du ɖe dzi, ke wotsrɔ̃nɛ to ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu dzi.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ame manyanu doa vlo ehavi, ke ŋutsu nugɔmesela léa eƒe aɖe.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Amenyagblɔla ʋua go nya ɣaɣla, ke ame ɖɔʋu ɣlaa nya.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Dukɔ aɖe dzea anyi, ne mɔfiala meli o, ke dziɖuɖu vana to aɖaŋuɖola geɖewo dzi.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Ame si de megbe na ame bubu la akpe fu, ke ame si gbe akpesisi abe ŋugbedodo ƒe dzesi ene la anɔ dedie.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Wodea bubu nyɔnu dɔmenyotɔ ŋu, ke ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo ƒe asi sua kesinɔnu ko dzi.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Ŋuistu dɔmenyotɔ wɔa nyui na eɖokui, gake ŋutsu ŋutasẽla hea hiã vaa eɖokui dzii.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Ame si nye dzɔdzɔetɔ vavã la, akpɔ agbe, ke ame si ti nu vɔ̃ɖi yome la yia eƒe ku me.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Yehowa tsri ame siwo ƒe dzi daa alakpa, ke ame siwo fɔɖiɖi mele woƒe mɔwo ŋu o la ƒe nu nyoa eŋu.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Maka ɖe esia dzi na mi be, womagbe tohehe na ame vɔ̃ɖi la o, ke woana ablɔɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Abe ale si sikaŋɔtigɛ nɔa ha ƒe ŋɔtimee ene la, nenema kee nye nyɔnu dzetugbe si meɖoa ŋu ɖo o.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe didiwo vaa eme na wo nyuie, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ wua nu le dziku me.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Ame ɖeka naa nu faa gake egakpɔa geɖe ɖe edzi, ame bubu vea nu le nu si wòle be wòana la ŋu gake ahe ko wòdana.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Nu adze dzi na ame si na nu faa, ame si na amewo ƒe dzi dze eme la, woana eya ŋutɔ hã ƒe dzi nadze eme.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ bli ɣla la amewo aƒo fi adee gake yayra ava ame si lɔ̃ be yeadzra etɔ la dzi.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Ame si ti nyui yome la, amewo adi nyui nɛ gake vɔ̃ vana na ame si le vɔ̃ dim.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe eƒe kesinɔnuwo dzi la adze anyi gake ame dzɔdzɔe awɔ mlɔmlɔmlɔ abe gbe dama ene.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Ame si he dzɔgbevɔ̃e va eƒe ƒome dzi la, ya anye eƒe domenyinu eye bometsila anye subɔla na nunyala.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe kutsetse nye agbeti, eye ame si ɖea luʋɔwo la, nunyalae.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Ne ame dzɔdzɔewo xɔ wo tɔ gome le anyigba dzi la, ekema aleke wòahanɔ na mawumavɔ̃lawo kple nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo!

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃ amehehe la lɔ̃a sidzedze, ke ame si lé fu mokaname la, bometsilae.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Yehowa vea ame nyui la nu, ke ebua fɔ ayemenuwɔla ya.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Womatsɔ vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi aɖo ame gɔme anyii o gake womate ŋu aho ame dzɔdzɔe ya o.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Srɔ̃nyɔnu zazɛ̃ nye fiakuku na srɔ̃ŋutsua, ke srɔ̃nyɔnu ŋukpenanuwɔla nye ŋuɖui le ƒu tome na srɔ̃a.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe ɖoɖowo toa mɔ ɖeka, ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo nye beble.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nyawo le lalam na ʋu gake dzɔdzɔetɔwo ƒe nuƒoƒo ɖea wo.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Wotutua ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒua anyi eye womeganɔa anyi o, ke ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe aƒe lia ke ɖaa.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Wokafua ame le nunya si le esi la ta, ke wodoa vlo ŋutsu tagbɔ kuku tɔwo.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Enyo be nànye ame tsɛ aɖe ko eye subɔla nanɔ asiwò, wu be nàwɔ ɖokuiwò amegãe eye nuɖuɖu manɔ asiwò o.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe léa be na eƒe lãwo ke dɔmenyo siwo ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ya wɔna la nye ŋutasesẽ.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Ame si ŋlɔ eƒe agble la akpɔ nuɖuɖu geɖe, ke ame si kplɔa blezibledi ɖo la, numanyalae.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu siwo woha la le ŋutasẽlawo dzrom, ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe ke ƒona ɖe to sesĩe.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu vlo ƒoƒo zua mɔ ɖenɛ, ke ame dzɔdzɔe dona le fu me.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe mɔ dzɔna le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkume, ke ame dzɔdzɔe xɔa aɖaŋuɖoɖo.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Bometsila ɖea eƒe dziku fiana zi ɖeka, ke nunyala doa toku dzudzu.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo nyateƒetɔ gblɔa nya si le eteƒe le ʋɔnu, ke aʋatsoɖasefo daa alakpa le ʋɔnu.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Nya vlowo ƒona ɖe ame abe yi ene, ke ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe aɖe hea dɔyɔyɔ vɛ.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Nyateƒenuyiwo nɔa anyi ɖikaa, ke alakpaɖe nu mesena yina o.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e medzɔna ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe dzi o, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo la, xaxa yɔa wo me fũu.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Yehowa lé fu alakpanuyiwo, ke ekpɔa dzidzɔ ɖe ame siwo toa nyateƒe la ŋu.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Nunyala mekɔa nu le sidzedze si su esi la dzi o, ke bometsilawo ƒe dzi ɖea gbeƒã woƒe bometsitsi.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Asi si doa vevi nu la aɖu fia, ke kuviawɔwɔ kplɔa ame ɖona ɖe dɔ sesẽ me.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Nuxaxa le dzi me tea ame ɖe anyi, ke amenuvenya dea dzi ƒo na ame.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ɖoa ŋu ɖo le xɔlɔ̃wɔwɔ me, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ kplɔa wo tranae.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ memea eƒe adelã o, ke nunyala léa be na eƒe nunɔamesiwo.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Agbe le dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ me, makumaku le mɔ ma dzi.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Vi nyanu ɖoa to fofoa ƒe amehehe, ke fewuɖula metsɔa ɖeke le mokaname me o.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nu ƒe kutsetsee wòtsɔna ɖua nu nyuiwoe, ke nuteƒemawɔlawo ƒe dzi tsi dzi ɖe nu vlo wɔwɔ ŋuti.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Ame si dzɔa eƒe nuyiwo ŋuti la dzɔa eƒe agbe ŋuti, ke ame si kea nu kabakaba la atsrɔ̃.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Nu dzroa kuviatɔ vevie gake mekpɔa naneke o, ke vevidonula ƒe didiwo vaa eme nɛ.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe léa fu alakpanya, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ya hea ŋukpe kple vlododo vɛ.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye dzɔa ŋutsu fɔmaɖila ƒe agbe ŋuti, ke vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi léa nu vɔ̃ wɔla ƒua anyi.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Ame aɖe wɔna abe kesinɔtɔe wònye ene, evɔ naneke mele esi o, ame bubu wɔa eɖokui ame dahee, evɔ kesinɔnu geɖe le esi.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe kesinɔnuwo ate ŋu aƒle eƒe agbe ta gake ame dahe mesea ŋɔdzidoname aɖeke o.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe kekeli klẽna nyuie, ke wotsia ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe akaɖi.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Dzre sɔŋ ko dada hena vɛ, ke nunya tsoa aƒe ɖe ame siwo sea aɖaŋu la gbɔ.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Ga si wokpɔ to mɔ fitifiti dzi la nu va yina, ke ame si dia ga vivivi la wɔnɛ be wòdzina ɖe edzi.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Mɔkpɔkpɔ si woɖe ɖa la nana dzi léa dɔ, ke didi si va eme la nye agbeti.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Ame si doa vlo amehehe la xɔa eŋufetu, ke ame si ɖoa to sedede la xɔa eteƒeɖoɖo.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe nufiafia nye agbevudo, eye wòɖea ame tso ku ƒe mɔkawo me.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Gɔmesese nyui hea amenuveve vanɛ, ke nuteƒemawɔlawo ƒe mɔ dzi sesẽna.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Nunyala ɖe sia ɖe wɔa nu kple gɔmesese, ke bometsila ɖea eƒe bometsitsi fiana.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Dɔtsɔla vɔ̃ɖi gena ɖe dzɔgbevɔ̃e me, ke dɔtsɔla si wɔa nuteƒe la hea dɔyɔyɔ vanɛ.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Ame si do toku amehehe la, ahedada kple ŋukpe vaa edzi, ke wodea bubu ame si lɔ̃a mokaname ŋuti.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Didi si vaa eme la vivina na luʋɔ, ke vɔ̃tsitsri nye ŋunyɔ na bometsilawo.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Ame si zɔna kple nunyala la, dzea nunya, ke ame si dzea xɔ̃ bometsilawo la gena ɖe fuwɔame me.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Dzɔgbevɔ̃e tia vɔ̃wɔla yome gake dzɔgbenyui nye ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe fetu.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Ame nyui gblẽa domenyinu ɖi na via ƒe viwo, ke woɖoa ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe kesinɔnuwo ɖi na ame dzɔdzɔewo.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ƒe agble wɔa nuku geɖe, ke amebaba kplɔnɛ dzonae.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Ame si vea nu le ameƒoti gbɔ la léa fu via, ke ame si lɔ̃a via la kpɔa egbɔ be yehee nyuie.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ɖua nu ɖia ƒo, ke dɔ wua ame vɔ̃ɖi ya.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu nyanu tua eya ŋutɔ ƒe xɔ, ke nyɔnu bometsila ya tsɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe asi vuvua xɔ si wòtu la kɔna ɖe anyi.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Ame si ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o la vɔ̃a Yehowa, ke ame siwo ƒe mɔ le gɔdɔ̃gɔdɔ̃ la doa vloe.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe nuƒo nana ameƒoti dzea eƒe dzimegbe, ke nunyala ƒe nuyi kpɔa eta.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Ne nyiwo meli o la, nyikpo me ɖia gbɔlo, ke woxaa nuku geɖe to nyitsu ƒe ŋusẽ me.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo nyateƒetɔ meblea ame o, ke aʋatsoɖasefo ya trɔa alakpa kɔna ɖi glẽglẽglẽ.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula dia nunya gake mekpɔa ɖeke o, ke gɔmesese vana na ame si si sidzedze le la bɔbɔe.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Te ɖa le bometsila gbɔ elabena màkpɔ gɔmesese le eƒe nu me o.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Ayedzelawo ƒe nunyae nye be woabu ta me le woƒe mɔwo ŋu, ke bometsilawo ƒe bometsitsie nye alakpa.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Bometsilawo le alɔme ɖem le nuvɔ̃ŋutivɔsa ŋuti, ke ŋudzedzekpɔkpɔ le dzɔdzɔetɔwo dome.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Dzi ɖe sia ɖe nya eya ŋutɔ ƒe vevesese eye ame aɖeke hã mate ŋu ama eƒe dzidzɔ kplii o.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe aƒe, ke ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe agbadɔ anɔ anyi ɖaa.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Mɔ aɖe li, si le dzɔdzɔe le ame ƒe ŋkume, ke le nuwuwua la, ekplɔa ame yia ku mee.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Le nukoko gɔ̃ hã me la, dzi ase veve eye dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ awu nu le nuxaxa me.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Woaxe fe na tosẽlawo le woƒe mɔwo ta eye nenema ke ame nyui hã axɔ eƒe fetu.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Susu wodzoetɔ xɔa nya sia nya dzi sena, ke nunyala dea ŋugble le eƒe afɔɖeɖewo ŋuti.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Nunyala léa fu vɔ̃ eye wòvɔa Yehowa, ke bometsila doa dziku kabakaba eye wòwɔa nu dzimagbɔɖitɔe.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ame si doa dɔmedzoe kabakaba la wɔa bometsinuwo eye wòléa fu ayedzela.

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Susu wodzoetɔwo ƒe domenyinue nye bometsitsi, ke wotsɔa sidzedze ɖɔna na nunyalawo.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo adze klo ɖe ame nyuiwo ŋkume eye nenema ke nu tovo wɔlawo awɔ le ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe agbonu.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ame dahewo ƒe aƒelikawo ke hã ƒoa asa na wo, ke xɔlɔ̃ geɖe nɔa kesinɔtɔwo si.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Ame si do vlo ehavi la wɔ nu vɔ̃, ke woayra ame si nyo dɔ me na hiãtɔ.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Ame siwo ɖoa nu vɔ̃ɖi la traa mɔ ke ame siwo wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe nu nyui wɔwɔ ŋu la xɔa lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ ƒe teƒeɖoɖo.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Kutrikuku ɖe dɔwɔna ŋu hea viɖe vɛ, ke nukpoloeƒoƒo ɖeɖe hea ame yia ahedada mee.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe kesinɔnue nye woƒe fiakuku, gake bometsilawo ƒe bometsinuwɔwɔ hea bometsitsi vanɛ.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɖasefo nyateƒetɔ ɖea ame geɖewo ƒe agbe, ke aʋatsoɖasefo nye ameblela.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Ame si vɔ̃a Yehowa la, mɔ sesẽ aɖe le esi eye wòanye bebeƒe na viawo.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Yehowa vɔvɔ̃e nye agbe ƒe vudo eye wòɖea ame tso ku ƒe mɔkawo me.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Ame xexlẽme gbogbo nye fia ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe, ke ne amewo mele du aɖe me o la, gbegblẽ vaa dumegã dzi.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Sidzedze gã aɖe sua ŋutsu dzigbɔɖitɔ si, ke ŋutsu si doa dziku kabakaba la, ɖea eƒe bometsitsi fiana.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Dzi si me ŋutifafa le la nana agbe ŋutilã gake ŋubiã nana ƒuwo ƒaƒãna.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Ame si tea ame dahewo ɖe anyi la doa vlo wo Wɔla, ke ame si nyoa dɔ me na hiãtɔ la dea bubu Mawu ŋuti.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Ne dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ la, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo yia to, ke le ku me ke hã la, ame dzɔdzɔewo kpɔa sitsoƒe.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Ame si si sidzedze su la, nunya tsoa aƒe ɖe eƒe dzi me, eye le bometsilawo dome gɔ̃ hã la, enana wodzea si ame si ƒomevi wònye.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔenyenye doa dukɔ ɖe dzi, ke nu vɔ̃ nye ŋukpe na dukɔmeviwo.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Dɔla nyanu ƒe nu nyoa fia ŋu, ke eƒe dɔmedzoe vaa dɔla ŋukpenanuwɔla dzi.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Nyaŋuɖoɖo kple gbe bɔbɔe tsia dziku nu, ke nyagbɔgblɔ kple gbedaɖeame nana dɔmedzoe flana.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe aɖe ɖea gɔmesese fiana, gake bometsinyawo dona tso bometsila nu glẽglẽglẽ.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Aɖe si hea dɔyɔyɔ vɛ la nye agbeti, ke alakpaɖe gbãa gbɔgbɔ gudugudugudu.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Bometsila doa vlo fofoa ƒe amehehe, ke ame si xɔa ɖɔɖɔɖo la, nunyalae.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu gã aɖe nɔa aƒe me na nunyala, ke ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe hokpɔkpɔ hea dzɔgbevɔ̃e vɛ na wo.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe nuyiwo kakaa sidzedze, ke mele alea le bometsilawo ƒe dzi me o.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Yehowa léa fu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe vɔsa, ke dzɔdzɔetɔwo ƒe gbedodoɖa dzea eŋu.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Yehowa léa fu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe mɔ, ke elɔ̃a ame siwo tia dzɔdzɔenyenye yome la ƒe mɔ.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Tohehe sesẽ le ame si tra le mɔ dzi la lalam eye ame si lé fu ɖɔɖɔɖo la aku.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ku kple tsiẽƒe le nuvo le Yehowa ŋkume, kaka wòahanye amegbetɔwo ƒe dzi!

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Fewuɖula tsri nyagbename eya ta mabia aɖaŋu le nunyalawo gbɔ o.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Dzi si si sidzedze su la dia gɔmesese gake bometsitsi zua nuɖuɖu na bometsila ƒe nu.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Ame siwo wole fu wɔmii la ƒe ŋkekewo katã nye vɔ̃ gake dzi si me dzidzɔ le la tua aglo atraɖii.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Nu sue si ŋu Yehowavɔvɔ̃ kpe ɖo la nyo wu kesinɔnu geɖe si ŋu dzimaɖeɖi le.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Amagbenuɖuɖu si ŋu lɔlɔ̃ kpe ɖo la nyo wu nyivi dami ɖuɖu si ŋu fuléle kpe ɖo.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Dɔmedzoetɔ hea mama vɛ, ke dzigbɔɖitɔ tsia dzre nu.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Ŋuwo le kuviatɔ ƒe mɔ dzi, ke dzɔdzɔetɔ ƒe mɔ nye mɔtata.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu nunyala hea dzidzɔ vɛ na fofoa, ke bometsila doa vlo dadaa.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Bometsinuwɔwɔ doa dzidzɔ na ame manyanu, ke nugɔmesela léa mɔ ɖeka tsɔna.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Ɖoɖowo me gblẽna ne aɖaŋudede meli o, ke ne aɖaŋuɖolawo li fũu la, wokpɔa dzidzedze.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Nyaŋuɖoɖo ɖe nunya me doa dzidzɔ na ame eye aleke nya si wogblɔ le egblɔɣi la mehenyoe o?

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Nunyalawo ƒe agbemɔ ɖo ta dzi, be wòakpe ɖe eŋu magaɖiɖi ayi ɖe tsiẽƒe o.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Yehowa gbãa dadalawo ƒe aƒe ƒua anyi, ke enana ahosiwo ƒe liƒo nɔa anyi pɛpɛpɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Yehowa léa fu ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe tameɖoɖo, ke ame siwo dza la tɔ ya doa dzidzɔ nɛ.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Ŋuklẽla hea fukpekpe vaa eƒe aƒe dzi, ke ame si lé fu zãnuxɔxɔ la anɔ agbe.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe dzi daa eƒe nyaŋuɖoɖowo kpɔ, ke nu vɔ̃ɖi doa go tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe nu me bababa.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Yehowa le adzɔge na ame vɔ̃ɖiwo, ke esea ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe gbedodoɖa.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Mo si kɔ la doa dzidzɔ na dzi, eye nya nyui dea agbe ƒuwo me.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖoa to mokaname si hea agbe vɛ la, ƒe dzi adze eme le nunyalawo dome.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Ame si doa toku amehehe la, doa vlo eɖokui, ke ame si xɔa mokaname la gɔmesese sua esi.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Yehowavɔvɔ̃ fiaa nunya ame eye ɖokuibɔbɔ doa ŋgɔ na bubu.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔ tɔe nye dzi ƒe nuɖoɖowo, ke nyaŋuɖoɖo na aɖe tsoa Yehowa gbɔ.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Fɔɖiɖi menɔa ame ŋutɔ ƒe mɔwo ŋu le eya ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkume o, ke Yehowa daa susuwo kpɔ.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Tsɔ nu sia nu si nèwɔna la de Yehowa ƒe asi me, ekema wò ɖoɖowo adze edzi na wò.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔ nu sia nu le eƒe ŋudɔwɔnu ta, eɖo ame vɔ̃ɖi la gɔ̃ hã ɖi hena dzɔgbevɔ̃eŋkeke la.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Dadalawo katã nye ŋunyɔnu na Yehowa. Maka ɖe edzi na wò be, womagbe tohehe na wo o.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Woɖea nu vɔ̃ ɖa to lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ me eye ame ƒoa asa na nu vɔ̃ɖi to Yehowavɔvɔ̃ me.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe ƒe mɔwo nyo Yehowa ŋu la, enana eƒe futɔwo gɔ̃ hã nɔa anyi kplii le ŋutifafa me.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Nu sue si ŋu dzɔdzɔenyenye kpe ɖo la nyo wu nu geɖe si ŋu madzɔmadzɔ kpe ɖo.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Ame wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe ale si wòazɔe ŋu le eƒe dzi me, gake Yehowae fiaa ale si wòaɖe afɔe.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Nudakpe kple nudanu vavãwo tso Yehowa gbɔ eye nenema ke nudakpe siwo katã le akplo me hã nye eƒe nuwɔwɔ.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Nu tovo wɔwɔ nye ŋunyɔnu na fiawo elabena woɖoa fiazikpui anyi ɖe dzɔdzɔenyenye dzi.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dziku nye ku ƒe dɔla, ke nunyala alé avui.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Ne fia ɖo mo kɔkɔe la, egɔmee nye agbe eye eƒe amenuveve le abe tsiɖoɖo le adame ene.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Aleke nunyaxɔxɔ mehenyo wu sikae o, eye gɔmesesetiatia mehenyo wu klosaloe o!

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe mɔtata ƒoa asa na nu vɔ̃ɖi eye ame si dzɔa eƒe mɔ ŋu la dzɔa eƒe agbe ŋuti.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Dada doa ŋgɔ na gbegblẽ eye ɖokuidodoɖedzi doa ŋgɔ na anyidzedze.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Enyo be woabɔbɔ ame ɖokui ɖe anyi le hiãtɔwo dome wu be woama afunyinuwo kple dadalawo.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Nu dzea edzi na ame si ɖoa to nufiame eye woayra ame si tsɔ eƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ da ɖe Yehowa dzi.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Woyɔa ame siwo nunya le woƒe dzi me la be sidzelawo, eye nya vivi doa nufiame ɖe ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Gɔmesese nye agbetsidzidzi na ame siwo ke ɖe eŋuti, ke bometsitsi hea tohehe vɛ na bometsilawo.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Nunyala ƒe dzi dzɔa eƒe nu ŋuti eye eƒe nuyiwo doa nufiame ɖe ŋgɔ.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Nya nyuiwo nye anyitsito, enana luʋɔ sea vivi, eye wòhea dɔyɔyɔ vɛ na ƒuwo.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Mɔ aɖe li si le dzɔdzɔe le ame ƒe ŋkume, ke le nuwuwua la, ekplɔa ame yia ku mee.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Agbatedɔwɔla ƒe nudzodzro wɔa dɔ nɛ, dɔwuame doa ŋusẽe be wòayi edzi.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Yakame le nu vɔ̃ɖi ɖom eye eƒe nuƒoƒo le abe dzo si le bibim sesĩe la ene.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi dea dzre aƒe eye amenyagblɔla maa xɔlɔ̃ veviwo dome.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Ame dzeaglã blea eƒe aƒelika nu, eye wòkplɔnɛ toa mɔ gɔglɔ̃ dzi.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Ame si le ŋku trom la le nu vɔ̃ɖi aɖe ɖom, eye ame si mia eƒe nu ɖe nu dzi la awɔ vɔ̃ godoo.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Ta si ƒo wɔ la nye atsyɔ̃fiakuku, agbe dzɔdzɔe nɔnɔe henɛ vɛ.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Enyo be nànye ŋutsu dzigbɔɖitɔ wu kalẽtɔ, ame si ɖu eƒe dziku dzi la nyo wu ame si xɔ du.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Wolɔa hotsui ɖe akɔ hetsɔna kaa nui, ke nyametsotso ɖe sia ɖe tso Yehowa gbɔ.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Abolo ƒuƒlu sue ɖuɖu si ŋu ŋutifafa kple dziɖeɖi kpe ɖo la nyo wu aƒe si me yɔ fũu kple agbeɖuɖu eye dzre kpe ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Dɔla nyanu aɖu aƒetɔ ɖe viŋutsu ŋukpenanuwɔla dzi eye ama domenyinu la kpli wo abe wo nɔviŋutsu wònye ene.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Sonu li na klosalo eye dzokpo li na sika, ke Yehowae doa dziwo katã kpɔ.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Ame si ɖea alɔme le ame dahe ŋuti la doa vlo woƒe Wɔla eye ame si kpɔa dzidzɔ be dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ la, womagbe tohehe nɛ o.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Ame si ku amegã la ƒe fiakukue nye viawo ƒe viwo eye dzilawo nye atsyɔ̃ na wo viwo.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Nuyi siwo doa wo ɖokuiwo ɖe dzi la medzena bometsila kaka alakpanuyiwo nahayi dziɖula dze ge o!

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Zãnu nye kpe xɔasi na ame si nae, afi sia afi si wòayi la, edzea dzi nɛ.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Ame si tsɔ nu tsyɔ vodada dzi la doa lɔlɔ̃ ɖe ŋgɔ eye ame si gawɔ nu si wòwɔ va yi la maa xɔlɔ̃ veviwo dome.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Mokaname dea ta me na ame si si sidzedze le wu nu si ƒoƒo alafa ɖeka nye na bometsila.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖoe kplikpaa be yeadze aglã eya ta woadɔ dumegã sẽŋuta ɖe eŋu.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Enyo be nàdo go sisiblisi si ŋu woɖe viwo le wu esi nàdo go bometsila le eƒe bometsitsi me.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu tsɔ vɔ̃ ɖo nyui teƒe la, vɔ̃ madzo ɖa le eƒe aƒe me kpɔ gbeɖe o.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Dzregɔmetoto le abe ale si woŋɔa tɔʋu ene; eya ta ɖe asi le nya ŋu hafi wòava zu dzre.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Afiatsotso na agɔdzela, kple fɔbubu agɔmadzela siaa nye nu si Yehowa tsri.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Ŋudɔwɔnu ka ga nye le bometsila ƒe asi me, esi didi aɖeke mele eme ɖe nunyadidi ŋuti o?

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Xɔlɔ̃ lɔ̃a ame ɣeawo katã ɣi, ke wodzi nɔviŋutsu hena hiãgbe.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃ dzrewɔwɔ la lɔ̃a nu vɔ̃ eye ame si de agbo kɔkɔ eƒe aƒe nu la le gbegblẽ dim.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Ame si si dzi dovo le la nu medzea edzi nɛ o eye ame si si alakpaɖe le la gena ɖe fukpekpe me.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu si tsi bome la hea veve vɛ, eye fofo si, si vi tsibome le la makpɔ dzidzɔ o.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Dzi si kpɔa dzidzɔ la nye atike nyui, ke gbɔgbɔ si wote ɖe to la nana ƒu tome ƒuna kplakplakpla.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi xɔa zãnu le bebeme be wòatrɔ nya dzɔdzɔe atsyɔ anyi.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Ame si si sidzedze le la ƒe ŋku nɔa nunya ŋu, ke bometsila ƒe ŋkuwo tsana, dona ɖe anyigba ƒe mlɔenu ke.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu tsibome hea nuxaxa vɛ na fofoa kple veve vɛ na ame si dzii.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Menyo be woahe to na fɔmaɖila alo aƒo dɔnunɔla ɖe eƒe nuteƒewɔwɔ ta o.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Ame si si sidzedze su la nya vlowo medona le enu o eye ame si si gɔmesese le la ɖɔa ŋu ɖo, medoa dziku dzodzro o.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Ɖokuitɔdila dia eɖokui ko tɔ eye meɖoa to nunyanya siwo gblɔm wole la o.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Bometsila medoa vivi ɖe gɔmesese ŋu o, ke boŋ ekpɔa dzidzɔ le eya ŋutɔ ƒe susuɖegblɔ ŋu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe numenyawo nye tɔ goglo, ke nunya ƒe vudo nye ta si le dzidzim.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Menyo be woade ame vɔ̃ɖi dzi alo atrɔ ame maɖifɔ ƒe nya dzɔdzɔe atsyɔ anyi o.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Bometsila ƒe nuyiwo denɛ dzre me eye eƒe nu hea ƒoƒo vaa edzii.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nu si bometsila ƒe nu gblɔ la, metso eya ŋutɔ gbɔ o, eye eƒe nuyi nye mɔka na eƒe luʋɔ.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Amenyagblɔla ƒe nyawo vivina abe nuɖuɖu vivi si woka de nu me la ene; woyina ɖe ame ƒe dɔgbowo me ke.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔa alɔgblɔdɔ le eƒe dɔ ŋuti la nye nugblẽla nɔvi.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe ŋkɔ nye mɔ sesẽ, ame dzɔdzɔewo sina yia eme eye wonɔa dedie.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Kesinɔtɔwo ƒe kesinɔnuwo nye woƒe du sesẽ eye wobuna be wonye gli kɔkɔ si ame aɖeke mate ŋu aflɔ o.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Enye bometsitsi kple ŋukpe na ame, be wòaɖo nya ŋu hafi ase nu si gblɔm wole.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe gbɔgbɔ lénɛ ɖe te le dɔléle me, ke ame ka ate ŋu atsɔ gbɔgbɔ si gbã gudugudu?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Sidzela ƒe dzi kpɔa gɔmesese eye nunyala ƒe to dia gɔmesese.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Nunana ʋua mɔ na nunala eye wòkplɔnɛ gena ɖe amegã la ƒe ŋkumee.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Ame gbãtɔ si to eƒe nya la dzena dzɔdzɔetɔe va se ɖe esime ame aɖe va bia gbee.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Nudzidze tsia dzre nu eye wòtsoa nya me na ame sesẽ siwo le dzre wɔm.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Nɔviŋutsu si dzi wodze agɔ le la sẽ wu du si ŋu woɖo gli sesẽ ɖo eye dzrewɔwɔ le abe fiasã si ƒe agbowo ŋu wode gameti sesẽwoe ene.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Ku kple agbe ƒe ŋusẽ le aɖe si, eye ame siwo lɔ̃e la aɖu eƒe kutsetse.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame si si srɔ̃nyɔnu su la ke ɖe nu nyui ŋu eye wòxɔa amenuveve tso Yehowa gbɔ.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ɖea kuku biaa nublanuikpɔkpɔ, ke kesinɔtɔ ya ɖoa nya ŋu adãtɔe.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Ame si si xɔlɔ̃ geɖe le la ate ŋu awu nu le gbegblẽ me, gake xɔlɔ̃ aɖe li si kuna ɖe ame ŋu wu dadavi gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Anyo be nànye ame dahe si ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu fɔɖiɖi mele o, wu bometsila si ƒe nuyiwo gblɔa nya tovo.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Menyo be dzo nanɔ mewò ɖe nuwo wɔwɔ ŋu gɔmesesemanɔmee alo atsi dzi ahabu mɔ o.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Ame ŋutɔ ƒe bometsitsie gblẽa eƒe agbe dome, evɔ eƒe dzi bina ɖe Yehowa ŋu.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnunɔamesi dzea xɔlɔ̃ geɖe na ame, gake ame dahe ƒe xɔlɔ̃wo kakana le eŋu.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Ame geɖewo wɔa nu be woadze fia ŋu, eye ame si naa nu ame faa la, ame sia ame dzea xɔ̃e.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ame dahe ƒe ƒometɔwo katã ɖea kɔ ɖa le eŋu, aleke exɔlɔ̃wo magbee geɖe wu o! Togbɔ be etia wo yome nɔa kuku ɖem na wo hã la, womedea nu eme nɛ o.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Ame si, si nunya su la lɔ̃a eya ŋutɔ ƒe luʋɔ eye ame si melɔ̃a nu le gɔmesese gbɔ o la, nu dzea edzi nɛ.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Agbe vivi nɔnɔ medze bometsila ʋuu keke wòahanye be kluvi ɖu aƒetɔ ɖe dumegãwo dzi o.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Ame ƒe nunya nana wògbɔa dzi ɖi eye ŋutikɔkɔe wònye nɛ ne eŋe aɖaba ƒu dzidada dzi.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dziku le abe dzata ƒe gbetete ene, ke eƒe amenuveve le abe zãmu le gbedzi ene.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Viŋutsu tsibome nye fofoa ƒe gbegblẽ eye srɔ̃nyɔnu dzrewɔla le abe tsitrɔnu si le ɖuɖum ɖaa ene.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Aƒewo kple kesinɔnuwo nye domenyinu tso dzilawo gbɔ, ke srɔ̃nyɔnu nyanu ya, Yehowa gbɔe wòtsona.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Kuvia nana ame dɔa alɔ̃ yia eme ʋĩi eye dɔ wua ƒomewɔla.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Ame si wɔna ɖe sedede dzi la dzɔa eƒe agbe ŋu, ke ame si metsɔ ɖeke le eƒe mɔwo ŋu o la aku.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Ame si nyo dɔ me na hiãtɔ la, do nugbana na Yehowa, aɖo nu si wòwɔ la teƒe nɛ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: He to na viwò ŋutsuvi elabena eya mee mɔkpɔkpɔ le; ke mègakpe ɖe ame siwo le eƒe ku dim la ŋuti o.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Ame si dzi kuna helĩhelĩ la, axe eŋutife; ne èɖee le eme la, agawɔe ake.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Ɖo to aɖaŋuɖoɖo, nàxɔ amehehe eye le nuwuwua la, àdze nunya.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Nu geɖewo ame ɖo ɖe eƒe dzi me, gake Yehowa ƒe ɖoɖo koe vaa eme.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Nu si ame dina lae nye lɔlɔ̃ si meʋãna o; enyo be nànye ame dahe wu alakpatɔ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Yehowavɔvɔ̃ kplɔa ame yia agbe gbɔe. Ekema ànɔ anyi aɖe dzi ɖi eye kuxi aɖeke maƒo go wò o.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Ne kuviatɔ de asi nuɖugba me la, maɖee ɖa atsɔ yi nu gbɔe teti gɔ̃ hã o!

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Ƒo fewuɖula kple ati, ekema gegemewo adze nunya; ka mo na ame si si sidzedze le, ekema gɔmesese asu esi.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Ame si daa adzo fofoa, nyaa dada doa goe lae nye viŋutsu si hea ŋukpe kple vlododo vɛ.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Vinye, ne èdzudzɔ amehenyawo sese la, ekema àtra tso gɔmesese ƒe nyawo gbɔ.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Aʋatsoɖasefo ɖua fewu le afia nyui tsotso ŋu eye ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe nu miaa nu vɔ̃ɖi.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Woɖo tohehe ɖi na fewuɖulawo eye woɖo ƒoƒo ɖi na bometsilawo ƒe dzime.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Wain nye fewuɖula eye aha muame nye avuwɔla, ame si wokplɔ trae la menya nu o.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Fia ƒe dziku doa vɔvɔ̃ abe dzata ƒe gbetete ene ame si do dziku nɛ la bua eƒe agbe.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Bubu wònye na ŋutsu ne eƒo asa na dzre gake bometsila ɖe sia ɖe wɔa dzre kabakaba.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Kuviatɔ meŋlɔa agble le agbledeɣi o, eya ta edia nu le nuŋeɣi doa kpoe.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ƒe tameɖoɖowo nye tɔ goglo, gake ame si si nugɔmesese su la akui wòavɔ.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Ŋutsu geɖewo gblɔna be lɔlɔ̃ matrɔ le yewo si gake ame ka ate ŋu akpɔ ŋutsu nuteƒewɔla?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Ame dzɔdzɔe nɔa agbe si ŋu kpɔtsɔtsɔ mele o; yayra anɔ viawo dzi emegbe gɔ̃ hã.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Ame ka ate ŋu agblɔ bena, “Mewɔ nye dzi dzadzɛe, ŋutinye kɔ eye vɔ̃ mele ŋutinye o?”

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Yehowa lé fu nudakpe vovovo eve kple nudzidzenu vovovo eve siaa.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Wonyaa ɖevi gɔ̃ hã to eƒe nuwɔna me, ne ele agbe dzadzɛ eye eƒe nuwɔnawo le eteƒe.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: Yehowa wɔ to si sea nu kple ŋku si kpɔa nu la siaa.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Mègalɔ̃ alɔ̃ tsu dɔdɔ o, ne menye nenema o la, àva zu hiãtɔ, nɔ ŋu ekema àɖu nu wòasusɔ.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Sika li, adzagba hã li fũu gake nuyi siwo gblɔa nunyanya la, kpe xɔasi veviwo wonye.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Xɔ avɔ le ame si da megbe na amedzro la si, tsɔe ɖo awɔbae ne eda megbe na nyɔnu gbolowɔla.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu si wokpɔ to amefuflu me la vivina na ŋutsu, gake le nuwuwu la, eƒe nu me yɔna kple kpekui sɔŋ.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɖoɖo to aɖaŋuxɔxɔ me, ne èle aʋa wɔm la, bia mɔfiame.

english_verse: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
translation_verse: Amenyagblɔla ʋua go nya ɣaɣla eya ta ƒo asa na ŋutsu nukpoloeƒola.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Ne ŋutsu do ɖiŋu na fofoa alo dadaa la, woatsi eƒe akaɖi ne ele viviti tsiɖitsiɖi me.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Domenyinu si wokpɔ to mɔ kpui dzi le gɔmedzedzea me la, yayra manɔ edzi le nuwuwua o.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Mègagblɔ be, “Maɖo vɔ̃ si nèwɔ ɖe ŋunye la teƒe na wò” o! Kpɔ Yehowa ƒe asinu ekema aɖe wò.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Yehowa lé fu nudakpe ƒomevi vovovowo eye nudanu amebatɔ hã menyoa Yehowa ŋu o.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Yehowa fiaa afɔɖeɖe ame, ke aleke ame aɖe awɔ ase eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔwo gɔme?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Mɔ wònye na ame ne ekɔ nane ŋu tamemabumabutɔe eye emegbe hafi wòva bu adzɔgbe si wòɖe la ŋuti.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Fia nyanu gbɔa ame vɔ̃ɖiwo eye wòzɔa wo dzi kple luƒotasiaɖam.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Yehowa ƒe akaɖi kpɔa ame ƒe gbɔgbɔ me eye wòdzroa eƒe ememe ke kpɔ.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Lɔlɔ̃ kple nuteƒewɔwɔ nana fia nɔa dedinɔnɔ me eye to lɔlɔ̃ me eƒe fiazikpui lia ke.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Ɖekakpuiwo ƒe ŋusẽe nye woƒe ŋutikɔkɔe eye ta ƒowɔ nye ame tsitsiwo ƒe atsyɔ̃.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Kɔ kple abixɔxɔ ɖea vɔ̃ ɖa eye ƒoƒo klɔa ame ƒe ememe ke.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu ƒe mɔwo katã dzea eŋu gake Yehowae daa dziwo kpɔ.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Nu dzɔdzɔe kple nu si le eteƒe wɔwɔ doa dzidzɔ na Yehowa wu vɔsa.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Ŋku gã kple dzi si me dada le lae nye ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe akaɖi, evɔ wòhenye nu vɔ̃.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Vevidonula ƒe ɖoɖoɖowo hea viɖe vɛ nenema kee dzitsitsi hea ahedada vɛ.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Kesinɔnu si wotsɔ alakpaɖe kpɔe la nu va yina kaba abe ƒuƒu ene eye wònye mɔ si ŋu aɖi vɔ̃ɖi le.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ŋutasẽnuwɔwɔ ahe wo adzoe elabena wogbe be yewomawɔ nu nyui o.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Fɔɖila ƒe mɔ le gɔdɔ̃gɔdɔ̃ gake fɔmaɖila ƒe nuwɔwɔ le dzɔdzɔe.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Enyo be woanɔ dzogoe dzi le xɔta wu be woanɔ xɔ ɖeka me kple srɔ̃nyɔnu dzrewɔla.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ dzroa ame vɔ̃ɖi vevie, mekpɔa nublanui na ehavi o.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Ne wohe to na fewuɖula la, bometsilawo dzea nunya; ne wofia nu nunyala la, sidzedze sua esi.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Dzɔdzɔetɔ la ɖea ŋku ɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe aƒe ŋu, eye wòhea gbegblẽ vaa ame vɔ̃ɖi la dzi.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe do toku ame dahe ƒe ɣlidodo la, ne eya hã do ɣli la, ame aɖeke masee nɛ o.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Afia nyui tsotso hea dzidzɔ vɛ na ame dzɔdzɔe, ke ehea ŋɔdzi vɛ na vɔ̃ wɔlawo.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu si tra tso gɔmesese ƒe mɔ dzi la va dzudzɔna le ame kukuwo ƒe ha me.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Ame si lɔ̃a agbeɖuɖu la azu hiãtɔ eye ame si lɔ̃a wain kple ami la makpɔ hotsui o.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Ame vɔ̃ɖi zua avulénu ɖe ame dzɔdzɔe teƒe eye nenema ke nuteƒemawɔla ɖea nuteƒewɔla nu.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Enyo be nànɔ dzogbe wu be nànɔ anyi kple srɔ̃nyɔnu dzrewɔla kple dɔmedzoedola.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Nuɖuɖu vivi kple ami bɔ ɖe nunyala ƒe aƒe me fũu, gake bometsila ɖua nu sia nu si le esi.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Ame si tia dzɔdzɔenyenye kple lɔlɔ̃ la, tia agbe, dzidzedze kple bubu.
