translation_verse: Mawudɔla enelia ku eƒe kpẽ la. Tete wòtsɔ nu xe ɣe, ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo ƒe mama etɔ̃ ƒe ɖeka ŋkume, eye viviti do. Ale ŋkeke ƒe mama etɔ̃ ƒe ɖeka mekpɔ kekeli o, eye nenema ke zã ƒe mama etɔ̃ ƒe ɖeka hã mekpɔ kekeli o.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Esi mele nu siawo kpɔm la, mese hɔ̃ aɖe si nɔ dzodzom le dziƒo titina la gblɔ kple gbe gã aɖe be, “Babaa! Babaa! Babaa na anyigbadzinɔlawo le kpẽ siwo mawudɔla etɔ̃ mamlɛawo ava ku la ta!”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla atɔ̃lia ku eƒe kpẽ la, eye mekpɔ ɣletivi si ge tso dziƒo va dze anyigba dzi la. Wotsɔ ʋe globo la ƒe safui na ɣletivi sia.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Esi wòʋu nu le ʋe globo la nu la, dzudzɔ do tso eme abe abolokpo gã aɖe mee dzudzɔ le dodom le ene. Dzudzɔ gã la na be ɣe kple dziŋgɔli do viviti.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Ʋetsuviwo ƒe ha gã aɖe do go tso dzudzɔ la me va anyigba dzi, eye wòna ŋusẽ wo be woawɔ nu abe ahɔ̃ siwo le anyigba dzi la ene.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Wode se na wo be womegagblẽ gbe siwo le anyigba dzi, numiemie loo alo atiwo o, ke boŋ woagblẽ ame siwo Mawu ƒe nutrenu mele ŋgonu na o la.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Womena ŋusẽ wo be woawu wo o, ke boŋ be woawɔ funyafunya wo dzinu atɔ̃. Ale fukpekpe si me woto la nɔ abe ale si ame si ahɔ̃ te la sea vevee ene.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Le ŋkeke mawo me la, amewo adi ku, gake womakpɔe o. Ku adzro wo vevie, gake ku asi abu ɖe wo.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Ʋetsuviawo ƒe dzedzeme le abe sɔ siwo bla akpa hena aʋayiyi ene. Woɖɔ nane ɖe ta si le abe sikafiakuku ene, eye woƒe mowo ɖi amegbetɔwo tɔ.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Woƒe ɖa le abe nyɔnuwo ƒe ɖa ene, eye woƒe aɖuwo le abe dzatawo tɔ ene.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Wodo akɔtakpoxɔnu siwo le abe gayibɔkɔtakpoxɔnuwo ene, eye woƒe aʋalawo ƒe hoowɔwɔ le abe sɔwo kple tasiaɖamwo ƒe hoowɔwɔ ne wolũ ɖe aʋa me la ene.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Asiketiwo kple tiwo le wo si abe ahɔ̃wo tɔ ene, eye ŋusẽ le woƒe asiketiwo me be woawɔ funyafunya amewo hena ɣleti atɔ̃.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Woƒe fiae nye mawudɔla si le ʋe globo la dzi kpɔm, ame si ƒe ŋkɔe nye Abadon le Hebrigbe me kple Apolion le Grikgbe me .

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃ gbãtɔ nu va yi, eye vɔ̃ eve bubuwo le mɔ dzi gbɔna.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla adelia ku eƒe kpẽ la. Tete mese gbe aɖe tso sikavɔsamlekpui si nɔ Mawu ŋkume la ƒe lãdzowo gbɔ.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Gbe la gblɔ na mawudɔla adelia si lé kpẽ la ɖe asi la be, “Ɖe ga mawudɔla ene siwo wobla da ɖe Frat tɔsisi gã la to la.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ale woɖe ga mawudɔla ene siwo wodzra ɖo ɖi na gaƒoƒo vevi, ŋkeke vevi, dzinu vevi kple ƒe vevi sia be woayi aɖawu amegbetɔƒomea ƒe mama etɔ̃ ƒe ɖeka.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Asrafo siwo do sɔ la ƒe xexlẽme anɔ miliɔn alafa eve (

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Sɔ kple sɔdola siwo mekpɔ le nye ŋutega me la ƒe dzedzeme nɔ ale: Woƒe akɔtakpoxɔnu biã hẽe abe dzo ene; ɖewo nye blɔ, eye ɖewo hã ɖi aŋuti ɖiɖi abe sulfakpe ene. Sɔawo ƒe tawo ɖi dzatawo ƒe ta, eye dzudzɔ kple sulfakpe do tso woƒe nuwo me.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Dzo, dzudzɔ kple sulfakpe si do go tso sɔawo ƒe nu me la wu amegbetɔƒomea ƒe mama etɔ̃ ƒe ɖeka.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Sɔawo ƒe ŋusẽ le woƒe nuwo kple asiketiwo me, elabena woƒe asiketiwo le abe dawo ene, eye ta li na asiketiawo, esiwo wotsɔna dea abi amewo ŋui.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Amegbetɔƒomea si susɔ, ame siwo dɔvɔ̃ siawo mewu o la gbe tɔtrɔ le woƒe asiwo ƒe nu tovowo wɔwɔ me. Wogbe be yewomaɖe asi le gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃wo subɔsubɔ, sika, klosalo, akɔbli, kpe kple ati legba siwo metea ŋu kpɔa nu, sea nu loo alo zɔna o la subɔsubɔ ŋuti o.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Nenema ke wometrɔ le woƒe amewuwu, afakaka, ahasiwɔwɔ alo fififi yome o.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ mawudɔla triakɔ bubu wòtso dziƒo gbɔna. Lilikpo nye awu ʋlaya wòdo, eye anyieʋɔ le eƒe ta dzi, eƒe mo le abe ɣe ene, eye eƒe afɔwo le abe dzosɔtiwo ene.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Elé agbalẽ sue aɖe ɖe asi, esi le ʋuʋu le eƒe asiƒome. Etsɔ eƒe ɖusifɔ da ɖe atsiaƒu me, tsɔ eƒe miafɔ da ɖe anyigba dzi,

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: eye wòdo ɣli sesẽ aɖe abe dzata ƒe gbeɖeɖe ene. Esi wòdo ɣlia la, dziɖegbe adreawo ƒe gbe ɖi.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Esi dziɖegbe adreawo ƒo nu la, menɔ klalo be maŋlɔ nu, gake mese gbe aɖe tso dziƒo gblɔ nam be, “Tre nu si dziɖegbe adreawo gblɔ la nu, eye mègaŋlɔe da ɖi o.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ke mawudɔla si mekpɔ wònɔ tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu me kple anyigba dzi la do eƒe ɖusibɔ ɖe dziƒo,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: eye wòyɔ eya ame si nɔ agbe tegbetegbe, ame si wɔ dziƒowo kple nu siwo katã le wo me, anyigba kple nu siwo le edzi kple atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme la ƒe ŋkɔ heka atam be, “Heheɖemegbe aɖeke maganɔ anyi o!

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Gake le ŋkeke siwo me mawudɔla adrelia aku eƒe kpẽa la, Mawu ƒe nu ɣaɣla la ava eme abe ale si wòɖe gbeƒã na eƒe dɔla nyagblɔɖilawoe ene.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Esi gbe si mese tso dziƒo gaƒo nu nam la, egblɔ nam be, “Heyi nàxɔ agbalẽ si le ʋuʋu le mawudɔla si le tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu me kple anyigba dzi la ƒe asi me.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Ale meyi ɖe mawudɔla la gbɔ, eye mebiae be wòatsɔ agbalẽ sue la nam. Egblɔ nam be, “Xɔe, eye nàɖui. Atrɔ azu nu veve le wò dɔ me, gake le wò nu me ya la, avivi abe anyitsi ene.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Mexɔ agbalẽ sue la le mawudɔla la si, eye meɖui. Evivi le nye nu me abe anyitsi ene, ke esi meɖui vɔ la, etrɔ zu nu veve le nye dɔ me.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Eyi edzi gblɔ nam be, “Ele na wò be nàgagblɔ nya ɖi tso ame geɖewo, dukɔwo, gbegbɔgblɔwo kple fiawo ŋuti.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Ke ɖe xɔxɔnu si le gbedoxɔa ŋuti la le eme; mègadzidzee o, elabena wotsɔe na ame siwo menye Yudatɔwo o. Woanya avuzi le du kɔkɔe la dzi ɣleti blaene-vɔ-eve sɔŋ.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Mana ŋusẽ nye ɖasefo eveawo, eye woata akpanya agblɔ nya ɖi hena ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eve blaade (

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Esiawoe nye amiti eve kple akaɖiti eve siwo le tsitre ɖe anyigba la ƒe Aƒetɔ la ŋkume.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Ne ame aɖe dze agbagba be yeawɔ nu vevi wo la, dzo dona le woƒe nu me hefiaa woƒe futɔwo. Aleae ame si di be yeawɔ nu vevi wo la akue.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋutsu siawo la, ŋusẽ le wo si be woatu dziŋgɔli, ale be tsi magadza le ɣeyiɣi si me wole nya gblɔm ɖi la o; ŋusẽ le wo si be woatrɔ tsiwo woazu ʋu, eye woada dɔvɔ̃ ƒomevi vovovowo ɖe anyigba dzi zi ale si wolɔ̃.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: Woƒe ŋutilã kukuawo amlɔ du gã la ƒe mɔtatawo dzi, du gã si wona ŋkɔe le nyamenya nu be Sodom kple Egipte, afi si woklã woƒe Aƒetɔ la ɖe ati ŋu le.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Amewo atso ƒome ɖe sia ɖe, to ɖe sia ɖe, gbegbɔgblɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe me akpɔ woƒe ŋutilã kukuawo ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã, eye woagbe be yewomaɖi wo o.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzinɔlawo akpɔ dzidzɔ le wo ŋuti, eye woaɖu azã, aɖo nunanawo ɖe wo nɔewo, elabena nyagblɔɖila eve siawo wɔ funyafunya ame siwo le anyigba dzi la.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Ke le ŋkeke etɔ̃ kple afã la megbe la, agbegbɔgbɔ tso Mawu gbɔ ge ɖe ame kukuawo me, wotsi tsitre, eye ŋɔdzi gã aɖe lé ame siwo kpɔ wo la.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Tete wose gbe gã aɖe tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be, “Miva dziƒo afii.” Ale woyi dziƒo le lilikpo me, eye woƒe futɔwo da ŋku ɖe wo dzi.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Le gaƒoƒo ma ke me la, anyigba ʋuʋu ŋɔdzitɔe, eye du la ƒe mama ewo dometɔ ɖeka mu dze anyi; ame akpe adre (

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Babadodo evelia nu va yi, ke etɔ̃lia gbɔna kpuie. Kpẽ adrelia kuku

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla adrelia ku eƒe kpẽ la, eye gbe sesẽ aɖewo ɖi le dziƒo nutowo me bena, “Xexea me ƒe fiaɖuƒe la zu míaƒe Aƒetɔ kple eƒe Kristo la ƒe fiaɖuƒe, eye wòaɖu fia tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: le gbɔgblɔm be, “O Aƒetɔ Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, míeda akpe na wò, wò ame si li fifia, eye nènɔ anyi kpɔ, elabena èxɔ wò ŋusẽ triakɔ la, eye nèdze dziɖuɖu gɔme.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Dukɔwo le nyanyram, eye wò dziku ɖiɖi va. Ɣeyiɣi de be woadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu kukuawo, eye woatu fe na wò dɔla, nyagblɔɖilawo, wò ame kɔkɔeawo kple ame siwo dea bubu wò ŋkɔ ŋuti la, ame gblɔewo kple amegãwo siaa. Nenema ke míeda akpe na wò be nètsrɔ̃ ame siwo tsrɔ̃ anyigba la.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, woʋu Mawu ƒe gbedoxɔ le dziƒo, eye wokpɔ Mawu ƒe nubablaɖaka le eƒe gbedoxɔ me. Tete dzi ke dzo, dzi ɖe gbe, sokpewo ge, anyigba ʋuʋu, eye kpetsi gã aɖe dza.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Fu nɔ eƒo, eye wònɔ ɣli dom esi wònɔ ku lém be yeadzi vi.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Emegbe la, dzesi bubu gadze le dziƒo: ʋɔ driba gã dzẽ aɖe si to ta adre, dzo ewo, eye fiakuku adre le tawo nɛ la va do.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Eƒe asike kplɔ ɣletivi siwo le dziŋgɔli ŋu la ƒe mama etɔ̃ ƒe ɖeka, eye wòhe wo ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba. Ʋɔ driba la nɔ tsitre ɖe nyɔnu si nɔ ku lém la ŋkume, eye wòle klalo be yeavuvu vidzĩ si nyɔnu la adzi la.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Nyɔnu la dzi ŋutsuvi, ame si ava aɖu dukɔwo katã dzi kple gatikplɔ. Tete woxɔ ɖevi la le esi kaba tsɔ yi ɖe Mawu kple eƒe fiazikpui la gbɔe.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Emegbe la, nyɔnu la si yi gbedzi le teƒe si Mawu dzra ɖo ɖi nɛ, afi si woakpɔ eta le hena ŋkeke akpe ɖeka alafa eve blaade (

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Eye aʋa dzɔ le dziƒo. Maikel kple eƒe mawudɔlawo wɔ aʋa kple ʋɔ driba la, eye ʋɔ driba la kple eƒe dɔlawo hã wɔ aʋa kpli wo.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Ke ʋɔ driba la ƒe ŋusẽ metri akɔ o, ale wobu woƒe nɔƒe le dziƒo.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ ʋɔ driba gã la, da xoxo si woyɔna be gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ alo Abosam, ame si kplɔ xexea me katã trae la ƒu gbe. Wotsɔ eya ŋutɔ kple eƒe dɔlawo ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Tete mese gbe sesẽ aɖe tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be, “Azɔ ko míaƒe Mawu la ƒe ɖeɖe, ŋusẽ kple fiaɖuƒe la kple eƒe Kristo ƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe ŋusẽ la va ɖo, elabena wotsɔ mía nɔviawo nu tsola, ame si nɔa wo nu tsom zã kple keli le Mawu ŋkume la ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Woɖu edzi to Alẽvi la ƒe ʋu kple woƒe ɖaseɖiɖi me. Womelɔ̃ woƒe agbe nenema gbegbe be woayi sisi ge le ku nu o,

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: eya ta dzi nedzɔ mi, mi dziƒowo kple mi ame siwo nɔ wo me la! Ke baba na anyigba kple atsiaƒu, elabena Abosam ɖi va mia gbɔ! Dzi le ekum vevie, elabena enyae be yeƒe ɣeyiɣi la le kpuie.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Esi ʋɔ driba la kpɔ be wotsɔ ye ƒu gbe ɖe anyigba la, eti nyɔnu si dzi ŋutsuvi la yome.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Wotsɔ hɔ̃ gã aɖe ƒe aʋala eveawo na nyɔnu la, ale be wòate ŋu adzo ayi ɖe teƒe si wodzra ɖo ɖi nɛ le gbedzi, afi si woakpɔ eta le hena ɣeyiɣi aɖe, ɣeyiɣiwo kple ɣeyiɣi afã le afi si ʋɔ driba la mate ŋu ade o la.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Tete ʋɔ driba la tu tsi to eƒe nu me, esi ɖuɖu abe tɔsisi ene, ne wòaɖɔ alé nyɔnu la, eye tɔsisi la nakplɔe adzoe.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Ke anyigba la kpe ɖe nyɔnu la ŋu esi wòke eƒe nu hemi tɔsisi si ʋɔ driba la tu to eƒe nu me la.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Dzi ku ʋɔ driba la vevie ɖe nyɔnu la ŋu, eye wòyi be yeaɖawɔ aʋa kple eƒe dzidzimevi mamlɛawo, ame siwo ɖoa to Mawu kple eƒe sededewo, eye wolé Yesu ƒe ɖaseɖiɖi me ɖe asi sesĩe la.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Ale ʋɔ driba la nɔ tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu la to. Tete mekpɔ lã wɔadã aɖe wòdo go tso atsiaƒu me gbɔna. Eto dzo ewo kple ta adre; fiakuku ewo nɔ dzoawo dzi, eye woŋlɔ busuŋkɔwo ɖe ta adreawo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe ŋu.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Lã wɔadã si mekpɔ la ɖi lãkle, gake eƒe afɔwo nɔ abe sisiblisi tɔwo ene, eye eƒe nu le abe dzata tɔ ene. Ʋɔ driba la tsɔ eƒe ŋusẽ, fiazikpui kple dziɖuɖuŋusẽ na lã wɔadã la.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Edze abe lã wɔadã la ƒe tawo dometɔ ɖeka ɖe wòxɔ abi vevie ene, gake abi gã si wòxɔ la ku. Xexea me katã ƒe nu ku, eye wodze lã wɔadã la yome.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Amewo subɔ ʋɔ driba la, elabena etsɔ dziɖuɖu ƒe ŋusẽ na lã wɔadã la, eye wosubɔ lã wɔadã la hã hebia be, “Ame kae le abe lã wɔadã la ene? Ame kae ate ŋu awɔ aʋa kplii?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Wona nu lã wɔadã la be wòagblɔ adegbeƒonyawo kple busunyawo, eye be wòaɖu dzi hena ɣleti blaene-vɔ-eve.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Eke eƒe nu be yeagblɔ busunya ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye yeaƒo ɖi eƒe ŋkɔ, eƒe nɔƒe kple ame siwo katã li kplii le dziƒo la.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Wona ŋusẽe be wòawɔ aʋa kple ame kɔkɔeawo, eye wòaɖu wo dzi. Nenema ke wona dziɖuɖuŋusẽe ɖe to sia to, ƒome sia ƒome, gbegbɔgblɔ sia gbegbɔgblɔ kple dukɔ sia dukɔ dzi.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Anyigbadzitɔwo katã asubɔ lã wɔadã la, ame siwo ƒe ŋkɔwo womeŋlɔ ɖe Alẽvi si wowu tso xexea me ƒe gɔmedzedze ke la ƒe agbegbalẽ la me o.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Ame si to senu li na la nesee.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: “Ne ame aɖe ayi aboyo me la, aboyo mee wòayi. Ne woawu ame aɖe kple yi la, yie woatsɔ awui.” Esia hiã na dzigbɔɖi le dzidodo me kple nuteƒewɔwɔ le ame kɔkɔeawo ƒe akpa dzi. Lã wɔadã si do go tso anyigba ƒe tume

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ lã wɔadã bubu wònɔ dodom tso anyigba ƒe tume. Eto dzo eve abe agbovi ene, gake enɔ nu ƒom abe ʋɔ driba ene.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Ewɔ lã wɔadã gbãtɔ ƒe dziɖuɖuŋusẽwo katã ŋu dɔ ɖe lã wɔadã gbãtɔ teƒe, eye wòna be anyigba kple edzinɔlawo katã nasubɔ lã wɔadã gbãtɔ, ame si ƒe kubi wowɔ wòku la.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Ewɔ dzesi kple nukunu gãwo, eye wòna be dzo gɔ̃ hã ge tso dziƒo va dze anyi le amewo ƒe ŋkume.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Le ŋusẽ si wonae be wòawɔ nukunuwo ɖe lã wɔadã gbãtɔ teƒe ta la, eble anyigbadzitɔwo katã. Ede se na wo be woali legba abe bubudede lã wɔadã si ŋu wode abi kple yi, eye wògale agbe la ŋu ene.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Wona ŋusẽe be wòade gbɔgbɔ lã wɔadã gbãtɔ ƒe legba me, ale be legba la nate ŋu aƒo nu, eye be woawu ame siwo katã gbe be yewomasubɔ lã wɔadã la ƒe legba o la.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Nenema ke wòzi ame sia ame, suewo kple gãwo, kesinɔtɔwo kple ame dahewo, ablɔɖeviwo kple kluviwo dzi be woade dzesi woƒe nuɖusibɔ alo woƒe ŋgonu,

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: ale be ame aɖeke mate ŋu aƒle nu alo adzra nu o, negbe ɖe wòxɔ dzesi si nye lã wɔadã la ƒe ŋkɔ alo xexlẽme si nye eƒe ŋkɔ la hafi.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Esia hiã nunya. Ne sidzedze le ame aɖe si la, nebu lã wɔadã la ƒe xexlẽme kpɔ, elabena enye ame ƒe xexlẽme ƒe dzesi. Eƒe xexlẽme ƒe dzesie nye alafa ade blaade-vɔ-ade.

english_verse: who had been rescued from the earth.
translation_verse: ), ame siwo woɖe tso anyigba dzi la ko.

translation_verse: Kasia mekpɔ Alẽvi la le ŋkunyeme. Enɔ tsitre ɖe Zion to la dzi, eye ame akpe alafa ɖeka blaene-vɔ-ene (

translation_verse: Mese gbe aɖe tso dziƒo abe tsi geɖewo ƒe hoowɔwɔ alo dzi ƒe gbeɖeɖe ene. Gbe si mese la nɔ abe kasaŋkuƒolawoe nɔ woƒe kasaŋkuwo ƒom ene.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Tete wodzi ha yeye le fiazikpui la ŋgɔ kple nu gbagbe eneawo kpakple amegãxoxoawo ƒe ŋkume. Ame aɖeke mete ŋu srɔ̃ ha la o, negbe ame akpe alafa ɖeka blaene-vɔ-ene (

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Ame siawoe nye ame siwo meƒo ɖi wo ɖokuiwo kple nyɔnunya o, elabena wowɔ wo ɖokuiwo kɔkɔe. Wokplɔa Alẽvi la ɖo yia afi sia afi si wòyina la. Woƒle wo tso amegbetɔwo dome, eye wotsɔ wo na Mawu kple Alẽvi la abe nukuwo ƒe gbãtɔwo ene.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Womekpɔ alakpa aɖeke le woƒe nu me o, elabena wonye mokakamanɔŋutɔwo. Mawudɔla etɔ̃awo kple woƒe gbedeasiwo

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu wònɔ dzodzom le yame, eye nyanyui mavɔ la le esi ne wòaɖe gbeƒãe na ame siwo le anyigba dzi, na dukɔ ɖe sia ɖe, to ɖe sia ɖe, gbegbɔgblɔ ɖe sia ɖe kple ƒome ɖe sia ɖe.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Egblɔ kple gbe gã aɖe be, “Mivɔ̃ Mawu, eye mitsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe nɛ, elabena eƒe ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe gaƒoƒo la va ɖo. Misubɔ eya ame si wɔ dziƒowo, anyigba, atsiaƒu kple tsi dzidziwo.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla evelia kplɔe ɖo le ɣli dom be, “Womui! Womu Babilonia Gã la, Babilonia si na dukɔwo no eƒe ahasiwɔwɔ ƒe dɔmedzoewain la.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla etɔ̃lia kplɔ wo ɖo le gbɔgblɔm kple gbe gã aɖe be, “Ne ame aɖe asubɔ lã wɔadã la kple eƒe legba, eye wòaxɔ eƒe dzesi ɖe ŋgonu alo eƒe asi ŋuti la,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: eya hã ano Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe wain si wokɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe dziku helĩhelĩ ƒe kplu la me wòyɔ banaa la. Woawɔ funyafunyae kple aŋɔdzo le mawudɔla kɔkɔeawo kple Alẽvi la ŋkume,

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: eye woƒe fuwɔame ƒe dzudzɔ atu ayi dziƒo tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me. Dzudzɔ aɖeke meli na ame siwo subɔ lã wɔadã la kple eƒe legba la zã kple keli, alo na ame si xɔ eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe dzesi ɖe eƒe ŋgonu o.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Esia hiã dzigbɔɖi le dzidodo me le ame kɔkɔeawo ƒe akpa dzi, ame siwo wɔa Mawu ƒe sededewo dzi, eye wonɔa nuteƒewɔwɔ dzi na Yesu.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Ke mese gbe aɖe tso dziƒo le gbɔgblɔm be, “Ŋlɔ agbalẽ be: Woayra ame siwo ku le Aƒetɔ la me tso azɔ dzi heyina.” “Ɛ̃,” Gbɔgbɔ la le gbɔgblɔm be, “Woadzudzɔ tso woƒe dɔwɔwɔwo me, elabena woƒe nuwɔnawo adze wo yome.” Xexeame ƒe nuŋeɣi la ɖo

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ lilikpo ɣi aɖe le nye ŋkume, eye ame aɖe si le abe Amegbetɔ Vi la ene la nɔ anyi ɖe lilikpo la dzi. Sikafiakuku le ta nɛ, eye wòlé nuxahɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ ɖe asi.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Kasia mawudɔla bubu do tso gbedoxɔ la me, eye wòdo ɣli kple gbe sesẽ gblɔ na ame si nɔ anyi ɖe lilikpo la dzi be, “Tsɔ wò nuxahɛ gobɛ la, eye nàxa nu, elabena nuŋeɣi ɖo, eye anyigba ƒe nukuwo ɖi hena xaxa.”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Ale ame si nɔ lilikpoa dzi la nye eƒe nuxahɛ gobɛ la ɖe anyigba blibo la tame, ale wòxa nukuwo le anyigba la dzi.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla bubu do tso gbedoxɔ si le dziƒo la me. Nuxahɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ nɔ eya hã ƒe asi me.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Mawudɔla bubu kplɔ eya hã ɖo; eyae nye ame si kpɔa dzo la dzi. Edo tso vɔsamlekpui la me, eye wògblɔ na ame si lé nuxahɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ la ɖe asi la kple gbe sesẽ aɖe be, “Tsɔ wò hɛ gobɛ ɖaɖɛ la, eye nàxa wainkpo siwo le anyigba ƒe wainkawo ŋu, elabena eƒe waintsetseawo ɖi.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla la nye eƒe nuxahɛ gobɛ la ɖe anyigba dzi, eye wòxa eƒe wain tsetsewo hetsɔ wo trɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe ƒe wainfiaƒe gã la.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Wonya avuzi le wo dzi le wainfiaƒe la le du la godo; ʋu si do le wainfiaƒe la me le ɖɔɖɔm va se ɖe sɔwo ƒe numegawo ŋuti ke; afi si wòsi ɖo la anɔ abe kilomita alafa etɔ̃ (

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Eye mekpɔ dzesi gã wɔnuku bubu le dziƒo: mawudɔla siwo lé dɔvɔ̃ adre mamlɛawo ɖe asi, mamlɛawo, elabena woawo me wowu Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe nu le.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Azɔ la, mekpɔ nane si le abe atsiaƒu si le abe ahuhɔ̃e si me biã hẽe abe dzo ene la, eye ame siwo ɖu lã wɔadã la kple eƒe legba kpakple eƒe ŋkɔ ƒe xexlẽmedzesi dzi la le tsitre ɖe atsiaƒu la to. Wolé kasaŋku siwo Mawu tsɔ na wo la ɖe asi,

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: eye wodzi Mose, Mawu ƒe dɔla ƒe ha kple Alẽvi la ƒe ha be, “Aƒetɔ Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, Wò nuwɔnawo lolo, eye wowɔ nuku. Wò dukɔwo ƒe fia, wò mɔwo le dzɔdzɔe, eye wonye nyateƒe.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: O Aƒetɔ, ame kae mavɔ̃ wò, eye wòatsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe ana wò ŋkɔ o? Elabena wò koe le kɔkɔe. Dukɔwo katã ava, eye woasubɔ wò, elabena woɖe wò nu dzɔdzɔe wɔwɔwo fia.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, mekpɔ gbedoxɔ si le dziƒo si nye ɖaseɖiɖi ƒe agbadɔ la wònɔ ʋuʋu.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla adre siwo lé dɔvɔ̃ adreawo ɖe asi la do tso gbedoxɔ la me. Wodo aklala biɖibiɖi ƒe awu dzadzɛwo, eye wotsɔ sikalidziblaka tso gae ɖe akɔta.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Tete nu gbagbe eneawo dometɔ ɖeka tsɔ sikagba adre siwo yɔ fũu kple Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ, Mawu si le agbe tegbetegbe la, na mawudɔla adreawo,

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: eye gbedoxɔ la me yɔ fũu kple dzudzɔ si tso Mawu ƒe ŋutikɔkɔe kple eƒe ŋusẽ gbɔ la. Ame aɖeke mete ŋu ge ɖe gbedoxɔ la me o, va se ɖe esime mawudɔla adreawo ƒe dɔvɔ̃ adreawo nu va yi.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Eye mese gbe gã aɖe tso gbedoxɔ la me le gbɔgblɔm na mawudɔla adreawo be, “Miyi ne miatrɔ Mawu ƒe dɔmedzoekplu adreawo kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla gbãtɔ yi ɖatrɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe anyigba dzi, eye dɔvɔ̃ la na be abi makumaku kple abi si nana wosea veve la kaka ɖe ame siwo xɔ lã wɔadã la ƒe dzesi, eye wosubɔ eƒe legba la dome.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla evelia trɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe atsiaƒu me, eye wòtrɔ zu ʋu si le abe ame kuku tɔ ene, eye nu gbagbe ɖe sia ɖe ku le atsiaƒu la me.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla etɔ̃lia trɔ eƒe kplu la kɔ ɖe tɔsisiwo kple tsi dzidziwo me, eye woawo hã trɔ zu ʋu.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Tete mese mawudɔla si kpɔa tsinyawo dzi la gblɔ be, “Wò la, wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ siawo le eteƒe. Wò, kɔkɔetɔ si li fifia, eye nènɔ anyi kpɔ la, Wò afiatsotsowo le eteƒe,

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: elabena wokɔ wò ame kɔkɔewo kple wo nyagblɔɖilawo ƒe ʋu ɖe anyi, eye nèkpe ʋu na wo be woano abe ale si dze wo ene.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Mese vɔsamlekpui la ɖo eŋu be, “Ɛ̃, Aƒetɔ Mawu, Ŋusẽkatãtɔ, wò ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃wo nye nyateƒe, eye wole dzɔdzɔe.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Mawudɔla enelia trɔ eƒe kplu la ɖe ɣe dzi, eye wòna ŋusẽ ɣe la be wòatsɔ dzo ƒe ŋusẽ aɖu amewoe.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Ɣe la ɖu wo vevie ale gbegbe be woƒo fi de Mawu ƒe ŋkɔ, ame si kpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe dɔvɔ̃ siawo dzi la. Ke wogbe be yewomatrɔ dzi me atsɔ ŋutikɔkɔe nɛ o.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.

translation_verse: Tete mekpɔ gbɔgbɔ makɔmakɔ etɔ̃ siwo ɖi akpɔkplɔwo la. Wodo tso ʋɔ driba la ƒe nu me kple lã wɔadã la ƒe nu me kple aʋatsonyagbɔɖila la ƒe nu me.

translation_verse: Wonye gbɔgbɔ vɔ̃ siwo le nukunuwo wɔm la, eye wodona yina ɖe xexemefiawo gbɔ, ne woaƒo wo nu ƒu hena aʋawɔwɔ le Mawu Ŋusẽkatãtɔ la ƒe ŋkeke gã la dzi.

translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna abe fiafitɔ ene! Woayra ame si le ŋudzɔ, eye wògale eƒe awuwo me la, be masi adzo amamae, eye wòaɖe eƒe ŋukpeƒe ɖe go o.”

translation_verse: Du gã la ma ɖe akpa etɔ̃ me, eye dukɔwo ƒe duwo mu dze anyi. Mawu ɖo ŋku Babilonia Gã la dzi, eye wòtsɔ kplu si yɔ fũu kple eƒe dɔmedzoe helĩhelĩ ƒe wain la nɛ.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Nya sia hiã na susu si me nunya le. Ta adreawo nye togbɛ adre siwo dzi nyɔnu la nɔ anyi ɖo la. Woganye fia adrewo hã.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Lã si nɔ anyi kpɔ, eye megali fifia o lae nye fia enyilia. Enye fia adreawo dometɔ ɖeka, eye wòyina ɖe eƒe tsɔtsrɔ̃ la me.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Dzo ewo siwo nèkpɔ la nye fia ewo siwo si fiaɖuƒe mesu haɖe o la, gake woana dziɖuɖuŋusẽ wo abe fiawo ene, kpe ɖe lã la ŋu hena gaƒoƒo ɖeka.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Woawɔ aʋa kple Alẽvi la, gake Alẽvi la aɖu wo dzi, elabena eyae nye aƒetɔwo ƒe Aƒetɔ kple fiawo ƒe Fia la, eye eƒe ame tiatiawo, ame siwo wòyɔ kple ame siwo dze eyome le anukware me la anɔ egbɔ.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Lã la kple eƒe dzo ewo siwo nèkpɔ la alé fu gbolo la, woahee va gbegblẽ me, eye woagblẽe ɖi amamae; woaɖu eƒe lã, eye woatɔ dzoe,

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.

translation_verse: Le esia megbe la, mekpɔ mawudɔla bubu wòɖi tso dziƒo gbɔna. Ŋusẽ gã aɖe nɔ esi, eye eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe na anyigba dzi klẽ.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Womagakpɔ akaɖi ƒe bibi le mewò akpɔ gbeɖe o. Nenema ke ŋugbetɔ kple ŋugbetɔsrɔ̃ ƒe gbe magaɖi le mewò akpɔ gbeɖe o. Wò asitsalawoe nye ame xɔŋkɔwo le xexea me; ètsɔ wò akunyawɔwɔ kplɔ dukɔwo katã trae.

translation_verse: Tete wògblɔ nam be, “Mègatre nyagblɔɖi siwo le agbalẽ sia me la nu o, elabena ɣeyiɣi la tu aƒe.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Vɔ̃wɔla nenɔ vɔ̃wɔwɔ dzi, ame vɔ̃ɖi nenɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi wɔwɔ dzi, nyuiwɔla hã nenɔ nyuiwɔwɔ dzi, eye ame si le kɔkɔe la, nenɔ kɔkɔenyenye dzi.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: “Kpɔ ɖa, megbɔna kpuie! Nye fetu kpe ɖe ŋutinye, eye maxe fe na ame sia ame le nu si wòwɔ la nu.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Nyee nye Alfa kple Omega, Gbãtɔ kple Mamlɛtɔ, Gɔmedzedze kple Nuwuwu.

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: “Woayra ame siwo nya woƒe awu ʋlayawo be woakpɔ mɔ ayi ɖe agbeti la gbɔ, eye be woato agboawo nu age ɖe du la me.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Ke avuwo, akunyawɔlawo, ahasiwɔlawo, hlɔ̃dolawo, trɔ̃subɔlawo kple ame siwo lɔ̃a aʋatso, eye wokanɛ hã la atsi agbo la godo.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Nye, Yesue dɔ nye mawudɔla be wòatsɔ ɖaseɖiɖi siawo na wò hena hameawo. Nyee nye Ke tso David me kple eƒe dzidzimevi. Nyee nye Ŋukeɣletivi Keklẽ la.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Gbɔgbɔ la kple ŋugbetɔ la gblɔ be, “Va!” Eye ame si le esem la hã negblɔ be, “Va!” Ne tsikɔ le ame aɖe wum la, neva; eye ame sia ame si lɔ̃ ko la, nexɔ agbetsi la no faa.

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Mele nu xlɔ̃m ame sia ame si le agbalẽ sia me nyagblɔɖiwo sem la be: Ne ame aɖe atsɔ nane akpe wo la, Mawu ana dɔvɔ̃ siwo katã ƒe nya woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ la me la nava edzi,

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: eye ne ame aɖe aɖe nya aɖewo le nyagblɔɖigbalẽ sia me la, Mawu mana wòakpɔ gome le agbeti la kple du kɔkɔe si ŋuti woƒo nu le le agbalẽ sia me la me o.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Ame si le ɖase ɖim le nu siawo ŋuti la gblɔ be, “Ɛ̃, megbɔna kpuie.” Amen. Va, Aƒetɔ Yesu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Aƒetɔ Yesu ƒe amenuveve nenɔ anyi kple Mawu ƒe amewo. Amen.
